book.name: 考研词汇
book.description: 考研英语高频核心词汇（含音标、释义与例句）

examples.text: He claimed that his parents had abandoned him...
examples.translation: 他声称父母遗弃了他。

examples.text: The road is strewn with abandoned vehicles.
examples.translation: 道路上满是弃置的车辆。

examples.text: The authorities have abandoned any attempt to distribute food...
examples.translation: 当局中止了分发食物的尝试。

examples.text: The scheme's investors, fearful of bankruptcy, decided to abandon the project.
examples.translation: 因为担心破产，该计划的投资者决定放弃这个项目。

examples.text: Logic had prevailed and he had abandoned the idea.
examples.translation: 最终理智占了上风，他打消了那个念头。

examples.text: We are scared to abandon ourselves to our feelings in case we seem weak or out of control.
examples.translation: 我们不敢放纵自己的情感，以免显得太过软弱或缺乏自制。

examples.text: He has spent money with gay abandon...
examples.translation: 他肆意挥霍钱财。

examples.text: Their permissiveness toward their children reflects the wild abandon of their own lives.
examples.translation: 他们对孩子的放任折射出他们自身生活的放浪形骸。

examples.text: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.
examples.translation: 全体船员秩序井然地准备弃船。

examples.text: He was suffering from pains in his abdomen.
examples.translation: 他感到腹部剧痛。

examples.text: I can't abide people who can't make up their minds...
examples.translation: 我受不了优柔寡断的人。

examples.text: She couldn't abide his success.
examples.translation: 她见不得他成功。

examples.text: The public never had faith in his ability to handle the job...
examples.translation: 公众从来不相信他有能力胜任这一职位。

examples.text: He has the ability to bring out the best in others.
examples.translation: 他能做到扬人之长。

examples.text: Her drama teacher spotted her ability...
examples.translation: 她的戏剧老师发现了她的才能。

examples.text: I have confidence in the ability of the players...
examples.translation: 我对于球员们的能力充满信心。

examples.text: They repeatedly questioned his leadership abilities...
examples.translation: 他们一再质疑他的领导才能。

examples.text: Does the school cater for all abilities?
examples.translation: 学校能够做到因材施教吗？

examples.text: I take care of them to the best of my abilities...
examples.translation: 我尽我所能地照顾他们。

examples.text: They tackled them to the best of their ability.
examples.translation: 他们竭尽全力给予解决。

meanings.meaning: 能；[经管] 有能力的；能干的

examples.text: The older child should be able to prepare a simple meal...
examples.translation: 那个年纪稍大的孩子应当会做一顿简单的饭菜。

examples.text: The company say they're able to keep pricing competitive...
examples.translation: 该公司说他们能够使定价保持竞争力。

examples.text: They seemed able to work together very efficiently.
examples.translation: 他们看来能很有效率地合作。

examples.text: You'll be able to read in peace...
examples.translation: 你就能安心地读书了。

examples.text: Have you been able to have any kind of contact?...
examples.translation: 你联系上了吗？

examples.text: It would be nice to be able to afford to retire earlier.
examples.translation: 无后顾之忧而能提早退休当是件幸事。

examples.text: ...one of the brightest and ablest members of the government...
examples.translation: 政府里最聪明能干的成员之一

examples.text: They are bright, intelligent, able and confident.
examples.translation: 他们聪明又智慧，能干又自信。

meanings.meaning: 反常的，不规则的；变态的

examples.text: ...abnormal heart rhythms and high anxiety levels.
examples.translation: 心律不齐和高度焦虑

examples.text: ...a child with an abnormal fear of strangers.
examples.translation: 过于认生的小孩

examples.text: ...abnormally high levels of glucose...
examples.translation: 异常高的葡萄糖水平

examples.text: This stops the cells from growing abnormally.
examples.translation: 这阻止了细胞畸形发育。

meanings.meaning: 在飞机上；[船] 在船上；在火车上

examples.text: She invited 750 people aboard the luxury yacht, the Savarona...
examples.translation: 她邀请了750人乘坐豪华游艇“萨瓦罗纳”号。

examples.text: They said goodbye to him as he got aboard the train at Union Station.
examples.translation: 当他在联合火车站登上火车之际，他们向他道别。

examples.text: It had taken two hours to load all the people aboard...
examples.translation: 花了两个小时才让所有乘客都上了船。

examples.text: The United States has a naval task force offshore, with two thousand marines aboard.
examples.translation: 美国在近海驻有海军特遣部队，船上共两千名海军陆战队官兵。

examples.text: The following year Parliament voted to abolish the death penalty for murder...
examples.translation: 议会于翌年表决对谋杀罪废除死刑。

examples.text: The whole system should be abolished.
examples.translation: 整个制度应该被废除。

examples.text: Stories abound about when he was in charge...
examples.translation: 关于他在任时的传闻多不胜数。

examples.text: Venice abounds in famous hotels...
examples.translation: 威尼斯有许多知名的酒店。

examples.text: The book abounds with close-up images from space.
examples.translation: 这本书里有大量拍自太空的特写照片。

meanings.meaning: 在附近的；四处走动的；在起作用的
大致；粗枝大叶；不拘小节的人

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, about is used after some verbs, nouns, and adjectives to introduce extra information. About is also often used after verbs of movement, such as ‘walk’ and ‘drive’, and in phrasal verbs such as ‘mess about’ and ‘set about’, especially in British English.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，about可用在一些动词、名词和形容词后引出附加信息。about还常用在walk, drive等表示动作的动词后或mess about，set about 等短语动词中，这类情况尤见于英国英语。

examples.text: She knew a lot about food...
examples.translation: 她对食物很在行。

examples.text: He never complains about his wife.
examples.translation: 他从不抱怨妻子。

examples.text: ...advice about exercise and diet...
examples.translation: 关于锻炼和饮食的建议

examples.text: Leadership is about the ability to implement change.
examples.translation: 领导才能就是要有实施变革的能力。

examples.text: 'I'm sorry about Patrick,' she said...
examples.translation: “我为帕特里克感到难过，”她说。

examples.text: I feel so guilty and angry about the whole issue.
examples.translation: 我对整件事深感内疚和气愤。

examples.text: Rachel was going to do something about Jacob...
examples.translation: 蕾切尔将对雅各布有所行动。

examples.text: He said he'd ask Nina for a divorce, but he never did anything about it.
examples.translation: 他说会跟尼娜提出离婚，可是他却从未付诸实际。

examples.text: There was a warmth and passion about him I never knew existed...
examples.translation: 他身上有一股我从不知道的热情和激情。

examples.text: I think there's something a little peculiar about the results of your test.
examples.translation: 我认为你的化验结果有点不对劲。

examples.text: In my local health centre there's about forty parking spaces...
examples.translation: 我们本地的保健中心约有40个停车位。

examples.text: The rate of inflation is running at about 2.7 percent.
examples.translation: 通货膨胀率大约为2.7%。

examples.text: Everyone was running about.
examples.translation: 大家都在跑来跑去。

examples.text: From 1879 to 1888 he wandered about Germany, Switzerland, and Italy...
examples.translation: 从1879到1888年，他游历于德国、瑞士和意大利等地。

examples.text: His hair was drifting about his shoulders like dirty snow.
examples.translation: 他的头发像脏兮兮的雪一样披散在肩上。

examples.text: Helen threw her arms about him...
examples.translation: 海伦张开双臂拥抱他。

examples.text: She was elegantly dressed with a double strand of pearls about her neck.
examples.translation: 她着装典雅，搭配着一条双层珍珠项链。

examples.text: There's lots of money about these days for schemes like this.
examples.translation: 近来这类计划资金充足。

examples.text: I think he's about to leave...
examples.translation: 我看他要走了。

examples.text: Argentina has lifted all restrictions on trade and visas are about to be abolished...
examples.translation: 阿根廷已经取消所有贸易限制，签证制也将废止。

examples.text: The film was about to start.
examples.translation: 电影快开场了。

examples.text: Despite considerable pain she has been getting out and about almost as normal...
examples.translation: 尽管还很痛，她已经基本上行动如常。

examples.text: The regulations were relaxed and the prisoners could get out and about a bit.
examples.translation: 规定有所放宽，犯人可以出去短暂放风。

examples.text: They often saw me out and about.
examples.translation: 他们经常看见我四处奔波。

examples.text: He lifted his hands above his head...
examples.translation: 他将双手举过头顶。

examples.text: Apartment 46 was a quiet apartment, unlike the one above it...
examples.translation: 和它楼上的那间不同，46号公寓很安静。

examples.text: He was staring into the mirror above him.
examples.translation: 他盯着在他上方的镜子。

examples.text: A long scream sounded from somewhere above.
examples.translation: 从上面什么地方传来一声长长的尖叫。

examples.text: ...a picture of the new plane as seen from above...
examples.translation: 这架新飞机的俯视图

examples.text: There are five bedrooms, a large attic above, and wine cellars below.
examples.translation: 有5间卧室，顶层是一个宽敞的阁楼，底下是酒窖。

examples.text: Several conclusions could be drawn from the results described above...
examples.translation: 从上文描述的结果中可以得出几个结论。

examples.text: Full details are in the table above.
examples.translation: 详细信息请见上文表格。

examples.text: For additional information, contact any of the above.
examples.translation: 如需更多信息，可与以上任何一处联系。

examples.text: For a copy of their brochure, write to the above address.
examples.translation: 欲索取其宣传册，请写信至以上地址。

examples.text: The temperature crept up to just above 40 degrees...
examples.translation: 温度攀升至40度出头。

examples.text: Victoria Falls has had above average levels of rainfall this year...
examples.translation: 维多利亚瀑布今年的降雨量超过了平均水平。

examples.text: These plants must be stored in the light at above freezing temperature...
examples.translation: 这些植物必须放置于零度以上光照充足的地方。

examples.text: Government spending is planned to rise 3 per cent above inflation.
examples.translation: 政府开支拟订高出通货膨胀3个百分点。

examples.text: Banks have been charging 25 percent and above for unsecured loans.
examples.translation: 银行对于没有担保的贷款一直收取25%或更高的费用。

examples.text: ...trying to talk above the noise...
examples.translation: 努力使说话声高过噪音

examples.text: Then there was a woman's voice, rising shrilly above the barking.
examples.translation: 接着，一个女人的尖厉声音盖过了犬吠声。

examples.text: I know you're above me socially, but I must say I find your attitude offensive...
examples.translation: 我明白你的社会地位比我高，但我得说我觉得你的态度很粗鲁。

examples.text: I married above myself — rich county people...
examples.translation: 我高攀了一门亲事，是县里的富有人家。

examples.text: Look at the people above you in the positions of power and see what type of characters they are.
examples.translation: 审视一下权位高于你的那些人，看他们具有哪种类型的性格。

examples.text: The policemen admitted beating the student, but said they were acting on orders from above.
examples.translation: 警察承认打过这名学生，但说他们只是奉命行事。

examples.text: I just think you're getting a little bit above yourself.
examples.translation: 我只是觉得你变得有点自视过高。

examples.text: This was clearly a failure by someone who thought he was above failure...
examples.translation: 这显然是认为自己根本不会失败的人所遭遇的一次失败。

examples.text: I'm not above doing my own cleaning.
examples.translation: 我很乐意自己做扫除。

examples.text: The Queen remains above criticism, apart from the issue of her tax liability...
examples.translation: 抛开她的纳税义务不谈，女王一直无可指摘。

examples.text: He was a respected academic and above suspicion.
examples.translation: 他是位受人尊敬的学者，根本没有嫌疑。

examples.text: ...his tendency to put the team above everything...
examples.translation: 他把这个团队看得比什么都重要的倾向

examples.text: I want to be honest, honest above everything else.
examples.translation: 我想要做到诚实，一切以诚实为上。

examples.text: I would love to go abroad this year, perhaps to the South of France.
examples.translation: 我今年很想出国，可能是去法国南部。

examples.text: ...public opposition here and abroad...
examples.translation: 国内外公众的反对

examples.text: He will stand in for Mr Goh when he is abroad...
examples.translation: 吴先生出国时由他代替。

examples.text: About 65 per cent of its sales come from abroad.
examples.translation: 大约65%的销量来自国外。

examples.text: There'll still be a feeling abroad that this change has to be recognised.
examples.translation: 人们还会普遍觉得这项变革早晚得接受。

meanings.meaning: 生硬的；突然的；唐突的；陡峭的

examples.text: Rosie's idyllic world came to an abrupt end when her parents' marriage broke up...
examples.translation: 父母婚姻的破裂使得罗茜田园诗般美好的世界陡然画上了句号。

examples.text: The recession brought an abrupt halt to this happiness...
examples.translation: 经济衰退让这幸福戛然而止。

examples.text: His abrupt departure is bound to raise questions.
examples.translation: 他的拂袖而去必然会招来很多疑问。

examples.text: He stopped abruptly and looked my way.
examples.translation: 他突然停下，朝我看过来。

examples.text: He was abrupt to the point of rudeness...
examples.translation: 他的唐突已到了无礼的地步。

examples.text: Cross was a little taken aback by her abrupt manner.
examples.translation: 她鲁莽的态度让克罗斯感到有点吃惊。

examples.text: 'Good night, then,' she said abruptly.
examples.translation: “那么，晚安，”她生硬地说道。

examples.text: I think Simon was hurt by your abruptness this afternoon.
examples.translation: 我觉得你下午的粗鲁行为对西蒙造成了伤害。

examples.text: ...a bundle of letters which had arrived for me in my absence...
examples.translation: 我不在期间寄给我的一大堆信件

examples.text: Eleanor would later blame her mother-in-law for her husband's frequent absences.
examples.translation: 埃莉诺过后会因丈夫经常不在家而责怪婆婆。

examples.text: The presence or absence of clouds can have an important impact on heat transfer...
examples.translation: 有无云层对热量的传递会产生重要的影响。

examples.text: In the absence of a will the courts decide who the guardian is.
examples.translation: 在没有遗嘱的情况下，由法庭指定监护人。

meanings.meaning: 缺席的；缺少的；心不在焉的；茫然的

examples.text: He has been absent from his desk for two weeks...
examples.translation: 他已经有两个星期没有坐在办公桌前了。

examples.text: The pictures, too, were absent from the walls...
examples.translation: 那些画也不在墙上了。

examples.text: Any soldier failing to report would be considered absent without leave and punished accordingly.
examples.translation: 士兵若未报到将被视为擅离职守而受处分。

examples.text: 'Nothing,' Rosie said in an absent way.
examples.translation: “没什么，”罗茜心不在焉地说。

examples.text: He nodded absently.
examples.translation: 他漫不经心地点了点头。

examples.text: ...absent fathers who fail to pay towards the costs of looking after their children.
examples.translation: 那些不在子女身边、未能支付抚养费的父亲

examples.text: She was old enough to absent herself from the lunch table if she chose...
examples.translation: 她长大了，可以自己做主不来吃午餐了。

examples.text: He pleaded guilty before a court martial to absenting himself without leave.
examples.translation: 在军事法庭上他对自己擅离职守表示服罪。

examples.text: Absent a solution, people like Sue Godfrey will just keep on fighting.
examples.translation: 假如得不到解决，像休·戈弗雷这样的人就会一直坚持斗争下去。

examples.text: It's not really suited to absolute beginners...
examples.translation: 它并不真正适合从零开始的初学者。

examples.text: A sick person needs absolute confidence and trust in a doctor.
examples.translation: 病人需要对医生有绝对的信心和信任。

examples.text: About 12 inches wide is the absolute minimum you should consider...
examples.translation: 12英寸左右的宽度绝对是你应考虑的最低值。

examples.text: I think it's absolute nonsense.
examples.translation: 我认为那十足是无稽之谈。

examples.text: He ruled with absolute power.
examples.translation: 他实行独裁统治。

examples.text: ...the doctrine of absolute monarchy based upon divine right.
examples.translation: 以神权为基础的君主专制学说

examples.text: John brought the absolute proof that we needed...
examples.translation: 约翰带来了我们所需的确凿证据。

examples.text: They had given an absolute assurance that it would be kept secret.
examples.translation: 他们信誓旦旦地保证将对此绝对保密。

examples.text: In absolute terms British wages remain low by European standards.
examples.translation: 根据欧洲标准，英国工资的绝对值依然很低。

examples.text: There are no absolute rules.
examples.translation: 世事无绝对。

examples.text: ...certain assumptions which are accepted without question as absolute truths.
examples.translation: 某些未经质疑就被作为绝对真理而全盘接受的假设

examples.text: We tend to think in absolutes.
examples.translation: 我们思考问题倾向于绝对化。

meanings.meaning: 吸收；吸引；承受；理解；使…全神贯注

examples.text: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air and moisture from the soil...
examples.translation: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳并从土壤中汲取水分。

examples.text: Refined sugars are absorbed into the bloodstream very quickly.
examples.translation: 精制糖迅速吸收进血液中。

examples.text: A household radiator absorbs energy in the form of electric current and releases it in the form of heat.
examples.translation: 家用取暖器吸收电流能量，再以热量的形式释放出来。

examples.text: The Colonial Office was absorbed into the Foreign Office.
examples.translation: 殖民部被并入了外交部。

examples.text: ...an economy capable of absorbing thousands of immigrants.
examples.translation: 能够吸纳数千移民的经济实体

examples.text: ...footwear which does not absorb the impact of the foot striking the ground.
examples.translation: 不具备减震功能的鞋子

examples.text: The banks would be forced to absorb large losses...
examples.translation: 银行将被迫承受巨大的损失。

examples.text: We can't absorb those costs.
examples.translation: 我们负担不起那些费用。

examples.text: It absorbed vast amounts of capital that could have been used for investment...
examples.translation: 它消耗掉了原本可用于投资的大笔资金。

examples.text: It might help if campaigning didn't absorb so much time and money.
examples.translation: 如果竞选活动没耗费这么多的时间和金钱，情况或许还不会这么糟。

examples.text: Too often he only absorbs half the information in the manual...
examples.translation: 他对于说明书上所说的经常是一知半解。

examples.text: We closed our offices at 2:00 p.m. to give employees time to absorb the bad news.
examples.translation: 我们下午两点就放工了，以便给员工时间来慢慢接受这一坏消息。

examples.text: ...a second career which absorbed her more completely than her acting ever had.
examples.translation: 比演艺生涯更让她投入的又一职业

meanings.meaning: 摘要；提取；使……抽象化；转移(注意力、兴趣等)；使心不在焉

examples.text: ...abstract principles such as justice...
examples.translation: 正义等抽象原则

examples.text: It's not a question of some abstract concept.
examples.translation: 这不是某个抽象概念的问题。

examples.text: ...the faculty of abstract reasoning.
examples.translation: 抽象推理的能力

examples.text: It is hard to think abstractly in these conditions.
examples.translation: 在这样的情况下进行抽象思维很困难。

examples.text: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.
examples.translation: 钱对她来说就是个抽象的东西，她从不去想钱。

examples.text: ...abstract words such as glory, honor, and courage.
examples.translation: 抽象名词，如光荣、荣耀和勇气

examples.text: ...a modern abstract painting.
examples.translation: 一幅现代派抽象画

examples.text: ...a licence to abstract water from the River Axe...
examples.translation: 从阿克斯河中抽水的许可证

examples.text: The author has abstracted poems from earlier books.
examples.translation: 作者从以前的书中摘取了一些诗作。

examples.text: It is absurd to be discussing compulsory redundancy policies for teachers...
examples.translation: 讨论针对教师的强制裁员政策真是滑稽可笑。

examples.text: I've known clients of mine go to absurd lengths, just to avoid paying me a few pounds...
examples.translation: 我知道我的一些客户就为了少付我几英镑，可谓无所不用其极。

examples.text: That's absurd.
examples.translation: 那非常荒谬。

examples.text: Parkinson had a sharp eye for the absurd.
examples.translation: 帕金森对于荒诞不经的事一眼即明。

examples.text: Prices were still absurdly low, in his opinion...
examples.translation: 在他看来，价格依然低得离谱。

examples.text: Absurdly, it makes shoppers overpay farmers to grow too much food.
examples.translation: 荒谬的是，这样会使得购物者支付过多的钱让农民去种太多的粮食。

examples.text: I find myself growing increasingly angry at the absurdity of the situation.
examples.translation: 对如此荒谬可笑的情况我感到越来越生气。

examples.text: ...the absurdities of fashionable childcare methods.
examples.translation: 时下流行的滑稽可笑的育婴法

examples.text: The area has an abundance of wildlife...
examples.translation: 这片地区有丰富的野生动植物。

examples.text: Food was in abundance.
examples.translation: 食品充足。

examples.text: There is an abundant supply of cheap labour...
examples.translation: 廉价劳动力供应充足。

examples.text: Birds are abundant in the tall vegetation.
examples.translation: 高大的植被中有着大量的鸟类。

meanings.meaning: 滥用；虐待；辱骂；弊端；恶习，陋习

examples.text: ...investigation of alleged child abuse.
examples.translation: 对涉嫌虐童案的调查

examples.text: ...victims of sexual and physical abuse.
examples.translation: 遭受性虐待及肉体摧残的受害者

examples.text: ...controversy over human rights abuses.
examples.translation: 关于践踏人权的争议

examples.text: I was left shouting abuse as the car sped off...
examples.translation: 汽车飞驰而去，留下我在那里大声咒骂。

examples.text: Raft repeatedly hurled verbal abuse at his co-star.
examples.translation: 拉夫特不断地破口大骂和他联合主演的演员。

examples.text: What went on here was an abuse of power.
examples.translation: 这里所发生的事是一种滥用职权的行为。

examples.text: ...drug and alcohol abuse.
examples.translation: 嗜毒和酗酒

examples.text: Janet had been abused by her father since she was eleven.
examples.translation: 珍妮特从11岁起就遭受父亲虐待。

examples.text: ...parents who feel they cannot cope or might abuse their children.
examples.translation: 认为自己应付不来或可能会虐待孩子的父母

examples.text: ...those who work with abused children.
examples.translation: 从事帮助受虐儿童的工作的人们

examples.text: ...a convicted child abuser.
examples.translation: 已定罪的虐童犯

examples.text: He alleged that he was verbally abused by other soldiers.
examples.translation: 他宣称自己遭到其他士兵的辱骂。

examples.text: He showed how the rich and powerful can abuse their position.
examples.translation: 他让我们看到有钱有势的人是如何滥用其地位的。

examples.text: ...the treatment of alcohol and drug abusers.
examples.translation: 对酗酒和嗜毒者的治疗

examples.text: Their academic standards are high...
examples.translation: 他们的教学水平很高。

examples.text: I was terrible at school and left with few academic qualifications...
examples.translation: 我的学习成绩一塌糊涂，离校时几乎没有学历。

examples.text: He is academically gifted...
examples.translation: 他在学习上很有天分。

examples.text: I was only average academically, but was good at sports.
examples.translation: 我学习成绩平平，但体育方面很出色。

examples.text: ...the start of the last academic year...
examples.translation: 最后一个学年的开始

examples.text: I'd had enough of academic life.
examples.translation: 学生生活我已经过够了。

examples.text: The author has settled for a more academic approach...
examples.translation: 那位作者已确定采用更为学术的方法。

examples.text: Different schools teach different types of syllabus, from the highly academic to the broadly vocational.
examples.translation: 不同的学校有不同的教学计划，从高度学术的到普通职业教育的，不一而足。

examples.text: The system is failing most disastrously among less academic children.
examples.translation: 这种制度对学习不太好的孩子效果最差。

examples.text: This was not an academic exercise — soldiers' lives were at risk...
examples.translation: 这不是纸上演习——士兵的生命受到了威胁。

examples.text: Such is the size of the problem that these arguments are purely academic.
examples.translation: 问题的实情在于这些论点纯属空谈。

meanings.meaning: 学院；研究院；学会；专科院校

examples.text: ...the Royal Academy of Music.
examples.translation: 皇家音乐学院

examples.text: ...her experience as a police academy instructor.
examples.translation: 她在警校当教官的经历

examples.text: ...the American Academy of Psychotherapists...
examples.translation: 美国心理治疗师学会

examples.text: The British Academy of Film and Television Arts.
examples.translation: 英国电影和电视艺术学院

examples.text: Growth will accelerate to 2.9 per cent next year...
examples.translation: 明年的增长会加快到2.9%。

examples.text: The government is to accelerate its privatisation programme.
examples.translation: 政府将加快其私有化计划的进程。

examples.text: Suddenly the car accelerated...
examples.translation: 汽车突然加速。

examples.text: She accelerated away from the kerb.
examples.translation: 她加速驶离了马路牙子。

meanings.meaning: 口音；重音；强调；特点；重音符号

examples.text: He had developed a slight American accent.
examples.translation: 他说话带上了一点轻微的美国口音。

examples.text: He is putting the accent on military readiness...
examples.translation: 他强调要保持备战状态。

examples.text: There is often a strong accent on material success.
examples.translation: 经常大力强调物质成就。

meanings.meaning: 接受；承认；承担；承兑；容纳

examples.text: Eventually Sam persuaded her to accept an offer of marriage...
examples.translation: 最终萨姆说服她接受了求婚。

examples.text: Your old clothes will be gratefully accepted by jumble sale organisers...
examples.translation: 旧货义卖的组织者会感激地领受您捐赠的旧衣物。

examples.text: All those invited to next week's peace conference have accepted.
examples.translation: 所有受邀参加下星期和平会谈的人都已同意出席。

examples.text: I do not accept that there is any kind of crisis in British science...
examples.translation: 我不相信英国科学界有什么危机。

examples.text: I don't think they would accept that view...
examples.translation: 我认为他们不会接受那种观点。

examples.text: He did not accept this reply as valid.
examples.translation: 他认为这个回答没有根据。

examples.text: ...a workforce generally accepted to have the best conditions in Europe.
examples.translation: 被普遍认为拥有欧洲最好的工作条件的劳动人口

examples.text: ...Britain's reluctance to accept a proposal for a single European currency...
examples.translation: 英国不愿接受单一欧洲货币的建议

examples.text: The Council will meet to decide if it should accept his resignation.
examples.translation: 委员会将召开会议决定是否接受他的辞呈。

examples.text: People will accept suffering that can be shown to lead to a greater good...
examples.translation: 如果能证明眼前的苦难会带来更大的好处，人们就会愿意承受。

examples.text: Urban dwellers often accept noise as part of city life...
examples.translation: 城市居民常将噪音当成城市生活的一部分。

examples.text: I wasn't willing to accept that her leaving was a possibility.
examples.translation: 我不愿接受她有可能离开的事实。

examples.text: We advised newspapers not to accept the advertising...
examples.translation: 我们建议报社不要承接这项广告。

examples.text: Cheques can only be accepted up to the value guaranteed on the card...
examples.translation: 支票的承兑金额不可高于卡上所担保的数额。

examples.text: Proof of postage will not be accepted as proof of receipt.
examples.translation: 邮资单据不能当作收据。

examples.text: All-male groups will not be accepted.
examples.translation: 清一色的男性团体将不被接纳。

examples.text: ...incentives to private landlords to accept young people as tenants.
examples.translation: 鼓励私人房东租房给年轻人的措施

examples.text: My grandparents have never had a problem accepting me...
examples.translation: 我的祖父母从来都是无条件地接受我。

examples.text: Many men still have difficulty accepting a woman as a business partner...
examples.translation: 许多男性仍然无法接受女性商业伙伴。

examples.text: Stephen Smith was accepted into the family like an adopted brother.
examples.translation: 这家人把斯蒂芬·史密斯视为养子一样当作一家人。

examples.text: The company cannot accept responsibility for loss or damage.
examples.translation: 公司不承担丢失或损坏的责任。

examples.text: The army refused to accept orders from the political leadership...
examples.translation: 军队拒绝接受政界领导层下达的命令。

examples.text: Don't automatically accept the solicitor recommended by the broker.
examples.translation: 别想当然地就接受中间人推荐的诉状律师。

examples.text: ...drugs which will fool the body into accepting transplants.
examples.translation: 能使身体顺利接受移植器官的药物

examples.text: The telephone booths accept 10 and 20 pence coins.
examples.translation: 电话亭可使用10便士和20便士的硬币。

examples.text: The Party is being degraded by its acceptance of secret donations...
examples.translation: 该党因私下接受捐赠而蒙羞。

examples.text: I sent them more than 6,000 cartoons before I had my one and only acceptance by them...
examples.translation: 我寄给他们6,000多幅漫画，最后才有1幅得以采用。

examples.text: Several shareholders have withdrawn earlier acceptances of the offer.
examples.translation: 几个股东对于先前同意的报价又反悔了。

examples.text: ...a letter of acceptance.
examples.translation: 中标函

examples.text: ...his acceptance speech for the Nobel Peace Prize.
examples.translation: 他的诺贝尔和平奖获奖感言

examples.text: ...a theory that is steadily gaining acceptance...
examples.translation: 逐步得到承认的理论

examples.text: There was a general acceptance that the defence budget would shrink.
examples.translation: 人们普遍相信国防预算将会缩减。

examples.text: Popular acceptance of authority had been an early aim of the Nationalists.
examples.translation: 国家主义者的一个早期目标是推动民众对权威的接受。

examples.text: ...his calm acceptance of whatever comes his way.
examples.translation: 他遇事泰然处之的态度

examples.text: Car manufacturers are already producing small numbers of electric vehicles to test customer acceptance...
examples.translation: 汽车制造商们已经开始生产少量的电动车辆以测试顾客的接受程度。

examples.text: Avant-garde music to this day has not found general public acceptance.
examples.translation: 先锋音乐时至今日都没有得到大众的广泛认可。

examples.text: ...an effort to ensure that the disabled achieve real acceptance.
examples.translation: 为确保残疾人真正得到接纳而作出的努力

examples.text: The facilities have been adapted to give access to wheelchair users.
examples.translation: 这些设施已经改造过以方便轮椅使用者进入。

examples.text: Scientists have only recently been able to gain access to the area...
examples.translation: 科学家直到最近才得以进入该地区。

examples.text: The Mortimer Hotel offers easy access to central London.
examples.translation: 从莫蒂默旅馆去往伦敦市中心交通近便。

examples.text: ...a Code of Practice that would give patients right of access to their medical records.
examples.translation: 允许病人查看自己病历的职业准则

examples.text: ...whether one has access to a dish and the other accoutrements needed to watch satellite TV.
examples.translation: 是否能使用碟型卫星天线以及其他观看卫星电视所需要的装备

examples.text: He was not allowed access to a lawyer.
examples.translation: 他未被获准见律师。

examples.text: My ex-wife deliberately sabotages my access to the children.
examples.translation: 我的前妻蓄意阻挠我见孩子。

examples.text: You've illegally accessed and misused confidential security files.
examples.translation: 你已经非法访问并盗用了机密的安全文件。

examples.text: ...an exclusive range of hand-made bedroom and bathroom accessories.
examples.translation: 独家经营的一系列手工卧室和浴室配件

examples.text: She was charged with being an accessory to the embezzlement of funds.
examples.translation: 她被指控为这起挪用公款案的从犯。

examples.text: Forster established the essentiality of minerals as accessory food factors required for maintaining life.
examples.translation: 福斯特证实了矿物质作为辅助食物因子在维持生命方面的重要性。

meanings.meaning: 事故；意外；[法] 意外事件；机遇

examples.text: She was involved in a serious car accident last week...
examples.translation: 上星期她卷入了一场严重的车祸。

examples.text: Six passengers were killed in the accident.
examples.translation: 六名乘客在车祸中丧生。

examples.text: 5,000 people die every year because of accidents in the home...
examples.translation: 每年有5,000人死于家中的意外事故。

examples.text: The police say the killing of the young man was an accident.
examples.translation: 警方说这个年轻人被杀是一个意外。

examples.text: She discovered the problem by accident...
examples.translation: 她碰巧发现了这个问题。

examples.text: Almost like an accident of nature, this family has produced more talent than seems possible.
examples.translation: 就像是天缘巧合，这个家族不可思议地人才辈出。

examples.text: A lot of the city's buildings are accidents waiting to happen.
examples.translation: 该城市中许多楼房都存在事故隐患。

examples.text: It's no accident that the boom in police series on TV coincided with the decline of the Western.
examples.translation: 警匪剧在电视上盛行之时恰好是西部片衰退之际，这并非偶然。

meanings.meaning: 意外的；偶然的；附属的；临时记号的
次要方面；非主要的特性；临时记号

examples.text: The jury returned a verdict of accidental death...
examples.translation: 陪审团作出意外死亡的正式裁决。

examples.text: His hand brushed against hers; it could have been either accidental or deliberate.
examples.translation: 就在有意无意间，他的手轻轻拂过她的手。

examples.text: A policeman accidentally killed his two best friends with a single bullet...
examples.translation: 一名警察不慎一枪打死了他的两个挚友。

examples.text: A special locking system means the door cannot be opened accidentally.
examples.translation: 特殊的锁定系统使门不会被意外打开。

examples.text: She has been acclaimed for the TV drama 'Prime Suspect'...
examples.translation: 她凭借电视剧《头号嫌疑犯》而受到好评。

examples.text: He was acclaimed as England's greatest modern painter...
examples.translation: 他被誉为英格兰现代最伟大的油画家。

examples.text: The group's debut album was immediately acclaimed a hip hop classic.
examples.translation: 这个组合的首张专辑一经推出便被盛赞为嘻哈乐的经典之作。

examples.text: She has published six highly acclaimed novels.
examples.translation: 她出版了六本备受赞誉的小说。

examples.text: Angela Bassett has won critical acclaim for her excellent performance...
examples.translation: 安吉拉·贝塞特凭借其出色的表演赢得了评论界的好评。

examples.text: All this equipment has received international acclaim from the specialist hi-fi press.
examples.translation: 这套设备受到全球高保真音响专业报刊的赞誉。

examples.text: The school in Poldown was not big enough to accommodate all the children...
examples.translation: 波尔登的学校不够大，容不下所有的孩子。

examples.text: The CD-ROMs will accommodate the works of all English poets from 600 to 1900.
examples.translation: 这些光盘能存下从公元600年到1900年所有英国诗人的作品。

examples.text: ...a hotel built to accommodate guests for the wedding of King Alfonso...
examples.translation: 一家为接待前来参加阿方索国王婚礼的来宾而建的宾馆

examples.text: Students are accommodated in homes nearby.
examples.translation: 学生被安置在附近的住家中。

examples.text: The roads are built to accommodate gradual temperature changes...
examples.translation: 修建这些道路时考虑到了温度的逐渐变化。

examples.text: The way that American history is taught may change in order to accommodate some more of those cultures.
examples.translation: 美国历史的授课方式可能会为了照顾到更多的文化而作改变。

examples.text: He has never put an arm around his wife to accommodate photographers...
examples.translation: 他从未为了迎合摄影师而搂住妻子。

examples.text: He's already altered several of the proposals in his economic plan to accommodate demands of special interests.
examples.translation: 他已经改动了经济计划中的几项提议以迁就特殊利益集团的要求。

examples.text: Some animal and plant species cannot accommodate to the rapidly changing conditions...
examples.translation: 某些种类的动植物不能适应迅速变化的环境。

examples.text: She walked slowly to accommodate herself to his pace.
examples.translation: 她走得很慢，以便与他保持一致的步伐。

meanings.meaning: 住处，膳宿；调节；和解；预订铺位

examples.text: The government will provide temporary accommodation for up to three thousand people...
examples.translation: 政府将给多达3,000人提供临时住处。

examples.text: Prices start at £1,095 per person, including flights, hotel accommodation and various excursions...
examples.translation: 起价为单人1,095英镑，包括机票、旅店住宿和各种出游费用。

examples.text: Rates are higher for deluxe accommodations.
examples.translation: 豪华间收费较高。

examples.text: The school occupies split-site accommodation on the main campus...
examples.translation: 该学院分散在主校区不同地点。

examples.text: Some trains carry bicycles, but accommodation is restricted so a reservation is essential.
examples.translation: 有些火车可以运载自行车，但因空间有限需要提前预订。

examples.text: His instinct would be to seek a new accommodation with the nationalists...
examples.translation: 他本能的反应会是寻求与民族主义者取得新的和解。

examples.text: Religions, to survive, must make accommodations with the larger political structures that nurture them.
examples.translation: 为了生存，宗教必须同其赖以存在的更大的政治体系相调和。

examples.text: Ken agreed to accompany me on a trip to Africa...
examples.translation: 肯答应陪我一起去非洲。

examples.text: She was accompanied by her younger brother...
examples.translation: 她由弟弟陪着。

examples.text: The Prime Minister, accompanied by the governor, led the President up to the house.
examples.translation: 首相在州长陪同下带领总统前往那座房子。

examples.text: This volume of essays was designed to accompany an exhibition in Cologne...
examples.translation: 这本文集是为配合在科隆举办的一场展览而出的。

examples.text: The proposal was instantly voted through with two to one in favour, accompanied by enthusiastic applause...
examples.translation: 在热烈的掌声中，提案以2比1的优势很快通过了表决。

examples.text: Perhaps the accompanying illustration will explain it.
examples.translation: 可能所附的图表能对此作出解释。

examples.text: He sang and Alice accompanied him on the piano...
examples.translation: 他一边唱，艾丽斯一边为他钢琴伴奏。

examples.text: We ended with Blake's Jerusalem, accompanied on the organ by Herbert Wiseman.
examples.translation: 在赫伯特·怀斯曼的风琴伴奏下，我们演唱了布莱克的《耶路撒冷》作为终曲。

examples.text: If we'd all work together, I think we could accomplish our goal...
examples.translation: 只要大家齐心协力，我想我们就能实现目标。

examples.text: They are skeptical about how much will be accomplished by legislation.
examples.translation: 他们对于立法成效心存疑虑。

examples.text: ...a fitting way to celebrate the peace accord.
examples.translation: 庆祝和平协定的恰当的方式

examples.text: His predecessor was accorded an equally tumultuous welcome...
examples.translation: 他的前任受到了同样热烈的欢迎。

examples.text: The government accorded him the rank of Colonel...
examples.translation: 政府授予他上校军衔。

examples.text: The treatment accorded to a United Nations official was little short of insulting.
examples.translation: 联合国官员所受到的这种待遇几近羞辱。

examples.text: Such an approach accords with the principles of socialist ideology.
examples.translation: 这种方法与社会主义意识形态的原则相符。

examples.text: ...scientific evidence that did not fully accord with the facts uncovered by the police.
examples.translation: 与警方所掌握的情况不完全一致的科学证据

examples.text: ...this military action, taken in accord with United Nations resolutions...
examples.translation: 依据联合国决议而采取的本次军事行动

examples.text: Old enemies can become new friends even if all their national interests are not in complete accord.
examples.translation: 即使国家利益不尽相同，他们也可以化敌为友。

examples.text: In many cases the disease will clear up of its own accord.
examples.translation: 这种病很多情况下会自愈。

examples.text: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.
examples.translation: 他辞去法国总理职务并非出于自愿。

examples.text: With one accord they turned and walked back over the grass.
examples.translation: 他们步调一致地转身走过草坪。

examples.text: Entries which are not in accordance with the rules will be disqualified.
examples.translation: 不符合规定的参赛作品将被取消资格。

meanings.meaning: 根据，按照；取决于；据…所说

examples.text: Philip stayed at the hotel, according to Mr Hemming...
examples.translation: 据亨明先生所说，菲利普住在旅馆里。

examples.text: He and his father, according to local gossip, haven't been in touch for years.
examples.translation: 当地风传，他和父亲已多年未联系了。

examples.text: They both played the game according to the rules...
examples.translation: 他们俩都依章行事。

examples.text: They must take their own decision according to their own legal advice.
examples.translation: 他们必须根据各自律师的意见自行决定。

examples.text: Prices vary according to the quantity ordered...
examples.translation: 价格随订购数量不同而有所变化。

examples.text: The route that the boatmen choose varies according to the water level.
examples.translation: 船夫选择的路线会随水位的变化而有所不同。

examples.text: If all goes according to plan, the first concert will be Tuesday evening.
examples.translation: 如果一切都按计划进行的话，第一场音乐会将在星期二晚上举行。

examples.text: We have a different background, a different history. Accordingly, we have the right to different futures...
examples.translation: 我们有不同的背景和不同的历史。因此，我们有权拥有不同的未来。

examples.text: The workforce have recently been calling for their working hours to be reduced. Many companies have accordingly switched to a five-day week.
examples.translation: 工人们最近一直在呼吁缩短工作时间。许多公司于是转成了一周五天工作制。

examples.text: It is a difficult job and they should be paid accordingly...
examples.translation: 这是份棘手的工作，他们应得到相应的报酬。

examples.text: The new government will make a judgment about its interests and act accordingly.
examples.translation: 新政府将对其利害得失作出判断，并采取相应的行动。

examples.text: Hammond is the archetypal Anglo-Saxon accountant, given to blue blazers and cavalry twill slacks.

meanings.meaning: 账户；解释；账目，账单；理由

examples.text: Some banks make it difficult to open an account...
examples.translation: 一些银行把开户弄得很麻烦。

examples.text: I had two accounts with Natwest, a savings account and a current account.
examples.translation: 我在国民威斯敏斯特银行有两个账户，一个储蓄账户和一个活期存款账户。

examples.text: Biggart Donald, the Glasgow-based marketing agency, has won two Edinburgh accounts.
examples.translation: 比加特·唐纳德，这家驻格拉斯哥的营销代理公司已赢得了两个爱丁堡的客户。

examples.text: He kept detailed accounts.
examples.translation: 他记明细账。

examples.text: ...an account book.
examples.translation: 账本

examples.text: He gave a detailed account of what happened on the fateful night...
examples.translation: 他详细描述了那个灾难性夜晚所发生的事。

examples.text: According to police accounts, Mr and Mrs Hunt were found dead on the floor of their kitchen.
examples.translation: 据警方称，亨特夫妇被发现死在家里厨房的地板上。

examples.text: This basic utilitarian model gives a relatively unsophisticated account of human behaviour...

examples.text: I tried to adopt a curled-up position to avoid damaging my limbs.
examples.translation: 我努力保持蜷曲的姿势以免四肢受伤。

examples.text: Podulski had joined the U.S. Navy as an aviator, adopting a new country and a new profession.
examples.translation: 波度尔斯基加入美国海军当上了飞行员，不仅改了国籍还换了行当。

examples.text: ...their adopted home in England.
examples.translation: 他们移居英国的家

examples.text: He has adopted the accent of a Second World War newscaster...
examples.translation: 他承袭了二战时期播音员的口音。

examples.text: The girl was uncertain what to do, or what tone of voice to adopt.
examples.translation: 女孩不知道该做什么，也不知道该用什么口气说。

examples.text: She adored her parents and would do anything to please them.
examples.translation: 她很爱自己的父母，为让他们高兴愿意做任何事。

examples.text: My mother adores bananas and eats two a day...
examples.translation: 我妈妈非常喜欢吃香蕉，每天要吃两根。

examples.text: I adore good books and the theatre.
examples.translation: 我爱读好书，也喜欢看戏。

examples.text: Becoming a father signified that he was now an adult...
examples.translation: 当了父亲意味着他已是个成年人了。

examples.text: Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
examples.translation: 14岁以下的儿童必须由成人陪同。

examples.text: ...a pair of adult birds.
examples.translation: 一对成年鸟

examples.text: I've lived most of my adult life in London.
examples.translation: 我成年之后的大部分时间都是在伦敦度过的。

examples.text: We were very adult about it. We discussed it rationally over a drink.
examples.translation: 在这件事上我们表现得很成熟。我们一边喝酒一边心平气和地谈了谈。

examples.text: ...dealing with emerging sexuality in an adult way.
examples.translation: 平静对待出现的性征

examples.text: ...an adult movie.
examples.translation: 成人电影

meanings.meaning: 提出；预付；使……前进；将……提前

examples.text: Reports from Chad suggest that rebel forces are advancing on the capital...
examples.translation: 来自乍得的报告显示叛军正向首都推进。

examples.text: The water is advancing at a rate of 5cm a day...
examples.translation: 水位正以每天5厘米的速度上升。

examples.text: ...a picture of a man throwing himself before an advancing tank.
examples.translation: 一名男子冲向迎面开来的坦克的一幅照片

examples.text: Medical technology has advanced considerably...
examples.translation: 医学技术突飞猛进。

examples.text: Japan has advanced from a rural, feudal society to an urban, industrial power.
examples.translation: 日本已从封建农业社会发展成一个城市化工业强国。

examples.text: I advanced him some money, which he would repay on our way home...
examples.translation: 我先借给他一些钱，在我们回家的路上他会还给我的。

examples.text: The bank advanced $1.2 billion to help the country with debt repayments.
examples.translation: 银行预支12亿美元帮助该国偿还债务。

examples.text: She was paid a £100,000 advance for her next two novels.
examples.translation: 她接下来的两部小说得到了10万英镑的预付稿费。

examples.text: Too much protein in the diet may advance the ageing process...
examples.translation: 饮食中摄入过量蛋白质可能会加速衰老。

examples.text: The country's election commission has advanced the date of parliamentary elections by three days.
examples.translation: 该国的选举委员会将议会选举日期提前了3天。

examples.text: When not producing art of his own, Oliver was busy advancing the work of others.
examples.translation: 奥利弗在不搞自己的艺术创作时，就会忙着帮助别人完成作品。

examples.text: Many theories have been advanced as to why some women suffer from depression...
examples.translation: 就一些女性患抑郁症的原因，各种说法纷至沓来。

examples.text: An important set of ideas have been advanced by the biologist Rupert Sheldrake.
examples.translation: 生物学家鲁珀特·谢尔德雷克已提出了一整套重要的观点。

examples.text: ...an advance on enemy positions...
examples.translation: 向敌方阵地推进

examples.text: The defences are intended to obstruct any advance by tanks and other vehicles.
examples.translation: 这些防御工事用于阻止坦克等车辆前进。

examples.text: Mark had for some time been making advances towards her...
examples.translation: 马克追她已经有一段时间了。

examples.text: She rejected his advances during the trip to Cannes.
examples.translation: 在去往戛纳的途中，她拒绝了他的挑逗。

examples.text: Air safety has not improved since the dramatic advances of the 1970s...
examples.translation: 航空安全自从20世纪70年代得到显著提高之后，至今再没有任何改善。

examples.text: Their progress at work was mirrored by their children's educational advance.
examples.translation: 子女在学业上有所进步，他们在工作上也就会有所起色。

examples.text: This could be an advance on the present situation.
examples.translation: 这样可能会改善当前状况。

examples.text: They don't normally give any advance notice about which building they're going to inspect...
examples.translation: 他们一般不会预先通知检查哪座大楼。

examples.text: The event received little advance publicity.
examples.translation: 关于该事件事先几乎没有报道。

examples.text: The 20-strong advance party will be followed by another 600 soldiers as part of UN relief efforts.
examples.translation: 作为联合国救援行动的一部分，在这支由20多人组成的先头部队之后还将增派600名士兵。

examples.text: I had asked everyone to submit questions in advance of the meeting.
examples.translation: 我已请每个人在会议之前提交问题。

examples.text: The subject of the talk is announced a week in advance.
examples.translation: 会谈的主题已提前一周宣布。

meanings.meaning: 先进的；高级的；晚期的；年老的
前进；增加；上涨（advance的过去式和过去分词形式）

examples.text: Without more training or advanced technical skills, they'll lose their jobs.
examples.translation: 没有进一步的培训或高级技能的话，他们就会丢掉工作。

examples.text: ...the most advanced optical telescope in the world.
examples.translation: 世界上最先进的光学望远镜

examples.text: ...a technologically advanced society.
examples.translation: 科技发达的社会

examples.text: The course is suitable for beginners and advanced students...
examples.translation: 本课程适合初学者及程度较高者。

examples.text: The lab has recently been updated to allow for more advanced courses.
examples.translation: 实验室最近经过更新，可以上更高阶的课程了。

examples.text: 'Medicare' is available to victims of advanced kidney disease...
examples.translation: 老年医疗保险也适用于肾病晚期患者。

examples.text: His ideas should be more advanced by the time the Committee meets in Edinburgh in October.
examples.translation: 到委员会10月份在爱丁堡开会时，他的观点应该更为成熟了。

examples.text: The gentleman, despite his advanced years, helped Kathryn back to her seat.
examples.translation: 这位绅士，尽管年事已高，仍然帮着凯瑟琳回到座位上。

examples.text: They are deliberately flouting the law in order to obtain an advantage over their competitors...
examples.translation: 他们为了和竞争对手抢夺先机而公然无视法律。

examples.text: A good crowd will be a definite advantage to me and the rest of the team.
examples.translation: 大批观众无疑将成为我和其他队员的一大优势。

examples.text: Men have created a social and economic position of advantage for themselves over women.
examples.translation: 男性已经为自己创造了优于女性的社会和经济上的有利地位。

examples.text: The great advantage of home-grown oranges is their magnificent flavour...
examples.translation: 家产柑橘的一大好处是口感极佳。

examples.text: This custom-built kitchen has many advantages over a standard one.
examples.translation: 这间定制的厨房与标准厨房相比存在诸多优点。

examples.text: I intend to take full advantage of this trip to buy the things we need.
examples.translation: 我打算充分利用这次旅行来购买我们所需的物品。

examples.text: She took advantage of him even after they were divorced.
examples.translation: 甚至在他们离婚后，她还在占他的便宜。

examples.text: The government have not been able to turn today's demonstration to their advantage.
examples.translation: 政府未能把今天的游行示威转为己用。

examples.text: The walls were painted in muted tones to show the pictures to good advantage.
examples.translation: 墙面被漆成了淡色调，以突出照片。

meanings.meaning: 到来；出现；基督降临；基督降临节

examples.text: Odessa was cosmopolitan long before the post-Soviet advent of international cuisine now prevalent in the city.

meanings.meaning: 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动

examples.text: I set off for a new adventure in the United States on the first day of the new year.
examples.translation: 新年第一天，我在美国开始了一次新的冒险。

examples.text: Their cultural backgrounds gave them a spirit of adventure.
examples.translation: 他们的文化背景赋予了他们一种冒险精神。

examples.text: ...a feeling of adventure and excitement.
examples.translation: 惊险刺激的感觉

examples.text: The group has adventured as far as the Austrian alps.
examples.translation: 该队伍的探险之旅远至奥地利的阿尔卑斯山。

examples.text: It pours out, angrily, aggressively and if uglily were an adverb it would do that too.

meanings.meaning: 不利的；相反的；敌对的（名词adverseness，副词adversely）

examples.text: The police said Mr Hadfield's decision would have no adverse effect on the progress of the investigation...
examples.translation: 警方称哈德菲尔德先生的决定将不会对调查的进展造成不利影响。

examples.text: Despite the adverse conditions, the road was finished in just eight months.
examples.translation: 尽管存在种种不利情况，公路还是仅用8个月就完工了。

examples.text: Price changes must not adversely affect the living standards of the people.
examples.translation: 物价变化一定不能给人们的生活水准带来负面影响。

examples.text: The players can advertise baked beans, but not rugby boots...
examples.translation: 球员可以给烤菜豆做广告，但不能代言橄榄球靴。

examples.text: In 1991, the house was advertised for sale at $49,000...
examples.translation: 1991年，这座房子登广告出售，售价为49,000美元。

examples.text: Religious groups are currently not allowed to advertise on television.
examples.translation: 目前禁止宗教团体在电视上做广告。

examples.text: We advertised for staff in a local newspaper...
examples.translation: 我们在一家地方报纸上刊登了招聘广告。

examples.text: I shall advertise for someone to go with me.
examples.translation: 我将登广告寻人和我同去。

examples.text: His hard sinewy body advertised his ruthlessness of purpose.
examples.translation: 他健硕的身体使他显得意志尤为坚强。

examples.text: There is no need to advertise the fact that you are a single woman...
examples.translation: 没有必要张扬你是一个单身女性。

examples.text: I didn't want to advertise the fact that he hadn't driven me to the airport.
examples.translation: 我不想宣扬他没有开车送我去机场的事。

examples.text: Don't be afraid to ask for advice about ordering the meal...
examples.translation: 点餐时可以大胆征求意见。

examples.text: Your community officer can give you advice on how to prevent crime in your area...
examples.translation: 社区工作人员能就如何预防社区内犯罪提供一些忠告。

examples.text: Take my advice and stay away from him!...
examples.translation: 听我的，离他远远的！

examples.text: Most foreign nationals have now left the country on the advice of their governments.
examples.translation: 大多数外国人听从本国政府的建议离开了该国。

examples.text: We are taking advice on legal steps to recover the money...
examples.translation: 我们正在就追回该款项所需的法律程序咨询律师。

examples.text: If you are prosecuted by the police, then it is essential that you take specialist legal advice.
examples.translation: 如果你受到警方起诉，至关重要的是你要听取专业律师的意见。

examples.text: Because of the popularity of the region, it is advisable to book hotels or camp sites in advance...
examples.translation: 鉴于该地区很受人们青睐，最好提前预订旅馆或宿营地。

examples.text: It is generally not advisable for expectant mothers to travel by air after the 28th week of pregnancy.
examples.translation: 怀孕28周以后的准妈妈一般不宜乘坐飞机出行。

examples.text: I have doubts about the advisability of surgery in this case.
examples.translation: 关于该病例做手术的可行性，我持有疑问。

meanings.meaning: 建议；劝告，忠告；通知；警告

examples.text: The minister advised him to leave as soon as possible...
examples.translation: 部长建议他尽快离开。

examples.text: Herbert would surely advise her how to approach the bank...
examples.translation: 赫伯特一定会就如何与银行接洽向她提供意见。

examples.text: I would strongly advise against it...
examples.translation: 我强烈建议反对此事。

examples.text: Doctors advised that he should be transferred to a private room.
examples.translation: 医生们建议将他转到单人病房。

examples.text: ...an officer who advises undergraduates on money matters...
examples.translation: 为本科生们提供理财建议的高级职员

examples.text: A family doctor will be able to advise on suitable birth control.
examples.translation: 家庭医生能够就合适的节育措施提出建议。

examples.text: ...the decision requiring police to advise suspects of their rights...
examples.translation: 要求警方告知疑犯他们所享权利的决定

examples.text: I think it best that I advise you of my decision to retire.
examples.translation: 我想我最好告诉你我决定退役。

examples.text: Candidates in India are advised to submit their applications through the overseas student office in London...
examples.translation: 印度的申请人被告知通过驻伦敦的海外学生办公室递交申请表。

examples.text: Residents are advised not to put their rubbish bags on the pavement outside their houses.
examples.translation: 居民被告知不要将垃圾袋放在门外的人行道上。

examples.text: Mr Williams is a conservative who advocates fewer government controls on business.
examples.translation: 威廉斯先生是个保守派，主张政府应减少对商业的控制。

examples.text: ...the tax policy advocated by the Opposition.
examples.translation: 反对党提倡的税收政策

examples.text: He was a strong advocate of free market policies and a multi-party system.
examples.translation: 他是自由市场政策和多党派制度的坚决拥护者。

examples.text: ...advocates for the homeless...
examples.translation: 为无家可归的人谋利益者

examples.text: Animal rights advocates argue that zoos are really animal prisons and very often cruel.
examples.translation: 动物权利保护者指出动物园实际上是动物的牢笼，经常很残酷地对待动物。

meanings.meaning: 空中的，航空的；空气的；空想的

examples.text: Weeks of aerial bombardment had destroyed factories and highways...
examples.translation: 数周的空中轰炸已经摧毁了许多工厂和公路。

examples.text: Patterns that are invisible on the ground can be the most striking part of an aerial photograph...
examples.translation: 地面上看不出来的图案可能会成为航拍照片中最引人注目的东西。

examples.text: The film begins with an aerial view of the Great Basin of Nevada.
examples.translation: 影片以空中鸟瞰内华达大盆地的镜头开始。

examples.text: The seagulls swirled in aerial combat over the barges.
examples.translation: 海鸥盘旋在驳船上方，展开空中的搏斗。

examples.text: ...a saucer-shaped satellite television aerial.
examples.translation: 碟状的卫星电视天线

examples.text: ...the radio aerials of taxis and cars.
examples.translation: 出租车和轿车的无线电天线

examples.text: Sitting in the Audi urban concept is like sitting in the cockpit of an aeroplane.

meanings.meaning: 美的；美学的；审美的，具有审美趣味的

examples.text: ...products chosen for their aesthetic appeal as well as their durability and quality.
examples.translation: 因其外形美观且经久耐用、质量上乘而被选定的产品

examples.text: He responded very strongly to the aesthetic of this particular work.
examples.translation: 他强烈地感受到这件作品的美学价值。

examples.text: There is nothing aesthetically pleasing about this bridge.
examples.translation: 这座桥无法给人以美的享受。

meanings.meaning: 事情；事务；私事；（尤指关系不长久的）风流韵事

examples.text: The government has mishandled the whole affair...
examples.translation: 政府对整个事件处理不当。

examples.text: The affair began when customs officials inspected a convoy of 60 tankers...
examples.translation: 就在海关关员检查一个60艘油轮的船队时，事情发生了。

examples.text: The industry minister described the affair as 'an absolute scandal'.
examples.translation: 工业部长将此事件形容为“绝对的丑闻”。

examples.text: ...the damage caused to the CIA and FBI in the aftermath of the Watergate affair.
examples.translation: 水门事件发生后给美国中央情报局和联邦调查局造成的不良影响

examples.text: ...confidential Bank of England documents relating to the BCCI affair.
examples.translation: 与国际信贷商业银行事务相关的英格兰银行的机密文件

examples.text: Michael said that his planned 10-day visit would be a purely private affair...
examples.translation: 迈克尔说他所计划的10天访问纯属个人私事。

examples.text: Breakfast will be a cheerless affair for the Prime Minister this morning.
examples.translation: 今天的早餐会让首相感觉全然无味。

examples.text: All their beds were distinctive; Mac's was an iron affair with brass knobs...
examples.translation: 他们的床都各具特色；马克的床是张带球形黄铜柱头的铁家伙。

examples.text: He tried dividing it into two bundles, tying them to his walking stick, and slinging the whole affair across his back.
examples.translation: 他试着将它分成两包绑在他的拐棍上，然后把所有东西都挂在后背上。

examples.text: She was having an affair with someone at work.
examples.translation: 她跟某一同事有染。

examples.text: He does not want to interfere in the internal affairs of another country...
examples.translation: 他不想干涉别国内政。

examples.text: With more details, here's our foreign affairs correspondent.
examples.translation: 详细情况，请听我们外交事务记者的报道。

examples.text: He was rational and consistent in the conduct of his affairs...
examples.translation: 他处理私事时头脑清楚，始终如一。

examples.text: The unexpectedness of my father's death meant that his affairs were not entirely in order.
examples.translation: 家父的猝然离世留下了尚未完全安排妥当的身后事。

examples.text: If you wish to make a fool of yourself, that is your affair...
examples.translation: 如果你想让自己出丑，那是你自己的事。

examples.text: If they want to stay and fight, then I guess that's their affair.
examples.translation: 如果他们想留下来打架，我想那是他们自己的事。

examples.text: Nicotine adversely affects the functioning of the heart and arteries...
examples.translation: 尼古丁会对心脏及动脉功能造成损害。

examples.text: More than seven million people have been affected by drought.
examples.translation: 已有超过700万的民众受到旱灾的影响。

examples.text: ...the worst-affected areas of Somalia.
examples.translation: 索马里受影响最为严重的地区

examples.text: Arthritis is a crippling disease which affects people all over the world.
examples.translation: 关节炎是一种会危害全人类健康的致残性疾病。

examples.text: The divorce affected Jim deeply...
examples.translation: 离婚对吉姆打击很大。

examples.text: Gregor loved his sister, and her loss clearly still affects him.
examples.translation: 格雷戈尔爱他的姐姐，她的去世显然仍令他悲伤不已。

examples.text: He listened to them, affecting an amused interest...
examples.translation: 他装作饶有兴致地听他们说话。

examples.text: Ms. Redgrave affects a heavy Italian accent.
examples.translation: 雷德格雷夫女士假装带有浓重的意大利口音。

examples.text: She thought of him with affection...
examples.translation: 她很想念他。

examples.text: She had developed quite an affection for the place.
examples.translation: 她逐渐对这个地方钟爱有加。

examples.text: ...trying to win their affection.
examples.translation: 试图赢得他们的好感

examples.text: The distant object of his affections is Caroline...
examples.translation: 他一厢情愿地爱慕卡罗琳。

examples.text: Jack Russell has a special place in the affections of the cricketing public.
examples.translation: 杰克·拉塞尔在打板球的人心中有着特殊的地位。

examples.text: ...her fear of being replaced in his affections.
examples.translation: 她害怕他会移情别恋

meanings.meaning: 使附属；接纳；使紧密联系

examples.text: ...twelve companies, including three affiliates of a Texas oil firm...
examples.translation: 12家公司，包括得克萨斯一家石油公司的3家分公司

examples.text: The World Chess Federation has affiliates in around 120 countries.
examples.translation: 国际象棋联合会在大约120个国家设有分支机构。

examples.text: All youth groups will have to affiliate to the National Youth Agency...
examples.translation: 所有青年团体必须并入全国青年事务处。

examples.text: The Government will not allow the staff association to affiliate with outside unions.
examples.translation: 政府不会允许其公务员协会与外部工会有紧密联系。

examples.text: He said he wanted to affiliate with a U.S. firm because he needed 'expert advice and counsel in legal affairs'.
examples.translation: 他说他因为需要“在法律事务上得到专家的意见和建议”，所以想与一家美国律师事务所建立合作关系。

examples.text: The House of Lords affirmed that the terms of a contract cannot be rewritten retrospectively.
examples.translation: 上议院申明合同条款改写后不具备追溯效力。

examples.text: ...a speech in which he affirmed a commitment to lower taxes...
examples.translation: 他作出减税承诺的演讲

examples.text: 'This place is a dump,' affirmed Miss T.
examples.translation: “这地方简直像个垃圾堆，”T小姐声称。

examples.text: The ministers issued an affirmation of their faith in the system.
examples.translation: 部长们表示了对该体制坚定的信心。

examples.text: Everything I had accomplished seemed to affirm that opinion.
examples.translation: 我所取得的一切似乎都证明那个观点是对的。

examples.text: The high turnout was an affirmation of the importance that the voters attached to the election.
examples.translation: 高投票率清楚地显示出选民们对选举的重视。

examples.text: Cigarette smoking used to be commoner among affluent people.
examples.translation: 吸烟曾经在富人中间更为普遍。

examples.text: ...the affluent neighborhoods of Malibu.
examples.translation: 马利布的富人区

examples.text: The diet of the affluent has not changed much over the decades.
examples.translation: 几十年来富人们的饮食习惯并未发生太大的变化。

examples.text: My parents can't even afford a new refrigerator...
examples.translation: 我父母甚至买不起一台新冰箱。

examples.text: The arts should be available to more people at prices they can afford...
examples.translation: 艺术品应该以人们能够承受的价格面向更多的人出售。

examples.text: We couldn't afford to buy a new rug.
examples.translation: 我们买不起新的小地毯。

examples.text: We can't afford to wait...
examples.translation: 我们等不起。

examples.text: The country could not afford the luxury of an election.
examples.translation: 该国负担不起选举这样奢侈的事。

examples.text: This affords us the opportunity to ask questions about how the systems might change...
examples.translation: 这给我们提供了就系统可能如何改变进行提问的机会。

examples.text: It was a cold room, but it afforded a fine view of the Old City.
examples.translation: 这房间虽然很冷，但是它能让人将古城的景致尽收眼底。

examples.text: ...the protection afforded by the police.
examples.translation: 警方提供的保护

examples.text: She did not seem at all afraid...
examples.translation: 她毫无惧色。

examples.text: I was afraid of the other boys...
examples.translation: 我害怕其他的男孩们。

examples.text: I'm still afraid to sleep in my own bedroom.
examples.translation: 我还是不敢在自己的卧室里睡觉。

examples.text: She's afraid for her family in Somalia.
examples.translation: 她为身在索马里的家人担心。

examples.text: I was afraid that nobody would believe me...
examples.translation: 我担心没有人会相信我。

examples.text: The Government is afraid of losing the election...
examples.translation: 现届政府担心会在选举中落败。

examples.text: We don't have anything like that, I'm afraid...
examples.translation: 我们恐怕没有那样的东西。

examples.text: I'm afraid I can't help you...
examples.translation: 恐怕我帮不了你。

examples.text: 'Bad news?' — 'I'm afraid so.'
examples.translation: “坏消息吗？”——“恐怕是。”

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, after is used in phrasal verbs such as ‘ask after’, ‘look after’, and ‘take after’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，after还可用于ask after，look after, take after等短语动词中。

examples.text: After breakfast Amy ordered a taxi...
examples.translation: 早饭后，埃米预订了一辆出租车。

examples.text: It wasn't until after Christmas that I met Paul.
examples.translation: 直到圣诞节之后我才见到保罗。

examples.text: After Don told me this, he spoke of his mother...
examples.translation: 唐告诉我这件事后，就谈起了他的母亲。

examples.text: Marina cared for him after he seriously injured his eye several years ago.
examples.translation: 自从几年前他眼睛严重受伤之后，玛丽娜就一直照顾他。

examples.text: After completing and signing it, please return the form to us in the envelope provided.
examples.translation: 填完表格并签名后，请装进所提供的信封里寄还给我们。

examples.text: ...women who have changed their mind after deciding not to have children...
examples.translation: 决定不生孩子后又改变主意的女性

examples.text: After flying from Los Angeles to London, allow four full days to adjust.
examples.translation: 从洛杉矶飞往伦敦之后，留出4整天时间适应环境。

examples.text: She's leaving the day after tomorrow.
examples.translation: 她打算后天离开。

examples.text: ...the party's annual conference, to be held the week after next.
examples.translation: 将在下下周举行的该党的年会

examples.text: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
examples.translation: 明天。或者是后天。

examples.text: He walked out, and Louise went after him.
examples.translation: 他走了出去，路易丝也跟着出去了。

examples.text: ...people who were after him for large amounts of money.
examples.translation: 为了大笔钱而追随他的人们

examples.text: They were after the money...
examples.translation: 他们想得到这笔钱。

examples.text: I did eventually find what I was after.
examples.translation: 我最终找到了我想要的东西。

examples.text: 'Come back!' he called after me...
examples.translation: “回来！”他朝我喊道。

examples.text: Claire stared after him until he disappeared around a corner.
examples.translation: 克莱尔一直注视着他，直到他消失在拐角。

examples.text: She used to mess up the floor and I had to clean up after her.
examples.translation: 她过去常常把地板弄得很脏乱，而我不得不为她清理干净。

examples.text: A few kilometres after the village, turn right to Montelabate.
examples.translation: 过了村庄之后再前行几公里，向右转前往蒙特拉贝特。

examples.text: I wrote my name after Penny's.
examples.translation: 我把自己的名字写在彭尼的下面。

examples.text: After Germany, America is Britain's second-biggest customer...
examples.translation: 对于英国来说，美国是仅次于德国的第二大客户。

examples.text: Methane is often regarded as the second most important greenhouse gas after carbon dioxide.
examples.translation: 甲烷常被认为是仅次于二氧化碳的重要温室气体。

examples.text: Phillimore Island is named after Sir Robert Phillimore...
examples.translation: 菲利莫尔岛以罗伯特·菲利莫尔爵士的名字命名。

examples.text: He persuaded Virginia to name the baby after him.
examples.translation: 他说服弗吉尼娅以他的名字为婴儿取名。

examples.text: 'After you.' — 'Not at all, Mr Bird, after you.'
examples.translation: “您先请。”——“别客气，伯德先生，您先请。”

examples.text: Sybil ate three biscuits, one after the other...
examples.translation: 西比尔接连吃了3块饼干。

examples.text: Caroline was trying on one outfit after another.
examples.translation: 卡罗琳一套接一套地试穿衣服。

examples.text: I waited for news, day after day, expecting to hear.
examples.translation: 我日复一日地等着，期待能听到消息。

examples.text: ...people who'd been coming here year after year.
examples.translation: 年复一年到这里来的人们

examples.text: He's arriving in the afternoon...
examples.translation: 他下午会到。

examples.text: He had stayed in his room all afternoon.
examples.translation: 他整个下午都呆在房间里。

examples.text: ...an afternoon news conference.
examples.translation: 午后的新闻发布会

examples.text: Afterward, as they were drinking Cognac, the judge asked him what he found so funny.

meanings.meaning: 又，此外；再一次；再说；增加

examples.text: He kissed her again...
examples.translation: 他再一次吻了她。

examples.text: Again there was a short silence...
examples.translation: 接着又是一阵短暂的沉寂。

examples.text: I don't ever want to go through anything like that again.
examples.translation: 我不想再经历那样的事了。

examples.text: He opened his attaché-case, removed a folder, then closed it again...
examples.translation: 他打开公文包，拿出一个文件夹后又把它合上了。

examples.text: I started to feel good about myself again.
examples.translation: 我又开始感觉良好了。

examples.text: Again the pregnancy was very similar to my previous two...
examples.translation: 同样，这次怀孕和我前两次的情形非常相似。

examples.text: With the new artists, you see a more dynamic stage show than you used to see. And again, that's probably part of the progress of technology.
examples.translation: 有了这些新艺术家，你看到的舞台剧会比你以前看的更富有活力。同样，那也可能是科技进步的一部分。

examples.text: It's easier to take a taxi. But then again you can't always get one...
examples.translation: 打出租车要容易些，但也并不总是能打到的。

examples.text: They may, but there again they may not.
examples.translation: 他们可能会，但也可能不会。

examples.text: Sorry, what's your name again?
examples.translation: 对不起，再问一次，你叫什么名字?

examples.text: A similar wine from France would cost you half as much again.
examples.translation: 法国类似的一种葡萄酒的价格比这高一半。

examples.text: Sherry is half as strong again as table wine.
examples.translation: 雪利酒比佐餐酒酒劲强一半。

examples.text: He would go over his work again and again until he felt he had it right...
examples.translation: 他会反复检查自己的工作直到他认为正确为止。

examples.text: Time and again political parties have failed to tackle this issue.
examples.translation: 各个政党处理这个问题时都屡屡失败。

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, against is used in phrasal verbs such as ‘come up against’, ‘guard against’, and ‘hold against’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，against还可用于come up against, guard against, hold against等短语动词中。

examples.text: On a table pushed against a wall there were bottles of beer and wine.
examples.translation: 在一张靠墙的餐桌上有啤酒和葡萄酒。

examples.text: ...the rain beating against the window panes.
examples.translation: 雨敲打着窗玻璃

examples.text: Taxes are unpopular — it is understandable that voters are against them...
examples.translation: 税收不受欢迎——选民们反对是可以理解的。

examples.text: Joan was very much against commencing drug treatment.
examples.translation: 琼极力反对进行药物治疗。

examples.text: ...a march to protest against job losses.
examples.translation: 反对失业的游行

examples.text: The vote for the suspension of the party was 283 in favour with 29 against.
examples.translation: 关于暂时取缔该党的投票结果为283票赞成，29票反对。

examples.text: The tour will include games against the Australian Barbarians...
examples.translation: 这次巡回赛将包括和澳大利亚野人队的比赛。

examples.text: Billy Hardy has pulled out of his second fight against Noel Carroll after a training accident.
examples.translation: 一次训练事故之后，比利·哈迪退出了和诺埃尔·卡罗尔的第二次比赛。

examples.text: Security forces are still using violence against opponents of the government.
examples.translation: 安全部队仍然在使用武力镇压反对政府的人。

examples.text: ...an upsurge in racism against immigrants...
examples.translation: 对移民的种族歧视的高涨

examples.text: The demonstration itself was against the Government's new Community Charge.
examples.translation: 游行本身反对的是政府新出台的“人头税”。

examples.text: ...the fight against crime...
examples.translation: 打击犯罪

examples.text: They are arguing against hospital closures...
examples.translation: 他们据理反对关闭医院。

examples.text: I must warn you against raising your hopes.
examples.translation: 我必须警告你不要期望过高。

examples.text: He didn't want to go against the wishes of the German government...
examples.translation: 他不想违抗德国政府的意愿。

examples.text: He discharged himself from hospital against the advice of doctors.
examples.translation: 他不顾医生的劝告自行出院了。

examples.text: A business needs insurance against risks such as fire and flood...
examples.translation: 公司需要上保险以防备火灾、洪灾等风险。

examples.text: It has been claimed that wine helps protect against heart disease.
examples.translation: 有人声称葡萄酒有助于预防心脏病。

examples.text: Have you got something against women, Les?...
examples.translation: 你对女性存有芥蒂吗，莱斯？

examples.text: I have nothing against foreigners.
examples.translation: 我对外国人并无芥蒂。

examples.text: It is against the law to detain you against your will for any length of time...
examples.translation: 无论强制扣押多长时间都属违法。

examples.text: We thought cheating was against the rules.
examples.translation: 我们认为作弊是违反规定的。

examples.text: ...swimming upstream against the current...
examples.translation: 逆流往上游泳

examples.text: They were going to sail around the little island, against the tide.
examples.translation: 他们打算绕着小岛逆潮航行。

examples.text: The Pope has sent a message appealing for unity in his homeland, against a background of divisions in the Solidarity movement...
examples.translation: 团结运动中各派搞分裂，在此情况下教皇发出号召，呼吁祖国保持团结。

examples.text: The profits rise was achieved against a backdrop of falling metal prices.
examples.translation: 在金属价格下跌的背景下，利润提高了。

examples.text: Our policy has to be judged against a clear test: will it improve the standard of education?...
examples.translation: 对我们的政策作出评判必须根据一条明确的准则：它是否会提高教育的水准？

examples.text: Check the operator's productivity against agreed targets...
examples.translation: 根据既定目标检验操作员的效率。

examples.text: The US dollar is down against most foreign currencies today.
examples.translation: 今天美元对大多数外汇的比价都有所下降。

examples.text: Over 50% of divorced men regretted their divorce, as against 25% of women.
examples.translation: 离婚男性中有50%以上后悔离婚，与此相对，女性只有25%。

examples.text: The odds against him surviving are incredible.
examples.translation: 他活下来的概率非常小。

examples.text: What were the odds against?
examples.translation: 不利情况有哪些呢？

meanings.meaning: 年龄；时代；寿命，使用年限；阶段
使成熟；使变老，使上年纪
(Age)人名；(瑞典)阿格；(日)扬 (姓)；(西、荷)阿赫

examples.text: She has a nephew who is just ten years of age...
examples.translation: 她有一个才10岁的侄子。

examples.text: At the age of sixteen he qualified for a place at the University of Hamburg...
examples.translation: 16岁时，他就有资格进入汉堡大学。

examples.text: I admired him for being so confident at his age.
examples.translation: 我钦佩他这般年纪就如此自信。

examples.text: Everything in the room looks in keeping with the age of the building.
examples.translation: 房间里的一切看起来都与这栋建筑物的存在年头很相称。

examples.text: Perhaps he has grown wiser with age...
examples.translation: 可能随着年纪增长，他变聪明了。

examples.text: The fabric was showing signs of age...
examples.translation: 这块衣料可以看出岁月留下的痕迹。

examples.text: The worst sign of age was in the fabric which looked decidedly ancient.
examples.translation: 岁月最无情的痕迹留在了那块看起来明显很古老的织物上。

examples.text: He had always looked so young, but he seemed to have aged in the last few months...
examples.translation: 他原来一直看起来很年轻，但最近几个月他显得老了。

examples.text: He was only in his mid-thirties, but already worry had aged him.
examples.translation: 他虽然只有三十五六岁，但忧虑让他很显老。

examples.text: Balsamic vinegar is aged in wood for at least 10 years and the flavour is wonderful...
examples.translation: 意大利香醋在木桶中就经历了至少10年的酝酿期，所以口味极佳。

examples.text: Whisky loses strength as it ages.
examples.translation: 存放时间越久，威士忌的口味越淡。

examples.text: ...the age of steam and steel.
examples.translation: 蒸汽和钢铁时代

examples.text: ...items of Bronze Age pottery.
examples.translation: 青铜器时代的陶器

examples.text: He waited what seemed an age...
examples.translation: 他等了似乎很长时间。

examples.text: The bus took absolutely ages to arrive.
examples.translation: 公共汽车过了很长时间才来。

examples.text: Recycling is an issue that has come of age in Britain in the last decade.
examples.translation: 回收利用是上个十年中被英国民众广泛认可的观念。

examples.text: The company was to be held in trust for Eddie until he came of age.
examples.translation: 在埃迪达到法定年龄之前，该公司将委托他人代为经营。

examples.text: Because she was under age, her parents were still responsible for her.
examples.translation: 因为她还未成年，她的父母仍然应为她负责。

examples.text: ...under age smoking.
examples.translation: 未成年吸烟

meanings.meaning: 代理，中介；代理处，经销处

examples.text: We had to hire maids through an agency.
examples.translation: 我们得通过中介雇用女佣。

examples.text: ...a successful advertising agency.
examples.translation: 一家成功的广告代理公司

examples.text: ...the government agency which monitors health and safety at work in Britain...
examples.translation: 英国负责劳工医疗和安全的部门

examples.text: Webster is retiring as head of the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA).
examples.translation: 韦伯斯特即将从中央情报局局长的位子上退职。

examples.text: Does television set the agenda on foreign policy?...
examples.translation: 电视舆论对外交政策有影响吗？

examples.text: Many of the coalition members could have their own political agendas...
examples.translation: 许多联盟成员可能会有他们自己的政治议题。

examples.text: The Danish president will put environmental issues high on the agenda.
examples.translation: 丹麦总统将试图把环境问题摆到重要位置上。

examples.text: This is sure to be an item on the agenda next week...
examples.translation: 这一定会成为下星期议事日程上的一项议题。

examples.text: High on the agenda of tomorrow's meeting will be the turmoil in Japan.
examples.translation: 日本发生的骚乱将是明天会议的首要议题。

meanings.meaning: 代理人，代理商；药剂；特工

examples.text: You are buying direct, rather than through an agent.
examples.translation: 你这是直接购买，而不是通过代理人。

examples.text: ...a written declaration by someone, authorizing another person to act as his agent.
examples.translation: 一份某人授权他人为其代理人的书面申明

examples.text: All these years he's been an agent for the East.
examples.translation: 这些年来他一直是为东方国家效力的一位间谍。

examples.text: In many societies young men regard themselves as highly active, the agents of change, shapers of the world.
examples.translation: 在许多社会中，年轻人将自己看成是高度活跃的分子，是变革的推动者和世界的塑造者。

examples.text: ...the bleaching agent in white flour.
examples.translation: 白面粉中的漂白剂

examples.text: ...fibrinogen, a blood clotting agent.
examples.translation: 血纤维蛋白原，一种凝血剂

examples.text: Stress and lack of sleep can aggravate the situation...
examples.translation: 压力和睡眠不足会使情况恶化。

examples.text: He would only aggravate the injury by rubbing it.
examples.translation: 他揉擦伤口只会使伤势加重。

examples.text: What aggravates you most about this country?
examples.translation: 该国的哪一点让你最恼火？

examples.text: You don't realise how aggravating you can be.
examples.translation: 你没有意识到自己有多么气人。

examples.text: I just couldn't take the aggravation.
examples.translation: 我就是咽不下这口气。

meanings.meaning: 侵略性的；好斗的；有进取心的；有闯劲的

examples.text: Some children are much more aggressive than others...
examples.translation: 一些孩子比其他孩子更好斗。

examples.text: These fish are very aggressive...
examples.translation: 这些鱼极具攻击性。

examples.text: Aggressive behaviour is a sign of emotional distress.
examples.translation: 好斗行为是情感苦闷的一种表现。

examples.text: They'll react aggressively.
examples.translation: 他们会作出挑衅性的反应。

examples.text: Her aggressiveness made it difficult for him to explain his own feelings.
examples.translation: 她咄咄逼人的态度让他难以解释自己的感情。

examples.text: He is respected as a very aggressive and competitive executive...
examples.translation: 他是一位锐意进取、竞争意识很强的主管，颇受尊敬。

examples.text: The Zambian game is much more aggressive than European soccer.
examples.translation: 赞比亚的这种运动比欧式足球要激烈得多。

examples.text: ...countries noted for aggressively pursuing energy efficiency.
examples.translation: 以积极追求能源效率而著称的国家

examples.text: The women who worked in these mills had begun to agitate for better conditions.
examples.translation: 在这些工厂里做工的妇女们开始抗议要求改善工作条件。

examples.text: At least seventy students were injured in the continuing agitation against the decision.
examples.translation: 至少有70名学生在反对该决定的持续抗争中受伤。

examples.text: All you need to do is gently agitate the water with a finger or paintbrush...
examples.translation: 你只需要用手指或刷子轻轻地搅动水。

examples.text: Its molecules can be agitated by microwave energy.
examples.translation: 微波能量可以使其分子随之运动。

examples.text: Temperature is a measure of the agitation of the molecules of matter.
examples.translation: 温度是物质分子运动的一个计量单位。

examples.text: The thought of them getting her possessions when she dies agitates her.
examples.translation: 一想到他们可能会在她死后得到她的财产，她就心绪不安。

examples.text: He was killed a few days ago in a skiing accident...
examples.translation: 几天前他在一场滑雪事故中丧生。

examples.text: The meeting is the first since the war began 14 years ago...
examples.translation: 这是自14年前爆发战争以来的第一次会晤。

examples.text: Harry's daughter is dead. She died long ago.
examples.translation: 哈里的女儿已不在人世，很久以前就死了。

meanings.meaning: 苦恼；极大的痛苦；临死的挣扎

examples.text: A new machine may save thousands of animals from the agony of drug tests...
examples.translation: 一种新型机器也许可以将成千上万的动物从药物试验的痛苦中解脱出来。

examples.text: She called out in agony...
examples.translation: 她疼得叫出声来。

examples.text: As a young man he suffered agonies of religious doubt.
examples.translation: 年轻时，他因为对宗教的怀疑而饱受折磨。

examples.text: If we agreed all the time it would be a bit boring, wouldn't it?...
examples.translation: 如果我们总是意见一致，就会有点无趣，对吗？

examples.text: Both have agreed on the need for the money...
examples.translation: 两个人一致表示需要那笔钱。

examples.text: So we both agree there's a problem?...
examples.translation: 那么我们两个人都认为存在问题，对吧？

examples.text: I see your point but I'm not sure I agree with you...
examples.translation: 我明白你的观点，但恐怕我不能苟同。

examples.text: I agree with you that the open system is by far the best...
examples.translation: 我同意你的观点，开放的系统显然是最佳的。

examples.text: 'It's appalling.' — 'It is. I agree.'...
examples.translation: “真是骇人听闻。”——“嗯，我同意。”

examples.text: I agree that the demise of London zoo would be terrible...
examples.translation: 我也认为如果伦敦动物园不复存在的话那真是太糟糕了。

examples.text: I agree with every word you've just said...
examples.translation: 我同意你刚说的每句话。

examples.text: 'Frankly I found it rather frightening.' — 'A little startling,' Mark agreed.
examples.translation: “坦白说我觉得这相当可怕。”——“是有点吓人，”马克表示同意。

examples.text: He agreed to pay me for the drawings...
examples.translation: 他答应向我支付这些画的钱。

examples.text: Donna agreed to both requests...
