examples.translation: 他的作品能让人们对一种异域文化产生较深入的了解。

examples.text: Such an attitude is alien to most businessmen.
examples.translation: 大多数商界人士都会对这样的态度感到陌生。

examples.text: Both women had hired illegal aliens for child care...
examples.translation: 两个女人都曾雇过非法入境者照看孩子。

examples.text: When war broke out, he was interned as an enemy alien.
examples.translation: 战争爆发时，他作为敌国人士遭到关押。

examples.text: Do either of you smoke cigarettes or drink alcohol?...
examples.translation: 你们俩有人吸烟或喝酒吗？

examples.text: No alcohol is allowed on the premises.
examples.translation: 场内禁止带酒。

examples.text: ...low-alcohol beer...
examples.translation: 低醇啤酒

examples.text: Products for dry skin have little or no alcohol.
examples.translation: 用于干性皮肤的产品含酒精较少或不含酒精。

examples.text: We looked very alike.
examples.translation: 我们长得很像。

examples.text: They even dressed alike.
examples.translation: 他们甚至连穿戴都相似。

examples.text: ...their assumption that all men and women think alike.
examples.translation: 他们关于所有男人和女人思考问题的方式都类似的假定

examples.text: The techniques are being applied almost everywhere by big and small firms alike.
examples.translation: 无论在大公司还是小公司，这些技术的应用几乎无处不在。

meanings.meaning: 活着的；活泼的；有生气的

examples.text: She does not know if he is alive or dead...
examples.translation: 她不知道他是生是死。

examples.text: They kept her alive on a life support machine.
examples.translation: 他们用呼吸机维持她的生命。

examples.text: Our relationship made me feel more alive...
examples.translation: 我们的关系使我感到更有活力。

examples.text: I never expected to feel so alive in my life again.
examples.translation: 我怎么也没想到自己会再一次这样活力焕发。

examples.text: The big factories are trying to stay alive by cutting costs...
examples.translation: 大型工厂正试图通过削减成本以维持生存。

examples.text: Both communities have a tradition of keeping history alive.
examples.translation: 两个团体都有延续历史的传统。

examples.text: The river was alive with birds...
examples.translation: 沿河活跃着各种鸟类。

examples.text: The street was alive with the sounds of the soldiers.
examples.translation: 这条街道上到处都是士兵的声音。

examples.text: You must be alive to op-portunity!...
examples.translation: 你必须注意机会！

examples.text: He was alive to what he was doing.
examples.translation: 他很清楚他在做什么。

examples.text: The doctor's voice had come alive and his small eyes shone.
examples.translation: 医生的嗓音恢复了活力，两只小眼睛也有了神采。

examples.text: ...the songs of birds that bring the garden alive.
examples.translation: 使花园恢复了生机的小鸟的鸣啭

examples.text: She made history come alive with tales from her own memories...
examples.translation: 通过讲述自己记忆中的故事，她把逝去的岁月变得生动起来。

examples.text: From here on he brings the character confidently alive.
examples.translation: 从这里开始他真正将这个角色演活了。

examples.text: He was certain Sid would be eaten alive by the hardened criminals in the jail.
examples.translation: 他确信锡德在监狱中肯定会被那些怙恶不悛的罪犯们扒掉一层皮。

examples.text: ...worries that the secret police may still be alive and kicking.
examples.translation: 担心秘密警察可能依旧在四处活动

examples.text: A man who went missing yesterday during a blizzard has been found alive and well.
examples.translation: 昨天在暴风雪中失踪的一名男子已经被找到，人安然无恙。

examples.text: Nowadays, a great deal can be done to alleviate back pain.
examples.translation: 如今，减轻背部疼痛可以有许多方法。

examples.text: ...the problem of alleviating mass poverty.
examples.translation: 摆脱普遍贫困的难题

examples.text: Their energies were focussed on the alleviation of the refugees' misery.
examples.translation: 他们把精力集中在减轻难民们的苦难上。

meanings.meaning: 宣称，断言；提出…作为理由

examples.text: She alleged that there was rampant drug use among the male members of the group...
examples.translation: 她声称该团体中有大量的男性成员吸毒。

examples.text: The accused is alleged to have killed a man...
examples.translation: 被告据称谋杀了一名男子。

examples.text: It was alleged that the restaurant discriminated against black customers.
examples.translation: 据称该饭馆歧视黑人顾客。

examples.text: The two parties were still too much apart to form an alliance.
examples.translation: 两党分歧甚大，还远未能结成同盟。

examples.text: What will be the effect of the alliance between IBM and Apple?...
examples.translation: 若IBM公司和苹果公司联合将会有什么效果呢？

examples.text: They are now in a position to govern the state in alliance with either the Free Democrats or the Green Party.
examples.translation: 他们现在可以选择与自由民主党人或绿党结盟来执掌国家政权。

examples.text: Tickets are limited and will be allocated to those who apply first...
examples.translation: 票数有限，先申请者先得。

examples.text: The 1985 federal budget allocated $7.3 billion for development programmes...
examples.translation: 1985年的联邦预算将73亿美元拨给了开发项目。

examples.text: Our plan is to allocate one member of staff to handle appointments.
examples.translation: 我们的计划是分派一位职员处理预约事宜。

examples.text: The children are not allowed to watch violent TV programmes...
examples.translation: 儿童不准收看含暴力内容的电视节目。

examples.text: The Government will allow them to advertise on radio and television...
examples.translation: 政府将准许他们在广播和电视上做广告。

examples.text: They will be allowed home...
examples.translation: 他们将获准回家。

examples.text: Smoking will not be allowed.
examples.translation: 吸烟将被禁止。

examples.text: Gifts like chocolates or flowers are allowed...
examples.translation: 巧克力、鲜花等礼物在允许之列。

examples.text: He should be allowed the occasional treat.
examples.translation: 应该准许他偶尔也轻松一下。

examples.text: He won't allow himself to fail...
examples.translation: 他不会任由自己失败的。

examples.text: If the soil is allowed to dry out the tree could die.
examples.translation: 如果听任土壤变干，树木可能会枯死。

examples.text: The compromise will allow him to continue his free market reforms.
examples.translation: 妥协将使他得以继续他的自由市场改革。

examples.text: ...an attempt to allow the Moslem majority a greater share of power...
examples.translation: 使穆斯林多数派拥有更大权力的尝试

examples.text: She said this would allow more effective planning.
examples.translation: 她说这会为更有效的规划创造可能。

examples.text: Please allow 28 days for delivery...
examples.translation: 请留出28天的送货时间。

examples.text: Allow about 75ml (3fl oz) per six servings.
examples.translation: 每6份酌加约75毫升(3液盎司)。

examples.text: Warren also allows that capitalist development may, in its early stages, result in increased social inequality.
examples.translation: 沃伦也承认资本主义发展初级阶段可能会导致社会不平等现象加剧。

examples.text: Allow me to buy you a drink at the bar.
examples.translation: 让我来请你喝一杯。

examples.text: Allow me to introduce Dr Amberg.
examples.translation: 请允许我介绍安伯格博士。

examples.text: He lives on a single parent's allowance of £70 a week...
examples.translation: 他靠每周70英镑的单亲家庭生活补助过日子。

examples.text: She gets an allowance for looking after Lillian.
examples.translation: 她因为照顾莉莲而拿补贴。

examples.text: ...those earning less than the basic tax allowance.
examples.translation: 那些收入低于基本免税额的人

examples.text: Most of our flights have a baggage allowance of 44lbs per passenger.
examples.translation: 我们大多数航班行李限重为每位乘客44磅。

examples.text: We'll make allowances in the schedule for time off...
examples.translation: 日程安排时我们会把休息时间考虑在内。

examples.text: The raw exam results make no allowance for social background.
examples.translation: 原始的考试成绩是不受社会背景影响的。

examples.text: He's tired so I'll make allowances for him.
examples.translation: 他很累，所以我会体谅他。

examples.text: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin...
examples.translation: 青铜是铜和锡的合金。

examples.text: The company produces titanium alloy.
examples.translation: 该公司生产钛合金。

meanings.meaning: 同盟国；伙伴；同盟者；助手
(Ally)人名；(巴基)阿利；(法)阿利；(英)艾丽(女子教名 Alice 的简称)；(尼日利)阿利

examples.text: Washington would not take such a step without its allies' approval...
examples.translation: 没有盟国的同意，华盛顿将不会采取这样一种行动。

examples.text: The United States is a close ally of South Korea.
examples.translation: 美国是韩国的亲密盟友。

examples.text: He is a close ally of the Prime Minister...
examples.translation: 他是首相的亲密支持者。

examples.text: She will regret losing a close political ally.
examples.translation: 她将为失去一个亲密的政治盟友而懊悔。

examples.text: He will have no choice but to ally himself with the new movement.
examples.translation: 他除了与新运动结盟别无选择。

examples.text: The couple had been dating for almost three years...
examples.translation: 这对情侣相恋已近3年。

examples.text: Storms have been hitting almost all of Britain recently...
examples.translation: 最近几乎整个英国都受到了暴风雨的侵袭。

examples.text: The effect is almost impossible to describe...
examples.translation: 这种影响几乎无法用言语描述。

examples.text: He was almost as tall as Pete, but skinnier...
examples.translation: 他和皮特差不多高，但更瘦。

examples.text: The arrested man will almost certainly be kept at this police station...
examples.translation: 几乎可以肯定，被逮捕的男子将被扣押在该警察局。

examples.text: He contracted Spanish flu, which almost killed him.
examples.translation: 他得了西班牙流感，险些丧命。

examples.text: There is nothing so fearful as to be alone in a combat situation...
examples.translation: 没有比孤身奋战更可怕的了。

examples.text: He was all alone in the middle of the hall.
examples.translation: 他独自一人在大厅中间。

examples.text: She has lived alone in this house for almost five years now...
examples.translation: 她已在这所房子里独自住了近5年。

examples.text: He was sitting alone at a table in a wine bar, smoking a big cigar.
examples.translation: 他独自一人坐在酒吧的一张桌旁，抽着一支大雪茄。

examples.text: I couldn't imagine why he would want to be alone with me...
examples.translation: 我想象不出为什么他会想和我独处。

examples.text: My brother and I were alone with Vincent.
examples.translation: 我和弟弟与文森特单独呆着。

examples.text: Never in her life had she felt so alone, so abandoned...
examples.translation: 她一生中从来没有感到如此孤单，如此无助。

examples.text: He found himself alone in a hostile world.
examples.translation: 他感到自己处在一个充满敌意的环境中，孤立无援。

examples.text: You alone should determine what is right for you...
examples.translation: 只有你自己才能决定什么适合你。

examples.text: They were convicted on forensic evidence alone.
examples.translation: 仅凭着法医证据，他们就被判有罪。

examples.text: The BBC alone is sending 300 technicians, directors and commentators...
examples.translation: 单单英国广播公司就派出技术人员、导演、解说员等一行300人。

examples.text: Megastars like Jack Nicholson, who made $500 million from Batman alone, are unlikely to be affected.
examples.translation: 像杰克·尼科尔森这样的巨星，单从《蝙蝠侠》一部片子中就赚了5亿美元，是不太可能受影响的。

examples.text: Newcastle is far from alone. Colleges around the country have developed programmes of student support...
examples.translation: 远不止是纽卡斯尔，全国的许多大学都推出了助学项目。

examples.text: Am I alone in thinking that this scandal should finish his career?
examples.translation: 只有我认为这件丑闻会断送他的事业吗？

examples.text: Alone among the major candidates, Gaviria expressed a determination to continue the campaign to defeat the drugs cartels...
examples.translation: 在主要的候选人中，只有加维里亚一人坚决表示要继续打击药品同业联盟。

examples.text: I alone was sane, I thought, in a world of crazy people.
examples.translation: 我认为，在一群疯子的世界里只有我自己是理性的。

examples.text: Bringing up a child alone should give you a sense of achievement...
examples.translation: 自己一个人带大孩子会给你一种成就感。

examples.text: He was working alone and did not have an accomplice.
examples.translation: 他在单干，没有同伙。

examples.text: I missed the stimulation of working with others when I tried to go it alone.
examples.translation: 当我试图单干时，我很怀念与他人一起工作的那股兴奋劲。

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, along is used in phrasal verbs such as ‘go along with’, ‘play along’, and ‘string along’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，along 还可用于go along with, play along 和 string along 等短语动词中。

examples.text: The young man led Mark Ryle along a corridor...
examples.translation: 那个年轻人领着马克·赖尔沿走廊而去。

examples.text: I looked along the length of the building.
examples.translation: 我的视线掠过整幢大楼。

examples.text: ...enormous traffic jams all along the roads.
examples.translation: 马路上严重的交通阻塞

examples.text: ...houses built on piles along the river...
examples.translation: 沿河打桩盖的房子

examples.text: Along each wall stretched green metal filing cabinets.
examples.translation: 绿色金属文件柜靠着各面墙依次排开。

examples.text: She skipped and danced along...
examples.translation: 她蹦蹦跳跳地往前走着。

examples.text: He raised his voice a little, talking into the wind as they walked along...
examples.translation: 他们往前走时，他略微提高了嗓音，迎着风说话。

examples.text: The wide road was blocked solid with traffic that moved along sluggishly.
examples.translation: 宽阔的马路被缓慢前行的车辆堵得严严实实。

examples.text: ...the negotiations which have been dragging along interminably...
examples.translation: 一直在无休止拖延的谈判

examples.text: Everything was coming along fine after all...
examples.translation: 一切居然进行得很顺利。

examples.text: My life is going along nicely.
examples.translation: 我的生活一帆风顺。

examples.text: This is open to women of all ages, so bring along your friends and colleagues...
examples.translation: 这对所有年龄段的女性开放，所以请带上你的朋友和同事一起光临。

examples.text: Wives will have to bring along their marriage certificate.
examples.translation: 已婚妇女必须携带结婚证。

examples.text: She invited everyone she knew to come along...
examples.translation: 她邀请了每一个她认识的人前来。

examples.text: He had the material tested and sent along the results.
examples.translation: 他对材料做了检验并送出了检验结果。

examples.text: The baby's mother escaped from the fire along with two other children...
examples.translation: 婴儿的母亲和另外两个孩子一起逃离了火海。

examples.text: There are 32 different kinds of chocolate on sale along with the bread and cakes.
examples.translation: 有32种不同的巧克力与面包和蛋糕一起出售。

examples.text: I've been fooling myself all along...
examples.translation: 我一直在欺骗自己。

examples.text: I think she had been planning all along to leave Hungary.
examples.translation: 我想她一直在计划离开匈牙利。

examples.text: He crossed the street and walked alongside Central Park...
examples.translation: 他穿过街道，沿着中央公园走。

examples.text: Much of the industry was located alongside rivers.
examples.translation: 许多工厂都设在河边。

examples.text: He waited several minutes for a car to pull up alongside.
examples.translation: 他等了几分钟，直到一辆汽车靠边停下。

examples.text: He had worked alongside Frank and Mark and they had become friends...
examples.translation: 他与弗兰克和马克一起工作过，并且成了朋友。

examples.text: Men aged 60 are fighting alongside young boys.
examples.translation: 年届六十的男人们和少年小伙们并肩作战。

examples.text: Her self-confidence will develop alongside her technique...
examples.translation: 随着她的技术不断提高，她会愈发自信。

examples.text: Alongside the Job Creation Programme they launched a Work Experience Programme.
examples.translation: 在开展创造就业项目的同时，他们还启动了工作经历项目。

examples.text: When we were children, our father read aloud to us...
examples.translation: 我们小的时候，父亲会给我们朗读。

examples.text: 'You fool,' he said aloud.
examples.translation: “你这个傻瓜，”他大声说。

examples.text: He really must be careful about thinking aloud. Who knew what he might say?
examples.translation: 他的确该注意自己说话不经思索的问题。谁知道他会说些什么？

examples.text: ...the restaurant that Hugh and all his friends go to...
examples.translation: 休和他所有的朋友都光顾的餐馆

examples.text: He lost all his money at a blackjack table in Las Vegas.
examples.translation: 在拉斯维加斯的21点纸牌桌上，他把钱输得精光。

examples.text: There is built-in storage space in all bedrooms...
examples.translation: 所有的卧室都有嵌入式储藏空间。

examples.text: 85 percent of all American households owe money on mortgages...
examples.translation: 85%的美国家庭背有按揭债务。

examples.text: Germany, like all great nations, will not change its personality...
examples.translation: 德国，和所有伟大的国家一样，将不会改变自己的特性。

examples.text: He was passionate about all literature.
examples.translation: 他热爱所有的文学作品。

examples.text: He was told to pack up all of his letters and personal belongings...
examples.translation: 他被告知收拾好自己所有的信件和私人物品。

examples.text: He was talking to all of us.
examples.translation: 他在对我们所有的人说话。

examples.text: We produce our own hair-care products, all based on herbal recipes...
examples.translation: 我们自己生产护发产品，全部采用草本配方。

examples.text: I'd spent all I had, every last penny.
examples.translation: 我已花光了所有的钱，一分不剩。

examples.text: Milk, oily fish and egg all contain vitamin D...
examples.translation: 牛奶、油性鱼类和鸡蛋都含有维生素D。

examples.text: We all admire professionalism and dedication.
examples.translation: 我们大家都对专业素质和奉献精神表示钦佩。

examples.text: George had to cut grass all afternoon...
examples.translation: 乔治整个下午都得割草。

examples.text: She's been feeling bad all week.
examples.translation: 她整整一周都感觉很糟糕。

examples.text: She's worked all her life...
examples.translation: 她工作了一辈子。

examples.text: He was looking at me all the time.
examples.translation: 他一直看着我。

examples.text: He spent all of that afternoon polishing the silver...
examples.translation: 他那天整个下午都在擦拭银器具。

examples.text: Two-thirds of the women interviewed think about food a lot or all of the time.
examples.translation: 2/3的被访女性表示自己经常或总是要考虑吃什么的问题。

examples.text: All is silent on the island now...
examples.translation: 此时岛上一片沉寂。

examples.text: As you'll have read in our news pages, all has not been well of late.
examples.translation: 正如你会从我们的新闻版面中看到的一样，最近一切都不太顺利。

examples.text: He loves animals and he knows all about them...
examples.translation: 他热爱动物并且对它们了如指掌。

examples.text: Parts for the aircraft will be made all round the world...
examples.translation: 这架飞机的部件将在世界各地制造。

examples.text: I got scared and I ran and left her all alone...
examples.translation: 我一害怕就跑了，把她一个人扔下了。

examples.text: He was doing it all by himself...
examples.translation: 他独自一人在做那件事。

examples.text: All around he could hear people calling out his name.
examples.translation: 他听见人们在四周喊着他的名字。

examples.text: He said all that remained was to agree to a time and venue...
examples.translation: 他说剩下的只是商定一个时间和集会地点。

examples.text: All you ever want to do is go shopping!...
examples.translation: 你想做的事就只是去购物！

examples.text: All I could say was, 'I'm sorry'.
examples.translation: 我所能说的只有“对不起”。

examples.text: In all fairness he had to admit that she was neither dishonest nor lazy...
examples.translation: 公正地说，他必须承认她既没有作假也没有偷懒。

examples.text: If the pool was open, we'd in all probability still be swimming in it...
examples.translation: 如果游泳池还开着，我们完全可能还在里面游泳。

examples.text: In all seriousness, there is nothing else I can do.
examples.translation: 可以非常诚恳地说，我没有其他能做的。

examples.text: You've gone all chatty...
examples.translation: 你变得真唠叨。

examples.text: He came over all dizzy when he stood up.
examples.translation: 他一站起身就觉得天旋地转。

examples.text: The living room is decorated in pale colours that make it all the more airy...
examples.translation: 起居室装饰成淡雅的颜色，显得更加宽敞明亮。

examples.text: 'How are you?' —'All the better for seeing you.'
examples.translation: “你好吗？”—“好，看见你更好了。”

examples.text: ...women who have it all: career, husband and children...
examples.translation: 拥有一切的女性：事业、丈夫和孩子

examples.text: Here's a man who has seen it all, tasted and heard it all.
examples.translation: 这是一个已经见闻过世间万象、尝尽人间百味的人。

examples.text: Above all, chairs should be comfortable...
examples.translation: 椅子首先应该舒适。

examples.text: Social services departments must accept, above all, the role of the parents.
examples.translation: 社会服务部门必须认可的，首先是父母的角色。

examples.text: I thought you might know somebody. After all, you're the man with connections.
examples.translation: 我以为你可能认识某个重要人物。毕竟你交游甚广。

examples.text: I came out here on the chance of finding you at home after all...
examples.translation: 我到这儿来就想碰碰运气，没想到你居然真的在家。

examples.text: The Social Democrats say they are ready after all to begin talks on joining a coalition government.
examples.translation: 社会民主党人竟然说他们准备开始谈判加入联合政府了。

examples.text: He dropped his sausage on the pavement and someone's dog ate it, mustard and all.
