examples.translation: 18岁及以上人群当中，有51万救济金申领者并非是失业者。

examples.text: Among the varieties available, my preference stays with the old and lovely pink-flowered variety, 'Apple Blossom'.
examples.translation: 可供选择的品种当中，我还是偏好这种老式、可爱、带有粉色花朵的类型，“苹果花”。

examples.text: ...a news conference attended among others by our foreign affairs correspondent...
examples.translation: 由我们的外事记者及其他许多人共同出席的一次新闻发布会

examples.text: She knew many theatrical personalities and had worked, among others, with George Bernard Shaw.
examples.translation: 她认识许多戏剧界人物，并与乔治·萧伯纳等很多人共过事。

examples.text: Most of the furniture was left to the neighbours or distributed among friends...
examples.translation: 大多数家具留给了邻居或分发给了朋友们。

examples.text: She tried to ensure her affection was equally shared among all three children.
examples.translation: 她尽力确保三个孩子从自己这里分享到同等的爱。

examples.text: European farm ministers disagree among themselves...
examples.translation: 欧洲各国的农业部长之间意见不一致。

examples.text: The directors have been arguing among themselves.
examples.translation: 经理们内部一直争论不休。

meanings.meaning: 总计，合计；相当于；共计；产生…结果

examples.text: He needs that amount of money to survive...
examples.translation: 他需要那样一笔钱以生存下去。

examples.text: I still do a certain amount of work for them...
examples.translation: 我仍然为他们做一些工作。

examples.text: Postal money orders are available in amounts up to $700.
examples.translation: 邮政汇票的金额最高可达700美元。

examples.text: Consumer spending on sports-related items amounted to £9.75 billion.
examples.translation: 消费者在体育相关产品上的花费共计97.5亿英镑。

examples.text: I'm able to lay my hands on any amount of cash at a minute's notice...
examples.translation: 多少钱我都可以马上弄到。

examples.text: There are any amount of clubs you could join.
examples.translation: 有无数个俱乐部你可以加入。

examples.text: There'll be ample opportunity to relax, swim and soak up some sun...
examples.translation: 将会有充足的机会去放松、游泳和晒太阳。

examples.text: The design of the ground floor created ample space for a good-sized kitchen.
examples.translation: 底层的设计为建一个大厨房提供了充足的空间。

examples.text: They have been amply rewarded with huge salaries.
examples.translation: 高额的薪水给了他们丰厚的回报。

examples.text: ...a young mother with a baby resting against her ample bosom.
examples.translation: 丰满的怀里抱着婴儿的年轻妈妈

meanings.meaning: [电子] 放大器，扩大器；扩音器

examples.text: The ZonePlayer ZP120 houses a fully fledged, 55-watt-per-channel, Class-D digital amplifier and weighs 5 pounds.
This landscape seemed to trap and amplify sounds...
examples.translation: 这种地貌好像可以笼住并放大声音。

examples.text: The music was amplified with microphones...
examples.translation: 音乐声通过麦克风被放大。

examples.text: 'This is the police,' came the amplified voice from the helicopter.
examples.translation: “我们是警察，”直升机上传来扩音器中的声音。

examples.text: ...a voice that needed no amplification.
examples.translation: 不需要使用扩音设备的大嗓门

examples.text: The mist had been replaced by a kind of haze that seemed to amplify the heat...
examples.translation: 薄雾散了，取而代之的是一种似乎更添酷热的烟霭。

examples.text: Her anxiety about the world was amplifying her personal fears about her future.
examples.translation: 她对世界的忧虑加剧了她对自己未来的恐惧。

examples.text: ...that amplification of the elements in his character that made him able to dominate her.
examples.translation: 他性格中的某些因素不断强化使他得以主宰她

meanings.meaning: 娱乐；消遣；使发笑；使愉快

examples.text: The thought seemed to amuse him...
examples.translation: 这种想法好像把他逗乐了。

examples.text: Their antics never fail to amuse.
examples.translation: 他们滑稽的举止总是让人发笑。

examples.text: I need distractions. I need to amuse myself so I won't keep thinking about things...
examples.translation: 我需要分散我的注意力。需要消遣一下，让自己不去想这样那样的事。

examples.text: Put a selection of baby toys in his cot to amuse him if he wakes early.
examples.translation: 要在婴儿床里放一些玩具，以便他醒得早时可以自己玩。

meanings.meaning: 类似物；类似情况；对等的人
类似的；相似物的；模拟计算机的

examples.text: No model can ever be a perfect analogue of nature itself.
examples.translation: 任何模型都无法完全模拟自然本身。

examples.text: The analogue signals from the video tape are converted into digital code.
examples.translation: 采自该录像带的模拟信号被转换成数字代码。

examples.text: It is probably easier to make an analogy between the courses of the planets, and two trains travelling in the same direction.
examples.translation: 将行星的运行比作两列火车朝同一方向行驶可能更容易些。

examples.text: McCarthy was asked to analyse the data from the first phase of trials of the vaccine...
examples.translation: 麦卡锡被要求对第一阶段疫苗试验的数据作出分析。

examples.text: This book teaches you how to analyse what is causing the stress in your life.
examples.translation: 这本书教你分析生活压力形成的原因。

examples.text: We haven't had time to analyse those samples yet...
examples.translation: 我们还没有时间分析那些样本。

examples.text: They had their tablets analysed to find out whether they were getting the real drug or not.
examples.translation: 他们将药片拿去化验以查明他们得到的是否是真药。

meanings.meaning: 分析的；解析的；善于分析的

examples.text: Noir is one of the places that the investigative, analytic, literary impulse went in America.
Her criteria defy analysis...
examples.translation: 她的标准让人搞不明白。

examples.text: We did an analysis of the way that government money has been spent in the past.
examples.translation: 我们分析了政府资金过去的使用情况。

examples.text: They collect blood samples for analysis at a national laboratory...
examples.translation: 他们采集血样供一个国家实验室进行分析。

examples.text: Jacobsen based his conclusion on an analysis of the decay of samarium-147 into neodymium-143.
examples.translation: 雅各布森得出的结论是基于对钐-147衰变成钕-143所作的分析。

examples.text: ...coming up after the newscast, an analysis of President Bush's domestic policy.
examples.translation: 在新闻报道之后是对布什总统国内政策的解读

examples.text: I'm on the right track and I think in the final analysis people will understand that...
examples.translation: 我的思路对头，我认为最终人们会明白的。

examples.text: Violence in the last analysis produces more violence.
examples.translation: 暴力最终会产生更多的暴力。

examples.text: ...our daily lives, so different from those of our ancestors...
examples.translation: 与我们祖先的生活有着天壤之别的我们的日常生活

examples.text: He could trace his ancestors back seven hundred years.
examples.translation: 他的先祖可以上溯到700年前。

examples.text: The direct ancestor of the modern cat was the Kaffir cat of ancient Egypt...
examples.translation: 现代猫的直系原种是古埃及的卡菲尔猫。

examples.text: The immediate ancestor of rock 'n' roll is rhythm-and-blues.
examples.translation: 摇滚乐直接源自节奏布鲁斯。

meanings.meaning: 锚；抛锚停泊；靠山；新闻节目主播

examples.text: We could anchor off the pier...
examples.translation: 我们可以在码头附近下锚停泊。

examples.text: They anchored the boat.
examples.translation: 他们抛锚停船。

examples.text: The roots anchor the plant in the earth...
examples.translation: 根部使植物固定在土壤中。

examples.text: The child seat belt was not properly anchored to the car.
examples.translation: 儿童坐椅的安全带并未在车上固定到位。

examples.text: He provided an emotional anchor for her...
examples.translation: 他是她的精神支柱。

examples.text: He remains the anchor of the country's fragile political balance.
examples.translation: 他仍然是维系该国脆弱的政治平衡的支柱。

examples.text: A united Germany must be firmly anchored in NATO if Europe is to remain stable...
examples.translation: 欧洲要保持稳定，德国必须统一并固守北约。

examples.text: His basic outlook remains anchored in the liberal tradition.
examples.translation: 他的基本观念依旧扎根于自由主义传统。

examples.text: Viewers saw him anchoring a five-minute summary of regional news.
examples.translation: 观众看见他主持一个5分钟的地方新闻摘要节目。

examples.text: ...a series of cassettes on the Vietnam War, anchored by Mr. Cronkite.
examples.translation: 克朗凯特先生主持的关于越南战争的系列节目录像带

examples.text: He worked in the news division of ABC — he was the anchor of its 15-minute evening newscast.
examples.translation: 他在美国广播公司的新闻部工作——他是晚间15分钟新闻播报的主持人。

examples.text: Sailing boats lay at anchor in the narrow waterway.
examples.translation: 帆船停泊在狭窄的水道上。

examples.text: We dropped anchor in a sheltered spot.
examples.translation: 我们在一个能够遮风挡雨的地方下了锚。

meanings.meaning: 古代的；古老的，过时的；年老的

examples.text: They believed ancient Greece and Rome were vital sources of learning.
examples.translation: 他们认为古代希腊罗马是知识的重要发源地。

examples.text: Salisbury Plain was known anciently as Ellendune.
examples.translation: 索尔兹伯里平原在古代被称为Ellendune。

examples.text: ...ancient Jewish tradition.
examples.translation: 古老的犹太传统

examples.text: ...ancient fishing rights.
examples.translation: 由来已久的捕鱼权

examples.text: ...a few acres of ancient woodland.
examples.translation: 几英亩古老的林地

examples.text: The ancients knew more than we do about the heavens.
examples.translation: 古代人对于上天比我们知道得多。

examples.text: Pete was telling them an anecdote about their mother...
examples.translation: 皮特正在给他们讲一件他们母亲的趣闻。

examples.text: He has a talent for recollection and anecdote.
examples.translation: 他在记忆力和讲述趣闻轶事方面颇具天赋。

examples.text: The image of the fox as a pest is grossly exaggerated in anecdote and folklore.
examples.translation: 狐狸的害人精形象在传闻和民间故事中遭到严重的夸大。

examples.text: When he returned, she and Simon had already gone...
examples.translation: 他回来时，她和西蒙已经走了。

examples.text: Between 1914 and 1920 large parts of Albania were occupied by the Italians...
examples.translation: 在1914年至1920年间阿尔巴尼亚的大部分地区被意大利人占据。

examples.text: I'm going to write good jokes and become a good comedian...
examples.translation: 我打算写一些精彩的笑话，成为出色的喜剧作家。

examples.text: I'm 53 and I'm very happy.
examples.translation: 我53岁而且我很幸福。

examples.text: Learning becomes more and more difficult as we get older...
examples.translation: 随着年龄增长，学习变得越来越难。

examples.text: Day by day I am getting better and better...
examples.translation: 我在一天天地好转。

examples.text: We talked for hours and hours...
examples.translation: 我们谈了很久很久。

examples.text: He lay down on the floor and cried and cried.
examples.translation: 他躺在地板上，哭个不停。

examples.text: I waved goodbye and went down the stone harbour steps...
examples.translation: 我挥手告别，然后走下港口石阶。

examples.text: He asked for ice for his whiskey and proceeded to get drunk.
examples.translation: 他要求给他的威士忌里面加冰，接着喝得大醉。

examples.text: You could only really tell the effects of the disease in the long term, and five years wasn't long enough...
examples.translation: 真的，这种病只能在很久以后才能看出它的影响，而5年的时间还不够长。

examples.text: The cure for bad teaching is good teachers, and good teachers cost money.
examples.translation: 解决教学质量差的办法就是请好的教师，但请好的教师是需要花钱的。

examples.text: All through yesterday crowds have been arriving and by midnight thousands of people packed the square.
examples.translation: 昨天陆续有大批人到来，午夜时有几千人聚集在广场上。

examples.text: As Downing claims, and as we noted above, reading is best established when the child has an intimate knowledge of the language...
examples.translation: 如唐宁所说，也正如我们前文所指出的，当孩子对语言非常熟悉时，阅读的效果最佳。

examples.text: Finally — and I really ought to stop in a minute — I wish to make the following recommendations.
examples.translation: 最后——我确实应该停一下——我想作以下推荐。

examples.text: Commuter airlines fly to out-of-the-way places. And business travelers are the ones who go to those locations.
examples.translation: 支线航空公司航班飞往偏僻地区。商务旅客就是会前往那些地区的人。

examples.text: 'He used to be so handsome.' — 'And now?'...
examples.translation: “他以前是那么英俊。”——“那么现在呢？”

examples.text: 'Well, of course, they haven't won a football game.' — 'And what would you expect?'.
examples.translation: “嗯，当然，他们一场足球比赛也没有赢过。”——“那么你所期望的是什么呢？”

examples.text: And now the drought in Sudan...
examples.translation: 现在苏丹也有旱情。

examples.text: Football, and Aston Villa will reclaim their lead at the top of the English First Division.
examples.translation: 来看足球，阿斯顿维拉队将在英格兰甲级联赛重登榜首。

examples.text: What does two and two make?
examples.translation: 2加2等于几？

examples.text: McCain spent five and a half years in a prisoner of war camp in Vietnam.
examples.translation: 麦凯恩在越南的战俘营里度过了5年半的时间。

examples.text: We printed two hundred and fifty invitations.
examples.translation: 我们印了250份请柬。

examples.text: ...three thousand and twenty-six pounds.

meanings.meaning: (Angel)人名；(德、塞、俄、保、瑞典、挪)安格尔；(土)安盖尔；(法、葡)安热尔；(西)安赫尔；(英、罗)安杰尔

examples.text: Thank you a thousand times, you're an angel.
examples.translation: 万分感谢，你真是个大好人。

examples.text: Poppa thought her an angel...
examples.translation: 爸爸视她为小天使。

examples.text: He was such an angel to put up with it.
examples.translation: 他这都能忍，真是个大好人。

examples.text: Billy is on the side of the angels when it comes to racial tolerance.
examples.translation: 说起种族间的包容，比利可真是宅心仁厚。

examples.text: Martin is inclined to rush in where angels fear to tread.
examples.translation: 马丁总是喜欢贸然行事。

meanings.meaning: (Anger)人名；(罗)安杰尔；(法)安热；(德、捷、瑞典)安格尔

examples.text: He cried with anger and frustration...
examples.translation: 他愤怒而又沮丧得哭了起来。

examples.text: Ellen felt both despair and anger at her mother.
examples.translation: 埃伦对她的母亲感到既绝望又生气。

examples.text: The decision to allow more offshore oil drilling angered some Californians.
examples.translation: 允许进行更多近海石油钻探的决定激怒了一些加利福尼亚人。

examples.text: The boat is now leaning at a 30 degree angle.
examples.translation: 船正以30度角倾斜。

examples.text: ...the angle of the blade.
examples.translation: 刀口的夹角

examples.text: ...brackets to adjust the steering wheel's angle.
examples.translation: 用于调整方向盘角度的支架

examples.text: Thanks to the angle at which he stood, he could just see the sunset...
examples.translation: 由于站的位置视角好，他刚好能看见日落。

examples.text: His face will be discreetly concealed by camera angles.
examples.translation: 通过调整照相机的角度，他的脸将被巧妙地遮住。

examples.text: We had to do the scene over and over again, from different angles...
examples.translation: 我们不得不翻来覆去地从不同的角度拍这个场面。

examples.text: He was considering the idea from all angles.
examples.translation: 他正从各个角度考虑这个想法。

examples.text: It sounds as if he's just angling for sympathy.
examples.translation: 听起来好像他只是在博取同情。

examples.text: You can open the slats for a bright light or angle them for more shade...
examples.translation: 可以调节百叶窗使光线亮一些，也可以暗一些。

examples.text: The path angled downhill and northwards...
examples.translation: 小路向山下伸展，然后向北延伸。

examples.text: He drove down the long, steeply angled driveway.
examples.translation: 他驱车从又长又陡的车道驶下。

examples.text: An iron bar stuck out at an angle...
examples.translation: 一根铁棍斜伸出来。

examples.text: The wall's at a slight angle.
examples.translation: 这面墙有点歪。

meanings.meaning: 生气的；愤怒的；狂暴的；（伤口等）发炎的

examples.text: She had been very angry at the person who stole her new bike...
examples.translation: 她很生气有人偷走了她的新自行车。

examples.text: Are you angry with me for some reason?...
examples.translation: 你是因为什么原因在生我的气吗？

examples.text: I was angry about the rumours...
examples.translation: 我对于这些谣言很愤怒。

examples.text: He's angry that people have called him a racist...
examples.translation: 人们把他叫做种族主义者，他对此愤愤不平。

examples.text: An angry mob gathered outside the courthouse.
examples.translation: 一群愤怒的暴民聚集在法院外。

examples.text: Officials reacted angrily to those charges...
examples.translation: 官员们对那些指控很生气。

examples.text: Health workers are angrily demanding higher pay.
examples.translation: 医务人员正怒气冲冲地要求增加工资。

examples.text: He was badly concussed, the glass leaving two angry cuts across his forehead.
examples.translation: 他遭受了严重的脑震荡，脑门上留下的两道被玻璃划破的口子已经红肿。

examples.text: A cry of anguish burst from her lips...
examples.translation: 她突然痛苦地大叫了一声。

examples.text: Mark looked at him in anguish.
examples.translation: 马克痛苦地看着他。

examples.text: He was attacked by wild animals...
examples.translation: 他遭到野兽的袭击。

examples.text: He had a real knowledge of animals, birds and flowers.
examples.translation: 他在花鸟走兽方面知之甚多。

examples.text: Language is something which fundamentally distinguishes humans from animals.
examples.translation: 语言是将人类与动物区分开来的基本特征。

examples.text: ...a habitat for plants and animals.
examples.translation: 动植物的栖息地

examples.text: Watch any young human being, or any other young animal.
examples.translation: 注意儿童或其他幼小动物。

examples.text: The illegal trade in animal products continues to flourish...
examples.translation: 野生动物制品的非法交易仍旧猖獗。

examples.text: Cut down on animal fats found in red meat, hard cheeses and so on.
examples.translation: 减少摄入存在于红色肉类、硬干酪等中的动物脂肪。

examples.text: This man is an animal, a beast...
examples.translation: 这人是个畜生，是个野兽。

examples.text: He was an animal in his younger days.
examples.translation: 他年轻时，是个衣冠禽兽。

examples.text: There was no doubting the animal magnetism of the man...
examples.translation: 这个男人无疑有一种野性的魅力。

examples.text: You feel an animal panic to run and hide.
examples.translation: 你会感到一种本能的恐惧而想要去逃避。

examples.text: You're quite a party animal aren't you, out there every night...
examples.translation: 你就是为派对而生的，不是吗，每天晚上你都去参加派对。

examples.text: The entrepreneur at twenty-five is a different animal from the entrepreneur at fifty.
examples.translation: 25岁的企业家和50岁的企业家是两种不同的人。

examples.text: John twisted his ankle badly.
examples.translation: 约翰的脚脖子崴得很严重。

examples.text: ...the one hundredth anniversary of the birth of Ho Chi Minh.
examples.translation: 胡志明诞辰一百周年纪念

meanings.meaning: 宣布参加竞选；当播音员

examples.text: He will announce tonight that he is resigning from office...
examples.translation: 他将于今晚宣布辞职。

examples.text: She was planning to announce her engagement to Peter...
examples.translation: 她正计划宣布她和彼得订婚一事。

examples.text: It was announced that the groups have agreed to a ceasefire.
examples.translation: 据宣告称这些组织已经同意停火。

examples.text: Peter announced that he had no intention of wasting his time at any university...
examples.translation: 彼得宣称他无意在任何一所大学浪费时间。

examples.text: 'I'm having a bath and going to bed,' she announced, and left the room.
examples.translation: “我要洗个澡然后上床睡觉，”她大声说完便离开了房间。

examples.text: Station staff announced the arrival of the train over the tannoy...
examples.translation: 车站工作人员通过广播告知火车到站了。

examples.text: They announced his plane was delayed.
examples.translation: 广播通知他所乘的航班晚点了。

examples.text: The next letter announced the birth of another boy...
examples.translation: 下一封信通知又一个男孩出生了。

examples.text: His entrance was announced by a buzzer connected to the door.
examples.translation: 他刚一进去，与门相连的门铃便嗡嗡作响。

examples.text: Dinner was announced, and served.
examples.translation: 已宣布开饭了，菜都上齐了。

examples.text: Try making a note of the things which annoy you...
examples.translation: 试着把烦心事写下来。

examples.text: It annoyed me that I didn't have time to do more reading...
examples.translation: 腾不出时间多看会儿书让我很烦。

examples.text: It just annoyed me to hear him going on.
examples.translation: 听他说个不停，真让我不堪其烦。

examples.text: ...the annual conference of Britain's trade union movement...
examples.translation: 英国工会运动的年会

examples.text: In its annual report, UNICEF says at least 40,000 children die every day.
examples.translation: 在其年度报告中，联合国儿童基金会称每天至少有4万名儿童死亡。

examples.text: Companies report to their shareholders annually.
examples.translation: 各公司每年向其股东汇报一次。

examples.text: Annual costs, tuition and fees, £6,600...
examples.translation: 每年的花销、学费和各项杂费6,600英镑。

examples.text: The electronic and printing unit has annual sales of about $80 million.
examples.translation: 电子印刷部门每年销售额约为8,000万美元。

examples.text: El Salvador produces 100,000 tons of refined copper annually...
examples.translation: 萨尔瓦多每年生产10万吨纯铜。

examples.text: Holiday World hires 300 new employees annually.
examples.translation: 假日世界每年雇佣300名新员工。

examples.text: I looked for Wyman's picture in my high-school annual...
examples.translation: 我在中学年刊中寻找怀曼的照片。

examples.text: He tried the various almanacs, annuals and gazettes which were held in the library.
examples.translation: 他试着在图书馆里找过各种历书、年鉴和报纸。

examples.text: The simplest way to deal with these hardy annuals is to sow them where they are to flower.
examples.translation: 处理这些一年生耐寒植物最简单的办法是将他们种在能开花的地方。

meanings.meaning: 匿名的，无名的；无个性特征的

examples.text: You can remain anonymous if you wish...
examples.translation: 你愿意的话可以不透露姓名。

examples.text: An anonymous benefactor stepped in to provide the prize money.
examples.translation: 一个匿名捐助者施以援手提供了奖金。

examples.text: ...anonymous phone calls.
examples.translation: 匿名电话

examples.text: Both mother and daughter, who have requested anonymity, are doing fine.
examples.translation: 这对不愿意透露姓名的母女俩目前情况良好。

examples.text: The latest photographs were sent anonymously to the magazine's Paris headquarters.
examples.translation: 最新的照片以匿名方式寄到了该杂志的巴黎总部。

examples.text: Of course, that would have to be by anonymous vote.
examples.translation: 当然，那必须通过不记名投票的方式。

examples.text: He claims many more people would support him in the anonymity of a voting booth.
examples.translation: 他声称会有更多的人通过投票站匿名投票的方式来支持他。

examples.text: ...the most anonymous part of north-west Washington...
examples.translation: 华盛顿西北部最无特色的地区

examples.text: It's nice to stay in a home rather than in an anonymous holiday villa.
examples.translation: 呆在家里比呆在单调乏味的度假别墅里要惬意得多。

examples.text: ...the anonymity of the rented room.
examples.translation: 租住的房间的单调无趣

meanings.meaning: 又一，另一；另外的；不同的

examples.text: Mrs. Madrigal buttered another piece of toast...
examples.translation: 马德里加尔夫人给另一片烤面包涂上了黄油。

examples.text: We're going to have another baby.
examples.translation: 我们又要有一个孩子。

examples.text: The demand generated by one factory required the construction of another...
examples.translation: 一家工厂产生的需求使得必须再建造一家工厂。

examples.text: MPs have one free trip to Brussels and another to Strasbourg, headquarters of the EC, each year.
examples.translation: 议员每年可免费去布鲁塞尔和欧洲委员会总部斯特拉斯堡旅行一次。

examples.text: I think he's just going to deal with this problem another day...
examples.translation: 我想他改天就会处理这个问题。

examples.text: The counsellor referred her to another therapist.
examples.translation: 咨询指导让她去看另一位治疗专家。

examples.text: He said one thing when he came here, and he's gone back to Washington and done quite another...
examples.translation: 他来这儿说的是一回事，等回到华盛顿做的又是另一回事。

examples.text: He didn't really believe that any human being could read another's mind.
examples.translation: 他并不真的相信有谁会读心术。

examples.text: Another time of great excitement for us boys was when war broke out...
examples.translation: 对我们男孩子来说另一个极度刺激的时刻是战争爆发。

examples.text: Another change that Sue made was to install central heating.
examples.translation: 休所作的另一个改变是安装中央供暖系统。

examples.text: Continue down the same road for another 2 kilometres until you reach the church of Santa Maria...
examples.translation: 沿同一条路再往前走两公里，直至到达圣马丽亚教堂。

examples.text: He believes prices will not rise by more than another 4 per cent.
examples.translation: 他认为物价涨幅不会再超过4个百分点。

examples.text: You may never be another Hemingway, but you can learn to write well.
examples.translation: 你可能成不了第二个海明威，但你可以练就一手好文笔。

examples.text: ...women learning to help themselves and one another...
examples.translation: 学着自助和互助的妇女们

examples.text: The two countries do little trade with one another.
examples.translation: 两国之间很少有贸易往来。

examples.text: They had faced one difficulty after another with bravery and dedication...
examples.translation: 他们以无畏和无私奉献的精神迎接了一个又一个的困难。

examples.text: They kept going, destroying one store after another.
examples.translation: 他们并未停手，摧毁了一家又一家商店。

examples.text: ...family members and visiting artists of one kind or another crowding the huge kitchen...
examples.translation: 聚集在这个宽敞厨房里的家庭成员和来访的各类艺术家

examples.text: All of these industries have at one time or another been linked to cancer.
examples.translation: 所有这些产业都曾在不同时期与癌症有过联系。

examples.text: I knew Ben was lying when he answered me...
examples.translation: 我知道本回答我时在撒谎。

examples.text: Just answer the question...
examples.translation: 只回答问题。

examples.text: He paused before answering...
examples.translation: 他停顿了一下才回答。

examples.text: 'When?' asked Alba, 'Tonight', answered Tom...
examples.translation: “什么时候？”阿尔芭问道。“今晚，”汤姆回答。

examples.text: Williams answered that he had no specific proposals yet.
examples.translation: 威廉斯回答说他还没有具体的提案。

examples.text: Without waiting for an answer, he turned and went in through the door...
examples.translation: 未等答复，他就转身进了门。

examples.text: I don't quite know what to say in answer to your question.
examples.translation: 我不太清楚如何回答你的问题。

examples.text: She is tough, unwilling to take no for an answer...
examples.translation: 她很强硬，不达目的誓不罢休。

examples.text: He would never take no for an answer.
examples.translation: 他从来都坚持己见。

examples.text: Did he answer your letter?...
examples.translation: 他给你回信了吗？

examples.text: She answered an advert for a job as a cook.
examples.translation: 她看到一则招聘厨师的广告后写信应征。

examples.text: I wrote to him but I never had an answer back...
examples.translation: 我写了信给他，但一直没收到回信。

examples.text: She wrote to Roosevelt's secretary in answer to his letter of the day before.
examples.translation: 她写了信给罗斯福的秘书，回复罗斯福前一天的来信。

examples.text: She answered her phone on the first ring...
examples.translation: 电话刚一响，她就接了。

examples.text: A middle-aged woman answered the door.
examples.translation: 一个中年妇女应声开了门。

examples.text: I knocked at the front door and there was no answer.
examples.translation: 我敲了敲前门，没有人应。

examples.text: There are no easy answers to the problems facing the economy...
examples.translation: 解决经济所面临的问题并非易事。

examples.text: Prison is not the answer for most young offenders...
examples.translation: 就大多数年轻的犯法者来说，把他们关进监狱不是解决问题的办法。

examples.text: Legislation is only part of the answer.
examples.translation: 立法只是解决方案中的一部分。

examples.text: Simply marking an answer wrong will not help the pupil to get future examples correct...
examples.translation: 仅仅在答案上打叉号不会有助于学生做对日后的题目。

examples.text: Below are printed the answers to the Brain of Soccer 1993 quiz.
examples.translation: 以下所印的是1993年“脑力足球”小测验的答案。

examples.text: To obtain her degree, she answered 81 questions over 10 papers.
examples.translation: 为获得学位，她回答了10页纸上的81个问题。

examples.text: In answer to speculation that she wouldn't finish the race, she boldly declared her intention of winning it.
examples.translation: 为了回应她会中途退赛的猜测，她大胆地宣布她要赢得这场比赛。

examples.text: He answered her smile with one of his own...
examples.translation: 他对她的微笑回以同礼。

examples.text: That statement seemed designed to answer criticism of allied bombing missions.
examples.translation: 那份声明似乎是专门就联合轰炸任务的批评作出反击。

examples.text: Cachaca is Brazil's answer to tequila.
examples.translation: 巴西甜酒相当于是巴西的龙舌兰酒。

examples.text: We provide specially designed shopping trolleys to answer the needs of parents with young children.
examples.translation: 我们提供特别设计的购物车，以满足带幼儿的父母的需要。

examples.text: Two men answering the description of the suspects tried to enter Switzerland...
examples.translation: 与描述的疑犯样子相符的两名男子试图进入瑞士。

examples.text: The Japanese never built any aircraft remotely answering to this description.
examples.translation: 日本人从未制造过与此描述有丝毫相近的飞机。

examples.text: Ants swarmed up out of the ground and covered her shoes and legs.
examples.translation: 蚂蚁从地下成群地钻出来，爬满了她的鞋子和双腿。

meanings.meaning: [电讯] 天线；[动] 触角，[昆] 触须

examples.text: For today's spacewalk, Feustel and Fincke will complete the unfinished work on the antenna system.

meanings.meaning: 预期，期望；占先，抢先；提前使用

examples.text: At the time we couldn't have anticipated the result of our campaigning...
examples.translation: 那时我们不可能预料到我们这项运动的结果。

examples.text: It is anticipated that the equivalent of 192 full-time jobs will be lost...
examples.translation: 预计将失去相当于192份全职工作的岗位。

examples.text: Officials anticipate that rivalry between leaders of the various drug factions could erupt into full scale war.
examples.translation: 官员们预计各个毒品团伙头目之间的对抗可能会引发一场全面的冲突。

examples.text: What Jeff did was to anticipate my next question...
examples.translation: 杰夫预先回答了我的下一个问题。

examples.text: Do you expect your partner to anticipate your needs?
examples.translation: 你是否期望你的伴侣不等你提出就主动满足你的需要？

examples.text: In the 50s, Rauschenberg anticipated the conceptual art movement of the 80s.
examples.translation: 上世纪50年代时，劳申伯格就早早地预见到了80年代的概念艺术运动。

meanings.meaning: 古老的，年代久远的；过时的，古董的；古风的，古式的
古董，古玩；古风，古希腊和古罗马艺术风格

examples.text: ...a genuine antique.
examples.translation: 一件古董真品

examples.text: ...antique silver jewellery...
examples.translation: 古董银首饰

examples.text: He finds material at auctions, antique shops and flea markets.
examples.translation: 他在拍卖行、古玩店和跳蚤市场中寻宝。

meanings.meaning: 焦虑；渴望；挂念；令人焦虑的事

examples.text: Her voice was full of anxiety...
examples.translation: 她的声音满是焦虑不安。

examples.text: Many editorials express their anxieties about the economic chaos in the country.
examples.translation: 许多社论对该国经济的混乱状况表示忧虑。

meanings.meaning: 焦虑的；担忧的；渴望的；急切的

examples.text: Both the Americans and the Russians are anxious to avoid conflict in South Asia...
examples.translation: 美国人和俄罗斯人都迫切希望避免在南亚发生冲突。

examples.text: He is anxious that there should be no delay...
examples.translation: 他非常希望不会出现延误。

examples.text: Those anxious for reform say that the present system is too narrow.
examples.translation: 那些渴望改革的人声称现有的体制过于狭隘。

examples.text: The foreign minister admitted he was still anxious about the situation in the country...
examples.translation: 外交部长承认对于该国的局势他仍然颇感忧虑。

examples.text: A friend of mine is a very anxious person.
examples.translation: 我的一个朋友是个非常容易焦虑不安的人。

examples.text: They are waiting anxiously to see who will succeed him.
examples.translation: 他们焦急地等待着看谁会接替他上任。

examples.text: The Prime Minister faces anxious hours before the votes are counted tomorrow night.
examples.translation: 在明晚计票完成之前，首相将面临数小时的煎熬等待。

examples.text: I never make any big decisions...
examples.translation: 我从未作过任何重大决定。

examples.text: I'm not making any promises...
examples.translation: 我不会作任何保证。

examples.text: We are doing this all without any support from the hospital...
examples.translation: 我们正在没有得到医院方面任何支持的情况下做这件事。

examples.text: Earlier reports were unable to confirm that there were any survivors...
examples.translation: 早先的报道无法证实是否有幸存者。

examples.text: It is too early to say what effect, if any, there will be on the workforce.
examples.translation: 如果会对劳动力产生一些影响，现在就说是什么影响还言之过早。

examples.text: You don't know any of my friends...
examples.translation: 我的朋友你一个都不认识。

examples.text: There was nothing you could do, nothing any of us could do.
examples.translation: 你帮不上什么忙，我们中的任何人也都无能为力。

examples.text: The children needed new school clothes and Kim couldn't afford any.
examples.translation: 孩子们需要新校服，可是金一件也买不起。

examples.text: Do you speak any foreign languages?...
examples.translation: 你会说外语吗？

examples.text: Are there any ladies in the audience?...
examples.translation: 观众当中有女士吗？

examples.text: Have you got any cheese I can have with this bread?
examples.translation: 你有没有奶酪，我好就着面包一起吃？

examples.text: Introduce foods one at a time and notice if you feel uncomfortable with any of them...
examples.translation: 一次加进一种食物，注意是否有哪一种令你感到不适。

examples.text: Have you ever used a homeopathic remedy for any of the following reasons?
examples.translation: 你是否因为以下任何一种理由采用过顺势疗法？

examples.text: If any bright thoughts occur to you pass them straight to me. Have you got any?...
examples.translation: 你有什么高见就立马告诉我。现在有吗？

examples.text: The plants are inspected for insects and if I find any, they are squashed.
examples.translation: 这些植物常进行虫害检查，如果发现害虫我就把它们捏死。

examples.text: Any actor will tell you that it is easier to perform than to be themselves...
examples.translation: 每一个演员都会告诉你演戏比做自己容易。

examples.text: I'm prepared to take any advice...
examples.translation: 我愿意接受任何忠告。

examples.text: I would overcome any weakness, any despair, any fear.
examples.translation: 我要克服所有的软弱、绝望和恐惧。

examples.text: Nealy disappeared two days ago, several miles away from any of the fighting...
examples.translation: 尼利两天前失踪了，所有战斗地点周围几英里内都不见他的踪影。

examples.text: It had been the biggest mistake any of them could remember.
examples.translation: 这是他们每一个人所能记得的最重大的错误。

examples.text: Clean the mussels and discard any that do not close.
examples.translation: 把贻贝洗干净，凡是合不上口的都扔掉。

examples.text: ...mangoes, bananas, pineapples, pears, and grapes as delicious as any you have ever eaten.
examples.translation: 吃过的最美味的芒果、香蕉、菠萝、梨和葡萄

examples.text: I can't see things getting any easier for graduates...
examples.translation: 我没看出毕业生的境遇有丝毫好转。

examples.text: Anne's not getting any younger.
examples.translation: 安妮一点没有变年轻。

examples.text: Finzer is not just any East Coast businessman...
examples.translation: 芬泽不是个普通的东海岸生意人。

examples.text: It's fashionable for young people to wear trainers, but not just any trainers.
examples.translation: 年轻人穿旅游鞋很时尚，但不是说所有的旅游鞋都如此。

examples.text: I don't want to see her any more...
examples.translation: 我不想再见到她。

examples.text: We felt we had no home any more, no family, nothing...
examples.translation: 我们觉得我们没有了家，也没有了家人，一无所有。

examples.text: I couldn't keep the tears hidden any longer.
examples.translation: 我再也掩饰不住泪水。

examples.text: Being a very agreeable person, however, she went on dates with practically anybody who asked.

meanings.meaning: 总之；无论如何；不管怎样

examples.text: ...her long legs which she displayed all anyhow getting in and out of her car.
examples.translation: 她上下车时不经意露出的长腿

examples.text: I won't tell anyone I saw you here...
examples.translation: 我不会告诉任何人我在这儿见过你。

examples.text: You needn't talk to anyone if you don't want to...
examples.translation: 不想说话的时候，你可以不说。

examples.text: He was far too scared to tell anybody...
examples.translation: 他害怕极了，不敢告诉任何人。

examples.text: Presidents are not any different from anybody else; they're human beings.
examples.translation: 总统跟一般人没有什么不同；他们也是人。

examples.text: Why would anyone want that job?...
examples.translation: 为什么会有人想要那份工作呢？

examples.text: How can anyone look sad at an occasion like this?...
examples.translation: 在这样的场合怎么会有人显得忧伤呢？

examples.text: If anyone deserves to be happy, you do.
examples.translation: 如果有谁应该获得幸福的话，那就是你。

examples.text: I always had been the person who achieved things before anyone else at my age...
examples.translation: 我过去总是比同龄人要捷足先登。

examples.text: It's not a job for anyone who is slow with numbers...
examples.translation: 这份工作不适合不擅长算术的人。

examples.text: Anybody interested in pop culture at all should buy 'Pure Cult'.
examples.translation: 任何对流行文化有一点兴趣的人都应该买《完全崇拜》这张专辑。

examples.text: Anyone could be doing what I'mdoing...
examples.translation: 我在做的事，谁都可能正在做。

examples.text: Al Smith could make anybody laugh.
examples.translation: 阿尔·史密斯能把所有人逗乐。

examples.text: It seems anyone who's anyone in business is going to the conference.
examples.translation: 似乎商界所有重要人物都将参加那个会议。

meanings.meaning: 无论如何，不管怎样；总之

examples.text: I'm certain David's told you his business troubles. Anyway, it's no secret that he owes money...
examples.translation: 我敢肯定戴维已经告诉过你他生意上有麻烦了。反正他欠钱也不是什么秘密了。

examples.text: Mother certainly won't let him stay with her and anyhow he wouldn't.
examples.translation: 母亲当然不会让他和她住在一起，再说他也不愿意。

examples.text: I don't know why I settled on Aberdeen, but anyway I did...
examples.translation: 我不知道为什么我定居在阿伯丁，尽管如此，我还是这么做了。

examples.text: I wasn't qualified to apply for the job really but I got it anyhow.
examples.translation: 实际上我并不具备申请这份工作的资格，但不管怎样，我还是被录用了。

examples.text: Mary Ann doesn't want to have children. Not right now, anyway.
examples.translation: 玛丽·安不想要孩子，至少现在不想。

examples.text: What do you want from me, anyway?...
examples.translation: 你到底想从我这儿得到什么？

examples.text: Where the hell was Bud, anyhow?
examples.translation: 巴德到底在哪儿？

examples.text: I was told to go to Reading for this interview. It was a very amusing affair. Anyhow, I got the job.
examples.translation: 我被通知前往雷丁面试。整个过程很有意思。总之，我被录用了。

examples.text: 'I've got a terrible cold.' — 'Have you? Oh dear. Anyway, so you're not going to go away this weekend?'
examples.translation: “我得了重感冒。”——“是吗？哦，天啊。对了，那你这个周末就不走了吧？”

examples.text: 'Anyway, I'd better let you have your dinner. Give our love to Francis. Bye.'
examples.translation: “那么，我不打扰你用餐了。代我们向弗朗西斯问好。再见。”

examples.text: 'Anyhow, thanks a lot. Bye bye.'
examples.translation: “那么，多谢了。再见。”

examples.text: We can't do anything...
examples.translation: 我们什么都做不了。

examples.text: Dad sat, not saying anything...
examples.translation: 爸爸坐着，一声不吭。

examples.text: She couldn't see or hear anything at all...
examples.translation: 她什么也看不见，什么也听不见。

examples.text: By the time I get home, I'm too tired to do anything active...
examples.translation: 我到家时累得无法动弹。

examples.text: I couldn't manage anything without you.
examples.translation: 没有你，我一事无成。

examples.text: What happened, is anything wrong?...
examples.translation: 怎么了，出什么事了吗？

examples.text: Did you find anything?...
examples.translation: 你找到什么了吗？

examples.text: Is there anything you can do to help?...
examples.translation: 你能帮忙做点什么吗？

examples.text: If there's anything I could do for him, I would.
examples.translation: 如果需要我帮他做点什么，我会帮忙的。

examples.text: More than anything else, he wanted to become a teacher...
examples.translation: 他最想成为一名教师。

examples.text: Anything that's cheap this year will be even cheaper next year...
examples.translation: 今年的便宜货明年会更便宜。

examples.text: She collects anything that has charm.
examples.translation: 她收集一切有特色的东西。

examples.text: He is young, fresh, and ready for anything...
examples.translation: 他年轻又富有朝气，什么事都愿意做。

examples.text: At that point, anything could happen...
examples.translation: 那一刻，什么事都可能发生。

examples.text: He is convinced he just has to say 'please' and he can have anything.
examples.translation: 他深信只要说一个“请”字，他就能拥有任何东西。

examples.text: Doctors have decided the only way he can live anything near a normal life is to give him an operation...
examples.translation: 医生的结论是只有做手术，他才有可能过上基本正常的生活。

examples.text: Only Cowans played anything close to his true form...
examples.translation: 只有考恩斯算是发挥出了正常水平。

examples.text: Plainer examples of the early period do not fetch anything like these sums.
examples.translation: 早期更为普通的样本卖不到这种价钱。

examples.text: Factory farming has turned the cow into a milk machine, producing anything from 25 to 40 litres of milk per day...
examples.translation: 集约饲养把奶牛变成了生产牛奶的机器，每天差不多要挤出25升到40升的牛奶。

examples.text: Fights with his father lasted anything between fifteen minutes and an hour.
examples.translation: 和他父亲争吵了大约15分钟到一个小时。

examples.text: He used to be as smart as anything...
examples.translation: 他过去聪明绝顶。

examples.text: She opened the door and jumped out, quick as anything.
examples.translation: 她打开门，飞快地跳了出来。

examples.text: I will be anything but quiet on Saturday night!...
examples.translation: 星期六的晚上我根本静不下心来！

examples.text: There's no evidence that he told anyone to say anything but the truth...
examples.translation: 并无证据表明他让什么人隐瞒真相。

examples.text: The Los Angeles police chief was not always so insulated from politicians; anything but.
examples.translation: 洛杉矶警察局局长并不总是如此疏远政客，根本不会。

examples.text: I wouldn't want to move for anything in the world...
examples.translation: 就是天塌了我也不搬走。

examples.text: I wouldn't have missed this summer in England for anything...
examples.translation: 我本来说什么也不会错过在英格兰的这个夏季的。

examples.text: I wouldn't be without Matthew for anything.
examples.translation: 我决不会离开马修。

examples.text: I never had to clean up after him. If anything, he did most of the cleaning.
examples.translation: 我从来不用跟在他后面打扫卫生。恰恰相反，他包揽了大部分的清洁工作。

examples.text: Listen, if you talk to him or anything make sure you let us know, will you...
examples.translation: 听着，如果你和他说话或什么的，一定要让我们知道，好吗？

examples.text: He didn't cry or scream or anything.
examples.translation: 他没哭也没喊，什么事也没有。

examples.text: I haven't got anywhere to live...
examples.translation: 我还没找到住的地方。

examples.text: There had never been such a beautiful woman anywhere in the world.
examples.translation: 世界上从未有过如此美丽的女人。

examples.text: Did you try to get help from anywhere?...
examples.translation: 你尝试过从哪里寻求帮助吗？

examples.text: If she wanted to go anywhere at all she had to wait for her father to drive her.
examples.translation: 她想去任何地方都只能等父亲开车送她去。

examples.text: In America most leisure-time activities are about a million times better than anywhere else...
examples.translation: 美国大多数休闲娱乐活动比其他地方要丰富得多的多。

examples.text: He'll meet you anywhere you want...
examples.translation: 他随你在哪儿见面都行。

examples.text: Let us know if you come across anywhere that has something special to offer.
examples.translation: 如果你碰上哪儿有什么特别的东西出售，就告诉我们。

examples.text: Rachel would have known Julia Stone anywhere.
examples.translation: 甭管到哪儿，雷切尔都会认出朱莉娅·斯通。

examples.text: ...jokes that are so funny they always work anywhere.
examples.translation: 屡试不爽的极为有趣的笑话

examples.text: His shoes cost anywhere from $200 up...
examples.translation: 他买的鞋子总在200美元以上。

examples.text: My visits lasted anywhere from three weeks to two months.
examples.translation: 我每次逗留时间从3个星期到两个月不等。

examples.text: There weren't anywhere near enough empty boxes...
examples.translation: 空箱子数量远远不够。

examples.text: The only one who's anywhere close to the truth is my mother.
examples.translation: 唯一算得上了解真相的人是我的母亲。

examples.text: The conversation did not seem to be getting anywhere...
examples.translation: 会谈好像没有取得任何进展。

examples.text: I didn't see that my career as a film-maker was going anywhere.
examples.translation: 我发现我作为电影制片人的职业没有什么发展前途。

meanings.meaning: 相距；与众不同地；分离着

examples.text: He was standing a bit apart from the rest of us, watching us...
examples.translation: 他站在离我们其余人不远的地方，看着我们。

examples.text: She saw Sheila standing some distance apart...
examples.translation: 她看见希拉站开了一段距离。

examples.text: Ray and sister Renee lived just 25 miles apart from each other.
examples.translation: 雷和妹妹勒妮的住处仅相隔25英里。

examples.text: ...regions that were too far apart to have any way of knowing about each other...
examples.translation: 相隔太远而无法互相了解的地区

examples.text: He was standing, feet apart.
examples.translation: 他叉腿站着。

examples.text: John and Isabelle moved apart, back into the sun...
examples.translation: 约翰和伊莎贝拉彼此分开，回到了阳光下。

examples.text: He tried in vain to keep the two dogs apart before the neighbour intervened.
examples.translation: 邻居过来帮忙前，他费了半天劲儿也没把两只狗分开。

examples.text: It was the first time Jane and I had been apart for more than a few days...
examples.translation: 那是我第一次和简分开数日。

examples.text: Mum and Dad live apart.
examples.translation: 妈妈和爸爸分居。

examples.text: When the clock stopped he took it apart to find out what was wrong...
examples.translation: 钟一不走了，他就把它拆开看看哪儿出毛病了。

examples.text: Many school buildings are unsafe, and some are falling apart.
examples.translation: 许多校舍不安全，有些简直是摇摇欲坠。

examples.text: Any manager knows that his company will start falling apart if his attention wanders...
examples.translation: 每个经理都知道只要自己的注意力有所分散，公司就会分崩离析。

examples.text: Her marriage to film producer Michael Greenburg fell apart.
examples.translation: 她和电影制片人迈克尔·格林伯格的婚姻破裂了。

examples.text: What really sets Mr Thaksin apart is that he comes from northern Thailand...
examples.translation: 他信先生真正与众不同之处是他来自泰国北部。

examples.text: Health spending tends to rise disproportionately as countries become richer; but even adjusting for this, America is a case apart.
examples.translation: 随着国家愈加富有，医疗保健费用增加的幅度却往往与之不成比例；但即使美国为此作出调整，还是与别国不同。

examples.text: Officials say they're so far apart on such a wide range of issues there's no telling how long the talks could drag on...
examples.translation: 官员们声称他们在许多问题上分歧甚大，所以无法预见谈判将拖多久。

examples.text: Their concept of a performance and our concept were miles apart.
examples.translation: 他们对于表演的理解和我们的大相径庭。

examples.text: I can still only tell Mark and Dave apart by the colour of their shoes!
examples.translation: 我仍然只能根据鞋子的颜色来区分马克和戴夫！

examples.text: Free range and battery eggs, boiled for four minutes, were hard to tell apart.
examples.translation: 柴鸡蛋和笼养鸡蛋在煮过4分钟之后很难区分。

examples.text: The room was empty apart from one man seated beside the fire...
examples.translation: 除了有个男人坐在火炉边，房间里空荡荡的。

examples.text: She was the only British competitor apart from Richard Meade.
examples.translation: 她是除了理查德·米德之外唯一的英国参赛者。

examples.text: This was, New York apart, the first American city I had ever been in where people actually lived downtown.
examples.translation: 除了纽约，这是我到过的第一个人们确实住在市中心的美国城市。

examples.text: Illiteracy threatens Britain's industrial performance. But, quite apart from that, the individual who can't read or write is unlikely to get a job...
examples.translation: 文盲的存在影响着英国的产业效益。但是，除此以外，更重要的是那些不具备读写能力的人也不太可能找到工作。

examples.text: There was always something to look forward to, apart from Rachel's visits.
examples.translation: 除了雷切尔的来访，总还有别的事情可以期待。

examples.text: That argument apart, it is for the Germans themselves to work out how their forces should come together.
examples.translation: 撇开那场纷争不谈，德国人自己也应该考虑一下如何将各种力量拧成一股绳。

examples.text: Christina has her own apartment, with her own car.
examples.translation: 克里斯蒂娜有自己的公寓和汽车。

examples.text: ...bleak cities of concrete apartment blocks.
examples.translation: 到处是水泥公寓楼群的沉闷的城市

examples.text: ...the private apartments of the Prince of Wales at St James's Palace.
examples.translation: 威尔士亲王在圣詹姆斯宫的私人套房

examples.text: You should apologise and tell the audience you will try to bring them the story later.

meanings.meaning: 道歉；谢罪；辩护；勉强的替代物

examples.text: I didn't get an apology...
examples.translation: 还没有向我道歉。

examples.text: We received a letter of apology...
examples.translation: 我们收到了一封致歉信。

examples.text: He made a public apology for the team's performance.
examples.translation: 他就队伍的表现公开道歉。

examples.text: His mother offered her apologies to the Jones family...
examples.translation: 他的母亲向琼斯一家赔了不是。

examples.text: When Mary finally appeared, she made her apologies to Mrs Madrigal.
examples.translation: 最终露面时，玛丽向马德里加尔夫人表示了歉意。

examples.text: Union officials made no apologies for the threatened chaos.
examples.translation: 工会干部们对于迫在眉睫的混乱局面不予道歉。

meanings.meaning: 减弱；变得苍白；令人发腻

examples.text: His ignorance appals me...
examples.translation: 他的无知让我震惊。

examples.text: My wife now looks like her mother, which appals me.
examples.translation: 我老婆现在看着就跟丈母娘似的，可吓人了。

examples.text: For many years, the country had been buried under the apparatus of the regime.
examples.translation: 多年来，这个国家一直处于该政权机构的高压统治下。

examples.text: ...a massive bureaucratic apparatus.
examples.translation: 庞大的官僚机构

examples.text: One of the boys had to be rescued by firemen wearing breathing apparatus.
examples.translation: 其中一个男孩须由带着呼吸装置的消防员才能救出。

examples.text: I was a bit depressed by our apparent lack of progress...
examples.translation: 我对我们看似缓慢的进展感到有些沮丧。

examples.text: There is at last an apparent end to the destructive price war.
examples.translation: 这场惨烈的价格战貌似终于结束了。

examples.text: It has been apparent that in other areas standards have held up well...
examples.translation: 显然，这些标准在其他地区执行得很好。

examples.text: The presence of a star is already apparent in the early film.
examples.translation: 在早期影片中已经显露出了明星相。

examples.text: The person may become dizzy for no apparent reason.
examples.translation: 这类人可能会莫名其妙地感到头晕。

meanings.meaning: 出现；显得；似乎；出庭；登场

examples.text: There appears to be increasing support for the leadership to take a more aggressive stance...
examples.translation: 好像有越来越多的人支持领导层采取更为强势的立场。

examples.text: The aircraft appears to have crashed near Katmandu...
examples.translation: 飞机似乎在加德满都附近坠毁了。

examples.text: It appears that some missiles have been moved...
examples.translation: 一些导弹似乎已经被移走了。

examples.text: It appears unlikely that the UN would consider making such a move...
examples.translation: 看起来联合国不太可能考虑采取这样一种行动。

examples.text: The presidency is beginning to appear a political irrelevance...
examples.translation: 总统一职似乎正在沦为政治上的摆设。

examples.text: Nine months later, those talks appear as distant as ever...
examples.translation: 9个月以后，那些会谈似乎仍然遥遥无期。

examples.text: He appeared willing to reach an agreement.
examples.translation: 他似乎愿意达成协议。

examples.text: She did her best to appear more self-assured than she felt...
examples.translation: 她竭力让自己表现得比实际更自信。

examples.text: He is anxious to appear a gentleman...
examples.translation: 他急于想表现得像个绅士。

examples.text: Under stress these people will appear to be superficial, over-eager and manipulative.
examples.translation: 这些人在压力下会显得浅薄无知、操之过急，而且爱摆布人。

examples.text: A woman appeared at the far end of the street...
examples.translation: 一个女人远远出现在街的尽头。

examples.text: Last night some of the prisoners appeared on the roof.
examples.translation: 昨晚，其中几个犯人出现在房顶上。

examples.text: ...small white flowers which appear in early summer...
examples.translation: 初夏时绽放的白色小花

examples.text: Slogans have appeared on walls around the city.
examples.translation: 标语已出现在全城周围的墙上。

examples.text: ...a test which can reveal infection at an early stage, before symptoms appear...
examples.translation: 可在症状出现前检测出早期感染的测试

examples.text: I could hardly wait for 'Boys' World' to appear each month.
examples.translation: 每个月我都翘首期盼着《男孩世界》的出版。

examples.text: ...a poem which appeared in his last collection of verse.
examples.translation: 发表在他最后一部诗集中的一首诗

examples.text: Jill Bennett became John Osborne's fourth wife, and appeared in several of his plays...
examples.translation: 吉尔·本内特成为了约翰·奥斯本的第四任妻子，并参演过他的几部戏剧。

examples.text: Student leaders appeared on television to ask for calm.
examples.translation: 学生领袖出现在电视上请求大家保持冷静。

examples.text: Two other executives appeared at Worthing Magistrates' Court charged with tax fraud...
examples.translation: 又有两个经理因偷税漏税指控被传唤到沃辛治安法庭。

examples.text: The American will appear before members of the disciplinary committee at Portman Square.
examples.translation: 那个美国人将在波特曼广场接受纪律委员会成员的审问。

meanings.meaning: 呼吁，恳求；上诉；诉诸，求助；有吸引力，迎合爱好；（体育比赛中）诉诸裁判
呼吁，请求；吸引力，感染力；上诉；诉诸裁判

examples.text: The Prime Minister appealed to young people to use their vote...
examples.translation: 首相呼吁年轻人行使他们的投票权。

examples.text: He will appeal to the state for an extension of unemployment benefits...
examples.translation: 他将呼吁国家延长领取失业救济金的时限。

examples.text: The United Nations has appealed for help from the international community.
examples.translation: 联合国已经呼吁国际社会提供援助。

examples.text: He has a message from King Fahd, believed to be an appeal for Arab unity...
examples.translation: 法赫德国王传话给他，据信内容是呼吁整个阿拉伯世界团结起来。

examples.text: Romania's government issued a last-minute appeal to him to call off his trip.
examples.translation: 罗马尼亚政府最后一刻恳请他取消行程。

examples.text: ...an appeal to save a library containing priceless manuscripts...
examples.translation: 为挽救存有珍贵手稿的图书馆的一次募捐

examples.text: This is not another appeal for famine relief.
examples.translation: 这不是为赈济饥荒的又一次募捐。

examples.text: He said they would appeal against the decision...
examples.translation: 他说他们将对该决议提出申诉。

examples.text: We intend to appeal the verdict...
examples.translation: 我们打算对裁决提出上诉。

examples.text: Maguire has appealed to the Supreme Court to stop her extradition.
examples.translation: 马圭尔已向最高法院提出上诉，要求停止对她的引渡。

examples.text: Heath's appeal against the sentence was later successful...
examples.translation: 希思对判决不服提出上诉，后来胜诉了。

examples.text: The jury agreed with her, but she lost the case on appeal.
examples.translation: 陪审团同意她的说法，但在上诉时她败诉了。

examples.text: On the other hand, the idea appealed to him...
examples.translation: 从另一方面来说，这个想法又使他很感兴趣。

examples.text: The range has long appealed to all tastes.
examples.translation: 该系列长期受到各类人士的欢迎。

examples.text: Its new title was meant to give the party greater public appeal...
examples.translation: 新的党名意在使该党对公众具有更强的吸引力。

examples.text: Johnson's appeal is to people in all walks of life.
examples.translation: 约翰逊广受各界人士欢迎。

examples.text: It was the president's second public appearance to date...
examples.translation: 这是总统到那时为止的第二次公开露面。

examples.text: Keegan made 68 appearances in two seasons for Southampton, scoring 37 times.
examples.translation: 基冈为南安普敦队踢了两个赛季，共上场68次，进球37个。

examples.text: She used to be so fussy about her appearance...
examples.translation: 她过去非常在意自己的容貌。

examples.text: He had the appearance of a college student...
examples.translation: 他的模样就像个大学生。

examples.text: A flat-roofed extension will add nothing to the value or appearance of the house.
examples.translation: 增建一个平顶房既不会使房子增值也不会使其更美观。

examples.text: The sudden appearance of a few bags of rice could start a riot.
examples.translation: 突然出现几袋大米可能会引起骚乱。

examples.text: ...last Christmas, when there'd been the welcome appearance of Cousin Fred.
examples.translation: 去年圣诞，堂兄弗雷德的现身受到热烈欢迎。

examples.text: Flowering plants were making their first appearance, but were still a rarity...
examples.translation: 显花植物开始出现了，但仍然很少。

examples.text: Fears are growing of a cholera outbreak following the appearance of a number of cases in the city.
examples.translation: 该市出现几起霍乱病例之后，人们对霍乱爆发的恐惧越来越强烈。

examples.text: We tried to meet both children's needs without the appearance of favoritism or unfairness...
examples.translation: 我们尽力对两个孩子的需要都予以满足，而不显得有所偏向或袒护。

examples.text: The US president risked giving the appearance that the US was taking sides.
examples.translation: 美国总统冒险作出美国正在摆明立场的姿态。

examples.text: He was a small and to all appearances an unassuming man.
examples.translation: 他个子小，看上去不事张扬。

examples.text: His parents' obsession with keeping up appearances haunted his childhood.
examples.translation: 父母过于爱面子的做法在他儿时一直困扰着他。

examples.text: You must put in an appearance, at least, or she'll think you're avoiding her.
examples.translation: 至少，你必须露一下面，否则她会认为你在躲避她。

examples.text: ...a burst appendix.
examples.translation: 阑尾穿孔

examples.text: He has a healthy appetite...
examples.translation: 他胃口很好。

examples.text: Symptoms are a slight fever, headache and loss of appetite.
examples.translation: 症状包括低烧、头痛和食欲不振。

examples.text: ...his appetite for success.
examples.translation: 他对成功的强烈渴望

examples.text: ...Americans' growing appetite for scandal...
examples.translation: 美国人对丑闻日益增强的好奇心

examples.text: She gave him just enough information to whet his appetite.
examples.translation: 她向他透露的信息刚好能吊起他的胃口。

examples.text: The audience laughed and applauded...
examples.translation: 观众边笑边鼓掌。

examples.text: Every person stood to applaud his unforgettable act of courage.
examples.translation: 所有人起立为他不可磨灭的英勇之举鼓掌。

examples.text: He should be applauded for his courage...
examples.translation: 他的勇气值得称道。

examples.text: This last move can only be applauded...
examples.translation: 最后这招令人拍手叫绝。

examples.text: She applauds the fact that they are promoting new ideas.
examples.translation: 他们在宣传新思想，对此她表示赞许。

examples.text: They greeted him with thunderous applause.
examples.translation: 他们以雷鸣般的掌声欢迎他。

examples.text: ...a round of applause.
examples.translation: 一阵掌声

meanings.meaning: 苹果，苹果树，苹果似的东西；[美俚]炸弹，手榴弹，（棒球的）球；[美俚]人，家伙。

examples.text: I want an apple.
examples.translation: 我想要一个苹果。

examples.text: ...2kg cooking apples.
examples.translation: 两公斤烹调用的苹果

examples.text: ...his ongoing search for the finest varieties of apple.
examples.translation: 他对最优种苹果坚持不懈的寻找

examples.text: ...a large garden with apple trees in it.
examples.translation: 种着苹果树的大果园

examples.text: Penny's only son was the apple of her eye.
examples.translation: 彭妮的独子是她的心肝宝贝。

examples.text: He could also learn to use the vacuum cleaner, the washing machine and other household appliances.
examples.translation: 他可以再学学使用吸尘器、洗衣机和其他家用电器。

examples.text: ...Maytag, one of America's biggest domestic appliance manufacturers.
examples.translation: 美泰克公司，美国最大的家电制造商之一

examples.text: These advances were the result of the intellectual appliance of science.
examples.translation: 这些进步是巧妙应用科学的结果。

meanings.meaning: 可适用的；可应用的；合适的

examples.text: What is a reasonable standard for one family is not applicable for another...
examples.translation: 对一个家庭合理的标准并不适用于另一个家庭。

examples.text: Appraisal has traditionally been seen as most applicable to those in management and supervisory positions...
examples.translation: 传统上认为业绩评定最适用于那些身处管理和监督职位之人。

examples.text: It should include a review of energy usage and, where applicable, the production and disposal of waste.
examples.translation: 它应该包括对能耗的检查结果，适当时还应包括对垃圾的产生和处理的审查结果。

examples.text: Piaget himself wrote relatively little about the applicability of his theories to education.
examples.translation: 皮亚热本人就其理论对教育的适用性论述相对很少。

meanings.meaning: 应用；申请；应用程序；敷用

examples.text: His application for membership of the organisation was rejected...
examples.translation: 他想要加入该组织的申请遭到了拒绝。

examples.text: ...Turkey's application to join the European Community...
examples.translation: 土耳其要求加入欧共体的申请

examples.text: Applications should be submitted as early as possible...
examples.translation: 申请表应尽早提交。

examples.text: Tickets are available on application.
examples.translation: 票可以通过申请获得。

examples.text: Students learned the practical application of the theory they had learned in the classroom...
examples.translation: 学生们学会了将课堂上学到的理论付诸实际应用。

examples.text: Simon's book provides a succinct outline of artificial intelligence and its application to robotics.
examples.translation: 西蒙的书简明扼要地概括了人工智能及其在机器人技术方面的应用。

examples.text: ...his immense talent, boundless energy and unremitting application.
examples.translation: 他横溢的才华、充沛的精力和不懈的努力

examples.text: With repeated applications of weedkiller, the weeds were overcome.
examples.translation: 经过反复施用除草剂，杂草得以彻底根除。

examples.text: I am continuing to apply for jobs...
examples.translation: 我正在继续找工作。

examples.text: They may apply to join the organization.
examples.translation: 他们可以申请加入该组织。

examples.text: Faulks has applied himself to this task with considerable energy...
examples.translation: 福克斯为这项任务倾注了大量精力。

examples.text: In spare moments he applied his mind to how rockets could be used to make money.
examples.translation: 在业余时间他潜心研究如何能用火箭来赚钱。

examples.text: The convention does not apply to us...
examples.translation: 这条惯例对我们不适用。

examples.text: The rule applies where a person owns stock in a corporation.
examples.translation: 该规定适用于持有公司股票的人。

examples.text: The Government appears to be applying the same principle...
examples.translation: 政府似乎是在运用相同的原则。

examples.text: His project is concerned with applying the technology to practical business problems.
examples.translation: 他的项目是将这项技术应用于实际的商务问题。

examples.text: Connell said a new medical term should be applied to Berg's actions. He calls it 'medicide'.
examples.translation: 康奈尔说应该用一个新的医学名词描述伯格的行为。他称之为“医生协助自杀”。

examples.text: The right thing would be to apply direct pressure to the wound...
examples.translation: 正确的做法是直接按住伤口。

examples.text: Applying the dye can be messy, particularly on long hair.
examples.translation: 涂抹染发剂可能会搞得一团糟，特别是长发。

examples.text: They forgot to apply the handbrake and the car rolled 60ft into the river.
examples.translation: 他们忘了拉手刹，汽车翻滚了60英尺，掉进了河里。

examples.text: It made sense to appoint a banker to this job...
examples.translation: 指派一位银行家做这份工作是明智之举。

examples.text: The commission appointed a special investigator to conduct its own inquiry...
examples.translation: 委员会委派了一个特别调查员自行调查。

examples.text: The Prime Minister has appointed a civilian as defence minister...
examples.translation: 首相已委任一位平民为国防部长。

examples.text: She was appointed a US delegate to the United Nations.
examples.translation: 她被任命为美国驻联合国代表。

examples.text: His appointment to the Cabinet would please the right-wing.
examples.translation: 他被任命为内阁成员会让右翼党派很高兴。

examples.text: ...his appointment as foreign minister in 1985.
examples.translation: 在1985年他被委任为外交部长

examples.text: Mr Fay is to take up an appointment as a researcher with the Royal Society.
examples.translation: 费伊先生将担任皇家学会研究员的职务。

examples.text: She has an appointment with her accountant...
examples.translation: 她和她的会计约好了见面。

examples.text: I made an appointment to see a specialist.
examples.translation: 我约好去见一位专家。

examples.text: ...a dental appointment.
examples.translation: 看牙医的预约

examples.text: Viewing is by appointment only.
examples.translation: 参观须事先预约。

meanings.meaning: 评价；估价（尤指估价财产，以便征税）；估计

examples.text: What is needed in such cases is a calm appraisal of the situation...
examples.translation: 在此类情况下需要对形势有一个冷静的评估。

examples.text: Self-appraisal is never easy.
examples.translation: 进行自我评价向来很难。

examples.text: Staff problems should be addressed through training and appraisals.
examples.translation: 职员问题应该通过培训和考核评定来解决。

examples.text: ...an appraisal of your financial standing.
examples.translation: 对你的财务状况的评估

examples.text: Anyone can appreciate our music...
examples.translation: 任何人都能欣赏我们的音乐。

examples.text: In time you'll appreciate the beauty and subtlety of this language.
examples.translation: 总有一天你会体会到这门语言的优美和微妙之处。

examples.text: She never really appreciated the depth and bitterness of the Irish conflict...
examples.translation: 她从来没有真正认识到爱尔兰矛盾的深刻和激烈。

examples.text: He appreciates that co-operation with the media is part of his professional duties.
examples.translation: 他懂得与媒体合作是自己工作职责的一部分。

examples.text: Peter stood by me when I most needed it. I'll always appreciate that...
examples.translation: 当我最需要的时候，彼得在我身边支持我。我将永存感激。

examples.text: Thanks, lads. I appreciate it...
examples.translation: 谢了，哥们儿。我很感激。

examples.text: I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't mention it.
examples.translation: 如果你不提它，我会很感激。

examples.text: They don't have any confidence that houses will appreciate in value.
examples.translation: 他们完全不相信房子会升值。

examples.text: He didn't approach the front door at once...
examples.translation: 他没有马上走向前门。

examples.text: When I approached, they grew silent...
examples.translation: 当我走近时，他们就不说话了。

examples.text: We turned to see the approaching car slow down.
examples.translation: 我们转身看见驶近的车慢慢停下。

examples.text: At their approach the little boy ran away and hid.
examples.translation: 他们一走近，小男孩就逃走藏了起来。

examples.text: ...the approach of a low-flying helicopter.
examples.translation: 一架低空飞行的直升机的逼近

examples.text: The path serves as an approach to the boat house.
examples.translation: 这条小路通往船屋。

examples.text: When Chappel approached me about the job, my first reaction was of disbelief...
examples.translation: 当查普尔为这份工作找我商量时，我的第一反应是不相信。

examples.text: He approached me to create and design the restaurant...
examples.translation: 他请我建造并设计该饭店。

examples.text: Anna approached several builders and was fortunate to come across Eddie.
examples.translation: 安娜与几个建筑商有过接洽，并且很幸运地碰到了埃迪。

examples.text: There had already been approaches from buyers interested in the whole of the group.
examples.translation: 已有对整组感兴趣的买家来进行洽谈。

examples.text: The Bank has approached the issue in a practical way...
examples.translation: 银行已经实际解决了这个问题。

examples.text: Employers are interested in how you approach problems.
examples.translation: 雇主们对你如何处理问题感兴趣。

examples.text: We will be exploring different approaches to gathering information.
examples.translation: 我们将探索收集信息的不同方法。

examples.text: ...the adversarial approach of the British legal system.
examples.translation: 英国法律制度采用的辩论式审判模式

examples.text: As autumn approached, the plants and colours in the garden changed.
examples.translation: 秋天临近，花园中的草木和颜色也发生了变化。

examples.text: ...the approaching crisis.
examples.translation: 步步逼近的危机

examples.text: ...the festive spirit that permeated the house with the approach of Christmas.
examples.translation: 随着圣诞节临近房子里洋溢着的节日气氛

examples.text: We approach the end of the year with the economy slowing and little sign of cheer.
examples.translation: 接近年末时，我们面临经济迟滞、处处萧条的局面。

examples.text: Oil prices have approached their highest level for almost ten years...
examples.translation: 石油价格已接近近10年中的最高水平。

examples.text: Mansell will race at average speeds approaching 200mph.
examples.translation: 曼塞尔将以接近每小时200英里的平均车速参赛。

examples.text: It is appropriate that Irish names dominate the list...
examples.translation: 名单上大部分是爱尔兰名字，这没什么不合适的。

examples.text: Dress neatly and attractively in an outfit appropriate to the job...
examples.translation: 着装要整洁美观，适合于这份工作。

examples.text: The teacher can then take appropriate action.
examples.translation: 老师到时可以采取适当的行动。

examples.text: Dress appropriately and ask intelligent questions...
examples.translation: 穿着要得体，提问要机敏。

examples.text: It's entitled, appropriately enough, 'Art for the Nation'.
examples.translation: 它被恰如其分地取名为“为了国家的艺术”。

examples.text: He wonders about the appropriateness of each move he makes.
examples.translation: 他对自己的每次行动都再三思量是否合适。

examples.text: Several other newspapers have appropriated the idea...
examples.translation: 另外有几家报社已盗用了这个创意。

examples.text: The land was simply appropriated by the rulers.
examples.translation: 土地完全被统治者霸占。

examples.text: Senator Lugar is skeptical that Congress will appropriate more funding for this purpose.
examples.translation: 参议员卢格怀疑国会是否会拨出更多资金用于此目的。

examples.text: ...efforts to win congressional approval for an aid package for Moscow...
examples.translation: 为获得国会准许向莫斯科提供一揽子援助而付出的努力

examples.text: The chairman has also given his approval for an investigation into the case...
examples.translation: 主席也已同意对此案进行调查。

examples.text: The proposed modifications met with widespread approval.
examples.translation: 修改提议得到了广泛的赞同。

examples.text: The testing and approval of new drugs will be speeded up.
examples.translation: 新药品的检测和审批速度将会加快。

examples.text: His son had an obsessive drive to gain his father's approval...
examples.translation: 他儿子非常渴望得到父亲的嘉许。

examples.text: The president's approval rating had risen.
examples.translation: 总统的支持率上升了。

examples.text: Ministers have put their seal of approval on the proposal...
examples.translation: 部长们已经批准了该提案。

examples.text: Last November the commission gave its stamp of approval to the deal.
examples.translation: 去年11月，委员会核准了这宗交易。

examples.text: Not everyone approves of the festival...
examples.translation: 不是所有人都赞成庆祝该节日。

examples.text: I approved of the proposal.
examples.translation: 我赞成该提案。

examples.text: You've never approved of Henry, have you?...
examples.translation: 你从来没有喜欢过亨利，对吗？

examples.text: I didn't approve of his manner.
examples.translation: 我不喜欢他的态度。

examples.text: The Russian Parliament has approved a program of radical economic reforms...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯议会已经通过一项重大经济改革方案。

examples.text: MPs approved the Bill by a majority of 97.
examples.translation: 议员们以97票的多数票通过了该议案。

examples.text: We have three suppliers in all who are approved by the Organic Farm Food Association.
examples.translation: 我们总共有3家获有机农产品协会认可的供货商。

examples.text: The approximate cost varies from around £150 to £250...
examples.translation: 费用大概介于150至250英镑之间。

examples.text: The times are approximate only.
examples.translation: 这些只是大致的时间。

examples.text: Approximately $150 million is to be spent on improvements.
examples.translation: 大约1.5亿美元将用于作出改善。

examples.text: They did not have even an approximate idea what the Germans really wanted.
examples.translation: 他们完全不清楚德国人真正想要什么。

examples.text: Something approximating to a fair outcome will be ensured...
examples.translation: 保证会有大致公正的结果。

examples.text: By about 6 weeks of age, most babies begin to show something approximating a day/night sleeping pattern.
examples.translation: 到6个星期大时，大多数婴儿开始表现出近似于日夜分明的睡觉模式。

examples.text: The changes will be introduced in April...
examples.translation: 这些变更将于4月开始实行。

examples.text: They were married on 7 April 1927 at Paddington Register Office.
examples.translation: 他们于1927年4月7日在帕丁顿登记处注册结婚。

meanings.meaning: 恰当的；有…倾向的；灵敏的

examples.text: The words of this report are as apt today as in 1929.
examples.translation: 这份报告的措词用在今天和用在1929年一样贴切。

examples.text: ...an apt description of the situation.
examples.translation: 对这种情况恰如其分的描述

examples.text: ...the beach in the aptly named town of Oceanside.
examples.translation: 名字起得十分贴切的海洋边镇的海滩

examples.text: She was apt to raise her voice and wave her hands about...
examples.translation: 她动不动就拔高嗓门，并挥舞双手。

examples.text: This type of weather is apt to be more common in winter.
examples.translation: 这种天气在冬季往往更为常见。

examples.text: Don't arch your back, keep your spine straight.
examples.translation: 别佝着背，把腰挺直。

examples.text: 'Oh really?' he said, arching an eyebrow.
examples.translation: “哦，真的吗？”他扬起一边的眉毛说。

examples.text: I gazed up at the domed ceiling arching overhead.
examples.translation: 我抬头凝望着上方弧形的穹顶。

examples.text: Both of them looked at him with that curious, slightly amused and even arch expression.
examples.translation: 他们俩都看着他，带着一副好奇的、有点觉得好笑甚至是淘气的表情。

examples.text: She looked at me rather archly.
examples.translation: 她有些调皮地看着我。

examples.text: Their attempts to be casual have so far just looked arch or patronising.
examples.translation: 他们本想做出漫不经心的样子，结果反而显得傲慢自大或自视甚高。

examples.text: 'You can't fool me,' Shirley said archly.
examples.translation: “你骗不了我，”雪莉傲慢地说。

meanings.meaning: [数] 任意的；武断的；专制的

examples.text: Arbitrary arrests and detention without trial were common.
examples.translation: 随意逮捕和拘留屡见不鲜。

examples.text: The victims were not chosen arbitrarily.
examples.translation: 下手对象不是随便选择的。

examples.text: He is horrified by the apparent arbitrariness by which she sets the prices.
examples.translation: 她定价时貌似的随意性让他很惊讶。

examples.text: ...Merrick Denton-Thompson, the landscape architect for Hampshire county council.
examples.translation: 梅里克·登顿-汤普森，汉普郡议会的园林设计师

examples.text: ...Paul Andreu, chief architect of French railways.
examples.translation: 保罗·安德鲁，法国铁路的总设计师

examples.text: ...Russia's chief architect of economic reform.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯经济改革的总规划师

meanings.meaning: 建筑学；建筑风格；建筑式样

examples.text: He studied classical architecture and design in Rome.
examples.translation: 他在罗马学习了古典建筑学和设计。

examples.text: ...modern architecture.
examples.translation: 现代建筑式样

examples.text: ...a fine example of Moroccan architecture.
examples.translation: 摩洛哥建筑风格的典范

examples.text: ...the architecture of the city's buildings.
examples.translation: 该城市建筑物的建筑风格

examples.text: ...the crumbling intellectual architecture of modern society.
examples.translation: 现代社会处于崩溃边缘的知识结构

examples.text: ...the architecture of muscle fibres.
examples.translation: 肌肉纤维的结构

examples.text: ...the large number of community groups in the area...
examples.translation: 该地区大量的社团

examples.text: 60 years ago half the French population still lived in rural areas.
examples.translation: 60年前有一半法国人仍然生活在乡村地区。

examples.text: ...mountainous areas of Europe, Asia, North and South America.
examples.translation: 欧洲、亚洲、南北美洲的山区

examples.text: Local authorities have been responsible for the running of schools in their areas...
examples.translation: 地方当局一直负责管理本地区的学校。

examples.text: If there is an election in your area, you should go and vote.
examples.translation: 如果你所居住的地区进行选举，你应该去参加投票。

examples.text: ...a picnic area.
examples.translation: 野餐区

examples.text: ...the main check-in area located in Terminal 1.
examples.translation: 位于1号候机厅的主检票区

examples.text: You will notice that your baby has two soft areas on the top of his head.
examples.translation: 你会注意到你的宝宝头顶上有两处柔软的地方。

examples.text: The islands cover a total area of 625.6 square kilometers...
examples.translation: 这些岛屿总面积为625.6平方公里。

examples.text: Although large in area, the flat did not have many rooms.
examples.translation: 这套公寓虽然面积很大，但并没有太多房间。

examples.text: ...the politically sensitive area of old age pensions.
examples.translation: 有关养老金的政治敏感话题

examples.text: ...the internationalization of the economy and all other areas of society...
examples.translation: 社会的经济和其他领域的国际化

examples.text: She wants to be involved in every area of your life.
examples.translation: 她想参与入你生活中的方方面面。

examples.text: The committee is concerned about players' behaviour, especially arguing with referees...
examples.translation: 委员会很关注运动员的行为，特别是与裁判争吵的行为。

examples.text: They were still arguing; I could hear them down the road.
examples.translation: 他们还在争吵；我在马路的那头都能听见他们的声音。

examples.text: Don't argue with me...
examples.translation: 别和我争辩。

examples.text: The children go to bed at 10.30. No one dares argue.
examples.translation: 孩子们10点半上床睡觉。没有人敢说不。

examples.text: He was arguing with the King about the need to maintain the cavalry at full strength...
examples.translation: 他正和国王讨论保留骑兵全部力量的必要性。

examples.text: They are arguing over foreign policy...
examples.translation: 他们正就外交政策进行讨论。

examples.text: The two of them sitting in their office were arguing this point.
examples.translation: 他们两人坐在办公室里讨论这一点。

examples.text: His lawyers are arguing that he is unfit to stand trial...
examples.translation: 他的律师正在提出理由说明他不适合出庭受审。

examples.text: It could be argued that the British are not aggressive enough.
examples.translation: 可以说英国人不够强势。

examples.text: The report argues against tax increases...
examples.translation: 报告提出理由反对提高税率。

examples.text: I argued the case for an independent central bank.
examples.translation: 我支持设立独立的中央银行。

examples.text: I've argued deductively from the text...
examples.translation: 我已依文字作过推理论证。

examples.text: He argued persuasively, and was full of confidence.
examples.translation: 他的论证很有说服力，且充满自信。

examples.text: We produced the best soccer of the tournament. Nobody would argue with that.
examples.translation: 本届比赛中我们踢出了最漂亮的足球，谁都不会否认这一点。

meanings.meaning: 论证；论据；争吵；内容提要

examples.text: There's a strong argument for lowering the price...
examples.translation: 有充分理由要求降低价格。

examples.text: The doctors have set out their arguments against the proposals...
examples.translation: 医生们已经陈述了他们反对这些提案的理由。

examples.text: It is better to convince by argument than seduce by example.
examples.translation: 以理说服强于举例诱导。

examples.text: The incident has triggered fresh arguments about the role of the extreme right in France...
examples.translation: 该事件引发了关于极右翼势力在法国所起作用的新一轮讨论。

examples.text: The issue has caused heated political argument.
examples.translation: 这个问题已经引发了激烈的政治争论。

examples.text: Anny described how she got into an argument with one of the marchers.
examples.translation: 安妮描述了她是如何与其中一位游行者发生争执的。

examples.text: ...a heated argument.
examples.translation: 激烈的争吵

examples.text: He complied without argument...
examples.translation: 他二话不说就服从了。

examples.text: It should of course be given back. There is no argument about that.
examples.translation: 它当然应该还回去，这是无可争议的。

examples.text: ...if a problem arises later in the pregnancy...
examples.translation: 如果在怀孕后期出现问题

examples.text: The birds also attack crops when the opportunity arises.
examples.translation: 一有机会鸟儿们也会破坏庄稼。

examples.text: ...an overwhelming sense of guilt arising from my actions...
examples.translation: 我的行为带来的沉重的罪恶感

examples.text: The charges arise out of a long-running fraud enquiry by Merseyside police.
examples.translation: 这些指控是默西赛德郡警方对诈骗案进行长期调查后提出的。

examples.text: Heavy Metal music really arose in the late 60s.
examples.translation: 重金属音乐真正形成于60年代后期。

examples.text: He arose at 6:30 a.m. as usual.
examples.translation: 同往常一样，他在早上6:30起了床。

examples.translation: 当我从椅子上站起来时，我父亲和埃莉诺的父亲谈兴正浓。

examples.text: Arise, Sir William.
examples.translation: 起立，威廉爵士。

examples.text: ...the flat terrace, from which arises the cubic volume of the house.
examples.translation: 上面矗立着立方形房屋的露天平台

examples.text: ...teaching the basics of reading, writing and arithmetic.
examples.translation: 教授阅读、写作和算术的基础知识

examples.text: ...an arithmetic test.
examples.translation: 算术测验

examples.translation: 4,000名妇女每人放入10个卢比，如果我算得对的话，总数将达到4万卢比。

examples.text: The budgetary arithmetic suggests that government borrowing is set to surge...
examples.translation: 预算数字表明政府借款将要大幅增加。

examples.text: The arithmetic is finely balanced: the socialists and their allies do not have an overall majority.
examples.translation: 该估算是经过仔细权衡的：社会主义者和他们的同盟并不占绝大多数。

examples.text: ...a processor which performs simple arithmetic operations such as adding or multiplying numbers.
examples.translation: 可进行加法或乘法等简单运算的处理器

examples.text: After returning from France, he joined the army...
examples.translation: 从法国回来之后，他参了军。

examples.text: The army is about to launch a major offensive.
examples.translation: 陆军部队即将发动一次大规模进攻。

examples.text: ...a top-ranking army officer.
examples.translation: 级别最高的陆军军官

examples.text: ...data collected by an army of volunteers.
examples.translation: 由大批志愿者收集的资料

examples.text: ...armies of shoppers looking for bargains.
