examples.translation: 8年的艰难时期刚刚过去，在此期间，伦敦有3家消防站遭关闭。如获批准，裁减又会接踵而至。

examples.text: From now on Labour will be on the back foot on the subject of welfare.
examples.translation: 今后工党在福利问题上将处于下风。

examples.text: ...another scheme designed purely to put the Scots Nationalists on the back foot.
examples.translation: 另一项纯粹旨在让苏格兰民族党人被迫退居守势的计划

examples.text: I was so badly behaved I was convinced she would be glad to see the back of me.
examples.translation: 我的表现如此差劲，相信她会很高兴看到我离开。

examples.text: Stacey Lattisaw has turned her back on her singing career with Motown Records to become a gospel singer...
examples.translation: 斯泰茜·拉蒂索抛弃了自己在摩城唱片公司的演唱事业，成为了一名福音歌手。

examples.text: Gunnell is not the sort to turn her back on someone who has coached her for 12 years.
examples.translation: 冈内尔不是那种将指导了自己12年的教练拒之门外的人。

examples.text: Some food labelling practices really get my back up.
examples.translation: 有些食物标签的贴法实在让我生气。

examples.text: We live in a ground floor flat which backs onto a busy street...
examples.translation: 我们住在一楼的一套公寓房里，背对着一条繁忙的街道。

examples.text: His garden backs onto a school.
examples.translation: 他的花园背朝一所学校。

examples.text: He backed his car out of the drive...
examples.translation: 他把车倒出了私人车道。

examples.text: The train backed out of Adelaide Yard on to the Dublin-Belfast line...
examples.translation: 火车倒出了阿德莱德调车场，开上了都柏林-贝尔法斯特线。

examples.text: I heard the engines revving as the lorries backed and turned.
examples.translation: 卡车倒车和掉头的时候，我听见发动机的轰鸣声。

examples.text: There is a new witness to back his claim that he is a victim of mistaken identity.
examples.translation: 有新的目击证人证明他的说法，他是被错认了。

examples.text: ...if France cannot persuade all five permanent members of the Security Council to back the plan...
examples.translation: 如果法国不能说服安理会五个常任理事国都支持该计划

examples.text: The Prime Minister is backed by the civic movement, Public Against Violence.
examples.translation: 首相得到“全民反暴力”公民运动的支持。

examples.text: ...government-backed loans to Egypt.
examples.translation: 向埃及提供的政府贷款

examples.text: Roland Nilsson last night backed Sheffield Wednesday to win the UEFA Cup...
examples.translation: 昨晚罗兰·尼尔森打赌谢菲尔德周三队会捧得欧洲联盟杯。

examples.text: The horse's owner Mr Hitchins backed him at 200-1 to finish in the first three...
examples.translation: 马的主人希钦斯先生以200比1的赔率赌它获得前三名。

examples.text: It is upsetting to discover that you have backed a loser.
examples.translation: 发现自己的投注对象输了是一件让人心烦的事。

examples.text: She was backed by acoustic guitar, bass and congas.
examples.translation: 原声吉他、贝斯和康茄鼓为她伴奏。

examples.text: Being a Communist was a badge of honour for thousands of trade union activists.
examples.translation: 对数千工会积极分子来说，成为共产党员是荣誉的象征。

meanings.meaning: 非常，很；严重地，厉害地；恶劣地

examples.text: I was angry because I played so badly...
examples.translation: 我很生气，因为自己的表现实在是太差了。

examples.text: The whole project was badly managed...
examples.translation: 整个项目管理不善。

examples.text: The coalition did worse than expected, getting just 11.6 per cent of the vote.
examples.translation: 联盟只获得了11.6%的选票，比预想的还糟。

examples.text: The bomb destroyed a police station and badly damaged a church...
examples.translation: 炸弹摧毁了一处警察局，并使一座教堂严重受损。

examples.text: One man was killed and another badly injured...
examples.translation: 一人死亡，一人重伤。

examples.text: It was a gamble that went badly wrong.
examples.translation: 这一冒险代价惨重。

examples.text: Why do you want to go so badly?...
examples.translation: 为什么你这么想走？

examples.text: Planes landed at Bagram airport today carrying badly needed food and medicine.
examples.translation: 运载急需食物和药品的飞机今天在巴格拉姆机场降落。

examples.text: They have both behaved very badly and I am very hurt...
examples.translation: 他们俩都很不友善，让我非常难过。

examples.text: I would like to know why we pensioners are being so badly treated.
examples.translation: 我想知道为什么我们这些领养老金的人受到如此恶劣的对待。

examples.text: Teachers know that low exam results will reflect badly on them...
examples.translation: 老师知道考试成绩不好将对他们不利。

examples.text: The male sex comes out of the film very badly...
examples.translation: 这部影片中男性的形象非常负面。

examples.text: Despite his illegal act, few people think badly of him.
examples.translation: 尽管他干了违法的事情，但很少有人认为他不好。

examples.text: You may have to work part-time, in a badly paid job with unsociable hours...
examples.translation: 你或许只能做个薪水低、非正常工作时间上班的兼职。

examples.text: This is the most dangerous professional sport there is, and the worst paid.
examples.translation: 这是最危险的职业体育运动，但报酬却是最低的。

examples.text: Andy's extensive experience will be sadly missed, said Badminton England chief executive Adrian Christy.

meanings.meaning: 行李；[交] 辎重（军队的）

examples.text: The passengers went through immigration control and collected their baggage.
examples.translation: 旅客通过入境检查后领取了自己的行李。

examples.text: ...excess baggage.
examples.translation: 超重行李

examples.text: How much emotional baggage is he bringing with him into the relationship?
examples.translation: 他背负着多重的感情包袱开始这段恋情？

examples.text: ...the ideological baggage of Fascism.
examples.translation: 法西斯主义在意识形态方面的偏执

meanings.meaning: 猎获；把…装入袋中；占据，私吞；使膨大

examples.text: She left the hotel carrying a shopping bag.
examples.translation: 她提着一个购物袋离开了酒店。

examples.text: ...a hotel with bags of character.
examples.translation: 很有特色的酒店

examples.text: The smart ones will have already bagged their seats by placing cards on them.
examples.translation: 聪明人早已在座位上放一张卡片占住了位子。

examples.text: 'I'll get the Republican nomination,' he assured me. 'It's in the bag.'
examples.translation: “我会得到共和党提名的，”他向我保证，“这是十拿九稳的事。”

examples.text: I don't want to be left holding the bag if something goes wrong.
examples.translation: 如果出了什么问题，我可不想替人背黑锅。

examples.text: Police arrived at his hotel and ordered him to pack his bags.
examples.translation: 警察来到他的酒店，命令他收拾行李走人。

examples.text: He baited his hook with pie...
examples.translation: 他在鱼钩上装了点馅饼作钓饵。

examples.text: The boys dug pits and baited them so that they could spear their prey.
examples.translation: 男孩们挖了坑，埋了饵，这样他们就可以刺杀猎物了。

examples.text: ...baited lures.
examples.translation: 诱饵

examples.text: Service stations use petrol as a bait to lure motorists into the restaurants and other facilities...
examples.translation: 加油站以汽油为诱饵，吸引开车的人用餐以及使用其他设施。

examples.text: Television programmes are essentially bait to attract an audience for advertisements.
examples.translation: 从根本上说，电视节目就是吸引观众看广告的诱饵。

examples.text: He delighted in baiting his mother.
examples.translation: 他喜欢逗母亲生气。

examples.text: When she attempts to make you feel guilty, don't take the bait...
examples.translation: 如果她试图让你觉得内疚，不要上当。

examples.text: Their behaviour may seem insulting, but it's important not to rise to the bait and get cross.
examples.translation: 他们的行为看起来可能很无礼，但千万不要上当生气。

examples.text: How did you learn to bake cakes?...
examples.translation: 你怎么学会烘蛋糕的？

examples.text: I love to bake.
examples.translation: 我喜欢烘烤糕点。

examples.text: On a Thursday she used to do all the baking.
examples.translation: 过去每逢周四，她会把烤东西的活儿都做了。

examples.text: Bake the cake for 35 to 50 minutes...
examples.translation: 将蛋糕烘35到50分钟。

examples.text: The batter rises as it bakes.
examples.translation: 烘烤的时候，面糊会膨胀起来。

examples.text: ...freshly baked bread.
examples.translation: 刚出炉的面包

examples.text: If you closed the windows you baked...
examples.translation: 如果把窗户关上，你会热死的。

examples.text: Britain bakes in a Mediterranean heatwave.
examples.translation: 地中海的热浪炙烤着英国。

examples.text: ...an aubergine bake.
examples.translation: 烤茄子

examples.text: The bad weather conditions prevented the plane from landing...
examples.translation: 糟糕的天气使飞机无法降落。

examples.text: We have been going through a bad time...
examples.translation: 我们正经历一段困难时期。

examples.text: I've had a bad day at work...
examples.translation: 我今天上班诸事不顺。

examples.text: Divorce is bad for children...
examples.translation: 离婚对孩子不好。

examples.text: Analysts fear the situation is even worse than the leadership admits.
examples.translation: 分析家担心情况比领导层承认的还要糟。

examples.text: He had a bad accident two years ago and had to give up farming...
examples.translation: 他两年前遇到严重的车祸，不得不放弃务农。

examples.text: This was a bad case of dangerous driving...
examples.translation: 这是一起严重的危险驾驶案例。

examples.text: The pain is often so bad she wants to scream...
examples.translation: 剧烈的疼痛常常让她想大声叫喊。

examples.text: The floods are described as the worst in nearly fifty years.
examples.translation: 这次洪灾据说是近50年来最为严重的。

examples.text: Economist Jeffrey Faux says a tax cut is a bad idea...
examples.translation: 经济学家杰弗里·福克斯认为减税是不明智的。

examples.text: Of course politicians will sometimes make bad decisions...
examples.translation: 政治家当然有时也会作出错误的决定。

examples.text: That's not a bad way to proceed, just somewhat different...
examples.translation: 以此方法进行并没有错，只是有些与众不同。

examples.text: The worst thing you can do is underestimate an opponent.
examples.translation: 最严重的错误就是低估对手。

examples.text: The closure of the project is bad news for her staff...
examples.translation: 项目终止对她的雇员来说是一个不幸的消息。

examples.text: It was a bad start in my relationship with Warr...
examples.translation: 我与沃尔的关系开始得不太顺利。

examples.text: The report couldn't have come at a worse time for the European Commission.
examples.translation: 这份报告发布的时间对欧盟委员会极为不利。

examples.text: She was in rather a bad film about the Mau Mau...
examples.translation: 她出演了一部关于茅茅运动（20世纪50年代肯尼亚基库尤人反抗英国殖民者的民族主义运动）的烂片。

examples.text: Many old people in Britain are living in bad housing...
examples.translation: 英国有很多老人居住条件恶劣。

examples.text: The state schools' main problem is that teachers' pay is so bad...
examples.translation: 公立学校的主要问题是教师的薪资太低。

examples.text: It was absolutely the worst food I have ever had.
examples.translation: 这绝对是我吃过的最糟糕的食物。

examples.text: He had increased Britain's reputation for being bad at languages...
examples.translation: 他加深了人们对英国人不擅长语言的印象。

examples.text: He was a bad driver...
examples.translation: 他是一个技术糟糕的司机。

examples.text: Rose was a poor cook and a worse mother.
examples.translation: 罗丝不太会做饭，更不会当母亲。

examples.text: Not being able to hear doesn't seem as bad as not being able to see...
examples.translation: 看不见比听不到更让人难以忍受。

examples.text: You need at least ten pounds if you go to the cinema nowadays — it's really bad.
examples.translation: 现在看场电影至少要花上10英镑——真是太贵了。

examples.text: 'How much is he paying you?' — 'Oh, five thousand.' —'Not bad.'...
'How are you, mate?' — 'Not bad, mate, how's yourself?'...
examples.translation: “最近怎么样，老兄？”——“还不错，你呢？”

examples.text: He's not a bad chap — quite human for an accountant...
examples.translation: 这个家伙人不坏——就会计来说已经很有人情味了。

examples.text: That's not a bad idea.
examples.translation: 这个主意不错。

examples.text: I was selling drugs, but I didn't think I was a bad person...
examples.translation: 我贩卖毒品，但我并不觉得自己是个坏人。

examples.text: He does not think that his beliefs make him any worse than any other man.
examples.translation: 他觉得自己的信仰并不让他比其他人更邪恶。

examples.text: They only recognise badness when they perceive it in others.
examples.translation: 他们只看到别人身上的恶行。

examples.text: You are a bad boy for repeating what I told you...
examples.translation: 重复我对你说的话，你真是个捣蛋鬼。

examples.text: Many parents find it hard to discourage bad behaviour.
examples.translation: 很多父母觉得要孩子循规蹈矩是件很难的事情。

examples.text: She is in a bit of a bad mood because she's just given up smoking.
examples.translation: 因为她刚刚戒烟，所以脾气有点大。

examples.text: You don't have to feel bad about relaxing...
examples.translation: 你不必为放松感到内疚。

examples.text: I feel bad that he's doing most of the work...
examples.translation: 大部分工作都是他在干，我觉得很过意不去。

examples.text: Are you trying to make me feel bad?
examples.translation: 你是想让我歉疚吗？

examples.text: Alastair has a bad back so we have a hard bed.
examples.translation: 阿拉斯泰尔背部有毛病，所以我们睡硬板床。

examples.text: They bought so much beef that some went bad.
examples.translation: 他们买了太多牛肉，有些都变质了。

examples.text: I don't like to hear bad language in the street...
examples.translation: 我不喜欢在街上听见一些污言秽语。

examples.text: I said a bad word.
examples.translation: 我说了一句脏话。

examples.text: It is too bad that Eleanor had to leave so soon...
examples.translation: 埃莉诺不得不这么快就离开，真是太遗憾了。

examples.text: Too bad he used his intelligence for criminal purposes.
examples.translation: 他把聪明都用在了犯罪上，太可惜了。

examples.text: Too bad if you missed the bus.
examples.translation: 你没有赶上公交车只能算自己倒霉。

examples.text: The economy is in a bad way...
examples.translation: 经济陷入困境。

examples.text: 'You look in a bad way,' chuckled Brad.
examples.translation: “你看起来糟透了，”布拉德笑着说。

examples.text: She's got beauty, wealth, and fame, and we still can't find anyone with a bad word to say about her.
examples.translation: 她美丽，富有，出名，而且我们还没有发现谁说她不好。

examples.text: The youth jumped from the the second floor balcony on to a ledge to escape.
I balanced on the ledge...
examples.translation: 我在窗台上站稳。

examples.text: He balanced a football on his head.
examples.translation: 他将一只足球稳稳地顶在头上。

examples.text: The medicines you are currently taking could be affecting your balance.
examples.translation: 你现在服用的药物可能会影响身体的平衡能力。

examples.text: Balance spicy dishes with mild ones...
examples.translation: 做到辛辣菜和清淡菜比重相当。

examples.text: The state has got to find some way to balance these two needs...
examples.translation: 国家必须找出平衡这两种需求的办法。

examples.text: Supply and demand on the currency market will generally balance.
examples.translation: 货币市场上的供求将大致持平。

examples.text: This book is a well balanced biography.
examples.translation: 此书是一部相当客观的传记。

examples.text: Their marriage is a delicate balance between traditional and contemporary values...
examples.translation: 他们的婚姻在传统和现代价值观之间保持着微妙平衡。

examples.text: There was no other way to ensure that people would get the right balance of foods.
examples.translation: 没有其他方法可以确保人们饮食均衡。

examples.text: ...the ecological balance of the forest.
examples.translation: 森林的生态平衡

examples.text: ...a powerful new gun which could tip the balance of the war in their favour...
examples.translation: 将使他们在战争中占据优势的威力巨大的新型火炮

examples.text: The balance continues to swing away from final examinations to continuous assessment.
examples.translation: 期末考试渐渐被连续性评估所取代。

examples.text: She carefully tried to balance religious sensitivities against democratic freedom.
examples.translation: 她谨慎地试图对宗教情感和民主自由两者作出权衡。

examples.text: He balanced his budgets by rigid control over public expenditure.
examples.translation: 他通过严格控制公共开支保持预算平衡。

examples.text: ...teaching them to balance the books...
examples.translation: 教他们结平账目

examples.text: To make the books balance, spending must fall and taxes must rise.
examples.translation: 为了使收支相等，必须减少支出，增加税收。

examples.text: I'd like to check the balance in my account please.
examples.translation: 请查一下我的账户余额。

examples.text: They were due to pay the balance on delivery.
examples.translation: 他们应该在货到时支付余额。

examples.text: The fate of a project which could revolutionise the use of computers in hospitals hangs in the balance.
examples.translation: 可能给医院的计算机使用带来革命的项目仍然前途未明。

examples.text: She was holding onto the rail to keep her balance...
examples.translation: 她抓住扶手以保持平衡。

examples.text: He swung around, almost losing his balance.
examples.translation: 他蓦地转身，差点失去平衡。

examples.text: A gust of wind knocked him off balance and he fell face down in the mud.
examples.translation: 一阵大风刮得他失去平衡，脸朝下摔在泥里。

examples.text: She was trying to behave as if his visit hadn't thrown her off balance.
examples.translation: 她尽力装作对他的造访并不吃惊。

examples.text: On balance he agreed with Christine.
examples.translation: 总的来说，他同意克里斯蒂娜的意见。

meanings.meaning: 秃顶的；光秃的；单调的；无装饰的
(Bald)人名；(英)鲍尔德；(德、法、波)巴尔德

examples.text: The man's bald head was beaded with sweat...
examples.translation: 这个男人的光头上满是汗珠。

examples.text: She is going bald.
examples.translation: 她开始谢顶。

examples.text: He wears a cap to cover a spot of baldness.
examples.translation: 他戴帽以遮斑秃。

examples.text: The announcement came in a bald statement from the official news agency...
examples.translation: 官方通讯社发表了直截了当的声明。

examples.text: The bald truth is he's just not happy.
examples.translation: 事实明摆着，他就是不开心。

examples.text: 'The leaders are outdated,' he stated baldly. 'They don't relate to young people.'
examples.translation: “这些领导都落伍了，”他直言不讳地说，“他们不了解年轻人的想法。”

meanings.meaning: (Ball)人名；(土)巴勒；(英、西)鲍尔；(法、德、俄、罗、捷)巴尔

examples.text: ...a golf ball.
examples.translation: 高尔夫球

examples.text: ...a tennis ball.
examples.translation: 网球

examples.text: Thomas screwed the letter up into a ball...
examples.translation: 托马斯把信揉成一团。

examples.text: They heard a loud explosion and saw a ball of fire go up.
examples.translation: 他们听见一声爆炸的巨响，看见一个火球腾空而起。

examples.text: He picked up the sheets of paper, and balled them tightly in his fists...
examples.translation: 他抓起那几张纸，在手里紧紧攥成团。

examples.text: His hands balled into fists...
examples.translation: 他攥起了拳头。

examples.text: I picked up the balled socks.
examples.translation: 我把卷成团的袜子拾掇起来。

examples.text: She balled the handkerchief up and threw it at his feet...
examples.translation: 她把手绢揉成一团，丢在了他的脚边。

examples.text: Brian's face balled up like a fist.
examples.translation: 布赖恩的脸鼓得像个拳头。

examples.text: The ball's now in your court — you have to decide what you're going to do.
examples.translation: 轮到你了——你必须决定自己要做什么。

examples.text: He will go to the Middle East next week to get the ball rolling again on peace talks...
examples.translation: 他下周将前往中东，开始重启和谈。

examples.text: I just want enough cash to start the ball rolling.
examples.translation: 我只是想有足够的启动资金。

examples.text: Outside the boys were sitting on the ground and, going by the gales of laughter, they were having a ball.
examples.translation: 男孩们在户外席地而坐，从阵阵笑声来看，他们玩得很开心。

examples.text: The detective has to discover the motive, the means and the opportunity and has to keep these three balls in the air.
examples.translation: 那名侦探必须查明动机、手段和时机，而且对这三项的调查必须同步展开。

examples.text: ...unhappy mothers trying to juggle ten balls in the air.
examples.translation: 同时要做无数件事情的可怜的母亲

examples.text: She really is on the ball; she's bought houses at auctions so she knows what she's doing.
examples.translation: 她很精明干练；她通过拍卖购过房，所以知道自己在做什么。

examples.text: The association has threatened to withdraw its support if the banks and building societies refuse to play ball.
examples.translation: 该协会威胁说如果银行和建屋互助会不配合的话，它将不再提供支持。

examples.text: I trained as a ballet dancer...
examples.translation: 我受过芭蕾舞训练。

examples.text: She is also keen on the ballet.
examples.translation: 她也热衷于芭蕾舞。

examples.text: The performance will include the premiere of three new ballets.
examples.translation: 三段新编芭蕾舞将在演出中首演。

meanings.meaning: 使像气球般鼓起；使激增

examples.text: She popped a balloon with her fork.
examples.translation: 她用叉子戳破了一个气球。

examples.text: They are to attempt to be the first to circle the Earth non-stop by balloon.
examples.translation: 他们试图完成乘热气球不间断环球飞行的创举。

examples.text: In London, the use of the Tube has ballooned...
examples.translation: 在伦敦，坐地铁的人激增。

examples.text: The budget deficit has ballooned to $25 billion...
examples.translation: 预算赤字已经猛增到250亿美元。

meanings.meaning: 投票；投票用纸；投票总数

examples.text: The result of the ballot will not be known for two weeks...
examples.translation: 无记名投票的结果将于两周后公布。

examples.text: Fifty of its members will be elected by direct ballot.
examples.translation: 50名成员将通过直选产生。

examples.text: Election boards will count the ballots by hand...
examples.translation: 选举委员会将人工计票。

examples.text: They succeeded in putting Perot's name on the ballot in Florida.
examples.translation: 他们成功地让佩罗在佛罗里达州成为了候选人之一。

examples.text: The union said they will ballot members on whether to strike.
examples.translation: 工会称他们将要求会员投票表决是否罢工。

examples.text: International observers say the balloting was fair.
examples.translation: 国际观察员说此次投票是公正的。

meanings.meaning: (Ban)人名；(日)蕃(名)；(缅、老、柬)班；(东南亚国家华语)万；(法)邦；(中)饼(广东话·威妥玛)；(德、塞、罗、阿拉伯)巴恩；(英)班恩

examples.text: Canada will ban smoking in all offices later this year.
examples.translation: 加拿大将从今年晚些时候起在办公场所全面禁烟。

examples.text: Last year arms sales were banned.
examples.translation: 去年武器遭禁售。

examples.text: ...a banned substance.
examples.translation: 违禁药物

examples.text: No reason was given for the banning of the magazine...
examples.translation: 杂志被无端取缔了。

examples.text: Opposition groups see the bannings as the latest stage of a government clampdown.
examples.translation: 反对派将这些查禁事件视为政府压制的一个新阶段。

examples.text: The General also lifted a ban on political parties.
examples.translation: 将军同时取消了对政党的禁令。

examples.text: He was banned from driving for three years.
examples.translation: 他被吊扣驾照3年。

meanings.meaning: 香蕉；喜剧演员；大鹰钩鼻

examples.text: ...a bunch of bananas.
examples.translation: 一串香蕉

examples.text: People went bananas with boredom...
examples.translation: 人们闷得发狂。

examples.text: Adamson's going to go bananas on this one.
examples.translation: 亚当森会被这个气疯的。

meanings.meaning: 带，环；[物] 波段；(演奏流行音乐的) 乐队

examples.text: He was a drummer in a rock band...
examples.translation: 他曾是一个摇滚乐团的鼓手。

examples.text: Local bands provide music for dancing.
examples.translation: 当地的乐队为跳舞伴乐。

examples.text: Bands played German marches.
examples.translation: 乐队演奏了德军进行曲。

examples.text: Bands of government soldiers, rebels and just plain criminals have been roaming some neighborhoods.
examples.translation: 成群结队的政府军士兵、反叛分子和彻头彻尾的犯罪分子一直在一些街区游荡。

examples.text: ...a small but growing band of Japanese companies taking their first steps into American publishing.
examples.translation: 数量不多、但仍在增长的一批初次涉足美国出版业的日本公司

examples.text: Almost all hospitals use a wrist-band of some kind with your name and details on it.
examples.translation: 几乎所有的医院都用某种腕带记录名字和详细信息。

examples.text: ...bands of natural vegetation between strips of crops...
examples.translation: 农作物狭地之间的野生植被带

examples.text: A band of light glowed in the space between floor and door.
examples.translation: 一束阳光透过地板和门之间的缝隙照了进来

examples.text: Surgeons placed a metal band around the knee cap to help it knit back together.
examples.translation: 外科医生在膝盖骨上套了个金属箍以帮助其愈合。

examples.text: ...a strong band of flat muscle tissue.
examples.translation: 一圈坚韧的扁平肌肉组织

examples.text: For an initial service, a 10 megahertz-wide band of frequencies will be needed.
examples.translation: 初始服务需要10兆赫宽的频带。

examples.text: ...a new tax band of 20p in the pound on the first £2,000 of taxable income.
examples.translation: 对应税收入的头两千英镑每镑征收20便士的新税阶

examples.text: They appear to rule out some of the ideas that have been mentioned — banding the tax so higher earners would pay more.
examples.translation: 他们看来要剔除其中提到的一些想法——如把税率分档，使收入越高，缴得越多。

examples.text: ...a banding system based on property values...
examples.translation: 基于财产价值的分级制

examples.text: The choice will be between a flat-rate or a banded charge.
examples.translation: 将在统一费用和分级费用之间作出选择。

examples.text: We put some ointment and a bandage on his knee...
examples.translation: 我们在他的膝盖上涂了些药膏并打上了绷带。

examples.text: His chest was swathed in bandages.
examples.translation: 他的胸部缠着绷带。

examples.text: Apply a dressing to the wound and bandage it.
examples.translation: 给伤口盖上敷料并用绷带包扎起来。

examples.text: ...a bandaged hand.
examples.translation: 缠着绷带的手

examples.text: I bandaged the leg up and gave her aspirin for the pain.
examples.translation: 我把她的腿用绷带包扎起来，并给了她阿司匹林止痛。

meanings.meaning: 直接地；砰然地；突然巨响地

examples.text: I heard four or five loud bangs...
examples.translation: 我听到四五声巨响。

examples.text: She slammed the door with a bang...
examples.translation: 她砰的一声摔上了门。

examples.text: The television went bang.
examples.translation: 电视机发出砰的一声巨响。

examples.text: The engine spat and banged.
examples.translation: 发动机爆出火花，接着发出砰的巨响。

examples.text: ...the sound of doors banging...
examples.translation: 砰然作响的关门声

examples.text: All up and down the street the windows bang shut...
examples.translation: 整条街的窗户都砰然关上了。

examples.text: The wind banged a door somewhere.
examples.translation: 有扇门被风吹得砰的一下关上了。

examples.text: We could bang on the desks and shout till they let us out...
examples.translation: 我们可以拍着桌子大喊大叫，直到他们放我们出去。

examples.text: There is no point in shouting or banging the table.
examples.translation: 叫嚷或者拍桌子都毫无意义。

examples.text: She banged his dinner on the table...
examples.translation: 她把他的饭菜砰地摔在了桌子上。

examples.text: He banged down the telephone.
examples.translation: 他砰的一声挂断了电话。

examples.text: She'd fainted and banged her head...
examples.translation: 她晕倒了，把脑袋给磕了。

examples.text: He hurried into the hall, banging his shin against a chair in the darkness.
examples.translation: 他匆匆步入大厅，黑暗中小腿撞到了一把椅子上。

examples.text: ...a nasty bang on the head.
examples.translation: 头上狠狠地撞了一下

examples.text: I didn't mean to bang into you...
examples.translation: 我不是故意撞你的。

examples.text: Various men kept banging into me in the narrow corridor.
examples.translation: 在这条狭窄的走廊上，不断有人撞到我。

examples.text: My bangs were cut short, but the rest of my hair was long.
examples.translation: 我剪短了刘海，但其他地方的头发还是很长。

examples.text: ...bang in the middle of the track...
examples.translation: 在小径的正中央

examples.text: For once you leave bang on time for work.
examples.translation: 你终于有一次准点上班去了。

examples.text: There will be more work to do, not less. Bang goes the fantasy of retirement at 35.
examples.translation: 工作只会增加，不会减少。梦想着35岁退休是彻底没戏了。

examples.text: Her career began with a bang in 1986.
examples.translation: 1986年，她的事业一炮打响。

examples.text: ...a large crowd of students carrying banners denouncing the government...
examples.translation: 一大群高举谴责政府的条幅的学生

examples.text: A big banner was draped across one of the streets saying, 'Idaho Falls Says NO to Drugs.'
examples.translation: 一条写有“爱达荷福尔斯市拒绝毒品”的大横幅悬跨其中一条街道。

examples.text: All countries march as one nation under the banner of friendship.
examples.translation: 所有国家在友谊的旗帜下团结一致，共同前进。

examples.text: Under the banner of education, we herd our children from ballet to basketball and back again.
examples.translation: 打着教育的旗号，我们赶鸭子上架似的让孩子从芭蕾到篮球，不停地学这个学那个。

examples.text: If the firm cannot sell its products, it will go bankrupt...
examples.translation: 如果公司的产品卖不出去，它就会倒闭。

examples.text: He was declared bankrupt after failing to pay a £114m loan guarantee.
examples.translation: 由于无力偿还1.14亿英镑的贷款担保，他被宣布破产。

examples.text: The move to the market nearly bankrupted the firm and its director...
examples.translation: 入市几乎使公司及其董事破产。

examples.text: Uninsured people can be bankrupted by big medical bills.
examples.translation: 高额的医疗费会让未参保者变得倾家荡产。

examples.text: He really thinks that European civilisation is morally bankrupt.
examples.translation: 他确实认为欧洲文明道德沦丧。

examples.text: Last night he attended a state banquet at Buckingham Palace.
examples.translation: 昨晚他出席了在白金汉宫举行的国宴。

examples.text: Tuna can be grilled, fried or barbecued...
examples.translation: 金枪鱼可以用烤炉烤、油炸或者烧烤。

examples.text: Here's a way of barbecuing corn-on-the-cob that I learned in the States.
examples.translation: 这是我在美国学的一种烤玉米的方法。

examples.text: ...barbecued chicken.
examples.translation: 烤鸡

examples.text: Which bank offers you the service that best suits your financial needs?...
examples.translation: 哪家银行提供的服务最适合您的理财需求？

examples.text: I had £10,000 in the bank.
examples.translation: 我在银行有1万英镑的存款。

examples.text: Once you have registered your particulars with an agency and it has banked your cheque, the process begins.
examples.translation: 一旦在某个代理行登记了详细信息并由它将支票存入银行，这一程序就开始了。

examples.text: My husband has banked with the Co-op since before the war.
examples.translation: 我丈夫自战前以来就在合作银行有户头。

examples.text: ...Britain's National Police Computer, one of the largest data banks in the world.
examples.translation: 英国国家警务计算机系统，世界上最大的数据库之一

examples.text: Prices starting at £6 a bottle won't break the bank.
examples.translation: 每瓶6英镑的起价不算太贵。

examples.text: ...30 miles of new developments along both banks of the Thames.
examples.translation: 泰晤士河两岸30英里的新开发区

examples.text: ...an old warehouse on the banks of a canal.
examples.translation: 运河河畔的一座旧仓库

examples.text: ...resting indolently upon a grassy bank.
examples.translation: 懒洋洋地躺在草埂上休息

examples.text: On their journey south they hit a bank of fog off the north-east coast of Scotland.
examples.translation: 南行途中，他们在苏格兰东北海岸外遭遇了大雾。

examples.text: The typical laborer now sits in front of a bank of dials.
examples.translation: 现如今，工人通常都是坐在一排仪表前。

examples.text: A plane took off and banked above the highway in front of him.
examples.translation: 一架飞机起飞后在他前方的公路上空侧飞转向。

meanings.meaning: (Barber)人名；(西)巴尔韦尔；(英)巴伯；(罗)巴尔伯

examples.text: ...a barber's shop in south London.
examples.translation: 伦敦南部的理发店

examples.text: My Mum took me to the barber's.
examples.translation: 我妈带我理发去了。

meanings.meaning: (Bar)人名；(阿拉伯、德、法、俄、罗、捷、波、葡、以)巴尔

examples.text: ...Devil's Herd, the city's most popular country-western bar.
examples.translation: “魔鬼之群”——这个城市最火的西部乡村酒吧

examples.text: ...the Brass Nickel Bar.
examples.translation: “黄铜镍币”酒吧

examples.text: I'll see you in the bar later...
examples.translation: 一会儿酒吧见。

examples.text: On the ship there are video lounges, a bar and a small duty-free shop.
examples.translation: 船上有录像厅、一个酒吧间和一家小型免税商店。

examples.text: Michael was standing alone by the bar when Brian rejoined him...
examples.translation: 布赖恩回到迈克尔身边时，他正一个人站在吧台旁边。

examples.text: He leaned forward across the bar.
examples.translation: 他将身子探过吧台。

examples.text: ...a brick building with bars across the ground floor windows.
examples.translation: 一楼窗户装有铁栅的砖砌建筑

examples.text: ...a crowd throwing stones and iron bars.
examples.translation: 投掷石块和铁条的人群

examples.text: Fisher was behind bars last night, charged with attempted murder...
examples.translation: 费希尔被控谋杀未遂，昨晚入狱。

examples.text: Nearly 5,000 people a year are put behind bars over motoring penalties.
examples.translation: 每年有近5,000人因违章驾车而入狱。

examples.text: What is your favourite chocolate bar?
examples.translation: 你最喜欢哪种巧克力？

examples.text: ...a bar of soap.
examples.translation: 一块肥皂

examples.text: ...a two-bar electric fire with a frayed flex.
examples.translation: 电线已经磨损的双片电热炉

examples.text: For added safety, bar the door to the kitchen.
examples.translation: 为了确保安全，把厨房的门闩上。

examples.text: The windows were closed and shuttered, the door was barred.
examples.translation: 窗户都关紧了，百叶窗都拉下了，门也闩上了。

examples.text: Harry moved to bar his way...
examples.translation: 哈里走过去挡住了他的路。

examples.text: He stepped in front of her, barring her way.
examples.translation: 他走到她前面，挡住了她的去路。

examples.text: Amnesty workers have been barred from Sri Lanka since 1982...
examples.translation: 从1982年起，大赦国际的工作人员就被禁止进入斯里兰卡。

examples.text: Many jobs were barred to them.
examples.translation: 很多工作将他们拒之门外。

examples.text: One of the fundamental bars to communication is the lack of a universally spoken, common language...
examples.translation: 交流的一个基本障碍就是缺少一种大家都说的通用语。

examples.text: In industry after industry, government bodies have erected bars to competition.
examples.translation: 政府机构在一个又一个行业中设置了障碍以阻止竞争。

examples.text: It is a war with no holds barred and we must prepare to resist...
examples.translation: 这是一场没有规则的战争，我们必须作好抵抗的准备。

examples.text: When she'd get angry it was no holds barred.
examples.translation: 她发起火来什么都干得出。

examples.text: Bar a plateau in 1989, there has been a rise in inflation ever since the mid-1980's...
examples.translation: 除1989年物价稳定之外，从20世纪80年代中期开始，通货膨胀就一直在上升。

examples.text: The aim of the service was to offer everything the independent investor wanted, bar advice.
examples.translation: 该项服务的目的就是向独立投资者提供除建议外他们想要的一切。

examples.text: He is simply the best goalscorer we have ever had, bar none.
examples.translation: 他绝对是我们从未有过的最佳进球手，无人可及。

examples.text: Robert was planning to read for the Bar.
examples.translation: 罗伯特打算学法律。

meanings.meaning: 仅仅，勉强；几乎不；公开地；贫乏地

examples.text: Anastasia could barely remember the ride to the hospital...
examples.translation: 阿纳斯塔西娅几乎记不起来怎么去的医院。

examples.text: It was 90 degrees and the air conditioning barely cooled the room...
examples.translation: 当时气温达到了90度，空调也不能让房间凉快多少。

examples.text: His voice was barely audible...
examples.translation: 他的声音几乎听不见。

examples.text: She was an elfin-like girl who looked barely 10 years old.
examples.translation: 她是个鬼马小精灵，看起来也就刚满10岁。

examples.text: The Boeing 767 had barely taxied to a halt before its doors were flung open...
examples.translation: 这架波音767刚刚停住，它的舱门就弹开了。

examples.text: Barely had the bulldozers started when Museum of London archaeologists swooped.
examples.translation: 推土机刚一启动，伦敦博物馆的考古学家们就蜂拥而至了。

examples.text: She was wearing only a thin robe over a flimsy nightdress, and her feet were bare...
examples.translation: 她只在薄如蝉翼的睡衣外套了一件薄睡袍，而且光着脚。

examples.text: She had bare arms and a bare neck.
examples.translation: 她的胳臂和脖子都露在外面。

examples.text: They would have liked bare wooden floors throughout the house.
examples.translation: 他们本想在整个房间的木地板上都不铺地毯的。

examples.text: ...an old, twisted tree, its bark shaggy, many of its limbs brittle and bare.
examples.translation: 一棵虬枝盘绕的古树，树皮粗糙，很多枝杈光秃秃的，一折就断

examples.text: His fridge was bare apart from three very withered tomatoes...
examples.translation: 除了三个蔫巴巴的西红柿，他的冰箱里什么也没有。

examples.text: He led me through to a bare, draughty interviewing room.
examples.translation: 他把我带到了一间空荡荡的、有过堂风的会见室。

examples.text: That's probably the most bare, bleak, barren and inhospitable island I've ever seen.
examples.translation: 那可能是我见过的最荒凉的岛屿，荒无人烟，寸草不生。

examples.text: Newspaper reporters were given nothing but the bare facts by the Superintendent in charge of the investigation.
examples.translation: 报社的记者们从负责这起调查的督察那里得到的只是一些最基本的情况。

examples.text: The army would try to hold the western desert with a bare minimum of forces...
examples.translation: 军队会用尽可能少的兵力扼守西部的沙漠。

examples.text: These are the bare essentials you'll need to dress your baby during the first few months.
examples.translation: 这些是你的宝宝在头几个月里要穿的基本衣物。

examples.text: Sales are growing for premium wines, but at a bare 2 percent a year.
examples.translation: 高档酒的销量正在增长，但年增长率只有2％。

examples.text: Walsh bared his teeth in a grin...
examples.translation: 沃尔什露齿一笑。

examples.text: He bared his muscular, hairy chest for a women's magazine.
examples.translation: 他为一本女性杂志秀出了他那肌肉发达、毛发浓密的性感胸部。

examples.text: Police believe the killer punched her to death with his bare hands...
examples.translation: 警方认为她是被凶手活活用拳头打死的。

examples.text: Rescuers were using their bare hands to reach the trapped miners.
examples.translation: 救援人员正徒手营救被困矿工。

examples.text: The clearing out of disused workshops laid bare thousands of Italianate glazed tiles.
examples.translation: 清理废弃的车间时发现了成千上万块意大利风格的釉面砖。

examples.text: No one wants to expose themselves, lay their feelings bare.
examples.translation: 没有人想自我剖白，将自己的情感公之于众。

examples.text: Few men would have bared their soul to a woman as he had.
examples.translation: 很少有男人能像他一样对一个女人敞开心扉。

meanings.meaning: 讨价还价；议价；(谈价钱后)卖

examples.text: At this price the wine is a bargain...
examples.translation: 这种葡萄酒卖这个价真是很便宜。

examples.text: Fresh salmon is a bargain at the supermarket this week.
examples.translation: 这周超市的新鲜鲑鱼特价销售。

examples.text: I'll make a bargain with you. I'll play hostess if you'll include Matthew in your guest-list...
examples.translation: 我们说定了，如果你能把马修也邀请来的话我就做东。

examples.text: The treaty was based on a bargain between the French and German governments.
examples.translation: 这个条约是以法国和德国政府之间的一个协议为基础的。

examples.text: They prefer to bargain with individual clients, for cash...
examples.translation: 在现款方面，他们更愿意同散户打交道。

examples.text: Shop in small local markets and don't be afraid to bargain.
examples.translation: 在当地的小店购物，不要害怕砍价。

examples.text: A union bargainer said that those jobs have been saved.
examples.translation: 一位工会的谈判人员说那些工作岗位都已经保住了。

examples.text: The government has called for sensible pay bargaining.
examples.translation: 政府提倡就报酬进行合理的商谈。

examples.text: ...a law firm with a reputation for driving a hard bargain.
examples.translation: 在讲价方面颇有名气的律师事务所

examples.text: This machine is designed to save you effort, and keep your work surfaces tidy into the bargain...
examples.translation: 这种机器既省力，又能保持工作台面的整洁。

examples.text: She is rich. Now you say she is a beauty into the bargain.
examples.translation: 她很有钱。现在你又说她还是个美女。

examples.text: Dealing with this dictator wasn't an option. He wouldn't have kept his side of the bargain.
examples.translation: 别跟这个独裁者打交道，他不会信守诺言的。

meanings.meaning: 树皮；深青棕色；毛皮；皮肤；狗叫

examples.text: Don't let the dogs bark...

examples.translation: 他惊恐地发现董事会成员正在进行你死我活的私人争斗。

examples.text: She has fought a constant battle with her weight...
examples.translation: 她一直在竭力控制体重。

examples.text: Greg lost his brave battle against cancer two years ago.
examples.translation: 格雷格在与癌症进行了勇敢的斗争之后于两年前去世。

examples.translation: 数千人与警方发生冲突，据报道有数人在冲突中受伤。

examples.text: The sides must battle again for a quarter-final place on December 16...
examples.translation: 双方将在12月16日再次交锋以争夺进入四分之一决赛的席位。

examples.text: They're also battling the government to win compensation.
examples.translation: 他们也在跟政府交涉以争取补偿。

examples.text: Doctors battled throughout the night to save her life.
examples.translation: 医生们彻夜奋战来挽救她的生命。

examples.text: ...a lone yachtsman returning from his months of battling with the elements...
examples.translation: 只身驾驶游艇与恶劣天气搏斗数月后成功归航的人

examples.text: In Wyoming, firefighters are still battling the two blazes.
examples.translation: 在怀俄明州，消防员还在为扑灭这两场大火而奋战。

examples.text: If anyone can do it, he can. He's a battler and has a strong character.
examples.translation: 只要有人能做到这一点，他就能做到。他是一位斗士，个性坚毅。

examples.text: ...the notorious Montonero guerrilla group who did battle with the army during the dirty war...
examples.translation: 曾在那场肮脏的战争中与这支部队交战的臭名昭著的蒙特内罗游击队

examples.text: This March, a British and an American company will do battle in the High Court over the right to press compact discs.
examples.translation: 今年3月，一家英国公司和一家美国公司将会在最高法院就光盘压制权展开争夺。

examples.text: Choosing the right type of paint for the job is half the battle.
examples.translation: 选对了涂料，这项工作就成功了一半。

examples.text: The battle lines were drawn after the government refused to budge from its final offer.
examples.translation: 政府拒绝改变其最后条件之后，双方对立态势趋向明朗。

examples.text: The crew fought a losing battle to try to restart the engines.
examples.translation: 全体船员努力尝试重新启动发动机，但结果徒劳无功。

examples.text: ...on a day when the sun is fighting a losing battle against the lowering clouds.
examples.translation: 那天，太阳慢慢被低垂的云层遮蔽起来。

examples.text: In the Cup Final, Leeds battled it out with the old enemy, Manchester United...
examples.translation: 在足总杯决赛中，利兹联队和宿敌曼彻斯特联队一决胜负。

examples.text: Barbados could have three new political parties battling it out in the next General Election.
examples.translation: 在下一届大选中，巴巴多斯可能有三个新的政党参加角逐。

examples.text: The strikers may have won the battle, but they lost the war.
examples.translation: 罢工者们虽胜犹败。

examples.text: The President offered compromises to parliament to defuse the battle of wills over who should wield power.
examples.translation: 总统对国会作出让步，以求结束这场旷日持久的权力争斗。

examples.text: With chess you're involved in a battle of wits from start to finish.
examples.translation: 下国际象棋从头到尾都是在比拼智慧。

examples.translation: 全国各地每所学校都在发生这样的事情。

examples.translation: 它可以让学生们有更多的时间来学习，或者更准确一点说，有更多的时间来放松自己。

examples.translation: 这类化学制剂，不管是芥子气还是神经瓦斯，都会被皮肤吸收。

examples.translation: 他觉得疼痛难忍，恨不得死了算了。

examples.translation: 她已经学会了按自己的方式行事，坚持自己的信仰。

examples.translation: 如果不是因为我会想念自己的花园的话，我会很乐意搬回公寓住。

examples.translation: 如果不是因为她，你父亲今天可能还活着。

examples.translation: “他还是那么胖吗？”——“我不知道，”她妈妈接着说，没有理睬这一打岔，“就算那样，他已经发财了。”

examples.translation: 她身体不舒服，简直要崩溃了。

examples.translation: 我只想躺在海滩上晒晒太阳。

examples.translation: 我们把独木舟径直划到岸边，并拖上岸。

examples.translation: 船搁浅在一片淤泥滩上。

examples.translation: 专家们无法解释为什么这些鲸会搁浅在海滩上。

examples.translation: 弗朗西丝开心地对自己的朋友笑着，毫不掩饰她的羡慕之情。

examples.translation: “欢迎回来，”她满面笑容地说。

examples.translation: 即将实现自己梦想的41岁男人的笑脸

examples.translation: 高能激光束

examples.translation: 这次访谈向全美国现场直播。

examples.translation: 聚光灯的强烈白光照在小舞台上。

examples.translation: 而外面的世界，你所能看见的就只是透过房顶缝隙射进来的阳光。

examples.translation: 房顶用橡木横梁支撑。

examples.translation: 他们把那个长方形的硬木箱抬进厨房，放到桌上。

examples.translation: 他们不得不忍受长期生活在战争恐惧中的痛苦。

examples.translation: 他不想和别人谈论这件事，哪怕对我也是一样。

examples.translation: 病人不应该自己承担治疗费用。

examples.translation: 如果一个女人决定独自抚养孩子，她就必须独自承担所有责任。

examples.translation: 他们每天的食谱和他们实际吃到的东西完全不同。

examples.translation: 对于很多软件包来说，价钱和成本没有什么联系。

examples.translation: 孩子们很乖。

examples.translation: 晴好的艳阳天

examples.text: That's a beautiful shot!
examples.translation: 射得漂亮！

examples.text: Arsenal played beautifully.
examples.translation: 阿森纳队踢得赏心悦目。

meanings.meaning: 美；美丽；美人；美好的东西

examples.text: ...an area of outstanding natural beauty...
examples.translation: 自然美景美不胜收的景区

examples.text: Everyone admired her elegance and her beauty.
examples.translation: 人人都羡慕她的优雅和美丽。

examples.text: She is known as a great beauty.
examples.translation: 她是出了名的大美女。

examples.text: The pass was a real beauty, but the shot was poor.
examples.translation: 传得非常漂亮，但是临门一脚太臭了。

examples.text: He was beginning to enjoy the beauties of nature.
examples.translation: 他开始享受大自然之美。

examples.text: Additional beauty treatments can be booked in advance.
examples.translation: 额外的美容服务可以提前预订。

examples.text: There would be no effect on animals—that's the beauty of such water-based materials.
examples.translation: 对动物毫无影响——水基材料妙就妙在这儿。

examples.text: He is called Mitch, because his name is Mitchell...
examples.translation: 人们叫他米奇，因为他大名叫米切尔。

examples.text: Because it is an area of outstanding natural beauty, you can't build on it...
examples.translation: 考虑到这一带自然风光旖旎，你不能建在这里。

examples.text: Women are doing the job well. This is partly because women are increasingly moving into a man's world...
examples.translation: 女性工作出色，部分原因在于她们越来越多地涉足男性的领域。

examples.text: 'Why didn't you tell me, Archie?'— 'Because you might have casually mentioned it to somebody else.'
examples.translation: “你怎么没告诉我呀，阿奇？”——“因为你可能会一不小心说了出去。”

examples.text: Maybe they just didn't want to ask too many questions, because they rented us a room without even asking to see our papers...
examples.translation: 也许他们只是懒得问太多的问题，因为他们都没要求看我们的证件就把一个房间租给我们了。

examples.text: The President has played a shrewd diplomatic game because from the outset he called for direct talks with the United States...
examples.translation: 总统玩了一场高明的外交游戏，因为从一开始他就要求和美国直接对话。

examples.text: I had a sense of déjà-vu because I could recognise everything in London.
examples.translation: 我有一种似曾相识的感觉，因为我能认出伦敦的一切。

examples.text: Many families break up because of a lack of money...
examples.translation: 许多家庭由于缺钱而破裂。

examples.text: Because of the law in Ireland, we had to work out a way of getting her over to Britain.
examples.translation: 由于爱尔兰的法律所限，我们不得不想办法把她弄到英国去。

examples.text: Just because it has a good tune does not mean it is great music...
examples.translation: 仅凭旋律优美并不见得就是一首杰出的音乐作品。

examples.text: Just because something has always been done a certain way does not make it right.
examples.translation: 仅仅因为老是以某种方式做事并不意味着这么做就是对的。

meanings.meaning: 打；打败；拍打；有节奏地舒张与收缩
拍子；敲击；有规律的一连串敲打
筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的

examples.text: My wife tried to stop them and they beat her...
examples.translation: 我妻子想阻止他们，他们就打了她。

examples.text: They were beaten to death with baseball bats.
examples.translation: 他们被人用棒球棒打死了。

examples.text: There was dead silence but for a fly beating against the glass...
examples.translation: 当时一片寂静，只听见一只苍蝇不停地撞击着玻璃。

examples.text: Nina managed to free herself and began beating at the flames with a pillow...
examples.translation: 尼娜好不容易挣脱出来，拿起枕头用力扑打火焰。

examples.text: The rain was beating on the windowpanes.
examples.translation: 雨点拍打着窗玻璃。

examples.text: ...the rhythmic beat of the surf.
examples.translation: 海浪有节奏的拍打

examples.text: ...the silence broken only by the beating of the rain.
examples.translation: 一片寂静，只听见雨声

examples.text: I felt my heart beating faster.
examples.translation: 我感觉我的心越跳越快。

examples.text: He could hear the beat of his heart...
examples.translation: 他能听见自己的心跳声。

examples.text: Most people's pulse rate is more than 70 beats per minute.
examples.translation: 大多数人的脉率都在每分钟70次以上。

examples.text: I could hear the beating of my heart.
examples.translation: 我能听见自己的心跳。

examples.text: When you beat the drum, you feel good.
examples.translation: 敲鼓的时候感觉很好。

examples.text: ...drums beating and pipes playing.
examples.translation: 敲鼓和吹风笛

examples.text: ...the rhythmical beat of the drum.
examples.translation: 有节奏的鼓点

examples.text: ...the thumping beat of rock music.
examples.translation: 摇滚乐强烈的节奏

examples.text: ...the dance beats of the last two decades.
examples.translation: 过去20年的舞曲节奏

examples.text: It's got four beats to a bar.
examples.translation: 一个小节有4拍。

examples.text: Beat the eggs and sugar until they start to thicken.
examples.translation: 把鸡蛋和白糖混在一起搅打至开始变稠。

examples.text: Beating their wings they flew off...
examples.translation: 它们拍打着翅膀飞走了。

examples.text: Its wings beat slowly.
examples.translation: 它的翅膀缓慢拍动着。

examples.text: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two-one...
examples.translation: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士以2比1击败美国。

examples.text: There are men who simply don't like being beaten by a woman...
examples.translation: 有些男人就是不想被女人打败。

examples.text: She was easily beaten into third place.
examples.translation: 她轻易落败，跌至第三。

examples.text: He was as eager as his Captain to beat the record.
examples.translation: 他和队长一样渴望打破这项纪录。

examples.text: It became clear that the Union was not going to beat the government...
examples.translation: 情况已然明朗，工会无法和政府抗衡。

examples.text: They recognise that tough action offers the only hope of beating inflation...
examples.translation: 他们认识到这一严厉举措是战胜通货膨胀的唯一希望。

examples.text: Kate Jackson is expecting her first child at 43—two years after beating breast cancer.
examples.translation: 凯特·杰克逊在43岁的时候怀上了第一个孩子——那时她战胜乳腺癌已经有两年了。

examples.text: The rescuers were beaten back by strong winds and currents...
examples.translation: 救援人员因风浪太大而被迫中断工作。

examples.text: South Africa's ruling National Party has beaten off a right-wing challenge.
examples.translation: 南非执政的国民党已经击退了右翼分子的一次挑战。

examples.text: Being boss of a software firm beats selling insurance...
examples.translation: 当软件公司的老板比卖保险强多了。

examples.text: Nothing quite beats the luxury of soaking in a long, hot bath at the end of a tiring day...
examples.translation: 辛苦一天之后美美地泡个热水澡比什么都强。

examples.text: For an evening stroll the beach at Dieppe is hard to beat.
examples.translation: 傍晚散步去迪耶普的海滩简直是不二之选。

examples.text: You can't beat soap and water for cleansing.
examples.translation: 做清洁没有比用肥皂和水更好的了。

examples.text: They were trying to beat the midnight deadline...
examples.translation: 他们要努力赶在午夜的最后期限之前完成。

examples.text: Those who shop on Sunday to beat the rush are wasting their time.
examples.translation: 那些为了在抢购高峰前下手而在星期天购物的人是在浪费时间。

examples.text: The team police get to know the people in their patrol areas better than cops who must cover a larger beat.
examples.translation: 小分队的警察比那些负责大片区域的警察更了解自己管片的群众。

examples.text: 'What am I doing wrong, anyway?' — 'Beats me, Lewis.'...
examples.translation: “不管怎样，我到底做错了什么？”——“这我也不知道，刘易斯。”

examples.text: How you can be so insensitive absolutely beats me.
examples.translation: 我真搞不懂你怎么会这么麻木。

examples.text: Beat it before it's too late.
examples.translation: 趁早滚开。

examples.text: Can you beat it; there was Graham Greene in Freetown and there was I on the other side of Africa.
examples.translation: 真是岂有此理！格雷厄姆·格林在弗里敦，而我却在非洲的另一边。

examples.text: Don't be too long about it or you'll find someone has beaten you to it.
examples.translation: 别拖得太久，不然就会有人捷足先登了。

examples.text: 'Are you jealous?' — 'Only when I'm not in control,' he says, not missing a beat.
examples.translation: “你眼红吗？”——“除非我把持不住自己，”他毫不犹豫地说道。

examples.text: Skye has scarcely missed a beat as one of the Gold Coast's spectacular models since her marriage.
examples.translation: 丝凯作为黄金海岸大红大紫的模特儿，自结婚以后从来就没有错失过任何机会。

examples.text: The officer on the beat picks up information; hears cries for help; makes people feel safe.
examples.translation: 值勤警员注意观察情况，对救援呼叫及时反应，确保让百姓有一种安全感。

examples.text: He beats time with hands and feet.
examples.translation: 他手脚并用地打着拍子。

examples.text: There had been no violence, no beatings-up until then.
examples.translation: 在那之前没有动粗打人。

examples.text: I first became interested in Islam while I was doing my nursing training...
examples.translation: 我在接受护理培训的时候开始对伊斯兰教产生了兴趣。

examples.text: The cocoa industry dwindled because it became increasingly difficult to cover costs...
examples.translation: 由于越来越难以收回成本，可可产业日渐衰落。

examples.text: During the 1980s the world's financial systems became more open...
examples.translation: 在20世纪80年代，世界金融体系变得更加开放。

examples.text: The pilot decided to land, but as we lost altitude the wind became stronger...
examples.translation: 飞行员决定着陆，但随着我们越飞越低，风变得越来越大。

examples.text: As she reached the age of thirty she became convinced she would remain single all her life...
examples.translation: 步入而立之年时，她确信自己会独身一辈子。

examples.text: After leaving school, he became a professional footballer...
examples.translation: 走出校门后，他成了一名职业足球运动员。

examples.text: In 1823 Honduras became a part of the United Provinces of Central America.
examples.translation: 1823年，洪都拉斯成为了中美洲联邦的一部分。

examples.text: Does khaki become you?...
examples.translation: 卡其布适合你吗？

examples.text: Don't be crude tonight, Bernard, it doesn't become you.
examples.translation: 今晚别说荤话，伯纳德，说荤话可不好。

examples.text: She thought constantly about her family; she might never know what had become of them...
examples.translation: 她一直挂念着家人；她也许再也听不到他们的消息了。

examples.text: Where will he go to school now he's been thrown out of Eton? What will become of him?
examples.translation: 现在他被伊顿公学开除了，他去哪儿上学呢？他将来又会怎样呢？

examples.text: Take a luxurious snooze on your king-size bed before heading out for a dip.

meanings.meaning: (Bee)人名；(赤几)贝埃；(东南亚国家华语)美；(英)比(女子教名Beatrix和Beatrice的昵称)

examples.text: He's got a bee in his bonnet about factory farming.
examples.translation: 他满脑子都是工厂化养殖的事儿。

examples.text: That year I won first prize in the spelling bee...
examples.translation: 那年，我在单词拼写比赛中得了第一名。

examples.text: ...a group of friends at a quilting bee.
examples.translation: 大家缝聚会上的一群好友

examples.text: ...roast beef.
examples.translation: 烤牛肉

examples.text: ...beef stew.
examples.translation: 炖牛肉

examples.text: ...exports of beef and powdered milk.
examples.translation: 牛肉和奶粉的出口

examples.text: Instead of beefing about what Mrs Martin has not done, her critics might take a look at what she is trying to do.
examples.translation: 批评者不要老是抱怨马丁太太没有做什么事情，不妨看看她正要做什么事情。

examples.text: I really don't have a beef with Wayne.
examples.translation: 我对韦恩真的没有什么不满的。

meanings.meaning: (Beer)人名；(法、德、俄、罗、捷、瑞典)贝尔；(英、西、南非)[纺] 比尔

examples.text: He sat in the kitchen drinking beer...
examples.translation: 他坐在厨房里喝啤酒。

examples.text: We have quite a good range of beers.
examples.translation: 我们有多种多样的啤酒。

examples.text: Would you like a beer?
examples.translation: 来杯啤酒吗？

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, before is used in the phrasal verbs ‘go before’ and ‘lay before’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，before 还可用于 go before 和 lay before 等短语动词中。

examples.text: Before World War II, women were not recruited as intelligence officers...
examples.translation: 在第二次世界大战之前，女性不能当情报人员。

examples.text: My husband rarely comes to bed before 2 or 3am.
examples.translation: 我丈夫很少在凌晨两三点之前睡觉。

examples.text: Stock prices climbed close to the peak they'd registered before the stock market crashed.
examples.translation: 股价几乎攀升到了股市崩盘前的历史最高位。

examples.text: He spent his early life in Sri Lanka before moving to England...
examples.translation: 在移居英格兰之前，他早年是在斯里兰卡度过的。

examples.text: Before leaving, he went into his office to fill in the daily time sheet.
examples.translation: 离开前，他到自己的办公室填写了日常考勤表。

examples.text: He took a cold shower and then towelled off before he put on fresh clothes.
examples.translation: 他冲了个凉水澡，用毛巾擦干身子后换上了新衣服。

examples.text: The war had ended only a month or so before.
examples.translation: 战争大约一个月前才刚刚结束。

examples.text: It's interesting that he sent me the book twenty days before the deadline for my book.
examples.translation: 有趣的是，他在我的书到期前20天把那本书送给了我。

examples.text: Kelman had a book published in the US more than a decade before a British publisher would touch him.
examples.translation: 克尔曼早在英国出版商同他接触前十多年就已经在美国出版过一本书了。

examples.text: Before Gallacher could catch up with the ball, Nadlovu had beaten him to it.
examples.translation: 加拉赫还没来得及追上球，纳德洛武就已经抢先一步触到球了。

examples.text: I've been here before...
examples.translation: 我以前来过这儿。

examples.text: I had met Professor Lown before...
examples.translation: 我以前见过劳恩教授。

examples.text: She had never been to Italy before.
examples.translation: 她以前从来没有去过意大利。

examples.text: It was some time before the door opened in response to his ring.
examples.translation: 他按完门铃后过了一会儿门才打开。

examples.text: There was additional work to be done before all the troops would be ready.
examples.translation: 在全军准备就绪之前，还有一些杂事必须处理。

examples.text: They drove through a tall iron gate and stopped before a large white villa.
examples.translation: 他们开车穿过一个大铁门，在一栋白色的大别墅前面停了下来。

examples.text: The turn is about two kilometres before the roundabout.
examples.translation: 拐弯就在环岛前面约2公里处。

examples.text: The Governor will appear before the committee next Tuesday.
examples.translation: 下周二，州长将接受委员会的质询。

examples.text: The game followed a colourful opening ceremony before a crowd of seventy-four thousand.
examples.translation: 绚丽多彩的开幕式过后，这场比赛在74,000名观众的瞩目之下开始了。

examples.text: Everyone in the room knew it was the single hardest task before them...
examples.translation: 房间里所有人都清楚，摆在他们面前的是最为艰巨的任务。

examples.text: I saw before me an idyllic life.
examples.translation: 展现在我眼前的是充满诗情画意的生活。

examples.text: Her husband, her children, and the Church came before her needs.
examples.translation: 丈夫、孩子和教会都比她本人的需求重要。

examples.text: How could she tell beforehand that I was going to go out?...
examples.translation: 她怎么会事先知道我要出去？

examples.text: Saunas can be hazardous if misused. Avoid a big meal beforehand.
examples.translation: 洗桑拿浴如果方法不当会有危险，浴前切忌饱食。

examples.text: I begged him to come back to England with me...
examples.translation: 我恳求他和我一起回英格兰。

examples.text: I begged to be allowed to leave...
examples.translation: 我请求允许我离开。

examples.text: We are not going to beg for help any more...
examples.translation: 我们不会再乞求帮助。

examples.text: They dropped to their knees and begged forgiveness.
examples.translation: 他们跪下请求原谅。

examples.text: I was surrounded by people begging for food...
examples.translation: 我被一群讨饭的围住了。

examples.text: There are thousands like him in Los Angeles, begging on the streets and sleeping rough...
examples.translation: 洛杉矶有数以千计像他这样的人，沿街乞讨，露宿街头。

examples.text: She was living alone, begging food from neighbors.
examples.translation: 她孑然一身，向邻居们讨饭吃。

examples.text: There is other housing going begging in town.
examples.translation: 城里还有些住宅无人问津。

examples.text: Hopewell's success begs the question: why aren't more companies doing the same?
examples.translation: 霍普韦尔的成功让人不禁要问：为什么其他公司不效仿呢？

examples.text: The research begs a number of questions.
examples.translation: 研究绕过了一些问题。

examples.text: He stood up and began to move around the room...
examples.translation: 他起身开始在屋里来回走动。

examples.text: The weight loss began to look more serious...
examples.translation: 体重下降眼看开始变得愈发厉害了。

examples.text: Snow began falling again.
examples.translation: 雪又开始下了。

examples.text: The problems began last November...
examples.translation: 问题在去年11月份开始出现。

examples.text: He has just begun his fourth year in hiding...
examples.translation: 他东躲西藏的第四个年头刚刚开始。

examples.text: The US is prepared to begin talks immediately.
examples.translation: 美国愿意立刻开始谈判。

examples.text: Could I begin with a few formalities?
examples.translation: 请允许我开场先讲几句套话。

examples.text: ...a businessman who began by selling golf shirts from the boot of his car...
examples.translation: 靠他的汽车后备箱练摊兜售高尔夫球衫起家的商人

examples.text: He began his career as a sound editor.
examples.translation: 他是从声音剪辑师做起的。

examples.text: 'Professor Theron,' he began, 'I'm very pleased to see you'...
examples.translation: “西伦教授，”他开口说道，“很高兴见到您。”

examples.text: He didn't know how to begin.
examples.translation: 他不知从何说起。

examples.text: What began as a local festival has blossomed into an international event.
examples.translation: 原先的地方节日已经发展成为一项国际性活动。

examples.text: The fate line begins close to the wrist...
examples.translation: 命运线始于接近手腕的地方。

examples.text: Rue Guynemer begins at the front of the Fitzgerald site.
examples.translation: 吉内梅街始于菲茨拉德故居前。

examples.text: The first word begins with an F.
examples.translation: 第一个词的首字母为F。

examples.text: You can't begin to imagine how much that saddens me.
examples.translation: 你都无从想象这让我有多悲伤。

examples.text: It was great to begin with but now it's difficult.
examples.translation: 一开始非常好，但现在可就难了。

examples.text: 'What do scientists you've spoken with think about that?' — 'Well, to begin with, they doubt it's going to work.'
examples.translation: “跟你聊过的科学家是怎么看的？”——“嗯，首先，他们怀疑这能否行得通。”

examples.text: This was also the beginning of her recording career...
examples.translation: 这也是她唱片生涯的开始。

examples.text: Think of this as a new beginning.
examples.translation: 把这当作一个新起点。

examples.text: I had the beginnings of a headache...
examples.translation: 我有了头痛的先兆。

examples.text: The discussions were the beginnings of a dialogue with Moscow.
examples.translation: 讨论拉开了同莫斯科对话的序幕。

examples.text: The wedding will be at the beginning of March.
examples.translation: 婚礼定于三月初举行。

examples.text: ...the question which was raised at the beginning of this chapter.
examples.translation: 在本章开头所提出的问题

examples.text: His views come from his own humble beginnings.
examples.translation: 他的观点源于他卑微的出身。

examples.text: The people that she had in her classroom were beginning learners.
examples.translation: 她带的这班学生都是初学者。

examples.text: She made an emotional public appeal on her son's behalf...
examples.translation: 她代表儿子动情地发出了公开呼吁。

examples.text: Secret Service officer Robin Thompson spoke on behalf of his colleagues.
examples.translation: 特工处官员罗宾·汤普森代表他的同僚发表了讲话。

examples.text: 'What do you mean?' I asked, offended on Liddie's behalf.
examples.translation: “你什么意思啊？”我问，替利迪感到愤愤不平。

meanings.meaning: 表现；（机器等）运转；举止端正；（事物）起某种作用

examples.text: I couldn't believe these people were behaving in this way...
examples.translation: 我难以相信这些人竟会有这种举动。

examples.text: He'd behaved badly.
examples.translation: 他表现得很糟糕。

examples.text: You have to behave...
examples.translation: 你得规矩点。

examples.text: They were expected to behave themselves.
examples.translation: 他们应该守规矩。

examples.text: Under certain conditions, electrons can behave like waves rather than particles.
examples.translation: 在一定条件下，电子可以作波状运动，而不是粒子状运动。

examples.text: The Navy has denied the separation proceedings are based on the suspicion of homosexual behavior.
I put one of the cushions behind his head...
examples.translation: 我把其中的一个软垫垫在他脑后。

examples.text: They were parked behind the truck...
examples.translation: 他们停在了卡车后面。

examples.text: The moon disappeared behind a cloud.
examples.translation: 月亮消失在云后。

examples.text: Rising into the hills behind are 800 acres of parkland...
examples.translation: 800英亩绿地延伸至山丘后面。

examples.text: She was attacked from behind.
examples.translation: 有人从后面袭击了她。

examples.text: Keith wandered along behind him...
examples.translation: 基思跟在他后面闲逛。

examples.text: Myra and Sam and the children were driving behind them.
examples.translation: 迈拉和萨姆带着孩子们开车跟在他们的后面。

examples.text: The troopers followed behind, every muscle tensed for the sudden gunfire.
examples.translation: 骑兵尾随其后，精神高度紧张以防突袭。

examples.text: The colonel was sitting behind a cheap wooden desk...
examples.translation: 上校坐在一张廉价的木桌后面。

examples.text: He could just about see the little man behind the counter.
examples.translation: 他勉强能看到柜台后面的小个子男人。

examples.text: I walked out and closed the door behind me...
examples.translation: 我走了出来，随手带上了门。

examples.text: He slammed the gate shut behind him.
examples.translation: 他砰的一声带上了大门。

examples.text: It is still not clear who was behind the killing...
examples.translation: 凶杀案的幕后主使尚不清楚。

examples.text: He is embarrassed about the motives behind his decision.
examples.translation: 关于这项决策的背后动机，他觉得难以启齿。

examples.text: He had the state's judicial power behind him.
examples.translation: 他有国家司法权作后盾。

examples.text: What lay behind his anger was really the hurt he felt at Grace's refusal...
examples.translation: 他生气的表面之下是因遭格雷斯拒绝而深受伤害的心。

examples.text: Behind the smiling eyes lurks the evil that led her to murder the two babies in her care.
examples.translation: 她笑里藏刀，杀害了她照顾的两个宝宝。

examples.text: She finished second behind the American, Ann Cody, in the 800 metres...
examples.translation: 她在800米赛跑中落后于美国选手安·科迪而位居第二。

examples.text: Food production has already fallen behind the population growth.
examples.translation: 粮食生产已经跟不上人口增长。

examples.text: The rapid development of technology means that she is now far behind, and will need retraining...
examples.translation: 随着技术的快速发展，她已经远远落伍了，需要接受再培训。

examples.text: The accounts are more than three months behind.
examples.translation: 这些账目滞后三个多月。

examples.text: Maureen put the nightmare behind her...
examples.translation: 莫琳已将噩梦抛诸脑后。

examples.text: He will attempt to put behind him the misery of failing to win a medal in his individual event.
examples.translation: 他会尽力忘掉自己没能在个人项目上夺牌的痛苦。

examples.text: He has 20 years of loyal service to Barclays Bank behind him...
examples.translation: 他已经忠心耿耿地为巴克莱银行效力了20年。

examples.text: Birgit was a popular actress with half a decade of filmmaking behind her.
examples.translation: 比吉特曾是一位当红女演员，有着五年的从影经历。

examples.text: The work is 22 weeks behind schedule...
examples.translation: 这项工作比计划滞后了22周。

examples.text: We were two months behind schedule, and already over budget.
examples.translation: 我们的进度晚了两个月，而且已经超出了预算。

examples.text: As women were not permitted in the war zone, Eleanor would have to stay behind...
examples.translation: 女性是不允许进入战区的，所以埃莉诺不得不留在后方。

examples.text: About 1,200 personnel will remain behind to take care of the air base.
examples.translation: 大约会有1,200人留守看管这个空军基地。

examples.text: The rebels fled into the mountains, leaving behind their weapons and supplies...
examples.translation: 叛军丢下武器和给养，逃进了山里。

examples.text: He came to Saudi Arabia, leaving behind his wife and their three children.
examples.translation: 他抛下妻子和三个孩子来到了沙特阿拉伯。

examples.text: It being a Sunday, the old men had the day off...
examples.translation: 因为是星期天，所以老人都休息。

examples.text: Little boys, being what they are, might decide to play on it...
examples.translation: 出于天性，小男孩们可能会决定利用这一点。

examples.text: Of course, being young, I did not worry.
examples.translation: 当然，因为还年轻，所以我并不担心。

examples.text: People expect a horse to perform like a car, with no thought for its feelings as a living being.
examples.translation: 人们希望马能像汽车一样，完全没有考虑到马作为一种有生命的动物会有什么样的感受。

examples.text: ...beings from outer space.
examples.translation: 来自外太空的生物

examples.text: Abraham Maslow described psychology as 'the science of being.'...
examples.translation: 亚伯拉罕·马斯洛形容心理学是“存在的科学”。

examples.text: The Kingdom of Italy formally came into being on 17 March 1861.
examples.translation: 意大利王国于1861年3月17日正式成立。

examples.text: ...the complex process by which the novel is brought into being.
examples.translation: 这部小说复杂的写作过程

examples.text: I used to go everywhere with my mother being as I was the youngest.
examples.translation: 我以前到哪儿都跟着我妈，因为我是老小。

examples.text: One billion people throughout the world are Muslims, united by belief in one god.
examples.translation: 全世界有10亿穆斯林，共同的一神信仰将他们团结在一起。

examples.text: ...a belief in personal liberty.
examples.translation: 对个人自由的信仰

examples.text: He refuses to compete on Sundays because of his religious beliefs.
examples.translation: 出于宗教信仰，他拒绝在礼拜天进行比赛。

examples.text: It is our belief that improvements in health care will lead to a stronger, more prosperous economy.
examples.translation: 我们坚信，改善医疗保健会使经济更加繁荣昌盛。

examples.text: We are devastated, shocked beyond belief...
examples.translation: 我们极为震惊，无法相信所发生的一切。

examples.text: Her son's skin improved beyond belief.
examples.translation: 她儿子的皮肤得到了难以置信的改善。

examples.text: Contrary to popular belief, there is no evidence that what you look like makes much difference to your life.
examples.translation: 和人们一般的看法相反，没有证据表明面相对人生有多大影响。

examples.text: Civilians had broken into the building, apparently in the belief that it contained food.
examples.translation: 平民百姓闯进了大楼，显然他们误以为里面有食物。

examples.text: Experts believe that the coming drought will be extensive...
examples.translation: 专家们认为即将发生的旱灾将侵袭大片地区。

examples.text: I believe you have something of mine...
examples.translation: 我想你拿了我什么东西。

examples.text: The main problem, I believe, lies elsewhere...
examples.translation: 主要的问题，我认为，出在别的地方。

examples.text: We believe them to be hidden here in this apartment...
examples.translation: 我们相信他们就被藏在这套公寓里。

examples.text: 'You've never heard of him?' — 'I don't believe so.'
examples.translation: “你从来没有听说过他？”——“我认为不是这样的。”

examples.text: He did not sound as if he believed her...
examples.translation: 他听起来似乎并不相信她。

examples.text: Never believe anything a married man says about his wife...
examples.translation: 永远不要相信一个已婚男人说的任何有关他妻子的话。

examples.text: Don't believe what you read in the papers.
examples.translation: 不要相信报纸上看到的东西。

examples.text: I don't believe in ghosts...
examples.translation: 我不相信有鬼。

examples.text: Do you believe in magic?
examples.translation: 你相信魔法真的存在吗？

examples.text: He believed in marital fidelity.
examples.translation: 他认为婚内应该忠诚。

examples.text: ...decent candidates who believed in democracy.
examples.translation: 信奉民主政治的正派候选人

examples.text: If you believe in yourself you can succeed.
examples.translation: 只要自信，就能成功。

examples.text: Many officers I spoke to found it hard to believe what was happening around them...
examples.translation: 很多和我谈过的官员都觉得发生在他们周围的事情令人难以置信。

examples.text: I was a physical and emotional wreck — I still can't believe how I ever got any work done.
examples.translation: 我那时身心俱疲——现在还难以相信我是怎么把一些事情做成的。

examples.text: I could not believe my eyes. She was far more beautiful than I had imagined.
examples.translation: 我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。她比我想象的漂亮多了。

examples.text: That's normal, believe it or not.
examples.translation: 那很正常，信不信由你。

examples.text: And would you believe it, he's younger than me!
examples.translation: 你信吗？他比我年轻！

examples.text: It's absolutely amazing, believe you me.
examples.translation: 这太不可思议了，真的。

examples.text: I had just enough time to finish eating before the bell rang and I was off to my first class...
examples.translation: 我刚吃完饭铃声就响了，于是我赶去上第一堂课。

examples.text: I've been ringing the door bell, there's no answer.
examples.translation: 我一直按门铃，但是没有人应门。

examples.text: My brother, Neville, was born on a Sunday, when all the church bells were ringing.
examples.translation: 我弟弟内维尔是星期天出生的，当时所有的教堂钟声齐鸣。

examples.text: There are 80 of these pictures and they're all as clear as a bell.
examples.translation: 这些照片一共有80张，都非常清晰。

examples.text: I was going to give you a bell tomorrow.
examples.translation: 我明天给你打电话。

examples.text: The description of one of the lads is definitely familiar. It rings a bell.
examples.translation: 对其中一个小伙子的描述确实似曾熟悉。听起来挺耳熟。

examples.text: The horse returned sound as a bell.
examples.translation: 这匹马安然无恙地回来了。

meanings.meaning: 属于，应归入；居住；适宜；应被放置

examples.text: The house had belonged to her family for three or four generations.
examples.translation: 这套房子归她们家有三四代人了。

examples.text: The handwriting belongs to a male...
examples.translation: 这是男性的笔迹。

examples.text: They established that the body belonged to a 15-year-old girl.
examples.translation: 他们确定这是一具15岁女孩的尸体。

examples.text: I used to belong to a youth club.
examples.translation: 我过去是一个青年俱乐部的成员。

examples.text: The judges could not decide which category it belonged in...
examples.translation: 评委们无法判定它属于哪一类。

examples.text: I realized that he and I belonged to different worlds.
examples.translation: 我意识到我和他不是一路人。

examples.text: The pictures belong to an era when there was a preoccupation with high society.
examples.translation: 这些画出自一个人人向往上流社会的时代。

examples.text: ...but the last word belonged to Rosanne.
examples.translation: 但是最终决定权在罗莎娜手里

examples.text: The future belongs to democracy.
examples.translation: 未来属于民主。

examples.text: He deduced that the two children belonged to the couple.
examples.translation: 他推断这俩小孩是这对夫妇的。

examples.text: I really think that we belong together...
examples.translation: 我真的觉得我们属于彼此。

examples.text: He belongs with me.
examples.translation: 他是我的。

examples.text: You don't belong here...
examples.translation: 你不属于这里。

examples.text: This piece really belongs in the concert hall...
examples.translation: 这曲子很适合在音乐厅演奏。

examples.text: I'm so glad to see you back where you belong...
examples.translation: 我真高兴看到你又回到了属于你自己的天地。

examples.text: They need to feel they belong.
examples.translation: 他们需要有归属感。

examples.text: ...a man utterly without a sense of belonging.
examples.translation: 完全没有归属感的男人

examples.text: He lost his beloved wife last year...
examples.translation: 他去年痛失爱妻。

examples.text: The rose is the most romantic of flowers, beloved of poets, singers, and artists.
examples.translation: 玫瑰是最浪漫的花，深受诗人、歌手和艺术家的喜爱。

examples.text: He takes his beloved into his arms.
examples.translation: 他将心爱之人拥入怀中。

examples.text: She laid her hands on her swollen belly...
examples.translation: 她把双手放在自己隆起的肚子上。

examples.text: ...a horse with its belly ripped open...
examples.translation: 一匹被开膛破肚的马

examples.text: You'll eat so much your belly'll be like a barrel.
examples.translation: 你会吃得肚子鼓鼓的，像个大酒桶。

examples.text: I really can't afford to see this company go belly up.
examples.translation: 我绝对不能眼睁睁地看着这家公司垮掉。

meanings.meaning: 在下面，在较低处；在本页下面

examples.text: He appeared from the apartment directly below Leonard's...
examples.translation: 他从伦纳德家正下方的公寓里走了出来。

examples.text: The path runs below a long brick wall...
examples.translation: 小道位于长砖墙脚下。

examples.text: The sun had already sunk below the horizon...
examples.translation: 太阳已经落到了地平线以下。

examples.text: The boat dipped below the surface of the water.
examples.translation: 这条船沉入水下。

examples.text: We climbed rather perilously down a rope-ladder to the boat below.
examples.translation: 我们冒着相当大的危险沿着绳梯爬到了下面的船上。

examples.text: ...a view to the street below...
examples.translation: 可以看到下面的街道

examples.text: Spread out below was a great crowd.
examples.translation: 下面是摩肩接踵的人群。

examples.text: They have designed a system which pumps up water from 70m below ground...
examples.translation: 他们设计了一套从地下70米处抽水的系统。

examples.text: Coils buried in tunnels below the ground might soon be used to store large amounts of electricity.
examples.translation: 埋在地下隧道里的线圈可能很快就会被用来储存大量的电。

examples.text: Please write to me at the address below...
examples.translation: 请按照下面的地址给我写信。

examples.text: The BBC Good Food Show is giving away free tickets in a competition. For details, see below.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司“美食秀”正在派送比赛免费券，详情见下文。

examples.text: Night temperatures can drop below 15 degrees Celsius...
examples.translation: 夜间气温会降到15摄氏度以下。

examples.text: British Telecom agreed to keep overall price increases to 7.5 per cent below inflation...
examples.translation: 英国电信同意将整体价格增幅控制在低于通货膨胀7.5%的水平。

examples.text: Rainfall has been below average.
examples.translation: 降雨量低于平均水平。

examples.text: ...temperatures at zero or below.
examples.translation: 零度或零度以下的温度

examples.text: Such people often experience less stress than those in the ranks immediately below them.
examples.translation: 这些人承受的压力往往小于那些职位仅次于他们的人。

examples.text: ...pay rises awarded to all white-collar staff below chief officer level.
examples.translation: 所有职位低于首席官员的白领员工的薪酬增长

meanings.meaning: 用带子系住；用皮带抽打

examples.text: He wore a belt with a large brass buckle.
examples.translation: 他系着一条带大铜扣的腰带。

examples.text: The turning disc is connected by a drive belt to an electric motor.
examples.translation: 转盘由一根传动带与电机相连。

examples.text: Miners in Zambia's northern copper belt have gone on strike...
examples.translation: 赞比亚北部铜矿带的矿工已经罢工了。

examples.text: Behind him was a belt of trees, and behind the trees hills and fields.
examples.translation: 在他身后是一片树林，树林后面是小山和田地。

examples.text: 'Is it right she belted old George in the gut?' she asked.
examples.translation: “她真的把老乔治痛打了一顿？”她问。

examples.text: Father would give you a belt over the head with the scrubbing brush.
examples.translation: 爸爸会拿硬毛刷打爆你的头。

examples.text: We belted down Iveagh Parade to where the motor was.
examples.translation: 我们沿着艾维格大街一路飞奔到汽车那儿。

examples.text: He is a black belt in karate.
examples.translation: 他是空手道黑带选手。

examples.text: Do you think it's a bit below the belt what they're doing?
examples.translation: 你觉得他们的做法是不是有点儿不太光明正大？

examples.text: ...this kind of below-the-belt discrimination.
examples.translation: 这种不公正的歧视

examples.text: Clearly, if you are spending more than your income, you'll need to tighten your belt.
examples.translation: 明摆着，要是你入不敷出，你就得省着点了。

examples.text: Clare is now a full-time author with six books, including four novels, under her belt.
examples.translation: 克莱尔现在是全职作家，著有6本书，其中有4部小说。

examples.text: He sat down on a park bench.
examples.translation: 他在公园的长椅上坐了下来。

examples.text: ...the laboratory bench.
examples.translation: 实验台

examples.text: ...the opposition benches.
examples.translation: 反对派议席

examples.text: The chairman of the bench adjourned the case until October 27.
examples.translation: 主审法官将案件延期到10月27日审理。

examples.text: Allgood served on the bench for more than 50 years.
examples.translation: 奥尔古德当了五十多年的法官。

examples.text: Ian Ferguson was preferred to Stuart McCall, who was on the bench.
examples.translation: 伊恩·弗格森比坐在替补席上的斯图尔特·麦考尔更受器重。

meanings.meaning: 使弯曲；使屈服；使致力；使朝向
弯曲，转弯；屈服；倾向；专心于

examples.text: I bent over and kissed her cheek...
examples.translation: 我俯身亲吻了她的脸颊。

examples.text: Turn the pot if the plants show signs of bending towards the light...
examples.translation: 如果花草有向阳性，就把花盆转一下。

examples.text: She bent and picked up a plastic bucket...
examples.translation: 她弯腰提起一个塑料桶。

examples.text: She was bent over the sink washing the dishes.
examples.translation: 她俯在水槽边洗盘子。

examples.text: Rick appeared, bending his head a little to clear the top of the door.
examples.translation: 里克到了，进门时为了避开门楣稍微低了下头。

examples.text: These cruel devices are designed to stop prisoners bending their legs...
examples.translation: 这些残酷的刑具是用来阻止犯人弯腿的。

examples.text: As you walk faster, you will find the arms bend naturally and more quickly.
examples.translation: 走快时，你会发现手臂会自然弯曲，而且频率会更快。

examples.text: Keep your knees slightly bent.
examples.translation: 保持双膝稍稍弯曲。

examples.text: Bend the bar into a horseshoe...
examples.translation: 把铁条弯成马蹄形。

examples.text: She'd cut a jagged hole in the tin, bending a knife in the process.
examples.translation: 她在罐头上曲里拐弯地划了个口，其间还弄弯了一把小刀。

examples.text: ...a length of bent wire.
examples.translation: 一段弯曲的铁丝

examples.text: The road bent slightly to the right...
examples.translation: 这条路稍微朝右弯。

examples.text: Glass bends light of different colours by different amounts.
examples.translation: 玻璃对不同颜色的光的折射量不同。

examples.text: The crash occurred on a sharp bend.
examples.translation: 撞车发生在一个急转弯处。

examples.text: ...an historic town nestling in a bend of the river.
examples.translation: 一个坐落在河曲处的历史名镇

examples.text: Congress has to bend to his will...
examples.translation: 国会不得不屈从于他的意志。

examples.text: Do you think she's likely to bend on her attitude to Europe?
examples.translation: 你认为她会改变对欧洲的态度吗？

examples.text: A minority of officers were prepared to bend the rules.
examples.translation: 少数官员准备篡改规则。

examples.text: Sometimes we bend the truth a little in order to spare them the pain of the real facts.
examples.translation: 有时我们会稍微变动一下事实，以免他们知道实情会太痛苦。

examples.text: People are bending over backwards to please customers.
examples.translation: 人们正使出浑身解数取悦顾客。

examples.text: And can you make that tea before your fidgeting drives me completely round the bend.
examples.translation: 你能不能把那壶茶泡好？瞧你坐立不安的样子，真要把我惹急了。

examples.text: People thought I was round the bend.
examples.translation: 人们以为我疯了。

examples.text: She could see the muscles of his shoulders beneath his T-shirt...
examples.translation: 她可以看到他T恤衫下的肩部肌肉。

examples.text: She found pleasure in sitting beneath the trees...
examples.translation: 她喜欢坐在树下。

examples.text: Four storeys of parking beneath the theatre was not enough.
examples.translation: 剧院下面的四层停车场不够用。

examples.text: ...the frozen grass crunching beneath his feet.
examples.translation: 在他脚下嘎吱作响的冻草

examples.text: On a shelf beneath he spotted a photo album.
examples.translation: 他在下面的架子上瞅见了一本相册。

examples.text: ...aeroplanes roaring above, subways rattling beneath.
examples.translation: 飞机在上面呼啸而过，地铁在下面隆隆疾驰

examples.text: ...emotional strains beneath the surface...
examples.translation: 表面之下的情感纠结

examples.text: Somewhere deep beneath the surface lay a caring character...
examples.translation: 在内心深处的某个角落里埋藏着一颗爱心。

examples.text: Beneath the festive mood there is an underlying apprehension.
examples.translation: 在喜庆的背后存在着隐忧。

examples.text: They decided she was marrying beneath her...
examples.translation: 他们认定她要嫁给一个配不上她的人。

examples.text: Many find themselves having to take jobs far beneath them.
examples.translation: 很多人觉得自己在工作上被迫大材小用。

meanings.meaning: 有益的，有利的；可享利益的

examples.text: ...vitamins which are beneficial to our health...
examples.translation: 对我们健康有益的维生素

examples.text: Using computers has a beneficial effect on children's learning.
examples.translation: 使用计算机对孩子们的学习有益。

examples.text: Each family farms individually and reaps the benefit of its labor...
examples.translation: 各家经营各自的农场，收获各自的劳动成果。

examples.text: I'm a great believer in the benefits of this form of therapy...
examples.translation: 我坚信这种治疗形式非常有益。

examples.text: For maximum benefit, use your treatment every day.
examples.translation: 为了达到最佳效果，你每天都要接受治疗。

examples.text: This could now work to Albania's benefit...
examples.translation: 这种情况目前对阿尔巴尼亚有利。

examples.text: I hope what I have written will be of benefit to someone else who may feel the same way.
examples.translation: 我希望我所写的内容能对其他和我有同感的人有所裨益。

examples.text: Both sides have benefited from the talks.
examples.translation: 双方都从谈判中获益。

examples.text: ...a variety of government programs benefiting children.
examples.translation: 有益于儿童的各种政府项目

examples.text: Steve didn't have the benefit of a formal college education...
examples.translation: 史蒂夫没能接受正规的大学教育。

examples.text: With the benefit of hindsight, it is clear we ought to have done more...
examples.translation: 事后看来，我们显然本该做得更多。

examples.text: This remarkable achievement took place without the benefit of our modern telecommunication industry.
examples.translation: 这项非凡成就的取得并没有借助于现代电信业这个有利条件。

examples.text: ...the removal of benefit from school-leavers...
examples.translation: 取消辍学者的补助金

examples.text: I was told that in order to get benefit payments I would have to answer some questions.
examples.translation: 我得知要领补助，就得回答一些问题。

examples.text: The very poorest parents are not in work, they are living on benefit.
examples.translation: 正是这些极端贫困的父母没有工作，靠救济金过活。

examples.text: I am organising a benefit gig in Bristol to raise these funds.
examples.translation: 我要在布里斯托尔组织一场义演来募集这些资金。

examples.text: At first I gave him the benefit of the doubt...
examples.translation: 起初，我姑且相信了他。

examples.text: Shalford is entitled to the benefit of the doubt.
examples.translation: 沙尔福德暂且获得了信任。

examples.text: You need people working for the benefit of the community...
examples.translation: 你们需要为社区谋利益的人。

examples.text: He doesn't have to go through this elaborate display for my benefit!
examples.translation: 他不必为了我作这么详细的展示！

meanings.meaning: 良性的；和蔼的，亲切的；吉利的

examples.text: They are normally a more benign audience...
examples.translation: 他们通常观看时比较温和。

examples.text: Critics of the scheme take a less benign view.
examples.translation: 对该方案的批评就没有这么温和了。

examples.text: I just smiled benignly and stood back.
