examples.translation: 我只是和善地笑了笑，站到了后面。

examples.text: We're taking relatively benign medicines and we're turning them into poisons.
examples.translation: 我们服的药相对来说药性温和，但是我们却在把它们变成毒药。

examples.text: It wasn't cancer, only a benign tumour.
examples.translation: 这不是癌症，只是良性肿瘤。

examples.text: They enjoyed an especially benign climate...
examples.translation: 他们那里的气候非常宜人。

examples.text: This plunge came in a time of relatively benign economic conditions.
examples.translation: 这次大跌出现在相对良好的经济环境下。

examples.text: America and Japan have settled back into a policy of benign neglect of their currencies.
examples.translation: 美国和日本又回到了不作为货币政策的老路。

examples.text: On the table beside an empty plate was a pile of books...
examples.translation: 桌上空盘子的旁边是一堆书。

examples.text: I moved from behind my desk to sit beside her.
examples.translation: 我从桌子后面走到她身边坐了下来。

examples.text: He had shouted down the phone at her, beside himself with anxiety...
examples.translation: 他焦急万分地对着电话那头的她大喊大叫。

examples.text: Cathy was beside herself with excitement.
examples.translation: 凯茜兴奋异常。

examples.text: I think she has many good qualities besides being very beautiful...
examples.translation: 我觉得她不但长得非常漂亮，而且还有很多优秀品质。

examples.text: There was only one person besides Ford who knew Julia Jameson.
examples.translation: 除了福特以外，只有一个人认识朱莉娅·詹姆森。

examples.text: You get to sample lots of baked things and take home masses of cookies besides.
examples.translation: 您不仅可以品尝各种烘烤糕点，还可以带很多饼干回家。

examples.text: The house was too expensive and too big. Besides, I'd grown fond of our little rented house.
examples.translation: 这座房子太贵太大了。再说，我已经喜欢上我们租的小房子了。

meanings.meaning: 打赌，赌注；被打赌的事物

examples.text: Jockeys are forbidden to bet on the outcome of races...
examples.translation: 职业赛马骑师禁止对赛马结果下注。

examples.text: I bet £10 on a horse called Premonition...
examples.translation: 我在一匹名叫“预兆”的赛马上下了10英镑的赌注。

examples.text: He bet them 500 pounds they would lose.
examples.translation: 他和他们打赌500英镑说他们会输。

examples.text: Do you always have a bet on the Grand National?
examples.translation: 你总是对全国赛马大会下点注吗？

examples.text: ...his thousand-pound fine for illegal betting.
examples.translation: 他因非法赌博而被罚款1,000英镑。

examples.text: ...betting shops.
examples.translation: 彩票销售点

examples.text: You can put a bet on almost anything these days.
examples.translation: 如今几乎可以对任何东西下赌注。

examples.text: The party is betting that the presidential race will turn into a battle for younger voters...
examples.translation: 该党期待这次总统竞选变成一场争取年轻一代选民的斗争。

examples.text: People were betting on a further easing of credit conditions.
examples.translation: 人们期待着贷款条件进一步放宽。

examples.text: I bet you were good at games when you were at school...
examples.translation: 我敢说你上学时体育很棒。

examples.text: I bet you anything you like he's a pimp...
examples.translation: 我敢打包票，他是个皮条客。

examples.text: I'll bet they'll taste out of this world...
examples.translation: 我敢说此味只应天上有。

examples.text: You can bet she will be there.
examples.translation: 你大可放心，她一定会去那里的。

examples.text: Textiles are a good bet for a country bent on industrialisation...
examples.translation: 纺织业对于致力于工业化的国家来说是个比较稳妥的产业。

examples.text: Your best bet is to choose a guest house.
examples.translation: 你最好选择一个小旅馆。

examples.text: It is a safe bet that the current owners will not sell.
examples.translation: 十有八九现在的业主不会出售。

examples.text: NASA is hedging its bets and adopting both strategies.
examples.translation: 美国航空航天局做了两手准备，两套策略双管齐下。

examples.text: 'I'd like to ask you something,' I said. — 'I bet you would,' she grinned.
examples.translation: “我想问你点事，”我说。——“我就知道你要问，”她笑道。

examples.text: My bet is that next year will be different...
examples.translation: 我敢说明年不会这样。

examples.text: It's my bet that he's the guy behind this killing.
examples.translation: 我认为他就是这起凶杀案的幕后主使。

examples.text: 'We'll never get a table in there' — 'Don't bet on it.'
examples.translation: “我们在那儿是订不上座了。”——“那可不一定。”

examples.text: 'Money can't buy happiness.' — 'Want to bet?'
examples.translation: “金钱买不到幸福。”——“敢打赌吗？”

examples.text: 'It's settled, then?' — 'You bet.'...
examples.translation: “那么，就这么定了？”——“定了。”

examples.text: 'Are you afraid of snakes?' — 'You bet your life I'm afraid of snakes.'
examples.translation: “你怕蛇吗？”——“这还用问，我当然怕啦。”

meanings.meaning: 最好的人，最好的事物；最佳状态

examples.text: If you want further information the best thing to do is have a word with the driver as you get on the bus...
examples.translation: 如果你想了解更多信息，最好的办法是在上公交车时问一问司机。

examples.text: It's not the best place to live if you wish to develop your knowledge and love of mountains.
examples.translation: 如果你想增长知识、培养登山爱好的话，这可不是最好的地方。

examples.text: James Fox is best known as the author of White Mischief.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯·福克斯以《欲望城》一书最为出名。

examples.text: We offer only the best to our clients...
examples.translation: 我们只把最好的服务提供给客户。

examples.text: He'll have the best of care.
examples.translation: 他会得到最好的照顾。

examples.text: Miss Blockey was at her best when she played the piano...
examples.translation: 布洛基小姐弹钢琴的时候发挥了她的最好水平。

examples.text: One needs to be a first-class driver to get the best out of that sort of machinery.
examples.translation: 只有一流的司机才能让那种机器发挥出最大的功效。

examples.text: A draw seems the best they can hope for...
examples.translation: 看来他们顶多只能指望打个平局了。

examples.text: The best we can do is try to stay cool and muddle through.
examples.translation: 我们能做的顶多就是设法保持冷静，蒙混过关。

examples.text: The thing I liked best about the show was the music...
examples.translation: 这场演出中我最喜欢的是它的音乐。

examples.text: Mother liked it best when Daniel got money...
examples.translation: 丹尼尔拿到钱的时候，母亲是最高兴的。

examples.text: What was the role you loved the best?
examples.translation: 你最喜欢哪一个角色？

examples.text: Wish him all the best, and tell him we miss him.
examples.translation: 祝他一切顺利，告诉他我们想念他。

examples.text: It was comfortable and cheap: best of all, most of the rent was being paid by two American friends.
examples.translation: 房子既舒适又便宜：最妙的是，大部分租金是由两位美国朋友支付的。

examples.text: The older people were left to carry on as best they could.
examples.translation: 年纪大一点的人被留下来，奋力坚持。

examples.text: This policy, they say, is at best confused and at worst non-existent...
examples.translation: 有人说这项政策往好里说是混乱不堪，往坏里说就是形同虚设。

examples.text: At best they were effective as antidepressants for no more than four months.
examples.translation: 它们充其量也只能起到4个月的抗抑郁剂的效果。

examples.text: I'll do my best to find out...
examples.translation: 我会尽力查明真相。

examples.text: It wasn't her fault, she was trying her best to help...
examples.translation: 这不是她的错，她是尽力帮忙的。

examples.text: It's a Championship fight — do your best.
examples.translation: 这是锦标赛——要尽全力。

examples.text: In the long run, it was for the best...
examples.translation: 长远来说，这是最好的。

examples.text: Whatever the circumstances, parents are supposed to know what to do for the best.
examples.translation: 不论在什么情况下，父母都应该知道怎样做才是最好的。

examples.text: Magda is now married to George Callerby and we are the best of friends.
examples.translation: 玛格达现在已经和乔治·卡勒比结婚了，我们成了最好的朋友。

examples.text: You'd best take a look.
examples.translation: 你最好还是看一看。

examples.text: He was convinced that doctors and dentists knew best.
examples.translation: 他确信医生和牙医最清楚该怎么做。

examples.text: I made sure I was very clean and looking my best.
examples.translation: 我把自己收拾得十分整洁，美丽动人。

examples.text: She instilled in the children the virtues of good hard work, and making the best of what you have.
examples.translation: 她慢慢给孩子们灌输勤奋工作的品德，教导他们充分利用现有的条件。

meanings.meaning: 背叛；出卖；泄露（秘密）；露出…迹象

examples.text: When I tell someone I will not betray his confidence I keep my word...
examples.translation: 如果我告诉某人我不会辜负他的信任，我就会恪守诺言。

examples.text: The President betrayed them when he went back on his promise not to raise taxes.
examples.translation: 总统背叛了他们，违背了不加税的诺言。

examples.text: She was her friend and now calls her a betrayer.
examples.translation: 她曾经是她的朋友，现在却叫她叛徒。

examples.text: They offered me money if I would betray my associates...
examples.translation: 他们提出来只要我供出同伙就给我钱。

examples.text: The group were informers, and they betrayed the plan to the Germans.
examples.translation: 这帮人是告密者，他们把计划泄露给了德国人。

examples.text: 'Traitor!' she screamed. 'Betrayer of England!'
examples.translation: “叛徒！”她尖叫道。“英格兰的叛徒！”

examples.text: We betray the ideals of our country when we support capital punishment.
examples.translation: 如果我们支持死刑，那就背弃了我们立国的理念。

examples.text: Babearth regarded the middle classes as the betrayers of the Revolution.
examples.translation: 巴博施把中产阶级看作是革命的叛徒。

examples.text: She studied his face, but it betrayed nothing...
examples.translation: 她仔细端详了一番他的脸，但什么也没有看出来。

examples.text: He nodded his head instead of saying anything where his voice might betray him.
examples.translation: 他一言不发，只是点头，因为一开口可能会露出破绽。

examples.text: Alcoholic beverages are served in the hotel lounge.
examples.translation: 酒店的公共休息室出售酒精饮料。

examples.text: ...artificially sweetened beverages.
examples.translation: 添加人工甜味剂的饮料

examples.text: ...foods and beverages.
examples.translation: 食品和饮料

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, between is used in a few phrasal verbs, such as ‘come between’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，between 还可用于 come between 等短语动词中。

examples.text: Charlie crossed between the traffic to the far side of the street.
examples.translation: 查利从车流中间穿过，到了街对面。

examples.text: I spent a lot of time in the early Eighties travelling between London and Bradford.
examples.translation: 八十年代初，我有很多时间穿梭于伦敦和布拉德福德之间。

examples.text: I think the relationship between patients and doctors has got a lot less personal...
examples.translation: 我认为医患关系变得越来越缺乏人情味。

examples.text: There have been intensive discussions between the two governments in recent days...
examples.translation: 近几天，双方政府一直在进行紧张的磋商。

examples.text: There has always been a difference between community radio and commercial radio.
examples.translation: 社区广播电台和商业广播电台一直是有区别的。

examples.text: His sense of duty often stood between him and the enjoyment of life.
examples.translation: 他的责任感经常让他无法好好享受生活。

examples.text: Increase the amount of time you spend exercising by walking between 15 and 20 minutes...
examples.translation: 步行15至20分钟，增加一下你的运动时间。

examples.text: Amsterdam is fun — a third of its population is aged between 18 and 30.
examples.translation: 阿姆斯特丹非常有趣——它有1/3的人口年龄介于18到30岁之间。

examples.text: The canal was built between 1793 and 1797...
examples.translation: 运河开凿于1793到1797年间。

examples.text: Berlin was well known for its good living in between the two world wars.
examples.translation: 在两次世界大战之间，柏林生活的优裕是众所周知的。

examples.text: ...a journey by jetfoil, coach and two aircraft, with a four-hour wait in Bangkok in between.
examples.translation: 一路上喷流水翼船、长途客车和两班飞机的颠簸劳顿，其间还得在曼谷等待4个小时

examples.text: Students will be able to choose between English, French and Russian as their first foreign language.
examples.translation: 学生可以在英语、法语和俄语中间选择一门作为第一外语。

examples.text: The three sites employ 12,500 people between them...
examples.translation: 这三处共雇用了12,500名员工。

examples.text: Between them, they train over fifty horses in Lambourn.
examples.translation: 他们在兰伯恩总共驯了五十多匹马。

examples.text: His company was bought out by Hogg Robinson for £3.5m, divided between five partners...
examples.translation: 他的公司被霍格·鲁宾逊公司以350万英镑的价格收购，分给了五位合伙人。

examples.text: There is only one bathroom shared between eight bedrooms.
examples.translation: 八间卧室共用一间浴室。

examples.text: Between you and me, though, it's been awful for business...
examples.translation: 不过你我之间说说，这事儿办得真不怎么样。

examples.text: Between ourselves, I know he wants to marry her.
examples.translation: 我们私下说说，我知道他想娶她。

examples.text: Beware of being too impatient with others...
examples.translation: 注意不要对他人太没有耐心。

examples.text: Motorists were warned to beware of slippery conditions...
examples.translation: 驾驶员接到提醒当心道路湿滑。

examples.text: Beware, this recipe is not for slimmers.
examples.translation: 注意，本食谱不适用于减肥者。

examples.text: The silence from Alex had hurt and bewildered her.
examples.translation: 亚历克斯的沉默伤害了她，让她不知所措。

meanings.meaning: 长辈；较好者；打赌的人（等于bettor）
更好的；更多的；较大程度地

examples.text: I like your interpretation better than the one I was taught...
examples.translation: 你的解释比我以前学过的更让我喜欢。

examples.text: I'd like nothing better than to join you girls...
examples.translation: 我最喜欢和你们女孩子在一起了。

examples.text: They liked it better when it rained.
examples.translation: 他们更喜欢雨天。

examples.text: He is much better now, he's fine...
examples.translation: 他现在好多了，身体状况不错。

examples.text: The doctors were saying there wasn't much hope of me getting better.
examples.translation: 医生们说我好转的希望不大。

examples.text: It's half past two. I think we had better go home...
examples.translation: 现在两点半了。我想我们最好还是回家吧。

examples.text: You'd better run if you're going to get your ticket...
examples.translation: 想买到票的话，你最好跑几步。

examples.text: He'd better not try to fool me.
examples.translation: 他最好不要愚弄我。

examples.text: Better not say too much aloud.
examples.translation: 最好不要大声说太多话。

examples.text: We expect better of you in the future...
examples.translation: 我们希望将来你有更大的成就。

examples.text: Our long-suffering mining communities deserve better than this.
examples.translation: 我们长期受苦受难的采矿群体应该得到比这更好的待遇。

examples.text: Sit down and be quiet in front of your elders and betters.
examples.translation: 在长辈和上级面前要老老实实地坐着。

examples.text: He recorded a time of 4 minutes 23, bettering the old record of 4-24...
examples.translation: 他用时4分23秒，刷新了4分24秒的原纪录。

examples.text: As an account of adolescence it could hardly be bettered.
examples.translation: 作为描写青春期的书，它已几臻完美。

examples.text: He had dedicated his life to bettering the lot of the oppressed people of South Africa...
examples.translation: 他毕生致力于改变南非受压迫人民的命运。

examples.text: Our parents chose to come here with the hope of bettering themselves.
examples.translation: 我们的父母选择来到这里，希望能够改善自己的生活。

examples.text: You are better eating just a small snack than hurrying a main meal...
examples.translation: 你最好简单吃点快餐，不要着急着慌地吃正餐。

examples.text: Wouldn't it be better putting a time-limit on the task?...
examples.translation: 是不是给这项任务规定一个时限比较好？

examples.text: Subjects like this are better left alone.
examples.translation: 像这类题材最好别碰。

examples.text: Dreams of changing the world for the better.
examples.translation: 让世界变得更美好的梦想

examples.text: She didn't allow her emotions to get the better of her.
examples.translation: 她没有感情用事。

examples.text: He is used to tough defenders, and he usually gets the better of them.
examples.translation: 他习惯了彪悍的后卫，通常都能战而胜之。

examples.text: She knew better than to argue with Adeline...
examples.translation: 她不至于和阿德琳发生争执。

examples.text: It's bad enough to have anyone joke about such a serious matter but a member of the police force should know better.
examples.translation: 拿这么严肃的事情开玩笑已经够糟的了，身为一名警察更不应该这样做。

examples.text: He thought he knew better than I did, though he was much less experienced...
examples.translation: 虽然他经验远没有我丰富，但他认为他比我懂行。

examples.text: My sister still claims she cheated on us at cards, but I know better.
examples.translation: 我妹妹仍然说她和我们玩牌的时候捣了鬼，其实我心知肚明。

examples.text: If you've got bags you're better off taking a taxi...
examples.translation: 你要是大包小包的，不如打的算了。

examples.text: Their stance seems to be that a baby or child is better off in its country of birth.
examples.translation: 他们似乎认为婴儿或者小孩还是呆在自己出生的国家为好。

examples.text: Now General Electric have gone one better than nature and made a diamond purer than the best quality natural diamonds.
examples.translation: 现在通用电气公司已经制造出了巧夺天工的钻石，其纯度比最好的天然钻石还要高。

examples.text: 'I came to ask your advice — no, to ask for your help.' — 'That's better. And how can I help you?'
examples.translation: “我来征求你们的意见——不对，请求你们帮助。”——“这还差不多。我们怎么帮助你？”

examples.text: Use strong white flour, and if you can get hold of durum wheat flour, then so much the better...
examples.translation: 使用高筋白面粉，如果你能弄到硬粒小麦面粉，那就更好了。

examples.text: If there's good skiing, breathtaking scenery and you don't need to catch a plane, all the better!
examples.translation: 如果有好的滑雪场、令人叹为观止的美景，又不用赶飞机，那就再好不过了。

examples.text: The Irish love a party, the bigger the better...
examples.translation: 爱尔兰人喜欢聚会，规模越大越好。

examples.text: The fewer things in the room the better.
examples.translation: 房间里的东西越少越好。

examples.text: She came on every ride herself, the better to instruct her eager pupils.
examples.translation: 每一个骑乘项目她都要亲自试一试，以便更好地指导她那些跃跃欲试的小学生。

examples.text: Alberg opened his mouth, as if to protest. But he thought better of it.
examples.translation: 阿尔伯格张了张嘴，似乎想要申辩，但想想又放弃了。

examples.text: I married you for better or worse, knowing all about these problems.
examples.translation: 这些问题我都知道，不管怎样我还是嫁给了你。

meanings.meaning: 超过；越过；那一边；在...较远的一边

examples.text: They heard footsteps in the main room, beyond a door...
examples.translation: 他们听见门外的大厅里有脚步声。

examples.text: On his right was a thriving vegetable garden and beyond it a small orchard of apple trees.
examples.translation: 他右边是一个生机勃勃的菜园，菜园的另一边是一个小小的苹果园。

examples.text: The house had a fabulous view out to the Strait of Georgia and the Rockies beyond.
examples.translation: 在这座房子里能看到乔治亚海峡和海峡那边落基山脉的壮美风景。

examples.text: ...the need to defend itself against its enemies inside its borders and beyond.
examples.translation: 抵御国内外敌人的需要

examples.text: Few jockeys continue race-riding beyond the age of 40...
examples.translation: 很少有职业赛马骑师超过40岁仍继续参加赛马的。

examples.text: You may be entitled to Child Benefit if a child continues getting full-time education beyond the date already notified by you.
examples.translation: 如果小孩接受全日制教育的时间超过了您已告知我们的那个期限，您就有权申请儿童补助金。

examples.text: The financing of home ownership will continue through the 1990s and beyond.
examples.translation: 购房贷款政策将会延续到20世纪90年代及以后。

examples.text: His interests extended beyond the fine arts to international politics and philosophy.
examples.translation: 他兴趣广泛，涵盖了从美术到国际政治乃至哲学的各个领域。

examples.text: He appears to have almost no personal staff, beyond a secretary who can't make coffee...
examples.translation: 除了一个不会冲咖啡的秘书之外，他好像几乎没有什么随身的工作人员。

examples.text: I knew nothing beyond a few random facts.
examples.translation: 除了一些零星的情况外，我什么也不知道。

examples.text: Their five-year relationship was strained beyond breaking point...
examples.translation: 他们五年的关系已经紧张到无法维系。

examples.text: It seems to me he's beyond caring about what anybody does.
examples.translation: 在我看来，他不关心别人做什么。

examples.text: What Jock had done was beyond my comprehension...
examples.translation: 我无法理解乔克的所作所为。

examples.text: Sweden is lovely in summer — cold beyond belief in winter...
examples.translation: 瑞典的夏天非常宜人——冬天却冷得让人难以置信。

examples.text: But by the year 2020 business computing will have changed beyond recognition.
examples.translation: 但是到了2020年，商业计算会变得面目全非。

examples.text: Although he could give her sympathy, any practical help would almost certainly be beyond him...
examples.translation: 虽然他可以对她表示同情，但是他几乎根本无法提供任何实际的帮助。

examples.text: The situation was beyond her control.
examples.translation: 局势并非她能控制。

meanings.meaning: (Bias)人名；(法、德、葡、喀)比亚斯；(英)拜厄斯

examples.text: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system...
examples.translation: 各级司法机构普遍存在对女性的偏见。

examples.text: There were fierce attacks on the BBC for alleged political bias.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司因被指具有政治偏见而遭到猛烈抨击。

examples.text: The Department has a strong bias towards neuroscience.
examples.translation: 这个系特别偏重神经科学。

examples.text: We mustn't allow it to bias our teaching.
examples.translation: 我们决不允许它影响我们的教学。

examples.text: The fabric, cut on the bias, hangs as light as a cobweb off a woman's body.
examples.translation: 这块斜裁料如蛛网一般轻盈地从一女子身上垂下来。

examples.text: ...a bias-cut dress.
examples.translation: 斜裁裙装

examples.text: ...the photographer's bible — Amateur Photographer.
examples.translation: 摄影师的宝典——《业余摄影师》

examples.text: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
examples.translation: 本章末尾列有一份有用的精选书目。

examples.text: I bicycled on towards the sea.
examples.translation: 我继续骑着自行车朝海边走。

examples.text: ...Sydney's successful bid for the 2000 Olympic Games...
examples.translation: 悉尼对2000年奥运会的成功申办

examples.text: The Government has already closed down two newspapers in a bid to silence its critics.
examples.translation: 政府已经查禁了两家报纸，试图压制批评人士的言论。

examples.text: Hanson made an agreed takeover bid of £351 million.
examples.translation: 汉森按协商出价3.51亿英镑接管该公司。

examples.text: Singapore Airlines is rumoured to be bidding for a management contract to run both airports...
examples.translation: 据传，新加坡航空公司正在争取签下两家机场的经营权。

examples.text: I don't think she is bidding to be Prime Minister again.
examples.translation: 我想她不会再次竞选首相。

examples.text: She decided to bid for a Georgian dressing table...
examples.translation: 她决定参与一个乔治王朝时期风格梳妆台的竞价。

examples.text: The bank announced its intention to bid...
examples.translation: 这家银行宣布了参加竞标的意向。

examples.text: He certainly wasn't going to bid $18 billion for this company.
examples.translation: 他肯定不会出180亿美元来收购这家公司。

examples.text: The bidding starts at £2 million.
examples.translation: 竞标底价是200万英镑。

examples.text: She bade farewell to her son...
examples.translation: 她和儿子道了别。

examples.text: I bade her goodnight.
examples.translation: 我向她道了晚安。

examples.text: They all smiled at him and bade him eat...
examples.translation: 他们都朝他微笑，请他吃饭。

examples.text: I dare say he did as he was bidden.
examples.translation: 我敢说他按照要求做了。

examples.text: Australia's a big country...
examples.translation: 澳大利亚是个幅员辽阔的国家。

examples.text: Her husband was a big man...
examples.translation: 她丈夫是个大块头。

examples.text: The car was too big to fit into our garage.
examples.translation: 这部车太大了，我们的车库放不下。

examples.text: The crowd included a big contingent from Ipswich.
examples.translation: 人群中有来自伊普斯威奇的一个人数众多的代表团。

examples.text: ...the big backlog of applications.
examples.translation: 大量积压的申请表

examples.text: Her problem was just too big for her to tackle on her own...
examples.translation: 她的问题太严重了，光靠她自己是没法解决的。

examples.text: There could soon be a big increase in unemployment.
examples.translation: 失业人数可能很快就会出现大幅增长。

examples.text: Exchange is largely controlled by big banks.
examples.translation: 货币兑换业务主要由大银行控制。

examples.text: ...one of the biggest companies in Italy.
examples.translation: 意大利最大的公司之一

examples.text: Their father was very big in the army...
examples.translation: 他们的父亲在军中很有影响力。

examples.text: I'm sure all the big names will come to the club.
examples.translation: 我相信所有的大人物都会到这个俱乐部来。

examples.text: ...a big letter J.
examples.translation: 大写字母J

examples.text: They use a lot of big words.
examples.translation: 他们使用很多生僻的词汇。

examples.text: We're not just looking at making it big in the UK, we want to be big internationally.
examples.translation: 我们不仅想在英国取得成功，还想在国际上扬名立万。

examples.text: Maybe we're not thinking big enough.
examples.translation: 也许我们的抱负还不够远大。

examples.text: I think boxing will take off in a big way here.
examples.translation: 我想拳击运动在这儿会有很大的发展。

examples.text: ...3 billion dollars...
examples.translation: 30亿美元

examples.text: This year, almost a billion birds will be processed in the region.
examples.translation: 今年将会有近10亿只禽类在这个地区加工。

examples.text: Biological systems have been doing this for billions of years...
examples.translation: 生物系统亿万年来一直都是这样。

examples.text: He urged US executives to invest billions of dollars in his country.
examples.translation: 他力劝美国公司的高管们向他的国家投资数十亿美元。

examples.text: He thought that it must be worth billions.
examples.translation: 他以为那一定价值连城。

meanings.meaning: [法] 法案；广告；账单；[金融] 票据；钞票；清单
宣布；开账单；用海报宣传

examples.text: They couldn't afford to pay the bills...
examples.translation: 他们无力支付这些账单。

examples.text: He paid his bill for the newspapers promptly.
examples.translation: 他立即支付了订报费。

examples.text: ...phone bills.
examples.translation: 电话账单

examples.text: Are you going to bill me for this?
examples.translation: 你们会给我开这个的账单吗？

examples.text: ...a large quantity of US dollar bills.
examples.translation: 大量的美钞

examples.text: This is the toughest crime bill that Congress has passed in a decade...
examples.translation: 这是十年来国会通过的最严厉的一项刑事法案。

examples.text: The bill was approved by a large majority.
examples.translation: 这项法案得到了绝大多数人的支持。

examples.text: She was billed to play the Red Queen in Snow White.
examples.translation: 海报宣传她会扮演《白雪公主》中的“红王后”。

examples.text: ...their quarrels over star billing.
examples.translation: 他们因为海报上排名的先后顺序而发生的争吵

examples.text: They bill it as Britain's most exciting museum.
examples.translation: 他们宣称它是英国最有趣的博物馆。

examples.text: If you fit the bill, send a CV to Rebecca Rees.
examples.translation: 如果你符合要求，就寄一份简历给丽贝卡·里斯。

examples.text: Who is footing the bill for her extravagant holiday?
examples.translation: 谁会为她奢侈的假日买单？

examples.text: President Mitterrand, 75, has been given a clean bill of health by doctors in Paris.
examples.translation: 巴黎的医生们告诉75岁的密特朗总统，他的身体非常健康。

meanings.meaning: (Bin)人名；(意、柬)宾；(日)敏(名)；(东南亚国家华语)民

examples.text: He screwed the paper small and chucked it in the bin.
examples.translation: 他把纸揉成小团，扔进了垃圾桶。

examples.text: ...a bread bin.
examples.translation: 面包箱

examples.text: ...big steel storage bins.
examples.translation: 钢质大储藏箱

examples.text: He decided to bin his paintings.
examples.translation: 他决定把他的画扔掉。

meanings.meaning: 结合；装订；有约束力；过紧
捆绑；困境；讨厌的事情；植物的藤蔓

examples.text: It is the memory and threat of persecution that binds them together.
examples.translation: 遭受迫害的记忆和威胁把他们紧紧联系在一起。

examples.text: ...the social and political ties that bind the USA to Britain.
examples.translation: 将美国和英国紧紧相连的社会和政治纽带

examples.text: ...a group of people bound together by shared language, culture, and beliefs.
examples.translation: 由共同的语言、文化和信仰紧紧联系在一起的一个群体

examples.text: The Luxembourg-based satellite service is not bound by the same strict rules as the BBC...
examples.translation: 设在卢森堡的卫星服务公司无须像英国广播公司那样遵守严格的规定。

examples.text: The authorities will be legally bound to arrest any suspects...
examples.translation: 当局负有逮捕所有疑犯的法律责任。

examples.text: There is a bottom deck though, so you're not bound to sit on top...
examples.translation: 不过还有一个底舱，所以你不一定非得坐在顶层。

examples.text: The treaty binds them to respect their neighbour's independence.
examples.translation: 条约规定他们必须尊重其邻国的独立。

examples.text: The world of advertising is obviously less bound by convention than the world of banking...
examples.translation: 显然，广告业比银行业更少受到惯例的束缚。

examples.text: Few of them feel bound by any enduring loyalties.
examples.translation: 他们中几乎没有人觉得有义务要保持忠诚。

examples.text: Bind the ends of the cord together with thread.
examples.translation: 用线把这根绳子的两端捆扎起来。

examples.text: ...the red tape which was used to bind the files...
examples.translation: 用来捆扎文件的红带子

examples.text: He said there were cases where prisoners were tightly bound, often for several days.
examples.translation: 他说有时犯人会被紧紧地捆绑起来，往往一捆就是好几天。

examples.text: Each volume is bound in bright-coloured cloth...
examples.translation: 每一卷都采用色彩亮丽的布面装帧。

examples.text: Their business came from a few big publishers, all of whose books they bound.
examples.translation: 他们的业务来自于几个大出版商，这些出版商的书都是他们装订的。

examples.text: ...four immaculately bound hardbacks.
examples.translation: 4本装订精美的精装书

examples.text: ...leather-bound stamp albums.
examples.translation: 皮面集邮册

examples.text: At present nobody understands why these three quarks which are in the proton are bound together...
examples.translation: 目前还没有人知道质子里面的这三个夸克为什么会结合在一起。

examples.text: These may bind to receptor molecules on the surfaces of cells...
examples.translation: 这些可能会在细胞表面和受体分子结合在一起。

examples.text: These compounds bind with genetic material in the liver.
examples.translation: 这些化合物在肝脏中与遗传物质实现结合。

examples.text: Bind the mixture with the raw minced liver and cook for 3 minutes more.
examples.translation: 让混合物滚上切碎的生肝脏，烹饪3分钟以上。

examples.text: ...a divine mixture of vegetarian cheeses bound with egg.
examples.translation: 素干酪和鸡蛋黏合在一起的绝妙搭配

examples.text: This puts the politicians in a bind as to what course to take...
examples.translation: 这使政治家们左右为难，不知道该如何处理。

examples.text: I'll advance you the money for it, here and now, just to help you out of a bind.
examples.translation: 我现在就把钱预付给你，好让你摆脱困境。

examples.text: It is expensive to buy and a bind to carry home.
examples.translation: 买这个费用很贵，搬回家也费劲。

meanings.meaning: （一个地区全部的）生物；生物学

examples.text: ...biologists studying the fruit fly.
examples.translation: 研究果蝇的生物学家

examples.text: The biology of these diseases is terribly complicated.
examples.translation: 这些疾病的机理极其复杂。

examples.text: ...human biology.
examples.translation: 人体生命机理

examples.text: ...a volume of biography and criticism.
examples.translation: 一册传记和评论文章

examples.text: John Paul Stevens, who will celebrate his ninetieth birthday on April 20th, generally bides his time.
It was the birth of his grandchildren which gave him greatest pleasure...
examples.translation: 孙子孙女的出生给他带来了极大的快乐。

examples.text: She concealed her pregnancy right up to the moment of birth...
examples.translation: 她隐瞒了自己怀孕的事，直到孩子出世。

examples.text: She weighed 5lb 7oz at birth.
examples.translation: 她出生时体重是5磅7盎司。

examples.text: ...premature births.
examples.translation: 早产

examples.text: ...the birth of popular democracy.
examples.translation: 人民民主的诞生

examples.text: ...men of low birth...
examples.translation: 出身卑微的人

examples.text: His birth, background and career show that you can make it in this country on merit alone.
examples.translation: 他的出身、背景和职业表明，在这个国家仅凭自己的能力就可以取得成功。

examples.text: Sadrudin was an Iranian by birth.
examples.translation: 萨德尔丁是伊朗血统。

examples.text: She's just given birth to a baby girl...
examples.translation: 她刚生了一个女孩。

examples.text: She's due to give birth at any moment.
examples.translation: 她随时可能分娩。

examples.text: In 1980, strikes at the Lenin Shipyards gave birth to the Solidarity trade union.
examples.translation: 1980年，列宁造船厂的罢工致使团结工会得以成立。

examples.text: During exchanges at First Minister's Questions, Carwyn Jones said Plaid's accusation "takes the biscuit".
They warned him that next time he'd find himself doing bird.
examples.translation: 他们警告他下次他可能就要进监狱了。

examples.text: As usual, Wheeler, a wise old bird, got it right...
examples.translation: 和往常一样，惠勒——一个非常聪明的人——又做对了。

examples.text: She was such a decent old bird.
examples.translation: 她是一个如此端庄的女人。

meanings.meaning: 奇异的（指态度，容貌，款式等）

examples.text: The game was also notable for the bizarre behaviour of the team's manager...
examples.translation: 这场比赛也因球队主教练怪异的举动而尽人皆知。

examples.text: You know, that book you lent me is really bizarre.
examples.translation: 你知道吗，你借给我的那本书真的很怪诞。

examples.text: She dressed bizarrely...
examples.translation: 她穿着奇装异服。

examples.text: Bizarrely, death is not a disqualification for voting although non-attendance at party meetings is.
examples.translation: 奇怪的是，死亡不会让人失去投票资格，但是不参加政党会议却会让人失去投票资格。

meanings.meaning: 苦的；痛苦的；尖刻的；充满仇恨的

examples.text: ...the scene of bitter fighting during the Second World War.
examples.translation: 第二次世界大战期间激烈的战斗场面

examples.text: ...a bitter attack on the Government's failure to support manufacturing...
examples.translation: 对政府支持制造业不力的猛烈抨击

examples.text: On the eve of the poll, campaigning was bitter.
examples.translation: 在投票前夕，竞选活动如火如荼。

examples.text: Any such thing would be bitterly opposed by most of the world's democracies.
examples.translation: 任何类似的事情都会遭到全世界民主国家的强烈反对。

examples.text: ...a bitterly fought football match.
examples.translation: 激烈的足球赛

examples.text: The rift within the organization reflects the growing bitterness of the dispute.
examples.translation: 组织内部严重失和反映出矛盾日趋升级。

examples.text: She is said to be very bitter about the way she was sacked...
examples.translation: 据说，她对自己被以如此方式解雇而感到愤愤不平。

examples.text: His long life was marked by bitter personal and political memories.
examples.translation: 他漫长的一生充满了关于个人生活和政治生涯的苦涩记忆。

examples.text: 'And he sure didn't help us,' Grant said bitterly.
examples.translation: “他当然没有帮助我们，”格兰特愤愤不平地说。

examples.text: ...the party bureaucrats who bitterly resented their loss of power.
examples.translation: 因为失去权力而满腹怨恨的党内官僚们

examples.text: I still feel bitterness and anger towards the person who knocked me down.
examples.translation: 我仍然对撞倒我的人愤恨不已。

examples.text: I think the decision was a bitter blow from which he never quite recovered...
examples.translation: 我想这个决定对他是个沉重的打击，从此以后他一蹶不振。

examples.text: A great deal of bitter experience had taught him how to lose gracefully...
examples.translation: 大量惨痛的经历让他学会了如何坦然面对失败。

examples.text: The statement was greeted with bitter disappointment by many of the other delegates.
examples.translation: 这份声明使其他许多代表大失所望。

examples.text: I was bitterly disappointed to have lost yet another race so near the finish.
examples.translation: 再一次在赛跑中与胜利失之交臂让我深感失望。

examples.text: Outside, a bitter east wind was accompanied by flurries of snow.
examples.translation: 外面，刺骨的东风伴着阵阵小雪。

examples.text: ...after spending a night in the bitter cold.
examples.translation: 在严寒中度过一夜之后

examples.text: It's been bitterly cold here in Moscow.
examples.translation: 莫斯科这里非常寒冷。

examples.text: The leaves taste rather bitter.
examples.translation: 这些叶子味道相当苦。

examples.text: ...as the wine ages, losing its bitter harshness, and becoming softer and smoother.
examples.translation: 年深日久，酒会褪去辣味，口感变得醇和起来

examples.text: ...a pint of bitter.
examples.translation: 一品脱苦啤酒

examples.text: The guerrillas would fight to the bitter end, he said, in order to achieve their main goal.
examples.translation: 他说，游击队员会为实现主要目标而战斗到底。

examples.text: It was like fingernails on a blackboard, said a participant in one of the meetings.

meanings.meaning: 勒索，敲诈；勒索所得之款

examples.text: It looks like the pictures were being used for blackmail...
examples.translation: 这些照片好像被用于敲诈勒索。

examples.text: Opponents accused him of blackmail and extortion.
examples.translation: 对方指控他敲诈勒索。

examples.text: The tactics employed can range from overt bullying to subtle emotional blackmail.
examples.translation: 从公然威吓到微妙的情感胁迫，各种战术都用上了。

examples.text: He told her their affair would have to stop, because Jack Smith was blackmailing him...
examples.translation: 他告诉她说他们的婚外情必须结束了，因为杰克·史密斯正在敲诈他。

examples.text: The government insisted that it would not be blackmailed by violence...
examples.translation: 政府坚持说它不会接受暴力讹诈。

examples.text: I thought he was trying to blackmail me into saying whatever he wanted.
examples.translation: 我认为他想敲诈我，让我说出他想知道的一切。

examples.text: The nasty thing about a blackmailer is that his starting point is usually the truth.
examples.translation: 勒索者的可恶之处在于他一开始往往是从事实入手的。

meanings.meaning: 机内测试设备（Built-In Test Equipment）

examples.text: Both sisters bit their nails as children...
examples.translation: 两姐妹都像小孩儿一样咬指甲。

examples.text: He bit into his sandwich...
examples.translation: 他咬了一口他的三明治。

examples.text: He had bitten the cigarette in two...
examples.translation: 他已经把香烟咬成了两半。

examples.text: Every year in this country more than 50,000 children are bitten by dogs...
examples.translation: 每年这个国家有5万多儿童被狗咬伤。

examples.text: Llamas won't bite or kick.
examples.translation: 美洲驼既不会咬人也不会踢人。

examples.text: He took another bite of apple...
examples.translation: 他又咬了一口苹果。

examples.text: You cannot eat a bun in one bite.
examples.translation: 你不能一口吃下一个面包。

examples.text: Look forward to eating the food and enjoy every bite.
examples.translation: 盼着吃东西，享受每一口食物。

examples.text: It was time to go home for a little rest and a bite to eat.
examples.translation: 该回家休息一会儿，吃一点儿东西了。

examples.text: When an infected mosquito bites a human, spores are injected into the blood...
examples.translation: 感染病毒的蚊子叮咬人之后，孢子便被注入血液中。

examples.text: We were all badly bitten by mosquitoes.
examples.translation: 我们都被蚊子咬惨了。

examples.text: Any dog bite, no matter how small, needs immediate medical attention.
examples.translation: 被狗咬后，不管伤口多小，都必须立即就医。

examples.text: As the sanctions begin to bite there will be more political difficulties ahead...
examples.translation: 随着制裁开始产生严重的负面影响，政治上将面临更多的困难。

examples.text: The recession started biting deeply into British industry.
examples.translation: 经济萧条开始对英国的工业产生严重影响。

examples.text: There may even be some wire or nylon biting into the flesh...
examples.translation: 甚至可能有一些金属丝或者尼龙线勒到肉里。

examples.text: The car's tires bit loudly on the rutted snow in the street.
examples.translation: 汽车轮子碾入街道上布满车辙的雪里，发出很大的声响。

examples.text: ...the addition of tartaric acid to give the wine some bite.
examples.translation: 为增加红酒的口感而加入酒石酸

examples.text: There was a bite in the air, a smell perhaps of snow.
examples.translation: 空气非常寒冷，似乎有雪的味道。

examples.text: The teams have that extra bite when they are playing against their neighbours...
examples.translation: 这几支队伍与其邻近地区队伍交手时锐气更盛。

examples.text: The novel seems to lack bite and tension—even passion.
examples.translation: 这部小说乏善可陈，没有紧张的情节——甚至缺少激情。

examples.text: After half an hour, the fish stopped biting and we moved on.
examples.translation: 半个小时以后，鱼儿不再咬钩了，我们只好换地方。

examples.text: If I don't get a bite in a few minutes I lift the rod and twitch the bait.
examples.translation: 如果几分钟没有鱼上钩，我就提起钓竿晃动一下鱼饵。

examples.text: ...bites of conversation.
examples.translation: 谈话的片段

examples.text: She may be cynical about the film industry, but ultimately she has no intention of biting the hand that feeds her.
examples.translation: 她对电影业可能有些怀疑失望，但终究没有恩将仇报之意。

examples.text: Whenever possible, suggest she talks about it but be aware she may bite your head off for your trouble.
examples.translation: 找机会建议她谈谈这事儿，但是小心她可能会因为你多事儿而大发雷霆。

examples.text: I must learn to bite my lip...
examples.translation: 我必须学会不乱说话。

examples.text: He bit his tongue as he found himself on the point of saying 'follow that car'.
examples.translation: 他想说“跟上那辆车”，话到嘴边又咽了回去。

examples.text: Local taxes are going to be taking a bigger bite out of people's income than they ever have before.
examples.translation: 地方税收在人们收入中的比重将超过以往任何时候。

meanings.meaning: [计] 比特（二进位制信息单位）；少量；马嚼子；辅币；老一套
咬（bite的过去式和过去分词）

examples.text: All it required was a bit of work...
examples.translation: 这事儿只需稍费工夫就可以了。

examples.text: I got paid a little bit of money.
examples.translation: 我只领到了一点点钱。

examples.text: This girl was a bit strange...
examples.translation: 这个女孩有点儿古怪。

examples.text: I think people feel a bit more confident...
examples.translation: 我想人们应该觉得稍微自信了一点儿。

examples.text: She looks a bit like his cousin Maureen...
examples.translation: 她长得有点儿像他表姐莫琳。

examples.text: That sounds a bit technical...
examples.translation: 那听起来有点儿专业。

examples.text: Isn't that a bit harsh?
examples.translation: 那不是有些太残酷了吗？

examples.text: It's all a bit of a mess...
examples.translation: 有点儿乱七八糟。

examples.text: Students have always been portrayed as a bit of a joke...
examples.translation: 学生们总是被描述为有点儿可笑的人。

examples.text: This comes as a bit of a disappointment.
examples.translation: 这有点儿让人失望。

examples.text: They're worth quite a bit of money...
examples.translation: 它们值不少钱。

examples.text: Things have changed quite a bit...
examples.translation: 情况发生了相当大的变化。

examples.text: He's quite a bit older than me.
examples.translation: 他的年纪比我大不少。

examples.text: I still think I have a bit more to offer...
examples.translation: 我还是认为我能再稍微多付出一点儿。

examples.text: Maybe we'll hear a little bit less noise.
examples.translation: 也许我们听到的噪音会稍微少一点儿。

examples.text: ...a bit more than half the total official debt.
examples.translation: 略微超过官方债务总额的一半

examples.text: Let's wait a bit...
examples.translation: 我们等一会儿吧。

examples.text: I hope there will be time to talk a bit...
examples.translation: 我希望能有时间谈一谈。

examples.text: That should keep you busy for a bit.
examples.translation: 那件事会让你忙上一小阵子。

examples.text: That's the bit of the meeting that I missed...
examples.translation: 那就是会议上我错过的那一小段。

examples.text: Now comes the really important bit...
examples.translation: 下面是非常重要的部分。

examples.text: The best bit was walking along the glacier.
examples.translation: 最好的部分就是沿着冰川走。

examples.text: Only a bit of string looped round a nail in the doorpost held it shut.
examples.translation: 仅仅是靠缠在门柱钉子上的一小段细绳把门关紧。

examples.text: ...crumpled bits of paper.
examples.translation: 皱皱巴巴的小纸片

examples.text: There was one bit of vital evidence which helped win the case...
examples.translation: 一个关键的证据帮助打赢了这场官司。

examples.text: Not one single bit of work has been started towards the repair of this road.
examples.translation: 这条路的修缮工作一丁点儿都还没开始。

examples.text: Bit by bit I began to understand what they were trying to do.
examples.translation: 我逐渐明白了他们想要干什么。

examples.text: I expect you're champing at the bit, so we'll get things going as soon as we can.
examples.translation: 我希望你努力打开局面，这样我们就能尽快把事情做起来。

examples.text: Marcie always tried to do her bit.
examples.translation: 玛茜总是努力尽一份力。

examples.text: My dinner jacket is every bit as good as his.
examples.translation: 我的晚礼服和他的一样好。

examples.text: It's a bit much expecting me to dump your boyfriend for you.
examples.translation: 指望我替你甩掉你的男朋友，有点儿过分了吧？

examples.text: I'm really not a bit surprised...
examples.translation: 我真的一点儿也不觉得惊讶。

examples.text: 'Are you disappointed?'—'Not a bit.'
examples.translation: “你失望了吗？”——“一点儿也不。”

examples.text: Did he give up? Not a bit of it!
examples.translation: 他放弃了吗？根本没有！

examples.text: She found a pretty yellow jug smashed to bits.
examples.translation: 她发现一个漂亮的黄色小罐被摔得粉碎。

meanings.meaning: 使变黑；把鞋油等涂在…上；把（眼眶）打成青肿
(Black)人名；(英、西)布莱克；(德、葡、捷)布拉克

examples.text: She was wearing a black coat with a white collar...
examples.translation: 她穿着一件白领黑外套。

examples.text: He had thick black hair...
examples.translation: 他的头发乌黑浓密。

examples.text: I wear a lot of black...
examples.translation: 我经常穿黑色衣服。

examples.text: He was dressed all in black.
examples.translation: 他一袭黑衣装束。

examples.text: He worked for the rights of black people...
examples.translation: 他为争取黑人权利而工作。

examples.text: Sherry is black, tall, slender and soft-spoken.
examples.translation: 谢里是个黑人，身材高挑，细声细语。

examples.text: ...the traditions of the black community.
examples.translation: 黑人社区的传统

examples.text: There are about thirty-one million blacks in the US.
examples.translation: 美国大约有3,100万黑人。

examples.text: A cup of black tea or black coffee contains no calories...
examples.translation: 一杯不加牛奶的茶或咖啡不含热量。

examples.text: I drink coffee black.
examples.translation: 我喝咖啡不加奶。

examples.text: It was, he said later, one of the blackest days of his political career...
examples.translation: 后来他说，这是他政治生涯中最黑暗的日子之一。

examples.text: The future for the industry looks even blacker.
examples.translation: 这个产业的前景看起来更加暗淡。

examples.text: In late 1975, she fell into a black depression...
examples.translation: 在1975年底，她陷入了情绪的低谷。

examples.text: Her mood was blacker than ever.
examples.translation: 她的心情从未如此低落过。

examples.text: I think their crime is a blacker one than mere exploitation.
examples.translation: 我想他们的罪行比单纯的剥削更残忍。

examples.text: ...the blackest laws in the country's history.
examples.translation: 这个国家历史上最严酷的法律

examples.text: 'So you can all go over there and get shot,' he said, with the sort of black humour common among British troops here...
examples.translation: “所以你们都可以到那里去挨枪子儿，”他说道，口吻中透着这里英国部队惯用的黑色幽默。

examples.text: It's a black comedy of racial prejudice, mistaken identity and thwarted expectations.
examples.translation: 这是一个关于种族歧视、身份错位和期望落空的黑色喜剧。

examples.text: He was also alleged to have conducted black magic ceremonies...
examples.translation: 据称他还做了法。

examples.text: The King was unjustly accused of practising the black arts.
examples.translation: 国王被诬陷施行妖术。

examples.text: Her husband blacked her eye...
examples.translation: 她丈夫把她的眼睛打青了。

examples.text: Their mother was trying to hide her two blacked eyes.
examples.translation: 他们的母亲想遮住自己被打青的双眼。

examples.text: Whenever she refused, he'd beat her black and blue...
examples.translation: 只要她拒绝他，他就会把她打得青一块紫一块。

examples.text: Bud's nose was still black and blue.
examples.translation: 巴德的鼻子还是青一块紫一块的。

examples.text: Remington's operations in Japan are now in the black...
examples.translation: 雷明顿在日本的业务现在有盈利。

examples.text: Until his finances are in the black I don't want to get married.
examples.translation: 在他有银行存款之前，我不想和他结婚。

examples.text: Passing my stall, she cast black looks at the amount of stuff still unsold.
examples.translation: 她经过我的货摊的时候，怒气冲冲地看了几眼还没有卖出去的东西。

examples.text: Many of these tools have sharp blades, so be careful.
examples.translation: 这些工具中很多都有锋利的刀片，务必小心。

examples.text: The commission is expected to blame the army for many of the atrocities...
examples.translation: 委员会理应谴责军队的诸多暴行。

examples.text: Ms Carey appeared to blame her breakdown on EMI's punishing work schedule...
examples.translation: 凯丽女士似乎将她的精神崩溃归咎于百代唱片公司高度紧张的工作日程安排。

examples.text: If it wasn't Sam's fault, why was I blaming him?
examples.translation: 如果这不是萨姆的过错，为什么我要责怪他？

examples.text: Nothing could relieve my terrible sense of blame.
examples.translation: 什么都无法减轻我深深的自责感。

examples.text: Some of the blame for the miscarriage of justice must be borne by the solicitors...
examples.translation: 律师们应对误判负部分责任。

examples.text: The president put the blame squarely on his opponent.
examples.translation: 总统把责任完全推给了他的对手。

examples.text: I do not blame them for trying to make some money...
examples.translation: 我认为他们想赚一些钱也是情有可原的。

examples.text: He slammed the door and stormed off. I could hardly blame him.
examples.translation: 他砰的一声关上门，气呼呼地走了。也难怪他会这么做。

examples.text: If their forces were not involved, then who is to blame?...
examples.translation: 如果他们的部队没有介入，那么谁应该承担责任？

examples.text: The policy is partly to blame for causing the worst unemployment in Europe.
examples.translation: 欧洲出现了最严重的失业情况，这应当部分归咎于这项政策。

examples.text: My life is ruined and I suppose I only have myself to blame.
examples.translation: 我的一生都毁了，我想这只能怪我自己。

meanings.meaning: 毛毯，毯子；毯状物，覆盖层
总括的，全体的；没有限制的

examples.text: The mud disappeared under a blanket of snow...
examples.translation: 泥巴被积雪盖住了。

examples.text: Cold damp air brought in the new year under a blanket of fog.
examples.translation: 厚厚的一层雾伴着阴冷潮湿的空气迎来了新的一年。

examples.text: It seems as if the blanket of depression is in some way necessary to help them blot out the even greater pain of real life...
examples.translation: 似乎这种弥漫的抑郁情绪多少能帮助他们忘却一些现实生活中更大的痛苦。

examples.text: A blanket of silence descended.
examples.translation: 大家都沉默不语。

examples.text: More than a foot of snow blanketed parts of Michigan...
examples.translation: 密歇根州的部分地区被超过一英尺厚的积雪所覆盖。

examples.text: With a thick mist now blanketing the trees, I got thoroughly lost.
examples.translation: 此时浓雾笼罩着林木，我彻底迷路了。

examples.text: There's already a blanket ban on foreign unskilled labour in Japan.
examples.translation: 日本已经全面禁止国外非熟练工入境。

examples.text: ...the blanket coverage of the Barcelona Olympics.
examples.translation: 对巴塞罗那奥运会的全面报道

meanings.meaning: (Blank)人名；(法)布朗克；(英、德、西、俄、罗、捷、瑞典、芬)布兰克

examples.text: We could put some of the pictures over on that blank wall over there...
examples.translation: 我们可以把一些图画贴在那边的空白墙壁上。

examples.text: He tore a blank page from his notebook.
examples.translation: 他从他的笔记本上撕下一页空白纸。

examples.text: ...blank cassettes.
examples.translation: 空白磁带

examples.text: Put a word in each blank to complete the sentence.
examples.translation: 每个空格填上一个单词，把句子补充完整。

examples.text: Abbot looked blank. 'I don't quite follow, sir.'...
examples.translation: 阿博特一脸茫然。“我没听明白，先生。”

examples.text: His daughter gave him a blank look.
examples.translation: 他女儿漠然地看了他一眼。

examples.text: She stared at him blankly.
examples.translation: 她面无表情地凝视着他。

examples.text: His eyes have the blankness of someone half-asleep.
examples.translation: 他的眼睛透着茫然，一副半睡半醒的样子。

examples.text: I'm sorry, but my mind is a blank...
examples.translation: 对不起，我脑子里一片空白。

examples.text: I came round in hospital and did not know where I was. Everything was a complete blank.
examples.translation: 我在医院里醒了过来，不知道自己身在何处。一切都是空白。

examples.text: ...a starter pistol which only fires blanks.
examples.translation: 只发射空包弹的发令枪

examples.text: They drew a blank in their search for the driver.
examples.translation: 他们四处寻找那个司机，但一无所获。

examples.text: My mind went totally blank.
examples.translation: 我的脑子突然一片空白。

meanings.meaning: 阴冷的；荒凉的，无遮蔽的；黯淡的，无希望的；冷酷的；单调的

examples.text: The immediate outlook remains bleak...
examples.translation: 近期前景依然暗淡。

examples.text: Many predicted a bleak future.
examples.translation: 很多人都预测前景暗淡。

examples.text: The continued bleakness of the American job market was blamed.
examples.translation: 美国就业市场的持续低迷被视为罪魁祸首。

examples.text: The island's pretty bleak.
examples.translation: 这座岛屿一片荒凉。

examples.text: ...bleak inner-city streets.
examples.translation: 凄清的旧城区街道

examples.text: The weather can be quite bleak on the coast.
examples.translation: 沿海地区的天气会非常阴冷。

examples.text: His face was bleak...
examples.translation: 他脸色阴郁。

examples.text: Alberg gave him a bleak stare.
examples.translation: 阿尔伯格沮丧地凝视着他。

meanings.meaning: 在树皮上刻路标；公开宣布
火焰，烈火；光辉；情感爆发

examples.text: Three people died as wreckage blazed, and rescuers fought to release trapped drivers...
examples.translation: 汽车残骸熊熊燃烧，三人葬身火海，救援人员奋力解救被困的司机们。

examples.text: The log fire was blazing merrily.
examples.translation: 木柴烧得正旺。

examples.text: ...a blazing fire.
examples.translation: 熊熊燃烧的大火

examples.text: Two firemen were hurt in a blaze which swept through a tower block last night.
examples.translation: 昨晚，一场大火吞噬了一座高层建筑，两位消防员被烧伤。

examples.text: The gardens blazed with colour.
examples.translation: 花园色彩绚丽。

examples.text: I wanted the front garden to be a blaze of colour.
examples.translation: 我想让门前的花园变得五彩缤纷。

examples.text: He got to his feet and his dark eyes were blazing with anger...
examples.translation: 他站起身来，乌黑的眼睛里喷射着怒火。

examples.text: Eva stood up and indignation blazed in her eyes...
examples.translation: 伊娃站了起来，眼睛里燃烧着愤怒。

examples.text: His eyes blazed intently into mine...
examples.translation: 他凝视着我的眼睛。

examples.text: Miss Turner turned blazing eyes on the victim.
examples.translation: 特纳小姐无比同情地看着受害者。

examples.text: He was arrested in a blaze of publicity.
examples.translation: 他在铺天盖地的报道中被捕了。

examples.text: ...the sporting career that began in a blaze of glory.
examples.translation: 在一片荣耀中开始的体育生涯

examples.text: Guns were blazing, flares going up and the sky was lit up all around...
examples.translation: 炮火不断，信号弹此起彼伏，四周的天空都被照亮了。

examples.text: She took the gun and blazed away with calm and deadly accuracy.
examples.translation: 她拿起枪，冷静地连续射击，弹无虚发。

examples.text: These surgeons have blazed the trail in the treatment of bomb victims.
examples.translation: 这些外科医生在治疗炸伤方面开辟了新的道路。

examples.text: His head had struck the sink and was bleeding...
examples.translation: 他的头撞到了水槽上，正在流血。

examples.text: He was bleeding profusely...
examples.translation: 他在大出血。

examples.text: She's going to bleed to death!
examples.translation: 她会流血而死！

examples.text: This results in internal bleeding.
examples.translation: 这导致了内出血。

examples.text: The colouring pigments from the skins are not allowed to bleed into the grape juice.
examples.translation: 外皮上的色素不能渗到葡萄汁里面去。

examples.text: We have been gradually bled for twelve years...
examples.translation: 我们被一点一滴地压榨了12年。

examples.text: They mean to bleed the British to the utmost.
examples.translation: 他们要最大限度地榨取英国人的财富。

examples.text: The war has bled the once-strong Armenian economy dry.
examples.translation: 战争榨干了原本繁荣的亚美尼亚经济。

examples.text: 250 people were killed in the blast.
examples.translation: 250人在这次爆炸中丧生。

examples.text: There is a risk that toxic chemicals might be blasted into the atmosphere.
examples.translation: 爆炸后有毒化学物质可能会进入大气层。

examples.text: ...a terrible accident in which his left arm was blasted off by some kind of a bomb...
examples.translation: 他的左臂被某种炸弹炸飞的可怕事故

examples.text: Earlier two holes were blasted into the ship's hull to let water out and stabilise the ferry...
examples.translation: 之前在船体上炸出了两个洞，以便把水排出，使船平稳下来。

examples.text: The explosion which followed blasted out the external supporting wall of her flat.
examples.translation: 接下来的爆炸毁坏了她公寓的外支撑墙。

examples.text: Their work was taken up with boring and blasting rock with gelignite...
examples.translation: 他们的工作是用葛里炸药炸石头，非常枯燥。

examples.text: They're using dynamite to blast away rocks to put a road in.
examples.translation: 他们用炸药炸石筑路。

examples.text: Three miles away there was a salvo of blasting in the quarry.
examples.translation: 三英里之外的采石场进行了爆破作业。

examples.text: ...a son who blasted his father to death after a lifetime of bullying...
examples.translation: 因从小到大一直被父亲虐待而开枪弑父的男子

examples.text: Alan Barnett, 28, was blasted with a sawn-off shotgun in Oldham on Thursday.
examples.translation: 28岁的艾伦·巴尼特于星期四在奥德姆被人用短管猎枪射杀。

examples.text: ...the man who killed Nigel Davies with a shotgun blast.
examples.translation: 用猎枪打死奈杰尔·戴维斯的男子

examples.text: The police were reported to have blasted their way into the house using explosives...
examples.translation: 据报道，警方借助爆破冲进了房子。

examples.text: One armoured column attempted to blast a path through a barricade of buses and trucks.
examples.translation: 一个武装纵队试图从公交车和卡车组成的路障中间炸出一条通道来。

examples.text: Blasting cold air over it makes the water evaporate...
examples.translation: 向它喷射冷空气可以使水蒸发。

examples.text: A blizzard was blasting great drifts of snow across the lake.
examples.translation: 暴风雪夹着大团的积雪吹过湖面。

examples.text: Blasts of cold air swept down from the mountains.
examples.translation: 强冷气流从山上疾掠而下。

examples.text: ...drivers who do not blast their horns...
examples.translation: 不按喇叭的司机

examples.text: The sound of western music blasted as she entered.
examples.translation: 她一进门便听到西部音乐震天的响声。

examples.text: The buzzer suddenly responded in a long blast of sound.
examples.translation: 蜂鸣器突然相应地发出了一声响亮的长鸣。

examples.text: Ramsay blasted the ball into the back of the net...
examples.translation: 拉姆齐劲射入网。

examples.text: He may try to blast his way out of trouble, playing attacking shots to balls he would not normally contemplate hitting.
examples.translation: 他可能是想努力摆脱困境，平时不会考虑击打的球也打起了进攻。

examples.text: Football: Taylor blasts Beck...
examples.translation: 足球：泰勒炮轰贝克。

examples.text: The Department of Health and a top immunologist have blasted a report in last week's Sunday Times.
examples.translation: 卫生部和一位知名免疫学家严词抨击了上周《星期日泰晤士报》的一篇报道。

examples.text: Cricket: Blast for Ormrod.
examples.translation: 板球：炮轰奥姆罗德。

examples.text: Blast! I can't do anything with this.
examples.translation: 真该死！我拿这个一点办法也没有。

examples.text: Making the album was a real blast.
examples.translation: 做这个专辑真是一种乐趣。

examples.text: In many of those homes the television is on full blast 24 hours a day...
examples.translation: 那些家庭有很多一天24小时把电视开到最大音量。

examples.text: You are unlikely to run the heater at full blast for long periods.
examples.translation: 你不太可能长时间把加热器开到最大挡位。

examples.text: ...asking for all present to bless this couple and their loving commitment to one another.
examples.translation: 就让在场的所有人祝福这对夫妇以及他们对彼此爱的承诺

examples.text: 'Bless you, Eva,' he whispered...
examples.translation: “愿上帝保佑你，伊娃，”他低声说。

examples.text: God bless and thank you all so much.
examples.translation: 愿上帝保佑你们，非常感谢。

examples.text: Blend the butter with the sugar and beat until light and creamy...
examples.translation: 把糖掺入黄油然后搅拌至滑软细腻。

examples.text: Blend the ingredients until you have a smooth cream...
examples.translation: 将各种配料调和均匀做成乳脂。

examples.text: Put the soap and water in a pan and leave to stand until they have blended...
examples.translation: 将肥皂和水放入平底锅中不动，然后让它们溶成一体。

examples.text: Most whiskies are blended whiskies.
examples.translation: 大多数的威士忌都是调和而成的。

examples.text: The public areas offer a subtle blend of traditional charm with modern amenities.
examples.translation: 这些公共场所将传统魅力和现代设施巧妙地融合在了一起。

examples.text: ...a blend of wine and sparkling water...
examples.translation: 酒和汽水的混合饮料

examples.text: He makes up his own blends of flour.
examples.translation: 他自己和了一些面粉。

examples.text: You could paint the walls and ceilings the same colour so they blend together.
examples.translation: 你可以把墙和天花板粉刷成同一种颜色，这样看上去浑然一体。

examples.text: ...the picture, furniture and porcelain collections that blend so well with the house itself.
examples.translation: 与房间本身非常搭调的图画、家具和瓷器收藏品

examples.text: His 'cosmic vision' is to blend Christianity with 'the wisdom of all world religions'.
examples.translation: 他的“远大设想”就是将基督教和“全世界所有宗教的智慧”融为一体。

examples.text: ...a band that blended jazz, folk and classical music.
examples.translation: 将爵士乐、民乐以及古典乐糅合在一起的乐队

meanings.meaning: 血腥的；非常的；嗜杀的，残忍的；血色的

examples.text: Forty-three demonstrators were killed in bloody clashes...
examples.translation: 43名示威者在流血冲突中丧生。

examples.text: They came to power in 1975 after a bloody civil war.
examples.translation: 在一场腥风血雨的内战之后，他们于1975年上台执政。

examples.text: Rebellions in the area were bloodily repressed by pro-government forces.
examples.translation: 这个地区的叛乱遭到了亲政府军队的血腥镇压。

examples.text: He was arrested last October still carrying a bloody knife...
examples.translation: 去年10月他被捕时，身上还带着一把血迹斑斑的刀。

examples.text: Yulka's fingers were bloody and cracked.
examples.translation: 尤尔卡的手指折断了，鲜血直流。

examples.text: The soldier reeled bloodily away.
examples.translation: 这名士兵浑身是血，踉跄而去。

examples.text: One of our children fell and bloodied his knee...
examples.translation: 我们的一个孩子跌倒了，膝盖磕破了。

examples.text: She stared at her own bloodied hands, unable to think or move.
examples.translation: 她盯着自己流血的双手，呆呆地愣住了。

examples.text: She'd been bloodied in love...
examples.translation: 她在爱情上一度伤痕累累。

examples.text: The reinsurance market has been bloodied by disasters in the U.S.
examples.translation: 再保险市场因美国发生的灾难而遭受重创。

examples.text: There was Greek blood in his veins...
examples.translation: 他有希腊血统。

examples.text: He was of noble blood, and an officer.
examples.translation: 他出身贵族，是一名军官。

examples.text: There is, it seems, some bad blood between Mills and the Baldwins.
examples.translation: 米尔斯和鲍德温一家人好像有些不和。

examples.text: And so what will he say to those who have been baying for his blood?
examples.translation: 那么，他又会对那些一直强烈要求制裁他的人说些什么呢？

examples.text: It makes my blood boil to think two thugs decided to pick on an innocent young girl.
examples.translation: 一想到两个暴徒要欺负一个天真的小姑娘，我就满腔怒火。

examples.text: The crime had been committed in cold blood.
examples.translation: 这一罪行极为残忍。

examples.text: The rage in his eyes made her blood run cold...
examples.translation: 他眼中的怒火吓得她汗毛倒竖。

examples.text: He could hear a sudden roaring. His blood froze.
examples.translation: 他听到突如其来的一声吼叫，吓得魂不附体。

examples.text: He has my son's blood on his hands. I hope it haunts him for the rest of his days.
examples.translation: 他手上沾了我儿子的血。我咒他余生不得安宁。

examples.text: Diplomacy was in his blood: his ancestors had been feudal lords...
examples.translation: 他天生擅长交际：他的祖先曾是封建领主。

examples.text: He has adventure in his blood.
examples.translation: 他天生具备冒险基因。

examples.text: There's been a major reshuffle of the cabinet to bring in new blood...
examples.translation: 内阁进行了重大改组，吸收了一些新鲜血液。

examples.text: The England selectors must start introducing young blood.
examples.translation: 英格兰队的人才选拔委员会必须着手引入一些新生力量。

examples.text: I had to sweat blood for an M.A.
examples.translation: 我得拼命争取获得硕士学位。

examples.text: The home side drew first blood with a penalty from Murray Strang.
examples.translation: 主场球队依靠默里·斯特朗的罚球而旗开得胜。

examples.text: Why do apparently sane people go through all the blood, sweat, tears and heartache involved in getting a PhD?
examples.translation: 为什么那些看起来神志正常的人会拼了命地要拿到一个博士学位？

examples.text: Families have their problems and jealousies, but blood is thicker than water.
examples.translation: 家家有本难念的经，也都难免互生嫉妒，但总归血浓于水。

examples.text: I started helping him run the business when he went blind...
examples.translation: 他失明以后，我就开始帮他打理生意。

examples.text: How would you explain colour to a blind person?
examples.translation: 你如何向盲人解释颜色？

examples.text: He was a teacher of the blind.
examples.translation: 他曾教过盲人。

examples.text: Early diagnosis and treatment can usually prevent blindness.
examples.translation: 早期的诊断和治疗通常可以预防失明。

examples.text: The sun hit the windscreen, momentarily blinding him.
examples.translation: 太阳照在挡风玻璃上，晃得他一时看不见东西。

examples.text: Her mother groped for the back of the chair, her eyes blind with tears.
examples.translation: 她妈妈泪眼蒙眬地伸手去摸椅背。

examples.text: Lettie groped blindly for the glass.
examples.translation: 莱蒂摸索着找杯子。

examples.text: David's good looks and impeccable manners had always made her blind to his faults...
examples.translation: 戴维英俊的长相和完美的举止总是让她对他的缺点视而不见。

examples.text: All the time I was blind to your suffering.
examples.translation: 一直以来，我都没有意识到你遭受的痛苦。

examples.text: ...blindness in government policy to the very existence of the unemployed.
examples.translation: 政府政策对失业者基本生存问题的漠视

examples.text: He never allowed his love of Australia to blind him to his countrymen's faults.
examples.translation: 他从来不会因为对澳大利亚的热爱而看不到自己同胞的缺点。

examples.text: ...her blind faith in the wisdom of the Church...
examples.translation: 她对教会智慧的盲目信仰

examples.text: Lesley yelled at him with blind, hating rage.
examples.translation: 莱斯莉心生愤恨，盛怒之下对他大嚷大叫。

examples.text: He tried to overtake three cars on a blind corner and crashed head-on into a lorry.
examples.translation: 他试图在一个死角处超过前面的三辆车，结果一头撞在了一辆卡车上。

examples.text: I remembered a huddle of stone buildings with blind walls.
examples.translation: 我记得一片没有窗户的石头建筑。

examples.text: Teachers are turning a blind eye to pupils smoking at school, a report reveals today...
examples.translation: 今日一篇报道称，老师们对学生在学校抽烟睁一只眼闭一只眼。

examples.text: I can't turn a blind eye when someone is being robbed.
examples.translation: 当有人遭到抢劫时，我不能视而不见。

examples.text: Now almost every woman also wears an underskirt, a blouse, underwear, shoes, some even stockings.

meanings.meaning: 花；开花期；兴旺期；花开的状态

examples.text: The cherry blossom came out early in Washington this year.
examples.translation: 今年华盛顿的樱花开得很早。

examples.text: ...the blossoms of plants, shrubs and trees.
examples.translation: 草木的花

examples.text: Why do some people take longer than others to blossom?...
examples.translation: 为什么有的人比他人大器晚成？

examples.text: What began as a local festival has blossomed into an international event.
examples.translation: 最初的地方节日已经发展成了国际性盛会。

examples.text: ...the blossoming relationship between Israel and Eastern Europe.
examples.translation: 以色列和东欧国家之间日益良好的关系

examples.text: ...the blossoming of British art, pop and fashion.
examples.translation: 英国艺术、流行乐和时装业的兴盛

examples.text: Rain begins to fall and peach trees blossom.
examples.translation: 开始下雨了，桃树也开花了。

meanings.meaning: (Bloom)人名；(瑞典、西)布洛姆；(英)布卢姆

examples.text: ...the sweet fragrance of the white blooms...
examples.translation: 白色花朵的芳香

examples.text: Harry carefully picked the bloom.
examples.translation: 哈里小心翼翼地摘下那朵花。

examples.text: ...a pink climbing rose in full bloom.
examples.translation: 盛开的粉色藤蔓玫瑰

examples.text: ...the sweet smell of the blackberry in bloom.
examples.translation: 绽放的黑莓花的芬芳

examples.text: This plant blooms between May and June.
examples.translation: 这种植物在5月至6月间开花。

examples.text: ...the scent of night-blooming flowers.
examples.translation: 夜间开放的花的香味

examples.text: Not many economies bloomed in 1990, least of all gold exporters like Australia...
examples.translation: 1990年经济繁荣的国家并不多，尤其是像澳大利亚这样的黄金出口国。

examples.text: She bloomed into an utterly beautiful creature.
examples.translation: 她出落得亭亭玉立。

examples.text: The skin loses its youthful bloom.
examples.translation: 皮肤失去了年轻时的光泽。

examples.text: The country's president will offer delegates his blueprint for the country's future.
examples.translation: 该国总统会向代表们展示他构想的国家未来发展的蓝图。

examples.text: ...the blueprint of a new plan of economic reform.
examples.translation: 有关经济改革新计划的设想

examples.text: ...a blueprint of the whole place, complete with heating ducts and wiring...
examples.translation: 整个地方的规划图，包括暖气管和布线

examples.text: The documents contain a blueprint for a nuclear device.
examples.translation: 文件内附有一张核装置的设计蓝图。

examples.text: The offspring contain a mixture of the genetic blueprint of each parent...
examples.translation: 子女身上遗传了父母双方的基因型板。

examples.text: DNA is the genetic material inside every cell that carries the blueprints for everything from hair color to the risk of cancer.
examples.translation: 脱氧核糖核酸是存在于每个细胞内的基因物质，它承载从头发颜色到致癌风险等各种遗传型板。

examples.text: I think he made a tactical blunder by announcing it so far ahead of time.
examples.translation: 我认为他在时机远未成熟时就把这事说了出去是一种失策。

examples.text: No doubt I had blundered again...
examples.translation: 无疑，我又犯了一个愚蠢的错误。

examples.text: You're a blundering fool.
examples.translation: 你是一个大笨蛋。

examples.text: People wanted to know how they had blundered into war, and how to avoid it in future.
examples.translation: 人们想知道他们是怎样稀里糊涂地陷入战争的，以及日后该如何避免重蹈覆辙。

examples.text: He had blundered into the table, upsetting the flowers.
examples.translation: 他不小心撞到了桌子，把花打翻了。

meanings.meaning: 蓝色；[复数]（美国海、陆、空三军穿的）蓝色制服；蓝颜料；[the blue(s)][用作单数或复数]布鲁斯（歌曲）（一种伤感的美国黑人民歌
蓝色的；沮丧的，忧郁的；下流的
把…染成蓝色；使成蓝色；给…用上蓝剂；用上蓝剂于

examples.text: There were swallows in the cloudless blue sky...
examples.translation: 燕子在万里无云的蓝天飞翔。

examples.text: She fixed her pale blue eyes on her father's.
examples.translation: 她淡蓝色的眼睛紧紧盯着她父亲的双眼。

examples.text: ...colourful blues and reds.
examples.translation: 绚丽的蓝色和红色

examples.text: His singing really does have the depth and the emotional range of the blues.
examples.translation: 他的歌声确实颇有布鲁斯音乐的内蕴和情感深度。

examples.text: ...the blues bars of Chicago.
examples.translation: 芝加哥的蓝调酒吧

examples.text: Interfering in-laws are the prime sources of the blues.
examples.translation: 喜欢指手画脚的姻亲最让人头疼。

examples.text: There's no earthly reason for me to feel so blue.
examples.translation: 我也说不出来为什么这么沮丧。

examples.text: ...a secret stash of porn mags and blue movies.
examples.translation: 偷偷藏起来的一堆色情杂志和黄色影碟

examples.text: One of them wrote to us out of the blue several years later.
examples.translation: 数年后他们中的一人突然给我们写了一封信。

meanings.meaning: 钝的，不锋利的；生硬的；直率的

examples.text: She is blunt about her personal life...
examples.translation: 她对自己的私生活直言不讳。

examples.text: She told the industry in blunt terms that such discrimination is totally unacceptable.
examples.translation: 她直截了当地告诉业界，这种歧视是完全无法接受的。

examples.text: 'I don't believe you!' Jeanne said bluntly...
examples.translation: “我不相信你！”珍妮毫不客气地说。

examples.text: To put it bluntly, he became a pain.
examples.translation: 坦白地说，他成了个令人头疼的人。

examples.text: His bluntness got him into trouble.
examples.translation: 他的耿直给他带来了麻烦。

examples.text: One of them had been struck 13 times over the head with a blunt object.
examples.translation: 他们中有一个人的头部被钝器击打13次。

examples.text: The constant repetition of violence has blunted the human response to it...
examples.translation: 反复出现的暴力事件使人们的反应都变得麻木了。

examples.text: Our appetite was blunted by the beer.
examples.translation: 喝啤酒让我们没有了胃口。

meanings.meaning: 成批的，大块的；交通堵塞的
(Block)人名；(英、法、德、西、葡、芬、罗)布洛克

examples.text: ...blocks of council flats.
examples.translation: 一栋栋市政公寓大楼

examples.text: ...a white-painted apartment block.
examples.translation: 一栋漆成白色的公寓大楼

examples.text: She walked four blocks down High Street...
examples.translation: 她沿着商业大街走了4个街区。

examples.text: He walked around the block three times.
examples.translation: 他绕着这个街区转了3圈。

examples.text: ...a block of ice.
examples.translation: 一大块冰

examples.text: Some students today blocked a highway that cuts through the center of the city...
examples.translation: 今天一些学生堵塞了一条贯穿市中心的公路。

examples.text: When the shrimp farm is built it will block the stream...
examples.translation: 一旦养虾场建起来，将会截断这条河流。

examples.text: He can clear blocked drains.
examples.translation: 他能清理堵塞的排水沟。

examples.text: ...a row of spruce trees that blocked his view of the long north slope of the mountain.
examples.translation: 一排云杉挡住了他的视线，使他看不到这座山绵长的北坡

examples.text: I started to move round him, but he blocked my way...
examples.translation: 我准备绕过他，但他挡住了我。

examples.text: Mr Calder tried to leave the shop but the police officer blocked his path.
examples.translation: 考尔德先生想离开商店，但是那位警员拦住了他。

examples.text: For years the country has tried to block imports of various cheap foreign products...
examples.translation: 多年来，这个国家一直竭力阻挠各种廉价外国产品的进口。

examples.text: His persistent attempts to complain to his superiors were blocked and ignored.
examples.translation: 他一再试图向上级投诉，但都被挡了回来并置之不理。

examples.text: In the final seconds, Gunn goalie Kevin Cantwell blocked two shots.
examples.translation: 在最后的几秒钟，甘恩队的守门员凯文·坎特维尔扑出了两次射门。

examples.text: Those booking a block of seats get them at reduced rates.
examples.translation: 团体订座可享受折扣价。

examples.text: The Chancellor, by his unusual statement, has put his head on the block.
examples.translation: 这位总理冒着丢乌纱帽的风险发表了一份非同寻常的声明。

examples.text: A chill wind blew at the top of the hill...
examples.translation: 山顶寒风呼啸。

examples.text: We woke to find a gale blowing outside.
examples.translation: 我们醒来时发现外面狂风大作。

examples.text: The wind blew her hair back from her forehead...
examples.translation: 风把她前额上的头发吹到了后面。

examples.text: Strong winds blew away most of the dust...
examples.translation: 大风卷走了大部分的尘土。

examples.text: Her cap fell off in the street and blew away...
examples.translation: 她的帽子掉在大街上，被风吹走了。

examples.text: Sand blew in our eyes...
examples.translation: 沙子吹进了我们的眼睛里。

examples.text: The bushes and trees were blowing in the wind.
examples.translation: 灌木丛和树木在风中摇晃。

examples.text: Danny rubbed his arms and blew on his fingers to warm them...
examples.translation: 丹尼搓着胳膊并向手指上哈气取暖。

examples.text: Take a deep breath and blow.
examples.translation: 深呼吸，吐气。

examples.text: He picked up his mug and blew off the steam.
examples.translation: 他端起杯子，吹走了热气。

examples.text: He blew a ring of blue smoke.
examples.translation: 他吐出了蓝色的烟圈。

examples.text: The whistle blew and the train slid forward...
examples.translation: 汽笛鸣响，火车向前滑动。

examples.text: A guard was blowing his whistle.
examples.translation: 一个警卫正在吹警笛。

examples.text: He took out a handkerchief and blew his nose.
examples.translation: 他掏出一块手帕，擤了擤鼻子。

examples.text: The can exploded, wrecking the kitchen and bathroom and blowing out windows...
examples.translation: 罐子爆炸了，不但炸毁了厨房和浴室，还把窗户炸飞了。

examples.text: Rival gunmen blew the city to bits.
examples.translation: 敌人把这座城市炸成了一片废墟。

examples.text: The dramatic World Motor Sports Council meeting in Paris blew the championship wide open as Schumacher was also docked six points...
examples.translation: 在巴黎召开的令人瞩目的世界汽车运动理事会会议使冠军归属充满各种可能，因为舒马赫也被扣了6分。

examples.text: Someone took an inappropriate use of words on my part and tried to blow it into a major controversy.
examples.translation: 有人不适当地引用我的话，想借此把事情闹大。

examples.text: Before you blow it all on a luxury cruise, give a little thought to the future...
examples.translation: 在把钱全砸到一趟海上豪华游之前，多少考虑一下日后怎么办。

examples.text: My brother lent me some money and I went and blew the lot.
examples.translation: 我兄弟借给我一些钱，全被我拿去挥霍了。

examples.text: He has almost certainly blown his chance of touring India this winter.
examples.translation: 他几乎肯定失去了今冬去印度旅行的机会。

examples.text: ...the high-risk world of real estate, where one careless word could blow a whole deal...
examples.translation: 一字不慎就可能会断送整笔交易的高风险的房地产业

examples.text: Oh you fool! You've blown it!
examples.translation: 哦，你这个笨蛋！都让你搞砸了！

examples.text: The fuse blew as he pressed the button.
examples.translation: 他刚一按下按钮，保险丝就烧断了。

examples.text: A lorry blew a tyre and careered into them...
examples.translation: 一辆货车爆胎了，向他们猛撞了过去。

examples.text: The car tyre blew.
examples.translation: 这辆车爆胎了。

examples.text: A tyre blew out when the coach was on its way.
examples.translation: 长途汽车在半路上爆胎了。

examples.text: Hollywood cameramen have good reason to blow their own trumpets.
examples.translation: 好莱坞的摄影师们有足够的理由可以自我吹嘘。

examples.text: He went off to hospital after a blow to the face.
examples.translation: 他脸部受到重击之后就去了医院。

examples.text: When the marriage finally broke up it was obviously a terrible blow to Soames...
examples.translation: 婚姻的最终破裂对索姆斯显然是一个沉重打击。

examples.text: That ruling comes as a blow to environmentalists...
examples.translation: 那项裁决对环境保护论者来说如同一记闷棍。

examples.text: His death dealt a severe blow to the army's morale.
examples.translation: 他的死严重打击了军队的士气。

examples.text: The representatives almost came to blows at a meeting.
examples.translation: 代表们在一次会议上差点动起手来。

examples.text: Senator Sarbanes expressed concern that programs designed to soften the blow of unemployment are not working well.
examples.translation: 旨在缓解失业冲击的项目进展得并不太顺利，参议员萨班斯对此表示关切。

examples.text: The team struck a blow for women's rights by winning the match.
examples.translation: 这个小组在比赛中获胜，维护了女性的权利。

examples.text: 'Hello, Maria,' he said, and she blushed again...
examples.translation: “你好，玛丽亚，”他说，这让她脸上又泛起了红晕。

examples.text: I blushed scarlet at my stupidity.
examples.translation: 我为自己的愚蠢羞愧得满脸通红。

examples.text: 'The most important thing is to be honest,' she says, without the trace of a blush.
examples.translation: “最重要的是要诚实，”她毫不脸红地说。

examples.text: 'We don't want to name the man to spare his blushes,' said a police spokesman.
examples.translation: “为了不让当事人颜面扫地，我们就不指名道姓了，”一位警方发言人说道。

meanings.meaning: 涂污；使…模糊不清；使暗淡；玷污

examples.text: Out of the corner of my eye I saw a blur of movement on the other side of the glass...
examples.translation: 从眼角余光中我看到玻璃的另一边隐约有东西在移动。

examples.text: Her face is a blur.
examples.translation: 她的脸模糊不清。

examples.text: This creates a spectrum of colours at the edges of objects which blurs the image...
examples.translation: 这在物体的边缘形成了一道色谱，使图像变得模糊不清。

examples.text: If you move your eyes and your head, the picture will blur.
examples.translation: 如果你的眼睛或头动了，图像就会变得模糊不清。

examples.text: ...blurred black and white photographs.
examples.translation: 模糊不清的黑白照片

examples.text: ...her belief that scientists are trying to blur the distinction between 'how' and 'why' questions...
examples.translation: 她认为科学家们试图模糊“如何”和“为什么”这两类问题之间的区别

examples.text: The evidence is blurred by central banks' reluctance to reveal their blunders.
examples.translation: 由于中央银行不愿意公开自己的愚蠢错误，证据并不清楚。

examples.text: The line between fact and fiction is becoming blurred.
examples.translation: 事实和虚构之间的界限正变得模糊起来。

examples.text: Her eyes, behind her glasses, began to blur...
examples.translation: 她藏在眼镜后面的双眼变得模糊起来。

examples.text: Sweat ran from his forehead into his eyes, blurring his vision.
examples.translation: 汗水从额头流到了眼睛里，模糊了他的视线。

examples.text: ...visual disturbances like eye-strain and blurred vision.
examples.translation: 像视觉疲劳和视野模糊这样的视觉障碍

meanings.meaning: 夸口说，自吹自擂说；以有…而自豪
自夸；值得夸耀的事物，引以为荣的事物

examples.text: Witnesses said Furci boasted that he took part in killing them...
examples.translation: 几位证人声称富尔奇曾吹嘘自己参与了对他们的屠杀。

examples.text: Carol boasted about her costume...
examples.translation: 卡萝尔炫耀着自己的穿着打扮。

examples.text: He's boasted of being involved in the arms theft...
examples.translation: 他吹嘘自己参与过盗窃军火的行动。

examples.text: We remember our mother's stern instructions not to boast.
examples.translation: 我们谨记母亲不许我们在人前炫耀的严厉教诲。

examples.text: It is the charity's proud boast that it has never yet turned anyone away...
examples.translation: 该慈善机构从未将任何人拒之门外，并引以为豪。

examples.text: He was asked about earlier boasts of a quick victory.
examples.translation: 有人质问他早先说过的那些速战速决的大话。

examples.text: The houses will boast the latest energy-saving technology...
examples.translation: 这些房屋将应用最新的节能技术。

examples.text: Frommen says his country boasts a healthy economy.
examples.translation: 弗罗曼称他的国家经济运行良好。

examples.text: One of the best ways to see the area is in a small boat...
examples.translation: 游览该地区的一个最好方式是乘坐小船。

examples.text: The island may be reached by boat from the mainland.
examples.translation: 这个岛屿可以从大陆乘小船到达。

examples.text: When the boat reached Cape Town, we said a temporary goodbye.
examples.translation: 客轮到达开普敦时，我们暂时分别。

examples.text: I earn enough to push the boat out now and again.
examples.translation: 我挣的钱足以时不时摆摆阔了。

examples.text: I said I didn't want to rock the boat in any way.
examples.translation: 我说过我根本不想挑事。

meanings.meaning: 上（飞机、车、船等）；用板盖上；给提供膳宿

examples.text: ...a chopping board.
examples.translation: 砧板

examples.text: ...a draughts board...
examples.translation: 跳棋棋盘

examples.text: Dr Tinsley had five pieces on the board against Chinook's four.
examples.translation: 廷斯利博士在棋盘上还有5枚棋子，对手钦诺克还有4枚。

examples.text: He wrote a few more notes on the board.
examples.translation: 他在黑板上又写了几条注释。

examples.text: The floor was draughty bare boards.
examples.translation: 地面铺的是透气性好的实木地板。

examples.text: Arthur wants to put his recommendation before the board at a meeting tomorrow.
examples.translation: 阿瑟希望在明天的会议上把自己的建议书提交董事会。

examples.text: ...the agenda for the September 12 board meeting.
examples.translation: 9月12日董事会议的议程

examples.text: The Scottish Tourist Board said 33,000 Japanese visited Scotland last year.
examples.translation: 苏格兰旅游局宣称去年有33,000名日本人到苏格兰旅游。

examples.text: ...the US National Transportation Safety Board.
examples.translation: 美国国家交通运输安全委员会

examples.text: I boarded the plane bound for England.
examples.translation: 我登上了飞往英格兰的飞机。

examples.text: Free room and board are provided for all hotel staff.
examples.translation: 宾馆的所有员工都可享受免费膳宿。

examples.text: All I knew about were Antony's own financial dealings, which were always above board.
examples.translation: 据我所知，安东尼经手的金融交易一直是公开透明的。

examples.text: There are hefty charges across the board for one-way rental...
examples.translation: 各处对单程租赁的收费都很高。

examples.text: The President promised across-the-board tax cuts if re-elected.
examples.translation: 总统许诺如果能再次当选将采取全面的减税措施。

examples.text: It's a case of not what you know but who you know in this world today and qualifications quite go by the board.
examples.translation: 在当今这个世界，重要的不是你知道什么而是你认识谁，能力才干根本派不上用场。

examples.text: They arrived at Gatwick airport on board a plane chartered by the Italian government...
examples.translation: 他们乘坐意大利政府的包机到达盖特威克机场。

examples.text: ...a naval task force with two thousand marines on board.
examples.translation: 由2,000名海军陆战队士兵组成的海军特遣队

examples.text: Spain swept the board in boys' team competitions.
examples.translation: 西班牙队在男子团体比赛中大获全胜。

examples.text: I hope that they will take on board some of what you have said.
examples.translation: 我希望他们能采纳你们所提出的部分想法。

examples.text: Half the shops are boarded up on the estate's small shopping street.
examples.translation: 在该住宅区的小型购物街上有一半商店都已封上了门窗。

examples.text: ...the boarded-up houses and the derelict factories of Merseyside.
examples.translation: 默西赛德郡封上门窗的房屋和废弃的工厂

meanings.meaning: 煮沸，烧开；使…激动；使…蒸发

examples.text: I stood in the kitchen, waiting for the water to boil...
examples.translation: 我站在厨房，等着水烧开。

examples.text: Boil the water in the saucepan and add the sage...
examples.translation: 把平底锅里的水烧开，然后加入鼠尾草。

examples.text: ...a saucepan of boiling water.
examples.translation: 一锅沸水

examples.text: He had nothing to do but boil the kettle and make the tea...
examples.translation: 他除了烧水沏茶以外无事可做。

examples.text: Marianne put the kettle on to boil.
examples.translation: 玛丽安娜放上水壶烧开水。

examples.text: Is the kettle boiling?
examples.translation: 壶里的水开了吗？

examples.text: Boil the chick peas, add garlic and lemon juice...
examples.translation: 把鹰嘴豆放在开水中煮，并加入大蒜和柠檬汁。

examples.text: I'd peel potatoes and put them on to boil.
examples.translation: 我要削掉土豆皮然后把它们煮熟。

examples.text: ...boiled eggs and toast.
examples.translation: 熟鸡蛋和吐司

examples.text: I used to be all sweetness and light on the outside, but inside I would be boiling with rage.
examples.translation: 我过去常常是外表看上去轻松愉快，而内心却怒火中烧。

examples.text: Put water, butter and lard into a saucepan and bring slowly to the boil.
examples.translation: 把水、黄油和猪油倒入平底锅，然后慢火煮沸。

meanings.meaning: 大胆的，英勇的；黑体的；厚颜无耻的；险峻的

examples.text: Amrita becomes a bold, daring rebel...
examples.translation: 阿姆里塔成了一个勇敢无畏的叛逆者。

examples.text: In 1960 this was a bold move...
examples.translation: 在1960年，这是一个大胆的举动。

examples.text: Poland was already making bold economic reforms.
examples.translation: 波兰已在大刀阔斧地进行经济改革。

examples.text: You can and must act boldly and confidently.
examples.translation: 你能够而且必须表现得勇敢和自信。
