examples.text: Don't forget the boldness of his economic programme.
examples.translation: 不要忘记他的经济方案非常大胆。

examples.text: I don't feel I'm being bold, because it's always been natural for me to just speak out about whatever disturbs me.
examples.translation: 我不觉得我有什么唐突，因为我素来心直口快，有什么烦心的都会说出来。

examples.text: 'You should do it,' the girl said, boldly.
examples.translation: “你应该做这件事，”女孩直言道。

examples.text: ...bold flowers in various shades of red, blue or white.
examples.translation: 色彩鲜艳、浓淡不一的红、蓝、白色花朵

examples.text: ...bold, dramatic colours.
examples.translation: 醒目生动的色彩

examples.text: The design is pretty startling and very boldly coloured.
examples.translation: 该设计颇出人意表，用色十分大胆。

examples.text: Each picture is shown in colour on one page and as a bold outline on the opposite page.
examples.translation: 每幅图片的彩样都单独印在一页上，而在该页的背面会映出清晰的轮廓。

meanings.meaning: 身体；主体；大量；团体；主要部分

examples.text: The largest organ in the body is the liver.
examples.translation: 人体最大的器官是肝脏。

examples.text: Lying flat on the floor, twist your body on to one hip and cross your upper leg over your body.
examples.translation: 平躺在地板上，屈体侧躺，把上面的一条腿搭在身上。

examples.text: Officials said they had found no traces of violence on the body of the politician.
examples.translation: 官员称他们没有在这位政治家的尸体上发现暴力侵犯的痕迹。

examples.text: ...the Chairman of the policemen's representative body, the Police Federation.
examples.translation: 警察的代表机构“警察协会”的主席

examples.text: ...the main trade union body, COSATU, Congress of South African Trade Unions.
examples.translation: 最大的工会组织COSATU，即南非全国总工会

examples.text: ...that large body of people which teaches other people how to teach.
examples.translation: 向别人传授教学方法的那一大批人

examples.text: The main body of the church had been turned into a massive television studio...
examples.translation: 该教堂的主体部分已被改造成了一个大型电视演播室。

examples.text: Give an introduction, followed by the body of the material, then a brief summary.
examples.translation: 首先写序言，接下来是内容的主体部分，然后作简短的总结。

examples.text: The only shade was under the body of the plane.
examples.translation: 唯一的阴凉处是飞机机身下面。

examples.text: It is probably the most polluted body of water in the world.
examples.translation: 这很可能是世界上受污染最严重的一片水域。

examples.text: An increasing body of evidence suggests that all of us have cancer cells in our bodies at times during our lives.
examples.translation: 越来越多的证据表明，我们所有人一生中体内时有癌细胞存在。

examples.text: ...a dry wine with good body.
examples.translation: 香醇的干葡萄酒

examples.text: 'We'll have her over for dinner.' — 'Over my dead body!'
examples.translation: “我们要请她过来吃饭。”——“休想！”

examples.text: He dedicated himself body and soul to the education of young men...
examples.translation: 他全身心地投入到年轻人的教育中。

examples.text: She was now committed to the band, body and soul.
examples.translation: 现在，她把全部心思都放到了乐队上面。

examples.text: He at first kept body and soul together by selling cartoons to the humorous papers.
examples.translation: 他最初通过向幽默搞笑类报纸出售卡通漫画维持生计。

examples.text: Bombs went off at two London train stations...
examples.translation: 伦敦的两个地铁站发生了炸弹爆炸事件。

examples.text: It's not known who planted the bomb...
examples.translation: 安放炸弹者身份不明。

examples.text: Most of the bombs fell in the south...
examples.translation: 大多数炸弹投在南部。

examples.text: There were two bomb explosions in the city overnight.
examples.translation: 一夜之间城里发生了两起炸弹爆炸事件。

examples.text: They are generally thought to have the bomb.
examples.translation: 人们普遍认为他们拥有核武器。

examples.text: Airforce jets bombed the airport.
examples.translation: 空军的喷气式飞机轰炸了该机场。

examples.text: Aerial bombing of rebel positions is continuing...
examples.translation: 对叛军阵地的空中轰炸正在继续。

examples.text: There has been a series of car bombings.
examples.translation: 发生了一系列的汽车爆炸事件。

meanings.meaning: 螺栓，螺钉；闪电，雷电；门闩；弩箭
筛选；囫囵吞下；（把门、窗等）闩上；突然说出，脱口说出
（门窗等）闩上，拴住；冲出，跳出；（马等的）脱缰；囫囵吞下
突然地；像箭似地；直立地

examples.text: The safety belt is easy to fit as there's no need to bolt it to seat belt anchorage points...
examples.translation: 由于不必扣在座位的固定夹上，安全带很容易就可以系好。

examples.text: Bolt the components together...
examples.translation: 把元器件组装在一起。

examples.text: The doors were bolted on.
examples.translation: 门都闩上了。

examples.text: ...a wooden bench which was bolted to the floor.
examples.translation: 用螺栓固定在地板上的木制长椅

examples.text: I heard the sound of a bolt being slowly and reluctantly slid open.
examples.translation: 我听到门闩被缓慢而吃力地拉开的声音。

examples.text: He reminded her that he would have to lock and bolt the kitchen door after her.
examples.translation: 他提醒她,在她走后他得把厨房的门上锁并闩上。

examples.text: ...the heavy bolted doors.
examples.translation: 紧锁的大门

examples.text: The pig rose squealing and bolted...
examples.translation: 那头猪突然嗷嗷叫着狂奔起来。

examples.text: I made some excuse and bolted for the exit.
examples.translation: 我编了个借口后便向出口冲去。

examples.text: Being under stress can cause you to miss meals, eat on the move, or bolt your food.
examples.translation: 人在压力之下有时会吃不上饭，或边走边吃，或是匆匆吃上几口。

examples.text: Back then I could bolt down three or four burgers and a pile of French fries.
examples.translation: 那时我一顿能吃下三四个汉堡和一大堆炸薯条。

examples.text: Suddenly a bolt of lightning crackled through the sky.
examples.translation: 突然一道闪电划破长空。

examples.text: ...bolts of black silk.
examples.translation: 成匹的黑丝绸

examples.text: If the soil dries out the plants may bolt.
examples.translation: 如果土壤过干，植株可能会过早结实。

examples.text: His father kept a tight grip on his collar in case he should make a bolt for the door.
examples.translation: 他的父亲紧紧抓住他的衣领，防止他夺门而逃。

examples.text: The company decided to appoint a Japanese manager as president of the company. The decision came as a bolt from the blue.
examples.translation: 公司决定任命一位日籍经理担任总裁。这个决定太出乎意料了。

examples.text: When I pushed his door open, Trevor was sitting bolt upright in bed.
examples.translation: 当我推开特雷弗的房门时，他正腰杆笔直地坐在床上。

examples.text: Workers in big firms receive a substantial part of their pay in the form of bonuses and overtime.
examples.translation: 大公司的员工有相当一部分薪酬来自奖金和加班费。

examples.text: ...a £15 bonus.
examples.translation: 15英镑的奖金

examples.text: ...a special bonus payment.
examples.translation: 一笔特别发放的奖金

examples.text: We felt we might finish third. Any better would be a bonus...
examples.translation: 我们感觉我们可能会获得第三名，要是能比这个名次更好那就是意外的惊喜了。

examples.text: It's made from natural ingredients, but with the added bonus of containing 30 per cent less fat than ordinary cheese.
examples.translation: 该干酪用天然原料制成，而且其脂肪含量比普通干酪低30%。

examples.text: These returns will not be enough to meet the payment of annual bonuses to policyholders.
examples.translation: 这些收益不够支付投保人每年分得的红利。

meanings.meaning: (Bone)人名；(英)博恩；(法、西、罗、塞)博内；(老)奔

examples.text: Many passengers suffered broken bones...
examples.translation: 许多乘客骨折。

examples.text: Stephen fractured a thigh bone...
examples.translation: 斯蒂芬断了一根股骨。

examples.text: The body is made up primarily of bone, muscle, and fat...
examples.translation: 人体主要是由骨骼、肌肉和脂肪构成。

examples.text: She scooped the chicken bones back into the stewpot.
examples.translation: 她拿勺捞起鸡骨头放回了炖锅里。

examples.text: Make sure that you do not pierce the skin when boning the chicken thighs...
examples.translation: 剔鸡腿骨时切勿戳破外面的皮。

examples.text: The boned fish is so easy to serve.
examples.translation: 剔了刺的鱼很容易烹制。

examples.text: ...a small, expensive pocketknife with a bone handle.
examples.translation: 昂贵的骨柄小折刀

examples.text: There are not even the bare bones of a garden here — I've got nothing.
examples.translation: 这儿连个花园的影子都没有——我什么也没看到。

examples.text: I've got a feeling in my bones that things are not quite right.
examples.translation: 直觉告诉我情况不太对头。

examples.text: Some of them make no bones about their political views.
examples.translation: 他们中的一些人坦率地表达了自己的政治观点。

examples.text: Stafford-Clark made no bones about reapplying for the job when Daldry was standing for it.
examples.translation: 当戴德利对他表示支持时，斯塔福德-克拉克毫不迟疑地再次申请了这份工作。

examples.text: He was nothing but skin and bones.
examples.translation: 他瘦得只剩皮包骨头了。

examples.text: It has survived by cutting its costs to the bone...
examples.translation: 它通过最大限度地降低运营成本生存了下来。

examples.text: Profit margins have been slashed to the bone in an attempt to keep turnover moving.
examples.translation: 为了维持资金周转，利润率已被降为最低。

examples.text: What I saw chilled me to the bone.
examples.translation: 我看到的景象令我不寒而栗。

meanings.meaning: 书籍；卷；帐簿；名册；工作簿
(Book)人名；(中)卜(广东话·威妥玛)；(朝)北；(英)布克；(瑞典)博克

examples.text: His eighth book came out earlier this year and was an instant best-seller...
examples.translation: 他的第8本书在今年早些时候面世，迅速成为了畅销书。

examples.text: 'Robinson Crusoe' is one of the most famous books in the world.
examples.translation: 《鲁宾逊漂流记》是一本世界名著。

examples.text: ...the author of a book on politics.
examples.translation: 一本政治著作的作者

examples.text: ...a book about witches.
examples.translation: 一本关于女巫的书

examples.text: ...a new book by Rosella Brown.
examples.translation: 罗塞拉·布朗的一本新书

examples.text: ...reference books.
examples.translation: 参考书

examples.text: Can I have a book of first class stamps please?
examples.translation: 请给我一板第一类邮件的邮票好吗？

examples.text: British officials have booked hotel rooms for the women and children...
examples.translation: 英国官员已为妇女和儿童预订了宾馆房间。

examples.text: Laurie revealed she had booked herself a flight home last night.
examples.translation: 劳丽透露她昨晚已为自己预订了返家的机票。

examples.text: ...three-star restaurants that are normally booked for months in advance.
examples.translation: 通常需提前数月预订的三星级饭店

examples.text: For the most part he left the books to his managers and accountants...
examples.translation: 他通常都把账册交给经理和会计们处理。

examples.text: Around 12 per cent of the people on our books are in the computing industry.
examples.translation: 我们的名册中有大约12%的人供职于计算机行业。

examples.text: League referee Keith Cooper booked him in the first half for a tussle with the goalie.
examples.translation: 联赛裁判基思·库珀在上半场因他与守门员抢球犯规而对他记名警告。

examples.text: They took him to the station and booked him for assault with a deadly weapon.
examples.translation: 他们把他带到警察局，把他用致命武器袭击他人的罪行记录在案。

examples.text: Sir John was definitely in the Treasury's bad books for incorrect thinking on economic prospects...
examples.translation: 约翰爵士肯定不受财政部的待见，因为他对经济前景的预测并不准确。

examples.text: Right from my very first day I seemed to be in everyone's good books.
examples.translation: 自打第一天起，我好像就和每个人都很合得来。

examples.text: Police should be asked to investigate so that the guilty can be brought to book soon.
examples.translation: 应该要求警方介入调查，以将罪犯早日绳之以法。

examples.text: Frank Spriggs was a very able man but something of a closed book...
examples.translation: 弗兰克·斯普里格斯是一个很有才干的人，但是有些让人捉摸不透。

examples.text: Economics was a closed book to him.
examples.translation: 他对经济学一窍不通。

examples.text: The car ferries from the mainland are often fully booked by February.
examples.translation: 从大陆出发的汽车轮渡常常在2月前就被预订一空。

examples.text: The greatest manager there has ever been, or ever will be in my book, is retiring.
examples.translation: 这位迄今为止最杰出的，在我看来，也是后人无法超越的经理，就要退休了。

examples.text: An economic boom followed, especially in housing and construction...
examples.translation: 接着出现了经济繁荣，尤其是在房地产业和建筑业。

examples.text: The 1980s were indeed boom years.
examples.translation: 20世纪80年代是真正的繁荣时期。

examples.text: ...the cycle of boom and bust which has damaged us for 40 years.
examples.translation: 40年来给我们造成巨大破坏的经济繁荣与萧条的交替循环

examples.text: The boom in the sport's popularity has meant more calls for stricter safety regulations...
examples.translation: 该项体育运动的兴起意味着制定更加严格的安全规则的呼声更高了。

examples.text: Public transport has not been able to cope adequately with the travel boom.
examples.translation: 公共交通系统还不能充分满足迅速发展的旅游业的需求。

examples.text: By 1988 the economy was booming...
examples.translation: 到1988年经济一直很繁荣。

examples.text: Sales are booming...
examples.translation: 销售额在快速增长。

examples.text: It has a booming tourist industry.
examples.translation: 其旅游产业在蓬勃发展。

examples.text: 'Ladies,' boomed Helena, without a microphone, 'we all know why we're here tonight.'...
examples.translation: “女士们，”海伦娜大声喊道，没有用麦克风，“我们都知道今晚我们为什么来到这里。”

examples.text: Thunder boomed like battlefield cannons over Crooked Mountain.
examples.translation: 雷声像战场上的炮声一样响彻克鲁克德山。

examples.text: Music boomed out from loudspeakers...
examples.translation: 喇叭中传出低沉的音乐声。

examples.text: A megaphone boomed out, 'This is the police.'
examples.translation: …扩音器响了起来：“我们是警察。”

examples.text: He turned his sightless eyes their way and boomed out a greeting.
examples.translation: 他将失明的双眼转向他们，低声打了个招呼。

examples.text: The stillness of night was broken by the boom of a cannon.
examples.translation: 夜晚的寂静被隆隆的炮声打破。

examples.text: The experience created a very special bond between us.
examples.translation: 这种经历使我们之间产生了一种很特殊的关系。

examples.text: ...the bond that linked them.
examples.translation: 将他们联结在一起的感情纽带

examples.text: Belinda was having difficulty bonding with the baby...
examples.translation: 贝琳达难以与孩子建立起亲密的关系。

examples.text: They all bonded while writing graffiti together...
examples.translation: 他们都是在一起涂鸦时互相熟识的。

examples.text: What had bonded them instantly and so completely was their similar background...
examples.translation: 是相似的生活背景使他们很快变得亲密无间。

examples.text: The players are bonded by a spirit that is rarely seen in an English team.
examples.translation: 队员们是靠一种精神拧成了一股绳，这种精神在英格兰球队中颇为鲜见。

examples.text: They expect bonding to occur naturally.
examples.translation: 他们希望能够建立自然的关系。

examples.text: ...the strong bond between church and nation...
examples.translation: 教会和国家之间紧密相连的关系

examples.text: There are tangible signs that the republic's successfully breaking its bonds with Moscow.
examples.translation: 有明显迹象表明该共和国成功地断绝了与莫斯科的密切联系。

examples.text: Freed from the bonds of convention and the fear of what others may think, the mind responds with new solutions...
examples.translation: 从传统的束缚中解脱出来，不再担心别人会有什么看法，顿时感到柳暗花明。

examples.text: We must, somehow, find a way to loosen the bonds of tradition.
examples.translation: 我们不管怎样都必须找到摆脱传统束缚的途径。

examples.text: The superglue may not create a bond with some plastics...
examples.translation: 强力胶水可能无法粘住某些塑料。

examples.text: The molecule contains four carbon atoms arranged in a ring with a triple bond between two of them.
examples.translation: 这个分子包含四个呈环状排列的碳原子，每两个碳原子之间形成一个三价键。

examples.text: Diamond may be strong in itself, but it does not bond well with other materials...
examples.translation: 钻石本身可能很坚固，但却不易与其他物质很好地黏合。

examples.text: In graphite sheets, carbon atoms bond together in rings...
examples.translation: 石墨层中的碳原子相互连接形成碳环。

examples.text: Strips of wood are bonded together and moulded by machine.
examples.translation: 木板条被黏合在一起并用机器压模成型。

examples.text: Most of it will be financed by government bonds.
examples.translation: 大部分资金将通过发行政府债券来筹措。

examples.text: ...the recent sharp decline in bond prices.
examples.translation: 最近债券价格的暴跌

examples.text: It wants the government to take action to boost the economy...
examples.translation: 它希望政府采取行动促进经济发展。

examples.text: The move is designed to boost sales during the peak booking months of January and February.
examples.translation: 这一举措旨在增加1月和2月预订高峰期的销售量。

examples.text: It would get the economy going and give us the boost that we need...
examples.translation: 它将会推动经济发展，带来我们所需要的繁荣局面。

examples.text: The proposal received a boost on Sunday when The New York Times endorsed it in a leading article.
examples.translation: 周日，该提议获得了大量支持，因为《纽约时报》在社论中对其作了肯定性的评论。

examples.text: We need a big win to boost our confidence...
examples.translation: 我们需要大胜一场来增强信心。

examples.text: Do what you can to give her confidence and boost her morale.
examples.translation: 尽你所能让她树立信心，提高士气。

examples.text: It did give me a boost to win such a big event.
examples.translation: 赢得如此重大的比赛确实使我信心倍增。

examples.text: I called her from a public phone booth near the entrance to the bar...
examples.translation: 我在酒吧入口处附近的公用电话亭给她打了电话。

examples.text: In Darlington, queues formed at some polling booths.
examples.translation: 在达灵顿，有些投票站前排起了队。

examples.text: They sat in a corner booth, away from other diners.
examples.translation: 他们坐在位于角落的一个雅座里，远离其他就餐的客人。

examples.text: He sat in a kitchen chair, reached down and pulled off his boots...
examples.translation: 他坐到厨房的椅子上，俯身脱掉了靴子。

examples.text: He was wearing riding pants, high boots, and spurs.
examples.translation: 他穿着马裤和长筒靴，靴上带着马刺。

examples.text: The soldiers' boots resounded in the street...
examples.translation: 士兵的军靴声在街上回荡。

examples.text: Equip yourself with stout walking boots and sticks.
examples.translation: 你自己要准备好结实的步行靴和拐杖。

examples.text: He booted the ball 40 yards back up field...
examples.translation: 他一脚踢出40码远，把球踢回前场。

examples.text: One guy booted the door down.
examples.translation: 一个人猛地踹倒了门。

examples.text: He opened the boot to put my bags in...
examples.translation: 他打开行李箱把我带的包放了进去。

examples.text: Harris got a rope from the car boot.
examples.translation: 哈里斯从汽车行李箱里拿出一条绳子。

examples.text: 'If we're gettin' booted, we sure as hell ain't leavin' it for the locals.'
examples.translation: “如果我们的车轮被锁住，我们绝不会把车留给当地人。”

examples.text: She was a disruptive influence, and after a year or two she got the boot...
examples.translation: 她总是影响正常的工作，一两年后便被解雇了。

examples.text: His girl gave him the boot.
examples.translation: 他被女友抛弃了。

examples.text: He is making money and receiving free advertising to boot!
examples.translation: 他既挣了钱，又做了免费的广告！

examples.text: They have to be thin, attractive and well-dressed to boot.
examples.translation: 她们必须得既苗条又迷人，而且一定要打扮漂亮。

examples.text: They fled across the border.
examples.translation: 他们穿越边界逃走了。

examples.text: ...the isolated jungle area near the Panamanian border...
examples.translation: 靠近巴拿马边境的偏僻丛林地区

examples.text: Clifford is enjoying life north of the border.
examples.translation: 克利福德正在边境北部自在地生活。

examples.text: ...the Mexican border town of Tijuana...
examples.translation: 墨西哥边境的提华纳镇

examples.text: Soldiers had temporarily closed the border between the two countries.
examples.translation: 士兵们临时封锁了两国之间的边境线。

examples.text: ...the European and Arab countries bordering the Mediterranean.
examples.translation: 地中海沿岸的欧洲和阿拉伯国家

examples.text: Both republics border on the Black Sea.
examples.translation: 两个共和国都临近黑海。

examples.text: ...pillowcases trimmed with a hand-crocheted border.
examples.translation: 饰有手工编织花边的枕套

examples.text: ...a lawn flanked by wide herbaceous borders.
examples.translation: 两侧栽种大片草本花的草坪

examples.text: ...border plants.
examples.translation: 花带里的植物

examples.text: ... the mile of white sand beach bordered by palm trees and tropical flowers
examples.translation: 四周种有棕榈树和热带花卉的长达1英里的白色沙滩

examples.text: Caesar marched north into the forests that border the Danube River.
examples.translation: 恺撒挥师北上，深入到多瑙河沿岸的森林地带。

examples.text: Dickie bored him all through the meal with stories of the Navy...
examples.translation: 迪基吃饭时一直在讲海军的故事，让他不胜其烦。

examples.text: Life in the country bores me.
examples.translation: 乡村生活令我生厌。

examples.text: ...a handsome engineer who bored me to tears with his tale of motorway maintenance
examples.translation: 英俊的工程师不停地讲高速公路养护的故事，烦得我要命

examples.text: I dropped out of high school. It bored me to death.
examples.translation: 我从中学退学了，那种学校生活令我烦得要死。

examples.text: There is every reason why I shouldn't enjoy his company — he's a bore and a fool.
examples.translation: 我有充分的理由不愿和他在一起 —— 他又乏味又愚笨。

examples.text: It's a bore to be sick, and the novelty of lying in bed all day wears off quickly.
examples.translation: 生病是件烦人的事，整天躺在床上的新鲜劲很快就没了。

examples.text: Get the special drill bit to bore the correct-size hole for the job.
examples.translation: 做这个活儿要拿个特殊的钻头来钻个大小合适的孔。

examples.text: His eyes bored into her, paralysing her, robbing her of movement...
examples.translation: 他双眼凝视着她，令她全身瘫软，不能动弹。

examples.text: Her eyes seemed to bore a hole in mine.
examples.translation: 她的目光似乎要把我的眼睛看穿。

meanings.meaning: (Born)人名；(柬)邦；(英、西、俄、捷、德、瑞典、匈)博恩

examples.text: My mother was 40 when I was born...
examples.translation: 母亲生我时40岁。

examples.text: She was born in London on April 29, 1923...
examples.translation: 她1923年4月29日在伦敦出生。

examples.text: He was born of German parents and lived most of his life abroad...
examples.translation: 他的父母都是德国人，但他一生中大部分时间在国外度过。

examples.text: Willie Smith was the second son born to Jean and Stephen.
examples.translation: 威利·史密斯是琼和斯蒂芬生的第二个儿子。

examples.text: He was born with only one lung.
examples.translation: 他生下来就只有一叶肺。

examples.text: Some people are born brainy...
examples.translation: 有些人天生聪明。

examples.text: I think he was born to be editor of a tabloid newspaper...
examples.translation: 我觉得他天生就是当小报编辑的料。

examples.text: We are all born leaders; we just need the right circumstances in which to flourish.
examples.translation: 我们每个人天生都具备领导者的素质；我们只是需要适当的环境来培养这种素质。

examples.text: She was born Jenny Harvey on June 11, 1946.
examples.translation: 她在1946年6月11号出生，取名叫珍妮·哈维。

examples.text: Jack was a born teacher.
examples.translation: 杰克天生是个当老师的料。

examples.text: The idea for the show was born in his hospital room...
examples.translation: 这个节目的构思是他在医院病房里想出来的。

examples.text: Congress passed the National Security Act, and the CIA was born...
examples.translation: 国会通过了《国家安全法》，中央情报局由此而诞生。

examples.text: Energy conservation as a philosophy was born out of the 1973 oil crisis.
examples.translation: 能源节约的理念产生于1973年的石油危机。

meanings.meaning: 借；借用；从其他语言中引入

examples.text: Can I borrow a pen please? ...
examples.translation: 我可以借支笔吗？

examples.text: He wouldn't let me borrow his clothes.
examples.translation: 他不愿我借他的衣服。

examples.text: Morgan borrowed £5,000 from his father to form the company 20 years ago...
examples.translation: 20年前摩根从他父亲那里借了5,000英镑，成立了这家公司。

examples.text: It's so expensive to borrow from finance companies...
examples.translation: 从信贷公司借钱利息非常高。

examples.text: He borrowed heavily to get the money together.
examples.translation: 他大量举债来凑齐这笔钱。

examples.text: I couldn't afford to buy any, so I borrowed them from the library.
examples.translation: 我一本书也买不起，只好从图书馆借。

examples.text: I borrowed his words for my book's title...
examples.translation: 我借用他的话作为我这本书的标题。

examples.text: Their engineers are happier borrowing other people's ideas than developing their own.
examples.translation: 他们的工程师更乐于借用别人的观点，而不愿自我创新。

examples.text: Perhaps that illness, diagnosed as fatal, gave him a sense of living on borrowed time.
examples.translation: 也许是那种被诊断为绝症的疾病让他有了时日无多之感。

meanings.meaning: 胸；胸怀；中间；胸襟；内心；乳房；内部

examples.text: ...a large young mother with a baby resting against her ample bosom.
examples.translation: 让怀中婴儿靠在她丰满胸部上的身材高大的年轻母亲

examples.text: Joan was delighted to welcome her boyfriend into the bosom of her large, close-knit family.
examples.translation: 琼十分高兴地欢迎她的男朋友加入她亲密无间的大家庭。

examples.text: They were bosom friends...
examples.translation: 他们是知心好友。

examples.text: Sakota was her cousin and bosom pal.
examples.translation: 沙科塔是她的表妹和亲密伙伴。

examples.text: We, at least, have taken her to our bosom.
examples.translation: 至少我们对她是关爱有加的。

examples.text: She cried out in fear and flung both arms up to protect her face...
examples.translation: 她吓得大叫，并且抡起双臂护住了自己的脸。

examples.text: Put both vegetables into a bowl and crush with a potato masher.
examples.translation: 把这两样蔬菜都放进一个碗里，然后用捣土豆器把它们捣碎。

examples.text: Both of these women have strong memories of the Vietnam War...
examples.translation: 这两位妇女都对越南战争记忆深刻。

examples.text: We're going to Andreas's Boutique to pick out something original for both of us.
examples.translation: 我们要去安德烈亚斯礼品店为我们俩挑选一些新奇玩意儿。

examples.text: Miss Brown and her friend, both from Stoke, were arrested on the 8th of June...
examples.translation: 布朗小姐和她的朋友于6月8日被逮捕，她们两人都来自斯托克。

examples.text: Will there be public-works programmes, or community service, or both?
examples.translation: 将会实施公共工程项目还是社区服务项目，还是二者都有？

examples.text: He visited the Institute of Neurology in Havana where they both worked...
examples.translation: 他访问了两人都曾工作过的哈瓦那的神经病学研究所。

examples.text: 'Well, I'll leave you both, then,' said Gregory.
examples.translation: “好吧，那我就不打扰你们俩了。”格雷戈里说道。

examples.text: Both the band's writers are fascinating lyricists...
examples.translation: 乐队的这两位作词人都是非常出色的填词高手。

examples.text: Both the horses were out, tacked up and ready to ride.
examples.translation: 两匹马都牵出来装上了马具，可以骑了。

examples.text: Now women work both before and after having their children...
examples.translation: 现在妇女在生孩子前后都要去工作。

examples.text: Any such action would have to be approved by both American and Saudi leaders.
examples.translation: 任何这样的行动都必须获得美国和沙特领导人双方的批准。

meanings.meaning: 烦扰，打扰；使……不安；使……恼怒

examples.text: Lots of people don't bother to go through a marriage ceremony these days...
examples.translation: 如今很多人不再费心思举行婚礼。

examples.text: Most of the papers didn't even bother reporting it...
examples.translation: 大多数报纸甚至懒得去报道这件事。

examples.text: Nothing I do makes any difference anyway, so why bother?
examples.translation: 既然我做什么都于事无补，我为什么还要费劲呢？

examples.text: ...and he does not bother with a helmet either.
examples.translation: 而且他也懒得戴头盔

examples.text: I usually buy sliced bread — it's less bother...
examples.translation: 我通常都买切片面包——比较省事。

examples.text: The courts take too long and going to the police is a bother...
examples.translation: 打官司耗时太久，去找警察也很麻烦。

examples.text: Most men hate the bother of shaving.
examples.translation: 大多数男士嫌刮胡子麻烦。

examples.text: Vince is having a spot of bother with the law.
examples.translation: 文斯惹上了点儿官司。

examples.text: Is something bothering you?...
examples.translation: 你有什么烦心事吗？

examples.text: That kind of jealousy doesn't bother me...
examples.translation: 那种嫉妒我并不在意。

examples.text: It bothered me that boys weren't interested in me...
examples.translation: 男孩子们对我不感兴趣令我很烦恼。

examples.text: Never bother about people's opinions.
examples.translation: 不要在意人们的看法。

examples.text: I was bothered about the blister on my hand...
examples.translation: 手上起的水泡让我心烦。

examples.text: I'm not bothered if he has another child.
examples.translation: 我不担心他有另一个孩子。

examples.text: We are playing a trick on a man who keeps bothering me...
examples.translation: 我们在捉弄一个总是来烦我的人。

examples.text: I don't know why he bothers me with this kind of rubbish.
examples.translation: 我不明白他为何用这种烂事来烦我。

examples.text: I just can't be bothered to look after the house...
examples.translation: 我就是不想费事照看这所房子。

examples.text: Doctors cannot be bothered to explain what they do.
examples.translation: 医生们才懒得解释他们所做的事情。

examples.text: I'll drive you back to your hotel later. It's no bother.
examples.translation: 我一会儿会开车把你送回宾馆，举手之劳。

examples.text: He cannot stand his boss...
examples.translation: 他无法忍受他的老板。

examples.text: Occasionally I have to go and ask the boss for a rise.
examples.translation: 有时我不得不找老板要求加薪。

examples.text: He thinks he's the boss.
examples.translation: 他认为自己是头儿。

examples.text: We cannot boss them into doing more...
examples.translation: 我们不能再差遣他们做更多的事了。

examples.text: 'You are not to boss me!' she shouted.
examples.translation: “你不能指挥我！”她喊道。

examples.text: He started bossing people around and I didn't like what was happening.
examples.translation: 他开始把别人差来遣去，而我不喜欢他这样。

examples.text: I'm very much my own boss and no one interferes with what I do.
examples.translation: 我自己很有主见，没有人干预我做的事。

examples.text: There were two empty beer bottles on the table...
examples.translation: 桌子上有两个空啤酒瓶。

examples.text: He was pulling the cork from a bottle of wine.
examples.translation: 他正在启一瓶葡萄酒的瓶塞。

examples.text: ...Victorian scent bottles.
examples.translation: 维多利亚时代风格的香水瓶

examples.text: He had drunk half a bottle of whisky.
examples.translation: 他已经喝掉了半瓶威士忌。

examples.text: This is a large truck which has equipment to automatically bottle the wine.
examples.translation: 这是一辆大型卡车，拥有自动将葡萄酒装瓶的设备。

examples.text: ...bottled water.
examples.translation: 瓶装水

examples.text: Gary was holding a bottle to the baby's lips.
examples.translation: 加里正拿着一个奶瓶给婴儿喂奶。

examples.text: Did she do things like bottling fruit or making jam?
examples.translation: 她干过将水果装瓶或做果酱之类的活计吗？

examples.text: ...bottled plums.
examples.translation: 装罐贮藏的李子

examples.text: But will anyone have the bottle to go through with it?
examples.translation: 但是谁会有胆量经受这件事？

examples.text: After my mother died my father started hitting the bottle.
examples.translation: 我母亲死后父亲开始酗酒。

examples.text: He was scheduled to appear on the Russell Harty Show, but bottled it at the last minute.
examples.translation: 他原定参加拉塞尔·哈蒂主持的节目，但在最后时刻打了退堂鼓。

meanings.meaning: 装底；测量深浅；查明真相

examples.text: He sat at the bottom of the stairs...
examples.translation: 他坐在最下面的一级楼梯上。

examples.text: Answers can be found at the bottom of page 8.
examples.translation: 在第8页末尾可以找到答案。

examples.text: ...the bottom of the sea.
examples.translation: 海底

examples.text: There's an extra duvet in the bottom drawer of the cupboard.
examples.translation: 橱柜最底层的抽屉里还有一床羽绒被。

examples.text: Spread the onion slices on the bottom of the dish.
examples.translation: 把洋葱片铺在盘底。

examples.text: ...the bottom of their shoes.
examples.translation: 他们的鞋底

examples.text: ...a suitcase with a false bottom.
examples.translation: 活底手提箱

examples.text: The bottom had fallen out of the city's property market.
examples.translation: 该市的房地产市场已陷入极度低迷。

examples.text: ...the Cathedral at the bottom of the street.
examples.translation: 街道尽头的大教堂

examples.text: Malone sat down on the bottom of the bed.
examples.translation: 马隆在床脚坐下了。

examples.text: He had worked in the theatre for many years, starting at the bottom.
examples.translation: 他从最基础的干起，已经从事戏剧工作很多年了。

examples.text: ...a contract researcher at the bottom of the pay scale.
examples.translation: 工资级别最低的合同研究人员

examples.text: He was always bottom of the class...
examples.translation: 他一直是全班的最后一名。

examples.text: The team is close to bottom of the League.
examples.translation: 这支球队快跌至联赛末席了。

examples.text: If there was one thing she could change about her body it would be her bottom.
examples.translation: 如果能对自己的身体做一点改变，那她会选择臀部。

examples.text: She wore blue tracksuit bottoms.
examples.translation: 她穿了一件蓝色田径裤。

examples.text: ...a skimpy bikini bottom.
examples.translation: 极其暴露的比基尼泳裤

examples.text: The two systems are, at bottom, conceptual models...
examples.translation: 这两个系统实质上是两种概念模式。

examples.text: At bottom, such an attitude is born not of concern for your welfare, but out of fear of losing you.
examples.translation: 实际上，这种态度并非源自对你幸福的关心，而是出于害怕失去你。

examples.text: Often I find that anger and resentment are at the bottom of the problem.
examples.translation: 我常常发现愤怒和不满是问题的真正根源。

examples.text: I'm happy, and I mean that from the bottom of my heart...
examples.translation: 我很开心，而且是那种发自肺腑的开心。

examples.text: I want to thank everyone from the bottom of my heart.
examples.translation: 我要衷心感谢每一个人。

examples.text: I have to get to the bottom of this mess.
examples.translation: 我必须查清造成这一混乱局面的真正原因。

examples.text: I bounced a ball against the house...
examples.translation: 我对着房子打球。

examples.text: My father would burst into the kitchen bouncing a football.
examples.translation: 我的父亲会颠着足球冲进厨房。

examples.text: ...a falling pebble, bouncing down the eroded cliff...
examples.translation: 从饱受侵蚀的峭壁弹落下来的卵石

examples.text: They watched the dodgem cars bang and bounce.
examples.translation: 他们看着那些碰碰车互相碰撞并弹开。

examples.text: The wheelchair tennis player is allowed two bounces of the ball.
examples.translation: 轮椅网球选手可以等球落地两次再击球。

examples.text: Your arms and legs need protection from light bouncing off glass...
examples.translation: 需要保护你的手臂和双腿免受玻璃反射光线的照射。

examples.text: They work by bouncing microwaves off solid objects.
examples.translation: 它们的工作原理是通过固体来反射微波。

examples.text: Her long black hair bounced as she walked...
examples.translation: 她走路时长长的黑发随之飘动。

examples.text: Then I noticed the car was bouncing up and down as if someone were jumping on it...
examples.translation: 然后我注意到那辆车在上下颠簸，好像有人在车上蹦跳似的。

examples.text: The wind was bouncing the branches of the big oak trees.
examples.translation: 一棵棵高大橡树的枝条随风摇摆。

examples.text: She lets us do anything, even bounce on our beds.
examples.translation: 她放任我们随心所欲，甚至连我们在床上蹦跳她也不管。

examples.text: Patsy had picked up the baby and was bouncing him on her knee.
examples.translation: 帕齐抱起婴儿放在膝上颠动着。

examples.text: Moira bounced into the office.
examples.translation: 莫伊拉蹦蹦跳跳地进了办公室。

examples.text: It was good to bounce ideas off another mind...
examples.translation: 与别人谈谈自己的想法是有益的。

examples.text: Let's bounce a few ideas around.
examples.translation: 咱们交流一下看法吧。

examples.text: Attempts have been made to bounce member states into decisions with major financial implications.
examples.translation: 已经努力迫使成员国制定具有重大金融意义的决策。

examples.text: Our only complaint would be if the cheque bounced...
examples.translation: 我们唯一的不满就是，如果支票被拒付…

examples.text: His bank wrongly bounced cheques worth £75,000.
examples.translation: 他的开户银行错误地拒付了票面金额为75,000英镑的支票。

examples.text: ...the Bow Brook which forms the western boundary of the wood...
examples.translation: 构成了这片树林西部边界的鲍溪

examples.text: Drug traffickers operate across national boundaries.
examples.translation: 贩毒分子进行跨国贩毒活动。

examples.text: The boundaries between history and storytelling are always being blurred and muddled.
examples.translation: 历史和轶闻的分界向来是模糊而混乱的。

examples.text: ...extending the boundaries of press freedom.
examples.translation: 扩大新闻自由的界限

examples.text: ...deep in the bowels of the earth...
examples.translation: 在地心深处

examples.text: Lyn went off into the dark bowels of the building.
examples.translation: 林恩进入了这座漆黑的建筑物的内部。

meanings.meaning: 有义务的；受约束的；装有封面的

examples.text: There are bound to be price increases next year...
examples.translation: 明年物价一定会上涨。

examples.text: If you are topless in a public place, this sort of thing is bound to happen.
examples.translation: 如果你在公共场所裸露上身，这种事情一定会发生。

examples.text: I'll show it to Benjamin. He's bound to know...
examples.translation: 我会把它给本杰明看，他肯定会知道。

examples.text: We'll have more than one child, and one of them's bound to be a boy.
examples.translation: 我们会有不止一个孩子，而且其中一定有个男孩。

examples.text: We are as tightly bound to the people we dislike as to the people we love...
examples.translation: 不管是我们讨厌的人还是喜爱的人都一样和我们密切相关。

examples.text: Economic growth is still bound to the issues of poverty, social justice and conservation.
examples.translation: 经济增长仍然与贫困、社会公正和资源保护等问题紧密相连。

examples.text: The ship was bound for Italy.
examples.translation: 这艘船驶向意大利。

examples.text: ...a Russian plane bound for Berlin.
examples.translation: 飞往柏林的俄罗斯飞机

examples.text: ...a Texas-bound oil freighter.
examples.translation: 驶往得克萨斯的油轮

examples.text: ...homeward-bound commuters.
examples.translation: 下班回家的通勤者

examples.text: I'm bound to say that it seems to me this is certain to lead to violence.
examples.translation: 我不得不说，在我看来这肯定会引发暴力事件。

examples.text: The manager of a company does not like having a large chunk of his wealth bound up in its shares...
examples.translation: 一家公司经理不愿意让大笔财富套在股票里。

examples.text: They'd have a lot of hydrogen sulfide gas bound up in their cells.
examples.translation: 他们的牢房里有大量的硫化氢气体。

examples.text: My fate was bound up with hers...
examples.translation: 我和她的命运紧密相连。

examples.text: The story of their exploration is inextricably bound up with the character of the caves themselves...
examples.translation: 他们的勘探经历与这些洞穴本身的特征有着不可分割的紧密联系。

examples.text: Their interests were completely bound up in their careers.
examples.translation: 他们的兴趣完全是围绕着他们的职业。

examples.text: Changes in temperature occur slowly and are constrained within relatively tight bounds.
examples.translation: 温度变化缓慢，而且局限在相对较小的范围内。

examples.text: ...a forceful personality willing to go beyond the bounds of convention.
examples.translation: 做事不拘常规的强硬个性

examples.text: ...the bounds of good taste.
examples.translation: 良好品味的界限

examples.text: Kirgizia is bounded by Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan.
examples.translation: 吉尔吉斯与乌兹别克斯坦、哈萨克斯坦和塔吉克斯坦接壤。

examples.text: ...the trees that bounded the car park.
examples.translation: 环绕在停车场周围的树木

examples.text: ...the park, bounded by two busy main roads and a huge housing estate.
examples.translation: 四周有两条繁忙的主干道路和一处大型住宅区的公园

examples.text: Our lives are bounded by work, family and television.
examples.translation: 我们的生活囿于工作、家庭和电视中。

examples.text: He bounded up the steps and pushed the bell of the door...
examples.translation: 他跳着上了台阶，按下了门铃。

examples.text: The dog came bounding back with the stick for Richard to throw again.
examples.translation: 那只狗蹦跳着叼回了木棍，交给理查德让他再扔出去。

examples.text: She leaps in one bound onto her pony's back for a speedy canter around the ring...
examples.translation: 她纵身一跃骑上了马背，绕着场地策马慢跑。

examples.text: With one bound Jack was free.
examples.translation: 杰克纵身一跃就脱身了。

examples.text: The shares bounded ahead a further 11p to 311p...
examples.translation: 股票价格又急涨了11便士，攀至311便士。

examples.text: The economy isn't bounding back as fast as people expected.
examples.translation: 经济并未像人们期望的那样迅速复苏。

examples.text: The passion of Argentinian football fans knows no bounds.
examples.translation: 阿根廷足球迷极为热情。

examples.text: For the last few days the area has been out of bounds to foreign journalists.
examples.translation: 最近几天该地区禁止外国记者进入。

examples.text: American parents may soon be able to rule violent TV programmes out of bounds.
examples.translation: 美国的家长可能很快就会迫使含有暴力内容的电视节目遭禁播。

examples.text: I go bowling for relaxation.
examples.translation: 我打保龄球是为了消遣。

meanings.meaning: (Bow)人名；(东南亚国家华语)茂；(英)鲍

examples.text: They bowed low to Louis and hastened out of his way...
examples.translation: 他们向路易斯深深鞠躬，并忙不迭地给他让道。

examples.text: He bowed slightly before taking her bag.
examples.translation: 他微微欠身，然后接过了她的包。

examples.text: I gave a theatrical bow and waved.
examples.translation: 我夸张地鞠了个躬，然后挥手致意。

examples.text: The Colonel bowed his head and whispered a prayer of thanksgiving...
examples.translation: 这位上校低头轻声做感恩祈祷。

examples.text: She stood still, head bowed, hands clasped in front of her.
examples.translation: 她一动不动地站着，低着头，双手紧扣在胸前。

examples.text: Some shops are bowing to consumer pressure and stocking organically grown vegetables...
examples.translation: 一些商店迫于顾客的压力，开始供应有机蔬菜。

examples.text: Parliament has bowed to the demand for a referendum next year.
examples.translation: 议会在人们的要求下已同意在明年举行全民公投。

examples.text: ...their determination not to be bowed in the face of the allied attacks.
examples.translation: 他们绝不在联合攻击面前丧失斗志的坚定决心

examples.text: I am bowed down by my sins.
examples.translation: 我为自己的罪孽感到不安。

examples.text: He bowed to the inevitable and announced that he was willing to resume diplomatic relations.
examples.translation: 迫于形势他只好宣称愿意恢复外交关系。

examples.text: They ran to the center of the tent to take their bows.
examples.translation: 他们跑到帐篷中央鞠躬致意。

examples.text: The waves were about five feet now, and the bow of the boat was leaping up and down.
examples.translation: 那时浪高大约有5英尺，船头在上下颠簸。

examples.text: ...the sight of that magnificent ship lit up from bow to stern.
examples.translation: 那艘豪华轮船从头到尾全被照亮的景象

examples.text: ...spray from the ship's bows.
examples.translation: 船头溅起的浪花

examples.text: Add a length of ribbon tied in a bow.
examples.translation: 再用一段丝带，系个蝴蝶结。

examples.text: Some of the raiders were armed with bows and arrows.
examples.translation: 其中一些袭击者身背弓箭。

meanings.meaning: 玩保龄球；滑动；平稳快速移动
投球；旋转；平稳快速移动

examples.text: Put all the ingredients into a large bowl...
examples.translation: 把所有配料都放进一个大碗里。

examples.text: Your dog should have his own bowls for food and water.
examples.translation: 你的狗应该有它自己进食和饮水用的碗。

examples.text: ...a bowl of soup.
examples.translation: 一碗汤

examples.text: He smacked the bowl of his pipe into his hand.
examples.translation: 他在自己手上磕打烟斗。

examples.text: ...the toilet bowl.
examples.translation: 马桶

examples.text: Everyone wanted to bowl, hence everyone wanted to open a bowling alley.
examples.translation: 大家都想玩保龄球，因此大家都想开保龄球馆。

examples.text: I can't see the point of bowling a ball like that...
examples.translation: 我看不出那样投球用意何在。

examples.text: He bowled so well that we won two matches.
examples.translation: 他的球投得极棒，使我们赢下了两场比赛。

examples.text: Watkins hit 16 before being bowled by Ambrose.
examples.translation: 沃特金斯击球得了16分后被安布罗斯投杀出局。

examples.text: He was bowled out first ball.
examples.translation: 他第一个球便被投杀出局。

examples.text: Veronica looked at him, smiling, as they bowled along...
examples.translation: 他们的车快速前行时，韦罗妮卡面带微笑地看着他。

examples.text: It felt just like old times, to bowl down Knightsbridge.
examples.translation: 驱车在奈茨布里奇大街上疾驰而过，感觉就好像回到了过去。

examples.text: ...the Crystal Palace Bowl.
examples.translation: 水晶宫露天剧场

examples.text: ...the Rose Bowl.
examples.translation: 玫瑰碗体育场

examples.text: ...the Fiesta college football bowl.
examples.translation: 大学橄榄球节日碗赛

meanings.meaning: (Boy)人名；(英、德、西、意、刚(金)、印尼、瑞典)博伊；(法)布瓦

examples.text: I knew him when he was a little boy...
examples.translation: 他还是个小男孩的时候我就认识他了。

examples.text: He was still just a boy.
examples.translation: 他还只是个孩子。

examples.text: ...the age when girls get interested in boys.
examples.translation: 姑娘开始对小伙子感兴趣的年龄

examples.text: Eric was my cousin Edward's boy...
examples.translation: 埃里克是我表兄爱德华的儿子。

examples.text: I have two boys.
examples.translation: 我有两个儿子。

examples.text: ...the local boy who made President...
examples.translation: 当上总统的本地小伙子

examples.text: 'Come on boys', he shouted to the sailors.
examples.translation: “加把劲儿，伙计们”，他向船员们喊道。

examples.text: Down, boy, down!
examples.translation: 趴下，小家伙，趴下！

examples.text: Oh Boy! Just think what I could tell him.
examples.translation: 哇，好家伙！想想看我会告诉他什么。

examples.text: He wants to be accepted as one of the boys.
examples.translation: 他想被人看作一个男子汉。

examples.text: The main opposition parties are boycotting the elections.
examples.translation: 主要反对党都抵制此次选举。

examples.text: Opposition leaders had called for a boycott of the vote.
examples.translation: 反对党领袖已号召人们拒绝投票。

examples.text: ...the lifting of the economic boycott against Israel.
examples.translation: 取消对以色列的经济封锁

examples.text: He reached into the cardboard box beside him...
examples.translation: 他把手伸进身边的纸板盒里。

examples.text: They sat on wooden boxes.
examples.translation: 他们坐在木箱子上。

examples.text: ...the box of tissues on her desk.
examples.translation: 她桌子上的纸巾盒

examples.text: She ate two boxes of liqueurs.
examples.translation: 她吃了两盒酒心巧克力。

examples.text: He scored from the penalty spot after being brought down in the box.
examples.translation: 在罚球区内被违规撞倒后，他罚点球破门得分。

examples.text: Do you watch it live at all or do you watch it on the box?
examples.translation: 你是在现场看还是在电视上看？

examples.text: ...Country Crafts, Box 111, Landisville.
examples.translation: 兰蒂斯维尔111号信箱，乡村工艺社

examples.text: ...box hedges.
examples.translation: 黄杨篱笆

examples.text: At school I boxed and played rugby...
examples.translation: 在学校时我既打拳击又玩橄榄球。

examples.text: The two fighters had previously boxed a 12-round match.
examples.translation: 这两位拳击手之前已经打了一场12回合的比赛。

examples.text: The Chancellor is boxed in by inflation targets and sterling.
examples.translation: 财政大臣被通货膨胀目标和英镑逼得束手无策。

meanings.meaning: 支架；括号；墙上凸出的托架
括在一起；把…归入同一类；排除

examples.text: ...a 33% top tax rate on everyone in these high-income brackets...
examples.translation: 对所有这些高收入人群征收的33%的最高税率

examples.text: Do you fall outside that age bracket?
examples.translation: 你不属于那个年龄段吗？

examples.text: Fix the beam with the brackets and screws.
examples.translation: 把横梁用托架和螺丝固定。

examples.text: ...adjustable wall brackets.
examples.translation: 可调节的壁架

examples.text: The Magi, Bramins, and Druids were bracketed together as men of wisdom...
examples.translation: 东方三博士、婆罗门和德鲁伊特都被视为富有智慧的人。

examples.text: Austrian wine styles are often bracketed with those of northern Germany.
examples.translation: 人们往往把奥地利葡萄酒的风味与德国北部葡萄酒的风味相提并论。

examples.text: The prices in brackets are special rates for the under 18s...
examples.translation: 括号中的价格是年龄在18岁以下的消费者可以享受的特别优惠价。

examples.text: My annotations appear in square brackets.
examples.translation: 在方括号里有我给的注解。

examples.text: Her father died of a brain tumour.
examples.translation: 她父亲死于脑瘤。

examples.text: Once you stop using your brain you soon go stale...
examples.translation: 一旦停止用脑，人很快就会变得迟钝。

examples.text: Stretch your brain with this puzzle.
examples.translation: 用这个智力游戏锻炼你的思维能力。

examples.text: They were not the only ones to have brains and ambition...
examples.translation: 并不是只有他们聪明、有志向。

examples.text: I had a good brain and the teachers liked me.
examples.translation: 我很聪明，老师们都喜欢我。

examples.text: Mr White was the brains behind the scheme...
examples.translation: 怀特先生是该项计划的幕后策划者。

examples.text: Some investigators regarded her as the brains of the gang.
examples.translation: 一些调查员认为她是该团伙的决策者。

examples.text: He had threatened to brain him then and there.
examples.translation: 他当时就威胁要打爆他的脑袋。

examples.text: They stood over him with clubs raised as if to beat his brains out.
examples.translation: 他们举着棍子监视着他，好像要揍扁他的脑袋。

examples.text: Give me all your money or I'll blow your brains out...
examples.translation: 把你所有的钱都给我，否则我就一枪把你的脑袋打开花。

examples.text: He blew his brains out with a shotgun.
examples.translation: 他用一支猎枪射中了他的脑袋。

examples.text: You've had chess on the brain since you were little.
examples.translation: 你从很小的时候就对下棋产生了浓厚兴趣。

examples.text: Why should a successful company allow another firm to pick its brains?
examples.translation: 为什么一个成功的企业就得允许别的公司来讨教呢？

examples.text: The brakes began locking...
examples.translation: 制动器开始锁定。

examples.text: A seagull swooped down in front of her car, causing her to slam on the brakes.
examples.translation: 一只海鸥突然扑到她的车前，她急忙猛踩刹车。

examples.text: He heard tires squeal as the car braked to avoid a collision...
examples.translation: 为避免相撞而刹车时，他听到了轮胎与地面刺耳的摩擦声。

examples.text: She braked sharply to avoid another car...
examples.translation: 她为了躲另一辆车而紧急刹车。

examples.text: He lit a cigarette and braked the car slightly...
examples.translation: 他点燃一支烟，轻踩刹车减速。

examples.text: She braked to a halt and switched off.
examples.translation: 她刹车停下，然后将车熄火。

examples.text: Illness had put a brake on his progress...
examples.translation: 疾病使他的进展放缓。

examples.text: You can take the financial brakes off in June.
examples.translation: 6月份可以放开金融管制。

examples.text: The local branch of Bank of America is handling the accounts...
examples.translation: 美国银行在当地的分行正在处理这些账目。

examples.text: National is Britain's leading autocare service with over 400 branches nationwide.
examples.translation: 英国轮胎与车辆养护公司是英国最有名的汽车养护企业，在全英国有400多家分店。

examples.text: Senate employees could take their employment grievances to another branch of government...
examples.translation: 参议院的雇员可以向别的政府部门申诉工作问题。

examples.text: He had a fascination for submarines and joined this branch of the service.
examples.translation: 他对潜艇非常着迷，因此加入了潜艇部队。

examples.text: ...the Metropolitan Police Special Branch.
examples.translation: 市公安局特别行动处

examples.text: Whole branches of science may not receive any grants.
examples.translation: 各自然科学学科可能都得不到任何拨款。

examples.text: Oncology is the branch of medicine dealing with tumors.
examples.translation: 肿瘤学是研究肿瘤的医学分支。

examples.text: This is one of the branches of the Roosevelt family.
examples.translation: 这是罗斯福家族的一个支系。

meanings.meaning: 铭刻于，铭记；打烙印于；印…商标于
(Brand)人名；(英、德、俄、西、意、罗、葡、捷、芬、瑞典、匈)布兰德；(法)布朗

examples.text: Winston is a brand of cigarette...
examples.translation: “温斯顿”是一个香烟品牌。

examples.text: I bought one of the leading brands.
examples.translation: 我买了几个畅销品牌中的一种。

examples.text: ...a supermarket's own brand.
examples.translation: 一家超级市场的自有品牌

examples.text: The British brand of socialism was more interested in reform than revolution.
examples.translation: 英国式的社会主义更加注重改革，而不是革命。

examples.text: I was instantly branded as a rebel...
examples.translation: 转眼间我被诬蔑为叛徒。

examples.text: The company has been branded racist by some of its own staff...
examples.translation: 一些内部员工谴责这家公司具有种族主义倾向。

examples.text: The US administration recently branded him a war criminal.
examples.translation: 美国当局最近认定他为战犯。

examples.text: The owner couldn't be bothered to brand the cattle.
examples.translation: 主人懒得给牛打烙印。

examples.text: A brand was a mark of ownership burned into the hide of an animal with a hot iron.
examples.translation: 烙印是一种用烙铁烫印在牲畜毛皮上以标志其归属的印记。

examples.text: After a couple of brandies Michael started telling me his life story.
examples.translation: 喝了两杯白兰地后，迈克尔开始向我讲述他的生平。

meanings.meaning: 支柱；[语] 大括号；曲柄
支撑；振作起来；激励；撑牢

examples.text: He braced himself for the icy plunge into the black water...
examples.translation: 他做好了准备要跳进冰冷的脏水里。

examples.text: She braced herself, as if to meet a blow.
examples.translation: 她严阵以待，仿佛准备面对打击。

examples.text: Elaine braced herself against the dresser and looked in the mirror...
examples.translation: 伊莱恩紧贴着衣橱照镜子。

examples.text: He braced his back against the wall.
examples.translation: 他后背紧靠在墙上。

examples.text: He braced his shoulders as the snow slashed across his face.
examples.translation: 雪花如刀割般刮在他的脸上，他绷紧了双肩。

examples.text: Overhead, the lights showed the old timbers, used to brace the roof.
examples.translation: 灯光照亮了头顶上支撑屋顶的旧房梁。

examples.text: ...a brace of bottles of Mercier Rose champagne.
examples.translation: 两瓶玛喜尔玫瑰香槟

examples.text: ...a few brace of grouse.
examples.translation: 几对松鸡

examples.text: He wore leg braces after polio in childhood...
examples.translation: 他幼时得过小儿麻痹症后双腿安上了支架。

examples.text: She wears a neck brace.
examples.translation: 她戴着颈托。

examples.text: He was not brave enough to report the loss of the documents.
examples.translation: 他没有勇气报告丢失了文件。

examples.text: ...images of brave people risking their lives to aid others.
examples.translation: 冒着生命危险去帮助他人的勇士们的形象

examples.text: Our men wiped them out, but the enemy fought bravely and well...
examples.translation: 我们的部队歼灭了敌人，但敌人也进行了顽强的抵抗。

examples.text: Mr Kim bravely stood up to authority.
examples.translation: 金先生勇敢地向权威挑战。

examples.text: Thousands have braved icy rain to demonstrate their support.
examples.translation: 数千人在寒冷的天气中冒雨赶来以示他们的支持。

examples.text: He felt disappointed but he tried to put on a brave face...
examples.translation: 他感到很失望，但还竭力强装欢笑。

examples.text: The White House tried to put a brave face on the job figures.
examples.translation: 白宫面对就业数字强颜欢笑。

meanings.meaning: 黄铜；黄铜制品；铜管乐器；厚脸皮

examples.text: The instrument is beautifully made in brass.
examples.translation: 这个仪器是用黄铜制成的，非常漂亮。

examples.text: He once again raised his baton and brought in the brass.
examples.translation: 他再次举起指挥棒，让铜管乐部加入进来。

examples.text: The brass are reluctant to fraternise with the enlisted men.
examples.translation: 高级军官不愿意与大兵们称兄道弟。

examples.text: Angola's ruling party was due to get down to brass tacks today with a debate on the party's record.
examples.translation: 安哥拉执政党预定在今天就有关该党执政记录的问题进行实质性讨论。

examples.text: The newspaper breached the code of conduct on privacy...
examples.translation: 该报违反了保护隐私的行为准则。

examples.text: The film breached the criminal libel laws.
examples.translation: 这部电影触犯了刑事诽谤法。

examples.text: The congressman was accused of a breach of secrecy rules.
examples.translation: 这位议员被控违反了保密规定。

examples.text: ...a $1 billion breach of contract suit.
examples.translation: 一起违约金达10亿美元的合同违约诉讼案

examples.text: Their actions threatened a serious breach in relations between the two countries.
examples.translation: 他们的行动使两国关系面临严重恶化的危险。

examples.text: ...the breach between Tito and Stalin.
examples.translation: 铁托和斯大林之间的不和

examples.text: The limestone is sufficiently fissured for tree roots to have breached the roof of the cave...
examples.translation: 石灰岩上有许多缝隙，故而树根能从岩洞顶部长出来。

examples.text: Fire may have breached the cargo tanks and set the oil ablaze.
examples.translation: 大火当时有可能把货船上的油罐烧漏了，从而引燃原油。

examples.text: The bomber had breached security by hurling his dynamite from a roof overlooking the building.
examples.translation: 这名爆炸手从一个俯瞰这座大楼的楼顶上投下炸药，破坏了安保系统。

examples.text: ...widespread breaches of security at Ministry of Defence bases.
examples.translation: 国防部各基地普遍存在的安全系统遭到攻破的现象

examples.text: I was persuaded to step into the breach temporarily when they became too ill to continue.
examples.translation: 在他们病得很重无法坚持的情况下，我被劝服去临时顶替他们。

examples.text: ...a loaf of bread...
examples.translation: 一条面包

examples.text: ...bread and butter...
examples.translation: 抹黄油的面包

examples.text: There is more fibre in wholemeal bread than in white bread.
examples.translation: 全麦面包纤维含量比白面包高。

examples.text: There's not a living soul in Colorado who doesn't depend for his bread on silver.
examples.translation: 科罗拉多的每一个人都是靠着开采银矿养家糊口。

examples.text: It is important that food be breaded just minutes before frying.
examples.translation: 把食物抹上面包屑后过几分钟就炸，这一点很重要。

examples.text: ...breaded fish.
examples.translation: 裹有面包屑的炸鱼

examples.text: The breadth of the whole camp was 400 paces.
examples.translation: 整个营地的宽度为400步。

examples.text: Older people have a tremendous breadth of experience...
examples.translation: 年长者阅历相当丰富。

examples.text: His breadth of knowledge filled me with admiration.
examples.translation: 他学识渊博，令我非常钦佩。

examples.text: The group built their reputation by playing across the length and breadth of North America...
examples.translation: 这个乐队通过到北美各地演出打响了知名度。

examples.text: She has travelled the length and breadth of Britain.
examples.translation: 她游历了英国各地。

meanings.meaning: 故障；崩溃；分解；分类；衰弱；跺脚曳步舞

examples.text: ...the breakdown of talks between the US and EU officials.
examples.translation: 美国和欧盟官员间谈判的破裂

examples.text: ...the irretrievable breakdown of a marriage...
examples.translation: 无法挽回的婚姻破裂

examples.text: He argues that the breakdown in the legal system has spawned a black market.
examples.translation: 他认为司法体系的不健全导致了黑市的出现。

examples.text: My personal life was terrible. My mother had died, and a couple of years later I had a breakdown...
examples.translation: 我个人的生活一团糟。母亲去世了，几年后我又患上了神经衰弱。

examples.text: They often seem depressed and close to emotional breakdown.
examples.translation: 他们经常显得很沮丧，精神濒于崩溃的边缘。

examples.text: Her old car was unreliable, so the trip was plagued by breakdowns...
examples.translation: 她的旧车老不听使唤，一路上总是出故障。

examples.text: If you stop on the hard shoulder, wait for the police or breakdown service.
examples.translation: 如果你的车坏在路肩上了，就得等警察或修理站来帮忙。

examples.text: The organisers were given a breakdown of the costs.
examples.translation: 向组织者提供了一份开支细目。

examples.text: What's for breakfast?
examples.translation: 早餐吃什么？

examples.text: ...breakfast cereal.
examples.translation: 谷类早餐食品

examples.text: All the ladies breakfasted in their rooms.
examples.translation: 所有女士都在她们的房间里吃早餐。

examples.text: She wears a low-cut dress which reveals her breasts...
examples.translation: 她穿了一件露乳沟的低胸连衣裙。

examples.text: As my newborn cuddled at my breast, her tiny fingers stroked my skin.
examples.translation: 我刚出生的宝宝蜷伏在我胸前，细小的手指触碰着我的肌肤。

examples.text: She was slim and muscular and full-breasted.
examples.translation: 她身材苗条但结实，乳房丰满。

examples.text: He struck his breast in a dramatic gesture.
examples.translation: 他动作夸张地捶打着自己的胸膛。

examples.text: The verse rose up to fire his breast with inspiration...
examples.translation: 这首诗激发了他的灵感。

examples.text: The battle roared; a sound calculated to arouse the sublimest emotions in the breast of the soldier.
examples.translation: 战场上吼声震天，意在唤起士兵们最昂扬的斗志。

examples.text: The cock's breast is tinged with chestnut.
examples.translation: 这只公鸡胸部羽毛呈浅栗色，带有白色细条纹。

examples.text: ...flocks of red-breasted parrots.
examples.translation: 成群的红胸鹦鹉

examples.text: He moved out from beneath an awning, reaching for something inside the breast of his overcoat...
examples.translation: 他离开遮阳篷，手伸进大衣前胸部找东西。

examples.text: He reached into his breast pocket for his cigar case.
examples.translation: 他把手伸进胸前口袋里拿雪茄烟盒。

examples.text: ...a chicken breast with vegetables.
examples.translation: 鸡脯肉拌蔬菜

examples.text: ...breast of lamb.
examples.translation: 羊胸肉

examples.text: The president beat his breast and called that deal a mistake.
examples.translation: 总裁捶胸顿足，称那是个错误的交易。

examples.text: I might as well make a clean breast of it. I have been living as a woman since 1975.
examples.translation: 我还是坦白的好。我从1975起就变成女人了。

meanings.meaning: （使）破；打破（纪录）；（常指好天气）突变；开始
（嗓音）突变；突破；破晓；（价格）突然下跌
破裂；间断；（持续一段时间的状况的）改变；间歇

examples.text: He fell through the window, breaking the glass...
examples.translation: 他撞破玻璃从窗口摔了下去。

examples.text: The plate broke...
examples.translation: 盘子打破了。

examples.text: Break the cauliflower into florets...
examples.translation: 把花椰菜撕成小朵。

examples.text: The plane broke into three pieces.
examples.translation: 飞机断成了三截。

examples.text: ...bombed-out buildings, surrounded by broken glass and rubble...
examples.translation: 被炸毁的楼宇四周尽是碎玻璃和碎砖瓦砾

examples.text: The only sound was the crackle of breaking ice.
examples.translation: 唯一的声响是冰层噼噼啪啪碎裂的声音。

examples.text: She broke a leg in a skiing accident...
examples.translation: 她在一次滑雪事故中摔断了一条腿。

examples.text: Old bones break easily...
examples.translation: 老年人容易骨折。

examples.text: Several people were treated for broken bones.
examples.translation: 数人接受了断骨治疗。

examples.text: It has caused a bad break to Gabriella's leg.
examples.translation: 这导致加布里埃拉一条腿严重骨折。

examples.text: Once you've broken the seal of a bottle there's no way you can put it back together again...
examples.translation: 一旦你撕开瓶子的密封条，你就无法再把它复原。

examples.text: The bandage must be put on when the blister breaks...
examples.translation: 水疱一旦破了就必须用绷带包扎起来。

examples.text: Do not use the cream on broken skin.
examples.translation: 不要在破损皮肤的表面涂护肤霜。

examples.text: When the clutch broke, the car was locked into second gear...
examples.translation: 离合器失灵后，汽车只能在二挡行驶。

examples.text: Tenants do not have to worry about leaking roofs and broken washing machines...
examples.translation: 租房者无需担心屋顶漏水和洗衣机出故障。

examples.text: The lead biker broke his bike chain.
examples.translation: 那位领先的自行车手车链子断了。

examples.text: We didn't know we were breaking the law.
examples.translation: 我们不知道自己在犯法。

examples.text: The company has consistently denied it had knowingly broken arms embargoes.
examples.translation: 这家公司一直否认自己是有意违反武器禁运规定。

examples.text: ...broken promises.
examples.translation: 背弃的承诺

examples.text: She broke free by thrusting her elbow into his chest.
examples.translation: 她用肘猛击他的胸部，挣脱了出来。

examples.text: ...his inability to break free of his marriage.
examples.translation: 他无法摆脱婚姻的束缚

examples.text: The Home Secretary aims to break the vicious circle between disadvantage and crime...
examples.translation: 内政大臣力图打破贫困和犯罪之间的恶性循环。

examples.text: New proposals have been put forward to break the deadlock among rival factions...
examples.translation: 旨在结束各竞争派别之间僵持局面的新提案已被提交。

examples.text: The country is heading towards elections which may break the party's long hold on power.
examples.translation: 这个国家正在朝着举行选举的目标迈进，选举可能会打破该党对政权的长期垄断。

examples.text: Nothing that might lead to a break in the deadlock has been discussed yet.
examples.translation: 还没有讨论出一个可能打破这一僵局的办法。

examples.text: Hugh broke the silence. 'Is she always late?' he asked...
examples.translation: 休打破了沉默，问道：“她总是迟到吗？”

examples.text: The unearthly silence was broken by a shrill screaming.
examples.translation: 一声尖叫打破了这可怕的沉寂。

examples.text: A sudden break in the cloud allowed rescuers to spot Michael Benson.
examples.translation: 天气的突然放晴帮助救援人员找到了迈克尔·本森。

examples.text: In 1959, Akihito broke with imperial tradition by marrying a commoner...
examples.translation: 明仁天皇在1959年打破皇室传统，娶了一位平民女子为妻。

examples.text: They were determined to break from precedent...
examples.translation: 他们决心打破先例。

examples.text: They have yet to break the link with the trade unions.
examples.translation: 他们还必须断绝与工会组织的联系。

examples.text: Making a completely clean break with the past, the couple got rid of all their old furniture.
examples.translation: 为了与过去彻底决裂，这对夫妇扔掉了他们全部的旧家具。

examples.text: If you continue to smoke, keep trying to break the habit...
examples.translation: 如果你还在吸烟的话，就尽量戒除这个习惯吧。

examples.text: The professor hoped to break the students of the habit of looking for easy answers.
examples.translation: 教授希望改掉学生们不动脑筋就想找到答案的习惯。

examples.text: He never let his jailers break him...
examples.translation: 他决不会让监狱看守们摧毁他的意志。

examples.text: The newspapers and television can make or break you...
examples.translation: 报纸和电视会使你成功，也会将你毁掉。

examples.text: Ken's wife, Vicki, said: 'He's a broken man.'
examples.translation: 肯的妻子薇姬说：“他被毁了。”

examples.text: They broke for lunch.
examples.translation: 他们停下来吃午饭。

examples.text: They may be able to help with childcare so that you can have a break...
examples.translation: 他们可以帮忙照料孩子，这样你就可以歇一歇了。

examples.text: I thought a 15 min break from his work would do him good...
examples.translation: 我想他停下工作休息15分钟对他会有好处。

examples.text: She rang Moira during a coffee break.
examples.translation: 她利用工间喝咖啡的休息时间给莫伊拉打了个电话。

examples.text: They are currently taking a short break in Spain.
examples.translation: 他们目前正在西班牙休短假。

examples.text: Because of the heat we broke our journey at a small country hotel.
examples.translation: 由于天气炎热，我们在一家乡村小旅馆停下来稍作歇息。

examples.text: He sustained serious neck injuries after he broke someone's fall.
examples.translation: 有人坠落压在他身上，致使他颈部受重伤。

examples.text: The news broke that the Prime Minister had resigned...
examples.translation: 据报道首相已经辞职。

examples.text: He resigned from his post as Bishop when the scandal broke.
examples.translation: 丑闻传开后他辞去了主教职务。

examples.text: Then Louise broke the news that she was leaving me...
examples.translation: 然后路易丝挑明了她要离开我。

examples.text: I worried for ages and decided that I had better break it to her.
examples.translation: 我烦恼了很长时间，后来决定还是把这事告诉她。

examples.text: He went into TV and got his first break playing opposite Sid James in the series 'Citizen James'.
examples.translation: 他进入了电视圈，获得的第一个机会是在连续剧《公民詹姆斯》中与锡德·詹姆斯演对手戏。

examples.text: Carl Lewis has broken the world record in the 100 metres...
examples.translation: 卡尔·刘易斯已经打破了百米赛跑的世界纪录。

examples.text: Jurassic Park had broken all box office records.
examples.translation: 《侏罗纪公园》打破了所有票房纪录。

examples.text: They continued the search as dawn broke.
examples.translation: 天放亮后他们继续搜寻。

examples.text: Danny listened to the waves breaking against the shore.
examples.translation: 丹尼聆听着波浪拍岸的声音。

examples.text: It was feared they could break the Allies' codes.
examples.translation: 恐怕他们会破译盟军的密码。

examples.text: Godfrey's voice broke, and halted.
examples.translation: 戈弗雷声音都变了，停顿下来。

examples.text: He sings with the strained discomfort of someone whose voice hasn't quite broken.
examples.translation: 他唱得很拘谨，声音听起来像是某个还没完全变声的男孩。

examples.text: I've been waiting for the weather to break...
examples.translation: 我一直在等待着暴风雨的到来。

examples.text: She hoped she'd be able to reach the hotel before the storm broke.
examples.translation: 她希望能够在起风暴前赶到旅馆。

examples.text: He broke McEnroe's serve.
examples.translation: 他破了麦肯罗的发球局。

examples.text: A single break of serve settled the first two sets.
examples.translation: 前两盘的比赛都是靠破掉对方一个发球局而分出胜负。

examples.text: 'I,' he finished poetically, 'will watch over you to the break of day.'
examples.translation: “我，”他以富有诗意的语言结尾，“将守候着你，直至晨光初露。”

examples.text: 'I'm a real intellectual-type guy, Tracy,' James joked. 'Oh, give me a break,' Tracy moaned.
examples.translation: “我可是个货真价实的高智商小伙儿，特雷西。”詹姆斯开玩笑地说道。“哦，别烦我了，”特雷西抱怨道。

examples.text: The moment had come to make a break or die...
examples.translation: 那个时候不跑就没命了。

examples.text: Dan made a break for his car only to find the driver's door locked.
examples.translation: 丹朝他的汽车跑去，却发现驾驶座位置的门被锁住了。

meanings.meaning: 呼吸，气息；一口气，（呼吸的）一次；瞬间，瞬息；微风；迹象；无声音，气音

examples.text: I could smell the whisky on his breath...
examples.translation: 我能闻到他呼出的威士忌的味道。

examples.text: Smoking causes bad breath.
examples.translation: 吸烟会导致口臭。

examples.text: He took a deep breath, and began to climb the stairs...
examples.translation: 他深吸了一口气，然后开始爬楼梯。

examples.text: Gasping for breath, she leaned against the door...
examples.translation: 她倚靠在门上，大口喘着气。

examples.text: He spoke for one and a half hours and barely paused for breath.
examples.translation: 他几乎一口气没停地说了一个半小时。

examples.text: Not even a breath of wind stirred the pine branches.
examples.translation: 一丝风也没有，松树枝条纹丝不动。

examples.text: It was left to Martina to add a breath of common sense to the proceedings.
examples.translation: 这件事交由马丁娜处理，她会使整个过程显得更符合情理一些。

examples.text: Her brisk treatment of an almost taboo subject was a breath of fresh air.
examples.translation: 她把这个近乎禁忌的话题处理得很轻松，令人耳目一新。

examples.text: I reached out a hand to steady myself against the house while I got my breath back.
examples.translation: 我伸出一只手抵住墙壁撑着身子，让自己喘口气。

examples.text: He had stopped to catch his breath and make sure of his directions.
examples.translation: 他曾停下来歇口气，同时确定一下方向。

examples.text: Kenny caught his breath as Nikko nearly dropped the bottle.
examples.translation: 尼科差点儿把瓶子摔了，这让肯尼倒吸了一口气。

examples.text: I held my breath and sank under the water.
examples.translation: 我屏住呼吸沉入水底。

examples.text: The whole world holds its breath for this speech.
examples.translation: 整个世界都屏住呼吸等待这一讲话。

examples.text: 'Next thing you know, I'll be dancing at your wedding,' he cried. 'Don't hold your breath,' my father replied.
examples.translation: “你瞧，下一件事是，我会在你的婚礼上跳舞，”他大声说。“你休想，”我父亲答道。

examples.text: His wife sat with him until he drew his last breath.
examples.translation: 他的妻子坐在他跟前，直到他咽下最后一口气。

examples.text: There she was, slightly out of breath from running.
examples.translation: 她在那儿，跑得有点儿喘不过气来。

examples.text: He hailed this week's arms agreement but in the same breath expressed suspicion about the motivations of the United States.
examples.translation: 他为本周达成的武器协议而欢呼，但同时又对美国的动机表示怀疑。

examples.text: She felt short of breath and flushed...
examples.translation: 她感到呼吸困难，脸颊绯红。

examples.text: Any exercise that causes undue shortness of breath should be stopped.
examples.translation: 任何导致呼吸出现困难的锻炼都应停止。

examples.text: I heard this song on the radio and it just took my breath away.
examples.translation: 我是从收音机里听到这首歌的，它令我惊叹不已。

examples.text: Walsh muttered something under his breath.
examples.translation: 沃尔什小声嘟囔了一句。

examples.text: The tone of her voice told him he was wasting his breath.
examples.translation: 她的语气使他明白他是在白费口舌。

meanings.meaning: 呼吸；低语；松口气；（风）轻拂
呼吸；使喘息；流露；低声说

examples.text: He stood there breathing deeply and evenly...
examples.translation: 他站在那儿均匀地深呼吸。

examples.text: Always breathe through your nose...
examples.translation: 要一直用鼻子呼吸。

examples.text: No American should have to drive out of town to breathe clean air...
examples.translation: 所有美国人都不必开车到城外去呼吸洁净的空气。

examples.text: A thirteen year old girl is being treated after breathing in smoke.
examples.translation: 一名13岁的小姑娘因吸入浓烟正在接受治疗。

examples.text: Her breathing became slow and heavy...
examples.translation: 她的呼吸变得沉重缓慢。

examples.text: He heard only deep breathing.
examples.translation: 他只能听到沉重的呼吸声。

examples.text: 'You don't understand,' he breathed.
examples.translation: “你不明白。”他低声说道。

examples.text: He never breathed a word about our conversation.
examples.translation: 关于我们的谈话他只字未提。

examples.text: It is the readers who breathe life into a newspaper with their letters.
examples.translation: 是读者通过来信给报纸带来了生气。

examples.text: Red wines should be allowed to 'breathe' if possible before drinking.
examples.translation: 如果可能的话，在饮用红酒前应该先开瓶透透气。

meanings.meaning: 繁殖；饲养；养育，教育；引起

examples.text: ...rare breeds of cattle...
examples.translation: 稀有品种的牛

examples.text: Certain breeds are more dangerous than others.
examples.translation: 某些品种比其他品种更危险。

examples.text: He lived alone, breeding horses and dogs...
examples.translation: 他独自一人生活，饲养马匹和狗。

examples.text: He used to breed dogs for the police...
examples.translation: 他曾经为警方培育警犬。

examples.text: These dogs are bred to fight.
examples.translation: 这些狗被培育作斗犬。

examples.text: There is potential for selective breeding for better yields.
examples.translation: 选种培育以提高产量会大有可为。

examples.text: Frogs will usually breed in any convenient pond...
examples.translation: 通常青蛙会在任何条件适宜的池塘中繁殖。

examples.text: The area now attracts over 60 species of breeding birds.
examples.translation: 这一地区现在吸引了60多种鸟类到此繁育后代。

examples.text: During the breeding season the birds come ashore.
examples.translation: 在繁殖季节各种鸟都飞到岸边。

examples.text: If they are unemployed it's bound to breed resentment...
examples.translation: 如果他们失去工作，一定会产生怨恨。

examples.text: Violence breeds violence.
examples.translation: 暴力会催生更多暴力。

examples.text: Sue is one of the new breed of British women squash players who are making a real impact...
examples.translation: 休是英国新一代的女子壁球运动员，她们的影响正在显现出来。

examples.text: The new breed of walking holidays puts the emphasis on enjoyment, not endurance...
examples.translation: 这种新型的徒步旅行假日重在愉悦身心，而不是为了锻炼耐力。

examples.text: I had found that rare breed of man who was not afraid of committing himself.
examples.translation: 我找到了那种勇于承担责任的男人，这样的男人很少有。

examples.text: I was born and bred in the highlands...
examples.translation: 我在高地地区出生和长大。

examples.text: Born and bred in this country, he and his wife emigrated to Los Angeles after the war...
examples.translation: 尽管生于斯长于斯，他和妻子在战后还是移民去了洛杉矶。

examples.text: A Londoner born and bred, she suspected that a month in the country would bore her to distraction.
examples.translation: 作为一个土生土长的伦敦人，她不相信在乡下呆一个月就会令她心烦意乱。

meanings.meaning: 微风；轻而易举的事；煤屑；焦炭渣；小风波

examples.text: ...a cool summer breeze.
examples.translation: 夏日凉爽的微风

examples.text: Lopez breezed into the quarter-finals of the tournament...
examples.translation: 洛佩斯轻松打入了锦标赛的四分之一决赛。

examples.text: 'Are you all right?' Francine asked as she breezed in with the mail.
examples.translation: “你没事吧？”芙朗辛拿着邮件踱步走进来，问道。

examples.text: John seems to breeze effortlessly through his many commitments at work.
examples.translation: 约翰似乎不费吹灰之力就完成了很多工作任务。

examples.text: And after being an office manager for 20 people, handling my own tiny staff of three is a breeze!...
examples.translation: 我曾经是管理着20个人的办公室经理，现在领导区区3名员工不费吹灰之力！

examples.text: Making the pastry is a breeze if you have a food processor.
examples.translation: 如果你有食品加工机，做这种点心轻而易举。

examples.text: He was being investigated for receiving bribes.
examples.translation: 他因收受贿赂正在接受调查。

examples.text: He was accused of bribing a senior bank official...
examples.translation: 他被指控贿赂一名高级银行官员。

examples.text: The government bribed the workers to be quiet.
examples.translation: 政府收买工人让其保持沉默。

meanings.meaning: 砖，砖块；砖形物；心肠好的人

examples.text: She built bookshelves out of bricks and planks.
examples.translation: 她用砖和木板制作书架。

examples.text: ...a tiny garden surrounded by high brick walls.
examples.translation: 四周有高高的砖墙环绕的小花园

examples.text: You were a brick, a real friend in need.
examples.translation: 你很够朋友，是真正的患难之交。

examples.text: I wanted to sort out this problem with him, but it was like banging my head against a brick wall.
examples.translation: 我曾想跟他把这个问题给解决了，但结果徒劳无功。

examples.text: After that my career just seemed to hit a brick wall...
examples.translation: 在那之后我的事业似乎就陷入了困境。

examples.text: The discussions in Brussels hit a brick wall.
examples.translation: 在布鲁塞尔进行的商谈进展受阻。

examples.text: Paying rent simply helps to line the pockets of landlords. It's far better to put your money into bricks and mortar of your own...
examples.translation: 租房子只会鼓了房东的腰包，自己投资买房要合算得多。

examples.text: As an investment, bricks and mortar are not what they were.
examples.translation: 作为一种投资，房产不再是从前意义上的房产。

examples.text: Pets could also potentially upstage the bride on what is supposed to be her big day.
He walked back over the railway bridge.
examples.translation: 他从铁路桥上走了回去。

examples.text: ...the Golden Gate Bridge.
examples.translation: 金门大桥

examples.text: ...a land bridge linking Serbian territories.
examples.translation: 连接塞尔维亚不同地区的陆桥

examples.text: It is unlikely that the two sides will be able to bridge their differences.
examples.translation: 双方不太可能消除彼此之间的分歧。

examples.text: ...the singer who bridged the gap between pop music and opera.
examples.translation: 将通俗音乐与歌剧结合起来的歌手

examples.text: We hope this book will act as a bridge between doctor and patient...
examples.translation: 我们希望这本书能成为医生与患者之间沟通的桥梁。

examples.text: They saw themselves as a bridge to peace.
examples.translation: 他们把自己看作实现和平的使者。

examples.text: On the bridge of his hooked nose was a pair of gold rimless spectacles.
examples.translation: 他的鹰钩鼻上架着一副金色无框眼镜。

examples.text: Keep it in your pack, purse or briefcase, or on the car seat next to you.

meanings.meaning: 简短的，简洁的；短暂的，草率的

examples.text: She once made a brief appearance on television...
examples.translation: 她曾经在电视上短暂露面。

examples.text: This time their visit is brief.
examples.translation: 他们这次的访问时间很短。

examples.text: In a brief statement, he concentrated entirely on international affairs...
examples.translation: 他作了一个简短的声明，集中阐述了在国际事务方面的立场。

examples.text: Write a very brief description of a typical problem.
examples.translation: 就一个典型问题作简要的描述。

examples.text: Now please be brief — my time is valuable...
examples.translation: 请长话短说——我的时间宝贵。

examples.text: I hope to be brief and to the point.
examples.translation: 我希望简明扼要，抓住重点。

examples.text: For a few brief minutes we forgot the anxiety and anguish.
examples.translation: 短短几分钟我们就忘记了焦虑与苦恼。

examples.text: A bra and a pair of briefs lay on the floor.
examples.translation: 地板上有一个胸罩和一条短内裤。

examples.text: A Defense Department spokesman briefed reporters...
examples.translation: 一位国防部发言人向记者们简要介绍了情况。

examples.text: The Prime Minister has been briefed by her parliamentary aides.
examples.translation: 首相已听取了她议会助手的简要汇报。

examples.text: ...customs officials with a brief to stop foreign porn coming into Britain.
examples.translation: 受命阻止国外淫秽出版物流入英国的海关官员

examples.text: ...and now sport in brief.
examples.translation: 现在播报体育简讯

examples.text: In brief, take no risks.
examples.translation: 总之，不能冒险。

meanings.meaning: 明亮的，鲜明的；聪明的；愉快的

examples.text: ...a bright red dress.
examples.translation: 鲜红的连衣裙

examples.text: ...the bright uniforms of the guards parading at Buckingham Palace.
examples.translation: 参加白金汉宫阅兵式的卫兵们色彩鲜艳的制服

examples.text: ...a display of brightly coloured flowers.
examples.translation: 色彩艳丽的花卉展示

examples.text: You'll be impressed with the brightness and the beauty of the colors.
examples.translation: 色彩的明艳美丽会让你大饱眼福。

examples.text: ...a bright October day...
examples.translation: 10月的一天，天气晴朗

examples.text: She leaned forward, her eyes bright with excitement.
examples.translation: 她身体前倾，眼里闪动着兴奋的光芒。

examples.text: ...a warm, brightly lit room...
examples.translation: 温暖、灯火通明的房间

examples.text: The sun shone brightly.
examples.translation: 阳光灿烂。

examples.text: An astronomer can determine the brightness of each star.
examples.translation: 天文学家能够测定每颗恒星的亮度。

examples.text: I was convinced that he was brighter than average.
examples.translation: 我确信他比一般人聪明。

examples.text: There are lots of books crammed with bright ideas...
examples.translation: 许多书里都有很多绝妙的想法。

examples.text: Ford had the bright idea of paying workers enough to buy cars.
examples.translation: 福特公司想出了付给工人足够的薪水去购买汽车这一绝妙的主意。

examples.text: The boy was so bright and animated...
examples.translation: 这个男孩活泼开朗，充满活力。

examples.text: 'May I help you?' said a bright American voice over the telephone.
examples.translation: “请问您需要什么帮助？”电话里传出一个充满活力的美国人的声音。

examples.text: He smiled brightly as Ben approached.
examples.translation: 本走过来时，他脸上露出灿烂的笑容。

examples.text: Both had successful careers and the future looked bright...
examples.translation: 两个人都事业有成，前程似锦。

examples.text: There are much brighter prospects for a comprehensive settlement than before.
examples.translation: 综合性的社区具有比以前更加光明的前景。

meanings.meaning: 灿烂的，闪耀的；杰出的；有才气的；精彩的，绝妙的

examples.text: She had a brilliant mind...
examples.translation: 她头脑聪明。

examples.text: It was his brilliant performance in 'My Left Foot' that established his reputation.
examples.translation: 他在《我的左脚》中的精彩表演使他一举成名。

examples.text: It is a very high quality production, brilliantly written and acted.
examples.translation: 其制作水准很高，剧本和表演都很精彩。

examples.text: He was a deeply serious musician who had shown his brilliance very early.
examples.translation: 他是个很严肃的音乐家，很早就展露出非凡的才华。

examples.text: If you get a chance to see the show, do go — it's brilliant...
examples.translation: 如果你有机会去看那个演出，你一定要去——棒极了！

examples.text: My sister's given me this brilliant book.
examples.translation: 我的姐姐给了我这本非常好看的书。

examples.text: It's extremely hard working together but on the whole it works brilliantly and we're still good friends.
examples.translation: 一起共事很不容易，但是总体来说我们合作得很成功，我们还是好朋友。

examples.text: He served four years in prison, emerging to find his brilliant career in ruins...
examples.translation: 他坐了4年牢，出狱后发现自己的辉煌事业已不复存在。

examples.text: The raid was a brilliant success.
examples.translation: 这次偷袭非常成功。

examples.text: The strategy worked brilliantly.
examples.translation: 这一战略成效显著。

examples.text: The woman had brilliant green eyes.
examples.translation: 这个女子有双明亮的碧眼。

examples.text: ...a brilliant white open-necked shirt.
examples.translation: 一件雪白的开领衬衣

examples.text: Many of the patterns show brilliantly coloured flowers.
examples.translation: 许多图案上都有色彩绚丽的花朵。

examples.text: ...an iridescent blue butterfly in all its brilliance.
examples.translation: 一只色彩斑斓的蓝色蝴蝶

examples.text: The event was held in brilliant sunshine...
examples.translation: 这一活动是在阳光明媚的日子举办的。

examples.text: It was 250 million times more brilliant than the Sun.
examples.translation: 它比太阳亮2.5亿倍。

examples.text: It's a brilliantly sunny morning.
examples.translation: 这天上午阳光灿烂。

examples.text: His eyes became accustomed to the dark after the brilliance of the sun outside.
examples.translation: 从阳光耀眼的室外走进来后，他的双眼开始适应了黑暗。

meanings.meaning: 带来；促使；引起；使某人处于某种情况或境地

examples.text: Remember to bring an apron or an old shirt to protect your clothes...
examples.translation: 记得带一个围裙或者一件旧衬衫来，免得弄脏你的衣服。

examples.text: Come to my party and bring a girl with you...
examples.translation: 带一个女伴来参加我的聚会吧。

examples.text: Someone went upstairs and brought down a huge kettle...
examples.translation: 有人上楼取下一个大水壶。

examples.text: My father brought home a book for me.
examples.translation: 我的父亲给我带回家一本书。

examples.text: Reaching into her pocket, she brought out a cigarette...
examples.translation: 她伸手从兜里掏出来一支烟。

examples.text: Her mother brought her hands up to her face.
examples.translation: 她母亲拉起她的双手放到自己脸上。

examples.text: He went and poured a brandy for Dena and brought it to her...
examples.translation: 他走过去为德娜倒了一杯白兰地，端到她跟前。

examples.text: The stewardess kindly brought me a blanket.
examples.translation: 女乘务员体贴地给我拿来了毯子。

examples.text: I told you about what brought me here...
examples.translation: 我告诉过你是什么把我带到这儿的。

examples.text: The shock of her husband's arrival brought her to her feet...
examples.translation: 丈夫的到来惊得她站了起来。

examples.text: Edna Leitch survived a gas blast which brought her home crashing down on top of her.
examples.translation: 埃德娜·利奇在一次煤气爆炸中幸免于难，那次爆炸把她家的房子炸塌了，她本人则被压在下面。

examples.text: ...a brave reporter who had risked death to bring the story to the world.
examples.translation: 一位冒着生命危险向世人报道此事的勇敢记者

examples.text: ...the drive to bring art to the public.
examples.translation: 将艺术介绍给公众的事业

examples.text: He brought the car to a stop in front of the square...
examples.translation: 他在广场前把车停了下来。

examples.text: His work as a historian brought him into conflict with the political establishment...
examples.translation: 他是一位历史学家，工作的缘故使他处在了和政界的当权者对立的位置上。

examples.text: The incident brings the total of people killed to fifteen...
examples.translation: 这次事故使死亡总人数达到15人。

examples.text: They have brought down income taxes.
examples.translation: 他们降低了所得税。

examples.text: He called on the United States to play a more effective role in bringing peace to the region...
examples.translation: 他呼吁美国在实现该地区的和平方面发挥更加富有成效的作用。

examples.text: Kinkel said the attacks had brought disgrace on Germany...
examples.translation: 金克尔声称这次袭击使德国蒙羞。

examples.text: Banks have brought trouble on themselves by lending rashly...
examples.translation: 银行滥放贷款给自己惹来了麻烦。

examples.text: He brought to the job not just considerable experience but passionate enthusiasm...
examples.translation: 他不仅给这一工作带来了不少经验，而且倾注了极大的热情。
