examples.text: The show is very amusing and the cast are very good.
examples.translation: 演出妙趣横生，演员的表演也很出彩。

examples.text: The world premiere of Harold Pinter's new play casts Ian Holm in the lead role...
examples.translation: 哈罗德·品特新剧的世界首演由伊恩·霍尔姆担纲主演。

examples.text: He was cast as a college professor...
examples.translation: 他被安排饰演一个大学教授。

examples.text: He had no trouble casting the movie.
examples.translation: 他为该部电影挑选演员没费一点力气。

examples.text: The film could have done without the casting of the director's daughter in a central role.
examples.translation: 其实，当初完全可以不选导演的女儿出演这部电影的关键角色。

examples.text: ...the casting director of Ealing film studios.
examples.translation: 伊灵制片公司负责挑选演员的导演

examples.text: Democrats have been worried about being cast as the party of the poor...
examples.translation: 民主党人一直担心被描绘成穷人的政党。

examples.text: Holland would never dare cast himself as a virtuoso pianist.
examples.translation: 霍兰永远不敢说自己是位钢琴名家。

examples.text: He cast a stern glance at the two men...
examples.translation: 他朝那两个人狠狠地瞪了一眼。

examples.text: I cast my eyes down briefly...
examples.translation: 我向下瞥了一眼。

examples.text: The maid, casting black looks, hurried out.
examples.translation: 女仆怒气冲冲地瞪了几眼，匆匆地出去了。

examples.text: The moon cast a bright light over the yard...
examples.translation: 明亮的月光洒在院子里。

examples.text: They flew in over the beach, casting a huge shadow.
examples.translation: 它们飞到海滩上空，抛下一大片黑影。

examples.text: Last night a top criminal psychologist cast doubt on the theory.
examples.translation: 昨天晚上，一位顶级犯罪心理学家使人们对该理论产生了怀疑。

examples.text: About ninety-five per cent of those who cast their votes approve the new constitution...
examples.translation: 参加投票的人中有大约95%支持新宪法。

examples.text: Gaviria had been widely expected to obtain well over half the votes cast.
examples.translation: 人们普遍认为加维里亚能获得远远超过半数的选票。

examples.text: Any true lover casting a pin into the fountain and gazing into it will see his or her future partner...
examples.translation: 只要你心诚，往喷泉里扔下一根大头针，然后盯着泉水看，就能看见未来伴侣的影子。

examples.text: John had Maude and her son cast into a dungeon.
examples.translation: 约翰让人将莫德和她的儿子关进了地牢。

examples.text: Some way from them, the fisherman cast his line.
examples.translation: 在离他们稍远的地方，渔夫下了钩。

examples.text: ...sculptures cast in bronze.
examples.translation: 青铜铸造的雕像

examples.text: An orthodontist took a cast of the inside of Billy's mouth.
examples.translation: 正畸医生从比利的口腔内部取了模型。

examples.text: The Social Democratic Party was full of people of an academic cast of mind...
examples.translation: 社会民主党内尽是些学究式思维的人。

examples.text: Hers was an essentially sunny cast of mind.
examples.translation: 她本质上是属于阳光快乐的性格。

meanings.meaning: 随便的；非正式的；临时的；偶然的
便装；临时工人；待命士兵

examples.text: It's difficult for me to be casual about anything...
examples.translation: 要我轻松处事很难。

examples.text: He's an easy-going, friendly young man with a casual sort of attitude towards money.
examples.translation: 他是个随和、友善的年轻人，不太在意金钱。

examples.text: 'No need to hurry,' Ben said casually.
examples.translation: “不必急，”本漫不经心地说。

examples.text: Bayldon asked the question with studied casualness.
examples.translation: 贝尔顿故作轻松地问了那个问题。

examples.text: What you mean as a casual remark could be misinterpreted...
examples.translation: 你随便说的一句话，可能就被曲解了。

examples.text: Even a casual observer could hardly have failed to notice the heightening of an already tense atmosphere.
examples.translation: 即便是不经意的旁观者也一定已经觉察到本就紧张的气氛进一步加剧了。

examples.text: I also bought some casual clothes for the weekend.
examples.translation: 我还买了些周末穿的休闲装。

examples.text: They were smartly but casually dressed.
examples.translation: 他们穿得很漂亮，但又都很随意。

examples.text: ...establishments which employ people on a casual basis, such as pubs and restaurants...
examples.translation: 酒吧、饭店等雇用临时工的地方

examples.text: It became increasingly expensive to hire casual workers.
examples.translation: 雇用临时工越来越贵了。

meanings.meaning: 意外事故；伤亡人员；急诊室

examples.text: Troops fired on demonstrators near the Royal Palace causing many casualties.
examples.translation: 军队在皇宫附近向示威人群开枪，造成大量伤亡。

examples.text: Fiat has been one of the greatest casualties of the recession.
examples.translation: 菲亚特一直是经济萧条中损失最惨重的公司之一。

examples.text: I was taken to casualty at St Thomas's Hospital.
examples.translation: 我被送往圣·托马斯医院的急救室。

examples.text: 'All right, I've been reading it. So what?' — 'Curiosity killed the cat, that's what.'
examples.translation: “好了好了，我是一直在读这个。那又怎么样？”——“不怎么样，只是好奇心，惹祸根。”

examples.text: I must look like something the cat dragged in.
examples.translation: 我当时看上去一定很邋遢。

examples.text: After three hours of playing cat and mouse, they threatened to open fire on our vessel, so we stopped...
examples.translation: 玩了3个小时的猫捉老鼠后，他们威胁说要向我们的船上开火，所以我们就停了下来。

examples.text: It's a cat-and-mouse game to him.
examples.translation: 对他说来，就是一场猫捉老鼠的游戏。

examples.text: The bank is poised to put the cat among the pigeons this morning by slashing the cost of borrowing.
examples.translation: 今天早上银行准备大幅下调贷款利率，这将引起轩然大波。

examples.text: It was described as a large, luxury mobile home, but there was barely room to swing a cat.
examples.translation: 那个活动房被形容为宽敞豪华，可事实上几乎连转身的地儿都没有。

meanings.meaning: 编目录；按确定价格收入目录（等于catalogue）

examples.text: Some 15 merchants, including Hong Kong's Wing On department store, hawk wares via a catalog-style format.
From all points of view, war would be a catastrophe...
examples.translation: 不管从哪方面说，战争都将是场灾难。

examples.text: If the world is to avoid environmental catastrophe, advanced economies must undergo a profound transition.
examples.translation: 世界若要想避免环境灾难，经济发达的国家必须进行深刻变革。

examples.text: This book clearly falls into the category of fictionalised autobiography...
examples.translation: 这本书很显然属于自传体小说。

examples.text: The tables were organised into six different categories...
examples.translation: 餐桌被编为6个不同的类别。

examples.text: Designer wedding dresses make wedding fashion a separate category from mainstream fashion.
examples.translation: 著名设计师设计的婚纱使得婚纱时尚有别于主流服装时尚。

examples.text: Police say they are confident of catching the gunman...
examples.translation: 警方说他们有信心抓住那个持枪歹徒。

examples.text: Where did you catch the fish?...
examples.translation: 这条鱼你在哪儿逮的？

examples.text: I wondered if it was an animal caught in a trap.
examples.translation: 我在想，会不会是什么动物掉进了陷阱。

examples.text: I jumped up to catch a ball and fell over.
examples.translation: 我跳起来接球，结果摔了个跟头。

examples.text: He missed the catch and the match was lost.
examples.translation: 他没有接住球，比赛输了。

examples.text: Liz caught his arm...
examples.translation: 莉兹一把抓住了他的胳膊。

examples.text: He knelt beside her and caught her hand in both of his...
examples.translation: 他跪在她的旁边，双手握住她的一只手。

examples.text: Garrido caught her by the wrist.
examples.translation: 加里多抓住她的手腕。

examples.text: The stinging slap almost caught his face...
examples.translation: 那狠狠的一巴掌差点搧在他脸上。

examples.text: I may have caught him with my elbow but it was just an accident...
examples.translation: 也许我的胳膊肘碰到了他，但那是无意的。

examples.text: He caught her on the side of her head with his other fist.
examples.translation: 他的另一只拳头从侧面击中她的头部。

examples.text: Her ankle caught on a root, and she almost lost her balance...
examples.translation: 她的脚踝被树根绊了一下，差点摔倒。

examples.text: A man caught his foot in the lawnmower.
examples.translation: 有个男的一只脚绞进剪草机里了。

examples.text: We were in plenty of time for Anthony to catch the ferry...
examples.translation: 我们时间充裕得很，足够安东尼赶上渡船。

examples.text: He caught a taxi to Harrods.
examples.translation: 他打了辆出租车去哈罗德百货商店。

examples.text: He caught a youth breaking into a car...
examples.translation: 他撞见一个青年正在撬车。

examples.text: I don't want to catch you pushing yourself into the picture to get some personal publicity...
examples.translation: 我不希望看见你为了出风头而去抢镜头。

examples.text: Three years ago my wife and I divorced. I caught her with her boss.
examples.translation: 3年前，我和老婆离了婚。我发现她和她老板有染。

examples.text: I caught myself feeling almost sorry for poor Mr Laurence.
examples.translation: 我突然发觉自己几乎同情起可怜的劳伦斯先生来了。

examples.text: As she turned back she caught the puzzled look on her mother's face...
examples.translation: 她转过身来，看见母亲脸上迷惑的表情。

examples.text: He caught a glimpse of the man's face in a shop window.
examples.translation: 他在商店橱窗里瞥见了一眼那个人的脸。

examples.text: Often a fox goes across the road in front of me and I just catch it in the headlights.
examples.translation: 常常有狐狸穿越车前方的马路，我借助车头灯正好看见。

examples.text: His ears caught a faint cry...
examples.translation: 他听到一声微弱的叫声。

examples.text: I do not believe I caught your name...
examples.translation: 我没有听清你的名字。

examples.text: The men out in the corridor were trying to catch what they said.
examples.translation: 外面走廊里的人竖起耳朵想听他们说些什么。

examples.text: Bill turns on the radio to catch the local news...
examples.translation: 比尔打开收音机，收听本地新闻。

examples.text: The exhibition is on at Droitwich until May 24. You can also catch it at Leominster from June 5.
examples.translation: 展览在德罗伊特威奇一直持续到5月24日。从6月5日起，还可以在莱姆斯特参观该展览。

examples.text: I dialled Elizabeth's number thinking I might catch her before she left for work...
examples.translation: 我拨了伊丽莎白的号码，心里想或许能赶在她去上班前联系到她。

examples.text: Hello, Dolph. Glad I caught you.
examples.translation: 喂，多尔夫，可见着你了。

examples.text: She looked as if the photographer had caught her by surprise...
examples.translation: 看上去，她好像被摄影师搞了个猝不及防。

examples.text: I'm sorry but I just cannot say anything. You've caught me at a bad time...
examples.translation: 对不起，我真的没什么好说的。你问得不是时候。

examples.text: The sheer number of spectators has caught everyone unprepared.
examples.translation: 观众的人数之多让所有人措手不及。

examples.text: My shoes caught his attention...
examples.translation: 我的鞋子引起了他的注意。

examples.text: A quick movement across the aisle caught his eye.
examples.translation: 有个人影在走道里一闪而过，引起了他的注意。

examples.text: There's no doubt Mr Putin's speech caught the mood of most deputies.
examples.translation: 无疑，普金先生的讲话充分反映了大多数代表的心情。

examples.text: When he was fishing off the island he was caught in a storm and almost drowned...
examples.translation: 他出岛捕鱼时，赶上一场暴风雨，差点淹死。

examples.text: Visitors to the area were caught between police and the rioters.
examples.translation: 到该地区游玩的人碰上警察和骚乱分子交战。

examples.text: The Jordanian leader is caught between both sides in the dispute...
examples.translation: 争论双方使约旦领导人左右为难。

examples.text: She was caught between envy and admiration.
examples.translation: 她不知是该妒忌还是该羡慕。

examples.text: The more stress you are under, the more likely you are to catch a cold.
examples.translation: 压力越大，越有可能患感冒。

examples.text: The fish is laid out on a large serving plate to catch the juices.
examples.translation: 鱼盛在一个大盘子里，以防汤汁洒出来。

examples.text: ...a specially designed breadboard with a tray to catch the crumbs.
examples.translation: 特制的切面包板，有个能接住面包屑的槽

examples.text: They saw the ship's guns, catching the light of the moon...
examples.translation: 他们看到船上的大炮在月光下熠熠生辉。

examples.text: A gust of wind caught the parachute.
examples.translation: 一阵风将降落伞吹远。

examples.text: She fiddled with the catch of her bag...
examples.translation: 她摆弄着包上的搭扣。

examples.text: Fit windows with safety locks or catches.
examples.translation: 给窗户装上安全锁或窗栓。

examples.text: The catch is that you work for your supper, and the food and accommodation can be very basic...
examples.translation: 圈套在于你是在挣钱糊口，但食宿其实有可能非常简单。

examples.text: 'It's your money. You deserve it.' — 'What's the catch?'
examples.translation: “这钱归你，你该拿这个钱。”——“搞什么名堂？”

examples.text: The catch included one fish over 18 pounds.
examples.translation: 捕获的鱼里有一条重逾18磅。

examples.text: I was so in love with him and all my friends said what a good catch he was.
examples.translation: 我当时和他陷入热恋，我的朋友们都说能找到他是我的福气。

examples.text: You won't catch me giving him a bad review!...
examples.translation: 我绝不会说他坏话的。

examples.text: You wouldn't catch me in there, I can tell you.
examples.translation: 我可以告诉你，你永远别想在那里看见我。

examples.text: It makes soldiers happy to know that somebody right at the top has been caught with his trousers down...
examples.translation: 顶头上司出了大洋相，当兵的最高兴了。

examples.text: I think we caught them with their pants down. They're a bit confused.
examples.translation: 我觉得我们让他们下不了台了。他们有点不知所措。

meanings.meaning: 投合，迎合；满足需要；提供饮食及服务

examples.text: Minorca is the sort of place that caters for families...
examples.translation: 梅诺卡岛是那种适合家庭旅游的地方。

examples.text: We cater to an exclusive clientele.
examples.translation: 我们只接待特定的高端客户。

examples.text: We have to cater for demand.
examples.translation: 我们得考虑需求。

examples.text: ...shops that cater for the needs of men...
examples.translation: 男性用品商店

examples.text: Exercise classes cater to all levels of fitness.
examples.translation: 各种健身班会照顾到不同身体状况的人。

examples.text: Nunsmere Hall can cater for receptions of up to 300 people...
examples.translation: 纳恩斯米尔酒店最多可以同时接待300人。

examples.text: The chef is pleased to cater for vegetarian diets...
examples.translation: 厨师非常乐意为客人做素食。

examples.text: Does he cater parties too?
examples.translation: 他也承办派对的饮食吗？

examples.text: ...St. Paul's Cathedral.
examples.translation: 圣保罗大教堂

examples.text: ...the cathedral city of Canterbury.
examples.translation: 有主教座堂的坎特伯雷市

examples.text: ...the Catholic Church.
examples.translation: 天主教教堂

examples.text: ...Catholic priests.
examples.translation: 天主教神父

examples.text: ...the Catholic faith.
examples.translation: 天主教信仰

examples.text: At least nine out of ten Mexicans are baptised Catholics.
examples.translation: 墨西哥人至少有9/10是受洗的天主教徒。

examples.text: He was a man of catholic tastes, a lover of grand opera, history and the fine arts.
examples.translation: 他这个人兴趣广泛，大歌剧、历史、美术，无所不好。

meanings.meaning: 牛；牲畜（骂人的话）；家畜；无价值的人

examples.text: ...the finest herd of beef cattle for two hundred miles.
examples.translation: 方圆两百英里内最好的肉用牛群

examples.text: Smoking is the biggest preventable cause of death and disease...
examples.translation: 在可以预防的引发死亡和疾病的因素当中，吸烟排在第一位。

examples.text: The causes are a complex blend of local and national tensions.
examples.translation: 原因很复杂，既有地方性冲突也有全国范围的紧张局势。

examples.text: Attempts to limit family size among some minorities are likely to cause problems...
examples.translation: 试图在某些少数民族地区限制生育可能会引起问题。

examples.text: This was a genuine mistake, but it did cause me some worry.
examples.translation: 这是好心办错事，可是确实让我担心了一阵子。

examples.text: ...a protein that gets into animal cells and attacks other proteins, causing disease to spread.
examples.translation: 进入动物细胞内攻击其他蛋白质、从而导致疾病传播的蛋白质

examples.text: ...the damage to Romanian democracy caused by events of the past few days.
examples.translation: 过去几天发生的事件对罗马尼亚民主政体的危害

examples.text: Only a few people can find any cause for celebration...
examples.translation: 只有少数几个人能找到庆祝的理由。

examples.text: Both had much cause to be grateful for the secretiveness of government in Britain.
examples.translation: 双方都有充分的理由对英国政府的行事隐秘深表感激。

examples.text: Refusing to have one leader has not helped the cause.
examples.translation: 拒绝推举一名领导者对此项事业毫无帮助。

examples.text: ...fundamental laws of biological cause and effect.
examples.translation: 生物学上因果关系的根本法则

examples.text: They make common cause for a few purposes, but for the most part, they pursue their own interests.
examples.translation: 他们因为几个目的而联手，可是多数情况下，他们追逐着各自的利益。

examples.text: The Raleigh International Bike Ride is open to anyone who wants to raise money for a good cause.
examples.translation: 想要为公益事业筹集资金的人都可以参加雷利国际自行车比赛。

examples.text: Extreme caution should be exercised when buying part-worn tyres...
examples.translation: 购买部分磨损轮胎时要格外当心。

examples.text: The Chancellor is a man of caution.
examples.translation: 财政大臣为人处世谨慎。

examples.text: Tony cautioned against misrepresenting the situation...
examples.translation: 托尼告诫说不要歪曲形势。

examples.text: The statement clearly was intended to caution Seoul against attempting to block the council's action again...
examples.translation: 显然，这个声明的目的是要警告首尔不要尝试再次阻拦委员会的行动。

examples.text: He cautioned that opposition attacks on the ruling party would not further political co-operation.
examples.translation: 他告诫说，反对派对执政党的攻击并不能增进政治合作。

examples.text: There was a note of caution for the Treasury in the figures.
examples.translation: 统计数字向财政部亮出了警告。

examples.text: The two men were cautioned but police say they will not be charged...
examples.translation: 那两个人受到了警告，不过警方说不会对他们提出指控。

examples.text: Tapp was eventually cautioned for wasting police time.
examples.translation: 最后，塔普因浪费警方时间而受到警告。

examples.text: In November 1987 Paula escaped with a caution. In October 1988 she was fined.
examples.translation: 1987年11月，葆拉运气好只是受到了口头警告;1988年10月，她被处以罚款。

examples.text: Nobody was cautioned after arrest.
examples.translation: 被捕后，没有人被告知其法律权利。

examples.text: I threw caution to the wind and rode as fast as I could.
examples.translation: 我不顾一切，骑得飞快。

examples.text: The scientists are cautious about using enzyme therapy on humans...
examples.translation: 科学家们对在人身上使用酶疗法非常慎重。

examples.text: He is a very cautious man.
examples.translation: 他做事很谨慎。

examples.text: David moved cautiously forward and looked over the edge...
examples.translation: 戴维小心翼翼地往前挪，从边缘向下张望。

examples.text: Cautiously, he moved himself into an upright position.
examples.translation: 他小心翼翼地直起了身子。

examples.text: He has been seen as a champion of a more cautious approach to economic reform.
examples.translation: 人们一直将他视为主张更为谨慎的经济改革措施的提倡者。

examples.text: I am cautiously optimistic that a new government will be concerned and aware about the environment...
examples.translation: 对于新政府是否会关注环境问题，我持谨慎的乐观态度。

examples.text: ...drawing a small picture with coloured chalks.
examples.translation: 用彩色粉笔画一幅小图

examples.text: He chalked the message on the blackboard...
examples.translation: 他用粉笔将消息写在黑板上。

examples.text: There was a blackboard with seven names chalked on it.
examples.translation: 黑板上用粉笔写着7个人名。

examples.text: The two places, he insists, are as different as chalk and cheese...
examples.translation: 他坚持说那两个地方有天壤之别。

examples.text: We are very aware of our differences, we accept that we are chalk and cheese.
examples.translation: 我们非常清楚相互之间的差异，并且承认自己是截然不同的两类人。

examples.text: The rest of us hadn't finished our drinks, not by a long chalk.
examples.translation: 我们其余几个人还没有喝完，还差得远呢。

examples.text: I like a big challenge and they don't come much bigger than this...
examples.translation: 我喜欢大的挑战，而所有挑战中再没有比这更大的了。

examples.text: The new government's first challenge is the economy.
examples.translation: 新政府面临的第一个难题是经济问题。

examples.text: The new Germany must rise to the challenge of its enhanced responsibilities...
examples.translation: 一个崭新的德国必须迎接挑战，承担更多的责任。

examples.text: They rose to the challenge of entertaining 80 schoolchildren for an afternoon.
examples.translation: 他们一个下午成功接待了80名学童。

examples.text: The demonstrators have now made a direct challenge to the authority of the government.
examples.translation: 示威者现在直接对政府的权威发出了质疑。

examples.text: Democratic leaders have challenged the president to sign the bill...
examples.translation: 民主党领袖对总统签署这项法案提出了质疑。

examples.text: The move was immediately challenged by two of the republics...
examples.translation: 此项动议立即遭到其中两个共和国的反对。

examples.text: I challenged him on the hypocrisy of his political attitudes.
examples.translation: 我就他虚伪的政治观点质问他。

examples.text: A mum slashed a neighbour's car tyre and challenged her to a fight after their daughters fell out...
examples.translation: 两家的女儿吵起来后，一个妈妈划破了邻居的车胎，说要和她较量较量。

examples.text: He left a note at the scene of the crime, challenging detectives to catch him...
examples.translation: 他在犯罪现场留了个条儿，向警探挑衅。

examples.text: We challenged a team who called themselves 'College Athletes'.
examples.translation: 我们向一个自称“大学运动员”的队下了战书。

examples.text: A third presidential candidate emerged to mount a serious challenge and throw the campaign wide open.
examples.translation: 第三位总统候选人的杀出对前两位构成了严峻挑战，并使得选举形势扑朔迷离。

examples.text: The men apparently opened fire after they were challenged by a patrol.
examples.translation: 显然，那些人是在受到一支巡逻队的盘问后开的火。

meanings.meaning: （身体或器官内的）室，膛；房间；会所
把…关在室内；装填（弹药等）

examples.text: We are going to make sure we are in the council chamber every time he speaks.
examples.translation: 每次他发表讲话我们都会确保赶到市议会会议厅去。

examples.text: More than 80 parties are contesting seats in the two-chamber parliament...
examples.translation: 有80多个党派在竞争两院的议席。

examples.text: Signor Amato's government has only a 16-seat majority in the Chamber of Deputies.
examples.translation: 阿马托先生的政府在下议院仅以16席的优势占有多数席位。

examples.text: For many, the dentist's surgery remains a torture chamber.
examples.translation: 对许多人来说，牙医的治疗室一直是间受刑室。

examples.text: But it might be too soon for party leaders to break out the champagne.
...a former Olympic champion...
examples.translation: 前奥运会冠军

examples.text: Kasparov became world champion.
examples.translation: 卡斯帕罗夫成为世界冠军。

examples.text: ...a champion boxer and skier.
examples.translation: 拳击和滑雪双料冠军

examples.text: He received acclaim as a champion of the oppressed...
examples.translation: 他因维护被压迫者的利益而备受称赞。

examples.text: He was once known as a champion of social reform.
examples.translation: 他曾经是社会改革的拥护者。

examples.text: He passionately championed the poor...
examples.translation: 他满腔热情地捍卫穷人的利益。

examples.text: The amendments had been championed by pro-democracy activists.
examples.translation: 修正案一直受到亲民主的活跃分子的支持。

meanings.meaning: 总理（德、奥等的）；（英）大臣；校长（美国某些大学的）；（英）大法官；（美）首席法官

examples.text: The Chancellor announced in the budget the average cut in public services would be about 25%.

meanings.meaning: 机会，际遇；运气，侥幸；可能性

examples.text: Do you think they have a chance of beating Australia?...
examples.translation: 你认为他们有可能击败澳大利亚吗？

examples.text: This partnership has a good chance of success...
examples.translation: 这个组合获胜的希望很大。

examples.text: The specialist who carried out the brain scan thought Tim's chances of survival were still slim...
examples.translation: 给蒂姆做脑部扫描的专科医生认为他活下来的可能性仍旧渺茫。

examples.text: There was really very little chance that Ben would ever have led a normal life.
examples.translation: 本过上正常人的生活的机会真的非常小。

examples.text: The electoral council announced that all eligible people would get a chance to vote...
examples.translation: 选举委员会宣布，所有有资格者都将获得投票的机会。

examples.text: Most refugee doctors never get the chance to practice medicine in British hospitals...
examples.translation: 多数去避难的医生永远没有机会在英国医院行医。

examples.text: I felt I had to give him a chance.
examples.translation: 我觉得自己必须给他个机会。

examples.text: ...a chance meeting.
examples.translation: 偶遇

examples.text: ...a victim of chance and circumstance.
examples.translation: 时运不济的倒霉蛋

examples.text: A man I chanced to meet proved to be a most unusual character...
examples.translation: 我邂逅了一个人，后来发现他是个极为与众不同的家伙。

examples.text: It was just then that I chanced to look round.
examples.translation: 就在那时，我恰好环顾了下四周。

examples.text: ...Christopher Columbus, who chanced upon the Dominican Republic nearly 500 years ago.
examples.translation: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布，在近500年前偶然发现多米尼加共和国的人

examples.text: Andy knew the risks. I cannot believe he would have chanced it...
examples.translation: 安迪知道有风险，我不敢相信他竟然甘冒其险。

examples.text: He decided no assassin would chance a shot from amongst that crowd.
examples.translation: 他认定，没有刺客会冒险混在人群里开枪。

examples.text: He had met Mr Maude by chance.
examples.translation: 他曾邂逅过莫德先生。

examples.text: Are they by any chance related?
examples.translation: 他们有可能是亲戚吗？

examples.text: Being very good at science subjects, I stood a good chance of gaining high grades...
examples.translation: 我理科很棒，所以很有机会拿高分。

examples.text: Neither is seen as standing any chance of snatching the leadership from him.
examples.translation: 两人都不被认为有任何可能从他手中夺得领导权。

examples.text: You take a chance on the weather if you holiday in the UK...
examples.translation: 在英国度假，只有赌天气了。

examples.text: From then on, they were taking no chances...
examples.translation: 从那时起，他们就不再冒险了。

examples.text: Dennis was not a man to take chances.
examples.translation: 丹尼斯不是个敢冒风险的人。

examples.text: ...the only serious current affairs programme on either channel.
examples.translation: 两个频道唯一的严肃时事节目

examples.text: ...the proliferating number of television channels in America.
examples.translation: 美国激增的电视频道

examples.text: ...the presenter of Channel 4 News.
examples.translation: 电视四台新闻节目的主持人

examples.text: The government will surely use the diplomatic channels available...
examples.translation: 政府肯定会利用各种现有的外交渠道。

examples.text: The Americans recognise that the UN can be the channel for greater diplomatic activity...
examples.translation: 美国人认识到可以通过联合国这个渠道开展更多的外交活动。

examples.text: Moscow and the Baltic republics are reopening channels of communication.
examples.translation: 莫斯科和波罗的海诸共和国正在重启沟通渠道。

examples.text: Jacques Delors wants a system set up to channel funds to the poor countries...
examples.translation: 雅克·德洛尔希望建立一套体系，将资金专门用于援助贫穷的国家。

examples.text: Revenues from 'green taxes' could then be channelled back into energy efficiency.
examples.translation: 从“绿色税收”得来的收入便可回过头来用于提高能效。

examples.text: Stephen is channelling his energies into a novel called Blue.
examples.translation: 斯蒂芬正集中精力写一部名为《蓝色》的小说。

examples.text: Keep the drainage channel clear.
examples.translation: 保持下水道畅通。

examples.text: The world's first transatlantic balloon race ended in chaos last night...
examples.translation: 昨晚世界第一届跨大西洋热气球比赛在一片混乱中收场。

examples.text: It is impossible to establish democracy amid economic chaos.
examples.translation: 经济秩序混乱不堪，是不可能建立民主的。

examples.text: She thought he was a very nice chap.
examples.translation: 她觉得他是个大好人。

meanings.meaning: 章，回；（俱乐部、协会等的）分会；人生或历史上的重要时期

examples.text: Chromium supplements were used successfully in the treatment of diabetes (see Chapter 4)...
examples.translation: 铬补充剂被成功运用于治疗糖尿病(见第4章)。

examples.text: I took the title of this chapter from one of my favorite books.
examples.translation: 我这章的标题来自我最喜欢的一本书。

examples.text: This had been a particularly difficult chapter in Lebanon's recent history.
examples.translation: 这在黎巴嫩的近代史上是个特别困难的时期。

examples.text: ...one of the most dramatic chapters of recent British politics.
examples.translation: 英国政治近来最富戏剧性的阶段之一

examples.text: The Archbishop began his address, thanking the Dean and Chapter of Westminster for inviting him to the Abbey.
examples.translation: 大主教在开始演讲之前，首先感谢威斯敏斯特大教堂的主教和全体教士邀请他来到这里。

examples.text: To find out more about cancer warning signs call your local chapter of the American Cancer Society.
examples.translation: 想要了解更多有关癌症的征兆，请给美国癌症协会本地分会打电话。

examples.text: In the course of the evening he gave me chapter and verse on the mosses of the Islay peat bogs.
examples.translation: 整个晚上，他向我详细讲述艾莱岛泥炭沼泽地上的各种青苔。

examples.text: The ambassador appealed for a change in US policy...
examples.translation: 大使呼吁美国在政策上作出改变。

examples.text: What is needed is a change of attitude on the part of architects...
examples.translation: 现在需要的是建筑师态度的转变。

examples.text: There are going to have to be some drastic changes...
examples.translation: 一定得进行重大变革。

examples.text: In Zaire political change was on its way...
examples.translation: 在扎伊尔，政治变革正在推进。

examples.text: 1998 was an important year for everyone: a time of change.
examples.translation: 1998年对所有人来说都是重要的一年：那是个变革的时期。

examples.text: It is a complex system, but it certainly makes a change...
examples.translation: 这是个复杂的体系，不过确实有所改变。

examples.text: Do you feel like you could do with a change?
examples.translation: 你想不想改变一下？

examples.text: His doctor increased the dosage but did not change to a different medication...
examples.translation: 他的医生加大了剂量，不过没有换药。

examples.text: He changed from voting against to abstaining.
examples.translation: 他原打算投反对票，后来改为弃权了。

examples.text: We are trying to detect and understand how the climates change...
examples.translation: 我们正努力探寻并理解气候是如何变化的。

examples.text: In the union office, the mood gradually changed from resignation to rage...
examples.translation: 在工会办公室，情绪慢慢从顺从转变成愤怒。

examples.text: She has now changed into a happy, self-confident woman...
examples.translation: 如今她已经变成一个快乐、自信的女人。

examples.text: They should change the law to make it illegal to own replica weapons...
examples.translation: 他们应该修订法律，使拥有仿制武器成为非法行为。

examples.text: Trees are changing colour earlier than last year...
examples.translation: 今年树木换装比去年早。

examples.text: He is a changed man since you left...
examples.translation: 打你走后，他就变了个人。

examples.text: A changing world has put pressures on the corporation.
examples.translation: 日新月异的世界使这家公司感到了压力。

examples.text: I paid £80 to have my car radio fixed and I bet all they did was change a fuse...
examples.translation: 我花80英镑让人把我车上的收音机修了修，可我敢肯定，他们只是换了根保险丝。

examples.text: If you want to change your doctor there are two ways of doing it.
examples.translation: 你要是想换个医生，办法有两个。

examples.text: A change of leadership alone will not be enough.
examples.translation: 仅仅更换领导层是不够的。

examples.text: Ben had merely changed his shirt...
examples.translation: 本仅仅换了件衬衫。

examples.text: They had allowed her to shower and change...
examples.translation: 他们准许她冲个澡，换套衣裳。

examples.text: I changed into a tracksuit...
examples.translation: 我换上一身运动装。

examples.text: I've got to get changed first. I've got to put my uniform on.
examples.translation: 我得先换一下衣服，穿上制服。

examples.text: He stuffed a bag with a few changes of clothing.
examples.translation: 他往包里塞了几套换洗衣服。

examples.text: After changing the bed, I would fall asleep quickly...
examples.translation: 换了床单，我很快就能睡着。

examples.text: I changed the sheets on your bed today.
examples.translation: 我今天把你的床单换了。

examples.text: She criticizes me for the way I feed or change him...
examples.translation: 她批评我不会给他喂奶、不会换尿布。

examples.text: He needs his nappy changed.
examples.translation: 他的尿布该换了。

examples.text: At Glasgow I changed trains for Greenock...
examples.translation: 我在格拉斯哥改乘去格里诺克的火车。

examples.text: We were turned off the train at Hanover, where we had to change.
examples.translation: 我们在汉诺威站被赶下火车，只好在那儿转车。

examples.text: The driver tried to change gear, then swerved...
examples.translation: 司机试图换挡，接着突然转向。

examples.text: He looked up into the mirror as he changed through his gears.
examples.translation: 他一边换挡，一边抬眼看后视镜。

examples.text: 'There's your change.' — 'Thanks very much.'...
examples.translation: “您的找头。”——“多谢。”

examples.text: They told the shopkeeper to keep the change.
examples.translation: 他们告诉店主不用找钱了。

examples.text: Thieves ransacked the office, taking a sack of loose change...
examples.translation: 窃贼洗劫了办公室，拿走了一口袋散币。

examples.text: The man in the store won't give him change for the phone unless he buys something.
examples.translation: 店里的人不肯给他换硬币打电话，除非他买点什么。

examples.text: The courier had change for a £10 note.
examples.translation: 快递员能破开10英镑的纸币。

examples.text: You can expect to pay the bank a fee of around 1% to 2% every time you change money...
examples.translation: 每次到银行换币都会要求付1%到2%的手续费。

examples.text: If you travel frequently, find an agency that will change one foreign currency directly into another.
examples.translation: 如果经常旅行，找一家能直接兑换外币的旅行社。

examples.text: Now let me ask you a question, for a change...
examples.translation: 现在换我来问你一个问题吧。

examples.text: Liz settled back in her seat, comfortably relaxed, enjoying being driven for a change.
examples.translation: 莉兹舒服放松地倚在座位上，享受着换别人开车的惬意。

meanings.meaning: 性格，品质；特性；角色；[计] 字符

examples.text: Perhaps there is a negative side to his character that you haven't seen yet...
examples.translation: 或许，他性格中不好的一面你还没有看见。

examples.text: The character of this country has been formed by immigration.
examples.translation: 这个国家的国民性是由移民形成的。

examples.text: The financial concessions granted to British Aerospace were, he said, of a precarious character...
examples.translation: 他说，向英国宇航公司给予财政优惠未获证实。

examples.text: The state farms were semi-military in character.
examples.translation: 那些国有农场从性质上讲是半军事的。

examples.text: Individuality is a valued and inherent part of the British character.
examples.translation: 个性鲜明是英国人固有的、也是他们看重的特点。

examples.text: It's that kind of courage and determination that makes him such a remarkable character...
examples.translation: 就是那种勇气和决心使他成为如此了不起的人。

examples.text: What a sad character that Nigel is.
examples.translation: 奈杰尔真是个可悲的人哪。

examples.text: He's begun a series of personal attacks on my character...
examples.translation: 他开始对我进行一连串的人身攻击。

examples.text: Mr Bartman was a man of good character.
examples.translation: 巴特曼先生品德高尚。

examples.text: She showed real character in her attempts to win over the crowd...
examples.translation: 她在努力获得民众的支持时，表现出真正的人格力量。

examples.text: I didn't know Ron had that much strength of character.
examples.translation: 我当时不知道罗恩有那么坚强的个性。

examples.text: An ugly shopping centre stands across from one of the few buildings with character.
examples.translation: 一座难看的购物中心对面，耸立着为数不多的几幢别具特色的大楼之一。

examples.text: The film is autobiographical and the central character is played by Collard himself...
examples.translation: 这部电影是自传体，其中的主角由科勒德亲自扮演。

examples.text: He's made the characters believable.
examples.translation: 他让个个角色都逼真可信。

examples.text: He'll be sadly missed. He was a real character.
examples.translation: 人们会非常怀念他的，他可真是个有趣的人啊。

examples.text: It was entirely in character for Rachel to put her baby first...
examples.translation: 把自己的婴孩放在第一位，这完全符合雷切尔的性格。

examples.text: What else could make him behave so out of character?
examples.translation: 还有什么能让他做出这种如此失常的行为来？

meanings.meaning: 典型的；特有的；表示特性的

examples.text: Genes determine the characteristics of every living thing.
examples.translation: 基因决定每个生物的特征。

examples.text: ...their physical characteristics.
examples.translation: 他们的身体特征

examples.text: ...the absence of strife between the generations that was so characteristic of such societies...
examples.translation: 这些社会中典型的代际冲突的缺失

examples.text: Windmills are a characteristic feature of the Mallorcan landscape...
examples.translation: 风车是马略卡岛风光的一大特色。

examples.text: Nehru responded with characteristic generosity.
examples.translation: 尼赫鲁以他一贯的大度之风作了回答。

examples.text: He replied in characteristically robust style...
examples.translation: 像以往一样，他的回答铿锵有力。

examples.text: MacMillan's music characteristically makes a dramatic impact...
examples.translation: 麦克米伦的音乐一向给人很大的触动。

examples.text: Characteristically, he worked hard at the assignment.
examples.translation: 他一如既往地认真完成分派的任务。

meanings.meaning: 描绘…的特性；具有…的特征

examples.text: This election campaign has been characterized by violence...
examples.translation: 暴力行为已成为这次竞选活动的一大特点。

examples.text: A bold use of colour characterizes the bedroom.
examples.translation: 这间卧室的特点是用色大胆。

examples.text: Both companies have characterized the relationship as friendly...
examples.translation: 两家公司都认为彼此之间关系友好。

examples.text: This play is characterized as a comedy.
examples.translation: 这出戏被认为是喜剧。

examples.text: I don't fully agree with that characterization of the welfare system.
examples.translation: 我并不完全同意对福利制度的描述。

meanings.meaning: 慈善；施舍；慈善团体；宽容；施舍物

examples.text: The National Trust is a registered charity.
examples.translation: 全国托管协会是个已注册的慈善机构。

examples.text: ...an Aids charity.
examples.translation: 艾滋病慈善组织

examples.text: He made substantial donations to charity...
examples.translation: 他为慈善事业捐了很多钱。

examples.text: Gooch will be raising money for charity.
examples.translation: 古奇将进行慈善募捐。

examples.text: ...a charity event.
examples.translation: 慈善活动

examples.text: My mum was very proud. She wouldn't accept charity...
examples.translation: 母亲自尊心很强，不会接受施舍。

examples.text: Her husband is unemployed and the family depends on charity.
examples.translation: 她丈夫失业了，全家人靠救济金过日子。

meanings.meaning: 费用；电荷；掌管；控告；命令；负载
使充电；使承担；指责；装载；对…索费；向…冲去
充电；控告；索价；向前冲；记在账上

examples.text: Even local nurseries charge £100 a week...
examples.translation: 连本地托儿所每星期都要收费100英镑。

examples.text: The majority of stalls charged a fair price...
examples.translation: 多数货摊要价比较公道。

examples.text: The hospitals charge the patients for every aspirin...
examples.translation: 医院每一片阿司匹林都要病人掏钱。

examples.text: Some banks charge if you access your account to determine your balance.
examples.translation: 有些银行对查询账户余额要收费。

examples.text: ...the architect who charged us a fee of seven hundred and fifty pounds.
examples.translation: 那个向我们要了750英镑服务费的建筑师

examples.text: Go out and buy a pair of glasses, and charge it to us...
examples.translation: 去买副眼镜，账记在我们头上。

examples.text: All transactions have been charged to your account.
examples.translation: 所有交易都记在你的账户上了。

examples.text: We can arrange this for a small charge...
examples.translation: 我们可以将此安排好，只收取很少的费用。

examples.text: Customers who arrange overdrafts will face a monthly charge of £5.
examples.translation: 透支的客户每月要缴纳5英镑的费用。

examples.text: He may still face criminal charges...
examples.translation: 他可能仍然要面临刑事指控。

examples.text: They appeared at court yesterday to deny charges of murder.
examples.translation: 他们昨天出庭，否认谋杀的指控。

examples.text: They have the evidence to charge him...
examples.translation: 他们握有控告他的证据。

examples.text: Police have charged Mr Bell with murder.
examples.translation: 警方已经起诉贝尔先生犯有谋杀罪。

examples.text: He charged the minister with lying about the economy.
examples.translation: 他指责部长在经济问题上撒谎。

examples.text: A few years ago Bacryl took charge of the company...
examples.translation: 几年前，巴克里尔接管了该公司。

examples.text: I have been given charge of this class...
examples.translation: 我被分配负责这个班。

examples.text: They would never forget their time in his charge.
examples.translation: 他们永远忘不掉在他手下的日子。

examples.text: Who's in charge here?
examples.translation: 这儿谁管事啊？

examples.text: ...the Swiss governess in charge of the smaller children.
examples.translation: 负责照管小一些的孩子的瑞士女家庭教师

examples.text: The coach tried to get his charges motivated.
examples.translation: 教练试图激发队员的积极性。

examples.text: He charged through the door to my mother's office...
examples.translation: 他冲出门，往我母亲的办公室跑去。

examples.text: He ordered us to charge.
examples.translation: 他命令我们冲锋。

examples.text: ...a charging bull.
examples.translation: 猛冲过来的公牛

examples.text: ...a bayonet charge.
examples.translation: 拼刺刀

examples.text: Alex had forgotten to charge the battery.
examples.translation: 亚力克斯忘了给电池充电。

examples.text: There was nothing in the brochure about having to drive the car every day to charge up the battery.
examples.translation: 手册里只字没提这车要天天开，以给电池充电。

examples.text: The leaflet is available free of charge from post offices.
examples.translation: 宣传单可以到邮局免费领取。

examples.text: 'Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs', the 1937 Disney classic, has lost none of its original charm...
examples.translation: 1937年迪斯尼推出的经典之作《白雪公主和七个小矮人》魅力不减当年。

examples.text: The house had its charms, not the least of which was the furniture that came with it.
examples.translation: 这座房子有其吸引人的地方，比如和房子配套的家具就很出彩。

examples.text: He was a man of great charm and distinction.
examples.translation: 他这个人魅力十足，卓尔不群。

examples.text: He even charmed Mrs Prichard, carrying her shopping and flirting with her, though she's 83...
examples.translation: 他又是帮普里查德夫人拎买的东西，又是和她调情，居然把83岁高龄的她也给迷倒了。

examples.text: The Indians, in turn, were charmed by the famous author's cultured and civilised outlook...
examples.translation: 而印第安人呢，则为那位著名作家有教养的、开化的见解而折服。

examples.text: You can't force — or even charm — him into behaving differently if he doesn't want to.
examples.translation: 他要是不愿意改变自己的言行举止，你来软的还是硬的都没有用。

examples.text: ...charming his way into the British Embassy in Teheran...
examples.translation: 靠他的个人魅力打入英国驻德黑兰大使馆

examples.text: He charmed his way out of trouble.
examples.translation: 他运用自己的魅力摆脱了麻烦。

examples.text: He is good at charming money out of companies.
examples.translation: 他擅长利用自己的魅力从各家公司套钱。

examples.text: They cross their fingers and spit over their shoulders as charms against the evil eye.
examples.translation: 他们手指交叉，向身后吐口水，作为抵抗邪眼的魔法。

examples.text: ...a good luck charm.
examples.translation: 护身符

examples.text: He figured out that you're lonely, like most widows, and he turned on the charm.
examples.translation: 他看出你和大多数寡妇一样很寂寞，所以就拿出他的魅力来了。

examples.text: Economically, the policy worked like a charm.
examples.translation: 从经济上说，这个政策非常奏效。

meanings.meaning: 绘制…的图表；在海图上标出；详细计划；记录；记述；跟踪（进展或发展

examples.text: Male unemployment was 14.2%, compared with 5.8% for women (see chart on next page)...
examples.translation: 相比女性的5.8%，男性失业率为14.2%(见下页图表)。

examples.text: The chart below shows our top 10 choices.
examples.translation: 下图是我们优先考虑的10个选择。

examples.text: ...charts of Greek waters.
examples.translation: 希腊海域图

examples.text: Portuguese explorers had charted the west coast of Africa as far as Sierra Leone...
examples.translation: 葡萄牙探险家已经绘制出了远至塞拉里昂的非洲西海岸地图。

examples.text: Ptolemy charted more than 1000 stars in 48 constella-tions...
examples.translation: 托勒密绘制了48个星座1,000多颗恒星的星位图。

examples.text: These seas have been well charted.
examples.translation: 这些海域的海图已经相当精准。

examples.text: This album confirmed The Orb's status as national stars, going straight to Number One in the charts...
examples.translation: 这张专辑确立了The Orb作为全国明星的地位，销量直升至排行榜首位。

examples.text: They topped both the US singles and album charts at the same time.
examples.translation: 他们同时荣登美国单曲榜和专辑榜榜首。

examples.text: One GP has charted a dramatic rise in local childhood asthma since the M25 was built nearby...
examples.translation: 一位全科医生跟踪记录发现，自从附近修建了25号高速公路以来，当地哮喘病患儿数量急剧增加。

examples.text: This magnificent show charts his meteoric rise from 'small town' country singer to top international Rock idol...
examples.translation: 这场盛大的演出展示了他是如何从一个“小镇”乡村歌手一跃成为国际顶级摇滚偶像的。

examples.text: Bulletin boards charted each executive's progress.
examples.translation: 公告牌显示了每个主管人员的工作进展情况。

examples.text: We've charted a possible way forward...
examples.translation: 我们已经制订了下一步可能的计划。

examples.text: NATO had charted a new course for stability and cooperation in Europe...
examples.translation: 北约制订了保持欧洲稳定与合作的新计划。

examples.text: Your future is already neatly planned and charted.
examples.translation: 你的未来已经规划妥当。

meanings.meaning: 特许；包租；发给特许执照

examples.text: ...Article 50 of the United Nations Charter.
examples.translation: 《联合国宪章》第50款

examples.text: ...the Social Charter of workers' rights.
examples.translation: 保障劳工权利的《社会宪章》

examples.text: ...the last charter plane carrying out foreign nationals.
examples.translation: 运送外国侨民出境的最后一架包机

examples.text: ...frequent charter flights to Spain.
examples.translation: 到西班牙的定期包机航班

examples.text: He chartered a jet to fly her home from California to Switzerland...
examples.translation: 他包了架喷气式飞机把她从加利福尼亚送回瑞士家里。

examples.text: Yesterday, a cargo ship chartered by the UN arrived in the capital carrying 1,550 tons of rice.
examples.translation: 昨天，一艘联合国租用的货船到达首都，船上载有1,550吨大米。

examples.text: They described the Home Office scheme as a 'charter for cheats'...
examples.translation: 他们称内政部的方案是“对诈骗的纵容”。

examples.text: They condemned the white paper as a charter for centralisation and selective education.
examples.translation: 他们谴责白皮书是在怂恿中央集权和精英教育。

meanings.meaning: 追逐；追捕；试图赢得；雕镂

examples.text: She chased the thief for 100 yards...
examples.translation: 她追了窃贼100码远。

examples.text: He said nothing to waiting journalists, who chased after him as he left.
examples.translation: 他对等候的记者什么也没说就走了，那些记者跟在他后面追。

examples.text: He was reluctant to give up the chase...
examples.translation: 他很不情愿放弃追赶。

examples.text: Police said he was arrested without a struggle after a car chase through the streets of Biarritz.
examples.translation: 警方说，在比亚里茨的大街小巷经过一阵飞车追逐后，他便乖乖地束手就擒了。

examples.text: In Wales, 14 people are chasing every job...
examples.translation: 在威尔士，每份工作都有14个人在竞争。

examples.text: There are too many schools chasing too few pupils.
examples.translation: 太多的学校在争夺太少的生源。

examples.text: ...publishers and booksellers chasing after profits from high-volume sales.
examples.translation: 通过薄利多销追求利润的出版社和书商

examples.text: They took an invincible lead in the chase for the championship.
examples.translation: 他们在冠军争夺赛中居于不可动摇的领先地位。

examples.text: I'm not very good at flirting or chasing women...
examples.translation: 我不太会和女人调情，也不擅长追求女性。

examples.text: 'I was always chasing after unsuitable men,' she says.
examples.translation: “我以前老是追错人，”她说。

examples.text: The chase is always much more exciting than the conquest anyway.
examples.translation: 不管怎么说，追求的过程总比得手更为刺激。

examples.text: Many farmers will then chase you off their land quite aggressively...
examples.translation: 许多农民然后就会凶巴巴地把你从他们的土地上撵走。

examples.text: Angry demonstrators chased him away.
examples.translation: 愤怒的示威者把他赶跑了。

examples.text: Hi everyone, we all know why we are here today, so let's cut to the chase.
examples.translation: 嗨，各位，大伙儿都知道今天我们为什么在这里，那就直入正题吧。

examples.text: His single-minded pursuit of European union helped chase Mrs Thatcher from power.
examples.translation: 他对欧洲统一的执著追求在一定程度上促成了撒切尔夫人的下台。

examples.text: They chased down the stairs into the narrow, dirty street.
examples.translation: 他们冲下楼梯，来到狭窄、肮脏的街上。

examples.text: ...chasing about late at night in search of life's necessities.
examples.translation: 深更半夜东奔西跑寻找生活必需品

examples.text: ...bear robes, mountain lion hides, and other trophies of the chase.
examples.translation: 熊皮袍子、美洲狮的皮，以及这次狩猎的其他战利品

examples.text: ...the Champion Hunter Chase.
examples.translation: 猎人王越野赛马

examples.text: Other officers gave chase but the killers escaped.
examples.translation: 其他警官追了上去，可是杀手还是逃了。

examples.text: People who adore the thrill of the chase know that prizes, like diamonds, are worth striving for.
examples.translation: 享受追求过程中的刺激的人们清楚，奖赏和钻石一样，是值得为之一搏的。

meanings.meaning: (Chat)人名；(英)查特(教名Carol、Carola、Caroline、Carolyn的昵称)；(西)查特；(越)质；(柬)乍；(泰)察；(捷)哈特；(中)质(广东话·威妥玛)；(法)沙

examples.text: The women were chatting...
examples.translation: 女人们在聊天。

examples.text: I was chatting to him the other day...
examples.translation: 前几天我和他聊了一阵。

examples.text: He's chatting with his dad...
examples.translation: 他在和他爸爸闲聊。

examples.text: We chatted about old times.
examples.translation: 我们聊到过去的时光。

examples.text: I had a chat with John.
examples.translation: 我和约翰聊了一会儿。

meanings.meaning: 便宜的；小气的；不值钱的

examples.text: I'm going to live off campus if I can find somewhere cheap enough...
examples.translation: 要是能找到足够便宜的地方，我就不在校园里住了。

examples.text: Smoke detectors are cheap and easy to put up...
examples.translation: 烟雾报警器既不贵又易于安装。

examples.text: Running costs are coming down because of cheaper fuel...
examples.translation: 燃料价格下来了，运营费用也会跟着下降。

examples.text: They served breakfast all day and sold it cheap.
examples.translation: 他们全天供应早餐，而且价钱公道。

examples.text: It will produce electricity more cheaply than a nuclear plant.
examples.translation: 它的发电成本要比核电站低。

examples.text: The cheapness and simplicity of the design makes it ideal for our task.
examples.translation: 这个设计既便宜又朴素，非常适合我们的任务要求。

examples.text: Don't resort to cheap copies; save up for the real thing.
examples.translation: 别买廉价的仿冒品，攒点钱买正品吧。

examples.text: ...a tight suit made of some cheap material.
examples.translation: 用廉价面料做的紧身套装

examples.text: ...unscrupulous employers who treat children as a cheap source of labour.
examples.translation: 把儿童当廉价劳动力使用的黑心雇主

examples.text: These tests will inevitably be used by politicians to make cheap political points.
examples.translation: 这些测试必然会被政客们不失时机地拿去大做政治文章。

examples.text: Oh, please, Dad, just this once don't be cheap.
examples.translation: 哦，求求你，爸爸，就这一回，别抠门儿了。

examples.text: We will end up living in a society where life is cheap.
examples.translation: 我们最终将生活在一个视人命为儿戏的社会。

examples.text: Most modern housing estates are terrible and inevitably done on the cheap.
examples.translation: 现在的房子大多质量差劲透顶，肯定都是偷工减料盖起来的。

examples.text: Students may be tempted to cheat in order to get into top schools.
examples.translation: 为了能进入一流学校，学生们会忍不住想作弊。

examples.text: In an election in 1988, he was accused of cheating by his opponent.
examples.translation: 在1988年的一次选举中，他被对手指控舞弊。

examples.text: Cheats will be disqualified.
examples.translation: 弄虚作假者将被取消资格。

examples.text: The company engaged in a deliberate effort to cheat them out of their pensions...
examples.translation: 公司涉嫌蓄意骗取他们的养老金。

examples.text: Many brokers were charged with cheating customers in commodity trades.
examples.translation: 许多经纪人被指控在商品交易中欺骗顾客。

examples.text: He cheated death when he was rescued from the roof of his blazing cottage.
examples.translation: 他被人从他那熊熊燃烧的棚屋顶上救了下来，捡了条命。

examples.text: The storyline is fatally compromised by an ending that leaves you feeling horribly cheated.
examples.translation: 故事结尾让人很失望，这样的结尾严重削弱了故事情节。

meanings.meaning: 无礼地向…讲话，对…大胆无礼

examples.text: Tears were running down her cheeks...
examples.translation: 眼泪顺着她的脸颊流了下来。

examples.text: She kissed him lightly on both cheeks.
examples.translation: 她轻轻地吻了他的双颊。

examples.text: ...rosy-cheeked children.
examples.translation: 脸蛋红扑扑的孩子们

examples.text: ...a fat, chubby-cheeked fellow.
examples.translation: 脸上肥嘟嘟的胖家伙

examples.text: I'm amazed they had the cheek to ask in the first place...
examples.translation: 我真惊讶他们当初竟然有脸问。

examples.text: I still think it's a bit of a cheek sending a voucher rather than a refund...
examples.translation: 我还是认为，他们寄来优惠购物券，而不是退款，真是有些厚颜无耻。

examples.text: The cheek of it, lying to me like that!
examples.translation: 真不要脸，竟然对我撒那样的谎！

meanings.meaning: 欢呼；愉快；心情；令人愉快的事

examples.text: The crowd cheered as Premier Wayne Goss unveiled a lifesize statue of poet Banjo Paterson...
examples.translation: 韦恩·戈斯州长揭开诗人巴尼奥·佩特森的等身塑像时，人群欢呼起来。

examples.text: Swiss fans cheered Jakob Hlasek during yesterday's match with Courier.
examples.translation: 昨天，瑞士球迷在雅各布·赫拉塞克对阵库里耶的比赛中为赫拉塞克喝彩加油。

examples.text: ...the Irish Americans who came to the park to cheer for their boys...
examples.translation: 赶到球场为他们的家乡球员助威的爱尔兰裔美国人

examples.text: Cheering crowds lined the route.
examples.translation: 沿途两旁站着欢呼的人群。

examples.text: The colonel was rewarded with a resounding cheer from the men.
examples.translation: 士兵对上校报以震天的欢呼声。

examples.text: Stephen noticed that the people around him looked cheered by his presence...
examples.translation: 斯蒂芬注意到，周围的人们似乎因为他的到来而受到鼓舞。

examples.text: The weather was perfect for a picnic, he told himself, but the thought did nothing to cheer him.
examples.translation: 他告诉自己，那样的天气出去野餐再合适不过了，可是，这丝毫不能让他提起精神来。

examples.text: ...very cheering news...
examples.translation: 振奋人心的消息

examples.text: It is cheering to see that customers are to benefit from a rebate on their electricity bills.
examples.translation: 想到顾客将享受电费部分退款优惠就叫人心里高兴。

examples.text: They were impressed by his steadfast good cheer...
examples.translation: 他整天笑呵呵的样子给他们留下很深的印象。

examples.text: A timely bingo win brought some cheer to Juliet Little's family yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天玩宾戈赢了一把，适时地给朱丽叶·利特尔一家带来些许的欢快心情。

examples.text: ...bread and cheese.
examples.translation: 涂了奶酪的面包

examples.text: ...cheese sauce...
examples.translation: 奶酪酱

examples.text: He cut the mould off a piece of cheese.
examples.translation: 他把霉菌从奶酪上切掉。

examples.text: ...delicious French cheeses.
examples.translation: 美味的法国干酪

examples.text: He is a big cheese in the Art Fraud Squad.
examples.translation: 他是反艺术诈骗专案组的重要人物。

examples.text: ...big cheeses from the State Department.
examples.translation: 国务院来的大人物

examples.text: But local pastry chef Elias da Silva claims he brought the recipe to Macau first.

meanings.meaning: 化学家；化学工作者；药剂师；炼金术士

examples.text: There are many creams available from the chemist which should clear the infection...
examples.translation: 很多能够消除这种感染的药膏在药店就能买到。

examples.text: She went into a chemist's and bought some aspirin.
examples.translation: 她进了一家药店，买了些阿司匹林。

examples.text: She worked as a research chemist.
examples.translation: 她曾经是化学研究员。

examples.text: We have literally altered the chemistry of our planet's atmosphere...
examples.translation: 我们确实改变了地球大气层的化学构成。

examples.text: If the supply of vitamins and minerals in the diet is inadequate, this will result in changes in body chemistry.
examples.translation: 如果饮食中的维生素和矿物质含量太低，将会引起人体化学结构的变化。

examples.text: ...the extraordinary chemistry between Ingrid and Bogart...
examples.translation: 英格丽和鲍嘉之间的情意绵绵

examples.text: Janis and I became friends but we were never close. The chemistry wasn't there.
examples.translation: 我和贾妮斯成了朋友，可我们从未走得太近，没有那种感觉。

examples.text: ...chemical reactions that cause ozone destruction.
examples.translation: 导致臭氧受到破坏的化学反应

examples.text: ...the chemical composition of the ocean.
examples.translation: 海洋的化学成分

examples.text: ...chemical weapons.
examples.translation: 化学武器

examples.text: ...chemically treated foods...
examples.translation: 用化学方法加工的食品

examples.text: The medicine chemically affects your physiology.
examples.translation: 这种药会通过化学作用影响生理机能。

examples.text: The whole food chain is affected by the overuse of chemicals in agriculture.
examples.translation: 整个食物链因农业生产过程过多使用化学品而受到影响。

examples.text: ...a chemicals company.
examples.translation: 化工公司

examples.text: ...the chemical industry.
examples.translation: 化工行业

examples.text: He wrote them a cheque for £10,000...
examples.translation: 他给他们开了张1万英镑的支票。

examples.text: I'd like to pay by cheque.
examples.translation: 我想用支票结账。

meanings.meaning: 怀有（感情等）；抱有（希望等）

examples.text: The president will cherish the memory of this visit to Ohio...
examples.translation: 总统将铭记这次俄亥俄之行。

examples.text: It was a wonderful occasion which we will cherish for many years to come.
examples.translation: 那是一个美好的时刻，我们将多年不忘。

examples.text: ...the cherished dream of a world without wars.
examples.translation: 梦想着一个没有战争的世界

examples.text: He genuinely loved and cherished her...
examples.translation: 他由衷地爱恋并珍惜她。

examples.text: The previous owners had cherished the house.
examples.translation: 房子先前的主人非常爱惜这房子。

examples.text: He described the picture as his most cherished possession.
examples.translation: 他说那幅画是他最珍爱的财产。

examples.text: These people cherish their independence and sovereignty.
examples.translation: 这些人民珍视他们的独立和主权。

examples.text: Freud called into question some deeply cherished beliefs.
examples.translation: 弗洛伊德对人们先前深信不疑的一些观念提出了质疑。
