examples.text: The banks have long competed with American Express's charge cards and various store cards...
examples.translation: 长久以来，这些银行一直在与美国运通公司的信用卡以及各式各样的商场赊购卡竞争。

examples.text: The stores will inevitably end up competing with each other in their push for increased market shares...
examples.translation: 在努力争取更大的市场份额的过程中，这些商场最终将不可避免地相互展开竞争。

examples.text: Banks and building societies are competing fiercely for business...
examples.translation: 银行和购房互助协会为了争夺业务而展开激烈的竞争。

examples.text: The American economy, and its ability to compete abroad, was slowing down according to the report.
examples.translation: 根据这项报告，美国经济及其海外竞争能力发展的速度开始放缓。

examples.text: Kangaroos compete with sheep and cattle for sparse supplies of food and water...
examples.translation: 袋鼠与牛羊争夺稀少的食物和水。

examples.text: Schools should not compete with each other or attempt to poach pupils...
examples.translation: 学校之间不应该相互竞争，也不应该企图挖走彼此的学生。

examples.text: More than 2300 candidates from 93 political parties are competing for 486 seats.
examples.translation: 来自93个政党的2,300多位候选人将争夺486个席位。

examples.text: He will be competing in the London-Calais-London race...
examples.translation: 他将参加伦敦至加来的航海往返赛。

examples.text: Dubbed foreign language films will not be allowed to compete for best film...
examples.translation: 外国译制片不得参加最佳影片的角逐。

examples.text: It is essential for all players who wish to compete that they earn computer ranking points.
examples.translation: 对所有希望参赛的选手来说，获得电脑排名的分数非常重要。

meanings.meaning: 胜任的；有能力的；能干的；足够的

examples.text: He was a loyal, distinguished and very competent civil servant.
examples.translation: 他是一位敬业、优秀而且非常称职的公务员。

examples.text: ...a competent performance.
examples.translation: 令人满意的表现

examples.text: The government performed competently in the face of multiple challenges.
examples.translation: 面临多种挑战，政府表现得非常出色。

examples.text: Most adults do not feel competent to deal with a medical emergency involving a child.
examples.translation: 大部分成年人不懂得如何对儿童实施急救。

examples.text: There's been some fierce competition for the title...
examples.translation: 夺冠之争一直都相当激烈。

examples.text: It was in these studios that young painters found the support and stimulating competition of peers.
examples.translation: 就是在这些画室里，年轻的画家们得到了同龄人的支持，也感受到了激励大家向前的竞争。

examples.text: I have to change my approach, the competition is too good now.
examples.translation: 我得改变方法，现在的竞争对手太强。

examples.text: The deal would have reduced competition in the commuter-aircraft market...
examples.translation: 这项协议原本会减少通勤航班市场的竞争。

examples.text: The farmers have been seeking higher prices as better protection from foreign competition...
examples.translation: 农场主们一直在寻找更高的价格，以更好地保护自己不受国外竞争对手的影响。

examples.text: Clothing stores also face heavy competition from factory outlets.
examples.translation: 成衣店也面临着来自工厂直销店的激烈竞争。

examples.text: The American aerospace industry has been challenged by some stiff competition.
examples.translation: 美国航空和航天工业已经受到某种强劲的竞争产品的挑战。

examples.text: ...a surfing competition...
examples.translation: 冲浪比赛

examples.text: The council has organised a series of events and competitions for school children in the area...
examples.translation: 委员会为本地区的中小学生组织了一系列的活动和比赛。

examples.text: He will be banned from international competition for four years.
examples.translation: 他将被禁赛4年，禁赛期间不能参加任何国际比赛。

meanings.meaning: 竞争的；比赛的；求胜心切的

examples.text: Only by keeping down costs will America maintain its competitive advantage over other countries...
examples.translation: 只有通过控制成本，美国才能保持对其他国家的竞争优势。

examples.text: Japan is a highly competitive market system...
examples.translation: 日本实行竞争激烈的市场体制。

examples.text: Universities are very competitive for the best students.
examples.translation: 大学对优等生的争夺十分激烈。

examples.text: He's now back up on the slopes again, skiing competitively in events for the disabled.
examples.translation: 他复出了，在残疾人滑雪比赛中表现不俗。

examples.text: He has always been ambitious and fiercely competitive...
examples.translation: 他一直都雄心勃勃，而且极其好胜。

examples.text: I'm a very competitive person and I was determined not be beaten.
examples.translation: 我非常要强，下定决心不能输给别人。

examples.text: They worked hard together, competitively and under pressure.
examples.translation: 他们在一起干得很卖力，顶着压力，一心求胜。

examples.text: I can't stand the pace, I suppose, and the competitiveness, and the unfriendliness.
examples.translation: 我觉得我无法适应紧张的节奏，还有那种相互竞争和冷漠的关系。

examples.text: Only those homes offered for sale at competitive prices will secure interest from serious purchasers.
examples.translation: 只有那些价格优惠的住房才会引起真想买房的人的兴趣。

examples.text: ...a travel company specialising in amazingly competitive rates for flights.
examples.translation: 专门提供极优惠航班折扣的旅游公司

examples.text: ...a number of early Martin and Gibson guitars, which were competitively priced.
examples.translation: 几把标价优惠的早期马丁吉他和吉布森吉他

examples.text: It is only on the world market that we can prove the competitiveness and quality of our goods.
examples.translation: 只有在世界市场上我们才能证明自身商品的竞争力和质量。

meanings.meaning: 编译；编制；编辑；[图情] 汇编

examples.text: Councils were required to compile a register of all adults living in their areas...
examples.translation: 各地政务委员会被要求编制一份该地区成年居民的名册。

examples.text: The book took 10 years to compile...
examples.translation: 编这本书花了10年时间。

examples.text: A report compiled by the Fed's Philadelphia branch described the economy as weak.
examples.translation: 一份由联邦储备银行的费城分部汇编的报告说经济不景气。

examples.text: There have been enormous advances in the compilation of data on suspected terrorists.
examples.translation: 恐怖嫌疑犯的资料收集工作已经取得了非常大的进展。

examples.text: Miners have complained bitterly that the government did not fulfill their promises...
examples.translation: 矿工们愤愤不平地抱怨说政府没有履行诺言。

examples.text: The American couple complained about the high cost of visiting Europe...
examples.translation: 这对美国夫妇抱怨到欧洲旅行的花销太高。

examples.text: For my own part, I have nothing to complain of...
examples.translation: 我这方面没有什么好抱怨的。

examples.text: They are liable to face more mistreatment if they complain to the police...
examples.translation: 如果他们向警方投诉，可能会受到更多虐待。

examples.text: People should complain when they consider an advert offensive...
examples.translation: 民众如果认为某个广告具有冒犯性就应该投诉。

examples.text: 'I do everything you ask of me,' he complained.
examples.translation: “你要我做的事我都做了。”他抱怨道。

examples.text: He complained of a headache.
examples.translation: 他说头痛。

examples.text: There's been a record number of complaints about the standard of service on Britain's railways...
examples.translation: 有关英国铁路服务水平的投诉空前的多。

examples.text: People have been reluctant to make formal complaints to the police...
examples.translation: 人们不愿向警方作出正式投诉。

examples.text: If you feel you have any cause for complaint about the service you should write to the Hospital Administrator.
examples.translation: 如果你觉得对服务有任何不满，应该写信给医院院长。

examples.text: If you have a complaint about shoes bought from a shop covered by the Footwear Code, there are several ways of putting the matter right...
examples.translation: 如果对在Footwear Code旗下零售店里买的鞋有不满意的地方，有几种解决问题的方式。

examples.text: I've got no complaints about them...
examples.translation: 对他们我没什么意见。

examples.text: My main complaint is that we can't go out on the racecourse anymore.
examples.translation: 我投诉的主要问题是我们没法再去外面的赛道了。

examples.text: Eczema is a common skin complaint which often runs in families.
examples.translation: 湿疹是一种常见的皮肤病，通常具遗传性。

examples.text: Nutmeg, parsley and cider all complement the flavour of these beans well.
examples.translation: 肉豆蔻、西芹和苹果酒都能很好地突出这些豆子的味道。

examples.text: There will be a written examination to complement the practical test...
examples.translation: 会有笔试作为实践考试的补充。

examples.text: We complement one another perfectly.
examples.translation: 我们相互取长补短，堪称完美。

examples.text: The green wallpaper is the perfect complement to the old pine of the dresser...
examples.translation: 绿色的墙纸完美地衬托出衣橱那年代久远的松木。

examples.text: Political knowledge is a necessary complement to science in approaching solutions to these problems.
examples.translation: 在寻找解决这些问题的方法时，需要有政治知识作为对科学知识的补充。

examples.text: Each ship had a complement of around a dozen officers and 250 men...
examples.translation: 每艘船的编制人数约为军官12位，船员250名。

examples.text: Not one house on the Close still had its full complement of windows.
examples.translation: 克洛斯岛上没有一所房子的窗户仍旧是齐全的。

examples.text: The rebels had taken complete control...
examples.translation: 叛乱分子完全控制了局面。

examples.text: It shows a complete lack of understanding by management...
examples.translation: 这表明管理层对此完全不了解。

examples.text: The resignation came as a complete surprise...
examples.translation: 辞职来得十分意外。

examples.text: He was the complete opposite of Raymond.
examples.translation: 他与雷蒙德完全相反。

examples.text: Dozens of flats had been completely destroyed...
examples.translation: 许多公寓已经被完全破坏了。

examples.text: Make sure that you defrost it completely.
examples.translation: 一定要完全解冻。

examples.text: ...something completely different.
examples.translation: 截然不同的事

examples.text: A complete tenement block was burnt to the ground...
examples.translation: 整幢公寓大楼被付之一炬。

examples.text: The job sheets eventually filled a complete book.
examples.translation: 工作指导卡最终装满了整整一个册子。

examples.text: The list may not be complete.
examples.translation: 这个单子可能不全。

examples.text: ...a complete dinner service...
examples.translation: 一整套餐具

examples.text: No garden is complete without a bed of rose bushes.
examples.translation: 没有玫瑰花圃的花园是不完整的。

examples.text: ...the accuracy and completeness of the information obtained.
examples.translation: 所获信息的精确性和完整性

examples.text: Children don't complete their set of 20 baby teeth until they are two to three years old.
examples.translation: 小孩要到两三岁才会长齐20颗乳牙。

examples.text: ...the stickers needed to complete the collection.
examples.translation: 集全一整套所需的贴纸

examples.text: ...the Complete Works of William Shakespeare.
examples.translation: 《威廉·莎士比亚全集》

examples.text: The diary comes complete with a gold-coloured ballpoint pen.
examples.translation: 这个日记本配有一支金色的圆珠笔。

examples.text: The work of restoring the farmhouse is complete...
examples.translation: 修复农舍的工作已经完成。

examples.text: It'll be two years before the process is complete.
examples.translation: 这个过程需要两年才能完成。

examples.text: Peter Mayle has just completed his first novel.
examples.translation: 彼得·梅尔刚刚完成他的第一部小说。

examples.text: ...the rush to get the stadiums completed on time.
examples.translation: 为了让各个体育场按时完工进行的匆忙赶工

examples.text: The project is nearing completion...
examples.translation: 这个项目即将结束。

examples.text: House completions for the year should be up from 1,841 to 2,200.
examples.translation: 今年竣工的房屋将会从1,841幢增加到2,200幢。

examples.text: She completed her degree in two years...
examples.translation: 她用两年的时间修完了课程，拿到了学位。

examples.text: This book took years to complete.
examples.translation: 这本书耗时多年才写完。

examples.text: Simply complete the coupon below...
examples.translation: 填写下面的订货单即可。

examples.text: We ask candidates to complete a psychometric questionnaire...
examples.translation: 我们让候选人填写一份心理测试问卷。

examples.text: Use the enclosed envelope to return your completed survey.
examples.translation: 请用随信附上的信封将填好的调查表寄回。

examples.text: He was the complete all-round journalist.
examples.translation: 他是一名全能的记者。

meanings.meaning: 使复杂化；使恶化；使卷入

examples.text: What complicates the issue is the burden of history...
examples.translation: 历史的重负使问题复杂化了。

examples.text: The day's events, he said, would only complicate the task of the peacekeeping forces...
examples.translation: 他说白天发生的事件只会使维和部队的任务更为复杂。

examples.text: To complicate matters further, everybody's vitamin requirements vary...
examples.translation: 更麻烦的是，每个人对维生素的需求量是不同的。

examples.text: Bad weather continues to complicate efforts to deal with oil spilling from the tanker.
examples.translation: 恶劣天气使得油轮溢油的处理工作更为复杂。

examples.text: ...in-depth coverage of today's complex issues.
examples.translation: 对时下一些复杂问题的深度报道

examples.text: ...a complex system of voting.
examples.translation: 错综复杂的选举体制

examples.text: ...her complex personality.
examples.translation: 她复杂的性格

examples.text: ...complex machines.
examples.translation: 结构复杂的机器

examples.text: ...plans for constructing a new stadium and leisure complex.
examples.translation: 修建新体育场和休闲中心的计划

examples.text: ...a complex of offices and flats.
examples.translation: 商住综合楼

examples.text: ...the complex of clans which occupied the land.
examples.translation: 生活在这片土地上的关系复杂的氏族群落

examples.text: ...the military-industrial complex.
examples.translation: 军工综合企业

examples.text: I have never had a complex about my height.
examples.translation: 我从来没有担心过自己的身高。

examples.text: ...a deranged attacker, driven by a persecution complex.
examples.translation: 患有受迫害妄想症、精神失常的袭击者

examples.text: The situation in Lebanon is very complicated.
examples.translation: 黎巴嫩的情况十分复杂。

examples.text: ...a very complicated voting system.
examples.translation: 非常复杂的选举体制

meanings.meaning: 并发症；复杂；复杂化；混乱

examples.text: The age difference was a complication to the relationship...
examples.translation: 年龄差异使得双方交往更加困难。

examples.text: An added complication is the growing concern for the environment.
examples.translation: 还有个问题就是对环境的日益关注。

examples.text: Blindness is a common complication of diabetes...
examples.translation: 失明是糖尿病常见的并发症。

examples.text: He died of complications from a heart attack.
examples.translation: 他死于心脏病发作引起的并发症。

meanings.meaning: 恭维；称赞；问候；致意；道贺

examples.text: You can do no harm by paying a woman compliments...
examples.translation: 对女人说些恭维话没有坏处。

examples.text: 'Well done, Cassandra,' Crook said. She blushed, but accepted the compliment with good grace.
examples.translation: “干得好，卡桑德拉。”克鲁克说。她脸一下子红了，但还是很有风度地接受了恭维。

examples.text: They complimented me on the way I looked each time they saw me...
examples.translation: 每次见到我，他们都称赞我的外貌。

examples.text: Firstly I compliment you on most of your excellent Spring issue of 'Triangle'.
examples.translation: 首先，让我来夸几句，你们《三角迷踪》春季号的大部分内容都非常精彩。

examples.text: We consider it a compliment to be called 'conservative'...
examples.translation: 我们认为被称作“保守分子”是对我们的一种赞赏。

examples.text: It's obvious he's worried about us and I'm taking it as a compliment.
examples.translation: 显然他担心我们，我把这当做一种赞美。

examples.text: My compliments to the chef...
examples.translation: 请向厨师代为致意！

examples.text: Give my compliments to your lovely wife when you write home.
examples.translation: 写信回家的时候，代我问候你可爱的妻子。

examples.text: The actors have entertained us so splendidly during this weekend, I think it's time we returned the compliment.
examples.translation: 这周末演员们给我们带来了精彩的演出，我觉得我们该回请他们了。

examples.text: Please give this to your boss with my compliments...
examples.translation: 请把这个给你的老板，算是我的一点心意。

examples.text: On my bedside table awaited, with the compliments of the management, an appetizing breakfast.
examples.translation: 一份让人垂涎的早餐摆在我的床头桌上，那是管理人员的一点小意思。

examples.text: The commander said that the army would comply with the ceasefire...
examples.translation: 指挥官说军队会遵守停火协议。

examples.text: Some beaches had failed to comply with European directives on bathing water...
examples.translation: 有些海滩未能遵守欧洲有关浴场的指令。

examples.text: There are calls for his resignation, but there is no sign yet that he will comply.
examples.translation: 有人要求他辞职，不过还没有迹象表明他会屈从。

meanings.meaning: 成分；组件；[电子] 元件

examples.text: Enriched uranium is a key component of a nuclear weapon...
examples.translation: 浓缩铀是核武器的关键组成部分。

examples.text: The management plan has four main components...
examples.translation: 管理计划有4个主要部分。

examples.text: They were automotive component suppliers to motor manufacturers.
examples.translation: 他们为汽车制造商供应汽车零件。

examples.text: Gorbachev failed to keep the component parts of the Soviet Union together...
examples.translation: 戈尔巴乔夫没能把苏联各成员国团结在一起。

examples.text: Polish workers will now be making component parts for Boeing 757s.
examples.translation: 现在波音757飞机的组成部件将由波兰工人制造。

meanings.meaning: 构成；写作；使平静；排…的版

examples.text: The force would be composed of troops from NATO countries...
examples.translation: 这支军队将由来自北约国家的部队组成。

examples.text: Protein molecules compose all the complex working parts of living cells...
examples.translation: 活细胞中所有复杂的运行成分都由蛋白质分子构成。

examples.text: They agreed to form a council composed of leaders of the rival factions.
examples.translation: 他们同意成立一个由敌对派系的领袖组成的委员会。

examples.text: Vivaldi composed a large number of very fine concertos...
examples.translation: 维瓦尔第创作了很多非常优美的协奏曲。

examples.text: Cale also uses electronic keyboards to compose.
examples.translation: 凯尔也用电子键盘谱曲。

examples.text: He started at once to compose a reply to Anna...
examples.translation: 他马上开始给安娜写回信。

examples.text: The document composed in Philadelphia transformed the confederation of sovereign states into a national government.
examples.translation: 在费城起草的这份文件使具有独立主权的各州组成的邦联变成了国家政府。

examples.text: Anthony dismounted with his camera and walked away from the walls to compose a shot...
examples.translation: 安东尼拿着照相机下了车，走向离城墙更远的地方，为拍摄构图。

examples.text: The drawing is beautifully composed.
examples.translation: 这幅画的构图很美。

examples.text: She quickly composed herself as the car started off...
examples.translation: 车一上路，她就很快让自己平静了下来。

examples.text: Then he composed his features, took Godwin's hand awkwardly and began to usher him from the office.
examples.translation: 然后他定了定神，尴尬地牵着戈德温的手，开始引领他离开办公室。

examples.text: Galton devised a method of creating composite pictures in which the features of different faces were superimposed over one another.
examples.translation: 高尔顿发明了一种把不同人的五官相互叠加在一起的制作合成照片的方法。

examples.text: Spain is a composite of diverse traditions and people.
examples.translation: 西班牙是一个汇集了多种传统和民族的国家。

meanings.meaning: 作文，作曲，作品；[材] 构成；合成物；成分

examples.text: Television has transformed the size and social composition of the audience at great sporting occasions...
examples.translation: 电视改变了重大体育赛事观众的规模和其社会阶层构成结构。

examples.text: Forests vary greatly in composition from one part of the country to another.
examples.translation: 一个国家不同区域的森林在组成结构上存在很大的差异。

examples.text: Mozart's compositions are undoubtedly amongst the world's greatest.
examples.translation: 莫扎特的作品无疑位居世界上最伟大的作品之列。

examples.text: He taught the piano, organ and composition...
examples.translation: 他教授钢琴、管风琴和作曲。

examples.text: The course is designed to help students with colour and composition.
examples.translation: 设置这门课程是为了指导学生如何运用色彩和构图。

examples.text: These plays are arranged in their order of composition.
examples.translation: 这些剧作是按照其创作的先后顺序安排的。

meanings.meaning: 合成；混合；和解妥协；搀合
[化学] 化合物；混合物；复合词

examples.text: Police fired on them as they fled into the embassy compound.
examples.translation: 当他们逃进使馆大院时，警察向他们开了枪。

examples.text: ...a military compound.
examples.translation: 军营

examples.text: Organic compounds contain carbon in their molecules.
examples.translation: 有机化合物的分子中含碳。

examples.text: Honey is basically a compound of water, two types of sugar, vitamins and enzymes.
examples.translation: 蜂蜜基本上是水、两种糖、几种维生素和酶的混合物。

examples.text: ...a tall shrub with shiny compound leaves.
examples.translation: 长有油光闪亮的复叶的高株灌木

examples.text: ...the compound microscope.
examples.translation: 复式显微镜

examples.text: Additional bloodshed and loss of life will only compound the tragedy...
examples.translation: 额外的流血和牺牲只会加重这场悲剧。

examples.text: The problem is compounded by the medical system here.
examples.translation: 这儿的医疗体制使问题进一步恶化。

examples.text: This was utterly beyond her comprehension.
examples.translation: 这让她完全无法理解。

examples.text: They turned to one another with the same expression of dawning comprehension, surprise, and relief.
examples.translation: 他们相互看了看，脸上都是同一种表情，恍然大悟、惊讶，而又如释重负。

examples.text: The course also features creative writing exercises and listening comprehension.
examples.translation: 这门课程也包括写作练习和听力理解。

examples.text: I just cannot comprehend your attitude...
examples.translation: 我就是无法理解你的态度。

examples.text: Whenever she failed to comprehend she invariably laughed.
examples.translation: 每当她听不懂的时候，她总是会笑。

meanings.meaning: 综合的；广泛的；有理解力的
综合学校；专业综合测验

examples.text: The Rough Guide to Nepal is a comprehensive guide to the region.
examples.translation: 《尼泊尔概况》是一本全面介绍该地区的旅游指南。

examples.text: ...Birmingham's inner-city comprehensives...
examples.translation: 伯明翰旧城区的综合中学

examples.text: She taught French at Cheam Comprehensive in South London.
examples.translation: 她在伦敦南部的奇姆综合中学教法语。

examples.text: He left comprehensive school at the age of 16.
examples.translation: 他16岁就从综合中学毕业了。

examples.text: ...Rushcliffe Comprehensive School.
examples.translation: 拉什克利夫综合中学

examples.text: Poor posture, sitting or walking slouched over, compresses the body's organs...
examples.translation: 坐着或者走路的时候低头垂肩，这种不正确的姿势会压迫体内的器官。

examples.text: Air will compress but the brake fluid won't.
examples.translation: 空气会压缩，但是刹车油不会。

examples.text: The compression of the wood is easily achieved.
examples.translation: 木头很容易压紧。

examples.text: He never understood how to organize or compress large masses of material...
examples.translation: 他从来就不懂如何对大篇的材料进行整理或精简。

examples.text: All those three books are compacted and compressed into one book.
examples.translation: 那三本书的内容全都压缩进一本书了。

examples.text: The four debates will be compressed into an unprecedentedly short eight-day period...
examples.translation: 这4场辩论将被压缩到短短8天的时间，这是前所未有的。

examples.text: Some courses such as engineering had to be compressed.
examples.translation: 有些课程，比如工程学，必须减少课时。

examples.text: Sore throats may be relieved by cold compresses.
examples.translation: 喉咙痛用冷敷布敷一下可能会好一些。

examples.text: The special cabinet committee comprises Mr Brown, Mr Mandelson, and Mr Straw...
examples.translation: 特别内阁委员会包括布朗先生、曼德尔森先生和斯特劳先生。

examples.text: The exhibition comprises 50 oils and watercolours...
examples.translation: 展览陈列了50幅油画和水彩画。

examples.text: The task force is comprised of congressional leaders, cabinet heads and administration officials...
examples.translation: 工作小组由国会领导人、内阁首脑和行政官员组成。

examples.text: A crowd comprised of the wives and children of scientists staged a demonstration.
examples.translation: 由科学家们的妻儿们组成的队伍举行了示威游行。

examples.text: ...the multitude of ideas, ambitions and regrets that comprises the culture of Russia today...
examples.translation: 构成现今俄罗斯文化的众多观点、抱负和遗憾

examples.text: Women comprise 44% of hospital medical staff.
examples.translation: 女性占医院医护人员的44%。

meanings.meaning: 义务的；必修的；被强制的
（花样滑冰、竞技体操等的）规定动作

examples.text: In East Germany learning Russian was compulsory...
examples.translation: 在东德，俄语是必修课。

examples.text: Many young men are trying to get away from compulsory military conscription.
examples.translation: 很多年轻人试图逃避强制征兵的政策。

examples.text: Five of the company's senior managers have been made compulsorily redundant.
examples.translation: 公司的高级经理中有5位已经被强制性地裁掉。

examples.text: Encourage your child to reach a compromise between what he wants and what you want...
examples.translation: 鼓励孩子在他的愿望和你的愿望之间找到一个折中点。

examples.text: Be ready and willing to make compromises between your needs and those of your partner...
examples.translation: 时刻准备好并乐意在自己与伴侣的需求之间作出让步。

examples.text: The government's policy of compromise is not universally popular.
examples.translation: 政府的妥协政策并没有受到普遍欢迎。

examples.text: The government has compromised with its critics over monetary policies...
examples.translation: 政府已经就货币政策向批评人士作出让步。

examples.text: 'Nine,' said I. 'Nine thirty,' tried he. We compromised on 9.15...
examples.translation: “9点。”我说。“9点半。”他试着说。于是我们各让一步，定在了9点一刻。

examples.text: Israel had originally wanted $1 billion in aid, but compromised on the $650 million.
examples.translation: 以色列原本想要获得10亿美元的援助，但后来作出让步，同意接受6.5亿的援助。

examples.text: ...members of the government who have compromised themselves by co-operating with the emergency committee...
examples.translation: 因与紧急委员会合作而使自己名誉受损的政府成员

examples.text: He would rather shoot himself than compromise his principles.
examples.translation: 他宁愿一枪打死自己也不愿违背自己的原则。

meanings.meaning: 计算；估算；用计算机计算

examples.text: I tried to compute the cash value of the ponies and horse boxes.
examples.translation: 我试着算了算马驹和运马拖车的现金价值。

meanings.meaning: 计算机；电脑；电子计算机

examples.text: The data are then fed into a computer...
examples.translation: 数据随后被输入电脑。

examples.text: The company installed a $650,000 computer system...
examples.translation: 这家公司安装了价值65万美元的电脑系统。

examples.text: It's done on a computer?...
examples.translation: 这是在电脑做的？

examples.text: The car was designed by computer.
examples.translation: 这款车是由电脑设计的。

examples.text: Unlike so many of his comrades he survived the war.
examples.translation: 和许多战友不同，他在战争中幸存下来。

examples.text: The Party's authority, comrades, will be put to a serious test.
examples.translation: 同志们，党的权威将受到严重的考验。

examples.text: Frances decided to conceal the machine behind a hinged panel...
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯决定把机器藏在带铰链的嵌板的后面。

examples.text: Five people were arrested for carrying concealed weapons.
examples.translation: 5人因身上藏有武器被捕。

examples.text: Robert could not conceal his relief...
examples.translation: 罗伯特无法掩饰自己如释重负的心情。

examples.text: She knew at once that he was concealing something from her.
examples.translation: 她马上知道了他有事瞒着她。

examples.text: ...a pair of carved Indian doors which conceal a built-in cupboard...
examples.translation: 嵌入式壁橱上的一对印度雕花门

examples.text: The hat concealed her hair.
examples.translation: 帽子遮住了她的头发。

examples.text: Bess finally conceded that Nancy was right...
examples.translation: 贝丝最终承认了南希是对的。

examples.text: 'Well,' he conceded, 'I do sometimes mumble a bit.'...
examples.translation: “嗯，”他承认道，“我有时候说话的确有点吐字不清。”

examples.text: Mr. Chapman conceded the need for Nomura's U.S. unit to improve its trading skills.
examples.translation: 查普曼先生承认野村证券美国分公司需要提高股票交易技巧。

examples.text: The government conceded the right to establish independent trade unions...
examples.translation: 政府承认建立独立工会的权利。

examples.text: Facing total defeat in Vietnam, the French subsequently conceded full independence to Laos.
examples.translation: 法国人在越南面临彻底的失败后，接着又让老挝取得了完全的独立。

examples.text: A strike by some ten thousand bank employees has ended after the government conceded some of their demands.
examples.translation: 政府答应了他们的一些要求后，大约有一万名银行员工参加的罢工结束了。

examples.text: They conceded four goals to Leeds United...
examples.translation: 他们被利兹联队攻进4个球。

examples.text: Luton conceded a free kick on the edge of the penalty area.
examples.translation: 卢顿未能在罚球区的边缘截住对方的任意球。

examples.text: Reiner, 56, has all but conceded the race to his rival...
examples.translation: 56岁的赖纳在比赛中几乎已经向对手认输了。

examples.text: Alain Prost finished third and virtually conceded the world championship.
examples.translation: 阿兰·普罗斯特以第三名的成绩结束比赛，实际上已经将世界冠军的位置拱手让人。

examples.text: Airtours conceded defeat in its attempt to take control of holiday industry rival Owners Abroad...
examples.translation: 空中旅游公司承认其对度假服务行业竞争对手海外业主旅行社的控股企图以失败告终。

examples.text: He happily conceded the election.
examples.translation: 他欣然接受了选举的失败。

meanings.meaning: 集中；浓缩；全神贯注；聚集

examples.text: It was up to him to concentrate on his studies and make something of himself...
examples.translation: 是否能专心学习并取得一定成就要靠他自己。

examples.text: Water companies should concentrate on reducing waste instead of building new reservoirs...
examples.translation: 自来水公司应该集中精力减少水浪费，而不是修建新水库。

examples.text: At work you need to be able to concentrate...
examples.translation: 工作的时候必须要做到聚精会神。

examples.text: This helps you to be aware of time and concentrates your mind on the immediate task.
examples.translation: 这有助于你掌握时间，全神贯注于眼前的任务。

examples.text: Italy's industrial districts are concentrated in its north-central and north-eastern regions...
examples.translation: 意大利的工业区集中在该国中北部和东北部地区。

examples.text: Most development has been concentrated in and around cities.
examples.translation: 土地开发主要集中在城市及周边地区。

examples.text: ...orange juice made from concentrate.
examples.translation: 用浓缩橙汁冲兑的橙汁

examples.text: A term in prison will concentrate his mind wonderfully.
examples.translation: 一想到要被判刑，他的头脑就会变得非常清醒。

examples.text: I just can't even conceive of that quantity of money...
examples.translation: 那么多钱，我根本都无法想象。

examples.text: He was immensely ambitious but unable to conceive of winning power for himself.
examples.translation: 他雄心勃勃，但是想不出自己能如何赢得权力。

examples.text: The ancients conceived the earth as afloat in water...
examples.translation: 古人认为地球飘浮在水里。

examples.text: We conceive of the family as being in a constant state of change...
examples.translation: 我们认为家庭处于不断变化之中。

examples.text: Elvis conceived of himself as a ballad singer.
examples.translation: 埃尔维斯认为自己是民谣歌手。

examples.text: She had conceived the idea of a series of novels...
examples.translation: 她萌生出撰写系列小说的想法。

examples.text: He conceived of the first truly portable computer in 1968.
examples.translation: 1968年，他构想出第一台真正的便携式计算机。

examples.text: Women, he says, should give up alcohol before they plan to conceive...
examples.translation: 他说女性在计划怀孕之前应该戒酒。

examples.text: About one in six couples has difficulty conceiving...
examples.translation: 大约1/6的夫妻有受孕困难。

examples.text: A mother who already has non-identical twins is more likely to conceive another set of twins.
examples.translation: 生育过非同卵双胞胎的母亲再怀上双胞胎的可能性更大。

examples.text: She added that the concept of arranged marriages is misunderstood in the west.
examples.translation: 她补充说，西方人对包办婚姻的概念有些误解。

examples.text: ...basic legal concepts.
examples.translation: 基本的法律概念

meanings.meaning: 浓度；集中；浓缩；专心；集合

examples.text: Neal kept interrupting, breaking my concentration...
examples.translation: 尼尔不停地打断我，使得我无法集中注意力。

examples.text: We lacked concentration and it cost us the goal and the game.
examples.translation: 我们注意力不够集中，结果丢了球，输了比赛。

examples.text: The area has one of the world's greatest concentrations of wildlife...
examples.translation: 这个地区是世界上野生动物最为密集的区域之一。

examples.text: There's been too much concentration of power in the hands of central authorities.
examples.translation: 权力一直过多地集中在中央机构手中。

examples.text: pH is a measure of the concentration of free hydrogen atoms in a solution...
examples.translation: pH值是测试溶液中自由氢原子浓度的单位。

examples.text: The latest data showed that global ozone concentrations had dropped several per cent over the last decade.
examples.translation: 最新数据显示，过去10年来全球臭氧的浓度降低了几个百分点。

examples.text: The group has expressed concern about reports of political violence in Africa...
examples.translation: 该团体对有关非洲政治暴力的报道表示关切。

examples.text: The move follows growing public concern over the spread of the disease...
examples.translation: 针对公众对该疾病的不断蔓延日益担忧，从而出台了这一举措。

examples.text: As the militants gather, there is concern that the protest might again run out of control...
examples.translation: 随着激进分子的聚集，人们担心抗议活动可能会再次失去控制。

examples.text: There is no cause for concern.
examples.translation: 不必担心。

examples.text: The growing number of people seeking refuge in Thailand is beginning to concern Western aid agencies...
examples.translation: 到泰国寻求庇护的人日益增多，这开始引起了西方援助机构的不安。

examples.text: It concerned her that Bess was developing a crush on Max.
examples.translation: 贝丝迷上了马克斯，这让她很担心。

examples.text: I've been concerned about you lately...
examples.translation: 最近我对你有些担心。

examples.text: We're naturally concerned for our daughter's safety...
examples.translation: 我们担心女儿的安全，这很自然。

examples.text: Academics and employers are deeply concerned that students are not sufficiently prepared mathematically for university courses.
examples.translation: 学生掌握的数学知识不足以应付大学课程，这让大学老师和用人单位非常担心。

examples.text: ...a phone call from a concerned neighbor.
examples.translation: 不安的邻居打来的电话

examples.text: His concern was that people would know that he was responsible...
examples.translation: 他担心大家会知道是他的责任。

examples.text: Unemployment was the electorate's main concern.
examples.translation: 选民关心的主要是失业问题。

examples.text: ...a story that illustrates how dangerous excessive concern with safety can be.
examples.translation: 一个说明过分关心安全问题会招致何等麻烦的故事

examples.text: Feminism must address issues beyond the concerns of middle-class whites.
examples.translation: 女权主义解决的问题不能仅仅局限于中产阶级白人妇女所关心的问题。

examples.text: Without her care and concern, he had no chance at all...
examples.translation: 若非她的关心和照顾，他根本没有机会。

examples.text: He had only gone along out of concern for his two grandsons.
examples.translation: 他完全是出于对两个孙子的关心才继续这样做。

examples.text: I didn't concern myself with politics...
examples.translation: 我不关心政治。

examples.text: He would concern himself solely with the plight of the hostages.
examples.translation: 他唯一关心的是人质的危险处境。

examples.text: The agency is more concerned with making arty ads than understanding its clients' businesses.
examples.translation: 这家广告公司更注重如何制作附庸风雅的广告，而忽视了对客户业务的了解。

examples.text: The bulk of the book concerns Sandy's two middle-aged children...
examples.translation: 书中主要描写桑迪的两个已到中年的孩子。

examples.text: Chapter 2 concerns itself with the methodological difficulties.
examples.translation: 第二章讲的是研究方法上的难点。

examples.text: Randolph's work was exclusively concerned with the effects of pollution on health.
examples.translation: 伦道夫的著作专门论述污染对健康的影响。

examples.text: It was just a little unfinished business from my past, and it doesn't concern you at all.
examples.translation: 这只是我过去的一点未了之事，与你没有任何关系。

examples.text: It's a very stressful situation for everyone concerned...
examples.translation: 对所有相关人士来说，这一形势非常紧张。

examples.text: I believe he was concerned in all those matters you mention.
examples.translation: 我认为你提到的那些事都与他有关。

examples.text: The technical aspects were the concern of the Army...
examples.translation: 技术方面由陆军负责。

examples.text: I would be glad to get rid of them myself. But that is not our concern.
examples.translation: 如果能亲自动手摆脱他们我会非常高兴，但那不是我们的分内之事。

examples.text: If not a large concern, Queensbury Nursery was at least a successful one.
examples.translation: 即使规模不算大，昆斯伯里托儿所至少办得很成功。

examples.text: As far as I'm concerned the officials incited the fight.
examples.translation: 在我看来，是官员们煽动了这场争斗。

examples.text: As far as starting a family is concerned, the trend is for women having their children later in life.
examples.translation: 在要孩子方面，目前的趋势是女性要孩子要得比较晚。

examples.text: The receivers will always prefer to sell a business as a going concern.
examples.translation: 破产管理人总是希望在公司仍然正常运转的时候将其卖掉。

examples.text: Any injury to a child is a cause of great concern to us...
examples.translation: 孩子受到任何伤害都会让我们非常担心。

examples.text: The survey's findings are a matter of great concern.
examples.translation: 这次调查的结果备受关注。

examples.text: How they are paid should be of little concern to the bank as long as they are paid.
examples.translation: 只要肯付款，付款方式对银行来说不是很重要。

meanings.meaning: 涉及；使关心（concern的ing形式）；忧虑

examples.text: For more information concerning the club contact I. Coldwell.
examples.translation: 咨询俱乐部详情，请与I.科德维尔联系。

examples.text: ...various questions concerning pollution and the environment.
examples.translation: 有关污染和环境的各种问题

examples.text: It is particularly concerning that he is working for non-British companies while advising on foreign policy.
examples.translation: 让人尤为不安的是，他在提供外交政策咨询的同时却又供职于一些外国公司。

meanings.meaning: 音乐会用的；在音乐会上演出的

examples.text: ...a short concert of piano music...
examples.translation: 一场短暂的钢琴音乐会

examples.text: I've been to plenty of live rock concerts.
examples.translation: 我去现场看过很多摇滚音乐会。

examples.text: ...a new concert hall.
examples.translation: 新的音乐厅

examples.text: I want people to remember Elvis in concert.
examples.translation: 我希望大家记住现场演唱会上的猫王。

examples.text: He wants to act in concert with other nations.
examples.translation: 他想和其他国家采取一致行动。

examples.text: The King made major concessions to end the confrontation with his people.
examples.translation: 为了结束与其臣民的冲突，国王作出了很大的让步。

examples.text: The government has granted concessions to three private telephone companies.
examples.translation: 政府已经向3家私营电话公司授予了特许权。

examples.text: ...tax concessions for mothers who stay at home with their children.
examples.translation: 针对在家照顾孩子的母亲的纳税优惠

examples.text: Open daily; admission £1.10 with concessions for children and OAPs.
examples.translation: 每天开放;门票1.10英镑，儿童和退休人士可享受票价优惠。

examples.text: Burton's text is concise and informative...
examples.translation: 伯顿的文章语言简洁，信息丰富。

examples.text: Whatever you are writing make sure you are clear, concise, and accurate.
examples.translation: 无论写什么，一定要清晰、简练、准确。

examples.text: He'd delivered his report clearly and concisely.
examples.translation: 他清楚、简要地作了汇报。

examples.text: ...Sotheby's Concise Encyclopedia of Porcelain.
examples.translation: 《苏富比简明瓷器百科全书》

examples.text: Larry had concluded that he had no choice but to accept Paul's words as the truth...
examples.translation: 拉里断定自己别无选择，只能当保罗的话是真的。

examples.text: So what can we conclude from this debate?...
examples.translation: 那么从这场辩论中我们能得出什么结论？

examples.text: 'The situation in the inner cities is bad and getting worse,' she concluded.
examples.translation: “内城的情况很糟，而且是越来越糟。”她断言道。

examples.text: 'It's a waste of time,' he concluded...
examples.translation: “这是浪费时间。”他总结道。

examples.text: I would like to conclude by saying that I do enjoy your magazine.
examples.translation: 最后，我想说我的确很喜欢你们的杂志。

examples.text: On the radio I caught Mr Hague's concluding remarks at the Blackpool conference.
examples.translation: 我在收音机中听到了黑格先生在布莱克浦会议上的总结发言。

examples.text: The evening concluded with dinner and speeches...
examples.translation: 这个夜晚在宴会和讲话中结束。

examples.text: The Group of Seven major industrial countries concluded its annual summit meeting today.
examples.translation: 由主要工业国家组成的七国集团今天结束了其年度峰会。

examples.text: Mexico and the Philippines have both concluded agreements with their commercial bank creditors...
examples.translation: 墨西哥和菲律宾均已与商业银行债权人达成了协议。

examples.text: If the clubs cannot conclude a deal, an independent tribunal will decide.
examples.translation: 如果俱乐部之间无法达成协议，将由一个独立的仲裁委员会来裁定。

examples.text: Over the years I've come to the conclusion that she's a very great musician...
examples.translation: 这些年来，我得出的结论是她是一位非常伟大的音乐家。

examples.text: I have tried to give some idea of how I feel — other people will no doubt draw their own conclusions.
examples.translation: 我试着说了一些我的感受，其他人无疑会有他们自己的结论。

examples.text: At the conclusion of the programme, I asked the children if they had any questions they wanted to ask me.
examples.translation: 节目结束的时候，我问孩子们有没有问题想问我。

examples.text: ...the expected conclusion of a free-trade agreement between Mexico and the United States.
examples.translation: 墨西哥与美国之间自由贸易协定的如期签订

examples.text: It was a foregone conclusion that I would end up in the same business as him...
examples.translation: 早已注定我最终会和他干同一行。

examples.text: The championship result was almost a foregone conclusion.
examples.translation: 锦标赛的结果差不多在意料之中。

examples.text: In conclusion, walking is a cheap, safe, enjoyable and readily available form of exercise.
examples.translation: 总而言之，散步是一种廉价、安全、愉快的锻炼方式，而且随时随地都可以进行。

examples.text: I didn't want her to jump to the conclusion that the divorce was in any way her fault...
examples.translation: 我不想让她草率地断定离婚完全是她的错。

examples.text: Forgive me. I shouldn't be jumping to conclusions.
examples.translation: 原谅我，我不该草率地下结论。

meanings.meaning: 混凝土的；实在的，具体的；有形的

examples.text: The posts have to be set in concrete...
examples.translation: 这些柱子必须用混凝土固定。

examples.text: They had lain on sleeping bags on the concrete floor.
examples.translation: 他们就躺在铺在混凝土地面上的睡袋上。

examples.text: ...concrete barriers.
examples.translation: 混凝土壁垒

examples.text: He merely cleared and concreted the floors.
examples.translation: 他只是把地面清理之后浇上了混凝土。

examples.text: He had no concrete evidence...
examples.translation: 他没有确凿的证据。

examples.text: There were no concrete proposals on the table...
examples.translation: 没有具体的提议可供讨论。

examples.text: I must have something to tell him. Something concrete.
examples.translation: 我必须告诉他点什么，必须是具体的东西。

examples.text: ...by way of making their point more concretely.
examples.translation: 通过更为具体地证明他们的观点

examples.text: ...using concrete objects to teach addition and subtraction.
examples.translation: 用实物来教加减法

examples.text: As Mr Blunkett emphasised, nothing is yet set in concrete.
examples.translation: 正如布伦基特先生所强调的，一切都还没有定下来。

examples.text: Political leaders united yesterday to condemn the latest wave of violence...
examples.translation: 政界领袖昨日联合起来对最近激增的暴力事件予以谴责。

examples.text: Graham was right to condemn his players for lack of ability, attitude and application.
examples.translation: 格雷厄姆指责队员们技艺不佳、态度不端正而且不够努力，他说得没错。

examples.text: ...a document that condemns sexism as a moral and social evil.
examples.translation: 把性别歧视视作道德和社会弊端予以谴责的文件

examples.text: He was condemned to life imprisonment.
examples.translation: 他被判终身监禁。

examples.text: ...appeals by prisoners condemned to death.
examples.translation: 被判死刑的囚犯们提出的上诉

examples.text: Their lack of qualifications condemned them to a lifetime of boring, usually poorly-paid work...
examples.translation: 没有学历使他们一辈子都得从事枯燥乏味而且通常报酬很低的工作。

examples.text: He felt condemned to being alone...
examples.translation: 他觉得自己注定要孤独终老。

examples.text: Mark was condemned to do most of the work.
examples.translation: 马克被迫承担大部分工作。

examples.text: State officials said the court's ruling clears the way for proceedings to condemn buildings in the area.
examples.translation: 州政府官员称法庭判决为宣布该地区楼房为危房的行动扫清了道路。

examples.text: We have learnt how to condense serious messages into short, self-contained sentences...
examples.translation: 我们已经学会了如何把重要的信息压缩成简短独立的句子。

examples.text: The English translation may have been condensed into a single more readable book.
examples.translation: 英译本可能被压缩成了更具可读性的单行本。

examples.text: Water vapour condenses to form clouds...
examples.translation: 水蒸气凝结形成云。

examples.text: The compressed gas is cooled and condenses into a liquid...
examples.translation: 压缩气体经冷却凝结成液态。

examples.text: As the air rises it becomes colder and moisture condenses out of it.
examples.translation: 随着空气上升，其温度降低，凝结出水分。

meanings.meaning: 决定；使适应；使健康；以…为条件

examples.text: He remains in a critical condition in a California hospital...
examples.translation: 他在加州的一家医院里，病情仍然十分危急。

examples.text: I received several compliments on the condition of my skin...
examples.translation: 好几个人夸我的皮肤保养得好。

examples.text: The two-bedroom chalet is in good condition...
examples.translation: 这个两居室的度假小屋维护得很好。

examples.text: You can't drive in that condition.
examples.translation: 你这种状态不能开车。

examples.text: This change has been timed under laboratory conditions...
examples.translation: 在实验室条件下测得了这一变化所需的时间。

examples.text: The mild winter has created the ideal conditions for an ant population explosion.
examples.translation: 暖冬为蚁群数量激增创造了理想的条件。

examples.text: The conditions are ripe for the spread of disease.
examples.translation: 这种疾病传播的条件已经成熟。

examples.text: People are living in appalling conditions...
examples.translation: 人们的居住条件极其恶劣。

examples.text: He could not work in these conditions any longer...
examples.translation: 他再也不能在这样的条件下工作了。

examples.text: The conditions in the camp are just awful.
examples.translation: 营地的条件简直太差了。

examples.text: The condition of the people could be elevated by a programme of social reform...
examples.translation: 人们的生活状况可以通过社会改革方案得到改善。

examples.text: The government has encouraged its people to better their condition.
examples.translation: 政府鼓励人民改善生活状况。

examples.text: ...the human condition.
examples.translation: 人类的生活状况

examples.text: ...economic targets set as a condition for loan payments.
examples.translation: 作为贷款偿还条件所设定的经济目标

examples.text: ...terms and conditions of employment...
examples.translation: 雇用条款及条件

examples.text: Egypt had agreed to a summit subject to certain conditions.
examples.translation: 埃及有条件地同意了一项峰会主题。

examples.text: Doctors suspect he may have a heart condition.
examples.translation: 医生怀疑他可能有心脏病。

examples.text: ...a rare condition that causes degeneration of the brain tissue.
examples.translation: 引起脑组织变性的罕见疾病

examples.text: We are all conditioned by early impressions and experiences...
examples.translation: 我们都受到早年印象和经历的影响。

examples.text: You have been conditioned to believe that it is weak to be scared...
examples.translation: 你习惯性地认为害怕是软弱的表现。

examples.text: I just feel women are conditioned into doing housework.
examples.translation: 我只是觉得女性做家务是习惯使然。

examples.text: ...a conditioned response.
examples.translation: 条件反应

examples.text: Because of social conditioning, men don't expect themselves to be managed by women.
examples.translation: 由于社会习惯的熏陶，男人不希望自己被女人管制。

examples.text: ...a protein which is excellent for conditioning dry and damaged hair.
examples.translation: 对干燥、受损的头发有极佳护理效果的蛋白质

examples.text: She was clearly in no condition to see anyone.
examples.translation: 很显然，她谁都不能见。

examples.text: He spoke to reporters on condition that he was not identified.
examples.translation: 在不披露身份的条件下，他接受了记者的采访。

examples.text: He was too out of condition to clamber over the top.
examples.translation: 他体质太差，爬不到山顶。

examples.text: I decided to conduct an experiment...
examples.translation: 我决定进行一次实验。

examples.text: He said they were conducting a campaign against democrats across the country...
examples.translation: 他说他们正在全国开展反对民主党人的运动。

examples.text: The council conducted a survey of the uses to which farm buildings are put.
examples.translation: 地方议会对农场建筑的使用情况进行了一次调查。

examples.text: Also up for discussion will be the conduct of free and fair elections...
examples.translation: 同样提出来进行讨论的还有如何进行自由公正的选举。

examples.text: The Conservative Party did not in the main disagree with Bevin's conduct of foreign policy.
examples.translation: 保守党大体上不反对贝文的外交施政方式。

examples.text: The way he conducts himself reflects on the party and will increase criticisms against him...
examples.translation: 他个人的行事方式给该党招来非议，也会招致更多对他个人的批评。

examples.text: Most people believe they conduct their private and public lives in accordance with Christian morality.
examples.translation: 大多数人认为他们是依照基督教的道德体系来处理自己的私生活和公共事务的。

examples.text: For Europeans, the law is a statement of basic principles of civilised conduct...
examples.translation: 对于欧洲人来说，法律是对基本文明行为准则的表述。

examples.text: He has trouble understanding that other people judge him by his conduct.
examples.translation: 别人通过他的行为举止对他进行评判，这一点他很难理解。

examples.text: Dennis had recently begun a successful career conducting opera in Europe...
examples.translation: 丹尼斯最近开始在欧洲担任歌剧指挥，事业发展得很成功。

examples.text: Solti will continue to conduct here and abroad...
examples.translation: 索尔蒂将继续在国内外担任指挥。

examples.text: At the Curtis Institute he studied conducting with Fritz Reiner.
examples.translation: 在柯蒂斯学院，他师从弗里茨·赖纳学习指挥。

examples.text: Water conducts heat faster than air.
examples.translation: 水的导热速度比空气快。

examples.text: He asked if he might conduct us to the ball which was to bring the proceedings to an end.
examples.translation: 他问是否可以带我们去舞会现场，整个仪式将在那儿结束。

meanings.meaning: 导体；售票员；领导者；管理人

examples.text: That's where conductor Herbert Von Karajan discovered her, in the mid-1970s, while rehearsing Alban Berg's Wozzeck.
He conferred with Hill and the others in his office...
examples.translation: 他与希尔及其他人在办公室里商议了一番。

examples.text: His doctors conferred by telephone and agreed that he must get away from his family for a time.
examples.translation: 诊治他的几位医生在电话里讨论了一番，一致认为他必须离开家人一段时间。

examples.text: The constitution also confers large powers on Brazil's 25 constituent states...
examples.translation: 宪法还赋予巴西的25个成员州很大的权力。

examples.text: An honorary doctorate of law was conferred on him by Newcastle University in 1976...
examples.translation: 1976年，纽卡斯尔大学授予他荣誉法学博士学位。

examples.text: Never imagine that rank confers genuine authority.
examples.translation: 绝对不要幻想那个头衔会有实权。

meanings.meaning: 会议；讨论；协商；联盟；（正式）讨论会；[工会、工党用语]（每年的）大会

examples.text: The President summoned all the state governors to a conference on education.
examples.translation: 总统召集各州州长召开了一次教育研讨会。

examples.text: ...the Conservative Party conference...
examples.translation: 保守党大会

examples.text: Last weekend the Roman Catholic Church in Scotland held a conference, attended by 450 delegates.
examples.translation: 上周末，苏格兰的天主教会举行了一次会议，450名代表与会。

examples.text: They sat down at the dinner table, as they always did, before the meal, for a conference...
examples.translation: 他们在餐桌旁坐下，和平常一样，吃饭之前要开个会。

examples.text: Her employer was in conference with two lawyers and did not want to be interrupted.
examples.translation: 她的老板在和两位律师谈事情，不想有人打扰。

examples.text: He had confessed to seventeen murders...
examples.translation: 他供认了17起谋杀案。

examples.text: Her husband confessed to having had an affair...
examples.translation: 她丈夫承认有过外遇。

examples.text: I had expected her to confess that she only wrote these books for the money...
examples.translation: 我本以为她会承认写这些书只是为了钱。

examples.text: Most rape victims confess a feeling of helplessness...
examples.translation: 大部分强奸案受害者都承认有一种无助的感觉。

examples.text: Ray changed his mind, claiming that he had been forced into confessing...
examples.translation: 雷翻了供，声称自己是被逼招供的。

examples.text: 'I played a very bad match,' he confessed.
examples.translation: “这场比赛我打得很差。”他坦白道。

examples.text: You just go to the church and confess your sins...
examples.translation: 你干脆去教堂忏悔自己的罪过吧。

examples.text: Once we have confessed our failures and mistakes to God, we should stop feeling guilty.
examples.translation: 一旦我们向上帝告明了自己的过失和错误，就不该再觉得内疚。

examples.text: I confess it's got me baffled...
examples.translation: 我承认这把我难倒了。

examples.text: I must confess I'm not a great enthusiast for long political programmes.
examples.translation: 我必须承认自己对时间很长的政治节目不是很热衷。

examples.text: I have every confidence in you...
examples.translation: 我完全相信你。

examples.text: This has contributed to the lack of confidence in the police...
examples.translation: 这导致了大家对警方缺乏信任。

examples.text: His record on ceasefires inspires no confidence.
examples.translation: 他以往在停火方面的表现让人对他毫无信心。

examples.text: The band is on excellent form and brimming with confidence...
examples.translation: 这支乐队状态极佳，自信满满。

examples.text: I always thought the worst of myself and had no confidence whatsoever.
examples.translation: 我老是妄自菲薄，没有一点儿信心。

examples.text: I can say with confidence that such rumors were totally groundless.
examples.translation: 我可以肯定地说这样的谣言完全没有根据。

examples.text: We told you all these things in confidence...
examples.translation: 我们告诉你的这些事都需要保密。

examples.text: Even telling Lois seemed a betrayal of confidence.
examples.translation: 即使是告诉洛伊丝都好像是在泄密。

examples.text: If your daughter takes you into her confidence, don't rush off to tell your husband.
examples.translation: 如果女儿告诉你她的秘密，不要急着说给丈夫听。

examples.text: Gregory shared confidences with Carmen.
examples.translation: 格雷戈里和卡门说了知心话。

examples.text: I am confident that everything will come out right in time...
examples.translation: 我坚信一切终究都会好起来。

examples.text: Mr Ryan is confident of success...
examples.translation: 瑞安先生坚信一定会成功。

examples.text: Management is confident about the way business is progressing.
examples.translation: 管理层对业务发展的态势充满信心。

examples.text: I can confidently promise that this year is going to be very different.
examples.translation: 我可以信心十足地保证今年将大不一样。

examples.text: In time he became more confident and relaxed...
examples.translation: 过了一段时间，他变得更加自信、更为放松。

examples.text: She is a confident woman who is certain of her views.
examples.translation: 她是一位充满自信的女性，对自己的观点深信不疑。

examples.text: She walked confidently across the hall.
examples.translation: 她自信地走过大厅。

examples.text: She is confident that everybody is on her side...
examples.translation: 她确信所有人都站在她这边。

examples.text: 'Bet you I can', comes the confident reply.
examples.translation: “我肯定行。”传来一个很有把握的回答。

examples.text: I can confidently say that none of them were or are racist.
examples.translation: 我可以非常肯定地说他们中没有一个种族主义者，过去没有，现在也没有。

meanings.meaning: 机密的；表示信任的；获信任的

examples.text: She accused them of leaking confidential information about her private life...
examples.translation: 她指责他们泄露其私生活的秘密。

examples.text: We'll take good care and keep what you've told us strictly confidential, Mr. Lane.
examples.translation: 莱恩先生，我们会非常小心，对您告诉我们的事严格保密。

examples.text: People can phone in the knowledge that any information they give will be treated confidentially.
examples.translation: 人们尽可放心地打电话来，他们提供的任何信息都会被保密。

examples.text: ...the confidentiality of the client-solicitor relationship.
examples.translation: 委托人与律师之间的保密关系

examples.text: 'Look,' he said in a confidential tone, 'I want you to know that me and Joey are cops.'...
examples.translation: “听着，”他悄声说，“我想让你知道我和乔伊是警察。”

examples.text: His face suddenly turned solemn, his voice confidential.
examples.translation: 他脸上的神情突然严肃起来，声音也压低了。

examples.text: Nash hadn't raised his voice, still spoke rather softly, confidentially.
examples.translation: 纳什没有提高嗓门，依然悄声说着，相当轻柔。

examples.text: Health officials have successfully confined the epidemic to the Tabatinga area...
examples.translation: 卫生官员成功地将疫情控制在塔巴廷加地区。

examples.text: The US will soon be taking steps to confine the conflict.
examples.translation: 美国很快就会采取措施限制冲突。

examples.text: He did not confine himself to the one language...
examples.translation: 他没把自己局限于这一门语言。

examples.text: Yoko had largely confined her activities to the world of big business...
examples.translation: 洋子主要是做大生意。

examples.text: His genius was not confined to the decoration of buildings.
examples.translation: 他的天赋不单体现在建筑物的装饰上。

examples.text: The woman will be confined to a mental institution...
examples.translation: 这个女人将被关进精神病院。

examples.text: He announced that the army and police had been confined to barracks.
examples.translation: 他通告说军队和警察已经被禁闭在营房中不得外出。

examples.text: The movie is set entirely within the confines of the abandoned factory.
examples.translation: 电影的拍摄完全是在这个废弃的工厂厂区内进行。

examples.text: ...the wild grass and weeds that grew in the confines of the grandstand.
examples.translation: 大看台上丛生的野草

examples.text: ...away from the confines of the British class system...
examples.translation: 超越英国社会等级制度的限制

examples.text: I can't stand the confines of this marriage.
examples.translation: 我受不了这段婚姻的限制。

meanings.meaning: 确认；确定；证实；批准；使巩固

examples.text: X-rays have confirmed that he has not broken any bones...
examples.translation: X光片证实他没有骨折。

examples.text: These new statistics confirm our worst fears about the depth of the recession...
examples.translation: 这些新的统计数据证实经济衰退已经严重到我们最为担忧的境地。

examples.text: This confirms what I suspected all along.
examples.translation: 这证实了我一直以来的怀疑。

examples.text: They took her resignation from Bendix as confirmation of their suspicions.
examples.translation: 他们认为她从本迪克斯公司辞职证实了他们的怀疑。

examples.text: The spokesman confirmed that the area was now in rebel hands...
examples.translation: 这位发言人证实该地区现已落入叛乱分子手中。

examples.text: He confirmed what had long been feared...
examples.translation: 他证实了人们长期以来的担心。

examples.text: Can you confirm this?
examples.translation: 这个你能确定吗？

examples.text: She glanced over at James for confirmation.
examples.translation: 她扫了詹姆斯一眼，想得到他的确认。

examples.text: You make the reservation, and I'll confirm it in writing.
examples.translation: 你来预订，我会去函确认。

examples.text: Travel arrangements are subject to confirmation by State Tourist Organisations.
examples.translation: 旅行安排有待州旅游组织的确认。

examples.text: He was confirmed as a member of the Church of England.
examples.translation: 他领受了坚振礼，成为英国国教会的一员。

examples.text: ...when I was being prepared for Confirmation...
examples.translation: 在我为领受坚振礼做准备的时候

examples.text: Flu prevented her from attending her daughter's confirmation.
examples.translation: 流感使她没能参加女儿的坚振礼。

examples.text: It has confirmed me in my decision not to become a nun.
examples.translation: 这使我更加坚定了不做修女的决心。

examples.text: Williams has confirmed his position as the world's number one snooker player.
examples.translation: 威廉姆斯巩固了自己世界头号斯诺克选手的地位。

examples.text: His new role could confirm him as one of our leading actors.
examples.translation: 他的新角色会确保他跻身我们的一流演员之列。

examples.text: Try to keep any conflict between you and your ex-partner to a minimum...
examples.translation: 尽量将自己与前配偶之间的摩擦减到最小。

examples.text: Employees already are in conflict with management over job cuts...
examples.translation: 雇员已经就裁员一事与管理层发生了争执。

examples.text: The two companies came into conflict.
examples.translation: 这两家公司起了冲突。

examples.text: ...the anguish of his own inner conflict.
examples.translation: 内心矛盾给他带来的极大痛苦

examples.text: ...talks aimed at ending four decades of conflict...
examples.translation: 旨在结束持续了40年的冲突的会谈

examples.text: The National Security Council has met to discuss ways of preventing a military conflict.
examples.translation: 国家安全委员会开会讨论防止发生军事冲突的办法。

examples.text: There is a conflict between what they are doing and what you want...
examples.translation: 他们所做的与你想要的之间存在冲突。

examples.text: Do you feel any conflict of loyalties?...
examples.translation: 有没有觉得两面效忠存在冲突？

examples.text: The two objectives are in conflict.
examples.translation: 两个目标发生了冲突。

examples.text: Personal ethics and professional ethics sometimes conflict...
examples.translation: 个人道德和职业道德有时会相互抵触。

examples.text: He held firm opinions which usually conflicted with my own...
examples.translation: 他所持的观点通常与我的相左，而且很难改变。

examples.text: There are conflicting reports about the identity of the hostage.
examples.translation: 有关人质身份的报道相互矛盾。

examples.text: ...three powers with conflicting interests.
examples.translation: 存在利益冲突的三个大国

examples.text: The Night Rider lamp has been designed to conform to new British Standard safety requirements...
examples.translation: “夜行者”灯的设计符合新的英国安全标准的要求。

examples.text: The meat market can continue only if it is radically overhauled to conform with strict European standards.
examples.translation: 肉类市场只有经过彻底的大检查，严格遵守欧洲标准，才能继续营业。

examples.text: Many children who can't or don't conform are often bullied...
examples.translation: 很多不能或不按规矩行事的小孩常常被人欺负。

examples.text: He did not feel obliged to conform to the rules that applied to ordinary men...
examples.translation: 他觉得自己不必遵守那些适用于普通人的规定。

examples.text: We conformed with social and family expectations.
examples.translation: 我们遵从社会和家庭的期望行事。

examples.text: I am well aware that we all conform to one stereotype or another...
examples.translation: 我们所有人都能找到某种与自己相似的模式化形象，这一点我很清楚。

examples.text: Like most 'peacetime wars' it did not conform to preconceived ideas.
examples.translation: 如同大多数“和平时代的战争”一样，这与我们的预想不同。

examples.text: Great care is taken to avoid confusing the two types of projects...
examples.translation: 大家非常谨慎，以免把这两类项目弄混。

examples.text: I can't see how anyone could confuse you with another!
examples.translation: 我不明白怎么会有人把你和另外一个人搞混！

examples.text: Use different colours of felt pen on your sketch to avoid confusion.
examples.translation: 用不同颜色的毡头笔画草图，以免搞混。

examples.text: German politics surprised and confused him.
examples.translation: 德国政治既令他惊讶，又让他困惑不解。

examples.text: To further confuse the issue, there is an enormous variation in the amount of sleep people feel happy with.
examples.translation: 使问题进一步复杂化的是，每个人需要的睡眠时间千差万别。

examples.text: She was confronted with severe money problems...
examples.translation: 她面临严峻的资金问题。

examples.text: Ministers underestimated the magnitude of the task confronting them.
examples.translation: 部长们低估了他们所面临的任务的艰巨性。

examples.text: We are learning how to confront death...
examples.translation: 我们正在学习如何直面死亡。

examples.text: NATO countries have been forced to confront fundamental moral questions.
examples.translation: 北约国家被迫正视基本的道德问题。

examples.text: I was confronted with an array of knobs, levers, and switches.
examples.translation: 我面对的是一大堆旋钮、控制杆和开关。

examples.text: She pushed her way through the mob and confronted him face to face...
examples.translation: 她挤过骚动的人群，与他当面对峙。

examples.text: They don't hesitate to open fire when confronted by police...
examples.translation: 他们遭遇警察时毫不犹豫地开火。

examples.text: The candidates confronted each other during a televised debate.
examples.translation: 候选人在电视辩论中当面交锋。

examples.text: She had decided to confront Kathryn with what she had learnt...
examples.translation: 她决定拿自己了解的事实与凯瑟琳当面对证。

examples.text: I could not bring myself to confront him about it...
examples.translation: 我不忍心就这事和他对质。

examples.text: His confronting me forced me to search for the answers.
examples.translation: 他对我的当面质询迫使我思索如何作答。

examples.text: She congratulated him on the birth of his son...
examples.translation: 她祝贺他喜得贵子。

examples.text: I was absolutely astonished by the reaction to our engagement. Everyone started congratulating us.
examples.translation: 大家对我们订婚的反应让我非常惊讶。所有人都开始祝贺我们。

examples.text: We have received many letters of congratulation.
examples.translation: 我们收到了很多贺信。

examples.text: I really must congratulate the organisers for a well run and enjoyable event...
examples.translation: 活动安排得有条不紊，充满乐趣，我必须要称赞一下组织者。

examples.text: We specifically wanted to congratulate certain players.
examples.translation: 我们特别想表扬几名选手。

examples.text: Waterstone has every reason to congratulate himself...
examples.translation: 沃特斯通完全有理由为自己感到高兴。

examples.text: Journalists have been congratulating themselves on the role the press has played in the investigations.
examples.translation: 记者们为新闻界在调查中所起的作用感到自豪。

examples.text: Russian President Dmitry Medvedev sent a telegram of congratulation and China's special envoy sent President Hu Jintao's "warmest congratulations".
There's still confusion about the number of casualties...
examples.translation: 伤亡人数依然不明。

examples.text: Omissions in my recent article must have caused confusion.
examples.translation: 我最近一篇文章中的几处省略肯定造成了困惑。

examples.text: There was confusion when a man fired shots...
examples.translation: 一个男子开了几枪，场面一片混乱。

examples.text: The rebel leader appears to have escaped in the confusion.
examples.translation: 叛乱分子首领似乎已乘乱逃脱。

examples.text: We always left his office in a state of confusion.
examples.translation: 我们总是一头雾水地离开他的办公室。

examples.text: ...the pressures and confusions of puberty.
examples.translation: 青春期的种种压力和困惑

meanings.meaning: 国会；代表大会；会议；社交

examples.text: Copyright: Remix Culture: Congress should carve a robust exemption to the law for non-commercial remix.

meanings.meaning: 结合；[语] 连接词；同时发生

examples.text: ...the conjunction of two events.
examples.translation: 两个事件的同时发生

examples.text: ...a conjunction of religious and social factors.
examples.translation: 宗教因素和社会因素的并存

examples.text: The army should have operated in conjunction with the fleet to raid the enemy's coast...
examples.translation: 陆军本应与舰队共同行动，突袭敌方海岸。

examples.text: Since iron destroys vitamin E, these two nutrients should not be taken in conjunction.
examples.translation: 铁会破坏维生素E，所以这两种营养物质不应该同时摄取。

examples.text: There was no evidence of a connection between BSE and the brain diseases recently confirmed in cats...
examples.translation: 没有证据表明疯牛病与最近确诊的猫类脑病有关联。

examples.text: The police say he had no connection with the security forces...
examples.translation: 警方说他与安全部队没有关系。

examples.text: He has denied any connection to the bombing.
examples.translation: 他否认与爆炸事件有任何关联。

examples.text: Check all radiators for small leaks, especially round pipework connections.
examples.translation: 检查所有的暖气片，看有没有小裂缝，尤其是管道连接处附近。

examples.text: Fukuoka has excellent air and rail connections to the rest of the country.
examples.translation: 福冈与国内其他城市之间有非常便捷的空运和铁路运输系统。

examples.text: My flight was late and I missed the connection.
examples.translation: 航班晚点，我没赶上转机。

examples.text: She used her connections to full advantage.
examples.translation: 她充分利用了自己的人脉。

examples.text: I am writing in connection with Michael Shower's letter...
examples.translation: 关于迈克尔·肖尔的来信，现复信如下。

examples.text: 13 men have been questioned in connection with the murder.
examples.translation: 有13名男子因谋杀案受到盘问。

examples.text: It is the 100th anniversary of his death. We here are having very great celebrations in this connection.
examples.translation: 今天是他逝世100周年纪念日，我们为此在这里举行盛大的纪念活动。

examples.text: During 1936, Mussolini conquered Abyssinia...
examples.translation: 1936年，墨索里尼攻占了阿比西尼亚。

examples.text: Early in the eleventh century the whole of England was again conquered by the Vikings.
examples.translation: 11世纪早期，整个英格兰再次被北欧海盗征服。

examples.text: I was certain that love was quite enough to conquer our differences...
examples.translation: 我相信爱足以克服我们的种种差异。

examples.text: He has never conquered his addiction to smoking.
examples.translation: 他一直未能戒除烟瘾。

examples.text: ... the oldest climber ever to conquer the mountain.
examples.translation: 征服这座山的年纪最大的登山者

examples.text: You can connect the machine to your hi-fi...
examples.translation: 你可以把机器连在高保真音响上。

examples.text: The traditional method is to enter the exchanges at night and connect the wires...
examples.translation: 传统的办法是晚上进入电话局，把线连上。

examples.text: Two cables connect to each corner of the plate.
examples.translation: 两条电缆连到金属板的每个角上。

examples.text: ...a television camera connected to the radio telescope.
examples.translation: 连接射电望远镜的电视摄影机

examples.text: These appliances should not be connected to power supplies...
examples.translation: 这些家用电器不应该接通电源。

examples.text: Ischia was now connected to the mainland water supply.
examples.translation: 伊斯基亚这时已经通上了大陆的水。

examples.text: The shower is easy to install — it needs only to be connected up to the hot and cold water supply...
examples.translation: 淋浴器很容易安装——只要接上冷热水就行。

examples.text: They turned the barricade into a potential death trap by connecting it up to the mains.
examples.translation: 他们给路障接上电源，让它变成了一个潜在的死亡陷阱。

examples.text: To call the police, an ambulance or the fire brigade dial 999 and the operator will connect you...
examples.translation: 呼叫警察、救护车或消防队，请拨打999，接线员会为您接通电话。

examples.text: He asked to be connected to the central switchboard.
examples.translation: 他请求接到总机。

examples.text: ...the long hallway that connects the rooms...
examples.translation: 连接各个房间的长过道

examples.text: The fallopian tubes connect the ovaries with the uterus...
examples.translation: 输卵管连接着卵巢和子宫。

examples.text: His workshop connected with a small building in the garden...
examples.translation: 他的工作间连着花园里的一栋小楼。

examples.text: The two rooms have connecting doors.
examples.translation: 这两间屋子有门相通。

examples.text: ...a train connecting with a ferry to Ireland...
examples.translation: 与开往爱尔兰的渡船联运的火车

examples.text: My connecting plane didn't depart for another six hours.
examples.translation: 我搭乘的联运航班又过了6个小时才起飞。

examples.text: ...business travellers wanting to connect to a long-haul flight...
examples.translation: 想换乘长途航班的商务旅行者

examples.text: That will connect you with time to spare for the seven o'clock Concorde.
examples.translation: 那样时间会有富余，你可以换乘7点的“协和”式客机。

examples.text: I hoped he would not connect me with that now-embarrassing review I'd written seven years earlier...
examples.translation: 我希望他不会把我和我7年前写的那篇现在看来令人难堪的评论联系起来。

examples.text: I wouldn't have connected the two things.
examples.translation: 我就不会把这两件事联系起来。

examples.text: A search of Brady's house revealed nothing that could connect him with the robberies...
examples.translation: 对布雷迪住所的搜查没有发现任何能证明他与这些抢劫案有关的东西。

examples.text: What connects them?
examples.translation: 他们之间有什么联系？

examples.text: If you stand on stage and share your view of the world, people will connect with you.
examples.translation: 如果你站在舞台上，分享自己对世界的看法，人们会与你产生共鸣的。

examples.text: He had led the conquest of southern Poland in 1939...
examples.translation: 1939年，他指挥了攻占波兰南部的行动。

examples.text: After the Norman Conquest the forest became a royal hunting preserve...
examples.translation: 诺曼征服之后，这片森林成为了皇家狩猎区。

examples.text: Jerusalem has seen endless conquests and occupations.
examples.translation: 耶路撒冷历经无数次征服、占领。

examples.text: He had realized that Britain could not have peace unless she returned at least some of her former conquests.
examples.translation: 他意识到除非英国至少归还一部分以前的占领地，否则国无宁日。

examples.text: Despite his conquests, he remains lonely and isolated.
examples.translation: 尽管他俘获过很多女人的芳心，却依然孤单寂寞。

examples.text: ...men who boast about their sexual conquests to all their friends.
examples.translation: 向所有朋友吹嘘自己如何搞定女人的男人

examples.text: Pushkin was a womaniser whose conquests included everyone from prostitutes to princesses.
examples.translation: 普希金是个情场老手，各种各样的女性，从妓女到公主，都成了他的俘虏。

examples.text: The conquest of inflation has been the Government's overriding economic priority for nearly 15 years.
examples.translation: 遏制通货膨胀是政府近15年来经济工作方面的头等大事。

examples.text: ...the conquest of cancer.
examples.translation: 攻克癌症

examples.text: I have battled with my conscience over whether I should actually send this letter...
examples.translation: 我备受良心的煎熬，不知是否真的应该把这封信寄出去。

examples.text: What if he got a guilty conscience and brought it back?...
examples.translation: 要是他觉得内疚，把东西拿回来了怎么办？

examples.text: I could go away again with a clear conscience.
examples.translation: 我可以问心无愧地再次离开。

examples.text: He refused for reasons of conscience to sign a new law legalising abortion.
examples.translation: 他出于信仰，拒绝签署使堕胎合法化的新法。

examples.text: ...the law on freedom of conscience and religious organizations.
examples.translation: 有关信仰自由和宗教组织自由的法律

examples.text: I'm so glad he had a pang of conscience...
examples.translation: 我很高兴他会有负疚感。

examples.text: They have shown a ruthless lack of conscience.
examples.translation: 他们没有表现出丝毫内疚，实在是太无情了。

examples.text: She could not, in good conscience, back out on her deal with him.
examples.translation: 凭良心她不能背弃与他达成的协议。

examples.text: Now the murderer has two deaths on his conscience.
examples.translation: 现在，这个杀人犯背着两条人命，受到了良心的谴责。

meanings.meaning: 认真的；尽责的；本着良心的；小心谨慎的

examples.text: We are generally very conscientious about our work...
examples.translation: 我们普遍对工作都非常认真。

examples.text: Virginia was still struggling to be a conscientious and dedicated mother.
examples.translation: 弗吉尼娅还在尽力成为一位勤勤恳恳、全心奉献的母亲。

examples.text: He studied conscientiously and enthusiastically.
examples.translation: 他一丝不苟、满怀热情地学习。

meanings.meaning: 意识到的；故意的；神志清醒的

examples.text: He was conscious of the faint, musky aroma of after-shave...
examples.translation: 他注意到了须后水淡淡的麝香味。

examples.text: She was very conscious of Max studying her...
examples.translation: 她非常清楚马克斯在仔细端详她。

examples.text: Conscious that he was becoming light-headed again, he went over to the window.
examples.translation: 他意识到自己又开始头晕了，于是走向窗边。

examples.text: I'm very conscious of my weight...
examples.translation: 我很在意自己的体重。

examples.text: He is acutely conscious that this transition will bring with it the risk of social unrest.
examples.translation: 他非常清楚这种转变伴随着社会动乱的危险。

examples.text: I don't think we ever made a conscious decision to have a big family...
examples.translation: 我觉得我们没有刻意地决定要生很多孩子。

examples.text: Make a conscious effort to relax your muscles.
examples.translation: 有意识地放松肌肉。

examples.text: Sophie was not consciously seeking a replacement after her father died.
examples.translation: 父亲去世后，索菲并没有刻意地寻找替代他的人。

examples.text: She was fully conscious all the time and knew what was going on.
examples.translation: 她一直都很清醒，知道是怎么回事。

examples.text: He had no conscious memory of his four-week stay in hospital...
examples.translation: 他对自己住院的4个星期没有任何有意识的记忆。

examples.text: Beneath the conscious mind there are many levels of the unconscious.
examples.translation: 在意识心理之下存在很多层次的无意识。

examples.text: Most people cannot consciously remember much before the ages of 5 to 7 years...
examples.translation: 大多数人在5至7岁之前没有多少有意识的记忆。

examples.text: Sometimes we are not consciously aware of these feelings.
examples.translation: 有时候我们没有意识到这些情感。

examples.text: The Cup was won for the third consecutive year by the Toronto Maple Leafs...
examples.translation: 多伦多枫叶队连续第三年捧杯。

examples.text: Photographs taken at the same time on two consecutive sunny days can be quite different from one another.
examples.translation: 在连续两个艳阳天的同一时间拍摄的照片也可能大不相同。

examples.text: ...a CD player which plays six CDs consecutively.
examples.translation: 可以连续播放6张CD的CD播放机

examples.text: The consensus amongst the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades...
examples.translation: 世界各国科学家一致认为在未来几十年里地球有可能变暖。

examples.text: The question of when the troops should leave would be decided by consensus.
examples.translation: 部队应该何时撤离的问题将由大家共同决定。

meanings.meaning: 同意；（意见等的）一致；赞成

examples.text: At approximately 11:30 p.m., Pollard finally gave his consent to the search...
examples.translation: 大概晚上11点半的时候，波拉德最终同意进行搜查。

examples.text: Can my child be medically examined without my consent?
examples.translation: 能不经我的同意就对我的孩子进行体检吗？

examples.text: He finally consented to go...
examples.translation: 他最终同意去了。

examples.text: He asked Ginny if she would consent to a small celebration after the christening...
examples.translation: 他问金尼是否同意在洗礼之后小小地庆祝一下。

examples.text: I was a little surprised when she consented.
examples.translation: 我有点儿吃惊她竟然同意了。

examples.text: By common consent their talk avoided the reason for their being there at all...
examples.translation: 双方达成共识，他们的谈话对他们去那儿的原因完全避而不谈。

examples.text: He left the company by mutual consent last September.
examples.translation: 去年9月，经双方同意，他离开了公司。

examples.text: By common consent this election constituted a historic step on the road to democracy.
examples.translation: 普遍认为这次选举是迈上民主之路的历史性一步。

examples.text: Her lawyer said she understood the consequences of her actions and was prepared to go to jail...
examples.translation: 她的律师说她明白自己行为的后果，已有了入狱的心理准备。

examples.text: An economic crisis may have tremendous consequences for our global security.
examples.translation: 一场经济危机可能严重影响到全球安定。

examples.text: His death was totally unexpected and, in consequence, no plans had been made for his replacement...
examples.translation: 他的死完全出乎意料，所以，根本没有安排替补人选。

examples.text: Maternity services were to be reduced in consequence of falling birth rates.
examples.translation: 由于出生率下降，产科服务会随之削减。

examples.text: ...people who are suffering and dying as a consequence of cigarette smoking...
examples.translation: 因吸烟而患病或死亡的人

examples.text: As an overseer, he suddenly found himself a person of consequence...
examples.translation: 作为工头，他突然觉得自己是个重要人物。

examples.text: Where he is from is of no consequence to me.
examples.translation: 他来自何方对我来说并不重要。

examples.text: These pilots must now face the consequences of their actions and be brought to trial...
examples.translation: 这些飞行员现在必须为自己的行为承担后果，接受审判。

examples.text: If climate changes continue, we will suffer the consequences.
examples.translation: 如果气候变化继续下去，我们将自食其果。

examples.text: Grandfather Dingsdale had sustained a broken back while working in the mines. Consequently, he spent the rest of his life in a wheelchair...
examples.translation: 丁斯戴尔爷爷在矿井里工作时被压断了脊骨，结果，下半辈子都与轮椅为伴了。

examples.text: Relations between the two companies had, consequently, never been close.
examples.translation: 因此，两家公司之间的关系一直都不太亲密。

examples.text: ...a four-nation regional meeting on elephant conservation.
examples.translation: 四国保护大象的地区性会议

examples.text: ...tree-planting and other conservation projects.
examples.translation: 植树以及其他环保计划

examples.text: Then he began his most famous work, the conservation and rebinding of the Book of Kells...
examples.translation: 之后他就开始了他最为出名的工作，即保护并重新装订《凯尔斯书》。

examples.text: ...projects aimed at promoting energy conservation.
examples.translation: 旨在促进节约能源的计划

examples.text: ...rules concerning the conservation of fishery resources.
examples.translation: 有关保护渔业资源的规定

examples.text: We don't consider our customers to be mere consumers; we consider them to be our friends...
examples.translation: 我们没有把客户仅仅看作是消费者;我们还把他们当作朋友。

examples.text: I had always considered myself a strong, competent woman...
examples.translation: 一直以来，我始终认为自己是个女强人。

examples.text: The paper does not explain why foreign ownership should be considered bad...
examples.translation: 报纸并没有解释为什么说外国人拥有所有权是坏事。

examples.text: I consider activities such as jogging and weightlifting as unnatural...
examples.translation: 我认为像慢跑、举重这样的运动不符合自然规律。

examples.text: Barbara considers that pet shops which sell customers these birds are very unfair.
examples.translation: 芭芭拉认为把这些鸟卖给顾客的宠物商店非常不地道。

examples.text: The government is being asked to consider a plan to fix the date of the Easter break...
examples.translation: 人们要求政府考虑确定复活节假期日期的计划。

examples.text: You do have to consider the feelings of those around you...
examples.translation: 你的确需要考虑周围人的感受。

examples.text: Consider how much you can afford to pay for a course, and what is your upper limit.
examples.translation: 考虑一下你能承受花多少钱修一门课，上限是多少。

examples.text: I had seriously considered telling the story from the point of view of the wives...
examples.translation: 我认真考虑过从为人妻者的视角来讲述这个故事。

examples.text: Watersports enthusiasts should consider hiring a wetsuit as well as a lifejacket...
examples.translation: 除了租救生衣，水上运动爱好者还应该考虑租一套潜水服。

examples.text: They are considering the launch of their own political party.
examples.translation: 他们正在考虑建立自己的政党。

examples.text: All things considered, I think you have behaved marvellously in coming here.
examples.translation: 从各方面考虑，我认为你来这儿是一个非常明智的举动。

meanings.meaning: 相当大的；重要的，值得考虑的

examples.text: To be without Pearce would be a considerable blow...
examples.translation: 失去皮尔斯将是一个巨大的打击。

examples.text: Doing it properly makes considerable demands on our time...
examples.translation: 把这事做好要耗费我们相当多的时间。

examples.text: Vets' fees can be considerable, even for routine visits.
examples.translation: 即使是常规检查，兽医的收费也会相当高。

examples.text: Children vary considerably in the rate at which they learn these lessons...
examples.translation: 孩子们学习这些课文的速度大不相同。

examples.text: Their dinner parties had become considerably less formal.
examples.translation: 他们的晚餐会已经远不如以前正式。

meanings.meaning: 体贴的；体谅的；考虑周到的

examples.text: I think he's the most charming, most considerate man I've ever known...
examples.translation: 我觉得他是我所认识的最有魅力并且最为体贴的男士。

examples.text: I've always understood one should try and be considerate of other people.
examples.translation: 我一直认为一个人应该尽量为他人着想。

examples.text: He treats everyone equally and considerately.
examples.translation: 他对待每一个人都一视同仁，体贴周到。

examples.text: He said there should be careful consideration of the future role of the BBC.
examples.translation: 他说应该认真思考英国广播公司将来要扮演的角色。

examples.text: Several proposals are under consideration by the state assembly.
examples.translation: 有几个提案州议会正在讨论中。

examples.text: Show consideration for other rail travellers...
examples.translation: 体谅其他铁路乘客。

examples.text: Really, her tone said, some people have absolutely no consideration.
examples.translation: 她的语气的确是在说有些人从不替他人考虑。

examples.text: They should not allow partisan political considerations or interests to cloud their judgment...
examples.translation: 他们不应该让党派政治因素或者党派利益影响自己的判断。

examples.text: A major consideration when choosing a dog is the size of your house and garden.
examples.translation: 选择狗时，一个重要的考虑因素是房子和花园的大小。

examples.text: The whole affair is bound to be taken into consideration when the Indian side is picked...
examples.translation: 如果选的是印度一方，整个事件必定会纳入考虑范围之中。

examples.text: Safe driving is good driving because it takes into consideration the lives of other people.
examples.translation: 安全驾驶是良好的驾驶习惯，因为它考虑到了他人的人身安全。

examples.text: Most Conservative MPs appear happy with the government's reassurances.
examples.translation: 大多数保守党下议院议员似乎都对政府的再三保证感到满意。

examples.text: ...disenchanted Conservative voters.
examples.translation: 不再抱任何幻想的保守党选民

examples.text: In 1951 the Conservatives were returned to power.
examples.translation: 1951年保守党重新执政。

examples.text: ...counties whose citizens invariably support the most conservative candidate in any election.
examples.translation: 其民众在任何选举中均铁定支持观点最右倾的候选人的几个郡

examples.text: The new judge is 50-year-old David Suitor who's regarded as a conservative.
examples.translation: 新法官是50岁的戴维·休特，他被视为右翼人士。

examples.text: People tend to be more aggressive when they're young and more conservative as they get older...
examples.translation: 人们年轻的时候往往较为激进，而随着年龄的增长会变得保守起来。

examples.text: It is essentially a narrow and conservative approach to child care.
examples.translation: 这实质上是一种狭隘的、因循守旧的照顾孩子的方法。

examples.text: The girl was well dressed, as usual, though in a more conservative style.
examples.translation: 这个女孩穿得一如往日那样讲究，只是风格比平日更为传统。
