examples.text: She was always very conservatively dressed when we went out.
examples.translation: 我们拍拖的时候，她总是穿得非常传统。

examples.text: A conservative estimate of the bill, so far, is about £22,000...
examples.translation: 到目前为止，这笔账单保守估计为大约2.2万英镑。

examples.text: This guess is probably on the conservative side.
examples.translation: 这个猜测可能偏于保守。

examples.text: The bequest is conservatively estimated at £30 million.
examples.translation: 保守估计，这笔遗产有3,000万英镑。

meanings.meaning: 始终如一的，一致的；坚持的

examples.text: Becker has never been the most consistent of players anyway.
examples.translation: 不管怎么说，贝克尔从来就不是表现最为稳定的球员。

examples.text: ...his consistent support of free trade.
examples.translation: 他对自由贸易始终如一的支持

examples.text: It's something I have consistently denied...
examples.translation: 那是我自始至终否认的事。

examples.text: Jones and Armstrong maintain a consistently high standard.
examples.translation: 琼斯和阿姆斯特朗始终保持着高水准。

examples.text: This result is consistent with the findings of Garnett & Tobin...
examples.translation: 这个结果与加尼特托宾公司的调查结果一致。

examples.text: New goals are not always consistent with the existing policies.
examples.translation: 新目标并不总是与现行政策一致。

examples.text: These are clear consistent policies which we are putting into place.
examples.translation: 这些就是我们正在付诸实施的政策，不但清楚而且前后一致。

examples.text: Breakfast consisted of porridge served with butter.
examples.translation: 早餐是麦片粥配佐餐黄油。

examples.text: Her crew consisted of children from Devon and Cornwall.
examples.translation: 她的团队由来自德文郡和康沃尔郡的孩子们组成。

examples.text: His work as a consultant consisted in advising foreign companies on the siting of new factories.
examples.translation: 作为一名顾问，他的工作是为外国公司在新厂选址问题上提供建议。

examples.text: ...Baudelaire's idea that genius consists in the ability to summon up childhood.
examples.translation: 波德莱尔认为天才在于唤起童年的能力的观点

meanings.meaning: [计] 控制台；[电] 操纵台

examples.text: 'Never mind, Ned,' he consoled me...
examples.translation: “没关系，内德。”他安慰我说。

examples.text: Often they cry, and I have to play the role of a mother, consoling them...
examples.translation: 经常他们一哭，我就要充当母亲的角色抚慰他们。

examples.text: He will have to console himself by reading about the success of his compatriots...
examples.translation: 他只能读读同胞们成功的故事来安慰自己。

examples.text: I can console myself with the fact that I'm not alone...
examples.translation: 不是只有我一个人才这样，我可以用这一事实来安慰自己。

examples.text: He consoled himself that Emmanuel looked like a nice boy, who could be a good playmate for his daughter.
examples.translation: 他安慰自己说，伊曼纽尔看上去是个不错的男孩，会是女儿的好玩伴。

examples.text: It is not a consoling thought to Germans to see that Americans have the same kind of problem, too.
examples.translation: 看到美国人也碰到了同样的问题，德国人并不会感到安慰。

examples.text: The only consolation for the Scottish theatre community is that they look likely to get another chance...
examples.translation: 对苏格兰戏剧界来说，唯一感到安慰的就是他们看来可能还有一个机会。

examples.text: He knew then he was right, but it was no consolation.
examples.translation: 当时他知道自己是正确的，但这并不能给他任何安慰。

examples.text: The question is: will the junta consolidate its power by force?...
examples.translation: 问题是：军政府会通过武力巩固其政权吗？

examples.text: Brydon's team-mate Martin Williamson consolidated his lead in the National League when he won the latest round.
examples.translation: 布赖登的队友马丁·威廉森在最近一轮比赛中获胜，巩固了自己在全国联赛中的领先地位。

examples.text: But change brought about the growth and consolidation of the working class...
examples.translation: 但是变革使得工人阶级发展壮大起来。

examples.text: Even if not total, the Romans' hold was sufficient for them to begin the task of consolidation.
examples.translation: 即使没有实现完全的控制，罗马人的势力也足以让他们开始着手巩固政权了。

examples.text: Judge Charles Schwartz is giving the state 60 days to disband and consolidate Louisiana's four higher education boards...
examples.translation: 查尔斯·施瓦茨法官将给路易斯安那州60天时间来解散然后合并该州的4个高等教育委员会。

examples.text: IBM, which consolidated some operations last summer, has made clear that it needs to continue to streamline them.
examples.translation: 去年夏天合并了部分业务的IBM公司明确表示需要继续进行精简，以提高效率。

examples.text: This consolidation meant having to reduce the numerical strength of the Army...
examples.translation: 这次合并意味着不得不削减陆军的兵力。

examples.text: Further consolidations in the industry could follow.
examples.translation: 该产业随后可能会有进一步的合并。

examples.text: The most conspicuous way in which the old politics is changing is in the growing use of referendums...
examples.translation: 旧式政治最明显的变化在于其越来越多地进行全民公决。

examples.text: You may feel tearful in situations where you feel conspicuous.
examples.translation: 觉得自己身处众目睽睽之下时，你可能会有想哭的感觉。

examples.translation: 显然，约翰斯顿的名字不在名单之上。

examples.translation: 比赛时他没有上场，并且由于没有参加赛后的庆祝活动而引起了大家的关注。

examples.translation: 7个人都来自布里斯托尔，他们承认了合谋纵火。

examples.translation: 没有证据表明这帮人对布什先生图谋不轨。

examples.translation: 咖啡因是茶、咖啡之类饮品中的活性成分。

examples.translation: 该中心95%以上的工作人员是志愿者。

examples.translation: 若干研究已经发现了两个重要常量。

meanings.meaning: 宪法；体质；章程；构造；建立，组成；体格

examples.text: The king was forced to adopt a new constitution which reduced his powers.
examples.translation: 国王被迫采用了削弱其权力的新宪法。

examples.text: ...the American Constitution...

examples.translation: 我一向体壮如牛。

examples.translation: 这些预算旨在减少赤字，将会大大受限。

examples.translation: 不知怎么的，他觉得自己必须得压低声音。

examples.translation: 他最终构筑起了一个延伸至泰国和新加坡的商业帝国。

examples.translation: 小说是基于一系列现场报道构思而成的。

examples.translation: 这是为奴隶制辩护的同一思想观念的再现。

examples.translation: 很多人食用燕麦麸后胆固醇水平下降了。

examples.translation: 这些酒中大部分都不适于人类饮用。

examples.translation: 没有章首目录。

examples.text: Previous students have had nothing but praise for the course content and staff...
examples.translation: 往届学生对课程内容与教员全是赞扬之词。

examples.text: This is how we see our tasks, and the substance and content of our work for the forthcoming period.
examples.translation: 这就是我们对工作任务的看法，以及下一阶段我们工作的实质与内容。

examples.text: Sunflower margarine has the same fat content as butter...
examples.translation: 向日葵所制人造黄油的脂肪含量与黄油脂肪含量相同。

examples.text: He was astonished at the high gold content in the 340 million-year-old rock.
examples.translation: 他对这块有3.4亿年历史的岩石的高含金量大为惊异。

examples.text: I am content to admire the mountains from below...
examples.translation: 我满足于从山脚下观赏山景。

examples.text: I'm perfectly content with the way the campaign has gone...
examples.translation: 我对竞选活动的进展十分满意。

examples.text: Not content with rescuing one theatre, Sally Green has taken on another.
examples.translation: 萨莉·格林不满足于挽救一家剧院，她又接手了另外一家。

examples.text: He says his daughter is quite content.
examples.translation: 他说他女儿非常满意。

examples.text: He wisely contented himself with his family and his love of nature...
examples.translation: 他非常明智，拥有家庭和对自然的热爱便知足了。

examples.text: Most manufacturers content themselves with updating existing models.
examples.translation: 大多数制造商都满足于对现有款型进行更新。

examples.text: Few contests in the recent history of British boxing have been as thrilling.
examples.translation: 英国近年的拳击比赛中很少有如此激动人心的。

examples.text: ...a writing contest.
examples.translation: 写作比赛

examples.text: The state election due in November will be the last such ballot before next year's presidential contest...
examples.translation: 定于11月举行的州选举将是明年总统竞选前最后一次此类投票选举。

examples.text: ...a clear contest between church and state.
examples.translation: 教会与政府之间明显的争斗

examples.text: He quickly won his party's nomination to contest the elections.
examples.translation: 他很快获得了本党提名,角逐大选。

examples.text: ...a closely contested regional flower show.
examples.translation: 各方争奇斗艳、难分高下的地区花卉展

examples.text: Your former employer has to reply within 14 days in order to contest the case...
examples.translation: 你的前任雇主若对本案存有异议，必须在14天内予以答复。

examples.text: Gender discrimination is a hotly contested issue.
examples.translation: 性别歧视是一个争论激烈的话题。

examples.text: We are doing this work in the context of reforms in the economic, social and cultural spheres.
examples.translation: 我们是在对经济、社会、文化诸领域进行改革的背景下从事这项工作的。

examples.text: ...the historical context in which Chaucer wrote...
examples.translation: 乔叟写作的历史背景

examples.text: This is the context in which President Chirac must decide his policy.
examples.translation: 这是希拉克总统必须确定其政策的背景。

examples.text: Without a context, I would have assumed it was written by a man.
examples.translation: 如果没有上下文，我会以为这是出自一名男子笔下。

examples.text: Taxation is not popular in principle, merely acceptable in context...
examples.translation: 征税基本上是不受欢迎的，在一定情境中才勉强为人接受。

examples.text: It is important that we put Jesus into the context of history.
examples.translation: 我们将耶稣置于历史环境中来看是很重要的。

examples.text: Thomas says that he has been taken out of context on the issue...
examples.translation: 托马斯说，在这个问题上他的话被断章取义了。

examples.text: Quotes can be manipulated and used out of context.
examples.translation: 引语可能会被篡改，使用时断章取义。

examples.text: She loved the African continent...
examples.translation: 她热爱非洲大陆。

examples.text: Dinosaurs evolved when most continents were joined in a single land mass.
examples.translation: 恐龙进化的时候，多数大陆连为一体。

examples.text: Its shops are among the most stylish on the Continent.
examples.translation: 其店铺跻身欧陆最时尚的店铺之列。

examples.text: The school has been in continual use since 1883...
examples.translation: 自1883年以来，该校从未停办过。

examples.text: They felt continual pressure to perform well...
examples.translation: 他们不断感受到压力，促使他们好好表演。

examples.text: Despite continual pain, he refused all drugs.
examples.translation: 尽管一直觉得疼，他还是拒绝使用任何药物。

examples.text: She cried almost continually and threw temper tantrums...
examples.translation: 她几乎哭个没完，还大发脾气。

examples.text: The large rotating fans whirred continually.
examples.translation: 大大的风扇没完没了地嗡嗡转着。

examples.text: ...the government's continual demands for cash to finance its chronic deficit...
examples.translation: 政府为补贴长期的财政赤字而对资金的持续需求

examples.text: She suffered continual police harassment.
examples.translation: 她不断受到警方的骚扰。

examples.text: Malcolm was continually changing his mind...
examples.translation: 马尔科姆不断地改主意。

examples.text: I had been writing him continually, trying to get him to call me.
examples.translation: 我一直在给他写信，想让他给我打电话。

examples.text: I hope they continue to fight for equal justice after I'm gone...
examples.translation: 我希望我走了以后他们能继续为司法公正而战。

examples.text: Interest rates continue to fall...
examples.translation: 利率持续下调。

examples.text: They are determined to continue working when they reach retirement age...
examples.translation: 他们决定在达到退休年龄后继续工作。

examples.text: There is no reason why you should not continue with any sport or activity you already enjoy.
examples.translation: 没有理由停下你一直在进行的体育运动或活动。

examples.text: He insisted that the conflict would continue until conditions were met for a ceasefire...
examples.translation: 他坚持认为除非满足停火条件，否则冲突会继续下去。

examples.text: But as the investigation continued, the plot began to thicken...
examples.translation: 但是随着调查的继续深入，情况开始变得复杂起来。

examples.text: Outside the building people continue their vigil, huddling around bonfires.
examples.translation: 在房子外面，人们挤在篝火旁边，继续守夜。

examples.text: ...the continued existence of a species.
examples.translation: 一个物种的延续

examples.text: I went up to my room to continue with my packing...
examples.translation: 我走进房间，继续打包。

examples.text: She looked up for a moment, then continued drawing.
examples.translation: 她抬头看了一下，然后继续画画。

examples.text: He denies 18 charges. The trial continues today...
examples.translation: 他否认了18项指控。审判今天继续。

examples.text: Once, he did dive for cover but he soon reappeared and continued his activities.
examples.translation: 他确实一度销声匿迹，但是很快就重出江湖，继续他的各种活动。

examples.text: 'You have no right to intimidate this man,' Alison continued...
examples.translation: “你没有权利威胁这个人，”艾莉森接着说。

examples.text: Tony drank some coffee before he continued...
examples.translation: 托尼喝了点咖啡继续说。

examples.text: Please continue.
examples.translation: 请接着讲。

examples.text: He had hoped to continue as a full-time career officer...
examples.translation: 他曾经希望继续当一名全职的职业事务员。

examples.text: For ten days I continued in this state.
examples.translation: 我的这种状况持续了10天。

examples.text: He continued rapidly up the path, not pausing until he neared the Chapter House.
examples.translation: 他匆匆地继续沿着这条路走，一直快到牧师会礼堂时才停下来。

examples.text: The main road continues towards Viterbo before turning right to Bolsena.
examples.translation: 大路一直延伸到维泰博，之后右转通向博尔塞纳。

meanings.meaning: 连续的，持续的；继续的；连绵不断的

examples.text: Residents report that they heard continuous gunfire.
examples.translation: 居民们报告说他们听到了连续不断的枪声。

examples.text: ...all employees who had a record of five years' continuous employment with the firm...
examples.translation: 所有在公司连续任职达5年的员工

examples.text: There is a continuous stream of phone calls.
examples.translation: 电话接连不断。

examples.text: The civil war has raged almost continuously since 1976...
examples.translation: 自从1976年开始，内战几乎没有中断过。

examples.text: It is the oldest continuously inhabited city in America.
examples.translation: 这是美国最古老的一直有人居住的城市。

examples.text: ...a continuous line of boats.
examples.translation: 一排船只

examples.text: ...the continuous frieze of sculpted figures.
examples.translation: 一条人物雕像构成的檐壁

examples.text: The company won a prestigious contract for work on Europe's tallest building...
examples.translation: 这家公司赢得了一份极为重要的合同，参与建设欧洲最高的大厦。

examples.text: He was given a seven-year contract with an annual salary of $150,000.
examples.translation: 他签下了一份为期7年的合同，年薪为15万美元。

examples.text: You can contract with us to deliver your cargo...
examples.translation: 你可以跟我们签订送货合同。

examples.text: The Boston Museum of Fine Arts has already contracted to lease part of its collection to a museum in Japan.
examples.translation: 波士顿美术博物馆已经签订合同，将其部分藏品租借给日本一家博物馆。

examples.text: Blood is only expelled from the heart when it contracts...
examples.translation: 血液在心脏收缩的时候从心脏流出。

examples.text: New research shows that an excess of meat and salt can contract muscles.
examples.translation: 新的研究表明，过量食用肉类和盐可能会导致肌肉收缩。

examples.text: ...the contraction and expansion of blood vessels...
examples.translation: 血管的收缩和扩张

examples.text: Foods and fluids are mixed in the stomach by its muscular contractions.
examples.translation: 通过胃部肌肉的收缩食物和流质在胃中混合。

examples.text: The manufacturing economy contracted in October for the sixth consecutive month.
examples.translation: 10月，制造业经济已经连续第6个月出现萎缩状况。

examples.text: He contracted AIDS from a blood transfusion...
examples.translation: 他因为输血而感染了艾滋病。

examples.text: Ovarian cancer is the sixth most common cancer contracted by women.
examples.translation: 卵巢癌是女性常患的第六大癌症。

examples.text: She contracted a formal marriage to a British ex-serviceman.
examples.translation: 她和一个英国退役军人正式订婚了。

examples.text: The convictions resulted in the local crime bosses putting a contract on him...
examples.translation: 这些判罪导致当地犯罪团伙的老大们要雇凶杀他。

examples.text: The police advised her to get out of town because there was a contract on her life.
examples.translation: 警察建议她离开这个城市，因为有人雇杀手杀她。

examples.text: The director wanted Olivia de Havilland, then under contract to Warner Brothers.
examples.translation: 导演想要当时签约于华纳兄弟娱乐公司旗下的奥利维娅·德哈维兰出演。

meanings.meaning: 反驳；否定；与…矛盾；与…抵触

examples.text: She dared not contradict him...
examples.translation: 她不敢反驳他。

examples.text: His comments appeared to contradict remarks made earlier in the day by the chairman...
examples.translation: 他的意见似乎和当天早些时候主席所说的相矛盾。

examples.text: He often talks in circles, frequently contradicting himself and often ends up saying nothing.
examples.translation: 他说话经常兜圈子，老是自相矛盾，常常到最后什么也没说。

examples.text: Her version contradicted the Govern-ment's claim that they were shot after being challenged...
examples.translation: 政府声称他们是在受到盘问后被开枪射杀的，而她的说法却与此相矛盾。

examples.text: The result seems to contradict a major U.S. study reported last November.
examples.translation: 这一结果似乎和去年11月美国研究人员发表的一项重要成果相矛盾。

examples.text: Mr Grant feels that the cutbacks contradict the Government's commitment to better educational standards.
examples.translation: 格兰特先生感觉这些缩减措施和政府提高教育水平的承诺背道而驰。

examples.text: ...the contradictions between her private life and the public persona...
examples.translation: 她的私生活与公众形象之间的巨大反差

examples.text: The performance seemed to me unpardonable, a contradiction of all that the Olympics is supposed to be...
examples.translation: 在我看来，这次的表现是不可宽恕的，和奥运精神完全相悖。

examples.text: The militants see no contradiction in using violence to bring about a religious state.
examples.translation: 好战者觉得用暴力建立一个宗教国家这种做法并无矛盾之处。

examples.text: A public service run for profit — a contradiction in terms if there ever was one.
examples.translation: 以营利为目的的公共服务机构——这是典型的用词上的自相矛盾（如果真有这种说法的话）。

examples.text: This view is contrary to the aims of critical social research for a number of reasons...
examples.translation: 之所以说此观点违背了批判性社会研究的宗旨，有几点理由。

examples.text: Several of those present, including Weinberger, had contrary information.
examples.translation: 几个在场的人，包括温博格，所掌握的信息截然不同。

examples.text: Contrary to popular belief, moderate exercise actually decreases your appetite...
examples.translation: 与通常的看法相反，适度的运动事实上会降低食欲。

examples.text: Contrary to what you might think, neither man was offended.
examples.translation: 你也许以为那两个人生气了，但实际上正相反，两个人都没有生气。

examples.text: It is not an idea around which the Community can unite. On the contrary, I see it as one that will divide us.
examples.translation: 这种想法并不能让欧共体团结一致。相反地，我认为它会导致我们的分裂。

examples.text: 'People just don't do things like that.' — 'On the contrary, they do them all the time.'
examples.translation: “人们根本不会做那样的事情。”——“恰恰相反，他们一直在那样做。”

examples.text: I'm not a feminist, quite the contrary...
examples.translation: 我不是一个女权主义者，根本不是。

examples.text: 'Are there any signs that he may quit soon?' — 'Quite the contrary.'
examples.translation: “有没有迹象表明他可能很快就会辞职？”——“完全没有。”

examples.text: That does not automatically mean, however, that the money supply has been curbed, and there is considerable evidence to the contrary...
examples.translation: 然而，那并不一定意味着货币供应量受到了限制，有大量证据表明事实正好相反。

examples.text: Despite repeated assurances to the contrary, Pakistan has not ended its nuclear programme.
examples.translation: 尽管巴基斯坦再三保证停止其核项目，但事实却并非如此。

examples.text: ...the contrast between town and country...
examples.translation: 城乡差别

examples.text: The two visitors provided a startling contrast in appearance...
examples.translation: 这两位访客的外表截然不同。

examples.text: Silk was used with wool for contrast.
examples.translation: 丝绸和毛料用在一起以形成对比。

examples.text: The private sector, by contrast, has plenty of money to spend...
examples.translation: 相比之下，私营部门就有很多钱可供开销。

examples.text: In contrast, the lives of girls in well-to-do families were often very sheltered...
examples.translation: 相反，生活在富裕家庭的女孩子通常都备受呵护。

examples.text: In contrast to similar services in France and Germany, Intercity rolling stock is very rarely idle.
examples.translation: 与法国和德国的类似铁路服务系统不同，“城际列车”很少闲置。

examples.text: His public statements have always been in marked contrast to those of his son...
examples.translation: 他和他儿子在公开场合的言论总是截然不同。

examples.text: That is in stark contrast to the situation during the 1970 oil crisis.
examples.translation: 那和1970年石油危机时的情形完全不同。

examples.text: The boy's room is a complete contrast to the guest room.
examples.translation: 这个男孩的房间和客房截然不同。

examples.text: ...a country of great contrasts.
examples.translation: 一个截然不同的国家

examples.text: She contrasted the situation then with the present crisis...
examples.translation: 她将当时的情况和目前的危机进行对比。

examples.text: Contrast that approach with what goes on in most organizations...
examples.translation: 将那个方法和大多数机构现行的做法进行对比。

examples.text: In this section we contrast four possible broad approaches.
examples.translation: 在这个部分，我们将对4种可行的广义方法进行对比。

examples.text: Johnson's easy charm contrasted sharply with the prickliness of his boss...
examples.translation: 约翰逊的亲和力和他老板易怒的性格形成了鲜明的对比。

examples.text: Paint the wall in a contrasting colour.
examples.translation: 把这面墙刷成对比鲜明的颜色。

examples.text: ...a television with brighter colours, better contrast, and digital sound.
examples.translation: 颜色更为鲜艳、图像对比度更高、具备数字音响效果的电视

examples.text: American economists have made important contributions to the field of financial and corporate economics...
examples.translation: 美国的经济学家们在金融和企业经济学领域做出了重要的贡献。

examples.text: He was awarded a prize for his contribution to world peace.
examples.translation: 他由于为世界和平做出贡献而获奖。

examples.text: This list ranked companies that make charitable contributions of a half million dollars or more.
examples.translation: 这张名单列出了慈善捐款额达50万美元以上的公司。

meanings.meaning: 贡献，出力；投稿；捐献 [ 过去式 contributed 过去分词 contributed 现在分词 contributing ]

examples.text: The three sons also contribute to the family business...
examples.translation: 这3个儿子也为家族事业做出了贡献。

examples.text: I believe that each of us can contribute to the future of the world...
examples.translation: 我相信我们每一个人都能够对世界的未来有所贡献。

examples.text: He believes he has something to contribute to a discussion concerning the uprising.
examples.translation: 他认为自己能够为有关起义的讨论提供一些信息。

examples.text: The US is contributing $4 billion in loans, credits and grants...
examples.translation: 美国将提供40亿美元的信贷和赠款。

examples.text: They say they would like to contribute more to charity, but money is tight this year...
examples.translation: 他们说他们很想捐献更多的钱支持慈善事业，但是今年的钱非常紧张。

examples.text: NATO officials agreed to contribute troops and equipment to such an operation if the UN Security Council asked for it.
examples.translation: 北约官员同意可在联合国安理会要求的情况下派出部队并提供装备参加这样的军事行动。

examples.text: ...the largest net contributors to EU funds.
examples.translation: 向欧盟基金净捐资额最大的捐助者

examples.text: The report says design faults in both the vessels contributed to the tragedy...
examples.translation: 报告说两艘船存在的设计缺陷也促成了这场悲剧的发生。

examples.text: Stress, both human and mechanical, may also be a contributing factor.
examples.translation: 来自人的和机械方面的压力可能也是一个因素。

examples.text: I was asked to contribute to a newspaper article making predictions for the new year...
examples.translation: 我受邀为报纸撰写一篇文章，对新的一年进行预测。

examples.text: Frank Deford is a contributing editor for Vanity Fair magazine.
examples.translation: 弗兰克·德福特是杂志《名利场》的特约编辑。

examples.text: Reporter Alan Nearn covers Central America and is a regular contributor to The New Yorker.
examples.translation: 记者艾伦·尼恩负责在中美洲采访报道，定期向《纽约客》杂志投稿。

examples.text: The oil companies were accused of contriving a shortage of gasoline to justify price increases.
examples.translation: 石油公司被控故意制造石油短缺以名正言顺地提高油价。

examples.text: We therefore had to contrive a very large black-out curtain.
examples.translation: 因此我们得制作一块很大的遮光窗帘。

examples.text: The orchestra contrived to produce some of its best playing for years.
examples.translation: 这支管弦乐队呈现了精彩的演奏，堪称其多年来的巅峰演奏。

examples.text: They somehow contrived to lose tens of thousands of applications.
examples.translation: 他们精心策划故意遗失了数万份申请书。

examples.text: Immigration is a controversial issue in many countries...
examples.translation: 在很多国家，移民都是一个颇有争议的问题。

examples.text: ...Morton's controversial book, 'Diana, Her True Story.'...
examples.translation: 莫顿颇有争议的一本书，《戴安娜：真实的故事》

examples.text: The changes are bound to be controversial.
examples.translation: 这些变化注定会引起争议。

examples.text: ...the controversial 19th century politician Charles Parnell.
examples.translation: 19世纪颇具争议的政治家查尔斯·帕内尔

examples.text: More controversially, he claims that these higher profits cover the cost of finding fresh talent...
examples.translation: 更具争议的是，他声称这些更高的利润可足以支付寻找新人才所花费的成本。

examples.text: David Hirst was controversially sent off on his European debut for Sheffield Wednesday last night.
examples.translation: 周三，也就是昨天晚上大卫·赫斯特代表谢菲尔德足球俱乐部参加他在欧洲的首场比赛时被罚下场，引来一片争议。

examples.text: The proposed cuts have caused considerable controversy.
examples.translation: 削减开支的提议引起了诸多争议。

examples.text: ...a fierce political controversy over human rights abuses.
examples.translation: 关于侵犯人权问题的激烈的政治辩论

examples.text: He was happy to make a detour for her convenience.
examples.translation: 为了她方便，他很乐意绕道。

examples.text: ...the need to put the rights of citizens above the convenience of elected officials.
examples.translation: 需要把公民的权利置于当选官员的便利之上

examples.text: Delivery times are arranged at your convenience.
examples.translation: 送货时间会安排在您方便的时候。

examples.text: Mail order is a convenience for buyers who are too busy to shop.
examples.translation: 邮购对于那些没有时间逛商店的购物者来说是一项非常方便的服务。

examples.text: Some TVRs have power steering and conveniences such as central locking and powered windows.
examples.translation: 一些特雷沃车型配有动力转向系统以及中央锁和电动窗之类的便利装置。

examples.text: ...an apartment with all the modern conveniences.
examples.translation: 现代化便利设施一应俱全的公寓

examples.text: ...the cubicles of a public convenience.
examples.translation: 公共厕所的小隔间

meanings.meaning: 方便的；[废语]适当的；[口语]近便的；实用的

examples.text: ...a flexible and convenient way of paying for business expenses...
examples.translation: 灵活而方便的业务费用支付方式

examples.text: The family thought it was more convenient to eat in the kitchen.
examples.translation: 这家人认为在厨房吃饭更方便。

examples.text: They may use a credit card for convenience.
examples.translation: 为了方便，他们可以使用信用卡。

examples.text: ...the convenience of a fast non-stop flight.
examples.translation: 快速直达航班的便利

examples.text: The body spray slips conveniently into your sports bag for freshening up after a game.
examples.translation: 身体喷雾可以很方便地放到运动包里，比赛结束后喷一喷能解乏提神。

examples.text: The town is well placed for easy access to London and convenient for Heathrow Airport...
examples.translation: 这座城市地理位置优越，到伦敦和希思罗机场都很方便。

examples.text: Martin drove along until he found a convenient parking place.
examples.translation: 马丁一直往前开，直到找到了一个方便的停车场。

examples.text: It was very conveniently situated just across the road from the City Reference Library...
examples.translation: 它就在市工具书图书馆的马路对面，十分便利。

examples.text: He chose Simi Valley in Ventura County mainly because it was conveniently close to Los Angeles.
examples.translation: 他选择住在文图拉县的西米山谷，主要是因为这里离洛杉矶很近，很方便。

examples.text: ...two conveniently placed push-buttons.
examples.translation: 两个很方便的按钮

examples.text: She will try to arrange a mutually convenient time and place for an interview...
examples.translation: 她会尽力安排一个双方都方便的时间和地点进行面试。

examples.text: Would this evening be convenient for you?
examples.translation: 今天晚上你方便吗？

examples.text: We cannot make this minority a convenient excuse to turn our backs...
examples.translation: 我们不能拿少数这几个人作为一种方便的借口而对此置之不理。

examples.text: ...a convenient scapegoat...
examples.translation: 随手抓来的替罪羊

examples.text: It does seem a bit convenient, doesn't it?
examples.translation: 这看起来确实省事，对吧？

examples.text: They've conveniently forgotten the risk of heart disease...
examples.translation: 他们有意忽略了患心脏病的风险。

examples.text: Conveniently, he had developed amnesia about that part of his life.
examples.translation: 他得了健忘症，记不起那一段生活了，倒也省心了。

meanings.meaning: 控制；管理；抑制；操纵装置

examples.text: The restructuring involves Mr Ronson giving up control of the company...
examples.translation: 这次改组涉及龙森先生放弃对公司的控制权。

examples.text: The first aim of his government would be to establish control over the republic's territory.
examples.translation: 他这届政府的首要目标是确立对共和国领土的控制权。

examples.text: Nobody knows who is in control of the club...
examples.translation: 没人知道是谁掌管着这家俱乐部。

examples.text: In the West, people feel more in control of their own lives.
examples.translation: 在西方，人们感觉个人生活更自如一些。

examples.text: All the newspapers were taken under government control.
examples.translation: 当时所有的报纸都受到政府控制。

examples.text: He lost control of his car...
examples.translation: 他的汽车失控了。

examples.text: Some teachers have more control over pupils than their parents have.
examples.translation: 有的老师比小学生的父母更能管得住他们。

examples.text: He had a terrible temper, and sometimes he would completely lose control...
examples.translation: 他的脾气很坏，有时会完全失控。

examples.text: He was working hard to keep control of himself.
examples.translation: 他正努力克制自己。

examples.text: He now controls the largest retail development empire in southern California...
examples.translation: 他现在掌管着加州南部最大的零售发展企业。

examples.text: Almost all of the countries in Latin America were controlled by dictators...
examples.translation: 当时几乎所有的拉丁美洲国家都由独裁者统治。

examples.text: Minebea ended up selling its controlling interest in both firms.
examples.translation: 美蓓亚集团最后将其在两家公司的控股权都出售了。

examples.text: AGA Gas is Swedish-controlled.
examples.translation: AGA天然气公司是一家瑞典的燃气公司。

examples.text: ...the state-controlled media.
examples.translation: 政府控制的媒体

examples.text: ...a computerised system to control the gates...
examples.translation: 控制大门的计算机系统

examples.text: Scientists would soon be able to manipulate human genes to control the ageing process.
examples.translation: 科学家们很快将能通过操控人类基因来控制衰老过程。

examples.text: ...the controlled production of energy from sugar by a cell.
examples.translation: 在细胞的控制下将糖转化为能量的过程

examples.text: ...computer-controlled traffic lights.
examples.translation: 由计算机控制的交通信号灯

examples.text: The federal government tried to control rising health-care costs.
examples.translation: 联邦政府试图控制日益高涨的医疗保健费用。

examples.text: ...measures to control illegal mining.
examples.translation: 控制非法采矿的措施

examples.text: Control of inflation remains the government's absolute priority.
examples.translation: 控制通货膨胀仍然是政府的第一要务。

examples.text: Jo was advised to learn to control herself...
examples.translation: 乔得到的建议是要学会控制自己的情绪。

examples.text: I just couldn't control my temper.
examples.translation: 我就是不能克制自己的脾气。

examples.text: Her manner was quiet and very controlled.
examples.translation: 她举止文静，而且非常冷静。

examples.text: ...the need to control environmental pollution...
examples.translation: 控制环境污染的需要

examples.text: One of the biggest tasks will be to control the spread of malaria.
examples.translation: 最大的任务之一就是控制疟疾的蔓延。

examples.text: I practised operating the controls.
examples.translation: 我练习操作这些控制装置。

examples.text: ...the control box.
examples.translation: 控制盒

examples.text: He died of a heart attack while at the controls of the plane.
examples.translation: 他在驾驶飞机的时候，心脏病突发去世。

examples.text: Critics question whether price controls would do any good...
examples.translation: 评论家们质疑物价管制措施是否会有用。

examples.text: Their talks are expected to focus on arms control...
examples.translation: 他们的会谈预计会集中讨论军备控制问题。

examples.text: They have very strict gun control in Sweden.
examples.translation: 瑞典对枪支实行非常严格的管制。

examples.text: He went straight through Passport Control without incident.
examples.translation: 他很顺利地通过了护照检查处。

examples.text: ...an agreement to abolish border controls.
examples.translation: 关于取消边界检查站的一项协议

examples.text: The fire is burning out of control...
examples.translation: 熊熊燃烧的大火正在失去控制。

examples.text: I'm dealing with customers all the time who have let their debts get out of control.
examples.translation: 我成天和那些负债累累、无力偿还的顾客们打交道。

examples.text: The situation is under control...
examples.translation: 局势已经得到控制。

examples.text: If the current violence is to be brought under control, the government needs to act.
examples.translation: 政府必须采取行动，才能使目前的暴力行为得到控制。

meanings.meaning: 大会；[法] 惯例；[计] 约定；[法] 协定；习俗

examples.text: It's just a social convention that men don't wear skirts...
examples.translation: 男人不穿裙子只是一种社会习俗。

examples.text: Despite her wish to defy convention, she had become pregnant and married at 21.
examples.translation: 尽管她不想遵循传统习俗，但她还是在21岁的时候就怀孕并且结婚了。

examples.text: We go offstage and come back for the convention of the encore.
examples.translation: 按照加演的传统做法，我们走到后台后又再次返场。

examples.text: ...the stylistic conventions of Egyptian art.
examples.translation: 埃及艺术的传统风格

examples.text: ...the UN convention on climate change.
examples.translation: 联合国有关气候变化的公约

examples.text: ...the Geneva convention.
examples.translation: 日内瓦公约

examples.text: ...the annual convention of the Society of Professional Journalists.
examples.translation: 职业新闻工作者协会年度大会

examples.text: ...the Republican convention.
examples.translation: 共和党代表大会

meanings.meaning: 符合习俗的，传统的；常见的；惯例的

examples.text: ...a respectable married woman with conventional opinions.
examples.translation: 一位观念传统、受人尊敬的已婚女性

examples.text: People still wore their hair short and dressed conventionally.
examples.translation: 人们还留着短发、穿着传统服饰。

examples.text: It is simpler and quicker to use than conventional methods.
examples.translation: 这比通常的做法更简单、更快捷。

examples.text: These discs hold more than 400 times as much information as a conventional computer floppy disk.
examples.translation: 这些光盘能容纳的信息量是普通计算机软盘的400多倍。

examples.text: Organically grown produce does not differ greatly in appearance from conventionally grown crops.
examples.translation: 有机农产品在外观上和以传统方法种植的作物没有很大的区别。

examples.text: We must reduce the danger of war by controlling nuclear, chemical and conventional arms.
examples.translation: 我们必须通过控制核武器、化学武器和常规武器的数量来减少战争的危险。

meanings.meaning: 交谈，会话；社交；交往，交际；会谈；（人与计算机的）人机对话

examples.text: He's a talkative guy, and I struck up a conversation with him...
examples.translation: 他是一个健谈的人，于是我开始和他攀谈起来。

examples.text: I waited for her to finish a telephone conversation.
examples.translation: 我等着她打完电话。

examples.text: When I arrived I found her in conversation with Mrs Williams.
examples.translation: 我到的时候，发现她正在和威廉斯夫人谈话。

examples.text: He had been trying to make conversation.
examples.translation: 他一直在尽量找话说。

examples.text: In real life, nobody was all bad, nor, conversely, all good.
examples.translation: 在现实生活中，没有彻头彻尾的坏人，相反地，也没有完完全全的好人。

meanings.meaning: 转换；变换；[金融] 兑换；改变信仰

examples.text: ...the conversion of disused rail lines into cycle routes...
examples.translation: 将废弃的铁路线改成自行车道

examples.text: A loft conversion can add considerably to the value of a house.
examples.translation: 将阁楼改造一下就可以使房子的价值大增。

examples.text: ...his conversion to Christianity...
examples.translation: 他皈依基督教

examples.text: It's hard to trust the President's conversion.
examples.translation: 总统信仰的改变让人难以相信。

meanings.meaning: 使转变；转换…；使…改变信仰
转变，变换；皈依；改变信仰
皈依者；改变宗教信仰者

examples.text: The signal will be converted into digital code.
examples.translation: 信号会被转变为数字代码。

examples.text: ...naturally occurring substances which the body can convert into vitamins.
examples.translation: 自然产生的能被身体转化成维生素的物质

examples.text: ...a table that converts into an ironing board.
examples.translation: 能转换成熨衣板的桌子

examples.text: By converting the loft, they were able to have two extra bedrooms.
examples.translation: 把阁楼改造一下，他们就可以多出两间卧室。

examples.text: ...the entrepreneur who wants to convert County Hall into an hotel...
examples.translation: 想把市政厅改建成旅馆的企业家

examples.text: He is living in a converted barn.
examples.translation: 他住在一个改造过的仓库里。

examples.text: Save money by converting your car to unleaded...
examples.translation: 将车改装一下，使用无铅汽油，这样可以省钱。

examples.text: The programme to convert every gas burner in Britain took 10 years.
examples.translation: 完成对英国所有煤气灶的改造花了10年时间。

examples.text: Converting metric measurements to U.S. equivalents is easy.
examples.translation: 将公制计量换算成美制计量非常简单。

examples.text: If you try to convert him, you could find he just walks away...
examples.translation: 如果你试图改变他的信仰，他就会走开。

examples.text: He was a major influence in converting Godwin to political radicalism...
examples.translation: 戈德温变成政治激进主义者主要是受他的影响。

examples.text: He converted to Catholicism in 1917.
examples.translation: 他于1917年皈依天主教。

examples.text: She, too, was a convert to Roman Catholicism.
examples.translation: 她也皈依了天主教。

examples.text: ...a Muslim convert now known as Yusuf Islam.
examples.translation: 现以优素福·伊斯兰这个名字为大家熟知的伊斯兰教皈依者

examples.text: He quickly converted me to the joys of cross-country skiing.
examples.translation: 他很快就使我迷上了越野滑雪。

examples.text: ...recent converts to vegetarianism.
examples.translation: 最近开始热衷于素食主义的人

examples.text: When I returned home, I tried to convey the wonder of this machine to my husband...
examples.translation: 回到家后，我竭力地想把这台机器的精妙之处描述给丈夫听。

examples.text: In every one of her pictures she conveys a sense of immediacy...
examples.translation: 她拍的每一张照片中都传递出一种临场感，使人有如亲临现场。

examples.text: He also conveyed his views and the views of the bureaucracy.
examples.translation: 他也表达了自己的看法和官方的看法。

examples.text: The railway company extended a branch line to Brightlingsea to convey fish direct to Billingsgate.
examples.translation: 铁路公司修建了一条通往布赖特灵西的支线，以便直接将鱼运送到比林斯门。

examples.text: In 1977 he was convicted of murder and sentenced to life imprisonment...
examples.translation: 1977年，他被判谋杀罪名成立，判处终身监禁。

examples.text: There was insufficient evidence to convict him.
examples.translation: 没有足够证据给他定罪。

examples.text: ...a convicted drug dealer.
examples.translation: 已定罪的毒品贩子

meanings.meaning: 定罪；确信；证明有罪；确信，坚定的信仰

examples.text: It is our firm conviction that a step forward has been taken...
examples.translation: 我们坚信已经向前迈进了一步。

examples.text: Their religious convictions prevented them from taking up arms.
examples.translation: 由于宗教信仰的原因，他们不会拿起武器进行反抗。

examples.text: 'We shall, sir,' said Thorne, with conviction.
examples.translation: “我们会的，先生，”索恩坚定地说。

examples.text: Nor did his denial carry conviction.
examples.translation: 他的否认也没有说服力。

examples.text: He will appeal against his conviction...
examples.translation: 他会对判决提起上诉。

examples.text: The man was known to the police because of previous convictions.
examples.translation: 因为有犯罪前科，警察们都认识这个人。

examples.text: Although I soon convinced him of my innocence, I think he still has serious doubts about my sanity...
examples.translation: 虽然我很快便让他相信我是清白的，但是我想他仍然非常怀疑我是否神志正常。

examples.text: The waste disposal industry is finding it difficult to convince the public that its operations are safe.
examples.translation: 废物处理行业发现很难让公众相信其操作是安全的。

examples.text: That weekend in Plattsburgh, he convinced her to go ahead and marry Bud.
examples.translation: 在普拉茨堡的那个周末，他说服她嫁给巴德。

examples.text: I have to go and cook the dinner...
examples.translation: 我得去做饭了。

examples.text: Chefs at the St James Court restaurant have cooked for the Queen...
examples.translation: 圣詹姆斯皇家饭店的厨师们曾经为女王烹制菜肴。

examples.text: We'll cook them a nice Italian meal.
examples.translation: 我们会给他们做一顿美味的意大利餐。

examples.text: Her hobbies include music, dancing, sport and cooking.
examples.translation: 她的爱好包括音乐、舞蹈、体育和烹饪。

examples.text: ...some basic instructions on how to cook a turkey...
examples.translation: 烹饪火鸡的一些基本的做法指导

examples.text: Let the vegetables cook gently for about 10 minutes...
examples.translation: 用小火将蔬菜煮大约10分钟。

examples.text: Drain the pasta as soon as it is cooked.
examples.translation: 意大利面煮熟以后立即将水沥干。

examples.text: They had a butler, a cook, and a maid.
examples.translation: 他们有一个男管家、一个厨师和一个女佣。

examples.text: I felt a current of cool air...
examples.translation: 我感觉到一阵凉风。

examples.text: The water was slightly cooler than a child's bath...
examples.translation: 这水比小孩的洗澡水稍微凉一些。

examples.text: The vaccines were kept cool in refrigerators.
examples.translation: 疫苗放在冰箱中冷藏。

examples.text: His knees felt the coolness of the tiled floor.
examples.translation: 他的膝盖感觉到地板砖有些凉。

examples.text: Thank goodness it's cool in here...
examples.translation: 谢天谢地，这里面挺凉快。

examples.text: Store grains and cereals in a cool, dry place.
examples.translation: 将粮食和谷物储存在阴凉干燥的地方。

examples.text: ...a cool November evening.
examples.translation: 11月一个凉爽的夜晚

examples.text: She walked into the cool of the hallway.
examples.translation: 她走到凉快的走廊上。

examples.text: Soon we left the coolness of the olive groves.
examples.translation: 很快我们就离开了凉爽的橄榄树林。

examples.text: In warm weather, you should wear clothing that is cool and comfortable.
examples.translation: 在热天里，应该穿凉快舒适的衣服。

examples.text: Choose a cool colour such as cream...
examples.translation: 选择冷色系，比如乳白色。

examples.text: The drawing-room was a cool silver green.
examples.translation: 客厅是冷色调的银绿色。

examples.text: Drain the meat and allow it to cool...
examples.translation: 把肉沥干水，让它冷却。

examples.text: Huge fans will have to cool the concrete floor to keep it below 150 degrees.
examples.translation: 必须用巨大的风扇来冷却混凝土地面，将其温度控制在150度以下。

examples.text: ...a cooling breeze.
examples.translation: 凉爽的微风

examples.text: Avoid putting your car away until the engine has cooled down...
examples.translation: 在发动机冷却之前不要把车开进车库里。

examples.text: The other main way the body cools itself down is by panting.
examples.translation: 喘气是身体自身降温的另一个主要方式。

examples.text: Being immobile in a cold room leads to a cooling of the body temperature.
examples.translation: 呆在一个冰冷的房间里不活动会使体温降低。

examples.text: Within a few minutes tempers had cooled...
examples.translation: 几分钟之内，火气就变小了。

examples.text: His weird behaviour had cooled her passion.
examples.translation: 他奇怪的举动使得她的激情冷却。

examples.text: He was marvelously cool again, smiling as if nothing had happened...
examples.translation: 他又变得出奇地冷静，微笑着，好像什么也没有发生过。

examples.text: At that, Reno lost her cool composure.
examples.translation: 听了那句话，雷诺失去了冷静。

examples.text: Everyone must think this situation through calmly and coolly.
examples.translation: 每个人都必须冷静沉着地仔细考虑这一情况。

examples.text: ...coolly 'objective' professionals.
examples.translation: 冷静“客观”的专业人士

examples.text: Detectives praised him for his coolness.
examples.translation: 侦探们称赞他沉着冷静。

examples.text: I didn't like him at all. I thought he was cool, aloof, and arrogant...
examples.translation: 我一点也不喜欢他，觉得他冷漠、孤僻而且傲慢。

examples.text: The idea met with a cool response...
examples.translation: 人们对这个想法反应冷淡。

examples.text: He was given a cool reception.
examples.translation: 他受到了慢待。

examples.text: It's your choice, Nina,' David said coolly.
examples.translation: “这是你的选择，尼娜，”戴维冷淡地说。

examples.text: She seemed quite unaware of the sudden coolness of her friend's manner.
examples.translation: 她似乎完全没有意识到朋友的态度突然变得冷淡起来。

examples.text: He was trying to be really cool and trendy.
examples.translation: 他竭力想扮酷，赶时髦。

examples.text: ...some 15-year-old kid who thinks it's cool to do heroin.
examples.translation: 认为吸食海洛因很酷的一个15岁的孩子

examples.text: Bev was really cool about it all.
examples.translation: 贝芙对这一切都表现得相当平静。

examples.text: Kathleen gave me a really cool dress.
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳给了我一件非常漂亮的衣服。

examples.text: Columbia recently resigned the band for a cool $30 million.
examples.translation: 哥伦比亚唱片公司最近以3,000万美元的高价再次签下这个乐队。

examples.text: Can't you guys just cool it?
examples.translation: 你们能不能冷静一下？

examples.text: She kept her cool and managed to get herself out of the ordeal...
examples.translation: 她保持着冷静与克制，努力使自己走出了这次痛苦的经历。

examples.text: The big Irishman was on the verge of losing his cool.
examples.translation: 那个高大的爱尔兰人快要失去冷静了。

examples.text: It's ridiculous to play it cool if someone you're mad about is mad about you too.
examples.translation: 如果让你生气的人也在生你的气，而你还要假装冷静，那就太可笑了。

examples.text: The UN had been co-operating with the State Department on a plan to find countries willing to take the refugees...
examples.translation: 联合国一直都在与美国国务院合作推进一项计划，寻找愿意接纳难民的国家。

examples.text: The couple spoke about how they would co-operate in the raising of their child...
examples.translation: 这对夫妇讲述了他们将如何共同抚养孩子。

examples.text: The French and British are co-operating more closely than they have for years.
examples.translation: 法国和英国现在的合作比往年更加密切。

examples.text: A deal with Japan could indeed open the door to economic co-operation with East Asia.
examples.translation: 和日本的一宗交易可能真的能够开启同东亚的经济合作之门。

examples.text: He agreed to co-operate with the police investigation...
examples.translation: 他同意配合警方的调查。

examples.text: The plan failed because the soldiers refused to co-operate.
examples.translation: 因为士兵们不肯合作，这项计划宣告失败。

examples.text: The police underlined the importance of the public's co-operation in the hunt for the bombers.
examples.translation: 警方强调在搜捕爆炸制造者的过程中，公众的配合至关重要。

examples.text: They decided a housing co-operative was the way to regenerate Ormiston Crescent...
examples.translation: 他们最终决定通过住房合作社来重建奥米斯顿月牙街。

examples.text: The restaurant is run as a co-operative.
examples.translation: 这家饭店是合作经营的。

examples.text: He was transferred to FBI custody in a smooth co-operative effort between Egyptian and US authorities...
examples.translation: 在埃及当局和美国当局的共同努力下他被顺利移交美国联邦调查局进行羁押。

examples.text: The President said the visit would develop friendly and co-operative relations between the two countries.
examples.translation: 总统说这次访问将会促进两国之间的友好合作关系。

examples.text: They agreed to work co-operatively to ease tensions wherever possible.
examples.translation: 他们同意互相配合尽一切努力缓解紧张局势。

examples.text: I made every effort to be co-operative.
examples.translation: 我尽了最大努力配合。

examples.text: They see the U.N. as the lead actor to coordinate the international community's assistance.
Frank didn't like having the cops know where to find him.
examples.translation: 弗兰克不想让警察知道去哪里可以找到他。

examples.text: Motel owners and restaurant managers copped it for neglecting their clients.
examples.translation: 汽车旅馆老板和饭店经理因为冷落顾客而受到责骂。

examples.text: The Jane's 'Triple X Album' came out in 1986, and wasn't much cop actually.
examples.translation: 简在1986年推出了《XXX》专辑，但事实上并不怎么样。

examples.text: It was amazing how my mother coped with bringing up three children on less than three pounds a week...
examples.translation: 我妈妈用每周不到3英镑的钱抚养大了3个孩子，简直太不可思议了。

examples.text: The problems were an annoyance, but we managed to cope.
examples.translation: 这些问题很讨厌，但是我们都设法解决了。

examples.text: Never before has the industry had to cope with war and recession at the same time...
examples.translation: 这个行业以前从未有过必须同时应付战争和萧条的经历。

examples.text: She has had to cope with losing all her previous status and money.
examples.translation: 她不得不忍受彻底失去以前所拥有的地位和金钱的痛苦。

examples.text: New blades have been designed to cope with the effects of dead insects...
examples.translation: 新的桨片设计使其可以应付昆虫尸体带来的影响。

examples.text: The country's prisons are filled with drug-takers, and cannot cope with the numbers...
examples.translation: 这个国家的监狱里挤满了瘾君子，都容纳不下了。

examples.text: The speed of economic change has been so great that the tax-collecting system has been unable to cope.
examples.translation: 经济变化得如此之快，以致税收系统都应付不过来了。

examples.text: Chile is the world's largest producer of copper.
examples.translation: 智利是世界上最大的产铜国。

examples.text: ...a copper mine.
examples.translation: 铜矿

examples.text: His hair has reverted back to its original copper hue.
examples.translation: 他的头发又变回原来的淡红棕色。

examples.text: ...your friendly neighbourhood copper.
examples.translation: 你们友善的社区警察

examples.text: The reporter apparently obtained a copy of Steve's resignation letter...
examples.translation: 那记者显然弄到了史蒂夫辞职信的复印件。

examples.text: Always keep a copy of everything in your own files.
examples.translation: 要时刻牢记把所有文件都备份。

examples.text: She never participated in obtaining or copying any classified documents for anyone.
examples.translation: 她从未参与过为任何人获取或复制机密文件之事。

examples.text: ...lawsuits against companies who have unlawfully copied computer programs.
examples.translation: 对非法复制计算机程序的公司提起的诉讼

examples.text: ...top designers, whose work has been widely copied...
examples.translation: 其作品被很多人仿制的顶级设计师

examples.text: He copied the chart from a book.
examples.translation: 他从一本书上复印了那个图表。

examples.text: He would allow John slyly to copy his answers to impossibly difficult algebra questions...
examples.translation: 他会让约翰偷偷抄下自己对一些极难的代数题的解答。

examples.text: He copied the data into a notebook...
examples.translation: 他将数据抄在一个笔记本上。

examples.text: We're copying from textbooks because we don't have enough to go round.
examples.translation: 我们在抄课本，因为课本不够。

examples.text: He wrote the title on the blackboard, then copied out the text sentence by sentence...
examples.translation: 他将题目写在黑板上，然后逐句抄下课文。

examples.text: 'Did he leave a phone number?' — 'Oh, yes.' She copied it out for him.
examples.translation: “他留电话号码了吗？”——“嗯，留了。”她将号码给他抄了下来。

examples.text: Children can be seen to copy the behaviour of others whom they admire or identify with...
examples.translation: 人们发现儿童会模仿他们所崇拜或有共鸣感的人。

examples.text: He can claim to have been defeated by opponents copying his own tactics.
examples.translation: 他可以说是被仿效自己策略的对手们给打败了。

examples.text: ...the coquettish gestures she had copied from actresses in soap operas.
examples.translation: 她从肥皂剧中的那些女演员那里学来的一些搔首弄姿的动作

examples.text: Children learn by copying.
examples.translation: 儿童通过模仿来学习。

examples.text: I bought a copy of 'USA Today' from a street-corner machine...
examples.translation: 我从街角的自动售卖机买了一份《今日美国》。

examples.text: You can obtain a copy for $2 from New York Central Art Supply.
examples.translation: 花两美元就能从纽约艺术用品中心买到一册。

examples.text: ...his ability to write the most lyrical copy in the history of sports television.
examples.translation: 他能够撰写体育节目史上最富热情和激情的稿件

examples.text: ...advertising copy.
examples.translation: 广告文案

examples.text: ...journalists looking for good copy.
examples.translation: 搜罗好题材的记者

examples.text: To order a book one first had to get permission from the monastery that held the copyright...
examples.translation: 要想订购书，必须先得到持有该书版权的修道院的许可。

examples.text: She threatened legal action against the Sun for breach of copyright.
examples.translation: 她威胁说要对《太阳报》侵犯其著作权的行为采取法律措施。

examples.text: The door had been tied shut with a length of nylon cord.
examples.translation: 门用一段尼龙绳拴住了。

examples.text: ...gilded cords and tassels.
examples.translation: 镀金的绳子和流苏

examples.text: ...electrical cord...
examples.translation: 电源线

examples.text: We used so many lights that we needed four extension cords.
examples.translation: 我们用的灯很多，因此需要4个接线板。

examples.translation: 他光着脚，穿着T恤衫和灯芯绒裤子。

examples.translation: 一条灯芯绒裤子

meanings.meaning: 补品；兴奋剂；甜香酒，甘露酒

examples.text: He had never known him to be so chatty and cordial...
examples.translation: 他从没见过他如此健谈，如此友善。

examples.text: He said the two countries had close and cordial relations.
examples.translation: 他说两国之间有着密切友好的关系。

examples.text: They all greeted me very cordially and were eager to talk about the new project.
examples.translation: 他们都很热情地向我打招呼，并且迫切想谈论这个新项目。

examples.text: Egypt wants to solve the problem in an atmosphere of cordiality.
examples.translation: 埃及想要友好地解决该问题。

examples.text: ...fruit cordials.
examples.translation: 果汁饮料

examples.text: Someone threw an apple core...
examples.translation: 有人扔了一个苹果核。

examples.text: Peel the pears and remove the cores.
examples.translation: 将梨削皮去核。

examples.text: ...machines for peeling and coring apples.
examples.translation: 苹果削皮去核机

examples.text: ...the earth's core...
examples.translation: 地核

examples.text: The core of the city is a series of ancient squares.
examples.translation: 市中心是一座接一座古老的广场。

examples.translation: 直击问题要害的能力

examples.translation: 黑人总爱惹事这一观念是种族主义论断的核心。

examples.translation: 我们的骨干团队已经就位了。

examples.text: A core of about six staff would continue with the project.
examples.translation: 由大约6名职员组成的骨干队伍将继续该项目。

examples.translation: 基础课是英文、数学和科学。

examples.text: I'm not opposed to a core curriculum in principle, but I think requiring a foreign language is unrealistic.
examples.translation: 原则上我不反对设置基础课程，但我认为要求掌握一门外语是不现实的。

examples.text: ...a core of nine academic subjects.
examples.translation: 包括9个学科的核心课程

examples.text: The core activities of local authorities were reorganised...
examples.translation: 地方政府的主要事务进行了调整。

examples.text: The group plans to concentrate on six core businesses...
examples.translation: 该集团打算主营6种业务。

examples.text: However, the main core of the company performed outstandingly.
examples.translation: 然而，该公司的主营业务却表现出色。

examples.text: The villagers are royalist to the core.
examples.translation: 那些村民是十足的保皇主义者。

examples.text: Leonard was shaken to the core; he'd never seen or read anything like it.
examples.translation: 伦纳德极为震惊;他从未看过或读过这样的东西。

examples.translation: 麦田

examples.translation: 他将谷仓装满了谷物。

examples.text: ...rows of corn in an Iowa field.
examples.translation: 艾奥瓦州农田里成排的玉米

examples.translation: 他看见杂志的一角从毯子下露了出来。

examples.translation: 在左上角写上“航空邮递”。

examples.translation: 起居室角落里的牌桌

examples.translation: 球飞进了球网的远角。

examples.translation: 最后我在钢琴旁的阴暗角落里发现了它。

examples.translation: 她擦掉嘴角的面包屑。

examples.text: Out of the corner of her eye she saw that a car had stopped.
examples.translation: 她用眼角的余光瞥见一辆车停了下来。

examples.translation: 她会整天在街角附近游荡。

examples.translation: 不可能每个街角都派驻警察。

examples.translation: 他一直等到那个男人拐过街角。

examples.text: ...a sharp corner...
examples.translation: 急转弯

examples.text: The road is a succession of hairpin bends, hills, and blind corners.
examples.translation: 这条路上急转弯、坡道和死拐角一个接一个。

examples.text: Buyers came from all corners of the world...
examples.translation: 买主来自世界各地。

examples.text: The group has been living in a remote corner of the Cambodian jungle.
examples.translation: 该部落一直居住在柬埔寨的丛林深处。

examples.text: A police motorcycle chased his car twelve miles, and cornered him near Rome...
examples.translation: 一辆摩托警车跟在他的车后追了12英里，最后在快到罗马时将他截住。

examples.text: He was still sitting huddled like a cornered animal.
examples.translation: 他还像一头困兽一样蜷缩着坐在那儿。

examples.text: Golan managed to corner the young producer-director for an interview.
examples.translation: 戈兰设法截住了那位兼任制片人的年轻导演，对其进行了采访。

examples.text: This restaurant has cornered the Madrid market for specialist paellas...
examples.translation: 这家餐馆垄断了马德里的特色肉菜饭市场。

examples.text: Zurich's affluence came initially from cornering a sizeable chunk of the 14th Century silk trade.
examples.translation: 苏黎世的富足最初来自于14世纪对丝绸贸易的高度垄断。

examples.text: Peter drove jerkily, cornering too fast and fumbling the gears.
examples.translation: 彼得转弯太急，换挡不利索，车开得一颠一颠的。

examples.text: The Chancellor of the Exchequer says that economic recovery is just around the corner.
examples.translation: 财政大臣说经济即将复苏。

examples.text: My new place is just around the corner.
examples.translation: 我的新家就在附近。

examples.text: Take your time, don't cut corners and follow instructions to the letter.
examples.translation: 慢慢来，不要图省事，要严格按照说明去做。

examples.text: They've combed the four corners of the world for the best accessories...
examples.translation: 为了找到最好的配件，他们寻遍了每个地方。

examples.text: Young people came from the four corners of the nation.
examples.translation: 全国各地的年轻人都来到这里。

examples.text: The government is in a corner on interest rates...
examples.translation: 政府在利率问题上陷入了困境。

examples.text: He appears to have backed himself into a tight corner.
examples.translation: 他似乎已把自己逼入了困境。

examples.translation: 跨国公司

examples.translation: 精工株式会社

examples.translation: 市政委员会改造900英亩的市中心贫民区的任务

examples.text: The correct answers can be found at the bottom of page 8...
examples.translation: 正确答案在第8页末尾。

examples.text: The following information was correct at time of going to press...
examples.translation: 下列信息在付印时准确无误。

examples.text: Doctors examine their patients thoroughly in order to make a correct diagnosis.
examples.translation: 为了作出准确的诊断，医生会对病人进行彻底的检查。

examples.text: Did I pronounce your name correctly?...
examples.translation: 你的名字我念对了吗？

examples.text: You have to correctly answer each question.
examples.translation: 你必须正确回答每一个问题。

examples.text: Ask the investor to check the correctness of what he has written.
examples.translation: 让投资人检查一下他所写的是否正确。

examples.text: You are absolutely correct. The leaves are from a bay tree...
examples.translation: 你说得很对，这是月桂树的叶子。

examples.text: If Casey is correct, the total cost of the cleanup would come to $110 billion.
examples.translation: 如果凯西是对的，清理的总花费将达1,100亿美元。

examples.text: The use of the correct materials was crucial...
examples.translation: 使用恰当的材料至关重要。

examples.text: White was in no doubt the referee made the correct decision.
examples.translation: 怀特确信裁判作出了公正的判罚。

examples.text: ...the correct way to produce a crop of tomato plants.
examples.translation: 栽种一季西红柿的正确方法

examples.text: If correctly executed, this shot will give them a better chance of getting the ball close to the hole.
examples.translation: 如果出手准确，这一击将使他们有机会把球打得离球洞更近。

examples.text: You are perfectly correct in trying to steer your mother towards increased independence...
examples.translation: 你试图让自己的母亲变得越来越独立，这样做很正确。

examples.text: I think the president was correct to reject the offer.
examples.translation: 我认为总统拒绝这一提议是正确的。

examples.text: When an accident happens, quite correctly questions are asked.
examples.translation: 当事故发生时，理所当然要询问一些情况。

examples.text: He may need surgery to correct the problem...
examples.translation: 要解决这个问题，他可能需要做外科手术。

examples.text: He has criticised the government for inefficiency and delays in correcting past mistakes.
examples.translation: 他批评政府在纠正过去的错误问题上效率低下，并且拖拖拉拉。

examples.text: ...legislation to require the correction of factual errors...
examples.translation: 要求改正与事实不符的错误的立法

examples.text: We will then make the necessary corrections.
examples.translation: 我们届时会作出必要的修改。

examples.translation: “实际上，并不是那样，”乔治纠正我。

examples.text: I must correct him on a minor point.
examples.translation: 我必须纠正他的一处小错误。

examples.text: It took an extraordinary effort to focus on preparing his classes or correcting his students' work.
examples.translation: 备课和批改学生的作业花费了他很多精力。

examples.text: I think English men are very polite and very correct...
examples.translation: 我认为英国人很有礼貌，举止非常得体。

examples.text: We were rather surprised by their sporting and correct behaviour.
examples.translation: 他们富有体育精神而且举止得体，让我们感到相当惊讶。

examples.translation: 议会最高法院按照常规，开庭前先为女王祈祷。

examples.translation: 他拘谨的步态和郑重其事的举止

examples.translation: 如果我没记错的话，那是在卡马森的一个停车场内。

examples.translation: 肥胖会增加高血压和中风发作的几率。

examples.translation: 配偶之间政治观点上的相似度要大于他们身高的相似程度。

examples.translation: 英国科学界不如以前受重视，资金也因此减少。

examples.translation: 在最高管理层，收入与工作表现并不总是相关的。

examples.translation: 人们试图把特定的语言功能与大脑的某些特定部位联系起来，这一努力目前还没有取得很大进展。

examples.translation: 瑞安中尉闭上眼睛，先是在脑海里回想了一遍不同的犯罪现场，然后将这些信息联系起来。

examples.translation: 观看赛马比赛的观众将获得一个与某一匹赛马相对应的号码。

examples.translation: 乘车出行者的比率上升了22%，与之相对应，人均骑自行车的行驶里程下降了19%。

examples.translation: 她满脸关切之情，但她的肢体语言并非如此。

examples.translation: 与1992年同期相比，今年3月和4月的销售额增长了8%。

examples.translation: 英国时来运转，势不可挡，与之相对，法国的国际影响力不断下降

examples.translation: 她仍与9年前在马略卡岛结识的美国朋友们通信。

examples.translation: 我们定期通信。

examples.text: The judges' decision is final and no correspondence will be entered into...
examples.translation: 法官的裁决是最终裁决，再写信也不会予以审议。

examples.text: His interest in writing came from a long correspondence with a close college friend.
examples.translation: 与一位大学密友的长期通信培养了他写作的兴趣。

examples.translation: 来信他总是会回。

examples.translation: 她在书信和笔记中几乎从不提及他。

examples.translation: 非洲语言中的发音与字母关系密切。

examples.text: He has devised a process for making gold wires which neither corrode nor oxidise...
examples.translation: 他设计了一种能够避免腐蚀或氧化的金丝制作流程。

examples.text: Engineers found the structure had been corroded by moisture...
examples.translation: 工程师们发现该建筑已经受潮腐蚀。

examples.text: Acid rain destroys trees and corrodes buildings.
examples.translation: 酸雨毁坏树木，腐蚀建筑物。

examples.text: The investigators found that the underground pipes were badly corroded.
examples.translation: 调查人员发现地下管道严重腐蚀。

examples.text: Suffering was easier to bear than the bitterness he felt corroding his spirit...
examples.translation: 相较于他感觉正在侵蚀他灵魂的痛苦而言，这种折磨倒更容易承受。

examples.text: He warns that corruption is corroding Russia.
examples.translation: 他警告说腐败正在侵蚀俄罗斯。

examples.text: ...to save the nation from corrupt politicians of both parties...
examples.translation: 从两个政党的腐败政客手中挽救这个国家

examples.text: ...corrupt police officers...
examples.translation: 腐败的警察

examples.text: He had accused three opposition members of corrupt practices.
examples.translation: 他指控3名反对派成员营私舞弊。

examples.text: ...several government officials charged with acting corruptly.
examples.translation: 被控营私舞弊的几名政府官员

examples.text: It is sad to see a man so corrupted by the desire for money and power.
examples.translation: 看到一个人因为追逐金钱和权力而如此腐化真是悲哀。

examples.text: ...warning that television will corrupt us all...
examples.translation: 警告说电视将会使我们所有人堕落

examples.text: Cruelty depraves and corrupts.
examples.translation: 残暴行为会使人堕落、道德败坏。

examples.text: Some of the finer typefaces are corrupted by cheap, popular computer printers...
examples.translation: 有些比较优美的字体经过价廉、通用的电脑打印机处理后就面目全非了。

examples.text: They can ensure that traditional cuisines are not totally corrupted by commercial practices.
examples.translation: 他们可以确保传统烹饪不会被商业运营模式完全破坏。

examples.text: ...corrupted data.
examples.translation: 被损坏的数据

examples.text: ...cosmic radiation.
examples.translation: 外太空的辐射

examples.text: ...cosmic debris.
examples.translation: 外太空垃圾

examples.text: ...the cosmic laws governing our world.
examples.translation: 支配我们世界的宇宙规律

examples.text: ...humanity's place in the cosmic order of things.
examples.translation: 在宇宙万物的秩序中人类的位置

meanings.meaning: 花费；使付出；使花许多钱

examples.text: The cost of a loaf of bread has increased five-fold...
examples.translation: 一条面包的价钱增长了4倍。

examples.text: In 1989 the price of coffee fell so low that in many countries it did not even cover the cost of production...
examples.translation: 1989年咖啡的价格跌至低谷，在很多国家甚至连生产成本都收不回来。

examples.text: Badges are also available at a cost of £2.50.
examples.translation: 徽章也有卖的，2.5英镑一枚。

examples.text: This course is limited to 12 people and costs £50...
examples.translation: 该课程只招收12人，学费为50英镑。

examples.text: Painted walls look much more interesting and doesn't cost much...
examples.translation: 彩绘墙壁看上去更有趣而且花费也不高。

examples.text: It's going to cost me over $100,000 to buy new trucks.
examples.translation: 买几辆新卡车将花掉我10万多美元。

examples.text: Costs have been cut by 30 to 50 per cent...
examples.translation: 成本降低了30%到50%。

examples.text: The company admits its costs are still too high.
examples.translation: 该公司承认其成本仍然过高。

examples.text: Everything that goes into making a programme, staff, rent, lighting, is now costed.
examples.translation: 制作节目的所有成本：人工、租用场地、灯光现在都已经估算了。

examples.text: ...seventy apartments, shops, offices, a restaurant and hotel, costed at around 10 million pounds.
examples.translation: 估价约为1,000万英镑的70套公寓、店铺、办公室、一家大饭店

examples.text: ...training days for charity staff on how to draw up contracts and cost out proposals...
examples.translation: 指导慈善机构员工如何起草合同和为提案估价的短期培训

examples.text: It is always worth having a loft conversion costed out.
examples.translation: 估算一下改建阁楼的费用总是很有必要的。

examples.text: He was jailed for 18 months and ordered to pay £550 costs.
examples.translation: 他被监禁了18个月，还责令他支付550英镑的诉讼费。

examples.text: ...a store that provided cigarettes and candy bars at cost.
examples.translation: 按成本价出售香烟和糖果的商店

examples.text: ...a practice known as dumping – that is, selling below cost to drive competition out of business.
examples.translation: 倾销行为——即通过以低于成本的价格销售产品来挤垮竞争对手

examples.text: In March Mr Salinas shut down the city's oil refinery at a cost of $500 million and 5,000 jobs.
examples.translation: 3月份，萨利纳斯先生关闭了该市的炼油场，造成5亿美元的损失，并使5,000人失去了工作。

examples.text: ...being so afraid of something that you feel you have to avoid it whatever the cost to your lifestyle.
examples.translation: 如此地害怕某事觉得必须避开它，无论自己的生活方式因此受到怎样的影响都在所不惜

examples.text: ...a six-year-old boy whose life was saved by an operation that cost him his sight...
examples.translation: 手术救了一名6岁男孩的命，却使他失明了

examples.text: The increase will hurt small business and cost many thousands of jobs.
examples.translation: 这种增长会使小企业受损并使成千上万的人失去工作。

examples.text: They told Jacques Delors a disastrous world trade war must be avoided at all costs.
examples.translation: 他们告诉雅克·德洛尔必须不惜任何代价避免一场毁灭性的世界贸易战。

examples.text: This book is of such importance that it must be published at any cost...
examples.translation: 这本书非常重要，无论如何也要出版。

examples.text: He ordered the army to recapture the camp at any cost.
examples.translation: 他命令军队无论如何也要夺回营地。

examples.text: Several countries in eastern Europe are counting the cost of yesterday's earthquake...
examples.translation: 东欧的几个国家正在计算昨天的地震带来的损失。

examples.text: Many people act on impulse without counting the cost.
examples.translation: 很多人不考虑后果就莽撞行事。

examples.text: Well-designed clothes cost money.
examples.translation: 设计精美的服装价格昂贵。

examples.text: Kathryn knows to her cost the effect of having served a jail sentence...
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳吃了苦头才知道服过刑会给一个人带来什么影响。

examples.text: There are very few people he can talk to in total confidence, as he has discovered to his cost.
examples.translation: 他吃了亏后才发现自己真正能够交心的人寥寥无几。

examples.text: Having professionally made curtains can be costly, so why not make your own?
examples.translation: 既然找专门人员做窗帘非常贵，为什么不自己做呢?

examples.text: Psychometric tests can save organizations from grim and costly mistakes...
examples.translation: 心理测试能够使组织机构避免犯下损失惨重的大错。

examples.text: This sort of scandal in international banking has been politically costly.
examples.translation: 国际银行业的这种丑闻一直以来都会造成极其恶劣的政治影响。

examples.text: Even from a distance the effect of his fox costume was stunning...
examples.translation: 即使从远处看,他的狐狸戏服也很抢眼。

examples.text: The performers, in costume and make-up, were walking up and down backstage...
examples.translation: 上了妆穿着戏服的演员在后台走来走去。

examples.text: In all, she has eight costume changes.
examples.translation: 她总共换了8次演出服。

examples.text: ...men and women in eighteenth-century costume...
examples.translation: 身穿18世纪服装的男男女女

examples.text: In the colourful markets at Chincero and Pisac, women still wear their traditional costume.
examples.translation: 在金测罗和皮萨克五颜六色的集市上，女人们还是身着传统装束。

examples.text: ...a lavish costume drama set in Ireland and the US in the 1890s.
examples.translation: 一部耗资巨大、以19世纪90年代的爱尔兰和美国为背景的古装戏

examples.text: Downstairs there's a breakfast room and guests can relax in the cosy bar.
examples.translation: 楼下有一个早餐间，宾客们可以在温馨的酒吧间休息一下。

examples.text: We took time to relax in the cosily decorated drawing room.
examples.translation: 我们在布置得温暖而又舒适的客厅里休息了一会儿。

examples.text: In the evening a log fire would provide cosiness.
examples.translation: 晚上点起篝火会让人感到温暖舒适。

examples.text: They like to make sure their guests are comfortable and cosy.
examples.translation: 他们希望确保客人们感到舒适温暖。

examples.text: He was settled cosily in the corner with an arm round Lynda.
examples.translation: 他被安置在一个温暖舒适的角落里，一只胳膊还搂着琳达。

examples.text: ...a cosy chat between friends...
examples.translation: 朋友间亲切的闲聊

examples.text: My mood this year is for a cosy, nice and thoroughly wholesome Christmas.
examples.translation: 我今年想过一个温馨、愉快并且绝对健康的圣诞节。

examples.text: ...chatting cosily with friends over coffee.
examples.translation: 边喝咖啡边和朋友惬意地闲聊

examples.text: ...the cosiness and solidity of family life.
examples.translation: 家庭生活的温馨与和睦

meanings.meaning: 小屋；村舍；（农舍式的）小别墅

examples.text: They used to have a cottage in N.W. Scotland...
examples.translation: 他们原来在苏格兰西北部有一间小屋。

examples.text: My sister Yvonne also came to live at Ockenden Cottage with me.
examples.translation: 姐姐伊冯娜也来到奥克肯登小屋和我一起住了。

examples.text: ...a cotton shirt.
examples.translation: 棉布衬衫

examples.text: ...a large cotton plantation in Tennessee.
examples.translation: 田纳西州大片的棉田

examples.text: There's a needle and cotton there.
examples.translation: 那儿有针和线。

examples.text: The new centre-right government's radical objectives are often couched in moderate terms...
examples.translation: 新的中右翼政府经常以温和的语言表述其激进的目标。

examples.text: This time the proposal was couched as an ultimatum.
examples.translation: 这一次该提议是以最后通牒的形式提出来的。

examples.text: Graham began to cough violently...
examples.translation: 格雷厄姆开始剧烈咳嗽。

examples.text: He coughed. 'Excuse me, Mrs Allsworthy, could I have a word?'
examples.translation: 他咳了一声说道，“奥尔斯沃西夫人，打断您一下，我能说句话吗？”

examples.text: Coughs and sneezes spread infections much faster in a warm atmosphere...
examples.translation: 在温暖的环境中，咳嗽和喷嚏传播疾病的速度要快得多。

examples.text: They were interrupted by an apologetic cough.
examples.translation: 他们被一声透着歉意的咳嗽打断了。

examples.text: He was then overcome by a terrible fit of coughing.
examples.translation: 接着他便控制不住地剧烈咳嗽了一阵。

examples.text: ...if you have a persistent cough for over a month.
examples.translation: 如果你持续咳嗽一个月以上

examples.text: I started coughing blood so they transferred me to a hospital.
examples.translation: 我开始咯血，于是他们把我转到了医院。

examples.text: On the chilly seas, Keats became feverish, continually coughing up blood.
examples.translation: 在寒冷彻骨的海上，基茨开始发烧，不断地咯血。

examples.text: Then suddenly, the engine coughed, spluttered and died.
examples.translation: 接着，发动机突然咔咔地响了几声，然后就熄火了。

examples.text: For my return journey, I felt I could afford the extra and travel first class...
examples.translation: 至于回程，我觉得我能多花点钱坐头等舱。

examples.text: I could see that something was terribly wrong...
examples.translation: 我能觉察到有什么事很不对头。

examples.text: He could not resist telling her the truth...
examples.translation: 他忍不住把实情告诉了她。

examples.text: When I left school at 16, I couldn't read or write...
examples.translation: 我16岁退学的时候既不识字也不会写字。

examples.text: There was no way she could have coped with a baby around.
examples.translation: 身边带着一个孩子，她不可能应付得过来。

examples.text: Though he had a temper and could be nasty, it never lasted...
examples.translation: 虽然他爱发脾气，而且有时还很讨厌，但向来都只是一阵儿。

examples.text: He could be very pleasant when he wanted to.
examples.translation: 他想要友好的时候会非常友好。

examples.text: He could have made a fortune as a lawyer...
examples.translation: 他本可以当律师挣大钱的。

examples.text: You could have been killed!...
examples.translation: 你差点儿就没命了！

examples.text: He did not regret saying what he did but felt that he could have expressed it differently.
examples.translation: 他并不后悔说了自己所做的事，但觉得本可以换一种方式表达。

examples.text: Doctors told him the disease could have been caused by years of working in smokey clubs...
examples.translation: 医生们告诉他这种疾病可能是由于多年在烟雾缭绕的俱乐部工作所致。

examples.text: An improvement in living standards could be years away...
examples.translation: 可能多年之后生活水平才能得到提高。

examples.text: He was jailed in February 1992 and could be released next year.
examples.translation: 他于1992年2月入狱，可能明年获释。

examples.text: They argued all the time and thought it couldn't be good for the baby...
examples.translation: 他们一直在争论，认为这对孩子肯定不好。

examples.text: Anne couldn't be expected to understand the situation...
examples.translation: 别指望安妮能弄明白当前情势。

examples.text: He couldn't have been more than fourteen years old.
examples.translation: 他不可能超过14岁。

examples.text: Their hope was that a new and better East Germany could be born...
examples.translation: 他们希望能够诞生一个崭新的、更加美好的东德。

examples.text: I knew that if I spoke to Myra, I could get her to call my father.
examples.translation: 我知道如果我同迈拉讲一声，就能让她给我父亲打电话。

examples.text: The charming characters she draws look like they could have walked out of the 1920s.
examples.translation: 她画的那些优雅迷人的人物就好像是从20世纪30年代走出来的一样。

examples.text: I could call the local doctor...
examples.translation: 我可以给当地医生打电话。

examples.text: We need money right? We could go around and ask if people need odd jobs done or something...
examples.translation: 咱们需要钱，对不对？咱们可以去周围打听一下看有没有人要找人做零工什么的。

examples.text: 'It's boring to walk all alone.' — 'Couldn't you go for walks with your friends?'...
examples.translation: “一个人走路很没意思。”——“你可以和朋友们一起去散步呀？”

examples.text: You could look for a career abroad where environmental jobs are better paid and more secure...
examples.translation: 你可以在国外找一份工作，那里与环境相关的工作报酬更高，也更稳定。

examples.text: It would be a good idea if you could do this exercise twice or three times on separate days.
examples.translation: 如果你能将此练习隔几天做上两三次就好了。

examples.text: Could I stay tonight?...
examples.translation: 我今晚可以留下吗？

examples.text: Could I speak to you in private a moment, John?...
examples.translation: 约翰，我可以单独跟你说一会儿话吗？

examples.text: I wonder if some time I could have a word with you...
examples.translation: 我在想可不可以找个时间跟你谈一谈？

examples.text: Sir, could you please come to the commanding officer's office?...
examples.translation: 长官，请您到指挥官的办公室来一下好吗？

examples.text: Could we go outside just for a second?...
examples.translation: 我们出去呆一小会儿行吗？

examples.text: He asked if he could have a cup of coffee...
examples.translation: 他问能否给他来杯咖啡。

examples.text: Couldn't I watch you do it?
examples.translation: 让我看着你做行吗？

examples.text: Well, if I could just interject...
examples.translation: 嗯，请允许我插一句。

examples.text: Could I stop you there?...
examples.translation: 我能打断您一下吗？

examples.text: Could I ask you if there have been any further problems?...
examples.translation: 我想请问您一下，是否还出了什么其他的问题？

examples.text: First of all, could I begin with an apology for a mistake I made last week?
examples.translation: 首先，请允许我为上周犯下的错误道歉。

examples.text: We've come to see you, so you could at least stand and greet us properly...
examples.translation: 我们都来看你了，你至少应该起身得体地打个招呼。

examples.text: Idiot! You could have told me!...
examples.translation: 蠢货！你本应该告诉我！

examples.text: He could have written...
examples.translation: 他本应该写信。

examples.text: Why couldn't she have said something?...
examples.translation: 为什么她什么都没说？

examples.text: But why couldn't he tell me straight out?
examples.translation: 可是他为什么不直截了当地告诉我？

examples.text: I could kill you! I swear I could!...
examples.translation: 我想杀了你！我发誓我真想杀了你！

examples.text: 'Welcome back' was all they said. I could have kissed them!...
examples.translation: 他们只是说，“欢迎回来。”我真想亲他们一下！

examples.text: She could have screamed with tension.
examples.translation: 她紧张得差点叫起来。

examples.text: If I could afford it I'd have four television sets...
examples.translation: 假如能买得起，我就会有4台电视机。

examples.text: If only I could get some sleep, I would be able to cope.
examples.translation: 要是能睡上一会儿，我就能应付了。

examples.text: The rest of the players are a great bunch of lads and I couldn't be happier...
examples.translation: 剩下的选手是一帮很棒的小伙子，我太高兴了。

examples.text: Darling Neville, I couldn't be more pleased for you...
examples.translation: 亲爱的内维尔，我真太为你高兴了。

examples.text: The news couldn't have come at a better time.
examples.translation: 那消息来得正是时候。

examples.text: How could you allow him to do something like that?...
examples.translation: 你怎么会允许他做那样的事？

examples.text: How could I have been so stupid?...
examples.translation: 我怎么会那么蠢？

examples.text: How could she do this to me?...
examples.translation: 她怎么能这样对我？

examples.text: How could you have lied to us all these years?
examples.translation: 你竟然骗了我们所有人这么多年！

examples.text: 'More cake?' — 'Oh no, I couldn't.'
examples.translation: “再来点蛋糕？”——“哦不，不用了。”

meanings.meaning: 委员会；会议；理事会；地方议会；顾问班子

examples.text: ...Cheshire County Council...
examples.translation: 柴郡政务委员会

examples.text: The city council has voted almost unanimously in favour.
examples.translation: 市政委员会几乎一致投票表示赞同。

examples.text: ...David Ward, one of just two Liberal Democrats on the council.
examples.translation: 戴维·沃德，市政委员会中仅有的两名自由民主党人之一

examples.text: ...reports of local council meetings.
examples.translation: 对当地政务委员会会议的报道

examples.text: There is a shortage of council housing...
examples.translation: 廉租公房房源不足。

examples.text: Council tenants around the country are planning a mass lobby of Parliament.
examples.translation: 全国各地的市政住房租户正在计划组建一个大的议会游说团。

examples.text: ...the National Council for Civil Liberties.
examples.translation: 全国公民自由委员会

examples.text: ...the Arts Council.
examples.translation: 艺术委员会

examples.text: ...community health councils.
examples.translation: 社区健康委员会

examples.text: The permanent council of the Organization of American States meets today here in Washington.
examples.translation: 美洲国家组织的常务委员们今天在华盛顿这里会面。

examples.text: ...the Bundesbank's central council.
examples.translation: 德意志联邦银行的中央委员会

examples.text: President Najibullah said he would call a grand council of all Afghans...
examples.translation: 纳吉布拉总统称他将召开阿富汗全民大会。

examples.text: The president also meets ministers at inter-ministerial councils held at the Elysée Palace.
examples.translation: 总统还在爱丽舍宫接见了参加部长级会议的各部长。

meanings.meaning: 法律顾问；忠告；商议；讨论；决策

examples.text: He had always been able to count on her wise counsel...
examples.translation: 他总能从她那里得到明智的建议。

examples.text: His parishioners sought his counsel and loved him.
examples.translation: 教区居民征询他的建议并且爱戴着他。

examples.text: My advisers counselled me to do nothing...
examples.translation: 顾问们建议我什么也不要做。

examples.text: The prime minister was right to counsel caution about military intervention.
examples.translation: 首相提出进行军事干预要慎重，这是很正确的。

examples.text: ...a psychologist who counsels people with eating disorders...
examples.translation: 为饮食失调症患者提供建议的心理学家

examples.text: Crawford counsels her on all aspects of her career.
examples.translation: 克劳福德为她的职业生涯提供全方位建议。

examples.text: Singleton's counsel said after the trial that he would appeal...
examples.translation: 审判结束后，辛格尔顿的律师表示他将会上诉。

examples.text: The defence counsel warned that the judge should stop the trial.
examples.translation: 被告辩护律师强烈建议法官应该休庭。

examples.text: Guscott rarely speaks out, preferring to keep his own counsel.
examples.translation: 古斯科特很少发表意见，他更喜欢把自己的看法埋在心里。
