examples.text: He kept a few dairy cows...
examples.translation: 他养了几头奶牛。

examples.text: Dad went out to milk the cows.
examples.translation: 爸爸出去挤牛奶。

examples.text: ...a herd of cows.
examples.translation: 一群奶牛

examples.text: ...a cow elephant.
examples.translation: 雌象

examples.text: The government, far from being cowed by these threats, has vowed to continue its policy.
examples.translation: 该政府丝毫没有被这些威胁吓住，发誓要继续执行其政策。

examples.text: ...cowing them into submission.
examples.translation: 胁迫他们顺从

examples.text: By this time she was so cowed by the beatings that she meekly obeyed.
examples.translation: 这时她已经被打怕了，只得言听计从。

examples.text: You can initiate policies until the cows come home, but unless they're monitored at a senior level, you won't get results.
examples.translation: 你可以花很长时间来制定政策，但除非高层对之进行监管，否则不会有效果。

examples.text: She accused her husband of being a coward.
examples.translation: 她指责丈夫胆小懦弱。

examples.text: Cover the casserole with a tight-fitting lid...
examples.translation: 用大小合适的盖子盖住砂锅。

examples.text: He whimpered and covered his face...
examples.translation: 他掩面抽泣。

examples.text: Keep what's left in a covered container in the fridge.
examples.translation: 把剩下的食物装入带盖的容器，放进冰箱。

examples.text: His finger went up to touch the black patch which covered his left eye...
examples.translation: 他伸手去触摸遮住左眼的黑眼罩。

examples.text: His head was covered with a khaki turban.
examples.translation: 他头上包着卡其布的穆斯林头巾。

examples.text: The clouds had spread and nearly covered the entire sky...
examples.translation: 云彩扩散开来，几乎遮住了整个天空。

examples.text: Two oil slicks are covering a total area of seven square miles...
examples.translation: 两层浮油漂浮在7平方英里的区域上。

examples.text: The desk was covered with papers...
examples.translation: 桌子上摆满了公文。

examples.text: I looked in the mirror and saw that my face was covered in blood.
examples.translation: 我照了照镜子，看见自己满脸是血。

examples.text: ...chocolate-covered biscuits.
examples.translation: 有巧克力外层的饼干

examples.text: The trees in your garden may have covered the ground with apples, pears or plums...
examples.translation: 你花园里的果树也许已经落了一地的苹果、梨或李子。

examples.text: She covered the walls with the signs of the zodiac.
examples.translation: 她在墙上贴满了十二星座的标志。

examples.text: It would not be easy to cover ten miles on that amount of petrol...
examples.translation: 就那么点儿汽油很难开10英里。

examples.text: It covered the distance in 28 hours compared with the train's six days.
examples.translation: 它走这一段要用28小时，与之相比火车要用6天。

examples.text: You go first. I'll cover you.
examples.translation: 你先撤，我掩护你。

examples.text: They said they could not provide adequate air cover for ground operations.
examples.translation: 他们声称无法为地面军事行动提供充分的空中掩护。

examples.text: Charles lit the fuses and they ran for cover.
examples.translation: 查尔斯点燃了导火索，他们便赶紧四处躲避。

examples.text: ...barren wastes of field with no trees and no cover.
examples.translation: 没有树木和其他遮蔽物的荒芜之地

examples.text: Their insurer paid the £900 bill, even though the policy did not strictly cover it...
examples.translation: 虽然严格来讲保险单并不包含这一项，他们的保险公司还是支付了那张900英镑的账单。

examples.text: These items are not covered by your medical insurance...
examples.translation: 这些项目不在你的医保范围之内。

examples.text: You should take out travel insurance covering you and your family against theft.
examples.translation: 你应该为自己和家人办理旅游保险以防偷盗。

examples.text: Make sure that the firm's insurance cover is adequate.
examples.translation: 确保该公司上了足够的保险。

examples.text: The law covers four categories of experiments...
examples.translation: 该法规适用于4类试验。

examples.text: Like any other commodity, pedigree dogs are covered by the Sale of Goods Act.
examples.translation: 像其他商品一样，纯种狗的买卖同样受《货物买卖法》的约束。

examples.text: The Oxford Chemistry Primers aim to cover important topics in organic chemistry...
examples.translation: 《牛津化学初级读本》丛书旨在论述有机化学中的重要问题。

examples.text: Other subjects covered included nerves and how to overcome them.
examples.translation: 所涉及的其他主题包括焦虑及如何克服。

examples.text: Robinson was sent to Italy to cover the 1990 World Cup...
examples.translation: 鲁宾逊被派到意大利报道1990年的世界杯比赛。

examples.text: The US news media will cover the trial closely.
examples.translation: 美国新闻媒体将对该审判进行追踪报道。

examples.text: Send it to the address given with £1.50 to cover postage and administration...
examples.translation: 将它寄到指定地址，并附上1.50英镑以支付邮资和管理费。

examples.text: Those figures might not even cover the cost of breakages.
examples.translation: 那笔钱甚至都不够赔偿破损费。

examples.text: ...a family room with washable covers on the furniture.
examples.translation: 家具上套有可清洗外罩的家庭娱乐室

examples.text: ...a duvet cover.
examples.translation: 羽绒被罩

examples.text: She set her glass down and slid farther under the covers.
examples.translation: 她放下杯子，钻进被子里。

examples.text: A few years ago, David Byrne was on the cover of Time magazine.
examples.translation: 几年前，大卫·拜恩曾登上《时代》周刊的封面。

examples.text: ...a small spiral-bound booklet with a green cover...
examples.translation: 有绿色封皮的螺旋装订的活页小册子

examples.text: I used to read every issue from cover to cover.
examples.translation: 以前我每一期都会从头读到尾。

examples.text: They set up a spurious temple that was a cover for sexual debauchery...
examples.translation: 他们建立起一座为淫秽活动作掩护的假寺庙。

examples.text: As a cover story he generally tells people he is a freelance photographer.
examples.translation: 为掩饰身份，他一般对外称自己是一名自由摄影师。

examples.text: Why would she cover for someone who was trying to kill her?
examples.translation: 她为什么要包庇想要杀她的人呢？

examples.text: She did not have enough nurses to cover for those who went ill or took holiday.
examples.translation: 她没有足够的护士来顶替那些生病或休假的人工作。

examples.text: He must make a decent living from other artists covering his songs.
examples.translation: 其他艺术家翻唱他的歌曲，一定使他过上了收入颇为可观的生活。

examples.text: The single is a cover of an old Rolling Stones song.
examples.translation: 这支单曲是滚石乐队的一首老歌的翻唱。

examples.text: Asking those kind of questions could blow my cover...
examples.translation: 问那种问题会暴露我的身份。

examples.text: The young man looked embarrassed, as if he were a spy whose cover had been blown.
examples.translation: 那个年轻人看起来局促不安，就好像他是一个身份暴露的间谍一样。

examples.text: They began running again, broke cover and dashed towards the road.
examples.translation: 他们又开始跑，离开隐蔽处朝公路冲去。

examples.text: Shoppers took cover behind cars as police marksmen returned fire.
examples.translation: 警方的射击手开火回击时，购物者们躲在汽车后面。

examples.text: 'Get under cover!' shouted Billy, and we darted once more for the tables.
examples.translation: “躲起来！”比利喊道，我们便又一次冲向桌子。

examples.text: They move under cover of darkness.
examples.translation: 他们在黑暗的掩护下行进。

examples.text: The canny Premier covered his back by pointing out that he was of Scottish stock.
examples.translation: 精明狡猾的首相辩解说自己是苏格兰血统。

examples.text: Just play it safe, cover your ass, keep your head down.
examples.translation: 要谨慎行事，保护好自己并保持低调。

meanings.meaning: 螃蟹；蟹肉；脾气乖戾的人；起重机

examples.text: Pope has returned from his trip with a massive load of oysters, shrimp and crab.
With great difficulty, the fisherman manoeuvred his small craft close to the reef...
examples.translation: 渔夫费了很大的劲才把他的小船划到暗礁旁。

examples.text: The troops are reported to have advanced nearly four miles since they were landed from naval craft on Sunday evening.
examples.translation: 据报道，部队自周日晚离开海军军舰登陆后已经挺进了将近4英里。

examples.text: ...the arts and crafts of the North American Indians...
examples.translation: 北美印第安人的手工艺

examples.text: All kinds of traditional craft industries are preserved here.
examples.translation: 这里保留着各种各样的传统手工业。

examples.text: ...the craft of writing...
examples.translation: 写作技巧

examples.text: Maurice Murphy, one of the country's leading classical trumpeters, learnt his craft with the Black Dyke Mills band.
examples.translation: 作为该国最著名的古典小号演奏家，莫里斯·墨菲曾师从黑堤磨坊铜管乐团。

examples.text: The windows would probably have been crafted in the latter part of the Middle Ages...
examples.translation: 这些窗户很可能是中世纪后期精心制作的。

examples.text: Many delegates were willing to craft a compromise...
examples.translation: 很多代表都想要制订出一个周密的折中方案。

examples.text: The author extracts the maximum from every carefully-crafted scene in this witty tale.
examples.translation: 作者从这个妙趣横生的故事的每一个精心构思的情节中都摘录了尽可能多的内容。

examples.text: ...original, hand-crafted bags at affordable prices.
examples.translation: 买得起的新颖的手工艺包

meanings.meaning: 用起重机起吊；伸长脖子
(Crane)人名；(意、葡)克拉内；(英、法、西)克兰

examples.text: The little prefabricated hut was lifted away by a huge crane.
examples.translation: 那间用预制板搭建的小棚屋被一辆大型起重机吊走了。

examples.text: She craned her neck to get a better view...
examples.translation: 她伸长脖子想看得更清楚些。

examples.text: Children craned to get close to him...
examples.translation: 孩子们探着身子想靠近他。

examples.text: She craned forward to look at me.
examples.translation: 她向前探出身子看着我。

meanings.meaning: 摇篮；发源地；发祥地；支船架
抚育；把...搁在支架上；把...放在摇篮内

examples.text: I dropped the receiver back in the cradle.
examples.translation: 我把听筒放回听筒架上。

examples.text: He fixed the towing cradle round the hull.
examples.translation: 他把牵引支架固定在船体上。

examples.text: Mali is the cradle of some of Africa's richest civilizations.
examples.translation: 马里是非洲一些最悠久的文明的发祥地。

examples.text: ...New York, the cradle of capitalism.
examples.translation: 纽约，资本主义的发源地

examples.text: I cradled her in my arms...
examples.translation: 我把她轻轻地抱在怀里。

examples.text: He was sitting at the big table cradling a large bowl of milky coffee.
examples.translation: 他坐在一张大桌子旁，手里捧着一大碗加了牛奶的咖啡。

examples.text: The bond of brotherhood was one to last from the cradle to the grave.
examples.translation: 兄弟之情会延续一辈子。

meanings.meaning: 撞碎；坠毁；破产；轰隆声；睡觉
摔碎；坠落；发出隆隆声；(金融企业等)破产
打碎；使坠毁、撞坏；擅自闯入

examples.text: His elder son was killed in a car crash a few years ago.
examples.translation: 他的长子几年前死于车祸。

examples.text: ...a plane crash.
examples.translation: 坠机事件

examples.text: The plane crashed mysteriously near the island of Ustica.
examples.translation: 那架飞机在乌斯蒂卡岛附近神秘坠毁了。

examples.text: ...when his car crashed into the rear of a van...
examples.translation: 他的车撞进一辆货车尾部的时候

examples.text: Even his death, after crashing his motorcycle on a bridge in New Orleans, was spectacular...
examples.translation: 甚至他骑摩托车在新奥尔良撞桥身亡的事也轰动一时。

examples.text: Her body was found near a crashed car.
examples.translation: 在一辆撞毁的汽车旁发现了她的尸体。

examples.text: The door swung inwards to crash against a chest of drawers behind it...
examples.translation: 门朝里摆去，撞到了后面的大衣柜。

examples.text: My words were lost as the walls above us crashed down, filling the cellar with brick dust...
examples.translation: 我们头顶的墙塌了下来，地下室里满是砖灰，我惊得说不出话来。

examples.text: I heard them coming, crashing through the undergrowth, before I saw them.
examples.translation: 还没看到他们，我便听到他们穿过矮树丛过来的声音。

examples.text: Two people in the flat recalled hearing a loud crash about 1.30 a.m.
examples.translation: 公寓楼里有两个人回想起凌晨1点半听见了一声巨响。

examples.text: When the market crashed, they assumed the deal would be cancelled.
examples.translation: 当市场崩溃时，他们认为交易会被取消。

examples.text: He predicted correctly that there was going to be a stock market crash.
examples.translation: 他准确地预测到股市即将崩盘。

examples.text: ...after the computer crashed for the second time in 10 days.
examples.translation: 电脑在10天内第二次死机后

examples.text: Don't worry if your baby seems a little reluctant to crawl or walk...
examples.translation: 如果你的宝宝不爱爬也不爱走，不要担心。

examples.text: I began to crawl on my hands and knees towards the door...
examples.translation: 我开始手脚并用朝门口爬去。

examples.text: As he tried to crawl away, he was hit in the shoulder.
examples.translation: 他试图爬走时肩膀中枪了。

examples.text: I watched the moth crawl up the outside of the lampshade.
examples.translation: 我看着飞蛾爬到灯罩外面。

examples.text: I crawled out of bed at nine-thirty...
examples.translation: 我9点半才勉强从床上爬起来。

examples.text: They had not foreseen the higher inflation in France when most of Western Europe was crawling out of recession...
examples.translation: 当西欧的大多数国家正从经济衰退中缓慢复苏时，他们并没有预见到法国的通货膨胀率会升高。

examples.text: Hairpin turns force the car to crawl at 10 miles an hour in some places.
examples.translation: 在一些地段，U形弯路使得汽车只能以每小时10英里的速度缓慢行进。

examples.text: The traffic on the approach road slowed to a crawl.
examples.translation: 引路上车辆行驶缓慢。

examples.text: This place is crawling with police.
examples.translation: 这个地方全是警察。

examples.text: ...rock-hard earth littered with rubbish and crawling with vermin.
examples.translation: 丢满垃圾、爬满虫子的坚硬土地

examples.text: I hated this man, his very touch made my skin crawl.
examples.translation: 我讨厌这个男人，他碰我一下我都觉得恶心。

examples.text: People thought they were all crazy to try to make money from manufacturing...
examples.translation: 人们认为他们简直是疯了，竟然想从制造业中赚钱。

examples.text: That's why he's got so caught up with this crazy idea about Mr. Trancas.
examples.translation: 那就是为什么他对特兰卡斯先生一直有如此疯狂的想法。

examples.text: ...that crazy, mixed-up world out there.
examples.translation: 外边那个疯狂而又混乱的世界

examples.text: The teenagers shook their long, black hair and gesticulated crazily...
examples.translation: 那些小青年甩着黑色的长发，做着各种奇怪的手势。

examples.text: Our policies are crazily extravagant and very destructive.
examples.translation: 我们的政策极度浪费并且破坏性极大。

examples.text: We had to have a sense of humour because of the craziness of it all.
examples.translation: 它的种种疯狂让我们不得不表现出幽默感。

examples.text: If I sat home and worried about all this stuff, I'd go crazy...
examples.translation: 如果整天坐在家里为这些事情担心，我会疯掉的。

examples.text: He strides around the room beaming like a crazy man.
examples.translation: 他绕着房间大步地走着，像个疯子一样笑着。

examples.text: Outside, mumbling, was one of New York's ever-present crazies.
examples.translation: 外面一个疯子在不停地咕哝着，在纽约这样的疯子很常见。

examples.text: He's still crazy about both his work and his hobbies...
examples.translation: 他对工作和个人爱好依然保持狂热。

examples.text: I'm also not crazy about the initial terms of the deal.
examples.translation: 我对该协议的最初条款也不太满意。

examples.text: Every football-crazy schoolboy in Europe dreams of one day being involved in the championships.
examples.translation: 在欧洲，每一个酷爱足球的男学生都梦想有朝一日能够参加锦标赛。

examples.text: None of that matters, because we're crazy about each other.
examples.translation: 那些都不重要，因为我们深深地爱着对方。

examples.text: This sitting around is driving me crazy...
examples.translation: 老这样坐着无所事事快让我发疯了。

examples.text: When Jock woke up and found you gone he went crazy.
examples.translation: 乔克醒来发现你走了，他简直气疯了。

examples.text: The stuff was selling like crazy...
examples.translation: 这东西卖疯了。

examples.text: Some people can diet like crazy and not lose weight.
examples.translation: 有些人拼命节食也不能减肥。

meanings.meaning: 奶油，乳脂；精华；面霜；乳酪

examples.text: ...strawberries and cream.
examples.translation: 奶油草莓

examples.text: ...cream of mushroom soup.
examples.translation: 奶油蘑菇汤

examples.text: Gently apply the cream to the affected areas.
examples.translation: 把药膏轻轻涂抹在患处。

examples.text: ...sun protection creams.
examples.translation: 防晒霜

examples.text: ...cream silk stockings.
examples.translation: 米色丝袜

examples.text: ...a cream-coloured Persian cat.
examples.translation: 米色的波斯猫

examples.text: The Ball was attended by the cream of Hollywood society.
examples.translation: 好莱坞的大牌影星们出席了那个舞会。

examples.text: ...the cream of Chicago's 200 jazz and blues clubs.
examples.translation: 芝加哥200家爵士乐和蓝调乐俱乐部中最优秀的成员

examples.text: A gas main had cracked under my neighbour's garage and gas had seeped into our homes...
examples.translation: 邻居车库下面的煤气总管裂开了，煤气渗入了我们家。

examples.text: Remove the dish from the oven, crack the salt crust and you will find the skin just peels off the fish.
examples.translation: 把盘子从烤箱里拿出来，弄碎鱼表面的那层盐，鱼皮就会从鱼身上剥落下来了。

examples.text: Thunder cracked in the sky...
examples.translation: 空中雷声咔嚓作响。

examples.text: He cracked his fingers nervously.
examples.translation: 他紧张不安地把手指按得咔吧作响。

examples.text: He cracked his head on the pavement and was knocked cold.
examples.translation: 他一头撞到人行道上，不省人事了。

examples.text: Crack the eggs into a bowl.
examples.translation: 把鸡蛋打在一个碗中。

examples.text: He has finally cracked the system after years of painstaking research.
examples.translation: 经过多年的努力研究，他终于找到了破解这个系统的办法。

examples.text: She's calm and strong, and she is just not going to crack...
examples.translation: 她镇定而且坚强，绝不会垮掉。

examples.text: I had the conviction Larkin's nerve would crack and he'd squeeze the trigger in a reflex action...
examples.translation: 我确信拉金会神经崩溃，他会反射性地扣动扳机。

examples.text: Some countries are showing signs of cracking under intense pressure from the United States.
examples.translation: 有些国家在美国的强大压力下有崩盘的迹象。

examples.text: Her voice cracked and she began to cry.
examples.translation: 她的声音变得沙哑，继而哭了起来。

examples.text: He cracked jokes and talked about beer and girls.
examples.translation: 他爱说笑话，喜欢谈论啤酒和姑娘。

examples.text: Package holidays are not always all they're cracked up to be.
examples.translation: 全包旅游并不总像人们说的那么好。

examples.text: You've just got to crack on, whatever the problems are.
examples.translation: 不管有什么问题，你都得抓紧时间努力干。

examples.text: Just tell him what to do and he'll crack on with the work.
examples.translation: 告诉他该干什么就行了，他会抓紧时间尽快干完的。

examples.text: Kathryn had seen him through a crack in the curtains.
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳透过窗帘缝看见了他。

examples.text: He went to the door, opened it a crack, and listened.
examples.translation: 他朝门走去，打开一条门缝听着。

examples.text: The plate had a crack in it...
examples.translation: 盘子上有一道裂纹。

examples.text: Hundreds of office buildings and homes developed large cracks in walls and ceilings.
examples.translation: 数百栋写字楼和住宅楼的墙壁和天花板上都出现了裂缝。

examples.text: Suddenly there was a loud crack and glass flew into the car...
examples.translation: 突然发出一声巨大的爆裂声，玻璃碎片飞进了车里。

examples.text: 'Crack!' — The first shot rang out, hitting Paolo.
examples.translation: “砰！”第一声枪响了，打中了保罗。

examples.text: I should love to have a crack at the Olympia title in my last year...
examples.translation: 我非常愿意在我职业生涯的最后一年向奥林匹亚大赛冠军头衔发起冲击。

examples.text: She decided to head for the dormitory to take another crack at locating Blanche.
examples.translation: 她决定回宿舍再找找布兰奇。

examples.text: When Paul made the crack about the 'famous girl detective', I began to suspect that he had it in for you.
examples.translation: 当保罗挖苦你是“著名的女侦探”时，我开始怀疑他是不是故意刁难你。

examples.text: ...a crack undercover police officer...
examples.translation: 训练有素的便衣警察

examples.text: He is said to be a crack shot, despite weak vision in one eye.
examples.translation: 尽管一只眼视力较弱，他仍被称为神枪手。

examples.text: I often start work at the crack of dawn when there is a big order to get out.
examples.translation: 有大笔订单要处理时，我经常会清晨便开始工作。

examples.text: The meeting was stormy, and the two sides managed only to paper over the cracks on some issues.
examples.translation: 会议很激烈，但双方只是在试图掩盖某些问题上的错误。

examples.text: None of them is expecting any favours, just a fair crack of the whip.
examples.translation: 他们谁也不期望受到任何特殊照顾，只希望机会均等。

examples.text: We set business free to create more jobs in Britain...
examples.translation: 我们放开对企业的限制以便在英国创造更多的就业机会。

examples.text: She could create a fight out of anything...
examples.translation: 她能无故挑起事端。

examples.text: The lights create such a glare it's next to impossible to see anything behind them...
examples.translation: 那些灯发出的光太强了，几乎看不清灯后面的任何东西。

examples.text: Criticizing will only destroy a relationship and create feelings of failure.
examples.translation: 批评责备只能破坏关系，让人产生失败感。

examples.text: These businesses stimulate the creation of local jobs...
examples.translation: 这些企业有助于为当地创造更多就业机会。

examples.text: The creation of large parks and forests is of lower priority than some twenty years ago.
examples.translation: 现在，建造大型林园没有20来年前那么受人重视了。

examples.text: It is really great for a radio producer to create a show like this...
examples.translation: 电台监制能够制作出这样的节目真是不简单。

examples.text: He's creating a whole new language of painting.
examples.translation: 他正在创造一种全新的绘画语言。

examples.text: Like so many creative people he was never satisfied.
examples.translation: 像许多富于创造力的人一样，他从不满足。

examples.text: ...her obvious creative talents.
examples.translation: 她显而易见的创作才能

examples.text: American art reached a peak of creativity in the '50s and 60s.
examples.translation: 美国艺术在五六十年代达到了一次创作顶峰。

examples.text: ...creative writing...
examples.translation: 创造性写作

examples.text: ...creative arts...
examples.translation: 创作型艺术

examples.text: Cooking is creative.
examples.translation: 烹饪富有创造性。

examples.text: ...his creative use of words.
examples.translation: 他对词语的创造性运用

examples.text: Genet teaches you to think creatively.
examples.translation: 吉尼特教你创造性地思考问题。

examples.text: Along with scores of other advertising creatives, he will be taking part in an exhibition at the Saatchi gallery.
examples.translation: 他将和许多广告创意人员一起参加在萨奇画廊举行的画展。

examples.text: Alaskan Eskimos believe that every living creature possesses a spirit...
examples.translation: 阿拉斯加的爱斯基摩人认为每一个活着的生物都有灵魂。

examples.text: The garden is surrounded by a hedge in which many small creatures can live...
examples.translation: 花园四周是树篱，许多小动物可以在那里栖身。

examples.text: They have been visited by creatures from outer space.
examples.translation: 有外星人拜访了他们。

examples.text: She's charming, a sweet creature...
examples.translation: 她很迷人，是个可人儿。

examples.text: I am not a vain creature...
examples.translation: 我不是个爱慕虚荣的人。

examples.text: She was a creature of the emotions, rather than reason.
examples.translation: 她是个感性的人，不太理性。

examples.text: We are not creatures of the Conservative government.
examples.translation: 我们不是保守派政府的傀儡。

examples.text: One man who was selling a ticket had an Olympic credential hanging around his neck.

meanings.meaning: 爬行；蔓延；慢慢地移动；起鸡皮疙瘩
爬行；毛骨悚然的感觉；谄媚者

examples.text: Back I go to the hotel and creep up to my room...
examples.translation: 我回到旅馆，蹑手蹑脚地上楼回到房间。

examples.text: The rabbit creeps away and hides in a hole.
examples.translation: 兔子悄悄溜走，藏进洞里。

examples.text: Mist had crept in again from the sea.
examples.translation: 薄雾又从海面上弥漫过来了。

examples.text: Insecurity might creep in...
examples.translation: 可能会不知不觉地产生不安全感。

examples.text: An increasing ratio of mistakes, perhaps induced by tiredness, crept into her game.
examples.translation: 可能是由于体力不支，她在比赛中的失误越来越多。

examples.text: ...a proposal that crept through unnoticed at the National Council in December...
examples.translation: 一项于12月份在全国委员会不声不响获得通过的提议

examples.text: Now his other major works are creeping back into concert programmes...
examples.translation: 现在他的其他主要作品又悄然出现在音乐会节目单上。

examples.text: Their organisation has been subjected to creeping privatisation since 1981.
examples.translation: 自1981年以来他们的组织已经被逐渐私有化了。

examples.text: The inflation rate has been creeping up to 9.5 per cent...
examples.translation: 通货膨胀率已攀升至9.5%。

examples.text: The average number of students in each class is creeping up from three to four.
examples.translation: 每个班的平均学生人数已经从3人增长到了4人。

examples.text: I always hated that statue. It gave me the creeps.
examples.translation: 我一直都很讨厌那座雕像。它让我心里发毛。

meanings.meaning: 队，组；全体人员，全体船员

examples.text: The mission for the crew of the space shuttle Endeavour is essentially over...
examples.translation: “奋进号”航天飞机上全体机组人员的任务基本上已经完成了。

examples.text: Despite their size, these vessels carry small crews, usually of around twenty men...
examples.translation: 这些船虽然体积庞大，但能够承载的船员却很少，通常为20人左右。

examples.text: The surviving crew members were ferried ashore.
examples.translation: 幸存下来的船员被运上了岸。

examples.text: ...a two-man film crew making a documentary...
examples.translation: 由两人组成的纪录片摄制组

examples.text: A paramedic ambulance crew went to the accident scene but were unable to save Mrs Wilson.
examples.translation: 一组急救护理人员赶到事故现场，但没能救活威尔逊太太。

examples.text: She was already a keen and experienced sailor, having crewed in both Merlin and Grayling...
examples.translation: 在“默林”号和“格雷林”号上工作过以后，她已经是一名头脑敏捷、经验丰富的水手了。

examples.text: There were to be five teams of three crewing the boat.
examples.translation: 该船上将有5组工作人员，每组3人。

examples.text: ...a fully crewed yacht.
examples.translation: 人员配备齐全的快艇

examples.text: ...the motley crew of failed and aspiring actors who comprised the 'distinguished guests'...
examples.translation: “贵宾”由一群形形色色的演员组成，有的郁郁不得志，有的胸怀抱负

examples.text: This crew of killers and life-wreckers are headed by the mad but cunning Nino Brown.
examples.translation: 这个残害生命的杀人团伙以疯狂而狡猾的尼诺·布朗为首。

meanings.meaning: 信用，信誉；[金融] 贷款；学分；信任；声望
相信，信任；把…归给，归功于；赞颂

examples.text: The group can't get credit to buy farming machinery...
examples.translation: 这些人无法赊购到农用机械。

examples.text: You can ask a dealer for a discount whether you pay cash or buy on credit.
examples.translation: 无论是付现还是赊购，都可以要求经销商打折。

examples.text: The idea that I could be charged when I'm in credit makes me very angry...
examples.translation: 想到账户里有余额时还要收费，我就非常气愤。

examples.text: I made sure the account stayed in credit...
examples.translation: 我确保账户里有余额。

examples.text: Interest is payable on credit balances.
examples.translation: 利息按照贷方余额支付。

examples.text: She noticed that only $80,000 had been credited to her account...
examples.translation: 她注意到自己的账户里只存进了80,000美元。

examples.text: Midland decided to change the way it credited payments to accounts...
examples.translation: 米兰银行决定改变付款贷记的方式。

examples.text: Interest is calculated daily and credited once a year, on 1 April.
examples.translation: 利息按天计算，每年4月1日一次性打入账户。

examples.text: The statement of total debits and credits is known as a balance.
examples.translation: 总借记和总贷记的结算即账户余额。

examples.text: Senator Bill Bradley outlined his own tax cut, giving families $350 in tax credits per child...
examples.translation: 比尔·布拉德利参议员概述了自己的减税计划，提出每个孩子可为家庭减免350美元的课税。

examples.text: Japan has provided about $2.5 billion in credits to Russia and about $50 million in direct aid.
examples.translation: 日本向俄罗斯提供了约25亿美元的借款和价值约5,000万美元的直接援助。

examples.text: We don't mind who gets the credit so long as we don't get the blame...
examples.translation: 谁受到表扬无所谓，只要我们不挨批就好。

examples.text: It would be wrong for us to take all the credit...
examples.translation: 如果我们把所有功劳都揽到自己身上，那就不对了。

examples.text: Some of the credit for her relaxed manner must go to Andy.
examples.translation: 她会如此放松，一部分应该归功于安迪。

examples.text: The staff are crediting him with having saved Hythe's life...
examples.translation: 职员们称赞他救了海丝的命。

examples.text: The 74-year-old mayor is credited with helping make Los Angeles the financial capital of the West Coast...
examples.translation: 洛杉矶成为西海岸的金融中心，那位74岁的市长功不可没。

examples.text: The screenplay for 'Gabriel Over the White House' is credited to Carey Wilson.
examples.translation: 电影《天使降临白宫》的剧本出自凯里·威尔逊之手。

examples.text: I wonder why you can't credit him with the same generosity of spirit...
examples.translation: 我想知道你为什么不认为他具有同样崇高的思想境界。

examples.text: They are crediting science with power it doesn't possess.
examples.translation: 他们过分夸大了科学的力量。

examples.text: He is one of the greatest British players of recent times and is a credit to his profession.
examples.translation: 他是近代英国最伟大的运动员之一，是这一体育运动的骄傲。

examples.text: Roosevelt either did not learn of the scandal or refused to credit what he heard...
examples.translation: 罗斯福要么是不知道那桩丑闻，要么是不相信他所听到的。

examples.text: It seems hard to credit that such things went on among senior Directors.
examples.translation: 高级主管中竟发生了这样的事，真是令人难以置信。

examples.text: The star Marlon Brando wants his name removed from the credits.
examples.translation: 影星马龙·白兰度要求把他的名字从演职员表中删掉。

examples.text: ...a moviegoer who remains in his seat until the credits are over.
examples.translation: 直到演职员表播完才离座的影迷

examples.text: You're a nice girl, Lettie, and your kind heart does you credit.
examples.translation: 你是个好女孩儿，莱蒂，你的善良值得称赞。

examples.text: His gift was an extremely kind gesture. Credit where credit's due.
examples.translation: 他的礼物是很友好的表示，这值得称赞。

examples.text: Bratbakk had more ability than the media gave him credit for.
examples.translation: 布拉特巴克比媒体称赞的要有才华。

examples.text: On the credit side, he's always been wonderful with his mother.
examples.translation: 就优点而言，他对母亲一直很孝顺。

examples.text: She had managed to pull herself together and, to her credit, continued to look upon life as a positive experience...
examples.translation: 她已经努力振作起来，而且值得称赞的是，她仍然积极乐观地看待生活。

examples.text: Although the offences were horrific it was to her credit that she had owned up.
examples.translation: 她的犯罪手段很残忍，但她的供认不讳还是可以认可的。

examples.text: I have twenty novels and countless magazine stories to my credit.
examples.translation: 我著有20部小说，还在杂志上发表了无数篇文章。

examples.text: During the summer term we would play cricket at the village ground.
examples.translation: 在夏季学期，我们会在村里的空地上打板球。

examples.text: ...the Yorkshire County Cricket Club.
examples.translation: 约克郡板球俱乐部

examples.text: Their treatment of staff is definitely not cricket.
examples.translation: 他们对待员工的方式绝对不公正。

meanings.meaning: 罪行，犯罪；罪恶；犯罪活动

examples.text: He and Lieutenant Cassidy were checking the scene of the crime...
examples.translation: 他和卡西迪中尉正在勘查犯罪现场。

examples.text: Mr Steele has committed no crime and poses no danger to the public...
examples.translation: 斯蒂尔先生没有犯罪，并未对公众构成危害。

examples.text: Endangering their lives will be regarded as a crime against humanity.
examples.translation: 危害他们的生命将被视为犯下了反人类罪。

examples.text: ...the growing problem of organised crime...
examples.translation: 有组织犯罪的问题越来越严重

examples.text: We need a positive programme of crime prevention.
examples.translation: 我们需要制订一个能有效预防犯罪的方案。

examples.text: A language is a finely tuned instrument which it is a crime to damage...
examples.translation: 语言是一种精心调试的乐器，破坏它就是一种罪过。

examples.text: It would be a crime to travel all the way to Australia and not stop in Sydney.
examples.translation: 如果千里迢迢去澳大利亚却不在悉尼停留，那将是一大失误。

examples.text: A group of gunmen attacked a prison and set free nine criminals in Moroto.
examples.translation: 一伙持枪歹徒袭击了莫罗托的一所监狱，放走了9名罪犯。

examples.text: Her husband faces various criminal charges...
examples.translation: 她丈夫面临多项犯罪指控。

examples.text: At 17, he had a criminal record for petty theft...
examples.translation: 他17岁就有了小偷小摸的犯罪前科。

examples.text: Doug was found guilty of criminal assault and sentenced to six months in jail.
examples.translation: 道格被判犯有人身攻击罪，监禁6个月。

examples.text: Between 1960 and 1985 we had a tenfold increase of criminality.
examples.translation: 从1960年到1985年，犯罪数量增长了10倍。

examples.text: ...a hospital for the criminally insane.
examples.translation: 收容精神不正常的罪犯的医院

examples.text: He said a full-scale dispute involving strikes would be criminal.
examples.translation: 他说如果出现罢工等大规模纠纷那将是极不应该的。

examples.text: It was, he said, criminally irresponsible for any party to say it would never raise personal taxation.
examples.translation: 他说，如果任何政党声称永远不会提高个人赋税，那都是错误而且不负责任的说法。

examples.text: She has gone from being a healthy, fit, and sporty young woman to being a cripple.
examples.translation: 她从一个健康、强壮、爱好运动的年轻女性变成了一个跛子。

examples.text: Mr Easton was seriously crippled in an accident and had to leave his job...
examples.translation: 伊斯顿先生在一次事故中重度伤残，不得不离职。

examples.text: He had been warned that another bad fall could cripple him for life...
examples.translation: 医生警告他，如果再次严重摔伤他可能会终身残疾。

examples.text: He heaved his crippled leg into an easier position.
examples.translation: 他把自己的一条瘸腿抬到一个更加舒服的位置。

examples.text: Howard wanted to be a popular singer, but stage fright crippled him...
examples.translation: 霍华德想成为流行歌手，但因怯场而心生畏惧。

examples.text: I'm not perfect but I'm also not emotionally crippled or lonely.
examples.translation: 我并不完美，但我也没有什么心结，也不孤独。

examples.text: Let's try to cripple their communications...
examples.translation: 我们试着破坏他们的通讯设备吧。

examples.text: A total cut-off of supplies would cripple the country's economy...
examples.translation: 全面切断物品供应会使该国经济陷入瘫痪。

examples.text: The pilot was able to maneuver the crippled aircraft out of the hostile area.
examples.translation: 飞行员成功地驾驶严重损坏的飞机驶出敌区。

meanings.meaning: 危机；危险期；决定性时刻
危机的；用于处理危机的

examples.text: Natural disasters have obviously contributed to the continent's economic crisis...
examples.translation: 很显然，自然灾害也是造成该大陆经济危机的原因之一。

examples.text: The Italian political system has been judged to be in terminal crisis for decades.
examples.translation: 人们认为意大利的政治体系几十年来一直存在着严重危机。

examples.text: ...children's illnesses or other family crises...
examples.translation: 孩子生病或其他家庭危机

examples.text: He's having a mid-life crisis.
examples.translation: 他正经历中年危机。

examples.text: ...someone to turn to in moments of crisis.
examples.translation: 危急时刻可以求助的人

examples.text: Bake the potatoes for 15 minutes, till they're nice and crisp.
examples.translation: 将土豆片烤15分钟，直至酥脆。

examples.text: ...crisp bacon.
examples.translation: 脆熏肉

examples.text: ...crisp lettuce.
examples.translation: 清脆的生菜

examples.text: The pizza base retains its crispness without becoming brittle.
examples.translation: 比萨饼的饼底依然酥脆，也没有变得易碎。

examples.text: ...crisply fried onion rings.
examples.translation: 炸得酥脆的洋葱圈

examples.text: Cook the bacon until it begins to crisp...
examples.translation: 把熏肉烹至酥脆。

examples.text: Spread breadcrumbs on a dry baking sheet and crisp them in the oven.
examples.translation: 把面包屑撒在干燥的烤盘上，然后放在烤箱里烤脆。

examples.text: ...a packet of crisps.
examples.translation: 一袋炸薯片

examples.text: ...cheese and onion potato crisps.
examples.translation: 奶酪和洋葱味炸薯片

examples.text: ...a crisp autumn day.
examples.translation: 秋高气爽的一天

examples.text: He wore a panama hat and a crisp white suit...
examples.translation: 他戴着一顶巴拿马草帽，穿着一身挺括的白西装。

examples.text: I slipped between the crisp clean sheets.
examples.translation: 我钻到崭新洁净的被单底下。

examples.text: ...crisp banknotes.
examples.translation: 崭新挺括的钞票

examples.text: ...his crisply pressed suit.
examples.translation: 他那熨得笔挺的西装

examples.text: ...crisp autumn leaves...
examples.translation: 踩上去发出脆响的秋叶

examples.text: He crunched through the crisp snow.
examples.translation: 他咯吱咯吱地踏雪行进着。

examples.text: 'Very well,' I said, adopting a crisp authoritative tone.
examples.translation: “很好，”我用干脆的命令性的语气说道。

examples.text: 'I'm not a journalist,' said Mary Ann crisply.
examples.translation: “我不是记者，”玛丽·安干脆地说道。

meanings.meaning: （批评判断的）标准；准则；规范；准据

examples.text: The most important criterion for entry is that applicants must design and make their own work...
examples.translation: 最重要的参赛标准是申请者必须设计并制作自己的作品。

examples.text: British defence policy had to meet three criteria if it was to succeed.
examples.translation: 要想奏效，英国的国防政策必须具备3个条件。

meanings.meaning: 批评家，评论家；爱挑剔的人

examples.text: Mather was film critic on the Daily Telegraph for many years...
examples.translation: 马瑟多年来一直担任《每日电讯报》的影评人。

examples.text: The New York critics had praised her performance.
examples.translation: 纽约的影评家们高度评价了她的表演。

examples.text: The newspaper has been the most consistent critic of the government...
examples.translation: 一直以来，该报批评政府的立场最为坚定。

examples.text: He became a fierce critic of the tobacco industry...
examples.translation: 他成了烟草业的强烈反对者。

examples.text: Her critics accused her of caring only about success.
examples.translation: 批评者指责她只在乎成功。

meanings.meaning: 鉴定的；[核] 临界的；批评的，爱挑剔的；危险的；决定性的；评论的

examples.text: The incident happened at a critical point in the campaign...
examples.translation: 该事件发生在竞选活动的关键时期。

examples.text: Environmentalists say a critical factor in the city's pollution is its population...
examples.translation: 环境保护主义者说造成该城市污染问题的一个关键因素是其人口数量。

examples.text: He says setting priorities is of critical importance...
examples.translation: 他说确定优先顺序是至关重要的。

examples.text: How you finance a business is critical to the success of your venture.
examples.translation: 如何融资对企业的成功至关重要。

examples.text: Economic prosperity depends critically on an open world trading system...
examples.translation: 经济繁荣关键要靠一个开放的世界贸易体系。

examples.text: It was a critically important moment in his career.
examples.translation: 那是他事业中至关重要的一刻。

examples.text: The German authorities are considering an airlift if the situation becomes critical...
examples.translation: 如果局势变得危急，德国当局将考虑实施空运。

examples.text: Its day-to-day finances are in a critical state.
examples.translation: 其日常财务状况十分糟糕。

examples.text: Moscow is running critically low on food supplies.
examples.translation: 莫斯科的食品供给严重不足。

examples.text: Ten of the injured are said to be in critical condition.
examples.translation: 据说伤者中有10人情况危急。

examples.text: She was critically ill...
examples.translation: 她病情危重。

examples.text: A youth was killed and another critically injured.
examples.translation: 一名青年被杀，另一名受重伤。

examples.text: His report is highly critical of the trial judge...
examples.translation: 他在报告中对主审法官有颇多批评。

examples.text: ...a few dozen intellectuals who've been critical of the regime...
examples.translation: 几十名一直批判该政权的知识分子

examples.text: He has apologised for critical remarks he made about the referee.
examples.translation: 他为自己对裁判的出言不逊道了歉。

examples.text: She spoke critically of Lara.
examples.translation: 她说起拉腊来颇有微词。

examples.text: We need to become critical text-readers...
examples.translation: 我们需要培养对文章的评判能力。

examples.text: Marx's work was more than a critical study of capitalist production.
examples.translation: 马克思的著作不仅仅是对资本主义生产的批判性研究。

examples.text: ...the critical analysis of political ideas.
examples.translation: 对政治观点的评判分析

examples.text: Wyman watched them critically.
examples.translation: 怀曼仔细地观察他们。

examples.text: The film met with considerable critical and public acclaim...
examples.translation: 该影片受到了影评人和公众的高度评价。

examples.text: The show was also a resounding critical success.
examples.translation: 这次演出同样好评如潮。

examples.text: This policy had repeatedly come under strong criticism on Capitol Hill...
examples.translation: 该政策在美国国会屡遭强烈批评。

examples.text: The criticism that the English do not truly care about their children was often voiced.
examples.translation: 常有人指责英国人并不真正关心自己的子女。

examples.text: She has published more than 20 books including novels, poetry and literary criticism.
examples.translation: 她已出版了包括小说、诗歌和文学评论在内的20多部著作。

examples.text: His mother had rarely criticized him or any of her children...
examples.translation: 他母亲很少指责他或她的任何孩子。

examples.text: The minister criticised the police for failing to come up with any leads...
examples.translation: 部长批评警方没能找到任何线索。

examples.text: The regime has been harshly criticized for serious human rights violations.
examples.translation: 该政府因为严重侵犯人权而受到强烈指责。

examples.text: The cock crows and the dawn chorus begins.
examples.translation: 雄鸡报晓，鸟儿欢叫。

examples.text: Edwards is already crowing about his assured victory...
examples.translation: 爱德华兹已经在为自己确定无疑的胜利自鸣得意了。

examples.text: We've seen them all crowing that the movement is dead.
examples.translation: 我们看到他们所有人都为那场运动的覆灭而洋洋自得。

examples.text: She was crowing with delight...
examples.translation: 她欢呼雀跃。

examples.text: 'I'm not sure I've ever driven a better lap,' crowed a delighted Irvine.
examples.translation: “我想这也许是我开得最棒的一圈，”欧文高兴地欢呼道。

examples.text: I live at Mesa, Washington, about 10 miles as the crow flies from Hanford.
examples.translation: 我住在华盛顿的梅萨，到汉福德的直线距离约为10英里。

meanings.meaning: 交叉，十字；十字架，十字形物
交叉的，相反的；乖戾的；生气的

examples.text: She was partly to blame for failing to look as she crossed the road...
examples.translation: 她过马路时没注意看，负有部分责任。

examples.text: Nine Albanians have crossed the border into Greece and asked for political asylum...
examples.translation: 9名阿尔巴尼亚人穿过边境进入希腊境内并寻求政治避难。

examples.text: In 1838 the first iron sailing vessel crossed the Atlantic...
examples.translation: 1838年，第一艘铁制帆船横渡大西洋。

examples.text: Egan crossed to the drinks cabinet and poured a Scotch.
examples.translation: 伊根穿行来到酒柜旁，倒了一杯苏格兰威士忌。

examples.text: The Defford to Eckington road crosses the river half a mile outside Eckington.
examples.translation: 从迪福德到埃金顿的路穿过那条距埃金顿半英里的河。

examples.text: ...the intersection where Main and Center streets cross...
examples.translation: 主街和中心街的交叉路口

examples.text: It is near where the pilgrimage route crosses the road to Quimper.
examples.translation: 那儿离朝圣之路与通往坎佩尔的道路的交叉路口很近。

examples.text: I normally never write into magazines but Mr Stubbs has finally crossed the line...
examples.translation: 我向来不给杂志写信，但是斯塔布斯先生最后做得太过火了。

examples.text: No party is entitled to a seat in the new parliament unless it gets at least 5 per cent of the vote. Many will fail to cross that threshold.
examples.translation: 任何政党只有获得至少5%的选票才能够在新一届议会中获得一个席位。很多政党都过不了这个门槛。

examples.text: Berg tilts his head and a mischievous look crosses his face...
examples.translation: 伯格侧着头，脸上掠过一丝调皮的神情。

examples.text: A faint smile crossed his lips.
examples.translation: 他嘴唇上掠过一丝微笑。

examples.text: Round her neck was a cross on a silver chain...
examples.translation: 她脖子上戴着一条银项链，上面挂着个十字架。

examples.text: He solemnly made the sign of the cross...
examples.translation: 他庄重地画了个十字。

examples.text: Christ died on the cross.
examples.translation: 耶稣死在十字架上。

examples.text: 'Holy Mother of God!' Marco crossed himself.
examples.translation: “圣母啊！”马尔科画着十字说道。

examples.text: My wife is much cleverer than me; it is a cross I have to bear.
examples.translation: 妻子比我聪明很多，这让我很难接受。

examples.text: Put a tick next to those activities you like and a cross next to those you dislike.
examples.translation: 在你喜欢的活动旁打钩，在不喜欢的活动旁画叉。

examples.text: Cheques/postal orders should be crossed and made payable to Newmarket Promotions.
examples.translation: 应在支票/邮政汇票上画线，并使之可用于新市场促销活动的支付。

examples.text: ...a crossed cheque.
examples.translation: 画线支票

examples.text: Jill crossed her legs and rested her chin on one fist, as if lost in deep thought...
examples.translation: 吉尔盘着腿，一个拳头支着下巴，仿佛陷入了沉思。

examples.text: Pop crossed his arms over his chest and watched us...
examples.translation: 波普叉着胳膊看着我们。

examples.text: He was sitting there in the living room with his legs crossed.
examples.translation: 他跷着腿坐在起居室里。

examples.text: If you ever cross him, forget it, you're finished.
examples.translation: 如果你曾经跟他作过对，就别想了，你没戏了。

examples.text: 'Ha!' It was a cross between a laugh and a bark...
examples.translation: “哈！”那声音听起来既像在笑又像在叫。

examples.text: It was a lovely dog. It was a cross between a collie and a golden retriever.
examples.translation: 那条狗可爱极了，是柯利牧羊犬和金毛猎犬的杂交品种。

examples.text: Le Tissier hit an accurate cross to Groves.
examples.translation: 勒蒂西耶将球准确地横传给了格罗夫斯。

examples.text: The Army boys had personnel carriers blockading the cross streets.
examples.translation: 陆军士兵用运兵车封锁了十字路口。

examples.text: The women are cross and bored...
examples.translation: 这个女人很生气，烦透了。

examples.text: I'm terribly cross with him...
examples.translation: 我很生他的气。

examples.text: She was rather cross about having to trail across London.
examples.translation: 她不得不疲惫地步行穿过伦敦，这让她相当生气。

examples.text: 'No, no, no,' Morris said crossly.
examples.translation: “不，不，不，”莫里斯生气地说道。

examples.text: Rice farmers here still plant and harvest their crops by hand...
examples.translation: 这里种植水稻的农场主仍是人工种植和收割庄稼。

examples.text: The main crop is wheat and this is grown even on the very steep slopes.
examples.translation: 主要作物是小麦，就连很陡的坡地都种上了小麦。

examples.text: Each year it produces a fine crop of fruit...
examples.translation: 这里每年水果都大丰收。

examples.text: The US government says that this year's corn crop should be about 8 percent more than last year...
examples.translation: 美国政府称今年的玉米产量应该会比去年提高8%左右。

examples.text: In the Middle Ages, years of crop failure were always followed by terrible disease.
examples.translation: 中世纪时，庄稼连年歉收后总会出现严重的疫情。

examples.text: The present crop of books and documentaries about Marilyn Monroe exploit the thirtieth anniversary of her death...
examples.translation: 时下出现的这些有关玛丽莲·梦露的书和纪录片是借她逝世30周年之际推出的。

examples.text: Next year's crop of undergraduates opting to take physics represents just 2 per cent of all undergraduates.
examples.translation: 明年选修物理的大学生仅占大学生总数的2%。

examples.text: Although these vegetables adapt well to our temperate climate, they tend to crop poorly.
examples.translation: 虽然这些蔬菜作物很适应我们这里温和的气候，它们的收成却很差。

examples.text: I started cropping my beans in July.
examples.translation: 我7月份开始收割豆类作物。

examples.text: I let the horse drop his head to crop the spring grass.
examples.translation: 我让马低下头啃吃春天的青草。

examples.text: She cropped her hair and dyed it blonde.
examples.translation: 她把头发剪短并染成了金黄色。

examples.text: She had cropped grey hair.
examples.translation: 她有一头剪短了的灰白头发。

examples.text: She had her long hair cut into a boyish crop.
examples.translation: 她把长发剪成了男孩子般的短发。

examples.text: I decided to crop the picture just above the water line...
examples.translation: 我决定把这张照片水印以下的部分裁掉。

examples.text: Her husband was cropped from the photograph.
examples.translation: 她丈夫被从照片上剪下去了。

meanings.meaning: 群众,一伙;一堆,许多,大众

examples.text: A huge crowd gathered in a square outside the Kremlin walls...
examples.translation: 一大群人聚集在克里姆林宫墙外的广场上。

examples.text: It took some two hours before the crowd was fully dispersed...
examples.translation: 大概花了两个小时才把人群全部疏散开。

examples.text: The crowd were enormously enthusiastic...
examples.translation: 观众热情高涨。

examples.text: The explosions took place in shopping centres as crowds of people were shopping for Mothers' Day.
examples.translation: 爆炸发生在购物中心，当时大批人群正在为母亲节购物。

examples.text: All the old crowd have come out for this occasion.
examples.translation: 那些老伙计们都来参加这一庆典。

examples.text: The hungry refugees crowded around the tractors...
examples.translation: 饥饿的难民聚集到拖拉机周围。

examples.text: Police blocked off the road as hotel staff and guests crowded around.
examples.translation: 当酒店工作人员和旅客们都聚拢过来时，警察封锁了那条路。

examples.text: Hundreds of thousands of people have crowded into the center of the Lithuanian capital, Vilnius...
examples.translation: 几十万人涌入立陶宛首都维尔纽斯的市中心。

examples.text: One group of journalists were crowded into a minibus...
examples.translation: 一群记者挤进一辆小型公共汽车。

examples.text: 'Bravo, bravo,' chanted party workers crowded in the main hall.
examples.translation: “太好了，太好了，”聚集在正厅的该党工作人员反复喊着。

examples.text: Thousands of demonstrators crowded the streets shouting slogans.
examples.translation: 数千名高喊着口号的示威者把街道挤得水泄不通。

examples.text: It had been a tense, restless day with people crowding her all the time.
examples.translation: 这是紧张、忙碌的一天，每时每刻都有人围在她身旁。

meanings.meaning: 重要的；决定性的；定局的；决断的

examples.text: He had administrators under him but took the crucial decisions himself...
examples.translation: 他手下有管理人员，但重要的决策仍由他自己来做。

examples.text: ...the most crucial election campaign for years...
examples.translation: 几年来最重要的竞选活动

examples.text: Improved consumer confidence is crucial to an economic recovery.
examples.translation: 消费者信心的提升对经济的复苏至关重要。

examples.text: Chewing properly is crucially important...
examples.translation: 正确的咀嚼方式是极其重要的。

examples.text: Crucially, though, it failed to secure the backing of the banks.
examples.translation: 然而重要的是，它没能获得银行的支持。

meanings.meaning: 加冕；居…之顶；表彰；使圆满完成

examples.text: ...a crown of flowers.
examples.translation: 花冠

examples.text: She says the sovereignty of the Crown must be preserved.
examples.translation: 她说必须维护王国政府的主权。

examples.text: ...a Minister of the Crown.
examples.translation: 王国政府的大臣

examples.text: ...chief witness for the Crown.
examples.translation: 公诉方的主要证人

examples.text: Elizabeth was crowned in Westminster Abbey on 2 June 1953...
examples.translation: 伊丽莎白于1953年6月2日在威斯敏斯特大教堂加冕。

examples.text: Two days later, Juan Carlos was crowned king.
examples.translation: 两天后，胡安·卡洛斯被加冕为国王。

examples.text: ...the newly crowned King.
examples.translation: 新加冕的国王

examples.text: Here another rugged castle crowns the cliffs and crags.
examples.translation: 这里又有一座高低不平的城堡建在悬崖绝壁之上。

examples.text: ...a very striking face, crowned by an abundance of hair.
examples.translation: 一张非常标致的脸，长着一头浓密的头发

examples.text: He laid his hand gently on the crown of her head.
examples.translation: 他把手轻轻放在她的头顶上。

examples.text: ...his dream of a fourth Wimbledon crown.
examples.translation: 他梦想第四次获得温布尔登网球公开赛的冠军

examples.text: It is an important moment, crowning the efforts of the Cup organisers...
examples.translation: 这是个重要时刻，它使得优胜杯赛组织者的努力圆满告捷。

examples.text: The summit was crowned by the signing of the historic START treaty.
examples.translation: 此次峰会以签订具有历史性意义的《削减进攻性战略武器条约》宣告圆满成功。

examples.text: ...the crowning achievement of his career.
examples.translation: 他事业上的最高成就

examples.text: He went on to crown a distinguished career in radio and television with his book 'The Price of Victory'.
examples.translation: 凭借《胜利的代价》一书，在广播和电视事业上成就杰出的他再创辉煌。

meanings.meaning: 残酷的，残忍的；使人痛苦的，让人受难的；无情的，严酷的

examples.text: Children can be so cruel...
examples.translation: 孩子有时可能会相当残忍。

examples.text: Don't you think it's cruel to cage a creature up?
examples.translation: 你不认为把动物关进笼里太残忍了吗？

examples.text: Douglas was often cruelly tormented by jealous siblings.
examples.translation: 道格拉斯经常被嫉妒他的兄弟姐妹整得很惨。

examples.text: ...struggling to survive in a cruel world with which they cannot cope...
examples.translation: 在一个难以应付的残酷世界里拼命求生

examples.text: By a cruel irony, his horse came down on a flat part of the course.
examples.translation: 十分残酷而且极具讽刺意味的是，他的马在赛场的平地上摔倒了。

examples.text: His life has been cruelly shattered by an event not of his own making.
examples.translation: 他的一生被一件原本与他无关的事残酷地毁了。

meanings.meaning: 粗糙的；天然的，未加工的；粗鲁的

examples.text: Standard measurements of blood pressure are an important but crude way of assessing the risk of heart disease or strokes...
examples.translation: 标准的血压测量是评估患心脏病或中风几率的一个重要但不精确的方法。

examples.text: Birthplace data are only the crudest indicator of actual migration paths.
examples.translation: 出生地信息只能非常粗略地显示实际移民过程。

examples.text: The donors can be split — a little crudely — into two groups...
examples.translation: 捐献者可以大致分为两组。

examples.text: Put crudely, the liberationists favour extending a number of rights to children.
examples.translation: 大致来说，妇女解放论者希望将一些权利延伸至儿童。

examples.text: ...crude wooden boxes.
examples.translation: 简陋的木盒子

examples.text: ...a crudely carved wooden form...
examples.translation: 雕刻粗糙的木质结构

examples.text: In some places maps are scarce, and are often crudely produced.
examples.translation: 有些地方很少有地图，而且通常绘制得都很粗糙。

examples.text: Nev! Must you be quite so crude?
examples.translation: 尼夫！你非得那么粗俗吗？

examples.text: ...crude language.
examples.translation: 粗俗的语言

examples.text: ...crude sexual jokes.
examples.translation: 荤段子

examples.text: He hated it when she spoke so crudely...
examples.translation: 他很讨厌她讲粗口。

examples.text: To put it crudely, nobody really gives a toss about this any more.
examples.translation: 说难听的，没人会真的再在乎这种事了。

examples.text: He had not expected such crudity from so sophisticated a minister.
examples.translation: 他真没想到如此见多识广的部长竟会这么幼稚。

examples.text: Crudeness is on the rise in all fields of entertainment.
examples.translation: 所有娱乐领域都日益粗俗化。

examples.text: ...8.5 million tonnes of crude steel.
examples.translation: 850万吨粗钢

examples.text: He and his wife were planning to go on a world cruise...
examples.translation: 他和太太计划乘船环游世界。

examples.text: The next stop on this cruise is likely to be in Cornwall.
examples.translation: 此次航游的下一站很可能是在康沃尔。

examples.text: She wants to cruise the canals of France in a barge...
examples.translation: 她想乘驳船游览法国的运河。

examples.text: During their summer holidays they cruised further afield to Normandy and Brittany.
examples.translation: 暑期他们乘船到更远的诺曼底和布列塔尼游览。

examples.text: ...a 51ft cruising yacht.
examples.translation: 长为51英尺的大游艇

examples.text: A black and white police car cruised past.
examples.translation: 一辆黑白相间的警车缓慢驶过。

examples.text: Graf looked in awesome form as she cruised to an easy victory.
examples.translation: 格拉芙轻松取胜，看上去状态极佳。

examples.text: ...gay men cruising on Clapham Common.
examples.translation: 在克拉珀姆公地寻找性伙伴的男同性恋者

meanings.meaning: 粉碎；迷恋；压榨；拥挤的人群

examples.text: Andrew crushed his empty can...
examples.translation: 安德鲁把他的空罐子捏扁了。

examples.text: Their vehicle was crushed by an army tank...
examples.translation: 他们的车被一辆军用坦克压扁了。

examples.text: Peel and crush the garlic.
examples.translation: 把蒜剥皮并捣碎。

examples.text: ...crushed ice.
examples.translation: 碎冰

examples.text: The military operation was the first step in a plan to crush the uprising.
examples.translation: 军事行动是镇压暴动计划的第一步。

examples.text: ...in his bid to crush the rebels.
examples.translation: 在他镇压叛乱者的过程中

examples.text: ...the violent crushing of anti-government demonstrations.
examples.translation: 对反政府示威的残暴镇压

examples.text: Listen to criticism but don't be crushed by it.
examples.translation: 听取批评意见，但不要被它击垮。

examples.text: We were at the front, crushed against the stage.
examples.translation: 我们在前面，被挤到了舞台边上。

examples.text: Franklin and his thirteen-year-old son somehow got separated in the crush...
examples.translation: 富兰克林和他13岁的儿子在人群中被挤散了。

examples.text: Everywhere he went he was mobbed by a crush of fans.
examples.translation: 他所到之处都有成群的歌迷簇拥着他。

examples.text: She had a crush on you, you know...
examples.translation: 她曾爱慕你，你是知道的。

examples.text: I'd got over my schoolgirl crush.
examples.translation: 我已经不再像女学生那样迷恋别人了。

meanings.meaning: 地壳；外壳；面包皮；坚硬外皮

examples.text: As the water evaporates, a crust of salt is left on the surface of the soil.
examples.translation: 随着水分的蒸发，地面上留下了一层结晶盐。

examples.text: Earthquakes leave scars in the earth's crust.
examples.translation: 地震会在地壳上留下裂痕。

examples.text: In his early days, he would do almost anything to earn a crust from the sport.
examples.translation: 早年为了能在体育界混口饭吃，他几乎什么都做。

examples.text: I hung up the phone and started to cry...
examples.translation: 我挂断电话，开始哭了起来。

examples.text: Please don't cry...
examples.translation: 拜托不要哭。

examples.text: He cried with anger and frustration.
examples.translation: 他又生气又沮丧，不禁哭了起来。

examples.text: ...a crying baby.
examples.translation: 啼哭的婴儿

examples.text: A nurse patted me on the shoulder and said, 'You have a good cry, dear.'
examples.translation: 一位护士拍了拍我的肩膀说，“痛快地哭一场吧，宝贝儿。”

examples.text: She had been unable to sleep for three days because of her 13-week-old son's crying.
examples.translation: 她13周大的儿子老是哭，她已经有3天没睡了。

examples.text: 'Nancy Drew,' she cried, 'you're under arrest!'...
examples.translation: “南茜·朱尔，”她喊道，“你被捕了！”

examples.text: I cried: 'It's wonderful news!'
examples.translation: 我叫道：“真是个好消息！”

examples.text: 'You're wrong, quite wrong!' Henry cried out, suddenly excited...
examples.translation: “你错了，大错特错！”亨利突然激动地大喊道。

examples.text: According to the legend, she cried out that no storm was going to stop her from finishing her ride.
examples.translation: 据传，她当时大声宣布，即使有再大的暴风雨她也要骑到终点。

examples.text: A cry of horror broke from me...
examples.translation: 我吓得大叫了一声。

examples.text: Her brother gave a cry of recognition...
examples.translation: 她哥哥认了出来，惊呼了一声。

examples.text: With a cry, she rushed forward.
examples.translation: 她大喊一声，向前冲去。

examples.text: Thousands of Ukrainians burst into cries of 'bravo' on the steps of the parliament...
examples.translation: 成千上万的乌克兰人聚集在议会门前高喊“好啊”。

examples.text: Passers-by heard his cries for help.
examples.translation: 路过的人听到了他求救的呼喊。

examples.text: There have been cries of outrage about this expenditure...
examples.translation: 这项开支遭到了一些人愤怒的指责。

examples.text: Many other countries have turned a deaf ear to their cries for help.
examples.translation: 很多其他国家对他们的求助置若罔闻。

examples.text: ...the cry of a seagull.
examples.translation: 海鸥的鸣叫

examples.text: Their lives are a far cry from his own poor childhood.
examples.translation: 他们的生活与他那贫苦的童年生活相比大相径庭。

examples.text: The main opposition party is already in full cry over this mishandling of security.
examples.translation: 主要反对党已经对这起安全事故的错误处理进行了猛烈抨击。

examples.text: I mean, what's he ever done in his life, for crying out loud?
examples.translation: 我的意思是，天啊，他一生中到底做过什么呀？

meanings.meaning: 结晶，晶体；水晶；水晶饰品
(Crystal)人名；(英)克里斯特尔，克丽丝特尔 (女名)

examples.text: ...salt crystals.
examples.translation: 盐晶体

examples.text: ...ice crystals.
examples.translation: 冰晶

examples.text: ...a single crystal of silicon.
examples.translation: 硅的单晶体

examples.text: ...a strand of crystal beads.
examples.translation: 一串水晶珠子

examples.text: Some of the finest drinking glasses are made from lead crystal.
examples.translation: 一些最高档的酒杯是用铅晶质玻璃制成的。

examples.text: ...crystal glasses.
examples.translation: 水晶玻璃杯

examples.text: ...an immense crystal chandelier.
examples.translation: 巨大的水晶玻璃枝形吊灯

examples.text: Get out your best china and crystal.
examples.translation: 拿出你最好的瓷器和水晶玻璃器皿。

meanings.meaning: 使成立方形；使自乘二次；量…的体积

examples.text: ...cold water with ice cubes in it...
examples.translation: 放了冰块的冷水

examples.text: ...a box of sugar cubes...
examples.translation: 一盒方糖

examples.text: The cabinet comes with locks and key and is shaped like a cube.
examples.translation: 储藏柜带有锁和钥匙，形状像个立方体。

examples.text: Remove the seeds and stones and cube the flesh...
examples.translation: 把籽和果核弄掉，将果肉切成小方块。

examples.text: Serve with cubed bread.
examples.translation: 和小面包块一起食用。

examples.text: You can hardly be held responsible for Darrow waltzing in, cool as a cucumber, and demanding thousands of pounds.
examples.translation: 达罗不慌不忙、大摇大摆地走进来，索要几千英镑，这跟你一点关系都没有。

examples.text: The actors not performing sit at the side of the stage in full view, waiting for their cues...
examples.translation: 还未轮到演出的演员坐在舞台旁边能看得一清二楚的地方，等待着他们的出场提示。

examples.text: I had never known him miss a cue.
examples.translation: 我从没见过他错过提示。

examples.text: He read the scene, with Seaton cueing him.
examples.translation: 在西顿的提示下，他念了这一场的台词。

examples.text: That was the cue for several months of intense bargaining...
examples.translation: 那意味着几个月的激烈谈判开始了。

examples.text: That was Nicholas's cue to ask for another chocolate chip cookie.
examples.translation: 那表示尼古拉斯还想要一块巧克力曲奇。

examples.text: Their youngest brother was nine when he picked up a cue for the first time.
examples.translation: 他们最年轻的弟弟第一次玩台球时才9岁。

examples.text: Kevin arrived right on cue to care for Harry...
examples.translation: 凯文到的正是时候，可以照顾哈丽。

examples.text: 'It's almost eight o'clock.' As if on cue the bell in the chapel began to toll for Matins.
examples.translation: “快8点了。”恰好在这时小教堂晨祷的钟声敲响了。

examples.text: Taking his cue from his companion, he apologized for his earlier display of temper.
examples.translation: 他也学着像同伴那样，为先前发脾气道歉。

examples.text: She also cultivated a small garden of her own.
examples.translation: 她还耕种了一片属于自己的小园子。

examples.text: ...the few patches of cultivated land.
examples.translation: 为数不多的几小块耕地

examples.text: ...the cultivation of fruits and vegetables...
examples.translation: 水果和蔬菜的种植

examples.text: Farmers with many acres under cultivation profited.
examples.translation: 耕种大片土地的农场主挣了钱。

examples.text: He has written eight books and has cultivated the image of an elder statesman...
examples.translation: 他已经写了8本书，树立起了其政界元老的形象。

examples.text: Cultivating a positive mental attitude towards yourself can reap tremendous benefits.
examples.translation: 培养一种自信的积极心态会让人受益匪浅。

examples.text: ...the cultivation of a positive approach to life and health.
examples.translation: 培养积极的生活方式和保健方式

examples.text: Howe carefully cultivated Daniel C. Roper, the Assistant Postmaster General...
examples.translation: 豪谨慎地和邮政副部长丹尼尔·C.罗珀拉近关系。

examples.text: Estonia has done much to cultivate the friendship of western European countries.
examples.translation: 爱沙尼亚努力发展与西欧国家的友谊。

examples.text: There is just not enough fun and frivolity in culture today.
examples.translation: 当今的文化恰恰是不够轻松有趣。

examples.text: ...aspects of popular culture.
examples.translation: 大众文化的方方面面

examples.text: ...France's Minister of Culture and Education.
examples.translation: 法国文化和教育部部长

examples.text: ...people from different cultures...
examples.translation: 来自不同文化背景的人们

examples.text: I was brought up in a culture that said you must put back into the society what you have taken out.
examples.translation: 我成长于其中的那个社会文化认为，取之社会必须回报社会。

examples.text: But social workers say that this has created a culture of dependency, particularly in urban areas...
examples.translation: 然而社会工作者认为这使得人们普遍产生了依赖，尤其是在城市地区。

examples.text: The institutions have realised they need to change their culture to improve efficiency and service.
examples.translation: 这些机构已经意识到需要改变他们的内部文化以提高效率、改进服务。

examples.text: ...a culture of human cells.
examples.translation: 人类细胞的培养物

examples.text: ...a number of tissue culture experiments.
examples.translation: 多次组织细胞培养实验

examples.text: To confirm the diagnosis, the hospital laboratory must culture a colony of bacteria.
examples.translation: 为进一步确诊，医院实验室必须培养一个细菌菌落。

examples.text: ...cultured human blood cells.
examples.translation: 培养的人体血细胞

examples.text: These disturbed kids can be cunning.
examples.translation: 这些心理不正常的孩子可能会很狡猾。

examples.text: ...Mr Blair's cunning plan.
examples.translation: 布莱尔先生的诡计

examples.text: They were cunningly disguised in golf clothes.
examples.translation: 他们穿上高尔夫球服，巧妙地伪装起来。

examples.text: ...one more example of the cunning of today's art thieves...
examples.translation: 当今艺术品盗贼手段狡猾的另一个例子

examples.text: He tackled the job with a great deal of imagination, skill and cunning.
examples.translation: 他在工作中充分发挥其想象力、技能和聪明才智来解决各种难题。

examples.text: ...cups and saucers.
examples.translation: 杯碟

examples.text: Mix about four cups of white flour with a pinch of salt.
examples.translation: 将约4杯白面粉与一撮盐混合。

examples.text: ...the brass cups of the small chandelier.
examples.translation: 枝形小吊灯的黄铜灯托儿

examples.text: Sri Lanka's cricket team will play India in the final of the Asia Cup.
examples.translation: 斯里兰卡板球队将在亚洲杯的决赛中对阵印度队。

examples.text: ...after his fateful injury in the 1991 FA Cup final.
examples.translation: 他在1991年足总杯决赛中受重伤之后

examples.text: He cupped his hands around his mouth and called out for Diane...
examples.translation: 他双手拢在嘴边，大声呼喊黛安娜。

examples.text: David knelt, cupped his hands and splashed river water on to his face...
examples.translation: 戴维跪下身，用手捧起河水往脸上撩。

examples.text: She held it in her cupped hands for us to see.
examples.translation: 她双手捧着它给我们看。

examples.text: He cupped her chin in the palm of his hand...
examples.translation: 他用手心托着她的下巴。

examples.text: He cradled the baby in his arms, his hands cupping her tiny skull.
examples.translation: 他轻轻地抱着婴儿，双手托着她的小脑袋。

examples.text: He talked too freely when, as was too often the case, he was in his cups.
examples.translation: 他经常喝醉，而且一喝醉就口无遮拦。

examples.text: The kitchen cupboard was stocked with tins of soup and food.
examples.translation: 厨房的橱柜里备有汤罐头和食品罐头。

examples.text: ...advertisements aimed at curbing the spread of Aids...
examples.translation: 旨在控制艾滋病传播的广告

examples.text: Inflation needs to be curbed in Russia.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯需要抑制通货膨胀。

examples.text: He called for much stricter curbs on immigration.
examples.translation: 他呼吁对移民采取更严格的限制措施。

examples.text: He curbed his temper...
examples.translation: 他稳住了情绪。

examples.text: You must curb your extravagant tastes.
examples.translation: 你必须控制自己铺张奢侈的嗜好。

meanings.meaning: 治疗；治愈；使硫化；加工处理
治病；痊愈；受治疗；被硫化；被加工处理
治疗；治愈；[临床] 疗法
(Cure)人名；(罗)库雷；(法)屈尔；(英)丘尔；(塞)楚雷

examples.text: An operation finally cured his shin injury...
examples.translation: 手术最终治好了他胫部的伤。

examples.text: Her cancer can only be controlled, not cured.
examples.translation: 她的癌症只能控制，无法治愈。

examples.text: MDT is an effective treatment and could cure all the leprosy sufferers worldwide...
examples.translation: 联合化疗是一种有望治愈全世界所有麻风病患者的有效治疗方法。

examples.text: Almost overnight I was cured...
examples.translation: 几乎是一夜间我就被治好了。

examples.text: Now doctors believe they have cured him of the disease.
examples.translation: 现在医生们确信已经治好了他的病。

examples.text: There is still no cure for a cold...
examples.translation: 尚没有治疗感冒的特效药。

examples.text: Atkinson has been told rest is the only cure for his ankle injury.
examples.translation: 阿特金森被告知休息是唯一能治好他脚踝伤的办法。

examples.text: Private firms are willing to make large scale investments to help cure Russia's economic troubles...
examples.translation: 私有企业愿意投巨资帮助俄罗斯渡过经济难关。

examples.text: We need to cure our environmental problems.
examples.translation: 我们需要解决环境问题。

examples.text: Punishment can never be an effective cure for acute social problems...
examples.translation: 惩罚绝不是解决严重社会问题的有效办法。

examples.text: The magic cure for inflation does not exist.
examples.translation: 抑制通货膨胀没有什么灵丹妙药。

examples.text: The experience was a detestable ordeal, and it cured him of any ambitions to direct again...
examples.translation: 那次经历是一次令人厌恶的煎熬，使得他放弃了任何再当导演的想法。

examples.text: He went to a clinic to cure his drinking and overeating.
examples.translation: 他去诊所戒酒并控制饮食。

examples.text: Legs of pork were cured and smoked over the fire.
examples.translation: 在火上熏制猪腿。

examples.text: ...sliced cured ham.
examples.translation: 切成片的熏火腿

meanings.meaning: 好奇，好奇心；珍品，古董，古玩

examples.text: Ryle accepted more out of curiosity than anything else...
examples.translation: 赖尔更多的是出于好奇才同意的。

examples.text: ...an enthusiasm and genuine curiosity about the past...
examples.translation: 对过去的巨大兴趣与真正的好奇

examples.text: To satisfy our own curiosity we traveled to Baltimore.
examples.translation: 为了满足好奇心，我们去了巴尔的摩。

examples.text: There is much to see in the way of castles, curiosities, and museums...
examples.translation: 可以看到很多城堡、奇珍异品和博物馆。

examples.text: Reed International is a curiosity in the international world of publishing.
examples.translation: 里德国际公司是国际出版界的一朵奇葩。

meanings.meaning: 好奇的，有求知欲的；古怪的；爱挑剔的

examples.text: Steve was intensely curious about the world I came from...
examples.translation: 史蒂夫非常想了解我以前生活的那个世界。

examples.text: Children are naturally curious.
examples.translation: 孩子天生好奇。

examples.text: ...a group of curious villagers.
examples.translation: 一群好奇的村民

examples.text: The woman in the shop had looked at them curiously...
examples.translation: 商店里的那个女人曾经好奇地看着他们。

examples.text: 'Is that how you got that scar on your face?' Bess asked curiously.
examples.translation: “那就是你脸上那道伤疤的由来？”贝丝好奇地问道。

examples.text: There is a curious thing about her writings in this period...
examples.translation: 她在这期间的著作与以往有所不同。

examples.text: The pageant promises to be a curious mixture of the ancient and modern...
examples.translation: 游行盛典将会是古老与现代的奇特融合。

examples.text: The naval high command's response to these developments is rather curious.
examples.translation: 海军最高指挥部对这些进展的回应十分反常。

examples.text: Harry was curiously silent through all this...
examples.translation: 在整个过程中哈里都一言不发，令人费解。

examples.text: Curiously, the struggle to survive has greatly improved her health.
examples.translation: 奇怪的是，她拼命求生的抗争使得她的健康状况大有好转。

examples.text: ...the little girl with blonde curls...
examples.translation: 长着金色卷发的小女孩

examples.text: A curl of black hair fell loosely across his forehead.
examples.translation: 他的额头上垂着一绺散开的黑色卷发。

examples.text: Dry curly hair naturally for maximum curl and shine.
examples.translation: 让卷发自然变干，才能使头发卷最多，最有光泽。

examples.text: She has hair that refuses to curl...
examples.translation: 她头发不易出卷。

examples.text: Maria had curled her hair for the event...
examples.translation: 玛丽亚为出席那次活动烫了头发。

examples.text: Afro hair is short and tightly curled.
examples.translation: 非洲式发型是浓密的小短卷。

examples.text: A thin curl of smoke rose from a rusty stove.
examples.translation: 生锈的炉子里冒出一缕青烟。

examples.text: ...curls of lemon peel.
examples.translation: 螺旋状的柠檬皮

examples.text: His fingers curled gently round her wrist...
examples.translation: 他轻轻地握住她的手腕。

examples.text: Raise one foot, curl the toes and point the foot downwards...
examples.translation: 抬起一只脚，弯曲脚趾，使脚尖朝下。

examples.text: She sat with her legs curled under her.
examples.translation: 她盘腿坐着。

examples.text: Smoke was curling up the chimney...
examples.translation: 烟从烟囱里袅袅升起。

examples.text: He curled the ball into the net.
examples.translation: 他一脚弧线球射门成功。

examples.text: He wanted to curl into a tiny ball...
examples.translation: 他想蜷缩成小小的一团。

examples.text: The kitten was curled on a cushion on the sofa.
examples.translation: 那只小猫在沙发垫子上蜷缩成了一团。

examples.text: In colder weather, your cat will curl up into a tight, heat-conserving ball...
examples.translation: 天气更冷时，猫会为了保存热量而紧紧地缩成一团。

examples.text: She curled up next to him...
examples.translation: 她蜷缩在他身边。

examples.text: He was asleep there, curled up in the fetal position.
examples.translation: 他像胎儿一样蜷曲地睡在那儿。

examples.text: The rose leaves have curled because of an attack by grubs.
examples.translation: 玫瑰的叶子因为闹虫害而卷边了。

examples.text: The corners of the lino were curling up.
examples.translation: 油地毡卷角了。

examples.text: He curled his upper lip in a show of scepticism...
examples.translation: 他撇嘴表示怀疑。

examples.text: She had a small, mean mouth that curled disapprovingly each time her husband wrote something in his diary.
examples.translation: 每次丈夫写日记时，她都会不满地撇撇那张刻薄的小嘴。

examples.text: Tourism is the country's top earner of foreign currency...
examples.translation: 旅游业是该国外汇创收最多的行业。

examples.text: More people favour a single European currency than oppose it.
examples.translation: 赞成单一欧洲货币的人占多数。

examples.text: ...Western currencies.
examples.translation: 西方货币

examples.text: His theory of the social contract had wide currency in America...
examples.translation: 他的社会契约论在美国广为认可。

examples.text: 'Loop' is one of those computer words that has gained currency in society.
examples.translation: 有一些计算机术语成了社会上的通用词汇,“循环”就是其中一个。

meanings.meaning: 现在的；流通的，通用的；最近的；草写的

examples.text: Under normal conditions, the ocean currents of the tropical Pacific travel from east to west...
examples.translation: 在正常情况下，太平洋的热带洋流自东向西流。

examples.text: The couple were swept away by the strong current.
examples.translation: 这对夫妻被巨大的水流卷走了。

examples.text: I felt a current of cool air blowing in my face.
examples.translation: 我觉得脸上有一阵冷风吹过。

examples.text: A powerful electric current is passed through a piece of graphite.
examples.translation: 给一块石墨通入强电流。

examples.text: Each party represents a distinct current of thought...
examples.translation: 每个党派代表一种不同的思潮。

examples.text: A strong current of nationalism runs through ideology and politics in the Arab world.
examples.translation: 一股强烈的民族主义思潮涌入阿拉伯世界的思想体系和政治体系。

examples.text: The current situation is very different to that in 1990...
examples.translation: 当前的形势与1990年截然不同。

examples.text: He plans to repeal a number of current policies...
examples.translation: 他计划废除一些当前的政策。

examples.text: When asked for your views about your current job, on no account must you be negative.
examples.translation: 当你被问及对目前工作的看法时，绝不要表现得消极。

examples.text: Twelve potential vaccines are currently being tested on human volunteers...
examples.translation: 目前正在人类志愿者身上试验12种试用疫苗。

examples.text: He currently has no strong rivals for power.
examples.translation: 目前没有可以和他争夺权势的有力对手。

examples.text: Current thinking suggests that toxins only have a small part to play in the build up of cellulite...
examples.translation: 目前普遍认为，毒素对皮下脂肪团堆积影响不大。

examples.text: This custom was still current in the late 1960s.
examples.translation: 这种习俗在20世纪60年代末仍然很普遍。

examples.text: There should be a broader curriculum in schools for post-16-year-old pupils...
examples.translation: 学校对16岁以上的学生开设的课程，范围应该更广一些。

examples.text: Russian is the one compulsory foreign language on the school curriculum.
examples.translation: 俄语在学校课程设置中是一门必修的外语课。

examples.text: ...the history curriculum.
examples.translation: 历史课

examples.text: I cursed and hobbled to my feet.
examples.translation: 我咒骂着一瘸一拐地站起来。

examples.text: He shot her an angry look and a curse.
examples.translation: 他生气地看了她一眼，骂了一句。

examples.text: Grandma protested, but he cursed her and rudely pushed her aside...
examples.translation: 奶奶提出抗议，但他辱骂她并把她粗暴地推到一旁。

examples.text: He cursed himself for having been so careless.
examples.translation: 他骂自己怎么那么不小心。

examples.text: So we set off again, cursing the delay, towards the west...
examples.translation: 于是，我们一面抱怨延误了时间，一面又朝西出发了。

examples.text: She silently cursed her own stupidity.
examples.translation: 她在心里默默地骂自己愚蠢。

examples.text: Maybe there is a curse on my family...
examples.translation: 可能我的家族受到了诅咒。

examples.text: He's been the object of a voodoo curse.
examples.translation: 他受到伏都教的诅咒。

examples.text: Apathy is the long-standing curse of British local democracy...
examples.translation: 冷漠是英国地方民主制度长期以来难以推广的祸根。

examples.text: Summer colds are a terrible curse.
examples.translation: 夏季感冒是极其糟糕的事。

examples.text: Her bedroom curtains were drawn.
examples.translation: 她卧室的窗帘拉上了。

examples.text: The curtain rises toward the end of the Prelude.
examples.translation: 序曲将近结束时帷幕升起来了。

examples.text: ...a curtain of cigarette smoke...
examples.translation: 烟幕

examples.text: He saw something dark disappear behind the curtain of leaves.
examples.translation: 他看到一个黑漆漆的东西从浓密的树叶后消失了。

examples.text: Management changes are under way that will finally bring down the curtain on Lord Forte's extraordinary working life.
examples.translation: 正在进行的管理层变更将最终为福特勋爵辉煌的职业生涯画上句号。

meanings.meaning: 曲线；弯曲；曲线球；曲线图表

examples.text: ...the curve of his lips.
examples.translation: 他嘴唇的曲线

examples.text: ...a curve in the road.
examples.translation: 道路的转弯

examples.text: Her spine curved...
examples.translation: 她的脊柱弯曲了。

examples.text: The track curved away below him.
examples.translation: 他脚下的小径蜿蜒地伸向远方。

examples.text: ...a knife with a slightly curving blade...
examples.translation: 一把刀刃略弯的刀

examples.text: A small, unobtrusive smile curved the cook's thin lips.

examples.translation: 每一家企业都将面临需求曲线的下滑。

examples.translation: 他们称需要西方的援助来缓解重大改革带来的冲击。

examples.text: The custom of lighting the Olympic flame goes back centuries...

examples.translation: 钟努力去适应当地的风俗习惯。

examples.text: It was his custom to approach every problem cautiously...
examples.translation: 他习惯谨慎地处理每一个问题。

examples.translation: 像往常一样，警方的法医专家对残骸进行了仔细的查看。

examples.text: You have the right to withhold your custom if you so wish...
examples.translation: 如果你这么不想来，你可以不再光顾。

examples.text: Providing discounts is not the only way to win custom.
examples.translation: 打折并不是招揽顾客的唯一途径。

examples.translation: 在她这里定做一件款型独一无二的衣服，价格从100美元到1,000美元以上不等。

examples.text: It is customary to offer a drink or a snack to guests...

examples.text: At Christmas it was customary for the children to perform bits of poetry...
examples.translation: 圣诞节孩子们总要唱一些圣诞颂歌。

examples.translation: 他们讥讽着，喊叫着，打破了惯常的那一分钟沉默。

examples.translation: 在中世纪的欧洲，婚姻通常是由双方的家庭安排的。

examples.text: The king carried himself with his customary elegance...
examples.translation: 国王保持着一贯的温文尔雅。

examples.text: Yvonne took her customary seat behind her desk.
examples.translation: 伊冯娜坐在桌子后面那个她常坐的位子上。

examples.text: Our customers have very tight budgets.

examples.translation: 心满意足的顾客

examples.text: We also improved our customer satisfaction levels.
examples.translation: 我们也提高了顾客满意的标准。

examples.text: She's a real cool customer.

examples.translation: 把西红柿纵向切成两半。

examples.translation: 该手术要在角膜上做几个切口。

examples.translation: 佐薇爬下岩石去够他，被划得满身是伤。

examples.translation: 血从他划伤的嘴唇涌出顺着下巴往下流。

examples.translation: 他左眼眉上留下了一道疤。

examples.translation: 上一拨房客连草都没有修剪。

examples.translation: 你要知道不可以在起居室里剪脚趾甲。

examples.translation: 她有一头深红色的短发。

examples.text: I could see long canoes cutting through the waves.
examples.translation: 我看见长长的独木舟破浪而行。

examples.translation: 他决定抄近路走格林尼治公园穿过希思区。

examples.translation: 联合国部队将裁减90%。

examples.translation: 当前经济状况需要立即将利率下调两个百分点。

examples.translation: 发现有必要对该文本进行一些删节。

examples.translation: 他们采用施加压力的策略迫使他们回来，包括切断食物和水的供应。

examples.translation: 很多婴儿到一岁大时才开始长牙。

examples.translation: 3个月内旷课次数超过一次就可能有麻烦了。

examples.translation: “丹尼尔，别绕弯子了，”布伦达厉声说道。

examples.translation: 你为什么不能停止废话去把门打开。

examples.translation: 用一块便宜点的肉，比如肋排肉。

examples.translation: 律师们自然从那个小家伙赢得的钱中分到了他们的一份。

examples.translation: 琼·史密斯的侦探小说比其他侦探小说都要出色。

examples.translation: 我们想要的是指导原则，不是固定的答案。

examples.translation: 可能除了詹姆斯外，公司里都没人能管得了他。

examples.translation: 它将脱离长期依附的国家，实现独立自主。

examples.translation: 他认为出生于英格兰的选手在国外不会取得好成绩。

examples.translation: 公然对立的两个对手之间的激烈辩论

examples.translation: 这种宣传有利也有弊。它使得人们关注我们，同样也关注了他们。

examples.translation: 叛军已经切断了来自首都的供电。

examples.translation: 假如供水被切断，他所在的公司就准备关闭。

examples.translation: 电话接通后，你最好在断线之前尽快把话说完。

examples.translation: 就谈到这里好吗，因为我们还有很多打来电话的人在等着呢。

examples.translation: 他警告说该行动正对经济造成破坏。

examples.translation: 爆炸给这所房子造成了大面积的损坏。

examples.translation: 遵守新的规定就意味着赛车比赛将遭受严重影响。

examples.translation: 他在法庭上被证明无罪，并且获得了损害赔偿金。

examples.translation: 伤害一旦造成，即使是现代外科手术也无法将其完全消除。

examples.translation: 别不当回事，该死！这可不是闹着玩儿的事。

examples.translation: 现在你对此做什么都完全无济于事。

examples.translation: 我们来搞一个超棒的聚会吧。

examples.translation: 她在其中大力鞭挞该极右党派的耸人听闻的书

examples.translation: 谴责巧克力广告企划人员在宣传中以女性为目标人群的一份报告

examples.translation: 那几乎是每个有过生活经历的女人都必须要自己回答的问题。

examples.translation: 她把探戈描述为一种非常性感的舞蹈。

examples.translation: 灯光在水面上摇曳。

examples.text: She tried to read it more slowly and carefully, but the words danced and dissolved before her eyes.
examples.translation: 她试图读得更慢更仔细一些，但那些字却在她眼前跳动而变得模糊起来。

examples.text: My friends endured tremendous danger in order to help me...
examples.translation: 为了帮助我，朋友们冒了极大的危险。

examples.text: His life could be in danger.
examples.translation: 他的生命可能会有危险。

examples.text: ...the dangers of smoking...
examples.translation: 吸烟的危害

examples.text: ...the danger of open conflict...
examples.translation: 公开冲突的危险

examples.text: Britain's roads are a danger to cyclists...
examples.translation: 英国的道路对骑自行车的人来说比较危险。

examples.text: Public health physicians say there are other dangers, too.
examples.translation: 公共保健医生说还有其他危险因素存在。

examples.text: There is a real danger that some people will no longer be able to afford insurance...
examples.translation: 一些人很可能再也负担不起保险了。

examples.text: There was no danger that any of these groups would be elected to power...
examples.translation: 不存在这些团体中的任何一个当选的风险。

examples.text: If there is a danger of famine, we should help.
examples.translation: 如果有可能出现饥荒，我们应该提供帮助。

examples.text: It's a dangerous stretch of road.
examples.translation: 那段路很不安全。

examples.text: ...dangerous drugs...
examples.translation: 危险的毒品

examples.text: It's dangerous to jump to early conclusions.
examples.translation: 过早地下结论可能会带来严重后果。

examples.text: He is dangerously ill...
examples.translation: 他病得很重。

examples.text: He rushed downstairs dangerously fast...
examples.translation: 他以极危险的速度猛冲下楼。

examples.text: The coach rocked dangerously.
examples.translation: 那辆长途汽车危险地颠簸摇晃。

examples.text: Dare sometimes behaves like an ordinary verb, for example ‘He dared to speak’ and ‘He doesn't dare to speak’ and sometimes like a modal, for example ‘He daren't speak’.
examples.translation: dare 有时用作普通动词，如，He dared to speak (他敢讲话）和 He doesn't dare to speak (他不敢讲话);有时又用作情态动词，如，He daren't speak (他不敢讲话)。

examples.text: Most people hate Harry but they don't dare to say so...
examples.translation: 大多数人都对哈里敢怒不敢言。

examples.text: He has also dared to take unpopular, but principled stands at times...
examples.translation: 他有时也会大胆坚持不受欢迎、但却有原则性的立场。

examples.text: We have had problems in our family that I didn't dare tell Uncle.
examples.translation: 我们家里有一些问题我以前不敢告诉叔叔。

examples.text: Dare she risk staying where she was?...
examples.translation: 她还敢冒险呆在原来的地方吗？

examples.text: The government dare not raise interest rates again...
examples.translation: 政府不敢再提高利率。

examples.text: 'Are you coming with me?' — 'I can't, Alice. I daren't.'
examples.translation: “你要和我一起去吗？”——“不行，艾丽斯，我不敢。”

examples.text: Over coffee, she lit a cigarette, her eyes daring him to comment...
examples.translation: 喝咖啡时，她点燃了一支烟，用挑衅的眼神看着他，谅他也不敢吭声。

examples.text: I dare you to sit through forty-five minutes with someone like Vincent!
examples.translation: 我想你绝不敢和文森特这样的人一起坐上 45 分钟！

examples.text: He'd do pretty much anything on a dare...
examples.translation: 别人一激他，他就几乎什么事都做得出来。

examples.text: When found, the children said they'd run away for a dare.
examples.translation: 找到这些孩子时，他们说自己是受了激将才出走的。

examples.text: Don't speak to me like that. Don't you dare...
examples.translation: 不要那样跟我讲话。我不允许！

examples.text: Allen, don't you dare go anywhere else, you hear?
examples.translation: 艾伦，其他地方哪儿都不准去，听到了吗？

examples.text: How dare you pick up the phone and listen in on my conversations!...
examples.translation: 你竟敢拿起电话偷听我的谈话！

examples.text: Suddenly the peace was destroyed by someone shouting, 'Get back! Go away! How dare you!'
examples.translation: 突然平静被打破了，就听见有人在喊：“滚回去！滚开！大胆！”

examples.text: Politicians usually attract younger women, dare I say it, because of the status they have in society.
examples.translation: 恕我直言，由于政客的社会地位，他们通常容易吸引一些年轻的女性。
