examples.translation: 她创造出了一种能令全世界的听众都感到快乐的音乐风格。

examples.text: The report has delighted environmentalists.
examples.translation: 这份报告让环境保护主义者欢欣不已。

examples.text: Generations of adults and children have delighted in the story...
examples.translation: 一代又一代的成年人和儿童都很喜欢这个故事。

examples.text: He delighted in sharing his love of birds with children.
examples.translation: 他喜欢与孩子们分享他对鸟类的热爱。

meanings.meaning: 交付；发表；递送；释放；给予（打击）；给…接生

examples.text: The Canadians plan to deliver more food to southern Somalia...
examples.translation: 加拿大计划向索马里南部地区运送更多的食品。

examples.text: The spy returned to deliver a second batch of classified documents...
examples.translation: 那名间谍返回来递送第二批机密文件。

examples.text: We were told the pizza would be delivered in 20 minutes.
examples.translation: 我们被告知比萨饼 20 分钟后送到。

examples.text: They have yet to show that they can really deliver working technologies...
examples.translation: 他们尚未证明自己真的能够开发出实用技术。

examples.text: ... proving they could deliver the vote in their areas...
examples.translation: 证明他们能够得到自己选区的选票

examples.text: We don't promise what we can't deliver.
examples.translation: 我们承诺的就一定会兑现。

examples.text: Mrs Montgomery was delivered into Mr Hinchcliffe's care...
examples.translation: 蒙哥马利夫人托给了欣奇利夫先生照顾。

examples.text: David delivered Holly gratefully into the woman's outstretched arms...
examples.translation: 戴维非常感激地把霍利送进那个女人张开的双臂中。

examples.text: He was led in in handcuffs and delivered over to me.
examples.translation: 他戴着手铐被带了过来，交到了我手里。

examples.text: The president will deliver a speech about schools...
examples.translation: 总统将就学校问题发表讲话。

examples.text: It is shocking that only one woman has delivered the lecture in 44 years.
examples.translation: 在 44 年间仅有一名女性作过讲座，这真令人震惊。

examples.text: Her husband had to deliver the baby himself.
examples.translation: 她丈夫不得不自己接生孩子。

examples.text: Those blows to the head could have been delivered by a woman.
examples.translation: 头部所受的那些重击有可能出自一个女人之手。

examples.text: I have given thanks to God for delivering me from that pain.
examples.translation: 我感谢上帝把我从那种痛苦中拯救出来。

examples.text: Please allow 28 days for delivery...
examples.translation: 递送将需要 28 天的时间。

examples.text: It is available at £108, including VAT and delivery.
examples.translation: 其价格为 108 英镑，包括增值税和送货费在内。

examples.text: ...the delivery of goods and resources.
examples.translation: 货物和资源的运送

examples.text: I got a delivery of fresh eggs this morning.
examples.translation: 我今天早上收到了送来的新鲜鸡蛋。

examples.text: ...a pizza delivery man.
examples.translation: 比萨饼递送员

examples.text: ...Interflora, the flower delivery service.
examples.translation: 国际花商联盟，鲜花速递服务机构

examples.text: His speeches were magnificently written but his delivery was hopeless.
examples.translation: 他的发言稿写得非常精彩，但他的演讲风格真是无可救药。

examples.text: In the end, it was an easy delivery: a fine baby boy...
examples.translation: 分娩过程最终非常顺利，生了个健康的男婴。

examples.text: Premature birth is three times more likely for twins, and delivery at 36 to 38 weeks is normal.
examples.translation: 双胞胎的早产率要比一般的高出两倍，在36到38周之间分娩很正常。

examples.text: Mr Byers last night demanded an immediate explanation from the Education Secretary...
examples.translation: 昨晚拜尔斯先生要求教育大臣立刻作出解释。

examples.text: Russia demanded that Unita send a delegation to the peace talks...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯要求安盟派代表团参加和谈。

examples.text: The hijackers are demanding to speak to representatives of both governments...
examples.translation: 劫机者要求与两国政府的代表都进行对话。

examples.text: 'What did you expect me to do about it?' she demanded.
examples.translation: “对此你期望我怎么办？”她质问道。

examples.text: He said the task of reconstruction would demand much patience, hard work and sacrifice...
examples.translation: 他说重建任务将需要付出极大的耐心、艰辛和牺牲。

examples.text: There would be fewer international crises demanding his attention...
examples.translation: 需要他去关注的国际危机将会减少。

examples.text: But he could also turn on the style when the occasion demanded.
examples.translation: 但是如果场合需要，他也能拿出派头来。

examples.text: There have been demands for services from tenants up there...
examples.translation: 那里的房客要求提供服务。

examples.text: They consistently rejected the demand to remove US troops...
examples.translation: 他们一再拒绝撤走美国部队的要求。

examples.text: He grew ever more fierce in his demands.
examples.translation: 他的要求变得越来越强硬了。

examples.text: Another flight would be arranged on Saturday if sufficient demand arose...
examples.translation: 如果需求量足够大，周六将再安排一趟航班。

examples.text: Demand for coal is down and so are prices...
examples.translation: 煤的需求下降了，煤价也相应下跌。

examples.text: The demand to see her work is much greater than expected...
examples.translation: 想要参观她作品的人数大大超出了预期。

examples.text: Because of the slump in domestic demand, production has stopped.
examples.translation: 由于国内需求大幅下降，生产已经停止。

examples.text: Researchers wrongly assumed that people were quite clear about the demands of the task.
examples.translation: 研究人员错误地认为大家都很清楚该项任务的要求。

examples.text: ...the demands and challenges of a new job...
examples.translation: 新工作的要求和挑战

examples.text: There were too many other demands on his loyalty now.
examples.translation: 现在还有太多其他的事情也要求他忠心。

examples.text: He was much in demand as a lecturer in the US.
examples.translation: 他的讲座在美国很受欢迎。

examples.text: I had no right to make demands on his time.
examples.translation: 我无权占用他的时间。

examples.text: ...a national commitment to providing treatment on demand for drug abusers.
examples.translation: 承诺在全国范围内为提出请求的吸毒者提供治疗

meanings.meaning: 民主，民主主义；民主政治

examples.text: ...the spread of democracy in Eastern Europe.
examples.translation: 民主制度在东欧的传播

examples.text: ...the pro-democracy movement.
examples.translation: 亲民主运动

examples.text: The new democracies face tough challenges.
examples.translation: 这些新兴的民主国家面临着严峻挑战。

examples.text: ...the union's emphasis on industrial democracy.
examples.translation: 该工会对工业民主的强调

meanings.meaning: 民主的；民主政治的；大众的

examples.text: Bolivia returned to democratic rule in 1982, after a series of military governments.
examples.translation: 在经历了数届军人政府后，玻利维亚于 1982 年恢复了民主政权。

examples.text: ...the country's first democratic elections.
examples.translation: 该国的首次民主选举

examples.text: That June, Yeltsin became Russia's first democratically elected President.
examples.translation: 那年 6月，叶利钦成了俄罗斯首位民选总统。

examples.text: Education is the basis of a democratic society...
examples.translation: 教育是民主社会的基础。

examples.text: He called for widespread changes to make the armed forces more democratic and less expensive.
examples.translation: 他呼吁进行广泛的改革，使武装部队作风更加民主，开支更加俭省。

examples.text: This committee will enable decisions to be made democratically.
examples.translation: 该委员会将实现民主决议过程。

examples.text: ...the Social Democratic Party.
examples.translation: 社会民主党

examples.text: ...the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan...
examples.translation: 阿富汗人民民主党

examples.text: Maxine Waters is a Democratic Congresswoman, representing South Central Los Angeles.
examples.translation: 玛克辛·沃特斯是一名民主党女议员，代表洛杉矶市中南区。

examples.text: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality...
examples.translation: 该研究还表明了肥胖症和死亡率之间存在直接的联系。

examples.text: You have to demonstrate that you are reliable...
examples.translation: 你得证明自己是靠得住的。

examples.text: They are anxious to demonstrate to the voters that they have practical policies...
examples.translation: 他们急于向选民证明自己有切实可行的政策。

examples.text: He's demonstrated how a campaign based on domestic issues can move votes.
examples.translation: 他已证明了基于国内议题的竞选活动是可以拉到选票的。

examples.text: Have they, for example, demonstrated a commitment to democracy?...
examples.translation: 例如，他们是否已表现出会致力于民主？

examples.text: The government's going to great lengths to demonstrate its military might.
examples.translation: 该政府正不遗余力地展示其军事力量。

examples.text: 30,000 angry farmers demonstrated against possible cuts in subsidies...
examples.translation: 3万名愤怒的农场主示威抗议可能对农产品补贴进行的削减。

examples.text: In the cities vast crowds have been demonstrating for change...
examples.translation: 在城市里，大批的人群举行示威游行，要求进行变革。

examples.text: Thousands of people demonstrated outside the parliament building.
examples.translation: 数千人在议会大楼前示威。

examples.text: The BBC has just successfully demonstrated a new digital radio transmission system...
examples.translation: 英国广播公司刚刚成功地演示了一套新的数字无线电传输系统。

examples.text: He flew the prototype to West Raynham to demonstrate it to a group of senior officers...
examples.translation: 他将原型空运到西雷纳姆，向一批高级军官作演示。

examples.text: A style consultant will demonstrate how to dress to impress.
examples.translation: 时尚顾问将示范如何穿着以给人留下深刻印象。

examples.text: Despite official denials, the rumours still persist...
examples.translation: 尽管官方予以否认，但谣言仍未平息。

examples.text: Denial of the Mafia's existence is nothing new.
examples.translation: 否认黑手党的存在并不是什么新鲜事。

examples.text: ...the denial of visas to international relief workers...
examples.translation: 拒绝给国际救援人员发放签证

examples.text: This does not justify the denial of constitutional protection.
examples.translation: 这不能成为剥夺他人受宪法保护权利的正当理由。

examples.text: With major life traumas, like losing a loved one, for instance, the mind's first reaction is denial...
examples.translation: 面对生活中的重大不幸，如失去至爱的人等，人们的第一反应就是拒绝接受。

examples.text: ...an addict who is in denial about his addiction.
examples.translation: 拒不承认自己吸毒成瘾的瘾君子den|ier /'deniə/ Denier is used when indicating the thickness of stockings and tights. 旦尼尔，旦(表示长筒袜、裤袜等纤度的单位)

examples.text: ...fifteen-denier stockings.
examples.translation: 15 旦的长筒袜

examples.text: Red eyes denote strain and fatigue...
examples.translation: 眼睛充血表明压力过大、身心疲惫。

examples.text: There was a message waiting, denoting that someone had been here ahead of her.
examples.translation: 有了一条留言，这表示有人已先于她到了这儿。

examples.text: In figure 24 'D' denotes quantity demanded and 'S' denotes quantity supplied.
examples.translation: 在图 24 中，D 代表需求量而 S 代表供应量。

examples.text: In the Middle Ages the term 'drab' denoted a very simple type of woollen cloth which was used by peasants to make their clothes.
examples.translation: 中世纪时，drab（“本色布”）一词指的是一种农民用来制衣的非常普通的羊毛织物。

meanings.meaning: 谴责；告发；公然抨击；通告废除

examples.text: The letter called for trade union freedom and civil rights, but did not openly denounce the regime...
examples.translation: 这封信呼吁保障工会自由和公民权利，但没有公开谴责该政权。

examples.text: German leaders denounced the attacks and pleaded for tolerance...
examples.translation: 德国领导人谴责袭击活动，恳请各方克制。

examples.text: Some 25,000 demonstrators denounced him as a traitor.
examples.translation: 大约 2.5万名示威者痛斥他是叛徒。

examples.text: ...informers who might denounce you at any moment.
examples.translation: 随时都可能告发你们的那些告密者

examples.text: Where Bucharest now stands, there once was a large, dense forest...
examples.translation: 布加勒斯特的所在地过去曾是一大片茂密的森林。

examples.text: Its fur is short, dense and silky...
examples.translation: 它的毛又短又密，柔软光洁。

examples.text: They thrust their way through the dense crowd.
examples.translation: 他们挤过密集的人群。

examples.text: Java is a densely populated island...
examples.translation: 爪哇岛人口稠密。

examples.text: The fire struck a densely wooded area of Oakland.
examples.translation: 奥克兰一个树木茂密的地区发生了大火。

examples.text: A dense column of smoke rose several miles into the air.
examples.translation: 一股浓烟升到了几英里的高空。

examples.text: ...a small dense star.
examples.translation: 密度很大的小恒星

examples.text: His prose is vigorous and dense, occasionally to the point of obscurity.
examples.translation: 他的散文文笔有力、内容庞杂，有时几近晦涩。

examples.text: He's not a bad man, just a bit dense.
examples.translation: 他人不坏，就是有点儿愚钝。

examples.text: ...a law which restricts the density of housing...
examples.translation: 限制房屋密集程度的法规

examples.text: The region has a very high population density.
examples.translation: 该地区的人口密度很高。

examples.text: ...areas with high densities of immigrant populations.
examples.translation: 移民人口稠密的地区

examples.text: Jupiter's moon Io, whose density is 3.5 grams per cubic centimetre, is all rock.
examples.translation: 密度为每立方厘米 3.5 克的木星卫星木卫一上遍布岩石。

examples.text: You can get free dental treatment.
examples.translation: 你可以得到免费的牙齿治疗。

examples.text: ...the dental profession.
examples.translation: 牙医行业

meanings.meaning: 牙科医生 牙医诊所

examples.text: Visit your dentist twice a year for a check-up.
examples.translation: 每年去牙医处做两次牙齿检查。

examples.text: It's worse than being at the dentist's.
examples.translation: 这比呆在牙科诊所里还要糟糕。

meanings.meaning: 否定，否认；拒绝给予；拒绝…的要求

examples.text: She denied both accusations...
examples.translation: 她对两项指控均予以否认。

examples.text: The government has denied that there was a plot to assassinate the president...
examples.translation: 政府否认曾有人密谋暗杀总统。

examples.text: They all denied ever having seen her.
examples.translation: 他们全都否认曾见过她。

examples.text: I denied my father because I wanted to become someone else.
examples.translation: 我和父亲断绝了关系，因为我想成为一个不一样的自己。

examples.text: If he is unlucky, he may find that his ex-partner denies him access to his children...
examples.translation: 如果不走运的话，他可能会发现前妻拒绝让他接近自己的孩子。

examples.text: Don't deny yourself pleasure...
examples.translation: 不要有乐不享。

examples.text: My mother denied herself for us.
examples.translation: 妈妈为了我们在生活上一贯节制。

meanings.meaning: 离开；出发，起程；违反；去世

examples.text: Our tour departs from Heathrow Airport on 31 March and returns 16 April...
examples.translation: 我们这次旅行于 3月 31 号从希思罗机场出发，4 月 16 号返回。

examples.text: In the morning Mr McDonald departed for Sydney...
examples.translation: 麦克唐纳先生上午启程前往悉尼。

examples.text: The coach departs Potsdam in the morning.
examples.translation: 长途客车早上从波茨坦开出。

examples.text: Why is it in this country that we have departed from good educational sense?...
examples.translation: 为什么在这个国家我们背离了教育上明智的选择？

examples.text: It takes a brave cook to depart radically from the traditional Christmas menu.
examples.translation: 一个厨师要彻底颠覆传统的圣诞节菜肴是需要很大勇气的。

examples.text: Lipton is planning to depart from the company he founded.
examples.translation: 利普顿打算离开他创立的那家公司。

examples.text: ...a number of staff departed during his reign as rector of the Royal College of Art...
examples.translation: 在他担任皇家艺术学院院长期间有好几名教师辞职了。

examples.text: He departed baseball in the '60s.
examples.translation: 他在 20 世纪 60 年代告别了棒球场。

examples.text: He departed this world with a sense of having fulfilled his destiny.
examples.translation: 他带着一种已完成使命的满足感离开了这个世界。

examples.text: ...the U.S. Department of Health, Education and Welfare...
examples.translation: 美国卫生、教育和福利部

examples.text: He moved to the sales department.
examples.translation: 他转到了销售部。

examples.text: ...the geography department of Moscow University.
examples.translation: 莫斯科大学地理系

examples.text: ...the jewelry department.
examples.translation: 珠宝首饰区

examples.text: 'I'm afraid the name means nothing to me,' he said. 'That's not my department.'
examples.translation: “恐怕这个名字对我来说毫无意义，”他说，“我对此并不熟悉。”

examples.text: ...the President's departure for Helsinki...
examples.translation: 总统动身前往赫尔辛基

examples.text: They hoped this would lead to the departure of all foreign forces from the country...
examples.translation: 他们希望这将驱使所有外国部队撤离该国。

examples.text: The airline has more than 90 scheduled departures from here every day.
examples.translation: 该航空公司每天都有 90 多架航班从这里起飞。

examples.text: This would inevitably involve his departure from the post of Prime Minister...
examples.translation: 这将不可避免地导致他辞去首相一职。

examples.text: Reihill's departure from the company is thought to follow disagreements with John Reihill Sr, who now controls the company.
examples.translation: 赖希尔从公司的离职被认为是因为与现在掌管公司的老约翰·赖希尔意见不合。

examples.text: Taylor announced another departure from practice in that England will train at Wembley...
examples.translation: 泰勒再次一改常规地宣布英格兰队将在温布利球场进行训练。

examples.text: Now she's written a novel which is not a mystery and is a considerable departure from her previous work.
examples.translation: 她现在创作了一部非推理小说，与她以前的作品大相径庭。

meanings.meaning: 依赖，依靠；取决于；相信，信赖

examples.text: The cooking time needed depends on the size of the potato...
examples.translation: 所需的烹饪时间取决于土豆的大小。

examples.text: What happened later would depend on his talk with De Solina...
examples.translation: 日后之事将有赖于他与德索利纳的谈话结果。

examples.text: How much it costs depends upon how much you buy.
examples.translation: 价钱取决于你买多买少。

examples.text: They may hate what he does but their survival depends on him...
examples.translation: 他们或许讨厌他的营生，但他们要想活下来必须依靠他。

examples.text: He depended on his writing for his income...
examples.translation: 他靠写作赚取收入。

examples.text: Nora grew accustomed to depending on her husband...
examples.translation: 诺拉变得习惯于依赖丈夫。

examples.text: Choosing the right account depends on working out your likely average balance.
examples.translation: 只有计算出自己可能的平均结余，才能选择合适的账户。

examples.text: 'You can depend on me,' Cross assured him.
examples.translation: “你可以信赖我，”克罗斯向他保证。

examples.text: 'But how long can you stay in the house?' – 'I don't know. It depends.'...
examples.translation: “但你能在这所房子里呆多久呢？”——“我不知道，这要看情况。”

examples.text: It all depends on your definition of punk, doesn't it?
examples.translation: “这全视乎你对朋克摇滚乐的定义，不是吗？”

examples.text: I tend to have a different answer, depending on the family...
examples.translation: 根据家庭的不同，我往往会给出不同的答案。

examples.text: People in the rest of the country celebrated independence even later, depending on when the news of Congress's action reached them.
examples.translation: 该国其他地区的人们庆祝独立的时间甚至更晚，这要取决于有关国会决定的消息何时传到了他们那里。

meanings.meaning: 依靠的；从属的；取决于…的

examples.text: The local economy is overwhelmingly dependent on oil and gas extraction...
examples.translation: 当地经济过于依赖石油和天然气的开采。

examples.text: Up to two million people there are dependent on food aid...
examples.translation: 那里有多达 200 万人口依靠食品援助。

examples.text: Britain became increasingly dependent upon American technology...
examples.translation: 英国变得越来越依赖美国的技术了。

examples.text: In his own way, he was dependent on her...
examples.translation: 他以自己的方式依赖着她。

examples.text: Just 26 per cent of households are married couples with dependent children.
examples.translation: 只有26%的家庭是有孩子要扶养的已婚夫妇。

examples.text: The results you get from weight training are largely dependent upon how you use those weights and what type of exercise programme you follow.
examples.translation: 举重训练的效果在很大程度上取决于如何使用那些举重器械以及遵照何种锻炼方案。

examples.text: The treatment of infertility is largely dependent on the ability of couples to pay.
examples.translation: 对不孕不育的治疗很大程度上视乎夫妇的经济能力。

examples.text: ...a gallery of pictures depicting Nelson's most famous battles.
examples.translation: 描绘纳尔逊指挥的那些最著名战役的一组画作

examples.text: Margaret Atwood's novel depicts a gloomy, futuristic America...
examples.translation: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德的小说描述了一个黑暗无望的未来美国。

examples.text: Children's books often depict farmyard animals as gentle, lovable creatures.
examples.translation: 儿童图书常常把农场的动物描写得温和而可爱。

examples.text: A £50 deposit is required when ordering, and the balance is due upon delivery.
examples.translation: 订货时需要交50英镑的订金，货到后余款结清。

examples.text: It is common to ask for the equivalent of a month's rent as a deposit.
examples.translation: 要求交一个月的房租作押金是很常见的。

examples.text: The Tory candidate lost his deposit.
examples.translation: 这名托利党候选人连竞选保证金都搭进去了。

examples.text: After 10 minutes the surplus material is washed away and any remaining deposit examined with ultra violet light.
examples.translation: 10分钟后剩余的物质被冲洗掉，任何残留的沉淀物则会用紫外线进行检测。

examples.text: ...underground deposits of gold and diamonds.
examples.translation: 地下金矿和金刚石矿

examples.text: ...mineral deposits.
examples.translation: 矿藏

examples.text: Someone was seen depositing a packet...
examples.translation: 有人看见一个人放下了件小包裹。

examples.text: Fritz deposited a glass and two bottles of beer in front of Wolfe...
examples.translation: 弗里茨把一个玻璃杯和两瓶啤酒放在沃尔夫面前。

examples.text: Imagine if you were suddenly swept up and deposited in Morocco. How well could you cope with the language, the weather, the people, and so on?
examples.translation: 设想一下你突然被带走丢到了摩洛哥。你能多好地适应那里的语言、天气和人等等？

examples.text: You are advised to deposit valuables in the hotel safe.
examples.translation: 建议把贵重物品存放在宾馆的保险箱里。

examples.text: The customer has to deposit a minimum of £100 monthly.
examples.translation: 顾客必须每月至少存 100 英镑。

examples.text: The phosphate was deposited by the decay of marine microorganisms.
examples.translation: 海洋微生物腐烂后沉积形成磷酸盐。

examples.text: I must admit the state of the country depresses me...
examples.translation: 我必须承认国家的现状让我倍感沮丧。

examples.text: I know he is too optimistic but I don't want to depress him.
examples.translation: 我知道他太过乐观了，但我不想令他灰心丧气。

examples.text: The stronger U.S. dollar depressed sales.
examples.translation: 美元走强导致销售额下降。

examples.text: The disintegration of the Soviet Union deprived western intelligence agencies of their main enemies...
examples.translation: 苏联解体使西方情报机构丧失了主敌。

examples.text: They've been deprived of the fuel necessary to heat their homes.
examples.translation: 他们没法得到家里取暖所必需的燃料。

examples.text: ...Jack Lang, France's minister for culture, and his deputy, Catherine Tasca.
examples.translation: 法国文化部长杰克·朗和他的副部长凯瑟琳·塔斯卡

examples.text: ...the academy's deputy director, Vladimir Kudryatsev.
examples.translation: 学院副院长弗拉基米尔·库德里亚夫采夫

examples.text: The president appealed to deputies to approve the plan quickly.
examples.translation: 总统呼吁议员尽快通过这一方案。

examples.text: The smaller lake ranges from five to fourteen feet in depth...
examples.translation: 小一些的湖深度从 5 英尺到 14 英尺不等。

examples.text: The depth of the shaft is 520 yards...
examples.translation: 立井的深度为520码。

examples.text: Pour the vegetable oil into a frying pan to a depth of about 1cm...
examples.translation: 往平底煎锅里倒入约1厘米深的植物油。

examples.text: They were detected at depths of more than a kilometre in the sea.
examples.translation: 它们是在海面下超过一公里深的地方被检测出来的。

examples.text: I am well aware of the depth of feeling that exists in Londonderry...
examples.translation: 我很清楚存在于伦敦德里市的那种强烈情绪。

examples.text: 'Tough, isn't it?' was all she said, but Amy felt the depth of her unspoken sympathy.
examples.translation: “很艰难，对不对？”她只说了这一句，但埃米感觉到了她未出口的深切同情。

examples.text: The country's leadership had underestimated the depth of the crisis.
examples.translation: 该国领导人低估了这场危机的严重性。

examples.text: We felt at home with her and were impressed with the depth of her knowledge...
examples.translation: 我们与她在一起很自在，而她渊博的知识令我们叹服。

examples.text: It makes invaluable reading for anyone who wants to acquire a greater depth of understanding of the subject.
examples.translation: 想要对这个问题有更加深入的了解，读读它会受益匪浅。

examples.text: White wines tend to gain depth of colour with age...
examples.translation: 白葡萄酒年头愈久，颜色愈深。

examples.text: The blue base gives the red paint more depth.
examples.translation: 蓝色底色将红色涂料衬托得愈加浓重。

examples.text: All the paintings are startlingly dramatic as a result of their depth of field and colour.
examples.translation: 景深和色彩的运用令所有的画作都展现出令人惊叹的戏剧性效果。

examples.text: His music lacks depth...
examples.translation: 他的音乐缺乏深度。

examples.text: There are hidden depths in all of us.
examples.translation: 我们所有人都有值得认识的深藏部分。

examples.text: The ship vanished into the depths.
examples.translation: 船消失在了大海深处。

examples.text: ...the depths of the countryside...
examples.translation: 乡村腹地

examples.text: Somewhere in the depths of the pine forest an identical sound reverberated.
examples.translation: 从松林深处传来一声回响。

examples.text: I was in the depths of despair when the baby was sick.
examples.translation: 孩子生病时我陷入了绝望的深渊之中。

examples.text: The country is in the depths of a recession.
examples.translation: 该国正遭遇最严重的经济衰退。

examples.text: ...the depths of winter.
examples.translation: 隆冬时节

examples.text: We will discuss these three areas in depth...
examples.translation: 我们将深入探讨这3个领域。

examples.text: Their achievements have already been analysed in depth and do not require further discussion.
examples.translation: 他们的成就已经全面分析过了，无需再议。

examples.text: Mr Gibson is clearly intellectually out of his depth...
examples.translation: 吉布森先生显然才智不逮。

examples.text: I'd always struggled at school. I hated it and felt out of my depth.
examples.translation: 我上学总是很吃力。我讨厌学习，觉得太难了。

examples.text: Mr Ying is one of those happy people who derive pleasure from helping others.
examples.translation: 英先生属于那种助人为乐的快活人。

examples.text: Anna's strength is derived from her parents and her sisters...
examples.translation: 安娜的坚强源自于她的父母和姐姐们。

examples.text: The word Easter derives from Eostre, the pagan goddess of spring.
examples.translation: Easter (复活节)一词由Eostre(多神教的春天女神)衍生而来。

meanings.meaning: 下降；下去；下来；遗传；屈尊

examples.text: Things are cooler and more damp as we descend to the cellar...
examples.translation: 当我们往下走去地窖时，四周愈见阴冷潮湿。

examples.text: She descended one flight of stairs.
examples.translation: 她走下了一段楼梯。

examples.text: An uneasy calm descended on the area...
examples.translation: 一种令人不安的平静笼罩了该地区。

examples.text: A reverent hush descended on the multitude.
examples.translation: 人群虔敬地噤了声。

examples.text: 3,000 city officials descended on Capitol Hill to lobby for more money...
examples.translation: 3,000名市政官员齐聚国会山，为筹集更多的款项进行游说。

examples.text: Curious tourists and reporters from around the globe are descending upon the peaceful villages.
examples.translation: 好奇的游客和记者从世界各地一齐涌向这些平静的村落。

examples.text: Darkness has now descended and the moon and stars shine hazily in the clear sky.
examples.translation: 夜幕现在已经降临，晴朗的天空里月影婆娑，星光朦胧。

examples.text: We're not going to descend to such methods...
examples.translation: 我们不会沦落到使用这种手段。

examples.text: She's got too much dignity to descend to writing anonymous letters.
examples.translation: 她是个自尊心很强的人，绝不会自贬身份去写匿名信。

examples.text: He was ultimately overthrown and the country descended into chaos.
examples.translation: 他最终被推翻，整个国家则陷入了混乱。

examples.text: They are descendants of the original English and Scottish settlers.
examples.translation: 他们是最初的英格兰和苏格兰定居者的后代。

examples.text: ...Lord Cochrane and his descendants.
examples.translation: 科克伦勋爵及其后裔

examples.text: His design was a descendant of a 1956 device...
examples.translation: 他的设计是从一个 1956 年的装置衍生而来的。

examples.text: They are the descendants of plants imported by the early settlers.
examples.translation: 它们是早期移民带来的一些植物的后代。

meanings.meaning: 除去…的气味；使…失去香味

examples.text: Sixteen of the youngsters set off for help, but during the descent three collapsed in the cold and rain.
examples.translation: 16 名年轻人出发去寻求帮助，但在下山过程中有 3 人因寒冷和大雨晕倒了。

examples.text: ...the crash of an Airbus A300 on its descent into Kathmandu airport.
examples.translation: 空客 A300 在加德满都机场降落时的坠毁

examples.text: On the descents, cyclists spin past cars, freewheeling downhill at tremendous speed.
examples.translation: 在坡道上，自行车手飞驰着超越了一辆辆汽车，靠着惯性一路疾冲下山。

examples.text: The only lasting solution lies in a political settlement. Without it, their descent into chaos will be guaranteed.
examples.translation: 唯一的长久之计是通过政治手段解决。否则，他们势必会陷入一片混乱。

examples.text: ...his swift descent from respected academic to struggling small businessman.
examples.translation: 他从一名受人尊敬的学者到一个度日艰难的小商人的瞬间沦落

examples.text: All the contributors were of African descent.
examples.translation: 所有的撰稿人都是非裔人士。

examples.text: We asked her to describe what kind of things she did in her spare time...
examples.translation: 我们请她描述一下她业余时间都在做什么。

examples.text: She broke down describing how she was arrested for refusing a breath test...
examples.translation: 她在叙述自己如何因为拒绝接受呼吸测试而被捕时再也控制不住情绪。

examples.text: She read a poem by Carver which describes their life together...
examples.translation: 她读了一首卡弗描写他们共同生活的诗。

examples.text: The myth of Narcissus is described in Ovid's work...
examples.translation: 有关那喀索斯的神话故事在奥维德的作品中有过描述。

examples.text: Just before his death he described seeing their son in a beautiful garden.
examples.translation: 就在临终前他说看到他们的儿子在一个美丽的花园里。

examples.text: He described it as an extraordinarily tangled and complicated tale...
examples.translation: 他说那是一个非常曲折复杂的故事。

examples.text: Eriksson described him as 'the best player on the pitch'...
examples.translation: 埃里克森称他是“场上最好的球员”。

examples.text: Andrew describes her as a large, bony and masculine woman...
examples.translation: 安德鲁说她是一个瘦骨嶙峋、男人模样的大块头女人。

examples.text: Even his closest allies describe him as forceful, aggressive and determined...
examples.translation: 即使他最亲密的盟友也认为他强硬决断、咄咄逼人，不达目的誓不罢休。

examples.text: He described the meeting as marking a new stage in the peace process.
examples.translation: 他称这次会议标志着和平进程进入了一个新阶段。

examples.text: His pass described a perfect arc through the leaden sky.
examples.translation: 他的传球在阴沉的天空中划出了一道完美的弧线。

examples.text: Police have issued a description of the man who was aged between fifty and sixty...
examples.translation: 警方已经发布了那名年龄在 50 到 60 岁之间的男子的相貌特征通告。

examples.text: ...a detailed description of the movements and battle plans of Italy's fleet...
examples.translation: 有关意大利舰队的行动和作战计划的详细说明

examples.text: He has a real gift for vivid description.
examples.translation: 他很善于描述，说起事情来活灵活现的。

examples.text: ...the oldest Catholic church of any description in England...
examples.translation: 英国所有天主教堂中最古老的一座

examples.text: Events of this description occurred daily.
examples.translation: 这类事件天天发生。

examples.text: His face is weary beyond description...
examples.translation: 他一脸难以形容的疲惫。

examples.text: We were in a disaster situation that defies description.
examples.translation: 我们陷入了难以言表的糟糕处境。

examples.text: ...the Sahara Desert.
examples.translation: 撒哈拉大沙漠

examples.text: ...the burning desert sun...
examples.translation: 沙漠中火辣辣的太阳

examples.text: The vehicles have been modified to suit conditions in the desert.
examples.translation: 车辆已改装过以适应沙漠的环境。

examples.text: They live in 12 high-rise apartment buildings that sit in a desert of concrete...
examples.translation: 他们居住的地方是坐落于一片钢筋水泥丛林中的12栋高层公寓楼。

examples.text: Pubs are a cultural desert.
examples.translation: 酒馆是文化沙漠。

examples.text: Farmers are deserting their fields and coming here looking for jobs...
examples.translation: 小农场主正舍弃他们的土地，到这里来寻找工作。

examples.text: After the show, the audience deserts the Blackpool streets.
examples.translation: 演出结束后，观众从布莱克浦的大街上消失了踪迹。

examples.text: They went off to swim in the pool, which was now deserted...
examples.translation: 他们去一个已废弃的游泳池游泳。

examples.text: She led them into a deserted sidestreet.
examples.translation: 她带着他们走进一条空寂无人的小巷。

examples.text: Mrs Roding's husband deserted her years ago...
examples.translation: 罗丁太太的丈夫数年前抛弃了她。

examples.text: He has been deserted by most of his advisers.
examples.translation: 他的大多数顾问都弃他而去。

examples.text: ...her father's desertion.
examples.translation: 她父亲的抛家弃子

examples.text: The paper's price rise will encourage readers to desert in even greater numbers...
examples.translation: 报纸价格的上涨将导致更多的读者不再订阅。

examples.text: He was pained to see many youngsters deserting kibbutz life...
examples.translation: 看到那么多的年轻人放弃了合作农场的生活，他感到很痛心。

examples.text: Spaniards are worried about German investors deserting Spain for Eastern Europe.
examples.translation: 西班牙人担心德国投资者放弃西班牙而转向东欧。

examples.text: ...a mass desertion of the Party by the electorate.
examples.translation: 大批选民抛弃了该党

examples.text: ...possible further desertions from the party at its conference.
examples.translation: 在其大会上可能发生的更多的退党

examples.text: Even when he appeared to be depressed, a dry sense of humour never deserted him...
examples.translation: 即使在他看上去很沮丧的时候，他也从没有丧失过自己的冷面幽默。

examples.text: She lost the next five games, and the set, as her confidence abruptly deserted her.
examples.translation: 她突然自信心全失，接下来连败 5 局，并最终丢了这一盘。

examples.text: He was a second-lieutenant in the army until he deserted...
examples.translation: 他在擅离部队之前是一名陆军少尉。

examples.text: He deserted from army intelligence last month...
examples.translation: 上个月他从陆军情报机关开小差跑了。

examples.text: Young workers are more willing to desert jobs they don't like.
examples.translation: 年轻职工对不喜欢的工作更易擅自离职。

examples.text: The high rate of desertion has added to the army's woes...
examples.translation: 高逃兵率更使部队雪上加霜。

examples.text: There were a growing number of desertions from the federal army.
examples.translation: 联邦部队中出现越来越多的开小差现象。

examples.text: At the end of the book the child's true identity is discovered, and the bad guys get their just deserts.
examples.translation: 在书的结尾，那个孩子的真实身份大白于世，坏人则得到了应有的惩罚。

examples.text: Government officials clearly deserve some of the blame as well...
examples.translation: 政府官员显然也应当承担部分责任。

examples.text: They know the sport inside out, and we treat them with the respect they deserve...
examples.translation: 他们对这项体育运动了如指掌，我们也给予了他们应有的尊重。

examples.text: These people deserve to make more than the minimum wage...
examples.translation: 这些人应该得到比最低工资更高的报酬。

examples.text: His children's books are classics that deserve to be much better known...
examples.translation: 他的儿童书非常经典，应该为更多人所知晓。

examples.text: I felt I deserved better than that...
examples.translation: 我觉得自己不应受到那样的对待。

examples.text: The Park Hotel has a well-deserved reputation.
examples.translation: 帕克旅馆的名声当之无愧。

examples.text: One of them said the two dead joy riders got what they deserved.
examples.translation: 他们中的一个人说这两名开偷来的车去兜风的人死得活该。

examples.text: They wanted to design a machine that was both attractive and practical.
examples.translation: 他们想设计一种既美观又实用的机械。

examples.text: ...men wearing specially designed boots.
examples.translation: 脚踏特制皮靴的男子

examples.text: We may be able to design a course to suit your particular needs...
examples.translation: 我们或许可以专门设计一门课程以满足你的特殊需求。

examples.text: Computer security systems will be designed by independent technicians...
examples.translation: 计算机安全系统将由独立的技师来设计。

examples.text: A number of very well designed studies have been undertaken.
examples.translation: 已经进行了多项精心规划的研究。

examples.text: He was a born mechanic with a flair for design...
examples.translation: 他生来就是个有设计天赋的机械师。

examples.text: Most mobile robots are still in the design stage...
examples.translation: 大多数移动机器人仍处在设计阶段。

examples.text: She came to London in 1960 to study fashion design.
examples.translation: 她1960年来到伦敦学习时装设计。

examples.text: These machines are constantly updated by improving the design of the computers.
examples.translation: 通过改善计算机的设计，这些机器不断得到更新。

examples.text: ...a new design of clock...
examples.translation: 新款时钟

examples.text: The shoes were of good design and good quality...
examples.translation: 这些鞋样式新颖，质量上乘。

examples.text: BMW is recalling 8,000 cars because of a design fault.
examples.translation: 因为发现了一个设计缺陷，宝马正在召回已卖出的 8,000 辆汽车。

examples.text: They drew up the design for the house in a week.
examples.translation: 他们在一周内就画出了房子的图样。

examples.text: Their range of tableware is decorated with a blackberry design...
examples.translation: 他们的整套餐具上都饰有黑莓图案。

examples.text: Many pictures have been based on simple geometric designs.
examples.translation: 许多画都是基于简单的几何图案。

examples.text: Is there some design in having him in the middle?...
examples.translation: 让他呆在中间是不是有什么目的？

examples.text: The intelligence service conceived a grand design to assassinate the War Minister.
examples.translation: 情报机构策划了一项暗杀陆军部长的重大计划。

examples.text: This project is designed to help landless people...
examples.translation: 这一项目旨在帮助那些没有土地的人。

examples.text: It's not designed for anyone under age eighteen.
examples.translation: 它不是为18岁以下者设计的。

examples.text: The pair met often — at first by chance but later by design.
examples.translation: 这两个人经常见面——开始是偶然的，后来就是有意的了。

examples.text: His colonel had designs on his wife...
examples.translation: 他的上校在打他妻子的主意。

examples.text: Greece has always stressed that it had no designs on the territory.
examples.translation: 希腊一直强调它对这片领土没有任何企图。

meanings.meaning: 指定；指派；标出；把…定名为

examples.text: ...a man interviewed in one of our studies whom we shall designate as E...
examples.translation: 在我们的一项研究中接受访谈的男子，我们称之为 E

examples.text: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark...
examples.translation: 人们正在努力将这座桥定为历史遗迹。

examples.text: I live in Exmoor, which is designated as a national park.
examples.translation: 我住在埃克斯穆尔，那里已被命名为国家公园。

examples.text: Some of the rooms were designated as offices.
examples.translation: 其中一些房间被指定用作办公室。

examples.text: ...scholarships designated for minorities...
examples.translation: 专门给予少数族裔学生的奖学金

examples.text: Smoking is allowed in designated areas.
examples.translation: 允许在指定区域内吸烟。

examples.text: Designate someone as the spokesperson...
examples.translation: 指派某人为发言人

examples.text: The President's designated successor is his son.
examples.translation: 总统的选定继承人是他的儿子。

examples.text: Japan's Prime Minister-designate is completing his Cabinet today.
examples.translation: 日本的当选首相今日将完成组阁。

examples.text: Prolonged negotiation was not desirable...
examples.translation: 拖长了的谈判并不是大家所想要的。

examples.text: The crowd moved indoors for what were deemed the most desirable items.
examples.translation: 人群为了被视为最值得拥有的物品涌入屋里。

examples.text: ...the desirability of democratic reform.
examples.translation: 民主改革的好处

examples.text: ...the debate on the desirability of banning the ivory trade.
examples.translation: 关于禁止象牙贸易是否可取的辩论

examples.text: ...the young women whom his classmates thought most desirable.
examples.translation: 他的同班同学认为最性感的年轻女子

examples.text: ...Veronica's desirability.
examples.translation: 韦罗妮卡的妩媚动人

examples.text: I had a strong desire to help and care for people...
examples.translation: 我非常渴望能够帮助和照顾他人。

examples.text: They seem to have lost their desire for life.
examples.translation: 他们似乎已丧失了对生活的热望。

examples.text: She had remarried and desired a child with her new husband...
examples.translation: 她又结婚了，并且渴望和新任丈夫生个小孩。

examples.text: But Fred was bored and desired to go home...
examples.translation: 但弗雷德觉得很无聊，想要回家。

examples.text: He desired me to inform her that he had made his peace with God.
examples.translation: 他想让我告诉她他已接受了上天的安排，获得了心灵的安宁。

examples.text: You may find that just threatening this course of action will produce the desired effect...
examples.translation: 你会发现只要威胁说将会采取这一行动就能取得预期的效果。

examples.text: His warnings have provoked the desired response.
examples.translation: 他的警告引起了预想的反应。

examples.text: Teenage sex, for instance, may come not out of genuine desire but from a need to get love.
examples.translation: 例如，青少年的性行为可能并不是源于真正的情欲，而是出于一种对爱的需要。

examples.text: It never occurred to him that she might not desire him.
examples.translation: 他从没有想过她可能不想跟他上床。

examples.text: Additional courses may be taken if desired...
examples.translation: 如有需要可选修额外的课程。

examples.text: Transfer this sauce to a separate saucepan, if desired.
examples.translation: 如果愿意的话，可以把这些调味汁倒入一只单独的长柄锅里。

examples.text: He was extremely devious in his efforts to achieve his heart's desire.
examples.translation: 他在设法得到自己的中意之物时会不择手段。

examples.text: The selection of TV programmes, especially at the weekend, leaves a lot to be desired...
examples.translation: 可供选择的电视节目，尤其是在周末的时候，还有大幅提升的空间。

examples.text: Food seems to have been available, even if the quality left much to be desired...
examples.translation: 食品似乎能够买到了，虽然质量还远不尽如人意。

examples.text: It is just possible that the accuracy of the information provided might leave something to be desired.
examples.translation: 很有可能所提供信息的准确性还不够高。

meanings.meaning: 办公桌；服务台；编辑部；（美）讲道台；乐谱架
书桌的；桌上用的；伏案做的

examples.text: I spoke to the girl on the reception desk...
examples.translation: 我跟服务台的女孩说了一下。

examples.text: A map and a bird-watchers' field checklist are available at the front desk.
examples.translation: 前台有地图和观鸟地点一览表可供拿取。

examples.text: ...the main information desk.
examples.translation: 主问询台

examples.text: Let our news desk know as quickly as possible on 414 3926...
examples.translation: 请尽快拨打电话 4143926 通知我们的新闻部。

examples.text: Over now to Simon Ingram at the sports desk.
examples.translation: 现在交给体育组的西蒙·英格拉姆。

examples.text: ...a desolate landscape of flat green fields broken by marsh...
examples.translation: 平坦绿野被沼泽割裂开的荒凉景色

examples.text: Half-ruined, hardly a building untouched, it's a desolate place.
examples.translation: 这里大半遭毁，几乎没有一栋建筑完好无损，变成了一块荒废之地。

examples.text: He was desolate without her.
examples.translation: 没有她，他感到孤独而凄凉。

examples.text: Their inclination to wait and demand more resources desolated President Lincoln.
examples.translation: 他们总是等待并要求得到更多资财的倾向让林肯总统甚感不快。

examples.text: I saw them walk away and felt absolutely desolated.
examples.translation: 我看到他们走开了，感到万分悲凉。

examples.text: They have maintained their optimism in the face of desolating subjugation.
examples.translation: 面对遭征服的悲惨命运，他们保持了乐观的态度。

meanings.meaning: 绝望；令人绝望的人或事

examples.text: I looked at my wife in despair...
examples.translation: 我绝望地看着妻子。

examples.text: ...feelings of despair or inadequacy.
examples.translation: 绝望或无能的感觉

examples.text: 'Oh, I despair sometimes,' he says in mock sorrow...
examples.translation: “啊，我有时会感到绝望，”他假装悲伤地说。

examples.text: He does despair at much of the press criticism.
examples.translation: 面对媒体的诸多批评他的确感到绝望。

examples.text: He wished to earn a living through writing but despaired of doing so.
examples.translation: 他想通过写作来谋生，不过他对此不抱希望。

examples.text: ...efforts to find homes for people despairing of ever having a roof over their heads...
examples.translation: 为那些对有瓦遮头不再抱有任何希望的人们找到住处的努力

examples.text: There are signs that many voters have already despaired of politicians.
examples.translation: 有迹象表明许多选民对政客已经不抱希望。

examples.text: Miller kept cool amid the heated exchange to despatch the resulting 34th-minute penalty past Langfield.

meanings.meaning: 不顾一切的；令人绝望的；极度渴望的

examples.text: Troops are needed to help get food into Kosovo where people are in desperate need...
examples.translation: 需要军队帮助将科索沃人民亟需的食品送抵那里。

examples.text: Desperate with anxiety, Bob and Hans searched the whole house...
examples.translation: 焦急万分的鲍勃和汉斯把整座房子找了个遍。

examples.text: He made a desperate attempt to hijack a plane.
examples.translation: 他铤而走险，企图劫持一架飞机。

examples.text: Thousands are desperately trying to leave their battered homes.
examples.translation: 成千上万的人不顾一切地想要离开他们千疮百孔的家园。

examples.text: They'd been married nearly four years and June was desperate to start a family...
examples.translation: 他们结婚已快4年了，琼非常渴望要个孩子。

examples.text: People are desperate for him to do something.
examples.translation: 人们极希望他能做点什么。

examples.text: He was a boy who desperately needed affection.
examples.translation: 他是一个极需要关爱的男孩。

examples.text: India's United Nations ambassador said the situation is desperate...
examples.translation: 印度驻联合国大使说形势非常危急。

examples.text: I decided not to abandon John when he was in such a desperate position.
examples.translation: 我决定不在约翰走投无路的时候抛弃他。

examples.text: I can never, ever forgive him. I despise him...
examples.translation: 我永远不会原谅他。我鄙视他。

examples.text: She secretly despises his work...
examples.translation: 她暗地里瞧不起他的工作。

examples.text: How I despised myself for my cowardice!
examples.translation: 我是多么鄙视自己的怯懦啊！

examples.text: Despite a thorough investigation, no trace of Dr Southwell has been found...
examples.translation: 尽管进行了彻底的调查，还是没有发现索思韦尔博士的任何踪迹。

examples.text: The National Health Service has visibly deteriorated, despite increased spending...
examples.translation: 尽管支出在增加，但国民医疗保健服务的质量却明显下降了。

examples.text: He was obviously distressed despite being unconscious...
examples.translation: 虽然他自己未发觉，但他显然很忧心。

examples.text: She will stand by husband, despite reports that he sent another woman love notes.
examples.translation: 尽管有报道说她丈夫曾给另一个女人写求爱信，但她还是会支持他。

examples.text: Despite myself, Harry's remarks had caused me to stop and reflect.
examples.translation: 哈里的话让我不由自主地停下来细想。

examples.text: She had homemade ice cream for dessert...
examples.translation: 她用自制的冰激凌作饭后甜点。

examples.text: I am partial to desserts that combine fresh fruit with fine pastry.
examples.translation: 我偏爱加有新鲜水果的精致油酥甜点。

examples.text: Spain is still our most popular holiday destination...
examples.translation: 西班牙仍是我们最喜爱的度假去处。

examples.text: Only half of the emergency supplies have reached their destination.
examples.translation: 仅有一半的紧急救援物资运抵了目的地。

meanings.meaning: (Destiny)人名；(英)德斯蒂尼，德斯蒂妮(女名)

examples.text: We are masters of our own destiny...
examples.translation: 我们是自己命运的主宰者。

examples.text: It is my destiny one day to be king.
examples.translation: 我命中注定有一天要成为国王。

examples.text: Is it destiny that brings people together, or is it accident?
examples.translation: 人们的相遇是天意还是偶然？

examples.text: That's a sure recipe for destroying the economy and creating chaos...
examples.translation: 那样做肯定会破坏经济、制造混乱。

examples.text: No one was injured in the explosion, but the building was completely destroyed...
examples.translation: 没有人在爆炸中受伤，但大楼遭到了彻底毁坏。

examples.text: Even the most gifted can have confidence destroyed by the wrong instructor.
examples.translation: 即使是最有天赋的人也可能会被错误的导师摧毁自信。

examples.text: If I was younger or more naive, the criticism would have destroyed me.
examples.translation: 如果我再年轻一些，或是再单纯一些，那些批评可能就会把我给毁了。

examples.text: Lindsay was unhurt but the horse had to be destroyed.
examples.translation: 林赛没有受伤，但那匹马却不得不被人道毁灭。

examples.text: ...an international agreement aimed at halting the destruction of the ozone layer.
examples.translation: 一项旨在阻止臭氧层破坏的国际协议

examples.text: ...weapons of mass destruction.
examples.translation: 大规模杀伤性武器

meanings.meaning: 破坏的；毁灭性的；有害的，消极的

examples.text: ...the awesome destructive power of nuclear weapons...
examples.translation: 核武器可怕的毁灭性力量

examples.text: Guilt can be very destructive.
examples.translation: 负疚感会具有很强的杀伤力。

examples.text: ...the size of armies and the destructiveness of their weapons.
examples.translation: 军队规模及其武器的杀伤力

examples.text: Power can be used creatively or destructively.
examples.translation: 权力可以得到创造性的运用，也可以带来毁灭性的结果。

examples.text: Detach the white part of the application form and keep it...
examples.translation: 把申请表的白色部分撕下存底。

examples.text: It is easy to detach the currants from the stems...
examples.translation: 很容易就能把醋栗从梗上摘下来。

examples.text: There was an accident when the towrope detached from the car.
examples.translation: 当拖绳从车子上脱落时发生了事故。

examples.text: It helps them detach themselves from their problems and become more objective.
examples.translation: 这有助于他们从所面临的问题中跳出来，变得更客观一些。

examples.text: Alexis saw his father detach himself from the group and walk away down the hill by himself.
examples.translation: 亚历克西斯看到父亲离开那一群人，独自走下山去了。

examples.text: The details of the plan are still being worked out...
examples.translation: 计划的细节仍在制订中。

examples.text: No details of the discussions have been given...
examples.translation: 没有透露讨论的细节。

examples.text: I recall every detail of the party.
examples.translation: 我回想起聚会的每一个细节。

examples.text: See the bottom of this page for details of how to apply for this exciting offer...
examples.translation: 有关如何申请这一令人兴奋的工作的详情请参见本页底部。

examples.text: Full details will be announced soon.
examples.translation: 具体信息很快就会公布。

examples.text: Only minor details now remain to be settled.
examples.translation: 现在仅剩一些细枝末节的问题需要解决。

examples.text: We like his attention to detail and his enthusiasm.
examples.translation: 我们喜欢他的细心和热情。

examples.text: The report detailed the human rights abuses committed during the war.
examples.translation: 这份报告详述了战争期间所发生的践踏人权的情况。

examples.translation: 他派了一名警察把它送到重案调查室。

examples.translation: 他说曾去过英国的许多地方，但没有细讲。

examples.translation: 他们俩都没准备要详细说明他们会谈的情况。

examples.translation: 我们彻底仔细地检查了措词后才最终定稿。

examples.text: The act allows police to detain a suspect for up to 48 hours...
examples.translation: 该法令允许警方将嫌疑犯扣押最多48小时。

examples.text: He was arrested and detained for questioning.
examples.translation: 他遭到逮捕、拘留以接受问讯。

examples.text: Thank you. We won't detain you any further.
examples.translation: 非常感谢。我们就不再耽搁您的时间了。

examples.text: ...a sensitive piece of equipment used to detect radiation...
examples.translation: 一件用于探测辐射的灵敏设备

examples.text: Most skin cancers can be cured if detected and treated early...
examples.translation: 如果早发现早治疗，大多数皮肤癌是可以治愈的。

examples.text: ...a device which can detect who is more at risk of a heart attack.
examples.translation: 可以查出心脏病发作概率的仪器

examples.text: Arnold could detect a certain sadness in the old man's face.
examples.translation: 阿诺德能觉察到老人脸上的一丝悲伤。

examples.text: Detectives are appealing for witnesses who may have seen anything suspicious...
examples.translation: 探员呼吁看到任何可疑情况的人进行举报。

examples.text: She hired a private detective in an attempt to find her daughter.
examples.translation: 她雇了一名私人侦探，试图找到自己的女儿。

examples.text: ...Detective Inspector Ian Mosley.
examples.translation: 伊恩·莫斯利探长

examples.text: ..Detective Nardosa of the New York City Police Department.
examples.translation: 纽约市警察局的纳尔多萨警探

examples.text: Despite careful detective work, many items have never been recovered.
examples.translation: 尽管进行了悉心探查，许多物品还是一直没有找回。

meanings.meaning: 探测器；检测器；发现者；侦察器

examples.text: ...a metal detector.
examples.translation: 金属探测器

examples.text: ...fire alarms and smoke detectors.
examples.translation: 火警报警器和烟雾检测器

examples.text: There are fears that the situation might deteriorate into full-scale war...
examples.translation: 人们担心形势可能恶化而演变成一场全面战争。

examples.text: The weather conditions are deteriorating...
examples.translation: 天气变得越来越糟。

examples.text: Grant's health steadily deteriorated.
examples.translation: 格兰特的健康状况持续恶化。

examples.text: ...concern about the rapid deterioration in relations between the two countries.
examples.translation: 对两国关系迅速恶化的担忧

examples.text: ...the slow steady deterioration of a patient with Alzheimer's disease.
examples.translation: 一名阿尔茨海默病患者病情的持续缓慢恶化

确定；决定；判决，终止；[主用于法律]了结，终止，结束

examples.text: The size of the chicken pieces will determine the cooking time...
examples.translation: 鸡块的大小将决定烹饪时间的长短。

examples.text: Social status is largely determined by the occupation of the main breadwinner...
examples.translation: 社会地位很大程度上是由家里经济支柱的职业决定的。

examples.text: What determines whether you are a career success or a failure?
examples.translation: 事业的成败取决于哪些因素？

examples.text: ...the gene which is responsible for male sex determination.
examples.translation: 决定男性性别的基因

examples.text: The investigation will determine what really happened...
examples.translation: 调查会查明到底发生了什么事情。

examples.text: Testing needs to be done to determine the long-term effects on humans...
examples.translation: 需要进行检测以确定其对人的长期影响。

examples.text: Science has determined that the risk is very small.
examples.translation: 科学已经探明其危险性非常小。

examples.text: The Baltic people have a right to determine their own future...
examples.translation: 波罗的海各国人民有权决定自己的未来。

examples.text: The final wording had not yet been determined...
examples.translation: 最终措辞仍未敲定。

examples.text: My aim was first of all to determine what I should do next.
examples.translation: 我的目标首先是要确定自己下一步该做什么。

examples.text: We must take into our own hands the determination of our future.
examples.translation: 我们必须将未来的决定权掌握在自己的手中。

examples.text: He determined to rescue his two countrymen...
examples.translation: 他决意营救自己的两名同胞。

examples.text: I determined that I would ask him outright.
examples.translation: 我下定决心要直截了当地问他。

examples.text: They stopped you as soon as you deviated from the script...
examples.translation: 一旦你偏离了剧本的内容，他们就会喊停。

examples.text: He planned his schedule far in advance, and he didn't deviate from it...
examples.translation: 他提前很早就制订出了自己的进度表，然后从未偏离过它。

examples.text: From very early on he believed a military revolution was necessary and he has never deviated from that ideological path.
examples.translation: 他一早就认为军事革命是必要的，并且从未背离过这一思想路线。

meanings.meaning: 开发；进步；使成长；使显影

examples.text: As children develop, some of the most important things they learn have to do with their sense of self...
examples.translation: 在成长过程中，孩子学到的一些最重要的东西与他们的自我意识有关。

examples.text: It's hard to say at this stage how the market will develop...
examples.translation: 在现阶段，很难说市场将会如何发展。

examples.text: These clashes could develop into open warfare...
examples.translation: 这些冲突可能会发展成为公开的战争。

examples.text: Society begins to have an impact on the developing child.
examples.translation: 社会开始对成长中的孩子产生影响。

examples.text: Their bodies were well-developed and super fit.
examples.translation: 他们的身体发育得很好，非常健壮。

examples.text: A huge row has developed about the pollution emanating from a chemical plant.
examples.translation: 一家化工厂造成的污染已经引发了激烈争论。

examples.text: ...blood clots in his lungs, a problem which developed from a leg injury.
examples.translation: 由腿伤引起的他肺部的血块

examples.text: All countries, it was predicted, would develop and develop fast.
examples.translation: 据预测，所有国家都会实现发展而且发展速度会很快。

examples.text: She won a grant to develop her own business...
examples.translation: 她赢得了一笔拨款，用以扩展自己的企业。

examples.text: Over the last few years tourism here has developed considerably.
examples.translation: 在过去几年里，这里的旅游业获得了相当大的发展。

examples.text: Housing finance is less developed in continental Europe.
examples.translation: 住房金融业在欧洲大陆的发展程度较低。

examples.text: Entrepreneurs developed fashionable restaurants and bars in the area.
examples.translation: 实业家在这一地区建起了许多时尚的餐馆和酒吧。

examples.text: ...the cost of acquiring or developing property.
examples.translation: 获得或开发地产的成本

examples.text: Developed land was to grow from 5.3% to 6.9%.
examples.translation: 已开发土地的面积将从 5.3% 增加到 6.9%。

examples.text: She later developed a taste for expensive nightclubs...
examples.translation: 她后来逐渐变得喜欢去消费高昂的夜总会。

examples.text: Mr Robinson has developed the reputation of a ruthless cost-cutter.
examples.translation: 大家都知道鲁宾逊先生在降低成本上毫不手软。

examples.text: Now you have an opportunity to develop a greater understanding of each other...
examples.translation: 现在你们有一个好机会，可以大大增进对彼此的了解。

examples.text: ...weekly workshops that are designed to develop acting and theatre skills...
examples.translation: 为了提高表演和舞台技巧而设的每周一次的培训班

examples.text: We must develop closer ties with Germany...
examples.translation: 我们必须与德国建立更为密切的关系。

examples.text: Their friendship developed through their shared interest in the Arts.
examples.translation: 对艺术的共同爱好加深了他们之间的友谊。

examples.text: ...a highly developed instinct for self-preservation.
examples.translation: 很强的自我保护意识

examples.text: The test should identify which smokers are most prone to develop lung cancer...
examples.translation: 这项检查应该可以确认哪些吸烟者更容易得肺癌。

examples.text: A sharp ache developed in her back muscles.
examples.translation: 她后背的肌肉疼得厉害。

examples.text: The aircraft made an unscheduled landing after developing an electrical fault.
examples.translation: 飞机由于发生电力故障而作了临时降落。

examples.text: He claims that several countries have developed nuclear weapons secretly.
examples.translation: 他声称有几个国家已经秘密研制出了核武器。

examples.text: ...a computer system specially developed for the Coastguard service.
examples.translation: 专为海岸警卫队研发的计算机系统

examples.text: I would like to thank them for allowing me to develop their original idea...
examples.translation: 我想感谢他们允许我深入完善他们最初的想法。

examples.text: This point is developed further at the end of this chapter...
examples.translation: 这一点在本章结尾处有进一步阐释。

examples.text: The idea of weather forecasting developed incredibly quickly.
examples.translation: 天气预报概念的发展速度快得令人难以置信。

examples.text: ...after developing one roll of film.
examples.translation: 冲洗了一卷胶卷后

examples.text: ...an electronic device that protects your vehicle 24 hours a day.
examples.translation: 24小时保护车辆的电子装置

examples.text: ...a device that could measure minute quantities of matter...
examples.translation: 能够测量微量物质的设备

examples.text: We believe that an explosive device had been left inside a container.
examples.translation: 我们认为有一个爆炸装置被留在了一只集装箱里。

examples.text: They claim that military spending is used as a device for managing the economy.
examples.translation: 他们声称军费开支是用来作为调控经济的手段的。

examples.text: ...the literary device of the metaphor.
examples.translation: 隐喻的文学手法

examples.text: Left to his own devices, Osborn is a fluent — and often original — guitarist.
examples.translation: 任其自由发挥时，奥斯本是一个弹奏流畅、常常富有创意的吉他手。

meanings.meaning: 魔鬼；撒旦；家伙；恶棍；淘气鬼；冒失鬼

examples.text: ...the idea of angels with wings and devils with horns and hoofs.
examples.translation: 天使长着翅膀、魔鬼长着角和蹄这样的观念

examples.text: I felt sorry for Blake, poor devil...
examples.translation: 我替布莱克感到难过，这个可怜的家伙。

examples.text: Manfred, you're a suspicious old devil...
examples.translation: 曼弗雷德，你是个可疑的老家伙。

examples.text: Susie, you're a determined little devil.
examples.translation: 苏茜，你真是个坚决的小家伙。

examples.text: 'I think he was a bit of a devil,' Constance said.
examples.translation: “我想他有点儿淘气，”康斯坦丝说道。

examples.text: He was always a devil of a nuisance...
examples.translation: 他总是极讨人厌。

examples.text: It's a devil of a tricky problem,isn't it?
examples.translation: 这是个非常棘手的问题，不是吗？

examples.text: We had the devil's own job to persuade him to take part.
examples.translation: 我们说服他参加可费了一番周折。

examples.text: He drives himself on, working like the devil from seven in the morning until midnight...
examples.translation: 他不断敦促自己，从早上 7 点一直拼命工作到午夜。

examples.text: He must have driven like the devil.
examples.translation: 他一定是把车开得飞快。

examples.text: Every one for himself and the devil take the hindmost.
examples.translation: 人人都只考虑自己，谁落后谁倒霉。

examples.text: Well, talk of the devil!
examples.translation: 呵，说曹操，曹操就到！

examples.text: 'What the devil's the matter?'
examples.translation: “究竟出了什么事？”

examples.text: Tim wondered how the devil they had managed it...
examples.translation: 蒂姆想知道他们究竟是怎么做到的。

examples.text: 'Why the devil did you do that?'
examples.translation: “你到底为什么要那样做？”

meanings.meaning: 设计；想出；发明；图谋；遗赠给

examples.text: We devised a scheme to help him...
examples.translation: 我们想出了一个帮他的计策。

examples.text: New long-range objectives must be devised.
examples.translation: 必须规划出新的长期目标。

examples.text: He decided to devote the rest of his life to scientific investigation...
examples.translation: 他决定将自己的余生献给科学研究事业。

examples.text: Considerable resources have been devoted to proving him a liar...
examples.translation: 为了证明他是个骗子已投入了相当多的人力和财力。

examples.text: She gladly gave up her part-time job to devote herself entirely to her art.
examples.translation: 她欣然辞去了兼职工作，全身心地投入到她的艺术中去。

examples.text: He devoted a major section of his massive report to an analysis of US aircraft design...
examples.translation: 在他的长篇报告中，他用了很大的篇幅来分析美国飞机的设计。

examples.text: Page upon page is devoted to the chain of events leading to the Prime Minister's resignation.
examples.translation: 一页又一页的篇幅都用来描述导致首相辞职的一连串事件。

examples.text: The dew gathered on the leaves.
examples.translation: 露水在叶子上凝结。

examples.text: The soldiers were diagnosed as having flu...
examples.translation: 这些士兵经诊断患了流感。

examples.text: Susan had a mental breakdown and was diagnosed with schizophrenia...
examples.translation: 苏珊精神崩溃，被诊断为得了精神分裂症。

examples.text: In 1894 her illness was diagnosed as cancer...
examples.translation: 1894 年，她的病确诊为癌症。

examples.text: He could diagnose an engine problem simply by listening...
examples.translation: 他仅靠听就能判断发动机出了什么问题。

examples.text: This disorder is easily diagnosed but not so easily treated.
examples.translation: 这种疾病容易诊断，但却不容易治疗。

examples.text: ...a circuit diagram...
examples.translation: 电路图

examples.text: You can reduce long explanations to simple charts or diagrams.
examples.translation: 你可以把冗长的解释简化成一目了然的图表。

examples.text: The sound waves of the voice could be diagramed as in B.
examples.translation: 这个声音的声波如图B所示。

examples.text: ...diagramming the movement of a system's variables.
examples.translation: 用图表表示系统各个变量的变化情况

examples.text: The luminous dial on the clock showed five minutes to seven...
examples.translation: 夜光钟面显示时间为 6点 55 分。

examples.text: The dials of most barometers are inscribed with weather terms.
examples.translation: 大多数气压计的盘面都刻有天气术语。

examples.text: He turned the dial on the radio...
examples.translation: 他转动收音机的电台旋钮。

examples.text: The heat dial was set at 150 degrees.
examples.translation: 温度调节器设定在 150 度。

examples.text: ...turning the dial on the phone.
examples.translation: 打转盘拨号电话

examples.text: He lifted the phone and dialled her number...
examples.translation: 他拿起电话，拨打了她的号码。

examples.text: He dialled, and spoke briefly to the duty officer.
examples.translation: 他拨通了电话，跟值班员简短地说了几句。

examples.translation: 在 20 世纪 50 年代，许多意大利人只会说当地方言。

examples.translation: 他们开始叽里呱啦地说起地方话来。

examples.translation: 直径不足人的头发直径1/5的电子管

examples.translation: 一段直径为 22 毫米的钢管

examples.translation: 直径在 1到3 毫米之间的微型胶囊

(Diamond)人名；(英、意、葡)戴蒙德；(法)迪亚蒙

examples.text: ...a pair of diamond earrings.
examples.translation: 一对钻石耳环

examples.text: ...a sphere made of diamond without impurity or flaw.
examples.translation: 用钻石制成的完美无瑕的圆球

examples.text: Nicole loves wearing her diamonds, even with jeans and a white T-shirt.
examples.translation: 妮科尔很喜欢戴她的钻石首饰，即使穿的是牛仔裤和白色T恤衫。

examples.text: He formed his hands into the shape of a diamond.
examples.translation: 他双手合成菱形。

examples.text: He drew the seven of diamonds.
examples.translation: 他摸了一张方块 7。

examples.translation: 赢得梅花 A，出一张方块

examples.text: The biggest disappointment was "The Rum Diary, " the Hunter S. Thompson adaption starring Johnny Depp.
Sheldon writes every day of the week, dictating his novels in the morning...
examples.translation: 谢尔登一周 7 天都要写作，每天早上口述小说让别人记录。

examples.text: Everything he dictated was signed and sent out the same day.
examples.translation: 他口授的所有内容都签上名并在同一天寄出了。

examples.text: He had warned the West against trying to dictate to the Soviet Union...
examples.translation: 他警告西方国家不要试图对苏联发号施令。

examples.text: What right has one country to dictate the environmental standards of another?...
examples.translation: 一个国家有什么权力强行给另一个国家制定环境标准？

examples.text: He cannot be allowed to dictate what can and cannot be inspected...
examples.translation: 什么能检查什么不能检查不能由他说了算。

examples.text: What gives them the right to dictate to us what we should eat?...
examples.translation: 他们有什么权利来规定我们应该吃什么？

examples.text: The officers were more or less able to dictate terms to successive governments...
examples.translation: 这些军官多多少少都能和继任的各届政府谈些条件。

examples.text: The rules of court dictate that a defendant is entitled to all evidence which may help his case.
examples.translation: 法庭规定被告可以出示任何对其辩护有帮助的证据。

examples.text: The film's budget dictated a tough schedule...
examples.translation: 影片的预算决定了拍摄进度会很紧张。

examples.text: The way in which they dress is dictated by very rigid fashion rules...
examples.translation: 他们的着装受到时尚规则的严格限制。

examples.text: Of course, a number of factors will dictate how long an apple tree can survive...
examples.translation: 当然，影响一棵苹果树寿命的因素有很多。

examples.text: Circumstances dictated that they played a defensive rather than attacking game.
examples.translation: 比赛形势决定了他们要打防守战而不是进攻战。

examples.text: Commonsense now dictates that it would be wise to sell a few shares.
examples.translation: 现在，常识告诉我们卖掉一些股票是明智的。

examples.text: Their job is to ensure that the dictates of the Party are followed.
examples.translation: 他们的工作就是确保党的指示得到执行。

examples.text: We have followed the dictates of our consciences and have done our duty.
examples.translation: 我们遵从了自己的良知，尽到了自己的义务。

examples.text: ...taking dictation from the dean of the Faculty...
examples.translation: 记录系主任口述的内容

examples.text: He had had an arm amputated and relied on her to take down his books from dictation.
examples.translation: 他的一只胳膊截掉了，只能口授书的内容让她来记录。

examples.text: The Europeans, while keen for partnership with the US, would not accept dictation.
examples.translation: 欧洲虽然很想与美国建立伙伴关系，但不会接受其对自己发号施令。

examples.text: ...a Welsh-English dictionary.
examples.translation: 一本威尔士语-英语词典

examples.text: ...the Dictionary of National Biography.
examples.translation: 《英国传记大词典》

examples.text: A year later my dog died...
examples.translation: 一年后我的狗死了。

examples.text: Sadly, both he and my mother died of cancer...
examples.translation: 非常不幸的是，他和我母亲都死于癌症。

examples.text: I would die a very happy person if I could stay in music my whole life...
examples.translation: 如果能终生从事音乐事业，我会死而无憾。

examples.text: ...friends who died young.
examples.translation: 英年早逝的朋友

examples.text: The elm trees are all dying...
examples.translation: 那些榆树全都奄奄一息了。

examples.text: Every working day I treat people who are dying from lung diseases caused by smoking.
examples.translation: 每天上班我都要医治那些因吸烟患上肺病的垂危患者。

examples.text: He watched helplessly as his mother died an agonizing death...
examples.translation: 他无助地看着母亲痛苦地死去。

examples.text: I'm no expert, but I don't think Tracy died a natural death.
examples.translation: 我不是什么专家，但我不认为特蕾西是自然死亡。

examples.text: Then suddenly, the engine coughed, spluttered and died.
examples.translation: 然后，发动机突然咔咔地响着，发出一阵噼啪声，接着就彻底熄火了。

examples.text: Her cigarette glowed brightly, then died.
examples.translation: 她的香烟燃起一阵亮光，然后就熄灭了。

examples.text: My love for you will never die...
examples.translation: 我对你的爱永不止息。

examples.text: Kathryn looked down at the floor and the smile died on her lips.
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳低头看向地板，笑容从她的嘴角消失了。

examples.text: Order me a pot of tea, I'm dying of thirst.
examples.translation: 给我来一壶茶，我快要渴死了。

examples.text: I'm dying for a breath of fresh air...
examples.translation: 我非常渴望能呼吸到新鲜空气。

examples.text: She was dying to talk to Frank.
examples.translation: 她很想同弗兰克谈谈。

examples.text: I nearly died when I learned where I was ending up...
examples.translation: 得知自己到了哪里时，我简直要晕过去了。

examples.text: I nearly died of shame...
examples.translation: 我羞愧难当。

examples.text: I thought I'd die laughing.
examples.translation: 我觉得我快要笑死了。

examples.text: It was too late and too urgent to turn back. The die was cast.
examples.translation: 现在为时已晚，来不及回头。事情已成定局了。

examples.text: Old habits die hard...
examples.translation: 积习难改。

examples.text: Such prejudices die hard.
examples.translation: 这些偏见很难消除。

examples.text: The story he told police differed from the one he told his mother...
examples.translation: 他在警方和母亲那里说辞不一。

examples.text: Management styles differ.
examples.translation: 管理风格各有不同。

examples.text: The two leaders had differed on the issue of sanctions...
examples.translation: 两位领导人在制裁问题上存在意见分歧。

examples.text: That is where we differ...
examples.translation: 那就是我俩看法不一的地方。

examples.text: Since his retirement, Crowe has differed with the President on several issues.
examples.translation: 退休以后，克罗在好几个问题上都与总统意见相左。

examples.text: That is the fundamental difference between the two societies...
examples.translation: 那是这两个社会之间的根本性差异。

examples.text: There is no difference between the sexes.
examples.translation: 男女之间没有差别。

examples.text: ...the vast difference in size...
examples.translation: 大小的巨大差异

examples.text: We do have social problems here. The difference is the people know each other and try to help each other.
examples.translation: 我们这里确实也存在社会问题。所不同的是人们都互相认识而且尽力互相帮助。

examples.text: The difference is 8532.
The two communities are learning how to resolve their differences.
examples.translation: 这两个社群正在学着如何解决彼此之间的分歧。

examples.text: Where you live can make such a difference to the way you feel...
examples.translation: 住在哪里会极大地影响你的感受。

examples.text: Exercise makes all the difference...
examples.translation: 锻炼身体非常重要。

examples.text: His retirement won't make any difference to the way we conduct our affairs.
examples.translation: 他的退休不会影响我们处理事情的方式。

examples.text: Shall we split the difference and say $7,500?
examples.translation: 我们折中一下，7,500 美元怎么样？

examples.text: For a beach resort with a difference, try Key West.
examples.translation: 如果想去一个与众不同的海滨度假胜地，那就去基韦斯特吧。

examples.text: ...a politician with a difference.
examples.translation: 不同寻常的政治家

examples.text: Was there a difference of opinion over what to do with the Nobel Prize money?
examples.translation: 在如何利用那笔诺贝尔奖金的问题上有不同意见吗？

examples.text: It's never too late to improve your diet.
examples.translation: 什么时候改善饮食都为时不晚。

examples.text: ...a healthy diet rich in fruit and vegetables...
examples.translation: 富含水果和蔬菜的健康饮食

examples.text: Poor diet and excess smoking will seriously damage the health of your hair.
examples.translation: 不合理饮食和过度吸烟会严重损害头发的健康。

examples.text: He was put on a diet of milky food.
examples.translation: 他按照医嘱要食用乳制品。

examples.text: ...a special diet for children with high cholesterol.
examples.translation: 专为胆固醇高的孩子准备的特别饮食

examples.text: Have you been on a diet? You've lost a lot of weight...
examples.translation: 你最近在节食吗？你瘦了好多。

examples.text: Diet and exercise will alter your shape...
examples.translation: 节食和锻炼会改变你的体形。

examples.text: I've only lost sixteen pounds since I started this diet.
examples.translation: 从这次节食开始到现在我只减了16磅。

examples.text: I've been dieting ever since the birth of my fourth child...
examples.translation: 我生完第四个孩子后就一直在节食。

examples.text: Most of us have dieted at some time in our lives.
examples.translation: 我们大多数人都曾在人生的某个时期为减肥而节食过。

examples.text: She has already lost around two stone through dieting.
examples.translation: 她通过节食已经减掉了大约两英石的体重。

examples.text: ...sugar-free diet drinks.
examples.translation: 无糖低热量饮料

examples.text: ...diet margarine.
examples.translation: 低卡路里的人造黄油

examples.text: The radio had fed him a diet of pop songs...
examples.translation: 他从广播里听到的都是千篇一律的流行歌曲。

examples.text: People are rejecting this constant diet of despair.
examples.translation: 人们开始拒绝这种没完没了的绝望情绪。

meanings.meaning: 不同的；个别的，与众不同的

examples.text: London was different from most European capitals...
examples.translation: 伦敦同大多数欧洲国家的首都都有所不同。

examples.text: If he'd attended music school, how might things have been different?...
examples.translation: 如果他上过音乐学校，事情会有怎样的不同呢？

examples.text: We have totally different views.
examples.translation: 我们的观点截然不同。

examples.text: My approach is totally different to his.
examples.translation: 我的方法和他的完全不同。

examples.text: We're not really any different than they are.
examples.translation: 我们跟他们其实并没有什么不同。

examples.text: ...a style of advertising that's different than the rest of the country.
examples.translation: 与该国其他地区的广告很不相同的广告风格

examples.text: Every individual learns differently...
examples.translation: 每个人的学习方式都不一样。

examples.text: They still get treated differently from almost every other contemporary British band...
examples.translation: 他们所得到的待遇仍然与当代几乎所有其他英国乐队都不同。

examples.text: The skeleton consists of differently shaped bones held together by ligaments.
examples.translation: 人体骨架是由依靠韧带连接的形状相异的骨头构成。

examples.text: Different countries specialised in different products...
examples.translation: 不同国家专门生产不同的产品。

examples.text: The number of calories in different brands of drinks varies enormously.
examples.translation: 不同牌子的饮料所含的卡路里数大不相同。

examples.text: This recipe is certainly interesting and different.
examples.translation: 这种烹饪法的确很有意思而且与众不同。

examples.text: A child may not differentiate between his imagination and the real world...
examples.translation: 儿童可能无法将自己的幻想与真实世界区分开来。

examples.text: At this age your baby cannot differentiate one person from another.
examples.translation: 这个年龄的婴儿还不能认人。

examples.text: ...distinctive policies that differentiate them from the other parties.
examples.translation: 使他们有别于其他政党的特殊政策

examples.text: The differentiation between the two product ranges will increase.
examples.translation: 这两个产品系列之间的差别将会加大。

meanings.meaning: 困难的；不随和的；执拗的

examples.text: Hobart found it difficult to get her first book published...
examples.translation: 霍巴特发现要出版自己的第一本书很不容易。

examples.text: The lack of childcare provisions made it difficult for single mothers to get jobs...
examples.translation: 由于缺乏保育服务，单身母亲很难找到工作。

examples.text: It was a very difficult decision to make...
examples.translation: 那是一个非常艰难的决定。

examples.text: We're living in difficult times...
examples.translation: 我们正处在困难时期。

examples.text: It's very difficult being a woman in motor racing.
examples.translation: 做一名女赛车手很不容易。

examples.text: I had a feeling you were going to be difficult about this.
examples.translation: 我有种感觉：你会在这件事上找别扭。

examples.text: ...the difficulty of getting accurate information...
examples.translation: 获取准确信息的难题

examples.text: The country is facing great economic difficulties.
examples.translation: 该国正面临巨大的经济困难。

examples.text: Do you have difficulty getting up?...
examples.translation: 你能站起来吗？

examples.text: The injured man mounted his horse with difficulty.
examples.translation: 受伤的男子艰难地上了马。

examples.text: You have to admit that you are, in fact, in difficulties...
examples.translation: 你不得不承认，你事实上是陷入了困境。

examples.text: Rumours spread about banks being in difficulty.
examples.translation: 有传闻称银行现在处境艰难。

examples.text: Over time, the technology is diffused and adopted by other countries.
examples.translation: 久而久之，这项技术传播到了其他国家并得到利用。

examples.text: ...an attempt to diffuse new ideas...
examples.translation: 传播新思想的尝试

examples.text: As agriculture developed, agricultural ideas diffused across Europe.
examples.translation: 随着农业的发展，农业知识开始在欧洲普及。

examples.text: ...the development and diffusion of ideas.
examples.translation: 思想的发展和传播

examples.text: The arrival of letters from the Pope did nothing to diffuse the tension.
examples.translation: 教皇的来信并没有缓解紧张的气氛。

examples.text: Diffusing a light also reduces its power...
examples.translation: 使灯光漫射也会降低其强度。

examples.text: The sun slid behind trees, its last light diffused by wintry branches.
examples.translation: 太阳躲到了树后，余晖透过冬日的树枝洒落下来。

examples.text: It allows nicotine to diffuse slowly and steadily into the bloodstream...
examples.translation: 它能使尼古丁平稳缓慢地渗透到血液里。

examples.text: It created a glowing centre of warmth that quickly diffused through my limbs...
examples.translation: 它形成了一个温暖的热源，热量迅速扩散至我的四肢。

examples.text: The moisture present in all foods absorbs the flavour of the smoke and eventually diffuses that flavour into its interior.
examples.translation: 所有食物中都存在的水分会吸收烟味，并最终将其散播到食物内部。

examples.text: There are data on the rates of diffusion of molecules.
examples.translation: 有关于分子扩散速度的数据。

examples.text: ...a diffuse community...
examples.translation: 分散的社群

examples.text: A cold, diffuse light filtered in through the skylight.
examples.translation: 一道冰冷的光线透过天窗漫射进来。

examples.text: His writing is so diffuse and obscure that it is difficult to make out what it is he is trying to say.
examples.translation: 他的文章含混晦涩，让人看后不知所云。

examples.text: They tried digging in a patch just below the cave...
examples.translation: 他们试着在洞穴正下方的一块地上挖掘。

examples.text: Dig a largish hole and bang the stake in first...
examples.translation: 挖一个大点儿的洞，先把木桩敲进去。

examples.text: Rescue workers are digging through the rubble in search of other victims...
examples.translation: 救援人员正在废墟中挖掘，以搜寻其他受害者。

examples.text: They dug for shellfish at low tide...
examples.translation: 退潮时他们在海滩上挖贝类。

examples.text: Two men were standing by the freshly dug grave.
examples.translation: 两名男子站在新挖的坟墓边。

examples.text: He dug into his coat pocket for his keys.
examples.translation: 他把手伸进上衣口袋里摸钥匙。

examples.text: She digs the serving spoon into the moussaka...
examples.translation: 她把分菜匙伸进那盘碎肉茄子蛋中。

examples.text: I grab George's arm and dig my nails into his flesh...
examples.translation: 我抓住乔治的胳膊，指甲抠进了他的肉里。

examples.text: He could feel the beads digging into his palm...
examples.translation: 他能感觉到珠子硌得手心生疼。

examples.text: Graham was standing there, his hands dug into the pockets of his baggy white trousers.
examples.translation: 格雷厄姆站在那里，双手插在宽松的白色裤子的兜里。

examples.text: The enquiry dug deeper into the alleged financial misdeeds of his government...
examples.translation: 这一调查对其政府涉嫌的财政违规行为展开了进一步深究。

examples.text: He has been digging into the local archives...
examples.translation: 他一直在仔细查阅当地的档案资料。

examples.text: Much that is included in them has appeared in other published works, and one must dig hard for reliable new material.
examples.translation: 这些资料中包括的许多内容在其他已发表作品中都已出现过，所以必须要深入挖掘以找到可靠的新材料。

examples.text: Occupants of the White House have exploited their office at key moments in an election campaign to dig themselves out of trouble...
examples.translation: 在竞选活动的关键时刻，白宫的主人利用职权帮助自己摆脱了麻烦。

examples.text: He's taken these measures to try and dig himself out of a hole.
examples.translation: 他已采取了这些措施，试图让自己摆脱困境。

examples.text: 'They play classic rock'n'roll,' states her boyfriend, 'My dad digs them too.'...
examples.translation: “他们演奏经典摇滚乐，”她的男朋友说道，“我爸爸也喜欢他们。”

examples.text: I can dig it. I don't expect a band always to be innovative.
examples.translation: 我可以理解。我不指望一个乐队总能创新。

examples.text: He's an archaeologist and has been on a dig in Crete for the past year.
examples.translation: 他是位考古学家，过去的一年都在参与克里特岛上的一项考古发掘工作。

examples.text: Americans are always quick to have a dig at the British...
examples.translation: 美国人总是动不动就嘲讽英国人。

examples.text: She couldn't resist a dig at Dave after his unfortunate performance.
examples.translation: 戴夫糟糕的表演结束后，她忍不住想挖苦他一番。

examples.text: Cassandra silenced him with a sharp dig in the small of the back.
examples.translation: 卡桑德拉使劲戳了一下他的后腰，让他住嘴。

examples.text: He went to London and lived in digs in Gloucester Road...
examples.translation: 他去了伦敦，在格洛斯特路的一所房子里租了房间住。

examples.text: I want you to dig deep. Find out who she is, and where she came from.
examples.translation: 我想让你彻底调查一下，弄清她是谁，从哪里来的。

examples.text: Holidaymakers are digging deep into their pockets to book late summer breaks.
examples.translation: 度假者想方设法拿出钱来预订夏末的短暂假期。

examples.text: Do not undertake strenuous exercise for a few hours after a meal to allow food to digest...
examples.translation: 饭后几个小时不要从事剧烈运动，以便食物能够消化。

examples.text: She couldn't digest food properly...
examples.translation: 她无法正常消化食物。

examples.text: Nutrients from the digested food can be absorbed into the blood.
examples.translation: 消化的食物中的营养成分能够被吸收到血液中去。

examples.text: They learn well but seem to need time to digest information...
examples.translation: 他们学得不错，但似乎还需要一些时间来消化信息。

examples.text: She read everything, digesting every fragment of news.
examples.translation: 她什么都读，新闻中的任何只言片语都要一一揣摩。

examples.text: All this has upset me. I need time to digest it all.
examples.translation: 所以这些都让我心烦。我需要时间来慢慢接受这一切。

examples.text: The organization publishes a regular digest of environmental statistics.
examples.translation: 该组织定期出版一份环境统计数据摘要。

examples.text: ...the Middle East Economic Digest.
examples.translation: 《中东经济文摘》

examples.text: The new digital technology would allow a rapid expansion in the number of TV channels.
examples.translation: 新的数字技术将会使电视频道的数量迅速增加。

examples.text: ...digitally recorded sound.
examples.translation: 数码录制的声音

examples.text: ...a digital display.
examples.translation: 数字显示

examples.text: ...her extraordinary dignity and composure.
examples.translation: 她那种端庄沉着的非凡气质

examples.text: ...the sense of human dignity.
examples.translation: 人的高尚感

examples.text: ...the integrity and the dignity of our lives and feelings.
examples.translation: 我们的生命以及情感的完整统一和尊贵庄严

examples.text: If you were wrong, admit it. You won't lose dignity, but will gain respect...
examples.translation: 如果你错了，那就承认。你不会因此而失去尊严，反而会赢得尊重。

examples.text: She still has her dignity.
examples.translation: 她仍然保持着自己的尊严。

meanings.meaning: 困境；进退两难；两刀论法

examples.text: He was faced with the dilemma of whether or not to return to his country...
examples.translation: 要不要回国，他进退两难。

examples.text: The issue raises a moral dilemma.
examples.translation: 这个问题引发了一个道德上的两难抉择。

meanings.meaning: 勤勉的；用功的，费尽心血的

examples.text: Meyers is a diligent and prolific worker...
examples.translation: 迈耶斯是个勤奋多产的工人。

examples.text: The historical research was impressively diligent.
examples.translation: 该项历史研究非常地认真、彻底。

examples.text: The police are pursuing their inquiries with great diligence.
examples.translation: 警方正不知疲倦地进行调查。

examples.text: The two sides are now working diligently to resolve their differences.
examples.translation: 双方正进行不懈的努力以解决他们之间的分歧。

examples.text: If you give your baby juice, dilute it well with cooled, boiled water...
examples.translation: 如果给婴儿喝果汁，要用凉开水充分稀释。

examples.text: The liquid is then diluted...
examples.translation: 然后液体被稀释。

examples.text: The poisons seeping from Hanford's contaminated land quickly dilute in the water.
examples.translation: 从汉福德受污染的土地里渗出的有毒物质很快就在水中稀释了。

examples.text: ...ditches dug for sewage dilution.
examples.translation: 用来稀释污水的沟渠

examples.text: ...a dilute solution of bleach.
examples.translation: 经稀释的漂白剂

examples.text: There was a clear intention to dilute black voting power...
examples.translation: 明显有意图要削弱黑人的选举力量。
