examples.text: Serious attention is being given to diluting the value of personal tax allowances.
examples.translation: 人们正密切关注降低个人收入免税额度一事。

examples.text: ...a potentially devastating dilution of earnings per share.
examples.translation: 每股收益可能的大幅摊薄

meanings.meaning: 暗淡的，昏暗的；模糊的，看不清的；悲观的，怀疑的
使暗淡，使失去光泽；使变模糊

examples.text: She stood waiting, in the dim light...
examples.translation: 她站在昏暗的光线下等待。

examples.text: Below decks, the lights were dim.
examples.translation: 船舱里灯光昏暗。

examples.text: Two lamps burned dimly...
examples.translation: 两盏灯发出微弱的光。

examples.text: He followed her into a dimly lit kitchen.
examples.translation: 他跟着她走进光线暗淡的厨房。

examples.text: ...the dimness of an early September evening.
examples.translation: 9 月初傍晚的昏暗

examples.text: The room was dim and cool and quiet.
examples.translation: 房间里阴暗、清冷，静悄悄的。

examples.text: I squinted to adjust my eyes to the dimness.
examples.translation: 我眯起眼，努力适应黑暗的环境。

examples.text: Pete's torch picked out the dim figures of Bob and Chang.
examples.translation: 皮特的火把映出了鲍勃和张的模糊身影。

examples.text: The shoreline could be dimly seen.
examples.translation: 海岸线隐约可见。

examples.text: It seems that the '60s era of social activism is all but a dim memory.
examples.translation: 20 世纪 60 年代的社会激进主义似乎只是一个模糊的记忆。

examples.text: Christina dimly recalled the procedure...
examples.translation: 克里斯蒂娜只依稀记得整个步骤。

examples.text: I was dimly aware that dozens of curious people were looking at us.
examples.translation: 我迷迷糊糊地感觉到有数十个人在好奇地看着我们。

examples.text: The prospects for a peaceful solution are dim.
examples.translation: 和平解决的希望非常渺茫。

examples.text: Dim the lighting – it is unpleasant to lie with a bright light shining in your eyes...
examples.translation: 把灯光调暗一些——躺着时眼前灯光太强很不舒服。

examples.text: The houselights dimmed.
examples.translation: 观众席的灯暗了下来。

examples.text: Dim your lights behind that car.
examples.translation: 开到那辆车后面时将前灯调为近光。

examples.text: Their economic prospects have dimmed...
examples.translation: 他们的经济前景变得很暗淡。

examples.text: Forty eight years of marriage have not dimmed the passion between Bill and Helen.
examples.translation: 48 年的婚姻生活并没消磨掉比尔和海伦之间的激情。

examples.text: Her eyes dimmed with sorrow...
examples.translation: 悲痛之下，她泪眼蒙眬。

examples.text: The twinkle in his eyes was dimmed by tears.
examples.translation: 他眼中闪烁的光芒被泪水模糊了。

examples.text: Their memory of what happened has dimmed...
examples.translation: 他们对所发生事情的记忆变得模糊了。

examples.text: The intervening years had dimmed his memory.
examples.translation: 经过了其间那么多年他的记忆已经不大清楚了。

meanings.meaning: 方面;[数] 维；尺寸；次元；容积

examples.text: There is a political dimension to the accusations...
examples.translation: 这些指控含有政治方面的因素。

examples.text: This adds a new dimension to our work.
examples.translation: 这给我们的工作增添了新的内容。

examples.text: He considers the dimensions of the problem...
examples.translation: 他考虑了问题的严重程度。

examples.text: The dimensions of the market collapse were certainly not anticipated.
examples.translation: 股市崩盘的严重程度的确是没有预料到的。

examples.text: Drilling will continue on the site to assess the dimensions of the new oilfield...
examples.translation: 该处的钻探工作将继续下去，以便估测新油田的面积。

examples.text: I don't think it would spoil the dimensions of the room.
examples.translation: 我不认为它会破坏房间的大小。

examples.text: ...the grandiose dimensions of the building.
examples.translation: 建筑物的宏伟壮观

examples.text: The threat of nuclear war has diminished...
examples.translation: 核战争的威胁已经减小了。

examples.text: Federalism is intended to diminish the power of the central state...
examples.translation: 联邦制旨在削弱中央政府的权力。

examples.text: Universities are facing grave problems because of diminishing resources...
examples.translation: 由于资源的减少，大学正面临严峻的问题。

examples.text: This could mean diminished public support for the war.
examples.translation: 这可能意味着公众对战争的支持会有所下降。

examples.text: He never put her down or diminished her...
examples.translation: 他从未奚落或贬低过她。

examples.text: He could no longer cope; he relied on me, and felt diminished by it.
examples.translation: 他再也无法承受，他依赖我，却因此觉得是受了轻贱。

meanings.meaning: (Dine)人名；(意、葡)迪内；(英)戴恩；(法)迪纳

examples.text: He dines alone most nights...
examples.translation: 大多数晚上他都是一个人用餐。

examples.text: That night the two men dined at Wilson's club...
examples.translation: 那天晚上这两个男人在威尔逊俱乐部进了餐。

examples.text: They used to enjoy going out to dine.
examples.translation: 他们以前很喜欢出去吃饭。

examples.text: She invited us to her house for dinner...
examples.translation: 她请我们去她家吃晚餐。

examples.text: Would you like to stay and have dinner?...
examples.translation: 你留下来一起吃饭好吗？

examples.text: Enjoy your dinner.
examples.translation: 请慢慢享用您的晚餐。

examples.text: ...four-course dinners.
examples.translation: 包括四道菜的正餐

examples.text: ...a series of official lunches and dinners...
examples.translation: 一系列的正式午餐和晚宴

examples.text: The Professional Cricketers' Association held its annual dinner in London.
examples.translation: 职业板球运动员协会在伦敦举办了自己的年度宴会。

meanings.meaning: 毕业证书，学位证书；公文，文书；奖状

examples.text: ...a new two-year course leading to a diploma in social work.
examples.translation: 一门为期两年、毕业后可以获得社会福利工作方面文凭的新课程

meanings.meaning: 下沉，下降；倾斜；浸渍，蘸湿

examples.text: They dip the food into the sauce...
examples.translation: 他们把食物放到调味汁里蘸了蘸。

examples.text: Quickly dip the base in and out of cold water.
examples.translation: 把底部在冷水中快速地浸一下后拿出来。

examples.text: One dip into the bottle should do an entire nail.
examples.translation: 往瓶子里蘸一下的量就应该能涂满整个指甲。

examples.text: She dipped a hand into the jar of sweets and pulled one out...
examples.translation: 她把手伸进糖果罐，摸出了一颗糖。

examples.text: Watch your fingers as you dip into the pot...
examples.translation: 把手伸进锅里时当心你的手指头。

examples.text: Ask the children to guess what's in each container by dipping their hands in.
examples.translation: 让孩子们伸手进去摸摸，猜猜每个容器里面是什么。

examples.text: Blake jumped in expertly; the boat dipped slightly under his weight...
examples.translation: 布莱克很熟练地跳上了船，他的重量使小船微微向下沉了沉。

examples.text: The sun dipped below the horizon.
examples.translation: 太阳落到了地平线下。

examples.text: I noticed little things, a dip of the head, a twitch in the shoulder.
examples.translation: 我注意到了一些细节：头的往下一沉，肩膀的突然颤动。

examples.text: The road dipped and rose again.
examples.translation: 道路陡然沉下去又升上来。

examples.text: ...a path which suddenly dips down into a tunnel.
examples.translation: 突然下降进入一条隧道的小路

examples.text: Where the road makes a dip, turn right.
examples.translation: 在下坡处，向右转。

examples.text: Their father was helping to dip the sheep.
examples.translation: 他们的父亲在帮忙给羊群洗药浴。

examples.text: He digs potatoes and helps with the sheep dipping.
examples.translation: 他挖土豆并帮忙给羊群洗药浴。

examples.text: ...sheep dip.
examples.translation: 羊群用的药浴液

examples.text: Unemployment dipped to 6.9 per cent last month...
examples.translation: 上个月失业率降到了 6.9%。

examples.text: The president became more cautious as his popularity dipped.
examples.translation: 由于支持率有所下降，总统变得更加谨慎了。

examples.text: ...the current dip in farm spending.
examples.translation: 目前农场开支的减少

examples.text: Maybe we could just buy some dips.
examples.translation: 或许我们可以只买一点儿蘸酱。

examples.text: ...prawns with avocado dip.
examples.translation: 配鳄梨酱的对虾

examples.text: She flicked through a romantic paperback between occasional dips in the pool.
examples.translation: 用在泳池里游一阵后歇一阵的几个空当，她翻完了一本平装本言情小说。

examples.text: He dipped his headlights as they came up behind a slow-moving van...
examples.translation: 当他们靠近一辆缓慢行驶的货车时，他把汽车前灯调成了近光。

examples.text: This picture shows the view from a car using normal dipped lights.
examples.translation: 这幅图片显示的是从一辆使用正常近光灯的汽车上所看到的景色。

examples.text: ...a chance to dip into a wide selection of books on Buddhism.
examples.translation: 博览佛教群书的机会

examples.text: Just when she was ready to dip into her savings, Greg hastened to her rescue.
examples.translation: 正当她准备动用自己的存款时，格雷格赶来给她救了急。

meanings.meaning: 外交的；外交上的；老练的

examples.text: ...before the two countries resume full diplomatic relations...
examples.translation: 在两国恢复全面的外交关系之前

examples.text: Efforts are being made to avert war and find a diplomatic solution...
examples.translation: 各方正在为避免战争、寻求外交解决途径而作出积极的努力。

examples.text: These diplomatic skills led to her appointment as the President of the United Nations General Assembly.
examples.translation: 凭借这些外交手腕，她被任命为联合国大会的主席。

examples.text: ...a growing sense of doubt that the conflict can be resolved diplomatically...
examples.translation: 对这一冲突可以通过外交途径得以解决日益加深的疑虑

examples.text: The President made it clear he did not want to see the country diplomatically isolated.
examples.translation: 总统明确表示他不想看到这个国家在外交上被孤立。

examples.text: She is very direct. I tend to be more diplomatic, I suppose.
examples.translation: 她人很直，我觉得我更婉转一些。

examples.text: 'Their sound is very interesting,' he says, diplomatically.
examples.translation: 他很圆滑地说道，“他们唱得不错。”

meanings.meaning: 直接的；直系的；亲身的；恰好的
直接地；正好；按直系关系

examples.text: They'd come on a direct flight from Athens.
examples.translation: 他们是搭乘从雅典直飞这里的航班过来的。

examples.text: ...the direct route from Amman to Bombay.
examples.translation: 从安曼到孟买的直达线路

examples.text: You can fly direct to Amsterdam from most British airports.
examples.translation: 从英国的大多数机场都可以直飞阿姆斯特丹。

examples.text: The jumbo jet is due to fly the hostages directly back to London.
examples.translation: 大型喷气式客机将把人质直接送回伦敦。

examples.text: Medicines should be stored away from direct sunlight...
examples.translation: 药品的储放应避免阳光直射。

examples.text: Direct illumination is harsh and unflattering.
examples.translation: 直射光照明既刺目又呆板。

examples.text: He has direct experience of the process of privatisation...
examples.translation: 他对私有化过程有着切身体会。

examples.text: He seemed to be in direct contact with the Boss...
examples.translation: 他似乎直接和老板联系。

examples.text: He is expected to extend direct rule by the central government for another six months.
examples.translation: 预计他将把中央政府的直接统治再延长 6 个月。

examples.text: I can deal direct with your Inspector Kimble...
examples.translation: 我可以跟你们的金布尔巡官当面交谈。

examples.text: Write to us direct with details of your clubs.
examples.translation: 直接给我们写信，讲述一下你们俱乐部的详细情况。

examples.text: We cannot measure pain directly. It can only be estimated...
examples.translation: 我们无法直接度量出疼痛的程度，而只能是作出估计。

examples.text: The British could do nothing directly to help the Austrians.
examples.translation: 英国无法给奥地利人提供直接援助。

examples.text: They were unable to prove that she died as a direct result of his injection...
examples.translation: 他们无法证明她的死是由于他的注射直接引起的。

examples.text: His visit is direct evidence of the improvement in their relationship...
examples.translation: 他的到访是他们之间关系已有所改善的明证。

examples.text: The minister denied there was a direct connection between the two issues.
examples.translation: 部长否认两者之间有直接的联系。

examples.text: He avoided giving a direct answer...
examples.translation: 他避免作出正面回答。

examples.text: The new songs are more direct...
examples.translation: 这些新歌听起来更直入人心。

examples.text: No direct reference was made to the call by the Foreign Office minister.
examples.translation: 没有直接提及外交部长的拜访。

examples.text: At your first meeting, explain simply and directly what you hope to achieve...
examples.translation: 初次见面时，要单刀直入地指出你想要达到什么目标。

examples.text: But he then went on to refer very directly to the argument.
examples.translation: 不过接下来他就直切主题提到了那场争论。

examples.text: Using 'I' adds directness to a piece of writing...
examples.translation: 采用第一人称会使文章更显亲切。

examples.text: 'I like Rupert enormously,' she said, with a directness which made Pat flush.
examples.translation: “我非常喜欢鲁珀特，”她说道，其坦率让帕特羞红了脸。

examples.text: I directed the extinguisher at the fire without effect...
examples.translation: 我把灭火器对准了火焰，但没起作用。

examples.text: He directed the tiny beam of light at the roof.
examples.translation: 他把那一小束光对准了屋顶。

examples.text: The learner's attention needs to be directed to the significant features...
examples.translation: 需要将学习者的注意力引向那些着重点上。

examples.text: Do not be surprised if, initially, she directs her anger at you...
examples.translation: 如果一上来她就冲你发火，不必惊讶。

examples.text: One assassination attempt was directed against the country's top three government leaders.
examples.translation: 有一次未遂的暗杀行动是针对该国的3名最高层领导人而来的。

examples.text: She could hardly believe the question was directed towards her...
examples.translation: 她很难相信这个问题是冲她来的。

examples.text: The abuse was directed at the TV crews...
examples.translation: 这些辱骂是冲着电视台的工作人员来的。

examples.text: Arnold directed a meaningful look at Irma.
examples.translation: 阿诺德意味深长地看了艾尔玛一眼。

examples.text: Could you direct them to Dr Lamont's office, please?...
examples.translation: 你能告诉他们去拉蒙特医生的办公室怎么走吗？

examples.text: Inside, a guard directed them to the right.
examples.translation: 进去后，一名警卫把他们引向了右边。

examples.text: Christopher will direct day-to-day operations.
examples.translation: 克里斯托弗将管理日常的运营。

examples.text: ...his coolness in directing the rescue of nine hostages.
examples.translation: 在组织解救9名人质的过程中他所表现出的冷静

examples.text: Organizations need clear direction...
examples.translation: 各组织机构需要条理清晰的指导。

examples.text: The house was built under the direction of John's partner.
examples.translation: 这座房子是在约翰的合伙人的指导下盖起来的。

examples.text: He directed various TV shows...
examples.translation: 他执导过多种题材的电视节目。

examples.text: The film was directed by Howard Hawks.
examples.translation: 该影片是由霍华德·霍克斯导演的。

examples.text: ...Miss Birkin's long-held ambition to direct as well as act.
examples.translation: 伯金小姐既当演员又做导演的夙愿

examples.text: They have been directed to give special attention to the problem of poverty...
examples.translation: 他们得到指示要特别关注贫困问题。

examples.text: The Bishop directed the faithful to stay at home.
examples.translation: 主教要求信徒们呆在家中。

examples.text: She is a direct descendant of Queen Victoria.
examples.translation: 她是维多利亚女王的嫡系后代。

meanings.meaning: 方向；指导；趋势；用法说明

examples.text: St Andrews was ten miles in the opposite direction...
examples.translation: 圣安德鲁斯在相反方向上 10 英里处。

examples.text: He drove off in the direction of Larry's shop...
examples.translation: 他驾车朝着拉里商店的方向驶去。

examples.text: Civilians were fleeing in all directions as soldiers yelled at them to get off the streets...
examples.translation: 听到士兵大叫着让他们从街上撤离，平民百姓们纷纷四处逃散。

examples.text: The instruments will register every change of direction or height.
examples.translation: 这些仪器将会记录下每一个方位或高度的变化。

examples.text: They threatened to walk out if the party did not change direction...
examples.translation: 他们威胁说，如果该党不改变方针，他们就将集体退席。

examples.text: I've never done any sustained writing, but that might be one of my next directions.
examples.translation: 我以前从未尝试过持续写作，不过那可能是我下一步努力的方向之一。

examples.text: I should know by now not to throw away the directions until we've finished cooking...
examples.translation: 现在我知道了不该在饭没做完之前就扔掉烹饪说明。

examples.text: He proceeded to give Dan directions to the computer room.
examples.translation: 他接着告诉丹去计算机房该怎么走。

examples.text: His failures underline the difference between theatre and film direction.
examples.translation: 他的失败说明了导演戏剧和电影是不同的。

meanings.meaning: 直接地；立即；马上；正好地；坦率地

examples.text: The second rainbow will be bigger than the first, and directly above it...
examples.translation: 第二道彩虹将比第一道还要大，而且正好位于其上。

examples.text: There, directly below me, was a guy holding the ball...
examples.translation: 刚好就在我下方，有个家伙手里拿着那个球。

examples.text: The naked bulb was directly over his head...
examples.translation: 裸露的灯泡正好在他的头顶上方。

examples.text: They are sleeping in the carpenter's shop directly above.
examples.translation: 他们正在正上方的木匠铺子里睡觉。

examples.text: Directly after the meeting, a senior cabinet minister spoke to the BBC...
examples.translation: 会议刚刚结束，一名高级内阁部长就在英国广播公司的电台上发表了讲话。

examples.text: Directly after lunch we were packed and ready to go...
examples.translation: 一吃完午饭我们就收拾好准备出发了。

examples.text: Directly following this treatment, he had a hollow, empty feeling in his stomach.
examples.translation: 这项治疗刚一结束，他就觉得胃里空空的。

examples.text: He will be there directly.
examples.translation: 他马上就到那儿。

meanings.meaning: 主任，主管；导演；人事助理

examples.text: ...the director of the intensive care unit at Guy's Hospital.
examples.translation: 盖伊医院重症护理病房的主任

examples.text: ...the Director of Public Prosecutions...
examples.translation: (英格兰以及威尔士的)检察官

examples.text: She has just been appointed artistic director of Queensland Theatre Company.
examples.translation: 她刚刚被任命为昆士兰剧团的艺术总监。

examples.text: He served on the board of directors of a local bank.
examples.translation: 他是当地一家银行的董事会成员之一。

examples.text: ...Karl Uggerholt, the financial director of Braun UK.
examples.translation: 卡尔·乌格洛尔特，贝朗英国分公司的财务经理

meanings.meaning: [计] 目录；工商名录；姓名地址录

examples.text: ...a telephone directory.
examples.translation: 电话号码簿

examples.text: This option lets you create new files or directories.
examples.translation: 用这个选项你可以创建新的文件或目录。

examples.text: Yahoo is the oldest and best-known Web directory service.
examples.translation: 雅虎是最早且最知名的因特网目录服务网站。

meanings.meaning: 污垢，泥土；灰尘，尘土；下流话

examples.text: I started to scrub off the dirt.
examples.translation: 我开始擦洗上面的灰尘。

examples.text: They all sit on the dirt in the dappled shade of a tree.
examples.translation: 他们全都坐在斑驳树阴下的泥土地上。

examples.text: I drove along the dirt road...
examples.translation: 我驱车沿那条土路行进。

examples.text: The rooster chased me across the dirt floor of the barn.
examples.translation: 公鸡追着我跑过谷仓的泥土地面。

examples.text: Steve was keen to get all the dirt he could on her...
examples.translation: 史蒂夫一心想要搜罗关于她的一切丑闻。

examples.text: Both parties use computers to dig up dirt on their opponents.
examples.translation: 双方都用电脑搜集对手的丑事。

examples.text: He dishes the dirt on his buddies.
examples.translation: 他说自己伙伴的闲话。

examples.text: People think they can treat me like dirt!
examples.translation: 人们以为可以视我为草芥！

meanings.meaning: 下流的，卑鄙的；肮脏的；恶劣的；暗淡的

examples.text: She still did not like the woman who had dirty fingernails...
examples.translation: 她还是不喜欢那个指甲脏脏的女子。

examples.text: The dress had been brightly coloured, but it was stained and dirty now.
examples.translation: 那件连衣裙原来色彩非常鲜艳，不过现在有污渍变脏了。

examples.text: He was afraid the dog's hairs might dirty the seats...
examples.translation: 他担心狗毛弄脏了座位。

examples.text: With poor quality tapes you could also risk dirtying the heads on your video recorder.
examples.translation: 使用劣质磁带还有可能会污损你的录像机磁头。

examples.text: The gunman had been hired by a rival Mafia family to do the dirty deed.
examples.translation: 一个敌对的黑手党家族雇用了那个枪手来实施这一卑劣行动。

examples.text: Jim Browne is the kind of fellow who can fight dirty.
examples.translation: 吉姆·布朗是那种打起架来不择手段的家伙。

examples.text: They told dirty jokes and sang raucous ballads...
examples.translation: 他们说着荤段子，哼着不着调的小曲儿。

examples.text: Of course lots of kids read dirty books in their rooms and hide them under the mattress.
examples.translation: 当然很多孩子在他们的房间里看黄书，而且会把它们藏在床垫子底下。

examples.text: I'm often asked whether the men talk dirty to me. The answer is no.
examples.translation: 常有人问我那些男人是否对我说下流话，答案是没有。

examples.text: You dirty liar.
examples.translation: 你这个可恶的骗子。

examples.text: The spectacle of the former naval officers washing their dirty linen in public was distinctly embarrassing...
examples.translation: 前海军官员们自揭伤疤的做法显然非常令人尴尬。

examples.text: We shouldn't wash our dirty laundry in public and if I was in his position, I'd say nothing at all.
examples.translation: 家丑不宜外扬，如果我是他的话，我就什么也不说。

examples.text: Michael gave him a dirty look and walked out.
examples.translation: 迈克尔狠狠地瞪了他一眼然后走开了。

examples.text: He was always trying it on. But now he's 71, it's causing problems. He's just a dirty old man.
examples.translation: 他以前总想乱来。但现在他已 71 岁，有些力不从心了。不过是个老色鬼罢了。

examples.text: As a member of an elite army hit squad, the army would send us out to do their dirty work for them.
examples.translation: 作为特工小分队的一员，部队总会派我们去做他们不愿做的事。

examples.text: Marketing became a dirty word at the company.
examples.translation: 市场营销成了公司里一个很令人讨厌的字眼。

meanings.meaning: 使失去能力；使残废；使无资格

examples.text: She did all this tendon damage and it really disabled her...
examples.translation: 她遭受这么严重的肌腱损伤，这实际上让她残废了。

examples.text: Although disabled by polio during the Second World War, Proctor was also a first-rate helmsman.
examples.translation: 二战期间尽管身患小儿麻痹症，普罗克特仍不失为一流的舵手。

examples.text: ...skin ulcers which are disfiguring and sometimes disabling.
examples.translation: 有损容貌甚至会致残的皮肤溃疡

examples.text: ...if you need to disable a car alarm.
examples.translation: 如果你需要暂停汽车报警功能

examples.text: The black car drove away from them and disappeared...
examples.translation: 那辆黑色轿车驶离了他们的视线。

examples.text: Clive disappeared into a room by himself...
examples.translation: 克莱夫独自一人进了屋。

examples.text: The airliner disappeared off their radar.
examples.translation: 那架班机从他们的雷达屏幕上消失了。

examples.text: ...a Japanese woman who disappeared thirteen years ago...
examples.translation: 一个 13 年前失踪的日本女人

examples.text: Janet's husband and sister noticed that small kitchen objects were disappearing with increasing regularity.
examples.translation: 珍妮特的丈夫和她的姐姐发现厨房里的小物件经常不翼而飞，而且次数愈发频繁。

examples.text: The immediate security threat has disappeared.
examples.translation: 直接的安全威胁已不复存在了。

examples.text: She knew that she would disappoint him.
examples.translation: 她知道她会令他失望的。

examples.text: A spokesman for UNHCR said he was surprised and disappointed by the decision.
examples.translation: 联合国难民署的一位发言人说他对这一决定既震惊又失望。

examples.text: It was the second air disaster in the region in less than two months...
examples.translation: 这已经是该地区不到两个月内的第二次空难了。

examples.text: Many had lost all in the disaster and were destitute.
examples.translation: 很多人被灾难夺去了一切，变得一无所有。

examples.text: The whole production was just a disaster!
examples.translation: 整个产品简直就是一个败笔！

examples.text: It would be a disaster for them not to reach the semi-finals...
examples.translation: 如果不能挺进半决赛，对他们来说就是完败。

examples.text: 'This tax is a disaster waiting to happen,' said an angry Tory backbencher.
examples.translation: “这项税收将为日后埋下祸根，”一位愤怒的保守党后座议员说道。

examples.text: The government brought itself to the brink of fiscal disaster...
examples.translation: 政府把自己推向了财政危机的边缘。

examples.text: 'The potential for disaster is enormous,' he says.
examples.translation: “这将会祸患无穷，”他说道。

meanings.meaning: 灾难性的；损失惨重的；悲伤的

examples.text: ...the recent, disastrous earthquake...
examples.translation: 最近的灾难性地震

examples.text: The effect on coffee prices has been disastrous for the producers.
examples.translation: 对咖啡价格的影响对生产商而言是灾难性的。

examples.text: The vegetable harvest is disastrously behind schedule...
examples.translation: 蔬菜收获比预期时间晚了很多，造成了严重后果。

examples.text: Their scheme went disastrously wrong.
examples.translation: 他们的方案一败涂地。

examples.text: England's cricketers have had another disastrous day.
examples.translation: 英格兰板球队又经历了灰色的一天。

examples.text: ...their disastrous performance in the general election of 1906.
examples.translation: 他们在1906大选中的糟糕表现

examples.text: ...the company's disastrously timed venture into property development.
examples.translation: 公司对房地产开发完全不合时宜的冒进

meanings.meaning: 圆盘，[电子] 唱片（等于disk）

examples.text: Most shredding machines are based on a revolving disc fitted with replaceable blades.
examples.translation: 大多数粉碎机都是基于一个装有可替换刀片的旋转圆盘来实现作业的。

examples.text: I had slipped a disc and was frozen in a spasm of pain.
examples.translation: 我有一个椎间盘错位了，疼得我动弹不得。

examples.text: This disc includes the piano sonata in C minor.
examples.translation: 这张唱片包括了 C小调的钢琴奏鸣曲。

meanings.meaning: 抛弃；被丢弃的东西或人

examples.text: Read the manufacturer's guidelines before discarding the box.
examples.translation: 在丢掉盒子前先看一下制造商的使用说明。

examples.text: ...discarded cigarette butts.
examples.translation: 丢弃的烟头

examples.text: You need a long series of data to be able to discern such a trend...
examples.translation: 你需要一长串的数据才能看出这一趋势。

examples.text: It was hard to discern why this was happening.
examples.translation: 很难弄清楚这为什么会发生。

examples.text: Below the bridge we could just discern a narrow, weedy ditch.
examples.translation: 我们仅能依稀辨出桥下一条杂草丛生的窄沟。

examples.text: He has a broken nose but may be discharged today...
examples.translation: 他鼻梁断了，但或许今天就能出院。

examples.text: You are being discharged on medical grounds.
examples.translation: 出于健康原因你将会退伍。

examples.text: ...the regulation that gay people should be discharged from the military...
examples.translation: 同性恋应该退役的规定

examples.text: Five days later Henry discharged himself from hospital.
examples.translation: 5天后，亨利擅自出院了。

examples.text: He was given a conditional discharge and ordered to pay compensation.
examples.translation: 他被有条件地释放了，被责令支付赔偿款。

examples.text: ...the quiet competence with which he discharged his many college duties.
examples.translation: 他得以胜任众多大学职务的那种内秀

examples.text: The goods will be sold for a fraction of their value in order to discharge the debt.
examples.translation: 货物将被贱价卖出以清偿债务。

examples.text: The resulting salty water will be discharged at sea...
examples.translation: 所产生的盐水将被排入大海。

examples.text: The bird had trouble breathing and was discharging blood from the nostrils.
examples.translation: 那只鸟呼吸困难，并且鼻孔里还在流血。

examples.text: They develop a fever and a watery discharge from their eyes...
examples.translation: 他们开始发烧，眼睛里分泌出一种水状物。

examples.text: All discharges and disposals of radioactive waste from Springfields were within relevant limits.
examples.translation: 斯普林菲尔德所有放射性废料的排放和处理都在限定的范围之内。

examples.text: Lewis was tried for unlawfully and dangerously discharging a weapon.
examples.translation: 刘易斯因非法和不安全的开枪而受到了审判。

examples.text: Order and discipline have been placed in the hands of headmasters and governing bodies.
examples.translation: 维持秩序和纪律的工作已交接给了校长和管理机构了。

examples.text: ...discipline problems in the classroom.
examples.translation: 课堂纪律问题

examples.text: It was that image of calm and discipline that appealed to voters.
examples.translation: 正是那个冷静、自律的形象打动了选民。

examples.text: ...inner disciplines like transcendental meditation...
examples.translation: 内省，如冥思静坐

examples.text: The discipline of studying music can help children develop good work habits.
examples.translation: 音乐学习中的训练可以帮助孩子们培养好的工作习惯。

examples.text: The workman was disciplined by his company but not dismissed...
examples.translation: 那个工人受到了公司的处罚，但并没有被解雇。

examples.text: Her husband had at last taken a share in disciplining the boy.
examples.translation: 她的丈夫最后也加了进来一起教训那个男孩。

examples.text: Out on the course you must discipline yourself to let go of detailed theory...
examples.translation: 在高尔夫球场上，你必须训练自己做到不拘泥于细枝末节的理论。

examples.text: I'm very good at disciplining myself.
examples.translation: 我能做到严格自律。

examples.text: You've got to make sure that people work together across disciplines...
examples.translation: 你必须确保让那些出身不同学科的人一起共事。

examples.text: We're looking for people from a wide range of disciplines.
examples.translation: 我们需要各个学科的人才。

examples.text: Neither side would disclose details of the transaction...
examples.translation: 双方均不肯披露交易细节。

examples.text: The company disclosed that he will retire in May.
examples.translation: 公司透露他将在5月退休。

meanings.meaning: 打折扣；将…贴现；贬损；低估；忽视

examples.text: They are often available at a discount...
examples.translation: 它们经常进行打折销售。

examples.text: Full-time staff get a 20 per cent discount.
examples.translation: 全职员工享受 20% 的折扣。

examples.text: ...a discount store specializing in household goods.
examples.translation: 专营家居用品的折扣店

examples.text: ...discontinued ranges of tiles at discount prices.
examples.translation: 折价出售的已停产的一套瓷砖

examples.text: This has forced airlines to discount fares heavily in order to spur demand...
examples.translation: 这迫使航空公司对机票大幅打折来刺激需求。

examples.text: Tour prices are being discounted as much as 33%.
examples.translation: 旅行价格打了 6.7 折之多。

examples.text: However, traders tended to discount the rumor...
examples.translation: 然而，商人往往不相信这一谣传。

examples.text: This theory has now been discounted.
examples.translation: 这个理论被打了折扣。

examples.text: It may be difficult to do at first. Don't let this discourage you.
examples.translation: 万事开头难，别因此而灰心。

examples.text: She was determined not to be too discouraged.
examples.translation: 她决心不过于气馁。

examples.text: Today's report is rather more discouraging for the economy.
examples.translation: 今天的报道让人对经济更加丧失了信心。

examples.text: ...typhoons that discouraged shopping and leisure activities.
examples.translation: 使购物和休闲活动化为泡影的台风

examples.text: ...a campaign to discourage children from smoking.
examples.translation: 劝阻儿童远离香烟的运动

examples.text: ...a tradition of political discourse.
examples.translation: 政治演讲的传统

examples.text: The Centre has a strong record of research in discourse analysis.
examples.translation: 该中心在语篇分析研究方面成果丰硕。

examples.text: ...our work on discourse and the way people talk to each other.
examples.translation: 我们对话语及人们相互交谈方式的研究

examples.text: Gates responds with a lengthy discourse on deployment strategy.
examples.translation: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

examples.text: He discoursed for several hours on French and English prose.
examples.translation: 他花了几个小时讲述法国和英国的散文。

examples.text: She discovered that they'd escaped...
examples.translation: 她发现他们已经逃跑了。

examples.text: I discovered I was pregnant...
examples.translation: 我发现自己怀孕了。

examples.text: As he discovered, she had a brilliant mind...
examples.translation: 正如他所发现的，她冰雪聪明。

examples.text: It was difficult for the inspectors to discover which documents were important...
examples.translation: 检查员们很难发现哪些文件是重要的。

examples.text: Haskell did not live to discover the deception...
examples.translation: 哈斯克尔至死都没识破那个骗局。

examples.text: It was discovered that the tapes were missing.
examples.translation: 有人发现磁带不见了。

examples.text: A few days later his badly beaten body was discovered on a roadside outside the city.
examples.translation: 几天后，他的尸体在城外的路边被发现，身上有被严重殴打过的痕迹。

examples.text: ...the first European to discover America...
examples.translation: 第一个发现美洲大陆的欧洲人

examples.text: In the 19th century, gold was discovered in California...
examples.translation: 19 世纪时，在加利福尼亚发现了金子。

examples.text: They discovered how to form the image in a thin layer on the surface.
examples.translation: 他们发现了如何在表面薄薄的一层上形成影像。

examples.text: ...the myth of Columbus as the heroic discoverer of the Americas 500 years ago.
examples.translation: 500 年前哥伦布作为发现美洲大陆的英雄人物而具有的传奇色彩

examples.text: I wish I'd discovered photography when I was younger...
examples.translation: 我要是早点接触到摄影技术就好了。

examples.text: Discover the delights and luxury of a private yacht.
examples.translation: 体验私人游艇的乐趣和奢华。

examples.text: The Beatles were discovered in the early 1960's.
examples.translation: 甲壳虫乐队于20世纪60年代初为世人所知。

meanings.meaning: 发现，发觉；被发现的事物

examples.text: I felt I'd made an incredible discovery.
examples.translation: 我觉得我有一个天大的发现。

examples.text: ...the discovery that both his wife and son are HIV positive.
examples.translation: 查出他妻子和儿子艾滋病病毒检测都呈阳性

examples.text: In that year, two momentous discoveries were made.
examples.translation: 那一年，有两个重大发现。

examples.text: ...the discovery of the ozone hole over the South Pole...
examples.translation: 南极上空臭氧洞的发现

examples.text: The fascination of discovery has never left him.
examples.translation: 他一直迷恋发现的魅力。

examples.text: His job is the discovery and promotion of new artists.
examples.translation: 他的任务就是发现并推出艺术新人。

examples.text: ...the discovery and destruction by soldiers of millions of marijuana plants.
examples.translation: 士兵发现并销毁了大量大麻作物

examples.text: They were gossipy and not always discreet...
examples.translation: 他们很爱传闲话，而且常常口无遮拦。

examples.text: He followed at a discreet distance.
examples.translation: 他小心翼翼地尾随在后，保持着一段距离。

examples.text: I took the phone, and she went discreetly into the living room.
examples.translation: 我拿起了电话，她知趣地进了客厅。

examples.text: We were very discreet about the romance...
examples.translation: 我们对这段恋情很谨慎。

examples.text: She's making a few discreet inquiries with her mother's friends.
examples.translation: 她旁敲侧击地向她母亲的朋友们打听过几次。

examples.text: Everyone tried discreetly to find out more about him.
examples.translation: 每个人都言语不露痕迹地试图打探到更多关于他的事。

examples.text: She wore discreet jewellery.
examples.translation: 她戴着素净的首饰。

examples.text: ...stately houses, discreetly hidden behind great avenues of sturdy trees...
examples.translation: 隐藏在林阴大道后面、不显山露水的豪宅

examples.text: The two rooms were relatively small and discreetly lit.
examples.translation: 这两个房间相对来说较小，且灯光柔和。

examples.text: ...the discrepancy between press and radio reports.
examples.translation: 新闻和广播报道之间的出入

examples.text: ...major discrepancies in payments made to claimants in similar circumstances.
examples.translation: 同类情况下索赔人所获款项的巨大差异

examples.text: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one...
examples.translation: 他分不清主意的好坏。

examples.text: The device can discriminate between the cancerous and the normal cells.
examples.translation: 这台仪器可以辨别癌细胞和正常的细胞。

examples.text: They believe the law discriminates against women.
examples.translation: 他们认为该项法律歧视女性。

examples.text: ...legislation which would discriminate in favour of racial minorities...
examples.translation: 偏袒少数种族的立法

examples.text: The Commission for Racial Equality teaches organisations not to discriminate.
examples.translation: 种族平等委员会告诫各家机构不要心存歧视。

examples.text: I will be discussing the situation with colleagues tomorrow...
examples.translation: 明天我会和同事们讨论一下情况。

examples.text: The cabinet met today to discuss how to respond to the ultimatum.
examples.translation: 内阁今天开会商量如何应对这道最后通牒。

examples.text: I will discuss the role of diet in cancer prevention in Chapter 7...
examples.translation: 我会在第7章详细论述日常饮食在抗癌中的作用。

examples.text: Coming up after the news, Dan Schorr discusses the state of the presidential campaign.
examples.translation: 新闻之后，丹·肖尔将带来对总统竞选活动的详细评述。

examples.text: ...the rapid spread of disease in the area.
examples.translation: 疾病在这一区域的迅速蔓延

examples.text: ...illnesses such as heart disease...
examples.translation: 诸如心脏病之类的疾病

examples.text: Doctors believe they have cured him of the disease.
examples.translation: 医生们相信他们已经治好了他的病。

examples.text: ...the wretched disease of racism eating away at the core of our society.
examples.translation: 侵蚀着我们社会核心的种族主义恶疾

meanings.meaning: 耻辱；丢脸的人或事；失宠
使……失宠；给……丢脸；使……蒙受耻辱；贬黜

examples.text: His vice president also had to resign in disgrace...
examples.translation: 他的副总统也被迫不光彩地辞去职务。

examples.text: She has brought disgrace upon womankind.
examples.translation: 她的行为让女性蒙羞。

examples.text: The way the sales were handled was a complete disgrace...
examples.translation: 这种销售手段为人所不齿。

examples.text: The national airline is a disgrace.
examples.translation: 国家航空公司真可耻。

examples.text: Republican leaders called him a disgrace to the party...
examples.translation: 共和党领导人称他是全党的耻辱。

examples.text: What went on was a scandal. It was a disgrace to Britain.
examples.translation: 发生的一切是个丑闻，是给英国抹黑。

examples.text: I have disgraced my family's name...
examples.translation: 我让家人蒙羞。

examples.text: I've disgraced myself by the actions I've taken.
examples.translation: 我的行为让我颜面尽失。

examples.text: He spoke of his disgust at the incident...
examples.translation: 他谈到了他对这件事的厌恶。

examples.text: A look of disgust came over his face...
examples.translation: 他脸上显出厌恶的表情。

examples.text: I threw the book aside in disgust.
examples.translation: 我厌恶地把书扔到一边。

examples.text: He disgusted many with his boorish behaviour.
examples.translation: 他的粗野行为让很多人都讨厌他。

meanings.meaning: 伪装；假装；用作伪装的东西

examples.text: You'll have to travel in disguise...
examples.translation: 你只能乔装出行。

examples.text: He was wearing that ridiculous disguise...
examples.translation: 他一副滑稽的装扮。

examples.text: She's adopted so many disguises her own mother wouldn't recognize her.
examples.translation: 她如此乔装改扮，连她妈妈都认不出她了。

examples.text: She disguised herself as a man so she could fight on the battlefield.
examples.translation: 她女扮男装，这样就可以上战场了。

examples.text: The extremists entered the building disguised as medical workers...
examples.translation: 极端分子伪装成医务工作者进入了大楼。

examples.text: I was heavily disguised.
examples.translation: 我从头到脚伪装了一番。

examples.text: He made no attempt to disguise his agitation...
examples.translation: 他毫不掩饰自己的焦虑不安。

examples.text: Their healthy image disguises the fact that they are highly processed foods...
examples.translation: 它们看上去有益健康，实则掩盖了其为精加工食品这一事实。

examples.text: I played along, and disguised my voice.
examples.translation: 我将错就错，换了一副嗓子说话。

examples.text: This is lust thinly disguised as love.
examples.translation: 这表面是爱，其实是赤裸的欲望。

meanings.meaning: 盘；餐具；一盘食物；外貌有吸引力的人
盛于碟盘中；分发；使某人的希望破灭；说（某人）的闲话

examples.text: ...plastic bowls and dishes...
examples.translation: 塑料碗碟

examples.text: Pile potatoes into a warm serving dish.
examples.translation: 把土豆倒在一个保温的盛菜用的盘子里。

examples.text: Nicholas ate a dish of spaghetti.
examples.translation: 尼古拉斯吃了一盘意大利面条。

examples.text: This dish is best served cold...
examples.translation: 这菜最好凉着吃。

examples.text: There are plenty of vegetarian dishes to choose from.
examples.translation: 有多道素菜可供选择。

examples.text: ...a delicious fish dish.
examples.translation: 一道美味的鱼

examples.text: There were dirty dishes in the sink...
examples.translation: 水槽里放着脏碗。

examples.text: He'd cooked dinner and washed the dishes.
examples.translation: 他做了饭，还洗了碗。

examples.text: ...a dish used to receive satellite broadcasts.
examples.translation: 用来接收卫星广播的碟形卫星天线

examples.text: I hate doing the dishes.
examples.translation: 我讨厌洗碗。

examples.text: We don't serve liver often because so many people dislike it...
examples.translation: 我们不常做肝这道菜，因为很多人吃不惯。

examples.text: David began to dislike all his television heroes who smoked.
examples.translation: 戴维开始讨厌所有他曾喜欢的吸烟的电视偶像了。

examples.text: He made no attempt to conceal his dislike of me...
examples.translation: 他毫不掩饰对我的厌恶。

examples.text: Years of dislike boiled over and blows were exchanged.
examples.translation: 多年的厌恶之情终于爆发，双方拳脚相加。

examples.text: Consider what your likes and dislikes are about your job...
examples.translation: 想想工作中哪些部分是自己喜欢的，哪些是不喜欢的。

examples.text: Strong irrational dislikes of other people can easily be picked up from others.
examples.translation: 对他人无端的厌恶之情别人可以轻易察觉到。

examples.text: I took a violent dislike to him...
examples.translation: 我非常烦他。

examples.text: He may suddenly take a dislike to foods that he's previously enjoyed.
examples.translation: 对以前爱吃的食物，他兴许突然就没了胃口。

examples.text: Local councillors have reacted with dismay and indignation...
examples.translation: 地方政务委员的反应是惊恐和愤怒。

examples.text: Lucy discovered to her dismay that she was pregnant...
examples.translation: 露西惊恐地发现自己怀孕了。

examples.text: The ministers expressed dismay at the continued practice of ethnic cleansing...
examples.translation: 部长们表达了对持续进行的种族清洗的忧虑。

examples.text: Meg looked up at her in dismay.
examples.translation: 梅格抬头焦虑地望了她一眼。

examples.text: The committee was dismayed by what it had been told...
examples.translation: 委员会对所告知的一切很是惊愕。

examples.text: The thought that she was crying dismayed him.
examples.translation: 想到她正在流泪，他伤心不已。

examples.text: He was dismayed at the cynicism of the youngsters...
examples.translation: 他对年轻人的玩世不恭感到惊愕。

examples.text: He was dismayed to find that his hands were shaking.
examples.translation: 他惶恐地发现自己的手正在发抖。

examples.text: ...a rare nerve disorder that can cause paralysis of the arms.
examples.translation: 一种可致手臂瘫痪的罕见的神经疾病

examples.text: ...a psychiatrist who specialises in eating disorders...
examples.translation: 一位长于治疗饮食失调的精神病专家

examples.text: He appeared to be suffering from a severe mental disorder and had served a term in prison.
examples.translation: 他看上去患有严重的精神疾病，而且坐过牢。

examples.text: The emergency room was in disorder...
examples.translation: 急诊室里一片混乱。

examples.text: Inside all was disorder: drawers fallen out, shoes and boots scattered.
examples.translation: 屋内凌乱不堪：抽屉都掉落出来，鞋靴东一只西一只满地都是。

examples.text: He called on the authorities to stop public disorder...
examples.translation: 他呼吁当局制止公众骚乱。

examples.text: There are other forms of civil disorder — most notably, football hooliganism.
examples.translation: 还有其他形式的民众骚乱，最出名的是足球流氓行为。

meanings.meaning: 解散；解雇；开除；让...离开；不予理会、不予考虑

examples.text: Mr Wakeham dismissed the reports as speculation...
examples.translation: 韦克厄姆先生把这些报道当作臆测而不予考虑。

examples.text: I would certainly dismiss any allegations of impropriety by the Labour Party...
examples.translation: 对于工党指责我行为不正当，我当然不会理会。

examples.text: I wouldn't dismiss it out of hand.
examples.translation: 我不会不假思索地摈弃它。

examples.text: I dismissed him from my mind...
examples.translation: 我不再想他了。

examples.text: 'It's been a lovely day,' she said, dismissing the episode.
examples.translation: “这是开心的一天，”她说，将那事抛到了脑后。

examples.text: ...the power to dismiss civil servants who refuse to work...
examples.translation: 开除拒不上班的公务员的权力

examples.text: The military commander has been dismissed.
examples.translation: 军队司令已经被免职了。

examples.text: Two more witnesses were called, heard and dismissed...
examples.translation: 又有两个目击者被传唤，提供证言后获准退席。

examples.text: The hired carriage was dismissed.
examples.translation: 雇来的马车被打发走了。

examples.text: An American judge yesterday dismissed murder charges against Dr Jack Kevorkian.
examples.translation: 昨天一个美国法官驳回了对杰克·凯沃尔基安医生的谋杀指控。

examples.text: ...their attempt to have the case against them dismissed.
examples.translation: 想让指控他们的诉讼案被驳回的企图

meanings.meaning: 取代；置换；转移；把…免职；排水

examples.text: These factories have displaced tourism as the country's largest source of foreign exchange...
examples.translation: 这些工厂已取代旅游业成为该国最大的外汇来源。

examples.text: Coal is to be displaced by natural gas and nuclear power.
examples.translation: 煤炭将让位于天然气和核能。

examples.text: In Europe alone thirty million people were displaced...
examples.translation: 仅在欧洲就有3,000万人被迫背井离乡。

examples.text: Most of the civilians displaced by the war will be unable to return to their homes.
examples.translation: 许多因战乱而流离失所的百姓将无法重返家园。

examples.text: ...the task of resettling refugees and displaced persons.
examples.translation: 重新安置难民和无家可归者的任务

examples.text: The oil appeared to be dispersing...
examples.translation: 油好像在扩散。

examples.text: The intense currents disperse the sewage...
examples.translation: 急流冲散了污水。

examples.text: Because the town sits in a valley, air pollution is not easily dispersed.
examples.translation: 因为小镇坐落在山谷中，空气污染不太容易散去。

examples.text: Police fired shots and used teargas to disperse the demonstrators...
examples.translation: 警方鸣枪并使用催泪弹来驱散示威者。

examples.text: The crowd dispersed peacefully after prayers.
examples.translation: 祈祷仪式过后，人们静静散去。

examples.text: Among the protesters and war veterans proudly displaying their medals was Aubrey Rose...
examples.translation: 在抗议者和骄傲地展示勋章的退伍老兵中，就有奥布里·罗斯。

examples.text: The cabinets display seventeenth-century blue-and-white porcelain.
examples.translation: 展柜中陈列着17世纪的青花瓷。

examples.text: Most of the other artists whose work is on display were his pupils or colleagues.
examples.translation: 其他参展的艺术家大多是他的学生或同事。

examples.text: She displayed her wound to the twelve gentlemen of the jury...
examples.translation: 她给陪审团的 12 位男士看了她的伤口。

examples.text: The chart can then display the links connecting these groups.
examples.translation: 这张图就会显示出这些群体之间的关联。

examples.text: It was unlike Gordon to display his feelings...
examples.translation: 戈登不太可能表露他的情感。

examples.text: He has displayed remarkable courage in his efforts to reform the party.
examples.translation: 在政党改革中，他表现出了非凡的勇气。

examples.text: Normally, such an outward display of affection is reserved for his mother.
examples.translation: 通常，只有在母亲面前他的情感才会如此外露。

examples.text: They started out by looking at the computer screens which display the images...
examples.translation: 他们开始在显示那些图像的电脑屏幕上寻找。

examples.text: Using the option to display only text speeds things up a lot.
examples.translation: 选用纯文本显示可以使速度大幅提升。

examples.text: ...a display of your work...
examples.translation: 你的成果展示

examples.text: She was leaning against a display case of prints of Paris.
examples.translation: 她正倚靠在一个展示巴黎照片的陈列柜上。

examples.text: ...the firework display.
examples.translation: 烟火表演

examples.text: ...gymnastic displays.
examples.translation: 体操表演

examples.text: ...the Royal Air Force Red Arrows display team.
examples.translation: 皇家空军红箭表演队

examples.text: A hard copy of the screen display can also be obtained from a printer.
examples.translation: 屏幕上显示的内容也可以通过打印机打印一份。

examples.text: ...obscure error messages appearing on the display.
examples.translation: 显示器上出现的令人费解的错误信息

examples.text: Do you have this information at your disposal?...
examples.translation: 你对这个情况有所了解吗？

examples.text: He has said he will use all the weapons at his disposal...
examples.translation: 他放出话说他将使出十八般武艺。

examples.text: If I can be of service, I am at your disposal.
examples.translation: 如果我可以效劳的话，敬请吩咐。

examples.text: ...methods for the permanent disposal of radioactive wastes.
examples.translation: 处理放射性废料的一劳永逸的办法

examples.text: ...waste disposal sites.
examples.translation: 废物处理场

examples.text: Before I elaborate on how Boeing won, I need to dispose of one inconvenient truth.

meanings.meaning: 处置；[心理] 性情；[军] 部署；倾向

examples.text: The rides are unsuitable for people of a nervous disposition...
examples.translation: 骑马这一活动不适合天性易紧张的人。

examples.text: He was a man of decisive action and an adventurous disposition.
examples.translation: 他是一个行动果断又爱冒险的人。

examples.text: ...his friendly and cheerful disposition.
examples.translation: 他友善又开朗的个性

examples.text: This has given him a disposition to consider our traditions critically...
examples.translation: 这使他倾向以批判眼光看待我们的传统。

examples.text: They show no disposition to improvise or to take risks.
examples.translation: 他们不愿意临时凑合或冒险。

examples.text: ...to understand the buildings from the disposition of walls and entrances.
examples.translation: 从墙体门窗布局来识别建筑物

examples.text: Judge Stacks was appointed to oversee the disposition of funds.
examples.translation: 斯塔克斯法官被指定监督资金的分配。

examples.text: They have won previous pay disputes with the government...
examples.translation: 在先前和政府的工资纠纷中他们赢了。

examples.text: Negotiators failed to resolve the bitter dispute between the European Community and the United States over cutting subsides to farmers.
examples.translation: 谈判者未能消弭欧共体和美国之间在削减农民补贴一事上的争端。

examples.text: He disputed the allegations...
examples.translation: 他对指控表示怀疑。

examples.text: Nobody disputed that Davey was clever...
examples.translation: 没有人怀疑戴维是聪明的。

examples.text: Some economists disputed whether consumer spending is as strong as the figures suggest.
examples.translation: 一些经济学家怀疑消费性开支是否如数据所显示的那么大。

examples.text: Russia and Ukraine have been disputing the ownership of the fleet...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯和乌克兰一直在争夺舰队的所有权。

examples.text: Fishermen from Bristol disputed fishing rights with the Danes.
examples.translation: 布里斯托尔的渔民与丹麦人争夺捕鱼权。

examples.text: ...a disputed border region.
examples.translation: 有争议的边境地区

examples.text: The two countries are in dispute over the boundaries of their coastal waters...
examples.translation: 两国在近海水域分界线上尚存分歧。

examples.text: It is currently in dispute with the government over price fixing.
examples.translation: 目前在定价上和政府还有争议。

examples.text: All those matters are in dispute and it is not for me to decide them.
examples.translation: 所有这些事项都尚无定论，也不是我可以决定的。

examples.text: He disregarded the advice of his executives...
examples.translation: 他对主管层的建议置若罔闻。

examples.text: Critics say he allowed the police and security forces to disregard human rights.
examples.translation: 批评人士说他听任警察和安全部队漠视人权。

examples.text: Whoever planted the bomb showed a total disregard for the safety of the public.
examples.translation: 无论是谁放置的炸弹都是对公众安全的极端漠视。

meanings.meaning: 破坏；使瓦解；使分裂；使中断；使陷于混乱

examples.text: Anti-war protesters disrupted the debate.
examples.translation: 反战示威者们打断了辩论。

examples.text: The drought has severely disrupted agricultural production.
examples.translation: 旱灾已严重影响了农业生产。

examples.text: The tension in the room had dissipated...
examples.translation: 房间里的紧张气氛消失了。

examples.text: He wound down the windows to dissipate the heat.
examples.translation: 他摇下窗子来散热。

examples.text: ...heat dissipation.
examples.translation: 散热

examples.text: He is dissipating his time and energy on too many different things...
examples.translation: 他在太多不同的事情上浪费时间和精力。

examples.text: Her father had dissipated her inheritance.
examples.translation: 她父亲已经挥霍掉了她继承的遗产。

examples.text: ...the dissipation of my wealth.
examples.translation: 对我财富的挥霍

examples.text: Heat gently until the sugar dissolves...
examples.translation: 慢慢加热直到糖溶解为止。

examples.text: Dissolve the salt in a little boiled water.
examples.translation: 将盐溶解在少许开水中。

examples.text: The committee has been dissolved...
examples.translation: 委员会已经解散了。

examples.text: The King agreed to dissolve the present commission.
examples.translation: 国王同意解散目前的委员会。

examples.text: The present assembly will be dissolved on April 30th...
examples.translation: 现在的议会将于 4 月 30 日解散。

examples.text: Kaifu threatened to dissolve the Parliament and call an election.
examples.translation: 卡夫威胁要解散议会并举行选举。

examples.text: The marriage was dissolved in 1976.
examples.translation: 这段婚姻于1976年结束。

examples.text: His new-found optimism dissolved...
examples.translation: 他刚刚萌生的乐观情绪消失了。

examples.text: Lenny still could not dissolve the nagging lump of tension in his chest.
examples.translation: 莱尼仍不能消除令他不安的紧张感。

examples.text: ...the distance between the island and the nearby shore...
examples.translation: 该岛和附近陆地之间的距离

examples.text: Everything is within walking distance...
examples.translation: 不管什么地方，都是走几步就到了。

examples.text: Geographical distance is also a factor.
examples.translation: 地理距离也是个因素。

examples.text: The distance wouldn't be a problem.
examples.translation: 距离不成问题。

examples.text: I'm doing a theology degree by distance learning.
examples.translation: 我正通过远程教育课程攻读神学学位。

examples.text: ...the emotional distance between them...
examples.translation: 他们之间情感上的疏远

examples.text: There was a vast distance between psychological clues and concrete proof...
examples.translation: 心理提示和确凿证据之间相差甚远。

examples.text: Wilson's intention is to rebuild his career and put distance between himself and his reputation.
examples.translation: 威尔逊打算东山再起，并让自己远离虚名浮誉。

examples.text: We suddenly saw her in the distance...
examples.translation: 我们突然看见她在远处。

examples.text: Mr. Dambar found himself gazing into the distance for a moment or two.
examples.translation: 丹巴先生不知不觉朝远方凝视了片刻。

examples.text: There were periods of sulking, of pronounced distance, of coldness.
examples.translation: 沉闷、明显不友好和冷淡的场面多次出现。

examples.text: The author distanced himself from some of the comments in his book...
examples.translation: 作者使自己书中的某些评论不带个人色彩。

examples.text: Television may actually be distancing the public from the war.
examples.translation: 电视实际上可能让公众远离战争。

examples.text: Clough felt he'd become too distanced from his fans.
examples.translation: 克拉夫感到他和他的仰慕者们过于疏远了。

examples.text: The only way I can cope with my mother is at a distance...
examples.translation: 我可以和我妈妈相处的唯一方法就是保持距离。

examples.text: Now I can look back on the whole tragedy from a distance of forty years.
examples.translation: 时隔40年后，现在我可以回顾整个悲剧了。

examples.text: If you go the distance in a race or sports competition, you continue running or playing until the end of the race or match.
examples.translation: 比赛到底;拼到底

examples.text: More riders than ever are now determined to go the distance.
examples.translation: 现在越来越多的骑手决心赛完全程。

examples.text: Jay had always tended to keep his girlfriends at a distance.
examples.translation: 杰伊一贯和他的女朋友们保持距离。

examples.text: He walked towards the doorway, careful to keep his distance.
examples.translation: 他走向门口，小心翼翼地保持着距离。

meanings.meaning: 蒸馏；滴下；作为精华产生（等于distil）

examples.text: The beauty of a great quote (of the more serious variety) is its power to distill.

meanings.meaning: 遥远的；冷漠的；远隔的；不友好的，冷淡的

examples.text: The mountains rolled away to a distant horizon.
examples.translation: 群山向远处的地平线绵延而去。

examples.text: ...the war in that distant land.
examples.translation: 在那遥远国度的战争

examples.text: There is little doubt, however, that things will improve in the not too distant future...
examples.translation: 不过事情在不久的将来会有所改善，这几乎毋庸置疑。

examples.text: Last summer's drought is a distant memory.
examples.translation: 去年夏天的旱灾已成为遥远的记忆。

examples.text: He's a distant relative of the mayor...
examples.translation: 他是市长的一个远亲。

examples.text: They were distant cousins.
examples.translation: 他们是远房表亲。

examples.text: His father's distantly related to the Royal family.
examples.translation: 他父亲和王室是远亲。

examples.text: He found her cold, ice-like and distant...
examples.translation: 他觉得她冷若冰霜，拒人于千里之外。

examples.text: He is direct and courteous but distant.
examples.translation: 他直截了当且礼数周全，但是态度冷淡。

examples.text: There was a distant look in her eyes from time to time, her thoughts elsewhere.
examples.translation: 她眼中时时流露出心不在焉的神情，思绪已飘至别处。

meanings.meaning: 明显的；独特的；清楚的；有区别的

examples.text: Engineering and technology are disciplines distinct from one another and from science...
examples.translation: 工程学和工艺学互不相同，也有别于自然学科。

examples.text: This book is divided into two distinct parts.
examples.translation: 这本书分为内容不同的两部分。

examples.text: ...a banking industry with two distinctly different sectors.
examples.translation: 涉足两个截然不同领域的银行业

examples.text: ...to impart a distinct flavor with a minimum of cooking fat.
examples.translation: 用最少量的食用油来调出一种独特的口味

examples.text: I distinctly heard the loudspeaker calling passengers for the Turin-Amsterdam flight.
examples.translation: 我清楚地听到扩音器里在请都灵至阿姆斯特丹航班的旅客登机。

examples.text: Now that Tony was no longer present, there was a distinct change in her attitude...
examples.translation: 由于托尼不在场了，她的态度有了明显的转变。

examples.text: I have distinct memories of him in his last years.
examples.translation: 我清楚地记得他最后几年的情况。

examples.text: I distinctly remember wishing I had not got involved.
examples.translation: 我清楚地记得希望自己没有被牵扯进去。

examples.text: Being 6ft 3in tall has some distinct disadvantages!
examples.translation: 身高6英尺3英寸有些明显的不便之处！

examples.text: Another Cup marathon between the two sides is now a distinct possibility.
examples.translation: 双方很可能再进行一场马拉松式的优胜杯比赛。

examples.text: His government is looking distinctly shaky.
examples.translation: 他的政府显然正处于风雨飘摇之中。

examples.text: There's a lot of evidence that oily fish, as distinct from fatty meat, has a beneficial effect.
examples.translation: 有许多证据表明油性鱼，与高脂肪肉不同，对人体有益。

meanings.meaning: 区别；差别；特性；荣誉、勋章

examples.text: There are obvious distinctions between the two wine-making areas...
examples.translation: 两个酿酒地区之间有着显著的差别。

examples.text: The distinction between craft and fine art is more controversial.
examples.translation: 对手工艺和美术之间的差别争议更大。

examples.text: I did not yet make a distinction between the pleasures of reading and of writing fiction...
examples.translation: 我还没有搞清楚阅读的快乐和写小说的快乐有何不同。

examples.text: He draws a distinction between art and culture.
examples.translation: 他区分了艺术和文化的不同。

examples.text: Lewis emerges as a composer of distinction and sensitivity.
examples.translation: 刘易斯作为一位悟性很高的优秀作曲家崭露头角。

examples.text: ...pieces of furniture of distinction.
examples.translation: 一件件精美家具

examples.text: The order was created in 1902 as a special distinction for eminent men and women...
examples.translation: 该勋位设立于1902年，作为一项殊荣授予杰出的男性和女性。

examples.text: I did an M.A. at Liverpool University in Latin American Studies and got a distinction.
examples.translation: 我在利物浦大学以优异成绩获得了拉丁美洲研究方向的硕士学位。

examples.text: He has the distinction of being regarded as the Federal Republic's greatest living writer.
examples.translation: 他才华横溢，被誉为联邦共和国目前尚在世的最伟大的作家。

meanings.meaning: 区分；辨别；使杰出，使表现突出

examples.text: Could he distinguish right from wrong?...
examples.translation: 他能分辨是非吗？

examples.text: Research suggests that babies learn to see by distinguishing between areas of light and dark...
examples.translation: 研究表明婴儿通过辨别光亮和黑暗的区域来学会看东西。

examples.text: It is necessary to distinguish the policies of two successive governments.
examples.translation: 分清前后两届政府的政策很有必要。

examples.text: There is something about music that distinguishes it from all other art forms...
examples.translation: 音乐的某种特质使其有别于所有其他艺术形式。

examples.text: The bird has no distinguishing features.
examples.translation: 这只鸟没有明显的特征。

examples.text: There were cries, calls. He could distinguish voices.
examples.translation: 有哭声、喊声——他能听出不同的声音。

examples.text: Over the next few years he distinguished himself as a leading constitutional scholar...
examples.translation: 在接下来的几年里，他作为一名宪法研究领域最杰出的学者而声名远扬。

examples.text: They distinguished themselves at the Battle of Assaye.
examples.translation: 他们在阿瑟耶之战中一战成名。

examples.text: The media distorts reality; categorises people as all good or all bad...
examples.translation: 媒体会歪曲事实，将人说得不是完美无缺就是一无是处。

examples.text: The minister has said his remarks at the weekend have been distorted.
examples.translation: 部长说他周末的讲话被曲解了。

examples.text: These figures give a distorted view of the significance for the local economy.
examples.translation: 这些数据会使人误解其对地方经济的重要性。

examples.text: A painter may exaggerate or distort shapes and forms...
examples.translation: 画家可能会对线条和形状进行夸大或扭曲。

examples.text: His size was persistently distorted by the cartoonists...
examples.translation: 漫画家们总是把他画得变形了。

examples.text: This caused the sound to distort.
examples.translation: 这导致了声音的失真。

examples.text: Sound was becoming more and more distorted through the use of hearing aids.
examples.translation: 使用助听器会使声音变得越来越失真。

examples.text: Tom admits that playing video games sometimes distracts him from his homework...
examples.translation: 汤姆承认玩电子游戏有时会使他无心做作业。

examples.text: Don't let yourself be distracted by fashionable theories...
examples.translation: 不要让自己被流行的理论分散了注意力。

examples.text: A disturbance in the street distracted my attention.
examples.translation: 街上的一阵骚乱分散了我的注意力。

examples.text: Jealousy causes distress and painful emotions.
examples.translation: 嫉妒会带来忧虑和痛苦。

examples.text: Her mouth grew stiff with pain and distress.
examples.translation: 疼痛和悲伤让她嘴巴发僵。

examples.text: He expressed concern that the ship might be in distress.
examples.translation: 他担心船可能会遇险。

examples.text: The constable received a distress call, and saw two youths attacking his colleague.
examples.translation: 这名警察收到了求救呼叫，看见两个年轻人正在殴打他的同事。

examples.text: The idea of Toni being in danger distresses him enormously.
examples.translation: 想到托尼正处于危险中，他心急如焚。

examples.text: I did not want to frighten or distress the horse.
examples.translation: 我并不想吓到马或惹怒它。

examples.text: Students shouted slogans and distributed leaflets...
examples.translation: 学生们喊着口号，分发着传单。

examples.text: Thousands of soldiers are working to distribute food and blankets to the refugees...
examples.translation: 数以千计的士兵正在给难民们分发食物和毯子。

examples.text: In the move most of the furniture was left to the neighbours or distributed among friends.
examples.translation: 大部分家具在搬家的时候都留给了邻居或送了朋友。

examples.text: We didn't understand how difficult it was to distribute a national paper.
examples.translation: 我们不了解分销一份全国发行的报纸有多难。

examples.text: Immediately after his election he began to distribute major offices among his friends and supporters.
examples.translation: 他当选后立即着手将要职分派给他的朋友和支持者们。

examples.text: Distribute the topping evenly over the fruit.
examples.translation: 将配料均匀地撒在水果上。

meanings.meaning: 打扰；妨碍；使不安；弄乱；使恼怒

examples.text: I hope I'm not disturbing you.
examples.translation: 我希望没有打扰到你。

examples.text: Find a quiet, warm, comfortable room where you won't be disturbed.
examples.translation: 找一个安静、温暖、舒适且不会被打扰到的房间。

examples.text: I dream about him, dreams so vivid that they disturb me for days...
examples.translation: 我几次梦见了他，梦境如此逼真，我好几天都心神不宁。

examples.text: He had been disturbed by the news of the attack on Hector Coyne.
examples.translation: 赫克托·科因受袭的消息让他焦虑不安。

examples.text: He'd placed his notes in the brown envelope. They hadn't been disturbed...
examples.translation: 他将笔记放到那个棕色的信封里了，并没有人动过。

examples.text: She patted Mona, taking care not to disturb her costume.
examples.translation: 她轻轻拍了拍莫娜，小心翼翼地，生怕弄乱她的戏服。

examples.text: Neither Baker nor Levy seemed eager to disturb the cordial atmosphere by discussing more sensitive issues...
examples.translation: 贝克和利维似乎都不愿谈及更为敏感的话题而破坏了友好的氛围。

examples.text: What could possibly disturb such tranquility?
examples.translation: 什么有可能会破坏这样的宁静呢？

examples.text: I drove around the business district.
examples.translation: 我开车在商业区转了转。

examples.text: ...Nashville's shopping district.
examples.translation: 纳什维尔的购物区

examples.text: ...a summer holiday hike in the Lake District...
examples.translation: 夏日假期在湖区的远足

examples.text: Varieties of these crops have been collected from all around the district.
examples.translation: 这些不同的作物已从该地区各处收集起来。

examples.text: ...the home of the governor of the district.
examples.translation: 该区行政长官的家

examples.text: ...the continuing support of Glasgow District Council.
examples.translation: 格拉斯哥行政区政务委员会一直以来给予的支持

examples.text: ...the district health authority.
examples.translation: 区卫生局

examples.text: During the disturbance which followed, three Englishmen were hurt.
examples.translation: 在接下来的骚乱中，3名英国人受伤。

examples.text: ...the worst of last September'sdisturbances.
examples.translation: 去年9月最严重的骚乱

examples.text: The home would cause less disturbance to local residents than a school...
examples.translation: 养老院对当地居民造成的干扰会比学校小。

examples.text: The animals are very sensitive to disturbance and have never bred in captivity.
examples.translation: 这些动物对外界的干扰很敏感，且从未被圈养过。

examples.text: Poor educational performance is related to emotional disturbance.
examples.translation: 糟糕的学习成绩与情绪失常有关。

examples.text: ...the treatment of certain heart rhythm disturbances.
examples.translation: 某种心律失常的治疗方法

meanings.meaning: 在…上掘沟；把…开入沟里；丢弃

examples.text: I decided to ditch the sofa bed.
examples.translation: 我决定把沙发床扔了。

examples.text: Unpopular policies such as unilateral disarmament were ditched.
examples.translation: 诸如单边裁军之类不得人心的政策已被废除了。

examples.text: I can't bring myself to ditch him and start again.
examples.translation: 我不忍心蹬掉他再觅新欢。

examples.text: One American pilot was forced to ditch his jet in the Gulf...
examples.translation: 一位美国飞行员被迫将喷气式飞机紧急迫降在波斯湾上。

examples.text: A survivor was knocked unconscious when the helicopter ditched.
examples.translation: 在直升机紧急迫降时，一名幸存者被撞昏过去。

meanings.meaning: 潜水；跳水；俯冲；急剧下降

examples.text: He tried to escape by diving into a river...
examples.translation: 他企图跳入河中逃跑。

examples.text: She was standing by a pool, about to dive in...
examples.translation: 她站在水池旁边，正要往里跳。

examples.text: Joanne had just learnt to dive.
examples.translation: 乔安妮刚学会跳水。

examples.text: Pat had earlier made a dive of 80 feet from the Chasm Bridge.
examples.translation: 帕特早先曾从80英尺高的峡谷大桥上俯冲跳下。

examples.text: Bezanik is diving to collect marine organisms.
examples.translation: 贝扎尼奇正在潜水采集海洋生物。

examples.text: This sighting occurred during my dive to a sunken wreck off Sardinia.
examples.translation: 这是我在撒丁岛附近的沉船残骸处潜水时所见的景象。

examples.text: ...a pelican which had just dived for a fish...
examples.translation: 刚刚潜入水中捕鱼的鹈鹕

examples.text: The shark dived down and swam under the boat.
examples.translation: 鲨鱼急速潜入水中，在船下游动。

examples.text: He was killed when his monoplane stalled and dived into the ground.
examples.translation: 他因驾驶的单翼飞机失速坠地而丧生。

examples.text: Witnesses said the plane failed to pull out of a dive and smashed down in a field.
examples.translation: 目击者说飞机未能从俯冲状态下重新拉起，坠毁在了田间。

examples.text: They dived into a taxi...
examples.translation: 他们迅速钻进一辆出租车。

examples.text: The cashier dived for cover when a gunman opened fire...
examples.translation: 出纳员在持枪歹徒开枪时冲向藏身处。

examples.text: He would dive under one obstacle, round another, and lightly step over a third.
examples.translation: 他会从一个障碍的下面冲过去，绕过另一个，再轻轻地跨过第三个。

examples.text: He made a sudden dive for Uncle Jim's legs to try to trip him up.
examples.translation: 他突然扑过去抱吉姆叔叔的腿，想把他撂倒。

examples.text: She dived into her bag and brought out a folded piece of paper.
examples.translation: 她立即将手伸入包中拿出一张折好的纸。

examples.text: If we cut interest rates, the pound would dive...
examples.translation: 如果我们降低利率，英镑就会大幅贬值。

examples.text: Profits have dived from £7.7m to £7.1m...
examples.translation: 利润从770万英镑暴跌至710万英镑。

examples.text: The shares dived 22p to 338p.
examples.translation: 股票暴跌22便士，收于338便士。

examples.text: Stock prices took a dive.
examples.translation: 股价暴跌。

examples.text: We've played in all the little pubs and dives around Liverpool.
examples.translation: 我们在利物浦所有的小酒吧和低级夜总会演出过。

meanings.meaning: 不同的；多种多样的；变化多的

examples.text: ...shops selling a diverse range of gifts...
examples.translation: 出售各种礼品的商店

examples.text: Society is now much more diverse than ever before.
examples.translation: 当今社会较之以往任何时候都要丰富多彩得多。

examples.text: Jones has a much more diverse and perhaps younger audience.
examples.translation: 琼斯的观众群更为多样化而且可能更年轻。

examples.text: The robbers threw smoke bombs to create a diversion...
examples.translation: 劫匪扔烟幕弹来转移人们的视线。

examples.text: The whole argument is a diversion.
examples.translation: 这场辩论分散了人们的注意力。

examples.text: Finger painting is very messy but an excellent diversion.
examples.translation: 用手指画画是很脏，但却是一项极好的消遣。

examples.text: They turned back because of traffic diversions.
examples.translation: 因为交通要临时绕行，他们掉头了。

examples.text: ...the illegal diversion of profits from secret arms sales.
examples.translation: 秘密军火交易所获利润的非法转移

examples.text: ...the diversion of a ship to Lebanon with $8m worth of aluminium on board.
examples.translation: 前往黎巴嫩的装有价值800万美元铝的船只改换航道

examples.text: ...Rainham Marshes, east London, where a new bypass will divert traffic from the A13...
examples.translation: 伦敦东部的雷纳姆泽，那儿有一条新的旁道将会分流 A13 公路的交通

examples.text: During the strike, ambulances will be diverted to private hospitals...
examples.translation: 在罢工期间，救护车将被转到私人医院去。

examples.text: We diverted a plane to rescue 100 passengers...
examples.translation: 我们让一架飞机改变航线去营救 100 名乘客。

examples.text: She insists on diverting to a village close to the airport...
examples.translation: 她坚持改道去机场附近的一个村庄。

examples.text: The capital remained jammed with diverted traffic.
examples.translation: 尽管实行了交通分流，首都依旧很堵。

examples.text: The government is trying to divert more public funds from west to east.
examples.translation: 政府正试图将更多的公共基金从西部转到东部。

examples.text: ...government departments involved in diverting resources into community care.
examples.translation: 负责将资源用于社区保健的政府部门

examples.text: He instructed switchboard staff to divert all Laura's calls to him.
examples.translation: 他让总机接线员将劳拉所有的电话都转给他。

examples.text: Customers will only incur additional call charges if the call is diverted outside the UK.
examples.translation: 只有当电话被转接到英国之外，客户才会被加收额外的电话费。

examples.text: They want to divert the attention of the people from the real issues.
examples.translation: 他们想要把人们的注意力从真正的问题上转移开。

examples.text: The President needed to divert attention away from his own economic record.
examples.translation: 总统需要将人们的视线从他以往在经济上的表现上转移开。

meanings.meaning: 划分；除；分开；使产生分歧

examples.text: The physical benefits of exercise can be divided into three factors...
examples.translation: 运动对身体的好处可以分为3个方面。

examples.text: It will be easiest if we divide them into groups...
examples.translation: 如果我们将他们分成小组将是最简单的。

examples.text: Divide the pastry in half and roll out each piece...
examples.translation: 把油酥面团一分为二，再分别擀成皮。

examples.text: We divide into pairs and each pair takes a region...
examples.translation: 我们分成两人一组，每一组负责一个区域。

examples.text: Bacteria reproduce by dividing and making copies of themselves.
examples.translation: 细菌通过分裂和自我复制来繁殖。

examples.text: Paul divides most of his spare time between the study and his bedroom...
examples.translation: 保罗在大部分空闲时间里要么呆在书房里，要么呆在卧室里。

examples.text: Divide the sauce among 4 bowls.
examples.translation: 把酱汁分到 4 个碗里。

examples.text: Measure the floor area of the greenhouse and divide it by six.
examples.translation: 量一下温室的建筑面积再将它除以 6。

examples.text: ...remote border areas dividing Tamil and Muslim settlements.
examples.translation: 将泰米尔聚居区和穆斯林聚居区隔开的偏远边境地区

examples.text: ...the artificial line that divides the city.
examples.translation: 划分城市的人为分界线

examples.text: ...the long frontier dividing Mexico from the United States.
examples.translation: 墨西哥和美国之间绵长的边界线

examples.text: She has done more to divide the Conservatives than anyone else...
examples.translation: 她在分裂保守党这件事上所起的作用比任何人都大。

examples.text: The democrats are divided over whether to admit him into their group...
examples.translation: 民主党人就是否允许他加入他们的组织意见不一。

examples.text: The party is likely to divide along ideological lines.
examples.translation: 该党有可能在意识形态上产生分歧。

examples.text: ...a deliberate attempt to create a Hindu-Muslim divide in India.
examples.translation: 故意在印度的印度教徒和穆斯林之间制造分歧的企图

examples.text: The time had come to cross the great divide between formality and truth.
examples.translation: 是时候跨越形式与真理之间的巨大分界线了。

examples.text: The government's policies of divide and rule have only contributed to the volatility of the region.
examples.translation: 政府分而治之的政策只是加剧了该地区的不稳定性。

meanings.meaning: 红利；股息；[数] 被除数；奖金

examples.text: The first quarter dividend has been increased by nearly 4 per cent.
examples.translation: 第一季度的股息增长了近 4%。

examples.text: Steps taken now to maximise your health will pay dividends later on.
examples.translation: 现在采取措施增强体质会使你日后受益。

meanings.meaning: 神圣的；非凡的；天赐的；极好的
占卜；预言；使用占卜勘探矿

examples.text: He suggested that the civil war had been a divine punishment.
examples.translation: 他暗示说内战是上天的惩罚。

examples.text: ...divine inspiration.
examples.translation: 天赐的灵感

examples.text: The law was divinely ordained.
examples.translation: 律法神定。

examples.text: 'Isn't it divine?' she said. 'I wish I had the right sort of brooch to lend you for it.'...
examples.translation: “它是不是美极了？”她说道，“真希望我有合适的胸针可以借给你来搭配它。”

examples.text: Darling how lovely to see you, you look simply divine.
examples.translation: 亲爱的，见到你太让人高兴了，你看上去简直美极了。

examples.text: ...divinely glamorous singer Jeffrey McDonald.
examples.translation: 浑身魅力四射的歌唱家杰弗里·麦克唐纳

examples.text: ...the child's ability to divine the needs of its parents and respond to them...
examples.translation: 孩子猜测父母的需要并作出回应的能力

examples.text: From this he divined that she did not like him much.
examples.translation: 他依此猜到她不太喜欢他。

examples.text: The only reason I was divining for water was because of the drought.
examples.translation: 我之所以探寻水源是因为发生了旱灾。

examples.text: ...a divining rod.
examples.translation: 探测杆

examples.text: Numerous marriages now end in divorce...
examples.translation: 现在许多婚姻都以离婚收场。

examples.text: Their divorce became final this weekend...
examples.translation: 他们离婚一事在这周末尘埃落定。

examples.text: The divorce proceedings have accelerated.
examples.translation: 离婚的诉讼程序已经加快。

examples.text: My parents divorced when I was very young...
examples.translation: 我很小的时候父母就离婚了。

examples.text: He and Lillian had got divorced...
examples.translation: 他和莉莲已离婚了。

examples.text: I am absolutely furious that he divorced me to marry her...
examples.translation: 他为了娶她而和我离婚，我愤怒至极。

examples.text: Mr Gold is divorcing for the second time...
examples.translation: 戈尔德先生正准备第二次离婚。

examples.text: I got divorced when I was about 31.
examples.translation: 我在 31 岁左右离了婚。

examples.text: ...this divorce of Christian culture from the roots of faith...
examples.translation: 基督教文化和信仰根基的脱离

examples.text: This process is, in no sense, a divorce between the Labour Party and the trade union movement.
examples.translation: 这个进程绝不是工党和工会运动相脱离。

examples.text: Good management in the police cannot be divorced from accountability...
examples.translation: 对警察队伍的良好管理和应负的责任是分不开的。

examples.text: We have been able to divorce sex from reproduction.
examples.translation: 我们已经能够将性和生育完全分开了。

meanings.meaning: [数] 除法；部门；分割；师（军队）；赛区

examples.text: ...the unification of Germany, after its division into two states at the end of World War Two.
examples.translation: 二战结束时曾被一分为二的德国实现了统一

examples.text: The current division of labor between workers and management will alter.
examples.translation: 当前工人与管理部门的分工将会改变。

examples.text: I taught my daughter how to do division at the age of six.
examples.translation: 女儿6岁时我就教她如何做除法了。

examples.text: The division between the prosperous west and the impoverished east remains.
examples.translation: 繁荣的西部和贫穷的东部之间的差距仍然存在。

examples.text: ...the bank's Latin American division.
examples.translation: 该银行的拉丁美洲分部

examples.text: ...the sales division.
examples.translation: 销售部

examples.text: Several armoured divisions are being moved from Germany.
examples.translation: 正从德国调动几个装甲师。

examples.text: Villa had just been relegated from the First Division.
examples.translation: 维拉队刚刚从甲级联赛中降级。

examples.text: ...the Scottish Premier Division leaders, Dundee United.
examples.translation: 苏格兰超级联赛的领头羊，邓迪联队

meanings.meaning: 晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的
使头晕眼花；使混乱；使茫然

examples.text: Her head still hurt, and she felt slightly dizzy and disoriented...
examples.translation: 她的头还痛，并且觉得有些晕头转向。

examples.text: He began to get dizzy spells.
examples.translation: 他开始一阵阵地头晕。

examples.text: Her head spins dizzily as soon as she sits up.
examples.translation: 她一坐起来头就晕。

examples.text: His complaint causes dizziness and nausea.
examples.translation: 他的病引起了头晕和恶心。

examples.text: She is famed for playing dizzy blondes.
examples.translation: 她以扮演金发傻妞而闻名。

examples.text: ...a charmingly dizzy great-grandmother.
examples.translation: 一位迷人的大大咧咧的曾祖母

examples.text: The sudden height dizzied her and she clung tightly.
examples.translation: 突然上升的高度让她晕头转向，她抓得紧紧的。

examples.text: We're descending now at dizzying speed.
examples.translation: 我们正以令人眩晕的速度下降。

examples.text: I escalated to the dizzy heights of director's secretary.
examples.translation: 我升到了总经理秘书这一显赫高位。

meanings.meaning: 码头；船坞；被告席；尾巴的骨肉部分

examples.text: ...the loading dock...
examples.translation: 装货码头

examples.text: She headed for the docks, thinking that Ricardo might be hiding in one of the boats...
examples.translation: 她走向码头，想着里卡多可能正藏在其中一条船上。

examples.text: What other ships are in dock here?
examples.translation: 这儿的码头还有其他什么船只？

examples.text: The vessel docked at Liverpool in April 1811...
examples.translation: 这艘轮船于 1811 年 4 月在利物浦靠岸。

examples.text: Russian commanders docked a huge aircraft carrier in a Russian port...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯指挥官指挥一艘巨型航空母舰驶入一个俄罗斯港口。

examples.text: The aircraft carrier has been docked there since last month.
examples.translation: 自上个月以来那艘航空母舰就一直停靠在那儿。

examples.text: The space shuttle Atlantis is scheduled to dock with Russia's Mir space station...
examples.translation: 亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机计划与俄国和平号空间站对接。

examples.text: They have docked a robot module alongside the orbiting space station...
examples.translation: 他们已经将一个自动操作舱与沿轨道运行的空间站并行对接上了。

examples.text: The shuttle will spend five days docked with Mir.
examples.translation: 航天飞机将和和平号对接5天。

examples.text: The truck left the loading dock with hoses still attached.
examples.translation: 卡车驶离装货月台时塑料水龙带还连在上面。

examples.text: He had a house there and a dock and a little aluminum boat.
examples.translation: 他在那儿有一所房子、一个泊船的码头和一艘小铝船。

examples.text: What about the odd chance that you do put an innocent man in the dock?
examples.translation: 若是你真的把一个无辜的人送上被告席了呢？

examples.text: He threatens to dock her fee...
examples.translation: 他威胁要扣掉她的服务费。

examples.text: To dock points would be wrong.
examples.translation: 扣分的判罚是错误的。

examples.text: He obtained his doctorate in Social Psychology.
examples.translation: 他获得了社会心理学博士学位。

meanings.meaning: 修理；篡改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位

examples.text: Do not discontinue the treatment without consulting your doctor...
examples.translation: 未经医嘱不要擅自中断治疗。

examples.text: Doctor Paige will be here right after lunch to see her.
examples.translation: 佩奇医生一吃完午饭就会来这儿看她。

examples.text: I have an appointment at the doctors.
examples.translation: 我在诊所有个预约。

examples.text: He is a doctor of philosophy.
examples.translation: 他是哲学博士。

examples.text: They doctored the prints to make her look as awful as possible.
examples.translation: 他们修改了照片，尽可能地丑化她的容貌。

examples.text: ...a cleverly doctored photograph.
examples.translation: 巧妙加工的照片

examples.text: The doctoring of the document has become a live political issue.
examples.translation: 对文件的篡改伪造已成为当下让人关注的政治问题。

examples.text: She had no doubt that it was he who had doctored her milk.
examples.translation: 她毫不怀疑是他在她的牛奶里下了药。

examples.text: ...doctored wine.
examples.translation: 掺了药的酒

meanings.meaning: 要求；规定；C大调音阶中的第一音
做；干；学习；研究；进行；完成；解答；整理；算出；引起；行过
助动词（构成疑问句和否定句）；（代替动词）；（用于加强语气）
（口语）事件；（主英国口语）诈骗；（主英国、新西兰口语）宴会；（口语）必须做到的事情

examples.text: They don't want to work...
examples.translation: 他们不想工作。

examples.text: I did not know Jamie had a knife...
examples.translation: 我不知道杰米有一把刀。

examples.text: It doesn't matter if you win or lose.
examples.translation: 你是赢是输都无所谓。

examples.text: Do you like music?...
examples.translation: 你喜欢音乐吗？

examples.text: What did he say?...
examples.translation: 他说了什么？

examples.text: Where does she live?
examples.translation: 她住在哪里？

examples.text: You know about Andy, don't you?...
examples.translation: 你知道安迪的情况，是不是？

examples.text: I'm sure they had some of the same questions last year, didn't they?
examples.translation: 我确定他们去年遇到过一些同样的问题，是不是？

examples.text: 'Did he think there was anything suspicious going on?' — 'Yes, he did.'...
examples.translation: “他认为有可疑的事发生吗?”——“是的，他认为有。”

examples.text: 'Do you have a metal detector?' — 'No, I don't.'...
examples.translation: “你有金属探测仪吗?”——“不，我没有。”

examples.text: They say they don't care, but they do.
examples.translation: 他们嘴上说不在乎，其实是在乎的。

examples.text: Don't be silly...
examples.translation: 别犯傻了。

examples.text: Don't touch that!
examples.translation: 别碰那个!

examples.text: Veronica, I do understand...
examples.translation: 韦罗妮卡，我确实懂了。

examples.text: You did have a tape recorder with you.
examples.translation: 你确实带了录音机。

examples.text: Do sit down...
examples.translation: 请坐。

examples.text: Do help yourself to another drink.
examples.translation: 再来一杯吧。

examples.text: I make more money than he does...
examples.translation: 我挣钱比他多。

examples.text: One day she will walk out, just as her own mother did...
examples.translation: 总有一天她会离家出走，就像她母亲那样。

examples.text: I had fantasies, as do all mothers, about how life would be when my girls were grown...
examples.translation: 和所有母亲一样，我对女儿们长大后的生活怀有幻想。

examples.text: Girls receive less health care and less education in the developing world than do boys.
examples.translation: 在发展中国家女孩接受到的医疗保健服务和教育比男孩要少。

examples.text: You know that's true, and so do I...
examples.translation: 你知道那是真的，我也知道。

examples.text: We don't forget that. Nor does he...
examples.translation: 我们没有忘记那事，他也没有。

examples.text: Her actions and thoughts became distorted. So did her behavior.
examples.translation: 她的行动和思想变得扭曲了，她的态度也是。

examples.text: I was trying to do some work...
examples.translation: 我当时正想要干点活。

examples.text: After lunch Elizabeth and I did the washing up...
examples.translation: 吃过午饭后，我和伊丽莎白洗了碗。

examples.text: Dad does the garden...
examples.translation: 爸爸收拾花园。

examples.text: Let me do your hair.
examples.translation: 让我来给你做头发。

examples.text: What are you doing?...
examples.translation: 你在干什么？

examples.text: So tell me what this molecule does that makes it special...
examples.translation: 那么告诉我这个分子有何作用而使其与众不同。

examples.text: Think twice before doing anything...
examples.translation: 三思而行。

examples.text: A lot of people got arrested for looting so they will think before they do it again...
examples.translation: 之前很多人因抢劫而被捕，所以他们不敢再轻举妄动。

examples.text: I'm glad they gave me my money back, but I think they did this to shut me up...
examples.translation: 我很高兴他们把钱还给我了，但是我认为他们这么做是为了堵我的嘴。

examples.text: The first thing is to get some more food. When we've done that we ought to start again...
examples.translation: 首先要弄到更多的食物，这之后我们应该重新开始。

examples.text: Brian counted to twenty and lifted his binoculars. Elena did the same...
examples.translation: 布赖恩数到 20，举起了双筒望远镜。埃琳娜也照着做了。

examples.text: He turned towards the open front door but, as he did so, she pushed past him.
