examples.translation: 他转身走向开着的前门，但与此同时，她从他旁边挤过去了。

examples.text: All she does is complain...
examples.translation: 她只知道抱怨。

examples.text: What I should do is go and see her...
examples.translation: 我应该去看她。

examples.text: The best that can be done is to make things as difficult as possible.
examples.translation: 最好的办法就是把事情弄得尽可能地难办。

examples.text: I was allowed to do whatever I wanted with my life...
examples.translation: 我可以自由支配自己的生活。

examples.text: What did he do with the thirty pounds?...
examples.translation: 他用这30英镑干了什么？

examples.text: The technology was good, but you couldn't do much with it.
examples.translation: 这项技术不错，但用处不大。

examples.text: They refuse to do anything about the real cause of crime: poverty...
examples.translation: 他们拒绝采取措施解决引发犯罪的真正问题：贫穷。

examples.text: Well, what are you going to do about it?...
examples.translation: 嗯，你打算怎么处理它呢？

examples.text: Sexual harassment, that's against the law. Something should be done about it...
examples.translation: 性骚扰是违法的，应该对此采取一些措施。

examples.text: If an engine packs in, there's not much the engineer can do about it until the plane is back on the ground.
examples.translation: 如果引擎坏了，那么在飞机着陆之前工程师也无能为力。

examples.text: A few bombs can do a lot of damage...
examples.translation: 几枚炸弹就可以造成严重破坏。

examples.text: It'll do you good to take a rest...
examples.translation: 休息一下对你有好处。

examples.text: The publicity did her career no harm.
examples.translation: 媒体的报道对她的事业没有坏处。

examples.text: The current reforms will do much to create these conditions...
examples.translation: 当前的改革对创造这些条件大有帮助。

examples.text: They did everything they could to help us...
examples.translation: 他们竭尽所能来帮助我们。

examples.text: He said that the opposition had done everything possible to sabotage the elections...
examples.translation: 他说对手已经使出一切可能的手段来破坏选举。

examples.text: Such incidents do nothing for live music's reputation...
examples.translation: 这类事件对于提高现场音乐的名声没有任何帮助。

examples.text: I'd just tried to do what I could for Lou.
examples.translation: 我刚刚为卢竭尽所能。

examples.text: I saw what the liquor was doing to her...
examples.translation: 我发现烈酒对她伤害很大。

examples.text: You overlook the pressure you're under and what it does to you.
examples.translation: 你忽视了你所承受的压力及它带给你的后果。

examples.text: What does your father do?...
examples.translation: 你父亲做什么工作？

examples.text: He knew what he wanted to do from the age of 14.
examples.translation: 他14岁起就知道自己日后干什么了。

examples.text: Are you doing anything tomorrow night?...
examples.translation: 你明天晚上有计划吗？

examples.text: 'What are you doing for Christmas?' Ella asked. 'We're going to Aunt Molly's.'...
examples.translation: “圣诞节你打算做什么？”埃拉问到。“我们打算去莫莉姨妈家。”

examples.text: There is nothing to do around here.
examples.translation: 在这无事可做。

examples.text: Connie did well at school and graduated with honours...
examples.translation: 康妮在学校表现很好，以优异的成绩毕业了。

examples.text: Out-of-town superstores are doing well...
examples.translation: 市郊的超市经营良好。

examples.text: How did I do?
examples.translation: 我表现怎样？

examples.text: They provide design services and do printing and packaging...
examples.translation: 他们提供设计服务，还进行印刷和包装。

examples.text: They do a good range of herbal tea.
examples.translation: 他们经营种类繁多的花草茶。

examples.text: They were doing 70 miles an hour.
examples.translation: 他们的速度达到了每小时 70 英里。

examples.text: His catamaran will do 37 knots.
examples.translation: 他的双体船的速度可以达到 37 节。

examples.text: I'd like to do maths at university.
examples.translation: 我希望在大学里学数学。

examples.text: So you did 'Macbeth' in the first year?' — 'No, in the first year we did 'Julius Caesar'.'
examples.translation: “那么你在第一年时学了《麦克白》?”——“不，第一年我们学的是《恺撒大帝》。”

examples.text: Gina does accents extremely well.
examples.translation: 吉娜模仿口音惟妙惟肖。

examples.text: 'Can't you be nicer to your sister?' — 'Nice? I don't do nice'.
examples.translation: “难道你不能对你妹妹好一点吗？”——“对她好？我做不到。”

examples.text: I don't do drugs.
examples.translation: 我不吸毒。

examples.text: I saw him doing ecstasy in the toilets.
examples.translation: 我看见他在洗手间吃摇头丸。

examples.text: Anything to create a scene and attract attention will do...
examples.translation: 任何能引起争吵、吸引注意力的事情都可以。

examples.text: We need a win — a draw won't do at all...
examples.translation: 我们需要一场胜利，平局根本不行。

examples.text: 'What would you like to eat?' — 'Anything'll do me, Eva.'
examples.translation: “你想吃什么？”——“我吃什么都行，伊娃。”

examples.text: I could do with a cup of tea...
examples.translation: 我需要一杯茶。

examples.text: The range could do with being extended.
examples.translation: 范围需要扩展。

examples.text: What did you do with that notebook?
examples.translation: 你把那个笔记本放哪儿了？

examples.text: 'Dr Campbell,' he said, clearly surprised. 'What are you doing here?'
examples.translation: “坎贝尔医生，”他显然很惊讶地说道，“您怎么在这儿?”

examples.text: What was he doing in Hyde Park at that time of the morning?
examples.translation: 那么一大早他在海德公园干什么？

examples.text: Mr Butterfield denies having anything to do with the episode...
examples.translation: 巴特菲尔德先生否认和此事有关。

examples.text: They were shouting at each other. It was something to do with money...
examples.translation: 他们在吵架，是为了钱的事。

examples.text: That's none of your business, it has nothing to do with you...
examples.translation: 那不关你的事，与你八竿子打不着。

examples.text: A lot of this has to do with power and greed.
examples.translation: 凡此种种都和权力与贪欲有关。

examples.text: A friend of his is having a do in Stoke...
examples.translation: 他的一位朋友正在斯托克举办宴会。

examples.text: They always have all-night dos there.
examples.translation: 他们经常在那儿闹通宵。

examples.text: Please advise me on the most suitable colour print film and some dos and don'ts.
examples.translation: 请向我推荐最合适的彩色胶卷，并告诉我一些注意事项。

examples.text: ...a TV documentary on homelessness.
examples.translation: 探讨无家可归问题的电视纪录片

examples.text: We have documentary evidence that they were planning military action.
examples.translation: 我们有书面证据证明他们正在策划军事行动。

meanings.meaning: 文件，公文；[计] 文档；证件

examples.text: The foreign ministers of the two countries signed the documents today.
examples.translation: 两国的外交大臣今天签署了文件。

examples.text: ...a policy document for the Labour Party conference...
examples.translation: 为工党大会准备的政策文件

examples.text: The policeman wanted to see all our documents.
examples.translation: 警察想查看我们所有的证件。

examples.text: When you are finished typing, remember to save your document.
examples.translation: 完成录入后，记得将文档存盘。

examples.text: He wrote a book documenting his prison experiences...
examples.translation: 他写书详细记录了他的狱中经历。

examples.text: The effects of smoking have been well documented.
examples.translation: 有关吸烟的影响记录翔实。

meanings.meaning: 洋娃娃；玩偶；无头脑的美丽女人
(Doll)人名；(英)多尔(女子教名Dorothea和Dorothy的昵称)；(西)多利

examples.text: She was dolled up for the occasion.
examples.translation: 她为这个活动精心打扮。

meanings.meaning: 狗；丑女人；卑鄙的人；(俚)朋友

examples.text: Outside, a dog was barking...
examples.translation: 外面，一只狗在叫。

examples.text: The dog growled again...
examples.translation: 狗又在狂吠。

examples.text: The British are renowned as a nation of dog lovers.
examples.translation: 英国人以爱犬而闻名。

examples.text: Is this a dog or a bitch?
examples.translation: 这是公狗还是母狗?

examples.text: ...a dog fox.
examples.translation: 公狐狸

examples.text: It's a real dog.
examples.translation: 这实在是蹩脚货。

examples.text: How can you go out with her? She's a real dog.
examples.translation: 你怎么能和她谈恋爱呢？她简直就是个恐龙。

examples.text: The problems that have dogged him all year are just a temporary setback...
examples.translation: 一时的挫折竟困扰了他一整年。

examples.text: His career has been dogged by bad luck.
examples.translation: 他在事业上一直不走运。

examples.text: The whole place was a bit of a dog's dinner, really...
examples.translation: 整个地方乌烟瘴气的，真的。

examples.text: Our own Board are going to make a dog's breakfast out of it if we aren't careful.
examples.translation: 如果我们不小心行事，我们的董事会就会乱成一团。

examples.text: It is very much dog eat dog out there...
examples.translation: 那儿的竞争异常残酷。

examples.text: The TV business today is a dog-eat-dog business.
examples.translation: 当前电视业的竞争残酷无情。

examples.text: They sit in impotent opposition while the country goes to the dogs.
examples.translation: 国家败落之际，他们加入了软弱无力的反对党。

examples.text: Why can't she let sleeping dogs lie?
examples.translation: 为什么她就不能不多事？

examples.text: She gets paid seven dollars an hour...
examples.translation: 她的报酬是每小时 7元。

examples.text: The government is spending billions of dollars on new urban rail projects.
examples.translation: 政府正把数十亿元花在新城市铁路项目上。

examples.text: In early trading in Tokyo, the dollar fell sharply against the yen.
examples.translation: 在东京市场早市开盘时，美元对日元的比价急剧下跌。

examples.text: Japanese investors once paid top dollar for the most glamorous hotels in the United States.
examples.translation: 日本投资者曾为投资美国高档酒店一掷千金。

examples.text: ...the great experimenters in the domain of art...
examples.translation: 艺术领域伟大的实验者们

examples.text: This information should be in the public domain.
examples.translation: 这一消息应该为公众所知。

examples.text: ...the mighty king's domain.
examples.translation: 势力强大的国王的领土

examples.text: ...the dome of St Paul's cathedral.
examples.translation: 圣保罗大教堂的圆顶

examples.text: ...the dome of the hill.
examples.translation: 山丘的圆顶

meanings.meaning: 国内的；家庭的；驯养的；一心只管家务的

examples.text: ...over 100 domestic flights a day to 15 UK destinations.
examples.translation: 每天超过100架次国内航班飞往英国境内15个目的地

examples.text: ...sales in the domestic market.
examples.translation: 国内市场的销售量

examples.text: Opportunities will improve as the company expands domestically and internationally...
examples.translation: 随着国内业务和国际业务的扩展，该公司将获得更好的机会。

examples.text: Domestically, he's going to make some compromises that he doesn't want to make.
examples.translation: 他打算在国内做些他不想做的让步。

examples.text: ...a plan for sharing domestic chores.
examples.translation: 分担家务活的计划

examples.text: ...domestic appliances.
examples.translation: 家用器具

examples.text: It was a scene of such domestic bliss...
examples.translation: 这是一幅家庭如此幸福的画面。

examples.text: I was called out to attend a domestic dispute.
examples.translation: 我被叫出去解决一场家庭纠纷。

examples.text: She was kind and domestic and put her family before her part-time job.
examples.translation: 她人很好也顾家，把家庭看得比兼职工作更为重要。

examples.text: ...a domestic cat.
examples.translation: 家猫

meanings.meaning: 显性的；占优势的；支配的，统治的

examples.text: ...a change which would maintain his party's dominant position in Scotland...
examples.translation: 将使他的政党在苏格兰继续占据支配地位的变化

examples.text: She was a dominant figure in the French film industry.
examples.translation: 她在法国电影界是个举足轻重的人物。

examples.text: Because it is carried by a dominant gene, an affected individual can expect about half of his or her children to inherit the illness.
examples.translation: 因为它是由显性基因携带，所以感染者的孩子会有约50％的可能性遗传该疾病。

meanings.meaning: 控制；支配；占优势；在…中占主要地位

examples.text: The book is expected to dominate the best-seller lists...
examples.translation: 这本书预计会占据畅销书排行榜的榜首。

examples.text: ...countries where life is dominated by war...
examples.translation: 战事频繁的国家

examples.text: No single factor appears to dominate.
examples.translation: 没有一个因素看似是决定性的。

examples.text: ...the domination of the market by a small number of organizations.
examples.translation: 少数机构对市场的垄断

examples.text: He denied that his country wants to dominate Europe...
examples.translation: 他否认他的国家想要控制欧洲。

examples.text: Women are no longer dominated by the men in their relationships...
examples.translation: 在两性关系中女性不再受制于男性。

examples.text: The countries of Eastern Europe immediately started to dominate.
examples.translation: 东欧国家立即开始占据支配地位。

examples.text: They had five centuries of domination by the Romans.
examples.translation: 他们被罗马人统治了 5 个世纪。

examples.text: It's one of the biggest buildings in this area, and it really dominates this whole place.
examples.translation: 这是该地区最大的建筑物之一，雄踞在整个地区之上。

examples.text: ...its skyline dominated by the central mosque.
examples.translation: 中央的清真寺高耸天际

examples.text: He frequently donates large sums to charity...
examples.translation: 他常常向慈善机构捐赠大笔钱款。

examples.text: Others donated secondhand clothes...
examples.translation: 其他人捐赠了一些旧衣服。

examples.text: The silver trophy was donated by a Leicester businessman.
examples.translation: 银制奖杯是由一个莱斯特的商人捐赠的。

examples.text: ...the donation of his collection to the art gallery.
examples.translation: 向美术馆捐献收藏品

examples.text: ...people who are willing to donate their organs for use after death...
examples.translation: 愿意死后捐献器官的人们

examples.text: All donated blood is screened for HIV.
examples.translation: 所献血液一律要经过人体免疫缺陷病毒的筛查。

examples.text: ...measures aimed at encouraging organ donation.
examples.translation: 旨在鼓励器官捐献的措施

examples.text: I've been a vegetarian for donkey's years.
examples.translation: 多年以来我一直是个素食者。

examples.text: ...old iron mines that haven't been used in donkey's years.
examples.translation: 废弃已久的旧铁矿

meanings.meaning: 厄运；死亡；判决；世界末日

examples.text: ...his warnings of impending doom.
examples.translation: 他关于大难临头的警告

examples.text: ...a wicked mermaid who lured sailors to their doom.
examples.translation: 引诱水手走向灭亡的邪恶的美人鱼

examples.text: Why are people so full of gloom and doom?...
examples.translation: 为什么人们如此沮丧悲观？

examples.text: Attendance figures had been steadily dropping, creating a mood of doom and discouragement among theatre directors.
examples.translation: 上座人数一直持续下降，使得戏剧导演产生悲观泄气的情绪。

examples.text: That argument doomed their marriage to failure.
examples.translation: 那次争吵使他们的婚姻注定要失败。

examples.text: I knocked at the front door, but there was no answer...
examples.translation: 我敲了敲前门，没有人应。

examples.text: The policeman opened the door and looked in...
examples.translation: 警察打开门朝里面看。

examples.text: I heard a door slamming.
examples.translation: 我听到门砰地关上了。

examples.text: She looked through the door of the kitchen. Her daughter was at the stove.
examples.translation: 她从厨房门口朝里看，发现女儿站在炉子旁。

examples.text: He entered Harrods by the main door...
examples.translation: 他从正门进入了哈罗德商场。

examples.text: The queues at the door wound around the building.
examples.translation: 门口的队伍绕了大楼一圈。

examples.text: Mrs Cade's house was only a few doors down from her daughter's apartment.
examples.translation: 凯德夫人的房子和她女儿的公寓就隔了几户人家。

examples.text: Carol answered the door as soon as I knocked.
examples.translation: 我一敲门，卡萝尔就来开了。

examples.text: The government would not allow anyone to sneak in by the back door and seize power by force...
examples.translation: 政府不会允许任何人偷偷混进来并用暴力攫取政权。

examples.text: They claim the Government is privatising dentistry through the back door.
examples.translation: 他们声称政府正通过不正当的手段将牙医业私有化。

examples.text: We never close the door on a successful series.
examples.translation: 我们从不把成功的系列节目拒之门外。

examples.text: ...decisions taken in secret behind closed doors.
examples.translation: 背地里秘密作出的决定

examples.text: They are going from door to door collecting money from civilians.
examples.translation: 他们挨家挨户地向百姓收钱。

examples.text: ...a door-to-door salesman...
examples.translation: 上门推销员

examples.text: Police immediately started door-to-door inquiries.
examples.translation: 警察立即展开了挨家挨户的盘查。

examples.text: ...tickets covering the whole journey from door to door...
examples.translation: 全程票

examples.text: Flying out on Friday from Gatwick it took seven hours door-to-door.
examples.translation: 星期五从盖特威克起飞全程需要 7 个小时。

examples.text: The bondholding may help the firm get its foot in the door to win the business...
examples.translation: 债券的持有可能是有助于该公司赢得业务的第一步。

examples.text: The Philips deal also gives Sparc a foot in the door of a new market — consumer electronics.
examples.translation: 与飞利浦公司的交易也使斯巴克得以进入一个新市场——消费类电子产品。

examples.text: Did you say anything to him or just shut the door in his face?
examples.translation: 你跟他说什么了吗，还是直接给了他个闭门羹？

examples.text: I'm notsure his death can be laid at medicine's door alone...
examples.translation: 我不确信他的死亡单单是药物所致。

examples.text: The blame is generally laid at the door of the government.
examples.translation: 通常谴责的矛头都会指向政府。

examples.text: This book opens the door to some of the most exciting findings in solid-state physics...
examples.translation: 这本书介绍了固态物理中一些最激动人心的发现。

examples.text: Researchers are pushing back the frontiers and opening doors to reveal why things happen and how things work.
examples.translation: 研究者们拓展了其研究领域，介绍并揭示了事物发生的原因和机理。

examples.text: The weather was fine enough for working out of doors.
examples.translation: 天气太好了，适合户外工作。

examples.text: Would they forgive and forget — or show him the door?
examples.translation: 他们会既往不咎吗——还是会对他下逐客令呢？

examples.text: Hannah looked up to see David and another man standing in the doorway...
examples.translation: 汉娜抬头看见戴维和另一个男的站在门口。

examples.text: We were escorted through a low doorway.
examples.translation: 我们在人陪同下穿过一条低矮的门道。

examples.text: ...homeless people sleeping in shop doorways.
examples.translation: 睡在商店门口无家可归的人们

examples.text: The minutes dragged past...
examples.translation: 时间一分钟一分钟地熬过去。

examples.text: The pacing was uneven, and the early second act dragged.
examples.translation: 节奏忽快忽慢，第二幕前半场太过拖沓。

examples.text: The satellite acts as a drag on the shuttle...
examples.translation: 卫星成了航天飞机的累赘。

examples.text: Spending cuts will put a drag on growth.
examples.translation: 缩减开支会减缓增长速度。

examples.text: As far as shopping for clothes goes, it's a drag...
examples.translation: 逛街买衣服是件挺没意思的事。

examples.text: A dry sandwich is a drag to eat.
examples.translation: 放干的三明治很难吃。

examples.text: He took a drag on his cigarette, and exhaled the smoke.
examples.translation: 他吸了一口烟，吐出了烟雾。

examples.text: The drag of those extra air molecules brought the satellite crashing to Earth.
examples.translation: 额外的空气分子阻力使得卫星坠毁到了地球上。

examples.text: Entertainment is laid on too, in the form of drag on Wednesdays and strippers on Sundays...
examples.translation: 还安排了娱乐活动，星期三是男扮女装演出，星期天是脱衣舞演出。

examples.text: The neighborhood is given over to performers, stilt walkers and drag queens.
examples.translation: 社区变成了玩杂耍的、踩高跷的和扮装皇后的天地。

examples.text: The band dressed up in drag.
examples.translation: 乐队的人都穿着女装。

examples.text: The government, he claimed, was dragging its feet.
examples.translation: 他声称政府在故意拖延。

meanings.meaning: 龙；凶暴的人，凶恶的人；严厉而有警觉性的女人
(Dragon)人名；(匈)德劳贡；(英、法、芬、罗、匈)德拉贡

examples.text: Last year, Dragon orbited the Earth twice and splashed down successfully in the Pacific Ocean.

meanings.meaning: 戏剧，戏剧艺术；剧本；戏剧性事件

examples.text: He acted in radio dramas.
examples.translation: 他在广播剧中扮演角色。

examples.text: He knew nothing of Greek drama...
examples.translation: 他对希腊戏剧一无所知。

examples.text: She met him when she was at drama school.
examples.translation: 她在戏剧学校上学时认识了他。

examples.text: There was none of the drama and relief of a hostage release...
examples.translation: 丝毫没有释放人质时的那种激动和如释重负的感觉。

examples.text: For all its drama, the event was not unexpected.
examples.translation: 虽然这件事带有戏剧性，但并不意外。

meanings.meaning: 喝光，耗尽；使流出；排掉水
排水；下水道，排水管；消耗

examples.text: Miners built the tunnel to drain water out of the mines...
examples.translation: 矿工们开凿了一条地道，以排出矿井里的水。

examples.text: Now the focus is on draining the water...
examples.translation: 现在的重点是把水排走。

examples.text: Springs and rivers that drain into lakes carry dissolved nitrates and phosphates...
examples.translation: 流入湖中的泉水和河水携带了溶于水的硝酸盐和磷酸盐。

examples.text: The water slowly drained away, down through the porous soil.
examples.translation: 水慢慢流走了，渗入了疏松的土壤。

examples.text: Vast numbers of people have been mobilised to drain flooded land...
examples.translation: 大量的人力被动员去排干受涝的土地。

examples.text: The soil drains freely and slugs aren't a problem.
examples.translation: 土壤排水畅通，鼻涕虫就不会造成什么麻烦。

examples.text: Drain the pasta well, arrange on four plates and pour over the sauce...
examples.translation: 将意大利面中的水分滤干，放在4个盘子里再淋上调味汁。

examples.text: Wash the leeks thoroughly and allow them to drain.
examples.translation: 彻底清洗韭葱，再沥去水分。

examples.text: Tony built his own house and laid his own drains.
examples.translation: 托尼自己盖了房子并铺设了下水管道。

examples.text: ...storm drains.
examples.translation: 排洪管

examples.text: Pamela drained her glass and refilled it.
examples.translation: 帕梅拉喝完后又续了一杯。

examples.text: Harry felt the colour drain from his face...
examples.translation: 哈里觉得他脸上的血色在消失。

examples.text: Thacker's face drained of colour...
examples.translation: 撒克面无人色。

examples.text: Jock's face had been suddenly drained of all colour...
examples.translation: 乔克的脸突然变得煞白。

examples.text: His usually florid complexion seemed drained of colour.
examples.translation: 他通常红润的脸色看上去没有了血色。

examples.text: And then, suddenly, the euphoria began to drain away...
examples.translation: 随后，狂喜的感觉突然开始消失了。

examples.text: She felt the tension drain out of her...
examples.translation: 她感到紧张情绪在消失。

examples.text: The happiness and the excitement had been drained completely from her voice.
examples.translation: 幸福和激动已经完全从她的声音中消失了。

examples.text: My emotional turmoil had drained me.
examples.translation: 纷乱的情绪让我心力交瘁。

examples.text: United left the pitch looking stunned and drained.
examples.translation: 曼联队离开球场时看上去备受打击，身心俱疲。

examples.text: This work is physically exhausting and emotionally draining.
examples.translation: 这项工作让人身心交瘁。

examples.text: As his energy drained away, his despair and worry grew...
examples.translation: 当他的精力耗尽时，他的绝望和担心也增加了。

examples.text: I can help resolve conflicts that drain energy.
examples.translation: 我可以帮助解决消耗精力的冲突。

examples.text: He could rest only when he was too drained of energy to fret further.
examples.translation: 只有当他精疲力竭无力再操心时他才能得以休息。

examples.text: ...an ultra-modern printing plant, which has been a big drain on resources...
examples.translation: 资源消耗很大的超现代印刷厂

examples.text: Fraud trials are often complex and have become an expensive drain on the public purse.
examples.translation: 诈骗案通常错综复杂，会给公共资金造成巨大损失。

examples.text: The state's finances have been drained by war...
examples.translation: 国家财力已经被战争消耗殆尽。

examples.text: The company has steadily drained its cash reserves.
examples.translation: 公司已逐渐用完了其现金储备。

examples.text: They were aware that their public image was rapidly going down the drain...
examples.translation: 他们意识到他们的公众形象正迅速被毁掉。

examples.text: He lamented that four years of his life had gone down the drain because of an injury to his groin.
examples.translation: 他痛惜他四年的生活就因大腿根部的伤被毁掉了。

examples.text: Small local stores are going down the drain.
examples.translation: 当地的小店都倒闭了。

meanings.meaning: 戏剧的；引人注目的；激动人心的

examples.text: A fifth year of drought is expected to have dramatic effects on the California economy...
examples.translation: 第五年遭受旱灾预计会对加利福尼亚的经济产生巨大的影响。

examples.text: This policy has led to a dramatic increase in our prison populations.
examples.translation: 这项政策已经让我们监狱的囚犯人数激增。

examples.text: At speeds above 50mph, serious injuries dramatically increase.
examples.translation: 时速超过50英里，重伤率会大大增加。

examples.text: He witnessed many dramatic escapes as people jumped from as high as the fourth floor...
examples.translation: 他目睹了许多人从五层高的楼上跳下来逃生的惊险场面。

examples.text: Their arrival was dramatic and exciting.
examples.translation: 他们的到来令人激动不已，难以忘怀。

examples.text: He tipped his head to one side and sighed dramatically.
examples.translation: 他把头歪向一边，重重地叹了口气。

examples.text: ...a dramatic arts major in college...
examples.translation: 大学里戏剧艺术专业的学生

examples.text: I had no thoughts of making a dramatic film. I was working in documentary.
examples.translation: 我没想过要拍一部剧情片，我正在拍一部纪录片。

examples.text: Drastic measures are needed to clean up the profession...
examples.translation: 行业清理整顿需要严厉的措施。

examples.text: He's not going to do anything drastic about economic policy.
examples.translation: 他不打算对经济政策作任何重大调整。

examples.text: Elderly people are not in a position to make drastic changes at this stage of their life...
examples.translation: 上了年纪的人在他们这个人生阶段不会再有什么实质性的改变。

examples.text: ...a drastic reduction in the numbers of people dying.
examples.translation: 死亡人数的大幅下降

examples.text: As a result, services have been drastically reduced.
examples.translation: 结果是服务业急剧萎缩。

examples.text: He felt the apartment's only drawback was that it was too small.
examples.translation: 他觉得这个公寓唯一的缺点就是太小了。

meanings.meaning: 抽屉；开票人；出票人；起草者；酒馆侍

examples.text: He opened a drawer in his writing-table.
examples.translation: 他打开了写字台的一个抽屉。

examples.text: She would sit there drawing with the pencil stub...
examples.translation: 她会坐在那儿用铅笔头画画。

examples.text: Draw a rough design for a logo...
examples.translation: 画一个公司标志的草图。

examples.text: He starts a painting by quickly drawing simplified shapes.
examples.translation: 他画图时先快速勾勒出大致的轮廓。

examples.text: I like dancing, singing and drawing.
examples.translation: 我喜欢跳舞、唱歌和画画。

examples.text: Claire had seen the taxi drawing away...
examples.translation: 克莱尔看到出租车缓缓开走了。

examples.text: A carriage door struck him as a train drew into Basildon station.
examples.translation: 当火车驶进巴斯尔登站时，一节车厢的门撞到他了。

examples.text: She drew away and did not smile...
examples.translation: 她慢慢走开了，脸上没有笑容。

examples.text: When we drew level, he neither slowed down nor accelerated.
examples.translation: 当我们齐头并进时，他既没有慢下来也没有加速。

examples.text: He drew his chair nearer the fire...
examples.translation: 他把椅子拉到离炉火更近的位置。

examples.text: He put his arm around Caroline's shoulders and drew her close to him...
examples.translation: 他一只手臂搂住卡罗琳的肩膀，将她拉近自己。

examples.text: Wilson drew me aside after an interview.
examples.translation: 采访后威尔逊把我拉到了一边。

examples.text: After drawing the curtains, she lit a candle...
examples.translation: 拉上窗帘后，她点燃了蜡烛。

examples.text: Mother was lying on her bed, with the blinds drawn.
examples.translation: 母亲正躺在床上，百叶窗已经拉了下来。

examples.text: He drew his dagger and turned to face his pursuers.
examples.translation: 他拔出匕首转身面向追他的人。

examples.text: ...a slow-moving tractor, drawing a trailer.
examples.translation: 拖着一辆挂车的移动缓慢的拖拉机

examples.text: ...a chariot drawn by six black mules.
examples.translation: 6 匹黑色骡子拉着的一辆双轮敞篷马车

examples.text: He paused, drawing a deep breath.
examples.translation: 他停了下来，深深地吸了口气。

examples.text: He drew on an American cigarette...
examples.translation: 他抽着一根美国产的香烟。

examples.text: Her cheeks hollowed as she drew smoke into her lungs.
examples.translation: 当她把烟吸进肺里时，她的双颊瘪了下去。

examples.text: Villagers still have to draw their water from wells.
examples.translation: 村民们仍然要从井里打水。

examples.text: Any practice that draws blood could increase the risk of getting the virus.
examples.translation: 任何引起出血的做法都可能会增加感染病毒的危险。

examples.text: She was drawing out cash from a cash machine...
examples.translation: 她正从自动提款机中取钱。

examples.text: Companies could not draw money from bank accounts as cash.
examples.translation: 公司不能从银行账户中提取现金。

examples.text: For the first few years I didn't draw any salary at all...
examples.translation: 在开始的几年里我分文未取。

examples.text: He is moving ever closer to drawing his pension.
examples.translation: 他就要领取养老金了。

examples.text: We delved through a sackful of letters to draw the winning name...
examples.translation: 我们把手探进一袋信件中抽取获奖者。

examples.text: Aston Villa have drawn a Czech team in the first round of the UEFA Cup.
examples.translation: 欧洲联盟杯首轮阿斯顿维拉队抽到了一支捷克球队。

examples.text: ...the draw for the quarter-finals of the UEFA Cup.
examples.translation: 欧洲联盟杯四分之一决赛的抽签

examples.text: I draw strength from the millions of women who have faced this challenge successfully...
examples.translation: 我从数百万成功面对这种挑战的女性身上汲取力量。

examples.text: The students are drawn from a cross-section of backgrounds.
examples.translation: 这些学生是从成长背景具代表性的候选群体中选取出来的。

examples.text: He draws two conclusions from this...
examples.translation: 他从这件事中得出两个结论。

examples.text: He says he cannot yet draw any conclusions about the murders.
examples.translation: 他说他还不能对几起谋杀下结论。

examples.text: ...literary critics drawing comparisons between George Sand and George Eliot...
examples.translation: 将乔治·桑德和乔治·艾略特进行比较的文学评论家

examples.text: Interesting distinctions can be drawn between the two populations.
examples.translation: 比较两类人可以发现有趣的差异。

examples.text: He was waving his arms to draw their attention...
examples.translation: 他正挥手以引起他们的注意。

examples.text: He just wants to draw attention to the plight of the unemployed.
examples.translation: 他仅仅是想引起人们对失业者困境的关注。

examples.text: Such a policy would inevitably draw fierce resistance from farmers.
examples.translation: 这种政策必然会招致农场主的强烈抵制。

examples.text: ...an official tour to South Africa which drew angry political reactions.
examples.translation: 引起政治上的愤怒反应的一次官方的南非之行

examples.text: The game is currently drawing huge crowds.
examples.translation: 这个游戏现在吸引了很多人。

examples.text: He drew and enthralled her...
examples.translation: 他令她动心，让她着迷。

examples.text: What drew him to the area was its proximity to central London.
examples.translation: 吸引他到该地区的原因是那里靠近伦敦市中心。

examples.text: The ambassador would not be drawn on questions of a political nature...
examples.translation: 大使不会对政治问题发表意见。

examples.text: 'Did he say why?' — 'No, he refuses to be drawn.'
examples.translation: “他说为什么了吗？”——“没有,他拒绝透露任何消息。”

examples.text: Holland and the Republic of Ireland drew one-one...
examples.translation: 荷兰队和爱尔兰队打成了一比一平。

examples.text: We drew with Ireland in the first game...
examples.translation: 在第一场比赛中我们和爱尔兰队打平了。

examples.text: Egypt drew two of their matches in Italy.
examples.translation: 埃及在意大利收获了两场平局。

examples.text: We were happy to come away with a draw against Sweden.
examples.translation: 我们很高兴能和瑞典队战平。

examples.text: Another celebration had drawn to its close.
examples.translation: 又一场庆典结束了。

examples.text: And all the time next spring's elections are drawing closer...
examples.translation: 明年春天的选举即将来临。

examples.text: As the day set for departure drew near, I told my wife that I could not accompany them.
examples.translation: 起程的日子就要到了,我告诉妻子我不能陪他们了。

examples.text: I'm dreading Christmas this year...
examples.translation: 今年我非常害怕过圣诞节。

examples.text: I dreaded coming back, to be honest...
examples.translation: 说实话,我生怕回来。

examples.text: I suffer badly from cold sores and dread them appearing on my wedding day...
examples.translation: 我的唇疱疹很严重，我真担心它会在我的婚礼上发作。

examples.text: I'd been dreading that the birth would take a long time.
examples.translation: 我一直十分担心分娩会花很长时间。

examples.text: She thought with dread of the cold winters to come.
examples.translation: 她害怕即将来临的寒冷冬季。

examples.text: ...a more effective national policy to combat this dread disease.
examples.translation: 对抗这可怕疾病的更有效的国家政策

examples.text: ...the dread phrase 'politically correct'.
examples.translation: 令人不快的短语“政治上正确”

examples.text: I dread to think what will happen in the case of a major emergency...
examples.translation: 我不敢想在重大紧急情况下会发生什么。

examples.text: I dread to think what Hollywood is planning to do with this interesting little story.
examples.translation: 我不敢想好莱坞打算如何处理这个有趣的小故事。

examples.text: She did a drawing of me.
examples.translation: 她给我画了张像。

meanings.meaning: 梦的；理想的；不切实际的

examples.text: He had a dream about Claire...
examples.translation: 他梦见了克莱尔。

examples.text: I had a dream that I was in an old study, surrounded by leather books.
examples.translation: 我梦见我在一间古老的书房里,四周全是皮装书。

examples.text: Ivor dreamed that he was on a bus...
examples.translation: 艾弗梦见他在一辆公共汽车上。

examples.text: She dreamed about her baby.
examples.translation: 她梦见了她的宝宝。

examples.text: He had finally accomplished his dream of becoming a pilot...
examples.translation: 他最终实现了成为一名飞行员的梦想。

examples.text: My dream is to have a house in the country...
examples.translation: 我梦想在乡间拥有一栋房子。

examples.text: You can make that dream come true.
examples.translation: 你可以让那个梦想实现。

examples.text: As a schoolgirl, she had dreamed of becoming an actress...
examples.translation: 她上学时曾梦想成为一名女演员。

examples.text: For most of us, a brand new designer kitchen is something we can only dream about...
examples.translation: 对我们大多数人来说,一间崭新的由著名设计师设计的厨房只能是一种梦想。

examples.text: I dream that my son will attend college and find a good job.
examples.translation: 我希望儿子能上大学并找到一份好工作。

examples.text: He had his dream house built on the banks of the river Bure.
examples.translation: 他在布尔河畔建造了他的梦幻屋。

examples.text: ...a dream holiday to Jamaica.
examples.translation: 牙买加梦幻之旅

examples.text: Greece is said to be a botanist's dream...
examples.translation: 据说希腊是植物学家梦寐以求的地方。

examples.text: He's every girl's dream!
examples.translation: 他是所有姑娘的梦中情人！

examples.text: When the right woman comes along, this bad dream will be over.
examples.translation: 当有合适的女人出现时,这种胡思乱想就会停止了。

examples.text: I wouldn't dream of making fun of you...
examples.translation: 我绝不会取笑你。

examples.text: My sons would never dream of expecting their clothes to be ironed.
examples.translation: 我的几个儿子从不指望别人帮他们熨好衣服。

examples.text: I never dreamed that I would be able to afford a home here...
examples.translation: 我从没想到我在这儿能买得起房子。

examples.text: Who could ever dream of a disaster like this?...
examples.translation: 谁能想到会发生这样的灾难？

examples.text: I find life more charming and more astonishing than I'd ever dreamed.
examples.translation: 我发现生活比我想象的更迷人、更不可思议。

examples.text: 'Perhaps one day I may go on a relaxing holiday.' — 'Yeah, dream on.'
examples.translation: “也许有一天我可以享受一个放松身心的假期。”——“是啊,你就做梦吧。”

examples.text: All day long I moved in a dream.
examples.translation: 整整一天我都心不在焉。

examples.text: She cooked like a dream...
examples.translation: 她烹饪技艺精湛。

examples.text: His ship had sailed like a dream.
examples.translation: 他的船行驶十分顺畅。

examples.text: This could be the man of my dreams.
examples.translation: 这就是我理想中的男子。

examples.text: Never in my wildest dreams did I think we could win.
examples.translation: 我做梦也没想到我们会赢。

examples.text: She had already achieved success beyond her wildest dreams.
examples.translation: 她已经取得超乎想象的成功。

examples.text: She was wearing a black dress.
examples.translation: 她穿一条黑色连衣裙。

examples.text: He's usually smart in his dress.
examples.translation: 他通常穿得很精神。

examples.text: ...hundreds of Cambodians in traditional dress.
examples.translation: 数百名身着传统服装的柬埔寨人

examples.text: He told Sarah to wait while he dressed...
examples.translation: 他让萨拉等他穿好衣服。

examples.text: Sue had dressed herself neatly for work.
examples.translation: 休穿戴整洁地上班去了。

examples.text: She bathed her and dressed her in clean clothes.
examples.translation: 她给她洗澡并穿上干净的衣服。

examples.text: He dresses in a way that lets everyone know he's got authority...
examples.translation: 他的穿着打扮让大家都知道他已经掌权了。

examples.text: She used to dress in jeans.
examples.translation: 她过去常穿牛仔裤。

examples.text: We don't dress for dinner here.
examples.translation: 我们这儿赴宴不穿礼服。

examples.text: The poor child never cried or protested when I was dressing her wounds.
examples.translation: 我给这个可怜的孩子包扎伤口时,她不哭也不闹。

examples.text: Scatter the tomato over, then dress the salad.
examples.translation: 把西红柿散放在上面,然后给色拉加调味汁。

examples.text: ...a bowl of dressed salad.
examples.translation: 一碗已调制好的色拉

examples.text: Her mother dressed the meat.
examples.translation: 她母亲把肉洗好了。

examples.text: ...dressed crab.
examples.translation: 洗好的螃蟹

examples.text: We proceeded to drift on up the river...
examples.translation: 我们继续向河流的上游漂流。

examples.text: The climbing balloon drifted silently over the countryside...
examples.translation: 不断上升的气球静静地飘过乡间。

examples.text: The waves became rougher as they drifted.
examples.translation: 他们漂流的时候,波浪越来越汹涌了。

examples.text: We need to offer young people drifting into crime an alternative set of values...
examples.translation: 我们需要给那些无意间犯了罪的年轻人灌输另一套价值观。

examples.text: She and her husband drifted apart and, eventually, they divorced...
examples.translation: 她和她丈夫渐行渐远,最后他们离婚了。

examples.text: There is a general sense that the country and economy alike are drifting.
examples.translation: 大家普遍感觉国家和经济都脱离了正轨。

examples.text: You've been drifting from job to job without any real commitment.
examples.translation: 你一直在无目的地更换工作，从未真正投入进去。

examples.text: ...the drift towards the cities.
examples.translation: 涌向城市的趋势

examples.text: As rural factories shed labour, people drift towards the cities.
examples.translation: 由于农村的工厂纷纷裁员,人们逐渐流向城市。

examples.text: Cool summer dance sounds are drifting from the stereo indoors.
examples.translation: 清凉的夏日舞曲的声音从室内音响中传了出来。

examples.text: The snow, except where it drifted, was only calf-deep...
examples.translation: 除了吹得堆积起来的地方,雪只有小腿肚深。

examples.text: The storm caused severe drifting.
examples.translation: 暴风雪造成了严重的积雪现象。

examples.text: ...the white and drifted snow.
examples.translation: 白色的积雪

examples.text: ...a nine-foot snow drift.
examples.translation: 9英尺深的雪堆

examples.text: There was a drift of smoke above the trees.
examples.translation: 树林上空飘浮着一股烟。

examples.text: Grace was beginning to get his drift...
examples.translation: 格雷丝慢慢明白了他的意思。

examples.text: Anybody who's listening will get the drift of what he was saying...
examples.translation: 任何一个在专心听的人都会领悟他所说的大意。

examples.text: I follow the drift of her conversation.
examples.translation: 我明白她谈话的大意。

meanings.meaning: 训练；钻孔机；钻子；播种机

examples.text: ...pneumatic drills.
examples.translation: 风钻

examples.text: ...a dentist's drill.
examples.translation: 牙钻

examples.text: He drilled into the wall of Lili's bedroom...
examples.translation: 他在莉莉卧室的墙上钻了个孔。

examples.text: I drilled five holes at equal distance.
examples.translation: 我钻了 5 个等间距的孔。

examples.text: There have been proposals to drill for more oil...
examples.translation: 有人提议钻探更多的石油。

examples.text: The team is still drilling.
examples.translation: 钻探队还在钻探。

examples.text: Drilling is due to start early next year.
examples.translation: 钻探将于明年早些时候开工。

examples.text: The teacher runs them through a drill — the days of the week, the weather and some counting.
examples.translation: 老师带他们做了反复练习：一周中每一天的叫法、天气和数数。

examples.text: He drills the choir to a high standard.
examples.translation: 他将合唱团训练到了一个高水平。

examples.text: ...stimulation rather than repetitive drilling.
examples.translation: 激励而不是重复性操练

examples.text: The Marines carried out a drill that included 18 ships and 90 aircraft...
examples.translation: 海军陆战队进行了有 18 艘军舰和 90 架飞机参与的训练。

examples.text: His hands were clasped behind him like a drill sergeant.
examples.translation: 他双手背在身后，像一个教官。

examples.text: ...a fire drill.
examples.translation: 消防演习

examples.text: ...air-raid drills.
examples.translation: 防空演习

examples.text: ...cotton drill.
examples.translation: 厚斜纹棉布

examples.text: Sow the seeds in drills about 1/2in. deep and 12in. apart.
examples.translation: 在深约 0.5 英寸,间隔 12 英寸的条播沟里播种。

examples.text: He drank his cup of tea...
examples.translation: 他喝他的那杯茶。

examples.text: They'd stopped drinking beer and started on tequila...
examples.translation: 他们已经不喝啤酒了,开始喝龙舌兰酒了。

examples.text: He drank thirstily from the pool under the rock.
examples.translation: 他饥渴地喝着岩石下水潭中的水。

examples.text: He was smoking and drinking too much...
examples.translation: 他嗜烟酗酒。

examples.text: Never accept a ride with people who have been drinking.
examples.translation: 千万别搭喝了酒的司机开的车。

examples.text: She had left him because of his drinking...
examples.translation: 她因他酗酒而离开了他。

examples.text: They patched up their differences by spending an evening of heavy drinking together.
examples.translation: 他们一宿畅饮后终于弥合了分歧。

examples.text: I'll get you a drink of water.
examples.translation: 我给你来杯水。

examples.text: She felt like a drink after a hard day.
examples.translation: 辛苦了一天后她想喝上一杯。

examples.text: Too much drink is bad for your health.
examples.translation: 酗酒有害健康。

examples.text: We drank ourselves into a stupor on cheap wine.
examples.translation: 我们喝廉价葡萄酒喝得酩酊大醉。

examples.text: At sixteen he could drink me under the table.
examples.translation: 16 岁的时候他就能把我灌醉了。

examples.text: He took to drink after his wife died.
examples.translation: 他妻子过世后他就沉溺于酒中了。

meanings.meaning: 水滴，滴水声；静脉滴注；使人厌烦的人

examples.text: Sit your child forward and let the blood drip into a tissue or on to the floor...
examples.translation: 让你的孩子前倾坐着，让血滴在纸巾上或地板上。

examples.text: Amid the trees the sea mist was dripping...
examples.translation: 林子里弥漫着湿漉漉的海雾。

examples.text: The children kept dripping Coke on the carpets.
examples.translation: 孩子们老往地毯上滴可乐。

examples.text: A tap in the kitchen was dripping...
examples.translation: 厨房的水龙头在滴水。

examples.text: Lou was dripping with perspiration...
examples.translation: 卢浑身淌汗。

examples.text: He was holding a cloth that dripped pink drops upon the floor.
examples.translation: 他正拿着一块布，布上粉红色的水滴落在地板上。

examples.text: Drips of water rolled down the trousers of his uniform.
examples.translation: 他的制服裤子在不停地滴水。

examples.text: I had a bad attack of pneumonia and spent two days in hospital on a drip.
examples.translation: 我得了严重的肺炎，在医院输了两天液。

examples.text: They were dazed by window displays dripping with diamonds and furs...
examples.translation: 他们被满橱窗陈列的钻石和皮草弄得眼花缭乱。

examples.text: His voice was dripping with sarcasm.
examples.translation: 他的话里满是讥讽。

meanings.meaning: 驾驶员；驱动程序；起子；传动器

examples.text: The driver got out of his van.
examples.translation: 司机从货车上下来。

examples.text: ...a taxi driver.
examples.translation: 出租车司机

examples.text: ...printer driver software.
examples.translation: 打印机驱动软件

meanings.meaning: 推动，发动（机器等）；驾驶（马车，汽车等）；驱赶
驱动器；驾车；[心理] 内驱力，推进力；快车道

examples.text: I drove into town and went to a restaurant for dinner...
examples.translation: 我驱车到市里一家餐馆就餐。

examples.text: He put the bags in the car and drove off...
examples.translation: 他把袋子放进车里，然后驾车离去。

examples.text: She never learned to drive...
examples.translation: 她一直没学会开车。

examples.text: Mrs Glick drove her own car and the girls went in Nancy's convertible.
examples.translation: 格利克夫人开着自己的车,女孩们上了南希的敞篷车。

examples.text: ...a qualified driving instructor...
examples.translation: 合格的驾驶教练

examples.text: It was an outrageous piece of dangerous driving.
examples.translation: 这种危险驾驶行为是令人极为愤慨的。

examples.text: His daughter Carly drove him to the train station.
examples.translation: 他女儿卡莉开车将他送到火车站。

examples.text: I thought we might go for a drive on Sunday.
examples.translation: 我想星期天我们可以驱车旅行。

examples.text: The current flows into electric motors that drive the wheels.
examples.translation: 电流流入了驱动车轮的电动机。

examples.text: He put the jeep in four-wheel drive and splashed up the slope.
examples.translation: 他将吉普车切换为四轮驱动模式后涉水爬上了坡。

examples.text: ...equipment such as terminals, tape drives or printers.
examples.translation: 诸如电脑终端、磁带驱动器或打印机等的设备

examples.text: I used a sledgehammer to drive the pegs into the ground...
examples.translation: 我用一把大锤子把短桩打进地里。

examples.text: I held it still and drove in a nail.
examples.translation: 我稳稳地拿着它将钉子钉了进去。

examples.text: Armstrong drove the ball into the roof of the net.
examples.translation: 阿姆斯特朗将球打入球门网顶。

examples.text: Woosnam sliced his drive into the bushes.
examples.translation: 伍斯纳姆的开杆球打进了灌木丛中。

examples.text: Rain drove against the window.
examples.translation: 雨敲打着窗户。

examples.text: He crashed into a tree in driving rain.
examples.translation: 他在骤雨中撞到树上了。

examples.text: ...rescuers battling through driving snow.
examples.translation: 冒着暴雪奋战的营救人员

examples.text: The last offensive drove thousands of people into Thailand...
examples.translation: 最后一次进攻将成千上万的人赶到了泰国。

examples.text: Every summer the shepherds drive the sheep up to pasture...
examples.translation: 每年夏天牧羊人都将羊群赶到牧场去。

examples.text: The smoke also drove mosquitoes away.
examples.translation: 烟同样能驱蚊。

examples.text: The recession and hospital bills drove them into bankruptcy...
examples.translation: 经济衰退和医疗账单逼得他们破产了。

examples.text: He nearly drove Elsie mad with his fussing.
examples.translation: 他的小题大做简直快把埃尔茜逼疯了。

examples.text: More than once, depression drove him to attempt suicide...
examples.translation: 抑郁症使他不止一次地企图自杀。

examples.text: Jealousy drives people to murder...
examples.translation: 嫉妒驱使人们去杀人。

examples.text: ...people who are driven by guilt, resentment and anxiety.
examples.translation: 受悔恨、愤怒、焦虑等情感驱使的人们

examples.text: ...a man driven by a pathological need to win.
examples.translation: 疯狂地一心只想赢的男子

examples.text: John will be best remembered for his drive and enthusiasm.
examples.translation: 约翰的魄力和热情最令人难忘。

examples.text: ...compelling, dynamic sex drives.
examples.translation: 强烈而旺盛的性欲

examples.text: The ANC is about to launch a nationwide recruitment drive...
examples.translation: 非洲国民大会打算在全国范围内发起招募运动。

examples.text: The Church in Haiti has played an important role in the drive towards democracy.
examples.translation: 海地的教会在争取民主的运动中扮演了重要的角色。

examples.text: ...23 Queen's Drive, Malvern, Worcestershire.
examples.translation: 伍斯特郡,莫尔文市,女王大道 23 号

examples.text: It was clear Cohen didn't understand what Millard was driving at.
examples.translation: 看得出科恩并不明白米勒德想说什么。

examples.text: Drought and famines have killed up to two million people here.
examples.translation: 旱灾和饥荒夺去了这里200万人的生命。

examples.text: He told a press conference that Spain was suffering one of the worst droughts of the century.
examples.translation: 他在记者招待会上说西班牙正遭受着本世纪最严重的旱灾之一。

examples.text: Forty-eight people have drowned after their boat capsized during a storm...
examples.translation: 他们的船在暴风雨中倾覆后有 48 人溺亡。

examples.text: A child can drown in only a few inches of water...
examples.translation: 儿童在只有几英寸深的水中就可能溺亡。

examples.text: Last night a boy was drowned in the river...
examples.translation: 昨晚一名男孩在河里溺亡。

examples.text: He walked into the sea and drowned himself...
examples.translation: 他投海自杀了。

examples.text: Dolphins have sometimes been known to save drowning swimmers.
examples.translation: 据悉海豚有时会救溺水的游泳者。

examples.text: We were drowning in data but starved of information.
examples.translation: 我们淹没在大量的数据中却找不到有用的信息。

examples.text: ...people who gradually find themselves drowning in debt...
examples.translation: 渐渐发现自己债台高筑的人们

examples.text: The potatoes were drowned in chilli.
examples.translation: 马铃薯完全被辣椒盖住了。

examples.text: Clapping drowned the speaker's words for a moment...
examples.translation: 鼓掌声一度淹没了发言人的声音。

examples.text: The conversation was drowned by the arrival of the taxi.
examples.translation: 到来的出租车的声音压过了谈话的声音。

examples.text: Their cheers drowned out the protests of demonstrators...
examples.translation: 他们的欢呼声盖过了示威者的抗议声。

examples.text: Her voice was drowned out by a loud crash.
examples.translation: 她的声音被一声响亮的撞击声所淹没。

meanings.meaning: 滴；使降低；使终止；随口漏出

examples.text: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night...
examples.translation: 夜间温度可能会降到零度以下。

examples.text: Once the rate rises it never drops back to its previous level...
examples.translation: 一旦价格上去了就再也不会降到以前的水平了。

examples.text: His blood pressure had dropped severely...
examples.translation: 他的血压下降得很严重。

examples.text: He had dropped the price of his London home by £1.25m.
examples.translation: 他已将他在伦敦的房子价格降了125万英镑。

examples.text: He was prepared to take a drop in wages...
examples.translation: 他已做好心理准备接受降薪。

examples.text: The poll indicates a drop in support for the Conservatives.
examples.translation: 民意测验表明保守党支持率有所下降。

examples.text: I dropped my glasses and broke them.
examples.translation: 我不小心把眼镜掉下来摔碎了。

examples.text: He felt hot tears dropping onto his fingers...
examples.translation: 他感觉到热泪掉到他的手指上。

examples.text: Burning embers started dropping from the ceiling...
examples.translation: 余火未尽的木块开始从天花板上往下掉。

examples.text: His toupee dropped off, revealing his bald head.
examples.translation: 他的假发掉了,露出了光头。

examples.text: Drop the noodles into the water...
examples.translation: 将面条下到水里。

examples.text: He dropped his plate into the sink.
examples.translation: 他把盘子丢到水槽里。

examples.text: ...shaped pots that simply drop into their own container...
examples.translation: 可轻松放入配套的盒子里、有特制外形的锅具

examples.text: Bombs drop round us and the floor shudders.
examples.translation: 炸弹落在我们周围,地板在颤抖。

examples.text: ...the dropping of the first atomic bomb.
examples.translation: 第一颗原子弹的投放

examples.text: Nancy dropped into a nearby chair...
examples.translation: 南希疲惫地瘫坐到近处的椅子上。

examples.text: She let her head drop...
examples.translation: 她低垂着头。

examples.text: He dropped his hands on to his knees.
examples.translation: 他将双手垂放在腿上。

examples.text: She looked about to drop...
examples.translation: 她看上去快要累垮了。

examples.text: You have to run until you drop.
examples.translation: 一直跑到你跑不动为止。

examples.text: A couple of boozy revellers dropped their trousers.
examples.translation: 两名醉酒的狂欢者脱掉了他们的裤子。

examples.text: Her voice will drop to a dismissive whisper...
examples.translation: 她会把声音压低，轻蔑地低语。

examples.text: He dropped his voice and glanced round at the door.
examples.translation: 他放低了声音，在门口环视了一下。

examples.text: He dropped me outside the hotel...
examples.translation: 他把我送到了酒店。

examples.text: Many children had been dropped at the stadium by their parents...
examples.translation: 很多孩子被家长送到了体育馆。

examples.text: Tim had dropped the letter in earlier.
examples.translation: 蒂姆早些时候把信送来了。

examples.text: Just drop me off at the airport...
examples.translation: 就让我在机场下好了。

examples.text: He was dropping off a late birthday present.
examples.translation: 他正在送一份迟到的生日礼物。

examples.text: He was told to drop the idea...
examples.translation: 他被告知要打消那个主意。

examples.text: The prosecution was forced to drop the case...
examples.translation: 控方被迫撤诉。

examples.text: Many nations still had not dropped sanctions against South Africa.
examples.translation: 很多国家还没有终止对南非的制裁。

examples.text: This was one of the factors that led to President Suharto's dropping of his previous objections.
examples.translation: 这是导致苏哈托总统放弃其先前异议的因素之一。

examples.text: The country's captain was dropped from the tour party to England.
examples.translation: 该国的国家队队长无缘英格兰之行。

examples.text: Oremans has yet to drop a set.
examples.translation: 奥尔曼斯还一局未输。

examples.text: Britain has dropped from second to third place in the league.
examples.translation: 英国在联赛中的排名从第二位降到了第三位。

examples.text: ...a drop of blue ink...
examples.translation: 一滴蓝墨水

examples.text: Add the cream a few drops at a time...
examples.translation: 每次加几滴奶油。

examples.text: I'll have another drop of that Italian milk.
examples.translation: 我还要喝点那种意大利牛奶。

examples.text: ...eye drops.
examples.translation: 眼药水

examples.text: There was a sheer drop just outside my window...
examples.translation: 我的窗外就是垂直深渊。

examples.text: It's only a four-foot drop.
examples.translation: 仅有 4 英尺的落差。

examples.text: If I drop a few hints he might give me a cutting.
examples.translation: 如果我给点暗示，他没准会送我一段插枝。

examples.text: Mary Ann wished he would just drop it...
examples.translation: 玛丽·安希望他就不要谈论它了。

examples.text: Does that mean you're going to drop the subject?
examples.translation: 那是不是意味着你将不再谈论那个话题了？

meanings.meaning: 使服麻醉药；使服毒品；掺麻醉药于

examples.text: The drug will be useful to hundreds of thousands of infected people.
examples.translation: 这种药将惠及成千上万的感染者。

examples.text: ...the drug companies.
examples.translation: 制药公司

examples.text: His mother was on drugs, on cocaine...
examples.translation: 他母亲吸毒，吸可卡因。

examples.text: She was sure Leo was taking drugs...
examples.translation: 她确定利奥在吸毒。

examples.text: ...the problem of drug abuse.
examples.translation: 吸毒问题

examples.text: They drugged the guard dog with doped meatballs...
examples.translation: 他们用掺了麻醉药的肉丸子麻醉了看门狗。

examples.text: She was drugged and robbed.
examples.translation: 她被人下了药，然后遭到抢劫。

examples.text: He grew tired, and drifted off into a drugged sleep.
examples.translation: 他累了,在药物的作用下迷迷糊糊地睡着了。

examples.text: I wonder now if that drink had been drugged...
examples.translation: 我现在想那饮料是否被人动过手脚。

examples.text: Anyone could have drugged that wine.
examples.translation: 指不定谁在那酒里下了药。

examples.text: A tourist was robbed after being given a drugged orange.
examples.translation: 一名旅游者在喝了一杯被动了手脚的橙汁饮料后遭到了抢劫。

examples.text: Stewart could not remember exactly why he had done it because he was so drunk...
examples.translation: 斯图尔特记不清他为什么要那样做了,因为他烂醉如泥。

examples.text: I got drunk and had to be carried home...
examples.translation: 我喝醉了，只好让人把我送回家。

examples.text: He was arrested on suspicion of drunk driving.
examples.translation: 他因涉嫌酒后驾车而被捕。

examples.text: A drunk lay in the alley.
examples.translation: 一个酒鬼躺在小胡同里。

examples.text: They are currently drunk with success...
examples.translation: 他们现在正陶醉于成功之中。

examples.text: I felt drunk with the excitement of life.
examples.translation: 当时我沉醉于生活中的精彩刺激。

meanings.meaning: 可疑的；暧昧的；无把握的；半信半疑的

examples.text: This claim seems to us to be rather dubious...
examples.translation: 在我们看来这种说法非常可疑。

examples.text: Soho was still a highly dubious area...
examples.translation: 索霍区仍然是个靠不住的地方。

examples.text: Those figures alone are a dubious basis for such a conclusion.
examples.translation: 仅凭那些数据就得出这种结论并不可靠。

examples.text: Carter was dubiously convicted of shooting three white men in a bar.
examples.translation: 卡特被判定在酒吧枪杀3名白人男子，这一罪名似有不妥。

examples.text: My parents were dubious about it at first but we soon convinced them.
examples.translation: 我父母起初对此心存疑虑,但是我们很快就让他们信服了。

examples.text: He eyed Coyne dubiously.
examples.translation: 他用怀疑的目光打量着科因。

examples.text: Nagy has the dubious honour of being the first athlete to be banned in this way...
examples.translation: 纳吉作为第一个以这种方式被禁赛的运动员而“出名”。

examples.text: El Salvador has earned the dubious distinction of having the worst soil erosion in continental America.
examples.translation: 萨尔瓦多因是美洲大陆土壤侵蚀最严重的地方而有了这份不光彩的名声。

examples.text: ...an oil drum.
examples.translation: 油桶

examples.text: ...a drum of chemical waste.
examples.translation: 一桶化学废料

examples.text: He had found a drum of electric cable.
examples.translation: 他发现了一卷电缆。

examples.text: He drummed his fingers on the leather top of his desk...
examples.translation: 他用手指连续敲击他的皮革桌面。

examples.text: Rain drummed on the roof of the car.
examples.translation: 雨嘀嘀嗒嗒地敲打着车顶。

examples.text: The trade secretary disagreed but promised to 'bang the drum for industry'.
examples.translation: 贸易部长并不同意，但是答应会“为产业界摇旗呐喊”。

meanings.meaning: 干的；口渴的；枯燥无味的；禁酒的

examples.text: Clean the metal with a soft dry cloth...
examples.translation: 用柔软的干布擦拭金属。

examples.text: Pat it dry with a soft towel...
examples.translation: 用柔软的毛巾将它拍干。

examples.text: Once the paint is dry, apply a coat of the red ochre emulsion paint...
examples.translation: 油漆干了后,涂一层发红的土黄色乳胶漆。

examples.text: The path was dry and slithery from the drought.
examples.translation: 小路因干旱变得又干又滑。

examples.text: ...the parched dryness of the air.
examples.translation: 干热的空气

examples.text: The washing might dry outside today, the sun's shining...
examples.translation: 洗过的衣物可能今天晾在外面就能干,阳光正足。

examples.text: Leave your hair to dry naturally whenever possible...
examples.translation: 尽可能让头发自然晾干。

examples.text: Wash and dry the lettuce...
examples.translation: 将莴苣洗洗再晾干。

examples.text: Liz laughed again, got up from the water and began to dry herself.
examples.translation: 利兹又笑了,从水里站起来开始擦干身上的水。

examples.text: Mrs. Madrigal began drying dishes.
examples.translation: 马德里加尔夫人开始擦干碟子。

examples.text: He got up and stood beside Julie, drying up the dishes while she washed.
examples.translation: 他站起身站在朱莉身旁,她洗碗碟，他擦干。

examples.text: Nothing looks worse than dry, cracked lips...
examples.translation: 没有什么比干燥开裂的嘴唇更难看的了。

examples.text: Dry hair can be damaged by washing it too frequently...
examples.translation: 干性头发洗得太频繁容易受损。

examples.text: My skin's been getting a little dry recently.
examples.translation: 我皮肤最近有点干。

examples.text: Dryness of the skin can also be caused by living in centrally heated homes and offices.
examples.translation: 长期呆在有中央供暖系统的住宅和办公室里也会引起皮肤干燥。

examples.text: Exceptionally dry weather over the past year had cut agricultural production...
examples.translation: 去年罕见的干旱天气已导致农业减产。

examples.text: The spring had been unusually dry and we received only two tenths of an inch of rain during the entire month of June.
examples.translation: 春天异常干旱，我们在整个 6 月只有 0.2 英寸的降雨量。

examples.text: It was one of the driest and dustiest places in Africa.
examples.translation: 那是非洲最干旱、尘土最多的地方之一。

examples.text: ...a hot, dry climate where the sun is shining all the time.
examples.translation: 终年阳光明媚的炎热干旱气候

examples.text: He was advised to spend time in the warmth and dryness of Italy.
examples.translation: 有人建议他去暖和而少雨的意大利呆一段时间。

examples.text: Such cars, however, do grip the road well, even in the dry.
examples.translation: 不过，这种车即使在干燥路面上也表现出了良好的抓地性能。

examples.text: The aquifer which had once fed the wells was pronounced dry...
examples.translation: 曾为水井供水的蓄水层正式宣告干涸了。

examples.text: The single-engine plane landed at a dry lake in western Arizona...
examples.translation: 单引擎飞机在亚利桑那州西部的一个干涸的湖底着陆了。

examples.text: In the end the Volga's waters will run dry.
examples.translation: 伏尔加河水终将干涸。

examples.text: To harvest oil and gas profitably from the North Sea, it must focus on the exploitation of small reserves as the big wells run dry.
examples.translation: 随着大型油井的枯竭，要想从北海的石油和天然气开采中盈利,必须着力于开采小储量的油井。

examples.text: She was suddenly thirsty and dry.
examples.translation: 她突然口渴了。

examples.text: His mouth was dry, he needed a drink...
examples.translation: 他口很干,需要喝上一杯。

examples.text: My throat was dry. I was at a loss for words.
examples.translation: 我喉咙很干,不知说什么才好。

examples.text: Symptoms included frequent dryness in the mouth.
examples.translation: 症状包括经常口干舌燥。

examples.text: There were few dry eyes in the house when I finished...
examples.translation: 我说完后房间里没几个人不掉泪的。

examples.text: She didn't wince and her eyes were dry. Talk about brave. She was unbelievable.
examples.translation: 她连眉头也未皱一下,也没哭。说到勇敢,她令人难以置信。

examples.text: Gujurat has been a totally dry state for the past thirty years.
examples.translation: 在过去的 30 年里古吉拉特一直是完全禁酒的一个州。

examples.text: ...a shady rip-off industry that sucks its talent dry then discards it...
examples.translation: 见不得人的山寨行业吸干了它的才华后又将它抛弃

examples.text: He's just milking the company dry.
examples.translation: 他是要把公司榨干。

examples.text: Fulton has retained his dry humour...
examples.translation: 富尔顿保持着他含而不露的幽默。

examples.text: Mr Brooke is renowned for his dry wit.
examples.translation: 布鲁克先生因他不露声色的机智而闻名。

examples.text: 'That is surprising.' — 'Hardly,' I said drily.
examples.translation: “那真令人吃惊。”——“这有什么,”我不露声色地说。

examples.text: ...a frank and drily witty woman.
examples.translation: 坦诚又机智的女人

examples.text: Her writing has a wry dryness.
examples.translation: 她的作品有一种冷嘲式的幽默。

examples.text: When he crept back to his desk, he heard the dry voice of Father Laurence.
examples.translation: 当他轻手轻脚地回到读经台时,他听到了劳伦斯神父冷冰冰的声音。

examples.text: 'Possible,' I said drily, 'but not likely'.
examples.translation: “也许,”我冷冷地说,“但可能性不大。”

examples.text: ...dry, academic phrases.
examples.translation: 枯燥无味的学术词汇

examples.text: A lot of the work was very dry and boring in Westminster.
examples.translation: 威斯敏斯特的许多工作非常枯燥无味令人厌烦。

examples.text: For breakfast, they had dry bread and tea.
examples.translation: 他们早餐吃了无黄油的面包，还喝了茶。

examples.text: ...a glass of chilled, dry white wine.
examples.translation: 一杯冰镇干白葡萄酒

examples.text: ...a tuft or two of dried-up grass.
examples.translation: 一两簇枯草

examples.text: Reservoirs are drying up and farmers have begun to leave their land...
examples.translation: 水库逐渐干涸,农民开始背井离乡。

examples.text: The fountain is reputed never to dry up.
examples.translation: 这口泉号称从不干涸。

examples.text: ...a dried-up river bed.
examples.translation: 干涸的河床

examples.text: Investment could dry up and that could cause the economy to falter...
examples.translation: 投资可能会中断,而这会引起经济衰退。

examples.text: Credit from foreign banks is drying up...
examples.translation: 外资银行的放贷金额持续萎缩，面临枯竭。

examples.text: The company laid off 65,000 workers after commercial-jet orders dried up.
examples.translation: 商务飞机订单减少后公司精减了 65,000 名工人。

examples.text: If you ask her what she's good at she will dry up after two minutes.
examples.translation: 如果你问她擅长什么，两分钟后她就没话说了。

meanings.meaning: 到期的；预期的；应付的；应得的

examples.text: The country's economic problems are largely due to the weakness of the recovery...
examples.translation: 该国的经济问题很大程度上是因为复苏乏力。

examples.text: If the trip is a success, a lot of this will be due to Mr Green's efforts.
examples.translation: 如果说这次旅行获得了成功,那很大程度上要归功于格林先生的努力。

examples.text: Due to the large volume of letters he receives Dave regrets he is unable to answer queries personally...
examples.translation: 因信件数量繁多,戴夫无法亲自答复提出的问题，他为此表示歉意。

examples.text: Jobs could be lost in the defence industry due to political changes sweeping Europe.
examples.translation: 因横扫欧洲的政治变故,国防行业中有些人可能会失业。

examples.text: The results are due at the end of the month...
examples.translation: 预计月底会有结果。

examples.text: The first price increases are due to come into force in July...
examples.translation: 第一批提价预计将在7月开始执行。

examples.text: Jason is currently in Britain to finish recording his second album which is due out in May...
examples.translation: 贾森正在英国完成他 5 月要出的第二张专辑的录制。

examples.text: Mr Carter is due in London on Monday.
examples.translation: 卡特先生预定于星期一到达伦敦。

examples.text: ...customers who paid later than twenty days after the due date.
examples.translation: 比预定日期推迟20天付款的顾客

examples.text: After due consideration it was decided to send him away to live with foster parents...
examples.translation: 充分考虑之后决定将他送到养父母那儿生活。

examples.text: I do hope that people will make use of footpaths and treat them with due attention that is needed.
examples.translation: 我真希望人们使用人行道并给予应有的关注。

examples.text: I was sent a cheque for £1,525 and advised that no further pension was due...
examples.translation: 我收到了一张 1,525 英镑的支票，并被告知我应得的养老金到此为止。

examples.text: I've got some leave due to me and I was going to Tasmania for a fortnight.
examples.translation: 我打算利用应享有的假期去塔斯马尼亚呆两周。

examples.text: He had not taken a summer holiday that year but had accumulated the leave due him.
examples.translation: 那年暑假他没有休息，而是把他应有的假期都攒了起来。

examples.text: The deputy chief inspector rang me up and said, 'Miss Smith, you know you are due for a move?'...
examples.translation: 副总督察给我打电话说,“史密斯小姐,你知道你要搬家了吗？”

examples.text: He is not due for release until 2020.
examples.translation: 他要到 2020 年才能被释放。

examples.text: I reckon I'm due one of my travels.
examples.translation: 我想我就要开始我的一次旅行了。

examples.text: Only 18 of the UN's 180 members had paid their dues by the January deadline.
examples.translation: 在一月最后期限前联合国 180 个成员国只有 18 个缴纳了会费。

examples.text: They headed due north...
examples.translation: 他们朝正北方向行进了。

examples.text: The Thames flows due south from Oxford, through the market town of Abingdon.
examples.translation: 泰晤士河从牛津向正南方向流去，穿过阿宾顿的集镇。

examples.text: ...a mining town 40 miles due east of Los Angeles.
examples.translation: 洛杉矶正东方向 40 英里处的采矿小镇

examples.text: In due course the baby was born...
examples.translation: 婴儿足月降生了。

examples.text: The arrangements will be published in due course.
examples.translation: 计划将在适当的时候公布。

examples.text: To give Linda her due, she had tried to encourage John in his school work.
examples.translation: 说句公道话,琳达努力规劝过约翰要好好学习。

examples.text: You can say 'with due respect' when you are about to disagree politely with someone.
examples.translation: (发表不同意见前的谦语)恕我冒昧,恕我直言

examples.text: With all due respect, you're wrong.
examples.translation: 恕我直言,您错了。

meanings.meaning: 钝的；迟钝的；无趣的；呆滞的；阴暗的

examples.text: They are both nice people but can be rather dull...
examples.translation: 他俩都是好人但非常沉闷。

examples.text: I felt she found me boring and dull...
examples.translation: 我觉得她认为我既无趣又沉闷。

examples.text: The documentary lasts for more than two-and-a-half hours, and there is scarcely a dull minute.
examples.translation: 该纪录片片长超过两个半小时,却鲜有沉闷之处。

examples.text: They enjoy anything that breaks the dullness of their routine life.
examples.translation: 只要能打破他们日常刻板、沉闷的生活，任何事情他们都喜欢。

examples.text: The body's natural rhythms mean we all feel dull and sleepy between 1 and 3pm.
examples.translation: 人体生物钟会让我们在下午 1 点到 3 点之间感觉没精打采、昏昏欲睡。

examples.text: His eyes looked dully ahead.
examples.translation: 他目光呆滞地看着前方。

examples.text: Did you notice any unusual depression or dullness of mind?
examples.translation: 你有没有觉察到抑郁、反应迟钝等反常现象？

examples.text: The stamp was a dull blue colour.
examples.translation: 邮票是晦暗的深蓝色。

examples.text: The street lamps gleamed dully through the night's mist.
examples.translation: 街灯透过夜晚的薄雾隐约泛出亮光。

examples.text: It's always dull and raining.
examples.translation: 天气总是阴雨连绵。

examples.text: The long whining whistle of a shell was followed by the dull boom of the explosion...
examples.translation: 在炮弹长长的哀鸣声呼啸而过之后是隆隆而低沉的爆炸声。

examples.text: The coffin closed with a dull thud.
examples.translation: 棺材合上时发出一声闷响。

examples.text: He heard his heart thump dully but more quickly.
examples.translation: 他听见低沉的心跳声，跳动的速度却更快了。

examples.text: The pain, usually a dull ache, gets worse with exercise...
examples.translation: 通常不明显的疼痛在运动后会加剧。

examples.text: I realized with a kind of dull shock that I didn't recognize a single name.
examples.translation: 我暗自一惊，发现一个名字都不认识。

examples.text: His arm throbbed dully.
examples.translation: 他的胳膊隐约在抽动。

examples.text: Her eyes dulled and she gazed blankly...
examples.translation: 她眼神暗淡，呆呆地凝视着。

examples.text: He can dull your senses with facts and figures...
examples.translation: 他会用事实和数据蒙蔽你的理智。

examples.text: Share prices and trading have been dulled by worries over the war.
examples.translation: 股票价格和交易因人们对战争的忧虑而走低。

meanings.meaning: 鸭子；鸭肉；（英）宝贝儿；零分

examples.text: Chickens and ducks scratch around the outbuildings.
examples.translation: 鸡鸭在棚子周围到处乱刨。

examples.text: ...honey roasted duck.
examples.translation: 蜜汁烤鸭

examples.text: I brought in one drake and three ducks.
examples.translation: 我弄来一只公鸭和三只母鸭。

examples.text: He ducked in time to save his head from a blow from the poker...
examples.translation: 他及时低下头，躲过了拨火棍的击打。

examples.text: He ducked his head to hide his admiration...
examples.translation: 他低下头以掩饰他的仰慕之情。

examples.text: I wanted to duck down and slip past but they saw me.
examples.translation: 我本想弯腰溜过去，但被他们看到了。

examples.text: Hans deftly ducked their blows.
examples.translation: 汉斯灵巧地躲过他们的击打。

examples.text: Matt ducked into his office...
examples.translation: 马特慌忙躲进他的办公室。

examples.text: He ducked through the door and looked about frantically.
examples.translation: 他溜进门里，慌忙地四处张望着。

examples.text: The Opposition reckons the Health Secretary has ducked all the difficult decisions...
examples.translation: 反对党认为卫生大臣逃避了所有决策难题。

examples.text: He had ducked the confrontation with United Nations inspectors last summer.
examples.translation: 去年夏天他避开了与联合国核查人员的对峙。

examples.text: She splashed around in the pool with Mark, rowdily trying to duck him.
examples.translation: 她和马克在水池中嬉戏,胡闹着要将他按入水中。

examples.text: Oh, I am glad to see you, duck.
examples.translation: 噢,很高兴见到你,亲爱的。

examples.text: All the criticism is water off a duck's back to me.
examples.translation: 批评对我来说左耳进右耳出，毫无影响。

examples.text: She took to mothering like a duck to water.
examples.translation: 她很快就对母亲这一角色驾轻就熟了。

meanings.meaning: 哑的，无说话能力的；不说话的，无声音的

examples.text: ...a young deaf and dumb man.
examples.translation: 年轻的聋哑男子

examples.text: We were all struck dumb for a minute.
examples.translation: 一时间我们惊讶得哑口无言。

examples.text: I shook my head dumbly, not believing him.
examples.translation: 我一言不发地摇了摇头,不相信他的话。

examples.text: I've met a lot of dumb people...
examples.translation: 我遇到过很多笨蛋。

examples.text: The questions were set up to make her look dumb.
examples.translation: 问题这么设计，就是为了让她出丑。

examples.text: I came up with this dumb idea...
examples.translation: 我想出了这个馊主意。

examples.text: It's the media that's dumb.
examples.translation: 让人恼火的是媒体。

examples.text: An expression of dumb recognition wiggled across her features.
examples.translation: 她不语，从她脸上掠过的一丝表情可知她是认得的。

examples.text: He accused broadcasters of contributing to the dumbing down of America.
examples.translation: 他谴责广播员过分简化了美国的形象。

meanings.meaning: 倾倒；倾卸；丢下，卸下；摆脱，扔弃；倾销
倒垃圾；突然跌倒或落下；卸货；转嫁（责任等）
垃圾场；仓库；无秩序地累积
（英）邓普（人名，男子教名Humphrey、Humphry的昵称）

examples.text: We dumped our bags at the nearby Grand Hotel and hurried towards the market...
examples.translation: 我们把包扔在附近的格兰德酒店后就匆匆赶往集市。

examples.text: He got my haversack from the cab and dumped it at my feet.
examples.translation: 他把我的背包从出租车上取来丢到我脚下。

examples.text: The getaway car was dumped near a motorway tunnel...
examples.translation: 逃亡用的车被丢弃在高速公路隧道附近。

examples.text: A million tonnes of untreated sewage is dumped into the sea...
examples.translation: 一百万吨未经处理的污水被倾倒进了海里。

examples.text: The government declared that it did not dump radioactive waste at sea.
examples.translation: 政府宣称并未将放射性废料倾倒在海里。

examples.text: German law forbids the dumping of hazardous waste on German soil.
examples.translation: 德国法律禁止在德国本土倾倒有害废料。

examples.text: ...companies that bring their rubbish straight to the dump...
examples.translation: 将其废弃物直接运送至垃圾场的公司

examples.text: The walled garden was used as a dump.
examples.translation: 带围墙的花园被用作了垃圾场。

examples.text: 'What a dump!' Christabel said, standing in the doorway of the youth hostel.
examples.translation: “真够脏乱的！”克丽丝特布尔站在青年旅社的门口说道。

examples.text: Ministers believed it was vital to dump the poll tax before the election.
examples.translation: 大臣们认为在大选前停止征收人头税至关重要。

examples.text: It produces more than it needs, then dumps its surplus onto the world market.
examples.translation: 当产量超过需求时,过剩的产品便倾销到世界市场。

examples.text: I thought he was going to dump me for another girl...
examples.translation: 我以为他要为了另一个女孩而和我分手。

examples.text: She was dumped by her long-term lover after five years...
examples.translation: 5 年后她被相恋多年的恋人抛弃了。

examples.text: I suggested that we not only dump the two companies, but that we also should ditch any other business not involved in soft drinks.
examples.translation: 我提议我们不仅要和那两个公司断绝关系，还要抛弃其他任何不涉及软饮料的业务。

examples.text: I was sometimes dumped with my grandmother or left with highly unsuitable au pairs...
examples.translation: 有时我被扔给奶奶照看，或者被交给毫无经验的临时保姆。

examples.text: He can't cope and dumps his two teenage boys on them to be looked after.
examples.translation: 他应付不过来，只能将他那两个十来岁的儿子交给他们代为照看。

examples.text: It can take a couple of hours to dump a thousand telephone numbers into a 128k EPROM pack...
examples.translation: 将 1,000 个电话号码转存到一个128k的EPROM芯片要花好几个小时。

examples.text: All the data is then dumped into the main computer.
examples.translation: 所有数据随后被转存至主计算机。

examples.text: ...a screen dump.
examples.translation: 屏幕转储

examples.text: He was a nice guy, Mona. He didn't dump on me.
examples.translation: 莫娜,他是个不错的家伙,没有亏待我。

examples.text: She's feeling a bit down in the dumps and needs cheering up.
examples.translation: 她情绪有点低落，需要振奋起来。

examples.text: His task will be to duplicate his success overseas here at home...
examples.translation: 他在海外取得了成功，现在的任务就是要在国内再创辉煌。

examples.text: Scientists hope the work done in collaboration with other researchers may be duplicated elsewhere.
examples.translation: 科学家们希望与其他研究人员合作的成果可以适用于别处。

examples.text: Charles scored again, with an exact duplicate of his first goal.
examples.translation: 查尔斯梅开二度,与第一次破门如出一辙。

examples.text: She found Ned alone in the photocopy room, duplicating some articles.
examples.translation: 她发现内德一个人在复印室里复印一些文章。

examples.text: ...a business which duplicates video and cinema tapes for the movie makers.
examples.translation: 为电影制片商复制录像带和影带的行业

examples.text: I'm on my way to Switzerland, but I've lost my card. I've got to get a duplicate.
examples.translation: 我正在去瑞士的路上,可是我把卡弄丢了，得去补办一张。

examples.text: He let himself in with a duplicate key.
examples.translation: 他用一把复制的钥匙打开门进去。

examples.text: ...a duplicate copy of the loan contract.
examples.translation: 贷款合同的副本

examples.text: Bone china is strong and durable.
examples.translation: 骨灰瓷坚固耐用。

examples.text: Airlines recommend hard-sided cases for durability.
examples.translation: 航空公司推荐使用硬边箱，因其经久耐用。

examples.translation: 能够听懂外语是种优势。

examples.translation: 他们对一切都视而不见，充耳不闻。

examples.translation: 人们一个劲儿地跟他说要继续留在学校念书，这让他烦透了。
