examples.translation: 我们将要求享有工作中应得的平等权利。

examples.text: ...the commitment to equal opportunities.
examples.translation: 对机会均等的承诺

examples.text: ...new legislation allowing building societies to compete on equal terms with their competitors.
examples.translation: 允许建房互助协会与其竞争者平等竞争的新法规

examples.text: We are equal in every way...
examples.translation: 我们在各个方面都是平等的。

examples.text: At any gambling game, everyone is equal.
examples.translation: 在任何赌博游戏中，每个人都机会均等。

examples.text: She was one of the boys, their equal...
examples.translation: 她也是男孩子们中的一员，和他们不相上下。

examples.text: You should have married somebody more your equal.
examples.translation: 你本应该和一个更门当户对的人结婚。

examples.text: She was determined that she would be equal to any test the corporation put to them...
examples.translation: 她下定决心要成功应对公司对他们的任何考验。

examples.text: The guards were equal to anything.
examples.translation: 那些卫兵能够应对任何事情。

examples.text: 9 percent interest less 7 percent inflation equals 2 percent...
examples.translation: 9%的利息减去7%的通货膨胀率等于2%。

examples.text: The average pay rise equalled 1.41 times inflation.
examples.translation: 薪水的平均增长幅度是通货膨胀率的1.41倍。

examples.text: The victory equalled Southend's best in history...
examples.translation: 那次胜利堪比索森德历史上最漂亮的获胜。

examples.text: No amount of money can equal memories like that.
examples.translation: 再多的金钱也比不上那样的记忆。

examples.text: As a pastor, it can be argued he has no equal...
examples.translation: 作为牧师，他可以说是出类拔萃。

examples.text: The film demands attention, and has no equal in cinema history.
examples.translation: 那部电影众人瞩目，在电影史上无与伦比。

examples.text: Other things being equal, most tenants would prefer single to shared rooms...
examples.translation: 如果其他条件不变，大多数房客都愿意住单人间而不会选择与他人同住。

examples.text: All things being equal, should it matter who earns most money?
examples.translation: 如果一切不变，谁赚的钱最多有什么关系吗？

examples.text: ...equality of the sexes.
examples.translation: 男女平等

meanings.meaning: 方程式，等式；相等；[化学] 反应式

examples.text: The equation is simple: research breeds new products...
examples.translation: 情况很简单：研究产生新产品。

examples.text: The party fears the equation between higher spending and higher taxes...
examples.translation: 该党担心难以平衡更多支出和更高税率之间的综合关系。

examples.text: New plans have taken chance out of the equation.
examples.translation: 新计划已经在这种综合局势中获得了机会。

examples.text: Eumetsat's familiar Meteosat class of observatories sit in geostationary orbits (GEO) some 36, 000km above the equator.
They become obsessed with trying to equip their vehicles with gadgets to deal with every possible contingency...
examples.translation: 他们变得痴迷于给自己的车辆装备小配件，以应付可能出现的各种紧急情况。

examples.text: Owners of restaurants would have to equip them to admit disabled people...
examples.translation: 餐厅老板将必须在餐厅里配备能够接纳残疾人的设施。

examples.text: The country did not possess the modern guns to equip the reserve army properly.
examples.translation: 该国没有现代枪炮来给预备役部队提供适当装备。

examples.text: ...well-equipped research buildings...
examples.translation: 设施齐全的研究大楼

examples.text: The greenhouses come equipped with a ventilating system and aluminium screen door...
examples.translation: 那些温室送来时配有通风系统和铝制纱门。

examples.text: Each caravan is equipped for four persons.
examples.translation: 每个活动房的设备可供4人使用。

examples.text: Relative poverty, however, did not prevent Martin from equipping himself with an excellent education...
examples.translation: 然而，较为贫困的状况并没有阻止马丁让自己接受一流的教育。

examples.text: A basic two-hour first aid course would equip you to deal with any of these incidents.
examples.translation: 两小时的基础急救课程能够让你有能力处理这类事件。

examples.text: Some students have emotional problems that teachers feel ill equipped to handle...
examples.translation: 一些学生的情感问题令老师们束手无策。

examples.text: When they leave school, they will be equipped for obtaining office jobs.
examples.translation: 离校时，他们将有能力获得办公室工作的机会。

examples.text: ...computers, electronic equipment and machine tools.
examples.translation: 计算机、电子设备和机床

examples.text: ...outdoor playing equipment.
examples.translation: 户外游乐设备

meanings.meaning: 等价的，相等的；同意义的

examples.text: The equivalent of two tablespoons of polyunsaturated oils is ample each day...
examples.translation: 每天相当于两大汤匙多重不饱和油的量就足够了。

examples.text: Even the cheapest car costs the equivalent of 70 years' salary for a government worker.
examples.translation: 即使是最便宜的汽车，价格也相当于一个公务员70年的薪水。

examples.text: A unit is equivalent to a glass of wine or a single measure of spirits...
examples.translation: 1个单位等于1杯葡萄酒或者1标准量的烈酒。

examples.text: They will react with hostility to the price rises and calls for equivalent wage increases are bound to be heard.
examples.translation: 他们将会强烈反对价格上涨，同时肯定会要求相应地增加工资。

examples.text: ...the civil administrator of the West Bank and his equivalent in Gaza.
examples.translation: 约旦河西岸的民政官和加沙的同职官员

examples.text: ...the Red Cross emblem, and its equivalent in Muslim countries, the Red Crescent.
examples.translation: 红十字及其在伊斯兰国家的对应标志——红月牙

examples.text: ...a decrease of 10% in property investment compared with the equivalent period in 1991.
examples.translation: 与1991年同期相比，房地产投资下降了10%

examples.text: His party has just suffered the equivalent of a near-fatal heart attack.
examples.translation: 他所在的政党刚刚经历了一次类似心脏病突发般几近致命的打击。

examples.text: ...the nuclear era...
examples.translation: 核时代

examples.text: ...the Reagan-Bush era...
examples.translation: 里根-布什时期

examples.text: It was an era of austerity.
examples.translation: 那是个艰苦的年代。

examples.text: They are desperate to erase the memory of that last defeat in Cardiff...
examples.translation: 他们急于抹去上次在卡迪夫遭遇失败的记忆。

examples.text: Love was a word he'd erased from his vocabulary since Susan's going.
examples.translation: 自从苏珊离开后，他再也不提“爱情”这个词了。

examples.text: He was in the studio tearfully erasing all the tapes he'd slaved over...
examples.translation: 他在录音棚里流着眼泪抹掉他辛苦录制的所有磁带。

examples.text: It appears the names were accidentally erased from computer disks.
examples.translation: 看起来那些名字被意外地从计算机磁盘上删除了。

examples.text: It was unfortunate that she had erased the message.
examples.translation: 不幸的是她已经删除了那条短信。

meanings.meaning: 竖立的；笔直的；因性刺激而勃起的

examples.text: Opposition demonstrators have erected barricades in roads leading to the parliament building...
examples.translation: 反对派示威者已经在通往国会大厦的道路上设置了路障。

examples.text: The building was erected in 1900-1901...
examples.translation: 这座建筑建于1900到1901年间。

examples.text: We all unconsciously erect barriers against intimacy.
examples.translation: 我们都会无意中对他人的亲近有所设防。

examples.text: Japanese proprietors are erecting a complex infrastructure of political influence throughout America...
examples.translation: 日本商人正在美国各地建立复杂的、具有政治影响力的基础结构。

examples.text: He erected a new doctrine of precedent.
examples.translation: 他创立了一套新的判例原则。

examples.text: ...the whole edifice of free trade which has been erected since the Second World War.
examples.translation: 第二次世界大战以来形成的整个自由贸易体系

examples.text: Stand reasonably erect, your arms hanging naturally...
examples.translation: 挺身站直，双臂自然下垂。

examples.text: Her head was erect and her back was straight.
examples.translation: 她抬头挺胸。

examples.text: ...the short, stiff, erect stems of almost bead-like blue flowers.
examples.translation: 酷似小珠子的蓝色小花坚挺的短花茎

examples.text: As their roots are strong and penetrating, they prevent erosion.
examples.translation: 它们的根十分粗壮而且扎得很深，从而避免了受侵蚀。

examples.text: ...erosion of the river valleys.
examples.translation: 河谷的侵蚀

examples.text: ...soil erosion.
examples.translation: 土壤侵蚀

examples.text: ...the erosion of confidence in world financial markets.
examples.translation: 对世界金融市场心灰意冷

examples.text: ...an erosion of presidential power.
examples.translation: 总统权力的削弱

examples.text: ...the erosion of moral standards.
examples.translation: 道德沦丧

examples.text: ...a dramatic erosion of support for the program.
examples.translation: 对该项目的支持大幅减少

examples.text: Some people have the erroneous notion that one can contract AIDS by giving blood...
examples.translation: 一些人错误地认为献血会让人感染艾滋病。

examples.text: They have arrived at some erroneous conclusions.
examples.translation: 他们得出了一些错误的结论。

examples.text: It had been widely and erroneously reported that Armstrong had refused to give evidence.
examples.translation: 大量失实的报道称阿姆斯特朗拒绝提供证据。

examples.text: NASA discovered a mathematical error in its calculations...
examples.translation: 美国国家航空航天局在它的计算结果中发现了一个数学错误。

examples.text: MPs attacked lax management and errors of judgment.
examples.translation: 议员们抨击管理的松散和判断的失误。

examples.text: The plane was shot down in error by a NATO missile.
examples.translation: 一枚北约的导弹误将那架飞机击落。

examples.text: I wanted an opportunity to talk some sense into him and try to make him see the error of his ways.
examples.translation: 我想找个机会开导他一下，好让他认识到自己做错了。

examples.text: The volcano erupted in 1980, devastating a large area of Washington state...
examples.translation: 那座火山在1980年喷发，摧毁了华盛顿州大片地区。

examples.text: Scientists say Mount Pinatubo could erupt again soon.
examples.translation: 科学家说皮纳图博山近期可能会再次喷发。

examples.text: ...the volcanic eruption of Tambora in 1815.
examples.translation: 1815年坦博拉山的火山喷发

examples.text: Heavy fighting erupted there today after a two-day ceasefire...
examples.translation: 在停火两天后，今天那里爆发了激烈的战斗。

examples.text: Violence erupted as the boys were driven away in two police vans.
examples.translation: 两辆警车将男孩们带走时突然发生了暴力冲突。

examples.text: ...this sudden eruption of violence.
examples.translation: 这次暴力事件的突然发生

examples.text: In Los Angeles, the neighborhood known as Watts erupted into riots...
examples.translation: 在洛杉矶，一个叫做沃茨的街区爆发了动乱。

examples.text: This region which had been relatively calm erupted in violence again this spring.
examples.translation: 已经相对平静的这个地区今年春天再次爆发暴力事件。

examples.text: Then, without warning, she erupts into laughter...
examples.translation: 然后在没有任何征兆的情况下，她突然大笑起来。

examples.text: Newman fled barefoot as the cheated husband erupted in fury.
examples.translation: 被戴绿帽的丈夫勃然大怒，纽曼吓得光着脚逃走了。

examples.text: ...an eruption of despair.
examples.translation: 突如其来的绝望

examples.text: At the end of the second week, my skin erupted in pimples.
examples.translation: 第二周周末，我的皮肤上突然出现了丘疹。

examples.text: ...eruptions of adolescent acne.
examples.translation: 青春痘的冒出

examples.text: ...an unpleasant skin eruption.
examples.translation: 令人难受的皮疹

examples.text: Both unions and management fear the dispute could escalate...
examples.translation: 工会和管理层都担心争端会恶化。

examples.text: The protests escalated into five days of rioting...
examples.translation: 抗议升级为为期5天的骚乱。

examples.text: Defeat could cause one side or other to escalate the conflict.
examples.translation: 失败可能会导致其中一方将冲突升级。

examples.text: The threat of nuclear escalation remains.
examples.translation: 核升级的威胁仍旧存在。

examples.text: ...a sudden escalation of violence.
examples.translation: 暴力事件的突然恶化

meanings.meaning: 逃避，避开，避免；被忘掉；被忽视
逃脱；避开；溜走；（气体，液体等）漏出；（未受伤或只受了一点伤害而）逃脱；声音（不自觉地）由…发出
逃跑；逃亡；逃走；逃跑工具或方法；野生种；泄漏

examples.text: A prisoner has escaped from a jail in northern England...
examples.translation: 一名囚犯从英格兰北部的一所监狱中越狱。

examples.text: They are reported to have escaped to the other side of the border...
examples.translation: 有报道称他们已经逃过了国境线。

examples.text: He was fatally wounded as he tried to escape.
examples.translation: 他在设法逃跑的时候受了致命伤。

examples.text: Officers mistook Stephen for an escaped prisoner.
examples.translation: 警官误以为斯蒂芬是一名逃犯。

examples.text: The man made his escape.
examples.translation: 那个人逃跑了。

examples.text: The two officers were extremely lucky to escape serious injury...
examples.translation: 那两名警官极其幸运，没有受重伤。

examples.text: The man's girlfriend managed to escape unhurt...
examples.translation: 那个男人的女朋友成功逃脱，毫发无损。

examples.text: He narrowly escaped with his life when suspected right-wing extremists fired shots into his office.
examples.translation: 疑似右翼极端分子的一些人向他的办公室开枪扫射，他侥幸逃生。

examples.text: I hear you had a very narrow escape on the bridge.
examples.translation: 我听说你在桥上险些出事。

examples.text: But for me television is an escape.
examples.translation: 但是对我而言，看电视是一种逃避的方法。

examples.text: ...an escape from the depressing realities of wartime.
examples.translation: 对于战时令人抑郁的现实生活的一种逃避

examples.text: We all need the occasional escape route from the boring, routine aspects of our lives...
examples.translation: 我们都时不时需要逃避生活中的无聊和平淡。

examples.text: This has, in fact, turned out to be a wonderful escape clause for dishonest employers everywhere.
examples.translation: 事实上，这已经成为所有狡猾的雇主们用来躲避责任的绝妙条款。

examples.text: It was an actor whose name escapes me for the moment...
examples.translation: 那个男演员的名字我一时想不起来了。

examples.text: Blonde and slender, she was too striking to escape their attention.
examples.translation: 金发细腰的她太引人注目了，他们很难不注意到她。

examples.text: Leave a vent open to let some moist air escape.
examples.translation: 打开一个通风口，让潮气逸出一些。

meanings.meaning: 陪同；护航舰；护卫队；护送者

examples.text: He arrived with a police escort shortly before half past nine.
examples.translation: 快到9点半的时候，他在一名警察的护送下到达了。

examples.text: ...a group being taken under police escort to the city outskirts.
examples.translation: 在警察护送下前往市郊的一群人

examples.text: My sister needed an escort for a company dinner.
examples.translation: 我妹妹需要一个陪她参加公司晚宴的男伴。

examples.text: I escorted him to the door...
examples.translation: 我陪他走到门口。

examples.text: The vessel was escorted to an undisclosed port.
examples.translation: 那艘轮船在护航下前往一个秘密港口。

examples.text: Millions of wild flowers colour the valleys, especially in April and May...
examples.translation: 尤其是在四五月份，不计其数的野花盛开，山谷里一片绚烂色彩。

examples.text: Re-apply sunscreen every two hours, especially if you have been swimming.
examples.translation: 每两个小时重新涂一次防晒油，尤其是在游泳的时候。

examples.text: Babies lose heat much faster than adults, and are especially vulnerable to the cold in their first month.
examples.translation: 婴儿散热比成年人快得多，在出生后的头一个月特别容易感冒。

examples.text: We asked Jason to write an essay about his hometown and about his place in it.
examples.translation: 我们让贾森写一篇有关他的家乡和他自己的家的短文。

examples.text: ...Thomas Malthus's essay on population.
examples.translation: 托马斯·马尔萨斯有关人口的论文

examples.text: Sinclair essayed a smile but it could hardly have been rated as a success.
examples.translation: 辛克莱想试着微笑一下，但根本没有笑出来。

examples.text: His first essay in running a company was a notoriously tough undertaking.
examples.translation: 众所周知，他第一次尝试经营公司时十分艰难。

examples.text: The essence of consultation is to listen to, and take account of, the views of those consulted.
examples.translation: 当顾问的精髓就在于倾听并考虑咨询者的观点。

examples.text: ...the essence of life...
examples.translation: 生活的本质

examples.text: Others claim that Ireland's very essence is expressed through the language.
examples.translation: 其他人声称爱尔兰最精髓的东西是通过语言表现出来的。

examples.text: Though off-puttingly complicated in detail, local taxes are in essence simple.
examples.translation: 虽然地税在细节上复杂得要命，但在本质上却很简单。

examples.text: Time is of the essence...
examples.translation: 时间是至关重要的。

examples.text: Speed was of the essence in a project of this type.
examples.translation: 对于这种项目来说，速度至关重要。

examples.text: ...a few drops of vanilla essence.
examples.translation: 几滴香草精油

examples.text: ...exotic bath essences.
examples.translation: 具有异国情调的沐浴香精

meanings.meaning: 基本的；必要的；本质的；精华的

examples.text: It was absolutely essential to separate crops from the areas that animals used as pasture...
examples.translation: 将庄稼和放牧区分开绝对必要。

examples.text: As they must also sprint over short distances, speed is essential...
examples.translation: 由于他们也必须进行短跑，因此速度至关重要。

examples.text: Jordan promised to trim the city budget without cutting essential services.
examples.translation: 乔丹承诺在不减少基本服务的前提下，缩减市政预算。

examples.text: The flat contained the basic essentials for bachelor life.
examples.translation: 那套公寓配有单身生活的基本必需品。

examples.text: Most authorities agree that play is an essential part of a child's development...
examples.translation: 大多数权威人士都同意，玩耍在孩子成长过程中起着非常重要的作用。

examples.text: In this trial two essential elements must be proven: motive and opportunity.
examples.translation: 在这次审讯中，必须证明两个基本因素：动机和时机。

examples.text: ...the essentials of everyday life, such as eating and exercise...
examples.translation: 饮食、锻炼等日常生活的要素

examples.text: This has stripped the contest down to its essentials.
examples.translation: 这就使比赛精简到最基本的环节。

examples.text: ...the bare essentials.
examples.translation: 最简单的基本知识

examples.text: The UN has established detailed criteria for who should be allowed to vote...
examples.translation: 联合国已经制定了有关投票资格的标准细则。

examples.text: The School was established in 1989 by an Italian professor.
examples.translation: 这所学院由一名意大利教授于1989年创建。

examples.text: We had already established contact with the museum...
examples.translation: 我们已经和那家博物馆建立了联系。

examples.text: Singapore and South Africa have established diplomatic relations.
examples.translation: 新加坡和南非已经建立了外交关系。

examples.text: Medical tests established that she was not their own child...
examples.translation: 医学化验证实她不是他们的亲骨肉。

examples.text: It will be essential to establish how the money is being spent...
examples.translation: 查清楚这笔钱将作何用途至关重要。

examples.text: An autopsy was being done to establish the cause of death...
examples.translation: 正在进行尸检以确定死亡原因。

examples.text: It was established that the missile had landed on a test range in Australia.
examples.translation: 经证实，那枚导弹已经落在澳大利亚的试验区域内。

examples.text: That link is an established medical fact.
examples.translation: 那一关联是已经证实的医学事实。

examples.text: This is going to be the show where up-and-coming comedians will establish themselves...
examples.translation: 这将是大有前途的喜剧演员们让自己获得认可的节目。

examples.text: He has established himself as a pivotal figure in US politics...
examples.translation: 他已经确立了自己在美国政界的核心地位。

examples.text: We shall fight to establish our innocence.
examples.translation: 我们应该努力证明自己的清白。

examples.text: His ideas influenced the establishment of National Portrait Galleries in London and Edinburgh.
examples.translation: 他的观念影响了伦敦和爱丁堡两所国家肖像艺术馆的建立。

examples.text: ...discussions to explore the establishment of diplomatic relations.
examples.translation: 旨在探究如何建立外交关系的讨论

examples.text: ...a scientific research establishment.
examples.translation: 科研机构

examples.text: ...shops and other commercial establishments.
examples.translation: 商店和其他商业单位

examples.text: Shopkeepers would once have been pillars of the Tory establishment...
examples.translation: 商店店主一度本该成为保守党统治集团的重要支柱。

examples.text: What do you expect? This is the Establishment we're taking on.
examples.translation: 你还期望什么？我们要应对的是“权威”。

examples.text: ...a hit-list of prominent British establishment figures.
examples.translation: 英国显要权贵的暗杀名单

examples.text: ...a shooting party on Lord Wyville's estate in Yorkshire.
examples.translation: 在怀维尔勋爵位于约克郡的庄园里举行的狩猎会

examples.text: He used to live on the estate.
examples.translation: 他过去曾住在那个住宅区。

examples.text: His estate was valued at $150,000.
examples.translation: 他的遗产被估价为15万美元。

examples.text: He is held in high esteem by colleagues in the construction industry...
examples.translation: 建筑业的同行们都非常敬重他。

examples.text: Their public esteem has never been lower...
examples.translation: 他们在公众中的信誉从未如此之低。

examples.text: He said he retained immense regard and esteem for the prime minister.
examples.translation: 他说他一直极其尊重和敬仰首相。

examples.text: I greatly esteem your message in the midst of our hard struggle.
examples.translation: 您在我们奋力抗争时发来的电文让我充满了敬意。

examples.text: Try to estimate how many steps it will take to get to a close object...
examples.translation: 尽力估算一下达到一个近距离目标需要多少步。

examples.text: I estimate that the total cost for treatment will be $12,500...
examples.translation: 我估计治疗费用总共会有12,500美元。

examples.text: He estimated the speed of the winds from the degree of damage...
examples.translation: 他根据破坏的程度估算风速。

examples.text: Some analysts estimate its current popularity at around ten per cent...
examples.translation: 一些分析家估计它现在的普及率在10%左右。

examples.text: His personal riches were estimated at £68 million.
examples.translation: 估计他的个人资产达到6,800万英镑。

examples.text: There are an estimated 90,000 gangsters in the country.
examples.translation: 估计该国有9万名匪徒。

examples.text: ...the official estimate of the election result...
examples.translation: 竞选结果的官方预测

examples.text: This figure is five times the original estimate...
examples.translation: 这个数据是最初估算的5倍。

examples.text: A recent estimate was that factories were undermanned by about 30 per cent.
examples.translation: 最新估算表明工厂的人员不足达30%左右。

examples.text: I hadn't been far wrong in my estimate of his grandson's capabilities.
examples.translation: 我对他孙子的能力的判断还不算太离谱。

examples.text: The shop also offers a curtain-making and fitting service. Quotes and estimates can be prepared by computer on the spot.
examples.translation: 那家商店还提供窗帘制作和安装服务，而且可以用计算机现场制作报价单和预算书。

examples.text: Whoever believes in Him shall have eternal life.
examples.translation: 所有相信上帝的人都会获得永生。

examples.text: ...the quest for eternal youth.
examples.translation: 对永葆青春的追求

examples.text: She is eternally grateful to her family for their support...
examples.translation: 她永远感激家人们给予她的支持。

examples.text: The whole universe exists eternally in that one infinite being.
examples.translation: 整个宇宙在无限的空间中永生。

examples.text: In the background was that eternal hum.
examples.translation: 背景音是没完没了的嗡嗡声。

examples.text: ...the eternal truths of the Indian subcontinent.
examples.translation: 印度次大陆的永恒真理

examples.text: ...the eternal question.
examples.translation: 永恒的问题

examples.text: ...a survey of Britain's ethnic minorities.
examples.translation: 对英国少数民族的调查

examples.text: ...ethnic tensions.
examples.translation: 种族关系紧张

examples.text: ...a predominantly young, ethnically mixed audience.
examples.translation: 年轻人占绝大多数的多民族的听众

examples.text: There are still several million ethnic Germans in Russia.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯境内仍有数百万德国人。

examples.text: ...a large ethnically Albanian population.
examples.translation: 大部分为阿尔巴尼亚人的人口

examples.text: ...the original flavours of ethnic dishes.
examples.translation: 民族特色菜肴的原汁原味

examples.text: ...a magnificent range of ethnic fabrics.
examples.translation: 各式各样具有民族特色的织物

examples.text: They were planning to evacuate the seventy American officials still in the country...
examples.translation: 他们正计划转移仍滞留在该国的70名美国官员。

examples.text: Since 1951, 18,000 people have been evacuated from the area.
examples.translation: 自1951年以来，已有18, 000人撤离了该地区。

examples.text: ...the evacuation of the sick and wounded...
examples.translation: 伤病员的撤离

examples.text: An evacuation of the city's four-million inhabitants is planned for later this week.
examples.translation: 计划在本周晚些时候疏散该市400万居民。

examples.text: The fire is threatening about sixty homes, and residents have evacuated the area...
examples.translation: 大火正威胁着大约60户人家，居民已经从该地区撤离。

examples.text: Officials ordered the residents to evacuate.
examples.translation: 官员命令居民撤离。

examples.text: ...the mass evacuation of the Bosnian town of Srebrenica...
examples.translation: 波斯尼亚小镇斯雷布雷尼察的大撤离

examples.text: Burning sulfur from the wreck has forced evacuations from the area.
examples.translation: 残骸上燃烧着的硫黄迫使人们撤出该地区。

examples.text: By his own admission, he evaded taxes as a Florida real-estate speculator...
examples.translation: 他亲口承认自己在佛罗里达从事房地产投机生意时逃过税。

examples.text: Delegates accused them of trying to evade responsibility for the failures of the past five years.
examples.translation: 代表们指责他们企图逃避过去5年中多次失败应负的责任。

examples.text: Mr Portillo denied he was evading the question...
examples.translation: 波蒂略先生否认自己正在回避那个问题。

examples.text: Too many companies, she says, are evading the issue.
examples.translation: 她说太多公司都在回避这个问题。

examples.text: Under the pretence of lighting a candle, she evades him and disappears...
examples.translation: 她假装点蜡烛，避开他消失了。

examples.text: She turned and gazed at the river, evading his eyes...
examples.translation: 她转身凝视着那条河，避开他的目光。

examples.text: He managed to evade capture because of the breakdown of a police computer.
examples.translation: 因为警方一台电脑瘫痪，他成功地躲避了抓捕。

examples.text: Happiness, which had been so elusive in Henry's life, still evaded him...
examples.translation: 亨利生活中过去一直难以捕捉的幸福仍旧与他无缘。

examples.text: When she sat down at her desk she found that the words evaded her.
examples.translation: 当她在桌前坐下时，却发现自己不知道该说些什么了。

examples.text: They will first send in trained nurses to evaluate the needs of the individual situation...
examples.translation: 他们首先会派一些训练有素的护士来评估每个病人的需求。

examples.text: The market situation is difficult to evaluate.
examples.translation: 市场状况难以评价。

examples.text: ...the opinions and evaluations of college supervisors...
examples.translation: 学院督学的意见和评价

examples.text: Evaluation is standard practice for all training arranged through the school.
examples.translation: 对学校组织的所有培训进行评估是例行的做法。

examples.text: Moisture is drawn to the surface of the fabric so that it evaporates...
examples.translation: 湿气被吸到织物表面从而蒸发。

examples.text: The water is evaporated by the sun.
examples.translation: 水在阳光照射下蒸发了。

examples.text: High temperatures also result in high evaporation from the plants...
examples.translation: 高温也导致了植物水分的大量蒸发。

examples.text: The soothing, cooling effect is caused by the evaporation of the sweat on the skin.
examples.translation: 这种放松而又凉爽的感觉是由于皮肤表面汗液的蒸发而产生的。

examples.text: My anger evaporated and I wanted to cry...
examples.translation: 我的怒气渐渐消失，想大哭一场。

examples.text: Your dreams always seem to evaporate, and nothing ever quite matches expectations...
examples.translation: 你的梦想似乎总是逐渐破灭，从来没有什么事情能完全符合你的预期。

examples.text: The project evaporated and Harry was left high and dry.
examples.translation: 那个项目逐渐叫停，哈里陷入了困境。

meanings.meaning: 夏娃； 前夕；傍晚；重大事件关头

examples.text: ...on the eve of his 27th birthday.
examples.translation: 在他27岁生日前一天

meanings.meaning: [数] 偶数的；平坦的；相等的
变平；变得可比较；成为相等

examples.text: He kept calling me for years, even after he got married...
examples.translation: 多年来他一直打电话给我，甚至是在他结婚以后。

examples.text: Even dark-skinned women should use sunscreens...
examples.translation: 即使黑皮肤的女性也应该涂抹防晒霜。

examples.text: I cannot come to a decision about it now or even give any indication of my own views...
examples.translation: 现在我无法对此作出决定，甚至就连自己是什么观点也不能作任何暗示。

examples.text: He didn't even hear what I said.
examples.translation: 他甚至没听见我说什么。

examples.text: It was on television that he made an even stronger impact as an interviewer...
examples.translation: 作为采访者，是电视让他产生了更大的影响。

examples.text: During his second day Edward looked even more pale and quiet than on his first...
examples.translation: 第二天，爱德华看起来比前一天更加苍白，也更加安静了。

examples.text: Stan was speaking even more slowly than usual.
examples.translation: 斯坦说得比平常还要慢。

examples.text: Cynthia is not ashamed of what she does, even if she ends up doing something wrong...
examples.translation: 辛西娅不为自己的所作所为感到羞愧，即使最终证明她所做的是错误的。

examples.text: Even though I'm supposed to be working by myself, there are other people who I can interact with.
examples.translation: 即便是需要我一个人工作，我还是可以和别人进行交流的。

examples.text: Even as she said this, she knew it was not quite true...
examples.translation: 就在她说这个的时候，她知道自己说的并非全是真的。

examples.text: He had been aware, even as he slept, of the noise of the engine.
examples.translation: 即使在睡觉的时候，他也一直听得到发动机的噪音。

examples.text: The bus was only half full. Even so, a young man asked Nina if the seat next to her was taken...
examples.translation: 公共汽车上只坐满了一半。尽管如此，一个年轻男子还是问尼娜她旁边的座位有没有人坐。

examples.text: She has never given up her nationality. Even so, her opponents argue that she is not a true Burmese.
examples.translation: 她从未放弃过她的国籍。即便如此，反对者仍然说她不是真正的缅甸人。

examples.text: Peace could come only gradually, in carefully measured steps. Even then, it sounds almost impossible to achieve...
examples.translation: 和平只会逐渐到来，而且每一步都走得小心翼翼。即使那样，要实现和平听起来仍几乎不可能。

examples.text: She was at her prettiest in her late teens, but even then she always had somebody who was prettier.
examples.translation: 她在十八九岁的时候最漂亮，但是即使在那时，也总有人比她更漂亮。

examples.text: How important is it to have an even temperature when you're working?...
examples.translation: 工作时周围环境温度恒定有多么重要呢？

examples.text: The brick-built property keeps the temperature at an even level throughout the year.
examples.translation: 那栋砖砌的房子里全年温度恒定。

examples.text: Stock is added evenly during the first 18 minutes while the mixture cooks...
examples.translation: 在将混合在一起的食物进行烹煮的前18分钟内，均匀地加入高汤。

examples.text: He looked at Ellen, breathing evenly in her sleep.
examples.translation: 他看着埃伦，她正呼吸均匀地睡着。

examples.text: The tables are fitted with a glass top to provide an even surface.
examples.translation: 桌子装了玻璃表面，因此十分平滑。

examples.text: Divide the dough into 12 even pieces and shape each piece into a ball...
examples.translation: 将面团分成12等份，每份揉成球状。

examples.text: Many are tired of being unpopular because of their wealth and would encourage more even distribution of it.
examples.translation: 很多人厌倦了因为自己的财富而不受欢迎，从而会鼓励更加均匀地分配财富。

examples.text: The meat is divided evenly and boiled in a stew...
examples.translation: 那块肉被均匀切成小块放到炖菜里煮熟。

examples.text: Within manufacturing, the loss of jobs has been far more evenly spread across the regions...
examples.translation: 在制造业，就业机会减少的现象已经在整个地区更加均匀地蔓延。

examples.text: The blood vessels in the skin are not evenly distributed around the face and neck.
examples.translation: 皮肤下的血管在脸部和颈部分布不均匀。

examples.text: It was an even game.
examples.translation: 这是一场势均力敌的比赛。

examples.text: ...an even match between eight nations.
examples.translation: 8个国家间一场不相上下的竞赛

examples.text: They must choose between two evenly matched candidates for governor.
examples.translation: 他们必须在两位不相上下的州长候选人之间作出选择。

examples.text: You don't owe me. I don't owe you. We're even.
examples.translation: 你不欠我，我也不欠你，我们扯平了。

examples.text: My voice surprised me; it was even and emotionless.
examples.translation: 我的声音听起来心平气和、不露一丝感情，这让我自己颇感惊讶。

examples.text: 'Is Mary Ann O.K?' — 'She's fine,' she said evenly.
examples.translation: “玛丽·安还好么？”——“她很好，”她平静地说。

examples.text: They have a more than even chance of winning the next election...
examples.translation: 他们赢得下届选举的机会在五成以上。

examples.text: The airline hopes to break even next year and return to profit the following year...
examples.translation: 那家航空公司希望明年实现收支相抵，在随后一年重新盈利。

examples.text: The theatre needs to fill over ninety per cent of its seats every night just to break even.
examples.translation: 那家剧院每天晚上需要有90%以上的上座率才刚刚能够收支相抵。

examples.text: I'm going to get even with you for this...
examples.translation: 我会跟你算这笔账的。

examples.text: Don't get angry, get even.
examples.translation: 与其生闷气，不如出口气。

meanings.meaning: 晚上；傍晚；（联欢性的）晚会；后期
在晚上的；为晚上的；晚上用的

examples.text: All he did that evening was sit around the flat...
examples.translation: 那天晚上他一直在公寓里无所事事地坐着。

examples.text: Supper is from 5.00 to 6.00 in the evening...
examples.translation: 晚餐在傍晚5点到6点之间。

examples.text: Towards evening the carnival entered its final stage.
examples.translation: 临近傍晚时，狂欢节进入最后阶段。

examples.text: ...the events of Black Wednesday...
examples.translation: “黑色星期三”事件

examples.text: ...in the wake of recent events in Europe...
examples.translation: 紧随欧洲最近发生的大事之后

examples.text: A new book by Grass is always an event.
examples.translation: 格拉斯的新书总能引起轰动。

examples.text: The cross-country section of the three-day event was held here yesterday.
examples.translation: 3日比赛中的越野项目昨天在这里举行。

examples.text: ...major sporting events.
examples.translation: 重大体育赛事

examples.text: ...our programme of lectures and social events.
examples.translation: 我们的演讲和社交活动计划

examples.text: A solo piper opens Aberdeen Highland Games at 10am and the main events start at 1pm.
examples.translation: 上午10点，一位风笛独奏家揭开了阿伯丁高地运动会的序幕，下午1点主要比赛项目开始。

examples.text: The bank has agreed to give an immediate refund in the unlikely event of an error being made...
examples.translation: 万一出现错误——虽然这种几率微乎其微，银行同意立即退款。

examples.text: In the event that any part of the deal may be blocked, the rest would go ahead.
examples.translation: 万一交易的某一部分受阻，其他部分将继续进行。

examples.text: In any event, the bowling alley restaurant proved quite acceptable.
examples.translation: 无论如何，那个保龄球场的餐厅证明还是很不错的。

examples.text: 'Don't underestimate us', Norman Willis warned last year. There was, in the event, little danger of that.
examples.translation: “别低估了我们，”诺曼·威利斯去年警告说。结果，什么事也没有。

examples.text: Eventually, the army caught up with him in Latvia...
examples.translation: 最终，大部队在拉脱维亚赶上了他。

examples.text: The flight eventually got away six hours late.
examples.translation: 那个航班推迟了6个小时后终于起飞。

examples.text: Eventually your child will leave home to lead her own life as a fully independent adult...
examples.translation: 最后，你的孩子会离开家，作为一个完全独立的成年人过她自己的生活。

examples.text: She sees the bar as a starting point and eventually plans to run her own chain of country inns.
examples.translation: 她把那间酒吧当作一个起点，最终计划是经营自己的乡村旅馆连锁店。

meanings.meaning: (Ever)人名；(英)埃弗；(俄)叶韦尔；(西、法)埃韦尔

examples.text: I'm not sure I'll ever trust people again...
examples.translation: 我不确定自己是否还会再相信任何人。

examples.text: Neither of us had ever skied...
examples.translation: 我们两个都从未滑过雪。

examples.text: Have you ever experienced failure?...
examples.translation: 你曾经历过失败吗？

examples.text: I don't know if you ever read any of his books...
examples.translation: 我不知道你是否读过他写的书。

examples.text: I forbid you ever to use that word!...
examples.translation: 我不准你再用那个词！

examples.text: You won't hear from Gaston ever again.
examples.translation: 你再也不会收到加斯顿的来信了。

examples.text: Have you ever seen anything like it?...
examples.translation: 你可曾见过像它这样的东西？

examples.text: Did you ever hear anyone sound so peculiar?
examples.translation: 你可曾听过谁的声音如此奇特？

examples.text: She's got a great voice and is singing better than ever...
examples.translation: 她的嗓音非常好，现在的唱功比以往任何时候都要好。

examples.text: Japan is wealthier and more powerful than ever before...
examples.translation: 日本比以往任何时候都更加富有和强大。

examples.text: He feels better than he has ever felt before...
examples.translation: 他从未感觉这么好过。

examples.text: 'Fear Of Music' remains among the best albums ever for many music fans...
examples.translation: 对很多乐迷而言，《惧怕音乐》仍是有史以来最好的专辑之一。

examples.text: This is the most awful evening I can ever remember.
examples.translation: 这是我记忆中最可怕的一晚。

examples.text: He was ever careful to check his scripts...
examples.translation: 他一向都认真检查剧本。

examples.text: Mother, ever the peacemaker, pointed her finger at my little brother and said, 'See? Now stop!'
examples.translation: 一向充当和事佬的妈妈用手指着弟弟说：“看到了没？快住手！”

examples.text: They grew ever further apart...
examples.translation: 他们变得越来越疏远了。

examples.text: I think the amount of work will increase and that it will become ever more complex.
examples.translation: 我想工作会越来越多，而且更加复杂。

examples.text: I can never, ever, forgive myself...
examples.translation: 我永远无法原谅我自己。

examples.text: Felix has never, ever confided in me.
examples.translation: 费利克斯从来都未向我倾诉过。

examples.text: Why ever didn't you tell me?...
examples.translation: 你究竟为什么不告诉我？

examples.text: When ever am I going to see you again?...
examples.translation: 我到底什么时候再见到你？

examples.text: Who ever heard of a thing like that?
examples.translation: 究竟是谁听说了那种事？

examples.text: He's been there ever since you left!...
examples.translation: 自从你离开后他就一直在那里！

examples.text: Ever since we moved last year, I worry a lot about whether I can handle this new job...
examples.translation: 自从去年我们搬家，我就一直非常担心能否做好这份新工作。

examples.text: 'Have you been chatting for long?' — 'Ever since you left.'
examples.translation: “你们聊了很久了吗？”——“打你离开后一直在聊。”

examples.text: I simply gave in to him, and I've regretted it ever since...
examples.translation: 我居然向他让步了，后来我一直为此后悔不已。

examples.text: In 1985 her first collection received rave reviews from Women's Wear Daily. Ever since, applause has never ceased.
examples.translation: 1985年她的首款系列时装得到《女性时装日报》的高度评价。从那时起，赞赏之声就一直不绝于耳。

examples.text: When I met Derek he was ever such a good dancer...
examples.translation: 我认识德里克时，他是个非常出色的舞者。

examples.text: This is in ever such good condition...
examples.translation: 它保存得非常好。

examples.text: I like him ever so much...
examples.translation: 我非常喜欢他。

examples.text: I'm ever so grateful...
examples.translation: 我太感激了。

examples.text: I saw him pause ever so slightly.
examples.translation: 我看到他稍稍停顿了一下。

examples.text: All she ever does is whinge and complain...
examples.translation: 她就会发牢骚抱怨。

examples.text: All he ever does is discuss the same boring list of medications.
examples.translation: 他就会翻来覆去讨论同一个无聊的药品单。

examples.text: As ever, the meals are primarily fish-based...
examples.translation: 像往常一样，饭菜主要是鱼。

examples.text: He was by himself, alone, as ever.
examples.translation: 他独自一人，一如往常。

examples.text: Every village has a green, a church, a pub and a manor house...
examples.translation: 每个村庄都有一片绿地、一座教堂、一间酒馆和一座庄园宅第。

examples.text: Record every expenditure you make.
examples.translation: 记下你的每一笔花销。

examples.text: ...mediterranean fish of every shape and hue...
examples.translation: 形色各异的地中海鱼类

examples.text: We need help, every kind of help.
examples.translation: 我们需要帮助，各种帮助。

examples.text: ...recipes for every occasion.
examples.translation: 应对各种场合的方法

examples.text: His every utterance will be scrutinized...
examples.translation: 他说的每句话都会被仔细审查。

examples.text: He will find his every step more harshly spotlighted than has been the case previously.
examples.translation: 他会发现与以往相比，他的每一步都会吸引人们更加密切的关注。

examples.text: We were made to attend meetings every day...
examples.translation: 我们每天都得参加会议。

examples.text: A burglary occurs every three minutes in London...
examples.translation: 伦敦每3分钟就会发生一起入室抢劫案。

examples.text: She will need to have the therapy repeated every few months...
examples.translation: 她将需要每隔几个月就进行一次治疗。

examples.text: They meet here every Friday morning.
examples.translation: 他们每周五早晨在这里会面。

examples.text: Two out of every three Britons already own a video recorder...
examples.translation: 每3个英国人中就有两个已经有了录像机。

examples.text: About one in every 20 people have clinical depression...
examples.translation: 大约每20个人中有1个患有临床抑郁症。

examples.text: He said Africa was suffering badly from deforestation: for every ten trees cut down, only one was planted.
examples.translation: 他说非洲的森林砍伐现象非常严重：每砍伐10棵树，仅种植1棵。

examples.text: The Congressional Budget Office says the federal deficit shows every sign of getting larger...
examples.translation: 国会预算办公室说有种种的迹象表明联邦赤字正在增加。

examples.text: I think that there is every chance that you will succeed...
examples.translation: 我想你取得成功的机会很大。

examples.text: The Chinese Foreign Minister was making every effort to secure a peaceful settlement...
examples.translation: 中国外交部长正在尽全力保证和平解决问题。

examples.text: Every care has been taken in compiling this list.
examples.translation: 汇编这份清单时考虑得很充分。

examples.text: Dozens of servants had catered to his every whim.
examples.translation: 几十个仆人迎合他所有稀奇古怪的念头。

examples.text: Stir the batter every now and then to keep it from separating...
examples.translation: 不时搅动面糊，防止其成分散开。

examples.text: Every so often the horse's heart and lungs are checked.
examples.translation: 不时检查那匹马的心脏和肺。

examples.text: I went home every other week...
examples.translation: 我隔周回一趟家。

examples.text: It has been snowing, roughly every third day, for as long as I've had the flu.
examples.translation: 自从我得了流感以来，这段时间一直在下雪，大约每三天一场。

examples.text: Second, the World Cup is an event which everybody on the planet loves talking about.
In the course of my everyday life, I had very little contact with teenagers.
examples.translation: 在我的日常生活中，我很少和青少年打交道。

examples.text: ...opportunities for improving fitness in your everyday routine.
examples.translation: 在日常生活中改善健康的机会

examples.text: ...the everyday problems of living in the city...
examples.translation: 城市生活中的日常问题

examples.text: A paint finish can transform something everyday and mundane into something more elaborate.
examples.translation: 油漆罩面能够使普通而平凡的东西看上去更加精致。

examples.text: Everyone in the street was shocked when they heard the news...
examples.translation: 听到那条消息，街上所有的人都震惊了。

examples.text: When everyone else goes home around 5 p.m. Lynn is still hard at work...
examples.translation: 当其他所有人都在晚上5点左右回家时，林恩仍在努力工作。

examples.text: Not everyone thinks that the government is being particularly generous.
examples.translation: 并非所有人都认为政府特别慷慨。

examples.text: Everyone feels like a failure at times...
examples.translation: 人们有时会觉得自己是个失败者。

examples.text: Everyone needs some free time for rest and relaxation...
examples.translation: 每个人都需要一些休息和放松的自由时间。

examples.text: You can't keep everybody happy.
examples.translation: 你不能使每个人都满意。

meanings.meaning: 每件事物；最重要的东西；（有关的）一切；万事

examples.text: He'd gone to Seattle long after everything else in his life had changed...
examples.translation: 他生活中的其他一切都改变了，很久之后他去了西雅图。

examples.text: Early in the morning, hikers pack everything that they will need for the day's hike...
examples.translation: 一大早，徒步旅行者们把当天旅行所需的一切都装进包里。

examples.text: Everything in the building had gone silent.
examples.translation: 大厦里一切都变得静悄悄的。

examples.text: 'This should have been decided long before now.' —'We can't think of everything.'...
examples.translation: “这个在此之前早该决定了。”——“我们不可能考虑得面面俱到。”

examples.text: Cathy thought that she had the answer to everything...
examples.translation: 凯茜觉得她能够处理一切。

examples.text: Noel and I do everything together...
examples.translation: 我和诺埃尔所有事情都一起做。

examples.text: Are you doing everything possible to reduce your budget?
examples.translation: 你在尽一切可能降低预算吗？

examples.text: She says everything is going smoothly...
examples.translation: 她说一切进展顺利。

examples.text: Is everything all right?...
examples.translation: 一切都好吗？

examples.text: Everything's going to be just fine.
examples.translation: 一切都会好起来的。

examples.text: I love him. He is everything to me...
examples.translation: 我爱他，他是我的一切。

examples.text: Crime cases were something that agents solved, and to him the case was everything...
examples.translation: 犯罪案件是执法人员要解决的事情，对于他而言，案件就是一切。

examples.text: Money isn't everything.
examples.translation: 金钱不是一切。

examples.text: She has everything: beauty, talent, children...
examples.translation: 她拥有一切：美貌、才干和子女。

examples.text: It was a garden that had everything. It was rich and wild and beautiful, and exciting.
examples.translation: 那个花园里一切尽有，景物丰富多彩、自然、美丽，令人激动。

examples.text: He had a bed and a fireplace and everything...
examples.translation: 他家里有一张床、一个壁炉及其他物品。

examples.text: We become friends and everything, and we call each other on the phone all the time.
examples.translation: 我们成了非常要好的朋友，一直互通电话。

examples.text: Working people everywhere object to paying taxes...
examples.translation: 各地的工薪族都反对缴税。

examples.text: We went everywhere together...
examples.translation: 我们一起去各个地方。

examples.text: Dust is everywhere...
examples.translation: 到处都是灰尘。

examples.text: Tap water is drinkable everywhere in the Algarve...
examples.translation: 阿尔加维各地的自来水都可饮用。

examples.text: People come here from everywhere to see these lights.
examples.translation: 人们从四面八方来到这里看这些灯。

examples.text: Bradley is still accustomed to travelling everywhere in style...
examples.translation: 布拉德利仍然保持着每次出行必派头十足的习惯。

examples.text: Everywhere he went he was introduced as the current United States Open Champion.
examples.translation: 他所到之处人们都介绍他是本届美国公开赛的冠军。

examples.text: I saw her picture everywhere...
examples.translation: 我到处都可以看见她的照片。

examples.text: I looked everywhere. I couldn't find him.
examples.translation: 我到处都找了，就是找不到他。

examples.text: There were cartons of cigarettes everywhere...
examples.translation: 到处都是香烟盒。

examples.text: Clothes were everywhere; hanging out of drawers, strewn across the floor, even spilling from the wastepaper basket.
examples.translation: 到处都是衣服：挂在抽屉上、扔在地上、甚至堆在废纸篓里。

examples.text: Ganley said he'd seen no evidence of widespread fraud...
examples.translation: 甘利说他没有看见诈骗泛滥的证据。

examples.text: There is a lot of evidence that stress is partly responsible for disease...
examples.translation: 有很多证据证明压力是造成疾病的原因之一。

examples.text: To date there is no evidence to support this theory.
examples.translation: 到目前为止，还没有证据支持这种理论。

examples.text: The evidence against him was purely circumstantial.
examples.translation: 对他不利的这项证据完全是间接证据。

examples.text: ...enough evidence for a successful prosecution.
examples.translation: 足以胜诉的证据

examples.text: The forensic scientists who carried out the original tests will be called to give evidence...
examples.translation: 进行最初化验的法医学家将被传唤到庭作证。

examples.text: Cabin crew have been giving evidence at the M1 aircrash enquiry.
examples.translation: 机舱人员一直在为M1空难调查作证。

examples.text: He's wise in other ways too, as evidenced by his reason for switching from tennis to golf...
examples.translation: 他在其他方面同样明智，这一点可以从他不打网球改打高尔夫的理由中得到证明。

examples.text: She was not calculating and evidenced no specific interest in money.
examples.translation: 她没什么心计，而且能感觉出她对钱没什么兴趣。

examples.text: Few soldiers were in evidence...
examples.translation: 没看见几个士兵。

examples.text: Poverty and bad housing conditions are still very much in evidence.
examples.translation: 贫困和糟糕的住房条件仍很常见。

meanings.meaning: 邪恶的；不幸的；有害的；讨厌的

examples.text: We are still being attacked by the forces of evil...
examples.translation: 我们仍在遭受邪恶力量的攻击。

examples.text: There's always a conflict between good and evil in his plays.
examples.translation: 他的戏剧中总是有善恶之间的斗争。

examples.text: He could not, after all, stop all the evil in the world.
examples.translation: 毕竟他无法阻止世界上的所有恶行。

examples.text: ...those who see television as the root of all evil.
examples.translation: 那些将电视视为万恶之源的人

examples.text: Apartheid is even a greater evil...
examples.translation: 种族隔离是更大的祸害。

examples.text: Higher taxes may be a necessary evil.
examples.translation: 提高税收可能会很不受欢迎，但却是必要的。

examples.text: ...a lecture on the evils of alcohol.
examples.translation: 有关饮酒危害的讲座

examples.text: ...the country's most evil terrorists...
examples.translation: 该国最邪恶的恐怖分子

examples.text: She's an evil woman.
examples.translation: 她是个邪恶的女人。

examples.text: After 1760 few Americans refrained from condemning slavery as evil...
examples.translation: 1760年后，很多美国人都在谴责奴隶制的社会危害。

examples.text: They are setting an evil example for their children.
examples.translation: 他们正给孩子们树立道德败坏的反面形象。

examples.text: I think this is an evil spirit at work...
examples.translation: 我认为这是恶魔在作祟。

examples.text: According to local folklore it is an evil place.
examples.translation: 据当地民间传说，那是个不祥的地方。

examples.text: Both men were smoking evil-smelling pipes.
examples.translation: 两个男人都在抽着难闻的烟斗。

examples.text: You can simply go on putting off the evil day and eventually find yourself smoking as much as ever.
examples.translation: 你当然可以想方设法摆脱，但最后你会发现自己还是像以前一样拼命抽烟。

examples.text: People voted for him as the lesser of two evils...
examples.translation: 人们投票支持他只不过是两害相权取其轻罢了。

examples.text: One suspects that hydro power is still the lesser evil.
examples.translation: 有人认为水力发电仍旧是两害相较取其轻。

examples.text: ...the scene evoking memories of those old movies...
examples.translation: 唤起对那些老电影的记忆的场景

examples.text: A sense of period was evoked by complementing pictures with appropriate furniture.
examples.translation: 给照片配上一些合适的家具，唤起了一种年代感。

examples.text: His footprints were clearly evident in the heavy dust...
examples.translation: 厚厚的尘土中他的脚印清晰易见。

examples.text: The threat of inflation is already evident in bond prices.
examples.translation: 通货膨胀的危险在证券价格上已经表现得很明显。

examples.text: ...the best-publicised cases of evident injustice.
examples.translation: 最广为人知的明显不公的案例

examples.text: It was evident that she had once been a beauty...
examples.translation: 显然她曾是个美人儿。

examples.text: The cities are bombarded day after day in an evident effort to force their surrender.
examples.translation: 那些城市遭到日复一日的炮轰，目的显然是要逼他们投降。

examples.text: ...the evolution of plants and animals.
examples.translation: 动植物的进化

examples.text: ...the theory of evolution by natural selection.
examples.translation: 自然选择的进化论

examples.text: ...human evolution.
examples.translation: 人类进化

examples.text: ...a crucial period in the evolution of modern physics.
examples.translation: 现代物理学演化过程中的重要时期

examples.text: ...an accurate account of his country's evolution...
examples.translation: 对他的国家演进的准确描述

examples.text: His long life comprised a series of evolutions.
examples.translation: 他漫长的一生包括一系列的发展变化。

meanings.meaning: 发展，进化；进化；使逐步形成；推断出
发展，进展；进化；逐步形成

examples.text: The bright plumage of many male birds has evolved to attract females...
examples.translation: 很多雄鸟进化出鲜艳的羽毛是为了吸引雌鸟。

examples.text: Maize evolved from a wild grass in Mexico.
examples.translation: 玉米是从墨西哥的一种野生禾本植物进化而来的。

examples.text: ...when amphibians evolved into reptiles.
examples.translation: 当两栖动物进化成爬行动物

examples.text: ...a tiny airline which eventually evolved into Pakistan International Airlines...
examples.translation: 最终发展成巴基斯坦国际航空公司的一家小型航空公司

examples.text: Popular music evolved from folk songs...
examples.translation: 流行音乐从民歌演变而来。

examples.text: As medical knowledge evolves, beliefs change...
examples.translation: 随着医学知识的逐步发展，观念也在发生变化。

examples.text: This was when he evolved the working method from which he has never departed.
examples.translation: 就在这个时候，他逐步形成了那种他一直沿用至今的工作方法。

examples.text: I don't remember the exact words...
examples.translation: 我不记得确切的话语。

examples.text: The exact number of protest calls has not been revealed...
examples.translation: 抗议电话的确切数量并未透露。

examples.text: It's an exact copy of the one which was found in Ann Alice's room.
examples.translation: 这正是在安·艾丽斯房间里找到的那份文件的副本。

examples.text: Try to locate exactly where the smells are entering the room...
examples.translation: 找找看气味具体是从什么地方散入房间的。

examples.text: The system worked perfectly, exactly as his training and plans had led him to expect...
examples.translation: 系统运行非常良好，和他在培训时与计划中预期的一模一样。

examples.text: What exactly goes wrong with those suffering from senile dementia?...
examples.translation: 那些患老年痴呆症的人到底出了什么问题？

examples.text: Both drugs will be exactly the same...
examples.translation: 两种药将完全一样。

examples.text: Barton couldn't remember exactly.
examples.translation: 巴顿记不清楚了。

examples.text: I hadn't really thought about it until this exact moment...
examples.translation: 直到这时我才真正开始考虑它。

examples.text: Do you really think I could get the exact thing I want?...
examples.translation: 你真的认为我能够得到我想要的东西么？

examples.text: It may be that you will feel the exact opposite of what you expected.
examples.translation: 可能你的感觉将和你的期盼刚好相反。

examples.text: These are exactly the people who do not vote...
examples.translation: 这些正是那些不投票的人。

examples.text: He knew exactly what he was doing.
examples.translation: 他清楚地知道自己在做什么。

examples.text: Formal, exact and obstinate, he was also cold, suspicious, touchy and tactless.
examples.translation: 严肃、严谨、倔强的他同时又冷漠、多疑、敏感、不会变通。

examples.text: Already he has exacted a written apology from the chairman of the commission...
examples.translation: 他已经强行要求委员会主席作出书面道歉。

examples.text: They, too, would be likely to exact a high price for their cooperation.
examples.translation: 他们也可能会为提供合作而索要高价。

examples.text: She uses the media to help her exact a terrible revenge.
examples.translation: 她利用媒体帮助自己进行可怕的复仇。

examples.text: The sheer physical effort had exacted a heavy price...
examples.translation: 纯粹的体力劳动已经产生了极其不利的影响。

examples.text: The strain of a violent ground campaign will exact a toll on troops.
examples.translation: 激烈的地面战役带来的紧张压力将让军队付出代价。

examples.text: A small number — five, to be exact—have been bad...
examples.translation: 一小部分——确切地说是5个——已经坏了。

examples.text: I consider myself to be a liberal democrat, or to be more exact, a democratic liberal.
examples.translation: 我认为自己是个自由主义的民主党人，或者更准确地说，是倡导民主的自由主义者。

examples.text: He thinks I'm exaggerating...
examples.translation: 他觉得我在夸大其词。

examples.text: Don't exaggerate...
examples.translation: 别夸张。

examples.text: Sheila admitted that she did sometimes exaggerate the demands of her job.
examples.translation: 希拉承认自己有时候确实夸大了工作的难度。

examples.text: Like many stories about him, it smacks of exaggeration...
examples.translation: 正如很多有关他的故事一样，这个故事也有点夸大。

examples.text: It would be an exaggeration to call the danger urgent.
examples.translation: 称那种危险为紧急事件有点夸张。

examples.text: These figures exaggerate the loss of competitiveness...
examples.translation: 这些数字夸大了竞争力的丧失。

examples.text: The dress exaggerates her wasp waist and enlarges her bosom.
examples.translation: 那件连衣裙凸显了她的蜂腰，也让她的胸部看起来更丰满。

examples.text: I don't want to take any more exams...
examples.translation: 我再也不想参加考试了。

examples.text: Kate's exam results were excellent.
examples.translation: 凯特的考试成绩非常优秀。

meanings.meaning: 检查；调查； 检测；考试

examples.text: He examined her passport and stamped it...
examples.translation: 他仔细检查了她的护照，然后在上面盖了章。

examples.text: Forensic scientists are examining what police believe to have been the bombers' car.
examples.translation: 法医学家正在对一辆警方怀疑属于投弹者的汽车进行仔细检查。

examples.text: The Navy is to carry out an examination of the wreck tomorrow...
examples.translation: 海军明天将对失事船只进行细查。

examples.text: They have also searched offices in Sheffield and taken away documents for examination.
examples.translation: 他们还搜查了位于设菲尔德的办公室，并带走了一些文件进行仔细检查。

examples.text: Another doctor examined her and could still find nothing wrong...
examples.translation: 另外一名医生对她进行了诊察，仍旧没有发现任何问题。

examples.text: He was examined again and then prescribed a different herbal medicine.
examples.translation: 医生又对他诊察了一遍，然后开了另外一种草药。

examples.text: He was later discharged after an examination at Westminster Hospital...
examples.translation: 在威斯敏斯特医院进行了一次诊察后他就出院了。

examples.text: Further examination is needed to exclude the chance of disease.
examples.translation: 需要进一步检查以排除患病的可能。

examples.text: I have given the matter much thought, examining all the possible alternatives...
examples.translation: 这个问题我已经考虑了很多，分析了各种可能的选择。

examples.text: The plans will be examined by EU environment ministers.
examples.translation: 欧盟各国环境部部长将仔细研究这些计划。

examples.text: The proposal requires careful examination and consideration.
examples.translation: 那项提议需要经过仔细研究和考虑。

examples.text: ...learning to cope with the pressures of being judged and examined by our teachers.
examples.translation: 学会应对老师评判和测验时的压力

meanings.meaning: 作为…的例子；为…做出榜样

examples.text: The doctors gave numerous examples of patients being expelled from hospital...
examples.translation: 医生们列举了大量病人被逐出医院的实例。

examples.text: Listed below are just a few examples of some of the family benefits available.
examples.translation: 下面仅例举了家庭可享受的几种福利。

examples.text: Symphonies 103 and 104 stand as perfect examples of early symphonic construction...
examples.translation: 第103和104号交响曲是早期交响乐结构的典型代表。

examples.text: The plaque illustrated in Figure 1 is an example of his work at this time.
examples.translation: 图1中的匾额是他这个时期的代表作。

examples.text: ...'educational toys' that are designed to promote the development of, for example, children's spatial ability...
examples.translation: 旨在促进儿童发展，诸如空间能力发展的“教学玩具”

examples.text: Take, for example, the simple sentence: 'The man climbed up the hill'...
examples.translation: 以The man climbed up the hill这个简单句为例。

examples.text: A few simple precautions can be taken, for example ensuring that desks are the right height.
examples.translation: 可以采取一些简单的预防措施，比如确保桌子的高度合适。

examples.text: He is a model professional and an example to the younger lads...
examples.translation: 他是个模范的专业人士，是年轻人的榜样。

examples.text: Their example shows us what we are all capable of.
examples.translation: 他们作为榜样向我们展示了我们都能做些什么。

examples.text: The examples are unique to this dictionary.
examples.translation: 这些例证是这部词典独有的。

examples.text: Following the example set by her father, she has fulfilled her role and done her duty...
examples.translation: 她以父亲为榜样，完成了任务，履行了职责。

examples.text: She should remember that she is a mother and a public figure and that others may follow her example.
examples.translation: 她应该记住自己是位母亲，也是位公众人物，别人可能会以她为榜样。

examples.text: Let us at least see our courts make an example of these despicable criminals.
examples.translation: 至少让我们看到法庭惩罚这些十恶不赦的罪犯以儆效尤。

examples.text: An officer's job was to set an example...
examples.translation: 军官的职责就是树立榜样。

examples.text: He is setting an example which other aristocrats and leading Britons should follow.
examples.translation: 他为其他贵族和伦敦要人们树立了榜样。

examples.text: Its research budget exceeds $700 million a year...
examples.translation: 其研究预算每年超过7亿美元。

examples.text: The demand for places at some schools exceeds the supply...
examples.translation: 某些学校的入学申请人数超过了招生。

examples.text: His performance exceeded all expectations.
examples.translation: 他的表演超出了所有人的期待。

examples.text: He accepts he was exceeding the speed limit...
examples.translation: 他承认自己超速了。

examples.text: I would be exceeding my powers if I ordered the march to be halted.
examples.translation: 如果我命令停止游行，我就越权了。

examples.text: We had an exceedingly good lunch...
examples.translation: 我们吃了一顿极为丰盛的午餐。

examples.text: This was an exceedingly difficult decision to take...
examples.translation: 作这个决定非常地难。

examples.text: I have a case that troubles me exceedingly.
examples.translation: 我有一件非常棘手的案子。

examples.text: Caine has always been an actor who excels in irony...
examples.translation: 凯恩向来是个擅长讽刺的演员。

examples.text: Mary was a better rider than either of them and she excelled at outdoor sports...
examples.translation: 玛丽的骑术比他们俩都要好，而且她擅长户外运动。

examples.text: Academically he began to excel...
examples.translation: 他开始在学术上超越他人。

examples.text: I think Krishnan excelled himself in all departments of his game.
examples.translation: 我认为克里舍南在比赛的各个环节都有超常的发挥。

examples.text: The recording quality is excellent...
examples.translation: 录音质量非常好。

examples.text: Luckily, Sue is very efficient and does an excellent job as Fred's personal assistant.
examples.translation: 幸运的是，作为弗雷德的私人助理，休办事效率很高，工作很出色。

examples.text: They're both playing excellently...
examples.translation: 他们双方打得都很出色。

examples.text: The tournament was excellently organised.
examples.translation: 那场锦标赛组织得很出色。

examples.text: I wouldn't have accepted anything except a job in Europe...
examples.translation: 除了到欧洲工作外，我本来什么都不会接受。

examples.text: I don't take any drugs whatsoever, except aspirin for colds...
examples.translation: 我什么药都不吃，除了感冒时吃阿司匹林。

examples.text: Children who take exams early will be allowed to drop a subject except in the case of maths, English and science.
examples.translation: 提早参加考试的孩子们可以免修除数学、英语和科学以外的一门课。

examples.text: Freddie would tell me nothing about what he was writing, except that it was to be a Christmas play...
examples.translation: 弗雷迪丝毫不肯透露他正在写什么，只告诉我那是一个圣诞节剧本。

examples.text: The log cabin stayed empty, except when we came...
examples.translation: 除非我们到来，要不然那间小木屋一直都是空的。

examples.text: Ida would not speak to him except to answer questions...
examples.translation: 除了回答问题，艾达都不和他说话。

examples.text: Nothing more to do now except wait.
examples.translation: 现在只能等待。

examples.text: He hadn't eaten a thing except for one forkful of salad...
examples.translation: 除了一餐叉色拉，他什么都没吃。

examples.text: Everyone was late, except for Richard.
examples.translation: 除了理查德，其他所有人都迟到了。

examples.text: Few guitarists can sing as well as they can play; Eddie, however, is an exception...
examples.translation: 很少有吉他手唱歌像弹吉他那么好，然而埃迪是个例外。

examples.text: There were no floral offerings at the ceremony, with the exception of a single red rose...
examples.translation: 除了一朵红色玫瑰花外，仪式上没有任何献花。

examples.text: The law makes no exceptions...
examples.translation: 法律不容许搞特殊。

examples.text: With few exceptions, guests are booked for week-long visits.
examples.translation: 宾客们几乎毫无例外地预订了一周游。

examples.text: Marketing is applied to everything these days, and books are no exception...
examples.translation: 现在市场营销已无处不在，图书也不例外。

examples.text: Most people have no real idea how to change to healthy food, and Maureen was no exception.
examples.translation: 大多数人并不真正清楚究竟如何转而食用健康食品，莫琳也是如此。

examples.text: Wine-making and accountants don't usually go together, but Thierry Hasard is an exception that proves the rule.
examples.translation: 酿酒和会计通常不搭边，而蒂埃里·阿萨尔却是普遍中的例外。

examples.text: He also took exception to having been spied on...
examples.translation: 他也讨厌被暗中监视。

examples.text: And the problem is that they take exception to any kind of noise whatsoever.
examples.translation: 问题是他们反感任何形式的噪音。

examples.text: Yesterday was a day off for everybody, with the exception of Lawrence...
examples.translation: 昨天所有人都放一天假，劳伦斯除外。

examples.text: In virtually every sport, with the possible exception of women's gymnastics, the players are now bigger and stronger than before.
examples.translation: 几乎在所有体育运动中，可能除女子体操外，现在的运动员都要比过去更加高大强壮。

examples.text: The vehicles are without exception old, rusty and dented...
examples.translation: 那些车辆一律都很破旧，锈迹斑斑，布满凹痕。

examples.text: Almost without exception those convicted were our friends and colleagues.
examples.translation: 那些被判有罪的人几乎无一例外都是我们的朋友和同事。

examples.text: ...children with exceptional ability...
examples.translation: 具有非凡才能的孩子们

examples.text: His translation is exceptional in its poetic quality.
examples.translation: 他的译作非常有诗意。

examples.text: He's an exceptionally talented dancer...
examples.translation: 他是个非常有天赋的舞者。

examples.text: The conditions under ground were exceptionally hot.
examples.translation: 地下环境非常热。

examples.text: ...if the courts hold that this case is exceptional...
examples.translation: 如果法庭认为这是个特殊案例

examples.text: School governors have the discretion to allow parents to withdraw pupils in exceptional circumstances.
examples.translation: 督学可以酌情允许父母在特殊情况下让学生退学。

examples.text: Exceptionally, in times of emergency, we may send a team of experts...
examples.translation: 在紧急情况下，我们可能会破例派一个专家小组。

examples.text: At your request we may agree, exceptionally, to work outside usual working hours.
examples.translation: 在您的要求下，我们可能会破例同意在正常工作时间之外工作。

examples.text: ...an excerpt from Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker.
examples.translation: 柴可夫斯基的《胡桃夹子》选段

examples.text: The readings you heard earlier were excerpted from a new oral history of Pearl Harbor.
examples.translation: 你之前听到的朗读片段节选自一部新的珍珠港口述史。

meanings.meaning: 超过，超额；过度，过量；无节制

examples.text: An excess of house plants in a small flat can be oppressive...
examples.translation: 在小公寓中摆放过多室内植物会让人觉得很压抑。

examples.text: Polyunsaturated oils are essential for health. Excess is harmful, however.
examples.translation: 多不饱和油对健康很重要。但是，食用过量就会有害。

examples.text: After cooking the fish, pour off any excess fat...
examples.translation: 烹完鱼后，倒掉多余的油。

examples.text: The major reason for excess weight is excess eating.
examples.translation: 体重超标的主要原因是饮食过量。

examples.text: She said she was sick of her life of excess.
examples.translation: 她说她厌倦了自己无节制的生活。

examples.text: ...adolescent excess.
examples.translation: 青春期的放肆

examples.text: ...the bloody excesses of warfare and empire-building.
examples.translation: 战争和帝国扩张的血腥暴行

examples.text: ...a letter demanding an excess fare of £20...
examples.translation: 要求额外付20英镑邮资的信

examples.text: Staff who have to travel farther can claim excess travel expenses.
examples.translation: 需要到更远的地方出差的职员可以领取额外差旅费。

examples.text: The company wanted £1,800 for a policy with a £500 excess for under-21s.
examples.translation: 那家公司想要办理单价1,800英镑的保单，并且要求21岁以下人员承担价值500英镑的免赔额。

examples.text: Avoid deposits in excess of £20,000 in any one account...
examples.translation: 单一账户存款勿超过两万英镑。

examples.text: The energy value of dried fruits is considerably in excess of that of fresh items.
examples.translation: 干果的能量值大大超过新鲜水果。

examples.text: I was reasonably fit, played a lot of tennis, and didn't smoke or drink to excess...
examples.translation: 我相当健康，经常打网球，不怎么吸烟，也不酗酒。

examples.text: Red meat, eaten to excess, is very high in fat and calories.
examples.translation: 过量食用的红肉中脂肪和卡路里含量很高。

examples.text: ...the alleged use of excessive force by police...
examples.translation: 警察涉嫌滥用武力

examples.text: The government says that local authority spending is excessive.
examples.translation: 政府称地方当局开支过大。

examples.text: Managers are also accused of paying themselves excessively high salaries...
examples.translation: 经理们还被指责给自己支付过高的薪水。

examples.text: Mum had started taking pills and drinking excessively.
examples.translation: 妈妈开始服药酗酒。

examples.text: We exchanged addresses and Christmas cards...
examples.translation: 我们交换了地址和圣诞贺卡。

examples.text: The two men exchanged glances...
examples.translation: 那两个男人互相扫了一眼。

examples.text: He exchanged a quick smile with her then entered the lift.
examples.translation: 他和她匆匆相视一笑，然后走进了电梯。

examples.text: He ruled out any exchange of prisoners with the militants.
examples.translation: 他拒绝和武装分子进行任何交换俘虏的活动。

examples.text: ...a frank exchange of views.
examples.translation: 坦诚地交换意见

examples.text: ...the chance to sell back or exchange goods...
examples.translation: 回销或调换商品的机会

examples.text: If the car you have leased is clearly unsatisfactory, you can always exchange it for another.
examples.translation: 如果你对租借的车明显不满意，可随时另换一辆。

examples.text: There've been some bitter exchanges between the two groups.
examples.translation: 两组之间发生过一些激烈的争吵。

examples.text: There was an exchange of fire during which the gunman was wounded...
examples.translation: 有过交火，其间那名持枪歹徒受伤了。

examples.text: This could intensify the risk of a nuclear exchange.
examples.translation: 这可能会加剧爆发核战争的危险。

examples.text: ...a series of sporting and cultural exchanges with Seoul...
examples.translation: 和首尔之间的一系列体育和文化交流

examples.text: ...educational exchanges for young people...
examples.translation: 面向年轻人的教育交流

examples.text: I'm going to go on an exchange visit to Paris.
examples.translation: 我将到巴黎交流参观。

examples.text: ...the Royal Exchange.
examples.translation: 皇家交易所

examples.text: It is illegal for public officials to solicit gifts or money in exchange for favors...
examples.translation: 公务员通过索要礼物或钱财作为为他人提供便利的交换是违法的。

examples.text: He paid her a huge salary. In exchange, he was assured of her vote.
examples.translation: 他给她支付了很高的薪水，作为交换，他确定能够得到她的选票。

examples.text: I only take on work that excites me, even if it means turning down lots of money...
examples.translation: 我只做那些令我感兴趣的工作，即使这意味着要少赚很多钱。

examples.text: We'd not been excited by anything for about three years...
examples.translation: 已经有大约3年的时间没有任何事情令我们激动。

examples.text: Where the show really excites is in the display of avant-garde photography.
examples.translation: 那场展览真正令人激动的就是先锋派摄影的展示。

examples.text: By all accounts, the monarchy does not excite strong feelings among the majority of Romanians...
examples.translation: 据各方面记述，君主制没有在大多数罗马人中激发起强烈的感情。

examples.text: Daniel's early exposure to motor racing did not excite his interest...
examples.translation: 丹尼尔早期与摩托车赛的接触并没有激发他的兴趣。

examples.text: Reports of the plot of this unusual film tend to excite revulsion.
examples.translation: 有关这部不同寻常电影的情节的报道常常令人生厌。

examples.text: Don't try exciting your partner with dirty magazines.
examples.translation: 不要尝试用黄色杂志激起伴侣的性欲。

examples.text: She makes you feel warm and comfortable, and maybe a little excited.
examples.translation: 她让人感觉温暖舒适，还可能有一点性欲高涨。

examples.text: ...a sexually exciting thought.
examples.translation: 激起性欲的想法

examples.text: The amount of nicotine in these nicotine substitutes can be enough to excite the heart.
examples.translation: 这些尼古丁替代品中的烟碱含量足以刺激心脏。

examples.text: ...when an electron drops from an excited state to a less excited state.
examples.translation: 当电子从激发态降为低激发态时

meanings.meaning: 兴奋；刺激；令人兴奋的事物

examples.text: Everyone is in a state of great excitement.
examples.translation: 每个人都大为兴奋。

examples.text: ...the excitement of a thunderstorm...
examples.translation: 雷雨交加的刺激

examples.text: This game had its challenges, excitements and rewards.
examples.translation: 这款游戏有各种挑战、刺激和奖赏。

meanings.meaning: 令人兴奋的；使人激动的

examples.text: The race itself is very exciting...
examples.translation: 比赛本身非常刺激。

examples.text: This voyage was the most exciting adventure of their lives...
examples.translation: 这次旅行是他们人生中最刺激的冒险经历。

examples.text: Jackie was an exciting player to watch.
examples.translation: 看杰基打球很刺激。

examples.text: He is an excitingly original writer.
examples.translation: 他是个极具独创性的作家。

examples.text: 'He went back to the lab', Iris exclaimed impatiently...
examples.translation: “他回实验室去了，”艾里斯不耐烦地大声说。

examples.text: He exclaims that it must be a typing error.
examples.translation: 他惊呼道那一定是个打字错误。

meanings.meaning: 排除；排斥；拒绝接纳；逐出

examples.text: The Academy excluded women from its classes...
examples.translation: 该学院不招收女学生。

examples.text: The army should be excluded from political life...
examples.translation: 军队不应该涉足政治。

examples.text: Many of the youngsters feel excluded.
examples.translation: 很多年轻人感觉自己被排挤。

examples.text: They eat only plant foods, and take care to exclude animal products from other areas of their lives...
examples.translation: 他们只吃素食，在生活的其他方面也注意拒绝使用动物产品。

examples.text: In some schools, Christmas carols are being modified to exclude any reference to Christ.
examples.translation: 某些学校正在对圣诞颂歌进行修改，删除提及耶稣的内容。

examples.text: I cannot entirely exclude the possibility that some form of pressure was applied to the neck.
examples.translation: 我不能完全排除颈部受到某种压迫的可能性。

examples.text: ...the pathological evidence, which does not exclude suicide.
examples.translation: 不排除自杀可能的病理学证据

examples.text: This was intended to exclude the direct rays of the sun...
examples.translation: 其目的是阻挡直射的太阳光。

examples.text: They have spent $3 million building fences around the National Park to exclude such pests.
examples.translation: 为了阻止这类有害动物进入，他们已经耗资300万美元在国家公园周边建造围栏。

meanings.meaning: 独家新闻；独家经营的项目；排外者

examples.text: He is already a member of Britain's most exclusive club...
examples.translation: 他已经是英国最高级俱乐部的成员了。

examples.text: The City was criticised for being too exclusive and uncompetitive.
examples.translation: 伦敦城被指责过于奢华和缺乏竞争力。

examples.text: ...a rising middle class, which objected to the exclusiveness of the traditional elite.
examples.translation: 反对传统精英奢华生活的新兴中产阶级

examples.text: ...a company with a reputation for exclusivity.
examples.translation: 因奢华而闻名的公司

examples.text: Our group will have exclusive use of a 60-foot boat...
examples.translation: 我们小组将独用一条60英尺长的船。

examples.text: Many of their cheeses are exclusive to our stores in Britain.
examples.translation: 在英国，他们生产的奶酪很多只在我们商店出售。

examples.text: Only 250 are to be sold in Europe, so exclusivity is guaranteed.
examples.translation: 在欧洲仅售250辆，所以可以保证与众不同。

examples.text: He told the magazine in an exclusive interview: 'All my problems stem from drink'.
examples.translation: 他在接受一家杂志社的独家采访时说：“我所有的问题都是饮酒造成的。”

examples.text: Some papers thought they had an exclusive.
examples.translation: 一些报纸认为自己是独家报道。

examples.text: All charges for service are exclusive of value added tax...
examples.translation: 所有服务费都不包括增值税。

examples.text: Skiing weekends cost £58 (exclusive of travel and accommodation).
examples.translation: 周末滑雪价格为58英镑（不含交通和住宿费）。

examples.text: They both have learnt that ambition and successful fatherhood can be mutually exclusive.
examples.translation: 他们两个人都认识到了追求理想和做个好父亲不能两者兼顾。

meanings.meaning: 偏移；远足；短程旅行；离题；游览，游览团

examples.text: In Bermuda, Sam's father took him on an excursion to a coral barrier.
examples.translation: 在百慕大，萨姆的父亲带他到附近的珊瑚礁去游玩。

examples.text: We also recommend a full day optional excursion to the Upper Douro...
examples.translation: 我们还推荐去杜罗河上游的短途自选一日游。

examples.text: Another pleasant excursion is Malaga, 18 miles away.
examples.translation: 另一个非常不错的短途旅游是去18英里以外的马拉加。

examples.text: ...Radio 3's latest excursion into ethnic music, dance and literature...
examples.translation: 第三广播台最近开始涉及有关少数民族音乐、舞蹈和文学的节目

examples.text: The few excursions into stylistic experiment do not entirely come off.
examples.translation: 几次体裁上的尝试都不算很成功。

meanings.meaning: 作为借口；请求宽恕；表示宽恕

examples.text: It is easy to find excuses for his indecisiveness...
examples.translation: 为他的犹豫不决寻找借口是很容易的。

examples.text: Once I had had a baby I had the perfect excuse to stay at home...
examples.translation: 一旦有了宝宝，我就完全有理由呆在家里了。

examples.text: If you stop making excuses and do it you'll wonder what took you so long.
examples.translation: 如果你不再找理由而是干些实事，你就会惊讶自己怎么浪费了这么多时间。

examples.text: There's no excuse for behaviour like that...
examples.translation: 没理由做出那种行为。

examples.text: Solitude was no excuse for sloppiness.
examples.translation: 独居不是邋遢的理由。

examples.text: He excused himself by saying he was 'forced to rob to maintain my wife and cat'...
examples.translation: 他辩解说自己是“为了供养妻子和猫儿被迫去抢劫的”。

examples.text: That doesn't excuse my mother's behaviour.
examples.translation: 那并不能为我母亲的行为辩解。

examples.text: Many people might have excused them for shirking some of their responsibilities.
examples.translation: 很多人可能已经原谅了他们逃避责任的行为。

examples.text: She is usually excused from her duties during the school holidays...
examples.translation: 在学校放假期间，她通常不必担负职责。

examples.text: She was excused duties on Saturday.
examples.translation: 星期六她不用工作。

examples.text: He excused himself and went up to his room.
examples.translation: 他告辞后回到他楼上的房间。

examples.text: Excuse me, but are you Mr Honig?
examples.translation: 请问，您是霍尼格先生吗？

examples.text: Excuse me interrupting, but there's a thing I feel I've got to say.
examples.translation: 抱歉打断一下，我觉得有件事我得说。

examples.text: 'Excuse me,' she said to Jarvis, and left the room...
examples.translation: “抱歉出去一下，”她对贾维斯说，然后离开了房间。

examples.text: Now if you'll excuse me, I've got work to do.
examples.translation: 对不起，这会儿我有工作要做。

examples.text: Excuse me, but I want to know what all this has to do with us.
examples.translation: 抱歉，我想知道所有这些和我们有什么关系。

examples.text: Saying excuse me, pardon me, Seaton pushed his way into the crowded living room.
examples.translation: 西顿一边说对不起、借过，一边挤过人群进入拥挤的客厅。

examples.text: He was executed by lethal injection earlier today...
examples.translation: 他于今天早些时候被注射处死。

examples.text: One group claimed to have executed the American hostage...
examples.translation: 一个组织声称已经处决了那名美国人质。

examples.text: This boy's father had been executed for conspiring against the throne.
examples.translation: 这个男孩的父亲因为密谋反对君主而被处死。

examples.text: Execution by lethal injection is scheduled for July 30th.
examples.translation: 定于7月30日执行注射死刑。

examples.text: We are going to execute our campaign plan to the letter.
examples.translation: 我们将严格施行我们的竞选计划。

examples.text: US forces are fully prepared for the execution of any action once the order is given by the president.
examples.translation: 美国军队充分准备好随时执行总统的任何指令。

examples.text: I executed the hairpin turn high on the sheer western face of the mountains...
examples.translation: 我在山脉西侧陡峭的高处成功地急转弯。

examples.text: The landing was skilfully executed.
examples.translation: 熟练地完成了着陆。

examples.text: Morris executed a suite of twelve drawings in 1978...
examples.translation: 莫里斯在1978年创作了由12幅画组成的一组作品。

examples.text: A well-executed shot of a tall ship is a joy to behold.
examples.translation: 欣赏优秀的高桅横帆船摄影作品是种乐趣。

examples.text: The ideas in the show's presentation were good, but failed in execution.
examples.translation: 那场展览陈述的想法很好，但是没能实现。

meanings.meaning: 行政的；经营的；执行的，经营管理的
总经理；执行委员会；执行者；经理主管人员

examples.text: ...an advertising executive.
examples.translation: 广告主管

examples.text: ...Her husband is a senior bank executive.
examples.translation: 她丈夫是银行高级主管。

examples.text: A successful job search needs to be as well organised as any other executive task...
examples.translation: 成功的求职与执行其他任何任务一样，都需要良好的条理性。

examples.text: I don't envisage I will take an executive role, but rather become a consultant on merchandise and marketing.
examples.translation: 我不设想自己将成为管理人员，但很希望成为商品营销顾问。

examples.text: ...an executive briefcase.
examples.translation: 高级公文包

examples.text: ...a chain of shops specialising in pricey executive toys.
examples.translation: 专卖价格昂贵的精美玩具的连锁商店

examples.text: ...executive cars.
examples.translation: 高级轿车

examples.text: He sits on the executive committee that manages Lloyds...
examples.translation: 他是管理劳埃德保险公司的执行委员会成员。

examples.text: Some executive members have called for his resignation.
examples.translation: 一些执行委员会成员要求他辞职。

examples.text: ...the executive of the National Union of Students.
examples.translation: 全国学生会执行委员会

examples.text: The government, the executive and the judiciary are supposed to be separate...
examples.translation: 政府、行政部门和司法部门应该彼此分离。

examples.text: The matter should be resolved by the executive branch of government.
examples.translation: 这个问题应该由政府的行政部门解决。

examples.text: The room's style exemplifies Conran's ideal of 'beauty and practicality'.
examples.translation: 那个房间的风格是体现康兰“美观和实用”观念的典范。

examples.text: ...the emotional expressiveness of modern dance as exemplified by the work of Martha Graham.
examples.translation: 以玛莎·格雷厄姆的作品为代表的现代舞的情感表现力

examples.text: Men in college were exempt from military service...
examples.translation: 大学在校男生免服兵役。

examples.text: Children under two years are exempt.
examples.translation: 两岁以下儿童免票。

examples.text: The fund was in danger of losing its tax-exempt status.
examples.translation: 该基金面临不再享受免税待遇的风险。

examples.text: South Carolina claimed the power to exempt its citizens from the obligation to obey federal law...
examples.translation: 南卡罗来纳州声称有权力免除该州公民遵守联邦法规的义务。

examples.text: Companies with fifty-five or fewer employees would be exempted from the requirements.
examples.translation: 员工在55人及以下的公司将免除这些条件。

examples.text: ...the exemption of employer-provided health insurance from taxation.
examples.translation: 雇主提供的健康保险免税

examples.text: ...new exemptions for students and the low-paid.
examples.translation: 对学生和低收入者的最新豁免

examples.text: He exerted considerable influence on the thinking of the scientific community on these issues...
examples.translation: 他极大地影响了科学界对这些问题的看法。

examples.text: The cyst was causing swelling and exerting pressure on her brain.
examples.translation: 那个囊肿正在引起肿胀，压迫着她的大脑。

examples.text: Youngsters get so absorbed that they don't realise how much they're exerting themselves...
examples.translation: 年轻人如此地沉浸其中，他们没有意识到自己有多么努力。

examples.text: Do not exert yourself unnecessarily.
examples.translation: 不要做无谓的努力。

examples.text: He clearly found the physical exertion exhilarating...
examples.translation: 他明显感觉体力劳动令人愉快。

examples.text: Thanks to the exertions of a few sensible and courageous men, the compromise was accepted.
examples.translation: 由于少数明智且勇敢的人的努力，折中方案被采纳了。

meanings.meaning: 运动；练习；运用；操练；礼拜；典礼
锻炼；练习；使用；使忙碌；使惊恐

examples.text: They are merely exercising their right to free speech...
examples.translation: 他们只是在行使他们的言论自由权。

examples.text: 'The powers delegated to me,' the President said, 'will be exercised with due responsibility.'...
examples.translation: “赋予我的权力，”总统说，“我将尽责履行。”

examples.text: Britain has warned travellers to exercise prudence and care.
examples.translation: 英国已经警告游客要谨慎小心。

examples.text: ...the exercise of political and economic power...
examples.translation: 行使政治经济权力

examples.text: Leadership does not rest on the exercise of force alone.
examples.translation: 领导才能并不仅仅在于武力的运用。

examples.text: She exercises two or three times a week...
examples.translation: 她每周锻炼两三次。

examples.text: Never keep on exercising if you have even the slightest chest pain...
examples.translation: 即使你只感到很轻微的胸部疼痛，也不要继续锻炼。

examples.text: Exercising the body does a great deal to improve one's health.
examples.translation: 锻炼身体对增进健康大有益处。

examples.text: Lack of exercise can lead to feelings of depression and exhaustion...
examples.translation: 缺乏锻炼会导致抑郁和疲劳。

examples.text: Aerobic exercise moves our entire body and uses most major muscles.
examples.translation: 有氧运动活动全身，锻炼大多数主要肌肉。

examples.text: They call rowing the perfect sport. It exercises every major muscle group.
examples.translation: 他们称划船是最佳运动，它可以锻炼每一处主要肌肉群。

examples.text: These stomach exercises will tighten abdominal muscles...
examples.translation: 这些腹部练习会增强腹肌。

examples.text: I do special neck and shoulder exercises...
examples.translation: 我做专门的颈部和肩部运动。

examples.text: That's when I try to meditate or do some deep-breathing exercises.
examples.translation: 这时我就会试着沉思或者做些深呼吸练习。

examples.text: General Powell predicted that in the future it might even be possible to stage joint military exercises...
examples.translation: 鲍威尔将军预测将来甚至可能举行联合军事演习。

examples.text: The military truck was taking 14 men on exercise in a remote area of Norway.
