examples.translation: 那辆军用卡车正载着14名士兵到挪威的一个偏远地区进行操练。

examples.text: Try working through the opening exercises in this chapter...
examples.translation: 做一做本章节的开篇习题。

examples.text: He took up piano lessons, combining standard classical exercises with his own attempts at Gershwin.
examples.translation: 他上钢琴课，一边进行标准的经典作品的练习，一边自己尝试练习格什温的作品。

examples.text: Vicky and Gary attended the graduation exercises at Columbia.
examples.translation: 维基和加里参加了哥伦比亚大学的毕业典礼。

examples.text: Her morning was an exercise in indecision. She tried on everything in her closet but couldn't remember what he'd liked...
examples.translation: 她整个早晨都犹豫不决。她试穿了衣橱中的所有衣服，却不记得他喜欢哪一件。

examples.text: As an exercise in stating the obvious, this could scarcely be faulted...
examples.translation: 这说的都是些显而易见的事情，几乎不可能出错。

examples.text: Think what a waste of taxpayers' money the whole exercise was.
examples.translation: 想想那整件事会浪费纳税人多少钱呀。

examples.text: This has been a major problem exercising the minds of scientists around the world...
examples.translation: 这一直是困扰全世界科学家的一个重要问题。

examples.text: The proper role of appeal judges is an issue that has long exercised the finest legal minds.
examples.translation: 上诉法官应当扮演何种角色，这一问题长期以来困扰着那些最出色的法律人士。

meanings.meaning: 排出；耗尽；使精疲力尽；彻底探讨

examples.text: Don't exhaust him...
examples.translation: 不要把他累坏了。

examples.text: He took to walking long distances in an attempt to physically exhaust himself.
examples.translation: 他开始长距离步行，试图耗尽自己的体力。

examples.text: She was too exhausted and distressed to talk about the tragedy.
examples.translation: 她太累了，而且无比悲伤，没法谈论那场悲剧。

examples.text: It was an exhausting schedule she had set herself.
examples.translation: 她给自己安排了叫人筋疲力尽的日程。

examples.text: We have exhausted all our material resources...
examples.translation: 我们已经耗尽了所有的物资。

examples.text: They said that food supplies were almost exhausted.
examples.translation: 他们说供应的食物几乎快要吃完了。

examples.text: She and Chantal must have exhausted the subject of babies and clothes.
examples.translation: 她和尚塔尔肯定已经充分讨论过宝宝和衣服的问题。

examples.text: ...the exhaust from a car engine...
examples.translation: 汽车发动机排放的尾气

examples.text: The city's streets are filthy and choked with exhaust fumes.
examples.translation: 那座城市的街道肮脏不堪，弥漫着令人窒息的废气。

examples.text: ...the concentration of car exhausts in the Los Angeles area.
examples.translation: 洛杉矶地区汽车尾气的浓度

examples.text: He has exhibited symptoms of anxiety and overwhelming worry...
examples.translation: 他表现出焦躁不安和过度忧虑的症状。

examples.text: Two cats or more in one house will also exhibit territorial behaviour...
examples.translation: 一所房子里有两只以上的猫时也会出现划分地盘的行为。

examples.text: The economy continued to exhibit signs of decline in September.
examples.translation: 9月份，经济继续呈现出衰退的迹象。

examples.text: His work was exhibited in the best galleries in America, Europe and Asia.
examples.translation: 他的作品在美洲、欧洲和亚洲最好的美术馆展出。

examples.text: ...a massive elephant exhibited by London Zoo in the late 19th Century.
examples.translation: 19世纪末伦敦动物园展出的一头巨型大象

examples.text: Five large pieces of the wall are currently on exhibition in London.
examples.translation: 那堵墙的5块大碎片眼下正在伦敦展出。

examples.text: By 1936 she was exhibiting at the Royal Academy.
examples.translation: 到1936年她已在皇家艺术学院展出作品。

examples.text: Shona showed me round the exhibits.
examples.translation: 肖纳带我参观了展品。

examples.text: ...an exhibit at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
examples.translation: 大都会艺术博物馆的展览

examples.text: Other women seemed content and even exhibited their bellies with pride...
examples.translation: 其他女人似乎很满足，甚至还骄傲地炫耀她们的肚腩。

examples.text: He seems to want to exhibit his shame.
examples.translation: 他似乎想要让大家知道自己感到羞愧。

meanings.meaning: 展览，显示；展览会；展览品

examples.text: ...an exhibition of expressionist art.
examples.translation: 表现派艺术展览会

examples.text: ...an exhibition on the natural history of the area.
examples.translation: 该地区自然历史的展览会

examples.text: He responded in champion's style by treating the fans to an exhibition of power and speed.
examples.translation: 他向崇拜者展示了他的力量和速度，表现得颇有冠军风范。

meanings.meaning: 流放，充军；放逐，被放逐者；流犯

examples.text: He is now living in exile in Egypt...
examples.translation: 他目前流亡埃及。

examples.text: He returned from exile earlier this year.
examples.translation: 今年早些时候他流亡归来。

examples.text: ...after nearly six years of exile...
examples.translation: 在将近6年的流亡生活之后

examples.text: During his exile, he also began writing books.
examples.translation: 在流放期间，他也开始写书。

examples.text: His second wife, Hilary, had been widowed, then exiled from South Africa...
examples.translation: 他的第二任妻子希拉丽已经成了寡妇，后来又被驱逐出南非。

examples.text: They threatened to exile her in southern Spain.
examples.translation: 他们威胁要将她流放到西班牙南部。

examples.text: ...Haiti's exiled president.
examples.translation: 海地流亡总统

examples.text: He has been exiled from the first team and forced to play in third team matches...
examples.translation: 他被开除出甲级球队，被迫参加丙级球队的比赛。

examples.text: Michael was exiled to the kitchen for supper.
examples.translation: 迈克尔被赶到厨房吃晚饭。

examples.text: Rovers lost 4-1 and began their long exile from the First Division.
examples.translation: 流浪者队以1比4落败，从此开始长期无缘甲级联赛。

meanings.meaning: 存在；生存；生活；继续存在

examples.text: He thought that if he couldn't see something, it didn't exist...
examples.translation: 他认为自己看不见的东西就不存在。

examples.text: Research opportunities exist in a wide range of pure and applied areas of entomology...
examples.translation: 纯理论昆虫学和应用昆虫学的众多领域都存在着研究机会。

examples.text: When Alfred Adler first postulated in 1908 that there existed an inborn instinct of aggression Freud argued against it.
examples.translation: 当艾尔弗雷德·阿德勒于1908年首次提出人生来就有攻击性本能的假设时，弗洛伊德对此表示反对。

examples.text: I exist from one visit to the next...
examples.translation: 我的生活就是一个接一个的访问。

examples.text: I was barely existing.
examples.translation: 我勉强维持生计。

examples.text: ...the problems of having to exist on unemployment benefit.
examples.translation: 不得不靠失业救济金过活的那些问题

meanings.meaning: 存在，实在；生存，生活；存在物，实在物

examples.text: ...the existence of other galaxies...
examples.translation: 其他星系的存在

examples.text: The Congress of People's Deputies in effect voted itself out of existence...
examples.translation: (苏联)人民代表大会的投票在事实上终结了自身的存在。

examples.text: Public worries about accidents are threatening the very existence of the nuclear power industry.
examples.translation: 公众对事故的担忧正威胁着核能工业的生存。

examples.text: You may be stuck with a miserable existence for the rest of your life...
examples.translation: 你可能一辈子都要过着悲惨的生活。

examples.text: Their day-to-day existence was routine.
examples.translation: 他们的日常生活很平淡。

examples.text: He picked up the case and walked towards the exit...
examples.translation: 他提起箱子，向出口走去。

examples.text: There's a fire exit by the downstairs ladies room.
examples.translation: 楼下女洗手间旁边有个消防出口。

examples.text: Take the A422 exit at Old Stratford.
examples.translation: 从旧斯特拉福特的A422号出口出来。

examples.text: I made a hasty exit and managed to open the gate.
examples.translation: 我匆忙离开并设法打开了大门。

examples.text: ...after England's exit from the European Championship...
examples.translation: 英格兰退出欧锦赛后

examples.text: They suggested that she make a dignified exit in the interest of the party.
examples.translation: 他们建议她为了政党的利益体面地下台。

examples.text: She exits into the tropical storm...
examples.translation: 她走了出去，消失在热带风暴中。

examples.text: As I exited the final display, I entered a hexagonal room...
examples.translation: 我从最后一个展厅里出来，走进一个六角形的房间。

examples.text: She walked into the front door of a store and exited from the rear.
examples.translation: 她走进了一家商店的前门，又从后门离开。

examples.text: I can open other applications without having to exit WordPerfect.
examples.translation: 我不必退出WordPerfect程序就可以打开其他应用程序。

examples.text: Press Exit to return to your document.
examples.translation: 按“退出”返回文档。

meanings.meaning: 异国的；外来的；异国情调的

examples.text: ...brilliantly coloured, exotic flowers...
examples.translation: 色彩斑斓的奇异花卉

examples.text: She flits from one exotic location to another.
examples.translation: 她辗转于异国他乡。

examples.text: ...exotically beautiful scenery.
examples.translation: 异常美丽的景色

examples.text: Engineers noticed that the pipes were not expanding as expected...
examples.translation: 工程师注意到管道并没有如预期那样膨胀。

examples.text: The money supply expanded by 14.6 per cent in the year to September...
examples.translation: 截至9月，当年的货币供应增加了14.6％。

examples.text: We have to expand the size of the image.
examples.translation: 我们不得不放大图像的尺寸。

examples.text: ...a rapidly expanding universe.
examples.translation: 迅速扩张的宇宙

examples.text: ...strips of expanded polystyrene.
examples.translation: 聚苯乙烯泡沫条

examples.text: The popular ceramics industry expanded towards the middle of the 19th century...
examples.translation: 到19世纪中期，大众制陶业得到了发展。

examples.text: The interest rate's coming down. I'll be able to expand or stay in business...
examples.translation: 利率正在降低，我可以扩大公司或者维持经营。

examples.text: I owned a bookshop and desired to expand the business...
examples.translation: 我拥有一家书店，想要扩大业务。

examples.text: Health officials are proposing to expand their services by organising counselling.
examples.translation: 卫生官员计划通过组织咨询来扩展他们的服务。

examples.text: ...the rapid expansion of private health insurance.
examples.translation: 个人健康保险的迅速发展

examples.text: ...a new period of economic expansion...
examples.translation: 经济发展的新时期

examples.text: The company has abandoned plans for further expansion.
examples.translation: 该公司已经放弃了进一步扩张的计划。

examples.text: ...a council workman who expects to lose his job in the next few weeks...
examples.translation: 预计自己在接下来的几周里会丢掉工作的市政工人

examples.text: They no longer expect corporate profits to improve...
examples.translation: 他们不再期待公司利润会增长。

examples.text: The talks are expected to continue until tomorrow...
examples.translation: 预计会谈将持续到明天。

examples.text: Few expected that he would declare his candidacy for the Democratic nomination for the presidency...
examples.translation: 几乎没人预料到他会宣布参加民主党总统候选人的竞选。

examples.text: It is expected that the new owner will change the yacht's name...
examples.translation: 估计新主人会给游艇改名。

examples.text: They expect a gradual improvement in sales of new cars.
examples.translation: 他们预计新车的销量会逐步上升。

examples.text: I am expecting several important letters but nothing has arrived...
examples.translation: 我正在等几封重要的信件，可是一封都没到。

examples.text: I wasn't expecting a visitor...
examples.translation: 我没想到会有人来访。

examples.text: We were expecting him home again any day now.
examples.translation: 我们期盼着他某一天再回家。

examples.text: He wasn't expecting our hospitality...
examples.translation: 他没有指望我们会盛情款待。

examples.text: I do expect to have some time to myself in the evenings...
examples.translation: 我确实希望晚上能有些属于自己的时间。

examples.text: I wasn't expecting you to help...
examples.translation: 我没指望你帮忙。

examples.text: Is this a rational thing to expect of your partner, or not?...
examples.translation: 指望你的伴侣做这件事合理吗？

examples.text: She realizes now she expected too much of Helen.
examples.translation: 现在她意识到自己对海伦的期望太高了。

examples.text: Don't expect an instant cure...
examples.translation: 别指望立即治愈。

examples.text: You cannot expect to like all the people you will work with...
examples.translation: 不要指望你会喜欢所有和你共事的人。

examples.text: Don't expect me to come and visit you there.
examples.translation: 别指望我会去那儿看你。

examples.text: She was expecting another baby...
examples.translation: 她又怀孕了。

examples.text: I hear Dawn's expecting again.
examples.translation: 我听说唐又怀孕了。

examples.text: I expect you can guess what follows...
examples.translation: 我想你能猜出接下来发生了什么。

examples.text: I expect you're tired...
examples.translation: 我想你累了。

examples.text: 'Will Joe be here at Christmas?' — 'I expect so.'...
examples.translation: “圣诞节时乔会来这里吗？”——“我想会的。”

examples.text: 'I don't think you have much of a case.' — 'I expect not.'
examples.translation: “我想你没有什么好理由。”——“我想没有。”

examples.text: It tastes artificial, but at that price what can you expect?...
examples.translation: 尝起来像是假的，但是就这个价格你还想指望什么？

examples.text: If a guy hunts and owns guns, what do you expect?
examples.translation: 如果一个人打猎而且还有自己的枪，你还想指望什么？

examples.text: Students' expectations were as varied as their expertise...
examples.translation: 学生们的期望根据他们的专业各有不同。

examples.text: The car has been General Motors' most visible success story, with sales far exceeding expectations...
examples.translation: 那种车是通用汽车公司有目共睹最成功的车型，销量远远超过预期。

examples.text: The Chancellor's statement lowers expectations of an early election...
examples.translation: 总理的发言使人们对提前选举不再抱太大期望。

examples.text: Contrary to general expectation, he announced that all four had given their approval.
examples.translation: 与大众的期盼相反的是，他宣布那4个人都同意了。

examples.text: Stephen Chase had determined to live up to the expectations of the Company.
examples.translation: 斯蒂芬·蔡斯决心不辜负公司的期望。

examples.text: ...the expectation that the grieving process should have a time limit on it.
examples.translation: 希望悲痛情绪不要长久持续下去

examples.text: ...Byrd's 1928 expedition to Antarctica.
examples.translation: 伯德1928年前往南极洲的探险

examples.text: Forty-three members of the expedition were killed.
examples.translation: 探险队中43名成员遇难。

examples.text: Caroline joined them on the shopping expeditions.
examples.translation: 卡罗琳加入了他们的购物之旅。

examples.text: ...a fishing expedition.
examples.translation: 垂钓之旅

examples.text: More than five-thousand secondary school students have been expelled for cheating.
examples.translation: 5,000多名中学生因为作弊被开除。

examples.text: ...a boy expelled from school for making death threats to his teacher.
examples.translation: 因为威胁要杀死老师而被学校开除的男孩

examples.text: An American academic was expelled from the country yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天一位美国学者被逐出该国。

examples.text: They were told at first that they should simply expel the refugees.
examples.translation: 一开始有人告诉他们应该直接将那些难民驱逐出境。

examples.text: Daily brushing of the skin helps the skin expel toxins...
examples.translation: 每天擦洗皮肤有助于皮肤排毒。

examples.text: As the lungs exhale this waste, gas is expelled into the atmosphere.
examples.translation: 肺呼出这些废气被排到空气中。

examples.text: Children expend a lot of energy and may need more high-energy food than adults.
examples.translation: 孩子们消耗很多能量，可能比成年人需要更多高能量的食物。

examples.text: Policies of tax reduction must lead to reduced public expenditure...
examples.translation: 减税政策必然导致公共支出的削减。

examples.text: They should cut their expenditure on defence...
examples.translation: 他们应该缩减国防开支。

examples.text: An expenditure for clothing will qualify as a trade or business expense.
examples.translation: 服装费将可算作贸易或商务开支。

examples.text: The financial rewards justified the expenditure of effort.
examples.translation: 经济上的回报证明付出的努力是值得的。

examples.text: He's bought a specially big TV at vast expense so that everyone can see properly...
examples.translation: 他花大价钱买了一台特别大的电视机，这样每个人都能看清楚。

examples.text: To avoid extra expense and mess later on, try to decide on fittings before the plastering's finished...
examples.translation: 为避免将来出现额外的开支和不必要的麻烦，尽量在抹灰完工之前把固定设施确定下来。

examples.text: It was not a fortune but would help to cover household expenses.
examples.translation: 这笔钱不算多，但是能帮助支付家庭开支。

examples.text: As a member of the International Olympic Committee her fares and hotel expenses were paid by the IOC...
examples.translation: 作为国际奥林匹克委员会的成员，她的交通费用和酒店住宿费用都由国际奥委会支付。

examples.text: Can you claim this back on expenses?
examples.translation: 这个你能报销吗？

examples.text: Should architects continue to be trained for five years at public expense?...
examples.translation: 建筑师是否应该继续接受5年的公费培训呢？

examples.text: Teachers who signed up did so out of personal choice and at their own expense.
examples.translation: 报名的教师完全出于自愿而且费用自理。

examples.text: I think he's having fun at our expense.
examples.translation: 我想他在拿我们寻开心。

examples.text: But skeptics worry that costs may be trimmed at the expense of the patient...
examples.translation: 但是持怀疑态度的人担心费用的削减会以牺牲病人的利益为代价。

examples.text: According to this study, women have made notable gains at the expense of men.
examples.translation: 根据这项研究，女性以牺牲男性的利益为代价而获得了显著的收益。

examples.text: They are worth having but not at the expense of better services...
examples.translation: 它们值得拥有，但是不能因此放弃更好的服务。

examples.text: The orchestra has more discipline now, but at the expense of spirit.
examples.translation: 那个管弦乐团现在更有纪律性了，却丧失了灵魂。

examples.text: Why go to the expense of buying an electric saw when you can hire one?...
examples.translation: 既然可以租电锯，为什么要花大价钱买一个呢？

examples.text: It was said that he went to great expense to install a lift in the building.
examples.translation: 据说他花费巨资在大楼里安装了一台电梯。

examples.text: Wine's so expensive in this country...
examples.translation: 葡萄酒在这个国家非常昂贵。

examples.text: I get very nervous because I'm using a lot of expensive equipment.
examples.translation: 因为正在使用很多昂贵的设备，所以我非常紧张。

examples.text: She was expensively dressed, with fine furs and jewels...
examples.translation: 她穿戴着名贵的毛皮大衣和珠宝，非常奢华。

examples.text: They do a third-rate job very expensively.
examples.translation: 他们收很多钱交出了三流的活儿。

examples.text: He has also had managerial experience on every level...
examples.translation: 他还有各个层级的管理经验。

examples.text: He's counting on his mother to take care of the twins for him; she's had plenty of experience with them.
examples.translation: 他靠母亲帮忙照顾他的双胞胎;她在这方面很有经验。

examples.text: I should not be in any danger here, but experience has taught me caution...
examples.translation: 我在这里应该不会有任何危险，但是经验告诉我要小心。

examples.text: She had learned from experience to take little rests in between her daily routine...
examples.translation: 经验告诉她在日常生活中要不时休息一下。

examples.text: 'If you act afraid, they won't let go,' he says, speaking from experience.
examples.translation: “如果你表现出害怕，他们就会抓住你不放，”这是他的经验之谈。

examples.text: Moving had become a common experience for me...
examples.translation: 搬家对我而言已经成了常事。

examples.text: His only experience of gardening so far proved immensely satisfying...
examples.translation: 到目前为止他唯一的一次园艺经历非常令人满意。

examples.text: Many of his clients are unbelievably nervous, usually because of a bad experience in the past.
examples.translation: 他的很多客户神经异常紧张，通常是因为过去有过糟糕的经历。

examples.text: We had never experienced this kind of holiday before and had no idea what to expect...
examples.translation: 我们以前从未有过这样的假期，不知道会怎么样。

examples.text: British business is now experiencing a severe recession.
examples.translation: 英国商业现在正经历严重的衰退。

examples.text: Widows seem to experience more distress than do widowers.
examples.translation: 寡妇似乎比鳏夫更痛苦。

examples.text: ...the experience of pain.
examples.translation: 痛苦的感受

examples.text: The astronauts are conducting a series of experiments to learn more about how the body adapts to weightlessness...
examples.translation: 那些宇航员正在进行一系列实验，以更多地了解身体如何适应失重状态。

examples.text: ...a proposed new law on animal experiments...
examples.translation: 有关动物实验的最新法规提案

examples.text: This question can be answered only by experiment.
examples.translation: 只有实验才能够解决这个问题。

examples.text: In 1857 Mendel started experimenting with peas in his monastery garden...
examples.translation: 1857年，孟德尔开始在修道院的菜园里用豌豆做实验。

examples.text: The scientists have experimented on the tiny neck arteries of rats...
examples.translation: 科学家们已经在老鼠细小的颈动脉上做了实验。

examples.text: The scientists have already experimented at each other's test sites.
examples.translation: 科学家已经在彼此的实验场所进行了实验。

examples.text: ...the ethical aspects of animal experimentation.
examples.translation: 动物实验涉及的伦理问题

examples.text: When the experimenters repeated the tests on themselves, they observed an exactly opposite effect.
examples.translation: 当实验者在自己身上重复测试时，他们观察到了完全相反的效果。

examples.text: As an experiment, we bought Ted a watch.
examples.translation: 我们试着给特德买了一块手表。

examples.text: ...the country's five year experiment in democracy...
examples.translation: 该国5年来对民主的尝试

examples.text: She needs plenty of room for experiment in her life.
examples.translation: 她一生需要很多尝试的机会。

examples.text: ...if you like cooking and have the time to experiment...
examples.translation: 如果你喜欢烹饪而且有时间尝试的话

examples.text: He believes that students should be encouraged to experiment with bold ideas.
examples.translation: 他认为应该鼓励学生们将大胆的观念付诸试验。

examples.text: Decentralization and experimentation must be encouraged...
examples.translation: 必须鼓励权力下放和大胆尝试。

examples.text: His stories about his sexual experimentation were more bravado than fact.
examples.translation: 他讲述的那些自己进行性尝试的事，更多的是吹嘘而非事实。

meanings.meaning: 实验的；根据实验的；试验性的

examples.text: ...an experimental air conditioning system...
examples.translation: 试验性的空调系统

examples.text: He tends to write bizarre and highly experimental pieces of music...
examples.translation: 他倾向于创作高度试验性而且风格奇异的音乐作品。

examples.text: The technique is experimental, but the list of its practitioners is growing.
examples.translation: 这种技术是试验性的，但是采用它的人正在增加。

examples.text: ...the main techniques of experimental science.
examples.translation: 实验科学的主要技术

examples.text: ...the use of experimental animals...
examples.translation: 实验动物的使用

examples.text: We have experimental and observational evidence concerning things which happened before and after the origin of life.
examples.translation: 有关生命起源前后发生了什么，我们通过实验和观察得出了一些证据。

examples.text: ...an ecology laboratory, where communities of species can be studied experimentally under controlled conditions.
examples.translation: 能够在受控环境中对物种群落进行实验研究的生态实验室

examples.text: The British Sports Minister is reported to be ready to argue for an experimental lifting of the ban.
examples.translation: 据报道，英国体育大臣准备争取试行取消那条禁令。

examples.text: This system is being tried out experimentally at many universities...
examples.translation: 该系统正在很多大学试用。

examples.text: Before opening the front door he lifted the cases experimentally.
examples.translation: 在打开前门之前，他试探性地提起了那些箱子。

examples.text: Our team of experts will be on hand to offer help and advice between 12 noon and 7pm daily.
examples.translation: 每天中午12点到下午7点，我们的专家小组将随时提供帮助和建议。

examples.text: ...a yoga expert.
examples.translation: 瑜伽大师

examples.text: ...an expert on trade in that area.
examples.translation: 那个领域的贸易专家

examples.text: The Japanese are expert at lowering manufacturing costs...
examples.translation: 日本人在降低制造成本方面很在行。

examples.text: There is a great deal to learn from Hal's expert approach.
examples.translation: 从哈尔熟练的方法中可以学到很多。

examples.text: Shopkeepers expertly rolled spices up in bay leaves.
examples.translation: 店主熟练地将调料卷进月桂树叶里。

examples.text: When the horse suffered a back injury Harvey cured it with his own expert hands...
examples.translation: 那匹马背部受伤后，哈维用他内行的双手把它治好了。

examples.text: The symptoms are very mild and it takes an expert eye to see them.
examples.translation: 症状非常轻，要靠专家的眼睛才能看出来。

examples.text: You'll also get expert advice on keeping your hair in good condition...
examples.translation: 你还会获得有关如何保持良好发质的专家建议。

examples.text: We'll need an expert opinion...
examples.translation: 我们需要听听专家的意见。

examples.text: The good news is that expert help is now available.
examples.translation: 好消息是现在可以获得专家的帮助。

meanings.meaning: 专门知识；专门技术；专家的意见

examples.text: The problem is that most local authorities lack the expertise to deal sensibly in this market.
examples.translation: 问题是大多数地方政府都缺乏合理应对这个市场的专门知识。

examples.text: He had lived illegally in the United States for five years after his visitor's visa expired.
examples.translation: 在访问签证到期后，他又在美国非法居住了5年。

examples.text: He endured excruciating agonies before he finally expired.
examples.translation: 在最终离世前他经受了极大的痛苦。

examples.text: Not every judge, however, has the ability to explain the law in simple terms...
examples.translation: 然而，不是每个法官都能用简单的语言来解释法律。

examples.text: Don't sign anything until your solicitor has explained the contract to you...
examples.translation: 在律师向你解释清楚合同之前，不要签署任何东西。

examples.text: Professor Griffiths explained how the drug appears to work...
examples.translation: 格里菲思教授解释了那种药物的工作原理。

examples.text: 'He and Mrs Stein have a plan,' she explained...
examples.translation: “他和斯坦夫人有个计划，”她解释说。

examples.text: I explained that each person has different ideas of what freedom is.
examples.translation: 我解释说，每个人对于自由是什么都有不同的观点。

examples.text: 'Let me explain, sir.' — 'Don't tell me about it. I don't want to know.'...
examples.translation: “您听我解释，先生。”——“别跟我说，我不想知道。”

examples.text: Before she ran away, she left a note explaining her actions...
examples.translation: 逃跑前，她留下一张便条解释原委。

examples.text: Hospital discipline was broken. Amy would have to explain herself...
examples.translation: 破坏了医院的纪律，埃米将不得不为自己辩解。

examples.text: Explain why you didn't telephone...
examples.translation: 说说你为什么没有打电话。

examples.text: The receptionist apologized for the delay, explaining that it had been a hectic day.
examples.translation: 接待员为拖延而道歉，解释说这天太忙了。

examples.text: She told the court she would give a full explanation of the prosecution's decision on Monday...
examples.translation: 她告诉法庭她会在星期一对原告方的决定作出全面解释。

examples.text: There was a hint of schoolboy shyness in his explanation...
examples.translation: 他的解释中带有一丝学生的羞涩。

examples.text: 'It's my ulcer,' he added by way of explanation.
examples.translation: “那是因为我得了溃疡，”他补充解释说。

examples.text: The deputy airport manager said there was no apparent explanation for the crash...
examples.translation: 机场副经理说那次飞机失事没有明显的原因。

examples.text: Digging further into the medical literature, I found out there was a scientific explanation for all this...
examples.translation: 进一步翻阅医学文献后我发现，这些都是有科学解释的。

examples.text: It's the only explanation I can think of.
examples.translation: 这是我能够想到的唯一理由。

examples.text: Haig was immediately impressed by Charteris's expertise and by his lucid explanation of the work.
examples.translation: 查特里斯的专业知识和他对作品浅显易懂的阐释立即给黑格留下了深刻印象。

examples.text: They were clearing up when the second bomb exploded...
examples.translation: 他们正在清理时，第二颗炸弹爆炸了。

examples.text: A school bus was hit by gunfire which exploded the fuel tank.
examples.translation: 校车被炮火击中，引爆了油箱。

examples.text: Do you fear that you'll burst into tears or explode with anger in front of her?...
examples.translation: 你担心会在她面前放声大哭或是勃然大怒吗？

examples.text: 'What happened!' I exploded...
examples.translation: “怎么了！”我发怒了。

examples.text: George caught the look and decided that Bess had better leave before she exploded.
examples.translation: 乔治看到这一表情，认为最好让贝丝在发作之前离开。

examples.text: The population explodes to 40,000 during the tourist season...
examples.translation: 旅游季节，人口激增至4万。

examples.text: Investment by Japanese firms has exploded.
examples.translation: 日本公司的投资已经开始激增。

examples.text: Electricity privatisation has exploded the myth of cheap nuclear power...
examples.translation: 电力私有化打破了关于廉价核能的神话。

examples.text: Such rumours have only recently been exploded.
examples.translation: 这类谣言直到最近才被戳穿。

examples.text: She heard laughter explode, then die.
examples.translation: 她听到有人爆笑了一阵，后来就没声音了。

examples.text: Critics claim he exploited black musicians for personal gain.
examples.translation: 批评家声称他压榨黑人音乐家谋求私利。

examples.text: ...the plight of the exploited sugar cane workers.
examples.translation: 受剥削的甘蔗工人的困境

examples.text: Extra payments should be made to protect the interests of the staff and prevent exploitation.
examples.translation: 为了保护员工的利益，防止剥削，应该要求公司支付额外工资。

examples.text: The government and its opponents compete to exploit the troubles to their advantage.
examples.translation: 政府及其反对派竞相利用这些问题为自己谋利。

examples.text: ...the exploitation of the famine by local politicians.
examples.translation: 地方政客对饥荒的利用

examples.text: You'll need a good aerial to exploit the radio's performance...
examples.translation: 你需要弄个好天线来发挥广播的性能。

examples.text: Cary is hoping to exploit new opportunities in Europe...
examples.translation: 卡里希望好好利用欧洲的新机遇。

examples.text: So you feel that your skills have never been fully appreciated or exploited?
examples.translation: 所以你觉得你的技能从未被完全认可或者充分发挥作用？

examples.text: I think we're being very short sighted in not exploiting our own coal.
examples.translation: 我认为不开采我们自己的煤是非常短视的做法。

examples.text: ...the planned exploitation of its potential oil and natural gas reserves.
examples.translation: 对潜在石油和天然气储备有计划的开采

examples.text: His wartime exploits were later made into a film.
examples.translation: 他在战争中的英勇行为后来被改编成一部电影。

meanings.meaning: 明确的；清楚的；直率的；详述的

examples.text: ...sexually explicit scenes in films and books.
examples.translation: 电影和书籍中露骨的性爱片段

examples.text: ...explicit references to age in recruitment advertising.
examples.translation: 招聘广告中对年龄的明确要求

examples.text: The play was the first commercially successful work dealing explicitly with homosexuality...
examples.translation: 该剧是第一部获得商业成功的公然以同性恋为主题的作品。

examples.text: Their intention is not to become involved in explicitly political activities.
examples.translation: 他们无意参与到明显具有政治性的活动中。

examples.text: When the book was published, the energy and explicitness caught the popular imagination.
examples.translation: 这本书出版后，它的活力和毫不隐讳迎合了公众的喜好。

examples.text: He was explicit about his intention to overhaul the party's internal voting system.
examples.translation: 他直言自己的目的是改革党内的投票制度。

examples.text: She has been talking very explicitly about AIDS to these groups.
examples.translation: 她一直都在非常坦诚地和这些群体谈论艾滋病问题。

examples.text: I just wanted to explore Paris, read Sartre, listen to Sidney Bechet...
examples.translation: 我就想逛逛巴黎，读读萨特的作品，听听悉尼·贝谢的音乐。

examples.text: After exploring the old part of town there is a guided tour of the cathedral...
examples.translation: 游览完老城区之后，会由导游带队参观大教堂。

examples.text: We've come to this country, let's explore!
examples.translation: 我们已经来到这个国家，让我们好好探访一番吧！

examples.text: We devote several days to the exploration of the magnificent Maya sites of Copan...
examples.translation: 我们安排了几天时间考察科潘宏伟的玛雅遗址。

examples.text: We set out on this voyage of exploration with an open mind.
examples.translation: 我们以开放的心态开始了这次探索之旅。

examples.text: The secretary is expected to explore ideas for post-war reconstruction of the area...

examples.translation: 1/18秒f/11光圈的曝光量

examples.translation: 对外界事件的反应

examples.text: Such events occur only when the external conditions are favorable.
examples.translation: 这种事情只有在外部条件有利时才会发生。

examples.text: There must be externally moderated tests.
examples.translation: 一定要有外聘人员负责审核评分的考试。

examples.text: It is 250 years since the wolf became extinct in Britain.
examples.translation: 狼在英国已经灭绝250年了。

examples.text: ...the bones of extinct animals.
examples.translation: 灭绝动物的骨骼

examples.text: If the current trend continues, black farmers in the United States may be extinct by the end of this decade...
examples.translation: 如果当前趋势继续发展下去，美国的黑人农民将在这个十年末不复存在。

examples.text: Herbalism had become an all but extinct skill in the Western world.
examples.translation: 草药医术在西方已经成了一门几乎绝迹的技艺。

examples.text: Its tallest volcano, long extinct, is Olympus Mons.
examples.translation: 它最高的火山是早已熄灭的奥林波斯山。

examples.text: It took about 50 minutes to extinguish the fire...
examples.translation: 大约花了50分钟才把火扑灭。

examples.text: The lights are extinguished as soon as the news conference is over.
examples.translation: 新闻发布会一结束，灯光就熄灭了。

examples.text: The message extinguished her hopes of Richard's return.
examples.translation: 那条消息使她对理查德归来的希望彻底破灭。

meanings.meaning: 临时演员；号外；额外的事物；上等产品
额外的，另外收费的；特大的

examples.text: Police warned motorists to allow extra time to get to work...
examples.translation: 警方告诫驾车者出门上班要留出富余时间。

examples.text: Extra staff have been taken on to cover busy periods...
examples.translation: 额外雇用了一些员工来应付繁忙时期。

examples.text: There's an extra blanket in the bottom drawer of the cupboard.
examples.translation: 壁橱最下面的抽屉里还有一条多余的毯子。

examples.text: For foreign orders postage is extra...
examples.translation: 国外订单邮费另计。

examples.text: The price of your meal is extra.
examples.translation: 你的餐费另计。

examples.text: Many of the additional features now cost extra...
examples.translation: 现在很多加演节目都要另外收费。

examples.text: She won't pay any extra.
examples.translation: 她不会支付任何额外费用。

examples.text: You may be charged 10% extra for this service.
examples.translation: 这项服务可能要你额外支付10％的费用。

examples.text: She is disgusted by big hotels adding so many extras to the bill that it nearly doubles...
examples.translation: 她非常厌恶大酒店额外收取这么多费用，账单金额都快翻倍了。

examples.text: There are no hidden extras.
examples.translation: 没有隐性的额外费用。

examples.text: Optional extras include cooking tuition at a top restaurant...
examples.translation: 可选的额外项目包括在顶级餐厅学习厨艺。

examples.text: They are also spending much less on extras like meals in restaurants.
examples.translation: 他们花在下馆子等额外消费上的钱也少多了。

examples.text: I'd have to be extra careful...
examples.translation: 我不得不格外小心。

examples.text: What makes a magnificent garden extra special?...
examples.translation: 是什么让华丽的花园格外特别？

examples.text: We were all told to try extra hard to be nice to him.
examples.translation: 叫我们都要对他格外好。

examples.text: ...a bag of extra-strong peppermints.
examples.translation: 一袋特浓薄荷糖

examples.text: ...the traditional method of pick and shovel to extract coal...
examples.translation: 用镐和铲挖煤的传统方法

examples.text: Citric acid can be extracted from the juice of oranges, lemons, limes or grapefruit.
examples.translation: 柠檬酸可以从橙汁、柠檬汁、酸橙汁或者柚子汁中提取。

examples.text: ...looking at the differences in the extracted DNA.
examples.translation: 查看提取出来的DNA之间的差别

examples.text: Petroleum engineers plan and manage the extraction of oil.
examples.translation: 石油工程师规划并管理石油的提炼。

examples.text: He extracted a small notebook from his hip pocket...
examples.translation: 他从屁股兜里摸出一个小笔记本。

examples.text: Patterson went straight to the liquor cabinet and extracted a bottle of Scotch...
examples.translation: 帕特森径直走到酒柜前，取出一瓶苏格兰威士忌。

examples.text: She reached into the wardrobe and extracted another tracksuit.
examples.translation: 她伸手又从衣橱里取出一件运动服。

examples.text: A dentist may decide to extract the tooth to prevent recurrent trouble...
examples.translation: 牙医可能会决定拔掉那颗牙，以免反复发作。

examples.text: She is to go and have a tooth extracted at 3 o'clock today.
examples.translation: 她今天3点要去拔颗牙。

examples.text: In those days, dentistry was basic. Extractions were carried out without anaesthetic.
examples.translation: 那时候，牙科学刚起步，拔牙都不打麻药。

examples.text: ...the capitalist system, which extracts huge profits from arms production at the tax-payers' expense...
examples.translation: 牺牲纳税人利益、从武器生产中攫取巨额利润的资本主义制度

examples.text: He sought to extract the maximum political advantage from the cut in interest rates...
examples.translation: 他试图从降息中牟取最大的政治好处。

examples.text: His development policies have extracted cash from the city centre.
examples.translation: 他的发展政策已经从市中心榨取了收益。

examples.text: He made the mistake of trying to extract further information from our director...
examples.translation: 他犯了个错误，不该试图从我们的主管那里打探更多的信息。

examples.text: He used her cash card, and the PIN number he had extracted from her, to take £500 from cashpoints.
examples.translation: 他套出了她的现金卡密码，然后用她的卡从自动提款机中取走了500英镑。

examples.text: I've simply extracted a few figures...
examples.translation: 我只是提取了一些数据。

examples.text: Britain's trade figures can no longer be extracted from export-and-import documentation at ports.
examples.translation: 英国的贸易数据现在不能再从各港口的进出口单证中提取了。

examples.text: ...files of data extracted from the departmental archives.
examples.translation: 从部门档案中提取的数据文件

examples.text: This material has been extracted from 'Collins Good Wood Handbook'.
examples.translation: 这些材料摘自《柯林斯优秀木材手册》。

examples.text: Read this extract from an information booklet about the work of an airline cabin crew.
examples.translation: 看看这段从有关航空公司乘务人员工作的信息手册中摘录的文字。

examples.text: Blend in the lemon extract, lemon peel and walnuts.
examples.translation: 调入柠檬汁、柠檬皮和核桃。

examples.text: ...fragrances taken from plant extracts.
examples.translation: 从植物提取物中获取的香水

meanings.meaning: 非凡的；特别的；离奇的；临时的；特派的

examples.text: We've made extraordinary progress as a society in that regard...
examples.translation: 在那个方面，我们的社会已经取得了巨大的进步。

examples.text: The task requires extraordinary patience and endurance...
examples.translation: 那项任务需要非凡的耐心和毅力。

examples.text: Rozhdestvensky is an extraordinary musician.
examples.translation: 罗日杰斯特文斯基是位出色的音乐家。

examples.text: She's extraordinarily disciplined.
examples.translation: 她非常守纪律。

examples.text: What an extraordinary thing to happen!...
examples.translation: 这事儿真蹊跷！

examples.text: His decision to hold talks is extraordinary because it could mean the real end of the war.
examples.translation: 他作出举行谈判的决定非同寻常，因为这可能意味着战争真的要结束了。

examples.text: Apart from the hair, he looked extraordinarily unchanged...
examples.translation: 令人惊奇的是，除了头发，他看起来一点儿都没变。

examples.text: Extraordinarily, the favourites for the title lie at the bottom of the table.
examples.translation: 令人大跌眼镜的是，夺标热门竟然排名垫底。

examples.text: ...at an extraordinary meeting of the sport's ruling body...
examples.translation: 在体育运动管理机构的特别会议上

examples.text: Representatives of the colonies met in an extraordinary congress.
examples.translation: 各殖民地代表在一次特别大会上会面。

meanings.meaning: 奢侈的；浪费的；过度的；放纵的

examples.text: We are not extravagant; restaurant meals are a luxury and designer clothes are out...
examples.translation: 我们并不铺张浪费：下馆子是一种奢侈，也不会考虑买名牌衣服。

examples.text: I hope you don't think I'm extravagant but I've had the electric fire on for most of the day.
examples.translation: 我几乎一整天都开着电热炉，希望你不会觉得我很浪费。

examples.text: Jeff had shopped extravagantly for presents for the whole family.
examples.translation: 杰夫花了很多钱为全家人买礼物。

examples.text: Her Aunt Sallie gave her an uncharacteristically extravagant gift...
examples.translation: 萨莉姨妈送给她一件贵得离谱的礼物。

examples.text: Baking a whole cheese in pastry may seem extravagant.
examples.translation: 烤点心时加一整块奶酪似乎太奢侈了。

examples.text: ...her extravagant lifestyle.
examples.translation: 她奢侈的生活方式

examples.text: By supercar standards, though, it is not extravagantly priced for a beautifully engineered machine.
examples.translation: 然而以豪华跑车的标准看，设计如此精美的汽车价格并不算太高。

examples.text: He was extravagant in his admiration of Hellas...
examples.translation: 他极度向往希腊。

examples.text: They may make extravagant shows of generosity.
examples.translation: 他们可能会表现得过于慷慨。

examples.text: She had on occasions praised him extravagantly.
examples.translation: 有时候她过分夸赞他。

examples.text: ...extravagantly bizarre clothes.
examples.translation: 过分怪异的衣服

examples.text: They have to compete by adorning their products with ever more extravagant claims...
examples.translation: 他们不得不通过更加离谱地吹捧自己的产品来进行竞争。

examples.text: Don't be afraid to consider apparently extravagant ideas.
examples.translation: 要勇于考虑一些貌似离谱的想法。

examples.text: ...the wildest and most extravagant London parties.
examples.translation: 伦敦最狂野、最美妙的聚会

examples.text: ...painting extravagant and bold designs onto wooden frames.
examples.translation: 在木框架上绘制一些精美而又大胆的图案

examples.text: The day before announcing his farewell to business, Sir James talked to me in his extravagantly elegant Paris home.
examples.translation: 在宣布退出商界的前一天，詹姆斯爵士在他位于巴黎的极为雅致的家中和我谈了话。

meanings.meaning: 为…描眉；用皱眉蹙额迫使

examples.text: An intriguing item on the news pages caused me to raise an eyebrow over my morning coffee...
examples.translation: 早晨喝咖啡时，新闻版面的一则趣闻令我感到惊奇。

examples.text: He raised his eyebrows over some of the suggestions...
examples.translation: 他对其中的一些建议表示反对。

examples.text: He was looking at her with his eyebrows raised questioningly.
examples.translation: 他皱着眉，狐疑地看着她。

examples.text: He suffered from poor eyesight and could no longer read properly.
examples.translation: 他视力不好，再也不能正常阅读了。

meanings.meaning: 极端的；极度的；偏激的；尽头的
极端；末端；最大程度；极端的事物

examples.text: The girls were afraid of snakes and picked their way along with extreme caution.
examples.translation: 女孩子们害怕蛇，走路时格外小心。

examples.text: ...people living in extreme poverty.
examples.translation: 生活极度贫困的人们

examples.text: ...the author's extreme reluctance to generalise.
examples.translation: 作者极不情愿进行归纳

examples.text: The extreme case was Poland, where 29 parties won seats...
examples.translation: 极端的例子是波兰，共有29个政党拥有议席。

examples.text: It is hard to imagine Lineker capable of anything so extreme...
examples.translation: 很难想象莱恩克尔能做出如此极端的事情。

examples.text: The scheme has been condemned as extreme.
examples.translation: 人们指责该计划太过极端。

examples.text: This extreme view hasn't captured popular opinion.
examples.translation: 这种偏激的观点未被大众接受。

examples.text: ...the racist politics of the extreme right.
examples.translation: 极右派的种族主义政治

examples.text: ...a 'middle way' between the extremes of success and failure...
examples.translation: 成功和失败这两个极端之间的“中间地带”

examples.text: They can withstand extremes of temperature and weather without fading or cracking.
examples.translation: 它们能够经受极端的气温和天气状况而不褪色、不破裂。

examples.text: ...the room at the extreme end of the corridor.
examples.translation: 在走廊尽头的那个房间

examples.text: ...winds from the extreme north.
examples.translation: 从极北吹来的风

examples.text: The police went to the extremes of installing the most advanced safety devices in the man's house...
examples.translation: 警方采取极端措施，在那个男子家里安装了最先进的安全装置。

examples.text: The doctor told me not to mention dieting to her in case she took it to the extreme...
examples.translation: 医生告诉我不要跟她提节食的事儿，免得她走极端。

examples.text: There is a sense of shame, sometimes carried to extremes.
examples.translation: 心中有羞愧感，有时候甚至无地自容。

examples.text: It is proving controversial in the extreme...
examples.translation: 事实证明它极具争议。

examples.text: Our rows become unhealthy in the extreme.
examples.translation: 我们的争吵变得极其有害。

examples.text: ...the fable of the tortoise and the hare...
examples.translation: 龟兔赛跑的寓言

examples.text: Each tale has the timeless quality of fable.
examples.translation: 每个故事都有其永恒的寓意。

examples.text: Is reincarnation fact or fable?
examples.translation: 转世轮回是确有其事还是无稽之谈？

examples.text: ...little-known horticultural facts and fables.
examples.translation: 有关园艺的鲜为人知的事实和谬传

meanings.meaning: 眼睛；视力；眼光；见解，观点

examples.text: I opened my eyes and looked...
examples.translation: 我睁开眼睛看了看。

examples.text: Maria's eyes filled with tears.
examples.translation: 玛丽亚的眼中噙满了泪水。

examples.text: ...a tall, thin white-haired lady with piercing dark brown eyes...
examples.translation: 有着一双锐利的深褐色眼睛、头发花白的瘦高个女士

examples.text: He is now blind in one eye.
examples.translation: 他现在一只眼睛瞎了。

examples.text: Sally eyed Claire with interest...
examples.translation: 萨莉饶有兴趣地打量着克莱尔。

examples.text: We eyed each other thoughtfully...
examples.translation: 我们若有所思地打量着对方。

examples.text: Martin eyed the bottle at Marianne's elbow.
examples.translation: 马丁端详着玛丽安娜肘边的瓶子。

examples.text: William was a man of discernment, with an eye for quality...
examples.translation: 威廉是个有鉴赏力的人，对于品质的优劣很有眼光。

examples.text: Their chief negotiator turned his critical eye on the United States...
examples.translation: 他们的首席谈判代表以批判的眼光看美国。

examples.text: It did not take his practised eye long to notice that he was not the only one who was hanging about...
examples.translation: 眼力老道的他很快就注意到他不是唯一在闲逛的人。

examples.text: He first learnt to fish under the watchful eye of his grandmother.
examples.translation: 在祖母的看护下，他第一次学起了钓鱼。

examples.text: An infra-red eye is said to detect the movement of any animal within an angle of 110 degrees at up to 10 metres.
examples.translation: 据说红外眼能够探测到110度角范围内远至10米的任何动物的活动。

examples.text: I was again using the cold, unflinching eye of the camera to probe a sick society.
examples.translation: 我再次通过照相机冷漠、坚定的镜头去探究这个病态的社会。

examples.text: The eye of the hurricane hit Florida just south of Miami.
examples.translation: 飓风的风眼袭击了佛罗里达州迈阿密正南部。

examples.text: A lot of them died in front of our eyes...
examples.translation: 他们中有很多人就死在我们眼前。

examples.text: We are under the eyes of both sides all the time.
examples.translation: 我们一直都在双方的密切监视下。

examples.text: I would be grateful if he could cast an expert eye over it and tell me what he thought of it...
examples.translation: 如果他能够以专家的眼光浏览一下，告诉我他的想法，我将非常感激。

examples.text: If you run your eye up and down these columns you will see that the value of some of them declined.
examples.translation: 你把这几列上下扫视一遍，就会发现其中有些贬值了。

examples.text: As she turned back, a movement across the lawn caught her eye.
examples.translation: 她转过身，瞥见有个东西从草地上穿了过去。

examples.text: I tried to catch Chrissie's eye to find out what she was playing at.
examples.translation: 我努力吸引克丽茜的注意，想知道她在搞什么名堂。

examples.text: That's probably the most bare and bleak island I've ever had the misfortune to clap eyes on...
examples.translation: 那可能是我不幸看到的最光秃、最荒凉的岛屿。

examples.text: What was he doing when you last set eyes on him?
examples.translation: 你上次见到他时他在做什么？

examples.text: She was looking at me across the room, and we made eye contact several times...
examples.translation: 她从房间的另一头看着我，我们有几次目光交汇。

examples.text: I spent a fruitless ten minutes walking up and down the high street, desperately avoiding eye contact with passers-by.
examples.translation: 我在大街上一无所获来回走了10分钟，其间还要拼命地躲避路人的目光。

examples.text: Most governments must simply be shutting their eyes to the problem.
examples.translation: 大多数政府肯定会索性对那个问题视而不见。

examples.text: ...a very simple punishment code based on an-eye-for-an-eye.
examples.translation: 非常简单的以眼还眼的惩罚法则

examples.text: Here, massive dunes stretched in every direction as far as the eye could see...
examples.translation: 在这里，巨大的沙丘向四面八方延绵不绝，一望无垠。

examples.text: There are pine trees as far as the eye can see.
examples.translation: 放眼望去，除了松树还是松树。

examples.text: Susan has a keen eye for detail, so each dress is beautifully finished off.
examples.translation: 苏珊对细节精益求精，所以每件衣裙都做得非常漂亮。

examples.text: The other serious problem in the eyes of the new government is communalism...
examples.translation: 在新政府看来，另一个严重问题是社群主义。

examples.text: Richard Dorrington was, in their eyes, a very sensible and reliable man...
examples.translation: 在他们眼中，理查德·多林顿是个非常可靠的明白人。

examples.text: The practice of religion in America sometimes seems strange to European eyes.
examples.translation: 在欧洲人看来，美国人的宗教习俗有时很奇怪。

examples.text: I ask the mounted patrol to keep their eyes open...
examples.translation: 我让骑警瞪大眼睛。

examples.text: You and your friends keep an eye out—if there's any trouble we'll make a break for it.
examples.translation: 你和你的朋友要留意——一有问题，我们就跑。

examples.text: I'm sure you will appreciate that we must keep a careful eye on all our running costs...
examples.translation: 我们必须密切关注所有的运营成本，这一点我想您肯定会赞同。

examples.text: I went for a run there, keeping an eye on the children the whole time...
examples.translation: 我去那里跑步，期间一直留意着孩子们。

examples.text: They're using villagers to keep an eye on each other, to spy on each other.
examples.translation: 他们利用村民互相监视，互相窥探。

examples.text: This whole business is very puzzling. There is a lot more to it than meets the eye.
examples.translation: 整件事非常令人费解，远比看起来复杂。

examples.text: The first sight that met my eyes on reaching the front door was the church enveloped in flames.
examples.translation: 赶到前门时，我第一眼看到的就是被大火吞没的教堂。

examples.text: All eyes will be on tomorrow's vote...
examples.translation: 所有目光都将聚集在明天的投票上。

examples.text: The eyes of the world were now on the police.
examples.translation: 这时所有的目光都聚焦在警方。

examples.text: As the boat plodded into British waters and up the English Channel, Customs had their eye on her.
examples.translation: 那艘船缓慢驶入英国水域，沿英吉利海峡向北时，海关一直密切关注着它。

examples.text: ...if you're saving up for a new outfit you've had your eye on.
examples.translation: 如果你在攒钱买一套你看中的新衣服

examples.text: We want all our members to undertake this trip responsibly, with their eyes open.
examples.translation: 我们希望所有成员都能够负责地开始这次旅程，做到心中有数。

examples.text: Watching your child explore the world about her can open your eyes to delights long forgotten.
examples.translation: 看着孩子探索她身边的世界能让你体会到早已忘记的快乐。

examples.text: Yuriko saw eye to eye with Yul on almost every aspect of the production...
examples.translation: 百合子和尤尔几乎在生产的每个方面都看法一致。

examples.text: We've never seen eye to eye.
examples.translation: 我们的看法从来就没有一致过。

examples.text: The bowlers at the eye of the storm were nowhere in evidence.
examples.translation: 处于风口浪尖的那些投手不见了踪影。

examples.text: ...the minister in the eye of the storm.
examples.translation: 备受指责的那位部长

examples.text: She took her eyes off the road to glance at me...
examples.translation: 她把视线从公路上移开，扫了我一眼。

examples.text: Nina couldn't take her eyes off Philip.
examples.translation: 尼娜无法将她的视线从菲利普身上移开。

examples.text: She tried to see things through his eyes...
examples.translation: 她尽力从他的视角看问题。

examples.text: The story is told through the eyes of Inspector Simon Potter.
examples.translation: 这个故事是从西蒙·波特巡官的视角讲述的。

examples.text: I am up to my eyes in work...
examples.translation: 我工作忙得不可开交。

examples.text: The women are just up to their eyes in debt.
examples.translation: 那些女人债台高筑。

meanings.meaning: 织物；布；组织；构造；建筑物

examples.text: ...small squares of red cotton fabric...
examples.translation: 小块方形红棉布

examples.text: Whatever your colour scheme, there's a fabric to match.
examples.translation: 无论什么样的色彩图案，都有与之相配的织物。

examples.text: The fabric of society has been deeply damaged by the previous regime...
examples.translation: 社会结构已遭到上届政府极大的破坏。

examples.text: Years of civil war have wrecked the country's infrastructure and destroyed its social fabric.
examples.translation: 经年内战已破坏了国家的基础设施，摧毁了其社会结构。

examples.text: Condensation will eventually cause the fabric of the building to rot away.
examples.translation: 冷凝作用将最终使建筑结构腐朽掉。

examples.text: All four claim that officers fabricated evidence against them...
examples.translation: 4 人全都声称警察捏造证据陷害他们。

examples.text: Eleven key officials were hanged on fabricated charges.
examples.translation: 11位高官因莫须有的罪名被处以绞刑。

examples.text: She described the interview with her in an Italian magazine as a 'complete fabrication'...
examples.translation: 她将意大利一家杂志对她的采访报道称为“子虚乌有”。

examples.text: This story is total fabrication.
examples.translation: 这种说法纯属捏造。

examples.text: All the tools are fabricated from high quality steel.
examples.translation: 所有工具均由精钢制成。

examples.text: ...a plant which fabricates airplane components.
examples.translation: 一家制造飞机配件的工厂

examples.text: More than 200 improvements, many of them major, were made in the design and fabrication of the shuttle.
examples.translation: 在航天飞机的设计及制造过程中，作了两百多项改进，其中很多是大的改动。

meanings.meaning: 难以置信的；传说的，寓言中的；极好的

examples.text: This is a fabulous album. It's fresh, varied, fun...
examples.translation: 这张专辑真棒，新颖、有趣且富于变化。

examples.text: The scenery and weather were fabulous.
examples.translation: 景色和天气都好极了。

examples.text: Despite his fabulous wealth, he is very much a man of the people.
examples.translation: 他虽然腰缠万贯，却非常亲民。

examples.text: ...their fabulously rich parents.
examples.translation: 他们极其富有的父母

examples.text: The new airport will facilitate the development of tourism...
examples.translation: 新机场将促进旅游业的发展。

examples.text: He argued that the economic recovery had been facilitated by his tough stance.
examples.translation: 他认为他的强硬立场推动了经济的复苏。

meanings.meaning: 脸；表面；面子；面容；外观；威信

examples.text: He rolled down his window and stuck his face out...
examples.translation: 他摇下车窗，把头探了出去。

examples.text: A strong wind was blowing right in my face...
examples.translation: 一阵劲风迎面吹来。

examples.text: He was going red in the face and breathing with difficulty...
examples.translation: 他涨红了脸，费力地喘着气。

examples.text: She had a beautiful face.
examples.translation: 她容貌秀丽。

examples.text: He was walking around with a sad face...
examples.translation: 他四处走着，神色哀伤。

examples.text: The priest frowned into the light, his face puzzled.
examples.translation: 神父在亮光下皱起了眉头，一脸疑惑。

examples.text: ...the north face of the Eiger...
examples.translation: 艾格尔山北坡

examples.text: He scrambled 200 feet up the cliff face.
examples.translation: 他沿着崖面向上攀登了200英尺。

examples.text: ...the changing face of the British countryside...
examples.translation: 英国乡村的日新月异

examples.text: This would change the face of Malaysian politics.
examples.translation: 这将改变马来西亚的政治面貌。

examples.text: Brothels, she insists, are the acceptable face of prostitution...
examples.translation: 她坚持认为，妓院是卖淫可为人接受的一种形式。

examples.text: Who ever thought people would see Arsenal as the acceptable face of football?
examples.translation: 谁会想到人们会认为足球之道可如阿森纳队呢？

examples.text: England doesn't want a war but it doesn't want to lose face...
examples.translation: 英格兰不想打仗，但也不想丢面子。

examples.text: To cancel the airport would mean a loss of face for the present governor...
examples.translation: 撤销机场对现任州长来说将是件丢脸的事情。

examples.text: She claimed they'd been in love, but I sensed she was only saying this to save face.
examples.translation: 她宣称他们相恋了，但我感到她这么说只是想挽回面子。

examples.text: Can't you see this could blow up in your face?
examples.translation: 你难道看不出这事会砸锅？

examples.text: You can criticise him until you're blue in the face, but you'll never change his personality.
examples.translation: 即使你苦口婆心地批评他，也改变不了他的个性。

examples.text: All the time Stephen was lying face down and unconscious in the bath tub...
examples.translation: 斯蒂芬一直脸朝下趴在浴缸里，不省人事。

examples.text: Charles laid down his cards face up.
examples.translation: 查尔斯将手中的牌摊了出来。

examples.text: No human being on the face of the earth could do anything worse than what he did.
examples.translation: 世界上再没有人能做出比他更坏的事情来。

examples.text: If a nuclear war breaks out, every living thing will be wiped off the face of the Earth.
examples.translation: 如果爆发核战争，地球上的所有生物都将灭绝。

examples.text: We were strolling into the town when we came face to face with Jacques DuBois...
examples.translation: 我们信步向镇子走去，迎面碰上雅克·杜波依斯。

examples.text: It was the first face-to-face meeting between the two men.
examples.translation: 这是两人首次当面会晤。

examples.text: Eventually, he came face to face with discrimination again...
examples.translation: 最终，他又一次遭遇歧视。

examples.text: I was gradually being brought face to face with the fact that I had very little success.
examples.translation: 我渐渐开始面对这个事实，那就是我几乎一事无成。

examples.text: ...scientific principles that seem to fly in the face of common sense...
examples.translation: 似乎有悖常识的科学原理

examples.text: He said that the decision flew in the face of natural justice.
examples.translation: 他说这个决定有悖天理。

examples.text: The Prime Minister has called for national unity in the face of the violent anti-government protests...
examples.translation: 面对强烈的反政府抗议，首相呼吁全国团结一致。

examples.text: Roosevelt was defiant in the face of the bad news.
examples.translation: 对这个坏消息，罗斯福毫不理会。

examples.text: With juveniles under eighteen, there's little we can do. We can't keep them in custody. They just laugh in your face.
examples.translation: 对18岁以下的青少年，我们几乎无计可施。我们不能拘留他们。他们只会公然嘲笑你。

examples.text: He came to me with a very long face.
examples.translation: 他拉长了脸来找我。

examples.text: Opening the door, she made a face at the musty smell...
examples.translation: 她打开门后闻到一股难闻的霉味，不禁做了个鬼脸。

examples.text: Kathryn pulled a face at Thomas behind his back.
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳在托马斯身后冲他做了个鬼脸。

examples.text: On the face of it that seems to make sense. But the figures don't add up...
examples.translation: 乍一看,似乎讲得通，但这些数字对不起来。

examples.text: It is, on the face of it, difficult to see how the West could radically change its position.
examples.translation: 初看起来，很难理解西方为何会立场突变。

examples.text: Friends will see you are putting on a brave face and might assume you've got over your grief...
examples.translation: 朋友们看到你一脸轻松，也许会以为你已经走出悲伤。

examples.text: Scientists are putting a good face on the troubles.
examples.translation: 科学家们对这些困难似乎不以为意。

examples.text: This Government has set its face against putting up income tax.
examples.translation: 这届政府执意反对提高所得税。

examples.text: If she shows her face again back in Massachusetts she'll find a warrant for her arrest waiting...
examples.translation: 如果她重又在马萨诸塞州露面，等待她的将是一纸拘捕令。

examples.text: I felt I ought to show my face at her father's funeral.
examples.translation: 我觉得我应该去参加她父亲的葬礼。

examples.text: What went through Tom's mind I can't imagine, but he did manage to keep a straight face...
examples.translation: 不知道汤姆想到了啥，但他确实忍住没笑。

examples.text: You have to wonder how anyone could say that seriously and with a straight face.
examples.translation: 你一定会惊奇怎么会有人能绷着脸、一本正经地说出那些话。

examples.text: Her opponent called her a liar to her face.
examples.translation: 她的对手当着她面说她是撒谎精。

examples.text: Relief and gratitude were written all over his face...
examples.translation: 他一脸释然与感激。

examples.text: I could just see the pain written across her face.
examples.translation: 我都可以看出他脸上写满了痛苦。

examples.text: They stood facing each other...
examples.translation: 他们面对面站着。

examples.text: The garden faces south.
examples.translation: 花园朝南。

examples.text: She stood up from the table and faced him...
examples.translation: 她从桌前站起来，面对着他。

examples.text: Stand up. Face the wall.
examples.translation: 起立，面向墙壁。

examples.text: Christie looked relaxed and calm as he faced the press...
examples.translation: 克里斯蒂面对记者，显得镇定自若。

examples.text: He was hauled in to face the judge.
examples.translation: 他被带了进来，面对法官。

examples.text: Williams faces life in prison if convicted of attempted murder...
examples.translation: 如被判谋杀未遂，威廉斯将面临终身监禁。

examples.text: The immense difficulties facing European businessmen in Russia were only too evident...
examples.translation: 在俄罗斯的欧洲商人所面临的巨大困难是显而易见的。

examples.text: We are faced with a serious problem.
examples.translation: 我们面临着一个严重问题。

examples.text: Although your heart is breaking, you must face the truth that a relationship has ended...
examples.translation: 虽然你伤透了心，但也必须面对现实，一段感情已结束了。

examples.text: He accused the Government of refusing to face facts about the economy...
examples.translation: 他指责政府不能在经济问题上面对现实。

examples.text: He called a family conference and faced them with the problems.
examples.translation: 他开了一个家庭会议，让他们正视这些问题。

examples.text: I have grown up now and I have to face up to my responsibilities...
examples.translation: 我已长大成人，必须担负起自己的责任。

examples.text: They were having to face up to the fact that they had lost everything.
examples.translation: 他们必须正视他们已经一无所有这个事实。

examples.text: I couldn't face the prospect of spending a Saturday night there, so I decided to press on...
examples.translation: 想到周六晚上要在那儿度过我就受不了，于是我决定要抓紧。

examples.text: My children want me with them for Christmas Day, but I can't face it...
examples.translation: 我的孩子们想要我跟他们一起过圣诞节，但我办不到。

examples.text: I couldn't face seeing anyone.
examples.translation: 我无法见任何人。

examples.text: She was always attracted to younger men. But, let's face it, who is not?
examples.translation: 她总是会被较年轻的男人吸引。不过，说实话，谁又不是呢？

examples.text: What recreational facilities are now available?...
examples.translation: 现在有些什么娱乐设施？

examples.text: The problem lies in getting patients to a medical facility as soon as possible.
examples.translation: 问题在于要把病人尽快送至医院。

examples.text: It is very useful to have an overdraft facility...
examples.translation: 有透支功能用处很大。

examples.text: One of the new models has the facility to reproduce speech as well as text.
examples.translation: 新型号中有一款具备复读和文本复制的功能。

examples.text: He and Marcia shared a facility for languages...
examples.translation: 他和马西娅都有语言天赋。

examples.text: Smell is a very basic sense but humans have lost much of the facility to use it properly.
examples.translation: 嗅觉是一种非常基本的官能，但人类已经丧失了恰当使用这种官能的大部分能力。

examples.text: His chances do not seem good in view of the fact that the Chief Prosecutor has already voiced his public disapproval...
examples.translation: 鉴于检察长已公开表示反对，他的机会看来不大了。

examples.text: Despite the fact that the disease is so prevalent, treatment is still far from satisfactory...
examples.translation: 尽管疾病肆虐，治疗却远不尽如人意。

examples.text: We have to lie and hide the fact that I have an illness...
examples.translation: 我们不得不撒谎来隐瞒我有病这个事实。

examples.text: In Rome, meeting him every morning, he soon became aware of the fact that Erter was ill.
examples.translation: 在罗马，他每天早晨都会见到厄特，因此他很快就发觉厄特病了。

examples.text: My family now accepts the fact that I don't eat sugar or bread...
examples.translation: 我的家人现在都接受了我不吃糖和面包这件事。

examples.text: The fact that he had left her of his own accord proved to me that everything he'd said was true.
examples.translation: 他主动离开她这件事向我证明了他所言句句属实。

examples.text: We've had a pretty bad time while you were away. In fact, we very nearly split up this time...
examples.translation: 你不在的时候我们相处得很不愉快，确切地说这次我们差点就分手了。

examples.text: He apologised as soon as he realised what he had done. In actual fact he wrote a nice little note to me...
examples.translation: 意识到自己的所作所为后他马上就道歉了，而且还给我写了一张温馨的小条儿。

examples.text: John Major didn't go to university. In fact he left school at 16.
examples.translation: 约翰·梅杰没有上过大学，说白了，他 16 岁便辍学了。

examples.text: That sounds rather simple, but in fact it's very difficult...
examples.translation: 那听来简单，但实际上很难。

examples.text: They complained that they had been trapped inside the police station, but in fact most were seen escaping over the adjacent roofs to safety in nearby buildings...
examples.translation: 他们抱怨说被困在了警察局里，但实际上，有人看见他们大多数人通过毗邻的屋顶，安全地逃到了附近的建筑物内。

examples.text: Why had she ever trusted her? In point of fact she never had, she reminded herself.
examples.translation: 她为什么要相信她呢？实际上，她从未信任过，她提醒着自己。

examples.text: ...a statement of verifiable historical fact...
examples.translation: 对有据可查的史实的讲述

examples.text: How much was fact and how much fancy no one knew.
examples.translation: 几多虚实，无人知晓。

examples.text: There is so much information you can almost effortlessly find the facts for yourself...
examples.translation: 资料这么多，你几乎可以毫不费力地找到事实真相。

examples.text: His opponent swamped him with facts and figures...
examples.translation: 他的对手抛出精确的资料和数据，使他难以招架。

examples.text: The lorries always left in the dead of night when there were few witnesses around to record the fact.
examples.translation: 这些卡车一般都在夜深人静的时候开走，那时候周围没什么人，不会被看到。

examples.text: It's not that difficult. As a matter of fact, it's quite easy...
examples.translation: 这并不那么困难，实际上，容易得很。

examples.text: 'I guess you haven't eaten yet.' — 'As a matter of fact, I have,' said Hunter.
examples.translation: “我想你还没吃吧？”“正好相反，我已经吃了。”亨特说道。

examples.text: I know for a fact that baby corn is very expensive in Europe...
examples.translation: 我知道玉米笋在欧洲的确价格不菲。

examples.text: I know for a fact that Graham has kept in close touch with Alan.
examples.translation: 我知道格雷厄姆确实与艾伦保持着密切的联系。

examples.text: The fact is blindness hadn't stopped the children doing many of the things that sighted children enjoy...
examples.translation: 实际上，失明并没有妨碍这些孩子去做健全孩子喜欢做的事情。

examples.text: The fact of the matter is that student finances are stretched.
examples.translation: 关键是奖学金有限。

examples.text: The fact remains that inflation, however you measure it, is unacceptably high...
examples.translation: 必须承认，无论怎么衡量，通货膨胀率都高得难以接受。

examples.text: His admirers claim that he came to power perfectly legally, but the fact remains that he did so by exploiting an illegal situation.
examples.translation: 他的崇拜者称他的上台是完全合法的，但必须承认，他是利用了一次非法事件上台的。

examples.text: We aren't playing well as a team, and that's a fact...
examples.translation: 我们作为一个球队打得并不好，事实就是如此。

examples.text: He is a dull writer and that's a fact.
examples.translation: 他写的东西很没意思，真的。

examples.text: 'I'm still staff colonel.' — 'Is that a fact?'
examples.translation: “我还是参谋上校。”——“不会吧？”

meanings.meaning: 因素；要素；[物] 因数；代理人
把…作为因素计入；代理经营；把…分解成

examples.text: Physical activity is an important factor in maintaining fitness.
examples.translation: 进行体育活动是保持身体健康的一个重要因素。

examples.text: The cost of butter quadrupled and bread prices increased by a factor of five.
examples.translation: 黄油价格涨了 4 倍，面包价格涨了 5 倍。

examples.text: ...suncream with a protection factor of 8.
examples.translation: 防晒系数为 8 的防晒霜

examples.text: He owned furniture factories in New York State.
examples.translation: 他在纽约州有几家家具厂。

examples.text: He was drunk and not in control of his faculties...
examples.translation: 他喝醉了，浑身都不听使唤了。

examples.text: It is also a myth that the faculty of hearing is greatly increased in blind people.
examples.translation: 盲人的听力会大幅增强也是一种谬谈。

examples.text: ...the Faculty of Social and Political Sciences.
examples.translation: 社会政治系

examples.text: The faculty agreed on a change in the requirements...
examples.translation: 全体教师一致同意修改规定。

examples.text: How can faculty improve their teaching so as to encourage creativity?
examples.translation: 教师们如何才能改进教学以激发创造性呢？

examples.text: ...eminent Stanford faculty members.
examples.translation: 声名显赫的斯坦福大学的教师们

meanings.meaning: [电影][电视] 淡出；[电影][电视] 淡入

examples.text: All colour fades — especially under the impact of direct sunlight...
examples.translation: 所有颜色都会褪色——尤其是在阳光直射下。

examples.text: No matter how soft the light is, it still plays havoc, fading carpets and curtains in every room.
examples.translation: 无论多么柔和的光线，也仍然会造成损害，会让所有房间的地毯和窗帘褪色。

examples.text: ...fading portraits of the Queen and Prince Philip.
examples.translation: 女王和菲利普亲王的褪色的画像

examples.text: ...a girl in a faded dress.
examples.translation: 穿着褪色衣服的姑娘

examples.text: ...faded painted signs on the sides of some of the buildings.
examples.translation: 一些建筑物侧面褪了色的油漆标记

examples.text: Seaton lay on his bed and gazed at the ceiling as the light faded...
examples.translation: 光线渐渐暗了下去，西顿躺在床上，凝视着天花板。

examples.text: The sound of the last bomber's engines faded into the distance.
examples.translation: 最后一架轰炸机的引擎声渐渐消失在远方。

examples.text: They observed the comet for 70 days before it faded from sight...
examples.translation: 他们观察了这颗彗星 70 天，直至其慢慢从视线中消失。

examples.text: They watched the familiar mountains fade into the darkness.
examples.translation: 他们看着熟悉的群山渐渐隐没到黑夜当中。

examples.text: We watched the harbour and then the coastline fade away into the morning mist.
examples.translation: 我们凝望着港口，只见海岸线渐渐隐于晨雾之中。

examples.text: She had a way of fading into the background when things got rough...
examples.translation: 情况一有不妙，她总能退到幕后。

examples.text: The most prominent poets of the Victorian period had all but faded from the scene.
examples.translation: 维多利亚时期最显赫的诗人差不多已全部湮没无声了。

examples.text: The sound comes up and slowly fades away into the distance.
examples.translation: 声音响起来，又慢慢消失在远处。

examples.text: Sympathy for the rebels, the government claims, is beginning to fade...
examples.translation: 政府宣称，对叛乱分子的同情开始消退。

examples.text: Prospects for peace had already started to fade.
examples.translation: 和平的前景已经开始日渐暗淡。

examples.text: ...fading memories of better days.
examples.translation: 对美好时光的日渐模糊的记忆

examples.text: Jay nodded, his smile fading.
examples.translation: 杰伊点点头，笑容慢慢隐去了。

examples.text: He thought her campaign would probably fade out soon in any case.
examples.translation: 他认为不管怎样，她的竞选活动都可能会很快归于沉寂。

examples.text: You'll need to be able to project two images onto the screen as the new one fades in and the old image fades out.
examples.translation: 你得能将两个图像投射到屏幕上，让新的渐渐淡入，旧的渐渐淡出。

meanings.meaning: 失败，不及格；破产；缺乏；衰退
不及格；使失望；忘记；舍弃

examples.text: The Workers' Party failed to win a single governorship...
examples.translation: 劳工党连一个州长职位也未能赢得。

examples.text: He failed in his attempt to take control of the company...
examples.translation: 他试图掌控公司，但以失败告终。

examples.text: Many of us have tried to lose weight and failed miserably...
examples.translation: 我们中很多人都努力要减肥，无奈均以惨败告终。

examples.text: The truth is, I'm a failed comedy writer really.
examples.translation: 事实上，我真的是个很失败的喜剧作家。

examples.text: We tried to develop plans for them to get along, which all failed miserably...
examples.translation: 我们试图计划让他们好好相处，但均以惨败告终。

examples.text: He was afraid the revolution they had started would fail...
examples.translation: 他担心他们发起的大变革会遭遇失败。

examples.text: After a failed military offensive, all government troops and police were withdrawn from the island.
examples.translation: 在一次军事进攻失败之后，所有政府军和警察均从岛上撤离了。

examples.text: Some schools fail to set any homework...
examples.translation: 有些学校没有布置任何作业。

examples.text: He failed to file tax returns for 1982...
examples.translation: 他没有呈报 1982 年的纳税申报单。

examples.text: The bomb failed to explode.
examples.translation: 炸弹没有爆炸。

examples.text: The lights mysteriously failed, and we stumbled around in complete darkness...
examples.translation: 灯不知怎么地不亮了，我们在一片黑暗中跌跌撞撞地走着。

examples.text: In fact many food crops failed because of the drought.
examples.translation: 实际上，因为干旱，很多粮食作物歉收。

examples.text: So far this year, 104 banks have failed.
examples.translation: 今年到目前为止，已有 104 家银行倒闭。

examples.text: ...a failed hotel business...
examples.translation: 破产的酒店

examples.text: Who wants to buy a computer from a failing company?
examples.translation: 谁愿意从一家要倒闭的公司买计算机呢？

examples.text: He was 58, and his health was failing rapidly...
examples.translation: 他 58 岁，身体正在迅速衰老。

examples.text: Here in the hills, the light failed more quickly...
examples.translation: 在山区这儿，天黑得更快。

examples.text: An apparently failing memory is damaging for a national leader.
examples.translation: 明显的记忆力衰退对一个国家领导人来说极为不利。

examples.text: We waited twenty-one years, don't fail us now.
examples.translation: 我们等了 21 年了，如今不要让我们失望。

examples.text: ...communities who feel that the political system has failed them.
examples.translation: 对此套政治体制感到失望的群体

examples.text: Lawyers are accused of failing in their duties to advise clients of their rights...
examples.translation: 律师们被控未尽到告知当事人其正当权利的职责。

examples.text: If we did not report what was happening in the country, we would be failing in our duty.
examples.translation: 如果我们没有报道这个国家正在发生的事情，我们就没有尽到自己的责任。

examples.text: For once, the artist's fertile imagination failed him...
examples.translation: 这位画家丰富的想象力曾一度枯竭。

examples.text: Their courage failed a few steps short and they came running back.
examples.translation: 还差几步他们却胆怯了，又跑回来了。

examples.text: I lived in fear of failing my end-of-term exams.
examples.translation: 我总是担心期末考试不及格。

examples.text: It's the difference between a pass and a fail.
examples.translation: 这是及格和不及格的差别。

examples.text: ...the two men who had failed him during his first year of law school.
examples.translation: 在法学院一年级时让他不及格的两个人

examples.text: If all else fails, I could always drive a truck.
examples.translation: 如果其他都不行，我总还可以开卡车。

examples.text: That's how it was in my day and I fail to see why it should be different now.
examples.translation: 我那时候就是这样的，我搞不懂为什么现在非要弄得不一样。

examples.text: He attended every meeting without fail.
examples.translation: 他逢会必到。

examples.text: On the 30th you must without fail hand in some money for Alex...
examples.translation: 30 日那天你必须替亚历克斯交一些钱。

examples.text: Tomorrow without fail he would be at the old riverside warehouse.
examples.translation: 明天他一定会在河边的旧仓库里。

examples.text: This policy is doomed to failure...
examples.translation: 这项政策注定会失败。

examples.text: Three attempts on the British 200-metre record also ended in failure.
examples.translation: 对英国 200 米纪录发起的3 次冲击也均以失败而告终。

examples.text: ...feelings of failure.
examples.translation: 挫败感

examples.text: The marriage was a failure and they both wanted to be free of it...
examples.translation: 他们的婚姻很失败，两人都想摆脱它。

examples.text: His six-year transition programme has by no means been a complete failure.
examples.translation: 他的六年转型计划绝没有彻底失败。

examples.text: Elgar received many honors and much acclaim and yet he often considered himself a failure...
examples.translation: 人们对埃尔加赞誉有加，但他却常觉得自己是个失败者。

examples.text: I just felt I had been a failure in my personal life.
examples.translation: 我就是觉得我的个人生活很失败。

examples.text: She accused the Foreign Office of disgraceful failure to support British citizens arrested overseas.
examples.translation: 她指责说，外交部未能给在海外被捕的英国公民提供支持是可耻的。

examples.text: ...their failure to get the product mix right.
examples.translation: 他们没有把产品组合弄对

examples.text: There were also several accidents mainly caused by engine failures on take-off...
examples.translation: 还有几次事故主要是起飞时引擎出现故障造成的。

examples.text: He was being treated for kidney failure...
examples.translation: 他因肾衰竭正在接受治疗。

examples.text: Researchers found an almost total crop failure and a severe shortage of drinking water.
examples.translation: 研究者们发现作物几乎颗粒无收，并且饮用水严重短缺。

examples.text: Business failures rose 16% last month.
examples.translation: 上个月倒闭公司的数量上升了 16％。

examples.text: There is, too, a simple failure of imagination...
examples.translation: 还有，就是纯粹缺乏想象力。

examples.text: He remained on his knees for a long time afterwards, ashamed by his failure of nerve.
examples.translation: 他后来在地上跪了很久，为自己缺乏胆量而感到羞耻。

meanings.meaning: 模糊的；头晕的；虚弱的；[医] 衰弱的
昏倒；变得微弱；变得没气力

examples.text: He became aware of the soft, faint sounds of water dripping...
examples.translation: 他开始注意到轻微的水滴声。

examples.text: The room held the faint, sweet odour of pipe tobacco...
examples.translation: 房间内有烟斗烟丝的淡淡馨香。

examples.text: He could see faint lines in her face...
examples.translation: 他可以看见她脸上的细纹。

examples.text: There was still the faint hope deep within him that she might never need to know.
examples.translation: 他内心深处仍怀有一丝隐约的希望：她也许永远不必知晓。

examples.text: He was already asleep in the bed, which smelled faintly of mildew...
examples.translation: 他已经在略带霉味的床上睡着了。

examples.text: She felt faintly ridiculous.
examples.translation: 她隐隐觉得有些荒唐。

examples.text: Caroline made a faint attempt at a laugh...
examples.translation: 卡罗琳敷衍地笑了一下。

examples.text: A faint smile crossed the Monsignor's face and faded quickly...
examples.translation: 一丝敷衍的微笑从那位大人脸上掠过，很快就消失了。

examples.text: Ten years ago today the US Center for Disease Control published the first faint warnings of a worldwide epidemic.
examples.translation: 10年前的今天，美国疾病控制中心敷衍其事地发出了第一份警告：一场世界范围的流行病可能会出现。

examples.text: John smiled faintly and shook his head.
examples.translation: 约翰微微笑了笑，摇了摇头。

examples.text: She suddenly fell forward on to the table and fainted...
examples.translation: 她突然向前栽倒在桌上，晕了过去。

examples.text: I thought he'd faint when I kissed him.
examples.translation: 我以为吻他的时候他会晕倒呢。

examples.text: She slumped to the ground in a faint.
examples.translation: 她一阵晕眩，跌倒在地。

examples.text: Other signs of angina are nausea, sweating, feeling faint and shortness of breath.
examples.translation: 心绞痛的其他征兆有恶心、出汗、头昏和气短。

examples.text: One patient suffered headaches, nausea, and faintness.
examples.translation: 一位病人感觉头疼、恶心、晕眩。

meanings.meaning: 公平的；美丽的，白皙的；[气象] 晴朗的

examples.text: It didn't seem fair to leave out her father...
examples.translation: 将她父亲排除在外似乎不公平。

examples.text: Do you feel they're paying their fair share?...
examples.translation: 你觉得他们付了该付的那份钱吗？

examples.text: Independent observers say the campaign's been very much fairer than expected...
examples.translation: 独立观察员说竞选比预期要公平得多。

examples.text: I wanted them to get a fair deal...
examples.translation: 我希望他们得到公平的待遇。

examples.text: An appeals court had ruled that they could not get a fair trial in Los Angeles.
examples.translation: 上诉法庭已经裁定他们在洛杉矶无法得到公正的审判。

examples.text: ...demonstrating concern for employees and solving their problems quickly and fairly...
examples.translation: 显示出对员工的关心，并迅速而公平地解决他们的问题

examples.text: In a society where water was precious, it had to be shared fairly between individuals.
examples.translation: 在一个水资源宝贵的社会，用水必须在个人间公平分配。

examples.text: My neighbours across the street travel a fair amount...
examples.translation: 我街对面的邻居游历甚广。

examples.text: My mother's brother lives a fair distance away so we don't see him and his family very often.
examples.translation: 我舅舅住在相当远的地方，所以我们很少见到他和他的家人。

examples.text: It's a fair guess to say that the damage will be extensive...
examples.translation: 说损失会很严重想必猜得不错。

examples.text: I have a fair idea of how difficult things can be.
examples.translation: 我大致了解情况会有多困难。

examples.text: Reimar had a fair command of English.
examples.translation: 赖马尔的英语说得还不错。

examples.text: Both children were very like Robina, but were much fairer than she was.
examples.translation: 两个孩子都很像罗比娜，但头发颜色比她浅得多。

examples.text: ...a tall, fair-haired Englishman.
examples.translation: 一个高个子、金色头发的英国人

examples.text: It's important to protect my fair skin from the sun.
examples.translation: 保护我白皙的皮肤不受日晒是很紧要的。

examples.text: Fair-skinned people who spend a great deal of time in the sun have the greatest risk of skin cancer.
examples.translation: 皮肤白皙的人如果长期暴露在太阳下，患皮肤癌的可能性最大。

examples.text: Weather conditions were fair.
examples.translation: 天气晴好。

examples.text: ...an antiques fair.
examples.translation: 古玩交易会

examples.text: To be fair, the team is young and not yet settled...
examples.translation: 说句公道话，这个队还年轻，还没有成型。

examples.text: And, let us be fair, some MPs do work hard.
examples.translation: 而且，说句公道话，有些下院议员工作还是很卖力的。

examples.text: If you don't like it, fair enough, but that's hardly a justification to attack the whole thing...
examples.translation: 如果你不喜欢，这说得过去，但把它批得一无是处就没什么道理了。

examples.text: Fair enough, you didn't have a perfectly happy childhood: but your childhood is over now.
examples.translation: 没错，你的童年生活不那么幸福：但它已经过去了。

examples.text: 'I'm taking it to our local police station.' — 'Oh right, fair enough.'...
examples.translation: “我要告到本地警察局。”——“呵，对，干得有理。”

examples.text: 'The message was addressed to me and I don't see why I should show it to you.' — 'Fair enough.'
examples.translation: “这条信息是写给我的，我不明白为什么要给你看。”——“说得在理。”

examples.text: The government is not playing fair, one union official told me.
examples.translation: 政府在搞鬼，一位工会官员告诉我。

examples.text: It would be fair to say he had one or two unhappy moments out there...
examples.translation: 可以这么说，他在那里有过一两次不愉快。

examples.text: I think it's fair to say that it didn't sound quite right.
examples.translation: 我想应该说那听起来可不太对。

examples.text: There are no excuses. We were beaten fair and square.
examples.translation: 没话说，我们是给正大光明地打败的。

examples.text: Both ships are fairly new...
examples.translation: 两艘船都还比较新。

examples.text: We did fairly well but only fairly well.
examples.translation: 我们做得还过得去，但也仅仅是过得去而已。

examples.text: Were you always fairly bright at school?...
examples.translation: 你在学校一直还算聪明吧？

examples.text: You've got to be fairly single-minded about it...
examples.translation: 对这事你还得专心一点。

examples.text: I'll have no income and no home and will need a job fairly badly.
examples.translation: 我快没收入也没地方住了，急需找一份工作。

examples.text: He fairly flew across the room...
examples.translation: 他简直是飞过了房间。

examples.text: For him, the place is fairly boiling with humanity...
examples.translation: 对他来说，这个地方充满了人情味。

examples.text: It can no doubt be fairly argued that Sir John, whose pay is linked to performance, is entitled to every penny...
examples.translation: 毋庸置疑，既然约翰爵士的薪水是与业绩挂钩的，他的每一分钱都是理所应得的。

examples.text: After I had read the book I could fairly claim to be an expert.
examples.translation: 读完这本书，我差不多可以说是专家了。

examples.text: Little ones also love big Dutch-style pancakes - the tiny Pannenkoekenhuis Upstairs has a fairy-tale feel.

meanings.meaning: (Faith)人名；(匈)福伊特；(英)费思，费丝(女名)；(瑞典)法伊特

examples.text: She had placed a great deal of faith in Mr Penleigh...
examples.translation: 她对彭利先生极其信任。

examples.text: People have lost faith in the British Parliament.
examples.translation: 人们已经对英国议会失去了信任。

examples.text: England shifted officially from a Catholic to a Protestant faith in the 16th century.
examples.translation: 英格兰于 16 世纪正式由天主教改信新教。

examples.text: Umberto Eco's loss of his own religious faith is reflected in his novels.
examples.translation: 翁贝托·艾柯个人宗教信仰的丧失反映在了他的小说里。

examples.text: If we don't, we're breaking faith with our people!
examples.translation: 如果我们不这样，就是对我们的人民背信弃义！

examples.text: This report was published in good faith but we regret any confusion which may have been caused.
examples.translation: 我们发表这篇报道的初衷是好的，但对可能已造成的混乱深感歉意。

examples.text: He has made one of the most powerful American films of the year by keeping faith with his radical principles.
examples.translation: 他秉承自己一贯的激进风格，制作出了本年度美国最有感染力的影片之一。

meanings.meaning: 忠实的，忠诚的；如实的；准确可靠的

examples.text: She had been faithful to her promise to guard this secret...
examples.translation: 她一直信守承诺，保守着这个秘密。

examples.text: Older Americans are among this country's most faithful voters.
examples.translation: 较年长的美国人是这个国家最忠实的选民群体之一。

examples.text: He spends his time making speeches at factories or gatherings of the Party faithful.
examples.translation: 他花时间在工厂或该党的忠实拥护者的集会上发表演说。

examples.text: He has since 1965 faithfully followed and supported every twist and turn of government policy.
examples.translation: 自1965年以来，他一直忠诚地跟随和支持政府政策的每一次变化和转向。
