examples.text: She insisted that she had remained faithful to her husband...
examples.translation: 她坚持说自己对丈夫一直是忠诚的。

examples.text: I'm very faithful when I love someone.
examples.translation: 我爱一个人是会非常忠贞的。

examples.text: The faithful revered him then as a prophet.
examples.translation: 那时，信徒们尊他为先知。

examples.text: Colin Welland's screenplay is faithful to the novel.
examples.translation: 科林·韦兰的电影剧本忠实于原小说。

examples.text: ...faithful copies of household items used in the mid-1800s.
examples.translation: 19世纪中期家庭用品的逼真仿制品

examples.text: When I adapt something I translate from one meaning to another as faithfully as I can.
examples.translation: 我改编东西的时候，会尽可能忠实地将意思表达出来。

examples.text: We tested a selection of vacuum cleaners, from old faithfuls to those with the latest features.
examples.translation: 我们测试了各种真空吸尘器，从值得信赖的老牌子到有着最新特色的产品，不一而足。

examples.text: The bank manager is said to have issued fake certificates.
examples.translation: 据说那个银行经理曾出具伪造的凭证。

examples.text: It is filled with famous works of art, and every one of them is a fake.
examples.translation: 这里满是艺术名品，但每一件都是赝品。

examples.text: It's safer to fake a tan with make-up rather than subject your complexion to the harsh rays of the sun...
examples.translation: 用化妆品打造出古铜色的皮肤比让皮肤受太阳的暴晒更为安全。

examples.text: He faked his own death last year to collect on a $1 million insurance policy.
examples.translation: 去年，他诈死以骗取100万美元的保险金。

examples.text: ...faked evidence.
examples.translation: 伪造的证据

examples.text: Jon faked nonchalance...
examples.translation: 乔恩装作若无其事的样子。

examples.text: Maturity and emotional sophistication can't be faked.
examples.translation: 成熟和情感上的老道是装不出来的。

examples.text: Suppose further that the false statements and obstruction continue into a subsequent criminal investigation.

meanings.meaning: (Fall)人名；(法、芬、瑞典)法尔；(英、匈)福尔；(阿拉伯)法勒

examples.text: Her father fell into the sea after a massive heart attack...
examples.translation: 她父亲在一次严重的心脏病发作后坠入海中。

examples.text: Prince Charles has again fallen from his horse...
examples.translation: 查尔斯王子又一次从马上摔了下来。

examples.text: Bombs fell in the town...
examples.translation: 炸弹落在镇上。

examples.text: I ought to seal the boxes up. I don't want the books falling out...
examples.translation: 我应该把盒子封起来。我不想让书掉出来。

examples.text: Twenty people were injured by falling masonry.
examples.translation: 有20人被倒塌的石墙砸伤。

examples.text: The helmets are designed to withstand impacts equivalent to a fall from a bicycle.
examples.translation: 头盔设计的承受力相当于从自行车上摔下的冲击力。

examples.text: The woman gripped the shoulders of her man to stop herself from falling...
examples.translation: 这个女人抓住丈夫的肩膀，以免摔倒。

examples.text: We watched buildings fall on top of people and pets...
examples.translation: 我们看到一幢幢大楼倒塌，砸在人和宠物身上。

examples.text: He lost his balance and fell backwards.
examples.translation: 他失去平衡，向后倒去。

examples.text: Mrs Briscoe had a bad fall last week.
examples.translation: 布里斯科太太上星期重重摔了一跤。

examples.text: I hit him so hard he fell down...
examples.translation: 我用劲太猛,把他打翻在地。

examples.text: Children jumped from upper floors as the building fell down around them.
examples.translation: 大楼倒塌时，孩子们从上面几层楼上跳了下来。

examples.text: A number of roads have been blocked by fallen trees.
examples.translation: 有几条路被倒下的树堵住了。

examples.text: Winds reached up to 100mph in some places with an inch of rain falling within 15 minutes.
examples.translation: 风力在一些地方达到了每小时 100 英里，15 分钟内降雨量达一英寸。

examples.text: One night there was a heavy fall of snow.
examples.translation: 有一天晚上下了一场大雪。

examples.text: Totally exhausted, he tore his clothes off and fell into bed...
examples.translation: 他疲惫至极，扯下衣服，一头倒在床上。

examples.text: In the morning I got as far as the sofa and fell on to it.
examples.translation: 早晨，我只走到沙发那儿，就一下子倒在上面。

examples.text: Output will fall by 6%...
examples.translation: 产量将减少 6％。

examples.text: Her weight fell to under seven stones...
examples.translation: 她的体重减到了 7 英石以下。

examples.text: Between July and August, oil product prices fell 0.2 per cent...
examples.translation: 七八月间,石油产品价格下降了 0.2％。

examples.text: The number of prosecutions has stayed static and the rate of convictions has fallen.
examples.translation: 提起诉讼的数量持平，有罪判决率下降。

examples.text: ...a time of falling living standards and emerging mass unemployment.
examples.translation: 生活水平下降、大规模失业初露端倪的时期

examples.text: There was a sharp fall in the value of the pound.
examples.translation: 英镑大幅贬值。

examples.text: There's a danger of the government falling because it will lose its majority...
examples.translation: 政府将因失去其占多数的优势而有倒台的危险。

examples.text: The moment Mrs Thatcher fell from power has left a lasting imprint on the world's memory.
examples.translation: 撒切尔夫人倒台的那一刻在世人的记忆中留下了永久的印痕。

examples.text: Following the fall of the military dictator in March, the country has had a civilian government...
examples.translation: 军事独裁者 3 月份垮台后，该国成立了一个平民政府。

examples.text: Her rise has mirrored his fall.
examples.translation: 她的崛起反衬了他的败落。

examples.text: Croatian army troops retreated from northern Bosnia and the area fell to the Serbs...
examples.translation: 克罗地亚军队从波斯尼亚北部撤军后，该地区落入塞尔维亚人手里。

examples.text: With the announcement 'Paphos has fallen!' a cheer went up from the assembled soldiers.
examples.translation: 随着一声宣告：“帕福斯陷落啦！”，聚集在一起的士兵爆发出一阵欢呼声。

examples.text: ...the fall of Rome.
examples.translation: 罗马的陷落

examples.text: Another wave of troops followed the first, running past those who had fallen.
examples.translation: 又一批士兵跟着第一批士兵从阵亡者身边跑过。

examples.text: It is almost impossible to visit Florida without falling in love with the state...
examples.translation: 去佛罗里达观光而不爱上这个州几乎不可能。

examples.text: 'Business to Business' was taken over by another company after it fell into debt...
examples.translation: 《致富》债务缠身，被另一家公司收购。

examples.text: I took Moira to the cinema, where she fell asleep...
examples.translation: 我带莫伊拉去看电影，她却在影院睡着了。

examples.text: Almost without exception these women fall victim to exploitation.
examples.translation: 这些女性几乎无一例外都受到了盘剥。

examples.text: The problems generally fall into two categories...
examples.translation: 问题大致分成两类。

examples.text: Both women fall into the highest-risk group.
examples.translation: 两个女人都属于高危人群。

examples.text: That responsibility falls on the local office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees...
examples.translation: 那由联合国高级难民署的地方分部负责。

examples.text: A vastly disproportionate burden falls on women for child care...
examples.translation: 照料孩子的重担落在了女性身上。

examples.text: A lot of suspicion fell on her.
examples.translation: 众多疑点落在了她的身上。

examples.text: The bus was stopped and silence fell on the passengers as the police checked identity cards.
examples.translation: 公交车被拦住了，警察检查身份证时，乘客们鸦雀无声。

examples.text: ...the oddly named Quasimodo Sunday which falls on the first Sunday after Easter.
examples.translation: 适逢复活节后第一个星期天的名字古怪的“卸白衣主日”

examples.text: Nancy, out of the corner of her eye, saw the shadow that suddenly fell across the doorway.
examples.translation: 南希从眼角的余光里看见突然有个影子落在门道上。

examples.text: ...a slender boy with black hair falling across his forehead.
examples.translation: 一个身材颀长的男孩儿，黑发垂在额上

examples.text: As he laid the flowers on the table, his eye fell upon a note in Grace's handwriting.
examples.translation: 他把花放在桌上时，目光落在一张写有格雷斯笔迹的字条上。

examples.text: As darkness fell outside, they sat down to eat at long tables.
examples.translation: 屋外夜幕降临，他们坐到长桌旁开始吃饭。

examples.text: ...panoramic views of the falls.
examples.translation: 瀑布的全景

examples.text: ...Niagara Falls.
examples.translation: 尼亚加拉瀑布

examples.text: He was elected judge in the fall of 1991...
examples.translation: 1991 年秋他当选为法官。

examples.text: The Supreme Court will not hear the case until next fall.
examples.translation: 最高法院将于明年秋开始审理此案。

examples.text: The last seven wickets fell for ten runs.
examples.translation: 最后 7 次三柱门失陷得了10分。

examples.text: By chance the book beside him fell open to St. Paul's warning to the Romans...
examples.translation: 他身旁的书偶然翻开到写着圣保罗对罗马人的告诫那页。

examples.text: The basket that she was carrying fell open.
examples.translation: 她提着的篮子忽然打开了。

examples.text: Within days of his death those same people were falling over themselves to denounce him.
examples.translation: 他尸骨未寒，还是那些人又大肆谴责起他来。

examples.text: At that point the radio handset fell to pieces.
examples.translation: 就在那一刻，无线电遥控器摔得粉碎。

examples.text: The work was never finished and bit by bit the building fell apart.
examples.translation: 工程一直没有完工，于是楼一点点地坍塌了。

examples.text: Europe's monetary system is falling apart...
examples.translation: 欧洲货币体系正在走向瓦解。

examples.text: I've tried everything to stop our marriage falling apart.
examples.translation: 我已竭尽所能去维系我们的婚姻。

examples.text: I was falling apart. I wasn't getting any sleep.
examples.translation: 我要崩溃了，我一直都没合眼。

examples.text: Officials say that one or two engines fell away from the plane shortly after takeoff.
examples.translation: 官员们说飞机起飞后不久就有一两台引擎脱落了。

examples.text: On either side of the tracks the ground fell away sharply.
examples.translation: 跑道两侧都是很陡的斜坡。

examples.text: His coalition may hold a clear majority but this could quickly fall away...
examples.translation: 他的联盟也许会占绝对多数，但这种优势可能会很快丧失。

examples.text: Demand began to fall away.
examples.translation: 需求开始减少。

examples.text: He fell back in embarrassment when he saw that Ross had no hair at all...
examples.translation: 看见罗斯的光头，他尴尬地后退了几步。

examples.text: The congregation fell back from them slightly as they entered.
examples.translation: 教堂会众在他们进来时稍稍往后退了退。

examples.text: The Prussian garrison at Charleroi was falling back.
examples.translation: 普鲁士驻沙勒罗瓦的部队正在撤退。

examples.text: Evans had rheumatic fever, missed school and fell behind...
examples.translation: 伊万斯得了风湿热，没去上课，功课也落下了。

examples.text: Boris is falling behind all the top players.
examples.translation: 鲍里斯落后于所有顶级选手。

examples.text: He faces losing his home after falling behind with the payments...
examples.translation: 他没能按时付款，面临着失去房子的危险。

examples.text: Thousands of people could die because the relief effort has fallen so far behind...
examples.translation: 因救援工作远远没有跟上，数千人可能面临死亡。

examples.text: Construction work fell behind schedule.
examples.translation: 建筑进度落后于工期。

examples.text: Service was outstandingly friendly and efficient, falling down on only one detail...
examples.translation: 服务态度极佳，效率也蛮高，仅在一个小地方不尽人意。

examples.text: That is where his argument falls down.
examples.translation: 这是他论点的薄弱之处。

examples.text: He was fantastically handsome — I just fell for him right away.
examples.translation: 他帅极了——我一下子就爱上了他。

examples.text: It was just a line to get you out here, and you fell for it!
examples.translation: 那不过是为了骗你到这儿来的一句谎言，你居然信了！

examples.text: I told him I would think about it and asked for his telephone number. He didn't fall for that one.
examples.translation: 我告诉他我会考虑，然后跟他要电话号码。他并没有上当。

examples.text: Part of my bedroom ceiling has fallen in.
examples.translation: 我卧室的天花板有些地方塌下来了。

examples.text: Prentice saw Goss fall in behind the informer.
examples.translation: 普伦蒂斯看见戈斯走在密探身后。

examples.text: Carmen's reluctance to fall in with Driver's plans led to trouble.
examples.translation: 卡门不愿接受德赖弗的计划，由此引来了麻烦。

examples.text: At university, Taylor had fallen in with a small clique of literature students.
examples.translation: 在大学里，泰勒曾经频繁参与一个文学小团体的活动。

examples.text: When your exhaust falls off, you have to replace it.
examples.translation: 如果你的排气管脱落，应将其更换。

examples.text: At the height of his fame, his every word was valued...
examples.translation: 在他声名鼎盛之时，他的每句话都受到重视。

examples.text: The film earned him international fame.
examples.translation: 这部电影为他赢得了国际声望。

examples.text: ...her rise to fame and fortune as a dramatist.
examples.translation: 她成为名利双收的剧作家

examples.text: He talked of other cultures as if they were more familiar to him than his own...
examples.translation: 他谈起其他文化时似乎比对他自己的文化还要熟悉。

examples.text: They are already familiar faces on our TV screens.
examples.translation: 他们已经是我们电视屏幕上的熟面孔了。

examples.text: ...the familiar names of long-established local firms.
examples.translation: 历史悠久、耳熟能详的当地公司

examples.text: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
examples.translation: 怪异的是，她看起来竟有些面熟，这让托尼心慌意乱。

examples.text: Lesinko is quite familiar with Central Television. He worked there for 25 years...
examples.translation: 莱辛科对中央电视台相当熟悉。他在那儿工作了25年。

examples.text: Most people are familiar with this figure from Wagner's opera.
examples.translation: 多数人都熟悉瓦格纳歌剧中的这一人物。

examples.text: The enemy would always have the advantage of familiarity with the rugged terrain.
examples.translation: 敌人一直都占有熟悉丘陵地形的优势。

examples.text: The driver of that taxi-cab seemed to me familiar to the point of impertinence...
examples.translation: 那辆出租车的司机在我看来放肆到了无礼的地步。

examples.text: John's 'crime' was being too familiar with the manager and calling him Gouldy.
examples.translation: 约翰的“罪行”就是对经理太随便，还叫他古尔迪。

examples.text: She needed to control her surprise at the easy familiarity with which her host greeted the head waiter.
examples.translation: 看见主人和领班侍者打招呼时轻薄随便的样子，她简直按捺不住惊讶。

examples.text: 'Gerald, isn't it?' I began familiarly.
examples.translation: “杰拉尔德，是你吧？”我亲昵地开口说道。

meanings.meaning: 家庭；亲属；家族；子女；[生]科；语族；[化]族
家庭的；家族的；适合于全家的

examples.text: There's room in there for a family of five...
examples.translation: 那儿能住下五口之家。

examples.text: His family are completely behind him, whatever he decides...
examples.translation: 他无论作出什么决定，家人都全力支持。

examples.text: To him the family is the core of society...
examples.translation: 对他来说，家庭是社会的核心。

examples.text: Does he have any family?
examples.translation: 他有什么亲人吗？

examples.text: They decided to start a family.
examples.translation: 他们决定要孩子。

examples.text: ...couples with large families.
examples.translation: 儿女成群的夫妇

examples.text: Her family came to Los Angeles at the turn of the century.
examples.translation: 她的祖先在世纪之交时来到洛杉矶。

examples.text: ...homes where their families had lived for generations.
examples.translation: 祖祖辈辈生活过的家

examples.text: ...the history of mental illness in the family.
examples.translation: 家族精神病史

examples.text: He returned to the family home...
examples.translation: 他回到自己家里。

examples.text: I was working in the family business.
examples.translation: 我在自家的企业工作。

examples.text: It had been designed as a family house...
examples.translation: 这房子的设计适合一家老小共同居住。

examples.text: A wedding is a family event.
examples.translation: 婚礼是全家人的庆典。

examples.text: ...foods in the cabbage family, such as Brussels sprouts.
examples.translation: 抱子甘蓝之类的十字花科食物

examples.text: Thousands of refugees are trapped by war, drought and famine...
examples.translation: 成千上万的难民陷于战争、旱灾和饥荒之中。

examples.text: The civil war is obstructing distribution of famine relief by aid agencies.
examples.translation: 内战阻碍着救援机构对饥荒赈济物资的配给。

meanings.meaning: 著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的

examples.text: New Orleans is famous for its cuisine.
examples.translation: 新奥尔良以其美食而著称。

examples.text: ...England's most famous landscape artist, John Constable.
examples.translation: 英格兰最著名的风景画家约翰·康斯太布尔

examples.text: If you're a Billy Crystal fan, you'll love this movie...
examples.translation: 如果你是比利·克里斯托的影迷，你会喜爱这部影片。

examples.text: As a boy he was a Manchester United fan...
examples.translation: 小时候，他是曼联队的球迷。

examples.text: I am a great fan of rave music.
examples.translation: 我是锐舞狂欢乐的狂热乐迷。

examples.text: She would have to wait in the truck, fanning herself with a piece of cardboard...
examples.translation: 她只得在卡车里等着，用一块纸板给自己扇风。

examples.text: Mo kept bringing me out refreshments and fanning me as it was that hot.
examples.translation: 天气太热了，莫不停地给我拿饮料出来，还拿扇子给我扇风。

examples.text: He cools himself in front of an electric fan.
examples.translation: 他在电扇前让自己凉快些。

examples.text: ...an extractor fan.
examples.translation: 排风扇

examples.text: ...its fan of tail feathers.
examples.translation: 它扇形的尾羽

examples.text: ...a conservatory with an ornate fan-shaped roof.
examples.translation: 有华丽扇形屋顶的温室

examples.text: Kneeling in front of the open hearth, old Maria was fanning the smoldering fire...
examples.translation: 老玛丽亚跪在壁炉前的空地上，扇着闷燃的炉火。

examples.text: During the afternoon, hot winds fan the flames.
examples.translation: 下午，热风使火苗越燃越旺。

examples.text: He said students were fanning social unrest with their violent protests.
examples.translation: 他说学生们的暴力抗议会煽动起社会动乱。

examples.text: ...economic problems which often fan hatred.
examples.translation: 那些常常煽起仇恨的经济问题

examples.text: The main body of British, American, and French troops had fanned out to the west...
examples.translation: 英、美、法部队的主力已经向西面散开。

examples.text: We fanned out from the farmhouse in twos and threes.
examples.translation: 我们三三两两从农舍散去。

examples.text: She suddenly raised her arms and spun, so the dress's full skirt fanned out in a bright circle...
examples.translation: 她突然举起双臂旋转起来，连衣裙的裙身呈圆形完全展开，明艳照人。

examples.text: Korontzis picked up his hand slowly and fanned out the cards one by one...
examples.translation: 科龙奇斯慢慢抬起手，一张一张地把牌展开。

examples.text: She lay on her back, her black hair fanned out over the pillow.
examples.translation: 她仰面倒下，她的黑发披散在枕头上。

meanings.meaning: 想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的

examples.text: What do you fancy doing, anyway?...
examples.translation: 你到底想干什么？

examples.text: Do you fancy going to see a movie sometime?...
examples.translation: 你想不想有空去看场电影？

examples.text: I just fancied a drink.
examples.translation: 我就是想喝点东西。

examples.text: She did not suspect that his interest was just a passing fancy.
examples.translation: 她相信这不过是他一时兴起。

examples.text: The boys would tease you to death if they didn't fancy you...
examples.translation: 如果男孩们不喜欢你的话，他们就会狠狠地捉弄你。

examples.text: I think he thinks I fancy him or something.
examples.translation: 我想他以为我爱慕他或什么的。

examples.text: So you fancy yourself as the boss someday?...
examples.translation: 这么说，你是想有一天自己当上老板喽？

examples.text: I didn't fancy myself wearing a kilt.
examples.translation: 我不想穿褶裥短裙。

examples.text: She fancies herself a bohemian...
examples.translation: 她自以为是放荡不羁的艺术家。

examples.text: She knew Felix fancied himself as a connoisseur.
examples.translation: 她知道费利克斯把他自己当成鉴赏家。

examples.text: ...a flighty young woman who really fancies herself.
examples.translation: 自命不凡、见异思迁的年轻女子

examples.text: You have to fancy Bath because they are the most consistent team in England...
examples.translation: 巴斯队一定会赢，因为他们是英格兰表现最稳定的球队。

examples.text: I fancy England to win through.
examples.translation: 我认为英格兰队会一路胜出。

examples.text: When Ferris looked up he fancied that he saw a shadow pass close to the window...
examples.translation: 费里斯抬头向上看，感觉看见一个影子在窗子近旁经过。

examples.text: She fancied he was trying to hide a smile.
examples.translation: 她猜想他正在尽力掩饰笑容。

examples.text: His last book is a bold, at times surrealistic mixture of fact and fancy.
examples.translation: 他的最后一部书把现实与梦幻大胆糅合在一起，有些地方表现出超现实主义色彩。

examples.text: ...a childhood fancy.
examples.translation: 儿时的幻想

examples.text: ...whims and fancies.
examples.translation: 突发的念头和不切实际的幻想

examples.text: It was very tasteless. Fancy talking like that so soon after his death...
examples.translation: 这真是太不得体了。真想不到在他尸骨未寒时就那么说话。

examples.text: 'Fancy that!' smiled Conti.
examples.translation: “真想不到！”康蒂笑着说。

examples.text: Sylvia took quite a fancy to him...
examples.translation: 西尔维娅深深爱上了他。

examples.text: The King took a fancy to ordering disguises and masks.
examples.translation: 国王迷上了订购化装用品和面具。

examples.text: She makes most of her own clothes, copying any fashion which takes her fancy.
examples.translation: 她的衣服多是仿照她喜爱的时装自己缝制的。

examples.text: It was packaged in a fancy plastic case with attractive graphics.
examples.translation: 它装在一个别致的有漂亮图纹的塑料盒子里。

examples.text: ...fancy jewellery.
examples.translation: 精美的珠宝

examples.text: He owned a fancy house out on Lake Agawam...
examples.translation: 他在阿格瓦姆湖畔拥有一座豪宅。

examples.text: They sent me to a fancy private school.
examples.translation: 他们把我送到一所昂贵的私立学校学习。

meanings.meaning: 奇异的；空想的；异想天开的；古怪的；极好的，极出色的；不可思议的；不切实际的

examples.text: I have a fantastic social life...
examples.translation: 我的社交生活丰富多彩。

examples.text: I thought she was fantastic.
examples.translation: 我觉得她太棒了。

examples.text: ...fantastic amounts of money.
examples.translation: 大笔的钱

examples.text: ...a fantastically expensive restaurant.
examples.translation: 贵得离谱的饭店

examples.text: Unlikely and fantastic legends grew up around a great many figures, both real and fictitious...
examples.translation: 围绕着许许多多或真实或虚构的人物，产生了一些不可思议、荒诞离奇的传说。

examples.text: The book has many fantastical aspects.
examples.translation: 这本书有很多方面都十分精彩。

meanings.meaning: 耽于幻想；奏幻想曲（等于phantasy）

examples.text: ...fantasies of romance and true love.
examples.translation: 对浪漫和真爱的憧憬

examples.text: The film is more of an ironic fantasy than a horror story.
examples.translation: 这部影片与其说是恐怖片，不如说是带有讽刺意味的奇幻片。

examples.text: ...a world of imagination, passion, fantasy, reflection.
examples.translation: 一个充满想象、激情、梦幻和沉思的世界

examples.text: Haskins said he has been playing fantasy baseball for the past five years.
examples.translation: 哈斯金斯说过去 5 年他一直在玩虚拟棒球。

meanings.meaning: 很；遥远地；久远地；到很远的距离；到很深的程度

examples.text: Far has two comparatives, farther and further, and two superlatives, farthest and furthest. Farther and farthest are used mainly in sense 1, and are dealt with here. Further and furthest are dealt with in separate entries.
examples.translation: far 有两个比较级 farther 和 further,两个最高级 farthest 和 furthest。farther 和 farthest 主要用于义项 1，下文将予以说明。further 和 furthest 将另立词条予以说明。

examples.text: They came from as far away as Florida...
examples.translation: 他们来自遥远的佛罗里达州。

examples.text: Both of my sisters moved even farther away from home...
examples.translation: 我的两个姐姐都搬得离家更远了。

examples.text: They lay in the cliff top grass with the sea stretching out far below...
examples.translation: 他们躺在悬崖顶端的草地上，崖下是向远方延伸的大海。

examples.text: Is it far?
examples.translation: 那儿远吗？

examples.text: How far is Pawtucket from Providence?...
examples.translation: 波塔基特离普罗维登斯有多远？

examples.text: How far is it to Malcy?...
examples.translation: 这儿离马尔锡有多远？

examples.text: How far can you throw?...
examples.translation: 你能扔多远？

examples.text: You can only judge how high something is when you know how far away it is...
examples.translation: 知道了某物的距离才能判断其高度。

examples.text: She followed the tracks as far as the road.
examples.translation: 她走了一条小路又一条小路来到路边。

examples.text: He had wandered to the far end of the room...
examples.translation: 他转到屋子的那一头。

examples.text: A narrow steep path leads down into a valley and up the far side.
examples.translation: 一条狭窄陡峭的小径向下伸进山谷，又从山谷的那一边向上延伸。

examples.text: I've spent a lot of time walking around Britain from the far north of Scotland down to Cornwall...
examples.translation: 我花了很长时间在英国徒步漫游，从苏格兰的最北端一直走到康沃尔。

examples.text: I wrote the date at the far left of the blackboard.
examples.translation: 我把日期写在黑板的最左边。

examples.text: ...hidden conflicts whose roots lie far back in time...
examples.translation: 很久以前就埋下祸根的潜在冲突

examples.text: I can't see any farther than the next six months...
examples.translation: 6个月以后的事情我就无法预见了。

examples.text: The first day of term, which seemed so far away at the start of the summer holidays, is looming.
examples.translation: 暑假刚开始时，开学显得那么遥远，现在却近在眼前。

examples.text: How far did the film tell the truth about Barnes Wallis?...
examples.translation: 影片讲述的巴恩斯·沃利斯的故事有多少真实的成分？

examples.text: But it is not clear how far they could help with the work on a power plant.
examples.translation: 但他们在电厂工程中能给予多少帮助尚不清楚。

examples.text: Discussions never progressed very far...
examples.translation: 讨论一直没多大进展。

examples.text: Think of how far we have come in a little time...
examples.translation: 想想我们在短短的时间内取得如此大的进展。

examples.text: I don't think Mr Cavanagh would get far with that trick.
examples.translation: 我想卡瓦纳先生的那套把戏玩不了多久。

examples.text: It's still not clear how far the Russian parliament will go to implement its own plans...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯议院在实施自己的计划时到底会采取怎样的极端措施尚不明了。

examples.text: Competition can be healthy, but if it is pushed too far it can result in bullying...
examples.translation: 竞争可以是良性的，但如果太过火，就可能造成以强凌弱。

examples.text: This time he's gone too far.
examples.translation: 这一次他太过分了。

examples.text: 'Does it sound like music?' — 'I wouldn't go that far.'...
examples.translation: “这听上去像音乐吗？”——“我可不那样认为。”

examples.text: I would go so far as to say it's positively neurotic.
examples.translation: 我可以这么说，这绝对是神经过敏。

examples.text: Women who eat plenty of fresh vegetables are far less likely to suffer anxiety or depression...
examples.translation: 吃新鲜蔬菜多的女性患焦虑症或抑郁症的几率要小很多。

examples.text: The police say the response has been far better than expected...
examples.translation: 警方称反应比预期好很多。

examples.text: These trials are simply taking far too long...
examples.translation: 这些审判耗时实在太长了。

examples.text: It now has debts reported to be far in excess of one thousand million pounds.
examples.translation: 据报道，现在它的债务已远远超过 10 亿英镑。

examples.text: The far right is now a greater threat than the extreme left...
examples.translation: 现在极右派比极左派威胁更大。

examples.text: Anti-racist campaigners are urging the Government to ban all far-Right groups.
examples.translation: 反种族主义活动家正在力促政府取缔所有极右组织。

examples.text: It only lasted a couple of years, as far as I know...
examples.translation: 据我所知，它仅仅维持了两三年。

examples.text: So far as I am aware, no proper investigation has ever been carried out into the subject.
examples.translation: 据我了解，目前对该问题尚未进行过正规的调查。

examples.text: He's still far and away the best we have.
examples.translation: 他仍然是我们最最优秀的人才。

examples.text: By far the most important issue for them is unemployment...
examples.translation: 对他们来说最重要的无疑就是失业问题。

examples.text: It was better by far to be clear-headed.
examples.translation: 保持头脑清醒要好得多。

examples.text: It was obvious that much of what they recorded was far from the truth...
examples.translation: 显然，他们所记录的很多根本不是事实。

examples.text: Far from being relaxed, we both felt so uncomfortable we hardly spoke...
examples.translation: 我们两人非但没有放松，反而都感觉很不自在，几乎没有说话。

examples.text: It is still far from clear exactly what the Thais intend to do.
examples.translation: 现在还完全不清楚泰国人究竟想做什么。

examples.text: Being dyslexic does not mean that one is unintelligent. Far from it.
examples.translation: 患有诵读困难症并不意味着智力低下。两者相差甚远。

examples.text: Far be it from me to criticise, but shouldn't their mother take a share of the blame?
examples.translation: 不是我要挑理，他们的母亲难道就不应该负点责任吗？

examples.text: His plan for tax relief is fine as far as it goes but will not be sufficient to get the economy moving again.
examples.translation: 他的减税方案还算不错，但并不足以促使经济再次发展。

examples.text: I was very impressed with the talent of Michael Ball. He will go far.
examples.translation: 我对迈克尔·鲍尔的才华印象非常深刻，他将来会前途无量。

examples.text: In his last few days the pain seemed to have stopped, but by then he was so far gone that it was no longer any comfort...
examples.translation: 在他弥留人世的最后几天里，疼痛似乎止住了，但那时他已奄奄一息，不再感到丝毫安慰。

examples.text: Many of the properties are in a desperate state but none is too far gone to save.
examples.translation: 很多地产情况都很糟糕，但都还不至于无法挽救。

examples.text: I hadn't been far wrong in my estimate...
examples.translation: 我过去的估计大致正确。

examples.text: Robertson is not far off her target.
examples.translation: 罗伯逊离她的目标不远了。

examples.text: That's the problem as far as I can see...
examples.translation: 在我看来，那就是问题所在。

examples.text: As far as I can see there are only two reasons for such an action.
examples.translation: 就我看来，采取这个行动只有两个原因。

examples.text: Their loyalty only went so far...
examples.translation: 他们的忠诚只能到这个程度。

examples.text: The church can only go so far in secular matters.
examples.translation: 教会在世俗事务上只能做这么多。

examples.text: It's been quiet so far...
examples.translation: 到现在为止还算安静。

examples.text: So far, they have met with no success...
examples.translation: 迄今为止，他们还从未成功过。

examples.text: Which one have you enjoyed most so far?
examples.translation: 目前你最喜欢哪一个？

examples.text: Of course, it's a case of so far, so good, but it's only one step.
examples.translation: 当然，目前情况还算不错，但这也只是一步而已。

examples.text: Thus far, the two prime ministers have achieved no concrete results.
examples.translation: 到目前为止，两位首相还没有取得实质性成果。

examples.text: Volunteers came from far and wide...
examples.translation: 志愿者来自四面八方。

examples.text: His fame spread far and wide.
examples.translation: 他远近闻名。

examples.text: If you remember these three golden rules you won't go far wrong.
examples.translation: 记住这三条金律，就不会错到哪儿。

examples.text: He could barely afford the railway fare.
examples.translation: 他几乎买不起火车票。

examples.text: ...taxi fares.
examples.translation: 打车费

examples.text: The fare has much improved since Hugh has taken charge of the kitchen.
examples.translation: 自从休主厨以来，伙食大为改进。

examples.text: ...traditional Portuguese fare in a traditional setting.
examples.translation: 盛放在传统餐具中的葡萄牙传统馔食

examples.text: It is unlikely that the marine industry will fare any better in September...
examples.translation: 海运业在9月份不可能有好转。

examples.text: Some later expeditions fared better, though they were no better equipped.
examples.translation: 虽然装备并未改善，但后来的一些探险进行得更好。

meanings.meaning: 别了！（常含有永别或不容易再见面的意思）；再会！

examples.text: They said their farewells there at the cafe.
examples.translation: 他们在咖啡馆道别。

examples.text: Farms in France are much smaller than those in the United States or even Britain.
examples.translation: 法国的农场比美国甚至是英国的农场都要小很多。

examples.text: They farmed some of the best land in Scotland...
examples.translation: 他们耕种着苏格兰最好的一部分土地。

examples.text: He has lived and farmed in the area for 46 years.
examples.translation: 他已在此地生活耕作了 46 年。

examples.text: ...trout fresh from a local trout farm.
examples.translation: 刚刚从当地鲑鱼养殖场捕捞的新鲜鲑鱼

meanings.meaning: (Farmer)人名；(英)法默；(法)法尔梅；(西)法梅尔

examples.text: The image of the yeoman-like yet struggling farmer retains a powerful mystique that pays political dividends.

meanings.meaning: 更远地；此外；更进一步地
进一步的；更远的（far的比较级）

examples.text: And I daresay that discrimination goes back a lot farther than that period of time.
Politics fascinated Franklin's father...
examples.translation: 政治让富兰克林的父亲着迷。

examples.text: She fascinated him, both on and off stage.
examples.translation: 不管是台上还是台下的她，都让他着迷。

meanings.meaning: 时尚；时装；样式；时髦人物

examples.text: There are 20 full-colour pages of fashion for men...
examples.translation: 书中有 20 张有关男性时尚的彩色插页。

examples.text: The fashion world does not mind what the real world thinks.
examples.translation: 时尚界并不在意现实世界的想法。

examples.text: In the early seventies I wore false eyelashes, as was the fashion...
examples.translation: 70 年代初我戴假睫毛，这在当时是时尚。

examples.text: Queen Mary started the fashion for blue and white china in England...
examples.translation: 玛丽女王开启了青花瓷在英格兰的流行风尚。

examples.text: He stayed at the top through all changes and fashions in pop music.
examples.translation: 在流行音乐的各种变化和各式潮流中他一直处于前沿。

examples.text: There is another drug called DHE that works in a similar fashion...
examples.translation: 另外还有一种叫 DHE 的药物，药效也差不多。

examples.text: It is happening in this fashion because of the obstinacy of one woman.
examples.translation: 事情会如此发展是因为一个女人的固执己见。

examples.text: Stone Age settlers fashioned necklaces from sheep's teeth.
examples.translation: 石器时代的移居者用羊的牙做成项链。

examples.text: She was educated — after a fashion — at home...
examples.translation: 她算得上是受过教育——家庭教育。

examples.text: He knew the way, after a fashion.
examples.translation: 他勉强认路。

examples.text: That sort of house is back in fashion...
examples.translation: 那种房子又时兴起来了。

examples.text: Marriage seems to be going out of fashion.
examples.translation: 婚姻似乎快要过时了。

meanings.meaning: 流行的；时髦的；上流社会的

examples.text: It became fashionable to eat certain kinds of fish...
examples.translation: 吃某些种类的鱼开始流行起来。

examples.text: Chelsea Harbour is renowned for its fashionable restaurants.
examples.translation: 切尔西港以高档餐馆闻名。

examples.text: ...women who are perfectly made up and fashionably dressed.
examples.translation: 妆容无可挑剔、穿着入时的女人们

meanings.meaning: 快速的，迅速的；紧的，稳固的
(Fast)人名；(德、英、俄、芬、捷、瑞典)法斯特

examples.text: ...fast cars with flashing lights and sirens...
examples.translation: 闪着灯、鸣着笛、飞速行驶的车辆

examples.text: Brindley was known as a very, very fast driver...
examples.translation: 众所周知，布林德利是个喜欢飞车的人。

examples.text: The party aims to attract votes from the business and professional communities, which want a faster pace of political reform...
examples.translation: 该党的目标是吸引商界和专业社群的选票，因为这两个群体都希望加快政治改革的步伐。

examples.text: The only question is how fast the process will be.
examples.translation: 唯一的问题是这个过程会有多快。

examples.text: They work terrifically fast...
examples.translation: 他们干活极快。

examples.text: It would be nice to go faster and break the world record...
examples.translation: 要是能再快一些、打破世界纪录就好了。

examples.text: He thinks they're not adapting fast enough...
examples.translation: 他认为他们适应得不够快。

examples.text: Barnes also knows that he is fast running out of time...
examples.translation: 巴恩斯也知道他的时间很快就要用完了。

examples.text: How fast were you driving?...
examples.translation: 你当时车开得有多快?

examples.text: How fast would the disease develop?
examples.translation: 这种病发展得有多快?

examples.text: When you've got a crisis like this you need professional help — fast!...
examples.translation: 当你遇到这样的危急情况，就需要专业救援了——要快！

examples.text: We'd appreciate your leaving as fast as possible.
examples.translation: 如果您能尽快离开，我们将不胜感激。

examples.text: That would be an astonishingly fast action on the part of the Congress.
examples.translation: 那将会是由国会方面采取的迅雷不及掩耳的行动。

examples.text: That clock's an hour fast.
examples.translation: 那个钟快了一个小时。

examples.text: She climbed the staircase cautiously, holding fast to the rail...
examples.translation: 她紧紧地抓着栏杆，小心翼翼地爬楼梯。

examples.text: The tanker is stuck fast on the rocks.
examples.translation: 油轮紧卡在礁石中间动弹不得。

examples.text: We can only try to hold fast to the age-old values of honesty, decency and concern for others...
examples.translation: 我们只能努力坚守那些古老的价值观：诚实、正派、关心他人。

examples.text: He told supporters to stand fast over the next few vital days.
examples.translation: 他叫支持者在接下来的几个重要日子里站稳立场。

examples.text: The fabric was ironed to make the colours fast.
examples.translation: 为防止掉色，织物已经过熨烫。

examples.text: Life in Detroit no longer satisfied him; he wanted the fast life of California.
examples.translation: 他不再满意底特律的生活，想要过加利福尼亚那种刺激快乐的生活。

examples.text: I fasted for a day and half and asked God to help me.
examples.translation: 我斋戒了一天半，祈求上帝伸出援手。

examples.text: The fast is broken at sunset, traditionally with dates and water.
examples.translation: 日落时开斋，按传统会吃椰枣、喝水。

examples.text: ...the Muslim holy month of fasting and prayer.
examples.translation: 穆斯林斋戒和祈祷的圣月

examples.text: When he went upstairs five minutes later, she was fast asleep.
examples.translation: 他5分钟后上楼时，她已睡熟。

examples.text: There have been people who have played fast and loose with the rules.
examples.translation: 有人在玩弄这些规则。

examples.text: No doubt someone had pulled a fast one on her over a procedural matter.
examples.translation: 无疑有人在程序性问题上骗了她。

meanings.meaning: 使固定；集中于；扎牢；强加于

examples.text: She got quickly into her Mini and fastened the seat-belt...
examples.translation: 她迅速钻进她的 Mini 车里并系紧安全带。

examples.text: Her long fair hair was fastened at the nape of her neck by an elastic band.
examples.translation: 她用皮筋将金色长发扎在脑后。

examples.text: ...the dress, which fastens with a long back zip.
examples.translation: 背部配有长拉链的连衣裙

examples.text: There were no instructions on how to fasten the carrying strap to the box...
examples.translation: 没有如何将背带系在盒子上的说明。

examples.text: Mamma fastened the picture on the wall.
examples.translation: 妈妈把画挂在了墙上。

examples.text: More and more her memory and all her thoughts fastened on one event...
examples.translation: 她越来越多地把记忆和心思都集中在一件事上。

examples.text: The discovery has fastened public attention on the possibilities of DNA analysis for resolving mysteries.
examples.translation: 这一发现将公众的注意力集中在用 DNA 分析技术来解开谜团的可能性上。

examples.text: My mind attempted to calm itself by fastening on this trivial detail...
examples.translation: 我尝试将注意力集中在这个小细节上以让自己平静下来。

examples.text: It's a gross oversimplification to fasten on to the red deer as a threat to the environment.
examples.translation: 仅关注马鹿威胁环境的一面过于片面了。

examples.text: He's fastening on that poor girl like a leech.
examples.translation: 他像蚂蟥一样缠着那个可怜的姑娘。

meanings.meaning: 致命的；重大的；毁灭性的；命中注定的

examples.text: It would clearly be fatal for Europe to quarrel seriously with America...
examples.translation: 欧洲若与美国反目显然会有致命的后果。

examples.text: He made the fatal mistake of compromising early...
examples.translation: 他犯了过早妥协的致命错误。

examples.text: It would deal a fatal blow to his fading chances of success.
examples.translation: 这将给他日渐渺茫的成功机会带来致命的一击。

examples.text: Failure now could fatally damage his chances in the future.
examples.translation: 现在失败会彻底毁掉他未来的机会。

examples.text: ...the fatal stabbing of a police sergeant...
examples.translation: 对警官致命的一刺

examples.text: A hospital spokesman said she had suffered a fatal heart attack.
examples.translation: 医院发言人说她死于心脏病发作。

examples.text: The dead soldier is reported to have been fatally wounded in the chest.
examples.translation: 据报道，死去的那位士兵是胸部受了致命伤。

examples.text: I see no use quarrelling with fate.
examples.translation: 我看不出和命运抗争有什么用。

examples.text: ...the fickleness of fate...
examples.translation: 命运的无常

examples.text: It was just one of those times when you wonder whether the fates conspire against you.
examples.translation: 有些时候，你会怀疑是不是造化弄人，现在就是如此。

examples.text: The Russian Parliament will hold a special session later this month to decide his fate...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯议会本月晚些时候将举行特别会议决定他的命运。

examples.text: He seems for a moment to be again holding the fate of the country in his hands...
examples.translation: 他似乎在一瞬间又一次将国家的命运握在了手中。

examples.text: The Casino, where she had often danced, had suffered a similar fate.
examples.translation: 她经常跳舞的赌场遭遇了相似的命运。

examples.text: ...the terrible fate awaiting humanity.
examples.translation: 等待人类的可怕命运

examples.text: The call for a boycott could be enough to seal the fate of next week's general election...
examples.translation: 抵制选举的呼吁足以注定下周大选失败的命运。

examples.text: And yesterday the Zoo's fate was sealed, largely due to two months of ever-dwindling entrance figures.
examples.translation: 昨日，伦敦动物园面临着关闭的命运，主要因为两个月来游客数量持续下滑。

meanings.meaning: 肥的，胖的；油腻的；丰满的
(Fat)人名；(法、西、塞)法特；(东南亚国家华语)发

examples.text: I could eat what I liked without getting fat...
examples.translation: 我怎么吃都不胖。

examples.text: After five minutes, the fat woman in the seat in front of me was asleep.
examples.translation: 5分钟后，我前排座位上的胖女人便睡着了。

examples.text: No one knows whether a child's tendency towards fatness is inherited or due to the food he eats.
examples.translation: 没人知道儿童的发胖倾向是遗传还是食物造成的。

examples.text: Because you're not burning calories, everything you eat turns to fat.
examples.translation: 由于没有消耗卡路里，你吃的所有东西都会变成脂肪。

examples.text: When you use oil or fat for cooking, use as little as possible.
examples.translation: 烹调时不论是植物油还是动物油，都要尽量少用。

examples.text: ...vegetable fats, such as coconut oil and palm oil.
examples.translation: 椰子油和棕榈油一类的植物油

examples.text: An easy way to cut the amount of fat in your diet is to avoid eating red meats...
examples.translation: 减少饮食中脂肪摄入量的简单方法就是避免吃红肉。

examples.text: Most low-fat yogurts are about 40 calories per 100g.
examples.translation: 大多数低脂酸奶每100克约含40卡热量。

examples.text: ...'Europe in Figures', a fat book published on September 22nd...
examples.translation: 9 月 22 日出版的大部头书《数说欧洲》

examples.text: He took out his fat wallet and peeled off some notes.
examples.translation: 他掏出鼓鼓的钱包，抽出几张钞票。

examples.text: They are set to make a big fat profit.
examples.translation: 他们下定决心要大赚一笔。

examples.text: 'Would your car be easy to steal?' — 'Fat chance. I've got a device that shuts down the gas and ignition.'
examples.translation: “你的汽车容易被盗吗？”——“不太可能。有个装置，可关闭油门和点火开关。”

examples.text: Liverpool grew fat on the basis of the slave trade.
examples.translation: 利物浦是靠奴隶贸易肥起来的。

examples.text: 'I think we should go in and hammer them.' — 'And a fat lot of good that would do us.'
examples.translation: “我觉得我们应该进去把他们狠揍一顿。”——“那对我们有个屁用。”

meanings.meaning: 父亲，爸爸；神父；祖先；前辈

examples.text: His father was a painter...
examples.translation: 他父亲是个画家。

examples.text: He would be a good father to my children.
examples.translation: 对我的孩子们来说，他会是个好父亲。

examples.text: ...Mr Stoneman, a father of five.
examples.translation: 5 个孩子的父亲斯通曼先生

examples.text: She claims Mark fathered her child...
examples.translation: 她宣称马克是孩子的父亲。

examples.text: He fathered at least three children by the wives of other men.
examples.translation: 他跟别人的老婆至少生了 3 个孩子。

examples.text: ...Max Dupain, regarded as the father of modern photography.
examples.translation: 被视为现代摄影之父的马克斯·杜培

examples.text: ...Mahatma Gandhi, the founding father of independent India.
examples.translation: 圣雄甘地，引领印度实现独立的国父

examples.text: I would like your advice on a matter of conscience, Father.
examples.translation: 我想就一件有关良心的事征求您的建议，神父。

examples.text: ...Father William.
examples.translation: 威廉神父

examples.text: ...Our Father in Heaven.
examples.translation: 我们的天父

examples.text: She continued to have severe stomach cramps, aches, fatigue, and depression...
examples.translation: 她仍然患有严重的胃痉挛，感觉疼痛、疲乏、抑郁。

examples.text: Clarke says his team could have lasted another 15 days before fatigue would have begun to take a toll.
examples.translation: 克拉克说，他的团队本来还可以再坚持 15 天，只是疲劳可能会造成严重后果，只好作罢。

examples.text: ...compassion fatigue caused by endless TV and celebrity appeals.
examples.translation: 没完没了的电视节目和名人呼吁而导致的同情心疲劳

examples.text: ...the result of four months of battle fatigue.
examples.translation: 4 个月的战斗疲劳带来的后果

examples.text: He never expected to return home wearing US combat fatigues.
examples.translation: 他从没想到会穿着美国军服回家。

examples.text: The problem turned out to be metal fatigue in the fuselage.
examples.translation: 问题原来是飞机机身出现金属疲劳。

meanings.meaning: 故障；[地质] 断层；错误；缺点；毛病；（网球等）发球失误
（通常用于疑问句或否定句）挑剔

examples.text: There was no escaping the fact: it was all his fault...
examples.translation: 这全是他的错，这是无法回避的事实。

examples.text: A few borrowers will find themselves in trouble with their repayments through no fault of their own.
examples.translation: 一些借款人会发现，他们还款遇到了麻烦，但根本不是由于自身的过失造成的。

examples.text: It is a big fault to think that you can learn how to manage people in business school.
examples.translation: 以为在商学院能学会如何管理人是一大错误。

examples.text: His manners had always made her blind to his faults.
examples.translation: 他的彬彬有礼总是使她对他的缺点视而不见。

examples.text: ...a short delay due to a minor technical fault...
examples.translation: 一个技术上的小故障引起的短暂延误

examples.text: Pilots were trying to repair a fault in the plane when it crashed...
examples.translation: 飞行员正在试图排除飞机故障的时候，飞机坠毁了。

examples.text: For all its faults, the film presents a clear message.
examples.translation: 该片尽管有种种不足，但还是表达了一个清晰的主旨。

examples.text: You can't fault them for lack of invention...
examples.translation: 你不能因为他们缺乏创新就指责他们。

examples.text: It is hard to fault the way he runs his own operation.
examples.translation: 他经营自己公司的方式无可指摘。

examples.text: ...the San Andreas Fault.
examples.translation: 圣安德烈亚斯断层

examples.text: He could never accept that he had been at fault...
examples.translation: 他怎么也无法承认是他的错。

examples.text: There are no indications that standard security arrangements were at fault.
examples.translation: 没有迹象表明例行的保安措施存在问题。

examples.text: I was disappointed whenever the cook found fault with my work.
examples.translation: 每当厨师挑剔我干的活儿时，我都非常沮丧。

examples.text: Jefferson was generous to a fault...
examples.translation: 杰斐逊大方得过了头。

examples.text: Others will tell you that she is modest to a fault, funny, clever and warm.
examples.translation: 别人会告诉你她有趣、聪明又热情，谦逊得过了头。

examples.text: The money will be used to repair faulty equipment.
examples.translation: 这笔钱将用来修理出故障的设备。

examples.text: Their interpretation was faulty — they had misinterpreted things.
examples.translation: 他们的理解是错误的——他们将事情曲解了。

examples.text: La Russa liked Craig's chances, even though not everything was tilted in his favor.

meanings.meaning: 有利的；良好的；赞成的，赞许的；讨人喜欢的

examples.text: Though they called this deal unacceptable, they might not see another one nearly as favorable.

meanings.meaning: 幸运儿；喜欢的事物；特别喜欢的人
最喜爱的；中意的；宠爱的

examples.text: The Quince and Apple Compote is a grown-up version of applesauce, a favorite pork-chop accompaniment.
...a modern reception desk with telephone and fax...
examples.translation: 有电话和传真机的现代化接待处

examples.text: These days, cartoonists send in their work by fax.
examples.translation: 现在卡通画家用传真机发送作品。

examples.text: I faxed a copy of the agreement to each of the investors...
examples.translation: 我给每个投资人都传真了一份合同。

examples.text: Did you fax him a reply?...
examples.translation: 你发传真回复他了吗？

examples.text: Pop it in the post, or get your secretary to fax it...
examples.translation: 把它扔进邮筒，要不然就让你的秘书发份传真。

examples.text: I faxed 10 hotels in the area to check room size.
examples.translation: 我给该地区 10 家旅馆发了传真，核实房间大小。

examples.text: I sent him a long fax, saying I didn't need a maid.
examples.translation: 我给他发了一份很长的传真，说我不需要女仆。

examples.text: ...a 2,000 word fax message.
examples.translation: 一份 2,000 词的传真

examples.text: I was sitting on the floor shivering with fear.
examples.translation: 我坐在地板上，吓得发抖。

examples.text: ...boyhood memories of sickness and fear of the dark...
examples.translation: 儿时记忆中的病痛和对黑暗的恐惧

examples.text: London Zoo is running hypnosis programmes to help people overcome their fear of spiders.
examples.translation: 伦敦动物园正在搞催眠活动，帮助人们克服对蜘蛛的恐惧。

examples.text: Many people fear change because they do not like the old ways to be disrupted.
examples.translation: 很多人惧怕变化，因为他们不喜欢旧有的生活方式遭到破坏。

examples.text: These youngsters are motivated not by a desire to achieve, but by fear of failure...
examples.translation: 激发这些年轻人的不是对成就的渴望，而是对失败的担心。

examples.text: Then one day his worst fears were confirmed...
examples.translation: 后来有一天，他最担心的事终于发生了。

examples.text: His fears might be groundless.
examples.translation: 他的担心也许毫无根据。

examples.text: ...the fear that once a war began it would soon pass beyond the ability of either side to manage it.
examples.translation: 担心一旦开战，双方很快都将无法驾驭战势

examples.text: She had feared she was going down with pneumonia or bronchitis...
examples.translation: 她担心会得肺炎或支气管炎。

examples.text: More than two million refugees have fled the area, fearing attack by loyalist forces.
examples.translation: 两百多万难民担心受到效忠旧政府的势力的攻击而逃离该地区。

examples.text: There was no fear that anything would be misunderstood...
examples.translation: 并无引起误会的可能性。

examples.text: There is a fear that the freeze on bank accounts could prove a lasting deterrent to investors.
examples.translation: 人们担心冻结银行账户可能会长期阻碍投资。

examples.text: Carla fears for her son...
examples.translation: 卡拉为儿子担心。

examples.text: He fled on Friday, saying he feared for his life.
examples.translation: 他星期五逃走了，说是担心自己有生命危险。

examples.text: He also spoke of his fears for the future of his country's culture.
examples.translation: 他也谈到了对祖国文化前途的担忧。

examples.text: ...fear for her own safety.
examples.translation: 对她自己安全的担心

examples.text: She pursed her lips together, as though fearing to betray her news...
examples.translation: 她闭紧双唇，仿佛害怕透露出她的消息。

examples.text: Old people fear to leave their homes.
examples.translation: 老年人都不愿背井离乡。

examples.text: I fear that a land war now looks very probable...
examples.translation: 恐怕陆地战爆发的可能性很大。

examples.text: 'Is anything left at all?' — 'I fear not.'
examples.translation: “留下什么东西了吗?” ——“恐怕没有。”

examples.text: The elderly live in fear of assault and murder.
examples.translation: 老人们生活在对袭击和谋杀的恐惧之中。

examples.text: She was afraid to say anything to them for fear of hurting their feelings...
examples.translation: 她什么都不敢对他们说，以免伤害他们的感情。

examples.text: No one dared shoot for fear of hitting Pete.
examples.translation: 没人敢开枪，怕伤着皮特。

examples.text: Fear not, Darlene will protect me...
examples.translation: 别担心，达琳会保护我的。

examples.text: You'll get the right training, never fear.
examples.translation: 你会受到正规训练的，别担心。

examples.text: When I asked him if he wanted to change his mind, William said 'No fear.'
examples.translation: 我问威廉是否想改主意，他说：“绝不会。”

examples.text: At some time or other Eve had obviously put the fear of God into her.
examples.translation: 显然伊芙时不时有意吓唬她一下。

meanings.meaning: 可行的；可能的；可实行的

examples.text: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions...
examples.translation: 她对在这些地区刺激投资是否可行表示怀疑。

examples.text: That may be fine for the US, but it's not feasible for a mass European market.
examples.translation: 那也许适合美国，但对于庞大的欧洲市场却并不可行。

examples.text: The committee will study the feasibility of setting up a national computer network.
examples.translation: 委员会将研究建立国家计算机网络的可行性。

examples.text: Bankers were fearful of a world banking crisis...
examples.translation: 银行家们害怕会发生一场全球银行业危机。

examples.text: I had often been very fearful, very angry, and very isolated.
examples.translation: 我以前经常感到非常恐惧，非常愤怒，非常孤独。

examples.text: 'What are you going to do to me?' Alex asked fearfully.
examples.translation: “你要拿我怎么样？”亚历克丝害怕地问。

examples.text: The region is in a fearful recession.
examples.translation: 该地区处于严重的经济衰退中。

examples.text: ...the fearful consequences which might flow from unilateral military moves.
examples.translation: 单方面军事行动可能造成的可怕后果

examples.text: You gave me a fearful shock!
examples.translation: 你让我大吃一惊。

examples.text: 'It sounds the most fearful hard work,' Sybil said later.
examples.translation: “这听起来是极为令人生畏的艰苦工作。”西比尔后来说。

examples.text: This is fearfully expensive compared with the last one I bought.
examples.translation: 这和我上次买的相比贵得吓人。

examples.text: Lunch was a feast of meat and vegetables, cheese, yoghurt and fruit, with unlimited wine...
examples.translation: 午餐很丰盛，有肉、蔬菜、奶酪、酸奶、水果, 酒无限量供应。

examples.text: The fruit was often served at wedding feasts...
examples.translation: 婚宴上经常有水果供应。

examples.text: On the following day a feast was given in King John's honour.
examples.translation: 第二天设宴款待约翰王。

examples.text: They feasted well into the afternoon on mutton and corn stew...
examples.translation: 他们吃玉米炖羊肉一直吃到下午。

examples.text: Starving dogs feasted on the human corpses.
examples.translation: 饿狗贪婪地啃食着人的尸体。

examples.text: Only a few feet away, their captors feasted in the castle's banqueting hall.
examples.translation: 仅在几英尺外，捉拿他们的人正在城堡的宴会厅里大吃大喝。

examples.text: The feasting, drinking, dancing and revelry continued for several days.
examples.translation: 一连几天都是宴会、痛饮、舞蹈和狂欢。

examples.text: This new series promises a feast of special effects and set designs...
examples.translation: 这部新的系列剧将会是一场特效和舞美的盛宴。

examples.text: Chicago provides a feast for the ears of any music lover.
examples.translation: 《芝加哥》将给所有音乐爱好者献上一场听觉的盛宴。

examples.text: The Jewish feast of Passover began last night...
examples.translation: 犹太人的宗教节日逾越节昨晚开始了。

examples.text: At Christmas the visitors began their circuit of dropping in on the eve of the feast day.
examples.translation: 圣诞节时，客人们在节日前夜开始逐家拜节。

examples.text: She stood feasting her eyes on the view.
examples.translation: 她驻足凝神欣赏这片景色。

examples.text: A racing car is an extraordinary feat of engineering.
examples.translation: 赛车是工程学上一项相当了不起的成就。

examples.text: ...a hat that she had made herself from black ostrich feathers.
examples.translation: 她用黑色鸵鸟羽毛给自己做的帽子

examples.text: ...a feather bed.
examples.translation: 羽毛褥垫床

examples.text: She and my mother were birds of a feather.
examples.translation: 她和我妈妈是一个类型的人。

examples.text: Harry's appointment to this important post was a feather in his cap.
examples.translation: 哈里被任命担任如此要职，这是件荣耀的事。

meanings.meaning: 特色，特征；容貌；特写或专题节目

examples.text: Patriotic songs have long been a feature of Kuwaiti life...
examples.translation: 爱国歌曲长期以来一直是科威特生活的一个特色。

examples.text: The spacious gardens are a special feature of this property...
examples.translation: 大花园是这处房产的特色。

examples.text: Perhaps the most unusual feature in the room is an extraordinary pair of candles.
examples.translation: 也许，这间屋子最与众不同之处就是一对非同寻常的蜡烛。

examples.text: His features seemed to change...
examples.translation: 他的容貌似乎有所改变。

examples.text: Her features were strongly defined.
examples.translation: 她的五官轮廓分明。

examples.text: It's a great movie and it features a Spanish actor who is going to be a world star within a year...
examples.translation: 这是一部精彩的影片，主演是一位西班牙演员，他不出一年就会成为国际巨星。

examples.text: The hour-long programme will be updated each week and feature highlights from recent games...
examples.translation: 这个时长一小时的节目将每周更新，重点介绍最近比赛的精彩片断。

examples.text: This spectacular event, now in its 5th year, features a stunning catwalk show.
examples.translation: 这一盛事如今已是第 5 个年头，其重头戏是一场精彩纷呈的时装秀。

examples.text: Jon featured in one of the show's most thrilling episodes.
examples.translation: 乔恩主演剧中最引人入胜的剧集之一。

examples.text: We are delighted to see the Sunday Times running a long feature on breast cancer.
examples.translation: 我们高兴地看到《星期天时报》发表了有关乳腺癌的长篇专题文章。

examples.text: ...a special feature on the fund-raising project.
examples.translation: 有关集资项目的专题报道

examples.text: ...the first feature-length cartoon, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.
examples.translation: 第一部卡通长片《白雪公主和七个小矮人》

examples.text: He joined the Army in February 1943...
examples.translation: 他 1943 年 2 月参军。

examples.text: His exhibition opens on 5 February...
examples.translation: 他的展览于 2 月 5 日开幕。

examples.text: Last February the tribunal agreed he had been the victim of racial discrimination.
examples.translation: 去年2月，特别法庭裁定他为种族歧视的受害者。

meanings.meaning: 北部联邦同盟盟员；北京连邦软件产业发展公司，国内主要的正版软件经销商

examples.text: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.
examples.translation: 在新的联邦政府体制中，6 省中的 5 个将成为自治区。

examples.text: He does not believe in a federal Europe with centralising powers.
examples.translation: 他认为一个集权式联邦制在欧洲是不可行的。

examples.text: The federal government controls just 6% of the education budget.
examples.translation: 联邦政府仅掌控 6％的教育预算。

examples.text: ...a federal judge.
examples.translation: 联邦法官

examples.text: ...residents of public housing and federally subsidized apartments.
examples.translation: 公共住房住户和享受联邦政府津贴的公寓住户

meanings.meaning: 联合；联邦；联盟；联邦政府

examples.text: ...the Russian Federation.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯联邦

examples.text: ...the British Athletic Federation...
examples.translation: 英国田径总会

examples.text: The organization emerged from a federation of six national agencies.
examples.translation: 该组织由 6 个全国性机构联合而成。

examples.text: He hadn't paid his television licence fee.
examples.translation: 他尚未缴纳电视机使用许可费。

examples.text: Find out how much your surveyor's and solicitor's fees will be.
examples.translation: 弄清你要向鉴定员和律师支付多少费用。

meanings.meaning: 微弱的，无力的；虚弱的；薄弱的

examples.text: He told them he was old and feeble and was not able to walk so far...
examples.translation: 他告诉他们，他年老体弱，不能走那么远。

examples.text: the feeble light of a tin lamp.
examples.translation: 锡灯微弱的光线

examples.text: His left hand moved feebly at his side.
examples.translation: 他的左手在身侧无力地动了一下。

examples.text: He said that the Government had been feeble.
examples.translation: 他说政府很懦弱。

examples.text: ...some rather feeble traditionalists.
examples.translation: 一些相当软弱的传统主义者

examples.text: This is a particularly feeble argument.
examples.translation: 这个论点尤其站不住脚。

examples.text: I said 'Sorry', very feebly, feeling rather embarrassed.
examples.translation: 我小声说了一句“对不起”，觉得很不好意思。

meanings.meaning: 喂养；供给；放牧；抚养（家庭等）；靠…为生
饲料；饲养；（动物或婴儿的）一餐

examples.text: We brought along pieces of old bread and fed the birds...
examples.translation: 我们拿了几片陈面包来喂鸟。

examples.text: She fed him a cookie...
examples.translation: 她给他吃了一块饼干。

examples.text: In that part of the world you can feed cattle on almost any green vegetable or fruit...
examples.translation: 在那个地方，几乎任何绿色蔬菜或水果都可以给牛吃。

examples.text: He spooned the ice cream into a cup and fed it to her.
examples.translation: 他用勺子把冰激凌舀进杯子，喂给她吃。

examples.text: She's had a good feed.
examples.translation: 她大吃了一顿。

examples.text: The feeding of dairy cows has undergone a revolution.
examples.translation: 乳牛的喂养方法发生了巨大的改变。

examples.text: Feeding a hungry family can be expensive.
examples.translation: 养活饥肠辘辘的一家人花费很大。

examples.text: ...a food reserve large enough to feed the Sudanese population for many months.
examples.translation: 足够苏丹人吃好多个月的食物储备

examples.text: After a few days the caterpillars stopped feeding...
examples.translation: 几天后毛虫停止进食。

examples.text: Slugs feed on decaying plant and animal material.
examples.translation: 蛞蝓以腐烂的动植物为食。

examples.text: When a baby is thirsty, it feeds more often...
examples.translation: 婴儿渴的时候，吃奶就会更频繁。

examples.text: I knew absolutely nothing about handling or feeding a baby.
examples.translation: 我对如何抱婴儿、如何给婴儿喂食一无所知。

examples.text: The grain just rotted and all they could use it for was animal feed.
examples.translation: 谷物完全烂掉了，他们能将其派上的唯一用场就是作动物饲料。

examples.text: ...poultry feed.
examples.translation: 家禽饲料

examples.text: ...blood vessels that feed blood to the brain.
examples.translation: 将血液输送到大脑的血管

examples.text: ...gas fed through pipelines.
examples.translation: 通过管道输送的燃气

examples.text: He took the compact disc from her, then fed it into the player...
examples.translation: 他从她手里接过光盘，放入播放机中。

examples.text: She was feeding documents into a paper shredder.
examples.translation: 她将文件放入碎纸机。

examples.text: He was surrounded by people who fed him ghastly lies...
examples.translation: 他周围的人都在给他灌输可怕的谎言。

examples.text: At least one British officer was feeding him with classified information.
examples.translation: 至少有一个英国官员在向他提供机密情报。

examples.text: The divorce was painfully public, feeding her dislike of the press.
examples.translation: 离婚的事张扬出去，她十分痛苦，更加厌恶媒体了。

examples.text: Feed plants to encourage steady growth.
examples.translation: 给植物施肥促使其不断生长。

examples.text: The drinking and the guilt fed on each other.
examples.translation: 酗酒和犯罪彼此助长。

examples.text: An automatic weather station feeds information on wind direction to the computer.
examples.translation: 自动化气象站将风向信息输入计算机。

examples.text: Continue to ask for feedback on your work...
examples.translation: 继续征求对你的工作的反馈意见。

examples.text: I was getting great feedback from my boss.
examples.translation: 老板对我的评价很高。

examples.text: I am feeling very depressed...
examples.translation: 我觉得非常沮丧。

examples.text: I will always feel grateful to that little guy...
examples.translation: 我会永远感激那个小伙子。

examples.text: I remember feeling sick...
examples.translation: 我记得有恶心的感觉。

examples.text: ...soldiers who once felt proud to wear their uniforms...
examples.translation: 曾经为穿上制服感到自豪的军人们

examples.text: Suddenly I felt a sharp pain in my shoulder...
examples.translation: 我突然感到肩膀上一阵剧痛。

examples.text: You won't feel a thing...
examples.translation: 你不会有任何感觉。

examples.text: I felt as if all my strength had gone...
examples.translation: 我感觉似乎已经筋疲力尽。

examples.text: I felt like I was being kicked in the teeth every day.
examples.translation: 我觉得每天都在遭受失望的打击。

examples.text: It feels good to have finished a piece of work...
examples.translation: 完成一项工作后感觉很好。

examples.text: The speed at which everything moved felt strange...
examples.translation: 一切进展如此之快让人感觉不对劲。

examples.text: Within five minutes of arriving back from holiday, it feels as if I've never been away...
examples.translation: 度假回来之后没过 5 分钟，我就感觉好像从未离开过。

examples.text: It felt like I'd had two babies instead of one...
examples.translation: 我感觉像是有两个孩子而不是一个。

examples.text: Preparing for that first trial felt like learning the rules of a new game.
examples.translation: 为第一次庭审作准备时感觉就像在学一种新游戏的规则。

examples.text: The metal felt smooth and cold...
examples.translation: 这种金属摸起来冰冷而光滑。

examples.text: The ten-foot oars felt heavy and awkward...
examples.translation: 10 英尺长的桨拿起来感觉很笨重。

examples.text: When the clay feels like putty, it is ready to use.
examples.translation: 黏土摸起来像油灰时，就可以用了。

examples.text: He remembered the feel of her skin...
examples.translation: 他记得触摸她的皮肤的感觉。

examples.text: Linen raincoats have a crisp, papery feel.
examples.translation: 尼龙雨衣的手感又干又脆又薄，像纸一样。

examples.text: It felt wintry cold that day.
examples.translation: 那天感觉像冬天一样寒冷。

examples.text: The doctor felt his head...
examples.translation: 医生摸了摸他的头。

examples.text: When dry, feel the surface and it will no longer be smooth...
examples.translation: 晾干之后，表面摸上去就不再光滑了。

examples.text: Feel how soft the skin is in the small of the back...
examples.translation: 感觉一下腰背部皮肤的柔滑。

examples.text: Her eyes squeezed shut, she felt inside the tin, expecting it to be bare.
examples.translation: 她闭紧眼睛摸摸罐内，预计里面是空的。

examples.text: Through several layers of clothes I could feel his muscles...
examples.translation: 透过好几层衣服，我能感觉到他的肌肉。

examples.text: He felt her leg against his.
examples.translation: 他感觉到她的腿贴着自己的腿。

examples.text: She felt something being pressed into her hands...
examples.translation: 她感觉有什么东西塞到了她手里。

examples.text: He felt something move beside him...
examples.translation: 他感觉身边有什么东西在动。

examples.text: She felt herself lifted from her feet...
examples.translation: 她感觉自己被抬了起来。

examples.text: Tremors were felt 250 miles away.
examples.translation: 250英里外都能感觉到颤动。

examples.text: I felt myself blush...
examples.translation: 我不觉脸红了。

examples.text: If at any point you feel yourself becoming tense, make a conscious effort to relax...
examples.translation: 如果什么时候感到紧张，就有意识地放松。

examples.text: I actually felt my heart quicken.
examples.translation: 我感觉心跳真的加快了。

examples.text: He felt her eyes on him...
examples.translation: 他感觉到她在看着他。

examples.text: Suddenly, I felt a presence behind me...
examples.translation: 突然，我感觉身后有什么东西。

examples.text: I could feel that a man was watching me very intensely...
examples.translation: 我能感觉到有人正紧盯着我看。

examples.text: He almost felt her wincing at the other end of the telephone.
examples.translation: 他几乎能感觉到她在电话那端皱眉蹙额。

examples.text: I feel that not enough is being done to protect the local animal life...
examples.translation: 我觉得对当地野生动物的保护力度不够。

examples.text: I feel certain that it will all turn out well...
examples.translation: 我觉得最后肯定会皆大欢喜。

examples.text: She felt herself to be part of a large business empire...
examples.translation: 她觉得自己成了一个庞大的商业帝国中的一分子。

examples.text: I never felt myself a real child of the sixties.
examples.translation: 我从未觉得自己真是 60 年代的人。

examples.text: I feel I should resign...
examples.translation: 我觉得自己应该辞职。

examples.text: He felt that he had to do it...
examples.translation: 他觉得他必须去做。

examples.text: You need not feel obliged to contribute...
examples.translation: 你不必觉得非捐款不可。

examples.text: They felt under no obligation to maintain their employees.
examples.translation: 他们觉得没有义务为员工提供生活费。

examples.text: We'd like to know what you feel about abortion...
examples.translation: 我们想知道你对堕胎是怎么看的。

examples.text: How do you feel about going back to the neighborhood?...
examples.translation: 对回到这个街区你有何感想？

examples.text: She feels guilty about spending less time lately with her two kids...
examples.translation: 最近她和两个孩子在一起的时间少了，她为此感到愧疚。

examples.text: He feels deep regret about his friend's death.
examples.translation: 他对朋友的去世深感惋惜。

examples.text: Neither of them felt like going back to sleep...
examples.translation: 他俩都不想回去睡觉。

examples.text: Could we take a walk? I feel like a little exercise.
examples.translation: 我们去散散步好吗？我想活动一下。

examples.text: The charity is still feeling the effects of revelations about its one-time president...
examples.translation: 这家慈善机构仍受到其前主席被检举带来的影响。

examples.text: The real impact will be felt in the developing world.
examples.translation: 发展中国家将会受到真正的影响。

examples.text: The room has a warm, cosy feel.
examples.translation: 这个房间有一种温暖舒适的感觉。

examples.text: ...a book that takes on the feel of an epic.
examples.translation: 一本史诗般的书

examples.text: He wanted to get the feel of the place.
examples.translation: 他想熟悉一下这个地方。

examples.text: I felt for my wallet and papers in my inside pocket...
examples.translation: 我在里兜里摸钱包和证件。

examples.text: I slumped down in my usual armchair and felt around for the newspaper.
examples.translation: 我一屁股坐在常坐的椅子上，摸索着找报纸。

examples.text: She cried on the phone and was very upset and I really felt for her.
examples.translation: 她在电话里哭了，非常难过，我很同情她。

meanings.meaning: 感觉，触觉；感情，情绪；同情
有感觉的；有同情心的；富于感情的
感觉；认为（feel的现在分词）；触摸

examples.text: It gave me a feeling of satisfaction...
examples.translation: 这给了我一种满足感。

examples.text: Strong feelings of pride welled up in me...
examples.translation: 我心中涌起强烈的自豪感。

examples.text: I think our main feeling would be of an immense gratitude...
examples.translation: 我觉得充斥我们心中的将是一种强烈的感激之情。

examples.text: He was unable to contain his own destructive feelings.
examples.translation: 他无法抑制自己消极的情绪。

examples.text: She has strong feelings about the alleged growth in violence against female officers...
examples.translation: 据称针对女警的暴力事件有所增加，她对此十分愤慨。

examples.text: I have also begun to reassess my own feelings about being a woman...
examples.translation: 我也开始重新审视自己对身为女性的感受。

examples.text: I think that sums up the feelings of most discerning and intelligent Indians...
examples.translation: 我想这概括了最富洞察力和悟性的印第安人的感受。

examples.text: He made no real secret of his feelings to his friends.
examples.translation: 他并不向朋友们掩饰自己的感受。

examples.text: He was afraid of hurting my feelings...
examples.translation: 他怕伤了我的心。

examples.text: He has no respect, no regard for anyone's feelings...
examples.translation: 他不尊重，也不顾及别人的感受。

examples.text: What about my feelings?
examples.translation: 谁关心我的感受？

examples.text: He was prompted to a rare outburst of feeling.
examples.translation: 他被惹得情绪非常激动，这很少见。

examples.text: ...a voice that trembles with feeling.
examples.translation: 激动得发颤的声音

examples.text: Thomas never lost his feeling for Harriet...
examples.translation: 托马斯对哈丽雅特的爱从未消逝。

examples.text: It's incredible that Peter can behave with such stupid lack of feeling.
examples.translation: 彼得行事如此麻木不仁，真是难以置信。

examples.text: I also had a strange feeling in my neck...
examples.translation: 我的脖子感觉也很奇怪。

examples.text: Focus on the feeling of relaxation...
examples.translation: 全身心体会放松的感觉。

examples.text: He experienced feelings of claustrophobia from being in a small place.
examples.translation: 他呆在一个狭小的地方，体验到了幽闭恐惧症的感觉。

examples.text: After the accident he had no feeling in his legs.
examples.translation: 事故过后，他的腿丧失了知觉。

examples.text: I have a feeling that everything will come right for us one day...
examples.translation: 我有种感觉，事情总有一天会变得对我们有利的。

examples.text: You have a feeling about people, and I just felt she was going to be good.
examples.translation: 人总会对其他人有某种感觉，我就觉得她会是个好人。

examples.text: There is still some feeling in the art world that the market for such works may be declining...
examples.translation: 艺术界一些人仍然认为，这类艺术品的市场可能趋于低迷。

examples.text: It seemed that anti-Fascist feeling was not being encouraged.
examples.translation: 看来反法西斯情绪并未受到鼓励。

examples.text: I had the terrible feeling of being left behind to bring up the baby while he had fun.
examples.translation: 我感觉糟糕透顶，我被留下抚养孩子，而他却在寻欢作乐。

examples.text: Try to get a feeling for the people who live here...
examples.translation: 试着去理解在这片土地上生息的人们。

examples.text: You seem to have a feeling for drawing.
examples.translation: 看来你有绘画的天赋。

examples.text: That's what we tried to portray in the book, this feeling of opulence and grandeur.
examples.translation: 那就是我们在书中竭力描绘的——一种富丽堂皇的气派。

examples.text: There's been some bad feeling between the two families.
examples.translation: 两家人之前有过节。

examples.text: I don't want any hard feelings between our companies...
examples.translation: 我不想我们两个公司间存有什么芥蒂。

examples.text: He held out his large hand. 'No hard feelings, right?'
examples.translation: 他伸出大手：“不生气，对吧？”

examples.translation: 就算在监狱里，狱友们对我也很友善。

examples.translation: 每个雌体四五月份只产一粒卵。

examples.translation: 男性领导人担心自己的妻子放弃传统的女性角色

examples.translation: 我总是被十分娇柔纤弱的女子吸引。

examples.translation: 村民们说这个围栏将限制公众进入山区。

examples.translation: 第一项任务就是把树林围起来不让羊进去。

examples.translation: 托马斯在一小块围起来的满是沙子的地上玩耍。

examples.translation: 他开始时为另一个犯罪团伙销赃，后来就自己干起了抢劫。

examples.translation: 昨晚，华盛顿尽最大努力与欧洲各国修好，称理解其担忧。

examples.translation: 10年前两国曾进行过边境战争，但现在正在重修旧好。

examples.translation: 他们保持中立,拒绝表态。

examples.text: He's not afraid of making decisions and is a man who never sits on the fence.
examples.translation: 他不怕拍板，从不作骑墙派。

examples.translation: 他计划将他镇北 5 英里处的约 100 英亩牧场圈起来。

examples.text: She was basically fenced in by what the military wanted to do...
examples.translation: 军旅事务使她基本上无法脱身。

examples.text: He put his hand on the post behind her so that he had her fenced in and could look down on her.
examples.translation: 他把手放在她身后的柱子上，这样就把她围在当中，可以低头看她了。

examples.text: They had recrossed the River Gambia by ferry.
examples.translation: 他们乘渡船再次穿过冈比亚河。

examples.translation: 每天，都有架飞机来鸟岛宾馆接送客人。

examples.translation: 天还黑着，就有5辆大巴开始从距银山煤矿 140 英里的地方出发运送矿工。

examples.translation: 一架直升机运来更多的士兵协助搜索。

examples.translation: 种植前加入养分均衡的肥料。

examples.translation: 球童跑过去给他拿东西。

examples.translation: 预计这幅画将售得两三百万英镑。

examples.translation: 我在帐篷里帮忙打杂。

examples.translation: 我叔叔吉姆发了高烧。

examples.translation: 这种疾病的症状包括发烧和体重减轻。

examples.translation: 安吉在极度兴奋中等待着。

examples.translation: 后来我们喝了几杯。

examples.translation: 这儿还有几个想法可供考虑。

examples.translation: 她沉默了几秒钟。

examples.translation: 医生每星期平均工作 90 个小时，有几个 24 小时候命，达到了每周 120 个小时。

examples.translation: 严格的食谱仅对少数人适用。

examples.text: There are many ways eggs can be prepared; here are a few of them.
examples.translation: 鸡蛋有多种做法，这是其中几种。

examples.translation: 我为几个老师举行的小型茶会

examples.translation: 过去几周是她记忆中平生最愉快的日子。

examples.translation: 领导人将在接下来的几天中飞往麦加签署协议。

examples.translation: 在最后几章中

examples.translation: 每天那个时候每隔几分钟就会有火车经过那里。

examples.translation: 她几乎没什么朋友，总的来说不怎么开心。

examples.translation: 几乎没什么成员打算投他的票。

examples.translation: 即使法律要求公司收税，也很少有公司这么做。

examples.translation: 问题是尽管要价极低，却很少有人想买。

examples.translation: 几乎无人质疑的唱歌和写歌的才能

examples.translation: 今年，工厂生产的小轿车可能只有 1,500 辆。

examples.translation: 我觉得其他人中不少都像我一样，有点迷惑不解。

examples.translation: 我们的视野出人意料地开阔。

examples.text: Going into the fourth lap, the two most broadly experienced riders led the field...
examples.translation: 进入第四圈时，两名身经百战的骑手开始领先。

examples.text: The field were so close that they would have caught us if I hadn't begun the sprint.
examples.translation: 其他参赛选手紧随身后，如果不是我开始冲刺，他们就会赶上我们了。

examples.text: ...one of the strongest fields ever assembled for the Women's Bowling Association championship.
examples.translation: 参加女子保龄球协会锦标赛的最强阵容之一

examples.text: I also conducted a field study among the boys about their attitude to relationships...
examples.translation: 我还对男孩子们进行了一项有关两性关系态度的实地调查。

examples.text: Our teachers took us on field trips to observe plants and animals, firsthand...
examples.translation: 老师带我们去野游，对动植物进行实地观察。

examples.text: The man offering help is a field worker.
examples.translation: 主动帮忙的人是个野外工作人员。

examples.text: When we are fielding, the umpires keep looking at the ball.
examples.translation: 我们防守的时候，裁判们一直看着球。

examples.text: At first base he led the league 21 times in fielding.
examples.translation: 他在一垒防守方面 21 次位居联盟第一。

examples.text: He was later shown on television, fielding questions.
examples.translation: 他后来出现在电视上，答复问题。

examples.text: England intend fielding their strongest team in next month's World Youth Championship.
examples.translation: 英格兰意欲在下月的世界青年锦标赛中推出他们的最强阵容。

examples.text: There are signs that the new party aims to field candidates in elections scheduled for February next year.
examples.translation: 有迹象表明新党意欲推举候选人参加定于明年 2 月举行的选举。

examples.text: In our absence the office gossips are probably having a field day...
examples.translation: 我们不在的时候，办公室里大概谣言四起了吧。

examples.text: I suspect that the lawyers are going to have a field day before it's all sorted out.
examples.translation: 我想律师们要好好忙活一通才能把一切都弄停当了。

examples.text: The zoo is doing major conservation work, both in captivity and in the field.
examples.translation: 无论在圈养场还是在野外，动物园在动物保护方面都承担了主要的工作。

examples.text: When it comes to picking up awards they lead the field by miles.
examples.translation: 他们在拿奖方面遥遥领先。

examples.text: He gave up playing the field and married a year ago.
examples.translation: 他不再处处留情，一年前结了婚。

examples.text: They look like the teeth of some fierce animal.
examples.translation: 它们看上去像某种猛兽的牙齿。

examples.text: 'I don't know,' she said fiercely.
examples.translation: “我不知道。”她怒气冲冲地说。

examples.text: Competition has been fierce to win a stake in Skoda...
examples.translation: 争夺斯柯达股份的竞争极为激烈。

examples.text: The town was captured after a fierce battle with rebels at the weekend...
examples.translation: 该镇在周末与叛乱分子一番激战后被攻占。

examples.text: He inspires fierce loyalty in his friends.
examples.translation: 他激发了朋友们对他的无比忠诚。

examples.text: He has always been ambitious and fiercely competitive.
examples.translation: 他总是雄心勃勃，争强好斗。

examples.text: The climbers were trapped by a fierce storm which went on for days.
examples.translation: 登山者被一连几天的强风暴雨给困住了。

examples.text: As I arrived a lorry had just been set on fire and was burning fiercely.
examples.translation: 我到的时候，一辆卡车刚被点着火，烧得正猛。

meanings.meaning: 十五；十五个；十五人组成的橄榄球队

examples.text: In India, there are fifteen official languages.
examples.translation: 印度有 15 种官方语言。

meanings.meaning: 五十；五十个；编号为50的东西
五十的；五十个的；众多的

examples.text: I probably look as if I'm in my fifties rather than my seventies.
examples.translation: 我大概看上去像 50 多岁而不是 70 多岁。

examples.text: He began performing in the early fifties.
examples.translation: 他20世纪50年代初开始从事表演。

meanings.meaning: 打架；与…打仗，与…斗争；反对…提案

examples.text: Mother Teresa is an elderly nun who has devoted her life to fighting poverty...
examples.translation: 德肋撒嬷嬷是一位毕生致力于消除贫困事业的年迈修女。

examples.text: More units to fight forest fires are planned...
examples.translation: 计划设立更多单位防控森林火灾。

examples.text: I've spent a lifetime fighting against racism and prejudice.
examples.translation: 我一辈子都在同种族主义和偏见作斗争。

examples.text: ...the fight against drug addiction.
examples.translation: 与毒瘾的斗争

examples.text: Our Government should be fighting for an end to food subsidies...
examples.translation: 我们政府应该努力废止食物补贴。

examples.text: Lee had to fight hard for his place on the expedition...
examples.translation: 李不得不为在考察队中获得一席之地而苦苦争取。

examples.text: I told him how we had fought to hold on to the company...
examples.translation: 我给他讲了我们是如何极力争取保住公司的。

examples.text: The team has fought its way to the cup final.
examples.translation: 这支队伍一路拼杀闯进了杯赛的决赛。

examples.text: I too am committing myself to continue the fight for justice.
examples.translation: 我本人也保证将继续为正义而战。

examples.text: The two men fought a battle over land and water rights...
examples.translation: 这两个男人为土地和水的使用权发生了争斗。

examples.text: In the latest incident at the weekend police fought a gun battle with a gang which used hand grenades against them...
examples.translation: 在周末发生的最近一起暴力事件中，警方与向他们投掷手榴弹的一伙匪徒展开了枪战。

examples.text: The Sioux had always fought other tribes for territorial rights.
examples.translation: 苏人总是为领地权与其他部落作战。

examples.text: He fought in the war and was taken prisoner by the Americans...
examples.translation: 他参了战，后被美国人俘虏。

examples.text: If I were a young man I would sooner go to prison than fight for this country...
examples.translation: 如果我是个年轻人，我宁愿进监狱也不愿为这个国家打仗。

examples.text: My father did leave his university to fight the Germans...
examples.translation: 我父亲确实离开了大学去和德国人打仗了。

examples.text: Last month rebels fought their way into the capital.
examples.translation: 上个月，叛乱分子一路攻进了首都。

examples.text: More than nine hundred people have died in the fighting.
examples.translation: 900多人在这场战斗中丧生。

examples.text: As a child she fought with her younger sister...
examples.translation: 她小时候会和妹妹打架。

examples.text: I did fight him, I punched him but it was like hitting a wall...
examples.translation: 我确实和他打了起来，我挥拳向他猛击，但就像打在墙上一样。

examples.text: He wrenched the crutch from Jacob, who didn't fight him for it...
examples.translation: 他猛地抢走了雅各布的拐杖，而雅各布并没有反抗。

examples.text: I refuse to act that way when my kids fight...
examples.translation: 我的孩子们打起架来时，我不会那样做。

examples.text: You get a lot of unruly drunks fighting each other.
examples.translation: 有很多无法无天的醉鬼在相互斗殴。

examples.text: He had had a fight with Smith and bloodied his nose.
examples.translation: 他和史密斯打了一架，把后者的鼻子打出了血。

examples.text: She was always arguing with him and fighting with him...
examples.translation: 她总是跟他争辩吵嘴。

examples.text: Gwendolen started fighting her teachers...
examples.translation: 格温德琳开始同老师争执起来。

examples.text: Mostly, they fight about paying bills.
examples.translation: 通常他们是为谁来支付账单而争吵。

examples.text: We think maybe he took off because he had a big fight with his dad the night before.
examples.translation: 我们觉得他突然走掉也许是因为头天晚上和爸爸大吵了一架。

examples.text: I fought my way into a carriage just before the doors closed...
examples.translation: 我刚挤进车厢，车门就关上了。

examples.text: Peter fought his way through a blizzard to save one of the chickens.
examples.translation: 彼得为了救其中一只鸡在暴风雪中艰难前行。

examples.text: This was Hyer's last fight, for no one else challenged him...
examples.translation: 这是海尔的最后一场比赛，因为再没有人向他发起挑战。

examples.text: The referee stopped the fight.
examples.translation: 裁判叫停了比赛。

examples.text: In a few hours' time one of the world's most famous boxers will be fighting in Britain for the first time...
examples.translation: 几个小时后，世界最著名的拳击手之一将开始其在英国的首场比赛。

examples.text: I'd like to fight him because he's undefeated and I want to be the first man to beat him...
examples.translation: 我想和他对阵，因为他从没有输过，而我想成为打败他的第一人。

examples.text: I'd like to fight him for the title.
examples.translation: 我想和他进行一场拳击比赛，争夺这一头衔。

examples.text: The former party treasurer helped raise almost £40 million to fight the election campaign.
examples.translation: 该党的前任财政部长帮助筹集了近 4,000 万英镑用于竞选。

examples.text: ...the fight for power between the two parties.
examples.translation: 两党间的权力之争

examples.text: Watkins sued the Army and fought his case in various courts for 10 years...
examples.translation: 沃特金斯将军队诉至法院，并在各级法庭打了 10 年的官司。

examples.text: The newspaper is fighting a damages action brought by the actress.
examples.translation: 这家报纸正和提起损害赔偿诉讼的女演员对簿公堂。

examples.text: I thought that we had a lot of fight in us.
examples.translation: 我觉得我们斗志高昂。

examples.text: I desperately fought the urge to giggle...
examples.translation: 我拼命地想忍住笑。

examples.text: He fought with the urge to smoke one of the cigars he'd given up awhile ago...
examples.translation: 他努力克制自己的烟瘾，不去抽一支戒掉没多久的雪茄。

examples.text: He fought to be patient with her.
examples.translation: 他竭力耐住性子对她。

examples.text: When they didn't shoot at me right away, I figured I had a fighting chance.
examples.translation: 当他们没有立即向我开枪时，我估摸自己还有一线生机。

examples.text: After a good night's sleep I feel fighting fit again.
examples.translation: 昨夜睡得很香，我又觉得自己精力充沛了。

examples.text: He is still fighting for his life in hospital.
examples.translation: 他仍在医院与死神搏斗。

examples.text: The teenage attackers fled when the two men fought back...
examples.translation: 当那两名男子还击时，袭击他们的少年逃之夭夭。

examples.text: We should take some comfort from the ability of the judicial system to fight back against corruption.
examples.translation: 司法制度有能力惩治腐败，这应使我们感到些许欣慰。

examples.text: She fought back the tears.
examples.translation: 她强忍住眼泪。

examples.text: Meg fought down the desire to run...
examples.translation: 梅格极力忍住不跑。

examples.text: He looked at the telephone, fighting down first the despair and then the anger.
examples.translation: 他看着电话，把绝望和愤怒一一压下。

examples.text: Unfortunately these drugs are quite toxic and hinder the body's ability to fight off infection...
examples.translation: 可惜的是，这些药物毒性很大，会削弱身体对感染的抵抗力。

examples.text: All day she had fought off the impulse to telephone Harry.
examples.translation: 她一整天都在克制自己想给哈里打电话的冲动。

examples.text: The woman fought off the attacker.
examples.translation: 这名女子打跑了袭击她的人。

examples.text: Instead of retaliating, he walks away leaving his team-mates to fight it out...
examples.translation: 他没有以牙还牙，而是径直走开，让队友去争出个结果。

examples.text: Malcolm continued to fight it out with Julien from his self-imposed exile in Paris.
