examples.translation: 马尔科姆自我放逐到了巴黎，但他继续要和朱利恩斗到底。

meanings.meaning: 数字；人物；图形；价格；（人的）体形；画像

examples.text: It would be very nice if we had a true figure of how many people in this country haven't got a job...
examples.translation: 如果我们能得到该国失业人口的真实数字就好了。

examples.text: It will not be long before the inflation figure starts to fall...
examples.translation: 过不了多久，通货膨胀率就会开始下降。

examples.text: New Government figures predict that one in two marriages will end in divorce.
examples.translation: 新的政府统计数字预测，每两例婚姻中就有一例会离异。

examples.text: Inflation, which has usually been in single figures, is running at more than 12%...
examples.translation: 通常保持在个位数的通货膨胀率现在已超过了 12％。

examples.text: Crawley, with 14, was the only other player to reach double figures...
examples.translation: 克劳利拿到 14 分,是仅有的另外一个得分达两位数的球员。

examples.text: The thermometer nudged three figures yesterday in Rome.
examples.translation: 罗马昨天气温接近(华氏)三位数。

examples.text: Alistair saw the dim figure of Rose in the chair...
examples.translation: 阿利斯泰尔看见了坐在椅子里的罗丝的模糊身影。

examples.text: She waited, standing on the bridge, until his figure vanished against the grey backdrop of the Palace...
examples.translation: 她站在桥上，一直等到他的身影消失在宫殿灰色的阴影中。

examples.text: A figure in a blue dress appeared in the doorway.
examples.translation: 一个穿着蓝色连衣裙的身影出现在门口。

examples.text: ...a life-size bronze figure of a brooding, hooded woman.
examples.translation: 一个戴着兜帽作沉思状的真人大小青铜女子雕像

examples.text: Take pride in your health and your figure...
examples.translation: 为自己的健康和体形感到骄傲吧。

examples.text: Janet was a natural blonde with a good figure.
examples.translation: 珍妮特天生一头金发，身材曼妙。

examples.text: The movement is supported by key figures in the three main political parties.
examples.translation: 这个运动受到三大政党关键人物的支持。

examples.text: Sometimes young lads just need to turn to a mother figure for a bit of a chat and reassurance.
examples.translation: 有时候年轻小伙子只是需要找一个母亲式的人物聊一聊，从中获得安慰。

examples.text: Daniel Boone, the great hero figure of the frontier...
examples.translation: 丹尼尔·布恩——西部伟大的英雄形象

examples.text: Local police chiefs should re-emerge as figures of authority and reassurance in their areas.
examples.translation: 地方警察局局长应该重新成为其所治一方具有权威和安定人心的人物。

examples.text: If you look at a world map (see Figure 1) you can identify the major wine-producing regions...
examples.translation: 查一查世界地图(见图1)，就能找到主要的葡萄酒产区。

examples.text: Figure 1.15 shows which provinces lost populations between 1910 and 1920.
examples.translation: 表 1.15 显示出哪些省份在 1910 至 1920 年间人口减少了。

examples.text: Draw a pentagon, a regular five-sided figure.
examples.translation: 画个五边形，一个规则的五边形。

examples.text: She figured that both she and Ned had learned a lot from the experience.
examples.translation: 她觉得自己和内德都从这一经历中学到了很多东西。

examples.text: When I finished, he said, 'Yeah. That figures'...
examples.translation: 等我说完，他说道：“是啊，那是预料中事。”

examples.text: Work it out and you'll find it figures.
examples.translation: 弄明白了你就会觉得这合情合理。

examples.text: Human rights violations figured prominently in the report.
examples.translation: 有关侵犯人权的部分在报告中占据了显要地位。

examples.text: Today she cuts a lonely figure.
examples.translation: 今天她看起来十分孤独。

examples.text: The man has become an unlikely figure of fun.
examples.translation: 令人想象不到的是，这个男人已经成为了笑谈。

examples.text: You'll lose your girlish figure if you don't watch out.
examples.translation: 如果不多加注意，你就会失去女孩般的苗条身段。

examples.text: No one will put a figure on the final cost of this reconstruction.
examples.translation: 谁也不愿确切地说明这一重建最后总共的花费是多少。

examples.text: Jack worked as hard as he could to build his business, but he hadn't figured on a few obstacles.
examples.translation: 杰克竭尽全力发展自己的公司，但有几个障碍是他始料不及的。

examples.text: It took them about one month to figure out how to start the equipment...
examples.translation: 他们花了大约1个月的时间才搞清楚如何启动设备。

examples.text: They're trying to figure out the politics of this whole situation...
examples.translation: 他们正试图弄明白整个情形背后的权术争斗。

examples.text: I don't have to be a detective to figure that out.
examples.translation: 我不是侦探也想得出。

examples.text: He figured up the balance in their checking account.
examples.translation: 他算出了他们活期存款账户上的余额总和。

examples.text: He sat behind a table on which were half a dozen files.
examples.translation: 他坐在一张放有6个文件夹的桌子后面。

examples.text: ...a file of insurance papers.
examples.translation: 一夹子保险文件

examples.text: There was stuff in that file that was private between me and Dr Denny...
examples.translation: 那份档案的有些内容是只应我和丹尼医生知道的。

examples.text: We already have files on people's tax details, mortgages and poll tax...
examples.translation: 我们已经建立了人们纳税详情、抵押贷款以及人头税的档案。

examples.text: You must record and keep a file of all expenses.
examples.translation: 必须对所有花费进行记录并存档。

examples.text: A secretary can file papers as efficiently as a floppy disk can store them...
examples.translation: 秘书归档文件时可以像软盘存储一样高效。

examples.text: They are all filed alphabetically under author.
examples.translation: 这些都是按照作者姓名的字母顺序归档的。

examples.text: A number of them have filed formal complaints against the police...
examples.translation: 他们中的许多人都对警方提出了正式控告。

examples.text: I filed for divorce on the grounds of adultery a few months later.
examples.translation: 几个月后我以通奸为由提起了离婚诉讼。

examples.text: Catherine Bond filed that report for the BBC from Nairobi...
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳·邦德从内罗毕向英国广播公司发送了那篇报道。

examples.text: He had to rush back to the office and file a housing story before the secretaries went home.
examples.translation: 他不得不冲回办公室，赶在秘书们回家之前提交一篇有关住房的新闻报道。

examples.text: She paused as the group of children filed out of the house...
examples.translation: 那群孩子从房子里鱼贯而出时，她停了下来。

examples.text: Slowly, people filed into the room and sat down.
examples.translation: 人们排成一列缓慢地依次走进房间，并坐了下来。

examples.text: Manicurists are skilled at shaping and filing nails.
examples.translation: 美甲师修锉指甲的手艺娴熟。

examples.text: His fingerprints were on file in Washington...
examples.translation: 他的指纹已在华盛顿记录在档。

examples.text: We'll keep your details on file...
examples.translation: 我们会把有关你的详细信息记录在档。

examples.text: It is one of the most desperate cases on her files.
examples.translation: 这是她记录的档案中最严重的案例之一。

examples.text: We were walking in single file to the lake.
examples.translation: 我们正排成一列朝湖边走去。

examples.text: When at home, most evenings would be spent reading, cutting up and filing away his photographs...
examples.translation: 晚上在家时，经常都是在看书或剪切和归类他的照片。

examples.text: The details are filed away by his three secretaries for future reference.
examples.translation: 他的3个秘书已经把详细情况归档备查。

meanings.meaning: 装满，使充满；满足；堵塞；任职

examples.text: Fill a saucepan with water and bring to a slow boil...
examples.translation: 往平底锅里加满水,小火煮沸。

examples.text: She made sandwiches, filled a flask and put sugar in...
examples.translation: 她做了三明治，把保温瓶灌满，又放了糖进去。

examples.text: The victims' lungs fill quickly with fluid...
examples.translation: 受害者的肺里很快充满了积液。

examples.text: The boy's eyes filled with tears...
examples.translation: 男孩眼泪汪汪。

examples.text: While the bath was filling, he padded about in his underpants.
examples.translation: 往浴缸里放水时，他穿着内裤走来走去。

examples.text: Pass me your cup, Amy, and I'll fill it up for you...
examples.translation: 把杯子递给我，埃米，我给你加满。

examples.text: Warehouses at the frontier between the two countries fill up with sacks of rice and flour.
examples.translation: 两国边境地区的仓库里堆满了一袋袋的大米和面粉。

examples.text: He cast his eyes at the rows of cabinets that filled the enormous work area...
examples.translation: 他把目光投向那一排排挤占了巨大工作空间的柜子。

examples.text: The text fills 231 pages.
examples.translation: 正文占了 231 页。

examples.text: ...the complicated machines that fill up today's laboratories.
examples.translation: 充斥当今实验室的各种复杂仪器

examples.text: ...four museum buildings filled with historical objects.
examples.translation: 塞满历史文物的 4 幢博物馆大楼

examples.text: ...the flower-filled courtyard of an old Spanish colonial house.
examples.translation: 一座西班牙殖民时期的老房子里开满鲜花的庭院

examples.text: Fill small holes with wood filler in a matching colour...
examples.translation: 用颜色相配的木质填料填平小孔。

examples.text: The gravedigger filled the grave.
examples.translation: 掘墓人把墓穴填上。

examples.text: If any cracks have appeared in the tart case, fill these in with raw pastry.
examples.translation: 如果饼皮开裂，就用生的油酥面团填平。

examples.text: In the parking lot of the school, the siren filled the air...
examples.translation: 警报声响彻学校停车场。

examples.text: All the light bars were turned on which filled the room with these rotating beams of light...
examples.translation: 所有灯条都打开了，满屋都是旋转的光柱。

examples.text: The barn was filled with the sour-sweet smell of fresh dung.
examples.translation: 谷仓里弥漫着新粪酸甜的气味。

examples.text: ...another sunshine-filled day.
examples.translation: 又一个阳光明媚的日子

examples.text: ...those whose work forces them to be in dusty or smoke-filled environments.
examples.translation: 那些出于工作原因不得不呆在满是烟尘环境中的人

examples.text: I admired my father, and his work filled me with awe and curiosity...
examples.translation: 我很钦佩父亲，并对他的工作充满了敬畏和好奇。

examples.text: He looked at me without speaking, and for the first time I could see the pride that filled him...
examples.translation: 他看着我没有说话，我第一次看出他内心充满了自豪。

examples.text: He stared at his favourite child, dismayed, filled with fear.
examples.translation: 他惊愕地盯着自己最宠爱的孩子，满心恐惧。

examples.text: If she wants a routine to fill her day, let her do community work.
examples.translation: 如果她想做些日常的事务来打发白天的时间，就让她去做社区工作吧。

examples.text: On Thursday night she went to her yoga class, glad to have something to fill up the evening.
examples.translation: 星期四晚上她去上了瑜伽课，很高兴自己有事可做。

examples.text: ...properly organized and staffed day-care programs fill a need which allows family structures to remain intact...
examples.translation: 组织得当、人员配备齐整的日托中心满足了人们的需求，保持了家庭结构不受破坏。

examples.text: She brought him a sense of fun, of gaiety that filled a gap in his life.
examples.translation: 她带给他开心快乐，弥补了他生命中的缺憾。

examples.text: Dena was filling the role of diplomat's wife with the skill she had learned over the years.
examples.translation: 德娜利用她多年来学到的处事技巧扮演着外交家妻子的角色。

examples.text: One problem not mentioned is the unemployed may not have the skills to fill the vacancies on offer...
examples.translation: 一个没有提及的问题是，失业人员也许缺乏填补所提供的空职的技能。

examples.text: A vacancy has arisen which I intend to fill.
examples.translation: 有一个职位空了出来，我想要补上。

examples.text: They joked and drank coffee and filled themselves with chocolate cake.
examples.translation: 他们开着玩笑，喝着咖啡，尽情地吃着巧克力蛋糕。

examples.text: Children are enthralled by his stories; he has been known to fill theatre halls in Australia.
examples.translation: 孩子们为他的故事所着迷;众所周知他在澳大利亚总是场场爆满。

examples.text: It is almost impossible to find a dentist who will fill a tooth on the National Health.
examples.translation: 几乎不可能找到一位愿意接受国民医疗保健来补牙的医师。

examples.text: A pharmacist can fill any prescription if, in his or her judgment, the prescription is valid.
examples.translation: 只要药剂师认定处方有效就可按方配药。

examples.text: We feel that we have had our fill of disappointments and emotional upsets.
examples.translation: 我们觉得已经受够了失望和情绪困扰。

examples.text: If you want your free copy of the Patients' Charter fill this form in...
examples.translation: 如果想要一份免费的《病人约章》，就把这张表填一下。

examples.text: Fill in the coupon and send it first class to the address shown.
examples.translation: 填写订单，并按一类邮件寄至注明的地址。

examples.text: When you have both filled in your patterns, you may want to share these with each other...
examples.translation: 两人都把图案填好色后，不妨互相交换着看一下。

examples.text: With a lip pencil, outline lips and fill them in.
examples.translation: 用唇线笔勾出双唇的轮廓，然后涂上唇膏。

examples.text: I didn't give Reid all the details yet — I'll fill him in...
examples.translation: 我还没有告诉里德所有详情——我会讲给他听的。

examples.text: He filled her in on Wilbur Kantor's visit.
examples.translation: 他告诉她威尔伯·坎特此行的详细经过。

examples.text: Vice-presidents' wives would fill in for first ladies.
examples.translation: 副总统夫人们将临时代替各位第一夫人。

examples.text: That's not a career. She's just filling in time until she gets married.
examples.translation: 那算不上什么事业，她只不过是在嫁人之前打发一下时间而已。

examples.text: Fill out the application carefully, and keep copies of it.
examples.translation: 仔细填写申请表，并且保存副本。

examples.text: A girl may fill out before she reaches her full height.
examples.translation: 女孩子在长足个头之前可能会发胖。

examples.text: Fill up on potatoes, bread and pasta, which are high in carbohydrate and low in fat...
examples.translation: 用碳水化合物含量高、脂肪含量低的土豆、面包和意大利面食填饱肚子。

examples.text: When you are happy about yourself you won't need to fill yourself up with food.
examples.translation: 一个人如果感觉舒心，就不必去胡吃海塞。

examples.text: Potatoes fill us up without overloading us with calories.
examples.translation: 吃土豆容易让我们有一种饱胀感，又不会摄入过多的热量。

meanings.meaning: 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影
摄制电影；生薄膜；变得朦胧

examples.text: Everything about the film was good. Good acting, good story, good fun.
examples.translation: 这部片子各个方面都很不错：表演出色，故事精彩，情节有趣。

examples.text: ...a government health film about the dangers of smoking.
examples.translation: 有关吸烟危害的公益健康教育影片

examples.text: He had filmed her life story...
examples.translation: 他把她一生的经历拍成了电影。

examples.text: Considering the restrictions under which she filmed, I think she did a commendable job.
examples.translation: 考虑到她拍摄时所受的各种限制，我觉得她交出的答卷值得嘉许。

examples.text: They have seen news film of families queueing in Russia to buy a loaf of bread.
examples.translation: 他们已经看过那段俄罗斯许多家庭为买面包排起长队的新闻画面。

examples.text: The photographers had already shot a dozen rolls of film.
examples.translation: 摄影师们已经拍光了一打胶卷。

examples.text: Film is a business with limited opportunities for actresses...
examples.translation: 电影行业对女演员来说机会有限。

examples.text: She wanted to set up her own company to invest in films.
examples.translation: 她想成立自己的公司投资电影。

examples.text: The sea is coated with a film of raw sewage.
examples.translation: 海面上漂浮着一层未经处理的污水。

examples.text: Cover with plastic film and refrigerate for 24 hours.
examples.translation: 覆上保鲜膜，冷藏 24 小时。

meanings.meaning: 富饶的，肥沃的；能生育的

examples.text: ...fertile soil.
examples.translation: 肥沃的土地

examples.text: ...the rolling fertile countryside of East Cork.
examples.translation: 科克郡东部起伏的乡间沃土

examples.text: He was able to bring large sterile acreages back to fertility.
examples.translation: 他能将大片的不毛之地重新变为沃土。

examples.text: ...a product of Flynn's fertile imagination...
examples.translation: 弗林丰富想象力的产物

examples.text: A chess player must have a fertile imagination and rich sense of fantasy.
examples.translation: 一个棋手必须有丰富的想象力，并善于奇思妙想。

examples.text: ...a fertile breeding ground for this kind of violent racism.
examples.translation: 易于滋生这种极端种族主义的温床

examples.text: The operation cannot be reversed to make her fertile again.
examples.translation: 手术结果不可逆转，无法让她恢复生育能力。

examples.text: Doctors will tell you that pregnancy is the only sure test for fertility.
examples.translation: 医生会告诉你怀孕是检测生育能力的唯一可靠方法。

examples.text: The word was finally given for us to get on board...
examples.translation: 终于通知我们登乘了。

examples.text: The food finally arrived at the end of last week and distribution began...
examples.translation: 食品总算在上周末运到并开始分发。

examples.text: Finally, after ten hours of negotiations, the gunman gave himself up.
examples.translation: 经过 10 个小时的谈判，持枪歹徒终于投降了。

examples.text: The action slips from comedy to melodrama and finally to tragedy.
examples.translation: 剧情从喜剧逐渐发展为情节剧，最后又演变为悲剧。

examples.text: Finally, who needs the theatre?...
examples.translation: 最后要说的是，谁还需要剧院呢？

examples.text: And finally, a word about the winner and runner-up.
examples.translation: 最后，来谈一谈冠亚军。

meanings.meaning: 滤波器；[化工] 过滤器；筛选；滤光器
过滤；渗透；用过滤法除去

examples.text: The best prevention for cholera is to boil or filter water, and eat only well-cooked food.
examples.translation: 预防霍乱的最佳方法是将水煮沸或过滤，并且只食用煮熟后的食物。

examples.text: ...a paper coffee filter.
examples.translation: 咖啡过滤纸

examples.text: You might use a yellow filter to improve the clarity of a hazy horizon.
examples.translation: 可以使用黄色滤光器让模糊的视野更加清晰。

examples.text: Light filtered into my kitchen through the soft, green shade of the cherry tree.
examples.translation: 光线透过樱桃树柔和的绿阴隐约照进我的厨房。

examples.text: It took months before the findings began to filter through to the politicians...
examples.translation: 调查结果数月后才传到从政者的耳朵里。

examples.text: News of the attack quickly filtered through the college.
examples.translation: 有关袭击的消息很快就在该学院中传开了。

examples.text: ...as indications filter in from polling stations.
examples.translation: 随着从投票站透露出各种迹象

examples.text: ...the horror stories which were beginning to filter out of Germany.
examples.translation: 开始传出德国的恐怖故事

examples.text: Children should have glasses which filter out UV rays...
examples.translation: 儿童应该戴上滤除紫外线的眼镜。

examples.text: Plants and trees filter carbon dioxide out of the air and produce oxygen.
examples.translation: 花草树木会过滤掉空气中的二氧化碳并制造氧气。

examples.text: The fund has been used largely to finance the construction of federal prisons...
examples.translation: 该基金大部分用于了资助联邦监狱的建造。

examples.text: Government expenditure is financed by taxation and by borrowing.
examples.translation: 政府开支依靠征税款和借贷来维持。

examples.text: A United States delegation is in Japan seeking finance for a major scientific project.
examples.translation: 一个美国代表团正在日本为一大型科研项目寻求资助。

examples.text: ...a major player in the world of high finance...
examples.translation: 高级金融界的大户

examples.text: The report recommends an overhaul of public finances...
examples.translation: 该报告建议对公共财政进行彻底改革。

examples.text: A former Finance Minister and five senior civil servants are accused of fraud.
examples.translation: 一名前财政大臣和五名高级公务员被指控诈骗。

examples.text: Be prepared for unexpected news concerning your finances...
examples.translation: 对财务上的意外状况要做到有备无患。

examples.text: In general, women manage the day-to-day finances but leave most longer-term decisions to men...
examples.translation: 通常，妇女管理日常财务，而把大多数较长期的决策交给男人。

examples.text: Finance is usually the biggest problem for students.
examples.translation: 经济问题通常是学生最大的问题。

meanings.meaning: 最终的；决定性的；不可更改的
决赛；期末考试；当日报纸的末版

examples.text: Astronauts will make a final attempt today to rescue a communications satellite from its useless orbit...
examples.translation: 今天宇航员将会做最后一次尝试,力图把一颗通信卫星从无效的轨道上抢救下来。

examples.text: This is the fifth and probably final day of testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee...
examples.translation: 今天是在参议院司法委员会作证的第5天，很可能也是最后一天。

examples.text: On the last Saturday in September, I received a final letter from Clive.
examples.translation: 9 月的最后一个星期六，我收到了克莱夫的最后一封信。

examples.text: You must have been on stage until the final curtain...
examples.translation: 你肯定在台上一直呆到了演出结束。

examples.text: The countdown to the Notting Hill Carnival is in its final hours.
examples.translation: 诺丁山狂欢节已经进入了最后几个小时的倒计时。

examples.text: Only a few go through the final humiliation of meeting the bailiff at the door.
examples.translation: 很少有人经受执达官上门的奇耻大辱。

examples.text: The judges' decision is final...
examples.translation: 法官的判决不可更改。

examples.text: The White House has the final say...
examples.translation: 白宫掌握着最后决定权。

examples.text: I'm not going, and that's final.
examples.translation: 我不会去，这我已经决定了。

examples.text: ...the Scottish Cup Final...
examples.translation: 苏格兰杯的决赛

examples.text: Pakistan's Jansher Khan has won the men's final at the Singapore Open.
examples.translation: 巴基斯坦的詹谢尔汗取得了新加坡公开赛男子决赛的胜利。

examples.text: Poland know they have a chance of qualifying for the World Cup Finals.
examples.translation: 波兰队知道他们有机会获得参加世界杯决赛的资格。

examples.text: Anna sat her finals in the summer.
examples.translation: 安娜在夏天参加了课程终结考试。

examples.text: The company is in financial difficulties.
examples.translation: 公司目前财政困难。

examples.text: ...the government's financial advisers.
examples.translation: 政府的财政顾问

examples.text: She would like to be more financially independent...
examples.translation: 她想在经济上更加独立。

examples.text: She's been struggling financially for years...
examples.translation: 她多年来一直生活拮据。

examples.text: Financially, things are a bit tight.
examples.translation: 经济上情况有点吃紧。

examples.text: One of the main findings of the survey was the confusion about the facilities already in place...
examples.translation: 这项调查的一个主要发现就是对于哪些设备已经到位搞不清楚。

examples.text: We hope that manufacturers will take note of the findings and improve their products accordingly.
examples.translation: 我们希望制造商能注意到这些结果，并对它们的产品作出相应的改进。

examples.text: The government hopes the court will announce its findings before the end of the month.
examples.translation: 政府希望法庭能在月底前宣布其判决结果。

examples.text: The police also found a pistol...
examples.translation: 警方还发现了一把手枪。

examples.text: They have spent ages looking at the map and can't find a trace of anywhere called Darrowby...
examples.translation: 他们对着地图细看了许久也没能找到那个叫达罗比的地方的影踪。

examples.text: I wonder if you could find me a deck of cards?
examples.translation: 不知您能否为我找一副纸牌？

examples.text: Many people here cannot find work...
examples.translation: 这里很多人都找不到工作。

examples.text: So far they have not found a way to fight the virus...
examples.translation: 迄今为止，他们还没有找到一种对抗该病毒的方法。

examples.text: He has to apply for a permit and we have to find him a job...
examples.translation: 他得申请一个许可证，而我们得给他找份工作。

examples.text: Does this mean that they haven't found a place for him?
examples.translation: 这是否意味着他们还没有给他寻着一个职位？

examples.text: Two thousand of France's 4,200 species of flowering plants are found in the park...
examples.translation: 法国的 4,200 种开花植物中有 2,000种可见于这个公园。

examples.text: Fibre is found in cereal foods, beans, fruit and vegetables.
examples.translation: 谷类食品、豆类、水果和蔬菜中含有纤维素。

examples.text: They found her walking alone and depressed on the beach...
examples.translation: 他们碰见她独自一人神色忧郁地走在海滩上。

examples.text: She returned to her east London home to find her back door forced open...
examples.translation: 她回到在伦敦东区的住所时发现后门被撬开了。

examples.text: Thrushes are a protected species so you will not find them on any menu.
examples.translation: 鸫鸟是受保护的物种，在菜谱上是找不到的。

examples.text: It's not the first time that you've found yourself in this situation...
examples.translation: 你陷入这种状况已经不是第一次了。

examples.text: I found myself having more fun than I had had in years...
examples.translation: 我发现自己这些年来从未像现在这样开心过。

examples.text: It all seemed so far away from here that he found himself quite unable to take it in.
examples.translation: 这事看起来好像发生在如此遥远的地方，他发现自己思想上一时难以接受。

examples.text: Daybreak found us on a cold, clammy ship...
examples.translation: 天亮时我们发现自己呆在一条冰冷黏湿的船上。

examples.text: His lunch did not take long to arrive and found him poring over a notepad covered with scrawls.
examples.translation: 不久午餐就送来了，当时他正埋头于一本满是潦草字迹的记事簿。

examples.text: The two biologists found, to their surprise, that both groups of birds survived equally well...
examples.translation: 这两位生物学家惊奇地发现，两组鸟都很好地存活了下来。

examples.text: At my age I would find it hard to get another job...
examples.translation: 到了我这个年纪自己就会发觉很难再找到一份工作了。

examples.text: We find her evidence to be based on a degree of oversensitivity...
examples.translation: 我们认识到她提供的证据在一定程度上是出于过分敏感。

examples.text: I've never found my diet a problem.
examples.translation: 我从未觉得自己的饮食有问题。

examples.text: She was found guilty of manslaughter and put on probation for two years...
examples.translation: 她被裁定过失杀人罪名成立，缓刑两年。

examples.text: When they found us guilty, I just went blank.
examples.translation: 当他们判定我们有罪时，我的脑子顿时一片空白。

examples.text: I find most of the young men of my own age so boring...
examples.translation: 我觉得和我同龄的年轻人大多都很无聊。

examples.text: We're sure you'll find it exciting!...
examples.translation: 我们保证你一定会认为这很刺激的！

examples.text: I find it ludicrous that nothing has been done to protect passengers from fire...
examples.translation: 乘客没有受到任何防火保护，这让我觉得十分荒唐。

examples.text: But you'd find him a good worker if you showed him what to do.
examples.translation: 但是只要教给他怎么做，就会发现他是个不错的员工。

examples.text: How could anyone find pleasure in hunting and killing this beautiful creature?...
examples.translation: 怎么会有人以猎杀这种美丽的动物为乐呢？

examples.text: I was too tired and frightened to find comfort in that familiar promise.
examples.translation: 我既疲惫又恐惧，就连那熟悉的承诺都无法让我感到安慰。

examples.text: I was just finding more time to write music...
examples.translation: 我刚刚找到了更多时间来作曲。

examples.text: My sister helped me find the money for a private operation.
examples.translation: 姐姐帮我筹集资金开办了一家私人企业。

examples.text: Another of his lucky finds was a pair of candle-holders...
examples.translation: 他的另一个幸运发现是一对烛台。

examples.text: His discovery was hailed as the botanical find of the century.
examples.translation: 他的发现被誉为本世纪植物学的最重大发现。

examples.text: He was an expert at finding his way, even in strange surroundings...
examples.translation: 他是认路的行家，即使在陌生的环境中也是如此。

examples.text: After a while I pulled myself to my feet and found my way to the street.
examples.translation: 过了一会儿我费力地站起身来，找到了那条大街。

examples.text: It is one of the very few Michelangelos that have found their way out of Italy...
examples.translation: 这是少数几件流传到意大利境外的米开朗琪罗作品之一。

examples.text: The most unlikely objects found their way into his design and look absolutely right where he placed them.
examples.translation: 那些最不可能的东西出现于他的设计中，并且在他的安排下显得恰得其所。

examples.text: It makes you want to watch the next episode to find out what's going to happen...
examples.translation: 这让人想要看下一集，弄清紧接着会发生什么事。

examples.text: I was relieved to find out that my problems were due to a genuine disorder...
examples.translation: 得知我的问题确实是由于病症引起的，我松了口气。

examples.text: Yesterday, the men's families held a news conference in their campaign to find out the truth...
examples.translation: 昨天，这些男子的家人举行了记者招待会，以发起查明真相的运动。

examples.text: As soon as we found this out, we closed the ward...
examples.translation: 我们一发现此事就关闭了病房。

examples.text: He began by reading everything he could find out about heroin.
examples.translation: 他从阅读所有能找到的有关海洛因的资料开始。

examples.text: Her face was so grave, I wondered for a moment if she'd found me out.
examples.translation: 她的表情如此严肃，我一时怀疑她是不是已经知道了我干的事。

meanings.meaning: 好的；优良的；细小的，精美的；健康的；晴朗的

examples.text: There is a fine view of the countryside...
examples.translation: 这里可以看到乡村的美景。

examples.text: This is a fine book.
examples.translation: 这是一本好书。

examples.text: ...London's finest art deco cinema.
examples.translation: 伦敦最杰出的装饰派艺术影院

examples.text: They are finely engineered boats.
examples.translation: 这些船只设计制造精良。

examples.text: Lina is fine and sends you her love and best wishes.
examples.translation: 莉娜身体很好，还让我转达她对你的爱和祝福。

examples.text: The skiing is fine...
examples.translation: 滑雪还行。

examples.text: Everything was going to be just fine...
examples.translation: 一切都会好起来的。

examples.text: It's fine to ask questions as we go along, but it's better if you wait until we have finished.
examples.translation: 中途可以提问，但最好是等到结束之后。

examples.text: All the instruments are working fine.
examples.translation: 所有仪器运行良好。

examples.text: If competition is the best way to achieve it, then, fine...
examples.translation: 如果竞争是达到目标的最佳方式，那就这么着吧。

examples.text: If you don't want to give it to me, that's fine, I don't mind...
examples.translation: 如果你不想把它给我，那可以，我不介意。

examples.text: 'It'll take me a couple of days.' — 'That's fine with me.'
examples.translation: “这得花上我两三天的时间。”——“我这儿没问题。”

examples.text: The heat scorched the fine hairs on her arms...
examples.translation: 炙热烤焦了她手臂上的汗毛。

examples.text: The ship has come to rest on the fine sand.
examples.translation: 这艘船停靠在细沙滩上。

examples.text: Chop the ingredients finely and mix them together.
examples.translation: 把原料细细剁碎后和在一起。

examples.text: That fineness of the tip is what controls the resolution of the image.
examples.translation: 笔尖的细度决定图像的分辨率。

examples.text: We waited in our fine clothes...
examples.translation: 我们身着盛装等候。

examples.text: She'll wear fine jewellery wherever she goes.
examples.translation: 无论到哪儿她都会佩戴精美的首饰。

examples.text: The market likes the broad outline but is reserving judgment on the fine detail.
examples.translation: 市场对这一整体设想表示出认可，但在具体细节上还未作出反应。

examples.text: They had to take the finely balanced decision to let the visit proceed...
examples.translation: 他们不得不在经过仔细权衡后作出让访问继续下去的决定。

examples.text: This is a fast-moving but finely observed drama.
examples.translation: 这是一部节奏紧凑但是观察入微的剧。

examples.text: ...a sense of quality and fineness of detail.
examples.translation: 对品质的注重与对细节的考究

examples.text: I was with fine people doing a good job...
examples.translation: 我和高尚的人们一起干着一份不错的工作。

examples.text: He was an excellent journalist and a very fine man.
examples.translation: 他是位杰出的记者，为人也非常正派。

examples.text: He might be doing a spot of gardening if the weather is fine.
examples.translation: 天气晴朗的话，他也许会侍弄侍弄花草。

examples.text: She was fined £500 and banned from driving for one month...
examples.translation: 她被罚款500 英镑，而且一个月内禁止开车。

examples.text: An east London school has set a precedent by fining pupils who break the rules.
examples.translation: 伦敦东区的一所学校开创了对违反校规的学生处以罚金的先例。

examples.text: She suddenly held up a small, bony finger and pointed across the room...
examples.translation: 她突然伸出一根瘦小的手指，指向屋子的另一头。

examples.text: She ran her fingers through her hair...
examples.translation: 她用手指捋了捋头发。

examples.text: There was a ring on each of his fingers.
examples.translation: 他每个手指上都戴着枚戒指。

examples.text: ...a thin finger of land that separates Pakistan from the former Soviet Union...
examples.translation: 分隔巴基斯坦和苏联的一块狭长地带

examples.text: Cover the base with a single layer of sponge fingers.
examples.translation: 底部垫上一层海棉条。

examples.text: He fingered the few coins in his pocket...
examples.translation: 他拨弄着口袋里的几枚硬币。

examples.text: Self-consciously she fingered the emeralds at her throat.
examples.translation: 她局促不安地摸抚着脖子上的绿宝石。

examples.text: Police and prosecutors manipulated the eyewitnesses so they would finger Aldo...
examples.translation: 警方和检察官操纵目击证人指证奥尔多。

examples.text: People who have fingered crack houses and fingered drug dealers have been assassinated.
examples.translation: 那些告发可卡因毒窟和毒品贩子的人遭到了暗杀。

examples.text: I poured two final fingers of bourbon into my glass.
examples.translation: 我把最后两指宽的波旁威士忌都倒进自己杯中。

examples.text: He has had his fingers burnt by deals that turned out badly...
examples.translation: 几笔糟糕的生意让他吃了苦头。

examples.text: Mr Walesa burned his fingers by promising he would give every Pole 100m zlotys to start a business.
examples.translation: 瓦文萨先生因为承诺给每个波兰人1亿兹罗提创办企业而尝到了苦果。

examples.text: He crossed his fingers, asking for luck for the first time in his life...
examples.translation: 他交叉手指，生平第一次祈求好运。

examples.text: I'm keeping my fingers crossed that they turn up soon.
examples.translation: 我在心里祈求他们赶快露面。

examples.text: I must make it clear I never laid a finger on her.
examples.translation: 我得说清楚，我可没有动过她一根毫毛。

examples.text: She never lifted a finger around the house...
examples.translation: 家里的活儿她从来一点忙都不帮。

examples.text: They will not lift a finger to help their country.
examples.translation: 他们不愿为自己的国家出一点儿力。

examples.text: He very much likes to have a finger in every pie...
examples.translation: 他很喜欢什么事都插上一杠。

examples.text: He's a man with fingers in a lot of pies.
examples.translation: 他这个人总是到处管闲事。

examples.text: He said he wasn't pointing an accusing finger at anyone in the government or the army.
examples.translation: 他说他并不是在指责政府或军方的任何人。

examples.text: Forensic evidence points the finger of suspicion firmly at him.
examples.translation: 法医的证据将怀疑的矛头明确地指向了他。

examples.text: Isn't it about time that you pulled your finger out?
examples.translation: 现在到了你该赶紧动起来的时候了吧？

examples.text: Midge couldn't quite put her finger on the reason...
examples.translation: 米吉还不能十分确定原因何在。

examples.text: He could never quite put his finger on who or what was responsible for all this.
examples.translation: 他一直就搞不清楚是谁或者什么造成了这一切。

examples.text: Money has slipped through his fingers all his life...
examples.translation: 他这一辈子都没能抓住金钱。

examples.text: You mustn't allow a golden opportunity to slip through your fingers or you will regret it later.
examples.translation: 千万别错失良机，否则日后追悔莫及。

examples.text: As soon as he'd finished eating, he excused himself...
examples.translation: 他一吃完就告辞离开了。

examples.text: Mr Gould was given a standing ovation and loud cheers when he finished his speech...
examples.translation: 古尔德先生结束演讲后，全场起立鼓掌并热烈欢呼。

examples.text: I've practically finished the ironing.
examples.translation: 我差不多已经熨完了。

examples.text: We waited a few minutes outside his office while he finished up his meeting.
examples.translation: 我们在他办公室外等他结束会议等了几分钟。

examples.text: The consultants had been working to finish a report this week.
examples.translation: 顾问们一直在为要于本周内完成一份报告而工作。

examples.text: Now she is busy finishing off a biography of Queen Caroline.
examples.translation: 现在她正忙着完成卡罗琳王后的传记。

examples.text: ...the amount of stuff required to finish up a movie.
examples.translation: 拍摄完一部影片所需要的大量东西

examples.text: The teaching day finishes at around 4pm...
examples.translation: 一天的教学在下午4点左右结束。

examples.text: When a play finishes its run, many of the costumes are hired out to amateur dramatics companies and schools.
examples.translation: 一部戏剧连演结束后，很多服装都会租借给业余剧团和学校。

examples.text: The two of them finished by kissing each other goodbye...
examples.translation: 他们两人最后互相吻别。

examples.text: The evening finished with the welcoming of three new members...
examples.translation: 晚会的最后是欢迎3个新成员。

examples.text: A buggy ferries you down to the main restaurant to finish the evening with a dance on the beach...
examples.translation: 一辆轻便马车将把你送到主餐厅，以沙滩上的一支舞结束这个晚上。

examples.text: The American dollar finished the day up against foreign currencies...
examples.translation: 美元汇率今日收盘时有所上涨。

examples.text: The last track finishes this compilation beautifully.
examples.translation: 整张选辑在最后一曲优美的旋律中结束。

examples.text: He finished second in the championship four years in a row.
examples.translation: 他连续4年获得锦标赛亚军。

examples.text: Her eyes flashed, but he held up a hand. 'Let me finish.'
examples.translation: 她眼光一闪，但他举起一只手说：“让我把话讲完。”

examples.text: I intend to continue it and see the job through to the finish...
examples.translation: 我打算继续下去，直到工作彻底完成。

examples.text: From start to finish he believed in me, often more than I did myself.
examples.translation: 他自始至终都相信我，而且时常超过我对自己的信任。

examples.text: Win a trip to see the finish of the Tour de France!...
examples.translation: 赢得观看环法自行车赛最后阶段比赛之旅！

examples.text: The replays of the close finish showed Ottey finished ahead of the Olympic champion.
examples.translation: 对难分先后的冲线镜头的回放显示奥蒂先于奥运冠军到达终点。

examples.text: The finish and workmanship of the woodwork was excellent.
examples.translation: 这件木工品的抛光和做工均属上乘。

examples.text: The conflict in the North and East of the island was a fight to the finish.
examples.translation: 该岛北部和东部的冲突是一场你死我活的斗争。

examples.text: Right up until the last minute, workers were still putting the finishing touches on the pavilions...
examples.translation: 直到最后一刻，工人们仍在对展馆进行最后的修饰。

examples.text: The only finishing touch most of these puddings need is a custard sauce.
examples.translation: 这些布丁大部分只需要用蛋奶沙司最后点缀一下。

examples.text: Kelly finished off his coffee...
examples.translation: 凯利喝光了他的咖啡。

examples.text: He took the bottle from her hands and finished it off in one long swallow.
examples.translation: 他从她手里夺过瓶子，一饮而尽。

examples.text: They meant to finish her off, swiftly and without mercy.
examples.translation: 他们打算毫不留情地迅速结果了她。

examples.text: They had met by chance at university and finished up getting married...
examples.translation: 他们在大学偶遇，最后结了婚。

examples.text: He's probably going to finish up in jail for business fraud.
examples.translation: 他最后很可能会因为商业诈骗而入狱。

examples.text: Finish up your drinks now, please.
examples.translation: 请现在喝完。

examples.text: My boyfriend was threatening to finish with me...
examples.translation: 男友威胁说要和我分手。

examples.text: 'Have you finished with me?' Luke asked, when he had listened to Armstrong's report of his evidence.
examples.translation: “你已经都问完我了吗?”卢克听完阿姆斯特朗向自己重述的证词后问道。

examples.text: ...a finite set of elements...
examples.translation: 有限元素集

examples.text: Only a finite number of situations can arise...
examples.translation: 只有有限的几种情况可能会发生。

examples.text: The fossil fuels (coal and oil) are finite resources.
examples.translation: 化石燃料(如煤和石油)属于有限资源。

meanings.meaning: 消防队员；救火队员；锅炉工

examples.text: When your house is burning down, you don't care about where your fireman goes to church.
Have a nightcap curled up before the lodge's giant stone fireplace and call it a day.

meanings.meaning: 坚定的；牢固的；严格的；结实的

examples.text: The firm's employees were expecting large bonuses.
examples.translation: 这家公司的雇员期待着发放大笔奖金。

examples.text: ...a firm of heating engineers.
examples.translation: 供暖工程公司

examples.text: Fruit should be firm and in excellent condition...
examples.translation: 水果应该硬实完好。

examples.text: Choose a soft, medium or firm mattress to suit their individual needs.
examples.translation: 针对他们各人不同的需要挑选柔软、软硬适中或者坚硬的床垫。

examples.text: Vegetables should retain some firmness and should not be soggy and waterlogged.
examples.translation: 蔬菜应保持一定的硬挺度，不应潮乎乎的浸透了水。

examples.text: If you have to climb up, use a firm platform or a sturdy ladder.
examples.translation: 如果非要爬上去，就踩在一个稳固的台子上或者找把结实的梯子。

examples.text: The front door is locked and all the windows are firmly shut.
examples.translation: 前门锁上了，所有窗户都关严了。

examples.text: The quick handshake was firm and cool...
examples.translation: 短暂的握手有力沉稳。

examples.text: He managed to grasp the metal, get a firm grip of it and heave his body upwards.
examples.translation: 他设法牢牢抓住了那个金属物，把整个身子往上提。

examples.text: he held me firmly by the elbow and led me to my aisle seat.
examples.translation: 他紧紧抓住我的胳膊肘，把我领到靠过道的座位上。

examples.text: Tim stretched out a hand in apology and was comforted by the firmness with which Marc gripped it.
examples.translation: 蒂姆伸出手来表示道歉，而马克紧紧地握住了它，这令蒂姆安下了心。

examples.text: She had to be firm with him. 'I don't want to see you again.'...
examples.translation: 她不得不对他狠下心来：“我不想再见到你。”

examples.text: Perhaps they need the guiding hand of a firm father figure.
examples.translation: 也许他们需要一个父亲般严格的指引者。

examples.text: 'A good night's sleep is what you want,' he said firmly.
examples.translation: “你现在需要好好睡一晚上，”他不容分辩地说。

examples.text: ...a manner that combines friendliness with compassion and firmness.
examples.translation: 兼具友善、怜悯与坚定的态度

examples.text: He made a firm decision to leave Fort Multry by boat...
examples.translation: 他打定主意乘船离开穆尔特里堡。

examples.text: It is my firm belief that an effective partnership approach between police and the public is absolutely necessary.
examples.translation: 我坚信警民之间进行有效合作是绝对必要的。

examples.text: Political values and opinions are firmly held, and can be slow to change...
examples.translation: 政治价值观和政见根深蒂固，要改变可能得花上很长时间。

examples.text: He is firmly convinced that it is vital to do this.
examples.translation: 他坚信做这件事至关重要。

examples.text: What's impressed me has been his considerable firmness of purpose.
examples.translation: 令我印象深刻的是他对目标的坚定不移。

examples.text: This man may have killed others but unfortunately we have no firm evidence...
examples.translation: 这名男子可能还杀害过其他人，只可惜我们没有确凿的证据。

examples.text: There's unlikely to be firm news about the convoy's progress for some time.
examples.translation: 一段时间内都不大可能会有关于车队行进情况的确切消息。

examples.text: Although the Yakutians are a minority, they have firm control of the territory...
examples.translation: 尽管雅库特人是少数民族，但他们却牢牢地掌控着这块版图。

examples.text: The company, a household name in the States, has a firm foothold in the British market.
examples.translation: 这家美国国内家喻户晓的公司在英国市场上站稳了脚跟。

examples.text: This tradition is also firmly rooted in the past...
examples.translation: 这个传统同样深深地植根于过去。

examples.text: It placed reggae music firmly in the mainstream of world culture.
examples.translation: 它使得雷鬼音乐在世界主流文化中占据了不可动摇的一席之地。

examples.text: The couple met about two years ago and soon became firm friends.
examples.translation: 这对夫妇大约两年前相遇，很快就成了知交。

examples.text: Cotton prices remain firm and demand is strong...
examples.translation: 棉花价格始终保持坚挺，需求旺盛。

examples.text: The shares held firm at 280p...
examples.translation: 股价稳稳地维持在280便士。

examples.text: Firm prices and stability will allow both producers and consumers to plan confidently.
examples.translation: 价格的居高不下和市场的稳定将使制造商与消费者都能满怀信心地制订计划。

examples.text: ...the firmness of the dollar against other currencies.
examples.translation: 美元对其他货币的坚挺

examples.text: Firm more soil over the roots and water thoroughly.
examples.translation: 在根上再多培些土，用水浇透。

examples.text: The council is standing firm against the barrage of protest...
examples.translation: 委员会面对接二连三的抗议拒不让步。

examples.text: The President has appealed to his European partners to stand firm on the issue.
examples.translation: 总统已经呼吁其欧洲伙伴在此问题上站稳立场。

examples.text: This treatment helps tone the body, firm up muscles and tighten the skin...
examples.translation: 该治疗有助于强身健体、紧致皮肤。

examples.text: I now go swimming five times a week, which helps firm me up...
examples.translation: 我现在每周游5次泳，这对强身健体很有益处。

examples.text: The mixture will seem too wet at this stage, but it will firm up when chilled.
examples.translation: 混合物在此阶段看起来会非常湿，但冷却后就会坚硬起来。

examples.text: Looking to the future, the Government will firm up their plans for a cleaner, greener, safer Britain...
examples.translation: 展望未来，政府将更加明确其计划，建设一个更清洁、更环保、更安全的英国。

examples.text: The ground rules have been firmed up...
examples.translation: 基本原则已得到进一步强化。

examples.text: At least the bank situation had firmed up.
examples.translation: 至少银行的形势已经更加明朗了。

examples.text: OPEC has agreed to freeze its global oil production slightly in order to firm up crude prices.
examples.translation: 石油输出国组织已同意对全球石油生产稍加冻结，以稳定原油价格。

examples.text: She lost 16 pounds in the first month of her diet.
examples.translation: 她节食的头一个月就减掉了16磅。

examples.text: ...the first few flakes of snow...
examples.translation: 初落的几片雪花

examples.text: Two years ago Johnson came first in the one hundred metres at Seoul.
examples.translation: 两年前约翰逊在首尔获得100米短跑冠军。

examples.text: The second paragraph startled me even more than the first...
examples.translation: 第二段比第一段更让我吃惊。

examples.text: He put me through a series of exercises to improve my car control. The first was to drive on simulated ice.
examples.translation: 他让我进行一系列的练习以提高我的控车能力。第一项就是在模拟冰面上驾车。

examples.text: I do not remember who spoke first, but we all expressed the same opinion...
examples.translation: 我不记得是谁最先发言的，但我们全都表达了相同的看法。

examples.text: First, tell me what you think of my products...
examples.translation: 先谈谈你觉得我的产品怎么样吧。

examples.text: Routine questions first, if you don't mind.
examples.translation: 如果不介意的话，请先回答一些例行问题吧。

examples.text: This is the first time she has experienced disappointment...
examples.translation: 这是她第一次感受到失望。

examples.text: It was the first occasion when they had both found it possible to keep a rendezvous.
examples.translation: 他们两人都能赴约，这还是头一遭。

examples.text: Anne and Steve got engaged two years after they had first started going out...
examples.translation: 在第一次约会两年后，安妮和史蒂夫订婚了。

examples.text: I met him first at his house where we had a chat.
examples.translation: 我初次见他是在他家里，当时我们聊了一会儿。

examples.text: It is a first for New York. An outdoor exhibition of Fernando Botero's sculpture on Park Avenue.
examples.translation: 在公园大道上露天展出费尔南多·博特罗的雕塑，这在纽约还是破天荒的事。

examples.text: We heard it on the TV last night — that was the first we heard of it...
examples.translation: 昨晚我们在电视上听到了这件事——那是我们头回听说。

examples.text: When Mark arrived home that afternoon, it was the first he knew for sure of the surprise party.
examples.translation: 马克那天下午回到家时是他第一次确切知道有惊喜派对这回事。

examples.text: When he first came home he wouldn't say anything about what he'd been doing.
examples.translation: 刚回到家时，他只字不提自己一直在做什么。

examples.text: She told him that her first reaction was disgust...
examples.translation: 她告诉他自己的第一反应是厌恶。

examples.text: My first feeling on getting into the cabin was one of dislike for everything I saw.
examples.translation: 我走进小木屋时的最初感觉是眼前的东西我都不喜欢。

examples.text: Marry that fat son of a fat cattle dealer? She would die first!
examples.translation: 嫁给那个大腹便便的牛贩子的胖儿子？她宁愿去死！

examples.text: Certain guidelines can be given. First, have a heating engineer check the safety of the system.
examples.translation: 可以提供一些指导原则：第一，找位供暖工程师检查系统的安全性。

examples.text: Before him, in the first row, sat the President...
examples.translation: 在他面前第一排坐着总统。

examples.text: First in the queue were two Japanese students.
examples.translation: 队伍最前面是两个日本学生。

examples.text: The first duty of any government must be to protect the interests of the taxpayers...
examples.translation: 任何政府的首要职责都必须是保护纳税人的利益。

examples.text: Imagine winning the local lottery first prize of £5,000.
examples.translation: 想象一下中个5,000英镑的当地彩票头奖吧。

examples.text: ...first team football.
examples.translation: 一线队足球

examples.text: ...the First Lord of the Admiralty.
examples.translation: 海军大臣

examples.text: ...the first mate of a British tanker.
examples.translation: 一艘英国油轮的大副

examples.text: ...an Oxford Blue who took a First in Constitutional History.
examples.translation: 获得宪法史优等学位的牛津大学校队运动员

examples.text: The cut in the interest rates has not had very much impact in California for two reasons. First of all, banks are still afraid to loan.
examples.translation: 降息在加利福尼亚并未产生多大影响，原因有二。首先，银行仍然不敢放贷。

examples.text: At first, he seemed surprised by my questions...
examples.translation: 起初，他似乎对我的问题感到惊讶。

examples.text: I had some difficulty at first recalling why we were there.
examples.translation: 刚开始回想我们为什么会在那儿时我有些费劲。

examples.text: There's no time for boyfriends, my career comes first.
examples.translation: 我没时间交男朋友，事业对我来说是第一位的。

examples.text: There will be five buses, first come first served.
examples.translation: 会有5辆巴士，先到先上。

examples.text: You knew about me from the first, didn't you?...
examples.translation: 从一开始你就知道我，对吧？

examples.text: I thought from the first that she was a little unsure about that marriage.
examples.translation: 从一开始我就觉得她对那桩婚事心里没底。

examples.text: He arrived in Natal to see at first hand the effects of the recent heavy fighting.
examples.translation: 他来到纳塔尔亲自了解最近发生的激烈冲突造成的后果。

examples.text: You don't know the first thing about farming.
examples.translation: 你对种地一窍不通。

examples.text: First off, huge apologies for last month's confusing report.
examples.translation: 首先，要对上个月那篇交代不清的报道表示深深的歉意。

examples.text: Somebody has to think for the child and put him first.
examples.translation: 必须有人替孩子着想，把他放在第一位。

examples.text: Let's see if we can't find something to set the mood. First things first; some music.
examples.translation: 看看我们能不能找点什么烘托一下气氛。当务之急：来点音乐吧。

examples.text: I was chatting to an islander who had just caught a fish...
examples.translation: 我正在跟一个刚刚抓到一条鱼的岛民聊天。

examples.text: The fish were counted and an average weight recorded.
examples.translation: 数了数鱼的数量，并把平均重量记录了下来。

examples.text: Does dry white wine go best with fish?
examples.translation: 吃鱼时喝干白葡萄酒是最佳选择吗？

examples.text: Brian remembers learning to fish in the River Cam.
examples.translation: 布赖恩记得曾在剑河学过钓鱼。

examples.text: On Saturday we fished the River Arno.
examples.translation: 周六我们在阿尔诺河钓鱼。

examples.text: He didn't want to create the impression that he was fishing for information...
examples.translation: 他不想让人觉得自己是在套话。

examples.text: She may be fishing for a compliment and welcome your reassurance...
examples.translation: 她也许是在拐弯抹角地想获得称赞，希望得到你的肯定。

examples.text: 'Lucinda, you don't have to talk to him!' Mike shouted. 'He's just fishing.'
examples.translation: “露辛达，你没必要跟他说话!”迈克叫道，“他不过是在打探消息。”

examples.text: I think he thought of himself as a country gentleman and was like a fish out of water in Birmingham.
examples.translation: 我想他认为自己是一名乡绅，在伯明翰就如离水之鱼一般浑身不自在。

examples.text: Kelly fished out another beer from his cooler...
examples.translation: 凯莉从他的冷藏箱里又拿出一瓶啤酒。

examples.text: She fished out a pair of David's socks for her cold feet.
examples.translation: 她找出一双戴维的袜子穿在了冰冷的脚上。

examples.text: He'd been a fisherman all his life and was familiar with the fury of the sea.

meanings.meaning: 拳，拳头；〈口〉笔迹；掌握；[印]指标参见号

examples.text: Angry protestors with clenched fists shouted their defiance...
examples.translation: 愤怒的抗议者们紧握拳头大声抗议。

examples.text: Gary clutched a penny in his fist.
examples.translation: 加里将一枚便士攥在手中。

examples.text: The iron-fist policy towards the fundamentalists is unlikely to be interrupted.
examples.translation: 对原教旨主义者采取的铁拳政策不可能中止。

meanings.meaning: 火；火灾；炮火；炉火；热情；激情；磨难
点燃；解雇；开除；使发光；烧制；激动；放枪
着火；射击；开枪；激动；烧火

examples.text: They saw a big flash and a huge ball of fire reaching hundreds of feet into the sky...
examples.translation: 他们看见一道强光和一个巨大的火球冲向数百英尺的高空。

examples.text: Many students were trapped by smoke and fire on an upper floor.
examples.translation: 许多学生被浓烟和大火困在了较高的一层上。

examples.text: 87 people died in a fire at the Happy Land Social Club...
examples.translation: 87 人在乐土社交俱乐部的火灾中丧生。

examples.text: A forest fire is sweeping across portions of north Maine this evening...
examples.translation: 今晚一场森林大火正席卷缅因州北部的部分地区。

examples.text: Much of historic Rennes was destroyed by fire in 1720.
examples.translation: 雷恩古城的大部分在 1720 年的大火中毁于一旦。

examples.text: There was a fire in the grate...
examples.translation: 壁炉内燃着火。

examples.text: After the killing, he calmly lit a fire to destroy evidence.
examples.translation: 杀人后，他镇定地点起火销毁罪证。

examples.text: The gas fire was still alight...
examples.translation: 燃气取暖器还在烧着。

examples.text: She switched on one bar of the electric fire.
examples.translation: 她打开了一片电暖器。

examples.text: After the pot is dipped in this mixture, it is fired...
examples.translation: 陶罐在这一混合料中浸过之后就拿去烧制。

examples.text: I have watched the potters mold, fire and paint their bowls, plates and vases with sacred designs.
examples.translation: 我见过制陶工人捏塑、烧制碗碟花瓶，并在上面涂绘各种宗教图案。

examples.text: When soft woods are used for the firing, the clay turns dark from the smoke.
examples.translation: 用软木烧制时，黏土会被烟雾熏暗。

examples.text: The engine fired and we moved off.
examples.translation: 点着引擎后我们就开走了。

examples.text: The engines were fired with coal and needed water to keep the steam up.
examples.translation: 这些发动机烧煤，并且需要加水以不断产生蒸汽。

examples.text: ...the potential to fire the imagination of an entire generation...
examples.translation: 能够激发整整一代人想象力的潜能

examples.text: It was Allen who fired this rivalry with real passion...
examples.translation: 是艾伦为这场较量注入了激情。

examples.text: Both his grandfathers were fired with an enthusiasm for public speaking...
examples.translation: 他的祖父和外公都热衷于演说。

examples.text: By Monday, Senor Menem had returned, apparently fired with new determination.
examples.translation: 到星期一时梅嫩先生已经回来了，显然他又燃起了新的决心。

examples.text: I went to hear him speak and was very impressed. He seemed so full of fire...
examples.translation: 我去听了他的讲话，结果留下了非常深刻的印象。他看上去充满了激情。

examples.text: His punishing schedule seemed to dim his fire at times.
examples.translation: 繁忙的日程似乎有时让他精力不济。

examples.text: My home catches fire and everything is destroyed...
examples.translation: 我家失了火，所有的东西都烧毁了。

examples.text: The aircraft caught fire soon after take-off.
examples.translation: 飞机起飞后不久就着火了。

examples.text: The play only really catches fire once Aschenbach falls in love.
examples.translation: 这部剧直到阿申巴赫堕入情网后才真正开始精彩起来。

examples.text: The only way they can deal with crime is to fight fire with fire.
examples.translation: 他们打击犯罪的唯一方法就是以牙还牙。

examples.text: Rocco does not have the same fire in his belly as his father.
examples.translation: 罗科不像他父亲那样充满激情。

examples.text: The captain radioed that the ship was on fire.
examples.translation: 船长发无线电说船着火了。

examples.text: He was on fire with this marvelous sight.
examples.translation: 看到这一令人叹为观止的景象，他激动万分。

examples.text: Schulte warned government and industrial leaders that those who even venture to think about mass layoffs are playing with fire.
examples.translation: 舒尔特警告政府和业界领袖说，哪怕只是动动大规模裁员念头的人都是在玩火。

examples.text: They set fire to vehicles outside that building...
examples.translation: 他们纵火焚烧了停在那幢大楼外的车辆。

examples.text: Lightning set several buildings on fire.
examples.translation: 闪电燃着了几栋大楼。

examples.text: Put on a helmet, fire up your engine and head out on the open road.
examples.translation: 戴上头盔，发动引擎，开上乡村干道。

examples.text: The president knows his task is to fire up the delegates.
examples.translation: 总统知道自己的任务就是唤起代表的热情。

examples.text: Seven people were wounded when soldiers fired rubber bullets to disperse crowds...
examples.translation: 士兵发射橡皮子弹驱散人群时有7个人受了伤。

examples.text: New guns firing high explosive shells were incorporated into the battlefield...
examples.translation: 发射高爆弹的新型大炮在战场上得到了使用。

examples.text: The gun was fired and Beaton was wounded a second time...
examples.translation: 枪响了，比顿再次受伤。

examples.text: Seventeen people were killed when security forces fired on demonstrators...
examples.translation: 安全部队朝示威者开枪致使 17 人丧生。

examples.text: They were firing. I screamed at them to stop.
examples.translation: 他们正在开枪。我尖叫着，让他们停下。

examples.text: They were under constant firing from the guns...
examples.translation: 他们遭到枪林弹雨的不间断攻击。

examples.text: The firing continued even while the protestors were fleeing.
examples.translation: 甚至在抗议者逃离的时候，枪击仍在继续。

examples.text: His car was raked with fire from automatic weapons...
examples.translation: 他的车遭到自动武器火力的扫射。

examples.text: The two were reportedly killed in an exchange of fire during a police raid.
examples.translation: 据报道，这两人在警方突击搜查时发生的交火中被打死。

examples.text: He fired an arrow into a clearing in the forest.
examples.translation: 他将箭射向林中的一片空地。

examples.text: They were bombarded by more than 100 representatives firing questions on pollution.
examples.translation: 100多名代表针对污染问题向他们发起连珠炮似的提问。

examples.text: He said they should turn their fire on the Conservative Party instead.
examples.translation: 他说他们应该掉转枪口，向保守党开火。

examples.text: Crowds elsewhere drew fire from troops.
examples.translation: 其他地方的人群吸引了军队的火力。

examples.text: The council recently drew fire for its intervention in the dispute...
examples.translation: 委员会最近因为介入该起争端而遭到批评。

examples.text: The campaign is drawing fire from anti-smoking advocates.
examples.translation: 该活动正受到禁烟倡导者的攻击。

examples.text: All I can suggest is that you just hang fire and wait a minute or two and try again...
examples.translation: 我的建议就是，先缓一缓，等上一两分钟再试一次。

examples.text: Last week, banks and building societies were hanging fire on interest rates.
examples.translation: 上周，银行和建屋互助会推迟了就利率问题作出决定。

examples.text: Devereux ordered his men to hold their fire until the ships got closer.
examples.translation: 德弗罗命令士兵等船靠近了再开火。

examples.text: Observers reckon the Bank of England will hold fire until nearer the Budget.
examples.translation: 观察家认为英格兰银行会推迟到更加接近预算案出台时再采取措施。

examples.text: He cheerfully blows away any bad guy stupid enough to get in his line of fire...
examples.translation: 他兴高采烈地将蠢到撞上他枪口的坏家伙全都干掉。

examples.text: The man and his son had been pushed into the line of fire by their captors.
examples.translation: 父子俩被那些掳走他们的人推到了枪口前。

examples.text: Then without warning, the troops opened fire on the crowd.
examples.translation: 接着军队未作警示便向人群开了火。

examples.text: The soldiers returned fire after being attacked.
examples.translation: 士兵们在遇袭后予以还击。

examples.text: The Belgians fell back as the infantry came under fire.
examples.translation: 步兵团受到火力攻击时比利时人向后撤退。

examples.text: ...sending aid to cities which have been under fire for weeks now.
examples.translation: 向那些现已连续数周遭受炮火袭击的城市提供援助

examples.text: The president's plan first came under fire from critics who said he hadn't included enough spending cuts.
examples.translation: 总统的计划先是遭到批评者的猛烈抨击，他们称开支削减力度不够。

examples.text: 'May I ask you something?' — 'Sure. Fire away.'
examples.translation: “我可以问你一个问题吗？”——“当然可以。尽管问吧。”

examples.text: A gunman fired off a volley of shots into the air...
examples.translation: 持枪歹徒朝天扫射了一排子弹。

examples.text: Cecil now began to panic and fired off two distress rockets.
examples.translation: 塞西尔此时开始慌张起来,连忙发射了两枚遇险信号火箭。

examples.text: ...an illustration of a guy firing a huge cannon off into the distance.
examples.translation: 描绘某人向远处发射巨型大炮的插图

examples.text: He immediately fired off an angry letter to his ministry colleagues...
examples.translation: 他立即给部里的同事发了一封怒气冲冲的信。

examples.text: Ordinary officers fired off a string of angry demands to the government, to improve their pay, status, and conditions.
examples.translation: 普通警员愤怒地向政府提出了一连串增加工资、提高地位和改善条件的要求。

examples.text: If he hadn't been so good at the rest of his job, I probably would have fired him...
examples.translation: 如果不是因为他在工作的其他方面做得如此之好，我可能就把他开除了。

examples.text: She was sent a box of chocolates along with a letter saying she was fired.
examples.translation: 她收到一盒巧克力和一封信，信上说她被解雇了。

examples.text: There was yet another round of firings.
examples.translation: 还会有新一轮的裁员。

examples.text: ...brass light fittings.
examples.translation: 黄铜灯具配件

examples.text: ...industrial fittings for kitchen and bathroom...
examples.translation: 工业化生产的厨卫零配件

examples.text: He has made fittings for antique cars.
examples.translation: 他给老式汽车制作过配件。

examples.text: A solitary man, it was perhaps fitting that he should have died alone...
examples.translation: 他是个离群索居的人，孤独地死去也许正得其所。

examples.text: The President's address was a fitting end to a bitter campaign.
examples.translation: 总统的讲话为一场激烈的竞选运动适时画上了句号。

examples.text: ...a fittingly eccentric figure.
examples.translation: 相称的怪人

examples.text: ...the four-storeyed, and fittingly named, High House...
examples.translation: 名实相符的被称为“高屋”的四层建筑

examples.text: Fittingly, she will spend her year off training her voice to sing blues and jazz.
examples.translation: 恰好她要休息一年，用来练唱蓝调和爵士乐。

examples.text: She lunched and shopped and went for fittings for clothes she didn't need.
examples.translation: 她吃完午饭后去购物,试穿了一些她并不需要的衣服。

meanings.meaning: 安装；使……适应；使……合身；与……相符
健康的；合适的；恰当的；准备好的

examples.text: The sash, kimono, and other garments were made to fit a child...
examples.translation: 腰带、和服和其他衣服都是儿童款的。

examples.text: She has to go to the men's department to find trousers that fit at the waist...
examples.translation: 她得去男装部找一条腰围合适的裤子。

examples.text: Line a tin with lightly-greased greaseproof paper, making sure the corners fit well.
examples.translation: 把稍稍上油的防油纸衬在罐子内部，确保各角都铺平整。

examples.text: Eventually he was happy that the sills and doors were a reasonably good fit.
examples.translation: 门槛和门扇算是贴合良好，他终于开心了。

examples.text: She was being fitted for her wedding dress.
examples.translation: 她正在试穿婚纱。

examples.text: ...a pocket computer which is small enough to fit into your pocket...
examples.translation: 小得能够放进衣袋里的袖珍电脑

examples.text: He folded his long legs to fit under the table...
examples.translation: 他把两条长腿蜷起来伸进桌下。

examples.text: The crowd was too large to fit inside the hall.
examples.translation: 人太多了，大厅里容不下。

examples.text: ...filters are available that fit over the lens of suitable cameras.
examples.translation: 现有可以安在合适相机镜头上的滤镜。

examples.text: She fitted her key in the lock...
examples.translation: 她把钥匙插进锁孔。

examples.text: Who could cut the millions of stone blocks and fit them together?...
examples.translation: 谁能切割出这数百万块的石块，再把它们堆叠起来呢？

examples.text: When the crown has been made you go back and the dentist will fit it into place.
examples.translation: 人造牙冠做好后再去，牙医会把它安上。

examples.text: Fit hinge bolts to give extra support to the door lock...
examples.translation: 安上铰链插销，让门锁更牢靠。

examples.text: Peter had built the overhead ladders, and the next day he fitted them to the wall...
examples.translation: 彼得已经搭好了攀爬横梯，第二天便把它们安在了墙上。

examples.text: Home spas or mini whirlpools massage and relax, and can be fitted into the bath.
examples.translation: 家庭热水澡桶或是小型涡流浴缸能够按摩并放松身体，可以安装在浴室中。

examples.text: Her daughter doesn't fit the current feminine ideal...
examples.translation: 她女儿并不符合当今的完美女性标准。

examples.text: Fostering is a full-time job and you should carefully consider how it will fit into your career...
examples.translation: 抚养孩子是全天候的事，应该仔细考虑如何将它与事业协调起来。

examples.text: There's something about the way he talks of her that doesn't fit.
examples.translation: 他谈论她的样子有点不对劲。

examples.text: The punishment must always fit the crime.
examples.translation: 必须始终坚持罪罚相当的原则。

examples.text: Of the seven bicycles we had, only two were fit for the road.
examples.translation: 我们的7辆自行车中，只有两辆适合走这种路。

examples.text: ...safety measures intended to reassure consumers that the meat is fit to eat...
examples.translation: 旨在让消费者放心食用这些肉的安全措施

examples.text: Follow our guide to making your home a fit place to work, rest and play.
examples.translation: 按照我们的指南把家营造成适合工作、休息和娱乐的地方。

examples.text: You're not fit to be a mother!...
examples.translation: 你不配做母亲！

examples.text: In a word, this government isn't fit to rule...
examples.translation: 简言之，这届政府无法胜任治国之责。

examples.text: I'm over 60 now and only fit for gardening and sleeping in a chair...
examples.translation: 我已过花甲，只能侍弄侍弄花草，躺在椅子上睡会儿觉了。

examples.text: He was not a fit companion for their skipper that particular morning.
examples.translation: 那天早晨，他没能和队长配合好。

examples.text: There is a debate about his fitness for the highest office...
examples.translation: 针对他是否能胜任最高职务展开了争论。

examples.text: If you have suffered from a serious medical condition, then you should consult your doctor about your fitness to travel.
examples.translation: 如果患有严重疾病，就应向医生咨询是否适合旅行。

examples.text: ...a man whose past experience fits him for the top job in education...
examples.translation: 一个资历丰富、适合担任教育界最高职位的人

examples.text: It is not a person's gender that fits them to be a vicar but what is in their hearts.
examples.translation: 一个人是否胜任教区牧师一职取决于其品德而不是其性别。

examples.text: About an hour later a really fit guy came up to me on the dance floor.
examples.translation: 大概过了一个小时，一个长相非常俊美的男人在舞池里向我走过来。

examples.text: The stink was fit to knock you down.
examples.translation: 这臭味简直要把人熏倒。

examples.text: ...hour after hour, the same exercises until you're fit to drop!
examples.translation: 一小时又一小时地做着同一套动作，直到快要晕倒！

examples.text: Wally was laughing fit to burst...
examples.translation: 沃利快要笑破肚皮了。

examples.text: You're shivering fit to die, Gracie.
examples.translation: 你抖得很厉害，格雷西。

examples.text: He's not a friend, you say, yet you saw fit to lend him money.
examples.translation: 你说他不是朋友，但你却决定借钱给他。

examples.text: We work long hours both outside and inside the home and we rush around trying to fit everything in...
examples.translation: 我们家里家外长时间忙活，忙完这里忙那里，想把一切都搞定。

examples.text: I find that I just can't fit in regular domestic work.
examples.translation: 我发现我真的没有时间做日常家务。

examples.text: She was great with the children and fitted in beautifully.
examples.translation: 她和孩子们打交道很有一手,相处得十分融洽。

examples.text: He knew where I fitted in and what he had to do to get the best out of me...
examples.translation: 他知道我适合做什么，也知道他要怎么做才能让我发挥出最佳水平。

examples.text: This fits in with what you've told me.
examples.translation: 这与你告诉过我的相符。

examples.text: It's hard to see how he would fit into the team.
examples.translation: 很难看出他将如何融入这支队伍。

examples.text: Most film locations broadly fit into two categories; those on private property and those in a public place.
examples.translation: 多数电影的拍摄场地大致归为两类：私人宅院与公共场地。

examples.text: We helped to fit him out for a trip to the Baltic...
examples.translation: 我们帮他准备了去波罗的海的行装。

examples.text: I suggest we fit you up with an office suite...
examples.translation: 我建议我们给你配备一间办公套房。

examples.text: They spent 18 million pounds of Government funds fitting out the London headquarters.
examples.translation: 他们花费了1,800万英镑的政府基金将伦敦总部的设施配备齐全。

examples.text: Mr Stone said inmates who had given evidence were trying to 'fit him up'...
examples.translation: 斯通先生说那些提供证据的同狱犯人是在试图“诬陷他”。

examples.text: There can never be any legitimate basis for police officers to fit up suspects they 'know' to be guilty.
examples.translation: 警官诬陷那些他们“知道”犯了罪的嫌疑人是根本没有任何法律依据的。

examples.text: An averagely fit person can master easy ski runs within a few days.
examples.translation: 健康的普通人几天内就可以掌握简单的滑雪技术。

examples.text: ...women who regularly engage in sports and fitness activities...
examples.translation: 经常参加体育锻炼和健身活动的女性

examples.text: Squash was once thought to offer all-round fitness.
examples.translation: 人们曾一度认为打壁球可以进行全身性锻炼。

examples.text: About two in every five epileptic fits occur during sleep...
examples.translation: 每5例癫痫病中约有两例是在睡眠过程中发作的。

examples.text: Once a fit has started there is nothing you can do to stop it.
examples.translation: 痉挛一旦发作就无法止住。

examples.text: Halfway down the cigarette she had a fit of coughing...
examples.translation: 烟抽到一半，她突然一阵猛咳。

examples.text: It was so unreal that I broke into a fit of giggles.
examples.translation: 这实在很离奇,我忍不住咯咯笑了起来。

examples.text: Pattie shot Tom in a fit of jealous rage.
examples.translation: 帕蒂妒火中烧，开枪击中了汤姆。

examples.text: Will Mrs Winterton have a fit if we add one more to the guest list at this late stage?...
examples.translation: 到这么晚的时候我们再增加一个客人，温特顿太太会发火吗？

examples.text: He'd have a fit if he knew what we were up to!
examples.translation: 要是他知道我们在干什么会气疯了的。

examples.text: He was a much more entertaining person, who used to have us all in fits.
examples.translation: 他以前更为风趣，常常让我们大家都捧腹大笑。

examples.text: My slimming attempts tend to go in fits and starts...
examples.translation: 我的瘦身运动总是三天打鱼两天晒网。

examples.text: Military technology advances by fits and starts.
examples.translation: 军事技术总是间断性地进步着。

examples.text: Eric Edward Bullus was born in Peterborough, the second of five children.
examples.translation: 埃里克·爱德华·布勒斯出生于彼得伯勒，是 5 个孩子中的老二。

examples.text: It is fixed on the wall...
examples.translation: 它固定在墙上。

examples.text: Most blinds can be fixed directly to the top of the window-frame...
examples.translation: 大多数窗帘都可直接安装在窗框上边。

examples.text: He fixed a bayonet to the end of his rifle.
examples.translation: 他在步枪口上安好了刺刀。

examples.text: He's going to fix a time when I can see him...
examples.translation: 他会确定一个我和他会面的时间。

examples.text: The date of the election was fixed...
examples.translation: 选举日期定下来了。

examples.text: The prices of milk and cereals are fixed annually.
examples.translation: 牛奶和谷类食物的价格每年确定一次。

examples.text: I've fixed it for you to see Bonnie Lachlan...
examples.translation: 你去见邦尼·拉克伦的事我已经安排好了。

examples.text: It's fixed. He's going to meet us at the airport...
examples.translation: 已经安排好了，他会在机场接我们。

examples.text: They thought that their relatives would be able to fix the visas...
examples.translation: 他们以为他们的亲戚们会把签证办好。

examples.text: He vanished after you fixed him with a job...
examples.translation: 你给他安排好工作后他就突然不见了。

examples.text: We fixed for the team to visit our headquarters...
examples.translation: 我们安排了该工作组参观我们的总部。

examples.text: They'd fixed yesterday that Mike'd be in late today.
examples.translation: 他们昨天已经确定迈克今天会来晚一些。

examples.text: He cannot fix the electricity...
examples.translation: 他不会修电路。

examples.text: If something is broken, we get it fixed.
examples.translation: 如果什么东西坏了，我们就找人来修理。

examples.text: It's not too late to fix the problem, although time is clearly getting short...
examples.translation: 虽然时间越来越紧迫，但现在处理这个问题还为时未晚。

examples.text: Fixing a 40-year-old wrong does not mean, however, that history can be undone.
examples.translation: 但是，平反一件40年的冤案并不意味着历史可以重写。

examples.text: Many of those changes could just be a temporary fix.
examples.translation: 那些变革中可能有很多只是权宜之计。

examples.text: She fixes her steel-blue eyes on an unsuspecting local official...
examples.translation: 她那灰蓝色的眼睛紧盯着一个毫无戒心的地方官员。

examples.text: Her soft brown eyes fixed on Kelly...
examples.translation: 她那双温柔的棕色眼睛紧盯着凯利。

examples.text: The child kept her eyes fixed on the wall behind him.
examples.translation: 这个小女孩眼睛一直紧盯着他身后的那堵墙。

examples.text: He took her hand and fixed her with a look of deep concern...
examples.translation: 他抓住她的手，表情极其关切地看着她。

examples.text: He fixed me with a lopsided grin.
examples.translation: 他冲我歪嘴笑了笑。

examples.text: Fix your attention on the practicalities of financing your schemes...
examples.translation: 重点考虑为你的计划融资是否可行。

examples.text: Attention is fixed on the stock market...
examples.translation: 重点关注的是证券市场。

examples.text: She kept her mind fixed on the practical problems which faced her.
examples.translation: 她专心思考面临的一些实际问题。

examples.text: Leonard was now fixed in his mind...
examples.translation: 伦纳德现在已经令他无法忘怀。

examples.text: Amy watched the child's intent face eagerly, trying to fix it in her mind.
examples.translation: 埃米急切地看着孩子那张神情专注的脸，想把它记在脑海里。

examples.text: The US crew fixed its radar on the Turkish ship...
examples.translation: 美国船员将雷达对准那艘土耳其船。

examples.text: The bore of the gun remained fixed on me.
examples.translation: 枪口依然指着我。

examples.text: He had not been able to fix his position...
examples.translation: 他一直未能确定他所在的位置。

examples.text: The satellite fixes positions by making repeated observations of each star.
examples.translation: 卫星通过对每颗恒星反复观察进行定位。

examples.text: ...accurate position fixing.
examples.translation: 准确定位

examples.text: The army hasn't been able to get a fix on the transmitter.
examples.translation: 军方一直未能确定发射台的准确位置。

examples.text: It's been hard to get a steady fix on what's going on.
examples.translation: 要对正在发生的事情保持持续的关注和了解并不容易。

examples.text: Sarah fixed some food for us...
examples.translation: 萨拉为我们准备了一些吃的。

examples.text: Let me fix you a drink...
examples.translation: 我给你弄杯饮料吧。

examples.text: Scotty stayed behind to fix lunch.
examples.translation: 斯科蒂留下来做午饭。

examples.text: 'I've got to fix my hair,' I said and retreated to my bedroom...
examples.translation: “我得把头发梳理一下，”我说罢回到了卧室。

examples.text: She called a cab, fixed her face, and scrawled a hasty note to Brian.
examples.translation: 她叫了辆出租车，补了一下妆，匆匆地给布莱恩写了张便条。

examples.text: The PR man suggested that I might benefit from getting my teeth fixed...
examples.translation: 公关顾问建议说，整牙也许对我有好处。

examples.text: I wonder if Tom ever had his teeth fixed anywhere else.
examples.translation: 我在想汤姆是不是在别的地方整过牙。

examples.text: They offered opposing players bribes to fix a decisive league match against Valenciennes...
examples.translation: 他们贿赂对方队员，在联赛对阵瓦朗谢讷队的一场决定性比赛中作弊。

examples.text: We didn't 'fix' anything. It'll be seen as it happens...
examples.translation: 我们没做任何手脚，该什么样就会什么样。

examples.text: The debate seems, in retrospect, to have been fixed from the beginning.
examples.translation: 回想起来，这场辩论好像从一开始就被人操纵了。

examples.text: ...this week's report of match-fixing.
examples.translation: 本周有关比赛作弊的报道

examples.text: It's all a fix, a deal they've made.
examples.translation: 这完全是一场骗局，是他们之间的交易。

examples.text: ...a suspected cartel that had fixed the price of steel for the construction market...
examples.translation: 涉嫌操控建筑市场钢材价格的卡特尔

examples.text: The company is currently in dispute with the government over price fixing.
examples.translation: 该公司目前与政府在是否存在价格操控问题上存在分歧。

examples.text: It turned the country into an 'aid junkie', heavily dependent on its annual fix of dollars...
examples.translation: 这使得该国严重依赖每年救济的那点美元，成了“嗜援成瘾”的国家。

examples.text: I need my fix of sugar, sweets, and chocolate...
examples.translation: 我离不开糖、甜品和巧克力。

examples.text: The trouble with her is she needs her daily fix of publicity.
examples.translation: 她的问题在于她每天都想要在媒体上曝一曝光。

examples.text: ...a quick energy fix.
examples.translation: 快速能量增补剂

examples.text: He was in a fix...
examples.translation: 他陷入了困境。

examples.text: The government has really got itself into a fix...
examples.translation: 政府真的让自己陷入了困境。

examples.text: This will put us in a very difficult economic fix.
examples.translation: 这将让我们陷入非常困难的经济窘境。

examples.text: Certain pigment colours were painted on to dry plaster using tempera (where egg yolk is used to fix the pigment)...
examples.translation: 使用蛋彩画颜料(内含可以定色的蛋黄)在干石膏上绘出了特定颜色。

examples.text: The main aim of inbreeding is to standardise, to fix desirable inherited characteristics and to dispel undesirable ones.
examples.translation: 同系交配的主要目的就是实现标准化，保持理想的遗传特性，并消除不良的特性。

examples.text: That'll fix him.
examples.translation: 那样他就不会再干了。

examples.text: I'm fixing to go to graduate school...
examples.translation: 我打算去读研究生。

examples.text: He would know when I was fixing to leave. He'd wait by the front door.
examples.translation: 他会知道我打算什么时候走，他还会在前门等着。

examples.text: The Vietnamese government has fixed on May 19th to celebrate his anniversary.
examples.translation: 越南政府已经决定于5月19日庆祝他的诞辰。

examples.text: I fixed up an appointment to see her...
examples.translation: 我安排了与她见面。

examples.text: Accommodation is never fixed up in advance.
examples.translation: 住宿从未提前安排好。

examples.text: I've fixed up Matthew's old room...
examples.translation: 我已经把马修原来住的房间装饰了一番。

examples.text: The whole block is being fixed up.
examples.translation: 整个街区都在进行装修。

examples.text: We'll fix him up with a tie...
examples.translation: 我们将给他准备一条领带。

examples.text: He was fixed up with a job.
examples.translation: 别人给他找了一份工作。

meanings.meaning: 设备；固定装置；固定于某处不大可能移动之物

examples.text: ...a detailed list of what fixtures and fittings are included in the purchase price.
examples.translation: 房屋购买价中包括的固定装置及设备的详细清单

examples.text: City won this fixture 3-0 last season.
examples.translation: 上个赛季曼城队在该项赛事中以3比0获胜。

examples.text: She was a fixture in New York's nightclubs...
examples.translation: 她是纽约夜总会的常客。

examples.text: The cordless kettle may now be a fixture in most kitchens.
examples.translation: 无绳电热水壶现在可能是多数厨房的固定设备。

examples.text: The heat from the flames was so intense that roads melted.
examples.translation: 烈焰的温度很高，连路面都被熔化了。

examples.text: ...a huge ball of flame.
examples.translation: 一大团火焰

examples.text: The best way to respond to a flame is to ignore it.
examples.translation: 回应谩骂性电子邮件的最好办法就是置之不理。

examples.text: Ever been flamed?
examples.translation: 收到过带有攻击性的电子邮件吗？

examples.text: Her cheeks flamed an angry red...
examples.translation: 她气得脸涨红了。

examples.text: Christopher's listening face flamed at the contempt.
examples.translation: 克利斯托弗听到这种蔑视，气得涨红了脸。

examples.text: ...that burning flame of love.
examples.translation: 那种熊熊燃烧的爱情之火

examples.text: She managed to scramble out of the vehicle as it burst into flames.
examples.translation: 车子一下子起火了,她设法从里面爬了出来。

examples.text: He accused the Tories of 'fanning the flames of extremism'.
examples.translation: 他谴责保守党分子“煽动极端主义情绪”。

examples.text: Fires broke out everywhere, the entire city went up in flames.
examples.translation: 到处都燃起了火，整个城市陷入一片火海。

examples.text: The Marines climbed to the roof of the embassy building to raise the American flag...
examples.translation: 海军陆战队队员爬到使馆大楼顶上，升起了美国国旗。

examples.text: They had raised the white flag in surrender.
examples.translation: 他们已经举起白旗投降。

examples.text: Joining John Whitaker will be his brother Michael also riding under the British flag...
examples.translation: 约翰·惠特克将与他的兄弟迈克尔一起代表英国参加这场自行车赛。

examples.text: The airport was opened by Canadian troops operating under the flag of the United Nations.
examples.translation: 机场由加拿大军队以联合国的名义开放。

examples.text: His enthusiasm was in no way flagging...
examples.translation: 他的热情丝毫未减。

examples.text: By 4,000m he was beginning to flag.
examples.translation: 跑到4,000米时，他开始体力不支。

examples.text: Steve Crabb can fly the flag with distinction for Britain in Barcelona.
examples.translation: 史蒂夫·克拉布在巴塞罗那可以旗帜鲜明地支持英国。

examples.text: Marlette was already out of the door, flagging down a taxi.
examples.translation: 马利特已经出门了，正挥手招呼一辆出租车。

examples.text: Staff can use the noticeboard to flag up any concerns.
examples.translation: 员工可以用布告栏表达任何关注。

examples.text: I think there are more important issues and I just wanted to flag that up.
examples.translation: 我想还有更重要的问题，我只是希望能引起对它的重视。

meanings.meaning: 拍打，拍打声；神经紧张；[航] 襟翼
拍动；神经紧张；鼓翼而飞；（帽边等）垂下

examples.text: Grey sheets flapped on the clothes line...
examples.translation: 灰色的床单在晾衣绳上飘来摆去的。

examples.text: They would flap bath towels from their balconies as they chatted.
examples.translation: 他们聊天时会在阳台上抖搂浴巾。

examples.text: The bird flapped its wings furiously...
examples.translation: 鸟儿使劲地扑打着翅膀。

examples.text: A pigeon emerges, wings flapping noisily, from the tower.
examples.translation: 一只鸽子从塔里钻出来，扑扑地拍打着翅膀。

examples.text: ...a kid running and flapping her arms.
examples.translation: 边跑边挥舞着手臂的小孩子

examples.text: He drew back the tent flap and strode out into the blizzard.
examples.translation: 他拉开帐篷的门帘，大步走进暴风雪中。

examples.text: ...a loose flap of skin.
examples.translation: 耷拉着快要掉下的一块皮

examples.text: ...the sudden slowing as the flaps were lowered.
examples.translation: 襟翼放下时的突然减速

examples.text: Nothing to be heard but the soft flap of a silk banner.
examples.translation: 万籁俱寂，只有一面绸制旗子轻轻飘动的响声。

examples.text: Why did people get in a flap over nuclear energy?...
examples.translation: 为什么人们对核能惶恐不安呢？

examples.text: Wherever he goes there's always a flap.
examples.translation: 无论他到哪里，都会引起一阵骚动。

meanings.meaning: 使闪耀；使张开；用发光信号发出；使外倾
闪耀，闪光；燃烧；突然发怒
闪光，闪耀；耀斑；爆发；照明弹

examples.text: ...a ship which had fired a distress flare.
examples.translation: 发出遇险信号弹的一艘船

examples.text: Camp fires flared like beacons in the dark.
examples.translation: 营火突然熊熊燃烧起来，看上去就像黑暗中的航标灯。

examples.text: Don't spill too much fat on the barbecue as it could flare up.
examples.translation: 不要在烤肉上浇太多的油，会烧起来的。

examples.text: Even as the President appealed for calm, trouble flared in several American cities.
examples.translation: 尽管总统呼吁保持冷静，美国一些城市的骚乱仍有所升级。

examples.text: Dozens of people were injured as fighting flared up.
examples.translation: 争斗愈演愈烈，数十人受伤。

examples.text: Tempers flared and harsh words were exchanged.
examples.translation: 怒气突然爆发，人们开始恶言相向。

examples.text: I turned to Jacky, my nostrils flaring in disgust...
examples.translation: 我转过身厌恶地看着杰基，鼻翼呼呼地翕动着。

examples.text: He stuck out his tongue and flared his nostrils.
examples.translation: 他伸出舌头，鼻翼扇动着。

examples.text: ...a simple black dress, cut to flare from the hips.
examples.translation: 一条简洁的黑裙，剪裁成从胯部向外展开的式样

examples.text: Students often find that their acne flares up before and during exams.
examples.translation: 学生们经常发现在考前和考试期间他们的粉刺会严重起来。

examples.text: A sudden flash of lightning lit everything up for a second...
examples.translation: 突然一个闪电瞬间照亮了一切。

examples.text: The wire snapped at the wall plug with a blue flash and the light fused...
examples.translation: 墙上插头处的电线啪地发出一道蓝光，电灯的保险丝烧断了。

examples.text: A jay emerged from the juniper bush in a flash of blue feathers.
examples.translation: 只见亮闪闪的蓝色羽毛一闪，一只松鸦从刺柏丛中钻了出来。

examples.text: Lightning flashed among the distant dark clouds...
examples.translation: 一道道电光在远处的乌云中闪现。

examples.text: He lost his temper after a driver flashed her headlights as he overtook...
examples.translation: 一个女司机在他超车时不停地闪着车前灯，这让他火冒三丈。

examples.text: He flashed his light into the boat and saw the fishing-line...
examples.translation: 他朝船上照去，看见了钓鱼线。

examples.text: He saw the flashing lights of the highway patrol car in his driving mirror.
examples.translation: 他从后视镜中看见公路巡逻车闪烁的车灯。

examples.text: 'What did Moira tell you?' Liz demanded with a flash of anger...
examples.translation: “莫伊拉跟你说什么啦？”利兹突然生气地质问道。

examples.text: When pursued, he made his escape with a flash of speed...
examples.translation: 遭到追赶时，他突然飞速地逃脱了。

examples.text: The essays could do with a flash of wit or humor.
examples.translation: 这些散文需要一些出其不意的风趣或幽默。

examples.text: It was a busy road, cars flashed by every few minutes.
examples.translation: 这是一条繁忙的道路，每隔几分钟就有汽车飞驰而过。

examples.text: ...the ball flashed across the face of the goal.
examples.translation: 球从球门前飞过。

examples.text: A ludicrous thought flashed through Harry's mind...
examples.translation: 一个荒谬的念头突然在哈里脑中闪现。

examples.text: Those lines of Milton flashed into my mind.
examples.translation: 弥尔顿的那几行诗忽然在我脑中闪过。

examples.text: Halim flashed his official card, and managed to get hold of a soldier to guard the Land Rover.
examples.translation: 哈利姆亮了一下他的军官证，设法找来了一名士兵看着路虎车。

examples.text: The figures flash up on the scoreboard...
examples.translation: 数字显示在记分牌上。

examples.text: The words 'Good Luck' were flashing on the screen...
examples.translation: “祝您好运”几个字出现在屏幕上。

examples.text: Researchers flash two groups of different letters onto a computer screen...
examples.translation: 研究者在计算机屏幕上显示出两组不同的字母。
