examples.text: The screen flashes a message: Try again...
examples.translation: 屏幕上显示出一条信息：再试一次。

examples.text: A list of items is repeatedly flashed up on the screen.
examples.translation: 一个选项列表反复出现在屏幕上。

examples.text: They had told their offices to flash the news as soon as it broke...
examples.translation: 他们已经告诉各办公室，一有消息立即发布。

examples.text: This is, of course, international news and soon it was being flashed around the world.
examples.translation: 当然，这是国际性新闻，很快就会传到世界各地。

examples.text: I flashed a look at Sue...
examples.translation: 我向休瞥了一眼。

examples.text: Meg flashed Cissie a grateful smile.
examples.translation: 梅格冲茜茜感激地笑了一笑。

examples.text: Her dark eyes flashed and she spoke rapidly.
examples.translation: 她飞快地说着，黑色的双眼放着光。

examples.text: He was one of the first people to use high speed flash in bird photography.
examples.translation: 他是最先使用高速闪光灯拍摄鸟类的人之一。

examples.text: Stopping to rest, Pete shut off the flash.
examples.translation: 皮特关掉手电筒，停下来休息。

examples.text: ...a flash uptown restaurant...
examples.translation: 城郊富人区的豪华饭店

examples.text: You can go for a 'rostrum' system, which sounds flash, but can be assembled quite cheaply.
examples.translation: 可以去弄一个“指挥台”系统，它听起来很昂贵，但其实花不了多少钱就可以组装起来。

examples.text: People will be looking in to see how good we are now and whether our success has just been a flash in the pan.
examples.translation: 人们会来看看我们现在有多成功，看看我们的成功是否只是昙花一现。

examples.text: The answer had come to him in a flash...
examples.translation: 他一下子就有了答案。

examples.text: It was done in a flash.
examples.translation: 一眨眼的工夫就完成了。

examples.text: Quick as a flash, the man said, 'I have to, don't I?'
examples.translation: 那人立即说道：“我必须如此，是不是？”

examples.text: His mind kept flashing back to the previous night...
examples.translation: 他脑中不断回想起头天晚上发生的事。

examples.text: Thoughts inevitably flash back to 1914, when trouble in this part of the Balkans led all the way to world war.
examples.translation: 这难免会令人想起1914年，那年巴尔干半岛上这一地区的动荡最终引发了世界大战。

examples.text: I knew she was just flattering me.
examples.translation: 我知道她只是在恭维我。

examples.text: ...a story of how the president flattered and feted him into taking his side.
examples.translation: 有关总统如何恭维并盛宴款待他、让他站到自己一边的故事

examples.text: I flatter myself that this campaign will put an end to the war...
examples.translation: 我自认为这次战役将结束这场战争。

examples.text: I flatter myself I've done it all rather well...
examples.translation: 我认为自己已经做得相当好了。

examples.text: You flatter yourself. Why would we go to such ludicrous lengths?
examples.translation: 你真自以为是。我们为什么要费那么大的力气?

examples.text: Orange and khaki flatter those with golden skin tones...
examples.translation: 橘黄色和卡其色能衬托那些金黄色皮肤的人。

examples.text: My philosophy of fashion is that I like to make clothes that flatter.
examples.translation: 我的时尚理念就是我喜欢做让人穿着更显漂亮的衣服。

examples.text: We've heard from lots of folks who are fans of the flavor, he said.

meanings.meaning: 瑕疵，缺点；一阵狂风；短暂的风暴；裂缝，裂纹
使生裂缝，使有裂纹；使无效；使有缺陷

examples.text: There were, however, a number of crucial flaws in his monetary theory...
examples.translation: 但是，他的货币理论中存在若干关键性错误。

examples.text: Almost all of these studies have serious flaws.
examples.translation: 几乎所有这些研究中都存在严重谬误。

examples.text: The only flaw in his character seems to be a short temper.
examples.translation: 他性格中的唯一缺点好像就是脾气急。

examples.text: He slammed the bedroom door behind him and fled...
examples.translation: 他把卧室房门重重地关上，然后逃跑了。

examples.text: He fled to Costa Rica to avoid military service.
examples.translation: 他逃到了哥斯达黎加以逃避服兵役。

examples.text: ...refugees who have fled from wars, famine and persecution...
examples.translation: 逃避战争、饥荒和迫害的难民

examples.text: ...refugees fleeing persecution or torture...
examples.translation: 躲避迫害和酷刑的难民

examples.text: Thousands have been compelled to flee the country in makeshift boats.
examples.translation: 数以千计的人被迫乘坐简易船只逃离了这个国家。

examples.text: The damage inflicted upon the British fleet was devastating.
examples.translation: 英国舰队遭到了毁灭性的重创。

examples.text: ...restaurants supplied by local fishing fleets.
examples.translation: 由当地捕鱼船队供货的饭馆

examples.text: With its own fleet of trucks, the company delivers most orders overnight...
examples.translation: 这个公司拥有自己的货车车队，大多数订购货品可以隔日送到。

examples.text: A fleet of ambulances took the injured to hospital.
examples.translation: 一队救护车把伤者送往医院。

examples.text: ...maggots which eat away dead flesh.
examples.translation: 食腐肉的蛆虫

examples.text: ...the pale pink flesh of trout and salmon.
examples.translation: 淡粉色的鳟鱼和鲑鱼肉

examples.text: ...the warmth of her flesh.
examples.translation: 她肌肤的温暖

examples.text: ...the sins of the flesh.
examples.translation: 肉欲之罪

examples.text: Cut the flesh from the olives and discard the stones.
examples.translation: 把橄榄的果肉切下来，然后去除果核。

examples.text: I'm only flesh and blood, like anyone else.
examples.translation: 我只是个凡人，和其他人一样。

examples.text: ...skills of a precision unmatched by any flesh and blood worker.
examples.translation: 世上任何工人都无法达到的精准技巧

examples.text: The kid, after all, was his own flesh and blood. He deserved a second chance.
examples.translation: 毕竟这个孩子是他的亲骨肉，应该给他第二次机会。

examples.text: It makes my flesh creep to think of it...
examples.translation: 想到它就会让我毛骨悚然。

examples.text: I was heading on a secret mission that made my flesh crawl.
examples.translation: 我正要执行一项让我心惊肉跳的秘密任务。

examples.text: Charles' appeal is best observed in the flesh...
examples.translation: 见到查尔斯本人才最能感受到他的魅力。

examples.text: The first thing viewers usually say when they see me in the flesh is 'You're smaller than you look on TV.'
examples.translation: 观众见到我本人通常说的第一句话就是“你比电视上看上去要矮小一些。”

examples.text: This is an attempt to put flesh on what has been a very bare skeleton plan up to now.
examples.translation: 这是一次试图使至今还只是框架的计划充实起来的尝试。

examples.text: He talked with him for an hour and a half, fleshing out the details of his original five-minute account...
examples.translation: 他和他谈了一个半小时，将自己原来5 分钟的陈述完全展开了。

examples.text: He has since fleshed out his story.
examples.translation: 他从此使自己的故事更加丰满。

meanings.meaning: 灵活的；柔韧的；易弯曲的

examples.text: ...brushes with long, flexible bristles.
examples.translation: 鬃毛长而柔韧的毛笔

examples.text: The flexibility of the lens decreases with age.
examples.translation: 眼球晶状体的柔韧性随着年龄增长而减退。

examples.text: Look for software that's flexible enough for a range of abilities.
examples.translation: 寻找功能多、适用性强的软件。

examples.text: ...flexible working hours.
examples.translation: 灵活的工作时间

examples.text: It would seem more sensible to apply standards flexibly rather than rigidly.
examples.translation: 灵活地运用标准比死守标准会显得更合情合理。

examples.text: The flexibility of distance learning would be particularly suited to busy managers.
examples.translation: 远程学习的灵活性对于日理万机的经理人来说特别适合。

examples.text: The flight will take four hours.
examples.translation: 这次航行要飞 4 个小时。

examples.text: I'll try to get on the flight down to Karachi tonight...
examples.translation: 我尽量赶上今晚去卡拉奇的航班。

examples.text: BA flight 286 was two hours late.
examples.translation: 英国航空公司 286 次航班晚点两个小时。

examples.text: These hawks are magnificent in flight, soaring and circling for long periods...
examples.translation: 这些鹰飞行能力极其出色，可以长时间在空中翱翔和盘旋。

examples.text: Supersonic flight could become a routine form of travel in the 21st century.
examples.translation: 搭乘超音速飞机会成为 21 世纪常规的旅行方式。

examples.text: A flight of green parrots shot out of the cedar forest.
examples.translation: 一群绿鹦鹉从杉木林里疾速飞出。

examples.text: Frank was in full flight when he reached them...
examples.translation: 弗兰克正在拼命奔逃，这时他联系到了他们。

examples.text: The family was often in flight, hiding out in friends' houses.
examples.translation: 这一家人常常东躲西藏，在朋友家里避风头。

examples.text: ...her hurried flight from the palace in a cart.
examples.translation: 她坐着马车匆匆逃离王宫

examples.text: We walked in silence up a flight of stairs and down a long corridor.
examples.translation: 我们默默地走上一段楼梯，穿过一个长长的走廊。

examples.text: Cockburn engaged in a flight of fancy, never once allowing facts to get in the way.
examples.translation: 科伯恩一直在想入非非，从不曾考虑现实状况。

examples.text: He was told of the raid and decided to take flight immediately.
examples.translation: 他得知要突击搜查，决定立刻逃走。

meanings.meaning: 掷，抛；嘲笑；使陷入；轻蔑地投射；猛动

examples.text: The woman flung the cup at him...
examples.translation: 那个女人使劲把杯子朝他扔去。

examples.text: He once seized my knitting, flinging it across the room.
examples.translation: 有一次他抓过我织的东西，把它扔到了屋子的另一头。

examples.text: He flung himself to the floor.
examples.translation: 他突然跳到地板上。

examples.text: She flung her arms around my neck and kissed me.
examples.translation: 她突然张开手臂搂住我的脖子，然后吻了我一下。

examples.text: The youth got him by the front of his shirt and flung him to the ground.
examples.translation: 年轻人抓住他的衬衫前襟，把他摔在了地上。

examples.text: Peter flung his shoes into the corner...
examples.translation: 彼得把他的鞋子甩到角落里。

examples.text: He flung it down on the desk.
examples.translation: 他把东西摔在桌子上。

examples.text: She flung herself into her career...
examples.translation: 她一心扑在事业上。

examples.text: I flung myself into poetry.
examples.translation: 我全身心投入诗歌创作。

examples.text: She claims she had a brief fling with him 30 years ago.
examples.translation: 她声称在 30 年前曾和他有过一段短暂的风流韵事。

examples.text: ...that last fling before you finally give up and take up a job.
examples.translation: 你最终收心并开始工作之前的最后一次放纵

meanings.meaning: 浮动；飘动，散播；摇摆；付诸实施
彩车，花车；漂流物；浮舟；浮萍

examples.text: They noticed fifty and twenty dollar bills floating in the water.
examples.translation: 他们发现水中漂浮着50和20美元的纸币。

examples.text: ...barges floating quietly by the grassy river banks...
examples.translation: 青草萋萋的河岸边静静漂浮着的驳船

examples.text: They'll spend some time floating boats in the creek.
examples.translation: 他们打算花些时间在溪流里放船模。。

examples.text: Empty things float.
examples.translation: 空的物体会在水中浮起。

examples.text: The white cloud of smoke floated away.
examples.translation: 白色的烟雾飘远了。

examples.text: ...the sun's rays lighting up the dust floating in the air.
examples.translation: 阳光照亮了空气中浮动的灰尘

examples.text: Sublime music floats on a scented summer breeze to the spot where you lie on the lush grass...
examples.translation: 你躺在绿草如茵的草地上，涤荡心灵的乐声随着清香的夏日微风飘到你的身边。

examples.text: The smells of delicious foods floated all around him.
examples.translation: 美食的香味弥漫在他的四周。

examples.text: Caroline floated up the aisle on her father's arm.
examples.translation: 卡罗琳挽着父亲的手臂从过道上优雅地走过。

examples.text: The French had floated the idea of placing the diplomatic work in the hands of the UN.
examples.translation: 法国提出将外交工作交由联合国处理的想法。

examples.text: He floated his firm on the stock market...
examples.translation: 他让自己的公司上市了。

examples.text: The advisers are delaying the key decision on whether to float 60 per cent or 100 per cent of the shares.
examples.translation: 顾问们对于发行60%还是100%股份的关键问题迟迟未作决定。

examples.text: A decision by the Finns to float their currency sent a shudder through the foreign exchanges...
examples.translation: 芬兰允许其货币自由浮动的决定在外汇市场上引起了震动。

examples.text: 59 per cent of people believed the pound should be allowed to float freely.
examples.translation: 59%的人认为应该允许英镑自由浮动。

examples.text: There are still some unfounded fears floating around out there about cancer being contagious.
examples.translation: 社会上还是有一些毫无根据的关于癌症会传染的恐惧。

examples.text: They kept a small flock of sheep...
examples.translation: 他们养了一小群羊。

examples.text: They are gregarious birds and feed in flocks.
examples.translation: 它们是群居鸟类，会集群觅食。

examples.text: These cases all attracted flocks of famous writers.
examples.translation: 这些案件都吸引了大批知名作家的关注。

examples.text: ...his flock of advisers.
examples.translation: 他的庞大顾问团

examples.text: The public have flocked to the show...
examples.translation: 公众蜂拥而至观看演出。

examples.text: The criticisms will not stop people flocking to see the film...
examples.translation: 批评的声音不会阻止人们涌到影院观看这部电影。

examples.text: His greatest wish must be that huge crowds flock into the beautiful park.
examples.translation: 他最大的愿望一定是希望人们成群结队地到这个美丽的公园参观。

meanings.meaning: (Flood)人名；(英)弗勒德；(瑞典、芬)弗洛德

examples.text: More than 70 people were killed in the floods, caused when a dam burst...
examples.translation: 大坝决口造成洪灾，70 多人因此丧生。

examples.text: This is the type of flood dreaded by cavers...
examples.translation: 这正是洞穴探险者害怕的那种洪水。

examples.text: Over 25 people drowned when a schoolbus tried to cross a river and flood waters swept through.
examples.translation: 一辆校车试图过河时遭遇洪水来袭，造成逾 25 人溺水身亡。

examples.text: The Chicago River flooded the city's underground tunnel system...
examples.translation: 芝加哥河的河水淹没了城市的地下隧道系统。

examples.text: The kitchen flooded.
examples.translation: 厨房被水淹了。

examples.text: People have been mobilised to build defences and drain flooded land as heavy rains continue to fall.
examples.translation: 大雨还在继续下，人们已经被动员起来修筑防洪工事，为遭淹田地排水。

examples.text: ...the relentless rain that caused twenty rivers to flood...
examples.translation: 引发了 20 条河流泛滥的持续降水

examples.text: Many streams have flooded their banks, making some roads impassable.
examples.translation: 许多小河的水已经漫过堤岸，造成一些道路不能通行。

examples.text: The administration is trying to stem the flood of refugees out of Haiti and into Florida...
examples.translation: 政府当局正试图阻止大批难民逃离海地，进入佛罗里达。

examples.text: He received a flood of letters from irate constituents.
examples.translation: 他收到愤怒的选区居民洪水般涌来的信件。

examples.text: Large numbers of immigrants flooded into the area...
examples.translation: 大量移民涌入这个地区。

examples.text: Enquiries flooded in from all over the world.
examples.translation: 世界各地的问询纷至沓来。

examples.text: ...the refugees flooding out of Kosovo.
examples.translation: 逃离科索沃的难民群

examples.text: ...a policy aimed at flooding Europe with exports...
examples.translation: 一项旨在让进口产品充斥欧洲市场的政策

examples.text: Brokers expect the markets to be flooded with the shares...
examples.translation: 股票经纪人预计股市会充斥着这种股票。

examples.text: German cameras at knock-down prices flooded the British market.
examples.translation: 德国产的廉价相机充斥着英国市场。

examples.text: ...the danger of Europe becoming flooded with low-cost agricultural imports.
examples.translation: 低成本的进口农产品充斥欧洲市场的危险

examples.text: A wave of happiness flooded me...
examples.translation: 我心中涌起一股幸福的暖流。

examples.text: Mary Ann was flooded with relief ...
examples.translation: 玛丽·安感到无比宽慰。

examples.text: It was probably the shock which had brought all the memories flooding back.
examples.translation: 可能是由于突然受到惊吓，所有的记忆一下子全涌现出来。

examples.text: The afternoon light flooded the little rooms...
examples.translation: 午后的阳光洒满一间间小屋。

examples.text: Morning sunshine flooded in through the open curtains.
examples.translation: 清晨的阳光透过拉开的窗帘照射进来。

examples.text: The pain was so bad that I would be in floods of tears...
examples.translation: 疼痛难忍，我就快大哭起来了。

examples.text: They said goodbye in a flood of tears.
examples.translation: 他们痛哭流涕地道别。

examples.text: Train lines were flooded out...
examples.translation: 铁路线被洪水冲毁。

examples.text: The river flooded them out every few years.
examples.translation: 每隔几年他们就会因这条河的泛滥而被迫离开家园。

meanings.meaning: 平的；单调的；不景气的；干脆的；平坦的；扁平的；浅的
（尤指贴着另一表面）平直地；断然地；水平地；直接地，完全地
使变平；[音乐]使（音调）下降，尤指降半音
逐渐变平；[音乐]以降调唱（或奏）
（法）弗拉特（人名）；（英）弗莱特（人名）

examples.text: Sara lives with her husband and children in a flat in central London...
examples.translation: 萨拉和丈夫还有孩子们住在伦敦中心城区的一间公寓里。

examples.text: It started a fire in a block of flats...
examples.translation: 大火是从一幢公寓大楼烧起的。

examples.text: Later on, Victor from flat 10 called.
examples.translation: 后来，10 号公寓的维克托打来电话。

examples.text: Tiles can be fixed to any surface as long as it's flat, firm and dry...
examples.translation: 只要表面平整、坚固而且干燥，瓷砖就可以贴住。

examples.text: After a moment his right hand moved across the cloth, smoothing it flat...
examples.translation: 过了一会儿，他用右手把布抹平。

examples.text: ...windows which a thief can reach from a drainpipe or flat roof...
examples.translation: 小偷从排水管或平屋顶上就可够到的窗户

examples.text: The sea was calm, perfectly flat.
examples.translation: 海面风平浪静，没有一丝波澜。

examples.text: Two men near him threw themselves flat...
examples.translation: 他身旁的两个男人直挺挺趴倒在地上。

examples.text: As heartburn is usually worse when you're lying down in bed, you should avoid lying flat.
examples.translation: 通常躺着的时候胃灼热会更加厉害，所以应当避免平卧。

examples.text: Ellen is walking down the drive with a square flat box balanced on one hand.
examples.translation: 埃伦正一手托着一个方形的扁盒子沿私人车道走着。

examples.text: To the north lie the flat and fertile farmlands of the Solway plain...
examples.translation: 北边是索尔韦平原平坦而肥沃的农田。

examples.text: The landscape became wider, flatter and very scenic...
examples.translation: 地势变得更开阔、更平整，风景十分优美。

examples.text: The highway stretched out flat and straight ahead.
examples.translation: 公路平坦而笔直地向前延伸。

examples.text: Notice the flatness and the rich, red earth.
examples.translation: 注意那平坦的地势和肥沃的红土地。

examples.text: The salt marshes and mud flats attract large numbers of waterfowl.
examples.translation: 盐碱地和泥滩吸引了大量水鸟。

examples.text: He slammed the counter with the flat of his hand.
examples.translation: 他用手掌使劲拍打着柜台。

examples.text: ...eight cloves of garlic crushed with the flat of a knife.
examples.translation: 用刀面拍碎的 8 粒蒜瓣

examples.text: People wear slacks, sweaters, flat shoes, and all manner of casual attire for travel.
examples.translation: 人们穿着宽松的长裤、运动衫、平底鞋和各式适合旅行的休闲服装。

examples.text: His mother looked ten years younger in jeans and flats.
examples.translation: 他妈妈穿上牛仔裤和平跟鞋，看上去年轻了 10 岁。

examples.text: Then, after I finally got back on the highway, I developed a flat.
examples.translation: 后来，我终于回到公路上后，车胎又瘪了。

examples.text: Could this really stop the champagne from going flat?
examples.translation: 这真的能让香槟不走气吗？

examples.text: His car alarm had been going off for two days and, as a result, the battery was flat.
examples.translation: 他的汽车报警器连着响了两天，结果电池耗没电了。

examples.text: The condition of flat feet runs in families.
examples.translation: 平足会在家族中遗传。

examples.text: The Foreign Ministry has issued a flat denial of any involvement...
examples.translation: 外交部已经坚决否认参与过此事。

examples.text: She is likely to give you a flat refusal.
examples.translation: 她很可能会断然拒绝你。

examples.text: Michael flatly denied virtually every rumour...
examples.translation: 迈克尔几乎对每个传闻都坚决否认。

examples.text: He flatly refused to discuss it...
examples.translation: 他断然拒绝讨论此事。

examples.text: I could use some money, Sarah told him flatly.
examples.translation: 萨拉态度坚决地告诉他，我可以用一部分钱。

examples.text: You're sitting behind an engine that'll move you from 0 to 60mph in six seconds flat...
examples.translation: 您面前的引擎，可以在短短 6 秒钟内速度从 0 提升至每小时 60 英里。

examples.text: I had it all explained to me in two minutes flat.
examples.translation: 短短两分钟内，我让人把一切都给我解释了一下。

examples.text: Fees are charged at a flat rate, rather than on a percentage basis...
examples.translation: 费用按固定价格收取，而不是基于百分比收取。

examples.text: Sometimes there's a flat fee for carrying out a particular task...
examples.translation: 有时执行某项特定的任务有固定的价码。

examples.text: Medicare is preparing to cut all payments by a flat 2%.
examples.translation: 国家医疗保健体系正准备对所有收费都统一减少 2%。

examples.text: During the first eight months of this year, sales of big pickups were up 14% while car sales stayed flat...
examples.translation: 今年前 8 个月，大型货车的销售量增加了 14％，而小轿车的销售仍然不景气。

examples.text: For the country overall, house prices have remained flat.
examples.translation: 从全国来说，房屋价格没有多大变化。

examples.text: The past few days have seemed comparatively flat and empty...
examples.translation: 过去这几天似乎比较平淡无聊。

examples.text: It is a long time since a party leader delivered such a dreadfully flat speech as he did yesterday.
examples.translation: 很久没有政党领导人像他昨天那样作如此枯燥无聊的演讲了。

examples.text: Kenworthy detected a certain flatness in the days that followed.
examples.translation: 肯沃西在接下来的几天中感到有些平淡无趣。

examples.text: 'Whatever you say,' he said in a deadly flat voice. 'I'll sit here and wait.'...
examples.translation: “不管你说什么，我都会坐在这里等。”他用一种极为平淡的声音说道。

examples.text: Her voice was flat, with no question or hope in it.
examples.translation: 她的声音平淡，听不出疑虑也感觉不到希望。

examples.text: 'I know you,' he said flatly, matter-of-fact, neutral in tone.
examples.translation: “我认识你。”他平淡地说道，就事论事，不带任何感情。

examples.text: ...Schubert's B flat Piano Trio (Opus 99).
examples.translation: 舒伯特降 B 调钢琴三重奏(第 99 号作品)

examples.text: Her vocal range was, to say the least of it, limited, and she had a distressing tendency to sing flat.
examples.translation: 至少可以说，她的音域不够宽，而且令人不舒服的是，她总是音高偏低。

examples.text: He had been fired because his singing was flat.
examples.translation: 他因为唱歌音调偏低而被炒了。

examples.text: My home state of Illinois is flat as a pancake...
examples.translation: 我的故乡伊利诺伊州一马平川。

examples.text: A man walked in off the street and fell flat on his face, unconscious.
examples.translation: 一个男人从街上走进来，趴倒在地，不省人事。

examples.text: Liz meant it as a joke but it fell flat...
examples.translation: 利兹本想开个玩笑，结果却没有达到效果。

examples.text: If it wasn't for the main actress, Ellen Barkin, the plot would have fallen flat on its face.
examples.translation: 如果不是女主角埃伦·巴尔金的话，整个情节会非常失败。

examples.text: Two years later he is flat broke and on the dole.
examples.translation: 两年后，他一贫如洗，靠失业救济金生活。

examples.text: Everyone is working flat out to try to trap those responsible...
examples.translation: 每个人都在全力以赴，设法捉住那些罪魁祸首。

examples.text: They hurtled across the line in a flat-out sprint.
examples.translation: 他们拼命冲刺，越过终点线。

examples.text: That allegation is a flat-out lie...
examples.translation: 那项指控是彻头彻尾的谎言。

examples.text: They say the industry is flat out lying about the effects of deregulation.
examples.translation: 他们说业界所谓的放宽管制已经取得了成效的说法纯属谎言。

examples.text: He had angina and was unable to walk for more than 200 yards on the flat.
examples.translation: 他患有心绞痛，在平地上最多能走 200 码。

examples.text: Lightly flour a rolling pin...
examples.translation: 在擀面杖上撒上薄薄的一层面粉。

examples.text: Remove the dough from the bowl and put it on a floured surface.
examples.translation: 把面团从碗中取出，放在撒有面粉的台面上。

meanings.meaning: 地板，地面；楼层；基底；议员席
铺地板；打倒，击倒；（被困难）难倒

examples.text: Jack's sitting on the floor watching TV...
examples.translation: 杰克正坐在地板上看电视。

examples.text: We painted the wooden floor with a white stain.
examples.translation: 我们把木地板刷成了白色。

examples.text: It is on the fifth floor of the hospital...
examples.translation: 它位于医院的5层。

examples.text: They occupied the first two floors of the tower.
examples.translation: 他们占用了塔楼的头两层。

examples.text: They spend hours feeding on the ocean floor.
examples.translation: 它们花好几个小时在海底进食。

examples.text: ...a two-hour climb from the valley floor.
examples.translation: 从谷底向上攀登两个小时

examples.text: The issues were debated on the floor of the House.
examples.translation: 这些问题在议院的议员席进行了讨论。

examples.text: The president is taking questions from the floor.
examples.translation: 总统正接受来自听众席的提问。

examples.text: ...the dealing floor at Standard Chartered Bank.
examples.translation: 渣打银行的交易大厅

examples.text: He was floored by the announcement...
examples.translation: 这个通告使他不知所措。

examples.text: He seemed floored by a string of scandals.
examples.translation: 他似乎被一连串的丑闻搞得茫然失措。

examples.text: He was floored twice in the second round.
examples.translation: 在第二轮中他两次被打倒在地。

examples.text: Ministers took the floor to denounce the decision to suspend constitutional rule...
examples.translation: 几位部长发言谴责暂停宪制的决定。

examples.text: Only members would be given the floor.
examples.translation: 只有会员才拥有发言权。

examples.text: The happy couple and their respective parents took to the floor.
examples.translation: 这对幸福的新人和他们各自的父母在舞池中翩翩起舞。

examples.text: Property prices have dropped through the floor...
examples.translation: 房地产价格骤降。

examples.text: Last year, sales went through the floor.
examples.translation: 去年，销售突然下滑。

examples.text: He could wipe the floor with the Prime Minister.
examples.translation: 他能彻底击败首相。

meanings.meaning: 兴旺；茂盛；挥舞；炫耀；华饰
繁荣，兴旺；茂盛；活跃；处于旺盛时期

examples.text: Business flourished and within six months they were earning 18,000 roubles a day...
examples.translation: 生意红火起来，不出6 个月他们就可以每天赚 18,000 卢布了。

examples.text: Racism and crime still flourish in the ghetto.
examples.translation: 城市贫民区的种族主义和犯罪仍然十分猖獗。

examples.text: London quickly became a flourishing port.
examples.translation: 伦敦迅速成为了一个繁荣的港口。

examples.text: The plant flourishes particularly well in slightly harsher climes.
examples.translation: 这种植物在气候条件稍差一点的地区长势尤其好。

examples.text: Britain has the largest and most flourishing fox population in Europe.
examples.translation: 英国拥有欧洲最大也是最具繁殖能力的狐狸种群。

examples.text: He flourished the glass to emphasize the point.
examples.translation: 他挥动手中的杯子来强调这一点。

examples.text: He took his peaked cap from under his arm with a flourish and pulled it low over his eyes.
examples.translation: 他一下子把尖顶帽从胳膊下面掏出来戴在头上，然后把帽檐拉低盖住眼睛。

examples.text: She tended to finish dancing with a flourish.
examples.translation: 她往往以夸张的姿势结束舞蹈。

examples.text: He scrawled his name across the bill, underlining it with a showy flourish.
examples.translation: 他在账单上潦草地签上自己的名字，并在名字下面画了一条花体线。

meanings.meaning: 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬

examples.text: A stream flowed gently down into the valley...
examples.translation: 一条小溪潺潺流进山谷。

examples.text: The current flows into electric motors that drive the wheels.
examples.translation: 电流流向电机，电机带动轮子转动。

examples.text: ...compressor stations that keep the gas flowing.
examples.translation: 使天然气保持流动的压缩机站

examples.text: It works only in the veins, where the blood flow is slower.
examples.translation: 它只在静脉里起作用，在静脉中血液流动更慢一些。

examples.text: Large numbers of refugees continue to flow from the troubled region into the no-man's land...
examples.translation: 大批难民不断从骚乱地区涌入无人地带。

examples.text: Troops would patrol major roads to ensure that traffic flows freely throughout the country.
examples.translation: 军队将在主要道路巡逻以确保全国的交通通畅。

examples.text: She watched the frantic flow of cars and buses along the street...
examples.translation: 她注视着街上小汽车和巴士汇成的滚滚车流。

examples.text: It would monitor traffic flows and provide feedback to motorists.
examples.translation: 它能监控交通状况，然后给司机提供反馈信息。

examples.text: A lot of this information flowed through other police departments...
examples.translation: 大量此类信息在警察机关其他部门中流传。

examples.text: An interest rate reduction is needed to get more money flowing and create jobs.
examples.translation: 需要下调利率来推动资金流动以及创造就业机会。

examples.text: ...the opportunity to control the flow of information.
examples.translation: 控制信息传播的时机

examples.text: In that moment a surge of hatred flowed through my blood...
examples.translation: 那一刻，一股仇恨在我的血液中翻涌。

examples.text: Waves of emotion flowed across his huge face.
examples.translation: 他那张大脸上一时间表情千变万化。

examples.text: Undesirable consequences flow from these misconceptions.
examples.translation: 这些误解造成了不良的影响。

examples.text: ...the psychological effects that can flow from childhood experiences of sexual abuse.
examples.translation: 可能由于儿时受到性侵犯而产生的心理影响

examples.text: His words flowed more readily.
examples.translation: 他说得更加流利了。

examples.text: ...a long white dress which flowed over her body.
examples.translation: 她身上穿的一条飘逸的白色长裙

examples.text: ...long black flowing hair.
examples.translation: 飘逸的黑色长发

examples.text: The wine flowed and we danced the night away...
examples.translation: 我们喝了很多酒，跳了一个晚上的舞。

examples.text: The square was packed, and the cobbled streets flowed with coloured petals.
examples.translation: 广场上挤满了人，鹅卵石铺就的街道上满是五颜六色的花朵。

examples.text: He had been replying for some 40 minutes already and was still in full flow.
examples.translation: 他已经就就此问题回答了 40 分钟左右，仍然不见有停下来的意思。

examples.text: Lunch at Harry's Bar was in full flow when Irene made a splendid entrance...
examples.translation: 当艾琳光彩照人地出现在门口时，哈里酒吧的午餐会正是热闹非凡。

examples.text: The Everton keeper needed all his courage to thwart a charging Vinny Jones in full flow.
examples.translation: 埃弗顿的守门员需要鼓足全部勇气才有可能抵挡住状态正佳的维尼·琼斯的冲锋射门。

examples.text: There's nothing I can do about the problem, so I might as well go with the flow.
examples.translation: 关于这个问题我无能为力，所以我不如就顺其自然好了。

meanings.meaning: 成熟，发育；开花；繁荣；旺盛

examples.text: Each individual flower is tiny.
examples.translation: 每一朵花都很小。

examples.text: ...large, purplish-blue flowers.
examples.translation: 紫蓝色的大花朵

examples.text: ...a bunch of flowers sent by a new admirer.
examples.translation: 又一个仰慕者送来的一束鲜花

examples.text: ...a lawned area surrounded by plants and flowers...
examples.translation: 周围种着植物和花卉的草地

examples.text: The flower garden will be ablaze with colour every day.
examples.translation: 花园每天都将开满各色鲜花。

examples.text: Several of these rhododendrons will flower this year for the first time.
examples.translation: 这些杜鹃花有些将在今年首度开花。

examples.text: Their relationship flowered.
examples.translation: 他们的关系最终开花结果了。

examples.text: Those killed have been described as the flower of Polish manhood.
examples.translation: 那些牺牲者被称为波兰男子中的精英。

examples.text: Some of the daffodils are still in flower...
examples.translation: 有些水仙花仍在开放。

examples.text: As one plant fades, another comes into flower.
examples.translation: 一株植物凋谢了，另一株又会盛开。

examples.text: I got flu...
examples.translation: 我得了流感。

examples.text: He had come down with the flu.
examples.translation: 他得了流感病倒了。

examples.text: Body temperature can fluctuate if you are ill.
examples.translation: 人患病后体温可能会上下波动。

examples.text: ...the fluctuating price of oil.
examples.translation: 油价的浮动

examples.text: Don't worry about tiny fluctuations in your weight...
examples.translation: 不要为体重的细微变化担心。

examples.text: The calculations do not take into account any fluctuation in the share price.
examples.translation: 这些计算没有考虑到股价的波动。

meanings.meaning: 流畅的，流利的；液态的；畅流的

examples.text: She studied eight foreign languages but is fluent in only six of them...
examples.translation: 她学习了8种外语，但是只能流利地说其中 6 种。

examples.text: He speaks fluent Russian.
examples.translation: 他说一口流利的俄语。

examples.text: To work as a translator, you need fluency in at least one foreign language.
examples.translation: 想当一名翻译的话，你至少需要熟练掌握一门外语。

examples.text: He spoke three languages fluently.
examples.translation: 他可以流利地说 3 种语言。

examples.text: He had emerged from being a hesitant and unsure candidate into a fluent debater.
examples.translation: 他从一个吞吞吐吐、缺乏自信的候选人成长为口若悬河的辩论者。

examples.text: His son was praised for speeches of remarkable fluency.
examples.translation: 他儿子因为发言流畅自然而得到了表扬。

examples.text: Alex didn't read fluently till he was nearly seven.
examples.translation: 亚历克斯快到7岁时才能流利地阅读。

meanings.meaning: 流动的；流畅的；不固定的

examples.text: The blood vessels may leak fluid, which distorts vision...
examples.translation: 血管可能会渗漏，造成视力模糊。

examples.text: Make sure that you drink plenty of fluids.
examples.translation: 务必保证足够的水分摄入。

examples.text: ...fluid retention.
examples.translation: 体液潴留

examples.text: The forehand stroke should be fluid and well balanced.
examples.translation: 正手击球应该保证动作流畅和平稳。

examples.text: ...long, fluid dresses.
examples.translation: 线条优雅流畅的长裙

examples.text: She dances with an exquisite fluidity of movement.
examples.translation: 她的舞姿细腻流畅。

examples.text: The situation is extremely fluid and it can be changing from day to day.
examples.translation: 情况极不稳定，每天都有可能变化。

examples.text: ...the complexity and fluidity of the crisis.
examples.translation: 危机的复杂性和不稳定性

meanings.meaning: 激动，洋溢；面红；萌芽；旺盛；奔流
使齐平；发红，使发亮；用水冲洗；使激动
大量的；齐平的；丰足的，洋溢的；挥霍的

examples.text: Do you sweat a lot or flush a lot?...
examples.translation: 你常出汗或是脸上常发烫吗？

examples.text: He turned away embarrassed, his face flushing red.
examples.translation: 他难为情地扭过头去，羞红了脸。

examples.text: There was a slight flush on his cheeks.
examples.translation: 他脸上泛起一丝红晕。

examples.text: Her face was flushed with anger.
examples.translation: 她气得满脸通红。

examples.text: She flushed the toilet and went back in the bedroom.
examples.translation: 她冲完马桶回到卧室。

examples.text: ...the sound of the toilet flushing.
examples.translation: 冲马桶的声音

examples.text: He heard the flush of a toilet.
examples.translation: 他听见冲马桶的声音。

examples.text: He was found trying to flush banknotes down the toilet.
examples.translation: 他试图把钞票从马桶里冲走时被发现。

examples.text: Flush the eye with clean cold water for at least 15 minutes...
examples.translation: 用干净冷水冲洗眼睛至少 15 分钟。

examples.text: Water is ideal to flush the kidneys and the urinary tract.
examples.translation: 用水清洗肾脏和尿道最理想不过。

examples.text: ...an 'alternative' therapy that gently flushes out the colon to remove toxins.
examples.translation: 一种温和冲洗结肠排出毒素的“替代”疗法

examples.text: That won't flush out all the sewage, but it should unclog some stinking drains.
examples.translation: 那样做虽不能将污物全部冲掉，但应该能疏通一些散发恶臭的排水管。

examples.text: They flushed them out of their hiding places...
examples.translation: 他们把他们从藏身之处赶了出来。

examples.text: The Guyana Defence Force is engaged in flushing out illegal Brazilian miners operating in the country.
examples.translation: 圭亚那国防军正采取行动驱逐在本国作业的非法巴西矿工。

examples.text: Make sure the tile is flush with the surrounding tiles.
examples.translation: 要保证每块瓷砖都和它周围的瓷砖在同一平面上。

examples.text: At that time, many developing countries were flush with dollars earned from exports...
examples.translation: 在那时，许多发展中国家都通过出口赚到了大量美元。

examples.text: If we're feeling flush we'll probably give them champagne.
examples.translation: 等我们有钱了就可能会给他们喝香槟。

examples.text: ...the first flush of young love.
examples.translation: 年轻人初尝恋爱滋味的兴奋

examples.text: ...in the flush of victory.
examples.translation: 在一阵胜利的喜悦中

examples.text: ...the flush of recent victories.
examples.translation: 最近接二连三的胜利

examples.text: ...a flush of memories.
examples.translation: 记忆涌现

meanings.meaning: 起泡沫；吐白沫；起着泡沫流动
使起泡沫；使成泡沫状物

examples.text: The water curved round the rocks in great bursts of foam.
examples.translation: 水流撞击岩石，产生大量泡沫。

examples.text: ...shaving foam.
examples.translation: 剃须泡沫

examples.text: ...modern three-piece suites filled with foam rubber...
examples.translation: 有泡沫橡胶填充物的现代家具三件套

examples.text: We had given him a large foam mattress to sleep on.
examples.translation: 我们给了他一张大海绵床垫用来睡觉。

examples.text: I let the water run into it and we watched as it foamed and bubbled.
examples.translation: 我把水引进去，然后我们看着它起沫、冒泡。

examples.text: ...ravines with foaming rivers rushing through them.
examples.translation: 泛着白沫的河水奔腾而过的沟壑

examples.text: Stewart was foaming at the mouth about an incident the previous afternoon.
examples.translation: 斯图尔特正为头天下午的事件而大发脾气。

examples.text: The planes flew through the clouds...
examples.translation: 飞机穿越云层。

examples.text: The bird flew away.
examples.translation: 鸟儿飞走了。

examples.text: He flew to Los Angeles...
examples.translation: 他飞往洛杉矶。

examples.text: He flew back to London...
examples.translation: 他飞回了伦敦。

examples.text: Mr Baker flew in from Moscow.
examples.translation: 贝克先生是从莫斯科飞过来的。

examples.text: Parker had successfully flown both aircraft...
examples.translation: 两架飞机帕克均成功驾驶过。

examples.text: He flew a small plane to Cuba...
examples.translation: 他驾驶一架小型飞机飞往古巴。

examples.text: His inspiration to fly came even before he joined the Army.
examples.translation: 他想开飞机的念头在参军之前就有了。

examples.text: ...a flying instructor.
examples.translation: 飞行教练

examples.text: It may be possible to fly the women and children out on Thursday...
examples.translation: 周四可能会将妇女和儿童空运出去。

examples.text: The relief supplies are being flown from a warehouse in Pisa.
examples.translation: 救济物资正从比萨的一个仓库空运过来。

examples.text: His long, uncovered hair flew back in the wind...
examples.translation: 他那露在外面的长发随风向后飞舞。

examples.text: She was running down the stairs, her hair flying.
examples.translation: 她从楼上跑下来，长发飘动着。

examples.text: They flew the flag of the African National Congress...
examples.translation: 他们升起非洲人国民大会的旗帜。

examples.text: A flag was flying on the new military HQ.
examples.translation: 一面旗帜在新的军事指挥部上空飘扬着。

examples.text: She flew to their bedsides when they were ill...
examples.translation: 在他们生病的时候她飞奔至他们身边。

examples.text: I flew downstairs...
examples.translation: 我飞奔到楼下。

examples.text: There are bullets flying around your head.
examples.translation: 子弹在头顶上呼啸而过。

examples.text: I must fly or I'll miss my plane...
examples.translation: 我必须赶快走了否则就会误机。

examples.text: I'll have to fly.
examples.translation: 我得赶紧走了。

examples.text: Rumours had been flying around the workrooms all morning...
examples.translation: 整个早上流言在各工作间传来传去。

examples.text: Rumours were flying about possible deals.
examples.translation: 关于可能的交易的传闻在满天飞。

examples.text: Ray wouldn't hurt a fly.
examples.translation: 雷心肠很软。

examples.text: ...a lovely girl, who would not have harmed a fly.
examples.translation: 连一只苍蝇都不肯伤害的可爱女孩

examples.text: A simmering row ended with her letting fly with a stream of obscenities.
examples.translation: 激烈的争吵最后以她一连串的污言秽语而告结束。

examples.text: It was all pretty much done on the fly.
examples.translation: 那几乎都是匆忙之中完成的。

examples.text: The blow sent the young man flying.
examples.translation: 这一拳把那个年轻人打翻在地。

examples.text: What I'd give to be a fly on the wall when Davis finds out what's happened to his precious cargo.
examples.translation: 我多么希望能够看到戴维斯发现他珍贵的货物出事时的样子啊。

examples.text: She flew at him for making a very anti-British remark.
examples.translation: 她攻击他激烈的反英言论。

examples.text: Losing a game would cause him to fly into a rage.
examples.translation: 输掉一场比赛会让他暴跳如雷。

meanings.meaning: 使模糊；使困惑；以雾笼罩

examples.text: The crash happened in thick fog...
examples.translation: 浓雾中发生了撞车。

examples.text: These ocean fogs can last for days.
examples.translation: 这种海上大雾可持续数天。

examples.text: ...a fog of stale cigarette smoke.
examples.translation: 一股难闻的香烟烟雾

examples.text: The most basic facts about him are lost in a fog of mythology...
examples.translation: 关于他的那些最基本信息离奇地湮没无踪了。

examples.text: Synchronizing these attacks may be difficult in the fog of war...
examples.translation: 在迷雾一样的战争中可能很难同时发动这些攻击。

examples.text: His mind was in a fog when he finally got up.
examples.translation: 他终于起床了，头脑一片混沌。

examples.text: The windows fogged immediately...
examples.translation: 窗户立刻被雾气笼罩了。

examples.text: Water had fogged his diving mask and he couldn't remember how to clear it...
examples.translation: 水的雾气模糊了他的潜水镜，他却不记得该怎样除雾了。

examples.text: The car windows were fogged with vapor.
examples.translation: 车窗上满是雾气。

examples.text: The car windows fogged up...
examples.translation: 车窗起雾了。

examples.text: It'd fog up their telescopes...
examples.translation: 这会让他们的望远镜蒙上一层雾气。

examples.text: His hair was all wet and his glasses were fogged up.
examples.translation: 他的头发全湿了，眼镜上蒙了一层雾气。

examples.text: The research effort has focused on tracing the effects of growing levels of five compounds...
examples.translation: 研究重点追踪了5种化合物含量上升的影响。

examples.text: He is currently focusing on assessment and development...
examples.translation: 他目前在关注评估和发展。

examples.text: Today he was able to focus his message exclusively on the economy...
examples.translation: 今天他得以将主题全部集中在经济方面。

examples.text: Many of the papers focus their attention on the controversy surrounding the Foreign Secretary.
examples.translation: 许多报纸都把关注的焦点放到围绕外交部长出现的争议上。

examples.text: The UN's role in promoting peace is increasingly the focus of international attention...
examples.translation: 联合国在促进和平方面的作用越来越受到国际社会的关注。

examples.text: The new system is the focus of controversy...
examples.translation: 这个新体制是争议的焦点。

examples.text: Her children are the main focus of her life.
examples.translation: 孩子们是她生活的重心。

examples.text: He said his sudden focus on foreign policy was not motivated by presidential politics...
examples.translation: 他说他突然关注外交政策并非受总统政治的驱使。

examples.text: The report's focus is on how technology affects human life rather than business...
examples.translation: 这个报告关注的是技术如何影响人类生活而非商业活动。

examples.text: IBM has also shifted its focus from mainframes to personal computers.
examples.translation: IBM 公司也把重心从特大型机转向了个人电脑。

examples.text: Somehow, though, their latest album has a focus that the others have lacked...
examples.translation: 但是，他们的最新专辑设法找到了其他专辑所欠缺的一种目的性。

examples.text: Suddenly all of the bizarre and seemingly isolated examples took on a meaningful focus.
examples.translation: 突然之间，所有那些怪异且看上去孤立的例子都具有了意义。

examples.text: Kelly couldn't focus his eyes well enough to tell if the figure was male or female...
examples.translation: 凯利没有看清楚那个人影到底是男的还是女的。

examples.text: His eyes slowly began to focus on what looked like a small dark ball...
examples.translation: 他的眼睛慢慢开始看清楚那个看上去像是个小黑球的东西。

examples.text: He found the binoculars and focused them on the boat...
examples.translation: 他找到双筒望远镜，然后调焦对准那艘船看。

examples.text: Had she kept the camera focused on the river bank she might have captured a vital scene.
examples.translation: 要是她把相机的镜头一直对准河岸的话，可能就捕捉到重要的一幕了。

examples.text: His focus switched to the little white ball...
examples.translation: 他把关注点转移到那个小白球上。

examples.text: Together these factors determine the depth of focus...
examples.translation: 这些因素综合起来决定了景深。

examples.text: It has no manual focus facility.
examples.translation: 它没有手动调焦功能。

examples.text: Magnetic coils focus the electron beams into fine spots.
examples.translation: 磁线圈把电子束聚焦成微小的点。

examples.text: Pictures should be in focus, with realistic colours and well composed groups.
examples.translation: 照片应该图像清晰，颜色逼真，构图合理。

examples.text: This aggression is the real issue the world should be concerned about. We want to keep that in focus...
examples.translation: 这次侵略才是世界应该关注的真正问题。我们想继续保持关注。

examples.text: These issues were brought into sharp focus by the Gulf crisis.
examples.translation: 海湾危机让这些问题备受关注。

examples.text: In some of the pictures the subjects are out of focus while the background is sharp.
examples.translation: 一些照片背景很清晰，被摄主体却因失焦而显得模糊。

examples.text: ...a lot of out-of-focus photographs.
examples.translation: 许多对焦不实的照片

examples.text: The deficit in the US balance of payments put these considerations out of focus...
examples.translation: 美国的国际收支逆差使这些因素没有得到关注。

examples.text: The movement towards democracy in Latin America and the foreign debt problems that have plagued it have gone out of focus.
examples.translation: 拉丁美洲的民主运动和困扰该地区的外债问题已经淡出人们的视线。

examples.text: Country folk can tell you that there are certain places which animals avoid...
examples.translation: 老乡会告诉你有些地方动物是不会去的。

examples.text: These are the folks from the local TV station.
examples.translation: 这些是当地电视台来的人。

examples.text: ...old folks.
examples.translation: 老年人

examples.text: I've been avoiding my folks lately.
examples.translation: 我近来一直在避开家人。

examples.text: 'It's a question of money, folks,' I announced...
examples.translation: “诸位，这是一个钱的问题，”我郑重其事地说。

examples.text: This is it, folks: the best record guide in the business.
examples.translation: 就是这个，伙计们，业内最好的唱片指南。

examples.text: ...South American folk art.
examples.translation: 南美洲的民间艺术

examples.text: ...traditional Chinese folk medicine.
examples.translation: 传统的中国民间医术

examples.text: ...Irish folk music.
examples.translation: 爱尔兰民间音乐

examples.text: ...a variety of music including classical, jazz, and folk.
examples.translation: 包括古典、爵士和民间音乐的各种音乐

examples.text: Jack was a folk hero in the Greenwich Village bars...
examples.translation: 在格林尼治村的酒吧里杰克是人们心目中的英雄。

examples.text: Folk psychology comes closer to the obvious truth than the most sophisticated theories.
examples.translation: 比起最复杂的理论，大众心理学更接近那些显而易见的事实。

examples.text: He folded the paper carefully...
examples.translation: 他把纸小心地折起来。

examples.text: Fold the omelette in half...
examples.translation: 把煎蛋对折。

examples.text: Fold the blanket back.
examples.translation: 把毛毯折回来。

examples.text: ...a folded towel.
examples.translation: 折叠起来的毛巾

examples.text: Make another fold and turn the ends together.
examples.translation: 再折一下，把末端对齐。

examples.text: The priest fumbled in the folds of his gown.
examples.translation: 牧师胡乱整了整长袍上的褶皱。

examples.text: The back of the bench folds forward to make a table...
examples.translation: 长凳的靠背可以向前翻折成一张桌子。

examples.text: This portable seat folds flat for easy storage...
examples.translation: 这张便携椅可以折叠，便于收纳。

examples.text: Check if you can fold the buggy without having to remove the raincover.
examples.translation: 看看你是否能不用拿掉防雨罩就把童车折叠起来。

examples.text: ...a folding beach chair.
examples.translation: 可折叠的沙滩椅

examples.text: When not in use it folds up out of the way...
examples.translation: 不用时就折起放好。

examples.text: Fold the ironing board up so that it is flat.
examples.translation: 把熨衣板折起放平。

examples.text: Meer folded his arms over his chest and turned his head away...
examples.translation: 米尔双臂交叉在胸前，把头转到一边。

examples.text: Mrs Ringrose sat down and folded her hands in her lap.
examples.translation: 林罗斯夫人坐下来，双手叠放在腿上。

examples.text: But as other shops fold, the march of the superstores continues...
examples.translation: 但在其他商店纷纷关门倒闭之时，大型超市的强劲扩张势头却依旧不减。

examples.text: 2,500 small businesses were folding each week.
examples.translation: 每周有2,500家小企业关张。

examples.text: The EU wanted to bring the US back into the fold...
examples.translation: 欧盟想要让美国重新回到他们的阵营之中。

examples.text: He might find it difficult to return to the family fold when he realizes his mistake.
examples.translation: 他可能会发现等他意识到自己的错误时再想重返家族已经非常难了。

examples.text: Fold in the flour...
examples.translation: 拌入面粉。

examples.text: Fold the cream into the egg yolk mixture.
examples.translation: 把奶油调入蛋黄液中。

examples.text: She folded it up, and tucked it into her purse...
examples.translation: 她将其折叠起来，塞进了钱包里。

examples.text: He folded up his paper and put it away.
examples.translation: 他把文件折了几折，然后收了起来。

examples.text: In the centuries following Christ's death, Christians genuinely believed the world was about to end...
examples.translation: 在耶稣死后的几个世纪里，基督徒们真的相信世界将要灭亡。

examples.text: Following a day of medical research, the conference focused on educational practices.
examples.translation: 在就医学研究专题讨论一天后，会议接下来的主题集中在教学实践上。

examples.text: The following day the picture appeared on the front pages of every newspaper in the world...
examples.translation: 第二天照片出现在全世界所有报纸的头版。

examples.text: We went to dinner the following Monday evening...
examples.translation: 接下来那个周一的晚上，我们一起去吃了晚餐。

examples.text: The following year she joined the Royal Opera House.
examples.translation: 次年她加入了皇家歌剧院。

examples.text: Write down the following information: name of product, type, date purchased and price...
examples.translation: 请写明如下信息：产品名称、类型、购买日期和价格。

examples.text: The method of helping such patients is explained in the following chapters.
examples.translation: 关于如何帮助这种病人，下面章节中将会作出解释。

examples.text: The following is a paraphrase of what was said...
examples.translation: 下面是对刚才说过的话的阐释。

examples.text: Do you use any of the following? Pager, Answering machine, Mobile phone, Car phone.
examples.translation: 你使用下面的物品吗？传呼机、电话答录机、移动电话和车载电话。

examples.text: Australian rugby league enjoys a huge following in New Zealand.
examples.translation: 澳大利亚橄榄球联盟在新西兰有众多支持者。

examples.text: The following wind and eastward running tide had given us a very pleasant, lazy sail.
examples.translation: 顺风和向东的潮水使我们的航行很惬意、很省力。

meanings.meaning: 跟随；遵循；追求；密切注意，注视；注意；倾听

examples.text: We followed him up the steps into a large hall...
examples.translation: 我们跟着他上楼来到一个很大的大厅。

examples.text: Please follow me, madam...
examples.translation: 请跟我来，夫人。

examples.text: They took him into a small room and I followed.
examples.translation: 他们把他带到一个小房间，我跟了进去。

examples.text: She realized that the Mercedes was following her...
examples.translation: 她意识到那辆奔驰在跟踪她。

examples.text: I think we're being followed.
examples.translation: 我想我们被跟踪了。

examples.text: He followed Janice to New York, where she was preparing an exhibition.
examples.translation: 他追随贾尼丝到了纽约，她正在那里准备一个展览。

examples.text: ...the rioting and looting that followed the verdict...
examples.translation: 判决宣布之后发生的暴乱和抢劫

examples.text: I remember nothing else about the days following Daddy's death...
examples.translation: 父亲去世之后那几天我不记得有什么其他事了。

examples.text: He was arrested in the confusion which followed...
examples.translation: 他在之后的混乱中被捕。

examples.text: Other problems may follow...
examples.translation: 其他的问题可能会接踵而至。

examples.text: Eyewitnesses spoke of a noise followed by a huge red light.
examples.translation: 目击者说响声过后出现了一道耀眼的红光。

examples.text: Her first major role was in Martin Scorsese's 'Goodfellas' and she followed this with a part in Spike Lee's 'Jungle Fever'.
examples.translation: 她主演的第一部影片是马丁·斯科塞斯的《好家伙》，之后接拍了斯派克·李的《丛林热》。

examples.text: The book proved such a success that the authors followed it up with 'The Messianic Legacy'.
examples.translation: 这本书取得了巨大的成功，作者于是又推出一部《弥赛亚的遗产》。

examples.text: Just because a bird does not breed one year, it does not follow that it will fail the next...
examples.translation: 不能因为一只鸟某一年没有繁殖就断定它第二年也不会繁殖。

examples.text: If the explanation is right, two things follow...
examples.translation: 如果解释是正确的，可以推断出两件事。

examples.text: It is easy to see the conclusions described in the text follow from this equation.
examples.translation: 很容易可以看出文中所述的结论是由这个方程式推出的。

examples.text: What follows is an eyewitness account...
examples.translation: 接下来的是目击者的陈述。

examples.text: There followed a list of places where Hans intended to visit...
examples.translation: 下面列出的是汉斯打算游览的地点。

examples.text: General analysis is followed by five case studies.
examples.translation: 综合分析之后是5个个案研究。

examples.text: If they followed the road, they would be certain to reach a village...
examples.translation: 如果他们沿着这条路走，就一定会到达一个村庄。

examples.text: All we had to do was follow the map...
examples.translation: 我们所要做的就是按照地图走。

examples.text: I followed the signs to Metrocity.
examples.translation: 我循着指示标志找到了地铁城购物中心。

examples.text: Our route follows the Pacific coast through densely populated neighbourhoods...
examples.translation: 我们的路线沿着太平洋海岸，途经人口稠密的街区。

examples.text: The Lot river follows a winding and tortuous course.
examples.translation: 洛特河的河道蜿蜒曲折。

examples.text: Ann's eyes followed a police car as it drove slowly past.
examples.translation: 安注视着一辆缓缓驶过的警车。

examples.text: His release turned out to follow the pattern set by that of the other six hostages.
examples.translation: 最终他的获释方式也和其他 6名人质的获释如出一辙。

examples.text: Take care to follow the instructions carefully...
examples.translation: 注意严格按照说明进行。

examples.text: No two chefs follow the same recipe.
examples.translation: 每个厨师都有不同的烹饪方式。

examples.text: His admiration for the athlete did not extend to the point where he would follow his example in taking drugs...
examples.translation: 他对于这个运动员的崇拜还没有达到要学他吸毒的程度。

examples.text: Where eastern Germany goes the rest will surely follow.
examples.translation: 东德怎样做，其他地方一定会效仿。

examples.text: He followed his father and became a surgeon...
examples.translation: 他子承父业，成为了一名外科医生。

examples.text: Anni-Frid's son has followed her into the music business.
examples.translation: 安妮-弗瑞德的儿子子承母业，也进入了音乐圈。

examples.text: Can you follow the plot so far?...
examples.translation: 目前为止剧情你能看得懂吗？

examples.text: I'm afraid I don't follow.
examples.translation: 恐怕我没明白。

examples.text: ...the millions of people who follow football because they genuinely love it...
examples.translation: 数以百万计的人关注足球，因为他们发自内心地热爱足球

examples.text: She was following Laura's progress closely.
examples.translation: 她密切关注着劳拉的进展。

examples.text: The film follows the fortunes of two women.
examples.translation: 这部电影讲述了两个女人的命运。

examples.text: ...an annotated version of Mozart's opera that allows the listener to follow the score.
examples.translation: 使听者能够一边欣赏一边对照着看的莫扎特歌剧的注释乐谱

examples.text: 'Do you follow any particular religion?' — 'Yes, we're all Hindus.'
examples.translation: “你们有自己的宗教信仰吗？”——“是的，我们都是印度教徒。”

examples.text: The winners are as follows: E. Walker; R. Foster; R. Gates; A. Mackintosh...
examples.translation: 优胜者分别是：E.沃克、R.福斯特、R.盖茨和A.麦金托什。

examples.text: This can be done if you proceed as follows.
examples.translation: 按照如下操作即可完成。

examples.text: Potatoes are still the most popular food, followed by white bread.
examples.translation: 马铃薯仍然是最受欢迎的食物，其次是白面包。

examples.text: He decided on roast chicken and vegetables, with apple pie to follow.
examples.translation: 他决定点烤鸡配蔬菜，然后是苹果派。

examples.text: The leadership has been unwilling to follow through the implications of these ideas...
examples.translation: 领导层不愿意对这些想法的含意进行深入探究。

examples.text: I was trained to be an actress but I didn't follow it through...
examples.translation: 我接受过演员培训，但是我没有坚持下去。

examples.text: He decided to follow through with his original plan.
examples.translation: 他决定把最初的计划执行到底。

examples.text: State security police are following up several leads...
examples.translation: 国家安全警察正在追查几条线索。

examples.text: An officer took a statement from me, but no one's bothered to follow it up.
examples.translation: 一位警官收集了我的供述，但却没有人愿意追查下去。

examples.text: I am very fond of Michael...
examples.translation: 我很喜欢迈克尔。

examples.text: She was especially fond of a little girl named Betsy.
examples.translation: 她尤其偏爱一个名叫贝齐的小女孩。

examples.text: ...a great fondness for children.
examples.translation: 非常喜欢孩子

examples.text: ...a fond father...
examples.translation: 慈父

examples.text: He gave him a fond smile.
examples.translation: 他给了他一个深情的微笑。

examples.text: Liz saw their eyes meet fondly across the table.
examples.translation: 利兹看到他们隔着桌子深情对视。

examples.text: He was fond of marmalade...
examples.translation: 他爱吃橘子酱。

examples.text: She is fond of collecting rare carpets.
examples.translation: 她喜欢收集稀罕少见的地毯。

examples.text: I've always had a fondness for jewels.
examples.translation: 我一直很喜欢珠宝。

examples.text: ...his fondness for cooking.
examples.translation: 他对烹饪的热衷。

examples.text: I have very fond memories of living in our village.
examples.translation: 我对乡村生活有着十分美好的回忆。

examples.text: My dad took us there when I was about four and I remembered it fondly.
examples.translation: 在我 4岁左右爸爸带我去过那里。记忆中那是一次愉快的经历。

examples.text: My fond hope is that we will be ready by Christmastime.
examples.translation: 我痴想着希望我们可以在圣诞假期前准备就绪。

examples.text: I fondly imagined that surgery meant a few stitches and an overnight stay in hospital.
examples.translation: 我天真地以为外科手术就是缝几针，然后在医院里熬一个晚上。

examples.text: Enjoy your food.
examples.translation: 用餐愉快。

examples.text: ...supplies of food and water.
examples.translation: 食物和水的供给

examples.text: ...emergency food aid.
examples.translation: 紧急食品援助

examples.text: ...frozen foods.
examples.translation: 冷冻食品

examples.text: It's not like you to be off your food.
examples.translation: 胃口不好，这可不像你了。

examples.text: Lord Fraser's speech offers much food for thought...
examples.translation: 弗雷泽勋爵的讲演发人深省。

examples.text: Developments in your career may give you food for thought.
examples.translation: 事业上的发展可能会引发你很多的思考。

examples.text: 'You fool!' she shouted...
examples.translation: “你这个白痴!”她大叫道。

examples.text: He'd been a fool to get involved with her!
examples.translation: 他竟然跟她扯到了一起，真是傻瓜！

examples.text: What a damn fool thing to do!...
examples.translation: 做的什么蠢事啊!

examples.text: What can that fool guard be thinking of?
examples.translation: 那个愚蠢的守卫能想什么？

examples.text: Art dealers fool a lot of people...
examples.translation: 艺术经纪人能欺骗很多人。

examples.text: Don't be fooled by his appearance...
examples.translation: 别被他的外表欺骗了。

examples.text: They tried to fool you into coming after us.
examples.translation: 他们想要骗你来追踪我们。

examples.text: What are you doing fooling with such a staggering sum of money?...
examples.translation: 你拿着这么一大笔钱瞎折腾什么呢？

examples.text: He kept telling her that here you did not fool with officials.
examples.translation: 他一直在告诫她这里的官员不好糊弄。

examples.text: ...gooseberry fool.
examples.translation: 奶油醋栗泥

examples.text: Your brother is making a fool of you...
examples.translation: 你哥哥在戏弄你。

examples.text: He'd been made a fool of.
examples.translation: 他被愚弄了。

examples.text: He was drinking and making a fool of himself.
examples.translation: 他在喝酒，让自己出尽了丑。

examples.text: Most managers couldn't care less about information technology. More fool them.
examples.translation: 多数的经理管理者根本不关心信息技术，他们真的很傻。

examples.text: They used to play the fool together, calling each other silly names and giggling.
examples.translation: 他们过去常在一起胡闹，互相取笑。

examples.text: They were fooling around on an Army firing range...
examples.translation: 他们在军队的射击训练场里闲晃。

examples.text: Have you been fooling around with something you shouldn't?
examples.translation: 你有没有做不该做的事？

examples.text: Never fool around with the clients' wives...
examples.translation: 永远不要和客户的妻子乱搞。

examples.text: Her husband was fooling around.
examples.translation: 她的丈夫在外面拈花惹草。

examples.text: Stop fooling about, man...
examples.translation: 不要再扮傻充愣了，老兄。

examples.text: They fooled around for the camera.
examples.translation: 他们在相机前面乱摆姿势。

examples.text: It would be foolish to raise hopes unnecessarily...
examples.translation: 无谓地燃起人们的希望是愚蠢的。

examples.text: It is foolish to risk skin cancer.
examples.translation: 冒患上皮肤癌的风险是愚蠢的。

examples.text: He admitted that he had acted foolishly.
examples.translation: 他承认自己的行为很愚蠢。

examples.text: They don't accept any foolishness when it comes to spending money.
examples.translation: 在花钱的问题上，他们向来很谨慎。

examples.text: I just stood there feeling foolish and watching him...
examples.translation: 我只是傻傻地站在那里看着他。

examples.text: I didn't want him to look foolish and be laughed at.
examples.translation: 我不希望见到他出丑，被别人嘲笑。

examples.text: He saw me standing there, grinning foolishly at him.
examples.translation: 他看见我站在那里，傻乎乎地咧着嘴朝他笑。

examples.text: Several boys were still playing football on the waste ground.
examples.translation: 几个男孩还在那片废弃的空地上踢足球。

examples.text: ...Arsenal Football Club.
examples.translation: 阿森纳足球俱乐部

examples.text: ...Italian football fans.
examples.translation: 意大利足球迷

examples.text: Two blocks beyond our school was a field where boys played football...
examples.translation: 离我们学校两个街区远的地方有个男孩们玩橄榄球的球场。

examples.text: This year's national college football championship was won by Princeton.
examples.translation: 今年全国高校橄榄球锦标赛的冠军是普林斯顿队。

examples.text: I heard footsteps outside.
examples.translation: 我听见了外面的脚步声。

examples.text: My father is extremely proud that I followed in his footsteps and became a doctor.
examples.translation: 我的父亲非常自豪，因为我继承他的事业，成为了一名医生。

examples.text: She stamped her foot again.
examples.translation: 她又跺了跺脚。

examples.text: ...a foot injury.
examples.translation: 足伤

examples.text: ...his aching arms and sore feet.
examples.translation: 他的疼痛的胳膊和酸痛的脚

examples.text: She was barefooted.
examples.translation: 她光着脚。

examples.text: ...pink-footed geese.
examples.translation: 粉脚雁

examples.text: David called to the children from the foot of the stairs...
examples.translation: 戴维在楼梯下面喊孩子们。

examples.text: ...the foot of Highgate Hill...
examples.translation: 海格特山脚下

examples.text: A single word at the foot of a page caught her eye.
examples.translation: 其中一页底部的一个字吸引了她的注意。

examples.text: Friends stood at the foot of the bed, looking at her with serious faces.
examples.translation: 朋友们站在床脚处，神情严肃地看着她。

examples.text: This beautiful and curiously shaped lake lies at around fifteen thousand feet...
examples.translation: 这个形状奇特的美丽湖泊周长约有15,000英尺。

examples.text: ...a shopping and leisure complex of one million square feet...
examples.translation: 占地100万平方英尺的购物休闲中心

examples.text: He occupies a cell 10 foot long, 6 foot wide and 10 foot high...
examples.translation: 他住在一个长 10 英尺、宽 6 英尺、高 10 英尺的小房间里。

examples.text: I have to give my height in feet and inches.
examples.translation: 我得报出自己的身高是几英尺几英寸。

examples.text: I tried to reach the foot brakes but I couldn't.
examples.translation: 我试图去够脚刹，但是没能踩到。

examples.text: Paratroopers and foot-soldiers entered the building on the government's behalf.
examples.translation: 伞兵和步兵代表政府进入大楼。

examples.text: The Government is getting cold feet about the reforms.
examples.translation: 政府对改革缩手缩脚。

examples.text: I don't know anyone in England but I am sure I will manage when I find my feet...
examples.translation: 我在英格兰不认识什么人，但是我相信自己一旦站稳脚跟就可以独当一面。

examples.text: Once he had found his feet he was able to deal with any problem.
examples.translation: 他一旦变得自信了就能够处理任何问题。

examples.text: In that respect he needs to keep his feet on the ground and not get carried away...
examples.translation: 在那一方面他需要脚踏实地，不能飘飘然。

examples.text: Kevin was always level-headed with both feet on the ground.
examples.translation: 凯文总是头脑冷静，脚踏实地。

examples.text: We rowed ashore, then explored the island on foot for the rest of the day.
examples.translation: 我们划船到了岸边，之后余下的时间步行在岛上探险。

examples.text: Everyone was on their feet applauding wildly.
examples.translation: 每个人都站起身来热烈鼓掌。

examples.text: You need someone to take the pressure off and help you get back on your feet...
examples.translation: 你需要有人为你分担压力，帮你恢复元气。

examples.text: He said they all needed to work together to put the country on its feet again.
examples.translation: 他说他们都需要通力协作以使国家恢复元气。

examples.text: He has good looks and charm, and always falls on his feet...
examples.translation: 他长得很帅，也有魅力，总是走好运。

examples.text: While I struggle through life, she lands on her feet.
examples.translation: 在我挣扎过活的时候，她却运气亨通。

examples.text: You're not in a position to remove me. The boot is now on the other foot.
examples.translation: 你没有权力开除我。相反，我现在可以开除你。

examples.text: Put your best foot forward and work on the assumption that there is an acceptable solution to every problem you are likely to face.
examples.translation: 要尽力而为，要相信你可能遇到的每一个问题都会有一个适当的解决方案。

examples.text: He had planned to go skiing on his own in March but his wife had decided to put her foot down.
examples.translation: 他原本打算在 3 月独自去滑雪，但是他的太太决定让他打消这个念头。

examples.text: I asked the driver to put his foot down for Nagchukha.
examples.translation: 我要求司机加大油门去那曲。

examples.text: Our chairman has really put his foot in it, poor man, though he doesn't know it.
examples.translation: 我们的主席真的让人很尴尬，可怜的人，尽管他自己没意识到。

examples.text: After supper he'd put his feet up and read. It was a pleasant prospect.
examples.translation: 晚饭后他会支起双腿，歇一歇，看看书。那真是件很惬意的事情。

examples.text: When he's around, we never put a foot wrong...
examples.translation: 他在的时候，我们从来不会出错。

examples.text: He hardly put a foot wrong in defence and was fine in attack.
examples.translation: 他防守的时候几乎滴水不漏，进攻也很出色。

examples.text: ...the day the first man set foot on the moon...
examples.translation: 人类首次登上月球的那一天

examples.text: A little later I left that place and never set foot in Texas again.
examples.translation: 之后没多久我离开了那个地方，从此再也没有回过得克萨斯。

examples.text: My father didn't mind whom I married, so long as I could stand on my own two feet and wasn't dependent on my husband.
examples.translation: 只要我能够自食其力，不依附于自己的丈夫，嫁给谁我父亲倒是并不介意。

examples.text: Malone got to his feet and followed his superior out of the suite...
examples.translation: 马隆站起身来，跟在他的上司后面走出了套房。

examples.text: The delegates cheered and rose to their feet...
examples.translation: 代表们欢呼着站起身来。

examples.text: He sprang to his feet and ran outside.
examples.translation: 他嗖的一下子站起身来跑了出去。

examples.text: The children were running about under everybody's feet.
examples.translation: 孩子们在周围乱跑，让所有人都很烦。

examples.text: Even though they called the election and had been preparing for it for some time, they got off on the wrong foot.
examples.translation: 尽管他们召集了选举，也为此做了一段时间的准备，但是一开始就走错了。

examples.text: They'll forbid you to marry...
examples.translation: 他们不会准许你结婚。

examples.text: She was shut away and forbidden to read...
examples.translation: 她被关了起来，并且不允许看书。

examples.text: Brazil's constitution forbids the military use of nuclear energy.
examples.translation: 巴西的宪法禁止将核能用于军事用途。

examples.text: His own pride forbids him to ask Arthur's help...
examples.translation: 他的自尊心不允许他开口向阿瑟求助。

examples.text: Custom forbids any modernisation.
examples.translation: 传统习惯阻碍着现代化的进程。

meanings.meaning: 为，为了；因为；给；对于；至于；适合于

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, for is used after some verbs, nouns, and adjectives in order to introduce extra information, and in phrasal verbs such as ‘account for’ and ‘make up for’. It is also used with some verbs that have two objects in order to introduce the second object.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，for 还可以用在一些动词、名词和形容词后，以引出更多信息，还可以用于 account for，make up for 等短语动词中。for 还可以和一些有双宾语的动词连用，引出第二个宾语。

examples.text: I have some free advice for you.
examples.translation: 我可以为你提供免费咨询。

examples.text: ...that intense need to care for your baby.
examples.translation: 那种想要照顾自己婴儿的迫切需要

examples.text: ...a table for two...
examples.translation: 两个人的位子

examples.text: Your mother is only trying to make things easier for you...
examples.translation: 你的母亲只是想把一切安排好，让你未来更顺畅。

examples.text: What have you got for me this morning, Patrick?...
examples.translation: 今天上午你为我安排了些什么，帕特里克?

examples.text: He wanted all the running of the business for himself.
examples.translation: 他想自己管理整个企业。

examples.text: I knew he worked for a security firm...
examples.translation: 我知道他在一家保安公司工作。

examples.text: Have you had any experience writing for radio?
examples.translation: 你有给电台写稿子的经验吗？

examples.text: ...a buyer for one of the largest chain stores in the south.
examples.translation: 南方最大的一家连锁店的采购

examples.text: She appears nightly on the television news, speaking for the State Department.
examples.translation: 她作为国务院的发言人，每晚都会出现在电视新闻中。

examples.text: ...the spokesman for the Democrats.
examples.translation: 民主党发言人

examples.text: If your pharmacy doesn't stock the product you want, have them order it for you...
examples.translation: 如果药店没有你想要的药品，让他们为你订购。

examples.text: I hold a shop door open for an old person...
examples.translation: 我帮一位老人把住店门。

examples.text: He picked the bracelet up for me.
examples.translation: 他帮我把手镯捡了起来。

examples.text: This is the best thing you've ever done – I am so happy for you!...
examples.translation: 这是你做得最棒的一件事——我为你感到高兴！

examples.text: He felt a great sadness for this little girl.
examples.translation: 他为这个小女孩深感悲哀。

examples.text: John, I'm sorry for Steve, but I think you've made the right decisions...
examples.translation: 约翰，我为史蒂夫感到难过，但是我想你的决定是正确的。

examples.text: Mack felt a pitiless contempt for her.
examples.translation: 麦克对她没有同情，只有鄙夷。

examples.text: Many new trains have space for wheelchair users...
examples.translation: 许多新型列车为坐轮椅者留有空间。

examples.text: It would take three to six hours for a round trip...
examples.translation: 往返行程需要 3 到 6 个小时。

examples.text: ...a huge room with plenty of room for books...
examples.translation: 可摆放许多书的大房间

examples.text: Chris couldn't even raise the energy for a smile.
examples.translation: 克里斯甚至连笑一笑的力气都没有。

examples.text: ...fishmongers displaying freshwater fish for sale...
examples.translation: 摆摊卖淡水鱼的鱼贩

examples.text: Skis are available for hire on a daily basis.
examples.translation: 雪橇可以按天租用。

examples.text: ...a room for rent.
examples.translation: 供租用的房间

examples.text: ...a comfortable chair, suitable for use in the living room.
examples.translation: 适合在客厅使用的舒服椅子

examples.text: ...drug users who use unsterile equipment for injections of drugs...
examples.translation: 使用未经消毒的注射器注射毒品的吸毒者

examples.text: The knife for cutting sausage was sitting in the sink.
examples.translation: 切香肠用的刀放在水槽里。

examples.text: ...economic aid for the future reconstruction of the country.
examples.translation: 用于该国未来重建的经济援助

examples.text: He's soon to make a speech in parliament explaining his reasons for going...
examples.translation: 他很快要在议会发表讲话，说明他辞职的原因。

examples.text: The county hospital could find no physical cause for Sumner's problems...
examples.translation: 关于萨姆纳的问题，县医院查不出任何生理上的原因。

examples.text: He has now been formally given the grounds for his arrest.
examples.translation: 他现在已被正式告知了自己被捕的原因。

examples.text: He had a great desire to have a home of his own for he had always lived with my grandmother.
examples.translation: 他强烈渴望拥有一个属于自己的家，因为他一直和我祖母住在一起。

examples.text: ...doing jobs that others turn down for lack of skill...
examples.translation: 做别人不愿意做的没有技术含量的工作

examples.text: They cannot sleep for hunger.
examples.translation: 他们饿得睡不着。

examples.text: If not for John, Brian wouldn't have learned the truth...
examples.translation: 要不是因为约翰，布赖恩也不可能知道真相。

examples.text: The earth would be a frozen ball if it were not for the radiant heat of the sun...
examples.translation: 如果没有太阳辐射的热量，地球就会变成一个冰球。

examples.text: She might have forgotten her completely had it not been for recurrent nightmares.
examples.translation: 要不是因为反复做噩梦，她可能已经把她彻底忘了。

examples.text: The toaster remained on for more than an hour...
examples.translation: 烤面包机持续开了一个多小时。

examples.text: For a few minutes she sat on her bed watching the clock...
examples.translation: 她坐在床上盯着时钟看了几分钟。

examples.text: He smoked one and a half packs of cigarettes a day for about 25 years...
examples.translation: 大约 25 年来，他每天都要抽一包半烟。

examples.text: They talked for a bit.
examples.translation: 他们聊了一小会儿。

examples.text: We drove on for a few miles...
examples.translation: 我们继续往前开了几公里。

examples.text: Great clouds of black smoke were rising for several hundred feet or so.
examples.translation: 大片的黑色烟云升至大约几百英尺的空中。

examples.text: We got the bus back to Tange for 30 cents...
examples.translation: 我们花了 30 美分坐公共汽车回到坦格。

examples.text: The Martins sold their house for about 1.4 million pounds...
examples.translation: 马丁夫妇把他们的房子卖了 140 万英镑。

examples.text: The doctor was prepared to do the operation for a large sum.
examples.translation: 医生做这个手术需要收取高额费用。

examples.text: ...the Welsh Boat Show, planned for July 30–August 1...
examples.translation: 预定于 7 月 30 日至 8 月 1 日期间举办的威尔士船展

examples.text: Marks & Spencer will be unveiling its latest fashions for autumn and winter...
examples.translation: 玛莎百货的最新款秋冬季时装即将亮相。

examples.text: The party was scheduled for 7:00.
examples.translation: 派对定在 7 点举行。

examples.text: He asked his daughter what she would like for her birthday...
examples.translation: 他问女儿过生日想要什么。

examples.text: I'll be home for Christmas.
examples.translation: 我会回家过圣诞节。

examples.text: They would be leaving for Rio early the next morning.
examples.translation: 他们第二天一早要去里约。

examples.text: What matters for most scientists is money and facilities...
examples.translation: 对多数科学家来说，资金和设备是至关重要的。

examples.text: For her, books were as necessary to life as bread...
examples.translation: 对她来说，书就像面包一样，是生活必需品。

examples.text: It would be excellent experience for him to travel a little.
examples.translation: 对他来说，偶尔出去旅游会是很不错的经历。

examples.text: It might be possible for a single woman to be accepted as a foster parent...
examples.translation: 有可能会接受单身女子作为领养人。

examples.text: I had made arrangements for my affairs to be dealt with by one of my children...
examples.translation: 我已经安排我的一个孩子处理我的事务。

examples.text: He held out his glass for an old waiter to refill.
examples.translation: 他把杯子递给一个老服务生重新续杯。

examples.text: He was tall for an eight-year-old...
examples.translation: 对一个 8 岁的孩子而言，他长得很高。

examples.text: He had too much money for a young man.
examples.translation: 对于一个年轻人来说，他太有钱了。

examples.text: Right, who's for a toasted sandwich then?...
examples.translation: 好吧，谁想要吐司三明治？

examples.text: 'What'll it be?' Paul said. —'I'm for halibut.'
examples.translation: “要吃什么？”保罗说。——“我要吃大比目鱼。”

examples.text: Wendy decided the sport was not for her...
examples.translation: 温迪认定这项运动不适合她。

examples.text: Not for me the settled life...
examples.translation: 安定的生活并不适合我。

examples.text: I'm afraid German beer isn't for me.
examples.translation: 恐怕我喝不了德国啤酒。

examples.text: I wish you would come back to Washington with us, but that's for you to decide...
examples.translation: 我希望你能和我们一起回华盛顿，但是这由你决定。

examples.text: It is not for me to arrange such matters.
examples.translation: 我无权安排这些事情。

examples.text: Are you for or against public transport?...
examples.translation: 你是支持还是反对公共交通？

examples.text: I'm for a government that the people respect and that respects the people...
examples.translation: 我拥护一个受到人民尊重并且尊重人民的政府。

examples.text: No, I'm not for abolishing prizes and denying novelists their money.
examples.translation: 不，我不赞成停止颁奖和取消小说家的奖金。

examples.text: Another union has voted for industrial action in support of a pay claim...
examples.translation: 另一个工会已经投票赞成采取要求加薪的劳工行动。

examples.text: The case for nuclear power is impressive...
examples.translation: 这个支持核能的案例令人印象深刻。

examples.text: We have no real, objective, scientific evidence for our belief.
examples.translation: 我们并无实际、客观、科学的证据支撑我们的信仰。

examples.translation: 赞成加大力度支持技术教育的委员会

examples.text: 833 delegates voted for, and only 432 against.
examples.translation: 833名代表投票赞成，只有 432 人反对。

examples.text: Reduced-calorie cheese is a great substitute for cream cheese...
examples.translation: 低卡路里干酪是奶油干酪的极佳替代品。

examples.text: Car park owners should be legally responsible for protecting vehicles...
examples.translation: 停车场场主有保护停放车辆的法律责任。

examples.text: Be prepared for both warm and cool weather...
examples.translation: 对冷暖天气都要做好准备。

examples.text: Make sure you have ample time to prepare for the new day ahead...
examples.translation: 要保证你有足够的时间为即将开始的新的一天做好准备。

examples.text: Special bus and rail services are being laid on to cater for the crowds...
examples.translation: 正在安排专门的巴士和铁路交通服务以满足群众的需要。

examples.text: He was destined for a career in the Bank of England.
examples.translation: 他注定要在英格兰银行开始职业生涯。

examples.text: The Brady Bill is named for former White House Press Secretary James Brady...
examples.translation: 布雷迪法案是以前白宫新闻秘书詹姆斯·布雷迪的名字命名的。

examples.text: Ayer started N. W. Ayer & Son in 1869, naming the firm for his father.
examples.translation: 艾尔在1869 年成立了 N. W. 艾尔父子公司，公司以他父亲的名字命名。

examples.translation: 在该地区每有一个农民失去工作，另外两到三个从事其他工作的人就会面临失业的危险。

examples.translation: 战前每100对夫妇中有一对离婚，现在则是 5 对。

examples.translation: 南极洲的每一寸土地和世界上其他地方相比都是最荒芜的

examples.text: He insists any tax cut be matched dollar-for-dollar with cuts in spending.
examples.translation: 他坚持每一项减税都要和支出削减一一对应。

examples.text: The technical term for sunburn is erythema...
examples.translation: 晒斑的专业术语是红斑。

examples.text: Cancer is derived from the Greek word for crab, karkinos.
examples.translation: cancer 这个词派生自希腊语中表示螃蟹的 karkinos 一词

examples.text: For further information on the life of William James Sidis, see Amy Wallace, 'The Prodigy'.
examples.translation: 想了解关于威廉·詹姆斯·西迪斯生平的更多信息，请参阅埃米·华莱士所著《神童》。

examples.text: I am all for cutting carbon dioxide emissions, but that would be much more easily achieved by giving subsidies to windpower, than with nuclear power...
examples.translation: 我完全赞成减少二氧化碳的排放，但是，相比发展核能，对发展风能提供补贴更容易实现这一目标。

examples.translation: 他完全赞成现役运动员尽可能多赚钱。

examples.text: I was all for it, but Wolfe said no.
examples.translation: 我对此完全赞成，但是乌尔夫说不行。

examples.text: He was married for the second time, this time to a Belgian...
examples.translation: 他第二次结婚，这一次是和一个比利时人。

examples.text: For the first time in my career, I was failing.
examples.translation: 我职业生涯中第一次经历失败。

examples.translation: 许多低成本独立制作的电影使新导演和新演员崭露头角。

examples.translation: 船的前部没有受到直接破坏。

examples.translation: 左前腿膝关节下出现的一个肿块
