examples.text: The old woman glared at him...
examples.translation: 那个老妇人狠狠地瞪着他。

examples.translation: 雅各布瞪着眼睛，嘴里咕哝着什么。

examples.translation: 他那怒不可遏的眼神在眼镜片下显得愈发逼人。

examples.translation: 专用眼镜可使强光减弱。

examples.translation: 据说诺尔玛不喜欢被人过多关注。

examples.translation: 她在电视摄像机的镜头聚焦下公然袭击了警察。

examples.translation: 格罗斯曼把杯子举到唇边。

examples.text: There's a glittering array of glass to choose from at markets.
examples.translation: 市场上有很多晶莹闪亮的玻璃制品可供挑选。

examples.text: He took off his glasses.
examples.translation: 他摘掉眼镜。

examples.translation: 为了一睹女主角的风采，一些追星族已经在海德公园饭店外守候了24个小时。

examples.translation: 她瞥见一群人站在河岸边。

examples.translation: 大学校园变得日益多种族化，通过校园可以对未来社会将要面对的诸多冲突有一个初步的认识。

examples.translation: 对前途的大致展望

examples.text: The bay glittered in the sunshine...
examples.translation: 海湾在阳光下闪闪发光。

examples.translation: 宫殿灯光璀璨。

examples.text: His eyes glittered with a tense amusement.
examples.translation: 他眼里流露出一丝紧张和愉悦。

examples.translation: 用些圆形小金属片或发光小亮片装饰这件女式短上衣。

examples.translation: 她被自己的生活中表面上的光鲜与奢华所蒙蔽。

examples.text: Waiters glide between tightly packed tables bearing trays of pasta.
examples.translation: 侍者们端着一盘盘意大利面在拥挤的餐桌之间自如穿行。

examples.translation: 陪伴我们的仅有那只盘旋的信天翁，它在游艇后面优雅轻盈地翱翔。

examples.text: ...a global ban on nuclear testing...
examples.translation: 全球核试验禁令

examples.translation: 艾滋病很可能会成为造成全球婴儿死亡的首要原因。

examples.text: ...a globally familiar trade name.
examples.translation: 享誉全球的商标名

examples.text: ...the global view, the ability to make wider decisions based on a knowledge of all the facts, not just some of them.
examples.translation: 大局观——基于全部而非部分事实作出更加宏观的决定的能力

examples.text: ...a global vision of contemporary societies.
examples.translation: 对当代社会的总体看法

examples.text: ...bottles of beer from every corner of the globe...
examples.translation: 来自世界各个角落的一瓶瓶啤酒

examples.translation: 地球表面70%的地方覆盖着水。

examples.text: ...a globe of the world...
examples.translation: 世界地球仪

examples.translation: 3个巨大的地球仪立在地板上。

examples.text: The overhead light was covered now with a white globe.
examples.translation: 现在，顶灯已装上了一个白色球状罩子。

examples.text: Inside it's gloomy after all that sunshine...
examples.translation: 尽管阳光明媚，里面依然暗淡无光。

examples.text: ...this huge gloomy church.
examples.translation: 这座昏暗的大教堂

examples.text: Miller is gloomy about the fate of the serious playwright in America.
examples.translation: 米勒对这位严肃剧作家在美国的命运颇为忧虑。

examples.text: He tells me gloomily that he has been called up for army service.
examples.translation: 他伤感地告诉我他已经被征召入伍了。

examples.text: ...a gloomy picture of an economy sliding into recession...
examples.translation: 经济陷入萧条的惨淡景象

examples.text: Officials say the outlook for next year is gloomy.
examples.translation: 官员们表示来年前景黯淡。

examples.text: ...a glorious rainbow in the air...
examples.translation: 空中壮观的彩虹

examples.text: She had missed the glorious blooms of the Mediterranean spring.
examples.translation: 她错过了地中海春季鲜花怒放的绚丽美景。

examples.text: ...a glorious Edwardian opera house.
examples.translation: 气势恢宏的爱德华时代的歌剧院

examples.text: ...gloriously embroidered costumes.
examples.translation: 华丽的刺绣戏服

examples.text: The win revived glorious memories of his championship-winning days...
examples.translation: 这次胜利勾起了他对往昔那些夺冠岁月的美好回忆。

examples.text: We opened the windows and let in the glorious evening air.
examples.translation: 我们打开窗户，让傍晚那沁人心脾的空气流进室内。

examples.text: ...her gloriously happy love life.
examples.translation: 她幸福美满的爱情生活

examples.text: Harrison had a glorious career spanning more than six decades...
examples.translation: 哈里森辉煌的职业生涯长达60多年。

examples.text: Her future could be more glorious even than her past.
examples.translation: 她的未来甚至可能会比过去还要辉煌。

examples.text: But the mission was successful, gloriously successful.
examples.translation: 但是，任务顺利完成，大获成功。

examples.text: I got dressed and emerged into glorious sunshine...
examples.translation: 我穿好衣服，走进灿烂的阳光中。

examples.text: The sun was out again, and it was a glorious day.
examples.translation: 太阳又出来了，这是个艳阳天。

examples.translation: 那天一反常态，天空阳光明媚。

examples.translation: 沃尔沙姆夺得20公里比赛冠军的那一刻无比荣耀。

examples.translation: 我们依然沉浸在夺得锦标赛冠军的荣耀中。

examples.translation: 这张专辑使他们重温了昔日的辉煌，但实际上没有任何新的突破。

examples.text: ...the military glories of Frederick the Great.
examples.translation: 腓特烈大帝军事上的巅峰时刻

examples.text: The glory of the idea blossomed in his mind.
examples.translation: 在他的脑海中这一想法变得越来越宏大。

examples.text: One of the glories of the island has always been its bird population.
examples.translation: 鸟儿的数量一直是该岛的一大骄傲。

examples.text: The workers were glorying in their new-found freedom...
examples.translation: 工人们因才获得的自由而无比喜悦。

examples.translation: 他没有陶醉于过去的成功，而是期望取得更大的成就。

examples.translation: 他把手套塞进口袋里。

examples.text: ...the cigarette's red glow...

examples.translation: 冉冉升起的太阳在田野中洒下金色的阳光。

examples.translation: 涂了润肤霜，我的脸一整天都红润亮泽。

examples.translation: 运动将让你体会到一种有所成就的无比喜悦感。

examples.translation: 他为她取得的成绩深感自豪。

examples.translation: 甚至炉火上方的壁炉台都泛着白光。

examples.translation: 这些颜色搭配使用会使你屋子里暖意融融，充满生机。

examples.translation: 色彩绚丽、镶满金叶的木雕

examples.translation: 树叶在秋日的晨曦中泛出红黄色的光。

examples.text: Her freckled skin glowed with health again.
examples.translation: 她长有雀斑的皮肤又泛出了健康的红光。

examples.text: ...a glowing complexion.

examples.text: The expectant mothers that Amy had encountered positively glowed with pride.
examples.translation: 埃米遇见的准妈妈们个个洋溢着自豪和喜悦。

examples.text: ...high quality glues.
examples.translation: 优质胶水

examples.translation: 用胶水把布料粘在窗户周围。

examples.translation: 材料被剪切下来并粘贴到合适位置。

examples.translation: 它们被粘贴在一起。

examples.translation: 他们都被奥运会吸引住了。

examples.translation: 他目不转睛地盯着钟表。

examples.translation: 戴维·西曼在一个指关节骨折后又回到阿森纳队的球门前。

examples.translation: 他们在上半场比赛中攻入了5球。

examples.translation: 这就需要设立自己的目标并为之努力。

examples.translation: 目的是筹集到尽可能多的资金。

examples.translation: 幸好你没有结婚。

examples.text: It's a good job it happened here rather than on the open road.
examples.translation: 庆幸的是事故发生在这里而不是在公路上。

examples.text: It may cost several billion roubles to make good the damage.
examples.translation: 也许要花上几十亿卢布才能赔偿这一损失。

examples.text: Certain that he was going to make good his threat to kill her, she lunged for the gun...
examples.translation: 他曾威胁要杀了她，而她确定他这次就要向她索命，便冲上前去拿枪。

examples.text: He was confident the allies would make good on their pledges.
examples.translation: 他相信盟友们会履行他们的承诺。

examples.text: Both men are poor boys made good.
examples.translation: 两人都是出身贫穷，最终干出了一番事业。

examples.text: I only ever use that on special occasions so it's as good as new...
examples.translation: 我只在特别的场合下才使用它，所以它跟新的一样。

examples.text: In a day or so he will be as good as new.
examples.translation: 他大概一天工夫就会恢复过来。

examples.text: Good old Harry. Reliable to the end...
examples.translation: 亲爱的哈里。永远值得信赖。

examples.text: There is nothing wrong with good old cauliflower cheese.
examples.translation: 这道令人喜爱的芝士菜花没有什么问题。

examples.text: ...roast goose.
examples.translation: 烤鹅

examples.text: He said that what they were up to would cook Krasky's goose.
examples.translation: 他说他们暗中进行的阴谋可能会使克拉斯基的计划流产。

examples.text: Unregulated tourism can kill the goose that laid their golden egg.
examples.translation: 旅游业的无序发展无异于杀鸡取卵。

meanings.meaning: 商品；动产；合意的人；真本领

examples.text: Money can be exchanged for goods or services.
examples.translation: 钱可以用来换取商品或服务。

examples.text: ...a wide range of consumer goods.
examples.translation: 种类繁多的消费品

examples.text: All his worldly goods were packed into a neat checked carrier bag...
examples.translation: 他的所有家当都装在一个干净的方格图案手提袋里。

examples.text: You can give your unwanted goods to charity.
examples.translation: 你可以将不要的物品捐赠给慈善机构。

examples.text: As long as I deliver the goods, my boss is very happy.
examples.translation: 只要我做好本职工作，我的老板就很高兴。

examples.text: He was the victim of those in his own party who had the goods on him.
examples.translation: 党内一些人掌握了他的把柄，结果他成了牺牲品。

examples.text: ...gorgeous mountain scenery...
examples.translation: 秀丽的山间景色

examples.text: It's a gorgeous day...
examples.translation: 这天过得很愉快。

examples.text: Some of the Renaissance buildings are gorgeous.
examples.translation: 一些文艺复兴时期的建筑美得令人惊叹。

examples.text: She has a gorgeously warm speaking voice.
examples.translation: 她的嗓音温婉动听。

examples.text: The cosmetics industry uses gorgeous women to sell its skincare products...
examples.translation: 化妆品行业常找一些性感美女来推销护肤产品。

examples.text: All the girls in my house are mad about Ryan, they think he's gorgeous.
examples.translation: 跟我同住的女孩都对瑞安很痴迷，她们觉得他非常性感。

examples.text: ...a red-haired man in the gorgeous uniform of a Marshal of the Empire.
examples.translation: 身着华丽的帝国元帅服的红发男子

examples.text: ...gorgeously embroidered clothing.
examples.translation: 华丽的刺绣服装

meanings.meaning: 小道传闻；随笔；爱说长道短的人

examples.text: He spent the first hour talking gossip...
examples.translation: 他头一个小时都在闲聊。

examples.text: There has been much gossip about the possible reasons for his absence...
examples.translation: 关于他缺席的原因有很多传言。

examples.text: Don't you like a good gossip?
examples.translation: 你不想好好地聊聊吗？

examples.text: We spoke, debated, gossiped into the night...
examples.translation: 我们交谈着，争论着，闲聊着，一直持续到晚上。

examples.text: Eva gossiped with Sarah...
examples.translation: 伊娃与萨拉在闲聊。

examples.text: Mrs Lilywhite never gossiped.
examples.translation: 利利怀特夫人从来不说长道短。

examples.text: He was a vicious gossip.
examples.translation: 他总是喜欢说别人的坏话。

examples.text: They go to the polls on Friday to choose the people they want to govern their country...
examples.translation: 星期五，他们去投票站投票选择他们所期望的国家管理者。

examples.text: Their citizens are very thankful they are not governed by a dictator.
examples.translation: 他们的公民十分庆幸没有受独裁者的统治。

examples.text: Marine insurance is governed by a strict series of rules and regulations...
examples.translation: 关于海险有一系列严格的规章制度对其作了规定。

examples.text: The government has altered the rules governing eligibility for unemployment benefit.
examples.translation: 政府已经修改了有关领取失业救济金资格的规章制度。

examples.text: The Government has insisted that confidence is needed before the economy can improve.
examples.translation: 政府坚持认为只有坚定信心经济才会有起色。

examples.text: ...democratic governments in countries like Britain and the US.
examples.translation: 诸如英美等国的民主政府

examples.text: ...fighting between government forces and left-wing rebels.
examples.translation: 政府军和左翼叛乱分子之间的战斗

examples.text: The first four years of government were completely disastrous.
examples.translation: 政府前4年的执政彻底失败。

examples.text: ...our system of government.
examples.translation: 我们的政府体制

meanings.meaning: 主管人员；统治者，管理者；[自] 调节器；地方长官

examples.text: He was governor of the province in the late 1970s...
examples.translation: 他在20世纪70年代末担任该省的省长。

examples.text: Governor William Livingston addressed the New Jersey Assembly.
examples.translation: 威廉·利文斯顿州长在新泽西州议会上发表了演说。

examples.text: Governors are using the increased powers given to them to act against incompetent headteachers.
examples.translation: 董事们运用赋予他们的更大权力罢免不称职的校长。

examples.text: ...the chairman of the BBC board of governors.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司董事会主席

examples.text: The incident was reported to the prison governor.
examples.translation: 这一事件已汇报给监狱长。

meanings.meaning: 长袍，长外衣；礼服；睡袍；法衣

examples.text: The new ball gown was a great success.
examples.translation: 这种新款舞会礼服很畅销。

examples.text: ...wedding gowns.
examples.translation: 结婚礼服

examples.text: ...an old headmaster in a flowing black gown.
examples.translation: 身着宽松黑礼袍的老校长

examples.text: I managed to grab her hand...
examples.translation: 我抓到了她的手。

examples.text: I grabbed him by the neck.
examples.translation: 我掐住他的脖子。

examples.text: He was clumsily trying to grab at Alfred's arms.
examples.translation: 他笨手笨脚地想抓住艾尔弗雷德的手臂。

examples.text: I made a grab for the knife...
examples.translation: 我试图抓住那把刀。

examples.text: Mr Penrose made a grab at his collar.
examples.translation: 彭罗斯先生试图揪住他的衣领。

examples.text: Grab that waiter, Mary Ann.
examples.translation: 玛丽·安，叫那位侍者过来。

examples.text: I jumped on the wall to grab the attention of the crowd.
examples.translation: 为了吸引那群人的注意，我纵身跃上墙头。

examples.text: Grab a beer.
examples.translation: 拿瓶啤酒来。

examples.text: She grabbed the chance of a job interview...
examples.translation: 她抓住了一次求职面试的机会。

examples.text: He grabbed at the opportunity to buy his castle.
examples.translation: 他抓住机会买下了他的城堡。

examples.text: ...a grab for personal power.
examples.translation: 对个人权力的巧取豪夺

examples.text: The famous Ritz hotel is up for grabs for £100m.
examples.translation: 著名的里兹饭店开价1亿英镑供各方竞购。

meanings.meaning: (Grace)人名；(英)格雷斯，格雷丝 (女名)；(法)格拉斯

examples.text: He moved with the grace of a trained boxer...
examples.translation: 他的动作带着一种训练有素的拳击手的风采。

examples.text: Ballet classes are important for poise and grace.
examples.translation: 芭蕾课可以很好地使人保持优雅的仪态。

examples.text: The new King seemed to be carrying out his duties with grace and due decorum...
examples.translation: 新国王在履行职责时看起来举止得体、端庄稳重。

examples.text: The young woman had grace beyond her years.
examples.translation: 这个年轻女子有着超越年龄的涵养。

examples.text: She didn't fit in and she had few social graces.
examples.translation: 她不适合这种场合，对社交礼仪所知甚少。

examples.text: She wanted a couple of days' grace to get the maisonette cleaned before she moved in...
examples.translation: 她想延缓几天，等到把这套复式公寓清理干净后再搬进去。

examples.text: We have only a few hours' grace before the soldiers come.
examples.translation: 士兵到来之前我们只剩下几个小时了。

examples.text: He went to the beautiful old Welsh dresser that graced this homely room...
examples.translation: 他走到为这间舒适的房间增色不少的漂亮的旧威尔士碗橱前。

examples.text: Her shoulders were graced with mink and her fingers sparkled with diamonds.
examples.translation: 肩上披着的貂皮衬托得她更加优雅，手上的钻戒则光彩夺目。

examples.text: He had been invited to grace a function at the evening college.
examples.translation: 他应邀为这所夜校的活动捧场。

examples.text: It was only by the grace of God that no one died.
examples.translation: 承蒙上帝保佑才无人死亡。

examples.text: Leo, will you say grace?
examples.translation: 利奥，你来做饭前祷告吧？

examples.text: ...a Latin grace.
examples.translation: 拉丁文的谢恩祷告

examples.text: Your Grace, I have a great favour to ask of you.
examples.translation: 大人，我想请您施以大惠。

examples.text: All went well at first, and I was in high favour; but presently I fell from grace...
examples.translation: 我最初一帆风顺，备受器重，但现在却失宠了。

examples.text: He did not even have the grace to apologise...
examples.translation: 他甚至连一个道歉都没有。

examples.text: Many of us do stupid things in our youth, but we should have the good grace to admit them.
examples.translation: 我们很多人在年轻的时候都会干些糊涂事，但是，我们应该懂得承认错误。

examples.text: He accepted the decision with good grace, and wished me the very best of luck...
examples.translation: 他欣然接受这一决定并祝我好运。

examples.text: With appallingly bad grace I packed up and we drove north.
examples.translation: 我很不情愿地收拾好行囊，然后我们驱车向北开去。

examples.text: You're so eager to stay in the good graces of the King that nothing else matters to you.
examples.translation: 你如此急于博得国王的欢心，以致其他事情都不管不顾了。

examples.text: His movements were so graceful they seemed effortless.
examples.translation: 他的动作优美自如，看起来毫不费劲。

examples.text: ...graceful ballerinas.
examples.translation: 优雅的芭蕾舞女演员

examples.text: She stepped gracefully onto the stage.
examples.translation: 她步态优雅地走上舞台。

examples.text: A graceful medieval cathedral...
examples.translation: 典雅的中世纪大教堂

examples.text: His handwriting, from earliest young manhood, was flowing and graceful.
examples.translation: 他的字从小就写得流畅优美。

examples.text: She loved the gracefully high ceiling, with its white-painted cornice.
examples.translation: 她喜欢这里高高的天花板，它造型优美，还带有一圈漆成白色的飞檐。

examples.text: Aubrey could think of no graceful way to escape Corbet's company...
examples.translation: 奥布里想不出有什么得体的办法能摆脱科比特。

examples.text: He was charming, cheerful, and graceful under pressure.
examples.translation: 他在重压之下依然开朗迷人，风度优雅。

examples.text: We managed to decline gracefully.
examples.translation: 我们设法婉拒了。

meanings.meaning: 亲切的；高尚的；和蔼的；雅致的

examples.text: She is a lovely and gracious woman.
examples.translation: 她是位可爱又亲切的女人。

examples.text: She closed with a gracious speech of thanks.
examples.translation: 她最后彬彬有礼地致谢，结束了讲话。

examples.text: Hospitality at the Presidential guest house was graciously declined.
examples.translation: 安排下榻总统宾馆的接待被婉拒了。

examples.text: He drove through the gracious suburbs with the swimming pools and tennis courts.
examples.translation: 他驾车穿过设有游泳池和网球场的舒适城郊住宅区。

examples.text: Good gracious, look at that specimen will you?
examples.translation: 哎呀，你快来瞧瞧那个标本！

meanings.meaning: 年级；等级；成绩；级别；阶段
(Grade)人名；(英)格雷德；(法、德、西、葡、塞、瑞典)格拉德

examples.text: Dust masks are graded according to the protection they offer...
examples.translation: 防尘口罩根据它们的防护效果分等级。

examples.text: South Point College does not grade the students' work.
examples.translation: 南点学院不对学生的作业评分。

examples.text: ...a three-tier grading system.
examples.translation: 三等分级制

examples.text: ...a grade II listed building.
examples.translation: 列入二级文物保护的建筑

examples.text: ...weapons-grade plutonium.
examples.translation: 武器级钚

examples.text: ...aviation fuel and high-grade oil.
examples.translation: 航空燃料和高级油

examples.text: What grade are you hoping to get?...
examples.translation: 你希望得到什么样的成绩？

examples.text: There was a lot of pressure on you to obtain good grades.
examples.translation: 你背负了拿到高分的巨大压力。

examples.text: Staff turnover is particularly high among junior grades.
examples.translation: 基层职员的流动率特别高。

examples.text: Mr White teaches first grade in south Georgia.
examples.translation: 怀特先生在佐治亚州南部教一年级。

examples.text: She drove up a steep grade and then began the long descent into the desert.
examples.translation: 她驾车开上一个陡坡，然后沿着长长的下坡路驶入沙漠。

examples.text: I was a naval officer, lieutenant junior grade.
examples.translation: 我是一名海军中尉军官。

examples.text: She had a strong desire to be a dancer but failed to make the grade.
examples.translation: 她非常渴望成为舞蹈演员，但却因为达不到标准而未能圆梦。

examples.text: Losing weight is a slow, gradual process...
examples.translation: 减肥是一个缓慢而渐进的过程。

examples.text: You can expect her progress at school to be gradual rather than brilliant.
examples.translation: 你可以指望她在学习上循序渐进，但别指望她突飞猛进。

meanings.meaning: 授予…学位；分等级；标上刻度

examples.text: In 1973, the first Open University graduates received their degrees.
examples.translation: 1973年，第一批开放大学的毕业生获得了学位。

examples.text: ...graduates in engineering.
examples.translation: 工程学学士

examples.text: The top one-third of all high school graduates are entitled to an education at the California State University.
examples.translation: 高中毕业生当中排名前1/3的学生可以进入加利福尼亚州立大学深造。

examples.text: She graduated in English and Drama from Manchester University.
examples.translation: 她毕业于曼彻斯特大学的英语和戏剧专业。

examples.text: When the boys graduated from high school, Ann moved to a small town in Vermont...
examples.translation: 当儿子们高中毕业后，安搬到佛蒙特州的一个小镇上居住。

examples.text: In 1986, American universities graduated a record number of students with degrees in computer science.
examples.translation: 1986年，美国大学计算机专业的毕业生人数创下了历史纪录。

examples.text: Bruce graduated to chef at the Bear Hotel...
examples.translation: 布鲁斯晋升为大熊饭店的厨师长。

examples.text: From commercials she quickly graduated to television shows.
examples.translation: 她很快就从拍商业广告上升到拍电视节目。

meanings.meaning: 粮食；颗粒；[作物] 谷物；纹理

examples.text: ...a grain of wheat.
examples.translation: 一粒小麦

examples.text: ...rice grains.
examples.translation: 米粒

examples.text: ...a bag of grain.
examples.translation: 一袋谷物

examples.text: ...the best grains.
examples.translation: 优质谷物

examples.text: ...a grain of sand.
examples.translation: 一粒沙子

examples.text: ...coarse-grained salt.
examples.translation: 粗盐

examples.text: There's more than a grain of truth in that.
examples.translation: 其中含有很深刻的道理。

examples.text: Brush the paint generously over the wood in the direction of the grain.
examples.translation: 顺着木材的纹理刷上厚厚的一层漆。

examples.text: ...a hard, heavy, straight-grained wood.
examples.translation: 坚硬粗重、纹理笔直的木头

examples.text: Privatisation goes against the grain of their principle of opposition to private ownership of industry.
examples.translation: 私有化有悖于他们反对工业私有的原则。

examples.text: He doesn't have mastery of the basic rules of grammar.
examples.translation: 他还没有掌握基本的语法规则。

examples.text: ...the difference between Sanskrit and English grammar.
examples.translation: 梵文语法与英文语法的区别

examples.text: His vocabulary was sound and his grammar excellent.
examples.translation: 他的词汇丰富，语法也很精通。

examples.text: ...a deterioration in spelling and grammar among teenagers.
examples.translation: 青少年拼写能力和语法知识的下降

examples.text: ...an advanced English grammar.
examples.translation: 高阶英语语法书

examples.text: Transformational grammars are more restrictive.
examples.translation: 转换生成语法局限性更大。

meanings.meaning: 宏伟的；豪华的；极重要的

examples.text: ...this grand building in the center of town...
examples.translation: 这幢位于市中心的宏伟建筑

examples.text: The scenery of South Island is on a grand scale.
examples.translation: 南岛风光壮观秀丽。

examples.text: Critics will point to other grand schemes that have gone less well, such as Sheffield's World Student Games disaster...
examples.translation: 批评家将会指出其他一些并不成功的大项目，比如谢菲尔德世界大学生运动会这一败笔。

examples.text: The grand design of Europe's monetary union is already agreed.
examples.translation: 欧洲统一货币的宏伟构想已经获得认同。

examples.text: He is grander and even richer than the Prince of Wales...
examples.translation: 他比威尔士亲王还牛气，甚至更有钱。

examples.text: The Duke of Clarence will be there, and many of your grander friends.
examples.translation: 克拉伦斯公爵将会到场，还有你许多牛不可及的朋友亦将出席。

examples.text: Few museums could rival the Old Royal Observatory at Greenwich for a grand day out...
examples.translation: 若想找个地儿开心地逛一天，没有哪家博物馆能比得上格林尼治皇家天文台。

examples.text: The dinner was a grand success...
examples.translation: 晚宴办得十分成功。

examples.text: He was having a grand time meeting new sorts of people.
examples.translation: 结识形形色色的人让他很开心。

examples.text: He was a grand bloke.
examples.translation: 他非常了不起。

examples.text: It came to a grand total of £20,329.
They stayed at The Grand Hotel, Budapest.
examples.translation: 他们住在布达佩斯大饭店。

examples.text: They're paying you ten grand now for those adaptations of old plays.
examples.translation: 他们打算付你一万美元作为改编老剧本的报酬。

examples.text: My grandmothers are both widows.
examples.translation: 我奶奶和外婆都是孤寡一人。

meanings.meaning: (Grant)人名；(瑞典、葡、西、俄、罗、英、塞、德、意)格兰特；(法)格朗

examples.text: They'd got a special grant to encourage research...
examples.translation: 他们得到一笔用以鼓励科研的特别经费。

examples.text: Unfortunately, my application for a grant was rejected.
examples.translation: 很遗憾，我的助学金申请被拒绝了。

examples.text: France has agreed to grant him political asylum...
examples.translation: 法国已经同意给予他政治避难。

examples.text: It was a Labour government which granted independence to India and Pakistan...
examples.translation: 是工党政府同意了印度和巴基斯坦的独立。

examples.text: Permission was granted a few weeks ago.
examples.translation: 几周前已获得了许可。

examples.text: The magistrates granted that the charity was justified in bringing the action.
examples.translation: 地方法官承认该慈善机构有理由提起诉讼。

examples.text: He took a risk, I'll grant you. But when you think about it, the risk was pretty small...
examples.translation: 我承认他有些冒险，但是回过来想一想，其实风险并不大。

examples.text: I grant you that there have been excesses here and there. But this happens in any popular national struggle.
examples.translation: 我承认各地出现了一些过激行为，但是这种现象在任何大规模民族斗争中都在所难免。

examples.text: What right has the family to take me for granted, Martin?...
examples.translation: 这家人有什么资格瞧不起我，马丁？

examples.text: The officials felt taken for granted and grumbled loudly.
examples.translation: 这些官员感到受了怠慢，于是大声抱怨起来。

examples.text: I was amazed that virtually all the things I took for granted up north just didn't happen in London.
examples.translation: 几乎所有我认为在北方是理所当然的事情在伦敦都没有发生，这让我惊诧不已。

examples.text: He seemed to take it for granted that he should speak as a representative.
examples.translation: 他似乎想当然地认为他应该以代表的身份发言。

meanings.meaning: 葡萄；葡萄酒；葡萄树；葡萄色
(Grape)人名；(法)格拉普；(德、瑞典)格拉佩

examples.text: These accusations have been going on for some time now, but it is just sour grapes.
examples.translation: 这些指责到现在已经持续了一段时间，但这不过是吃不到葡萄说葡萄酸罢了。

examples.text: Where we are going you will have one profile on Yahoo, one social graph on Yahoo.

meanings.meaning: 形象的；图表的；绘画似的

examples.text: The descriptions of sexual abuse are graphic.
examples.translation: 这些性虐待的描写绘声绘色。

examples.text: ...graphic scenes of drug taking.
examples.translation: 赤裸裸的吸毒场景

examples.text: Here, graphically displayed, was confirmation of the entire story.
examples.translation: 通过这里形象的展示证实了整件事的真实性。

examples.text: ...fine and graphic arts.
examples.translation: 美术与平面艺术

examples.text: ...a computer manufacturer which specialises in graphics.
examples.translation: 专注于图形设计的计算机制造商

examples.text: The articles are noticeably shorter with strong headlines and graphics...
examples.translation: 这些文章明显短了许多，并且配上了醒目的标题和图表。

examples.text: The Agriculture Department today released a new graphic to replace the old symbol.
examples.translation: 农业部今天发布了一个新图标以取代旧标志。

examples.text: He grasped both my hands...
examples.translation: 他紧紧抓住我的双手。

examples.text: She was trying to grasp at something.
examples.translation: 她正试图抓住什么东西。

examples.text: His hand was taken in a warm, firm grasp.
examples.translation: 他的手被热情地紧紧握住了。

examples.text: The people in your grasp are not guests, they are hostages...
examples.translation: 你所控制的这些人不是客人，而是人质。

examples.text: She allowed victory to slip from her grasp.
examples.translation: 她让胜利从手中溜走了。

examples.text: ...the task of liberating a number of states from the grasp of tyrants.
examples.translation: 将多个国家从暴君手中解放出来的任务

examples.text: The Government has not yet grasped the seriousness of the crisis...
examples.translation: 政府当局还没有意识到这场危机的严重性。

examples.text: He instantly grasped that Stephen was talking about his wife.
examples.translation: 他马上就明白斯蒂芬在说他的妻子。

examples.text: They have a good grasp of foreign languages.
examples.translation: 他们外语掌握得很好。

examples.text: Peace is now within our grasp.
examples.translation: 现在和平在望。

examples.text: Small things stirred in the grass around the tent...
examples.translation: 一些小东西在帐篷四周的草丛里窸窸窣窣地动着。

examples.text: The lawn contained a mixture of grasses.
examples.translation: 草坪上生长着各种青草。

examples.text: In the old days, there were strict fines for walking on the grass or missing a study period...
examples.translation: 过去，踩踏草坪或旷课都会被重金处罚。

examples.text: I'm going to cut the grass.
examples.translation: 我要去修剪草坪了。

examples.text: I started smoking grass when I was about sixteen.
examples.translation: 我大约16岁的时候开始吸大麻。

examples.text: His wife wants him to grass on the members of his own gang...
examples.translation: 妻子要他向警方告发他所在团伙的成员。

examples.text: He was repeatedly attacked by other inmates, who accused him of grassing.
examples.translation: 他屡遭指责他告密的其他囚犯的殴打。

examples.text: How many of them are going to grass up their own kids to the police?
examples.translation: 他们当中会有多少人向警方揭发自己的孩子呢？

examples.text: He was very happy with us but wanted to see if the grass was greener elsewhere.
examples.translation: 他对我们感到十分满意，但还想看看是否有更合适的人选。

examples.text: The Prime Minister refused to be put out to grass. Asked if he would quit, he replied: 'The answer is No'.
examples.translation: 首相拒绝被解除职务，当问到他是否会辞职时，他说，“我的回答是不。”

meanings.meaning: 感谢的；令人愉快的，宜人的

examples.text: She was grateful to him for being so good to her...
examples.translation: 他对她这么好，令她很感激。

examples.text: I should like to extend my grateful thanks to all the volunteers.
examples.translation: 我想对所有的志愿者致以衷心的谢意。

examples.text: 'That's kind of you, Sally,' Claire said gratefully.
examples.translation: “你真是太好心了，萨莉，”克莱尔感激地说道。

examples.text: ...a sense of gratitude...
examples.translation: 感恩图报之意

examples.text: I wish to express my gratitude to Kathy Davis for her immense practical help.
examples.translation: 凯茜·戴维斯实实在在地帮了大忙，我想对她表示感谢。

meanings.meaning: (Grave)人名；(英)格雷夫；(德、瑞典)格拉弗；(法)格拉夫；(俄、葡)格拉韦

examples.text: They used to visit her grave twice a year.
examples.translation: 他们以前每年去她的墓前凭吊两次。

examples.text: ...drinking yourself to an early grave...
examples.translation: 纵酒而自折其寿

examples.text: Most men would rather go to the grave than own up to feelings of dependency.
examples.translation: 大多数男人宁死都不愿承认有依赖感。

examples.text: He said that the situation in his country is very grave...
examples.translation: 他说他的国家情况十分危急。

examples.text: I have grave doubts that the documents tell the whole story.
examples.translation: 我对这些文件能否说明所有的问题深表怀疑。

examples.text: They had gravely impaired the credibility of the government.
examples.translation: 他们严重地损害了政府的信誉。

examples.text: William was up on the roof for some time and when he came down he looked grave...
examples.translation: 威廉在屋顶上呆了一段时间，他下来的时候面色凝重。

examples.text: Anxiously, she examined his unusually grave face.
examples.translation: 她忐忑不安地审视着他异常严肃的脸色。

examples.text: 'I think I've covered that business more than adequately,' he said gravely.
examples.translation: “我想我已经把那件事说得够详细了，”他正色说道。

examples.text: The magazine isn't trying to ruin his career, the man's digging his own grave by refusing an interview.
examples.translation: 这份杂志并非想断送他的事业，而他拒绝接受采访就是在自毁前程。

examples.text: Darwin must be turning in his grave at the thought of what is being perpetrated in his name.
examples.translation: 一想到冒他之名所做下的那些事，达尔文在九泉之下一定不得安宁。

meanings.meaning: 重力，地心引力；严重性；庄严

examples.text: Arrows would continue to fly forward forever in a straight line were it not for gravity, which brings them down to earth.
examples.translation: 要不是重力使箭落向地面，它们将永远以直线往前飞行。

examples.text: They deserve punishment which matches the gravity of their crime...
examples.translation: 应当根据罪行的严重性来惩治他们。

examples.text: Not all acts of vengeance are of equal gravity.
examples.translation: 并非所有的报复行为都同等恶劣。

examples.text: There was an appealing gravity to everything she said.
examples.translation: 她说的每句话都带着一种庄严，很能吸引人。

examples.text: ...grease-stained hands.
examples.translation: 沾满油渍的手

examples.text: I greased front and rear hubs and adjusted the brakes.
examples.translation: 我在前后轮毂上都抹了润滑油，还调校了刹车。

examples.text: His hair is thick with grease.
examples.translation: 他的头发油乎乎的。

examples.text: He could smell the bacon grease.
examples.translation: 他闻到一股腌肉的油脂味儿。

examples.text: Grease two sturdy baking sheets and heat the oven to 400 degrees...
examples.translation: 在两块结实的烤板上抹些油，把烤炉加热到400度。

examples.text: Place the frozen rolls on a greased baking tray.
examples.translation: 将冷冻的肉卷放到抹了油的烤盘上。

examples.text: Five cows graze serenely around a massive oak...
examples.translation: 5头奶牛在一棵大橡树旁悠闲自在地啃着青草。

examples.text: The hills have been grazed by sheep because they were too steep to be ploughed...
examples.translation: 这几座山过于陡峭，不适于耕种，所以就用来牧羊了。

examples.text: Several horses grazed the meadowland.
examples.translation: 几匹马在牧场吃草。

examples.text: ...a large herd of grazing animals.
examples.translation: 一大群正在吃草的动物

examples.text: I had grazed my knees a little.
examples.translation: 我的膝盖擦破了一点皮。

examples.text: ...grazed arms and legs.
examples.translation: 擦伤了的四肢

examples.text: A bullet had grazed his arm...
examples.translation: 一颗子弹擦过他的手臂。

examples.text: Wright managed a shot but it grazed the near post and rolled harmlessly across the goal.
examples.translation: 赖特勉强起脚射门，但是球擦着近门柱有惊无险地偏出了球门。

examples.text: He attacked greedy bosses for awarding themselves big rises...
examples.translation: 他抨击那些贪心的老板为他们自己大幅加薪。

examples.text: She is greedy and selfish.
examples.translation: 她既贪婪又自私。

examples.text: Livy ate the pasties greedily and with huge enjoyment.
examples.translation: 莉薇津津有味地大口吃着点心。

meanings.meaning: 伟大的，重大的；极好的，好的；主要的

examples.text: The room had a great bay window.
examples.translation: 这间房有一扇巨大的凸窗。

examples.text: ...a great hall as long and high as a church.
examples.translation: 长度和高度与教堂相当的大厅

examples.text: I'll take great care of it...
examples.translation: 我会加倍爱惜它的。

examples.text: Benjamin Britten did not live to a great age.
examples.translation: 本杰明·布里顿并未活到很大的年纪。

examples.text: ...the great cultural achievements of the past...
examples.translation: 昔日辉煌的文化成就

examples.text: America can be great again.
examples.translation: 美国会再度崛起。

examples.text: A nation must take certain risks to achieve greatness.
examples.translation: 一个国家想取得巨大的成就必定要冒一定的风险。

examples.text: Wes Hall was once one of the West Indies' great cricketers.
examples.translation: 韦斯·霍尔曾经是西印度群岛伟大的板球运动员之一。

examples.text: ...the great George Padmore.
examples.translation: 伟大的乔治·帕德莫尔

examples.text: Abraham Lincoln achieved greatness.
examples.translation: 亚伯拉罕·林肯成就卓越。

examples.text: ...all the greats of Hollywood.
examples.translation: 所有的好莱坞名流

examples.text: ...cycling's all-time greats.
examples.translation: 空前杰出的自行车运动员

examples.text: ...a medley of rock'n'roll greats.
examples.translation: 摇滚金曲大联唱

examples.text: Arturo has this great place in Cazadero...
examples.translation: 阿图罗在卡扎德罗威望极高。

examples.text: They're a great bunch of guys...
examples.translation: 他们是一群很棒的小伙子。

examples.text: I think she's great.
examples.translation: 我认为她很了不起。

examples.text: I feel just great.
examples.translation: 我感觉好极了。

examples.text: ...a great big Italian wedding.
examples.translation: 场面盛大的意大利式婚礼

examples.text: ...her sense of colour and great eye for detail.
examples.translation: 她对颜色的感觉和捕捉细节的非凡眼力

examples.text: Oh great! That'll be good for Fergus.
examples.translation: 哦，太棒了！那将对弗格斯很有利。

examples.text: 'Oh great,' I thought. 'Just what I need.'
examples.translation: “哼，”我想，“正合我心。”

examples.text: ...the great white shark.
examples.translation: 大白鲨

examples.text: ...shiny red and green apples...
examples.translation: 红红绿绿、富有光泽的苹果

examples.text: Yellow and green together make a pale green.
examples.translation: 黄色与绿色混合能调配出淡绿色。

examples.text: Cairo has only thirteen square centimetres of green space for each inhabitant.
examples.translation: 开罗居民的人均绿地面积仅13平方厘米。

examples.text: ...the lush greenness of the river valleys.
examples.translation: 郁郁葱葱的河谷

examples.text: The power of the Green movement in Germany has made that country a leader in the drive to recycle more waste materials.
examples.translation: 德国环保运动的影响力使得该国率先发起了回收利用更多废品的运动。

examples.text: ...trying to persuade governments to adopt greener policies...
examples.translation: 试图说服政府采取更为环保的政策

examples.text: Our children are being educated to be green in everything they do.
examples.translation: 我们的孩子所受的教育是凡事都要注重环保。

examples.text: A Swiss company offers to help environmental investors by sending teams round factories to ascertain their greenness.
examples.translation: 一家瑞士公司表示愿意向工厂周边派遣小组进行环境检测以协助环境投资者。

examples.text: The Greens see themselves as a radical alternative to the two major British political parties.
examples.translation: 绿党人士认为他们与英国的两个主要政党截然不同。

examples.text: ...the 18th green.
examples.translation: 第18洞轻击区

examples.text: ...the village green.
examples.translation: 村子里的草坪

examples.text: ...Bethnal Green.
examples.translation: 贝斯纳尔格林区

examples.text: Eat your greens.
examples.translation: 把青菜吃掉。

examples.text: Pick and ripen any green fruits in a warm dark place.
examples.translation: 摘些还没有熟的水果然后在温暖阴暗的地方放熟。

examples.text: He was a young lad, very green, very immature.
examples.translation: 他还是个毛头小子，幼稚得很，一点都不成熟。

examples.text: You don't need green fingers to fill your home with lush leaves.
examples.translation: 不是园艺大师也可以把自己的家里装点得绿意盎然。

meanings.meaning: 温室 造成温室效应的

examples.text: What's more, South Asia also borders with China, the biggest greenhouse gas emitter in the world.

meanings.meaning: 欢迎，迎接；致敬，致意；映入眼帘

examples.text: She liked to be home to greet Steve when he came in from school.
examples.translation: 她喜欢呆在家里迎接放学回家的史蒂夫。

examples.text: The European Court's decision has been greeted with dismay by fishermen...
examples.translation: 渔民对欧洲法庭的裁决感到失望。

examples.text: It is unlikely that this suggestion will be greeted enthusiastically in the Baltic States.
examples.translation: 该提议不大可能在波罗的海诸国得到热烈响应。

examples.text: I was greeted by a shocking sight...
examples.translation: 一幅令人震惊的画面映入我的眼帘。

examples.text: The savoury smell greeted them as they went through the door.
examples.translation: 他们进门时一阵香味扑鼻而来。

examples.text: His greeting was familiar and friendly...
examples.translation: 他的问候让人觉得随意又亲切。

examples.text: They exchanged greetings...
examples.translation: 他们互致问候。

examples.text: He raised a hand in greeting.
examples.translation: 他挥挥手打了个招呼。

examples.text: ...a grey suit.
examples.translation: 灰色套装

examples.text: ...my grey hair...
examples.translation: 我灰白的头发

examples.text: Eddie was going grey.
examples.translation: 埃迪的头发开始变白了。

examples.text: It was a grey, wet April Sunday.
examples.translation: 这是4月一个阴雨绵绵的星期天。

examples.text: ...winter's greyness.
examples.translation: 冬日的阴沉

examples.text: Brazilians look gloomily forward to a New Year that even the president admits will be grey and cheerless.
examples.translation: 展望新年，巴西人心情沮丧，甚至连总统都承认明年困难重重，不容乐观。

examples.text: In this new world of greyness there is an attempt to remove all risks.
examples.translation: 身处这个前景暗淡的新世界，人们力图排除所有的风险。

examples.text: ...little grey men in suits.
examples.translation: 身着西服、缺乏个性的小个子男人们

examples.text: Journalists are frustrated by his apparent greyness.
examples.translation: 他毫无个人魅力可言，这让记者们很失望。

examples.text: There was further evidence of grey consumer power last week, when Ford revealed a car designed with elderly people in mind.
examples.translation: 福特汽车公司为老年人设计的一款汽车于上周亮相，这进一步体现了老年消费者的购买力。

examples.text: ...a huge outpouring of national grief for the victims of the shootings...
examples.translation: 举国上下对枪击事件中的遇害者所表现出的万分悲痛之情

examples.text: Their grief soon gave way to anger.
examples.translation: 他们的悲痛迅速转化为愤怒。

examples.text: So many marriages have come to grief over lack of money...
examples.translation: 许多婚姻都因缺钱而以失败告终。

examples.text: He was driving a Mercedes racer at 100 mph and almost came to grief.
examples.translation: 他当时驾驶着一辆梅塞德斯赛车以每小时100英里时速度飞驰，险些出事。

examples.text: 'He's been arrested for theft and burglary.' — 'Good grief!'
examples.translation: “他因为偷窃和入室盗窃而被逮捕了。”——“我的天哪！”

examples.text: He's grieving over his dead wife and son...
examples.translation: 他因丧妻失子而悲痛不已。

examples.text: I didn't have any time to grieve...
examples.translation: 我没有时间伤心。

examples.text: Margery's grieving family battled to come to terms with their loss.
examples.translation: 玛格丽万分悲痛的家人努力从丧亲之痛中恢复过来。

examples.text: He was deeply grieved by the sufferings of the common people...
examples.translation: 百姓的困苦使他痛心不已。

examples.text: I was grieved to hear of the suicide of James...
examples.translation: 听到詹姆斯自杀的消息，我非常伤心。

examples.text: It grieved me to see the poor man in such distress.
examples.translation: 看见这个可怜的人如此困窘，我很难过。

examples.text: They painted a grim picture of growing crime...
examples.translation: 他们描绘了犯罪率上升的严峻情形。

examples.text: There was further grim economic news yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天又传来更多令人沮丧的经济消息。

examples.text: The mood could not have been grimmer.
examples.translation: 情绪低落到了极点。

examples.text: ...an unrelenting grimness of tone.
examples.translation: 语气中一直带着沮丧

examples.text: The city might be grim at first, but there is a vibrancy and excitement.
examples.translation: 这座城市最初可能并不吸引人，但是它有一种生机和活力。

examples.text: ...the tower blocks on the city's grim edges.
examples.translation: 矗立在荒凉的城市边缘的一幢幢塔楼

examples.text: She was a grim woman with a turned-down mouth...
examples.translation: 她是个沉默寡言、令人畏惧的女人。

examples.text: Her expression was grim and unpleasant.
examples.translation: 她表情严肃，看上去很不开心。

examples.text: 'It's too late now to stop him,' Harris said grimly.
examples.translation: “现在阻止他已经太晚了，”哈里斯严肃地说道。

examples.text: Things were pretty grim for a time.
examples.translation: 事情一度糟糕透了。

examples.text: He grins, delighted at the memory...
examples.translation: 想到往事，他开心地咧嘴笑了起来。

examples.text: Sarah tried several times to catch Philip's eye, but he just grinned at her.
examples.translation: 萨拉几次想引起菲利普的注意，但是他只是冲她咧嘴笑了笑。

examples.text: ...a statue of a grinning old man cutting the throat of a deer.
examples.translation: 一边割鹿喉、一边咧着嘴笑的老人雕像

examples.text: She came out of his office with a big grin on her face...
examples.translation: 她笑容满面地走出他的办公室。

examples.text: Bobby looked at her with a sheepish grin.
examples.translation: 博比望着她腼腆地咧嘴一笑。

examples.text: They cannot stand the sight of each other, but they will just have to grin and bear it.
examples.translation: 他们连看对方一眼都不愿意，但是也只得默默忍受。

examples.text: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
examples.translation: 将胡椒粒储存在密封容器中，在需要的时候磨成粉。

examples.text: ...the odor of fresh ground coffee.
examples.translation: 现磨咖啡的香气

examples.text: He makes his own paint, grinding up the pigment with a little oil.
examples.translation: 他就着几滴油磨了些颜料，自己制油彩。

examples.text: 'Well,' I said, grinding my cigarette nervously into the granite step.
examples.translation: “好吧，”我边说边紧张不安地把香烟在花岗岩台阶上捻灭。

examples.text: If you know you're grinding your teeth, particularly at night, see your dentist.
examples.translation: 如果你知道自己在磨牙，尤其是在夜间，你应该去看看牙医。

examples.text: ...a shop where they grind knives...
examples.translation: 磨刀铺

examples.text: The tip can be ground to a much sharper edge to cut smoother and faster.
examples.translation: 可以把尖端磨得更锋利些，这样切割起来更顺更快。

examples.text: Tanks had crossed the border at five fifteen and were grinding south.
examples.translation: 坦克队于5点15分越过边境，正轰隆隆地缓慢向南开进。

examples.text: The grind of heavy machines could get on their nerves.
examples.translation: 重型机器发出的刺耳的摩擦声会让他们心烦意乱。

examples.text: The daily grind of government is done by Her Majesty's Civil Service...
examples.translation: 枯燥的日常政务都由女王陛下的政府行政部门来处理。

examples.text: Life continues to be a terrible grind for the ordinary person.
examples.translation: 生活对于平头百姓而言依然是理不清的琐事。

examples.text: The peace process has ground to a halt while Israel struggles to form a new government.
examples.translation: 当以色列竭力组建新政府的时候，和平进程已经陷于停顿。

examples.text: The tanks ground to a halt after a hundred yards because the fuel had been siphoned out.
examples.translation: 由于燃油被人抽走，这些坦克行驶了100码后又轰隆隆地缓缓停了下来。

meanings.meaning: 紧握；柄；支配；握拍方式；拍柄绷带

examples.text: She gripped the rope.
examples.translation: 她紧紧抓住绳索。

examples.text: His strong hand eased the bag from her grip.
examples.translation: 他强有力的手迫使她松开了握紧袋子的双手。

examples.text: The president maintains an iron grip on his country...
examples.translation: 总统牢牢地控制着他的国家。

examples.text: Tony Blair last night tightened his grip on Labour mps with new powers to root out troublemakers.
examples.translation: 昨晚，托尼·布莱尔利用新赋予的权力铲除了制造事端者，加强了对工党议员的控制。

examples.text: Pain gripped him...
examples.translation: 他感到一阵剧痛。

examples.text: The entire community has been gripped by fear.
examples.translation: 恐惧笼罩着整个社区。

examples.text: The nation is gripped by the dramatic story.
examples.translation: 举国上下都为那个戏剧性的故事牵动着。

examples.text: The film turned out to be a gripping thriller.
examples.translation: 那部电影原来是部扣人心弦的惊悚片。

examples.text: ...a new way of reinforcing rubber which gives car tyres better grip.
examples.translation: 加固橡胶以增强车胎抓地力的新方法

examples.text: The government's first task is to get to grips with the economy.
examples.translation: 政府的首要任务是处理好经济问题。

examples.text: Britain is still in the grip of recession.
examples.translation: 英国依然没有摆脱经济衰退。

examples.text: ...a region in the grip of severe drought.
examples.translation: 受大旱严重影响的地区

examples.text: Shakur loses his fragile grip on reality and starts blasting away at friends and foe alike.
examples.translation: 沙库尔丧失了对形势仅存的一点判断，无论对敌对友都开始大加挞伐。

examples.text: Slowly, he opened his eyes. As he did so, he began to groan with pain...
examples.translation: 他慢慢地睁开眼睛，并发出痛苦的呻吟。

examples.text: They glanced at the man on the floor, who began to groan...
examples.translation: 他们瞥了一眼躺在地上的男人，那人现在开始呻吟起来。

examples.text: She was making small groaning noises.
examples.translation: 她发出轻轻的呻吟声。

examples.text: She heard him let out a pitiful, muffled groan...
examples.translation: 她听到他发出一声令人悲悯的低沉的呻吟声。

examples.text: As his ball flew wide, there was a collective groan from the stands.
examples.translation: 他将球踢飞了，看台上一片叹息声。

examples.text: 'My leg — I think it's broken,' Eric groaned.
examples.translation: “我的腿——我想是断了，”埃里克咕哝着说。

examples.text: His parents were beginning to groan about the price of college tuition.
examples.translation: 他的父母开始抱怨大学的学费太贵。

examples.text: Listen sympathetically to your child's moans and groans about what she can't do.
examples.translation: 当你的孩子因不能做某些事情而发牢骚的时候，你应该抱着一颗理解的心去倾听。

examples.text: The timbers groan and creak and the floorboards shift.
examples.translation: 这些木头在吱吱嘎嘎作响，木地板有些摇晃。

examples.text: The bar counter groans under the weight of huge plates of the freshest fish.
examples.translation: 吧台上摆满了大碟大碟非常新鲜的鱼。

examples.text: ...a table groaning with food.
examples.translation: 堆满了食物的桌子

examples.text: Consumers were groaning under the weight of high interest rates...
examples.translation: 高利率令消费者不堪重负。

examples.text: Bookshelves groan under the burden of books on threats to the environment.
examples.translation: 书架上摆满了有关环境威胁的书，不堪重负。

examples.text: Hobo Soup on the grocer's shelf -- "A Jungle Recipe, Fit For A King!"
With his left hand he groped for the knob, turned it, and pulled the door open...
examples.translation: 他左手摸索着门把手，转动一下，然后推开门。

examples.text: Bunbury groped in his breast pocket for his wallet.
examples.translation: 邦伯里手伸进前胸口袋里摸索钱包。

examples.text: I didn't turn on the light, but groped my way across the room.
examples.translation: 我没有开灯，而是一路摸黑走过房间。

examples.text: He groped for solutions to the problems facing the country...
examples.translation: 他在探求国家所面临问题的解决办法。

examples.text: She groped for a simple word to express a simple idea.
examples.translation: 她想找个简单的词来表达简单的想法。

examples.text: They continue their groping towards a constitutional settlement.
examples.translation: 他们继续寻求合乎宪法规定的解决方案。

examples.text: He would try to grope her breasts and put his hand up her skirt.
examples.translation: 他会试图摸她的胸部，还把手从她的裙子上向上移。

examples.text: She even boasted of having a grope in a cupboard with a 13-year-old.
examples.translation: 她甚至吹嘘曾和一个13岁的男孩在衣橱里有过肌肤之亲。

meanings.meaning: 总共的；粗野的；恶劣的；显而易见的

examples.text: The company were guilty of gross negligence.
examples.translation: 该公司犯有严重过失。

examples.text: ...an act of gross injustice.
examples.translation: 极端不公的法案

examples.translation: 教育资金多年来极为匮乏。

examples.translation: 她过于肥胖。

examples.translation: 我感到无地自容，不知道自己怎么会变得如此粗俗。

examples.text: He wears really gross holiday outfits.
examples.translation: 他穿着十分难看的节日服装。

examples.translation: 我只有在觉得自己胖得很难看的时候才能拒绝巧克力这类东西的诱惑。

examples.translation: 10月份之前保证10.4%的毛利或7.8%的纯利收益的固定利率账户

examples.translation: 利息是按照总收入给付，未扣除税金。

examples.translation: 一年总收入为两万英镑的父亲

examples.translation: 6月份国民储蓄机构的总销售额为7.09亿英镑。

examples.translation: 我是个工厂工人，去年的总收入为12,900英镑。

examples.translation: 到目前为止，这些电影的票房总收入已超过了5.9亿英镑。

examples.translation: 他订购了12罗磁盘。

examples.translation: 学生们分组研究复杂的问题。

examples.translation: 一个环保组织的成员正在一家化工厂里举行抗议活动。

examples.text: She is among the most promising players in her age group...
examples.translation: 她是所在年龄组中最有前途的选手之一。

examples.translation: 整体而言，当今的老年人依然相对贫困。

examples.translation: 该集团的税前利润为1,105万英镑。

examples.translation: 总部位于法国的保险集团

examples.text: At school he played bass in a pop group called The Urge.
examples.translation: 他上学的时候在一个叫“冲动”的流行乐队中担任贝司手。

examples.translation: 比利·布拉格的伴奏乐队

examples.translation: 这些资料被分成了7部分。

examples.text: The G-7 organization groups together the world's seven leading industrialized nations...
examples.translation: 七国集团将世界上7个最主要的工业国家归在一起。

examples.text: We want to encourage them to group together to act as a big purchaser.
examples.translation: 我们想鼓励他们组成一个大的采购团。

examples.text: Forty or fifty women were sitting cross-legged on the ground...
examples.translation: 四五十个女人盘腿坐在地上。

examples.translation: 我们沿着屋顶滑了下来，落到地上。

examples.text: People were making for the air-raid shelters below ground.
examples.translation: 人们正奔向地下防空洞。

examples.text: Coordinating airline traffic on the ground is as complicated as managing the traffic in the air.
examples.translation: 协调地面的航空交通与管理空中交通一样复杂。

examples.text: The ground had eroded.
examples.translation: 这片土壤遭到侵蚀。

examples.text: ...the marshy ground of the river delta.
examples.translation: 河流三角洲的沼泽地

examples.text: ...a stretch of waste ground...
examples.translation: 一块荒地

examples.text: This memorial stands on sacred ground.
examples.translation: 这块纪念碑屹立于圣地之上。

examples.text: ...Indian hunting grounds...
examples.translation: 印第安人的狩猎场

examples.text: The best fishing grounds are around the islands.
examples.translation: 最好的渔场在这些岛屿周围。

examples.translation: 该市的足球场

examples.text: ...a parade ground.
examples.translation: 阅兵场

examples.translation: 皇家花园

examples.text: ...the grounds of the University.
examples.translation: 大学校区

examples.text: The company has maintained its reputation as the developing ground for new techniques...
examples.translation: 该公司一直享有新技术研发基地的美誉。

examples.text: Seattle is fertile ground for small businesses.
examples.translation: 西雅图是适合小型企业发展的沃土。

examples.text: Sensing she was on shaky ground, Marie changed the subject...
examples.translation: 感到自己的观点站不住脚，玛丽于是换了个话题。

examples.text: The French are on solid ground when they argue that competitiveness is no reason for devaluation...
examples.translation: 法国人认为不能以提高竞争力为由进行贬值，他们是有道理的。

examples.text: It's often necessary to go over the same ground more than once.
examples.translation: 常常有必要对同样的内容不只一次地进行检查。

examples.translation: 有迹象表明该党在最新一轮投票中正逐渐领先。

examples.translation: 美元失去了更多的优势。

examples.text: In the interview he gave some grounds for optimism...
examples.translation: 他接受采访时阐述了持乐观态度的理由。

examples.text: The court overturned that decision on the grounds that the Prosecution had withheld crucial evidence...
examples.translation: 法庭以检控方拒绝出示关键证据为由撤销了那项判决。

examples.text: Owen was against it, on the grounds of expense.
examples.translation: 欧文因费用问题对此表示反对。

examples.text: Her argument was grounded in fact...
examples.translation: 她的观点有事实根据。

examples.text: They believe the soul is immortal, grounding this belief on the Divine nature of the human spirit.
examples.translation: 基于对人类精神神圣性的信仰，他们认为灵魂是永恒的。

examples.translation: 民航部长下令所有飞机不得起飞。

examples.translation: 氢气泄漏迫使美国国家航空航天局停止了航天飞机的发射。

examples.translation: 汤普森罚他一个月不能出门，并禁止看电视。

examples.text: Residents have been told to stay away from the region where the ship was grounded...
examples.translation: 居民们被告知不要靠近船只搁浅的区域。

examples.text: The boat finally grounded on a soft, underwater bank.
examples.translation: 那条船最终在松软的水下浅滩搁浅了。

examples.text: ...a grounded oil tanker.
examples.translation: 搁浅的油轮

examples.text: ...ground beef.
examples.translation: 绞碎的牛肉

examples.text: ...The sausages are made of coarsely ground pork.
examples.translation: 这些香肠用切得较粗的猪肉制成。

examples.text: Gellhorn may have broken new ground when she filed her first report on the Spanish Civil War.
examples.translation: 当盖尔霍恩发出她第一篇关于西班牙内战的报道时，她也许已经开辟了一片新的天地。

examples.text: The town was razed to the ground after the French Revolution.
examples.translation: 该镇在法国大革命后被夷为平地。

examples.translation: 东贝鲁特的市民们躲进了地下室和掩体中。

examples.text: She seems to have found a middle ground in which mutual support, rather than complete dependency, is possible.
examples.translation: 她似乎已经找到了实现相互支持而非完全依赖其中一方的中间立场。

examples.text: We help small companies to get off the ground.
examples.translation: 我们帮助一些小公司顺利起步。

examples.text: On her own ground she knows exactly what she's doing.
examples.translation: 她在自己熟悉的领域里对自己的行为有十足的把握。

examples.text: ...a political initiative which would prepare the ground for war.
examples.translation: 为战争埋下了伏笔的政治倡议

examples.text: The spectacle of Sakharov standing his ground and speaking his mind gave me hope.
examples.translation: 萨哈罗夫坚持立场、坦率直言的样子让我看到了希望。

examples.text: She had to force herself to stand her ground when she heard someone approaching.
examples.translation: 听到有人走近，她只好强迫自己鼓起勇气，绝不退缩。

examples.text: Good managers are often thin on the ground.
examples.translation: 优秀的经理人常常寥寥无几。

examples.text: Jan was almost a grown-up...
examples.translation: 简都快是个大人了。

examples.text: Tell children to tell a grown-up if they're being bullied.
examples.translation: 告诉孩子们，如果被人欺负就告诉大人。

examples.text: I have grown-up children who're doing well.
examples.translation: 我的几个孩子已经长大成人并且事业有成。

examples.text: She's very grown-up.
examples.translation: 她表现得很像个大人。

examples.text: Her songs tackle grown-up subjects...
examples.translation: 她的歌曲唱的都是成年人的事情。

examples.text: She talked in a grown-up manner.
examples.translation: 她说起话来像个大人。

examples.translation: 我们成年之后不再长个儿。

examples.text: The station had roses growing at each end of the platform.
examples.translation: 车站月台的两头种着玫瑰花。

examples.text: I always grow a few red onions...
examples.translation: 我总是喜欢种一些红洋葱。

examples.text: Lettuce was grown by the Ancient Romans.
examples.translation: 古罗马人最先种植莴苣。

examples.text: Then the hair began to grow again and I felt terrific.
examples.translation: 然后，头发又长起来了，我感觉棒极了。

examples.text: I'd better start growing my hair.
examples.translation: 我最好开始留头发。

examples.text: They began to grow as persons.
examples.translation: 他们开始长大成人了。

examples.text: I grew a little afraid of the guy next door...
examples.translation: 我开始有些害怕隔壁的那个家伙。

examples.text: He's growing old...
examples.translation: 他渐渐变老了。

examples.text: He grew to love his work.
examples.translation: 他开始喜欢上他的工作了。

examples.text: The number of unemployed people in Poland has grown by more than a quarter in the last month...
examples.translation: 上个月，波兰的失业人数增长超过了1/4。

examples.text: Opposition grew and the government agreed to negotiate.
examples.translation: 反对的声音越来越高，政府只好同意进行谈判。

examples.text: ...a growing number of immigrants.
examples.translation: 日益增长的移民数量

examples.text: The boys grew into men...
examples.translation: 这些男孩子长成了男子汉。

examples.text: This political row threatens to grow into a full blown crisis.
examples.translation: 这场政治争端有可能演化成一场全面爆发的危机。

examples.text: The idea for this book grew out of conversations with Philippa Brewster.
examples.translation: 创作这本书的想法来源于跟菲莉帕·布鲁斯特的谈话。

examples.text: The economy continues to grow.
examples.translation: 经济持续发展。

examples.text: ...a fast growing business.
examples.translation: 迅速发展的企业

examples.text: To grow the business, he needs to develop management expertise and innovation across his team.
examples.translation: 为了拓展业务，他需要提高整个团队的管理技能和创新能力。

examples.text: ...crystals that grow in cavities in the rock...
examples.translation: 岩石洞穴中形成的水晶

examples.text: We tried to grow some copper sulphate crystals with our children.
examples.translation: 我们想跟孩子们一起制作硫酸铜晶体。

examples.translation: 民族主义的高涨

examples.text: ...Japan's enormous economic growth.
examples.translation: 日本经济的突飞猛进

examples.translation: 两个较小政党的支持率稳步上升，可能会打乱投票结果。

examples.text: The area has seen a rapid population growth...
examples.translation: 该地区人口激增。

examples.translation: 这几年的市场年增长率都保持在20%。

examples.translation: 计算机与电子行业属于蓬勃发展的产业，需要娴熟的技术人员。

examples.translation: 房地产贷款已经成了美国银行业增长最快的业务领域。

examples.translation: 孩子的情感与智力发展

examples.translation: 不同的教师在学生的成长过程中起到不同的作用。

examples.translation: 控制生殖和身体发育的荷尔蒙

examples.translation: 细胞不断地分裂更新，这是人体发育过程的一部分。

examples.translation: 这有助于新生发植株的成熟，令其开出繁茂的花朵。

examples.translation: 掐掉幼株的芽尖以便让它们长得紧凑浓密，呈丛生状。

examples.translation: 这种外科手术甚至可以用来切除癌性肿瘤。

meanings.meaning: 保证；担保；保证人；保证书；抵押品

examples.text: Surplus resources alone do not guarantee growth.
examples.translation: 仅有富余的资源并不能确保发展。

examples.text: ...a man whose fame guarantees that his calls will nearly always be returned.
examples.translation: 其名望能确保他的呼吁几乎总能得到回应的人

examples.translation: 公司悠久的品牌并不能确保商品的质量。

examples.text: There is still no guarantee that a formula could be found.
examples.translation: 还没有把握是否能找到一个配方。

examples.translation: 大多数州都保障人们免费享受充分教育的权利。

examples.translation: 保证安排所有的学生第一年在校内住宿。

examples.translation: 我们保证你们会找到自己的交际圈。

examples.translation: 若您对所购商品不满意，我们保证退款。

examples.translation: 加利福尼亚的州宪法涵盖对隐私权的保障。

examples.text: All Dreamland's electric blankets are guaranteed for three years.
examples.translation: 所有的梦乡牌电热毯质保3年。

examples.text: ... parts of guaranteed quality.

meanings.meaning: 守卫；警戒；护卫队；防护装置

examples.text: Gunmen guarded homes near the cemetery with shotguns...

examples.translation: 手持步枪的海军陆战队士兵监视着他们。

examples.translation: 有一队警察看守着他。

examples.text: The prisoners overpowered their guards and locked them in a cell.
examples.translation: 囚犯们制服了监狱看守，并将他们锁进了牢房。

examples.text: We have a security guard around the whole area...
examples.translation: 我们在该地区各处部署了保安。

examples.text: A heavily armed guard of police have sealed off the city centre.
examples.translation: 一队全副武装的警察已经封锁了市中心。

examples.text: He closely guarded her identity.
examples.translation: 他对她的身份守口如瓶。

examples.text: ...a threat to the country's jealously guarded unity.
examples.translation: 对该国珍惜维护的统一局面的威胁

examples.text: ...the chin guard of my helmet...
examples.translation: 我头盔上的下巴保护罩

examples.text: A blade guard is fitted to protect the operator.
examples.translation: 为保证操作人员的人身安全安装了桨叶保护罩。

examples.text: ...the Grenadier Guards.
examples.translation: 英国近卫步兵团

examples.text: Charm the audience and catch them off guard...
examples.translation: 吸引观众的注意力，然后给他们来个出其不意。

examples.text: The invitation had caught me off guard.
examples.translation: 收到这份邀请让我颇感意外。

examples.text: The ANC could not afford to lower its guard until everything had been carried out...
examples.translation: 非洲人国民大会在所有事项皆已完成前不敢有丝毫松懈。

examples.text: You can't let your guard down...
examples.translation: 你不能放松警惕。

examples.text: It takes me a long time to drop my guard and get close to people.
examples.translation: 我要花上好长时间才能放下戒备心，与人接近。

examples.text: They've even mounted guard outside the main hotel in the capital...
examples.translation: 他们甚至派人在首都的大饭店外面站岗。

examples.text: Police mounted round-the-clock guards on properties last night.
examples.translation: 警方昨晚通宵值守财物。

examples.text: The police have questioned him thoroughly, and he'll be on his guard...
examples.translation: 警方已经对他进行了详细的盘问，因此他会保持戒备心理。

examples.text: He is constantly on guard against any threat of humiliation.
examples.translation: 他时刻提防着任何有辱尊严之事。

examples.text: Police were on guard at Barnet town hall.
examples.translation: 警察在巴尼特市政厅值守。

examples.text: One young policeman stood guard outside the locked embassy gates.
examples.translation: 一位年轻的警察在大门紧闭的使馆外站岗。

examples.text: Three men were arrested and one was under guard in hospital.
examples.translation: 有3人被逮捕，1人在警方监护下送医院治疗。

examples.text: The suit was faultless: Wood guessed that he was a very successful publisher or a banker...
examples.translation: 西装无可挑剔：伍德推测他可能是个相当成功的出版商或银行家。

examples.text: You can only guess at what mental suffering they endure...
examples.translation: 你只能猜测他们忍受着多大的精神痛苦。

examples.text: Paula reached for her camera, guessed distance and exposure, and shot two frames...
examples.translation: 葆拉伸手拿过照相机，估算了一下距离和曝光时间，然后拍了两张照片。

examples.text: Guess what I did for the whole of the first week...
examples.translation: 猜猜我整个第一周都干了些什么。

examples.text: If she guessed wrong, it meant twice as many meetings the following week.
examples.translation: 如果她猜测错误，那就意味着下周的会议要多上一倍。

examples.text: By now you will have guessed that I'm back in Ireland...
examples.translation: 你现在应该已经猜出我回到了爱尔兰了。

examples.text: As you've probably guessed, the problem was electrical...
examples.translation: 你们可能已经猜测出来了，这个问题与电有关。

examples.text: He should have guessed what would happen...

examples.text: Someone might have guessed our secret and passed it on.
examples.translation: 有人或许已经猜到了我们的秘密并且将其散布开了。

examples.text: My guess is that the chance that these vaccines will work is zero...
examples.translation: 我猜测这些疫苗根本不可能奏效。

examples.text: He'd taken her pulse and made a guess at her blood pressure...
examples.translation: 他给她把过脉，估量了她的血压。

examples.text: Well, we can hazard a guess at the answer.
examples.translation: 噢，我们可以猜一猜答案。

examples.text: Just when this will happen is anyone's guess...
examples.translation: 谁也说不准这事什么时候会发生。

examples.translation: 谁也说不清发生了什么事。

examples.text: At a guess he's been dead for two days.
examples.translation: 据猜测，他已死了两天。

examples.text: I guess she thought that was pretty smart...

examples.text: I guess he's right...

examples.text: 'I think you're being paranoid.' — 'Yeah. I guess so.'
examples.translation: 我认为你太多疑了。”——“是啊，我也是这样认为。”

examples.text: The author's intention is to keep everyone guessing until the bitter end...
examples.translation: 这位作家打算把悲惨结局的悬念一直保留到最后。

examples.text: She was keeping everyone guessing about the latest love in her life.
examples.translation: 她不让任何人知道自己最近的感情生活。

examples.text: Guess what, I just got my first part in a movie.
examples.translation: 你猜怎么着，我刚刚得到了自己的第一个电影角色。

examples.text: She was a guest at the wedding...
examples.translation: 她是参加婚礼的客人。

examples.text: Their guests sipped drinks on the veranda.
examples.translation: 他们的客人在游廊里浅酌着美酒。

examples.translation: 杰拉尔德·杰弗斯博士是特邀演讲人。

examples.translation: 他们是在她客串出演热播电视系列剧《守护者》时认识的。

examples.translation: 这个乐队最近在林戈·斯塔尔和“恐惧之泪”乐队的唱片中客串过。

examples.translation: 书面智商测试仅供参考。

examples.translation: 你不相信马修斯先生有罪。

examples.translation: 她见到我时一脸歉疚。

examples.translation: 他很内疚地回头一瞥。

examples.translation: 许多人或许保守着这个罪恶的秘密。

examples.translation: 我带着一种罪恶的解脱感离开。

examples.translation: 他们被判谋杀罪成立。

examples.translation: 他承认确实犯有人身伤害罪。

examples.translation: 冷冻鱼之前并不总是需要先把内脏掏空。

examples.translation: 新总理有勇气推动不受欢迎的增税方案获得通过。

examples.translation: 本周，一颗燃烧弹炸毁了一栋有60位居民的楼房。

examples.translation: 一座内部被毁的废置工厂矗立在那里。

examples.translation: 大部分人都拼命工作，作出了很大的牺牲。

examples.translation: 当了20年的烟鬼后，纳特先生戒了烟。

examples.translation: 从口音、举止和思维习惯上看，他完全是东欧人。

examples.translation: 在原生境中，木槿能长到25英尺高。

examples.translation: 几乎没有哪个国家像南非那样拥有如此多样化的动植物栖生地。

examples.translation: 半份鲜榨柠檬汁

examples.text: Steve barely said a handful of words during the first half hour.
examples.translation: 史蒂夫在前半小时里没说几句话。

examples.text: His eyes were half closed...
examples.translation: 他双眼半闭。

examples.text: His refrigerator frequently looked half empty...
examples.translation: 他的冰箱里经常半空着。

examples.text: She'd half expected him to withdraw from the course.
examples.translation: 她多少已经预料到他会中途就退出这门课程。

examples.text: The only goal was scored by Jakobsen early in the second half.
examples.translation: 唯一的一粒进球是由雅各布森在下半场刚开始时打进的。

examples.text: ...a half of lager and a sandwich.
examples.translation: 半品脱淡啤酒和一份三明治

examples.text: She was half Italian and half English.
examples.translation: 她是半意大利半英国血统。

examples.text: 'What time were you planning lunch?'—'Half past twelve, if that's convenient.'...
examples.translation: “你打算什么时候吃午饭？”“如果方便的话，12点半。”

examples.text: I think I got there about four and left about half past.
examples.translation: 我想我是4点钟左右到达那里，大约半个小时后离开的。

examples.text: They are supposed to be here at about half four.
examples.translation: 他们应该在4点半左右到达这里。

examples.text: He felt half dead with tiredness...
examples.translation: 他已经累得半死不活了。

examples.text: All this time I've been half sick about you and why you wouldn't write.
examples.translation: 我一直非常担心你，一直在想你为什么不来信。

examples.text: I thought about you half the night...
examples.translation: 我几乎整夜都在想着你。

examples.text: He wouldn't know what he was saying half the time...
examples.translation: 他大部分时间里都不知道自己在说些什么。

examples.text: One phone call and half the city's police force will be around to arrest you.
examples.translation: 只要打个电话，警察就会倾城而动过来抓你。

examples.text: You don't half sound confident...
examples.translation: 你听起来非常有信心。

examples.text: I didn't half get into trouble...
examples.translation: 我遇到了大麻烦。

examples.text: She eventually decided the acting profession wasn't half bad...
examples.translation: 她最终断定，表演这一行并不适合。

examples.text: My kick wasn't half a bad effort for an old man...
examples.translation: 像我这把年纪的人，老腿确实不听使唤了。

examples.text: 'There'd been a tremendous amount of poverty around and presumably this made some impact then.' — 'Oh not half.'
examples.translation: “过去贫困现象比比皆是，恐怕在当时也有不小的影响吧？”“没错，那还真不是一星半点的。”

examples.text: You're not half the man you think you are...
examples.translation: 你根本不是你自己想象的那种人。

examples.text: Poor old Henry, and not half as clever as he'd thought.
examples.translation: 可怜的老亨利，以为自己多聪明。

examples.text: It becomes clear that Montgomerie has a job and half on his hands.
examples.translation: 很显然，蒙哥马利手头有一大堆事情要做。

examples.text: I was worried that my career, my children and my other half might become too much to cope with.
examples.translation: 我担心我的事业、我的孩子们和我的那口子可能会让我应付不过来。

examples.text: The number of 7 year olds who read poorly has increased by half over the past 5 years...
examples.translation: 不识字的7岁儿童的人数在过去5年里增加了一半。

examples.text: Cutting food intake by half is an incredibly difficult thing for anyone to do.
examples.translation: 将进食量减半对任何人来说都是件非常难的事。

examples.text: In Italy they rarely do things by halves. Designers work thoroughly, producing the world's most wearable clothes in the most beautiful fabrics.
examples.translation: 在意大利，人们很少马虎从事。设计师们精益求精，用最美丽的布料制造出世界上最适合穿着的衣服。

examples.text: He's constantly on the phone to his girlfriend. We have to go halves on the phone bill which drives me mad.
examples.translation: 他总和女友煲电话粥。令我抓狂的是电话费可是我们俩平摊的。

meanings.meaning: 过道，门厅，走廊；会堂；食堂；学生宿舍；大厅，前厅；娱乐中心，会所
（土）哈勒（人名）；（德、波、丹、芬、瑞典）哈尔（人名）；（英）霍尔（人名）；（法）阿尔（人名）

examples.text: The lights were on in the hall and in the bedroom.
examples.translation: 门厅和卧室的灯都亮着。

examples.text: Its 300 inhabitants will be celebrating with a dance in the village hall...
examples.translation: 300名村民将在村礼堂举行一场舞会以示庆祝。

examples.text: We picked up our conference materials and filed into the lecture hall...
examples.translation: 我们领了会议材料后鱼贯进入讲演厅。

examples.text: It was brilliant to hear George Harrison in concert at the Royal Albert Hall last week.
examples.translation: 上周在皇家艾伯特厅听到乔治·哈里森的现场演出真是太棒了。

examples.text: He died at Holly Hall, his wife's family home.
examples.translation: 他在妻子的娘家冬青府去世。

examples.text: ...New York's Carnegie Hall.
examples.translation: 纽约的卡内基音乐厅

examples.text: They halted at a short distance from the house...
examples.translation: 他们在离房子不远处停了下来。

examples.text: The engine note changed as the aircraft landed, taxied and halted...
examples.translation: 发动机的声音随着飞机着陆、滑行和停下一直在变化。

examples.text: She held her hand out flat, to halt him.
examples.translation: 她平伸出一只手掌，要挡住他。

examples.text: Striking workers halted production at the auto plant yesterday...
examples.translation: 罢工工人于昨日停止了汽车厂的生产。

examples.text: He criticised the government for failing to halt economic decline...
examples.translation: 他批评政府未能遏止经济下滑。

examples.text: Exports have not been halted completely because another line is operational.
examples.translation: 出口并没有完全停止，因为另一条生产线还能运转。

examples.text: The colonel ordered 'Halt!'
examples.translation: 上校命令道：“立定！”

examples.text: The Russian government had called a halt to the construction of a new project in the Rostov region.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯政府已叫停了罗斯托夫地区的一个新工程。

examples.text: Sofia and Alex came to a halt and both tried to regain their breath...
examples.translation: 索菲娅和亚历克斯停了下来，两人都想喘口气。

examples.text: The elevator creaked to a halt at the ground floor.
examples.translation: 电梯嘎吱一声停在了一层。

examples.text: Her political career came to a halt in December 1988...
examples.translation: 她的政治生涯于1988年12月画上了句号。

examples.text: Air traffic in Poland has been brought to a halt by an air traffic controllers' strike.
examples.translation: 由于航空调度员罢工，波兰的空中交通已完全瘫痪。

meanings.meaning: 火腿；业余无线电爱好者；蹩脚演员
(Ham)人名；(英、瑞典、塞)哈姆；(老)罕；(柬)汉

examples.text: ...a huge baked ham.
examples.translation: 巨大的烤火腿

examples.text: ...ham sandwiches.
examples.translation: 火腿三明治

examples.text: ...a dozen slices of ham.
examples.translation: 12片火腿

examples.text: I became a ham radio operator at the age of eleven.
examples.translation: 我在11岁时成了一名业余无线电操作员。

examples.text: Thrusting themselves into the spirit of the farce, they ham it up like mad.
examples.translation: 他们全力投入到这部闹剧中去，极尽搞怪之能事。

meanings.meaning: 汉堡包，汉堡；牛肉饼，肉饼；碎牛肉
(Hamburger)人名；(英)汉堡；(瑞典)汉布里耶；(德)汉布格尔

examples.text: So the Hamburger case and Dr Rivier's remarks have implications far beyond professional cycling.

meanings.meaning: 铁锤；链球；[解剖] 锤骨；音锤
(Hammer)人名；(法)阿梅；(德、英、芬、捷、瑞典、荷、丹、挪)哈默

examples.text: He used a hammer and chisel to chip away at the wall.
examples.translation: 他用榔头和凿子铲墙。

examples.text: To avoid damaging the tree, hammer a wooden peg into the hole...
examples.translation: 为了不毁坏树，用锤子将一个木栓钉进洞里。

examples.text: Builders were still hammering outside the window.
examples.translation: 建筑工人仍在窗外敲敲打打。

examples.text: The workers kneel on the ground and hammer the small stones in.
examples.translation: 工人们跪在地上，将小石子锤进去。

examples.text: The noise of hammering was dulled by the secondary glazing.
examples.translation: 因为隔着双层玻璃，锤子的敲打声变低沉了。

examples.text: We had to hammer and shout before they would open up...
examples.translation: 我们不停地拍门、叫喊，他们才开了门。

examples.text: A crowd of reporters was hammering on the door...
examples.translation: 一群记者正在砰砰地拍打着大门。

examples.text: He hammered his two clenched fists on the table.
examples.translation: 他双拳紧握，重重地捶着桌子。

examples.text: As he said it, there was a hammering outside.
examples.translation: 他说这话时，外面传来一阵敲打声。

examples.text: He hammered it into me that I had not suddenly become a rotten goalkeeper...
examples.translation: 他反复告诉我，我并没有一下子变成个差劲的守门员。

examples.text: Recent advertising campaigns from the industry have hammered at these themes.
examples.translation: 该行业最近的广告宣传活动一直在反复强调这些主题。

examples.text: The report hammers the private motorist...
examples.translation: 该报告严词谴责了那个私家车司机。

examples.text: If we turned up late we would be hammered by everybody.
examples.translation: 如果我们迟到，就会遭到大家的声讨。

examples.text: Parents have taken a terrible hammering.
examples.translation: 家长们遭到了严厉的批评。

examples.text: Look at the numbers of small businesses that are being hammered unmercifully...
examples.translation: 看看有多少小企业正在遭受无情的打击。

examples.text: The company has been hammered by the downturn in the construction and motor industries.
examples.translation: 公司因建筑和汽车行业的衰退而受到了冲击。

examples.text: He hammered the young Austrian player in four straight sets.
examples.translation: 他直落4局轻取年轻的奥地利对手。

examples.text: Our cricketers are suffering their ritual hammering at the hands of the Aussies.
examples.translation: 我们的板球队员们照例又狠栽在了澳大利亚队的手上。

examples.text: My heart was hammering. The footsteps had stopped outside my door.
examples.translation: 我的心怦怦直跳。脚步声已停在我的门外。

examples.text: Events like the hammer and the discus are not traditional crowd-pullers in the West.
examples.translation: 掷链球和铁饼等在西方算不上传统的受欢迎项目。

examples.text: He loved gardening. He went at it hammer and tongs as soon as he got back from work...
examples.translation: 他酷爱侍弄花草。只要下班一回到家，他就兴冲冲地忙活起来。

examples.text: They yell, shout and argue. For six hours a night they go at it, hammer and tongs.
examples.translation: 他们又叫又喊又吵，每晚都要乐此不疲地闹腾6个小时。

examples.text: Ian Fleming's original unpublished notes are to go under the hammer at London auctioneers Sotheby's.
examples.translation: 伊恩·弗莱明未出版的原版笔记将在伦敦的苏富比拍卖行进行拍卖。

examples.text: The bad weather hampered rescue operations...
examples.translation: 恶劣的天气阻碍了救援工作的进行。

examples.text: I was hampered by a lack of information.
examples.translation: 我受到了信息不足的牵累。

examples.text: ...a luxury food hamper.
examples.translation: 豪华食品礼物篮

examples.text: ...a picnic hamper.
examples.translation: 野餐篮子

examples.text: If you have not kept a pet parrot before, it would be wise to purchase a handbook on the subject.
examples.translation: 如果以前没有养过鹦鹉，最好买一本相关的饲养手册。

examples.text: ...the AA Members' Handbook.
examples.translation: 《汽车协会会员手册》

examples.text: He surveyed the handful of customers at the bar...
examples.translation: 他打量着吧台那边零星的几个顾客。

examples.text: One spring morning a handful of potential investors assembled in Quincy.
examples.translation: 春天的一个早上，几位有望投资者聚集在昆西。

examples.text: She scooped up a handful of sand and let it trickle through her fingers.
examples.translation: 她抓起一把沙子，让它从指缝里一点点漏下来。

examples.text: Zara can be a handful sometimes.
examples.translation: 扎拉有时很难管教。

examples.text: I put my hand into my pocket and pulled out the letter...
examples.translation: 我把手伸进口袋，掏出了那封信。

examples.text: Sylvia, camera in hand, asked, 'Where do we go first?'
examples.translation: 西尔维娅手里拿着相机问道：“我们先去哪里？”

examples.text: The hand of the military authorities can be seen in the entire electoral process...
examples.translation: 整个选举过程中都能看出军方的介入。

examples.text: The study will strengthen the hand of congressmen who want stricter enforcement of the 14-year-old Act.
examples.translation: 该研究将使那些希望更加严格执行这项已存在14年的法案的议员影响力加强。

examples.text: I feel that possibly the majority of these dogs are in the wrong hands...
examples.translation: 在我看来很可能这些狗大多数都没有人妥善照看。

examples.text: He is leaving his north London business in the hands of a colleague...
examples.translation: 他把自己伦敦北部的业务交给一位同事打理。

examples.text: We're in safe hands...
examples.translation: 我们的事会得到妥当处理的。

examples.text: The Government is openly encouraging the transfer of one of our greatest public buildings into private hands.
examples.translation: 政府在公开支持将我们最伟大的公共建筑之一转与私人管理。

examples.text: I could see you'd want a hand with the children...
examples.translation: 我能看出你需要有人帮着照看孩子。

examples.text: Come and give me a hand in the garden...
examples.translation: 到花园里来帮我一把。

examples.text: We gave him a hand bringing it back.
examples.translation: 我们帮他把它弄了回来。

examples.text: He now works as a farm hand...
examples.translation: 他现在是一名农场工人。

examples.text: He met mill hands, miners and farm labourers.
examples.translation: 他见过工厂工人、矿工和农场工人。

examples.text: Let's give 'em a big hand.
examples.translation: 让我们为他们热烈鼓掌。

examples.text: He came to ask Usha's father for her hand in marriage.
examples.translation: 他来请求乌莎的父亲把女儿嫁给他。

examples.text: He carefully inspected his hand.
examples.translation: 他仔细地审视着自己手中的牌。

examples.text: I had a very good 14.2 hands pony, called Brandy.
examples.translation: 我有一匹很棒的14.2手高的小马，名叫布朗迪。

examples.text: The manuscripts were written in the composer's own hand.
examples.translation: 手稿是作曲家亲笔写的。

examples.text: Having the right equipment at hand will be enormously helpful...
examples.translation: 手头上有合适的设备将会帮上大忙。

examples.text: Realizing that his retirement was near at hand, he looked for some additional income.
examples.translation: 意识到自己快要退休了，他想要挣些外快。

examples.text: The civilian population were suffering greatly at the hands of the security forces.
examples.translation: 老百姓吃尽了安全部队的苦头。

examples.text: Each pleat was stitched in place by hand.
examples.translation: 每条褶裥都是手工缝制到位的。

examples.text: The firm has changed hands many times over the years.
examples.translation: 该公司多年来已几易其主。

examples.text: Parker could have customers eating out of his hand.
examples.translation: 帕克能让顾客对自己言听计从。

examples.text: He blamed the press for forcing his hand.
examples.translation: 他指责新闻界迫使自己采取行动。

examples.text: She had her hands full with new arrivals.
examples.translation: 她忙于应付新来的人。

examples.text: He gave Stephanie a free hand in the decoration.
examples.translation: 他放手让斯蒂芬妮全权负责装修一事。

examples.text: Patty began reading everything she could get her hands on.
examples.translation: 帕蒂开始阅读她能找到的所有东西。

examples.text: The UN inspectors work hand in glove with the Western intelligence agencies.
examples.translation: 联合国观察员和西方情报机构之间密切合作。

examples.text: I saw them making their way, hand in hand, down the path.
examples.translation: 我看到他们手拉手沿着小路往前走去。

examples.text: For us, research and teaching go hand in hand...
examples.translation: 对我们而言，研究和教学是齐头并进的。

examples.text: Hand in hand with the police inquiries the government has also announced a full investigation.
examples.translation: 在警方调查的同时，政府也宣布要展开彻查。

examples.text: He thanked all who had a hand in his release.
examples.translation: 他向所有帮助自己获得释放的人表示感谢。

examples.text: Henry and Richard both ruled with a heavy hand.
examples.translation: 亨利和理查都用高压手段实行统治。

examples.text: She approached a young couple holding hands on a bench.
examples.translation: 她走近一对手拉手坐在长椅上的年轻情侣。

examples.text: I don't need anyone to hold my hand.
examples.translation: 我不需要任何人的精神安慰。

examples.text: Wales are three points behind Romania in the group but have a game in hand.
examples.translation: 威尔士队在小组中以3分之差落后于罗马尼亚队，但他们还有一场比赛没踢。

examples.text: Hughes finished with 15 seconds in hand.
examples.translation: 休斯提前了15秒完成。

examples.text: The business in hand was approaching some kind of climax.
examples.translation: 手头的生意似乎快到紧要关头了。

examples.text: The Olympic organisers say that matters are well in hand.
examples.translation: 奥运会的组织方说各项事务都在掌控之中。

examples.text: He still plays keyboards for a local band to keep his hand in.
examples.translation: 他仍在一个本地乐队里担任键盘手，以免技艺生疏。

examples.text: Chris crawled on his hands and knees out onto the highway.
examples.translation: 克里斯手脚并用爬上了公路。

examples.text: I'd be glad to lend a hand.
examples.translation: 我很乐意帮忙。

examples.text: Keep your hands off my milk.
examples.translation: 不准打我的牛奶的主意。

examples.text: I can't think of any off hand.
examples.translation: 我现在一个也想不出来。

examples.text: They now have yet another drug problem on their hands...
examples.translation: 他们现在又有个吸毒问题需要解决。

examples.text: She would like the worry of dealing with her affairs taken off her hands.
examples.translation: 她希望不再为处理自己的事务而烦恼。

examples.text: The Bridal Department will have experts on hand to give you all the help and advice you need...
examples.translation: 婚礼用品部会有现成的专家为您提供所需的一切帮助和建议。

examples.text: There was simply no cash on hand to meet the cost of food.
examples.translation: 手头实在没有现金可以购买食品。

examples.text: On the one hand, if the body doesn't have enough cholesterol, we would not be able to survive. On the other hand, if the body has too much cholesterol, the excess begins to line the arteries.
examples.translation: 一方面，如果体内没有足够的胆固醇，我们就无法存活下去。另一方面，如果体内胆固醇过高，多余的胆固醇就会附着在动脉内壁上。

examples.text: Well, all right, hospitals lose money. But, on the other hand, if people are healthy, don't think of it as losing money; think of it as saving lives.
examples.translation: 嗯，好吧，医院是赔钱。但从另一个角度看，如果人们都健健康康的，就不能认为是在赔钱，而应该想成是在救死扶伤。

examples.text: His drinking had got out of hand.
examples.translation: 他酗酒的恶习已无法控制。

examples.text: I initially dismissed the idea out of hand.
examples.translation: 我起初不假思索地就否定了这个想法。

examples.text: He is playing into the hands of racists.
examples.translation: 他这样做正中种族主义分子的下怀。

examples.text: He has grown more serious about running for president, although he refuses to show his hand.
examples.translation: 尽管他拒绝亮出自己的底牌，他对竞选总统一事却越来越认真了。

examples.text: I hope that Parliament will soon take the NHS in hand...
examples.translation: 我希望议会能很快接管国民医疗保健系统。

examples.text: He had thought her worth taking in hand.
examples.translation: 他曾经认为照管她是值得的。

examples.text: She threw up her hands in despair...
examples.translation: 她绝望地举起双手表示放弃。

examples.text: Or are they just going to throw up their hands and say you're asking too much?
examples.translation: 或许他们只会愤怒地挥舞着双手说你的要求太过分了？

examples.text: Politicians are always saying that they want to help us but their hands are tied...
examples.translation: 政客们总是说想帮助我们，但却身不由己。

examples.text: Her hands were tied by the way that the US constitution is structured.
examples.translation: 她为美国宪法的表述缚住了手脚。

examples.text: You may want to keep this brochure safe, so you have it to hand whenever you may need it.
examples.translation: 你应该保管好这份手册，这样随时想用都能马上在手边找到。

examples.text: After he left school, he tried his hand at a variety of jobs—bricklayer, cinema usher, coal man.
examples.translation: 离开学校后，他尝试过各种工作，如泥瓦匠、电影院引座员、运煤工。

examples.text: ...a person who can turn his hand to anything.
examples.translation: 什么事都能学着做的人

examples.text: He seems to have washed his hands of the job.
examples.translation: 那份工作他好像已经洗手不干了。

examples.text: Iago even gets Cassio to produce Desdemona's handkerchief — which Iago had hidden in Cassio's room.

meanings.meaning: 障碍；不利条件，不利的因素

examples.text: He lost his leg when he was ten, but learnt to overcome his handicap.
examples.translation: 他10岁时失去了一条腿，但他学会了克服自己的残疾。
