examples.translation: 斯特凡诺骑一辆摩托车放羊。

examples.text: A boy herded half a dozen camels down towards the water trough.
examples.translation: 一个男孩赶着6头骆驼朝饮水槽走去。

examples.text: I'm here all by myself and I know I'm going to get lost...
examples.translation: 这里只有我一个人，我知道我会迷路的。

examples.text: Well, I can't stand here chatting all day.
examples.translation: 好了，我不能一整天就站在这里闲聊。

examples.text: ...the growing number of skiers that come here...
examples.translation: 越来越多到这里来的滑雪者

examples.text: Sheila was in here a minute ago...
examples.translation: 希拉刚才还在这里。

examples.text: My name is Roseanne and I'm in here for heroin addiction...
examples.translation: 我的名字叫罗丝安妮，我是因为吸食海洛因上瘾来到这里的。

examples.text: I'm not going to stay here. I'm out of here, back down to San Diego...
examples.translation: 我不会呆在这里。我要离开这儿，回到圣迭戈。

examples.text: When Mommy comes, just tell her I'm up here.
examples.translation: 妈妈来了就告诉她我在这上面。

examples.text: ...if you will just sign here...
examples.translation: 请在这里签字

examples.text: Come and sit here, Lauren...
examples.translation: 过来坐这里，劳伦。

examples.text: 'From there, pulling a line to here,' he said, making invisible drawings in the air...
examples.translation: “从那里拉一根绳到这里，”他一边说，一边在空中比划着。

examples.text: 'It's on the right-hand side of the shopping centre.' — 'Okay. Fine.' —'Oh it's here.'
examples.translation: “它在购物中心的右侧。”——“好的。”——“哦，在这里。”

examples.text: My friend here writes for radio...
examples.translation: 我这位朋友是个电台撰稿人。

examples.text: I have here at my side Mr. Glenn Williams...
examples.translation: 我身边这位是格伦·威廉斯先生。

examples.text: I have a little book here by a lady called Mystic Meg.
examples.translation: 我手里有本小书，是一个叫“神秘梅格”的女士写的。

examples.text: ...where we have come from, where we are going to, or what our purpose here is, if any...
examples.translation: 我们从哪里来，到哪里去，或者倘若我们活在人世间有何目的的话，这个目的是什么

examples.text: Who are we? What are we doing here?
examples.translation: 我们是谁？我们在人世间做什么？

examples.text: I'm here to help you...
examples.translation: 我是来帮你的。

examples.text: I'm not here to listen to your complaints.
examples.translation: 我不是来听你抱怨的。

examples.text: 'Here's the taxi,' she said politely...
examples.translation: “出租车来了，”她礼貌地说。

examples.text: 'Mr Cummings is here,' she said, holding the door open...
examples.translation: “卡明斯先生来了，”她把门敞着说道。

examples.text: Here comes your husband...
examples.translation: 你丈夫过来了。

examples.text: 'Okay, here we are,' she said, and inserted her key in the lock...
examples.translation: “好了，我们到了，”她说，然后把钥匙插进锁里。

examples.text: Here's my apartment.
examples.translation: 我的公寓到了。

examples.text: Both sides will have to sell the agreement to their people. It's here that the real test will come...
examples.translation: 双方都必须要让各自的民众接受这项协议。真正的考验就在这里。

examples.text: It's here that we come up against the difference of approach...
examples.translation: 我们就是在这一点上面临方法上的分歧。

examples.text: The book goes into recent work in greater detail than I have attempted here...
examples.translation: 与我在这方面的尝试相比，这本书对近期研究的介绍更为详尽。

examples.text: Here I think it is appropriate to draw your attention to one very specific feature of socialism.
examples.translation: 谈到这里，我认为应该适时地提醒大家注意社会主义的一个非常明确的特征。

examples.text: Here comes the summer...
examples.translation: 夏天到了。

examples.text: Economic recovery is here...
examples.translation: 经济开始复苏。

examples.text: Here is your opportunity to acquire a luxurious one bedroom home.
examples.translation: 现在正是购买一套豪华一居室住房的机会。

examples.text: From Nairobi here's our East Africa correspondent, Colin Blane...
examples.translation: 以下是我们来自内罗毕的东非记者科林·布兰的报道。

examples.text: Here is a summer soup that is almost a meal in itself...
examples.translation: 接下来是一道几乎可以抵作一餐的夏季汤品。

examples.text: Now here's what I want you to do...
examples.translation: 听着，现在这是我想让你做的事。

examples.text: So here's what I think.
examples.translation: 我就说说我的看法。

examples.text: You know you can phone me — here's my mother's number...
examples.translation: 你可以给我打电话——给你，这是我母亲的电话号码。

examples.text: Here's your coffee, just the way you like it...
examples.translation: 给你的咖啡，按你的口味冲的。

examples.text: Here's my card. You know where to find me...
examples.translation: 这是我的名片。你知道哪里能找到我。

examples.text: Here's some letters I want you to sign...
examples.translation: 这里有几封信要你签字。

examples.text: Here's your cash.
examples.translation: 这是您的现金。

examples.text: Here you are, saying these terrible things...
examples.translation: 看看你，说这些难听的话。

examples.text: Here we are, pretending we're winning.
examples.translation: 瞧瞧我们，装出一副胜利者的姿态。

examples.text: I rummaged through the drawers and came up with Amanda's folder. 'Here we are.'
examples.translation: 我翻遍了抽屉，找出了阿曼达的文件夹。“找到了。”

examples.text: Dr Culver nervously muttered 'Here goes,' and gave the little girl an injection.
examples.translation: 卡尔弗医生紧张地嘟囔了一句“要打了啊”，然后就给小女孩打了一针。

examples.text: 'Police! Open up!' — 'Oh well,' I thought, 'here we go.'...
examples.translation: “警察！开门！”——“哎呀。”我想，“又来了。”

examples.text: At first, he was told he was too young and I thought, 'Oh, boy, here we go again.'...
examples.translation: 起先，他被告知他太年轻了，我心想，“哎，又是老一套。”

examples.text: Here I go again, confusing the issue.
examples.translation: 我又把问题搞得更复杂了。

examples.text: I'm a practicing physician trying to help people here and now...
examples.translation: 我是一名此时此刻只想治病救人的执业医师。

examples.text: Instead of staying in the here and now, you bring up similar instances from the past.
examples.translation: 你没有紧扣眼前所发生的事，而是只提出了一些过去的类似事例。

examples.text: I do a bit of teaching here and there...
examples.translation: 我零零散散地到处教些课。

examples.text: He could only understand a word here and there.
examples.translation: 他只能零星地听懂一两个单词。

examples.text: He raised his glass. 'Here's to neighbors.'...
examples.translation: 他举起杯子： “各位高邻，干了这杯！”

examples.text: Tony smiled and lifted his glass. 'Here's to you, Amy.'
examples.translation: 托尼微笑着举起杯子。“为你干一杯，埃米。”

meanings.meaning: 遗产；传统；继承物；继承权

examples.text: The historic building is as much part of our heritage as the paintings.
examples.translation: 这座历史建筑和这些画一样，都是留给我们的文化遗产的一部分。

examples.text: ...the rich heritage of Russian folk music.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯民间音乐的丰富遗产

examples.text: The hero of Doctor Zhivago dies in 1929.
examples.translation: 《日瓦戈医生》的男主角于1929年去世。

examples.text: ...the author's decision to make his hero a photographer.
examples.translation: 作者将男主角设计成一名摄影师的决定

examples.text: He called Mr Mandela a hero who had inspired millions.
examples.translation: 他称曼德拉先生为鼓舞了数百万民众的英雄。

examples.text: ...the goalscoring hero of the British hockey team...
examples.translation: 英国曲棍球队的得分英雄

examples.text: They think you're some sort of hero.
examples.translation: 他们认为你算得上是个英雄。

examples.text: My boyhood hero was Bobby Charlton...
examples.translation: 我童年时代的偶像是博比·查尔顿。

examples.text: No matter, he remained the hero of the crowds.
examples.translation: 不要紧，他仍是众人心目中的英雄。

meanings.meaning: 英雄的；英勇的；记叙英雄及其事迹的；夸张的

examples.text: The heroic sergeant risked his life to rescue 29 fishermen from their blazing trawler...
examples.translation: 英勇的中士冒着生命危险从熊熊燃烧着的拖网渔船上救出了29名渔民。

examples.text: His heroic deeds were celebrated in every corner of India.
examples.translation: 他的英雄事迹在印度广为传颂。

examples.text: He had acted heroically during the liner's evacuation.
examples.translation: 他在乘客撤离客轮的过程中表现得很英勇。

examples.text: The company has made heroic efforts at cost reduction...
examples.translation: 公司在降低成本方面付出了艰苦卓绝的努力。

examples.text: He finally faltered in the last game of a heroic match...
examples.translation: 他在这场艰苦比赛的最后一局中踉跄结束。

examples.text: Their dogged single-mindedness is almost heroic.
examples.translation: 他们不屈不挠专心致志的劲头简直是一种壮举。

examples.text: Single parents cope heroically in doing the job of two people.
examples.translation: 单身父母扮演双亲的角色非常辛苦。

examples.text: ...the book's central, heroic figure.
examples.translation: 书中的中心主角人物

examples.text: ...the man whose aerial heroics helped save the helicopter pilot...
examples.translation: 以空中的英雄壮举拯救了直升机飞行员的人

examples.text: England need heroics from the captain now.
examples.translation: 英格兰队此刻需要队长采取英勇果断的行为。

examples.text: He said his advice was: 'No heroics, stay within the law'...
examples.translation: 他说自己的建议是：“不要逞英雄，要遵纪守法。”

examples.text: Cut it out, Perry. You've performed your heroics. It's all over now.
examples.translation: 住手吧，佩里。你已经逞过英雄了。现在一切都结束了。

examples.text: They were charged with a variety of offences concerning the supply of heroin and crack cocaine.

meanings.meaning: 女主角；女英雄；女杰出人物

examples.text: The heroine is a senior TV executive.
examples.translation: 女主角是一名电视台的高级主管。

examples.text: The national heroine of the day was Xing Fen, winner of the first Gold medal of the Games.
examples.translation: 现今的民族英雄是在该运动会上获得首枚金牌的邢芬。

examples.text: My heroine was Elizabeth Taylor.
examples.translation: 我心目中的偶像是伊丽莎白·泰勒。

examples.text: His hand as it shook hers was warm and firm...
examples.translation: 和她握手时他的手温暖而有力。

examples.text: He'd never seen eyes as green as hers...
examples.translation: 他从未看到过像她那样澄绿的眼睛。

examples.text: Professor Camm was a great friend of hers...
examples.translation: 卡姆教授是她的一位挚友。

examples.text: Hers was the suggestion I acted upon.
examples.translation: 我是按照她的建议去做的。

examples.text: The author can report other people's results which more or less agree with hers.
examples.translation: 作者可以提及其他人得出的和她自己基本吻合的结果。

meanings.meaning: 她自己（she的反身代词）；她亲自

examples.text: She let herself out of the room...
examples.translation: 她走出了房间。

examples.text: Jennifer believes she will move out on her own when she is financially able to support herself...
examples.translation: 珍妮弗相信，当自己有钱养活自己时，就会搬出去单住。

examples.text: Robin didn't feel good about herself.
examples.translation: 罗宾对自己没有信心。

examples.text: How can anyone blame her for actions for which she feels herself to be in no way responsible?
examples.translation: 她认为自己对这些行动不负有责任，别人怎么还能因此而责备她呢？

examples.text: Britain's dream of herself began to fade.
examples.translation: 不列颠民族的梦想开始渐渐幻灭。

examples.text: The ship adjusted herself to the roll and rhythm of the sea.
examples.translation: 船随着海水的起伏节奏时起时落。

examples.text: She's so beautiful herself...
examples.translation: 她本人是如此美丽。

examples.text: Has anyone thought of consulting Bethan herself?...
examples.translation: 有人想过咨询一下贝唐本人的意见吗？

examples.text: She herself was not a keen gardener.
examples.translation: 她本人不是个热衷于园艺的人。

meanings.meaning: 踌躇，犹豫；有疑虑，不愿意

examples.text: The telephone rang. Catherine hesitated, debating whether to answer it...
examples.translation: 电话响了。凯瑟琳犹豫了一下要不要去接。

examples.text: She hesitated a long time and then she said 'Yes'.
examples.translation: 她犹豫了很长时间，然后才说“行”。

examples.text: Asked if he would go back, Mr Searle said after some hesitation, 'I'll have to think about that'...
examples.translation: 当被问到是否会回去时，瑟尔先生迟疑了一下说：“我得考虑考虑。”

examples.text: Mirella approached him and, after a brief hesitation, shook his hand.
examples.translation: 米雷拉走近他，犹豫片刻后，和他握了握手。

examples.text: Some parents hesitate to take these steps because they suspect that their child is exaggerating...
examples.translation: 一些家长不愿意采取这些措施，因为他们怀疑自己的孩子在夸大其词。

examples.text: I hesitated to apply the word 'vulnerable' to him but it came into my mind...
examples.translation: 我不愿用“脆弱”这个词来形容他，但它却突然出现在我脑子里了。

examples.text: I will not hesitate to take unpopular decisions.
examples.translation: 我会毫不犹豫地作出并不受欢迎的决定。

examples.text: In the event of difficulties, please do not hesitate to contact our Customer Service Department...
examples.translation: 如果遇到困难，请尽管和我们的客户服务部联系。

examples.text: Please don't hesitate to tell either Mr Schrader or myself should you feel ill again...
examples.translation: 如果你再觉得不舒服，请尽管告诉施拉德尔先生或我本人。

examples.text: Do not hesitate to laugh at anything you find amusing.
examples.translation: 只要觉得好笑就尽管笑。

meanings.meaning: 嗨！（表示问候或用以唤起注意）

examples.text: 'Hi, Liz,' she said shyly.
examples.translation: “你好，利兹，”她腼腆地说。

examples.text: He hid the bicycle in the hawthorn hedge...
examples.translation: 他把自行车藏在山楂树篱中。

examples.text: They could see that I was terrified, and hid me until the coast was clear.
examples.translation: 他们能看出我很害怕，就把我藏起来，直到没有危险了才让我出来。

examples.text: At their approach the little boy scurried away and hid...
examples.translation: 他们走近时，小男孩急忙跑开藏了起来。

examples.text: They hid themselves behind a tree.
examples.translation: 他们躲到一棵树后。

examples.text: She hid her face under the collar of his jacket and she started to cry...
examples.translation: 她将脸埋在他外套的衣领下，开始哭了起来。

examples.text: He hid his face in his hands again, lost in his own thoughts.
examples.translation: 他又用双手捂住脸，陷入了沉思。

examples.text: Lee tried to hide his excitement...
examples.translation: 李试图掩饰自己的激动心情。

examples.text: I have absolutely nothing to hide, I have done nothing wrong...
examples.translation: 我绝对没有什么好隐瞒的，我没有做错什么。

examples.text: Alison was not the sort of person to hide anything from her dad.
examples.translation: 艾莉森不是那种有事瞒着自己父亲的人。

examples.text: The man's heavy moustache hid his upper lip completely...
examples.translation: 那个男人浓密的髭须完全遮住了他的上唇。

examples.text: The compound was hidden by trees and shrubs.
examples.translation: 大院掩映在树木灌丛之中。

examples.text: ...the process of tanning animal hides.
examples.translation: 鞣制兽皮的工序

examples.text: ...kangaroo hide.
examples.translation: 袋鼠皮

examples.text: Like most other American companies with a rigid hierarchy, workers and managers had strictly defined duties...
examples.translation: 和其他多数拥有严格等级制度的美国公司一样，这里的工人和管理人员都有界定严格的职责。

examples.text: She rose up the Tory hierarchy by the local government route...
examples.translation: 她通过地方政府的渠道在保守党的等级制度中一步步地晋升。

examples.text: Even in the desert there was a kind of social hierarchy.
examples.translation: 即便在沙漠中也存在某种社会等级制度。

examples.text: ...the notion of 'cultural imperialism' implies a hierarchy of cultures, some of which are stronger than others.
examples.translation: “文化扩张主义”意味着一种文化等级体系的存在，其中有些文化要比其他文化更强大。

meanings.meaning: 高的；高级的；崇高的；高音调的
高水平；天空；由麻醉品引起的快感；高压地带

examples.text: ...a house, with a high wall all around it...
examples.translation: 四周围着高墙的房子

examples.text: Mount Marcy is the highest mountain in the Adirondacks.
examples.translation: 马西山是阿迪朗达克山脉中最高的山。

examples.text: ...distraught people who have threatened to jump from high buildings.
examples.translation: 曾威胁说要从高楼跳下的心神不安的人们

examples.text: ...high-heeled shoes...
examples.translation: 高跟鞋

examples.text: The gate was too high for a man of his age to climb.
examples.translation: 大门太高了，像他那个年龄的人爬不上去。

examples.text: ...wagons packed high with bureaus, bedding, and cooking pots.
examples.translation: 书桌、寝具和炊具堆得老高的运货车

examples.text: ...an elegant bronze horse only nine inches high...
examples.translation: 只有9英寸高的精致青铜马雕塑

examples.text: The grass in the yard was waist high...
examples.translation: 院子里的草有齐腰高。

examples.text: Measure your garage: how high is the door?
examples.translation: 量一量你的车库：门有多高？

examples.text: I looked down from the high window...
examples.translation: 我从高高的窗口往下看。

examples.text: The bridge was high, jacked up on wooden piers...
examples.translation: 桥很高，被几个大木墩托起。

examples.text: The sun was high in the sky, blazing down on us...
examples.translation: 太阳高挂在空中，火辣辣地照在我们身上。

examples.text: In Castel Molo, high above Taormina, you can sample the famous almond wine made there.
examples.translation: 在陶尔米纳山高处的莫罗堡，你可以品尝那里酿造的著名的杏仁酒。

examples.text: ...being able to run faster or jump higher than other people.
examples.translation: 能比别人跑得更快、或跳得更高

examples.text: His farm was high up in the hills.
examples.translation: 他的农场在山的高处。

examples.text: ...grapes grown high up on the cliff...
examples.translation: 生长在山崖高处的葡萄

examples.text: We saw three birds circling very high up.
examples.translation: 我们看到3只鸟在高空盘旋。

examples.text: The European country with the highest birth rate is Ireland...
examples.translation: 人口出生率最高的欧洲国家是爱尔兰。

examples.text: Official reports said casualties were high...
examples.translation: 官方报告称死伤惨重。

examples.text: The higher the risk of lending money, the higher is the interest rate demanded by the lenders...
examples.translation: 贷款的风险越高，贷方索要的利率就越高。

examples.text: High winds have knocked down trees and power lines...
examples.translation: 大风刮倒了树木和电线。

examples.text: Commercialisation has given many sports a higher profile.
examples.translation: 商业化已经让多项体育运动有了更高的公众关注度。

examples.text: He expects the unemployment figures to rise even higher in coming months.
examples.translation: 他预计失业人数会在今后几个月里进一步攀升。

examples.text: Don't indulge in rich sauces, fried food and thick pastry as these are high in fat.
examples.translation: 不要吃太多浓酱汁、油炸食品和甜腻的油酥点心，因为这些食品的脂肪含量很高。

examples.text: ...a superb compost, high in calcium.
examples.translation: 富含钙的优质堆肥

examples.text: Traffic from Jordan to Iraq is down to a dozen loaded lorries a day, compared with a high of 200 a day...
examples.translation: 现在从约旦到伊拉克一天只有十几辆装货的卡车通过，而最高峰时可达到一天200辆。

examples.text: Sales of Russian vodka have reached an all-time high.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯伏特加酒的销量已达到历史最高水平。

examples.text: The Labour Party has not made the issue a high priority...
examples.translation: 工党尚未将该问题列为优先考虑的事项。

examples.text: Economic reform is high on the agenda.
examples.translation: 经济改革已成为头等大事。

examples.text: Was there anyone particularly high in the administration who was an advocate of a different policy?...
examples.translation: 政府中有没有哪位高层人物支持采取不同政策？

examples.text: Every single one of the arms companies is controlled by the families of high officials.
examples.translation: 每一家军火公司都是由高官家族控制的。

examples.text: ...corruption in high places.
examples.translation: 高层腐败

examples.text: ...high social class.
examples.translation: 上层社会

examples.text: His cousin is somebody quite high up in the navy...
examples.translation: 他的堂兄是一位海军高官。

examples.text: You've offended somebody very high up.
examples.translation: 你得罪了某位高层人物。

examples.text: Neither Anna nor I are interested in high finance.
examples.translation: 安娜和我对巨额融资都不感兴趣。

examples.text: ...the rise of Japan's high technology industries.
examples.translation: 日本高科技产业的崛起

examples.text: You should not be afraid to aim high in the quest for an improvement in your income...
examples.translation: 想让自己的收入有所提高时，你应该敢于给自己设定高的目标。

examples.text: We just do not set our sights high enough.
examples.translation: 我们设定的目标不够高远。

examples.text: She has always had a high reputation for her excellent short stories...
examples.translation: 她一直因其优秀的短篇小说享有很高的声望。

examples.text: People have such high expectations of you.
examples.translation: 人们对你寄予重望。

examples.text: This is high quality stuff...
examples.translation: 这东西质量很好。

examples.text: His team were of the highest calibre...
examples.translation: 他的团队水平一流。

examples.text: Schools award scholarships for high academic achievement.
examples.translation: 学校向学业成绩优异者授予奖学金。

examples.text: He was a man of the highest principles.
examples.translation: 他是个道德崇高的人。

examples.text: Her high voice really irritated Maria.
examples.translation: 她的尖嗓门实在让玛丽亚很恼火。

examples.text: The waters of the Yangtze River are dangerously high for the time of year.
examples.translation: 长江的水位每年这个时候都处于危险的高位。

examples.text: Her spirits were high with the hope of seeing Nick in minutes rather than hours.
examples.translation: 她很兴奋，因为再过几分钟而不是几小时后就有希望见到尼克了。

examples.text: He was too high on drugs and alcohol to remember them.
examples.translation: 他吸毒酗酒后处于极度兴奋状态，已经记不得他们了。

examples.text: Orders had come from on high that extra care was to be taken during this week.
examples.translation: 上面下了命令，本周要格外小心。

examples.text: Schools with better reputations will be flooded with applications while poorer schools will be left high and dry.
examples.translation: 较有名气的学校将会收到如潮水涌至般的申请，而差一些的学校则会陷入招生困境。

examples.text: Highland Birchwoods will help the groups progress towards decisions on whether to build the plants.

meanings.meaning: 最精彩的部分；最重要的事情；加亮区

examples.text: Last year Collins wrote a moving ballad which highlighted the plight of the homeless...
examples.translation: 去年，柯林斯写了一首动人的抒情歌曲，突出描绘了无家可归者的苦境。

examples.text: Once again, the 'Free Press' prefers not to highlight these facts...
examples.translation: “自由新闻”组织再次故意不去突出强调这些事实。

examples.text: Two events have highlighted the tensions in recent days.
examples.translation: 两起事件进一步凸显了最近一段时间的紧张局势。

examples.text: Highlight the chosen area by clicking and holding down the left mouse button.
examples.translation: 点击并摁住鼠标左键将所选区域高亮显示。

examples.text: ...the relevant maps with the route highlighted in yellow.
examples.translation: 用黄色荧光笔标出路线的相关地图

examples.text: ...a match that is likely to prove one of the highlights of the tournament...
examples.translation: 可能是本次联赛中最精彩的比赛之一

examples.text: The highlight of my day used to be cooking Meg a meal when she came in from work...
examples.translation: 过去，我一天中最有意思的事就是在梅格下班回到家时为她做顿饭。

examples.text: I don't want to watch the game now. I'll just wait till the highlights come on later tonight.
examples.translation: 我现在不想看比赛。我要等到今晚晚些时候好戏上演的时候再看。

meanings.meaning: 高度地；非常；非常赞许地

examples.text: Mr Singh was a highly successful salesman...
examples.translation: 辛格先生是个非常成功的推销员。

examples.text: It seems highly unlikely that she ever existed.
examples.translation: 她好像压根就没存在过。

examples.text: ...the highly controversial nuclear energy programme.
examples.translation: 备受争议的核能计划

examples.text: ...a highly placed government advisor.
examples.translation: 高级政府顾问

examples.text: ...highly ranked soccer teams.
examples.translation: 名列前茅的足球队

examples.text: He was the most highly paid member of staff.
examples.translation: 他是员工中薪酬最高的。

examples.text: Daphne and Michael thought highly of the school.
examples.translation: 达夫妮和迈克尔对那所学校评价很高。

examples.text: ...one of the most highly regarded chefs in the French capital.
examples.translation: 法国首都最受推崇的厨师之一

examples.text: I crossed the highway, dodging the traffic.
examples.translation: 我避开车流穿过了公路。

examples.text: Two men tried to hijack a plane on a flight from Riga to Murmansk...
examples.translation: 两名男子试图劫持一架从里加飞往摩尔曼斯克的飞机。

examples.text: A Korean airliner was hijacked by two passengers and forced to fly to Tashkent...
examples.translation: 一架韩国的大型客机被两名乘客劫持，被迫飞往塔什干。

examples.text: The hijacked plane exploded in a ball of fire.
examples.translation: 被劫持的飞机爆炸,变成了一团火球。

examples.text: Every minute during the hijack seemed like a week.
examples.translation: 被劫持过程中，每一分钟都过得如同一周那么漫长。

examples.text: Car hijackings are running at a rate of nearly 50 a day.
examples.translation: 劫车事件的发生率高达每天近50起。

examples.text: A peaceful demonstration had been hijacked by anarchists intent on causing trouble.
examples.translation: 和平示威已遭到蓄意制造事端的无政府主义者的操控。

examples.text: You could hike through the Fish River Canyon...
examples.translation: 你可以徒步穿越鱼河峡谷。

examples.text: We plan to hike the Samaria Gorge.
examples.translation: 我们计划去撒马利亚峡谷远足。

examples.text: ...some harder, more strenuous hiking on cliff pathways.
examples.translation: 沿着悬崖峭壁上的羊肠小路前行的更艰难费力的徒步旅行

examples.text: ...heavy hiking boots.
examples.translation: 沉重的登山靴

examples.text: ...a sudden 1.75 per cent hike in Italian interest rates...
examples.translation: 意大利利率1.75%的突然上浮

examples.text: His economic plan, with its tax hikes and spending cuts, will slow the economy.
examples.translation: 他通过采取上调税率和削减支出等经济计划,将会使经济发展放慢速度。

examples.text: It has now been forced to hike its rates by 5.25 per cent...
examples.translation: 它目前已经被迫将利率提高了5.25%。

examples.text: TSB's monthly credit card rate is now hiked from 1.95% to 2.05%...
examples.translation: TSB银行的信用卡月利率现在从1.95%提高到了2.05%。

examples.text: The federal government hiked the tax on hard liquor.
examples.translation: 联邦政府提高了烈性酒的税率。

examples.text: The insurers have started hiking up premiums by huge amounts...
examples.translation: 保险公司已经开始大幅度提高保费。

examples.text: Big banks were hiking their rates up.
examples.translation: 各大银行正在提高利率。

meanings.meaning: (Hill)人名；(法、西)伊尔；(德、英、匈、捷、罗、芬、瑞典)希尔

examples.text: We trudged up the hill to the stadium.
examples.translation: 我们费力地爬到山上的体育场。

examples.text: ...Maple Hill.
examples.translation: 梅普尔山

examples.text: ...the Black Hills of Dakota.
examples.translation: 达科他州的布莱克丘陵

examples.text: He doesn't take kindly to suggestions that he is over the hill.
examples.translation: 他不爱听别人说他风光不再。

meanings.meaning: (Him)人名；(东南亚国家华语)欣；(柬)亨；(中)谦(广东话·威妥玛)

examples.text: John's aunt died suddenly and left him a surprisingly large sum...
examples.translation: 约翰的婶婶突然去世了，留给他一笔巨额财产。

examples.text: Is Sam there? Let me talk to him...
examples.translation: 萨姆在吗？让我和他谈谈。

examples.text: On his arrival, Elaine met him at the bus station...
examples.translation: 他来时，伊莱恩在汽车站迎接他。

examples.text: My brother had a lovely dog. I looked after him for about a week.
examples.translation: 我哥哥有一只可爱的狗。我照看了它约一周。

examples.text: If the child sees the word 'hear', we should show him that this is the base word in 'hearing' and 'hears'.
examples.translation: 如果孩子看到hear这个词，我们就应该告诉他这是hearing和hears的词干。

examples.text: God will help you if you turn to Him in humility and trust.
examples.translation: 如果你怀着一颗谦恭而信任的心向上帝求助，上帝会帮助你。

examples.text: He poured himself a whisky and sat down in the chair...
examples.translation: 他给自己倒了一杯威士忌，然后坐在椅子上。

examples.text: A driver blew up his car and himself after being stopped at a police checkpoint...
examples.translation: 一名司机在一个警方检查站被拦截后，把自己连人带车炸上了天。

examples.text: William went away muttering to himself.
examples.translation: 威廉喃喃自语着走开了。

examples.text: The child's natural way of expressing himself is play...
examples.translation: 孩子表达自己的本能方法就是玩耍。

examples.text: The student is invited to test each item for himself by means of specific techniques.
examples.translation: 邀请学生们采用特定的技术自己去测试每个项目。

examples.text: He thanked God for concealing Himself from the wise and revealing Himself to the simple.
examples.translation: 他感谢上帝，因为上帝在自作聪明的人面前自行隐匿，在心地纯洁的人面前则显现神迹。

examples.text: There's no evidence that the Prime Minister himself cancelled the visit.
examples.translation: 没有证据表明是首相本人取消了访问。

examples.text: He himself had joined the others straight from the office...
examples.translation: 他本人下班后径直加入到了他们的行列。

examples.text: There's no work and no future for students like himself.
examples.translation: 像他这样的学生既找不到工作，也看不到前途。

examples.text: Does the fact that your players are part-timers help or hinder you?...
examples.translation: 队员们都是兼职的，这对你有利还是不利？

examples.text: Further investigation was hindered by the loss of all documentation on the case.
examples.translation: 由于案件卷宗全部丢失致使进一步的调查受阻。

examples.text: A thigh injury increasingly hindered her mobility...
examples.translation: 大腿受伤使她行动愈发不便。

examples.text: Landslides and bad weather are continuing to hinder the arrival of relief supplies to the area.
examples.translation: 滑坡和恶劣天气仍在阻碍救援物资运送到该地区。

meanings.meaning: 铰链，折叶；关键，转折点；枢要，中枢
用铰链连接；依…为转移；给…安装铰链；（门等）装有蝶铰

examples.text: The top swung open on well-oiled hinges.
examples.translation: 用润滑良好的铰链固定的盖子一旋转就打开了。

meanings.meaning: 熟悉内情的；非常时尚的
(Hip)人名；(塞)希普；(中)协(广东话·威妥玛)

examples.text: Tracey put her hands on her hips and sighed.
examples.translation: 特蕾西双手叉腰叹了口气。

examples.text: He is broad-chested and narrow-hipped.
examples.translation: 他宽肩窄臀。

examples.text: ...a hip young character with tight-cropped blond hair and stylish glasses.
examples.translation: 留着一头毛寸金发、戴着时尚眼镜的时髦青年

examples.text: Judges don't have to shoot from the hip. They have the leisure to think, to decide.
examples.translation: 法官们不必贸然行事。他们可以不慌不忙地去思考，去决定。

examples.text: The Minister gave a strong hint that the government were thinking of introducing tax concessions for mothers...
examples.translation: 部长明显地暗示政府正在考虑对母亲们实行税收减免。

examples.text: I'd dropped a hint about having an exhibition of his work up here...
examples.translation: 我已经暗示要在这里举办一次他的作品展。

examples.text: The statement gave no hint as to what the measures would be.
examples.translation: 讲话没有就这些措施的具体内容作出暗示。

examples.text: 'I think I hear the telephone ringing.'—'Okay, I can take a hint.'
examples.translation: “我想我听到电话铃在响。”——“好的，我明白你的意思了。”

examples.text: She suggested a trip to the shops and hinted at the possibility of a treat of some sort...
examples.translation: 她建议去逛逛商店，并暗示可能要请客。

examples.text: Criticism is hinted at, but never made explicit...
examples.translation: 批评总是含沙射影，但从未明说。

examples.text: Was he hinting that there could be some connection between drugs and Ian's disappearance?...
examples.translation: 他是不是在暗示毒品和伊恩的失踪有某种联系？

examples.text: The President hinted he might make some changes in the government.
examples.translation: 总统暗示他可能会在政府中进行某些改革。

examples.text: Here are some helpful hints to make your journey easier...
examples.translation: 几条有用的建议可以让你的旅途更轻松。

examples.text: I'm hoping to get some fashion hints.
examples.translation: 我希望能得到一些有关时尚的建议。

examples.text: She added only a hint of vermouth to the gin...
examples.translation: 她只在杜松子酒里加了少许苦艾酒。

examples.text: I glanced at her and saw no hint of irony on her face.
examples.translation: 我瞥了她一眼，没有在她的脸上看到一丝嘲弄。

examples.text: Sixteen of the contestants have hired lawyers and are suing the organisers...
examples.translation: 有16名参赛者已经请了律师，正在起诉主办方。

examples.text: The rest of the staff have been hired on short-term contracts...
examples.translation: 其余的工作人员签的是短期雇用合同。

examples.text: He will be in charge of all hiring and firing at PHA.
examples.translation: 他将负责公共房产管理局所有人员的雇用和解聘事务。

examples.text: ...the mystery assassin (who turned out to be a hired killer).
examples.translation: 神秘刺客（最终被证实是一名雇用杀手）

examples.text: To hire a car you must produce a passport and a current driving licence...
examples.translation: 租车须出示护照及有效驾照。

examples.text: Her hired car was found abandoned at Beachy Head.
examples.translation: 她那辆租来的车被发现遗弃在比奇角。

examples.text: They booked our hotel, and organised car hire...
examples.translation: 他们为我们订好了旅馆并安排了租车事宜。

examples.text: Hire of skis, boots and clothing, is all available.
examples.translation: 滑雪板、滑雪靴和滑雪服皆有出租。

examples.text: ...a day's outing by hire car to the southern coast of Crete.
examples.translation: 赴克里特南部海滨租车一日游

examples.text: Fishing tackle is available for hire.
examples.translation: 有钓具可供出租。

examples.text: His is a third person singular possessive determiner. His is also a possessive pronoun.
examples.translation: his 是第三人称单数所有格限定词，亦为所有格代词。

examples.text: He spent a large part of his career in Hollywood...
examples.translation: 他的职业生涯中有很长一段时间是在好莱坞度过的。

examples.text: The past 10 years have been the happiest and most fulfilling of his life...
examples.translation: 过去10年是他一生中最快乐、最充实的时期。

examples.text: The dog let his head thump on the floor again.
examples.translation: 那只狗又用头撞地板。

examples.text: He had taken advice, but the decision was his...
examples.translation: 他听取了别人的建议，但决定是他自己作出的。

examples.text: Anna reached out her hand to him and clasped his.
examples.translation: 安娜向他伸出手，两双手握在一起。

examples.text: Formerly, the relations between a teacher and his pupils were dominated by fear on the part of the pupils...
examples.translation: 以往的师生关系主要是学生惧怕老师。

examples.text: Everyone should receive a fair price for the product of his labour.
examples.translation: 每个人都应该按劳所得。

examples.text: The student going to art or drama school will be very enthusiastic about further education. His is not a narrow mind, but one eager to grasp every facet of anything he studies.
examples.translation: 上艺术或戏剧学校的学生会渴望继续深造。他们思想活跃，迫切地想要掌握自己所学知识的每一个方面。

examples.text: ...humble faith in God, and trust in His Church.
examples.translation: 对上帝的谦卑信仰和对教会的信任

examples.text: In what way do you feel called to serve God as a clergyman? Is it your way, or His?
examples.translation: 作为一位牧师你认为自己是如何受召唤去为上帝服务的？是受你自己的召唤，还是上帝的召唤？

examples.text: Paul Kingsbury, a music historian at the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum, explains why.

meanings.meaning: 有历史意义的；历史上著名的

examples.text: ...the historic changes in Eastern Europe.
examples.translation: 东欧的历史性变革

examples.text: ...a fourth historic election victory.
examples.translation: 第4次具有重大历史意义的竞选胜利

meanings.meaning: 历史的；史学的；基于史实的

examples.text: ...an important historical figure.
examples.translation: 重要的历史人物

examples.text: ...the historical impact of Western capitalism on the world...
examples.translation: 西方资本主义对世界历史的影响

examples.text: In Buda, several historical monuments can be seen.
examples.translation: 在比尤达可以看到几处历史遗迹。

examples.text: Historically, royal marriages have been cold, calculating affairs.
examples.translation: 在历史上，皇室婚姻一直是冷漠且处处算计的事情。

examples.text: He is writing a historical novel about nineteenth-century France.
examples.translation: 他正在写一本描述19世纪法国的历史小说。

examples.text: ...another great Eisenstein historical film.
examples.translation: 爱森斯坦的另一部杰出的历史片

examples.text: ...historical records.
examples.translation: 史籍

examples.text: ...modern historical research.
examples.translation: 现代史学研究

examples.text: It was this kind of historical context that Morris brought to his work...
examples.translation: 莫里斯的作品正是基于这样一种历史背景。

examples.text: The Telegraph puts the union in a historical perspective.
examples.translation: 《电讯报》从历史的角度对该工会进行了报道。

meanings.meaning: 历史，历史学；历史记录；来历

examples.text: The Catholic Church has played a prominent role throughout Polish history.
examples.translation: 天主教会在整个波兰历史上曾发挥过举足轻重的作用。

examples.text: ...the most evil mass killer in history.
examples.translation: 历史上最令人发指的屠杀狂徒

examples.text: ...the history of Birmingham.
examples.translation: 伯明翰的历史

examples.text: ...religious history.
examples.translation: 宗教史

examples.text: Willy Brandt made history by visiting East Germany in 1970.
examples.translation: 威利·勃兰特1970年访问东德，书写了历史新篇章。

examples.text: Bradley will go down in history as Los Angeles' longest serving mayor.
examples.translation: 布拉德利将作为洛杉矶任期最长的市长被载入史册。

examples.text: ...a day that will go down in history.
examples.translation: 将被载入史册的一天

examples.text: ...his magnificent history of broadcasting in Canada.
examples.translation: 他在加拿大辉煌的播音史

examples.text: ...oral histories taken from elderly people in Rochester.
examples.translation: 罗切斯特老一辈人的口述史

examples.text: He had a history of drink problems...
examples.translation: 他过去酗酒度日。

examples.text: The boy's mother had a history of abusing her children.
examples.translation: 男孩的母亲过去常虐待自己的孩子。

examples.text: He couldn't get a new job because of his medical history.
examples.translation: 由于他的病史，他无法找到新的工作。

examples.text: ...an exhibition documenting the personal history of Anne Frank.
examples.translation: 安妮·弗兰克生平资料展

examples.text: The Charlottetown agreement is history.
examples.translation: 夏洛特敦协定已成为历史。

examples.text: We met at college, the rest is history.
examples.translation: 我们是在上大学时认识的，接下来的事大家都知道了。

examples.text: The polytechnics have hitherto been at an unfair disadvantage in competing for pupils and money...
examples.translation: 到目前为止，理工专科学校在争取生源和资金方面一直处于劣势。

examples.text: Hitherto, the main emphasis has been on the need to resist aggression...
examples.translation: 迄今为止，一直重点强调的是要抵抗侵略。

examples.text: The helicopter is the first in the world to be designed to serve three hitherto very distinct markets.
examples.translation: 这款直升机是世界上首批为满足3个迄今为止完全不同的市场而设计的机型。

meanings.meaning: 打击；袭击；碰撞；偶然发现；伤…的感情
打；打击；（演出等）成功；讽刺

examples.text: Find the exact grip that allows you to hit the ball hard...
examples.translation: 找到能让你大力击球的准确握拍方法。

examples.text: She hit him hard across his left arm...
examples.translation: 她狠狠地打在他的左臂上。

examples.text: Police at the scene said Dr Mahgoub had been hit several times in the head.
examples.translation: 现场的警察称马哈古卜医生的头部遭到了几次击打。

examples.text: The car had apparently hit a traffic sign before skidding out of control...
examples.translation: 汽车显然是撞上了一个交通标志牌后打滑失控的。

examples.text: She hit the last barrier and sprawled across the track.
examples.translation: 她撞上了最后一个跨栏，整个人趴在了跑道上。

examples.text: ...multiple-warhead missiles that could hit many targets at a time...
examples.translation: 可一次击中多个目标的多弹头导弹

examples.text: The hospital had been hit with heavy artillery fire.
examples.translation: 医院被重炮击中。

examples.text: First a house took a direct hit and then the rocket exploded.
examples.translation: 先是一幢房子被直接击中，然后火箭弹就爆炸了。

examples.text: The plan to charge motorists £75 a year to use the motorway is going to hit me hard...
examples.translation: 向汽车驾驶员每年收取75英镑高速公路使用费的计划将对我大为不利。

examples.text: About two-hundred people died in the earthquake which hit northern Peru...
examples.translation: 约200人在秘鲁北部发生的地震中丧生。

examples.text: Special schools were hardest hit.
examples.translation: 特殊教育学校是受打击最为严重的。

examples.text: It hit me that I had a choice...
examples.translation: 我突然意识到我有选择的余地。

examples.text: Then the answer hit me. It had been staring me in the face.
examples.translation: 然后我突然想到了答案，原来它一直就明摆在我的面前。

examples.text: He admits to having hit the lowest point in his life ...
examples.translation: 他承认自己跌到了一生中的最低谷。

examples.text: Oil prices hit record levels yesterday.
examples.translation: 油价昨天达到了创纪录的水平。

examples.text: The song became a massive hit in 1945.
examples.translation: 这首歌在1945年风靡大江南北。

examples.text: ...the surprise hit video of the year.
examples.translation: 本年度出乎意料的热门视频

examples.text: Our small company has had 78,000 hits on its Internet pages.
examples.translation: 我们这个小公司的因特网网页已经有了78,000次的点击量。

examples.text: They hit it off straight away, Daddy and Walter...
examples.translation: 爸爸和沃尔特很快就一见如故。

examples.text: How well did you hit it off with one another?
examples.translation: 你们俩人合得来吗？

examples.text: He made a hit with Lady Sopwith...
examples.translation: 他深受索普威思太太的喜爱。

examples.text: She sends her best wishes — you've obviously made a hit there.
examples.translation: 她向你问好——看得出来你在那里大受欢迎。

examples.text: My hobbies are letter writing, football, music, photography, and tennis.
examples.translation: 我的业余爱好是写信、踢足球、听音乐、玩摄影和打网球。

examples.text: Hoisting my suitcase on to my shoulder, I turned and headed toward my hotel...
examples.translation: 我把手提箱扛到肩上，转身向入住的旅馆走去。

examples.text: Grabbing the side of the bunk, he hoisted himself to a sitting position.
examples.translation: 他抓住铺位的床沿，坐起身来。

examples.text: A twenty-foot steel pyramid is to be hoisted into position on top of the tower...
examples.translation: 一个高20英尺的钢质角锥体将被吊起，安装在塔的顶部。

examples.text: Then a crane hoisted him on to the platform.
examples.translation: 然后一台升降机将他送到了舞台上。

examples.text: A group of youths hoisted their flag on top of the disputed monument.
examples.translation: 一群年轻人将他们的旗帜升到那座备受争议的纪念碑顶上。

meanings.meaning: 持有人；所有人；固定器；（台、架等）支持物

examples.text: This season the club has had 73,500 season-ticket holders.
examples.translation: 本赛季该俱乐部已经有73,500名持有季票的观众。

examples.text: ...Peter Koech, the record holder in the 3,000 metres steeplechase.
examples.translation: 3,000米障碍赛跑的纪录保持者彼得·克奇

examples.text: ...the holders of the European Football Championship.
examples.translation: 拥有欧洲足球锦标赛冠军称号的球队

examples.text: ...a toothbrush holder.
examples.translation: 牙刷托

examples.text: ...a cigarette holder.
examples.translation: 烟嘴

meanings.meaning: 凿洞，穿孔；（高尔夫球等）进洞

examples.text: He took a shovel, dug a hole, and buried his once-prized possessions...
examples.translation: 他拿起一把铁锨，挖了个坑，将自己曾经珍爱的物品埋了起来。

examples.text: The builders had cut holes into the soft stone to support the ends of the beams.
examples.translation: 建筑工人在软石上挖了洞以支撑梁端。

examples.text: ...a 60ft hole.
examples.translation: 60英尺深的洞

examples.text: These tiresome creatures eat holes in the leaves...
examples.translation: 这些讨厌的虫子在叶子上咬出了洞。

examples.text: Armed robbers broke into the jeweller's through a hole in the wall.
examples.translation: 持枪劫匪钻过墙洞闯进了珠宝店。

examples.text: ...kids with holes in the knees of their jeans.
examples.translation: 牛仔裤膝部有破洞的小孩

examples.text: ...a rabbit hole.
examples.translation: 兔窝

examples.text: There were some holes in that theory, some unanswered questions.
examples.translation: 那个理论中有一些漏洞，一些问题没有解答。

examples.text: Why don't you leave this awful hole and come to live with me?
examples.translation: 你为什么不离开这个破地方，搬过来和我住？

examples.text: I played nine holes with Gary Player today.
examples.translation: 我今天和加里·普莱耶打了9洞高尔夫球。

examples.text: He holed from nine feet at the 18th...
examples.translation: 他打到第18洞时从9英尺外击球入穴。

examples.text: Frost holed a bunker shot from 50 feet to snatch the title by one stroke.
examples.translation: 弗罗斯特在50英尺外的沙坑中击球入穴，以一杆的优势获得冠军。

examples.text: Blocks of flats have been holed and some shells have fallen within the historic ramparts.
examples.translation: 几栋公寓楼被炸出了窟窿，几枚炮弹还落在了古护城墙内。

examples.text: We need more folk heroes like we need a hole in the head.
examples.translation: 我们绝对不需要有更多的民间英雄了。

examples.text: He admitted that the government was in 'a dreadful hole'.
examples.translation: 他承认政府目前“处境极为尴尬”。

examples.text: All they ever dream about is getting a hole in one.
examples.translation: 他们一直梦想着能一杆入穴。

examples.text: He then goes on to pick holes in the article before reaching his conclusion.
examples.translation: 他接着在文章中挑了一番刺儿后才作出结论。

examples.text: I've just come back from a holiday in the United States...
examples.translation: 我刚从美国度假回来。

examples.text: We rang Duncan to ask where he was going on holiday...
examples.translation: 我们打电话给邓肯，问他要去哪里度假。

examples.text: Ischia is a popular seaside holiday resort...
examples.translation: 伊斯基亚是个很受欢迎的海滨度假胜地。

examples.text: We're going to Scotland for our holidays.
examples.translation: 我们要去苏格兰度假。

examples.text: New Year's Day is a public holiday throughout Britain...
examples.translation: 元旦是全英国的公众假日。

examples.text: He invited her to spend the Fourth of July holiday at his summer home on Fire Island...
examples.translation: 他邀请她去自己在法尔岛上的消夏寓所过美国独立纪念日。

examples.text: Bad weather has caused dozens of flight cancellations over the holiday weekend.
examples.translation: 恶劣的天气已经导致这个连假周末数十个航班被取消。

examples.text: ...the first day of the school holidays.
examples.translation: 学校放假的第一天

examples.text: Every worker will be entitled to four weeks' paid holiday a year.
examples.translation: 每位工人每年都能享受4周的带薪休假。

examples.text: Sampling the local cuisine is one of the delights of holidaying abroad...
examples.translation: 品尝当地菜肴是海外度假的乐趣之一。

examples.text: Vacant rooms on the campus were being used by holidaying families.
examples.translation: 校园里的闲置宿舍住着一些度假的家庭。

meanings.meaning: 空的；中空的，空腹的；凹的；虚伪的

examples.text: ...a hollow tree.
examples.translation: 空心的树

examples.text: ...a hollow cylinder.
examples.translation: 中空圆筒

examples.text: He looked young, dark and sharp-featured, with hollow cheeks.
examples.translation: 他看起来很年轻，肤色黝黑，五官分明，双颊凹陷。

examples.text: I made my home there, in the hollow of a dying elm.
examples.translation: 我在一棵快要枯死的榆树的树洞里安了家。

examples.text: Below him the town lay warm in the hollow of the hill.
examples.translation: 在他下方，小镇卧在温暖的山谷里。

examples.text: ...where water gathers in a hollow and forms a pond.
examples.translation: 在那里水积聚在低洼处形成了池塘

examples.text: Any threat to bring in the police is a hollow one.
examples.translation: 任何威胁说要叫警察来的话都是虚声恫吓。

examples.text: ...a hollow man who's coasted on charm for far too long.
examples.translation: 长久以来一直依靠个人魅力取胜的肤浅之人

examples.text: One month before the deadline we see the hollowness of these promises.
examples.translation: 离最后期限只有一个月时，我们认识到了这些许诺都是空头支票。

examples.text: Murray Pick's hollow laugh had no mirth in it.
examples.translation: 默里·皮克的干笑里没有一点快乐。

examples.text: ...the hollow sound of a gunshot.
examples.translation: 空洞的枪响

examples.text: The mule's back was hollowed by the weight of its burden.
examples.translation: 骡背被重负压得塌下了。

examples.text: ...her high, elegantly hollowed cheekbones.
examples.translation: 她凹陷有致的高颧骨

examples.text: To them, as to all Christians, this is a holy place.
examples.translation: 对他们以及所有基督徒来说，这里是一处圣地。

examples.text: ...Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
examples.translation: 赎罪日，犹太历中最神圣的日子

examples.text: The Indians think of him as a holy man, a combination of doctor and priest.
examples.translation: 印度人把他视为圣人，他既是医生又是僧侣。

examples.text: Have you done your homework, Gemma?
examples.translation: 杰玛，你做完家庭作业了吗？

examples.text: Before you go near a stockbroker, do your homework.
examples.translation: 找股票经纪人之前，先要做好必要的准备工作。

meanings.meaning: 家，住宅；产地；家乡；避难所

examples.text: Last night they stayed at home and watched TV...
examples.translation: 昨晚他们呆在了家里看电视。

examples.text: ...his home in Hampstead.
examples.translation: 他位于汉普斯特德的住所

examples.text: ...the allocation of land for new homes.
examples.translation: 新建住宅用地的划拨

examples.text: She gives frequent performances of her work, both at home and abroad...
examples.translation: 她经常在国内外演出自己的作品。

examples.text: His father worked away from home for much of Jim's first five years...
examples.translation: 父亲在吉姆5岁前的大部分时间里都在外地工作。

examples.text: At seventeen, Daniele was told to leave home by her father...
examples.translation: 达妮埃尔17岁时，父亲让她离开了家。

examples.text: Ms Highsmith has made Switzerland her home...
examples.translation: 海史密斯女士已经在瑞士安了家。

examples.text: Warwick is home to some 550 international students...
examples.translation: 华威大学约有550名外国留学生。

examples.text: Brian decided to leave the UK and set up home in Southern Spain...
examples.translation: 布赖恩决定离开英国，去西班牙南部定居。

examples.text: He has moved back to his home town of Miami.
examples.translation: 他已经搬回了自己的家乡迈阿密。

examples.text: His wife wasn't feeling too well and she wanted to go home...
examples.translation: 他的妻子感到有些不舒服，想要回家。

examples.text: I'll telephone you as soon as I get home...
examples.translation: 我一到家就给你打电话。

examples.text: Hi, Mom, I'm home!...
examples.translation: 嘿，妈妈，我回家了！

examples.text: Company officials say striking union members should stay home today.
examples.translation: 公司管理人员说参加罢工的工会会员今天应该呆在家里。

examples.text: ...cheap but healthy home cooking...
examples.translation: 便宜而健康的家常菜

examples.text: All you have to do is make a home video.
examples.translation: 你要做的就是拍一段家庭录像片。

examples.text: Europe's software companies still have a growing home market.
examples.translation: 欧洲软件公司的国内市场仍在增长中。

examples.text: ...the Guardian's home news pages.
examples.translation: 《卫报》的国内新闻版

examples.text: It's going to be a home for handicapped children.
examples.translation: 这将是一家残疾儿童福利院。

examples.text: ...an old people's home.
examples.translation: 养老院

examples.text: She had, at any rate, provided a peaceful and loving home for Harriet...
examples.translation: 她至少为哈丽雅特提供了一个安宁关爱的家。

examples.text: Single-parent homes are commonplace.
examples.translation: 单亲家庭很普遍。

examples.text: This south-west region of France is the home of claret.
examples.translation: 法国西南部的这个地区是干红葡萄酒的产地。

examples.text: The equipment itself is getting smaller, neater and easier to find a home for.
examples.translation: 该设备本身正变得越来越小，越来越轻巧，也越来越便于存放。

examples.text: It is now up to all of us to debate this issue and press home the argument.
examples.translation: 现在要靠我们大家对此问题进行辩论，并尽可能将论点阐述清楚。

examples.text: I scored in both games against Barcelona; we drew at home and beat them away.
examples.translation: 我在两场对阵巴塞罗那队的比赛中都进了球;我们在主场战平，在客场赢了他们。

examples.text: All three are Chelsea fans, and attend all home games together.
examples.translation: 3个人都是切尔西队的球迷，一起观看了所有的主场比赛。

examples.text: He spoke very good English and appeared pleased to see us, and we soon felt quite at home...
examples.translation: 他英语说得非常好，见到我们显得很高兴，我们很快就不拘束了。

examples.text: I am not completely at home in any Protestant Church.
examples.translation: 我在任何一个新教教会都不是特别自在。

examples.text: Their sobering conversation brought home to everyone present the serious and worthwhile work the Red Cross does.
examples.translation: 他们发人深省的对话使在座的每个人都清楚地认识到红十字会所从事的严肃而有价值的工作。

examples.text: The prime minister and the moderates are not yet home and dry.
examples.translation: 首相和温和派还未大功告成。

examples.text: Did the reality of war finally hit home?...
examples.translation: 人们终于认清战争的现实了吗？

examples.text: Israeli officials say that message struck home.
examples.translation: 以色列官员说这一信息切中了要害。

examples.text: Many cottages are a home from home, offering microwaves, dishwashers, tvs and videos.
examples.translation: 很多度假屋都像自家一样，里面有微波炉、洗碗机、电视机和录像机。

examples.text: So a dreary Monday afternoon in Walthamstow is nothing to write home about, right?
examples.translation: 这么说，在沃尔瑟姆斯托度过的一个沉闷的周一下午没什么值得大书特书的，是吗？

examples.text: Only two torpedoes struck home.
examples.translation: 只有两枚鱼雷击中了目标。

meanings.meaning: 均匀的；[数] 齐次的；同种的

examples.text: The unemployed are not a homogeneous group...
examples.translation: 失业者不能一概而论。

examples.text: Russia is ethnically relatively homogeneous.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯是个民族成分相对单一的国家。

meanings.meaning: 诚实的，实在的；可靠的；坦率的

examples.text: My dad was the most honest man I ever met...
examples.translation: 爸爸是我所见过的最正直的人。

examples.text: I know she's honest and reliable.
examples.translation: 我知道她诚实可靠。

examples.text: She fought honestly for a just cause and for freedom.
examples.translation: 她为了正义的事业和自由而光明正大地斗争。

examples.text: I was honest about what I was doing...
examples.translation: 我对自己所做的事情并无隐瞒。

examples.text: He had been honest with her and she had tricked him!...
examples.translation: 他对她坦诚相见，而她却骗了他！

examples.text: What do you think of the school, in your honest opinion?
examples.translation: 坦率地说，你认为这个学校怎么样？

examples.text: It came as a shock to hear an old friend speak so honestly about Ted.
examples.translation: 听到一位老朋友如此坦率地谈起特德真让人大吃一惊。

examples.text: I'm not sure, honest.
examples.translation: 我不能肯定，真的。

examples.text: I wish we weren't doing this, Lillian, honest to God, I really do...
examples.translation: 我希望我们没有在干这事，莉莲，真的，我真这么想。

examples.text: You wanna know the honest-to-God truth?
examples.translation: 你想知道真正的事实吗？

examples.text: To be honest the house is not quite our style...
examples.translation: 说实话，这所房子不太适合我们。

examples.text: I'd rather get it out the way, to be honest.
examples.translation: 老实说，我情愿把它处理掉。

meanings.meaning: 对…说甜言蜜语；加蜜使甜

examples.text: Honey, I don't really think that's a good idea.
examples.translation: 亲爱的，我不认为那是个好主意。

examples.text: In Washington, the Senate observed a moment of silence in honor of the fallen 2, 000.
At that time, Congress gave honorable discharges to the 1, 100 WASPs and officially declared them veterans.

meanings.meaning: 持有；拥有；保存；拘留；约束或控制
(Hold)人名；(英、德、捷)霍尔德 又作“Hold住”使用，中英混用词汇，表示轻松掌控全局。 [ 过去式 held 过去分词 held或holden 现在分词 holding ]

examples.text: Hold the knife at an angle...
examples.translation: 斜握住刀。

examples.text: She is holding her journal and a pen...
examples.translation: 她手里拿着日记和一支笔。

examples.text: He held the pistol in his right hand...
examples.translation: 他右手握着手枪。

examples.text: Hold the baby while I load the car.
examples.translation: 你先抱着孩子，让我把东西装上车。

examples.text: He released his hold on the camera.
examples.translation: 他松手放开了照相机。

examples.text: I was woken up by someone grabbing hold of my sleeping bag...
examples.translation: 有人猛地抓住了我的睡袋，把我惊醒了。

examples.text: A doctor and a nurse caught hold of his arms...
examples.translation: 一名医生和一名护士抓住了他的双臂。

examples.text: Mother took hold of the barking dogs by their collars.
examples.translation: 母亲拉住了那几只吠叫的狗的项圈。

examples.text: If only he would hold her close to him.
examples.translation: 要是他能将她拥入怀中就好了。

examples.text: He then held the man in an armlock until police arrived...
examples.translation: 然后他反扭住那名男子的手臂让他动弹不得，直到警察赶到。

examples.text: I'd got two nurses holding me down.
examples.translation: 两名护士按着我不让我乱动。

examples.text: ...use of an unauthorized hold on a handcuffed suspect.
examples.translation: 对戴手铐的嫌疑犯使用非法的擒拿方式

examples.text: Soon she was crying bitterly about the pain and was holding her throat.
examples.translation: 很快她痛得大哭起来，同时用手捂着自己的喉咙。

examples.text: Hold your hands in front of your face...
examples.translation: 把双手举在面前。

examples.text: He walked at a rapid pace with his back straight and his head held erect.
examples.translation: 他昂首挺胸地快步而行。

examples.text: ...the wooden wedge which held the heavy door open...
examples.translation: 卡住沉重的门不让它关上的木楔

examples.text: They used steel pins to hold everything in place.
examples.translation: 他们用钢钉将所有东西都固定住。

examples.text: Two knife racks hold her favourite knives.
examples.translation: 两个刀架上存放着她最心爱的刀具。

examples.text: ...the large cardboard and wooden cases used to hold my new appliances.
examples.translation: 用来装我新买的家用电器的几个大的纸箱和木箱

examples.text: A fire had been reported in the cargo hold.
examples.translation: 行李舱内报称起火了。

examples.text: The Small Firms Service holds an enormous amount of information on any business problem...
examples.translation: 小型企业服务处备有关于各种商务问题的海量信息。

examples.text: We have reviewed the data that we hold for the area.
examples.translation: 我们已经审核过为该地区保存的数据了。

examples.text: The small bottles don't seem to hold much...
examples.translation: 这些小瓶子好像装不下多少。

examples.text: One CD-ROM disk can hold over 100,000 pages of text.
examples.translation: 一张光盘可以存储十多万多页的文字资料。

examples.text: ...but you had to be able to hold your liquor.
examples.translation: 但你得能喝酒才行。

examples.text: I thought the car held the road really well.
examples.translation: 我认为这辆车抓地性能真的非常好。

examples.text: He held firm opinions which usually conflicted with my own...
examples.translation: 他对自己的观点坚定不移，而这些观点通常和我的相左。

examples.text: He holds certain expectations about the teacher's role...
examples.translation: 他对教师的角色抱有某些期待。

examples.text: Current thinking holds that obesity is more a medical than a psychological problem...
examples.translation: 现在的观点认为，肥胖更多的是医学问题而非心理问题。

examples.text: The public, meanwhile, hold architects in low esteem.
examples.translation: 与此同时，公众对建筑师并不看重。

examples.text: ...a widely held opinion.
examples.translation: 普遍的看法

examples.text: Death doesn't hold any fear for me...
examples.translation: 死亡对我来说并不可怕。

examples.text: It held more mystery than even the darkest jungle...
examples.translation: 它甚至比最黑暗的丛林还更令人感到神秘。

examples.text: This approach, more than any other, holds promise for true reform.
examples.translation: 这一方法比其他任何方法都更让人看到真正改革的希望。

examples.text: She has never held ministerial office...
examples.translation: 她从未担任过部长级职务。

examples.text: I'd seen it before in people who held immense power.
examples.translation: 我以前曾在掌握大权的人身上看到过这种情况。

examples.text: Applicants should normally hold a good Honours degree...
examples.translation: 申请人通常应该拥有优秀荣誉学位。

examples.text: He did not hold a firearm certificate...
examples.translation: 他没有持枪许可。

examples.text: Passengers holding tickets will receive refunds.
examples.translation: 持票旅客将会得到退款。

examples.text: The country will hold democratic elections within a year...
examples.translation: 该国将在一年之内举行民主选举。

examples.text: The German sports federation said it would hold an investigation.
examples.translation: 德国体育联合会称它将进行调查。

examples.text: ...the club, which was licensed to hold parties.
examples.translation: 获准举办各种聚会的俱乐部

examples.text: They also called for the holding of multi-party general elections.
examples.translation: 他们还呼吁举行多党大选。

examples.text: The Prime Minister, is holding consultations with his colleagues to finalise the deal...
examples.translation: 首相正在和同僚进行磋商，以敲定该协议。

examples.text: The engineer and his son held frequent consultations concerning technical problems...
examples.translation: 工程师和他的儿子经常就技术问题互相征求意见。

examples.text: They can't believe you can even hold a conversation.
examples.translation: 他们不敢相信你竟然能够把一场对话进行下去。

examples.text: The group said it continues to hold 1,774,687 Vons shares...
examples.translation: 该集团称其继续持有1,774,687股冯氏公司的股份。

examples.text: The Fisher family holds 40% of the stock.
examples.translation: 费希尔家族持有40%的股份。

examples.text: He continued to hold a lead in Angola's presidential race...
examples.translation: 他继续在安哥拉总统大选中占据领先地位。

examples.text: Mestel holds a slight advantage.
examples.translation: 梅斯特尔占有微弱优势。

examples.text: If you want to hold someone's attention, look them directly in the eye but don't stare...
examples.translation: 如果想吸引住某人的注意力，就要直视他们的眼睛，但别死盯着。

examples.text: Couldn't I hold Philippe's interest?
examples.translation: 我难道就不能让菲利普一直感兴趣吗？

examples.text: It's impossible to hold any individual responsible.
examples.translation: 不可能归咎于任何个人。

examples.text: ...shareholders who want to hold corporate directors more accountable for their actions.
examples.translation: 想让公司董事为自己的行为负更大责任的股东们

examples.text: The inside of a van was as good a place as any to hold a kidnap victim...
examples.translation: 小货车内是关押被绑架人的好地方。

examples.text: Somebody is holding your wife hostage...
examples.translation: 有人挟持了你妻子作为人质。

examples.text: Japan had originally demanded the return of two seamen held on spying charges.
examples.translation: 日本起初要求放回两名以间谍罪名遭拘留的海员。

examples.text: Demonstrators have been holding the square since Sunday.
examples.translation: 示威者从周日起就占领了广场。

examples.text: It's always useful to have a hold over a fellow like Carl May...
examples.translation: 能支配像卡尔·梅这样的人总是很有用的。

examples.text: He had ordered his officers to keep an exceptionally firm hold over their men...
examples.translation: 他已经命令军官要倍加严格地管住自己的手下。

examples.text: Because he once loved her, she still has a hold on him.
examples.translation: 因为他曾经爱过她，她现在仍能对他产生影响。

examples.text: Could you hold the line and I'll just get my pen...
examples.translation: 能否请您稍等一会儿，我拿支笔？

examples.text: A telephone operator asked him to hold.
examples.translation: 电话接线员让他不要挂断。

examples.text: He tells his secretary to hold his calls.
examples.translation: 他让秘书代接电话。

examples.text: OPEC production is holding at around 21.5 million barrels a day...
examples.translation: 石油输出国组织的石油产量保持在每天约2,150万桶。

examples.text: They were expecting the jobless rate to hold steady...
examples.translation: 他们预计失业率会保持稳定。

examples.text: The Prime Minister yesterday ruled out Government action to hold down petrol prices...
examples.translation: 首相昨天表示政府不会采取行动抑制汽油价格上涨。

examples.text: The final dividend will be held at 20.7p, after an 8 per cent increase.
examples.translation: 增长了8%后，最终的红利将会保持在20.7便士的水平。

examples.text: ...provided the pound holds its value against the euro.
examples.translation: 只要英镑保持其和欧元之间的比价

examples.text: ...a voice which hit and held every note with perfect ease and clarity.
examples.translation: 非常自如清晰地唱出并拉长每个音符的歌喉

examples.text: A London Underground spokesman defended the decision to hold the train until police arrived.
examples.translation: 伦敦地铁公司的发言人为推迟发车直到警方赶来的决定作了辩解。

examples.text: Does your offer still hold?
examples.translation: 你的提议仍然有效吗？

examples.text: Our luck couldn't hold for ever...
examples.translation: 我们不会永远走运。

examples.text: Would the weather hold?...
examples.translation: 天气会保持晴好吗？

examples.text: Will the ceasefire hold?
examples.translation: 停火能持续下去吗？

examples.text: Today, most people think that argument no longer holds...
examples.translation: 今天，大多数人认为那个论点已经站不住脚了。

examples.text: The theory could still hold.
examples.translation: 该理论有可能仍然成立。

examples.text: Democrats say arguments against the bill won't hold up.
examples.translation: 民主党人声称反对该议案的论点站不住脚。

examples.text: How long would the roof hold?
examples.translation: 房顶能支撑多久？

examples.text: These laws also hold for universities.
examples.translation: 这些法律也适用于各大学。

examples.text: I hold to my belief that people should be allowed to have private lives...
examples.translation: 我坚信应该允许人们拥有自己的私生活。

examples.text: Would you still hold to that view?
examples.translation: 你仍会坚持那个看法吗？

examples.text: Will the President be able to hold to this commit-ment?...
examples.translation: 总统能恪守此承诺吗？

examples.text: Not all men are as honorable or hold to the same standards as Sam.
examples.translation: 不是所有的人都像萨姆那样品德如此高尚，抑或恪守同样的道德准则。

examples.text: ...whether youngsters in a multicultural society can really be expected to hold to uniformity in their speech.
examples.translation: 多文化社会中的年轻人是否真的有望坚持言语的统一性

examples.text: I would say it's almost time to hold him to that promise...
examples.translation: 我认为已经差不多是时候让他兑现那个承诺了。

examples.text: Don't hold me to that...
examples.translation: 我不能百分百保证。

examples.text: It does hold you to certain standards of fairness.
examples.translation: 它的确能让你恪守某些公平原则。

examples.text: Barry was holding forth on politics.
examples.translation: 巴里正在滔滔不绝地谈论政治。

examples.text: It is hard to get hold of guns in this country.
examples.translation: 在这个国家里要搞到枪支是很困难的。

examples.text: He first had to get hold of some basic facts.
examples.translation: 他首先得弄清一些基本事实。

examples.text: The only electrician we could get hold of was miles away.
examples.translation: 我们唯一能够联络到的电工离这里有好几英里远。

examples.text: Hold it! Don't move!
examples.translation: 停下！别动！

examples.text: He put his retirement on hold until he had found a solution...
examples.translation: 他推迟了退休，直到他找到了解决办法。

examples.text: He described their foreign policy as on hold.
examples.translation: 他将他们的外交政策称为缓兵之计。

examples.text: One of his jackets hung from a hook.
examples.translation: 他的一件夹克衫挂在衣钩上。

examples.text: ...curtain hooks...
examples.translation: 窗帘挂钩

examples.text: He felt a fish pull at his hook.
examples.translation: 他感觉到有条鱼在扯钓钩。

examples.text: Paul hooked his tractor to the car and pulled it to safety.
examples.translation: 保罗把自己的拖拉机挂在汽车上，然后把它拉到了安全的地方。

examples.text: ...one of those can openers that hooked onto the wall.
examples.translation: 那些挂在墙上的开罐器中的一个

examples.text: She latched on to his arm, hooking her other arm around a tree...
examples.translation: 她拽住他的胳膊不放，另一只胳膊抱紧一棵树。

examples.text: I hooked my left arm over the side of the dinghy.
examples.translation: 我用左臂钩住小划艇的船舷。

examples.text: At the first cast I hooked a huge fish.
examples.translation: 第一次抛下钓线，我就钓了一条大鱼。

examples.text: Lewis desperately needs to keep clear of Ruddock's big left hook.
examples.translation: 刘易斯无论如何得躲开拉多克凌厉的左钩拳才行。

examples.text: I'm guessing again now because I'm not hooked into the political circles...
examples.translation: 我现在又是在猜测了，因为我没有涉足政界。

examples.text: Eager to hook into a career but can't find one right for you?
examples.translation: 急于干一番事业，但又找不到适合自己的？

examples.text: ...an interactive media tent where people will be able to hook into the internet.
examples.translation: 人们可以上网的互动式媒体帐篷区

examples.text: ...a UK firm that lets Britons hook up to the Internet.
examples.translation: 为英国人提供联网服务的英国公司

examples.text: Government officials accused of bribery and corruption get off the hook with monotonous regularity...
examples.translation: 被指控贪污受贿的政府官员无一例外总能脱身。

examples.text: His opponents have no intention of letting him off the hook until he agrees to leave office immediately.
examples.translation: 在他同意马上离职之前，他的对手不打算放过他。

examples.text: Since war broke out, the phones at donation centers have been ringing off the hook.
examples.translation: 自从战争爆发以来，捐赠中心的电话就一直响个不停。

meanings.meaning: 蹦跳,跳跃；跳舞；一次飞行的距离

examples.text: I hopped down three steps...
examples.translation: 我单脚跳下了3级台阶。

examples.text: Malcolm hopped rather than walked.
examples.translation: 马尔科姆与其说是用走的不如说是用单脚跳的。

examples.text: 'This really is a catchy rhythm, huh?' he added, with a few little hops.
examples.translation: “这个节奏还真想让人跟着跳，是吧？”他说着又小步蹦跶了几下。

examples.text: A small brown fawn hopped across the trail in front of them.
examples.translation: 一只棕色的小鹿蹦跳着穿过他们面前的那条小路。

examples.text: The rabbit got up, took four hops and turned round.
examples.translation: 兔子直起身来，蹦跳了4下，又转回头。

examples.text: My wife and I were the first to arrive and hopped on board...
examples.translation: 我和妻子是最早赶到登船的。

examples.text: I hopped out of bed quickly.
examples.translation: 我迅速跳下床。

examples.text: It is a three-hour drive from Geneva but can be reached by a 20-minute hop in a private helicopter.
examples.translation: 从日内瓦开车要3小时，但坐私人直升机只要20分钟就到了。

examples.text: They were afraid of being turned down when they asked girls to dance at high school hops.
examples.translation: 他们在中学社交舞会上邀请女孩子跳舞时，害怕会遭到拒绝。

examples.text: 'Hop it', I snapped at the bloke. 'She's with me.'
examples.translation: “滚开，”我厉声对那家伙说，“她是和我一起的。”

examples.text: The family's hopping mad that she left them nothing.
examples.translation: 这家人因为她什么也没有给他们留下而气得跳脚。

examples.text: His plans almost caught security chiefs and hotel staff on the hop.
examples.translation: 他的计划几乎让安全主管和饭店工作人员都措手不及。

examples.text: I am hopeful this misunderstanding will be rectified very quickly...
examples.translation: 我相信这个误会将很快得到纠正。

examples.text: Surgeons were hopeful of saving the sight in Sara's left eye.
examples.translation: 外科医生有信心保住萨拉左眼的视力。

examples.text: 'Am I welcome?' He smiled hopefully, leaning on the door.
examples.translation: “欢迎我吗？”他靠在门上，满怀希望地笑着说道。

examples.text: The result of the election in is yet another hopeful sign that peace could come to the Middle East.
examples.translation: 已出炉的选举结果再次显示在中东实现和平是有希望的。

examples.text: ...hopeful forecasts that the economy will improve.
examples.translation: 认为经济会改善的鼓舞人心的预测

examples.text: We've chartered the aircraft in the hopeful anticipation that the government will allow them to leave.
examples.translation: 我们已经包租了那架飞机，希望政府会对他们放行。

examples.text: His soccer skills continue to be put to good use in his job as football coach to young hopefuls.
examples.translation: 他的球技在他给这些希望成为明日之星的年轻人担任教练的过程中继续发挥出很大作用。

examples.text: She had decided she must go on as usual, follow her normal routine, and hope and pray...
examples.translation: 她打定主意必须像平时一样生活，遵循自己通常的作息规律，同时怀抱希望、虔诚祈祷。

examples.text: He hesitates before leaving, almost as though he had been hoping for conversation...
examples.translation: 他离开前有些犹豫，几乎像是他一直期望能够交谈点什么。

examples.text: I hope to get a job within the next two weeks...
examples.translation: 我希望能在未来两周内找到一份工作。

examples.text: The researchers hope that such a vaccine could be available in about ten years' time...
examples.translation: 研究人员期望能在大约10年内研制出这样的疫苗。

examples.text: 'We'll speak again.' — 'I hope so.'
examples.translation: “我们以后再谈。”——“希望如此。”

examples.text: 'Will it happen again?' — 'I hope not, but you never know.'
examples.translation: “这事还会再发生吗？”——“但愿不会，但谁知道呢。”

examples.text: Things aren't ideal, but that's the best you can hope for...
examples.translation: 事情并不理想，但你只能指望这样了。

examples.text: I always knew it was too much to hope for.
examples.translation: 我一直都知道这是个奢望。

examples.text: ...these mountains, which no one can hope to penetrate.
examples.translation: 没有人能有望深入其中的这些大山

examples.text: The only hope for underdeveloped countries is to become, as far as possible, self-reliant...
examples.translation: 欠发达国家的唯一出路就是尽可能做到自力更生。

examples.text: The car was smashed beyond any hope of repair.
examples.translation: 汽车被撞烂了，修复无望。

examples.text: Now that he has become President, many people once again have hope for genuine changes in the system...
examples.translation: 既然他已当上了总统，很多人又再次看到了进行真正的体制改革的希望。

examples.text: But Kevin hasn't given up hope of being fit...
examples.translation: 但凯文仍没有放弃康复的希望。

examples.text: Consumer groups still hold out hope that the president will change his mind...
examples.translation: 消费者团体仍期望总统会回心转意。

examples.text: Thousands of childless couples are to be given new hope by the government.
examples.translation: 政府将为数千对无子女的夫妇带来新的希望。

examples.text: They have hopes of increasing trade between the two regions...
examples.translation: 他们希望增进两个地区之间的贸易。

examples.text: The delay in the programme has dashed Japan's hopes of commercial success in space...
examples.translation: 该计划的拖延使得日本在太空获得商业性成功的希望化为泡影。

examples.text: My hope is that, in the future, I will go over there and marry her.
examples.translation: 我的希望是将来能去那里和她结婚。

examples.text: ...England's last hope in the English Open Table Tennis Championships...
examples.translation: 英格兰队在英国乒乓球公开锦标赛中的最后希望

examples.text: Roemer represented the best hope for a businesslike climate in Louisiana.
examples.translation: 罗默最有希望给路易斯安那州带来务实高效之风。

examples.text: I took the risk and hoped for the best...
examples.translation: 我冒了这个险，心里祈祷能够诸事顺利。

examples.text: Some companies are cutting costs and hoping for the best.
examples.translation: 有些公司在削减成本，希望一切好转。

examples.text: There is no reason for people to get their hopes up over this mission...
examples.translation: 不必对这次行动抱太大希望。

examples.text: I don't want you to build your hopes up, but I'll have a word with Fred tomorrow.
examples.translation: 我不想让你抱很大希望，但我明天会和弗雷德说一声的。

examples.text: Everybody knows they haven't got a hope in hell of forming a government anyway.
examples.translation: 众人皆知他们根本就无力组建政府。

examples.text: I had high hopes that Derek Randall might play an important part...
examples.translation: 我对德里克·兰德尔发挥重要作用寄予厚望。

examples.text: Britain's three-day event team has high hopes of winning the Olympic gold medal...
examples.translation: 英国队有很大希望赢得奥运会马术三日赛的金牌。

examples.text: He had no great hopes for the success of his undertaking.
examples.translation: 他对自己事业的成功不抱太大希望。

examples.text: She glanced about the hall, hoping against hope that Richard would be waiting for her.
examples.translation: 她眼睛扫过大厅，对理查德会在那里等她仍怀有一丝希望。

examples.text: I hope you don't mind me coming to see you...
examples.translation: 希望你不介意我来见你。

examples.text: I hope I haven't said anything to upset you.
examples.translation: 但愿我没有说过让你不高兴的话。

examples.text: You're not trying to see him, I hope?...
examples.translation: 但愿你不是想要去见他吧？

examples.text: I hope you won't be too harsh with the girl...
examples.translation: 希望你不要对那个女孩太严厉。

examples.text: Are we starting that again? I most sincerely hope not.
examples.translation: 我们又要旧事重提了吗？我真的希望不要。

examples.text: I'm the best man for the job, I hope...
examples.translation: 希望我是那份工作的最佳人选。

examples.text: Fraulein Wendel is well, I hope?
examples.translation: 我想文德尔小姐一切都好吧？

examples.text: He was studying in the hope of being admitted to an engineering college...
examples.translation: 他努力学习，希望能被一所工程学院录取。

examples.text: We will be analysing all the things she has told us in the hope that we can locate the person responsible.
examples.translation: 我们将分析她告诉我们的所有事情，希望能找出罪魁祸首。

examples.text: I just live in hope that one day she'll talk to me...
examples.translation: 我只是妄想着有一天她会和我说话。

examples.text: My mother bought lots of tickets and lived in hope of winning the prize.
examples.translation: 我母亲买了很多彩票，一心希望能中大奖。

examples.text: The industry reckons it will see orders swell by 10% this financial year. Some hope.
examples.translation: 业界估计本财年订单会增加10%。这绝对不可能。

meanings.meaning: [天] 地平线；视野；眼界；范围

examples.text: A grey smudge appeared on the horizon. That must be Calais, thought Fay...
examples.translation: 一个模糊的灰影出现在地平线上。那里一定是加来，法伊心想。

examples.text: The sun had already sunk below the horizon.
examples.translation: 太阳已经落到了地平线下面。

examples.text: As your horizons expand, these new ideas can give a whole new meaning to life...
examples.translation: 随着眼界不断开阔，这些新观念会为生活赋予全新的意义。

examples.text: By embracing other cultures and genres, we actually broaden our horizons, rather than narrow any existing ones.
examples.translation: 通过接纳其他文化和体裁，我们实际上拓宽了领域，而不是让现有的范围变得狭窄。

examples.text: With breast cancer, as with many common diseases, there is no obvious breakthrough on the horizon...
examples.translation: 对乳腺癌等很多常见疾病来说，目前还看不到有明显的突破。

examples.text: Suddenly, with war on the horizon, the army seemed in danger of disintegration...
examples.translation: 随着战争即将爆发，军队似乎突然面临分崩离析的危险。

examples.text: There are glimmers of hope on the horizon.
examples.translation: 就快看见希望的曙光了。

meanings.meaning: 水平的；地平线的；同一阶层的
水平线，水平面；水平位置

examples.text: The board consists of vertical and horizontal lines...
examples.translation: 板上画着横纵的线条。

examples.text: Swing the club back until it is horizontal.
examples.translation: 将球杆向后挥至水平位置。

examples.text: Do not raise your left arm above the horizontal.
examples.translation: 左臂不要举过水平高度。

examples.text: The wind was cold and drove the snow at him almost horizontally.
examples.translation: 寒风凛冽，雪花几乎是朝他扑面而来。

examples.text: ...a horizontally striped tie.
examples.translation: 横条领带

examples.text: The undulating planes of the countryside provide relief from the hard horizontals and verticals of the urban scene.
examples.translation: 乡村起伏不平的地势使人们摆脱了城市刻板的横平竖直景象。

examples.text: The record sounds horrible.
examples.translation: 唱片难听极了。

examples.text: ...a horrible small boy.
examples.translation: 讨厌的小男孩

examples.text: When trouble comes they behave selfishly and horribly.
examples.translation: 遇到麻烦时，他们表现得很自私，很差劲。

examples.text: Still the horrible shrieking came out of his mouth.
examples.translation: 他的嘴里还是发出了恐怖的尖叫声。

examples.text: A two-year-old boy was horribly murdered.
examples.translation: 一名两岁男孩惨遭杀害。

examples.text: That seems like a horrible mess that will drag on for years...
examples.translation: 看起来那像是个会拖延多年的大烂摊子。

examples.text: Unless you respect other people's religions, horrible mistakes and conflict will occur.
examples.translation: 如果不尊重别人的宗教信仰，就会祷下大错，酿成冲突。

examples.text: Our plans have gone horribly wrong...
examples.translation: 我们的计划出了大岔子。

examples.text: You got horribly drunk.
examples.translation: 你喝了个烂醉。

meanings.meaning: (Horn)人名；(英、德、匈、捷、罗、波、芬、希、瑞典)霍恩；(法)奥尔恩；(柬)洪

examples.text: He sounded the car horn.
examples.translation: 他按响了汽车喇叭。

examples.text: A mature cow has horns.
examples.translation: 成年奶牛有犄角。

examples.text: ...a hunting horn.
examples.translation: 猎号

examples.text: ...a wind-up gramophone with a big horn.
examples.translation: 带有一个大喇叭形扬声器的发条式留声机

examples.text: During his six years in office, Seidman has often locked horns with lawmakers.
examples.translation: 在任的6年中，塞德曼经常和立法议员争得不可开交。

examples.text: The bird is caught on the horns of a dilemma. Should it attack the predator, even though it then risks its own life? Or should it get out while the going is good?
examples.translation: 这只鸟进退维谷。是应该冒着生命危险攻击捕食者呢？还是应该及早逃命？
