examples.translation: 市建住房租户请就该问题致电住房部。

examples.text: Both housings are waterproof to a depth of two metres.
examples.translation: 两个机罩的防水深度均为两米。

examples.text: Beautiful butterflies hovered above the wild flowers...
examples.translation: 美丽的蝴蝶在野花上方飞舞。

examples.text: A police helicopter hovered overhead...
examples.translation: 一架警方直升机悬停在头顶上空。

examples.text: Mist hovered in all the valleys.
examples.translation: 所有的山谷都笼罩着一层雾气。

examples.text: Judith was hovering in the doorway...
examples.translation: 朱迪丝在门口徘徊。

examples.text: With no idea of what to do for my next move, my hand hovered over the board.
examples.translation: 不知道下一步该怎么走，我一只手在棋盘上举落不定。

examples.text: She hovered on the brink of death for three months as doctors battled to save her...
examples.translation: 3个月来她一直在死亡线上徘徊，而医生则在全力挽救她的生命。

examples.text: Just as at the turn of the century, we hover between great hopes and great fears.
examples.translation: 正如世纪之交时那样，我们再次在巨大的希望和忧虑之间彷徨不定。

examples.text: In September 1989 the exchange rate hovered around 140 yen to the dollar...
examples.translation: 1989年9月，日元对美元的汇率一直在140比1的水平上下浮动。

examples.text: His golf handicap hovered between 10 and 12.
examples.translation: 他的高尔夫球差点一直在10杆到12杆之间徘徊。

examples.text: How do I make payments into my account?...
examples.translation: 我如何向自己的账户付款？

examples.text: How do you manage to keep the place so tidy?...
examples.translation: 你是怎样把这里保持得如此整洁的？

examples.text: The law, your contracts, your public protect you, do they? How?...
examples.translation: 法律、合约和公众会保护你。真的会吗？怎么保护？

examples.text: How are you going to plan for the future?
examples.translation: 你未来将作何打算？

examples.text: I don't want to know how he died...
examples.translation: 我不想知道他是怎么死的。

examples.text: Did you ever wonder how the top supermodels manage to look stunning?...
examples.translation: 难道你就没有想过那些超级名模是如何做到外表如此惊艳的吗？

examples.text: I didn't know how to tell you.
examples.translation: 我不知道该如何告诉你。

examples.text: It's amazing how people collect so much stuff over the years...
examples.translation: 人们竟然日积月累地收集了这么多东西，真令人惊叹。

examples.text: It's funny how I never seem to get a thing done on my day off...
examples.translation: 好笑的是，我好像从来没有在休息日里做成过一件事。

examples.text: I remember how Grandma loved to cook, loved to fix special treats...
examples.translation: 我记得祖母喜欢烹饪，喜欢做些平日吃不到的美味佳肴。

examples.text: It's important to become acutely aware of how your eating ties in with your stress level.
examples.translation: 重要的是要深刻意识到饮食和压力之间的紧密关系。

examples.text: How much money are we talking about?...
examples.translation: 总共是多少钱？

examples.text: How many full-time staff have we got?...
examples.translation: 我们有多少名全职工？

examples.text: How long will you be staying?...
examples.translation: 你要呆多久？

examples.text: How old is your son now?...
examples.translation: 你儿子现在多大了？

examples.text: How fast were you driving?...
examples.translation: 你当时的车速有多快？

examples.text: How difficult is it to do business with the company?...
examples.translation: 和那家公司做生意有多难？

examples.text: 'How well do you know Mrs. O'Toole?' Ryan asked...
examples.translation: “你和奥图尔夫人有多熟？”瑞安问。

examples.text: No-one knows how many people have been killed since the war began...
examples.translation: 没有人知道自开战以来已经有多少人丧生了。

examples.text: He was asked how serious the situation had become.
examples.translation: 他被问起情况已经变得有多严重。

examples.text: How was your trip down to Orlando?...
examples.translation: 你的奥兰多之行怎么样？

examples.text: How did your date go?...
examples.translation: 你的约会进行得怎么样？

examples.text: Tell me about your clinical trials. How did they go?...
examples.translation: 跟我说说你的临床试验。进展如何？

examples.text: Tell me how everything went off tonight...
examples.translation: 告诉我今晚一切都进行得怎么样。

examples.text: I wonder how Sam got on with him.
examples.translation: 我不知道萨姆和他相处得怎么样。

examples.text: Hi! How are you doing?...
examples.translation: 嗨！你近来怎么样？

examples.text: How's Rosie?...
examples.translation: 罗茜近来怎么样？

examples.text: How's the job?...
examples.translation: 工作情况如何？

examples.text: She asked how he had been feeling...
examples.translation: 她问他最近身体如何。

examples.text: Susan introduced herself to him and asked him how he was.
examples.translation: 苏珊向他作了自我介绍，并询问他的近况。

examples.text: 'How do you do, Mrs Bellingham,' Sam said.
examples.translation: “你好，贝林厄姆夫人，”萨姆说。

examples.text: Two historical questions — you can answer them how you like...
examples.translation: 两个历史问题——你可以随便回答。

examples.text: It's your life, so live it how you want!
examples.translation: 这是你的生活，你想怎样过就怎样过！

examples.text: I didn't realize how heavy that shopping was going to be...
examples.translation: 我没想到买的东西会有多沉。

examples.text: Franklin told them all how happy he was to be in Britain again.
examples.translation: 富兰克林告诉他们大家能再一次来到英国他非常开心。

examples.text: How strange that something so simple as a walk on the beach could suddenly mean so much...
examples.translation: 诸如在沙滩散步这样的小事会突然变得如此重要，真是令人感到不可思议。

examples.text: How anxiously she awaited my answer...
examples.translation: 她焦急万分地等待我的答复。

examples.text: How she must have talked last night!
examples.translation: 她昨晚一定没停过嘴！

examples.text: How can you drink so much beer, Luke?...
examples.translation: 你怎么能喝这么多啤酒呢，卢克？

examples.text: How could such a writer be taken seriously?...
examples.translation: 怎么会把这样一位作家当回事呢？

examples.text: How could he be so indiscreet?
examples.translation: 他怎么能如此轻率？

examples.text: How about a cup of coffee?...
examples.translation: 来杯咖啡怎么样？

examples.text: You want Jeannie to make the appointment for you? How about the end of next week?...
examples.translation: 你想让珍妮帮你预约吗？下周末怎么样？

examples.text: How would you like to have dinner one night?
examples.translation: 哪天晚上和我一起吃饭好吗？

examples.text: Well, I enjoyed that. How about you two?...
examples.translation: 嗯，我觉得那很棒。你们俩呢？

examples.text: 'Something to drink?' — 'No, thanks,' said Michael. He glanced at Wilfred. 'How about you?'
examples.translation: “要喝点什么吗？”—“不了，谢谢，”迈克尔说。他看了一眼威尔弗雷德。“你呢？”

examples.text: The twins made their appearance at three o'clock. How about that? Spot on time.
examples.translation: 双胞胎在3点时出现了。神吧？绝对准时。

examples.text: Are your products and services competitive? How about marketing?
examples.translation: 你们的产品和服务有竞争力吗？营销又怎么样呢？

examples.text: 'They don't say a single word to each other.'—'How come?'
examples.translation: “他们相互之间一句话都不说。”——“怎么会这样呢？”

examples.text: How come he hasn't been able to be as good this year?...
examples.translation: 为什么他今年表现不及往常呢？

examples.text: 'She was weird.' — 'How so?'
examples.translation: “她有些古怪。”——“为什么这么说呢？”

examples.text: 'The fuel gauge is broken.' — 'Broken? How do you mean?'
examples.translation: “燃油表坏了。”——“坏了？你说清楚点？”

examples.text: Suppose we meet somewhere for a drink? I'll pay. How's that?
examples.translation: 我们找个地方一起喝一杯吧？我请客。怎么样？

meanings.meaning: 无论如何；不管怎样（接副词或形容词）；然而；可是
无论以何种方式; 不管怎样

examples.text: This was not an easy decision. It is, however, a decision that we feel is dictated by our duty...
examples.translation: 这很难抉择。不过，我们觉得自己有义务作出决定。

examples.text: Some of the food crops failed. However, the cotton did quite well...
examples.translation: 有些粮食作物歉收。但棉花的收成仍相当不错。

examples.text: Higher sales have not helped profits, however.
examples.translation: 然而，销售量的增加并没有推动利润。

examples.text: You should always strive to achieve more, however well you have done before...
examples.translation: 无论之前取得何等辉煌的成就，都应该不断努力进取。

examples.text: However hard she tried, nothing seemed to work...
examples.translation: 不管她怎么努力，好像都无济于事。

examples.text: There is no sunset however beautiful, no joke however funny, no movie, no meal that I can enjoy only by myself...
examples.translation: 如果我孤独一人，那么无论看到多么美丽的日落，听到多么好笑的笑话，看任何电影，品任何佳肴，我都不会有一丝感觉。

examples.text: However much it hurt, he could do it.
examples.translation: 无论有多痛，他都能做到。

examples.text: However we adopt healthcare reform, it isn't going to save major amounts of money...
examples.translation: 不管我们采取何种医疗改革措施，都省不下太多钱。

examples.text: Wear your hair however you want.
examples.translation: 你想弄什么发型自己看着办。

examples.text: The 20,000 or however many who come to watch would love to be out on the pitch...
examples.translation: 约两万名来看比赛的观众都希望能身处球场之上。

examples.text: Wait 30 to 60 minutes or however long it takes.
examples.translation: 等30到60分钟左右。

examples.text: However did you find this place in such weather?
examples.translation: 你到底是怎样在这样的天气里找到这个地方的？

examples.text: Somewhere in the streets beyond a dog suddenly howled, baying at the moon.
examples.translation: 远处的街上，有只狗突然对月长嚎起来。

examples.text: The dog let out a savage howl and, wheeling round, flew at him.
examples.translation: 那只狗发出一声凶猛的狂吠，突然转身向他扑去。

examples.text: He howled like a wounded animal as blood spurted from the gash...
examples.translation: 当血从伤口中喷出时，他像一只受伤的动物一样嚎叫起来。

examples.text: The baby was howling for her 3am feed.
examples.translation: 宝宝哀号着要吃凌晨3点的那顿奶。

examples.text: With a howl of rage, he grabbed the neck of a broken bottle and advanced.
examples.translation: 他一声怒吼，抓起一个破瓶子的瓶颈冲上前来。

examples.text: The wind howled all night, but I slept a little...
examples.translation: 风整夜怒号着，但我还是睡了一会儿。

examples.text: It sank in a howling gale.
examples.translation: 它在呼啸的狂风中沉没了。

examples.text: 'Get away, get away, get away' he howled...
examples.translation: “滚开，滚开，都滚开”他高声嚷道。

examples.text: The crowd howled its approval.
examples.translation: 人群高声欢呼，以示赞同。

examples.text: Joe, Pink, and Booker howled with delight...
examples.translation: 乔、平克和布克高兴得放声大笑。

examples.text: The crowd howled, delirious.
examples.translation: 人群笑声震天，欣喜若狂。

examples.text: His stories caused howls of laughter.
examples.translation: 他讲的故事引起了阵阵大笑。

meanings.meaning: 把...挤在一起；使缩成一团；草率了事

examples.text: She huddled inside the porch as she rang the bell...
examples.translation: 她按门铃时身子在门廊里缩成一团。

examples.text: Myrtle sat huddled on the side of the bed, weeping.
examples.translation: 默特尔缩着身子坐在床边哭泣。

examples.text: Tired and lost, we huddled together...
examples.translation: 我们疲惫不堪，又迷了路，于是大家都挤在一起。

examples.text: ...strangers huddling together for warmth...
examples.translation: 挤作一团取暖的陌生人

examples.text: Hundreds of people huddled around a single transistor radio listening to the announcement...
examples.translation: 数百人挤在一台晶体管收音机周围收听公告。

examples.text: The survivors spent the night huddled around bonfires.
examples.translation: 幸存者围聚着篝火过了夜。

examples.text: Off to one side, Sticht, Macomber, Jordan, and Kreps huddled to discuss something...
examples.translation: 施蒂希特、麦康伯、乔丹和克雷普斯走到一旁私下商量着什么。

examples.text: The president has been huddling with his most senior aides...
examples.translation: 总统一直在和最高层助理开私下碰头会。

examples.text: Mrs Clinton was huddled with advisers at her headquarters.
examples.translation: 克林顿夫人和顾问聚在总部秘谈。

examples.text: We lay there: a huddle of bodies, gasping for air...
examples.translation: 我们横七竖八地挤作一团躺在那里，大口喘着气。

examples.text: Les kept seeing Eric and Tam in a huddle and he knew they were talking about him.
examples.translation: 莱斯总是看到埃里克和塔姆凑在一起，他知道他们是在谈论自己。

examples.text: ...the huddle of dark houses on the other side of the reservoir.
examples.translation: 水库另一边那一片杂乱无序的黑魆魆的房子

meanings.meaning: 拥抱；紧抱在一起；挤在一起
(Hug)人名；(英)胡克；(法)于格；(德、瑞典)胡格

examples.text: She had hugged him exuberantly and invited him to dinner the next day...
examples.translation: 她兴高采烈地拥抱了他，并邀请他第二天一起吃晚饭。

examples.text: They hugged each other like a couple of lost children...
examples.translation: 他们相互紧抱在一起，就像一对迷路的孩子。

examples.text: We hugged and kissed.
examples.translation: 我们拥抱亲吻。

examples.text: Syvil leapt out of the back seat, and gave him a hug.
examples.translation: 赛维尔从后座跳出来，给了他一个拥抱。

examples.text: Shaerl trudged toward them, hugging a large box...
examples.translation: 谢尔抱着一个大箱子步履艰难地向他们走去。

examples.text: She hugged her legs tight to her chest...
examples.translation: 她将双腿紧紧抱在胸前。

examples.text: She stood hugging her quilted jacket round her.
examples.translation: 她紧裹棉衣站在那里。

examples.text: The road hugs the coast for hundreds of miles...
examples.translation: 公路沿着海岸延伸数百英里。

examples.text: Our pilot reduced height until we hugged the ground.
examples.translation: 飞行员降低了高度，最后我们紧贴着地面飞行。

examples.text: ...a tiny little woman with huge black glasses...
examples.translation: 戴着一副硕大黑框眼镜的娇小女子

examples.text: Several painters were working on a huge piece of canvas which would serve as the scenery...
examples.translation: 几位画家正在一块用作舞台布景的巨大帆布上作画。

examples.text: Our driver strolled up, huge and swarthy.
examples.translation: 我们的司机悠闲地走了过来，他身材高大，肤色黝黑。

examples.text: I have a huge number of ties because I never throw them away...
examples.translation: 我有超多条领带，因为我从来不肯扔掉它们。

examples.text: He is furious they are making huge profits out of the misery of young addicts.
examples.translation: 看到他们从年轻吸毒者的痛苦中榨取暴利，他怒不可遏。

examples.text: In summer this hotel is a hugely popular venue for wedding receptions.
examples.translation: 夏天时这家饭店是个非常受欢迎的婚宴举办地。

examples.text: ...a hugely successful businessman...
examples.translation: 极其成功的商人

examples.text: She seemed to be enjoying herself hugely...
examples.translation: 她似乎玩得非常开心。

examples.text: I think she was hugely embarrassed by the whole scene.
examples.translation: 我认为整个场面让她极其尴尬。

examples.text: Another team is looking at the huge problem of debts between companies...
examples.translation: 另一组人正在研究公司间严重的债务问题。

examples.text: The result was human suffering on a huge scale.
examples.translation: 结果是人类遭遇深重的灾难。

meanings.meaning: (Hum)人名；(匈、塞、英)胡姆；(东南亚国家华语)湛

examples.text: The birds sang, the bees hummed...
examples.translation: 鸟儿叫，蜂儿鸣。

examples.text: Within five hours, the equipment will be humming away again...
examples.translation: 用不了5小时，设备就又能嗡嗡地运转了。

examples.text: There was a low humming sound in the sky.
examples.translation: 空中传来一阵低沉的嗡嗡声。

examples.text: ...the hum of traffic...
examples.translation: 嘈杂的车流声

examples.text: There was a general hum of conversation around them.
examples.translation: 他们周围的人都在嗡嗡地低声交谈。

examples.text: She was humming a merry little tune...
examples.translation: 她哼着一支欢快的小曲儿。

examples.text: He hummed to himself as he opened the trunk.
examples.translation: 他独自哼着曲子打开了车子的后备箱。

examples.text: The guard stopped his humming and turned his head sharply.
examples.translation: 守卫停止了哼唱，猛地转过头。

examples.text: The place is really beginning to hum...
examples.translation: 这个地方真正开始热闹起来了。

examples.text: On Saturday morning, the town hums with activity and life.
examples.translation: 周六早晨，小镇一派热闹繁忙，活力盎然。

examples.text: Hum, I am sorry but I thought you were French.
examples.translation: 嗯，很抱歉，我以为你是法国人。

examples.text: ...the human body.
examples.translation: 人体

examples.text: ...human history.
examples.translation: 人类历史

examples.text: Its rate of growth was fast — much more like that of an ape than that of a human.
examples.translation: 它的发育速度很快——更像猿，而不像人。

examples.text: ...an ever growing risk of human error...
examples.translation: 越来越高的人为错误的风险

examples.text: We're not perfect. We're only human.
examples.translation: 我们并不完美。我们只是凡人。

meanings.meaning: 人类；人道；仁慈；人文学科

examples.text: They face charges of committing crimes against humanity.
examples.translation: 他们被控犯有反人类罪。

examples.text: ...a young lawyer full of illusions and love of humanity.
examples.translation: 满脑子幻想并且博爱的年轻律师

examples.text: ...a man who's almost lost his humanity in his bitter hatred of his rivals.
examples.translation: 因痛恨竞争对手而几乎丧失人性的男子

examples.text: Her speech showed great maturity and humanity.
examples.translation: 她的演讲思想高度成熟，并且洋溢着博爱精神。

examples.text: ...students majoring in the humanities.
examples.translation: 主修人文学科的学生

meanings.meaning: 潮湿的；湿润的；多湿气的

examples.text: Visitors can expect hot and humid conditions...
examples.translation: 游客会遇到炎热潮湿的天气状况。

examples.text: The day is overcast and humid.
examples.translation: 天气多云潮湿。

meanings.meaning: 谦逊的；简陋的；（级别或地位）低下的；不大的
使谦恭；轻松打败（尤指强大的对手）；低声下气

examples.text: He gave a great performance, but he was very humble...
examples.translation: 他的表演非常出色，但他却很谦虚。

examples.text: Andy was a humble, courteous and gentle man.
examples.translation: 安迪是个谦逊而且彬彬有礼的绅士。

examples.text: ...a humble apology.
examples.translation: 恭敬的道歉

examples.text: 'I'm a lucky man, undeservedly lucky,' he said humbly.
examples.translation: “我是个幸运的人，本不配如此幸运，”他谦虚地说。

examples.text: Spyros Latsis started his career as a humble fisherman in the Aegean...
examples.translation: 斯皮罗斯·拉齐斯的第一份职业是爱琴海上一名地位卑贱的渔夫。

examples.text: He came from a fairly humble, poor background.
examples.translation: 他出生在一个地位相当低下的贫穷家庭。

examples.text: There are restaurants, both humble and expensive, that specialize in them...
examples.translation: 专门做这些菜的餐馆既有毫不起眼的也有价格昂贵的。

examples.text: Varndell made his own reflector for these shots from a strip of humble kitchen foil.
examples.translation: 瓦恩德尔用一狭条普通的厨房用箔纸自制了反光板来拍摄这些照片。

examples.text: It is, in my humble opinion, perhaps the best steak restaurant in Great Britain.
examples.translation: 依拙见，这可能是英国最好的牛排馆。

examples.text: So may I humbly suggest we all do something next time.
examples.translation: 那么鄙人可否建议下次我们大家都要做点事。

examples.text: Anson was forced to eat humble pie and publicly apologise to her.
examples.translation: 安森被迫认错并公开向她道歉。

examples.text: Honda won fame in the 1980s as the little car company that humbled the industry giants...
examples.translation: 本田在20世纪80年代作为一家轻易挫败行业巨头的小汽车公司而声名鹊起。

examples.text: Third-placed Barnet were humbled 3-0 at Crewe.
examples.translation: 排名第三的巴尼特队以0–3的比分在克鲁遭遇惨败。

examples.text: Ted's words humbled me...
examples.translation: 特德的话让我感到自惭。

examples.text: I am sure millions of viewers were humbled by this story.
examples.translation: 我相信数百万观众看了这个故事后都会感到自己的渺小。

examples.text: I came away very humbled and recognizing that I, for one, am not well-informed.
examples.translation: 我离开时感到十分惭愧，意识到自己至少可说是见识短浅。

examples.text: Giving up an addiction is a humbling experience.
examples.translation: 戒瘾是一次让人重新认识自己的经历。

examples.text: The heat and humidity were insufferable.
examples.translation: 高温和潮湿让人难以忍受。

examples.text: The humidity is relatively low.
examples.translation: 湿度相对较低。

examples.text: She had been beaten and humiliated by her husband...
examples.translation: 她遭到丈夫的殴打和羞辱。

examples.text: His teacher continually humiliates him in maths lessons.
examples.translation: 他的数学老师频频在课上羞辱他。

examples.text: I have never felt so humiliated in my life.
examples.translation: 我一生中从未感到如此丢脸。

examples.text: Hostility may be the engine of humor, but the broadcast networks dread its snarl.

meanings.meaning: 诙谐的，幽默的；滑稽的，可笑的

examples.text: He was quite humorous, and I liked that about him.
examples.translation: 他很幽默，我喜欢他这一点。

examples.text: ...a humorous magazine.
examples.translation: 幽默杂志

examples.text: He looked at me humorously as he wrestled with the door...
examples.translation: 他一边和那扇门较着劲，一边表情滑稽地看着我。

examples.text: Occasionally he made a humorously sardonic remark.
examples.translation: 他时不时说一句幽默嘲讽的话。

examples.text: According to one official more than a hundred people have been arrested.
examples.translation: 一名官员称有一百多人被捕。

examples.text: Hundreds of tree species face extinction...
examples.translation: 许许多多树种濒临灭绝。

examples.text: Today you can buy hundreds of flavours of ice-cream.
examples.translation: 如今你可以买到很多种口味的冰激凌。

examples.text: Hundreds have been killed in the fighting and thousands made homeless.
examples.translation: 很多人在战火中丧生，更多的人则落得无家可归。

examples.text: Are you a hundred per cent sure it's your neighbour?...
examples.translation: 你百分之百肯定是你的邻居吗？

examples.text: I agree with you one hundred per cent.
examples.translation: 我完全同意你的话。

examples.text: Hunger is the body's signal that levels of blood sugar are too low...
examples.translation: 饥饿感是身体发出的信号，表示血糖水平太低。

examples.text: The nutritionally balanced menus are designed to help you lose up to a pound a day without hunger pangs.
examples.translation: 营养搭配均衡的菜谱旨在不必忍受饥饿的前提下帮您每天减掉一磅体重。

examples.text: Three hundred people in this town are dying of hunger every day.
examples.translation: 该镇每天有300人濒于饿死。

examples.text: ...a desire to alleviate hunger and suffering in the Third World.
examples.translation: 减轻第三世界的饥荒和苦难的愿望

examples.text: Geffen has a hunger for success that seems bottomless.
examples.translation: 格芬的成功欲望似乎永无止境。

examples.text: ...his hunger to equal Vardon's record of six wins.
examples.translation: 他想平瓦登六个冠军头衔的纪录的渴望

examples.text: But Jules was not eager for classroom learning, he hungered for adventure.
examples.translation: 但朱尔斯对坐在课堂里学习并不热心，他渴望冒险。

meanings.meaning: 饥饿的；渴望的；荒年的；不毛的

examples.text: My friend was hungry, so we drove to a shopping mall to get some food...
examples.translation: 我的朋友饿了，于是我们开车去一家购物中心吃饭。

examples.text: She is reduced to stealing to feed her hungry family.
examples.translation: 她沦落到要靠偷窃来养活饥饿的家人。

examples.text: James ate hungrily.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯狼吞虎咽。

examples.text: Leonidas' family had been poor, he went hungry for years.
examples.translation: 利奥尼达斯家曾经很穷，他有很多年都吃不饱肚子。

examples.text: Susan was certainly hungry for a life different from the one she had made for herself...
examples.translation: 苏珊无疑一心想过一种和现在不同的生活。

examples.text: I left Oxford in 1961 hungry to be a critic.
examples.translation: 我于1961年离开牛津，渴望成为一名评论家。

examples.text: ...power-hungry politicians.
examples.translation: 渴求权力的政客

examples.text: ...land-hungry peasants.
examples.translation: 渴望拥有土地的农民

examples.text: He looked at her hungrily. What eyes! What skin!
examples.translation: 他饥渴地看着她。瞧这眼睛！瞧这皮肤！

meanings.meaning: (Hunt)人名；(德、瑞典)洪特；(英)亨特；(法)安

examples.text: A forensic team was hunting for clues...
examples.translation: 法医小组正在寻找线索。

examples.text: Some new arrivals lose hope even before they start hunting for a job...
examples.translation: 有些新来的人甚至还没开始找工作就感到绝望了。

examples.text: Chryssa hunted for Patra, and found her busy at a corner of the site.
examples.translation: 克丽莎到处寻找帕特拉，最后发现她在现场的一个角落里忙活着。

examples.text: The couple had helped in the hunt for the toddlers.
examples.translation: 这对夫妇曾帮着搜寻那些幼童。

examples.text: Detectives have been hunting him for seven months...
examples.translation: 侦探7个月来一直在追捕他。

examples.text: Her irate husband was hunting him with a gun.
examples.translation: 她暴怒的丈夫正拿着一把枪追杀他。

examples.text: Despite a nationwide hunt for the kidnap gang, not a trace of them was found.
examples.translation: 尽管已经在全国范围内追捕该绑架团伙，却没有发现他们的任何蛛丝马迹。

examples.text: As a child I learned to hunt and fish...
examples.translation: 从小我就学会了打猎和捕鱼。

examples.text: A leopard hunts alone, and an injured leopard cannot hunt...
examples.translation: 豹向来单独猎食，所以如果受伤了就无法捕猎。

examples.text: He got up at four and set out on foot to hunt black grouse.
examples.translation: 他4点钟起了床，徒步出发去猎杀黑琴鸡。

examples.text: He set off for a nineteen-day moose hunt in Nova Scotia.
examples.translation: 他动身前往新斯科舍参加为时19天的驼鹿捕猎活动。

examples.text: She liked to hunt as often as she could.
examples.translation: 她喜欢一有时间就去猎狐。

examples.text: The hunt was held on land owned by the Duke of Marlborough.
examples.translation: 猎狐活动在马尔伯勒公爵的庄园举行。

examples.text: We're still in the hunt for the League title and we want to go all the way in the Cup.
examples.translation: 我们仍有机会获得联赛冠军，而且我们还想一路杀进足总杯决赛。

meanings.meaning: 丢下；用力投掷；愤慨地说出

examples.text: Groups of angry youths hurled stones at police...
examples.translation: 成群结伙愤怒的年轻人朝警察投掷石块。

examples.text: One prisoner set fire to rags and hurled them into the courtyard...
examples.translation: 一名囚犯将破布点着，扔进院子。

examples.text: Simon caught the grenade and hurled it back...
examples.translation: 西蒙接住手榴弹，又把它大力掷了回去。

examples.text: Gangs rioted last night, breaking storefront windows and hurling rocks and bottles.
examples.translation: 几个帮派昨晚聚众闹事，他们打碎商店临街的玻璃窗，并投掷石块和瓶子。

examples.text: How would you handle being locked in the back of a cab while the driver hurled abuse at you?
examples.translation: 如果你被锁在出租车后座上而且还遭到司机的无礼谩骂，你会怎么办？

examples.text: It was stronger than Hurricane Katrina and it hit closer to the city, Mock said.

meanings.meaning: 仓促（做某事）；催促；（朝某方向）迅速移动；迅速处理

examples.text: Claire hurried along the road...
examples.translation: 克莱尔匆匆地沿路而行。

examples.text: When she finished work she had to hurry home and look after her son...
examples.translation: 她下班后就得赶紧回家照顾儿子。

examples.text: Bob hurried to join him, and they rode home together.
examples.translation: 鲍勃匆忙赶去和他会合，然后两人一起开车回家。

examples.text: Mrs Hardie hurried to make up for her tactlessness by asking her guest about his holiday...
examples.translation: 哈迪夫人赶紧问客人假期过得怎么样，替自己的言不得体打圆场。

examples.text: There was no longer any reason to hurry.
examples.translation: 再也不用着急了。

examples.text: Kate was in a hurry to grow up, eager for knowledge and experience...
examples.translation: 凯特急于长大，渴望获取知识和经验。

examples.text: Eric left the barge in a hurry.
examples.translation: 埃里克匆忙离开了驳船。

examples.text: ...The President's attempt to hurry the process of independence.
examples.translation: 总统试图加快独立进程的努力

examples.text: Rachel hurried him to his bed...
examples.translation: 雷切尔催着他上了床。

examples.text: They say they are not going to be hurried into any decision...
examples.translation: 他们说自己不会被迫仓促作出任何决定。

examples.text: I don't want to hurry you.
examples.translation: 我不想催你。

examples.text: I'll need to talk with you, but there's no hurry...
examples.translation: 我得和你谈谈，但不着急。

examples.text: 'I am in no particular hurry,' he insisted.
examples.translation: “我没什么特别着急的事，”他坚持道。

examples.text: I love it at St Mirren so I'm in no hurry to go anywhere...
examples.translation: 我喜欢在圣米伦的生活，所以我哪里也不愿去。

examples.text: 'It's a thrill I'm in no hurry for,' he smiles.
examples.translation: “我可不想要这种刺激，”他笑着说。

meanings.meaning: 使受伤；损害；使疼痛；使痛心
感到疼痛；有坏处；带来痛苦

examples.text: Yasin had seriously hurt himself while trying to escape from the police...
examples.translation: 亚辛试图从警察手中逃脱时受了重伤。

examples.text: He had hurt his back in an accident.
examples.translation: 他在一次事故中伤了后背。

examples.text: His collar bone only hurt when he lifted his arm.
examples.translation: 他的锁骨只有在抬臂时才感觉到痛。

examples.text: His comrades asked him if he was hurt...
examples.translation: 战友问他是否受伤了。

examples.text: They were dazed but did not seem to be badly hurt.
examples.translation: 他们有些神志不清，但看起来没有受重伤。

examples.text: I didn't mean to hurt her, only to keep her still...
examples.translation: 我不是故意要弄痛她，只是想让她别乱动。

examples.text: You're hurting my arm...
examples.translation: 你弄痛我的胳膊了。

examples.text: Ouch. That hurt.
examples.translation: 哎哟，好痛。

examples.text: He is afraid of hurting Bessy's feelings...
examples.translation: 他怕伤害了贝茜的感情。

examples.text: She's afraid she's going to be hurt and that she'll never fall in love again...
examples.translation: 她害怕自己会受到伤害，从而永远不会再恋爱了。

examples.text: What hurts most is the betrayal, the waste.
examples.translation: 最痛彻心扉的是背叛和感情的浪费。

examples.text: Yes, I was hurt, jealous...
examples.translation: 是的，我感到伤心、嫉妒。

examples.text: He gave me a slightly hurt look.
examples.translation: 他有点受伤地看了我一眼。

examples.text: I am lonely and I am hurting.
examples.translation: 我很孤单，很难过。

examples.text: The combination of hot weather and decreased water supplies is hurting many industries...
examples.translation: 炎热的天气和供水的减少正危及很多行业。

examples.text: They may fear hurting their husbands' careers.
examples.translation: 她们可能担心对丈夫的事业造成损害。

examples.text: ...feelings of hurt and anger, fear and despair...
examples.translation: 伤心、愤怒、恐惧、绝望的复杂情感

examples.text: I was full of jealousy and hurt...
examples.translation: 我满怀嫉妒，伤心不已。

examples.text: There would be a hurt in her heart for a while, but in the end she would get over it.
examples.translation: 她可能会伤心难过一阵子，但最终她会好起来。

examples.text: It never hurts to ask...
examples.translation: 多问无妨。

examples.text: It wouldn't hurt you to be a bit more serious.
examples.translation: 认真一点对你没有坏处。

examples.text: Eva married her husband Jack in 1957...
examples.translation: 伊娃和丈夫杰克于1957年结的婚。

examples.text: Are they husband and wife?
examples.translation: 他们是夫妻吗？

examples.text: Husbanding precious resources was part of rural life.
examples.translation: 节约地使用宝贵的资源是乡村生活的一部分。

examples.text: He stood outside a small hut his family constructed out of Styrofoam and plywood.
The company also plans to launch its first commercialized hydrogen fuel cell vehicle by 2015.
He accused newspapers of hypocrisy in their treatment of the story...
examples.translation: 他指责了报纸在报道该新闻时的虚伪。

examples.text: You'll have little patience with the hypocrisy and double standards you encounter.
examples.translation: 你将会无法忍受所遭遇的伪善和双重标准。

examples.text: ...the hypocrisies of middle-class provincial life.
examples.translation: 地方中产阶级生活的虚假矫饰

examples.text: Work will now begin to test the hypothesis in rats...
examples.translation: 现在将开始在老鼠身上做实验以验证该假设。

examples.text: Different hypotheses have been put forward to explain why these foods are more likely to cause problems.
examples.translation: 人们已经提出不同的假说来解释为什么这些食物更有可能带来问题。

meanings.meaning: 歇斯底里的；异常兴奋的

examples.text: Police and bodyguards had to protect him as the almost hysterical crowds struggled to approach him...
examples.translation: 当情绪几近失控的人群拼命想接近他时，警察和保镖不得不保护他。

examples.text: He made headlines and received hysterical hate mail.
examples.translation: 他成了新闻人物，收到了疯狂的攻击性邮件。

examples.text: I don't think we can go round screaming hysterically: 'Ban these dogs. Muzzle all dogs.'
examples.translation: 我不认为歇斯底里地到处去高喊“禁止遛狗。给所有狗带上口套”是个好主意。

examples.text: I suffered bouts of really hysterical depression.
examples.translation: 我曾患阵发的严重癔病性抑郁症。

examples.text: I was curled up on the floor in a corner sobbing hysterically.
examples.translation: 我蜷缩在地上的某个角落，失声痛哭。

examples.text: I had to rush to the loo to avoid an attack of hysterical giggles.
examples.translation: 我不得不冲向卫生间，以免遭到别人的疯狂嘲笑。

examples.text: She says she hasn't laughed as hysterically since she was 13.
examples.translation: 她说自己从13岁起就再也没有像这样疯狂大笑过。

examples.text: Paul Mazursky was Master of Ceremonies, and he was pretty hysterical.
examples.translation: 保罗·马祖尔斯基担任司仪，他简直把人笑坏了。

examples.text: It wasn't supposed to be a comedy but I found it hysterically funny.
examples.translation: 这本来不是一出喜剧，但我却觉得非常滑稽。

examples.text: Jim and I are getting married...
examples.translation: 我和吉姆就要结婚了。

examples.text: She liked me, I think.
examples.translation: 我觉得，她曾喜欢过我。

examples.text: Glaciers are moving rivers of ice...
examples.translation: 冰河是犹如河水般流动的巨大冰体。

examples.text: The ice is melting.
examples.translation: 冰正在融化。

examples.text: ...a bitter lemon with ice.
examples.translation: 一杯加冰的苦柠檬汁

examples.text: I've iced and decorated the cake.
examples.translation: 我在蛋糕上挂了糖衣，还做了花样装饰。

examples.text: He's eaten a lot of choc ices.
examples.translation: 他吃了很多巧克力冰激凌。

examples.text: That sort of approach should go a long way toward breaking the ice...
examples.translation: 那种方法对打破僵局会大有帮助。

examples.text: The major purpose of his trip was to break the ice, and his itinerary so far has been packed full.
examples.translation: 他此行的主要目的是打破僵局，目前的行程已经排满。

examples.text: That sort of romantic attitude cuts no ice with money-men.
examples.translation: 那种不切实际的态度对金融家们根本不起什么作用。

examples.text: The deal was put on ice for three months...
examples.translation: 该交易被搁置了 3 个月。

examples.text: The $40 million-a-month aid payments will remain on ice.
examples.translation: 每月 4,000 万美元的援助款项将继续搁置下去。

examples.text: I had skated on thin ice and, so far, got away with it.
examples.translation: 我曾经冒过很大风险，但目前为止侥幸没事。

examples.text: Outside the ice-cream shop, two kids were licking ice creams and staring right at Chenayya.
It's a good idea to plan ahead...
examples.translation: 提前做计划是个好主意。

examples.text: I really like the idea of helping people...
examples.translation: 我非常赞同帮助他人的提议。

examples.text: She told me she'd had a brilliant idea.
examples.translation: 她告诉我她有个好主意。

examples.text: Some of his ideas about democracy are entirely his own.
examples.translation: 他关于民主的一些观点完全是他自己的创见。

examples.text: ...the idea that reading too many books ruins your eyes...
examples.translation: 读书过多损害眼睛的看法

examples.text: My idea of physical perfection is to be very slender.
examples.translation: 在我看来，要拥有完美身材就要非常苗条。

examples.text: This table will give you some idea of how levels of ability can be measured...
examples.translation: 这张表格会让你大致了解能力水平可以怎样评估。

examples.text: Could you give us an idea of the range of complaints you've been receiving?...
examples.translation: 你能跟我们大致讲一下今年收到的投诉的范围吗？

examples.text: If you cannot remember the exact date give a rough idea of when it was.
examples.translation: 如果你记不清确切日期，就说一下大致的时间吧。

examples.text: By the end of the week you will have a clear idea of what your eating habits are...
examples.translation: 到这周末你便会清楚自己的饮食习惯了。

examples.text: No one has any real idea how much the company will make next year.
examples.translation: 没人真的知道该公司明年会赚多少钱。

examples.text: I had an idea that he joined the army later, but I may be wrong.
examples.translation: 我猜他后来参军了，但也可能我猜得不对。

examples.text: The idea is to encourage people to get to know their neighbours.
examples.translation: 其目的是促使人们结识邻居。

examples.text: He sent for a number of books he admired with the idea of re-reading them...
examples.translation: 他订购了一些自己喜欢的书，打算重新再读一遍。

examples.text: I had to postpone ideas of a career and stay at home.
examples.translation: 我不得不暂缓就业打算，呆在家里。

examples.text: 'Is she coming by coach?' — 'Well I've no idea.'
examples.translation: “她坐长途汽车来吗?”——“哦，我不知道。”

examples.text: We haven't the faintest idea where he is.
examples.translation: 我们根本不知道他在哪里。

examples.text: It isn't too difficult once you get the idea...
examples.translation: 你一旦弄懂了，就不太难了。

examples.text: You're beginning to get the idea.
examples.translation: 你开始明白了。

examples.text: We are both so happy, you have no idea...
examples.translation: 你肯定想象不出来，我们俩都这么幸福。

examples.text: You have no idea how depressed it made me.
examples.translation: 你都想象不出这事令我多么沮丧。

meanings.meaning: 理想的；完美的；想象的；不切实际的

examples.text: ...the bohemian ideals of truth, beauty, freedom and love.
examples.translation: 崇信真、美、自由与爱的波西米亚式理想

examples.text: I tried to live up to my ideal of myself.
examples.translation: 我努力活出理想的自我。

examples.text: ...the Japanese ideal of beauty...
examples.translation: 日本人理想中的美人形象

examples.text: Throughout his career she remained his feminine ideal.
examples.translation: 在他整个职业生涯中，她一直是他心中完美女性的代表。

examples.text: She decided that I was the ideal person to take over the job...
examples.translation: 她认定我是接手这份工作的最佳人选。

examples.text: I really love the area and see it as an ideal place to start my managerial career...
examples.translation: 我真的很喜欢那个地区，把它视为开创我管理事业的理想之地。

examples.text: The conditions were ideal for racing.
examples.translation: 当时的天气最适合比赛。

examples.text: We do not live in an ideal world...
examples.translation: 我们并非生活在完美的世界里。

examples.text: In an ideal world, there would be no such thing as rubbish...
examples.translation: 在一个理想世界中，不会有垃圾之类的东西。

examples.text: Their ideal society collapsed around them into the Terror and then into the Counterrevolution.
examples.translation: 他们所处的理想社会崩溃了，社会进入恐怖时期，接着是反革命时期。

examples.text: Nearly all the houses were identical...
examples.translation: 几乎所有的房子都一模一样。

examples.text: The two parties fought the last election on almost identical manifestos.
examples.translation: 两个政党以几乎完全相同的竞选宣言参加了上次竞选。

examples.text: ...nine identically dressed female dancers.
examples.translation: 9个装扮得一模一样的舞女

meanings.meaning: 鉴定，识别；认同；身份证明

examples.text: Early identification of a disease can prevent death and illness...
examples.translation: 病症的及早诊断可避免死亡与病痛。

examples.text: Their work includes the identification of genes which govern the growth rate and fertility...
examples.translation: 他们的工作包括找出那些控制生长率和繁殖能力的基因。

examples.text: There should be some identification of goals, and how far these have been achieved.
examples.translation: 应该对目标加以明确，并确认完成情况。

examples.text: Officials are awaiting positive identification before charging the men with war crimes...
examples.translation: 在以战争罪起诉这些人以前，官员们一直在等待他们身份的核实。

examples.text: He's made a formal identification of the body.
examples.translation: 他正式确认了死者身份。

examples.text: ...the Hamlyn identification guide to wild flowers of Britain.
examples.translation: 哈姆林对英国野生花草的鉴定指导

examples.text: The woman who was on passport control asked me if I had any further identification.
examples.translation: 检查护照的女士问我是否有进一步的身份证明。

examples.text: Throughout the Balkans, there is a close identification of nationhood with language.
examples.translation: 整个巴尔干半岛上，国家地位与语言有着非常密切的联系。

examples.text: ...the identification of Spain with Catholicism.
examples.translation: 西班牙与天主教的密切联系

examples.text: I need your full, emotional identification with the problem and with me...
examples.translation: 我需要你对我、对此问题都有充分的情感认同与支持。

examples.text: Marilyn had an intense identification with animals.
examples.translation: 玛丽莲非常怜爱动物。

meanings.meaning: 确定；鉴定；识别，辨认出；使参与；把…看成一样

examples.text: There are a number of distinguishing characteristics by which you can identify a Hollywood epic...
examples.translation: 好莱坞的史诗大片有着一些与众不同的特点。

examples.text: I tried to identify her perfume...
examples.translation: 我试图分辨出她用哪种香水。

examples.text: A uniformed chauffeur identified me among the crowd.
examples.translation: 一个穿制服的司机在人群中认出了我。

examples.text: Police have already identified around 10 murder suspects...
examples.translation: 警方已经确认了约10名谋杀案疑凶。

examples.text: The reporters identified one of the six Americans as an Army Specialist...
examples.translation: 记者们认出6名美国人中有一位是陆军技术兵。

examples.text: They identified six plants as having potential for development into pharmaceutical drugs.
examples.translation: 他们验明6种植物有可能提炼出药物麻醉剂。

examples.text: Scientists claim to have identified natural substances with cancer-combating properties...
examples.translation: 科学家们声称已经发现自然界的某些物质具有抗癌特性。

examples.text: Having identified the problem, the question arises of how to overcome it.
examples.translation: 发现问题后，如何克服它的问题又出现了。

examples.text: She wore a little nurse's hat on her head to identify her...
examples.translation: 她头戴一顶小护士帽，很容易辨认。

examples.text: His boots and purple beret identify him as commanding the Scottish Paratroops.
examples.translation: 他的长靴和紫色贝雷帽表明他统领着苏格兰伞兵部队。

examples.text: She would only play a role if she could identify with the character...
examples.translation: 她只愿扮演她能认同的角色。

examples.text: I could speak their language and identify with their problems because I had been there myself.
examples.translation: 我会讲他们的语言，能体会他们的难处，因为我自己曾在那里呆过。

examples.text: She hates playing the sweet, passive women that audiences identify her with...
examples.translation: 她讨厌扮演那些漂亮可爱、消极被动的女人，观众们已把她定型为这类角色。

examples.text: The candidates all want to identify themselves with reform.
examples.translation: 候选人都想把自己与改革密切联系起来。

meanings.meaning: 身份；同一性，一致；特性；恒等式

examples.text: Abu is not his real name, but it's one he uses to disguise his identity...
examples.translation: 阿布不是他的真名，是他用于伪装身份的名字。

examples.text: The police soon established his true identity and he was quickly found.
examples.translation: 警方不久就查出了他的真实身份，并很快找到了他。

examples.text: I wanted a sense of my own identity.
examples.translation: 我想要确立自己的个性意识。

examples.text: ...the distinct cultural, religious and national identity of many Italians.
examples.translation: 许多意大利人独有的文化、宗教、民族特性

meanings.meaning: 意识形态；思想意识；观念学

examples.text: ...capitalist ideology.
examples.translation: 资本主义意识形态

examples.text: McCartney was also keen to write in a classical idiom, rather than a pop one...
examples.translation: 麦卡特尼也热衷于古典风格而不是通俗风格的创作。

examples.text: It was an old building in the local idiom.
examples.translation: 那是一座具有当地风格的古建筑。

examples.text: Proverbs and idioms may become worn with overuse...
examples.translation: 谚语和习语会由于使用过多而变得俗套。

examples.text: She is, in fact, a perfect illustration of the French idiom 'to be comfortable in one's own skin.'
examples.translation: 实际上，她很好地诠释了“欣然接纳自我”这一法语习语的意思。

examples.text: And nothing was so irritating as the confident way he used archaic idiom.
examples.translation: 没什么比他使用过时的方言时那种自负的神态更气人的了。

examples.text: ...her command of the Chinese idiom.
examples.translation: 她对汉语方言的掌握

examples.text: I knew I'd been an idiot to stay there...
examples.translation: 我知道我呆在这里很蠢。

examples.text: You're an idiot!
examples.translation: 你是个白痴！

examples.text: ...a bunch of idiot journalists waiting to ask me stupid questions.
examples.translation: 一帮白痴似的记者等着问我愚蠢的问题

examples.text: ...the village idiot.
examples.translation: 村里的那个智障者

examples.text: Employees have been idle almost a month because of shortages.
examples.translation: 由于原料短缺，员工们已将近一个月无事可做。

examples.text: Now the machine is lying idle.
examples.translation: 如今机器闲置着。

examples.text: ...factories that had been idle for years.
examples.translation: 已经闲置多年的工厂

examples.text: ...idle bureaucrats who spent the day reading newspapers...
examples.translation: 无所事事、整天看报纸的官僚们

examples.text: I never met such an idle bunch of workers in all my life!
examples.translation: 我一辈子都没碰到过像他们这样吃白饭的工人！

examples.text: Idleness is a very bad thing for human nature.
examples.translation: 懒散是人性中很糟糕的一面。

examples.text: We were not idly sitting around.
examples.translation: 我们并非坐着没事干。

examples.text: Brian kept up the idle chatter for another five minutes.
examples.translation: 布赖恩又絮絮地唠叨了5分钟。

examples.text: ...idle curiosity.
examples.translation: 无聊的好奇心

examples.text: We talked idly about magazines and baseball...
examples.translation: 我们漫不经心地谈论杂志和棒球。

examples.text: 'Has there been an accident?' Gary asked, idly curious.
examples.translation: “出什么事故了吗?”加里问道，漫不经心又好奇。

examples.text: It would be idle to pretend the system is perfect.
examples.translation: 假装系统完美无疵是徒劳的。

examples.text: It was more of an idle threat than anything...
examples.translation: 那其实是唬人的话。

examples.text: His statement isn't merely an idle boast.
examples.translation: 他的话不仅仅是虚张声势的自夸。

examples.text: When they reached his house, Scobie idled a bit, finishing his cigarette...
examples.translation: 他们到他家后，斯科比闲逛了一会儿，抽完了他的香烟。

examples.text: We spent many hours idling in one of the cafes that line three sides of the tiny piazza...
examples.translation: 露天小市场的三面都有小餐馆，我们在其中一家餐馆闲呆了很长时间。

examples.text: He idled around afterwards, window shopping until about 5pm.
examples.translation: 然后他就闲逛，浏览橱窗直到下午 5 点钟左右。

examples.text: ...idled assembly plants.
examples.translation: 停业的装配厂

examples.text: The strike has idled about 55,000 machinists.
examples.translation: 罢工使约 55,000 名机械师无事可做。

examples.text: Beyond a stand of trees a small plane idled...
examples.translation: 在树林的那一边,一架小飞机停在那里,发动机在空转。

examples.text: Her Daimler limo waits with its engine idling.
examples.translation: 她的戴姆勒豪华轿车原地待命,发动机在空转。

meanings.meaning: （表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如

examples.text: She gets very upset if I exclude her from anything...
examples.translation: 要是有什么事情我不让她参加,她会非常难过。

examples.text: You'll feel a lot better about yourself if you work on solutions to your upsetting situations...
examples.translation: 如果你设法找到解决自己麻烦的办法,你自我感觉会好得多。

examples.text: You can go if you want...
examples.translation: 你要是想走就可以走。

examples.text: If you would like to send a donation to Cobuild, please enclose a cheque with your coupon...
examples.translation: 如果你想为Cobuild语料库捐款,请随订货单附上支票。

examples.text: If you went into town, you'd notice all the pubs have loud jukeboxes...
examples.translation: 如果你进了城,你会注意到所有的酒吧都有音量很大的自动点唱机。

examples.text: What I did was right and if I had done anything less it would have been wrong...
examples.translation: 我做的一切都是正确的,如果我少做了一点点,就会出错。

examples.text: Fry remaining peppers, adding a little more dressing if necessary...
examples.translation: 用油炸一下剩下的辣椒,如果需要再加点调味汁。

examples.text: Do you have a knack for coming up with ideas? If so, we would love to hear from you.
examples.translation: 你有什么能想出好点子的诀窍吗？如果有,我们很愿意收到你的来信。

examples.text: He asked if I had left with you, and I said no...
examples.translation: 他问我是否和你一块儿离开的,我说不是。

examples.text: I wonder if I might have a word with Mr Abbot?
examples.translation: 请问我能否和阿博特先生说几句话？

examples.text: Sometimes, that standard is quite difficult, if not impossible, to achieve...
examples.translation: 有时即便有可能达到那个标准，那也是非常困难。

examples.text: I'm working on my fitness and I will be ready in a couple of weeks, if not sooner...
examples.translation: 我正在调养身体,最多两三周以后就可以了。

examples.text: Many, if not most, scientific papers are presented orally at scientific meetings...
examples.translation: 许多科学论文,即便不是大多数,都是以口头形式在科学会议上发表的。

examples.text: What one quality, if any, do you like the most about your partner?...
examples.translation: 你最喜欢你伴侣的哪一点,假如有的话？

examples.text: Meat was available once a week if at all.
examples.translation: 就算有肉，也是每周才吃一次。

examples.text: If I could just make another small point about the weightlifters in the Olympics...
examples.translation: 请允许我就有关奥运会举重运动员的问题再补充一点。

examples.text: So, if we may return strictly to athletics again for a few minutes...
examples.translation: 因此,如果我们可以再花几分钟重新回到田径运动话题上来的话……

examples.text: But if I can interrupt, Joe, I don't think anybody here is personally blaming the Germans...
examples.translation: 但是请允许我打断一下，乔,我认为在场的任何人都没有谴责德国人的意思。

examples.text: Well, it's the old argument Max, which is a bit ridiculous if you don't mind me saying so...
examples.translation: 哦,马克斯，又是那个很老套且有点儿荒谬的争论,如果你不介意我这么说的话。

examples.text: Well if you want my opinion, unless you do it soon you're gonna lose the opportunity and you'll be really sorry.
examples.translation: 如果你想听我的意见,你应该尽快做那事,否则你会失去机会,并且会非常遗憾。

examples.text: I wonder if you'd be kind enough to give us some information, please?
examples.translation: 请问您能不能给我们提供一些信息？

examples.text: If you will just sign here, we will arrange for your bank to deduct your payments automatically.
examples.translation: 麻烦您在这里签一下字,我们将联系您的银行自动扣除您的付款。

examples.text: If there was any disappointment it was probably temporary...
examples.translation: 即便有点儿失望,也肯定是暂时的。

examples.text: Even if I'm overstating the case for nutrition, at least it will result in the woman being in charge of her own symptoms...
examples.translation: 即便我夸大了营养的重要性,但至少它会让这个女人知道关注自己的症状。

examples.text: So what if sometimes they stayed rather late, it doesn't mean anything.
examples.translation: 因此，即便有时他们熬夜到很晚,那也说明不了什么。

examples.text: A number of recent advances hold out if not the hope of a cure, then at least the possibility of some drug which could stop the spread of the virus...
examples.translation: 近来的一些进展即使不能提供治愈的希望,也至少有望研制出来某种药物来阻止病毒的传播。

examples.text: She understood his meaning, if not his words, and took his advice.
examples.translation: 她即便没听懂他的话,也明白了他的意思,并且接受了他的建议。

examples.text: I became a distraught, worried mother, a useless role if ever there was one...
examples.translation: 我变成了一个忧心如焚的母亲,一个全无用处的角色。

examples.text: If ever there was the right person in the right job it was she...
examples.translation: 要是真的有才尽其用的人,那就是她。

examples.text: If ever a man needed your love, I need it.
examples.translation: 如果说真有一个男人需要你的爱,那就是我。

examples.text: She writes me often, if only to scold me because I haven't written to her...
examples.translation: 她常来信,即使仅仅为了责怪我还没回信给她。

examples.text: A one-to-one meeting with the US President was necessary, if only for a deeper exchange of views.
examples.translation: 与美国总统一对一的会谈是必要的,即便仅仅是为了双方观点更深入的交流。

examples.text: If only you had told me that some time ago...
examples.translation: 要是你早些时候告诉我该多好啊！

examples.text: If only it were that simple!...
examples.translation: 要是那么简单就好了！

examples.text: 'Hey, listen to me, all that 1980 nonsense is over.' — 'If only, Timothy, if only.'
examples.translation: “嗨,听我说,所有那些 1980 年的无聊之事都结束了。”——“要是这样就好了,蒂莫西,要是这样就好了。”

examples.text: The whole room looks as if it has been lovingly put together over the years...
examples.translation: 整个房间看起来好像是经过了多年的精心布置。

examples.text: His heart was pounding, as if he were frightened.
examples.translation: 他的心怦怦跳,似乎被吓坏了。

examples.text: He points two fingers at his head, as if he were holding a gun...
examples.translation: 他把两根手指指向他的头,仿佛他正举着一支枪。

examples.text: The two cousins looked as if they'd been carved from blocks of ice.
examples.translation: 两个堂姊妹看起来像由冰块雕刻而成。

examples.text: My husband, for some unknown reason, suggested that I loved my birds more than him: as if I would...
examples.translation: 我丈夫,莫名其妙地,暗示我爱鸟甚于爱他：仿佛我真如此似的。

examples.text: Getting my work done! My God! As if it mattered.
examples.translation: 把我的工作做完！老天！好像它真的很重要似的。

examples.text: Living together didn't harm our friendship. If anything it strengthened it...
examples.translation: 在一起住并没有损害我们的友谊。要说真有什么的话,它反而巩固了我们的友谊。

examples.text: Asthma drugs are not addictive and you don't need to keep increasing the dose. If anything, the reverse is true.
examples.translation: 哮喘药物不会造成药物依赖,你不用持续增大剂量。甚至正相反,减小剂量才对。

examples.text: I am surprised by the fuss she's making. It's not as if my personality has changed.
examples.translation: 她的大惊小怪令我很吃惊。显然不是我的个性改变了。

examples.text: If I were you, Mrs Gretchen, I just wouldn't worry about it...
examples.translation: 要是我是你,格蕾琴夫人,我一点都不会担心。

examples.text: What I'd do if I were you is be nice to him...
examples.translation: 如果我是你,我要做的就是对他好。

examples.text: I should lie down for a bit, if I were you.
examples.translation: 如果我是你,我就会躺一会儿。

examples.text: The bombs ignited a fire which destroyed some 60 houses...
examples.translation: 炸弹引发的大火烧毁了大约 60 栋房屋。

examples.text: The blasts were caused by pockets of methane gas that ignited.
examples.translation: 爆炸是由甲烷气囊被引燃造成的。

examples.text: There was one teacher who really ignited my interest in words...
examples.translation: 曾经有一位老师真正激起了我对文字的兴趣。

examples.text: The recent fighting in the area could ignite regional passions far beyond the borders.
examples.translation: 最近该地区的战斗可能激发边境以外整个地区的激动情绪。

examples.text: I am embarrassed by my complete ignorance of history...
examples.translation: 我对历史一无所知,这让我很难堪。

examples.text: There is so much ignorance about mental illness...
examples.translation: 人们对精神疾病很不了解。

examples.text: In my ignorance I had never heard country & western music.
examples.translation: 我很无知,从来没听过乡村与西部音乐。

examples.text: People don't like to ask questions for fear of appearing ignorant...
examples.translation: 人们不喜欢问问题,害怕自己会显得很无知。

examples.text: Many people are worryingly ignorant of the facts about global warming.
examples.translation: 许多人竟然不知道地球变暖的事实,实在令人担忧。

examples.text: ...ignorant peasants.
examples.translation: 愚昧无知的农民

examples.text: I met some very ignorant people who called me all kinds of names.
examples.translation: 我碰到了一些非常粗鲁的家伙,他们用各种脏话骂我。

examples.text: She said her husband ignored her...
examples.translation: 她说丈夫不关心她。

examples.text: The government had ignored his views on the subject...
examples.translation: 政府没有理睬他对这一问题的看法。

examples.text: She ignored legal advice to drop the case...
examples.translation: 她没有理睬律师关于放弃诉讼的建议。

examples.text: For two decades her theatrical talents were ignored by the film industry.
examples.translation: 她的舞台表演天赋在电影行业中被埋没了 20 年。

examples.text: Such arguments ignore the question of where ultimate responsibility lay.
examples.translation: 这些争论忽略了最终责任由谁来负的问题。

meanings.meaning: 生病的；坏的；邪恶的；不吉利的

examples.text: In November 1941 Payne was seriously ill with pneumonia...
examples.translation: 1941 年 11 月,佩恩得了严重的肺炎。

examples.text: I was feeling ill...
examples.translation: 我觉得自己生病了。

examples.text: If damp, musty buildings make you ill, mould is probably the cause...
examples.translation: 如果潮湿发霉的建筑令你生病了,霉菌很可能是病因。

examples.text: Two years ago my husband was declared to be terminally ill.
examples.translation: 两年前,我丈夫被诊断患了不治之症。

examples.text: I used to work with the mentally ill...
examples.translation: 我曾经做过一份和精神病人打交道的工作。

examples.text: She became a nun and cared for the terminally ill for the rest of her life.
examples.translation: 她做了修女,用她的余生照顾患有绝症的人们。

examples.text: His critics maintain that he's responsible for many of Algeria's ills.
examples.translation: 他的批评者们坚持认为他应该为阿尔及利亚所面临的许多难题负责任。

examples.text: ...various potions that would cure all ills.
examples.translation: 解决所有问题的多种方案

examples.text: They say they mean you no ill.
examples.translation: 他们说他们对你并无恶意。

examples.text: The company's conservative instincts sit ill with competition.
examples.translation: 该公司保守的本性不利于竞争。

examples.text: She had brought ill luck into her family...
examples.translation: 她给家庭带来了厄运。

examples.text: He says that he bears no ill feelings towards Johnson.
examples.translation: 他说他对约翰逊并无恶感。

examples.text: It's possible he won't play but I can ill afford to lose him...
examples.translation: 有可能他不会上场,但是我几乎承受不起失去他的损失。

examples.text: We can ill afford another scandal...
examples.translation: 我们经不起再有丑闻出现了。

examples.text: It's an ignorance we can ill afford.
examples.translation: 这是我们难以承受的无知。

examples.text: It's an ominous development that may bode ill for the Russian parliament.
examples.translation: 进展很不顺利,对俄罗斯议会来说这可能是个坏兆头。

examples.text: Shortly before Christmas, he was mysteriously taken ill...
examples.translation: 圣诞节前不久,他突然不明原因地病倒了。

examples.text: She fell ill with measles.
examples.translation: 她患麻疹病倒了。

examples.text: Recent events should make everyone modest about saying what cannot happen there, for good or ill.
examples.translation: 最近的事件应该会让每个人在预测某处不可能发生什么事时变得谨慎起来,不论是好事还是坏事。

meanings.meaning: [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的

examples.text: It is illegal to intercept radio messages...
examples.translation: 拦截无线电报是非法的。

examples.text: Birth control was illegal there until 1978...
examples.translation: 1978 年以前那里节育是非法的。

examples.text: He has been charged with membership of an illegal organisation.
examples.translation: 他被指控参与非法组织。

examples.text: ...illegal drugs.
examples.translation: 毒品

examples.text: ...an illegal action.
examples.translation: 非法行动

examples.text: They were yesterday convicted of illegally using a handgun...
examples.translation: 他们昨天被判犯有非法使用手枪罪。

examples.text: The previous government had acted illegally.
examples.translation: 上届政府采取的行动不合法。

examples.text: There is no evidence of illegality.
examples.translation: 没有违法的证据。

examples.text: ...a clothing factory where many illegals worked.
examples.translation: 雇用很多非法移民的服装厂

meanings.meaning: 文盲的；不识字的；没受教育的

examples.text: A large percentage of the population is illiterate.
examples.translation: 文盲人口占有相当高的比例。

examples.text: ...an educational centre for illiterates.
examples.translation: 扫盲中心

examples.text: Many senior managers are technologically illiterate.
examples.translation: 许多高级经理都对技术知之甚少。

examples.text: If your child shows any signs of illness, take her to the doctor...
examples.translation: 如果您的孩子出现任何患病症状,带她去看医生。

examples.text: Mental illness is still a taboo subject.
examples.translation: 精神疾病仍然是禁忌话题。

examples.text: She returned to her family home to recover from an illness.
examples.translation: 她回家养病来了。

meanings.meaning: 阐明，说明；照亮；使灿烂；用灯装饰

examples.text: No streetlights illuminated the street...
examples.translation: 这条街上没有照明的路灯。

examples.text: The black sky was illuminated by forked lightning.
examples.translation: 叉状的闪电照亮了黑沉沉的天空。

examples.text: They use games and drawings to illuminate their subject.
examples.translation: 他们用游戏和图画来阐明他们的主题。

examples.text: His autobiography provides an illuminating insight into his mind.
examples.translation: 他的自传可以让读者深入洞察他的精神世界。

meanings.meaning: 幻觉，错觉；错误的观念或信仰

examples.text: Do not have any illusions that an industrial tribunal will right all employment wrongs...
examples.translation: 不要幻想一个劳资仲裁法庭能纠正所有的雇佣不公现象。

examples.text: No one really has any illusions about winning the war.
examples.translation: 没有人幻想能赢得这场战争。

examples.text: Floor-to-ceiling windows can give the illusion of extra height...
examples.translation: 从地板直抵天花板的窗子会给人以高出实际距离的幻觉。

examples.text: This eerie calm is an illusion.
examples.translation: 这种怪诞的平静是一种假象。

examples.text: The example of the United States illustrates this point...
examples.translation: 美国的例子证明了这一点。

examples.text: This change is neatly illustrated by what has happened to the Arab League...
examples.translation: 这种变化鲜明地体现在阿拉伯联盟所发生的事件上。

examples.text: The incident graphically illustrates how parlous their position is...
examples.translation: 这一事件生动地证明了他们目前的地位多么岌岌可危。

examples.text: The case also illustrates that some women are now trying to fight back.
examples.translation: 这一事件也说明现在一些妇女正试图反击。

examples.text: Let me give another example to illustrate this difficult point...
examples.translation: 我再举个例子来说明这个难点。

examples.text: Throughout, she illustrates her analysis with excerpts from discussions.
examples.translation: 自始至终,她摘引讨论内容来阐明她的分析。

examples.text: Here, by way of illustration, are some extracts from our new catalogue.
examples.translation: 这里引为例证的是我们新目录的部分摘录。

examples.text: She went on to art school and is now illustrating a book...
examples.translation: 她后来读了艺术学校,现在正在为一本书画插图。

examples.text: He has illustrated the book with black-and-white photographs.
examples.translation: 他为那本书配了一些黑白照片插图。

examples.text: The book is beautifully illustrated throughout.
examples.translation: 这本书从头到尾都有精美的插图。

examples.text: ...the world of children's book illustration.
examples.translation: 儿童图书插图世界

examples.text: ...a perfect illustration of the way Britain absorbs and adapts external influences.
examples.translation: 英国吸收借鉴外来影响的绝好例证

examples.text: She looked like a princess in a nineteenth-century illustration.
examples.translation: 她看起来像19世纪插图读物中的公主。

examples.text: The image of art theft as a gentleman's crime is outdated...
examples.translation: 把盗窃艺术品看作是一种绅士犯罪的观念已经过时了。

examples.text: The words 'Cote d'Azur' conjure up images of sunny days in Mediterranean cafes.
examples.translation: Cote d'Azur (蓝色海岸)这个词让人联想到地中海咖啡馆阳光明媚的日子。

examples.text: The Prime Minister knows that his personal image is his greatest political asset...
examples.translation: 总理知道他的个人形象是他最重要的政治资产。

examples.text: He has cultivated the image of an elder statesman...
examples.translation: 他已树立起一个政界元老的形象。

examples.text: The tobacco industry has been trying to improve its image.
examples.translation: 烟草行业一直在试图改善其形象。

examples.text: ...photographic images of young children...
examples.translation: 小孩子们的照片

examples.text: A computer in the machine creates an image on the screen.
examples.translation: 机器上的计算机在屏幕上产生了影像。

examples.text: The natural images in the poem are meant to be suggestive of realities beyond themselves.
examples.translation: 诗中描绘的自然景象意在让人联想到景象以外的现实。

examples.text: Marianne's son was the image of his father.
examples.translation: 玛丽安娜的儿子长得酷似他父亲。

meanings.meaning: 虚构的，假想的；想像的；虚数的

examples.text: Lots of children have imaginary friends.
examples.translation: 许多孩子都会凭空想象一些朋友。

examples.text: ...creating an imaginary world.
examples.translation: 创造一个虚构的世界

meanings.meaning: [心理] 想象力；空想；幻想物

examples.text: Antonia is a woman with a vivid imagination...
examples.translation: 安东尼娅是个想象力丰富的女人。

examples.text: Alistair had a logical mind, and little imagination...
examples.translation: 阿利斯泰尔逻辑思维能力很强,但缺乏想象力。

examples.text: The Government approach displays a lack of imagination.
examples.translation: 政府的方案显得缺乏想象力。

examples.text: Long before I ever went there, Africa was alive in my imagination.
examples.translation: 早在我真正踏足之前很久,非洲就已在我的脑海中活灵活现了。

examples.text: Italian football captured the imagination of the nation last season.
examples.translation: 上个赛季意大利足球吸引了全国上下的注意。

examples.text: Their films are exciting and really stretch the imagination.
examples.translation: 他们的电影非常精彩且发人深省。

meanings.meaning: 虚构的；富于想像的；有创造力的

examples.text: ...an imaginative writer.
examples.translation: 想象力丰富的作家

examples.text: ...hundreds of cooking ideas and imaginative recipes...
examples.translation: 成百上千个烹饪点子和富有创意的食谱

examples.text: They should adopt a more imaginative approach and investigate alternative uses for their property.
examples.translation: 他们应该采用一种更有想象力的方式来为他们的财产找到另外的用途。

examples.text: The hotel is decorated imaginatively and attractively.
examples.translation: 宾馆装修别具一格,赏心悦目。

examples.text: He could not imagine a more peaceful scene...
examples.translation: 他想象不出比这更祥和的景象。

examples.text: She couldn't imagine living in a place like that...
examples.translation: 她无法想象住在那样一个地方。

examples.text: Can you imagine how she must have felt when Mary Brent turned up with me in tow?...
examples.translation: 你能想象得到她看见我和玛丽·布伦特出双入对时有何感受吗？

examples.text: Imagine you're lying on a beach, listening to the steady rhythm of waves lapping the shore...
examples.translation: 想象一下你正躺在海滩上,倾听海浪有节奏地轻轻拍打海岸的声音。

examples.text: I can't imagine you being unfair to anyone, Leigh.
examples.translation: 利,我想象不出你会对谁不公正。

examples.text: I imagine you're referring to Jean-Paul Sartre...
examples.translation: 我猜你说的是让－保罗·萨特。

examples.text: We tend to imagine that the Victorians were very prim and proper...
examples.translation: 我们往往认为维多利亚时代的人们都一本正经,谨言慎行。

examples.text: 'Was he meeting someone?' — 'I imagine so.'
examples.translation: “他在和谁约会吗？”——“我猜是的。”

examples.text: I realised that I must have imagined the whole thing.
examples.translation: 我意识到大概整件事都是我臆想出来的。

examples.text: ...a genuine German musical which does not try to imitate the American model.
examples.translation: 不刻意模仿美国模式的真正的德国音乐剧

examples.text: ...a precedent which may be imitated by other activists in the future.
examples.translation: 将来可能会被其他激进分子仿效的先例

examples.text: Clarence screws up his face and imitates the Colonel again.
examples.translation: 克拉伦斯又板起面孔,模仿起上校来。

examples.text: ...the most accurate imitation of Chinese architecture in Europe.
examples.translation: 全欧洲最逼真的仿中国样式的建筑

examples.text: They discussed important issues in imitation of their elders...
examples.translation: 他们模仿长辈的口气讨论重要问题。

examples.text: Molly learned her golf by imitation.
examples.translation: 莫莉通过模仿学会了打高尔夫球。

examples.text: ...a complete set of Dickens bound in imitation leather.
examples.translation: 一套仿皮本的狄更斯全集

examples.text: He gave his imitation of Queen Elizabeth's royal wave...
examples.translation: 他模仿伊丽莎白女王挥手致意。

examples.text: I could do a pretty good imitation of him.
examples.translation: 我可以惟妙惟肖地学他的样子。

meanings.meaning: 立即的；直接的；最接近的

examples.text: These tragic incidents have had an immediate effect...
examples.translation: 这些悲剧性事件造成的后果即刻显现。

examples.text: My immediate reaction was just disgust.
examples.translation: 我当时的第一反应就是反感。

examples.text: Relief agencies say the immediate problem is not a lack of food, but transportation.
examples.translation: 救援机构称最紧迫的问题不是食物匮乏,而是运输不畅。

examples.text: In the immediate aftermath of the riots, a mood of hope and reconciliation sprang up...
examples.translation: 暴乱过后紧接着出现了期待未来与盼望和解的气氛。

examples.text: His immediate superior, General Geichenko, had singled him out for special mention.
examples.translation: 他的直接上级盖琴科将军特别提到了他。

examples.text: Only a handful had returned to work in the immediate vicinity...
examples.translation: 仅有几个人回到临近地区工作。

examples.text: I was seated at Sauter's immediate left.
examples.translation: 我紧挨着索特左手边坐着。

examples.text: The presence of his immediate family is obviously having a calming effect on him.
examples.translation: 他的直系亲属都在场,这显然起到了让他镇定的作用。

meanings.meaning: 巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的

examples.text: ...an immense cloud of smoke...
examples.translation: 大片的烟云

examples.text: With immense relief I stopped running.
examples.translation: 我长长地松了一口气，停止了奔跑。

examples.text: The immensity of the universe is difficult to grasp.
examples.translation: 宇宙的浩瀚难以捉摸。

examples.text: Since then I've lived alone and immersed myself in my career.
examples.translation: 自那以后,我一直一个人生活,全身心投入我的事业当中。

examples.text: He's really becoming immersed in his work.
examples.translation: 他真的开始专心埋头于工作。

examples.text: The electrodes are immersed in liquid.
examples.translation: 电极浸没在液体中。

examples.text: ...illegal immigrants.
examples.translation: 非法移民

examples.text: ...immigrant visas.
examples.translation: 移民签证

examples.text: This blood test will show whether or not you're immune to the disease...
examples.translation: 这个血检会显示你是否对这种疾病具有免疫力。

examples.text: Most adults are immune to Rubella.
examples.translation: 大多数成人对风疹具有免疫力。

examples.text: Birds in outside cages develop immunity to airborne bacteria.
examples.translation: 养在户外笼子里的鸟会对空气传播的细菌产生免疫力。

examples.text: It is hoped the procedure will trigger an immune response that will wipe out HIV-infected cells while leaving non-infected cells unharmed.
examples.translation: 希望这一治疗会激发免疫反应,清除感染了艾滋病病毒的细胞，同时又不损伤未感染细胞。

examples.text: Whilst Marc did gradually harden himself to the poverty, he did not become immune to the sight of death...
examples.translation: 尽管马克逐渐对贫困现象无动于衷,但他对于死亡的惨象还是不免动容。

examples.text: Football is not immune to economic recession.
examples.translation: 足球不可能不受到经济衰退的影响。

examples.text: Members of the Bundestag are immune from prosecution for corruption...
examples.translation: 德国联邦议院的成员可免受贪腐罪的起诉。

examples.text: No one is immune from scandal.
examples.translation: 谁都难免会有丑闻。

examples.text: The police are offering immunity to witnesses.
examples.translation: 警方对证人将免予起诉。

examples.text: They say they expect the meeting to have a marked impact on the future of the country...
examples.translation: 他们称他们预期会议对国家的未来会产生显著影响。

examples.text: The major impact of this epidemic worldwide is yet to come...
examples.translation: 这种传染病在世界范围内的重大影响还未完全显现。

examples.text: When an executive comes into a new job, he wants to quickly make an impact.
examples.translation: 一个新主管刚上任时,会希望尽快树立威信。

examples.text: The plane is destroyed, a complete wreck: the pilot must have died on impact...
examples.translation: 飞机遭到毁坏,完全成了一堆残骸：飞行员肯定死于撞击。

examples.text: A running track should be capable of absorbing the impact of a runner's foot landing on it.
examples.translation: 跑道应该能够吸收奔跑者踩踏地面时产生的撞击力。

examples.text: Such schemes mean little unless they impact on people.
examples.translation: 这些计划没什么意义,除非它们对人民产生影响。

examples.text: That, in turn would increase pressure for higher wages and that, in turn, would impact on inflation and competition.
examples.translation: 那样就会增加工资上涨的压力,而那样又会对通货膨胀和竞争产生影响。

examples.text: ...the potential for women to impact the political process.
examples.translation: 女性影响政治进程的潜力

examples.text: Somebody who is a foreign investor and more sensitive about the public profile will be more impacted by that pressure.
examples.translation: 对公众形象较注意的外国投资者会更多地受到那种压力的影响。

examples.text: ...the sharp tinkle of metal impacting on stone...
examples.translation: 金属撞击石头发出的刺耳叮当声

examples.text: According to the air force, the missile merely impacted with the ground prematurely...
examples.translation: 根据空军提供的消息，导弹只是提前撞向了地面。

examples.text: When a large object impacts the Earth, it makes a crater.
examples.translation: 当巨大物体撞击地球时,就会产生凹坑。

examples.text: Consumption of alcohol impairs your ability to drive a car or operate machinery...
examples.translation: 饮酒会削弱你驾驶汽车或操控机器的能力。

examples.text: His movements were painfully impaired by arthritis.
examples.translation: 他行动不便，深受关节炎之苦。

examples.text: The blast left him with permanently impaired hearing.
examples.translation: 爆炸造成他的听力永久性损伤。

meanings.meaning: 给予（尤指抽象事物），传授；告知，透露

examples.text: The ability to impart knowledge and command respect is the essential qualification for teachers...
examples.translation: 具备传授知识并赢得尊敬的能力是对教师的基本要求。

examples.text: I am about to impart knowledge to you that you will never forget.
examples.translation: 我会向你传授让你终生牢记的知识。

examples.text: She managed to impart great elegance to the unpretentious dress she was wearing...
examples.translation: 她使自己朴素的衣着看起来也十分优雅。

examples.text: His production of Harold Pinter's play fails to impart a sense of excitement or danger.
examples.translation: 他所执导的哈罗德·品特的剧作没能表现出紧张、危险感。

examples.text: He is impatient as the first hour passes and then another...
examples.translation: 一个小时、两个小时过去了,他不耐烦了。

examples.text: The big clubs are becoming increasingly impatient at the rate of progress.
examples.translation: 大牌俱乐部对缓慢的进展越来越不耐烦了。

examples.text: People have been waiting impatiently for a chance to improve the situation.
examples.translation: 人们一直在焦急地等待使形势出现转机的机会。

examples.text: There is considerable impatience with the slow pace of political change...
examples.translation: 政治变革的缓慢步伐已令很多人失去耐心。

examples.text: Impatience is growing after three days in which nothing has been achieved.
examples.translation: 3 天没有任何进展,烦躁情绪见长。

examples.text: Beware of being too impatient with others...
examples.translation: 注意不要对人不耐烦。

examples.text: He threw it aside with an impatient gesture and another oath and walked off.
examples.translation: 他不耐烦地把它扔到一边,又骂了一句,然后走开了。

examples.text: 'Come on, David,' Harry said impatiently.
examples.translation: “戴维,快点!”哈里不耐烦地说。

examples.text: There was a hint of impatience in his tone.
examples.translation: 他的语气中透出些不耐烦。

examples.text: He was impatient to get home...
examples.translation: 他迫不及待想要回家。

examples.text: They are impatient for jobs and security.
examples.translation: 他们渴望得到工作，获取安全感。

examples.text: She showed impatience to continue the climb.
examples.translation: 她迫不及待地想要继续攀登。

meanings.meaning: 必要的，不可避免的；紧急的；命令的，专横的；势在必行的；[语]祈使的
必要的事；命令；需要；规则；[语]祈使语气

examples.text: It was imperative that he act as naturally as possible...
examples.translation: 最重要的是他要做到尽可能自然。

examples.text: That's why it is imperative to know what your rights are at such a time...
examples.translation: 这就是为什么你有必要在这个时候知道你的权利有哪些。

examples.text: The events of the past few days make it imperative for her to act.
examples.translation: 过去这几天发生的事迫使她不得不立即行动。

examples.text: The most important political imperative is to limit the number of US casualties.
examples.translation: 现在的头等政治大事就是要控制美国人的伤亡人数。

examples.text: ...the needs of those unable to respond to the imperatives of an enterprise culture.
examples.translation: 那些不能积极响应企业文化核心要求的人的需求

meanings.meaning: 帝国的；皇帝的；至高无上的；威严的

examples.text: ...the Imperial Palace in Tokyo...
examples.translation: 东京的皇宫

examples.text: They executed Russia's imperial family in 1918.
examples.translation: 他们 1918 年处死了俄国沙皇皇族。

examples.text: This decision will give renewed impetus to the economic regeneration of east London...
examples.translation: 这一决定会给东伦敦的经济复苏带来新的推动力。

examples.text: She was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
examples.translation: 她躁动不安,需要为自己的才华找到新的突破口。

examples.text: The government promised to implement a new system to control financial loan institutions...
examples.translation: 政府许诺实施新的制度来控制金融贷款机构。

examples.text: The report sets out strict inspection procedures to ensure that the recommendations are properly implemented.
examples.translation: 报告规定了严格的检查程序，以确保建议得到切实执行。

examples.text: Very little has been achieved in the implementation of the peace agreement signed last January.
examples.translation: 去年 1 月签署的和平协议基本上没有得到贯彻执行。

examples.text: ...knives and other useful implements.
examples.translation: 刀子和其他有用工具

examples.text: ...writing implements.
examples.translation: 书写用具

meanings.meaning: 含义；暗示；牵连，卷入；可能的结果，影响

examples.text: The Attorney General was aware of the political implications of his decision to prosecute...
examples.translation: 司法部长很清楚他决定起诉可能引发的政治后果。

examples.text: The low level of current investment has serious implications for future economic growth.
examples.translation: 当前低迷的投资水平会对未来的经济增长产生严重影响。

examples.text: The implication was obvious: vote for us or it will be very embarrassing for you...
examples.translation: 弦外之音很明显：投票给我们,否则你会非常难堪。

examples.text: The implication that marital infidelity enhances a leader's credibility is preposterous.
examples.translation: 婚姻不忠会提升领导人可信度的暗示荒谬之极。

examples.text: His authority and, by implication, that of his management team is under threat.
examples.translation: 他的权威,同时也意味着他整个管理团队的权威，正面临着威胁。

examples.text: This is seen as an implicit warning not to continue with military action...
examples.translation: 这被视为一个停止军事行动的含蓄警告。

examples.text: Branagh says that it was his intention to make explicit in the film what was only implicit in the play.
examples.translation: 布莱纳说他的用意是将剧本中的隐晦含意在电影中清晰明白地表现出来。

examples.text: The jury implicitly criticised the government by their verdict.
examples.translation: 陪审团通过裁决间接地批评了政府。

examples.text: ...the delays implicit in formal council meetings...
examples.translation: 正式的政务会议所惯有的耽搁延迟

examples.text: Try and learn from the lessons implicit in the failure of your marriage.
examples.translation: 要努力从失败婚姻中吸取教训。

examples.text: He had implicit faith in the noble intentions of the Emperor.
examples.translation: 他对皇帝的高尚意图深信不疑。

examples.text: I trust him implicitly.
examples.translation: 我绝对信任他。

examples.text: 'Are you implying that I have something to do with those attacks?' she asked coldly...
examples.translation: “你在暗示我和那些袭击有关吗？”她冷冷地问。

examples.text: She felt undermined by the implied criticism.
examples.translation: 她觉得这一含沙射影的批评对自己造成了不利影响。

examples.text: Exports in June rose 1.5%, implying that the economy was stronger than many investors had realized...
examples.translation: 6 月份出口上升 1.5%,表明经济比许多投资者所认为的更要坚挺。

examples.text: A 'frontier-free' Europe implies a greatly increased market for all economic operators.
examples.translation: “无国界的”欧洲对所有经营者来说都意味着一个大大扩展了的市场。

meanings.meaning: 进口，进口货；输入；意思，含义；重要性

examples.text: Britain last year spent nearly £5000 million more on importing food than selling abroad...
examples.translation: 去年英国的进口食品支出比其出口食品收入多出近50亿英镑。

examples.text: To import from Russia, a Ukrainian firm needs Russian roubles.
examples.translation: 要从俄罗斯进口商品,乌克兰公司就需要俄罗斯卢布。

examples.text: ...imported goods from Mexico and India.
examples.translation: 自墨西哥和印度进口的货物

examples.text: Germany, however, insists on restrictions on the import of Polish coal...
examples.translation: 但是德国坚持对进口波兰煤炭加以限制。

examples.text: On July 3rd the government slashed import duties on cars.
examples.translation: 7月3号,政府大幅度降低了汽车进口税。

examples.text: ...restrictions concerning the importation of birds.

examples.translation: 他们被指望去完成难以完成的任务。

examples.translation: 比利·沙利文给我留下的印象是他是个很不错的人。

examples.translation: 他显然以为一场军事政变正在酝酿中。

examples.text: ...the ins and outs of high finance...
examples.translation: 大宗金融交易的详情

examples.text: Dietary experts can advise on the ins and outs of dieting.
examples.translation: 饮食专家可以对日常饮食的方方面面提出建议。

meanings.meaning: 发生率；影响；[光] 入射；影响范围

examples.text: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
examples.translation: 乳腺癌的发病率随年龄增长而递增。

examples.text: ...the high incidence of child mortality.
examples.translation: 儿童高死亡率

examples.text: ...a couple of isolated incidences.
examples.translation: 几起孤立的病例

meanings.meaning: [光] 入射的；附带的；易发生的，伴随而来的

examples.text: These incidents were the latest in a series of disputes between the two nations...
examples.translation: 这些事件是两国一系列争端中最近发生的几起。

examples.text: 26 people have been killed in a dramatic shooting incident...
examples.translation: 已有 26 人在一起恶性枪击事件中被打死。

examples.text: The voting went ahead without incident.
examples.translation: 投票顺利进行。

examples.text: 'I didn't ask you to come. Incidentally, why have you come?'
examples.translation: “我没有叫你来。顺便问一下,你为什么过来?”

examples.text: The tower, incidentally, dates from the twelfth century.
examples.translation: 那座塔,顺便提一下,可以追溯到 12 世纪。

examples.text: The letter mentioned my great-aunt and uncle only incidentally.
examples.translation: 信中仅附带提到了我的姑奶奶和叔叔。

examples.text: I incline to the view that he is right.
examples.translation: 我倾向于认为他是正确的。

examples.text: ...the factors which incline us towards particular beliefs...
examples.translation: 使我们倾向于相信某些特定信仰的因素

examples.text: Many end up as team leaders, which inclines them to co-operate with the bosses...
examples.translation: 很多人最后成为团队领袖,这使得他们易于和上司合作。

examples.text: Those who fail incline to blame the world for their failure.
examples.translation: 那些失败者往往将他们的失败归咎于社会。

examples.text: Jack inclined his head very slightly.
examples.translation: 杰克轻轻点了点头。

examples.text: He came to a halt at the edge of a steep incline.
examples.translation: 他在一个陡坡边上停住了。

examples.text: A good British breakfast always includes sausages...
examples.translation: 一顿丰盛的英式早餐总会包括香肠。

examples.text: The trip has been extended to include a few other events...
examples.translation: 旅程被延长，其他几项活动也被包括进来。

examples.text: The list includes many British internationals.
examples.translation: 名单中包括了许多英国国际级选手。

examples.text: I had worked hard to be included in a project like this...
examples.translation: 为参与这样的项目,我过去一直努力工作。

examples.text: The President is expected to include this idea in his education plan.
examples.translation: 人们期望总统把这一意见列入他的教育计划当中。

examples.text: ...all prices are inclusive of delivery.
examples.translation: 所有的价格都包括运费在内。

examples.text: ...an inclusive price of £32.90.
examples.translation: 全包价为 32.90 英镑

examples.text: ...a special introductory offer of £5,995 fully inclusive.
examples.translation: 囊括全部费用的特别试销价 5,995 英镑

examples.text: Training will commence on 5 October, running from Tuesday to Saturday inclusive.
examples.translation: 培训将于 10 月 5 日开始,从星期二(含)到星期六(含)。

examples.text: ...£20 for senior citizens and children (5 to 16 inclusive).
examples.translation: 老人与儿童(5 至 16 岁，包含 5 岁和 16 岁)价格为20英镑

examples.text: The academy is far more inclusive now than it used to be.
examples.translation: 该学会的包容性比过去强了很多。

examples.text: Many families on low incomes will be unable to afford to buy their own home...
examples.translation: 许多低收入家庭将会买不起自己的房子。

examples.text: To cover its costs, the company will need an annual income of £5 million...
examples.translation: 公司年收入需要达到500万英镑才能收支平衡。

examples.text: Over a third of their income comes from comedy videos.
examples.translation: 他们收入的1/3 强来自于喜剧片。

meanings.meaning: 合并的；一体化的；组成公司的

examples.text: The new cars will incorporate a number of major improvements.
examples.translation: 新款汽车会有若干重大改进。

examples.text: The agreement would allow the rebels to be incorporated into a new national police force...
examples.translation: 协议将允许把叛军收编入一支新的国家警备部队。

examples.text: The party vowed to incorporate environmental considerations into all its policies.
examples.translation: 该党宣誓要把环境因素纳入它所有的政策当中。

examples.text: ...the incorporation of Piedmont Airlines and PSA into US Air.
examples.translation: 皮埃蒙特航空公司和太平洋西南航空公司并入全美航空公司

examples.text: The population continues to increase...
examples.translation: 人口继续增长。

examples.text: Japan's industrial output increased by 2%...
examples.translation: 日本工业产量增长了2%。

examples.text: The company has increased the price of its cars...
examples.translation: 公司已经提高了汽车价格。

examples.text: The increased investment will help stabilise the economy...
examples.translation: 增加的投资将有助于经济的稳定。

examples.text: We are experiencing an increasing number of problems.
examples.translation: 我们正遇到越来越多的问题。

examples.text: ...a sharp increase in productivity...
examples.translation: 生产率的大幅提高

examples.text: He called for an increase of 1p on income tax.
examples.translation: 他呼吁所得税提高 1 便士。

examples.text: ...an increase of violence along the border.
examples.translation: 边境线上暴力事件的增加

examples.text: Crime is on the increase.
examples.translation: 犯罪活动在不断增多。

examples.text: He was finding it increasingly difficult to make decisions...
examples.translation: 他发现越来越难以作出决定。

examples.text: There is an increasingly popular alternative...
examples.translation: 有了越来越受欢迎的替代品。

examples.text: The U.S. has increasingly relied on Japanese capital...
examples.translation: 美国越来越依赖日本的资本。

examples.text: Increasingly, their goals have become more radical.
examples.translation: 他们的目标变得越来越激进。

examples.text: The wildflowers will be incredible after this rain...
examples.translation: 这场雨过后,野花会变得美不胜收。

examples.text: Thanks for taking me, I had an incredible time...
examples.translation: 谢谢你带我去,我玩得非常开心。

examples.text: You're always an incredible help on these cases.
examples.translation: 在这些事情上你一直是个难得的好帮手。

examples.text: Their father was incredibly good-looking.
examples.translation: 他们的父亲十分英俊。

examples.text: It seemed incredible that people would still want to play football during a war...
examples.translation: 在战时人们仍然想踢足球,这似乎不可思议。

examples.text: We should not dismiss as lies the incredible stories that children may tell us.
examples.translation: 我们不应把孩子们告诉我们的一些不可思议的故事当成谎话而不予理睬。

examples.text: Incredibly, some people don't like the name.
examples.translation: 不可思议的是,有些人不喜欢这个名字。

examples.text: We import an incredible amount of cheese from the Continent...
examples.translation: 我们从欧洲大陆进口数量惊人的奶酪。
