examples.text: There was an incredible din...
examples.translation: 声音异常嘈杂。

examples.text: It's incredible how much Francesca wants her father's approval...
examples.translation: 你想象不到弗朗西丝卡多么希望得到父亲的同意。

examples.text: His panic was incredible.
examples.translation: 他惊恐万分。

examples.text: It was incredibly hard work.
examples.translation: 那是个极其艰苦的工作。

examples.text: The government had also incurred huge debts...
examples.translation: 政府也已负债累累。

examples.text: She falls in love and incurs the wrath of her father.
examples.translation: 她恋爱了,这引起了父亲的愤怒。

examples.text: ...the terrible damage incurred during the past decade.
examples.translation: 在过去 10 年间遭受的严重损伤

meanings.meaning: 真的（表示惊讶、怀疑、讽刺等）

examples.text: Later, he admitted that the payments had indeed been made...
examples.translation: 后来,他承认确实付过款了。

examples.text: He did indeed keep important documents inside his hat...
examples.translation: 他确实把重要文件放在了他的帽子里。

examples.text: 'Did you know him?' — 'I did indeed.'...
examples.translation: “你认识他吗?”——“当然。”

examples.text: 'Know what I mean?' — 'Indeed I do.'...
examples.translation: “明白我的意思吗?”——“当然明白了。”

examples.text: 'Isn't it a gorgeous day, Father?' — 'Yes, indeed!'...
examples.translation: “爸爸，今天天气是不是很棒?”——“是的,确实很棒！”

examples.text: 'That's a topic which has come to the fore very much recently.' — 'Indeed.'
examples.translation: “那是最近才受到众人关注的一个话题。”——“确实如此。”

examples.text: We have nothing against diversity; indeed, we want more of it...
examples.translation: 我们一点都不抵触多样化;实际上,我们需要多样性更丰富一些。

examples.text: When we asked to see more we were refused. Indeed we were escorted away by men with guns.
examples.translation: 当我们要求进一步参观时却被拒绝了。实际上，我们是被一些带枪的人护送离开的。

examples.text: The engine began to sound very loud indeed...
examples.translation: 发动机开始发出极大的声响。

examples.text: The wine was very good indeed...
examples.translation: 红酒确实非常好。

examples.text: Of course, these occasions are rare indeed.
examples.translation: 当然,这样的场合实在稀少。

examples.text: 'Now where are the real villains?' — 'Where indeed?'...
examples.translation: “那么那些真正的恶棍在哪里？”——“是啊，到底在哪里？”

examples.text: 'And what do we do here?' — 'What, indeed?'
examples.translation: “我们在这里做什么呢?”——“是啊，到底做什么?”

examples.text: In 1816, Argentina declared its independence from Spain.
examples.translation: 1816年,阿根廷宣布脱离西班牙正式独立。

examples.text: ...the country's first elections since independence in 1962.
examples.translation: 该国自 1962 年独立以来的首次选举

examples.text: He was afraid of losing his independence.
examples.translation: 他害怕失去自己的独立性。

examples.text: ...a woman's independence, capability, and power.
examples.translation: 一个女人的独立、能力与权力

meanings.meaning: 独立的；单独的；无党派的；不受约束的

examples.text: Your questions should be independent of each other...
examples.translation: 你的问题应该彼此无关。

examples.text: We're going independent from the university and setting up our own group...
examples.translation: 我们马上就将从大学分离出去,成立我们自己的团体。

examples.text: Two independent studies have been carried out.
examples.translation: 两项彼此独立的研究已在进行中。

examples.text: ...several people working independently in different areas of the world...
examples.translation: 在世界的不同地区各自独立展开工作的几个人

examples.text: The commission will operate independently of ministers.
examples.translation: 委员会将独立运作，不受各部部长管辖。

examples.text: Phil was now much more independent of his parents...
examples.translation: 菲尔现在不那么依赖父母了。

examples.text: She would like to be financially independent...
examples.translation: 她希望在经济上能够自立。

examples.text: There were benefits to being a single independent woman.
examples.translation: 做一个单身、自立的女性好处多多。

examples.text: We aim to help disabled students to live and study independently.
examples.translation: 我们旨在帮助残疾学生尽可能独立地生活和学习。

examples.text: ...the independently-minded females of the Nineties...
examples.translation: 90 年代思想独立的女性

examples.text: He is independently wealthy.
examples.translation: 他靠自己的努力而致富。

examples.text: ...a fully independent state...
examples.translation: 一个完全独立的国家

examples.text: Papua New Guinea became independent from Australia in 1975.
examples.translation: 巴布亚新几内亚 1975 年脱离澳大利亚正式独立。

examples.text: ...an independent television station.
examples.translation: 独立电视台

examples.text: ...the Office of Government Ethics, an independent agency.
examples.translation: 政风处,一个独立的机构

examples.text: ...a fully independent, not-for-profit organisation.
examples.translation: 一个完全独立的非营利组织

examples.text: He taught chemistry at a leading independent school.
examples.translation: 他在一所重点私立中学教化学。

examples.text: The government ordered an independent inquiry into the affair...
examples.translation: 政府下令对该事件进行独立调查。

examples.text: An independent opinion poll published today shows growing discontent with the government.
examples.translation: 今天发表的一项独立民意测验表明民众对政府的不满正与日俱增。

examples.text: There's been a late surge of support for an independent candidate.
examples.translation: 最近一位无党派候选人的支持率迅速上升。

examples.text: ...the most powerful independent politician in France.
examples.translation: 法国最有影响力的无党派政治家

examples.text: ...Mr Brown has not ruled out the possibility of standing as an independent.
examples.translation: 布朗先生不排除以无党派人士身份参加竞选的可能。

examples.text: ...the UK retail price index.
examples.translation: 英国零售价格指数

examples.text: ...economic indices.
examples.translation: 经济指数

examples.text: Curiously, the word 'gay' does not occur in the index...
examples.translation: 奇怪的是,gay这个词没有出现在索引当中。

examples.text: There's even a special subject index.
examples.translation: 甚至有一个专项索引。

examples.text: This vast archive has been indexed and made accessible to researchers...
examples.translation: 这个存量巨大的档案室的所有文件都已编了索引,可供研究人员使用。

examples.text: Painters and sculptors are indexed separately...
examples.translation: 画家和雕刻家被分开，分别做了索引。

examples.text: She's indexed the book by author, by age, and by illustrator.
examples.translation: 她根据作者、年龄和插图画家分别为该书编了索引。

examples.text: Minimum pensions and wages are to be indexed to inflation.
examples.translation: 最低养老金和最低工资要与通货膨胀挂钩。

examples.text: Weeds are an index to the character of the soil.
examples.translation: 杂草是反映土壤特征的一个指标。

examples.text: A survey of retired people has indicated that most are independent and enjoying life...
examples.translation: 对退休人员的调查表明，大部分人都自食其力,享受生活。

examples.text: Our vote today indicates a change in United States policy...
examples.translation: 我们今天的选举表明了美国政策的一种变化。

examples.text: This indicates whether remedies are suitable for children.
examples.translation: 由此可以看出治疗方法是否适合儿童。

examples.text: Mr Rivers has indicated that he may resign...
examples.translation: 里弗斯先生暗示他可能会辞职。

examples.text: U.S. authorities have not yet indicated their monetary policy plans.
examples.translation: 美国当局尚未透露他们的货币政策计划。

examples.text: He indicated a chair. 'Sit down.'
examples.translation: 他指着一把椅子说，“坐下。”

examples.text: Pelham moved across to indicate a wall chart.
examples.translation: 佩勒姆走过去指着一张挂图。

examples.text: Dreams can help indicate your true feelings...
examples.translation: 梦可以反映你的真实感情。

examples.text: His language indicates a poor education.
examples.translation: 他的言语反映出他没受过多少教育。

examples.text: The needles that indicate your height are at the top right-hand corner...
examples.translation: 显示你身高的指针在右上角。

examples.text: The temperature gauge indicated that it was boiling.
examples.translation: 温度计显示它在沸腾。

examples.text: He told us when to indicate and when to change gear.
examples.translation: 他告诉我们何时打转向灯、何时换挡。

examples.text: All the indications are that we are going to receive reasonable support from abroad...
examples.translation: 所有迹象都表明，我们将从国外获得有力支持。

examples.text: He gave no indication that he was ready to compromise.
examples.translation: 他没有妥协的意思。

meanings.meaning: 陈述语气；陈述语气的动词形式

examples.text: The result was indicative of a strong retail market...
examples.translation: 结果表明零售业市场繁荣。

examples.text: Often physical appearance is indicative of how a person feels.
examples.translation: 一个人的外表常能反映出他的感受。

meanings.meaning: 漠不关心的；无关紧要的；中性的，中立的

examples.text: People have become indifferent to the suffering of others.
examples.translation: 人们对别人的痛苦已经变得无动于衷。

examples.text: ...the row over the police's indifferent attitude to the killings.
examples.translation: 严厉谴责警方对杀戮无动于衷的态度

examples.text: 'Not that it matters,' said Tench indifferently.
examples.translation: “那并不要紧,”坦奇漠然地说。

examples.text: She had starred in several very indifferent movies...
examples.translation: 她主演过几部表现非常一般的电影。

examples.text: Much of the food we eat is of very poor or indifferent quality.
examples.translation: 我们吃的许多食物质量要么很差,要么很一般。

examples.text: ...an eight-year-old girl who reads tolerably and writes indifferently.
examples.translation: 阅读尚可、写作很一般的 8 岁女孩

examples.text: He is indignant at suggestions that they were secret agents...
examples.translation: 有人暗示他们可能是特务,这让他非常气愤。

examples.text: MPs were indignant that the government had not consulted them...
examples.translation: 政府没有事先征求他们的意见,下院议员们感到很愤怒。

examples.text: Sheena gave her an indignant look.
examples.translation: 希娜愤怒地看了她一眼。

examples.text: 'That is not true,' Erica said indignantly.
examples.translation: “那不是真的,”埃丽卡愤怒地说。

examples.text: She was filled with indignation at the conditions under which miners were forced to work...
examples.translation: 矿工们被迫在如此恶劣的条件下工作,她感到异常愤怒。

examples.text: No wonder he could hardly contain his indignation.
examples.translation: 难怪他几乎抑制不住自己的愤怒。

meanings.meaning: 不可缺少的；绝对必要的；责无旁贷的
不可缺少之物；必不可少的人

examples.text: She was becoming indispensable to him.
examples.translation: 他已变得越来越离不开她了。

examples.text: ...the indispensable guide for any traveller in France.
examples.translation: 在法国对任何游客来说都不可缺少的向导

examples.text: They wait for the group to decide rather than making individual decisions...
examples.translation: 他们等待团体作决定而不是各自作出决定。

examples.text: Aid to individual countries would be linked to progress towards democracy...
examples.translation: 对个别国家的援助会与其民主进程相挂钩。

examples.text: Divide the vegetables among four individual dishes.
examples.translation: 把蔬菜分开盛放在4个单独的盘子里。

examples.text: ...cheeses which come in individually wrapped segments...
examples.translation: 单独包装成块的奶酪

examples.text: There are 96 pieces and they are worth, individually and collectively, a lot of money.
examples.translation: 共有 96 件,它们无论单独一件还是放在一起,都值很多钱。

examples.text: ...anonymous individuals who are doing good things within our community.
examples.translation: 一些在我们社区内做好事却不留名的个人

examples.text: ...the rights and responsibilities of the individual...
examples.translation: 个人的权利和责任

examples.text: A child's awareness of being an individual grows in stages during the pre-school years.
examples.translation: 孩子的个体意识在入学前的几年中逐渐增强。

examples.text: It was really all part of her very individual personality...
examples.translation: 那其实都是她独特个性的表现。

examples.text: The language is highly individual.
examples.translation: 语言非常独特。

examples.text: No smoking in any indoor facilities.
examples.translation: 所有室内场所都不许吸烟。

examples.text: ...an indoor market.
examples.translation: 室内市场

examples.text: ...indoor plants.
examples.translation: 室内植物

examples.text: Doctors said surgery could induce a heart attack.
examples.translation: 医生们说手术有可能引起心脏病发作。

examples.text: ...an economic crisis induced by high oil prices.
examples.translation: 由高油价引发的经济危机

examples.text: I would do anything to induce them to stay...
examples.translation: 我会想尽一切办法劝他们留下来。

examples.text: More than 4,000 teachers were induced to take early retirement.
examples.translation: 4000 多名教师被说服提前退休。

examples.text: He might decide that it is best to induce labour.
examples.translation: 他也许决定最好引产。

examples.text: ...if there are obvious medical reasons for induction.
examples.translation: 如果有明显的医学原因需要进行引产

meanings.meaning: 满足；纵容；使高兴；使沉迷于…

examples.text: Only rarely will she indulge in a glass of wine...
examples.translation: 她只是偶尔才喝杯红酒,让自己享受一下。

examples.text: He returned to Britain so that he could indulge his passion for football...
examples.translation: 他重返英国，为的是可以尽情释放自己对足球的激情。

examples.text: You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune.
examples.translation: 你不必花大把钱就可以好好犒劳一下自己。

examples.text: He did not agree with indulging children.
examples.translation: 他反对纵容娇惯孩子。

meanings.meaning: 工业的，产业的；从事工业的；供工业用的；来自勤劳的

examples.text: ...industrial machinery and equipment.
examples.translation: 工业机械与设备

examples.text: ...a link between industrial chemicals and cancer.
examples.translation: 化工制品与癌症的联系

examples.text: ...ministers from leading western industrial countries.
examples.translation: 西方工业大国的部长们

examples.text: Energy consumption rises as countries industrialise...
examples.translation: 随着各国实现工业化,能源消费增加了。

examples.text: Stalin's methods had industrialized the Russian economy...
examples.translation: 斯大林采取的措施使俄国经济实现了工业化。

examples.text: Britain was the first nation to be industrialised.
examples.translation: 英国是最早实现工业化的国家。

examples.text: Industrialization began early in Spain.
examples.translation: 西班牙很早就开始了工业化。

examples.text: British industry suffers through insufficient investment in research.
examples.translation: 研究投入不足让英国工业深受其害。

examples.text: ...in countries where industry is developing rapidly.
examples.translation: 在工业迅速发展的国家

examples.text: ...the motor vehicle and textile industries.
examples.translation: 汽车业与纺织业

examples.text: ...the Scottish tourist industry.
examples.translation: 苏格兰旅游业

examples.text: Some Afro-Caribbeans are rejecting the whole race relations industry...
examples.translation: 一些加勒比黑人在抵制整个种族关系运动。

examples.text: The multibillion-dollar fitness industry rakes in fat profits from our hunger to look good.
examples.translation: 数十亿美元的健身产业利用我们的爱美之心赚取巨额利润。

examples.text: No one doubted his ability, his industry or his integrity.
examples.translation: 没人怀疑他的能力、勤奋和正直。

meanings.meaning: [力] 惯性；惰性，迟钝；不活动

examples.text: ...her inertia, her lack of energy...
examples.translation: 她的怠惰和缺乏活力

examples.text: This might help you overcome inertia.
examples.translation: 这可能有助于你克服惰性。

examples.text: If the case succeeds, it is inevitable that other trials will follow...
examples.translation: 如果该案胜诉,其他审判必然随之而来。

examples.text: The defeat had inevitable consequences for British policy.
examples.translation: 战败对英国政策不可避免地产生了影响。

examples.text: 'It's just delaying the inevitable,' he said.
examples.translation: “那仅仅会延迟不可避免之事的发生,”他说。

meanings.meaning: 婴儿的；幼稚的；初期的；未成年的

examples.text: ...young mums with infants in prams...
examples.translation: 用婴儿车推着宝宝的年轻妈妈

examples.text: The family were forced to flee with their infant son.
examples.translation: 那家人被迫带着他们尚在襁褓中的儿子逃走了。

examples.text: ...the infant mortality rate in Britain.
examples.translation: 英国的婴儿夭折率

examples.text: You've been my best friend ever since we started in the infants.
examples.translation: 自从我们上幼儿园起，你就是我最好的朋友。

examples.text: ...an infant carrier in the back of a car.
examples.translation: 汽车后部的婴儿座椅

examples.text: The infant company was based in Germany.
examples.translation: 这家新公司总部在德国。

examples.text: ...the infant health service.
examples.translation: 处于初期阶段的公共医疗卫生服务

examples.text: A single mosquito can infect a large number of people.
examples.translation: 一只蚊子就可以感染很多人。

examples.text: ...objects used by an infected person.
examples.translation: 被感染者使用过的物品

examples.text: ...people infected with HIV.
examples.translation: 感染艾滋病病毒的人们

examples.text: ...plants that are resistant to infection.
examples.translation: 对传染病具有抵抗力的植物

examples.text: The birds infect the milk.
examples.translation: 鸟污染了牛奶。

examples.text: ...a virus which is spread mainly by infected blood.
examples.translation: 主要通过被污染的血液传播的病毒

examples.text: For an instant I was infected by her fear...
examples.translation: 有那么一会儿她的恐惧也传染给了我。

examples.text: He thought they might infect others with their bourgeois ideas...
examples.translation: 他认为他们可以用他们的资产阶级思想去影响别人。

examples.text: His urge for revenge would never infect her.
examples.translation: 他的强烈复仇渴望永远不会影响到她。

examples.text: This virus infected thousands of computers within days.
examples.translation: 这种病毒在短短几天内感染了数千台计算机。

meanings.meaning: 传染的；传染性的；易传染的

examples.text: ...infectious diseases such as measles...
examples.translation: 类似麻疹这样的传染病

examples.text: These viruses affect children and are highly infectious.
examples.translation: 这些病毒会侵袭儿童，而且具有很强的传染性。

examples.text: She radiates an infectious enthusiasm for everything she does...
examples.translation: 她做任何事情都充满一种极富感染力的热情。

examples.text: There was a peal of laughter down the phone, which Harry found infectious.
examples.translation: 电话里传来一阵响亮的笑声,哈里也不禁受其感染。

examples.text: I inferred from what she said that you have not been well...
examples.translation: 我从她的话语里推断你身体一直不太好。

examples.text: By measuring the motion of the galaxies in a cluster, astronomers can infer the cluster's mass.
examples.translation: 通过测量星系在一个星系团内的运动,天文学家们可以推定这个星系团的质量。

examples.text: The police inferred that they found her behaviour rather suspicious.
examples.translation: 警方暗示他们发现她行为非常可疑。

examples.text: There were two inferences to be drawn from her letter.
examples.translation: 由她的信可以得出两个结论。

examples.text: It had an extremely tiny head and, by inference, a tiny brain.
examples.translation: 它的头极小，由此推断其脑容量也非常小。

meanings.meaning: 差的；自卑的；下级的，下等的

examples.text: The cassettes were of inferior quality...
examples.translation: 那些磁带质量较差。

examples.text: This resulted in overpriced and often inferior products...
examples.translation: 这就导致了标价过高而往往质量低劣的产品的出现。

examples.text: If children were made to feel inferior to other children their confidence declined.
examples.translation: 如果让孩子感觉他们不如其他孩子,他们的信心就会减弱。

examples.text: He preferred the company of those who were intellectually inferior to himself.
examples.translation: 他喜欢与那些智力水平不如他的人共处。

examples.text: ...the inferior status of women in pre-revolutionary Russia...
examples.translation: 革命之前俄国妇女的低微地位

examples.text: Most career women make me feel inferior.
examples.translation: 大部分职业女性让我感到自己不如她们。

examples.text: A gentleman should always be civil, even to his inferiors.
examples.translation: 绅士应该总是彬彬有礼,即便是对地位不及自己者。

examples.text: I found it difficult to shake off a sense of social inferiority.
examples.translation: 我发现很难摆脱社交自卑感。

meanings.meaning: 无限的，无穷的；无数的；极大的
无限；[数] 无穷大；无限的东西（如空间，时间）

examples.text: ...an infinite variety of landscapes...
examples.translation: 变化万千的风景

examples.text: With infinite care, John shifted position...
examples.translation: 约翰小心翼翼地挪动了位置。

examples.text: The choice is infinite.
examples.translation: 选择是极其多的。

examples.text: His design was infinitely better than anything I could have done.
examples.translation: 他的设计比我所能设计出的不知要好上多少倍。

examples.text: ...an infinite number of atoms...
examples.translation: 无穷多的原子

examples.text: Obviously, no company has infinite resources.
examples.translation: 显然,没有哪个公司的资源是无限的。

examples.text: ...God's infinite mercy.
examples.translation: 上帝无限的仁慈

examples.text: ...pondering on the infinite.
examples.translation: 对无极的思考

examples.text: A centimeter can be infinitely divided into smaller units.
examples.translation: 一厘米可以无穷尽地分成更小的单位。

meanings.meaning: 膨胀；通货膨胀；夸张；自命不凡

examples.text: ...rising unemployment and high inflation.
examples.translation: 不断增长的失业人数与高通货膨胀

examples.text: ...an inflation rate of only 2.2%.
examples.translation: 仅 2.2% 的通货膨胀率

meanings.meaning: 影响；势力；感化；有影响的人或事

examples.text: As Hugh grew older, she had less influence and couldn't control him...
examples.translation: 休慢慢长大,她的影响力变小了,无法再控制他了。

examples.text: I have rather a large influence over a good many people...
examples.translation: 我对很多人都有相当大的影响力。

examples.text: He denies exerting any political influence over them...
examples.translation: 他否认对他们施加了任何政治压力。

examples.text: The government should continue to use its influence for the release of all hostages.
examples.translation: 政府应继续运用其影响力来解救所有人质。

examples.text: He is trying to improperly influence a witness...
examples.translation: 他在试图误导证人。

examples.text: The angry crowds could influence the government...
examples.translation: 愤怒的群众可以影响政府。

examples.text: My dad influenced me to do electronics.
examples.translation: 我学电子是受爸爸的影响。

examples.text: Van Gogh had a major influence on the development of modern painting...
examples.translation: 凡·高对现代绘画的发展有着重大影响。

examples.text: The Shropshire landscape was an influence on Owen too...
examples.translation: 什罗普郡的风景也对欧文产生了影响。

examples.text: Many other medications have an influence on cholesterol levels.
examples.translation: 许多其他的药物治疗对胆固醇水平都有一定的影响。

examples.text: We became the best of friends and he influenced me deeply...
examples.translation: 我们成了最好的朋友,他深深地影响了我。

examples.text: What you eat may influence your risk of getting cancer...
examples.translation: 你吃的东西会影响你患癌症的风险。

examples.text: They still influence what's played on the radio.
examples.translation: 他们对电台播放什么节目仍然会有影响。

examples.text: I thought Sue would be a good influence on you...
examples.translation: 我认为苏能对你产生良好影响。

examples.text: TV is a bad influence on people.
examples.translation: 电视会对人们产生不良影响。

examples.text: I fell under the influence of a history master...
examples.translation: 我当时深受一位历史老师的影响。

examples.text: The very earliest sculptures were made under the influence of Greek art...
examples.translation: 最早的雕塑作品受到了希腊艺术的影响。

examples.text: He was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence of alcohol.
examples.translation: 他因涉嫌酒后驾驶被捕。

examples.text: Police charged the man with driving under the influence...
examples.translation: 警方指控那名男子酒后驾车。

examples.text: We find members of the opposite sex more attractive when under the influence.
examples.translation: 我们喝醉时感到异性更具吸引力。

examples.text: It helps to have influential friends.
examples.translation: 有几个位高权重的朋友很有好处。

examples.text: ...the influential position of president of the chamber...
examples.translation: 很有影响力的议院议长之位

examples.text: He had been influential in shaping economic policy.
examples.translation: 他在制定经济政策方面起到了影响。

examples.text: ...one of the most influential books ever written.
examples.translation: 最有影响的书之一

examples.text: They would inform him of any progress they had made...
examples.translation: 他们会把他们取得的任何进步都告诉他。

examples.text: My daughter informed me that she was pregnant...
examples.translation: 我女儿告诉我她怀孕了。

examples.text: 'I just added a little soy sauce,' he informs us.
examples.translation: “我就加了一点儿酱油,”他告诉我们。

examples.text: Somebody must have informed on us...
examples.translation: 肯定有人告发我们了。

examples.text: Thousands of American citizens have informed on these organized crime syndicates.
examples.translation: 数以千计的美国公民检举过这些有组织的犯罪团伙。

examples.text: All great songs are informed by a certain sadness and tension...
examples.translation: 所有很棒的歌曲都透着某种悲伤和张力。

examples.text: The concept of the Rose continued to inform the poet's work.
examples.translation: 玫瑰的概念持续贯穿于诗人的作品中。

meanings.meaning: 信息，资料；知识；情报；通知

examples.text: Pat refused to give her any information about Sarah...
examples.translation: 帕特拒绝向她提供任何关于萨拉的消息。

examples.text: Each centre would provide information on technology and training...
examples.translation: 每个中心都会提供技术与培训方面的信息。

examples.text: For further information contact the number below.
examples.translation: 如需更多信息,请拨打下面的电话。

examples.text: ...an important piece of information...
examples.translation: 一条重要情报

examples.text: The information was passed on to another government department.
examples.translation: 该信息被传达给另一政府部门。

examples.text: Pictures are scanned into a form of digital information that computers can recognize.
examples.translation: 照片被扫描成某种电脑可以识别的数字资料。

examples.text: ...searching with infrared scanners for weapons and artillery.
examples.translation: 用红外扫描仪搜索武器与大炮

meanings.meaning: 基础设施；公共建设；下部构造

examples.text: ...investment in infrastructure...
examples.translation: 对基础设施的投资

examples.text: The infrastructure, from hotels to transport, is old and decrepit.
examples.translation: 从宾馆到交通，所有的基础设施都已陈旧失修。

meanings.meaning: 有独创性的；机灵的，精制的；心灵手巧的

examples.text: ...a truly ingenious invention...
examples.translation: 真正有创意的发明

examples.text: Gautier's solution to the puzzle is ingenious.
examples.translation: 戈蒂埃破解这道难题的方法很巧妙。

examples.text: The roof has been ingeniously designed to provide solar heating.
examples.translation: 房顶经过巧妙设计，可提供太阳能取暖。

examples.text: Mix in the remaining ingredients.
examples.translation: 混入其余的原料。

examples.text: The meeting had all the ingredients of high political drama...
examples.translation: 这次会议具备了作为高度戏剧性的政治事件的一切要素。

examples.text: I think that is one of the major ingredients in his success.
examples.translation: 我认为那是他成功的主要因素之一。

examples.text: The valley is inhabited by the Dani tribe.
examples.translation: 山谷里居住着达尼部落。

examples.text: ...the people who inhabit these islands.
examples.translation: 居住在这些岛上的人们

examples.text: ...the beautifully coloured fish that inhabit the Egyptian reefs.
examples.translation: 栖息在埃及暗礁间的美丽彩色鱼类

examples.text: ...a land primarily inhabited by nomads.
examples.translation: 主要居住着游牧民族的地区

examples.text: ...the inhabitants of Glasgow.
examples.translation: 格拉斯哥市居民

examples.text: He took a long slow breath, inhaling deeply...
examples.translation: 他缓缓地深吸了一口气。

examples.text: He was treated for the effects of inhaling smoke.
examples.translation: 他因吸入烟尘而接受治疗。

meanings.meaning: 固有的；内在的；与生俱来的，遗传的

examples.text: Stress is an inherent part of dieting.
examples.translation: 节食必定会带来压力。

examples.text: ...the dangers inherent in an outbreak of war.
examples.translation: 一旦爆发战争所固有的危险

examples.text: Aeroplanes are not inherently dangerous...
examples.translation: 飞机本身并不危险。

examples.text: War is inherently a dirty business.
examples.translation: 战争与生俱来就是肮脏的。

examples.text: He has no son to inherit his land.
examples.translation: 他没有儿子来继承田产。

examples.text: ...paintings that he inherited from his father.
examples.translation: 他从父亲那里继承来的油画

examples.text: ...people with inherited wealth.
examples.translation: 继承了财富的人

examples.text: The government inherited an impossible situation from its predecessors...
examples.translation: 这届政府从前任那里接过了一个非常棘手的烂摊子。

examples.text: Our legal system inherited laws from the English system.
examples.translation: 我们的司法体系沿袭了英国的法律体系。

examples.text: ...the inherited wisdoms contained in its social hierarchy.
examples.translation: 社会等级划分中所包含的传承下来的智慧

examples.text: We inherit from our parents many of our physical characteristics...
examples.translation: 我们的许多身体特征都是从父母那里遗传而来的。

examples.text: Her children have inherited her love of sport...
examples.translation: 她的孩子们继承了她对运动的热爱。

examples.text: Stammering is probably an inherited defect.
examples.translation: 口吃很可能是一种遗传性缺陷。

examples.text: Wine or sugary drinks inhibit digestion...
examples.translation: 葡萄酒或含糖饮料抑制消化。

examples.text: The high cost of borrowing is inhibiting investment by industry in new equipment.
examples.translation: 借款的高成本抑制了企业对新设备的投资。

examples.text: It could inhibit the poor from getting the medical care they need...
examples.translation: 那会使穷人得不到他们所需要的医疗保健。

examples.text: Officers will be inhibited from doing their duty.
examples.translation: 官员们将无法履行职责。

examples.text: The initial reaction has been excellent...
examples.translation: 初期的反应非常好。

examples.text: The aim of this initial meeting is to clarify the issues.
examples.translation: 本次初步会议的目标是澄清这些问题。

examples.text: ...a silver Porsche car with her initials JB on the side.
examples.translation: 车身有她姓名缩写JB的银色保时捷跑车

examples.text: Would you mind initialing this voucher?...
examples.translation: 请在凭单上用首字母签名。

examples.text: The agreement was initialled in June.
examples.translation: 这份协议是6月份草签的。

meanings.meaning: 开始，创始；发起；使初步了解
开始；新加入者，接受初步知识者
新加入的；接受初步知识的

examples.text: They wanted to initiate a discussion on economics...
examples.translation: 他们想启动一次经济学讨论。

examples.text: The trip was initiated by the manager of the community centre.
examples.translation: 这次旅行由社区活动中心的经理发起。

examples.text: He initiated her into the study of other cultures.
examples.translation: 他将她领进了研究其他文化的大门。

examples.text: In many societies, young people are formally initiated into their adult roles.
examples.translation: 在很多社会里,年轻人经过正式仪式才算成年。

examples.text: ...the ceremony that initiated members into the Order.
examples.translation: 吸收成员加入会社的仪式

examples.text: Chen was an initiate of a Chinese spiritual discipline.
examples.translation: 陈是某个中国神学领域的新入门者。

examples.text: Government initiatives to help young people have been inadequate...
examples.translation: 政府在积极帮助年轻人方面做得还不够。

examples.text: There's talk of a new peace initiative.
examples.translation: 传闻有可能提出新的和平倡议。

examples.text: We have the initiative; we intend to keep it...
examples.translation: 我们拥有主动权;我们不打算放弃它。

examples.text: He paused enough to consider the options but never so long as to lose the initiative.
examples.translation: 他停顿了一会儿权衡自己有哪些选项,但并没有久到丧失主动权。

examples.text: She was disappointed by his lack of initiative.
examples.translation: 她对他缺少进取心感到失望。

examples.text: ...workers who are able to sort out problems on their own initiative.
examples.translation: 能主动解决问题的工人

examples.text: We must take the initiative in the struggle to end the war...
examples.translation: 为尽早结束战争,我们必须抢先行动。

examples.text: She knew she had to take the initiative and maintain an aggressive game throughout.
examples.translation: 她知道自己必须采取主动，并且始终保持咄咄逼人的态势。

examples.text: His son was injected with strong drugs...
examples.translation: 他儿子被注射了烈性麻醉药。

examples.text: The technique consists of injecting healthy cells into the weakened muscles...
examples.translation: 该技术是把健康细胞注射到衰弱的肌肉里面。

examples.text: He needs to inject himself once a month.
examples.translation: 他需要每月为自己打一针。

examples.text: She kept trying to inject a little fun into their relationship...
examples.translation: 她一直在设法为他们的关系增添一些情趣。

examples.text: The result might inject more sense into future bargaining.
examples.translation: 其结果可能为未来的谈判注入更多的理性。

examples.text: He has injected £5.6 billion into the health service.
examples.translation: 他已经为公共医疗卫生服务投入了 56 亿英镑。

examples.text: A number of bombs have exploded, seriously injuring at least five people...
examples.translation: 数个炸弹爆炸,造成至少5人重伤。

examples.text: Several policemen were injured in the clashes.
examples.translation: 几名警察在冲突中受伤。

examples.text: ...stiff penalties for motorists who kill, maim, and injure.
examples.translation: 对致人死亡、残疾、受伤的驾车者处以严厉惩罚

examples.text: The letter was handwritten in black ink.
examples.translation: 信是用黑色墨水写的。

examples.text: Ritter took his left hand and inked the fingertips.
examples.translation: 里特伸出左手,在指尖上沾上印油。

examples.text: Four police officers sustained serious injuries in the explosion...
examples.translation: 4名警官在爆炸中受重伤。

examples.text: The two other passengers escaped serious injury.
examples.translation: 另外两名乘客逃过一劫，未受重伤。

examples.text: She was awarded £3,500 for injury to her feelings.
examples.translation: 她判得 3,500 英镑精神损失赔偿。

meanings.meaning: 在内地；向内地；向内陆；在内陆

examples.text: The vast majority live further inland...
examples.translation: 大部分人住在更远的内地。

examples.text: It's about 15 minutes' drive inland from Cannes...
examples.translation: 从戛纳向内陆方向开车走约需 15 分钟。

examples.text: The car turned away from the coast and headed inland.
examples.translation: 汽车离开了海岸,驶向内陆。

examples.text: ...a rather quiet inland town.
examples.translation: 颇为宁静的内陆城镇

examples.text: ...a sheltered inlet.
examples.translation: 避风的小港湾

examples.text: ...a blocked water inlet.
examples.translation: 被堵死的入水孔

examples.text: ...the Waterside Inn.
examples.translation: 水畔客栈

examples.text: She got up and went into an inner office...
examples.translation: 她起身进了里间办公室。

examples.text: Wade stepped inside and closed the inner door behind him.
examples.translation: 韦德走进去，随手带上了里面的门。

examples.text: Loving relationships will give a child an inner sense of security...
examples.translation: 亲昵关系会给予孩子内心一种安全感。

examples.text: Michael needed to express his inner tensions.
examples.translation: 迈克尔需要宣泄一下他内心的紧张。

meanings.meaning: (Innocent)人名；(英、西)因诺森特；(法)伊诺桑

examples.text: He was sure that the man was innocent of any crime...
examples.translation: 他确信那个男人没有犯任何罪。

examples.text: The police knew from day one that I was innocent.
examples.translation: 警方一开始就知道我是无辜的。

examples.text: They seemed so young and innocent...
examples.translation: 他们看起来如此少不更事。

examples.text: He's curiously innocent about what this means to other people.
examples.translation: 关于这对其他人意味着什么,他一无所知，这一点颇不寻常。

examples.text: Ian was a hopeless innocent where women were concerned.
examples.translation: 一涉及女性,伊恩就显得极其无知。

examples.text: The baby gurgled innocently on the bed.
examples.translation: 床上的婴儿天真地咯咯笑着。

examples.text: All those wounded were innocent victims...
examples.translation: 所有伤者都是无辜的受害人。

examples.text: The war was killing innocent women and children.
examples.translation: 战争夺走了许多无辜妇女和儿童的生命。

examples.text: It was a perfectly innocent question.
examples.translation: 那是个完全没有恶意的问题。

examples.text: The vegetarian burger was an innovation which was rapidly exported to Britain.
examples.translation: 素食汉堡是一种迅速传到了英国的新开发食品。

examples.text: ...the transformation wrought by the technological innovations of the industrial age.
examples.translation: 由工业时代的新技术方法促成的变化

examples.text: We must promote originality and encourage innovation.
examples.translation: 我们必须提倡创意,鼓励革新。

examples.text: He has invented innumerable excuses, told endless lies.
examples.translation: 他编造了数不清的借口和谎话。

meanings.meaning: [自][电子] 输入；将…输入电脑

examples.text: We listen to our employees and value their input...
examples.translation: 我们听取员工的想法,重视他们的意见和建议。

examples.text: They may need some additional inputs and advice on how to improve the management of their farms.
examples.translation: 他们可能需要听取更多的意见和建议来改善农场的经营。

examples.text: All this information had to be input onto the computer.
examples.translation: 所有这些信息都必须输入计算机。

examples.text: He made some inquiries and discovered she had gone to the Continent...
examples.translation: 他打听了一番，发现她已经去了欧陆。

examples.text: After a brief inquiry about the Christmas holiday, he returned to the subject of music.
examples.translation: 简短地问了一下圣诞假期之后,他又回到了音乐的话题上。

examples.text: This is the most difficult and shocking murder inquiry I have had to open in the last 25 years...
examples.translation: 这是 25 年来我所展开的最困难、最令人震惊的谋杀调查。

examples.text: The Democratic Party has called for an independent inquiry into the incident.
examples.translation: 民主党要求对事件展开独立调查。

examples.text: The investigation has suddenly switched to a new line of inquiry.
examples.translation: 调查突然转向了一条新的线索。

examples.text: Two men were helping police with their inquiries at Salisbury last night.
examples.translation: 两名男子昨天夜里在索尔兹伯里接受了警方盘问。

examples.text: Like they could have an insect sized robot that burrows under your skin and dispenses tranquilizers.
He took a small key from his pocket and slowly inserted it into the lock...
examples.translation: 他从口袋里掏出一把小钥匙,慢慢地插到锁眼里。

examples.text: Wait for a couple of minutes with your mouth closed before inserting the thermometer.
examples.translation: 先合上嘴巴等几分钟再放进体温计。

examples.text: ...the first experiment involving the insertion of a new gene into a human being.
examples.translation: 将新基因植入人体的首次实验

examples.text: They joined with the monarchists to insert a clause calling for a popular vote on the issue.
examples.translation: 他们与君主主义者联手添加了一个条款,呼吁对该议题进行全民投票。

examples.text: He recorded an item for insertion in the programme.
examples.translation: 他录了一条消息插播到节目中。

examples.text: The form inside of can also be used as a preposition. This form is more usual in American English.
examples.translation: 亦使用 inside of 作介词,这在美国英语中更为常见。

examples.text: There is a telephone inside the entrance hall.
examples.translation: 门厅内有部电话。

examples.text: The couple chatted briefly on the doorstep before going inside...
examples.translation: 夫妇俩进去之前在门阶上简短地说了几句。

examples.text: He ripped open the envelope and read what was inside...
examples.translation: 他撕开信封，看了里面的信。

examples.text: I could hear music coming from inside...
examples.translation: 我能听到里面传来乐声。

examples.text: At a table inside, a man and woman were awaiting her...
examples.translation: 在里面的一张桌子旁,一男一女正等着她。

examples.text: Inside, clouds of cigarette smoke swirled.
examples.translation: 屋内香烟的烟雾缭绕。

examples.text: ...four-berth inside cabins with en suite bathroom and shower.
examples.translation: 有4张卧铺并配有盥洗室和淋浴的内舱

examples.text: The doors were locked from the inside...
examples.translation: 门从里面锁上了。

examples.text: I painted the inside of the house...
examples.translation: 我粉刷了一遍房子内部。

examples.text: Kiwi fruit can be eaten by cutting off the tops and scooping out the insides with a teaspoon.
examples.translation: 可以把猕猴桃的顶部切掉，用茶匙把里面的果肉挖出来吃。

examples.text: The popular papers all have photo features on their inside pages.
examples.translation: 通俗报纸的内页都有照片专栏。

examples.text: The potato cakes should be crisp outside and meltingly soft inside.
examples.translation: 土豆饼应该外面酥脆,里面嫩软。

examples.text: He's been inside three times.
examples.translation: 他进过三次监狱。

examples.text: I was driving up at seventy miles an hour on the inside lane on the motorway.
examples.translation: 我在高速公路的慢道上以每小时 70 英里的速度行驶。

examples.text: I overtook Charlie on the inside.
examples.translation: 我从慢车道上超了查利。

examples.text: Sloane used inside diplomatic information to make himself rich...
examples.translation: 斯隆利用外交内幕消息发了财。

examples.text: Keith Vass, editor, denies he had inside knowledge...
examples.translation: 编辑基思·瓦斯否认他知道内部消息。

examples.text: It's fascinating to get the inside story so many years after this incident.
examples.translation: 事件过后这么多年方获知当时的内情，这实在是令人慨叹。

examples.text: 75 percent of chief executives come from inside the company...
examples.translation: 75% 的行政总裁来自公司内部。

examples.text: He hasn't looked very carefully into what was happening inside the ruling party.
examples.translation: 他没有认真研究执政党内部正在发生什么。

examples.text: ...a recent book about the inside world of pro football.
examples.translation: 关于职业足球内幕的一本新书

examples.text: McAvoy was convinced he could control things from the inside but he lost control.
examples.translation: 麦卡沃伊确信自己能从内部控制局面,但他失算了。

examples.text: There is nothing left inside—no words, no anger, no tears...
examples.translation: 整颗心都空了——没有语言,没有愤怒,没有眼泪。

examples.text: Do you get a feeling inside when you write something you like?
examples.translation: 当你写下喜欢的文字时,内心会有一种特别的情感吗？

examples.text: He felt a great weight of sorrow inside him...
examples.translation: 他内心感到极为沉痛。

examples.text: There was a little anger inside me.
examples.translation: 我心里有点生气。

examples.text: What is needed is a change from the inside, a real change in outlook and attitude.
examples.translation: 现在需要的是内心深处的变化,在看法与态度上的真正改变。

examples.text: They should have everything working inside an hour...
examples.translation: 他们应该会在一个小时之内使一切运转起来。

examples.text: New Zealand were ahead inside five minutes.
examples.translation: 新西兰队领先了不到 5 分钟。

examples.text: Her umbrella blew inside out.
examples.translation: 她的伞被风吹得翻转了。

examples.text: He knew the game inside out...
examples.translation: 他对比赛非常熟悉。

examples.text: We know each other inside out.
examples.translation: 我们对彼此都了如指掌。

examples.text: Edinburgh is an American city turned inside out: the rich in the middle, the poor around the outside...
examples.translation: 爱丁堡与美国城市相反：富人住在中心,穷人住在周边。

examples.text: War turns morality inside out: killing and cruelty are virtues.
examples.translation: 战争颠倒是非：杀戮与残忍成了美德。

examples.text: The project would give scientists new insights into what is happening to the earth's atmosphere...
examples.translation: 该项目将使科学家对地球大气层的状况有更新的深入了解。

examples.text: I hope that this talk has given you some insight into the kind of the work that we've been doing.
examples.translation: 希望这次谈话能使你对我们正在开展的工作有一些较深入的了解。

examples.text: He was a man with considerable insight.
examples.translation: 他是个富有洞察力的人。

examples.text: My family insisted that I should not give in, but stay and fight...
examples.translation: 家里人坚持认为我不应让步,而应该留下来继续抗争。

examples.text: She insisted on being present at all the interviews...
examples.translation: 她坚持所有采访自己都要在场。

examples.text: She insists on all her employees coming to the Christmas lunch she gives every year...
examples.translation: 她坚持要求所有员工都参加她每年一次的圣诞午餐。

examples.text: I didn't want to join in, but Kenneth insisted.
examples.translation: 我不想加入,但是肯尼思非要坚持。

examples.text: The president insisted that he was acting out of compassion, not opportunism...
examples.translation: 总统坚持说他如此做是出于同情而不是为了投机。

examples.text: 'It's not that difficult,' she insists...
examples.translation: “并没有那么困难,”她坚持说。

examples.text: Crippen insisted on his innocence.
examples.translation: 克里平坚称自己是无辜的。

examples.text: Elaine went outside to inspect the playing field...
examples.translation: 伊莱恩走到外面查看操场。

examples.text: Cut the fruit in half and inspect the pips: if they are turning slightly brown it is ready for harvesting.
examples.translation: 把果实切成两半，检查一下其中的籽：如果有点成棕色，那就该收获了。

examples.text: He had completed his inspection of the doors...
examples.translation: 他已经检查完所有的门。

examples.text: From a distance, the birds appear mainly green in colour. However, closer inspection reveals that their chests are banded with yellow.
examples.translation: 从远处看，这些鸟主要是绿色的。但是,近距离仔细看，就会发现它们的胸部带有黄色条纹。

examples.text: The Public Utilities Commission inspects us once a year...
examples.translation: 公共事业委员会每年到我们这里视察一次。

examples.text: Each hotel is inspected and, if it fulfils certain criteria, is recommended.
examples.translation: 会对每家旅馆都进行检查,如果它达到了一定的标准,就获得推荐。

examples.text: Officers making a routine inspection of the vessel found fifty kilograms of the drug.
examples.translation: 对船只进行例行检查的警官发现了 50 千克的毒品。

examples.text: My inspiration comes from poets like Baudelaire and Jacques Prévert...
examples.translation: 我的灵感源于像波德莱尔和雅克·普雷韦这样的诗人。

examples.text: What better way of finding inspiration for your own garden than by visiting others.
examples.translation: 还有什么比参观别人花园更好的获取灵感、扮靓自家花园的方法呢。

examples.text: Powell's unusual journey to high office is an inspiration to millions...
examples.translation: 鲍威尔升任高官的不寻常历程对数以百万计的人都是一个激励。

examples.text: She was a great inspiration. She was the person who impressed us with the importance of research.
examples.translation: 她极大地鼓舞了我们，让我们深刻了解到研究的重要性。

examples.text: India's myths and songs are the inspiration for her books...
examples.translation: 印度的神话与歌曲是她那些书的灵感来源。

examples.text: The inspiration behind the reforms was a paper written in 1985.
examples.translation: 改革的想法源于 1985 年的一篇论文。

examples.text: Alison had an inspiration.
examples.translation: 艾莉森有了条妙计。

meanings.meaning: 激发；鼓舞；启示；产生；使生灵感

examples.text: These herbs will inspire you to try out all sorts of exotic-flavoured dishes!...
examples.translation: 这些香草会激发你去品尝各种异国风味的菜肴！

examples.text: Our challenge is to motivate those voters and inspire them to join our cause...
examples.translation: 我们面临的挑战是如何调动那些选民的积极性并鼓励他们加入我们的事业。

examples.text: And what inspired you to change your name?
examples.translation: 是什么促使你改名的?

examples.text: Jimi Hendrix inspired a generation of guitarists.
examples.translation: 吉米·亨德里克斯启发了整整一代吉他演奏者。

examples.text: The book was inspired by a real person, namely Tamara de Treaux.
examples.translation: 那本书的灵感源于一个真实人物,即塔玛拉·德特罗。

examples.text: ...a political murder inspired by the same nationalist conflicts now wrecking the country.
examples.translation: 正是由正在毁掉该国的民族主义冲突激发的一起政治谋杀

examples.text: ...Mediterranean-inspired ceramics in bright yellow and blue...
examples.translation: 源于地中海风格的鲜亮黄蓝色陶瓷器

examples.text: Jamaica's socialist government is adopting US-inspired free market practices.
examples.translation: 牙买加的社会主义政府正在仿效美国实行自由市场。

examples.text: The car's performance quickly inspires confidence.
examples.translation: 该汽车的性能会很快唤起驾驶者的信心。

examples.text: The building was turned into a secret military installation.
examples.translation: 该建筑被改造成了一处秘密军事设施。

examples.text: ...a nuclear installation.
examples.translation: 核设施

meanings.meaning: 安装；分期付款；部分；就职

examples.text: Eurozone officials are withholding the next loan installment until Athens formally approves the rescue package.
They had installed a new phone line in the apartment.
examples.translation: 他们已经在公寓里装上了新的电话线。

examples.text: Hundreds of lives could be saved if the installation of alarms was more widespread.
examples.translation: 如果报警器得到更广泛的安装,成百上千的生命就可能被挽救。

examples.text: A new Catholic bishop was installed in Galway yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天在戈尔韦任命了一位新的天主教主教。

examples.text: Professor Sawyer was formally installed as President last Thursday...
examples.translation: 索耶教授上周四被正式任命为校长。

examples.text: The army has promised to install a new government within a week.
examples.translation: 军队已经许诺在一周内任命新一届政府。

examples.text: He sent a letter inviting Naomi to attend his installation as chief of his tribe.
examples.translation: 他给娜奥米寄了封信,邀请她来参加他就任部落酋长的仪式。

examples.text: Before her husband's death she had installed herself in a modern villa.
examples.translation: 丈夫去世之前她已经在一所现代化别墅里安顿下来了。

examples.text: There are a number of improvements; for instance, both mouse buttons can now be used...
examples.translation: 在许多地方有了改进,例如,鼠标的左右键都可以使用了。

examples.text: Let your child make some of the small decisions concerning his daily routine. For instance, allow him to choose what clothes he wears at the weekend.
examples.translation: 让孩子在日常生活中作一些小决定。比如,让他自己决定周末穿什么衣服。

examples.text: She cited an instance where their training had been a marvelous help in dealing with problems.
examples.translation: 她举了一个所受训练为解决问题帮了大忙的实例。

examples.text: ...an investigation into a serious instance of corruption.
examples.translation: 对一起严重的腐败事件的调查

examples.text: In the first instance your child will be seen by an ear, nose and throat specialist...
examples.translation: 你的孩子将首先由耳鼻喉专科医生来诊察。

examples.text: The post was for one year in the first instance with possible renewal to a further year.
examples.translation: 该岗位初始为一年期,有可能会再续聘一年。

examples.text: The rally was organised at the instance of two senior cabinet ministers.
examples.translation: 集会是应两位资深内阁大臣的要求组织的。

examples.text: For an instant, Catherine was tempted to flee...
examples.translation: 有那么一会儿,凯瑟琳很想逃跑。

examples.text: The pain disappeared in an instant.
examples.translation: 疼痛立刻就消失了。

examples.text: At that instant the museum was plunged into total darkness...
examples.translation: 就在那时,博物馆陷入了一片漆黑。

examples.text: In the same instant he flung open the car door.
examples.translation: 与此同时,他猛地推开了车门。

examples.text: I had bolted the door the instant I had seen the bat.
examples.translation: 我一看到蝙蝠就把门闩上了。

examples.text: Mr Porter's book was an instant hit...
examples.translation: 波特先生的书一经推出便大受欢迎。

examples.text: He had taken an instant dislike to Mortlake.
examples.translation: 他一到莫特莱克就觉得不喜欢这个地方。

examples.text: The man was killed instantly...
examples.translation: 那名男子当场死亡。

examples.text: The songs are instantly recognisable.
examples.translation: 这些歌曲的辨识度很强。

examples.text: ...instant coffee.
examples.translation: 速溶咖啡

examples.text: Death was instantaneous because both bullets hit the heart.
examples.translation: 因为两颗子弹都击中了心脏,所以死亡是瞬间发生的。

examples.text: Airbags inflate instantaneously on impact.
examples.translation: 安全气囊遇到撞击立即膨胀。

examples.text: She had to spend nearly four months away from him that summer, instead of the usual two...
examples.translation: 那个夏天她被迫离开他将近四个月而不是通常的两个月。

examples.text: Check-out workers in London will receive £7.17 an hour instead of £6.54...
examples.translation: 伦敦的收银员每小时工资将从原先的 6.54 英镑涨为 7.17 英镑。

examples.text: They raised prices and cut production, instead of cutting costs...
examples.translation: 他们没有降低成本，而是抬高价格、削减产量。

examples.text: Instead of going to work thinking that it will be totally boring, try to be positive.
examples.translation: 不要一边去上班一边想着工作太无聊,要积极一些。

examples.text: He reached for the wine but did not drink, pushed it, instead, across the table towards Joanna...
examples.translation: 他伸手拿酒却没有喝,而是把它推给了坐在桌子对面的乔安娜。

examples.text: The kitchen might have been workable had Nicola kept it tidy; instead it was littered with pots and pans...
examples.translation: 如果妮古拉会收拾,厨房本来是能用的;但现在,这里到处乱放着锅碗瓢盆。

examples.text: My husband asked why I couldn't just forget about dieting all the time and eat normally instead.
examples.translation: 丈夫问我为什么就不能不整天想着节食,转而正经吃饭。

examples.text: I didn't have as strong a maternal instinct as some other mothers...
examples.translation: 我不像别的母亲那样有那么强烈的母性本能。

examples.text: The basis for training relies on the dog's natural instinct to hunt and retrieve...
examples.translation: 训练是基于狗搜寻和衔回的天生本能。

examples.text: He always knew what time it was, as if by instinct.
examples.translation: 他总能知道几点了,仿佛是出于本能。

examples.text: Farmers are increasingly losing touch with their instinct for managing the land...
examples.translation: 农民正在逐渐丢失经营土地的本领。

examples.text: Irene is so incredibly musical and has a natural instinct to perform.
examples.translation: 艾琳有着极高的音乐天分和天生的表演才能。

examples.text: I should've gone with my first instinct, which was not to do the interview...
examples.translation: 我本该听从自己的第一反应,不接受这次采访的。

examples.text: She hadn't followed her instinct and because of this Frank was dead.
examples.translation: 她没有听从自己心里的话,弗兰克因此死了。

examples.text: There is scientific evidence to support our instinct that being surrounded by plants is good for health...
examples.translation: 我们觉得周围植物环绕会有益健康,这种直觉有科学证据支持。

examples.text: He seems so honest and genuine and my every instinct says he's not.
examples.translation: 他看起来这么老实诚恳,但我的全部直觉告诉我他一点都不。

meanings.meaning: 开始（调查）；制定；创立；提起（诉讼）

examples.text: ...the National Cancer Institute.
examples.translation: 国家癌症研究所

examples.text: ...an elite research institute devoted to computer software...
examples.translation: 致力于计算机软件开发的精英研究机构

examples.text: Directly in front of the institute is Kelly Ingram Park.
examples.translation: 该协会正前方是凯利·英格拉姆公园。

examples.text: We will institute a number of measures to better safeguard the public...
examples.translation: 我们将实施一系列措施来更好地保护公众安全。

examples.text: Hormone replacement therapy is very important and should be instituted early.
examples.translation: 激素替代治疗非常重要,应该及早开始。

meanings.meaning: 制度；建立；（社会或宗教等）公共机构；习俗

examples.text: ...the Institution of Civil Engineers...
examples.translation: 土木工程学院

examples.text: Class size varies from one type of institution to another...
examples.translation: 班级大小因院校类型而异。

examples.text: ...banks and other financial institutions.
examples.translation: 银行和其他金融机构

examples.text: He was transferred to Shoal Creek Mental Institution for an indefinite period...
examples.translation: 他被转到了肖尔溪精神病院，要在那里无限期地呆下去。

examples.text: Larry has been in an institution since he was four...
examples.translation: 拉里从4岁起就一直生活在孤儿院。

examples.text: He visited various penal institutions in the United Kingdom in the late 1930s.
examples.translation: 20 世纪 30 年代末他探访了英国各种各样的服刑机构。

examples.text: I believe in the institution of marriage.
examples.translation: 我相信婚姻制度。

examples.text: ...the institution of the family.
examples.translation: 家庭制度

examples.text: There was never an official institution of censorship in Albania.
examples.translation: 在阿尔巴尼亚从未设立过官方审查制度。

examples.text: ...the institution of the forty-hour week.
examples.translation: 每周 40 小时工作制的建立

examples.text: The family has instructed solicitors to sue Thomson for compensation...
examples.translation: 那家人已经指示律师起诉汤姆森,要求赔偿。

examples.text: 'Go and have a word with her, Ken,' Webb instructed...
examples.translation: “肯,去和她谈谈吧,”韦布吩咐道。

examples.text: I want you to instruct them that they've got three months to get the details sorted out.
examples.translation: 我想让你告知他们,他们有3个月时间来解决细节问题。

examples.text: He instructed family members in nursing techniques.
examples.translation: 他教给家人护理技巧。

meanings.meaning: 指令，命令；指示；教导；用法说明

examples.text: Two lawyers were told not to leave the building but no reason for this instruction was given.
examples.translation: 两名律师被告知不得离开大楼,但对这一命令并没有提供任何理由。

examples.text: Each candidate is given instruction in safety...
examples.translation: 向每位申请人都讲授了安全知识。

examples.text: All schoolchildren must now receive some religious instruction.
examples.translation: 现在所有的在校儿童都必须接受一定的宗教教育。

examples.text: Always read the instructions before you start taking the medicine.
examples.translation: 在服药之前一定要先阅读说明书。

meanings.meaning: 仪器；工具；乐器；手段；器械

examples.text: ...a thin tube-like optical instrument.
examples.translation: 试管状的细长光学仪器

examples.text: ...instruments for cleaning and polishing teeth...
examples.translation: 清洗和抛光牙齿的器械

examples.text: The environment itself will at the same time be measured by about 60 scientific instruments.
examples.translation: 同时环境本身将由大约60种科学器械来测量。

examples.text: Learning a musical instrument introduces a child to an understanding of music.
examples.translation: 学一门乐器能引导孩子了解音乐。

examples.text: ...crucial instruments on the control panel.
examples.translation: 控制面板上的重要仪表

examples.text: ...navigation instruments.
examples.translation: 导航仪器

examples.text: The veto has been a traditional instrument of diplomacy for centuries.
examples.translation: 几个世纪以来否决权一直是外交上惯用的手段。

meanings.meaning: 乐器的；有帮助的；仪器的，器械的

examples.text: In his first years as chairman he was instrumental in raising the company's wider profile...
examples.translation: 他任董事长的最初几年为提升公司的知名度起到了积极的推动作用。

examples.text: Jesse Jackson was instrumental in the release of some of the hostages.
examples.translation: 其中一些人质得以获释多亏了杰西·杰克逊。

examples.text: ...a cassette recording of vocal and instrumental music.
examples.translation: 有声乐也有器乐的磁带录音

examples.text: The last track on the CD is an instrumental.
examples.translation: CD 上的最后一支曲目是一首器乐曲。

meanings.meaning: 隔离，使孤立；使绝缘，使隔热

examples.text: They wonder if their community is no longer insulated from big city problems...
examples.translation: 他们在想是否大城市的问题离自己的社区也已经不再遥远了。

examples.text: Their wealth had insulated them from reality.
examples.translation: 财富将他们与现实隔离。

examples.text: They lived in happy insulation from brutal facts.
examples.translation: 他们幸福地生活在不受残酷现实干扰的世界里。

examples.text: It will take almost 25 years to insulate the homes of the six million households that require this assistance...
examples.translation: 要为 600 万户有此需求的家庭进行住宅隔热隔音处理得花将近 25 年的时间。

examples.text: Is there any way we can insulate our home from the noise?...
examples.translation: 有什么办法可以使我们的住宅隔音吗？

examples.text: Are your hot and cold water pipes well insulated?
examples.translation: 你们的冷热水管包好隔热层了吗？

examples.text: ...a garment lined with a light insulating material.
examples.translation: 里子是轻便保暖材料的衣服

examples.text: In order to make it safe, the element is electrically insulated.
examples.translation: 为安全起见,该元件作了电绝缘处理。

examples.text: ...electrical insulating tape.
examples.translation: 绝缘胶带

examples.text: I did not mean to insult you...
examples.translation: 我不是要故意侮辱你。

examples.text: Buchanan said he was insulted by the judge's remarks.
examples.translation: 布坎南说法官的那番话侮辱了他。

examples.text: I would be a bit insulted if he said anything like that.
examples.translation: 如果他说过任何那样的话,我会感到有些受辱的。

examples.text: Their behaviour was an insult to the people they represent...
examples.translation: 他们的行为是对他们代表的人民的一种侮辱。

examples.text: The prison Governor criticised some of his officers who shouted insults at prisoners on the roof.
examples.translation: 监狱长批评了一些站在屋顶上大声辱骂囚犯的狱警。

examples.text: The driver of the car that killed Smith got a £250 fine and five penalty points on his licence. To add insult to injury, he drove away from court in his own car.
examples.translation: 撞死史密斯的汽车司机仅被罚款250英镑，驾照上扣了5分。更让人不可接受的是,他竟然开着自己的车从法院扬长而去。

meanings.meaning: 保险；保险费；保险契约；赔偿金

examples.text: The insurance company paid out for the stolen jewellery and silver...
examples.translation: 保险公司赔付了遭窃的珠宝和银器。

examples.text: We recommend that you take out travel insurance on all holidays.
examples.translation: 我们建议您为所有假期都购买旅行保险。

examples.text: The country needs a defence capability as insurance against the unexpected.
examples.translation: 国家需要有一定的防御能力，以应对不可预知的情况。

meanings.meaning: 完整的；原封不动的；未受损伤的

examples.text: Most of the cargo was left intact after the explosion...
examples.translation: 大部分货物在爆炸发生后都完好无损。

examples.text: If the family unit is still intact, the patient frequently does very well.
examples.translation: 如果家庭仍然完整,病人常常恢复得很好。

examples.text: For protection against unforeseen emergencies, you insure your house, your furnishings and your car...
examples.translation: 为了防范不可预见的紧急情况,人们给房子、家具和汽车上保险。

examples.text: Think carefully before you insure against accident, sickness and redundancy...
examples.translation: 在为意外事故、疾病与失业投保之前一定要考虑清楚。

examples.text: We automatically insure your belongings against fire and theft.
examples.translation: 我们自动为您的财产上失窃险和火灾险。

examples.text: He insured himself against failure by treating only people he was sure he could cure...
examples.translation: 他仅仅治疗有把握治愈的病人，以使自己免于失败。

examples.text: All the electronics in the world cannot insure against accidents, though.
examples.translation: 世上没有哪种电子器材能完全避免意外事故的发生。

meanings.meaning: 积分的；完整的，整体的；必须的

examples.text: Rituals and festivals form an integral part of every human society...
examples.translation: 仪式与节日构成了任何人类社会不可缺少的一部分。

examples.text: Anxiety is integral to the human condition.
examples.translation: 焦虑是人类的基本生存状况之一。

meanings.meaning: 使…完整；使…成整体；求…的积分；表示…的总和
求积分；取消隔离；成为一体

examples.text: He didn't integrate successfully into the Italian way of life...
examples.translation: 他没有顺利地融入到意大利的生活方式中。

examples.text: Integrating the kids with the community, finding them a role, is essential...
examples.translation: 使孩子融入社区并为他们找到某个角色非常必要。

examples.text: The way Swedes integrate immigrants is, she feels, 100% more advanced...
examples.translation: 她觉得瑞典人帮助移民适应当地生活的方式百分百地更为先进。

examples.text: If they want to integrate, that's fine with me.
examples.translation: 如果他们想加入,我没有意见。

examples.text: He thinks we are living in a fully integrated, supportive society.
examples.translation: 他认为我们生活在一个完全和谐、相互扶持的社会里。

examples.text: ...the integration of disabled people into mainstream society.
examples.translation: 残疾人士跟主流社会的融合

examples.text: Schools came to us because they wanted to integrate...
examples.translation: 学校来向我们寻求帮助是因为他们想让不同种族的学生得到平等待遇。

examples.text: Encouraging teacher transfer would not, by itself, integrate the teaching corps.
examples.translation: 鼓励教师调动本身不会消弭教学队伍中的种族隔离。

examples.text: ...a black honor student in Chicago's integrated Lincoln Park High School.
examples.translation: 在芝加哥兼收黑人和白人学生的林肯公园高中就学的一名黑人优等生

examples.text: Lots of people in Chicago don't see that racial border. They see progress towards integration.
examples.translation: 在芝加哥很多人看不到那条种族边界。他们看到的是朝向种族融合的进步。

examples.text: Integrating the pound with other European currencies could cause difficulties...
examples.translation: 把英镑与欧洲其他货币合并会引发许多难题。

examples.text: Ann wanted the conservatory to integrate with the kitchen...
examples.translation: 安想把温室与厨房打通。

examples.text: Little attempt was made to integrate the parts into a coherent whole...
examples.translation: 在把各部分结合成一个连贯的整体方面几乎未作任何尝试。

examples.text: Talks will now begin about integrating the activities of both companies.
examples.translation: 关于合并两家公司业务的谈判现在将会开始。

examples.text: There is, he said, a lack of an integrated national transport policy.
examples.translation: 他指出，目前缺乏一个统一的全国交通运输政策。

examples.text: ...a more integrated approach to land uses in a rural environment.
examples.translation: 农村土地利用更趋协调的方法

examples.text: With Germany, France has been the prime mover behind closer European integration.
examples.translation: 法国与德国一道,一直是更加紧密的欧洲一体化进程的主要推动者。

examples.text: I have always regarded him as a man of integrity...
examples.translation: 我一直认为他正直诚实。

examples.text: He was praised for his fairness and high integrity.
examples.translation: 他的公正和正直操守受人称道。

examples.text: Separatist movements are a threat to the integrity of the nation.
examples.translation: 分离主义运动对国家统一是个威胁。

meanings.meaning: 知识分子；凭理智做事者

examples.text: High levels of lead could damage the intellectual development of children...
examples.translation: 铅含量过高会损害儿童的智力发展。

examples.text: He has written seven thrillers, and clearly enjoys intellectual pursuits.
examples.translation: 他已经写了7本惊悚小说,显然很喜欢这样的智力活动。

examples.text: ...intellectually satisfying work...
examples.translation: 悦人心智的工作

examples.text: Intellectually, I was completely prepared for that type of work.
examples.translation: 从心智上来说,我已经对那种工作完全作好了准备。

examples.text: ...teachers, artists and other intellectuals.
examples.translation: 教师、艺术家和其他知识分子

examples.text: They were very intellectual and witty.
examples.translation: 他们才思敏捷，风趣诙谐。

examples.text: ...an intellectual elite.
examples.translation: 知识分子精英

meanings.meaning: 智力；情报工作；情报机关；理解力

examples.text: She's a woman of exceptional intelligence.
examples.translation: 她是个有着非凡智慧的女子。

examples.text: Nerve cells, after all, do not have intelligence of their own.
examples.translation: 毕竟,神经细胞自身并没有智力。

examples.text: She first moved into the intelligence services 22 years ago...
examples.translation: 22年前她初次进入情报部门。

examples.text: The purpose of intelligence is to provide information on how the enemy can be beaten...
examples.translation: 谍报的目的是提供如何打败敌人的信息。

examples.text: Why was military intelligence so lacking?
examples.translation: 为什么军事情报如此匮乏？

meanings.meaning: 智能的；聪明的；理解力强的

examples.text: Susan's a very bright and intelligent woman who knows her own mind.
examples.translation: 苏珊是个非常聪明、有主见的女子。

examples.text: ...lively and intelligent conversation...
examples.translation: 生动有趣、聪明睿智的谈话

examples.text: He ventured the opinion that 'whales are as intelligent as human beings'.
examples.translation: 他大胆提出了“鲸与人类一样聪明”的观点。

examples.text: They are incapable of thinking intelligently about politics.
examples.translation: 他们对政治没有什么高见。

examples.text: An intelligent computer will be an indispensable diagnostic tool for doctors.
examples.translation: 智能计算机将成为医生不可或缺的诊断工具。

examples.text: ...the biggest-ever search for intelligent life elsewhere in the universe.
examples.translation: 有史以来规模最大的寻找外星智能生命的行动

meanings.meaning: 可理解的；明了的；仅能用智力了解的

examples.text: The language of Darwin was intelligible to experts and non-experts alike...
examples.translation: 达尔文的语言无论对专家还是非专业人士而言都明白易懂。

examples.text: The woman moaned faintly but made no intelligible response.
examples.translation: 那个女人发出微弱的呻吟声，却没有作出任何有意义的反应。

examples.text: She intends to do A levels and go to university...
examples.translation: 她计划先参加高级考试，然后去读大学。

examples.text: I didn't intend coming to Germany to work...
examples.translation: 我没有打算来德国工作。

examples.text: We had always intended that the new series would be live.
examples.translation: 我们一直打算现场直播这部新的电视系列节目。

examples.text: This money is intended for the development of the tourist industry...
examples.translation: 这笔钱准备用于旅游业的开发。

examples.text: Columns are usually intended in architecture to add grandeur and status...
examples.translation: 圆柱在建筑中通常用来增添气势和显示地位。

examples.text: Originally, Hatfield had been intended as a leisure complex.
examples.translation: 最初,哈特菲尔德是准备建成一个休闲娱乐中心的。

examples.text: He didn't intend any sarcasm...
examples.translation: 他没有任何讽刺的意思。

examples.text: Burke's response seemed a little patronizing, though he undoubtedly hadn't intended it that way...
examples.translation: 伯克的回答有点施恩与人的感觉,尽管他无疑并没有那个意思。

examples.text: This sounds like a barrage of accusation—I don't intend it to be...
examples.translation: 这听起来像是接二连三的指责——这并非我的本意。

examples.text: I think he intended it as a put-down comment.
examples.translation: 我认为他的评论有奚落贬低之意。

meanings.meaning: 强烈的；紧张的；非常的；热情的

examples.text: He was sweating from the intense heat...
examples.translation: 高温酷热让他大汗淋漓。

examples.text: Suddenly the room filled with intense light...
examples.translation: 突然,刺眼的强光照亮了整个房间。

examples.text: Stevens's murder was the result of a deep-seated and intense hatred...
examples.translation: 史蒂文斯遭谋杀源于深仇宿怨。

examples.text: His threats become more intense, agitated, and frequent.
examples.translation: 他发出的威胁更显言辞激烈、焦虑不安，也更为频繁。

examples.text: The fast-food business is intensely competitive.
examples.translation: 快餐业竞争非常激烈。

examples.text: The attack was anticipated but its intensity came as a shock.
examples.translation: 攻击是预料之中的,但攻势之猛烈令人震惊。

examples.text: The battle for third place was intense...
examples.translation: 第三名的争夺紧张激烈。

examples.text: The military on both sides are involved in intense activity.
examples.translation: 双方的武装力量都有密集动作。

examples.text: I felt so self-conscious under Luke's mother's intense gaze...
examples.translation: 在卢克母亲审视的目光下,我感到极不自在。

examples.text: He gazed at me with those intense blue eyes.
examples.translation: 他用那双深邃的蓝眼睛凝视着我。

examples.text: He sipped his drink, staring intensely at me.
examples.translation: 他慢酌浅饮，仿佛洞悉一切地紧盯着我。

examples.text: I know he's an intense player, but he does enjoy what he's doing...
examples.translation: 我知道他是个拼命三郎,但他确实喜欢自己所做的事。

examples.text: She is taller than I imagined, more adult, more intense.
examples.translation: 她比我想象的更高、更成熟、更热切。

examples.text: His intensity and the ferocity of his feelings alarmed me.
examples.translation: 他感情之激烈和狂暴都让我惊恐。

meanings.meaning: 强度；强烈；[电子] 亮度；紧张

examples.text: Baroque flourishes, celestial superheroes, bellowing baristi: few cities match the raw intensity of Naples.

meanings.meaning: 加强的；集中的；透彻的；加强语气的

examples.text: ...several days and nights of intensive negotiations...
examples.translation: 几天几夜紧锣密鼓的谈判

examples.text: Each counsellor undergoes an intensive training programme before beginning work.
examples.translation: 每个辅导员在上岗前都要接受密集培训。

examples.text: Ruth's parents opted to educate her intensively at home.
examples.translation: 露丝的父母选择了在家对她进行集中教育。

examples.text: Elsewhere large areas have been drained and levelled for industry or intensive farming.
examples.translation: 在别处,大片区域被抽干了水或铲平了地，以作为工业或集约化农业用地。

examples.text: ...intensive methods of rearing poultry.
examples.translation: 饲养家禽的集约化方法

examples.text: Will they farm the rest of their land less intensively?
examples.translation: 他们会在其余土地上实施较轻程度的集约化耕种吗？

examples.text: Beveridge announced his intention of standing for parliament...
examples.translation: 贝弗里奇宣布他打算竞选议员。

examples.text: It is my intention to remain in my position until a successor is elected...
examples.translation: 我的打算是继续呆在岗位上,直到选出继任者。

examples.text: Unfortunately, his good intentions never seemed to last long.
examples.translation: 不幸的是,他的善意似乎从来就没有持久过。

examples.text: We have no intention of buying American jets...
examples.translation: 我们无意购买美国喷气式飞机。

examples.text: Those close to him are convinced that he has every intention of staying on until the end of his seven-year term.
examples.translation: 他身边的人都确信他打算继续留任，直到 7 年任期期满。

examples.text: While the other children interacted and played together, Ted ignored them.
examples.translation: 当别的孩子相互交流、一起玩耍的时候,泰德对他们不予理睬。

examples.text: ...rhymes and songs to help parents interact with their babies.
examples.translation: 帮助父母与婴儿进行互动的童谣与歌曲

examples.text: This can sometimes lead to somewhat superficial interactions with other people.
examples.translation: 这有时可能会导致与他人的交往流于肤浅。

examples.text: ...our experience of informal social interaction among adults.
examples.translation: 我们关于成人间非正式社交的经验

examples.text: Millions of people want new, simplified ways of interacting with a computer...
examples.translation: 数以百万计的人们想要新的简化方式实现人机交互。

examples.text: There will be a true global village in which telephones, computers and televisions interact.
examples.translation: 将会出现一个电话、电脑、电视互动的真正的地球村。

examples.text: ...experts on human-computer interaction.
examples.translation: 人机交互的专家

examples.text: You have to understand how cells interact...
examples.translation: 你必须明白细胞是怎样相互作用的。

examples.text: Atoms within the fluid interact with the minerals that form the grains.
examples.translation: 液体中的原子与形成颗粒的矿物质相互作用。

examples.text: ...the interaction between physical and emotional illness.
examples.translation: 身体疾病与心理疾病的相互影响

examples.text: ...sexual intercourse...
examples.translation: 性交

examples.text: We didn't have intercourse.
examples.translation: 我们没有发生性关系。

examples.text: There was social intercourse between the old and the young.
examples.translation: 老年人与年轻人之间有社会交往。

meanings.meaning: 兴趣，爱好；利息；趣味；同行
使……感兴趣；引起……的关心；使……参与

examples.text: There has been a lively interest in the elections in the last two weeks...
examples.translation: 近两周来选举受到了热烈关注。

examples.text: His parents tried to discourage his interest in music, but he persisted...
examples.translation: 他的父母设法打消他对音乐的兴趣,但他始终坚持。

examples.text: She'd liked him at first, but soon lost interest...
examples.translation: 她刚开始是喜欢他，但很快就失去了兴趣。

examples.text: Food was of no interest to her at all.
examples.translation: 食物一点都提不起她的兴趣。

examples.text: Encourage your child in her interests and hobbies even if they're things that you know little about...
examples.translation: 要鼓励孩子的兴趣爱好，即使你对它们所知甚少。

examples.text: He developed a wide range of sporting interests as a pupil at Millfield.
examples.translation: 他在米尔菲尔德私立学校上学的时候培养了广泛的运动爱好。

examples.text: That passage interested me because it seems to parallel very closely what you're doing in the novel...
examples.translation: 那一段引起了我的关注，因为它似乎与你在小说里所采用的手法非常相似。

examples.text: It may interest you to know that Miss Woods, the housekeeper, witnessed the attack.
examples.translation: 您或许会有兴趣知道管家伍兹小姐目击了袭击过程。

examples.text: In the meantime I can't interest you in a new car, I suppose?...
examples.translation: 那么我想这时候我不能说服您买辆新车了？

examples.text: The group wasn't able to interest them in reproducing literature specifically for women.
examples.translation: 这个团体没能说服他们再版专门面向女性的文学作品。

examples.text: Did those directors act in the best interests of their club?...
examples.translation: 那些董事行事时是以他们俱乐部的最大利益为出发点吗？

examples.text: The social worker would try to get her to see she was acting against the boy's interests.
examples.translation: 这位社会工作者会设法让她明白她这么做对这个男孩没有好处。

examples.text: The government accused unnamed 'foreign interests' of inciting the trouble...
examples.translation: 政府不指名地谴责“外国利益集团”煽动骚乱。

examples.text: He resigned as finance minister only weeks before the election and stood against big-business interests.
examples.translation: 他在大选到来仅几周前辞去了财政部长职务,并抵制大公司利益集团。

examples.text: Her other business interests include a theme park in Scandinavia and hotels in the West Country.
examples.translation: 她其他的公司股权包括斯堪的纳维亚的一个主题游乐园和英格兰西南部的几家酒店。

examples.text: ...the Hatch family, who controlled large dairy interests...
examples.translation: 掌控大量奶业股权的哈奇家族

examples.text: Disney will retain a 51 percent controlling interest in the venture.
examples.translation: 迪斯尼将保留该项目 51% 的控股权。

examples.text: The West has an interest in promoting democratic forces in Eastern Europe...
examples.translation: 东欧民主力量的发展与西方国家利害攸关。

examples.text: Domestic consumers of petroleum products have an interest in a secure source of petroleum products.
examples.translation: 石油产品的国内消费者希望其来源能够获得保障。

examples.text: Does your current account pay interest?...
examples.translation: 你的活期账户有利息吗？

examples.text: This is an important step toward lower interest rates.
examples.translation: 这是向较低利率迈出的重要一步。

examples.text: ...a call for all businessmen to work together in the interests of national stability.
examples.translation: 呼吁所有商人为了国家稳定而团结协作

meanings.meaning: 有趣的；引起兴趣的，令人关注的

examples.text: It was interesting to be in a different environment...
examples.translation: 到一个全新的环境中是很有意思的。

examples.text: The two halves of the town face each other, and both have interesting churches...
examples.translation: 城镇一分为二，两两相望,各自都有颇具趣味的教堂。

examples.text: His third album is by far his most interesting.
examples.translation: 他的第三张专辑是迄今最有味道的。

meanings.meaning: （使通过界面或接口）接合，连接；[计算机]使联系
相互作用（或影响）；交流，交谈

examples.text: ...a witty exploration of that interface between bureaucracy and the working world.
examples.translation: 对官僚阶层与劳动大众之间的临界区域的风趣探究

examples.text: ...the development of better user interfaces.
examples.translation: 更友好的用户界面的开发

examples.text: ...the way we interface with the environment...
examples.translation: 我们与环境相互作用的方式

examples.text: The different components all have to interface smoothly...
examples.translation: 不同的部件都必须能顺利接合。

examples.text: He had interfaced all this machinery with a master computer.
examples.translation: 他把所有机器连接到了一台主计算机上。

examples.text: I wish everyone would stop interfering and just leave me alone...
examples.translation: 我希望大家都别再来干涉我,让我一个人静一静。

examples.text: The UN cannot interfere in the internal affairs of any country.
examples.translation: 联合国不能干涉任何国家的内政。

examples.text: Drug problems frequently interfered with his work...
examples.translation: 吸毒问题频频干扰他的工作。

examples.text: Alexander wasn't going to let a lack of space interfere with his plans...
examples.translation: 亚历山大不会让空间不够的问题妨碍他的计划。

examples.text: Smoking and drinking interfere with your body's ability to process oxygen.
examples.translation: 抽烟与酗酒有碍身体处理氧气的能力。

examples.text: The parliament described the decree as interference in the republic's internal affairs...
examples.translation: 议会形容此法令为对共和国内政的干涉。

examples.text: Airlines will be able to set cheap fares without interference from the government.
examples.translation: 航空公司将能脱离政府干预设定便宜的机票价格。

examples.text: ...electrical interference...
examples.translation: 电子干扰

examples.text: They have been accused of deliberately causing interference to transmissions.
examples.translation: 他们被指故意干扰信号传输。

meanings.meaning: 临时的，暂时的；中间的；间歇的
过渡时期，中间时期；暂定

examples.text: She was sworn in as head of an interim government in March.
examples.translation: 她3月份宣誓就任过渡政府首脑。

examples.text: ...an interim report.
examples.translation: 临时报告

examples.text: But, in the interim, we obviously have a duty to maintain law and order...
examples.translation: 但是,在过渡期间,我们显然有责任维护治安。

examples.text: He was to remain in jail in the interim.
examples.translation: 他在此期间将会继续被关押。

examples.text: The interior of the house was furnished with heavy, old-fashioned pieces...
examples.translation: 房子里摆放着笨重的旧式家具。

examples.text: The boat's interior badly needed painting.
examples.translation: 该船内部亟需油漆。

examples.text: The interior walls were painted green...
examples.translation: 内墙漆成了绿色。

examples.text: There is more interior space than in some rival cars...
examples.translation: 车内空间比有些同类车宽敞。

examples.text: He pulled the car over, turned on the interior light, examined the map.
examples.translation: 他把车开到路边,打开车内的照明灯查看地图。

examples.text: ...a 5-day hike into the interior.
examples.translation: 为期 5 天、深入内地的远足

examples.text: ...the unknown interior of South America...
examples.translation: 南美洲不为人知的腹地

examples.text: Many areas in the country's interior are unable to report Aids cases immediately.
examples.translation: 该国内地的很多地区无法即时报告艾滋病病例。

examples.text: The French Interior Minister has intervened in a scandal over the role of a secret police force.
examples.translation: 法国内政部长对一起涉及秘密警察部队所扮演角色的丑闻进行了干预。

examples.text: An official from the Ministry of the Interior said six people had died.
examples.translation: 内政部的一位官员说已有 6 人丧生。

examples.text: She depicted the interior life of human beings, and particularly their moral stresses and strains.
examples.translation: 她描写人类的内心生活,尤其是他们所承受的道德压力。

examples.text: ...the mind's interior space.
examples.translation: 心灵的内在空间

examples.text: You should consider breaking the journey with intermediate stopovers at airport hotels.
examples.translation: 你应该考虑将旅程分为几段,中途在机场旅馆稍作停留。

examples.text: ...hourly trains to Perugia, Assisi, and intermediate stations.
examples.translation: 每小时都会发出的、开往佩鲁贾、阿西西与中间站的火车

examples.text: The Badminton Club holds coaching sessions for beginners and intermediate players on Friday evenings.
examples.translation: 羽毛球俱乐部每周五晚上为初学者与中等水平练习者开设训练课程。

examples.text: The ski school coaches beginners, intermediates, and advanced skiers.
examples.translation: 滑雪学校训练指导初学者及中级与高级滑雪者。

meanings.meaning: 间歇的；断断续续的；间歇性

examples.text: After three hours of intermittent rain, the game was abandoned.
examples.translation: 3 个小时断断续续的降雨之后,比赛取消了。

examples.text: The talks went on intermittently for three years.
examples.translation: 会谈开开停停地进行了 3 年。

meanings.meaning: 国际组织；国际体育比赛；外国居留者；国际股票
国际的；两国（或以上）国家的；超越国界的；国际关系的；世界的

examples.text: ...an international agreement against exporting arms to that country.
examples.translation: 禁止向该国出口武器的国际协定

examples.text: ...Kuwait International Airport.
examples.translation: 科威特国际机场

examples.text: ...emergency aid from the international community.
examples.translation: 国际社会提供的紧急援助

examples.text: There are only two internationally recognised certificates in Teaching English as a Foreign Language...
examples.translation: “作为外语的英语教学”只有两种国际上认可的证书。

examples.text: I am one of the few young women who has made it as a writer financially and internationally.
examples.translation: 我是为数不多的既获得财富又享有国际知名度的年轻女作家之一。

examples.text: ...the midweek international against England.
examples.translation: 周三对抗英格兰的国际比赛

examples.text: ...a former England international.
examples.translation: 前英格兰国手

examples.text: The country stepped up internal security...
examples.translation: 该国加强了国内安保。

examples.text: We now have a Europe without internal borders...
examples.translation: 我们如今拥有一个内部没有边界的欧洲。

examples.text: Mr Kelly posted his resignation letter to Mr Jones in the internal mail box.
examples.translation: 凯利先生把辞职信寄到了琼斯先生的内部邮箱里。

examples.text: The state is not a unified and internally coherent entity.
examples.translation: 该国不是一个统一的、内部团结的实体。

examples.text: ...massive internal bleeding...
examples.translation: 体内大出血

examples.text: Some of the internal walls of my house are made of plasterboard.
examples.translation: 我家房子的一些内墙是石膏板做的。

examples.text: Evening primrose oil is used on the skin as well as taken internally...
examples.translation: 夜来香油既可外敷于皮肤也可以内服。

examples.text: Internally, however, the two computers are so different that programs cannot be switched from one to the other.
examples.translation: 但是,这两台计算机内部配置迥异，以至于程序不能从其中一台转到另一台里面。

examples.text: No matter what, all of them are portable, on-the-go devices with Internet access, much like smartphones.
The whole speech might well be interpreted as a coded message to the Americans...
examples.translation: 整个演讲完全可以看成是在向美国人传递编码信息。

examples.text: The judge quite rightly says that he has to interpret the law as it's been passed...
examples.translation: 法官说他必须按照该法的立法初衷来阐释它，这完全没错。

examples.text: Both approaches agree on what is depicted in the poem, but not on how it should be interpreted.
examples.translation: 两种方法对诗中所描绘的是何种事物的看法是一致的,但是对于应该如何阐释这首诗有所分歧。

examples.text: The chambermaid spoke little English, so her husband came with her to interpret...
examples.translation: 女服务员几乎不会说英语,因此她丈夫跟着来给她做翻译。

examples.text: Interpreters found they could not interpret half of what he said.
examples.translation: 口译员们发现他说的话他们连一半都翻译不出来。

examples.text: Turkin tapped him on the shoulder. 'Sorry to interrupt, Colonel.'...
examples.translation: 图尔金拍拍他的肩膀。“不好意思打断您一下,上校。”

examples.text: He tried to speak, but she interrupted him.
examples.translation: 他想说话,但被她打断了。

examples.text: The sudden interruption stopped Beryl in mid-flow.
examples.translation: 突然的插话打断了刚说到一半的贝丽尔。

examples.text: He has rightly interrupted his holiday in Spain to return to London...
examples.translation: 他马上中止了在西班牙的度假回到伦敦。

examples.text: The match took nearly three hours and was interrupted at times by rain.
examples.translation: 比赛进行了将近3个小时,几次因雨而暂停。

examples.text: ...interruptions in the supply of food and fuel...
examples.translation: 食物与燃料供应的中断

examples.text: Motherhood did not constitute much of an interruption to her career...
examples.translation: 做母亲并没有在很大程度上中断她的事业。

examples.text: I was able to get on with my work without interruption.
examples.translation: 我可以不受打扰继续我的工作了。

examples.text: Taller plants interrupt the views from the house.
examples.translation: 稍高些的植物遮挡了房内的视线。

meanings.meaning: 交叉；十字路口；交集；交叉点

examples.text: ...at the intersection of two main canals.
examples.translation: 在两条大运河的交汇处

examples.text: ...a busy highway intersection.
examples.translation: 交通繁忙的公路交叉口

examples.text: The ferry service has restarted after an interval of 12 years...
examples.translation: 时隔12年之后，轮渡服务又重新开通了。
