examples.text: There was a long interval of silence.
examples.translation: 中间有很长时间的沉默。

examples.text: During the interval, wine was served...
examples.translation: 幕间休息时有葡萄酒供应。

examples.text: England were two goals behind at the interval.
examples.translation: 中场休息时英格兰队落后两球。

examples.text: She woke him for his medicines at intervals throughout the night.
examples.translation: 她夜里每隔一段时间就叫他起来服药。

examples.text: Several red and white barriers marked the road at intervals of about a mile...
examples.translation: 路上设有几处红白相间的路障，相互间隔约一英里。

examples.text: The trees which gave the road its name stood at regular intervals along the kerb...
examples.translation: 这条道路得名于这些树木，它们沿两边的路缘间隔均匀地排列着。

examples.text: At intervals there were red warning lights.
examples.translation: 红色警示灯一明一灭地闪着。

examples.text: The situation calmed down when police intervened...
examples.translation: 警方干预后，局势平息下来。

examples.text: The Government is doing nothing to intervene in the crisis.
examples.translation: 政府没有采取任何行动对这次危机进行干预。

examples.text: Hattie intervened and told me to stop it...
examples.translation: 哈蒂打断我，叫我停下来。

examples.text: 'I've told you he's not here,' Irena intervened.
examples.translation: “我告诉你了他不在这里,”伊雷娜插话说。

examples.text: The South African mailboat arrived on Friday mornings unless bad weather intervened...
examples.translation: 除非受恶劣天气干扰,南非邮船一般在星期五上午抵达。

examples.text: I pray that death may not intervene to prevent our meeting with my darling children.
examples.translation: 我祈祷死亡不要阻挠我们与我亲爱的孩子们见一面。

meanings.meaning: 采访；接见；对…进行面谈；对某人进行面试

examples.text: When I went for my first interview for this job I arrived extremely early...
examples.translation: 在参加这份工作的初次面试时,我到得非常早。

examples.text: The interview went well...
examples.translation: 面试进行得非常顺利。

examples.text: Not everyone who writes in can be invited for interview.
examples.translation: 并非每一个写来求职信的人都会被邀请参加面试。

examples.text: When Wardell was interviewed, he was impressive, and on that basis, he was hired...
examples.translation: 沃德尔参加面试的时候给人留下了深刻印象,所以基于这点,他被雇用了。

examples.text: He was among the three candidates interviewed for the job.
examples.translation: 他是3个来参加求职面试的人选之一。

examples.text: Allan gave an interview to the Chicago Tribune newspaper last month...
examples.translation: 艾伦上个月接受了《芝加哥论坛报》的采访。

examples.text: There'll be an interview with Mr Brown after the news.
examples.translation: 新闻过后播出的是对布朗先生的访谈。

examples.text: I seized the chance to interview Chris Hani about this issue.
examples.translation: 我抓住机会就这一问题采访了克里斯·哈尼。

examples.text: The police interviewed the driver, but had no evidence to go on.
examples.translation: 警方讯问了司机,但是没有获得什么有用的证据。

meanings.meaning: 亲密的；私人的；精通的；有性关系的

examples.text: I discussed with my intimate friends whether I would immediately have a baby.
examples.translation: 我与密友们讨论是否我要马上生孩子。

examples.text: They are to have an autumn wedding, an intimate of the couple confides.
examples.translation: 他们的婚礼将在秋季举行,这对情侣的一位密友透露说。

examples.text: He did not feel he had got to know them intimately.
examples.translation: 他认为他没必要和他们密切来往。

examples.text: I just won't discuss my intimate relationships.
examples.translation: 我就是不想讨论我的恋爱关系。

examples.text: ...their intimate moments with their boyfriends.
examples.translation: 她们与男友共浴爱河的时刻

examples.text: You have to be willing to get to know yourself and your partner intimately.
examples.translation: 你必须愿意在恋爱中逐渐认识自己和伴侣。

examples.text: He wrote about the intimate details of his family life...
examples.translation: 他写到了关于他家庭生活的一些不为人知的细节。

examples.text: I hate to interrupt your intimate conversation but we do have an assignment to discuss.
examples.translation: 我实在不愿打断你们的私人谈话,但是我们确实有事要谈。

examples.text: It was the first time they had attempted to talk intimately.
examples.translation: 那是他们第一次试图私下交谈。

examples.text: ...an intimate candlelit dinner for two.
examples.translation: 温馨的二人烛光晚餐

examples.text: ...an intimate connection between madness and wisdom...
examples.translation: 疯狂与智慧的密切关联

examples.text: France has kept the most intimate links with its former African territories.
examples.translation: 法国与其前非洲属地一直保持着最密切的联系。

examples.text: Property and equities are intimately connected in Hong Kong.
examples.translation: 在香港，房地产与证券密切关联。

examples.text: He surprised me with his intimate knowledge of Kierkegaard and Schopenhauer.
examples.translation: 他对克尔恺郭尔与叔本华的深刻了解让我很吃惊。

examples.text: ...a golden age of musicians whose work she knew intimately.
examples.translation: 其作品她耳熟能详的黄金一代的音乐家

examples.text: He went on to intimate that he was indeed contemplating a shake-up of the company...
examples.translation: 他继续暗示他确实在考虑对公司进行一次大改组。

examples.text: He had intimated to the French and Russians his readiness to come to a settlement.
examples.translation: 他已经向法国人和俄国人暗示他愿意达成协议。

examples.text: Jones had set out to intimidate and dominate Paul...
examples.translation: 琼斯开始恐吓并控制保罗。

examples.text: Attempts to intimidate people into voting for the governing party did not work.
examples.translation: 胁迫人们为执政党投票的企图没有成功。

examples.text: ...an inquiry into allegations of intimidation during last week's vote.
examples.translation: 对上周投票期间出现胁迫投票的指控的调查

meanings.meaning: 到…里；深入…之中；成为…状况；进入到…之内

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, into is used after some verbs and nouns in order to introduce extra information. Into is also used with verbs of movement, such as ‘walk’ and ‘push’, and in phrasal verbs such as ‘enter into’ and ‘talk into’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外, into 还可用在一些动词、名词后面以引出附加信息。into 还可与表示动作的动词如 walk，push连用,以及用于动词词组中，如 enter into, talk into。

examples.text: Until the 1980s almost all olives were packed into jars by hand.
examples.translation: 直到 20 世纪 80 年代,几乎所有的橄榄都是手工装罐的。

examples.text: I have no idea how he got into Iraq...
examples.translation: 我不知道他是怎样进入伊拉克的。

examples.text: She got up and went into an inner office...
examples.translation: 她站起来走进里间的办公室。

examples.text: He got into bed and started to read.
examples.translation: 他钻进被窝开始读书。

examples.text: Flavell had accidentally discharged a pistol, firing it into the ceiling...
examples.translation: 弗拉维尔不小心扳动了一把手枪的扳机，子弹射入了天花板。

examples.text: The rider came off and the handlebar went into his neck.
examples.translation: 骑车人从自行车上摔了下来,车把插进了他的脖子里。

examples.text: Poisonous smoke had got into the water supply...
examples.translation: 毒烟已经进入供水系统。

examples.text: The money went into a common fund.
examples.translation: 这笔钱被放到了一个普通基金里。

examples.text: A train plowed into the barrier at the end of the platform...
examples.translation: 火车撞上了月台尽头的栅栏。

examples.text: Joanna heard him bump into the table and curse again.
examples.translation: 乔安娜听见他撞到了桌子上，又骂骂咧咧的。

examples.text: She could change into a different outfit in two minutes...
examples.translation: 她能在两分钟内换上一套不同的行头。

examples.text: He put on his underwear and got into his suit.
examples.translation: 他穿好内衣,然后穿上西装。

examples.text: He had too much time on his hands and that caused him to get into trouble...
examples.translation: 他手头时间太富裕了,反倒为他惹来了麻烦。

examples.text: I slid into a depression.
examples.translation: 我逐渐消沉了。

examples.text: ...the group's plunge into financial crisis earlier in the year.
examples.translation: 该集团年初陷入财政危机

examples.text: Gerome tried to talk her into taking an apartment in Paris.
examples.translation: 杰罗姆试图说服她在巴黎买一套公寓。

examples.text: ...his attempt to turn a nasty episode into a joke.
examples.translation: 他想把一段很不愉快的插曲变成一则笑话的尝试

examples.text: ...learning what she needs to know to grow into a competent adult.
examples.translation: 学习那些要想成为真正意义上的成年人她必须知道的东西

examples.text: ...Irish fairytales that had been translated into English.
examples.translation: 被翻译成英语的爱尔兰童话故事

examples.text: Sixteen teams are taking part, divided into four groups...
examples.translation: 有16个队参加,分为4组。

examples.text: Roll out the pastry and cut into narrow strips...
examples.translation: 把油酥面团擀薄然后切成长条。

examples.text: Now if a great lake like Victoria were to dry up partially, it would be split into a number of separate, smaller lakes.
examples.translation: 现在如果像维多利亚湖这样的大湖部分干涸,它就会被分成若干独立的小湖泊。

examples.text: The concert will raise funds for research into Aids...
examples.translation: 这场音乐会将为艾滋病研究筹集资金。

examples.text: We are beginning to have some insight into drug therapy.
examples.translation: 我们开始对药物治疗有了一些深入了解。

examples.text: In the early 1990s, it was easy to get into the rental business...
examples.translation: 20 世纪 90 年代早期,进入租赁行业很容易。

examples.text: He closed down the business and went into politics.
examples.translation: 他关闭公司投身政治。

examples.text: He had three children, and lived on into his sixties...
examples.translation: 他有3个孩子,已经60多岁了。

examples.text: The Open Golf Championship will be getting into its second day in a few hours.
examples.translation: 再过几个小时,高尔夫公开锦标赛将进入第二天的比赛。

examples.text: I'm into electronics myself.
examples.translation: 我本身对电子很感兴趣。

examples.text: ...intricate patterns and motifs.
examples.translation: 复杂的式样与图案

examples.text: ...intricately carved sculptures.
examples.translation: 精雕细刻的雕塑品

meanings.meaning: 阴谋；诡计；复杂的事；私通
用诡计取得；激起...的兴趣

examples.text: ...political intrigue.
examples.translation: 政治阴谋

examples.text: ...a powerful story of intrigue, passion and betrayal.
examples.translation: 一个关于阴谋、激情与背叛的动人心魄的故事

examples.text: ...the plots and intrigues in the novel.
examples.translation: 小说中的阴谋与诡计

examples.text: The novelty of the situation intrigued him.
examples.translation: 周围环境的独具一格令他着迷。

examples.text: The paintings have no intrinsic value except as curiosities...
examples.translation: 这些油画除了作为古董，本身没有什么内在价值。

examples.text: The rate is determined by intrinsic qualities such as the land's slope.
examples.translation: 速度由诸如地面坡度这样的内在因素决定。

examples.text: Sometimes I wonder if people are intrinsically evil...
examples.translation: 有时我在想是否人性本恶。

examples.text: It was intrinsically a very powerful ship.
examples.translation: 它本身是一艘动力非常强劲的船。

examples.text: The Government has introduced a number of other money-saving moves...
examples.translation: 政府已经采取了其他一些省钱的举措。

examples.text: I kept the birds indoors all winter and introduced them into an aviary the following June...
examples.translation: 整个冬天我把鸟关在室内,然后在接下来的6月份把它们放入鸟类饲养场饲养。

examples.text: The word 'Pagoda' was introduced to Europe by the 17th century Portuguese.
examples.translation: Pagoda 这个词由 17 世纪的葡萄牙人引入欧洲。

examples.text: He is best remembered for the introduction of the moving assembly-line.
examples.translation: 他最为人铭记的创举是率先采用流水装配线。

examples.text: ...the introduction of a privacy bill to prevent press intrusions into private lives.
examples.translation: 实施隐私法以阻止新闻媒体对私人生活的侵扰

examples.text: He introduced us to the delights of natural food.
examples.translation: 他让我们认识到食用天然食物的乐趣。

examples.text: His introduction to League football would have been gentler if he had started at a smaller club...
examples.translation: 如果他是在小点的俱乐部起步的话,他的首次足球联赛经历可能会更轻松些。

examples.text: It was Sergeant Miller's introduction to a crime which has occupied him for nearly nine years.
examples.translation: 米勒巡佐从未用这么久的时间处理一宗罪案,它已花了他将近9年的时间。

examples.text: Tim, may I introduce you to my uncle's secretary, Mary Waller?...
examples.translation: 蒂姆,我来介绍一下，这位是我叔叔的秘书玛丽·沃勒。

examples.text: Someone introduced us and I sat next to him...
examples.translation: 有人给我们作了介绍,我挨着他坐下了。

examples.text: We haven't been introduced. My name is Nero Wolfe...
examples.translation: 还没人介绍我们。我叫尼罗·沃尔夫。

examples.text: Let me introduce myself.
examples.translation: 我来自我介绍一下。

examples.text: With considerable shyness, Elaine performed the introductions.
examples.translation: 伊莱恩非常害羞地进行了介绍。

examples.text: 'Health Matters' is introduced by Dick Oliver on BBC World Service.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司对外广播频道的“健康动态”节目由迪克·奥利弗主持。

meanings.meaning: 介绍；引进；采用；入门；传入

examples.text: Ellen Malos, in her introduction to 'The Politics of Housework', provides a summary of the debates.
examples.translation: 埃伦·马洛斯在她为《家务政治学》一书所作的序言中对这些争论进行了总结。

examples.text: On balance, the book is a friendly, down-to-earth introduction to physics.
examples.translation: 总而言之,这是一本通俗而务实的物理入门书。

examples.text: ...'Psychology and Language: An Introduction to Psycholinguistics'.
examples.translation: 《心理学与语言：心理语言学入门》

examples.text: There are two among their recent introductions that have greatly impressed me.
examples.translation: 在他们最近引进的东西里面有两样给我留下了非常深刻的印象。

examples.text: Michael Jackson, of course, needs no introduction.
examples.translation: 迈克尔·杰克逊,当然,众所周知。

examples.text: The press has been blamed for intruding into people's personal lives in an unacceptable way...
examples.translation: 新闻媒体因为以令人难以容忍的方式侵扰人们的私生活而一直受到指责。

examples.text: I don't want to intrude on your meeting...
examples.translation: 我不想打扰你们的会议。

examples.text: I hope I'm not intruding.
examples.translation: 希望我没有打扰你们。

examples.text: Do you feel anxious when unforeseen incidents intrude on your day?...
examples.translation: 当意外事件干扰了你的生活时,你会感到焦虑吗？

examples.text: There are times when personal feelings cannot be allowed to intrude.
examples.translation: 有些时候是不允许夹杂个人感情的。

examples.text: The officer on the scene said no one had intruded into the area.
examples.translation: 在场的警官说没人闯入过这个地方。

examples.text: We believe they intruded on to the field of play...
examples.translation: 我们认为他们擅自闯入了球场。

examples.text: The voyage home began, but not before an intruding aeroplane had repeatedly circled the ship.
examples.translation: 开始返航了,但是在这之前一架入侵的飞机曾反复在轮船上空盘旋。

meanings.meaning: 直觉；直觉力；直觉的知识

examples.text: Her intuition was telling her that something was wrong...
examples.translation: 她的直觉告诉她一定出了什么问题。

examples.text: You can't make a case on your intuitions, Phil.
examples.translation: 菲尔,你不能凭直觉来作出解释。

examples.text: In autumn 1944 the allies invaded the Italian mainland at Anzio and Salerno...
examples.translation: 1944 年秋，盟军从安齐奥与萨勒诺攻入意大利本土。

examples.text: The Romans and the Normans came to Britain as invading armies.
examples.translation: 罗马人以及诺曼人通过军事入侵来到英国。

examples.text: People invaded the streets in victory processions almost throughout the day...
examples.translation: 几乎一整天,大街上都挤满了欢庆胜利的游行队伍。

examples.text: Every so often the kitchen would be invaded by ants.
examples.translation: 厨房常常会遭到大批蚂蚁的进犯。

meanings.meaning: 变得病弱；因病而奉命退役

examples.text: I hate being treated as an invalid.
examples.translation: 我讨厌被人当作伤病号对待。

examples.text: The trial was stopped and the results declared invalid...
examples.translation: 审判被中止,判决结果被宣布无效。

examples.text: We cannot accept liability if you are refused entry because of invalid documents.
examples.translation: 如果你因证件无效被拒入内,我们不承担责任。

examples.text: ...the invalidity of the marriage ceremony.
examples.translation: 结婚仪式无效

examples.text: We think that those arguments are rendered invalid by the hard facts on the ground.
examples.translation: 我们认为那些论点当场即被确凿的事实驳倒了。

examples.text: I was able to gain invaluable experience over that year...
examples.translation: 在那一年里我有幸获得了非常宝贵的经验。

examples.text: The research should prove invaluable in the study of linguistics...
examples.translation: 该调查研究在语言学研究领域的重要性应该会得到证实。

examples.text: Their advice was invaluable to me at that stage of my work.
examples.translation: 他们的建议对我那一阶段的工作非常宝贵。

examples.text: They almost invariably get it wrong...
examples.translation: 他们几乎总是理解错。

examples.text: Their teamwork was invariably good...
examples.translation: 他们的团队协作总是很好。

examples.text: Invariably, he keeps the refrigerator well stocked.
examples.translation: 他总是把冰箱塞得满满的。

examples.text: ...seven years after the Roman invasion of Britain...
examples.translation: 罗马人入侵英国7年以后

examples.text: He was commander in chief during the invasion of Panama.
examples.translation: 在侵略巴拿马的战役中他是总司令。

examples.text: ...this year's annual invasion of flies, wasps and ants...
examples.translation: 今年，苍蝇、黄蜂和蚂蚁同往年一样的大批进犯

examples.text: Seaside resorts such as Blackpool and Brighton are preparing for a tourist invasion.
examples.translation: 像布莱克浦与布赖顿这样的海滨胜地正为游客的大批涌入做准备。

examples.text: Is reading a child's diary always a gross invasion of privacy?
examples.translation: 偷看孩子的日记一定是对个人隐私的严重侵犯吗？

examples.text: ...the first skirmish in the invasion of the British Parliament by Brussels.
examples.translation: 布鲁塞尔干扰英国议会的首次摩擦

examples.text: He invented the first electric clock...
examples.translation: 他发明了第一个电动机械钟。

examples.text: Writing had not been invented as yet.
examples.translation: 书写体系当时还没有创造出来。

examples.text: I stood still, trying to invent a plausible excuse.
examples.translation: 我站着不动,试图编个说得过去的借口。

meanings.meaning: 发明；发明物；虚构；发明才能

examples.text: It's been a tricky business marketing his new invention...
examples.translation: 推广他的新发明一直是件棘手的事情。

examples.text: The spinning wheel was a Chinese invention.
examples.translation: 纺车是中国人的发明。

examples.text: More than eight million books were printed within fifty years after the invention of the printing press.
examples.translation: 印刷机发明以后的 50 年间,有 800 多万册图书被印刷。

examples.text: ...the invention of the telephone.
examples.translation: 电话的发明

examples.text: In these and several other respects, there are many inventions and exaggerations...
examples.translation: 在这些方面和其他几个方面都存在许多捏造与夸张之处。

examples.text: The story was certainly a favourite one, but it was undoubtedly pure invention.
examples.translation: 这个故事当然特别受欢迎,但它无疑纯属虚构。

examples.text: ...his great powers of invention.
examples.translation: 他出色的创造才能

meanings.meaning: 存货，存货清单；详细目录；财产清册

examples.text: Before starting, he made an inventory of everything that was to stay.
examples.translation: 开始之前,他把所有要留下的东西列了详细的清单。

examples.text: ...one inventory of twelve sails for each yacht.
examples.translation: 每艘快艇 12 张帆的储备

examples.text: The tension grew in inverse proportion to the distance from their final destination.
examples.translation: 拉力的大小与他们离终点的距离成反比。

examples.text: The size of the nebula at this stage is inversely proportional to its mass.
examples.translation: 这个阶段星云的大小与其质量成反比。

examples.text: There is no sign that you bothered to consider the inverse of your logic.
examples.translation: 你根本就不想把你的逻辑反过来考虑。

examples.text: The hologram can be flipped to show the inverse image.
examples.translation: 全息图可以通过反转显现出逆像。

meanings.meaning: 使…转化；使…颠倒；使…反转；使…前后倒置
颠倒的事物；倒置物；倒悬者

examples.text: Invert the cake onto a cooling rack.
examples.translation: 把蛋糕倒扣在冷却架上。

examples.text: ...a black inverted triangle.
examples.translation: 一个黑色的倒三角

examples.text: They may be hoping to invert the presumption that a defendant is innocent until proved guilty.
examples.translation: 他们可能有望颠覆“被告在证实有罪之前是无辜的”这一假设。

examples.text: ...a telling illustration of inverted moral values.
examples.translation: 是非颠倒的道德观的有力证明

meanings.meaning: 投资；覆盖；耗费；授予；包围

examples.text: They intend to invest directly in shares...
examples.translation: 他们打算直接投资股票。

examples.text: He invested all our profits in gold shares...
examples.translation: 他把我们所有的收益都投资在黄金股上了。

examples.text: When people buy houses they're investing a lot of money.
examples.translation: 购买房子时,人们是在进行大笔的投资。

examples.text: ...the British government's failure to invest in an integrated transport system.
examples.translation: 英国政府未能给综合交通系统的建设投入资金

examples.text: ...the European Investment Bank, which invested £100 million in Canary Wharf...
examples.translation: 向卡纳里码头投资了1亿英镑的欧洲投资银行

examples.text: Why does Japan invest, on average, twice as much capital per worker per year than the United States?
examples.translation: 为什么日本平均每年在每个工人身上的投入是美国的两倍呢？

examples.text: The company invested thousands in an electronic order-control system...
examples.translation: 公司耗资数千购买了一套电子订单管理系统。

examples.text: The easiest way to make ice cream yourself is to invest in an ice cream machine.
examples.translation: 自己制作冰激凌的最简单的办法就是买一台冰激凌机。

examples.text: I would rather invest time in Rebecca than in the kitchen.
examples.translation: 我宁愿把时间花在丽贝卡身上也不愿花在厨房里。

examples.text: The buildings are invested with a nation's history...
examples.translation: 这些建筑承载着一个国家的历史。

examples.text: A tsar was a living icon, invested with deep historical and religious significance.
examples.translation: 沙皇曾是活着的圣像,具有深远的历史和宗教意义。

examples.text: The constitution had invested him with certain powers.
examples.translation: 宪法授予他某些权力。

examples.text: Gas officials are investigating the cause of an explosion which badly damaged a house in Hampshire...
examples.translation: 煤气系统的官员正在调查一起瓦斯爆炸的起因,这起事故严重毁坏了汉普郡的一所房屋。

examples.text: The two officers were being investigated by the director of public prosecutions...
examples.translation: 两名警官正在接受检察官的审查。

examples.text: Police are still investigating how the accident happened.
examples.translation: 警方仍然在调查事故的起因。

examples.text: He ordered an investigation into the affair...
examples.translation: 他命令对此事件展开调查。

examples.text: He has been notified by magistrates that he is under investigation for corruption.
examples.translation: 地方法官告知他因为贪污腐败问题正在对他进行审查。

examples.text: He said the government must introduce tax incentives to encourage investment...
examples.translation: 他说政府必须推出税收激励政策来鼓励投资。

examples.text: One of the most important changes concerns the investment of pension contributions.
examples.translation: 最重要的一个变化涉及养老保险基金的投资。

examples.text: ...investment bankers.
examples.translation: 投资银行家

examples.text: ...an investment of twenty-eight million pounds...
examples.translation: 2,800万英镑的投资金额

examples.text: You'll be able to earn an average rate of return of 8% on your investments.
examples.translation: 你将能获得 8% 的平均投资收益率。

examples.text: ...people's desire to buy a house as an investment...
examples.translation: 人们买房投资的强烈意愿

examples.text: Total foreign investment in America still constitutes only about 5% of U.S. assets.
examples.translation: 美国的外资总额仍然只占美国资产的 5%左右。

examples.text: When selecting boots, fine, quality leather will be a wise investment...
examples.translation: 在挑选长筒靴的时候,购买上等的好皮靴将是明智的选择。

examples.text: A small-screen portable TV can be a good investment.
examples.translation: 小屏幕的便携式电视机很值得买。

examples.text: I worry about this big investment of time and effort.
examples.translation: 我担心投入这么多时间与精力却不起作用。

meanings.meaning: 无形的，看不见的；无形的；不显眼的，暗藏的

examples.text: The lines were so finely etched as to be invisible from a distance...
examples.translation: 线条被蚀刻得如此精细，在远处看都看不见。

examples.text: The belt is invisible even under the thinnest garments.
examples.translation: 这种腰带即便在最薄的衣衫下都看不出来。

examples.text: A thin coil of smoke rose almost invisibly into the sharp, bright sky.
examples.translation: 一缕缭绕升起的轻烟几乎淡不可见地消失在明亮耀眼的天空中。

examples.text: Parents fear they might overstep these invisible boundaries...
examples.translation: 父母担心他们可能会逾越这些无形的界限。

examples.text: Her father's face had suddenly tightened as though he was being strangled by invisible hands.
examples.translation: 她父亲的脸突然僵硬了,仿佛是被无形的双手扼住了脖子。

examples.text: ...the tradition that invisibly shapes things in the present.
examples.translation: 不知不觉地塑造着当前的一切的传统

examples.text: It was strange, how invisible a clerk could feel...
examples.translation: 一名办事员会感到如此受人忽视，令人觉得不可思议。

examples.text: The problems of the poor are largely invisible.
examples.translation: 穷人的问题大多不受重视。

examples.text: ...the invisibility of women's concerns in society.
examples.translation: 社会对女性所关注问题的忽视

examples.text: ...The Invisible Man.
examples.translation: 《隐形人》

examples.text: Tourism is Britain's single biggest invisible export...
examples.translation: 旅游业是英国最大的一项无形输出。

examples.text: The revenue from tourism is the biggest single item in the country's invisible earnings...
examples.translation: 旅游业收入是该国无形收益当中最大的一项。

examples.text: The invisible trade surplus was £200 million lower than reported.
examples.translation: 无形贸易盈余比报道所称的少 2 亿英镑。

examples.text: ...an invitation to lunch...
examples.translation: 共进午餐的邀请

examples.text: The Syrians have not yet accepted an invitation to attend...
examples.translation: 叙利亚人还没有接到出席邀请。

examples.text: He's understood to be there at the personal invitation of President Daniel Arap Moi.
examples.translation: 据悉他是应总统丹尼尔·阿拉普·莫伊亲自邀请而到场的。

examples.text: Hundreds of invitations are being sent out this week.
examples.translation: 本周将寄出数百份请柬。

examples.text: ...gold embossed invitation cards.
examples.translation: 烫金的请柬

examples.text: ...a war that most liberal Democrats regarded as an invitation to disaster...
examples.translation: 一场大部分自由民主党人认为会招致灾难的战争

examples.text: Don't leave your shopping on the back seat of your car — it's an open invitation to a thief.
examples.translation: 别把买的东西放在汽车后座上——那会招来小偷的。

examples.text: She invited him to her 26th birthday party in New Jersey...
examples.translation: 她邀请他去参加她在新泽西举行的 26 岁生日聚会。

examples.text: I invited her in for a coffee...
examples.translation: 我请她进来喝杯咖啡。

examples.text: Neighbours have invited us out, given us clothes, and taken us on excursions...
examples.translation: 邻居们请我们出去吃饭,给我们衣服,还带我们去远足。

examples.text: Barron invited her to accompany him to the races...
examples.translation: 巴伦邀请她陪他参加比赛。

examples.text: Sometimes it seems right to invite an entire class of children so no one will feel left out...
examples.translation: 有时似乎应该邀请全班孩子，这样任何人都不会感到被孤立。

examples.text: I haven't been invited.
examples.translation: 我没有被邀请。

examples.text: ...an invited audience of children from inner-city schools.
examples.translation: 从旧城区学校邀请来的小学生观众

examples.text: At a future date, managers will be invited to apply for a management buy-out...
examples.translation: 在将来的某天,经理们将受邀进行管理层收购。

examples.text: The person concerned would be shown the evidence in private and invited to stand down...
examples.translation: 将会向有关人员私下出示该证据,并要求其暂时离开证人席。

examples.text: If a new leader emerged, it would then be for the Queen to invite him to form a government...
examples.translation: 如果新首脑产生了,女王就会邀请他组建政府。

examples.text: The Department is inviting applications from groups within the Borough.
examples.translation: 该部门欢迎本行政区内各团体提出申请。

examples.text: I realise that an Englishman who generalises about Ireland invites trouble...
examples.translation: 我意识到英国人如果对爱尔兰问题加以泛化的话会招惹麻烦。

examples.text: Their refusal to compromise will inevitably invite more criticism from the UN.
examples.translation: 他们拒绝妥协必然会引发联合国的更多批评。

examples.text: They haven't got an invite to the wedding.
examples.translation: 他们还没收到参加婚礼的请柬。

meanings.meaning: 包含；牵涉；使陷于；潜心于

examples.text: Running a kitchen involves a great deal of discipline and speed...
examples.translation: 料理好厨房需要把一切都安排得规规矩矩，且要讲求速度。

examples.text: Nicky's job as a public relations director involves spending quite a lot of time with other people.
examples.translation: 尼基作为公共关系主管，需要花很多时间与别人打交道。

examples.text: If there was a cover-up, it involved people at the very highest levels of government.
examples.translation: 如果有人想要隐瞒实情,那其中就涉及政府部门最高层的人物。

examples.text: ...a riot involving a hundred inmates...
examples.translation: 有 100 名囚犯参与的暴动

examples.text: Detectives launched an operation involving Interpol and Nigerian police.
examples.translation: 侦探们联合国际刑警与尼日利亚警方开展了一项行动。

examples.text: I seem to have involved myself in something I don't understand.
examples.translation: 我似乎卷入了一件我并不知情的事情当中。

examples.text: Noel and I do everything together, he involves me in everything...
examples.translation: 我和诺埃尔什么事情都一起做,他让我参与所有的事。

examples.text: Before too long he started involving me in the more confidential aspects of the job.
examples.translation: 不久,他便开始让我介入工作中更机密的方面。

examples.text: A late booking may involve you in extra cost...
examples.translation: 预订晚了的话你可能要额外多花钱。

examples.text: This involved me in a round trip of over 400 miles.
examples.translation: 为此我需要往返旅行 400 多英里。

meanings.meaning: 向内的；内部的；精神的；本质上的；熟悉的

examples.text: I sighed with inward relief.
examples.translation: 我心里舒了一口气。

examples.text: ...a glow of inward satisfaction.
examples.translation: 内心强烈的满足感

examples.text: Chantal smiled inwardly...
examples.translation: 尚塔尔内心窃喜。

examples.text: Sara, while remaining outwardly amiable toward all concerned, was inwardly furious.
examples.translation: 萨拉尽管表面上对所有相关的人依然和蔼可亲,内心却怒火中烧。

examples.text: ...a sharp, inward breath like a gasp...
examples.translation: 像倒抽气一样猛地吸入一口气

examples.text: The athlete takes off from one leg from an inward twist.
examples.translation: 这名运动员向内转体一周单腿起跳。

examples.text: The huge, iron gate was locked.
examples.translation: 巨大的铁门紧锁着。

examples.text: ...the highest grade iron ore deposits in the world...
examples.translation: 世界上最优质的铁矿层

examples.text: Some would call these odd pieces of iron and wood 'antiques'...
examples.translation: 有些人会把这些奇怪的铁片与木块称作“古董”。

examples.text: He was a tall, lanky man with iron-grey hair.
examples.translation: 他是个瘦高个子，一头铁灰色头发。

examples.text: She used to iron his shirts...
examples.translation: 她以前常给他熨衬衫。

examples.text: ...a freshly ironed shirt.
examples.translation: 刚熨过的衬衫

examples.text: I managed to get all the ironing done this morning.
examples.translation: 我今天上午努力熨完了所有的衣服。

examples.text: ...a man of icy nerve and iron will...
examples.translation: 有着冰一样冷静的神经与钢铁般坚强意志的人

examples.text: She delighted in the nickname, the 'iron lady'.
examples.translation: 她喜爱这个昵称——“铁娘子”。

examples.text: He died in 1985 after ruling Albania with an iron fist for 40 years.
examples.translation: 在以铁腕统治阿尔巴尼亚 40 年后，他于1985年去世。

examples.text: ...a people living permanently in the iron grip of poverty.
examples.translation: 永远无法摆脱贫困生活的民族

examples.text: Too many irons in the fire can sap your energy and prevent you from seeing which path to take.
examples.translation: 同时做太多事会使你精力衰竭,让你不知道该做哪件事。

meanings.meaning: 讽刺；反语；具有讽刺意味的事

examples.text: They find only irony in the narrator's concern...
examples.translation: 他们发现叙述者只是一味地嘲讽。

examples.text: Sinclair examined the closed, clever face for any hint of irony, but found none.
examples.translation: 辛克莱审视着那张不动声色的精明的脸庞，试图寻找任何冷嘲的迹象,但是却什么都没发现。

examples.text: The irony is that many officials in Washington agree in private that their policy is inconsistent...
examples.translation: 具有讽刺意味的是,华盛顿的很多官员都私下里承认他们的政策前后不一致。

examples.text: Opposition parties lost no time in stressing the irony of his return to power after being rejected by voters in November.
examples.translation: 他 11 月份遭选民否决后又重新上台，反对党马上对这一讽刺性现象大做文章。

meanings.meaning: 无关的；不考虑的；不顾的

examples.text: ...their commitment to a society based on equality for all citizens irrespective of ethnic origin...
examples.translation: 他们承诺建立一个不分种族出身、全民平等的社会

examples.text: This service should be available to everybody, irrespective of whether they can afford it.
examples.translation: 这项服务应该面向所有人,不管他们是否负担得起。

examples.text: None of the water from Lake Powell is used to irrigate the area.
examples.translation: 鲍威尔湖的水一滴都没有用于灌溉该地区。

examples.text: ...strips of cultivated land irrigated by a maze of interconnected canals.
examples.translation: 由纵横交错的运河灌溉的一条条狭长耕地区域

examples.text: The agricultural land is hilly and the irrigation poor.
examples.translation: 农田多为丘陵地,灌溉不足。

examples.text: ...a sophisticated irrigation system.
examples.translation: 先进的灌溉系统

examples.text: Their attitude irritates me...
examples.translation: 他们的态度激怒了我。

examples.text: Perhaps they were irritated by the sound of crying.
examples.translation: 也许他们被哭声惹烦了。

examples.text: Not surprisingly, her teacher is getting irritated with her.
examples.translation: 毫不奇怪,她的老师有点被她惹恼了。

examples.text: Wear rubber gloves while chopping chillies as they can irritate the skin.
examples.translation: 切辣椒时要戴橡胶手套,因为辣椒会刺激皮肤。

examples.text: ...a wonderful day trip to the picturesque island of Gozo...
examples.translation: 到风景如画的戈佐岛享受美妙的一日游

examples.text: We spent a day on Caldey Island.
examples.translation: 我们在科尔迪岛上度过了一天。

examples.text: ...the Canary Islands.
examples.translation: 加那利群岛

examples.text: ...the paradise isle of Bali.
examples.translation: 天堂一般的巴厘岛

examples.text: ...the Isle of Man.
examples.translation: 马恩岛

examples.text: This policy could isolate the country from the other permanent members of the United Nations Security Council...
examples.translation: 这一政策可能会使该国孤立于联合国安全理事会其他常任理事国之外。

examples.text: Political influence is being used to shape public opinion and isolate critics.
examples.translation: 政治影响正被用来左右公众舆论,使批评家们陷于孤立。

examples.text: They are finding themselves increasingly isolated within the teaching profession.
examples.translation: 他们发现自己在教育界越来越孤立无助。

examples.text: Diplomatic isolation could lead to economic disaster.
examples.translation: 外交孤立可能导致经济灾难。

examples.text: ...the public isolation of the Prime Minister.
examples.translation: 首相受到公众的冷落

examples.text: When he was thinking out a problem Tweed's habit was never to isolate himself in his room...
examples.translation: 思考问题的时候,特威德从来没有把自己关在房间里的习惯。

examples.text: His radicalism and refusal to compromise isolated him...
examples.translation: 他的激进主义与拒绝妥协使他受到孤立。

examples.text: Police officers had a siege mentality that isolated them from the people they served...
examples.translation: 警察们有一种受围心态,这使得他们脱离了所服务的群众。

examples.text: But of course no one lives totally alone, isolated from the society around them.
examples.translation: 但是,当然没人是完全脱离周围社会一个人生存。

examples.text: Our anxieties can also be controlled by isolating thoughts, feelings and memories...
examples.translation: 我们也可以通过将一些想法、感情与记忆分开考虑以控制焦虑情绪。

examples.text: ...attempts to isolate a single factor as the cause of the decline of Britain...
examples.translation: 试图分离出一种因素作为英国衰退的原因

examples.text: Gandhi said that those who isolate religion from politics don't understand the nature of either.
examples.translation: 甘地说过,那些主张政教分离者对两者的本质都不了解。

examples.text: We can use genetic engineering techniques to isolate the gene that is responsible...
examples.translation: 我们可以使用基因工程技术把相关基因分离出来。

examples.text: Researchers have isolated a new protein from the seeds of poppies.
examples.translation: 研究人员已经从罂粟种子里分离出一种新的蛋白质。

examples.text: ...the chemical isolated from brain tissue.
examples.translation: 从脑组织里分离出的一种化学物质

examples.text: Patients will be isolated from other people for between three days and one month after treatment...
examples.translation: 治疗结束后,病人将与其他人隔离3天到1个月的时间。

examples.text: You don't have to isolate them from the community.
examples.translation: 你没必要把他们与社区隔离。

meanings.meaning: 发行，发布；发给；放出，排出
发行；流出；造成…结果；传下

examples.text: Agents will raise the issue of prize-money for next year's world championships...
examples.translation: 经纪人将提出下年度世锦赛奖金的问题。

examples.text: A key issue for higher education in the 1990's is the need for greater diversity of courses...
examples.translation: 20 世纪 90 年代,高等教育的一个重要议题是要使课程更加多样化。

examples.text: Is it right for the Church to express a view on political issues?
examples.translation: 教会对政治问题发表看法是否恰当？

examples.text: I was earning a lot of money, but that was not the issue...
examples.translation: 我赚很多钱,但那不是最重要的。

examples.text: She avoided the issue by ordering a turkey sandwich...
examples.translation: 她点了份火鸡三明治,以此来避开这个重要问题。

examples.text: Do not draw it on the chart, however, as this will confuse the issue...
examples.translation: 但不用把它画到图上去,因为那样反而会混淆问题的重点。

examples.text: The real issue was never addressed.
examples.translation: 真正的要害问题根本没有被提及。

examples.text: The growing problem is underlined in the latest issue of the Lancet...
examples.translation: 最近一期的《柳叶刀》杂志中强调了这一日益严重的问题。

examples.text: I read Germaine Greer's article in the March issue with particular interest.
examples.translation: 我饶有兴致地阅读了杰曼·格里尔在三月那期发表的文章。

examples.text: Last night he issued a statement denying the allegations...
examples.translation: 昨晚他发表声明否认那些指控。

examples.text: The government issued a warning that the strikers should end their action or face dismissal...
examples.translation: 政府发布了警告,要求罢工者停止行动,否则将被解雇。

examples.text: Yesterday his kidnappers issued a second threat to kill him.
examples.translation: 昨天绑匪再次威胁要将他撕票。

examples.text: On your appointment you will be issued with a written statement of particulars of employment...
examples.translation: 正式任命时,你会拿到一份关于雇用细则的书面声明。

examples.text: Staff will be issued with new grey-and-yellow designer uniforms.
examples.translation: 将会向雇员发放灰黄相间的名牌新制服。

examples.text: ...a standard army issue rifle.
examples.translation: 一支常规军队配备的步枪

examples.text: A tinny voice issued from a speaker.
examples.translation: 扬声器里传出了细微的声音。

examples.text: The problems of immigration were not the question at issue...
examples.translation: 移民问题不在讨论之列。

examples.text: One of the main points at issue is that the Community wants the representatives to be based in East Jerusalem.
examples.translation: 争论的要点之一是,共同体希望代表们的总部设在东耶路撒冷。

examples.text: It seemed the Colonel had no desire to make an issue of the affair.
examples.translation: 看上去上校不想在那件事上挑起争端。

examples.text: Sister Morrison might take issue with me on that matter...
examples.translation: 莫里森修女在那件事上或许会和我持不同意见。

examples.text: I will not take issue with the fact that we have a recession.
examples.translation: 我不否认经济衰退的事实。

examples.text: I think once you do have issues with food you're going to have them for the rest of your life.
examples.translation: 我认为一旦你吃东西有问题的话,你可能终生都会如此。

meanings.meaning: (It)人名；(缅)意；(中)热(广东话·威妥玛)

examples.text: He saw the grey Land-Rover down the bypass. It was more than a hundred yards from him...
examples.translation: 他看见那辆灰色的路虎越野车停在不远处的边道上,离他一百码开外。

examples.text: It's a wonderful city, really. I'll show it to you if you want...
examples.translation: 这真是一座很棒的城市,如果你愿意的话我领你看看。

examples.text: My wife has become crippled by arthritis. She is embarrassed to ask the doctor about it...
examples.translation: 我妻子因为患关节炎腿瘸了。她不好意思去向医生询问相关病情。

examples.text: I took a lot of convincing that parenthood was a good idea and I didn't think I'd be much use at it.
examples.translation: 很多人都劝我要个孩子好，但我觉得为人父母我真的不适合。

examples.text: She could, if she wanted, compel him, through a court of law, to support the child after it was born...
examples.translation: 如果她愿意,她可以通过法庭强制他在孩子出生以后抚养孩子。

examples.text: He threw the baby high in the air and it stopped crying.
examples.translation: 他把孩子向空中高高抛起,孩子就停止了哭闹。

examples.text: He was through with sports, not because he had to be but because he wanted it that way...
examples.translation: 他放弃了体育运动,不是因为被迫而是出于自愿。

examples.text: Antonia will not be jealous, or if she is, she will not show it.
examples.translation: 安东尼娅不会嫉妒,即便嫉妒,她也不会表现出来。

examples.text: It was nice to see Steve again...
examples.translation: 再次见到史蒂夫真是太好了。

examples.text: It's a pity you never got married, Sarah...
examples.translation: 萨拉,你没结过婚真是遗憾啊。

examples.text: It's funny how you remember things...
examples.translation: 你回忆往事的方式真好笑。

examples.text: It's good of him to spare the time to visit at all...
examples.translation: 他能抽出时间过来看看真是不错。

examples.text: Is it possible he'll phone you?...
examples.translation: 他有可能给你打电话吗？

examples.text: He found it hard to work with a microphone pointing at him...
examples.translation: 他发觉对着麦克风他很难专心工作。

examples.text: I know it's a good idea to use dental floss...
examples.translation: 我知道用洁牙线是一个好主意。

examples.text: It's up to us to change things we don't like...
examples.translation: 能否改变那些我们不喜欢的事情取决于我们自己。

examples.text: It seems that you are letting things get you down.
examples.translation: 看上去你快要累趴下了。

examples.text: It has been said that stress causes cancer...
examples.translation: 据说压力会引发癌症。

examples.text: Yesterday it was reported that a number of people had been arrested in the capital...
examples.translation: 昨天据报道有很多人在首都被捕。

examples.text: It was noted that within a year the incidence of illness had increased quite significantly.
examples.translation: 据观察一年之内发病率显著上升。

examples.text: Of course, as it turned out, three-fourths of the people in the group were psychiatrists...
examples.translation: 当然,结果是那群人中 3/4 是精神病学家。

examples.text: I like it here...
examples.translation: 我喜欢这里。

examples.text: We live in a world in which only the strongest can make it to the top.
examples.translation: 我们生活在这样一个世界里——只有最强的人才能爬得最高。

examples.text: It's three o'clock in the morning...
examples.translation: 现在是凌晨 3 点整。

examples.text: It was a Monday, so she was at home...
examples.translation: 那天是星期一,因此她在家里。

examples.text: It's December 1989, in Las Vegas.
examples.translation: 那是 1989 年 12 月,在拉斯维加斯。

examples.text: It was very wet and windy the day I drove over the hill to Milland...
examples.translation: 那天风雨交加,我开车翻过小山去米兰德。

examples.text: It's getting dark. Let's go inside...
examples.translation: 天色暗下来了,我们进去吧。

examples.text: It was warm in the kitchen.
examples.translation: 厨房里真暖和。

examples.text: 'Who is it?' he called. — 'It's your neighbor.'...
examples.translation: “是谁啊?”他问道。——“是你的邻居。”

examples.text: Hello Freddy, it's only me, Maxine.
examples.translation: 你好,弗蕾迪！是我,玛克辛。

examples.text: It's really the poor countries that don't have an economic base that have the worst environmental records...
examples.translation: 确实是那些没有经济基础的穷国的环境记录最差。

examples.text: It was the country's rulers who devised this system...
examples.translation: 是该国的执政者创造了这一体制。

examples.text: It was I who found him there...
examples.translation: 是我发现了他在那里。

examples.text: It's my father they're accusing.
examples.translation: 他们指控的是我父亲。

examples.text: It's not that I didn't want to be with my family...
examples.translation: 并不是我不想和家人在一起。

examples.text: It's not just that a gulf exists in living standards — there's a psychological ravine.
examples.translation: 不仅仅是生活水平上存在巨大差异，心理上也有鸿沟。

meanings.meaning: 条款，项目；一则；一件商品（或物品）

examples.text: The most valuable item on show will be a Picasso drawing...
examples.translation: 展览会上最贵重的展品是毕加索的一幅素描。

examples.text: The menu includes the occasional off-beat item.
examples.translation: 菜单中包括了偶尔会有的非传统菜肴。

examples.text: The other item on the agenda is the tour.
examples.translation: 日程中的另一项是旅游。

examples.text: There was an item in the paper about him.
examples.translation: 报纸上有一条关于他的报道。

examples.text: She and Gino were an item.
examples.translation: 她和吉诺曾是一对。

examples.text: The British Labor Party concludes its annual conference today in Brighton.
examples.translation: 英国工党的年度会议今天在布赖顿闭幕。

examples.text: ...Japan, with its extreme housing shortage...
examples.translation: 住房严重短缺的日本

examples.text: The dog lifted its head, listening...
examples.translation: 那条狗抬起头,竖耳倾听。

examples.text: I met one woman whose tiny baby had just died and whose other child was fighting for its life.
examples.translation: 我遇到了一个女人,她那一点点大的小宝宝刚刚死去,另一个孩子也在死亡线上挣扎。

examples.text: Scientists have discovered remarkable new evidence showing how the body rebuilds itself while we sleep...
examples.translation: 科学家们已经发现了令人瞩目的新证据,说明了人体在睡眠状态下是如何自我修复的。

examples.text: Unemployment does not correct itself.
examples.translation: 失业问题不会自行解决。

examples.text: ...the threat of Europe building trade business around itself.
examples.translation: 欧洲在周边地区建立贸易往来的威胁

examples.text: I think life itself is a learning process...
examples.translation: 我认为生活本身就是一个学习的过程。

examples.text: The involvement of the foreign ministers was itself a sign of progress...
examples.translation: 外交部长的介入本身就是取得进展的一个标志。

examples.text: He cheered up on Christmas Day itself.
examples.translation: 他圣诞节那天振作起来了。

examples.text: I was never really happy there, although the people were kindness itself...
examples.translation: 我在那里从来没有真正高兴过,虽然那里的人们非常亲切。

examples.text: Many men are charm itself...
examples.translation: 许多男人非常有魅力。

examples.text: He is rarely satisfied with anything less than perfection itself.
examples.translation: 他一般只对那些绝对完美的事情感到满意。

meanings.meaning: 短上衣，夹克；土豆皮；书籍的护封；文件套，公文夹
给…穿夹克；给…装护套；给…包上护封；〈口〉打

examples.text: ...a black leather jacket.
examples.translation: 黑色皮夹克

meanings.meaning: 使堵塞；挤进，使塞满；混杂；压碎

examples.text: ...home-made jam.
examples.translation: 自制果酱

examples.text: He picked his cap up off the ground and jammed it on his head...
examples.translation: 他从地上捡起帽子，猛地扣到头上。

examples.text: Pete jammed his hands into his pockets.
examples.translation: 皮特使劲把手插进口袋里。

examples.text: The second time he fired his gun jammed...
examples.translation: 他开第二枪时枪卡壳了。

examples.text: A rope jammed the boat's propeller...
examples.translation: 一根绳子卡住了船的螺旋桨。

examples.text: Cracks appeared in the wall and a door jammed shut...
examples.translation: 墙上出现了裂缝，一扇门卡住打不开了。

examples.text: The intake valve was jammed open...
examples.translation: 进气阀卡住了，关不上。

examples.text: Every few minutes the motor cut out as the machinery became jammed.
examples.translation: 机器老是卡住，马达隔不了几分钟就突然熄火。

examples.text: Hundreds of departing motorists jammed the roads.
examples.translation: 数百名打算驾车离开的司机堵住了道路。

examples.text: Trucks sat in a jam for ten hours waiting to cross the bridge.
examples.translation: 等待过桥的卡车堵了10个小时。

examples.text: Nearby roads and the dirt track to the beach were jammed with cars.
examples.translation: 附近通往海滩的公路和土路全都堵满了汽车。

examples.text: Hundreds of people jammed the boardwalk to watch...
examples.translation: 数百人挤在木板人行道上观看。

examples.text: They jammed into buses provided by the Red Cross and headed for safety.
examples.translation: 他们挤上红十字会派来的巴士前往安全的地方。

examples.text: The stadium was jammed and they had to turn away hundreds of disappointed fans.
examples.translation: 体育场里观众爆满，他们不得不将几百名失望的球迷拒之门外。

examples.text: They will try to jam the transmissions electronically.
examples.translation: 他们会试图用电子信号对发射进行干扰。

examples.text: The plane is used for electronic jamming and radar detection.
examples.translation: 这架飞机用于进行电子干扰和雷达探测。

examples.text: Hundreds of callers jammed the BBC switchboard for more than an hour...
examples.translation: 在一个多小时内，成百上千的来电使得英国广播公司的总机应接不暇。

examples.text: The telephone exchange has been jammed all day with people wanting to buy season tickets.
examples.translation: 很多人想买季票，电话总机一天到晚忙个不停。

examples.text: They were in a real jam, Bob thought glumly.
examples.translation: 他们确实遇上麻烦了，鲍勃闷闷不乐地想。

examples.text: He was jamming with his saxophone.
examples.translation: 他在即兴吹奏萨克斯管。

examples.text: ...a free-form jazz jam.
examples.translation: 随性的爵士乐即兴演出

examples.text: ...a jam session.
examples.translation: 即兴演奏环节

examples.text: We always have snow in January...
examples.translation: 我们这儿1月份总会下雪。

examples.text: She was born on January 6, 1946...
examples.translation: 她出生于1946年1月6日。

examples.text: I haven't seen my own daughter since last January.
examples.translation: 自去年1月起我就没见过女儿了。

meanings.meaning: 冲突；不一致；震惊；发刺耳声

examples.text: ...yellow cucumbers in great glass jars.
examples.translation: 存放在大玻璃罐里的黄瓜

examples.text: She opened up a glass jar of plums.
examples.translation: 她打开了装满梅子的玻璃罐。

examples.text: ...two jars of filter coffee.
examples.translation: 两罐滴漏式咖啡

examples.text: They had a few jars together.
examples.translation: 他们一起喝了几杯。

examples.text: Sometimes a light remark jarred on her father.
examples.translation: 有时候一句玩笑就会令她父亲不快。

examples.text: ...televised congressional hearings that jarred the nation's faith in the presidency...
examples.translation: 电视里播放的动摇了全国人民对总统信心的国会听证会

examples.translation: 这么多不同种类的养老金，你想要了解可得费点劲儿。

examples.text: I got up early the next morning to jog...
examples.translation: 第二天早晨我一大早起来去慢跑。

examples.translation: 第一天他勉强绕着整个街区跑了下来。

examples.translation: 他又去晨跑了。

examples.translation: 他并不是因为散步和慢跑而瘦下来的。

examples.translation: 请勿磕碰相机。

examples.translation: 警方已计划明天再现犯罪现场，希望当时路过的人能想起些什么。

examples.text: He debated whether to make a joke about shooting rabbits, but decided against it...
examples.translation: 他心里琢磨是否该开个有关打兔子的玩笑，但决定还是算了。

examples.translation: 洛娜边笑边和特雷弗打趣。

examples.translation: 这个项目花了很长的时间，斯蒂芬甚至打趣说它永远都没有结束的那一天。

examples.text: 'Well, a beautiful spring Thursday would probably be a nice day to be buried on,' Nancy joked.
examples.translation: “嗯，一个美丽的春天的周四可能是个下葬的好日子。”南希开玩笑说。

examples.text: It was probably just a joke to them, but it wasn't funny to me.
examples.translation: 对他们而言，那可能仅仅是个恶作剧，但对我来说，它一点也不好笑。

examples.text: Don't get defensive, Charlie. I was only joking...
examples.translation: 别这么大戒心，查理。我只不过是开开玩笑。

examples.text: 'I wish you made as much fuss of me,' Vera joked.
examples.translation: “我倒真希望你也能这么好好地关心我一下，”薇拉打趣道。

examples.text: It's ridiculous, it's pathetic, it's a joke...
examples.translation: 这真荒谬，简直是可悲、可笑。

examples.text: The police investigation was a joke. A total cover-up.
examples.translation: 警方的调查简直荒唐可笑，完全是在掩盖真相。

examples.text: Giving an arsonist a lighter is beyond a joke...
examples.translation: 把打火机交给纵火犯简直是不可理喻。

examples.text: I'm not afraid of a fair fight but this is beginning to get beyond a joke.
examples.translation: “我不怕公平地打上一架，但是这玩笑有点儿开过头了。”

examples.text: I wish I had your courage, Michael, to make a joke of it like that.
examples.translation: 我真希望能有你那样的勇气，迈克尔，能把事情那么一笑置之。

examples.text: Two hours on a bus is no joke, is it?
examples.translation: 在公交车上坐上两个小时可不轻松，对吧？

examples.text: 'For once,' he said, 'the joke's on me. And it's not very funny.'
examples.translation: “他说：“这一次玩笑反而开到自己身上来了。这一点儿也不好玩。”

examples.translation: 他们对投票本身不抱任何希望。

examples.translation: 如果你没得到任何结果，请和本地议员联系。

examples.translation: 得知这个消息，他高兴得手舞足蹈。

examples.translation: 法官将听证会延至下周二。

examples.translation: 法官席曼先生判处他终身监禁。

examples.translation: 参赛者将分成两个年龄段接受评判：5 至10岁和11至14岁。

examples.translation: 我愿意根据每本图书各自的优点来作出评价。

examples.translation: 联合国认为局势过于危险，因此撤出了救济人员。

examples.translation: 我认为这是有史以来播出的最烂的节目之一。

examples.translation: 医生认为，直到受伤之前，该男子的身体一直很好。

examples.translation: 关于其是否合理，两种看法可能都存在。

examples.text: It is important to judge the weight of your washing load correctly...
examples.translation: 正确估计待洗衣物的重量很重要。

examples.translation: 我估计他40岁上下。

examples.translation: 虽然能够隐隐约约看到海岸线，但无法估计出大概有多远。

examples.translation: 我估计，这些年来，我当老师的收入要比富特先生的收入低不少。

examples.text: I'm a pretty good judge of character...
examples.translation: 我很善于判断人的性格。

examples.translation: 看来我妹妹全然不懂得欣赏男性的魅力。

examples.translation: 从民意测验来看，他似乎胜券在握。

examples.translation: 从他讲这件事时笑的样子来看，那应该是很幽默的了。

examples.translation: 从创作能力来看，莫扎特20至30岁时显然精力充沛，身体健康。

examples.text: They were typed records of his bets, going back a couple of years as far as I could judge...
examples.translation: 据我判断，这些是他过去几年下注打赌的书面记录。

examples.text: The book, so far as I can judge, is remarkably accurate.
examples.translation: 就我看来，这本书内容相当准确。

examples.text: ...an independent judicial inquiry...
examples.translation: 独立的司法调查

examples.text: The last judicial hanging in Britain was in l964.
examples.translation: 英国最后一例绞刑判决是在1964年。

examples.text: ...judicial decisions.
examples.translation: 法庭的判决

examples.text: Even if the amendment is passed it can be defeated judicially.
examples.translation: 即使修正案获得通过，也有可能通过司法途径被废除。

examples.text: ...a jug of water.
examples.translation: 一壶水

examples.text: ...fresh orange juice...
examples.translation: 鲜榨橙汁

examples.text: Soak the couscous overnight in the juice of about six lemons.
examples.translation: 将粗麦粉浸于大约6个柠檬榨出的果汁中，浸泡整夜。

examples.text: When cooked, drain off the juices and put the meat in a processor or mincer.
examples.translation: 肉煮熟后，沥干肉汁，将其放入食品加工机或绞肉机中。

examples.text: In late July 1914, he and Violet spent a few days with friends near Berwick-upon-Tweed...
examples.translation: 1914年7月下旬，他和维奥莱特与几个朋友在特威德河畔贝里克附近度过了几天。

examples.text: I expect you to report for work on July the twenty-eighth.
examples.translation: 我希望你于7月28日报到上岗。

meanings.meaning: 连接，接合；交叉点；接合点

examples.text: Follow the road to a junction and turn left...
examples.translation: 沿着这条路到交叉路口，然后左转。

examples.text: Leave the M1 at junction 25...
examples.translation: 在25号交叉路口驶离1号高速公路。

examples.text: There's a good British Rail link at Clapham Junction.
examples.translation: 在克拉珀姆枢纽站有条很不错的英国铁路线。

meanings.meaning: 六月；琼（人名，来源于拉丁语，含义是“年轻气盛的六月”）

examples.text: He spent two and a half weeks with us in June 1986...
examples.translation: 1986年6月他和我们一起呆了两周半。

examples.text: I am moving out on June 5...
examples.translation: 我打算6月5号搬走。

examples.text: Last June I decided to take a trip to Marbella.
examples.translation: 去年6月我决定去马贝拉旅行。

examples.text: I jumped over the fence...
examples.translation: 我跳过了栅栏。

examples.text: They came into the front hall, stamping their boots and jumping up and down to knock the snow off...
examples.translation: 他们进入了前厅，跺着靴子，蹦跳着抖掉身上的雪。

examples.text: I'd jumped seventeen feet six in the long jump, which was a school record...
examples.translation: 我跳远曾经跳出了17.6英尺，创造了学校纪录。

examples.text: Whoever heard of a basketball player who doesn't need to jump?
examples.translation: 有谁听说过篮球运动员不需要跳跃的吗？

examples.text: She was taking tiny jumps in her excitement.
examples.translation: 她兴奋得又蹦又跳。

examples.text: He jumped out of a third-floor window...
examples.translation: 他从3楼的窗户跳了出去。

examples.text: She has jumped from an aeroplane four times...
examples.translation: 她已经4次从飞机上跳下。

examples.text: I jumped the last six feet down to the deck.
examples.translation: 最后的6英尺我一跃而下，跳到甲板上。

examples.text: He jumped the first fence beautifully.
examples.translation: 他轻松地跨过第一道栏。

examples.text: Adam jumped from his seat at the girl's cry...
examples.translation: 女孩儿一哭，亚当立即从座位上跳了起来。

examples.text: She jumped to her feet and ran downstairs...
examples.translation: 她突然站起来，跑下楼去了。

examples.text: 'I'll do it, Eleanor,' Angus said, jumping up.
examples.translation: “我来吧，埃莉诺，”安格斯腾地站起来说道。

examples.text: The phone shrilled, making her jump.
examples.translation: 刺耳的电话铃响了起来，把她吓了一跳。

examples.text: Sales jumped from $94 million to over $101 million...
examples.translation: 销售额从9, 400万美元激增到了1.0 1亿美元。

examples.text: The number of crimes jumped by ten per cent last year...
examples.translation: 去年犯罪率猛升了10%。

examples.text: Shares in Euro Disney jumped 17p.
examples.translation: 欧洲迪斯尼的股票价格迅速上涨了17便士。

examples.text: ...a big jump in energy conservation.
examples.translation: 大幅度的能源节约

examples.text: The prince refused to jump the queue for treatment at the local hospital.
examples.translation: 王子在本地医院候诊时拒绝插队。

examples.text: A week later, the same guys jumped on me on our own front lawn...
examples.translation: 一个星期后，同一伙人又在我们家门口的草坪上袭击了我。

examples.text: Two guys jumped me with clubs in the carpark.
examples.translation: 两个家伙在停车场用球棒袭击了我。

examples.text: Members of the public would jump at the chance to become part owners of the corporation.
examples.translation: 一些公众会迫不及待地想要抓住机会成为这家公司的持股人。

examples.text: A lot of people jumped on me about that, you know.
examples.translation: 你知道，那件事让很多人逮着机会批评我。

examples.text: Helicopters helped fire crews get a jump on the blaze...
examples.translation: 直升机帮助消防队员控制住了火势。

examples.text: The idea is to get the jump on him.
examples.translation: 想法是要胜过他。

examples.text: I don't think a lot of people will jump up and down and say 'thank heavens'..
examples.translation: 我并不认为很多人会欣喜若狂地说“感谢上帝”。

examples.text: Everybody still jumps up and down about being rid of tyrants.
examples.translation: 大家都还在为摆脱了暴君的统治而激动不已。

examples.text: ...the mountains and jungles of Papua New Guinea...
examples.translation: 巴布亚新几内亚的山脉和丛林

examples.text: The mountain area is covered entirely in dense jungle.
examples.translation: 山区完全掩映在茂密的丛林中。

examples.text: ...a remote jungle area.
examples.translation: 偏远的丛林地带

examples.text: ...a jungle of stuffed birds, knick-knacks, potted plants.
examples.translation: 堆满了鸟类标本、小摆设和盆栽植物的乱七八糟的地方

examples.text: Social security law and procedure remain a jungle of complex rules.
examples.translation: 有关社会保障的法律和程序仍旧是个充满错综复杂的规则的危险领域。

examples.text: ...the examination jungle.
examples.translation: 竞争激烈的考试

examples.text: If you make aggression pay, this becomes the law of the jungle...
examples.translation: 如果你通过侵略谋取利益，这就成了弱肉强食。

examples.text: The law of the jungle demands: kill or be killed.
examples.translation: 丛林法则要求的是：杀戮或者被杀。

meanings.meaning: 年少者，晚辈；地位较低者；大学三年级学生

examples.text: Junior and middle-ranking civil servants have pledged to join the indefinite strike.
examples.translation: 基层和中层公务员已承诺要加入到无限期罢工中来。

examples.text: ...a junior minister attached to the prime minister's office.
examples.translation: 在总理公署任职的助理部长

examples.text: The Lord Chancellor has said legal aid work is for juniors when they start out in the law.
examples.translation: 大法官曾说过，法律援助工作适合由初涉法律工作、年资较浅的律师来做。

examples.text: She now lives with actor Denis Lawson, 10 years her junior.
examples.translation: 她现在与比她小10岁的演员丹尼斯·劳森同居。

examples.text: His son, Arthur Ochs Junior, is expected to succeed him as publisher.
examples.translation: 他的儿子，小阿瑟·奥克斯，有望子承父业继续从事出版。

examples.text: Their youngest daughter Amy's a junior at the University of Evansville in Indiana...
examples.translation: 他们的小女儿埃米是印第安纳州埃文斯维尔大学三年级的学生。

examples.text: It was the summer before his junior year in high school.
examples.translation: 那是他升入高三前的那个夏天。

examples.text: Rose finds her furniture in junk shops...
examples.translation: 罗丝从旧货店买来了家具。

examples.text: What are you going to do with all that junk, Larry?
examples.translation: 这一大堆破烂儿你打算怎么处理，拉里？

examples.text: Consumers will not have to junk their old cassettes to use the new format...
examples.translation: 消费者将不必丢弃他们的旧盒带而采用新的制式。

examples.text: The Socialists junked dogma when they came to office in 1982.
examples.translation: 社会党人1982年上台执政后，就把其政治信条弃之不顾。

meanings.meaning: (Jury)人名；(西)胡里；(英、法)朱里；(德)尤里

examples.text: The jury convicted Mr Hampson of all offences.
examples.translation: 陪审团裁定汉普森先生全部罪名成立。

examples.text: ...the tradition of trial by jury.
examples.translation: 由陪审团审判的惯例

examples.text: I am not surprised that the Booker Prize jury included it on their shortlist.
examples.translation: 我毫不惊讶布克奖评委会将其列在入选名单中。

examples.text: The jury is out on whether or not this is true...
examples.translation: 这是否属实仍未得出定论。

examples.text: The jury is still out on what kind of solutions we might undertake.
examples.translation: 尚未确定我们可能采取何种解决办法。

meanings.meaning: 只是，仅仅；刚才，刚刚；正好，恰好；实在；刚要
公正的，合理的；正直的，正义的；正确的；公平的；应得的
(Just)人名；(英)贾斯特；(法)朱斯特；(德、匈、波、捷、挪)尤斯特；(西)胡斯特

examples.text: I've just bought a new house...
examples.translation: 我刚买了栋新房子。

examples.text: The two had only just met...
examples.translation: 这两个人只不过才刚刚认识。

examples.text: I just had the most awful dream...
examples.translation: 我刚做了个非常可怕的梦。

examples.text: I'm only just beginning to take it in that he's still missing.
examples.translation: 我刚刚才开始反应过来，原来他仍然下落不明。

examples.text: I'm just making the sauce for the cauliflower...
examples.translation: 我正在弄花椰菜的调味汁呢。

examples.text: I'm just going to walk down the lane now and post some letters...
examples.translation: 我正打算沿这条小巷往南走，去寄几封信。

examples.text: The Vietnam War was just about to end.
examples.translation: 那时越南战争就要结束了。

examples.text: Randall would just now be getting the Sunday paper...
examples.translation: 兰德尔这个时候应该正在拿周日的报纸。

examples.text: Just then the phone rang...
examples.translation: 正在那时，电话响了。

examples.text: I remember now. He arrived just at the moment it happened...
examples.translation: 现在我想起来了，他恰恰在事情发生的时候到了。

examples.text: Just as she prepared to set off to the next village, two friends arrived in a taxi.
examples.translation: 正当她准备出发去下一个村子时，两个朋友乘出租车来了。

examples.text: It's just a suggestion...
examples.translation: 这只是个建议。

examples.text: It's not just a financial matter...
examples.translation: 这不仅仅是资金的问题。

examples.text: You can tell just by looking at me that I am all right...
examples.translation: 你只用看看我就知道我很好了。

examples.text: The reason women are drinking is just because they like it.
examples.translation: 女人喝酒只是因为她们喜欢喝。

examples.text: That's just one example of the kind of experiments you can do...
examples.translation: 这只不过是你可以做的各种试验中的一例罢了。

examples.text: These are just a few of the many options available.
examples.translation: 这些只不过是众多可能的选择中的几个。

examples.text: Stephanie and David redecorated a room in just three days...
examples.translation: 斯蒂法妮和戴维仅仅花了3天就把一个房间装饰一新。

examples.text: Remember he's just fourteen years old.
examples.translation: 记住，他才14岁。

examples.text: Leaving like I did just made it worse...
examples.translation: 像我那样一走了之只会让事情变得更糟。

examples.text: They just hurt the people in their community, they didn't really solve any problem.
examples.translation: 他们只是伤害了他们社区的居民，并没有真正解决任何问题。

examples.text: Her hand was just visible by the light from the sitting room...
examples.translation: 借着起居室的灯光，勉强能看见她的手。

examples.text: It was Colin's voice, only just audible...
examples.translation: 那是科林的声音，勉强能听得见。

examples.text: I arrived just in time for my flight to London...
examples.translation: 我差一点就没赶上去伦敦的飞机。

examples.text: Jack took out his notes and talked for just under an hour...
examples.translation: 杰克掏出他的笔记，讲了将近一个小时。

examples.text: He could just reach the man's head with his right hand.
examples.translation: 他举起右手刚刚能够到那个男人的头。

examples.text: It's an old trick but it just might work...
examples.translation: 这是个老掉牙的把戏了，不过也许会有用。

examples.text: It may just be possible.
examples.translation: 那也许有可能。

examples.text: She just won't relax...
examples.translation: 她就是放松不下来。

examples.text: I knew you'd be here. I just knew...
examples.translation: 我知道你会在这儿的。我就是知道。

examples.text: Isn't it fantastic? Just look at that!...
examples.translation: 这是不是棒极了？看看那个！

examples.text: Just think, we should be home this time tomorrow...
examples.translation: 想象一下，明天的这个时候我们就到家了。

examples.text: I don't see the point in it really. It's just stupid...
examples.translation: 我真的不理解这到底有什么意义,简直是愚蠢透顶。

examples.text: Isn't he just the most beautiful thing you ever saw?
examples.translation: 他难道不是你见过的最美的事物么？

examples.text: Could you just give us a description of your cat?...
examples.translation: 能否请您向我们描述一下您的猫？

examples.text: Can you just lift the table for a second?...
examples.translation: 你把桌子抬起来一下好吗？

examples.text: I'm just going to ask you a bit more about your father's business...
examples.translation: 我只想再问一点儿有关你父亲的生意的情况。

examples.text: Just add water, milk and butter...
examples.translation: 只要加水、牛奶和黄油就行了。

examples.text: I'd just like to mention that, personally, I don't think it's wise...
examples.translation: 我只是想说，就我个人而言，我认为这并不明智。

examples.text: Just wait for me in the lounge.
examples.translation: 请在休息室里等我就行了。

examples.text: 'Let me in, Di.' — 'Okay. Just a minute.'
examples.translation: “让我进来，迪。”——“好的。稍等一下。”

examples.text: Well, now just a second, I don't altogether agree with the premise.
examples.translation: 嗯，且慢，我并不完全同意这个前提。

examples.text: 'That's crazy,' I said. 'Isn't it just?' he said...
examples.translation: “那简直是疯了，”我说。“谁说不是呢？”他说。

examples.text: 'The manager's going to have some tough decisions to make.' — 'Won't he just.'
examples.translation: “经理将要作一些非常艰难的决定。”——“确实如此。”

examples.text: I can just see the nasty suspicious looks I'd be getting from you if we started whispering together...
examples.translation: 要是我们开始凑在一起交头接耳，我简直能想象到你那种令人讨厌的怀疑的目光了。

examples.text: I can just hear her telling her friends, 'Well, I blame his mother!'
examples.translation: 我简直能听到她和她的朋友们说，“哎呀，都是他妈妈的错！”

examples.text: It is really not clear just why he became a Socialist...
examples.translation: 他为何成为社会党人的确切原因实际上还不清楚。

examples.text: There are no statistics about just how many people won't vote...
examples.translation: 没有统计数字表明具体将有多少人不参加投票。

examples.text: My arm hurts too, just here...
examples.translation: 我的胳膊也疼，就是这里。

examples.text: That's Warwick Road, just opposite Earls Court tube station.
examples.translation: 那是沃里克路，就在伯爵宫地铁站对面。

examples.text: Kiwi fruit are just the thing for a healthy snack...
examples.translation: 猕猴桃作为有益健康的零食是再好不过了。

examples.text: 'Let's get a coffee somewhere.'—'I know just the place.'
examples.translation: “我们找个地方喝杯咖啡吧。”——“我知道个好地方。”

examples.text: ...the bottle of whiskey that we had stashed behind the bookcase for just this eventuality.
examples.translation: 那瓶我们放在书架后面专为这种情况准备的威士忌

examples.text: Behind the facade they are just like the rest of us...
examples.translation: 在那副外表背后，他们和我们大家是完全一样的。

examples.text: He worked just as hard as anyone...
examples.translation: 他和所有人一样非常努力。

examples.text: At 62 years old, her voice sounded just the same as it did when she was 21.
examples.translation: 她62岁了，但嗓音还和21岁时一模一样。

examples.text: There are those who believe that Nick Price is just about the best golfer in the world...
examples.translation: 有一些人认为尼克·普赖斯几乎就是世界上最优秀的高尔夫球运动员了。

examples.text: What does she read? Just about everything...
examples.translation: 她看些什么书？几乎什么都看。

examples.text: 'His memory must be completely back, then?' — 'Just about.'
examples.translation: “这么说，他的记忆一定是完全恢复了？”——“差不多。”

examples.text: I can just about tolerate it at the moment...
examples.translation: 当时我差一点就忍受不了了。

examples.text: We've got just about enough time to get there.
examples.translation: 我们刚刚有足够的时间赶到那里。

examples.text: Eve, squinting at the clock, saw it was just on 7 a.m...
examples.translation: 伊夫眯着眼瞥了一下钟，看到差不多是早上7点钟。

examples.text: Many were retired people, and just on a fifth were in their fifties.
examples.translation: 许多都是退休的人，其中差不多有五分之一年龄在五十多岁。

examples.text: 'She has a large flat in Mayfair.' — 'Just so.'
examples.translation: “她在梅费尔有个大公寓。”——“正是。”

examples.text: I do her hair, and it has to be just so.
examples.translation: 我必须得按她的要求为她做头发。

examples.text: I'm sorry I struck you. I didn't mean to. It's just that I was so mad...
examples.translation: 很抱歉我打了你。我不是有意的，只不过我当时气极了。

examples.text: Your hair is all right; it's just that you need a haircut.
examples.translation: 你的头发挺好的；只是你需要剪剪了。

examples.text: In a just society there must be a system whereby people can seek redress through the courts...
examples.translation: 在一个公正的社会中，一定会有一套人们可以通过法庭寻求赔偿的体制。

examples.text: She fought honestly for a just cause and for freedom...
examples.translation: 她为了正义的事业和自由而光明正大地斗争。

examples.text: Was Pollard's life sentence just or was it too severe?
examples.translation: 判处波拉德终身监禁是公正合理还是量刑过重？

examples.text: They were not treated justly in the past...
examples.translation: 过去他们没有受到公正的对待。

examples.text: No government can justly claim authority unless it is based on the will of the people.
examples.translation: 除非以民众的意愿为基础，否则任何一个政府的当政都是名不正言不顺的。

meanings.meaning: 司法，法律制裁；正义；法官，审判员
(Justice)人名；(英)贾斯蒂斯，贾斯蒂丝(女名)

examples.text: He has a good overall sense of justice and fairness...
examples.translation: 他极富正义感和公平意识。

examples.text: He only wants freedom, justice and equality...
examples.translation: 他只要自由、公正和平等。

examples.text: There is no justice in this world!
examples.translation: 这个世界毫无公平可言！

examples.text: We are a minority and must win people round to the justice of our cause.
examples.translation: 我们属于少数群体，必须赢得人们对我们的正义事业的支持。

examples.text: Many in Toronto's black community feel that the justice system does not treat them fairly...
examples.translation: 多伦多的黑人群体中有很多人觉得司法制度对待他们有失公正。

examples.text: A lawyer is part of the machinery of justice.
examples.translation: 律师是司法体系的一部分。

examples.text: Thomas will be sworn in today as a justice on the Supreme Court.
examples.translation: 托马斯今天将宣誓就任最高法院法官。

examples.text: A preliminary hearing was due to start today before Mr Justice Hutchison, but was adjourned.
examples.translation: 今天法官哈奇森先生本来要主持一项预审，但暂时休庭了。

examples.text: They demanded that those responsible be brought to justice...
examples.translation: 他们要求将责任人缉拿归案。

examples.text: She'd need proof to bring Jason to justice.
examples.translation: 她需要有证据才能将贾森绳之以法。

examples.text: The photograph I had seen didn't do her justice...
examples.translation: 我看到的那张照片把她拍得走样了。

examples.text: Most TV sets don't have the sound quality to do justice to the music.
examples.translation: 大多数电视机的音质不好，无法播出原来的音乐效果。

examples.text: No one article can ever do justice to the topic of fraud...
examples.translation: 没有哪一篇文章能把欺诈这一话题讲得恰到好处。

examples.text: It is impossible here to do justice to the complex history of the Legion.
examples.translation: 在这里不可能完整地论述古罗马军团复杂的历史。

examples.text: I don't think he could do himself justice playing for England...
examples.translation: 我认为他为英格兰队效力时不可能充分发挥自己的水平。

examples.text: I don't think I can win, but I want to do myself justice.
examples.translation: 我认为我不会获胜，但我会尽自己最大的努力。

examples.text: Trial by television makes for very rough justice indeed.
examples.translation: 电视庭审实际上会令审判不公。

examples.text: It would have been rough justice had he been deprived of this important third European win.
examples.translation: 要是他被剥夺了这一意义重大的第三个欧洲冠军头衔，那对他简直是太不公平了。

examples.text: No argument can justify a war...
examples.translation: 任何理由都不能为战争开脱。

examples.text: Ministers agreed that this decision was fully justified by economic conditions.
examples.translation: 部长们一致同意，这个决定完全符合经济情况。

examples.text: Click on this icon to align or justify text.
examples.translation: 点击这个图标使文本排齐。

examples.text: The number of juveniles in the general population has fallen by a fifth in the past 10 years.
examples.translation: 总人口中少年所占比例在过去10年中下降了1/5。

examples.text: Juvenile crime is increasing at a terrifying rate.
examples.translation: 青少年犯罪正在以惊人的速度增长。

examples.text: ...a scheme to lock up persistent juvenile offenders.
examples.translation: 将青少年惯犯关入监狱的计划

examples.text: He's a typical male, as he gets older he becomes more juvenile.
examples.translation: 他是个典型的男人，年龄越大越孩子气。

meanings.meaning: 敏锐的，敏捷的；渴望的；强烈的；热心的；锐利的

examples.text: You're not keen on going, are you?...
examples.translation: 你不太想去，是吗？

examples.text: Both companies were keen on a merger...
examples.translation: 两家公司都很想合并。

examples.text: I'm very keen that the European Union should be as open as possible to trade from Russia...
examples.translation: 我热切地希望欧盟尽可能开放与俄罗斯的贸易。

examples.text: She's still keen to keep in touch...
examples.translation: 她仍旧很愿意保持联系。

examples.text: I am not keen for her to have a bicycle.
examples.translation: 我不太放心她有辆自行车。

examples.text: ...Doyle's keenness to please.
examples.translation: 多伊尔想取悦他人的热切心情

examples.text: ...a keenness for the idea of a co-ordinated approach to development.
examples.translation: 想要协调一致搞发展的强烈愿望

examples.text: I got quite keen on the idea...
examples.translation: 我对这个想法燃起了极大的热情。

examples.text: I wasn't too keen on physics and chemistry.
examples.translation: 我对物理和化学不是太感喜爱。

examples.text: ...his keenness for the arts.
examples.translation: 他对艺术的喜爱

examples.text: She was a keen amateur photographer.
examples.translation: 她是业余摄影爱好者。

examples.text: He's a very keen student and works very hard...
examples.translation: 他是个很好学的学生，学习非常努力。

examples.text: You're all very keen.
examples.translation: 你们都很热心。

examples.text: ...the keenness of the students.
examples.translation: 学生的好学

examples.text: He had retained a keen interest in the progress of the work.
examples.translation: 他对那项工作的进展一直很关心。

examples.text: ...his keen sense of loyalty.
examples.translation: 他强烈的忠诚感

examples.text: She remained keenly interested in international affairs...
examples.translation: 她仍旧对国际事务很感兴趣。

examples.text: This is a keenly awaited project.
examples.translation: 这是一个让人热切期待的项目。

examples.text: He's been a keen supporter of the Labour Party all his life...
examples.translation: 他一生都是工党的热情拥护者。

examples.text: He is a keen advocate of park-and-ride schemes.
examples.translation: 他是“停车再换乘”计划的热情拥护者。

examples.text: They described him as a man of keen intellect...
examples.translation: 他们把他描述成一个才思敏捷的人。

examples.text: Mr Walsh has a keen appreciation of the priorities of the electorate...
examples.translation: 沃尔什先生深刻理解选民最为关注的事项。

examples.text: I can see you have a keen sense of humour.
examples.translation: 我能看出你极具幽默感。

examples.text: They're keenly aware that whatever they decide will set a precedent.
examples.translation: 他们深知无论他们的决定是什么，都将开创先例。

examples.text: ...an amateur artist with a keen eye for detail...
examples.translation: 对细节非常敏感的业余画家

examples.text: Brand's keen ear caught the trace of an accent.
examples.translation: 布兰德敏锐的耳朵听出了口音。

examples.text: Charles listened keenly.
examples.translation: 查尔斯竖着耳朵听着。

examples.text: ...his keenly observed portrait.
examples.translation: 他栩栩如生的肖像

examples.text: Mick has always been very keen on Carla.
examples.translation: 米克一直迷恋卡拉。

examples.text: There is expected to be a keen fight in the local elections.
examples.translation: 预计地方选举的竞争会非常激烈。

examples.text: The contest should be very keenly fought.
examples.translation: 比赛将会争夺得非常激烈。

examples.text: The company negotiates very keen prices with their suppliers.
examples.translation: 该公司通过讨价还价从供货商那里拿到了很低的价格。

examples.text: The shops also offer a keenly priced curtain-making service.
examples.translation: 这些商店也提供价格优惠的窗帘制作服务。

examples.text: He tossed back his head and keened...
examples.translation: 他仰天恸哭起来。

examples.text: Someone was making a low, keening noise.
examples.translation: 有人正在低声哀泣。

examples.text: So you're not mad keen on science then?...
examples.translation: 那么你对科学并不是太感兴趣了？

examples.text: She was mad keen to go.
examples.translation: 她非常想去。

examples.text: ...a mad keen golfer.
examples.translation: 高尔夫发烧友

examples.text: I'll put the kettle on and make us some tea.
examples.translation: 我去烧壶水给大家沏茶。

examples.text: Pour a kettle of boiling water over the onions.
examples.translation: 在洋葱上倒一壶开水。

examples.text: Put the meat into a small kettle.
examples.translation: 把肉放进一个小锅里。

examples.text: Playing for the reserve team is a totally different kettle of fish.
examples.translation: 作为替补参加比赛完全是两码事。

examples.text: The noise kept him awake...
examples.translation: 噪音吵得他一直没有睡着。

examples.text: Reggie was being kept busy behind the bar...
examples.translation: 雷吉一直在柜台后忙活。

examples.text: To keep warm they burnt wood in a rusty oil barrel...
examples.translation: 他们在一只生锈的油桶里烧木柴来保暖。

examples.text: For several years I kept in touch with her.
examples.translation: 几年来，我一直和她保持联系。

examples.text: Keep away from the doors while the train is moving...
examples.translation: 列车运行过程中要远离车门。

examples.text: He kept his head down, hiding his features...
examples.translation: 他低头掩面。

examples.text: It was against all orders to smoke, but a cigarette kept away mosquitoes...
examples.translation: 吸烟违反所有规章，但香烟可以驱蚊。

examples.text: Doctors will keep her in hospital for at least another week.
examples.translation: 医生会让她再住至少一个星期的院。

examples.text: I managed to stick to the diet and keep off sweet foods...
examples.translation: 我努力做到了只吃规定饮食，不沾甜食。

examples.text: He's going to be a fantastic player if he keeps away from booze and women...
examples.translation: 如果能不近酒色，他将成为一名出色的运动员。

examples.text: The best way to keep babies off sugar is to go back to the natural diet and eat lots of fresh fruit.
examples.translation: 避免婴儿摄入食糖的最好办法是让其回归自然的饮食，多吃新鲜水果。

examples.text: Embarrassment has kept me from doing all sorts of things...
examples.translation: 我总是害怕受窘，什么事都不敢去做。

examples.text: He kept her from being lonely...
examples.translation: 他不让她感到孤独。

examples.text: What can you do to keep it from happening again?
examples.translation: 你怎样防止它再次发生？

examples.text: She bit her lip to keep from crying...
examples.translation: 她咬住嘴唇不哭。

examples.text: He had to lean on Dan to keep from falling.
examples.translation: 他不得不靠在丹身上以免摔倒。

examples.text: She knew that Gabriel was keeping something from her.
examples.translation: 她知道加布里埃尔有事瞒着她。

examples.text: I keep forgetting it's December...
examples.translation: 我总是忘了现在是12月了。

examples.text: I turned back after a while, but he kept walking...
examples.translation: 我过了一会就往回走了，但他还接着走。

examples.text: Did he give up or keep on trying?...
examples.translation: 他是放弃了还是在继续努力？

examples.text: My wife keeps on saying that I work too hard.
examples.translation: 我妻子总说我工作太辛苦了。

examples.text: Until last year, the regime kept a tight grip on the country...
examples.translation: 直到去年，那个国家还处于该政权的严密控制之下。

examples.text: One of them would keep a look-out on the road behind to warn us of approaching vehicles...
examples.translation: 他们中会有一人看着后面的路，提醒我们注意过来的车辆。

examples.text: His parents kept a vigil by his bedside as he was given brain and body scans.
examples.translation: 在他做脑扫描和全身扫描时，他的父母守护在他床边。

examples.text: 'I like this dress,' she said. 'Keep it. You can have it,' said Daphne...
examples.translation: “我喜欢这件连衣裙，”她说。“留下吧。给你了，”达夫妮说道。

examples.text: Lathan had to choose between marrying her and keeping his job.
examples.translation: 莱森不得不在娶她和保住工作之间作出选择。

examples.text: She kept her money under the mattress...
examples.translation: 她把钱放在床垫下。

examples.text: She remembered where she kept the gun...
examples.translation: 她记得放枪的地方。

examples.text: To make it easier to contact us, keep this card handy.
examples.translation: 把这张卡放在手边，以便于和我们联系。

examples.text: I'm hoping you'll keep your promise to come for a long visit...
examples.translation: 我希望你遵守诺言来这儿多呆几天。

examples.text: He had again failed to keep his word.
examples.translation: 他又食言了。

examples.text: Eleanor began to keep a diary...
examples.translation: 埃莉诺开始记日记了。

examples.text: The volunteers kept a record of everything they ate for a week.
examples.translation: 志愿者记录下他们一周所吃的所有食物。

examples.text: She could just about afford to keep her five kids...
examples.translation: 她勉勉强强能养得起自己的5个孩子。

examples.text: I just cannot afford to keep myself...
examples.translation: 我难以维持生计。

examples.text: The pay was enough to keep him in whisky for a day or two.
examples.translation: 这笔钱够他喝一两天威士忌了。

examples.text: Ray will earn his keep on local farms while studying...
examples.translation: 雷求学期间会在当地的农场干活赚取生活费。

examples.text: I need to give my parents money for my keep.
examples.translation: 我需要付给父母我的生活费。

examples.text: I've brought you some eggs. We keep chickens...
examples.translation: 我给你带了些鸡蛋。我们养鸡。

examples.text: This mad writer kept a lobster as a pet.
examples.translation: 这个疯狂的作家把龙虾当宠物养。

examples.text: His father kept a village shop.
examples.translation: 他父亲经营一家乡村商店。

examples.text: Sorry to keep you, Jack...
examples.translation: 很抱歉让你久等了，杰克。

examples.text: 'What kept you?' — 'I went in the wrong direction.'
examples.translation: “你为什么晚了？”——“我走错了方向。”

examples.text: Whatever is left over may be put into the refrigerator, where it will keep for 2-3 weeks.
examples.translation: 剩下的东西都可以放进冰箱，可以保持两到三个星期不坏。

examples.text: She hasn't been keeping too well lately...
examples.translation: 她最近身体不太好。

examples.text: How are you keeping these days?
examples.translation: 你这些天身体怎么样？

examples.text: It may take a number of attempts, but it is worth keeping at it...
examples.translation: 可能要试几次，但还是值得坚持的。

examples.text: 'Keep at it!' Thade encouraged me.
examples.translation: “坚持下去！”萨德鼓励我道。

examples.text: Ensure that whatever you gain now will be for keeps...
examples.translation: 确保你现在所获得的一切永远不会失去。

examples.text: He advised them to leave town for keeps.
examples.translation: 他建议他们离开镇子，永远别再回来。

examples.text: She forced herself to keep going...
examples.translation: 她强迫自己继续下去。

examples.text: I was shouting: 'Keep going, keep going!'
examples.translation: 我喊着：“坚持，坚持！”

examples.text: His office was in keeping with his station and experience...
examples.translation: 他的办公室与其身份和阅历相称。

examples.text: In keeping with tradition, the Emperor and Empress did not attend the ceremony...
examples.translation: 按照传统，皇帝和皇后未参加该仪式。

examples.text: His own response to it seemed to be out of keeping with his earlier expressed opinions.
examples.translation: 他自己对此的反应与其早前表达的看法并不一致。

examples.text: There are fears that he will not be able to keep it up when he gets to the particularly demanding third year...
examples.translation: 有人担心他到了要求极其严格的第3年时会坚持不下去。

examples.text: You're doing a great job! Keep it up!
examples.translation: 你们干得非常棒！继续好好干吧！

examples.text: I have to tell someone. I can't keep it to myself...
examples.translation: 我得找人说说。我心里憋不住。

examples.text: There's one thing you can do for me. But keep it to yourself.
examples.translation: 有件事你能帮我做。但你要保密。

examples.text: He was a quiet man who kept himself to himself...
examples.translation: 他是个喜欢安静、不爱与人来往的人。

examples.text: Since she knows little Italian, she keeps to herself.
examples.translation: 因为不怎么懂意大利语，她很少和人交往。

meanings.meaning: 键入；用键盘式排字机排字
用键盘进行操作；作键盘式排字机排字

examples.text: Tanya's hands rippled over the keyboard.
examples.translation: 塔尼娅的双手在琴键上翻飞。

examples.text: ...Sean O'Hagan on keyboards.
examples.translation: 键盘手肖恩·奥黑根

examples.text: ...the keyboard player.
examples.translation: 键盘乐器演奏者

meanings.meaning: 键入；锁上；调节…的音调；提供线索

examples.text: They put the key in the door and entered...
examples.translation: 他们用钥匙打开门进去了。

examples.text: She reached for her coat and car keys.
examples.translation: 她伸手拿外套和汽车钥匙。

examples.text: ...the key of A minor.
examples.translation: A小调
