examples.text: You will find a key at the front of the book.
examples.translation: 你会在书的前面找到略语表。

examples.text: He is expected to be the key witness at the trial...
examples.translation: 他将成为审判的关键证人。

examples.text: Education is likely to be a key issue in the next election.
examples.translation: 在下届选举中教育可能成为最重要的一个议题。

examples.text: The key to success is to be ready from the start...
examples.translation: 成功的关键在于从一开始就要准备充分。

examples.text: Diet and relaxation are two important keys to good health.
examples.translation: 限制饮食和放松身心是保持健康的两个要诀。

examples.text: He kicked the door hard...
examples.translation: 他使劲儿踢门。

examples.text: He threw me to the ground and started to kick...
examples.translation: 他把我摔倒在地开始踢我。

examples.text: He escaped by kicking open the window...
examples.translation: 他踢开窗户逃跑了。

examples.text: The fiery actress kicked him in the shins...
examples.translation: 那位脾气暴躁的女演员踢了他的小腿。

examples.text: An ostrich can kick a man to death.
examples.translation: 鸵鸟能把人踢死。

examples.text: He suffered a kick to the knee.
examples.translation: 他膝盖被人踢了一下。

examples.text: I went to kick the ball and I completely missed it...
examples.translation: 我去踢球却踢了个空。

examples.text: He kicked the ball away...
examples.translation: 他把球踢开了。

examples.text: A furious player kicked his racket into the grandstand.
examples.translation: 一位愤怒的球员将他的球拍踢向了看台。

examples.text: Schmeichel swooped to save the first kick from Borisov.
examples.translation: 舒梅切尔的奋力一扑挡住了鲍里索的第一次射门。

examples.text: They were dragged away struggling and kicking...
examples.translation: 他们被拖走时挣扎着又踢又蹬。

examples.text: First he kicked the left leg, then he kicked the right...
examples.translation: 他先踢左腿，然后踢右腿。

examples.text: He kicked his feet away from the window.
examples.translation: 他从窗户旁跑开了。

examples.text: As its rider tried to free it, the horse kicked out.
examples.translation: 骑手想松开那匹马时，它乱踢乱蹬。

examples.text: He was kicking his legs like a Can Can dancer...
examples.translation: 他像跳康康舞一样踢着腿。

examples.text: She begins dancing, kicking her legs high in the air.
examples.translation: 她开始跳舞，做了空中高踢腿动作。

examples.text: She's kicked her drug habit and learned that her life has value...
examples.translation: 她已经戒了毒，并且认识到了生命可贵。

examples.text: I've kicked cigarettes, heroin, and booze.
examples.translation: 我已经戒了烟，不再吸食海洛因和酗酒了。

examples.text: I got a kick out of seeing my name in print.
examples.translation: 当看到我的名字印成铅字时，我感到无比兴奋。

examples.text: In the end I just couldn't kick Jimmy when he was down.
examples.translation: 最后我就是无法做到在吉米倒霉时落井下石。

examples.text: They made a few small bets for kicks.
examples.translation: 他们觉得好玩便小赌了几把。

examples.text: He had to be dragged kicking and screaming into action.
examples.translation: 他要被强拉硬拽才肯行动起来。

examples.text: We've been struggling for years and it's a real kick in the teeth to see a new band make it ahead of us.
examples.translation: 我们奋斗了多年，看到一支新的乐队反而超越了我们，真让人大失所望。

examples.text: I was still kicking myself for not paying attention...
examples.translation: 我仍在怪自己没有注意。

examples.text: I immediately regretted having said this— I could have kicked myself.
examples.translation: 我一说完这话就后悔了——我都想抽自己。

meanings.meaning: 小山羊皮制的；较年幼的

examples.text: They've got three kids...
examples.translation: 他们有3个孩子。

examples.text: All the kids in my class could read.
examples.translation: 我们班所有的孩子都能阅读。

examples.text: There were gangs of kids on motorbikes roaming around...
examples.translation: 过去有成群结队的年轻人骑着摩托车四处游荡。

examples.text: That's a lot for a kid of 22 to cope with.
examples.translation: 那对一个22岁的年轻人来说是够难应付的。

examples.text: My kid sister woke up and started crying.
examples.translation: 我妹妹醒了，哭了起来。

examples.text: I'm not kidding, Frank. There's a cow out there, just standing around...
examples.translation: 我没有开玩笑，弗兰克。外面有一头母牛，就站在附近。

examples.text: I'm just kidding...
examples.translation: 我只是开玩笑。

examples.text: Are you sure you're not kidding me?
examples.translation: 你确定不是在和我开玩笑吗？

examples.text: He liked to kid Ingrid a lot...
examples.translation: 他很喜欢捉弄英格丽德。

examples.text: He used to kid me about being chubby.
examples.translation: 他过去常取笑我胖。

examples.text: We're kidding ourselves, Bill. We're not winning, we're not even doing well...
examples.translation: 我们在自己骗自己，比尔。我们没有赢，我们甚至都没有发挥好。

examples.text: I could kid myself that you did this for me, but it would be a lie.
examples.translation: 我可以欺骗自己你这样做是为了我，但那终究是谎言。

examples.text: I'm scared. No kidding, really.
examples.translation: 我很害怕。不是开玩笑，真的。

examples.text: 'We won.' — 'No kidding?'
examples.translation: “我们赢了。”——“真的吗？”

examples.text: You've got to be kidding! I can't live here!...
examples.translation: 你在开玩笑吧！我不可能住这儿！

examples.text: 'He's a mild inoffensive man isn't he? — Oh you've gotta be kidding.'
examples.translation: “他是个温和、没有恶意的人，不是吗？”——“啊，你不是开玩笑吧。”

examples.text: She played the role of a meek, innocent, shy girl. I don't know who she was trying to kid...
examples.translation: 她装作一个温顺、天真、害羞的女孩。真不知道她想骗谁。

examples.text: 'Maybe tomorrow will be better,' I said, hanging up. 'Who am I kidding?' I told Wolfe. 'Tomorrow will be more of the same.'
examples.translation: “也许明天会更好，”我说着挂断了电话。“我在骗谁啊？”我对沃尔夫说。“明天还是一个样。”

examples.text: Police in Brazil uncovered a plot to kidnap him...
examples.translation: 巴西警方发现了有人要绑架他的阴谋。

examples.text: They were intelligent and educated, yet they chose to kidnap and kill...
examples.translation: 他们聪明且有教养，却选择去绑架和杀人。

examples.text: The kidnapped man was said to have been seized by five people.
examples.translation: 据说那名男子是被5个人绑架的。

examples.text: His kidnappers have threatened that they will kill him unless three militants are released from prison.
examples.translation: 绑架他的绑匪威胁说，如果不释放3名激进分子他们就杀了他。

examples.text: Two youngsters have been arrested and charged with kidnapping.
examples.translation: 已有两名年轻人被逮捕并被控绑架。

examples.text: Stewart denies attempted murder and kidnap...
examples.translation: 斯图尔特否认对其谋杀未遂和绑架的指控。

examples.text: He was charged with the kidnap of a 25 year-old woman.
examples.translation: 他被指控绑架一名25岁的女子。

examples.text: ...lambs' kidneys.
examples.translation: 羊腰子

examples.text: ...steak and kidney pie.
examples.translation: 牛排和腰花馅饼

examples.text: He'd lost ten kilos in weight.
examples.translation: 他的体重已经减掉了10公斤。

examples.text: ...a kilo of rice.
examples.translation: 1公斤大米

examples.text: More than 1,000 people have been killed by the armed forces...
examples.translation: 1,000多人被武装部队杀死。

examples.text: He had attempted to kill himself on several occasions...
examples.translation: 他好几次试图自杀。

examples.text: Cattle should be killed cleanly and humanely...
examples.translation: 牛应该被干净利落地无痛屠宰。

examples.text: The earthquake killed 62 people...
examples.translation: 地震导致62人死亡。

examples.text: Heroin can kill.
examples.translation: 海洛因能致死。

examples.text: There is tension in the region following the killing of seven civilians.
examples.translation: 随着7名平民被杀害，该地区局势紧张起来。

examples.text: After the kill the men and old women collect in an open space and eat a meal of whale meat.
examples.translation: 捕杀过后，男人们和老年妇女们聚集到一片空地上吃了一顿鲸鱼肉。

examples.text: His objective was to kill the space station project altogether...
examples.translation: 他的目的是使空间站项目全面停止。

examples.text: Public opinion may yet kill the proposal.
examples.translation: 舆论可能最终会扼杀这个提议。

examples.text: He would soon launch a second offensive, killing off the peace process...
examples.translation: 他不久将会再次发动进攻，彻底毁掉整个和平进程。

examples.text: The Government's financial squeeze had killed the scheme off.
examples.translation: 政府的财政困难已使这个计划成为泡影。

examples.text: He was forced to take opium to kill the pain.
examples.translation: 他被迫服用鸦片来止痛。

examples.text: My feet are killing me.
examples.translation: 我的脚疼死了。

examples.text: You shouldn't always have to kill yourself to do well.
examples.translation: 你不该总是为了做到尽善尽美而累坏自己。

examples.text: Tell Richard I'm going to kill him when I get hold of him.
examples.translation: 告诉理查德，一旦抓住他，我要杀了他。

examples.text: Three or four more weeks won't kill me!
examples.translation: 再过3周或4周不会要了我的命！

examples.text: I'm just killing time until I can talk to the other witnesses...
examples.translation: 在和其他目击者交谈前我只是在打发时间。

examples.text: To kill the hours while she waited, Ann worked in the garden.
examples.translation: 为了打发等待的那几个小时，安在菜园里干些活。

examples.text: I'll make this marriage work if it kills me.
examples.translation: 再难我也要努力使这桩婚姻幸福美满。

examples.text: Seeing his chance, Dennis moved in for the kill.
examples.translation: 看到机会来了，丹尼斯开始采取行动。

meanings.meaning: [计量] 公里；[计量] 千米

examples.text: ...about twenty kilometres from the border...
examples.translation: 离边界约20公里

examples.text: The fire destroyed some 40,000 square kilometres of forest.
examples.translation: 大火烧毁了大约4万平方公里的森林。

meanings.meaning: 同类的；有亲属关系的；性质类似的
(Kin)人名；(缅)庆；(朝)紧；(匈、柬、塞)金；(中)金(普通话·威妥玛)

examples.text: She has gone to live with her husband's kin.
examples.translation: 她住到丈夫的亲戚家里去了。

meanings.meaning: 和蔼的；宽容的；令人感激的
(Kind)人名；(德、俄、法、捷)金德；(瑞典)欣德

examples.text: The party needs a different kind of leadership...
examples.translation: 该党需要一种不同的领导风格。

examples.text: Had Jamie ever been in any kind of trouble?...
examples.translation: 杰米遇到过什么麻烦吗？

examples.text: I'm not the kind of person to get married...
examples.translation: 我不是那种适合结婚的人。

examples.text: This book prize is the biggest of its kind in the world...
examples.translation: 这一图书奖项是世界上同类奖项中分量最重的。

examples.text: Ear pain of any kind must never be ignored.
examples.translation: 决不要忽视耳部的任何疼痛。

examples.text: I hate Lewis and his kind just as much as you do...
examples.translation: 我和你一样痛恨刘易斯之流。

examples.text: I can take care of your kind.
examples.translation: 我能对付像你这样的家伙。

examples.text: Adoption can fail for all kinds of reasons...
examples.translation: 收养不成功可能有各种原因。

examples.text: Donations came from all kinds of people...
examples.translation: 捐赠来自于各界人士。

examples.text: All kinds of remarkable things began to happen.
examples.translation: 开始发生各种不寻常的事。

examples.text: It was kind of sad, really...
examples.translation: 有点儿让人难过，真的。

examples.text: She wasn't beautiful. But she was kind of cute...
examples.translation: 她不漂亮。但她有几分可爱。

examples.text: It kind of gives us an idea of what's happening.
examples.translation: 这让我们大概了解了正在发生的事情。

examples.text: There is good news of a kind for the Prime Minister...
examples.translation: 对总理来说也算是有个好消息。

examples.text: She finds solace of a kind in alcohol.
examples.translation: 她从酒精中多少得到一些安慰。

examples.text: She's a very unusual woman, one of a kind.
examples.translation: 她是个非常与众不同的女人，是独一无二的。

examples.text: They were two of a kind, from the same sort of background.
examples.translation: 他们俩是一类人，有相同的背景。

examples.text: They hurled defiant taunts at the riot police, who responded in kind.
examples.translation: 他们向防暴警察挑衅大骂，防暴警察同样回骂他们。

examples.text: Inflation and the shortage of banknotes has forced factories to pay their workers in kind.
examples.translation: 通货膨胀和纸币短缺使工厂不得不以实物抵付工人的工资。

examples.text: ...benefits in kind.
examples.translation: 实物形式的福利

examples.text: She is warm-hearted and kind to everyone and everything...
examples.translation: 她对每个人每件事都很热心、宽厚。

examples.text: I must thank you for being so kind to me...
examples.translation: 我很感激你对我这么好。

examples.text: It was very kind of you to come.
examples.translation: 你能来真是太好了。

examples.text: 'You seem tired this morning, Jenny,' she said kindly.
examples.translation: “你今天早上看上去很累，珍妮，”她关切地说。

examples.text: Please be so kind as to see to it that all the alterations are made at once!...
examples.translation: 请务必立即执行变更！

examples.text: I wonder if you'd be kind enough to call him.
examples.translation: 请你给他打个电话好吗？

examples.text: Summer clothes are invariably less kind to fuller figures.
examples.translation: 体形较丰满的人穿夏装总是不那么好看。

examples.text: She's in kindergarten now.
examples.translation: 她目前在上幼儿园。

examples.text: We have been treated with such kindness by everybody.
examples.translation: 每个人对我们都很好。

meanings.meaning: 主要的，最重要的，最大的
(King)人名；(德、英、葡、捷、西)金；(中)金(普通话·威妥玛)；(泰)京；(东南亚国家华语)京

examples.text: ...the king and queen of Spain...
examples.translation: 西班牙国王和王后

examples.text: In 1154, Henry II became King of England.
examples.translation: 1154年，亨利二世成为英格兰国王。

examples.text: ...King Albert.
examples.translation: 阿尔伯特国王

examples.text: He's the king of unlicensed boxing...
examples.translation: 他是黑市拳王。

examples.text: He was the king of the big love song.
examples.translation: 他是流行情歌之王。

examples.text: ...the king of diamonds.
examples.translation: 方片K

examples.text: Executives lived like kings. The top thirty-one executives were paid a total of $14.2 million.
examples.translation: 经理们活得像国王一样。职位最高的31名经理的薪金总额达到了1,420万美元。

examples.text: The kingdom's power declined.
examples.translation: 王国的势力衰弱了。

examples.text: ...the United Kingdom.
examples.translation: 联合王国

examples.text: ...the Kingdom of Denmark.
examples.translation: 丹麦王国

examples.text: It was infamous as a kingdom of brigands, scoundrels, and slave-traders.
examples.translation: 该地区因土匪、无赖和奴隶贩子猖獗而声名狼藉。

examples.text: She leaned up and kissed him on the cheek...
examples.translation: 她倾身向前亲吻了他的面颊。

examples.text: She kissed me hard on the mouth...
examples.translation: 她深深地吻了我的嘴。

examples.text: Her parents kissed her goodbye as she set off from their home...
examples.translation: 她动身离开父母家时父母和她吻别。

examples.text: They kissed for almost half a minute...
examples.translation: 他们吻了将近半分钟。

examples.text: We kissed goodbye.
examples.translation: 我们吻别了。

examples.text: I put my arms around her and gave her a kiss...
examples.translation: 我抱着她吻了她一下。

examples.text: We gave each other hugs and kisses every morning.
examples.translation: 我们每天早晨都拥抱亲吻对方。

examples.text: The men stepped forward to kiss the hand of their mentor...
examples.translation: 这些男子走上前去轻吻他们导师的手。

examples.text: She bowed her head and kissed the Archbishop's ring.
examples.translation: 她低下头轻吻大主教的戒指。

examples.text: The wheels of the aircraft kissed the runway.
examples.translation: 飞机的轮子轻触跑道。

examples.text: Maria blew him a kiss...
examples.translation: 玛丽亚给了他一个飞吻。

examples.text: Amy blew a kiss from the door.
examples.translation: 埃米在门口做了个飞吻的动作。

examples.text: I felt sure I'd have to kiss my dancing career goodbye.
examples.translation: 我明确感觉到我将不得不与我的舞蹈生涯说再见了。

meanings.meaning: (Kit)人名；(俄)基特；(东南亚国家华语)吉；(英)基特，姬特(女名)(教名 Christopher、Katherine 的昵称)

examples.text: ...a well-stocked first aid kit...
examples.translation: 一套完备的急救用品

examples.text: The kit consisted of about twenty cosmetic items and a lady's shaver.
examples.translation: 整套工具包括大约20种化妆用品和一个女士褪毛器。

examples.text: I forgot my gym kit.
examples.translation: 我忘带健身用品了。

examples.text: Her popular pot holder is also available in do-it-yourself kits.
examples.translation: 她那广受欢迎的防烫布垫也可以自己购买原料套装自己制作。

examples.text: I don't like taking my kit off on screen...
examples.translation: 我不喜欢在银幕上表演裸戏。

examples.text: Back in the Fifties, social convention required that males models keep their kit on.
examples.translation: 回首50年代，那时社会习俗要求男模不能脱掉所有衣服。

examples.text: Judge Hodgman settles a marital dispute: should the kitchen sink dispense dish soap or hand soap?
He will receive physiotherapy on his damaged left knee.
examples.translation: 因左膝受伤，他将接受物理治疗。

examples.text: ...a knee injury.
examples.translation: 膝关节受伤

examples.text: He sat with the package on his knees...
examples.translation: 他坐着，将包裹放在腿上。

examples.text: I sat in the back of the taxi with my son on my knee.
examples.translation: 我坐在出租车后排座上，儿子坐在我腿上。

examples.text: ...jeans with holes at both knees.
examples.translation: 两个膝部都有洞的牛仔裤

examples.text: She fell to the ground on her knees and prayed...
examples.translation: 她跪下祈祷。

examples.text: She was on her knees in the kitchen.
examples.translation: 她在厨房跪着。

examples.text: Ian kneed him in the groin.
examples.translation: 伊恩用膝盖顶他的下身。

examples.text: The country was being brought to its knees by the loss of 2.4 million manufacturing jobs...
examples.translation: 该国因制造业丧失了240万个就业机会而遭到严重打击。

examples.text: Our aim is to bring this government to its knees, to force it to the negotiating table.
examples.translation: 我们的目标是使该政府屈服，迫使它走上谈判桌。

examples.text: She knelt by the bed and prayed...
examples.translation: 她跪在床边祈祷。

examples.text: Other people were kneeling, but she just sat.
examples.translation: 其他人跪着，而她只是坐着。

examples.text: ...a kneeling position.
examples.translation: 跪着的姿势

examples.text: She kneeled down beside him.
examples.translation: 她在他旁边跪下。

meanings.meaning: 使用空头支票；象风筝一样飞；轻快地移动

examples.text: The Government flies these kites of disinformation, then people feel grateful when the changes don't happen.
examples.translation: 政府故意放出这些虚假消息来试探舆论，而当其中提到的改变并未出现时，老百姓便会心怀感激。

examples.text: I felt so strange on the steroid injections. I was as high as a kite some of the time.
examples.translation: 注射类固醇后我感觉很奇特。我有时会极度兴奋。

examples.text: ...a knife and fork...
examples.translation: 一副刀叉

examples.text: Two robbers broke into her home, held a knife to her throat and stole her savings.
examples.translation: 两个盗贼闯进了她的家，把刀架在她的脖子上，抢走了她的积蓄。

examples.text: Dawson takes revenge on the man by knifing him to death...
examples.translation: 道森用刀杀死了他的仇人。

examples.text: She was knifed in the back six times.
examples.translation: 她的背部中了6刀。

examples.text: Kelly was about to go under the knife when her surgeon stopped everything.
examples.translation: 凯莉的手术就要开始时被她的外科医生给叫停了。

examples.text: Spending by Japanese companies has left them more competitive than companies in other nations. They will be cutting through the competition like a hot knife through butter.
examples.translation: 日本公司的支出使得它们比其他国家的公司更具竞争力。它们将在竞争中轻而易举地取胜。

examples.text: Officials hung the flag upside down. You could have cut the atmosphere with a knife.
examples.translation: 官员们把旗子挂倒了。气氛紧张得让人透不过气来。

examples.text: The Party knives are out for the leader.
examples.translation: 该党派要向其领导人开刀了。

examples.text: Travis twisted the knife by laughing at her...
examples.translation: 特拉维斯火上浇油般地嘲笑她。

examples.text: It is the turn of Latvia to twist the knife.
examples.translation: 轮到拉特维亚落井下石了。

examples.text: I had endless hours to knit and sew...
examples.translation: 我整天无休止地编织缝纫。

examples.text: I have already started knitting baby clothes...
examples.translation: 我已经开始给宝宝织衣服了。

examples.text: She knitted him 10 pairs of socks to take with him...
examples.translation: 她给他织了10双袜子让他带走。

examples.text: During the war, Joan helped her mother knit scarves for soldiers...
examples.translation: 战争期间，琼帮妈妈给战士们织围巾。

examples.text: She pushed up the sleeves of her grey knitted cardigan and got to work.
examples.translation: 她撸起身上灰色开襟毛衣的衣袖开始工作。

examples.text: Ferris wore a heavy knit sweater.
examples.translation: 费里斯身着一件织得厚厚的毛衣。

examples.text: ...a cotton-knit sweater.
examples.translation: 棉针织衫

examples.text: ...hand-knit garments.
examples.translation: 手工编织的衣服

examples.text: Pattern charts with small print are often difficult for older knitters to use.
examples.translation: 上了年纪的针织工使用小的图样时通常很不方便。

examples.text: The best thing about sport is that it knits the whole family close together...
examples.translation: 体育运动最大的益处在于它使整个家庭紧密地团结在一起。

examples.text: Ordinary people have some reservations about their president's drive to knit them so closely to their neighbors.
examples.translation: 普通百姓对总统号召人们邻里间亲密相处的动机心存疑虑。

examples.text: ...a closer-knit family.
examples.translation: 关系更加亲密的家庭

examples.text: ...a tightly knit society.
examples.translation: 紧密团结的社会

examples.text: The bone hasn't knitted together properly.
examples.translation: 骨头愈合得不好。

examples.text: ...broken bones that have failed to knit.
examples.translation: 没能愈合好的断骨

examples.text: They knitted their brows and started to grumble...
examples.translation: 他们皱着眉头抱怨起来。

examples.text: Billy's eyebrows knitted together in a little frown.
examples.translation: 比利眉头微皱。

examples.text: He turned the knob and pushed against the door.
examples.translation: 他扭动把手推了推门。

examples.text: A loose brass knob on the bedstead rattled.
examples.translation: 床架上一个松动的球形铜扣发出嘎啦声。

examples.text: ...the volume knob.
examples.translation: 音量旋钮

examples.text: Top the steaming hot potatoes with a knob of butter.
examples.translation: 在冒热气的马铃薯上放一小块黄油。

examples.text: She went directly to Simon's apartment and knocked on the door...
examples.translation: 她直奔西蒙的房间，敲了敲门。

examples.text: Knock at my window at eight o'clock and I'll be ready...
examples.translation: 8点钟敲我的窗，我会准备好的。

examples.text: He knocked before going in.
examples.translation: 他进去前先敲了敲门。

examples.text: They heard a knock at the front door.
examples.translation: 他们听到前门有人敲门。

examples.text: They were wakened by a loud knocking at the door.
examples.translation: 他们被一阵嘈杂的敲门声吵醒。

examples.text: She accidentally knocked the tea tin off the shelf...
examples.translation: 她不小心把架子上的茶叶罐碰了下来。

examples.text: The baby was knocked from his father's arms...
examples.translation: 婴儿被从他父亲的怀中撞落。

examples.text: Isabel rose so abruptly that she knocked down her chair...
examples.translation: 伊莎贝尔起得太急了，以致碰倒了她坐的椅子。

examples.text: Buckets of roses had been knocked over.
examples.translation: 一桶桶的玫瑰被撞翻在地。

examples.text: The bags have tough exterior materials to protect against knocks, rain and dust.
examples.translation: 这些包的面料非常结实耐用，可以防撞、防雨并防尘。

examples.text: They decided to knock the two rooms into one...
examples.translation: 他们决定把两间屋子打通连成一间。

examples.text: The spacious kitchen was achieved by knocking together three small rooms.
examples.translation: 这个宽敞的厨房是由3个小屋子打通连成的。

examples.text: The third wave was so strong it knocked me backwards...
examples.translation: 第3波浪太大了，把我打了回去。

examples.text: They were knocked to the ground and robbed of their wallets...
examples.translation: 他们被打倒在地并被抢走了钱包。

examples.text: Someone had knocked him unconscious.
examples.translation: 有人把他打昏了。

examples.text: The stories of his links with the actress had knocked the fun out of him...
examples.translation: 有关他与那位女演员有关系的传闻使他很不开心。

examples.text: When they first joined for training many were starry eyed about just sailing around the world. We soon knocked that out of them...
examples.translation: 在他们参加培训之初，很多人还只是对环球航行抱有天真的想法。我们很快便使他们消除了那种想法。

examples.text: Those people hurt me and knocked my confidence.
examples.translation: 那些人既伤害了我的身体又打击了我的自信心。

examples.text: His old truck, knocking and smoking, pulled down the road and out of sight.
examples.translation: 他那辆旧卡车一边冒着烟一边哐里哐啷地沿路向前驶去，直到驶出了视线。

examples.text: I'm not knocking them: if they want to do it, it's up to them...
examples.translation: 我不是批评他们：想不想做那件事取决于他们。

examples.text: Never knock charter flights; they are opening up the world for budget-conscious travellers.
examples.translation: 绝不要挑剔包机航班；他们使精打细算的乘客能够去往世界各地。

examples.text: This season he's more determined than ever to prove the knockers wrong.
examples.translation: 这个赛季他比以往任何时候都更坚决地想要证明那些批评者是错的。

examples.text: What they said was a real knock to my self-confidence...
examples.translation: 他们的话是对我自信心的一次重大打击。

examples.text: The art market has suffered some severe knocks during the past two years.
examples.translation: 在过去的两年间，艺术品市场遭受了严重的打击。

examples.text: Glamorous make-up is best reserved for days when you want to go all out to knock 'em dead.
examples.translation: 魅惑彩妆最好留到你竭力想把所有人都迷倒的时候。

examples.text: Will you just knock it off!
examples.translation: 别闹了！

meanings.meaning: （绳等的）结；节瘤，疙瘩；海里/小时（航速单位）

examples.text: One lace had broken and been tied in a knot.
examples.translation: 一条带子已经断了，打了个结。

examples.text: He knotted the laces securely together...
examples.translation: 他把带子紧紧地系在一起。

examples.text: He knotted the bandanna around his neck.
examples.translation: 他在脖子上系了一条印花大围巾。

examples.text: ...a knotted rope.
examples.translation: 打着结的绳索

examples.text: A little knot of men stood clapping.
examples.translation: 一小群人站在那儿鼓掌。

examples.text: There was a knot of tension in his stomach.
examples.translation: 他紧张得心揪得紧紧的。

examples.text: I felt my stomach knot with apprehension...
examples.translation: 我很担忧，心都揪紧了。

examples.text: The old dread knotted her stomach.
examples.translation: 从前那些可怕的经历让她的心都揪紧了。

examples.text: His forehead knotted in a frown.
examples.translation: 他眉头紧锁。

examples.text: ...his knotted muscles.
examples.translation: 他紧绷的肌肉

examples.text: They travel at speeds of up to 30 knots.
examples.translation: 他们以高达30节的速度行进。

examples.text: ...thirteen knot winds.
examples.translation: 13节的风

examples.text: The press agent tied himself in knots trying to apologise.
examples.translation: 那个广告宣传人员急于道歉。

examples.text: Len tied the knot with Kate five years ago.
examples.translation: 莱恩5年前和凯特结婚了。

meanings.meaning: 知识，学问；知道，认识；学科

examples.text: She told Parliament she had no knowledge of the affair.
examples.translation: 她告诉议会她对此事并不知情。

examples.text: ...the quest for scientific knowledge.
examples.translation: 对科学知识的探索

examples.text: Alec never carried a gun to my knowledge...
examples.translation: 据我所知亚历克从来不带枪。

examples.text: To the best of my knowledge, Gloria did not make these comments.
examples.translation: 据我所知，格洛丽亚没这么说过。

examples.text: You can let your kids play here, safe in the knowledge that they won't get sunburn.
examples.translation: 你可以放心让孩子们在这儿玩，他们肯定不会晒黑。

examples.text: ...David Blunkett, MP for Sheffield (Lab).
examples.translation: 代表谢菲尔德的下院议员戴维·布伦基特（工党）

examples.text: I don't know the name of the place...
examples.translation: 我不知道那个地方的名字。

examples.text: I know that you led a rifle platoon during the Second World War...
examples.translation: 我知道你在二战期间率领一个步枪排。

examples.text: 'People like doing things for nothing.' — 'I know they do.'...
examples.translation: “人们喜欢没事找事。”——“我知道确实是那样。”

examples.text: I don't know what happened to her husband...
examples.translation: 我不知道她丈夫出了什么事。

examples.text: 'How did he meet your mother?' — 'I don't know.'...
examples.translation: “他怎么认识你母亲的？”——“我不知道。”

examples.text: We all know about his early experiments in flying...
examples.translation: 我们都了解他早期的飞行试验。

examples.text: They looked younger than I knew them to be...
examples.translation: 他们看起来比我所知道的实际年龄显小。

examples.text: Radon is known to be harmful to humans in large quantities...
examples.translation: 众所周知，大量的氡会对人体造成伤害。

examples.text: It is not known whether the bomb was originally intended for the capital itself...
examples.translation: 尚不清楚炸弹起初的轰炸目标是否是首都。

examples.text: It's always been known that key figures in the government do very well for themselves.
examples.translation: 众所周知政府中的要员都很会保全自己的利益。

examples.text: Gifford was a friend. I'd known him for nine years...
examples.translation: 吉福德是我的一位朋友。我和他认识9年了。

examples.text: Do you two know each other?...
examples.translation: 你们俩互相认识吗？

examples.text: He doesn't know anybody in London.
examples.translation: 他在伦敦谁也不认识。

examples.text: We know of the incident but have no further details...
examples.translation: 我们听说过这件事，但对详情不是很清楚。

examples.text: The president admitted that he did not know of any rebels having surrendered so far...
examples.translation: 总统承认据他所知迄今为止还没有反叛者投降。

examples.text: I know of no one who would want to murder Albert.
examples.translation: 我没听说有人想杀艾伯特。

examples.text: Hire someone with experience, someone who knows about real estate...
examples.translation: 雇佣有经验、了解房地产业的人。

examples.text: She didn't know anything about music but she liked to sing.
examples.translation: 虽然她对音乐一无所知，但却爱唱歌。

examples.text: It helps to know French and Creole if you want to understand some of the lyrics...
examples.translation: 如果你想读懂一些抒情诗，学点法语和克里奥尔语是有帮助的。

examples.text: Rachel already knows as many words in German as she does in English...
examples.translation: 雷切尔掌握的德语词汇已经和她掌握的英语词汇一样多了。

examples.text: Her new classmates knew no Latin.
examples.translation: 她的新同学不会拉丁语。

examples.text: No matter how well you know Paris, it is easy to get lost...
examples.translation: 不管你对巴黎多么熟悉，也很容易迷路。

examples.text: I don't know the play, I've just come to see it.
examples.translation: 我不了解这部剧，只是来看看。

examples.text: The health authorities now know how to deal with the disease...
examples.translation: 卫生部门现在知道如何对付这种病了。

examples.text: We know what to do to make it work.
examples.translation: 我们知道如何让它起作用。

examples.text: Then I saw a gun under the hall table so I knew that something was wrong...
examples.translation: 后来我看到大厅的桌子下有一把枪，我就意识到有些不对劲儿。

examples.text: The first I knew about it was when I woke up in the ambulance.
examples.translation: 当我从救护车中苏醒过来时才知道发生了什么事。

examples.text: Would she know you if she saw you on the street?...
examples.translation: 如果她在大街上看到你，能认出你吗？

examples.text: I thought I knew the voice.
examples.translation: 我觉得在哪里听过这声音。

examples.text: The disease is more commonly known as Mad Cow Disease...
examples.translation: 这种疾病更通俗的名称是疯牛病。

examples.text: He was born as John Birks Gillespie, but everyone knew him as Dizzy...
examples.translation: 他本名为约翰·伯克斯·吉莱斯皮，但人人都叫他“小迷糊”。

examples.text: He was the only boy in the school who was known by his Christian name and not his surname.
examples.translation: 他是学校里唯一一个被称呼洗礼名而不是姓氏的男孩儿。

examples.text: ...British Nuclear Fuels, otherwise known as BNFL.
examples.translation: 英国核料烧股份有限公司，也称BNFL。

examples.text: Lots of people know her as a very kind woman...
examples.translation: 很多人认为她是个非常善良的女人。

examples.text: We know them as inaccurate and misleading property descriptions...
examples.translation: 我们认为对性状的这些描述是不准确的，且会使人产生误解。

examples.text: Kemp knew him for a meticulous officer.
examples.translation: 肯普认为他是个很细心的官员。

examples.text: Most of us know her as the woman who used to present the television news...
examples.translation: 我们大多数人认识她是因为她曾主持过电视新闻节目。

examples.text: The soldiers — all of whom we knew as neighbours — stood around pointing guns at us.
examples.translation: 那些士兵——我们都视之为邻居的人——站在四周用枪指着我们。

examples.text: He planned to end the welfare system as we know it.
examples.translation: 他计划终止现行的福利制度。

examples.text: ...those values of our culture that are essential to civilisation as we know it.
examples.translation: 我们文化中那些构成我们所熟悉的文明社会之根基的价值观

examples.text: The new neighbours were getting to know each other...
examples.translation: 新邻居之间正在互相了解。

examples.text: I'd really like to see you again and get to know you better.
examples.translation: 我很愿意再次见到你并且更多地了解你。

examples.text: 'Who's he?' — 'God knows.'
examples.translation: “他是谁？”——“天晓得。”

examples.text: Old Gunga spoke God knows how many languages...
examples.translation: 老贡嘎会说很多种语言，天晓得有多少种。

examples.text: Heaven only knows what his mother would have said.
examples.translation: 天晓得他母亲原本会说什么。

examples.text: 'This country is so awful.' — 'I know, I know.'
examples.translation: “这个国家太糟糕了。”——“的确是，的确是。”

examples.text: 'There are trains straight from Cambridge.' — 'I know, but it's no quicker.'
examples.translation: “有直接从剑桥开出的列车。”——“我知道，但也不快。”

examples.text: I'm sorry, George. I know how you feel...
examples.translation: 我很遗憾，乔治。我理解你的感受。

examples.text: I know what you're going through.
examples.translation: 我知道你正在经受什么样的煎熬。

examples.text: 'He should quite simply resign.' — 'I don't know about that.'
examples.translation: “他就该辞职。”——“我不知道。”

examples.text: I don't know that it's made the decision any easier.
examples.translation: 我不认为这对作出决定有丝毫帮助。

examples.text: I don't know about the rest of you, but I'm hungry...
examples.translation: 我不知道你们怎么样，但我是饿了。

examples.text: I don't know about you, but I've had just about enough of this.
examples.translation: 我不知道你怎么想，但我已经受够了。

examples.text: I don't know how he could do this to his own daughter...
examples.translation: 真想不到他竟对自己的女儿这样。

examples.text: I don't know how you can say that...
examples.translation: 真想不到你竟说那话。

examples.text: I don't know what those folk think they are playing at.
examples.translation: 真不知道那些家伙在搞什么鬼。

examples.text: 'What was that all about?' — 'Damned if I know.'
examples.translation: “那都是关于什么的？”——“我要知道就好了。”

examples.text: I'm damned if I know what plans he has in that direction.
examples.translation: 我压根不知道他在那方面有什么计划。

examples.text: It was gratifying to be in the know about important people...
examples.translation: 了解重要人物的一些内幕真令人高兴。

examples.text: He takes crucial decisions without consulting people in the know.
examples.translation: 他没有咨询相关知情人士就作了重要的决定。

examples.text: None of us stayed long. I mean, the atmosphere wasn't — well, you know what I mean...
examples.translation: 我们都没呆太久。我的意思是，气氛并不是——唔，你知道我的意思。

examples.text: She was a bit stuck up, know what I mean?
examples.translation: 她有点自命不凡，你明白我的意思吧?

examples.text: You never know, I might get lucky...
examples.translation: 很难说，我也许会交好运呢。

examples.text: There might be an even bigger one — I doubt it, but you never know.
examples.translation: 可能还有个比这还要大的——我觉得有点悬，但也很难说。

examples.text: 'Is he married?' — 'Not that I know of.'
examples.translation: “他结婚了吗？”——“据我所知没有。”

examples.text: How was I to know you'd return so suddenly?...
examples.translation: 我怎么知道你会这么突然就回来?

examples.text: You weren't to know — in fact, I think I'm the only person who does know.
examples.translation: 你不会知道——实际上，我想我是唯一真正知道的人。

examples.text: Don't listen to him, what does he know?...
examples.translation: 别听他的，他知道什么？

examples.text: I always felt his attitude was, 'What do you know about it?'
examples.translation: 我感觉他总是那种“你懂什么？”的态度。

examples.text: Well, what do you know!
examples.translation: 哎呀，真没想到！

examples.text: The conditions in there are awful, you know...
examples.translation: 你要知道，那里的条件很艰苦。

examples.text: You know, it does worry me.
examples.translation: 你要知道，这实在让我担心。

examples.text: He's generous and, you know, very nice, very polite...
examples.translation: 他很大方而且，你知道，很友善，很有礼貌。

examples.text: I thought I'd, you know, have a chat with you.
examples.translation: 我想我应该，呃，和你谈谈。

examples.text: Wear the white dress, you know, the one with all the black embroidery.
examples.translation: 穿那件白裙，你知道的，上面有黑色刺绣的那件。

examples.text: You don't know how good it is to speak to somebody from home.
examples.translation: 你不知道和家乡来的人说说话感觉有多好。

examples.text: He peered at the label on the bottle.
examples.translation: 他仔细地看着瓶上的标签。

examples.text: The stuff has never been properly logged and labelled...
examples.translation: 这些东西从未进行过妥善登记，也没有贴标签标注。

examples.text: Meat labelled 'Scotch Beef' sells for a premium in supermarkets...
examples.translation: 带有“Scotch Beef（苏格兰牛肉）”标志的牛肉在超市里售价不菲。

examples.text: All the products are labelled with comprehensive instructions.
examples.translation: 所有产品均标有详尽的使用说明。

examples.text: Too often the press are labelled as bad boys...
examples.translation: 记者们往往被视为捣蛋分子。

examples.text: Certain estates are labelled as undesirable...
examples.translation: 某些物业被归入不受欢迎之列。

examples.text: They are afraid to contact the social services in case they are labelled a problem family...
examples.translation: 由于害怕被贴上“问题家庭”的标签，他们不敢联系社会福利机构。

examples.text: If you venture from 'feminine' standards, you are labelled aggressive and hostile.
examples.translation: 女性要是不够女人味便会背上咄咄逼人、很不友善之名。

examples.text: Her treatment of her husband earned her the label of the most hated woman in America.
examples.translation: 她对待丈夫的行径使她赢得了“全美最可恶的女人”的称号。

examples.text: She landed a contract with record label EMI...
examples.translation: 她获得了一份与百代唱片公司的合约。

examples.text: It was on the Virgin label.
examples.translation: 它由维京唱片公司发行。

examples.text: There, they could still take advantage of cheap labor without having to contend with ocean crossings.

meanings.meaning: 花边；鞋带；饰带；少量烈酒

examples.text: She finally found the perfect gown, a beautiful creation trimmed with lace.
examples.translation: 她终于找到了理想的礼服——一袭饰有蕾丝的美丽长裙。

examples.text: ...a plain white lace bedspread.
examples.translation: 朴素的白色蕾丝床罩

examples.text: Barry was sitting on the bed, tying the laces of an old pair of running shoes.
examples.translation: 巴里正坐在床上系他那双旧跑鞋的鞋带。

examples.text: I have a good pair of skates, but no matter how tightly I lace them, my ankles wobble.
examples.translation: 我有一双不错的溜冰鞋，可是不管我把鞋带系得多紧，脚脖子那里还是空落落的。

examples.text: He sat on the steps, and laced up his boots...
examples.translation: 他坐在台阶上系靴子的鞋带。

examples.text: Nancy was lacing her shoe up when the doorbell rang.
examples.translation: 门铃响时南希正在系鞋带。

examples.text: She laced his food with sleeping pills.
examples.translation: 她在他的食物里掺了安眠药。

examples.text: Fred liked to lace his conversation with military terms.
examples.translation: 弗雷德喜欢在谈话中时不时蹦几个军事术语。

examples.text: ...a speech laced with humour.
examples.translation: 充满幽默的讲话

examples.text: He took to lacing his fingers together in an attempt to keep his hands still.
examples.translation: 为了不让双手发颤，他十指紧扣。

meanings.meaning: (Lack)人名；(老)拉；(英、法、意、葡、匈)拉克；(匈)洛克

examples.text: Despite his lack of experience, he got the job...
examples.translation: 他虽然经验不足，但还是获得了这份工作。

examples.text: The charges were dropped for lack of evidence...
examples.translation: 指控因证据不足而被撤销。

examples.text: He tricked his way into a job as a hospital doctor and killed a patient through lack of care...
examples.translation: 他混入医院当上医生，结果因疏忽职守致使一名病人丧生。

examples.text: There is a lack of people wanting to start up new businesses.
examples.translation: 有创业意愿的人非常匮乏。

examples.text: It lacked the power of the Italian cars...
examples.translation: 它没有意大利轿车动力强劲。

examples.text: He lacked the judgment and political acumen for the post of chairman...
examples.translation: 他欠缺做主席应具备的判断力和政治敏锐度。

examples.text: Certain vital information is lacking in the report.
examples.translation: 该报告缺少某些关键信息。

examples.text: He said there was no lack of things for them to talk about...
examples.translation: 他说他们之间不缺谈资。

examples.text: President Clinton displayed no lack of vigor when he began to speak.
examples.translation: 克林顿总统开腔时颇有气势。

examples.text: When I was a lad his age I would laugh at the strangest things...
examples.translation: 我是他那样的小毛孩时，莫明其妙地就会发笑。

examples.text: Come along, lad. Time for you to get home.
examples.translation: 来吧，小伙子。你该回家了。

examples.text: ...a drink with the lads...
examples.translation: 与哥们儿一块喝一杯

examples.text: The lads don't join the union because they're frightened of being victimized.
examples.translation: 那几个伙计没加入工会是因为害怕成为牺牲品。

examples.text: If they want to climb the ladder of success they should be given that opportunity...
examples.translation: 假如他们有出人头地的意愿，就应该给他们那样的机会。

examples.text: She admired her mother's sister for moving up the social ladder.
examples.translation: 她羡慕姨妈社会地位的提升。

examples.text: Her hair was a mess and there was a ladder in her tights.
examples.translation: 她头发乱糟糟，裤袜脱了线。

examples.text: She's a very sweet old lady...
examples.translation: 她是一位很和蔼的老太太。

examples.text: Shall we rejoin the ladies?
examples.translation: 咱们和女士们会合吧？

examples.text: ...a lady doctor.
examples.translation: 女医生

examples.text: ...a cream-coloured lady's shoe.
examples.translation: 乳白色女鞋

examples.text: Your table is ready, ladies, if you'd care to come through...
examples.translation: 你们的桌位已经准备好了，女士们，请跟我来。

examples.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen.
examples.translation: 下午好，女士们，先生们。

examples.text: ...the Empress and ladies of the Imperial Palace...
examples.translation: 皇后与皇宫里的贵妇们

examples.text: Our governess was told to make sure we knew how to talk like English ladies.
examples.translation: 要求家庭女教师教会我们英国贵妇般的谈吐。

examples.text: Cockburn's arrival coincided with that of Sir Iain and Lady Noble...
examples.translation: 科伯恩到时正好伊恩爵士和诺布尔夫人也来了。

examples.text: My dear Lady Mary, how very good to see you.
examples.translation: 亲爱的玛丽夫人，见到您真是太高兴了。

examples.text: His wife was great as well, beautiful-looking and a real lady...
examples.translation: 他妻子也很招人喜欢，样子俏丽，是位真正的淑女。

examples.text: A lady always sits quietly with her hands in her lap.
examples.translation: 淑女端坐时总是双手放在膝上，不发一言。

examples.text: At Temple station, Charlotte rushed into the Ladies.
examples.translation: 一到坦普尔站，夏洛特立即冲进了女厕所。

examples.text: What seems to be the trouble, lady?...
examples.translation: 您遇到什么麻烦了吗，小姐？

examples.text: As she left the litter-strewn lot, an angry voice called out to her. 'Hey, lady!'
examples.translation: 她正要离开满地垃圾的停车场，一个愤怒的声音朝她大嚷：“喂，小姐！”

meanings.meaning: 落后；迟延；防护套；囚犯；桶板
落后于；押往监狱；加上外套

examples.text: Britain still lags behind most of Europe in its provisions for women who want time off to have babies...
examples.translation: 英国在妇女生育福利方面依然落后于欧洲大多数国家。

examples.text: The restructuring of the pattern of consumption in Britain also lagged behind...
examples.translation: 在消费结构重组方面，英国也落后于人。

examples.text: He now lags 10 points behind the champion...
examples.translation: 他现在落后冠军10分。

examples.text: A poll for the Observer showed Labour on 39 per cent with the Tories lagging a point behind...
examples.translation: 《观察家报》一项民意调查显示，工党支持率为39%，保守党落后其1个百分点。

examples.text: Hague was lagging badly in the polls.
examples.translation: 黑格在民意调查中被远远抛在后面。

examples.text: There's a time lag between infection with HIV and developing AIDS...
examples.translation: 从感染艾滋病病毒到病发有一段滞后期。

examples.text: Price rises have matched rises in the money supply with a lag of two or three months.
examples.translation: 在增加货币供应两三个月后，物价也跟着上涨。

examples.text: If you have to take the floorboards up, take the opportunity to lag any pipes at the same time...
examples.translation: 如果一定要把地板掀开，不妨趁此机会给各个管道加一层隔热保护。

examples.text: Water tanks should be well lagged and the roof well insulated.
examples.translation: 水箱和屋顶都需要敷设严密的保温层。

examples.text: They can go fishing in the lake...
examples.translation: 他们可以在湖里钓鱼。

examples.text: The Nile flows from Lake Victoria in East Africa north to the Mediterranean Sea.
examples.translation: 尼罗河由东非的维多利亚湖向北流至地中海。

examples.text: Laura was basting the leg of lamb.
examples.translation: 劳拉正往羔羊腿上浇抹油脂。

examples.text: She came and put her arms around me. 'You poor lamb. What's wrong?'
examples.translation: 她走过来搂着我。“可怜的宝贝，出什么事儿啦？”

examples.text: The pair surrendered to him like lambs...
examples.translation: 那两个人乖乖地向他投降。

examples.text: We follow their every word like lambs to the slaughter.
examples.translation: 我们对他们完全言听计从。

meanings.meaning: 跛足的；僵痛的；不完全的；无说服力的；差劲的，蹩脚的

examples.text: He was aware that she was lame in one leg...
examples.translation: 他注意到她一条腿有残疾。

examples.text: David had to pull out of the Championships when his horse went lame.
examples.translation: 戴维不得不退出锦标赛，因为他的马瘸了。

examples.text: ... the wounded and the lame of the last war.
examples.translation: 上次战争中受伤和腿残的人

examples.text: Persistent damage or inadequate healing may lead to chronic lameness.
examples.translation: 反复受伤或治疗不当可导致长期跛足。

examples.text: He mumbled some lame excuse about having gone to sleep...
examples.translation: 他含含糊糊地找了个蹩脚的借口，想要解释自己为什么睡着了。

examples.text: All our theories sound pretty lame.
examples.translation: 我们的理论似乎全都站不住脚。

examples.text: 'Lovely house,' I said lamely.
examples.translation: “房子真不错，”我称赞道，听上去毫无信服力。

examples.text: She switched on the bedside lamp...
examples.translation: 她打开床头灯。

examples.text: In the evenings we eat by the light of an oil lamp.
examples.translation: 晚上我们便在一盏油灯下吃饭。

examples.text: ...a sun lamp.
examples.translation: 太阳灯

examples.text: ...the use of infra-red lamps.
examples.translation: 红外线灯的使用

examples.text: We had been made homeless by our landlady.
examples.translation: 我们被女房东弄得无家可归。

examples.text: ...Bet, the landlady of the Rovers Return.
examples.translation: “浪子归乡”酒吧老板娘贝特

examples.text: Good agricultural land is in short supply.
examples.translation: 良田短缺。

examples.text: ...160 acres of land.
examples.translation: 160英亩土地

examples.text: ...a small piece of grazing land.
examples.translation: 一小块牧地

examples.text: Their home is on his father's land...
examples.translation: 他们的家建在他父亲拥有的地皮上。

examples.text: His lands were poorly farmed.
examples.translation: 他的田地耕种不当。

examples.text: Living off the land was hard enough at the best of times.
examples.translation: 即使在年景最好的时候，务农为生也是相当艰辛的。

examples.text: It isn't clear whether the plane went down over land or sea.
examples.translation: 不清楚飞机是坠毁在陆地上还是海里。

examples.text: ...a stretch of sandy beach that was almost inaccessible from the land.
examples.translation: 从陆路几乎难以到达的一片沙滩

examples.text: Her husband's body lies buried 2,000 miles away in a strange land.
examples.translation: 她丈夫的遗体埋葬在两千英里外一个陌生的国度。

examples.text: ...blessed lands of sun and sea and olive trees.
examples.translation: 有着阳光、海水和橄榄树的美丽国度

examples.text: ...America, land of opportunity.
examples.translation: 美国——机遇之邦

examples.text: ...this land of free speech.
examples.translation: 这个言论自由的国度

examples.text: He was sent flying into the air and landed 20ft away...
examples.translation: 他被抛到空中，落在20英尺外的地方。

examples.text: Three mortar shells had landed close to a crowd of people.
examples.translation: 3枚迫击炮弹落在人群旁。

examples.text: The jet landed after a flight of just under three hours...
examples.translation: 这架喷气式飞机在飞行了将近3小时后降落了。

examples.text: He landed his troops on the western shore...
examples.translation: 他率部队在西岸登陆。

examples.text: The crew finally landed the plane on its belly on the soft part of the runway.
examples.translation: 机组人员终于使飞机腹部在跑道土质松软的部分着地。

examples.text: The vessels will have to land their catch at designated ports.
examples.translation: 船只必须在指定的港口把捕到的鱼卸下。

examples.text: ...a five-man gang which landed the huge shipment on the Cornwall coast.
examples.translation: 在康沃尔海岸卸下这一大批货的五人团伙

examples.text: He landed in a psychiatric ward...
examples.translation: 他被关进了精神病房。

examples.text: This is not the first time his exploits have landed him in trouble.
examples.translation: 这已经不是他第一次因自己的冒险行为而惹上麻烦了。

examples.text: The other options simply complicate the situation and could land him with more expense.
examples.translation: 其他办法只会使情况复杂化，而且可能给他带来更大花销。

examples.text: Two days later the book had already landed on his desk...
examples.translation: 两天后那本书竟然已经摆在了他的书桌上。

examples.text: This was the weekend that the war finally landed on their doorstep.
examples.translation: 在这个周末，战火终于烧到了他们的家门口。

examples.text: One angler landed fish of 10 lb and 9 lb on the same day.
examples.translation: 一名垂钓者在同一天分别钓到了10磅和9磅重的鱼。

examples.text: He landed a place on the graduate training scheme...
examples.translation: 他在毕业生培训计划中赢得了一个位置。

examples.text: His flair with hair soon landed him a part-time job at his local barbers.
examples.translation: 他的美发天赋令他很快在当地一家发廊找到一份兼职工作。

examples.text: De Leon landed a punch on the Italian's mouth after the end of the eleventh round...
examples.translation: 11个回合过后，德莱昂一拳击在那个意大利人的嘴巴上。

examples.text: I could hear the blows landing as he appealed for help.
examples.translation: 在他求救的同时我能听到拳头落下的声音。

examples.text: His landlord doubled the rent.
examples.translation: 他的房东把租金提高了一倍。

examples.text: The landlord refused to serve him because he considered him too drunk.
examples.translation: 酒吧老板觉得他已经喝多了，拒绝再给他添酒。

meanings.meaning: 小巷；[航][水运] 航线；车道；罚球区
(Lane)人名；(英、俄)莱恩；(老)兰；(德、法、意、葡、塞、瑞典)拉内

examples.text: ...a quiet country lane...
examples.translation: 宁静的乡间小径

examples.text: Follow the lane to the river.
examples.translation: 沿着小路走到河边。

examples.text: ...The Dorchester Hotel, Park Lane.
examples.translation: 公园路多切斯特酒店

examples.text: The lorry was travelling at 20mph in the slow lane...
examples.translation: 卡车在慢车道上以20英里的时速行驶。

examples.text: I pulled out into the eastbound lane of Route 2.
examples.translation: 我转入2号公路东向车道。

examples.text: The pool is divided into three sections with a crawler lane for beginners...
examples.translation: 泳池分三部分，有为初学者而设的慢泳道。

examples.text: Drawn in lane three, she had all her rivals in sight.
examples.translation: 她抽到第三道，所有对手尽收眼底。

examples.text: The collision took place in the busiest shipping lanes in the world.
examples.translation: 撞船事故发生在全世界最繁忙的航道上。

examples.text: ...the young criminals' lust for life in the fast lane.
examples.translation: 青少年罪犯对紧张刺激生活的贪求

meanings.meaning: 语言；语言文字；表达能力

examples.text: ...the English language...
examples.translation: 英语

examples.text: Students are expected to master a second language...
examples.translation: 学生们要掌握一门外语。

examples.text: Holidays are for seeing the sights, hearing the language and savouring the smells.
examples.translation: 度假是为了赏风景之美，听语言之妙，品百味之香。

examples.text: Students examined how children acquire language...
examples.translation: 学生们仔细研究儿童如何习得语言。

examples.text: Language is not art but both are forms of human behavior.
examples.translation: 言语不是艺术，但两者都是人类的行为方式。

examples.text: ...the language of business.
examples.translation: 商业用语

examples.text: Television companies tend to censor bad language in feature films...
examples.translation: 电视公司往往会在审查故事片时删去其中的粗话。

examples.text: There's a girl gonna be in the club, so you guys watch your language.
examples.translation: 俱乐部里会有一位女孩，你们男的说话注意点。

examples.text: ...a booklet summarising it in plain language...
examples.translation: 以平实语言对其作出概述的小册子

examples.text: The tone of his language was diplomatic and polite...
examples.translation: 他说话圆通得体、彬彬有礼。

examples.text: Mr Harris has not been afraid to use language that many in his party despise.
examples.translation: 哈里斯先生素来不怕使用为许多党内人士所不齿的言辞。

examples.text: Some sign languages are very sophisticated means of communication.
examples.translation: 有些手语可以表达非常复杂的内容。

examples.text: ...the digital language of computers.
examples.translation: 计算机的数字语言

examples.text: He toiled only by lantern-light, not letting anyone watch him work, and stopping when passers-by approached.
She waited quietly with her hands in her lap...
examples.translation: 她双手放在腿上静静等候。

examples.text: Hugh glanced at the child on her mother's lap.
examples.translation: 休瞥了一眼坐在她妈妈膝上的小女孩。

examples.text: ...that last lap of the race...
examples.translation: 比赛最后一圈

examples.text: On lap two, Baker edged forward.
examples.translation: 第二圈时，贝克悄然赶了上去。

examples.text: He was caught out while lapping a slower rider.
examples.translation: 他在套圈超越一位落后的车手时出了错。

examples.text: I had thought we might travel as far as Oak Valley, but we only managed the first lap of the journey.
examples.translation: 我原以为我们最远能到达橡树谷，结果只走完了第一段路程。

examples.text: ...the water that lapped against the pillars of the boathouse...
examples.translation: 轻拍着船屋支柱的海水

examples.text: With a rising tide the water was lapping at his chin before rescuers arrived...
examples.translation: 救援人员到达时上涨的潮水已经淹到了他的下巴。

examples.text: The building was right on the river and the water lapped the walls.
examples.translation: 建筑物就矗立在水中，河水轻轻拍打着墙壁。

examples.text: The only sound was the lapping of the waves.
examples.translation: 只闻浪涛拍击之声。

examples.text: The cat lapped milk from a dish.
examples.translation: 猫舔食盘中牛奶。

examples.text: She poured some water into a plastic bowl. Faust, her Great Dane, lapped it up with relish.
examples.translation: 她往一个塑料碗里倒了一些水，她的大丹犬福斯特便美滋滋地舔起来。

examples.text: They had to stop the operation, so at that stage my life was in the lap of the gods.
examples.translation: 他们不得不停止手术，所以那时的我只能听天由命。

examples.text: We don't live in the lap of luxury, but we're comfortable.
examples.translation: 我们的生活虽然并非锦衣玉食，也算是衣食无忧。

meanings.meaning: 失效；流逝；背离，失检；陷入

examples.text: On Friday he showed neither decency nor dignity. It was an uncommon lapse.
examples.translation: 星期五那天他的表现既不得体，又有失尊严。如此失态非常少有。

examples.text: I had a little lapse of concentration in the middle of the race...
examples.translation: 我在比赛中途一时走神。

examples.text: He was a genius and because of it you could accept lapses of taste...
examples.translation: 由于他是天才，所以品位上偶有差池大家也不会介意。

examples.text: The incident was being seen as a serious security lapse.
examples.translation: 这一事故被看作是一次严重的安全疏忽。

examples.text: She muttered something unintelligible and lapsed into silence...
examples.translation: 她不知嘟囔了几句什么后就不再开口。

examples.text: Doris Brown closed her eyes and lapsed into sleep.
examples.translation: 多丽丝·布朗闭上眼睛，安然入睡。

examples.text: She lapsed into a little girl voice to deliver a nursery rhyme...
examples.translation: 她改用童声唱起童谣来。

examples.text: Teenagers occasionally find it all too much to cope with and lapse into bad behaviour.
examples.translation: 青少年偶尔会因感到压力太大无所适从而做出不良行为。

examples.text: Her lapse into German didn't seem peculiar. After all, it was her native tongue.
examples.translation: 她冒出几句德语并不足为奇。毕竟那是她的母语。

examples.text: ...the restoration of diplomatic relations after a lapse of 24 years...
examples.translation: 时隔24年后外交关系的恢复

examples.text: There is usually a time lapse between receipt of new information and its publication.
examples.translation: 新信息的接收与发布之间通常会间隔一段时间。

examples.text: New products and production processes are transferred to the developing countries only after a substantial amount of time has lapsed.
examples.translation: 新的产品和生产工序要经过一段相当长的时间后才能向发展中国家转移。

examples.text: Her membership of the Labour Party has lapsed...
examples.translation: 她已不再是工党党员。

examples.text: Ford allowed the name and trademark to lapse during the Eighties.
examples.translation: 福特在20世纪80年代废止了该名称和商标。

examples.text: I lapsed in my 20s, returned to it, then lapsed again, while writing the life of historical Jesus...
examples.translation: 我20多岁时曾经停止信教，后来一度又信，再后来撰写历史上耶稣的生平故事时又再脱教。

examples.text: She calls herself a lapsed Catholic.
examples.translation: 她称自己已不再信仰天主教。

meanings.meaning: 膝上型轻便电脑，笔记本电脑

examples.text: She used to work at her laptop until four in the morning.
examples.translation: 她从前经常用手提电脑一直工作到凌晨4点。

examples.text: ...a laptop computer he called Magic Slate.
examples.translation: 一台被他称作“魔幻书写板”的便携式电脑

examples.text: The fund is largely financed through government borrowing...
examples.translation: 该基金大致上由政府借款支持。

examples.text: I largely work with people who already are motivated...
examples.translation: 我大多和积极主动的人一起工作。

examples.text: Their weapons have been largely stones.
examples.translation: 一直以来，他们的武器主要是石头。

examples.text: Retail sales dipped 6/10ths of a percent last month, largely because Americans were buying fewer cars...
examples.translation: 上月零售额下降了千分之六，主要是因为美国人买汽车少了。

examples.text: The French empire had expanded largely through military conquest.
examples.translation: 法兰西帝国的扩张主要靠军事征服。

examples.text: The Pike lives mainly in large rivers and lakes...
examples.translation: 狗鱼主要生活在大江大湖中。

examples.text: In the largest room about a dozen children and seven adults are sitting on the carpet...
examples.translation: 在最大那间房里，地毯上坐了约12个小孩和7个大人。

examples.text: He was a large man with thick dark hair.
examples.translation: 他身材魁梧，头发浓黑。

examples.text: The gang finally fled with a large amount of cash and jewellery...
examples.translation: 该团伙最后携大量现金和珠宝逃之夭夭。

examples.text: There are a large number of centres where you can take full-time courses...
examples.translation: 有很多中心提供全日制课程。

examples.text: The figures involved are truly very large.
examples.translation: 涉及数目确实非常庞大。

examples.text: ...a large company in Chicago...
examples.translation: 芝加哥一家大公司

examples.text: Many large organizations run courses for their employees.
examples.translation: 许多大企业为旗下员工开办课程。

examples.text: ...the already large problem of under-age drinking...
examples.translation: 已经很严重的未成年人饮酒问题

examples.text: There's a very large question about the viability of the newspaper.
examples.translation: 报纸能否办下去是一个重大问题。

examples.text: I think the chances of getting reforms accepted by the community at large remain extremely remote...
examples.translation: 我看要使改革方案得到社会的广泛认可，机会还很渺茫。

examples.text: Amongst the population at large the support for the present regime is virtually zero.
examples.translation: 在一般大众中，支持现政权的人数几乎是零。

examples.text: The man who tried to have her killed is still at large.
examples.translation: 那个企图雇凶杀她的男子仍然在逃。

examples.text: By and large, the papers greet the government's new policy document with a certain amount of scepticism.
examples.translation: 总体上，报界对政府的新政策文件将信将疑。

examples.text: ...new laser technology...
examples.translation: 新的激光技术

examples.text: Researchers realised that a tunable laser beam might be useful in surgery.
examples.translation: 研究人员意识到，可调谐激光束也许可以用在外科手术中。

examples.text: ...the first-ever laser, built in 1960.
examples.translation: 有史以来第一台激光器，于1960年制造

meanings.meaning: 鞭打；冲击；摆动；扎捆；煽动；讽刺
鞭打；睫毛；鞭子；责骂；讽刺

examples.text: ...sombre grey eyes, with unusually long lashes...
examples.translation: 一双忧郁的灰眼睛，眼睫毛长得出奇

examples.text: Joanna studied him through her lashes.
examples.translation: 乔安娜眯着眼睛打量他。

examples.text: Secure the anchor by lashing it to the rail...
examples.translation: 把锚系到栏杆上拴牢。

examples.text: The shelter is built by lashing poles together to form a small dome...
examples.translation: 把杆子扎成一个穹顶小棚就成了遮蔽所。

examples.text: Cindy lashed her motorboat alongside...
examples.translation: 辛迪把她的快艇系在旁边。

examples.text: We were worried about the lifeboat which was not lashed down.
examples.translation: 我们为那艘没有系牢的救生艇悬着心。

examples.text: The worst winter storms of the century lashed the east coast of North America...
examples.translation: 本世纪最恶劣的冬季暴风雪横扫北美东海岸。

examples.text: Suddenly rain lashed against the windows...
examples.translation: 蓦地，大雨猛烈地抽打在窗户上。

examples.text: The rain was absolutely lashing down.
examples.translation: 大雨倾盆。

examples.text: ...gales of lashing rain.
examples.translation: 狂风暴雨

examples.text: She went quiet for a moment while she summoned up the words to lash him...
examples.translation: 她沉默片刻，寻思着抨击他的话语。

examples.text: The report lashes into police commanders for failing to act on intelligence information.
examples.translation: 该报告严斥警局指挥官没有根据情报采取行动。

examples.text: Never before had he felt the full lash of John's temper.
examples.translation: 他以前从未见识过约翰如此暴烈的脾气。

examples.text: The villagers sentenced one man to five lashes for stealing a ham from his neighbor.
examples.translation: 村民们裁定将一名偷邻居火腿的男子鞭打5下。

examples.text: They snatched up whips and lashed the backs of those who had fallen.
examples.translation: 他们抓起鞭子，朝跌倒的人背上抽去。

examples.text: When in danger, the anteater lashes its tail round a branch...
examples.translation: 遇有危险，食蚁兽会迅速用尾巴卷住树枝。

examples.text: They tried to get the harpoon into the ray before the sting tail came lashing over to retaliate...
examples.translation: 他们试图把鱼叉刺进鳐鱼体内，以防它猛摆那蜇人的尾巴报复。

examples.text: Don't go near that lashing tail.
examples.translation: 别靠近它摆动的尾巴。

meanings.meaning: 末尾，最后；上个；鞋楦（做鞋的模型）
最后的；最近的，最新的；仅剩的；最不可能…的
最后地；上次，最近；最后一点

examples.text: I got married last July...
examples.translation: 我在刚过去的7月里结了婚。

examples.text: He never made it home at all last night...
examples.translation: 他昨晚根本没回家。

examples.text: Last month a shopkeeper's nephew was shot dead...
examples.translation: 上个月一名店主的侄子被枪杀了。

examples.text: It is not surprising they did so badly in last year's elections.
examples.translation: 他们在去年选举中如此糟糕的表现并不奇怪。

examples.text: Much has changed since my last visit...
examples.translation: 从我上次去到现在，很多事情已经变了。

examples.text: At the last count inflation was 10.9 per cent...
examples.translation: 最近一次统计显示通胀率为10.9%。

examples.text: I split up with my last boyfriend three years ago...
examples.translation: 我3年前和前任男友分的手。

examples.text: The last few weeks have been hectic.
examples.translation: 过去几周一直忙得不可开交。

examples.text: The next tide, it was announced, would be even higher than the last.
examples.translation: 据报下一次潮水甚至会比上一次涨得更高。

examples.text: When were you there last?...
examples.translation: 你上次去是什么时候？

examples.text: The house is a little more dilapidated than when I last saw it...
examples.translation: 那房子比我上次见到时更破旧了些。

examples.text: Hunting on the trust's 625,000 acres was last debated two years ago.
examples.translation: 有关在该托管机构管理的62.5万英亩土地上狩猎一事，最近一次辩论是两年前。

examples.text: This is his last chance as prime minister.
examples.translation: 这是他作为首相的最后机会。

examples.text: ...the last three pages of the chapter...
examples.translation: 该章最后3页

examples.text: She said it was the very last house on the road...
examples.translation: 她说就是路边最后那间屋子。

examples.text: They didn't come last in their league.
examples.translation: 他们没有在联赛中垫底。

examples.text: It wasn't the first time that this particular difference had divided them and it wouldn't be the last...
examples.translation: 他们因此事产生分歧不是第一次，也不会是最后一次。

examples.text: The trickiest bits are the last on the list.
examples.translation: 最棘手的部分列在最后。

examples.text: I testified last...
examples.translation: 我最后一个作证。

examples.text: I was always picked last for the football team at school...
examples.translation: 在学校里分队踢足球时，我总是最后被挑的那一个。

examples.text: The foreground, nearest the viewer, is painted last.
examples.translation: 距离观者最近的前景是最后才画的。

examples.text: She was the last to go to bed...
examples.translation: 她最后一个上床。

examples.text: Riccardo and I are always the last to know what's going on.
examples.translation: 我和里卡尔多总是最后才知道发生什么事情。

examples.text: Jed nodded, finishing off the last piece of pizza.
examples.translation: 杰德点点头，把最后一块比萨饼吃完。

examples.text: ...the freeing of the last hostage.
examples.translation: 最后一名人质的获释

examples.text: He finished off the last of the wine...
examples.translation: 他喝完了最后一点酒。

examples.text: The last of the ten inmates gave themselves up after twenty eight hours on the roof of the prison.
examples.translation: 在监狱屋顶上坚持了28小时后，10名囚犯中的最后几个终于投降。

examples.text: Sampras reached the last four at Wimbledon.
examples.translation: 桑普拉斯杀入了温布尔登四强。

examples.text: ...the only woman among the authors making it through to the last six.
examples.translation: 进入最后6人名单的唯一一位女作家

examples.text: The last thing I wanted to do was teach...
examples.translation: 我最不想干的事情就是教书。

examples.text: He would be the last person who would do such a thing.
examples.translation: 他最不可能干这种事情。

examples.text: I would be the last to say that science has explained everything.
examples.translation: 我绝对不认为科学已经解释了所有事情。

examples.text: She disappeared shouting, 'To the river, to the river!' And that was the last we saw of her...
examples.translation: 她高喊着“往河里去，往河里去！”然后就消失了。那是我们最后一次看到她的情形。

examples.text: I had a feeling it would be the last I heard of him.
examples.translation: 我有一种感觉，这将是我最后一次听到他的消息。

examples.text: The marriage had lasted for less than two years...
examples.translation: 这段婚姻维持了不到两年。

examples.text: The games lasted only half the normal time...
examples.translation: 比赛只持续了通常时间的一半。

examples.text: Enjoy it because it won't last.
examples.translation: 尽情享受吧，因为这不会长久。

examples.text: You only need a very small blob of glue, so one tube lasts for ages...
examples.translation: 每次只需一点点胶水而已，因此一管可以用很长时间。

examples.text: The repaired sail lasted less than 24 hours...
examples.translation: 修好的帆支撑了不到24小时。

examples.text: The implication is that this battery lasts twice as long as other batteries...
examples.translation: 言外之意是，这种电池的寿命是其他品牌电池的两倍。

examples.text: If you build more plastics into cars, the car lasts longer.
examples.translation: 如果汽车采用更多塑料元件，寿命会更长一些。

examples.text: They wouldn't have lasted the full game...
examples.translation: 他们本不可能撑完整场比赛的。

examples.text: I almost lasted the two weeks. I only had a couple of days to do.
examples.translation: 我几乎撑过了这两个星期。我只有几天时间去做。

examples.text: It'll be a miracle if the band lasts out the tour...
examples.translation: 如果乐队能撑完巡演，那将是个奇迹。

examples.text: A breakfast will be served to those who last out till dawn!
examples.translation: 坚持到天亮的能吃上早餐！

examples.text: I'm so glad that we've found you at last!...
examples.translation: 我们终于找到你了，我真是太高兴了！

examples.text: Here, at long last, was the moment he had waited for...
examples.translation: 他等待已久的时刻终于到来。

examples.text: At last the train arrived in the station...
examples.translation: 火车终于到站了。

examples.text: 'All right', he said at last. 'You may go.'
examples.translation: “好吧”，他终于开口道，“你可以走了。”

examples.text: It was the dog he'd heard the night before last...
examples.translation: 他前晚听到的是狗叫声。

examples.text: In the budget before last a tax penalty on the mobile phone was introduced.
examples.translation: 上上次的预算案中对移动电话引入了惩罚性税收。

examples.text: It's the last but one day in the athletics programme...
examples.translation: 那是田径比赛结束的前一天。

examples.text: The British team finished last but one.
examples.translation: 英国队位列倒数第二。

examples.text: I'd spent all I had, every last penny...
examples.translation: 我把钱全部花光了，一分不剩。

examples.text: You'll never quite get rid of every last bit of grit...
examples.translation: 无法把所有的沙砾都清除干净。

examples.text: My tape recorder did not catch every last word.
examples.translation: 我的录音机并没有把每一个字都录下来。

examples.text: Workers will go on a 'last in, first out' basis.
examples.translation: 对工人的裁员原则是“后进先出”。

examples.text: The last I heard, Joe and Irene were still happily married.
examples.translation: 我最近一次听说时，乔和艾琳仍然是一对快乐的夫妻。

examples.text: I have left my best wine until last...
examples.translation: 我把最好的酒留到了最后。

examples.text: I picked first all the people who usually were left till last.
examples.translation: 我先挑出了所有通常留到最后的人。

examples.text: I honestly thought I'd seen the last of you.
examples.translation: 老实说我以为再也不用见到你了。

examples.text: ...a highly readable political thriller with plenty of twists of plot to keep you guessing to the last.
examples.translation: 一部可读性极强的政治惊悚小说，情节峰回路转，不到最后一刻绝对猜不中结局

examples.text: A gentleman to the last, he did not run, but merely attempted to stroll away...
examples.translation: 他始终保持绅士风度，没有拔脚就跑，只是试图移步走开。

examples.text: Armstrong was tall and handsome to the last.
examples.translation: 阿姆斯特朗从来都是这么高大、英俊。

examples.text: Every movement, no matter how casual and spontaneous, needs to be worked out to the last detail...
examples.translation: 对每一个动作，无论它显得多么随意和无意识，都不能放过一丝细节。

examples.text: Our troops are being used up to the last man.
examples.translation: 我们的部队已人尽其用。

meanings.meaning: 晚的；迟的；已故的；最近的

examples.text: It was late in the afternoon...
examples.translation: 那是下午近黄昏的时候。

examples.text: She had to work late at night...
examples.translation: 她不得不深夜工作。

examples.text: His autobiography was written late in life...
examples.translation: 他的自传写于晚年。

examples.text: The case is expected to end late next week...
examples.translation: 这个案子预计在下周晚些时候结案。

examples.text: Since late last year the border area has been the scene of heavy fighting.
examples.translation: 自去年底以来，边界地区的战斗一直很激烈。

examples.text: The talks eventually broke down in late spring...
examples.translation: 在春天快要结束时谈判最终破裂。

examples.text: He was in his late 20s.
examples.translation: 他将近30岁。

examples.text: ...the late 1960s.
examples.translation: 20世纪60年代末

examples.text: It was very late and the streets were deserted...
examples.translation: 时间已很晚，街上空空荡荡。

examples.text: We've got to go now. It's getting late.
examples.translation: 我们得走了。时候不早了。

examples.text: A large crowd had gathered despite the lateness of the hour.
examples.translation: 尽管天色已晚，仍有一大群人聚集到了一起。

examples.text: Steve arrived late...
examples.translation: 史蒂夫迟到了。

examples.text: The talks began some fifteen minutes late...
examples.translation: 会谈晚了大概15分钟才开始。

examples.text: We got up late.
examples.translation: 我们起晚了。

examples.text: His campaign got off to a late start...
examples.translation: 他的竞选活动启动较晚。

examples.text: We were a little late...
examples.translation: 咱们有点晚了。

examples.text: The train was 40 minutes late...
examples.translation: 火车晚点了40分钟。

examples.text: He's a half hour late.
examples.translation: 他迟到了半小时。

examples.text: He apologised for his lateness.
examples.translation: 他为迟到道歉。

examples.text: We went to bed very late...
examples.translation: 我们很晚才睡。

examples.text: He married late.
examples.translation: 他结婚晚。

examples.text: They had a late lunch in a cafe...
examples.translation: 他们很晚才在一家小餐馆吃了午饭。

examples.text: He was a very late developer.
examples.translation: 他发育相当晚。

examples.text: ...my late husband.
examples.translation: 我已故的丈夫

examples.text: ...the late Mr Parkin.
examples.translation: 已故的帕金先生

examples.text: ...Cousin Zachary, late of Bellevue Avenue.
examples.translation: 直到不久前还住在贝尔邬大道的表兄扎卡里

examples.text: ...Strobe Talbott, late of Time magazine.
examples.translation: 刚离开《时代》杂志不久的斯特罗布·塔尔博特

examples.text: It's been a long time coming but better late than never.
examples.translation: 早就该如此了。不过，也总比没有的强。

examples.text: I'd left it all too late in the day to get anywhere with these strategies.
examples.translation: 我按兵不动时间太长，致使这些策略都不管用了。

examples.text: His life has changed of late...
examples.translation: 他的生活近来发生了变化。

examples.text: The dollar has been stronger of late.
examples.translation: 美元近来走势强劲。

examples.text: It was too late to turn back...
examples.translation: 回头已经太晚了。

examples.text: We realized too late that we were caught like rats in a trap.
examples.translation: 等我们发觉自己已成瓮中之鳖时已经太晚了。

examples.text: Dad's health hasn't been too good lately...
examples.translation: 爸爸的健康状况近来不太好。

examples.text: Lord Tomas had lately been appointed Chairman of the Centre for Policy Studies...
examples.translation: 托马斯勋爵最近被任命为政策研究中心主席。

examples.text: 'Have you talked to her lately?'
examples.translation: “你最近有没有跟她谈过？”

examples.text: Optimism about the US economy has been a rare commodity lately.
examples.translation: 近来很少有人对美国经济持乐观态度。

examples.text: ...Timothy Jean Geoffrey Pratt, lately deputy treasury solicitor...
examples.translation: 新卸任的政府法务部副部长蒂莫西·琼·杰弗里·普拉特

examples.text: Advertisements attempt to project a latent meaning behind an overt message.
examples.translation: 广告的意图是以公开的信息传达隐含之意。

examples.text: He resigned ten years later...
examples.translation: 10年后他辞了职。

examples.text: I'll join you later...
examples.translation: 我呆会儿和你会合。

examples.text: Burke later admitted he had lied.
examples.translation: 伯克后来承认自己撒了谎。

examples.text: Later on I'll be speaking to Patty Davis...
examples.translation: 等会儿我会跟帕蒂·戴维斯谈。

examples.text: This is only going to cause me more problems later on.
examples.translation: 这只会在以后给我带来更多麻烦。

examples.text: At a later news conference, he said differences should not be dramatized...
examples.translation: 在后来的新闻发布会上，他说不应夸大分歧。

examples.text: The competition should have been rescheduled for a later date...
examples.translation: 比赛本应另择日期。

examples.text: A later report said the oil fire on the sea was out.
examples.translation: 随后的报道称，海上的石油大火已经熄灭。

examples.text: He found happiness in later life...
examples.translation: 他在晚年找到了幸福。

examples.text: In his later years he wrote very little...
examples.translation: 晚年他甚少动笔。

examples.text: Her later career was best known for her partnership with Rudolf Nureyev.
examples.translation: 在她职业生涯后期，最为人熟知的是和鲁道夫·努列耶夫的搭档组合。

examples.text: ...the later part of the 20th century.
examples.translation: 20世纪后半叶

examples.text: McKinnon estimated the lateral movement of the bridge to be between four and six inches.
examples.translation: 麦金农估计大桥的侧向移动介于4至6英寸之间。

examples.text: Shafts were sunk, with tunnels dug laterally.
examples.translation: 竖井已经打下，并且挖有横向矿道。

examples.text: Cuba was one of the least Catholic of the Latin countries...
examples.translation: 古巴是拉丁语系国家中天主教化程度最小的国家之一。

examples.text: The enthusiasm for Latin music is worldwide.
examples.translation: 全球掀起拉丁音乐热潮。

examples.text: They are role models for thousands of young Latins.
examples.translation: 他们是千万拉丁青年的榜样。

examples.text: In the middle to high latitudes rainfall has risen steadily over the last 20-30 years.
examples.translation: 在过去二三十年里，中高纬度地区的降雨量持续增加。

examples.text: The army must cease military operations above 36 degrees latitude north.
examples.translation: 在北纬36度以北地区，军队必须停止军事行动。

examples.text: He would be given every latitude in forming a new government...
examples.translation: 他将可以不受任何限制地组建新政府。

examples.text: His status at the studio afforded him all the artistic latitude he could ask for.
examples.translation: 他在创作室的地位让他可以在艺术上自由探索。

meanings.meaning: 后者的；近来的；后面的；较后的

examples.text: He tracked down his cousin and uncle. The latter was sick.
examples.translation: 他追查到了堂弟和叔叔的下落，发现叔叔这时正在病中。

examples.text: There are the people who speak after they think and the people who think while they're speaking. Mike definitely belongs in the latter category.
examples.translation: 有些人开口之前会三思，而有些人想到什么就说什么。迈克绝对属于后者。

examples.text: He is getting into the latter years of his career...
examples.translation: 他正步入职业生涯的后半程。

examples.text: The latter part of the debate concentrated on abortion.
examples.translation: 后半部分的辩论集中在堕胎问题上。

examples.text: Their laughter filled the corridor...
examples.translation: 整个走廊都回荡着他们的笑声。

examples.text: He delivered the line perfectly, and everybody roared with laughter.
examples.translation: 那句台词他拿捏得恰到好处，引得众人哈哈大笑。

examples.text: ...hysterical laughter.
examples.translation: 歇斯底里的笑声

examples.text: Pantomime is about bringing laughter to thousands...
examples.translation: 圣诞童话剧旨在把欢笑带给千千万万的人。

examples.text: My interests: eating out, fun nights in, music and laughter.
examples.translation: 我的爱好是：到外面上馆子，晚上在家娱乐，听音乐，寻乐子。

examples.text: He was about to offer an explanation, but she was beginning to laugh...
examples.translation: 他正要解释，她却笑起来了。

examples.text: He laughed with pleasure when people said he looked like his dad...
examples.translation: 人们说他长得像父亲时，他乐得大笑起来。

examples.text: The British don't laugh at the same jokes as the French...
examples.translation: 法国人觉得好笑的笑话，英国人不一定会笑。

examples.text: 'I'll be astonished if I win on Sunday,' laughed Lyle.
examples.translation: “我要是星期天能赢那就真是奇了怪了，”莱尔笑道。

examples.text: Lysenko gave a deep rumbling laugh at his own joke.
examples.translation: 李森科说笑话的时候自己咯咯直乐。

examples.text: I thought they were laughing at me because I was ugly...
examples.translation: 我觉得他们嘲笑我是因为我长得丑。

examples.text: She wanted to laugh at the melodramatic way he was acting.
examples.translation: 他戏剧化的夸张架势使她忍不住想笑。

examples.text: They were persuaded onstage for a laugh by their mates...
examples.translation: 他们被同伴们说服，上台一乐。

examples.text: It's a project she's doing for laughs.
examples.translation: 这个项目是她图好玩儿才做的。

examples.text: If you can get a laugh by wearing a silly hat, you must have been born a comic...
examples.translation: 如果你戴一顶傻傻的帽子就能让人发笑，那你一定是天生的笑匠。

examples.text: The joke got a big laugh, which encouraged me to continue.
examples.translation: 我的笑话引来哄堂大笑，这使我深受鼓舞，继续往下讲。

examples.text: Working there's great. It's quite a good laugh actually...
examples.translation: 在那儿工作挺不错。说实在的，蛮好玩儿的。

examples.text: It was a good laugh there!
examples.translation: 那儿可真是好玩！

examples.text: Mickey was a good laugh and great to have in the dressing room.
examples.translation: 米基是个活宝，在更衣室里总是逗人笑个不停。

examples.text: We've both had a good laugh about the accident despite what's happened.
examples.translation: 虽然出了意外，但我俩事后都一笑置之。

examples.text: Des O'Connor is expecting to have the last laugh on his critics by soaring to the top of the Christmas hit parade.
examples.translation: 德斯·奥康纳预计会飙升至圣诞畅销唱片排行榜的榜首，这将让他的批评者都笑不出来。

examples.text: Claire, a poisoner? Don't make me laugh — She was just a lousy cook.
examples.translation: 克莱尔投毒？别逗了。她只不过厨艺很差罢了。

examples.text: The bikers have shown enough contempt of the law to ride their machines over police cars. 'You've got to laugh at their audacity,' said Mr Starkey.
examples.translation: 摩托车党藐视法律，竟对警车玩起凌空飞车来。“牛气可嘉呀，”斯塔基先生说道。

meanings.meaning: 发射（导弹、火箭等）；发起，发动；使…下水
发射；发行，投放市场；下水；汽艇

examples.text: NASA plans to launch a satellite to study cosmic rays...
examples.translation: 美国国家航空航天局计划发射一颗卫星上天，对宇宙射线进行研究。

examples.text: A Delta II rocket was launched from Cape Canaveral early this morning.
examples.translation: 今天一早，一枚“德尔塔”Ⅱ型火箭在卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

examples.text: This morning's launch of the space shuttle Columbia has been delayed.
examples.translation: 原定今早“哥伦比亚”号航天飞机的发射已被推迟。

examples.text: There was no time to launch the lifeboats because the ferry capsized with such alarming speed.
examples.translation: 渡轮瞬间倾覆，根本没时间放救生艇下水。

examples.text: The launch of a ship was a big occasion.
examples.translation: 新船下水是件大事。

examples.text: Heavy fighting has been going on after the guerrillas had launched their offensive...
examples.translation: 游击队发起攻击后，激烈的战斗一直持续不断。

examples.text: The police have launched an investigation into the incident...
examples.translation: 警方已对该事件展开调查。

examples.text: The President was on holiday when the coup was launched.
examples.translation: 政变发动时，总统正在度假。

examples.text: ...the launch of a campaign to restore law and order.
examples.translation: 发起一场旨在恢复法律和秩序的运动

examples.text: Crabtree & Evelyn has just launched a new jam, Worcesterberry Preserve...
examples.translation: 瑰珀翠刚推出一款新果酱——伍斯特浆果果酱。

examples.text: Marks & Spencer recently hired model Linda Evangelista to launch its new range.
examples.translation: 玛莎百货最近聘请模特儿琳达·埃万杰利斯塔为其发布新系列产品。

examples.text: The company's spending has also risen following the launch of a new Sunday magazine.
examples.translation: 发行一本新周日杂志后，公司的开支也跟着上升。

examples.text: The captain was on the deck of the launch, steadying the boat for the pilot...
examples.translation: 船长站在汽艇甲板上为领航员保向。

examples.text: We'll make a trip by launch to White Island.
examples.translation: 我们将乘汽艇到怀特岛。

meanings.meaning: 洗衣店，洗衣房；要洗的衣服；洗熨；洗好的衣服

examples.text: I'll do your laundry...
examples.translation: 我来帮你洗衣服。

examples.text: ...the room where I hang the laundry...
examples.translation: 我晾挂衣服的房间

examples.text: He'd put his dirty laundry in the clothes basket.
examples.translation: 他会把自己的脏衣服扔进洗衣篮里。

examples.text: We had to have the washing done at the laundry.
examples.translation: 我们得把衣服拿到洗衣店去洗。

examples.text: He worked in the laundry at Oxford prison.
examples.translation: 他在牛津监狱的洗衣房工作。

examples.text: ...the ladies' lavatory at the University of London.
examples.translation: 伦敦大学的女厕所

examples.text: ...a public lavatory.
examples.translation: 公厕

meanings.meaning: 法律；规律；法治；法学；诉讼；司法界
(Law)人名；(东南亚国家华语)刘；(英、缅、柬)劳

examples.text: Obscene and threatening phone calls are against the law...
examples.translation: 猥亵和恐吓电话都是违法的。

examples.text: They are seeking permission to begin criminal proceedings against him for breaking the law on financing political parties...
examples.translation: 他们正寻求取得对他提起刑事诉讼的许可令，以控告他违反了有关政党资助的法律。

examples.text: There must be changes in the law quickly to stop this sort of thing ever happening to anyone else...
examples.translation: 我们必须迅速修订法律，以杜绝此类事情发生在其他人身上。

examples.text: The book analyses why women kill and how the law treats them.
examples.translation: 该书分析了女性杀人的动机以及法律对此是如何规定的。

examples.text: He was a professor of criminal law at Harvard University law school...
examples.translation: 他是哈佛大学法学院的刑法学教授。

examples.text: Under international law, diplomats living in foreign countries are exempt from criminal prosecution...
examples.translation: 根据国际法，驻外外交官员免受刑事检控。

examples.text: Important questions of constitutional law were involved.
examples.translation: 其中涉及到有关宪法的一些重大问题。

examples.text: ...the country's liberal political asylum law...
examples.translation: 该国开明的政治庇护法

examples.text: The law was passed on a second vote.
examples.translation: 此法在第二次表决时通过。

examples.text: ...the laws of the Church of England...
examples.translation: 英国国教会的教规

examples.text: Match officials should not tolerate such behaviour but instead enforce the laws of the game.
examples.translation: 赛事官员不应纵容这种行为，而应严格执行比赛规则。

examples.text: ...inflexible moral laws.
examples.translation: 不容改变的道德准则

examples.text: The laws of nature are absolute.
examples.translation: 自然法则至高无上。

examples.text: ...the law of gravity.
examples.translation: 万有引力定律

examples.text: A career in law is becoming increasingly attractive to young people...
examples.translation: 法律行业对年轻人的吸引力越来越大。

examples.text: Nearly 100 law firms are being referred to the Solicitors' Disciplinary Tribunal.
examples.translation: 近百家律师事务所被送上律师纪律法庭。

examples.text: He came to Oxford and studied law...
examples.translation: 他来到牛津学习法律。

examples.text: He holds a law degree from Bristol University.
examples.translation: 他拥有布里斯托尔大学的法律学位。

examples.text: One opposition member of parliament accuses the government of wanting to be above the law...
examples.translation: 议会一名反对党议员指责政府意图凌驾于法律之上。

examples.text: He considered himself above the law.
examples.translation: 他自以为比法还大。

examples.text: On the law of averages we just can't go on losing.
examples.translation: 根据平均律，我们不会再输下去了。

examples.text: By law all restaurants must display their prices outside...
examples.translation: 根据法律，所有餐厅都必须在店外明示用餐价格。

examples.text: Minicabs are prohibited by law from touting passers-by for business.
examples.translation: 无标志的预约型出租车沿街拉客是非法的。
