examples.text: He went to law and did not succeed in his claim against us.
examples.translation: 他告上了法庭，但没有告赢我们。

examples.text: ...traditional parents, who believed in laying down the law for their offspring.
examples.translation: 认为应对子女发号施令的传统的家长们

examples.text: The speeding motorist was pinned to the ground by angry locals who took the law into their own hands until police arrived.
examples.translation: 愤怒的当地人以暴代法——将超速司机强行按在地上，直至警察赶来。

examples.text: Some of the landowners were a law unto themselves. There was nobody to check their excesses and they exploited the people.

examples.translation: 新闻短片里有他跳向空中的画面。

examples.text: The man threw his arms out as he leapt.
examples.translation: 该男子张开双臂，纵身一跳。

examples.text: Smith took Britain's fifth medal of the championships with a leap of 2.37 metres.
examples.translation: 史密斯跳出2.37米的成绩，为英国夺得锦标赛的第5枚奖牌。

examples.text: The two men leaped into the jeep and roared off...
examples.translation: 两名男子跳上吉普车，疾驰而去。

examples.text: With a terrible howl, he leapt forward and threw himself into the water.
examples.translation: 他狂吼一声，向前猛冲，纵身跳进水中。

examples.text: The car leapt forward.
examples.translation: 汽车向前飞驰。

examples.text: The result has been a giant leap in productivity.
examples.translation: 其结果是生产力的大幅提高。

examples.text: ...the leap in the unemployed from 35,000 to 75,000...
examples.translation: 由35,000猛增至75,000的失业人数

examples.text: Contemporary art has taken a huge leap forward in the last five or six years.
examples.translation: 当代艺术在过去五六年间突飞猛进。

examples.text: Warwicks leap to third in the table, 31 points behind leaders Essex.
examples.translation: 沃里克队在排名中蹿升至第3名，落后领先的埃塞克斯队31分。

examples.text: My heart leaped at the sight of her.
examples.translation: 我见到她时心都要跳出来了。

examples.text: The post of principal of the theatre school became vacant and he leapt at the chance.
examples.translation: 戏剧学校校长一职出缺，他马上抓住了这个机会。

examples.text: He's improved in leaps and bounds this season...
examples.translation: 他今季的表现一日千里。

examples.text: The total number of species on the planet appears to be growing by leaps and bounds.
examples.translation: 地球上的物种数目似乎正飞速增长。

examples.text: Prudent people are not going to take a leap in the dark...
examples.translation: 小心谨慎的人是不会轻易冒险的。

examples.text: Once more he's making a leap into the unknown without a plan.
examples.translation: 他再次毫无计划地乱闯。

examples.text: Their children were going to learn English...
examples.translation: 他们的小孩会学英语。

examples.text: He is learning to play the piano.
examples.translation: 他在学钢琴。

examples.text: ...learning how to use new computer systems...
examples.translation: 学习如何使用新的电脑系统

examples.text: Experienced teachers help you learn quickly.
examples.translation: 经验丰富的老师可助你学习快速有成。

examples.text: ...a bilingual approach to the learning of English.
examples.translation: 学习英语的双语方法

examples.text: It was only after his death that she learned of his affair with Betty...
examples.translation: 一直到他死后她才知道他和贝蒂有染。

examples.text: It didn't come as a shock to learn that the fuel and cooling systems are the most common causes of breakdown...
examples.translation: 燃油和冷却系统是造成故障的最常见的原因，这一点不奇怪。

examples.text: ...the Admiral, who, on learning who I was, wanted to meet me.
examples.translation: 得知我是谁后想和我结识的海军上将

examples.text: You have to learn to face your problem...
examples.translation: 你要学会面对自己的问题。

examples.text: We are learning how to confront death instead of avoiding its reality.
examples.translation: 我们在学习如何直面死亡，而非回避死亡这一现实。

examples.text: I am convinced that he has learned from his mistakes...
examples.translation: 我深信他已从错误中吸取了教训。

examples.text: The company failed to learn any lessons from this experience.
examples.translation: 公司未能从这次经历中吸取任何教训。

examples.text: He learned this song as an inmate at a Texas prison.
examples.translation: 他在得克萨斯监狱服刑时学会了这首歌。

meanings.meaning: 博学的；有学问的；学术上的

examples.text: He is a serious scholar, a genuinely learned man.
examples.translation: 他是一位严谨的学者，一个真正的学问家。

examples.text: This learned book should start a real debate on Western policy towards the Baltics.
examples.translation: 这部学术性著作应该会引发一场关于西方对波罗的海国家政策的大辩论。

examples.text: Your anxiety is a learned reaction, and it is nurtured and sustained by the events of your everyday life.
examples.translation: 人的焦虑是后天反应，由日常生活中的事件催生和维系。

examples.text: The brochure described the library as the focal point of learning on the campus.
examples.translation: 这本小册子把图书馆形容为校园学习的中心。

meanings.meaning: 租约；租期；租赁物；租赁权

examples.text: He took up a 10 year lease on the house at Rossie Priory.
examples.translation: 他签了一份10年租约，租下了罗茜大宅的房子。

examples.text: He went to Toronto, where he leased an apartment...
examples.translation: 他去了多伦多，在那儿租了一间公寓。

examples.text: She hopes to lease the building to students...
examples.translation: 她希望把房子租给学生。

examples.text: He will need more grazing land and perhaps La Prade could lease him a few acres.
examples.translation: 他将需要更多牧场，也许拉普拉德可以租几英亩地给他。

examples.text: The operation has given me a new lease of life.
examples.translation: 手术使我重获新生。

meanings.meaning: 最小的；最少的（little的最高级）

examples.text: Least is often considered to be the superlative form of little.
examples.translation: least常被看作little的最高级。

examples.text: Aim to have at least half a pint of milk each day...
examples.translation: 目标是每天至少喝半品脱的牛奶。

examples.text: About two-thirds of adults consult their doctor at least once a year...
examples.translation: 约有2/3的成年人至少每年就医一次。

examples.text: Normally it has only had eleven or twelve members in all. Now it will have seventeen at the very least.
examples.translation: 通常总共只有十一二个会员。现在将至少有十七个。

examples.text: She could take a nice holiday at least...
examples.translation: 最不济她也可以去过一个愉快的假期。

examples.text: He is at least content that there will be no immediate use of force...
examples.translation: 至少他对不会即时使用暴力感到满意。

examples.text: At the least, I needed some sleep...
examples.translation: 起码我得睡一会儿。

examples.text: His possession of classified documents in his home was, at the very least, a violation of Navy security regulations.
examples.translation: 他把机密文件藏在家中，至少是违反了海军安全条例。

examples.text: We've no idea what his state of health is but at least we know he is still alive...
examples.translation: 我们不清楚他的健康情况如何，但起码知道他仍然活着。

examples.text: If something awful happens to you at least you can write about it.
examples.translation: 如果你遭遇了不幸，至少你有东西可写。

examples.text: It's not difficult to get money for research or at least it's not always difficult...
examples.translation: 争取到研究资金并不难，起码不总是那么难。

examples.text: The police say his death was an accident, officially at least...
examples.translation: 警方说他的死是个意外，起码官方消息如此。

examples.text: They didn't actually like the magazine very much, but they bought it or, at the least, borrowed it from each other.
examples.translation: 他们其实并不怎么喜欢这本杂志，但还是会买，或至少会互相借着看。

examples.text: I try to offend the least amount of people possible...
examples.translation: 我尽量少得罪人。

examples.text: If you like cheese, go for the ones with the least fat.
examples.translation: 要是喜欢吃奶酪，就吃脂肪含量最少的。

examples.text: On education funding, Japan performs best but spends the least per student.
examples.translation: 在教育投资方面，日本花在每位学生身上的钱最少，但却做得最好。

examples.text: Damming the river may end up benefitting those who need it the least.
examples.translation: 筑坝截流最终可能使与该河最无利害关系的人受益。

examples.text: The least experienced athletes had caused a great many false-starts through the day's proceedings...
examples.translation: 那天的比赛中，经验最浅的运动员抢跑无数次。

examples.text: He was one of the least warm human beings I had ever met.
examples.translation: 他是我见过的最冷漠的人之一。

examples.text: ...the least technically accomplished car in Europe.
examples.translation: 欧洲技术含量最小的汽车

examples.text: I don't have the least idea of what you're talking about...
examples.translation: 我一点儿都不知道你在说什么。

examples.text: They neglect their duty at the least hint of fun elsewhere...
examples.translation: 别处哪怕发生一丁点儿乐事，他们便会忘记自己的职责。

examples.text: The bosses paid less than they had promised and the least complaint went to the police.
examples.translation: 老板们给的钱比原先答应的少，而警方收到的投诉少之又少。

examples.text: He had a way of throwing her off guard with his charm when she least expected it.
examples.translation: 他往往趁她最没有心理准备时发动魅力攻势，令她措手不及。

examples.text: Having to get up at three o'clock every morning was the least of her worries...
examples.translation: 她发愁的事多着呢，相比之下，每天早上3点就要起床根本就不算什么。

examples.text: Although three days isn't very long, shortage of time was the least of his problems...
examples.translation: 虽然3天时间不算长，但对他来说，这已经是最不成问题的问题了。

examples.text: At that moment, they were among the least of the concerns of the government.
examples.translation: 那时，他们还谈不上是政府的心头之患。

examples.text: Well, the least you can do, if you won't help me yourself, is to tell me where to go instead...
examples.translation: 你自己要是不帮我，好歹也告诉我该上哪儿去呀。

examples.text: The least they could have given me was half a day to rest...
examples.translation: 他们本应该起码给我半天时间休息。

examples.text: The least his hotel could do is provide a little privacy.
examples.translation: 他的酒店至少应该提供一点隐私保护。

examples.text: Why not relax and let me teach you how to windsurf? It's the least I can do...
examples.translation: 干吗不轻松一下，让我来教你玩帆板？我乐意为你效劳。

examples.text: I want to help — it's the least I can do for the girl who saved my brother...
examples.translation: 我想要帮忙——这姑娘救了我弟弟一命，这是我最起码能做的。

examples.text: 'Right,' she said, chuckling. 'Thanks, anyway.' 'It was the least I could do'.
examples.translation: “行啦，”她笑呵呵地说，“还是得谢谢你。”“不客气”。

examples.text: I'm not like that at all. Not in the least...
examples.translation: 我哪里是那种人。绝对不是。

examples.text: I'm not in the least bit touched by the Marilyn Monroe kind of beauty...
examples.translation: 我对玛丽莲·梦露那种美一点儿都不动心。

examples.text: Alice wasn't the least bit frightened.
examples.translation: 艾丽斯一点儿都不怕。

examples.text: ...her four sons, Christopher, twins Daniel and Nicholas, and last but not least 2-year-old Jack.
examples.translation: 她的4个儿子，克里斯托弗、双胞胎丹尼尔和尼古拉斯，还有不能不提的两岁大的杰克

examples.text: No one ever reads these articles, least of all me...
examples.translation: 从没有人读这些文章，我就更不用说了。

examples.text: Such a speech should never have been made, least of all by a so-called responsible politician.
examples.translation: 这种话本来就不应该说，尤其是不应出自一个所谓负责任的政客之口。

examples.text: Dieting can be bad for you, not least because it is a cause of stress...
examples.translation: 节食可能不利于健康，相当重要的原因是它会引起精神压力。

examples.text: Everyone is more reluctant to travel these days, not least the Americans.
examples.translation: 这段时间大家都减少了出游的欲望，美国人尤其如此。

examples.text: Accommodation was basic to say the least...
examples.translation: 往轻里说是住宿条件简陋。

examples.text: Some members of the public can be a bit abusive to say the least.
examples.translation: 有些民众客气点说是嘴里不大干净。

examples.text: He wore a leather jacket and dark trousers.
examples.translation: 他身穿皮夹克和深色裤子。

examples.text: ...an impressive range of upholstered furniture, in a choice of fabrics and leathers.
examples.translation: 琳琅满目的覆面家具，有多种布料和皮革可供选择

examples.text: ...a couple of youths in motorcyclists' black leathers.
examples.translation: 两个穿黑色机车皮衣的年轻人

examples.text: He would not be allowed to leave the country...
examples.translation: 他可能会被禁止离开该国。

examples.text: I simply couldn't bear to leave my little girl...
examples.translation: 我就是受不了要离开我的小女儿。

examples.text: My flight leaves in less than an hour...
examples.translation: 我乘坐的航班一小时内起飞。

examples.text: The last of the older children had left for school.
examples.translation: 年龄较大的几个孩子中，最后一个也已经上学去了。

examples.text: He left school with no qualifications...
examples.translation: 他没有获得任何学历证书便离开了学校。

examples.text: I am leaving to concentrate on writing fiction.
examples.translation: 我辞职是为了专心写小说。

examples.text: ...a leaving present.
examples.translation: 告别礼物

examples.text: He'll never leave you. You need have no worry...
examples.translation: 他不会离开你的，你不用担心。

examples.text: I would be insanely jealous if Bill left me for another woman.
examples.translation: 要是比尔为了别的女人离开我，我会醋意大发。

examples.text: I left my bags in the car...
examples.translation: 我把包放在车里了。

examples.text: Don't leave your truck there...
examples.translation: 别把货车停在那儿。

examples.text: From the moment that Philippe had left her in the bedroom at the hotel, she had heard nothing of him...
examples.translation: 自菲利普把她独自丢在酒店房间后，她就再也没有听到他的消息了。

examples.text: Leave your key with a neighbour in case you lock yourself out one day.
examples.translation: 给邻居留把钥匙，以防有朝一日把自己反锁在外面。

examples.text: You can leave a message on our answering machine...
examples.translation: 您可以在我们的答录机上留言。

examples.text: Decide whether the ball is in square A, B, C, or D, then call and leave your answer...
examples.translation: 选定球放在A、B、C、D哪个方格，然后打电话来，留下您的答案。

examples.text: I left my phone number with several people.
examples.translation: 我把电话号码留给了几个人。

examples.text: Salter drove off, leaving Callendar surveying the scene.
examples.translation: 索尔特开车走了，剩下卡伦德勘查现场。

examples.text: I'd better leave you to get on with it, then...
examples.translation: 那我还是让你一个人接着干吧。

examples.text: Diana took the hint and left them to it...
examples.translation: 戴安娜会意，任由他们自己去解决。

examples.text: One of the advantages of a department store is that you are left to yourself to try things on...
examples.translation: 逛百货公司的其中一个优势是顾客可自行试穿衣服。

examples.text: He quietly slipped away and left me to my tears.
examples.translation: 他悄悄溜走了，独剩我一人落泪。

examples.text: He always left a little food for the next day...
examples.translation: 他总是留下一点儿食物第二天吃。

examples.text: Double rooms at any of the following hotels should leave you some change from £150.
examples.translation: 以下任何一间酒店的双人房价格都不到150英镑。

examples.text: ...a crash which left him with a broken collarbone...
examples.translation: 造成他锁骨骨折的车祸

examples.text: He left me with a child to support.
examples.translation: 他扔下我独自拉扯一个孩子。

examples.text: ...violent disturbances which have left at least ten people dead...
examples.translation: 造成至少10人死亡的暴乱

examples.text: The documentary left me in a state of shock...
examples.translation: 那部纪录片使我大为震惊。

examples.text: So where does that leave me?
examples.translation: 那么我的境况又会如何呢？

examples.text: If you don't like the cocktail you ordered, just leave it and try a different one.
examples.translation: 你要是不喜欢你要的鸡尾酒，就别喝了，要点别的吧。

examples.text: A muscle tear will leave a scar after healing...
examples.translation: 肌肉撕裂复原后会留下疤痕。

examples.text: She left a lasting impression on him.
examples.translation: 她给他留下了难以忘怀的印象。

examples.text: He left the album open on the table...
examples.translation: 他把相册摊在桌上没收。

examples.text: I've left the car lights on...
examples.translation: 我没把车灯关掉。

examples.text: I left the engine running.
examples.translation: 我动机一直开着。

examples.text: Leave a gap at the top and bottom so air can circulate.
examples.translation: 上下各留一个口子通风。

examples.text: Affix the blue airmail label and leave the rest to us...
examples.translation: 贴上蓝色的空邮标签，其余的事情交给我们。

examples.text: The judge should not have left it to the jury to decide...
examples.translation: 法官本不该把案子交给陪审团来裁定。

examples.text: For the moment, I leave you to take all decisions.
examples.translation: 我把决定权暂时全交给你。

examples.text: The ceasefire leaves a lot to the goodwill of the forces involved...
examples.translation: 停火协议的执行很大程度取决于各方武装力量的意愿。

examples.text: It's a vague formulation that leaves much to the discretion of local authorities.
examples.translation: 这只是个模糊的构想，许多方面还要由地方当局来定夺。

examples.text: This left me only one possible course of action...
examples.translation: 这样我只有一条路可走。

examples.text: He was left with no option but to resign.
examples.translation: 他除了辞职外别无选择。

examples.text: Don't leave it all until the last minute.
examples.translation: 不要把什么都拖到最后一分钟。

examples.text: I hope I haven't left it too late.
examples.translation: 但愿我没有错失良机。

examples.text: I think we'd better leave the subject of Nationalism...
examples.translation: 我看我们最好还是搁下民族主义这个话题吧。

examples.text: He suggested we get together for a drink sometime. I said I'd like that, and we left it there.
examples.translation: 他建议我们找个时间出来喝一杯。我说好，然后我们就换了个话题。

examples.text: He died two and a half years later, leaving everything to his wife.
examples.translation: 他于两年半后去世，把所有遗产都留给了妻子。

examples.text: It is for his humanity as much as his music that his numerous friends and pupils will remember him. He leaves a wife, son and daughter.
examples.translation: 他的仁爱精神，以及他的音乐，都将长留在无数友人和学生的记忆里。他身后遗下妻子和一对儿女。

examples.text: Why don't you take a few days' leave?
examples.translation: 你为什么不休几天假？

examples.text: ...maternity leave...
examples.translation: 产假

examples.text: He is home on leave from the Navy.
examples.translation: 他从海军部队休假回到家里。

examples.text: ...an application for leave to appeal against the judge's order.
examples.translation: 不服法官指令的上诉申请

examples.text: Some people need to confront a traumatic past; others find it better to leave it alone...
examples.translation: 有人需要直面过去的创伤，有人则觉得不去想它为妙。

examples.text: Why can't you leave him be?
examples.translation: 你就不能不管他？

examples.text: Leaving aside the question of privacy, constant surveillance can be remarkably convenient.
examples.translation: 如果不去管隐私问题的话，实施不间断监视其实是非常便利的。

examples.text: He thanked them for the pleasure of their company and took his leave.
examples.translation: 他感谢他们的愉快陪伴，然后道别走了。

examples.text: He knew when to leave well alone and when to interfere.
examples.translation: 他知道什么时候该适可而止，什么时候该插手干预。

examples.text: As soon as the police disappear the violence will take up from where it left off.
examples.translation: 警察一走，暴力事件就会死灰复燃。

examples.text: ...a series of lectures by Professor Eric Robinson...
examples.translation: 埃里克·鲁宾逊教授的系列讲座

examples.text: In his lecture Riemann covered an enormous variety of topics.
examples.translation: 里曼的演讲涵盖了各种各样的主题。

examples.text: She then invited him to Atlanta to lecture on the history of art...
examples.translation: 她于是邀请他去亚特兰大讲艺术史。

examples.text: She has danced, choreographed, lectured and taught all over the world...
examples.translation: 她到过世界各地跳舞、编舞、演讲和教学。

examples.text: Wendy Rigby was recently invited to lecture a group of doctors on the benefits of aromatherapy.
examples.translation: 温迪·里格比最近应邀给一帮医生讲芳香疗法的疗效。

examples.text: He used to lecture me about getting too much sun...
examples.translation: 他以前常唠叨我太阳晒得太多。

examples.text: Chuck would lecture me, telling me to get a haircut...
examples.translation: 查克就会数落我，让我去理一下发。

examples.text: She was no longer interrogating but lecturing.
examples.translation: 她已经不是在审问而是在教训人了。

examples.text: Our captain gave us a stern lecture on safety.
examples.translation: 船长就安全问题严厉地训斥了我们一顿。

examples.text: Is there any gin left?...
examples.translation: 还有杜松子酒吗？

examples.text: He's got plenty of money left...
examples.translation: 他还剩有大把的钱。

examples.text: They still have six games left to play.
examples.translation: 他们还剩6场比赛要打。

examples.text: So much income is devoted to monthly mortgage payments that nothing is left over.
examples.translation: 收入的大部分都付了按揭月供款，以至于分文不剩。

examples.text: ...a large bucket of cut flowers left over from the wedding.
examples.translation: 婚礼留下的一大桶鲜切花

examples.text: In Britain cars drive on the left.
examples.translation: 在英国，汽车靠左行驶。

examples.text: ...the brick wall to the left of the conservatory...
examples.translation: 温室左边那面砖墙

examples.text: Beaufort Castle is on your left.
examples.translation: 博福尔城堡在你左手边。

examples.text: Turn left at the crossroads into Clay Lane.
examples.translation: 十字路口左转进克雷巷。

examples.text: ...the traditional parties of the Left...
examples.translation: 传统的左翼政党

examples.text: The government's industrial policy has been fiercely attacked by the left.
examples.translation: 政府的工业政策遭到了左派的猛烈抨击。

examples.text: After Mrs Thatcher's first election victory in 1979, Labour moved sharply to the left...
examples.translation: 1979年撒切尔夫人首次大选获胜后，工党的路线明显左转。

examples.text: There will be a radical swing to the right or the left.
examples.translation: 将出现极左或极右的情况。

examples.text: You could make a real difference to someone's life by leaving them a generous legacy.
examples.translation: 慷慨留下您的遗产，改写他人的人生。

examples.text: ...a programme to overcome the legacy of inequality and injustice created by Apartheid...
examples.translation: 旨在消除种族隔离政策所遗留的不平等与不公正问题的项目

examples.text: The old system has left a mixed legacy.
examples.translation: 旧制度留下的遗产有好有坏。

examples.text: He was tapping his walking stick against his leg.
examples.translation: 他用手杖轻敲着腿。

examples.text: Her name was Sheila, a long-legged blonde.
examples.translation: 她叫希拉，是一位长腿的金发女郎。

examples.text: ...a large four-legged animal.
examples.translation: 大型四足动物

examples.text: He moved on through wet grass that soaked his trouser legs.
examples.translation: 他继续前行，穿过湿漉漉的草地，裤腿全湿透了。

examples.text: ...a chicken leg.
examples.translation: 鸡腿

examples.text: ...a leg of mutton.
examples.translation: 羊腿

examples.text: His ankles were tied to the legs of the chair...
examples.translation: 他的脚脖子被绑在椅腿上。

examples.text: The teak table has fluted legs.
examples.translation: 这张柚木桌子的桌腿有凹槽纹饰。

examples.text: ...a three-legged stool.
examples.translation: 三脚凳

examples.text: ...an ancient Guatemalan bow-legged table.
examples.translation: 古老的危地马拉弯腿桌

examples.text: The first leg of the journey was by boat to Lake Naivasha in Kenya.
examples.translation: 行程的首段是乘船到肯尼亚的奈瓦沙湖。

examples.text: The first round of the cup was decided over two legs...
examples.translation: 杯赛的首轮以两场分胜负。

examples.text: They will televise both legs of Leeds' European Cup clash with Rangers.
examples.translation: 欧洲杯利兹联队与流浪者队的两场争夺战都将进行电视转播。

examples.text: We saw some kids shinning up a drainpipe before legging it clutching a TV and hi-fi...
examples.translation: 我们看见几个年轻人爬上了排水管，后来就见他们提着一台电视机和音响跑掉了。

examples.text: He was now to be seen legging it across the field.
examples.translation: 现在可以看到他快步跑过田地。

examples.text: This relationship is on its last legs.
examples.translation: 这段关系已经快玩儿完了。

examples.text: Of course I won't tell them; I was only pulling your leg.
examples.translation: 我当然不会告诉他们啦。我跟你开玩笑的。

examples.text: It's only my word against his, I know. So I don't have a leg to stand on.
examples.translation: 现在是我和他各说各的，这我知道。所以我的话无法证实。

examples.text: The American economy still has legs.
examples.translation: 美国经济仍可持续发展。

examples.text: He vowed to take legal action.
examples.translation: 他誓言要采取法律行动。

examples.text: ...the British legal system...
examples.translation: 英国的法律体系

examples.text: I sought legal advice on this.
examples.translation: 我就此进行了法律咨询。

examples.text: ...the legal profession.
examples.translation: 法律界

examples.text: There are reasons to doubt that a second trial is morally, legally or politically justified...
examples.translation: 我们有理由怀疑重审是否有道德、法律或政治理据。

examples.text: It could be a bit problematic, legally speaking.
examples.translation: 从法律上讲，会有点问题。

examples.text: What I did was perfectly legal.
examples.translation: 我所做的绝对合法。

examples.text: ...drivers who have more than the legal limit of alcohol.
examples.translation: 血液中酒精含量超过法定限度的司机

examples.text: The school is legally responsible for your child's safety...
examples.translation: 学校对你的孩子负有法律上的安全责任。

examples.text: A lorry driver can legally work eighty-two hours a week.
examples.translation: 从法律上讲，货车司机一星期可工作82小时。

meanings.meaning: 传奇；说明；图例；刻印文字

examples.text: ...the legends of ancient Greece...
examples.translation: 古希腊传说

examples.text: ...the Robin Hood legend...
examples.translation: 罗宾汉传奇

examples.text: The play was based on Irish legend.
examples.translation: 这部戏取材于爱尔兰传说。

examples.text: ...blues legends John Lee Hooker and B.B. King.
examples.translation: 布鲁斯音乐大师约翰·李·胡克和B. B. 金

examples.text: The incident has since become a family legend...
examples.translation: 此事自此成为了家族传奇。

examples.text: His frequent brushes with death are the stuff of legend among the press.
examples.translation: 他频繁地与死神擦肩而过，成了报章杂志的热门猛料。

examples.text: ...a letter calling for legislation to protect women's rights.
examples.translation: 一封呼吁立法保护妇女权益的信

meanings.meaning: 合法的；正当的；合理的；正统的

examples.text: The French government has condemned the coup in Haiti and has demanded the restoration of the legitimate government...
examples.translation: 法国政府对海地政变表示谴责，并要求恢复合法政府的地位。

examples.text: The government will not seek to disrupt the legitimate business activities of the defendant.
examples.translation: 政府无意干扰被告的合法经营活动。

examples.text: The opposition parties do not recognise the political legitimacy of his government.
examples.translation: 反对党不承认他的政府在政治上的合法性。

examples.text: The government has been legitimately elected by the people.
examples.translation: 政府是由人民依法选出的。

examples.text: That's a perfectly legitimate fear...
examples.translation: 怀有这种恐惧完全在情理之中。

examples.text: The New York Times has a legitimate claim to be a national newspaper.
examples.translation: 《纽约时报》有理由称自己是一份全国性报纸。

examples.text: As if to prove the legitimacy of these fears, the Cabinet of Franz von Papen collapsed on December 2.
examples.translation: 仿佛是要印证这些恐惧事出有因似的，弗朗茨·冯·巴本的内阁于12月2日倒台了。

examples.text: They could quarrel quite legitimately with some of my choices.
examples.translation: 他们大有理由不同意我的一些选择。

examples.text: We only married in order that the child should be legitimate.
examples.translation: 我们结婚纯粹是为了给孩子一个合法身份。

examples.text: We want to legitimate this process by passing a law.
examples.translation: 我们希望通过立法来使这一程序合法化。

examples.text: ...the legitimation of state constitutions.
examples.translation: 国家宪法的正式通过

examples.text: ...a relaxing way to fill my leisure time.
examples.translation: 我打发空余时间的轻松办法

examples.text: ...one of Britain's most popular leisure activities.
examples.translation: 英国最受欢迎的休闲活动之一

examples.text: You will be able to stroll at leisure through the gardens...
examples.translation: 您可在花园里闲逛。

examples.text: He could read all the national papers at his leisure.
examples.translation: 他可以悠然阅读所有的全国性报纸。

meanings.meaning: (Lemon)人名；(英、德、捷、瑞典)莱蒙；(法)勒蒙

examples.text: ...a slice of lemon.
examples.translation: 一片柠檬

examples.text: ...oranges, lemons and other citrus fruits.
examples.translation: 橙子、柠檬和其他柑橘类水果

examples.text: ...lemon juice.
examples.translation: 柠檬汁

examples.text: He took a little test drive and agreed the car was a lemon.
examples.translation: 他试驾了一下，也认为这车不行。

examples.text: I just stood there like a lemon.
examples.translation: 我就傻乎乎地站在那儿。

examples.text: The bank is reassessing its criteria for lending money...
examples.translation: 银行正重新评估其贷款标准。

examples.text: I had to lend him ten pounds to take his children to the pictures.
examples.translation: 我只好借给他10英镑，让他带孩子们去看电影。

examples.text: ...financial deregulation that led to institutions being more willing to lend.
examples.translation: 使金融机构更愿意提供贷款的金融管制的解除

examples.text: ...a financial institution that specializes in the lending of money.
examples.translation: 专门从事贷款业务的金融机构

examples.text: ...a slump in bank lending.
examples.translation: 银行贷款的骤减

examples.text: Will you lend me your jacket for a little while?...
examples.translation: 你能把上衣借给我穿一会儿吗？

examples.text: He had lent the bungalow to the Conrads for a couple of weeks.
examples.translation: 他把那间平房借给康拉德一家住了两三个星期。

examples.text: He was approached by the organisers to lend support to a benefit concert...
examples.translation: 主办方找过他，希望他能对慈善音乐会给予支持。

examples.text: Stipe attended yesterday's news conference to lend his support.
examples.translation: 斯蒂普出席了昨天的新闻发布会以示支持。

examples.text: The room lends itself well to summer eating with its light, airy atmosphere.
examples.translation: 这个房间又亮堂又通风，夏天在此用餐最合适不过。

examples.text: Enthusiastic applause lent a sense of occasion to the proceedings...
examples.translation: 热烈的掌声给活动平添了几分隆重的色彩。

examples.text: A more relaxed regime and regular work lends the inmates a dignity not seen in other prisons.
examples.translation: 由于管理较为宽松而且经常从事劳动，这里的囚犯因此多了一份其他监狱的囚犯所没有的尊严感。

meanings.meaning: 长度，长；时间的长短；（语）音长

examples.text: It is about a metre in length.
examples.translation: 它长约1米。

examples.text: ...the length of the fish...
examples.translation: 鱼的身长

examples.text: The plane had a wing span of 34ft and a length of 22ft.
examples.translation: 这架飞机的翼展长34英尺，机身长22英尺。

examples.text: ...a book of at least 100 pages in length...
examples.translation: 一百多页厚的书

examples.text: The length of a paragraph depends on the information it conveys.
examples.translation: 段落的长短取决于它所传达的信息量。

examples.text: The exact length of each period may vary...
examples.translation: 每一阶段的确切时长可能会有所不同。

examples.text: His film, over two hours in length, is a subtle study of family life.
examples.translation: 他这部片长逾两个小时的电影对家庭生活进行了巧妙的剖析。

examples.text: ...a 30ft length of rope...
examples.translation: 一根30英尺长的绳子

examples.text: You can hang lengths of fabric behind the glass.
examples.translation: 你可以在玻璃后面挂几条织品。

examples.text: Many have been surprised at the length of time it has taken him to make up his mind...
examples.translation: 他居然花了那么长时间才拿定主意，许多人都对此感到吃惊。

examples.text: I noticed, too, the length of her fingers.
examples.translation: 我也注意到她的手指很长。

examples.text: I swim 40 lengths a day.
examples.translation: 我每天游20个来回。

examples.text: Harvard won by four lengths.
examples.translation: 哈佛大学队领先4个艇位胜出。

examples.text: I looked along the length of the building...
examples.translation: 我的目光沿着大楼从首到尾扫过。

examples.text: The inspiration stemming from his travels lasted the length of his career.
examples.translation: 由旅行得来的灵感伴随了他的整个职业生涯。

examples.text: At length my father went into the house.
examples.translation: 我父亲最后还是进了屋。

examples.text: They spoke at length, reviewing the entire incident.
examples.translation: 他们把事情的整个经过详尽地复述了一遍。

examples.text: Greta Garbo went to great lengths to hide from reporters and photographers.
examples.translation: 葛丽泰·嘉宝想方设法躲开记者和摄影师。

meanings.meaning: 透镜，镜头；眼睛中的水晶体；晶状体；隐形眼镜；汽车的灯玻璃

examples.text: ...a camera lens...
examples.translation: 照相机镜头

examples.text: I packed your sunglasses with the green lenses.
examples.translation: 我把你那副绿色镜片的太阳镜装好了。

examples.text: Less is often considered to be the comparative form of little.
examples.translation: less常被看作是little的比较级。

examples.text: ...a dishwasher that uses less water and electricity than older machines...
examples.translation: 较旧式机器省水省电的洗碗机

examples.text: Children of very low ability should not be permitted to pay less attention to the sciences.
examples.translation: 不应让能力非常差的孩子放松对理科课程的学习。

examples.text: Borrowers are striving to ease their financial position by spending less and saving more.
examples.translation: 借债人正努力减少支出、增加储蓄，以缓解财务紧张的窘况。

examples.text: Last year less of the money went into high-technology companies...
examples.translation: 去年，投入高科技公司的资金有所减少。

examples.text: The other option would be for me to own less of the house but that would be stupid.
examples.translation: 还有一个选择是我放弃房子的部分产权，但这是个蠢办法。

examples.text: Motorways actually cover less than 0.1 percent of the countryside...
examples.translation: 高速公路的实际覆盖面积还不到农村地区的0.1%。

examples.text: Less than a half hour later he returned upstairs.
examples.translation: 不到半个小时，他又跑上楼来。

examples.text: I often think about those less fortunate than me...
examples.translation: 我经常想到那些没我这么幸运的人。

examples.text: Other amenities, less commonly available, include a library and exercise room...
examples.translation: 还有一些不太常有的设施，包括图书馆和健身房。

examples.text: Poverty is less of a problem now than it used to be.
examples.translation: 贫穷问题已较过去有所缓解。

examples.text: At first sight it looked less like a capital city than a mining camp...
examples.translation: 乍看上去，它不像是首府，更像是矿工村。

examples.text: Trades union leadership in those days was less a career than a vocation.
examples.translation: 那时候的工会领导与其说是一份职业，倒不如说是一种使命。

examples.text: We are eating more and exercising less...
examples.translation: 我们吃得多了，锻炼却少了。

examples.text: I see less of any of my friends than I used to.
examples.translation: 我见所有朋友都比以前少了。

examples.text: I never talked about it, still less about her...
examples.translation: 我从来没说起过这事，更没有提起过她。

examples.text: The boy didn't have a girlfriend, much less a wife.
examples.translation: 这小伙子连女朋友都没有，更不用提老婆了。

examples.text: ...Boyton Financial Services Fees: £750, less £400...
examples.translation: 博伊顿金融服务费：750英镑，扣除400英镑

examples.text: Company car drivers will pay between ten and twenty five percent, less tax.
examples.translation: 公司的司机要支付10%到25%，从中扣除税款。

examples.text: The couple seem to spend less and less time together...
examples.translation: 两口子在一起的时间似乎越来越少。

examples.text: She sounded less and less eager to return to Ireland...
examples.translation: 听她话音，她回爱尔兰的热情似乎日渐消退。

examples.text: Many basic goods are now rationed. Less and less is available.
examples.translation: 很多基本商品现在都要定量供给。能买到的东西越来越少。

examples.text: Her greeting was less than enthusiastic...
examples.translation: 她的问候一点都不热情。

examples.text: Her advice has frequently been less than wholly helpful.
examples.translation: 她的建议往往毫无帮助。

examples.text: He had returned to England in an aircraft carrier no less...
examples.translation: 他竟然坐航空母舰回的英格兰。

examples.text: Who wrote the screenplay from Patricia Highsmith's book? Raymond Chandler, no less.
examples.translation: 帕特里夏·海史密斯那本书是谁改编成剧本的？雷蒙德·钱德勒呀，厉害。

examples.text: No less than 35 per cent of the country is protected in the form of parks and nature sanctuaries...
examples.translation: 该国多达35%的地区以公园和自然保护区的形式受到保护。

examples.text: He is lined up for no less than four US television interviews.
examples.translation: 多达4家美国电视媒体排期邀请他上节目接受采访。

examples.text: It would be his last French lesson for months...
examples.translation: 这将是他以后几个月里的最后一堂法语课。

examples.text: Johanna took piano lessons.
examples.translation: 约翰娜上了钢琴课。

examples.text: There's still one lesson to be learned from the crisis—we all need to better understand the thinking of the other side.
examples.translation: 从这次危机中我们还可以吸取一个教训——我们都需要更好地了解对方的想法。

examples.text: The Rev. Nicola Judd read the lesson.
examples.translation: 尼古拉·贾德牧师选读了经文。

examples.text: I was afraid to open the door lest he should follow me...
examples.translation: 我不敢开门，唯恐他还跟着我。

examples.text: The president has gone along with the hardliners lest they be tempted to oust him...
examples.translation: 总统同意了强硬派的意见，以免他们产生赶他下台的念头。

examples.text: And, lest we forget, Einstein wrote his most influential papers while working as a clerk.
examples.translation: 大家不要忘记，爱因斯坦最有影响力的论文还是当文员的时候写的。

examples.text: People said we were interfering with nature, and that we should just let the animals die...
examples.translation: 人们说我们是在干涉自然界，还说我们应该任由动物死去。

examples.text: Thorne let him talk...
examples.translation: 索恩让他畅所欲言。

examples.text: She let the door slam...
examples.translation: 她听任门砰地关上。

examples.text: I can't let myself be distracted by those things.
examples.translation: 我不能因为那些事情让自己分神。

examples.text: I love sweets but Mum doesn't let me have them very often...
examples.translation: 我爱吃糖，可妈妈不让我常吃。

examples.text: The Americans won't let her leave the country...
examples.translation: 美国人不允许她出境。

examples.text: Visa or no visa, they won't let you into the country.
examples.translation: 不管有没有签证，他们都不会让你入境。

examples.text: I had to get up at seven o'clock this morning to let them into the building because they had lost their keys...
examples.translation: 今天早上我不得不7点钟就起床开门让他们进楼，因为他们把钥匙弄丢了。

examples.text: I let myself into the flat...
examples.translation: 我自己开门进了公寓。

examples.text: I'd better go and let the dog out...
examples.translation: 我还是去把这狗放出去吧。

examples.text: The guards were removing a section of fencing to let it through.
examples.translation: 警卫在拆除一段围栏好让它通过。

examples.text: Let me say it again. I despised Wade's life...
examples.translation: 我再说一遍。我厌恶韦德的生活方式。

examples.text: Let me tell you what I saw last night...
examples.translation: 我来告诉你我昨晚见到了什么。

examples.text: Let me explain why...
examples.translation: 让我来解释为什么。

examples.text: Let me give you one quick example.
examples.translation: 我给你举个简单的例子。

examples.text: Let me take your coat...
examples.translation: 我来帮您拿外套。

examples.text: Let me get you something to drink.
examples.translation: 我给你拿杯喝的来。

examples.text: Let's consider ways of making it easier...
examples.translation: 咱们来想想办法把它变得更容易些吧。

examples.text: Let us look at these views in more detail.
examples.translation: 我们来具体研究一下这些观点。

examples.text: I'm bored. Let's go home...
examples.translation: 我觉得好无聊。我们回家吧。

examples.text: 'Shall we go in and have some supper?' — 'Yes, let's.'
examples.translation: “我们要不要进去吃点晚饭？”——“好啊，走吧。”

examples.text: Let's have some hush, please...
examples.translation: 请大家安静一下。

examples.text: 'Let us pray,' said the Methodist chaplain.
examples.translation: “我们来祈祷吧，”那个循道宗牧师说。

examples.text: Now, let's see. Where did I leave my bag?...
examples.translation: 嗯，我想想。我把包放哪儿了？

examples.text: 'How long you been living together then?' — 'Erm, let me think. It's about four years now.'
examples.translation: “那你们住在一起有多久了？”——“呃，我想想。到现在差不多4年了。”

examples.text: If he wants to do that, let him do it...
examples.translation: 他要做，就让他做好了。

examples.text: Let them talk about me; I'll be dead, anyway...
examples.translation: 随他们怎么说我吧；我反正是要死的。

examples.text: 'She'll kill you.' — 'Let her try.'
examples.translation: “她会杀了你的。”——“那就让她试试。”

examples.text: Let him get his own cup of tea...
examples.translation: 自己的茶让他自己端。

examples.text: If they value these data, let them pay for them.
examples.translation: 他们要是看重这些数据，就让他们出钱买。

examples.text: Please God, let him telephone me.
examples.translation: 上帝啊，求你让他打电话给我吧。

examples.text: Let x equal 5 and y equal 3...
examples.translation: 设x等于5，y等于3。

examples.text: The new man in my life (let's call him Dave) had a very jealous ex-girlfriend.
examples.translation: 我生命中这个新男人（就叫他戴夫吧），他的前女友是个醋坛子。

examples.text: She is thinking of letting her house to an American serviceman...
examples.translation: 她正考虑把房子租给一个美国军人。

examples.text: The reasons for letting a house, or part of one, are varied.
examples.translation: 把整套房子或其中一部分租出去，其原因是多种多样的。

examples.text: I couldn't sell the London flat, so I let it out to pay the mortgage...
examples.translation: 我不能把伦敦那套公寓卖掉，所以我把它租出去偿还按揭。

examples.text: Home owners who have extra space available may want to let out a room.
examples.translation: 有多余空间的屋主也许会想租出个把房间。

examples.text: It is incredible that the 12-year-old managed to even reach the pedals, let alone drive the car.
examples.translation: 12岁的孩子能踩到踏板已经是不可思议，就更不用说开车了。

examples.text: If your child is really sick and needs sleep and quiet, let him be.
examples.translation: 如果孩子真的病了，需要睡眠和静养的话，就不要去打扰他。

examples.text: She let go of Mona's hand and took a sip of her drink...
examples.translation: 她放开莫娜的手，抿了一口饮料。

examples.text: She held the photos with the determined grip of a small child and wouldn't let go.
examples.translation: 她像小孩一样紧紧攥住那些照片，不肯放手。

examples.text: In therapy, she began to let go of her obsession with Mike...
examples.translation: 在心理治疗中，她开始逐渐放下对麦克的痴迷。

examples.text: The work should focus on helping parents to let go of their children.
examples.translation: 工作应以协助父母放松对子女的管教为重点。

examples.text: They held him for three hours and they let him go...
examples.translation: 他们扣留了他3个小时后放走了他。

examples.text: I'm quite happy really to net a fish and then let it go.
examples.translation: 网到鱼后又把它放生，我挺开心的。

examples.text: I've assured him I have no plans to let him go...
examples.translation: 我向他保证，我绝对没打算让他走人。

examples.text: Peterson was let go after less than two years.
examples.translation: 不到两年彼得森就被解雇了。

examples.text: Let it go, he thought. He didn't feel like arguing.
examples.translation: 管它呢，他想。他并不想争吵。

examples.text: Stop worrying about what you're feeling. Let yourself go.
examples.translation: 不要总想着自己是什么感觉。放轻松点。

examples.text: If you have let yourself go, you should consider doing something about it for the sake of your health.
examples.translation: 你以前要是对自己不管不顾，现在应该为了自己的健康着想而改变一下。

examples.text: He got the impression that Miss Hawes had no idea of what she was letting herself in for...
examples.translation: 他觉得霍斯小姐根本不知道自己会惹来什么麻烦。

examples.text: I realized I'd let myself in for something from which there was no turning back.
examples.translation: 我意识到自己陷入了没有退路的境地。

examples.text: They want to let them know that they are safe...
examples.translation: 他们想让他们知道他们安全无事。

examples.text: If you do want to go, please let me know.
examples.translation: 如果你真想去的话就请告诉我。

examples.text: How could she know about that? He'd certainly never let drop any hint...
examples.translation: 她是怎么知道的？他绝对没有走漏半点风声。

examples.text: He might have let something slip in a moment of weakness.
examples.translation: 他可能一时大意说漏了嘴。

examples.text: She has all the glee of a little girl let loose in a sweetie shop...
examples.translation: 她像糖果店里无人管束的小女孩那样兴高采烈。

examples.text: Trainees go through a four-hour lesson before they are let loose on the controls.
examples.translation: 受训人员须上4小时的课才能自由进行操作。

examples.text: He let loose a long, deep sigh...
examples.translation: 他突然喟然长叹了一声。

examples.text: Hill let loose a torrent of abuse against those who prosecuted his case.
examples.translation: 希尔对控告他的人破口大骂起来。

examples.text: Many believe it was his shyness and insecurity which let him down...
examples.translation: 很多人认为是他的腼腆和缺乏安全感拖了他的后腿。

examples.text: Sadly, the film is let down by an excessively simple plot.
examples.translation: 遗憾的是，过于简单的情节使得这部电影差强人意。

examples.text: I let the tyres down on his car...
examples.translation: 我把他的汽车轮胎放了气。

examples.text: Remove wheelnuts, let down tyre, put on spare.
examples.translation: 拧下车轮螺母，放掉车胎的气，换上备用胎。

meanings.meaning: 信；字母，文字；证书；文学，学问；字面意义

examples.text: I had received a letter from a very close friend.
examples.translation: 我收到一个很要好的朋友的来信。

examples.text: ...a letter of resignation...
examples.translation: 辞职信

examples.text: Our long courtship had been conducted mostly by letter.
examples.translation: 我俩长期的恋爱过程基本上靠的是书信。

examples.text: ...the letters of the alphabet.
examples.translation: 字母表中的字母

examples.text: ...the letter E.
examples.translation: 字母E

examples.text: Valerie earned letters in three sports: volleyball, basketball, and field hockey.
examples.translation: 瓦莱丽在排球、篮球和曲棍球三个项目上获得了佩戴校名首字母标志的荣誉。

examples.text: Burkoth lettered in soccer.
examples.translation: 伯考思在足球上获得了佩戴校名首字母标志的荣誉。

examples.text: They had stuck to the letter of the law and in my view they should be ashamed.
examples.translation: 他们死抠法律字眼。依我看他们应该感到惭愧。

examples.text: She obeyed his instructions to the letter.
examples.translation: 她分毫不差地遵照他的吩咐去做。

meanings.meaning: 用杠杆撬动；把…作为杠杆
(Lever)人名；(法)勒韦；(英)利弗；(德)莱韦尔

examples.text: Push the tiny lever on the lock...
examples.translation: 按一下锁上的小柄。

examples.text: The taps have a lever to control the mix of hot and cold water.
examples.translation: 水阀上有一个手柄控制冷热水。

examples.text: Neighbours eventually levered open the door with a crowbar...
examples.translation: 邻居们最终用一根铁撬把门撬开了。

examples.text: Insert the fork about 6in. from the root and simultaneously lever it backwards...
examples.translation: 将耙子插入到离根部约6英寸的地方并同时向后扳。

examples.text: Alex levered himself up from the sofa.
examples.translation: 亚历克斯从沙发上撑扶着站了起来。

examples.text: Radical, militant factions want to continue using the hostages as a lever to gain concessions from the west.
examples.translation: 激进的好战派想要继续利用人质作筹码来换取西方的让步。

examples.text: If you don't know your cholesterol level, it's a good idea to have it checked...
examples.translation: 你要是不清楚自己的胆固醇水平，最好去检查一下。

examples.text: Michael's roommate had been pleasant on a superficial level...
examples.translation: 迈克尔的室友表面上还算友善。

examples.text: We do have the lowest level of inflation for some years...
examples.translation: 我们的通货膨胀率多年来确实一直保持在最低水平。

examples.text: The exercises are marked according to their level of difficulty.
examples.translation: 这些练习题标有难易程度。

examples.text: The water level of the Mississippi River is already 6.5 feet below normal...
examples.translation: 密西西比河的水位已经比正常值低了6.5英尺。

examples.text: The gauge relies upon a sensor in the tank to relay the fuel level.
examples.translation: 油表靠油箱里的感应器来显示燃料的液位。

examples.text: Stir in 1 level teaspoon of yeast.
examples.translation: 加入一平茶匙的酵母后搅拌。

examples.text: Liz sank down until the water came up to her chin and the bubbles were at eye level.
examples.translation: 莉兹往下沉，直到水没过下巴，泡沫浮至眼睛。

examples.text: He leaned over the counter so his face was almost level with the boy's...
examples.translation: 他倾身伏在柜台上，一张脸几乎凑到小男孩的面前。

examples.text: Amy knelt down so that their eyes were level.
examples.translation: 埃米屈膝在地，两人目光相对平视。

examples.text: The floor was level, but the ceiling sloped toward his head.
examples.translation: 地板是平的，但天花板朝他的头这边倾斜。

examples.text: ...a plateau of fairly level ground.
examples.translation: 地势相当平坦的高原

examples.text: Just before we drew level with the gates, he slipped out of the jeep and disappeared into the crowd...
examples.translation: 我们快到门前时，他溜出吉普车，消失在人群中。

examples.text: When the car had pulled level with him, he had spoken into the lowered passenger window.
examples.translation: 汽车开到他身边与他并行时，他朝拉下车窗的后排座位说了几句话。

examples.text: He waited until they were level with the door before he turned around sharply and punched Graham.
examples.translation: 等两人都到了门边后，他才猛地转过身来朝格雷厄姆挥手就是一拳。

examples.text: Napoli have drawn level with AC Milan at the top of the Italian league.
examples.translation: 那不勒斯队追平了AC米兰队，并列意大利联赛排行榜的榜首。

examples.text: The teams were level at the end of extra time.
examples.translation: 加时赛结束后两队打成平手。

examples.text: Iglesias scored twice to level the score...
examples.translation: 伊格莱西亚斯连进两球，追平了比分。

examples.text: The Cincinnati Reds have levelled the score in the National League play-off against the Pittsburgh Pirates.
examples.translation: 在国家联盟季后赛中，辛辛那提红人队扳平了与匹兹堡海盗队的比分。

examples.text: He forced his voice to remain level...
examples.translation: 他竭力使自己的语气保持平静。

examples.text: When Julie speaks of her disability, she talks in the same calm, level tones she uses to discuss her A level prospects.
examples.translation: 谈到自己的残疾时，朱莉的语气一如谈及她的高级证书考试前景般冷静平和。

examples.text: Further tremors could level more buildings...
examples.translation: 余震可能会摧毁更多的建筑物。

examples.text: The storm was the most powerful to hit Hawaii this century. It leveled sugar plantations and destroyed homes.
examples.translation: 这是本世纪夏威夷遭遇的最强风暴。无数甘蔗园和住宅被夷为平地。

examples.text: Allegations of corruption were levelled at him and his family...
examples.translation: 他和他的家人受到了贪污指控。

examples.text: He leveled bitter criticism against the US.
examples.translation: 他对美国提出了尖锐的批评。

examples.text: He said thousands of Koreans still levelled guns at one another along the demilitarised zone between them.
examples.translation: 他说在非军事区两边仍然有数以千计的韩国和朝鲜军人用枪互相瞄准对方。

examples.text: I'll level with you. I'm no great detective. I've no training or anything...
examples.translation: 实话告诉你吧，我根本不是什么大侦探。我没有受过任何训练。

examples.text: He has leveled with the American people about his role in the affair.
examples.translation: 他向美国人民坦白了他在这个事件中所扮演的角色。

examples.text: The President told American troops that he would do his level best to bring them home soon.
examples.translation: 总统跟美军士兵说他会尽其所能让他们早日回家。

examples.text: There were probably moments when you wondered if anyone spoke the truth or was on the level.
examples.translation: 很可能有些时候你会怀疑，到底有没有人在说真话，有没有人是真诚的。

meanings.meaning: (Levy)人名；(西、意、葡、芬、法、瑞典)莱维；(英、以)利维

examples.text: ...an annual motorway levy on all drivers.
examples.translation: 以所有司机为征收对象的高速公路年税

examples.text: They levied religious taxes on Christian commercial transactions...
examples.translation: 他们对基督徒的商业交易征收宗教税。

examples.text: Taxes should not be levied without the authority of Parliament.
examples.translation: 未经议会授权不得征税。

meanings.meaning: 责任；债务；倾向；可能性；不利因素

examples.text: As the president's prestige continues to fall, they're clearly beginning to consider him a liability.
examples.translation: 随着总统的声望持续下跌，他们显然开始视他为负累。

examples.text: ...what was once a vote catching policy, is now a political liability.
examples.translation: 这一曾经吸引选票的政策，如今成了政治上的负累。

examples.text: The company had assets of $138 million and liabilities of $120.5 million.
examples.translation: 这家公司资产为1.38亿美元，负债为1.205亿美元。

meanings.meaning: 有责任的，有义务的；应受罚的；有…倾向的；易…的

examples.text: Only a small minority of the mentally ill are liable to harm themselves or others.
examples.translation: 在精神病患者中，只有一小部分有可能会伤害自己或他人。

examples.text: She will grow into a woman particularly liable to depression...
examples.translation: 她长大成人后会特别容易患抑郁症。

examples.text: Steroids are used to reduce the inflammation, which makes the muscles of the airways liable to constriction.
examples.translation: 类固醇用于消除可能导致气道肌肉收缩的炎症。

examples.text: The airline's insurer is liable for damages to the victims' families...
examples.translation: 航空公司所投的保险公司有责任向受害者家属赔付损害赔偿金。

examples.text: As the killings took place outside British jurisdiction, the Ministry of Defence could not be held liable.
examples.translation: 谋杀案发生在英国司法管辖范围外，故国防部无须对其负责。

examples.text: He is claiming damages from London Underground, which has admitted liability but disputes the amount of his claim.
examples.translation: 他正向伦敦地铁公司索赔。该公司承认负有责任，但对索赔金额持有异议。

meanings.meaning: 自由主义的；慷慨的；不拘泥的；宽大的

examples.text: She is known to have liberal views on divorce and contraception.
examples.translation: 众所周知，她在离婚与避孕方面思想很开明。

examples.text: ...a nation of free-thinking liberals.
examples.translation: 思想开放的自由主义者的国度

examples.text: ...a liberal democracy with a multiparty political system...
examples.translation: 多党政制的自由民主国家

examples.text: They favour liberal free-market policies.
examples.translation: 他们支持开放的自由市场政策。

examples.text: These kinds of price controls go against all the financial principles of the free market liberals.
examples.translation: 这些价格调控措施与信奉自由市场的自由主义者所倡导的经济原则完全背道而驰。

examples.text: The Liberal leader has announced his party's withdrawal from the ruling coalition.
examples.translation: 自由党领袖已宣布该党退出执政联盟。

examples.text: The Liberals hold twenty-three seats in parliament.
examples.translation: 自由党党员在议会中占23席。

examples.text: As always he is liberal with his jokes...
examples.translation: 像平时一样，他出口就是笑话。

examples.text: She made liberal use of her elder sister's make-up and clothes.
examples.translation: 她随便把姐姐的化妆品和衣服拿来用。

examples.text: Chemical products were used liberally over agricultural land.
examples.translation: 化学产品曾被大量地用于农田。

examples.text: They planned to march on and liberate the city...
examples.translation: 他们计划继续挺进，解放该城市。

examples.text: They made a triumphal march into their liberated city.
examples.translation: 他们胜利地开进了被他们解放的城市。

examples.text: ...a mass liberation movement.
examples.translation: 群众解放运动

examples.text: He asked how committed the leadership was to liberating its people from poverty.
examples.translation: 他问领导层有多大决心要让人民脱贫。

examples.text: If you have the chance to spill your problems out to a therapist it can be a very liberating experience.
examples.translation: 如果能有机会向治疗师倾诉自己的烦恼，你将会体验到一种如释重负的解脱感。

examples.text: ...the women's liberation movement.
examples.translation: 妇女解放运动

examples.text: The government is devising a plan to liberate prisoners held in detention camps.
examples.translation: 政府计划释放关押在拘留营内的囚犯。

examples.text: Wit Wolzek claimed the legislation could impinge on privacy, self determination and respect for religious liberty...
examples.translation: 威特·沃尔泽克声称这项法律可能会对隐私权和自主权造成侵犯，并破坏对宗教自由的尊重。

examples.text: Such a system would be a fundamental blow to the rights and liberties of the English people.
examples.translation: 这样一种制度将对英国人民的权利与自由造成根本性的打击。

examples.text: Why not say that three convictions before court for stealing cars means three months' loss of liberty...
examples.translation: 为什么不说被判3项偷车罪名就意味着丧失3个月的人身自由呢？

examples.text: There is no formal confirmation so far that he is at liberty.
examples.translation: 目前还没有正式确认他已经获得人身自由。

examples.text: The island's in the Pacific Ocean; I'm not at liberty to say exactly where, because we're still negotiating for its purchase.
examples.translation: 这个岛在太平洋上；我无权说出它的具体位置，因为我们仍在洽谈购买事宜。

examples.text: I took the liberty of going into Assunta's wardrobe, as it was open; I was looking for a towel.
examples.translation: 阿孙塔的衣橱敞着，我便擅自在里面翻了一下。我想找一条毛巾。

examples.text: Try and retain the excitement of the event in your writing, without taking liberties with the truth...
examples.translation: 请尽量在文字中再现活动的热烈气氛，但不要对事实添油加醋，任意窜改。

examples.text: She knew she was taking a big liberty in developing Mick's photos without his knowledge.
examples.translation: 她知道没告诉米克就擅自冲洗他的照片是太过放肆了。

examples.text: S. 63, the school shares a library—and a librarian—with the other school in its building, P.
...the local library...
examples.translation: 当地图书馆

examples.text: She issued them library cards.
examples.translation: 她给他们发了借书证。

examples.text: My thanks go to the British School of Osteopathy, for the use of their library.
examples.translation: 感谢不列颠骨疗法学校允许我使用他们的藏书。

examples.text: Guests were rarely entertained in the library.
examples.translation: 很少会在书房招待客人。

examples.text: ...a proposal that would require the state to license guns...
examples.translation: 要求该州对枪支实行许可管理的议案

examples.text: Under the agreement, the council can license a U.S. company to produce the drug.
examples.translation: 根据协议，委员会可授权一家美国公司生产这种药品。

examples.text: She folded up her letter, licking the envelope flap with relish...
examples.translation: 她把信折好，用力舔了舔信封的折口。

examples.text: The dog rose awkwardly to his feet and licked the man's hand excitedly.
examples.translation: 那只狗笨拙地站起来，兴奋地舔着那个男人的手。

examples.text: Kevin wanted a lick of Sarah's lollipop.
examples.translation: 凯文想舔一下萨拉的棒棒糖。

examples.text: He might be able to lick us all in a fair fight...
examples.translation: 如果公平较量，他也许能将我们所有人都轻易打败。

examples.text: The Chancellor's upbeat message that the Government had licked inflation for good was marred by more job losses.
examples.translation: 总理乐观地声称政府已经一劳永逸地解决了通货膨胀问题，但更多人的失业却令这一消息大为减色。

examples.text: The fire came roaring through the kitchen ceiling and sent its red tongues licking into the entrance hall...
examples.translation: 大火蔓烧过厨房的天花板咆哮而来，红色的火舌朝门厅内卷去。

examples.text: The apex of the flames licked the crimson sky.
examples.translation: 火焰的舌尖舔卷着绯红色的天空。

examples.text: It could do with a lick of paint to brighten up its premises.
examples.translation: 可用少量油彩使四下显得更亮堂。

examples.text: ...the screeching licks of heavy metal guitar.
examples.translation: 用重金属吉他演奏的尖厉过门

examples.text: A dull pain began to throb behind his lids.
examples.translation: 他的眼皮后面开始隐隐作痛地抽动。

examples.text: The soldiers' presence seemed to keep a lid on the violence...
examples.translation: 士兵的存在似乎抑制住了暴力活动。

examples.text: Their finance ministry is still trying to put a lid on the long-simmering securities scandal.
examples.translation: 他们的财政部仍在试图遮掩一触即发的证券丑闻。

examples.text: If our industry is to remain competitive it must mean keeping a lid on prices.
examples.translation: 我们的行业要想保持竞争力，就必须对价格加以控制。

meanings.meaning: (Lie)人名；(罗、挪、瑞典)利；(中)李(普通话·威妥玛)

examples.text: There was a child lying on the ground...
examples.translation: 地上躺着一个小孩。

examples.text: The injured man was lying motionless on his back...
examples.translation: 那名受伤的男子一动不动地仰面躺在那里。

examples.text: He lay awake watching her for a long time.
examples.translation: 他睁着眼躺在那里看她看了很长时间。

examples.text: ...a newspaper lying on a nearby couch...
examples.translation: 放在旁边沙发上的一张报纸

examples.text: Broken glass lay scattered on the carpet.
examples.translation: 碎玻璃散落在地毯上。

examples.text: ...a two-page memo lying unread on his desk.
examples.translation: 一份两页的备忘录放在他桌子上，还没看过

examples.text: The islands lie at the southern end of the Kurile chain.
examples.translation: 这些岛屿位于千岛群岛的南端。

examples.text: She turned back to the Bible lying open in her lap...
examples.translation: 她将注意力又转回到摊放在腿上的《圣经》。

examples.text: The picture lay hidden in the archives for over 40 years...
examples.translation: 这张照片在档案室中藏了40多年。

examples.text: His country's economy lies in ruins.
examples.translation: 他的国家的经济崩溃了。

examples.text: I was going well and was lying fourth...
examples.translation: 我当时发挥不错，排在第四。

examples.text: Blyth Tait is lying in second place.
examples.translation: 布莱思·泰特目前名列第二。

examples.text: The problem lay in the large amounts spent on defence...
examples.translation: 问题在于防务方面耗资巨大。

examples.text: They will only assume that, as a woman, the fault lies with me...
examples.translation: 他们只会假定是我出了错，因为我是女人。

examples.text: He realised his future lay elsewhere...
examples.translation: 他意识到他的未来不在这里。

examples.text: We must be clear about where the responsibility lies.
examples.translation: 我们必须清楚责任所在。

examples.text: She'd need all her strength and bravery to cope with what lay in store...
examples.translation: 她需要所有的力量与勇气去应付将会出现的问题。

examples.text: The President's most serious challenges lie ahead.
examples.translation: 对总统来说最为严重的挑战还在后面。

examples.text: The inscription reads: Here lies Catin, the son of Magarus...
examples.translation: 碑文写着：马格勒斯之子卡廷长眠于此。

examples.text: My father lies in the small cemetery a few miles up this road.
examples.translation: 我父亲葬在沿这条路往北几英里处的一个小公墓里。

examples.text: It had been wet overnight, and a morning mist lay on the field.
examples.translation: 前一天晚上下了雨，田野上笼着一层晨雾。

examples.text: The actual site of a city is determined by the natural lie of the land.
examples.translation: 城市的实际选址取决于这片土地的自然状况。

examples.text: 'Who else do you work for?' — 'No one.' — 'That's a lie.'...
examples.translation: “你还为谁卖命？”——“没有谁。”——“你撒谎。”

examples.text: I've had enough of your lies...
examples.translation: 我已经听够了你的谎言。

examples.text: All the boys told lies about their adventures.
examples.translation: 所有这些男孩谈论他们的冒险经历时都没说实话。

examples.text: I know he's lying...
examples.translation: 我知道他在说谎。

examples.text: If asked, he lies about his age...
examples.translation: 有人问起时，他就会谎报年龄。

examples.text: She lied to her husband so she could meet her lover...
examples.translation: 她对丈夫撒了谎，好与情人幽会。

examples.text: He reportedly called her 'a lying little twit'.
examples.translation: 据说他称她是“满嘴谎话的可恶白痴”。

examples.text: Lying is something that I will not tolerate.
examples.translation: 我绝对不能容忍撒谎这样的行为。

examples.text: The camera can sometimes lie.
examples.translation: 照相机拍出的照片有时也未必可靠。

examples.text: This survey gives the lie to the idea that Britain is moving towards economic recovery.
examples.translation: 这项调查显示英国经济正在复苏的想法是失实的。

examples.text: My mother never told my father the truth about me. We've been living a lie all this time.
examples.translation: 母亲从来没告诉父亲我的真实身世。一直以来我们都活在谎言之中。

examples.text: It is the first scene of the play chronologically. I tell a lie, it's actually strictly speaking the second scene.
examples.translation: 从时间顺序上来看这是整个剧的第一场。不对，严格说来实际上是第二场。

examples.text: During my lifetime I haven't got around to much travelling.
examples.translation: 我一生中没怎么去旅行过。

examples.text: ...a trust fund to be administered throughout his wife's lifetime.
examples.translation: 为他妻子终生管理的信托基金

examples.text: ...an extraordinary lifetime of achievement.
examples.translation: 成就斐然的一生

examples.text: ...the lifetime of a parliament.
examples.translation: 议会的届期

examples.text: ...a satellite's lifetime.
examples.translation: 卫星的使用期

examples.text: This could be not just the trip of a lifetime but the experience of a lifetime.
examples.translation: 这可能不仅是一趟终生难遇的旅行，也将是一次终生难遇的体验。

examples.text: ...a baby's first minutes of life...
examples.translation: 婴儿生命的最初几分钟

examples.text: Amnesty International opposes the death penalty as a violation of the right to life.
examples.translation: 国际特赦组织反对死刑，称其违背了生命权。

examples.text: ...the earth's supply of life-giving oxygen.
examples.translation: 地球上生物赖以维生的氧气量

examples.text: Is there life on Mars?...
examples.translation: 火星上有生物吗？

examples.text: The book includes some useful facts about animal and plant life.
examples.translation: 这本书包括了有关动植物的一些有用的知识。

examples.text: Your life is in danger...
examples.translation: 你的生命正处在危险中。

examples.text: A nurse began to try to save his life...
examples.translation: 一名护士开始试图挽救他的生命。

examples.text: The intense fighting is reported to have claimed many lives.
examples.translation: 据报道激烈的战斗导致很多人丧生。

examples.text: He spent the last fourteen years of his life in retirement...
examples.translation: 他一生中最后的14年是在退休中度过的。

examples.text: For the first time in his life he regretted that he had no faith.
examples.translation: 有生以来第一次他为自己没有信仰而后悔。

examples.text: Interior designers spend their working lives keeping up to date with the latest trends...
examples.translation: 室内设计师的整个职业生涯都是紧跟时尚潮流的。

examples.text: That was the beginning of my life in the television business.
examples.translation: 这是我投身电视业的初始阶段。

examples.text: My personal life has had to take second place to my career...
examples.translation: 我的私人生活不得不为事业让路。

examples.text: Most diabetics have a normal sex life.
examples.translation: 绝大多数糖尿病患者有着正常的性生活。

examples.text: Life won't be dull!...
examples.translation: 生活绝不会沉闷！

examples.text: It's the people with insecurities who make life difficult.
examples.translation: 就是那些没有安全感的人让生活变得问题不断。

examples.text: ...the sort of life we can only fantasise about living.
examples.translation: 我们只能幻想的那种生活

examples.text: I was 19 and too young to know much about life...
examples.translation: 我当时才19岁，太年轻了，不谙世事。

examples.text: I needed some time off from education to experience life.
examples.translation: 我需要从学校教育中抽身一段时间去体验人生。

examples.text: How did you adjust to college life?
examples.translation: 你是如何适应大学生活的？

examples.text: ...the culture and life of north Africa...
examples.translation: 北非的文化与生活

examples.text: He abhors the wheeling-and-dealing associated with conventional political life.
examples.translation: 他憎恨传统政治生活中的尔虞我诈。

examples.text: The town itself was full of life and character...
examples.translation: 这个城市本身充满活力，个性十足。

examples.text: The rejection of the Jewish theme meant the rejection of everything that gave the script passion and life...
examples.translation: 抛弃了犹太主题就等于完全抛弃了这个剧本的激情与活力之源。

examples.text: He's sucked the life out of her.
examples.translation: 他使她变得毫无生气。

examples.text: A life of John Paul Jones had long interested him.
examples.translation: 他很久以来一直都想创作一部关于约翰·保罗·琼斯的传记作品。

examples.text: He could get life in prison, if convicted.
examples.translation: 如果罪名成立，他可能会被判终身监禁。

examples.text: The repairs did not increase the value or the life of the equipment.
examples.translation: 维修既没有使设备增值，也没有延长其使用寿命。

examples.text: ...learning to draw from life...
examples.translation: 学习写生

examples.text: She had once posed for Life classes when she was an art student.
examples.translation: 她在艺校上学时曾为人体写生课当过模特儿。

examples.text: The Church is my life.
examples.translation: 教会就是我生命的全部。

examples.text: The cold, hard cruelty of two young men is vividly brought to life in this true story...
examples.translation: 这个真实的故事把两个年轻人的冷酷残忍刻画得入木三分。

examples.text: Poems which had seemed dull and boring suddenly came to life.
examples.translation: 原本显得沉闷枯燥的诗歌突然有了生气。

examples.text: The volcano came to life a week ago.
examples.translation: 一个星期前，火山开始变得活跃。

examples.text: I believe in life after death.
examples.translation: 我相信人死后生命会以某种形式存在。

examples.text: He was in a critical condition, fighting for his life in hospital.
examples.translation: 他的情况很危急，正在医院里与死神搏斗。

examples.text: He was jailed for life in 1966 for the murder of three policemen...
examples.translation: 他因谋杀了3名警察而在1966年被终身监禁。

examples.text: She may have been scarred for life...
examples.translation: 她可能会留下永久的创伤。

examples.text: There can be no jobs for life.
examples.translation: 没有一辈子的饭碗。

examples.text: I can't for the life of me understand why you didn't think of it.
examples.translation: 我无论如何也无法理解你为什么没想到这个。

examples.text: I made for the life raft and hung on for dear life.
examples.translation: 我游到救生筏前，死命地抓住它。

examples.text: I can't spend the rest of my life wishing it hadn't happened. Life goes on.
examples.translation: 我不能下半辈子一直活在希望这事没有发生的阴影中。生活还是要继续。

examples.text: There is a new man in her life.
examples.translation: 她有了一个新男友。

examples.text: I have never been so scared in all my life...
examples.translation: 我一生中从来没有这么害怕过。

examples.text: I have never seen such a shambles in my life.
examples.translation: 我一辈子都没见过这么乱七八糟的场面。

examples.text: A top reggae singer gave a young fan the thrill of her life when he serenaded her.
examples.translation: 一名当红雷盖乐歌手对着一个年轻的歌迷唱了一首小夜曲，这让她感到了前所未有的激动与兴奋。

examples.text: ...not that we should expect all good publishers to be larger than life...
examples.translation: 不等于说我们要求所有的优秀出版社都与众不同。

examples.text: Throughout his career he's always been a larger than life character.
examples.translation: 在他的整个职业生涯中，他都是一个非同凡响的人物。

examples.text: Man can have no greater love than to lay down his life for his friends.
examples.translation: 牺牲自己的生命去救朋友，没有比这更伟大的爱了。

examples.text: Viewers will remember the dashing hero, Dirk, risking life and limb to rescue Daphne from the dragons.
examples.translation: 观众不会忘记风度翩翩的男主角德克冒着生命危险把达芙妮从恶龙爪下救出的情形。

examples.text: He had gone as far away as possible to build a new life.
examples.translation: 他去了尽可能远的地方开始新的生活。

examples.text: 'You should have given him a lift.' — 'In that condition? Not on your life!'
examples.translation: “你应该让他搭一段车的。”——“在那种情况下？绝对不行。”

examples.text: Adults need to live their own lives and that's difficult with children.
examples.translation: 大人需要过他们自己的生活，但有了孩子就很难做到了。

examples.text: I'm going to stop letting drugs and drink rule my life.
examples.translation: 我决心不再让毒品和酒精控制我的生活。

examples.text: Winston could not have read the road signs to save his life.
examples.translation: 温斯顿怎么也学不会看路标。

examples.text: Herr's book started life as a dramatic screenplay.
examples.translation: 赫尔的书一开始是一个电影剧本。

examples.text: Before execution, he admitted to taking the lives of at least 35 more women...
examples.translation: 被处决之前，他承认另外还杀死过至少35名女性。

examples.text: He helped his first wife take her life when she was dying of cancer.
examples.translation: 他曾帮助自己身患癌症、不久于人世的第一任妻子自杀。

examples.text: 'It never would have happened if Florette had not gone back for the book.' — 'That's life.'
examples.translation: “要是弗洛里特不回去取书就不会发生这样的事了。”——“这就是人生。”

examples.text: To his great relief the engine came to life...
examples.translation: 发动机突然又开始转了，这让他大大松了一口气。

examples.text: In the garden of the Savoy Hotel the sprinklers suddenly burst into life.
examples.translation: 萨伏伊酒店花园里的洒水器突然开始喷水。

examples.text: Here I am at a crummy hotel with no clean clothes, no money and suffering from shock. What a life!
examples.translation: 我如今身在一家破旧的旅馆里，没有干净衣服，没有一分钱，又惊魂未定。这是什么日子啊！

examples.text: Life is not worth living without food you can look forward to and enjoy!...
examples.translation: 如果没有美食可以让人期待和享受，那人生还有什么意思！

examples.text: Those are the moments which make life worth living.
examples.translation: 正是这些时刻让生活有了意义。

meanings.meaning: 举起；提升；鼓舞；空运；抄袭

examples.text: The Colonel lifted the phone and dialed his superior...
examples.translation: 上校拿起电话，拨通了上司的号码。

examples.text: She lifted the last of her drink to her lips.
examples.translation: 她将最后一点饮料送到唇边。

examples.text: She put her arms around him and lifted him up...
examples.translation: 她抱住他，把他举了起来。

examples.text: Curious shoppers lifted up their children to take a closer look at the parade.
examples.translation: 好奇的购物者把自己的孩子举起来，好让他们更清楚地看到游行的队伍。

examples.text: Amy lifted her arm to wave. 'Goodbye,' she called...
examples.translation: 埃米举起胳膊挥挥手。“再见，”她喊道。

examples.text: She lifted her foot and squashed the wasp into the ground.
examples.translation: 她抬起脚，把黄蜂踩扁。

examples.text: Tom took his seat again and lifted his feet up on to the railing...
examples.translation: 汤姆又坐了下来，把双脚抬起搭到栏杆上。

examples.text: The boys lifted up their legs, indicating they wanted to climb in.
examples.translation: 男孩们抬起腿，示意想要爬进来。

examples.text: When he finished he lifted his eyes and looked out the window.
examples.translation: 他完成之后抬起眼睛往窗外看去。

examples.text: The European Commission has urged France to lift its ban on imports of British beef.
examples.translation: 欧盟委员会敦促法国解除进口英国牛肉的禁令。

examples.text: He used his incredible sense of humour to lift my spirits...
examples.translation: 他用自己不可思议的幽默感逗我开心。

examples.text: A brisk walk in the fresh air can lift your mood and dissolve a winter depression...
examples.translation: 在清新的空气中轻快地散散步，会让你心情愉快，一扫冬日的抑郁。

examples.text: As soon as she heard the telephone ring her spirits lifted.
examples.translation: 她一听到电话铃响就立刻来了精神。

examples.text: My selection for the team has given me a tremendous lift.
examples.translation: 入选该队给了我极大的鼓舞。

examples.text: They took the lift to the fourth floor.
examples.translation: 他们坐电梯到了五楼。

examples.text: He had a car and often gave me a lift home.
examples.translation: 他有车，经常让我搭他的车回家。

examples.text: The army lifted people off rooftops where they had climbed to escape the flooding...
examples.translation: 军队空运转移了为躲避洪水而爬到房顶的群众。

examples.text: The helicopters are designed to quickly lift soldiers and equipment to the battlefield.
examples.translation: 这些直升机是为将士兵和装备快速空运到战场上而设计的。

examples.text: The bank lifted its basic home loans rate to 10.99% from 10.75%...
examples.translation: 银行将基本房屋贷款利率从10.75%提高到10.99%。

examples.text: A barrage would halt the flow upstream and lift the water level.
examples.translation: 一道拦河坝将会在上游拦住水流，抬升水位。

examples.text: The fog had lifted and revealed a warm, sunny day.
examples.translation: 雾已经散了，看来是温暖晴朗的一天。

examples.text: Lift carrots on a dry day and pack them horizontally in boxes of damp sand.
examples.translation: 晴天时把胡萝卜挖出来，平放在装有湿沙的盒子里。

meanings.meaning: 光；光线；灯；打火机；领悟；浅色；天窗
轻的；浅色的；明亮的；轻松的；容易的；清淡的

examples.text: Cracks of light filtered through the shutters...
examples.translation: 斑驳的光线透过百叶窗照射进来。

examples.text: Light and water in embassy buildings were cut off...
examples.translation: 大使馆内的水电都被切断了。

examples.text: It was difficult to see in the dim light.
examples.translation: 光线很昏暗，看不太清楚。

examples.text: ...ultraviolet light.
examples.translation: 紫外线

examples.text: The janitor comes round to turn the lights out...
examples.translation: 看门人巡视一圈，把灯熄灭。

examples.text: You get into the music, the lights and the people around you.
examples.translation: 你融入到音乐、灯光以及身边的人群中。

examples.text: ...street lights.
examples.translation: 街灯

examples.text: ...the heavy city traffic with its endless delays at lights and crossings.
examples.translation: 在交通灯和十字路口前长久等待的拥堵的城市车流

examples.text: It was dark and a giant moon lit the road so brightly you could see the landscape clearly...
examples.translation: 天黑了，一轮巨大的月亮把道路照得通明，周围的景物可以看得一清二楚。

examples.text: The room was lit by only the one light...
examples.translation: 房间里仅靠这一盏灯照明。

examples.text: The low sun lit the fortress walls with yellow light.
examples.translation: 低悬的太阳将黄灿灿的阳光泻在堡垒的墙壁上。

examples.text: ...the little lighted space at the bottom of the stairwell.
examples.translation: 楼梯井底部的一小块有灯照着的地方

examples.text: It was still light when we arrived at Lalong Creek...
examples.translation: 我们到达拉隆溪时天还没黑。

examples.text: He would often rise as soon as it was light and go into the garden.
examples.translation: 他经常天一亮就起床去花园。

examples.text: ...light summer evenings.
examples.translation: 天色明亮的夏日黄昏

examples.text: It is a light room with tall windows...
examples.translation: 这间房有高大的窗子，光线充足。

examples.text: Her house is light and airy, crisp and clean.
examples.translation: 她的房子光线充足，空气流通，清新整洁。

examples.text: The dark green spare bedroom is in total contrast to the lightness of the large main bedroom.
examples.translation: 墨绿色的备用卧室与宽敞明亮的主卧室形成了巨大的反差。

examples.text: Stephen hunched down to light a cigarette...
examples.translation: 斯蒂芬弓着身子点燃一支烟。

examples.text: If the charcoal does fail to light, use a special liquid spray and light it with a long taper.
examples.translation: 要是木炭确实着不了的话，使用一种特殊的液体喷剂，再用长木片将其点燃。

examples.text: ...a lighted candle.
examples.translation: 点着了的蜡烛

examples.text: Have you got a light anybody?
examples.translation: 你们谁有火吗？

examples.text: He has worked hard in recent months to portray New York in a better light.
examples.translation: 最近几个月里他努力从更积极的角度来描绘纽约。

examples.text: ...the harsh light of reality.
examples.translation: 现实严酷的一面

examples.text: They can get on with running the school system according to their own lights and in their own interests.
examples.translation: 他们可以继续按照自己的想法，依据自己的利益来管理学校系统。

examples.text: I remembered the curious expectant light in his eyes.
examples.translation: 我记得他眼里那好奇而期待的目光。

examples.text: Nothing about this sum has come to light...
examples.translation: 关于这笔钱人们一无所知。

examples.text: The truth is unlikely to be brought to light by the promised enquiry.
examples.translation: 承诺要进行的调查不太可能揭露真相。

examples.text: At last the light dawned. He was going to marry Phylis!
examples.translation: 终于明白过来了——他要和菲莉丝结婚了！

examples.text: Three hours before first light Fuentes gave orders for the evacuation of the camp.
examples.translation: 黎明前3个小时富恩特斯下达了撤离营地的命令。

examples.text: The food industry was given a green light to extend the use of these chemicals...
examples.translation: 食品业获准继续使用这些化学品。

examples.text: Other countries are eagerly awaiting an American green light to lift the sanctions altogether.
examples.translation: 其他国家正在急切等待美国同意完全撤销制裁。

examples.text: In the light of this information it is now possible to identify a number of key issues.
examples.translation: 根据这一信息，现在有可能弄清楚几个关键问题了。

examples.text: 'Why didn't somebody come and tell me?' — 'Because you were out like a light.'
examples.translation: “为什么没有人来告诉我？”——“因为你一下就睡过去了。”

examples.text: Museum basements are stacked full of objects which never see the light of day.
examples.translation: 博物馆的地下室里堆满了永远不会重见天日的物件。

examples.text: This extraordinary document first saw the light of day in 1966.
examples.translation: 这份非同寻常的文件第一次公开是在1966年。

examples.text: I saw the light and ditched him.
examples.translation: 我终于醒悟，甩掉了他。

examples.text: They had poured fuel through the door of the flat and had then set light to it.
examples.translation: 他们隔着公寓门往里边倒汽油，然后点着了火。

examples.text: A new approach offers an answer, and may shed light on an even bigger question.
examples.translation: 新的方法提供了一个答案，并且可能让人们对一个更大的问题有进一步的了解。

examples.text: All I can do is tell her to hold on, that there's light at the end of the tunnel.
examples.translation: 我只能告诉她要坚持，让她知道总会柳暗花明的。

examples.text: Modern tennis rackets are now apparently 20 per cent lighter.
examples.translation: 现代的网球拍据说比以前的轻20%。

examples.text: ...weight training with light weights...
examples.translation: 轻量负重训练

examples.text: Try to wear light, loose clothes.
examples.translation: 尽量穿轻便宽松的衣服。

examples.text: The toughness, lightness, strength, and elasticity of whalebone gave it a wide variety of uses.
examples.translation: 鲸须既韧又轻，而且强度和弹性大，这些特点使其用途广泛。

examples.text: It's a Sunday like any other with the usual light traffic in the city...
examples.translation: 这是一个星期天，像任何一个星期天一样，城里的车辆不多。

examples.text: Trading was very light ahead of yesterday's auction.
examples.translation: 昨天拍卖之前的成交量很小。

examples.text: ...a light breeze.
examples.translation: 微风

examples.text: Put the onions in the pan and cook until lightly browned.
examples.translation: 将洋葱放入平底锅内，炒至略呈棕色。

examples.text: ...the small and lightly armed UN contingent.
examples.translation: 联合国轻装小分队

examples.text: ...a convoy of light armoured vehicles...
examples.translation: 轻型装甲车队

examples.text: They used light machine guns and AK forty-sevens.
examples.translation: 他们使用了轻机枪和AK—47步枪。

examples.text: Less chemical gets into the subsoil which is particularly important with the light, tropical soils.
examples.translation: 进入底土的化学物质会减少，这对土质松软的热带土壤而言尤为重要。

examples.text: The walls are light in colour and covered in paper...
examples.translation: 墙的颜色素淡，贴了墙纸。

examples.text: He is light haired with gray eyes.
examples.translation: 他浅色头发，灰色眼睛。

examples.text: We know he has a light green van.
examples.translation: 我们知道他有一辆淡绿色小货车。

examples.text: ...a light blue box.
examples.translation: 淡蓝色盒子

examples.text: She had drifted into a light sleep...
examples.translation: 她迷迷糊糊地进入了浅睡。

examples.text: She was usually a light sleeper.
examples.translation: 她通常很容易惊醒。

examples.text: He was dozing lightly in his chair.
examples.translation: 他坐在椅子上半睡半醒地打着盹儿。

examples.text: The voice was sweet and light.
examples.translation: 那嗓音甜美轻柔。

examples.text: ...a light, healthy lunch.
examples.translation: 量少而健康的午餐

examples.text: ...wine and cheese or other light refreshment.
examples.translation: 酒和奶酪或其他小食品

examples.text: She found it impossible to eat lightly.
examples.translation: 她发现要吃得少简直不可能。

examples.text: Berti's clear tomato soup is deliciously light...
examples.translation: 伯蒂做的西红柿清汤清淡可口。

examples.text: Bake salmon in foil or poach in a light stock for 8-10 minutes.
examples.translation: 用箔纸包烤或用清汤蒸煮三文鱼8至10分钟。

examples.text: ...light table wines.
examples.translation: 低度佐餐酒

examples.text: He was on the training field for some light work yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天他在训练场进行了一些强度较小的训练。

examples.text: She confessed her astonishment at her light sentence when her father visited her at the jail.
examples.translation: 父亲来探监时，她承认对自己受到的从轻判决感到诧异。

examples.text: One of the accused got off lightly in exchange for pleading guilty to withholding information from Congress.
examples.translation: 其中一名被告承认了对国会隐瞒信息的罪名，从而获得从轻处理。

examples.text: Use a light touch when applying cream or make-up...
examples.translation: 涂抹乳霜或化妆品时动作要轻。

examples.text: There was a light knock at the door.
examples.translation: 有人在轻轻地敲门。

examples.text: He kissed her lightly on the mouth...
examples.translation: 他轻轻地吻了她的唇。

examples.text: Knead the dough very lightly.
examples.translation: 轻轻地揉面团。

examples.text: She danced with a grace and lightness that were breathtaking.
examples.translation: 她的舞跳得优雅轻盈，令人惊叹。

examples.text: He doesn't like me reading light novels.
examples.translation: 他不喜欢我看些消遣小说。

examples.text: ...light classical music.
examples.translation: 轻古典音乐

examples.text: ...a light entertainment programme.
examples.translation: 轻松的娱乐节目

examples.text: Talk to him in a friendly, light way about the relationship...
examples.translation: 用友好随意的方式跟他谈谈这一关系吧。

examples.text: Let's finish on a lighter note.
examples.translation: 最后，我们谈一个比较轻松的话题吧。

examples.text: 'Once a detective, always a detective,' he said lightly.
examples.translation: “一日为侦探，终生为侦探，”他满不在意地说。

examples.text: 'I'm not an authority on them,' Jessica said with forced lightness.
examples.translation: “我又不是这些方面的权威，”杰茜卡故作轻松地说。

examples.text: It can be no light matter for the Home Office that so many young prisoners should have wanted to kill or injure themselves.
examples.translation: 竟然有那么多的年轻囚犯试图自杀或自残，内政部决不可等闲视之。

examples.text: His allegations cannot be lightly dismissed.
examples.translation: 不能把他提出的指控当儿戏。

examples.text: Roberts attempted to make light of his discomfort.
examples.translation: 罗伯茨试图轻描淡写自己的不适。

examples.text: One man died when he was struck by lightning...
examples.translation: 一人遭雷击致死。

examples.text: Another flash of lightning lit up the cave.
examples.translation: 又一道闪电照亮了山洞。

examples.text: ...thunder and lightning.
examples.translation: 雷电

examples.text: Driving today demands lightning reflexes.
examples.translation: 如今开车需要反应极其迅速。

meanings.meaning: 很可能的；合适的；有希望的

examples.text: Experts say a 'yes' vote is still the likely outcome...
examples.translation: 专家说结果仍可能是投赞成票。

examples.text: If this is your first baby, it's far more likely that you'll get to the hospital too early...
examples.translation: 如果是第一胎，孕妇很有可能会过早地赶到医院。

examples.text: Francis thought it likely John still loved her.
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯觉得约翰可能还爱着她。

examples.text: Profit will most likely have risen by about £25 million...
examples.translation: 利润极可能增加2,500万英镑左右。

examples.text: Very likely he'd told them he had American business interests.
examples.translation: 很可能他已经告诉他们自己拥有美国商业利益。

examples.text: In the meantime the war of nerves seems likely to continue...
examples.translation: 与此同时，心理战似乎还可能继续。

examples.text: Once people have seen that something actually works, they are much more likely to accept change.
examples.translation: 一旦人们看到有些东西确实奏效，那他们可能会更容易接受变化。

examples.text: At one point he had seemed a likely candidate to become Prime Minister...
