examples.translation: 他一度看似是个合适的首相人选。

examples.text: We aimed the microscope at a likely looking target.
examples.translation: 我们把显微镜对准了一个看起来合适的目标。

examples.text: 'How about having a phone out here?' — 'Not likely!'
examples.translation: “在这外面装个电话怎么样？”——“没门儿！”

examples.text: He looks like Father Christmas...
examples.translation: 他长得像圣诞老人。

examples.text: Kathy is a great mate, we are like sisters...
examples.translation: 凯茜是个很好的伙伴，我们亲如姐妹。

examples.text: It's a bit like going to the dentist; it's never as bad as you fear...
examples.translation: 这有点像去看牙医：情况总是没有你所想象的那么糟。

examples.text: It's nothing like what happened in the mid-Seventies...
examples.translation: 这跟70年代中期的情形截然不同。

examples.text: This is just like old times.
examples.translation: 宛如时光倒转。

examples.text: ...a mountain shaped like a reclining woman.
examples.translation: 形似斜倚女子的高山

examples.text: What was Bulgaria like?...
examples.translation: 保加利亚是个怎样的地方？

examples.text: What did she look like?...
examples.translation: 她长什么样子？

examples.text: What was it like growing up in Hillsborough?...
examples.translation: 在希尔斯伯勒长大的生活是怎样的？

examples.text: Joe still has no concept of what it's like to be the sole parent.
examples.translation: 乔对当单亲家长是什么滋味还没有任何概念。

examples.text: The neglect that large cities like New York have received over the past 12 years is tremendous...
examples.translation: 过去12年里，纽约等大城市受到了极大的冷遇。

examples.text: He could say things like, 'Let's go to the car' or 'Let us go for a walk' in French.
examples.translation: 他能用法语说“我们去开车吧”或“我们去散步吧”之类的话。

examples.text: It also moved those who, like me, are too young to have lived through the war...
examples.translation: 它也打动了那些像我一样年纪太轻而没有经历过战争的人。

examples.text: Like many cities in Germany, it had to recreate itself after the second world war.
examples.translation: 像德国很多城市一样，它不得不在第二次世界大战后进行重建。

examples.text: I was shaking all over, trembling like a leaf...
examples.translation: 我像风中的落叶一样浑身发抖。

examples.text: Greenfield was behaving like an irresponsible idiot.
examples.translation: 格林菲尔德表现得像一个不负责任的白痴。

examples.text: You should have told us. But it's just like you not to share...
examples.translation: 你应该早告诉我们的。不过你就是这么个人，把事情都藏在心里。

examples.text: Why does he want to do a mad thing like that? It's not like him.
examples.translation: 他为什么要做这样的傻事呢？这可一点都不像他。

examples.text: His arms look like they might snap under the weight of his gloves...
examples.translation: 他的胳膊看起来好像不堪手套重负要折断了一样。

examples.text: On the train up to Waterloo, I felt like I was going on an adventure.
examples.translation: 坐在开往滑铁卢的火车上，我觉得自己好像正踏上一趟冒险旅程。

examples.text: People are strolling, buying ice cream for their children, just like they do every Sunday...
examples.translation: 人们在闲逛，给孩子们买冰激凌，就像每个星期天一样。

examples.text: He spoke exactly like I did...
examples.translation: 他的话跟我的一模一样。

examples.text: We really were afraid, not like in the cinema.
examples.translation: 我们是真的很害怕，不是像看电影时的那种害怕。

examples.text: There's nothing like candlelight for creating a romantic mood...
examples.translation: 再没什么比烛光更能营造浪漫气氛了。

examples.text: There was no feeling like it in the world.
examples.translation: 天底下没有比这更好的感觉了。

examples.text: Three hundred million dollars will be nothing like enough...
examples.translation: 3亿美元远远不够。

examples.text: It's really not anything like as bad as it looks.
examples.translation: 根本不像表面上看起来这么糟糕。

examples.text: I decided that I'd go and, like, take a picture of him while he was in the shower.
examples.translation: 我决定我要去，嗯，拍一张他的冲凉照。

examples.text: He said 'I'm attracted to you.' I'm like 'You're kidding!'
examples.translation: 他说，“我对你有好感。”我当时的反应是，“你开玩笑的吧！”

examples.text: My dad was there and he's like: 'Yeah. Yeah. I want to come.'
examples.translation: 我爸爸当时在那儿，就说，“对，对，我想来。”

examples.text: He likes baseball...
examples.translation: 他喜欢棒球。

examples.text: I can't think why Grace doesn't like me...
examples.translation: 我不明白为什么格雷丝不喜欢我。

examples.text: What music do you like best?...
examples.translation: 你最喜欢什么音乐？

examples.text: I just didn't like being in crowds...
examples.translation: 我就是不喜欢呆在人多的地方。

examples.text: Do you like to go swimming?...
examples.translation: 你喜欢去游泳吗？

examples.text: I like my whisky neat...
examples.translation: 我喜欢喝纯威士忌。

examples.text: That's one of the things I like about you. You're strong.
examples.translation: 这是我喜欢你的一个地方。你很坚强。

examples.text: How do you like America?...
examples.translation: 你觉得美国怎么样？

examples.text: How did you like the trip?
examples.translation: 这趟旅行感觉如何？

examples.text: I've been looking at the cookery book. I like the way it is set out...
examples.translation: 我翻过那本烹饪书。我喜欢它的版式设计。

examples.text: The US administration would like to see a negotiated settlement to the war...
examples.translation: 美国政府希望看到战争能以和谈方式解决。

examples.text: Opal, his wife, didn't really like him drinking so much...
examples.translation: 他的妻子奥珀尔不太喜欢他喝这么多酒。

examples.text: I don't like relying on the judges' decisions.
examples.translation: 我不认为应该依赖评委的决定。

examples.text: I like to get to airports in good time...
examples.translation: 我习惯早早地赶到机场。

examples.text: I hear Mary's husband likes her to be home no later than six o'clock.
examples.translation: 我听说玛丽的丈夫希望她6点前就回到家里。

examples.text: I'd like a bath...
examples.translation: 我想洗个澡。

examples.text: If you don't mind, I think I'd like to go home.
examples.translation: 如果你不介意的话，我想我要回家了。

examples.text: I'd like to apologize...
examples.translation: 我想道歉。

examples.text: I would like to take this opportunity of telling you about a new service which we are offering.
examples.translation: 我想借此机会向您介绍我们推出的一项新服务。

examples.text: Here's your change. Would you like a bag?...
examples.translation: 这是找您的钱。您需要一个袋子吗？

examples.text: Perhaps while you wait you would like a drink at the bar...
examples.translation: 也许在您等候时，您可以去酒吧喝点东西。

examples.text: Would you like to come back for coffee?
examples.translation: 有时间再过来喝杯咖啡好吗？

examples.text: I'd like an explanation...
examples.translation: 我希望有人能解释一下。

examples.text: We'd like you to look around and tell us if anything is missing...
examples.translation: 请您四处看看，告诉我们是不是缺了什么东西。

examples.text: Would you like to tell me what happened?
examples.translation: 能告诉我发生了什么事吗？

examples.text: You have to make sure you're comparing like with like...
examples.translation: 你必须确保是在进行同类比较。

examples.text: Homeopathic treatment is based on the 'like cures like' principle.
examples.translation: 顺势疗法是基于“以毒攻毒”的原理。

examples.text: I thought that I knew everything about Jemma: her likes and dislikes, her political viewpoints.
examples.translation: 我原以为我了解杰玛的一切：她的好恶爱憎，她的政治观点。

examples.text: Many students are also keeping fit through jogging, aerobics, weight training, and the like.
examples.translation: 很多学生还通过慢跑、有氧体操、负重训练等方式来健身。

examples.text: You can stay here if you like...
examples.translation: 如果你愿意，可以呆在这里。

examples.text: 'Shall we stop talking about her?' — 'If you like.'
examples.translation: “我们不说她了好不好？”——“听你的。”

examples.text: This is more like a downpayment, or a deposit, if you like.
examples.translation: 这更像是首付，也可以说是定金。

examples.text: He's working like mad at the moment.
examples.translation: 他眼下正在拼命地工作。

examples.text: Why would somebody like her want to spend an evening with the likes of me?...
examples.translation: 像她那样的人为什么要跟我这样的人共度一个晚上呢？

examples.text: She went to Cambridge and rubbed shoulders with the likes of George Bernard Shaw.
examples.translation: 她去了剑桥，交往的都是像萧伯纳这样的人物。

examples.text: They'd come and bring their neighbours, like as not.
examples.translation: 他们会来的，也许还会带邻居来。

examples.text: Like it or not, our families shape our lives and make us what we are...
examples.translation: 不管我们愿不愿意，家庭环境会影响我们人生的发展方向，使我们变成现在的样子。

examples.text: We're going to have to spend the night here whether we like it or not.
examples.translation: 喜欢也好，不喜欢也罢，我们今晚要在这里过夜了。

examples.text: It opens and closes, like this.
examples.translation: 这个能开能关，就像这样。

examples.text: I'm sorry to intrude on you like this...
examples.translation: 很抱歉这样来打扰你。

examples.text: Stop pacing like that.
examples.translation: 别再那样走来走去了。

examples.text: It's on company advice — well, orders, more like.
examples.translation: 这是公司的建议——嗯，更确切地说是命令。

examples.text: They can get something like £3,000 a year...
examples.translation: 他们一年能挣到3,000英镑左右。

examples.text: 'When roughly would this be? Monday?' — 'Something like that.'
examples.translation: “大概会在什么时候？星期一？”——“差不多吧。”

examples.text: That's more like it, you're getting into the swing of things now.
examples.translation: 这才对了嘛，你现在慢慢开始熟悉情况了。

examples.text: ...technological advances the like of which the world had previously only dreamed of...
examples.translation: 只存在于前人梦想中的惊人科技进步

examples.text: We are dealing with an epidemic the likes of which we have never seen in this century.
examples.translation: 我们面临的疫情规模在本世纪尚属空前。

examples.text: The likelihood of infection is minimal...
examples.translation: 感染的可能性极小。

examples.text: There didn't seem much likelihood of it happening...
examples.translation: 这种事情发生的可能性不大。

examples.text: There is every likelihood that sanctions will work.
examples.translation: 制裁完全可能发挥作用。

examples.text: But the likelihood is that people would be willing to pay if they were certain that their money was going to a good cause...
examples.translation: 但如果人们确切知道自己的钱会用于做善事，他们就可能更愿意掏腰包。

examples.text: That, as we all know, is not only a possibility but a likelihood.
examples.translation: 众所周知，那不仅可能发生，而且是很可能发生。

examples.text: In all likelihood, the committee will have to interview every woman who's worked with Thomas.
examples.translation: 十有八九，委员会将不得不与每一位曾和托马斯共过事的女性面谈。

examples.text: These requests are ignored. His requests for rent are likewise sometimes ignored...
examples.translation: 这些要求被置之不理。他关于支付租金的要求有时也同样未被理睬。

examples.text: The V2 was not an ordinary weapon: it could only be used against cities. Likewise the atom bomb.
examples.translation: V2火箭并非普通武器：它只能用于对付城市。原子弹也是这样。

examples.text: He lent money, made donations and encouraged others to do likewise.
examples.translation: 他又借钱又捐款捐物，并且鼓励别人也这样做。

meanings.meaning: 切断…的手足；从…上截下树枝

examples.text: She would be able to stretch out her cramped limbs and rest for a few hours.
examples.translation: 她将能伸展一下蜷缩的四肢，休息几个小时。

examples.text: This entire rickety structure was hanging from the limb of an enormous leafy tree.
examples.translation: 这整个快要散架的搭建物吊挂在一棵枝繁叶茂的大树的枝杈上。

examples.text: They can see themselves going out on a limb, voting for a very controversial energy bill.
examples.translation: 他们可以预见到要是给极具争议性的能源法案投赞成票，可能会陷入孤立。

examples.text: The police were lucky they found him before I did. I would have torn him limb from limb.
examples.translation: 警察很幸运，比我先找到了他。不然我真会把他大卸八块的。

examples.text: Her love for him was being tested to its limits...
examples.translation: 她对他的爱经受着极其严峻的考验。

examples.text: There is no limit to how much fresh fruit you can eat in a day...
examples.translation: 每天食用多少新鲜水果都可以。

examples.text: Firefighters are being stretched to the limit as fire sweeps through the drought-stricken state.
examples.translation: 火势在这个遭受旱灾的州里迅速蔓延，消防队员疲于应对，接近极限。

examples.text: The three month time limit will be up in mid-June...
examples.translation: 3个月的限期截至6月中旬。

examples.text: The economic affairs minister announced limits on petrol sales.
examples.translation: 经济部长宣布了对石油销售的限制。

examples.text: ...the city limits of Baghdad.
examples.translation: 巴格达市区

examples.text: She has to work within the limits of a fairly tight budget...
examples.translation: 她不得不在相当紧张的预算范围内精打细算。

examples.text: He outlined the limits of British power.
examples.translation: 他勾画了英国的势力范围。

examples.text: He limited payments on the country's foreign debt...
examples.translation: 他对该国外债的偿还作出了限制。

examples.text: The view was that the economy would grow by 2.25 per cent. This would limit unemployment to around 2.5 million.
examples.translation: 这一观点认为经济将会增长2.25%，这将把失业人数限定在250万左右。

examples.text: It is now accepted that men should limit themselves to 20 units of alcohol a week...
examples.translation: 现在人们已经接受，男性一周饮酒量不应超过20个单位。

examples.text: Voters cut councillors' pay and limited them to one staff member each.
examples.translation: 选民削减了市政会委员的薪酬，并且限定他们每人只配一个工作人员。

examples.text: The conditions laid down to me were not too limiting.
examples.translation: 给我规定的条件还不算太苛刻。

examples.text: The protests were not limited to New York...
examples.translation: 抗议活动不只限于纽约。

examples.text: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
examples.translation: 这次抽奖只限英国公民参加。

examples.text: A one-mile area around the wreck is still off limits...
examples.translation: 沉船方圆一英里内仍然禁止进入。

examples.text: These establishments are off limits to ordinary citizens.
examples.translation: 这些建筑禁止普通公民入内。

examples.text: Smoking was off limits everywhere.
examples.translation: 到处都禁止吸烟。

examples.text: If police breathalyse me and find I am over the limit I face a long ban...
examples.translation: 如果警察对我作呼气测醉试验，发现我饮酒过量，我将会被禁驾很长时间。

examples.text: He was found to be three times over the limit.
examples.translation: 他血液中的酒精浓度是允许极限的3倍。

examples.text: They have found that, in terms of both salary and career success, the sky is the limit.
examples.translation: 他们发现，就收入和事业成功来讲，多高都有可能的。

examples.text: In the circumstances we'll tell you what we can, within limits, of course, and in confidence.
examples.translation: 在这种情况下，我们会把能告诉你的都告诉你，当然这是有限度的，而且需要保密。

meanings.meaning: 限制；限度；极限；追诉时效；有效期限；缺陷

examples.text: All the talk had been about the limitation of nuclear weapons.
examples.translation: 谈话都是围绕着限制核武器进行的。

examples.text: ...damage limitation.
examples.translation: 损失控制

examples.text: ...a limitation on the tax deductions for people who make more than $100,000 a year...
examples.translation: 对年收入10万美元以上者的课税减免限制

examples.text: There is to be no limitation on the number of opposition parties.
examples.translation: 反对党的数量没有限制。

examples.text: I realized how possible it was to overcome your limitations, to achieve well beyond what you believe yourself capable of...
examples.translation: 我意识到，要超越自己的局限、取得超乎自己想象的成就是完全有可能的。

examples.text: Parents are too likely to blame schools for the educational limitations of their children.
examples.translation: 父母十之八九将子女的教育局限归咎于学校。

examples.text: This drug has one important limitation. Its effects only last six hours.
examples.translation: 这种药有一个严重缺陷：它的药力只能持续6个小时。

examples.text: ...an acute disc collapse in the spine, causing limitation of movement.
examples.translation: 导致行动不便的急性脊柱椎间盘萎陷

examples.text: They may only have a limited amount of time to get their points across...
examples.translation: 他们可能只有有限的时间来说明自己的意思。

examples.text: Shops have a very limited selection.
examples.translation: 商店里的选择非常有限。

examples.text: They had plans to turn the club into a limited company...
examples.translation: 他们计划将这个俱乐部变为一家股份有限公司。

examples.text: He is the founder of International Sports Management Limited.
examples.translation: 他是国际体育管理有限公司的创始人。

meanings.meaning: 跛行，一拐一拐地走；缓慢费力地前进

examples.text: I wasn't badly hurt, but I injured my thigh and had to limp...
examples.translation: 我伤得不重，但一条大腿伤到了，只好一瘸一拐地走。

examples.text: He had to limp off with a leg injury.
examples.translation: 他腿上有伤，离开时只能一瘸一拐地走。

examples.text: A stiff knee following surgery forced her to walk with a limp.
examples.translation: 手术后她的膝盖活动不便，走路时被迫跛行。

examples.text: In recent years the newspaper had been limping along on limited resources...
examples.translation: 近年来这家报社一直在靠有限的资源艰难维持。

examples.text: A British battleship, which had been damaged severely in the battle of Crete, came limping into Pearl Harbor.
examples.translation: 一艘在克里特岛战役中严重受损的英国战舰艰难缓慢地驶进珍珠港。

examples.text: She was told to reject applicants with limp handshakes...
examples.translation: 她被告知要回绝掉那些握手软弱无力的申请者。

examples.text: A residue can build up on the hair shaft, leaving the hair limp and dull looking.
examples.translation: 残留物会积聚在头发上，使头发看起来软塌塌的，而且毫无光泽。

examples.text: Flags and bunting hung limply in the still, warm air.
examples.translation: 空气暖暖的，也没有风，旗帜和彩旗无精打采地垂着。

examples.text: He carried her limp body into the room and laid her on the bed...
examples.translation: 他把绵软无力的她抱进房间，放在床上。

examples.text: He hit his head against a rock and went limp.
examples.translation: 他的头撞到一块岩石上，身子软了下来。

meanings.meaning: 线的，线型的；直线的，线状的；长度的

examples.text: Her novel subverts the conventions of linear narrative. It has no neat chronology and no tidy denouement.
examples.translation: 她的小说颠覆了线性叙事的传统，没有清晰的时间线索，也没有简单明了的结局。

examples.text: ...the linear view of time, with the idea that the past is moving into the present and the present into the future.
examples.translation: 线性的时间观，认为过去通向现在，现在通向未来。

examples.text: ...the sharp, linear designs of the Seventies and Eighties.
examples.translation: 七八十年代轮廓清晰的线条设计

meanings.meaning: 亚麻布，亚麻线；亚麻制品

examples.text: ...a white linen suit.
examples.translation: 白色亚麻套装

examples.text: ...cottons, woolens, silks and linens.
examples.translation: 棉毛丝麻织品

examples.text: ...embroidered bed linen...
examples.translation: 绣花床单和枕套

examples.text: All linens and towels are provided.
examples.translation: 提供全套日用织品和毛巾。

examples.text: ...luxury ocean liners.
examples.translation: 豪华远洋客轮

examples.text: ...the cruise liner, the QE2.
examples.translation: 伊丽莎白女王2号游轮

examples.text: The scent of her perfume lingered on in the room...
examples.translation: 她的香水味道在房间里久久不散。

examples.text: A guerrilla war has lingered into its fourth decade...
examples.translation: 一场游击战已经持续了30多年。

examples.text: He was ashamed. That feeling lingered, and he was never comfortable in church after that...
examples.translation: 他深感羞耻。这种感觉一直萦绕在心头，并且自那以后他在教堂总是觉得不自在。

examples.text: He would rather be killed in a race than die a lingering death in hospital.
examples.translation: 他宁肯在比赛中丢了性命也不愿在医院里苟延残喘。

examples.text: Customers are welcome to linger over coffee until around midnight...
examples.translation: 客人尽可以喝着咖啡逗留到午夜左右。

examples.text: I lingered on in Atlanta for a few days, spending much of my time with an artist friend...
examples.translation: 我在亚特兰大又逗留了几天，大部分时候都和一位搞艺术的朋友在一起。

examples.text: It is a dreary little town where few would choose to linger.
examples.translation: 这是个沉闷的小镇，没几个人会愿意在此流连。

meanings.meaning: 排成一行；划线于；以线条标示；使…起皱纹

examples.text: Draw a line down that page's center.
examples.translation: 沿那一页的中心画一条竖线。

examples.text: ...a dotted line...
examples.translation: 虚线

examples.text: The ball had clearly crossed the line.
examples.translation: 球明显出界了。

examples.text: He has a large, generous face with deep lines.
examples.translation: 他宽大的脸盘上布满了深深的皱纹。

examples.text: ...fine lines and wrinkles.
examples.translation: 细细的皱纹和褶子

examples.text: The sparse line of spectators noticed nothing unusual.
examples.translation: 那一排稀稀落落的观众没留意到任何不寻常之处。

examples.text: Children clutching empty bowls form a line...
examples.translation: 紧紧抓着空碗的孩子们排成一队。

examples.text: The next line should read: Five days, 23.5 hours...
examples.translation: 下一行应该是：5天，23.5小时。

examples.text: Tina wouldn't have read more than three lines.
examples.translation: 蒂娜肯定读不过三行。

examples.text: ...a line from Shakespeare's Othello: 'one that loved not wisely but too well'...
examples.translation: 莎士比亚剧作《奥赛罗》中的一句台词：“一个在恋爱上不智而过于深情的人”

examples.text: Every time I sing that line, I have to compete with that bloody trombone!...
examples.translation: 每次唱到那一句，我都不得不跟那该死的长号拼声音。

examples.text: Learning lines is very easy. Acting is very difficult.
examples.translation: 记台词很容易。表演很难。

examples.text: 'In time perhaps you'll marry again'. 'That's a great line, coming from you!'.
examples.translation: “有一天也许你会再结婚的。”“这句话真中听啊，难得你能这么说！”

examples.text: ...chat-up lines like 'You've got beautiful eyes'.
examples.translation: 诸如“你的眼睛很漂亮”之类的搭讪语

examples.text: She put her washing on the line.
examples.translation: 她把洗好的衣物晾在绳子上。

examples.text: ...a piece of fishing-line...
examples.translation: 一节钓线

examples.text: The winds downed power lines.
examples.translation: 风吹落了电线。

examples.text: The telephone lines went dead...
examples.translation: 电话断线了。

examples.text: It's not a very good line. Shall we call you back Susan?...
examples.translation: 电话线路不太好。苏珊，我们再打给你好吗？

examples.text: She's on the line from her home in Boston.
examples.translation: 她是在波士顿家中打电话。

examples.text: ...the 24-hours information line.
examples.translation: 24小时信息热线

examples.text: ...details from Lesbian Line.
examples.translation: 女同性恋热线传来的详情

examples.text: The American continent's geography severely limited the lines of attack...
examples.translation: 美洲大陆的地形严重限制了进攻路线。

examples.text: Negotiators say they're keeping communication lines open.
examples.translation: 谈判专家说他们保持着沟通渠道的畅通。

examples.text: ...the guerrillas' main supply lines.
examples.translation: 游击队的主要补给线

examples.text: Walk in a straight line...
examples.translation: 沿直线行进。

examples.text: The wings were at right angles to the line of flight.
examples.translation: 机翼与航线成直角。

examples.text: They've got to ride all the way to the end of the line...
examples.translation: 他们得一直坐到终点站。

examples.text: Fires broke out at three railway stations, halting service on two commuter lines for several hours...
examples.translation: 三个火车站发生了火灾，两条通勤线路的服务被迫中断数小时。

examples.text: I would be able to stay on the Piccadilly Line and get off the tube at South Kensington.
examples.translation: 我就可以留在皮卡迪利线上，然后在南肯辛顿站下地铁。

examples.text: Leaves on the line are an expensive problem for the railways.
examples.translation: 处理铁轨上的落叶对铁路公司而言是一个耗资巨大的工程。

examples.text: The Foreign Office offered to pay the shipping line all the costs of diverting the ship to Bermuda.
examples.translation: 外交部愿意向海运公司支付将该船改道至百慕大的一切费用。

examples.text: The garden has an informal feel to soften the architectural lines of the conservatory.
examples.translation: 花园有一种随意的风格，从而使温室的建筑轮廓显得柔和了。

examples.text: ...a sculptured evening dress that follows the lines of the body.
examples.translation: 贴合身体曲线的凹凸有致的晚礼服

examples.text: ...the California state line.
examples.translation: 加利福尼亚州州界

examples.text: Their unit was shelling the German lines only seven miles away.
examples.translation: 他们的部队在炮轰仅有7英里之遥的德军防线。

examples.text: ...the stupendous fortification they called the Maginot Line.
examples.translation: 他们称为马其诺防线的巨大防御工事

examples.text: Forty members of the governing Conservative party rebelled, voting against the government line...
examples.translation: 执政的保守党有40名党员倒戈，投票反对政府的方针。

examples.text: Most members of Parliament took a hard line on this issue.
examples.translation: 绝大多数议员在这个问题上都持强硬立场。

examples.text: Our discussion in the previous chapter continues this line of thinking...
examples.translation: 我们上一章的讨论延续了这一思路。

examples.text: What are some of the practical benefits likely to be of this line of research?
examples.translation: 这一研究方法可能会产生哪些实际效益？

examples.text: There followed an assortment of praise for the coffee along the lines of 'Hey, this coffee is fantastic!'...
examples.translation: 然后就是对咖啡的各种溢美之词，类似“嘿，这咖啡真棒！”等等。

examples.text: He'd said something along those lines already...
examples.translation: 他已经说过类似的话了。

examples.text: Our forecast for 1990 was on the right lines...
examples.translation: 我们有关1990年的预测大体是正确的。

examples.text: The main lines of the plan were a reduction in expenditure and the rationalization of government controls.
examples.translation: 该计划的主要内容是支出的缩减和政府控制的合理化改革。

examples.text: ...so-called autonomous republics based on ethnic lines.
examples.translation: 基于民族划分的所谓自治共和国

examples.text: ...reorganising old factories to work along Japanese lines.
examples.translation: 重组旧工厂使其按日本模式生产

examples.text: So what was your father's line of business?...
examples.translation: 那你父亲当时是做什么工作的？

examples.text: In my line of work I often get home too late for dinner.
examples.translation: 干我们这一行的，经常回家太迟都吃不上晚饭。

examples.text: Wild guesses aren't much in my line...
examples.translation: 瞎猜并不是我的专长。

examples.text: Perhaps doing voluntary work is more your line?
examples.translation: 也许你更喜欢做志愿工作？

examples.text: His best selling line is the cheapest lager at £1.99.
examples.translation: 他最畅销的产品是最便宜的只卖1.99英镑的贮藏啤酒。

examples.text: Most kids can do something in the art line.
examples.translation: 大多数孩子可以参加某项艺术活动。

examples.text: ...a production line capable of producing three different products.
examples.translation: 一条能生产三种不同产品的流水线

examples.text: ...the old Welsh royal line descended from Arthur and Uther Pendragon...
examples.translation: 承自亚瑟和乌瑟·彭德拉根的古老的威尔士皇族世家

examples.text: This title will only pass down through the male line.
examples.translation: 这个头衔将只能传给男性后裔。

examples.text: Nicholas Paul Patrick was seventh in the line of succession to the throne...
examples.translation: 尼古拉斯·保罗·帕特里克是王位的第七顺位继承人。

examples.text: The line of command went from head office in Chicago to a regional boss and then down to a country boss and finally to a local-office managing-partner.
examples.translation: 职权的大小依次为芝加哥总部、区域主管、某国主管，最后是当地办事处的任事股东。

examples.text: ...the man who stands next in line for the presidency.
examples.translation: 总统职位的第一顺位接任者

examples.text: We were part of a long line of artists...
examples.translation: 我们同属一脉相承的艺术家。

examples.text: It's the latest in a long line of tragedies.
examples.translation: 这是一长串悲剧事件中最新的一件。

examples.text: Thousands of local people lined the streets and clapped as the procession went by.
examples.translation: 数以千计的当地居民站在街道两旁，为由此经过的队伍鼓掌。

examples.text: ...a square lined with pubs and clubs.
examples.translation: 四周遍布酒吧和俱乐部的广场

examples.text: ...a long tree-lined drive.
examples.translation: 两旁绿树林立的一条很长的私人车道

examples.text: Scoop the blanket weed out and use it to line hanging baskets...
examples.translation: 把那些丝状水藻捞出来，垫在吊篮里。

examples.text: Female bears tend to line their dens with leaves or grass.
examples.translation: 母熊往往会在洞穴里垫些树叶或草。

examples.text: ...a dark, suede-lined case.
examples.translation: 用绒面革做衬里的深色箱子

examples.text: ...the muscles that line the intestines.
examples.translation: 肠道内壁的一层肌肉

examples.text: Somewhere along the line he picked up an engineering degree...
examples.translation: 在此期间的某个时候他拿到了一个工程学学位。

examples.text: It would depend how far down the line the relationship was.
examples.translation: 这得视这一关系到底发展到了什么程度而定。

examples.text: Excellent acting all down the line captures the sound and feeling of that semi-feudal age...
examples.translation: 全体演员的精彩表演捕捉到了那个半封建时代的声音和感觉。

examples.text: Democrats and Republicans differed right down the line on what the proper responses were.
examples.translation: 民主党与共和党就何为恰当的反应处处针锋相对。

examples.text: Letters have come from prisoners, declaring that they would draw the line at hitting an old lady.
examples.translation: 已经有囚犯写信来，宣称就连他们也绝对不会殴打老太太。

examples.text: It is, however, not possible to draw a distinct line between the two categories.
examples.translation: 不过，这两个类别无法泾渭分明地区分开来。

examples.text: My phone doesn't work, so drop me a line.
examples.translation: 我的电话坏了，你写信给我吧。

examples.text: More than 3,000 police officers were wounded in the line of duty last year.
examples.translation: 去年有3,000多名警察因公受伤。

examples.text: Passport checks will remain the first line of defence against terrorists...
examples.translation: 护照检查仍将是对付恐怖分子的第一道防线。

examples.text: The first line of treatment is to help the affected skin by moisturising it regularly.
examples.translation: 首要的治疗方法就是通过定期滋润来帮助受到影响的皮肤。

examples.text: He must be in line for a place in the Guinness Book of Records...
examples.translation: 他肯定能在《吉尼斯世界纪录大全》中获得一席之地。

examples.text: Public sector pay is also in line to be hit hard.
examples.translation: 公共部门的薪资也很可能受到重创。

examples.text: The device itself was right under the vehicle, almost in line with the gear lever...
examples.translation: 该装置本身就在车子正下方，几乎与变速杆处于同一直线上。

examples.text: Venus, the Sun and Earth all moved into line.
examples.translation: 金星、太阳和地球都到了一条直线上。

examples.text: The structure of our schools is now broadly in line with the major countries of the world...
examples.translation: 我们的学校建构现在基本上与世界上主要国家的相一致了。

examples.text: This brings the law into line with most medical opinion.
examples.translation: 这使得该法与绝大多数医学见解保持了一致。

examples.text: ...the economic discipline required to bring currencies into line.
examples.translation: 实现货币统一所需的经济纪律

examples.text: I had been standing in line for three hours.
examples.translation: 我已经排了3个小时的队。

examples.text: All this was just designed to frighten me and keep me in line.
examples.translation: 所有这一切不过是设计好了来恐吓我、让我乖乖听话的。

examples.text: ...if the Prime Minister fails to bring rebellious Tories into line.
examples.translation: 如果首相无法使倒戈的托利党人就范的话

examples.text: The Energy Secretary hopes to bring on line a safer new tritium production reactor...
examples.translation: 能源大臣希望能投产一座更安全的新型产氚反应堆。

examples.text: The new machine will go on line in June 2006...
examples.translation: 新机器将于2006年6月投入使用。

examples.text: ...linguistic skills.
examples.translation: 语言技能

examples.text: ...linguistic theory.
examples.translation: 语言学理论

examples.text: Somalia is an ethnically and linguistically homogeneous nation.
examples.translation: 索马里是民族和语言单一的国家。

examples.text: Modern linguistics emerged as a distinct field in the nineteenth century.
examples.translation: 现代语言学在19世纪作为一个独立的领域出现。

examples.text: ...applied linguistics.
examples.translation: 应用语言学

meanings.meaning: 连接起来；联系在一起；将人或物连接或联系起来

examples.text: ...the link between smoking and lung cancer.
examples.translation: 吸烟与胃癌之间的关联

examples.text: The UN Security Council has linked any lifting of sanctions to compliance with the ceasefire terms...
examples.translation: 联合国安全理事会将取消制裁与遵守停火协议挂钩。

examples.text: The study further strengthens the evidence linking smoking with early death...
examples.translation: 这项研究进一步证实了吸烟与早逝之间的联系。

examples.text: Liver cancer is linked to the hepatitis B virus...
examples.translation: 肝癌与乙肝病毒存在关联。

examples.text: The detention raised two distinct but closely linked questions.
examples.translation: 这一拘留行为引发了两个互为独立但又密切相关的问题。

examples.text: ...the high-speed rail link between London and the Channel Tunnel...
examples.translation: 伦敦与海峡隧道间的高速铁路连接线

examples.text: The new road schemes include a link between Chelmsford and the M25...
examples.translation: 新的道路规划中包括了一条切姆斯福德与M25号高速公路的连接线。

examples.text: Stalin insisted that the radio link with the German Foreign Ministry should remain open.
examples.translation: 斯大林坚持与德国外交部的无线电联系应该保持开放。

examples.text: ...the Rama Road, which links the capital, Managua, with the Caribbean coast...
examples.translation: 连接首都马那瓜和加勒比海岸的拉马路

examples.text: The campus is linked by regular bus services to Coventry.
examples.translation: 校园与考文垂之间由班车连接起来。

examples.text: ...the Channel Tunnel linking Britain and France.
examples.translation: 连通英国与法国的海峡隧道

examples.text: Kiev hopes to cement close links with Bonn...
examples.translation: 基辅希望能加强与波恩的密切关系。

examples.text: In 1984 the long link between AC Cars and the Hurlock family was severed...
examples.translation: 1984年，AC汽车公司与赫洛克家族长久以来的关系破裂了。

examples.text: A cabinet minister came under investigation for links to the Mafia.
examples.translation: 一位内阁大臣因被怀疑与黑手党有关联而受到调查。

examples.text: She was my only link with the past...
examples.translation: 她是我与过去的唯一纽带。

examples.text: The Red Cross was created to provide a link between soldiers in battle and their families at home...
examples.translation: 红十字会是作为前线士兵和后方家人的一种联系方式而创立起来的。

examples.text: These projects will provide vital links between companies and universities.
examples.translation: 这些项目将会成为公司和大学之间至关重要的联系纽带。

examples.text: Criminologist Dr Ann Jones has linked the crime to social circumstances...
examples.translation: 犯罪学家安·琼斯博士认为这起罪案与社会环境有关。

examples.text: They've linked her with various men, including magnate Donald Trump.
examples.translation: 他们把她与不同的男人扯上关系，包括大亨唐纳德·特朗普。

examples.text: ...a report in The Sunday Times linking him with organized crime.
examples.translation: 《星期日泰晤士报》上一篇声称他与集团犯罪有联系的报道

examples.text: Certainly, Andreessen didn't think up using hypertext to link Internet documents.
examples.translation: 当然，用超文本链接因特网文档并不是安德烈亚森发明的。

examples.text: She linked her arm through his...
examples.translation: 她挽住他的手臂。

examples.text: He linked the fingers of his hands together on his stomach.
examples.translation: 他双手十指交叉放在腹部。

examples.text: It was so slippery that some of the walkers linked arms and proceeded very carefully...
examples.translation: 路太滑了，一些徒步者手挽手小心翼翼地前行。

examples.text: She stayed with them, linking arms with the two girls, joking with the boys.
examples.translation: 她跟他们呆在一起，与两个女孩手挽手，和男孩子们开着玩笑。

meanings.meaning: 狮子；名人；勇猛的人；社交场合的名流
(Lion)人名；(西、葡)利昂；(德、法、意、捷、瑞典)利翁；(英)莱昂

examples.text: 's movie studio profits grew, helped by the theatrical re-release of "The Lion King" in 3-D.

meanings.meaning: (Lip)人名；(法)利普；(中)猎(广东话·威妥玛)；(柬)利；(东南亚国家华语)立

examples.text: Wade stuck the cigarette between his lips.
examples.translation: 韦德把香烟叼在嘴里。

examples.text: ...the lip of the jug.
examples.translation: 壶嘴

examples.text: ...the lip of Mount Etna's smouldering crater.
examples.translation: 埃特纳火山冒着烟的火山口

examples.text: She bit her lip as she recalled the words he'd thrown at her.
examples.translation: 回想起他甩给她的那些话，她咬了咬唇。

examples.text: A reporter asks the president the question on everyone's lips: 'Do you anticipate being re-appointed?'...
examples.translation: 一名记者向总裁提了大家都想问的问题：“您觉得自己会再获任命吗？”

examples.text: He is the guy whose name is on everyone's lips at the moment.
examples.translation: 他就是那个现在大家都在谈论的人。

examples.text: They licked their lips in anticipation...
examples.translation: 他们舔舔嘴唇，满怀期待。

examples.text: We swallowed the chocolates in one gulp, licking our lips.
examples.translation: 我们一口吞下了巧克力，满意地咂着嘴。

examples.text: As for anything told to me in confidence, well, my lips are sealed.
examples.translation: 至于私底下告诉我的任何事情，我会守口如瓶的。

meanings.meaning: 液体的；清澈的；明亮的；易变的

examples.text: Drink plenty of liquid...
examples.translation: 要大量饮水。

examples.text: Boil for 20 minutes until the liquid has reduced by half...
examples.translation: 煮20分钟，直到液体体积减半。

examples.text: Solids turn to liquids at certain temperatures.
examples.translation: 在特定温度下固体会变成液体。

examples.text: Wash in warm water with liquid detergent.
examples.translation: 用洗衣液加温水洗。

examples.text: ...liquid nitrogen...
examples.translation: 液态氮

examples.text: Fats are solid at room temperature, and oil is liquid at room temperature.
examples.translation: 脂肪在室温下为固态，油在室温下为液态。

examples.text: The bank had sufficient liquid assets to continue operations.
examples.translation: 这家银行有充足的流动资产来维持经营。

meanings.meaning: 酒，含酒精饮料；溶液；液体；烈酒

examples.text: The room was filled with cases of liquor.
examples.translation: 房间里堆满了整箱整箱的烈性酒。

examples.text: ...intoxicating liquors.
examples.translation: 致醉的烈酒

meanings.meaning: (List)人名；(匈)李斯特；(英、德、法、西、捷)利斯特

examples.text: We are making a list of the top ten men we would not want to be married to...
examples.translation: 我们正在列一份我们最不愿意嫁的十大男人的名单。

examples.text: There were six names on the list.
examples.translation: 名单上有六个名字。

examples.text: ...fine wine from the hotel's exhaustive wine list.
examples.translation: 酒店应有尽有的酒单上的美酒

examples.text: High on the list of public demands is to end military control of broadcasting...
examples.translation: 高居公众呼声前列的是要求结束军方对广播电视的控制。

examples.text: I would have thought if they were looking for redundancies I would be last on the list...
examples.translation: 我本以为，要是他们打算裁员，我会是最不可能被裁的人选。

examples.text: 'First City' joined a long list of failed banks.
examples.translation: “第一城市银行”加入了一长串破产银行之列。

examples.text: The pupils were asked to list the sports they loved most and hated most...
examples.translation: 小学生们被要求列出他们最喜欢和最讨厌的运动。

examples.text: Manufacturers must list ingredients in order of the amount used.
examples.translation: 生产商必须按用量多少的顺序将成分列出。

examples.text: A medical examiner has listed the deaths as homicides...
examples.translation: 一名验尸官将这些死亡事件列为凶杀。

examples.text: He was not listed under his real name on the residents panel.
examples.translation: 他未以真名在居民名册上登记。

examples.text: It will list on the London Stock Exchange next week with a value of 130 million pounds.
examples.translation: 它将以1.3亿英镑的市值于下星期在伦敦证券交易所上市。

examples.text: The ship listed again, and she was thrown back across the bunk.
examples.translation: 船再次倾侧了，她又被甩回床铺的另一头。

examples.text: The ship's list was so strong now that almost at once she stumbled.
examples.translation: 船现在倾侧得太厉害，她几乎立刻就摔倒了。

examples.text: He spent his time listening to the radio...
examples.translation: 他听收音机打发时间。

examples.text: Sonia was not listening.
examples.translation: 索尼娅没有用心听。

examples.text: One or two listeners had fallen asleep while the President was speaking.
examples.translation: 总统讲话时有一两名听众睡着了。

examples.text: We listen for footsteps approaching...
examples.translation: 我们留神听是不是有脚步声传来。

examples.text: They're both asleep upstairs, but you don't mind listening just in case of trouble, do you?
examples.translation: 他们都在楼上睡着了，但你不介意留神听着点以防万一吧？

examples.text: I didn't really listen out for the lyrics.
examples.translation: 我没怎么注意听歌词。

examples.text: Anne, you need to listen to me this time...
examples.translation: 安妮，这次你得听我的。

examples.text: When I asked him to stop, he would not listen.
examples.translation: 我叫他停下，可他不听。

examples.text: Listen, I finish at one.
examples.translation: 听我说，我一点钟收工。

examples.text: Okay, listen up, guys. We've got to talk a little about how you look.
examples.translation: 好了，听我说，各位。我们需要谈谈大家的形象问题。

examples.text: Listen here, young lady. Don't you call me that!
examples.translation: 你给我听着，小姐。别那样叫我！

examples.text: Many adults have some problems with literacy and numeracy...
examples.translation: 很多成年人在读写和计算方面都有困难。

examples.text: The literacy rate there is the highest in Central America.
examples.translation: 那里的识字率居中美洲之首。

meanings.meaning: 照字面地；逐字地；不夸张地；正确地；简直

examples.text: We've got to get the economy under control or it will literally eat us up...
examples.translation: 我们必须设法控制经济，不然它非把我们吞噬了不可。

examples.text: The views are literally breath-taking.
examples.translation: 景色美得简直让人窒息。

examples.text: Putting on an opera is a tremendous enterprise involving literally hundreds of people...
examples.translation: 上演一台歌剧是一项浩大的工程，说要涉及数以百计的人真是一点都不夸张。

examples.text: I literally crawled to the car.
examples.translation: 我真的是爬到车那边去的。

examples.text: The word 'volk' translates literally as 'folk'...
examples.translation: volk这个单词直译过来为folk（人们）。

examples.text: A stanza is, literally, a room.
examples.translation: stanza（诗节）的原意为“房间”。

examples.text: If you tell a person to 'step on it' or 'throw on your coat,' they may take you literally, with disastrous consequences.
examples.translation: 如果你告诉一个人step on it（“加速；加快”，字面意义“踩在上面”）或者throw on your coat（“赶快穿上外套”，字面意义“扔在你的外套上”），他们可能会按字面理解你的话，那就会引起灾难性的后果。

meanings.meaning: 文学的；书面的；精通文学的

examples.text: Her literary criticism focuses on the way great literature suggests ideas...
examples.translation: 她的文学批评集中关注的是伟大的文学作品表达思想的方式。

examples.text: She's the literary editor of the 'Sunday Review'.
examples.translation: 她是《星期天评论》的文学编辑。

examples.text: ...a literary masterpiece.
examples.translation: 文学名著

examples.text: ...classic works of literature.
examples.translation: 文学经典

examples.text: ...a Professor of English Literature...
examples.translation: 英国文学教授

examples.text: It may not be great literature but it certainly had me riveted!...
examples.translation: 这可能不算伟大的文学作品，但它无疑深深地吸引了我！

examples.text: The book explores the connection between American ethnic and regional literatures.
examples.translation: 这本书探讨了美国族裔文学与地区文学之间的关系。

examples.text: The literature on immigration policy is almost unrelievedly critical of the state...
examples.translation: 关于移民政策方面的著述几乎总是会一成不变地批评政府。

examples.text: This work is documented in the scientific literature.
examples.translation: 这一著作被列为科学文献。

examples.text: I am sending you literature from two other companies that provide a similar service...
examples.translation: 我把另外两家提供类似服务的公司的宣传资料发给你。

examples.text: Some companies have toned down the claims on their promotional literature.
examples.translation: 一些公司已降低了宣传资料中标榜之词的调门。

meanings.meaning: [计量] 公升（米制容量单位）

examples.text: ...15 litres of water...
examples.translation: 15升水

examples.text: This tax would raise petrol prices by about 3.5p per litre.
examples.translation: 这项税收会使每升汽油价格提高约3.5便士。

examples.text: ...a Ford Escort with a 1.9-litre engine.
examples.translation: 装配1.9升发动机的福特雅士

meanings.meaning: 垃圾；轿，担架；一窝（动物的幼崽）；凌乱
乱丢；给…垫褥草；把…弄得乱七八糟

examples.text: If you see litter in the corridor, pick it up...
examples.translation: 在过道里看到垃圾的话请捡起来。

examples.text: On Wednesday we cleared a beach and woodland of litter.
examples.translation: 星期三我们清理了一块海滨林地的垃圾。

examples.text: He pushed aside the litter of books and papers and laid two places at the table.
examples.translation: 他把桌子上凌乱堆放着的书本和报纸推开，摆了两套餐具。

examples.text: Glass from broken bottles litters the pavement.
examples.translation: 人行道上满是破碎瓶子的玻璃渣。

examples.text: The entrance hall is littered with toys and wellington boots...
examples.translation: 门厅里到处乱扔着玩具和雨靴。

examples.text: Concrete purpose-built resorts are littered across the mountainsides.
examples.translation: 山坡上到处都是专门建造的水泥度假屋。

examples.text: History is littered with men and women spurred into achievement by a father's disregard...
examples.translation: 历史上因为被父亲漠视而发奋成功的儿女数不胜数。

examples.text: Charles' speech is littered with lots of marketing buzzwords like 'package' and 'product'.
examples.translation: 查尔斯的演讲充斥着“包装”、“产品”之类的营销领域流行用语。

examples.text: ...a litter of pups.
examples.translation: 一窝小狗

meanings.meaning: 小的；很少的；短暂的；小巧可爱的

examples.text: I had little money and little free time...
examples.translation: 我没什么钱，也没多少空闲时间。

examples.text: I find that I need very little sleep these days...
examples.translation: 我发现最近我只需要睡很少时间。

examples.text: There is little doubt that a diet high in fibre is more satisfying...
examples.translation: 毫无疑问，高纤维的饮食更尽人意。

examples.text: So far little progress has been made towards ending the fighting...
examples.translation: 到目前为止，在结束交战方面还没取得什么进展。

examples.text: The pudding is quick and easy and needs little attention once in the oven.
examples.translation: 这种布丁做起来简单快捷，放到烤箱里之后就不用操什么心了。

examples.text: Little of the existing housing is of good enough quality...
examples.translation: 现有的住房几乎少有质量过关的。

examples.text: They claim that little of the $16.5 million dollars in aid sent by the US government has reached them.
examples.translation: 他们声称美国政府提供的1,650万美元资助到他们手上时已所剩无几。

examples.text: He ate little, and drank less...
examples.translation: 他没吃什么东西，更没喝什么。

examples.text: In general, employers do little to help the single working mother...
examples.translation: 一般而言，雇主很少为工作的单亲妈妈提供帮助。

examples.text: Little is known about his childhood.
examples.translation: 对他的童年所知甚少。

examples.text: On their way back to Marseille they spoke very little...
examples.translation: 返回马赛的路上，他们没怎么说话。

examples.text: Only Africa is at present little affected by hard drugs.
examples.translation: 目前只有非洲没怎么受到硬毒品的影响。

examples.text: Mrs Caan needs a little help getting her groceries home...
examples.translation: 卡安太太需要有人帮把手将食品杂货拿回家。

examples.text: A little food would do us all some good...
examples.translation: 吃点东西，对我们大家都会有好处。

examples.text: ...a little light reading...
examples.translation: 一点消遣性的阅读

examples.text: I shall be only a very little time.
examples.translation: 我很快就好。

examples.text: They get paid for it. Not much. Just a little.
examples.translation: 他们干这是有报酬的。不多，只有一点。

examples.text: Pour a little of the sauce over the chicken...
examples.translation: 在鸡肉上浇一点调味汁。

examples.text: I'm sure she won't mind sparing us a little of her time.
examples.translation: 我肯定她不会介意为我们抽点时间。

examples.text: He walked a little by himself in the garden.
examples.translation: 他一个人在花园里散了一会儿步。

examples.text: He complained a little of a nagging pain between his shoulder blades...
examples.translation: 他有几句提到说肩胛骨之间一直在疼。

examples.text: He was a little bit afraid of his father's reaction...
examples.translation: 他有点害怕父亲的反应。

examples.text: If you have to drive when you are tired, go a little more slowly than you would normally...
examples.translation: 如果不得不疲劳驾驶，那就开得比平时慢一点。

examples.text: He wanted to have someone to whom he could talk a little about himself.
examples.translation: 他希望能有人听他说说关于自己的一些事。

examples.text: In the beginning he had felt well, but little by little he was becoming weaker...
examples.translation: 一开始他感觉很好，但慢慢地就变虚弱了。

examples.text: I would have to learn, little by little, to exist alone.
examples.translation: 我得慢慢学会独自生活。

examples.text: We sat around a little table, eating and drinking wine.
examples.translation: 我们围坐在一张小桌旁吃吃喝喝。

examples.text: ...the little group of art students.
examples.translation: 那一小群艺术专业的学生

examples.text: She's got the nicest little house not far from the library.
examples.translation: 她有一幢非常漂亮的小房子，就在离图书馆不远处。

examples.text: ...a little old lady...
examples.translation: 身材娇小的老太太

examples.text: James usually drives a little hatchback.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯通常开一辆小巧的掀背车。

examples.text: I have a little boy of 8...
examples.translation: 我有一个8岁的小男孩。

examples.text: When I was little I was very hyperactive.
examples.translation: 我小时候异常好动。

examples.text: Whenever Daniel's little sister was asked to do something she always had a naughty reply.
examples.translation: 每次让丹尼尔的妹妹做什么事，她总是要淘气地回嘴。

examples.text: Just go down the road a little way, turn left, and cross the bridge...
examples.translation: 沿这条路走一小段，向左转，然后过桥。

examples.text: Why don't we just wait a little while and see what happens...
examples.translation: 为什么不再等一下看看事态的发展。

examples.text: I've been wanting to have a little talk with you.
examples.translation: 我一直想找机会跟你谈几句。

examples.text: I had a little laugh to myself...
examples.translation: 我自顾自地笑了一下。

examples.text: She stood up quickly, giving a little cry of astonishment...
examples.translation: 她迅速站了起来，惊叫了一声。

examples.text: He turned with a little nod and I watched him walk away.
examples.translation: 他边点了点头边转过身，我看着他走了。

examples.text: ...irritating little habits...
examples.translation: 烦人的小毛病

examples.text: Harry found himself getting angry over little things that had never bothered him before.
examples.translation: 哈里发现自己会因为小事而生气，而以前他从不会在意这些事情。

meanings.meaning: 活的；生动的；实况转播的；精力充沛的

examples.text: She has lived here for 10 years...
examples.translation: 她在这里住了10年了。

examples.text: She always said I ought to live alone...
examples.translation: 她总说我应该一个人住。

examples.text: Where do you live?...
examples.translation: 你住在哪里？

examples.text: He still lives with his parents.
examples.translation: 他还和父母住在一起。

examples.text: We lived quite grandly...
examples.translation: 我们生活得非常快乐。

examples.text: Compared to people living only a few generations ago, we have greater opportunities to have a good time...
examples.translation: 比起上几辈人，我们有更多机会享受生活。

examples.text: We can start living a normal life again now.
examples.translation: 我们现在可以重新过上正常的生活了。

examples.text: ...the local support group for people living with HIV and AIDS.
examples.translation: 帮助人类免疫缺陷病毒感染者及艾滋病患者的当地团体

examples.text: He lived for his work.
examples.translation: 他为工作而活。

examples.text: He's got a terrible disease and will not live long...
examples.translation: 他已身患重疾，时日无多。

examples.text: A perennial is a plant that lives indefinitely...
examples.translation: 多年生植物是指能存活很多年的植物。

examples.text: He lived to be 103...
examples.translation: 他活了103岁。

examples.text: My father died nigh on ten years ago, but he lived to see his first grandson...
examples.translation: 我父亲过世差不多10年了，不过他活着时见到了第一个孙儿的出世。

examples.text: Matilda was born in northern Italy in 1046 and apparently lived to a ripe old age...
examples.translation: 玛蒂尔达1046年出生在意大利北部，据信享有高寿。

examples.text: The blue whale is the largest living thing on the planet...
examples.translation: 蓝鲸是地球上体型最大的生物。

examples.text: Ian was her only living relative.
examples.translation: 伊恩是她唯一还在世的亲戚。

examples.text: ...the last indigenous people to live by hunting...
examples.translation: 最后一个狩猎为生的土著民族

examples.text: These crimes were committed largely by professional criminals who lived by crime.
examples.translation: 这些罪案大都是由以犯罪为生的职业罪犯制造的。

examples.text: They live by the principle that we are here to add what we can to life, not to get what we want from it.
examples.translation: 他们恪守着这样的原则：我们来到世上是要为生活做贡献，而不是从中索取。

examples.text: The memory of that will live with me for many years to come...
examples.translation: 那个记忆将会伴随我多年。

examples.text: His name will live in history as one of the greatest bowlers of all time...
examples.translation: 他将会作为史上最伟大的板球投手之一而留名青史。

examples.text: Lenin lives on in the minds and hearts of millions of people.
examples.translation: 列宁永远活在亿万人民的心中。

examples.text: He has lived and breathed polo since he was seven.
examples.translation: 他从7岁开始就一直热衷于马球。

examples.text: If you have never been to an opera, you haven't lived...
examples.translation: 要是从来没看过歌剧，那就枉过此生了。

examples.text: You haven't lived until you've used their new micro system.
examples.translation: 要是没用过他们新的微系统，这辈子就算白活了。

examples.text: One in 10 Californians is unemployed and thousands more live in fear of losing their jobs.
examples.translation: 十分之一的加利福尼亚人没有工作，还有数以千计的人成天提心吊胆地害怕失去工作。

examples.text: There is no reason why you couldn't live it up once in a while.
examples.translation: 偶尔放纵一下也无妨。

examples.text: ...a protest against the company's tests on live animals.
examples.translation: 反对该公司利用活体动物做试验的抗议

examples.text: ...baskets of live chickens.
examples.translation: 一篮篮的活鸡

examples.text: Murray was a guest on a live radio show.
examples.translation: 默里在一个直播的电台节目里当嘉宾。

examples.text: ...we were laughing and gossiping, oblivious to the fact that we were on live TV...
examples.translation: 我们肆意大笑，闲聊八卦，忘记了自己是在做电视直播。

examples.text: They watch all the live matches...
examples.translation: 他们每一场直播比赛都必看。

examples.text: A broadcast of the speech was heard in San Francisco, but it is not known if this was live.
examples.translation: 在旧金山听到了这次演说的转播，但不知道是不是实况。

examples.text: It was broadcast live in 50 countries...
examples.translation: 它在50个国家进行了直播。

examples.text: We'll be going live to Nottingham later in this bulletin.
examples.translation: 在本次新闻快报中，我们稍后将有来自诺丁汉的现场报道。

examples.text: The Rainbow has not hosted live music since the end of 1981...
examples.translation: 1981年末之后，彩虹剧院就再没主办过现场音乐会。

examples.text: A live audience will pose the questions...
examples.translation: 问题将由现场的观众提出。

examples.text: The band was forced to cancel a string of live dates.
examples.translation: 乐队被迫取消了一系列的现场表演。

examples.text: Kat Bjelland has been playing live with her new band.
examples.translation: 凯特·比耶兰最近一直在与她的新乐队作现场表演。

examples.text: This is my favourite live album of all time...
examples.translation: 这是我最喜爱的现场专辑。

examples.text: The LP features live recordings from the 'Great Xpectations' all-day show.
examples.translation: 这张大碟收录了“远大前程”全天秀的现场录音。

examples.text: The plug broke, exposing live wires...
examples.translation: 插头坏了，带电的电线露在外面。

examples.text: He warned others about the live electric cables as they climbed to safety.
examples.translation: 他们爬向安全地带的过程中，他提醒其他人当心带电的电缆。

examples.text: They trained in the jungle using live ammunition.
examples.translation: 他们在丛林中接受真枪实弹的训练。

examples.text: A live bomb had earlier been defused.
examples.translation: 一枚未爆炸的炸弹稍早被拆除了雷管。

examples.text: The new system went live earlier this year...
examples.translation: 新系统在今年早些时候开始了运行。

examples.text: The service should go live this summer.
examples.translation: 这项服务将在今年夏天投入使用。

examples.text: He had never met a real live admiral...
examples.translation: 他从来没遇到过一位真正的海军上将。

examples.text: She has the best pet of all — a real live tiger.
examples.translation: 她有世上最佳的宠物——一只活生生的老虎。

meanings.meaning: 活泼的；生动的；真实的；生气勃勃的

examples.text: She had a sweet, lively personality...
examples.translation: 她的性格可爱活泼。

examples.text: Josephine was bright, lively and cheerful.
examples.translation: 约瑟芬聪明、活泼、开朗。

examples.text: Amy could sense his liveliness even from where she stood.
examples.translation: 埃米从她所站的位置都能感到他活力逼人。

examples.text: It turned out to be a very interesting session with a lively debate...
examples.translation: 结果这成了一场非常有意思的、气氛热烈的辩论会。

examples.text: Their 4-1 win in Honduras was a particularly lively affair.
examples.translation: 他们在洪都拉斯以4比1获胜的那场比赛尤其激动人心。

examples.text: Some may enjoy the liveliness of such a restaurant for a few hours a day or week.
examples.translation: 有些人可能每天或每周来几个小时，体验一下这个饭馆的热闹氛围。

examples.text: She was a very well educated girl with a lively mind, a girl with ambition.
examples.translation: 她是个受过良好教育、思维敏捷、抱负远大的女孩子。

examples.text: ...her very lively imagination.
examples.translation: 她那活跃奔放的想象力

examples.text: The papers also show a lively interest in European developments.
examples.translation: 论文对欧洲的动向亦表现出浓厚的兴趣。

examples.text: ...grilled calves' liver.
examples.translation: 烤小牛肝

examples.text: The 10th of 12 children, she claimed the living-room piano as her own private space.

meanings.meaning: 活的；现存的；活跃的；逼真的

examples.text: Father never talked about what he did for a living...
examples.translation: 父亲从不谈他的谋生之道。

examples.text: He earns his living doing all kinds of things.
examples.translation: 他做各种各样的活计来谋生。

examples.text: Olivia has always been a model of healthy living.
examples.translation: 奥利维娅一向是健康生活的楷模。

examples.text: ...the stresses of urban living.
examples.translation: 城市生活的压力

examples.text: The spacious living quarters were on the second floor...
examples.translation: 宽敞的生活区位于3楼。

examples.text: The study links the main living area to the kitchen.
examples.translation: 书房把主要的生活区与厨房连在一起。

examples.text: The young man is dead. We have only to consider the living.
examples.translation: 这位年轻人已经死了。我们只能考虑在生之人。

examples.text: He almost manages to scrape a living as an artist.
examples.translation: 他靠当艺术家来勉强混口饭吃。

meanings.meaning: 负载，负荷；工作量；装载量

examples.text: The three men seemed to have finished loading the truck...
examples.translation: 这3名男子似乎已把东西往卡车上装载完毕。

examples.text: Mr. Dambar had loaded his plate with lasagne...
examples.translation: 丹巴尔先生盛了一大盘千层面。

examples.text: Soldiers were loaded with blankets and supplies...
examples.translation: 士兵们背着毯子和给养。

examples.text: They load all their equipment into backpacks...
examples.translation: 他们把设备全装进背包里面。

examples.text: She deposited the loaded tray.
examples.translation: 她把满满的托盘放下。

examples.text: I've just loaded my truck up...
examples.translation: 我刚把货装上了卡车。

examples.text: The giggling couple loaded up their red sports car and drove off...
examples.translation: 笑咧咧的夫妻把东西装上他们的红色跑车后疾驰而去。

examples.text: We loaded up carts with all the blankets, bandages, medication, water we could spare...
examples.translation: 我们把所有可以省出来的毯子、绷带、药物和水塞进推车。

examples.text: She loaded up his collection of vintage wines into crates.
examples.translation: 她把他收藏的陈年佳酿装进板条箱里。

examples.text: ...the loading of baggage onto international flights.
examples.translation: 国际航班的行李装运

examples.text: He drove by with a big load of hay...
examples.translation: 他载着一大车干草驶过。

examples.text: He was carrying a very heavy load.
examples.translation: 他身上背着沉甸甸的东西。

examples.text: I put another load in the washing machine.
examples.translation: 我把另一堆衣服放进洗衣机。

examples.text: I've got loads of money...
examples.translation: 我有大把的钱。

examples.text: His people came up with a load of embarrassing information...
examples.translation: 他的部下亮出一大堆令人尴尬的资料来。

examples.text: I used to read loads of Asterix books.
examples.translation: 我以前看了很多《高卢英雄传》系列漫画书。

examples.text: ...a load of kids.
examples.translation: 一大群小孩

examples.text: I've never heard such a load of nonsense...
examples.translation: 如此一派胡言，本人闻所未闻。

examples.text: Personally, I think that's a load of garbage!
examples.translation: 我个人认为这纯粹是一堆垃圾！

examples.text: I knew how to load and handle a gun...
examples.translation: 我知道怎么上子弹，也知道枪怎么用。

examples.text: He carried a loaded gun...
examples.translation: 他带了一把子弹上膛的枪。

examples.text: They were quite safe because they weren't loaded.
examples.translation: 它们挺安全的，因为都没上子弹。

examples.text: A photographer from the newspaper was loading his camera with film...
examples.translation: 那家报纸的一名摄影师正往相机里装胶卷。

examples.text: A technician loads a video tape into one of the machines...
examples.translation: 一名技师把一盒录影带装进其中一台机器。

examples.text: The data can subsequently be loaded on a computer for processing.
examples.translation: 接下来可将数据载入计算机处理。

examples.text: She's taking some of the load off the secretaries.
examples.translation: 她在给秘书们减轻一些工作量。

examples.text: An efficient bulb may lighten the load of power stations...
examples.translation: 一个节能灯泡也许就能减轻发电站的负荷。

examples.text: Several processors can share the load of handling data in a single program.
examples.translation: 几个处理器可共同分担处理一个程序数据的负荷。

examples.text: Some of these chairs have flattened feet which spread the load on the ground...
examples.translation: 这些椅子中有的是平脚的，这样可分散地面所受的压力。

examples.text: High blood pressure imposes an extra load on the heart.
examples.translation: 高血压会给心脏增加额外的负担。

meanings.meaning: 游荡；游手好闲；虚度光阴
游荡；游手好闲；虚度光阴

examples.text: ...a loaf of crusty bread.
examples.translation: 一条硬皮面包

examples.text: ...freshly baked loaves.
examples.translation: 新鲜出炉的面包

examples.text: Soldiers loafed at street corners.
examples.translation: 士兵们在街角逛荡。

examples.text: We had been at Cambridge together, she studying medicine and me loafing around.
examples.translation: 我们一起在剑桥呆过。她学医，我则无所事事。

examples.text: The country has no access to foreign loans or financial aid...
examples.translation: 该国得不到任何外国贷款或经济援助。

examples.text: The president wants to make it easier for small businesses to get bank loans.
examples.translation: 总统希望能让小企业更方便地获得银行贷款。

examples.text: ...loan repayments.
examples.translation: 清偿贷款的分期付还款项

examples.text: I am in need of a loan of a bike for a few weeks...
examples.translation: 我需要借辆自行车用几个星期。

examples.text: He had offered the loan of his small villa at Cap Ferrat.
examples.translation: 他愿意借出在费拉角的小别墅。

examples.text: He had kindly offered to loan us all the plants required for the exhibit...
examples.translation: 他善解人意地提出愿意把展览需要的植物通通借给我们。

examples.text: We were approached by the Royal Yachting Association to see if we would loan our boat to them.
examples.translation: 皇家游艇协会的人找过我们，问我们能不能把船借给他们。

examples.text: It is common practice for clubs to loan out players to sides in the lower divisions...
examples.translation: 俱乐部把球员外借给下级联赛中的球队是常例。

examples.text: The ground was loaned out for numerous events including pop concerts.
examples.translation: 场地被借用来搞过无数活动，包括流行音乐会。

examples.text: ...impressionist paintings on loan from the National Gallery...
examples.translation: 从国家美术馆借出的印象派画作

examples.text: Many of these are on display in the Museum, but some have been sent out on loan to other museums.
examples.translation: 其中很多在博物馆展出，但也有一些借给了其他博物馆。

examples.text: David Speedie, on loan from Southampton, scored his first goal for Birmingham...
examples.translation: 从南安普敦转借来的戴维·斯皮迪为伯明翰进了他的第一球。

examples.text: She's on loan to us from the CIA.
examples.translation: 她是从中央情报局借调给我们的。

meanings.meaning: 大厅；休息室；会客室；游说议员的团体

examples.text: Carers from all over the UK lobbied Parliament last week to demand a better financial deal...
examples.translation: 英国各地的家庭看护人员上周向议会游说，要求改善经济待遇。

examples.text: Gun control advocates are lobbying hard for new laws...
examples.translation: 枪械管制支持者正努力游说通过新法。

examples.text: The union has attacked the plan and threatened to lobby against it...
examples.translation: 工会不但攻击该计划，而且还扬言要游说议员反对它。

examples.text: It must be terribly frustrating to lobby and get absolutely nowhere.
examples.translation: 游说未取得一点结果，一定让人非常沮丧。

examples.text: The aid was frozen in June after intense lobbying by conservative Republicans.
examples.translation: 经保守派共和党人的激烈游说，援助于6月份被冻结。

examples.text: Agricultural interests are some of the most powerful lobbies in Washington...
examples.translation: 农业利益集团是华盛顿最具影响力的游说团体之一。

examples.text: He set up this lobby of independent producers.
examples.translation: 他组织了这个由独立生产商组成的游说团。

examples.text: ...the Lawyers' Committee for Civil Rights, a housing lobby group.
examples.translation: 民权律师委员会，一个住房政策游说团体

examples.text: I met her in the lobby of the museum.
examples.translation: 我在博物馆的前厅遇见了她。

meanings.meaning: [计] 局部；当地居民；本地新闻
当地的；局部的；地方性的；乡土的

examples.text: We'd better check on the match in the local paper...
examples.translation: 我们最好在本地报纸上查一下这场比赛。

examples.text: Some local residents joined the students' protest...
examples.translation: 当地一些居民也加入了学生的抗议行列。

examples.text: I was going to pop up to the local library.
examples.translation: 我正打算到邻近的图书馆跑一趟。

examples.text: That's what the locals call the place.
examples.translation: 当地人就是这么叫这个地方的。

examples.text: We've got cards which are drawn and printed and designed by someone locally.
examples.translation: 我们买了一些当地人绘画、印制和设计的明信片。

examples.text: Education comprises two-thirds of all local council spending.
examples.translation: 教育占地方市政会全部开支的三分之二。

examples.text: ...the controversial system of local taxation known as the poll tax.
examples.translation: 被称为“人头税”的备受争议的地方税制

examples.text: The curriculum was to be decided locally.
examples.translation: 课程安排将由地方决定。

examples.text: The Black Horse is my local.
examples.translation: “黑马”是我常去的附近酒吧。

examples.text: An injection of local anaesthetic is usually given first to numb the area.
examples.translation: 通常先打局麻，以使该部位失去知觉。

examples.text: Following the discovery of the explosives the president cancelled his visit to the locality...
examples.translation: 发现炸药后，总统取消了对该地的访问。

examples.text: Details of the drinking water quality in your locality can be obtained from the public register.
examples.translation: 有关当地饮用水质量的详情，可从公共登记册上获知。

examples.text: The scientists want to locate the position of the gene on a chromosome...
examples.translation: 科学家们希望找出该基因在染色体中的位置。

examples.text: We've simply been unable to locate him.
examples.translation: 我们就是没办法找到他。

examples.text: Atlanta was voted the best city in which to locate a business by more than 400 chief executives...
examples.translation: 逾400名行政总裁投票推选亚特兰大为最适宜开办公司的城市。

examples.text: Tudor Court represents your opportunity to locate at the heart of the new Birmingham.
examples.translation: 都铎宛，您在新伯明翰中心区置业的好机会。

examples.text: ...tax breaks for businesses that locate in run-down neighbor-hoods.
examples.translation: 针对开办在老旧街区的商户的减税措施
