examples.translation: 我的主人命令我务必私下里传递消息。

examples.text: In 1777 several northern states encouraged white masters to free their slaves for military service.
examples.translation: 1777年，北方的几个州鼓励白人奴隶主解放奴隶，让他们参军。

examples.text: The dog yelped excitedly when his master opened a desk drawer and produced his leash.
examples.translation: 主人打开抽屉拿出牵狗用的皮带时，狗兴奋地叫了起来。

examples.text: She was a master of the English language...
examples.translation: 她是英文高手。

examples.text: He is a master at blocking progress...
examples.translation: 他特别擅长充当拦路虎。

examples.text: They appear masters in the art of making regulations work their way.
examples.translation: 他们似乎十分擅长利用规章制度为自己服务。

examples.text: ...a master craftsman.
examples.translation: 手艺高超的工匠

examples.text: ...a master criminal.
examples.translation: 手段高明的罪犯

examples.text: Jackson remained calm and always master of his passions...
examples.translation: 杰克逊镇定自若，始终克制着情绪。

examples.text: He was under no illusions as to who was master in his house.
examples.translation: 对于谁当家作主，他不抱任何幻想。

examples.text: Duff soon mastered the skills of radio production...
examples.translation: 达夫很快掌握了广播节目制作的技能。

examples.text: Students are expected to master a second language.
examples.translation: 学生应该掌握一门第二语言。

examples.text: When you have mastered one situation you have to go on to the next...
examples.translation: 一旦控制住了一个局面，又得接着应付下一个。

examples.text: His genius alone has mastered every crisis.
examples.translation: 仅凭天分，他就控制了所有的危机。

examples.text: Mr Palmer was a retired maths master.
examples.translation: 帕尔默先生是一名退休的数学教师。

examples.text: ...a portrait by the Dutch master, Vincent Van Gogh.
examples.translation: 一幅由荷兰著名画家文森特·凡·高所作的画像

examples.text: Keep one as a master copy for your own reference and circulate the others.
examples.translation: 一盘留作母带自用，其余的都分发出去。

examples.text: ...the Royal Pacific's master.
examples.translation: “皇家太平洋”号的船长

examples.text: I've a master's in economics.
examples.translation: 我获得了经济学硕士学位。

examples.text: She believed that she had been selected by the Master to reveal forgotten wisdom.
examples.translation: 她认为自己是被长老选中来揭示被人们遗忘的智慧的。

examples.text: Nice to see you, Master Simon.
examples.translation: 很高兴见到您，西蒙少爷。

examples.text: It was no place for a man who liked to be his own master.
examples.translation: 这绝非喜爱独立自主的人能呆下去的地方。

meanings.meaning: (Mat)人名；(土)马特；(柬)马；(英)马特，玛特(女名)(教名Matthew、Martha、Matilda的昵称)

examples.text: The food is served on polished tables with mats.
examples.translation: 饭菜摆放在擦得铮亮、铺着衬垫的餐桌上。

examples.text: There was a letter on the mat...
examples.translation: 地毯上有一封信。

examples.text: Bring a sleeping bag and foam mat.
examples.translation: 带上睡袋和泡沫垫。

examples.text: The houses are well spaced out, each on its own plot of ground and mat of coarse grass...
examples.translation: 房屋稀稀疏疏地坐落着，每栋都有自己的一片地和粗草坪。

examples.text: She touched the thick mat of sandy hair on his chest.
examples.translation: 她摸着他那浓密的淡棕色胸毛。

meanings.meaning: 助手，大副；配偶；同事；配对物
(Mate)人名；(日)蛏(姓)；(西、意、塞)马特；(波黑)马特；(罗、俄)马泰

examples.text: He's off drinking with his mates...
examples.translation: 他跟哥儿们出去喝酒了。

examples.text: A mate of mine used to play soccer for Liverpool.
examples.translation: 我的一个朋友在利物浦队踢过球。

examples.text: Come on mate, things aren't that bad.
examples.translation: 别灰心，兄弟，事情没那么糟。

examples.text: He has found his ideal mate.
examples.translation: 他找到了理想的伴侣。

examples.text: ...as women do become as powerful in the marketplace as their mates.
examples.translation: 随着女人在商界的确变得和男人一样强大

examples.text: The males guard their mates zealously.
examples.translation: 雄性动物死死地守护着他们的配偶。

examples.text: This allows the pair to mate properly and stops the hen staying in the nest-box...
examples.translation: 这样可以使这对公鸡和母鸡正常交配，让母鸡不再呆在鸡窝里。

examples.text: They want the males to mate with wild females...
examples.translation: 他们希望这些雄性动物可以和野生的雌性动物交配。

examples.text: It is easy to tell when a female is ready to mate.
examples.translation: 雌性动物何时准备交配一目了然。

examples.text: ...the mating season.
examples.translation: 交配季节

examples.text: ...the mate of a fishing trawler.
examples.translation: 拖网渔船上的大副

meanings.meaning: 使比赛；使相配；敌得过，比得上；相配；与…竞争
比赛；匹配；相配，相称；相比
比赛，竞赛；匹配；对手；火柴

examples.text: He was watching a football match...
examples.translation: 他正在观看一场足球比赛。

examples.text: France won the match 28-19.
examples.translation: 法国队以28比19赢得了这场比赛。

examples.text: ...a packet of cigarettes and a box of matches.
examples.translation: 一包香烟和一盒火柴

examples.text: Her nails were painted bright red to match her dress...
examples.translation: 她的指甲涂成了大红色，为的是与裙子相配。

examples.text: All the chairs matched...
examples.translation: 所有椅子都是配套的。

examples.text: You don't have to match your lipstick exactly to your outfit...
examples.translation: 你不一定非要让唇膏的颜色同礼服完全搭配。

examples.text: Mix and match your tableware and textiles from the new Design House collection.
examples.translation: 把你从“设计公司”新系列中挑选来的餐具和桌布搭配好。

examples.text: The pillow cover can match up with the sheets...
examples.translation: 这条枕巾可以和床单配上。

examples.text: Because false eyelashes come in various lengths and shades, it's so easy to match them up with your own.
examples.translation: 假睫毛有各种不同的长度和颜色，所以很容易与你自己的睫毛配上。

examples.text: Their strengths in memory and spatial skills matched...
examples.translation: 他们在记忆力和空间技能方面势均力敌。

examples.text: Our value system does not match with their value system.
examples.translation: 我们的价值体系和他们的并不相同。

examples.text: ...efforts to match demand with supply by building new schools.
examples.translation: 通过建立新学校以达到供需平衡的努力

examples.text: The students are asked to match the books with the authors...
examples.translation: 要求学生把书籍与作者对应起来。

examples.text: We will try to match you to employers with the vacancies you are looking for...
examples.translation: 我们会争取为你找到提供你所需职位的用人单位。

examples.text: It can take time and effort to match buyers and sellers...
examples.translation: 给买卖双方牵线可能需要一些时间和工夫。

examples.text: The sale would only go ahead if the name and number matched...
examples.translation: 只有名称与数目吻合，才能进行销售。

examples.text: Pictures of road signs are matched with their Highway Code meanings.
examples.translation: 道路标志图是同公用通道法规一致的。

examples.text: The consultant seeks to match up jobless professionals with small companies in need of expertise...
examples.translation: 这个顾问力求使失业的专业人员找到需要专门技术的小公司。

examples.text: They compared the fat intake of groups of vegetarians and meat eaters, and matched their diets up with levels of harmful blood fats...
examples.translation: 他们比较了素食者组与肉食者组的脂肪摄入量，并将他们的膳食与血脂超标水平对应起来。

examples.text: My sister and I never really matched up...
examples.translation: 我和妹妹从没真正地合得来过。

examples.text: I'm sure that yellow lead matched up to that yellow socket.
examples.translation: 我敢肯定那根黄线接那个黄色插口。

examples.text: Helen's choice of lipstick was a good match for her skin-tone...
examples.translation: 海伦选择的唇膏很适合她的肤色。

examples.text: Moira was a perfect match for him.
examples.translation: 莫伊拉和他简直是绝配。

examples.text: They played some fine attacking football, but I think we matched them in every respect...
examples.translation: 他们的攻势足球踢得不错，不过我认为我们各方面和他们比起来都不逊色。

examples.text: His record has never been matched.
examples.translation: 他的纪录尚无人能及。

examples.text: The finals of the Championship begin today, matching the United States against France...
examples.translation: 锦标赛决赛于今天打响，由美国队对法国队。

examples.text: Lewis is matched against the WBO's heavyweight champion, Tommy Morrison.
examples.translation: 刘易斯对决世界拳击组织的重量级拳王汤米·莫里森。

examples.text: I had finally met my match in power and intellect.
examples.translation: 我终于遇上了与我在力量与智力上不相上下的劲敌。

examples.text: I was no match for a man with such power...
examples.translation: 我根本不是这样强大的男人的对手。

examples.text: Hand-held guns proved no match for heavy armor.
examples.translation: 结果证明，手持枪械无法同重型装甲抗衡。

meanings.meaning: 重要的；物质的，实质性的；肉体的

examples.text: ...electrons in a conducting material such as a metal.
examples.translation: 金属等导电材料中的电子

examples.text: ...the design of new absorbent materials.
examples.translation: 新型高吸水性材料的设计

examples.text: ...recycling of all materials.
examples.translation: 所有材料的回收

examples.text: ...the thick material of her skirt...
examples.translation: 她的裙子的厚布料

examples.text: The materials are soft and comfortable to wear.
examples.translation: 这些布料质地柔软，穿着很舒服。

examples.text: The builders ran out of materials.
examples.translation: 建筑商耗尽了材料。

examples.text: ...sewing materials.
examples.translation: 缝纫材料

examples.text: In my version of the story, I added some new material.
examples.translation: 我在讲述这个故事时加入了新的素材。

examples.text: ...the film producer's debt to the author of original screen material.
examples.translation: 影片的制片人受到了创作影片原始素材的作者的启发

examples.text: Every room must have been stuffed with material things.
examples.translation: 每个房间肯定都塞满了东西。

examples.text: ...the material world.
examples.translation: 物质世界

examples.text: ...his descriptions of their poor material conditions.
examples.translation: 他对他们贫困的物质生活的描述

examples.text: He has tried to help this child materially and spiritually...
examples.translation: 他尽力在物质和精神上帮助这个孩子。

examples.text: They believe that a tough, materially poor childhood is character-building...
examples.translation: 他们认为一个艰难贫困的童年有助于性格的培养。

examples.text: The object has no real value, materially or emotionally.
examples.translation: 无论从物质还是情感上说，这个东西都一无是处。

examples.text: She was not university material...
examples.translation: 她不是上大学的料。

examples.text: His message has changed little since he became presidential material.
examples.translation: 成为总统候选人后，他的宣言并没有多少变化。

examples.text: The nature and availability of material evidence was not to be discussed...
examples.translation: 实质性证据的性质和可用性毋庸讨论。

examples.text: They contend that the company failed to disclose material information.
examples.translation: 他们坚持认为该公司并未透露实质性的信息。

meanings.meaning: 数学的，数学上的；精确的

examples.text: ...mathematical calculations...
examples.translation: 数学计算

examples.text: Given the sheer number of stars that exist it's a mathematical certainty that there is life on other planets.
examples.translation: 考虑到现有星球数量，从数学的角度来说，其他行星上面肯定存在生命。

examples.text: ...a mathematically complicated formula...
examples.translation: 运算繁复的方程

examples.text: Mathematically, it made sense.
examples.translation: 从数学的角度而言，这是有道理的。

examples.text: ...children who display extraordinary mathematical ability.
examples.translation: 显示出不凡的数学能力的儿童

examples.text: ...a mathematical genius.
examples.translation: 数学天才

examples.text: Anyone can be an astrologer as long as they are mathematically minded.
examples.translation: 任何善于运算的人都可以成为占星家。

examples.text: He taught science and maths.
examples.translation: 他教科学和数学这两门课。

meanings.meaning: 成熟的；充分考虑的；到期的；成年人的
使…成熟；使…长成；慎重作出

examples.text: You will learn what to expect as your child matures physically...
examples.translation: 在孩子身体发育成熟时，你就知道会发生什么事了。

examples.text: The eggs hatched and the chicks matured.
examples.translation: 小鸡破壳而出。

examples.text: ...young girls who'd not yet matured.
examples.translation: 尚未发育成熟的小女孩

examples.text: When the trees matured they were cut in certain areas...
examples.translation: 在有些地方，树木长成后就会被砍掉。

examples.text: Their songwriting has matured.
examples.translation: 他们的歌曲创作水平已经成熟。

examples.text: Hopefully after three years at university I will have matured...
examples.translation: 希望3年大学生活之后我能变成熟。

examples.text: I thought you had matured enough not to be giggly and silly about serious art.
examples.translation: 我觉得你已经长大成人，不应该再冲着严肃的艺术作品傻笑。

examples.text: They are emotionally mature and should behave responsibly...
examples.translation: 他们在情感上已经成熟，应该负责任地行事。

examples.text: You and I are mature, freethinking adults.
examples.translation: 你我都是明白事理、思想自由的成年人。

examples.text: It is his most mature comedy yet.
examples.translation: 这是他迄今最成熟的喜剧作品。

examples.text: Unlike wine, brandy matures only in wood, not glass.
examples.translation: 和葡萄酒不同的是，白兰地只能在木制容器而非玻璃容器里酿制。

examples.text: ...the cellars where the cheeses are matured.
examples.translation: 酿制奶酪的地窖

examples.text: ...our best selling matured cheddar.
examples.translation: 我们最畅销的切达熟干酪

examples.text: Grate some mature cheddar cheese.
examples.translation: 将一些已经酿熟的切达干酪磨碎。

examples.text: ...the best place to enjoy fine, mature wines.
examples.translation: 品尝葡萄佳酿的最佳之处

examples.text: These bonuses will be paid when your savings plan matures in ten years' time.
examples.translation: 这些红利会在10年后存款到期时支付。

examples.text: ...an endowment policy that matured on September 1.
examples.translation: 9月1日到期的人寿定期保险单

examples.text: ...a man of mature years who had been in the job for longer than most of the members could remember.
examples.translation: 一个已过中年的男子，大多数成员都不记得他干这行有多久了

meanings.meaning: [数] 极大，最大限度；最大量
最高的；最多的；最大极限的

examples.text: Under planning law the maximum height for a fence or hedge is 2 metres...
examples.translation: 规划法中规定，围栏或树篱最高为2米。

examples.text: China headed the table with maximum points.
examples.translation: 中国队以最高分位居榜首。

examples.text: The law provides for a maximum of two years in prison...
examples.translation: 法律规定最高可处以两年监禁。

examples.text: Twelve hours is the minimum, sixty hours the maximum.
examples.translation: 12小时为下限，60小时为上限。

examples.text: ...the maximum amount of information...
examples.translation: 海量信息

examples.text: It was achieved with minimum fuss and maximum efficiency.
examples.translation: 事情事半功倍地完成了。

examples.text: ...a maximum security prison.
examples.translation: 密不透风的监狱

examples.text: We need an extra 6g a day maximum.
examples.translation: 我们一天最多还需要6克。

examples.text: You have to develop your capabilities to the maximum.
examples.translation: 你必须尽你所能。

examples.text: It was clear that she wanted to discuss some private matter...
examples.translation: 很明显，她想谈些私事。

examples.text: Until the matter is resolved the athletes will be ineligible to compete...
examples.translation: 除非这个问题得以解决，否则这些运动员没有资格参加比赛。

examples.text: Don't you think this is now a matter for the police?...
examples.translation: 难道你不觉得这件事现在该交由警方处理吗？

examples.text: Business matters drew him to Paris.
examples.translation: 他因公前往巴黎。

examples.text: If your ordinary life is out of control, then retreating into a cosy ritual will not improve matters...
examples.translation: 如果正常生活都一团糟了，那么再讲究小情调根本无济于事。

examples.text: If it would facilitate matters, I would be happy to come to New York...
examples.translation: 如果对事态发展有利，我很乐意来纽约。

examples.text: Matters took an unexpected turn.
examples.translation: 事态发生了意想不到的转变。

examples.text: History is always a matter of interpretation...
examples.translation: 历史总是一种阐释角度的问题。

examples.text: Observance of the law is a matter of principle for us...
examples.translation: 守法是我们的一个原则问题。

examples.text: After that, life became a matter of defying school rules...
examples.translation: 从那以后，生活便成了处处与校规作对。

examples.text: Jack had attended these meetings as a matter of routine for years.
examples.translation: 数年来，杰克把参加这些会议当成是例行公事。

examples.text: ...the Government's plans to levy VAT on printed matter.
examples.translation: 政府对印刷品征收增值税的计划

examples.text: ...a rich variety of reading matter.
examples.translation: 种类繁多的阅读材料

examples.text: A proton is an elementary particle of matter.
examples.translation: 质子是物质的基本粒子。

examples.text: He has spent his career studying how matter behaves at the fine edge between order and disorder.
examples.translation: 他从事研究物质在有序与无序的细微临界处的行为变化。

examples.text: They feed mostly on decaying vegetable matter.
examples.translation: 它们大多以腐烂的蔬菜为食。

examples.text: ...waste matter from industries.
examples.translation: 工业废料

examples.text: Carole, what's the matter? You don't seem happy...
examples.translation: 卡萝尔，出什么事了？你好像不开心。

examples.text: What's the matter with your office?...
examples.translation: 你们部门出什么事了吗？

examples.text: She told him there was nothing the matter.
examples.translation: 她告诉他没出什么事。

examples.text: Within a matter of days she was back at work...
examples.translation: 仅仅几天后，她又回去上班了。

examples.text: He expected to be at East Grinstead station in a matter of hours...
examples.translation: 他希望几个小时内可以到达东格林斯特德站。

examples.text: This time the journey was short, a matter of four or five miles up into the hills.
examples.translation: 这次的旅程很短，只有上山的四五英里路。

examples.text: A lot of the food goes on the floor but that doesn't matter...
examples.translation: 许多食品掉在地板上，不过也没什么关系。

examples.text: As for Laura and me, the colour of our skin has never mattered...
examples.translation: 至于我和劳拉，肤色根本不是问题。

examples.text: As long as staff are smart, it does not matter how long their hair is...
examples.translation: 员工只要聪明，头发留多长没什么关系。

examples.text: Does it matter that people don't know this?...
examples.translation: 人们对此事不知情，这重要吗？

examples.text: Money is the only thing that matters to them.
examples.translation: 对他们来说，钱是唯一重要的东西。

examples.text: Being responsible for one's own health is one thing, but being responsible for another person's health is quite a different matter...
examples.translation: 对自己的健康负责是一回事，对他人的健康负责就完全是另一回事了。

examples.text: You have no business going into such places all by yourselves. If your parents take you, of course, that's another matter.
examples.translation: 你们不该自己去这些地方。不过如果是父母带你们去的，那就另当别论了。

examples.text: Your doctor and health visitor can help a great deal and you need to talk about it with them as a matter of urgency.
examples.translation: 你的医生和家访护士会帮很大的忙。你应该和他们谈一谈，这是当务之急。

examples.text: Choosing the colour for the drawing-room walls was no easy matter.
examples.translation: 选择客厅墙壁的颜色绝非易事。

examples.text: 'He's moving in here,' Maria said. 'So that's the end of the matter.'
examples.translation: “他就要搬来住了，”玛丽亚说，“那么就这么定了。”

examples.text: The fact of the matter is that most people consume far more protein than they actually need...
examples.translation: 真实的情况是，大多数人摄入的蛋白质比他们实际所需的多出许多。

examples.text: The truth of the matter is that he was having an identity crisis when he met Carina.
examples.translation: 实际情况是，他认识卡丽娜时正在迷失自我。

examples.text: The irony was that Shawn had not seen her. Nor for that matter had anyone else...
examples.translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，肖恩并没有见过她，别人也同样如此。

examples.text: A great deal of hard work was done and, for that matter, is continuing.
examples.translation: 大量艰苦的工作已经完成，同样，大量艰苦的工作也仍在继续。

examples.text: 'Did I wake you?' — 'Yes, but it doesn't matter.'
examples.translation: “我把你吵醒了？”——“是的，不过没关系。”

examples.text: 'Steve, what do you want?' — 'Coke, Pepsi, it doesn't matter.'
examples.translation: “史蒂夫，你要喝点什么？”——“可口可乐，百事，随便啦。”

examples.text: Their behaviour is an offence. It's no laughing matter.
examples.translation: 他们这么做是犯罪，这可不是开玩笑的。

examples.text: Don't let yourself despair; this will only make matters worse...
examples.translation: 不要想不开，这样只能使情况变得更糟。

examples.text: To make matters worse, it started to rain again.
examples.translation: 更糟的是，又开始下雨了。

examples.text: 'Didn't you ever read the book?' Keating shook his head. 'Well, no matter.'...
examples.translation: “你从没看过这本书？”基廷摇了摇头。“嗯，没关系。”

examples.text: 'Shoddy workmanship these days,' he remarked. 'No matter, it will still bear my weight.'
examples.translation: “现如今的做工实在是差劲，”他说，“无所谓了，好歹还撑得住我的体重。”

examples.text: No matter what your age, you can lose weight by following this program...
examples.translation: 不论年龄多大，都可以按这套方案来减肥。

examples.text: No matter how often they were urged, they could not bring themselves to join in...
examples.translation: 就算别人说破了嘴皮，他们就是不加入。

examples.text: Jenkins would reward all investors, no matter when they made their investment.
examples.translation: 无论投资人何时投资，詹金斯都会让他们得到回报。

examples.text: He had decided to publish the manuscript no matter what...
examples.translation: 他决定无论如何都要出版那部手稿。

examples.text: I vowed then, no matter what, I would never be like those people.
examples.translation: 于是我发誓，无论如何，我和他们那种人都不会成为一丘之貉。

examples.text: 'We're not that contrived. We're not that theatrical.' — 'That's a matter of opinion.'
examples.translation: “我们没那么造作，也没那么夸张。”——“见仁见智喽。”

examples.text: It would be only a matter of time before he went through with it.
examples.translation: 他完成这件事只是时间问题。

meanings.meaning: 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿；会，能

examples.text: You may wonder what a Secretary-General of the United Nations is doing writing about football.
Maybe she is in love...
examples.translation: 她大概是恋爱了。

examples.text: Maybe he sincerely wanted to help his country...
examples.translation: 或许他是诚心诚意地想帮助自己的祖国。

examples.text: I do think about having children, maybe when I'm 40...
examples.translation: 我的确在考虑要孩子的问题，也许等到我40岁吧。

examples.text: Things are maybe not as good as they should be...
examples.translation: 情况也许并没有情理之中那么好。

examples.text: Bill will come on then maybe Ralph, then Bobby and Johnny doing their hits.
examples.translation: 比尔先上，然后大概是拉尔夫，接下来是博比和约翰尼击球。

examples.text: Maybe we can go to the movies or something...
examples.translation: 也许我们可以去看场电影什么的。

examples.text: Maybe you'd better tell me what this is all about...
examples.translation: 也许你应该告诉我这究竟是怎么回事。

examples.text: Maybe you shouldn't eat in that restaurant anymore...
examples.translation: 也许你不该再去那家餐厅吃饭了。

examples.text: Maybe if you tell me a little about her?...
examples.translation: 也许你可以跟我讲一点关于她的事情？

examples.text: Wait a while, maybe a few days.
examples.translation: 等一等吧，也许要过几天。

examples.text: Maybe there is jealousy, but I think the envy is more powerful...
examples.translation: 也许是羡慕，但我认为更多的是嫉妒。

examples.text: OK, maybe I am a failure, but, in my opinion, no more than the rest of this country.
examples.translation: 好吧，也许我是个失败者，不过在我看来，这个国家里的其他人也不比我成功到哪里去。

examples.text: 'Do you think that another country will step in to become the dominant military power in the region?' — 'Maybe.'...
examples.translation: “您认为另一个国家会介入在该地区建立军事霸权吗？”——“可能吧。”

examples.text: 'Is she coming back?' — 'Maybe. No one hears from her.'
examples.translation: “她快回来了吗？”——“也许吧。都还没信儿呢。”

examples.text: The men were maybe a hundred feet away and coming closer.
examples.translation: 那些人大约有100英尺远，正在向这里靠近。

examples.text: They'll come to the bar for a year, or maybe even two, then they'll find another favourite spot.
examples.translation: 他们会在一年，有时甚至是两年里一直光顾这个酒吧，然后再另寻好去处。

examples.text: I'm the Foursquare mayor, actually, which means I come here more than anyone else.

meanings.meaning: 自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分
(Me)人名；(日)马(姓)；(朝)袂；(阿拉伯、柬、老)梅

examples.text: He was a wonderful editor, and he used to scare the hell out of me.
And forget crowds in their thousands - home games at Meadow Park hardly create stampedes.
She sat next to him throughout the meal...
examples.translation: 用餐时她一直坐在他身旁。

examples.text: It's rare that I have an evening meal with my children.
examples.translation: 我难得跟孩子们一起吃晚饭。

examples.text: The waiter offered him red wine or white wine with his meal...
examples.translation: 侍者为他端上佐餐的红葡萄酒或者白葡萄酒。

examples.text: Fresh fish makes a delicious meal.
examples.translation: 新鲜的鱼做菜非常美味。

examples.text: Lawyers always make such a meal of the simplest little thing.
examples.translation: 律师总是死抠细节。

examples.text: I hadn't a clue to the meaning of 'activism'...
examples.translation: 我根本不明白 activism 的意思。

examples.text: I became more aware of the symbols and their meanings.
examples.translation: 我进一步理解了这些符号及其意义。

examples.text: Unsure of the meaning of this remark, Ryle chose to remain silent...
examples.translation: 由于不确定这句话究竟是什么意思，赖尔选择了保持沉默。

examples.text: Her book is not without autobiographical meaning.
examples.translation: 她的书不无为自己作传的意图。

examples.text: Art has real meaning when it helps people to understand themselves.
examples.translation: 当艺术有助于人们了解自身的时候才有真正的意义。

examples.text: ...a challenge that gives meaning to life.
examples.translation: 使生活变得有意义的挑战

examples.text: Don't mention failure when Kevin is around. He doesn't know the meaning of the word.
examples.translation: 凯文在的时候不要提“失败”这个词。他不知道什么叫“失败”。

examples.text: Eventually your child will leave home to lead her own life as a fully independent adult, but in the meantime she relies on your support...
examples.translation: 你的孩子最终将长大成人，完全独立，离开家过自己的生活，不过在此期间她会靠你帮助。

examples.text: It now hopes to hold elections in February. Meantime, the state will continue to be run from Delhi.
examples.translation: 现在有望在2月进行选举。在此期间，该邦继续由德里政府管理。

examples.text: The Prime Minister has, for the meantime, seen off the challenge of the opposition...
examples.translation: 首相目前已经经受住了反对派的挑战。

examples.text: For the meantime, the opinion polls have to be taken on trust.
examples.translation: 眼下必须相信民意调查。

meanings.meaning: 意思是；打算（mean的第三人称单数） [ 复数means ]

examples.text: The move is a means to fight crime...
examples.translation: 采取这项举措是为了打击犯罪。

examples.text: The army had perfected the use of terror as a means of controlling the population...
examples.translation: 军队已经深谙利用恐怖手段控制民众之道。

examples.text: Business managers are focused on increasing their personal wealth by any available means.
examples.translation: 企业经理一心只想用尽办法增加个人财富。

examples.text: ...a person of means...
examples.translation: 富人

examples.text: He did not have the means to compensate her.
examples.translation: 他没有钱来补偿她。

examples.text: The more gifts she received, the more she craved, until he was living beyond his means...
examples.translation: 得到的礼物越多，她的胃口就越大，直到他捉襟见肘为止。

examples.text: It is far better to pay off old debts steadily by living within your means.
examples.translation: 量入为出地一步步偿还旧债，这个方法要好得多。

examples.text: This is a two year course taught by means of lectures and seminars...
examples.translation: 本课程为期两年，授课形式为讲座与研讨。

examples.text: The trailer was connected to the car by means of a complicated system of hoses, pipes and rods.
examples.translation: 活动房屋通过一系列复杂的软管、管道和连杆与汽车相连。

examples.text: 'Can I come and have a look at your house?' — 'Yes by all means'.
examples.translation: “我可以过来看看你的房子吗？”“当然可以。”

examples.text: This is by no means out of the ordinary...
examples.translation: 这丝毫不足为奇。

examples.text: They were not finished, however, not by any means.
examples.translation: 不过，他们并没有结束,绝对没有。

examples.text: We seem to have lost sight of the fact that marketing is only a means to an end.
examples.translation: 我们似乎忽略了这样一个事实：营销只是达到目的的手段。

examples.text: Brush the aubergines with oil, add salt and pepper, and bake till soft. Meanwhile, heat the remaining oil in a heavy pan...
examples.translation: 把油涂在茄子上，加盐和胡椒烤至松软。与此同时，在厚锅中加热剩余的油。

examples.text: Kate turned to beckon Peter across from the car, but Bill waved him back, meanwhile pushing Kate inside.
examples.translation: 凯特转身示意汽车对面的彼得过来，可是比尔却挥手示意他回去，同时把凯特推进车内。

examples.text: You needn't worry; I'll be ready to greet them. Meanwhile I'm off to discuss the Fowler's party with Felix.
examples.translation: 你不必担心，我会招呼他们的。其间，我还要去跟费利克斯商量一下福勒举办聚会的事。

examples.text: 'I can very easily explain my dealings with them.' — 'I am sure you can, sir. But in the meanwhile I must ask you to come with me.'
examples.translation: “我跟他们之间的交往很好解释。”——“这我相信，先生。不过，我还得请您跟我走一趟。”

examples.text: He had always found his wife's mother a bit annoying. The mother-daughter relationship, meanwhile, was close.
examples.translation: 他总是觉得丈母娘有点烦人，然而她们母女之间的关系却非常亲密。

examples.text: In modern Welsh, 'glas' means 'blue'...
examples.translation: 在现代威尔士语中，glas 意为“蓝色”。

examples.text: What does 'evidence' mean?...
examples.translation: evidence 是什么意思？

examples.text: The red signal means you can shoot.
examples.translation: 红色信号表示可以射击。

examples.text: Do you mean me?...
examples.translation: 你指的是我吗？

examples.text: Let me illustrate what I mean with an old story...
examples.translation: 让我用一个古老的故事来说明我的意思吧。

examples.text: What do you think he means by that?...
examples.translation: 你觉得他那么说是什么意思呢？

examples.text: I think he means that he does not want this marriage to turn out like his friend's.
examples.translation: 我认为他的意思是，他不愿意这场婚姻落得跟他朋友的婚姻一样的下场。

examples.text: The idea that she witnessed this shameful incident meant nothing to him...
examples.translation: 虽然她目睹了这可耻的一幕，但是这对他来说无关紧要。

examples.text: It would mean a lot to them to win.
examples.translation: 获胜对他们来说非常重要。

examples.text: An enlarged prostate does not necessarily mean cancer...
examples.translation: 前列腺肿大不一定就是癌症。

examples.text: Just because he has a beard doesn't necessarily mean he's a hippy.
examples.translation: 不能因为他蓄须就说他是嬉皮士。

examples.text: It would almost certainly mean the end of NATO...
examples.translation: 这几乎肯定会导致北大西洋公约组织的终结。

examples.text: Trade and product discounts can also mean big savings...
examples.translation: 商品促销与产品折扣同样意味着可能会省下一大笔钱。

examples.text: The change will mean that the country no longer has full diplomatic relations with other states.
examples.translation: 这个变化将意味着该国断绝与其他国家的正式外交关系。

examples.text: Children universally prefer to live in peace and security, even if that means living with only one parent...
examples.translation: 孩子们普遍愿意过平静安宁的生活，即便这意味着只能与单亲生活在一起。

examples.text: Managing well means communicating well.
examples.translation: 良好的管理需要有效的沟通。

examples.text: He says you're fired if you're not back at work on Friday. And I think he meant it...
examples.translation: 他说，如果你星期五还不回去上班的话就解雇你。我想他是当真的。

examples.text: He could see I meant what I said. So he took his fur coat and left.
examples.translation: 他看得出我并非只是说说而已，于是拿起他的皮衣走了。

examples.text: I didn't mean to hurt you...
examples.translation: 我无意伤害你。

examples.text: If that sounds harsh, it is meant to...
examples.translation: 如果这么说听起来刺耳的话，那目的就达到了。

examples.text: Did you mean to leave your dog here?...
examples.translation: 你是不是故意把你的狗丢在这里呢？

examples.text: I can see why you believed my letters were threatening but I never meant them to be.
examples.translation: 我能理解你为什么认为我的信是在吓唬人，但是我绝无此意。

examples.text: I'm sure he didn't mean any harm...
examples.translation: 我相信他并无恶意。

examples.text: I didn't mean any offence. It was a flippant, off-the-cuff remark.
examples.translation: 我本无意冒犯，那不过是句脱口而出的冒失话。

examples.text: Summer is the perfect time to catch up on the new books you meant to read...
examples.translation: 夏天是把想读却没读的新书恶补一下的最佳时机。

examples.text: You know very well what I meant to say...
examples.translation: 你非常清楚我想说什么。

examples.text: I mean to look after my body.
examples.translation: 我得多注意身体。

examples.text: John was constantly reassuring me that we were meant to be together.
examples.translation: 约翰不断安慰我说，我们注定要在一起。

examples.text: It was his idea. Gordon's, I mean...
examples.translation: 这是他的主意，我是指戈登。

examples.text: Is something upsetting you—I mean, apart from this business?
examples.translation: 有什么烦心事吗？我的意思是，除了这件事以外还有吗？

examples.text: I'm sure he wouldn't mind. I mean, I was the one who asked him...
examples.translation: 我肯定他不会在意的，因为是我问他的。

examples.text: They were filled with racial stereotypes, I mean, it looked like something from the 1930s.
examples.translation: 他们满脑子种族成见，似乎都是些20世纪30年代的老思想。

examples.text: It was law or classics—I mean English or classics.
examples.translation: 是法律或者古典文学——我的意思是英语或古典文学。

examples.text: I know what it means to lose a child under such tragic circumstances.
examples.translation: 我明白在这种悲惨的情况下失去孩子的滋味。

examples.text: 'Oh, Gairdner,' he said, as if that meant something to him...
examples.translation: “哦，盖尔德纳，”他说道，好像他听说过这个名字。

examples.text: Does the word 'Fareham' mean anything to anyone?
examples.translation: 有人对 Fareham 这个词有印象吗？

examples.text: I know you mean well, but I can manage by myself.
examples.translation: 我明白您的好意，不过我自己能行。

examples.text: What accident? You mean Christina's?...
examples.translation: 哪次事故？你是说克里斯蒂娜的那次？

examples.text: 'What if I had said no?' 'About the apartment, you mean?'
examples.translation: “我要是说了不呢？”“你是说公寓那件事吗？”

examples.text: Don't be mean with fabric, otherwise curtains will end up looking skimpy.
examples.translation: 别这么吝啬布料，不然做出来的窗帘会显得特寒酸。

examples.text: This very careful attitude to money can sometimes border on meanness.
examples.translation: 这种对待金钱的过分谨慎的态度有时几近于吝啬。

examples.text: ...the meanest grant possible from the local council.
examples.translation: 从地方委员会可能获得的微乎其微的拨款

examples.text: The little girls had locked themselves in upstairs because Mack had been mean to them...
examples.translation: 小姑娘们把自己锁在楼上，因为麦克对她们很刻薄。

examples.text: I'd feel mean saying no.
examples.translation: 拒绝的话我说不出口。

examples.text: He had been behaving very meanly to his girlfriend.
examples.translation: 他对女朋友一直非常刻薄。

examples.text: ...the meanest fighter in the world.
examples.translation: 世界上最残忍的斗士

examples.text: He was raised on the mean streets of the central market district of Panama City.
examples.translation: 他从小在巴拿马城中心闹市区的穷街陋巷里长大。

examples.text: He cooks a mean salmon...
examples.translation: 他烧鲑鱼的水平一流。

examples.text: Marge played a mean game of tennis.
examples.translation: 玛吉打得一手好网球。

examples.text: She was no mean performer on a variety of other instruments...
examples.translation: 许多别的乐器她也演奏得相当出色。

examples.text: Moreover, Ramsay was no mean thinker himself.
examples.translation: 而且拉姆齐自己也是一位出色的思想家。

examples.text: To destroy 121 enemy aircraft is no mean record...
examples.translation: 歼灭121架敌机是一个了不起的纪录。

examples.text: Repton reached the final, and since around 1,500 schools entered the competition, that was no mean achievement.
examples.translation: 雷普顿进入了决赛，鉴于有1,500所左右的学校参与了角逐，能够取得这样的成绩相当了不起。

examples.text: Take a hundred and twenty values and calculate the mean.
examples.translation: 取120个值计算平均数。

examples.text: ...the mean score for 26-year-olds.
examples.translation: 26岁年龄组的平均分数

examples.text: Meat and fish are relatively expensive.
examples.translation: 肉和鱼相对来说比较贵。

examples.text: ...imported meat products.
examples.translation: 进口肉制品

examples.text: ...a buffet of cold meats and salads.
examples.translation: 有冷肉和色拉的自助餐

examples.text: What normal people considered pressure was meat and drink to him.
examples.translation: 一般人认为有压力的事情在他看来却是快乐无比的事。

examples.text: What they want is the meat and potatoes of how we're going to improve this country and get our country moving again.
examples.translation: 他们想知道的是我们如何改善国家、让其恢复活力的基本方法。

examples.text: If you smell gas fumes or burning, take the car to your mechanic...
examples.translation: 如果你闻见汽油冒烟或燃烧的异味，应把车送修。

examples.text: An elevator mechanic can work the machinery directly by turning this lever.
examples.translation: 电梯修理工可以转动这根杠杆直接操作机器。

examples.text: What are the mechanics of this new process?...
examples.translation: 这一新工序如何操作？

examples.text: The mechanics of the job, however, have changed little since then.
examples.translation: 不过，工作流程从那以后就几乎没有任何变化。

examples.text: ...the other great theory of 20th-century physics, quantum mechanics...
examples.translation: 20世纪物理学的另一个伟大理论——量子力学

examples.text: He has not studied mechanics or engineering.
examples.translation: 他没有学习过力学和工程学。

examples.text: I continued to measure his progress against the charts in the doctor's office...
examples.translation: 我继续比照医生办公室里的图表来判断他病情的发展。

examples.text: A grammar school's success was measured in terms of the number of pupils who got into university...
examples.translation: 一所文法学校成功与否是以考上大学的学生人数为衡量依据的。

examples.text: It was difficult to measure the precise impact of the labor action.
examples.translation: 此次罢工影响几何，难以作出准确的评估。

examples.text: Measure the length and width of the gap...
examples.translation: 测量一下这条缝隙的长与宽。

examples.text: He measured the speed at which ultrasonic waves travel along the bone.
examples.translation: 他测出了超声波穿过骨头的速度。

examples.text: The house is more than twenty metres long and measures six metres in width...
examples.translation: 这座房子长20多米，宽6米。

examples.text: This hand-decorated plate measures 30cm across...
examples.translation: 这只手工绘制的盘子直径为30厘米。

examples.text: Their paddock measures 24 metres square.
examples.translation: 他们的围场为24米见方。

examples.text: With the exception of Juan, each attained a measure of success...
examples.translation: 除了胡安之外，每个人都获得了相当大的成功。

examples.text: The colonies were claiming a larger measure of self-government.
examples.translation: 殖民地正要求获得更大程度上的自治。

examples.text: It is a measure of their plight that few of them have anywhere to go to...
examples.translation: 他们几乎全都无处可归，看得出他们是陷入了困境。

examples.text: That is a measure of how bad things have become at the bank.
examples.translation: 那简直就是银行里糟糕局面的写照。

examples.text: The government warned that police would take tougher measures to contain the trouble...
examples.translation: 政府警告说，警方将采取更为强硬的措施来遏制动乱。

examples.text: He said stern measures would be taken against the killers...
examples.translation: 他说将会采取严厉措施惩罚凶手。

examples.text: As a precautionary measure repeat the medication.
examples.translation: 作为预防性措施，请重复用药。

examples.text: He poured himself another generous measure of malt.
examples.translation: 他又为自己倒了满满一大杯麦芽威士忌。

examples.text: ...a pub measure of spirits.
examples.translation: 一杯烈酒

examples.text: Mankind's knowledge of the universe has increased beyond measure...
examples.translation: 人类对于宇宙的了解已经大为增加。

examples.text: She irritated him beyond measure.
examples.translation: 她让他大为光火。

examples.text: I repeated my question for good measure...
examples.translation: 另外，我重复了我的问题。

examples.text: For good measure, a few details of hotels were included.
examples.translation: 除此之外还包括对宾馆的一些详细介绍。

examples.text: The governments of the industrialized world had failed to get the measure of the crisis...
examples.translation: 工业化国家的政府没能意识到这次危机的严重程度。

examples.text: Has he taken the measure of us and concluded that we're not willing to risk a life?...
examples.translation: 他有没有掂掂我们的分量，知道我们并不愿冒生命危险？

examples.text: Lili was the only person I knew who had the measure of her brother.
examples.translation: 在我认识的人中间，只有莉莉清楚她兄弟几斤几两。

examples.text: Power is in some measure an act of will...
examples.translation: 权力在某种程度上是意志的表现。

examples.text: In Britain, we have so far escaped, in large measure, either of these afflictions.
examples.translation: 在英国，我们迄今为止已经远远地避开了这两类麻烦。

meanings.meaning: 机械的；力学的；呆板的；无意识的；手工操作的

examples.text: ...a small mechanical device that taps out the numbers.
examples.translation: 能够输出数字的小型机械装置

examples.text: ...the oldest working mechanical clock in the world...
examples.translation: 世界上最古老的还在走动的机械钟

examples.text: Most mechanical devices require oil as a lubricant.
examples.translation: 绝大多数机械装置都需要用油作为润滑剂。

examples.text: The air was circulated mechanically.
examples.translation: 空气循环是靠机械驱动的。

examples.text: ...mechanical engineering...
examples.translation: 机械工程学

examples.text: The company undertakes mechanical work on all types of cars...
examples.translation: 该公司承接各类汽车的修理工作。

examples.text: The train had stopped due to a mechanical problem.
examples.translation: 火车因为机械故障停了下来。

examples.text: The car was mechanically sound, he decided.
examples.translation: 他断定，这辆车的机械性能非常可靠。

examples.text: He was a very mechanical person, who knew a lot about sound...
examples.translation: 他精通机械，了解许多有关声音的知识。

examples.text: I'm not mechanical like my father; I have to follow the instructions.
examples.translation: 我没有爸爸那么精通机械，所以得按说明书上说的去做。

examples.text: I'm not mechanically minded.
examples.translation: 我没有搞机械的头脑。

examples.text: It is real prayer, and not mechanical repetition...
examples.translation: 这是真正的祈祷，不是机械的重复。

examples.text: Many girls have a kind of mechanical attitude towards sex...
examples.translation: 许多女孩在性方面会有些率性而为。

examples.text: Her retort was mechanical.
examples.translation: 她的反驳是脱口而出的。

examples.text: He nodded mechanically, his eyes fixed on the girl.
examples.translation: 他机械地点点头，眼睛直勾勾地盯着那个姑娘。

examples.text: ...the locking mechanism...
examples.translation: 锁定装置

examples.translation: 炸弹由一个专门装置引爆。

examples.translation: 对违规的武器出口商实施惩罚尚无执行机制。

examples.text: ...the clumsy and ineffective mechanism of price controls.
examples.translation: 方法笨拙、效率低下的价格控制机制

examples.text: ...a survival mechanism, a means of coping with intolerable stress.
examples.translation: 一种生存机制，一种应对无法承受的压力的方法

examples.text: The silver medal went to Mike Day with the bronze to his fellow-American Donny Robinson.
Several police officers received medical treatment for cuts and bruises.
examples.translation: 几名警官因割伤和擦伤而接受了医治。

examples.translation: 医疗行业

examples.text: Therapists cannot prescribe drugs as they are not necessarily medically qualified.
examples.translation: 由于治疗师不一定具有行医资格，所以他们不可以开处方。

examples.text: He pursued a career in medicine...
examples.translation: 他从事医学。

examples.text: I was interested in alternative medicine and becoming an aromatherapist...
examples.translation: 我对替代疗法非常感兴趣，想做个芳香疗法治疗师。

examples.text: Psychiatry is an accepted branch of medicine.
examples.translation: 精神病学是公认的医学分支。

examples.text: People in hospitals are dying because of shortage of medicine.
examples.translation: 由于药品匮乏，医院里的病人濒临死亡。

examples.text: ...herbal medicines.
examples.translation: 草药

meanings.meaning: 中世纪的；原始的；仿中世纪的；老式的

examples.text: ...a medieval castle.
examples.translation: 中世纪城堡

examples.text: ...the medieval chroniclers.
examples.translation: 中世纪编年史家

examples.text: Many busy executives have begun to practice yoga and meditation.
examples.translation: 许多忙碌的主管开始练习瑜伽和冥想。

examples.text: Having chosen a meditation it is important that you stick to that meditation for, at the very least, a fortnight.
examples.translation: 选择了一种冥想方法后，至少要坚持练习两周时间，这一点非常重要。

examples.text: ...the man, lost in meditation, walking with slow steps along the shore...
examples.translation: 这名陷入沉思中的男子，沿着岸边慢慢地走着

examples.text: In his lonely meditations Antony had been forced to the conclusion that there had been rumours.
examples.translation: 独自静心想来，安东尼断定曾有流言蜚语。

examples.text: In fact, the entire novel is a long meditation on childbearing and mortality...
examples.translation: 实际上，整部小说就是一部关于生儿育女与道德伦理的长篇沉思录。

examples.text: The title track is a pointed meditation on a continent gone wrong.
examples.translation: 主打歌是对一个误入歧途的大陆的深刻沉思。

examples.text: He meditated on the problem...
examples.translation: 他仔细斟酌着这个问题。

examples.text: On the day her son began school, she meditated on the uncertainties of his future.
examples.translation: 儿子开始上学的那一天，她就在考虑他未来的种种不确定因素了。

examples.text: I was meditating, and reached a higher state of consciousness.
examples.translation: 我在冥想，并进入了一个更高的意识境界。

meanings.meaning: 中间的，中等的；半生熟的

examples.text: A medium dose produces severe nausea within hours...
examples.translation: 中等剂量几小时之内会引发严重的恶心。

examples.text: He was of medium height with blond hair and light blue eyes.
examples.translation: 他中等身材，金发碧眼。

examples.text: Foods that contain only medium levels of sodium are bread, cakes, milk, butter and margarine.
examples.translation: 含钠量仅为中等水平的食物有面包、蛋糕、牛奶、黄油和人造黄油。

examples.text: ...a sweetish, medium-strength beer.
examples.translation: 中度甜啤酒

examples.text: Cook under a medium-hot grill.
examples.translation: 在热度适中的烤架下烹制。

examples.text: Andrea has medium brown hair, grey eyes and very pale skin...
examples.translation: 安德烈娅有着深浅适中的棕发、灰色的眼睛和十分白皙的皮肤。

examples.text: When violet is added to the medium blue a particularly striking, warm coloration is created.
examples.translation: 在中蓝色中加入蓝紫色就形成了一种格外鲜艳夺目的暖色。

examples.text: In Sierra Leone, English is used as the medium of instruction for all primary education...
examples.translation: 在塞拉利昂，基础教育阶段全部用英语授课。

examples.text: But Artaud was increasingly dissatisfied with film as a medium.
examples.translation: 但是阿尔托对电影这种表现方式越来越不满。

examples.text: Blood is the medium in which oxygen is carried to all parts of the body...
examples.translation: 血液是将氧气输送到人体各个部位的媒介。

examples.text: Hyatt has found a way of creating these qualities using the more permanent medium of oil paint.
examples.translation: 海厄特已经找到产生这些特性的方法，那就是利用油彩这种更加持久的材料。

examples.text: I still aim to strike a happy medium between producing football that's worth watching and getting results...
examples.translation: 我仍致力于打造这样一种球风——既具观赏性，又能得分，两全其美。

examples.text: It's very difficult to strike a happy medium and make it right for everybody.
examples.translation: 找到皆大欢喜的折中办法颇有难度。

examples.text: Her voice was full of melody.
examples.translation: 她的声音非常悦耳。

meanings.meaning: 瓜；甜瓜；大肚子；圆鼓鼓像瓜似的东西

examples.text: They have bulbous melon heads, and their dorsal fin is located far forward on the body.
I have just met the man I want to spend the rest of my life with...
examples.translation: 我刚刚遇到了我想与之共度余生的男人。

examples.text: He's the kindest and sincerest person I've ever met...
examples.translation: 他是我所见过的最友善、最真诚的人。

examples.text: We met by chance.
examples.translation: 我们是偶然相遇的。

examples.text: When he was in the supermarket, he met up with a buddy he had at Oxford...
examples.translation: 他在超市遇见了他在牛津时的一个朋友。

examples.translation: 他们1956年相遇，那时他们俩都还是小男生。

examples.translation: 下班后我们可以见面喝上一杯。

examples.text: Meet me down at the beach tomorrow, at 6am sharp.
examples.translation: 明天早上6点整在海滩上跟我见面。

examples.text: We tend to meet up for lunch once a week...
examples.translation: 我们往往每周共进一次午餐。

examples.text: My intention was to have a holiday and meet up with old friends.
examples.translation: 我原本打算度个假，跟老朋友们见见面。

examples.text: Hey, Terry, come and meet my Dad.
examples.translation: 嗨，特里，过来认识一下我爸爸。

examples.translation: “珍妮弗，”马洛里小姐说，“这位是利·范沃林。”——“见到您很高兴，”珍妮弗说。

examples.text: I have to leave. Nice to have met you.
examples.translation: 我得走了。认识您很高兴。

examples.text: Mama met me at the station...
examples.translation: 妈妈在车站接我。

examples.text: Lili and my father met me off the boat...
examples.translation: 莉莉和我父亲在码头迎接我。

examples.text: Kurt's parents weren't able to meet our plane so we took a taxi.
examples.translation: 库尔特的父母无法来接机，于是我们打了车。

examples.text: Officials from the two countries will meet again soon to resume negotiations...
examples.translation: 两国官员不久将再度会晤以重启谈判。

examples.text: The commission met 14 times between 1988 and 1991.
examples.translation: 1988至1991年间，该委员会举行了14次会议。

examples.text: Most of the lawmakers who met with the president yesterday said they backed the mission.
examples.translation: 大多数昨天与总统会晤的立法者说他们支持这个行动。

examples.text: The idea met with a cool response from various quarters...
examples.translation: 这个想法遭到了各方人士的冷遇。

examples.text: We hope today's offer will meet with your approval too...
examples.translation: 我们希望今天的提议也能够得到您的首肯。

examples.text: Reagan's speech was met with incredulity in the US.
examples.translation: 里根的演讲在美国遭到了质疑。

examples.text: The current arrangements for the care of severely mentally ill people are inadequate to meet their needs...
examples.translation: 目前对严重精神病患者的护理安排不足以满足他们的需要。

examples.text: Out of the original 23,000 applications, 16,000 candidates meet the entry requirements.
examples.translation: 最初的2.3万份申请中有1.6万份满足入选的要求。

examples.text: British manufacturing failed to meet the crisis of the 1970s...
examples.translation: 英国制造业未能经受住20世纪70年代危机的考验。

examples.text: It is an enormous challenge but we hope to meet it within a year or 18 months...
examples.translation: 这是一个巨大的挑战，但是我们希望在1年或18个月之内能够战胜它。

examples.translation: 为了如期完成任务，他们拼命地工作。

examples.translation: 政府说将帮助支付损害造成的部分费用。

examples.text: As your income increases you will find less difficulty in finding the money to meet your monthly repayments.
examples.translation: 随着收入的增加，你会发现筹钱支付每月的还款没那么难了。

examples.text: I honestly don't know how I will react the next time I meet a potentially dangerous situation...
examples.translation: 我真不知道下次再碰上有潜在危险的情况时会作何反应。

examples.text: Never had she met such spite and pettiness.
examples.translation: 她从未遭遇过如此恶毒和狭隘的事情。

examples.text: Attempts to find civilian volunteers have met with embarrassing failure...
examples.translation: 寻找平民志愿者的种种尝试都遭遇了令人难堪的失败。

examples.translation: 为使俄罗斯太空项目走向商业化而作出的种种努力几乎没有取得什么成功。

examples.text: You sense the stresses in the hull each time the keel meets the ground...
examples.translation: 每次龙骨触地的时候你都能感受到船体所受的压力。

examples.text: Nick's head bent slowly over hers until their mouths met.
examples.translation: 尼克慢慢向她低下头去，直到他们的嘴唇碰在了一起。

examples.text: Nina's eyes met her sisters' across the table...
examples.translation: 尼娜与桌子对面的姐妹们目光相遇。

examples.text: I found myself smiling back instinctively when our eyes met.
examples.translation: 我发现当我们的目光相遇时，我本能地还以微笑。

examples.text: It is one of the rare places in the world where the desert meets the sea.
examples.translation: 世界上沙漠与大海相接的地方非常少见，这里就是一处。

examples.translation: 南美洲最南端、太平洋与大西洋的汇合处

examples.text: Parallel lines will never meet no matter how far extended...
examples.translation: 无论延伸多长，平行线永不相交。

examples.text: The track widened as it met the road.
examples.translation: 小路在和公路相交的地方变宽了。

examples.text: The two women will meet tomorrow in the final...
examples.translation: 这两位女选手将在明天的决赛里决一胜负。

examples.translation: 1781年3月15日，力量悬殊的两支队伍在吉尔福德狭路相逢。

examples.translation: 英格兰队上次在国际板球锦标赛中遭遇澳大利亚队时

examples.translation: 约翰·佩内尔在佛罗里达迈阿密的一次运动会上成为撑竿越过17英尺的第一人。

examples.translation: 他犹豫起来，然后摇摇头，避开了她的目光。

examples.translation: 雅各布·辛克莱在一名士兵的手里送了命。

examples.translation: 没有人知道他究竟是如何或在何处丢掉性命的。

examples.translation: 我们可以开会来讨论那件事吗？

examples.translation: 全体与会者认定有必要作出进一步努力。

examples.translation: 那是1月，在我们初次相遇37年之后，我和丹尼斯一同回到了工作室。

examples.translation: 她的生活因几年前同她以前的美术老师的偶遇改变了。

meanings.meaning: 使融化；使熔化；使软化；使感动

examples.text: The snow had melted, but the lake was still frozen solid...
examples.translation: 雪已经融化了，但是湖面上仍然冻得结结实实的。

examples.text: Meanwhile, melt the white chocolate in a bowl suspended over simmering water...
examples.translation: 同时，把碗置于微沸的水上，将白巧克力放入碗中使其熔化。

examples.text: Add the melted butter, molasses, salt, and flour.
examples.translation: 加入化开的黄油、糖浆、盐和面粉。

examples.text: His anxiety about the outcome melted, to return later but not yet...
examples.translation: 他对未知结果的焦虑消散了，这种焦虑过后还会袭上心头，但至少现在还没有。

examples.text: He would have struggled but his strength had melted.
examples.translation: 他本欲作一番挣扎，却已力不从心。

examples.text: When he heard these words, Shinran felt his inner doubts melt away.
examples.translation: 听到这番话，欣兰感到他内心的疑虑顿时消散了。

examples.text: The youths dispersed and melted into the darkness...
examples.translation: 年轻人散开了，消失在夜幕之中。

examples.text: The squadron's armour is draped in sand-coloured nets that melt into the landscape.
examples.translation: 装甲连的装甲车上罩着沙色的网，和周围的风景融为一体。

examples.text: When his lips break into a smile, it is enough to melt any woman's heart...
examples.translation: 他粲然一笑就足以让任何女人心软。

examples.text: When a bride walks down the aisle to a stirring tune, even the iciest of hearts melt.
examples.translation: 当新娘伴着激动人心的乐曲走在教堂的走廊上时，即便最冰冷的心都会融化。

examples.text: ...a tuna melt.
examples.translation: 金枪鱼奶酪三明治

examples.translation: 他拒绝说出所涉及员工的姓名。

examples.translation: 他们缺乏训练，这有可能会使民众面临风险。

examples.text: ...a sunflower or a similar member of the daisy family.
examples.translation: 向日葵或菊科植物中一种类似的植物

examples.translation: 银河系中央一个密集星团中最耀眼的几颗星

examples.translation: 会员的支持对于我们协会来说非常重要。

examples.translation: 英国是北大西洋公约组织的正式成员国。

examples.translation: 欧洲自由贸易联盟的成员国

examples.translation: 各成员国尽其所能的协作方式

examples.translation: 他当选为利兹市议员而进入了议会。

examples.translation: 以色列议会的议员戴维·马根

examples.translation: 加入教会青年团契促使她形成了自己的政治观点。

examples.translation: 近期党员人数的下降

meanings.meaning: 纪念碑，纪念馆；纪念仪式；纪念物

examples.translation: 为哥伦布建一座纪念碑是他一生的梦想。

examples.text: Every village had its war memorial.
examples.translation: 每座村庄都有自己的战争纪念碑。

examples.translation: 她的追悼会正在圣保罗教堂举行。

examples.translation: 发给驻扎本地的兵团的纪念章

examples.translation: 这个博物馆将用来纪念经过埃利斯岛的数百万移民。

examples.translation: 这座城市毫不妥协的荒凉面貌是对其神秘莫测的创建者的永久纪念。

examples.translation: 在我看来，你对公众是个祸害。

examples.translation: 法西斯主义的威胁

examples.translation: 过度饮酒是一种社会公害。

examples.translation: 肯沃西，你这人真讨厌，居然侵犯我的隐私。

examples.translation: 有一种危机四伏的感觉。

examples.text: ...a voice full of menace.
examples.translation: 充满威胁的声音

examples.translation: 欧洲国家仍具有威胁英国自身安全的潜在能力。

examples.translation: 她正受到姐姐最近一个男友的恐吓。

examples.text: All the details of the meeting are fresh in my memory...
examples.translation: 我对会议的所有细节都记忆犹新。

examples.text: He'd a good memory for faces, and he was sure he hadn't seen her before...
examples.translation: 他对别人的长相过目不忘，他确信自己以前没有见过她。

examples.text: But locals with long memories thought this was fair revenge for the injustice of 1961...
examples.translation: 可是，对以前的事记忆犹新的当地人却认为，这是对1961年那起非正义事件的正当复仇。

examples.text: Two major areas in which mentally retarded children require help are memory and attention.
examples.translation: 智障儿童主要是在记忆力和注意力这两方面需要帮助。

examples.text: She cannot bear to watch the film because of the bad memories it brings back...
examples.translation: 她看不了那部电影，因为它会勾起一些痛苦的回忆。

examples.text: Her earliest memory is of singing at the age of four to wounded soldiers...
examples.translation: 她最早的记忆是在4岁时为受伤的战士唱歌。

examples.text: He had happy memories of his father.
examples.translation: 他对父亲有着愉快的记忆。

examples.text: The data are stored in the computer's memory.
examples.translation: 资料存在计算机内存里。

examples.text: She remained devoted to his memory...
examples.translation: 她对他仍十分怀念。

examples.text: The congress opened with a minute's silence in memory of those who died in the struggle.
examples.translation: 代表大会开幕时进行了一分钟的默哀，以怀念在斗争中牺牲的人。

examples.text: Many members of the church sang from memory...
examples.translation: 许多教徒都是凭记忆唱颂歌。

examples.text: Children write down the word, cover it up and then try to spell it from memory.
examples.translation: 孩子们把这个词写下来蒙住，然后试着凭记忆拼出来。

examples.text: The floods are the worst in living memory...
examples.translation: 那次洪水是人们记忆中最严重的一次。

examples.text: No-one in living memory has come back from that place alive.
examples.translation: 在人们的记忆中，没有人从那个地方生还。

examples.text: His illness caused him to lose his memory.
examples.translation: 疾病使他失忆了。

examples.text: They took a long time to mend the roof...
examples.translation: 他们花了很长时间修缮屋顶。

examples.text: Somebody else lent me a pump and helped me mend the puncture...
examples.translation: 别人借给我一个打气筒，又帮我补好了轮胎。

examples.text: I should have had the catch mended, but never got round to it.
examples.translation: 我原本应该修好这个窗钩的，却一直没能抽出时间来。

examples.text: You'll mend. The X-rays show that your arm will heal all right...
examples.translation: 你会康复的。X光照片显示你的胳膊能够较好地复原。

examples.text: I'm feeling a good bit better. The cut aches, but it's mending...
examples.translation: 我感觉好多了。伤口很疼，但是正在愈合。

examples.text: He must have a major operation on his knee to mend severed ligaments.
examples.translation: 为了让他断裂的韧带愈合，他的膝盖必须动一次大手术。

examples.text: He sent Evans as his personal envoy to discuss ways to mend relations between the two countries...
examples.translation: 他派埃文斯以私人特使的身份前往商讨修复两国关系的途径。

examples.text: I felt that might well mend the rift between them.
examples.translation: 我觉得那样做也许可以让他们冰释前嫌。

examples.text: More evidence that the economy was on the mend was needed.
examples.translation: 需要更多证据来证明经济正在好转。

examples.text: The baby had been poorly but seemed on the mend.
examples.translation: 宝宝生病了，但似乎正在好起来。

examples.text: He has promised drastic disciplinary action if they do not mend their ways.
examples.translation: 如果他们不改邪归正的话，他保证一定严惩不贷。

examples.text: ...the mental development of children.
examples.translation: 儿童的智力发展

examples.text: ...intensive mental effort.
examples.translation: 高强度的脑力劳动

examples.text: I think you are mentally tired...
examples.translation: 我想你的脑子累了。

examples.text: I had never felt more mentally alive...
examples.translation: 我从未感到思维如此活跃。

examples.text: Physically I might not have been overseas but mentally and spiritually I was with them.
examples.translation: 虽然我人不在国外，可是从精神和心灵上，我和他们是在一起的。

examples.text: The mental state that had created her psychosis was no longer present.
examples.translation: 导致她精神失常的那种心理状态已经消失了。

examples.text: ...mental health problems.
examples.translation: 心理健康问题

examples.text: ...an inmate who is mentally disturbed.
examples.translation: 精神失常的囚犯

examples.text: ...the needs of the mentally ill and the mentally handicapped.
examples.translation: 精神病患者与智障人士的需要

examples.text: Practise mental arithmetic when you go out shopping...
examples.translation: 外出购物的时候练习一下心算。

examples.text: Graham made a quick mental calculation.
examples.translation: 格雷厄姆很快就心算出来了。

examples.text: This technique will help people mentally organize information.
examples.translation: 这项技术将帮助人们在脑子里组织信息。

examples.text: I just said to him 'you must be mental'.
examples.translation: 我刚才对他说：“你一定是疯了。”

examples.text: She made a mental note to have his prescription refilled.
examples.translation: 她记着要拿他的处方再配一回药。

examples.text: She made a mental note not to sit anywhere near him.
examples.translation: 她心里牢牢记着不坐在他的附近。

meanings.meaning: 提到，谈到；提及，论及；说起

examples.text: She did not mention her mother's absence...
examples.translation: 她并没有说起她母亲不在场的事。

examples.text: I may not have mentioned it to her...
examples.translation: 我可能没跟她提过这件事。

examples.text: I had mentioned that I didn't really like contemporary music...
examples.translation: 我说过，我其实并不喜欢当代音乐。

examples.text: She shouldn't have mentioned how heavy the dress was...
examples.translation: 她本不该说起这条裙子有多沉。

examples.text: I felt as though I should mention it as an option.
examples.translation: 我觉得我好像应该把它作为一种选择提出来。

examples.text: The statement made no mention of government casualties...
examples.translation: 声明里没有提及政府方面的伤亡情况。

examples.text: At the community centre, mention of funds produces pained looks.
examples.translation: 在社区中心一提到资金问题，大家就会愁眉不展。

examples.text: I was absolutely outraged that I could be even mentioned in an article of this kind...
examples.translation: 我大为恼火，我的名字居然出现在这种文章里面。

examples.text: As for your father, he won't be mentioned in my will.
examples.translation: 至于你父亲，我的遗嘱里不会提到他的名字。

examples.text: ...Brigadier Ferguson was mentioned in the report as being directly responsible.
examples.translation: 弗格森准将作为直接负责人在报道中被提及。

examples.text: His appointment is a complete surprise — he has never been mentioned as a front runner...
examples.translation: 他的任命完全出人意料——他从来都不是呼声最高的候选人。

examples.text: Her name has been mentioned as a favoured leadership candidate.
examples.translation: 提到她的名字时，说她是领导职位的热门候选人。

examples.text: So many people have helped me with this book that it is hard to pick out the few for special mention.
examples.translation: 帮助我完成本书的人数太多，难以从中选出几位特别致谢。

examples.text: 'Thank you very much.' — 'Don't mention it.'
examples.translation: “非常感谢！”——“别客气。”

examples.text: The audience, not to mention the bewildered cast, were not amused...
examples.translation: 观众们并没有觉得好笑，更不用说那些一头雾水的演员了。

examples.text: It was both deliberate and malicious, not to mention clever.
examples.translation: 这件事是处心积虑、早有预谋的，更不用说其手段的高明。

examples.text: A waiter offered him the menu...
examples.translation: 一个服务生给他送上了菜单。

examples.text: Even the most elaborate dishes on the menu were quite low on calories.
examples.translation: 这菜单上即便是制作最精美的菜品其热量也非常低。

examples.text: Try out the menu on a few friends...
examples.translation: 让几个朋友尝尝这道菜。

examples.text: The menu is all-important. Every component of every meal should create contrasts.
examples.translation: 饭菜的安排至关重要。每一顿饭的每一道菜都应该有所不同。

examples.text: In Washington, the Holocaust Memorial Museum has debated in the past, the issue of selling merchandise.
Any knowledgeable wine merchant would be able to advise you.
examples.translation: 任何一个懂行的葡萄酒商人都可以给你提出建议。

examples.text: The family was forced to live on credit from local merchants.
examples.translation: 这家人不得不靠向当地商人赊账生活。

examples.text: There's been a big reduction in the size of the British merchant fleet in recent years.
examples.translation: 近些年来英国商船队伍的规模大为缩减。

meanings.meaning: [化]汞，水银 [天]水星 温度表 精神，元气

examples.text: In 2005, he and his ensemble won Britain's most prestigious music award, the Mercury Prize.

meanings.meaning: 仁慈，宽容；怜悯；幸运；善行
(Mercy)人名；(英)默西，默茜(女名)；(法)梅西

examples.text: Neither side took prisoners or showed any mercy...
examples.translation: 双方都没有抓俘虏，也没有表现出丝毫的心慈手软。

examples.text: They cried for mercy but their pleas were met with abuse and laughter...
examples.translation: 他们哭喊着请求宽恕，可是他们的恳求却遭到了谩骂和嘲笑。

examples.text: May God have mercy on your soul.
examples.translation: 愿上帝宽恕你的灵魂。

examples.text: She vanished nine months ago while on a mercy mission to West Africa...
examples.translation: 9个月前她在去西非的慈善之旅中消失了。

examples.text: It's the first so-called mercy flight for a fortnight as the Americans have been waiting for enough people to fill a 747 jet.
examples.translation: 美国人一直在等人坐满一架747飞机，这便是第一次为期两周的所谓慈善飞行。

examples.text: It really was a mercy that he'd died so rapidly at the end...
examples.translation: 他最后去得那么快，真是谢天谢地。

examples.text: The two cars finished up in a run-off area, clear of the circuit, and that was a mercy.
examples.translation: 两辆车最后都停在了缓冲区，避开了赛车道，真是万幸。

examples.text: Buildings are left to decay at the mercy of vandals and the weather...
examples.translation: 建筑物因人为的肆意破坏及日晒雨淋而日益破败。

examples.text: The Emperor must realize that he has us at his mercy.
examples.translation: 皇帝必须意识到我们任由他处置。

examples.text: But so low has morale sunk that the team and the fans would have been grateful for small mercies.
examples.translation: 士气如此低沉，一丁点的好运都会让队员和球迷庆幸不已。

examples.text: He's going to throw himself on the mercy of the court.
examples.translation: 他准备听凭法庭发落。

examples.text: Mere does not have a comparative form. The superlative form merest is used to emphasize how small something is, rather than in comparisons.
examples.translation: mere 没有比较级，最高级 merest 并无比较之义，而是用来强调极其微小。

examples.text: There is more to good health than the mere absence of disease...
examples.translation: 身体健康不仅仅指不生病，还包括更多。

examples.text: In Poland, the faith has always meant more than mere religion...
examples.translation: 在波兰，信仰的含义向来不仅仅指宗教。

examples.text: She'd never received the merest hint of any communication from him.
examples.translation: 她从未得到他准备沟通的一丁点儿暗示。

examples.text: The mere mention of food had triggered off hunger pangs...
examples.translation: 单单提到食物就引起了阵阵饥饿感。

examples.text: Whenever there was a gap in the traffic the merest pressure on the accelerator was enough to close it...
examples.translation: 每当车流里出现了一点儿空距，只要稍稍一踩油门，空距就没有了。

examples.text: The team manager has been quick to clamp down on the merest hint of complacency.
examples.translation: 球队主教练很快就消除了自满的小苗头。

examples.text: Sixty per cent of teachers are women, but a mere 5 percent of women are heads and deputies...
examples.translation: 有60%的教师是女性，但是担任校长和副校长的女性仅占5%。

examples.text: Tickets are a mere £7.50 at the door...
examples.translation: 门口买票只要7.5英镑。

examples.text: For the past two decades, North Carolina taxed cigarettes at a mere 2 cents a packet.
examples.translation: 过去20年里，北卡罗来纳州的香烟税仅为每包2美分。

examples.text: Michael is now merely a good friend...
examples.translation: 迈克尔现在仅仅是个不错的朋友而已。

examples.text: Francis Watson was far from being merely a furniture expert...
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯·沃森远远不止是个家具行家。

examples.text: Merely because you believe a thing is right, it isn't automatically so...
examples.translation: 事情不会仅仅因为你相信它是对的，就会必然如此。

examples.text: They are offering merely technical assistance.
examples.translation: 他们仅仅是在提供技术援助。

examples.text: The brain accounts for merely three per cent of body weight.
examples.translation: 大脑仅占体重的3%。

examples.text: The team needs players who want to play cricket for England, not merely any country that will have them...
examples.translation: 球队需要的是想为英格兰而战的板球选手，而不是愿为任何国家打球的选手。

examples.text: His were not merely crimes of theft but of violence against elderly people.
examples.translation: 他所犯的不止是偷窃罪，而是针对老年人的暴力犯罪。

examples.text: My life merged with his...
examples.translation: 我和他的生活合而为一。

examples.text: Bank of America merged with a rival bank...
examples.translation: 美国银行与一家竞争银行合并了。

examples.text: The rivers merge just north of a vital irrigation system...
examples.translation: 就在一个重要的灌溉系统的北边，这些河流交汇在一起。

examples.text: The two countries merged into one...
examples.translation: 两国合而为一。

examples.text: He sees sense in merging the two agencies while both are new...
examples.translation: 他觉得将这两家建立不久的机构合而为一是明智的。

examples.text: Then he showed me how to merge the graphic with text on the same screen.
examples.translation: 然后他教我如何将图表和文字合并在同一个屏幕上。

examples.text: Like a chameleon, he could merge unobtrusively into the background...
examples.translation: 他就像一条变色龙，可以神不知鬼不觉地隐藏在背景中间。

examples.text: His features merged with the darkness...
examples.translation: 他的面容消失在黑暗之中。

examples.text: Night and day begin to merge.
examples.translation: 夜尽昼来。

examples.text: The argument seemed to have considerable merit...
examples.translation: 这个论点似乎颇有价值。

examples.text: Box-office success mattered more than artistic merit...
examples.translation: 票房上的成功比艺术价值更重要。

examples.text: Your feature has the merit of simply stating what has been achieved.
examples.translation: 你这篇专题文章的可取之处是简明扼要地道出了取得的成就。

examples.text: They have been persuaded of the merits of peace.
examples.translation: 他们被劝服，认识到了和平的好处。

examples.text: ...the technical merits of a film...
examples.translation: 一部电影技术上的长处

examples.text: It was obvious that, whatever its merits, their work would never be used.
examples.translation: 很明显，无论他们的作品有何优点都永远不会被采用。

examples.text: He said he had done nothing wrong to merit a criminal investigation...
examples.translation: 他说自己没有干坏事，不应该受到刑事调查。

examples.text: Such ideas merit careful consideration.
examples.translation: 这样的想法值得斟酌。

examples.text: Everybody is selected on merit...
examples.translation: 每个人都是凭个人才能入选的。

examples.text: Each case is judged on its merits.
examples.translation: 每个案件都是按照案件本身的特点判定的。

meanings.meaning: 愉快的；微醉的；嬉戏作乐的

examples.text: He was much loved for his merry nature...
examples.translation: 他快乐的天性很是招人喜欢。

examples.text: From the house come the bursts of merry laughter...
examples.translation: 房子里传出一阵阵欢乐的笑声。

examples.text: Merry black eyes glinted at them.
examples.translation: 闪烁着喜悦光芒的黑眼睛注视着他们。

examples.text: Chris threw back his head and laughed merrily.
examples.translation: 克里斯回过头，开心地笑了。

examples.text: ...the merry sounds of a seven-piece brass band...
examples.translation: 由7名乐手组成的铜管乐队演奏的悦耳乐声

examples.text: She was humming a merry little tune.
examples.translation: 她哼着一支动听的小曲。

examples.text: They went off to Glengarriff to get merry.
examples.translation: 他们到格伦加里夫去好好地喝上一杯。

examples.text: It hasn't stopped the British Navy proceeding on its merry way...
examples.translation: 这没有阻止英国海军继续得意扬扬地前进的步伐。

examples.text: In the merry world of American lawyers it is the simplest thing in the world to start an action.
examples.translation: 在无忧无虑的美国律师界，世上最简单的事情就是提出诉讼。

examples.text: Merry Christmas, everyone...
examples.translation: 祝大家圣诞快乐！

examples.text: I just wanted to wish you a merry Christmas...
examples.translation: 我只想祝福你圣诞快乐。

examples.text: A merry Christmas to all our readers.
examples.translation: 祝我们所有的读者圣诞快乐。

examples.text: Neighbours approached their boundaries from opposite sides and made merry together.
examples.translation: 邻居们从对面来到他们这边，一起尽情欢乐。

meanings.meaning: 混乱；食堂，伙食团；困境；脏乱的东西
把事情弄糟；制造脏乱；玩弄

examples.text: The house is a mess...
examples.translation: 屋里一片狼藉。

examples.text: The wrong shampoo can leave curly hair in a tangled mess...
examples.translation: 不合适的洗发水会使卷发纠结成乱糟糟的一团。

examples.text: Linda can't stand mess.
examples.translation: 琳达无法忍受脏乱。

examples.text: I've made such a mess of my life.
examples.translation: 我把自己的生活弄得一团糟。

examples.text: ...the many reasons why the economy is in such a mess...
examples.translation: 经济陷入如此困境的众多原因

examples.text: She'd got herself into a mess, of that he was certain.
examples.translation: 他肯定她已经让自己陷入了困境。

examples.text: Finally, making a dreadful mess, they devour the fruit...
examples.translation: 最后，他们狼吞虎咽地吃起了水果，果汁滴得到处都是。

examples.text: I'll clear up the mess later.
examples.translation: 我呆会儿会把滴落的水擦干净。

examples.text: ...a party at the officers' mess...
examples.translation: 在军官餐厅举行的聚会

examples.text: He hurried to the Mess to find the control officer.
examples.translation: 他匆忙赶到餐厅去找指挥官。

meanings.meaning: 消息；差使；启示；预言；广告词
报信，报告；[通信] 报文

examples.text: I got a message you were trying to reach me...
examples.translation: 我收到一条留言，说你想跟我联系。

examples.text: Would you like to leave a message?...
examples.translation: 您要留言吗？

examples.text: A message taped by the President was broadcast to US troops around the world.
examples.translation: 一条总统录音的口讯被播送给全世界的美国军队。

examples.text: The report's message was unequivocal...
examples.translation: 报告中传达的信息是明确的。

examples.text: I no longer want to stay friendly with her but I don't know how to get the message across...
examples.translation: 我再也不想和她做朋友了，但是又不知如何告诉她。

examples.text: I think they got the message that this is wrong.
examples.translation: 我认为他们已经得到了消息，知道这是错误的。

examples.text: People who message a lot feel unpopular if they don't get many back...
examples.translation: 如果人们发出大量短信但收到的回复却不多，就会觉得自己不受欢迎。

examples.text: She messaged him saying she wished they were together.
examples.translation: 她给他留言说希望跟他在一起。

examples.text: There will be a messenger at the Airport to collect the photographs from our courier...
examples.translation: 机场会有一名信使从我们的递送员手中取走照片。

examples.text: He gave the instruction for the document to be sent by messenger.
examples.translation: 他下令由通信员送出文件。

examples.text: ...pieces of furniture in wood, metal and glass...
examples.translation: 用木料、金属和玻璃制成的一件件家具

examples.text: He hit his head against a metal bar.
examples.translation: 他的头撞在一根金属棒上。

examples.text: ...the avoidance of 'violent expressions and metaphors' like 'kill two birds with one stone'.
examples.translation: 避免使用“有暴力意味的表达和隐喻”，例如“一石二鸟”

examples.text: ...the writer's use of metaphor.
examples.translation: 作者对隐喻的运用

examples.text: The divided family remains a powerful metaphor for a society that continued to tear itself apart.
examples.translation: 破碎的家庭仍旧是一个继续分崩离析的社会的有力象征。

examples.text: To mix yet more metaphors, you were trying to run before you could walk, and I've clipped your wings...
examples.translation: 混用更多的隐喻来说，你还没学会走就想跑，而我又剪掉了你的翅膀。

examples.text: Despite the mixed metaphor, there is some truth in this judgement.
examples.translation: 尽管有混用的比喻，这个判断还是有些道理的。

meanings.meaning: 使用体验派表演方法的

examples.text: The pill is the most efficient method of birth control.
examples.translation: 服用避孕药是最有效的避孕方法。

examples.text: ...new teaching methods...
examples.translation: 新式教学法

examples.text: The usual method of getting through the Amsterdam traffic is to cycle to your local railway station and take the train.
examples.translation: 克服阿姆斯特丹城市交通障碍的常用方法是骑自行车到附近的火车站乘火车。

examples.text: Chris Boardman won the Olympic 4,000 metres pursuit...
examples.translation: 克里斯·博德曼赢得了奥运会4,000米自行车追逐赛的冠军。

examples.text: The tunnel is 10 metres wide and 600 metres long.
examples.translation: 隧道宽10米，长600米。

examples.text: They must each compose a poem in strict alliterative metre...
examples.translation: 他们必须每人作一首严格押头韵的诗。

examples.text: All of the poems are written in traditional metres and rhyme schemes.
examples.translation: 所有的诗都按传统的韵律和韵脚而作。

examples.text: Around 180,000 metric tons of food aid is required...
examples.translation: 需要大约18万公吨的食品援助。

examples.text: Converting metric measurements to U.S. equivalents is easy.
examples.translation: 将公制计量单位换算为美制计量单位十分简单。

meanings.meaning: 大都市的；大主教辖区的；宗主国的
大城市人；大主教；宗主国的公民

examples.text: ...the metropolitan district of Miami.
examples.translation: 迈阿密的都市区

examples.text: ...a dozen major metropolitan hospitals.
examples.translation: 大城市的12家大医院

examples.text: ...metropolitan sophistication and rustic naivety.
examples.translation: 大城市的圆滑世故和乡村的天真纯朴

examples.text: ...the Ukrainian Catholic representatives, Metropolitan Volodymyr and Bishop Sofron.
examples.translation: 乌克兰的天主教代表——弗拉基米尔大主教和索夫龙主教

examples.text: It also has a microphone and speakers, through which the operator both listens and speaks.
The media put their every decision under the microscope.
examples.translation: 媒体仔细研究了他们的每一个决定。

meanings.meaning: 中间的，中部的；中级的，中等的

examples.text: Howard stood in the middle of the room sipping a cup of coffee...
examples.translation: 霍华德站在房间中央，小口抿着一杯咖啡。

examples.text: Hyde accelerated away from the kerb, swerving out into the middle of the street...
examples.translation: 海德加速驶离路边，突然向街道中央一个急转弯。

examples.text: I was in the middle of the back row...
examples.translation: 我在后排的中间。

examples.text: Make sure the roast potatoes aren't raw in the middle.
examples.translation: 要确保这些烤土豆不夹生。

examples.text: The middle button of his uniform jacket was strained over his belly.
examples.translation: 制服上装中间的纽扣在他的肚子上绷得紧紧的。

examples.text: ...the middle finger of her left hand.
examples.translation: 她左手的中指

examples.text: At age fifty-three, he now has a few extra pounds around his middle...
examples.translation: 53岁的他腰间长了几磅赘肉。

examples.text: The cook's apron covered her middle.
examples.translation: 厨用围裙裹着她的腰部。

examples.text: I woke up in the middle of the night and could hear a tapping on the window...
examples.translation: 我半夜里醒来，听见有敲窗户的声音。

examples.text: It was now the middle of November, cold and often foggy...
examples.translation: 现在是11月中旬，天气寒冷而且经常有雾。

examples.text: By the middle of 1979, Jimmy Carter was in serious political trouble...
examples.translation: 1979年中期，吉米·卡特陷入了严重的政治困境。

examples.text: She was born in the middle of a rain storm.
examples.translation: 她出生在一场暴风雨中。

examples.text: The month began and ended quite dry, but the middle fortnight saw nearly 100mm of rain fall nationwide.
examples.translation: 本月月初和月末颇为干燥， 不过中旬的两周全国有将近100毫米的降水。

examples.text: She knew he was in his middle fifties, although he looked much younger...
examples.translation: 尽管他看上去年轻得多，她知道他在55岁左右。

examples.text: I went on competing till I was in my middle forties.
examples.translation: 我继续参赛，直到45岁左右。

examples.text: His middle son died in a drowning accident five years back.
examples.translation: 他排行居中的那个儿子5年前意外溺水身亡。

examples.text: He favoured a middle course between free enterprise and state intervention...
examples.translation: 他更倾向于在自由经营与国家干预之间走一条中庸之道。

examples.text: The Mayor of Jerusalem has tried to minimise conflict by maintaining a middle way between the various religions.
examples.translation: 耶路撒冷市市长对各宗教采取折中的态度，力图使冲突最小化。

examples.text: They agreed to split the bill down the middle...
examples.translation: 他们同意均摊费用。

examples.text: If the conservatives are not removed, then the party will almost certainly split down the middle.
examples.translation: 如果不除掉保守势力，那么这个党几乎肯定会分裂成两派。

examples.text: It's a bit hectic. I'm in the middle of cooking for nine people...
examples.translation: 我正忙着为9个人做饭呢，有点儿忙不过来。

examples.text: He was always in the middle of a business transaction.
examples.translation: 他总是忙着做生意。

examples.text: Congress is in the midst of rewriting the nation's banking laws...
examples.translation: 国会正在修订国家银行法规。

examples.text: We are in the midst of one of the worst recessions for many, many years.
examples.translation: 我们正处在多年来最严重的一次经济衰退之中。

examples.text: Eleanor arrived in the midst of a blizzard.
examples.translation: 埃莉诺在暴风雪大作时到达。

examples.text: Many were surprised to see him exposed like this in the midst of a large crowd...
examples.translation: 许多人看到他像这样暴露在一大群人中间都非常吃惊。

examples.text: Angelo laid the gun carefully on the table, in the midst of brochures and other papers.
examples.translation: 安杰洛小心翼翼地把枪放在桌上的一堆手册和文件中间。

examples.text: We're lucky to have such a man in our midst.
examples.translation: 在我们中间有这样一个人是我们的幸运。

meanings.meaning: 可以；或许（may的过去式）；应该

examples.text: Smoking might be banned totally in most buildings...
examples.translation: 绝大多数建筑中可能会全面禁止吸烟。

examples.text: The two countries might go to war...
examples.translation: 两国有可能交战。

examples.text: I might well regret it later...
examples.translation: 我很可能以后会对此后悔的。

examples.text: He said he might not be back until tonight.
examples.translation: 他说他有可能要到今晚才回来。

examples.text: She and Simon's father had not given up hope that he might be alive...
examples.translation: 她和西蒙的父亲还没有放弃他或许还活着的希望。

examples.text: You might be right...
examples.translation: 你或许是对的。

examples.text: They haven't seen each other for five years; he might not be interested in her any more.
examples.translation: 他们已经5年没有见面了。他或许对她不再感兴趣了。

examples.text: ...a suit that looks as though it might contain polyester.
examples.translation: 一套看上去似乎含有涤纶成分的西装

examples.text: America might sell more cars to the islands if they were made with the steering wheel on the right.
examples.translation: 如果制造的汽车方向盘是装在右边的，美国可能会在这些岛屿卖出更多的汽车。

examples.text: ...the type of person who might appear in a fashion magazine.
examples.translation: 那种可能会登上时装杂志的人

examples.text: I heard what might have been an explosion...
examples.translation: 我听见了一声巨响，可能是爆炸声。

examples.text: She thought the shooting might have been an accident...
examples.translation: 她想这次枪击可能是一次意外。

examples.text: The equipment needed to clean up the spill might not have arrived yet...
examples.translation: 清理漏油所需要的设备可能还没有送到。

examples.text: The letters might not have been meant for me at all.
examples.translation: 这些信件可能原本就不是写给我的。

examples.text: If she had had to give up riding she might have taken up sailing competitively...
examples.translation: 如果她当时不得不放弃骑自行车的话，她或许就从事她很有优势的帆船运动了。

examples.text: Had the bomb dropped over a populated area of the city, there might have been a great deal of damage...
examples.translation: 如果炸弹投在了该市人口密集的地区，那损失就大了。

examples.text: The report might have been better written...
examples.translation: 这份报告本来可以写得更好。

examples.text: I didn't give my name because if I did I thought you might not have come.
examples.translation: 我没有留下我的名字，因为如果我这么做的话，我想你可能就不会来了。

examples.text: He might be a bore, but he was as quick-witted as a weasel...
examples.translation: 他也许是个很无聊的人，可是却像黄鼠狼一样机灵。

examples.text: They might not have two cents to rub together, but at least they have a kind of lifestyle that is different.
examples.translation: 他们也许穷得叮当响，但他们至少拥有一种不同的生活方式。

examples.text: And while I'm out you might clean up the kitchen...
examples.translation: 我不在的时候，你打扫一下厨房总该可以吧。

examples.text: You might have told me that before!
examples.translation: 你之前应该告诉我那件事情！

examples.text: They might be wise to stop advertising on television...
examples.translation: 他们不妨停止在电视上做广告，这样做可能是明智之举。

examples.text: You might try the gas station down the street...
examples.translation: 你可以到街那头的加油站试试。

examples.text: You might want to consider cycling...
examples.translation: 你或许可以考虑骑自行车。

examples.text: I was just wondering if you might like to go feed the cat...
examples.translation: 不知道你是否愿意去喂那只猫。

examples.text: I thought we might go for a drive on Sunday...
examples.translation: 我想星期天我们可以开车去兜风。

examples.text: It might be a good idea to tell your husband.
examples.translation: 告诉你的丈夫不失为上策。

examples.text: Might I make a suggestion?...
examples.translation: 我能否提个建议？

examples.text: Might I ask what you're doing here?...
examples.translation: 我可不可以问一下，您在这里干什么？

examples.text: Might I trouble you for a drop more tea?...
examples.translation: 能否麻烦您再添一点茶？

examples.text: I was wondering if I might talk to you for a moment...
examples.translation: 不知道我能否跟您谈一会。

examples.text: Might I draw your readers' attention to the dangers in the Government's proposal.
examples.translation: 请各位在阅读时注意一下政府提案中的风险。

examples.text: 'How's Jan?' she asked. — 'Bad. As you might expect.'...
examples.translation: “简怎么样？”她问道。——“如你所料，情况不好。”

examples.text: The drivers, as you might imagine, didn't care much for that.
examples.translation: 和想象中的一样，这些司机对此并不太在意。

examples.text: Relatives ring up constantly, not always for the best motives, I might add...
examples.translation: 亲戚们不断打电话过来，不客气地说，他们并非全都出于最好的动机。

examples.text: It didn't come as a great surprise to me, I might say.
examples.translation: 可以这么说，这并没有令我大吃一惊。

examples.text: I might have known I'd find you with some little slut...
examples.translation: 我早该知道你会跟哪个小娼妇在一起。

examples.text: 'I detest clutter, you know.' — 'I didn't know, but I might have guessed.'
examples.translation: “我特别厌恶杂乱无章，你是知道的。”——“我可不知道，不过我早该猜到了。”

examples.text: The might of the army could prove a decisive factor.
examples.translation: 军事力量可能会成为决定性的因素。

examples.text: She swung the hammer at his head with all her might.
examples.translation: 她使出全身力气抡起榔头砸向他的脑袋。

meanings.meaning: 移动；随季节而移居；移往

examples.text: People migrate to cities like Jakarta in search of work...
examples.translation: 人们为找工作而迁移到雅加达这类城市里。

examples.text: Farmers have learned that they have to migrate if they want to survive.
examples.translation: 农民们已经认识到，想要生存就必须外出打工。
