examples.translation: 曾收藏有一批精美的马赛克镶嵌画的罗马别墅

examples.text: He has used a mixture of mosaic, collage and felt-tip pen.
examples.translation: 他混合使用了马赛克、拼贴画和毡头笔。

examples.text: I am working with mostly highly motivated people...
examples.translation: 和我共事的人大多积极性极高。

examples.text: Cars are mostly metal.
examples.translation: 轿车的大部分部件是金属制造的。

examples.text: ...men and women, mostly in their 30s...
examples.translation: 大多为30多岁的男男女女

examples.text: Her own twelve pictures sold fairly well, mostly to friends and family...
examples.translation: 她自己的12幅画卖得相当好，多半卖给了朋友和家人。

examples.text: They have mostly invested their money in expensive real estate.
examples.translation: 他们已把钱主要投资到昂贵的房地产业了。

meanings.meaning: 大部分的，多数的；最多的

examples.text: Most is often considered to be the superlative form of much and many.
examples.translation: most 常被认为是 much 和 many 的最高级。

examples.text: By stopping smoking you are undoing most of the damage smoking has caused...
examples.translation: 通过戒烟可以消除吸烟造成的大部分危害。

examples.text: Sadly, most of the house was destroyed by fire in 1828.
examples.translation: 遗憾的是，这座房屋在1828年的火灾中大部分被烧毁。

examples.text: Most people think the Queen has done a good job over the last 50 years...
examples.translation: 多数人认为女王在过去50年间的表现令人满意。

examples.text: Most companies are looking to sponsor students on specific courses.
examples.translation: 大部分公司在寻求机会资助学习某些特定课程的学生。

examples.text: Seventeen civilians were hurt. Most are students who had been attending a twenty-first birthday party...
examples.translation: 17名平民受伤，大部分是学生，在参加一个21岁生日聚会。

examples.text: All of the rooms have private baths, and most have radios and TV.
examples.translation: 所有房间都自带浴室，大部分房间有收音机和电视机。

examples.text: The President himself won the most votes...
examples.translation: 总统本人获得最多选票。

examples.text: The skippers get the most money, and after them the cooks...
examples.translation: 船长拿到的钱最多，其次是厨师。

examples.text: Tom had the most authority of all.
examples.translation: 汤姆在所有人中威信最高。

examples.text: The most they earn in a day is ten roubles.
examples.translation: 他们每天最多挣10卢布。

examples.text: What she feared most was becoming like her mother...
examples.translation: 她最怕的就是变得像她妈妈那样。

examples.text: What they wanted most from the president was a leader who at least would try to educate the country.
examples.translation: 他们对总统最大的期待是，至少他应尽力教诲国民。

examples.text: ...Professor Morris, the person he most hated.
examples.translation: 莫里斯教授，他最憎恶的人

examples.text: She said she wanted most of all to be fair.
examples.translation: 她说她最想要的是公平。

examples.text: Her children had the best, most elaborate birthday parties in the neighborhood...
examples.translation: 她的孩子们的生日聚会在街坊四邻里是最好、最讲究的。

examples.text: He was one of the most influential performers of modern jazz...
examples.translation: 他是现代爵士乐最有影响力的表演者之一。

examples.text: If anything, swimming will appeal to her most strongly...
examples.translation: 如果说有什么能强烈地吸引她，那就是游泳了。

examples.text: Keeping pace with the litter during summer, when the park is most heavily used, is also a huge task.
examples.translation: 夏季公园游人最多的时候，及时清扫废弃物也是一项艰巨的任务。

examples.text: ...the most junior of the New York Times music critics.
examples.translation: 《纽约时报》最年轻的乐评人

examples.text: What question are you asked the most?...
examples.translation: 你们被问及最多的问题是什么？

examples.text: Inevitably those who suffer the most are the mothers and children...
examples.translation: 妇女和儿童必然是最遭罪的。

examples.text: Among the subjects for which the pass rate has risen the most are art and design, business studies, and music.
examples.translation: 及格率提高最多的科目是艺术设计、商业研究和音乐。

examples.text: Most surprisingly, quite a few said they don't intend to vote at all...
examples.translation: 最让人吃惊的是，相当多的人说他们根本不打算参加投票。

examples.text: Most interestingly, they are demanding that a national working party on crimes against women and children be established.
examples.translation: 最令人关注的是，他们要求针对侵害妇女和儿童的犯罪成立全国专案组。

examples.text: I'll be most pleased to speak to them...
examples.translation: 能跟他们谈谈我会十分高兴。

examples.text: I believe he is most painfully anxious about Diana.
examples.translation: 我相信他肯定非常担心黛安娜。

examples.text: Poach the pears in apple juice for perhaps ten minutes at most.
examples.translation: 把梨放入苹果汁中，最多煮10分钟左右。

examples.text: ...staying on at school for two extra years to study only three, or at the most four subjects...
examples.translation: 在学校再多呆两年学习仅仅三门、至多四门课程

examples.text: Many companies are expecting flat sales or at most a 1 to 2 percent increase over last year.
examples.translation: 很多公司预计销售不会有大的起色，或者最多比去年增多1%或2%。

examples.text: Happiness is the ability to make the most of what you have...
examples.translation: 幸福就是有能力充分享受你拥有的一切。

examples.text: Making the most of your hair means getting the cut and shape right.
examples.translation: 让头发达到最佳效果意味着要修剪得当，并选择合适的发型。

examples.text: His family is staying at a motel as long as they can afford it.

meanings.meaning: 母亲；大娘；女修道院院长
生下；养育；像母亲般关怀或照管

examples.text: She sat on the edge of her mother's bed...
examples.translation: 她坐在母亲床边。

examples.text: She's an English teacher and a mother of two children...
examples.translation: 她是英语教师，还是两个孩子的母亲。

examples.text: Mother and child form a close attachment...
examples.translation: 母子情深。

examples.text: I'm here, Mother.
examples.translation: 我在这儿呢，妈妈。

examples.text: Colleen had dreamed of mothering a large family.
examples.translation: 科琳曾梦想抚养一群孩子。

examples.text: The reality of mothering is frequently very different from the romantic ideal.
examples.translation: 养育孩子的现实经常与浪漫的理想大相径庭。

examples.text: She felt a great need to mother him...
examples.translation: 她迫切地感到要细心照料他。

examples.text: Stop mothering me.
examples.translation: 别再宠我了。

meanings.meaning: 动作；移动；手势；请求；意向

examples.text: ...the laws governing light, sound, and motion...
examples.translation: 有关声、光和运动的定律

examples.text: One group of muscles sets the next group in motion...
examples.translation: 一组肌肉带动下一组肌肉运动。

examples.text: The wind from the car's motion whipped her hair around her head.
examples.translation: 汽车驶过带起的风吹乱了她的头发。

examples.text: Cover each part of the body with long sweeping strokes or circular motions...
examples.translation: 对全身每个部位画长弧线轻抚或做圆圈状按摩。

examples.text: He made a neat chopping motion with his hand.
examples.translation: 他挥手做了一个干净利落的劈砍的动作。

examples.text: The conference is now debating the motion and will vote on it shortly...
examples.translation: 大会正在就提议进行辩论，稍后将就此表决。

examples.text: Opposition parties are likely to bring a no-confidence motion against the government...
examples.translation: 反对党很可能提出对政府的不信任案。

examples.text: He is eligible now to file a motion for a new trial.
examples.translation: 他现在有资格提议重新进行审判。

examples.text: She motioned for the locked front doors to be opened...
examples.translation: 她示意把锁着的前门打开。

examples.text: He stood aside and motioned Don to the door...
examples.translation: 他站到一边并示意唐到门口去。

examples.text: I motioned him to join us...
examples.translation: 我示意他加入到我们的队伍中来。

examples.text: He motioned to her to go behind the screen.
examples.translation: 他示意她走到屏风后面。

examples.text: Try to make sure your bowel motions are regular and that you avoid any constipation.
examples.translation: 尽量保证大便规律，避免便秘。

examples.text: 'You really don't care, do you?' she said quietly. 'You're just going through the motions.'
examples.translation: “你其实不在意，对不对？”她悄声说，“你就是装装样子而已。”

examples.text: The sailor went through all the motions smartly...
examples.translation: 这个水手机灵地走了走过场。

examples.text: Actors go through the motions of different types of labor.
examples.translation: 演员们假装从事不同的劳动。

examples.text: His job as England manager begins in earnest now his World Cup campaign is in motion...
examples.translation: 现在世界杯足球赛的征战工作已经展开，而他作为英格兰队主教练的工作也真正开始了。

examples.text: Her sharp, aggressive tone set in motion the events that led to her downfall.
examples.translation: 她那咄咄逼人的尖锐语调拉开了导致她垮台的事件的序幕。

examples.text: I have set the wheels in motion to sell Endsleigh Court.
examples.translation: 我已着手出售恩德斯勒公馆。

meanings.meaning: 刺激；使有动机；激发…的积极性

examples.text: They are motivated by a need to achieve...
examples.translation: 对成功的渴望激励着他们。

examples.text: The crime was not politically motivated...
examples.translation: 该犯罪行为没有政治动机。

examples.text: I don't want to be missing out. And that motivates me to get up and do something every day.
examples.translation: 我不想被落下。这促使我行动起来每天做点事。

examples.text: ...highly motivated employees.
examples.translation: 积极性很高的雇员

examples.text: His poor performance may be attributed to lack of motivation rather than to reading difficulties.
examples.translation: 他糟糕的表现也许要归因于缺乏积极性，而不是阅读障碍。

examples.text: How do you motivate people to work hard and efficiently?...
examples.translation: 你是怎样激励大家奋发高效地工作的？

examples.text: Never let it be said that the manager doesn't know how to motivate his players.
examples.translation: 绝对不要让人说这位主教练不知道如何激励他的队员。

examples.text: Gross's skill in motivation looked in doubt when his side began the second half badly.
examples.translation: 球队下半场开局不利，看来格洛斯给队员鼓劲的技巧值得怀疑。

examples.text: Police have ruled out robbery as a motive for the killing.
examples.translation: 警方已排除因抢劫而杀人的可能。

examples.text: ...the motives and objectives of British foreign policy...
examples.translation: 英国外交政策的动机和目标

examples.text: The doctor's motive was to bring an end to his patient's suffering.
examples.translation: 医生的初衷是终止患者的痛苦。

examples.text: She got in and started the motor.
examples.translation: 她坐上车，发动了引擎。

examples.text: Theft of motor vehicles is up by 15.9%.
examples.translation: 机动车辆偷盗案上升了15.9%。

examples.text: ...the future of the British motor industry...
examples.translation: 英国汽车工业的未来

examples.text: He worked as a motor mechanic.
examples.translation: 他是一名汽车修理工。

examples.text: I had motored down from Cheshire.
examples.translation: 我从柴郡一路南下开过来。

examples.text: Restarting the engine, we motored downriver.
examples.translation: 我们重新启动马达，沿河而下。

examples.text: Ben Nevis, in Scotland, is Britain's highest mountain.
examples.translation: 苏格兰境内的本尼维斯山是英国最高的山。

examples.text: ...a lovely little mountain village.
examples.translation: 怡人的小山村

examples.text: They are faced with a mountain of bureaucracy...
examples.translation: 他们面对一大堆繁文缛节。

examples.text: They have mountains of coffee to sell.
examples.translation: 他们有大量的咖啡要卖。

examples.text: 'We had a mountain to climb after the second goal went in,' said Crosby.
examples.translation: 克罗斯比说：“进第二个球之后，我们面临着严峻的挑战。”

examples.text: Joan still mourns her father...
examples.translation: 琼仍在为父亲的死伤心。

examples.text: The whole nation had mourned the death of their great leader...
examples.translation: 举国向去世的伟大领袖表示了深深的哀悼。

examples.text: He mourned for his valiant men...
examples.translation: 他向他的勇士们致哀。

examples.text: As the nation continued to mourn, the new President of South Africa paid his own tribute.
examples.translation: 举国仍在哀悼之际，南非新任总统也表达了自己的怀念之情。

examples.text: We mourned the loss of our cities...
examples.translation: 我们为失去多座城市而痛心。

examples.text: She mourned for the beloved past.
examples.translation: 她怀念美好的过去。

examples.text: Spoon the mixture carefully into the mould...
examples.translation: 用勺小心地把混合物舀起，倒入模具内。

examples.text: The moulds for the foundry are made in the tool-room area.
examples.translation: 铸造车间的模具是在工具间生产的。

examples.text: ...jelly moulds.
examples.translation: 果冻模具

examples.text: At first sight, Joe Pesci is not exactly cast in the leading man mould...
examples.translation: 第一眼看上去，乔·佩希并不是当领袖的料。

examples.text: He was from the same mould as the men she had gazed at worshipfully when a child: rich, handsome, of impeccable social standing.
examples.translation: 他富有、英俊，有无可挑剔的社会地位，是她孩提时就仰慕的那种男人。

examples.text: Memorial services have become tedious and expected. I would like to help break the mould...
examples.translation: 纪念仪式已变得令人生厌且毫无新意，我想为打破这种既有模式做点什么。

examples.text: When they first started, they said they were going to break the mould of British politics.
examples.translation: 刚开始时他们说他们将打破英国政治的原有格局。

examples.text: Using 2 spoons, mould the cheese mixture into small balls or ovals...
examples.translation: 用两把小匙将奶酪混合物塑成圆球或椭圆球形状。

examples.text: Before we left the camp, my twin brother and I moulded a chair out of mud.
examples.translation: 离开营地前，我和孪生弟弟用泥巴做了一把椅子。

examples.text: She was only 17 at the time and the experience moulded her personality...
examples.translation: 那时她只有17岁，那次经历影响了她的性格。

examples.text: Here we outline some of the sometimes conflicting forces moulding the debate...
examples.translation: 在此我们概述一些有时影响争论的相互对立的力量。

examples.text: Too often we try to mold our children into something they do not wish to be.
examples.translation: 我们常常试图把孩子塑造成他们自己不想成为的样子。

examples.text: You need a malleable pillow that will mould to the curves of your neck...
examples.translation: 你需要一个柔韧性好、能与你的颈椎弯曲弧度相吻合的枕头。

examples.text: She stood there, the wind moulding the dress around her.
examples.translation: 她站在那儿，风把套裙吹得紧紧裹在身上。

meanings.meaning: 鼠标；老鼠；胆小羞怯的人

examples.text: The plural mouses can be used for meaning 2.
examples.translation: 复数 mouses 可用于义项2。

examples.text: ...the problem of rats and mice.
examples.translation: 鼠患

meanings.meaning: 增加；爬上；使骑上马；安装，架置；镶嵌，嵌入；准备上演；成立（军队等）
山峰；底座；乘骑用马；攀，登；运载工具；底座

examples.text: The ANC announced it was mounting a major campaign of mass political protests.
examples.translation: 非洲人国民大会宣布他们正在开展一次大规模政治抗议活动。

examples.text: ...a security operation mounted by the army.
examples.translation: 军队开展的维护安全军事行动

examples.text: For several hours, tension mounted...
examples.translation: 有几个小时，紧张局势有所加剧。

examples.text: The decibel level was mounting...
examples.translation: 噪音在增强。

examples.text: There was mounting concern in her voice.
examples.translation: 她的声音里流露出越来越多的担心。

examples.text: ...the mounting heat of the stadium.
examples.translation: 体育场不断上升的热度

examples.text: The uncollected garbage mounts in city streets...
examples.translation: 未收的垃圾在市区街道上越积越多。

examples.text: He ignored his mounting debts.
examples.translation: 他对日益增加的债务置之不理。

examples.text: If you hide away your problems and pretend that they don't exist they will just continue to mount up...
examples.translation: 如果你把问题藏起来，假装它们不存在，问题只会越积越多。

examples.text: Her medical bills mounted up.
examples.translation: 她的医疗费不断增加。

examples.text: Llewelyn was mounting the stairs up into the keep...
examples.translation: 卢埃林登上台阶，走进城堡主楼。

examples.text: The vehicle mounted the pavement.
examples.translation: 机动车开上了人行道。

examples.text: He mounted his horse and rode away...
examples.translation: 他骑上马走了。

examples.text: A man in a crash helmet was mounting a motorbike...
examples.translation: 一位戴头盔的男子正跨上摩托车。

examples.text: He went to the small stable where his horse was, harnessed it, mounted, and rode out to the beach.
examples.translation: 他走进拴马的小马厩，套上马具，骑上马奔向海滩。

examples.text: ...the number of owners who care for older mounts.
examples.translation: 愿意照料老马的马主的数量

examples.text: Her husband mounts the work on velour paper and makes the frame...
examples.translation: 她丈夫把作品装裱在绒纸上，并制作了画框。

examples.text: The support for the fence is mounted on an extension to the table.
examples.translation: 篱笆的支撑部分安装在桌子延长出的地方。

examples.text: ...a specially mounted horse shoe.
examples.translation: 特别安装的马蹄铁

examples.text: ...a wall-mounted electric fan.
examples.translation: 安装在墙上的电扇

examples.text: ...pickup trucks with side-mounted fuel tanks.
examples.translation: 油箱置于侧面的轻型货车

examples.text: The gallery has mounted an exhibition of art by Irish women painters.
examples.translation: 画廊已举办了一场爱尔兰女画家的作品展。

examples.text: ...Mount Kilimanjaro.
examples.translation: 乞力马扎罗山

meanings.meaning: 做作地说，装腔作势地说；喃喃地说出

examples.text: She clamped her hand against her mouth...
examples.translation: 她用手捂着嘴。

examples.text: His mouth was full of peas.
examples.translation: 他满嘴都是豌豆。

examples.text: ...an inflammation of the mouth.
examples.translation: 口腔发炎

examples.text: He straightened up and looked at me, open-mouthed.
examples.translation: 他直起身，目瞪口呆地看着我。

examples.text: ...a wide-mouthed, gray-haired policeman.
examples.translation: 大嘴巴、灰头发的警察

examples.text: I've always had a loud mouth, I refuse to be silenced...
examples.translation: 我一贯大声说出自己的想法，不会迫于压力而一言不发。

examples.text: You've got such a crude mouth!
examples.translation: 你说话真粗鲁！

examples.text: ...Simon, their smart-mouthed teenage son.
examples.translation: 西蒙，他们十几岁的儿子，口齿伶俐

examples.text: ...mean-mouthed heavies with the sly sadistic eyes of professional bullies.
examples.translation: 满嘴秽言的打手，有着职业恶棍狡诈、恶毒的眼神

examples.text: By the mouth of the tunnel he bent to retie his lace.
examples.translation: 到隧道出入口时，他弯腰重新系好鞋带。

examples.text: He put the flowers in a wide-mouthed blue vase.
examples.translation: 他把花放进蓝色阔口花瓶里。

examples.text: ...the town at the mouth of the River Dart.
examples.translation: 位于达特河入海口的城镇

examples.text: I mouthed a goodbye and hurried in behind Momma...
examples.translation: 我用口型默示告别，然后匆匆跟在妈妈身后走了进去。

examples.text: She winked broadly at him and silently mouthed something...
examples.translation: 她使劲冲他使眼色，不出声地对他说了些什么。

examples.text: 'It's for you,' he mouthed.
examples.translation: 他用口型示意：“这是给你的。”

examples.text: I mouthed some sympathetic platitudes...
examples.translation: 我言不由衷地说了一些表示同情的客套话。

examples.text: They mouthed the values of family, religion and charity, but demonstrated the opposite in their private lives.
examples.translation: 他们大谈家庭、宗教和慈善的价值，但他们在个人生活中的表现却恰恰相反。

examples.text: He had to feed his family on the equivalent of four hundred pounds a month and, with five mouths to feed, he found this very hard.
examples.translation: 他要用相当于400英镑的月收入来维持五口之家的生计，感觉很艰难。

examples.text: Sometimes I hardly dare open my mouth...
examples.translation: 有时我几乎不敢开口说话。

examples.text: He hasn't opened his mouth since he's been there.
examples.translation: 他从到那儿后一直没有开口。

examples.text: You wouldn't be here now if she'd kept her mouth shut.
examples.translation: 如果她守口如瓶的话，你现在就不会在这儿啦。

examples.text: She moved the sheaf of papers into position...
examples.translation: 她把那捆报纸挪到合适的地方。

examples.text: You can move the camera both vertically and horizontally...
examples.translation: 你可以上下左右移动摄像机。

examples.text: A traffic warden asked him to move his car...
examples.translation: 交通管理员让他把车开走。

examples.text: I could see the branches of the trees moving back and forth...
examples.translation: 我能看到树枝来回摇摆。

examples.text: The train began to move.
examples.translation: 火车开动了。

examples.text: She waited for him to get up, but he didn't move...
examples.translation: 她等他起床，但他没动弹。

examples.text: There was so much furniture you could hardly move without bumping into something...
examples.translation: 家具太多，稍挪步就会撞到什么东西上。

examples.text: He moved around the room, putting his possessions together...
examples.translation: 他在屋里走来走去，忙着把自己的东西放在一起。

examples.text: She moved away from the window.
examples.translation: 她从窗边走开。

examples.text: The doctor made a move towards the door...
examples.translation: 医生朝门口走去。

examples.text: Daniel's eyes followed her every move.
examples.translation: 丹尼尔的目光追随着她的一举一动。

examples.text: Industrialists must move fast to take advantage of new opportunities in Eastern Europe.
examples.translation: 实业家们必须尽快采取行动，抓住东欧的新机遇。

examples.text: The one point cut in interest rates was a wise move...
examples.translation: 将利率降低一个点是明智的举措。

examples.text: It may also be a good move to suggest she talks things over...
examples.translation: 建议她把事情谈开了也许是不错的做法。

examples.text: The thirty-five member nations agreed to the move...
examples.translation: 35个成员国同意采取该措施。

examples.text: Her latest disappearing act may be no more than a stunt, or a smart career move.
examples.translation: 她最近玩消失也许只是一个噱头，或是其职业生涯上的一着妙棋。

examples.text: My family home is in York-shire and they don't want to move...
examples.translation: 我家人住在约克郡，他们不打算搬家。

examples.text: She had often considered moving to London...
examples.translation: 她过去常想搬到伦敦去住。

examples.text: They move house fairly frequently...
examples.translation: 他们搬家相当频繁。

examples.text: The London Evening Standard moved offices a few years ago.
examples.translation: 《伦敦标准晚报》报址几年前迁走了。

examples.text: Modigliani announced his move to Montparnasse in 1909.
examples.translation: 莫迪利亚尼1909年宣布他要移居蒙帕尔纳斯。

examples.text: His superiors moved him to another parish...
examples.translation: 上级把他派往另一个教区。

examples.text: Ms Clark is still in position and there are no plans to move her...
examples.translation: 克拉克女士仍然在位，没有要调动她的计划。

examples.text: The family had to be moved because of an attack on their home.
examples.translation: 这家人在住处遭受袭击后，只好举家迁往别处。

examples.text: He moved from being an extramural tutor to being a lecturer in social history...
examples.translation: 他原先是一名校外辅导老师，后调入学校讲授社会史。

examples.text: In the early days Christina moved jobs to get experience.
examples.translation: 起初克里斯蒂娜更换不同的工作来积累经验。

examples.text: His move to the chairmanship means he will take a less active role in day-to-day management.
examples.translation: 他调任主席职务，意味着他对日常管理工作的参与将减少。

examples.text: Let's move to another subject, Dan.
examples.translation: 丹，我们换个话题吧。

examples.text: The club has moved its meeting to Saturday, January 22nd...
examples.translation: 俱乐部把会议日期改到1月22号，星期六。

examples.text: The band have moved forward their Leeds date to October 27.
examples.translation: 乐队已把去利兹的日期提前至10月27号。

examples.text: The Labour Party has moved to the right and become like your Democrat Party...
examples.translation: 工党已右倾化了，变得像你们民主党。

examples.text: It is already possible to start moving toward the elimination of nuclear weapons...
examples.translation: 已有可能朝着消除核武器的目标努力。

examples.text: Since the Convention was drawn up international opinion has begun to move against it.
examples.translation: 自从该国际公约起草之日起，国际社会就转而对其持反对意见。

examples.text: His move to the left was not a sudden leap but a natural working out of ideas.
examples.translation: 他转向左派不是一种骤变，而是思想意识的自然发展。

examples.text: Events are moving fast...
examples.translation: 事件进展迅速。

examples.text: Someone has got to get things moving.
examples.translation: 应该有人牵头把事情做起来。

examples.text: Everyone thought I was mad to go back, but I wouldn't be moved.
examples.translation: 大家都认为我回去是很不明智的，但我不会动摇。

examples.text: It was punk that first moved him to join a band seriously...
examples.translation: 最初是朋克摇滚乐促使他正式加入了乐队。

examples.text: The president was moved to come up with these suggestions after the hearings.
examples.translation: 听证会促使总统想出了这些建议。

examples.text: These stories surprised and moved me...
examples.translation: 这些故事让我吃惊，也让我感动。

examples.text: His prayer moved me to tears.
examples.translation: 他的祈祷把我感动得热泪盈眶。

examples.text: Those who listened to him were deeply moved.
examples.translation: 听众都被他深深打动了。

examples.text: She moves in high-society circles in London...
examples.translation: 她时常出入伦敦的上流社会。

examples.text: They moved in a world where hostility to racists was natural.
examples.translation: 他们出没在一个对种族主义者的敌视习以为常的世界里。

examples.text: Labour quickly moved a closure motion to end the debate...
examples.translation: 工党很快提出终止辩论的动议。

examples.text: I move that the case be dismissed.
examples.translation: 我提议对该案不予受理。

examples.text: With no idea of what to do for my next move, my hand hovered over the board.
examples.translation: 我举着棋子，不知下一步该怎么走。

examples.text: He knew one false move would end in death.
examples.translation: 他明白稍有差池就会被置于死地。

examples.text: He glanced at his wristwatch. 'I suppose we'd better make a move.'
examples.translation: 他看一眼手表说：“我想我们最好动身吧。”

examples.text: He made a move to leave.
examples.translation: 他起身离开。

examples.text: The week before the deal was supposed to close, fifteen Japanese banks made a move to pull out...
examples.translation: 在预定交易就要结束的前一周，15家日本银行采取行动撤离。

examples.text: Don't wait for others to make the first move: invite friends to visit you.
examples.translation: 别等别人先主动，要先邀请朋友到家来。

examples.text: Jack never wanted to stay in one place for very long, so they were always on the move.
examples.translation: 杰克从不想在一个地方呆太久，所以他们总在奔波辗转。

examples.text: It's part of a broader Hindu nationalist movement that's gaining strength throughout the country.
examples.translation: 这是一场凝聚全国力量的更大规模的印度教民族主义运动的一部分。

examples.text: ...the women's movement.
examples.translation: 妇女运动

examples.text: They actually monitor the movement of the fish going up river.
examples.translation: 他们实际上在监测鱼类迁往上游的活动。

examples.text: ...the plan for free movement of people, goods, capital and services across internal Community borders...
examples.translation: 劳动力、货物、资本和服务在共同体各成员国间自由流动的计划

examples.text: There was movement behind the window in the back door...
examples.translation: 后门窗户后面有动静。

examples.text: A tall, thin man was waving his arms in an effort to direct the movements of a large removal van...
examples.translation: 一个身材瘦高的男士正挥舞双臂想指挥一辆大型搬运车行驶。

examples.text: Her hand movements are becoming more animated.
examples.translation: 她双手舞动得越发欢快了。

examples.text: There are reports of fresh troop movements across the border.
examples.translation: 有报告说，新近有军队越过边境。

examples.text: ...the movement towards democracy in Latin America...
examples.translation: 拉丁美洲的民主进程

examples.text: There was a very good atmosphere at the talks and the participants believed movement forward was possible.
examples.translation: 会谈气氛非常融洽，与会者相信会取得进展。

examples.text: I want a full account of your movements the night Mr Gower was killed.
examples.translation: 请你完整地描述一下高尔先生被杀的那天晚上你的一切行踪。

examples.text: ...the first movement of Beethoven's 7th symphony.
examples.translation: 贝多芬《第七交响曲》第一乐章

examples.text: In the first movie Tony Curtis ever made he played a grocery clerk.
examples.translation: 托尼·柯蒂斯在其首部电影里，扮演了一个食品杂货店店员。

examples.text: ...a horror movie.
examples.translation: 恐怖电影

examples.text: He took her to the movies.
examples.translation: 他带她去看电影。

examples.text: She laughs too much...
examples.translation: 她笑得太多了。

examples.text: Thank you very much...
examples.translation: 非常感谢。

examples.text: My hairstyle hasn't changed much since I was five.
examples.translation: 从5岁起，我的发型就一直没怎么变。

examples.text: He said that his father never talked much about the war...
examples.translation: 他说他父亲从来不多谈那场战争。

examples.text: Gwen had not seen her Daddy all that much, because mostly he worked on the ships...
examples.translation: 格温一直不常见到她父亲，因为他大部分时间在船上工作。

examples.text: Do you get back East much?
examples.translation: 你经常回东部吗？

examples.text: The skin is much too delicate...
examples.translation: 皮肤太娇嫩了。

examples.text: You'd be so much happier if you could see yourself the way I see you...
examples.translation: 如果你能像我看你那样看待自己，你会快乐得多。

examples.text: He had written to The Times and then, much more unacceptably, allowed himself to be interviewed on television.
examples.translation: 他已写信给《泰晤士报》了，更让人受不了的是居然后来还同意接受电视台采访。

examples.text: The day ended much as it began...
examples.translation: 这一天的开始和结束几乎是一样的。

examples.text: Sheep's milk is produced in much the same way as goat's milk.
examples.translation: 绵羊奶和山羊奶的生产过程差不多。

examples.text: They are grown on the hillsides in full sun, without much water...
examples.translation: 它们被种植在阳光充足、土壤水分不多的山坡上。

examples.text: Japan has been reluctant to offer much aid to Russia...
examples.translation: 日本一直不愿意向俄罗斯提供太多的援助。

examples.text: The Home Office acknowledges that much crime goes unreported...
examples.translation: 内政部承认很多犯罪活动没有举报。

examples.text: Furniture is so bulky, it takes so much room.
examples.translation: 家具体积太大，占了太多空间。

examples.text: ...eating too much and drinking too much...
examples.translation: 大吃大喝

examples.text: There was so much to talk about.
examples.translation: 要说的太多。

examples.text: Much of the time we do not notice that we are solving problems...
examples.translation: 很多时候我们没意识到自己正在解决问题。

examples.text: She does much of her work abroad...
examples.translation: 她的工作大部分要在国外做。

examples.text: Her father had been a merchant seaman, absent for much of her childhood.
examples.translation: 她爸爸曾是商船船员，在她童年的大部分时光里都不在她身边。

examples.text: 'Can you hear it where you live?' He shook his head. 'Not much.'...
examples.translation: “你住的地方听得到吗？”他摇摇头说：“很少听到。”

examples.text: 'Do you care very much about what other people think?' — 'Too much.'
examples.translation: “你对别人的看法很在意吗？”——“太在意了。”

examples.text: I don't see much of Tony nowadays...
examples.translation: 我现在见托尼的次数不多。

examples.text: We won't be seeing much of each other for a while.
examples.translation: 我们会有一段时间不常见面。

examples.text: How much money can I afford?...
examples.translation: 我能出得起多少钱？

examples.text: See just how much fat and cholesterol you're eating...
examples.translation: 看看你究竟摄入了多少脂肪和胆固醇。

examples.text: I'm always very aware of how much work there is still to be done...
examples.translation: 我一直很清楚还要做多少工作。

examples.text: Krock told this story to McCauley and asked him how much truth there was in it.
examples.translation: 克罗克把这件事告诉了麦考利，并问他此事有几分真实性。

examples.text: She knows how much this upsets me but she persists in doing it...
examples.translation: 她知道这样会让我有多苦恼，但她坚持这样做。

examples.text: How much cooler will it get?
examples.translation: 天气会凉爽多少呢？

examples.text: How much do you earn?...
examples.translation: 你挣多少钱？

examples.text: Greg made a vague gesture to indicate how much.
examples.translation: 格雷格做了一个含糊的手势表示有多少。

examples.text: I shall try, with as much patience as is possible, to explain yet again...
examples.translation: 我会尽可能耐心地试着再解释一遍。

examples.text: Their aim will be to produce as much milk as possible...
examples.translation: 他们的目标是尽可能提高牛奶产量。

examples.text: With an 18-watt fluorescent bulb you get as much light but use 75% less electricity.
examples.translation: 用18瓦的荧光灯灯泡有同样的亮度，而用电量却减少75％。

examples.text: Much as they hope to go home tomorrow, they're resigned to staying on until the end of the year.
examples.translation: 虽然他们希望明天就回家，但还是准备耐心地继续呆到年底。

examples.text: You're waiting for a woman — I thought as much.
examples.translation: 你在等一位女士——我也这么想的。

examples.text: The organisers hope to raise as much as £6m for charity.
examples.translation: 组织者希望能募集到高达600万英镑的善款。

examples.text: They are always short of water to drink, much less to bathe in...
examples.translation: 他们的饮用水一直短缺，更别提洗澡水了。

examples.text: But we must not think of Chekhov as a leftist, much less a revolutionary.
examples.translation: 但是我们绝不应把契科夫看成是个左派人物，他更不是革命者。

examples.text: 'What was stolen?' — 'Oh, nothing much.'...
examples.translation: “什么被偷了？”——“噢，不是什么重要的东西。”

examples.text: Nothing much interesting seemed to be happening.
examples.translation: 看来不会发生什么有趣的事。

examples.text: It hasn't been much of a holiday...
examples.translation: 这简直不像是假日。

examples.text: It's not much of a career, you may think.
examples.translation: 你可能想这根本算不上是一份职业。

examples.text: Well, so much for the producers. But what of the con-sumers?
examples.translation: 好吧，关于生产商就讲这么多，那关于消费者呢？

examples.text: He has spent 19 million pounds, lost three cup finals and been relegated. So much for money.
examples.translation: 他已花了1,900万英镑，输掉了三场杯赛决赛，球队也降级了。钱也不是万能的。

examples.text: I don't really think of her as a daughter so much as a very good friend...
examples.translation: 与其说我把她当作女儿，不如说把她当作好朋友。

examples.text: She told me she was not so much leaving her job as it was leaving her.
examples.translation: 她告诉我，与其说是她辞了工作，不如说是工作辞了她。

examples.text: I didn't so much as catch sight of him all day long...
examples.translation: 我一整天都没见他人影。

examples.text: Laura had not reproached him, never so much as mentioned it...
examples.translation: 劳拉没责备他，甚至提都没提那件事。

examples.text: She auctioned off the car without so much as taking a ride in it.
examples.translation: 她甚至都没怎么开过那辆车，就把它拍卖了。

examples.text: He himself believed in freedom, so much so that he would rather die than live without it.
examples.translation: 他非常崇尚自由，不自由，毋宁死。

examples.text: His inability to stay at one job for long had finally proved too much for her.
examples.translation: 他没有哪份工作能干长，这一点最终让她难以忍受。

examples.text: ...a man very much in charge of himself...
examples.translation: 自制力很强的人

examples.text: Yorkshire is still very much a farming community with good meat, good dairy produce and eggs...
examples.translation: 约克郡在很大程度上仍以农业为主，出产优质肉类、奶制品和蛋类。

examples.text: Something was very much the matter.
examples.translation: 确实出问题了。

meanings.meaning: 泥；诽谤的话；无价值的东西

examples.text: His uniform was crumpled, untidy, splashed with mud...
examples.translation: 他的制服皱巴巴的，邋遢不堪，还溅上了泥点。

examples.text: Their lorry got stuck in the mud.
examples.translation: 他们的货车陷到泥里了。

examples.text: He spooned instant coffee into two of the mugs.
examples.translation: 他用勺子把速溶咖啡舀入两个杯子中。

examples.text: He had been drinking mugs of coffee to keep himself awake.
examples.translation: 为让自己保持清醒，他一杯接一杯地喝咖啡。

examples.text: I was walking out to my car when this guy tried to mug me...
examples.translation: 我正出门朝我的车走去，就在这时这家伙企图对我进行抢劫。

examples.text: He has been mugged more than once.
examples.translation: 他已是不止一次被抢劫了。

examples.text: Bank robberies, burglaries and muggings are reported almost daily in the press...
examples.translation: 报纸上几乎每天都有抢劫银行、入室行窃和拦路抢劫的报道。

examples.text: We usually think of a victim of mugging as being someone elderly.
examples.translation: 我们通常以为被拦路抢劫的受害者是老年人。

examples.text: He's a mug as far as women are concerned...
examples.translation: 在女性眼里，他是个傻瓜。

examples.text: I feel such a mug for signing the agreement.
examples.translation: 我觉得签这个协议真傻。

examples.text: I used to be a very heavy gambler, but not any more. It's a mug's game...
examples.translation: 我曾经是个赌棍，但现在再也不赌了，那是傻瓜的游戏。

examples.text: Dieting is a mug's game.
examples.translation: 傻瓜才节食。

examples.text: He managed to get his ugly mug on the telly.
examples.translation: 他设法让自己那张丑陋的脸上了电视。

examples.text: He died of multiple injuries...
examples.translation: 他死于多处受伤。

examples.text: The most common multiple births are twins, two babies born at the same time.
examples.translation: 最常见的多胎是双胞胎，两个婴儿同时出生。

examples.text: Their numerical system, derived from the Babylonians, was based on multiples of the number six.
examples.translation: 他们的数制源自古巴比伦人，以数字6的倍数为基数。

examples.text: It made it almost impossible for the smaller retailer to compete against the multiples.
examples.translation: 这使得小零售商几乎不可能跟连锁店竞争。

meanings.meaning: 乘；使增加；使繁殖；使相乘

examples.text: Such disputes multiplied in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries...
examples.translation: 这类纠纷在18和19世纪大量增多。

examples.text: Her husband multiplied his demands on her time.
examples.translation: 她丈夫需要她的时间大大增加。

examples.text: These creatures can multiply quickly.
examples.translation: 这些动物能迅速繁殖。

examples.text: What do you get if you multiply six by nine?
examples.translation: 9乘以6得多少？

examples.text: ...the remarkable ability to multiply huge numbers correctly without pen or paper.
examples.translation: 不借助纸笔而能正确计算大数字乘积的非凡能力

examples.text: There are a multitude of small quiet roads to cycle along...
examples.translation: 有很多可以骑车的宁静小路。

examples.text: Addiction to drugs can bring a multitude of other problems.
examples.translation: 毒瘾会带来许多其他问题。

examples.text: 'Strong, centralized government' is a term that can cover a multitude of sins.
examples.translation: “强大的中央集权政府”是一个能掩饰种种问题的措词。

examples.text: ...surrounded by a noisy multitude.
examples.translation: 被喧闹的人群围着

examples.text: ...the multitudes that throng around the Pope.
examples.translation: 围在主教周围的人群

examples.text: The hideous truth was hidden from the multitude...
examples.translation: 向大众隐瞒了骇人听闻的真相。

examples.text: It is our task to convince the multitudes that we are pursuing a lawful hobby in a lawful way.
examples.translation: 我们的任务是要让民众相信，我们是在用合法的方式来从事一种合法的爱好。

meanings.meaning: 市政的，市的；地方自治的

examples.text: The municipal authorities gave the go-ahead for the march.
examples.translation: 市政当局批准了这次游行。

examples.text: ...next month's municipal elections.
examples.translation: 下个月的市政选举

examples.text: ...the municipal library.
examples.translation: 市图书馆

examples.text: The three accused, aged between 19 and 20, are charged with attempted murder...
examples.translation: 3个年龄在19到20岁之间的被告被控谋杀未遂。

examples.text: She refused to testify, unless the murder charge against her was dropped.
examples.translation: 除非撤销对她的谋杀指控，否则她拒绝作证。

examples.text: ...brutal murders.
examples.translation: 残忍的谋杀案

examples.text: ...a thriller about two men who murder a third to see if they can get away with it.
examples.translation: 关于两个男人为了看看是否能成功逃脱惩罚而去谋杀另一名男子的惊悚片

examples.text: ...the body of a murdered religious and political leader.
examples.translation: 被谋杀的宗教和政治领袖的尸体

examples.text: His charm and the fact that he is so likeable often allows him to get away with murder.
examples.translation: 他很有魅力而且讨人喜欢，这常让他能够为所欲为。

examples.text: People are screaming blue murder about the amount of traffic going through their town.
examples.translation: 人们对着那些穿越他们城市的川流不息的车辆大呼小叫。

meanings.meaning: 低语；低语声；低声抱怨；潺潺声
低声说；私下抱怨；发出轻柔持续的声音

examples.text: He turned and murmured something to the professor...
examples.translation: 他转身对教授小声说了些什么。

examples.text: She murmured a few words of support...
examples.translation: 她小声说了几句支持的话。

examples.text: 'How lovely,' she murmured...
examples.translation: 她低语道：“多可爱呀。”

examples.text: Murmuring softly that they must go somewhere to talk, he led her from the garden.
examples.translation: 他低声温柔地说他们必须找一个地方谈谈，然后把她带出了花园。

examples.text: They spoke in low murmurs...
examples.translation: 他们低声说着话。

examples.text: She gave a little murmur.
examples.translation: 她低声咕哝了一句。

examples.text: The piano music mixes with the murmur of conversation...
examples.translation: 钢琴的弹奏声混杂着低低的交谈声。

examples.text: I could hear the murmur of the sea...
examples.translation: 我能听到大海的呢喃声。

examples.text: The clamor of traffic has receded to a distant murmur.
examples.translation: 车辆的喧闹声已渐渐远去，变得模糊起来。

examples.text: The promise of some basic working rights draws murmurs of approval...
examples.translation: 对一些基本工作权利的承诺引来一片低声的赞许。

examples.text: Already there are murmurs of discontent.
examples.translation: 已有一些不满的怨言。

examples.text: The doctor said James had now developed a heart murmur.
examples.translation: 医生说詹姆斯的心脏有杂音。

meanings.meaning: 加强；使劲搬动；使劲挤出

examples.text: Keeping your muscles strong and in tone helps you to avoid back problems...
examples.translation: 保持肌肉强壮发达有利于预防背部疾病。

examples.text: He is suffering from a strained thigh muscle...
examples.translation: 他的大腿肌肉拉伤了，疼得很。

examples.text: There are three types of muscle in the body.
examples.translation: 体内有3种类型的肌肉。

examples.text: Eisenhower used his muscle to persuade Congress to change the law...
examples.translation: 艾森豪威尔用他的影响力说服国会修改了该项法律。

examples.text: In one town, all the women were urged to remove their money from the banks on an allotted day, to demonstrate women's financial muscle.
examples.translation: 在某市，所有的女性都被建议在指定日期从银行取走她们的钱，以展示女性群体的经济实力。

examples.text: The Fair Trade Commission has of late been flexing its muscles, cracking down on cases of corruption.
examples.translation: 公平交易委员会最近在显示威力，严厉打击腐败事件。

examples.text: He stood without moving a muscle, unable to believe what his eyes saw so plainly.
examples.translation: 他站在那里一动不动，不能相信眼前如此清清楚楚看到的一切。

meanings.meaning: 肌肉的；肌肉发达的；强健的

examples.text: As a general rule, all muscular effort is enhanced by breathing in as the effort is made...
examples.translation: 通常，肌肉的力量能通过使劲儿吸气增强。

examples.text: Early symptoms include anorexia, muscular weakness and fatigue.
examples.translation: 早期症状有厌食、肌无力和疲劳。

examples.text: Like most female athletes, she was lean and muscular.
examples.translation: 像大多女运动员一样，她清瘦但肌肉发达。

examples.text: ...his tanned muscular legs.
examples.translation: 他那肌肉发达、肤色黝黑的双腿

examples.text: For months Malcolm had wanted to visit the Parisian art museums.
examples.translation: 几个月来马尔科姆一直想参观巴黎的艺术博物馆。

examples.text: ...the American Museum of Natural History.
examples.translation: 美国自然历史博物馆

meanings.meaning: 蘑菇，伞菌；蘑菇形物体；暴发户
蘑菇的；蘑菇形的；迅速生长的
迅速增加；采蘑菇；迅速生长

examples.text: There are many types of wild mushrooms.
examples.translation: 野生蘑菇有很多种。

examples.text: ...eggs, bacon, sausage, and mushrooms.
examples.translation: 鸡蛋、腊肉、香肠和蘑菇

examples.text: ...mushroom omelette.
examples.translation: 蘑菇煎蛋饼

examples.text: The media training industry has mushroomed over the past decade...
examples.translation: 在过去10年里，媒体培训产业迅速成长。

examples.text: A sleepy capital of a few hundred thousand people has mushroomed to a crowded city of 2 million.
examples.translation: 几十万人的沉寂首府迅速发展成为拥有两百万人口的拥挤都市。

examples.text: ...the mushrooming of commercial art galleries in Barcelona and Madrid.
examples.translation: 巴塞罗那和马德里两地大量涌现的商业美术馆

examples.text: ...classical music.
examples.translation: 古典音乐

examples.text: ...the music of George Gershwin.
examples.translation: 乔治·格什温的音乐作品

examples.text: ...a mixture of music, dance, cabaret and children's theatre.
examples.translation: 音乐、舞蹈、卡巴莱和儿童剧的混合

examples.text: ...a music critic for the New York Times.
examples.translation: 《纽约时报》的乐评人

examples.text: He went on to study music, specialising in the clarinet.
examples.translation: 他继续学习音乐，主攻单簧管。

examples.text: ...a music lesson.
examples.translation: 音乐课

examples.text: He's never been able to read music.
examples.translation: 他一直都不识谱。

examples.text: Popular support—it's music to the ears of any politician.
examples.translation: 大众的支持对任何一名政界人士来说都是佳音。

examples.text: Sooner or later, I'm going to have to face the music.
examples.translation: 迟早我得自己承担后果。

examples.text: We have a wealth of musical talent in this region...
examples.translation: 在这一地区有大量的音乐人才。

examples.text: Stan Getz's musical career spanned five decades...
examples.translation: 斯坦·盖兹的音乐生涯跨越50个春秋。

examples.text: London's musical life might become as exciting as Berlin's.
examples.translation: 伦敦的音乐生活可能会变得像柏林的一样令人兴奋。

examples.text: Musically there is a lot to enjoy.
examples.translation: 从音乐角度看， 有很多可以欣赏的东西。

examples.text: ...trying to communicate verbally what he can only communicate musically.
examples.translation: 尝试用语言表达他只能用音乐表达的内容

examples.text: ...London's smash hit musical Miss Saigon.
examples.translation: 在伦敦轰动一时的音乐剧《西贡小姐》

examples.text: I came from a musical family.
examples.translation: 我出身于音乐世家。

examples.text: ...a people of extraordinary musicality.
examples.translation: 有非凡音乐天赋的民族

examples.text: He had a soft, almost musical voice.
examples.translation: 他声音柔和，如音乐般动听。

examples.text: The voice was as musically soft as ever.
examples.translation: 那声音一如既往地轻柔悦耳。

examples.text: He was a brilliant musician.
examples.translation: 他是一位才华横溢的音乐家。

examples.text: ...one of Britain's best known rock musicians.
examples.translation: 英国最知名的摇滚乐手之一

meanings.meaning: 必须，一定；可以，应当；很可能
绝对必要的事物；未发酵葡萄汁
(Must)人名；(匈)穆什特；(俄、瑞典)穆斯特

examples.text: Must is a modal verb. It is followed by the base form of a verb.
examples.translation: must为情态动词，后跟动词原形。

examples.text: You are going to have to take a certain amount of criticism, but you must cope with it...
examples.translation: 你肯定会遭到一些批评，但你必须去面对。

examples.text: The doctor must not allow the patient to be put at risk...
examples.translation: 医生决不能置患者于危险境地而不顾。

examples.text: The soil must not be overwatered, especially during the first few weeks...
examples.translation: 切忌土壤过涝，尤其在最初几周。

examples.text: We must not forget your birthday.
examples.translation: 我们一定不能忘了你的生日。

examples.text: Candidates must satisfy the general conditions for admission...
examples.translation: 候选人必须满足参选的总体条件。

examples.text: Mr Allen must pay Mr Farnham's legal costs...
examples.translation: 艾伦先生应当支付法纳姆先生的诉讼费。

examples.text: Equipment must be supervised if children are in the house.
examples.translation: 如果孩子们在屋里，必须有人监管设备。

examples.text: At 29 Russell must be one of the youngest ever Wembley referees...
examples.translation: 29岁的拉赛尔一定是有史以来温布利球场上的裁判员中最年轻的一个。

examples.text: Reggae must be the only music that's got its own country — Jamaica...
examples.translation: 雷盖音乐得到了一整个国家人民的支持，这个国家就是牙买加——这一点上它无疑是独一无二的。

examples.text: I'm sure he must feel he has lost a close family friend, because I know I do...
examples.translation: 我敢说他一定觉得自己失去了一位亲密的世交，因为我知道我是这种感觉。

examples.text: I must have been a bore.
examples.translation: 我一定让人觉得很无聊。

examples.text: 'You must be Emma,' said the visitor...
examples.translation: 来客说：“你肯定是埃玛。”

examples.text: Miss Holloway had a weak heart. She must have had a heart attack...
examples.translation: 霍洛韦小姐心脏不好，她肯定得过心脏病。

examples.text: His only explanation was that he must have brought them home in order to continue his work...
examples.translation: 他唯一的解释是，自己想必是为了继续工作而把它们带回家了。

examples.text: The medical reports really must have suggested that he was really seriously hurt.
examples.translation: 医学报告肯定已经指出他伤得的确很重。

examples.text: In order to take that job, you must have left another job...
examples.translation: 为得到那份工作，你肯定已辞去了另一份工作。

examples.text: In order to start reading this book you must have had some idea that the physical symptoms you were experiencing were due to anxiety.
examples.translation: 开始读这本书之前，你一定已经了解到：你身体的不适症状是源于焦虑。

examples.text: I must be getting back...
examples.translation: 我一定要回来。

examples.text: I must have a whiskey...
examples.translation: 我要喝杯威士忌。

examples.text: I must telephone my parents...
examples.translation: 我一定要给父母打电话。

examples.text: I must speak to Tania at once...
examples.translation: 我要马上跟塔尼娅讲话。

examples.text: He told the Prime Minister that he felt he must now leave.
examples.translation: 他告诉首相，他感觉自己现在必须要离开了。

examples.text: You must see a doctor, Frederick...
examples.translation: 弗雷德里克，你一定得去看医生。

examples.text: You must see the painting Paul has given me as a wedding present...
examples.translation: 你一定要看看保罗送给我作结婚礼物的那幅画。

examples.text: You must come to lunch with us...
examples.translation: 你一定要来和我们一起吃午饭。

examples.text: You must visit me. Come to dinner.
examples.translation: 你一定要来我家吃晚饭。

examples.text: This must be a very difficult job for you...
examples.translation: 对你来说，这份工作想必很难。

examples.text: You must be very worried by now...
examples.translation: 你现在一定非常担心。

examples.text: Now sit down and make yourself comfortable. You must be very tired.
examples.translation: 现在坐下来，让自己舒服些，你一定很累了。

examples.text: This came as a surprise, I must say...
examples.translation: 我得说这真是个意外。

examples.text: I must admit I like looking feminine...
examples.translation: 我得承认我喜欢看起来淑女一些。

examples.text: They were very polite, I must confess.
examples.translation: 我得承认他们很有礼貌。

examples.text: It must be noted, however, that not all British and American officers carried out orders...
examples.translation: 然而，一定要注意不是所有的英国和美国军官都执行了命令。

examples.text: It must be stated that this illness is one of the most complex conditions known to man.
examples.translation: 必须声明，这种疾病是人类已知的最为复杂的疾病之一。

examples.text: Why must you do everything as if you have to win?...
examples.translation: 你为什么做每件事情都跟你非要赢似的？

examples.text: Why must she inter-rupt?...
examples.translation: 她为什么非要插嘴？

examples.text: Must you always run when the pressure gets too much?
examples.translation: 难道压力一大你就非要逃开吗？

examples.text: 'Go! Please go.' — 'You must be joking!'...
examples.translation: “走吧！请走吧。”——“你一定是在开玩笑吧！”

examples.text: I really must be quite mad!...
examples.translation: 真的，我一定是气坏了！

examples.text: You must have gone out of your mind!
examples.translation: 你准是疯了！

examples.text: The new 37th issue of National Savings Certificates is a must for any taxpayer...
examples.translation: 新发行的第37期国家储蓄债券是任何一个纳税人的必然之选。

examples.text: A must is a visit to the fascinating and world-renowned Motor Museum.
examples.translation: 一定要去参观一下那个举世闻名且精彩有趣的汽车博物馆。

examples.text: If you must be in the sunlight, use the strongest filter cream you can get...
examples.translation: 如果一定要呆在太阳底下的话，就擦上你能买到的防晒系数最高的防晒霜。

examples.text: 'Could I have a word?' — 'Oh dear, if you must.'...
examples.translation: “我能说一句吗？”——“亲爱的，如果你非说不可的话，好吧。”

examples.text: If you must have a cigarette, choose a seat in the first row of the smoking section.
examples.translation: 如果你一定要吸烟的话，去吸烟区的第一排找个座位。

examples.text: 'Why don't you wear your jogging shorts Mum?' — 'Well, my legs are too skinny, if you must know.'
examples.translation: “妈妈，为什么不穿你的慢跑短裤呢？”——“哦，如果你非要问的话，因为我的腿太瘦了。”

examples.text: 'You told him you'd been there that night.' — 'If you must know, yes.'
examples.translation: “你跟他说过你那天夜里去过那儿了。”——“是的，如果你非要问的话。”

examples.text: He was mute, distant, and indifferent...
examples.translation: 他一句话也不说，显得疏远而冷漠。

examples.text: I threw a mute look of appeal at Paula.
examples.translation: 我默默地向葆拉投去恳求的目光。

examples.text: He could watch her standing mute by the phone...
examples.translation: 他能看到她一声不响地站在电话旁。

examples.text: He sat mute, speechless with ecstasy, gazing into the sky.
examples.translation: 他静静坐着，凝视天空，一言不发，心驰神往。

examples.text: I crouched by him and grasped his hand, mutely offering what comfort I could.
examples.translation: 我蹲在他身旁，握住他的手，默默地，尽我所能地安慰他。

examples.text: Marianna, the duke's daughter, became mute after a shock.
examples.translation: 公爵的女儿玛丽安娜在遭受了一次电击后失声了。

examples.text: The corruption does not seem to have muted the country's prolonged economic boom.
examples.translation: 腐败似乎没有影响国家经济的持续繁荣。

examples.text: The threat contrasted starkly with his administration's previous muted criticism...
examples.translation: 这一威胁和他这届政府之前低调的指责形成了鲜明的对比。

examples.text: The financial markets gave a muted response to the Democrats' triumph.
examples.translation: 金融市场对民主党的胜利反响不大。

examples.text: They begin to mute their voices, not be as assertive...
examples.translation: 他们开始压低嗓门，不再那么肯定了。

examples.text: At first the wooded hillsides muted the sounds.
examples.translation: 最初长满树木的山坡吸收了噪音。

examples.text: 'Yes,' he muttered, his voice so muted I hardly heard his reply...
examples.translation: 他小声说：“是。”声音低得我几乎听不到。

examples.text: There were muted cheers from the public gallery.
examples.translation: 旁听席传出了轻微的欢呼声。

meanings.meaning: 咕哝；抱怨地说；低声含糊地说
(Mutter)人名；(法)米泰；(德、匈、西)穆特；(英)马特

examples.text: 'God knows what's happening in that madman's mind,' she muttered...
examples.translation: 她咕哝着：“天知道那个疯子在想什么。”

examples.text: She can hear the old woman muttering about consideration...
examples.translation: 她能听到那个老妇人小声咕哝说考虑考虑。

examples.text: He sat there shaking his head, muttering to himself...
examples.translation: 他坐在那儿摇着头，小声地自言自语。

examples.text: She was staring into the fire muttering.
examples.translation: 她目不转睛地盯着火苗，小声咕哝着。

examples.text: They make no more than a mutter of protest.
examples.translation: 他们只不过是低声抗议了一下。

examples.text: He heard muttering from the front of the crowd...
examples.translation: 他听到人群前面有人在小声嘀咕什么。

examples.text: He will lead the party into the election, in spite of the mutterings about his leadership.
examples.translation: 尽管人们对他的领导颇有微词，他仍将领导其政党参加选举。

examples.text: ...a leg of mutton.
examples.translation: 羊腿

examples.text: ...mutton stew.
examples.translation: 炖羊肉

meanings.meaning: 我自己；我亲自；我的正常的健康状况和正常情绪

examples.text: I asked myself what I would have done in such a situation...
examples.translation: 我问自己在这种情况下我会怎么做。

examples.text: I looked at myself in the mirror...
examples.translation: 我看着镜子里的自己。

examples.text: I felt ashamed of myself.
examples.translation: 我感到惭愧。

examples.text: I myself enjoy cinema, poetry, eating out and long walks...
examples.translation: 我本人喜欢电影、诗歌、外出吃饭和远途散步。

examples.text: I'm fond of cake myself...
examples.translation: 我本人很喜欢蛋糕。

examples.text: He was roughly the same age as myself.
examples.translation: 他大概和我同岁。

examples.text: ...a complete beginner like myself.
examples.translation: 和我一样的完完全全的初学者

examples.text: 'Where did you get that embroidery?' — 'I made it myself.'
examples.translation: “你从哪儿弄到那件刺绣品的？”——“我自己绣的。”

meanings.meaning: 神秘的；不可思议的；难解的

examples.text: He died in mysterious circumstances...
examples.translation: 他死得很蹊跷。

examples.text: A mysterious illness confined him to bed for over a month...
examples.translation: 他得了一种神秘的怪病，卧床有一个多月。

examples.text: The whole thing seems very mysterious...
examples.translation: 整件事情看起来都很蹊跷。

examples.text: He began to feel sympathy for this slightly mysterious man.
examples.translation: 他开始对这位有点儿神秘的男子怀有同情。

examples.text: A couple of messages had mysteriously disappeared.
examples.translation: 几条信息神秘地消失不见了。

examples.text: As for his job — well, he was very mysterious about it.
examples.translation: 至于他的工作，他总是显得非常神秘，从不多说。

examples.text: Asked what she meant, she said mysteriously: 'Work it out for yourself'.
examples.translation: 问她是什么意思，她故弄玄虚地说：“你自己想吧。”

meanings.meaning: 秘密，谜；神秘，神秘的事物；推理小说，推理剧；常作 mysteries 秘技，秘诀

examples.text: The source of the gunshots still remains a mystery.
examples.translation: 枪炮声来自何处仍是个谜。

examples.text: ...the mysteries of mental breakdown.
examples.translation: 精神崩溃之谜

examples.text: She's a lady of mystery...
examples.translation: 她是个神秘的女人。

examples.text: It is an elaborate ceremony, shrouded in mystery.
examples.translation: 仪式是精心筹划的，笼罩着一层神秘的色彩。

examples.text: The mystery hero immediately alerted police after spotting a bomb.
examples.translation: 那个无名英雄发现炸弹后马上报了警。

examples.text: ...a mystery prize of up to £1,000.
examples.translation: 高达1,000英镑的神秘奖品

examples.text: His fourth novel is a murder mystery set in London.
examples.translation: 他的第四部小说讲述的是一起发生在伦敦的神秘谋杀案。

meanings.meaning: 神话；虚构的人，虚构的事

examples.text: There is a famous Greek myth in which Icarus flew too near to the Sun.
examples.translation: 有一个著名的希腊神话，讲的是伊卡洛斯飞得离太阳过近的故事。

examples.text: ...the world of magic and of myth.
examples.translation: 魔法和神话的世界

examples.text: Contrary to the popular myth, women are not reckless spendthrifts.
examples.translation: 和人们的普遍观念恰恰相反，女性并不是胡乱挥霍者。

examples.text: The East and the West can work together for their mutual benefit and progress...
examples.translation: 东西方可以为彼此共同的利益和发展而合作。

examples.text: It's plain that he adores his daughter, and the feeling is mutual.
examples.translation: 明摆着他很喜欢自己的女儿，而且女儿也喜欢他。

examples.text: Attempts to reach a mutually agreed solution had been fruitless...
examples.translation: 试图达成一个双方都赞成的解决方案的努力毫无结果。

examples.text: A meeting would take place at a mutually convenient time.
examples.translation: 会议拟在双方都方便的时候召开。

examples.text: They do, however, share a mutual interest in design...
examples.translation: 不过他们确实都对设计感兴趣。

examples.text: We were introduced by a mutual friend.
examples.translation: 我们一个共同的朋友介绍我们认识了。

examples.text: Britain's third largest building society abandoned its mutual status and became a bank.
examples.translation: 英国第三大建屋互助会准备放弃其互助性质，转变为银行。

examples.text: I invited him back to my flat for a coffee...
examples.translation: 我邀请他回我的公寓喝杯咖啡。

examples.text: John's my best friend...
examples.translation: 约翰是我最好的朋友。

examples.text: I received a bill for the car rental from my credit card company...
examples.translation: 我收到一张我的信用卡公司寄来的汽车租金账单。

examples.text: My understanding was that we'd meet at her place.
examples.translation: 我的理解是我们在她那儿见面。

examples.text: My sweet Freda...
examples.translation: 我亲爱的弗蕾达

examples.text: Yes, of course, my darling.
examples.translation: 是，当然了，亲爱的。

examples.text: My God, I've never seen you so nervous...
examples.translation: 天哪，我从没见你这么紧张过。

examples.text: My goodness, Tim, you have changed!
examples.translation: 我的天，蒂姆，你变了！

examples.text: It's naive to think that teachers are always tolerant...
examples.translation: 认为老师们总那么宽容是幼稚的。

examples.text: I must have been naive to think we would get my parents' blessing.
examples.translation: 我一定太天真了，竟认为我们会得到我父母的祝福。

examples.text: ...naive idealists...
examples.translation: 天真的理想主义者

examples.text: Their view was that he had been politically naive.
examples.translation: 他们认为他在政治上一直很幼稚。

examples.text: ...naively applying Western solutions to Eastern problems...
examples.translation: 幼稚地利用西方的办法解决东方的问题

examples.text: I thought, naively, that this would be a nine-to-five job.
examples.translation: 我天真地以为这是份朝九晚五的工作。

examples.text: I was alarmed by his naivety and ignorance of international affairs.
examples.translation: 他对国际事务缺乏经验且无知，这很让我吃惊。

meanings.meaning: (Nail)人名；(法)纳伊；(土、阿拉伯、罗)纳伊尔

examples.text: A mirror hung on a nail above the washstand...
examples.translation: 脸盆架上方用钉子挂着一面镜子。

examples.text: He hammered the nail into the branch.
examples.translation: 他把钉子钉到了树枝上。

examples.text: Frank put the first plank down and nailed it in place...
examples.translation: 弗兰克放下第一块厚木板，把它钉在合适的位置上。

examples.text: They nail shut the front door...
examples.translation: 他们把前门钉死了。

examples.text: The windows were all nailed shut.
examples.translation: 窗户都钉死了。

examples.text: Keep your nails short and your hands clean.
examples.translation: 常剪指甲，保持双手清洁。

examples.text: The prosecution still managed to nail him for robberies at the homes of leading industrialists.
examples.translation: 检控方仍设法使其入室抢劫知名实业家们的罪名成立。

examples.text: He's a shrewd businessman and hard as nails...
examples.translation: 他是一个既精明又铁石心肠的生意人。

examples.text: He simply looked mean and hard as nails.
examples.translation: 他看起来既卑鄙又冷酷无情。

examples.text: 'I think it would civilize people a bit more if they had decent conditions.' — 'I think you've hit the nail on the head.'
examples.translation: “我认为，如果人们有良好的环境，就会更有教养一点。”——“我想你说到点子上了。”

meanings.meaning: 裸体的；无装饰的；无证据的；直率的

examples.text: Her naked body was found wrapped in a sheet in a field...
examples.translation: 在田里发现了她的尸体，全身赤裸，裹在一条床单里。

examples.text: The hot paving stones scorched my naked feet...
examples.translation: 烫人的铺路石灼烤着我的一双赤脚。

examples.text: They stripped me naked...
examples.translation: 他们扒光了我的衣服。

examples.text: He stood naked in front of me.
examples.translation: 他赤身裸体地站在我面前。

examples.text: He had pulled the blanket over his body to hide his nakedness.
examples.translation: 他把毛毯扯过来裹住自己赤裸的身体。

examples.text: The nest contained eight little mice that were naked and blind.
examples.translation: 窝里有8只还没长毛、眼睛尚未睁开的小老鼠。

examples.text: If the reports are accurate, the deal leaves the authorities and the President virtually naked.
examples.translation: 如果报道属实，此交易的确使当局和总统猝不及防。

examples.text: ...Bevan's appeal against going 'naked into the conference chamber'.
examples.translation: 贝文“不要毫无准备地走进会议室”的呼吁

examples.text: ...a naked bulb dangling in a bare room...
examples.translation: 空荡荡的房间里吊着的一只没有灯罩的灯泡

examples.text: The water was heated by a naked gas flame.
examples.translation: 水是用燃气明火加热的。

examples.text: The naked hatred in the woman's face shocked me...
examples.translation: 那位女士一脸毫不掩饰的憎恨让我震惊。

examples.text: There had been naked misery in her voice when she'd spoken about the letter.
examples.translation: 她说起那封信时，声音里流露出明显的痛苦。

examples.text: She was embarrassed at showing her fear so nakedly.
examples.translation: 她对于如此直接地表露了自己的恐惧感到尴尬不已。

examples.text: Naked aggression and an attempt to change frontiers by force could not go unchallenged.
examples.translation: 公然的侵略和企图用武力改变边界的行径是不能置之不理的。

examples.text: ...violence and the naked pursuit of power.
examples.translation: 暴力以及对权力赤裸裸的追求

examples.text: ...naked greed.
examples.translation: 赤裸裸的贪欲

examples.text: The worms cannot be seen by the naked eye...
examples.translation: 这些虫子用肉眼看不见。

examples.text: The planet Mars will be visible to the naked eye all week...
examples.translation: 整周都可以用肉眼观察到火星。

examples.text: There's so much going on that you can't see with the naked eye.
examples.translation: 有很多正在发生的事情肉眼是无法察觉的。

examples.text: One group of people seems to be forgotten, namely pensioners...
examples.translation: 有一类人似乎被遗忘了，就是那些领养老金的人。

examples.text: They were hardly aware of the challenge facing them, namely, to re-establish prosperity.
examples.translation: 他们几乎没有意识到自己面临的挑战，即再创繁荣。

examples.text: She was taking tiny bites of a hot dog and daintily wiping her lips with a napkin.
examples.translation: 她小口地吃着热狗，用餐巾优雅地擦着嘴。

meanings.meaning: 命名，任命；指定；称呼；提名；叫出

examples.text: 'What's his name?'—'Peter.'...
examples.translation: “他叫什么？”——“彼得。”

examples.text: I don't even know if Sullivan's his real name...
examples.translation: 我甚至不知道沙利文是否是他的真名。

examples.text: They changed the name of the street.
examples.translation: 他们把街道名称改了。

examples.text: My mother insisted on naming me Horace.
examples.translation: 我母亲坚持给我取名叫霍勒斯。

examples.text: ...a man named John T. Benson...
examples.translation: 名叫约翰·T.本森的男人

examples.text: He won his first Derby on the aptly named 'Never Say Die'.
examples.translation: 他驾驭着这匹名副其实的“永不言败”夺得了他的第一个德比马赛冠军。

examples.text: Why have you not named any of your sons after yourself?
examples.translation: 为什么没让哪个儿子用你的名字呢？

examples.text: It's nearly thirty years since a journalist was jailed for refusing to name a source...
examples.translation: 一名记者因拒绝说出消息来源而入狱已经是近30年前的事了。

examples.text: One of the victims of the weekend's snowstorm has been named as twenty-year-old John Barr.
examples.translation: 周末暴风雪中的一名罹难者已确认是20岁的约翰·巴尔。

examples.text: Call Marty, tell him to name his price.
examples.translation: 给马蒂打电话，让他出个价儿。

examples.text: The England manager will be naming a new captain, to replace the injured David Beckham...
examples.translation: 英格兰队主教练将任命新队长，接替受伤的大卫·贝克汉姆。

examples.text: When the chairman of Campbell's retired, McGovern was named as his successor...
examples.translation: 坎贝尔公司的总裁退休后，麦戈文被选定为继任者。

examples.text: Early in 1941 he was named commander of the Afrika Korps.
examples.translation: 他早在1941年就被任命为非洲军团的指挥官。

examples.text: He had a name for good judgement...
examples.translation: 他以判断准确而闻名。

examples.text: She's never had any drug problems or done anything to give jazz a bad name.
examples.translation: 她从没有吸过毒，也没做过任何有损爵士乐名声的事。

examples.text: ...some of the most famous names in modelling and show business.
examples.translation: 模特和时装界一些最知名的红人

examples.text: ...top names such as Nike, Levi's, Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger.
examples.translation: 耐克、李维斯、CK和汤米·希尔费格之类的顶级名牌

examples.text: The house is in my husband's name...
examples.translation: 房子是我丈夫名下的。

examples.text: A double room had been reserved for him in the name of Muller.
examples.translation: 已用穆勒的名字为他预订了一个双人间。

examples.text: In the United States the majority governs in the name of the people...
examples.translation: 在美国，多数派代表民众执政。

examples.text: She accepted the gift in the name of the Save the Children Fund.
examples.translation: 她代表“拯救儿童基金会”接受了礼物。

examples.text: ...one of those rare occasions in history when a political leader risked his own power in the name of the greater public good...
examples.translation: 历史上少有的例子之一，政治领袖为更大的公共利益，甘冒丢官弃职的风险

examples.text: There had been times when she had felt sickened by the things people did in the name of business.
examples.translation: 有时人们打着做生意的幌子所做的事情让她感到恶心。

examples.text: What in the name of heaven's going on?...
examples.translation: 看在上帝份儿上，这到底是怎么回事？

examples.text: In the name of humanity I ask the government to reappraise this important issue.
examples.translation: 我以人道的名义请求政府重新评估这一重大问题。

examples.text: ...the group, which is now a political party in all but name...
examples.translation: 这一团体，现在是有实无名的政党

examples.text: It's the end of the doctrine in all but name.
examples.translation: 这实际上已是该学说的终结，只是未被道明罢了。

examples.text: He greets customers by name and enquires about their health.
examples.translation: 他跟顾客打招呼时直呼其名，并问他们身体可好。

examples.text: ...a young Australian, Harry Busteed by name...
examples.translation: 名叫哈里·巴斯蒂德的澳大利亚年轻人

examples.text: This guy, Jack Smith, does he go by the name of Jackal?
examples.translation: 这个叫杰克·史密斯的家伙是不是还有个名字叫杰凯尔？

examples.text: At my last school they called me names because I was so slow...
examples.translation: 在之前的学校，因为我反应慢，他们骂过我。

examples.text: They had called her rude names.
examples.translation: 他们用粗鲁的言语谩骂她。

examples.text: Family values are suddenly the name of the game...
examples.translation: 家庭价值观突然变得重要起来。

examples.text: The name of the game is survival.
examples.translation: 重要的是活下去。

examples.text: He had political points of view and lent his name to a lot of causes.
examples.translation: 他很有政治见解，对很多事业都予以支持。

examples.text: She was beginning to make a name for herself as a portrait photographer...
examples.translation: 她开始成为一个小有名气的人像摄影师。

examples.text: He made his name with several collections of short stories.
examples.translation: 他是以几部短篇小说集成名的。

examples.text: Nobody was prepared to risk prosecution by actually naming names.
examples.translation: 没有人愿意冒着被起诉的风险去真正指认别人。

examples.text: The government will also name and shame the worst performing airlines.
examples.translation: 政府还将曝光业绩最差的航空公司。

examples.text: Many of the groups exist in name only...
examples.translation: 许多团体实际上是有名无实。

examples.text: He is commander-in-chief in name only.
examples.translation: 他只是名义上的总司令。

examples.text: Pickled cucumbers, jam, pickled berries, tomatoes; you name it, they've got it...
examples.translation: 酸黄瓜、果酱、腌浆果、西红柿，凡是你说得出的，他们都有。

examples.text: I also enjoy windsurfing, tennis, racquetball, swimming, you name it.
examples.translation: 我也喜欢帆板、网球、短柄墙球、游泳等等，不一而足。

meanings.meaning: 小睡，打盹儿；细毛；孤注一掷

examples.text: Use your lunch hour to have a nap in your chair...
examples.translation: 利用午饭时间坐在椅子上打个盹吧。

examples.text: I might take a little nap.
examples.translation: 我可能会打个盹。

examples.text: An elderly person may nap during the day and then sleep only five hours a night.
examples.translation: 老年人白天会小睡一会儿，然后晚上只睡5个小时。

examples.text: The security services were clearly caught napping.
examples.translation: 保安工作明显有漏洞。

meanings.meaning: 叙事的，叙述的；叙事体的

examples.text: ...a fast-moving narrative...
examples.translation: 快节奏的叙事

examples.text: Sloan began his narrative with the day of the murder.
examples.translation: 斯隆以发生谋杀案的那天作为故事的开端。

examples.text: Neither author was very strong on narrative.
examples.translation: 两个作者都不是很善于讲故事。

examples.text: ...Nye's simple narrative style.
examples.translation: 奈简约的叙事风格

meanings.meaning: 狭窄的，有限的；勉强的；精密的；度量小的

examples.text: ...through the town's narrow streets...
examples.translation: 穿过该镇狭窄的街道

examples.text: She had long, narrow feet.
examples.translation: 她的双脚瘦长。

examples.text: ...the narrow strip of land joining the peninsula to the rest of the island.
examples.translation: 把半岛和岛屿其他部分连在一起的狭长陆地

examples.text: ...the narrowness of the river mouth.
examples.translation: 河口的狭窄

examples.text: The wide track narrows before crossing another stream.
examples.translation: 宽宽的小径在穿过另一条小溪前逐渐收窄。

examples.text: Coggins' eyes narrowed angrily. 'You think I'd tell you?'...
examples.translation: 科金斯气得眯起眼睛。“你认为我会告诉你？”

examples.text: He paused and narrowed his eyes in concentration.
examples.translation: 他停下来，眯起眼睛专注地看着。

examples.text: ...a narrow and outdated view of family life...
examples.translation: 对家庭生活狭隘过时的看法

examples.text: I would have preferred somebody who had wider ideas, and he was rather narrow.
examples.translation: 我会更倾向于一个思路开阔些的人，他的想法太狭隘了。

examples.text: The present A-level system requires schoolchildren to specialise far too early and too narrowly...
examples.translation: 目前的高级程度考试体系过早地要求中小学生学有专攻，也使他们过于局限。

examples.text: They're making judgments based on a narrowly focused vision of the world.
examples.translation: 他们的判断是基于一种狭隘的世界观。

examples.text: ...the narrowness of their mental and spiritual outlook.
examples.translation: 他们心理和精神世界的狭隘

examples.text: Most recent opinion polls suggest that the gap between the two main parties has narrowed...
examples.translation: 最新的民意测验显示这两大主要政党之间的差距已经缩小了。

examples.text: Senate negotiators further narrowed their differences over the level of federal spending for anti-drug programs.
examples.translation: 关于联邦政府在反毒品项目上的支出问题，参议院的谈判代表们进一步缩小了分歧。

examples.text: ...a narrowing of the gap between rich members and poor.
examples.translation: 成员间贫富差距的缩小

examples.text: Delegates have voted by a narrow majority in favour of considering electoral reform.
examples.translation: 代表们投票表决，以微弱多数票赞同考虑选举制度的改革。

examples.text: She narrowly failed to win enough votes...
examples.translation: 她只差一点点就能获得足够的选票。

examples.text: The People's Party is narrowly behind the Socialists in the polls.
examples.translation: 民意测验中人民党以微弱票数之差排在社会党人之后。

examples.text: The narrowness of the government's victory reflected deep division within the Party.
examples.translation: 政府的勉强获胜反映了党内的严重分歧。

examples.text: Two police officers had a narrow escape when separatists attacked their vehicles.
examples.translation: 分裂主义者袭击他们的车辆时，两名警官死里逃生。

examples.text: Five firemen narrowly escaped death when a staircase collapsed beneath their feet.
examples.translation: 他们脚下的一段楼梯坍塌时,5名消防队员险些丧命。

examples.text: If he was shaken by the narrowness of his recent escape he showed no signs of it.
examples.translation: 若说最近死里逃生的经历令他受到了惊吓，那他可一点都没表现出来。

meanings.meaning: 下流的；肮脏的；脾气不好的；险恶的
令人不快的事物 性的吸引力

examples.text: ...an extremely nasty murder...
examples.translation: 令人发指的谋杀

examples.text: This divorce could turn nasty.
examples.translation: 这场离婚可能会撕破脸。

examples.text: ...the nastiness of war.
examples.translation: 战争的残酷

examples.text: What nasty little snobs you all are...
examples.translation: 你们全都是些可恶的势利小人。

examples.text: The guards looked really nasty...
examples.translation: 卫兵们看起来真凶。

examples.text: Mummy is so nasty to me when Daddy isn't here.
examples.translation: 爸爸不在这儿时，妈妈对我很凶。

examples.text: She took the money and eyed me nastily...
examples.translation: 她拿了钱，恶狠狠地打量着我。

examples.text: Nikki laughed nastily.
examples.translation: 妮基恶毒地笑起来。

examples.text: As the years went by his nastiness began to annoy his readers.
examples.translation: 年深日久，他恶毒的文字开始让读者生厌。

examples.text: ...Emily's nasty little house in Balham...
examples.translation: 埃米莉在巴勒姆的脏乱小屋

examples.text: That damned Farrel made some nasty jokes here about Mr. Lane.
examples.translation: 那个该死的法雷尔开了些关于莱恩先生的下流玩笑。

examples.text: A spokesman said this firm action had defused a very nasty situation.
examples.translation: 一位发言人称这一坚决的行动缓和了极为棘手的局面。

examples.text: My little granddaughter caught her heel in the spokes of her bicycle — it was a very nasty wound...
examples.translation: 我小孙女的脚跟夹到自行车的轮辐里了，伤得很严重。

examples.text: Lili had a nasty chest infection.
examples.translation: 莉莉胸部感染很严重。

examples.text: ...evil organisations, peopled with nasties...
examples.translation: 充斥着恶棍的邪恶组织

examples.text: Decaffeinated coffee still contains some stimulants and other nasties linked with cancer.
examples.translation: 脱咖啡因的咖啡仍含一些刺激物和其他可能致癌的有害物质。

examples.text: Such policies would require unprecedented cooperation between nations...
examples.translation: 这样的政策要求国家间进行空前的合作。

examples.text: The Arab nations agreed to meet in Baghdad.
examples.translation: 阿拉伯各国同意在巴格达会晤。

examples.text: It was a story that touched the nation's heart.
examples.translation: 这是一个感动了全体国民的故事。

meanings.meaning: 国家的；国民的；民族的；国立的

examples.text: Ruling parties have lost ground in national and local elections.
examples.translation: 执政党在全国和地区选举中均败北。

examples.text: ...major national and international issues.
examples.translation: 国内和国际重大问题

examples.text: ...a nationally televised speech...
examples.translation: 全国电视讲话

examples.text: Duncan Campbell is nationally known for his investigative work.
examples.translation: 邓肯·坎贝尔因其调查工作闻名全国。

examples.text: ...the national characteristics and history of the country...
examples.translation: 这个国家的民族特征和历史

examples.text: Baseball is the national pastime.
examples.translation: 棒球是全民性的休闲运动。

examples.text: ...a Sri-Lankan-born British national.
examples.translation: 出生于斯里兰卡的英国国民

examples.text: Asked his nationality, he said British...
examples.translation: 被问及国籍时，他说是英国。

examples.text: The crew are of different nationalities and have no common language.
examples.translation: 船员来自不同国家，语言不通。

examples.text: ...the many nationalities that comprise Ethiopia.
examples.translation: 组成埃塞俄比亚的众多民族

meanings.meaning: 本国的；土著的；天然的；与生俱来的；天赋的

examples.text: It was his first visit to his native country since 1948...
examples.translation: 这是自1948年以来他首次回到自己的祖国。

examples.text: Mother Teresa visited her native Albania.
examples.translation: 特雷莎修女访问了她的祖国阿尔巴尼亚。

examples.text: Dr Aubin is a native of St Blaise.
examples.translation: 奥宾博士是圣布莱斯人。

examples.text: ...two Dutch volunteer workmen, natives of Tilburg.
examples.translation: 来自蒂尔堡的两个荷兰志愿工人

examples.text: Joshua Halpern is a native Northern Californian.
examples.translation: 乔舒亚·哈尔彭是土生土长的北加州人。

examples.text: ...men and women native to countries such as Japan.
examples.translation: 出生在像日本这样国家的人们

examples.text: They used force to banish the natives from the more fertile land.
examples.translation: 他们使用武力把土著居民驱逐出了比较肥沃的土地。

examples.text: Native people were allowed to retain some sense of their traditional culture and religion.
examples.translation: 当地原住民获准可以保留一些自己的传统文化和宗教。

examples.text: She spoke not only her native language, Swedish, but also English and French...
examples.translation: 她不仅讲自己的母语瑞典语，还讲英语和法语。

examples.text: French is not my native tongue.
examples.translation: 法语不是我的母语。

examples.text: ...a project to create a 50 acre forest of native Caledonian pines...
examples.translation: 营造50英亩喀里多尼亚土生松树林的项目

examples.text: Many of the plants are native to Brazil.
examples.translation: 这些植物中有很多原产地在巴西。

examples.text: The coconut palm is a native of Malaysia.
examples.translation: 椰子树原产于马来西亚。

examples.text: We have our native inborn talent, yet we hardly use it.
examples.translation: 我们有天生的才能，但我们却几乎未曾使用过。

examples.text: You don't think he's gone native, do you? Perhaps he has married out there and decided he can't come home.
examples.translation: 你觉得他并没有入乡随俗，是吗？可能他和那里的人结了婚，认定回不了家了。

meanings.meaning: 自然的；物质的；天生的；不做作的
自然的事情；白痴；本位音

examples.text: It is only natural for youngsters to crave the excitement of driving a fast car...
examples.translation: 年轻人追求开快车的刺激是太正常不过的事情。

examples.text: It is only natural that he should resent you...
examples.translation: 他怨恨你是很自然的事。

examples.text: A period of depression can be a perfectly natural response to certain aspects of life.
examples.translation: 某段时间感到抑郁可能是对生活某些方面很正常的反应。

examples.text: ...the insect's natural instinct to feed...
examples.translation: 昆虫进食的本能

examples.text: Anger is the natural reaction we experience when we feel threatened or frustrated.
examples.translation: 我们觉得受到威胁或遭受挫折时本能地会感到气愤。

examples.text: She has a natural ability to understand the motives of others...
examples.translation: 她有一种洞察他人动机的天赋。

examples.text: He had a natural flair for business.
examples.translation: 他有做生意的天分。

examples.text: He's a natural with any kind of engine...
examples.translation: 他天生就会摆弄各种发动机。

examples.text: She proved to be a natural on camera.
examples.translation: 事实证明她在镜头前很有表演天赋。

examples.text: Bethan's sister was as friendly and natural as the rest of the family...
examples.translation: 贝唐的妹妹和她家的其他人一样友好、随意。

examples.text: Hannah's natural manner reassured her, and she relaxed.
examples.translation: 汉娜轻松自然的举止消除了她的疑虑，于是她放松了下来。

examples.text: For pictures of people behaving naturally, not posing for the camera, it is essential to shoot unnoticed...
examples.translation: 要拍出不专门摆姿势、举止自然的人物照片，抓拍是关键。

examples.text: She is magnificent at making you feel you can talk quite naturally to her.
examples.translation: 她很了不起，能让你感觉可以自然随意地和她交谈。

examples.text: The critics praised the reality of the scenery and the naturalness of the acting.
examples.translation: 评论家称赞了舞台布景的现实逼真和表演的真实自然。

examples.text: It has called the typhoon the worst natural disaster in South Korea in many years...
examples.translation: 它称这次台风为韩国多年来最严重的自然灾害。

examples.text: The gigantic natural harbour of Poole is a haven for boats.
examples.translation: 巨型天然港普尔港是船只的避风港。

examples.text: Nitrates are chemicals that occur naturally in water and the soil...
examples.translation: 硝酸盐是水和土壤中自然存在的化学物质。

examples.text: Honey is a naturally acidic substance.
examples.translation: 蜂蜜是天然的酸性物质。

examples.text: She has been reunited with her natural mother...
examples.translation: 她和亲生母亲团聚了。

examples.text: His commitments to the stepchildren will not reduce his obligation to his natural children.
examples.translation: 他对继子女的关爱和投入不会减少他对亲生孩子的责任。

examples.text: ...B natural. B
examples.translation: 本位音

examples.text: Is that F a natural or a sharp?
examples.translation: 那个F是本位音还是升半音？

examples.text: According to the Home Office, your brother died of natural causes...
examples.translation: 根据内政部的调查，你哥哥属正常死亡。

examples.text: A prisoner collapsed and died yesterday, apparently from natural causes.
examples.translation: 一名囚犯昨天突然倒下死了，看上去像是正常死亡。

examples.text: The most amazing thing about nature is its infinite variety.
examples.translation: 大自然最让人惊叹的是它的无限多样性。

examples.text: ...grasses that grow wild in nature.
examples.translation: 自然界里各种野生的草

examples.text: ...the ecological balance of nature.
examples.translation: 自然界的生态平衡

examples.text: Mr Sharp would not comment on the nature of the issues being investigated.
examples.translation: 夏普先生不愿就被调查问题的性质发表评论。

examples.text: ...the ambitious nature of the programme...
examples.translation: 雄心勃勃的计划

examples.text: The protests had been non-political by nature...
examples.translation: 这些抗议活动不带政治色彩。

examples.text: The rise of a major power is both economic and military in nature.
examples.translation: 一个大国的崛起究其实质包括经济和军事两个方面。

examples.text: Jeya feels that her ambitious nature made her unsuitable for an arranged marriage...
examples.translation: 耶娅觉得她不安分的个性不适合包办的婚姻。

examples.text: She trusted people. That was her nature...
examples.translation: 她信任别人，这是她的天性。

examples.text: He was by nature affectionate.
examples.translation: 他生性温柔亲切。

examples.text: All these activities are against nature.
examples.translation: 所有这些活动都是违背常理的。

examples.text: She was very anxious to get away from cities and back to nature.
examples.translation: 她特别渴望离开城市，回归自然。

examples.text: Peacekeeping, by its nature, makes pre-planning difficult...
examples.translation: 维和行动本身的特点决定了预先制订计划很困难。

examples.text: One could argue that smoking, by its very nature, is addictive.
examples.translation: 有人可能认为抽烟从本质上说就具有成瘾性。

examples.text: I'm afraid I have to answer a call of nature.
examples.translation: 抱歉我要去趟洗手间。

examples.text: Of course, in the nature of things, and with a lot of drinking going on, people failed to notice...
examples.translation: 喝了那么多酒，大家当然没能察觉到。

examples.text: Many have already died, and in the nature of things many more will die.
examples.translation: 很多人已经死去，更多的人势必也将会死去。

examples.text: There is movement towards, I think, something in the nature of a pluralistic system...
examples.translation: 我想，出现了某种向类似多元体系转变的趋势。

examples.text: It was in the nature of a debate rather than an argument.
examples.translation: 那更像是一场辩论，而不是争吵。

examples.text: Planning ahead had always come as second nature to her...
examples.translation: 预先计划一直是她的习惯。

examples.text: It's not easy at first, but it soon becomes second nature.
examples.translation: 起初不容易，但很快就习惯了。

meanings.meaning: 顽皮的，淘气的；不听话的；没规矩的；不适当的；下流的

examples.text: Girls, you're being very naughty...
examples.translation: 姑娘们，你们真是淘气。

examples.text: You naughty boy, you gave me such a fright.
examples.translation: 你这调皮鬼，吓了我一跳。

examples.text: When he poked his tongue at the press it was just a young boy's natural naughtiness.
examples.translation: 他冲着媒体记者们伸舌头，只是出于小男孩顽皮的天性。

examples.text: You know what little boys are like with naughty words.
examples.translation: 你知道小男孩们说下流话是什么样子。

examples.text: ...saucy TV shows, crammed full of naughty innuendo.
examples.translation: 充斥着淫猥暗示的下流电视节目

examples.text: ...a writer who shocked the bourgeoisie with his sexual naughtiness.
examples.translation: 以露骨性描写震惊中产阶级的作家

examples.text: He was the senior serving naval officer.
examples.translation: 他那时是现役海军高级军官。

examples.text: ...the US naval base at Guantanamo Bay.
examples.translation: 关塔那摩湾美国海军基地

examples.text: The government announced an order for three Type 23 frigates for the Royal Navy yesterday...
examples.translation: 政府昨天宣布为皇家海军订购3艘23型护卫舰。

examples.text: Her own son was also in the Navy.
examples.translation: 她自己的儿子那时也在海军。

examples.text: ...a United States navy ship.
examples.translation: 一艘美国海军军舰

examples.text: I mostly wore black or navy trousers.
examples.translation: 我大部分时间穿黑色或深蓝色裤子。

examples.text: ...a navy-blue blazer.
examples.translation: 海军蓝的便上装

examples.text: He might easily have been seen by someone who lived nearby...
examples.translation: 住在附近的人很可能有谁见过他。

examples.text: He spoke softly to a couple standing nearby...
