examples.translation: 他轻声和站在旁边的一对夫妇说话。

examples.text: There is less expensive accommodation nearby...
examples.translation: 附近有不太贵的住处。

examples.text: There were one or two suspicious looks from nearby.
examples.translation: 附近有一两个人投来怀疑的目光。

examples.text: At a nearby table a man was complaining in a loud voice...
examples.translation: 邻桌的一位男士当时正高声地抱怨着。

examples.text: ...the nearby village of Crowthorne.
examples.translation: 附近的克罗索恩村

examples.text: Don't come near me...
examples.translation: 别靠近我。

examples.text: Her children went back every year to stay in a farmhouse near the cottage...
examples.translation: 她的孩子们每年都回去，住在小屋边的农舍里。

examples.text: He drew his chair nearer the fire...
examples.translation: 他把椅子拉得更靠近炉火一些。

examples.text: Some of the houses nearest the bridge were on fire.
examples.translation: 离桥最近的一些房屋着火了。

examples.text: He crouched as near to the door as he could...
examples.translation: 他蹲得距门尽可能近。

examples.text: She took a step nearer to the barrier...
examples.translation: 她朝障碍物又迈近了一步。

examples.text: As we drew near, I saw that the boot lid was up.
examples.translation: 我们靠近时，我看见汽车行李箱的盖子翘了起来。

examples.text: He collapsed into the nearest chair...
examples.translation: 他倒在离他最近的那张椅子上。

examples.text: Where's the nearest telephone?...
examples.translation: 最近的电话亭在哪儿？

examples.text: He went back into the bedroom, slipped into the nearer bed, and said goodnight...
examples.translation: 他回到卧室，悄悄爬上离他较近的那张床，道了声晚安。

examples.text: The nearer of the two barges was perhaps a mile away.
examples.translation: 两艘驳船中较近的那艘可能有一英里远。

examples.text: He was suddenly aware of his nearness.
examples.translation: 他突然意识到离得近了。

examples.text: After the war, The House of Hardie came near to bankruptcy...
examples.translation: 战后，哈迪家族濒于破产。

examples.text: The repairs to the Hafner machine were near to completion...
examples.translation: 对哈夫纳机器的修理即将结束。

examples.text: Apart from anything else, he comes near to contradicting himself.
examples.translation: 不说别的，他几乎自己就是自相矛盾。

examples.text: He was near tears...
examples.translation: 他几乎要哭出来了。

examples.text: For almost a month he lay near death...
examples.translation: 他几乎有一个月的时间卧床不起，命悬一线。

examples.text: We are no nearer agreement now than in the past.
examples.translation: 我们现在和过去一样，还是不能达成一致意见。

examples.text: ...a sickening sensation that was near to nausea.
examples.translation: 近乎恶心的难受感觉

examples.text: Often her feelings were nearer hatred than love.
examples.translation: 她的感情常常是恨而不是爱。

examples.text: It would appear that the legal profession is the nearest thing to a recession-proof industry...
examples.translation: 司法行业看来是最不易受经济萧条影响的领域了。

examples.text: He is the nearest to a dead cert that Britain has in Albertville.
examples.translation: 他是英国在阿尔贝维尔冬奥会上最有希望夺取金牌的选手。

examples.text: The time for my departure from Japan was drawing nearer every day.
examples.translation: 我离开日本的日子一天天近了。

examples.text: Performance is lowest between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m., and reaches a peak near midday...
examples.translation: 凌晨3点至5点表现最差，近中午时分最好。

examples.text: 'Since I retired to this place,' he wrote near the end of his life, 'I have never been out of these mountains.'...
examples.translation: “自从隐居到这里，”他在生命即将结束时写道，“我一直没有离开过这些大山。”

examples.text: I'll tell you nearer the day.
examples.translation: 那一天临近时我会告诉你。

examples.text: ...to increase manufacturing from about 2.5 million cars a year to nearer 4.75 million...
examples.translation: 将轿车年产量从250万辆左右增加到接近475万辆

examples.text: The pound, which ended last year near its annual low, is expected to come under renewed pressure today.
examples.translation: 英镑去年年终降到了接近全年最低点的水平，预计今天将再度面临汇价下跌的压力。

examples.text: He will absolutely not go near a hospital...
examples.translation: 他绝对不会去医院。

examples.text: I'm so annoyed with her that I haven't been near her for a week.
examples.translation: 我很生她的气,有一个星期没见她了。

examples.text: ...a mighty beech tree on the near side of the little clearing...
examples.translation: 矗立在林间小块空地近侧的一棵高大的山毛榉树

examples.text: Jane put one foot in the near stirrup and turned to look at the stranger.
examples.translation: 简一只脚就近蹬上马镫，转脸看着陌生人。

examples.text: She was believed to have died in near poverty on the French Riviera.
examples.translation: 据信她在法国里维埃拉去世时几乎身无分文。

examples.text: ...the 48-year-old who was brought in to rescue the bank from near collapse.
examples.translation: 被调来帮助银行摆脱濒临破产困境的48岁的新任

examples.text: ...his near fatal accident two years ago...
examples.translation: 两年前令他差点丧命的事故

examples.text: The picture beneath was near lifesize.
examples.translation: 下方的这幅画几乎和实体一样大小。

examples.text: He completed the lengthy course some three seconds faster than his nearest rival, Jonathon Ford...
examples.translation: 他比劲敌乔纳森·福特少用了大概3秒钟完成了漫长的赛程。

examples.text: That victory put the Ukrainians beyond the reach of their nearest challengers, Dynamo Moscow.
examples.translation: 本场胜利使乌克兰人甩开了最强有力的对手，莫斯科迪那摩队。

examples.text: As he neared the stable, he slowed the horse and patted it on the neck...
examples.translation: 接近马厩时，他勒马缓行，轻拍它的脖颈。

examples.text: We were nearing the top of the pass to Tsagochen Thang when the van spluttered and died.
examples.translation: 我们在驶近通往 Tsagochen Thang 的垭口时，货车噼啪几声熄火了。

examples.text: His age was hard to guess — he must have been nearing fifty...
examples.translation: 很难猜测他的年龄，他一定快50了。

examples.text: You are nearing the end of your training and you haven't attempted any assessments yet...
examples.translation: 培训快结束了，你还没有参加任何评估测试。

examples.text: The project is taking a long time but is now nearing completion.
examples.translation: 这个项目耗时很长，但现在就快结束了。

examples.text: As half time neared, Hardyman almost scored twice...
examples.translation: 临近中场休息时，哈迪曼差点梅开二度。

examples.text: This factor will come increasingly to the fore as election day nears.
examples.translation: 随着选举日的临近，这一因素将愈发重要。

examples.text: ...that English convention of not showing your feelings, even to your nearest and dearest.
examples.translation: 甚至不向最亲近的人流露自己情感的英国社会习俗

examples.text: People would gather from near and far...
examples.translation: 人们会从四面八方聚到一起。

examples.text: Within months his reputation spread near and far.
examples.translation: 没几个月他就远近闻名了。

examples.text: The controversy regarding vitamin C is unlikely to be resolved in the near future.
examples.translation: 关于维生素C的争议短期内不可能平息。

examples.text: They are nowhere near good enough...
examples.translation: 他们还远不够好。

examples.text: It was nowhere near as painful as David had expected...
examples.translation: 这远不如戴维所料想的那么痛苦。

examples.text: The state pension is nowhere near enough.
examples.translation: 国家养老金还远远不够。

examples.text: I bought them for a pound apiece, near enough...
examples.translation: 我几乎是以一英镑一件的价钱买下了它们。

examples.text: They are as near as dammit new...
examples.translation: 它们几乎是新的。

examples.text: As a second lieutenant, he had to salute damned near everybody.
examples.translation: 身为少尉，他几乎是逢人便得敬礼。

examples.text: He damned near fooled me...
examples.translation: 他险些把我骗了。

examples.text: As he was to tell Miranda later, he as near as dammit left it there.
examples.translation: 像他随后告诉米兰达的那样，他几乎没碰它。

examples.text: Goldsworth stared at me in silence for nearly twenty seconds...
examples.translation: 将近20秒的时间，戈兹沃思就那么一声不响地盯着我看。

examples.text: Hunter knew nearly all of this already...
examples.translation: 这事亨特几乎已全知道了。

examples.text: Several times Thorne nearly fell...
examples.translation: 有好几次索恩都差点跌倒。

examples.text: I nearly had a heart attack when she told me...
examples.translation: 当她告诉我时，我差点没犯心脏病。

examples.text: The beach was nearly empty...
examples.translation: 海滩差不多空无一人了。

examples.text: They nearly always ate outside.
examples.translation: 他们几乎总在外面吃饭。

examples.text: It was already nearly eight o'clock...
examples.translation: 已经快8点了。

examples.text: I was nearly asleep...
examples.translation: 我差不多都睡着了。

examples.text: The voyage is nearly over...
examples.translation: 航行即将结束。

examples.text: You're nearly there...
examples.translation: 你就快猜到了。

examples.text: I've nearly finished the words for your song.
examples.translation: 我马上就要完成你那首歌的歌词了。

examples.text: Father's flat in Paris wasn't nearly as grand as this...
examples.translation: 爸爸在法国的公寓远不如这处宽敞。

examples.text: Minerals in general are not nearly so well absorbed as other nutrients...
examples.translation: 总体来说，矿物质远远不如其他营养成分好吸收。

examples.text: British car workers did not earn nearly enough money to buy the products they were turning out.
examples.translation: 英国汽车工人的工资远不足以购买自己制造的产品。

meanings.meaning: 灵巧的；整洁的；优雅的；齐整的；未搀水的；平滑的

examples.text: So they left her in the neat little house, alone with her memories...
examples.translation: 于是他们把她一个人留在整洁的小房子里，只有记忆陪着她。

examples.text: She undressed and put her wet clothes in a neat pile in the corner.
examples.translation: 她脱掉衣服，把湿衣服整齐地码成一堆放在角落里。

examples.text: ...a girl in a neat grey flannel suit...
examples.translation: 身着整洁的灰色法兰绒套装的女孩

examples.text: Everything was neat and tidy and gleamingly clean.
examples.translation: 所有的东西都整整齐齐、干干净净、闪闪发亮。

examples.text: He folded his paper neatly and sipped his coffee...
examples.translation: 他把报纸整齐地叠起来，然后抿了口咖啡。

examples.text: At the door was a neatly dressed, dignified man.
examples.translation: 门口站着一位穿戴整齐、仪态庄重的男子。

examples.text: The grounds were a perfect balance between neatness and natural wildness.
examples.translation: 这些庭园是整齐有序和天然粗放的完美结合。

examples.text: 'That's not like Alf,' he said, 'leaving papers muddled like that. He's always so neat.'
examples.translation: 他说道：“这不像是阿尔夫的风格，他不会把文件弄得那么乱。他一向很爱整洁。”

examples.text: I followed her into that room which her mother had maintained so neatly...
examples.translation: 我跟着她走进那个她妈妈收拾得十分整洁的房间。

examples.text: He had maybe a thousand tapes, all neatly labelled and catalogued.
examples.translation: 他大约有1,000盒磁带，都整齐地贴着标签并分了类。

examples.text: ...a paragon of neatness, efficiency and reliability.
examples.translation: 整洁、高效与可靠的典范

examples.text: ...a faded woman with neat features.
examples.translation: 姿色虽衰但五官清秀的女人

examples.text: ...neat handwriting.
examples.translation: 娟秀的笔迹

examples.text: She was a small woman, slender and neatly made.
examples.translation: 她是一个玲珑娇小的女士，身材苗条匀称。

examples.text: A neat move between Black and Keane left Nigel Clough in the clear, but his shot skimmed wide of the far post.
examples.translation: 奈杰尔·克拉夫凭借一次漂亮的跑位在布莱克和基恩之间扯出了空当儿，但是他的射门却大大偏出了远门柱。

examples.text: He watched her peel and dissect a pear neatly, no mess, no sticky fingers.
examples.translation: 他看着她利索地削完梨，再切成块，没有弄得乱七八糟，手指也没弄得黏糊糊的。

examples.text: ...watching a solitary car backing out neatly.
examples.translation: 看着单独一辆车利落地倒了出来

examples.text: It had been such a neat, clever plan...
examples.translation: 这曾是个如此巧妙、机智的计划。

examples.text: Neat solutions are not easily found to these issues...
examples.translation: 很难找到解决这些问题的巧妙办法。

examples.text: 'Make the punishment fit the crime.' How neat and tidy it sounded.
examples.translation: “罪罚相当”，这听起来多么简洁。

examples.text: Real people do not fit neatly into these categories...
examples.translation: 现实中的人是没法简单地归入这些类别的。

examples.text: The theory that personality is determined by our biology neatly lets everyone off the hook.
examples.translation: 个性是由生物学特征决定的，这种理论让我们每个人都可以解脱了。

examples.text: He knew full well he had been outflanked, and he appreciated the neatness of it.
examples.translation: 他十分清楚自己已经输了，他很欣赏这种干净利落的落败方式。

examples.text: 'Oh, those new apartments are really neat,' the girl babbled on...
examples.translation: 那个女孩赞不绝口地说：“噢，那些新公寓真是非常棒。”

examples.text: It'll be neat to have a father and son playing on the same team...
examples.translation: 爸爸和儿子同队效力，那真是太棒了。

examples.text: He thought Mick was a really neat guy.
examples.translation: 他认为米克真是一个好小伙。

examples.text: He poured himself a brandy and swallowed it neat...
examples.translation: 他给自己倒了一杯白兰地，没兑水就一饮而尽。

examples.text: He took a mouthful of neat whisky, and coughed.
examples.translation: 他喝了一口纯威士忌，咳嗽了起来。

examples.text: I kept the engine running because it might be necessary to leave fast...
examples.translation: 我没让发动机熄火，因为也许需要迅速离开。

examples.text: We will do whatever is necessary to stop them...
examples.translation: 我们要采取一切必要措施去阻止他们。

examples.text: Is that really necessary?...
examples.translation: 那真有必要吗？

examples.text: Make the necessary arrangements.
examples.translation: 做一下必要的安排。

examples.text: Wastage was no doubt a necessary consequence of war...
examples.translation: 巨大的损耗无疑是战争的必然结果。

examples.text: Scientific work is differentiated from art by its necessary connection with the idea of progress.
examples.translation: 科学工作与艺术的区别在于它与人类进步有着必然联系。

examples.text: ...a small parcel of necessaries tied up in a handkerchief and carried on a stick.
examples.translation: 用手绢包好挑在棍子上的一小包生活必需品

examples.text: If necessary, the airship can stay up there for days to keep out of danger...
examples.translation: 必要时，飞艇能在那里停留数天以躲避危险。

examples.text: The army needs men who are willing to fight, when necessary...
examples.translation: 军队需要在必要时愿意投入战斗的军人。

examples.text: All the rigging had been examined, and renewed where necessary.
examples.translation: 所有索具都进行了检查，并把该更换的部件全部更换一新。

examples.text: A prolonged drought had necessitated the introduction of water rationing...
examples.translation: 由于持续干旱，用水需要实行配给了。

examples.text: Frank was carrying out fuel-system tests which necessitated turning the booster pumps off.
examples.translation: 弗兰克在做燃料系统测试，这一测试需要关掉升压泵。

examples.text: There is agreement on the necessity of reforms...
examples.translation: 对改革的必要性已经达成了共识。

examples.text: As soon as the necessity for action is over the troops must be withdrawn...
examples.translation: 一旦军事行动的必要性不复存在，军队就必须撤出。

examples.text: Most women, like men, work from economic necessity...
examples.translation: 与男人一样，大部分女人也是出于经济原因而工作。

examples.text: Some people have to lead stressful lifestyles out of necessity.
examples.translation: 一些人迫于生计不得不过着紧张忙碌的生活。

examples.text: The assembly line of necessity kept moving...
examples.translation: 生产线势必保持运转下去。

examples.text: Negotiations between the enemies are of necessity indirect.
examples.translation: 敌手之间的谈判必定是间接的。

examples.text: Water is a basic necessity of life.
examples.translation: 生命离不开水。

examples.text: ...food, fuel and other daily necessities.
examples.translation: 食物、燃料和其他日常必需品

examples.text: The President pleaded that strong rule from the centre was a regrettable, but temporary necessity.
examples.translation: 总统辩解说，实行高度的中央集权虽不尽如人意，但暂时来说却是必要的。

meanings.meaning: 使变细；与…搂著脖子亲吻

examples.text: She threw her arms round his neck and hugged him warmly...
examples.translation: 她伸出双臂搂住他的脖子，热情地拥抱他。

examples.text: He was short and stocky, and had a thick neck.
examples.translation: 他矮壮结实，脖子很粗。

examples.text: ...the low, ruffled neck of her blouse...
examples.translation: 她的打褶低胸的衬衫领口

examples.text: He wore a blue shirt open at the neck.
examples.translation: 他穿了件蓝衬衫，领口敞开着。

examples.text: Catherine gripped the broken neck of the bottle.
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳紧握着破裂的瓶颈。

examples.text: ...cancer of the neck of the womb.
examples.translation: 宫颈癌

examples.text: They sat talking and necking in the car for another ten minutes...
examples.translation: 他们在车里又坐了10分钟，边说边搂着亲热。

examples.text: I found myself behind a curtain, necking with my best friend's wife.
examples.translation: 我意识到自己在帘子后面吻着至友的妻子。

examples.text: Cee En Cee went on to win by a neck from Leigh Crofter.
examples.translation: 西恩西再次以微弱优势战胜莉·克罗夫特。

examples.text: Most farmers have bank managers breathing down their necks.
examples.translation: 大部分农场主的一举一动都受到银行经理们的密切关注。

examples.text: The latest polls indicate that the two main parties are neck and neck...
examples.translation: 最近的一次民意测验显示两个主要政党难分高下。

examples.text: The party is running neck-and-neck with Labour.
examples.translation: 该党和工党目前是旗鼓相当。

examples.text: I won't have him risking his neck on that motorcycle.
examples.translation: 我不会让他冒险骑那辆摩托车。

examples.text: He had enough friends in the right places to save his neck and cover up for him...
examples.translation: 他有很多朋友能保全他，帮他打掩护。

examples.text: He said the President was making a last ditch attempt to save his own neck.
examples.translation: 他说总统正在作最后的努力，希望保住自己的声誉。

examples.text: During my political life I've earned myself a reputation as someone who'll stick his neck out, a bit of a rebel.
examples.translation: 我在政治生涯中敢冒风险、有点叛逆是小有名气的。

examples.text: No-one should start working life with a debt round their neck...
examples.translation: 任何人都不该身背债务开始工作生涯。

examples.text: It's a legacy which will hang around the country's neck for some time to come.
examples.translation: 这项遗留问题在未来的一段时间内仍将困扰这个国家。

examples.text: The black market was flourishing, everybody was corrupt, in it up to their necks...
examples.translation: 黑市繁荣，每个人都已堕落，深陷其中。

examples.text: He is probably up to his neck in debt.
examples.translation: 他很有可能债务缠身。

examples.text: It's so good to see you. What brings you to this neck of the woods?
examples.translation: 见到你真高兴，哪阵风把你吹来了？

examples.text: ...a diamond necklace and matching earrings.
examples.translation: 钻石项链和与之相配的耳环

examples.text: Alleged strike breakers had their houses petrol-bombed or were hacked to death or necklaced.
examples.translation: 破坏罢工的嫌疑人，其房屋遭汽油弹炸毁，人被砍死或被套上火项链烧死。

examples.text: ...the gruesome practice of necklacing.
examples.translation: 用火项链处决人的令人毛骨悚然的做法

meanings.meaning: 需要，要求；缺乏；必要之物

examples.text: Need sometimes behaves like an ordinary verb, for example 'She needs to know' and 'She doesn't need to know' and sometimes like a modal, for example 'She need know', 'She needn't know', or, in more formal English, 'She need not know.' need
examples.translation: 有时用作普通动词，例如：She needs to know (她需要知道)，She doesn't need to know (她不需要知道)。有时 need 用作情态动词，例如：She need know, She needn't know 或更为正式的说法：She need not know。

examples.text: These diets provide everything your body needs...
examples.translation: 这些饮食提供了你身体需要的所有营养。

examples.text: I need to make a phone call...
examples.translation: 我要打个电话。

examples.text: A baby does not need to wear shoes until he starts to walk...
examples.translation: 婴儿在开始走路前不需要穿鞋。

examples.text: I need you to do something for me...
examples.translation: 我需要你为我做点儿什么。

examples.text: I need you here, Wally...
examples.translation: 我这儿需要你，沃利。

examples.text: I need you sane and sober.
examples.translation: 我要你清醒、冷静。

examples.text: Charles has never felt the need to compete with anyone.
examples.translation: 查尔斯从未感到有与任何人竞争的必要。

examples.text: ...the child who never had his need for attention and importance satisfied.
examples.translation: 渴望得到关注和重视但从未获得过满足的孩子

examples.text: ...the special nutritional needs of the elderly.
examples.translation: 老年人的特殊营养需要

examples.text: The building needs quite a few repairs.
examples.translation: 该建筑有好几处应该修缮。

examples.text: ...a garden that needs tidying...
examples.translation: 应该清整的花园

examples.text: The taste of vitamins is not too nice so the flavour sometimes needs to be disguised.
examples.translation: 维生素的口味不太好，所以有时需要掩盖一下。

examples.text: Mr Forrest believes there is a need for other similar schools throughout Britain...
examples.translation: 福里斯特先生认为全英国都需要有类似的学校。

examples.text: 'I think we should see a specialist.' — 'I don't think there's any need for that.'...
examples.translation: “我想我们应该见见专家。”——“我认为没有任何必要。”

examples.text: There's no need for you to stay.
examples.translation: 你不需要呆在这儿了。

examples.text: 'I'll put the key in the window.' — 'You needn't bother,' he said gruffly...
examples.translation: “我会把钥匙放在窗户里。”——“不必麻烦了，”他粗声说道。

examples.text: Look, you needn't shout...
examples.translation: 嗨，你不必大喊大叫。

examples.text: She need not know I'm here.
examples.translation: 她不必知道我在这儿。

examples.text: Well, for Heaven's sake, you don't need to apologize...
examples.translation: 噢，看在上天的份上，你不用道歉。

examples.text: Come along, Mother, we don't need to take up any more of Mr Kemp's time.
examples.translation: 走吧，妈妈，我们不必再打扰肯普先生了。

examples.text: You needn't worry...
examples.translation: 你不必担心。

examples.text: This needn't take long, Simon...
examples.translation: 西蒙，这花不了多长时间。

examples.text: Buying budget-priced furniture needn't mean compromising on quality or style...
examples.translation: 买价钱经济的家具并不意味着就要牺牲质量和样式。

examples.text: Loneliness can be horrible, but it need not remain that way...
examples.translation: 孤独可能会很可怕，但也并非一定如此。

examples.text: He need never drink again if he doesn't want to.
examples.translation: 如果他不想喝酒的话，他可以永远不再喝了。

examples.text: He replied, with a reassuring smile, 'Oh, you don't need to worry about them.'...
examples.translation: 他面带让人安心的微笑回答道：“噢，你不必为他们担心。”

examples.text: You don't need to be a millionaire to consider having a bank account in Switzerland.
examples.translation: 想在瑞士银行开个账户，你不必非得是个百万富翁。

examples.text: You needn't come again, if you don't want to...
examples.translation: 如果你不想来，可以不用再来。

examples.text: Well, you needn't tell me anything if you don't want to.
examples.translation: 好吧，如果你不想告诉我，可以什么也不说。

examples.text: You don't need to wait for me...
examples.translation: 你不必等我。

examples.text: Mommy, you don't need to stay while we talk.
examples.translation: 妈妈，我们谈话时你不必陪着。

examples.text: What is right for us need not be right for others...
examples.translation: 对我们来说是对的东西，对别人来说未必正确。

examples.text: Freedom need not mean independence.
examples.translation: 自由不一定意味着独立。

examples.text: She could have made the sandwich herself; her mum needn't have bothered to do anything...
examples.translation: 她本来可以自己做三明治的;她妈妈原本不必费心做任何事情。

examples.text: I was a little nervous when I announced my engagement to Grace, but I needn't have worried...
examples.translation: 我宣布和格雷丝订婚时有点紧张，但我本不必担心的。

examples.text: We spent a hell of a lot of money that we needn't have spent.
examples.translation: 我们花了很多本来不需要花的钱。

examples.text: You didn't need to give me any more money you know, but thank you.
examples.translation: 你看你原本不必再给我钱的，但还是要谢谢你。

examples.text: I needn't add that if you fail to do as I ask, you will suffer the consequences.
examples.translation: 如果你没按我的要求做的话，后果请自负——这话我就不必再说了吧。

examples.text: I hardly need to say that I have never lost contact with him.
examples.translation: 几乎不用说，我从未和他失去联系。

examples.text: Mid-fifties, short black hair, grey moustache, distinctive Russian accent. Need I go on?
examples.translation: 五十四五岁，黑色短发，灰色八字胡，明显的俄国口音，还需要我继续说吗？

examples.text: The education authorities have to provide for children in need...
examples.translation: 教育主管部门得救助贫困儿童。

examples.text: Remember that when both of you were in need, I was the one who loaned you money.
examples.translation: 记住，在你们两个都有困难的时候，是我借钱给你们的。

examples.text: I was all right but in need of rest...
examples.translation: 我没事，就是需要休息一下。

examples.text: He was badly in need of a shave...
examples.translation: 他早就应该刮一下胡子了。

examples.text: The house was in need of modernisation when they bought it.
examples.translation: 他们买下时，这栋房子需要进行现代化改造。

examples.text: They will now seek permission to take their case to the House of Lords, and, if need be, to the European Court of Human Rights.
examples.translation: 他们现在将争取获准将案件呈交上议院审理，并且，如有必要，会上诉到欧洲人权法院。

examples.text: There's no need to call a doctor...
examples.translation: 没有必要叫医生。

examples.text: There's no need for that kind of language in this magazine...
examples.translation: 这份杂志没必要出现那种语言。

examples.text: 'I'm going to come with you.'—'Now look, Sue, there's no need.'
examples.translation: “我跟你一起去。”——“休，你看，没这个必要。”

examples.text: With apologies to my old history teacher, who needs history lessons?...
examples.translation: 这话对不住我亲爱的历史老师，不过有谁需要历史课呢？

examples.text: Cigarettes, who needs them?
examples.translation: 香烟，谁会要呀？

examples.text: She took the needle off the record and turned the lights out.
examples.translation: 她把唱针从唱片上移开，把灯也关了。

examples.text: She kept looking at the dial on the boiler. The needle had reached 250 degrees.
examples.translation: 她一直看着锅炉上的刻度盘，指针已指向了250度。

examples.text: The carpet of pine needles was soft underfoot.
examples.translation: 脚下厚厚的松针踩上去软绵绵的。

examples.text: Blake could see he had needled Jerrold, which might be unwise.
examples.translation: 布莱克看得出他已经惹怒了杰罗尔德，这也许并不是什么明智之举。

meanings.meaning: [数] 负的；消极的；否定的；阴性的

examples.text: The news from overseas is overwhelmingly negative...
examples.translation: 来自海外的消息特别不容乐观。

examples.text: All this had an extremely negative effect on the criminal justice system.
examples.translation: 这一切对刑事司法制度产生了极坏的影响。

examples.text: This will negatively affect the result over the first half of the year.
examples.translation: 这将对上半年的结果产生不利影响。

examples.text: When asked for your views about your current job, on no account must you be negative about it...
examples.translation: 被问及你对自己目前工作的看法时，无论如何不要流露出消极情绪。

examples.text: Why does the media present such a negative view of this splendid city?
examples.translation: 媒体为什么对这座光彩夺目的城市持如此悲观的看法？

examples.text: A few weeks later he said that maybe he viewed all his relationships rather negatively.
examples.translation: 几个星期后，他说他也许把自己的各种人际关系看得太消极了。

examples.text: I loathe negativity. I can't stand people who moan.
examples.translation: 我厌恶消极态度，不能忍受唉声叹气的人。

examples.text: Dr Velayati gave a vague but negative response...
examples.translation: 韦拉亚提医生给了一个含糊而否定的回答。

examples.text: Upon a negative decision, the applicant loses the protection offered by Belgian law...
examples.translation: 一旦得到否定裁决，申请人就失去了比利时法律的保护。

examples.text: The Tory response to that was negative.
examples.translation: 保守党对此的答复是否定的。

examples.text: 60 percent of the sample answered negatively...
examples.translation: 抽样调查中60％的接受调查者作出了否定回答。

examples.text: Stein shook his head slowly, negatively.
examples.translation: 斯坦慢慢摇了摇头，表示否定。

examples.text: In the past we have heard only negatives when it came to following a healthy diet.
examples.translation: 说到遵循健康饮食习惯，我们过去听到的都是否定的说法。

examples.text: So far 57 have taken the test and all have been negative.
examples.translation: 到目前为止，参加测试的有57人，测试结果均呈阴性。

examples.text: ...negative test results.
examples.translation: 阴性测试结果

examples.text: Stimulate the site of greatest pain with a small negative current.
examples.translation: 以微弱负电流刺激疼得最厉害的部位。

examples.text: As these electrons are negatively charged they will attempt to repel each other.
examples.translation: 因为这些电子都带负电，它们将会互相排斥。

examples.text: The weakest students can end up with a negative score.
examples.translation: 最差的学生可能会以负分收场。

examples.text: The Council answered those questions in the negative...
examples.translation: 委员会对那些问题的答复是否定的。

examples.text: Seventy-nine voted in the affirmative, and none in the negative.
examples.translation: 79人投赞成票，没有人投反对票。

examples.text: 'I went' in the negative is 'I did not go'.
examples.translation: I went (我去了)的否定式是 I did not go (我没去)。

examples.text: The woman denied that she had neglected her child...
examples.translation: 那位女士否认疏于照管自己的孩子。

examples.text: Feed plants and they grow, neglect them and they suffer.
examples.translation: 人勤地生宝;人懒地长草。

examples.text: ...an ancient and neglected church.
examples.translation: 疏于维护的古教堂

examples.text: The town's old quayside is collapsing after years of neglect...
examples.translation: 镇上老码头区多年来疏于维护，快要塌陷了。

examples.text: Niwano's business began to suffer from neglect.
examples.translation: 尼瓦诺的生意因为疏于管理而开始出现问题。

examples.text: He'd given too much to his career, worked long hours, neglected her...
examples.translation: 他为事业付出太多，长时间地工作，忽视了她。

examples.text: If you are not careful, children tend to neglect their homework.
examples.translation: 如果你不注意的话，孩子们往往会不重视他们的家庭作业。

examples.text: The fact that she is not coming today makes her grandmother feel lonely and neglected.
examples.translation: 她今天不来，这让她奶奶感到孤独，觉得受了冷落。

examples.text: ... a neglected aspect of London's forgotten history...
examples.translation: 伦敦湮没的历史中被忽略了的一个方面

examples.text: The journal she had begun lay neglected on her bedside table.
examples.translation: 她早就开始看的那本杂志搁在床头柜上，好久没翻了。

examples.text: We often neglect to make proper use of our bodies...
examples.translation: 我们经常忘记该合理地使用我们的身体。

examples.text: They never neglect their duties.
examples.translation: 他们从未玩忽职守。

meanings.meaning: 微不足道的，可以忽略的

examples.text: The pay that the soldiers received was negligible...
examples.translation: 士兵拿到的军饷少得可怜。

examples.text: Senior managers are convinced that the strike will have a negligible impact.
examples.translation: 高层主管们相信罢工的影响微不足道。

examples.text: One of those volcanoes, Cerro Negro, is close to Leon and popular as a day trip.
It is not clear whether the president is willing to negotiate with the democrats...
examples.translation: 还不清楚总统是否愿意和民主人士洽谈。

examples.text: When you have two adversaries negotiating, you need to be on neutral territory...
examples.translation: 让敌对双方坐下来谈判时，你得保持中立。

examples.text: The local government and the army negotiated a truce...
examples.translation: 地方政府和部队经过谈判达成休战协定。

examples.text: Western governments have this week urged him to negotiate and avoid force...
examples.translation: 西方各国政府本周敦促他进行谈判，避免使用武力。

examples.text: The South African president has negotiated an end to white-minority rule...
examples.translation: 南非总统已通过谈判达成协议，结束了少数白人的统治。

examples.text: His publishing house had just begun negotiating for her next books...
examples.translation: 他的出版社刚刚开始就她随后几本书的出版问题进行商谈。

examples.text: There were reports that three companies were negotiating to market the drug.
examples.translation: 有报道说，有3家公司在洽谈这种药的市场推广。

examples.text: Frank Mariano negotiates the desert terrain in his battered pickup...
examples.translation: 弗兰克·马里亚诺驾驶他那辆破烂不堪的皮卡车成功穿越了沙漠地带。

examples.text: I negotiated the corner on my motorbike and pulled to a stop...
examples.translation: 我骑摩托车顺利通过拐角，然后停了下来。

examples.text: I negotiated my way out of the airport and joined the flow of cars.
examples.translation: 我驱车驶出机场，汇入车流之中。

examples.text: Our neighbor keeps inviting us for meetings and talks, Vajpayee is quoted as saying.
Abdulghani Mohammed died in the incident in the al-Jamia neighborhood Sunday morning, ministry officials said.
Professor Hisamatsu spoke neither English nor German...
examples.translation: 久松教授既不会讲英语，也不会讲德语。

examples.text: The play is neither as funny nor as disturbing as Tabori thinks it is.
examples.translation: 这部戏既不像塔博里想象的那么滑稽，也不像他想象的那么让人讨厌。

examples.text: At first, neither man could speak.
examples.translation: 起初，两个人都不会说。

examples.text: Neither of us felt like going out.
examples.translation: 我俩都不想外出。

examples.text: They both smiled; neither seemed likely to be aware of my absence for long.
examples.translation: 他俩都笑了，看来两人都未意识到我已离开很长时间了。

examples.text: I never learned to swim and neither did they...
examples.translation: 我从没学过游泳，他们也没有。

examples.text: Britain does not agree and neither do Denmark, Portugal and Ireland.
examples.translation: 英国不同意，丹麦、葡萄牙和爱尔兰也持反对意见。

examples.text: I can't ever recall Dad hugging me. Neither did I sit on his knee.
examples.translation: 我不记得爸爸曾经抱过我，我也没在他膝盖上坐过。

examples.text: 'I'd never heard of her before I came here.' — 'That is neither here nor there.'
examples.translation: “来之前我从未听说过她。”——“那没什么。”

examples.text: Whether or not he realised the fact was neither here nor there.
examples.translation: 他是否认识到事实真相无关紧要。

examples.text: I am planning a 25th birthday party for my nephew.
examples.translation: 我在为侄子筹划他25岁的生日聚会。

examples.text: ...spinal nerves.
examples.translation: 脊神经

examples.text: ...in cases where the nerve fibres are severed.
examples.translation: 在一些神经纤维被割断的病例中

examples.text: Jill's nerves are stretched to breaking point...
examples.translation: 吉尔的神经绷紧到了极点。

examples.text: I can be very patient, and then I can burst if my nerves are worn out.
examples.translation: 我很有耐心，可如果我的承受力到了极限，我就撑不住了。

examples.text: I just played badly. It wasn't nerves.
examples.translation: 我只是打得很糟，不是紧张造成的。

examples.text: The brandy made him choke, but it restored his nerve...
examples.translation: 虽说白兰地呛了他一下，却让他恢复了勇气。

examples.text: He never got up enough nerve to meet me.
examples.translation: 他从没有足够的胆量来见我。

examples.text: I nerved myself to face the pain.
examples.translation: 我鼓足勇气去面对痛苦。

examples.text: Lately he's not done a bloody thing and it's getting on my nerves.
examples.translation: 近来他没有干任何坏事，这让我心神不定起来。

examples.text: They've got a nerve, complaining about our behaviour...
examples.translation: 他们竟敢对我们的行为表示不满。

examples.text: He had the nerve to ask me to prove who I was.
examples.translation: 他竟敢要求我证明我自己的身份。

examples.text: He held his nerve to beat Andre Agassi in a five-set thriller on Court One...
examples.translation: 他镇定自若，在1号场地惊心动魄的5盘3胜对决中击败了安德鲁·阿加西。

examples.text: We need to keep our nerve now.
examples.translation: 我们现在需要保持镇静。

examples.text: Eileen, mother of three, had been living on her nerves for some considerable time.
examples.translation: 艾琳是3个孩子的母亲，已有相当一段时间总是感到紧张不安。

examples.text: The bomber had lost his nerve and fled.
examples.translation: 放炸弹的人没了胆子，逃之夭夭。

examples.text: Alistair saw Henry shrink, as if the words had touched a nerve...
examples.translation: 阿利斯泰尔看到亨利向后缩了一下，好像那些话触到了他的痛处。

examples.text: The mere mention of John had touched a very raw nerve indeed.
examples.translation: 提到约翰就真的让人心痛。

meanings.meaning: 神经的；紧张不安的；强健有力的

examples.text: The party has become deeply nervous about its prospects of winning the next election...
examples.translation: 该党对赢得下一次选举的前景深感忧虑。

examples.text: She described Mr Hutchinson as nervous and jumpy after his wife's disappearance.
examples.translation: 据她描述，哈钦森先生自从妻子失踪后变得神经兮兮、一惊一乍的。

examples.text: Brunhilde stood up nervously as the men came into the room...
examples.translation: 那些人进屋时，布伦希尔德紧张地站了起来。

examples.text: Nervously clutching our glasses of chilled wine, we gathered on the terrace.
examples.translation: 我们聚集在露台上，手里紧张地握着盛有冰镇葡萄酒的酒杯。

examples.text: I smiled warmly so he wouldn't see my nervousness.
examples.translation: 我热情地微笑着，所以他不会看出我的紧张。

examples.text: She was apparently a very nervous woman, and that affected her career.
examples.translation: 她显然是一个很神经质的女人，这一点影响了她的事业。

examples.text: The number of nervous disorders was rising in the region...
examples.translation: 该地区神经紊乱患者的人数在上升。

examples.text: He developed nervous problems after people began repeatedly correcting him.
examples.translation: 人们开始不停地纠正他的错误，之后他的神经就出现了问题。

meanings.meaning: (Nest)人名；(德)内丝特；(英)内丝特(女子教名 Agnes 威尔士语的昵称)

examples.text: I can see an eagle's nest on the rocks.
examples.translation: 我能看到岩石上的鹰巢。

examples.text: Some species may nest in close proximity to each other.
examples.translation: 一些鸟类会彼此紧挨着筑巢。

examples.text: ...nesting sites.
examples.translation: 巢址

examples.text: Some solitary bees make their nests in burrows in the soil.
examples.translation: 一些独居蜂会把巢筑在田间的地洞里。

examples.text: ...a rat's nest.
examples.translation: 鼠穴

examples.text: My wife seems to be building a nest of her own at Osborne House...
examples.translation: 我夫人像是要把奥斯本庄园变成自己的安乐窝。

examples.text: The baby had been asleep in her nest of pink and white blankets.
examples.translation: 婴儿睡在粉色和白色毛毯铺成的小窝里。

examples.text: ...Biarritz, notorious in those days as a nest of spies...
examples.translation: 比亚里茨，那时候出了名的间谍老巢

examples.text: Are you telling me that you've got your own little nest of informers in the Police Department?
examples.translation: 你是说你在警察局有一帮通风报信的？

examples.text: Mary's much more interested in doing things for other people than feathering her own nest.
examples.translation: 相比追逐私利，玛丽更乐意帮助他人。

examples.text: When their children had flown the nest, he and his wife moved to a thatched cottage in Dorset.
examples.translation: 孩子们独立生活后，他和妻子搬到多塞特的茅草屋去住了。

examples.text: I threw aside my mosquito net and jumped out of bed.
examples.translation: 我把蚊帐甩到一边，跳下床来。

examples.text: Several fishermen sat on wooden barrels, tending their nets.
examples.translation: 几个渔夫坐在木桶上修补渔网。

examples.text: I'm quite happy to net a fish and then let it go...
examples.translation: 我特别喜欢用网捕到鱼后再把它放了。

examples.text: Poachers have been netting salmon to supply the black market.
examples.translation: 盗猎者一直在捕捞大麻哈鱼到黑市上去卖。

examples.text: He let the ball slip through his grasp and into the net.
examples.translation: 球从他的掌中滑出，钻进了球门。

examples.text: Centre half Tiler netted his first goal for the club.
examples.translation: 中前卫泰勒为俱乐部射进了他的第一粒进球。

examples.text: They took to the water intent on netting the £250,000 reward offered for conclusive proof of the monster's existence.
examples.translation: 他们前往那片水域，打算找到怪物存在的确凿证据，以获得为此设立的25万英镑奖金。

examples.text: Secret investigations have netted ninety staff suspected of fraud and theft...
examples.translation: 秘密调查已抓获90名涉嫌欺诈盗窃的职员。

examples.text: The anti-drug sweep had netted nearly 900 kilogrammes of cocaine.
examples.translation: 扫毒行动已缴获了近900千克的可卡因。

examples.text: Last year he netted a cool 3 million pounds by selling his holdings...
examples.translation: 去年他通过出售自己持有的股份获得了整整300万英镑的净收入。

examples.text: The security forces are casting their net wider.
examples.translation: 安全部队正在更广泛地布网。

examples.text: Officials fear some of the thugs identified by British police may have slipped through the net.
examples.translation: 官员们担心英国警方指认的一些罪犯可能已成为漏网之鱼。

examples.text: And a number of African countries, too, are slipping through the net...
examples.translation: 并且一些非洲国家也被漏掉了。

examples.text: The existence of more than one agency with power to intervene can lead to children falling through the net.
examples.translation: 多个部门都可干预的事实可能会导致一些孩子被遗漏。

examples.text: ...a rise in sales and net profit...
examples.translation: 销售和纯利润的增长

examples.text: At the year end, net assets were £18 million...
examples.translation: 到年底，净资产达1,800万英镑。

examples.text: What you actually receive is net of deductions for the airfare and administration.
examples.translation: 你实际上得到的是扣除机票和管理费的净值。

examples.text: Balances of £5,000 and above will earn 11 per cent gross, 8.25 per cent net...
examples.translation: 结余在5,000英镑及以上将获毛利11％，纯利8.25％。

examples.text: ...a first year profit of around £10,000 net...
examples.translation: 第一年大约10,000英镑的纯利润

examples.text: All bank and building society interest is paid net.
examples.translation: 所有银行和建房互助协会的贷款都要支付纯利息。

examples.text: ...350 mg net weight.
examples.translation: 净重350毫克

examples.text: We have a net gain of nearly 50 seats, the biggest for any party in Scotland...
examples.translation: 我们最终获得了近50个席位，是苏格兰政党里赢得席位最多的。

examples.text: We will be a net exporter of motor cars in just a few years' time.
examples.translation: 我们将在仅仅几年时间里成为汽车净出口国。

examples.text: ...Strasbourg, with its rambling network of medieval streets...
examples.translation: 中世纪街道纵横交织的斯特拉斯堡

examples.text: The uterus is supplied with a rich network of blood vessels and nerves.
examples.translation: 密布的血管和神经网向子宫输送养料。

examples.text: Distribution of the food is going ahead using a network of local church people and other volunteers...
examples.translation: 食品正通过当地教会人士和其他志愿者形成的网络分发下去。

examples.text: He is keen to point out the benefits which the family network can provide.
examples.translation: 他很乐意指出家庭网络可以带来的好处。

examples.text: ...a computer network with 154 terminals...
examples.translation: 有154个终端的计算机网络

examples.text: Huge sections of the rail network are out of action.
examples.translation: 铁路网的很多区段停运。

examples.text: An American network says it has obtained the recordings.
examples.translation: 美国一家广播网声称已经得到了那些录音材料。

examples.text: ...Fuji Television Network, a highly successful commercial station.
examples.translation: 富士电视网,一家非常成功的商业电视台

examples.text: Lumsdon would like to see his programme sold and networked...
examples.translation: 拉姆斯敦希望看到自己的节目卖出，并进行联播。

examples.text: He had once had his own networked chat show.
examples.translation: 他曾经拥有自己的电视联播访谈节目。

examples.text: In business, it is important to network with as many people as possible on a face to face basis.
examples.translation: 在生意场上，通过与尽可能多的人面对面地打交道来建立工作关系很重要。

meanings.meaning: 中立的，中性的；中立国的；非彩色的
中立国；中立者；非彩色；齿轮的空档

examples.text: Let's meet on neutral territory...
examples.translation: 我们在中立地区会面吧。

examples.text: Those who had decided to remain neutral in the struggle now found themselves required to take sides.
examples.translation: 那些先前决定在争斗中保持中立的人现在发现他们需要表明立场了。

examples.text: It was a good game to watch for the neutrals.
examples.translation: 对中立方来说，这是一场精彩的比赛。

examples.text: ...a reputation for political neutrality and impartiality.
examples.translation: 以政治上保持中立和公正著称

examples.text: Isabel put her magazine down and said in a neutral voice, 'You're very late, darling.'...
examples.translation: 伊莎贝尔放下杂志，平静地说道：“亲爱的，你来得太晚了。”

examples.text: He told her about the death, describing the events in as neutral a manner as he could.
examples.translation: 他告诉了她这次死亡事故的情况，描述经过时尽可能不掺杂个人感情。

examples.text: I noticed, behind the neutrality of his gaze, a deep weariness.
examples.translation: 我注意到他不露声色的注视背后藏着深深的厌倦。

examples.text: Three in every five interviewed felt that the Budget was neutral and they would be no better off...
examples.translation: 五分之三的受访者觉得该预算案不好不坏，他们的境况不会好到哪里去。

examples.text: Both sides had agreed to use neutral terms in their references to each other, avoiding controversial ones...
examples.translation: 双方已达成协议，在提及对方时使用中性的词语，避免有争议的字眼。

examples.text: He had departed from his prepared testimony, which was considered to be neutral.
examples.translation: 他抛开了自己准备好的、被认为是中立的证词。

examples.text: Graham put the van in neutral and jumped out into the road.
examples.translation: 格雷厄姆把货车挂到空挡，自己跳到马路上。

examples.text: At the horizon the land mass becomes a continuous pale neutral grey...
examples.translation: 陆地在地平线处变成了一片浅灰。

examples.text: Mary suggests using a neutral lip pencil.
examples.translation: 玛丽建议用浅色唇线笔。

examples.text: A neutron is simply a neutral particle in the nucleus of an atom.
examples.translation: 中子就是原子核里不带电的粒子。

examples.text: Pure water is neutral with a pH of 7.
examples.translation: 纯水是中性的，酸碱度为7。

examples.text: I have never lost the weight I put on in my teens...
examples.translation: 我十几岁时增加的体重一直没有减下去。

examples.text: Never had he been so free of worry...
examples.translation: 他从未如此无忧无虑过。

examples.text: That was a mistake. We'll never do it again...
examples.translation: 那是个错误，我们永远不会再犯了。

examples.text: Never say that. Never, do you hear?...
examples.translation: 永远都别那样说，永远都不，你听见了吗？

examples.text: He was never really healthy...
examples.translation: 他从来就没有真正健康过。

examples.text: This is never to happen again.
examples.translation: 再也不会发生这样的事了。

examples.text: I would never do anything to hurt him...
examples.translation: 我决不会做任何伤害他的事情。

examples.text: Even if you are desperate to get married, never let it show...
examples.translation: 即使你想结婚想得发狂，也决不要表现出来。

examples.text: Divorce is never easy for children...
examples.translation: 父母离婚对孩子来说绝不是件轻松的事。

examples.text: The golden rule is never to clean a valuable coin.
examples.translation: 重要的原则是决不清除贵重硬币上的污垢。

examples.text: I never, ever sit around thinking, 'What shall I do next?'...
examples.translation: 我从不闲坐着琢磨：“我接下来做什么呢？”

examples.text: He's vowed never ever to talk about anything personal in public, ever again.
examples.translation: 他已发誓再也不当众谈论任何个人的事情，永远不。

examples.text: He never achieved anything...
examples.translation: 他从没有取得任何成就。

examples.text: He waited until all the luggage was cleared, but Paula's never appeared...
examples.translation: 他一直等到所有的行李都拿走了，但始终没看见葆拉的。

examples.text: I never knew the lad...
examples.translation: 我不认识这个小伙子。

examples.text: I'd never have dreamt of doing such a thing.
examples.translation: 我做梦也没想过干这样的事。

examples.text: 'What were you up to there?' — 'I was head of the information department.' — 'Well I never!'
examples.translation: “你在那儿干什么？”——“我是信息部的负责人。”——“啊，真没想到!”

examples.text: It would never do to have Henry there in her apartment...
examples.translation: 亨利呆在她的公寓里怎么也不合适。

examples.text: I don't think it is an example of bad writing myself, otherwise I'd be agreeing with Leavis, and that would never do.
examples.translation: 我本人不认为这是篇糟糕的文章，否则我就和利维斯看法一样了，那可不行。

examples.text: Most marriages fail after between five and nine years. Nevertheless, people continue to get married.
examples.translation: 大部分婚姻在婚后第五至第九年间失败，然而，人们仍会选择结婚。

examples.text: There had been no indication of any loss of mental faculties. His whole life had nevertheless been clouded with a series of illnesses.
examples.translation: 没有迹象显示他的智力受到了损害，但是他的一生却是疾病缠身。

meanings.meaning: 新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的

examples.text: They've just opened a new hotel in the Stoke area...
examples.translation: 他们刚在斯托克地区开了一家新宾馆。

examples.text: The new invention ensures the beer keeps a full, frothy head.
examples.translation: 这项新发明能保证啤酒始终保持丰富的泡沫。

examples.text: ...the introduction of new drugs to suppress the immune system...
examples.translation: 对免疫系统有抑制作用的新药的使用

examples.text: Their epic fight is the subject of a new film...
examples.translation: 他们史诗般的战斗是一部新电影的主题。

examples.text: These ideas are nothing new in America.
examples.translation: 这些观念在美国毫不新鲜。

examples.text: The board acknowledges problems which arise from the newness of the approach.
examples.translation: 董事会承认使用新方法产生了种种问题。

examples.text: That afternoon she went out and bought a new dress...
examples.translation: 那天下午她出门买了一件新裙子。

examples.text: There are many boats, new and used, for sale...
examples.translation: 有很多新旧不一的船待售。

examples.text: They cost nine pounds new, three pounds secondhand.
examples.translation: 新的9英镑，旧的3英镑。

examples.text: Under the new rules, some factories will cut emissions by as much as 90 percent...
examples.translation: 按照新规定，一些工厂的减排量要高达90%。

examples.text: I had been in my new job only a few days...
examples.translation: 我到新的工作岗位只有几天的时间。

examples.text: I had to find somewhere new to live...
examples.translation: 我不得不另找住处。

examples.text: Rachel has a new boyfriend...
examples.translation: 雷切尔换了个男朋友。

examples.text: They told me I needed a new battery.
examples.translation: 他们告诉我需要换新电池。

examples.text: The new planet is about ten times the size of the earth.
examples.translation: 新发现的行星大约是地球的10倍那么大。

examples.text: The start of a new year is a good time to reflect on the many achievements of the past...
examples.translation: 新年伊始是反思过去一年诸多成就的好时机。

examples.text: The next election is for the government to take us into the new century.
examples.translation: 下次选举要选出带领我们进入新世纪的政府。

examples.text: ...the usual exhaustion of a new mother...
examples.translation: 刚做妈妈的人通常会有的疲惫感

examples.text: The Association gives a free handbook to all new members.
examples.translation: 协会给新成员人手一本免费手册。

examples.text: She wasn't new to the company...
examples.translation: 公司对她早有耳闻。

examples.text: His name was new to me then and it stayed in my mind...
examples.translation: 当时我是第一次听到他的名字，就记住了。

examples.text: I'm new here and all I did was follow orders.
examples.translation: 我新来乍到，我所做的事情都是按照命令行事。

examples.text: We waited and waited for news of him...
examples.translation: 我们左等右等，盼着他的消息。

examples.text: They still haven't had any news about when they'll be able to go home...
examples.translation: 他们仍然没有何时能回家的消息。

examples.text: I wish I had better news for you...
examples.translation: 我多希望能带给你好消息。

examples.text: He's thrilled to bits at the news.
examples.translation: 他听到这个消息欣喜若狂。

examples.text: Foreign News is on Page 16...
examples.translation: 国外新闻在16版。

examples.text: We'll also have the latest sports news...
examples.translation: 我们也会收到最新的体育新闻。

examples.text: The announcement was made at a news conference...
examples.translation: 这个通知是在记者招待会上发布的。

examples.text: Those are some of the top stories in the news.
examples.translation: 那些是新闻头条里的一部分内容。

examples.text: I heard all about the bombs on the news.
examples.translation: 我从新闻广播里得知了关于炸弹的全部消息。

examples.text: ...the six o'clock news.
examples.translation: 6点钟的新闻

examples.text: ...the New York Daily News.
examples.translation: 《纽约每日新闻》

examples.text: A murder was big news...
examples.translation: 谋杀案是重大新闻事件。

examples.text: If you are a celebrity, you are headline news.
examples.translation: 如果你是名人，你就是头条新闻。

examples.text: The drop in travel is bad news for the airline industry...
examples.translation: 旅游热降温对航空业来说是个坏消息。

examples.text: This new attitude is good news to AIDS activists.
examples.translation: 这种新态度对艾滋病活动家来说是件好事。

examples.text: I'd certainly tell you if I knew anything, but I don't. What you're saying is news to me.
examples.translation: 如果我真知道什么的话，我肯定会告诉你，可我不知道。你现在说的我都没听过。

meanings.meaning: 报纸 报社 旧报纸

examples.text: He was carrying a newspaper...
examples.translation: 他拿着一份报纸。

examples.text: They read their daughter's allegations in the newspaper.
examples.translation: 他们从报纸上看到了女儿的说法。

examples.text: ...a Sunday newspaper feature about AIDS in America.
examples.translation: 周日报纸上一篇关于美国艾滋病情况的专题文章

examples.text: It is Britain's fastest growing national daily newspaper...
examples.translation: 这是英国发展最快的全国性日报社。

examples.text: Alexander Lazarus is a food critic for the newspaper.
examples.translation: 亚历山大·拉扎勒斯是为该报撰稿的饮食评论家。

examples.text: He found two pots, each wrapped in newspaper.
examples.translation: 他发现了两个分别用报纸包着的罐子。

meanings.meaning: 下一个的；其次的；贴近的

examples.text: I got up early the next morning.
examples.translation: 第二天早晨我早早地起床了。

examples.text: ...the next available flight...
examples.translation: 下一趟可搭乘的航班

examples.text: Who will be the next prime minister?...
examples.translation: 谁将成为下一届首相呢？

examples.text: I want my next child born at home...
examples.translation: 我想下次在家生孩子。

examples.text: Many senior citizens have very few visitors from one week to the next...
examples.translation: 很多老人一周又一周很少有人探望。

examples.text: And then Captain Charles sings, 'Don't ever laugh when a hearse goes by or you will be the next to die.'
examples.translation: 随后查尔斯船长唱到：“如果你不想下一个死的是你，当灵车走过时绝不要笑。”

examples.text: Let's plan a big night next week...
examples.translation: 我们下周组织一次盛大的晚会吧。

examples.text: He retires next January...
examples.translation: 他明年一月退休。

examples.text: Next day the EU summit strengthened their ultimatum.
examples.translation: 次日，欧盟峰会发出了更加强硬的最后通牒。

examples.text: I shall be 26 years old on Friday next.
examples.translation: 下周五我就26岁了。

examples.text: He predicted that the region's economy would grow by about six per cent both this year and next.
examples.translation: 他预言，今年和明年这一地区的经济均会有约6％的增幅。

examples.text: Grace sighed so heavily that Trish could hear it in the next room...
examples.translation: 格雷斯重重的叹息声连隔壁房间的特里斯都能听见。

examples.text: The man in the next chair was asleep...
examples.translation: 邻座的男士睡着了。

examples.text: Stop at the next corner. I'm getting out.
examples.translation: 在下一个拐角停下，我要下车。

examples.text: Next, close your eyes then screw them up tight...
examples.translation: 接着，合上双眼，然后再用力闭紧。

examples.text: I don't know what to do next...
examples.translation: 我不知道接着该干什么了。

examples.text: The news is next.
examples.translation: 接下来是新闻。

examples.text: I next saw him at his house in Berkshire...
examples.translation: 我在伯克郡他的家中再次见到了他。

examples.text: When we next met, he was much more jovial.
examples.translation: 我们再次见面时，他愉快多了。

examples.text: The one thing he didn't have was a son. I think he's felt that a grandson is the next best thing...
examples.translation: 他唯一缺的就是个儿子，我想他觉得有个外孙也不错。

examples.text: At least three times more daffodils are grown than in Holland, the next largest grower.
examples.translation: 水仙花的栽培量至少是第二种植大国荷兰的3倍。

examples.text: ...the party's annual conference, to be held in Bournemouth the week after next.
examples.translation: 下下周在伯恩茅斯举行的该党年会

examples.text: I enjoy pleasure as much as the next person...
examples.translation: 我和别人一样愉快。

examples.text: I'm as ambitious as the next man. I'd like to manage at the very highest level.
examples.translation: 我和别人一样雄心勃勃，想进入最高管理层。

examples.text: I had leaned over to pick up some change, and the next thing I knew I felt this terrible pain in my ankle.
examples.translation: 我俯身去拿那些零钱，接下来就突然感到脚踝剧痛。

examples.text: She sat down next to him on the sofa.
examples.translation: 她紧挨着他在沙发上坐下了。

examples.text: ...at the southern end of the Gaza Strip next to the Egyptian border...
examples.translation: 在紧靠埃及边境的加沙地带南端

examples.text: The car was parked in the small weedy lot next to the hotel.
examples.translation: 轿车停在紧挨旅馆的一小块草地上。

examples.text: Her children were the number two priority in her life next to her career...
examples.translation: 对她而言，孩子们的重要性仅次于她的事业。

examples.text: Next to the expense of cashiers, pricing items is one of the costliest labor costs of grocery retailers.

examples.translation: 提名他为体育大使的总统令

examples.text: Voters will choose fifty of the seventy five deputies. The Emir will nominate the rest...
examples.translation: 选民将选出75名代表中的50名，其余代表由埃米尔任命。

examples.text: The EU would nominate two members to the committee...
examples.translation: 欧盟将为该委员会指定两名成员。

examples.text: He was nominated by the African National Congress as one of its team at the Groote Sehuur talks...
examples.translation: 非洲人国民大会指派他为参加格鲁特舒尔会谈的代表团成员之一。

examples.text: It is legally possible for an elderly person to nominate someone to act for them, should they become incapable of looking after themselves.
examples.translation: 从法律上来说，如果老人生活不能自理，他可以指定某人为其代理事务。

examples.text: Practically every movie he made was nominated for an Oscar.
examples.translation: 他执导的影片几乎每部都获得过奥斯卡奖提名。

examples.text: ...a campaign to nominate the twice World Champion as Sports Personality of the Year.
examples.translation: 提名那位两届世界冠军获得者为年度体育人物的拉票活动

meanings.meaning: 没有人；一个也没有；没有任何东西

examples.text: She did none of the maintenance on the vehicle itself...
examples.translation: 她对车子本身没有进行半点养护。

examples.text: None of us knew how to treat her.
examples.translation: 我们没有人知道该如何对待她。

examples.text: I turned to bookshops and libraries seeking information and found none...
examples.translation: 我去了书店和图书馆查找资料，但什么也没找到。

examples.text: No one could imagine a great woman painter. None had existed yet...
examples.translation: 没有谁能想象出一位伟大的女画家是什么样子。这样的画家还没有出现过。

examples.text: Only two cars produced by Austin-Morris could reach 100 mph and none could pass the 10-second acceleration test.
examples.translation: 奥斯丁-莫里斯集团生产的车中只有两款能达到每小时100英里的速度，而且没有一款能通过10秒加速测试。

examples.text: He knew his own mind and was having none of their attempts to keep him at home.
examples.translation: 他心意已决，坚决不答应他们想要将自己留在家中。

examples.text: None but God will ever know what I suffered...
examples.translation: 只有上帝知道我受过什么苦。

examples.text: He whispered so softly that none but Julie heard him.
examples.translation: 他这般低声耳语，只有朱莉听得见。

examples.text: He was none too thrilled to hear from me at that hour...
examples.translation: 在那个钟点接到我的电话，他一点也兴奋不起来。

examples.text: Her hand grasped my shoulder, none too gently.
examples.translation: 她的手紧紧抓住了我的肩膀。

examples.text: You could end up committed to yet another savings scheme and none the wiser about managing your finances...
examples.translation: 你可能最终又会把钱投入另一个储蓄计划，在理财方面丝毫没有变得明智些。

examples.text: He became convinced that his illness was purely imaginary: that made it none the better.
examples.translation: 他逐渐相信了自己的病纯粹是想象出来的，但那也没有让他的病情有任何好转。

examples.text: There was still a long way to go. Nonetheless, some progress had been made...
examples.translation: 路还很长，不过已经取得了一些进展。

examples.text: His face is serious but nonetheless very friendly.
examples.translation: 他一脸严肃，但还是非常友好。

examples.text: Most orthodox doctors however dismiss this as complete nonsense.
examples.translation: 但大多数传统的医生认为此说法完全是胡说八道。

examples.text: ...all that poetic nonsense about love...
examples.translation: 所有那些关于爱情的充满诗情画意的假话

examples.text: I'm putting on weight.'—'Nonsense my dear.'
examples.translation: “我长胖了。”“胡说，亲爱的。”

examples.text: Surely it is an economic nonsense to deplete the world of natural resources...
examples.translation: 耗尽世界的自然资源毋庸置疑是愚蠢的经济行为。

examples.text: I think there is a limit to how much of this nonsense people are going to put up with.
examples.translation: 我想人们对这种胡闹总有一个承受极限。

examples.text: ...a children's nonsense poem by Charles E Carryl.
examples.translation: 查尔斯·E.卡里尔写的一首儿童打油诗

examples.text: The fighting made a nonsense of peace pledges made in London last week...
examples.translation: 这场战斗使上周在伦敦所作的和平承诺变成一纸空文。

examples.text: It makes nonsense of our own rules governing laws of adoption in this country.
examples.translation: 这使将我们自己的规定凌驾于该国收养法之上的做法显得十分荒谬。

examples.text: To people like Mr Park, who lives on instant noodle soup, the political wrangling seems distant.
The long day of meetings started at noon...
examples.translation: 会议接连不断的漫长一天从中午开始。

examples.text: Our branches are open from 9am to 5pm during the week and until 12 noon on Saturdays.
examples.translation: 我们的分行每周一至周五上午9点到下午5点营业，周六营业到中午12点。

examples.text: The noon sun was fierce...
examples.translation: 正午的阳光火辣辣的。

examples.text: He expected the transfer to go through by today's noon deadline.
examples.translation: 他希望转账在今天中午的最后期限之前完成。

meanings.meaning: (Nor)人名；(中)挪(广东话·威妥玛)；(马来、俄)诺尔；(柬)诺

examples.text: Neither Mr Rose nor Mr Woodhead was available for comment yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天罗斯先生和伍德黑德先生都无暇发表意见。

examples.text: I can give you neither an opinion nor any advice...
examples.translation: 我既不能给你意见，也不能提供任何建议。

examples.text: They can neither read nor write, nor can they comprehend such concepts.
examples.translation: 他们不会读，不会写，也理解不了这样的概念。

examples.text: 'None of us has any idea how long we're going to be here.' — 'Nor do I.'...
examples.translation: “我们没有人知道要在这儿呆多久。”——“我也不知道。”

examples.text: 'If my husband has no future,' she said, 'then nor do my children.'...
examples.translation: “如果我丈夫没有前途，”她说，“那我的孩子们也没有。”

examples.text: He doesn't want to live in the country when he grows up, nor does he want to live in the city.
examples.translation: 他长大后不想住在乡下，也不想住在城里。

examples.text: Cooking up a quick dish doesn't mean you have to sacrifice flavour. Nor does fast food have to be junk food.
examples.translation: 烹饪快餐并不意味着牺牲风味，快餐也不见得就一定是垃圾食品。

meanings.meaning: 规范，基准；定额，分配之工作量

examples.text: ...the commonly accepted norms of democracy.
examples.translation: 被人们普遍接受的民主准则

examples.text: ...a social norm that says drunkenness is inappropriate behaviour.
examples.translation: 认为醉酒是不当行为的社会规范

examples.text: Families of six or seven are the norm in Borough Park...
examples.translation: 在区公园住宅区六口或七口之家十分普遍。

examples.text: The changes will lead to more flexible leases, and leases nearer to 15 years than the present norm of 25 years.
examples.translation: 这些变化将带来更灵活的、接近15年的租期，而不是现行的常规为25年的租期。

examples.text: ...an agency which would establish European norms and co-ordinate national policies to halt pollution.
examples.translation: 确立各项欧洲环保标准、协调各国政策以阻遏污染的机构

examples.text: He has occasional injections to maintain his good health but otherwise he lives a normal life...
examples.translation: 他偶尔要注射药物保持身体健康，但除此之外他生活一切正常。

examples.text: The two countries resumed normal diplomatic relations...
examples.translation: 两国恢复了正常的外交关系。

examples.text: Some of the shops were closed but that's quite normal for a Thursday afternoon...
examples.translation: 一些商店关门了，但在星期四下午这是很平常的。

examples.text: In November, Clean's bakery produced 50 percent more bread than normal...
examples.translation: 克林面包房11月份烤的面包比平常多50％。

examples.text: Life in Israel will continue as normal.
examples.translation: 在以色列，生活将一如既往。

examples.text: Statistics indicate that depressed patients are more likely to become ill than are normal people...
examples.translation: 统计显示抑郁症患者比正常人更容易生病。

examples.text: Will the baby be normal?
examples.translation: 婴儿会一切正常吗？

meanings.meaning: 正常化；标准化；正规化；常态化

examples.text: The "normalization" of monetary conditions is going to mean a lot of different things to different people.
One girl is from Orlando but stays with a host family in North Carolina.

meanings.meaning: 东北的；向东北的；来自东北的

examples.text: They are canvassing the mother's apartment complex in Redmond, northeast of Bellevue, Tyler said.

在西北；向西北；来自西北

examples.text: She wiped her nose with a tissue...
examples.translation: 她用纸巾擦了擦鼻子。

examples.text: She's got funny eyes and a big nose.
examples.translation: 她有一双古怪的眼睛和一个大鼻子。

examples.text: Sue parked off the main street, with the van's nose pointing away from the street.
examples.translation: 休把小货车停在远离大街的地方，车头背对着大街。

examples.text: The river that runs through Middlesbrough became ugly on the eye and hard on the nose.
examples.translation: 穿过米德尔斯伯勒的那条河变得污秽不堪、臭不可闻。

examples.text: Chirkpar rattled past him on the right to snatch the prize by a nose.
examples.translation: 一匹名为切厄克帕的赛马从他右侧疾驰而过，以一鼻之差获胜。

examples.text: He could not see the driver as the car nosed forward...
examples.translation: 车慢慢向前开，他却看不见司机。

examples.text: A motorboat nosed out of the mist and nudged into the branches of a tree...
examples.translation: 一艘摩托艇缓缓驶出薄雾，蹭进一棵树的枝叶中。

examples.text: Ben drove past them, nosing his car into the garage.
examples.translation: 本小心翼翼地把车开进车库时从他们身边经过。

examples.text: If you kept your nose clean, you had a job for life.
examples.translation: 如果你规规矩矩，就可以一辈子都捧着这个饭碗。

examples.text: Just follow your nose and in about five minutes you're at the old railway.
examples.translation: 径直往前开，大约5分钟就能到旧铁路线。

examples.text: You won't have to think, just follow your nose.
examples.translation: 你不必思考，跟着你的直觉走。

examples.text: He had a nose for trouble and a brilliant tactical mind...
examples.translation: 他善于发现问题，还总能想出高明的策略。

examples.text: Gergen had a great sense of news, a good nose for trends, and a wide range of contacts.
examples.translation: 格根有很强的新闻意识，对潮流嗅觉灵敏，而且人脉很广。

examples.text: He's just getting up my nose so much at the moment.
examples.translation: 他这会儿真让我生气。

examples.text: I don't look down my nose at comedy...
examples.translation: 我并不轻视喜剧。

examples.text: They rather looked down their noses at anyone who couldn't speak French.
examples.translation: 他们相当瞧不起不会说法语的人。

examples.text: We don't like paying through the nose for our wine when eating out.
examples.translation: 下馆子时，我们不喜欢在酒水上花很多钱。

examples.text: We don't like strangers who poke their noses into our affairs...
examples.translation: 我们不喜欢陌生人干预我们的事务。

examples.text: Why did you have to stick your nose in?
examples.translation: 你为什么非要插手？

examples.text: His enemies will attempt to rub his nose in past policy statements.
examples.translation: 他的对手会试图揪住他过去政策陈述的漏洞不放。

examples.text: There is evidence that the industry's greed means that it is cutting off its nose to spite its face.
examples.translation: 有证据表明该产业的贪婪是在作茧自缚。

examples.text: ...a line of about twenty fast-moving trucks driving nose to tail.
examples.translation: 一排大约20辆首尾相接、快速行驶的卡车

examples.text: He has always thumbed his nose at the media.
examples.translation: 他对媒体一直都嗤之以鼻。

examples.text: I'm not in a financial position to turn up my nose at several hundred thousand pounds.
examples.translation: 我的经济境况使我无法对几十万英镑无动于衷。

examples.text: Okay so have an affair, but not right under my nose.
examples.translation: 有外遇就有外遇好了，但别在我眼皮底下。

meanings.meaning: “非”（计算机中逻辑运算的一种）

examples.text: Not is often shortened to n't in spoken English, and added to the auxiliary or modal verb. For example, ‘did not’ is often shortened to ‘didn't’.
examples.translation: not在口语中常略作 n't，用在助动词或情态动词后，例如：did not 常略作 didn't。

examples.text: I was not in Britain at the time...
examples.translation: 当时我不在英国。

examples.text: There are many things you won't understand here...
examples.translation: 这儿有很多事情是你无法理解的。

examples.text: I don't trust my father anymore.
examples.translation: 我再也不相信爸爸了。

examples.text: Haven't they got enough problems there already?...
examples.translation: 难道他们那儿的问题还少吗？

examples.text: Didn't I see you at the party last week?...
examples.translation: 我在上周的聚会上见过你，对不对？

examples.text: Didn't you just love the Waltons?
examples.translation: 你难道不喜欢看《沃尔顿一家》吗？

examples.text: Why didn't you do it months ago?...
examples.translation: 几个月以前你为什么不做呢？

examples.text: Why couldn't he listen to her?...
examples.translation: 他为什么不能听她的呢？

examples.text: Hasn't anyone ever kissed you before?...
examples.translation: 以前从没有人吻过你吗？

examples.text: Shouldn't you have gone further?...
examples.translation: 你不是该更深入一步了吗？

examples.text: Didn't I tell you to put some slippers on?
examples.translation: 难道我没有告诉你要穿拖鞋吗？

examples.text: 'It's a nice piece of jewellery though, isn't it?'...
examples.translation: “可这是一件漂亮的首饰，不是吗?”

examples.text: I've been a great husband, haven't I?...
examples.translation: 我一直是个很不错的丈夫，不是吗？

examples.text: You will take me tomorrow, won't you?
examples.translation: 你明天会带上我的，不是吗？

examples.text: Actually we do have a position in mind. Why don't you fill out our application?...
examples.translation: 实际上我们的确在考虑一个职位，你先填一下我们的求职表好吗？

examples.text: Couldn't they send it by train?
examples.translation: 他们不能用火车运过来吗？

examples.text: 'Have you found Paula?'—'I'm afraid not, Kate.'...
examples.translation: “你找到葆拉了吗？”——“很遗憾，没有，凯特。”

examples.text: At first I really didn't care whether he came or not.
examples.translation: 起先我真的不在乎他是否会来。

examples.text: Not all the money, to put it mildly, has been used wisely...
examples.translation: 说得好听些，不是所有的钱都花得是地方。

examples.text: Not every applicant had a degree.
examples.translation: 不是所有的求职者都有学位。

examples.text: He didn't always win the arguments, but he often was right...
examples.translation: 他并非在争辩中总是能赢，但他经常是对的。

examples.text: She couldn't always afford a babysitter...
examples.translation: 她并不是总能请得起临时保姆。

examples.text: The life of an FBI agent wasn't always as glamorous as people thought.
examples.translation: 美国联邦调查局特工的生活并非总像人们想象的那么刺激。

examples.text: The houses are beautiful, but there's no shop, not even a pub to go into...
examples.translation: 这些房子很漂亮，但周围没有商店，甚至连一个酒馆都没有。

examples.text: I sent report after report. But not one word was published...
examples.translation: 我寄了一篇又一篇的报告，但一个字都没有发表。

examples.text: 'Did he have any enemies?' — 'Not a one. Not a damn one!'
examples.translation: “他有什么仇人吗？”——“一个都没有，竟然找不出一个！”

examples.text: The tug crossed our stern not fifty yards away...
examples.translation: 拖船擦着我们的船尾开了过去，距离不到50码。

examples.text: ...a large crowd not ten yards away waiting for a bus...
examples.translation: 不到10码远的地方有一大群等公共汽车的人

examples.text: They were here not five minutes ago!
examples.translation: 他们不到5分钟前还在这儿！

examples.text: He has his place in the Asian team not because he is white but because he is good...
examples.translation: 他在这支亚洲球队中占有一席之地，不是因为他是白人，而是因为他确实出色。

examples.text: Training is an investment not a cost...
examples.translation: 培训是一种投资，而不是花费。

examples.text: There came an explosion, not so much a bang as a shaking like an earthquake.
examples.translation: 发生了一次爆炸，没听到一声轰然巨响，倒像是地震那样地面猛晃了晃。

examples.text: These movies were not only making money; they were also perceived to be original...
examples.translation: 这些电影不仅赚钱，而且被视为具有原创性。

examples.text: There is always a 'black market' not just in Britain but in Europe as a whole...
examples.translation: 黑市一直存在，不只是在英国，整个欧洲也是。

examples.text: Hoffman did not simply oppose the system; he used the system against itself.
examples.translation: 霍夫曼不仅仅是反对这个体制，他还利用体制自身的漏洞对它进行攻击。

examples.text: His death took me a year to get over; not that you're ever really over it...
examples.translation: 我用一年时间慢慢接受了他去世的事实，但其实你永远不会真正完全忘掉。

examples.text: It occurred to Tom to wonder whether Jane was quite trustworthy. Not that he thought she was in any way politically active.
examples.translation: 汤姆突然想到简是不是值得信任，并不是说他认为简有些热衷于政治。

examples.text: 'Sorry. I sound like Abby, don't I?' — 'No. Not at all.'...
examples.translation: “抱歉，我讲起话来像阿比，是不是？”——“不，一点不像。”

examples.text: 'You don't think that you've betrayed your country.' — 'No I don't. No, not at all.'
examples.translation: “你认为你没有背叛自己的国家。”——“我没有，根本没有。”

examples.text: 'Thank you very much for speaking with us.' — 'Not at all.'
examples.translation: “非常感谢您能和我们交谈。”——“不客气。”

examples.text: The proposed new structure is notable not only for its height, but for its shape...
examples.translation: 拟建的新建筑令人瞩目，不仅是因其高度，也因其外形。

examples.translation: 莫不想受任何人支配，而且很明显她从不容许自己生活里的男性光芒盖过自己。

examples.translation: 除了一些有趣的例外，医生都是些讲求实际的家伙。

examples.translation: 由当地名流选出、任职9年的参议员缺少国民议会议员的民主合法性。

examples.translation: 显要人物包括五名参议员、两名最高法院法官和三名州长。

examples.text: He brought out a notebook and pen from his pocket.
examples.translation: 他从口袋里掏出笔记本和钢笔。

examples.text: ...her reporter's notebook.
examples.translation: 她的记者专用笔记本

examples.text: ...a range of notebook computers which allows all your important information to travel safely with you.
examples.translation: 使你能够随身携带所有重要信息安全旅行的各种笔记本电脑

examples.translation: 史蒂文斯给他写了张便条，请他去自己的公寓。

examples.text: I'll have to leave a note for Karen.
examples.translation: 我得给卡伦留张便条。

examples.translation: 我知道如果我不把这个想法记下来就会忘记，所以我找人借了支笔。

examples.translation: 磋商的时候要作记录，因为最终的书面报告非常简洁。

examples.translation: 参见第223页的注释16。

examples.translation: 詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《流亡者》，由J.C.C. 梅斯作序并注释

examples.translation: 因为贝内特先生要请假一段时间，他请医生开了病假条。

examples.text: I've got half a ton of gravel in the lorry but he won't sign my delivery note.
examples.translation: 我的卡车里装着半吨沙砾，但他不给我签收送货单。

examples.text: They exchange traveller's cheques at a different rate from notes.
examples.translation: 他们兑换旅行支票时依据的汇率跟兑换现钞时不同。

examples.text: ...a five pound note.
examples.translation: 5英镑的纸币

examples.text: She has a deep voice and doesn't even try for the high notes...
examples.translation: 她嗓音低沉，从没试过高音。

examples.text: If the note of D is sounded on a harp, all the corresponding D strings of other octaves will likewise resonate.
examples.translation: 如果用竖琴演奏D音符，其他八度音阶所有相应的D弦都将发出共鸣。

examples.text: There is an unmistakable note of nostalgia in his voice when he looks back on the early years of the family business...
examples.translation: 他回忆早些年的家族生意时，无疑是带着一种怀旧的语气的。

examples.text: It was not difficult for him to catch the note of bitterness in my voice.
examples.translation: 他不难听出我话语中的愤愤不平。

examples.text: Yesterday's testimony began on a note of passionate but civilized disagreement...
examples.translation: 昨天的作供是在激烈但文明地表达分歧的氛围中开始的。

examples.text: Somehow he tells these stories without a note of horror...
examples.translation: 不知为什么他讲这些故事时一点都不害怕。

examples.text: The furniture strikes a traditional note which is appropriate to its Edwardian setting.
examples.translation: 这些家具给人一种古香古色的感觉，与周围爱德华七世时期风格的布置很协调。

examples.text: The White House has noted his promise to support any attack that was designed to enforce the UN resolutions...
examples.translation: 白宫已经注意到他承诺支持所有旨在贯彻联合国决议的打击。

examples.text: Suddenly, I noted that the rain had stopped...
examples.translation: 突然，我意识到雨已经停了。

examples.text: Haig noted how he 'looked pinched and rather tired'.
examples.translation: 黑格注意到了他“看上去消瘦，非常劳累”的样子。

examples.text: Note the statue to Sallustio Bandini, a prominent Sienese...
examples.translation: 请看这座萨卢斯蒂奥·班迪尼的雕像，他是一位杰出的锡耶纳人。

examples.text: Please note that there are a limited number of tickets.
examples.translation: 请注意，票的数量有限。

examples.text: The report notes that export and import volumes picked up in leading economies...
examples.translation: 报告特别指出经济大国的进出口量攀升。

examples.text: The yearbook also noted a sharp drop in reported cases of sexually transmitted disease.
examples.translation: 年鉴同时指出，性传播疾病报告病例数显著下降。

examples.text: 'He has had his tonsils out and has been ill, too,' she noted in her diary...
examples.translation: “他切除了扁桃体，一直病着，”她在日记里写道。

examples.text: One policeman was clearly visible noting the number plates of passing cars...
examples.translation: 能清楚地看到一名警察记下了经过车辆的车牌号。

examples.text: A guard came and took our names and noted where each of us was sitting.
examples.translation: 一名警卫来记了我们的名字，还记下了我们每个人的座位。

examples.text: The women were busily comparing notes on the queen's outfit...
examples.translation: 女人们忙着交换对女王衣着的看法。

examples.text: They exchanged greetings, compared notes on their wives and families, and finally got down to business.
examples.translation: 他们互致问候，聊了聊家常，然后才言归正传。

examples.text: ...politicians of note...
examples.translation: 政要

examples.text: He has published nothing of note in the last ten years.
examples.translation: 他在过去的10年里没有发表任何有影响的作品。

examples.text: Before his first round of discussions, Mr Baker sounded an optimistic note...
examples.translation: 第一轮讨论前，贝克先生听上去还比较乐观。

examples.text: Plants growing out of cracks in paving strike the right note up a cottage-garden path.
examples.translation: 从铺路石缝隙间长出的植物恰好营造出乡间农舍花园小径的感觉。

examples.text: Take note of the weather conditions...
examples.translation: 留心一下天气状况。

examples.text: They took note that she showed no surprise at the news of the murder.
examples.translation: 他们注意到她对谋杀的消息一点都不感到惊讶。

examples.text: I've done nothing much since coffee time...
examples.translation: 咖啡时间过后，我什么都没干。

examples.text: Mr Pearson said he knew nothing of his wife's daytime habits...
examples.translation: 皮尔逊先生说，他对妻子白天的生活习惯一无所知。

examples.text: He was dressed in jeans and nothing else...
examples.translation: 他穿着牛仔装，没别的了。

examples.text: There is nothing wrong with the car.
examples.translation: 这车一点毛病也没有。

examples.text: Because he had always had money it meant nothing to him...
examples.translation: 因为他一直不缺钱，所以这对他来说不算什么。

examples.text: While the increase in homicides is alarming, it is nothing compared to what is to come in the rest of the decade...
examples.translation: 虽然凶杀案的增加令人担忧，但和这个十年里接下来的几年将要发生的事相比却是小巫见大巫了。

examples.text: She kept bursting into tears over nothing at work...
examples.translation: 她老是为工作上微不足道的事儿哭鼻子。

examples.text: Do our years together mean nothing?
examples.translation: 难道我们这么多年在一起都毫无意义吗？

examples.text: It is the picture itself that is the problem; so small, so dull. It's a nothing, really...
examples.translation: 问题在图片本身;这么小，这么无趣。没什么价值，真的。

examples.text: All it took was a word here, a word there, to convince him that he was a nothing.
examples.translation: 所要做的是处处提醒他，使他相信自己并非什么大人物。

examples.text: The furniture was threadbare; he'd obviously picked it up for nothing...
examples.translation: 这件家具很破旧，显然他是白捡来的了。

examples.text: Homes in this corner of Mantua that once went for $350,000 are now worth nothing.
examples.translation: 曼图亚市这个位置的房子曾一度卖到35万美元，现在不值几个钱了。

examples.text: Around the lake the countryside generally is nothing special...
examples.translation: 湖四周的乡村总的来说没有什么特别的。

examples.text: There was nothing remarkable about him...
examples.translation: 他没有什么特别之处。

examples.text: All kids her age do silly things; it's nothing to worry about.
examples.translation: 她这个年龄的孩子都会做傻事，根本不用担心。

examples.text: Youngsters learn nothing so fast as how to beat the system...
examples.translation: 年轻人对如何钻制度的空子学得最快。

examples.text: I consider nothing more important in my life than songwriting...
examples.translation: 我想我的生活中没什么比写歌更重要了。

examples.text: There's nothing better than a good cup of hot coffee.
examples.translation: 没什么比一大杯热咖啡更好的了。

examples.text: Either he went through with this thing or he did not; it was all or nothing.
examples.translation: 他要么把这件事做完，要么就不做，只有这两种选择。

examples.text: After all, 15 minutes of exercise is better than nothing.
examples.translation: 毕竟，锻炼15分钟比不锻炼好。

examples.text: All that money brought nothing but sadness and misery and tragedy...
examples.translation: 钱带来的只是悲伤、痛苦和灾难。

examples.text: It did nothing but make us ridiculous...
examples.translation: 这只是让我们显得很滑稽。

examples.text: They care for nothing but fighting.
examples.translation: 他们只知道打架，什么也不关心。

examples.text: Pay now, or nothing doing...
examples.translation: 现在付钱，否则不行。

examples.text: 'I could take the subway and have David pick me up at the station.' — 'Nothing doing.'
examples.translation: “我可以坐地铁，然后让戴维到车站接我。”——“不行。”

examples.text: Much depends on which individual ingredients you choose. There is nothing for it but to taste and to experiment for yourself...
examples.translation: 很大程度上取决于你选择哪种配料。除了亲口品尝和动手尝试外，没有别的方法。

examples.text: He wished he was not in a room so far from the bathroom. There was nothing for it but a long trudge through the house.
examples.translation: 他真希望自己的房间离卫生间不那么远，没别的办法，只能走上长长的一段穿过屋子。

examples.text: Professor Fish has been nothing if not professional...
examples.translation: 菲什教授一贯表现出很高的职业水准。

examples.text: Hollywood is nothing if not creative, especially if someone else will pick up the bills.
examples.translation: 好莱坞是极有创造力的地方，尤其是如果有人肯埋单的话。

examples.text: 'Thank you for the wonderful dinner.' — 'It's nothing,' Sarah said...
examples.translation: “谢谢你招待了这么美味的晚餐。”——“这没什么，”萨拉说。

examples.text: 'I'll be on my way. I can't thank you enough, Alan.' — 'It was nothing, but take care.'
examples.translation: “艾伦，我要走了。真不知该怎么感谢你。”——“小事情，多保重。”

examples.text: It's all rubbish and superstition, and there's nothing in it.
examples.translation: 这都是废话和迷信，不是真的。

examples.text: This device has a gripper that electrically twists off the jar top. Nothing to it...
examples.translation: 这个装置有一个能拧开瓶盖的电动钳子，并不复杂。

examples.text: If you've shied away from making pancakes in the past, don't be put off — there's really nothing in it!
examples.translation: 如果你过去不敢做烤薄饼的话，现在别迟疑了，真是一点儿都不费事!

examples.text: What he had in mind amounted to nothing less than a total reversal of the traditional role of the executive...
examples.translation: 他头脑中所想的简直就是对管理人员传统角色的彻底颠覆。

examples.text: You're nothing less than a murderer!
examples.translation: 你简直就是凶手！

examples.text: Not for nothing was the plane called 'The widow-maker'...
examples.translation: 这种飞机被称作“寡妇机”是事出有因的。

examples.text: It's not for nothing that interior decorators the world over look to the English country garden for glorious inspiration.
examples.translation: 全世界的室内设计师都希望从英国乡村花园汲取美妙的灵感，这并非没有道理。

examples.text: What's wrong with you is that you think you can get something for nothing.
examples.translation: 你的问题是你认为自己可以不劳而获。

examples.text: 'We're going to talk this over in my office.'—'We're going to do nothing of the sort.'...
examples.translation: “我们打算到我办公室把这件事谈个明白。”——“我们决不同意这么做。”

examples.text: Mrs Adamson said that she was extremely sorry, in tones that made it clear that she was nothing of the sort.
examples.translation: 亚当森夫人说她深感抱歉，但她的语气清楚地让人感到她毫无歉意。

examples.text: People should not hesitate to contact the police if they've noticed anyone acting suspiciously...
examples.translation: 如果发现形迹可疑的人，应该马上报警。

examples.text: I noticed that most academics were writing papers during the summer...
examples.translation: 我注意到大部分学者暑期都在写论文。

examples.text: Luckily, I'd noticed where you left the car...
examples.translation: 幸运的是我注意到了你把车停在哪里。

examples.text: Mrs Shedden noticed a bird sitting on the garage roof...
examples.translation: 谢登夫人注意到一只鸟落在车库顶上。

examples.text: She needn't worry that he'll think she looks a mess. He won't notice.
examples.translation: 她不必担心自己在他眼里显得不修边幅，他根本不会注意。

examples.text: Notices in the waiting room requested that you neither smoke nor spit...
examples.translation: 候车室的公告牌要求人们不要吸烟和随地吐痰。

examples.text: A few guest houses had 'No Vacancies' notices in their windows.
examples.translation: 有几家旅社在窗户上贴出了“客满”的告示。

examples.text: ...a notice which said 'Beware Flooding'.
examples.translation: 写有“小心山洪”字样的告示牌

examples.text: Interest is paid monthly. Three months' notice is required for withdrawals...
examples.translation: 利息按月支付。提款须提前3个月通知银行。

examples.text: Unions are required to give seven days' notice of industrial action...
examples.translation: 工会组织劳工行动应提前7天作出声明。

examples.text: She was transferred without notice.
examples.translation: 她事先没接到通知就被调走了。

examples.text: I rang The Globe with news of Blake's death, and put notices in the personal column of The Times...
examples.translation: 我给环球剧院打电话告知了布莱克的死讯，然后在《泰晤士报》的私人广告栏登了讣告。

examples.text: The request is published in notices in today's national newspapers.
examples.translation: 这一请求刊登在今天全国各大报纸的启事栏里。

examples.text: Bonus notices were issued each year from head office to local agents...
examples.translation: 分红通告每年由总公司发送至地方代理商。

examples.text: There will be a creditors meeting on June 15 and notices will be circulated to all known creditors.
examples.translation: 6月15号有一个债权人会议，通告将送达所有已知的债权人。

examples.text: Nevertheless, it's good to know you've had good notices, even if you don't read them.
examples.translation: 不过，即便你不看，知道有一些对你的好评也挺好。

examples.text: There's no one available at such short notice to take her class...
examples.translation: 只提前这么短的时间通知，找不到人替她的课。

examples.text: All our things stayed in our suitcase, as if we had to leave at a moment's notice.
