examples.translation: 我们的东西都放在手提箱里，好像我们一经通知就得马上离开。

examples.text: I am so glad that you have brought this to my notice...
examples.translation: 我很高兴你让我注意到了这件事情。

examples.text: It was in 1982 that his name was first brought to our notice.
examples.translation: 他的名字第一次引起我们注意是在1982年。

examples.text: Her work also came to the notice of the French actor-producer Louis Jouvet...
examples.translation: 她的作品也引起了法国演员兼制片人路易·茹韦的注意。

examples.text: As I write, a very interesting case has come to my notice.
examples.translation: 在我写作过程中，一个非常有趣的案例引起了我的注意。

examples.text: It hasn't escaped our notice that the hospital has come out of all the proposed changes really quite nicely...
examples.translation: 我们注意到医院很好地兑现了所有拟议的变革举措。

examples.text: From the smallest to the largest production unit, no one escaped notice.
examples.translation: 从最小的到最大的生产单位，全都在监控之下。

examples.text: All flights to Lanchow had been cancelled until further notice.
examples.translation: 所有飞往兰州的航班都已取消，何时恢复另行通知。

examples.text: The next morning I telephoned him and gave him his notice.
examples.translation: 第二天早晨我给他打了电话，通知他已被解雇。

examples.text: He handed in his notice at the bank and ruined his promising career.
examples.translation: 他向银行提出了辞职，毁掉了自己的大好前程。

examples.text: We want the government to take notice of what we think they should do for single parents...
examples.translation: 我们希望政府能够关注单亲父母，为他们做一些应该做的事。

examples.text: This should make people sit up and take notice.
examples.translation: 这件事应引起人们的关注。

examples.text: They took no notice of him, he did not stand out, he was in no way remarkable...
examples.translation: 他们没在意他，他并不突出，一点也不引人注目。

examples.text: I tried not to take any notice at first but then I was offended by it.
examples.translation: 起初我尽量不予理会，但后来我被惹恼了。

meanings.meaning: 显而易见的，显著的；值得注意的

examples.text: It is noticeable that women do not have the rivalry that men have...
examples.translation: 显而易见，女性不像男人们那样好勇斗狠。

examples.text: The most noticeable effect of these changes is in the way people are now working together.
examples.translation: 这些变化带来的最明显效果体现在人们现在一起工作的方式上。

examples.text: Standards of living were deteriorating rather noticeably...
examples.translation: 生活水平下降得十分明显。

examples.text: There are also many physical signs, most noticeably a change in facial features.
examples.translation: 还有很多体貌特征，最明显的是面容的变化。

examples.text: The skipper notified the coastguard of the tragedy...
examples.translation: 船长向海岸警卫队报告了这起灾难。

examples.text: Earlier this year they were notified that their homes were to be cleared away...
examples.translation: 今年早些时候他们接到通知说他们的房屋要拆迁。

examples.text: She confirmed that she would notify the police and the hospital.
examples.translation: 她确认说她会通知警方和医院。

examples.text: We each have a notion of just what kind of person we'd like to be...
examples.translation: 我们每人都有一个自己想成为什么样的人的想法。

examples.text: I reject absolutely the notion that privatisation of our industry is now inevitable...
examples.translation: 我绝对不能接受我们这一产业的私有化目前已成必然的看法。

examples.text: I'd had a few notions about being a journalist.
examples.translation: 我以前曾有过想当记者的念头。

meanings.meaning: 声名狼藉的，臭名昭著的

examples.text: ...an area notorious for drugs, crime and violence...
examples.translation: 因毒品、犯罪和暴力而臭名昭著的地区

examples.text: She told us the story of one of Britain's most notorious country house murders.
examples.translation: 她给我们讲述了英国最有名的一起乡村别墅谋杀案。

examples.text: The train company is overstaffed and notoriously inefficient...
examples.translation: 铁路公司冗员过多，工作效率出了名地低。

examples.text: He worked mainly in New York City where living space is notoriously at a premium...
examples.translation: 他主要在纽约市工作，那儿的住房出了名地昂贵。

examples.text: Doctors notoriously neglect their own health and fail to seek help when they should.
examples.translation: 众所周知,医生不注意自身的健康，而且在应该求助时也不这么做。

examples.text: He despised William Pitt, notwithstanding the similar views they both held.
examples.translation: 尽管他和威廉·皮特看法相似，却瞧不起他。

examples.text: His relations with colleagues, differences of opinion notwithstanding, were unfailingly friendly.
examples.translation: 尽管有意见分歧，他和同事们一直关系融洽。

examples.text: Plus, "Istria" is still a little-known proper noun and "Tuscany" has moved into adjective territory.
The food she eats nourishes both her and the baby.
examples.translation: 她吃的食物给她和婴儿提供了营养。

examples.text: ...microbes in the soil which nourish the plant.
examples.translation: 土壤中为植物提供营养的微生物

examples.text: Most of these nourishing substances are in the yolk of the egg.
examples.translation: 这些营养物质中的大部分在蛋黄里。

examples.text: ...sensible, nourishing food.
examples.translation: 合理的、有营养的食物

examples.text: Journalists on the whole don't create public opinion. They can help to nourish it.
examples.translation: 大体说来记者不制造舆论。他们会助长舆论。

examples.text: ...a current of thought which has been nourished by historical tradition.
examples.translation: 在历史传统中汲取养分的思潮

examples.text: ...a novel by Herman Hesse...
examples.translation: 一部赫尔曼·黑塞的小说

examples.text: ...historical novels set in the time of the Pharaohs.
examples.translation: 以法老时代为背景的历史小说

examples.text: Protesters found a novel way of demonstrating against steeply rising oil prices...
examples.translation: 抗议者找到了抗议油价飞涨的新办法。

examples.text: The very idea of a sixth form college was novel in 1962.
examples.translation: 第六学级学院在1962年还是新提法。

meanings.meaning: 新奇；新奇的事物；新颖小巧而廉价的物品

examples.text: In the contemporary western world, rapidly changing styles cater to a desire for novelty and individualism.
examples.translation: 在当代西方社会，快速变化的时尚迎合了人们追求新奇和个性的需求。

examples.text: Seeing people queuing for food was a novelty...
examples.translation: 看到人们排队买食品是件新鲜事。

examples.text: It came from the days when a motor car was a novelty.
examples.translation: 这要从轿车还是新鲜玩意儿那会儿说起。

examples.text: At Easter, we give them plastic eggs filled with small toys, novelties and coins.
examples.translation: 复活节时，我们给他们分发塑料彩蛋，里面装着小玩具、新颖的小玩意儿和硬币。

examples.text: He arrived in London in November 1939...
examples.translation: 他于1939年11月抵达伦敦。

examples.text: There's no telling what the voters will do next November.
examples.translation: 很难说投票人明年11月会如何表现。

examples.text: She's a widow now...
examples.translation: 她现在是寡妇。

examples.text: But we are now a much more fragmented society...
examples.translation: 但我们现在所处的是一个更加四分五裂的社会。

examples.text: Beef now costs well over 30 roubles a pound...
examples.translation: 牛肉现在卖到了每磅30多卢布。

examples.text: She should know that by now.
examples.translation: 她现在应该知道了。

examples.text: Now is the time when we must all live as economically as possible.
examples.translation: 现在到了我们都必须尽可能节衣缩食的时候了。

examples.text: I'm sorry, but I must go now...
examples.translation: 很抱歉我得马上走了。

examples.text: I fear that if I don't write now I shall never have another opportunity to do so.
examples.translation: 我担心如果我不立即开始写作的话，就永远都不会再有机会了。

examples.text: Now is your chance to talk to him.
examples.translation: 现在你跟他说话的机会来了。

examples.text: Now you're settled, why don't you take up some serious study?...
examples.translation: 既然你已经安顿下来了，为什么不开始正经地学点东西呢？

examples.text: Now that she was retired she lived with her sister.
examples.translation: 现在她已经退休了，和姐姐一起住。

examples.text: Mrs Chandra has received one sweater for each of her five children and says that the winter will not be so hard now...
examples.translation: 钱德拉夫人已经收到了5个孩子每人一件的毛衣，她说这下冬天就不那么难挨了。

examples.text: She told me not to repeat it, but now I don't suppose it matters...
examples.translation: 她曾告诉我不要再重蹈覆辙，但这下我认为已经无关紧要了。

examples.text: Diplomats now expect the mission to be much less ambitious.
examples.translation: 这一来外交官们估计这次任务会轻松很多。

examples.text: She felt a little better now...
examples.translation: 这时她觉得好点儿了。

examples.text: It was too late now for Blake to lock his room door...
examples.translation: 这会儿布莱克再锁房门已太晚了。

examples.text: By now it was completely dark outside.
examples.translation: 这会儿外面全黑了。

examples.text: They've been married now for 30 years...
examples.translation: 到现在他们已经结婚30年了。

examples.text: They have been missing for a long time now...
examples.translation: 现在他们已失踪很长一段时间了。

examples.text: It's some days now since I heard anything.
examples.translation: 我已经有一段时间没听到过什么消息了。

examples.text: 'Now then,' Max said, 'to get back to the point.'...
examples.translation: “好吧”，马克斯说,“回到正题上来。”

examples.text: She stays at school for drama and doesn't get back till nine. Now, what's everyone drinking?...
examples.translation: 她留在学校排戏，要到9点才回来。喂，大家要喝什么？

examples.text: Now then, laddie, what's the trouble?...
examples.translation: 喂，老弟，怎么啦？

examples.text: Now, can we move on and discuss the vital business of the day, please.
examples.translation: 好，我们继续好吗？讨论一下今天的重要事务。

examples.text: Now, er, dogs can live to fifteen...
examples.translation: 哦，狗能活15年。

examples.text: Now, erm, obviously some of our listeners may have some ideas.
examples.translation: 嗯，对了，显然我们的一些听众可能会有些想法。

examples.text: Come on now. You know you must be hungry...
examples.translation: 好，来吧，你肯定已经饿了。

examples.text: Come and sit down here, now...
examples.translation: 好，来，坐在这儿。

examples.text: Now don't talk so loud and bother him, honey.
examples.translation: 亲爱的，好了，别这么大声说话打扰他。

examples.text: My son went to Almeria in Southern Spain. Now he and his wife are people who love a quiet holiday...
examples.translation: 我儿子去了西班牙南部的阿尔梅里亚，你看，他和妻子是喜欢过安静假期的那种人。

examples.text: Now, I hadn't told him these details, so he must have done some research on his own.
examples.translation: 你看，我没有告诉他这些细节，因此他一定是自己作了一些调查。

examples.text: Now, if it was me, I'd want to do more than just change the locks...
examples.translation: 不过，如果是我，我要做的就不仅仅是换锁了。

examples.text: Now, as for the Democrats, they've been able to use this issue quite effectively to portray the president as insensitive.
examples.translation: 然而，对民主党人来说，他们成功利用了这个问题来渲染总统的麻木不仁。

examples.text: My father has a collection of magazines to which I return every now and then...
examples.translation: 我爸爸收藏了很多杂志，我有时会翻看一下。

examples.text: Now and again he'd join in when we were playing video games.
examples.translation: 我们玩电子游戏时，他偶尔会和我们一起玩。

examples.text: Jim expects to be sent to Europe any day now...
examples.translation: 吉姆预计随时会被派到欧洲去。

examples.text: Any moment now the silence will be broken.
examples.translation: 寂静随时会被打破。

examples.text: And now for something completely different...
examples.translation: 下面是完全不同的事情。

examples.text: Now for a quick look at some of the other stories in the news.
examples.translation: 下面我们快速浏览一下其他新闻报道。

examples.text: You looked pretty upset just now...
examples.translation: 你刚才看上去挺难过的。

examples.text: I spoke just now of being in love...
examples.translation: 我刚才说起坠入爱河的事。

examples.text: Just now I thought I saw someone.
examples.translation: 我想我刚才看到了什么人。

examples.text: I'm pretty busy just now...
examples.translation: 我现在特别忙。

examples.text: Mr Goldsworth is not available just now.
examples.translation: 戈兹沃斯先生这会儿没时间。

examples.text: It's now or never, so make up your mind...
examples.translation: 机不可失，下决心吧。

examples.text: Much as I hate to go, it's now or never.
examples.translation: 虽然我很讨厌去，但也就此一回了。

examples.text: 'I figure it's all over.'—'Now, now. You did just fine.'
examples.translation: “我想都过去了。”——“好啦，好啦，你做得还不错。”

examples.text: 'I want to go with you, Daddy.'—'Now, now, sweetheart.'
examples.translation: “爸爸，我想和你一起去。”——“好吧，好吧，小宝贝。”

examples.text: Now then, no unpleasantness, please...
examples.translation: 好了，别争了，好吗?

examples.text: Now, now Roger, I'm sure you didn't mean it but that remark was in very poor taste.
examples.translation: 算了，罗杰，我肯定你不是那个意思，但那话太难听了。

examples.text: Nowadays it's acceptable for women to be ambitious. But it wasn't then...
examples.translation: 如今，女性胸怀大志也能被接受，但那时候不是这样。

examples.text: I don't see much of Tony nowadays.
examples.translation: 我现在不经常见到托尼了。

meanings.meaning: 无处；任何地方都不；毫无结果
无处；任何地方；无名之地
不存在的；毫无结果的；不知名的

examples.text: Nowhere is language a more serious issue than in Hawaii...
examples.translation: 没有哪个地方像夏威夷那样，语言成了如此重要的问题。

examples.text: This kind of forest exists nowhere else in the world...
examples.translation: 在世界其他地方找不到这样的森林。

examples.text: If you are extremely rich, you could stay nowhere better than the Ruislip Court Hotel.
examples.translation: 如果你非常有钱，那就住赖斯利普宫廷酒店吧，没有比它更好的地方了。

examples.text: There was nowhere to hide and nowhere to run...
examples.translation: 无处可藏，也无处可逃。

examples.text: I have nowhere else to go, nowhere in the world...
examples.translation: 我没有其他地方可去，在这个世界上没有任何地方。

examples.text: He had nowhere to call home.
examples.translation: 他根本没有可称为家的地方。

examples.text: Michael glanced anxiously down the corridor, but Wilfred was nowhere to be seen...
examples.translation: 迈克尔焦急地顺着走廊望去，可根本看不到威尔弗雷德的影儿。

examples.text: The escaped prisoner was nowhere in sight...
examples.translation: 越狱的囚犯已经无影无踪了。

examples.text: He had gone out to get the gin. The cigarettes were nowhere.
examples.translation: 他去外边拿杜松子酒了，烟不知放哪儿了。

examples.text: ...endless paths that led nowhere in particular.
examples.translation: 不知通往何处的没有尽头的小路

examples.text: ...country roads that go from nowhere to nowhere.
examples.translation: 不知从哪里来也不知通向何方的乡间公路

examples.text: A car came from nowhere, and I had to jump back into the hedge just in time...
examples.translation: 一辆轿车不知从什么地方突然冒了出来，我只得向后跳到树篱中躲避，险些躲不及。

examples.text: Houses had sprung up out of nowhere on the hills.
examples.translation: 山丘上突然冒出一幢幢的房子。

examples.text: He nowhere offers concrete historical background to support his arguments...
examples.translation: 他没给出具体的历史背景来支撑他的论点。

examples.text: Point taken, but nowhere did we suggest that this yacht's features were unique...
examples.translation: 你说得对，但我们压根没讲过这艘游艇的特色是独一无二的。

examples.text: The most important issue for most ordinary people was nowhere on the proposed agenda.
examples.translation: 在提交的议事日程上找不到对大部分普通人来说最重要的议题。

examples.text: At dusk we pitched camp in the middle of nowhere.
examples.translation: 黄昏时，我们在茫茫荒野中扎营。

examples.text: ...a farmhouse in the middle of nowhere.
examples.translation: 遥远偏僻处的一所农舍

examples.text: My mind won't stop going round and round on the same subject and I seem to be getting nowhere...
examples.translation: 我脑子一直在不停地围绕着同一个问题转啊转，但一无所获。

examples.text: 'Getting nowhere fast,' pronounced Crosby, 'that's what we're doing.'...
examples.translation: 克罗斯比断言说：“我们一无所获，在做无用功。”

examples.text: Oh, stop it! This is getting us nowhere.
examples.translation: 哦，停下！这样不会有结果的。

examples.text: He's nowhere near recovered yet from his experiences...
examples.translation: 他还远没有从自己的经历中走出来。

examples.text: The chair he sat in was nowhere near as comfortable as the custom-designed one behind his desk.
examples.translation: 他坐的那把椅子远不如他书桌后面那把定做的舒服。

meanings.meaning: 原子能的；[细胞] 细胞核的；中心的；原子核的

examples.text: ...a nuclear power station.
examples.translation: 核电站

examples.text: ...nuclear energy.
examples.translation: 核能

examples.text: ...nuclear physics.
examples.translation: 核物理

examples.text: They rejected a demand for the removal of all nuclear weapons from UK soil.
examples.translation: 他们拒绝了将所有核武器从英国国土上撤除的要求。

examples.text: ...nuclear testing.
examples.translation: 核试验

examples.text: Neutrons and protons are bound together in the nucleus of an atom.
examples.translation: 在原子核里，中子和质子是结合在一起的。

examples.text: The Civic Movement could be the nucleus of a centrist party of the future.
examples.translation: 公民运动的成员可能会成为未来中间派政党的核心。

meanings.meaning: 讨厌的人；损害；麻烦事；讨厌的东西

examples.text: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk...
examples.translation: 他醉酒时有点讨厌。

examples.text: Sorry to be a nuisance.
examples.translation: 抱歉添麻烦了。

examples.text: He spent three days making an absolute nuisance of himself.
examples.translation: 他3天时间就把自己变成了个地地道道的“讨人嫌”。

meanings.meaning: 使麻木；使发愣；使失去感觉

examples.text: He could feel his fingers growing numb at their tips...
examples.translation: 他能感到指尖正在变得麻木。

examples.text: My legs felt numb and my toes ached.
examples.translation: 我双腿麻木，脚趾疼痛。

examples.text: I have recently been suffering from pain and numbness in my hands.
examples.translation: 我近来双手一直疼痛麻木。

examples.text: The mother, numb with grief, has trouble speaking...
examples.translation: 那位母亲因过于悲痛而说不出话来。

examples.text: I was so shocked I went numb.
examples.translation: 我太过震惊，呆若木鸡。

examples.text: Many men become more aware of emotional numbness in their 40s.
examples.translation: 很多男性到了不惑之年以后会愈加意识到自己的情感麻木。

examples.text: He walked numbly into the cemetery.
examples.translation: 他糊里糊涂地走进了墓地。

examples.text: For a while the shock of Philippe's letter numbed her...
examples.translation: 菲利普来信的打击让她愣了好一会儿。

examples.text: The horror of my experience has numbed my senses.
examples.translation: 我经历的那种恐怖已使我感觉迟钝。

examples.text: I'm so numbed with shock that I can hardly think.
examples.translation: 我惊呆了，几乎无法思考。

examples.text: ...the sort of numbed hush which usually follows an automobile accident.
examples.translation: 通常在车祸之后出现的那种死寂

examples.text: The cold numbed my fingers...
examples.translation: 严寒冻得我的手指都没有知觉了。

examples.text: An injection of local anaesthetic is usually given first to numb the area...
examples.translation: 通常先注射局部麻醉药，使该部位失去知觉。

examples.text: She awoke with a numbed feeling in her left leg.
examples.translation: 她醒来觉得左腿麻木。

meanings.meaning: 数；（杂志等的）期；号码；数字；算术
编号；计入；数…的数目；使为数有限

examples.text: No, I don't know the room number...
examples.translation: 不，我不知道房间号。

examples.text: Stan Laurel was born at number 3, Argyll Street...
examples.translation: 斯坦·劳雷尔出生在阿盖尔街3号。

examples.text: The number 47 bus leaves in 10 minutes.
examples.translation: 47路公共汽车10分钟后开车。

examples.text: Quite a considerable number of interviews are going on...
examples.translation: 大量的采访在继续。

examples.text: I have had an enormous number of letters from single parents...
examples.translation: 我已经收到了大量单亲家长的来信。

examples.text: Growing numbers of people in the rural areas are too frightened to vote.
examples.translation: 越来越多生活在乡下的人被吓得不敢投票了。

examples.text: I seem to remember that Sam told a number of lies...
examples.translation: 我好像记得萨姆说过不少谎话。

examples.text: There must be any number of people in my position.
examples.translation: 一定有很多人处在我这种境况。

examples.text: ...the world number one, Tiger Woods...
examples.translation: 世界排名第一的泰格·伍兹

examples.text: Before you knew it, the single was at Number 90 in the US singles charts...
examples.translation: 转眼之间这张单曲唱片已在美国单曲唱片排行榜上排名第90位了。

examples.text: Vikram Seth's 'A Suitable Boy' is number two in the best-seller lists.
examples.translation: 维克拉姆·塞思的《如意郎君》在畅销书排行榜中排名第二。

examples.text: They told me that their village numbered 100...
examples.translation: 他们告诉我他们村子有100人。

examples.text: This time the dead were numbered in hundreds, not dozens.
examples.translation: 这次死亡人数是数以百计，而非几十人。

examples.text: Sarah sat down and dialled a number.
examples.translation: 萨拉坐下来拨了一个电话号码。

examples.text: ...a list of names and telephone numbers...
examples.translation: 姓名和电话号码表

examples.text: My number is 414-3925...
examples.translation: 我的电话号码是414-3925。

examples.text: 'You must have a wrong number,' she said. 'There's no one of that name here.'
examples.translation: “你一定是拨错电话号码了，”她说：“这儿没有这个人。”

examples.text: ...'Unforgettable', a number that was written and performed in 1951...
examples.translation: 《难以忘怀》，一首1951年创作并演唱的歌曲

examples.text: Responsibility for the dance numbers was split between Robert Alton and the young George Balanchine.
examples.translation: 舞蹈节目分别由罗伯特·奥尔顿和年轻的乔治·巴兰钦负责。

examples.text: The Leicester Swannington Railway is numbered among Britain's railway pioneers...
examples.translation: 莱斯特—斯旺宁顿铁路被看作是英国最早的铁路之一。

examples.text: He numbered several Americans among his friends.
examples.translation: 他把几个美国人看成朋友。

examples.text: He cut his paper up into tiny squares, and he numbered each one...
examples.translation: 他把纸剪成了小方块，然后逐一编号。

examples.text: Each factor has been numbered.
examples.translation: 每个要素都编了号。

examples.text: Critics believe his days are numbered because audiences are tired of watching him.
examples.translation: 批评家猜想他走红的时间不会长了，因为观众现在厌倦了他的表演。

examples.text: Scientists like the idea that one of their number is close to the seat of power...
examples.translation: 科学家们欢迎他们中的一员接近权力中心的想法。

examples.text: One of our number has made a very interesting design of flooring, which has won a prize.
examples.translation: 我们中的一名成员设计出了非常有趣的地板图案，还获了奖。

meanings.meaning: 数值的；数字的；用数字表示的（等于numeric）

examples.text: Your job is to group them by letter and put them in numerical order.
examples.translation: 你的工作是把他们按字母顺序分组，然后按数字顺序排序。

examples.text: ...a numerically coded colour chart...
examples.translation: 用数字编码的色谱

examples.text: Numerically, there are a lot of young people involved in crime.
examples.translation: 从数字上看，有很多年轻人犯罪。

examples.text: Sex crimes were just as numerous as they are today...
examples.translation: 当时性犯罪和现在一样多。

examples.text: Despite numerous attempts to diet, her weight soared.
examples.translation: 尽管多次尝试节食，她的体重仍然飙升了。

meanings.meaning: 看护，护理；照顾；培养；给…喂奶

examples.text: She had spent 29 years as a nurse...
examples.translation: 她做了29年的护士。

examples.text: Patients were dying because of an acute shortage of nurses.
examples.translation: 因为护理人员严重不足，患者生命垂危。

examples.text: All the years he was sick my mother had nursed him...
examples.translation: 他生病的这些年来，我妈妈一直照料着他。

examples.text: She rushed home to nurse her daughter back to health.
examples.translation: 她赶回家去，要照顾女儿恢复健康。

examples.text: We're going to go home and nurse our colds.
examples.translation: 我们打算回家调养感冒。

examples.text: Jane still nurses the pain of rejection...
examples.translation: 简仍因遭到拒绝而痛苦。

examples.text: He had nursed an ambition to lead his own big orchestra.
examples.translation: 他一直有一个梦想，希望能指挥一支自己的顶级管弦乐队。

examples.text: Every morning she got up early with the children and the nurse.
examples.translation: 每天早晨，她和孩子、保姆一起早早起床。

examples.text: Most authorities recommend letting the baby nurse whenever it wants.
examples.translation: 大部分权威人士建议婴儿饿了就随时喂奶。

examples.text: ...young women nursing babies...
examples.translation: 给孩子喂奶的年轻妈妈

examples.text: Young people and nursing mothers are exempted from charges.
examples.translation: 未成年人和哺乳期女性免予起诉。

examples.text: This nursery will be able to cater for 29 children...
examples.translation: 这家托儿所能照料29个孩子。

examples.text: Her company ran its own workplace nursery.
examples.translation: 她的公司开办了内部的托儿所。

examples.text: An affordable nursery education service is an essential basic amenity.
examples.translation: 人们能负担得起的幼儿园教育是一项基本的社会福利。

examples.text: ...a nursery teacher.
examples.translation: 幼儿园老师

examples.text: He has painted murals in his children's nursery.
examples.translation: 他在孩子们的儿童房墙壁上画上了画。

examples.text: The garden, developed over the past 35 years, includes a nursery.
examples.translation: 这个有35年历史的花园里有一个苗圃。

examples.text: Parents want to know the best way to nurture and raise their child to adulthood...
examples.translation: 父母希望知道养育孩子长大成人的最佳方法。

examples.text: The modern conservatory is not an environment for nurturing plants.
examples.translation: 这个现代化温室的环境不适合培育植物。

examples.text: She was not receiving warm nurturing care.
examples.translation: 她没有得到温暖的抚育。

examples.text: Which adult in these children's lives will provide the nurturing they need?
examples.translation: 这些孩子生活中的哪个成人会为他们提供所需的养育呢？

examples.text: She had always nurtured great ambitions for her son.
examples.translation: 她总是鼓励儿子要树立远大抱负。

examples.text: ...parents whose political views were nurtured in the sixties...
examples.translation: 政治观点形成于60年代的父母一辈

examples.text: Charlie Nelson has nurtured fine sprinters.
examples.translation: 查理·纳尔逊已经培养出了相当优秀的短跑选手。

examples.text: The decision to cut back on film-making had a catastrophic effect on the nurturing of new talent.
examples.translation: 削减电影制作经费的决定在扶植新人方面有灾难性的影响。

examples.text: The human organism learns partly by nature, partly by nurture.
examples.translation: 人的学习能力部分是天生的，部分是后天培养的。

meanings.meaning: 螺母，螺帽；坚果；难对付的人，难解的问题

examples.text: Nuts and seeds are good sources of vitamin E.
examples.translation: 坚果和种子里含有丰富的维生素E。

examples.text: If you want to repair the wheels you just undo the four nuts.
examples.translation: 如果你想修理轮子，只需拧开这4个螺母就行了。

examples.text: ...nuts and bolts that haven't been tightened up.
examples.translation: 没有拧紧的螺母和螺栓

examples.text: ...a football nut who spends thousands of pounds travelling to watch games.
examples.translation: 花上几千英镑四处去看比赛的足球迷

examples.text: They're nuts about the car...
examples.translation: 他们对汽车非常痴迷。

examples.text: She's nuts about you.
examples.translation: 她迷恋上你了。

examples.text: There's some nut out there with a gun.
examples.translation: 外边有个拿着枪的疯子。

examples.text: You guys are nuts...
examples.translation: 你们这些人简直是有毛病。

examples.text: A number of the French players went nuts, completely out of control.
examples.translation: 有几个法国运动员简直是疯了，完全失去了控制。

examples.text: My father would go nuts if he saw bruises on me...
examples.translation: 如果我爸爸看到我脸上有伤痕，他会气疯的。

examples.text: We heard your sister doing her nut.
examples.translation: 我们听到你妹妹在大发脾气。

examples.text: He's more concerned about the nuts and bolts of location work.
examples.translation: 他更为担忧的是外景拍摄的具体内容。

examples.text: The Daily Express describes Dr Carey as a pretty tough nut.
examples.translation: 《每日快报》把凯里医生说成是特别难对付的家伙。

examples.text: Getting out there is in many ways the hardest nut to crack.
examples.translation: 从很多方面来说，出去交际是最难以做到的事了。

examples.text: There are alternative sources of nutrition to animal meat...
examples.translation: 存在替代肉类的其他营养来源。

examples.text: As in all experimental sciences, we still do not know everything about nutrition.
examples.translation: 就像所有实验科学一样，我们仍然没有完全认识营养作用。

meanings.meaning: 尼龙，[纺] 聚酰胺纤维；尼龙袜

examples.text: Europe's largest producer of nylon is based in Belgium...
examples.translation: 欧洲最大的尼龙制造商总部设在比利时。

examples.text: I put on a new pair of nylon socks.
examples.translation: 我穿上了一双新尼龙袜。

examples.text: This woman wore seamed nylons and kept smoothing her skirt.
examples.translation: 这个女士穿着长筒尼龙缝袜，不停地把裙子弄平整。

examples.text: Many large oaks were felled during the war.
examples.translation: 很多高大的橡树在战争中遭到了砍伐。

examples.text: ...forests of beech, chestnut, and oak.
examples.translation: 一片片山毛榉、栗树和橡树林

examples.text: The cabinet was made of oak.
examples.translation: 这个橱柜是橡木做的。

examples.text: Suchen never understood what had driven her to grasp the oar at the last moment.
He took an oath of loyalty to the government...
examples.translation: 他宣誓效忠政府。

examples.text: He swore an oath promising to uphold and protect the country's laws and constitution.
examples.translation: 他宣誓捍卫国家的法律与宪法。

examples.text: His girlfriend had gone into the witness box and taken the oath...
examples.translation: 他的女朋友进入证人席并立了誓。

examples.text: Under oath, Aston finally admitted that he had lied...
examples.translation: 在宣誓的约束下，阿斯顿终于承认自己撒了谎。

examples.text: Three officers gave evidence on oath against him.
examples.translation: 3位警官经宣誓提出了对他不利的证据。

examples.text: Wellor let out a foul oath and hurled himself upon him.
examples.translation: 韦勒骂了一句粗话，然后向他猛扑过去。

examples.text: He appointed his new staff because of their ideas and their experiences, not their political obedience.
He was very respectful at home and obedient to his parents...
examples.translation: 他在家里对父母十分恭敬顺从。

examples.text: What a sweet, obedient little girl she was in the sixth grade.
examples.translation: 她上六年级的时候是个多么可爱温顺的小女孩啊！

examples.text: ...unquestioning obedience to the law...
examples.translation: 对法律的绝对服从

examples.text: They command the respect and obedience of the armed forces.
examples.translation: 他们要求武装部队尊重上级，服从指挥。

examples.text: He was looking obediently at Keith, waiting for orders.
examples.translation: 他恭顺地看着基思，等着他发号施令。

examples.text: Cissie obeyed her mother without question...
examples.translation: 茜茜对她母亲言听计从。

examples.text: Most people obey the law...
examples.translation: 大多数人都遵纪守法。

examples.text: It was still Baker's duty to obey.
examples.translation: 贝克依然有义务服从。

meanings.meaning: 异议，反对；缺陷，缺点；妨碍；拒绝的理由

examples.text: Some managers have recently raised objection to the PFA handling these negotiations...
examples.translation: 一些主教练最近就英格兰职业足球运动员协会负责这些谈判提出了异议。

examples.text: Despite objections by the White House, the Senate voted today to cut off aid.
examples.translation: 参议院不顾白宫的反对于今天投票决定中止援助。

examples.text: I have no objection to banks making money...
examples.translation: 我对银行营利并不抵触。

examples.text: I no longer have any objection to your going to see her.
examples.translation: 我不会再因为你去见她而不高兴。

meanings.meaning: 目的；目标；[光] 物镜；宾格

examples.text: Our main objective was the recovery of the child safe and well...
examples.translation: 我们的主要目标是将孩子安然无恙地找回来。

examples.text: His objective was to play golf and win.
examples.translation: 他的目标是参加高尔夫球比赛并赢得胜利。

examples.text: He had no objective evidence that anything extraordinary was happening.
examples.translation: 他没有客观证据表明正在发生什么不同寻常之事。

examples.text: We simply want to inform people objectively about events.
examples.translation: 我们只是想如实地向人们通报事件情况。

examples.text: The poll, whose objectivity is open to question, gave the party a 39% share of the vote.
examples.translation: 在这次投票中该党获得了39％的选票，但其客观性值得怀疑。

examples.text: I believe that a journalist should be completely objective...
examples.translation: 我认为新闻记者不应当有丝毫偏见。

examples.text: I would really like to have your objective opinion on this.
examples.translation: 我很想听听你对此事的客观见解。

examples.text: Try to view situations more objectively, especially with regard to work.
examples.translation: 要尽量客观地分析情况，尤其是在工作上。

examples.text: The psychiatrist must learn to maintain an unusual degree of objectivity.
examples.translation: 精神科医生务必要学会保持超乎寻常的客观态度。

examples.text: When teachers assign homework, students usually feel an obligation to do it...
examples.translation: 老师布置作业时，学生通常认为完成作业是一种义务。

examples.text: Ministers are under no obligation to follow the committee's recommendations.
examples.translation: 部长不必非得听从委员会的建议。

examples.text: The United States will do that which is necessary to meet its obligations to its own citizens...
examples.translation: 美国将为自己的公民尽其应尽的义务。

examples.text: I have an ethical and a moral obligation to my client.
examples.translation: 我对我的当事人负有道义上的责任。

examples.text: If you are selling your property, why not call us for a free valuation without obligation?...
examples.translation: 如果您打算出售房产，何不打电话让我们作免费估价呢？

examples.text: You can review your policy in detail for a full 15 days without obligation.
examples.translation: 您可以在15天的免费体验期内仔细审核保单细则。

meanings.meaning: 迫使；强制；赐，施恩惠；责成

examples.text: The storm got worse and worse. Finally, I was obliged to abandon the car and continue on foot...
examples.translation: 暴风雨愈发猛烈，我最终不得不弃车步行。

examples.text: This decree obliges unions to delay strikes.
examples.translation: 该法令迫使工会推迟罢工。

examples.text: If you ever need help with the babysitting, I'd be glad to oblige...
examples.translation: 如果你什么时候需要找人照看孩子，我很乐意帮忙。

examples.text: We called up three economists to ask how to eliminate the deficit and they obliged with very straightforward answers...
examples.translation: 我们打电话给3位经济学家询问如何消除赤字，他们坦率地给予了答复。

examples.text: Mr Oakley always has been ready to oblige journalists with information.
examples.translation: 奥克利先生总是乐于向记者透露消息。

examples.text: Much obliged for your assistance...
examples.translation: 对您的帮助我不胜感激。

examples.text: Thank you very much indeed, Doctor, I am extremely obliged to you.
examples.translation: 大夫，太感谢您了，您真是我的大恩人。

examples.text: I would be obliged if you could read it to us.
examples.translation: 您若能把它读给大家听，我将不胜感激。

meanings.meaning: 昏暗的，朦胧的；晦涩的，不清楚的；隐蔽的；不著名的，无名的
使…模糊不清，掩盖；隐藏；使难理解
某种模糊的或不清楚的东西

examples.text: The origin of the custom is obscure...
examples.translation: 这一习俗的起源鲜为人知。

examples.text: The hymn was written by an obscure Greek composer for the 1896 Athens Olympics.
examples.translation: 这首赞歌是希腊一位名不见经传的作曲家为1896年的雅典奥运会创作的。

examples.text: The contracts are written in obscure language...
examples.translation: 这些合同的语言晦涩难懂。

examples.text: Richard's statement was disgracefully obscure.
examples.translation: 理查德的声明隐晦费解，真是丢人。

examples.text: Trees obscured his vision; he couldn't see much of the Square's southern half...
examples.translation: 树木遮挡了他的视线，南半广场的一大部分他都无法看清。

examples.text: One wall of the parliament building is now almost completely obscured by a huge banner.
examples.translation: 议会大楼的一面墙现在几乎被一条巨型横幅完全盖住了。

examples.text: ...the jargon that frequently obscures educational writing...
examples.translation: 经常让普教著作变得艰深晦涩的术语

examples.text: This issue has been obscured by recent events.
examples.translation: 最近发生的一些事件使这一问题变得混淆不清。

examples.text: He squinted his eyes as though he were studying an object on the horizon.
examples.translation: 他眯起眼睛，就好像在端详地平线上的某一物体。

examples.text: ...an object the shape of a coconut...
examples.translation: 形似椰子的物体

examples.text: In the cosy consulting room the children are surrounded by familiar objects.
examples.translation: 在温馨的诊疗室里，孩子们周围摆满了亲切熟悉的东西。

examples.text: The object of the exercise is to raise money for the charity...
examples.translation: 那样做旨在筹集善款。

examples.text: He made it his object in life to find the island...
examples.translation: 他把找到那座岛屿当成自己的人生目标。

examples.text: My object was to publish a scholarly work on Peter Mourne.
examples.translation: 我的目标是出版一本关于彼得·莫恩的学术著作。

examples.text: The object of her hatred was 24-year-old model Ros French...
examples.translation: 令她心头生恨的是24岁的模特罗斯·弗伦奇。

examples.text: The object of great interest at the Temple was a large marble tower built in memory of Buddha...
examples.translation: 这处庙宇最引人注目的是一座为纪念佛陀而修建的宏伟的大理石塔。

examples.text: She knew that she was an object of pity among her friends.
examples.translation: 她知道自己是朋友们同情的对象。

examples.text: A lot of people will object to the book...
examples.translation: 很多人都会对这本书表示反感。

examples.text: Cullen objected that his small staff would be unable to handle the added work...
examples.translation: 卡伦提出反对，说他的人手较少，无法完成额外工作。

examples.text: We objected strongly but were outvoted...
examples.translation: 我们强烈表示反对，但还是被否决了。

examples.text: 'Hey, I don't know what you're talking about,' Russo objected.
examples.translation: “喂，我不知道你在说些什么，”拉索反驳道。

examples.text: Hugh Johnson's shop in London has a range of superb Swedish crystal glasses that I would have if money were no object...
examples.translation: 休·约翰逊伦敦店出售各种美轮美奂的瑞典水晶玻璃杯，不考虑钱的话我都想买。

examples.text: Although he was based in Wales, distance was no object.
examples.translation: 虽然他主要住在威尔士，但是距离不成问题。

examples.text: ...careful observation of the movement of the planets...
examples.translation: 对行星运动的仔细观测

examples.text: In hospital she'll be under observation all the time.
examples.translation: 医院会对她24小时密切观察。

examples.text: This book contains observations about the causes of addictions.
examples.translation: 该书包括有关成瘾原因的观察发现。

examples.text: 'You're an obstinate man,' she said. 'Is that a criticism,' I said, 'or just an observation?'.
examples.translation: “你是个很执拗的人，”她说道。“你这是批评呢，”我说，“还是只是发表评论而已？”

examples.text: She has good powers of observation.
examples.translation: 她的观察力很敏锐。

meanings.meaning: 观察；遵守；说；注意到；评论

examples.text: Stern also studies and observes the behaviour of babies...
examples.translation: 斯特恩还研究观察婴儿的行为。

examples.text: Are there any classes I could observe?...
examples.translation: 有我可以观摩的课吗？

examples.text: Our sniper teams observed them manning an anti-aircraft gun.
examples.translation: 我们的狙击队观看他们操作高射炮。

examples.text: In 1664 Hooke observed a reddish spot on the surface of the planet.
examples.translation: 1664年，胡克注意到这颗行星表面有一块微红的斑点。

examples.text: We observe that the first calls for radical transformation did not begin until the period of the industrial revolution...
examples.translation: 我们认为直到工业革命时期才出现了要求彻底变革的第一波呐喊。

examples.text: 'He is a fine young man,' observed Stephen.
examples.translation: “他是个很不错的小伙子，”斯蒂芬评论道。

examples.text: Imposing speed restrictions is easy, but forcing motorists to observe them is trickier...
examples.translation: 限制车速容易，但强制司机遵守这些限速规定就难办多了。

examples.text: The army was observing a ceasefire...
examples.translation: 军队正遵守停火协议。

examples.text: American forces are observing Christmas quietly.
examples.translation: 美国部队正在悄悄地庆祝圣诞节。

meanings.meaning: 痴迷；困扰；[内科][心理] 强迫观念

examples.text: She would try to forget her obsession with Christopher...
examples.translation: 她会努力忘记对克里斯托弗的迷恋。

examples.text: 95% of patients know their obsessions are irrational.
examples.translation: 95％的病人都知道他们的痴迷是不理智的。

examples.text: So much equipment becomes obsolete almost as soon as it's made.
examples.translation: 这么多设备几乎一生产出来就要被淘汰。

examples.text: Most competition cars will only roll over if they hit an obstacle...
examples.translation: 大多数赛车只有在撞上障碍物时才会翻车。

examples.text: He left her to navigate her own way round the trolleys and other obstacles.
examples.translation: 他扔下她一个人在一堆手推车和其他障碍物之间绕来绕去。

examples.text: Overcrowding remains a large obstacle to improving conditions...
examples.translation: 过分拥挤仍然是改善环境的一大障碍。

examples.text: To succeed, you must learn to overcome obstacles.
examples.translation: 必须学会克服困难才能成功。

examples.text: Tractors and container lorries have completely obstructed the road.
examples.translation: 拖拉机和集装箱货车已经将这条路完全堵死了。

examples.text: A number of local people have been arrested for trying to obstruct lorries loaded with logs...
examples.translation: 一些当地人因试图阻止满载原木的卡车通行而被逮捕。

examples.text: Drivers who park their cars illegally, particularly obstructing traffic flow, deserve to be punished.
examples.translation: 非法停车的司机，尤其是那些阻断交通的，应当予以惩处。

examples.text: The authorities are obstructing a United Nations investigation.
examples.translation: 当局正在阻挠联合国的调查。

examples.text: Claire positioned herself so as not to obstruct David's line of sight.
examples.translation: 克莱尔为了不挡住戴维的视线挪了一下位置。

examples.text: Evans was trying to obtain a false passport and other documents...
examples.translation: 埃文斯正试图取得一本假护照和其他证件。

examples.text: The perfect body has always been difficult to obtain.
examples.translation: 完美的身材总是很难拥有。

examples.text: The longer this situation obtains, the more extensive the problems become.
examples.translation: 这种局面持续的时间越长，问题波及的范围就越广。

meanings.meaning: 明显的；显著的；平淡无奇的

examples.text: ...the need to rectify what is an obvious injustice...
examples.translation: 矫正明显不公的需要

examples.text: Determining how the Democratic challenger would conduct his presidency isn't quite so obvious.
examples.translation: 这位民主党挑战者将如何履行总统职务还不能明确判断。

examples.text: There are some very obvious phrases that we all know or certainly should know better than to use.
examples.translation: 我们都知道或是肯定应该知道有些说法已毫无新意，最好避免使用。

examples.text: Francis smiled agreement, irritated by the obviousness of his answer.
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯笑了笑以示赞同，对他那了无新意的回答有些恼火。

examples.text: It may be stating the obvious, but most teleworking at present is connected with computers.
examples.translation: 这一点或许人人皆知，但当前大部分远程办公都离不开计算机。

meanings.meaning: 偶然的；临时的；特殊场合的

examples.text: I've had occasional mild headaches all my life...
examples.translation: 间或发作的轻微头疼困扰了我一辈子。

examples.text: Esther used to visit him for the occasional days and weekends.
examples.translation: 埃丝特过去会偶尔在周末或别的日子来探望他。

examples.text: He still misbehaves occasionally...
examples.translation: 他偶尔还是会行为不端。

examples.text: I'll occasionally go to a local jazz evening with a friend.
examples.translation: 我有时会跟朋友去参加当地的爵士乐之夜。

examples.text: I often think fondly of an occasion some years ago at Covent Garden...
examples.translation: 我时常愉快地回想起几年前在科文特花园的一个时刻。

examples.text: Mr Davis has been asked on a number of occasions.
examples.translation: 戴维斯先生曾多次被问及。

examples.text: Taking her with me on official occasions has been a challenge...
examples.translation: 带着她出席正式场合对我来说一直是个挑战。

examples.text: It will be a unique family occasion.
examples.translation: 这将是一次特别的家庭聚会。

examples.text: It is an occasion for all the family to celebrate...
examples.translation: 这是个值得举家庆祝的时刻。

examples.text: It is always an important occasion for setting out government policy.
examples.translation: 这历来都是阐明政府政策的重要时机。

examples.text: He argued that the release of hostages should not occasion a change in policy.
examples.translation: 他认为释放人质不应造成政策的改变。

examples.text: We have had occasion to deal with members of the group on a variety of charges.
examples.translation: 我们有必要以多项罪名起诉该组织的成员。

examples.text: He treated them seriously and, on occasion, entertained them hilariously...
examples.translation: 他对待他们严肃认真，偶尔又逗得他们捧腹不已。

examples.text: He translated not only from the French but also, on occasion, from the Polish.
examples.translation: 他不仅做法文翻译，有时也做些波兰语翻译。

examples.text: Inverness, however, rose to the occasion in the second half, producing some of the best football they have played for some time.
examples.translation: 然而，因弗内斯队在下半场经受住了考验，踢出了很长一段时间以来的最佳水平。

examples.text: I suppose I was looking for an occupation which was going to be an adventure...
examples.translation: 我想我在找的是一份具有冒险性的工作。

examples.text: Occupation: administrative assistant.
examples.translation: 职业：行政助理

examples.text: Parachuting is a dangerous occupation.
examples.translation: 跳伞是一项危险的消遣运动。

examples.text: Prii had become fluent in German during the Wehrmacht's occupation of Estonia in 1942...
examples.translation: 在1942年德军侵占爱沙尼亚期间，普里学得了一口流利的德语。

examples.text: ...the deportation of Jews from Paris during the German occupation.
examples.translation: 德国人占领巴黎期间对犹太人的驱逐

examples.text: ...people who sell their home and buy another one for their own occupation.
examples.translation: 出售房屋再另购一套自住的人

examples.text: There were over 40 tenants, all occupying one wing of the hospital...
examples.translation: 共有40多位房客，他们全部住在这家医院的一个病区。

examples.text: Land is, in most instances, purchased by those who occupy it.
examples.translation: 在大多数情况下，土地都是由其使用者购得。

examples.text: The hospital bed is no longer occupied by his wife...
examples.translation: 他的妻子不在这张病床上了。

examples.text: I saw three camp beds, two of which were occupied.
examples.translation: 我看见了3张折叠床，其中两张已有人占了。

examples.text: U.S. forces now occupy a part of the country...
examples.translation: 美国军队现在占领了该国的一部分。

examples.text: Alexandretta had been occupied by the French in 1918 after the defeat of Turkey.
examples.translation: 土耳其溃败之后，亚历山大勒塔在1918年被法国人占领。

examples.text: ...the occupied territories.
examples.translation: 被侵占的领土

examples.text: We occupy a quality position in the market place...
examples.translation: 我们在市场上居于高端地位。

examples.text: Men still occupy more positions of power than women.
examples.translation: 担任要职的男性仍然比女性多。

examples.text: Her parliamentary career has occupied all of her time...
examples.translation: 她整日忙于议会的工作。

examples.text: He hurried to take the suitcases and occupy himself with packing the car...
examples.translation: 他急匆匆地去拎手提箱，忙着往车里装。

examples.text: I would deserve to be pitied if I couldn't occupy myself.
examples.translation: 如果我都不能让自己忙碌起来，那真是太可怜了。

examples.text: Keep the brain occupied...
examples.translation: 保持大脑全神贯注。

examples.text: I had forgotten all about it because I had been so occupied with other things.
examples.translation: 因为忙于其他事情，我把这件事忘得精光。

examples.text: I had other matters to occupy me, during the day at least...
examples.translation: 至少白天我还有别的事情要做。

examples.text: This challenge will occupy Europe for a generation or more.
examples.translation: 这将是欧洲在未来二三十年或者更长的时间里所要面临的挑战。

examples.text: Even quite small aircraft occupy a lot of space...
examples.translation: 哪怕很小的飞机也要占很大的空间。

examples.text: Bookshelves occupied most of the living room walls.
examples.translation: 这些书架占了起居室的大部分墙面。

examples.text: She reached Karachi on Monday evening, the journey having occupied three days and nine hours.
examples.translation: 她在星期一晚上抵达了卡拉奇，这段行程耗时3天9小时。

examples.text: If headaches only occur at night, lack of fresh air and oxygen is often the cause...
examples.translation: 如果只是在晚上头疼，那常常是由于缺乏新鲜空气和氧气的缘故。

examples.text: The crash occurred when the crew shut down the wrong engine...
examples.translation: 机务人员关错了引擎，随即飞机坠毁。

examples.text: In March 1770, there occurred what became known as the Boston Massacre.
examples.translation: 1770年3月在那里发生了后来闻名的波士顿惨案。

examples.text: The cattle disease occurs more or less anywhere in Africa where the fly occurs...
examples.translation: 在非洲凡是有这种蝇虫的地方，几乎都会出现这一牛病。

examples.text: These snails do not occur on low-lying coral islands or atolls.
examples.translation: 在地势低平的珊瑚岛或环礁上没有这种螺。

examples.text: It did not occur to me to check my insurance policy...
examples.translation: 我没有想到要核实我的保险单条款。

examples.text: It occurred to me that I could have the book sent to me...
examples.translation: 我想到可以让人把书寄给我。

examples.text: The same idea had occurred to Elizabeth.
examples.translation: 伊丽莎白也想到了这个主意。

examples.text: Complaints seemed to be an everyday occurrence...
examples.translation: 似乎每天都有投诉。

examples.text: The food queues have become a daily occurrence across the country.
examples.translation: 排队购买食品的长龙已成了全国各地每日可见的景象。

examples.text: The greatest occurrence of coronary heart disease is in those over 65.
examples.translation: 65岁以上者是冠心病的最高发人群。

examples.text: There were few sights as beautiful as the calm ocean on a warm night.
examples.translation: 鲜有景致能与温暖夜色下风平浪静的大海媲美。

examples.text: They spent many days cruising the northern Pacific Ocean.
examples.translation: 他们在北太平洋航行了很多天。

examples.text: ...the Indian Ocean.
examples.translation: 印度洋

examples.text: I had cried oceans of tears...
examples.translation: 我泪流成河。

examples.text: APEC seems be drowning in an ocean of jargon.
examples.translation: 亚太经合组织似乎为一大堆空洞的胡言乱语所淹没。

examples.text: His fee is a drop in the ocean compared with the real cost of broadcasting.
examples.translation: 同播出的实际开支相比较，他那点酬金不过是九牛一毛。

examples.text: The trouble began just after ten o'clock last night...
examples.translation: 昨晚刚过10点钟麻烦就开始了。

examples.text: I went to sleep, and at two o'clock in the morning I woke up.
examples.translation: 我睡着了，凌晨两点的时候醒了过来。

examples.text: Most seasonal hiring is done in early October...
examples.translation: 大部分季节性招聘在10月初进行。

examples.text: The first plane is due to leave on October 2...
examples.translation: 第一架飞机定于10月2号起飞。

examples.text: My grandson has been away since last October.
examples.translation: 我的孙子自去年10月份就离开了。

meanings.meaning: 奇数的；古怪的；剩余的；临时的；零散的

examples.text: He'd always been odd, but not to this extent...
examples.translation: 他一直比较怪异，不过并没有到这种程度。

examples.text: What an odd coincidence that he should have known your family...
examples.translation: 他居然认识你的家人，真是太巧了。

examples.text: Something odd began to happen.
examples.translation: 怪事开始出现。

examples.text: ...an oddly shaped hill...
examples.translation: 形状怪异的小山

examples.text: His own boss was behaving rather oddly.
examples.translation: 他自己的老板举动相当反常。

examples.text: Perhaps it was that very oddness that attracted me to Glen's music.
examples.translation: 也许正是格伦音乐的怪异之处吸引了我。

examples.text: ...moving from place to place where she could find the odd bit of work...
examples.translation: 她为了找到点儿零散活计不断地搬来搬去

examples.text: He had various odd cleaning jobs around the place...
examples.translation: 他在这附近干过各种零碎的保洁工作。

examples.text: I knew that Alan liked the odd drink.
examples.translation: 我知道艾伦喜欢偶尔喝点酒。

examples.text: How many pages was it, 500 odd?...
examples.translation: 这有多少页，500来页？

examples.text: He has now appeared in sixty odd films...
examples.translation: 他迄今演过60多部影片。

examples.text: 'How long have you lived here?' — 'Twenty odd years.'
examples.translation: “你在这里住多久了？”——“20多年了。”

examples.text: The odd numbers are on the left as you walk up the street...
examples.translation: 沿这条街走，在左边的是单号。

examples.text: There's an odd number of candidates.
examples.translation: 候选人总数为单数。

examples.text: I'm wearing odd socks today by the way.
examples.translation: 顺便提一下，我今天穿的袜子不成对。

examples.text: Azerbaijan has been the odd man out, the one republic not to hold democratic elections...
examples.translation: 阿塞拜疆没有举行民主选举，是这些共和国中的异类。

examples.text: Mark and Rick were the odd ones out in claiming to like this cherry beer.
examples.translation: 只剩下马克和里克声称喜欢喝这种樱桃啤酒。

examples.text: What are the odds of finding a parking space right outside the door?...
examples.translation: 就在门口找到停车位的可能性有多大？

examples.text: The odds are that you are going to fail.
examples.translation: 你很可能会失败。

examples.text: Gavin Jones, who put £25 on Eugene, at odds of 50 to 1, has won £1,250.
examples.translation: 加文·琼斯以50比1的赔率赌尤金胜，他下注25英镑，赢了1,250英镑。

examples.text: He was at odds with his Prime Minister...
examples.translation: 他与首相不和。

examples.text: An adviser said there was no reason why the two countries should remain at odds.
examples.translation: 一位顾问说这两个国家不会一直这样争执下去。

examples.text: He reckoned the odds are against the scheme going ahead...
examples.translation: 他认为目前实施这项计划的希望渺茫。

examples.text: I'm sorry. I just feel as if the odds are stacked up against me.
examples.translation: 对不起，我只是觉得情况好像对我很不利。

examples.text: Some women do manage to achieve business success against all odds...
examples.translation: 尽管困难重重，一些女性还是在商场上获得了成功。

examples.text: Finally, late in life and against considerable odds, she became a nun.
examples.translation: 她排除极大困难，最终在晚年成为了一名修女。

examples.text: His troops will only engage in a ground battle when all the odds are in their favour.
examples.translation: 他的部队只有在胜券在握的时候才打地面战。

examples.text: His reception there shortened the odds that he might be the next Tory leader.
examples.translation: 他在那里得到的反应使他更有望成为英国保守党下一任领导人。

examples.text: She can learn and recall the special odor of the colony to which she belongs.
He apologizes for his comments and says he had no intention of offending the community...
examples.translation: 他为自己发表的评论道歉并称无意冒犯该社群。

examples.text: The survey found almost 90 percent of people were offended by strong swearwords...
examples.translation: 这项调查发现几乎90％的人都会为不堪入耳的脏话所触怒。

examples.text: Television censors are cutting out scenes which they claim may offend.
examples.translation: 电视节目审查官正在剪掉他们称有可能会令人反感的一些镜头。

examples.text: She is terribly offended, angered and hurt by this.
examples.translation: 她认为这是对她的严重冒犯，感到非常愤怒和深受伤害。

examples.text: This bill offends against good sense and against justice...
examples.translation: 该法案有悖于理智和公正。

examples.text: In showing contempt for the heavyweight championship Douglas offended a stern code.
examples.translation: 道格拉斯藐视重量级拳王称号的行为违背了严格的准则。

examples.text: In Western countries girls are far less likely to offend than boys.
examples.translation: 在西方国家，女孩的犯罪倾向远低于男孩。

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, off is used after some verbs and nouns in order to introduce extra information. Off is also used in phrasal verbs such as ‘get off’, ‘pair off’, and ‘sleep off’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，off 可以用在某些动词和名词之后引出附加信息。off 还可用于 get off,pair off, sleep off 等短语动词中。

examples.text: I took the key for the room off a rack above her head...
examples.translation: 我从她头上方的架子上拿走了房门钥匙。

examples.text: Hugh wiped the rest of the blood off his face with his handkerchief.
examples.translation: 休用手帕擦去脸上残留的血迹。

examples.text: Lee broke off a small piece of orange and held it out to him...
examples.translation: 李掰下一小瓣橘子递给他。

examples.text: His exhaust fell off six laps from the finish.
examples.translation: 离终点还有6圈时，他的排气管掉了下来。

examples.text: Don't try to get on or off a moving train!...
examples.translation: 火车运行时请勿上下车！

examples.text: As he stepped off the aeroplane, he was shot dead.
examples.translation: 他一走下飞机便中枪身亡。

examples.text: At the next stop the man got off too and introduced himself.
examples.translation: 那个男人在下一站也下了车并作了自我介绍。

examples.text: Locking up men does nothing more than keep them off the streets...
examples.translation: 把这些人关起来只是做到了不让他们上街而已。

examples.text: The local police had warned visitors to keep off the beach at night.
examples.translation: 当地警方告诫游客不要在夜间去海滩。

examples.text: ...a sign saying 'Keep Off'.
examples.translation: 写着“请勿入内”的牌子

examples.text: The boat was anchored off the northern coast of the peninsula...
examples.translation: 这艘船停泊在离该半岛北部海岸不远的地方。

examples.text: Lily lives in a penthouse just off Park Avenue...
examples.translation: 莉莉住在公园大道附近的一套顶层豪华公寓里。

examples.text: The Princess's sitting-room leads off the drawing room...
examples.translation: 王妃的起居室挨着客厅。

examples.text: Tiny secluded beaches can be found off the beaten track.
examples.translation: 在人迹罕至的地方能找到僻静的小海滩。

examples.text: He was just about to drive off when the secretary came running out...
examples.translation: 他正打算驾车离开，这时秘书跑了出来。

examples.text: She gave a hurried wave and set off across the grass...
examples.translation: 她匆匆地挥了挥手便穿过草地离开了。

examples.text: She was off again. Last year she had been to Kenya. This year it was Goa...
examples.translation: 她又走了，去年去了肯尼亚，今年则是果阿。

examples.text: When his master's off traveling, Caleb stays with Pierre's parents.
examples.translation: 凯莱布在主人外出旅行时与皮埃尔的父母住在一起。

examples.text: He took off his spectacles and rubbed frantically at the lens...
examples.translation: 他摘下眼镜，疯狂地擦着镜片。

examples.text: He hastily stripped off his old uniform and began pulling on the new one.
examples.translation: 他匆匆地脱下旧制服，开始穿上新的那件。

examples.text: The rest of the men had the day off...
examples.translation: 其他人这天没上班。

examples.text: You can even snatch a few hours off, and perhaps negotiate the occasional night off too...
examples.translation: 你甚至可以抽空休息几小时，商量一下的话没准还能偶尔不用上晚班。

examples.text: She was sacked for demanding Saturdays off...
examples.translation: 她因为要求星期六不上班而被解雇了。

examples.text: I'm off tomorrow...
examples.translation: 我明天不上班。

examples.text: The average Swede was off sick 27 days last year.
examples.translation: 去年瑞典人平均休病假27天。

examples.text: He could not get time off work to go on holiday.
examples.translation: 他工作很忙，抽不出时间去度假。

examples.text: Keep off the subject of politics...
examples.translation: 勿谈政治。

examples.text: Keep the conversation off linguistic matters.
examples.translation: 避谈语言学问题。

examples.text: Until Pointon is completely happy, however, the deal's off...
examples.translation: 但是，在波因顿完全满意之前，这一协议不再作数。

examples.text: The vacant W.B.C. junior-lightweight title has been called off...
examples.translation: 空缺的世界拳击理事会次轻量级头衔被取消了。

examples.text: Greenpeace refused to call off the event.
examples.translation: 绿色和平组织拒绝取消这一活动。

examples.text: She felt better and the psychiatrist took her off drug therapy...
examples.translation: 她感觉好些了，那位精神科医生让她停止了药物治疗。

examples.text: Most pregnant women remain off cigarettes while carrying the child.
examples.translation: 大多数孕妇都在孕期戒了烟。

examples.text: I'm off coffee at the moment...
examples.translation: 我眼下不再嗜咖啡了。

examples.text: Diarrhoea can make you feel weak, as well as putting you off your food.
examples.translation: 腹泻会让人感到乏力，而且没有胃口。

examples.text: As he pulled into the driveway, he saw her bedroom light was off...
examples.translation: 当他把车开进车道时，他看到她卧室的灯已经熄了。

examples.text: We used sail power and turned the engine off to save our fuel...
examples.translation: 我们借助风帆的动力航行，且关掉了发动机以节省燃油。

examples.text: The microphones had been switched off.
examples.translation: 这些麦克风已关掉。

examples.text: ...Simons Leatherwear, 37 Old Christchurch Road. 20 per cent off all jackets this Saturday.
examples.translation: 本周六老基督堂路37号的西蒙斯皮衣店所有夹克降价20％。

examples.text: ...discounts offering thousands of pounds off the normal price of a car.
examples.translation: 比平时车价低几千英镑的折扣

examples.text: I'm prepared to knock five hundred pounds off but no more.
examples.translation: 我做好了降500英镑的打算，但不会再低了。

examples.text: Florida was a long way off...
examples.translation: 佛罗里达离这儿很远。

examples.text: ...animals that from a long way off look like flies...
examples.translation: 远看像苍蝇的动物

examples.text: Below you, though still 50 miles off, is the most treeless stretch of land imaginable.
examples.translation: 就在你下方，不过是在50英里开外的，是一片你能想象到的最荒凉的不毛之地。

examples.text: An end to the crisis seems a long way off...
examples.translation: 这场危机看来远未结束。

examples.text: The required technology is probably still two years off.
examples.translation: 所需技术可能还要两年才能开发出来。

examples.text: I don't really get a lot of information, and if I do I get it off Mark...
examples.translation: 我得到的信息其实不多，即使有也是马克告诉我的。

examples.text: I can't find the boys' shampoo. I can't think where I put it when I took it off them...
examples.translation: 我找不到那帮家伙的洗发水了，从他们那里拿来后我就忘了搁在什么地方。

examples.text: 'Telmex' was bought off the government by a group of investors.
examples.translation: 一批投资商从政府手中买下墨西哥电信公司。

examples.text: Most of these people aren't very well off...
examples.translation: 这些人大都不算太富裕。

examples.text: Surely you can't be that badly off?...
examples.translation: 你肯定没那么穷吧？

examples.text: He's very comfortably off.
examples.translation: 他生活相当宽裕安逸。

examples.text: Don't eat that! It's mouldy. It's gone off!
examples.translation: 别吃那个！它已经发霉变质了！

examples.text: Her husband's memories are of living off roast chicken and drinking whisky...
examples.translation: 她丈夫只记得过去吃烤鸡、喝威士忌的日子。

examples.text: Antony had been living off the sale of his own paintings.
examples.translation: 安东尼一直靠卖自己的画为生。

examples.text: The Auto Compact Disc Cleaner can run off batteries or mains.
examples.translation: 这种光盘自动清洗机可用电池或电源两种方式驱动。

examples.text: ...coming home with make-up all over his clothes — it's a bit off isn't it...
examples.translation: 衣服上到处沾着化妆品回到家——他这样有点过分了，是不是。

examples.text: Some of the dialogue is slightly off.
examples.translation: 部分对话有些不太得体。

examples.text: I was still working on and off as a waitress to support myself...
examples.translation: 我为了糊口仍然间或去做服务员。

examples.text: We lived together, off and on, for two years.
examples.translation: 我们断断续续在一起生活了两年。

meanings.meaning: 攻击的；冒犯的；无礼的；讨厌的

examples.text: Some friends of his found the play horribly offensive.
examples.translation: 他的一些朋友觉得该剧非常让人反感。

examples.text: ...offensive remarks which called into question the integrity of my firm.
examples.translation: 令我公司的诚信遭受质疑的冒犯性言论

examples.text: The group who had been shouting offensively opened to let her through...
examples.translation: 那群无礼叫嚷的人让开一条路让她通过。

examples.text: I thought his glance at me had been offensively bold.
examples.translation: 我觉得他对我的瞥视唐突无礼。

examples.text: Its latest military offensive against rebel forces is aimed at reopening important trade routes...
examples.translation: 它对叛军的最新一轮军事进攻旨在重新打开重要的贸易通道。

examples.text: The armed forces have launched offensives to recapture lost ground.
examples.translation: 这支武装部队已发动进攻要夺回失去的阵地。

examples.text: Republicans acknowledged that they had little choice but to mount an all-out offensive on the Democratic nominee.
examples.translation: 共和党人承认他们别无选择，只有对获提名的民主党人展开全面攻击。

examples.text: ...a diplomatic offensive.
examples.translation: 外交攻势

examples.text: The worst-ever defeat of this team proved once again that Stanford can be one of the most explosive offensive teams in the country.
examples.translation: 该队前所未有的惨败再次证明斯坦福队是国内最具爆发力的进攻型队伍之一。

examples.text: The West African forces went on the offensive in response to attacks on them...
examples.translation: 西非部队对袭击者展开全力还击。

examples.text: The Foreign Secretary has decided to take the offensive in the discussion on the future of the community.
examples.translation: 外交大臣决定在有关该社群未来的讨论中采取攻势。

examples.text: John was irritated by drivers parking near his house and causing an obstruction.
examples.translation: 约翰对那些在他家附近泊车堵住通道的司机感到恼火。

examples.text: The boy was suffering from a bowel obstruction and he died.
examples.translation: 这个男孩因患肠梗阻死去了。

examples.text: Mr Guest refused to let them in and now faces a criminal charge of obstruction.
examples.translation: 格斯特先生因为将他们拒之门外，现在面临妨碍公务的刑事指控。

meanings.meaning: 提议；出价；意图；录取通知书

examples.text: He has offered seats at the conference table to the Russian leader and the president of Kazakhstan...
examples.translation: 他已邀请俄罗斯领导人和哈萨克斯坦总统参加会谈。

examples.text: The number of companies offering them work increased...
examples.translation: 越来越多的公司向他们提供工作机会。

examples.text: Rhys offered him an apple...
examples.translation: 里斯给他一个苹果。

examples.text: Western governments have offered aid.
examples.translation: 西方政府提供了援助。

examples.text: Peter offered to teach them water-skiing...
examples.translation: 彼得主动提出教他们滑水。

examples.text: 'Can I get you a drink,' she offered.
examples.translation: “想要喝点什么吗，”她提议道。

examples.text: The offer of talks with Moscow marks a significant change from the previous western position...
examples.translation: 提议与莫斯科举行会谈标志着西方立场的重大转变。

examples.text: 'I ought to reconsider her offer to move in,' he mused...
examples.translation: “我该重新考虑她让我搬去和她一起住的提议，”他思忖着。

examples.text: He had refused several excellent job offers.
examples.translation: 他已经拒绝了好几个绝佳的工作机会。

examples.text: They manage a company offering advice on mergers and acquisitions...
examples.translation: 他们经营着一家为兼并收购业务提供咨询的公司。

examples.text: She offered him emotional and practical support in countless ways...
examples.translation: 她以数不清的方式给予了他情感上和实质上的支持。

examples.text: They are offered very little counselling or support.
examples.translation: 他们没有得到多少指导或支持。

examples.text: The President has offered his sympathy to the Georgian people...
examples.translation: 总统对格鲁吉亚人民表示了同情。

examples.text: It must be better to be able to offer them love and security...
examples.translation: 要是能给予他们关爱和安全感肯定会更好。

examples.text: John's mother and sister rallied round offering comfort.
examples.translation: 约翰的母亲和姐姐到他身边给予安慰。

examples.text: Church leaders offered prayers and condemned the bloodshed...
examples.translation: 教会领袖向上帝祈祷并谴责流血事件。

examples.text: He will offer the first harvest of rice to the sun goddess.
examples.translation: 他将把收获的第一束稻子献给太阳女神。

examples.text: He should consider offering up a prayer to St Lambert.
examples.translation: 他应当考虑向圣朗贝尔祷告。

examples.text: We have been successful because we are offering a quality service...
examples.translation: 我们因提供的服务水准一流一直经营得很成功。

examples.text: Sainsbury's is offering customers 1p for each shopping bag reused...
examples.translation: 塞恩斯伯里超市为重复利用购物袋的顾客提供每只1便士的奖励。

examples.text: Eagle Star offers a 10% discount to the over-55s.
examples.translation: 鹰星公司给予年龄在55岁以上的顾客10％的折扣。

examples.text: This month's offers include a shirt, trousers and bed covers...
examples.translation: 本月的特价商品包括一款衬衫、裤子和多种床罩。

examples.text: Today's special offer gives you a choice of three destinations...
examples.translation: 今天推出的特价线路有3个目的地可供选择。

examples.text: Over 40 new books are on offer at 25 per cent off their normal retail price.
examples.translation: 超过40种新书降价25％特惠销售。

examples.text: Whitney has offered $21.50 a share in cash for 49.5 million Prime shares...
examples.translation: 惠特尼公司开出每股21.50美元的现金价收购4,950 万股普赖姆公司的股票。

examples.text: They are offering farmers $2.15 a bushel for corn...
examples.translation: 他们向农民出价每蒲式耳2.15美元收购玉米。

examples.text: He will write Rachel a note and offer her a fair price for the land...
examples.translation: 他将给蕾切尔写一张便条，就那块土地开出合理的价格。

examples.text: It was his custom in buying real estate to offer a rather low price.
examples.translation: 他在购买地产时习惯把价格压得很低。

examples.text: The lawyers say no one else will make me an offer...
examples.translation: 律师说不会再有人给我出价了。

examples.text: He has dismissed an offer of compensation.
examples.translation: 他拒绝接受赔偿金。

examples.text: In your free time, explore all that this incredible city has to offer.
examples.translation: 您可以在闲暇时间探索这座美妙城市的各种风情。

examples.text: Savings schemes are the best retail investment products on offer.
examples.translation: 储蓄方案是现有的最佳零售投资产品。

examples.text: ...country cottages on offer at bargain prices.
examples.translation: 低价出售的乡村别墅

examples.text: It seems that while the Kiwis are keen to have him, he is still open to offers.
examples.translation: 看来尽管新西兰几维队很想与他签约，他仍然欢迎其他球队开价。

meanings.meaning: 办公室；政府机关；官职；营业处

examples.text: He had an office big enough for his desk and chair, plus his VDU...
examples.translation: 他有一间足以容纳书桌、椅子和视频显示器的办公室。

examples.text: At about 4.30 p.m. Audrey arrived at the office...
examples.translation: 大约下午4点30分，奥德丽到了办公室。

examples.text: Telephone their head office for more details.
examples.translation: 更详细的情况请致电他们的总部咨询。

examples.text: ...an office block.
examples.translation: 办公大楼

examples.text: Thousands have registered with unemployment offices.
examples.translation: 已有数千人在失业管理处作了登记。

examples.text: ...Downing Street's press office.
examples.translation: 唐宁街新闻办公室

examples.text: ...the Congressional Budget Office.
examples.translation: 国会预算局

examples.text: The tourist office operates a useful room-finding service.
examples.translation: 这家旅游办事处提供十分实用的住宿查询服务。

examples.text: ...the airline ticket offices.
examples.translation: 航空公司售票处

examples.text: The events to mark the President's ten years in office went ahead as planned...
examples.translation: 总统任职10周年的庆祝活动按计划进行。

examples.text: They are fed up with the politicians and want to vote them out of office...
examples.translation: 他们再也无法忍受这些政客，希望通过选举把他们赶下台。

examples.text: The president shall hold office for five years...
examples.translation: 总统任期为5年。

examples.text: The Vietnam War dashed President Johnson's hopes of a second term of office...
examples.translation: 越南战争使约翰逊总统连任的希望破灭了。

examples.text: He ran for office.
examples.translation: 他参加了公职的竞选。

examples.text: She sought the good offices of the President for the smooth passage of the Bill.
examples.translation: 为了使该法案顺利通过，她寻求总统的帮助。

meanings.meaning: 军官，警官；公务员，政府官员；船长

examples.text: ...a retired British army officer...
examples.translation: 退役的英国陆军军官

examples.text: Her husband served during the Civil War as an officer in the White Army.
examples.translation: 她的丈夫在内战时期是一名白军的军官。

examples.text: ...a local authority education officer.
examples.translation: 当地政府的教育官员

examples.text: ...senior officers in the West Midlands police force...
examples.translation: 西米德兰兹郡警队的高级警官

examples.text: Thank you, Officer.
examples.translation: 谢谢你，警官。

examples.text: According to the official figures, over one thousand people died during the revolution...
examples.translation: 根据官方数字，1,000多人在这场革命中丧生。

examples.text: An official announcement is expected in the next few days...
examples.translation: 预计过几天会发布一项正式声明。

examples.text: A report in the official police newspaper gave no reason for the move.
examples.translation: 刊登在警方的官方报纸上的一篇报道没有说明此次行动的原因。

examples.text: The election results have still not been officially announced...
examples.translation: 选举结果仍未正式公布。

examples.text: The nine-year civil war is officially over.
examples.translation: 长达9年的内战正式宣告结束。

examples.text: The President is in Brazil for an official two-day visit.
examples.translation: 总统正在巴西进行为期两天的正式访问。

examples.text: ...the official residence of the Head of State.
examples.translation: 国家元首的官邸

examples.text: The official explanation for the cancellation of the party conference is that there are no premises available...
examples.translation: 官方对取消此次政党会议作出的解释是没有场地。

examples.text: The official reason given for the President's absence was sickness.
examples.translation: 对外公布的总统未到场原因是身体有恙。

examples.text: Officially, the guard was to protect us. In fact, they were there to report on our movements.
examples.translation: 这些警卫表面上是为了保护我们。实际上，他们在那里是为了随时报告我们的行踪。

examples.text: A senior UN official hopes to visit Baghdad this month.
examples.translation: 一位联合国高级官员希望于本月访问巴格达。

meanings.meaning: 抵消，补偿；平版印刷；支管
抵消；弥补；用平版印刷术印刷

examples.text: The increase in pay costs was more than offset by higher productivity...
examples.translation: 提高的生产率抵消了增加的工资成本后仍有结余。

examples.text: The move is designed to help offset the shortfall in world oil supplies caused by the UN embargo.
examples.translation: 此举旨在缓解联合国禁运所造成的世界石油供应短缺的局面。

examples.text: Eleanor was now less anxious about her offspring than she had once been.
examples.translation: 埃莉诺现在不像以往那样为孩子忧心了。

examples.text: Often is usually used before the verb, but it may be used after the verb when it has a word like ‘less’ or ‘more’ before it, or when the clause is negative.
examples.translation: often通常用于动词前，但若前面有less，more等词，或从句为否定形式时，可置于动词之后。

examples.text: Early American weathervanes were most often cut from flat wooden boards...
examples.translation: 美国早期的风向标大多截自平直的木板。

examples.text: They used these words freely, often in front of their parents too...
examples.translation: 这些语词他们随口即出，在父母面前也常常如此。

examples.text: It was often hard to work and do the course at the same time...
examples.translation: 半工半读常常很艰难。

examples.text: That doesn't happen very often.
examples.translation: 那样的事并不常见。

examples.text: How often do you brush your teeth?...
examples.translation: 你多久刷一次牙？

examples.text: I don't know how often I heard the same awful jokes...
examples.translation: 这种千篇一律的烂笑话我不知道听过多少回了。

examples.text: Unemployed Queenslanders were victims of personal crime twice as often as employed people.
examples.translation: 在昆士兰，失业人群沦为个人犯罪受害者的可能性比就业人群高一倍。

examples.text: She's going to come back every so often...
examples.translation: 她会偶尔回来的。

examples.text: Every so often he would turn and look at her.
examples.translation: 他会时不时回头看她一眼。

examples.text: Yet, as often as not, they find themselves the target of persecution rather than praise...
examples.translation: 然而，他们发现自己往往不是被赞扬而是遭刁难。

examples.text: Although sometimes I feel like bothering, as often as not I don't...
examples.translation: 虽然我有时会觉得这是在找麻烦，但是通常并不会这样。

examples.text: Behind many successful men there is, more often than not, a woman who makes this success possible.
examples.translation: 很多成功男人的背后往往都有一位助他一臂之力的女人。

examples.text: The company buys and sells about 600,000 barrels of oil a day.
examples.translation: 该公司每天买卖约60万桶石油。

examples.text: ...the rapid rise in prices for oil and petrol.
examples.translation: 石油与汽油价格的急剧上涨

examples.text: ...a small oil lamp.
examples.translation: 一盏小油灯

examples.text: A crew of assistants oiled and adjusted the release mechanism until it worked perfectly...
examples.translation: 一班助手给排放装置加润滑油并作调试，直到其达至理想工作状态。

examples.text: The leather may need to be oiled every two to three weeks in order to retain its suppleness.
examples.translation: 为了保持皮革的柔韧性，可能两三周就要上一次油。

examples.text: Combine the beans, chopped mint and olive oil in a large bowl...
examples.translation: 将菜豆、切碎的薄荷和橄榄油放在大碗里搅拌。

examples.text: Drop the slices into the oil and fry until golden brown.
examples.translation: 将切片倒进油里，煎至金棕色。

examples.text: Try a hot bath with some relaxing bath oil...
examples.translation: 用舒缓沐浴油洗个热水澡吧。

examples.text: My sister smeared herself with suntan oil and slept by the swimming pool all day.
examples.translation: 我姐姐抹了些防晒油，一整天睡在游泳池边。

examples.text: Her colourful oils and works on paper have a naive, dreamlike quality.
examples.translation: 她那些色彩斑斓的油画与纸上作品给人一种天真、梦幻般的感觉。

examples.text: When she paints in oils she always uses the same range of colours.
examples.translation: 她创作油画时总是使用同一组色彩。

examples.text: On all such occasions, the king stands in the wings, oiling the wheels of diplomacy.
examples.translation: 在所有这样的场合，国王总是身处幕后确保外交活动的顺利进行。

examples.text: ...a shooting range where it's OK to use weapons...
examples.translation: 可以使用武器的射击场

examples.text: Is it okay if I come by myself?...
examples.translation: 我一个人来行吗？

examples.text: I guess for a fashionable restaurant like this the prices are OK.
examples.translation: 我想对于这样一家时髦的餐馆来说，这样的价格算是可以接受吧。

examples.text: We seemed to manage okay for the first year or so after David was born.
examples.translation: 戴维出生后的头一两年，我们似乎还能对付。

examples.text: Check that the baby's okay...
examples.translation: 看看孩子是否还好。

examples.text: 'Don't worry about me,' I said. 'I'll be okay.'
examples.translation: “别担心我，”我说，“我不会有事的。”

examples.text: 'Just tell him Sir Kenneth would like to talk to him.' — 'OK.'...
examples.translation: “就跟他说肯尼思爵士想跟他谈谈。”——“好的。”

examples.text: 'Shall I give you a ring on Friday?' — 'Yeah okay.'
examples.translation: “我星期五给你打电话好吗？”——“好的。”

examples.text: Add them together, divide by five, and you've got the average. Okay?...
examples.translation: 把它们相加再除以5就是平均数，明白吗？

examples.text: We'll get together next week, OK?
examples.translation: 我们下周聚一聚，好吗？

examples.text: OK. Now, let's talk some business...
examples.translation: 好了，我们现在言归正传吧。

examples.text: Tim jumped to his feet. 'Okay, let's go.'
examples.translation: 蒂姆一跃而起，“好了，我们走吧。”

examples.text: Okay, there is a slight difference...
examples.translation: 行了，是略有不同。

examples.text: Okay, so I'm forty-two.
examples.translation: 得了，我就算42岁吧。

examples.text: His doctor wouldn't OK the trip...
examples.translation: 医生不会同意他去旅行。

examples.text: We are all wondering why the government is suddenly okaying a brand new school on the island.
examples.translation: 我们都很疑惑为什么政府突然批准在岛上建一所新学校。

examples.text: He gave the okay to issue a new press release...
examples.translation: 他同意发布一篇新的新闻稿。

examples.text: We are ready to start flying to Britain as soon as we get the okay.
examples.translation: 一旦获得批准，我们将随即启程飞往英国。

examples.text: Omit the salt in this recipe...
examples.translation: 省略菜谱中放盐这一步。

examples.text: Our apologies to David Pannick for omitting his name from last week's article.
examples.translation: 我们在上周的文章里漏掉了戴维·潘尼克的名字，特此向他致歉。

examples.text: His new girlfriend had omitted to tell him she was married.
examples.translation: 他的新女友未把自己已婚的事实告诉他。

examples.text: ...a white-haired old man...
examples.translation: 白发老人

examples.text: He was considered too old for the job.
examples.translation: 他被认为年纪太大,不适合做这份工作。

examples.text: ...providing a caring response for the needs of the old and the handicapped.
examples.translation: 对老年人和残疾人的需求予以关心照顾

examples.text: He was abandoned by his father when he was three months old...
examples.translation: 他3个月大的时候被父亲遗弃了。

examples.text: The paintings in the chapel were perhaps a thousand years old...
examples.translation: 小教堂里的这些画可能有1,000年的历史了。

examples.text: How old are you now?...
examples.translation: 你现在多大了？

examples.text: These weren't young kids, they were as old as I was...
examples.translation: 他们不是小孩子，他们跟我一样大。

examples.text: Bill was six years older than David.
examples.translation: 比尔比戴维大6岁。

examples.text: She loved the big old house...
examples.translation: 她喜欢这幢古老的大房子。

examples.text: These books must be very old.
examples.translation: 这些书肯定有好些年头了。

examples.text: ...an old Arab proverb.
examples.translation: 一句古老的阿拉伯谚语

examples.text: ...her old habit of criticizing his speech...
examples.translation: 她总是要对他的发言提出批评的老习惯

examples.text: Ethnic tensions are an old problem here.
examples.translation: 种族矛盾是该地区由来已久的问题。

examples.text: He took a bunch of keys from the pocket of his old corduroy trousers.
examples.translation: 他从破旧的灯芯绒裤子口袋里掏出一串钥匙。

examples.text: ...an old toothbrush.
examples.translation: 一把旧牙刷

examples.text: The old road had disappeared under grass and heather...
examples.translation: 从前的那条路已经消失在杂草和欧石南丛中。

examples.text: Although the old secret police have been abolished, the military police still exist...
examples.translation: 虽然旧时的秘密警察业已废除，但宪兵队依然存在。

examples.text: In the old Liberal party the peace movement was a powerful voice.
examples.translation: 和平运动在过去的自由党内呼声很强。

examples.text: I'll make up the bed in your old room...
examples.translation: 我会把你原来房间的床铺整理好。

examples.text: I still have affection for my old school...
examples.translation: 我依然眷恋着母校。

examples.text: Mark was heartbroken when Jane returned to her old boyfriend.
examples.translation: 简同前男友旧情复燃，这使马克心都碎了。

examples.text: I called my old friend John Horner...
examples.translation: 我给老朋友约翰·霍纳打了电话。

examples.text: Mr Brownson, I assure you King's an old enemy of mine...
examples.translation: 布朗森先生，我向你保证金是我的老冤家。

examples.text: The French and English are old rivals.
examples.translation: 法国人跟英国人是老对头。

examples.text: Are you all right, old chap?...
examples.translation: 你还好吗，老家伙？

examples.text: Good old Bergen would do him the favor.
examples.translation: 好心肠的老伯根会帮他这个忙的。

examples.text: Any old paper will do...
examples.translation: 随便一张旧报纸就行。

examples.text: The portraits and sumptuous ornaments, and the gold clock, show that this is not just any old front room.
examples.translation: 墙上挂的画像、奢华的装饰和那座金钟都表明这可不是一间普普通通的客厅。

examples.text: In the old days we got a visit from the vet maybe once a year.
examples.translation: 以前，兽医大概每年来我们这里出诊一次。

examples.text: He remembers the good old days when everyone in his village knew him and you could leave your door open at night.
examples.translation: 他还记得村里人互相熟识、可以夜不闭户的美好往昔。

examples.text: ...the warrior knights of old.
examples.translation: 旧时骁勇善战的骑士

examples.text: ...a programme of work to recreate the Sherwood Forest of old.
examples.translation: 重现古时舍伍德森林的工程

examples.text: I met Wilma once, briefly...
examples.translation: 我曾经和威尔玛有过短短的一面之缘。

examples.text: Since that evening I haven't once slept through the night...
examples.translation: 从那天晚上之后，我没有睡过一次安稳觉。

examples.text: Mary had only been to Manchester once before.
examples.translation: 玛丽以前只去过一次曼彻斯特。

examples.text: 'Have they been to visit you yet?' — 'Just the once, yeah.'...
examples.translation: “他们来看过你吗？”——“来过，就一次。”

examples.text: Listen to us, if only this once.
examples.translation: 听我们的吧，哪怕就这么一次。

examples.text: Lung cells die and are replaced about once a week...
examples.translation: 肺细胞约每周新老更替一次。

examples.text: We arranged a special social event once a year to which we invited our major customers.
examples.translation: 我们每年举办一次专门的社交活动，邀请重要客户出席。

examples.text: The patient was seen for follow-up visits once every three months...
examples.translation: 这位病人每三个月接受一次随访就诊。

examples.text: My daughter comes to visit me once every fortnight.
examples.translation: 我女儿每两周来看我一次。

examples.text: The culture minister once ran a theatre...
examples.translation: 这位文化部长曾经经营过一家剧院。

examples.text: I lived there once myself, before I got married...
examples.translation: 我结婚前曾独自在那儿住过。

examples.text: The house where she lives was once the village post office...
examples.translation: 她现在住的房子曾经是村里的邮局。

examples.text: My memory isn't as good as it once was.
examples.translation: 我的记性赶不上从前了。

examples.text: ...an undulating park, once lovely but now ruined by new buildings.
examples.translation: 曾经景色秀美、而今被新建筑糟蹋得面目全非的高低错落的庭园

examples.text: I once went camping at Lake Darling with a friend...
examples.translation: 我曾和一位朋友在达令湖畔露营。

examples.text: We once walked across London at two in the morning...
examples.translation: 我们曾在凌晨两点步行穿过伦敦。

examples.text: Diana had taken that path once.
examples.translation: 黛安娜曾走过那条路。

examples.text: The decision had taken about 10 seconds once he'd read a market research study...
examples.translation: 在他看过一份市场调研报告后大概10秒钟就作出了决定。

examples.text: Once customers come to rely on these systems they almost never take their business elsewhere...
examples.translation: 顾客一旦依赖上这些系统，几乎就不会光顾其他商家。

examples.text: Once inside her apartment she felt an urge to brush her teeth.
examples.translation: 一回到自己的公寓，她就有一种想要刷牙的冲动。

examples.text: I feel terribly sleepy all at once...
examples.translation: 我突然觉得特别困。

examples.text: All at once there was someone knocking on the door.
examples.translation: 忽然有人敲门。

examples.text: I have to go, I really must, at once...
examples.translation: 我得走了，我真的必须马上就走。

examples.text: Remove from the heat, add the parsley, toss and serve at once...
examples.translation: 端离炉子，加上欧芹，颠起翻面后就立刻上桌。

examples.text: The audience at once greeted him warmly.
examples.translation: 观众立即对他作出了热情的反应。

examples.text: You can't be doing two things at once...
examples.translation: 不能一心二用。

examples.text: No bank could ever pay off its creditors if they all demanded their money at once...
examples.translation: 如果所有的储户同时要求提取存款，没有哪家银行能办得到。

examples.text: She seems at once feminine and able to cope in a man's world.
examples.translation: 她看起来既有女人味，又能在男人的世界里游刃有余。

examples.text: For once, dad is not complaining...
examples.translation: 爸爸这次破天荒地没有抱怨。

examples.text: His smile, for once, was genuine.
examples.translation: 只有这一次，他真诚地笑了。

examples.text: Amy picked up the hairbrush and smoothed her hair once more...
examples.translation: 埃米拿起发梳，再次将头发梳理整齐。

examples.text: Once again an official inquiry has spoken of weak management and ill-trained workers.
examples.translation: 官方调查又一次提到了管理不力与工人缺乏训练的问题。

examples.text: We have to resolve this matter once and for all...
