examples.translation: 我们必须彻底解决这一问题。

examples.text: If we act fast, we can once and for all prevent wild animals in Britain from suffering terrible cruelty.
examples.translation: 如果我们迅速采取行动，就可以一劳永逸地使英国的野生动物免受残忍的虐待。

examples.text: Earrings need to be taken out and cleaned once in a while.
examples.translation: 耳环要偶尔取出来清洗一下。

examples.text: Once in a while she phoned him.
examples.translation: 她间或会给他打个电话。

examples.text: I popped my head round the door once or twice...
examples.translation: 我有几次头撞到了门上。

examples.text: Once or twice she had caught a flash of interest in William's eyes...
examples.translation: 有那么一两次，她发现威廉的眼睛里流露出一丝感兴趣的神色。

examples.text: She gazed up at him, blinking once or twice, apparently surprised at his cleverness.
examples.translation: 她抬头注视着他，偶尔才眨一下眼睛，显然对他的聪明才智颇为惊讶。

examples.text: 'Once upon a time,' he began, 'there was a man who had everything.'...
examples.translation: “很久很久以前，”他开始说道，“有这么一个人，他应有尽有。”

examples.text: Once upon a time, asking a woman if she has a job was quite a straightforward question.
examples.translation: 从前，问一位女性是否有工作是个相当简单直接的问题。

examples.text: One must apply oneself to the present and keep one's eyes firmly fixed on one's future goals...
examples.translation: 人们必须立足现在，目光锁定未来目标。

examples.text: To work one must have time to oneself.
examples.translation: 一个人要工作就必须有属于自己的时间。

examples.text: The historic feeling of the town makes it a pleasant place to base oneself for summer vacations...
examples.translation: 该镇的历史气息让它成为人们夏季度假的好去处。

examples.text: The only guarantee of having a cabin to oneself is by travelling first class...
examples.translation: 只有坐头等舱旅行才能保证一个人独享一舱。

examples.text: It's so easy to feel sorry for oneself...
examples.translation: 人很容易为自己感到委屈。

examples.text: The doll-like figures in these stories are unlike anybody, let alone oneself.
examples.translation: 这些故事中的玩偶形象跟谁都不像，更不用说像自己了。

examples.text: It is a very rewarding exercise to work this out oneself...
examples.translation: 独自解决这个问题是一次受益匪浅的锻炼。

examples.text: Some things one must do oneself.
examples.translation: 有些事情必须亲自去做。

examples.text: It is better to die oneself than to kill.
examples.translation: 宁可自亡，不可行凶。

examples.text: Will you chop an onion up for me?...
examples.translation: 你能帮我把一个洋葱切碎吗？

examples.text: It is made with fresh minced meat, cooked with onion and a rich tomato sauce.
examples.translation: 这道菜用鲜肉沫加洋葱和浓郁的番茄酱做成。

examples.text: ...onion soup.
examples.translation: 洋葱汤

meanings.meaning: 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着
向，朝……；关于；在……之上；在……时候

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, on is used after some verbs, nouns, and adjectives in order to introduce extra information. On is also used in phrasal verbs such as ‘keep on’, ‘cotton on’, and ‘sign on’.

examples.text: ...one of the greatest ever rock performers, the one and only Tina Turner.
examples.translation: 史上最伟大的摇滚乐手之一，举世无双的蒂娜·特纳

examples.text: We went into the room one by one...
examples.translation: 我们挨个儿走进房间。

examples.text: One by one the houses burst into flames.
examples.translation: 房子一幢接一幢地燃起熊熊大火。

examples.text: One or other of the two women was wrong.
examples.translation: 这两个女人当中有一个人错了。

examples.text: We may make one or two changes...
examples.translation: 我们可以作一两处改动。

examples.text: I've also sold one or two to an American publisher...
examples.translation: 我还卖了几本给一位美国出版商。

examples.text: I asked one or two of the stallholders about it.
examples.translation: 我向一两个摊贩打听了此事。

examples.text: I'm not one to waste time on just anyone.
examples.translation: 我可不是个随便浪费时间在任何人身上的人。

examples.text: ...the competitive kind who will see this as the opportunity to be one up on you.
examples.translation: 具有竞争意识、将此视作占据上风的契机的那种人

meanings.meaning: 在…之上；对…了解；映射到…上

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, onto is used in phrasal verbs such as ‘hold onto’ and ‘latch onto’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，onto还可用于 hold onto, latch onto 等短语动词中。

examples.text: Smear Vaseline on to your baby's skin to prevent soreness.
examples.translation: 给孩子皮肤上抹些凡士林以防止肿痛。

examples.text: The players emerged onto the field...
examples.translation: 运动员入场了。

examples.text: ...when the photographer sets off onto the moors...
examples.translation: 摄影师动身踏入高沼时

examples.text: Alex turned his car on to the Albert Quay and drove along until he found a parking place.
examples.translation: 亚历克斯转头把车开到了艾伯特码头，并且一直往前开，直到找到停车的地方。

examples.text: ...the metal part of the door onto which the sun had been shining...
examples.translation: 在阳光照耀下闪闪发亮的门的金属部分

examples.text: The colours rotated round on a disc and were reflected onto the wall behind.
examples.translation: 圆盘上色彩流转，反射到后面的墙上。

examples.text: ...the house with its leafy garden and its view on to Regent's Park.
examples.translation: 带有郁郁葱葱的花园、可将摄政公园的景色收入眼底的房子

examples.text: ...windows opening onto carved black-wood balconies...
examples.translation: 开向黑檀雕花阳台的窗户

examples.text: The door opened onto a lighted hallway.
examples.translation: 这扇门通往亮着灯的走廊。

examples.text: ...a two-hundred-yard-wide strip of land that backs onto a large lake.
examples.translation: 一块200码宽、背朝大湖的狭地

examples.text: As he stepped backwards she fell onto her knees, then onto her face...
examples.translation: 他向后退时，她双膝跪倒在地，接着迎面倒了下去。

examples.text: Puffing a little, Mabel shifted her weight onto her feet...
examples.translation: 梅布尔喘了口气，把身体重心移到脚上。

examples.text: I willed my eyes to open and heaved myself over on to my back.
examples.translation: 我竭力睁开眼睛，费劲地翻过身来仰面躺着。

examples.text: As he got on to the plane, he asked me how I was feeling...
examples.translation: 他上飞机时问我感觉如何。

examples.text: Who can fold up a pushchair, toddler and shopping and then get them all onto the bus?...
examples.translation: 谁有那本事一手收起婴儿推车，一手抱着刚会走路的孩子，还得提着刚买的东西，然后挤上公共汽车？

examples.text: 'I'll see you onto the train.' — 'Thank you.'
examples.translation: “我送你上火车。”——“谢谢。”

examples.text: The reflector is held onto the sides of the spacecraft with a frame...
examples.translation: 反射器通过支架牢牢地固定在航天器的侧面。

examples.text: She was conscious of a second man hanging on to the rail...
examples.translation: 她意识到还有第二个人紧紧抓着栏杆。

examples.text: She had to cling onto the doorhandle until the pain passed.
examples.translation: 她不得不抓紧门把手，直到那阵疼痛过去。

examples.text: Let's get on to more important matters...
examples.translation: 咱们谈谈更重要的事吧。

examples.text: So, if we could just move onto something else?
examples.translation: 那么我们可不可以干脆谈点别的？

examples.text: The Macedonian question had failed to get on to the agenda...
examples.translation: 马其顿问题没能列入议事日程。

examples.text: The pill itself has changed a lot since it first came onto the market...
examples.translation: 该药片本身自首次进入市场以来已经有了很大改变。

examples.text: Twelve thousand workers will go onto a four-day week at their factory in Birmingham.
examples.translation: 伯明翰工厂的12,000名工人将采取每周4天工作制。

examples.text: He leaned across the table and whispered to me, 'I'm really onto something.'...
examples.translation: 他从桌上俯过身来对我低声说道：“我真的就快有重大发现了。”

examples.text: Archaeologists knew they were onto something big when they started digging.
examples.translation: 考古学家在发掘之初就知道他们将有重大发现。

examples.text: He did not want Pollard to become suspicious that he was now onto him...
examples.translation: 他不想让波拉德怀疑他已察觉到其不轨行为。

examples.text: I had told people what he had been doing, so now the police were onto him.
examples.translation: 我已将他的所作所为告诉了别人，因此现在警方正在追查他。

meanings.meaning: 不透明的；不传热的；迟钝的

examples.text: You can always use opaque glass if you need to block a street view.
examples.translation: 如果不想从室内看到街景，可以使用不透明玻璃。

examples.text: ...the opaque language of the inspector's reports.
examples.translation: 巡视员报告中晦涩难懂的语言

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, of is used after some verbs, nouns, and adjectives in order to introduce extra information. Of is also used in phrasal prepositions such as ‘because of’, ‘instead of’ and ‘in spite of’, and in phrasal verbs such as ‘make of’ and ‘dispose of’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，of 可以用在某些动词、名词和形容词之后引出附加信息。of 还可用于 because of,instead of, in spite of 等短语介词和 make of, dispose of 等短语动词中。

examples.text: ...the population of this town...
examples.translation: 该镇的人口

examples.text: The aim of the course is to help students to comprehend the structure of contemporary political and social systems.
examples.translation: 这门课程旨在帮助学生了解当代政治与社会体制的结构。

examples.text: Would you say what you felt was a feeling of betrayal?...
examples.translation: 你是否觉得有一种被人出卖的感觉？

examples.text: She let out a little cry of pain.
examples.translation: 她疼得轻呼了一声。

examples.text: ...the problem of a national shortage of teachers.
examples.translation: 全国性教师短缺问题

examples.text: ...a vague notion of democracy.
examples.translation: 模糊的民主概念

examples.text: ...the recession of 1974-75...
examples.translation: 1974至1975年的经济萧条

examples.text: This has been a good chance of meeting up with everyone again.
examples.translation: 这是一个和大家再次见面的好机会。

examples.text: ...the reduction of trade union power inside the party.
examples.translation: 党内工会权力的削弱

examples.text: ...the assessment of future senior managers.
examples.translation: 对未来高级经理的评估

examples.text: ...the death of their father.
examples.translation: 他们父亲的死

examples.text: ...the Marriage of Figaro.
examples.translation: 《费加罗的婚礼》

examples.text: ...7.6 litres of pure alcohol.
examples.translation: 7.6升纯酒精

examples.text: ...a few kilometres of new roads.
examples.translation: 几公里新修道路

examples.text: ...dozens of people.
examples.translation: 几十个人

examples.text: ...billions of dollars.
examples.translation: 数十亿美元

examples.text: ...groups of protestors.
examples.translation: 成群结队的抗议者

examples.text: ...a collection of short stories...
examples.translation: 短篇小说集

examples.text: A flock of birds flew towards us slowly from far away.
examples.translation: 一群鸟儿从远处朝我们缓缓飞来。

examples.text: ...the Prince of Wales.
examples.translation: 威尔士亲王

examples.text: ...the Finance Minister of Bangladesh.
examples.translation: 孟加拉国财政部长

examples.text: ...the superb rock-hewn Cave Temples of Badami.
examples.translation: 巧夺天工的巴达米石窟庙群

examples.text: We could all do with a cup of tea...
examples.translation: 要是能给我们都来杯茶就好了。

examples.text: Conder opened another bottle of wine...
examples.translation: 康德又开了一瓶酒。

examples.text: Marta drank a glass of juice.
examples.translation: 玛尔塔喝了一杯果汁。

examples.text: ...a box of tissues.
examples.translation: 一盒纸巾

examples.text: ...a packet of cigarettes.
examples.translation: 一盒香烟

examples.text: ...a roomful of people.
examples.translation: 一屋子人

examples.text: ...a blade of grass...
examples.translation: 一片草叶

examples.text: Marina ate only one slice of bread...
examples.translation: 玛丽娜只吃了一片面包。

examples.text: With a stick of chalk he wrote her order on a blackboard.
examples.translation: 他用一截粉笔将她的指示写在黑板上。

examples.text: ...local decorations of wood and straw.
examples.translation: 用木头和稻草制成的本地饰品

examples.text: ...loose-fitting garments of linen.
examples.translation: 宽松的亚麻布衣服

examples.text: ...a mixture of paint-thinner and petrol.
examples.translation: 油漆稀释剂与汽油的混合物

examples.text: ...the other side of the square...
examples.translation: 广场另一侧

examples.text: We had almost reached the end of the street.
examples.translation: 我们几乎到了街的尽头。

examples.text: ...the beginning of the year...
examples.translation: 一年的开始

examples.text: Edward disappeared around 9.30pm on the 23rd of July.
examples.translation: 爱德华失踪于7月23号晚上9点30分左右。

examples.text: ...the core of the problem.
examples.translation: 问题的核心

examples.text: He'd been dreaming of her...
examples.translation: 他一直梦见她。

examples.text: Listen, I shall be thinking of you always...
examples.translation: 听着，我会永远记得你的。

examples.text: Her parents did not approve of her decision...
examples.translation: 父母不赞成她的决定。

examples.text: The Americans cannot accuse him of ignoring the problem...
examples.translation: 美国人不能指责他对问题置之不理。

examples.text: The elderly relative had died of old age.
examples.translation: 这位年事已高的亲戚得享天年。

examples.text: I have grown very fond of Alec...
examples.translation: 我越来越喜欢亚力克。

examples.text: His father was quite naturally very proud of him...
examples.translation: 他父亲自然为他感到无比骄傲。

examples.text: I think everyone was scared of her...
examples.translation: 我想大家都很怕她。

examples.text: She would be guilty of betraying her own mother.
examples.translation: 她会犯下背叛自己母亲的错误。

examples.text: This has been so nice, so terribly kind of you...
examples.translation: 您这么做真是太好心，太令我们感激不尽了。

examples.text: I suppose it's stupid of us not to be able to make up our own minds...
examples.translation: 我们自己都没办法拿定主意，这真是太傻了。

examples.text: That's certainly very generous of you Tony.
examples.translation: 托尼，你真是慷慨大方。

examples.text: ...an awkward, slow-moving giant of a man.
examples.translation: 举止笨拙、行动迟缓的巨人般的男子

examples.text: Your extra fat may be more of a health risk than you realize...
examples.translation: 多余的脂肪对健康的威胁可能比你意识到的要大。

examples.text: As time goes by, sleeping becomes less of a problem.
examples.translation: 随着时间的推移，睡眠逐渐不再成为问题。

examples.text: ...the worth of their music.
examples.translation: 他们音乐的价值

examples.text: ...the creaminess of her skin...
examples.translation: 她皮肤的光滑细腻

examples.text: She is a woman of enviable beauty.
examples.translation: 她的美貌令人艳羡。

examples.text: ...a matter of overwhelming importance...
examples.translation: 至关重要的事情

examples.text: The new deal was considered to be the most generous of its kind.
examples.translation: 这一新交易被认为是同类交易中最大的一笔。

examples.text: The crisis faced over the next few months is of an entirely different scale...
examples.translation: 接下来几个月内将要面临的危机规模将是无法相比的。

examples.text: Both world wars were of unquestionable importance as economic events.
examples.translation: 两次世界大战都是重要性无可置疑的经济事件。

examples.text: Last Thursday, Nick announced record revenues of $3.4 billion...
examples.translation: 上个星期四，尼克宣布公司收入创下34亿美元的纪录。

examples.text: He has been sentenced to a total of 21 years in prison since 1973...
examples.translation: 自1973年以来，他已总共被判21年监禁。

examples.text: The last figures so far this year indicate a rise of 13.8%.
examples.translation: 今年到目前为止的最新数据显示增长了13.8%。

examples.text: ...young people under the age of 16 years...
examples.translation: 16岁以下的青少年

examples.text: I feel like a girl of 18.
examples.translation: 我感觉自己像个18岁的小姑娘。

examples.text: ...eight bruising years of war...
examples.translation: 艰苦卓绝的8年战争

examples.text: The project has gone through nearly a dozen years of planning.
examples.translation: 该项目已历经近12年的规划。

examples.text: At about a quarter of eight in the evening Joe Urber calls...
examples.translation: 大约晚上8点差一刻的时候，乔·乌尔贝尔打来电话。

examples.text: We got to the beach at five of one in the afternoon.
examples.translation: 我们下午1点差5分的时候到达海滩。

meanings.meaning: 唯一的，仅有的；最合适的

examples.text: Only the President could authorize the use of the atomic bomb...
examples.translation: 只有总统才能授权使用原子弹。

examples.text: ...the guidance and discipline that can be provided only by a strong male...
examples.translation: 只有强有力的男性才能给予的指导和训练

examples.text: Only here were the police visible in any strength at all...
examples.translation: 只有在这里才能看到廖廖几个警察。

examples.text: 44-year-old woman seeks caring, honest male of similar age for friendship and fun. Genuine replies only...
examples.translation: 44岁女士寻觅年龄相仿、体贴诚实的男士为友，共享快乐。非诚勿扰。

examples.text: A business can only be built and expanded on a sound financial base...
examples.translation: 企业只有具备了稳固的经济基础才能立足和发展。

examples.text: It's true that I seem to have forgotten you, but it only seems that way.
examples.translation: 我看起来好像确实是把你忘记了，但那只是看起来而已。

examples.text: The lawyer is paid only if he wins...
examples.translation: 只有官司赢了才支付律师费。

examples.text: The Bank of England insists that it will cut interest rates only when it is ready...
examples.translation: 英格兰银行坚持只有条件成熟才会降息。

examples.text: Dark matter gives out no light and is detectable only because of its gravitational effect on visible matter.
examples.translation: 暗物质不发光，它之所以能被发现，只是因为它对可见物质产生引力作用。

examples.text: She was the only woman in Shell's legal department...
examples.translation: 她是壳牌公司法律事务部唯一的女性。

examples.text: My cat Gustaf was the only thing I had—the only company.
examples.translation: 我的猫古斯塔夫是我所有的一切——我唯一的伴侣。

examples.text: That left Mr Dertliev as the only candidate.
examples.translation: 那使得德尔特利耶夫先生成为唯一的候选人。

examples.text: At the moment it is only a theory...
examples.translation: 眼下这只不过是个推测而已。

examples.text: 'I'm only a sergeant,' said Clements...
examples.translation: “我只是一名中士，”克莱门茨说道。

examples.text: Don't get defensive, Charlie. I was only joking.
examples.translation: 别那么大戒心，查利，我只是开个玩笑罢了。

examples.text: Child car seats only cost about £10 a week to hire.
examples.translation: 儿童汽车坐椅一周的租金才10英镑。

examples.text: ...spacecraft guidance systems weighing only a few grams...
examples.translation: 仅有几克重的宇宙飞船导航系统

examples.text: My father allowed me only a sip or two of wine with each meal...
examples.translation: 我父亲每餐只许我喝一两口酒。

examples.text: I've only recently met him.
examples.translation: 我最近才认识他。

examples.text: These are only a few of the possibilities...
examples.translation: 这些仅仅是其中几种可能。

examples.text: Only a minority of the people supported the Revolution.
examples.translation: 只有少数人支持这场革命。

examples.text: For a moment I could say nothing. I could only stand and look...
examples.translation: 我有那么一会儿一句话都说不出来，只能站在那里看着。

examples.text: The police can only guess at the scale of the problem.
examples.translation: 警方只能猜测问题的严重性。

examples.text: I only wish he were here now that things are getting better for me...
examples.translation: 现在我的境况好转了，我真希望他能在这里。

examples.text: We can only hope that the elephants can recover.
examples.translation: 我们唯有希望这些大象能够康复。

examples.text: It's just as dramatic as a film, only it's real...
examples.translation: 这就像电影一样充满戏剧性，不过这是真实发生的。

examples.text: It's a bit like my house, only nicer...
examples.translation: 这有点像我的房子，只是更为漂亮。

examples.text: Drop in and see me when you're ready. Only don't take too long about it.
examples.translation: 方便的时候来我这里坐坐，只是别让我等太久。

examples.text: I'd invite you to come with me, only it's such a long way...
examples.translation: 要不是路太远，我一定会邀你一同前往。

examples.text: I'd be quite happy to go. Only I don't know what my kids would say about living there.
examples.translation: 我是很乐意去的，只是不知道孩子们会不会喜欢住在那里。

examples.text: Ryle tried the Embassy, only to be told that Hugh was in a meeting...
examples.translation: 赖尔试着找了大使馆，却被告知休正在开会。

examples.text: He raced through the living room, only to find the front door closed.
examples.translation: 他飞快地跑过起居室，却发现前门锁上了。

examples.text: It's only fair to let her know that you intend to apply...
examples.translation: 告诉她你打算申请，这才算公平嘛。

examples.text: She appeared to have changed considerably, which was only to be expected.
examples.translation: 她看起来变化很大，不过这完全是在意料之中的。

examples.text: The embargo would only hurt innocent civilians...
examples.translation: 禁运只会殃及无辜的百姓。

examples.text: She says that legalising prostitution will only cause problems.
examples.translation: 她说卖淫合法化只会引发问题。

examples.text: Any time you want a babysitter, dear, you only have to ask...
examples.translation: 亲爱的，你什么时候需要人帮忙照看孩子，只要开口说一声就行。

examples.text: We have only to read the labels to know what ingredients are in foods.
examples.translation: 我们只要看一下标签即可知道食品的成分。

examples.text: I've only just arrived...
examples.translation: 我刚到。

examples.text: The signs of an economic revival are only just beginning...
examples.translation: 经济复苏的迹象刚刚开始显现。

examples.text: You're only just back from leave.
examples.translation: 你才刚休假回来。

examples.text: For centuries farmers there have only just managed to survive...
examples.translation: 几个世纪以来，那里的农民只能勉强维持生计。

examples.text: I am old enough to remember the Blitz, but only just...
examples.translation: 伦敦空袭那阵我已开始记事，但也只是仅仅有些模糊的印象。

examples.text: 'I think we could agree on that one.' — 'Only just.'
examples.translation: “我想在那一点上我们是一致的。”——“勉强算是吧。”

examples.text: I know only too well that plans can easily go wrong...
examples.translation: 计划很容易出岔子，我太清楚这点了。

examples.text: When the new baby comes along it is only too easy to shut out the others.
examples.translation: 新生儿出世后，其他孩子极容易受到冷落。

examples.text: I'll be only too pleased to help them out with any queries.
examples.translation: 我非常乐意为他们答疑解惑。

meanings.meaning: 开始；机会；通路；空缺的职位

examples.text: They returned to take part in the season's opening game.
examples.translation: 他们回来参加本赛季的开幕赛。

examples.text: ...the opening day of the fifth General Synod.
examples.translation: 第5届总议会的开幕日

examples.text: The opening of the scene depicts Akhnaten and his family in a moment of intimacy.
examples.translation: 这幕戏的开场描绘了埃及法老阿肯那顿和他的家人其乐融融的情景。

examples.text: He squeezed through a narrow opening in the fence.
examples.translation: 他从围栏上的狭窄缺口里挤了过去。

examples.text: I glanced down at the beach as we passed an opening in the trees.
examples.translation: 我们经过一块林中空地时，我往下扫了一眼海滩。

examples.text: Her capabilities were always there; all she needed was an opening to show them.
examples.translation: 她一直都很有能力；她需要的只是一次展示才华的机会。

examples.text: We don't have any openings now, but we'll call you if something comes up.
examples.translation: 我们现在没有职位空缺，一旦有的话我们会给你打电话。

examples.text: ...a one-act opera about contemporary women in America.
examples.translation: 关于当代美国女性的独幕歌剧

examples.text: ...Donizetti's opera 'Lucia di Lammermoor'.
examples.translation: 多尼采蒂的歌剧《拉美莫尔的露西娅》

examples.text: ...an opera singer...
examples.translation: 歌剧演员

examples.text: He was also learned in classical music with a great love of opera.
examples.translation: 他还是个酷爱歌剧的古典音乐专家。

examples.text: Until his death in 1986 Greenwood owned and operated an enormous pear orchard.
examples.translation: 到他1986年去世前，格林伍德一直拥有并管理着一片面积广阔的梨园。

examples.text: ...allowing commercial banks to operate in the country...
examples.translation: 允许商业银行在该国开展业务

examples.text: Operating costs jumped from £85.3m to £95m.
examples.translation: 运营成本从8,530万英镑激增至9,500万英镑。

examples.text: Company finance is to provide funds for the everyday operation of the business.
examples.translation: 公司融资是要为日常运作提供资金。

examples.text: Ceiling and wall lights can operate independently...
examples.translation: 吊灯和壁灯可单独开关。

examples.text: How do accounting records operate?...
examples.translation: 账目是如何记录的？

examples.text: The world of work doesn't operate that way.
examples.translation: 职场上可不是那样的。

examples.text: Why is it the case that taking part-time work is made so difficult by the operation of the benefit system?
examples.translation: 为什么福利制度的实行会使打零工变得这么困难？

examples.text: A massive rock fall trapped the men as they operated a tunnelling machine...
examples.translation: 这些工人在操作隧道挖掘机时被大量的落石困住了。

examples.text: The number of fax machines operating around the world has now reached ten million.
examples.translation: 现在全球使用的传真机数量已达到了1,000万台。

examples.text: ...over 1,000 dials monitoring every aspect of the operation of the aeroplane.
examples.translation: 监控飞机所有运行细节的1,000多个仪表盘

examples.text: The surgeon who operated on the King released new details of his injuries...
examples.translation: 为国王动手术的外科医生通报了其伤势的最新详情。

examples.text: You examine a patient and then you decide whether or not to operate.
examples.translation: 先为病人作检查，然后再决定是否做手术。

examples.text: Up to ten thousand Zimbabwean soldiers are operating in Mozambique...
examples.translation: 多达1万名津巴布韦士兵正在莫桑比克执行任务。

examples.text: This freed the Austrian army to operate against the French.
examples.translation: 这使得奥地利军队可以对法军作战。

meanings.meaning: 操作；经营；[外科] 手术；[数][计] 运算

examples.text: The rescue operation began on Friday afternoon...
examples.translation: 救援行动于星期五下午开始。

examples.text: The soldiers were engaged in a military operation close to the Ugandan border.
examples.translation: 这些士兵参加了乌干达边境附近的一次军事行动。

examples.text: ...a big operation against the drugs trade.
examples.translation: 打击毒品交易的大规模行动

examples.text: Thorn's electronics operation employs around 5,000 people...
examples.translation: 索恩的电子公司雇用了约5,000名员工。

examples.text: The two parent groups now run their business as a single combined operation.
examples.translation: 这两个母公司现在合并为一家企业经营业务。

examples.text: Charles was at the clinic recovering from an operation on his arm.
examples.translation: 查尔斯的胳膊动了手术，正在这家诊所进行康复治疗。

examples.text: Until the rail links are in operation, passengers can only travel through the tunnel by coach.
examples.translation: 在铁路连线开通之前，乘客只能乘坐长途客车穿越隧道。

examples.text: ...the free banking system that has been in operation since the early eighties.
examples.translation: 从80年代初就开始实行的自由银行制度

examples.text: There are three ski lifts in operation.
examples.translation: 有3台滑雪缆车在运行。

examples.text: The Financial Services Act came into operation four years ago...
examples.translation: 《金融服务法》于4年前开始实施。

examples.text: Cheaper energy conservation techniques have been put into operation in the developed world.
examples.translation: 更经济的节能技术在发达国家已经投入使用。

examples.text: The whole system will be fully operational by December 1995.
examples.translation: 整个系统到1995年12月将可全面投入使用。

examples.text: The nuclear industry was required to prove that every operational and safety aspect had been fully researched.
examples.translation: 核工业被要求证明其在运营与安全各方面都进行过充分的研究。

examples.text: An all-female political section would have been operationally ineffective...
examples.translation: 一个由清一色的女性组成的政治部门工作起来将会毫无效率可言。

examples.text: The device had been used operationally some months previously.
examples.translation: 该设备几个月之前曾投入运行。

meanings.meaning: 经营者；操作员；话务员；行家

examples.text: He dialled the operator and put in a call for Rome.
examples.translation: 他拨了接线员的号，让他接通一个到罗马的电话。

examples.text: ...computer operators.
examples.translation: 计算机操作员

examples.text: ...'Tele-Communications', the nation's largest cable TV operator.
examples.translation: 全国最大的有线电视运营商“电视通信公司”

examples.text: He was a smart operator. Don't underestimate him.
examples.translation: 他这个人精明圆滑，可别小瞧了他。

examples.text: ...one of the shrewdest political operators in the Arab World.
examples.translation: 阿拉伯世界最精明狡猾的政客之一

examples.text: I wasn't asking for your opinion, Dick...
examples.translation: 我并不是在征求你的意见，迪克。

examples.text: He held the opinion that a government should think before introducing a tax...
examples.translation: 他认为政府在开征新税前应仔细斟酌。

examples.text: Most who expressed an opinion spoke favorably of Thomas.
examples.translation: 大多数发表看法的人都支持托马斯。

examples.text: That improved Mrs Goole's already favourable opinion of him.
examples.translation: 那件事更加深了古尔太太对他的好印象。

examples.text: Some, I suppose, might even be in positions to influence opinion...
examples.translation: 有的人，我认为，甚至有可能影响舆论。

examples.text: There is a broad consensus of opinion about the policies which should be pursued.
examples.translation: 对应当实行何种政策，舆论达成了广泛一致的意见。

examples.text: Even if you have had a regular physical check-up recently, you should still seek a medical opinion.
examples.translation: 即使近期做过一次常规体检，也应当征求医生的意见。

examples.text: The book is, in Henry's opinion, the best book on the subject...
examples.translation: 依照亨利的看法，这本书是关于该主题的最佳著述。

examples.text: Well he's not making a very good job of it in my opinion.
examples.translation: 然而，在我看来，这件事他做得不尽如人意。

examples.text: Frank is of the opinion that the 1934 yacht should have won.
examples.translation: 弗兰克认为本该是那艘1934年的帆船获胜。

examples.text: ...Mr Kennedy's opponent in the leadership contest...
examples.translation: 与肯尼迪先生争夺领导权的对手

examples.text: He described the detention without trial of political opponents as a cowardly act.
examples.translation: 他称未经审判就将政敌关押起来是懦夫之举。

examples.text: Norris twice knocked down his opponent in the early rounds of the fight...
examples.translation: 诺里斯在前几个回合中两次击倒对手。

examples.text: He's the best opponent I've come across this season, a great player.
examples.translation: 他是我本赛季遇到的最出色的对手，一位了不起的运动员。

examples.text: ...opponents of the spread of nuclear weapons...
examples.translation: 反对核武器扩散的人士

examples.text: He became an outspoken opponent of the old Soviet system.
examples.translation: 他成为旧的苏联体制直言不讳的抨击者。

examples.text: I had an opportunity to go to New York and study...
examples.translation: 我曾经有一个去纽约学习的机会。

examples.text: The best reason for a trip to London is the super opportunity for shopping...
examples.translation: 绝佳的购物机会是前往伦敦的最好理由。

examples.text: I want to see more opportunities for young people.
examples.translation: 我希望年轻人能有更多机会。

examples.text: ...equal opportunities in employment.
examples.translation: 同等的就业机会

examples.text: Mr Taylor was not bitter towards those who had opposed him...
examples.translation: 泰勒先生对那些曾反对过他的人并未怀恨在心。

examples.text: Many parents oppose bilingual education in schools.
examples.translation: 很多家长反对学校实行双语教育。

examples.text: Jennie had sat opposite her at breakfast.
examples.translation: 珍妮吃早餐时坐在她对面。

examples.text: He looked up at the buildings opposite, but could see no open window...
examples.translation: 他抬头看向对面那些楼，但没有看见哪扇窗户开着。

examples.text: Melissa slid in beside Paula, and her husband sat opposite.
examples.translation: 梅利莎悄悄溜进来坐在葆拉身边，她的丈夫在对面坐下。

examples.text: ...the opposite corner of the room.
examples.translation: 房间的对角

examples.text: All the cars driving in the opposite direction had their headlights on...
examples.translation: 对面开来的车都打着头灯。

examples.text: I should have written the notes in the opposite order...
examples.translation: 我本应按相反的顺序记笔记的。

examples.text: In fact everything he does is opposite to what is considered normal behaviour.
examples.translation: 事实上，他的一切作为都和人们所认为的正常举动大相径庭。

examples.text: Ritter was a very complex man but Marius was the opposite, a simple farmer...
examples.translation: 里特城府颇深，而马里厄斯恰恰相反，是个心地淳朴的农民。

examples.text: Well, whatever he says you can bet he's thinking the opposite...
examples.translation: 呃，不管他说什么，你都可以肯定他想的完全是另一套。

examples.text: What's the opposite of white?
examples.translation: 与白色相对的颜色是什么？

meanings.meaning: 压迫，压抑；使……烦恼；使……感到沉重

examples.text: These people often are oppressed by the governments of the countries they find themselves in...
examples.translation: 这些人经常受到所在国政府的压迫。

examples.text: We are not normal like everybody else. If we were they wouldn't be oppressing us.
examples.translation: 我们跟其他正常人不一样。否则，他们就不会压迫我们了。

examples.text: The place oppressed Aubrey even before his eyes adjusted to the dark...
examples.translation: 奥布里的眼睛还没有适应黑暗之前，这地方便已经让他觉得很压抑了。

examples.text: It was not just the weather which oppressed her.
examples.translation: 让她心烦的不只是天气。

examples.text: ...optical telescopes.
examples.translation: 光学望远镜

examples.text: ...the optical effects of volcanic dust in the stratosphere.
examples.translation: 火山灰在平流层造成的视觉效果

examples.text: The President says she is optimistic that an agreement can be worked out soon...
examples.translation: 总统说她对很快达成协议持乐观态度。

examples.text: Michael was in a jovial and optimistic mood.
examples.translation: 迈克尔情绪愉快乐观。

examples.text: Both sides have spoken optimistically about the talks.
examples.translation: 双方都对会谈表示乐观。

examples.text: Depending on your circumstances you may wish to opt for one method or the other...
examples.translation: 依据自身情况的不同，你可能希望选择这种或那种方法。

examples.text: Our students can also opt to stay in residence.
examples.translation: 我们的学生也可以选择住校。

examples.text: Aim to do some physical activity three times a week for optimum health.
examples.translation: 为了达到最佳的健康状况，要力争每周进行3次身体锻炼。

examples.text: ...regions in which optimal conditions for farming can be created.
examples.translation: 能创造最适宜耕种条件的地区

meanings.meaning: [计] 选项；选择权；买卖的特权

examples.text: He's argued from the start that America and its allies are putting too much emphasis on the military option...
examples.translation: 他从一开始就认为美国及其盟国过于强调军事手段。

examples.text: What other options do you have?
examples.translation: 你还有什么别的选择吗？

examples.text: Criminals are given the option of going to jail or facing public humiliation...
examples.translation: 罪犯可以选择要么坐牢，要么遭受当众羞辱。

examples.text: We had no option but to abandon the meeting.
examples.translation: 我们别无选择，只有放弃这次会面。

examples.text: Each bank has granted the other an option on 19.9% of its shares.
examples.translation: 两家银行都同意给予对方其19.9%股份的期权。

examples.text: Several options are offered for the student's senior year.
examples.translation: 为毕业班学生开设了几门选修课。

examples.text: I am keeping my options open. I have not made a decision on either matter.
examples.translation: 我保留选择权，这两件事我都还没有作出决定。

examples.text: We take the soft option. I like to keep the crowd happy because that's what they pay for...
examples.translation: 我们决定采取最保险的方案。我希望让观众开心，因为他们就是为这个掏钱的。

examples.text: The job of chairman can no longer be regarded as a convenient soft option.
examples.translation: 别再以为董事长这份工作是那么容易做的。

examples.text: A holiday isn't an optional extra. In this stressful, frantic world it's a must...
examples.translation: 休假并非可有可无。在这个紧张而忙碌的世界，它是必不可少的。

examples.text: Sex education is a sensitive area for some parents, and thus it should remain optional.
examples.translation: 性教育对某些家长而言是个敏感领域，因此应该保持其非强制性。

meanings.meaning: (Or)人名；(中)柯(广东话·威妥玛)；(柬)奥；(土、匈、土库、阿塞、瑞典)奥尔

examples.text: 'Tea or coffee?' John asked...
examples.translation: “喝茶还是喝咖啡？”约翰问道。

examples.text: Was she blonde or brunette?...
examples.translation: 她的头发是金色还是深褐色？

examples.text: Spread the inside of the loaf with olive paste or pesto sauce for extra flavour...
examples.translation: 在面包里面涂些橄榄酱或香蒜酱会更好吃。

examples.text: He said he would try to write or call as soon as he reached the Canary Islands...
examples.translation: 他说他一到加那利群岛就会设法写信或者打电话来。

examples.text: Students are asked to take another course in English, or science, or mathematics.
examples.translation: 要求学生在英语、自然科学和数学中再选一门课。

examples.text: Items like bread, milk and meat were either unavailable or could be obtained only on the black market...
examples.translation: 像面包、牛奶和肉之类的东西要么是买不到，要么就是只能去黑市买。

examples.text: Either you can talk to him, or I will...
examples.translation: 要么你跟他谈，要么我去。

examples.text: I don't know whether people will buy it or not...
examples.translation: 我不知道是否会有人买。

examples.text: I am not sure whether I was knocked over by the blast or whether I just fell...
examples.translation: 我拿不准自己是被爆炸的气浪掀翻的还是恰巧跌了一跤。

examples.text: The bathroom has taken a lot longer to get right than either Elaine or Dennis had envisaged.
examples.translation: 装修浴室花的时间远比伊莱恩和丹尼斯预想的要长。

examples.text: Everyone benefited from limiting their intake of tea to just three or four cups a day...
examples.translation: 每天只喝三四杯茶对身体有益。

examples.text: When I was nine or ten someone explained to me that when you are grown up you have to work...
examples.translation: 我大概9岁或10岁的时候，有人跟我说人长大了就得工作。

examples.text: Normally he asked questions, and had a humorous remark or two.
examples.translation: 通常都是他提问题，还不时地冒出一两句俏皮话。

examples.text: The man was a fool, he thought, or at least incompetent...
examples.translation: 他想道，那人是个傻瓜，或者说，至少很无能。

examples.text: There was nothing more he wanted, or so he thought...
examples.translation: 他再无所求，或者说他是这么想的。

examples.text: That was sporting of him. Or should I say cowardly...
examples.translation: 他风格真高。或者我是否应该说他很懦弱？

examples.text: She was aware of tension between them. Or had it been there from the beginning?
examples.translation: 她意识到他们的关系有些紧张。或者一开始就是如此吗？

examples.text: She had to have the operation, or she would die.
examples.translation: 她必须动手术，要不然就没命了。

examples.text: He must have thought Jane was worth it or he wouldn't have wasted time on her, I suppose.
examples.translation: 我想，他一定认为简值得他这么做，否则他不会在她身上浪费时间。

examples.text: Chairman or no, if I want to stop the project, I can...
examples.translation: 不管我是不是主席，只要我想停止这个项目，我就能做到。

examples.text: The first difficulty is that, old-fashioned or not, it is very good.
examples.translation: 首要的难题是，过时也好，不过时也罢，它很不错。

examples.text: The next day, rain or no rain, it was business as usual...
examples.translation: 第二天是否下雨都没有差别，一切照常进行。

examples.text: Oil or no oil, Serbia has troubles.
examples.translation: 不管是否有石油，塞尔维亚的困难都会存在。

meanings.meaning: 公开的；敞开的；空旷的；坦率的；营业着的

examples.text: He opened the window and looked out...
examples.translation: 他打开窗户往外看。

examples.text: The church doors would open and the crowd would surge out.
examples.translation: 教堂的门会打开，人群会蜂拥而出。

examples.text: ...an open window...
examples.translation: 开着的窗户

examples.text: A door had been forced open.
examples.translation: 一扇门遭强行打开。

examples.text: The Inspector opened the packet of cigarettes...
examples.translation: 检查员撕开了那包香烟。

examples.text: The capsules are fiddly to open.
examples.translation: 这些胶囊得小心翼翼地打开。

examples.text: ...an open bottle of milk...
examples.translation: 一瓶已开封的牛奶

examples.text: I tore the letter open.
examples.translation: 我拆开了这封信。

examples.text: He opened up a cage and lifted out a 6ft python.
examples.translation: 他打开笼子，拎出一条6英尺长的蟒蛇。

examples.text: He opened the heavy Bible...
examples.translation: 他翻开那本厚厚的《圣经》。

examples.text: She opens her umbrella, and walks up River Street...
examples.translation: 她撑开伞，沿着河街向前走。

examples.text: The flower opens to reveal a Queen Bee...
examples.translation: 花瓣展开，一只蜂王露了出来。

examples.text: The officer's mouth opened, showing white, even teeth.
examples.translation: 那个军官咧开嘴，露出洁白整齐的牙齿。

examples.text: Without warning, Bardo smacked his fist into his open hand...
examples.translation: 巴多没有任何预兆地一拳砸在自己摊开的手掌上。

examples.text: His mouth was a little open, as if he'd started to scream.
examples.translation: 他的嘴微微张开，似乎是要开始尖叫。

examples.text: Keith took a map from the dashboard and opened it out on his knees.
examples.translation: 基思从仪表板上的贮物箱里拿出一张地图，在膝盖上摊开。

examples.text: ...oval tables which open out to become circular.
examples.translation: 展开后呈圆形的椭圆形桌子

examples.text: Double click on the icon to open the file.
examples.translation: 双击图标打开文件。

examples.text: When I opened my eyes I saw a man with an axe standing at the end of my bed...
examples.translation: 我睁开眼睛时，看见一个手持斧头的男人站在床尾。

examples.text: His eyes were opening wide.
examples.translation: 他双眼圆睁。

examples.text: As soon as he saw that her eyes were open he sat up.
examples.translation: 一看见她的眼睛睁开他就坐了起来。

examples.text: She opened her arms and gave me a big hug.
examples.translation: 她张开双臂，紧紧地拥抱了我。

examples.text: Good listeners even sit in an open way: relaxed, arms loose...
examples.translation: 善于倾听的人甚至坐姿也很坦荡端正：身体放松，双臂自然下垂。

examples.text: I play normal bunker shots with an open stance.
examples.translation: 我打一般的沙坑球采取开立击球姿势。

examples.text: He had always been open with her and she always felt she would know if he lied...
examples.translation: 他对她总是坦诚相待，她也一直觉得如果他说谎，自己一定能察觉。

examples.text: She has an open, trusting nature.
examples.translation: 她天性坦诚，对人信赖。

examples.text: ...a relationship based on honesty and openness.
examples.translation: 基于诚实和坦率的关系

examples.text: The action is an open violation of the Vienna Convention...
examples.translation: 该行为公然违背了《维也纳公约》。

examples.text: Hearing the case in open court is only one part of the judicial process.
examples.translation: 公开审理这一案件只是司法程序的一部分。

examples.text: ...the new climate of political openness.
examples.translation: 政治开放的新气候

examples.text: They are open to suggestions on how working conditions might be improved.
examples.translation: 他们愿意就如何改善工作条件听取各种意见。

examples.text: The system, though well-meaning, is open to abuse...
examples.translation: 该制度动机虽好，却易遭滥用。

examples.text: They left themselves wide open to accusations of double standards and hypocrisy.
examples.translation: 他们使自己陷于被人指责搞双重标准和虚伪不实的境地。

examples.text: The truth of the facts produced may be open to doubt...
examples.translation: 所摆出事实的真实性仍然值得怀疑。

examples.text: It is an open question how long that commitment can last.
examples.translation: 这一承诺能维持多久还不确定。

examples.text: The rebels have opened the road from Monrovia to the Ivory Coast...
examples.translation: 叛乱分子已经开放了从蒙罗维亚到象牙海岸的道路。

examples.text: The solid rank of police officers lining the courtroom opened to let them pass.
examples.translation: 把法庭围得水泄不通的一队警察让开一条路让他们通过。

examples.text: We were part of an entire regiment that had nothing else to do but to keep that highway open.
examples.translation: 整个团除了保持那条公路畅通就无事可干，而我们就是这个团的一部分。

examples.text: As rescue workers opened up roads today, it became apparent that some small towns were totally devastated...
examples.translation: 今天救援人员打通了道路后，人们发现一些小镇显然已被彻底摧毁。

examples.text: When the Berlin Wall came down it wasn't just the roads that opened up but the waterways too.
examples.translation: 柏林墙一倒，不仅是陆路，连水路也开通了。

examples.text: The corridor opened into a low smoky room.

examples.translation: 这家医疗机构建议我们保密，而我们却想公开此事。

examples.translation: 这颗行星可能正环绕着一颗小恒星运行。

examples.translation: 1957年，苏联发射了第一颗绕地卫星。

meanings.meaning: 有秩序的；整齐的；值班的

examples.text: The organizers guided them in orderly fashion out of the building...
examples.translation: 组织者引领他们井然有序地走出大楼。

examples.translation: 尽管选举前发生了暴力事件，报道说投票得以和平有序地进行。

examples.translation: 这是一座美丽清洁、秩序井然的城市。

examples.translation: 他们的车一排排井然有序地停放着。

examples.translation: 这幅画作在条理分明和出人意表之间取得了平衡。

examples.translation: 我坚定地认为绝大部分老百姓会赞同我的观点。

examples.translation: 它所含热量比普通的冰激凌少了25卡路里。

examples.translation: 对我们来说，这只是一个平常的周末。

examples.translation: 我只是一个颇为平庸无趣的普通人。

examples.translation: 你的生活从那时起一定非常平淡无奇。

examples.translation: 制作精良但毫无特色的酒杯、灯具和餐具

examples.translation: 大部分学校都很不愿意为减少开支而裁员。

examples.translation: 为了让我们其余这些人能够睡得更安稳而要他们冒生命危险

examples.translation: 他们要想同政府讨价还价就得有人质。

examples.translation: 在他们的电脑上查询个人记录，需要提供被查询人的姓名和地址。

examples.translation: “让他走！”他命令道。

examples.translation: “上楼回你的房间去。现在就去！”他命令他道。

examples.translation: 总统已经下令进行全面调查。

examples.translation: 他被处以两年的监管。

examples.translation: 我们给他叫了一瓶啤酒。

examples.translation: 侍者把他们点的餐端了过来，格雷厄姆签了单。

examples.translation: （按照优先次序）写下你想具有的品质。
