examples.translation: 这一运动以自由和社会民主为目标。

examples.text: ...legislation that would have made discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation illegal.
examples.translation: 本来会将性取向歧视定为非法的法规

examples.text: They give their new employees a day or two of perfunctory orientation.
examples.translation: 他们对新员工进行了一两天例行公事的培训。

examples.text: ...a one-day orientation session.
examples.translation: 为期一天的迎新会

examples.text: Farnese had the orientation of the church changed so that the front would face a square.
examples.translation: 法尔内塞改变了教堂的朝向，这样它的正面就可以对着广场。

examples.text: ...theories about the origin of life...
examples.translation: 有关生命起源的各种理论

examples.text: The disorder in military policy had its origins in Truman's first term...
examples.translation: 军事政策的混乱可追溯到杜鲁门的第一届任期。

examples.text: Their medical problems are basically physical in origin...
examples.translation: 他们的病症主要是由于身体原因引起的。

examples.text: Most of the thickeners are of plant origin.
examples.translation: 大部分增稠剂来源于植物。

examples.text: Thomas has not forgotten his humble origins.
examples.translation: 托马斯没有忘记自己卑微的出身。

examples.text: ...people of Asian origin...
examples.translation: 亚裔民众

examples.text: They are forced to return to their country of origin.
examples.translation: 他们被迫返回出生国。

meanings.meaning: 原始的；最初的；独创的；新颖的

examples.text: The original plan was to hold an indefinite stoppage...
examples.translation: 最初的计划是无限期停工。

examples.text: The inhabitants have voted overwhelmingly to restore the city's original name of Chemnitz.
examples.translation: 居民以压倒多数票同意恢复该市原来的名字“开姆尼茨”。

examples.text: When you have filled in the questionnaire, copy it and send the original to your employer...
examples.translation: 填好这份问卷后，复印一份并将原卷交给雇主。

examples.text: For once the sequel is as good as the original.
examples.translation: 续集破天荒地与第一部一样精彩。

examples.text: ...an original movie poster.
examples.translation: 原版电影海报

examples.text: ...its policy of commissioning original work.
examples.translation: 其委托创作新作品的政策

examples.text: ...with catchy original songs by Richard Warner.
examples.translation: 以及理查德·沃纳最新创作的朗朗上口的歌曲

examples.text: It is one of the most original works of imagination in the language.
examples.translation: 这是用该语言写成的最具独创性和想象力的作品之一。

examples.text: ...an original writer.
examples.translation: 独树一帜的作家

examples.text: ...a chef with an original touch and a measure of inspiration.
examples.translation: 有几分创意和灵感的厨师

examples.text: He was capable of writing things of startling originality.
examples.translation: 他能够写出极具创意的作品。

examples.text: He read every book or author it deals with, often in the original...
examples.translation: 这方面的每一本书和每一位作家他都读过，而且通常均为原著。

examples.text: The texts were sung in the original Italian.
examples.translation: 这些歌词是用原来的意大利语演唱的。

examples.text: The disease originated in Africa...
examples.translation: 这种病源于非洲。

examples.text: All carbohydrates originate from plants...
examples.translation: 所有的碳水化合物均来自植物。

examples.text: I suppose no one has any idea who originated the story?
examples.translation: 我想没有人知道是谁编了这个故事？

meanings.meaning: 装饰；[建][服装] 装饰物；教堂用品

examples.text: ...a shelf containing a few photographs and ornaments.
examples.translation: 摆放着几张照片和些许装饰品的架子

examples.text: ...Christmas tree ornaments.
examples.translation: 圣诞树装饰物

examples.text: I guessed he was the chief because he wore more gold ornaments than the others.
examples.translation: 我估计他是酋长，因为他戴的金饰最多。

examples.text: ...walls of glass overlaid with ornament.
examples.translation: 贴着装饰物的玻璃墙

examples.text: I'm an orphan and pretty much grew up on my own.
examples.translation: 我是个孤儿，差不多是靠自己长大的。

examples.text: ...a young orphan girl brought up by peasants...
examples.translation: 由农民抚养长大的幼小孤女

examples.text: Jones was orphaned at the age of ten, and taken in by next-door neighbours...
examples.translation: 琼斯10岁时成为孤儿，被隔壁的邻居收养。

examples.text: By the end of the decade, some ten million children are expected to have been orphaned by the disease.
examples.translation: 到这个10年结束时，大约1,000万儿童将会因为这种疾病而失去双亲。

examples.text: ..a fifteen-year-old boy left orphaned by the recent disaster.
examples.translation: 被最近的那场灾难夺走了父母的15岁男孩

meanings.meaning: 正统的；传统的；惯常的；东正教的

examples.text: Payne gained a reputation for sound, if orthodox, views...
examples.translation: 虽然观点正统，但佩恩合乎情理的见解还是令他为人称道。

examples.text: Many of these ideas are now being incorporated into orthodox medical treatment.
examples.translation: 现在这些理念中有很多正被吸收至正统医学治疗中。

examples.text: ...orthodox police methods.
examples.translation: 警方的常规手段

examples.text: ...orthodox Jews.
examples.translation: 正统派的犹太教徒

examples.text: ...orthodox conservatives.
examples.translation: 循规蹈矩的保守派

examples.text: ...the Greek Orthodox Church.
examples.translation: 希腊东正教会

examples.text: When other follows the determiner an, it is written as one word.
examples.translation: 当 other 跟在限定词 an 之后时，两词合写作一个单词。See见 another.

examples.text: The communique gave no other details.
examples.translation: 这份公报并未透露其他细节。

examples.text: Four crewmen were killed, one other was injured...
examples.translation: 4位船员死亡，还有1位受伤。

examples.text: In 1914 he (like so many others) lied about his age so that he could join the war effort.
examples.translation: 1914年他（跟其他很多人一样）虚报了年龄以便能够参战。

examples.text: The authorities insist that the discussions must not be linked to any other issue...
examples.translation: 当局坚持此次讨论不得涉及其他任何问题。

examples.text: Calls cost 36p per minute cheap rate and 48p per minute at all other times...
examples.translation: 话费在优惠时段为每分钟36便士，其他时段一律为每分钟48便士。

examples.text: He would have to accept it; there was no other way...
examples.translation: 对此他将别无选择，只有接受。

examples.text: They will then have more money to spend on other things.
examples.translation: 这样他们就可以有更多的钱花在其他地方。

examples.text: This issue, more than any other, has divided her cabinet...
examples.translation: 主要是这一问题使她的内阁产生了分歧。

examples.text: Some of these methods will work. Others will not.
examples.translation: 这些方法中有一些会奏效，其他的则行不通。

examples.text: The Captain was at the other end of the room...
examples.translation: 船长在房间的另一头。

examples.text: You deliberately went in the other direction...
examples.translation: 你故意朝另一个方向走。

examples.text: Half of PML's scientists have first degrees, the other half have PhDs.
examples.translation: 普利茅斯海洋研究所的科学家一半有学士学位，另一半则有博士学位。

examples.text: Almost everybody had a cigarette in one hand and a martini in the other...
examples.translation: 几乎每个人都是一手夹着香烟，一手端着马提尼酒。

examples.text: While one of them tried to put his hand in my pocket, the other held me from behind.
examples.translation: 其中一人试图掏我口袋的时候，另一个人从后面抱住了我。

examples.text: Queensway Quay will incorporate shops, restaurants and other amenities...
examples.translation: 女王道码头将会融商店、餐馆以及其他生活便利设施为一体。

examples.text: Place them in a jam jar, porcelain bowl, or other similar container.
examples.translation: 将它们装入果酱罐、瓷碗或其他类似容器中。

examples.text: Descartes received his stimulus from the new physics and astronomy of Copernicus, Galileo, and others.
examples.translation: 笛卡儿从哥白尼、伽利略等人的新物理学和天文学中得到启发。

examples.text: When the other pupils were taken to an exhibition, he was left behind.
examples.translation: 当其余学生被带去参观展览时，他被留了下来。

examples.text: Aubrey's on his way here, with the others.
examples.translation: 奥布里和其他人正在来这里的路上。

examples.text: The suffering of other people appals me...
examples.translation: 人们的苦难让我无比震惊。

examples.text: She likes to be with other people.
examples.translation: 她喜欢与人交往。

examples.text: His humour depended on contempt for others.
examples.translation: 他的幽默基于对别人的蔑视。

examples.text: I rang her the other day and she said she'd like to come round...
examples.translation: 我前几天给她打电话，她说想过来玩。

examples.text: The other evening we had a party.
examples.translation: 前不久的某个晚上我们搞了一次聚会。

examples.text: He moved to England in 1980 where, among other things, he worked as a journalist...
examples.translation: 他1980年移居英格兰，期间从事过包括记者在内的很多工作。

examples.text: His travels took him to Dublin, among other places...
examples.translation: 他游历过很多地方，其中包括都柏林。

examples.text: He is expected to be supported at the meeting by Dennis Skinner and Tony Benn among others.
examples.translation: 他预计将在会上获得包括丹尼斯·斯金纳和托尼·本在内的很多人的支持。

examples.text: Their food is adequate. It includes meat at least every other day, vegetables and fruit...
examples.translation: 他们的伙食足够丰富了，有蔬菜、水果，而且至少每隔一天吃一次肉。

examples.text: Now that their children have grown up she joins Paddy in London every other week.
examples.translation: 他们的孩子都长大了，她便每隔一周就到伦敦帕迪那里。

examples.text: The same will apply in every other country.
examples.translation: 这也适用于其他任何国家。

examples.text: He called together all his employees and announced that the manager was none other than his son.
examples.translation: 他把所有的员工召集到一起，宣布经理不是别人，正是他的儿子。

examples.text: Nothing other than an immediate custodial sentence could be justified...
examples.translation: 只有判决即时监禁才算合理。

examples.text: The rebels would not be happy with anything other than the complete removal of the current regime...
examples.translation: 叛乱分子只有彻底推翻了现政权才肯罢休。

examples.text: They have left us with no other choice than to take formal action.
examples.translation: 他们逼得我们别无选择，只有采取正式行动。

examples.text: I was going to have him called away from the house on some pretext or other...
examples.translation: 我准备找个什么借口把他从屋里支出去。

examples.text: The Foundation is holding a dinner in honour of something or other...
examples.translation: 基金会正举办某个纪念宴会。

examples.text: Somehow or other he's involved.
examples.translation: 不知怎的，他也牵涉在内。

examples.text: She makes no reference to any feminist work other than her own...
examples.translation: 除了自己的之外，她没有提及其他女权主义著作。

examples.text: The journey by road to Wolverhampton is not recommended to anyone other than the most experienced cyclist.
examples.translation: 除了经验非常丰富的自行车手外，建议其他人不要走去伍尔弗汉普顿的那条路。

examples.text: Make a note of the questions you want to ask. You will invariably forget some of them otherwise...
examples.translation: 把想提的问题记下来，否则总是会漏掉其中的一些。

examples.text: I'm lucky that I'm interested in school work, otherwise I'd go mad.
examples.translation: 我很庆幸自己对学习怀有兴趣，不然我会疯掉的。

examples.text: ...men who want to provide positive role models for kids who might otherwise be out on the streets.
examples.translation: 想为那些可能会流落街头的孩子树立榜样的人

examples.text: The decorations for the games have lent a splash of colour to an otherwise drab city.
examples.translation: 为运动会所作的装扮给原本毫无生气的城市增添了一抹亮色。

examples.text: ...a blue and gold caravan, slightly travel-stained but otherwise in good condition.
examples.translation: 除了在旅途中弄得有点脏以外，性能良好的蓝金色旅行拖车

examples.text: Take approximately 60mg up to four times a day, unless advised otherwise by a doctor...
examples.translation: 每次服用大约60毫克，每天最多4次，或遵医嘱。

examples.text: There is no way anything would ever happen between us, and believe me I've tried to convince myself otherwise...
examples.translation: 相信我，我已经努力试图说服自己我们之间存有希望，但我们真的是绝对不可能的。

examples.text: All photographs are by the author unless otherwise stated.
examples.translation: 若无特殊说明，所有照片均出自该作者。

examples.text: The studio could punish its players by keeping them out of work, and otherwise controlling their lives.
examples.translation: 电影公司能通过让艺人坐冷板凳来惩罚他们，并采用其他方式控制他们的生活。

examples.text: It was for the police to assess the validity or otherwise of the evidence...
examples.translation: 应该由警方来判定证据有效与否。

examples.text: He didn't want company, talkative or otherwise...
examples.translation: 他不想跟人搭伴，不管这个伴儿是否健谈。

examples.text: I was feeling really ill, mentally and otherwise.
examples.translation: 我觉得身心俱疲。

examples.text: Mark, you've got a good wife. You ought to take care of her...
examples.translation: 马克，你娶了个好妻子，应该好好待她。

examples.text: The people who already own a bit of money or land ought to have a voice in saying where it goes...
examples.translation: 已经有点钱财或土地的人应当对其走向有发言权。

examples.text: You ought to be ashamed of yourselves. You've created this problem.
examples.translation: 你们应该感到惭愧，都是你们惹的祸。

examples.text: You don't have to be alone with him and I don't think you ought to be...
examples.translation: 你不必单独跟他呆在一起，而且我认为你也不该这样。

examples.text: You ought to ask a lawyer's advice...
examples.translation: 你应当征求一下律师的意见。

examples.text: She wondered if she ought to take some coffee out to Alfred...
examples.translation: 她不知道自己是否应该给艾尔弗雷德端去咖啡。

examples.text: We ought not to be quarrelling now.
examples.translation: 我们现在不应该吵架。

examples.text: 'This ought to be fun,' he told Alex, eyes gleaming.
examples.translation: “这应该会很有趣！”他对亚历克斯说，两眼闪闪发光。

examples.text: By rights the Social Democrats ought to be the favourites in the election. But nothing looks less certain...
examples.translation: 社会民主党按理应该最有希望赢得这次选举，但一切从未如此不确定过。

examples.text: Though this gives them a nice feeling, it really ought to worry them.
examples.translation: 虽然这让他们感觉良好，但他们其实应该为此担心。

examples.text: He ought to have reached the house some time ago.
examples.translation: 他应该早就到房子那儿了。

examples.text: Basically the system ought to have worked...
examples.translation: 其实这套系统本应发挥作用的。

examples.text: The money to build the power station ought to have been sufficient.
examples.translation: 建设电站的资金本该足够了。

examples.text: I realize I ought to have told you about it...
examples.translation: 我意识到自己本该把这件事告诉你的。

examples.text: Perhaps we ought to have trusted people more...
examples.translation: 也许我们本当对人多一些信任的。

examples.text: I ought not to have asked you a thing like that. I'm sorry...
examples.translation: 我不该问你那样的事情，我很抱歉。

examples.text: I'm beginning to feel now we oughtn't to have let her go away like that.
examples.translation: 我现在开始觉得，我们不该就那样让她走了。

examples.text: I really ought to be getting back now...
examples.translation: 现在我真得回去了。

examples.text: I think I ought to go.
examples.translation: 我想我该走了。

examples.text: ...four ounces of sugar.
examples.translation: 4盎司糖

examples.text: If only my father had possessed an ounce of business sense...
examples.translation: 要是我父亲有一点点经商的头脑就好了。

examples.text: I spent every ounce of energy trying to hide.
examples.translation: 我费尽力气想藏起来。

examples.text: We're expecting our first baby...
examples.translation: 我们怀上了第一个孩子。

examples.text: I locked myself out of our apartment and had to break in...
examples.translation: 我把自己锁在了我们的公寓外面，不得不破门而入。

examples.text: Clear it away so we can put our mugs down.
examples.translation: 把它拿开，我们好放杯子。

examples.text: The quality of our life depends on keeping well...
examples.translation: 我们的生活质量取决于健康状况。

examples.text: We are all entirely responsible for our actions, and for our reactions.
examples.translation: 我们都对自己的行为和反应负全责。

examples.text: Our Barry had a habit of doing that sort of thing.
examples.translation: 我家巴里就习惯干那种事。

examples.text: Japanese democracy is certainly different from ours...
examples.translation: 日本的民主制度无疑与我们的不同。

examples.text: There are few strangers in a town like ours...
examples.translation: 像我们这样的镇子很少有外地人。

examples.text: Half the houses had been fitted with alarms and ours hadn't.
examples.translation: 有半数的房子安装了警报器，不过我们家没有。

examples.text: We sat round the fire to keep ourselves warm...
examples.translation: 我们围坐在火边取暖。

examples.text: It was the first time we admitted to ourselves that we were tired.
examples.translation: 这是我们第一次承认自己累了。

examples.text: We all know that when we exert ourselves our heart rate increases.
examples.translation: 我们都知道太卖命了会导致心跳加速。

examples.text: Others are feeling just the way we ourselves would feel in the same situation...
examples.translation: 别人此时的感受和我们自己在同样的情形下时没什么两样。

examples.text: The people who will suffer won't be people like ourselves.
examples.translation: 受苦的不会是像我们这样的人。

examples.text: We villagers built that ourselves, we had no help from anyone.
examples.translation: 那是我们村民自己修建的，没有依靠任何人的帮助。

examples.text: The four-day festival ended a day early after an outbreak of violence involving hundreds of youths.
examples.translation: 一场有数百名年轻人卷入的暴力活动发生后，为期4天的节庆活动被迫提前一天结束。

examples.text: ...the outbreak of war in the Middle East...
examples.translation: 中东战争的爆发

examples.text: In Peru, a cholera outbreak continues to spread.
examples.translation: 霍乱在秘鲁各地相继爆发。

meanings.meaning: 出现；在外；出局；出声地；不流行地

examples.text: Carefully pull out the centre pages...
examples.translation: 小心翼翼地抽出中间的几页。

examples.text: He took out his notebook and flipped the pages...
examples.translation: 他掏出笔记本，飞快地翻着。

examples.text: They paid in that cheque a couple of days ago, and drew out around two thousand in cash.
examples.translation: 他们几天前将那张支票存入了银行，然后支取了近2,000元现金。

examples.text: It's hot out — very hot, very humid.
examples.translation: 外面很热——非常炎热而且非常潮湿。

examples.text: I tried to get in touch with you yesterday evening, but I think you were out...
examples.translation: 我昨晚想要和你联系，但好像你不在家里。

examples.text: She had to go out.
examples.translation: 她得出趟门。

examples.text: The police tell me they've finished their investigations out there...
examples.translation: 警方告诉我他们已完成了在那儿的调查工作。

examples.text: Rosie's husband was now out East.
examples.translation: 罗茜的丈夫现在远在东部。

examples.text: The tide was out and they walked among the rock pools.
examples.translation: 潮水已经退去，他们走过岩石区的潮水潭。

examples.text: Me and my friends are out ten thousand dollars, with nothing to show for it!
examples.translation: 我和朋友亏了1万美金，还一无所得！

examples.text: All the lights were out in the house...
examples.translation: 屋里的灯全都灭了。

examples.text: Several of the lights went out, one after another.
examples.translation: 其中几盏灯一个接一个地熄灭了。

examples.text: Well, the daffodils are out in the gardens and they're always a beautiful show.
examples.translation: 哎呀，花园里的黄水仙开了，它们永远都是一道亮丽的风景。

examples.text: I usually put it in my diary when I see the wild flowers coming out.
examples.translation: 我看到野花开时总会记在日记里。

examples.text: ...cover versions of 40 British Number Ones — out now.
examples.translation: 40首英国头榜歌曲的翻唱版现在上市

examples.text: The French edition came out in early 1992.
examples.translation: 法文版于1992年初出版。

examples.text: We've been out for two and a half months and we're not going back until we get what we're asking for.
examples.translation: 我们已经罢工两个半月了，除非要求得到满足，否则我们不会复工。

examples.text: In June last year, 26 people came out on strike protesting against a compulsory 65-hour week.
examples.translation: 去年6月，26人举行罢工，抗议强制实行每周65小时工作制。

examples.text: That's right out, I'm afraid.
examples.translation: 那恐怕根本行不通。

examples.text: Romance is making a comeback. Reality is out.
examples.translation: 浪漫主义正重新流行起来，而现实主义过时了。

examples.text: When the two ends of the tunnel met in the middle they were only a few inches out.
examples.translation: 隧道两端在中间相接时，仅有几英寸的误差。

examples.text: Most companies these days are just out to make a quick profit.
examples.translation: 如今，大多数公司只想能迅速获利。

examples.text: The New York gay action group 'Queer Nation' recently outed an American Congressman.
examples.translation: 纽约的同性恋行动组织“酷儿国度”最近揭露一位美国国会议员为同性恋。

examples.text: The gay and lesbian rights group, Stonewall, sees outing as completely unhelpful.
examples.translation: 男女同性恋权益组织“石墙”认为公开揭露同性恋者身份毫无益处。

examples.text: She let him out of the house.
examples.translation: 她让他出了屋子。

examples.text: I always took my key out of my bag and put it in my pocket.
examples.translation: 我总是将钥匙从包里取出来放进口袋。

examples.text: He went on staring out of the window...
examples.translation: 他继续凝视着窗外。

examples.text: He looked out the window at the car on the street below.
examples.translation: 他望着窗下街头的那辆汽车。

examples.text: People can keep out of the sun to avoid skin cancer.
examples.translation: 人们可以通过避免阳光照射来预防皮肤癌。

examples.text: In the past army troops have relied heavily on air support to get them out of trouble...
examples.translation: 过去，陆军部队在很大程度上依赖空中支援来摆脱困境。

examples.text: The economy is starting to climb out of recession...
examples.translation: 经济开始走出衰退。

examples.text: The Salvation Army has worked in the big cities to keep endangered young people out of a life of crime.
examples.translation: 救世军已经在大城市展开行动，努力使那些处于危险边缘的年轻人远离犯罪。

examples.text: You come out of university and find there are no jobs available...
examples.translation: 从大学毕业后却找不到工作。

examples.text: Doctors should be able to decide who they can safely let out of hospital early.
examples.translation: 医生应该有权决定谁可以安全地提早出院。

examples.text: Shaun was in the bedroom, out of earshot, watching television...
examples.translation: 肖恩在卧室里看电视，听不见。

examples.text: He turned to look back, but by then she was out of sight.
examples.translation: 他转头看去，但那时她已经不见了。

examples.text: He took up office out of a sense of duty...
examples.translation: 他就任公职是出于一种责任感。

examples.text: Some people have left out of embarrassment at what's happened to them.
examples.translation: 一些人已经由于为发生在自己身上的事感到难堪而离开了。

examples.text: 'Where is she being held prisoner?' I asked. 'Did you get it out of him?'...
examples.translation: “她被囚禁在什么地方？”我问道，“你从他口里套出来没有？”

examples.text: We knew we could get better work out of them.
examples.translation: 我们知道他们可以做得更漂亮。

examples.text: We all had a lot of fun out of him...
examples.translation: 他给我们带来很多快乐。

examples.text: To get the most out of your money, you have to invest.
examples.translation: 要想把钱的收益最大化，就必须投资。

examples.text: I can't find the sugar — and we're out of milk.
examples.translation: 我找不到糖——而且我们也没牛奶了。

examples.text: Would you advise people to make a building out of wood or stone?
examples.translation: 你会建议人们用木材还是石头建房子呢？

examples.text: Two out of five thought the business would be sold privately on their retirement or death...
examples.translation: 五个人之中有两个认为公司会在他们退休或去世时被私下卖掉。

examples.text: In 99 cases out of a hundred this will be done more effectively by the army.
examples.translation: 这件事让军队来做十之八九会更有效。

examples.text: Mr. Singh said he was pleased with the outcome...
examples.translation: 辛格先生说他对这一结果感到满意。

examples.text: It's too early to know the outcome of her illness.
examples.translation: 现在要想知道她病情的结果还为时过早。

examples.text: ...a successful outcome.
examples.translation: 圆满的结局

meanings.meaning: 户外的；露天的；野外的（等于out-of-door）

examples.text: If you enjoy outdoor activities, this is the trip for you...
examples.translation: 如果你喜欢户外运动，这一旅行很适合你。

examples.text: There were outdoor cafes on almost every block.
examples.translation: 几乎每个街区都有露天咖啡馆。

meanings.meaning: 外面的，外部的；远离中心的

examples.text: He heard a voice in the outer room.
examples.translation: 他听到外屋有人说话。

examples.text: ...the outer suburbs of the city.
examples.translation: 城市远郊住宅区

examples.text: She was wearing an outfit she'd bought the previous day...
examples.translation: 她穿着前一天买的那套衣服。

examples.text: I spent lots of money on smart new outfits for work.
examples.translation: 我花大笔钱购置了上班时穿的漂亮新套装。

examples.text: He works for a private security outfit...
examples.translation: 他在一家私人保安公司工作。

examples.text: We are a professional outfit and we do require payment for our services.
examples.translation: 我们是一家专业机构，对所提供服务确实要收取费用。

examples.text: They outfitted him with artificial legs...
examples.translation: 他们为他安了假腿。

examples.text: I outfitted an attic bedroom as a studio.
examples.translation: 我把阁楼卧室改装成了工作室。

meanings.meaning: 远足；短途旅游；体育比赛

examples.text: One evening, she made a rare outing to the local discotheque.
examples.translation: 她有天晚上破天荒地去了一次当地的迪斯科舞厅。

examples.text: ...families on a Sunday afternoon outing.
examples.translation: 星期天下午远足的家庭

examples.text: Playing against Zebre in England's first outing, he suffered a whiplash injury to his neck.
examples.translation: 在英格兰队首次对阵热布里的比赛中，他颈部受了挥鞭伤。

meanings.meaning: 出口，排放孔；[电] 电源插座；销路；发泄的方法；批发商店

examples.text: ...the largest retail outlet in the city.
examples.translation: 该市最大的零售商店

examples.text: ...the factory outlet store in Belmont.
examples.translation: 位于贝尔蒙特的厂家直销型折扣店

examples.text: Her father had found an outlet for his ambition in his work.
examples.translation: 她父亲在工作中找到了施展抱负的机会。

examples.text: ...a warm air outlet.
examples.translation: 热气出口

examples.text: ...an underwater outlet pipe discharging waste into the sea.
examples.translation: 排污入海的水下管道

examples.text: The mayor outlined his plan to clean up the town's image...
examples.translation: 市长概述了他整顿市容的计划。

examples.text: The methods outlined in this book are only suggestions.
examples.translation: 本书概括的一些方法仅供参考。

examples.text: Following is an outline of the survey findings...
examples.translation: 以下是调查结果概要。

examples.text: The proposals were given in outline by the Secretary of State.
examples.translation: 国务卿对提议进行了简要的概述。

examples.text: The Ritz was outlined against the lights up there...
examples.translation: 高悬的灯光映照出里兹饭店的轮廓。

examples.text: It was a beautiful sight outlined above the starry sky.
examples.translation: 星空之上映衬出美景。

examples.text: He could see only the hazy outline of the goalposts.
examples.translation: 他只能看见球门柱模糊的轮廓。

examples.text: The illness had a profound effect on his outlook...
examples.translation: 这场病对他的人生观产生了深刻的影响。

examples.text: I adopted a positive outlook on life...
examples.translation: 我开始抱持积极向上的人生观。

examples.text: We were quite different in outlook, Philip and I.
examples.translation: 我和菲利普的世界观截然不同。

examples.text: The economic outlook is one of rising unemployment...
examples.translation: 展望未来的经济，失业率将会上升。

examples.text: Has motherhood changed your career outlook?
examples.translation: 当了母亲是否改变了你的职业前途？

examples.text: ...the uncertain outlook for the motor industry.
examples.translation: 汽车工业的不明朗前景

examples.text: Manual workers need a good breakfast for high-energy output...
examples.translation: 体力劳动者身体消耗巨大，早餐要丰盛一些。

examples.text: Government statistics show the largest drop in industrial output for ten years.
examples.translation: 政府统计数据显示这是10年来工业产量最大幅度的滑坡。

examples.text: You run the software, you look at the output, you make modifications.
examples.translation: 运行该软件，查看输出结果并进行修正。

meanings.meaning: 凌辱，强奸；对…施暴行；激起愤怒

examples.text: Many people have been outraged by some of the things that have been said...
examples.translation: 其中的一些言论激怒了很多人。

examples.text: Reports of torture and mass executions in Serbia's detention camps have outraged the world's religious leaders.
examples.translation: 关于塞尔维亚拘留营里动用酷刑并大肆处决的报道令全世界的宗教领袖义愤填膺。

examples.text: He is truly outraged about what's happened to him...
examples.translation: 这一遭遇实在让他满腔愤慨。

examples.text: Some outraged readers said the story was extremely offensive and distressing.
examples.translation: 一些感到义愤的读者说这篇报道极为令人反感，而且非常伤人。

examples.text: The decision provoked outrage from women and human rights groups...
examples.translation: 这一决定激起了妇女和人权组织的强烈愤慨。

examples.text: The Treaty has failed to arouse genuine public outrage.
examples.translation: 该协定并未真正激起公愤。

examples.text: The latest outrage was to have been a co-ordinated gun and bomb attack on the station...
examples.translation: 最近的一起暴行是同时动用了枪支和炸弹的对车站的袭击。

examples.text: Tom, this is an outrage!
examples.translation: 汤姆，这简直太过分了！

examples.text: Decide at the outset what kind of learning programme you want to follow...
examples.translation: 开始时就选定自己的学习方案。

examples.text: From the outset he had put his trust in me, the son of his old friend.
examples.translation: 他从一开始就很信任我这个他老朋友的儿子。

examples.text: Hours later we reached the outskirts of New York.
examples.translation: 我们几小时后到达了纽约市郊。

meanings.meaning: 杰出的；显著的；未解决的；未偿付的

examples.text: Derartu is an outstanding athlete and deserved to win.
examples.translation: 德拉尔图是位优秀的运动员，赢得比赛也是理所当然。

examples.text: ...an area of outstanding natural beauty...
examples.translation: 自然景色美不胜收的地方

examples.text: He was outstanding at tennis and golf.
examples.translation: 他的网球和高尔夫球球技一流。

examples.text: The total debt outstanding is $70 billion...
examples.translation: 未偿债务总额达700亿美元。

examples.text: You have to pay your outstanding bill before joining the scheme.
examples.translation: 在参加该项目之前必须结清余账。

examples.text: We still have some outstanding issues to resolve before we'll have a treaty that is ready to sign.
examples.translation: 我们签协议之前还有一些未尽事宜待解决。

examples.text: The company is an outstanding example of a small business that grew into a big one...
examples.translation: 该公司是小企业成长为大企业的突出例子。

examples.text: His mother, whose influence on his development was outstanding, came of a distinguished American family.
examples.translation: 对他的成长影响深远的母亲出身于一个地位显赫的美国家庭。

examples.text: ...the outside of the building...
examples.translation: 建筑物的外部

examples.text: Cook over a fairly high heat until the outsides are browned.
examples.translation: 用大火烹调至表面焦黄。

examples.text: ...high up on the outside wall.
examples.translation: 在外墙的高处

examples.text: 'Was the car inside the garage?' — 'No, it was still outside.'...
examples.translation: “车在车库里吗？”——“不，还在外面。”

examples.text: I stepped outside and pulled up my collar against the cold mist...
examples.translation: 我走出门，竖起衣领抵御冷雾。

examples.text: Outside, the light was fading rapidly...
examples.translation: 屋外的天色很快就暗下来。

examples.text: The shouting outside grew louder.
examples.translation: 外面的叫喊声越来越大。

examples.text: The victim was outside a shop when he was attacked.
examples.translation: 被害人遇袭时正在一家商店的外面。

examples.text: ...the outside temperature.
examples.translation: 室外温度

examples.text: ...an outside toilet.
examples.translation: 户外厕所

examples.text: She'd sent him outside the classroom...
examples.translation: 她让他到教室外面去。

examples.text: He stood in the narrow hallway just outside the door.
examples.translation: 他就站在门外狭窄的走廊里。

examples.text: They heard voices coming from outside in the corridor...
examples.translation: 他们听到外面的走廊上有人说话。

examples.text: She heard the dog on the landing outside.
examples.translation: 她听到了外面楼梯平台上的狗叫声。

examples.text: ...a side of Morris's character she hid carefully from the outside world...
examples.translation: 莫里斯小心隐藏不让外人知晓的性格中的一面

examples.text: It's important to have outside interests.
examples.translation: 培养一些业余爱好很重要。

examples.text: The scheme was good for the prisoners because it brought them outside into the community.
examples.translation: 这一计划对囚犯很有帮助，因为它让他们走出去融入社会中。

examples.text: ...an old castle outside Budapest...
examples.translation: 布达佩斯城外的古堡

examples.text: The number of warships stationed outside European waters roughly doubled.
examples.translation: 部署在欧洲水域之外的战舰数量差不多增加了一倍。

examples.text: ...theatres both in and outside London.
examples.translation: 伦敦市内外的剧院

examples.text: Peace cannot be imposed from the outside by the United States or anyone else.
examples.translation: 美国或其他任何国家都不能将和平强加于他国。

examples.text: It was travelling in the outside lane at 78mph.
examples.translation: 它正以78英里的时速在快车道上疾驶。

examples.text: ...coming up on the outside.
examples.translation: 从快车道追上来

examples.text: The company now makes much greater use of outside consultants.
examples.translation: 该公司现在对外聘顾问的利用更加充分。

examples.text: ...church services given on Sundays by outside chaplains.
examples.translation: 外请牧师主持的星期天礼拜仪式

examples.text: He is hoping to recruit a chairman from outside the company.
examples.translation: 他想从公司以外聘请一位主席。

examples.text: The condition is practically unknown outside psychiatry clinics.
examples.translation: 除了医院的精神病科外，这种病几乎不为人知。

examples.text: ...the largest merger ever to take place outside the oil industry.
examples.translation: 石油行业之外发生的一起有史以来规模最大的并购

examples.text: She is a beautiful boat, but way, way outside my price range...
examples.translation: 这条船很漂亮，但价格却远远超出我能承受的范围。

examples.text: When Cathy sings about love, you feel that she's singing about something outside her experience.
examples.translation: 凯茜在唱情歌的时候，你能感觉到她没有这方面的体验。

examples.text: They are open outside normal daily banking hours.
examples.translation: 它们在银行正常营业时间以外开放。

examples.text: ...nor does it help if your job involves working outside normal office hours.
examples.translation: 工作需要加班也会有害。

examples.text: Every single relationship I've had with a man, outside of my husband, has ended in disaster.
examples.translation: 除了我丈夫之外，我与所有男人的感情都以悲剧收场。

examples.text: Give yourself forty minutes at the outside.
examples.translation: 最多给自己留40分钟。

meanings.meaning: 向外的；外面的；公开的；外服的；肉体的
向外（等于outwards）；在外；显而易见地

examples.text: Tickets must be bought seven days in advance, with outward and return journey dates specified.
examples.translation: 购票需提前7天，并确定往返日期。

examples.text: In spite of my outward calm I was very shaken...
examples.translation: 我外表看似镇定，实则吓得不轻。

examples.text: What the military rulers have done is to restore the outward appearance of order.
examples.translation: 军事统治者所做的只是为了恢复表面上的秩序。

examples.text: Mark was lying unconscious but with no outward sign of injury.
examples.translation: 马克躺在那儿昏迷不醒，但看不出受伤的迹象。

examples.text: He was a man in his late thirties, with fine, dark hair and a pale oval face.
examples.translation: 他年近四十，头发乌黑亮泽，长着一张苍白的鹅蛋脸。

examples.text: ...the small oval framed picture of a little boy.
examples.translation: 镶在椭圆形相框里的小男孩照片

examples.text: Using 2 spoons, mould the cheese into small balls or ovals.
examples.translation: 用两把勺子将奶酪滚成小球形或椭圆形。

examples.text: Put the onions and ginger in the oven and let them roast for thirty minutes.
examples.translation: 将洋葱和姜放进烤箱烘烤30分钟。

examples.text: He looked at himself in the mirror over the table.
examples.translation: 他对着桌子上方的镜子照了照。

examples.text: ...a bridge over the river Danube.
examples.translation: 多瑙河上的一座桥

examples.text: ...helicopters flying low over the crowd.
examples.translation: 在人群上空低飞的直升机

examples.text: ...planes flying over every 10 or 15 minutes.
examples.translation: 每隔 10或15分钟就从上空飞过的飞机

examples.text: A grey mackintosh was folded over her arm...
examples.translation: 她胳膊上搭着一件灰色雨衣。

examples.text: Joe's clothing was flung over the back of a chair.
examples.translation: 乔的衣服扔在椅背上。

examples.text: His hair fell over his brow instead of being brushed straight back...
examples.translation: 他的头发没有整齐地往后梳，而是搭在前额。

examples.text: Mix the ingredients and pour over the mushrooms...
examples.translation: 将配料搅拌均匀浇在蘑菇上。

examples.text: He was wearing a light-grey suit over a shirt...
examples.translation: 他在衬衫外面套了一件浅灰色西装。

examples.text: He pulled the cap halfway over his ears.
examples.translation: 他压低帽子，盖住一半耳朵。

examples.text: Heat this syrup and pour it over.
examples.translation: 将糖浆加热，浇在上面。

examples.text: They stopped to lean over a gate...
examples.translation: 他们停下来，身子探过一扇栅栏门。

examples.text: Everyone in the room was bent over her desk.
examples.translation: 房间里的每一个人都弯腰围在她的办公室桌前。

examples.text: Sam leant over to open the door of the car.
examples.translation: 萨姆俯身去开车门。

examples.text: I went and stood beside him, looking over his shoulder.
examples.translation: 我走过去站在他身边，从他的肩头望过去。

examples.text: ...conversing over the fence with your friend...
examples.translation: 与你的朋友隔着围栏交谈

examples.text: I heard various scraps of conversation over the dinner table.
examples.translation: 我在餐桌上听到各种只言片语的对话。

examples.text: ...a light and airy bar with a wonderful view over the River Amstel...
examples.translation: 可将阿姆斯特尔河美景尽收眼底的明亮通风的酒吧

examples.text: His rooms looked out over a narrow lane behind the college.
examples.translation: 从他的房间可以看见学院后面一条狭窄的小巷。

examples.text: Policemen jumped over the wall of the Spanish Embassy in pursuit...
examples.translation: 警察在追捕中跳过西班牙大使馆的围墙。

examples.text: I stepped over a broken piece of wood...
examples.translation: 我跨过一块破木头。

examples.text: Nearly one million people crossed over the river into Moldavia...
examples.translation: 将近100万人渡过这条河进入摩尔达维亚。

examples.text: He'd just come over the border.
examples.translation: 他刚刚越过边境。

examples.text: I climbed over into the back seat.
examples.translation: 我爬到后座上。

examples.text: She ran swiftly over the lawn to the gate...
examples.translation: 她一溜烟穿过草地跑到了大门口。

examples.text: Joe passed his hand over his face and looked puzzled.
examples.translation: 乔用手摸了一把脸，看上去疑惑不解。

examples.text: ...Richard Garrick, who lived in the house over the road.
examples.translation: 住在马路对面那所房子里的理查德·加里克

examples.text: ...a fashionable neighbourhood, just over the river from Manhattan.
examples.translation: 与曼哈顿隔河相望的时尚街区

examples.text: I got out the car and drove over to Dervaig...
examples.translation: 我把车开出来，驶向德韦格。

examples.text: I thought you might have invited her over.
examples.translation: 我以为你可能已经邀请她过来了。

examples.text: He noticed Rolfe standing silently over by the window...
examples.translation: 他注意到罗尔夫一声不吭地站在窗户旁边。

examples.text: John reached over and took Joanna's hand...
examples.translation: 约翰伸手握住乔安娜的手。

examples.text: He tossed over a cigarette.
examples.translation: 他扔过来一支香烟。

examples.text: If he drinks more than two glasses of wine he falls over...
examples.translation: 他喝酒超过两杯就会醉倒在地。

examples.text: He was knocked over by a bus and broke his leg...
examples.translation: 他被一辆公共汽车撞倒，一条腿折了。

examples.text: The truck had gone off the road and toppled over.
examples.translation: 那辆卡车冲出马路后就翻倒了。

examples.text: His car rolled over after a tyre was punctured...
examples.translation: 一只轮胎被扎破后，他的车翻了个底朝天。

examples.text: The alarm did go off but all I did was yawn, turn over and go back to sleep.
examples.translation: 闹钟确实响了，但我只是打了个哈欠，翻个身又接着睡着了。

examples.text: ...doctors who work all over the country.
examples.translation: 在全国各地工作的医生

examples.text: ...the letters she received from people all over the world.
examples.translation: 她收到的来自世界各地的信件

examples.text: Why don't you come over here tomorrow evening...
examples.translation: 你明天晚上过来吧。

examples.text: My father was in the U.S. army over here.
examples.translation: 我父亲在这里的美国陆军服役。

examples.text: The cafe is just across the road over there...
examples.translation: 咖啡馆就在那边马路对面。

examples.text: She'd married some American and settled down over there.
examples.translation: 她嫁给了一位美国人，并在那边定居了。

examples.text: Cigarettes kill over a hundred thousand Britons every year...
examples.translation: 每年香烟夺去10万多英国人的生命。

examples.text: I met George well over a year ago.
examples.translation: 我认识乔治已经是一年多前的事了。

examples.text: ...equipment costs of over £100m.
examples.translation: 耗资一亿多英镑的设备

examples.text: ...people aged 65 and over.
examples.translation: 65岁及以上的人群

examples.text: Expenditure on education has gone up by seven point eight per cent over and above inflation...
examples.translation: 扣除通货膨胀因素，教育支出实际增长了7.8%。

examples.text: Consider supplements over and above this healthy diet.
examples.translation: 除了这种健康饮食之外，还应考虑各种补养品。

examples.text: Larsons pay me well enough, but there's not much over for luxuries when there's two of you to live on it...
examples.translation: 拉森公司给我的薪水算是不错，但是两个人靠这份工资生活便没有多少闲钱买奢侈品了。

examples.text: Primrose was given an apple, left over from our picnic lunch.
examples.translation: 我们中午野餐剩下的一个苹果给了普丽姆罗丝。

examples.text: She said if she had the chance to do it over, she would have hired a press secretary...
examples.translation: 她说如果有机会从头来过，她会雇一位新闻秘书。

examples.text: Dave, the pianist, played it over a couple of times.
examples.translation: 演奏钢琴的戴夫将这支曲子反复弹了两三遍。

examples.text: He had to have everything spelled out twice over for him.
examples.translation: 他不得不把所有事项都对他详细说明了两次。

examples.text: When you realise they are singing the same songs over again, the novelty wears off...
examples.translation: 当你意识到他们开始从头演唱同样的歌曲时，新鲜感也就没有了。

examples.text: If I was living my life over again I wouldn't have attended so many committee meetings.
examples.translation: 如果生命可以重来，我再也不会参加这么多委员会会议了。

examples.text: He doesn't want the hassle all over again...
examples.translation: 他不想再惹这种麻烦了。

examples.text: The whole process started all over again...
examples.translation: 整个程序又再次开始了。

examples.text: He had to prove himself all over again.
examples.translation: 他不得不重新证明自己。

examples.text: He plays the same songs over and over...
examples.translation: 他一遍又一遍地放着同样的歌曲。

examples.text: 'I don't understand it,' he said, over and over again.
examples.translation: “我不明白，”他反复不停地说。

examples.text: Warplanes that have landed there will be kept until the war is over...
examples.translation: 降落在那里的战斗机将一直扣留到战争结束。

examples.text: The bad times were over...
examples.translation: 倒霉的日子过去了。

examples.text: I am glad it's all over.
examples.translation: 我很高兴一切都结束了。

examples.text: I'm glad that you're over the flu...
examples.translation: 你的流感好了，我真高兴。

examples.text: She was still getting over the shock of what she had been told.
examples.translation: 她被告知了这件事，直到现在还惊魂未定。

examples.text: He's never had any influence over her...
examples.translation: 他从未对她有过任何影响力。

examples.text: For two decades she has sought complete control over her film career...
examples.translation: 她20年来一直力图完全主宰自己的电影事业。

examples.text: The oil companies have lost their power over oil price and oil production.
examples.translation: 石油公司已经失去了对油价和石油产量的控制。

examples.text: The women were making a fuss over nothing.
examples.translation: 这些女人是在无谓地小题大做。

examples.text: ...concern over recent events in Burma...
examples.translation: 对缅甸近期所发生事件的关注

examples.text: Staff at some air and sea ports are beginning to protest over pay...
examples.translation: 一些机场和港口的职员开始抗议薪酬太低。

examples.text: They had already begun fighting over her.
examples.translation: 他们已经开始为了她你争我夺。

examples.text: The number of attacks on the capital had gone down over the past week...
examples.translation: 上一周对首都的袭击次数已经减少了。

examples.text: Many strikes over the last few years have not ended successfully...
examples.translation: 过去几年中有多次罢工都未获成功。

examples.text: Over breakfast we discussed plans for the day.
examples.translation: 我们一边吃早饭一边讨论这一天的计划。

examples.text: ...discussing the problem over a glass of wine.
examples.translation: 在杯盏之间讨论这个问题

examples.text: I'm not prepared to discuss this over the telephone...
examples.translation: 我不想在电话里讨论这件事。

examples.text: The head of state addressed the nation over the radio...
examples.translation: 这位国家元首通过广播向全国发表了讲话。

examples.text: Announcements were made over the loudspeaker system.
examples.translation: 通知通过喇叭广播。

examples.text: With the rest of the sports news, over to Colin Maitland.
examples.translation: 下面由科林·梅特兰接着为大家播报其他体育新闻。

examples.text: At the start of the last over, bowled by Chris Lewis, the Welsh county were favourites.
examples.translation: 在最后一轮由克里斯·刘易斯连续投出6个有效球之前，威尔士郡队本来胜券在握。

meanings.meaning: 全部的；全体的；一切在内的

examples.text: ...the overall rise in unemployment...
examples.translation: 失业率总体的上升

examples.text: Cut down your overall amount of physical activity...
examples.translation: 减少体力活动的总量。

examples.text: It is usually the woman who assumes overall care of the baby.
examples.translation: 通常由女性负责照顾孩子的方方面面。

examples.text: Overall, I like Connie. I think she's great...
examples.translation: 总的说来，我喜欢康妮，我认为她人挺不错。

examples.text: Overall I was disappointed...
examples.translation: 总的说来，我很失望。

examples.text: The college has few ways to assess the quality of education overall.
examples.translation: 总体看来，这所大学评估教育质量的方法寥寥无几。

examples.text: ...workers in blue overalls.
examples.translation: 穿着蓝色连身工作服的工人

examples.text: An elderly man dressed in faded overalls took the witness stand.
examples.translation: 一位穿着褪色吊带工装裤的老人上了证人席。

examples.text: He was wearing a ridiculous cashmere overcoat, and his suit today was a medium-gray flannel herringbone.
Molly had fought and overcome her fear of flying...
examples.translation: 莫莉已经努力克服了对飞行的恐惧。

examples.text: Find a way to overcome your difficulties.
examples.translation: 找出办法战胜困难。

examples.text: The night before the test I was overcome by fear and despair...
examples.translation: 考试前的晚上，恐惧和绝望让我内心无比惊慌。

examples.text: A dizziness overcame him, blurring his vision.
examples.translation: 他感到一阵眩晕，眼前发黑。

examples.text: The residents were trying to escape from the fire but were overcome by smoke.
examples.translation: 居民试图逃离火场，却被浓烟熏倒了。

meanings.meaning: 充满，洋溢；泛滥；超值；溢值

examples.text: Pour in some of the syrup, but not all of it, as it will probably overflow...
examples.translation: 倒一些糖浆进去，但别全倒，因为可能会溢出来。

examples.text: Rivers and streams have overflowed their banks in countless places.
examples.translation: 在许多地方，河流与小溪都已经决堤。

examples.text: The great hall was overflowing with people...
examples.translation: 大礼堂里挤满了人。

examples.text: Jails and temporary detention camps are overflowing...
examples.translation: 监狱和临时拘留所里人满为患。

examples.text: He emptied a few overflowing ashtrays.
examples.translation: 他将几只满满的烟灰缸倒干净。

examples.text: Kenneth overflowed with friendliness and hospitality...
examples.translation: 肯尼思满怀友善好客之情。

examples.text: Ridley's anger finally overflowed.
examples.translation: 里德利终于按捺不住满腔的怒火。

examples.text: Tents have been set up next to hospitals to handle the overflow...
examples.translation: 医院旁搭起了帐篷以安置容纳不下的人员。

examples.text: The loch's overflow cascades into the waterfalls of a Japanese water garden.
examples.translation: 溢出的湖水倾泻而下，形成了一座日式水景花园的瀑布。

examples.text: ...the overflow pipe.
examples.translation: 溢流管

examples.text: The kitchen garden was full to overflowing with fresh vegetables...
examples.translation: 家庭菜园里种满了新鲜蔬菜。

examples.text: He was one of the few teachers who always filled the lecture room to overflowing.
examples.translation: 他是为数不多的课堂场场爆满的老师之一。

meanings.meaning: 在头顶上；在空中；在高处
高架的；在头上的；在头顶上的
天花板；[会计] 经常费用

examples.text: She turned on the overhead light and looked around the little room.
examples.translation: 她打开头顶上方的灯，环视了一圈这个小房间。

examples.text: ...people who live under or near overhead cables.
examples.translation: 住在高架电缆下或其附近的人

examples.text: ...planes passing overhead...
examples.translation: 从头顶上空飞过的飞机

examples.text: Now there were only the stars overhead.
examples.translation: 现在抬头只能看见星星。

examples.text: I overheard two doctors discussing my case.
examples.translation: 我无意中听到两位医生讨论我的病情。

examples.text: ...snatches of overheard conversation.
examples.translation: 偷听到的片言只语

meanings.meaning: 部分重叠；部分的同时发生

examples.text: When the bag is folded flat, the bag bottom overlaps one side of the bag...
examples.translation: 袋子平整折起后，底面与一侧交叠。

examples.text: Overlap the slices carefully so there are no gaps...
examples.translation: 将切片小心翼翼地搭好，中间不留任何空隙。

examples.text: Use vinyl seam adhesive where vinyls overlap...
examples.translation: 塑料布相叠处用塑料封口胶粘起来。

examples.text: The edges must overlap each other or weeds will push through the gaps.
examples.translation: 边缘必须互搭在一起，否则杂草会从缝隙中钻出来。

examples.text: ...neat overlapping circles.
examples.translation: 相交的匀整圆形

examples.text: Elizabeth met other Oxford intellectuals some of whom overlapped Naomi's world...
examples.translation: 伊丽莎白结识了其他一些牛津大学的学者，其中有几位娜奥米也认识。

examples.text: Christian holy week overlaps with the beginning of the Jewish holiday of Passover...
examples.translation: 基督教的圣周与犹太教逾越节的头几天重叠。

examples.text: The needs of patients invariably overlap...
examples.translation: 病人的需求总有一些是一致的。

examples.text: Their lifespans overlapped by six years.
examples.translation: 他们在世的时间有6年是交叉的。

examples.text: ...the overlap between civil and military technology...
examples.translation: 民用和军用技术之间的重叠

examples.text: We may begin to discover overlaps.
examples.translation: 我们可能开始发现交叉的部分了。

meanings.meaning: 忽略；俯瞰；远眺；检查；高耸于…之上

examples.text: Pretty and comfortable rooms overlook a flower-filled garden...
examples.translation: 漂亮舒适的房间俯视着花团锦簇的花园。

examples.text: Jack Aldwych lived in a huge, old two-storeyed house overlooking Harbord.
examples.translation: 杰克·阿尔德维奇住在一幢可以看见哈博德的巨大的两层旧房子里。

examples.text: We overlook all sorts of warning signals about our own health.
examples.translation: 我们忽视有关自身健康的种种预警信号。

examples.text: ...a fact that we all tend to overlook.
examples.translation: 我们所有人往往视而不见的事实

examples.text: ...satisfying relationships that enable them to overlook each other's faults.
examples.translation: 能使他们互相包容对方缺点的舒心的关系

examples.text: The weather remained calm overnight...
examples.translation: 整晚都悄然无风。

examples.text: The decision was reached overnight...
examples.translation: 决定是在夜里作出的。

examples.text: Overnight a man died after being shot and wounded yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天一名男子遭枪击受伤，于夜间死亡。

examples.text: Travel and overnight accommodation are included...
examples.translation: 旅行与晚间的食宿包括在内。

examples.text: Overnight buying in the Far East also helped the dollar.
examples.translation: 远东的夜间买入也帮助了美元。

examples.text: The rules are not going to change overnight...
examples.translation: 这些规定不会说变就变。

examples.text: He's realistic enough to know he's not going to succeed overnight...
examples.translation: 他很现实，知道自己的成功不会一蹴而就。

examples.text: Almost overnight, she had aged ten years and become fat.
examples.translation: 她几乎一夜之间老了10岁，人也胖了。

examples.text: In 1970 he became an overnight success in America.
examples.translation: 1970年，他在美国一夜成名。

examples.text: He realized he'd left his overnight bag at Mary's house.
examples.translation: 他意识到自己把过夜包落在玛丽家了。

examples.text: They had told her she would be overnighting in Sydney.
examples.translation: 他们跟她说过她将在悉尼过夜。

examples.text: Overnights can be arranged.
examples.translation: 可以安排过夜。

examples.text: ...a $16 million highway overpass over Route 1.
examples.translation: 造价1,600万美元的1号公路上的上跨公路桥

examples.text: He has returned to South Africa from his long overseas trip.
examples.translation: 他结束了漫长的海外旅行回到南非。

examples.text: ...overseas trade figures.
examples.translation: 海外贸易额

examples.text: If you're staying for more than three months or working overseas, a full 10-year passport is required...
examples.translation: 在国外工作或居留3个月以上，需要持10年期的护照。

examples.text: Much of the investment was overseas.
examples.translation: 大部分均为海外投资。

examples.text: Every year nine million overseas visitors come to London.
examples.translation: 每年有900万外国游客来伦敦观光。

examples.text: When he eventually overtook the last truck he pulled over to the inside lane...
examples.translation: 他终于超过了最后那辆卡车后便驶回了内车道。

examples.text: The red car was pulling out ready to overtake.
examples.translation: 那辆红色汽车驶离车列准备超车。

examples.text: It's the first time at these games that the Americans have overtaken the Cubans...
examples.translation: 这是美国人在这一运动会上首次超越古巴人。

examples.text: Lung cancer has now overtaken breast cancer as a cause of death for women in the US...
examples.translation: 肺癌现在已经取代乳腺癌成为美国女性的一大杀手。

examples.text: Sales are booming in Japan, which has overtaken Britain as the Mini's biggest market.
examples.translation: 迷你车在日本的销量迅猛增长，使日本超过英国成为该车最大的消费市场。

examples.text: Tragedy was shortly to overtake him, however.
examples.translation: 然而，不幸将很快降临到他的头上。

examples.text: Something like panic overtook me...
examples.translation: 一种恐慌的感觉袭裹了我。

examples.text: From the moment Edward had told her of the escape attempt, she had been overtaken by a sense of impending doom.
examples.translation: 自从爱德华告诉她打算逃跑的那一刻起，她便强烈感到厄运在一步步逼近。

examples.text: That government was overthrown in a military coup three years ago.
examples.translation: 那个政府在3年前的军事政变中被推翻。

examples.text: ...an attempt to overthrow the president.
examples.translation: 推翻总统的企图

examples.text: They were charged with plotting the overthrow of the state.
examples.translation: 他们被控阴谋颠覆国家政权。

meanings.meaning: [劳经] 加班时间；延长时间；加时赛

examples.text: He would work overtime, without pay, to finish a job...
examples.translation: 他会为了完成工作无偿加班。

examples.text: Union leaders had urged miners to vote in favour of an overtime ban.
examples.translation: 工会领导人呼吁矿工投票支持加班禁令。

examples.text: We had to battle very hard and our defence worked overtime to keep us in the game...
examples.translation: 我们不得不奋力搏杀；为保证我们不被淘汰出局，防守队员拼尽了全力。

examples.text: She works overtime with her vacuum cleaner to keep grit out of the kitchen.
examples.translation: 她动用真空吸尘器力争不让厨房出现沙砾。

examples.text: Denver had won the championship by defeating the Cleveland Browns 23-20 in overtime.
examples.translation: 丹佛队在加时赛中以23比20击败克利夫兰布朗队夺得冠军。

examples.text: The lorry veered out of control, overturned and smashed into a wall...
examples.translation: 卡车突然失控，翻倒撞上了一堵墙。

examples.text: Alex jumped up so violently that he overturned his glass of sherry...
examples.translation: 亚历克斯一下子暴跳起来，结果把他那杯雪利酒都打翻了。

examples.text: A dozen cartons of books had been overturned and strewn about the floor.
examples.translation: 十几个装书的纸箱都被倒空，乱扔了一地。

examples.text: ...a battered overturned boat.
examples.translation: 千疮百孔的倾覆的小船

examples.text: When the Russian parliament overturned his decision, he backed down...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯议会推翻了他的决定，他只好作罢。

examples.text: His nine-month sentence was overturned by Appeal Court judge Lord Justice Watkins.
examples.translation: 上诉法院法官沃特金斯撤销了对他作出的9个月徒刑的判决。

examples.text: He accused his opponents of wanting to overturn the government.
examples.translation: 他指责反对派企图颠覆政府。

examples.text: ...a society where all the old values had been overturned.
examples.translation: 摒弃了所有旧价值观的社会

meanings.meaning: 淹没；压倒；受打击；覆盖；压垮

examples.text: He was overwhelmed by a longing for times past...
examples.translation: 他一心渴望回到从前。

examples.text: The need to talk to someone, anyone, overwhelmed her.
examples.translation: 她迫不及待地要找个人说说话，随便是谁都行。

examples.text: Sightseers may be a little overwhelmed by the crowds and noise.
examples.translation: 拥挤的人群和喧闹的噪音可能会让游客有些茫然不知所措。

examples.text: It was clear that one massive Allied offensive would overwhelm the weakened enemy.
examples.translation: 毫无疑问，盟军一次大规模的进攻就会击溃已是强弩之末的敌军。

examples.text: The task won't feel so overwhelming if you break it down into small, easy-to-accomplish steps...
examples.translation: 如果将这个任务细分为简单易行的若干步骤来做，便不会感到如此无所适从。

examples.text: She felt an overwhelming desire to have another child.
examples.translation: 她一心想再要一个孩子。

examples.text: Women of his own middle class found him overwhelmingly attractive.
examples.translation: 同属中产阶级的女性觉得他的魅力令人难以抗拒。

examples.text: ...the overwhelmingly strange medieval city of Fès.
examples.translation: 极为奇特的中世纪城市非斯

examples.text: The overwhelming majority of small businesses go broke within the first twenty-four months...
examples.translation: 绝大多数小企业在头两年内就破产了。

examples.text: The party won an overwhelming victory in Burma's general elections last May...
examples.translation: 去年5月，该党在缅甸大选中获得了压倒性的胜利。

examples.text: The vote was overwhelming — 283 in favour, and only twenty-nine against.
examples.translation: 投票的结果是压倒性的——283票支持，只有29票反对。

examples.text: The House of Commons has overwhelmingly rejected calls to bring back the death penalty for murder...
examples.translation: 下议院以压倒性的多数驳回了对谋杀罪恢复死刑判决的呼吁。

examples.text: Although things are changing the medical establishment is still overwhelmingly male.
examples.translation: 虽然世易时移，但医学界依然是男性的天下。

meanings.meaning: 欠；感激；应给予；应该把……归功于

examples.text: The company owes money to more than 60 banks...
examples.translation: 这家公司欠下60多家银行的债。

examples.text: Blake already owed him nearly £50...
examples.translation: 布莱克已经欠他将近50英镑了。

examples.text: I'm broke, Livy, and I owe a couple of million dollars...
examples.translation: 我破产了，莉薇，而且我欠了几百万美元的债。

examples.text: He could take what was owing for the rent.
examples.translation: 他可以把自己欠的钱抵作对方的租金。

examples.text: I always suspected she owed her first job to her friendship with Roger...
examples.translation: 我一直怀疑她仗着自己是罗杰的朋友才得到第一份工作。

examples.text: He owed his survival to his strength as a swimmer...
examples.translation: 他是因为水性好才幸免于难的。

examples.text: The fruit owes its extraordinary aroma to a mixture of three main chemicals...
examples.translation: 这种水果独特的芳香来自于3种主要化学物质的混合。

examples.text: The city essentially owes its fame and beauty to the Moors who transformed it into the Muslim capital of Spain...
examples.translation: 该城的声名与美丽基本上要归功于将它变成西班牙穆斯林之都的摩尔人。

examples.text: I owe him my life.
examples.translation: 我能活下来全亏了他。

examples.text: As a professional composer I owe much to Radio 3...
examples.translation: 作为一名职业作曲家，我十分感激第三电台。

examples.text: He's been fantastic. I owe him a lot.
examples.translation: 他真是个大好人，我欠他太多了。

examples.text: The island's present economy owes a good deal to whisky distilling...
examples.translation: 该岛当前的经济发展主要归功于蒸馏法酿造威士忌酒行业。

examples.text: Mrs Allen's style of cooking owes much to her mother-in-law.
examples.translation: 艾伦太太的烹饪风格很大程度上承传于她的婆婆。

examples.text: Perhaps we owe these people more respect...
examples.translation: 也许我们应该给予这些人更多的尊重。

examples.text: I owe you an apology. You must have found my attitude very annoying...
examples.translation: 我应该向你道歉。你一定觉得我的态度很恶劣吧。

examples.text: I owe a big debt of gratitude to her.
examples.translation: 我对她万分感激。

examples.text: I can't go. I owe it to him to stay...
examples.translation: 我不能走。看在他的分上我也该留下来。

examples.text: You owe it to yourself to get some professional help...
examples.translation: 你应该为了自己寻求专业人士的帮助。

examples.text: Of course she would have to send a letter; she owed it to the family.
examples.translation: 她当然必须寄封信回去，跟家里联系是应该的。

examples.text: He was out of work owing to a physical injury...
examples.translation: 他因为受伤而失业了。

examples.translation: 海鸥的鸣叫声给这片海港带来了迷人的独特气息。

examples.text: He lives on his own...

examples.translation: 孩子能独立完成的事情

examples.translation: 他大摇大摆地在镇上四处晃悠，好像这是他的地盘。

examples.translation: 宠物的主人都知道它们有自己的个性。

examples.translation: 新业主要等到9月份才能入住。

examples.translation: 1月23日，美国决定放宽对外国持有美国航空公司所有权的管制规定。

examples.translation: 英国拥有房屋者人数的增加

examples.text: Many people were not satisfied with the pace of change.

examples.translation: 乐于放慢生活节奏的人

examples.translation: 他们无法忍受那种节奏和工作负荷。

examples.translation: 随着复苏的加速，利率会降下来。

examples.translation: 他沿着圣安托万街轻快地走去。

examples.translation: 走近自己的车时，他们加快了脚步。

examples.translation: 他只走了几步远就又停了下来。

examples.translation: 我往后退了一步。

examples.translation: 他们等的时候，克拉维斯在屋里不安地踱来踱去。

examples.translation: 他发现约翰在公寓里来回踱步，无法入睡。

examples.translation: 他来回走着，咆哮着，她目不转睛地看着。

examples.translation: 这是场艰苦的比赛，我不得不控制好节奏。

examples.translation: 农民们很气愤，因为提价赶不上通货膨胀。

examples.translation: 世界变化得太快，她跟不上

examples.translation: 还剩4圈的时候，他紧紧咬住领先者。

examples.translation: 黛西在她身边大步走着，大口喘着气，但是没有落后。

examples.text: The computer will give students the opportunity to learn at their own pace...
examples.translation: 计算机让学生们有机会按照自己的节奏学习。

examples.text: She was going too fast so I decided to keep riding at my own pace.
examples.translation: 她骑得太快了，所以我决定按自己的速度骑。

examples.text: The British coach is putting the boxers through their paces...
examples.translation: 英国教练正在检验拳手们的能力。

examples.translation: 一队世界上最优秀的滑水运动员将一展身手。

examples.text: He withdrew the needle and placed a pad of cotton-wool over the spot.
examples.translation: 他把针头拔出，在扎针处按了一块药棉。

examples.translation: 有肩垫的印花裙子

examples.translation: 她写在了便笺簿上。

examples.translation: 准备好铅笔和便笺簿，把你的一些想法记下来。

examples.translation: “给你票，”他说着，从票本上把票撕了下来。

examples.translation: 轻步快速穿过街道的狗

examples.text: I often bumped into him as he padded the corridors.
examples.translation: 他在走廊里轻轻地走过时，我常常碰见他。

examples.translation: 小型圆形直升机停机坪

examples.text: ...a landing pad on the back of the ship...
examples.translation: 船尾的停机坪

examples.text: Journalists report seeing a fire on the pad after the launch.
examples.translation: 记者们报道说在发射后看到发射台着火了。

examples.translation: 我绕过大房子走向我的公寓。

examples.translation: 否则我不会想到给自己找一套单身公寓。

examples.translation: 用手指头肚儿轻拍脸颊一遍。

examples.translation: 用枕头垫一下汽车坐椅靠背。

examples.text: I can tell you I always padded my bras.
examples.translation: 我可以告诉你我的内衣一直装衬垫的。

examples.text: ...a padded jacket.
examples.translation: 夹袄

examples.text: ...backrests padded with camel's wool.
examples.translation: 用骆驼绒填充的靠垫

meanings.meaning: 使失色；使变苍白；用栅栏围

examples.text: Migrating birds filled the pale sky...
examples.translation: 灰白的天空中满是迁徙的飞鸟。

examples.text: As we age, our skin becomes paler.
examples.translation: 随着年龄的增长，我们的皮肤愈见苍白。

examples.text: ...a circle of pale light.
examples.translation: 淡淡的光晕

examples.text: ...a pale blue sailor dress...
examples.translation: 浅蓝色水手服

examples.text: In the background, dressed in pale green, stood Eunice.
examples.translation: 尤妮斯穿着浅绿色的衣服站在后面不起眼的地方。

examples.text: She looked pale and tired...
examples.translation: 她看起来脸色苍白憔悴。

examples.text: He went deathly pale.
examples.translation: 他面如死灰。

examples.text: ...his paleness when he realized that he was bleeding.
examples.translation: 他意识到自己在流血时的苍白脸色

examples.text: When someone you love has a life-threatening illness, everything else pales in comparison.
examples.translation: 你爱的人得了致命疾病时，其他一切事情都显得不那么重要了。

examples.text: ...a soap opera against which other soaps pale into insignificance.
examples.translation: 让其他同类剧相形见绌的肥皂剧

examples.text: This sort of thing really is quite beyond the pale.
examples.translation: 这种事情真是不可接受。

examples.text: ...beyond the pale of acceptable human behaviour.
examples.translation: 超出可接受的人类行为的范围

meanings.meaning: (Palm)人名；(英)帕姆；(瑞典)帕尔姆；(法、德、俄、捷、芬、挪)帕尔姆

examples.text: Dornberg slapped the table with the palm of his hand...
examples.translation: 多恩伯格用手拍着桌子。

examples.text: He wiped his sweaty palm.
examples.translation: 他擦了擦满是汗水的手掌。

examples.text: Johnson thought he had the board of directors in the palm of his hand...
examples.translation: 约翰逊以为自己完全掌控了董事会。

examples.text: They held his fate in the palms of their ancient hands.
examples.translation: 他们这些老人将他的命运掌握在手心里。

meanings.meaning: 平底锅；盘状的器皿；淘盘子，金盘，秤盘

examples.text: Heat the butter and oil in a large pan.
examples.translation: 把黄油和食用油放到大平底锅里加热。

examples.text: His first high-budget movie, called 'Brain Donors', was panned by the critics.
examples.translation: 他的第一部高成本制作电影《撞板三舞男》遭到恶评。

examples.text: The camera panned along the line of players...
examples.translation: 摄像机沿着那排选手移动拍摄。

examples.text: He panned over the crowd for a few minutes before swivelling back to the right...
examples.translation: 他从头到尾移动拍摄了那群人好几分钟，才转回右侧。

examples.text: A television camera panned the stadium...
examples.translation: 一台电视摄像机摇摄整座体育场。

examples.text: He panned the camera, giving a sense of motion.
examples.translation: 他用摄像机移动拍摄，营造一种运动的效果。

examples.text: People came westward in the 1800s to pan for gold...
examples.translation: 在19世纪，人们前往西部淘金。

examples.translation: 每年他们淘出大约1.5吨金子。

meanings.meaning: 仪表板；嵌板；座谈小组，全体陪审员

examples.text: He assembled a panel of scholars to advise him...
examples.translation: 他组织了一个学者小组为他出谋划策。

examples.text: All the writers on the panel agreed Quinn's book should be singled out for special praise...
examples.translation: 专门小组的所有作家一致认为奎因的书应该单独挑出来予以特别表扬。

examples.text: The advisory panel disagreed with the decision.
examples.translation: 顾问小组不同意该决定。

examples.text: ...the frosted glass panel set in the centre of the door.
examples.translation: 门中间镶嵌的磨砂玻璃板

examples.text: The equipment was extremely sophisticated and was monitored from a central control-panel...
examples.translation: 这台设备极为复杂，由中央控制面板进行监控。

examples.text: They had failed to recognise signs on their instrument panel indicating a serious problem.
examples.translation: 他们没有注意到仪表板上显示的重大故障信号。

examples.text: An earthquake hit the capital, causing panic among the population...
examples.translation: 首都发生了地震，引发民众恐慌。

examples.text: I phoned the doctor in a panic, crying that I'd lost the baby.
examples.translation: 我惊慌失措地给医生打电话，哭着说我的孩子没了。

examples.text: There was a moment of panic in Britain as it became clear just how vulnerable the nation was...
examples.translation: 一时间，英国出现了大恐慌，因为人们清楚地看到了英国有多么不堪一击。

examples.text: I'm in a panic about getting everything done in time...
examples.translation: 我一阵手忙脚乱，想及时做完所有事情。

examples.text: The policy announcement caused panic buying of petrol.
examples.translation: 那则政策公告引发了汽油抢购风潮。

examples.text: Guests panicked and screamed when the bomb exploded...
examples.translation: 炸弹爆炸后，客人们惊慌失措，尖声惊叫。

examples.text: The unexpected and sudden memory briefly panicked her...
examples.translation: 突然间莫名涌起的回忆让她心头一紧。

examples.text: She refused to be panicked into a hasty marriage.
examples.translation: 她不愿因恐慌而仓促结婚。

examples.translation: 霍顿向外望去，肥沃的谷地和平缓的丘陵尽收眼底。

examples.text: ...a gripping panorama of medieval history.
examples.translation: 引人入胜的中世纪史概论

meanings.meaning: 喘息；渴望；气喘吁吁地说出某事

examples.translation: 她爬得很快，结果累得气喘吁吁。

examples.translation: 我们都喜欢乘坐游乐场那些让人毛发直竖的游乐设施，把自己吓得魂不附体。

meanings.meaning: 贴糊墙纸；发交通违章传票

examples.text: He wrote his name down on a piece of paper for me...
examples.translation: 他把他的名字写在一张纸上交给我。

examples.translation: 她拿着纸笔坐在桌旁。

examples.translation: 漂亮的包装纸

examples.text: ...a paper bag.

examples.translation: 我或许能在村子里找到一份报纸。

examples.text: I'll cook and you read the paper.
examples.translation: 我做饭，你看报纸。

examples.text: You can't believe everything you read in the paper...
examples.translation: 报纸上看到的东西不能全信。

examples.translation: 报纸上有很多关于继子女所面临的问题的报道。

examples.translation: 她的资料包括未发表的文章和信件。

examples.translation: 一位被警察拦下的摩洛哥青年拒绝出示他的证件。

examples.text: They have arrested four people who were trying to leave the country with forged papers.
examples.translation: 他们已经逮捕了4名企图利用伪造证件离境的人。

examples.text: He just published a paper in the journal Nature analyzing the fires.
examples.translation: 他刚刚在《自然》杂志上发表了一篇分析火灾的论文。

examples.text: ...the ten common errors that appear most frequently in student papers.
examples.translation: 学生论文中最常见的10个错误

examples.text: We sat each paper in the Hall...
examples.translation: 我们每一场考试都是在大厅里考的。

examples.text: She finished the exam paper.
examples.translation: 她答完了考卷。

examples.text: ...the applied mathematics paper.
examples.translation: 应用数学试卷

examples.text: ...a new government paper on European policy.
examples.translation: 有关欧洲政策的新政府文件

examples.text: They expressed deep mistrust of the paper promises...
examples.translation: 他们对书面承诺表现出极度的不信任。

examples.text: We're looking for people who have experience rather than paper qualifications.
examples.translation: 我们要找有经验的人，而不是有文凭的人。

examples.text: We papered all four bedrooms...
examples.translation: 我们把4个卧室都贴了墙纸。

examples.text: We have papered this bedroom in softest grey...
examples.translation: 我们给这个卧室贴上了极柔和的灰色壁纸。

examples.text: The room was strange, the walls half papered, half painted.
examples.translation: 那个房间很奇怪，墙壁一半贴壁纸，一半刷涂料。

examples.text: It is important to get something down on paper...
examples.translation: 把一些东西写在纸上很重要。

examples.text: It was the first time I had put it all down on paper. I found it helped.
examples.translation: 这是我第一次把所有的东西都写在纸上，我觉得这有帮助。

examples.text: On paper, I am the healthiest man alive, yet I feel permanently unwell.
examples.translation: 理论上，我是活着的最健康的人，但是我总感觉不舒服。

examples.text: The family is estimated to have been worth, on paper at least, more than £1.1billion.
examples.translation: 据估计，这个家族理论上至少拥有11亿英镑以上的财富。

examples.text: She said she would buy the book when it comes out in paperback.
examples.translation: 她说等那本书出平装本时再买。

examples.text: They fell 41,000 ft. before opening their parachutes...
examples.translation: 他们下降了41,000英尺后才拉开伞。

examples.text: UN troops could be landed by helicopter or even by parachute.
examples.translation: 联合国部队可以乘直升机着陆，甚至可以伞降。

examples.translation: 他空降进入。

examples.translation: 飞机将食品、衣物、毯子、药品和水空投到崎岖多山的边界地区。

examples.translation: 补给物资被空投到山区。

examples.translation: 空降到公司协助制定战略思想的顾问

examples.translation: 18个月前，人们普遍猜测前外交大臣可能会空降至苏格兰议会。

examples.text: A military parade marched slowly and solemnly down Pennsylvania Avenue.
examples.translation: 阅兵队列沿宾夕法尼亚大道缓慢而庄严地行进。

examples.translation: 逾4,000名陆、海、空三军将士在香榭丽舍大街游行。

examples.text: Everybody was beginning to parade back to the village.
examples.translation: 大家开始成群结队地返回村庄。

examples.text: He had them on parade at six o'clock in the morning...
examples.translation: 他让他们早晨6点列队接受检阅。

examples.text: Morning parade was in progress on the parade ground.
examples.translation: 阅兵场正在进行早间检阅。

examples.text: Banners were paraded from church to church on feast days.
examples.translation: 宗教节日期间，人们打着横幅在教堂间游行。

examples.text: Five leading fighter pilots have been captured and paraded before the media.
examples.translation: 有5名一流的战斗机飞行员被俘，并被在媒体上曝光。

examples.text: Children are paraded on television alongside the party leaders to win votes.
examples.translation: 为了拉选票，孩子们被拉去和政党领袖们一起出现在电视上。

examples.text: Valentino is keen to see celebrities parading his clothes at big occasions.
examples.translation: 瓦伦蒂诺喜欢看名人在重大场合展示他设计的服装。

examples.text: I love to put on a bathing suit and parade on the beach...
examples.translation: 我喜欢穿着泳衣在海滩上招摇而行。

examples.text: They danced and paraded around.
examples.translation: 他们跳着舞，四下招摇。

examples.text: They parade their virtuous beliefs and hide their vices...
examples.translation: 他们大秀美德并掩盖自己的罪恶。

examples.text: Women were not supposed to parade their ambition nakedly.
examples.translation: 女性被认为不应该赤裸裸地展示其雄心。

examples.text: The Chancellor will be able to parade his cut in interest rates as a small victory...
examples.translation: 财政大臣就能把他的减息举措当作一场小胜来夸耀了。

examples.text: She might have been paraded as a woman who was working hard to change her ways.
examples.translation: 她可能已经被吹嘘成一个靠努力工作改变命运的女人了。

examples.text: ...all the fashions that parade as modern movements in art.
examples.translation: 标榜为现代艺术运动的所有流行时尚

examples.text: When I ask Nick about his childhood, he remembers a parade of babysitters.
examples.translation: 我问到尼克的童年生活时，他记起了一个又一个保姆。

examples.text: ...an endless parade of advertisements.
examples.translation: 没完没了的广告

examples.translation: 南海克拉伦斯商业街皇后酒店

examples.text: ...a new paradigm of production.
examples.translation: 新的生产范式

examples.text: He had become the paradigm of the successful man.
examples.translation: 他已经成为成功人士的典范。

meanings.meaning: 悖论，反论；似非而是的论点；自相矛盾的人或事

examples.text: The paradox is that the region's most dynamic economies have the most primitive financial systems...
examples.translation: 矛盾之处在于这个地区最有活力的经济体却有着最落后的金融体系。

examples.text: The paradox of exercise is that while using a lot of energy it seems to generate more...
examples.translation: 锻炼奇怪的地方在于它会越活动越有劲。

examples.text: Death itself is a paradox, the end yet the beginning.
examples.translation: 死亡本身就是自相矛盾的，既是终结也是开始。

examples.text: The story contains many levels of paradox...
examples.translation: 这个故事存在多重悖论。

examples.text: Although I'm so successful I'm really rather a failure. That's a paradox, isn't it?
examples.translation: 虽然我非常成功，可事实上我却是个相当失败的人。这句话自相矛盾，是吧？

examples.text: The length of a paragraph depends on the information it conveys...
examples.translation: 段落的长度取决于它所传达的信息。

examples.text: Paragraph 81 sets out the rules that should apply if a gift is accepted.
examples.translation: 第81节列出了接受礼物后应该遵循的规定。

examples.text: Readers familiar with English history will find a vague parallel to the suppression of the monasteries...
examples.translation: 熟悉英国历史的读者会发现这与镇压修道院略有相似之处。

examples.text: It's an ecological disaster with no parallel anywhere else in the world.
examples.translation: 这是一场在世界其他地方都没有出现过的生态灾难。

examples.text: ...an achievement without parallel in the modern era.
examples.translation: 现代无可比拟的成就

examples.text: Detailed study of folk music from a variety of countries reveals many close parallels...
examples.translation: 仔细研究各国民间音乐后发现了许多非常相似之处。

examples.text: There are significant parallels with the 1980s...
