examples.translation: 他母亲死后留给他一小笔遗产。

examples.text: These powers were eventually passed to municipalities.
examples.translation: 这些权力最终移交给了各市当局。

examples.text: ...a genetic trait, which can be passed from one generation to the next.
examples.translation: 能够从一代传到下一代的基因特征

examples.text: Officials failed to pass vital information to their superiors...
examples.translation: 官员们没有将重要信息汇报给他们的上司。

examples.text: He passed the letters to the Department of Trade and Industry.
examples.translation: 他把信交给了贸工部。

examples.text: I do not know what to do with the information if I cannot pass it on...
examples.translation: 如果我不能把这些信息传出去，我该如何是好。

examples.text: From time to time he passed on confidential information to him...
examples.translation: 他时不时告诉他一些机密信息。

examples.text: He has written a note asking me to pass on his thanks.
examples.translation: 他写了张便条让我转达他的谢意。

examples.text: Your partner should then pass the ball back to you...
examples.translation: 然后你的搭档应该将球回传给你。

examples.text: Dodd passed back to Flowers.
examples.translation: 多德把球回传给弗劳尔斯。

examples.text: Hirst rolled a short pass to Merson.
examples.translation: 赫斯特将球短传给默森。

examples.text: He couldn't imagine why he had let so much time pass without contacting her...
examples.translation: 他想不通自己为什么过了那么长时间还没有和她联系。

examples.text: As the years passed he felt trapped by certain realities of marriage...
examples.translation: 随着岁月的流逝，他觉得受困于婚姻的某些现实问题。

examples.text: Several minutes passed before the girls were noticed.
examples.translation: 过了几分钟那些女孩才引起注意。

examples.text: The children passed the time playing in the streets...
examples.translation: 那些孩子在街上玩耍打发时间。

examples.text: To pass the time they sang songs and played cards.
examples.translation: 他们靠唱歌、打牌来打发时间。

examples.text: The country was passing through a grave crisis...
examples.translation: 那个国家正在经历一场严重危机。

examples.text: 'Have you ever been at all religious?' — 'No. I never passed through that phase.'
examples.translation: “你信过教吗？”——“没有，我从没有信过。”

examples.text: They became the first company in their field to pass the £2 billion turn-over mark.
examples.translation: 他们成为自己所在领域中首家营业额超过20亿英镑的公司。

examples.text: Kevin has just passed his driving test...
examples.translation: 凯文刚刚通过驾照考试。

examples.text: ...new drugs which have passed early tests to show that they are safe...
examples.translation: 通过早期测试显示其具有安全性的新药

examples.text: I didn't pass.
examples.translation: 我考试没有通过。

examples.text: An A-level pass in Biology is preferred for all courses...
examples.translation: 不管读什么课程，生物学高级证书考试最好都要及格。

examples.text: Passes are graded from 'A' down to 'E'.
examples.translation: 及格分为A到E几等。

examples.text: Several popular beaches were found unfit for bathing although the government passed them last year...
examples.translation: 有几家火爆的海滨浴场被查出不适于游泳，但是去年政府却宣布他们合格。

examples.text: The medical board would not pass him fit for General Service.
examples.translation: 医疗卫生委员会不会批准他为全科医生。

examples.text: The Estonian parliament has passed a resolution declaring the republic fully independent...
examples.translation: 爱沙尼亚议会已经通过了宣布共和国完全独立的决议。

examples.text: Race Relations Acts were passed in 1968 and 1976.
examples.translation: 1968年和1976年通过了《种族关系法》。

examples.text: Passing sentence, the judge said it all had the appearance of a con trick...
examples.translation: 宣布判决时，法官称其完全符合诈骗案的要素。

examples.text: Before sentence was passed, Mr Mills escaped from jail.
examples.translation: 在宣判前，米尔斯先生越狱了。

examples.text: I don't really know so I could not pass comment on that...
examples.translation: 我不了解实情，所以我不能就此发表意见。

examples.text: We passed a few remarks about the weather.
examples.translation: 我们聊了几句天气。

examples.text: This practice embarrassed Luther, but he let it pass without comment...
examples.translation: 这种做法让卢瑟难堪，但是他未置一词。

examples.text: The cocktails were so sweet that the strength of them might pass unnoticed until it was too late.
examples.translation: 这些鸡尾酒太好喝了，等你感受到酒劲时可能为时已晚。

examples.text: Children's toy guns now look so realistic that they can often pass for the real thing...
examples.translation: 现在的儿童玩具枪看起来过于逼真，以至常常被误认作真枪。

examples.text: It is doubtful whether Ted, even with his fluent French, passed for one of the locals.
examples.translation: 尽管特德能说一口流利的法语，但他是否会被当成当地人仍值得怀疑。

examples.text: ...a woman passing as a man.
examples.translation: 被误认作男人的女人

examples.text: I think I'll pass on the hiking next time...
examples.translation: 我想远足的事下次再说吧。

examples.text: 'You can join us if you like.' Brad shook his head. 'I'll pass, thanks.'
examples.translation: “你要乐意，可以加入我们。”布拉德摇了摇头。“下次吧，谢谢。”

examples.text: A sensitive bladder can make you feel the need to pass water frequently.
examples.translation: 敏感性膀胱让你有尿频感。

examples.text: I got myself a pass into the barracks...
examples.translation: 我弄到了进兵营的通行证。

examples.text: Malaysian Railways has a rail pass for foreign visitors: 10 days' unlimited travel costs around £53.
examples.translation: 马来西亚铁路公司有专为外国游客准备的铁路乘车证：十日不限次乘车大约花费53英镑。

examples.text: The monastery is in a remote mountain pass.
examples.translation: 那个修道院在一个偏远的山口中。

examples.text: Nancy wasn't sure if Dirk was making a pass at her.
examples.translation: 南希不确定德克是不是在勾引她。

examples.text: Harry stepped into the passage and closed the door behind him.
examples.translation: 哈里走进过道，随手关上了门。

examples.text: ...up some stairs and along a narrow passage towards a door.
examples.translation: 上几级楼梯，沿着一条狭窄的走廊来到一个门口

examples.text: He reads a passage from Milton.
examples.translation: 他读了一节弥尔顿的诗。

examples.text: ...the passage in which Blake spoke of the world of imagination...
examples.translation: 布莱克谈及幻想世界的那一段

examples.text: Compare the following passages.
examples.translation: 比较下列片段。

examples.text: ...cells that line the air passages.
examples.translation: 气管内壁上的细胞

examples.text: ...blocked nasal passages.
examples.translation: 堵塞了的鼻腔

examples.text: He cleared a passage for himself through the crammed streets...
examples.translation: 他在拥挤的街道上挤出了一条通路。

examples.text: Two men suddenly elbowed a passage through the shoppers.
examples.translation: 两名男子突然用肘在购物者中挤出一条路。

examples.text: Germany had not requested Franco's consent for the passage of troops through Spain...
examples.translation: 德国没有征求佛朗哥的同意便让军队通过了西班牙。

examples.text: The passage of heat through rock is extremely slow.
examples.translation: 热在岩石中传导得极慢。

examples.text: ...to ease their passage to a market economy.
examples.translation: 使他们更顺利地过渡到市场经济

examples.text: ...the passage from school to college.
examples.translation: 从中学到大学的过渡

examples.text: It's been 200 years since the passage of the Bill of Rights.
examples.translation: 《人权法案》通过已经200年了。

examples.text: An asset that increases in value with the passage of time.
examples.translation: 价值与日俱增的资产

examples.text: ...after the passage of eighteen months.
examples.translation: 18个月过去后

examples.text: We'd arrived the day before after a 10-hour passage from Swansea.
examples.translation: 从斯旺西出发航行10小时后，我们于前天到达。

examples.text: Mr Thomas would be given safe passage to and from Jaffna...
examples.translation: 托马斯先生可以安全地往来于贾夫纳。

examples.text: You may have free passage across our territory whenever you require it.
examples.translation: 无论你什么时候需要，都可以自由穿过我们的领地。

meanings.meaning: 旅客；乘客；过路人；碍手碍脚的人

examples.text: Mr Fullemann was a passenger in the car when it crashed.
examples.translation: 出车祸时，福勒曼先生正在那辆车上。

examples.text: ...a flight from Milan with more than forty passengers on board.
examples.translation: 搭载着四十多名乘客的米兰来的航班

examples.text: I sat in the passenger seat.
examples.translation: 我坐在乘客座位上。

examples.text: ...a passenger train.
examples.translation: 客运列车

examples.text: A passer-by described what he saw moments after the car bomb had exploded...
examples.translation: 一位过路人描述了汽车炸弹爆炸后他看到的情形。

examples.text: I went and sat in a cafe and watched the passers-by.
examples.translation: 我走进一家咖啡馆坐下，望着来往的路人。

examples.text: ...my passion for a dark-haired, slender boy named James.
examples.translation: 我对一个名叫詹姆斯的黑头发高挑个儿男孩的热恋

examples.text: ...the expression of love and passion.
examples.translation: 爱和情欲的表达

examples.text: ...Maggy, the object of his passions.
examples.translation: 玛吉，他热恋的对象

examples.text: He spoke with great passion.
examples.translation: 他发表了热情洋溢的讲话。

examples.text: ...the passion and commitment of the Republican candidate.
examples.translation: 共和党候选人的激情和奉献精神

examples.text: She had a passion for gardening...
examples.translation: 她酷爱园艺。

examples.text: His other great passion was Italy.
examples.translation: 他酷爱的另一个国家是意大利。

meanings.meaning: 被动的，消极的；被动语态的

examples.text: His passive attitude made things easier for me...
examples.translation: 他顺从的态度让我做起事来要轻松些。

examples.text: Even passive acceptance of the regime was a kind of collaboration.
examples.translation: 即使被动接受该政权也是一种通敌行为。

examples.text: He sat there passively, content to wait for his father to make the opening move.
examples.translation: 他温顺地坐在那里，心满意足地等着他父亲走第一步棋。

examples.text: ...the passivity of the public under the military occupation.
examples.translation: 军事占领下公众的顺从

examples.text: They want less passive ways of filling their time.
examples.translation: 他们想找些更为积极的方式来打发时间。

examples.text: ...the passive enjoyment one gets from looking at a painting or sculpture.
examples.translation: 观看绘画或雕塑获得的被动享受

examples.text: They made it clear that they would only exercise passive resistance in the event of a military takeover.
examples.translation: 他们声明一旦发生军事接管，他们只会采取非暴力抵抗。

examples.text: You should take your passport with you when changing money.
examples.translation: 兑换货币时应该带着护照。

examples.text: ...a South African businessman travelling on a British passport.
examples.translation: 持英国护照旅行的南非商人

examples.text: Victory would give him a passport to the riches he craves...
examples.translation: 胜利将使他有机会获得自己梦寐以求的财富。

examples.text: If the interview goes well it could be the passport to an exciting new career.
examples.translation: 面试顺利的话，将获得令人兴奋的新工作。

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, past is used in the phrasal verb ‘run past’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，past还可以用于短语动词run past。

examples.text: He should learn from the mistakes of the past. We have been here before...
examples.translation: 他应该从过去的错误中吸取教训。我们有过同样的经历。

examples.text: We would like to put the past behind us.
examples.translation: 我们想抛开过去。

examples.text: What was the point in living in the past, thinking about what had or had not happened?
examples.translation: 老是生活在过去，想着曾经发生过，或是没有发生过什么，有什么意义？

examples.text: ...revelations about his past.
examples.translation: 曝光他的过去

examples.text: ...Germany's recent past.
examples.translation: 德国不久前的过去

examples.text: I knew from past experience that alternative therapies could help...
examples.translation: 根据过去的经验，我知道替代疗法可能有用。

examples.text: ...a return to the turbulence of past centuries...
examples.translation: 回到过去几个世纪的动荡状态

examples.text: The list of past champions includes many British internationals.
examples.translation: 历届冠军榜中包括很多英国世界冠军。

examples.text: A South Korean newspaper said today the event will be smaller than in years past.
examples.translation: 一份韩国报纸今天说活动的规模不会有前些年那么大。

examples.text: Most shops have remained closed for the past three days.
examples.translation: 过去3天大多数商店一直都没有营业。

examples.text: ...the momentous events of the past few days.
examples.translation: 过去几天的重大事件

examples.text: Many economists believe the worst of the economic downturn is past.
examples.translation: 很多经济学家认为经济衰退最糟糕的时期已经过去了。

examples.text: ...images from years long past...
examples.translation: 很多年以前的形象

examples.text: The time for loyalty is past.
examples.translation: 忠诚已经过时了。

examples.text: It's ten past eleven...
examples.translation: 现在是11点过10分。

examples.text: I arrived at half past ten.
examples.translation: 我10点半到的。

examples.text: I have my lunch at half past.
examples.translation: 我半点的时候吃午饭。

examples.text: It was past midnight...
examples.translation: 午夜已过。

examples.text: It's past your bedtime.
examples.translation: 你的就寝时间已经过了。

examples.text: I dashed past him and out of the door...
examples.translation: 我从他身边跑过，夺门而出。

examples.text: A steady procession of people filed past the coffin...
examples.translation: 人们排成一队，一个接一个地从灵柩旁走过。

examples.text: He was never able to get past the border guards.
examples.translation: 他从未能够通过边防哨兵的检查。

examples.text: An ambulance drove past.
examples.translation: 一辆救护车开了过去。

examples.text: She stared past Christine at the bed.
examples.translation: 她的目光越过克里斯蒂娜盯着床。

examples.text: Go north on I-15 to the exit just past Barstow...
examples.translation: 沿着15号州际公路一直向北，一过巴斯托就从出口驶出。

examples.text: Just past the Barlby roundabout there's temporary traffic lights.
examples.translation: 在刚过巴尔比环岛的地方，有一个临时红绿灯。

examples.text: He was well past retirement age...
examples.translation: 他早过了退休年龄。

examples.text: They felt that, at 69 or so, Mr Peters was past his prime.
examples.translation: 他们觉得69岁左右的彼得斯先生已经风光不再了。

examples.text: ...a piece of cheese four weeks past its sell-by date...
examples.translation: 一块过期4周的奶酪

examples.text: The situation is long past the stage when anyone's advice would help.
examples.translation: 情况早变了，不是谁提个建议就能补救的事儿。

examples.text: She was past caring about anything by then and just wanted the pain to end...
examples.translation: 那时，她已经什么都不在乎了，只盼着疼痛能够止住。

examples.text: Often by the time they do accept the truth they are past being able to put words to feelings.
examples.translation: 往往等他们真正接受事实时，他们已无法用语言形容自己的感情了。

examples.text: I suppose they're saying that I'm past it...
examples.translation: 我猜想他们是在说我已经力不从心了。

examples.text: We could do with a new car. The one we've got is a bit past it.
examples.translation: 我们可以弄辆新车，现在那辆已经不太好使了。

examples.text: You know what she's like. I wouldn't put it past her to call the police and say I stole them.
examples.translation: 你知道她是个什么样的人。要是她打电话报警说我偷了它们，一点儿也不奇怪。

meanings.meaning: 面团，膏；糊状物，[胶粘] 浆糊

examples.text: He then sticks it back together with flour paste...
examples.translation: 然后他用面糊把它重新粘了起来。

examples.text: Blend a little milk with the custard powder to form a paste.
examples.translation: 往蛋奶沙司粉里加入一点儿牛奶，搅成糊糊。

examples.text: ...wallpaper paste.
examples.translation: 壁纸糨糊

examples.text: ...tomato paste.
examples.translation: 番茄酱

examples.text: ...fish paste sandwiches.
examples.translation: 鱼酱三明治

examples.text: ...pasting labels on bottles...
examples.translation: 把商标贴在瓶子上

examples.text: Activists pasted up posters criticizing the leftist leaders.
examples.translation: 激进分子张贴起海报批评左翼领袖。

examples.text: ...paste emeralds.
examples.translation: 铅玻璃翡翠

examples.text: His favourite pastime is golf.
examples.translation: 他最喜欢的消遣是打高尔夫。

examples.text: The cows are out now, grazing in the pasture.
examples.translation: 牛现在已经放出去了，正在牧场上吃草。

examples.text: ...mountain pastures.
examples.translation: 高山牧场

examples.text: Michael decided he wanted to move on to pastures new for financial reasons.
examples.translation: 出于经济原因，迈克尔决意去寻找更好的前程。

examples.text: ...nurses seeking greener pastures overseas.
examples.translation: 到国外寻求更好前程的护士们

examples.text: I'm retiring next month. They're putting me out to pasture.
examples.translation: 我下个月退休。他们要我养老去了。

examples.text: 'Don't you worry about any of this,' she said patting me on the knee...
examples.translation: “这个你什么都不用担心，”她轻拍着我的膝盖说。

examples.text: The landlady patted her hair nervously...
examples.translation: 女房东焦虑地轻抚着她的头发。

examples.text: Wash the lettuce and pat it dry.
examples.translation: 把莴苣洗一下拍干。

examples.text: He gave her an encouraging pat on the shoulder.
examples.translation: 他轻轻地拍了一下她的肩膀表示鼓励。

examples.text: There's no pat answer to that...
examples.translation: 那个问题不是随随便便就能回答的。

examples.text: Despite the film's merits I felt it was too pat.
examples.translation: 尽管那部电影不乏亮点，但我还是觉得它过于敷衍了事。

examples.text: The players deserve a pat on the back...
examples.translation: 球员们值得表扬。

examples.text: If you do something well, give yourself a pat on the back.
examples.translation: 事情做得漂亮时，给自己一点表扬。

examples.text: I have my story down pat...
examples.translation: 我对自己想好的说法已烂熟于心。

examples.text: He had his answer off pat.
examples.translation: 他对自己如何作答胸有成竹。

examples.text: On the other side, the men stood pat and were unyielding...
examples.translation: 在另一方面，那些人固执己见，不肯让步。

examples.text: It makes it hard for the Fed to do anything but stand pat till the economy's direction becomes clearer.
examples.translation: 这让美联储几乎无计可施，在经济发展方向明朗之前只好硬挺着。

meanings.meaning: 眼罩；斑点；碎片；小块土地

examples.text: ...the bald patch on the top of his head...
examples.translation: 他头顶上的秃斑

examples.text: There was a small patch of blue in the grey clouds.
examples.translation: 灰色的云团中透出一小片蓝天。

examples.text: ...two big damp patches on the carpet.
examples.translation: 地毯上的两大块湿迹

examples.text: ...a patch of land covered in forest.
examples.translation: 一小块林地

examples.text: ...the little vegetable patch in her backyard.
examples.translation: 她家后院中的一小块菜地

examples.text: ...a patch of wild cornflowers.
examples.translation: 一小片野矢车菊

examples.text: ...jackets with patches on the elbows.
examples.translation: 肘部打着补丁的夹克

examples.text: ...trying to fix the flat tire by putting a patch on it.
examples.translation: 想打上一块补丁修好漏气的轮胎

examples.text: She went to the hospital and found him lying down with a patch over his eye.
examples.translation: 她去了医院，发现他躺着，一只眼睛戴着眼罩。

examples.text: He and Walker patched the barn roof...
examples.translation: 他和沃克补好了谷仓顶。

examples.text: One of the mechanics took off the damaged tyre, and took it back to the station to be patched.
examples.translation: 其中一个机修工卸下坏轮胎，把它带回维修站修补。

examples.text: ...their patched clothes.
examples.translation: 他们打着补丁的衣服

examples.text: Older machines will need a software patch to be loaded to correct the date.
examples.translation: 老些的机器需要下载软件补丁来修改日期。

examples.text: His marriage was going through a bad patch...
examples.translation: 他的婚姻当时麻烦不断。

examples.text: The company I work for went through a rough patch.
examples.translation: 我所在的公司经历了一段困难时期。

examples.text: He's not a patch on the rest of the Cabinet...
examples.translation: 他远比不上内阁的其他成员。

examples.text: Handsome, she thought, but not a patch on Alex.
examples.translation: 是帅，她想，不过比亚历克斯差远了。

meanings.meaning: 授予专利；取得…的专利权

examples.text: P&G applied for a patent on its cookies...
examples.translation: 宝洁公司为它的饼干申请专利权。

examples.text: He held a number of patents for his many innovations...
examples.translation: 他拥有多项发明的专利权。

examples.text: It sued Centrocorp for patent infringement.
examples.translation: 它诉Centrocorp公司侵犯专利权。

examples.text: He patented the idea that the atom could be split...
examples.translation: 他获得了“原子可以再分”这一概念的专利权。

examples.text: The invention has been patented by the university.
examples.translation: 那项发明已被那所大学申请了专利。

examples.text: ...a patented machine called the VCR II.
examples.translation: 名为VCR II的专利机器

examples.text: This was patent nonsense.
examples.translation: 这明显是胡说八道。

examples.text: ...a patent lie.
examples.translation: 赤裸裸的谎言

examples.text: He made his displeasure patently obvious...
examples.translation: 他明显地表示了不悦。

examples.text: This is patently absurd.
examples.translation: 这显然荒唐透顶。

examples.text: We followed the path along the clifftops...
examples.translation: 我们沿着悬崖顶上的小路走。

examples.text: Feet had worn a path in the rock...
examples.translation: 经年的踩踏在岩石上形成了一条小径。

examples.text: He went up the garden path to knock on the door.
examples.translation: 他穿过花园小径去敲门。

examples.text: A group of reporters blocked his path...
examples.translation: 一群记者堵住了他的去路。

examples.text: She did not notice the man until he moved into her path.
examples.translation: 直到那个男人拦住她的去路，她才注意到他。

examples.text: He stepped without looking into the path of a reversing car.
examples.translation: 一辆汽车正在倒车，他看都没看它倒向哪里就一脚迈了出去。

examples.text: ...people who live near airports or under the flight path of airplanes...
examples.translation: 住在机场附近或者航线下方的人们

examples.text: The storm wrecked homes in its path.
examples.translation: 暴风雨摧毁了所经之处的房屋。

examples.text: The opposition appear to have chosen the path of cooperation rather than confrontation...
examples.translation: 反对派似乎已经选择了合作而不是对抗的路线。

examples.text: He promised that within 100 days he would put the country on the path to economic recovery.
examples.translation: 他许诺在100天内让国家走上经济复兴之路。

examples.text: The Church of England put a serious obstacle in the path of women who want to become priests.
examples.translation: 英国国教在妇女成为牧师的道路上设置了重大障碍。

examples.text: It was highly unlikely that their paths would cross again...
examples.translation: 他们再次偶遇的可能性非常小。

examples.text: Over the years, Yul and Kirk had crossed paths many times.
examples.translation: 几年来，尤尔和柯克偶遇了很多次。

meanings.meaning: 可怜的，悲哀的；感伤的；乏味的

examples.text: ...a pathetic little dog with a curly tail...
examples.translation: 可怜的卷尾巴小狗

examples.text: The small group of onlookers presented a pathetic sight...
examples.translation: 这一小群旁观者看起来真是让人悲哀。

examples.text: She now looked small, shrunken and pathetic.
examples.translation: 她现在看起来瘦小枯槁，很可怜。

examples.text: She was pathetically thin.
examples.translation: 她瘦得可怜。

examples.text: What pathetic excuses...
examples.translation: 多差劲的借口啊！

examples.text: It's a pound for a small glass of wine, which is pathetic.
examples.translation: 一小杯葡萄酒要1英镑，真差劲。

examples.text: ...the pathetic attempts at public speaking made by members of all parties...
examples.translation: 所有政党党员在公开演讲时所作的令人生厌的尝试

examples.text: Don't be so pathetic.
examples.translation: 别那么讨人厌。

examples.text: Five women in a group of 18 people is a pathetically small number.
examples.translation: 18人的小组中只有5个女性，真是少得可怜。

examples.text: He doesn't have the patience to wait...
examples.translation: 他没有耐心等待。

examples.text: It was exacting work and required all his patience.
examples.translation: 工作很艰巨，需要他有极大的耐心。

examples.text: He would often sit and play patience.
examples.translation: 他常常坐着玩单人纸牌游戏。

examples.text: He tended to stutter, which tried her patience...
examples.translation: 他老结巴，这叫她难以忍受。

examples.text: I feel that she would try the patience of a saint.
examples.translation: 我觉得圣人都能被她逼疯。

examples.text: The earlier the treatment is given, the better the patient's chances...
examples.translation: 病人越早接受治疗，康复的可能性就越大。

examples.text: She was tough but wonderful with her patients...
examples.translation: 她很严厉，但对患者却很好。

examples.text: He specialized in treatment of cancer patients.
examples.translation: 他是治疗癌症病人的专家。

examples.text: Please be patient — your cheque will arrive...
examples.translation: 请耐心点——你的支票会来的。

examples.text: He was endlessly kind and patient with children.
examples.translation: 他对孩子们总是非常好，很有耐心。

examples.text: She waited patiently for Frances to finish.
examples.translation: 她耐心地等弗朗西丝弄完。

examples.text: Woosnam is fiercely patriotic...
examples.translation: 伍斯纳姆非常爱国。

examples.text: The crowd sang 'Land of Hope and Glory' and other patriotic songs.
examples.translation: 人群高唱《希望和光荣之地》等爱国歌曲。

examples.text: Prison officers continued to patrol the grounds within the jail.
examples.translation: 狱警继续巡视监狱。

examples.text: He failed to return from a patrol.
examples.translation: 他去巡逻，然后没再回来。

examples.text: The army is now on patrol in Srinagar and a curfew has been imposed...
examples.translation: 军队目前在斯利那加巡逻，且已实行了宵禁。

examples.text: Security forces remained on patrol until late into the night.
examples.translation: 保安部队继续巡逻至深夜。

examples.text: Guerrillas attacked a patrol with hand grenades.
examples.translation: 游击队用手榴弹袭击了巡逻队。

examples.text: ...a border patrol operating near the Burmese frontier.
examples.translation: 在缅甸边界巡逻的边境巡逻队

meanings.meaning: (Patron)人名；(英)佩特伦；(法、意、罗)帕特龙

examples.text: Catherine the Great was a patron of the arts and sciences.
examples.translation: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝资助发展艺术和科学。

examples.text: Fiona and Alastair have become patrons of the National Missing Person's Helpline.
examples.translation: 菲奥娜和阿拉斯泰尔已经成为国家失踪人口服务热线的代言人。

examples.text: He spent the night at the Savoy: like so many of its patrons, he could not resist the exclusively English cooking.
examples.translation: 他在萨沃伊酒店过了夜：和许多顾客一样，他无法抗拒精美的英式菜肴。

examples.text: All three attacks followed the same pattern...
examples.translation: 3次袭击模式相同。

examples.text: A change in the pattern of his breathing became apparent.
examples.translation: 他的呼吸方式明显起了变化。

examples.text: ...a golden robe embroidered with red and purple thread stitched into a pattern of flames.
examples.translation: 用红线和紫线绣着火焰图案的金色礼袍

examples.text: ...cutting out a pattern for trousers...
examples.translation: 裁出裤子的样板

examples.text: Send for our free patterns to knit yourself.
examples.translation: 欢迎函索免费式样体验自己编织的乐趣。

examples.text: ...sewing patterns.
examples.translation: 缝纫样板

examples.text: 'It's rather embarrassing,' he began, and paused...
examples.translation: “非常令人难堪，”他开口道，然后停顿了一下。

examples.text: He had to pause to clear his throat...
examples.translation: 他不得不停顿一下清清嗓子。

examples.text: He worked steadily, and fast, pausing only to toss away clumps of grass roots...
examples.translation: 他平稳快速地工作着，只在扔掉草根块儿时停顿一下。

examples.text: On leaving, she paused for a moment at the door...
examples.translation: 离开时，她在门口停顿了一下。

examples.text: He talked for two hours without pausing for breath.
examples.translation: 他一连说了两个小时，都没有停顿一下喘口气。

examples.text: After a pause Alex said sharply: 'I'm sorry if I've upset you'...
examples.translation: 歇了一会儿后，亚历克斯毫不客气地说：“要是让你心烦了，那我很抱歉。”

examples.text: There was a pause while the barmaid set down two plates in front of us.
examples.translation: 酒吧女招待在我们面前摆放两个盘子时停顿了一下。

examples.text: An opposition spokesman said he hoped the agreement would give them pause for thought about the futility of violence.
examples.translation: 反对派发言人说他希望协议能够让他们仔细想想暴力行为毫无意义。

examples.text: The avenue had never been paved, and deep mud made it impassable in winter.
examples.translation: 这条大街从未铺过路面，冬天泥泞不堪，无法通行。

examples.text: ...a small paved courtyard...
examples.translation: 地面铺砌过的小院子

examples.text: The sidewalks were paved with brick and lined with trees.
examples.translation: 人行道铺着砖，两边种着树。

examples.text: ...a new proposal intended to pave the way for the signing of a chemical weapons reduction agreement...
examples.translation: 旨在为签订削减化学武器协议铺平道路的一项新提议

examples.text: The discussions are aimed at paving the way for formal negotiations between the two countries.
examples.translation: 讨论旨在为两国进行正式谈判铺平道路。

examples.text: He was hurrying along the pavement.
examples.translation: 他在人行道上疾行。

examples.text: The kitten was black with white front paws and a white splotch on her chest...
examples.translation: 那只黑色小猫长着白色前爪，胸口上有一块白斑。

examples.text: He removes a thorn from a lion's paw.
examples.translation: 他从狮子脚掌上拔下一根刺。

examples.text: He shook Keaton's hand with his big paw.
examples.translation: 他用他的大爪子握了握基顿的手。

examples.text: Madigan's horse pawed the ground...
examples.translation: 马迪根的马用蹄子扒着地面。

examples.text: The dogs continued to paw and claw frantically at the chain mesh.
examples.translation: 那些狗继续用爪子疯狂地抓铁丝网。

examples.text: Stop pawing me, Giles!...
examples.translation: 别碰我，贾尔斯！

examples.text: He pawed at my jacket with his free hand.
examples.translation: 他用闲着的那只手摸我的夹克。

examples.text: Accommodation is free — all you pay for is breakfast and dinner...
examples.translation: 住宿免费——你只需付早餐和正餐的钱。

examples.text: We paid £35 for each ticket...
examples.translation: 我们每张票付了35英镑。

examples.text: The wealthier may have to pay a little more in taxes...
examples.translation: 更富有的人可能得多缴一点儿税。

examples.text: He proposes that businesses should pay taxes to the federal government...
examples.translation: 他提议企业应该向联邦政府纳税。

examples.text: You can pay by credit card.
examples.translation: 你可以用信用卡付账。

examples.text: The lawyer was paid a huge salary...
examples.translation: 那位律师薪酬很高。

examples.text: I get paid monthly...
examples.translation: 我按月领工资。

examples.text: They could wander where they wished and take jobs from who paid best.
examples.translation: 他们可以想去哪儿就去哪儿，谁给的钱多就给谁干活儿。

examples.text: ...their complaints about their pay and conditions.
examples.translation: 他们对薪水和工作条件的不满

examples.text: ...the workers' demand for a twenty per cent pay rise.
examples.translation: 工人要求加薪20%

examples.text: Students were paid substantial sums of money to do nothing all day but lie in bed...
examples.translation: 学生们得到了一大笔钱，而所要做的就是整天躺在床上什么也不做。

examples.text: If you help me, I'll pay you anything.
examples.translation: 如果你帮我，你要多少钱我都给。

examples.text: ...a legally binding international treaty that establishes who must pay for environmental damage...
examples.translation: 规定谁该为环境破坏买单的有法律约束力的国际条约

examples.text: If you don't subsidize ballet and opera, seat prices will have to go up to pay for it.
examples.translation: 如果你不为芭蕾和歌剧提供补贴，就得提高剧场票价来为此买单。

examples.text: We're stuck in jobs that don't pay very well...
examples.translation: 我们深陷在工资低廉的工作中。

examples.text: The account does not pay interest on a credit balance.
examples.translation: 这个账户的贷方余额没有利息。

examples.text: There are some agencies now specialising in helping older people to find jobs which pay...
examples.translation: 现在有些机构专门帮助年龄较大的人找有报酬的工作。

examples.text: They owned land; they made it pay.
examples.translation: 他们拥有土地；他们让土地生钱。

examples.text: He paid £20 into his savings account...
examples.translation: 他往自己的储蓄账户上存了20英镑。

examples.text: There is nothing more annoying than queueing when you only want to pay in a few cheques.
examples.translation: 没有比你只想存几张支票还得排队更令人恼火的了。

examples.text: It pays to invest in protective clothing...
examples.translation: 在防护服上投资是值得的。

examples.text: He talked of defending small nations, of ensuring that aggression does not pay.
examples.translation: 他谈到了保卫小国家，绝不让侵略得逞。

examples.text: Britain was to pay dearly for its lack of resolve...
examples.translation: 英国将为缺乏决心付出惨痛的代价。

examples.text: Why should I pay the penalty for somebody else's mistake?...
examples.translation: 为什么我要代人受过？

examples.text: She feels it's a small price to pay for the pleasure of living in this delightful house.
examples.translation: 她觉得，和住在这套令人愉快的房子里的那种快乐相比，这点代价不算大。

examples.text: Do pay us a visit next time you're in Birmingham...
examples.translation: 下次你来伯明翰一定要来看看我们。

examples.text: He felt a heavy bump, but paid no attention to it...
examples.translation: 他觉得起了个大包，但是没有理会。

examples.text: He had nothing to do with arranging the funeral, but came along to pay his last respects.
examples.translation: 他不是来筹备葬礼的，只是过来向遗体告别的。

examples.text: The company has set up joint-venture pay-TV channels in Belgium, Spain, and Germany.
examples.translation: 该公司已在比利时、西班牙和德国设立了合资付费电视频道。

examples.text: ...investments in energy efficiency that would pay for themselves within five years.
examples.translation: 将在5年内收回成本的能效投资

examples.text: He was murdered at a presidential rally by gunmen in the pay of drug traffickers.
examples.translation: 他在一场总统竞选集会上被毒品贩子雇用的枪手谋杀了。

examples.text: I went to college anyway, as a part-time student, paying my own way...
examples.translation: 总之我上了大学，半工半读，自食其力。

examples.text: The British film industry could not pay its way without a substantial export market.
examples.translation: 没有广阔的出口市场，英国电影工业无以为继。

meanings.meaning: 付款，支付；报酬，报答；偿还；惩罚，报应

examples.text: Thousands of its customers are in arrears with loans and mortgage payments...
examples.translation: 有数千客户拖欠其贷款和抵押贷款还款。

examples.text: The fund will make payments of just over £1 billion next year.
examples.translation: 该基金明年的支付额刚好过10亿英镑。

examples.text: He had sought to obtain payment of a sum which he had claimed was owed to him.
examples.translation: 他声称别人欠他一笔钱，他在想方设法讨要回来。

examples.text: Archaeologists have found that the Philistine diet leaned heavily on grass pea lentils, an Aegean staple.
Peace talks involving other rebel leaders and government representatives broke up without agreement last week, but are due to resume shortly...
examples.translation: 上个星期，其他叛军领导人和政府代表之间的和谈没能达成协议，宣告破裂，但是和谈不久会重开。

examples.text: Leaders of some rival factions signed a peace agreement last week...
examples.translation: 上周，一些敌对派系领导人签订了和平协议。

examples.text: They hope the treaty will bring peace and stability to Southeast Asia.
examples.translation: 他们希望该条约能够为东南亚带来和平与稳定。

examples.text: The President spoke of a shared commitment to world peace and economic development.
examples.translation: 总统提到了共同致力于世界和平和经济发展。

examples.text: ...the Nobel Peace Prize.
examples.translation: 诺贝尔和平奖

examples.text: ...two peace campaigners accused of causing damage to an F1-11 nuclear bomber...
examples.translation: 被控破坏一架F1-11核轰炸机的两名和平运动者

examples.text: He campaigned for peace and against the spread of nuclear weapons.
examples.translation: 他为裁军运动和反对核武器扩散而奔走。

examples.text: All I want is to have some peace and quiet and spend a couple of nice days with my grandchildren...
examples.translation: 我就想清静一下，和孙子孙女们一起好好呆几天。

examples.text: One more question and I'll leave you in peace.
examples.translation: 再问一个问题，我就不打扰你了。

examples.text: I had a wonderful feeling of peace and serenity when I saw my husband...
examples.translation: 看到我丈夫时，我有一种异常平静安详的奇妙感觉。

examples.text: The peace of the Lord be always with you...
examples.translation: 愿主的平和与你永在。

examples.text: I know you will never be at peace until you have discovered where your brother is.
examples.translation: 我知道，不查明你兄弟在哪儿你永远都不得安宁。

examples.text: ...a period of relative peace in the country's industrial relations...
examples.translation: 该国劳资关系相对和睦的一段时期

examples.text: If you can't live in peace with your little brother then get out of the house.
examples.translation: 如果你没法和你弟弟和睦相处，就滚出这座房子。

examples.text: The Peace of Ryswick was signed in September 1697.
examples.translation: 《里斯维克和约》签订于1697年9月。

examples.text: ...people who knew about this evil man but held their peace...
examples.translation: 了解这个恶棍却默不作声的人们

examples.text: I felt it politic to keep my peace and play the part of the attentive listener.
examples.translation: 我觉得保持沉默、做一名专心的听众比较明智。

examples.text: ...the first UN contingent assigned to help keep the peace in Cambodia...
examples.translation: 派往柬埔寨协助维持治安的第一批联合国分遣队

examples.text: How did your mother succeed in keeping the peace between these two very different men?
examples.translation: 你母亲是如何做到让这两个性格迥异的男人相安无事的？

examples.text: The demonstrators were bound over to keep the peace.
examples.translation: 示威者一定要遵纪守法。

examples.text: The President ought to seize this opportunity to make his peace with political parties and negotiate a speedy return to democracy...
examples.translation: 总统应该抓住这个机会与各政党握手言好，协商尽快恢复民主。

examples.text: All of a sudden she seemed to want to make peace and patch up our quarrel.
examples.translation: 突然她似乎想要和好，结束我们之间的争吵。

examples.text: The main appeal these bonds hold for individual investors is the safety and peace of mind they offer...
examples.translation: 这些债券对个人投资者的主要吸引力在于其安全性，令人放心。

examples.text: He began to insist upon a bullet-proof limousine, just for peace of mind.
examples.translation: 他开始坚持要防弹豪华轿车，仅仅是为了安心而已。

examples.text: Once I knew I was forgiven I could be at peace with myself at last...
examples.translation: 一旦我知道自己得到了宽恕，便可以心平气和了。

examples.text: They make you relax. They make you feel at peace with the world.
examples.translation: 他们令你放松，让你觉得与世无争。

meanings.meaning: 和平的，爱好和平的；平静的

examples.text: He has attempted to find a peaceful solution to the Ossetian conflict...
examples.translation: 他试图寻求和平解决奥赛梯冲突的方案。

examples.text: They emphasised that their equipment was for peaceful and not military purposes.
examples.translation: 他们强调他们的设备用于和平而非战争目的。

examples.text: The US military expects the matter to be resolved peacefully.
examples.translation: 美国军方期待该事件得到和平解决。

examples.text: The farmers staged a noisy but peaceful protest outside the headquarters of the organization...
examples.translation: 农场主在该组织总部外进行了喧闹而和平的抗议。

examples.text: Despite the violence that preceded the elections, reports say that polling was orderly and peaceful.
examples.translation: 虽然选举之前有过暴力事件，但有报道称投票过程秩序井然，波澜不惊。

examples.text: Ten thousand people are reported to have taken part in the protest which passed off peacefully.
examples.translation: 据报道，有1万人参加了和平抗议。

examples.text: ...warriors who killed or enslaved the peaceful farmers.
examples.translation: 杀害或奴役本分农民的武士

examples.text: They've been living and working peacefully with members of various ethnic groups.
examples.translation: 他们和不同民族的人们一起和睦地生活和工作。

examples.text: ...a peaceful Georgian house in the heart of Dorset...
examples.translation: 多塞特腹地一幢宁静的乔治王朝风格的房子

examples.text: Mornings are usually quiet and peaceful in Hueytown.
examples.translation: 胡伊镇的早晨通常一片静谧祥和。

examples.text: Except for traffic noise the night passed peacefully.
examples.translation: 除了车流的噪音，那一晚过得很平静。

examples.text: I feel relaxed and peaceful...
examples.translation: 我感到放松而平和。

examples.text: The animals look peaceful and happy.
examples.translation: 那些动物看起来气定神闲，怡然自得。

examples.text: Would she wake to find Gaston sleeping peacefully at her side?
examples.translation: 她醒来会发现加斯顿安详地睡在她身旁吗？

meanings.meaning: 桃子；桃树；桃红色；受人喜欢的人（或物）

examples.text: ...the romantic Tower Suite, decorated throughout in peach and ivory.
examples.translation: 完全用桃红色和象牙白装饰的浪漫塔楼套房

examples.text: ...a peach silk blouse.
examples.translation: 桃红色的丝绸上衣

examples.text: Frank was there and he is a perfect peach.
examples.translation: 弗兰克在那儿，他是个非常可爱的人。

examples.text: ...a peach of a goal from Beardsley.
examples.translation: 比尔兹利的绝妙进球

meanings.meaning: 消瘦；到达最高点；变憔悴

examples.text: The party's membership has fallen from a peak of fifty-thousand after the Second World War...
examples.translation: 二战后该党党员人数已从5万人的峰值下降了。

examples.text: The bomb went off in a concrete dustbin at the peak of the morning rush hour.
examples.translation: 在最繁忙的交通早高峰期，那枚炸弹在一个混凝土垃圾箱里爆炸了。

examples.text: ...a flourishing career that was at its peak at the time of his death...
examples.translation: 他去世时正处于巅峰的欣欣向荣的事业

examples.text: Economies have peaks and troughs.
examples.translation: 经济有高峰，也有低谷。

examples.text: Temperatures have peaked at over thirty degrees Celsius...
examples.translation: 温度最高达30摄氏度以上。

examples.translation: 她的建议中有完全正确的金玉良言，但有过于恭维之嫌。

examples.translation: 所有受伤的行人中有1/3以上是儿童。

examples.translation: 曾经典雅的白色立柱正在掉漆。

examples.translation: 那时他的脸因为晒伤而脱皮。

examples.translation: 孩子们围在门口偷看他。

examples.translation: 她时不时地偷眼看他是否在注意自己。

examples.translation: “14分钟，”克里斯瞥了一眼他的手表说道。

examples.translation: 商店门口从不同方向露出一张脸。

examples.translation: 她一睡觉，就不会发出一点儿动静。

examples.translation: 我一直盯着看一张毫无意义的计算机打印稿。

examples.translation: 他看见海关官员透过驾驶座车窗仔细地往里看。

examples.translation: 斯旺勋爵于1981年受封终身贵族。

examples.translation: 他迷人的个性使他深受同龄人的喜爱。

examples.text: I really intended to pen this letter to you early this morning...
examples.translation: 我真的打算今天一大早给你写这封信的。

examples.translation: 她给他的私人秘书写了一份简短的备忘录。

examples.translation: 他不是十分确定狐狸是怎么进入羊圈的。

examples.translation: 将牛群赶回家，这样就能挤奶并将其关进牛棚过夜

examples.translation: 我不必像个囚犯一样被关在房间里。

examples.translation: 他每次一提笔就不知道如何措辞透露这个消息。

examples.translation: 最高处罚是最多7年监禁或者无上限罚款。

examples.translation: 政治形势转而对自由主义者有利。

examples.translation: X射线能够穿透很多物体。

examples.translation: 外墙厚3到3.5英尺，以防炸弹穿透。

examples.translation: 她的英语语法上没错，但是里面夹杂着很多法语短语。

examples.translation: 她所演绎的遭人背叛的美狄亚

examples.text: The Festival Of Asian Arts & Music will include two days of live performances.
examples.translation: 亚洲艺术音乐节将安排两天的现场表演。

examples.text: That study looked at the performance of 18 surgeons...
examples.translation: 那项研究调查了18名外科医生的工作表现。

examples.text: The poor performance has been blamed on the recession and cheaper sports car imports...
examples.translation: 业绩不佳的原因被归咎于经济衰退和低价跑车的进口。

examples.text: The job of the new director-general was to ensure that performance targets were met.
examples.translation: 新主管的任务是确保实现业绩目标。

examples.text: He devoted in excess of seventy hours a week to the performance of his duties...
examples.translation: 为了完成任务，他每周工作70多个小时。

examples.text: The people believe that the performance of this ritual is the will of the Great Spirit.
examples.translation: 该部族的人认为举行这种仪式是大神的意志。

examples.text: The whole process is quite a performance...
examples.translation: 整个过程相当复杂。

examples.text: She made a big performance of sprinkling all the spices on.
examples.translation: 她费了不少劲才把所有的香料都撒在上面。

examples.text: The hall smelled of her mother's perfume.
examples.translation: 大厅里弥漫着她母亲身上的香水味。

examples.text: ...a bottle of perfume.
examples.translation: 一瓶香水

examples.text: ...the manufacture of soaps and perfumes.
examples.translation: 肥皂和香水的制造

examples.text: ...a delicate white soap without perfume.
examples.translation: 不含香料、味道淡雅的白色肥皂

examples.text: ...a perfume for skin creams.
examples.translation: 润肤霜中使用的香料

examples.text: ...the perfume of roses...
examples.translation: 玫瑰花的芳香

examples.text: There were two lemon trees and I paused to enjoy their perfume.
examples.translation: 那里有两棵柠檬树，我不禁驻足品味柠檬的芬芳。

examples.text: Flowers started to perfume the air...
examples.translation: 花儿的香气开始弥漫在空气中。

examples.text: As they bake, they perfume the whole house with the aroma of apples and spices.
examples.translation: 他们烤蛋糕的时候，整幢房子都飘着苹果和香料的香气。

examples.text: ...gardens perfumed with jasmine.
examples.translation: 茉莉飘香的花园

examples.text: The oil is used to flavour and perfume soaps, foam baths, and scents.
examples.translation: 这种精油用来给肥皂、沐浴液和香水添加香味。

examples.text: ...shower gel perfumed with the popular Paris fragrance.
examples.translation: 添加了流行的巴黎香水的沐浴啫喱

meanings.meaning: 或许；（表示不确定）也许；（用于粗略的估计）或许；（表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许；可能

examples.text: Millson regarded her thoughtfully. Perhaps she was right...
examples.translation: 米尔森若有所思地注视着她。或许她是对的。

examples.text: In the end they lose millions, perhaps billions...
examples.translation: 最后他们输掉几百万，或许是几十亿。

examples.text: He does not paint for very long on any one painting, perhaps for two and a half hours at a time...
examples.translation: 他每幅画不会画很长时间，一次大概画两个半小时。

examples.text: It was bulky, perhaps three feet long and almost as high...
examples.translation: 它体积很大,大约有3英尺长,高度也将近3英尺。

examples.text: Perhaps, in time, the message will get through...
examples.translation: 或许消息会及时送达。

examples.text: They'd come soon, perhaps when the radio broadcast was over.
examples.translation: 他们很快就会来，可能在广播结束之后。

examples.text: Perhaps the most important lesson to be learned is that you simply cannot please everyone...
examples.translation: 也许最应吸取的教训就是懂得众口难调。

examples.text: His very last paintings are perhaps the most puzzling...
examples.translation: 他去世前的最后一批画作也许是最让人困惑的。

examples.text: The lesson from all of this is perhaps a broader one...
examples.translation: 从所有这一切中得出的教训可能具有更广泛的意义。

examples.text: Do you perhaps disapprove of Agatha Christie and her Poirot and Miss Marple?...
examples.translation: 你大概不太欣赏阿加莎·克里斯蒂和她作品中的波洛和马普尔小姐?

examples.text: He was not perhaps physically the strongest in the class.
examples.translation: 他可能不是全班身体最壮的。

examples.text: Perhaps I may be permitted a few suggestions...
examples.translation: 也许我可以提几条建议。

examples.text: Well, perhaps you'll come and see us at our place?...
examples.translation: 嗯，或者你到我们家来见我们如何？

examples.text: Perhaps if you rang me when you got back to your office?
examples.translation: 你回到办公室后给我打电话怎么样？

examples.text: 'You know it doesn't make sense for you.' — 'Perhaps. I don't know. Maybe it does maybe it doesn't.'...
examples.translation: “你知道它对你来说没有意义。”——“也许吧，我不知道。可能有意义，也可能没意义。”

examples.text: 'I'm sure we can make it,' he says. Perhaps, but it will not be easy.
examples.translation: “我确信我们能成功。”他说。也许吧，但是不会轻而易举。

meanings.meaning: 周期，期间；时期；月经；课时；（语法学）句点，句号

examples.text: This crisis might last for a long period of time.
examples.translation: 这次危机可能持续很长时间。

examples.text: ...a period of a few months.
examples.translation: 几个月时间

examples.text: ...for a limited period only.
examples.translation: 只在有限的时期内

examples.text: ...a period of economic good health and expansion...
examples.translation: 经济健康发展并且不断扩张的一段时期

examples.text: He went through a period of wanting to be accepted...
examples.translation: 有一段时间他很想被人接受。

examples.text: The South African years were his most creative period.
examples.translation: 在南非的那些年是他创作最旺盛的时期。

examples.text: ...the Roman period...
examples.translation: 罗马帝国时代

examples.text: No reference to their existence appears in any literature of the period.
examples.translation: 这一时期的文学作品中都没有提及他们的存在。

examples.text: ...the most difficult periods of history.
examples.translation: 历史上最艰难的时期

examples.text: ...dressed in full period costume.
examples.translation: 穿着宽松的古装

examples.text: ...replicas of period instruments.
examples.translation: 古乐器的复制品

examples.text: They accompanied him during his exercise periods.
examples.translation: 练习的时候他们陪着他。

examples.text: ...periods of private study.
examples.translation: 自习课

examples.text: ...taking his scripts to school in order to learn the lines in free periods.
examples.translation: 把他的剧本带到学校以便空闲的时候背台词

examples.text: I don't want to do it, period.
examples.translation: 我不想做，这事就到此为止吧。

examples.text: The walls would be lined with books and periodicals.
examples.translation: 这几面墙会摆放书籍和期刊。

examples.text: ...a monthly periodical.
examples.translation: 月刊

examples.text: She made periodical visits to her dentist.
examples.translation: 她定期去看牙医。

examples.text: ...periodical screening for cancer.
examples.translation: 定期进行肿瘤检查

examples.text: Meetings are held periodically to monitor progress on the case...
examples.translation: 定期举行会议以监督案件的进展。

examples.text: Police were periodically patrolling the area.
examples.translation: 警察定时在这一地区巡逻。

examples.text: Most of the butterflies perish in the first frosts of autumn.
examples.translation: 大多数蝴蝶会在秋天的第一场霜冻来临时纷纷死去。

examples.text: ...the ferry disaster in which 193 passengers perished.
examples.translation: 造成193名乘客丧生的渡船事故

examples.text: Buddhism had to adapt to the new world or perish...
examples.translation: 佛教必须适应新时代，否则将会消亡。

examples.text: Civilizations do eventually decline and perish.
examples.translation: 各种文明最后都会衰落、消亡。

examples.text: Obviously the plaster's just perished and all fallen off...
examples.translation: 很明显灰泥已脆裂老化,全剥落下来了。

examples.text: Their tyres are slowly perishing.
examples.translation: 他们的车胎在慢慢老化。

examples.text: ...tattered pieces of ancient, perished leather.
examples.translation: 磨损得破烂不堪的旧皮革

examples.text: Me a policeman! Perish the thought!...
examples.translation: 我当警察！想都别想了，不可能！

examples.text: We don't have a computer (perish the thought) and have only recently bought an electric typewriter.
examples.translation: 我们没有电脑（死了心吧），只好最近买了台电动打字机。

examples.text: Heavy drinking can cause permanent damage to the brain...
examples.translation: 酗酒能造成永久性大脑损伤。

examples.text: ...a permanent solution to the problem...
examples.translation: 该问题一劳永逸的解决办法

examples.text: The ban is intended to be permanent.
examples.translation: 禁令将永久生效。

examples.text: His reason had been permanently affected by what he had witnessed...
examples.translation: 他所目睹的那一幕永久性地影响了他的神智。

examples.text: The only way to lose weight permanently is to completely change your attitudes toward food.
examples.translation: 永久性减肥的唯一办法就是彻底改变对食物的态度。

examples.text: Anything which threatens the permanence of the treaty is a threat to peace.
examples.translation: 任何对条约持续生效构成威胁的因素都将危及和平。

examples.text: They gradually realized the permanency of their condition.
examples.translation: 他们渐渐意识到他们的这种状况将永久地持续下去。

examples.text: ...a permanent state of tension...
examples.translation: 长久以来的紧张局势

examples.text: They feel under permanent threat...
examples.translation: 他们觉得一直处于威胁之下。

examples.text: There was a permanent 20-yard queue for the portable toilets.
examples.translation: 流动厕所前总排着20码长的队伍。

examples.text: ...the heavy, permanently locked gate.
examples.translation: 长年锁着的厚重大门

examples.text: At the end of the probationary period you will become a permanent employee.
examples.translation: 试用期结束后,你将成为长期雇员。

examples.text: ...a permanent job.
examples.translation: 固定工作

examples.text: ...permanently employed registered dockers.
examples.translation: 在编的正式码头工人

examples.text: York Cottage was as near to a permanent home as the children knew...
examples.translation: 在孩子们眼中,约克小屋最像一个安定的家。

examples.text: They had no permanent address.
examples.translation: 他们没有固定居所。

examples.text: Bias against women permeates every level of the judicial system...
examples.translation: 司法体制中各个层面都有歧视女性的现象。

examples.text: An obvious change of attitude at the top will permeate through the system.
examples.translation: 上级态度的明显改变将影响到整个体制。

examples.text: The smell of roast beef permeated the air...
examples.translation: 空气中弥漫着烤牛肉的香味。

examples.text: Eventually, the water will permeate through the surrounding concrete.
examples.translation: 最终,水会渗透进周围的混凝土中。

examples.text: He asked permission to leave the room...
examples.translation: 他请求准许离开房间。

examples.text: Finally his mother relented and gave permission for her youngest son to marry...
examples.translation: 最后他母亲让步了,准许她的小儿子结婚。

examples.text: Police said permission for the march had not been granted...
examples.translation: 警方说游行并未得到批准。

examples.text: They cannot leave the country without permission.
examples.translation: 他们不能擅自离开该国家。

examples.text: ...oil exploration permissions.
examples.translation: 石油勘探许可证

examples.text: He can let the court's decision stand and permit the execution...
examples.translation: 他有权维持法庭判决，批准死刑生效。

examples.text: The guards permitted me to bring my camera and tape recorder...
examples.translation: 卫兵准许我带相机和录音机。

examples.text: Employees are permitted to use the golf course during their free hours...
examples.translation: 准许雇员在业余时间使用高尔夫球场。

examples.text: No outside journalists have been permitted into the country...
examples.translation: 禁止外国记者进入该国。

examples.text: If they appear to be under 12, then the doorman is not allowed to permit them entry to the film.
examples.translation: 如果他们看起来不到12岁,门卫不得允许其进入观看该影片。

examples.text: The majority of foreign nationals working here have work permits...
examples.translation: 大多数在这里工作的外国人都有工作许可证。

examples.text: He has to apply for a permit, and we have to find him a job.
examples.translation: 他必须要申请工作许可证，我们得给他找份工作。

examples.text: He sets about creating an environment that just doesn't permit experiment, it encourages it...
examples.translation: 他着手营造一种不仅可以进行试验而且鼓励进行试验的环境。

examples.text: Try to go out for a walk at lunchtime, if the weather permits...
examples.translation: 只要天气不太差，中午尽量出去散散步。

examples.text: This method of cooking also permits heat to penetrate evenly from both sides.
examples.translation: 这种烹饪方法也能使两面均匀受热。

examples.text: Captain Bowen permitted himself one cigar a day...
examples.translation: 鲍恩上尉破例允许自己每天抽一支雪茄。

examples.text: Only once in his life had Douglas permitted himself to lose control of his emotions.
examples.translation: 道格拉斯一生中只有一次情绪失控。

examples.text: Permit me to give you some advice...
examples.translation: 请允许我给你提点建议。

examples.text: Permit me to offer you my sincere congratulations.
examples.translation: 谨致衷心祝贺。

meanings.meaning: 永久的；不断的；四季开花的；无期限的

examples.text: ...the creation of a perpetual union.
examples.translation: 永久联盟的创立

examples.text: They were all perpetually starving...
examples.translation: 他们都一直忍饥挨饿。

examples.text: He and his wife would be compelled to live perpetually as second-class citizens.
examples.translation: 他和妻子将被迫永远做二等公民。

examples.text: I thought her perpetual complaints were going to prove too much for me.
examples.translation: 我想我再也受不了她无休无止的抱怨了。 per|pet|ual|ly

examples.text: ...a perpetually renewed miracle...
examples.translation: 不断再现的奇迹

examples.text: He perpetually interferes in political affairs.
examples.translation: 他总是干预政事。

meanings.meaning: 使困惑，使为难；使复杂化

examples.text: It perplexed him because he was tackling it the wrong way.
examples.translation: 由于处理不当，这个问题令他大伤脑筋。

examples.text: Mr Weaver and his family have been persecuted by the authorities for their beliefs...
examples.translation: 韦弗先生和他的家人由于其信仰而遭到当局的迫害。

examples.text: They began by brutally persecuting the Catholic Church.
examples.translation: 他们开始残酷迫害天主教。

examples.text: ...a persecuted minority.
examples.translation: 受迫害的少数派

examples.text: He said his first wife persecuted him with her unreasonable demands...
examples.translation: 他说他的第一任妻子总是拿无理要求纠缠他。

examples.text: Vic was bullied by his father and persecuted by his sisters.
examples.translation: 维克受到父亲的欺压和姊妹们的纠缠。

meanings.meaning: 坚持；不屈不挠；固执己见（在辩论中）

examples.text: ...his ability to persevere despite obstacles and setbacks.
examples.translation: 他锲而不舍、百折不挠的劲头儿

examples.text: ...a school with a reputation for persevering with difficult and disruptive children...
examples.translation: 因对捣乱难管的学生不离不弃而闻名的学校

examples.text: She persevered in her idea despite obvious objections raised by friends.
examples.translation: 虽然朋友们明确反对,她还是坚持己见。

examples.text: He is a persevering, approachable family man.
examples.translation: 他是一个不屈不挠、平易近人的居家男人。

examples.text: Contact your doctor if the cough persists...
examples.translation: 如果还是咳嗽就去看医生。

examples.text: These problems persisted for much of the decade.
examples.translation: 这些问题在那10年的大部分时间里一直存在。

examples.text: Why does Britain persist in running down its defence forces?...
examples.translation: 为什么英国要坚持消减其军事防御力量？

examples.text: He urged the United States to persist with its efforts to bring about peace...
examples.translation: 他敦促美国继续进行和平斡旋。

examples.text: 'You haven't answered me,' she persisted...
examples.translation: “你还没有回答我,”她追问道。

examples.text: When I set my mind to something, I persist.
examples.translation: 一旦我对某事拿定主意,我就会坚持到底。

meanings.meaning: (Person)人名；(法、俄、德)佩尔松；(瑞典)佩尔松；(英)珀森

examples.text: At least one person died and several others were injured...
examples.translation: 至少一人死亡，还有几个人受伤。

examples.text: Everyone knows he's the only person who can do the job...
examples.translation: 人人都知道他是唯一能做这项工作的人。

examples.text: My great-grandfather was a person of some importance here...
examples.translation: 我曾祖父曾是这儿的头面人物。

examples.text: The amount of sleep we need varies from person to person...
examples.translation: 我们对睡眠的需求量因人而异。

examples.text: They were both lovely, friendly people...
examples.translation: 他们俩都很和善友好。

examples.text: At least fifty four people have been killed and a further fifty are missing.
examples.translation: 至少有54人死亡，另外还有50人失踪。

examples.text: ...removal of the right of accused persons to remain silent...
examples.translation: 剥夺被告人保持沉默的权利

examples.text: Persons who wish to adopt a child may contact their local social services department.
examples.translation: 想收养孩子的人可以与当地社会公益部门联系。

examples.text: ...persons with neck problems.
examples.translation: 脖子有毛病的人

examples.text: I've a lot of time for him as a person now...
examples.translation: 现在我有充分的时间去了解他的人品。

examples.text: Robin didn't feel good about herself as a person.
examples.translation: 罗宾不喜欢自己的为人。

examples.text: I am not a country person at all. I prefer the cities.
examples.translation: 我根本不喜欢乡村生活，我喜欢城市。

examples.text: You must collect the mail in person and take along some form of identification...
examples.translation: 你必须携带本人身份证明亲自来取邮件。

examples.text: She went to New York to receive the award in person.
examples.translation: 她亲自前往纽约领奖。

examples.text: It was the first time she had seen him in person.
examples.translation: 这是她第一次见到他本人。

examples.text: ...a trip to Hollywood to meet his favorite actor in person...
examples.translation: 去好莱坞亲自面见他最喜欢的演员的旅程

examples.text: She wanted to hear him sing in person.
examples.translation: 她想听他现场演唱。

examples.text: The suspect had refused to give any details of his identity and had carried no documents on his person.
examples.translation: 嫌疑犯拒绝说出他的具体身份，而且身上没有携带任何身份证明。

examples.text: We had a knowledgeable guide in the person of George Adams.
examples.translation: 我们有一位见识广博的导游乔治·亚当斯。

meanings.meaning: 人事消息栏；人称代名词

examples.text: He learned this lesson the hard way — from his own personal experience...
examples.translation: 吃一堑长一智，他这个教训来之不易——是从他自己的亲身经历中得来的。

examples.text: That's my personal opinion.
examples.translation: 那是我的个人观点。

examples.text: ...books, furniture, and other personal belongings...
examples.translation: 书、家具和其他个人物品

examples.text: Refugees also complain that soldiers steal food and personal property from them and demand bribes in exchange for food or shelter...
examples.translation: 难民们同时抱怨说士兵偷他们的食品和私人财物，而且借提供食物和住处之机向他们索贿。

examples.text: The President arrived, followed by his personal bodyguard.
examples.translation: 总统来了，随行的是他的私人保镖。

examples.text: ...an estimated personal fortune of almost seventy million dollars.
examples.translation: 估计个人财产接近7,000万美元

examples.text: ...a business that requires a great deal of personal contact.
examples.translation: 经常需要本人亲自联系、打理的生意

examples.text: ...a personal letter from the President's secretary...
examples.translation: 总统秘书亲自寄出的信

examples.text: People do not mind paying a bit extra for the personal touch.
examples.translation: 冲着个性化设计人们不介意多花点儿钱。

examples.text: ...teaching young people about marriage and personal relationships...
examples.translation: 教导年轻人有关婚姻和人际关系方面的事情

examples.text: You never allow personal problems to affect your performance...
examples.translation: 绝不要让个人问题影响你的表现。

examples.text: We sacrifice our personal lives to our work...
examples.translation: 我们为工作牺牲了私人生活。

examples.text: Mr Knight said that he had resigned for personal reasons.
examples.translation: 奈特先生说他是由于个人原因而辞职。

examples.text: Newspapers resorted to personal abuse...
examples.translation: 报纸采取了人身攻击的手段。

examples.text: Myra was attacking something I'd written, and her attack got a little personal.
examples.translation: 迈拉批评我写的东西，她的批评多少有些人身攻击的味道。

examples.text: ...men who take as much trouble over personal hygiene as women.
examples.translation: 像女人一样不嫌麻烦打理个人卫生的男人

examples.text: He was a personal friend whom I've known for many many years...
examples.translation: 他是一位我认识多年的私人朋友。

examples.text: What began as a professional relationship became a personal one pretty quickly, despite us coming from very different backgrounds.
examples.translation: 尽管我们各自背景不同，但我们还是很快从工作关系发展成了私下的好朋友。

examples.text: She has such a kind, friendly personality...
examples.translation: 她个性善良友好。

examples.text: Through sheer force of personality Hugh Trenchard had got his way...
examples.translation: 休·特伦查德完全凭着个人魅力就能随心所欲。

examples.text: These personality traits get passed on from generation to generation...
examples.translation: 这些性格特征代代相传。

examples.text: The contest was as much about personalities as it was about politics.
examples.translation: 竞赛比手段策略，也比个性。

examples.text: ...a woman of great personality...
examples.translation: 极有个性的女人

examples.text: He is such a personality — he is so funny.
examples.translation: 他很有个性魅力——非常风趣。

examples.text: We're going to the pictures tonight...

examples.text: They have in their mind a picture of what an alcoholic should look like...
examples.translation: 他们的心中有一个酒鬼应有的样子。

examples.translation: 我尽力想象那个地方，但想不出来。

examples.text: I'll try and give you a better picture of what the boys do...

examples.translation: 她的书是女性当下所面临问题的凄凉写照。

examples.translation: 从现在已公布的文件看，真相开始浮现。

examples.translation: 有时安全措施过于严密，使本来可能会提供重要情况的人成了局外人。
