examples.translation: 见过自己的设计在其他国家遭到盗版的美国制造商

examples.text: Pirated copies of music tapes are flooding the market...
examples.translation: 盗版音乐带正充斥市场。

examples.text: A pirated edition of the book was published in August 1986.
examples.translation: 这本书的一个盗版版本在1986年8月出版。

examples.text: Pirate copies of the video are already said to be in Britain.
examples.translation: 该录像带的盗版版本据说已在英国出现。

examples.text: The vehicle contained several items including an air pistol, a knife, a balaclava and lump hammer.
As hydrogen gas inside the engine heats up, it drives a piston that generates electricity.

meanings.meaning: 矿井；深坑；陷阱；（物体或人体表面上的）凹陷；（英国剧场的）正厅后排；正厅后排的观众
使竞争；窖藏；使凹下；去…之核；使留疤痕

examples.text: It was a better community then when all the pits were working.
examples.translation: 所有的煤矿都在开工的那个时候，这个社区的情况要更好一些。

examples.text: Eric lost his footing and began to slide into the pit.
examples.translation: 埃里克一脚踩空，开始往坑里滑。

examples.text: This area of former farmland was worked as a gravel pit until 1964.
examples.translation: 这块过去曾是农田的地1964年前一直被用作沙砾坑。

examples.text: You will be pitted against people who are every bit as good as you are...
examples.translation: 你将和与你势均力敌的对手展开竞争。

examples.text: This was one man pitted against the universe.
examples.translation: 这是一个人挑战整个宇宙。

examples.text: He moved quickly into the pits and climbed rapidly out of the car.
examples.translation: 他迅速进入检修加油站，飞快地爬出赛车。

examples.text: Mary Ann asked him how dinner had been. 'The pits,' he replied.
examples.translation: 玛丽·安问他晚餐怎么样，他回答说：“糟透了。”

examples.text: I'd like to pit my wits against the best.
examples.translation: 我希望同最优秀的对手斗智。

examples.text: I had a funny feeling in the pit of my stomach.
examples.translation: 我心头有种怪怪的感觉。

meanings.meaning: 投；掷；定位于；用沥青涂；扎营；向前倾跌
沥青；音高；程度；树脂；倾斜；投掷；球场

examples.text: There was a swimming-pool, cricket pitches, playing fields...
examples.translation: 有一个游泳池、几个板球场和运动场。

examples.text: Their conduct both on and off the pitch was excellent.
examples.translation: 他们场上场下都表现出众。

examples.text: Simon pitched the empty bottle into the lake.
examples.translation: 西蒙把空瓶子扔到湖里。

examples.text: The movement took him by surprise, and he pitched forward...
examples.translation: 这一动使他冷不防地向前摔倒。

examples.text: Alan staggered sideways, pitched head-first over the low wall and fell into the lake...
examples.translation: 艾伦身子倒向一侧，一头栽过矮墙，跌进了湖里。

examples.text: I was pitched into the water and swam ashore.
examples.translation: 我被甩到水里后向岸边游去。

examples.text: They were being pitched into a new adventure...
examples.translation: 他们正被抛入一场新的冒险。

examples.text: This could pitch the government into confrontation with the workforce.
examples.translation: 这有可能把政府推向与工人正面交锋的境地。

examples.text: We passed long, hot afternoons pitching a baseball.
examples.translation: 我们通过投棒球玩打发了一个个漫长、炎热的下午。

examples.text: His pitching was a legend among major league hitters.
examples.translation: 他的投球在大联盟的击球员中是个传奇。

examples.text: He raised his voice to an even higher pitch.
examples.translation: 他把音调抬得更高了。

examples.text: His cry is pitched at a level that makes it impossible to ignore...
examples.translation: 他的哭喊声之大让人没法不理睬。

examples.text: His voice was pitched high, the words muffled by his crying...
examples.translation: 他的声音很高，嘴里的话因哭泣而含混不清。

examples.text: Her voice was well pitched and brisk.
examples.translation: 她的声音响亮活泼。

examples.text: I think the material is pitched at too high a level for our purposes...
examples.translation: 我想相对于我们的意图来说，内容定得过难了。

examples.text: The government has pitched High Street interest rates at a new level.
examples.translation: 政府已设定了新的商业利率水平。

examples.text: I feel very sorry for the competitors who have all worked themselves up to a very high pitch for this first day...
examples.translation: 我为第一天就已耗费相当大体力的参赛者感到非常惋惜。

examples.text: Tension has reached such a pitch that the armed forces say soldiers may have to use their weapons to defend themselves against local people.
examples.translation: 紧张关系已达白热化程度，武装部队说士兵有可能不得不使用武器保护自己不受当地民众的伤害。

examples.text: He had pitched his tent in the yard...
examples.translation: 他在院子里搭起了帐篷。

examples.text: At dusk we pitched camp in the middle of nowhere.
examples.translation: 黄昏时分，我们在茫茫荒野中扎了营。

examples.text: The ship is pitching and rolling in what looks like about fifteen foot seas.
examples.translation: 这只船在看起来约有15英尺高的海浪中上下左右颠簸。

examples.text: The timbers of similar houses were painted with pitch.
examples.translation: 类似房屋所用的栋木刷了沥青。

examples.text: The President speaks in New York today, making another pitch for his economic program...
examples.translation: 总统今天在纽约发表讲话，再一次为他的经济计划作宣传。

examples.text: Prue invited the magazine's editor to lunch and made her pitch.
examples.translation: 普吕邀请该杂志的编辑共进午餐，推销自己的点子。

meanings.meaning: 对……表示怜悯；对……感到同情

examples.text: He felt a sudden tender pity for her...
examples.translation: 他突然涌起一股对她的温柔怜悯之情。

examples.text: She knew that she was an object of pity among her friends.
examples.translation: 她知道自己是朋友同情的对象。

examples.text: I don't know whether to hate or pity him.
examples.translation: 我不知道该恨他，还是该同情他。

examples.text: It is a great pity that all pupils in the city cannot have the same chances...
examples.translation: 非常遗憾的是，在这个城市里，并非所有的学生都能获得同样的机会。

examples.text: Pity you haven't got your car, isn't it...
examples.translation: 可惜你还没有车，不是吗？

examples.text: It seemed a pity to let it all go to waste.
examples.translation: 让这一切白白浪费掉，真是可惜了。

examples.text: One should avoid showing too much pity...
examples.translation: 一个人应该避免显得太过仁慈。

examples.text: She saw no pity in their faces.
examples.translation: 她从他们的脸上看不到慈悲。

examples.text: But my world isn't your world, more's the pity.
examples.translation: 可惜的是，我们是两个世界的人。

examples.text: 'Run, Katherine. For pity's sake run!' he screamed.
examples.translation: “跑，凯瑟琳，快跑！”他尖叫道。

examples.text: No woman had ever felt the need to take pity on him before.
examples.translation: 以前从没有女性觉得他需要同情。

examples.text: The pity is that it was all completely unnecessary...
examples.translation: 遗憾的是这完全没有必要。

examples.text: The pity of it was that the Americans didn't play cricket.
examples.translation: 可惜的是美国人不打板球。

meanings.meaning: 瘟疫；灾祸；麻烦；讨厌的人

examples.text: A cholera plague had been killing many prisoners of war at the time.
examples.translation: 当时霍乱疫情已在夺去很多战俘的生命。

examples.text: ...a fresh outbreak of plague.
examples.translation: 新一轮鼠疫的爆发

examples.text: ...illnesses such as smallpox, typhus and the plague.
examples.translation: 像天花、伤寒和鼠疫这样的疾病

examples.text: The city is under threat from a plague of rats...
examples.translation: 该市处于鼠患的威胁之下。

examples.text: Last year there was a plague of robbery and housebreaking.
examples.translation: 去年抢劫和入室行窃成灾。

examples.text: Inflation will remain a recurrent plague...
examples.translation: 通货膨胀将继续成为周期性的烦扰。

examples.text: Tim seems to have escaped the cynicism which is the absolute plague of our generation.
examples.translation: 蒂姆好像并没有染上我们这代人愤世嫉俗的通病。

examples.text: She was plagued by weakness, fatigue, and dizziness...
examples.translation: 她感觉体虚、疲倦、头昏眼花。

examples.text: Fears about job security plague nearly half the workforce.
examples.translation: 几乎一半的员工担心失业。

examples.text: I'm not going to plague you with a lot more questions, Miss Culver...
examples.translation: 卡尔弗小姐，我不会再问更多的问题来烦你了。

examples.text: Tommy Cook had been plaguing Pinner for months.
examples.translation: 汤米·库克已纠缠平纳好几个月了。

examples.text: I would avoid him like the plague when his wife and my parents were around...
examples.translation: 他的妻子和我的父母在旁边时，我会极力躲着他。

examples.text: I normally avoid cheap wine like the plague.
examples.translation: 我一般对廉价的葡萄酒敬而远之。

examples.text: A plague on you and your damned percentages!
examples.translation: 你和你该死的百分比都见鬼去吧！

meanings.meaning: (Place)人名；(罗)普拉切；(法)普拉斯；(英)普莱斯

examples.text: In 1857, during the Indian Mutiny, a massacre took place at Cawnpore, a frontier station.

meanings.meaning: 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的
平原；无格式；朴实无华的东西

examples.text: In general, a plain carpet makes a room look bigger...
examples.translation: 一般来说，单色的地毯使房间显得更宽敞。

examples.text: He placed the paper in a plain envelope...
examples.translation: 他把论文装进一个空白信封里。

examples.text: He wore a plain blue shirt, open at the collar.
examples.translation: 他穿一件素净的蓝色衬衫，领口敞着。

examples.text: Bronwen's dress was plain but it hung well on her...
examples.translation: 布朗温的长裙虽然朴素，却很合身。

examples.text: It was a plain, grey stone house, distinguished mainly by its largely unspoilt simplicity.
examples.translation: 这是一幢简朴的灰石房子，主要以其天然简约的风格显得与众不同。

examples.text: He was very tall and plainly dressed.
examples.translation: 他个子很高，衣着朴素。

examples.text: It was plain to him that I was having a nervous breakdown...
examples.translation: 他能明显地看出我快要精神崩溃了。

examples.text: He's made it plain that he loves the game and wants to be involved still.
examples.translation: 他明确表示自己热爱这项运动，并仍想参与其中。

examples.text: ...a shy, rather plain girl with a pale complexion.
examples.translation: 肤色苍白、相貌平平的害羞女孩

examples.text: Once there were 70 million buffalo on the plains.
examples.translation: 北美大平原上曾有过7,000万头野牛。

examples.text: The food was just plain terrible.
examples.translation: 这食物实在太难吃了。

examples.text: Is it love of publicity or plain stupidity on her part?
examples.translation: 她是喜欢抛头露面，还是太过愚蠢了呢？

examples.text: Why couldn't they call you plain Ann or Alice like the rest?
examples.translation: 他们为什么不能像其他人一样，给你取个普普通通的安或艾丽斯的名字呢？

examples.text: Three officers in plain clothes told me to get out of the car.
examples.translation: 3名便衣警察让我下车。

examples.text: The three leaders had worked out a peace plan...
examples.translation: 3位领导人已制订出了一个和平方案。

examples.text: The project is part of a United Nations plan for refugees.
examples.translation: 该项目是联合国难民计划的一部分。

examples.text: ...a detailed plan of action for restructuring the group...
examples.translation: 改组该集团的详细行动计划

examples.text: He maintains that everything is going according to plan.
examples.translation: 他坚称一切都在按计划进行。

examples.text: If you plan what you're going to eat, you reduce your chances of overeating...
examples.translation: 如果计划一下要吃什么，就有可能不会吃得过多。

examples.text: He planned to leave Baghdad on Monday...
examples.translation: 他计划周一离开巴格达。

examples.text: It would be difficult for schools to plan for the future...
examples.translation: 学校很难筹划未来。

examples.text: I had been planning a trip to the West Coast...
examples.translation: 我一直计划去趟西海岸。

examples.text: A planned demonstration has been called off by its organisers.
examples.translation: 原定的游行示威已被组织者取消。

examples.text: 'I'm sorry,' she said. 'I have plans for tonight.'
examples.translation: “抱歉，”她说，“我今晚有安排了。”

examples.text: The government is making plans to evacuate more than two hundred of its citizens from the troubled area.
examples.translation: 政府打算疏散200多名留在骚乱地区的公民。

examples.text: We are planning a new kitchen.
examples.translation: 我们在设计新厨房。

examples.text: ...when you have drawn a plan of the garden.
examples.translation: 当你画出花园的平面图后

meanings.meaning: (Planet)人名；(法)普拉内；(西、葡)普拉内特

examples.text: The picture shows six of the eight planets in the solar system.
examples.translation: 这幅图标示了太阳系八大行星中的6颗。

meanings.meaning: 刨平；用刨子刨；掠过水面

examples.text: He had plenty of time to catch his plane...
examples.translation: 他有足够的时间赶飞机。

examples.text: Her mother was killed in a plane crash.
examples.translation: 她母亲在一次坠机中遇难。

examples.text: ...fighter planes.
examples.translation: 战斗机

examples.text: ...a building with angled planes.
examples.translation: 带有坡面的建筑物

examples.text: All the planets orbit the Sun in roughly the same plane, round its equator.
examples.translation: 所有的行星大致在同一平面上绕太阳赤道运转。

examples.text: ...life on a higher plane of existence...
examples.translation: 更高境界的生活

examples.text: We felt we were living life on several different planes.
examples.translation: 我们感到大家生活的精神层次各不相同。

examples.text: She watches him plane the surface of a walnut board...
examples.translation: 她看着他刨平一块胡桃木板。

examples.text: Again I planed the surface flush.
examples.translation: 我又一次把表面刨平。

examples.text: The piece was reduced in size by planing down the four corners.
examples.translation: 这块木头的4个角刨过后就变小了。

examples.text: All four of the boats planed across the Solent with the greatest of ease.
examples.translation: 4艘船都极其自如地掠过索伦特海峡。

meanings.meaning: 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼

examples.text: Water each plant as often as required.
examples.translation: 按要求经常给每一株植物浇水。

examples.text: ...exotic plants.
examples.translation: 异域植物

examples.text: He says he plans to plant fruit trees and vegetables.
examples.translation: 他说他打算种植果树和蔬菜。

examples.text: Extensive flooding in the country has delayed planting and many crops are still under water.
examples.translation: 这个国家大面积的水灾已延误了播种，而很多农作物还浸在水下。

examples.text: They plan to plant the area with grass and trees...
examples.translation: 他们计划在这一地区种草植树。

examples.text: Recently much of their energy has gone into planting a large vegetable garden.
examples.translation: 最近他们把很多精力投在种植大菜园上了。

examples.text: ...newly planted fields.
examples.translation: 刚栽种完的田地

examples.text: ...Ford's British car assembly plants...
examples.translation: 福特公司在英国的汽车装配厂

examples.text: The plant provides forty per cent of the country's electricity.
examples.translation: 全国总电量的40%是这家发电厂提供的。

examples.text: ...investment in plant and equipment.
examples.translation: 对机械设备的投资

examples.text: She planted her feet wide and bent her knees slightly.
examples.translation: 她双脚宽分站稳，膝盖微屈。

examples.text: ...with his enormous feet planted heavily apart.
examples.translation: 他的大脚重重地分开站好

examples.text: So far no one has admitted planting the bomb.
examples.translation: 到目前为止，还没有人承认是自己放了炸弹。

examples.text: He claimed that the drugs had been planted to incriminate him.
examples.translation: 他声称毒品是有人栽赃陷害他。

examples.text: Journalists informed police who planted an undercover detective to trap Smith.
examples.translation: 记者通知了警方，后者于是为诱捕史密斯而安插了一名卧底侦探。

examples.text: She planted a kiss on each of his leathery cheeks.
examples.translation: 她在他粗糙的面颊上左右各吻了一下。

examples.text: He hoped that he could plant the idea in such a way that Abramov would believe it was his own.
examples.translation: 他希望能把这个想法注入阿布拉莫夫的头脑，但要让他相信这是他自己的念头。

meanings.meaning: 适用于种植园或热带、亚热带国家的

examples.text: ...banana plantations in Costa Rica.
examples.translation: 哥斯达黎加的香蕉种植园

examples.text: ...a plantation of almond trees.
examples.translation: 人造扁桃树林

meanings.meaning: 减轻；粘贴；涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；使平服

examples.text: There were huge cracks in the plaster, and the green shutters were faded...
examples.translation: 灰泥上出现多条大裂缝，绿色百叶窗也褪色了。

examples.text: In the Mus d'Orsay in Paris is a sculpture in plaster by Rodin.
examples.translation: 巴黎的奥赛博物馆里有一件罗丹的石膏雕塑作品。

examples.text: The ceiling he had just plastered fell in and knocked him off his ladder.
examples.translation: 他刚抹上灰泥的天花板塌了，把他从梯子上砸了下来。

examples.text: They plastered the city with posters condemning her election...
examples.translation: 他们在城里到处张贴谴责她当选的海报。

examples.text: His room is plastered with pictures of Porsches and Ferraris.
examples.translation: 他的房间里贴满保时捷和法拉利车的图片。

examples.text: She plastered herself from head to toe in high factor sun lotion.
examples.translation: 她给自己从头到脚都抹上了强效防晒露。

meanings.meaning: 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的

examples.text: ...a wooden crate, sheltered from wetness by sheets of plastic...
examples.translation: 用塑料薄膜防潮的木板箱

examples.text: A lot of the plastics that carmakers are using cannot be recycled.
examples.translation: 汽车制造商使用的许多塑料制品是无法回收利用的。

examples.text: ...a black plastic bag.
examples.translation: 黑色塑料袋

examples.text: ...plastic airline food...
examples.translation: 航班上味同嚼蜡的食品

examples.text: When girls put on too much eye-shadow, they look plastic.
examples.translation: 女孩子如果把眼影涂得过重，看起来就不自然了。

examples.text: Using plastic to pay for an order is simplicity itself.
examples.translation: 用信用卡支付订单是很简单的事。

examples.text: ...shopping with their plastic money.
examples.translation: 用他们的信用卡购物

examples.text: The mud is smooth, gray, soft, and plastic as butter.
examples.translation: 这种泥浆呈灰色，它光滑、柔软，像黄油一样易塑。

examples.text: ...the plasticity of the flesh.
examples.translation: 肉体的可塑性

meanings.meaning: 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片
(Plate)人名；(英、德、俄、西、意、瑞典)普拉特

examples.text: Anita pushed her plate away; she had eaten virtually nothing.
examples.translation: 安妮塔把自己的盘子推开;她几乎什么都没吃。

examples.text: ...a huge plate of bacon and eggs.
examples.translation: 一大盘咸肉煎蛋

examples.text: ...dusty-looking cars with New Jersey plates.
examples.translation: 落满灰尘、挂着新泽西州牌照的汽车

examples.text: ...gold and silver plate, jewellery, and roomfuls of antique furniture.
examples.translation: 金银餐具、珠宝，还有整屋整屋的古董家具

examples.text: Fermor's book has 55 colour plates.
examples.translation: 弗莫尔的书里有55页整版彩色插图。

examples.text: The United States Geological Survey has revealed that the earthquake was not caused by a simple horizontal movement of one plate past another.
examples.translation: 美国地质调查局揭示了此次地震并非由大陆板块间简单的水平交错运动所引起。

examples.text: We have enough on our plate. There is plenty of work to be done on what we have.
examples.translation: 我们有很多工作要做。仅是手头现有的事情就已经有的忙了。

examples.text: Even the presidency was handed to him on a plate.
examples.translation: 他甚至连总统之位都是得来全不费工夫。

meanings.meaning: 高原；稳定水平；托盘；平顶女帽
达到平衡；达到稳定时期

examples.text: A broad valley opened up leading to a high, flat plateau of cultivated land.
examples.translation: 一条宽阔的山谷展现在眼前，通往一处平整的开垦地高原。

examples.text: The US heroin market now appears to have reached a plateau...
examples.translation: 美国的海洛因市场现在似乎已到了停滞期。

examples.text: I think the economy is stuck on a kind of plateau of slow growth.
examples.translation: 我认为经济将停留在缓慢发展的阶段。

examples.text: Evelyn's career is accelerating, and mine is plateauing out a bit...
examples.translation: 伊夫琳的职业生涯蒸蒸日上，而我的则停滞不前。

examples.text: The shares plateaued at 153p.
examples.translation: 股票稳定在153便士。

examples.text: Nick finished what he was saying and jumped down from the platform.
examples.translation: 尼克讲完后，从讲台上跳了下来。

examples.text: Some of these flood shelters are on raised platforms, which have allowed government helicopters to land amid the continuing floods...
examples.translation: 其中一些防洪棚搭建在高台上，高台可供政府的直升机在持续的洪水中降落。

examples.text: They found a spot on a rocky platform where they could pitch their tents.
examples.translation: 他们在一块岩石平台上找到了一个可以搭帐篷的地方。

examples.text: The train was about to leave and I was not even on the platform.
examples.translation: 火车就快开了，可我还没到站台。

examples.text: ...a platform of political and economic reforms...
examples.translation: 政治和经济改革纲领

examples.text: The Socialist Party won a landslide victory on a nationalist platform.
examples.translation: 社会党凭借民族主义政纲赢得了压倒性胜利。

examples.text: The demonstration provided a platform for a broad cross section of speakers.
examples.translation: 示威集会为具有广泛代表性的人士提供了发表意见的机会。

examples.text: I stood on the crowded back platform of the seven o'clock bus as it lurched along the wet damp street.
examples.translation: 我站在早晨7点那班公共汽车拥挤的后门处，随着它沿潮湿的街道蹒跚行进。

meanings.meaning: 貌似可信的，花言巧语的；貌似真实的，貌似有理的

examples.text: A more plausible explanation would seem to be that people are fed up with the Conservative government...
examples.translation: 貌似更加合理的解释似乎是，人们已经厌倦了保守党政府。

examples.text: That explanation seems entirely plausible to me.
examples.translation: 那个解释在我看来完全说得通。

examples.text: Having bluffed his way in without paying, he could not plausibly demand his money back.
examples.translation: 他没花钱就蒙混了进来，没道理再要求退钱。

examples.text: ...the plausibility of the theory.
examples.translation: 该理论的貌似合理性

examples.text: He was so plausible that he conned everybody.
examples.translation: 他那么会花言巧语，以至于骗过了所有的人。

examples.text: ...St Tropez, playground of the rich and famous.
examples.translation: 圣特罗佩，富豪和名流的游憩胜地

meanings.meaning: 游戏；扮演；演奏；播放；同…比赛
演奏；玩耍；上演；参加比赛

examples.text: ...invite the children round to play...
examples.translation: 邀请孩子们来玩

examples.text: They played in the little garden...
examples.translation: 他们在小花园里玩耍。

examples.text: Polly was playing with her teddy bear.
examples.translation: 波莉正在玩她的泰迪熊。

examples.text: ...a few hours of play until the babysitter takes them off to bed.
examples.translation: 几个小时的玩耍，直到保姆带他们去睡觉

examples.text: While the twins played cards, Francis sat reading...
examples.translation: 那对双胞胎玩扑克牌的时候，弗朗西斯坐着看书。

examples.text: Alain was playing cards with his friends...
examples.translation: 阿兰正和朋友打扑克牌。

examples.text: I used to play basketball...
examples.translation: 我过去常打篮球。

examples.text: I want to play for my country...
examples.translation: 我想代表自己的国家参加比赛。

examples.text: He captained the team but he didn't actually play.
examples.translation: 他是球队的队长，但实际上却并未上场。

examples.text: Both sides adopted the Continental style of play.
examples.translation: 双方都采用了欧陆式打法。

examples.text: Northern Ireland will play Latvia...
examples.translation: 北爱尔兰队将对阵拉脱维亚队。

examples.text: I've played against him a few times.
examples.translation: 我已多次和他交手。

examples.text: Fischer won after 5 hours and 41 minutes of play.
examples.translation: 经过5小时41分钟的较量，菲舍尔获得了胜利。

examples.text: Think first before playing the ball...
examples.translation: 踢出球前先想一想。

examples.text: Sikander Bakht played a bad shot...
examples.translation: 西坎德尔·巴克特击出一记坏球。

examples.text: I played the ball back slightly.
examples.translation: 我把球轻轻打了回去。

examples.text: Someone had played a trick on her, stretched a piece of string at the top of those steps...
examples.translation: 有人搞恶作剧整她，在最高的台阶上拉了一根绳子。

examples.text: I thought: 'This cannot be happening, somebody must be playing a joke'.
examples.translation: 我想：“这不可能发生，肯定是谁在开玩笑。”

examples.text: She stared at the floor, idly playing with the strap of her handbag.
examples.translation: 她眼睛盯着地板，漫不经心地摆弄着手提包的带子。

examples.text: The company put on a play about the homeless...
examples.translation: 这家剧团上演了一出讲述无家可归者的戏。

examples.text: It's my favourite Shakespeare play.
examples.translation: 它是我最喜欢的一部莎士比亚戏剧。

examples.text: ...Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, in which he played Hyde...
examples.translation: 他在其中饰演海德一角的《化身博士》

examples.text: His ambition is to play the part of Dracula.
examples.translation: 他渴望扮演德拉库拉。

examples.text: Hill tried to play the peacemaker...
examples.translation: 希尔想要充当和事佬。

examples.text: She was just playing the devoted mother...
examples.translation: 她只是装得像个尽心尽责的母亲似的。

examples.text: So you want to play nervous today?
examples.translation: 这么说你今天想装出一副紧张的样子了？

examples.text: Investors are playing it cautious, and they're playing it smart.
examples.translation: 投资者审慎精明地行事。

examples.text: Nina had been playing the piano...
examples.translation: 尼娜一直都在弹钢琴。

examples.text: Two people played jazz on a piano...
examples.translation: 两人联手在一架钢琴上演奏爵士乐。

examples.text: He played for me...
examples.translation: 他为我弹奏。

examples.text: Place your baby in her seat and play her a lullaby...
examples.translation: 把宝宝放到座位上，给她弹一首摇篮曲。

examples.text: The guitars played.
examples.translation: 吉他声响起。

examples.text: She played her records too loudly...
examples.translation: 她播放唱片时音量太大了。

examples.text: Every evening in those days the BBC played 'God Save The King'...
examples.translation: 那些日子里，英国广播公司每天晚上都会播放《天佑吾王》。

examples.text: The records were played on the radio...
examples.translation: 这些唱片在收音机里播放过。

examples.text: There is classical music playing in the background.
examples.translation: 背景里有古典音乐在播放。

examples.text: A band was playing...
examples.translation: 乐队在表演。

examples.text: He will play concerts in Amsterdam and Paris.
examples.translation: 他将在阿姆斯特丹和巴黎举办音乐会。

examples.text: The sun played on the frosty roofs.
examples.translation: 阳光在结霜的屋顶上闪烁变幻。

examples.text: What the hell are you playing at?
examples.translation: 你究竟在搞什么名堂？

examples.text: The real existence of a military option will come into play...
examples.translation: 存在选择军事手段的切实可能这一点将会起到作用。

examples.text: Breathing brings many muscles into play.
examples.translation: 呼吸使很多肌肉活动起来。

examples.text: They played a part in the life of their community...
examples.translation: 他们参与到了自己社区的生活中。

examples.text: The UN would play a major role in monitoring a ceasefire.
examples.translation: 联合国在监督停火方面会发挥重要作用。

examples.text: ...the role played by diet in disease.
examples.translation: 节食在疾病中扮演的角色

meanings.meaning: 恳求，请求；辩解，辩护；借口，托辞

examples.text: Mr Nicholas made his emotional plea for help in solving the killing.
examples.translation: 尼古拉斯先生恳请帮助以解决这起凶杀案。

examples.text: ...an impassioned plea to mankind to act to save the planet.
examples.translation: 让人类行动起来拯救这个星球的慷慨激昂的呼吁

examples.text: The judge questioned him about his guilty plea...
examples.translation: 法官就他的认罪答辩进行审问。

examples.text: We will enter a plea of not guilty...
examples.translation: 我们将进行无罪抗辩。

examples.text: Her plea of guilty to manslaughter through provocation was rejected.
examples.translation: 她因受到挑衅而过失杀人的有罪答辩被驳回。

examples.text: Phillips murdered his wife, but got off on a plea of insanity...
examples.translation: 菲利普斯谋杀了他的妻子，但以精神错乱为由逃脱了惩罚。

examples.text: Mr Dunn's pleas of poverty are only partly justified.
examples.translation: 邓恩先生贫穷的托词只是部分成立。

examples.text: The lady pleaded with her daughter to come back home...
examples.translation: 这位女士恳求她的女儿回家。

examples.text: He was kneeling on the floor pleading for mercy...
examples.translation: 他跪在地板上请求宽恕。

examples.text: 'Do not say that,' she pleaded...
examples.translation: 她恳求道：“别那么说。”

examples.text: I pleaded to be allowed to go.
examples.translation: 我请求准许离开。

examples.text: Morris had pleaded guilty to robbery.
examples.translation: 莫里斯已承认犯有抢劫罪。

examples.text: He appeared before the Committee to plead his case...
examples.translation: 他出现在委员会面前为自己辩护。

examples.text: He would plead the cause of Russian unity.
examples.translation: 他会公开支持俄罗斯的统一。

examples.text: Mr Burke, pleading poverty, changed his mind...
examples.translation: 伯克先生以自己穷为由改变了主意。

examples.text: Mr Giles pleads ignorance as his excuse...
examples.translation: 贾尔斯先生把不知情当作自己的借口。

examples.text: It was no defence to plead that they were only obeying orders.
examples.translation: 辩称他们只是在服从命令站不住脚。

meanings.meaning: 令人愉快的，舒适的；讨人喜欢的，和蔼可亲的

examples.text: I've got a pleasant little apartment...
examples.translation: 我有一套舒适的小公寓。

examples.text: It's always pleasant to do what you're good at doing.
examples.translation: 做自己擅长的事总是令人愉快的。

examples.text: We talked pleasantly of old times...
examples.translation: 我们愉快地谈着过去的时光。

examples.text: The room was pleasantly warm.
examples.translation: 这个房间温暖惬意。

examples.text: The woman had a pleasant face...
examples.translation: 这位女士面相和善。

examples.text: Lloyd George was most anxious to be agreeable and pleasant.
examples.translation: 劳埃德·乔治极力想表现得平易近人、和蔼亲切。

examples.text: Can you help us please?...
examples.translation: 能请你帮帮我们吗？

examples.text: Would you please open the door?...
examples.translation: 请你开一下门好吗？

examples.text: Please come in...
examples.translation: 请进。

examples.text: 'May I sit here?' — 'Please do.'...
examples.translation: “我能坐这儿吗？”——“请坐。”

examples.text: Can we have the bill please?
examples.translation: 劳驾，买单。

examples.text: 'Tea?' — 'Yes, please.'...
examples.translation: “要茶吗？”——“好的，谢谢。”

examples.text: 'You want an apple with your cheese?' — 'Please.'
examples.translation: “要不要加个苹果和奶酪一起吃？”——“行啊。”

examples.text: Please, Mary, this is all so unnecessary...
examples.translation: 玛丽，请不要这样，这完全没必要。

examples.text: Isabella. Please. I don't have time for this.
examples.translation: 伊莎贝拉，别再说了，我没有时间听这个。

examples.text: Please sir, can we have some more?...
examples.translation: 请问，先生，我们能再要一些吗？

examples.text: Please, Miss Smith, a moment.
examples.translation: 对不起，史密斯小姐，能耽误你一会儿吗？

examples.text: More than anything, I want to please you...
examples.translation: 最重要的是，我想让你高兴。

examples.text: Much of the food pleases rather than excites...
examples.translation: 这些食物中许多只是让人满意，但并不让人兴奋。

examples.text: It pleased him to talk to her.
examples.translation: 能和她交谈让他很高兴。

examples.text: Women should be free to dress and act as they please...
examples.translation: 女性应该有穿衣和行动的自由。

examples.text: He does whatever he pleases...
examples.translation: 他想干什么就干什么。

examples.text: Isabel can live where she pleases.
examples.translation: 伊莎贝尔可以喜欢住哪儿就住哪儿。

examples.text: He walked by my table and, casually as you please, picked up my address book...
examples.translation: 他走到我的桌旁，非常随意地拿起了我的通讯录。

examples.text: Bold as you please, she grabbed me by the sleeve.
examples.translation: 她真够大胆的，竟抓住了我的衣袖。

examples.text: Ladies and gentlemen, if you please. Miss Taylor's going to play for us...
examples.translation: 女士们，先生们，烦请泰勒小姐为我们表演。

examples.text: Sir Harry! Stop, if you please!
examples.translation: 哈里爵士！对不起，请等一下！

examples.text: She was pretty unforthcoming. Made Sally wait till she'd cooked Selby's lunch, if you please.
examples.translation: 她爱搭不理地把萨莉晾在一边，直到她为塞尔比做好午饭，你说怪不怪。

examples.text: 'Do you mind if I wait?' I asked. Melanie shrugged: 'Please yourself.'
examples.translation: 我问道：“要不我等会儿吧？”梅拉妮耸耸肩说：“随你便。”

meanings.meaning: 快乐；希望；娱乐；令人高兴的事

examples.text: Watching sport gave him great pleasure...
examples.translation: 观看体育比赛给他以极大的愉悦。

examples.text: Everybody takes pleasure in eating...
examples.translation: 每个人都从吃中得到满足感。

examples.text: He gets huge pleasure from ballet and contemporary dance.
examples.translation: 他从芭蕾和现代舞中得到极大的快乐。

examples.text: He mixed business and pleasure in a perfect and dynamic way...
examples.translation: 他以互动的方式将工作和娱乐完美地结合起来。

examples.text: I read for pleasure.
examples.translation: 我读书消遣。

examples.text: Watching TV is our only pleasure.
examples.translation: 看电视是我们唯一的乐事。

examples.text: ...the pleasure of seeing a smiling face.
examples.translation: 看到一张微笑的面孔的愉悦

examples.text: ...the conveniences and pleasures of modern life.
examples.translation: 现代生活的种种便利和乐趣

examples.text: 'A pleasure to meet you, sir,' he said...
examples.translation: 他说：“先生，很高兴见到您。”

examples.text: Mr and Mrs James Stephens request the pleasure of your company at the marriage of their daughter Caroline Mary to Mr David Smith.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯·斯蒂芬斯夫妇敬请您莅临小女卡罗琳·玛丽与戴维·史密斯先生的婚礼。

examples.text: 'Thanks very much anyhow.' — 'It's a pleasure.'
examples.translation: “无论怎样，非常感谢。”——“别客气。”

examples.text: 'Thanks for your call.' — 'My pleasure.'
examples.translation: “谢谢你打来电话。”——“不用谢。”

examples.text: 'Could you photocopy the advert and put it in the post to us?' — 'With pleasure John.'
examples.translation: “你能把广告影印一下寄给我们吗？”——“当然可以，约翰。”

meanings.meaning: 保证，誓言；抵押；抵押品，典当物
保证，许诺；用……抵押；举杯祝……健康

examples.text: The meeting ended with a pledge to step up cooperation between the six states of the region.
examples.translation: 会议以承诺加快这一地区六国间的合作而结束。

examples.text: ...a £1.1m pledge of support from the Spanish ministry of culture.
examples.translation: 来自西班牙文化部110万英镑的资助许诺

examples.text: Mr Dudley has pledged to give any award to charity...
examples.translation: 达德利先生已承诺将任何所获的损害赔偿额都捐给慈善机构。

examples.text: Philip pledges support and offers to help in any way that he can...
examples.translation: 菲利普保证给予支持，并主动提出尽其所能提供帮助。

examples.text: I pledge that by next year we will have the problem solved.
examples.translation: 我保证来年之前我们将解决这个问题。

examples.text: The French President is pledging $150 million in French aid next year...
examples.translation: 法国总统许诺为法国明年的援助经费拨款1.5亿美元。

examples.text: The government has now pledged £170m over the next six years for improving primary care.
examples.translation: 为了改善初级卫生保健工作，政府已承诺在未来6年内拨款1.7亿英镑。

examples.text: ...a pledge of forty two million dollars a month.
examples.translation: 每月拨款4,200万美元的承诺

examples.text: The President pledged himself to increase taxes for the rich but not the middle classes...
examples.translation: 总统保证增加对富人而非中产阶级的税收。

examples.text: Tony Cottee has pledged himself to Everton Football Club for another three years...
examples.translation: 托尼·科蒂已答应同埃弗顿足球俱乐部再续约3年。

examples.text: The treaties renounce the use of force and pledge the two countries to co-operation.
examples.translation: 条约声明放弃使用武力，并保证两国将进行合作。

examples.text: He asked her to pledge the house as security for a loan.
examples.translation: 他要她拿房子来抵押贷款。

examples.text: Fish are plentiful in the lake.
examples.translation: 这个湖里鱼很多。

examples.text: ...a plentiful supply of vegetables and salads and fruits.
examples.translation: 蔬菜、色拉和水果的充分供应

examples.text: Nettle grows plentifully on any rich waste ground.
examples.translation: 荨麻在任何肥沃的荒地上都能茂盛地生长。

examples.text: There was still plenty of time to take Jill out for pizza...
examples.translation: 还有充裕的时间带吉尔出去吃比萨饼。

examples.text: Most businesses face plenty of competition...
examples.translation: 大多数企业面临着巨大的竞争压力。

examples.text: Taking plenty of exercise can be of great benefit...
examples.translation: 多锻炼会非常有好处。

examples.text: Are there plenty of fresh fruits and vegetables in your diet?
examples.translation: 你的饮食中新鲜果蔬充足吗？

examples.text: I don't believe in long interviews. Fifteen minutes is plenty...
examples.translation: 我不认为面试该花很长时间，15分钟足够了。

examples.text: She's got plenty to do these days.
examples.translation: 现如今她有很多的事情要做。

examples.text: You are all fortunate to be growing up in a time of peace and plenty.
examples.translation: 你们都很幸运，成长在和平富足的时代。

examples.text: ...an area that has become a symbol of despair in the midst of America's plenty.
examples.translation: 在富庶的美国已成为绝望象征的一个地区

examples.text: The water looked plenty deep...
examples.translation: 这水看起来很深。

examples.text: The compartment is plenty big enough...
examples.translation: 这个隔间足够大了。

examples.text: Keep in mind you're going to be fighting lots of men who hit plenty hard.
examples.translation: 记住你要和许多出拳非常凶狠的人交手。

examples.text: There were thrills in plenty on Saturday at Terrassa, where Germany won the gold medal...
examples.translation: 周六的塔拉萨充满着紧张兴奋的气氛，德国队在此赢得了金牌。

examples.text: School inspectors visit regularly, finding everything satisfactory, books in plenty and five computer terminals.
examples.translation: 督学定期进行检查，发现所有方面都令人满意，教材充足，还有5台计算机终端设备。

examples.text: ...the worsening plight of Third World countries plagued by debts.
examples.translation: 受债务困扰的第三世界国家日益加深的苦境

examples.text: Security forces have uncovered a plot to overthrow the government...
examples.translation: 安全部队揭露了一起推翻政府的阴谋。

examples.text: He was responding to reports of an assassination plot against him.
examples.translation: 他正就有关针对他的暗杀阴谋的报道作出回应。

examples.text: Prosecutors in the trial allege the defendants plotted to overthrow the government...
examples.translation: 检方在审判中指称被告密谋推翻政府。

examples.text: The military were plotting a coup...
examples.translation: 军方正在策划一场政变。

examples.text: They are awaiting trial on charges of plotting against the state.
examples.translation: 他们因被指控阴谋叛乱而在候审。

examples.text: Yesterday's meeting was intended to plot a survival strategy for the party...
examples.translation: 昨天的会议旨在制订使该党能够继续存在下去的策略。

examples.text: For the next five years she plotted her career.
examples.translation: 她规划了自己今后5年的职业。

examples.text: I thought that I'd buy myself a small plot of land and build a house on it...
examples.translation: 我想我该给自己买一小块地，在上面建一座房子。

examples.text: The bottom of the garden was given over to vegetable plots.
examples.translation: 花园的尽头留作了菜地。

examples.text: We plot about eight points on the graph.
examples.translation: 我们在图表上绘制出大约8个点的曲线。

examples.text: We were trying to plot the course of the submarine.
examples.translation: 我们试图标绘出潜艇的航线图。

examples.text: They used a computer to plot the movements of everyone in the building.
examples.translation: 他们使用了一台计算机绘制这座建筑里每个人的活动图表。

examples.text: The Tories have lost the plot on law and order.
examples.translation: 保守党人在治安问题上不知所措。

examples.text: They ploughed nearly 100,000 acres of virgin moorland.
examples.translation: 他们犁了将近10万英亩未开垦的高沼地。

examples.text: ...a carefully ploughed field.
examples.translation: 仔细犁过的田地

examples.text: In Roman times November was a month of hard work in ploughing and sowing.
examples.translation: 在古罗马时期，11月是辛勤耕耘和播种的月份。

examples.text: There was not one inch of soil that was not under the plough.
examples.translation: 没有一寸土地未被开垦成耕地。

examples.text: ...as we put more and more wilderness under the plough.
examples.translation: 随着我们将越来越多的荒地开垦成耕地

meanings.meaning: 塞住；用插头将与电源接通

examples.text: She put the plug in the sink and filled it with cold water.
examples.translation: 她把水槽的塞子塞上，注满凉水。

examples.text: A plug had been inserted in the drill hole.
examples.translation: 钻孔已塞上了塞子。

examples.text: Crews are working to plug a major oil leak.
examples.translation: 船员正在封堵一个漏油的大洞。

examples.text: We did not want people on the show who are purely interested in plugging a book or film.
examples.translation: 我们不想让那些只想为书或电影做广告的人上节目。

examples.text: Let's do this show tonight and it'll be a great plug, a great promotion.
examples.translation: 我们今晚做这个节目吧，它会是一次很好的宣传、有力的推介。

examples.text: The banks have the power to pull the plug on the project.
examples.translation: 银行能让该工程下马。

examples.text: Plumber Keith Colthart, 24, admitted trying to sell two protected animals through the Ad Trader website.

meanings.meaning: 突然地下降；投入；陷入；跳进

examples.text: At least 50 people died when a bus plunged into a river...
examples.translation: 一辆公共汽车栽进河里，造成至少50人丧生。

examples.text: He ran down the steps to the pool terrace and plunged in.
examples.translation: 他跑下台阶来到泳池露台，纵身跳进池里。

examples.text: ...a plunge into cold water.
examples.translation: 一头跳入冰冷的水中

examples.text: A soldier plunged a bayonet into his body...
examples.translation: 一名士兵将刺刀插进了他的身体。

examples.text: She plunged her face into a bowl of cold water...
examples.translation: 她把脸扎进一盆凉水里。

examples.text: I plunged in my knife and fork.
examples.translation: 我插入了刀叉。

examples.text: The government's political and economic reforms threaten to plunge the country into chaos...
examples.translation: 政府的政治和经济改革可能会使国家陷入混乱局面。

examples.text: 8,000 homes were plunged into darkness as electricity cables crashed down...
examples.translation: 由于电缆损毁，8,000户家庭顿时落入一片黑暗之中。

examples.text: Eddy finds himself plunged into a world of brutal violence...
examples.translation: 埃迪发现自己被抛入了一个野蛮、暴力的世界。

examples.text: The economy is plunging into recession.
examples.translation: 经济正陷入萧条。

examples.text: That peace often looked like a brief truce before the next plunge into war.
examples.translation: 那种和平看起来常常像是再次陷入战争前的短暂休战。

examples.text: The two men plunged into discussion...
examples.translation: 两位男士立即投入到讨论中。

examples.text: The prince should be plunged into work...
examples.translation: 王子应该积极参与工作。

examples.text: Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into your career.
examples.translation: 抓住机会投身到事业中去。

examples.text: His sudden plunge into the field of international diplomacy is a major surprise.
examples.translation: 他突然投身国际外交界是一大意外。

examples.text: His weight began to plunge...
examples.translation: 他的体重开始锐减。

examples.text: The Pound plunged to a new low on the foreign exchange markets yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天在外汇市场上英镑骤跌至新低。

examples.text: Shares have plunged from £17 to £7.55...
examples.translation: 股票已从17英镑骤跌至7.55英镑。

examples.text: The bank's profits plunged by 87 per cent...
examples.translation: 银行的利润骤降了87%。

examples.text: Its net profits plunged 73% last year.
examples.translation: 去年，它的净利猛跌了73%。

examples.text: Japan's banks are in trouble because of bad loans and the stock market plunge.
examples.translation: 日本银行因呆账和股市暴跌而陷入困境。

examples.text: If you have been thinking about buying shares, now could be the time to take the plunge.
examples.translation: 如果你一直在考虑购买股票，现在或许是采取行动的最好时机。

examples.text: 'Data' is the Latin plural form of 'datum'.
examples.translation: data 在拉丁文中是 datum 的复数形式。

examples.text: ...his use of the plural pronoun 'we'.
examples.translation: 他对复数代词 we 的使用

examples.text: What is the plural of 'person'?
examples.translation: person 的复数形式是什么？

examples.text: ...irregular plurals.
examples.translation: 不规则复数形式

examples.text: Britain is a plural society in which the secular predominates...
examples.translation: 英国是个世俗主导的多元社会。

examples.text: His government has pledged to move the country towards a plural democracy.
examples.translation: 他的政府已承诺要推动本国朝着多元民主的方向发展。

examples.text: Send a cheque for £18.99 plus £2 for postage and packing...
examples.translation: 请寄上18.99英镑的支票，外加2英镑的邮资和包装费。

examples.text: They will pay about $673 million plus interest.
examples.translation: 他们将支付约6.73亿美元再加上利息。

examples.text: The aircraft was subjected to temperatures of minus 65 degrees and plus 120 degrees.
examples.translation: 这架飞机经历了零下65度和零上120度的温度变化。

examples.text: There's easily enough room for two adults and three children, plus a dog in the boot...
examples.translation: 能宽宽松松容下两个大人、三个孩子，而且后备箱里还可以放只狗。

examples.text: We had to have an actor who could generate real empathy. Plus he had to carry the audience through a lot of plot.
examples.translation: 我们得找一名能真正入戏的男演员，而且他还得能让观众跟上复杂的剧情中。

examples.text: There are only 35 staff to serve 30,000-plus customers...
examples.translation: 只有35名员工，却要为3万多顾客服务。

examples.text: Among the guests were 16 high-flying executives, all on salaries of £50,000 a year plus.
examples.translation: 客人中有16位极为成功的主管，年薪都超过了5万英镑。

examples.text: Experience of any career in sales is a big plus...
examples.translation: 任何销售领域的工作经验都是一大优势。

examples.text: There are plenty of plus points about being an older first-time mum.
examples.translation: 年龄稍长再做妈妈有很多好处。

meanings.meaning: 小型的，袖珍的；金钱上的

examples.text: He took his flashlight from his jacket pocket and switched it on...
examples.translation: 他从夹克口袋里拿出手电筒，打开开关。

examples.text: The man stood with his hands in his pockets.
examples.translation: 那个男人双手插在兜里站着。

examples.text: When you come to choosing a dining table, it really is worth digging deep into your pocket for the best you can afford.
examples.translation: 选购餐桌时，尽财力所能买最好的是很值得的。

examples.text: ...ladies' fashions to suit all shapes, sizes and pockets...
examples.translation: 适合所有体形、个头和财力的女士时装款式

examples.text: You would be buying a piece of history as well as a boat, if you put your hand in your pocket for this one...
examples.translation: 如果掏钱买下它的话，你所购买的将不仅仅是一艘船，还是一段历史。

examples.text: We don't believe that they have the economic reforms in place which would justify putting huge sums of Western money into their pockets.
examples.translation: 我们认为他们并没有让经济改革步入正轨，因此不存在把巨额西方资金送进他们口袋的正当理由。

examples.text: ...a pocket calculator.
examples.translation: 袖珍计算器

examples.text: ...my pocket edition of the Oxford English Dictionary.
examples.translation: 我的袖珍版《牛津英语词典》

examples.text: He survived the earthquake after spending 3 days in an air pocket...
examples.translation: 他在气窝里度过了3天，得以从地震中幸存。

examples.text: The army controls the city apart from a few pockets of resistance.
examples.translation: 除了一些零星的抵抗外，部队已控制了城市。

examples.text: Dishonest importers would be able to pocket the VAT collected from customers.
examples.translation: 不诚实的进口商将会能够把从顾客那里收取的增值税据为己有。

examples.text: He pocketed more money from this tournament than in his entire three years as a professional.
examples.translation: 他在这次锦标赛上获得的奖金比他整整3年职业生涯的收入都多。

examples.text: Anthony snatched his letters and pocketed them...
examples.translation: 安东尼抓过他的信，塞入了口袋。

examples.text: He pocketed a wallet containing £40 cash from the bedside of a dead man.
examples.translation: 他把从一名死者床边拿到的装有40英镑现金的钱包藏进了口袋。

examples.text: It's Saturday, you're down the high street and you've got a few quid burning a hole in your pocket.
examples.translation: 周六走在商街上，口袋里有几个钱忍不住想要花掉。

examples.text: The board of directors must surely have been in Johnstone's pocket.
examples.translation: 董事会肯定已被约翰斯通掌控了。

examples.text: It is estimated that 5,000 bank staff could be lining their own pockets from customer accounts.
examples.translation: 据估计可能会有5,000名银行职员利用客户账户中饱私囊。

examples.text: ...a government that ignores the needs of the majority in order to line the pockets of the favoured few.
examples.translation: 无视大多数人的需要以为少数特权者牟利的政府

examples.text: They were well out of pocket — they had spent far more in Hollywood than he had earned...
examples.translation: 他们非常缺钱——他们在好莱坞的花费已经远远超出了他的收入。

examples.text: Statements with errors could still be going out, but customers who notify us will not be left out of pocket.
examples.translation: 存在错误的结算单仍有可能发送出去，但告知我们的客户将不会遭受损失。

examples.text: They were more in danger of having their pockets picked than being shot at.
examples.translation: 比起遭到枪击，他们被人扒窃的危险更大。

examples.text: When everyone was released, after five months, he wrote a satirical poem about his fellow-inmates.
He was a painter and poet.
examples.translation: 他既是画家又是诗人。

examples.text: She nearly died of pneumonia.
examples.translation: 她差点儿死于肺炎。

examples.text: ...Russian poetry...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯诗歌

examples.text: Lawrence Durrell wrote a great deal of poetry...
examples.translation: 劳伦斯·达雷尔创作了大量的诗歌。

examples.text: Since when have you been interested in poetry?
examples.translation: 你从什么时候开始对诗歌感兴趣的？

examples.text: His music is purer poetry than a poem in words.
examples.translation: 他的音乐比真正的诗歌更具诗意。

meanings.meaning: 污染；使中毒，放毒于；败坏；阻碍
毒药，毒物；酒；有毒害的事物；[助剂] 抑制剂

examples.text: Poison from the weaver fish causes paralysis, swelling, and nausea...
examples.translation: 龙的毒素会引起瘫痪、肿胀和恶心。

examples.text: Mercury is a known poison.
examples.translation: 水银是一种已知的有毒物质。

examples.text: The rumours that she had poisoned him could never be proved.
examples.translation: 她曾下毒害他的谣言永远都无法得到证实。

examples.text: She was sentenced to twenty years' imprisonment for poisoning and attempted murder.
examples.translation: 她因投毒和谋杀未遂被判20年监禁。

examples.text: Employees were taken to hospital yesterday after being poisoned by fumes...
examples.translation: 因吸入有害气体而中毒的员工昨天被送进了医院。

examples.text: Toxic waste could endanger lives and poison fish.
examples.translation: 有毒废物可能危及生命，毒死鱼类。

examples.text: ...acute alcohol poisoning...
examples.translation: 急性酒精中毒

examples.text: His illness was initially diagnosed as food poisoning.
examples.translation: 他的病最初被诊断为食物中毒。

examples.text: If I was your wife I would poison your coffee.
examples.translation: 如果我是你老婆，我会在你的咖啡里下毒。

examples.text: He was terrified to eat, suspecting that the food was poisoned.
examples.translation: 他不敢吃东西，怀疑食物被人投了毒。

examples.text: ...an umbrella tipped with a poisoned dart.
examples.translation: 伞尖装有毒镖的雨伞

examples.text: ...the textile and fibre industries that taint the air, poison the water and use vast amounts of natural resources...
examples.translation: 污染空气、破坏水源并消耗大量自然资源的纺织纤维工业

examples.text: The land has been completely poisoned by chemicals.
examples.translation: 土地已被化学品彻底污染。

examples.text: ...dying forests, poisoned rivers and lakes.
examples.translation: 正在消失的森林、遭污染的河流和湖泊

examples.text: The whole atmosphere has really been poisoned.
examples.translation: 整个气氛已全然遭到破坏。

examples.text: ...ill-feeling that will poison further talk of a common foreign policy.
examples.translation: 将会危害有关共同外交政策的进一步商讨的敌意

examples.text: All parts of the yew tree are poisonous, including the berries.
examples.translation: 紫杉的各个部分都有毒，包括浆果。

examples.text: ...a large cloud of poisonous gas.
examples.translation: 一大团有毒气体

examples.text: There are hundreds of poisonous spiders and snakes.
examples.translation: 毒蜘蛛和毒蛇成百上千。

examples.text: ...poisonous comments.
examples.translation: 恶毒的评论

examples.text: ...lying awake half the night tormented by poisonous suspicions.
examples.translation: 醒着躺了半宿，为卑劣的猜疑所折磨

examples.text: ...poisonous attacks on the state-run church.
examples.translation: 对国立教堂的恶意攻击

meanings.meaning: 要点；得分；标点；[机] 尖端

examples.text: We disagree with every point Mr Blunkett makes...
examples.translation: 布伦基特先生提出的观点我们一个都不同意。

examples.text: Dave Hill's article makes the right point about the Taylor Report...
examples.translation: 戴夫·希尔的文章对《泰勒报告》的看法是正确的。

examples.text: The following tale will clearly illustrate this point.
examples.translation: 接下来的故事将清楚地阐明这一点。

examples.text: 'If he'd already killed once, surely he'd have killed Sarah?' She had a point there...
examples.translation: “如果他杀过一次人，那他一定已经杀了萨拉吧？”她说得有道理。

examples.text: Oh I take your point, John, about that.
examples.translation: 噢，约翰，关于那一点，我觉得你说得对。

examples.text: 'Did I ask you to talk to me?' — 'That's not the point.'...
examples.translation: “我请你跟我谈了吗？”——“问题不在这儿。”

examples.text: The American Congress and media mostly missed the point about all this.
examples.translation: 美国国会和媒体大都没搞清这一切的核心问题。

examples.text: What was the point of thinking about him?...
examples.translation: 想他有什么用呢？

examples.text: There was no point in staying any longer.
examples.translation: 再留下来就没有意义了。

examples.text: Many of the points in the report are correct...
examples.translation: 报告中的很多细节是正确的。

examples.text: The most interesting point about the village was its religion...
examples.translation: 这个村庄最有意思的地方就是它的宗教。

examples.text: Science was never my strong point at school.
examples.translation: 我上学时理科从来都不是我的强项。

examples.text: As a mark of respect the emperor met him at a point several weeks' march from the capital...
examples.translation: 出于尊重，皇帝在离首都还有几个星期路程的地方迎接了他。

examples.text: The pain originated from a point in his right thigh.
examples.translation: 疼痛是从他右大腿的某处开始的。

examples.text: We're all going to die at some point...
examples.translation: 我们都将在某个时间死去。

examples.text: At one point, around 70,000 members had failed to pay...
examples.translation: 一度曾有约7万名成员没有支付费用。

examples.text: At this point Diana arrived...
examples.translation: 这时候，戴安娜到了。

examples.text: It got to the point where he had to leave.
examples.translation: 到了他不得不走的地步。

examples.text: This is FM stereo one oh three point seven...
examples.translation: 这里是调频立体声103.7。

examples.text: Inflation at nine point four percent is the worst for eight years.
examples.translation: 9.4%的通货膨胀率是8年来最糟的。

examples.text: They lost the 1977 World Cup final to Australia by a single point...
examples.translation: 他们在1977年的世界杯决赛中仅以一分之差输给了澳大利亚队。

examples.text: Chamberlain scored 50 or more points four times in the season.
examples.translation: 张伯伦在赛季中有4次得分不低于50。

examples.text: Sightseers arrived from all points of the compass.
examples.translation: 观光者来自四面八方。

examples.text: ...the rattle of the wheels across the points.
examples.translation: 驶过道岔的车轮发出的哐啷哐啷声

examples.text: ...too far away from the nearest electrical point.
examples.translation: 离最近的电掣位也太远

examples.text: I pointed at the boy sitting nearest me...
examples.translation: 我指了指坐得离我最近的男孩。

examples.text: He pointed at me with the stem of his pipe...
examples.translation: 他用烟斗柄指着我。

examples.text: He pointed to a chair, signalling for her to sit.
examples.translation: 他指向一把椅子，示意她坐下。

examples.text: David Khan pointed his finger at Mary...
examples.translation: 戴维·卡恩用手指指着玛丽。

examples.text: A man pointed a gun at them and pulled the trigger.
examples.translation: 一名男子用手枪指着他们，扣动了扳机。

examples.text: An arrow pointed to the toilets...
examples.translation: 箭头指向卫生间。

examples.text: You can go anywhere and still the compass points north or south...
examples.translation: 无论走到哪里，罗盘仍然指向北或南。

examples.text: He controlled the car until it was pointing forwards again.
examples.translation: 他稳住车子，直到它又朝前开去。

examples.text: Earlier reports pointed to pupils working harder, more continuously, and with enthusiasm...
examples.translation: 早些时候的报告显示学生学习更为刻苦、持久，并且怀有学习热情。

examples.text: Private polls and embassy reports pointed to a no vote.
examples.translation: 私人民意调查和使馆报告表明投票结果将会是否决。

examples.text: George Fodor points to other weaknesses in the way the campaign has progressed...
examples.translation: 乔治·福多尔以运动开展过程中的其他不足为证。

examples.text: Gooch last night pointed to their bowling as the key to World Cup success.
examples.translation: 古奇昨晚指出，他们的投球是在世界杯上取得成功的关键。

examples.text: Brian didn't like it, but that was beside the point.
examples.translation: 布赖恩不喜欢它，但那并不重要。

examples.text: He came to the point at once. 'You did a splendid job on this case.'...
examples.translation: 他立刻切入正题道：“这件案子你处理得很棒。”

examples.text: Was she ever going to get to the point?
examples.translation: 她到底还会不会讲到重点？

examples.text: I think you've made your point, dear...
examples.translation: 亲爱的，我想你已证明你的观点了。

examples.text: Dr David McCleland, of Boston University, studied one-hundred people, aged eighteen to sixty, to prove the point...
examples.translation: 为证明这一点，波士顿大学的戴维·麦克莱兰博士对100名年龄在18至60岁之间的人进行了研究。

examples.text: The tie-break proved the point.
examples.translation: 决胜局证明了这一点。

examples.text: She made a point of spending as much time as possible away from Osborne House.
examples.translation: 她特意尽可能地不呆在奥斯本庄园。

examples.text: He was on the point of saying something when the phone rang...
examples.translation: 他正要说话时电话铃响了。

examples.text: She looked on the point of tears.
examples.translation: 她看起来就要哭了。

examples.text: Mr. Baker was smiling and to the point...
examples.translation: 贝克先生微笑着，说得很中肯。

examples.text: The description which he had been given was brief and to the point.
examples.translation: 给他的描述言简意赅。

examples.text: 'Was she good?' — 'Mmm. Up to a point.'
examples.translation: “她行不行？”——“嗯，某种程度上来说还可以。”

examples.text: It worked up to a point.
examples.translation: 它起了一定作用。

examples.text: Lindy poked him in the ribs.
examples.translation: 琳迪戳了戳他的肋部。

examples.text: John smiled at them and gave Richard a playful poke.
examples.translation: 约翰冲着他们笑了笑，开玩笑地捅了理查德一下。

examples.text: He poked his finger into the hole.
examples.translation: 他把手指插入孔中。

examples.text: He saw the dog's twitching nose poke out of the basket...
examples.translation: 他看到那只狗一抽一抽的鼻子从篮子里冒出来。

examples.text: His fingers poked through the worn tips of his gloves.
examples.translation: 他的手指从手套的破指尖处露了出来。

examples.text: Julie tapped on my door and poked her head in...
examples.translation: 朱莉轻轻地敲了敲我的门，探进头来。

examples.text: We hadn't been able to poke our heads out and see what was going on...
examples.translation: 我们无法伸出头去，看看发生了什么。

examples.text: Raymond's head poked through the doorway.
examples.translation: 雷蒙德的头从门口探了出来。

meanings.meaning: 极地的；两极的；正好相反的

examples.text: ...the rigours of life in the polar regions...
examples.translation: 在极地地区生活的艰苦

examples.text: Warmth melted some of the polar ice.
examples.translation: 温暖的天气融化了一些极地的冰雪。

examples.text: ...polar explorers.
examples.translation: 极地探险者

examples.text: In many ways, Brett and Bernard are polar opposites.
examples.translation: 在许多方面，布雷特和伯纳德截然不同。

examples.text: ...economists at polar ends of the politico-economic spectrum.
examples.translation: 政治经济观点完全对立的经济学家

examples.text: The truck crashed into a telegraph pole...\n
examples.translation: 卡车撞到了电线杆上。

examples.text: He reached up with a hooked pole to roll down the metal shutter.\n
examples.translation: 他用带钩的杆子把金属护窗拉了下来。

examples.text: For six months of the year, there is hardly any light at the poles.\n
examples.translation: 在南北极，每年有6个月时间几乎没有光照。

examples.text: The two politicians represent opposite poles of the political spectrum.\n
examples.translation: 这两位从政者代表了政界的两个极端。

examples.translation: 由托妮·帕默精彩演绎的胸部丰满、吵吵嚷嚷的霍尔太太

examples.text: ...this northern novelist, who accurately portrays provincial domestic life.
examples.translation: 这位准确描述外省家庭生活的北方小说家

examples.text: ...the landscape as portrayed by painters such as Claude and Poussin.
examples.translation: 克劳德和普桑等画家所描绘的风景

examples.text: She says the programme portrayed her as a 'lady of easy virtue'.
examples.translation: 她说这个节目把她刻画成了一个“水性杨花的女人”。

examples.text: ...complaints about the way women are portrayed in adverts.
examples.translation: 抗议在广告中如此刻画女性

meanings.meaning: 造成，形成；摆姿势；装模作样；提出…讨论

examples.text: This could pose a threat to jobs in the coal industry...
examples.translation: 这可能会给煤炭产业的就业造成威胁。

examples.text: His ill health poses serious problems for the future.
examples.translation: 他身体不好，对将来造成严重的隐患。

examples.text: When I finally posed the question, 'Why?' he merely shrugged.
examples.translation: 当我最后问“为什么”时，他只是耸了耸肩。

examples.text: ...the moral issues posed by new technologies.
examples.translation: 新技术带来的道德问题

examples.text: The team posed as drug dealers to trap the ringleaders.
examples.translation: 该队队员装扮成毒品贩子，诱捕罪犯头目。

examples.text: Before going into their meeting the six foreign ministers posed for photographs.
examples.translation: 开会前，6位外交部长合影留念。

examples.text: He criticized them for dressing outrageously and posing pretentiously.
examples.translation: 他批评她们衣着暴露而且矫揉造作。

examples.text: We have had several preliminary sittings in various poses.
examples.translation: 我们进行了几次预拍摄，摆了各种不同的造型。

examples.text: In many writers modesty is a pose, but in Ford it seems to have been genuine.
examples.translation: 很多作家都是故作谦虚，但福特却似乎表里如一。

meanings.meaning: 位置，方位；职位，工作；姿态；站位

examples.text: The ship was identified, and its name and position were reported to the coastguard...
examples.translation: 那艘船已找到，其名字和位置已报告给海岸警卫队。

examples.text: This conservatory enjoys an enviable position overlooking a leafy expanse.
examples.translation: 这个温室位置绝佳，放眼望去，草木繁茂，郁郁葱葱。

examples.text: Hold the upper back and neck in an erect position to give support for the head...
examples.translation: 挺直上背部和脖子来支撑头部

examples.text: Ensure the patient is turned into the recovery position...
examples.translation: 确保使患者处于复苏体位。

examples.text: Mr. Dambar had raised himself to a sitting position.
examples.translation: 丹巴尔先生已坐了起来。

examples.text: Position trailing plants near the edges and in the sides of the basket to hang down...
examples.translation: 把蔓生植株靠边放，使其从篮子的四面垂下。

examples.text: Place the pastry circles on to a baking sheet and position one apple on each circle.
examples.translation: 把油酥面圈放到烘烤盘上，每个上面放一个苹果。

examples.text: ...the position of older people in society.
examples.translation: 老年人在社会中的地位

examples.text: He left a career in teaching to take up a position with the Arts Council...
examples.translation: 他辞去教学工作到艺术委员会任职。

examples.text: Hyundai said this week it is scaling back its U.S. operations by eliminating 50 positions.
examples.translation: 现代公司本周表示其美国分公司准备裁掉50个职位以缩小经营规模。

examples.text: Agassi and Sampras resumed their battle for the world's No. 1 position, both winning their opening matches...
examples.translation: 阿加西和桑普拉斯继续他们对世界第一宝座的争夺，两人在首场比赛中均获得胜利。

examples.text: By the ninth hour the car was running in eighth position.
examples.translation: 到第9个小时的时候，这辆车位列第8。

examples.text: He's going to be in a very difficult position indeed if things go badly for him...
examples.translation: 如果事情进展不顺利的话，他的处境将非常艰难。

examples.text: Companies should be made to reveal more about their financial position...
examples.translation: 应该要求公司使其财务状况更为透明化。

examples.text: It was not the only time he found himself in this position.
examples.translation: 他已不是第一次察觉自己陷入如此境地了。

examples.text: He could be depended on to take a moderate position on most of the key issues...
examples.translation: 他应该会在大部分关键问题上采取中间立场。

examples.text: Mr Howard is afraid to state his true position on the republic, which is that he is opposed to it.
examples.translation: 霍华德先生不敢表明自己对共和体制持反对态度的真实立场。

examples.text: The UN system will be in a position to support the extensive relief efforts needed...
examples.translation: 联合国将能满足全面救济需求。

examples.text: I am not in a position to comment.
examples.translation: 我不便发表评论。

examples.text: This second door is an extra security measure and can be locked in position during the day...
examples.translation: 这第二道门是又一项安全措施，白天可以上锁。

examples.text: Some 28,000 US troops are moving into position.
examples.translation: 约2.8万人的美国军队即将部署到位。

meanings.meaning: 积极的；[数] 正的，[医][化学] 阳性的；确定的，肯定的；实际的，真实的；绝对的

examples.text: Be positive about your future and get on with living a normal life...
examples.translation: 要对自己的未来充满信心，继续过一种正常的生活。

examples.text: Her husband became much more positive and was soon back in full-time employment.
examples.translation: 她丈夫自信大增，不久便重新开始全职工作。

examples.text: ...a positive frame of mind.
examples.translation: 积极的心态

examples.text: You really must try to start thinking positively.
examples.translation: 你真的必须努力开始以一种积极的心态思考问题了。

examples.text: The parting from his sister had a positive effect on John...
examples.translation: 和姐姐分开对约翰来说有好处。

examples.text: Working abroad should be an exciting and positive experience for all concerned.
examples.translation: 在海外工作对所有相关人员来说都应该是一段让人兴奋而愉快的经历。

examples.text: Work on the positive, creating beautiful, loving and fulfilling relationships.
examples.translation: 致力于好的方面，努力营造美好的、友爱的、令人满意的关系。

examples.text: There are positive changes that should be implemented in the rearing of animals...
examples.translation: 应该对动物饲养进行明确的改革。

examples.text: He was expected to make a very positive contribution to the 1996 Games organisation...
examples.translation: 人们期待他为1996年奥运会的组织做出积极的贡献。

examples.text: Having a good diet gives me a sense that I'm doing something positive and that I'm in control.
examples.translation: 合理膳食让我感觉自己并非无所作为且能安排好自己的生活。

examples.text: There's been a positive response to the UN Secretary-General's recent peace efforts.
examples.translation: 联合国秘书长近期为和平所作出的努力得到了积极的回应。

examples.text: He responded positively and accepted the fee of £1,000 I had offered.
examples.translation: 他作出了肯定的答复，并接受了我给的1，000英镑的费用。

examples.text: I'm as positive as I can be about it...
examples.translation: 我对它有绝对的把握。

examples.text: 'She's never late. You sure she said eight?' — 'Positive.'
examples.translation: “她从不迟到，你肯定她说的是8点？”——“肯定。”

examples.text: There was no positive evidence that any birth defects had arisen as a result of Vitamin A intake.
examples.translation: 没有确凿证据证明，摄取维生素A会导致出生缺陷。

examples.text: He has positively identified the body as that of his wife.
examples.translation: 他已确认那是他妻子的尸体。

examples.text: If the test is positive, a course of antibiotics may be prescribed...
examples.translation: 如果化验结果呈阳性，可能会开一个疗程的抗生素。

examples.text: He was stripped of his Olympic Hundred Metres gold medal after testing positive for steroids.
examples.translation: 类固醇检测呈阳性后，他的奥运百米金牌被收回。

examples.text: Good day to you, Bernard! It's a positive delight to see you...
examples.translation: 你好，伯纳德！见到你真高兴。

examples.text: He was in a positive fury...
examples.translation: 他确实发怒了。

examples.text: The man was being a positive embarrassment.
examples.translation: 这位男士极为尴尬。

examples.text: It's really a simple numbers game with negative and positive numbers.
examples.translation: 它其实就是正负数的简单数字游戏。

examples.text: ...positively charged ions.
examples.translation: 阳离子

meanings.meaning: 控制；使掌握；持有；迷住；拥有，具备

examples.text: He was then arrested and charged with possessing an offensive weapon...
examples.translation: 他随后被逮捕，并被控拥有攻击性武器。

examples.text: He is said to possess a fortune of more than two-and-a-half-thousand million dollars.
examples.translation: 据说他拥有超出25亿美元的财富。

examples.text: ...individuals who are deemed to possess the qualities of sense, loyalty and discretion...
examples.translation: 被认为具备了理性、忠诚和判断力的人

examples.text: This figure has long been held to possess miraculous power.
examples.translation: 这个数字长时间以来都被认为拥有神奇的力量。

examples.text: Absolute terror possessed her...
examples.translation: 她恐惧到了极点。

examples.text: Tsvetayeva was possessed by a frenzied urge to get out of Moscow.
examples.translation: 茨维塔耶娃内心有一种想要离开莫斯科的狂热冲动。

examples.text: What on earth had possessed her to agree to marry him?
examples.translation: 究竟是什么让她同意嫁给他的？

meanings.meaning: 拥有；财产；领地；自制；着迷

examples.text: Those documents are now in the possession of the Guardian...
examples.translation: 那些文件目前在《卫报》手里。

examples.text: We should go up and take possession of the land...
examples.translation: 我们应该北上占领那片土地。

examples.text: He was also charged with illegal possession of firearms...
examples.translation: 他还被控非法持有枪支。

examples.text: Religious pamphlets were found in their possession.
examples.translation: 他们被发现持有宗教宣传册。

examples.text: People had lost their homes and all their possessions...
examples.translation: 人们失去了自己的家园和所有的财物。

examples.text: She had tidied away her possessions.
examples.translation: 她已收拾好个人物品。

examples.text: All of them were French possessions at one time or another.
examples.translation: 它们都曾是法国的领地。

examples.text: ...Britain's imperial possessions.
examples.translation: 大英帝国的属地

examples.text: They were convinced the girls' behaviour was due to possession by the devil.
examples.translation: 他们相信了这些女孩之所以有如此举动是因为鬼魂附体。

meanings.meaning: 可能性；可能发生的事物

examples.text: We were not in the least worried about the possibility that sweets could rot the teeth...
examples.translation: 我们以前完全不担心吃糖果有可能会蛀牙。

examples.text: Tax on food has become a very real possibility.
examples.translation: 极有可能征收食物税。

examples.text: The government now owns a lot of our land — one possibility would be to compensate us with other property...
examples.translation: 政府现在占了我们的大量土地，一种可能是用其他地产来对我们作出补偿。

examples.text: There were several possibilities open to each manufacturer.
examples.translation: 每个制造商都可以有几种不同的选择。

examples.text: It's not beyond the realms of possibility that the security services do bug important public figures.
examples.translation: 安全部门完全有可能窃听重要公众人物的谈话。

meanings.meaning: 可能性；合适的人；可能的事物

examples.text: If it is possible to find out where your brother is, we shall...
examples.translation: 如果能找出你兄弟在哪儿，我们就会去找。

examples.text: Everything is possible if we want it enough...
examples.translation: 只要我们有足够的信念，任何事情都是有可能的。

examples.text: This morning he had tried every way possible to contact her...
examples.translation: 他今天早晨已想尽办法与她联系。

examples.text: Live as you like, leave home if you want — that was never possible when I was young...
examples.translation: 随心所欲地生活，不想在家呆着就离开——我年轻的时候，这可根本不可能。

examples.text: It's been a beautiful evening and you have made it all possible.
examples.translation: 那是个美好的夜晚，你让一切成为可能。

examples.text: He referred the matter to the Attorney General for possible action against several newspapers...
examples.translation: 他把对几家报纸可能提起诉讼的事宜提交首席检察官来处理。

examples.text: Her family is discussing a possible move to America...
examples.translation: 她的家人在讨论移居美国的可能。

examples.text: One possible solution, if all else fails, is to take legal action...
examples.translation: 如果其他办法都不行，还有一种可能是提起诉讼。

examples.text: Is this not a possible outcome of the development of genetically modified food?
examples.translation: 这难道不是转基因食品开发可能会导致的一种结果吗？

examples.text: It is possible that there's an explanation for all this...
examples.translation: 也许，对于所有这一切，会有一种解释。

examples.text: It was possible that Harry himself did not know what he had intended to do.
examples.translation: 可能哈里本人都不清楚自己意欲何为。

examples.text: Please make your decision as soon as possible...
examples.translation: 请尽快作决定。

examples.text: I want to learn as much as possible about the industry so that I'm better prepared...
examples.translation: 我想尽可能多学一些关于这个行业的知识，让自己更有备无患。

examples.text: Michael sat down as far away from her as possible...
examples.translation: 迈克尔尽可能坐得离她远些。

examples.text: Buy fresh produce as often as possible.
examples.translation: 尽量常买新鲜农产品。

examples.text: They have joined the job market at the worst possible time...
examples.translation: 他们在最不景气的时候进入了就业市场。

examples.text: We expressed in the clearest possible way our disappointment, hurt and anger...
examples.translation: 我们清楚明白地表达了我们的失望、伤心和愤怒。

examples.text: He is doing the best job possible.
examples.translation: 他干得真是太漂亮了。

examples.text: I need to see you, right away if possible.
examples.translation: 我要见你，如果可能，马上。

examples.text: ...the moral duty to uphold peace if at all possible.
examples.translation: 只要有可能就应维护和平的道义责任

examples.text: Government sources are now openly speculating about a possible successor for Dr Lawrence...
examples.translation: 官方消息人士在公开推测谁有可能成为接任劳伦斯博士的人选。

examples.text: Bradley has been considered a possible presidential contender himself.
examples.translation: 布拉德利本人就被认为是总统职位的有力竞争者。

examples.text: Kennedy, who divorced wife Joan in 1982, was tipped as a presidential possible...
examples.translation: 有人预测，1982年和妻子琼离婚的肯尼迪有可能当选总统。

examples.text: He had been on the Nobel Prize committee's list of possibles.
examples.translation: 他在诺贝尔委员会列出的获奖候选者名单之列。

examples.text: He is a democrat with the skill, nerve, and ingenuity to push the limits of the possible.
examples.translation: 他是一个手腕高超、富有胆识、足智多谋的民主党人，能够让不可能的事成为可能。

examples.text: Exercise will not only lower blood pressure but possibly protect against heart attacks...
examples.translation: 锻炼不仅会降低血压，而且可能对心脏病有预防效果。

examples.text: They were smartly but casually dressed; possibly students...
examples.translation: 他们衣着时尚，但很休闲，也许是学生。

examples.text: Do you think that he could possibly be right?
examples.translation: 你觉得他有可能是对的吗？

examples.text: It was the most unexpected piece of news one could possibly imagine...
examples.translation: 这条新闻最出人意料了，真是让人想象不到。

examples.text: I mean, how could they possibly eat that stuff?...
examples.translation: 我的意思是，他们怎么可能吃那东西呢？

examples.text: What could this possibly mean?
examples.translation: 这到底是什么意思？

examples.text: They've done everything they can possibly think of...
examples.translation: 凡是能想到的，他们都去做了。

examples.text: It's one of the nicest feelings you can possibly have.
examples.translation: 这是一种极其美妙的感觉。

examples.text: No I really can't possibly answer that!
examples.translation: 不，我无论如何也回答不了那个问题。

examples.text: There's nothing more they can possibly do right...
examples.translation: 他们除此之外啥也做不了。

examples.text: We cannot possibly risk so many innocent lives...
examples.translation: 我们绝不可能拿这么多无辜者的生命冒险。

examples.text: That can't possibly be right.
examples.translation: 那绝不可能是对的。

examples.text: The online streaming push also helps the company reduce its postage bill for mailing DVDs.
You'll receive your book through the post...
examples.translation: 书会邮递给你。

examples.text: The winner will be notified by post...
examples.translation: 获胜者将以邮件形式通知。

examples.text: The cheque is in the post.
examples.translation: 支票已寄出。

examples.text: He flipped through the post without opening any of it...
examples.translation: 他飞快地翻了一下邮件，但一封也没有打开。

examples.text: There has been no post in three weeks.
examples.translation: 3个星期都没有邮件。

examples.text: Entries must arrive by first post next Wednesday...
examples.translation: 参赛作品必须在下周三第一批邮件之前寄达。

examples.text: They just have to wait patiently for the next post.
examples.translation: 他们只好耐心地等下一批邮件。

examples.text: If I write a letter, would you post it for me?...
examples.translation: 如果我写封信，你能替我寄出去吗？

examples.text: I'm posting you a cheque tonight...
examples.translation: 我今晚会给你寄支票。

examples.text: I posted a letter to Stanley saying I was an old Army friend.
examples.translation: 我给斯坦利寄了封信，说我是他的一个老战友。

examples.text: He'd left me to pack up the mail and post it off...
examples.translation: 他让我整理并投递邮件。

examples.text: All you do is complete and post off a form.
examples.translation: 你所要做的就是填写并寄出表格。

examples.text: Officials began posting warning notices...
examples.translation: 官员们开始张贴警告。

examples.text: She has posted photographs on bulletin boards.
examples.translation: 她已把照片贴在了公告牌上。

examples.text: He has posted a sign up that says 'No Fishing'...
examples.translation: 他已经张贴了一张“禁止钓鱼”的告示牌。

examples.text: We post up a set of rules for the house.
examples.translation: 我们张贴了一份房屋生活守则。

examples.text: A consultation paper has been posted on the Internet inviting input from Net users.
examples.translation: 一份征询意见书已贴在了因特网上，欢迎网络用户发表意见。

examples.text: Keep me posted on your progress.
examples.translation: 让我随时了解你们的进展。

examples.text: She had earlier resigned her post as President Menem's assistant...
examples.translation: 她早些时候辞去了梅内姆总统助理一职。

examples.text: Sir Peter has held several senior military posts.
examples.translation: 彼得爵士担任过几个高级军事职务。

examples.text: After training she was posted to Brixton...
examples.translation: 培训结束后她被派往布里克斯顿。

examples.text: It is normal to spend two or three years working in this country before being posted overseas.
examples.translation: 被派往海外之前，通常会在这个国家工作两三年。

examples.text: Quick men, back to your post!
examples.translation: 迅速返回各自岗位！

examples.text: Police have now been posted outside all temples...
examples.translation: 现在所有神殿外都已安排警察站岗。

examples.text: British Rail had to post a signalman at the entrance to the tunnel...
examples.translation: 英国铁路公司不得不在隧道入口设置了一名信号员。

examples.text: We have guards posted near the windows.
examples.translation: 我们已在窗户附近设了岗哨。

examples.text: You have to get eight wooden posts, and drive them into the ground...
examples.translation: 你得找来8根木桩，并把它们敲入地里。

examples.text: The device is fixed to a post.
examples.translation: 这个装置被固定在杆子上。

examples.text: Wimbledon were unlucky not to win after hitting the post twice.
examples.translation: 温布尔登队运气不佳，两次将球踢到门柱上，最终没有获胜。

examples.text: Monica sent him an erotic postcard, with a note detailing her ideas about education reform.
It's composed of a silicon rubber compound with the thickness and flexibility of poster board.
Mrs Southby said she waited every day for the postman to bring a cheque.

meanings.meaning: 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面

examples.text: He decided to postpone the expedition until the following day...
examples.translation: 他决定把探险推迟到第二天。

examples.text: The visit has now been postponed indefinitely.
examples.translation: 参观现在已经被无限期推迟了。

examples.text: You can make your stomach look flatter instantly by improving your posture...
examples.translation: 通过采取更好的坐姿，你的腹部马上就会看起来平坦一些。

examples.text: Exercise, fresh air, and good posture are all helpful...
examples.translation: 锻炼、新鲜空气和好的坐立姿势都很有益。

examples.text: Sit in a relaxed upright posture.
examples.translation: 保持放松、直立的坐姿。

examples.text: The military machine is ready to change its defensive posture to one prepared for action...
examples.translation: 军方随时准备由防御立场转向备战立场。

examples.text: None of the banks changed their posture on the deal as a result of the inquiry.
examples.translation: 没有一家银行因为这次调查而对该交易改变立场。

examples.text: She says the President may just be posturing.
examples.translation: 她说总统也许只是在做样子而已。

examples.text: Any calls for a new UN resolution are largely political posturing...
examples.translation: 任何要求联合国出台新决议的呼吁在很大程度上都只是一种虚伪的政治姿态。

examples.text: There's been a lot of posturing on both sides.
examples.translation: 双方有很多时候都是在装腔作势。

examples.text: ...metal cooking pots.
examples.translation: 金属炒锅

examples.text: He was stirring a pot of soup.
examples.translation: 他在搅拌一锅汤。

examples.text: There's tea in the pot.
examples.translation: 壶里有茶。

examples.text: He spilt a pot of coffee.
examples.translation: 他把一壶咖啡弄洒了。

examples.text: Hundreds of jam pots lined her scrubbed shelves.
examples.translation: 她那擦得干干净净的架子上排列着几百个果酱罐。

examples.text: ...a pot of red paint.
examples.translation: 一罐红色颜料

examples.text: Pot the cuttings individually.
examples.translation: 把插条分别栽入盆中。

examples.text: ...potted plants.
examples.translation: 盆栽植物

examples.text: He must have pots of money.
examples.translation: 他一定有很多钱。

examples.text: I've taken some money from the pot for wrapping paper.
examples.translation: 我已从公共基金里拿了一些钱买包装纸。

examples.text: He did not pot a ball for the next two frames.
examples.translation: 他在接下来的两局中一杆未进。

examples.text: The neighbourhood really is going to pot.
examples.translation: 这个街区确实在走向败落。

examples.text: If you haven't made an appointment, take pot luck and knock on the door...
examples.translation: 如果你没有预约，就敲门试试运气吧。

examples.text: He scorns the 'pot-luck' approach.
examples.translation: 他对这种“碰运气”的方法不屑一顾。

meanings.meaning: [作物] 土豆，[作物] 马铃薯

examples.text: ...a political hot potato such as abortion.
examples.translation: 类似堕胎这样政治上的烫手山芋

meanings.meaning: 潜能；可能性；[电] 电势

examples.text: The firm has identified 60 potential customers at home and abroad...
examples.translation: 该公司已在国内外找到60个潜在客户。

examples.text: ...potential party members...
examples.translation: 有可能发展成党员的人

examples.text: We are aware of the potential problems and have taken every precaution.
examples.translation: 我们已意识到潜在的问题，并采取了全面的预防措施。

examples.text: Clearly this is a potentially dangerous situation...
examples.translation: 这无疑是一种潜在的危险局势。

examples.text: Potentially this could damage the reputation of the whole industry.
examples.translation: 这可能会毁掉整个行业的声誉。

examples.text: The boy has great potential...
examples.translation: 这个男孩非常有潜质。

examples.text: The school strives to treat pupils as individuals and to help each one to achieve their full potential...
examples.translation: 学校力求对每一个学生因材施教，帮助他们充分发挥其潜力。

examples.text: Denmark recognised the potential of wind energy early.
examples.translation: 丹麦早就认识到了风能的潜力。

examples.text: ...the economic potentials of Eastern and Western Europe.
examples.translation: 东欧和西欧的经济潜能

examples.text: John seemed as horrified as I about his potential for violence...
examples.translation: 约翰似乎和我一样害怕他自己会使用暴力。

examples.text: The meeting has the potential to be a watershed event...
examples.translation: 这次会议有可能成为具有转折性的事件。

examples.text: The potential for conflict is great...
examples.translation: 爆发冲突的可能性很大。

examples.text: Death and murder always lurk as potentials in very violent relationships.
examples.translation: 充满暴力的男女关系中总是存在着死亡和凶杀的可能性。

examples.text: Dr Binger keeps poultry, pigs and goats...
examples.translation: 班热博士饲养家禽、猪和羊。

examples.text: Most poultry farmers have to rely on commercially manufactured feeds.
examples.translation: 多数饲养家禽的农场主不得不依赖商业化生产的饲料。

examples.text: The menu features roast meats and poultry.
examples.translation: 菜单上的特色菜是烤肉和家禽肉。

meanings.meaning: 英镑；重击，重击声；兽栏；拘留所

examples.text: Beer cost three pounds a bottle...
examples.translation: 啤酒每瓶3英镑。

examples.text: A thousand pounds worth of jewellery and silver has been stolen.
examples.translation: 价值1,000英镑的珠宝和银饰被盗。

examples.text: ...multi-million pound profits.
examples.translation: 数百万英镑的利润

examples.text: ...a pound coin.
examples.translation: 1英镑硬币

examples.text: The pound is expected to continue to increase against most other currencies.
examples.translation: 英镑对大多数其他货币的汇率有望继续升高。

examples.text: Her weight was under ninety pounds.
examples.translation: 她的体重不足90磅。

examples.text: ...a pound of cheese.
examples.translation: 一磅奶酪

examples.text: He pounded the table with his fist...
examples.translation: 他用拳头猛击桌子。

examples.text: Somebody began pounding on the front door...
examples.translation: 有人开始不停地猛敲前门。

examples.text: She came at him, pounding her fists against his chest.
examples.translation: 她冲向他，用拳头使劲打他的胸膛。

examples.text: ...the pounding waves.
examples.translation: 猛烈拍打的波浪

examples.text: She paused as she pounded the maize grains.
examples.translation: 她捣玉米粒时停了一下。

examples.text: I'm sweating, my heart is pounding. I can't breathe.
examples.translation: 我浑身冒汗，心脏狂跳，呼吸困难。

examples.text: ...the fast pounding of her heart.
examples.translation: 她快速的心跳

examples.text: Banks are quick to demand their pound of flesh when overdrafts run a little over the limit.
examples.translation: 透支稍微超出限额时，银行便会很快要求归还欠款。

examples.text: Pour a pool of sauce on two plates and arrange the meat neatly...
examples.translation: 在两个盘子里倒少许沙司酱，然后把肉摆放整齐。

examples.text: Francis poured a generous measure of the whisky into a fresh glass...
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯往一个干净的玻璃杯里倒了很多威士忌。

examples.text: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying-pan, then pour in the egg mixture.
examples.translation: 在不粘煎锅里将油加热，然后倒入鸡蛋糊。

examples.text: He got up and poured himself another drink...
examples.translation: 他站起身来，给自己又倒了一杯。

examples.text: She asked Tillie to pour her a cup of coffee...
examples.translation: 她请蒂莉给她倒杯咖啡。

examples.text: Quietly Mark poured and served drinks for all of them.
examples.translation: 马克一声不响地给他们每人倒好饮料并端上来。

examples.text: Blood was pouring from his broken nose...
examples.translation: 血从他受伤的鼻子里涌出来。

examples.text: There was dense smoke pouring from all four engines...
examples.translation: 4个发动机全都在冒浓烟。

examples.text: Tears poured down both our faces...
examples.translation: 我俩都泪流满面。

examples.text: The tide poured in from the south.
examples.translation: 潮水从南面涌来。

examples.text: It has been pouring in Delhi almost non stop for the past three days, disrupting normal life...
examples.translation: 德里市在过去的3天里一直在下着倾盆大雨，几乎没有停过，扰乱了人们的正常生活。

examples.text: It has been pouring with rain all week...
examples.translation: 一个星期以来一直在下着瓢泼大雨。

examples.text: The rain was pouring down...
examples.translation: 天空下着倾盆大雨。
