examples.text: We drove all the way through pouring rain.
examples.translation: 我们在倾盆大雨中一路驱车前行。

examples.text: Any day now, the Northern forces may pour across the new border...
examples.translation: 北方的军队现在随时都可能大批越过新边界。

examples.text: Holidaymakers continued to pour down to the coast in search of surf and sun...
examples.translation: 度假者不断涌至海边冲浪和享受阳光。

examples.text: At six p.m. large groups poured from the numerous offices.
examples.translation: 下午6点钟大群大群的人从无数办公楼里蜂拥而出。

examples.text: Martin, 78, died yesterday. Tributes poured in from around the globe...
examples.translation: 马丁于昨天去世，享年78岁。世界各地的人们纷纷致以哀悼。

examples.text: The commission has invited interested parties to submit comments, and these are now pouring in.
examples.translation: 委员会已邀请各当事方递交意见，现在意见书纷至沓来。

examples.text: The education secretary poured cold water on the recommendations of a working party.
examples.translation: 教育大臣对一个工作小组的建议泼冷水。

examples.text: According to World Bank figures, 41 per cent of Brazilians live in absolute poverty...
examples.translation: 根据世界银行的统计数字，41%的巴西人生活在赤贫中。

examples.text: Garvey died in loneliness and poverty.
examples.translation: 加维在孤独和穷困中死去。

examples.text: Britain has suffered from a poverty of ambition.
examples.translation: 英国一直缺乏远大理想。

examples.text: ...a poverty of ideas.
examples.translation: 思想贫乏

meanings.meaning: 粉；粉末；[化工][军] 火药；尘土

examples.text: Put a small amount of the powder into a container and mix with water...
examples.translation: 把少量粉末放入容器，加水混合。

examples.text: The wood turns to powder in his fingers.
examples.translation: 木头在他指间会变成粉末。

examples.text: ...a fine white powder.
examples.translation: 白色细粉

examples.text: ...cocoa powder.
examples.translation: 可可粉

examples.text: She powdered her face and applied her lipstick and rouge.
examples.translation: 她往脸上搽了粉，抹了口红和胭脂。

examples.text: ...the old woman's powdered face.
examples.translation: 老妇人那张搽了粉的脸

examples.text: The smell of powder was in the air.
examples.translation: 空气里有股火药味儿。

examples.text: ...a day's powder skiing.
examples.translation: 一天的滑雪时光

meanings.meaning: 功率；力量；能力；政权；势力；[数] 幂
激励；供以动力；使…有力量
借影响有权势人物以操纵权力的

examples.text: She interviewed six women who have reached positions of great power and influence...
examples.translation: 她采访了6名身居高位，并且颇具影响力的女士。

examples.text: In a democracy, power must be divided.
examples.translation: 在民主政体中，权力必须分制。

examples.text: ...a political power struggle between the Liberals and National Party.
examples.translation: 自由党和民族党之间的政治权力之争

examples.text: Human societies have the power to solve the problems confronting them...
examples.translation: 人类社会有能力解决面临的问题。

examples.text: Fathers have the power to dominate children and young people...
examples.translation: 父辈们有能力支配孩子们和年轻人的生活。

examples.text: He was so drunk that he had lost the power of speech.
examples.translation: 他醉得太厉害，连话都说不出来了。

examples.text: Your debt situation is only temporary, and it is within your power to resolve it...
examples.translation: 你的债务情况只是暂时的，你有能力解决好。

examples.text: Although it is not in his power to do so, he said he would rebuild the Air Base...
examples.translation: 虽然这超出了他的能力范围，他还是说他会重建空军基地。

examples.text: We must do everything in our power to ensure the success of the conference.
examples.translation: 我们必须尽一切能力保证会议圆满成功。

examples.text: The Prime Minister has the power to dismiss and appoint senior ministers...
examples.translation: 首相有权任免高级部长。

examples.text: The police have the power of arrest...
examples.translation: 警方有权拘捕。

examples.text: The legal powers of British Customs officers are laid out in the Customs and Excise Management Act of 1969.
examples.translation: 英国海关官员的法定权限在1969年的《关税与消费税管理法》中有明文规定。

examples.text: In 1964 Labour came into power...
examples.translation: 工党于1964年上台。

examples.text: He first assumed power in 1970...
examples.translation: 他于1970年首次执政。

examples.text: The party has been in power since independence in 1964.
examples.translation: 该党自1964年独立以来一直执政。

examples.text: In Western eyes, Iraq is a major power in an area of great strategic importance.
examples.translation: 在西方人眼里，伊拉克是位于具有重要战略意义的地区的一个重要强国。

examples.text: ...the emergence of the new major economic power, Japan.
examples.translation: 新兴重要经济强国日本的崛起

examples.text: The Roadrunner had better power, better tyres, and better brakes.
examples.translation: “路行者”汽车的性能、轮胎和刹车都更好。

examples.text: ...massive computing power.
examples.translation: 强大的计算能力

examples.text: Nuclear power is cleaner than coal...
examples.translation: 核能比煤清洁。

examples.text: Power has been restored to most parts that were hit last night by high winds...
examples.translation: 大部分昨晚遭大风袭击的地区已恢复供电。

examples.text: There is enough power to run up to four lights.
examples.translation: 电力足够带起4盏灯。

examples.text: The 'flywheel' battery, it is said, could power an electric car for 600 miles on a single charge...
examples.translation: 据说“飞轮”电池充电一次就能驱动电动汽车行驶600英里。

examples.text: The planes are powered by Rolls Royce engines.
examples.translation: 这些飞机由劳斯莱斯公司制造的发动机提供动力。

examples.text: ...battery-powered radios.
examples.translation: 用电池的收音机

examples.text: ...nuclear-powered submarines.
examples.translation: 核潜艇

examples.text: ...large power tools, such as chainsaws.
examples.translation: 大型电动工具，如链锯

examples.text: ...a power drill.
examples.translation: 电钻

examples.text: Any number to the power of nought is equal to one.
examples.translation: 任何数的0次方等于1。

examples.text: The powers that be, in this case the independent Television Association, banned the advertisement altogether...
examples.translation: 掌权的，在这件事中即独立的电视协会，干脆禁播了那则电视广告。

examples.text: The powers that be may keep us from building a house just where we want to.
examples.translation: 当局可能会阻止我们随意建房屋。

examples.text: You're a powerful man — people will listen to you.
examples.translation: 你是有影响力的人，大家会听你的。

examples.text: ...Russia and India, two large, powerful countries.
examples.translation: 两大强国，俄罗斯和印度

examples.text: ...Hong Kong's powerful business community.
examples.translation: 香港有影响力的商界

examples.text: Hans flexed his powerful muscles...
examples.translation: 汉斯活动了一下他那强健的肌肉。

examples.text: It's such a big powerful dog.
examples.translation: 它是一条如此强壮的大狗。

examples.text: He is described as a strong, powerfully-built man of 60...
examples.translation: 他被描述成一个强壮的、肌肉发达的60岁老人。

examples.text: You can contract your muscles more powerfully by linking up your breathing to the exercise.
examples.translation: 你可以将呼吸与运动保持一致，使肌肉收缩更有力。

examples.text: The more powerful the car the more difficult it is to handle.
examples.translation: 汽车的功率越大，就越难驾驭。

examples.text: ...powerful computer systems...
examples.translation: 功能强大的计算机系统

examples.text: Alcohol is also a powerful and fast-acting drug.
examples.translation: 酒也是一种效力强且迅速给人快感的毒品。

examples.text: Crack is a much cheaper, smokable form of cocaine which is powerfully addictive.
examples.translation: 强效可卡因更便宜，可以吸食，极易使人上瘾。

examples.text: There was a powerful smell of stale beer.
examples.translation: 有一种呛人的过期啤酒味。

examples.text: ...tiny creamy flowers with a powerful scent.
examples.translation: 散发浓香的淡黄色小花

examples.text: The railway station smelt powerfully of cats and drains.
examples.translation: 火车站上有冲鼻的猫味和臭水沟味。

examples.text: At that moment Mrs. Jones's powerful voice interrupted them, announcing a visitor.
examples.translation: 就在那一刻，琼斯夫人响亮的声音打断了他们，说有人来访。

examples.text: ...Bleasdale's powerful 11-part drama about a corrupt city leader.
examples.translation: 布利兹戴尔创作的关于一个腐败市领导的极具感染力的电视剧，共有11集

examples.text: ...one of the world's most powerful and moving operas, Verdi's 'Otello'.
examples.translation: 威尔第创作的《奥泰罗》，世界最具感染力、最动人的歌剧之一

examples.text: ...a powerful new style of dance-theatre.
examples.translation: 有感染力的新型舞蹈剧

examples.text: It's a play — painful, funny and powerfully acted.
examples.translation: 这是一部悲喜交加、表演感人的戏剧。

examples.text: We can offer you practical suggestions on how to increase the fibre in your daily diet...
examples.translation: 我们能就如何增加你日常饮食中的纤维素量提供实际的建议。

examples.text: This practical guidebook teaches you about relaxation, coping skills, and time management.
examples.translation: 这本实用的旅行指南教给你放松的方法、处理问题的技巧以及如何安排时间。

examples.text: You were always so practical, Maria...
examples.translation: 玛丽亚，你以前一向很注重实效。

examples.text: How could she be so practical when he'd just told her something so shattering?...
examples.translation: 他刚把这么令人震惊的事情告诉她，她怎么会如此理智呢？

examples.text: He lacked any of the practical common sense essential in management.
examples.translation: 管理方面基本的实用常识他一点也不懂。

examples.text: Although the causes of cancer are being uncovered, we do not yet have any practical way to prevent it...
examples.translation: 虽然癌症的病因正被逐步揭开，但我们尚未有任何切实可行的办法来预防它。

examples.text: It is not easy to make practical suggestions for helping her.
examples.translation: 要提出切实可行的建议帮助她并不容易。

examples.text: Our clothes are lightweight, fashionable, practical for holidays.
examples.translation: 我们的服装轻便、时尚，并且很适合度假时穿。

examples.text: He'd known the old man practically all his life...
examples.translation: 他几乎打记事起就认识这个老人。

examples.text: I know people who find it practically impossible to give up smoking.
examples.translation: 我认识一些人，他们觉得戒烟几乎是不可能的。

examples.text: The course is more practically based than the Masters degree...
examples.translation: 该课程比硕士学位课程更注重实践。

examples.text: The British are not famed for their philosophy and tend to be more practically minded.
examples.translation: 英国人不是以其哲学思想闻名，而是往往更注重实际。

examples.text: Some firms have cut workers' pay below the level set in their contract, a practice that is illegal in Germany...
examples.translation: 一些公司把工人薪水减至低于合同规定的水平，这种做法在德国是非法的。

examples.text: Gordon Brown has demanded a public inquiry into bank practices.
examples.translation: 戈登·布朗已要求对银行的惯例做法进行公开调查。

examples.text: She was taking all three of her daughters to basketball practice every day...
examples.translation: 她每天都带3个女儿进行篮球训练。

examples.text: ...the hard practice necessary to develop from a learner to an accomplished musician...
examples.translation: 从初学者成长为有造诣的音乐家所必需的艰苦训练

examples.text: The defending world racing champion recorded the fastest time in a final practice today.
examples.translation: 世界赛车卫冕冠军在今天最后的训练中创下了最快的纪录。

examples.text: ...the practice of internal medicine...
examples.translation: 内科业务

examples.text: I eventually realized I had to change my attitude toward medical practice.
examples.translation: 我终于认识到自己不得不改变对医务工作的看法。

examples.text: ...a law guaranteeing the people freedom of conscience and religious practice.
examples.translation: 保证人们信仰自由和宗教活动自由的法律

examples.text: The new doctor's practice was miles away from where I lived...
examples.translation: 新开的诊所离我住的地方有几英里远。

examples.text: My law practice isn't the most important thing in my life, you know.
examples.translation: 你知道，我的律师事务所不是我生活里最重要的事情。

examples.text: ...the difference between foreign policy as presented to the public and foreign policy in actual practice...
examples.translation: 公布于众的外交政策和实际外交政策的区别

examples.text: In practice, workers do not work to satisfy their needs.
examples.translation: 事实上，工人工作并不是为了满足本身的需要。

examples.text: It is normal practice not to reveal details of a patient's condition...
examples.translation: 不透露患者病情的细节是惯常的做法。

examples.text: The transcript is full of codewords, which is standard practice in any army.
examples.translation: 抄本上全是密码，这种做法是所有军队的惯例。

examples.text: 'How's your German?' — 'Not bad, but I'm out of practice.'
examples.translation: “你的德语如何？”——“还行，只是长时间没练习了。”

examples.text: Now that he is back, the prime minister has another chance to put his new ideas into practice...
examples.translation: 既然首相又掌权了，他就重新有机会实施他的新想法。

examples.text: We weren't allowed to put into practice in our daily lives the teachings we received.
examples.translation: 我们不能够将所受的教义在日常生活中付诸实践。

meanings.meaning: 练习，实践；实施，实行；从事

examples.text: Lauren practises the piano every day...
examples.translation: 劳伦每天练习钢琴。

examples.text: When she wanted to get something right, she would practise and practise and practise.
examples.translation: 她想做好一件事的时候，就会练习、练习、再练习。

examples.text: ...countries which practise multi-party politics...
examples.translation: 实行多党政体的国家

examples.text: Acupuncture was practised in China as long ago as the third millennium BC...
examples.translation: 中国早在公元前3,000年就已开始采用针灸疗法。

examples.text: He was brought up in a family which practised traditional Judaism.
examples.translation: 他是在一个信奉传统犹太教的家庭长大的。

examples.text: The church has broken the agreement, by insisting all employees must be practising Christians.
examples.translation: 教会坚持所有雇员都必须信奉基督教，这一做法破坏了协议。

examples.text: There are consistent reports of electrical torture being practised on inmates.
examples.translation: 一直有报道称犯人被施以电刑。

examples.text: In Belgium only qualified doctors may practise alternative medicine...
examples.translation: 在比利时只有资质合格的医生才能从事非传统医学工作。

examples.text: He was born in Hong Kong where he subsequently practised as a lawyer until his retirement...
examples.translation: 他出生在香港，后来在那里从事律师工作，直到退休。

examples.text: The ways in which solicitors practise are varied...
examples.translation: 事务律师的从业方式是多种多样的。

examples.text: An art historian and collector, he was also a practising architect.
examples.translation: 他身为艺术历史学家和收藏家，同时也是一名从业建筑师。

meanings.meaning: 开业者，从业者，执业医生

examples.text: Poised above my shins is Dr. Troy Sing, practitioner of Chinese medicine and acupuncturist.
The American president praised Turkey for its courage...
examples.translation: 美国总统赞扬了土耳其的勇气。

examples.text: Many others praised Sanford for taking a strong stand...
examples.translation: 其他很多人称赞桑福德立场坚定。

examples.text: He praised the excellent work of the UN weapons inspectors.
examples.translation: 他赞扬了联合国武器核查人员的出色工作。

examples.text: All the ladies are full of praise for the staff and service they received...
examples.translation: 所有女士都高度赞扬了工作人员和他们所提供的服务。

examples.text: I have nothing but praise for the police...
examples.translation: 我对警方唯有称赞。

examples.text: That is high praise indeed.
examples.translation: 那真是高度的赞美。

examples.text: She asked the church to praise God.
examples.translation: 她请求教会赞美上帝。

examples.text: Hindus were singing hymns in praise of the god Rama.
examples.translation: 印度教教徒在唱圣歌赞美罗摩神。

examples.text: ...the belief that the US had signalled a policy shift by damning with faint praise the mediation efforts.
examples.translation: 认为美国对调停努力明褒实贬是表明其政策已发生转变的观点

examples.text: Ottershaw's been singing your praises for years...
examples.translation: 奥特肖多年来对你一直高度赞赏。

examples.text: Andy Sinton is not a man given to singing his own praises.
examples.translation: 安迪·辛顿不是一个惯于吹嘘自我的人。

examples.text: He spent his time in prison praying and studying...
examples.translation: 他把狱中的时间都用于祈祷和学习。

examples.text: Now all we have to do is help ourselves and to pray to God.
examples.translation: 我们现在所要做的就是自助并向上帝祈祷。

examples.text: ...all those who work and pray for peace...
examples.translation: 所有那些为和平努力和祈祷的人们

examples.text: Kelly prayed that God would judge her with mercy.
examples.translation: 凯莉祈求在接受最后的审判时能得到上帝的怜悯。

examples.text: I'm just praying that somebody in Congress will do something before it's too late...
examples.translation: 我只是在祈求国会中会有人在还来得及的时候做点什么。

examples.text: One can only pray that the team's manager learns something from it...
examples.translation: 大家也只能希冀球队教练从中汲取教训。

examples.text: Many were secretly praying for a compromise.
examples.translation: 很多人在暗中祈求和解。

examples.text: And what, pray, do you buy and sell, Major?
examples.translation: 梅杰，请问，你都买卖些什么？

examples.text: I beg your pardon, pray continue.
examples.translation: 抱歉，请继续。

examples.text: They had joined a religious order and dedicated their lives to prayer and good works...
examples.translation: 他们已加入一个宗教团体，终生都将祈祷和行善。

examples.text: The night was spent in prayer.
examples.translation: 整个晚上都在祷告。

examples.text: They should take a little time and say a prayer for the people on both sides.
examples.translation: 他们应该花点时间，为双方的人祈祷。

examples.text: ...prayers of thanksgiving.
examples.translation: 感恩节祈祷文

examples.text: This drug could be the answer to our prayers.
examples.translation: 这种药或许可以满足我们的祈望。

examples.text: He promised that the boy would be back at school in time for evening prayers.
examples.translation: 他保证男孩会及时回到学校参加晚祈祷。

examples.text: ...Muslims attending prayers in the main mosque.
examples.translation: 在大清真寺参加祈祷的穆斯林

examples.text: She'd been caught from behind and hadn't a prayer of freeing herself.
examples.translation: 有人从后面抓住她，她不可能脱身。

meanings.meaning: 说教；讲道；鼓吹；传道；反复灌输

examples.text: At High Mass the priest preached a sermon on the devil...
examples.translation: 牧师在大弥撒上布道驱邪。

examples.text: The bishop preached to a crowd of several hundred local people...
examples.translation: 主教向当地聚集的数百人布道。

examples.text: He denounced the decision to invite his fellow archbishop to preach.
examples.translation: 他痛斥了邀请其他大主教同仁布道的决定。

examples.text: The Prime Minister said he was trying to preach peace and tolerance to his people...
examples.translation: 首相表示他在竭力向他的人民宣传和平和宽容。

examples.text: Health experts are now preaching that even a little exercise is far better than none at all...
examples.translation: 现在健康专家都在宣扬，即使是少量的运动也远比根本不运动好得多。

examples.text: For many years I have preached against war.
examples.translation: 我多年来都在进行反战宣传。

examples.text: 'Don't preach at me,' he shouted.
examples.translation: 他大喊道：“不要对我说教。”

examples.text: He ought to practise what he preaches.
examples.translation: 他应该以身作则。

examples.text: Could he not, just as a precaution, move to a place of safety?...
examples.translation: 就算仅仅是为了以防万一，难道他就不能挪到安全的地方吗？

examples.text: I had taken the precaution of doing a little research before I left London...
examples.translation: 我已在离开伦敦前进行了准备，做了些调查研究。

examples.text: Extra safety precautions are essential in homes where older people live.
examples.translation: 在有老人的家里，采取额外的安全防范措施是绝对必要的。

examples.text: Intensive negotiations between the main parties preceded the vote...
examples.translation: 主要政党在选举前进行了集中的谈判。

examples.text: The earthquake was preceded by a loud roar and lasted 20 seconds...
examples.translation: 地震前有一阵巨大的轰隆声，持续了20秒钟。

examples.text: Industrial orders had already fallen in the preceding months.
examples.translation: 工业订单在前几个月就已减少。

examples.text: He gestured to Alice to precede them from the room...
examples.translation: 他给艾丽斯做手势，让她在他们前面离开房间。

examples.text: They were preceded by mounted cowboys.
examples.translation: 他们前面是骑马的牛仔们。

examples.text: Look at the information that precedes the paragraph in question...
examples.translation: 查看正在讨论的这段文字前面的信息。

examples.text: Repeat the exercises described in the preceding section.
examples.translation: 把前一节要求的练习重做一遍。

examples.text: The trial could set an important precedent for dealing with large numbers of similar cases...
examples.translation: 这次审判能为处理大量类似案例开创重要的先例。

examples.text: There are plenty of precedents in Hollywood for letting people out of contracts.
examples.translation: 在好莱坞，允许影视人员解除合同的先例有很多。

examples.text: Like everyone else, I had been following the news closely in the preceding weeks.

meanings.meaning: 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的
(Precious)人名；(英)普雷舍斯，普雷舍丝(女名)

examples.text: After four months in foreign parts, every hour at home was precious...
examples.translation: 在国外呆了4个月后，在家的每一刻都是宝贵的。

examples.text: A family break allows you to spend precious time together...
examples.translation: 家庭度假会让你们一起度过宝贵的时光。

examples.text: Water is becoming an increasingly precious resource.
examples.translation: 水正成为日益珍贵的资源。

examples.text: ...jewellery and precious objects belonging to her mother.
examples.translation: 她妈妈的珠宝和珍奇物品

examples.text: Her family's support is particularly precious to Josie...
examples.translation: 家庭的支持对乔茜来说尤为可贵。

examples.text: Mary left her most precious possession — a small bookcase — to her niece.
examples.translation: 玛丽把她最珍视的财产——一个小书架，留给了她的侄女。

examples.text: You don't care about anything but yourself and your precious face.
examples.translation: 你什么都不关心，除了你自己和你那张娇贵的脸。

examples.text: Actors, he decided, were too precious and neurotic.
examples.translation: 他认定演员们太做作，并且都神经兮兮的。

examples.text: The banks have had precious little to celebrate recently...
examples.translation: 银行最近没几件值得庆贺的事。

examples.text: Precious few homebuyers will notice any reduction in their monthly repayments.
examples.translation: 极少数购房者会注意到他们月还款额的减少。

examples.text: I can remember the precise moment when my daughter came to see me and her new baby brother in hospital...
examples.translation: 我能清楚地回想起我女儿来医院看我和她刚出生的弟弟的那一刻。

examples.text: The precise location of the wreck was discovered in 1988...
examples.translation: 残骸的确切位置是在1988年发现的。

examples.text: He was not clear on the precise nature of his mission...
examples.translation: 他对自己使命的确切性质还不清楚。

examples.text: We will never know the precise details of his death.
examples.translation: 我们永远都不会知道他死亡的确切细节。

examples.text: They speak very precise English...
examples.translation: 他们讲一口非常地道的英语。

examples.text: He does not talk too much and what he has to say is precise and to the point.
examples.translation: 他话不多，但他说的话既准确又中肯。

examples.text: More than a week ago, Thursday evening to be precise, Susanne was at her evening class...
examples.translation: 一个多星期以前，确切地说是周四晚上，苏珊在夜校上课。

examples.text: The restaurant in which we ate that night had more people in it at 11pm, 51 more to be precise, than it did at 10pm.
examples.translation: 那天晚上我们去吃饭的那家餐馆晚上11点时比10点时人更多，准确地说多了51人。

meanings.meaning: 精度，[数] 精密度；精确

examples.text: The choir sang with precision...
examples.translation: 唱诗班的演唱准确无误。

examples.text: The interior is planned with a precision the military would be proud of.
examples.translation: 内部设计一丝不苟，足以让军方引以为豪。

examples.text: At 84, John feels his age precludes too much travel...
examples.translation: 84岁的约翰感到自己年事已高，不能进行太多的旅行。

examples.text: He would rebuff enquiries in such a way as to preclude any further discussion.
examples.translation: 他会断然拒绝询问，使得无法进行进一步的讨论。

examples.text: A constitutional amendment precludes any president from serving more than two terms...
examples.translation: 一项宪法修正案使得任何总统的任职不得超过两届。

examples.text: In some cases poor English precluded them from ever finding a job.
examples.translation: 英语不好有时会让他们找不到工作。

examples.text: He maintained that he learned everything he knew from his predecessor Kenneth Sisam.
examples.translation: 他坚称他所知道的一切都获自前任肯尼思·赛瑟姆。

examples.text: The car is some 40mm shorter than its predecessor.
examples.translation: 这辆轿车比原先的车型短了约40毫米。

meanings.meaning: 作出预言；作预料，作预报

examples.text: The latest opinion polls are predicting a very close contest...
examples.translation: 最近的民意测验预测竞争将会非常激烈。

examples.text: He predicted that my hair would grow back 'in no time'...
examples.translation: 他预言我的头发“一眨眼”就会长回来。

examples.text: It's hard to predict how a jury will react...
examples.translation: 很难预测陪审团将会作出何种反应。

examples.text: 'The war will continue another two or three years,' he predicted.
examples.translation: “这场战争还会再持续两三年的时间，”他预测道。

meanings.meaning: 主要的；卓越的；支配的；有力的；有影响的

examples.text: Amanda's predominant emotion was that of confusion.
examples.translation: 阿曼达主要还是感到困惑。

examples.text: I will preface what I am going to say with a few lines from Shakespeare...
examples.translation: 进入正题之前，我先引用莎士比亚的几句诗作为开场白。

examples.text: The president prefaced his remarks by saying he has supported unemployment benefits all along.
examples.translation: 总统在发表讲话前说他一直以来都支持发放失业津贴。

examples.text: Does he prefer a particular sort of music?...
examples.translation: 他有特别喜欢的音乐吗？

examples.text: I became a teacher because I preferred books and people to politics...
examples.translation: 我当了老师，因为我更喜欢书本和人而不是权术。

examples.text: I prefer to go on self-catering holidays...
examples.translation: 我喜欢膳食自助的度假。

examples.text: I would prefer him to be with us next season...
examples.translation: 我更希望他下一个赛季和我们在一起。

examples.text: Bob prefers making original pieces rather than reproductions...
examples.translation: 鲍勃更喜欢创作原创作品，而不是制作复制品。

examples.text: The woodwork's green now. I preferred it blue...
examples.translation: 这个木制品现在是绿色的。我更喜欢它是蓝色的。

examples.text: Her own preferred methods of exercise are hiking and long cycle rides.
examples.translation: 她自己喜欢徒步旅行和骑自行车长途旅行这样的运动方式。

meanings.meaning: 更好的，更可取的；更合意的

examples.text: A big earthquake a long way off is preferable to a smaller one nearby...
examples.translation: 远处发生大地震总比在附近发生小地震好。

examples.text: The hazards of the theatre seemed preferable to joining the family paint business...
examples.translation: 经营剧院的风险似乎比加入家族涂料产业的风险要小一些。

examples.text: Was an evening with Peter in their company preferable to being left at home alone?
examples.translation: 晚上和彼得在他们的公司呆着是不是比一个人留在家里好一些？

examples.text: Do something creative or take exercise, preferably in the fresh air.
examples.translation: 做一些有创意的事情或者运动一下，最好是在空气新鲜的户外进行。

examples.text: Parents can express a preference for the school their child attends...
examples.translation: 父母可以表达对自己孩子所上学校的偏好。

examples.text: Many of these products were bought in preference to their own.
examples.translation: 这些产品中有很多是因为认为自己的产品不佳才购进的。

examples.text: The Pentagon will give preference to companies which do business electronically.
examples.translation: 美国国防部将会优先考虑那些能够进行电子商务的公司。

examples.text: Lena got pregnant and married...
examples.translation: 莉娜怀孕并结婚了。

examples.text: Tina was pregnant with their first daughter.
examples.translation: 蒂娜怀了他们的第一个女儿。

examples.text: There was a long, pregnant silence.
examples.translation: 当时出现了长时间耐人寻味的沉默。

examples.text: ...a deceptive peace, pregnant with invisible threats.
examples.translation: 一种和平的假象，潜伏着许多无形的威胁

examples.text: There was a deep-rooted racial prejudice long before the two countries became rivals and went to war...
examples.translation: 早在这两个国家成为敌人并且兵戎相见之前，它们之间就有了根深蒂固的种族偏见。

examples.text: There is widespread prejudice against workers over 45...
examples.translation: 人们普遍对年龄超过45岁的工人存有偏见。

examples.text: He said he hoped the Swiss authorities would investigate the case thoroughly and without prejudice.
examples.translation: 他说希望瑞士当局会彻底地、不带任何偏见地调查这个案件。

examples.text: I think your South American youth has prejudiced you...
examples.translation: 我认为你在南美度过的青少年时代让你产生了偏见。

examples.text: The report was held back for fear of prejudicing his trial...
examples.translation: 因为担心会使他的审判有失公正，这篇报道被暂时压了下来。

examples.text: He claimed his case would be prejudiced if it became known he was refusing to answer questions.
examples.translation: 他声称如果大家都知道他拒绝回答问题，就会对他的案件抱有成见。

examples.text: Her study was not in any way intended to prejudice the future development of the college...
examples.translation: 她的研究绝对无意损害这所大学未来的发展。

examples.text: They claim the council has prejudiced their health by failing to deal with asbestos.
examples.translation: 他们声称，理事会没有处理好石棉的问题，从而损害了他们的健康。

examples.text: We accept the outcome of the inquiry, without prejudice to the unsettled question of territorial waters.
examples.translation: 我们接受了调查结果，并没有使悬而未决的领海问题进一步恶化。

examples.text: Preliminary results show the Republican party with 11 percent of the vote...
examples.translation: 初步结果显示共和党获得了11%的选票。

examples.text: Preliminary talks on the future of the bases began yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天开始了关于基地未来的初步讨论。

examples.text: It had taken about ten minutes to cover the preliminaries...
examples.translation: 准备工作大概花了10分钟。

examples.text: A background check is normally a preliminary to a presidential appointment.
examples.translation: 总统任命前通常要进行背景审查的准备工作。

examples.text: The winner of each preliminary goes through to the final.
examples.translation: 每场初赛的获胜者进入决赛。

examples.text: ...Australian premier Paul Keating.
examples.translation: 澳大利亚总理保罗·基廷

examples.text: ...the country's premier opera company.
examples.translation: 这个国家的顶尖歌剧团

meanings.meaning: 引出，预先提出；作为…的前提
前提；上述各项；房屋连地基

examples.text: There is a kitchen on the premises...
examples.translation: 该处有一个厨房。

examples.text: The business moved to premises in Brompton Road.
examples.translation: 这家公司搬到了布朗普顿路。

examples.text: The premise is that schools will work harder to improve if they must compete...
examples.translation: 前提是，如果各学校必须参与竞争的话，就会更加努力。

examples.text: The programme started from the premise that men and women are on equal terms in this society.
examples.translation: 这个项目是以这个社会男女平等为前提的。

meanings.meaning: 额外费用；奖金；保险费;(商)溢价

examples.text: It is too early to say whether insurance premiums will be affected.
examples.translation: 现在说保险费是否会受影响还为时过早。

examples.text: Even if customers want 'solutions', most are not willing to pay a premium for them...
examples.translation: 即使顾客想得到“解决方案”，他们大多数也不愿意为此支付额外费用。

examples.text: Callers are charged a premium rate of 48p a minute.
examples.translation: 打电话要支付每分钟48便士的附加费。

examples.text: At the premium end of the market, business is booming.
examples.translation: 高端市场业务繁荣。

examples.text: ...the most popular premium ice cream in this country.
examples.translation: 这个国家最受欢迎的优质冰激凌

examples.text: If space is at a premium, choose adaptable furniture that won't fill the room.
examples.translation: 如果空间有限，就选择一些不会把房间占得很满的可改装家具。

examples.text: He eventually sold the shares back to the bank at a premium.
examples.translation: 他最后以高价把股票回售给银行。

examples.text: I place a high premium on what someone is like as a person...
examples.translation: 我非常重视一个人的人品。

examples.text: They put a high premium on prevention and primary care.
examples.translation: 他们对预防和初级护理极为重视。

examples.text: Rub the surface of the wood in preparation for the varnish...
examples.translation: 打磨木头的表面，为刷清漆做准备。

examples.text: Few things distracted the Pastor from the preparation of his weekly sermons...
examples.translation: 几乎没有什么事情能使牧师在准备每周的布道时分神。

examples.text: Behind any successful event lay months of preparation.
examples.translation: 任何成功的活动都需要好几个月的准备。

examples.text: The United States is making preparations for a large-scale airlift of 1,200 American citizens...
examples.translation: 美国正在为运送1,200名美国公民的大规模空运做准备。

examples.text: Final preparations are under way for celebrations to mark German unification.
examples.translation: 纪念德国统一的庆典活动正在做最后的准备工作。

examples.text: ...anti-ageing creams and sensitive-skin preparations.
examples.translation: 抗衰老面霜和敏感性皮肤适用的护肤制剂

examples.text: Two technicians were preparing a videotape recording of last week's programme...
examples.translation: 两个技术人员正在准备上周节目的录像带。

examples.text: On average each report requires 1,000 hours to prepare...
examples.translation: 准备一份报告平均需要1,000小时。

examples.text: The crew of the Iowa has been preparing the ship for storage.
examples.translation: “艾奥瓦号”的船员一直都在为货物储存准备船只。

examples.text: The Party leadership is using management consultants to help prepare for the next election...
examples.translation: 该党的领导层正在管理顾问的帮助下筹备下一届的选举。

examples.text: President Castro has warned Cubans to prepare for a profound economic emergency...
examples.translation: 卡斯特罗主席已经提醒古巴人民为严重的经济危急状况做准备。

examples.text: He had to go back to his hotel and prepare to catch a train for New York...
examples.translation: 他不得不回到酒店，准备赶火车去纽约。

examples.text: His doctor had told him to prepare himself for surgery.
examples.translation: 他的医生已经告诉他做好动手术的准备。

examples.text: She made her way to the kitchen, hoping to find someone preparing dinner...
examples.translation: 她走到厨房，希望看到有人在准备晚饭。

examples.text: The best way of preparing the nuts is to rehydrate them by soaking overnight.
examples.translation: 做这些坚果的最好方法就是用水浸泡一个晚上，为其补充水分。

examples.text: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
examples.translation: 语法规则中并没有规定句子以介词结尾是错误的。

examples.text: Our doctor diagnosed a throat infection and prescribed antibiotic and junior aspirin...
examples.translation: 我们的医生诊断是喉部感染，并且开了一些抗生素和小剂量阿司匹林。

examples.text: She took twice the prescribed dose of sleeping tablets...
examples.translation: 她服用了双倍医嘱剂量的安眠药片。

examples.text: The law allows doctors to prescribe contraception to the under 16s.
examples.translation: 法律允许医生给16岁以下未成年人开避孕药。

examples.text: ...article II of the constitution, which prescribes the method of electing a president...
examples.translation: 规定了总统选举方法的宪法第二条

examples.text: Alliott told Singleton he was passing the sentence prescribed by law.
examples.translation: 阿利奥特告诉辛格尔顿他是依法判决。

examples.text: You will have to take your prescription to a chemist.
examples.translation: 你得拿着处方去找药剂师。

examples.text: The prescription Ackerman gave me isn't doing any good.
examples.translation: 阿克曼给我开的药没有任何疗效。

examples.text: The drug is available on prescription only.
examples.translation: 这种药只能凭处方购买。

examples.text: ...the economic prescriptions of Ireland's main political parties.
examples.translation: 爱尔兰主要政党的经济对策

meanings.meaning: 存在；出席；参加；风度；仪态

examples.text: They argued that his presence in the village could only stir up trouble...
examples.translation: 他们认为他在村里出现只会招惹麻烦。

examples.text: Her Majesty later honoured the Headmaster with her presence at lunch.
examples.translation: 随后女王陛下出席了午餐，令校长感到荣幸。

examples.text: They do not seem to have the vast, authoritative presence of those great men...
examples.translation: 他们看起来并没有那些伟人的翩翩风度和威严。

examples.text: Hendrix's stage presence appealed to thousands of teenage rebels.
examples.translation: 亨德里克斯在台上的风采吸引了成千上万的叛逆少年。

examples.text: The forest was dark and silent, haunted by shadows and unseen presences...
examples.translation: 这个森林黑暗寂静，经常有幽灵和看不见的鬼怪出没。

examples.text: She started to be affected by the ghostly presence she could feel in the house.
examples.translation: 她觉得这座房子里有可怕的鬼怪，开始变得神经紧张。

examples.text: The Philippine government wants the US to maintain a military presence in Southeast Asia.
examples.translation: 菲律宾政府希望美国继续在东南亚驻军。

examples.text: The somewhat acid flavour is caused by the presence of lactic acid.
examples.translation: 这种微酸的味道是因为含有乳酸造成的。

examples.text: ...the presence of a carcinogen in the water...
examples.translation: 水中含有的一种致癌物质

examples.text: Although the fluid presents no symptoms to the patient, its presence can be detected by a test.
examples.translation: 虽然这种液体不会使患者出现任何症状，但是它可以通过测试检测出来。

examples.text: Rather than politely lobbying politicians, Gay Dignity will be making its presence felt through demonstrations.
examples.translation: “同性恋尊严”游行活动不会彬彬有礼地向政客们游说，而会通过示威引起关注。

examples.text: The talks took place in the presence of a diplomatic observer.
examples.translation: 会谈是在一位外交观察员在场的情况下进行的。

examples.text: He had the presence of mind to put his emergency oxygen tube in his mouth.
examples.translation: 他镇定自若地把应急输氧管放进了自己的嘴里。

examples.text: She is presently developing a number of projects...
examples.translation: 她现在正着手开发多个项目。

examples.text: The island is presently uninhabited...
examples.translation: 这座岛屿目前无人居住。

examples.text: He is presently the medical director for the Fellowship of World Christians.
examples.translation: 他目前是世界基督徒团契的主任医师。

examples.text: Presently, a young woman in a white coat came in...
examples.translation: 很快，一个穿着白色外套的年轻女子走了进来。

examples.text: 'You're not looking too well, Thomas,' he said presently.
examples.translation: “托马斯，你看起来气色不太好，”他脱口而出。

examples.text: 'Who's Agnes?' — 'You'll be meeting her presently.'...
examples.translation: “谁是阿格尼丝？”——“你很快就会见到她。”

examples.text: 'Just take it easy,' David said. 'You'll feel better presently.'
examples.translation: “放松点，”戴维说，“你很快就会觉得更舒服些。”

meanings.meaning: 保护区；禁猎地；加工成的食品

examples.text: We will do everything to preserve peace.
examples.translation: 我们会尽全力维持和平。

examples.text: ...an effort to fit in more students while preserving standards.
examples.translation: 在保持原有教学水平的同时招收更多学生的努力

examples.text: ...the preservation of the status quo.
examples.translation: 维持现状

examples.text: We need to preserve the forest...
examples.translation: 我们需要保护森林。

examples.text: Conservation is an issue which gets a lot of attention these days — whether it means preserving old buildings, or protecting the environment.
examples.translation: 资源保护是目前备受关注的问题——不管它指的是对古建筑的保护，还是对环境的保护。

examples.text: ...perfectly preserved medieval houses.
examples.translation: 保存完好的中世纪房屋

examples.text: ...the preservation of buildings of architectural or historic interest.
examples.translation: 对在建筑学或历史上有重要意义的建筑物的保护

examples.text: I like to make puree, using only enough sugar to preserve the plums.
examples.translation: 我喜欢做果泥，只需要用一点糖把李子腌一下。

examples.text: ...preserved ginger in syrup.
examples.translation: 用糖浆腌制的姜

examples.text: The conduct of foreign policy is largely the preserve of the president...
examples.translation: 外交政策事宜主要由总统专门负责。

examples.text: With the menfolk away at war, women got their first crack at the male preserves of employment and sport.
examples.translation: 由于男人们都去了战场，女人们第一次在男性专属的职业和运动中一展身手。

examples.text: ...Pantanal, one of the world's great wildlife preserves.
examples.translation: 潘塔纳尔，世界上最大的野生动物保护区之一

examples.text: He will be only the second chief justice in history to preside over such a preceeding.
...President Mubarak...
examples.translation: 穆巴拉克总统

examples.text: The White House says the president would veto the bill.
examples.translation: 白宫称总统将否决这项议案。

examples.text: Research and marketing operations will be Mr. Furlaud's job as president of the new company.
examples.translation: 作为新公司的总裁，弗劳德先生将负责调研和市场运作。

examples.text: ...Alexandre de Merode, the president of the medical commission.
examples.translation: 药物委员会主席亚历山大·德梅罗德

meanings.meaning: 压；按；新闻；出版社；[印刷] 印刷机

examples.text: He pressed his back against the door...
examples.translation: 他后背紧紧靠在门上。

examples.text: They pressed the silver knife into the cake.
examples.translation: 他们拿银制餐刀切入蛋糕。

examples.text: Drago pressed a button and the door closed...
examples.translation: 德拉戈按了一个按钮，然后门就关上了。

examples.text: There was no-one at the reception desk, so he pressed a bell for service.
examples.translation: 接待处一个人也没有，于是他按了服务铃。

examples.text: ...a TV which rises from a table at the press of a button.
examples.translation: 只要按下按钮就从桌子上升起的电视机

examples.text: The engine stalled. He pressed the accelerator hard...
examples.translation: 发动机熄火了。他用力踩油门。

examples.text: She stood up and leaned forward with her hands pressing down on the desk.
examples.translation: 她站起来，双手撑在桌子上，身体向前倾。

examples.text: Police might now press for changes in the law...
examples.translation: 警方现在可能竭力要求修改法律。

examples.text: They had pressed for their children to be taught French.
examples.translation: 他们极力要求给他们的孩子教授法语。

examples.text: Trade unions are pressing him to stand firm...
examples.translation: 各工会正在竭力劝说他坚定立场。

examples.text: Mr King seems certain to be pressed for further details...
examples.translation: 看来人们一定会竭力要求金先生提供进一步的细节。

examples.text: She smiles coyly when pressed about her private life.
examples.translation: 当人们追问她的私生活时，她羞涩地笑了笑。

examples.text: The protest campaign has used mass strikes and demonstrations to press its demands...
examples.translation: 抗议活动通过大规模罢工和示威游行来向当局提出诉求。

examples.text: His officials have visited Washington to press their case for economic aid.
examples.translation: 他的官员们已经访问了华盛顿，竭力要求得到经济援助。

examples.text: The weight of irrational guilt pressed on her...
examples.translation: 无端的负罪感压得她喘不过气来。

examples.text: Right now, I've got other problems that are pressing on me.
examples.translation: 现在又有其他一些问题困扰着我。

examples.text: All I had was money, which I pressed on her reluctant mother...
examples.translation: 我就只有钱了，她母亲虽然不愿接受，我还是硬塞给了她。

examples.text: Food and cigarettes were pressed on him.
examples.translation: 别人硬塞给他一些食品和香烟。

examples.text: Vera pressed his shirt...
examples.translation: 薇拉把他的衬衫熨平了。

examples.text: There's a couple of dresses to be pressed.
examples.translation: 还有几件衣服要熨。

examples.text: ...clean, neatly pressed, conservative clothes.
examples.translation: 干干净净、熨烫平整的式样保守的衣服

examples.text: The grapes are hand-picked and pressed...
examples.translation: 这些葡萄是精心挑选用来榨汁的。

examples.text: I pressed the juice of half a lemon into a glass of water.
examples.translation: 我用手将半个柠檬的汁挤入一杯水中。

examples.text: ...1 clove fresh garlic, pressed or diced.
examples.translation: 一瓣新鲜的大蒜，拍碎或切成丁

examples.text: Today the British press is full of articles on India's new prime minister...
examples.translation: 今天英国的报纸上登满了关于印度新任总理的文章。

examples.text: ...freedom of the Press...
examples.translation: 新闻自由

examples.text: Press reports revealed that ozone levels in the upper atmosphere fell during the past month.
examples.translation: 新闻报道透露上层大气的臭氧浓度在上个月有所下降。

examples.text: Christie looked relaxed and calm as he faced the press afterwards...
examples.translation: 后来面对记者的时候，克里斯蒂显得放松而镇静。

examples.text: A meeting was promised, but the Press was not admitted.
examples.translation: 承诺将召开一次会议，但是不允许记者到场。

examples.text: ...the invention of the printing press...
examples.translation: 印刷机的发明

examples.text: He was writing the book up to the moment the presses rolled.
examples.translation: 直到付梓的那一刻他才完稿。

examples.text: ...the bad press that career women consistently get in this country...
examples.translation: 该国职业女性一直受到的舆论上的苛评

examples.text: Men get more bad press in her new novel.
examples.translation: 在她的新小说中，男人受到了更多的谴责。

examples.text: I could have pressed charges against him...
examples.translation: 我本可以起诉他。

examples.text: Police have announced they will not be pressing charges.
examples.translation: 警方已宣布不会提起诉讼。

examples.text: We check prices at the time of going to press...
examples.translation: 我们会在付印的时候核对价格。

examples.text: As this column went to press, I learnt that the man had died.
examples.translation: 当这个专栏开印的时候，我才知道那个人已经死了。

examples.text: The local bar has been pressed into service as a school...
examples.translation: 当地的酒吧被暂时用作学校。

examples.text: Kenny had been pressed into service to guard the door.
examples.translation: 肯尼被临时雇来看门。

examples.text: She kicked at the door with her foot, and the pressure was enough to open it...
examples.translation: 她用脚踢门，力气之大足以把门踹开。

examples.text: The pressure of his fingers had relaxed...
examples.translation: 他手指按压的力道减轻了。

examples.text: The best way to treat such bleeding is to apply firm pressure.
examples.translation: 治疗这种流血的最好方法就是牢牢将伤口压住。

examples.text: The window in the cockpit had blown in and the pressure dropped dramatically...
examples.translation: 驾驶舱的窗户突然向内破裂，气压急剧降低。

examples.text: Warm air is now being drawn in from another high pressure area over the North Sea.
examples.translation: 暖气流正从北海上空的另一个高气压带移动过来。

examples.text: He may have put pressure on her to agree...
examples.translation: 他可能向她施加了压力，迫使她同意。

examples.text: Its government is under pressure from the European Commission...
examples.translation: 其政府承受着来自欧盟委员会的压力。

examples.text: The political pressures to do something are pretty enormous.
examples.translation: 要求采取行动的政治压力非常巨大。

examples.text: Can you work under pressure?...
examples.translation: 你能在压力下工作吗？

examples.text: Even if I had the talent to play tennis I couldn't stand the pressure...
examples.translation: 即使我有打网球的天赋，我也无法承受这种压力。

examples.text: The pressures of modern life are great.
examples.translation: 现代生活的压力很大。

examples.text: He will never pressure you to get married...
examples.translation: 他永远不会强迫你结婚。

examples.text: The Government should not be pressured into making hasty decisions...
examples.translation: 政府不应该迫于压力仓促作出决定。

examples.text: Don't pressure me...
examples.translation: 不要逼我。

examples.text: His boss did not pressure him for results.
examples.translation: 他的老板并没有催促他尽早拿出结果。

examples.text: You're likely to feel anxious and pressured.
examples.translation: 你可能会觉得焦虑不安、有压力。

examples.text: ...efforts to build up the prestige of the United Nations...
examples.translation: 为树立联合国的威望所作的努力

examples.text: It was his responsibility for foreign affairs that gained him international prestige.
examples.translation: 他在负责处理外交事务的过程中赢得了国际声望。

examples.text: ...high prestige jobs.
examples.translation: 非常体面的工作

examples.text: ...such prestige cars as Cadillac, Mercedes, Porsche and Jaguar.
examples.translation: 像凯迪拉克、奔驰、保时捷和捷豹这样气派的汽车

examples.text: Presumably the front door was locked when you came down this morning?...
examples.translation: 早上你下楼的时候，前门大概是锁上的吧？

examples.text: The spear is presumably the murder weapon...
examples.translation: 这支鱼叉可能就是凶器。

examples.text: He had gone to the reception desk, presumably to check out.
examples.translation: 他已经去前台了，可能是要办理退房手续。

examples.text: I presume you're here on business...
examples.translation: 我想你是来这里出差的。

examples.text: Dido's told you the whole sad story, I presume?...
examples.translation: 我想狄多已经把这件伤心事全部告诉你了吧？

examples.text: 'Had he been home all week?' — 'I presume so.'
examples.translation: “他整个星期都在家吗？”——“我想是这样的。”

examples.text: ...areas that have been presumed to be safe...
examples.translation: 被认为很安全的地方

examples.text: The missing person is presumed dead.
examples.translation: 那名失踪者已被认定死亡。

examples.text: They're resentful that outsiders presume to meddle in their affairs...
examples.translation: 他们对外人擅自干预他们的事务非常愤慨。

examples.text: I wouldn't presume to question your judgment.
examples.translation: 我不会冒昧地质疑你的判断。

examples.text: The legal definition of 'know' often presumes mental control...
examples.translation: “知晓”的法律定义通常假定存在思维控制能力。

examples.text: The arrangement presumes that both lenders and borrowers are rational.
examples.translation: 这一协议假定借贷双方都是在神志清楚的状态下签订的。

examples.text: He has brought much of the present crisis on himself...
examples.translation: 目前的大部分危机都是他自己引起的。

examples.text: ...the government's present economic difficulties...
examples.translation: 政府当前的经济难题

examples.text: It has been skilfully renovated by the present owners...
examples.translation: 现在的主人非常巧妙地将其翻修了。

examples.text: No statement can be made at the present time.
examples.translation: 目前不能发表任何声明。

examples.text: ...his struggle to reconcile the past with the present.
examples.translation: 他为协调过去和现在所付出的努力。

examples.text: ...continuing right up to the present...
examples.translation: 一直持续到现在

examples.text: Then her thoughts would switch to the present.
examples.translation: 然后，她的思绪会转到现在。

examples.text: There is no way at present of predicting which individuals will develop the disease...
examples.translation: 目前还没有办法预测谁会得这种病。

examples.text: At present children under 14 are not permitted in bars.
examples.translation: 目前，14岁以下儿童不允许进酒吧。

examples.text: ...Western European art from the period of Giotto to the present day.
examples.translation: 从乔托时期直至现代的西欧艺术

examples.text: ...monastic music of the present day.
examples.translation: 当代的寺庙音乐

examples.text: The ministers had expressed the unanimous view that sanctions should remain in place for the present.
examples.translation: 大臣们一致认为暂时还不能取消制裁。

examples.text: Don't wait until New Year to resolve to organise your life. There's no time like the present.
examples.translation: 不要等到新年才下决心规划生活。要把握当下。

examples.text: The president was not present at the meeting...
examples.translation: 总裁没有出席这次会议。

examples.text: Nearly 85 per cent of men are present at the birth of their children...
examples.translation: 将近85%的男性在他们的孩子出生时都在场。

examples.text: The whole family was present.
examples.translation: 全家人都到场了。

examples.text: This special form of vitamin D is naturally present in breast milk...
examples.translation: 这种特殊形态的维生素D天然存在于母乳中。

examples.text: One theory is that the infection has been present in humans for a very long time...
examples.translation: 有一种理论认为，这种传染病存在于人类中已经有很长时间了。

examples.text: If the gene is present, a human embryo will go on to develop as a male.
examples.translation: 如果这种基因存在，人类胚胎就会发育为男性。

examples.text: The carpet was a wedding present from the Prime Minister...
examples.translation: 这张地毯是首相送的结婚礼物。

examples.text: I bought a birthday present for my mother...
examples.translation: 我给母亲买了一份生日礼物。

examples.text: This book would make a great Christmas present.
examples.translation: 这本书会是一份很不错的圣诞礼物。

examples.text: The mayor presented him with a gold medal at an official city reception...
examples.translation: 市长在一次正式的市政招待会上给他颁发了一枚金质奖章。

examples.text: Prince Michael of Kent presented the prizes...
examples.translation: 肯特亲王迈克尔颁发了奖品。

examples.text: The group intended to present this petition to the parliament.
examples.translation: 这个团体打算把这份请愿书呈递给议会。

examples.text: Then came the presentation of the awards by the Queen Mother.
examples.translation: 然后由王太后颁奖。

examples.text: This presents a problem for many financial consumers...
examples.translation: 这给很多金融消费者带来了一个问题。

examples.text: The future is going to be one that presents many challenges...
examples.translation: 未来将会面临诸多挑战。

examples.text: This summer school presents an opportunity to experience all aspects of dance...
examples.translation: 今年夏天，学校提供了一次全方位体验舞蹈的机会。

examples.text: Public policy on the family presents liberals with a dilemma.
examples.translation: 有关家庭的公共政策使自由主义者陷入了进退两难的境地。

examples.text: Their colleagues insulted them whenever the opportunity presented itself...
examples.translation: 一有机会，同事们就会侮辱他们。

examples.text: A further obstacle has presented itself, however.
examples.translation: 然而，突然又出现了一个障碍。

examples.text: We spend the time collating and presenting the information in a variety of chart forms...
examples.translation: 我们花费时间用各种各样的图表来比照和展示这些信息。

examples.text: We presented three options to the unions for discussion...
examples.translation: 我们向工会提供了3种选择供讨论。

examples.text: In effect, Parsons presents us with a beguilingly simple outline of social evolution.
examples.translation: 事实上，帕森斯向我们展示了一个看似简单的社会沿革轮廓图。

examples.text: ...in his first presentation of the theory to the Berlin Academy.
examples.translation: 当他第一次向柏林学院陈述该理论的时候

examples.text: ...a fair presentation of the facts to a jury...
examples.translation: 向陪审团就事实所作的公正陈述

examples.text: No amount of slick presentation can disguise the gap between what the government promised and what it has delivered.
examples.translation: 无论多少漂亮的说辞都掩盖不了政府的承诺和其实际的兑现之间的差距。

examples.text: The government has presented these changes as major reforms...
examples.translation: 政府将这些变化描述为重大的改革。

examples.text: The British like to present themselves as a nation of dog-lovers...
examples.translation: 英国人喜欢把自己说成是一个爱狗的民族。

examples.text: In Europe, Aga Khan III presented himself in a completely different light.
examples.translation: 在欧洲，阿迦汗三世表现得完全是另一副样子。

examples.text: ...all those tricks which would help him to present himself in a more confident way in public.
examples.translation: 能使他在公众面前表现得更为自信的那些窍门

examples.text: The small group of onlookers presented a pathetic sight...
examples.translation: 这一小群旁观者看上去让人觉得悲哀。

examples.text: In presenting a more professional image the party risks losing its individuality.
examples.translation: 为了给人一种更为职业的形象，该党可能会丧失自身特色。

examples.text: ...presenting a calm and dignified face to the world at large.
examples.translation: 向全世界展示出一副冷静和威严的面孔

examples.text: She was told to present herself at the Town Hall at 11.30 for the induction ceremony...
examples.translation: 她被告知于11点30分在市政厅参加就职仪式。

examples.text: We presented ourselves to the authorities promptly.
examples.translation: 我们立即向当局备案。

examples.text: She presents a monthly magazine programme on the BBC.
examples.translation: 她在英国广播公司主持一个月刊节目。

examples.text: The Lyric Theatre is presenting a new production of 'Over the Bridge'.
examples.translation: 利里克剧院正在上演新排的《桥对面》。

examples.text: Fox stepped forward, welcomed him in Malay, and presented him to Jack...
examples.translation: 福克斯走向前，用马来语向他表示欢迎，并把他介绍给了杰克。

examples.text: Allow me to present my wife's cousin, Mr Zachary Colenso.
examples.translation: 请允许我介绍我妻子的表哥，扎卡里·科伦索先生。

examples.text: I pretend that things are really okay when they're not...
examples.translation: 当情况不好的时候我假装一切顺利。

examples.text: Sometimes the boy pretended to be asleep...
examples.translation: 有时这个男孩会假装睡着了。

examples.text: I had no option but to pretend ignorance.
examples.translation: 我别无他法，只能假装不知道。

examples.text: She can sunbathe and pretend she's in Spain...
examples.translation: 她可以晒晒太阳，假装自己是在西班牙。

examples.text: The children pretend to be different animals dancing to the music.
examples.translation: 孩子们扮成不同的动物，随着音乐起舞。

examples.text: We do not pretend that the past six years have been without problems for us...
examples.translation: 我们并不自夸在过去的6年中没有遇到任何问题。

examples.text: Within this lecture I cannot pretend to deal adequately with dreams.
examples.translation: 在这一次讲座中，我不敢自诩能对梦境作透彻的分析。

examples.text: They wanted a pretext for subduing the region by force...
examples.translation: 他们想找借口用武力征服这个地区。

examples.text: He excused himself on the pretext of a stomach upset...
examples.translation: 他借口自己胃不舒服离开了。

examples.text: They would now find some dubious pretext to restart the war.
examples.translation: 他们现在会找个蹩脚的借口重新发动战争。

examples.text: She's a very charming and very pretty girl.
examples.translation: 她是一个非常迷人的漂亮女孩。

examples.text: She smiled again, prettily.
examples.translation: 她又微微一笑，非常迷人。

examples.text: Her prettiness had been much admired.
examples.translation: 她的美貌让众人羡慕不已。

examples.text: Whitstable is still a very pretty little town.
examples.translation: 惠特斯特布尔仍然是一个非常漂亮的小镇。

examples.text: ...comfortable sofas covered in a pretty floral print.
examples.translation: 罩着漂亮的印花布的舒适沙发

examples.text: The living-room was prettily decorated.
examples.translation: 客厅装修得很漂亮。

examples.text: ...shells of quite unbelievable prettiness.
examples.translation: 漂亮得让人难以置信的贝壳

examples.text: I had a pretty good idea what she was going to do...
examples.translation: 我很清楚她会怎么做。

examples.text: Pretty soon after my arrival I found lodgings.
examples.translation: 我到达之后，很快就找到了住处。

examples.text: His new government looks pretty much like the old one...
examples.translation: 他的新政府看起来和旧政府没什么两样。

examples.text: I travel pretty well every week.
examples.translation: 我几乎每周都出去旅行。

examples.text: When the war started, they thought they were sitting pretty, because they had all that extra grain.
examples.translation: 战争开始的时候，他们认为自己境况不错，因为他们粮食准备充足。

examples.text: We hope that common sense would prevail...
examples.translation: 我们希望情理会占上风。

examples.text: Rick still believes that justice will prevail...
examples.translation: 里克仍然相信正义会得以伸张。

examples.text: Political and personal ambitions are starting to prevail over economic interests.
examples.translation: 政治抱负和个人野心开始压倒经济利益。

examples.text: A similar situation prevails in America...
examples.translation: 相似的情况在美国随处可见。

examples.text: ...the confusion which had prevailed at the time of the revolution...
examples.translation: 在革命期间普遍存在的混乱

examples.text: How people in a certain era bury their dead says much about the prevailing attitudes toward death.
examples.translation: 某个特定时代的人们如何埋葬逝者很大程度上反映出当时人们对待死亡的普遍态度。

examples.text: He appears to have the votes he needs to prevail...
examples.translation: 他似乎已经获得了取胜所需的选票。

examples.text: I do hope he will prevail over the rebels.
examples.translation: 我确实希望他能战胜叛乱者。

examples.text: We must, each of us, prevail upon our congressman to act...
examples.translation: 我们每一个人都必须说服我们各自的国会议员采取行动。

examples.text: Do you think she could be prevailed upon to do those things?
examples.translation: 你觉得有可能说服她去做那些事情吗？

examples.text: This condition is more prevalent in women than in men...
examples.translation: 这种病症在女性当中比在男性当中更为普遍。

examples.text: Smoking is becoming increasingly prevalent among younger women...
examples.translation: 抽烟在年轻女性中变得越来越常见。

examples.text: The prevalent view is that interest rates will fall.
examples.translation: 人们普遍认为利率会下降。

examples.text: ...the prevalence of asthma in Britain and western Europe.
examples.translation: 英国和西欧哮喘的流行

examples.text: These methods prevent pregnancy...
examples.translation: 这些方法能防止怀孕。

examples.text: Further treatment will prevent cancer from developing...
examples.translation: 进一步的治疗将阻止癌症恶化。

examples.text: We recognized the possibility and took steps to prevent it happening.
examples.translation: 我们认识到了这种可能性，并且采取了一些预防措施。

examples.text: ...the prevention of heart disease.
examples.translation: 预防心脏病

examples.text: ...crime prevention.
examples.translation: 防止犯罪

examples.text: He said this would prevent companies from creating new jobs...
examples.translation: 他说这将使公司无法创造新的工作机会。

examples.text: Its nationals may be prevented from leaving the country...
examples.translation: 其国民可能会被禁止出境。

examples.text: The police have been trying to prevent them carrying weapons.
examples.translation: 警方一直都设法阻止他们携带武器。

examples.text: She has a teenage daughter from a previous marriage...
examples.translation: 她前一段婚姻有一个十几岁的女儿。

examples.text: He has no previous convictions.
examples.translation: 他没有前科。

examples.text: It was a surprisingly dry day after the rain of the previous week...
examples.translation: 上星期刚下过雨，天气却出奇地干燥。

examples.text: He recalled exactly what Bob had told him the previous night.
examples.translation: 他清楚记得前一天晚上鲍勃告诉他的话。

meanings.meaning: 捕食；牺牲者；被捕食的动物

examples.text: Electric rays stun their prey with huge electrical discharges...
examples.translation: 电鳐能放出强大的电流把猎物击晕。

examples.text: These animals were the prey of hyenas.
examples.translation: 这些动物是鬣狗的猎物。

examples.text: The effect was to disrupt the food chain, starving many animals and those that preyed on them...
examples.translation: 其结果就是破坏食物链，使很多动物和那些以捕食它们为生的动物饿死。

examples.text: The larvae prey upon small aphids.
examples.translation: 这种幼虫以小蚜虫为食。

examples.text: Police officers lie in wait for the gangs who stalk their prey at night...
examples.translation: 警察设伏等待那些在晚上跟踪目标伺机作案的歹徒。

examples.text: This burglar thought old people are easy prey.
examples.translation: 这个夜贼觉得老人容易下手。

examples.text: Pam had never learned that there were men who preyed on young runaways...
examples.translation: 帕姆从来不知道有人专门坑骗离家出走的年轻人。

examples.text: The survey claims loan companies prey on weak families already in debt.
examples.translation: 这项调查声称信贷公司专对那些已经负债的弱势家庭下手。

examples.text: The absence of children at Christmas preyed on Liz's mind...
examples.translation: 利兹因为圣诞节时孩子们不在而一直心神不宁。

examples.text: He had been unwise and it preyed on his conscience.
examples.translation: 他做得不太明智，这一直让他良心不安。

examples.text: He was prey to a growing despair...
examples.translation: 他被与日俱增的绝望折磨着。

examples.text: You were both a prey to compulsions.
examples.translation: 你俩都太冲动了。

examples.text: On the flight from Paris to Toulon, Mechiche fell prey to panic...
examples.translation: 在从巴黎飞往土伦的航班上，梅希什惊慌失措。

examples.text: Children in evacuation centres are falling prey to disease.
examples.translation: 疏散中心的孩子正受到疾病的折磨。

meanings.meaning: (Price)人名；(英)普赖斯；(法)普里斯；(葡、瑞典)普里塞

examples.text: ...a sharp increase in the price of petrol...
examples.translation: 汽油价格猛涨

examples.text: They expected house prices to rise...
examples.translation: 他们盼望着房价上升。

examples.text: Computers haven't come down in price.
examples.translation: 计算机没有降价。

examples.text: Slovenia will have to pay a high price for independence...
examples.translation: 斯洛文尼亚将为独立付出巨大的代价。

examples.text: There may be a price to pay for such relentless activity, perhaps ill health or even divorce...
examples.translation: 这样没命地工作可能要付出代价，也许是健康受损，甚至是离婚。

examples.text: He's paying the price for working his body so hard.
examples.translation: 他因为过度劳累身体有些吃不消了。

examples.text: The shares are expected to be priced at about 330p...
examples.translation: 这些股票的价格可能会定在330便士左右。

examples.text: Digital priced the new line at less than half the cost of comparable mainframes...
examples.translation: Digital公司新产品的定价比同类主机的一半还要低。

examples.text: There is a very reasonably priced menu.
examples.translation: 菜单上的定价非常合理。

examples.text: It's hard to maintain competitive pricing.
examples.translation: 维持具有竞争力的定价非常困难。

examples.text: If they wanted a deal at any price, they would have to face the consequences...
examples.translation: 如果他们无论如何都想达成交易，他们就得承担其后果。

examples.text: We obviously want to see the hostages home, but not at any price.
examples.translation: 我们显然也希望看到人质回家，但并不是不惜任何代价。

examples.text: Most goods are available, but at a price.
examples.translation: 大多数商品都有售，但是价格极高。

examples.text: Fame comes at a price...
examples.translation: 出名是有代价的。

examples.text: Theismann's precious information came at a price, however.
examples.translation: 不过，泰斯曼付出了代价才得到这些宝贵的信息。

examples.text: He remains at large despite the high price put on his head by the authorities.
examples.translation: 尽管当局悬赏重金缉拿他，他仍旧逍遥法外。

examples.text: You can't put a price on friendship...
examples.translation: 友谊无价。

examples.text: You can't put a price on the value of the work done by our nurses.
examples.translation: 不能用金钱来衡量护士的工作。

examples.text: What price a glorious repeat of last week's triumph?
examples.translation: 还有可能再次上演上周的辉煌胜利吗？

examples.text: Yes, they are free of him, but at what price to themselves, their families, those left behind?...
examples.translation: 是的，他们离开了他，但是对他们自己、他们的家人以及那些留下来的人又有什么用呢？

examples.text: What price success!
examples.translation: 成功了又如何？

examples.text: Prick the potatoes and rub the skins with salt...
examples.translation: 将马铃薯戳一些洞，并用盐揉搓外皮。

examples.text: He pricks holes in the foil with a pin.
examples.translation: 他用大头针在箔纸上戳一些孔。

examples.text: She had just pricked her finger with the needle.
examples.translation: 她刚用针把手指扎破了。

examples.text: Davydd felt tears prick his eyes.
examples.translation: 大卫德觉得眼泪就要流出来了。

examples.text: Most were sympathetic once we pricked their consciences...
examples.translation: 一旦我们使他们良心发现，大多数人还是有同情心的。

examples.text: I was pricked by the needle of curiosity.
examples.translation: 我突然感到好奇。

examples.text: At the same time she felt a prick on her neck.
examples.translation: 同时，她觉得脖子上一阵刺痛。

examples.text: ...the sense of pride in a job well done...
examples.translation: 做好一项工作的自豪感

examples.text: We take pride in offering you the highest standards...
examples.translation: 我们为向您提供最高标准的服务而感到自豪。

examples.text: They can look back on their endeavours with pride.
examples.translation: 他们可以骄傲地回首过去付出的努力。

examples.text: Davis had to salvage his pride...
examples.translation: 戴维斯必须得挽回他的自尊。

examples.text: It was a severe blow to Kendall's pride.
examples.translation: 这严重地打击了肯德尔的自尊心。

examples.text: His pride may still be his downfall.
examples.translation: 他的傲慢可能还会毁了他。

examples.text: Smith prides himself on being able to organise his own life...
examples.translation: 史密斯对能够把自己的生活安排得井井有条感到很得意。

examples.text: Doyle prides himself on his accuracy.
examples.translation: 道尔为自己的准确无误感到自豪。

examples.text: The bike soon became his pride and joy.
examples.translation: 这辆自行车很快就成了他的骄傲。

examples.text: A three-foot-high silver World Championship cup takes pride of place near a carved wooden chair...
examples.translation: 一个3英尺高的世界锦标赛银质奖杯放在一把木雕椅附近，位置非常显眼。

examples.text: The manifesto gives pride of place to job creation.
examples.translation: 这项宣言将创造工作机会放在首位。

examples.text: No doubt his old mother would now swallow her pride and go and live with Gladys.
examples.translation: 无疑，他的老母亲如今只能放下身价，去和格拉迪斯住在一起。

meanings.meaning: 使成为神职人员；任命…为祭司

examples.text: He had trained to be a Catholic priest.
examples.translation: 他受训成为了一名天主教神父。

examples.text: That's the primary reason the company's share price has held up so well...
examples.translation: 这是公司股票价格一直居高不下的主要原因。

examples.text: I don't think young people's primary aim in life is to get drunk...
examples.translation: 我觉得年轻人生活的主要目标并不是一醉方休。

examples.text: His misunderstanding of language was the primary cause of his other problems...
examples.translation: 他对语言的误解是引起其他问题的主要原因。

examples.text: The family continues to be the primary source of care and comfort for people as they grow older.
examples.translation: 随着年龄的增长，家庭仍然是人们获得关爱和安慰的主要源泉。

examples.text: Britain did not introduce compulsory primary education until 1880...
examples.translation: 直到1880年，英国才开始实行初等义务教育。

examples.text: Ninety-nine per cent of primary pupils now have hands-on experience of computers.
examples.translation: 现在，99%的小学生都亲手操作过电脑。

examples.text: ...primary teachers.
examples.translation: 小学教师

examples.text: It is not the primary tumour that kills, but secondary growths elsewhere in the body...
examples.translation: 原发性肿瘤并不会置人于死地，致命的是身体其他部位的继发肿瘤。

examples.text: They have been barred from primary bidding for clients.
examples.translation: 他们被禁止对客户进行最初的投标。

examples.text: ...the 1968 New Hampshire primary...
examples.translation: 1968年新罕布什尔州的初选

examples.text: She won the Democratic primary...
examples.translation: 她在民主党的初选中获胜。

examples.text: New York holds its primary election on Tuesday.
examples.translation: 纽约州将在星期二举行预选。

meanings.meaning: 初期；青年；精华；全盛时期

examples.text: Political stability, meanwhile, will be a prime concern...
examples.translation: 同时，政治稳定性将放在首位。

examples.text: It could be a prime target for guerrilla attack...
examples.translation: 这可能是游击队进攻的主要目标。

examples.text: The police will see me as the prime suspect!
examples.translation: 警方会把我当作头号嫌疑人！

examples.text: Prime candidate to take over his job is Margaret Ramsay.
examples.translation: 接替他工作的首要人选是玛格丽特·拉姆齐。

examples.text: It was one of the City's prime sites, near the Stock Exchange.
examples.translation: 这是伦敦最好的地段之一，离证券交易所很近。

examples.text: The prime example is Macy's, once the undisputed king of California retailers.
examples.translation: 最典型的例子是梅西百货，它曾经是加利福尼亚无可争辩的零售巨头。

examples.text: Maybe I'm just coming into my prime now...
examples.translation: 也许我现在正要步入事业辉煌期。

examples.text: She was in her intellectual prime...
examples.translation: 在智力上，她正处于壮年。

examples.text: We've had a series of athletes trying to come back well past their prime.
examples.translation: 我们有些早已过了黄金期的运动员仍然想东山再起。

examples.text: ...young persons in the prime of life.
examples.translation: 风华正茂的年轻人

examples.text: Claire wished she'd primed Sarah beforehand...
examples.translation: 克莱尔真希望她事先指点过萨拉。

examples.text: Arnold primed her for her duties...
examples.translation: 阿诺德事先让她熟悉了自己的任务。

examples.text: The press corps was primed to leap to the defense of the fired officials.
examples.translation: 记者团获知信息后，立即声援被解雇官员。

examples.text: He was priming the bomb to go off in an hour's time...
examples.translation: 他正在装炸弹，设定为在一个小时之内爆炸。

examples.text: Tom keeps a primed 10-foot shotgun in his office.
examples.translation: 汤姆在办公室放了一支装了子弹的10英尺长的猎枪。

meanings.meaning: 原始的，远古的；简单的，粗糙的

examples.text: ...studies of primitive societies.
examples.translation: 对原始社会的研究

examples.text: ...primitive tribes.
examples.translation: 原始部落

examples.text: ...primitive whales...
examples.translation: 原始鲸

examples.text: Primitive humans needed to be able to react like this to escape from dangerous animals...
examples.translation: 原始人必须要能作出这样的反应以逃避危险的动物。

examples.text: It is a primitive instinct to flee a place of danger.
examples.translation: 逃离危险的地方是一种原始本能。

examples.text: The conditions are primitive by any standards...
examples.translation: 无论用什么标准来衡量，其条件都很简陋。

examples.text: The primitive surgery of those days left him virtually deaf in one ear...
examples.translation: 那时候简陋的外科手术让他一只耳朵几乎失聪。

examples.text: It's using some rather primitive technology.
examples.translation: 它使用的是非常古老的技术。

examples.text: ...Prince Edward and other royal guests...
examples.translation: 爱德华王子和其他皇室宾客

examples.text: The Prince won warm applause for his ideas.
examples.translation: 王子的想法赢得了热烈的掌声。

examples.text: He was speaking without the prince's authority.
examples.translation: 他说话的时候没有君王的威严。

examples.text: To his 19th-century peers, Robert Brown was the prince of botany.
examples.translation: 对于19世纪的同行来说，罗伯特·布朗是植物学巨匠。

examples.text: Princess Anne topped the guest list.
examples.translation: 安妮公主排在宾客名单之首。

examples.text: ...Caroline Lindon, Princess of Monaco.
examples.translation: 摩纳哥公主卡罗琳·林登

examples.text: The principal reason for my change of mind is this.
examples.translation: 这是我改变主意的最主要原因。

examples.text: ...the country's principal source of foreign exchange earnings...
examples.translation: 这个国家最主要的外汇收入来源

examples.text: Their principal concern is bound to be that of winning the next general election.
examples.translation: 他们最关心的问题肯定是赢得下一次大选。

examples.text: Donald King is the principal of Dartmouth High School.
examples.translation: 唐纳德·金是达特茅斯中学的校长。

meanings.meaning: 原理，原则；主义，道义；本质，本义；根源，源泉

examples.text: Buck never allowed himself to be bullied into doing anything that went against his principles...
examples.translation: 巴克从来不会因为受到威胁而做违背自己原则的事情。

examples.text: ...moral principles...
examples.translation: 道德准则

examples.text: It's not just a matter of principle.
examples.translation: 这不仅仅是原则的问题。

examples.text: ...a man of principle.
examples.translation: 讲究原则的男人

examples.text: ...a violation of the basic principles of Marxism...
examples.translation: 违背马克思主义的基本原则

examples.text: The doctrine was based on three fundamental principles.
examples.translation: 这个学说建立在三条基本原理之上。

examples.text: These people lack all understanding of scientific principles.
examples.translation: 这些人对科学原理一窍不通。

examples.text: ...the principles of quantum theory.
examples.translation: 量子论原理

examples.text: I agree with it in principle but I doubt if it will happen in practice.
examples.translation: 我大体上同意这一点，但是怀疑它是否能够付诸实践。

examples.text: Even assuming this to be in principle possible, it will not be achieved soon.
examples.translation: 即使假定这在理论上行得通，它也不可能于短期内实现。

examples.text: He would vote against it on principle...
examples.translation: 他会根据原则投反对票。

examples.text: His father, on principle, did not like to hear requests for money.
examples.translation: 从原则上来说，他父亲不喜欢别人借钱。

meanings.meaning: 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记
印刷；打印；刊载；用印刷体写；在…印花样

examples.text: He started to print his own posters to distribute abroad...
examples.translation: 他开始印刷自己的海报并发往国外。

examples.text: The Slovene bank has printed a specimen bank note...
examples.translation: 斯洛文尼亚银行已经印刷了纸币票样。

examples.text: Our brochure is printed on environmentally-friendly paper...
examples.translation: 我们的小册子是用环保纸张印刷的。

examples.text: We found that television and radio gave rise to far fewer complaints than did the printed media.
examples.translation: 我们发现电视和广播引发的投诉比印刷媒体要少多了。

examples.text: Community workers here are printing up pamphlets for peace demonstrations...
examples.translation: 这里的社区工作者正在为和平示威游行印刷小册子。

examples.text: Hey, I know what, I'll get a bumper sticker printed up.
examples.translation: 嘿，有了，我会找人印刷一些保险杠贴纸。

examples.text: His brother ran a printing and publishing company.
examples.translation: 他哥哥经营了一家印刷出版公司。

examples.text: ...stocks of paper and printing ink.
examples.translation: 库存的纸张和印刷油墨

examples.text: We can only print letters which are accompanied by the writer's name and address.
examples.translation: 我们只能刊登附有作者姓名和地址的信件。

examples.text: ...a questionnaire printed in the magazine recently.
examples.translation: 最近在杂志上刊登的一份调查问卷

examples.text: ...the number printed on the receipt...
examples.translation: 印在发票上的数字

examples.text: The company has for some time printed its phone number on its products...
examples.translation: 有一段时间，公司把电话号码印在产品上。

examples.text: The shirts were printed with a paisley pattern...
examples.translation: 这些衬衫上印着佩斯利旋纹图案。

examples.text: 'Ecu' was printed in lower case rather than capital letters.
examples.translation: ecu是用小写字母而不是大写字母印刷的。

examples.text: Her mother wore one of her dark summer prints...
examples.translation: 她妈妈穿着一件深色印花夏装。

examples.text: In this living room we've mixed glorious floral prints.
examples.translation: 在这间客厅，我们粘贴了各种美丽的印花纸。

examples.text: ...multi-coloured print jackets.
examples.translation: 五颜六色的印花夹克

examples.text: Printing a black-and-white negative on to colour paper produces a similar monochrome effect...
examples.translation: 将一张黑白底片冲印到彩色相纸上会产生相似的单色效果。

examples.text: I selected two negatives to print from.
examples.translation: 我选了两张底片进行冲印。

examples.text: ...black and white prints of Margaret and Jean as children.
examples.translation: 玛格丽特和吉恩小时候的黑白照片

examples.text: ...35mm colour print films.
examples.translation: 35毫米的彩色胶片

examples.text: First released in 1957, the movie now appears in a new print.
examples.translation: 1957年首次上映后，这部影片现在有了新的拷贝。

examples.text: ...William Hogarth's famous series of prints.
examples.translation: 威廉·霍加斯著名的版画系列

examples.text: ...columns of tiny print...
examples.translation: 一栏栏极小的印刷字

examples.text: Laser printers give high quality print.
examples.translation: 激光打印机的打印质量很好。

examples.text: I have been convinced that the print media are more accurate and more reliable than television.
examples.translation: 我已经确信印刷媒体比电视更准确、更可靠。

examples.text: ...print journalists.
examples.translation: 报刊业记者

examples.text: Print your name and address on a postcard and send it to us.
examples.translation: 在明信片上用印刷体写上你的名字和地址，然后邮寄给我们。

examples.text: He crawled from print to print, sniffing at the earth, following the scent left in the tracks.
examples.translation: 它沿着脚印向前爬，在地面上嗅着，追踪着路上留下的气味。

examples.text: ...boot prints.
examples.translation: 靴印

examples.text: Fresh prints of both girls were found in the flat.
examples.translation: 在公寓里发现了两个女孩不久前留下的指纹。

examples.text: Many of these poets appeared in print only long after their deaths...
examples.translation: 这些诗人中有很多都是在去世很久以后作品才得以发表的。

examples.text: There was no immediate prospect of the diaries getting into print.
examples.translation: 这些日记近期不会发表。

examples.text: Many of their books have been in print for nearly 40 years.
examples.translation: 他们的很多书都印行将近40年了。

examples.text: I believe the book is now out of print, but it can easily be borrowed from libraries.
examples.translation: 我想这本书现在已经停印了，但从图书馆很容易借到。

examples.text: I'm looking at the small print; I don't want to sign anything that I shouldn't sign...
examples.translation: 我正在看附属细则，我可不想签署任何不应该签署的东西。

examples.text: This might be a good time for Button's management to study the fine print of his contract.
examples.translation: 这可能是巴顿的管理人员研读他的合同细则的好时机。

meanings.meaning: (Prior)人名；(法、西、葡、捷)普里奥尔；(英)普赖尔；(意)普廖尔

examples.text: He claimed he had no prior knowledge of the protest...
examples.translation: 他声称自己事先并不知道这次抗议的事。

examples.text: The Constitution requires the president to seek the prior approval of Congress for military action...
examples.translation: 宪法规定总统在采取军事行动之前必须获得国会同意。

examples.text: For the prior year, they reported net income of $1.1 million.
examples.translation: 他们公布上一年度纯收入为110万美元。

examples.text: The firm I wanted to use had prior commitments.
examples.translation: 我想选用的这家公司已有约在先。

examples.text: Prior to his Japan trip, he went to New York...
examples.translation: 在去日本之前，他去了纽约。

examples.text: A man seen hanging around the area prior to the shooting could have been involved.
examples.translation: 在枪杀案发生之前，有人目睹一位男子在这附近游荡，该男子可能与此案有关。

meanings.meaning: 优先；优先权；[数] 优先次序；优先考虑的事

examples.text: Being a parent is her first priority...
examples.translation: 做好母亲是她的头等大事。

examples.text: The government's priority is to build more power plants...
examples.translation: 政府的首要任务是建造更多的发电站。

examples.text: Getting your priorities in order is a good way to not waste energy on meaningless pursuits.
examples.translation: 将事情按优先顺序排列能有效地避免把精力浪费在无意义的工作上。

examples.text: The school will give priority to science, maths and modern languages...
examples.translation: 学校将重点发展理科、数学和现代语言。

examples.text: The proposals deserve support as they give priority to the needs of children.
examples.translation: 这些提议值得拥护，因为它们优先考虑了儿童的需求。

examples.text: The fight against inflation took priority over measures to combat the deepening recession...
examples.translation: 抵制通货膨胀比抑制日益加剧的经济衰退更为重要。

examples.text: I disagree with the premise that economic development has priority over the environment.
examples.translation: 我不赞成经济发展应优先于环境保护这个前提。

examples.text: The prison's inmates are being kept in their cells...
examples.translation: 这个监狱的犯人被关在他们的囚室里。

examples.text: He was sentenced to life in prison...
examples.translation: 他被判处终身监禁。

examples.text: They released Mr Mandela from prison in 1990.
examples.translation: 1990年，他们将曼德拉先生从狱中释放。

examples.text: ...the gas chamber at San Quentin Prison.
examples.translation: 圣昆廷监狱的毒气室

meanings.meaning: 囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告

examples.text: The committee is concerned about the large number of prisoners sharing cells.
examples.translation: 这个委员会对牢房拥挤问题表示担忧。

examples.text: ...wartime hostages and concentration-camp prisoners...
examples.translation: 战时的人质和集中营的战俘

examples.text: He was held prisoner in Vietnam from 1966 to 1973...
examples.translation: 他在1966年到1973年间被作为战俘关押在越南。

examples.text: He was taken prisoner in North Africa in 1942.
examples.translation: 他于1942年在北非被俘。

examples.text: We are all prisoners of our childhood and feel an obligation to it...
examples.translation: 我们都无法忘记自己的童年时代，觉得仍然为它所缚。

examples.text: She was a prisoner of her own ego.
examples.translation: 她为自己的自尊心所困。

examples.text: He saw the publication of this book as an embarrassing invasion of his privacy...
examples.translation: 他觉得这本书的出版侵犯了他的私生活，让他十分难堪。

examples.text: Thatched pavilions provide shady retreats for relaxing and reading in privacy.
examples.translation: 茅草亭是独自放松和读书的阴凉清幽之所。

examples.text: ...a collection of over 60 designs to try on in the privacy of your own home.
examples.translation: 能让你自己在家安心试穿的60多种款式的系列时装

examples.text: The press invade people's privacy unjustifiably every day.
examples.translation: 每天媒体都会毫无道理地干扰人们的生活。

examples.text: ...a joint venture with private industry...
examples.translation: 与私营企业建立的合资企业

examples.text: Bupa runs private hospitals in Britain...
examples.translation: 保柏在英国开办私立医院。

examples.text: Brazil says its constitution forbids the private ownership of energy assets.
examples.translation: 巴西称其宪法禁止个人占有能源资产。

examples.text: No other European country had so few privately owned businesses...
examples.translation: 再没有哪个欧洲国家有如此之少的私有企业。

examples.text: She was privately educated at schools in Ireland and Paris.
examples.translation: 她在爱尔兰和巴黎的学校接受过私立教育。

examples.text: ...the law's insistence that private citizens are not permitted to have weapons...
examples.translation: 法律坚持要求公民个人不得持有武器

examples.text: The King was on a private visit to enable him to pray at the tombs of his ancestors...
examples.translation: 国王以私人身份出访，以便能够祭拜先祖陵墓。

examples.text: The family tried to bring a private prosecution against him for assault.
examples.translation: 这家人试图以侵犯人身为由对他提起自诉。

examples.text: The landowners have had to sell their private aircraft...
examples.translation: 这些土地所有者不得不卖掉自己的私人飞机。

examples.text: They want more State control over private property...
examples.translation: 他们希望加强国家对私有财产的控制。

examples.text: There are 76 individually furnished bedrooms, all with private bathrooms...
examples.translation: 这里有76间陈设各异的卧室，都配有独立卫生间。

examples.text: I took the precaution of clearing out my desk before I left, and only my private secretary knows it.
examples.translation: 我在离开之前预先把桌子整理好了，这一点只有我的私人秘书知道。

examples.text: 673 private golf clubs took part in a recent study...
examples.translation: 673家私人高尔夫俱乐部参与了最近的研究。

examples.text: The door is marked 'Private'...
examples.translation: 这扇门上标着“私人房间”。

examples.text: Brian Epstein was buried in a private ceremony at Long Lane Cemetery, Liverpool.
examples.translation: 在利物浦朗雷恩公墓为布赖恩·爱泼斯坦举行了私人葬礼。

examples.text: Don't bug private conversations, and don't buy papers that reprint them.
examples.translation: 不要窃听私人谈话，不要购买重印这些谈话的报纸。

examples.text: Few senior figures have issued any public statements but privately the resignation's been welcomed...
examples.translation: 几乎没有高层人员发表任何公开声明，但私下里大家都为这次辞职窃喜。

examples.text: I had not talked to Winnette privately for weeks.
examples.translation: 我好几个星期没有和温尼特私下谈过话了。

examples.text: I've always kept my private and professional life separate...
examples.translation: 我总是将私生活和工作分开。

examples.text: My private affairs are no one's business but my own.
examples.translation: 我自己的事自己管，不用其他人操心。

examples.text: We all felt as if we were intruding on his private grief.
examples.translation: 我们都觉得似乎触及到了他内心的伤痛。

examples.text: ...the enactment of her private sexual fantasies...
examples.translation: 她内心产生了性幻想

examples.text: It's just that it's something very private, and I simply can't talk about it.
examples.translation: 只不过这是非常隐私的事情，我根本不能谈论这个。

examples.text: Privately, she worries about whether she's really good enough...
examples.translation: 她暗自担心自己是不是真的有那么好。

examples.text: He had privately resolved he would buy her the dress.
