examples.translation: 他暗地里下定决心要给她买那件衣服。

examples.text: Chinese waiters stood in a cluster, sharing a private joke...
examples.translation: 华人服务生们站在一起，讲着只有他们自己才懂的笑话。

examples.text: As many as 40 per cent of twins have a private language that excludes the rest of the family.
examples.translation: 多达40％的双胞胎都有自己的语言，其他家庭成员都听不懂。

examples.text: It was the only reasonably private place they could find.
examples.translation: 这是他们能找到的唯一一个还算僻静之处。

examples.text: ...a very attractive country house set within a uniquely beautiful and private position...
examples.translation: 坐落在风景独特的僻静之处的非常别致的乡间别墅

examples.text: We were alone, completely private, with not even Angela present.
examples.translation: 就我们自己，没有其他人打扰，连安吉拉也不在。

examples.text: She has always been a rather private person...
examples.translation: 她一直是一个相当内向的人。

examples.text: Gould was an intensely private individual.
examples.translation: 古德以前是个极为孤僻的人。

examples.text: Martial arts: Private lessons: £8 per hour.
examples.translation: 武术：私人教授：每小时8英镑

examples.text: ...Donald Tovey, who took her as his private pupil for the piano.
examples.translation: 唐纳德·托维，她的私人钢琴老师

examples.text: One gunner in each battery was an NCO and the rest were privates.
examples.translation: 每个炮兵连都有一个炮手是军士，其余都是二等兵。

examples.text: ...Private Martin Ferguson.
examples.translation: 二等兵马丁·费格森

examples.text: You should wash your feet and your privates every day.
examples.translation: 应该每天洗脚，并清洗阴部。

examples.text: Some of what we're talking about might better be discussed in private.
examples.translation: 我们要谈论的一些事情最好是在私下里讨论。

examples.text: The Russian Federation has issued a decree abolishing special privileges for government officials.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯联邦已经颁布法令废除政府官员的特权。

examples.text: ...the ancient powers and privileges of the House of Commons.
examples.translation: 国会下议院古老的权力和特权

examples.text: Pironi was the son of privilege and wealth, and it showed...
examples.translation: 皮罗尼出身于有钱有势的豪门，这看得出来。

examples.text: Having been born to privilege in old Hollywood, she was carrying on a family tradition by acting.
examples.translation: 她出身于过去好莱坞的名门，继承了当演员的家族传统。

examples.text: It must be a privilege to know such a man...
examples.translation: 认识这样的人肯定很荣幸。

examples.text: I once had the privilege of meeting the late philosopher CLR James.
examples.translation: 我曾经有幸和已故的哲学家C.L.R.詹姆士会面。

examples.text: We want to privilege them because without the top graduate students, we can't remain a top university...
examples.translation: 我们希望给予这些最顶尖的研究生特别照顾，因为没有他们，我们就无法继续处于一流大学之列。

examples.text: They are privileging a tiny number to the disadvantage of the rest.
examples.translation: 他们优待少数几个人，使其他人处于不利的境地。

examples.text: You must claim your prize by telephoning our claims line...
examples.translation: 您必须通过拨打我们的领奖电话来领取奖品。

examples.text: He won first prize at the Leeds Piano Competition...
examples.translation: 他在利兹国际钢琴比赛中荣获一等奖。

examples.text: He was awarded the Nobel Prize for Physics in 1985...
examples.translation: 他于1985年被授予诺贝尔物理学奖。

examples.text: They were going all out for the prize-money, £6,500 for the winning team.
examples.translation: 他们正全力争取队伍获胜，以赢得6,500英镑的奖金。

examples.text: ...a prize bull.
examples.translation: 获奖的公牛

examples.text: ...prize blooms.
examples.translation: 有望获奖的花

examples.text: With no lands of his own, he was no great matrimonial prize.
examples.translation: 他没有自己的地产，不是结婚的上佳人选。

examples.text: Military figures, made out of lead are prized by collectors...
examples.translation: 收藏家们对铅铸的军人塑像视若珍宝。

examples.text: One of the gallery's most prized possessions is the portrait of Ginevra de'Benci.
examples.translation: 这个美术馆最珍贵的藏品之一是达芬奇的《女子肖像》。

examples.text: He tried to prize the dog's mouth open...
examples.translation: 他试图把这条狗的嘴掰开。

examples.text: I prised off the metal rim surrounding one of the dials...
examples.translation: 我把其中一个刻度盘的金属边撬开了。

examples.text: He held on tight but she prised it from his fingers.
examples.translation: 他抓得很紧，但她还是掰开他的手，把它拿走了。

examples.text: Alison and I had to prize conversation out of him.
examples.translation: 我和艾莉森只得从他口中撬出谈话内容。

meanings.meaning: 可能性；机率；[数] 或然率

examples.text: Without a transfusion, the victim's probability of dying was 100%...
examples.translation: 如果不输血，患者必死无疑。

examples.text: The probabilities of crime or victimization are higher with some situations than with others...
examples.translation: 在有些情况下，犯罪或受害的几率要相对更高。

examples.text: You cannot prove conclusively that Sellafield caused cancer. You can only work on the basis of probability.
examples.translation: 你们无法确切证明塞拉菲尔德核电厂引发了癌症。你们只能基于可能性入手。

examples.text: There's an excellent probability that unless action is quickly taken, pipes will freeze...
examples.translation: 除非立即采取行动，否则管道很有可能冻住。

examples.text: If you've owned property for several years, the probability is that values have increased...
examples.translation: 如果一处房产已经拥有多年，有可能它已经增值了。

examples.text: Formal talks are still said to be a possibility, not a probability...
examples.translation: 据称正式会谈仍有可能，但可能性不大。

examples.text: His story-telling can push the bounds of probability a bit far at times.
examples.translation: 他讲故事的时候，不时会有些夸大。

examples.text: The Republicans had better get used to the fact that in all probability, they are going to lose...
examples.translation: 共和党人最好习惯他们很有可能失败的事实。

examples.text: In all probability, the final upturn in their fortunes is some months away yet.
examples.translation: 很可能再过数月他们才会转运。

meanings.meaning: 很可能的事；大有希望的候选者

examples.text: It is probable that the medication will suppress the symptom without treating the condition...
examples.translation: 这种药物有可能治标不治本。

examples.text: She does not want to be taken to an optician with the probable result of having to wear glasses...
examples.translation: 她不想被带去验光，因为结果可能是她必须配戴眼镜。

examples.text: An airline official said a bomb was the incident's most probable cause.
examples.translation: 一位航空公司的官员称这次事件极有可能是由炸弹引起的。

examples.text: The Socialists united behind their probable presidential candidate, Michel Rocard.
examples.translation: 社会党人团结在他们很有希望当选的总统候选人米歇尔·罗卡尔周围。

examples.text: The more they probed into his background, the more inflamed their suspicions would become...
examples.translation: 他们越调查他的背景，疑团就越多。

examples.text: For three years, I have probed for understanding...
examples.translation: 3年来，我一直都想弄明白。

examples.text: The Office of Fair Trading has been probing banking practices...
examples.translation: 公平贸易署一直在对银行业务进行调查。

examples.text: The form asks probing questions.
examples.translation: 这个表格问了一些试探性的问题。

examples.text: ...a federal grand-jury probe into corruption within the FDA.
examples.translation: 联邦大陪审团对食品及药物管理局内部的腐败进行的调查

examples.text: If he remains here, he'll be away from the press and their probings.
examples.translation: 如果他继续留在这里，就可以远离新闻界和他们的纠缠。

examples.text: The surgeon would pick up his instruments, probe, repair and stitch up again...
examples.translation: 外科医生会拿起他的工具，探查、修复然后再重新缝合。

examples.text: Dr Amid probed around the sensitive area...
examples.translation: 阿米德医生在敏感区周围检查。

examples.text: A doctor probed deep in his shoulder wound for shrapnel.
examples.translation: 一位医生伸进他肩膀伤口的深处寻找弹片。

examples.text: ...a fibre-optic probe.
examples.translation: 光纤探针

examples.text: A flashlight beam probed the underbrush only yards away from their hiding place...
examples.translation: 一束手电筒的光束在离他们的藏身之地只有几码远的灌木丛里搜寻着。

examples.text: I probed around for some time in the bushes.
examples.translation: 我在矮树丛里四处搜寻了一段时间。

examples.text: He probes the enemy's weak positions, ignoring his strongholds...
examples.translation: 他侦察敌人兵力薄弱的位置，对其要塞不予理睬。

examples.text: Squads of prison officers have been probing the rioters' defences.
examples.translation: 几队狱警一直都在探察暴乱者的防卫情况。

examples.text: Small probes would give the allied armies some combat experience before the main battle started.
examples.translation: 小规模的试探可以使盟军在大战开始之前获得一些战斗经验。

examples.text: Its rings were discovered by telescope from Earth, but space probes later found that spectacular rings surround some other planets...
examples.translation: 它的圆环是从地球上用望远镜发现的，但是太空探测器后来又发现了围绕其他一些星球的壮观的圆环。

examples.text: The Pioneer probes have on board ultraviolet instruments which are measuring light that we can't measure on the earth.
examples.translation: “先驱者号”太空探测器上装有紫外线仪器，能够对在地球上探测不到的光进行测量。

examples.text: ...the economic problems of the inner city...
examples.translation: 内城区的经济问题

examples.text: The main problem is unemployment...
examples.translation: 主要的问题是失业。

examples.text: He told Americans that solving the energy problem was very important...
examples.translation: 他告诉美国人解决能源问题非常重要。

examples.text: I do not have a simple solution to the drug problem.
examples.translation: 我没有解决毒品问题的简单办法。

examples.text: With mathematical problems, you can save time by approximating.
examples.translation: 对于数学题，可以用取近似值的办法节约时间。

examples.text: In some cases a problem child is placed in a special school...
examples.translation: 有时，问题儿童被放在特殊的学校。

examples.text: She is afraid to contact the social services in case they are labelled a problem family.
examples.translation: 她不敢联系社会服务部门，以免被当作问题家庭。

examples.text: 'Can you repair it?' — 'No problem'...
examples.translation: “你能修好它吗？”——“没问题。”

examples.text: If the property needs a new dishwasher, no problem, just put it on a credit card.
examples.translation: 如果住所需要一个新的洗碗机，没问题，用信用卡买一个就可以了。

examples.text: 'I ought to think about going actually. If that's all right with you.' — 'Yeah. No problem.'...
examples.translation: “事实上，我应该考虑去，如果你不介意的话。”——“嗯，没关系。”

examples.text: If they don't want to speak to me, fine. No problem.
examples.translation: 如果他们不想和我讲话，好的。我不介意。

examples.text: A biopsy is usually a minor surgical procedure...
examples.translation: 活组织检查通常是一个很小的外科手术。

examples.text: Police insist that Michael did not follow the correct procedure in applying for a visa...
examples.translation: 警方坚持称迈克尔没有按照正确的程序申请签证。

examples.text: The White House said there would be no change in procedure.
examples.translation: 白宫说程序上不会发生变化。

meanings.meaning: 开始；继续进行；发生；行进

examples.text: He proceeded to tell me of my birth...
examples.translation: 他接着给我讲我出生的事。

examples.text: He asked for ice for his whiskey and proceeded to get contentedly drunk.
examples.translation: 他要求在威士忌里加冰，接着心满意足地喝了个酩酊大醉。

examples.text: The group proceeded with a march they knew would lead to bloodshed...
examples.translation: 这个团体继续示威游行，他们知道这将导致流血事件的发生。

examples.text: The trial has been delayed until November because the defence is not ready to proceed.
examples.translation: 因为被告方没有做好应诉的准备，审判已经被延期至11月份。

examples.text: The ideas were not new. Their development had proceeded steadily since the war...
examples.translation: 这些并不是什么新思想，自从战争开始就一直稳定地发展演变。

examples.text: Efforts to reform the Interior Ministry have not yet proceeded very far.
examples.translation: 对内政部进行改革的尝试还没有取得很大进展。

examples.text: She climbed the steps and proceeded along the upstairs hallway...
examples.translation: 她爬上楼梯，顺着楼上的走廊走去。

examples.text: The freighter was allowed to proceed after satisfying them that it was not breaking sanctions.
examples.translation: 在确认没有违反制裁条例后，货船被放行了。

examples.text: The proceeds of the arms sales were then funneled to Contra fighters in Central America...
examples.translation: 出售武器所得的收入随后用来支持了中美洲的反政府武装组织。

examples.text: The proceeds from the concert will go towards famine relief.
examples.translation: 音乐会的收入将用于救助饥荒。

meanings.meaning: 开始；继续做；行进（proceed的ing形式）

examples.text: ...criminal proceedings against the former prime minister...
examples.translation: 对前首相的刑事诉讼

examples.text: The Council had brought proceedings to stop the store from trading on Sundays.
examples.translation: 该委员会已经提起诉讼，禁止这家商店在周日营业。

examples.text: The proceedings of the enquiry will take place in private...
examples.translation: 问讯将会秘密进行。

examples.text: He viewed the proceedings with doubt and alarm.
examples.translation: 他带着怀疑和警觉的眼光看待这些事件。

examples.text: The Department of Transport is to publish the conference proceedings.
examples.translation: 交通部将公布这次会议的记录。

meanings.meaning: 过程，进行；方法，步骤；作用；程序；推移
经过特殊加工（或处理）的

examples.text: There was total agreement to start the peace process as soon as possible...
examples.translation: 全体一致同意尽快开始和平进程。

examples.text: They decided to spread the building process over three years...
examples.translation: 他们决定用3年时间建成。

examples.text: The best way to proceed is by a process of elimination.
examples.translation: 继续进行下去的最佳方式是实行淘汰制。

examples.text: It occurs in elderly men, apparently as part of the ageing process...
examples.translation: 这种情况出现在老年人当中，显然是衰老过程的一部分。

examples.text: The regularity with which this occurs suggests that the process is genetically determined.
examples.translation: 这种现象出现的规律性表明这个过程是由基因决定的。

examples.text: ...fish which are processed by freezing, canning or smoking...
examples.translation: 经过冷冻、罐装或熏制处理的鱼

examples.text: The material will be processed into plastic pellets.
examples.translation: 这些材料将会被加工成塑料小球。

examples.text: ...diets high in refined and processed foods.
examples.translation: 包含很多精制食品和加工食品的饮食

examples.text: ...the cost of re-engineering the production process.
examples.translation: 重新设计生产过程的成本

examples.text: America sent cotton to England for processing.
examples.translation: 美国把棉花运到英格兰进行加工。

examples.text: ...nuclear fuel processing plant.
examples.translation: 核燃料处理厂

examples.text: ...facilities to process the data, and the right to publish the results...
examples.translation: 处理数据的设备和公开其结果的权利

examples.text: The information gathered by the telescopes will be processed by computers.
examples.translation: 通过望远镜获得的信息将由计算机进行处理。

examples.text: ...data processing...
examples.translation: 数据处理

examples.text: The advances in communications altered the nature of information processing.
examples.translation: 通讯技术的进步使信息处理发生了质的改变。

examples.text: Patients took more than two hours to be processed through the department.
examples.translation: 病人在这个科看病需要两个多小时的时间。

examples.text: The administration is in the process of drawing up a peace plan...
examples.translation: 政府正在起草和平计划。

examples.text: Her novel is in the process of being turned into a television series.
examples.translation: 她的小说正被拍成电视连续剧。

examples.text: He finished ahead of the Spaniard, and in the process picked up his first time trial win as a pro...
examples.translation: 他领先那个西班牙人到达终点，同时也首次作为职业选手获得计时赛的胜利。

examples.text: You have to let us struggle for ourselves, even if we must die in the process.
examples.translation: 你得让我们为自己拼搏，哪怕我们会在这个过程中死去。

meanings.meaning: 宣告，公布；声明；表明；赞扬

examples.text: The Boers rebelled against British rule, proclaiming their independence on 30 December 1880...
examples.translation: 布尔人反抗英国统治，并于1880年12月30日宣布独立。

examples.text: Britain proudly proclaims that it is a nation of animal lovers...
examples.translation: 英国骄傲地声称自己是一个热爱动物的国家。

examples.text: He still proclaims himself a believer in the Revolution.
examples.translation: 他仍然声称自己拥护革命。

examples.text: 'I think we have been heard today,' he proclaimed...
examples.translation: “我想今天我们说的大家都听见了，”他明确地说。

examples.text: He confidently proclaims that he is offering the best value in the market.
examples.translation: 他信心百倍地声称他的产品是市场上最物有所值的。

meanings.meaning: 队伍，行列；一列，一排；列队行进

examples.text: ...a funeral procession.
examples.translation: 出殡的队伍

examples.text: ...religious processions.
examples.translation: 宗教游行的队伍

examples.text: The drug is known to produce side-effects in women...
examples.translation: 据悉，这种药会对女性产生副作用。

examples.text: Talks aimed at producing a new world trade treaty have been under way for six years.
examples.translation: 旨在制定出一个新的世界贸易条约的谈判已经进行了6年。

examples.text: The company produced circuitry for communications systems...
examples.translation: 该公司为通信系统生产电路。

examples.text: I'm quite pleased that we do have the capacity to produce that much food.
examples.translation: 我很高兴我们确实有能力生产这么多粮食。

examples.text: These plants are then pollinated and allowed to mature and produce seed.
examples.translation: 然后，这些植物就被授粉，从而成熟结籽。

examples.text: ...gases produced by burning coal and oil.
examples.translation: 煤和油燃烧时产生的气体

examples.text: They challenged him to produce evidence to support his allegations...
examples.translation: 他们要他拿出证据证明自己的主张。

examples.text: Scientists have produced powerful arguments against his ideas.
examples.translation: 科学家们提出了有力论据反驳他的观点。

examples.text: To hire a car you must produce a passport and a current driving licence...
examples.translation: 租车必须出示护照和有效驾驶执照。

examples.text: She produced the knife during arguments with her friends.
examples.translation: 在和朋友争吵的时候，她掏出了刀。

examples.text: He has produced his own sports magazine called Yes Sport...
examples.translation: 他推出了自己的体育杂志，叫做《是的，体育》。

examples.text: He produced 'A Chorus Line', Broadway's longest running show.
examples.translation: 他制作推出了《歌舞线上》这一百老汇经久不衰的剧目。

examples.text: We manage to get most of our produce in Britain...
examples.translation: 我们设法在英国搞到我们所需的大部分农产品。

examples.text: Winter produce will cost more for the next few weeks.
examples.translation: 在未来几周，冬季农产品会更贵。

meanings.meaning: 产品；结果；[数] 乘积；作品

examples.text: Try to get the best product at the lowest price...
examples.translation: 尽量以最低的价格买到最好的产品。

examples.text: South Korea's imports of consumer products jumped 33% in this year.
examples.translation: 今年，韩国消费产品的进口激增了33%。

examples.text: We are all products of our time...
examples.translation: 我们都是这个时代的产物。

examples.text: The bank is the product of a 1971 merger of two Japanese banks.
examples.translation: 这家银行是由两家日本银行于1971年合并而成。

examples.text: That model won't go into production before late 1990.
examples.translation: 那种型号在20世纪90年代末以前不会批量生产。

examples.text: ...tax incentives to encourage domestic production of oil.
examples.translation: 鼓励国内石油生产的税收优惠政策

examples.text: We needed to increase the volume of production...
examples.translation: 我们需要提高产量。

examples.text: It expected to maintain production of cars at the same level as last year.
examples.translation: 预期今年汽车的产量会和去年持平。

examples.text: These proteins stimulate the production of blood cells.
examples.translation: 这些蛋白质会刺激血细胞的产生。

examples.text: During the film's production, the director wanted to shoot a riot scene but the filming was blocked...
examples.translation: 在影片摄制期间，导演想拍摄一个暴乱场面，但是被禁止了。

examples.text: She is head of the production company.
examples.translation: 她是制片公司的负责人。

examples.text: For this production she has learnt the role in Spanish.
examples.translation: 为了这次演出，她已经学会了用西班牙语演这个角色。

examples.text: ...a critically acclaimed production of Othello.
examples.translation: 获得好评的《奥赛罗》

examples.text: Entry to the show is free to members on production of their membership cards.
examples.translation: 会员只要出示会员卡就可以免费观看演出。

meanings.meaning: 能生产的；生产的，生产性的；多产的；富有成效的

examples.text: Training makes workers highly productive...
examples.translation: 培训提高了工人们的生产力。

examples.text: More productive farmers have been able to provide cheaper food.
examples.translation: 农民提高产量就能使食物更加便宜。

examples.text: ...fertile and productive soils.
examples.translation: 肥沃高产的土地

examples.text: The company is certain to reinvest its profits productively.
examples.translation: 公司肯定会将它的利润进行高效益的再投资。

examples.text: He was hopeful that the next round of talks would also be productive...
examples.translation: 他对下一轮会谈同样富有成效满怀希望。

examples.text: I was sorry he had left, although I soon developed a productive relationship with his successors.
examples.translation: 虽然我很快就和他的继任者建立了良好的关系，但是我仍然对他的离开感到遗憾。

examples.text: They feel they are interacting productively with elderly patients.
examples.translation: 他们觉得和年长的病人进行互动颇有益处。

examples.text: Land, labor and capital are all productive of wealth.
examples.translation: 土地、劳动和资本都能创造财富。

meanings.meaning: 生产力；生产率；生产能力

examples.text: The third-quarter results reflect continued improvements in productivity...
examples.translation: 第三季度的结果表明生产率持续上升。

examples.text: His method of obtaining a high level of productivity is demanding.
examples.translation: 他那种提高生产率的方法实施起来非常困难。

meanings.meaning: 职业，专业；声明，宣布，表白

examples.text: Harper was a teacher by profession...
examples.translation: 哈珀的职业是教师。

examples.text: Only 20 per cent of jobs in the professions are held by women.
examples.translation: 在这些职业中，只有20%的岗位是由女性担任的。

examples.text: The attitude of the medical profession is very much more liberal now.
examples.translation: 现在，医务人员的态度开明多了。

meanings.meaning: 专业的；职业的；职业性的

examples.text: His professional career started at Liverpool University.
examples.translation: 他的职业生涯是从利物浦大学开始的。

examples.text: ...a professionally-qualified architect...
examples.translation: 一个具有专业从业资格的建筑师

examples.text: The opening months of 1987 were difficult, personally and professionally.
examples.translation: 无论从个人生活还是从工作上来说，1987年初的几个月都非常艰难。

examples.text: ...highly qualified professional people like doctors and engineers.
examples.translation: 像医生和工程师这样需要高技能的专业人员

examples.text: My father wanted me to become a professional and have more stability.
examples.translation: 我父亲想让我成为职业人士，这样能更稳定一些。

examples.text: This has been my worst time for injuries since I started as a professional footballer...
examples.translation: 这是我当职业足球运动员以来受伤来得最不是时候的一次。

examples.text: Jack Nicklaus has played in every Major Championship since he turned professional in 1961.
examples.translation: 杰克·尼克劳斯自从1961年转为职业选手以来参加了四大赛的所有比赛。

examples.text: He had been a professional since March 1985.
examples.translation: 他从1985年3月开始就成了职业选手。

examples.text: By age 16 he was playing professionally with bands in Greenwich Village.
examples.translation: 16岁的时候，他就为格林尼治村的乐队进行专业演奏。

examples.text: ...an art student who had played professional football for a short time.
examples.translation: 踢过短时间职业足球的艺术系学生

examples.text: They run it with a truly professional but personal touch.
examples.translation: 他们的经营既有真正的专业水准又不乏个人特色。

examples.text: ...a dedicated professional who worked harmoniously with the cast and crew.
examples.translation: 一位非常敬业的、同所有演职人员合作融洽的专业人士

examples.text: These tickets have been produced very professionally.
examples.translation: 这些标签制作得非常专业。

meanings.meaning: 教授；教师；公开表示信仰的人

examples.text: ...Professor Cameron...
examples.translation: 卡梅伦教授

examples.text: In 1979, only 2% of British professors were female.
examples.translation: 1979年，英国只有2%的教授是女性。

examples.text: Robert Dunn is a professor of economics at George Washington University.
examples.translation: 罗伯特·达恩是乔治·华盛顿大学经济学的教师。

examples.text: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admission requirement.
examples.translation: 英语基本熟练是入学条件之一。

meanings.meaning: 侧面；轮廓；外形；剖面；简况

examples.text: His handsome profile was turned away from us.
examples.translation: 他英俊的侧影从我们眼前转开了。

examples.text: This picture shows the girl in profile.
examples.translation: 这张照片照的是女孩的侧面。

examples.text: A newspaper published profiles of the candidates' wives.
examples.translation: 一家报纸刊登了几位候选人夫人的简介。

examples.text: Tamar Golan, a Paris-based journalist, profiles the rebel leader.
examples.translation: 驻巴黎记者塔玛·戈兰对反叛者的首领进行了介绍。

examples.text: ...a former FBI agent who pioneered psychological profiling in the 1970s.
examples.translation: 在20世纪70年代开创了心理画像的前联邦调查局探员

examples.text: DNA profiling has aided the struggle against crime.
examples.translation: DNA分析对于打击犯罪有所帮助。

examples.text: ...a move that would give Egypt a much higher profile in the upcoming peace talks...
examples.translation: 能使埃及在未来的和谈中更加引人关注的举动

examples.text: Football is a high profile business...
examples.translation: 足球是一个引人注目的产业。

examples.text: The police deliberately kept a low profile in most places.
examples.translation: 警方在大多数地方有意保持低调。

examples.text: The bank made pre-tax profits of £3.5 million...
examples.translation: 这家银行的税前利润为350万英镑。

examples.text: You can improve your chances of profit by sensible planning...
examples.translation: 你可以通过合理计划来提高盈利的机会。

examples.text: The profit motive is inherently at odds with principles of fairness and equity.
examples.translation: 盈利动机天生就与公平和公正的原则相抵触。

examples.text: Footballers are accustomed to profiting handsomely from bonuses...
examples.translation: 足球运动员对获取丰厚的奖金已习以为常。

examples.text: He has profited by selling his holdings to other investors...
examples.translation: 他将自己的股票卖给其他投资者，从中获利。

examples.text: The dealers profited shamefully at the expense of my family.
examples.translation: 这些经销商通过损害我家人的利益不光彩地赚钱。

examples.text: Jennifer wasn't yet totally convinced that she'd profit from a more relaxed lifestyle...
examples.translation: 珍尼弗还不完全相信更轻松的生活方式会对她有好处。

examples.text: So far the French alliance had profited the rebels little...
examples.translation: 到目前为止叛军都没有从法国同盟那里获得什么好处。

examples.text: Whom would it profit to terrify or to kill James Sinclair?
examples.translation: 恐吓或者干掉詹姆斯·辛克莱对谁会有好处？

examples.text: The artist found much to his profit in the Louvre.
examples.translation: 这位艺术家从卢浮宫受益颇多。

meanings.meaning: 有利可图的；赚钱的；有益的

examples.text: Drug manufacturing is the most profitable business in America...
examples.translation: 制药业是美国利润最丰厚的业务。

examples.text: It was profitable for them to produce large amounts of food.
examples.translation: 生产大量的食物能让他们获利。

examples.text: The 28 French stores are trading profitably.
examples.translation: 这28家法国商店在盈利。

examples.text: Changes were made in operating methods in an effort to increase profitability.
examples.translation: 为了提高利润，经营方式上发生了改变。

examples.text: ...collaboration which leads to a profitable exchange of personnel and ideas.
examples.translation: 有利于人员和观念交流的合作

examples.text: In fact he could scarcely have spent his time more profitably.
examples.translation: 事实上，他几乎已最大程度地利用了他的时间。

meanings.meaning: 深厚的；意义深远的；渊博的

examples.text: ...discoveries which had a profound effect on many areas of medicine.
examples.translation: 对很多医学领域产生了深刻影响的发现

examples.text: ...profound disagreement...
examples.translation: 严重的分歧

examples.text: The overwhelming feeling is just deep, profound shock and anger...
examples.translation: 最强烈的感觉就是深深的震惊和愤怒。

examples.text: Anna's patriotism was profound.
examples.translation: 安娜有强烈的爱国心。

examples.text: This has profoundly affected my life...
examples.translation: 这给我的生活带来了深刻的影响。

examples.text: In politics, as in other areas, he is profoundly conservative.
examples.translation: 就像在其他领域一样，他在政治方面也非常保守。

examples.text: This is a book full of profound, original and challenging insights.
examples.translation: 这本书充满了深刻、新颖、令人深思的见解。

examples.text: ...one of the country's most profound minds.
examples.translation: 该国知识最渊博的人之一

examples.text: The general argued that the nuclear programme should still continue...
examples.translation: 将军认为核计划应该继续进行。

examples.text: The programme of sell-offs has been implemented by the new chief executive.
examples.translation: 新任总裁已经执行了抛售方案。

examples.text: ...a series of TV programmes on global environment.
examples.translation: 有关全球环境的一系列电视节目

examples.text: ...local news programmes.
examples.translation: 地方新闻节目

examples.text: Parents can programme the machine not to turn on at certain times.
examples.translation: 父母可以设定这台机器的程序，使它在特定时间段无法开启。

examples.text: We are all genetically programmed to develop certain illnesses.
examples.translation: 基因决定了我们都会患上某些疾病。

examples.text: The medical community continues to make progress in the fight against cancer...
examples.translation: 医学界在抗癌的斗争中不断取得进步。

examples.text: The two sides made little if any progress towards agreement.
examples.translation: 双方在达成协议方面的进展甚微。

examples.text: The Chancellor is reported to have been delighted with the progress of the first day's talks...
examples.translation: 据报道，总理对第一天会谈的进展表示满意。

examples.text: Ellen would keep me abreast of the progress by phone.
examples.translation: 埃伦会通过电话及时向我通报进展情况。

examples.text: He will visit once a fortnight to see how his new staff are progressing...
examples.translation: 他会每两个星期来访一次，看看他的新员工进展如何。

examples.text: Were you surprised that his disease progressed so quickly?...
examples.translation: 他的病情发展得这么快，您是否感到意外？

examples.text: He started with sketching and then progressed to painting.
examples.translation: 他先是画素描，然后发展到画油画。

examples.text: As the evening progressed, sadness turned to rage...
examples.translation: 随着夜幕逐渐降临，悲伤变成了愤怒。

examples.text: Life was hard, and it became harder as the war progressed.
examples.translation: 那时候生活很艰难，并且随着战争的持续愈发艰难了。

examples.text: Very little was done to progress the case in the first 10 or so months after K was charged.
examples.translation: 在K被指控后最初的10个月左右，这个案子进展缓慢。

examples.text: The game was already in progress when we took our seats...
examples.translation: 我们坐下来的时候，比赛已经开始了。

examples.text: The diaries are a mixture of confession, work in progress and observation.
examples.translation: 这些日记里既有自白，也有当下工作记录，还有见闻评论。

examples.text: ...a progressive businessman who had voted for Roosevelt in 1932 and 1936...
examples.translation: 在1932年和1936年投票支持罗斯福的开明商人

examples.text: Willan was able to point to the progressive changes he had already introduced...
examples.translation: 维兰能够找出他已经采用的一些革新。

examples.text: The children go to a progressive school.
examples.translation: 这些孩子在一所先进的学校念书。

examples.text: The Republicans were deeply split between progressives and conservatives.
examples.translation: 共和党的革新派和保守派之间存在严重的分裂。

examples.text: One prominent symptom of the disease is progressive loss of memory.
examples.translation: 这种疾病的一个显著症状就是记忆逐渐丧失。

examples.text: ...the progressive development of a common foreign and security policy.
examples.translation: 共同外交与安全政策的逐步发展

examples.text: Her symptoms became progressively worse...
examples.translation: 她的症状日渐恶化。

examples.text: The amount of grant the council received from the Government was progressively reduced.
examples.translation: 这个委员会获得的政府津贴数额逐渐减少。

examples.text: ...a law that prohibits tobacco advertising in newspapers and magazines...
examples.translation: 禁止在报刊杂志上刊登香烟广告的法律

examples.text: Fishing is prohibited...
examples.translation: 禁止钓鱼。

examples.text: Federal law prohibits foreign airlines from owning more than 25% of any U.S. airline.
examples.translation: 联邦法律禁止外国航空公司拥有任何一家美国航空公司超过25%的股权份额。

examples.text: ...the prohibition of women on air combat missions.
examples.translation: 禁止女性参加空中作战任务

examples.text: Money will also go into local development projects in Vietnam...
examples.translation: 钱也会用于越南的地方发展项目当中。

examples.text: ...an international science project...
examples.translation: 国际科学项目

examples.text: Besides film and record projects, I have continued to work in the theater.
examples.translation: 除了电影和唱片工作外，我还继续从事戏剧表演。

examples.text: Students complete projects for a personal tutor, working at home at their own pace.
examples.translation: 学生完成了做私人家教的课题，在家里按自己的步调工作。

examples.text: Africa's mid-1993 population is projected to more than double by 2025...
examples.translation: 预计到2025年，非洲的人口会是1993年年中人口的两倍多。

examples.text: The government had been projecting a 5% consumer price increase for the entire year.
examples.translation: 政府预测全年消费价格将增长5%。

examples.text: ...a projected deficit of $1.5 million.
examples.translation: 预计赤字为150万美元

examples.text: Bradley projects a natural warmth and sincerity...
examples.translation: 布拉德利表现出一种自然的热情和真诚。

examples.text: He just hasn't been able to project himself as the strong leader...
examples.translation: 他根本没能表现出一个强有力的领导者的样子。

examples.text: His first job will be to project Glasgow as a friendly city...
examples.translation: 他的第一项任务将是树立格拉斯哥作为一座友好城市的形象。

examples.text: The initial image projected was of a caring, effective president.
examples.translation: 他最初表现出的是一个充满爱心、办事有效的总统形象。

examples.text: He projects his own thoughts and ideas onto her.
examples.translation: 他以为她有着和自己相同的想法和观点。

examples.text: The team tried projecting the maps with two different projectors onto the same screen.
examples.translation: 这个小组想用两台不同的投影仪把这些地图投射到同一个屏幕上。

examples.text: ...the remains of a war-time defence which projected out from the shore.
examples.translation: 海滨凸立着的战时防御工事的遗迹

examples.text: ...a piece of projecting metal.
examples.translation: 一块凸立着的金属

meanings.meaning: [仪] 投影仪；放映机；探照灯；设计者

examples.text: ...a 35-millimetre slide projector.
examples.translation: 35毫米的幻灯机

examples.text: Mr Chesler said foreign military aid was prolonging the war...
examples.translation: 切斯勒先生说国外的军事援助拉长了战事。

examples.text: The actual action of the drug can be prolonged significantly.
examples.translation: 这种药物实际起作用的时间可以大大延长。

examples.text: ...the prolongation of productive human life.
examples.translation: 人类生育年龄的延长

meanings.meaning: 突出的，显著的；杰出的；卓越的

examples.text: ...a prominent member of the Law Society.
examples.translation: 法律协会的重要成员

examples.text: ...the children of very prominent or successful parents.
examples.translation: 杰出或成功人士的孩子

examples.text: Here the window plays a prominent part in the design.
examples.translation: 这里窗户在设计中起着非常重要的作用。

examples.text: ...Romania's most prominent independent newspaper.
examples.translation: 罗马尼亚最著名的独立报纸

examples.text: Trade will figure prominently in the second day of talks in Washington...
examples.translation: 华盛顿会谈的第二天将重点讨论贸易问题。

examples.text: Entries will be prominently displayed in the exhibition hall.
examples.translation: 参赛作品将陈列在展厅显眼的地方。

meanings.meaning: 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望

examples.text: The post office has promised to resume first class mail delivery to the area on Friday...
examples.translation: 邮局承诺于星期五恢复对这个地区第一类邮件的递送。

examples.text: He had promised that the rich and privileged would no longer get preferential treatment...
examples.translation: 他已经保证富人和特权阶层不会再得到优惠待遇。

examples.text: Promise me you will not waste your time...
examples.translation: 答应我，不要浪费自己的时间。

examples.text: 'We'll be back next year,' he promised...
examples.translation: “我们明年会回来的，”他承诺道。

examples.text: 'You promise?' — 'All right, I promise.'
examples.translation: “你保证？”——“好的，我保证。”

examples.text: In 1920 the great powers promised them an independent state...
examples.translation: 1920年，列强承诺让他们成为一个独立的国家。

examples.text: The officers promise a return to multiparty rule.
examples.translation: 这些官员承诺恢复多党统治。

examples.text: If you make a promise, you should keep it...
examples.translation: 如果做出了承诺，就应该遵守。

examples.text: The program has lived up to its promise to promote family welfare.
examples.translation: 这个项目恪守了其改善家庭福利的承诺。

examples.text: While it will be fun, the seminar also promises to be most instructive.
examples.translation: 这次的研讨会不仅会有趣，而且有可能会颇具启发意义。

examples.text: The boy first showed promise as an athlete in grade school.
examples.translation: 这个男孩在上小学的时候就初次显示出成为运动员的潜力。

meanings.meaning: 许诺，答应（promise的现在分词形式）

examples.text: A school has honoured one of its brightest and most promising former pupils.
examples.translation: 一所学校给曾在这里就读的最聪明、最有前途的一位学生授予了荣誉头衔。

meanings.meaning: 成为王后或其他大于卒的子

examples.text: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth...
examples.translation: 不必为了促进经济增长而牺牲环境保护。

examples.text: In many ways, our society actively promotes alcoholism.
examples.translation: 我们的社会从多个方面助长了酗酒的风气。

examples.text: The government has pledged to give the promotion of democracy higher priority.
examples.translation: 政府已经保证把促进民主摆在更重要的位置。

examples.text: ...disease prevention and health promotion.
examples.translation: 预防疾病和增进健康

examples.text: Paul Weller has announced a full British tour to promote his second solo album.
examples.translation: 保罗·韦勒已经宣布到英国巡演，以推广他的第二张专辑。

examples.text: ...a special St Lucia week where the island could be promoted as a tourist destination.
examples.translation: 在特殊的圣卢西亚活动周期间这个岛屿可以作为旅游胜地进行宣传推广

examples.text: I was promoted to editor and then editorial director...
examples.translation: 我先是被提升为编辑，然后又晋升为编务总监。

examples.text: In fact, those people have been promoted.
examples.translation: 事实上，那些人已经升职了。

examples.text: Woodford Green won the Second Division title and are promoted to the First Division.
examples.translation: 伍德福德格林队赢得了乙级联赛的冠军，成功升甲。

examples.text: Fans of Leeds United have been celebrating their team's promotion to the first division.
examples.translation: 利兹联队的球迷们一直都在庆祝他们的球队升入甲级联赛。

meanings.meaning: 提示；促进；激起；（给演员）提白
提示；付款期限；DOS命令：改变DOS系统提示符的风格

examples.text: Japan's recession has prompted consumers to cut back on buying cars...
examples.translation: 日本经济的不景气使得消费者在购买车辆上减少了开支。

examples.text: The need for villagers to control their own destinies has prompted a new plan.
examples.translation: 村民们想要掌握自己的命运，这促成了一项新的计划。

examples.text: 'Go on,' the therapist prompted him...
examples.translation: “接着说，”医生鼓励他道。

examples.text: How exactly did he prompt her, Mr Markham?
examples.translation: 确切地说，他是怎样提示她的，马卡姆先生？

examples.text: Her blushes were saved by a prompt from one of her hosts.
examples.translation: 幸亏一位主持人提示，她才不至于尴尬脸红。

examples.text: It is not too late, but prompt action is needed.
examples.translation: 现在还不算晚，但是需要立即采取行动。

examples.text: ...an inflammation of the eyeball which needs prompt treatment.
examples.translation: 需要立即治疗的眼球炎症

examples.text: You have been so prompt in carrying out all these commissions...
examples.translation: 你执行所有这些命令可真够迅速的。

examples.text: We didn't worry because they were always so prompt with their rental payment.
examples.translation: 我们不担心，因为他们交租金总是非常及时。

meanings.meaning: 俯卧的；有…倾向的，易于…的

examples.text: For all her experience, she was still prone to nerves...
examples.translation: 尽管有经验，她还是容易紧张。

examples.text: People with fair skin who sunburn easily are very prone to develop skin cancer.
examples.translation: 皮肤白皙容易晒伤的人极易患皮肤癌。

examples.text: ...the most injury-prone rider on the circuit.
examples.translation: 环道上最容易受伤的车手

examples.text: Bob slid from his chair and lay prone on the floor...
examples.translation: 鲍勃从椅子上滑下来，趴在了地板上。

examples.text: Since 1991, parents have been advised not to put their infants down to sleep in the prone position.
examples.translation: 自1991年以来就一直建议父母不要让婴儿趴着睡觉。

examples.text: And sometimes it seemed to Constance that she had divorced her own pronoun, I, and run away with another, she.
Have I pronounced your name correctly?...
examples.translation: 你的名字我念得对吗？

examples.text: He pronounced it Per-sha, the way the English do.
examples.translation: 他像英格兰人那样将它读成Per-sha。

examples.text: A specialist has now pronounced him fully fit...
examples.translation: 一位专家已宣布他的身体完全恢复了。

examples.text: I now pronounce you man and wife.
examples.translation: 我现在宣布你们结为夫妻。

examples.text: The authorities took time to pronounce their verdicts...
examples.translation: 当局斟酌权衡再三才宣布他们的决定。

examples.text: 'As for me,' he pronounced, 'I can recognize a good deal when I see one'...
examples.translation: “至于我，”他宣称，“买卖好坏我一看便知。”

examples.text: He walked around the garden and pronounced himself satisfied...
examples.translation: 他绕着花园走了走，说自己很满意。

examples.text: Men feel perfectly free to pronounce on the way women should look.
examples.translation: 男人随心所欲地对女性美的标准发表看法。

examples.text: She gave the word its French pronunciation...
examples.translation: 她读出了该词的法语发音。

examples.text: You're going to have to forgive my pronunciation.
examples.translation: 你得原谅我的发音。

meanings.meaning: 证明；证据；校样；考验；验证；试验
防…的；不能透入的；证明用的；耐…的

examples.text: You have to have proof of residence in the state of Texas, such as a Texas ID card...
examples.translation: 你必须有在得克萨斯州的居住证明，比如得克萨斯身份证。

examples.text: This is not necessarily proof that he is wrong...
examples.translation: 这不一定就证明他是错的。

examples.text: Economists have been concerned with establishing proofs for their arguments.
examples.translation: 经济学家一直致力于为他们的观点寻找证据。

examples.text: I'm correcting the proofs of the Spanish edition right now.
examples.translation: 我正在校正西班牙语版本的校样。

examples.text: ...an uncorrected proof copy of the book.
examples.translation: 该书未校正的校样

examples.text: ...a glass of Wild Turkey bourbon: 101 degrees proof.
examples.translation: 一杯威特基波旁威士忌：酒精度为101°

examples.text: The fortress was proof against the techniques of attack then in use...
examples.translation: 该防御工事能抵御当时所使用的各种进攻手段。

examples.text: His papers were proof against all but the most expert of scrutinies.
examples.translation: 他的论文几乎可以经受住最专业的审查。

examples.text: He is living proof that some players just get better with age.
examples.translation: 有些运动员年纪越大状态越好，他就是个活生生的例子。

examples.text: The Windermere Golf Club is proof positive that golf and ecology can co-exist in perfect harmony.
examples.translation: 温德米尔高尔夫俱乐部证明了高尔夫和生态能完全和谐共存。

examples.text: The Front adopted an aggressive propaganda campaign against its rivals.
examples.translation: 该阵线采用激进的宣传手段对付它的对手。

examples.text: ...anti-European propaganda movies.
examples.translation: 反欧洲的宣传影片

examples.text: The tiny rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to propel it toward Mars.
examples.translation: 小火箭捆绑在宇宙飞船上，用于推动飞船飞向火星。

examples.text: ...rocket-propelled grenades.
examples.translation: 火箭推动的榴弹

examples.text: ...the first jet-propelled aeroplane.
examples.translation: 首架喷气式飞机

examples.text: It was a shooting star that propelled me into astronomy in the first place...
examples.translation: 最初是一颗流星促使我从事天文学。

examples.text: He is propelled by both guilt and the need to avenge his father.
examples.translation: 他受到内疚感和为父报仇之心的双重驱使。

meanings.meaning: 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的

examples.text: Two out of five people lack a proper job...
examples.translation: 每五人中有两人没有正当的工作。

examples.text: I always cook a proper evening meal.
examples.translation: 我总是把晚餐做得很丰盛。

examples.text: The Supreme Court will ensure that the proper procedures have been followed...
examples.translation: 最高法院将确保程序的履行合乎规范

examples.text: He helped to put things in their proper place.
examples.translation: 他帮忙把东西放置妥当。

examples.text: In those days it was not thought entirely proper for a woman to be on the stage...
examples.translation: 那个时候，女性登台表演被认为不太得体。

examples.text: It is right and proper to do this.
examples.translation: 这么做很得体。

examples.text: A distinction must be made between archaeology proper and science-based archaeology.
examples.translation: 必须区分考古学本身和以科学为基础的考古学。

examples.text: ...the sacred name of the Holy Prophet of Islam.
examples.translation: 伊斯兰先知的圣名

examples.text: I promised myself I'd defy all the prophets of doom and battle back to fitness.
examples.translation: 我发誓要打破所有的死亡预言，力争恢复健康。

examples.text: Richard could easily destroy her personal property to punish her for walking out on him...
examples.translation: 理查德能轻易毁掉她的私人财产来惩罚她对他的背叛。

examples.text: Security forces searched thousands of homes, confiscating weapons and stolen property.
examples.translation: 安全部队搜查了数千所住宅，没收了武器和赃物。

examples.text: Cecil inherited a family property near Stamford...
examples.translation: 塞西尔继承了斯坦福德附近的一处家族房产。

examples.text: This vehicle has been parked on private property.
examples.translation: 这辆车停在了私人地产上。

examples.text: A radio signal has both electrical and magnetic properties.
examples.translation: 无线电信号具有电、磁双重属性。

examples.text: A large proportion of the dolphins in that area will eventually die...
examples.translation: 那片区域里的很大一部分海豚终将死去。

examples.text: A proportion of the rent is met by the city council.
examples.translation: 一部分租金由市政委员会支付。

examples.text: The proportion of women in the profession had risen to 17.3%...
examples.translation: 从事该职业的女性比例已升高到17.3%。

examples.text: The radio station has to include a substantial proportion of classical music.
examples.translation: 该电台不得不播放大量的古典音乐。

examples.text: Women's bodies tend to have a higher proportion of fat to water.
examples.translation: 女性的身体内脂肪与水分的比例往往更高。

examples.text: In the tropics plants grow to huge proportions.
examples.translation: 在热带，植物会长得非常高大。

examples.text: ...a fraud of breathtaking proportions.
examples.translation: 金额惊人的诈骗案

examples.text: You can vary the relative proportions of things in a picture very simply.
examples.translation: 你能很简单地改变一幅画中事物的相对比例。

examples.text: The pressure in the cylinders would go up in proportion to the boiler pressure.
examples.translation: 汽缸内的压力会随着汽锅压力的增加而相应增加。

examples.text: Children tend to have relatively larger heads than adults in proportion to the rest of their body.
examples.translation: 与成人相比，儿童头部占整个身体的比例相对较大。

examples.text: The punishment was out of all proportion to the crime.
examples.translation: 罚不当罪。

examples.text: Everything just got blown out of proportion...
examples.translation: 所有一切都变得不可收拾了。

examples.text: We've got to keep this in proportion.
examples.translation: 我们应当正确对待这一点。

examples.text: We must not lose our sense of proportion.
examples.translation: 我们不能丧失主次观念。

examples.text: The President is to put forward new proposals for resolving the country's constitutional crisis...
examples.translation: 总统将提出解决国家宪法危机的新议案。

examples.text: ...the government's proposals to abolish free health care...
examples.translation: 政府关于废除免费医疗保健的提案

examples.text: The Security Council has rejected the latest peace proposal.
examples.translation: 安理会拒绝了最新的和平提案。

examples.text: After a three-weekend courtship, Pamela accepted Randolph's proposal of marriage.
examples.translation: 经过3个周末的追求之后，帕梅拉接受了伦道夫的求婚。

examples.text: Britain is about to propose changes to some institutions...
examples.translation: 英国将提议对一些机构进行改革。

examples.text: It was George who first proposed that we dry clothes in that locker.
examples.translation: 是乔治首先提议我们把衣服挂在那个储物柜里晾干的。

examples.text: It's still far from clear what action the government proposes to take over the affair...
examples.translation: 政府打算采取何种行动处理该事件仍然十分不明朗。

examples.text: And where do you propose building such a huge thing?
examples.translation: 那么你打算在哪里建这么一个庞然大物呢？

examples.text: This highlights a problem faced by people proposing theories of ball lightning...
examples.translation: 这使得球状闪电理论的提出者所面临的一个问题凸显出来。

examples.text: Newton proposed that heavenly and terrestrial motion could be unified with the idea of gravity.
examples.translation: 牛顿提出天体和地球的运动可以用万有引力来解释。

examples.text: A delegate from Siberia proposed a resolution that he stand down as party chairman...
examples.translation: 一名来自西伯利亚的代表提议他辞去党主席的职务。

examples.text: I asked Robin Balfour and Derek Haig to propose and second me.
examples.translation: 我请罗宾·鲍尔弗和德里克·黑格提名并支持我。

examples.text: ...Mr Ian Murch, the proposer of the motion.
examples.translation: 伊恩·默奇先生，该动议的提议者

examples.text: Usually the bride's father proposes a toast to the health of the bride and groom.
examples.translation: 通常新娘的父亲会提议为新郎新娘的健康干杯。

examples.text: He had proposed to Isabel the day after taking his seat in Parliament.
examples.translation: 当选议员的第二天，他向伊莎贝尔求婚了。

examples.text: Making easy money has always been an attractive proposition...
examples.translation: 轻松赚钱总是件诱人的事。

examples.text: Even among seasoned mountaineers Pinnacle Ridge is considered quite a tough proposition.
examples.translation: 即使在经验丰富的登山者中，平纳克尔峰也被认为是很难攀登的。

examples.text: The proposition that democracies do not fight each other is based on a tiny historical sample.
examples.translation: 认为民主国家互不争斗的观点是以一个极小的历史样本为根据的。

examples.text: Vote Yes on Proposition 136, but No on Propositions 129, 133 and 134.
examples.translation: 对第136号修正案投赞成票，但对第129号、133号和134号修正案投反对票。

examples.text: You came to see me at my office the other day with a business proposition...
examples.translation: 几天前你带着一份商业提案来我的办公室见我。

examples.text: I want to make you a proposition.
examples.translation: 我想给你提一个建议。

examples.text: He had allegedly tried to proposition a colleague.
examples.translation: 据说他曾试图向一名同事求欢。

examples.text: ...unwanted sexual propositions.
examples.translation: 令人讨厌的求欢

examples.text: Shute's prose is stark and chillingly unsentimental...
examples.translation: 舒特的散文平铺直叙，没有感情，让人感觉冷冰冰的。

examples.text: What he has to say is expressed in prose of exceptional lucidity and grace.
examples.translation: 他所要说的都以极为明晰优雅的文字表达了出来。

meanings.meaning: 检举；贯彻；从事；依法进行

examples.text: The police have decided not to prosecute because the evidence is not strong enough...
examples.translation: 由于证据不足，警方已决定不起诉。

examples.text: Photographs taken by roadside cameras will soon be enough to prosecute drivers for speeding...
examples.translation: 路边电子眼拍下的照片很快将足以起诉超速的司机。

examples.text: He is being prosecuted for two criminal offences.
examples.translation: 他因两项刑事罪名受到起诉。

examples.text: The attorney who will prosecute the case says he cannot reveal how much money is involved.
examples.translation: 将对此案提起公诉的律师说他不能透露具体的涉案金额。

examples.text: ...the prosecuting attorney.
examples.translation: 检察官

examples.text: Unfortunately, there is little prospect of seeing these big questions answered...
examples.translation: 不幸的是，几乎不可能看到这些重大问题得到回复。

examples.text: The prospects for peace in the country's eight-year civil war are becoming brighter...
examples.translation: 该国经历8年内战之后重归和平的前景正逐渐变得光明。

examples.text: There is a real prospect that the bill will be defeated in parliament.
examples.translation: 该议案很有可能会被议会否决。

examples.text: They now face the prospect of having to wear a cycling helmet by law...
examples.translation: 他们现在面临的情形是：不久将需要依法佩戴摩托车头盔。

examples.text: After supper he'd put his feet up and read. It was a pleasant prospect.
examples.translation: 晚饭后，他会架起脚来看书。想起来就让人愉快。

examples.text: I chose to work abroad to improve my career prospects.
examples.translation: 我选择出国工作以求在事业上有更好的发展。

examples.text: ...a detailed review of the company's prospects.
examples.translation: 对该公司前景的详细考查

examples.text: He had prospected for minerals everywhere from the Gobi Desert to the Transvaal...
examples.translation: 他已在从戈壁沙漠到德兰士瓦的无数地方勘探过矿藏。

examples.text: In fact, the oil companies are already prospecting not far from here.
examples.translation: 事实上，石油公司已经在离此不远处进行勘探。

examples.text: He was involved in oil, zinc and lead prospecting.
examples.translation: 他参与了石油、锌和铅的勘探。

examples.text: The discovery of gold brought a flood of prospectors into the Territories.
examples.translation: 金子的发现吸引了大量的勘探者进入这些地区。

examples.text: The story should act as a warning to other prospective buyers...
examples.translation: 这篇报道应该对其他潜在的购买者起到警示作用。

examples.text: When his prospective employers learned that he smoked, they said they wouldn't hire him.
examples.translation: 本有可能雇用他的老板们得知他吸烟后，说他们不会雇他。

examples.text: ...the terms of the prospective deal.
examples.translation: 可能达成的交易的条款

examples.text: The high street banks continue to prosper...
examples.translation: 商业街上的银行仍旧一派繁荣景象。

examples.text: His teams have always prospered in cup competitions.
examples.translation: 他的队伍在杯赛上总是成绩不俗。

examples.text: ...a new era of peace and prosperity.
examples.translation: 和平繁荣的新时代

examples.text: ...Japan's economic prosperity.
examples.translation: 日本的经济繁荣

examples.text: ...the youngest son of a relatively prosperous British family...
examples.translation: 一个相对富裕的英国家族中最小的儿子

examples.text: The place looks more prosperous than ever.
examples.translation: 这地方显得空前繁荣。

examples.text: So, what can women do to protect themselves from heart disease?...
examples.translation: 那么，女性怎样做才能使自己不得心脏病呢？

examples.text: A long thin wool coat and a purple headscarf protected her against the wind...
examples.translation: 一件薄薄的羊毛长外套和一条紫色的头巾为她挡了风。

examples.text: The government is committed to protecting the interests of tenants.
examples.translation: 政府承诺保护租户们的利益。

examples.text: Many manufacturers have policies to protect themselves against blackmailers.
examples.translation: 许多厂家都购买了保险，以防遭到敲诈。

examples.text: Fish was a major source of protein for the working man.
examples.translation: 鱼肉曾是劳动者的主要蛋白质来源。

examples.text: ...a high protein diet.
examples.translation: 高蛋白饮食

examples.text: Groups of women took to the streets to protest against the arrests...
examples.translation: 成群结队的妇女上街抗议逮捕行动。

examples.text: The students were protesting at overcrowding in the university hostels...
examples.translation: 学生们在抗议大学宿舍过于拥挤。

examples.text: They were protesting soaring prices...
examples.translation: 他们抗议物价暴涨。

examples.text: He picked up the cat before Rosa could protest.
examples.translation: 未等罗莎表示异议，他就抱起了猫。

examples.text: The opposition now seems too weak to stage any serious protests against the government...
examples.translation: 反对党现在似乎势力非常弱小，无法针对政府发起真正的抗议。

examples.text: The unions called a two-hour strike in protest at the railway authority's announcement.
examples.translation: 各工会号召罢工两小时，以对铁路当局所发通告表示抗议。

examples.text: ...a protest march.
examples.translation: 抗议游行

examples.text: When we tried to protest that Mo was beaten up they didn't believe us...
examples.translation: 我们试图申明莫遭到了毒打，他们却不相信我们。

examples.text: 'I never said any of that to her,' he protested...
examples.translation: “我从来没有对她那么说过，”他申辩道。

examples.text: He has always protested his innocence.
examples.translation: 他一直申辩自己是无辜的。

examples.text: That was how she usually dealt with their protests that she was spoiling her grandchildren.
examples.translation: 当他们坚持说她是在溺爱孙儿，她通常会作出那样的回应。

examples.text: Chris Retzler has built a prototype of a machine called the wave rotor.
examples.translation: 克里斯·雷茨勒已制造出了一种叫波转子的机器的样机。

examples.text: ...the first prototype aircraft.
examples.translation: 第一架飞机样机

examples.text: He was the prototype of the elder statesman.
examples.translation: 他是老一辈政治家的典型。

examples.text: I felt proud of his efforts...
examples.translation: 我为他的努力感到骄傲。

examples.text: They are proud that she is doing well at school...
examples.translation: 他们为她出色的学习成绩感到骄傲。

examples.text: I am proud to be a Canadian...
examples.translation: 身为一个加拿大人我感到很自豪。

examples.text: Derek is now the proud father of a bouncing baby girl.
examples.translation: 德里克现在为有一个健康活泼的女宝宝而骄傲。

examples.text: 'That's the first part finished,' he said proudly.
examples.translation: “那是已完成的第一部分，”他自豪地说。

examples.text: This must have been one of the proudest moments of his busy and hard working life.
examples.translation: 这一定是他劳碌工作的一生中最引以为荣的时刻之一。

examples.text: He was too proud to ask his family for help and support...
examples.translation: 他自尊心太强，不愿向家人寻求帮助和支持。

examples.text: We are a proud people. We are not used to begging or taking things.
examples.translation: 我们是有自尊的民族。我们不习惯乞讨或接受施舍。

examples.text: She was said to be proud and arrogant.
examples.translation: 据说她傲慢自大。

examples.text: The handles stand proud of the doors of the car.
examples.translation: 把手位于车门之外。

examples.text: The hotel has indeed done them proud.
examples.translation: 这家宾馆的确对他们盛情款待。

examples.text: We have been accused of exaggerating before, but unfortunately all our reports proved to be true...
examples.translation: 以前一直有人指责我们夸大事实，但遗憾的是，我们所有的报道都证明是真实的。

examples.text: In the past this process of transition has often proven difficult.
examples.translation: 过去这一过渡过程常常很艰难。

examples.text: ...an experiment which was to prove a source of inspiration for many years to come.
examples.translation: 在之后多年证明一直都是灵感源泉的一项实验

examples.text: You brought this charge. You prove it!...
examples.translation: 你提出了这项控告。你拿出证据来！

examples.text: The results prove that regulation of the salmon farming industry is inadequate.
examples.translation: 结果证明对鲑鱼饲养行业的管理不够完善。

examples.text: ...trying to prove how groups of animals have evolved...
examples.translation: 试图证明动物群体是如何进化的

examples.text: That made me hopping mad and determined to prove him wrong...
examples.translation: 那使我极为恼火，下决心要证明他是错的。

examples.text: History will prove him to have been right all along.
examples.translation: 历史将证明他一直是对的。

examples.text: ...a proven cause of cancer.
examples.translation: 已确证的癌症病因

examples.text: Margaret proved herself to be a good mother...
examples.translation: 玛格丽特证明了自己是个好妈妈。

examples.text: As a composer he proved himself adept at large dramatic forms...
examples.translation: 身为作曲家的他证明了自己在创作大型戏剧方面驾轻就熟。

examples.text: A man needs time to prove himself...
examples.translation: 人需要时间来证明自己。

examples.text: Few would argue that this team has experience and proven ability.
examples.translation: 这个队伍的丰富经验和表现出来的实力是众所公认的。

examples.text: They made a 3,000 mile detour simply to prove a point.
examples.translation: 他们绕行3,000英里只是为了证明自己能够做到。

examples.text: The other banks are going to be very eager to help, provided that they see that he has a specific plan...
examples.translation: 如果看到他有具体的计划，其他银行会很愿意提供帮助。

examples.text: Provided they are fit I see no reason why they shouldn't go on playing for another four or five years.
examples.translation: 只要他们身体强健，我看不出他们有什么理由不继续再打四五年比赛。

examples.text: I'll be glad to provide a copy of this...
examples.translation: 我很愿意提供它的一个副本。

examples.text: They would not provide any details...
examples.translation: 他们不愿提供任何细节。

examples.text: The government was not in a position to provide them with food.
examples.translation: 政府不可能给他们提供食物。

examples.text: They remain the main providers of sports facilities.
examples.translation: 他们仍然是体育设施的主要提供商。

examples.text: The treaty provides that, by the end of the century, the United States must have removed its bases...
examples.translation: 条约规定，到本世纪末，美国必须撤除其基地。

examples.text: The Act provides that only the parents of a child have a responsibility for that child's financial support.
examples.translation: 法令规定只有孩子的父母才有责任为孩子提供经济支持。

examples.text: ...the Algarve, Portugal's southernmost province.
examples.translation: 阿尔加维， 葡萄牙最南部的省份

examples.text: The government plans to transfer some 30,000 government jobs from Paris to the provinces.
examples.translation: 政府计划将3万个左右的政府职位从巴黎转移到外省。

examples.text: Arvo avoided committing himself. 'I'm afraid that's not my province,' he replied...
examples.translation: 阿尔沃不想作出承诺，“恐怕那不归我管，”他回答说。

examples.text: Industrial research is the province of the Department of Trade and Industry.
examples.translation: 工业研究属贸易和工业部的职责范围。

meanings.meaning: 规定；条款；准备；[经] 供应品

examples.text: The department is responsible for the provision of residential care services.
examples.translation: 该部门负责提供家庭护理服务。

examples.text: ...nursery provision for children with special needs.
examples.translation: 为有特殊需要的儿童提供护理

examples.text: Mr King asked if it had ever occurred to her to make provision for her own pension...
examples.translation: 金先生问她是否曾想过要为自己的养老金预先作安排。

examples.text: There is no provision for funding performance-related pay rises.
examples.translation: 没有为与业绩挂钩的加薪预作资金准备。

examples.text: Special provision should be made for children...
examples.translation: 应给孩子在经济上专门作好安排。

examples.text: There are very generous provisions for the mother.
examples.translation: 这位母亲在物质上得到了很好的赡养。

examples.text: He backed a provision that would allow judges to delay granting a divorce decree in some cases...
examples.translation: 他赞成一项允许法官在一些情况下延迟作出离婚判决的法律条款。

examples.text: The bill's provision for the sale and purchase of land faces stiff opposition from conservatives.
examples.translation: 该法案关于土地买卖的规定遭到保守派的强硬反对。

examples.text: On board were enough provisions for two weeks.
examples.translation: 船上有足够两周吃的食物。

examples.text: He started beating me when I was about fifteen but I didn't do anything to provoke him...
examples.translation: 在我快15岁时他开始打我，可我并没有任何招惹他的举动。

examples.text: I provoked him into doing something really stupid.
examples.translation: 在我的刺激下他做了件非常愚蠢的事。

examples.text: His election success has provoked a shocked reaction...
examples.translation: 他的当选引起一片震惊。

examples.text: The destruction of the mosque has provoked anger throughout the Muslim world.
examples.translation: 毁坏清真寺的行为激怒了整个伊斯兰世界。

examples.text: It is always prudent to start any exercise programme gradually at first...
examples.translation: 刚开始一项锻炼计划时循序渐进总是明智的。

examples.text: Being a prudent and cautious person, you realise that the problem must be resolved.
examples.translation: 慎重小心的人都会意识到这个问题非解决不可。

examples.text: I believe it is essential that we act prudently...
examples.translation: 我认为我们必须慎重行事。

examples.text: Prudently, Joanna spoke none of this aloud.
examples.translation: 出于慎重，乔安娜说这些话时一直压低声音。

meanings.meaning: 精神病学；精神病治疗法

examples.text: Your question strikes directly to the heart not just of psychiatry but of modern medicine itself.
...Professor of Psychology at Bedford College.
examples.translation: 贝德福德学院的心理学教授

examples.text: ...a fascination with the psychology of murderers.
examples.translation: 对杀人犯心理的着迷

examples.text: He was in the pub until closing time...
examples.translation: 他在酒吧里一直呆到打烊。

examples.text: Richard used to run a pub.
examples.translation: 理查德曾经开过酒吧。

meanings.meaning: 公众的；政府的；公用的；公立的

examples.text: Lauderdale House is now open to the public...
examples.translation: 劳德代尔艺术教育中心现已向公众开放。

examples.text: Pure alcohol is not for sale to the general public...
examples.translation: 纯酒精不向大众出售。

examples.text: Trade unions are regarding the poll as a test of the public's confidence in the government.
examples.translation: 工会将此次民意调查当作测试民众对政府信心的一种方式。

examples.text: Market research showed that 93% of the viewing public wanted a hit film channel.
examples.translation: 市场调查表明93%的观众希望有一个播放热门影片的频道。

examples.text: ...the American voting public.
examples.translation: 美国选民

examples.text: The President is attempting to drum up public support for his economic program.
examples.translation: 总统正竭力争取公众对他的经济计划予以支持。

examples.text: The social services account for a substantial part of public spending.
examples.translation: 社会福利事业占了一大部分的公共支出。

examples.text: ...publicly funded legal services.
examples.translation: 政府出资的法律服务机构

examples.text: ...the New York Public Library...
examples.translation: 纽约公立图书馆

examples.text: The new museum must be accessible by public transport.
examples.translation: 新博物馆必须能乘坐公共交通工具到达。

examples.text: ...a public health service available to all.
examples.translation: 面向全民的公共医疗保健服务

examples.text: ...the heavily congested public areas of international airports...
examples.translation: 国际机场人潮涌动的公共场所

examples.text: I avoid working in places which are too public.
examples.translation: 我避免在过于抛头露面的地方工作。

examples.text: The Archbishop of Canterbury yesterday hit out at public figures who commit adultery...
examples.translation: 昨天坎特伯雷大主教严厉抨击了几位与人通奸的公众人物。

examples.text: I'd like to see more women in public life, especially Parliament.
examples.translation: 我希望看到更多女性参与公众事务，尤其是能在议会中工作。

examples.text: The National Heritage Committee has conducted a public inquiry to find the answer...
examples.translation: 国家遗产委员会进行了公开调查以寻找答案。

examples.text: The comments were the ministry's first detailed public statement on the subject...
examples.translation: 这些评论是该部委第一次就此事所作的详细公开声明。

examples.text: Marilyn made her last public appearance at Madison Square Garden.
examples.translation: 玛丽莲最后一次公开亮相是在麦迪逊广场花园。

examples.text: He never spoke publicly about the affair...
examples.translation: 他从未公开说过此事。

examples.text: Every move the President makes is publicly discussed as openly as possible.
examples.translation: 总统采取的每一项措施都经过尽可能公开的讨论。

examples.text: Blair wants any new evidence on IRA pub bombs made public...
examples.translation: 布莱尔希望将任何关于爱尔兰共和军制造的酒馆爆炸事件的新证据都公之于众。

examples.text: The facts could cause embarrassment if they ever became public.
examples.translation: 一旦披露出去，真相会让人非常尴尬。

examples.text: One expects people in the public eye to conduct their personal lives with a certain decorum...
examples.translation: 人们期望公众人物的私生活能检点些。

examples.text: He has kept his wife and daughter out of the public eye.
examples.translation: 他一直让妻子和女儿远离公众视线。

examples.text: In 1951 AC went public, having achieved an average annual profit of more than £50,000.
examples.translation: AC公司于1951年上市，当时平均年利润为5万多英镑。

examples.text: Bylaws are to make it illegal to smoke in public.
examples.translation: 地方法规将规定在公共场合抽烟为非法。

examples.text: The guide is being translated into several languages for publication near Christmas...
examples.translation: 该手册正被译成数种语言，将在临近圣诞节时出版。

examples.text: The publication of his collected poems was approaching the status of an event.
examples.translation: 他的诗集的出版可能说是一件大事。

examples.text: They have started legal proceedings against two publications which spoke of an affair.
examples.translation: 他们开始对两本提及一桩婚外情的出版物提起法律诉讼。

examples.text: A spokesman said: 'We have no comment regarding the publication of these photographs.'
examples.translation: 一位发言人说，“对于这些照片的公之于众，我们不予置评。”

meanings.meaning: 宣传，宣扬；公开；广告；注意

examples.text: Much advance publicity was given to the talks...
examples.translation: 对于这次会谈有很多前期报道。

examples.text: ...government publicity campaigns...
examples.translation: 政府宣传活动

examples.text: It was all a publicity stunt.
examples.translation: 这完全是个宣传噱头。

examples.text: The case has generated enormous publicity in Brazil.
examples.translation: 这个案件已经在巴西引起了极大的关注。

examples.text: ...the renewed publicity over the Casey affair.
examples.translation: 对凯西事件的再次关注

examples.text: They publish reference books...
examples.translation: 他们出版工具书。

examples.text: His latest book of poetry will be published by Faber in May.
examples.translation: 他的最新诗集将由菲贝尔出版公司于5月出版。

examples.text: The ban was imposed after the magazine published an article satirising the government...
examples.translation: 这家杂志刊登了一篇讽刺政府的文章后被停刊。

examples.text: I don't encourage people to take photographs like this without permission, but by law we can publish.
examples.translation: 我不鼓励人们未经允许就拍摄这样的照片，但根据法律我们可以刊登。

examples.text: John Lennon found time to publish two books of his humorous prose.
examples.translation: 约翰·列侬抽时间出版了两本幽默散文。

examples.text: The demonstrators called on the government to publish a list of registered voters.
examples.translation: 游行者呼吁政府公布注册选民的名单。

meanings.meaning: 喷出，张开；使膨胀；夸张；使骄傲自满
粉扑；泡芙；蓬松；一阵喷烟；肿块；吹嘘，宣传广告

examples.text: He lit a cigar and puffed at it twice...
examples.translation: 他点了一支雪茄，吸了两口。

examples.text: He nodded and puffed on a stubby pipe as he listened.
examples.translation: 他边听边点头，还吸着一支粗短的烟斗。

examples.text: She was taking quick puffs at her cigarette like a beginner.
examples.translation: 她像刚开始抽烟的人一样很快地吸着。

examples.text: Richard lit another cigarette and puffed smoke towards the ceiling...
examples.translation: 理查德又点了一支烟，朝着天花板喷云吐雾。

examples.text: The weather was dry and cold; wisps of steam puffed from their lips.
examples.translation: 天气又干又冷，他们嘴里哈出缕缕白气。

examples.text: He drew heavily on his cigarette and puffed out a cloud of smoke.
examples.translation: 他猛吸了一口烟，吐出一团烟雾。

examples.text: As I completed my 26th lap the Porsche puffed blue smoke.
examples.translation: 我跑了26圈时，保时捷车冒出了蓝烟。

examples.text: Wind caught the sudden puff of dust and blew it inland.
examples.translation: 风猛地刮起一阵灰尘，将它吹往内陆。

examples.text: I know nothing about boxing, but I could see he was unfit, because he was puffing.
examples.translation: 我对拳击一无所知，但我能看出他状态不佳，因为他在急促喘息。

examples.text: What is presented to the public as a critical evaluation is really an elaborate puff for him and his magazine.
examples.translation: 公众所看到的评论界的好评实际上是对他和他的杂志的一种吹捧。

examples.text: He puffed the new system by showing how badly his existing system performed by comparison.
examples.translation: 他通过比较，展示了当前的系统运行得如何不好，以此来吹捧这种新的系统。

examples.text: They have pulled out patients' teeth unnecessarily...
examples.translation: 他们毫无必要地拔掉了病人的牙。

examples.text: He pulled on a jersey...
examples.translation: 他套上一件运动衫。

examples.text: Erica was solemn, pulling at her blonde curls...
examples.translation: 埃丽卡表情严肃，扯着自己卷曲的金发。

examples.text: I helped pull him out of the water...
examples.translation: 我帮忙把他从水里拉了出来。

examples.text: Someone pulled her hair...
examples.translation: 有人扯她的头发。

examples.text: He knew he should pull the trigger, but he was suddenly paralysed by fear...
examples.translation: 他知道他应该扣动扳机，但突然间害怕得动弹不得。

examples.text: Pull as hard as you can...
examples.translation: 用全力拉。

examples.text: I let myself out into the street and pulled the door shut.
examples.translation: 我出门上街并拉上了门。

examples.text: The feather must be removed with a straight, firm pull.
examples.translation: 拔羽毛必须干净利落。

examples.text: Jack pulled the slip of paper from his shirt pocket...
examples.translation: 杰克从衬衫口袋里抽出这张纸条。

examples.text: Wade walked quickly to the refrigerator and pulled out another beer.
examples.translation: 韦德快步走到冰箱边又拿出一罐啤酒。

examples.text: This is early-20th-century rural Sussex, when horses still pulled the plough...
examples.translation: 这是20世纪早期的萨塞克斯乡村，那时还是用马拉犁。

examples.text: He pulls a rickshaw, probably the oldest form of human taxi service.
examples.translation: 他拉黄包车，这可能是人类最古老的载客服务形式了。

examples.text: Hughes pulled himself slowly to his feet...
examples.translation: 休斯慢慢站了起来。

examples.text: He pulled his arms out of the sleeves...
examples.translation: 他把胳膊从袖子里抽出来。

examples.text: She tried to pull her hand free...
examples.translation: 她想把自己的手挣脱开。

examples.text: Lillian brushed his cheek with her fingertips. He pulled away and said, 'Don't!'
examples.translation: 莉莲用指尖碰他的脸颊。他挣开了说，“不要这样！”

examples.text: He pulled to a stop behind a pickup truck...
examples.translation: 他在一辆皮卡货车后面停了下来。

examples.text: The train pulled to a halt at the platform.
examples.translation: 火车在站台边停下。

examples.text: He pulled away, extending his lead to 15 seconds...
examples.translation: 他把领先优势逐渐扩大到了15秒。

examples.text: The six states he won in 1988 are the same states in which he has yet to pull ahead of his opponent.
examples.translation: 1988年他获胜的6个州也是他目前有待领先于对手的几个州。

examples.text: If I wanted to improve the car significantly I would have to pull it apart and start again.
examples.translation: 如果想好好地改进这辆车，我将不得不把它拆开重装。

examples.text: They had a fight. One of them pulled a gun on the other...
examples.translation: 他们打了起来。其中一人拔出枪指着另一个人。

examples.text: I pulled a knife and threatened her.
examples.translation: 我拔出刀威胁她。

examples.text: The organisers have to employ performers to pull a crowd.
examples.translation: 组织者不得不雇些演员来聚拢人气。

examples.text: They provided a far better news service and pulled in many more viewers...
examples.translation: 他们提供的新闻播报要好得多，因此吸引了更多的观众。

examples.text: She is still beautiful, and still pulling them in at sixty.
examples.translation: 她依然很美丽，虽已年届60，对他们仍很有吸引力。

examples.text: Joe felt there was little he could do to help Betty, and his heart was pulling him elsewhere.
examples.translation: 乔感到帮不上贝蒂什么忙，他的心思在别的地方。

examples.text: No matter how much you feel the pull of the past, make a determined effort to look to the future.
examples.translation: 不管对过去有多么留恋，你也要下定决心往前看。

examples.text: ...the pull of gravity.
examples.translation: 重力的牵引

examples.text: We're all pulling for each other because we're desperate to win the Cup back...
examples.translation: 因为我们非常想赢回奖杯，所以一直在互相打气。

examples.text: You know I've been pulling for you.
examples.translation: 你知道我一直在为你加油。

examples.text: Dave pulled a back muscle and could barely kick the ball...
examples.translation: 戴夫背部拉伤，几乎没法踢球。

examples.text: He suffered a pulled calf muscle.
examples.translation: 他小腿肚肌肉拉伤。

examples.text: Jeff leaned back and pulled on his cigarette.
examples.translation: 杰夫往后一靠，深深地吸了一口烟。

examples.text: He took a deep pull of his cigarette and exhaled the smoke.
examples.translation: 他深吸了一口烟，然后轻轻吐了出来。

examples.text: Everyone saw the stunt you pulled on me.
examples.translation: 大家都看见了你对我耍的花招。

examples.text: What! A big bloke like you, beaten by his wife! Pull the other one; it's got bells on.
examples.translation: 什么！你这么一个大块头居然被他的妻子打了！别逗了。

examples.text: Mahoney's pulse was racing, and he felt confused.
examples.translation: 马奥尼脉搏跳得很快，他感到很慌乱。

examples.text: ...the repetitive pulse of the music.
examples.translation: 音乐中重复的鼓点

examples.text: The switch works by passing a pulse of current between the tip and the surface.
examples.translation: 那个开关通过在末梢和表面之间传输电流脉冲工作。

examples.text: The White House insists that the president is in touch with the pulse of the black community.
examples.translation: 白宫坚持称总统是了解黑人群体的心声的。

examples.text: His temples pulsed a little, threatening a headache...
examples.translation: 他的太阳穴跳了一会，像是头痛要发作了。

examples.text: It was a slow, pulsing rhythm that seemed to sway languidly in the air.
examples.translation: 那是一种缓缓的律动，感觉像是慵懒地摇曳在空气中。

examples.text: He claims to have his finger on the pulse of the industry...
examples.translation: 他声称该对行业了如指掌。

examples.text: It's important to keep your finger on the pulse by reading all the right magazines.
examples.translation: 通过阅读所有相关杂志而保持消息灵通是很重要的。

examples.text: ...pumps that circulate the fuel around in the engine...
examples.translation: 使燃料在发动机内循环的泵

examples.text: There was no water in the building, just a pump in the courtyard...
examples.translation: 楼里没有水，只是在庭院里有个水泵。

examples.text: You'll need a bicycle pump to keep the tyres topped up with air.
examples.translation: 需要一个打气筒来给自行车轮胎里充足气。

examples.text: It's not enough to get rid of raw sewage by pumping it out to sea...
examples.translation: 将未经处理的污水排入海中了事是不够的。

examples.text: The money raised will be used to dig bore holes to pump water into the dried-up lake.
examples.translation: 所筹资金将用于钻孔打水以抽水到干涸的湖中。

examples.text: ...drill rigs that are busy pumping natural gas...
examples.translation: 不停抽取天然气的架式钻机

examples.text: Age diminishes the heart's ability to pump harder and faster under exertion.
examples.translation: 随着年龄的增加，人在消耗体力时心脏的输血能力和输血速度会有所减弱。

examples.text: There are already long queues of vehicles at petrol pumps.
examples.translation: 加油泵边车辆已经排起了长队。

examples.text: ...gas pumps.
examples.translation: 汽油加油泵

examples.text: She was released from hospital yesterday after having her stomach pumped.
examples.translation: 洗胃之后，她昨天出了院。

examples.text: The Government needs to pump more money into community care.
examples.translation: 政府需要将更多资金投入到社区护理这一块。

examples.text: He ran in every five minutes to pump me about the case...
examples.translation: 他每隔五分钟就跑来追问我这件事。

examples.text: He must have pumped Janey for details...
examples.translation: 他肯定追问过珍妮详细的情况。

examples.text: Stop trying to pump information out of me.
examples.translation: 别再追问我消息了。

examples.text: A gunman burst in and pumped five bullets into her head.
examples.translation: 一个持枪歹徒闯进来，朝她的脑袋连射5枪。

examples.text: ...the use of tax money to prime the pump of the state's economy.
examples.translation: 用税收收入来刺激该国经济发展

examples.text: After punching him on the chin she wound up hitting him over the head...
examples.translation: 她先挥拳打他的下巴，然后又打他的脑袋。

examples.text: He punched the wall angrily, then spun round to face her.
examples.translation: 他生气地用拳捶墙，接着转过身来面对着她。

examples.text: 'I almost lost my job today.' — 'What happened?' — 'Oh, I punched out this guy.'...
examples.translation: “我今天几乎丢了工作。”——“发生什么事了？”——“哦，我打了这个家伙。”

examples.text: In the past, many kids would settle disputes by punching each other out.
examples.translation: 过去，很多孩子用拳头解决矛盾。

examples.text: He was hurting Johansson with body punches in the fourth round.
examples.translation: 第四回合时，他数次挥拳打在约翰松身上。

examples.text: ...the awesome range of blows which have confirmed him as boxing's hardest puncher.
examples.translation: 又准又狠的系列组合拳，确立了他在拳坛的“铁榔头”称号

examples.text: At the end, Graf punched the air in delight, a huge grin on her face.
examples.translation: 最后，格拉夫高兴得挥动着拳头，脸上笑开了花。

examples.text: Mrs. Baylor strode to the elevator and punched the button.
examples.translation: 贝勒太太迈向电梯，按下按钮。

examples.text: I took a ballpoint pen and punched a hole in the carton.
examples.translation: 我拿了一支圆珠笔，在纸盒上戳了一个洞。

examples.text: Make two holes with a hole punch.
examples.translation: 用打孔器打两个孔。

examples.text: My nervousness made me deliver the vital points of my address without sufficient punch...
examples.translation: 我太紧张，没能有效地传达我演说的要点。

examples.text: Hurricane Andrew may be slowly losing its punch, but its winds are still around 100 miles an hour.
examples.translation: 飓风安德鲁的风力可能会逐渐减弱，但风速仍在每小时100英里左右。

examples.text: She has a reputation for getting at the guts of a subject and never pulling her punches.
examples.translation: 她论事一针见血是出了名的，从来都是直言不讳。

examples.text: He's always very punctual. I'll see if he's here yet.
examples.translation: 他总是很准时。我去看看他是否已经来了。

examples.text: My guest arrived punctually.
examples.translation: 我的客人来得很准时。

examples.text: I'll have to have a word with them about punctuality.
examples.translation: 我必须和他们谈一谈守时的问题。

meanings.meaning: 惩罚；严厉对待；贪婪地吃喝

examples.text: I don't believe that George ever had to punish the children...
examples.translation: 我认为乔治根本没有必要处罚孩子们。

examples.text: According to present law, the authorities can only punish smugglers with small fines...
examples.translation: 根据现行法律，当局只能对走私者处以小额罚款。

examples.text: Don't punish your child for being honest.
examples.translation: 不要因为你的孩子说了实话而处罚他。

examples.text: The government voted to punish corruption in sport with up to four years in jail...
examples.translation: 政府经表决后决定对体育界的舞弊行为最高将处以4年监禁。

examples.text: Such behaviour is unacceptable and will be punished.
examples.translation: 这种行为不可容忍，必将受到惩罚。

meanings.meaning: 学生；[解剖] 瞳孔；未成年人

examples.text: Over a third of those now at secondary school in Wales attend schools with over 1,000 pupils...
examples.translation: 威尔士现在的初中生中有1/3以上的人就读的学校学生总数超过1,000人。

examples.text: Eleanor was a reluctant, anxious pupil.
examples.translation: 埃莉诺是个扭捏局促的小学生。

examples.text: After his education, Goldschmidt became a pupil of the composer Franz Schreker.
examples.translation: 学业结束后，戈尔德施米特成了作曲家弗朗兹·施雷克尔的学生。

meanings.meaning: 木偶；傀儡；受他人操纵的人

examples.text: When the invasion occurred he ruled as a puppet of the occupiers...
examples.translation: 外敌入侵时，他作为占领者的傀儡行使统治。

examples.text: He warned there would be a 'social explosion' if the army installed another puppet prime minister.
examples.translation: 他警告说如果军方再安插一个新的傀儡首相，将会引发“社会暴动”。

examples.text: He purchased a ticket and went up on the top deck...
examples.translation: 他买了一张票，然后上到顶层甲板。

examples.text: Most of those shares were purchased from brokers.
examples.translation: 大部分的股份是从经纪人手中购得的。

examples.text: The broker will get 5% if he finds a purchaser...
examples.translation: 找到一个买家，经纪人就能提成5%。

examples.text: The group is the second largest purchaser of fresh fruit in the US.
examples.translation: 该集团是美国新鲜水果的第二大买主。

examples.text: Some of the receipts had been for the purchase of cars.
examples.translation: 其中一些收据是购买汽车时开的。

examples.text: She opened the tie box and looked at her purchase. It was silk, with maroon stripes.
examples.translation: 她打开领带盒，看着她买回的东西：一条带有褐红色条纹的丝制领带。

examples.text: I got a purchase on the rope and pulled...
examples.translation: 我紧抓住绳子，用力去拉。

examples.text: I couldn't get any purchase with the screwdriver on the damn screws.
examples.translation: 我用螺丝刀拧那些该死的螺丝钉时一点也使不上劲儿。

meanings.meaning: 纯的；纯粹的；纯洁的；清白的；纯理论的

examples.text: ...a carton of pure orange juice.
examples.translation: 一盒纯橙汁

examples.text: In remote regions, the air is pure and the crops are free of poisonous insecticides.
examples.translation: 在偏远地区，空气很纯净，庄稼也不施用有毒的杀虫剂。

examples.text: ...demands for purer and cleaner river water.
examples.translation: 需要更纯净、更清洁的河水

examples.text: They worried about the purity of tap water.
examples.translation: 他们担心自来水是否纯净。

examples.text: ...flowers in a whole range of blues with the occasional pure white.
examples.translation: 各种深深浅浅的蓝色花朵，偶尔有纯白色花朵点缀其间

examples.text: The soaring purity of her voice conjured up the frozen bleakness of the Far North.
examples.translation: 她高昂纯净的嗓音使人想起极北地区滴水成冰的寒冷与清冽。

examples.text: Nicholson never swerved from his aim of making pure and simple art.
examples.translation: 尼科尔森始终坚持创作纯粹简单的艺术，从未动摇过。

examples.text: ...verse of great purity, sonority of rhythm, and symphonic form.
examples.translation: 节奏铿锵有力、气势恢宏、地道纯正的诗句

examples.text: Physics isn't just about pure science with no immediate applications...
examples.translation: 物理学并非只是一门不能直接运用的纯科学。

examples.text: They did not approach their subject solely as a matter of 'pure' theory.
examples.translation: 他们并没有把他们的学科完全当作一门“纯”理论学科来对待。

examples.text: The old man turned to give her a look of pure surprise...
examples.translation: 老人转身十分惊奇地看了她一眼。

examples.text: To sleep on my own and not hear the boys snore or grunt was pure bliss.
examples.translation: 自己一个人睡、不用听男孩们的鼾声或咕哝声简直是幸福极了。

examples.text: She was baptized and she was pure and clean of sin.
examples.translation: 接受了洗礼的她纯洁无瑕。

examples.text: The American Female Reform Society promoted sexual purity.
examples.translation: “美国女性改革社团”倡导性贞洁。

examples.text: It's blackmail, pure and simple.
examples.translation: 这纯粹是敲诈。

examples.text: I take wheat and yeast tablets daily to purify the blood...
examples.translation: 我每天服用干酵母片以净化血液。

examples.text: Only purified water is used.
examples.translation: 只使用纯净水。

examples.text: ...a water purification plant.
examples.translation: 水净化工厂
