meanings.meaning: 紫色的；帝王的；华而不实的

examples.text: She wore purple and green silk.
examples.translation: 她穿着紫绿相间的绸缎衣服。

examples.text: ...sinister dark greens and purples.
examples.translation: 不祥的暗绿色和紫色

examples.text: ...passages of purple prose describing intense experiences.
examples.translation: 一篇篇描述强烈感受的词藻华丽的散文

examples.text: In the last 10 minutes Tranmere struck a purple patch which culminated in their goal.
examples.translation: 最后10分钟，特兰米尔队时来运转，终于收获了进球。

examples.text: The purpose of the occasion was to raise money for medical supplies...
examples.translation: 那次活动是为筹集资金购买医药物资。

examples.text: Various insurance schemes already exist for this purpose.
examples.translation: 已经有各种保险计划可以实现这一目的。

examples.text: ...the use of nuclear energy for military purposes...
examples.translation: 核能在军事上的运用

examples.text: He was asked about casualties, but said it would serve no purpose to count bodies...
examples.translation: 有人问他伤亡情况，但他说清点尸体是没有意义的。

examples.text: Most of them are destroyed because they've served their purpose.
examples.translation: 它们中大多数在完成使命后被销毁。

examples.text: They might well be prepared to do you harm in order to achieve their purpose...
examples.translation: 为达成自己的目的，他们说不定已经做好了伤害你的准备。

examples.text: His purpose was to make a profit by improving the company's performance.
examples.translation: 他的目标是通过提高公司的业绩来实现盈利。

examples.text: The teachers are enthusiastic and have a sense of purpose.
examples.translation: 教师们很热情并且很有决心。

examples.text: For all practical purposes the treaty has already ceased to exist...
examples.translation: 实际上协议已经不复存在。

examples.text: To all intents and purposes the case was closed.
examples.translation: 实际上该案已经了结了。

examples.text: Was it an accident or did David do it on purpose?
examples.translation: 是意外还是戴维故意所为？

meanings.meaning: (女士)手提袋；(国家、家庭、团体等的) 财力

examples.text: She looked at me and then reached in her purse for cigarettes.
examples.translation: 她看看我，接着伸手去包里拿香烟。

examples.text: The money could simply go into the public purse, helping to lower taxes.
examples.translation: 这笔钱可以直接划入公共资金，帮助降低税收。

examples.text: She pursed her lips in disapproval.
examples.translation: 她撅起嘴唇，表示不赞成。

examples.text: It became harder for women married to diplomats to pursue their own interests...
examples.translation: 与外交官结婚的女性要追求自己的爱好就变得更加困难了。

examples.text: He said Japan would continue to pursue the policies laid down at the London summit...
examples.translation: 他说日本将继续贯彻伦敦峰会所制定的政策。

examples.text: She had come to England to pursue an acting career.
examples.translation: 她来英格兰投身演艺事业。

examples.text: The implication seems to be that it is impossible to pursue economic reform and democracy simultaneously...
examples.translation: 言外之意似乎是经济改革和民主化进程是不可能同时进行的。

examples.text: Mr. Menendez has aggressively pursued new business.
examples.translation: 梅嫩德斯先生积极开拓新业务。

examples.text: If your original request is denied, don't be afraid to pursue the matter.
examples.translation: 如果你最初的请求遭到拒绝，不要害怕，要继续追问下去。

examples.text: She pursued the man who had stolen a woman's bag.
examples.translation: 她追赶那个偷了一个妇女提包的男人。

examples.text: ...a young man whose relentless pursuit of excellence is conducted with single-minded determination.
examples.translation: 一心一意、坚定不移地追求完美的年轻人

examples.text: ...individuals who impoverish their families in pursuit of some dream.
examples.translation: 为了追求某个梦想而使家庭陷于贫困的人

examples.text: The vigorous pursuit of policies is no guarantee of success.
examples.translation: 坚决贯彻方针政策并不能保证成功。

examples.text: ...a police officer who drove a patrol car at more than 120mph in pursuit of a motor cycle.
examples.translation: 以超过每小时120英里的时速驾驶巡逻车追赶一辆摩托车的警官

examples.text: Moreau took gold in the five-kilometre individual pursuit competition.
examples.translation: 莫罗在个人五公里追逐赛中获得金牌。

examples.text: They both love outdoor pursuits...
examples.translation: 他们俩都喜欢户外活动。

examples.text: His favourite childhood pursuits were sailing, swimming and cycling.
examples.translation: 儿时他最大的爱好是帆船运动、游泳和骑自行车。

examples.text: I rushed through with Sue in hot pursuit.
examples.translation: 我冲了过去，苏在后面穷追不舍。

meanings.meaning: 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服
推，决心；大规模攻势；矢志的追求

examples.text: The woman pushed back her chair and stood up...
examples.translation: 那女人把椅子往后一推站了起来。

examples.text: They pushed him into the car.
examples.translation: 他们把他推进了车里。

examples.text: ...a woman pushing a pushchair...
examples.translation: 推婴儿车的女人

examples.text: He put both hands flat on the door and pushed as hard as he could...
examples.translation: 他两只手平放在门上用尽全力推。

examples.text: When there was no reply, he pushed the door open.
examples.translation: 没有人应答，他就把门推开了。

examples.text: He gave me a sharp push...
examples.translation: 他猛地推了我一下。

examples.text: Information is called up at the push of a button.
examples.translation: 按一个键信息就会被调出来。

examples.text: I pushed through the crowds and on to the escalator...
examples.translation: 我挤出人群，踏上了自动扶梯。

examples.text: Dix pushed forward carrying a glass...
examples.translation: 迪克斯拿着杯子往前挤。

examples.text: He pushed his way towards her, laughing.
examples.translation: 他笑着朝她挤了过去。

examples.text: One detachment pushed into the eastern suburbs towards the airfield...
examples.translation: 一支小分队开进了东部郊区向飞机场挺进。

examples.text: The army may push southwards into the Kurdish areas.
examples.translation: 军队可能南下向库尔德地区挺进。

examples.text: All that was needed was one final push, and the enemy would be vanquished once and for all.
examples.translation: 只需要发动最后一次进攻，就能把敌人彻底消灭。

examples.text: Any shortage could push up grain prices...
examples.translation: 任何一种短缺都会抬高粮食价格。

examples.text: The government had done everything it could to push down inflation...
examples.translation: 政府已经采取了所有可能的措施来抑制通货膨胀。

examples.text: Interest had pushed the loan up to $27,000.
examples.translation: 利息已经使得贷款金额提高到了27,000美元。

examples.text: We are continuing to push the business forward...
examples.translation: 我们正在继续推进业务的发展。

examples.text: The government seemed intent on pushing local and central government in opposite directions.
examples.translation: 政府似乎一心想让地方政府和中央政府背道而驰。

examples.text: She thanks her parents for keeping her in school and pushing her to study...
examples.translation: 她感谢父母送她上学并督促她学习。

examples.text: James did not push her into stealing the money...
examples.translation: 詹姆斯没有怂恿她去偷钱。

examples.text: I knew he was pushing himself to the limit and felt rather anxious...
examples.translation: 我知道他正把自己逼到极限，而且感觉非常焦虑。

examples.text: There is no point in pushing them unless they are talented and they enjoy it.
examples.translation: 除非他们很有才华而且自己喜欢，否则逼迫他们是没有意义的。

examples.text: We need a push to take the first step.
examples.translation: 我们需要一点儿鼓励才能迈出第一步。

examples.text: Britain's health experts are pushing for a ban on all cigarette advertising...
examples.translation: 英国的健康专家正努力争取取缔任何形式的香烟广告。

examples.text: Germany is pushing for direct flights to be established.
examples.translation: 德国正在努力争取直飞航班的开通。

examples.text: In its push for economic growth it has ignored projects that would improve living standards...
examples.translation: 在努力实现经济增长之时，它忽略了那些能提高生活水平的项目。

examples.text: They urged negotiators to make a final push to arrive at an agreement.
examples.translation: 他们敦促谈判者为达成协议作最后的努力。

examples.text: Ministers will push the case for opening the plant...
examples.translation: 部长们将极力劝说人们接受开办工厂一事。

examples.text: She knew enough about publishing to know that they could push a hundred thousand copies into the bookshops.
examples.translation: 关于出版业她非常了解，很清楚他们能够向书店推销10万本书。

examples.text: She was sent for trial yesterday accused of pushing drugs.
examples.translation: 她因被控贩毒昨天被送交法院接受审判。

examples.text: I think that he was pushing it a bit when he said it was the best stadium in the world.
examples.translation: 他说这是世界上最好的体育场，我觉得说得有些过头。

examples.text: Two cabinet ministers also got the push.
examples.translation: 两位内阁大臣也被撤职了。

examples.text: Put is used in a large number of expressions which are explained under other words in this dictionary. For example, the expression to put someone in the picture is explained at picture.
examples.translation: put 用于许多表达方式中，这些表达方式的解释列在本词典的其他词条下。例如，to put someone in the picture 的解释在 picture 词条下。

examples.text: She hesitated, then put her hand on Grace's arm...
examples.translation: 她犹豫了一下，然后把手放到格雷斯的胳膊上。

examples.text: Mishka put down a heavy shopping bag.
examples.translation: 米什卡把一个沉重的购物袋放下。

examples.text: Rather than put him in the hospital, she had been caring for him at home...
examples.translation: 她没有让他住在医院，而是一直在家里照顾他。

examples.text: I'd put the children to bed.
examples.translation: 我会安顿孩子们上床睡觉。

examples.text: This is going to put them out of business...
examples.translation: 这将会使他们破产。

examples.text: He was putting himself at risk...
examples.translation: 他在使自己处于危险的境地。

examples.text: My doctor put me in touch with a psychiatrist...
examples.translation: 我的医生为我联系了一位精神科医生。

examples.text: The British people put us back in power.
examples.translation: 英国人使我们重掌政权。

examples.text: The ruling will put extra pressure on health authorities to change working practices and shorten hours...
examples.translation: 该判决将给卫生部门施加更多的压力促使其改变工作惯例，缩短工作时间。

examples.text: Be aware of the terrible strain it can put on a child when you expect the best reports...
examples.translation: 在期待孩子能取得最好成绩时，要当心这会给他们带来可怕的压力。

examples.text: They will also force schools to put more emphasis on teaching basic subjects.
examples.translation: 他们也会迫使学校更加注重基础科目的教学。

examples.text: He had decided long ago that he would put his trust in socialism when the time came...
examples.translation: 很久以前他就决定时机成熟时会寄希望于社会主义。

examples.text: How much faith should we put in anti-ageing products?
examples.translation: 我们对抗衰老产品应该抱有多少信心？

examples.text: We're not saying that activists should put all their effort and time into party politics...
examples.translation: 我们并不是说活动家应该把所有的精力和时间都用到政党政治上。

examples.text: Eleanor did not put much energy into the discussion.
examples.translation: 埃莉诺没有为这次讨论花费太多精力。

examples.text: Investors should consider putting some money into an annuity...
examples.translation: 投资者们应当考虑存一些年金。

examples.text: Put $10,000 into this investment and in 10 years, you'll have almost $18,000.
examples.translation: 在这项投资上投入1万美元，10年后就会得到近18,000美元。

examples.text: I had already met Pete a couple of times through — how should I put it — friends in low places...
examples.translation: 我已经见过皮特几次了，是通过——怎么说呢——一些社会下层的朋友见的。

examples.text: He doesn't, to put it very bluntly, give a damn about the woman or the baby...
examples.translation: 直白地说，他根本不在乎那个女人和那个小孩。

examples.text: If I was auditioning for a vocalist, let me put it this way, he wouldn't get to sing in my band...
examples.translation: 如果我来面试歌手的话，请允许我这样说，他不会进入我的乐团来唱歌的。

examples.text: He admitted the security forces might have made some mistakes, as he put it...
examples.translation: 他承认安全部队，按他的话说，可能犯了一些错误。

examples.text: You can't put that sort of fear into words.
examples.translation: 那种恐惧无法用语言表达。

examples.text: Is this fair? Well, I put that question today to Deputy Counsel Craig Gillen...
examples.translation: 这公平吗？我今天向副顾问克雷格·吉伦提出这个问题。

examples.text: He thinks that some workers may be afraid to put questions publicly.
examples.translation: 他认为一些工人可能害怕公开提问。

examples.text: He always put his point of view with clarity and with courage...
examples.translation: 他总是清楚而勇敢地提出自己的观点。

examples.text: He put the case to the Saudi Foreign Minister...
examples.translation: 他把这起事件向沙特外长作了说明。

examples.text: He sat there listening as we put suggestions to him.
examples.translation: 我们给他提建议的时候，他坐在那儿听着。

examples.text: I would put her age at about 50 or so...
examples.translation: 我认为她的年龄在50岁上下。

examples.text: All the more technically advanced countries put a high value on science...
examples.translation: 所有技术上较先进的国家都高度重视科学。

examples.text: It is not easy to put the guilty and innocent into clear-cut categories.
examples.translation: 有罪和无罪并不那么容易判定。

examples.text: Mary's family were so pleased that they put an announcement in the local paper to thank them...
examples.translation: 玛丽的家人很高兴，就在当地的报纸上登了一则启事来感谢他们。

examples.text: I think what I put in that book is now pretty much the agenda for this country...
examples.translation: 我认为我在书中写的正是目前该国亟待解决的问题。

examples.text: He crossed out 'Screenplay' and put 'Written by' instead.
examples.translation: 他划掉了“编剧”二字，改为“作者”。

examples.text: He considered himself a crafty man — a man would have to get up very early in the morning to put one over on Alf Tandy.
examples.translation: 他觉得自己太狡猾了——为了愚弄一下阿尔夫·坦迪通常得早上很早起床。

examples.text: But I put it to you that they're useless...
examples.translation: 但是我告诉你它们是没用的。

examples.text: I put this to Kenyon. 'Absolutely untrue,' he said.
examples.translation: 我向凯尼恩指出了这一点。他说：“绝对不是真的。”

examples.text: London has more pubs and clubs than the rest of the country put together.
examples.translation: 伦敦的酒馆和俱乐部比英国其他地区所有的加在一起还要多。

examples.text: Put it there, Pal, put it there!
examples.translation: 握个手，老弟，祝贺你！

meanings.meaning: 使…困惑；使…为难；苦思而得出

examples.text: My sister puzzles me and causes me anxiety.
examples.translation: 我妹妹总让我捉摸不透，弄得我焦虑不安。

examples.text: His letter poses a number of puzzling questions.
examples.translation: 他的信中提出了许多令人困惑的问题。

examples.text: In rehearsing Shakespeare, I puzzle over the complexities of his verse and prose.
examples.translation: 在排演莎士比亚的戏剧时，其中诗句和散文的复杂让我大伤脑筋。

examples.text: ...a word puzzle.
examples.translation: 字谜

examples.text: Data from Voyager II has presented astronomers with a puzzle about why our outermost planet exists...
examples.translation: “旅行者二号”发回的数据给天文学家们提出了一个难题：离我们最远的那颗行星为什么会存在。

examples.text: She was a puzzle.
examples.translation: 她是个谜。

meanings.meaning: 使…渐增；使…上涨；使…成金字塔状

examples.text: We set off to see the Pyramids and Sphinx.
examples.translation: 我们出发去看金字塔和狮身人面像。

examples.text: On a plate in front of him was piled a pyramid of flat white biscuits.
examples.translation: 在他面前的盘子上有一摞摆成金字塔形状的白色薄饼。

examples.text: Traditionally, the Brahmins, or the priestly class, are set at the top of the social pyramid.
examples.translation: 传统上，婆罗门，或称僧侣阶级，处于社会金字塔的顶端。

meanings.meaning: 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格

examples.text: They will be encouraged to mix academic A-levels with vocational qualifications...
examples.translation: 将鼓励他们在取得优秀学习成绩的同时也要获得一定的职业资质。

examples.text: Lucy wants to study medicine but needs more qualifications.
examples.translation: 露西希望学医，但是需要通过更多的资格考试。

examples.text: Following qualification, he worked as a social worker.
examples.translation: 通过资格考试认证之后，他做了一名社会工作者。

examples.text: Responsibility and reliability are necessary qualifications...
examples.translation: 有责任感、值得信赖是必备的素质。

examples.text: That time with him is my qualification to write this book.
examples.translation: 我和他曾经相处过一段时间，所以才能写出这本书。

examples.text: The empirical evidence considered here is subject to many qualifications...
examples.translation: 此处提及的实验证据有诸多限制条件。

examples.text: This statement requires qualification and clarification.
examples.translation: 这份陈述需要进行限定和澄清。

examples.text: The government conceded to their demands almost without qualification.
examples.translation: 政府几乎是无条件地同意了他们的要求。

meanings.meaning: 限制；使具有资格；证明…合格

examples.text: But when I'd qualified and started teaching it was a different story...
examples.translation: 可是等我获得资格开始教书的时候，却是另一番情形了。

examples.text: I qualified as a doctor from London University over 30 years ago.
examples.translation: 30多年前，我从伦敦大学毕业，取得了行医资格。

examples.text: To qualify for maternity leave you must have worked for the same employer for two years...
examples.translation: 你必须为同一个雇主工作满两年才能享受产假。

examples.text: The basic course does not qualify you to practise as a therapist.
examples.translation: 这门基础课程并不能让你获得治疗师的从业资格。

examples.text: ...skills that qualify foreigners for work visas.
examples.translation: 使外国人有资格获得工作签证的技能

examples.text: ...highly trained staff who are well qualified to give unbiased, practical advice.
examples.translation: 受过良好训练、能够提供客观而切实的建议的工作人员

examples.text: 13 percent of American households qualify as poor, says Mr. Mishel...
examples.translation: 米歇尔先生说，13%的美国家庭符合贫困家庭的标准。

examples.text: These people seem to think that reading a few books on old age qualifies them as experts.
examples.translation: 这些人似乎以为自己读了几本关于老年人的书就可以算作专家了。

examples.text: Nottingham Forest qualified for the final by beating Tranmere on Tuesday...
examples.translation: 诺丁汉森林队于星期二打败了特兰米尔队，取得了决赛资格。

examples.text: Cameroon have also qualified after beating Sierra Leone.
examples.translation: 喀麦隆队击败塞拉利昂队之后也成功晋级。

examples.text: ...a World Cup qualifying match.
examples.translation: 世界杯预选赛

examples.text: Kenya's Robert Kibe was the fastest qualifier for the 800 metres final.
examples.translation: 肯尼亚的罗伯特·基布是800米决赛入围者中速度最快的选手。

examples.text: I would qualify that by putting it into context.
examples.translation: 我会将它放入上下文中进行具体解释。

examples.text: There are qualitative differences in the way children and adults think...
examples.translation: 孩子和成年人的思维方式有质的不同。

examples.text: That's the whole difference between quantitative and qualitative research.
examples.translation: 那就是定量研究和定性研究之间的重大差别。

examples.text: The new media are unlikely to prove qualitatively different from the old...
examples.translation: 新媒体不可能与旧媒体有质的差别。

meanings.meaning: 质量，[统计] 品质；特性；才能

examples.text: Everyone can greatly improve the quality of life...
examples.translation: 每个人都可以大大改善生活质量。

examples.text: Other services vary dramatically in quality.
examples.translation: 其他服务在质量上差别很大。

examples.text: ...high quality paper and plywood.
examples.translation: 优质的纸张和胶合板

examples.text: ...a college of quality...
examples.translation: 优秀的学院

examples.text: In our work, quality is paramount.
examples.translation: 我们的工作追求品质至上。

examples.text: We have been successful because we are offering a quality service.
examples.translation: 我们之所以成功，是因为我们提供了优质的服务。

examples.text: Sometimes you wonder where your kids get their good qualities...
examples.translation: 有时你会想，孩子们身上的优秀品质是从何而来呢？

examples.text: He wanted to introduce mature people with leadership qualities...
examples.translation: 他想引进具有领导素质的成熟人才。

examples.text: A job analysis should also include what skills and personal qualities are required.
examples.translation: 工作岗位分析也应当包括必备技能与个人素质。

examples.text: ...a childlike quality.
examples.translation: 孩子般的天真特质

examples.text: ...the pretentious quality of the poetry...
examples.translation: 这首诗浮夸造作的特点

examples.text: Thyme tea can be used by adults for its antiseptic qualities.
examples.translation: 百里香茶的杀菌功效可用于成人。

examples.text: Even the quality papers agreed that it was a triumph.
examples.translation: 即使是内容严肃的报纸也认为这是一次胜利。

examples.text: It is difficult to quantify an exact figure as firms are reluctant to declare their losses.
examples.translation: 由于各家公司都不愿意公布所受的损失，所以很难得出一个精确的数字。

examples.text: Others are more susceptible to attempts at quantification.
examples.translation: 其他人更容易倾向于加以量化的做法。

examples.text: ...the advantages of quantitative and qualitative research.
examples.translation: 定量研究与定性研究的优势

examples.text: ...the quantitative analysis of migration.
examples.translation: 对迁徙的定量研究

examples.text: We cannot predict quantitatively the value or the cost of a new technology.
examples.translation: 我们无法对一项新技术的价值或成本进行量化预测。

examples.text: ...a small quantity of water.
examples.translation: 少量的水

examples.text: ...vast quantities of food...
examples.translation: 大量食品

examples.text: The bowl needs to be re-frozen after each use, so it takes a long time to make a large quantity...
examples.translation: 这种碗每次使用之后都需要重新冷冻，因此要做大份食物时需要很长时间。

examples.text: Cheap goods are available, but not in sufficient quantities to satisfy demand...
examples.translation: 有一些廉价的商品，但是数量不足以满足需求。

examples.text: Uranium is available in considerable quantity from various areas of the world.
examples.translation: 可世界上许多地区都有相当数量的铀储量。

examples.text: After some initial problems, acetone was successfully produced in quantity...
examples.translation: 解决了最初的一些问题之后，终于成功地制造出了大量丙酮。

examples.text: But even with those databases, the sheer quantity of data can still cause problems.
examples.translation: 可是即便有了那些数据库，数据的数量之大仍然会带来问题。

examples.text: ...the less discerning drinker who prefers quantity to quality...
examples.translation: 不求质、但求量的不那么识货的饮酒者

examples.text: In terms of quantity, production grew faster than ever before.
examples.translation: 从数量上看，产量增长的速度比以往任何时期都要快。

examples.text: He is an unknown quantity for his rivals.
examples.translation: 对于对手们而言，他是个未知数。

meanings.meaning: 吵架；反目；怨言；争吵的原因；方头凿

examples.text: I had a terrible quarrel with my other brothers...
examples.translation: 我跟其他几个兄弟大吵了一架。

examples.text: It could have happened during a quarrel between them over Naomi.
examples.translation: 这件事可能是在他们为娜奥米争吵的过程中发生的。

examples.text: ...New Zealand's quarrel with France over the Rainbow Warrior incident...
examples.translation: 新西兰和法国关于“彩虹勇士号”事件的争端

examples.text: The quarrel between the Serbs and the Croats is old and bitter.
examples.translation: 塞尔维亚人和克罗地亚人之间的争斗由来已久，而且非常激烈。

examples.text: At one point we quarrelled, over something silly...
examples.translation: 我们一度为一件愚蠢的小事吵了起来。

examples.text: My brother quarrelled with my father.
examples.translation: 我哥哥和父亲吵了一架。

examples.text: We have no quarrel with the people of Spain or of any other country...
examples.translation: 我们和西班牙以及其他国家的人民并无分歧。

examples.text: She had no quarrel with much of what had been said at dinner.
examples.translation: 晚饭上所说的话她大部分都没有意见。

examples.text: I would quarrel with you on that figure...
examples.translation: 在那个数字的问题上，我并不认同你的看法。

examples.text: While some of his peers might quarrel with the title, his credentials remain impressive.
examples.translation: 尽管他的一些同龄人也许并不认同这个称号，他的资历仍然令人钦佩不已。

meanings.meaning: 夸脱（容量单位）；一夸脱的容器

examples.text: Pick up a quart of milk or a loaf of bread.
examples.translation: 拿1夸脱牛奶或一条面包。

meanings.meaning: 四分之一；地区；季度；一刻钟；两角五分；节

examples.text: A quarter of the residents are over 55 years old...
examples.translation: 1/4的居民年龄在55岁以上。

examples.text: I've got to go in a quarter of an hour...
examples.translation: 一刻钟以后我就得走了。

examples.text: Prices have fallen by a quarter since January...
examples.translation: 1月份以来，价格已经下跌了25%。

examples.text: Cut the peppers into quarters.
examples.translation: 将辣椒切为4瓣。

examples.text: The largest asteroid is Ceres, which is about a quarter the size of the moon.
examples.translation: 最大的小行星是谷神星，体积约为月球的1/4。

examples.text: ...the past quarter century...
examples.translation: 过去的25年

examples.text: He closed his door and started the quarter-mile walk down the hill.
examples.translation: 他关上门，踏上了1/4英里长的下山路。

examples.text: The group said results for the third quarter are due on October 29.
examples.translation: 该集团表示第三季度的结果将于10月29日公布。

examples.text: It was a quarter to six...
examples.translation: 当时是6点差一刻。

examples.text: See you about quarter to nine...
examples.translation: 8点45分左右再见。

examples.text: I got a call at quarter of seven one night...
examples.translation: 一天晚上6点45分时，我接到了一个电话。

examples.text: Nobody else turned up till a quarter past ten...
examples.translation: 直到10点一刻，其他人才露面。

examples.text: The time was recorded at a quarter after five.
examples.translation: 时间显示是5点15分。

examples.text: Chop the mushrooms and quarter the tomatoes.
examples.translation: 把蘑菇切成丁，再把西红柿切成四瓣。

examples.text: The doses I suggested for adults could be halved or quartered.
examples.translation: 我之前建议成人服用的剂量可以降到1/2或者1/4。

examples.text: I dropped a quarter into the slot of the pay phone.
examples.translation: 我向付费电话的投币孔里投了一枚25分硬币。

examples.text: Look for hotels in the French Quarter.
examples.translation: 在法国人居住区寻找旅馆。

examples.text: Help came from an unexpected quarter...
examples.translation: 援助来自于一个意想不到的团体。

examples.text: There are fears in some quarters that the republic would have little chance of surviving on its own.
examples.translation: 某些人士担心共和国独立支撑下去的希望很渺茫。

examples.text: Mckinnon went down from deck to the officers' quarters.
examples.translation: 麦金农走下甲板，来到军官们的住处。

examples.text: Our soldiers are quartered in Peredelkino.
examples.translation: 我们的士兵在佩列杰利基诺扎营。

examples.text: You can watch aircraft take off or land at close quarters...
examples.translation: 你可以近距离观察飞机的起降。

examples.text: This is not war as you learned it. It is brutal work, with no quarter given.
examples.translation: 这并不是你所了解的战争。它残酷无情，对人没有半点怜悯。

meanings.meaning: 季度的，按季度的；一年四次的
按季度，[农] 一季一次地；纵横四分地

examples.text: ...the latest Bank of Japan quarterly survey of 5,000 companies.
examples.translation: 日本银行对5,000家公司的最新季度调查

examples.text: It makes no difference whether dividends are paid quarterly or annually.
examples.translation: 红利按季发放还是按年发放没有什么差别。

examples.text: The quarterly had been a forum for sound academic debate.
examples.translation: 这本季刊曾经是进行颇有见地的学术讨论的论坛。

examples.text: ...'Foreign Policy', a quarterly journal published in Paris.
examples.translation: 《外交政策》——一本在巴黎出版的季刊

examples.text: ...a quartz crystal.
examples.translation: 石英晶体

meanings.meaning: 女王，王后；（纸牌中的）皇后；（蜜蜂等的）蜂王

examples.text: ...Queen Victoria...
examples.translation: 维多利亚女王

examples.text: She met the Queen last week.
examples.translation: 上周她受到了女王的接见。

examples.text: The king and queen had fled.
examples.translation: 国王和王后都逃之夭夭了。

examples.text: ...the queen of crime writing.
examples.translation: 犯罪小说女王

examples.text: ...the queen of spades.
examples.translation: 黑桃王后

meanings.meaning: 奇怪的；同性恋的；不舒服的；心智不平衡的
同性恋者；怪人；伪造的货币

examples.text: If you ask me, there's something a bit queer going on.
examples.translation: 要是你问我的话，我觉得有点儿不太对劲。

examples.text: ...queer men.
examples.translation: 同性恋男子

examples.text: ...contemporary queer culture.
examples.translation: 当代同性恋文化

examples.text: ...queer activism.
examples.translation: 同性恋激进主义

meanings.meaning: 熄灭，[机] 淬火；解渴；结束；冷浸

examples.text: He stopped to quench his thirst at a stream.
examples.translation: 他停了下来，在小溪边饮水止渴。

examples.text: My quest for a better bank continues.
examples.translation: 我继续寻找一家更好的银行。

examples.text: ...his quest to find true love...
examples.translation: 他对真爱的不懈追寻

examples.text: Waite spent his life on a spiritual quest.
examples.translation: 韦特毕生都在进行精神探索。

examples.text: He went on to say that he was going to New York in quest of peace...
examples.translation: 他接着说自己准备到纽约去寻求安宁。

examples.text: The Puritans became fugitives in quest of liberty.
examples.translation: 清教徒变成了追求自由的逃亡者。

examples.text: They asked a great many questions about England...
examples.translation: 他们问了一大堆有关英格兰的问题。

examples.text: The President refused to answer further questions on the subject...
examples.translation: 总统拒绝就这个话题再回答问题。

examples.text: Right, next question...
examples.translation: 好，下一个问题。

examples.text: 'Do you feel that the British gamble more than they should?'—'Well, that's a very difficult question to answer.'
examples.translation: “你是否认为英国人过于沉溺于赌博？”——“嗯，这个问题很难回答。”

examples.text: This led the therapist to question Jim about his parents and their marriage...
examples.translation: 这让治疗专家问起了吉姆有关他父母及他们婚姻的情况。

examples.text: A man is being questioned by police in connection with an attack on a disabled woman.
examples.translation: 警方正在询问一名涉嫌袭击一位残疾女性的男子。

examples.text: The police have detained thirty-two people for questioning.
examples.translation: 警已经扣押了32人进行盘问。

examples.text: It never occurs to them to question the doctor's decisions...
examples.translation: 他们从未想过要怀疑医生的决定。

examples.text: Weber is challenging his audience to question their own beliefs.
examples.translation: 韦伯正要求观众们反思质疑各自的信仰。

examples.text: There's no question about their success...
examples.translation: 他们一定会成功。

examples.text: There's some question as to whether he will sign this resolution...
examples.translation: 他是否会签署这项决议还不能确定。

examples.text: As a footballer, Le Saux's ability was beyond question...
examples.translation: 作为一名足球运动员，勒索克斯的能力不容置疑。

examples.text: The paper says the President's move has called into question the whole basis of democracy in the country...
examples.translation: 报纸上说，总统的做法让人们对国家民主制度的整个基础提出了质疑。

examples.text: Why Marlowe was killed may be open to question, but where he is buried is not...
examples.translation: 也许马洛的死因还不能确定，但是他的埋葬地点没有任何疑问。

examples.text: With the loyalty of key military units in question, that could prove an extraordinarily difficult task.
examples.translation: 由于无法确定关键军事部队忠诚与否，这项任务也许会变得异常困难。

examples.text: But the whole question of aid is a tricky political one...
examples.translation: 但是整个援助问题是个非常复杂的政治问题。

examples.text: That decision raised questions about the secretary of state's powers and the fairness of his procedure.
examples.translation: 那个决定引起人们对国务卿的权力及其做法的公平性的质疑。

examples.text: The question is: Is this what we really want?
examples.translation: 问题在于：这是我们真正想要的吗？

examples.text: ...if the security question is not resolved...
examples.translation: 如果安全问题没有解决的话

examples.text: It was just a question of having the time to readjust.
examples.translation: 这只是个需要时间重新适应的问题。

examples.text: He'd heard somewhere that the questions in economics examination papers stayed the same from year to year...
examples.translation: 他从某处听说经济学考试的考题年年都一样。

examples.text: That question did come up in the examination.
examples.translation: 那道题确实在考试中出现了。

examples.text: 'Why didn't you appoint Ron twelve months ago?'—'Good question.'
examples.translation: “你为什么12个月前不任命罗恩呢？”——“问得好。”

examples.text: The player in question is Mark Williams...
examples.translation: 我们所说的那个选手是马克·威廉斯。

examples.text: Add up all the income you've received over the period in question.
examples.translation: 把那个时期里你拿到的所有收入加在一起。

examples.text: For the homeless, private medical care is simply out of the question...
examples.translation: 对于无家可归的人而言，私人医疗纯粹是天方夜谭。

examples.text: Is a tax increase still out of the question?
examples.translation: 增加税收仍然是不可能的事吗？

examples.text: Stuart got serious quickly and popped the question six months later.
examples.translation: 斯图尔特很快认真起来，6个月之后便求婚了。

examples.text: As far as he was concerned there was no question of betraying his own comrades...
examples.translation: 就他而言，背叛自己的同志是不可能的。

examples.text: There is no question of the taxpayer picking up the bill for the party.
examples.translation: 要纳税人为该党买单是不可能的。

examples.text: ...military formations, carrying out without question the battle orders of superior officers.
examples.translation: 毫无异议地执行上级军官的战斗命令的部队编队

examples.text: He was our greatest storyteller, without question.
examples.translation: 毫无疑问，他是我们最会讲故事的人。

examples.text: Headteachers will be asked to fill in a questionnaire.
examples.translation: 校长们将被要求完成一份问卷调查。

examples.text: I watched as he got a tray and joined the queue...
examples.translation: 我看着他拿了个托盘排起了队。

examples.text: She waited in the bus queue...
examples.translation: 她排队等公共汽车。

examples.text: There was still a queue for tickets on the night...
examples.translation: 晚上仍然有人在排队买票。

examples.text: Behind him was a long queue of angry motorists.
examples.translation: 在他的身后，愤怒的司机排成了长龙。

examples.text: Manchester United would be at the front of a queue of potential buyers...
examples.translation: 在众多潜在的买家中，曼彻斯特联队将排在最前列。

examples.text: Single parents got priority in the housing queue...
examples.translation: 单亲父母在申请住房时享有优先权。

examples.text: The queue for places at the school has never been longer.
examples.translation: 排队申请上这所学校的人数达到历史最高峰。

examples.text: I had to queue for quite a while.
examples.translation: 我不得不排一会儿队。

examples.text: ...a line of women queueing for bread.
examples.translation: 一列排队买面包的女人

examples.text: A mob of journalists are queuing up at the gate to photograph him...
examples.translation: 一群新闻记者在门口排起长队，等着给他拍照。

examples.text: We all had to queue up for our ration books.
examples.translation: 我们都得排队领取定量配给票证薄。

examples.text: Your print job has been sent to the network print queue.
examples.translation: 你的打印任务已经发送到了网络打印列表中。

meanings.meaning: 快的；迅速的，敏捷的；灵敏的

examples.text: You'll have to be quick. The flight leaves in about three hours...
examples.translation: 你得快点了，飞机大约3小时后起飞。

examples.text: I think I'm a reasonably quick learner...
examples.translation: 我认为我是一个学东西还算快的人。

examples.text: Europe has moved a long way since then at a very quick pace.
examples.translation: 从那以后，欧洲迅速发展，并取得了长足的进步。

examples.text: Cussane worked quickly and methodically...
examples.translation: 库塞因干活很利索，且有条不紊。

examples.text: Stop me if I'm speaking too quickly.
examples.translation: 要是我讲得太快，请打断我。

examples.text: ...the natural quickness of his mind.
examples.translation: 他天生的敏捷反应

examples.text: Warm the sugar slightly first to make it dissolve quicker...
examples.translation: 先将糖稍稍加热，以使其溶解得更快些。

examples.text: Prost went quickest.
examples.translation: 普罗斯特走得最快。

examples.text: He took one last quick look about the room...
examples.translation: 他朝房间匆匆扫了最后一眼。

examples.text: I just popped in for a quick drink...
examples.translation: 我只是顺路过来小酌一杯。

examples.text: Although this recipe looks long, it is actually very quick to prepare...
examples.translation: 尽管这个菜谱看上去很长，其实做起来很快。

examples.text: My father would have driven me to Cornwall, but we decided it would be quicker by train.
examples.translation: 父亲原本要开车送我去康沃尔，但我们还是觉得坐火车更快。

examples.text: You can become fitter quite quickly and easily.
examples.translation: 你可以非常迅速而且轻松地变得更健康。

examples.text: Officials played down any hope for a quick end to the bloodshed...
examples.translation: 官员们让迅速结束这场流血冲突的希望变得渺茫起来。

examples.text: These investors feel the need to make quick profits.
examples.translation: 这些投资者觉得收益必须立竿见影。

examples.text: We need to get it back as quickly as possible...
examples.translation: 我们得尽快把它拿回来。

examples.text: It quickly became the most popular men's fragrance in the world...
examples.translation: 它很快成为世界上最受欢迎的男士香水。

examples.text: 'Not me,' Robarts said quickly.
examples.translation: “不是我，”罗巴茨立即说道。

examples.text: I got away as quick as I could...
examples.translation: 我尽快离开了。

examples.text: Quick! John! It's Carmela. I think she's taken an overdose...
examples.translation: 快来！约翰！卡梅拉出事了，我想她用药过量了。

examples.text: The advantage in going faster is that you get there quicker.
examples.translation: 快点走的好处在于，你可以早点到达那里。

examples.text: Mark says the ideas are Katie's own, and is quick to praise her talent...
examples.translation: 马克说这些都是凯蒂自己的想法，并随即称赞起她的天赋来。

examples.text: Furthermore, as Gervaise was quick to point out, Mr Scully was not a detective.
examples.translation: 而且，正如热尔韦斯毫不犹豫地指出来的那样，斯库利先生并不是一名侦探。

examples.text: Her fingernails are bitten to the quick.
examples.translation: 她的手指甲都被咬秃了。

examples.text: I once heard her weeping in her bedroom, which cut me to the quick.
examples.translation: 有一次，我听见她在卧室里哭泣，这深深地刺痛了我的心。

meanings.meaning: 安静的；安定的；不动的；温顺的

examples.text: Tania kept the children reasonably quiet and contented...
examples.translation: 塔妮娅把孩子们哄得安安静静而又心满意足。

examples.text: A quiet murmur passed through the classroom...
examples.translation: 一阵悄悄的低语声传遍了整个教室。

examples.text: The airlines have invested enormous sums in new, quieter aircraft.
examples.translation: 航空公司投入了大笔资金购买噪音较小的新型飞机。

examples.text: 'This is goodbye, isn't it?' she said quietly...
examples.translation: “这就算是告别了，是吗？”她轻轻地说。

examples.text: He closed the door quietly.
examples.translation: 他悄悄地关上了门。

examples.text: ...the smoothness and quietness of the flight.
examples.translation: 飞行时的平稳和安静

examples.text: She was received in a small, quiet office...
examples.translation: 她在一个安静的小办公室里受到接待。

examples.text: The street was unnaturally quiet.
examples.translation: 街上安静得有些异常。

examples.text: I miss the quietness of the countryside.
examples.translation: 我非常怀念乡间的宁静。

examples.text: ...a quiet rural backwater...
examples.translation: 平静而与世隔绝的农村地区

examples.text: It is very quiet without him...
examples.translation: 他不在的时候这里非常清静。

examples.text: While he wanted Los Angeles and partying, she wanted a quiet life...
examples.translation: 他喜欢洛杉矶，喜欢聚会，她却希望过平静的生活。

examples.text: The city is now relatively quiet but there's palpable anger as people cope with shortages...
examples.translation: 现在这座城市比较安静，但却因物资匮乏而明显充斥着怒气。

examples.text: His most prized time, though, will be spent quietly on his farm.
examples.translation: 不过，他最宝贵的时光将在自己的农场里平静地度过。

examples.text: I do very much appreciate the quietness and privacy here.
examples.translation: 我的确非常喜欢这里宁静幽雅、不受打扰的氛围。

examples.text: He called for quiet and announced that the next song was in our honor...
examples.translation: 他叫大家安静，然后宣布下一首歌要送给我们。

examples.text: Jeremy wants some peace and quiet before his big match.
examples.translation: 杰里米希望在大赛来临之前能享受到些许平静和安宁。

examples.text: I told them to be quiet and go to sleep...
examples.translation: 我叫他们不要说话，马上睡觉。

examples.text: I just went quiet, embarrassed, and couldn't answer...
examples.translation: 我一下子收了声，红了脸，答不出话来。

examples.text: They were both quiet for a while. Then Charlie said: 'I must go.'...
examples.translation: 他们俩都沉默了一会儿。然后查利说：“我得走了”。

examples.text: Then a voice called out, 'Quiet, everybody, please!'
examples.translation: 这时有人大声喊道：“安静，请各位安静！”

examples.text: Amy stood quietly in the doorway watching him.
examples.translation: 埃米一言不发地站在门口看着他。

examples.text: He has a quiet confidence in his ability...
examples.translation: 他对自己胸有成竹，但却并不张扬。

examples.text: All through his life he has shown a quiet determination to get things done.
examples.translation: 他一生都在默默而坚定地做事。

examples.text: Nigel Deering, the publisher, is quietly confident about the magazine's chances.
examples.translation: 出版商奈杰尔·迪林心中对这份杂志的成功很有把握。

examples.text: The Swedes had sought his freedom through quiet diplomacy...
examples.translation: 瑞典人通过秘密的外交手段来争取他的自由。

examples.text: Then it was back to the house for a quiet celebration...
examples.translation: 然后就回到房子里悄悄地庆祝一番。

examples.text: Can I have a quiet word with you, son?
examples.translation: 孩子，我能和你私下谈一谈吗？

examples.text: I slipped away quietly...
examples.translation: 我不声不响地溜走了。

examples.text: The goal of shifting freight from road to rail has been quietly abandoned...
examples.translation: 已经悄悄放弃了将货物从公路改走铁路运输的目标。

examples.text: Lee's body was flown to the US, where he was quietly buried in Seattle.
examples.translation: 李的遗体被空运至美国，并在西雅图悄悄地下葬了。

examples.text: He's a nice quiet man.
examples.translation: 他是一个温和友善的人。

examples.text: They dress in quiet colors so as not to call attention to themselves.
examples.translation: 为了避免别人注目，他们穿得很朴素。

examples.text: The wind dropped and the sea quieted...
examples.translation: 风势减弱了，海面平静下来。

examples.text: Estela started to say something but a gesture from her husband quieted her at once.
examples.translation: 埃丝特拉正要说些什么，但是看到丈夫的一个手势，马上就不说话了。

examples.text: Music seemed to quiet her anxiety and loneliness.
examples.translation: 音乐似乎能够减轻她的焦虑和孤独。

examples.text: She's not going to go quietly.
examples.translation: 她不会乖乖离开的。

examples.text: I told her to keep quiet about it...
examples.translation: 我告诉她此事要保密。

examples.text: I think I found it easier than Nell to keep our engagement quiet.
examples.translation: 我觉得，我比内尔更容易守得住我们订婚的秘密。

examples.text: She'd promised to give him driving lessons, on the quiet, when no one could see.
examples.translation: 她已经保证要在别人看不见的时候私下教他开车。

meanings.meaning: 东拼西凑地编；加软衬料后缝制

examples.text: ...an old patchwork quilt.
examples.translation: 一床旧的百衲被

examples.text: He quit his job as an office boy in Athens...
examples.translation: 他辞去了在雅典当办公室勤杂工的工作。

examples.text: He figured he would quit before Johnson fired him.
examples.translation: 他估计自己会在约翰逊炒他鱿鱼之前先辞职。

examples.text: A nicotine spray can help smokers quit the habit without putting on weight...
examples.translation: 尼古丁喷雾剂能够帮助吸烟者在不增加体重的同时戒烟。

examples.text: I was trying to quit smoking at the time.
examples.translation: 当时我正在努力戒烟。

examples.text: ...the idea that humans might one day quit the earth to colonise other planets...
examples.translation: 人类有朝一日可能会离开地球到其他星球定居繁衍的想法

examples.text: Police were called when he refused to quit the building.
examples.translation: 他拒绝离开那座大楼，于是人们叫来了警察。

examples.text: They raised $630,000 through listener donations, and then called it quits...
examples.translation: 他们通过听众捐款的方式筹集了63万美元后宣告结束。

examples.text: You can decide whether there is hope in working for mutual happiness, or if you should call it quits.
examples.translation: 你可以决定是否有希望为双方共同的幸福努力，或者就此一刀两断。

examples.text: I felt quite bitter about it at the time...
examples.translation: 当时我对这件事感到相当怨愤。

examples.text: I was doing quite well, but I wasn't earning a lot of money...
examples.translation: 我干得还算不错，可是挣的钱却不算多。

examples.text: Well, actually it requires quite a bit of work and research...
examples.translation: 嗯，实际上这需要花不少的工夫，做点研究。

examples.text: I was quite a long way away, on the terrace...
examples.translation: 我在露台上，离得还挺远。

examples.text: I quite enjoy living here.
examples.translation: 我挺喜欢住在这里。

examples.text: It is quite clear that we were firing in self defence...
examples.translation: 事实很清楚，我们开枪是出于自卫。

examples.text: That's a general British failing. In the USA it's quite different...
examples.translation: 那是英国人的普遍缺点。在美国，情况就大不一样了。

examples.text: I can state quite definitely it will be terrible...
examples.translation: 我可以非常明确地说，情况会十分糟糕。

examples.text: This was a serious breach of trust quite apart from the gravity of any offence...
examples.translation: 这不光是情节重大的犯罪行为，还是一种严重的背信行为。

examples.text: I quite agree with you. That's a good way of looking at it.
examples.translation: 我很赞同你的观点，这是看待该问题的一个很好的角度。

examples.text: Something here is not quite right...
examples.translation: 这里有什么地方不太对劲。

examples.text: After treatment he was able to continue but he was never quite the same...
examples.translation: 治疗之后他又可以继续下去了，可是再也恢复不到从前的状态了。

examples.text: We still can't quite believe he's here with us after all this time...
examples.translation: 我们还是不太敢相信，过了这么久，他居然还和我们一起呆在这里。

examples.text: And at the beginning, I didn't quite understand what all this was about...
examples.translation: 我起初不太明白这一切究竟是怎么回事。

examples.text: That wasn't quite what I meant.
examples.translation: 我其实不是这个意思。

examples.text: 'Oh, he's quite a character,' Sean replied...
examples.translation: “喔，他真是个了不起的人，”肖恩回答说。

examples.text: It's quite a city, Boston.
examples.translation: 波士顿，真是一座伟大的城市。

examples.text: 'And if you buy the record it's your choice isn't it.' — 'Quite'...
examples.translation: “如果你买这张唱片，那是你的选择，不是吗？”——“可不是嘛。”

examples.text: 'I won't say over the air who it is.' — 'No, quite.'
examples.translation: “我不会在电话里说出那个人是谁。”——“对，的确应该这样。”

examples.text: Her bottom lip quivered and big tears rolled down her cheeks.
examples.translation: 她的下唇颤抖着，豆大的泪珠顺着面颊滚落下来。

examples.text: Cooper arrived, quivering with rage...

examples.translation: 西比尔询问了她当女工的生活。

examples.translation: 该法案将迫使雇主在招聘工人时采取限额制度。

examples.translation: 毫无疑问，他们身上也有人所共有的弱点。

examples.translation: 他引用波利先生的话，说和谈已在进行之中。

examples.translation: 她引用了罗曼·加里的一本书中的名句。

examples.translation: 昨天比利时《晚报》援引了一名自称目击了谋杀经过的教授的话。

examples.translation: 我把信交给了我们当地的媒体，他们引用了其中的一部分内容。

examples.translation: 米彻先生援引统计数据来说明最贫困人口的生活水平下降了。

examples.translation: 一位旅行社职员给她开出的从布里斯托尔至帕尔马的机票报价是160英镑。

examples.translation: 在香港昨天早些时候的交易中，黄金的牌价为每盎司368.20美元。

examples.translation: 赫伦公司是一家私营公司，没有在股票交易市场挂牌。

examples.translation: remembered 一词用引号括了起来。

examples.translation: 对少数民族和少数人种的保护

examples.translation: 我们俩都是异族通婚所生的子女。

examples.translation: 没有迹象表明杀戮是由种族原因引起的。

examples.translation: 我的背包太大了，行李架上放不下。

examples.text: You have to fight to reach the racks of clothes but the bargains are amazing.
examples.translation: 你得费力往前挤才能够到那一架架的衣服，但那些打折品的确超值。

examples.translation: 他已经很虚弱的身体受着高烧的折磨。

examples.translation: 这个国家目前正被3场激烈的分离主义运动所困扰。

examples.translation: 被愧疚和不安所折磨的少年

examples.translation: 她开始绞尽脑汁地回忆在疗养院发生的事。

examples.translation: 就在一年前，他还被13岁时开始染上的海洛因毒瘾所折磨。

examples.translation: 她从昨晚就一直穿着的同一件成品裙装

examples.translation: 至于衣服，我们到好莱坞大道上的一家商店里，都是直接挑现成的买。

examples.translation: 他如此大声喧闹，我怕他打扰了邻居。

examples.translation: 我的睡梦被隔壁极为恼人的吵闹声给搅了。

examples.translation: 钻孔机和电锯的噪声过了半夜还继续响着。

examples.translation: 走私活动每年都会导致数千只珍奇鸟类死亡。

examples.translation: 起了疑心的爱好者揭发了这一勾当，警察在诺丁汉逮捕了一名男子。

examples.translation: 提供网球拍及网球。

examples.translation: 飞机是在从米兰出发的飞行途中从雷达屏上消失的。

examples.translation: 举办这次竞赛是为了迅速招募成员。

examples.translation: 学院欢迎所有的学生，无论其种族、宗教信仰和国籍是什么。

examples.translation: 雇主以种族或国籍为由歧视员工是非法的。

examples.translation: 美国的经济飞速增长。

examples.translation: 他仍然尽可能经常地参加赛车比赛。

examples.translation: 婚礼那天，新娘看上去真是光彩照人。

examples.translation: BBC第4电台

examples.translation: 火灾肆虐超过4个小时，期间列车停止了运行。

examples.translation: 战乱肆虐，是时候表明立场了。

examples.translation: 弗兰妮正在屋里大发脾气。

examples.text: The police, raining blows on rioters and spectators alike, cleared the park...
examples.translation: 警察不分闹事者与观众统统一顿猛击，把人们清除出了足球场。

examples.text: Rockets, mortars and artillery rounds rained on buildings.
examples.translation: 火箭炮、迫击炮和各种炮弹如雨点般落在大楼上。

examples.text: Fighter aircraft rained down high explosives...
examples.translation: 战斗机投下大量烈性炸药。

examples.text: Grenades and mortars rained down on Dubrovnik.
examples.translation: 手榴弹和迫击炮弹如雨点般落在杜布罗夫尼克。

examples.text: A rain of stones descended on the police.
examples.translation: 一阵乱石砸向警察。

examples.text: You'll be as right as rain as soon as you are back in your own home with your baby.
examples.translation: 你一回家同孩子在一起就会完全没事了。

examples.text: Frances took her daughter walking every day, rain or shine.
examples.translation: 弗朗西丝无论晴天还是下雨，每天都带女儿去散步。

meanings.meaning: 彩虹；五彩缤纷的排列；幻想
使呈彩虹状；如彩虹般装饰

examples.text: Oh look, a rainbow!
examples.translation: 看哪，彩虹！

examples.text: ...silk brocade of every colour of the rainbow.
examples.translation: 彩虹般五颜六色的绸缎

examples.text: ...a rainbow of coloured cushions.
examples.translation: 五颜六色的彩垫

examples.text: The promise of a cure — the pot of gold at the end of the rainbow — often makes sensible people do irrational things.
examples.translation: 找到一种治愈方法的希望——就如同永远够不到的一桶黄金——往往让理智的人们做出不理智的事情。

meanings.meaning: 搜索；用耙子耙；掠过，擦过
倾斜；搜索；掠过；用耙子耙
耙子；斜度；钱耙；放荡的人，浪子

examples.text: Rake the soil, press the seed into it, then cover it lightly...
examples.translation: 将土耙松，把种子种在土里，然后轻轻地盖上土。

examples.text: The beach is raked and cleaned daily.
examples.translation: 每天都有人把海滩耙平并且清理干净。

examples.text: I watched the men rake leaves into heaps...
examples.translation: 我看着那些人把叶子耙成堆。

examples.text: She raked out the ashes from the boiler.
examples.translation: 她把炉灰从锅炉里面耙了出来。

examples.text: Planes dropped bombs and raked the beach with machine gun fire...
examples.translation: 飞机投下炸弹，并用机关枪扫射海滩。

examples.text: The caravan was raked with bullets...
examples.translation: 车队遭到了子弹扫射。

examples.text: The headlights raked across a painted sign.
examples.translation: 车头灯扫过一张标志牌。

examples.text: Ragged fingernails raked her skin...
examples.translation: 粗糙的指甲划过她的皮肤。

examples.text: He found the man's cheeks and raked them with his nails.
examples.translation: 他摸到了那人的脸颊并用指甲抓过去。

examples.text: Many can survive only by raking through dustbins.
examples.translation: 许多人靠在垃圾箱中寻食才能够活下来。

examples.text: He raised his hand to wave...
examples.translation: 他举手挥动起来。

examples.text: She went to the window and raised the blinds...
examples.translation: 她走到窗前，拉起了百叶窗。

examples.text: Milton raised the glass to his lips.
examples.translation: 米尔顿把玻璃杯举到唇边。

examples.text: ...a small raised platform.
examples.translation: 一个凸起的小平台

examples.text: They had raised the white flag in surrender...
examples.translation: 他们举白旗投降了。

examples.text: At midnight, the German flag will be raised over the Reichstag.
examples.translation: 半夜时，德国国旗将在德国国会大厦升起。

examples.text: He raised himself into a sitting position...
examples.translation: 他坐了起来。

examples.text: She raised herself on one elbow.
examples.translation: 她用一只胳膊肘撑起身体。

examples.text: The Republic of Ireland is expected to raise interest rates...
examples.translation: 爱尔兰共和国预计会提高利率。

examples.text: Two incidents in recent days have raised the level of concern.
examples.translation: 最近发生的两起事件引发了更多人的关注。

examples.text: ...a raised body temperature.
examples.translation: 升高的体温

examples.text: ...a new drive to raise standards of literacy in Britain's schools.
examples.translation: 提高英国学校文化水平的新运动

examples.text: Don't you raise your voice to me, Henry Rollins!...
examples.translation: 别冲我叫嚷，亨利·罗林斯！

examples.text: Anne raised her voice in order to be heard.
examples.translation: 为了让人能听得见，安妮提高了嗓门。

examples.text: Within two months Kelly got a raise.
examples.translation: 不到两个月，凯利就获得了加薪。

examples.text: ...events held to raise money for Help the Aged...
examples.translation: 为“帮助老年人”活动而发起的募捐活动

examples.text: All funds raised will be used by Children With Leukaemia.
examples.translation: 所有募集到的资金都将用于“白血病患儿”组织。

examples.text: They raised the money to buy the house and two hundred acres of grounds.
examples.translation: 他们筹钱来购买房屋及200英亩的土地。

examples.text: The agreement has raised hopes that the war may end soon...
examples.translation: 那项协议使人们感到战争有望很快结束。

examples.text: The accident again raises questions about the safety of the plant.
examples.translation: 这起事故再一次引发了人们对于工厂安全性的质疑。

examples.text: ...a joke that raised a smile on everyone's lips.
examples.translation: 让大家都会心一笑的笑话

examples.text: In the meeting Mrs. Ashrawi raised the three main concerns that the Palestinians had...
examples.translation: 会议上，阿什拉维夫人提出了巴勒斯坦人最为关注的三个问题。

examples.text: He had been consulted and had raised no objections.
examples.translation: 事先征求了他的意见，他并没有提出异议。

examples.text: My mother was an amazing woman. She raised four of us kids virtually singlehandedly.
examples.translation: 我的母亲是位了不起的女性。她几乎是一个人把我们4个孩子带大的。

examples.text: ...the house where she was raised.
examples.translation: 她在其间长大的那幢房子

examples.text: He raises 2,000 acres of wheat and hay.
examples.translation: 他种植了2,000英亩的小麦和牧草。

examples.text: ...a perfectly cooked farm-raised chicken.
examples.translation: 精心烹制的农场养的鸡

meanings.meaning: 团结；重整；恢复；（网球等）连续对打
团结；集合；恢复健康、力量等

examples.text: About three thousand people held a rally to mark international human rights day...
examples.translation: 大约3,000人举行了一场大会来庆祝国际人权日。

examples.text: Supporters of the policy are reported to be gathering in Delhi for a mass rally.
examples.translation: 有报道说这项政策的拥护者要齐聚德里召开群众集会。

examples.text: His supporters have rallied to his defence...
examples.translation: 他的拥护者团结起来为他辩护。

examples.text: He rallied his own supporters for a fight.
examples.translation: 他把自己的拥护者召集起来准备斗争。

examples.text: He rallied enough to thank his doctors...
examples.translation: 他身体好得差不多了，于是去感谢他的医生。

examples.text: Markets began to rally worldwide.
examples.translation: 世界各地的市场开始复苏。

examples.text: After a brief rally the shares returned to 126p.
examples.translation: 经过短暂的反弹后，股价回落到了126便士。

examples.text: Carlos Sainz of Spain has won the New Zealand Motor Rally.
examples.translation: 西班牙人卡洛斯·赛恩斯在新西兰摩托车公路大赛中夺冠。

examples.text: ...an accomplished rally driver.
examples.translation: 技术精湛的公路赛车手

examples.text: ...a long rally.
examples.translation: 长时间的连续对打

meanings.meaning: [数] 随机的；任意的；胡乱的

examples.text: The survey used a random sample of two thousand people across England and Wales...
examples.translation: 该调查在英格兰和威尔士随机抽样了2,000人。

examples.text: The competitors will be subject to random drug testing.
examples.translation: 参赛者将要接受随机药检。

examples.text: ...interviews with a randomly selected sample of thirty girls aged between 13 and 18.
examples.translation: 在13到18岁女孩中随机抽取30位进行访谈

examples.text: ...random violence against innocent victims...
examples.translation: 加诸无辜受害者的无端暴行

examples.text: Children's words and actions are often fairly random.
examples.translation: 小孩子的言行常常是随性而为。

examples.text: ...random variations of the wind.
examples.translation: 风的变化不定

examples.text: ...drinks and magazines left scattered randomly around.
examples.translation: 到处都是随手乱丢的饮料和杂志

examples.text: Isn't this a demand to control the randomness of life?
examples.translation: 这难道不是要求对生命的无常加以控制吗？

examples.text: We received several answers, and we picked one at random.
examples.translation: 我们收到了一些答复，并从中随机挑选了一个。

examples.text: Three black people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.
examples.translation: 3名黑人被从一辆面包车里胡乱射出的子弹打死了。

meanings.meaning: （在...内）变动；平行，列为一行；延伸；漫游；射程达到
漫游；放牧；使并列；归类于；来回走动

examples.text: A wide range of colours and patterns are available...
examples.translation: 各种颜色和样式都有。

examples.text: The two men discussed a range of issues...
examples.translation: 那两个人讨论了一系列问题。

examples.text: The range includes chests of drawers, tables and wardrobes.
examples.translation: 该系列包括五斗柜、桌子和衣橱。

examples.text: The average age range is between 35 and 55.
examples.translation: 平均年龄在35岁到55岁之间。

examples.text: ...properties available in the price range they are looking for.
examples.translation: 在他们寻求的价格范围内的房产

examples.text: ...top-of-the-range products for which people are prepared to pay a little bit more.
examples.translation: 人们愿意多花一点钱购买的高档产品

examples.text: The 120mm mortar has a range of 18,000 yards...
examples.translation: 口径为120毫米的迫击炮的射程是1.8万码。

examples.text: The trees on the mountains within my range of vision had all been felled...
examples.translation: 山上我视野范围内的树木都被砍倒了。

examples.text: Tactical nuclear weapons have shorter ranges.
examples.translation: 战术核武器的威力范围较小。

examples.text: They range in price from $3 to $15.
examples.translation: 它们的价格从3美元到15美元不等。

examples.text: ...offering merchandise ranging from the everyday to the esoteric.
examples.translation: 供应从日常用品到专业用具等各种商品

examples.text: ...temperatures ranging between 5℃ and 20℃.
examples.translation: 温度变化在5℃到20℃之间

examples.text: The conversation ranged over the desirability of such restaurants, the shortcomings of men, and why it had only taken 15 minutes to cross a continent.
examples.translation: 谈话涉及了这类餐馆的吸引人之处、男人的弱点，还有为什么只用15分钟就跨越了一个大洲。

examples.text: Some 300 trees have been ranged along the perimeter hedge...
examples.translation: 沿着绿篱栽种着大约300棵树。

examples.text: More than 1,500 police and troops are ranged against them.
examples.translation: 1,500多名警察和士兵列队与他们对峙。

examples.text: Feeding is not a problem because the birds range over such a large area...
examples.translation: 这种鸟活动的范围很大，因此觅食不成问题。

examples.text: They range widely in search of carrion.
examples.translation: 它们在广阔的区域内搜寻腐肉。

examples.text: ...the massive mountain ranges to the north.
examples.translation: 向北延伸的巨大山脉

examples.text: ...an impressive range of hills topped with trees.
examples.translation: 山顶覆盖着树木的绵绵山峦

examples.text: It reminds me of my days on the rifle range preparing for duty in Vietnam.
examples.translation: 它使我想起了在靶场练习射击准备去越南服役的日子。

examples.text: ...an Army firing range.
examples.translation: 陆军射击场

examples.text: Cars are driven through the mess, splashing everyone in range.
examples.translation: 车从脏水里驶过，溅了周围所有人一身水。

examples.text: ...a base within range of enemy missiles...
examples.translation: 在敌人导弹射程内的基地

examples.text: ...out of range of their rockets...
examples.translation: 在他们火箭炮的射程之外

examples.text: The fish stayed 50 yards offshore, well out of range.
examples.translation: 这种鱼生活在离岸50码的地方，完全钓不到。

examples.text: He was shot in the head at close range...
examples.translation: 他在近距离内被人用枪击中头部。

examples.text: McCoist knocked the ball in from close range.
examples.translation: 麦克科伊斯特门前近距离将球攻入。

examples.text: ...photographing wild animals from close range...
examples.translation: 对野生动物进行近距离拍摄

examples.text: The enemy opened fire at a range of only 20 yards.
examples.translation: 敌人在距离仅20码的地方开火了。

examples.text: He eventually rose to the rank of captain...
examples.translation: 他终于升职当上了船长。

examples.text: The former head of counter-intelligence had been stripped of his rank and privileges.
examples.translation: 反情报机构的前任长官被革职并剥夺了特权。

examples.text: ...officers of equivalent rank in the other branches.
examples.translation: 其他部门的同级官员

examples.text: Each rank of the peerage was represented...
examples.translation: 每个贵族阶级都有代表。

examples.text: He must be treated as a hostage of high rank, not as a common prisoner.
examples.translation: 必须把他当成高级人质来对待，而不能像对待普通囚犯那样。

examples.text: The report ranks the UK 20th out of 22 advanced nations...
examples.translation: 报告中把英国排在22个先进国家中的第20位。

examples.text: He was at the time ranked 10th in the world and had a regular place in the Swedish Davis Cup team...
examples.translation: 他那时世界排名第10，并且是瑞典戴维斯杯队的主力队员。

examples.text: The United States ranks 20th in its infant mortality rate.
examples.translation: 美国在婴儿死亡率方面排名第20。

examples.text: ...the only British woman to be ranked in the top 50 of the women's world rankings...
examples.translation: 女子世界排名前50位的唯一一个英国人

examples.text: Mr Short does not even rank in the world's top ten.
examples.translation: 肖特先生甚至没有进入世界前10名。

examples.text: His prices rank high among those of other contemporary photographers...
examples.translation: 在当代摄影师当中，他的要价很高。

examples.text: Investors ranked South Korea high among Asian nations...
examples.translation: 在亚洲各国当中，投资者很看重韩国。

examples.text: St Peters-burg's night life ranks as more exciting than the capital's...
examples.translation: 圣彼得堡的夜生活比首都的更刺激。

examples.text: 18 per cent of women ranked sex as very important in their lives...
examples.translation: 18%的女性认为性在她们的生活中是很重要的。

examples.text: The Ritz-Carlton in Aspen has to rank as one of the most extraordinary hotels I have ever been to...
examples.translation: 不得不说，阿斯彭的丽兹·卡尔顿饭店是我所住过的最气派的酒店之一。

examples.text: Since the 1930s, cancer has always been ranked as the disease people are most concerned about.
examples.translation: 自从20世纪30年代以来，癌症一直被列为人类最关注的疾病。

examples.text: ...a performance of heroic calibre that must rank with the most memorable in international rugby...
examples.translation: 必被列为国际橄榄球赛中最令人难忘的一场荡气回肠的比赛

examples.text: As a novel, Nineteen Eighty-four hardly ranks with the greats.
examples.translation: 作为一部小说，《一九八四》很难被列为杰作。

examples.text: There were some misgivings within the ranks of the media too...
examples.translation: 媒体内部也存在一些疑虑。

examples.text: The General Assembly welcomed five new members to its ranks.
examples.translation: 联合国大会对5个新成员国的加入表示了欢迎。

examples.text: ...the growing ranks of companies building personal computers.
examples.translation: 越来越多的生产个人电脑的公司

examples.text: Top military leaders say there have been reports of demoralization in the ranks...
examples.translation: 最高军事指挥说有报告称士兵中出现了士气低落。

examples.text: Most store managers have worked their way up through the ranks.
examples.translation: 大多数商店经理都是由普通店员干起，一步步升上来的。

examples.text: Ranks of police in riot gear stood nervously by...
examples.translation: 一队队防暴警察紧张待命。

examples.text: She continued to smile at the ranks of cameras on their doorstep.
examples.translation: 她依旧对着门口的一排排照相机微笑着。

examples.text: The man led the way to the taxi rank...
examples.translation: 那人带路来到了出租汽车候客处。

examples.text: He walked towards the first taxi on the rank.
examples.translation: 他朝着停车处的第一辆出租车走去。

examples.text: He called it 'rank hypocrisy' that the government was now promoting equal rights.
examples.translation: 他把目前政府提倡平等权利的举措称为“彻头彻尾的伪善”。

examples.text: The kitchen was rank with the smell of drying uniforms.
examples.translation: 厨房内充斥着烘干制服的难闻气味。

examples.text: ...the rank smell of unwashed clothes.
examples.translation: 脏衣服所发出的臭味

examples.text: 'Even the President's staunchest supporters have some issues where they simply must break ranks,' says Senator Lott...
examples.translation: “即使是总统最忠实的拥护者在某些事情上也会不听指令，”参议员洛特说。

examples.text: Britain appears unlikely to break ranks with other members of the European Union.
examples.translation: 英国看起来不会与欧盟的其他成员反目。

examples.text: Conservative MPs intend to put aside their differences over Europe and close ranks behind the Prime Minister...
examples.translation: 保守党下院议员打算暂且搁置他们在欧洲问题上的分歧，团结起来支持首相。

examples.text: Institutions tend to close ranks when a member has been accused of misconduct.
examples.translation: 当其中某成员被谴责失职时，机构往往会抱成一团。

examples.text: Last month, 370,000 Americans joined the ranks of the unemployed...
examples.translation: 上个月，有37万美国人加入了失业者的行列。

examples.text: The rank outsiders, Cameroon, beat the defending champions, Argentina, by one goal to nil.
examples.translation: 本不被看好的喀麦隆队却以1比0击败了卫冕冠军阿根廷队。

examples.text: The Captain pulled rank and made his sergeant row the entire way.
examples.translation: 上校倚仗权势让他的中士划船划了一路。

meanings.meaning: 抢走；轻敲；敲击致使；使着迷

examples.text: For some people, rap — the music of the hip-hop generation — is just so much noise...
examples.translation: 对某些人来说，说唱乐——嘻哈一族的音乐——简直就是噪音。

examples.text: Her favorite music was by Run DMC, a rap group.
examples.translation: 她最喜爱的音乐是Run DMC说唱组合的音乐。

examples.text: ...the unexpected pleasure of hearing the Kids not only rap but even sing...
examples.translation: 听到Kids组合不仅表演说唱音乐还唱了歌的意外惊喜

examples.text: New Yorkers rap about parties and clubs, I rap about car chases and guns.
examples.translation: 纽约人在说唱音乐中表现晚会和俱乐部的情景，我则说唱飞车追逐和枪战的情景。

examples.text: Every member contributes to the rap, singing either solo or as part of a rap chorus.
examples.translation: 每个成员都参与到说唱中来，或者独唱，或者表演说唱乐中的和声部分。

examples.text: Mary Ann turned and rapped on Simon's door.
examples.translation: 玛莉·安转身急促地敲了敲西蒙家的门。

examples.text: ...rapping the glass with the knuckles of his right hand...
examples.translation: 用他右手指关节敲击玻璃

examples.text: A guard raps his stick on a metal hand rail.
examples.translation: 一名守卫用警棍敲打金属扶手。

examples.text: There was a sharp rap on the door.
examples.translation: 有人在急促地敲门。

examples.text: You'll be facing a Federal rap for aiding and abetting an escaped convict.
examples.translation: 因涉嫌协助和教唆越狱囚犯，你将面临联邦指控。

examples.text: FA chiefs could still face a rap and a possible fine...
examples.translation: 足协高层可能还要受到训诫并被处以罚款。

examples.text: Timeshare companies also come in for a rap as they continue to flout the rules.
examples.translation: 各分时度假公司也受到了批评，因为他们一直违反相关规则。

examples.text: Water industry chiefs were rapped yesterday for failing their customers...
examples.translation: 昨天，水利行业的头头们因为怠慢客户而受到批评。

examples.text: The minister rapped banks over their treatment of small businesses.
examples.translation: 部长批评了银行对待小企业的态度。

examples.text: The rap against Conn was that he was far too reckless...
examples.translation: 科恩被人们认为做事太不计后果。

examples.text: The rap on this guy is that he doesn't really care...
examples.translation: 这家伙据说并不怎么在乎。

examples.text: He said statisticians gave them a bad rap by 'lying with figures'.
examples.translation: 他说统计学家“用数据说谎”，败坏了他们的名声。

examples.text: Today we are going to rap about relationships.
examples.translation: 今天我们要聊聊关系的问题。

examples.text: We rap the manufacturers on their knuckles if the toy is shoddy...
examples.translation: 如果玩具质量低劣，我们会痛斥制造商。

examples.text: I joined the workers on strike and was rapped over the knuckles...
examples.translation: 我参加了工人的罢工，因而受到了训斥。

examples.text: Ms Tyson also had her knuckles rapped for doing this.
examples.translation: 泰森女士也因为这么做而受到了指责。

examples.text: The remark earned him a rap on the knuckles...
examples.translation: 那番话使他受到了指责。

examples.text: Britain gave them a diplomatic rap over the knuckles.
examples.translation: 英国对他们进行了外交上的谴责。

examples.text: When the client was murdered, his wife took the rap, but did she really do it?
examples.translation: 当那名客户被谋杀后，他妻子背上了黑锅，然而真是她杀的吗？

examples.text: ...their decision to help Minnie beat the murder rap.
examples.translation: 他们要帮米妮逃过谋杀罪惩罚的决定

meanings.meaning: 强奸，掠夺；[园艺] 油菜；葡萄渣

examples.text: A young woman was brutally raped in her own home...
examples.translation: 一名年轻女子在自己家中惨遭强暴。

examples.text: Her party opposes abortion, except in cases of rape or incest...
examples.translation: 她的党派反对堕胎，但强奸或乱伦引起的怀孕除外。

examples.text: Almost ninety per cent of all rapes and violent assaults went unreported.
examples.translation: 几乎90%的强奸案和暴力侵害案都没有报案。

examples.text: As a result of the rape of the forests, parts of the country are now short of water.
examples.translation: 由于森林遭到破坏，目前该国的部分地区水源短缺。

meanings.meaning: 迅速的，急促的；飞快的；险峻的
急流；高速交通工具，高速交通网

examples.text: ...the country's rapid economic growth in the 1980's...
examples.translation: 20世纪80年代该国经济的迅速增长

examples.text: This signals a rapid change of mind by the government.
examples.translation: 这标志着政府思想的急剧转变。

examples.text: ...the rapid decline in the birth rate in Western Europe.
examples.translation: 西欧人口出生率的迅速下降

examples.text: ...countries with rapidly growing populations...
examples.translation: 人口迅速增长的国家

examples.text: Try to rip it apart as rapidly as possible...
examples.translation: 动作尽可能快地把它撕开。

examples.text: 'Operating profit is rising more rapidly,' he said.
examples.translation: “营业利润增长愈加迅速，”他说。

examples.text: ...the rapidity with which the weather can change.
examples.translation: 天气的迅速变化

examples.text: He walked at a rapid pace along Charles Street.
examples.translation: 他快步走过查尔斯大街。

examples.text: ...whether the Tunnel will provide more rapid car transport than ferries...
examples.translation: 隧道是否能够提供比渡船更加快捷的车辆运输

examples.text: Breathing becomes more rapid and sweating starts.
examples.translation: 呼吸变得更加急促并且开始流汗。

examples.text: He was moving rapidly around the room...
examples.translation: 他在房间里来来回回地快步走着。

examples.text: They rapidly spread out over the field.
examples.translation: 他们很快便在田野上散开。

examples.text: The water rushed through the holes with great rapidity.
examples.translation: 湍急的水流奔涌过洞口。

examples.text: They battled against other Indian tribes, but rarely fought with the whites...
examples.translation: 他们同其他印第安部落作战，但很少与白人并肩对敌。

examples.text: I very rarely wear a raincoat because I spend most of my time in a car...
examples.translation: 我难得穿一次雨衣，因为大部分时间我都是呆在车里。

examples.text: Money was plentiful, and rarely did anyone seem very bothered about levels of expenditure...
examples.translation: 有足够的钱，似乎很难见到有人为花费而烦心。

examples.text: They were rarely seen together and certainly did not travel together...
examples.translation: 很少见到他们在一起，当然更不可能一起旅行。

examples.text: Adolescent suicide is rarely an impulsive reaction to immediate distress...
examples.translation: 青少年自杀很少是由于突然发生不幸而作出的冲动反应。

examples.text: Rarely does a grand jury publicly disagree with a prosecutor.
examples.translation: 大陪审团公开反对公诉人意见的情况很少见。

examples.text: ...the black-necked crane, one of the rarest species in the world...
examples.translation: 黑颈鹤，世界最稀有的物种之一

examples.text: She collects rare plants...
examples.translation: 她收集稀有植物。

examples.text: Do you want to know about a particular rare stamp or rare stamps in general?
examples.translation: 你是想了解某一种珍稀邮票还是想了解珍稀邮票的整体概念？

examples.text: ...on those rare occasions when he did eat alone...
examples.translation: 在那些极其少见的、他的确单独吃饭的时候

examples.text: Heart attacks were extremely rare in babies, he said...
examples.translation: 婴儿极少有心脏病发作的情况，他说。

examples.text: It's apparently rare for anyone to have two legs the same length...
examples.translation: 显然，一个人两条腿的长度完全相同的情况是很少见的。

examples.text: I think it's very rare to have big families nowadays.
examples.translation: 我想，如今大家庭已经很少见了。

examples.text: Ferris has a rare ability to record her observations on paper...
examples.translation: 费里斯具备把自己的观察结果记录下来的超强能力。

examples.text: It was a rare pleasure to see him in action.
examples.translation: 看他打球是一种享受。

examples.text: ...a leader of rare strength and instinct.
examples.translation: 拥有杰出才干和天赋的领导

examples.text: Thick tuna steaks are eaten rare, like beef...
examples.translation: 像牛肉一样，厚的金枪鱼排做到半熟即可食用。

examples.text: Waiter, I specifically asked for this steak rare.
examples.translation: 服务员，我特别强调了这块牛排要做得嫩些。

meanings.meaning: 轻率的；鲁莽的；不顾后果的
[皮肤] 皮疹；突然大量出现的事物

examples.text: It would be rash to rely on such evidence...
examples.translation: 依靠这样的证据是草率的。

examples.text: Mr. Major is making no rash promises...
examples.translation: 梅杰先生没有作出轻率的承诺。

examples.text: Don't do anything rash until the feelings subside.
examples.translation: 在冷静下来之前不要鲁莽行事。

examples.text: I made quite a lot of money, but I rashly gave most of it away...
examples.translation: 我赚了不少钱，但是大部分被我轻率地花掉了。

examples.text: My sister always said I acted rashly.
examples.translation: 我姐姐总是说我行为鲁莽。

examples.text: With characteristic rashness and valor, Peter plunged into the icy water.
examples.translation: 以他惯有的冲动和勇气，彼得一头扎进了冰冷的水中。

examples.text: ...the rashness of youth.
examples.translation: 年少的鲁莽

examples.text: I noticed a rash on my leg...
examples.translation: 我发现我腿上长了疹子。

examples.text: He may break out in a rash when he eats these nuts...
examples.translation: 他吃了这些坚果可能会长皮疹。

examples.text: The symptoms include skin rashes, fever, and painful joints.
examples.translation: 病症包括皮疹、发烧和关节疼痛。

examples.text: They believe this confusion is responsible for a rash of suicides this spring.
examples.translation: 他们认为今年春天一连串的自杀事件是由这次混乱引起的。

examples.text: ...one of the few major airlines left untouched by the industry's rash of takeovers...
examples.translation: 没有受到行业内大量收购风波波及的少数几个重要航空公司之一

examples.text: Now a rash of scruffy little shops bordered one side of the street.
examples.translation: 现在街道的一边排满了各种破旧的小店。

examples.text: This was demonstrated in a laboratory experiment with rats.
examples.translation: 在实验室用老鼠进行的实验证明了这一点。

examples.text: ...a rat-infested derelict building.
examples.translation: 鼠灾泛滥的废弃建筑

examples.text: What did you do with the gun you took from that little rat Turner?
examples.translation: 你是怎么处理从那个叫特纳的小叛徒手里得到的枪的？

examples.text: They were accused of encouraging children to rat on their parents.
examples.translation: 他们被指控唆使儿童告发自己的父母。

examples.text: She claims he ratted on their divorce settlement.
examples.translation: 她声称他违反了他们的离婚协议。

examples.text: If I don't send a picture, he will smell a rat...
examples.translation: 如果我不寄出照片，他将有所察觉。

examples.text: Though Lloyd George's behaviour seemed curious, Haig still did not smell a rat.
examples.translation: 尽管劳埃德·乔治的行为古怪，黑格仍然没有任何怀疑。

examples.text: The rate at which hair grows can be agonisingly slow...
examples.translation: 头发生长的速度可能极其缓慢。

examples.text: The world's tropical forests are disappearing at an even faster rate than experts had thought.
examples.translation: 世界上热带森林消失的速度比专家们预想的还要快。

examples.text: New diet books appear at a rate of nearly one a week...
examples.translation: 新的饮食类书籍差不多一周出一本。

examples.text: His heart rate was 30 beats per minute slower...
examples.translation: 他的心率每分钟慢了30次。

examples.text: Britain held the unenviable record of having the highest divorce rate in Europe.
examples.translation: 英国在欧洲各国中保持着不光彩的最高离婚率纪录。

examples.text: Calls cost 36p per minute cheap rate and 48p at all other times.
examples.translation: 优惠时段的话费是每分钟36便士，其他时段是48便士。

examples.text: ...specially reduced rates for travellers using Gatwick Airport...
examples.translation: 为在盖特威克机场进出港的乘客提供的优惠价格

examples.text: East German wages were converted at the rate of one old East mark for one Deutschmark.
examples.translation: 东德的工资兑换比率是一个旧东德马克兑换一个德国马克。

examples.text: The government insisted that it would not be panicked into interest rate cuts.
examples.translation: 政府坚称不会陷入恐慌而匆忙降息。

examples.text: Soldiers were exempt from paying rates...
examples.translation: 士兵免缴地方税。

examples.text: The new council tax combines elements of both the community charge and the rates.
examples.translation: 新的家庭税合并了人头税和地方税两个税种。

examples.text: Of all the men in the survey, they rate themselves the least fun-loving and the most responsible...
examples.translation: 在所有参加调查的人中，他们认为自己最不贪玩、最负责任。

examples.text: The film was rated excellent by 90 per cent of children...
examples.translation: 90%的孩子都表示这部电影很精彩。

examples.text: Most rated it a hit...
examples.translation: 大多数人认为它很受欢迎。

examples.text: We rate him as one of the best...
examples.translation: 我们认为他是其中佼佼者之一。

examples.text: She rated the course highly...
examples.translation: 她对这门课的评价很高。

examples.text: Reading books does not rate highly among Britons as a leisure activity.
examples.translation: 读书并非英国人很喜欢的休闲活动。

examples.text: ...the most highly rated player in English football.
examples.translation: 英格兰足球界最受好评的球员

examples.text: It's flattering to know that other clubs have shown interest and seem to rate me...
examples.translation: 得知其他俱乐部对我感兴趣并看好我令我受宠若惊。

examples.text: Its artistic value failed to move Paddy Clegg. 'I don't know what all the fuss is about. I didn't rate it at all,' he said.
examples.translation: 它的艺术价值没能打动帕迪·克莱格。“我不知道这样大惊小怪是为什么。我一点儿也不看好它，”他说道。

examples.text: He is generally rated Italy's No. 3 industrialist...
examples.translation: 他被公认为意大利第三大实业家。

examples.text: He came here rated 100th on the tennis computer.
examples.translation: 他以网坛排名第100名的身份来到这里。

examples.text: This is so extraordinary, it rates a medal and a phone call from the President...
examples.translation: 这简直不可思议，应该得到一枚奖章以及总统的电话祝贺。

examples.text: In those crowded streets her attire did not rate a second glance.
examples.translation: 在那些拥挤的街道她的穿着并未引起注意。

examples.text: She modestly suggests that 'sex, or at any rate gender, may account for the difference'...
examples.translation: 她谨慎地提出“性别，至少是男女的性征，也许能解释这个差异”。

examples.text: He is the least appealing character, to me at any rate.
examples.translation: 他是其中最没有吸引力的角色，至少对我来说是这样。

examples.text: At any rate, Pankin said that relations between the two nations will be restored before the conference...
examples.translation: 不管怎样，潘金说两国之间的关系将在会谈之前恢复。

examples.text: Well, at any rate, let me thank you for all you did.
examples.translation: 好吧，不管怎样，还是要感谢你所做的一切。

examples.text: At this rate, she would be almost seven feet tall by then...
examples.translation: 这样下去，她到时将有7英尺高了。

examples.text: At this rate they'd be lucky to get home before eight-thirty or nine.
examples.translation: 这样看来他们能在8点半或是9点以前到家就算幸运了。

examples.text: The problem was psychological rather than physiological...
examples.translation: 问题是心理方面的而不是生理方面的。

examples.text: Sedge is similar in appearance to grass but has a solid rather than a hollow stem...
examples.translation: 莎草看上去和普通的草没什么两样，但其草茎是实芯的而不是空芯的。

examples.text: The dark star in Nova Muscae 1991 is a black hole rather than a neutron star...
examples.translation: 在1991年苍蝇座中的暗星其实是一个黑洞而非中子星。

examples.text: When I'm going out in the evening I use the bike if I can rather than the car.
examples.translation: 我晚上要外出的时候，我宁愿骑自行车而不是开车。

examples.text: Rather than break her appointment and disappoint me, Katie again took the car...
examples.translation: 凯蒂又一次把车开来了，而没有爽约让我失望。

examples.text: She made students think for themselves, rather than telling them what to think...
examples.translation: 她让学生们独立思考，而不是一味地告诉他们该思考些什么。

examples.text: I suggest that rather than the show season starting in June, it should be brought forward to April or May...
examples.translation: 我提议它应该提前到4月或5月，而不等要到6月份开始的展示会。

examples.text: Most of these will be fleeing cold and hunger, rather than fighting...
examples.translation: 这些人中的大部分会因饥寒交迫而逃亡，而不是因为战争。

examples.text: She prefers to stay in detention rather than be released and go into exile.
examples.translation: 她更愿意呆在拘留所而不是被释放然后开始流亡生活。

examples.text: Twenty million years ago, Idaho was not the arid place it is now. Rather, it was warm and damp, populated by dense primordial forest...
examples.translation: 2,000万年前，爱达荷州并不像现在这样干旱。相反，那时的爱达荷州温暖潮湿，有大片的原始森林。

examples.text: But there must be no talk of final victory; rather, the long, hard slog to a solution...
examples.translation: 但是这还谈不上是最后的胜利；而是长期、艰难地寻找解决方法的过程。

examples.text: The process is not a circle but rather a spiral...
examples.translation: 这个过程不是一个圆周运动而是螺旋上升型的。

examples.text: He explained what the Crux is, or rather, what it was.
examples.translation: 他解释了什么是南十字座，或者更确切地说，过去南十字座是什么。

examples.text: If it's all the same to you, I'd rather work at home...
examples.translation: 如果对你来说没什么差别，我宁愿在家中工作。

examples.text: Which programme would you rather appear on?...
examples.translation: 你更愿意在哪个节目中露面？

examples.text: Kids would rather play than study...
examples.translation: 孩子们宁愿玩也不愿学习。

examples.text: I have no information one way or the other, but I would rather he do it than not do it...
examples.translation: 我没有办法得到情报，但是我宁愿他去做。

examples.text: I would rather Lionel took it on...
examples.translation: 我宁愿莱昂内尔负责这件事。

examples.text: Sorry. I'd rather not talk about it...
examples.translation: 抱歉，我不愿意谈论这个。

examples.text: Would you like that? Don't hesitate to say no if you'd rather not.
examples.translation: 你喜欢那个吗？如果你不喜欢就直说。

examples.text: I grew up in rather unusual circumstances...
examples.translation: 我在非同寻常的环境下长大。

examples.text: It had made some rather bad mistakes which I thought should be corrected...
examples.translation: 它犯了一些相当严重的错误，我觉得应该加以纠正。

examples.text: He had had an excellent dinner at a rather good local hotel...
examples.translation: 他已在当地一个相当不错的饭店里享用了一顿可口的晚餐。

examples.text: The first speaker began to talk, very fast and rather loudly...
examples.translation: 第一个发言者开始讲话了，语速很快，声音相当大。

examples.text: We got along rather well...
examples.translation: 我们相处得相当融洽。

examples.text: I'm afraid it's rather a long story...
examples.translation: 恐怕这说来话长。

examples.text: The reality is rather more complex...
examples.translation: 事实要更加复杂。

examples.text: As you can see, he did rather better for himself than I did.
examples.translation: 你可以看出，他自己做的比我做的还要好。

examples.text: ...a figure rather too good to be true...
examples.translation: 好得有点不真实的人物

examples.text: The fruit is rather like a sweet chestnut...
examples.translation: 这种果实颇似甜栗子。

examples.text: Robbie was there with his family, keeping rather in the background.
examples.translation: 罗比和他的家人一起在那里，深居简出。

examples.text: I rather think he was telling the truth...
examples.translation: 我倒觉得他讲的是真话。

examples.text: I rather like the decorative effect.
examples.translation: 我倒很喜欢装饰的效果。

examples.text: 'Well, he did have a sort of family connection with it, didn't he.' — 'Oh yes. Rather.'
examples.translation: “那么，他的确和它有些家族渊源，是不是？”——“噢，是的，的确如此。”

examples.text: In 1978 there were 884 students at a lecturer/student ratio of 1:15...
examples.translation: 1978年有884名学生，师生比为1比15。

examples.text: The bottom chart shows the ratio of personal debt to personal income...
examples.translation: 下面的图表显示了个人负债与个人收入之比。

examples.text: The adult to child ratio is 1 to 6.
examples.translation: 成人与儿童的比例为1比6。

examples.text: He's asking you to look at both sides of the case and come to a rational decision...
examples.translation: 他是要求你看到问题的两面后再作出理性的决定。

examples.text: Mary was able to short-circuit her stress response by keeping her thoughts calm and rational.
examples.translation: 玛丽能够保持头脑清醒理智，因而迅速做出反应。

examples.text: It can be very hard to think rationally when you're feeling so vulnerable and alone.
examples.translation: 人在脆弱和孤独的时候很难理智地思考。

examples.text: We live in an era of rationality.
examples.translation: 我们生活在理性的时代。

examples.text: Did he come across as a sane rational person?...
examples.translation: 他看起来是一个正常而理智的人吗？

examples.text: Rachel looked calmer and more rational now.
examples.translation: 雷切尔现在看上去更加平静、更加理智了。

meanings.meaning: 生的；未加工的；阴冷的；刺痛的；擦掉皮的；无经验的；（在艺术等方面）不成熟的

examples.text: We import raw materials and energy and export mainly industrial products.
examples.translation: 我们进口原材料和能源，主要出口工业产品。

examples.text: ...two ships carrying raw sugar from Cuba.
examples.translation: 两艘来自古巴装有粗糖的船

examples.text: ...a popular dish made of raw fish...
examples.translation: 受欢迎的生鱼菜肴

examples.text: This versatile vegetable can be eaten raw or cooked...
examples.translation: 这种蔬菜有多种吃法，既可生吃也可烹调后食用。

examples.text: Half of it is burned and half of it is raw.
examples.translation: 一半烧焦了，另一半还是生的。

examples.text: ...the drag of the rope against the raw flesh of my shoulders...
examples.translation: 绳子摩擦着我蹭破了皮的肩头

examples.text: Her feet hurt and her hands were rubbed raw from unaccustomed work.
examples.translation: 这种活儿她根本做不习惯，双脚疼痛，双手也蹭破了皮。

examples.text: ...the raw passions of nationalism...
examples.translation: 朴实的民族主义热情

examples.text: Her grief was still raw and he did not know how to help her.
examples.translation: 她仍然沉浸在悲伤中，他不知道如何帮她才好。

examples.text: The rawness of his greed was frank and uninhibited.
examples.translation: 他的贪婪是赤裸裸的，干脆直接，毫不掩饰。

examples.text: ...the raw power of instinct.
examples.translation: 本能的强大力量

examples.text: ...the raw vitality of his earlier painting.
examples.translation: 他早期绘画的强大生命力
