examples.translation: 我很遗憾地通知你，他因伤势太重不治身亡。

examples.text: He expressed great regret and said that surgeons would attempt to reverse the operation...
examples.translation: 他深表歉意，说外科医生会努力消除手术造成的损伤。

examples.text: She has accepted his resignation with regret.
examples.translation: 她遗憾地接受了他的辞职。

meanings.meaning: 定期的；有规律的；合格的；整齐的；普通的
常客；正式队员；中坚分子

examples.text: Take regular exercise...
examples.translation: 定期进行锻炼。

examples.text: Now it's time for our regular look at the world of international sport...
examples.translation: 现在我们再来关注一下国际体坛的消息。

examples.text: We're going to be meeting there on a regular basis...
examples.translation: 我们将定期在那里会面。

examples.text: The cartridge must be replaced at regular intervals.
examples.translation: 弹药必须定时更换。

examples.text: Exercise regularly...
examples.translation: 定期锻炼。

examples.text: He also writes regularly for 'International Management' magazine.
examples.translation: 他也定期给《国际管理》杂志撰稿。

examples.text: The overdraft arrangements had been generous because of the regularity of the half-yearly payments.
examples.translation: 因为是每半年定期还款，所以透支额度还算高。

examples.text: ...after a morning punctuated by regular volleys of gunfire...
examples.translation: 过了枪声阵阵的早上之后

examples.text: This condition usually clears up with regular shampooing.
examples.translation: 这种情形通常多用香波洗洗头即可消除。

examples.text: Fox, badger, weasel and stoat are regularly seen here...
examples.translation: 狐狸、獾、黄鼠狼和白鼬在这里很常见。

examples.text: Potentially dangerous bacteria are regularly sent from one laboratory to another.
examples.translation: 有潜在危险的细菌经常被从一个实验室传到另一个实验室。

examples.text: Closures and job losses are again being announced with monotonous regularity.
examples.translation: 倒闭和失业的消息又在一次次地反复宣布着。

examples.text: 'Tell me, Mr Mentakis, was Mrs Savalas one of your regular customers?'...
examples.translation: “告诉我，门塔基斯先生，萨瓦拉斯夫人是您的常客吗？”

examples.text: She has become a regular visitor to Houghton Hall.
examples.translation: 她已经成了霍顿府的常客。

examples.text: ...people who are not regular churchgoers.
examples.translation: 不常去教堂的人

examples.text: Regulars at his local pub have set up a fund to help out...
examples.translation: 经常光顾他的酒吧的人伸出援手成立了一个基金会。

examples.text: I wasn't one of their regulars.
examples.translation: 我并不是他们的正式成员。

examples.text: The man sat at his regular table near the window.
examples.translation: 这个人坐在他固定的靠窗的位置。

examples.text: ...samples from one of their regular suppliers.
examples.translation: 他们的一个固定供货商提供的样品

examples.text: ...a very regular beat...
examples.translation: 非常规律的节拍

examples.text: He stood in the doorway, listening to her quiet, regular breathing.
examples.translation: 他站在走道里，听着她那沉静而规律的呼吸声。

examples.text: Remember to breathe regularly.
examples.translation: 记住要保持呼吸均匀。

examples.text: Experimenters have succeeded in controlling the rate and regularity of the heartbeat.
examples.translation: 实验者已经成功控制了心跳的速度和频率。

examples.text: The product looks and burns like a regular cigarette...
examples.translation: 这种产品看起来和点燃后都与常见的香烟没什么两样。

examples.text: He describes himself as just a regular guy from suburban Chicago.
examples.translation: 他说自己就是一个从芝加哥郊区来的普通人。

examples.text: ...a cheeseburger and regular fries.
examples.translation: 一个奶酪汉堡和中份薯条

examples.text: ...strange small rounded sandy hillocks, that look as if they've been scattered in a regular pattern on the ground.
examples.translation: 奇怪的圆形小沙丘，看上去好像是被整齐地散放在地上似的

examples.text: ...regular rows of wooden huts.
examples.translation: 整齐的一排排小木屋

examples.text: ...some regular geometrical shape.
examples.translation: 一些对称的几何图形

examples.text: ...the chessboard regularity of their fields.
examples.translation: 他们的田地像棋盘一样方正

examples.text: Most schemes attempt to reduce the cost of defence through a smaller regular army...
examples.translation: 大多数方案都试图通过缩减常备军的规模来降低国防支出。

examples.text: Only about a third of the reinforcements will be regular troops.
examples.translation: 增援部队中仅有约1/3是常备军。

examples.text: ...the presence of a garrison of British regulars.
examples.translation: 英国正规军的进驻

meanings.meaning: 调节，规定；控制；校准；有系统的管理

examples.text: The powers of the European Commission to regulate competition are increasing...
examples.translation: 欧盟委员会对竞争的监管权越来越大。

examples.text: As we get older the temperature-regulating mechanisms in the body tend to become a little less efficient.
examples.translation: 随着年龄的增长，人体体温调节机制的功能往往会有所弱化。

examples.text: ...a planned, state-regulated economy...
examples.translation: 国家调控的计划经济

examples.text: It's a treatment that can carry risks, and in Britain it's strictly regulated.
examples.translation: 这种治疗方式可能会有危险，在英国是受到严格控制的。

examples.text: The European Union has proposed new regulations to control the hours worked by its employees...
examples.translation: 欧盟已经就其雇员工作时间的控制问题拟定了新的规章。

examples.text: Under pressure from the American government, Fiat and other manufacturers obeyed the new safety regulations.
examples.translation: 在美国政府的压力之下，菲亚特和其他汽车制造商同意遵守新的安全规定。

examples.text: ...a noisy cheerful group of people in regulation black parade tunics.
examples.translation: 身穿正统黑色游行束身服装、吵吵嚷嚷欢呼庆祝的一群人

examples.text: Social services also have responsibility for the regulation of nurseries...
examples.translation: 社会福利部门也有责任对托儿所进行管理。

examples.text: Some in the market now want government regulation in order to reduce costs.
examples.translation: 现在一些市场人士希望政府实施调控，以降低成本。

meanings.meaning: 排演；预演；练习；训练；叙述

examples.text: The band was scheduled to begin rehearsals for a concert tour...
examples.translation: 这支乐队准备开始为巡演排练。

examples.text: When 'Can-Can' was in rehearsal, Porter felt that the title song needed a musical introduction.
examples.translation: 在排练《康康舞》的时候，波特感觉主题曲需要一个前奏乐曲。

examples.text: The sketch should be a kind of rehearsal for the eventual painting...
examples.translation: 草图应该是最终绘画的某种演练。

examples.text: Daydreams may seem to be rehearsals for real-life situations.
examples.translation: 白日梦可能像是真实情景的预演。

examples.text: Confusion reigned about how the debate would end...
examples.translation: 在这一争论如何结束的问题上人们陷入了混乱。

examples.text: A relative calm reigned over the city.
examples.translation: 城市相对平静了一些。

examples.text: ...Henry II, who reigned from 1154 to 1189.
examples.translation: 1154至1189年间在位的亨利二世

examples.text: ...Queen Victoria, Britain's longest reigning monarch.
examples.translation: 维多利亚女王，英国历史上统治时间最长的君主

examples.text: ...Queen Victoria's reign.
examples.translation: 维多利亚女王的统治

examples.text: Connors reigned as the world No. 1 for 159 consecutive weeks...
examples.translation: 康纳斯连续159周排名世界第一。

examples.text: Coco Chanel reigned over fashion for half a century.
examples.translation: 可可·香奈儿在半个世纪里一直主宰着时尚界。

examples.text: ...a new book celebrating Havergal's reign as artistic director of the Citizens' Theatre.
examples.translation: 一本颂扬哈弗格尔作为艺术总监如何主宰城市剧院的新书

examples.text: The bicycle reigned supreme as Britain's most popular mode of transport...
examples.translation: 当时自行车是英国最流行的交通工具。

examples.text: Senator Sam Nunn reigns supreme over the Senate Armed Services Committee.
examples.translation: 萨姆·纳恩参议员主导着参议院军事委员会。

examples.text: The commanders accused him of carrying out a reign of terror.
examples.translation: 指挥官们谴责他实行恐怖统治。

meanings.meaning: (Rein)人名；(西、阿拉伯)雷因；(法)兰；(英、荷、捷、德、芬、瑞典)赖因；(爱沙)雷恩

examples.text: He was determined to see the party keep a hold on the reins of power...
examples.translation: 他决意要确保这个政党掌握政权。

examples.text: The government continued to believe it should give free rein to the private sector in transport.
examples.translation: 政府仍然认为应该给予交通领域的私营企业以经营自由。

examples.text: Her parents had kept her on a tight rein with their narrow and inflexible views.
examples.translation: 她的父母观念狭隘而僵化，对她管束很严。

meanings.meaning: 求援；得到增援；给予更多的支持

examples.text: A stronger European Parliament would, they fear, only reinforce the power of the larger countries...
examples.translation: 他们担心一个更加强大的欧洲议会只会增强大国的力量。

examples.text: This sense of privilege tends to be reinforced by the outside world.
examples.translation: 这种优越感往往会被外部世界强化。

examples.text: ...films that reinforce the idea that we live in a threatening and risky world.
examples.translation: 让我们更加意识到自己生活的世界充满威胁和危险的电影

examples.text: Eventually, they had to reinforce the walls with exterior beams.
examples.translation: 最终，他们不得不通过增加外梁来对墙体进行加固。

examples.text: Its windows were of reinforced glass.
examples.translation: 它的窗户装的是强化玻璃。

examples.text: Both sides have been reinforcing their positions after yesterday's fierce fighting...
examples.translation: 双方经过昨天的激战后都在向各自的阵地增派兵力。

examples.text: Troops and police have been reinforced in the southern Pakistan city of Hyderabad.
examples.translation: 巴基斯坦南部的海得拉巴市已增派了军队和警力。

examples.text: The British government is expected to reject the idea of state subsidy for a new high speed railway...
examples.translation: 预计英国政府不会考虑为修建一条新的高速铁路提供国家补贴的设想。

examples.text: Seventeen publishers rejected the manuscript before Jenks saw its potential.
examples.translation: 17家出版社回绝了这部手稿，直到詹克斯看到了它的潜在价值。

examples.text: The rejection of such initiatives indicates that voters are unconcerned about the environment.
examples.translation: 此类倡议遇冷表明选民对环境并不关心。

examples.text: ...the children of Eastern European immigrants who had rejected their parents' political and religious beliefs.
examples.translation: 抛弃了父母一代政治和宗教信仰的东欧移民子女

examples.text: ...his rejection of our values.
examples.translation: 他对我们的价值观的摒弃

examples.text: One of my most able students was rejected by another university.
examples.translation: 我的一个最有能力的学生申请另一所大学落选了。

examples.text: Be prepared for lots of rejections before you land a job.
examples.translation: 在找到一份工作之前，要做好屡次碰壁的准备。

examples.text: You make friends with people and then make unreasonable demands so that they reject you.
examples.translation: 你和别人交朋友，然后向人家提出无理要求，结果被人家拒绝。

examples.text: ...people who had been rejected by their lovers.
examples.translation: 被爱人拒绝的人

examples.text: These feelings of rejection and hurt remain.
examples.translation: 被拒绝和受伤的感觉还在。

examples.text: It was feared his body was rejecting a kidney he received in a transplant four years ago.
examples.translation: 令人担心的是，他的身体可能对4年前移植的肾产生了排斥反应。

examples.text: ...a special drug which stops rejection of transplanted organs.
examples.translation: 一种可以阻止身体对移植器官产生排异反应的特殊药物

examples.text: Garbo plays the Queen, rejoicing in the love she has found with Antonio...
examples.translation: 嘉宝饰演王后，陶醉于和安东尼奥的热恋中。

examples.text: A Foreign Ministry statement said that the French government rejoiced at the happy outcome to events...
examples.translation: 外交部的声明称法国政府很高兴看到事件得到圆满解决。

examples.text: Party activists in New Hampshire rejoiced that the presidential campaign had finally started.
examples.translation: 新罕布什尔州党派激进分子对于总统选举终于启动感到欣喜若狂。

examples.text: There was general rejoicing at the news.
examples.translation: 听到这一消息大家普遍感到高兴。

examples.text: ...their tortoise, who rejoiced in the name of Carruthers.
examples.translation: 他们养的龟有个搞笑的名字——卡拉瑟斯

meanings.meaning: 涉及；认同；符合；与…有某种联系

examples.text: Other recommendations relate to the details of how such data is stored...
examples.translation: 其他建议涉及此类信息储存方面的一些细节。

examples.text: It does not matter whether the problem you have relates to food, drink, smoking or just living...
examples.translation: 不管你的问题是由食物、饮料、吸烟引起，或仅仅是生活引起，都无关紧要。

examples.text: I had papers relating to the children which my wife and I had to sign.
examples.translation: 我有一些关于孩子的文件需要我和妻子签字。

examples.text: More studies will be required before we know what the functions of these genes are and whether they relate to each other...
examples.translation: 要弄清这些基因的功能以及它们彼此之间是否关联，我们还需要开展更多的研究。

examples.text: Cornell University offers a course that investigates how language relates to particular cultural codes...
examples.translation: 康奈尔大学开设了一门研究语言与特定文化符号之间如何关联的课程。

examples.text: Many Christians today feel the need to relate their experience to that of the Hindu, the Buddhist and the Muslim.
examples.translation: 如今，许多基督徒感到有必要把自身的体验与印度教徒、佛教徒和伊斯兰教徒的体验相联系。

examples.text: ...a paper called 'Language and Freedom' in which Chomsky tries to relate his linguistic and political views...
examples.translation: 一篇题为“语言和自由”的论文，文中乔姆斯基试图把他的语言学观点和政治观点联系起来

examples.text: At the end, we have a sense of names, dates, and events but no sense of how they relate.
examples.translation: 最后，我们对名字、日期和事件有了些认识，但并不清楚它们之间的关联。

examples.text: He is unable to relate to other people...
examples.translation: 他无法理解他人的想法。

examples.text: I think it is important for children to have brothers and sisters they can relate to...
examples.translation: 我认为对孩子们来讲有可以相互理解沟通的兄弟姐妹很重要。

examples.text: When people are cut off from contact with others, they lose all ability to relate.
examples.translation: 一个人与其他人隔绝后，会失去全部的沟通能力。

examples.text: There were officials to whom he could relate the whole story...
examples.translation: 有一些官员会听他讲述整个故事。

examples.text: She related her tale of living rough.
examples.translation: 她讲述了自己艰苦谋生的故事。

meanings.meaning: 关系；叙述；故事；亲属关系

examples.text: Greece has established full diplomatic relations with Israel...
examples.translation: 希腊已经和以色列建立了全面的外交关系。

examples.text: Apparently relations between husband and wife had not improved...
examples.translation: 很明显夫妇之间的关系没有改善。

examples.text: The company has a track record of good employee relations.
examples.translation: 公司有员工关系良好的记录。

examples.text: It is a question of the relation of ethics to economics.
examples.translation: 这是一个伦理学和经济学的关系问题。

examples.text: ...a relation between youthful unemployment and drug-related offences...
examples.translation: 年轻人失业与毒品相关犯罪之间的关联

examples.text: This theory bears no relation to reality.
examples.translation: 这个理论和现实没什么联系。

examples.text: ...visits to friends and relations...
examples.translation: 拜访亲友

examples.text: In America they are touting Hugh Grant as the next Cary Grant (no relation).
examples.translation: 在美国，他们把休·格兰特吹捧为第二个加里·格兰特(两人并无亲属关系)。

examples.text: The money he'd been ordered to pay was minimal in relation to his salary.
examples.translation: 他被要求支付的金额与他的薪水相比微不足道。

examples.text: ...women's position in relation to men in the context of the family...
examples.translation: 在家庭范围内女人相对于男人的位置

examples.text: You are given a map so that you can see where your villa is in relation to the swimming pool.
examples.translation: 你会拿到一张地图，这样你就能了解自己的别墅与游泳池的相对位置。

examples.text: ...a question which has been asked many times in relation to Irish affairs...
examples.translation: 被问过多次的关于爱尔兰事务的问题

examples.text: He is the sixth person to be arrested in relation to the coup plot.
examples.translation: 他是政变阴谋牵涉到的第6个被捕的人。

examples.text: ...the friendly relationship between France and Britain...
examples.translation: 法国和英国之间的友好关系

examples.text: ...family relationships.
examples.translation: 家庭关系

examples.text: We had been together for two years, but both of us felt the relationship wasn't really going anywhere.
examples.translation: 我们在一起已经两年了，但我们双方都觉得这段感情不会有什么结果。

examples.text: There is a relationship between diet and cancer.
examples.translation: 饮食结构和癌症之间有一定关联。

examples.text: ...an analysis of market mechanisms and their relationship to state capitalism and political freedom.
examples.translation: 对于市场机制及其与国家资本主义和政治自由之间关系的分析

meanings.meaning: 相对的；有关系的；成比例的
亲戚；相关物；[语] 关系词；亲缘植物

examples.text: Do relatives of yours still live in Siberia?...
examples.translation: 你的亲属仍然住在西伯利亚吗？

examples.text: Get a relative to look after the children.
examples.translation: 找一个亲戚来照看孩子。

examples.text: The fighting resumed after a period of relative calm...
examples.translation: 战斗在相对平静的一段时间之后再次打响。

examples.text: It is a cancer that can be cured with relative ease...
examples.translation: 这是一种相对来说比较容易治疗的癌症。

examples.text: Pedestrian zones mean that children can play in relative safety.
examples.translation: 步行区域意味着孩子们可以在那里相对安全地玩耍。

examples.text: They chatted about the relative merits of London and Paris as places to live...
examples.translation: 他们聊起了伦敦和巴黎两座城市相比较都有哪些宜居的优点。

examples.text: I reflected on the relative importance of education in 50 countries.
examples.translation: 我思考了50个国家相对而言对教育的重视程度。

examples.text: ...the relative strength of the central and state governments.
examples.translation: 中央政府和州政府的相对力量

examples.text: Japanese interest rates rose relative to America's...
examples.translation: 日本利率随美国利率上浮。

examples.text: House prices now look cheap relative to earnings...
examples.translation: 相对收入而言房价现在看起来比较便宜。

examples.text: The satellite remains in one spot relative to the earth's surface.
examples.translation: 相对地球表面而言，这颗卫星位置固定。

examples.text: Fitness is relative; one must always ask 'Fit for what?'...
examples.translation: “适合”是相对而言的;应该常常问一问“适合什么？”

examples.text: Truth is relative.
examples.translation: 真理是相对的。

examples.text: The pheasant is a close relative of the Guinea hen.
examples.translation: 雉与珍珠鸡有很近的亲缘关系。

examples.text: Relativity was not even mentioned, although this was the focus of his belated acceptance speech.

meanings.meaning: 放松，休息；松懈，松弛；变从容；休养
放松；使休息；使松弛；缓和；使松懈

examples.text: I ought to relax and stop worrying about it...
examples.translation: 我应该放松一下，不要再担心它了。

examples.text: For the first time since his arrival he relaxed slightly...
examples.translation: 自从他来了之后这是他第一次稍微放松一点儿。

examples.text: Do something that you know relaxes you.
examples.translation: 做点儿让你自己放松的事情。

examples.text: Massage is used to relax muscles, relieve stress and improve the circulation...
examples.translation: 按摩可以使肌肉放松，缓解压力和促进血液循环。

examples.text: His face relaxes into a contented smile.
examples.translation: 他面部肌肉放松下来，露出了满意的微笑。

examples.text: He gradually relaxed his grip on the arms of the chair.
examples.translation: 他紧握椅子扶手的手逐渐松开了。

examples.text: Rules governing student conduct relaxed somewhat in recent years...
examples.translation: 近年来约束学生行为的规定有所放宽。

examples.text: How much can the President relax his grip over the nation?...
examples.translation: 总统可以对国家的控制放松到什么样的程度？

examples.text: Some analysts believe that the government soon will begin relaxing economic controls.
examples.translation: 一些分析人士认为政府不久将开始放松经济管制。

meanings.meaning: [电] 继电器；接替，接替人员；驿马

examples.text: Britain's prospects of beating the United States in the relay looked poor.
examples.translation: 英国要在接力赛中战胜美国，前景看上去并不那么乐观。

examples.text: The satellite will be used mainly to relay television programmes...
examples.translation: 这颗人造卫星主要用途是转播电视节目。

examples.text: This system continuously monitors levels of radiation and relays the information to a central computer...
examples.translation: 这个系统不间断地监控辐射水平，并将信息传送到中央计算机。

examples.text: The event will be relayed to a giant TV screen a mile away.
examples.translation: 这项赛事将会在一英里以外的一个巨大的电视屏幕上转播。

examples.text: More than a thousand people outside listened to a relay of the proceedings.
examples.translation: 外面有一千多人收听了整个进程的转播。

examples.text: ...a security system with satellite relays.
examples.translation: 带有卫星传输设备的保安系统

examples.text: ...a television relay station.
examples.translation: 电视转播站

examples.text: She relayed the message, then frowned...
examples.translation: 她把消息带到了，然后皱紧了眉头。

examples.text: The decision will be relayed to Iraq's ambassador at the UN.
examples.translation: 这个决定将会被传达给伊拉克驻联合国大使。

meanings.meaning: 释放；发射；让与；允许发表

examples.text: He was released from custody the next day...
examples.translation: 第二天他被从拘留所里放了出来。

examples.text: He is expected to be released from hospital today...
examples.translation: 他有望今天出院。

examples.text: Fifty-five foxes were released from a fur farm by animal rights activists...
examples.translation: 动物权利保护主义者把55只狐狸从毛皮动物饲养场放了出来。

examples.text: He was released on bail.
examples.translation: 他被保释出来了。

examples.text: He called for the immediate release of all political prisoners.
examples.translation: 他要求立即释放所有政治犯。

examples.text: ...the secret negotiations necessary to secure hostage releases...
examples.translation: 为确保人质释放而要进行的秘密谈判

examples.text: Serious complications have delayed his release from hospital.
examples.translation: 各种严重的并发症延迟了他的出院。

examples.text: Divorce releases both the husband and wife from all marital obligations to each other...
examples.translation: 离婚解除了夫妻双方相互之间所有的婚姻义务。

examples.text: This releases the teacher to work with individuals who are having extreme difficulty.
examples.translation: 这使得教师可以专门辅导学习特别吃力的学生。

examples.text: ...release from stored tensions, traumas and grief...
examples.translation: 使久积的紧张情绪、精神创伤和忧伤得以缓解

examples.text: They look on life at college as a blessed release from the obligation to work.
examples.translation: 他们把大学生活看成是一种愉快的解脱，可以不用承担工作的义务。

examples.text: Becoming your own person releases your creativity...
examples.translation: 保持自己的本色才有助于发挥自身创造力。

examples.text: I personally don't want to release my anger on anyone else...
examples.translation: 我个人并不想把自己的愤怒发泄在别人身上。

examples.text: Humour is wonderful for releasing tension.
examples.translation: 幽默是舒缓紧张情绪的良方。

examples.text: She felt the sudden sweet release of her own tears.
examples.translation: 她感到自己甜蜜的泪水一下子涌了出来。

examples.text: They're not releasing any more details yet...
examples.translation: 他们还未公布更多细节。

examples.text: Figures released yesterday show retail sales were down in March.
examples.translation: 昨天公布的数据显示零售额在3月份有所下滑。

examples.text: Action had been taken to speed up the release of cheques.
examples.translation: 已经采取行动加速支票的发放。

examples.text: He stopped and faced her, releasing her wrist.
examples.translation: 他停下来面对着她，放开了她的手腕。

examples.text: ...the twisting action before a bowler releases the ball.
examples.translation: 投球手掷球前的屈身动作

examples.text: Wade released the hand brake and pulled away from the curb.
examples.translation: 韦德松开手刹驶离路边。

examples.text: ...a weapon which releases toxic nerve gas...
examples.translation: 释放神经毒气的武器

examples.text: The contraction of muscles uses energy and releases heat...
examples.translation: 肌肉的收缩消耗能量并且释放热量。

examples.text: The drug is surgically implanted into a woman's arm where it gradually releases the hormones into the body.
examples.translation: 这种药物被通过手术的方式植入一位女子的手臂，它会逐渐向人体释放荷尔蒙。

examples.text: Under the agreement, releases of cancer-causing chemicals will be cut by about 80 per cent.
examples.translation: 根据协议，致癌化学物的排放量将减少约80％。

examples.text: He is releasing an album of love songs.
examples.translation: 他即将推出一张情歌专辑。

examples.text: Which of the new releases do you think are really good?
examples.translation: 在这些新片中你觉得哪些真的不错？

examples.text: The video has sold three million copies in its first three weeks on release.
examples.translation: 影碟推出的前3周就卖出了300万张。

meanings.meaning: 相关的；切题的；中肯的；有重大关系的；有意义的，目的明确的

examples.text: We are trying to make politics more relevant to younger people.
examples.translation: 我们试图使政治活动更加贴近年轻人。

examples.text: We have passed all relevant information on to the police.
examples.translation: 我们已经把所有相关信息都告知了警方。

examples.text: Make sure you enclose all the relevant certificates.
examples.translation: 要保证把所有相关证书都放在里面。

examples.text: She was efficient and reliable...
examples.translation: 她办事很有效率，也很可靠。

examples.text: Japanese cars are so reliable.
examples.translation: 日本产的汽车质量非常可靠。

examples.text: It's been working reliably for years.
examples.translation: 它多年来运转一直很稳定。

examples.text: He's not at all worried about his car's reliability.
examples.translation: 对于自己那台车性能的稳定性他根本不担心。

examples.text: There is no reliable information about civilian casualties...
examples.translation: 关于平民的伤亡还没有确凿的信息。

examples.text: It's very difficult to give a reliable estimate...
examples.translation: 要给出可靠的估计非常困难。

examples.text: We have reliable sources.
examples.translation: 我们有可靠的消息来源。

examples.text: Sonia, we are reliably informed, loves her family very much.
examples.translation: 我们从可靠的消息来源获知索尼娅非常爱自己的家人。

examples.text: Both questioned the reliability of recent opinion polls.
examples.translation: 双方都质疑最近民意测验的可信度。

meanings.meaning: 信赖；信心；受信赖的人或物

examples.text: ...the country's increasing reliance on foreign aid.
examples.translation: 这个国家日益依赖外国援助

meanings.meaning: 救济；减轻，解除；安慰；浮雕

examples.text: I breathed a sigh of relief...
examples.translation: 我如释重负地松了口气。

examples.text: The news will come as a great relief to the French authorities...
examples.translation: 这个消息会让法国当局大大松一口气。

examples.text: To his relief a loud knock on the door spared him from giving an explanation...
examples.translation: 一声重重的敲门声让他松了一口气，他可以不用解释了。

examples.text: It's a relief to get out of the office once in a while.
examples.translation: 偶尔走出办公室去透透气也是一种调剂。

examples.text: This brought considerable relief from the pain.
examples.translation: 这相当大地缓解了疼痛。

examples.text: ...a self-help programme which can give lasting relief from the torment of hay fever.
examples.translation: 可以持续缓解枯草热病痛的自助项目

examples.text: Relief agencies are stepping up efforts to provide food, shelter and agricultural equipment.
examples.translation: 救济机构正加大力度提供食物、住所和农用器械。

examples.text: ...famine relief.
examples.translation: 饥荒救济

examples.text: No relief drivers were available.
examples.translation: 找不到代班司机。

meanings.meaning: 解除，减轻；使不单调乏味；换…的班；解围；使放心

examples.text: Drugs can relieve much of the pain...
examples.translation: 药物能够大大地缓解病痛。

examples.text: This should save her from boredom and will also relieve the pressure on you to keep her entertained.
examples.translation: 这能使她不会感到厌倦，而且也会减轻你的压力，不必总想着逗她开心。

examples.text: A part-time bookkeeper will relieve you of the burden of chasing unpaid invoices and paying bills.
examples.translation: 雇一个兼职会计将使你摆脱追讨未付单据和支付账单的负担。

examples.text: A porter relieved her of the three large cases.
examples.translation: 一个行李搬运工替她扛了3个大包。

examples.text: At seven o'clock the night nurse came in to relieve her.
examples.translation: 7点钟的时候夜班护士来接她的班。

examples.text: The officer involved was relieved of his duties because he had violated strict guidelines...
examples.translation: 那名相关的官员被免除了职务，因为他违反了要求严格的规章制度。

examples.text: The party leader has been relieved of his post.
examples.translation: 这个党的领导人被免除了职务。

examples.text: The offensive began several days ago as an attempt to relieve the town.
examples.translation: 进攻于几天前开始，试图解放这个城镇。

examples.text: It is not difficult to train your dog to relieve itself on command.
examples.translation: 训练你的狗按指令大小便并非难事。

examples.text: ...his understanding of Indian philosophy and religion...
examples.translation: 他对印度哲学和宗教信仰的理解

examples.text: Do avoid potentially contentious subjects such as religion, sex or politics.
examples.translation: 一定要避免可能引起争议的话题，如宗教、性和政治。

examples.text: ...the Christian religion.
examples.translation: 基督教

examples.text: This guy got religion about a year back.
examples.translation: 这家伙一年前信了教。

meanings.meaning: 宗教的；虔诚的；严谨的；修道的

examples.text: ...religious groups.
examples.translation: 宗教团体

examples.text: ...different religious beliefs.
examples.translation: 不同的宗教信仰

examples.text: India has always been one of the most religiously diverse countries.
examples.translation: 印度一直都是宗教信仰最多元的国家之一。

examples.text: They are both very religious and felt it was a gift from God.
examples.translation: 他们俩都很虔诚，感觉这是上帝的恩赐。

meanings.meaning: 滋味；风味；食欲；开胃小菜；含义；调味品
盼望;期待;享受; 品味；喜爱；给…加佐料

examples.text: I relish the challenge of doing jobs that others turn down...
examples.translation: 我喜欢挑战别人拒绝做的工作。

examples.text: He ate quietly, relishing his meal.
examples.translation: 他安静地吃着，细细品味着食物。

examples.text: The three men ate with relish.
examples.translation: 这3个人吃得津津有味。

examples.text: Jacqueline is not relishing the prospect of another spell in prison...
examples.translation: 杰奎琳可不想再蹲一阵子监狱。

examples.text: He relished the idea of getting some cash.
examples.translation: 他盼望得到一些现金。

meanings.meaning: 不情愿的；勉强的；顽抗的

examples.text: Mr Spero was reluctant to ask for help...
examples.translation: 斯佩罗先生不愿意寻求帮助。

examples.text: The police are very reluctant to get involved in this sort of thing.
examples.translation: 警方很不愿意卷入这类事情。

examples.text: We have reluctantly agreed to let him go.
examples.translation: 我们不情愿地同意放他走。

examples.text: Ministers have shown extreme reluctance to explain their position to the media.
examples.translation: 部长们极不情愿向媒体解释他们的立场。

examples.text: They relied heavily on the advice of their professional advisers...
examples.translation: 他们非常依赖职业咨询师提供的建议。

examples.text: The Association relies on member subscriptions for most of its income.
examples.translation: 这个协会的收入大部分来自会员的入会费。

examples.text: I know I can rely on you to sort it out...
examples.translation: 我相信你会把它解决好的。

examples.text: The Red Cross are relying on us.
examples.translation: 红十字会信赖我们。

meanings.meaning: 保持；依然；留下；剩余；逗留；残存

examples.text: The three men remained silent...
examples.translation: 这3个人保持着沉默。

examples.text: The situation remains tense...
examples.translation: 形势持续紧张。

examples.text: The government remained in control...
examples.translation: 政府仍控制着局势。

examples.text: He remained a formidable opponent...
examples.translation: 他依然是一个令人敬畏的对手。

examples.text: It remains possible that bad weather could tear more holes in the tanker's hull.
examples.translation: 恶劣天气仍然可能使油轮船体遭受更多破损。

examples.text: He will have to remain in hospital for at least 10 days...
examples.translation: 他至少得在医院里呆10天。

examples.text: From time to time, James remained at home with his family.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯偶尔留在家里陪家人。

examples.text: Many of the differences in everyday life remain...
examples.translation: 日常生活中的许多差异仍然存在。

examples.text: The wider problem remains...
examples.translation: 更普遍的问题仍未解决。

examples.text: There remains deep mistrust of his government.
examples.translation: 仍然有人对他领导的政府很不信任。

examples.text: Major questions remain to be answered about his work...
examples.translation: 关于他工作的许多重要问题仍然悬而未决。

examples.text: Huge amounts of weapons remain to be collected.
examples.translation: 大量的武器仍有待收缴。

examples.text: They were tidying up the remains of their picnic.
examples.translation: 他们正在收拾野餐后剩下的东西。

examples.text: ...the charred remains of a tank.
examples.translation: 烧焦的坦克残骸

examples.text: ...the remains of an ancient mosque.
examples.translation: 一座古清真寺的遗迹

examples.text: The unrecognizable remains of a man had been found...
examples.translation: 一具无法辨认的男性尸体被发现了。

examples.text: More human remains have been unearthed in the north of the country.
examples.translation: 在该国北部挖出了更多的人类遗骨。

examples.text: There are Roman remains all around us.
examples.translation: 我们周围都是古罗马的遗迹。

examples.text: The fact remains that inflation is unacceptably high...
examples.translation: 事实是通货膨胀率仍高得离谱。

examples.text: The question remains whether he was fully aware of the claims.
examples.translation: 问题是他是否完全意识到了这些要求。

examples.text: It remains to be seen whether her parliamentary colleagues will agree.
examples.translation: 她的国会同僚是否同意，现在还无从知晓。

meanings.meaning: [数] 余数，残余；剩余物；其余的人

examples.text: He gulped down the remainder of his coffee...
examples.translation: 他把剩下的咖啡一口气喝了下去。

examples.text: I spent the remainder of the day feeling terrible.
examples.translation: 我那天余下的时间里心情都很糟糕。

examples.text: Only 5.9 per cent of the area is now covered in trees. Most of the remainder is farmland...
examples.translation: 这个地区的树木覆盖率只有5.9%。其他多数地方都是农田。

examples.text: Of the 59 committee members, 40 were against legalisation, 13 were in favour and the remainder were undecided.
examples.translation: 在59个委员会委员中，有40人反对这项法案，13人赞成，其余的尚未表明态度。

examples.text: It failed to sell and was soon remaindered.
examples.translation: 此书销量不好，很快就被廉价处理了。

examples.text: Still, Mahathir remains on precarious ground and his toughest battles may well lie ahead.
I remarked that I would go shopping that afternoon...
examples.translation: 我说过我那天下午要去购物。

examples.text: 'Some people have more money than sense,' Winston had remarked...
examples.translation: “某些人钱多但无头脑，”温斯顿曾经评论道。

examples.text: On several occasions she had remarked on the boy's improvement...
examples.translation: 她好几次提及这个男孩的进步。

examples.text: Everyone has remarked on what a lovely lady she is.
examples.translation: 每个人都说她是个可爱的女士。

examples.text: She has made outspoken remarks about the legalisation of cannabis in Britain...
examples.translation: 她对英国关于大麻的立法进行了大胆评论。

examples.text: Geoff Cooke's recent remark that no one is indispensable will certainly not have escaped him.
examples.translation: 杰夫·库克近来关于没有什么人是不可缺少的那番话当然也包括他。

meanings.meaning: 卓越的；非凡的；值得注意的

examples.text: He was a remarkable man...
examples.translation: 他是个不同寻常的人。

examples.text: It was a remarkable achievement...
examples.translation: 那是一项非凡的成就。

examples.text: It is quite remarkable that doctors have been so wrong about this.
examples.translation: 医生们对此有过如此错误的认识真是很不寻常。

examples.text: The Scottish labour market has been remarkably successful in absorbing the increase in the number of graduates...
examples.translation: 苏格兰的劳动力市场在吸纳新增毕业生就业方面异常成功。

examples.text: Remarkably, the child recovered from a disease which had swept the world, killing and crippling millions.
examples.translation: 令人意想不到的是，这个孩子从病中康复了，而这种病症曾经席卷整个世界，使数以百万计的人丧生或残疾。

examples.text: The remedy lies in the hands of the government.
examples.translation: 解决良策掌握在政府手中。

examples.text: ...a remedy for economic ills.
examples.translation: 解决经济问题的良方妙策

examples.text: ...natural remedies to help overcome winter infections.
examples.translation: 有助于治疗冬季传染病的自然疗法

examples.text: A great deal has been done internally to remedy the situation.
examples.translation: 已经做了很多内部工作对这种情形进行补救。

examples.text: You wouldn't remember me. I was in another group...
examples.translation: 你不会记得我。我那时在另外一组。

examples.text: I certainly don't remember talking to you at all...
examples.translation: 我当然完全不记得和你讲过话。

examples.text: I remember her being a dominant figure...
examples.translation: 我记得她是一个举足轻重的人物。

examples.text: I remembered that we had drunk the last of the coffee the week before...
examples.translation: 我记得我们在一个星期前就把最后的那点儿咖啡喝完了。

examples.text: I can remember where and when I bought each one...
examples.translation: 我记得每一件东西是在何地何时买的。

examples.text: I used to do that when you were a little girl, remember?
examples.translation: 在你还是小女孩的时候我曾经那么做过，记得吗？

examples.text: She remembered that she was going to the social club that evening...
examples.translation: 她记起来那晚她正要去社交俱乐部。

examples.text: Then I remembered the cheque, which cheered me up.
examples.translation: 然后我想起了那张支票，这让我精神大振。

examples.text: If you can't remember your number, write it in code in a diary...
examples.translation: 如果你记不住你的号码，用代码把它记在记事本上。

examples.text: I couldn't remember ever having felt so safe and secure...
examples.translation: 我从未有过如此安全的感觉。

examples.text: I don't remember you asking me about that...
examples.translation: 我不记得你问过我那件事情。

examples.text: I can't remember what I said...
examples.translation: 我记不起来自己说了什么。

examples.text: Don't tell me you can't remember.
examples.translation: 不要告诉我你记不起来了。

examples.text: I did remember to take the present...
examples.translation: 我的确记得拿了礼物。

examples.text: Please remember to enclose a stamped addressed envelope when writing.
examples.translation: 请记得写信时在信封里放一个贴好邮票、写明地址的信封。

examples.text: It is important to remember that each person reacts differently...
examples.translation: 重要的是要记住每个人的反应不同。

examples.text: It is worth remembering that children tend to copy their parents in this respect...
examples.translation: 值得记住的是孩子们在这一方面往往会效仿父母。

examples.text: It should be remembered that this loss of control can never be regained.
examples.translation: 要记住这种失控可能永远无法恢复。

examples.text: At his grammar school he is remembered for being bad at games...
examples.translation: 在文法学校他因不善于玩游戏为大家所熟知。

examples.text: He will always be remembered as one of the great Chancellors of the Exchequer.
examples.translation: 作为最伟大的财政大臣之一他将永远被铭记。

examples.text: 'Remember me to Lyle, won't you?' I said...
examples.translation: “代我问候莱尔，好吗？”我说。

examples.text: She asked to be remembered to you.
examples.translation: 她要我转达对你的问候。

examples.text: We'll give everyone a night to remember...
examples.translation: 我们将带给大家一个难忘的夜晚。

examples.text: I'll make it a birthday to remember.
examples.translation: 我将使这成为一个难忘的生日。

examples.text: So she simply welcomed him and reminded him of the last time they had met...
examples.translation: 于是她只是对他表示欢迎，并且提醒说他们上次见过面。

examples.text: I had to remind myself that being confident is not the same as being perfect!
examples.translation: 我得提醒自己表现得自信和表现得完美并不是一回事！

examples.text: 'Let me remind you,' said Marianne, 'that Manchester is also my home town.'...
examples.translation: “让我来提醒你，”玛丽安娜说，“曼彻斯特也是我的家乡。”

examples.text: May I remind you that the care of your health is a religious duty...
examples.translation: 我可以提醒你呵护自己的健康是一项宗教责任吗？

examples.text: Need I remind you who the enemy is?
examples.translation: 还需要我来提醒你敌人是谁吗？

examples.text: Can you remind me to buy a bottle of Martini?...
examples.translation: 你能提醒我买一瓶马提尼酒吗？

examples.text: The note was to remind him about something he had to explain to one of his students.
examples.translation: 这张字条是要提醒他得向他的一个学生解释某件事情。

examples.text: She reminds me of the wife of the pilot who used to work for you...
examples.translation: 她让我想到过去为你工作的飞行员的妻子。

examples.text: This reminds me of Christmas parties.
examples.translation: 这让我想起圣诞聚会。

examples.text: After twenty-four hours of fighting, the remnants of the force were fleeing...
examples.translation: 战斗持续了24个小时后，该部队残部打算溜掉。

examples.text: Beneath the present church were remnants of Roman flooring...
examples.translation: 在现在的教堂下面是古罗马时期地面的遗存。

examples.text: Obedience by women towards men is a remnant of religious teaching.
examples.translation: 女人对男人的顺从是宗教教义的残迹。

examples.text: Landslides have cut off many villages in remote areas.
examples.translation: 滑坡使边远地区的许多村庄与外界隔绝。

examples.text: ...a remote farm in the Yorkshire dales.
examples.translation: 位于约克郡山谷的一个偏僻的农场

examples.text: ...the remoteness of the island.
examples.translation: 岛屿的偏远

examples.text: Slabs of rock had slipped sideways in the remote past, and formed this hole.
examples.translation: 在久远的过去，岩石板滑落到周边，从而形成了这个洞。

examples.text: This government depends on the wishes of a few who are remote from the people...
examples.translation: 这个政府按照远离民众的少数人的意愿行事。

examples.text: Teenagers are forced to study subjects that seem remote from their daily lives.
examples.translation: 青少年被迫学习和他们的日常生活关系不大的学科。

examples.text: ...the remoteness of the officers from their men.
examples.translation: 军官与其部下之间关系的疏远

examples.text: I use a sunscreen whenever there is even a remote possibility that I will be in the sun...
examples.translation: 不论何时只要有一点可能暴露在阳光下，我就会用防晒霜。

examples.text: The chances of his surviving are pretty remote.
examples.translation: 他生还的机会非常渺茫。

examples.text: She looked so beautiful, and at the same time so remote.
examples.translation: 她相貌如此美丽，同时又如此清高不群。

examples.text: His remoteness was resented.
examples.translation: 他的冷漠让人厌恶。

examples.text: What they expected to be the removal of a small lump turned out to be major surgery...
examples.translation: 他们原以为只需切除小肿块的手术最后变成了一次大手术。

examples.text: Parliament had decided that his removal from power was illegal.
examples.translation: 国会决议认为他的免职是非法的。

examples.text: ...popular methods of hair removal.
examples.translation: 去除毛发的大众方法

examples.text: Home removals are best done in cool weather...
examples.translation: 最好在天气凉爽时搬家。

examples.text: They were in the furniture removal business.
examples.translation: 他们做家具搬运生意。

examples.text: ...a removal van.
examples.translation: 搬家卡车

examples.text: As soon as the cake is done, remove it from the oven...
examples.translation: 蛋糕一烤好，立即把它从烤箱中取出。

examples.text: At least three bullets were removed from his wounds...
examples.translation: 从他的伤口至少取出了3颗子弹。

examples.text: Often, the simplest answer is just to remove yourself from the situation...
examples.translation: 通常情况下，最简单的办法就是让你自己脱离那个环境。

examples.text: He went to the refrigerator and removed a bottle of wine.
examples.translation: 他走到冰箱处拿出一瓶酒。

examples.text: He removed his jacket.
examples.translation: 他脱下了夹克。

examples.text: This treatment removes the most stubborn stains...
examples.translation: 这种处理方式会清除最顽固的污渍。

examples.text: Try using lemon juice to remove tobacco stains from your fingers.
examples.translation: 试试用柠檬汁去除手指上的烟渍。

examples.text: The student senate voted to remove Fuller from office...
examples.translation: 学生评议会投票免除了富勒的职位。

examples.text: The president could only be removed from power once free elections were organised...
examples.translation: 总统只有在开始自由选举时才能被免职。

examples.text: All senior officers involved in the coup will have to be removed.
examples.translation: 所有参与政变的高级官员都将被免职。

examples.text: The agreement removes the last serious obstacle to the signing of the arms treaty...
examples.translation: 这个协议排除了签订武器条约的最后一个严重障碍。

examples.text: Most of her fears had been removed.
examples.translation: 她的恐惧基本上消除了。

examples.text: She enjoyed his company and the excitement of feeling herself linked at one remove to London society...
examples.translation: 她喜欢他的陪伴，也很享受离伦敦社交圈仅仅一步之遥的兴奋感觉。

examples.text: She can know the world only at several removes.
examples.translation: 她只能间接地认知这个世界。

examples.text: ...the Renaissance masterpieces in London's galleries...
examples.translation: 伦敦美术馆里文艺复兴时期的杰作

examples.text: Science took a new and different turn in the Renaissance.
examples.translation: 科学在文艺复兴时期发生了新的转变。

examples.text: Popular art is experiencing a renaissance...
examples.translation: 通俗艺术正在复兴。

examples.text: They gathered to protest against the renaissance of the extreme right.
examples.translation: 他们聚集起来抗议极右势力的复活。

meanings.meaning: 致使；提出；实施；着色；以…回报

examples.text: It contained so many errors as to render it worthless.
examples.translation: 它错误太多,所以毫无用处。

examples.text: ...barrel-makers whose trade was rendered obsolete by the introduction of stainless steel wine vats.
examples.translation: 不锈钢葡萄酒桶的出现使木制酒桶制造者没了生意

examples.text: He had a chance to render some service to his country...
examples.translation: 他有了一个为国服务的机会。

examples.text: Any assistance you can render him will be appreciated...
examples.translation: 无论给予他何种帮助，他都会非常感激。

examples.text: The money was in fact payment by the CIA for services rendered.
examples.translation: 这些钱其实是中央情报局付给的工作报酬。

examples.text: The Board had been slow to render its verdict.
examples.translation: 董事会迟迟未能作出决定。

examples.text: ...'Zensho shimasu,' which the translator rendered literally as, 'I will do my best.'...
examples.translation: “Zensho shimasu,”译者直译为“我会尽全力”。

examples.text: All the signs and announcements were rendered in English and Spanish.
examples.translation: 所有的指示标志和公告都被译成了英语和西班牙语。

examples.text: He renewed his attack on government policy towards Europe...
examples.translation: 他重新开始对政府的欧洲政策进行抨击。

examples.text: He believes the peace talks will be renewed soon...
examples.translation: 他相信和平谈判不久将会重新开始。

examples.text: There was renewed fighting yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天战斗重新打响了。

examples.text: When the two men met again after the war they renewed their friendship...
examples.translation: 两个人在战争结束后再次见面时重归于好。

examples.text: In December 1989 Syria renewed diplomatic relations with Egypt.
examples.translation: 1989年12月,叙利亚和埃及重新建立了外交关系。

examples.text: Larry's landlord threatened not to renew his lease...
examples.translation: 拉里的房东威胁说不跟他续租。

examples.text: The job was for a fixed term and the contract is not being renewed.
examples.translation: 这个工作有固定期限，而且合同不能续签。

examples.text: Cells are being constantly renewed.
examples.translation: 细胞不断再生。

examples.text: ...a renewed interest in public transport systems.
examples.translation: 对公交系统重新产生的兴趣

examples.text: The couple spent thousands renovating the house...
examples.translation: 这对夫妇花了几千元来翻新房子。

examples.text: She lives in a large, renovated farmhouse.
examples.translation: 她住在一个宽敞的翻新过的农舍里。

examples.text: ...a property which will need extensive renovation.
examples.translation: 需要进行大规模整修的房产

examples.text: She rents a house with three other girls...
examples.translation: 她和其他3个女孩合租一套房子。

examples.text: He left his hotel in a rented car.
examples.translation: 他开着一辆租来的车离开了酒店。

examples.text: She rented rooms to university students.
examples.translation: 她把房间租给了大学生。

examples.text: He rented out his house while he worked abroad...
examples.translation: 他在国外工作期间把自己的房子租了出去。

examples.text: He repaired the boat, and rented it out for $150.
examples.translation: 他修好了那条船，然后把它以150美元的价格租了出去。

examples.text: She worked to pay the rent while I went to college...
examples.translation: 在我读大学期间，她打工挣钱来付租金。

examples.text: Traders in Marble Arch are facing huge rent increases.
examples.translation: 大理石拱门的经销商们面临租金的大幅上涨。

examples.text: Goldsmith has repaired the roof to ensure the house is wind-proof...
examples.translation: 戈德史密斯修理了屋顶，以确保房屋能够抗风。

examples.text: The cost of repairing earthquake damage could be more than seven-thousand-million dollars...
examples.translation: 弥补地震造成的损失需要超过70亿美元。

examples.text: A woman drove her car to the garage to have it repaired.
examples.translation: 一位女士把车开到修理厂修理。

examples.text: ...TV repairers.
examples.translation: 电视修理工

examples.text: The government continued to try to repair the damage caused by the minister's interview...
examples.translation: 政府不断努力弥补因该部长接受采访带来的不良影响。

examples.text: The first and most important thing was to repair my relationship with my father.
examples.translation: 最首要和最重要的是挽救我和父亲的关系。

examples.text: Many women know how to carry out repairs on their cars...
examples.translation: 许多妇女懂得怎样修自己的车。

examples.text: Many of the buildings are in need of repair...
examples.translation: 许多建筑需要整修。

examples.text: There is no doubt now that her marriage is beyond repair.
examples.translation: 毫无疑问她的婚姻无法挽救。

examples.text: We then repaired to the pavilion for lunch.
examples.translation: 然后我们就去凉亭吃午饭了。

examples.text: The monks of Ettal keep the abbey in good repair...
examples.translation: 埃塔尔的修道士把修道院维护得很好。

examples.text: The road was in bad repair in parts.
examples.translation: 公路的部分路段路况很差。

examples.text: It will take 30 years to repay the loan...
examples.translation: 还清贷款需要30年的时间。

examples.text: He advanced funds of his own to his company, which was unable to repay him.
examples.translation: 他把自己的资金预付给他的公司，而公司却不能把钱偿还给他。

examples.text: It was very kind. I don't know how I can ever repay you...
examples.translation: 真是太好了。我都不知道怎么报答你才好。

examples.text: I owe them a debt that cannot easily be repaid.
examples.translation: 我欠他们一笔钱，不容易偿还。

examples.text: He repeated that he had been misquoted...
examples.translation: 他反复说他的话被错误引用了。

examples.text: I repeat that medicine is on the brink of a revolution...
examples.translation: 我要再次强调，医学面临着变革。

examples.text: The Libyan leader Colonel Gadaffi repeated his call for the release of hostages...
examples.translation: 利比亚领导人卡扎菲上校反复呼吁释放人质。

examples.text: 'You fool,' she kept repeating.
examples.translation: “你这个傻瓜，”她不断地重复着。

examples.text: She had an irritating habit of repeating everything I said to her...
examples.translation: 她有个惹人讨厌的习惯，我跟她说的每一件事她都告诉别人。

examples.text: I trust you not to repeat that to anyone else...
examples.translation: 我相信你不会把我的话告诉别人。

examples.text: Now, brother, repeat after me, 'All praise to Allah, Lord of All the Worlds'.
examples.translation: 现在，我的兄弟，跟着我说，“至上伟大的真主，全世界的主宰。”

examples.text: Then he started rambling and repeating himself.
examples.translation: 他接下来就开始不着边际、说话来回重复了。

examples.text: We are not, I repeat, not actually in the negotiating process...
examples.translation: 我们不是，我重申一下，实际上不是在进行谈判。

examples.text: Find and destroy, repeat destroy, these units.
examples.translation: 找到并且销毁，重复一下，销毁这些部件。

examples.text: The next day I repeated the procedure...
examples.translation: 第二天我重复了这个程序。

examples.text: He said Japan would never repeat its mistakes...
examples.translation: 他说日本永远不会再犯同样的错误。

examples.text: Hold this position for 30 seconds, release and repeat on the other side.
examples.translation: 保持这个姿势30秒钟，放松，然后换另一侧重复。

examples.text: The UN will have to work hard to stop history repeating itself...
examples.translation: 联合国必须努力避免历史重演。

examples.text: The cycle then repeats itself.
examples.translation: 这个循环周而复始。

examples.text: There were fears that there might be a repeat of last year's campaign of strikes.
examples.translation: 有人担心去年的罢工运动可能再次重演。

examples.text: ...in order to prevent a repeat tragedy.
examples.translation: 为了防止悲剧的再次发生

examples.text: Nearly 60% of our bookings come from repeat business and personal recommendation.
examples.translation: 我们近60%的订单来自于回头客和熟人介绍。

examples.text: There's nothing except sport and repeats on TV.
examples.translation: 除了体育节目和重播节目外，电视上没什么新鲜内容。

examples.text: This year can only see a repeat performance of the decline.
examples.translation: 今年还会出现下降。

examples.text: Both men have repeatedly denied the allegations...
examples.translation: 两个人都一再否认指控。

examples.text: The rebel soldiers tried repeatedly to storm the building.
examples.translation: 叛军屡次尝试强攻这座建筑。

meanings.meaning: 击退；抵制；使厌恶；使不愉快

examples.text: They have fifty thousand troops along the border ready to repel any attack.
examples.translation: 他们有5万人的部队驻扎在边境，随时准备击退任何进攻。

examples.text: Like poles repel, unlike poles attract...
examples.translation: 同极相斥，异极相吸。

examples.text: As these electrons are negatively charged they will attempt to repel each other.
examples.translation: 因为这些电子都是带负电荷的，它们会互相排斥。

examples.text: ...a violent excitement that frightened and repelled her.
examples.translation: 使她恐惧和厌恶的强烈兴奋感

examples.text: She was very striking but in some way I felt repelled.
examples.translation: 她非常引人注目，但我觉得她有些讨厌。

meanings.meaning: 全部节目；计算机指令系统；（美）某人或机器的全部技能

examples.text: Meredith D'Ambrosio has thousands of songs in her repertoire.
examples.translation: 梅雷迪思·丹布罗西奥会唱几千首歌曲。

examples.text: ...Mike's impressive repertoire of funny stories...
examples.translation: 迈克会讲大量有趣故事的非凡才能

examples.text: This has been one of the most successful desserts in my repertoire.
examples.translation: 这是我会做的甜点中做得最成功的一种。

examples.text: It is no coincidence that the works in the 'standard repertoire' tend to have names.
examples.translation: 在“标准剧目”中的作品有各自的名字并非偶然。

examples.text: Today the city government has taken measures to prevent a repetition of last year's confrontation...
examples.translation: 今天市政府已经采取措施，防止去年的冲突重演。

examples.text: Collins wants to avoid repetition of the confusion that followed the discovery in 1989 of the cystic fibrosis gene.
examples.translation: 科林斯想要避免1989年发现囊肿性纤维化致病基因后的那种混乱局面再次出现。

examples.text: He could also have cut out much of the repetition and thus saved many pages.
examples.translation: 他原本也可以砍去许多重复的内容，从而缩减许多页。

meanings.meaning: 取代，代替；替换，更换；归还，偿还；把…放回原处

examples.text: The council tax replaces the poll tax next April.
examples.translation: 市政税在明年4月将取代人头税。

examples.text: ...the city lawyer who replaced Bob as chairman of the company...
examples.translation: 取代鲍勃成为公司主席的市政律师

examples.text: The smile disappeared to be replaced by a doleful frown.
examples.translation: 笑容消失了，取而代之的是哀伤的蹙眉。

examples.text: I clean out all the grease and replace it with oil so it works better in very low temperatures...
examples.translation: 我把所有的油脂清除干净，然后用油来代替，从而使它在低温条件下运转得更好。

examples.text: The BBC decided it could not replace her.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司认定那不能取代她。

examples.text: The shower that we put in a few years back has broken and we cannot afford to replace it.
examples.translation: 我们几年前安装的淋浴器坏了，但买不起新的来换。

examples.text: The line went dead. Whitlock replaced the receiver...
examples.translation: 线路中断了，惠特洛克把听筒放回原处。

examples.text: Replace the caps on the bottles.
examples.translation: 把瓶盖重新盖上。

meanings.meaning: 更换；复位；代替者；补充兵员

examples.text: ...the replacement of damaged or lost books.
examples.translation: 受损或丢失图书的更换或补充

examples.text: Taylor has nominated Adams as his replacement...
examples.translation: 泰勒提名亚当斯接替他。

examples.text: The 18-year-old made his debut last week as a replacement for the injured Gordon Durie.
examples.translation: 这个18岁选手作为受伤的戈登·迪里的替补在上周首次出场。

examples.text: 'That's a nice dress,' said Michael. 'Thanks,' she replied solemnly...
examples.translation: “那件衣服很好看，”迈克尔说。“谢谢，”她严肃地回答。

examples.text: He replied that this was absolutely impossible...
examples.translation: 他回复说这是绝对不可能的。

examples.text: Grace was too terrified to reply...
examples.translation: 格雷斯吓坏了，不能作答。

examples.text: I've not replied to Lee's letter yet...
examples.translation: 我还没有给李回信呢。

examples.text: To their surprise, hundreds replied to the advertisement.
examples.translation: 令他们吃惊的是，有几百人对广告作出了回应。

examples.text: I called out a challenge, but there was no reply...
examples.translation: 我提出挑战，但是没人回应。

examples.text: David has had 12 replies to his ad...
examples.translation: 戴维的广告已经有12条回复了。

examples.text: They went ahead without waiting for a reply from the Germans...
examples.translation: 他们没等德国人答复就接着往下推进。

examples.text: He said in reply that the question was unfair.
examples.translation: 他回答说这个问题不公平。

examples.text: Graeme Hick scored an unbeaten 58 as Worcestershire replied to Middlesex's 202 with 132-3...
examples.translation: 格雷姆·希克未出局拿得58分，从而使伍斯特郡队以132分3人出局的成绩回敬了米德尔塞克斯队的202分。

examples.text: Deryck Fox gave Featherstone the lead early in the first half with a penalty, but Saints were quick to reply.
examples.translation: 德里克·福克斯在上半场的罚球使费瑟斯通队领先，但是圣徒队很快进行了反击。

examples.text: Farmers threw eggs and empty bottles at police, who replied with tear gas...
examples.translation: 农民向警察扔鸡蛋和空瓶子，警察则以催泪弹回击。

examples.text: The National Salvation Front has already replied to this series of opposition moves with its own demonstrations.
examples.translation: 民族救亡阵线已经组织了示威，以此回击反对派的一系列活动。

examples.text: They had been called in to clear drains after local people reported a foul smell...
examples.translation: 当地居民举报闻到恶臭气味后，他们被叫来清理排水沟。

examples.text: I reported the theft to the police...
examples.translation: 我向警方报告了这起盗窃案。

examples.text: The officials also reported that two more ships were apparently heading for Malta...
examples.translation: 官员们也报告说，又有两艘船显然正往马耳他驶去。

examples.text: 'He seems to be all right now,' reported a relieved Taylor...
examples.translation: “他现在看上去没事了，”泰勒放心地报告。

examples.text: The foreign secretary is reported as saying that force will have to be used if diplomacy fails...
examples.translation: 报道称，外交大臣表示如果外交努力不能奏效将不得不使用武力。

examples.text: She reported him missing the next day...
examples.translation: 第二天她报案说他失踪了。

examples.text: Between forty and fifty people are reported to have died in the fighting.
examples.translation: 报道称有40到50人在冲突中丧生。

examples.text: Many journalists enter the country to report on political affairs...
examples.translation: 许多记者进入该国对政治事件进行报道。

examples.text: I'll now call at the vicarage and report to you in due course.
examples.translation: 我现在要去教区牧师家拜访，然后适时向你汇报情况。

examples.text: ...a report in London's Independent newspaper...
examples.translation: 伦敦《独立报》的报道

examples.text: With a report on these developments, here's Jim Fish in Belgrade...
examples.translation: 这里是吉姆·菲什在贝尔格莱德发来的关于事件进展的报道。

examples.text: Press reports said that 65mm of water fell in twenty four hours.
examples.translation: 媒体报道称24小时内的降雨量达到了65毫米。

examples.text: After an inspection, the inspectors must publish a report.
examples.translation: 在视察之后，视察者必须发表一份报告。

examples.text: A report by the Association of University Teachers finds that only 22 per cent of lecturers in our universities are women.
examples.translation: 大学教师联合会发表的报告发现只有22%的大学讲师为女性。

examples.text: She came back to give us a progress report on how the project is going...
examples.translation: 她回来给我们作了关于项目进程的报告。

examples.text: It seemed obvious from his report of that meeting that you were trying to focus suspicion on Mr Hirsch.
examples.translation: 从他对那次会面的报告中可以明显看出你正把怀疑的焦点转向赫希先生。

examples.text: There are unconfirmed reports that two people have been shot in the neighbouring town of Lalitpur...
examples.translation: 据报道有两人在勒利德布尔城附近被枪杀，但尚未得到证实。

examples.text: There were no reports of casualties.
examples.translation: 没有人员死伤的报道。

examples.text: His ex-wife reported him to police a few days later...
examples.translation: 他的前妻几天后向警方告发了他。

examples.text: The Princess was reported for speeding twice on the same road within a week.
examples.translation: 这位公主一周之内在同一路段上两次因超速行驶被告发。

examples.text: According to protocol, he first reported to the Director of the hospital...
examples.translation: 根据礼节，他先向医院院长报到。

examples.text: Mr Ashwell has to surrender his passport and report to the police every five days...
examples.translation: 阿什维尔先生不得不交出他的护照，并且每隔5天到警察局报到一次。

examples.text: None of the men had reported for duty.
examples.translation: 这些人没有一个到岗位报到。

examples.text: He reported to a section chief, who reported to a division chief, and so on up the line.
examples.translation: 他由组长领导，组长由部门主管领导，如此逐级向上。

examples.text: And now she was getting bad school reports.
examples.translation: 现在她的学习成绩越来越差。

examples.text: Soon afterwards there was a loud report as the fuel tanks exploded.
examples.translation: 不久之后就听到燃料箱爆炸的巨响。

examples.text: ...a TV reporter.
examples.translation: 电视记者

examples.text: ...a trainee sports reporter...
examples.translation: 见习体育记者

examples.text: Our reporter Chris Loosemore sums up the findings.
examples.translation: 我们的记者克里斯·卢斯莫尔总结了这些发现。

meanings.meaning: 代表；表现；描绘；回忆；再赠送

examples.text: ...the politicians we elect to represent us...
examples.translation: 我们选举出来代表我们的政界人士

examples.text: The offer has yet to be accepted by the lawyers representing the victims.
examples.translation: 受害者的代理律师还没有接受这个提议。

examples.text: The general secretary may represent the president at official ceremonies.
examples.translation: 总书记可以在一些官方仪式上代表主席。

examples.text: My only aim is to represent Britain at the Olympics.
examples.translation: 我唯一的目标是代表英国参加奥运会。

examples.text: Women are already well represented in the area of TV drama...
examples.translation: 女性在电视剧领域占据了一席之地。

examples.text: In New Mexico all kinds of cuisines are represented.
examples.translation: 在新墨西哥州， 有各种各样的烹饪方法。

examples.text: The pieces on view are not grouped around any one theme, but rather represent superb examples from various periods...
examples.translation: 展出的作品并非围绕着一个主题，而是不同时期的经典之作。

examples.text: These developments represented a major change in the established order.
examples.translation: 这些发展代表了现有秩序的重大转变。

examples.text: ...a black dot in the middle of the circle is supposed to represent the source of the radiation.
examples.translation: 圆圈中心的黑点应该是表示放射源。

examples.text: We believe you represent everything British racing needs.
examples.translation: 我们相信你代表了英国赛马所需要的一切。

examples.text: The popular press tends to represent him as an environmental guru.
examples.translation: 大众媒体往往把他描绘成环保领袖。

meanings.meaning: 典型的，有代表性的；代议制的

examples.text: ...trade union representatives...
examples.translation: 工会代表

examples.text: Employees from each department elect a representative.
examples.translation: 每个部门的员工选举一名代表。

examples.text: She had a stressful job as a sales representative.
examples.translation: 作为一名销售代表，她的工作压力很大。

examples.text: The new head of state should be chosen by an 87 member representative council.
examples.translation: 新的国家元首应该由包括87名成员的代表委员会选出。

examples.text: ...the institutions of a representative government.
examples.translation: 代议制政府的各个机构

examples.text: He was in no way representative of dog-trainers in general.
examples.translation: 他远不是一般意义上的驯狗师。

examples.text: ...fairly representative groups of adults.
examples.translation: 相当典型的成年人群体

examples.text: ...a process designed to ensure the representativeness of the sample interviewed.
examples.translation: 为保证抽样的对象具有代表性而设计的过程

meanings.meaning: 抑制，[心理] 压抑；镇压

examples.text: ...a society conditioned by violence and repression.
examples.translation: 受暴力和镇压制约的社会

examples.text: ...the repressions of the 1930s.
examples.translation: 20世纪30年代的镇压

examples.text: ...the repression of his feelings about men.
examples.translation: 他对男人情感的压抑

examples.text: She is quick to reproach anyone who doesn't live up to her own high standards...
examples.translation: 只要有人不符合她自己的高标准，她马上就会加以指责。

examples.text: She had not even reproached him for breaking his promise.
examples.translation: 她甚至没有责怪他违背诺言。

examples.text: He looked at her with reproach...
examples.translation: 他用责备的目光看着她。

examples.text: Women in public life must be beyond reproach.
examples.translation: 女性参与公众生活无可非议。

examples.text: You've no reason to reproach yourself, no reason to feel shame...
examples.translation: 你没有理由自责，也没有理由感到惭愧。

examples.text: We begin to reproach ourselves for not having been more careful.
examples.translation: 我们开始自责起来，怪自己不够小心。

examples.text: The shootings and bombings were 'a scandal and reproach to all of us in Europe'.
examples.translation: 这些枪杀和轰炸事件是“我们所有欧洲人的丑闻和耻辱”。

meanings.meaning: 复制；再生；生殖；使…在脑海中重现

examples.text: I shall not try to reproduce the policemen's English...
examples.translation: 我不会试图去模仿那个警察讲的英语。

examples.text: The effect has proved hard to reproduce.
examples.translation: 事实证明，这种效果很难再现。

examples.text: We are grateful to you for permission to reproduce this article.
examples.translation: 非常感谢您允许我们复印这篇文章。

examples.text: If we can reproduce the form we have shown in the last couple of months we will be successful.
examples.translation: 如果我们能再采用前两个月的形式，我们就会成功。

examples.text: ...a society where women are defined by their ability to reproduce...
examples.translation: 用生育能力衡量女性价值的社会

examples.text: We are reproducing ourselves at such a rate that our numbers threaten the ecology of the planet.
examples.translation: 我们的繁衍速度太快，以至于人口数量对地球的生态系统造成了威胁。

examples.text: Genes are those tiny bits of biological information swapped in sexual reproduction.
examples.translation: 基因是在有性繁殖中交换的微小生物信息。

examples.text: ...the acids which are vital for normal cell reproduction.
examples.translation: 对正常细胞繁殖至关重要的酸性物质

examples.text: The title character of that 2008 animated flop was also some sort of humanoid reptile.
In 1918, Austria became a republic.
examples.translation: 1918年，奥地利成为共和国。

examples.text: ...the Baltic republics.
examples.translation: 波罗的海沿岸诸共和国

examples.text: ...the Republic of Ireland.
examples.translation: 爱尔兰共和国

meanings.meaning: 共和国的；共和政体的；共和主义的；拥护共和政体的

examples.text: ...the nations that had adopted the republican form of government.
examples.translation: 实行共和政体的国家

examples.text: ...Republican voters...
examples.translation: 支持共和党的选民们

examples.text: Some families have been republican for generations.
examples.translation: 有些家庭世代都支持共和党。

examples.text: What made you decide to become a Republican?
examples.translation: 是什么让你决定加入共和党的？

examples.text: ...a Republican paramilitary group.
examples.translation: 共和派的准军事组织

examples.text: ...a Northern Ireland republican.
examples.translation: 北爱尔兰共和主义人士

examples.text: Alice Munro has a reputation for being a very depressing writer.
examples.translation: 艾丽斯·芒罗以文风沉郁闻名。

examples.text: ...Barcelona's reputation as a design-conscious, artistic city.
examples.translation: 巴塞罗那作为一个具有设计意识的艺术城市的声誉

examples.text: This college has a good academic reputation...
examples.translation: 这所大学有良好的学术声誉。

examples.text: The stories ruined his reputation.
examples.translation: 这些传闻把他的名誉全毁了。

examples.text: She was by reputation a good organiser.
examples.translation: 听说她的组织能力很强。

examples.text: Mr Dennis said he had requested access to a telephone...
examples.translation: 丹尼斯先生说他已经请求使用电话。

examples.text: She had requested that the door to her room be left open.
examples.translation: 她要求不要关闭通向她房间的门。

examples.text: They requested him to leave...
examples.translation: 他们要求他离开。

examples.text: Students are requested to park at the rear of the Department.
examples.translation: 学生必须把车停在该系后面。

examples.text: France had agreed to his request for political asylum...
examples.translation: 法国已经同意了他寻求政治庇护的请求。

examples.text: Vietnam made an official request that the meeting be postponed.
examples.translation: 越南已经正式请求将会议推迟。

examples.text: If you have any requests, I'd be happy to play them for you.
examples.translation: 您点播任何歌曲，我都会很乐意为您演奏。

examples.text: The evacuation is being organised at the request of the United Nations Secretary General.
examples.translation: 根据联合国秘书长的要求，正在组织撤退。

examples.text: Leaflets giving details are available on request...
examples.translation: 备有介绍详情的传单以供索取。

examples.text: Chambermaids will bring an iron or hair dryer on request.
examples.translation: 只要提出要求，清理房间的女服务员就会送来熨斗或电吹风。

examples.text: If you require further information, you should consult the registrar...
examples.translation: 如果需要进一步了解信息，请咨询教务主任。

examples.text: This isn't the kind of crisis that requires us to drop everything else...
examples.translation: 这样的危机并不需要我们抛弃其他的一切。

examples.text: Some of the materials required for this technique may be difficult to obtain.
examples.translation: 这项技术需要的某些材料可能很难获取。

examples.text: The rules also require employers to provide safety training...
examples.translation: 这些规定还要求雇主提供安全培训。

examples.text: At least 35 manufacturers have flouted a law requiring prompt reporting of such malfunctions...
examples.translation: 至少有35名制造商触犯了要求此类故障出现后立即上报的法律。

examples.text: The law now requires that parents serve on the committees that plan and evaluate school programs...
examples.translation: 现在，法律要求家长在规划和评估学校项目的委员会中任职。

examples.text: Then he'll know exactly what's required of him.
examples.translation: 到那时他就会确切地知道对他的要求是什么了。

examples.text: ...an important research study that should be required reading for every member of the cabinet.
examples.translation: 每一位内阁成员都应阅读的一份重要研究论文

examples.text: Its products met all legal requirements...
examples.translation: 它的产品符合所有的法律要求。

examples.text: Graduate status is the minimum requirement for entry to the teaching profession...
examples.translation: 研究生学历是从事教学工作的最低要求。

examples.text: I knew that concentration was the first requirement for learning.
examples.translation: 我知道专心致志是学习的首要条件。

examples.text: Variations of this programme can be arranged to suit your requirements.
examples.translation: 本方案可以进行调整，以满足您的需求。

examples.text: ...a packaged food which provides 100 percent of your daily requirement of one vitamin.
examples.translation: 能够百分之百满足人体对于一种维生素每日所需的包装食品

examples.text: Helicopters rescued nearly 20 people from the roof of the burning building...
examples.translation: 直升机从失火大楼的楼顶救出了将近20人。

examples.text: He had rescued her from a horrible life.
examples.translation: 他把她从可怕的生活中解救了出来。

examples.text: It took rescuers 90 minutes to reach the trapped men.
examples.translation: 营救人员花了90分钟才赶到被困者那里。

examples.text: Lights clipped onto life jackets improve the chances of rescue...
examples.translation: 别在救生衣上的灯提高了获救可能性。

examples.text: A big rescue operation has been launched for a trawler missing in the English Channel.
examples.translation: 为寻找在英吉利海峡失踪的一艘拖网渔船，人们展开了一场大规模的搜救行动。

examples.text: A major air-sea rescue is under way...
examples.translation: 一场大规模的海空营救行动正在进行。

examples.text: Five children were pulled from the smoke-filled house in heroic rescues by fire crews.
examples.translation: 在消防人员英勇的营救行动中，有5个孩子从浓烟弥漫的房子里被救出。

examples.text: The 23-year-old's screams alerted a passerby who went to her rescue...
examples.translation: 那个23岁女孩的尖叫引来了一位过路人前去营救。

examples.text: The crisis puts strong political pressure on the state government to come to the rescue.
examples.translation: 这次危机给前来救助的州政府带来了巨大的政治压力。

meanings.meaning: 研究；调查 [ 过去式 researched 过去分词 researched 现在分词 researching ]

examples.text: 65 percent of the 1987 budget went for nuclear weapons research and production.
examples.translation: 1987年65％的预算经费被用于核武器的研究和生产。

examples.text: ...cancer research.
examples.translation: 癌症研究

examples.text: ...his researches into which kinds of flowers bees get their best honey from.
examples.translation: 他对蜜蜂能从何种花中采到最好的蜜进行的研究

examples.text: She spent two years in South Florida researching and filming her documentary...
examples.translation: 她花了两年时间在佛罗里达州南部做研究，拍摄纪录片。

examples.text: So far we haven't been able to find anything, but we're still researching.
examples.translation: 目前我们还没有任何发现，但是我们仍在研究。

examples.text: He chose to join the company as a market researcher.
examples.translation: 他选择到这家公司做了市场研究员。

meanings.meaning: 相似；相似之处；相似物；肖像

examples.text: There was a remarkable resemblance between him and Pete...
examples.translation: 他和皮特之间有着惊人的相似之处。

examples.text: Our tour prices bore little resemblance to those in the holiday brochures.
examples.translation: 我们的旅游报价和那些度假手册里的价格相去甚远。

examples.text: Some of the commercially produced venison resembles beef in flavour...
examples.translation: 有些商业化养殖的鹿肉味道和牛肉很相似。

examples.text: She so resembles her mother.
examples.translation: 她很像她母亲。

examples.text: She resents her mother for being so tough on her...
examples.translation: 她怨恨母亲对她太严厉。

examples.text: I resent being dependent on her.
examples.translation: 我很讨厌自己对她的依赖。

examples.text: I told him my main reservation about his film was the ending...
examples.translation: 我告诉他我主要是对他电影的结尾有保留意见。

examples.text: After three days, the strikers' demands were met almost without reservation.
examples.translation: 3天以后，罢工人员的要求几乎全部得到了满足。

examples.text: He went to the desk to make a reservation...
examples.translation: 他到服务台进行了预订。

examples.text: Accommodation is restricted so a reservation is essential.
examples.translation: 铺位有限，所以有必要进行预订。

examples.text: Seventeen thousand Indians live in Arizona on a reservation.
examples.translation: 1.7万印第安人生活在亚利桑那州的保留地。

meanings.meaning: 储备，储存；自然保护区；预备队；缄默；[金融] 储备金

examples.text: A double room with a balcony overlooking the sea had been reserved for him...
examples.translation: 特地为他预留了一间带阳台的海景双人房。

examples.text: In the United States lanes are reserved for cars with more than one occupant.
examples.translation: 在美国，多人乘坐的汽车有专行道。

examples.text: I'll reserve a table for five...
examples.translation: 我要预订一张5人的桌子。

examples.text: Demand will be huge, so ask your newsagent to reserve your copy today.
examples.translation: 需求量会很大，所以今天得请卖报摊主为你预留出你那份。

examples.text: The Gulf has 65 per cent of the world's oil reserves...
examples.translation: 海湾地区拥有全世界65％的石油储藏。

examples.text: A friend can be a reserve of help in times of trouble.
examples.translation: 朋友可以在困难的时候提供帮助。

examples.text: He ended up as a reserve, but still qualified for a team gold medal.
examples.translation: 他最后成了替补队员，但仍有资格获得团体金牌。

examples.text: Marine biologists are calling for Cardigan Bay to be created a marine nature reserve to protect the dolphins.
examples.translation: 海洋生物学家号召将卡迪根湾建成一个海洋自然保护区，以保护那里的海豚。

examples.text: The subject is one which must be discussed with reserve...
examples.translation: 对这个话题必须进行慎重的讨论。

examples.text: His natural reserve made him appear self-conscious.
examples.translation: 他天生的内敛性格让他显得有些拘谨。

examples.text: ...the bottle of whisky that he kept in reserve...
examples.translation: 他特地留的那瓶威士忌

examples.text: There were patrol cars on the streets and riot police standing by in reserve.
examples.translation: 巡逻车在街上守候，防暴警察也在一旁待命。

examples.text: ...the huge oil reservoir beneath the Kuwaiti desert.
examples.translation: 科威特沙漠下面巨大的石油储藏

examples.text: ...the body's short-term reservoir of energy.
examples.translation: 身体的短期能量储备

examples.text: ...hotels and private residences.
examples.translation: 旅馆和私人住宅

examples.text: She travels constantly, moving among her several residences around the world.
examples.translation: 她经常旅行，穿梭于她在世界各地的多处住所。

examples.text: ...differences among women based on age, place of residence and educational levels.
examples.translation: 不同年龄、居住地和教育程度的女性之间的差异

examples.text: They had entered the country and had applied for permanent residence...
examples.translation: 他们已经入境该国，并申请了永久居留权。

examples.text: She moved out of 28 Barbary Lane to take up residence in a house in Pacific Heights.
examples.translation: 她从巴巴里街28号搬出来，住进了太平洋高地住宅区的一所房子。

examples.text: Windsor is open to visitors when the Royal Family is not in residence.
examples.translation: 王室未在温莎城堡居住期间，城堡会对游客开放。

examples.text: Wakoski is writer in residence at Michigan State University.
examples.translation: 瓦科斯基是密歇根州立大学的常驻作家。

examples.text: ...former Chicago Symphony composer in residence, John Corliano.
examples.translation: 约翰·科利亚诺，芝加哥交响乐团的前任常驻作曲家

meanings.meaning: 居住的；住院医师；定居的

examples.text: The Archbishop called upon the government to build more low cost homes for local residents...
examples.translation: 大主教呼吁政府为当地居民建造更多低成本的住宅。

examples.text: More than 10 percent of Munich residents live below the poverty line.
examples.translation: 超过10％的慕尼黑居民生活在贫困线以下。

examples.text: He moved to Belgium in 1990 to live with his son, who had been resident in Brussels since 1967.
examples.translation: 他于1990年搬到比利时和儿子一起住。他儿子自1967年起就住在布鲁塞尔。

examples.text: The morning after your arrival, you meet with the resident physician for a private consultation.
examples.translation: 到达后的第二天早上，你就去见住院医生，进行私人问诊。

examples.text: Having begun her career at Gray's Pottery, she stayed there as resident designer for seven years.
examples.translation: 在格雷陶器场开始自己的职业生涯后，她在那里做了7年的特聘设计师。

examples.text: A hospital administrator has resigned over claims he lied to get the job...
examples.translation: 一位医院的管理人员辞职了，因为有人指责他为了得到这份工作而撒了谎。

examples.text: Mr Robb resigned his position last month.
examples.translation: 罗布先生上个月辞职了。

examples.text: Pat and I resigned ourselves to yet another summer without a boat...
examples.translation: 我和帕特在没有船的情况下勉强又凑合了一个夏天。

examples.text: He had resigned himself to watching the European Championships on television.
examples.translation: 他只好将就着在电视上看欧洲锦标赛。

examples.text: She says she will resist a single European currency being imposed...
examples.translation: 她说她会反对在欧洲推行单一货币。

examples.text: They resisted our attempts to modernize the distribution of books.
examples.translation: 他们反对我们采用现代化方式发行图书。

examples.text: The man was shot outside his house as he tried to resist arrest...
examples.translation: 该男子在其住宅外拒捕时被击毙。

examples.text: When she had attempted to cut his nails he resisted.
examples.translation: 她试图给他剪指甲，他不让。

examples.text: Students should resist the temptation to focus on exams alone...
examples.translation: 学生们应当抵制诱惑，集中精力备考。

examples.text: She cannot resist giving him advice.
examples.translation: 她忍不住给他提建议。

examples.text: ...bodies trained and toughened to resist the cold...
examples.translation: 经过训练和磨炼，可以抵御寒冷的身体

examples.text: Chemicals form a protective layer that resists both oil and water-based stains.
examples.translation: 化学物质形成了一个抗油污和水渍的保护层。

meanings.meaning: 阻力；电阻；抵抗；反抗；抵抗力

examples.text: The US wants big cuts in European agricultural export subsidies, but this is meeting resistance.
examples.translation: 美国想大幅度削减欧洲农业出口补贴，但此举遭到了抵制。

examples.text: The troops are encountering stiff resistance...
examples.translation: 军队遭遇了顽强抵抗。

examples.text: Police in riot gear cleared the noisy demonstrators, who offered no resistance.
examples.translation: 身穿防暴服的警察驱散了喧闹的游行者，没有遇到抵抗。

examples.text: This disease is surprisingly difficult to catch as most people have a natural resistance to it.
examples.translation: 由于多数人对这种病具有天然免疫力，所以发病率低得出奇。

examples.text: The design of the bicycle has managed to reduce the effects of wind resistance and drag.
examples.translation: 这种自行车的设计成功地减少了风的阻力和摩擦力。

examples.text: ...materials that lose all their electrical resistance.
examples.translation: 电阻为零的材料

examples.text: They managed to escape after being arrested by the resistance.
examples.translation: 他们被抵抗组织抓住后又设法逃脱了。

examples.text: They would rather take the line of least resistance than become involved in arguments.
examples.translation: 他们倾向采用阻力最小的方案，不愿卷入纷争。

examples.text: Some people are very resistant to the idea of exercise.
examples.translation: 有些人十分反对锻炼。

examples.text: ...how to improve plants to make them more resistant to disease...
examples.translation: 如何改良植物以增强它们对病害的抵抗力

examples.text: The body may be less resistant if it is cold.
examples.translation: 天冷时，身体的抵抗力会下降。

examples.text: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader...
examples.translation: 投票者认为他是一位坚定果断的国际领导人。

examples.text: He described the situation as very dangerous and called for resolute action.
examples.translation: 他将形势描述得非常危险，并号召采取果断行动。

examples.text: He resolutely refused to speak English unless forced to...
examples.translation: 除非迫不得已，否则他坚决不说英语。

examples.text: The United States remains resolutely opposed to this.
examples.translation: 美国对此仍然坚决反对。

meanings.meaning: [物] 分辨率；决议；解决；决心

examples.text: He replied that the UN had passed two major resolutions calling for a complete withdrawal.
examples.translation: 他答复说联合国已经通过了两项号召全面撤军的重要决议。

examples.text: ...a draft resolution on the occupied territories.
examples.translation: 针对被占领领土的决议草案

examples.text: They made a resolution to lose all the weight gained during the Christmas period.
examples.translation: 他们下定决心要减去圣诞期间增加的体重。

examples.text: 'I think I'll try a hypnotist,' I said with sudden resolution.
examples.translation: “我会找催眠师试试，”我突然坚决地说。

examples.text: ...the successful resolution of a dispute involving UN inspectors in Baghdad.
examples.translation: 涉及联合国驻巴格达观察员的争端的成功解决

examples.text: ...in order to find a peaceful resolution to the crisis.
examples.translation: 为了和平解决此次危机

examples.text: Now this machine gives us such high resolution that we can see very small specks of calcium.
examples.translation: 现在这台机器可以呈现很高的分辨率，我们可以看见非常小的钙微粒。

meanings.meaning: 决定；溶解；使…分解；决心要做…

examples.text: We must find a way to resolve these problems before it's too late...
examples.translation: 我们必须及时找到解决这些问题的方法。

examples.text: They hoped the crisis could be resolved peacefully.
examples.translation: 他们希望这场危机能够得到和平解决。

examples.text: She resolved to report the matter to the hospital's nursing manager...
examples.translation: 她决定把这件事汇报给医院的护士长。

examples.text: She resolved that, if Mimi forgot this promise, she would remind her.
examples.translation: 她决定，如果米米忘记了这个承诺，她就提醒她。

examples.text: This will strengthen the American public's resolve to go to war.
examples.translation: 这会坚定美国公众诉诸战争的决心。

examples.text: ...like a musician resolving a confused mass of sound into melodic or harmonic order...
examples.translation: 就像音乐家那样将混乱嘈杂的声音变成优美和谐的旋律

examples.text: Each of the spirals of light resolved into points.
examples.translation: 每一束螺旋光都分解成了光点。

meanings.meaning: 凭借，手段；度假胜地；常去之地
求助，诉诸；常去；采取某手段或方法

examples.text: His punishing work schedule had made him resort to drugs...
examples.translation: 异常紧张的工作安排使他开始吸毒。

examples.text: Some schools have resorted to recruiting teachers from overseas.
examples.translation: 有些学校不得不开始从海外招收老师。

examples.text: Congress has a responsibility to ensure that all peaceful options are exhausted before resort to war.
examples.translation: 国会有责任确保只有在所有和平手段都不奏效的情况下才会诉诸战争。

examples.text: ...the ski resorts.
examples.translation: 滑雪胜地

examples.text: Nuclear weapons should be used only as a last resort...
examples.translation: 不到万不得已时不能选择使用核武器。

examples.text: As a last resort you may have to accept their point of view.
examples.translation: 最终，你可能不得不接受他们的观点。

examples.text: They would in the last resort support their friends whatever they did.
examples.translation: 无论他们的朋友做了什么，他们最终都会支持他们的朋友。

examples.text: Some families don't have the resources to feed themselves properly...
examples.translation: 有些家庭无力维持生活。

examples.text: There's a great shortage of resource materials in many schools.
examples.translation: 很多学校物资都十分短缺。

examples.text: ...resources like coal, tungsten, oil and copper...
examples.translation: 煤、钨、石油和铜之类的资源

examples.text: Today we are overpopulated, straining the earth's resources.
examples.translation: 现在我们人口过多，致使地球资源使用过度。

examples.text: I want him to respect me as a career woman...
examples.translation: 我希望他把我当作一个职业女性来尊重。

examples.text: He needs the advice of people he respects, and he respects you.
examples.translation: 他需要从他敬重的人那里获得建议，而他一向都很敬重你。

examples.text: I have tremendous respect for Dean...
examples.translation: 我非常敬重迪安。

examples.text: His voice was warm with friendship and respect.
examples.translation: 他的声音里充满了友善和敬意。

examples.text: Finally, trying to respect her wishes, I said I'd leave.
examples.translation: 最后，为了尊重她的意愿，我说我会离开。

examples.text: They will campaign for the return of traditional lands and respect for aboriginal rights and customs.
examples.translation: 他们会争取讨回世代相传的土地，并要求尊重土著居民的权利和风俗。
