examples.text: It is about time tour operators respected the law and their own code of conduct.
examples.translation: 旅行社是时候该遵守法律和行业规范了。

examples.text: ...respect for the law and the rejection of the use of violence.
examples.translation: 遵守法律，反对使用暴力

examples.text: With respect, Minister, you still haven't answered my question...
examples.translation: 部长，恕我冒昧，您还没有回答我的问题。

examples.text: With respect, I hardly think that's the point.
examples.translation: 恕我直言，但我认为这不是重点。

examples.text: Carl had asked him to visit the hospital and to pay his respects to Francis.
examples.translation: 卡尔已经让他去医院看望弗朗西斯。

examples.text: The son had nothing to do with arranging the funeral, but came along to pay his last respects.
examples.translation: 这个儿子没有参与葬礼的安排，但是来向遗体告别了。

examples.text: The children are not unintelligent—in fact, they seem quite normal in this respect...
examples.translation: 这些孩子并非愚钝——事实上，在这个方面他们似乎很正常。

examples.text: In many respects Asian women see themselves as equal to their men.
examples.translation: 在很多方面，亚洲女性都认为自己和丈夫是平等的。

examples.text: Parents often have little choice with respect to the way their child is medically treated...
examples.translation: 关于孩子的治疗方法，父母通常没有什么选择的余地。

examples.text: Where Dr Shapland feels the system is not working most effectively is in respect of professional training.
examples.translation: 沙普兰博士认为系统在专业培训上的运作效率不是非常高。

examples.text: Steve and I were at very different stages in our respective careers...
examples.translation: 史蒂夫和我在各自的职业生涯中处于迥然不同的阶段。

examples.text: They went into their respective bedrooms to pack.
examples.translation: 他们回到各自的卧室打包。

meanings.meaning: 回答；作出反应；承担责任

examples.text: They are likely to respond positively to the President's request for aid...
examples.translation: 他们可能会对总统的援助要求作出积极回应。

examples.text: The army responded with gunfire and tear gas...
examples.translation: 军队用炮火和催泪瓦斯予以反击。

examples.text: 'Are you well enough to carry on?' — 'Of course,' she responded scornfully...
examples.translation: “你的身体状况可以继续工作吗？”——“当然，”她不屑地回答道。

examples.text: The Belgian Minister of Foreign Affairs responded that the protection of refugees was a matter for an international organization...
examples.translation: 比利时外交大臣回应说，保护难民是国际组织的事情。

examples.text: This modest group size allows our teachers to respond to the needs of each student.
examples.translation: 这样的小组规模适中，可以使老师照顾到每一个学生的需求。

examples.text: I'm pleased to say that he is now doing well and responding to treatment.
examples.translation: 我很高兴地说，他现在恢复得不错，治疗取得了积极的效果。

examples.text: There has been no response to his remarks from the government...
examples.translation: 政府尚未对他的言论作出回应。

examples.text: Your positive response will reinforce her actions...
examples.translation: 你积极的回应会使她的行为更加坚定。

examples.text: The meeting was called in response to a request from Venezuela.
examples.translation: 应委内瑞拉的要求召开了这次会议。

examples.text: Each manager had responsibility for just under 600 properties...
examples.translation: 每位经理负责将近600处房产。

examples.text: We need to take responsibility for looking after our own health...
examples.translation: 我们必须对自己的健康负责。

examples.text: 'She's not your responsibility,' he said gently.
examples.translation: “她不归你负责，”他温和地说道。

examples.text: No one admitted responsibility for the attacks...
examples.translation: 没有人对这些袭击负责。

examples.text: Someone had to give orders and take responsibility for mistakes.
examples.translation: 必须得有人下令，并为错误负责。

examples.text: He handled his responsibilities as a counselor in an intelligent and caring fashion.
examples.translation: 作为一名顾问他精明能干、热心周到。

examples.text: ...programmes to help employees balance work and family responsibilities.
examples.translation: 帮助雇员兼顾工作和家庭责任的项目

examples.text: She would have loved to have a better-paying job with more responsibility...
examples.translation: 她本想有一份报酬更高、职权更大的工作。

examples.text: Carrington held a position of responsibility within the government.
examples.translation: 卡林顿在政府机构身居要职。

examples.text: The court feels it has a responsibility to ensure that customers are not misled...
examples.translation: 法院认为它有责任确保消费者不受误导。

examples.text: As parents we have a responsibility to give our children a sense of belonging.
examples.translation: 作为父母，我们有责任给孩子一种归属感。

examples.text: She had decided that as a doctor she had a responsibility to her fellow creatures.
examples.translation: 她已经决定，作为医生，她应该对自己的同胞负责。

meanings.meaning: 负责的，可靠的；有责任的

examples.text: He still felt responsible for her death...
examples.translation: 他仍然觉得自己对她的死负有责任。

examples.text: I want you to do everything you can to find out who's responsible.
examples.translation: 我希望你能尽一切可能找出责任人。

examples.text: ...the minister responsible for the environment...
examples.translation: 负责环境工作的部长

examples.text: The man responsible for finding the volunteers is Dr. Charles Weber.
examples.translation: 负责寻找志愿者的人是查尔斯·韦伯博士。

examples.text: I'm responsible to my board of directors...
examples.translation: 我对董事会负责。

examples.text: The government will be responsible to the President alone.
examples.translation: 政府只对总统一人负责。

examples.text: He's a very responsible sort of person...
examples.translation: 他是个非常有责任心的人。

examples.text: He feels that the media should be more responsible in what they report.
examples.translation: 他觉得媒体应该对报道的内容更负责任些。

examples.text: He urged everyone to act responsibly.
examples.translation: 他敦促大家做事要有责任心。

examples.text: I work in a government office. It's a responsible position, I suppose, but not very exciting...
examples.translation: 我在政府机关工作。我想那是一个责任重大的职位，但并不是很有意思。

examples.text: They have been demoted to less responsible jobs.
examples.translation: 他们被降职去做不太重要的工作。

examples.text: They ate in an Italian restaurant in Forth Street...
examples.translation: 他们在第四大街的一家意大利餐馆吃了饭。

examples.text: We had dinner in the hotel's restaurant.
examples.translation: 我们在这家宾馆的餐厅吃了晚饭。

meanings.meaning: 使休息，使轻松；把…寄托于
休息，静止；休息时间；剩余部分；支架

examples.text: It was an experience I will treasure for the rest of my life...
examples.translation: 我的余生都会珍惜这次经历。

examples.text: I'm going to throw a party, then invest the rest of the money...
examples.translation: 我会开一个派对，然后把剩下的钱用来投资。

examples.text: He was unable to travel to Barcelona with the rest of the team.
examples.translation: 他未能和其他队员一起去巴塞罗那。

examples.text: Only 55 per cent of the raw material is canned. The rest is thrown away.
examples.translation: 只有55％的原材料被罐装储存。其余的都被扔掉了。

examples.text: ...a man with nice clothes, a Range Rover and the rest...
examples.translation: 一个穿着体面、开着路虎如此等等的男人

examples.text: And what about racism and all the rest of it?
examples.translation: 那种族主义之类的观念又怎么样呢？

examples.text: He's tired and exhausted, and has been advised to rest for two weeks...
examples.translation: 他精疲力竭，被建议休息两周。

examples.text: Try to rest the injured limb as much as possible.
examples.translation: 尽量不要活动受伤的手臂。

examples.text: 'You're worn out, Laura,' he said. 'Go home and get some rest.'...
examples.translation: “你太累了，劳拉，”他说，“回家休息一下吧。”

examples.text: After I've had a good rest, I'll tell you everything.
examples.translation: 我先好好歇一会儿，之后再告诉你一切。

examples.text: Such a view rests on a number of incorrect assumptions...
examples.translation: 这样的观点建立在很多不正确的假设之上。

examples.text: The long-term future of the country rests on how we teach our children.
examples.translation: 国家的长远未来取决于我们如何教育孩子。

examples.text: The judge said that whether Miss Bergman wishes to admit it or not, the responsibility rests with her. ...
examples.translation: 法官说不管伯格曼小姐愿不愿意承认，这件事的责任都在她。

examples.text: The final decision rested with the President.
examples.translation: 最后的决定权在于总统。

examples.text: He rested his arms on the back of the chair...
examples.translation: 他把手臂放在椅背上。

examples.text: He rested one of his crutches against the rail.
examples.translation: 他把一根拐杖靠在栏杆上。

examples.text: His head was resting on her shoulder...
examples.translation: 他的头靠在她的肩上。

examples.text: He had been resting his head in his hands, deep in thought.
examples.translation: 他双手撑着头，陷入了沉思。

examples.text: He rested on his pickaxe for a while.
examples.translation: 他在尖嘴镐上靠了一会儿。

examples.text: When you are sitting, keep your elbow on the arm rest.
examples.translation: 坐立时，把胳膊肘靠在扶手上。

examples.text: As she spoke, her eyes rested on her husband's face.
examples.translation: 她说话的时候，眼睛凝视着丈夫的脸。

examples.text: The plane had plowed a path through a patch of forest before coming to rest in a field.
examples.translation: 飞机猛冲过一片森林，在一片田野中停了下来。

examples.text: How can any woman rest easy now, knowing her breast cancer may be misdiagnosed?
examples.translation: 知道自己的乳腺癌可能被误诊，哪个女人能不担心呢？

examples.text: Give it a rest, will you? We're trying to get some sleep...
examples.translation: 你安静一下，好吗？我们想睡一会儿。

examples.text: I think you ought to give football a rest for a time.
examples.translation: 我认为你应该暂时停止踢足球。

examples.text: His dying wish was to be laid to rest at the church near his Somerset home.
examples.translation: 他的遗愿是把他安葬在家乡萨默塞特郡附近的教堂里。

examples.text: His speech should lay those fears to rest...
examples.translation: 他的演说应当会消除那些忧虑。

examples.text: I am determined to put to rest these rumours that we are in financial trouble.
examples.translation: 我决定平息那些说我们正面临财政困难的谣言。

examples.text: I am not prepared to let this matter rest...
examples.translation: 我不准备就此罢休。

examples.text: Let it rest, Rachel. Leave her in peace.
examples.translation: 别说了，雷切尔。让她平静一下。

examples.text: She was quick to put his mind at rest. 'Mrs Barrett will be delighted to have your brothers back,' she said...
examples.translation: 她很快就让他放心了。“巴雷特太太会很高兴让你的兄弟们回来的，”她说道。

examples.text: A brain scan last Friday finally set his mind at rest.
examples.translation: 上周五的脑部扫描终于让他放心了。

meanings.meaning: 焦躁不安的；不安宁的；得不到满足的

examples.text: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
examples.translation: 到了1982年，她感到厌倦了，需要新的动力来激发她的才能。

examples.text: ...a major new initiative to placate the country's restless intellectuals.
examples.translation: 安抚国家不安分的知识分子的重大新举措

examples.text: From the audience came increasing sounds of restlessness.
examples.translation: 观众不满的呼声越来越高。

examples.text: My father seemed very restless and excited.
examples.translation: 我父亲看起来坐立不安，激动不已。

examples.text: Karen complained of hyperactivity and restlessness.
examples.translation: 卡伦诉说自己有多动、焦躁不安的问题。

examples.text: He paced up and down restlessly, trying to put his thoughts in order.
examples.translation: 他坐立不安地走来走去，尽力想理清思绪。

examples.text: The shocking revelations of the 700-page report had caused him several restless nights...
examples.translation: 这篇长达700页的报告中披露的惊人信息使他几夜未眠。

examples.text: Hurt had spent a restless few hours on the plane from Paris.
examples.translation: 赫特在从巴黎起飞的飞机上辗转反侧了几个小时。

examples.text: The army has recently been brought in to restore order...
examples.translation: 最近军队被调来重整秩序。

examples.text: As they smiled at each other, harmony was restored again...
examples.translation: 他们彼此微笑的时候，又恢复了往日的和睦。

examples.text: The death penalty was never restored.
examples.translation: 再也没有恢复死刑。

examples.text: His visit is expected to lead to the restoration of diplomatic relations...
examples.translation: 人们期待他的出访会恢复外交关系。

examples.text: They were committed to the eventual restoration of a traditional monarchy.
examples.translation: 他们致力于传统君主政体的最终恢复。

examples.text: We will restore her to health but it may take time...
examples.translation: 我们会让她恢复健康，但可能需要一些时间。

examples.text: He said the ousted president must be restored to power...
examples.translation: 他说被赶下台的总统必须重新掌权。

examples.text: His country desperately needs Western aid to restore its ailing economy.
examples.translation: 他的国家急需西方援助以复苏其不景气的经济。

examples.text: I owe the restoration of my hearing to this remarkable new technique.
examples.translation: 多亏了这项非凡的新技术，我恢复了听力。

examples.text: ...experts who specialise in examining and restoring ancient parchments.
examples.translation: 专门致力于检查和修复古代羊皮纸文稿的专家

examples.text: ...the beautifully restored old town square.
examples.translation: 整修得很漂亮的古镇广场

examples.text: I specialized in the restoration of old houses...
examples.translation: 我专门从事旧房翻修。

examples.text: The bones were 'mislaid' during the seventeenth-century restorations.
examples.translation: 这些骨头在17世纪的修复工作中被“放错了位置”。

examples.text: The following day their horses and goods were restored to them...
examples.translation: 第二天，马匹和货物都归还给了他们。

examples.text: The looted property was restored and the chargé d'affaires was told that the soldiers responsible had been arrested.
examples.translation: 被劫财物已经物归原主，代办得知对此负有责任的士兵已被逮捕。

examples.text: Wally gripped my arm, partly to restrain me and partly to reassure me...
examples.translation: 沃利抓住我的手臂，一是想制止我，二是想稳住我。

examples.text: One onlooker had to be restrained by police.
examples.translation: 一个旁观者遭到了警察的制止。

examples.text: She was unable to restrain her desperate anger...
examples.translation: 她无法控制自己极度的愤怒。

examples.text: Unable to restrain herself, she rose and went to the phone...
examples.translation: 她没能克制住自己，起身走向电话。

examples.text: Gladys wanted to ask, 'Aren't you angry with him?' But she restrained herself from doing so.
examples.translation: 格拉迪丝想问，“你不生他的气吗？”但她忍住没问。

examples.text: The radical 500-day plan was very clear on how it intended to try to restrain inflation...
examples.translation: 这个为期500天的激进计划明确阐明将如何控制通货膨胀。

examples.text: In the 1970s, the government tried to restrain corruption.
examples.translation: 在20世纪70年代，政府曾经试图打击腐败。

examples.text: The Prime Minister is calling for new restraints on trade unions...
examples.translation: 首相正在呼吁对工会施加新的限制措施。

examples.text: With open frontiers and lax visa controls, criminals could cross into the country without restraint.
examples.translation: 由于边境开放和签证管理松懈，罪犯可以毫无限制地进入这个国家。

examples.text: They behaved with more restraint than I'd expected...
examples.translation: 他们表现得比我预料的更为克制。

examples.text: I'll speak to the staff and ask them to exercise restraint and common sense.
examples.translation: 我会和员工谈一谈，要他们加强自制，理智处事。

examples.text: For a year and a half, wage restraint on a voluntary basis worked...
examples.translation: 在一年半的时间里，自愿实行的限薪措施奏效了。

examples.text: He sued them for restraint of trade and won.
examples.translation: 他控告他们实行贸易管制，并且胜诉了。

examples.text: There is talk of raising the admission requirements to restrict the number of students on campus...
examples.translation: 有传闻称将通过提高录取条件来限制在校学生的数目。

examples.text: The French, I believe, restrict Japanese imports to a maximum of 3 per cent of their market.
examples.translation: 我认为，法国将把从日本的最高进口量限制在其市场总量的3％。

examples.text: Some restriction on funding was necessary.
examples.translation: 有必要对资金提供加以限制。

examples.text: Villagers say the fence would restrict public access to the hills...
examples.translation: 村民们说架篱笆能限制公众进山。

examples.text: The government imprisoned dissidents, forbade travel, and restricted the press...
examples.translation: 政府囚禁了持不同政见者，禁止出游，并且限制了新闻自由。

examples.text: These dams have restricted the flow of the river downstream.
examples.translation: 这些堤坝限制了河水顺流而下。

examples.text: ...the justification for this restriction of individual liberty.
examples.translation: 为这种限制个人自由的行为作出的辩护

examples.text: He was, however, allowed to stay on at the temple as long as he restricted himself to his studies...
examples.translation: 然而，只要他专心学习，他就可以继续留在寺庙里。

examples.text: The patient isn't restricted to a meagre diet...
examples.translation: 并没有限制这位病人少吃东西。

examples.text: For the first two weeks patients are restricted to the grounds.
examples.translation: 在头两周里，病人们只能在院子里活动。

examples.text: The hospital may restrict bookings to people living locally...
examples.translation: 这家医院可能会限定只有当地居民才能预约。

examples.text: Camping is restricted to five designated campgrounds.
examples.translation: 露营被限制在指定的5个野营地。

meanings.meaning: 结果；成绩；答案；比赛结果

examples.text: Compensation is available for people who have developed asthma as a direct result of their work...
examples.translation: 直接因工作原因患上哮喘的人会获得赔偿。

examples.text: A real pizza oven gives better results than an ordinary home oven.
examples.translation: 专门的比萨烤箱比普通家用烤箱效果更好。

examples.text: Fifty per cent of road accidents result in head injuries...
examples.translation: 50％的道路交通事故都会导致头部损伤。

examples.text: Regular trips back to her adopted motherland have resulted in her first book, Tiger Balm.
examples.translation: 经常返回她移居的国家让她写出了她的第一本书《万金油》。

examples.text: Many hair problems result from what you eat...
examples.translation: 很多头发问题都是由饮食引起的。

examples.text: Ignore the early warnings and illness could result.
examples.translation: 忽略早期征兆可能会导致疾病。

examples.text: 'What was the result?' — 'One-nil to Leeds.'...
examples.translation: “比赛结果怎样？”——“利兹队以1比0获胜。”

examples.text: The final election results will be announced on Friday.
examples.translation: 选举的最终结果将在周五宣布。

examples.text: ...the football results.
examples.translation: 足球赛结果

examples.text: They found their computers producing different results from exactly the same calculation.
examples.translation: 他们发现他们的计算机进行完全相同的计算会得出不同的结果。

examples.text: Kate's exam results were excellent.
examples.translation: 凯特的考试成绩非常出色。

meanings.meaning: 合力；结果；[化学] 生成物

examples.text: At least a quarter of a million people have died in the fighting and the resultant famines.
examples.translation: 至少25万人死于这场战斗和由此引发的饥荒。

meanings.meaning: 摘要；[管理] 履历，简历
重新开始，继续；恢复，重新占用

examples.text: After the war he resumed his duties at Emmanuel College...
examples.translation: 战争过后，他重新开始了在伊曼纽尔学院的工作。

examples.text: The search is expected to resume early today.
examples.translation: 预计搜寻工作会于今天早些时候重新开始。

examples.text: It is premature to speculate about the resumption of negotiations.
examples.translation: 现在猜测谈判是否会重新开始还为时过早。

examples.text: 'I changed my mind,' Blanche said, resuming her seat.
examples.translation: “我改变主意了，”布兰奇说着回到她的座位上。

examples.text: 'Hey, Judith,' he resumed, 'tell me all about yourself.'
examples.translation: “嘿，朱迪思，”他接着说，“跟我谈谈你自己吧。”

examples.text: ...retail stores...
examples.translation: 零售店

examples.text: Retail sales grew just 3.8 percent last year.
examples.translation: 去年零售额只上升了3.8%。

examples.text: It originally retailed at £23.50.
examples.translation: 它原来的零售价格是23.50英镑。

examples.text: Mr Hastings gleefully retailed the story to Mr Anderson over lunch.
examples.translation: 黑斯廷斯先生在午宴上兴致勃勃地把这个故事向安德森先生详述了一遍。

examples.text: The interior of the shop still retains a nineteenth-century atmosphere...
examples.translation: 这家商店的内部装修仍然保留着19世纪的风格。

examples.text: He retains a deep respect for the profession...
examples.translation: 他对这个职业仍然深怀敬意。

examples.text: Other countries retained their traditional and habitual ways of doing things...
examples.translation: 其他国家仍然保持着他们做事的传统和习惯。

examples.text: If left covered in a warm place, this rice will retain its heat for a good hour.
examples.translation: 如果加盖放在暖和的地方，这些米饭可以保温足足一个小时。

examples.text: He decided to retain him for the trial.
examples.translation: 他决定聘请他为出庭律师。

meanings.meaning: 保留；扣留，滞留；记忆力；闭尿

examples.text: They supported the retention of a strong central government.
examples.translation: 他们赞成保留一个强大的中央政府。

examples.text: At the age when most people retire, he is ready to face a new career...
examples.translation: 在大多数人都退休的年龄，他却准备好面对新的职业。

examples.text: Although their careers are important many said they plan to retire at 50...
examples.translation: 虽然事业很重要，但很多人都说他们打算50岁退休。

examples.text: In 1974 he retired from the museum.
examples.translation: 他1974年从博物馆退休了。

examples.text: I have decided to retire from Formula One racing at the end of the season...
examples.translation: 我已经决定在这个赛季末结束一级方程式赛车生涯。

examples.text: One of the most serious injuries was to Simon Littlejohn, who was forced to retire from the race with a leg injury.
examples.translation: 伤势最重的人之一是西蒙·利特尔约翰，他腿部受伤，被迫退出了比赛。

examples.text: Eisenhower left the White House and retired to his farm in Gettysburg.
examples.translation: 艾森豪威尔离开白宫，退隐到他在葛底斯堡的农场。

examples.text: The jury will retire to consider its verdict today.
examples.translation: 陪审团今天将退庭商议裁决结果。

examples.text: She retires early most nights, exhausted...
examples.translation: 她大多数晚上都觉得精疲力尽，很早就睡了。

examples.text: Some time after midnight, he retired to bed.
examples.translation: 午夜过后，他上床就寝。

examples.text: Was he afraid, he was asked. 'Afraid of what?' he retorted...
examples.translation: 有人问他是否害怕。“害怕什么？”他反问道。

examples.text: Others retort that strong central power is a dangerous thing in Russia.
examples.translation: 其他人反驳说强大的中央集权在俄罗斯是很危险的。

examples.text: His sharp retort clearly made an impact.
examples.translation: 他尖刻的反驳显然起了作用。

examples.text: 'I've already got a job,' I said quickly, and retreated from the room...
examples.translation: “我已经有了一份工作。”我马上说道，并从房间里退了出来。

examples.text: The young nurse pulled a face at the Matron's retreating figure.
examples.translation: 看着护士长离去的身影，这个年轻的护士做了个鬼脸。

examples.text: The French, suddenly outnumbered, were forced to retreat...
examples.translation: 人数突然处于劣势的法军被迫撤退。

examples.text: Retreating soldiers were dousing homes and shops with petrol and setting them on fire.
examples.translation: 撤退的士兵把汽油浇到住宅和商店上，并放火焚烧。

examples.text: In June 1942, the British 8th Army was in full retreat.
examples.translation: 1942年6月，英国第八军全面撤退。

examples.text: I believe people should live in houses that allow them to retreat from the harsh realities of life...
examples.translation: 我认为人们所居住的房子应该能让他们远离残酷的现实生活。

examples.text: From bouncing confidence she had retreated into self-pity.
examples.translation: 她从信心百倍变得自怜自哀。

examples.text: The President's remarks appear to signal that there will be no retreat from his position...
examples.translation: 总统的言辞似乎在暗示他不会主动辞职。

examples.text: It's a retreat into the adolescence they never really had.
examples.translation: 这是对他们从不曾真正拥有的青春时代的回归。

examples.text: He spent yesterday hidden away in his country retreat.
examples.translation: 他昨天躲在了他乡下的静养地。

examples.text: Cockburn decided it was time to beat a hasty retreat.
examples.translation: 科伯恩认为到了该紧急撤退的时候了。

examples.text: He reached over and retrieved his jacket from the back seat...
examples.translation: 他伸手从后座上取回了自己的夹克。

examples.text: The men were trying to retrieve weapons left when the army abandoned the island.
examples.translation: 士兵们正试图找回军队从该岛撤退时留下的武器。

examples.text: He is the one man who could retrieve that situation.
examples.translation: 他是唯一能挽回局面的人。

examples.text: Computers can instantly retrieve millions of information bits...
examples.translation: 计算机可以立即检索到数百万条信息。

examples.text: As the child gets older, so his or her strategies for storing and retrieving information improve.
examples.translation: 随着孩子们长大，他们储存和检索信息的能力也会提高。

examples.text: In retrospect, I wish that I had thought about alternative courses of action...
examples.translation: 回想起来，我真希望自己当时考虑过其他做法。

examples.text: It was a very strange feeling in retrospect — I was frightened, but excited at the same time.
examples.translation: 回想起来那是一种非常奇怪的感觉——我当时既害怕又兴奋。

examples.text: She has refused to reveal the whereabouts of her daughter...
examples.translation: 她不肯透露她女儿的行踪。

examples.text: A survey of the British diet has revealed that a growing number of people are overweight...
examples.translation: 对英国人饮食进行的一项调查显示有越来越多的人超重。

examples.text: After the fire, it was revealed that North Carolina officials had never inspected the factory...
examples.translation: 大火过后人们发现北卡罗来纳州的官员从没对这家工厂进行过检查。

examples.text: No test will reveal how much of the drug was taken.
examples.translation: 没有哪项测试可以测出用药量。

examples.text: A grey carpet was removed to reveal the original pine floor.
examples.translation: 一块灰色的地毯被揭开，露出了原来的松木地板。

examples.text: Blair will return to London tonight...
examples.translation: 今晚布莱尔将返回伦敦。

examples.text: Our correspondent Stephen Sackur has just returned from the camps on the border...
examples.translation: 我们的通讯记者斯蒂芬·萨克刚从边境的营地回来。

examples.text: So far more than 350,000 people have returned home.
examples.translation: 迄今已有35万多人返回了家园。

examples.text: Ryle explained the reason for his sudden return to London.
examples.translation: 赖尔解释了他突然返回伦敦的原因。

examples.text: I enjoyed the book and said so when I returned it...
examples.translation: 我喜欢这本书，并且在还书时也这样说了。

examples.text: The car was not returned on time, then was reported stolen.
examples.translation: 这辆车没有按时归还，然后就报失了。

examples.text: The main demand of the Indians is for the return of one-and-a-half-million acres of forest to their communities.
examples.translation: 印第安人的主要要求是将150万英亩的森林归还给他们族群。

examples.text: He returned the notebook to his jacket.
examples.translation: 他把笔记本放回到他的夹克里。

examples.text: Back at the station the Chief Inspector returned the call...
examples.translation: 探长回到警察局后回了电话。

examples.text: She will be disappointed if her feelings are not returned.
examples.translation: 如果她的感情得不到回报，她会感到非常失望。

examples.text: Official reports in Algeria suggest that calm is returning to the country...
examples.translation: 阿尔及利亚的官方报告表明这个国家正在恢复往日的平静。

examples.text: The pain returned in waves.
examples.translation: 疼痛又如潮水般阵阵袭来。

examples.text: It was like the return of his youth.
examples.translation: 他似乎又回到了年轻时代。

examples.text: Life has improved and returned to normal.
examples.translation: 生活已经改善并恢复了正常。

examples.text: He made an uneventful return to normal health...
examples.translation: 他的身体顺利康复了。

examples.text: The opposition now fears a return to martial rule.
examples.translation: 现在反对派害怕恢复军事统治。

examples.text: The power of the Church is one theme all these writers return to.
examples.translation: 所有这些作家都回归到了教会权力这个主题上。

examples.text: At that stage he will be 52, young enough to return to politics if he wishes to do so.
examples.translation: 那时他将会是52岁，还很年轻，如果他希望的话，仍可重返政坛。

examples.text: He has not ruled out the shock possibility of a return to football.
examples.translation: 他没有排除有一天会出惊人决定重返足坛。

examples.text: They returned a verdict of not guilty.
examples.translation: 他们宣布了无罪的判决。

examples.text: He bought a return ticket and boarded the next train for home.
examples.translation: 他买了往返票，并登上了下一趟回家的火车。

examples.text: BA and Air France charge more than £400 for a return to Nice.
examples.translation: 英国航空公司和法国航空公司去尼斯的往返票价为400多英镑。

examples.text: Buy an extra ticket for the return trip.
examples.translation: 多买一张返程票。

examples.text: Profits have picked up this year but the return on capital remains tiny...
examples.translation: 今年的利润已经回升，但是资本收益仍然很少。

examples.text: Higher returns and higher risk usually go hand in hand.
examples.translation: 更高的收益通常伴随着更高的风险。

examples.text: He was convicted of filing false income tax returns...
examples.translation: 他因为在纳税申报表上作假而被定罪。

examples.text: Anyone with slight complications in their tax affairs is likely to be asked to fill in a return.
examples.translation: 任何在税务方面情况稍微复杂的人都可能要填写税收申报表。

examples.text: Early returns show Bulgaria's opposition party may have won.
examples.translation: 早期的选举结果表明保加利亚的反对党可能已获胜。

examples.text: You pay regular premiums and in return the insurance company will pay out a lump sum.
examples.translation: 你定期支付保险费，而保险公司则会一次性给你一笔钱作为回报。

examples.text: The deal offers an increase in policy value in return for giving up guarantees.
examples.translation: 作为放弃担保的交换，这笔交易将提高保单价值。

examples.text: The release of Mr Nelson Mandela marked the point of no return in South Africa's movement away from apartheid.
examples.translation: 纳尔逊·曼德拉先生的释放标志着南非种族隔离政策一去不复返。

meanings.meaning: 启示；揭露；出乎意料的事；被揭露的真相

examples.text: ...the seemingly everlasting revelations about his private life.
examples.translation: 对他的私生活看似没完没了的曝光

examples.text: ...the revelation that William had survived the initial attack.
examples.translation: 威廉在首次袭击中幸存下来的惊人内幕

examples.text: ...following the revelation of his affair with a former secretary...
examples.translation: 在他和前秘书的私情被揭露之后

examples.text: Further revelations are expected.
examples.translation: 人们期待着真相的进一步披露。

examples.text: The noise, the buildings, the people, came as a revelation...
examples.translation: 这里的噪音、建筑物和人都令人出乎意料。

examples.text: Degas's work had been a revelation to her.
examples.translation: 德加的作品曾经让她大开眼界。

examples.text: The whole system was based on divine revelation in the Scriptures.
examples.translation: 整个体系都建立在《圣经》的神圣启示的基础之上。

examples.text: The attackers were said to be taking revenge on the 14-year-old, claiming he was a school bully...
examples.translation: 据说，这些攻击者是在报复这个14岁的孩子，说他是学校的小霸王。

examples.text: The killings were said to have been in revenge for the murder of her lover.
examples.translation: 据说，她杀人是为了替她被害的情人报仇。

examples.text: The Sunday Mercury accused her of trying to revenge herself on her former lover...
examples.translation: 《星期日信使报》指责她企图报复她以前的情人。

examples.text: ...the relatives of murdered villagers wanting to revenge the dead.
examples.translation: 想要为死者报仇的被害村民的亲属

examples.text: ...a boom year at the cinema, with record advertising revenue and the highest ticket sales since 1980...
examples.translation: 电影院非常景气的一年，创下1980年以来广告及票房收入新高

examples.text: One study said the government would gain about $12 billion in tax revenues over five years.
examples.translation: 一项研究表明政府将在5年中获得约120亿美元的税收。

examples.text: They have made it clear they will not reverse the decision to increase prices...
examples.translation: 他们已经明确表示不会更改提价的决定。

examples.text: The rise, the first in 10 months, reversed the downward trend in Belgium's jobless rate.
examples.translation: 10个月来失业率的首次上升逆转了比利时失业率持续下降的趋势。

examples.text: In the squares place a penny, nickel, dime and quarter in that order. The object is to reverse the order of these coins...
examples.translation: 在这些方块中按顺序放置1分、5分、10分和25分的硬币各一枚。目标是颠倒这些硬币的顺序。

examples.text: The normal word order is reversed in passive sentences.
examples.translation: 正常词序在被动句中是颠倒的。

examples.text: He reversed the position of the two stamps.
examples.translation: 他将两枚邮票的位置调换了一下。

examples.text: Another car reversed out of the drive...
examples.translation: 另一辆车倒出了车道。

examples.text: He reversed and drove away...
examples.translation: 他把车倒出来，开走了。

examples.text: He reversed his car straight at the policeman.
examples.translation: 他径直把车倒向警察。

examples.text: He lurched the car in reverse along the ruts to the access road.
examples.translation: 他顺着车辙摇摇晃晃地将车倒到了支路上。

examples.text: The wrong attitude will have exactly the reverse effect.
examples.translation: 错误的态度会产生完全相反的效果。

examples.text: There is absolutely no evidence at all that spectators want longer cricket matches. Quite the reverse...
examples.translation: 完全没有证据表明观众想看时间更长的板球比赛。情况恰恰相反。

examples.text: This would lead one to expect a fat, dense and detailed autobiography. The reverse is true. The book is short and spare.
examples.translation: 这会让人以为是一本内容晦涩而详尽的大部头自传。但正好相反，这本书简短明了。

examples.text: It's clear that the party of the former Prime Minister has suffered a major reverse.
examples.translation: 显然，前首相所在党派遭受了重大的挫折。

examples.text: Cheques should be made payable to Country Living and your address written on the reverse.
examples.translation: 支票抬头必须写“《乡村生活》杂志”，你的地址应写在背面。

examples.text: Amis tells the story in reverse, from the moment the man dies...
examples.translation: 埃米斯以倒叙的方式讲述了这个故事，从这个男人死去的时候开始讲起。

examples.text: The downward trend went into reverse and the scores started to creep up again.
examples.translation: 比分下降的趋势发生逆转，分数又开始逐渐上升了。

meanings.meaning: 回顾；复习；评论；检讨；检阅

examples.text: The president ordered a review of US economic aid to Jordan...
examples.translation: 总统下令对美国向约旦提供的经济援助进行审查。

examples.text: The White House quickly announced that the policy is under review.
examples.translation: 白宫很快宣布该项政策正在审核中。

examples.text: The Prime Minister reviewed the situation with his Cabinet yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天，首相和他的内阁对局势进行了审度。

examples.text: The next day we reviewed the previous day's work.
examples.translation: 第二天，我们仔细检查了头一天的工作。

examples.text: Disney's 'Beauty And The Beast' has won rave reviews...
examples.translation: 迪斯尼出品的电影《美女与野兽》赢得了众多好评。

examples.text: We've never had a good review in the music press.
examples.translation: 我们从未在音乐媒体获得过好评。

examples.text: Richard Coles reviews all of the latest video releases...
examples.translation: 理查德·科尔斯为所有最新发行的录影带都写了评论。

examples.text: His book about Afghanistan is reviewed here by Anthony Hyman.
examples.translation: 安东尼·海曼在此就他那本关于阿富汗的书写了书评。

examples.text: When he reviewed the troops they cheered him as he smiled and raised his hat.
examples.translation: 他检阅军队时微笑着举起帽子，人们与此同时都向他欢呼。

examples.text: Reviewing for exams gives you a chance to bring together all the individual parts of the course...
examples.translation: 考前复习让你有机会把一门课程所有零碎的知识都融会贯通。

examples.text: Review all the notes you need to cover for each course.
examples.translation: 把每一门课程需要掌握的笔记都复习一下。

examples.text: Begin by planning on three two-hour reviews with four chapters per session.
examples.translation: 先安排3次温习时间，每次用2个小时复习4个章节。

examples.text: He soon came to revise his opinion of the profession.
examples.translation: 他很快就改变了对这个职业的看法。

examples.text: They realised that some of their prices were higher than their competitors' and revised prices accordingly...
examples.translation: 他们意识到自己有些价格高于竞争对手，就相应调整了价格。

examples.text: The United Nations has been forced to revise its estimates of population growth upwards.
examples.translation: 联合国已经被迫上调了其对人口增长做出的预测。

examples.text: Three editors handled the work of revising the articles for publication...
examples.translation: 3位编辑负责文章的修订出版工作。

examples.text: The staff should work together to revise the school curriculum.
examples.translation: 全体教职工应当齐心协力修订学校课程。

examples.text: I have to revise for maths...
examples.translation: 我得复习数学。

examples.text: I'd better skip the party and stay at home to revise.
examples.translation: 我最好还是不去参加这个聚会，留在家里温习功课。

meanings.meaning: 复兴；复活；苏醒；恢复精神
使复兴；使苏醒；回想起；重演，重播

examples.text: ...an attempt to revive the British economy...
examples.translation: 试图复兴英国经济的努力

examples.text: His trial revived memories of French suffering during the war...
examples.translation: 他的受审重新勾起了在战争中受苦受难的法国人民的回忆。

examples.text: There is no doubt that grades have improved and interest in education has revived.
examples.translation: 无疑，成绩提高了，上学的兴趣也恢复了。

examples.text: Habib grimaced at the revived memories.
examples.translation: 重新涌上心头的记忆让哈比卜愁眉苦脸。

examples.text: The Gaiety is reviving John B. Kean's comedy 'The Man from Clare'.
examples.translation: 盖伊提剧院正在重新上演约翰·B. 基恩的喜剧《来自克莱尔的人》。

examples.text: She and a neighbour tried in vain to revive him...
examples.translation: 她和邻居想尽一切办法都没能让他苏醒过来。

examples.text: With a glazed stare she revived for one last instant.
examples.translation: 她最后清醒了一会儿，眼神呆滞。

examples.text: It was undeniably a revolt by ordinary people against their leaders...
examples.translation: 不可否认，这是一场平民百姓反抗领导人的起义。

examples.text: The newly-occupied Italian colony of Libya rose in revolt in 1914.
examples.translation: 意大利新占领的殖民地利比亚于1914年发生叛乱。

examples.text: In 1375 the townspeople revolted...
examples.translation: 1375年，市民奋起反抗。

examples.text: Zanzibar's fortunes declined after the islanders revolted against the sultanate in 1964.
examples.translation: 桑给巴尔岛的居民于1964年反抗苏丹统治，随后时局便不断恶化。

examples.text: The prime minister is facing a revolt by party activists over his refusal to hold a referendum...
examples.translation: 因为拒绝进行公民投票，首相正面临着党内激进分子的反抗。

examples.text: Soon the entire armed forces were in open revolt.
examples.translation: 很快，整个武装部队开始公然抗命。

examples.text: The prime minister only reacted when three of his senior cabinet colleagues revolted and resigned in protest on Friday night...
examples.translation: 直到周五晚上首相的3位高级内阁同僚倒戈并辞职以示抗议时，首相才有所反应。

examples.text: Caroline revolted against her ballet training at sixteen.
examples.translation: 卡罗琳16岁时拒绝接受芭蕾舞训练。

examples.text: The period since the revolution has been one of political turmoil.
examples.translation: 革命爆发后就陷入了政治动乱期。

examples.text: ...after the French Revolution.
examples.translation: 法国革命之后

examples.text: ...before the 1917 Revolution.
examples.translation: 1917年革命之前

examples.text: The nineteenth century witnessed a revolution in ship design and propulsion.
examples.translation: 19世纪船舶设计和船舶动力领域发生了重大的变革。

examples.text: ...the industrial revolution.
examples.translation: 工业革命

meanings.meaning: 革命的；旋转的；大变革的

examples.text: Do you know anything about the revolutionary movement?
examples.translation: 你了解这场革命运动吗？

examples.text: ...the Cuban revolutionary leader, Jose Marti.
examples.translation: 古巴革命领导人何塞·马蒂

examples.text: The revolutionaries laid down their arms and its leaders went into voluntary exile.
examples.translation: 革命者放下了武器，其领导人也自愿流亡他国了。

examples.text: Invented in 1951, the rotary engine is a revolutionary concept in internal combustion...
examples.translation: 1951年发明的转缸式发动机是内燃机领域内的革命性概念。

examples.text: His playing as a trumpet player was quite revolutionary.
examples.translation: 他的小号演奏独创一格。

meanings.meaning: 旋转；循环出现；反复考虑
使…旋转；使…循环；反复考虑

examples.text: Since childhood, her life has revolved around tennis...
examples.translation: 从孩童时期开始，她的生活就以网球为中心。

examples.text: This plot revolves around a youngster who is shown various stages of his life.
examples.translation: 这个故事情节围绕着一个年轻人展开，描述了他人生的各个阶段。

examples.text: The debate revolves around specific accounting techniques...
examples.translation: 这场争论的焦点是具体的会计技术。

examples.text: The conversation revolved around the terrible condition of the road.
examples.translation: 这次对话主要讨论这条路的糟糕路况。

examples.text: The satellite revolves around the Earth once every hundred minutes.
examples.translation: 这颗人造卫星每100分钟围绕地球旋转一周。

examples.text: Overhead, the fan revolved slowly...
examples.translation: 风扇在头顶上缓缓地转动着。

examples.text: Monica picked up her Biro and revolved it between her teeth.
examples.translation: 莫妮卡拿起她的伯罗圆珠笔，放在牙齿间转动着。

examples.text: A bonus of up to 5 per cent can be added to a pupil's final exam marks as a reward for good spelling, punctuation and grammar...
examples.translation: 小学生期末考试的分数最多可以加5分，作为对其拼写、标点和语法正确的奖励。

examples.text: He was given the job as a reward for running a successful leadership bid.
examples.translation: 因为成功组织了领导职位竞选活动，他得到了这份工作。

examples.text: The firm last night offered a £10,000 reward for information leading to the conviction of the killer.
examples.translation: 昨晚这家公司悬赏 1万英镑，寻找能将凶手定罪的证据。

examples.text: Make the extra effort to impress the buyer and you will be rewarded with a quicker sale.
examples.translation: 多用心去打动顾客，货物就会更快售出。

examples.text: The company is only just starting to reap the rewards of long-term investments...
examples.translation: 这家公司才刚刚开始收获长期投资的回报。

examples.text: Potentially high financial rewards are attached to senior hospital posts.
examples.translation: 当上医院的高级职员就有可能享受丰厚的经济报酬。

examples.text: The compression and density make this a difficult book to read, but it richly rewards the effort.
examples.translation: 这本书内容丰富，思想深刻，很难读懂，但是非常值得一读。

examples.text: His music of that period fused the rhythms of Jazz with classical forms...
examples.translation: 他那个时期的音乐将爵士乐的韵律和古典音乐的形式融合在了一起。

examples.text: He had no sense of rhythm whatsoever...
examples.translation: 他没有任何节奏感。

examples.text: She could hear the constant rhythm of his breathing.
examples.translation: 她能听见他均匀而有节奏的呼吸。

examples.text: Begin to listen to your own body rhythms.
examples.translation: 开始聆听你自己身体的节奏。

examples.text: ...the seasonal rhythm of the agricultural year.
examples.translation: 一年中农业的季节性

examples.text: Her heart was thumping against her ribs...
examples.translation: 她的心脏紧抵着肋骨砰砰跳动。

examples.text: My face was covered with bruises and I had a broken rib.
examples.translation: 我的脸上全是瘀伤，肋骨还断了一根。

examples.text: ...a rib of beef.
examples.translation: 牛排

examples.text: ...pork ribs in sweet sauce.
examples.translation: 带甜酱的猪排

examples.text: The guys in my local pub used to rib me about drinking 'girly' drinks.
examples.translation: 我家当地酒馆里的人以前总是取笑我喝“女人”饮料。

meanings.meaning: 带；缎带；（勋章等的）绶带；带状物；勋表
把…撕成条带；用缎带装饰

examples.text: She had tied back her hair with a peach satin ribbon.
examples.translation: 她用一根桃色缎带把头发扎在脑后。

examples.text: ...a piece of ribbon.
examples.translation: 一根丝带

meanings.meaning: (Rice)人名；(瑞典)里瑟；(塞)里采；(英)赖斯

examples.text: ...a meal consisting of chicken, rice and vegetables...
examples.translation: 有鸡肉、米饭和蔬菜的一顿饭

examples.text: Thailand exports its fine rices around the world.
examples.translation: 泰国将精米出口到世界各地。

meanings.meaning: (Rich)人名；(丹)里克；(捷)里赫；(英、西)里奇；(葡、法)里什

examples.text: You're going to be a very rich man...
examples.translation: 你将会成为一个非常有钱的人。

examples.text: Their one aim in life is to get rich...
examples.translation: 他们人生的一个目标就是要变成有钱人。

examples.text: With nothing but his own talent, he made himself rich and famous.
examples.translation: 他一无所有，仅靠自身才能就变得富有而出名。

examples.text: This is a system in which the rich are cared for and the poor are left to suffer...
examples.translation: 在这种制度之下，富人备受关照而穷人却受苦受难。

examples.text: Only the very rich have really benefited.
examples.translation: 只有非常有钱的人才真正受益了。

examples.text: ...a gossip page featuring the rich and famous.
examples.translation: 关注富人和名人的八卦版

examples.text: An Olympic gold medal can lead to untold riches for an athlete...
examples.translation: 一枚奥运金牌能给运动员带来无尽的财富。

examples.text: Some people want fame or riches — I just wanted a baby.
examples.translation: 有人希望得到名望，有人希望获得财富——我只想要个孩子。

examples.text: There is hunger in many parts of the world, even in rich countries.
examples.translation: 世界上很多地方，甚至在富有的国家里，都有人忍饥挨饿。

examples.text: ...Russia's vast natural riches.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯丰富的自然资源

examples.text: ...the oil riches of the Middle East.
examples.translation: 中东的石油资源

examples.text: Liver and kidney are particularly rich in vitamin A...
examples.translation: 肝脏和肾脏的维生素A含量尤其丰富。

examples.text: Fish is a rich source of protein.
examples.translation: 鱼肉富含蛋白质。

examples.text: ...the hearty, rich foods of Gascony...
examples.translation: 加斯科涅丰盛而油腻的食物

examples.text: Additional cream would make it too rich.
examples.translation: 再加奶油会让它过于油腻。

examples.text: The coffee flavour complemented the richness of the pudding.
examples.translation: 咖啡的味道中和了布丁的油腻感。

examples.text: Farmers grow rice in the rich soil.
examples.translation: 农民们在肥沃的土地上种植稻子。

examples.text: ...the country's rich deposits of the metal, lithium.
examples.translation: 这个国家丰富的锂金属矿藏

examples.text: ...the richness of the country's mineral deposits.
examples.translation: 该国丰富的矿藏

examples.text: The director discovered a rich vein of sentimentality...
examples.translation: 导演发现了一个丰富的情感源泉。

examples.text: My collection of Victorian literature turned out to be a rich and often hilarious source of information.
examples.translation: 我收藏的维多利亚时代的文学作品竟成了一个资源丰富的信息宝库，而且内容常常令人捧腹。

examples.text: ...a rich and luxuriously perfumed bath essence.
examples.translation: 香味浓郁的沐浴香精

examples.text: ...an attractive, glossy rich red colour.
examples.translation: 迷人而富有光泽的艳红色

examples.text: ...the richness of colour in Gauguin's paintings.
examples.translation: 高更画作中绚丽的颜色

examples.text: A rich and varied cultural life is essential for this couple.
examples.translation: 丰富多样的文化生活对这对夫妇而言至关重要。

examples.text: ...the rich history of the island...
examples.translation: 这个岛屿灿烂的历史

examples.text: Manchester has a rich cultural, economic and sporting heritage.
examples.translation: 曼彻斯特有丰富的文化、经济和体育遗产。

examples.text: It all adds to the richness of human life.
examples.translation: 这一切让人类的生活更加丰富多彩。

examples.text: Visitors can view a rich and colorful array of aquatic plants and animals...
examples.translation: 游客们可以看到一系列各种各样、色彩斑斓的水生动植物。

examples.text: Australia has a rich cultural mix.
examples.translation: 澳大利亚拥有丰富多样的文化。

examples.text: ...a rich vocabulary.
examples.translation: 大量的词汇

examples.text: ...a huge country, containing a richness of culture and diversity of landscape.
examples.translation: 拥有丰富的文化和复杂多样的地貌的大国

examples.text: Gil says that women can't keep secrets. That's rich, coming from him, the professional sneak.
examples.translation: 吉尔说女人不能保守秘密。这话从他这样一个整天打小报告的人嘴里说出来真是太荒谬了。

examples.text: He's stinking rich, and with no more talent than he ever had before.
examples.translation: 他现在已经有几个臭钱了，但仍然和以前一样没什么才能。

examples.text: ...a handful of filthy rich young men who work eight months a year.
examples.translation: 少数几个每年只工作8个月的腰缠万贯的年轻人

examples.text: The owner needs to get rid of the car for financial reasons...
examples.translation: 因为经济原因，车主必须把汽车处理掉。

examples.text: There's corruption, and we're going to get rid of it...
examples.translation: 存在贪污腐败现象，我们将予以清除。

examples.text: She will have to get rid of the excess weight on her hips.
examples.translation: 她得减去臀部多余的脂肪。

examples.text: He believed that his manager wanted to get rid of him for personal reasons...
examples.translation: 他认为经理是出于个人原因想开除他。

examples.text: You seem in rather a hurry to get rid of me.
examples.translation: 看起来你急于想摆脱我。

examples.text: The proposals are an attempt to rid the country of political corruption...
examples.translation: 这些提议试图使这个国家摆脱政治腐败。

examples.text: The new vaccine may rid the world of one of its most terrifying diseases.
examples.translation: 这种新疫苗可能会消除世界上最可怕的一种疾病。

examples.text: Why couldn't he ever rid himself of those thoughts, those worries?
examples.translation: 为什么他总是无法摆脱那些想法和担忧?

examples.text: ...the country's efforts to rid itself of poverty and hunger.
examples.translation: 该国为了消除贫困和饥饿而作出的努力

examples.text: The family had sought a way to be rid of her and the problems she had caused them.
examples.translation: 这家人已经找到一个方法摆脱她以及她给他们带来的问题。

examples.text: It seems to me your wife was a shallow woman and you're well rid of her.
examples.translation: 在我看来你妻子是一个浅薄的女人，幸好你离开了她。

meanings.meaning: 谜语；粗筛；谜一般的人、东西、事情等

examples.text: Scientists claimed yesterday to have solved the riddle of the birth of the Universe.
examples.translation: 科学家们昨天声称已经解开了宇宙形成之谜。

examples.text: Unknown attackers riddled two homes with gunfire...
examples.translation: 来路不明的袭击者用枪炮将两处住宅打得千疮百孔。

examples.text: The darkness saved me from being riddled with bullets.
examples.translation: 身处黑暗中让我不至于被子弹打得浑身是洞。

meanings.meaning: 骑；乘；控制；（骑马、自行车等）穿越；搭乘；飘浮
骑；乘坐；交通工具；可供骑行的路；（乘坐汽车等的）旅行；乘骑；（乘车或骑车的）短途旅程；供乘骑的游乐设施

examples.text: I saw a girl riding a horse...
examples.translation: 我看见一个骑马的女孩。

examples.text: Can you ride?...
examples.translation: 你会骑马吗？

examples.text: He was riding on his horse looking for the castle...
examples.translation: 他正骑着马寻找那座城堡。

examples.text: They still ride around on horses.
examples.translation: 他们仍然骑着马到处转。

examples.text: Riding a bike is great exercise...
examples.translation: 骑自行车是很好的运动。

examples.text: Two men riding on motorcycles opened fire on him...
examples.translation: 两个骑摩托车的男人向他开了枪。

examples.text: He rode to work on a bicycle.
examples.translation: 他骑自行车上班。

examples.text: He prefers travelling on the Tube to riding in a limousine...
examples.translation: 他更愿意乘地铁出行，不愿坐豪华轿车。

examples.text: I was riding on the back of a friend's bicycle...
examples.translation: 我当时坐在一个朋友的自行车后座上。

examples.text: I remember the village full of American servicemen riding around in jeeps...
examples.translation: 我记得当时村子里满是开着吉普到处转悠的美国兵。

examples.text: I rode to Lily's in a cab.
examples.translation: 我乘出租车去了莉莉家。

examples.text: She took some friends for a ride in the family car...
examples.translation: 她开着自己的家庭轿车载着几个朋友出去兜了一圈。

examples.text: Would you like to go for a ride?...
examples.translation: 你想出去兜风吗？

examples.text: She lives just a short bus ride from school.
examples.translation: 她住的地方从学校乘公交车就几站地。

examples.text: Billions of pounds are riding on the outcome of the election...
examples.translation: 几十亿英镑都取决于这次选举的结果。

examples.text: Everything rides on the judgment of these few men.
examples.translation: 一切都取决于对这几个人的判决。

examples.text: He was riding high in the public opinion polls...
examples.translation: 他在民意调查中支持率颇高。

examples.text: His team is riding high.
examples.translation: 他的团队正春风得意。

examples.text: The Chancellor could face a rough ride unless the plan works...
examples.translation: 除非这个计划能够奏效，否则财政大臣将举步维艰。

examples.text: The woman who is brave enough to pursue her own path must prepare herself for a rough ride.
examples.translation: 勇于走自己道路的女人就必须准备好面对外界的非难。

examples.text: When he had not returned with my money an hour later I realized that I had been taken for a ride.
examples.translation: 1个小时后他没有带着我的钱回来，我才意识到自己上当受骗了。

examples.text: ...the bony ridge of the eye socket.
examples.translation: 眼窝处突出的骨骼

examples.text: It is ridiculous to suggest we are having a romance...
examples.translation: 暗示我们正在谈恋爱的说法真是太荒谬了。

examples.text: It was an absolutely ridiculous decision.
examples.translation: 这是一个绝对荒谬的决定。

examples.text: They shot him at point blank range with an automatic rifle...
examples.translation: 他们用自动步枪近距离开枪射杀了他。

examples.text: Neighbours heard the sound of rifle fire and alerted the police.
examples.translation: 邻居们听到了步枪声，就报了警。

examples.text: I discovered my husband rifling through the filing cabinet...
examples.translation: 我发现我丈夫正在档案柜里匆匆翻找着什么东西。

examples.text: The men rifled through his clothing and snatched the wallet...
examples.translation: 那些人匆匆翻了翻他的衣服，然后一把抢走了钱包。

examples.text: There were lockers by each seat and I quickly rifled the contents.
examples.translation: 每个座位旁都有带锁的柜子，我迅速翻找着里面的东西。

meanings.meaning: 严格的；僵硬的，死板的；坚硬的；精确的

examples.text: Several colleges in our study have rigid rules about student conduct...
examples.translation: 在我们的研究中，有几所大学制定了严格的学生行为规则。

examples.text: Hospital routines for nurses are very rigid.
examples.translation: 医院中护士的日常工作非常刻板。

examples.text: ...the rigidity of government policy.
examples.translation: 政府政策的死板

examples.text: The caste system was rigidly enforced.
examples.translation: 过去印度的种姓制度非常严格。

examples.text: She was a fairly rigid person who had strong religious views...
examples.translation: 她相当顽固，宗教观念极强。

examples.text: My father is very rigid in his thinking.
examples.translation: 我父亲的思想非常顽固。

examples.text: ...rigid plastic containers...
examples.translation: 坚硬的塑料容器

examples.text: These plates are fairly rigid.
examples.translation: 这些盘子非常坚硬。

examples.text: ...the strength and rigidity of glass.
examples.translation: 玻璃的强度和硬度

examples.text: I went rigid with shock...
examples.translation: 我惊得僵在那里。

examples.text: Andrew went rigid when he saw a dog, any dog, anywhere.
examples.translation: 安德鲁过去只要看见狗，无论在哪里，无论什么狗，都会吓得一动不动。

examples.text: She stood rigidly and stared into the room.
examples.translation: 她直直地站在那里，凝视着屋内。

meanings.meaning: 严格的，严厉的；严密的；严酷的

examples.text: The selection process is based on rigorous tests of competence and experience.
examples.translation: 选拔过程是基于对能力和经验的严格测试。

examples.text: ...a rigorous system of blood analysis.
examples.translation: 缜密的血液分析系统

examples.text: ...rigorous military training.
examples.translation: 严格的军事训练

examples.text: ...rigorously conducted research.
examples.translation: 严格进行的研究

examples.text: He is rigorous in his control of expenditure.
examples.translation: 他对支出控制得非常严格。

examples.text: She looked at him over the rim of her glass.
examples.translation: 她的目光越过玻璃杯的边沿看着他。

examples.text: ...a round mirror with white metal rim.
examples.translation: 镶着白色金属边框的圆镜子

examples.text: There was already a rim of dark hairs and soap round the basin.
examples.translation: 洗脸盆边上已经有一圈黑头发和肥皂沫。

examples.text: Twelve inmates have been killed during a riot at the prison.
examples.translation: 12名犯人在一场监狱暴乱中被杀害。

examples.text: Last year 600 inmates rioted, starting fires and building barricades...
examples.translation: 去年，600名犯人闹事，他们纵火并设置路障。

examples.text: They rioted in protest against the government.
examples.translation: 他们发动暴乱，以抗议政府的行为。

examples.text: The militia dispersed the rioters.
examples.translation: 民兵驱散了暴乱者。

examples.text: At least fifteen people are now known to have died in three days of rioting.
examples.translation: 目前已知至少有15人在持续了3天的暴乱中丧生。

examples.text: All the cacti were in flower, so that the desert was a riot of colour...
examples.translation: 所有的仙人掌都开花了，整个沙漠里五彩缤纷。

examples.text: With Indian cuisine, you expect a riot of tastes and spices.
examples.translation: 印度菜肴口味丰富，并添加各种香料。

examples.text: I'm glad you read the riot act to Billy. He's still a kid and still needs to be told what to do.
examples.translation: 我很高兴你警告比利不许胡闹。他还是个孩子，仍然需要有人告诉他该做什么。

examples.text: Rampaging prisoners ran riot through Strangeways jail.
examples.translation: 斯特兰韦斯监狱里那些狂暴的囚犯们全都失去了控制。

examples.text: A conservatory offers the perfect excuse to let your imagination run riot.
examples.translation: 音乐学院让你有充分的理由任想象力自由驰骋。

examples.text: We have no proof and when there is no proof, rumour runs riot.
examples.translation: 我们没有证据，只要没有证据，谣言就会满天飞。

examples.text: That's absolutely right...
examples.translation: 那绝对正确。

examples.text: Clocks never told the right time...
examples.translation: 钟表显示的时间从来都不准确。

examples.text: You chip away at the problem until somebody comes up with the right answer...
examples.translation: 你们要不断地琢磨这个问题直到有人得出正确答案为止。

examples.text: The barman tells me you saw Ann on Tuesday morning. Is that right?
examples.translation: 酒吧招待员告诉我你星期二早上看见了安，对吗？

examples.text: He guessed right about some things.
examples.translation: 有些事情他猜对了。

examples.text: She attended one meeting only, if I remember rightly.
examples.translation: 如果我没有记错的话，她只参加了一次会议。

examples.text: Walking, done in the right way, is a form of aerobic exercise...
examples.translation: 走路，如果方法正确的话，也是一种有氧健身运动。

examples.text: They have computerized systems to ensure delivery of the right pizza to the right place...
examples.translation: 他们已经实现了系统的计算机化，以保证比萨的送货准确无误。

examples.text: The chocolate is then melted down to exactly the right temperature.
examples.translation: 然后巧克力被熔化到了恰好的温度。

examples.text: To make sure I did everything right, I bought a fat instruction book.
examples.translation: 为了保证不出任何差错，我买了一本厚厚的指南。

examples.text: He was always to be seen in the right places...
examples.translation: 他总是会出现在一些体面的地方。

examples.text: Through his father, he had met all the right people.
examples.translation: 他通过父亲认识了很多正派的人。

examples.text: Ron has been right about the result of every General Election but one...
examples.translation: 罗恩对于历届大选结果都预测对了，只有一次除外。

examples.text: Is that true? Was she right?...
examples.translation: 那是真的吗？她说得没错吗？

examples.text: Am I right in thinking you're the only person in the club who's actually played at Wembley?
examples.translation: 我想你是这个俱乐部中唯一一个真正在温布利打过比赛的人，对吗？

examples.text: He rightly assumed that the boy was hiding.
examples.translation: 他猜对了，那个男孩躲起来了。

examples.text: She'd made the right choice in leaving New York...
examples.translation: 她离开纽约的决定是正确的。

examples.text: The right decision was made, but probably for the wrong reasons...
examples.translation: 作出的决定是正确的，但理由可能是错误的。

examples.text: They decided the time was right for their escape.
examples.translation: 他们认为逃跑的时机到了。

examples.text: She hoped she'd decided rightly.
examples.translation: 她希望自己作出了正确的决定。

examples.text: Ratatouille doesn't taste right with any other oil...
examples.translation: 普罗旺斯杂烩用其他任何油炒出来的味道都不正宗。

examples.text: The name Sue Anne never seemed quite right to Molly...
examples.translation: 莫莉总觉得休·安妮这个名字不太好听。

examples.text: He went into hospital and came out after a week. But he still wasn't right.
examples.translation: 他住院后一周又出院了。但是状况仍然不太好。

examples.text: You were right to do what you did, under the circumstances...
examples.translation: 在这种情况下，你做的是对的。

examples.text: The president was absolutely right in ordering the bombing raid.
examples.translation: 总统下令发动空袭是绝对合乎道义的。

examples.text: The crowd screamed for a penalty but the referee rightly ignored them...
examples.translation: 观众强烈要求罚球，但是裁判作出了公正的决定，对此没有理会。

examples.text: Education, quite rightly, is currently at the forefront of the political agenda.
examples.translation: 目前教育被排在政治议程的首位，这样做非常恰当。

examples.text: It's not right, leaving her like this...
examples.translation: 就这样离开她是不对的。

examples.text: Fox hunting is popular among some people in this country. It doesn't make it right though...
examples.translation: 这个国家有些人喜欢猎狐，但是这并不能使其变得名正言顺。

examples.text: The BBC thought it was right and proper not to show the film.
examples.translation: 英国广播公司认为不播放这部电影是合理而且正当的做法。

examples.text: At least he knew right from wrong.
examples.translation: 至少他明辨是非。

examples.text: Many people have very strong opinions about the rightness or wrongness of abortion.
examples.translation: 很多人都对堕胎是否合乎道义有强烈的意见。

examples.text: They recognise the urgency of righting the economy...
examples.translation: 他们认识到了复苏经济的紧迫性。

examples.text: Your eyesight rights itself very quickly.
examples.translation: 你的视力恢复得非常快。

examples.text: We've made progress in righting the wrongs of the past...
examples.translation: 我们在纠正过去的错误方面取得了进展。

examples.text: Having spent 25 years righting his own mistakes, he is anxious that children should not waste opportunities.
examples.translation: 他花了25年的时间弥补自己的过失，因此他非常渴望孩子们不要错失良机。

examples.text: He righted the yacht and continued the race...
examples.translation: 他调正了快艇，继续比赛。

examples.text: The helicopter turned at an awful angle before righting itself.
examples.translation: 直升机在恢复平稳之前倾斜得很厉害。

examples.text: I can't think of anything in my life that's going right...
examples.translation: 我想不起我的生活中有任何一帆风顺的事情。

examples.text: I was pleased with my performance on Saturday — everything went right.
examples.translation: 我对自己星期六的表现挺满意——一切顺利。

examples.text: She wasn't entirely in the right...
examples.translation: 她并非完全占理。

examples.text: Legally, the local tax office is in the right.
examples.translation: 从法律的角度来说，当地税务局的做法是无可厚非的。

examples.text: We've discovered what's gone wrong and are going to put it right.
examples.translation: 我们已经发现了存在的问题，准备加以纠正。

examples.text: She confesses to having trouble finding Mr Right.
examples.translation: 她承认找不到自己的白马王子。

examples.text: ...bachelors searching for Ms Right.
examples.translation: 寻找真命天女的单身汉们

examples.text: Ahead of you on the right will be a lovely garden...
examples.translation: 在你右前方会有一个美丽的花园。

examples.text: He looks to his left, up at the screen, then to his right.
examples.translation: 他朝左边看了看，抬头望向屏幕，然后又看了看右边。

examples.text: Turn right into the street.
examples.translation: 朝右拐进街道。

examples.text: The Tory Right despise him...
examples.translation: 保守党右翼分子鄙视他。

examples.text: The right attacks me for being irreligious.
examples.translation: 右翼分子抨击我没有宗教信仰。

examples.text: They see the shift to the right as a worldwide phenomenon.
examples.translation: 他们认为政治上的右翼倾向是一个世界现象。

examples.text: I think he ought to be at the right hand of the president.
examples.translation: 我想他应该成为总统的得力助手。

examples.text: They don't know their rights...
examples.translation: 他们不知道自己的权利。

examples.text: You must stand up for your rights.
examples.translation: 你必须维护自己的权利。

examples.text: ...voting rights.
examples.translation: 投票权

examples.text: ...a woman's right to choose...
examples.translation: 女性的选择权

examples.text: People have the right to read any kind of material they wish.
examples.translation: 人们有权利阅读自己喜欢的任何东西。

examples.text: An agent bought the rights to his life...
examples.translation: 一个经纪人购买了他的传记的出版权。

examples.text: He'd tried to buy the film rights of all George Bernard Shaw's plays.
examples.translation: 他曾尝试买下萧伯纳所有戏剧的电影改编权。

examples.text: She did work which by rights should be done by someone else.
examples.translation: 她做了理应由别人做的事情。

examples.text: Although now a celebrity in her own right, actress Lynn Redgrave knows the difficulties of living in the shadow of her famous older sister...
examples.translation: 虽然女演员琳恩·雷德格雷夫现在依靠自己的能力出了名，但她明白生活在大名鼎鼎的姐姐的阴影里有多不容易。

examples.text: Their baby is a person in his own right.
examples.translation: 他们的宝宝是个很独立的人。

examples.text: He reserved the right to change his mind...
examples.translation: 他保留了改变主意的权利。

examples.text: The ministry said it reserved the right to take whatever action necessary.
examples.translation: 该部表示保留采取任何必要行动的权利。

examples.text: You were quite within your rights to refuse to co-operate with him.
examples.translation: 你完全有权拒绝跟他合作。

examples.text: Right, I'll be back in a minute...
examples.translation: 好的，我一会儿就回来。

examples.text: Wonderful. Right, let's go to our next caller.
examples.translation: 太棒了。好的，我们接听下一个电话。

examples.text: They have a small plane, right?
examples.translation: 他们有一架小飞机，对吧？

examples.text: So if it's not there now, the killer has it. Right?
examples.translation: 如果它现在不在那里，就在凶手那里。是吧？

examples.text: 'Your children may well come away speaking with a bit of a broad country accent' — 'Right.' — 'because they're mixing with country children.'
examples.translation: “你的孩子们走的时候可能会带点儿浓重的乡下口音。”——“嗯。”——“因为他们现在和乡下孩子打成一片。”

examples.text: He suggested that many of the ideas just would not work. But the tenor of his input was 'Right on! Please show us how to make them work'.
examples.translation: 他认为这些想法有很多根本就不会奏效。但是他说话的大意却是“好极了！请告诉我们怎么让它们见效”。

examples.text: 'I want a word with you when you stop.' — 'Right you are.'
examples.translation: “等你停下来的时候，我想跟你说句话。”——“好的。”

examples.text: The back of a car appeared right in front of him.
examples.translation: 汽车尾部正对着他。

examples.text: ...a charming resort right on the Italian frontier...
examples.translation: 就在意大利边境上的一个美丽的度假胜地

examples.text: I had to decide right then.
examples.translation: 我当时就得做决定。

examples.text: ...the highway that runs through the Indian zone right to the army positions...
examples.translation: 穿过印第安人居住区直达军队阵地的公路

examples.text: She was kept very busy right up to the moment of her departure...
examples.translation: 她一直忙得不可开交，直到出发的那一刻还在忙。

examples.text: It was taken right there on a conveyor belt.
examples.translation: 它被传送带直接送到了那边。

examples.text: The candle had burned right down...
examples.translation: 这根蜡烛完全烧尽了。

examples.text: The handle came right off in my hand.
examples.translation: 把手一下子就从我的手中脱落。

examples.text: He gave them a right telling off...
examples.translation: 他狠狠地责备了他们一通。

examples.text: England's European Championship plans are in a right mess.
examples.translation: 英格兰队的欧洲锦标赛作战计划乱七八糟。

examples.text: All of a sudden, right after the summer, Mother gets married...
examples.translation: 突然，刚过夏天，妈妈就结婚了。

examples.text: She then decided right before the opening to make a dramatic announcement.
examples.translation: 然后就在开幕式开始之前，她决定要宣布一件激动人心的事情。

examples.text: I'm going to get some water. I'll be right back.
examples.translation: 我去拿点水。马上就回来。

examples.text: He wants to see you right away...
examples.translation: 他想马上见你。

examples.text: I knew right away she was dead...
examples.translation: 我马上就知道她死了。

examples.text: Right off I want to confess that I was wrong.
examples.translation: 我立刻就想承认我错了。

examples.text: Right now I'm feeling very excited...
examples.translation: 现在，我觉得非常激动。

examples.text: I'm warning you; stop it right now!
examples.translation: 我警告你，马上住手！

examples.text: ...The Right Reverend John Baker.
examples.translation: 约翰·贝克牧师阁下

examples.text: ...the Right Honourable Lynn Jones MP.
examples.translation: 尊敬的林恩·琼斯议员阁下

examples.text: ...the Right Honourable Michael Portillo.
examples.translation: 尊敬的迈克尔·波蒂略阁下

meanings.meaning: 熟的，成熟的；时机成熟的

examples.text: Always choose firm, but ripe fruit.
examples.translation: 一定要挑选硬实但已成熟的水果。

examples.text: ...fields of ripe wheat.
examples.translation: 成熟的麦田

examples.text: Test the figs for ripeness.
examples.translation: 看看这些无花果熟了没有。

examples.text: Conditions were ripe for an outbreak of cholera...
examples.translation: 霍乱即将暴发。

examples.text: This society is ripe for change.
examples.translation: 发生社会变革的时机已经成熟。

examples.text: He lived to the ripe old age of 95.
examples.translation: 他活到了95岁高龄。

examples.text: Haig's message was that victory was ripe for picking.
examples.translation: 黑格传达的意思是说胜利唾手可得。

examples.text: He told reporters that he thought the time was ripe for a normalisation of relations...
examples.translation: 他告诉记者他认为是时候恢复两国间正常关系。

examples.text: The British Foreign Office has decided the time is ripe to send its first female ambassador to the region.
examples.translation: 英国外交部作出决定现在可以向该地区派驻第一位女大使。

meanings.meaning: 戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物

examples.text: He rang me at my mother's...
examples.translation: 他打电话到我妈妈家找我。

examples.text: If you'd like more information, ring the Hotline on 414 3929...
examples.translation: 如果想了解更多信息，请拨打热线电话414 3929。

examples.text: I would ring when I got back to the hotel...
examples.translation: 我回到酒店就会打电话。

examples.text: She has rung home just once...
examples.translation: 她只给家里打了一次电话。

examples.text: Could someone ring for a taxi?
examples.translation: 有谁能打电话叫出租车吗？

examples.text: You can ring us up anytime...
examples.translation: 你随时都可以给我们打电话。

examples.text: John rang up and invited himself over for dinner...
examples.translation: 约翰打电话来，主动要求过来吃晚饭。

examples.text: A few months ago I rang up about some housing problems...
examples.translation: 几个月前，我打电话问过一些住房的问题。

examples.text: Nobody rings up a doctor in the middle of the night for no reason.
examples.translation: 没有人会无缘无故半夜给医生打电话。

examples.text: As soon as he got home, the phone rang...
examples.translation: 他一回到家，电话就响了。

examples.text: The phone never stopped ringing.
examples.translation: 这部电话一直响个不停。

examples.text: After at least eight rings, an ancient-sounding maid answered the phone.
examples.translation: 电话至少响了8声之后，一个听起来非常年老的女仆接了电话。

examples.text: She was jolted out of her sleep by the ringing of the telephone.
examples.translation: 她被电话铃声惊醒了。

examples.text: He heard the school bell ring...
examples.translation: 他听见学校的铃声响了。

examples.text: The door was opened before she could ring the bell.
examples.translation: 她还没来得及按门铃，门就开了。

examples.text: There was a ring at the bell.
examples.translation: 铃声响了。

examples.text: ...the ringing of church bells.
examples.translation: 教堂的钟声

examples.text: Shall I ring for a fresh pot of tea?...
examples.translation: 要我按铃叫一壶新沏的茶水吗？

examples.text: He rang for the guard to let him out.
examples.translation: 他按铃叫保安放他出去。

examples.text: The whole place was ringing with music.
examples.translation: 整个地方都回荡着音乐。

examples.text: His proud boast of leading 'the party of low taxation' has a hollow ring.
examples.translation: 他洋洋得意地吹嘘自己领导着“一个主张低税收的政党”，这听起来很空洞。

examples.text: Ring the changes by adding spices, dried fruit or olives.
examples.translation: 加点香料、干果或橄榄以换换口味。

examples.text: She shivered as the sound of that man's abuse rang in her ears.
examples.translation: 她耳边回响起那个男人的辱骂气得浑身发抖。

examples.text: We'll give him a ring as soon as we get back.
examples.translation: 我们一回来就会给他打电话。

examples.text: Joanna's denial rang true...
examples.translation: 乔安娜的否认听起来像是真的。

examples.text: The rumpus has made all the optimistic statements about unity and harmony ring a little hollow.
examples.translation: 这一番吵闹使得所有关于团结和谐的乐观言论听起来都显得有几分空洞。

examples.text: She wore several diamond rings.
examples.translation: 她戴了好几个钻石戒指。

examples.text: ...a gold wedding ring.
examples.translation: 黄金婚戒

examples.text: Frank took a large ring of keys from his pocket.
examples.translation: 弗兰克从口袋里掏出一大串钥匙。

examples.text: ...a ring of blue smoke.
examples.translation: 蓝色的烟圈

examples.text: They then formed a ring around the square.
examples.translation: 然后他们在广场周围围成了一圈。

examples.text: ...grilled fish surrounded by a ring of thinly cut carrots.
examples.translation: 边上放着一圈薄胡萝卜片的烤鱼

examples.text: He will never again be allowed inside a British boxing ring.
examples.translation: 他被永久禁止踏入英国拳击赛场。

examples.text: Police are investigating the suspected drug ring at the school.
examples.translation: 警方正在调查这所学校的可疑贩毒团伙。

examples.text: ...an international spy ring.
examples.translation: 国际间谍组织

examples.text: The areas are sealed off and ringed by troops.
examples.translation: 这些地区被军队封锁包围了。

examples.text: He demonstrated his techniques for ringing birds.
examples.translation: 他展示了给鸟儿环志的技术。

examples.text: Mentally, he can still run rings round men half his age!
examples.translation: 他在智力上仍远远高于那些比他年轻一半的人。

examples.text: I felt the banner rip as we were pushed in opposite directions...
examples.translation: 当我们被推向相反的方向时，我感觉横幅被撕裂了。

examples.text: I tried not to rip the paper as I unwrapped it.
examples.translation: 我把纸打开的时候，尽量不把它撕破。

examples.text: Looking at the rip in her new dress, she flew into a rage.
examples.translation: 看到新连衣裙上的口子，她勃然大怒。

examples.text: He ripped away a wire that led to the alarm button...
examples.translation: 他把连着报警按钮的电线扯掉了。

examples.text: She ripped off her dress and let it fall to the floor...
examples.translation: 她一把扯下连衣裙，任其滑落到地上。

examples.text: He ripped the phone from her hand.
examples.translation: 他把电话从她手中抢了过来。

examples.text: A volley of bullets ripped into the facing wall...
examples.translation: 一排子弹射进对面的墙上。

examples.text: Their minibus was ripped apart by a bomb...
examples.translation: 他们的面包车被炸弹炸得粉碎。

examples.text: The fire ripped through the living room...
examples.translation: 大火吞噬了客厅。

examples.text: A violent streak of pain ripped through her whole body.
examples.translation: 一阵剧烈的疼痛传遍了她的全身。

examples.text: Turn the guitars up full and let rip...
examples.translation: 把吉他的音量调到最大，尽情欢乐吧。

examples.text: 'Yaaaaaaa,' Carla let rip with the cry of the Valkyries.
examples.translation: “呀——”卡拉放开喉咙，发出女武神瓦尔基里一般的嘶喊声。

examples.text: The ecological disaster is partly a product of letting everything rip in order to increase production.
examples.translation: 出现生态灾难的部分原因是人们为了增产而不惜一切代价。

meanings.meaning: 仪式的；例行的；礼节性的

examples.text: This is the most ancient, and holiest of the Shinto rituals...
examples.translation: 这是最古老、最神圣的神道教仪式。

examples.text: These ceremonies were already part of pre-Christian ritual in Mexico.
examples.translation: 这些仪式已经成为墨西哥基督教时期以前的宗教仪式的一部分。

examples.text: ...fastings and ritual dancing.
examples.translation: 斋戒和传统舞蹈

examples.text: ...an act of ritual suicide.
examples.translation: 仪式性的自杀行为

examples.text: The statue was ritually bathed and purified.
examples.translation: 作为仪式对这座雕塑进行冲洗和净化。

examples.text: The whole Italian culture revolves around the ritual of eating...
examples.translation: 整个意大利的文化都以饮食习惯为中心。

examples.text: Cocktails at the Plaza was a nightly ritual of their sophisticated world.
examples.translation: 到广场饭店喝鸡尾酒是他们这个高雅时髦的圈子中的人每晚必做的事情。

examples.text: I realized that here the conventions required me to make the ritual noises.
examples.translation: 我意识到此时按照惯例我应该说些客套话。

examples.text: There is a small risk of brain damage from the procedure...
examples.translation: 该手术有导致脑损伤的轻微风险。

examples.text: In all the confusion, there's a serious risk that the main issues will be forgotten.
examples.translation: 在一片混乱中，主要的问题很有可能会被遗忘。

examples.text: ...mentally disordered women who pose a serious risk to the public...
examples.translation: 给民众构成严重威胁的精神错乱的女人

examples.text: I suppose people do it because there is that element of danger and risk...
examples.translation: 我想人们这样做是因为其中存在危险和风险的因素。

examples.text: Obesity is a major risk factor in many diseases.
examples.translation: 肥胖是引发多种疾病的重要因素。

examples.text: You're taking a big risk showing this to Kravis...
examples.translation: 你把这个给克拉维斯看会有很大的风险。

examples.text: This was one risk that paid off.
examples.translation: 这是一个成功的冒险。

examples.text: It's being overfat that constitutes a health risk...
examples.translation: 威胁健康的一个因素是身体过于肥胖。

examples.text: The restaurant has been refurbished — it was found to be a fire risk...
examples.translation: 这家餐馆已经重新整修了——之前发现存在火灾隐患。

examples.text: He was not seen as a risk to national security.
examples.translation: 人们不认为他是威胁国家安全的危险分子。

examples.text: Before providing the cash, they will have to decide whether you are a good or bad risk...
examples.translation: 在提供资金之前，他们得确认你是不是信誉良好的贷款对象。

examples.text: If you are already considered a credit risk by a bank, a secured loan might be your only alternative.
examples.translation: 如果银行已经认为你有信用风险，那么抵押贷款就是你唯一的选择了。

examples.text: Those who fail to register risk severe penalties...
examples.translation: 那些没有注册的人可能会受到严厉的处罚。

examples.text: Pregnant women who are heavy drinkers risk damaging the unborn foetus.
examples.translation: 酗酒的孕妇可能会给体内的胎儿造成伤害。

examples.text: The captain was not willing to risk taking his ship through the straits in such bad weather.
examples.translation: 船长不愿意在这样恶劣的天气里冒险将船驶过海峡。

examples.text: At the top, I risked a glance back...
examples.translation: 在顶端，我壮着胆回头瞟了一眼。

examples.text: Don't risk it. It isn't worth it.
examples.translation: 不要冒这个险。这样做不值得。

examples.text: She risked her own life to help a disabled woman...
examples.translation: 她冒着生命危险去帮助一个残疾妇女。

examples.text: Why should he have risked all that to become an agent of a foreign power?
examples.translation: 为什么就该他冒失去这一切的风险做外国势力的代理人呢？

examples.text: Up to 25,000 jobs are still at risk...
examples.translation: 多达25,000份工作仍受到威胁。

examples.text: An estimated seven million people are at risk of starvation...
examples.translation: 估计有700万人面临着饿死的危险。

examples.text: If they have the virus they are putting patients at risk.
examples.translation: 如果他们有这种病毒，就会将病人置于危险境地。

examples.text: At the risk of being repetitive, I will say again that statistics are only a guide...
examples.translation: 尽管会显得啰唆，但我还得再说一遍，统计数字只是一个参考。

examples.text: Americans wanted to aid Britain even at the risk of war.
examples.translation: 哪怕冒着开战的危险，美国人也想帮助英国人。

examples.text: Those who wish to come here will do so at their own risk.
examples.translation: 那些想来这里的人风险自负。

examples.text: The officers had run the risk of being dismissed...
examples.translation: 这些警官冒了被开除的风险。

examples.text: I knew I was running a great many risks.
examples.translation: 我知道我正担着很多的风险。

examples.text: The world champion finished more than two seconds ahead of his nearest rival...
examples.translation: 世界冠军领先第二名2秒多钟到达终点。

examples.text: He eliminated his rivals in a brutal struggle for power...
examples.translation: 他在一场残酷的权力争斗中将对手一一铲除。

examples.text: The police believe the fight was due to a dispute between rival teenage gangs.
examples.translation: 警察认为这场打斗是由两个敌对的青少年帮派之间的纠纷引起的。

examples.text: ...a wonderfully fragrant wine which has no rivals in the Rhone...
examples.translation: 在罗纳河地区独一无二的无比香醇的葡萄酒

examples.text: He is a pastry chef without rival.
examples.translation: 他是最好的面点师。

examples.text: Cassette recorders cannot rival the sound quality of CDs...
examples.translation: 卡式磁带录音机的音质无法和CD相媲美。

examples.text: An epidemic to rival that which killed 26,000 in 1989 may hit the UK.
examples.translation: 一种流行病可能会袭击英国，其危害程度不亚于1989年导致26,000人丧生的疾病。

examples.text: ...a chemical works on the banks of the river.
examples.translation: 跨河而建的一家化工厂

examples.text: ...boating on the River Danube.
examples.translation: 在多瑙河上划船

examples.text: He watched the smoke rise from his cigarette...
examples.translation: 他注视着烟雾从香烟上升起。

examples.text: The powdery dust rose in a cloud around him.
examples.translation: 一团粉尘在他周围扬起。

examples.text: Spray rose up from the surface of the water...
examples.translation: 水面溅起水花。

examples.text: Black dense smoke rose up.
examples.translation: 浓浓的黑烟升起。

examples.text: Luther rose slowly from the chair...
examples.translation: 卢瑟慢慢地从椅子上站起来。

examples.text: He looked at Livy and Mark, who had risen to greet him.
examples.translation: 他看着站起来跟他打招呼的莉薇和马克。

examples.text: The only thing I wanted was to rise up from the table and leave this house.
examples.translation: 我只想从桌旁站起来，离开这所房子。

examples.text: Tony had risen early and gone to the cottage to work.
examples.translation: 托尼很早就起来去小屋干活了。

examples.text: He wanted to be over the line of the ridge before the sun had risen.
examples.translation: 他想在太阳升起以前翻过山脊。

examples.text: The building rose before him, tall and stately...
examples.translation: 那座高大宏伟的建筑耸立在他面前。

examples.text: The towers rise out of a concrete podium.
examples.translation: 这些塔楼耸立在一个混凝土墩座上。

examples.text: The White Mountains rose up before me.
examples.translation: 怀特山矗立在我的面前。

examples.text: The waters continue to rise as more than 1,000 people are evacuated.
examples.translation: 水面持续上涨，已经有1,000多人被疏散了。

examples.text: ...the tides rise and fall.
examples.translation: 潮水时涨时落。

examples.text: He looked up the slope of land that rose from the house...
examples.translation: 他抬头看了看屋后的斜坡。

examples.text: The ground begins to rise some 20 yards away...
examples.translation: 地面在20码开外的地方开始升高。

examples.text: The great house stood on rising ground.
examples.translation: 这座大房子建在一个斜坡上。

examples.text: The pub itself was on a rise, commanding views across the countryside...
examples.translation: 酒吧本身就建在一个斜坡上，可以俯眺乡村风光。

examples.text: I climbed to the top of a rise overlooking the ramparts.
examples.translation: 我爬到了一个可以俯瞰护城墙的坡顶。

examples.text: Pre-tax profits rose from £842,000 to £1.82m...
examples.translation: 税前利润从84.2万英镑上升到了182万英镑。

examples.text: Tourist trips of all kinds in Britain rose by 10.5% between 1977 and 1987...
examples.translation: 英国各种旅游项目在1977至1987年间增多了10.5%。

examples.text: Exports in June rose 1.5% to a record $30.91 billion...
examples.translation: 6月份的出口额上升了1.5%，创下309.1亿美元的历史最高纪录。

examples.text: The number of business failures has risen...
examples.translation: 企业倒闭的数量增加了。

examples.text: The increase is needed to meet rising costs.
examples.translation: 因为成本增加，这种上调是必要的。

examples.text: ...the prospect of another rise in interest rates...
examples.translation: 利率可能会再次上涨

examples.text: Foreign nationals have begun leaving because of a sharp rise in violence.
examples.translation: 因为暴力活动的急剧增加，外国人已经开始离开这个国家。

examples.text: He will get a pay rise of nearly £4,000.
examples.translation: 他的工资将会上涨将近4,000英镑。

examples.text: ...the rise of racism in America.
examples.translation: 美国种族主义的抬头

examples.text: ...the rise of home ownership.
examples.translation: 购房者的增多

examples.text: The wind was still rising, approach-ing a force nine gale.
examples.translation: 风力仍在增强，接近9级大风。

examples.text: Foxworth shivered as the wind rose up and roared through the beech trees.
examples.translation: 风势渐大，在山毛榉树间呼呼吹过，福克斯沃思瑟瑟发抖。

examples.text: 'Bernard?' Her voice rose hysterically...
examples.translation: “伯纳德？”她歇斯底里地提高了嗓门。

examples.text: His voice rose almost to a scream.
examples.translation: 他提高了嗓门，几乎在尖叫。

examples.text: There were low, muffled voices rising from the hallway.
examples.translation: 从走廊里隐约传来了低沉的说话声。

examples.text: From the people, a cheer rose up.
examples.translation: 人群中传出了一阵欢呼声。

examples.text: A tide of emotion rose and clouded his judgement...
examples.translation: 心头涌起一阵强烈的感情，模糊了他的判断力。

examples.text: The thought made anger rise in him and he went into a bar and had a double whisky.
examples.translation: 这个想法让他怒火直冒，于是他去了一家酒吧，要了双份的威士忌。

examples.text: Amy felt the colour rising in her cheeks at the thought.
examples.translation: 埃米一想到这件事，就觉得脸红。

examples.text: The National Convention has promised armed support to any people who wish to rise against armed oppression.
examples.translation: 国民议会承诺向所有想要反抗武装压迫的人提供武装支持。

examples.text: He warned that if the government moved against him the people would rise up...
examples.translation: 他警告说如果政府对他采取不利行动，人民就会起来造反。

examples.text: A woman called on the population to rise up against the government.
examples.translation: 一位女性号召人们起来反抗政府。

examples.text: ...popular risings against tyrannical rulers.
examples.translation: 反对暴君的民众起义

examples.text: She is a strong woman who has risen to the top of a deeply sexist organisation...
examples.translation: 她是一个女强人，已经升至一个性别歧视意识根深蒂固的组织的最高层。

examples.text: From an unlikely background he has risen rapidly through the ranks of government.
examples.translation: 虽然没有什么背景，但他在政府中的地位仍然迅速提高。

examples.text: I started with Hoover 26 years ago in sales and rose up through the ranks.
examples.translation: 我26年前加入胡佛公司时做的是销售工作，后来级级攀升。

examples.text: Haig's rise was fuelled by an all-consuming sense of patriotic duty...
examples.translation: 黑格非常强烈的爱国主义责任感使他的地位大大提高了。

examples.text: The group celebrated the regime's rise to power in 1979.
examples.translation: 这个集团庆祝该政府于1979年上台执政。

examples.text: Low levels of choline in the body can give rise to high blood-pressure...
examples.translation: 体内胆碱水平过低会引起高血压。

examples.text: The picture gave rise to speculation that the three were still alive and being held captive.
examples.translation: 这张照片让人们猜测这3个人还活着，而且被囚禁起来了。

examples.text: There was very little traffic on the roads...
examples.translation: 这些公路上车辆稀少。
