examples.text: We just go straight up the Bristol Road...
examples.translation: 我们就沿着布里斯托尔大道直走。

examples.text: He was coming down the road the same time as the girl was turning into the lane...
examples.translation: 当女孩拐进这个车道时，他也正沿着这条路驶来。

examples.text: Buses carry 30 per cent of those travelling by road...
examples.translation: 公交车承载了公路交通客流量的30％。

examples.text: ...road accidents...
examples.translation: 道路交通事故

examples.text: We are bound to see some ups and downs along the road to recovery.
examples.translation: 在经济复苏的过程中，我们一定会经历一些曲折起伏。

examples.text: I was relieved to get back in the car and hit the road again.
examples.translation: 回到车里重新上路后，我松了一口气。

examples.text: He hoped to get a new truck and go back on the road.
examples.translation: 他希望能有一辆新的卡车，重新上路。

examples.text: The government took another step on the road to political reform.
examples.translation: 政府在实现政治改革的路上又迈进了一步。

examples.text: ...the stunning fashion pictures which launched unknown teenager Jane March on the road to stardom.
examples.translation: 让名不见经传的少女简·马奇走向成名之路的惊艳的时装照片

examples.text: A police car roared past...
examples.translation: 一辆警车呼啸而过。

examples.text: The plane roared down the runway for takeoff...
examples.translation: 飞机轰鸣着沿着跑道疾驰，准备起飞。

examples.text: Flames roared hundreds of feet into the air.
examples.translation: 火焰呼呼地蹿到了几百英尺的高空。

examples.text: The engine roared, and the vehicle leapt forward...
examples.translation: 发动机轰鸣着，车子猛然冲出去。

examples.text: Her heart was pounding and the blood roared in her ears.
examples.translation: 她的心怦怦跳着，热血在耳中澎湃。

examples.text: ...the roaring waters of Niagara Falls.
examples.translation: 尼亚加拉瀑布澎湃的水流

examples.text: ...the roar of traffic...
examples.translation: 车流的轰鸣

examples.text: Local residents saw it plunge towards Earth with a deafening roar.
examples.translation: 当地的居民看见它伴着一声震耳欲聋的巨响撞向地面。

examples.text: Max threw back his head and roared with laughter.
examples.translation: 马克斯仰头大笑起来。

examples.text: There were roars of laughter as he stood up.
examples.translation: 他站起来的时候，人们哄堂大笑。

examples.text: 'I'll kill you for that,' he roared...
examples.translation: “我会为此杀了你，”他大吼道。

examples.text: During the playing of the national anthem the crowd roared and whistled...
examples.translation: 在播放国歌的时候，人们喊叫着，吹着口哨。

examples.text: The audience roared its approval.
examples.translation: 观众们大声喊着，表示赞同。

examples.text: There was a roar of approval.
examples.translation: 响起一阵热烈的赞同声。

examples.text: The lion roared once, and sprang.
examples.translation: 狮子大吼一声，跳了起来。

examples.text: ...the roar of lions in the distance.
examples.translation: 远处狮子的吼声

meanings.meaning: 烤，焙；烘，烘烤；暴露于某种热力下以得温暖

examples.text: I personally would rather roast a chicken whole.
examples.translation: 我个人更愿意烤整只鸡。

examples.text: ...roast beef.
examples.translation: 烤牛肉

examples.text: Come into the kitchen. I've got to put the roast in.
examples.translation: 到厨房来。我得把烤肉放进去。

examples.text: Mrs Yacoub was robbed of her £3,000 designer watch at her West London home...
examples.translation: 雅各布夫人那块价值3,000英镑的名牌手表在西伦敦的家中被人抢走了。

examples.text: Police said Stefanovski had robbed a man just hours earlier.
examples.translation: 警察说斯泰凡诺夫斯基就在几个小时前抢劫了一名男子。

examples.text: When Miles Davis died, jazz was robbed of its most distinctive voice...
examples.translation: 随着迈尔斯·戴维斯的去世，爵士乐界失去了其最与众不同的声音。

examples.text: I can't forgive Lewis for robbing me of an Olympic gold.
examples.translation: 我不能原谅刘易斯夺走了我一块奥运会金牌。

examples.text: Pope John Paul II knelt in his white robes before the simple altar.
examples.translation: 教皇约翰·保罗二世身着白色长袍在简朴的圣坛前面跪下来。

examples.text: ...a fur-lined robe of green silk.
examples.translation: 毛皮衬里的绿色丝绸长袍

examples.text: Ryle put on a robe and went down to the kitchen.
examples.translation: 赖尔穿上睡袍，下楼去了厨房。

meanings.meaning: 机器人；遥控设备，自动机械；机械般工作的人

examples.text: ...very light-weight robots that we could send to the moon for planetary exploration.
examples.translation: 可以发射到月球上进行行星探测的极轻型机器人

meanings.meaning: 强健的；健康的；粗野的；粗鲁的

examples.text: More women than men go to the doctor. Perhaps men are more robust or worry less?...
examples.translation: 看医生的女性多于男性。也许男性更强壮或者顾虑要少一些？

examples.text: We've always specialised in making very robust, simply designed machinery.
examples.translation: 我们一直专注于制造极为结实耐用而且设计简单的机器。

examples.text: He became robustly healthy.
examples.translation: 他变得很健壮。

examples.text: ...the robustness of diesel engines.
examples.translation: 柴油机的结实耐用

examples.text: A British Foreign Office minister has made a robust defence of the agreement...
examples.translation: 一位英国外交大臣坚决维护这个协议。

examples.text: He has the keen eye and robust approach needed.
examples.translation: 他具备了所需的敏锐的洞察力和坚定的行事态度。

examples.text: In the decisions we have to make about Europe, we have to defend our position very robustly indeed.
examples.translation: 在我们不得不做出的关于欧洲的决定中，我们确实必须非常坚决地维护我们的立场。

examples.text: ...a prominent industrialist renowned for the robustness of his right-wing views.
examples.translation: 因其强烈鲜明的右翼观点而出名的杰出实业家

meanings.meaning: 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加

examples.text: There has been a renewed rocket attack on the capital.
examples.translation: 首都遭受了新一轮的火箭袭击。

examples.text: Fresh food is so scarce that prices have rocketed...
examples.translation: 新鲜食物非常匮乏，导致价格猛涨。

examples.text: The nation has experienced four years of rocketing crime.
examples.translation: 4年来，这个国家的犯罪率急剧上升。

examples.text: A train rocketed by, shaking the walls of the row houses...
examples.translation: 一辆火车疾驰而过，排屋的墙都摇晃起来。

examples.text: Dublin has rocketed up the charts to become one of Europe's most popular tourist destinations for city breaks.
examples.translation: 都柏林的排名飞速攀升，成为了欧洲最受欢迎的旅游度假城市之一。

meanings.meaning: (Rod)人名；(英、法、德、捷、希)罗德；(阿拉伯)鲁德；(老)罗

examples.text: ...a 15-foot thick roof that was reinforced with steel rods.
examples.translation: 用钢筋加固的15英尺厚的屋顶

examples.text: ...the drug's role in preventing more serious effects of infection...
examples.translation: 这种药物在防止感染加重方面的作用

examples.text: Both sides have roles to play.
examples.translation: 双方都各有自己的角色。

examples.text: She has just landed the lead role in The Young Vic's latest production...
examples.translation: 她刚刚获得在小维克剧院上演的最新作品中出演女主角的机会。

examples.text: Shakespearean women's roles were originally written to be played by men.
examples.translation: 莎士比亚笔下的女性角色在创作之初是打算由男性来扮演的。

examples.text: The hills above the valley are bare rock...
examples.translation: 山谷上方的小山全是光秃秃的石头。

examples.text: A little way below the ridge was an outcrop of rock that made a rough shelter.
examples.translation: 山脊下方不远处有一块露出地面的岩石，大致形成了一个掩蔽处。

examples.text: She sat cross-legged on the rock.
examples.translation: 她盘腿坐在那块巨大的岩石上。

examples.text: ...the sound of the sea crashing against the rocks...
examples.translation: 海浪冲击岩石的声音

examples.text: He and two friends were climbing a rock face when they heard cries for help.
examples.translation: 他和两个朋友正在攀岩时突然听到了求救声。

examples.text: She bent down, picked up a rock and threw it into the trees.
examples.translation: 她弯腰捡起一块石子，扔进了树丛中。

examples.text: His body rocked from side to side with the train...
examples.translation: 他的身体随着火车左右摇晃。

examples.text: He stood a few moments, rocking back and forwards on his heels...
examples.translation: 他站了一会儿，踮着脚跟前后摇晃。

examples.text: She sat on the porch and rocked the baby.
examples.translation: 她坐在门廊上，摇晃着孩子。

examples.text: Three people were injured yesterday when an explosion rocked one of Britain's best known film studios...
examples.translation: 昨天，一起爆炸使得英国最著名的电影制片厂之一发生强烈震动，导致3人受伤。

examples.text: ...a country that's rocked by dozens of earthquakes every year...
examples.translation: 每年遭受十几次地震袭击的国家

examples.text: As the buildings rocked under heavy shellfire, he took refuge in the cellars.
examples.translation: 当一座座楼房在猛烈的炮火中颤动摇晃时，他躲进了地下室。

examples.text: His death rocked the fashion business.
examples.translation: 他的去世震惊了整个时装界。

examples.text: ...the latest scandal to rock the monarchy...
examples.translation: 震惊了整个王国的最新丑闻

examples.text: Wall Street was rocked by the news and shares fell 4.3 per cent by the end of trading.
examples.translation: 这则消息震惊了整个华尔街，股票在交易日结束时下跌了4.3％。

examples.text: He once told an interviewer that he didn't even like rock music.
examples.translation: 他曾告诉一位采访者，他甚至都不喜欢摇滚乐。

examples.text: ...a rock concert.
examples.translation: 摇滚音乐会

examples.text: ...famous rock stars.
examples.translation: 摇滚明星

examples.text: ...a stick of rock.
examples.translation: 一条硬棒糖

examples.text: ...a Scotch on the rocks.
examples.translation: 加冰块的苏格兰威士忌

examples.text: She confided to her mother six months ago that her marriage was on the rocks...
examples.translation: 6个月前，她向母亲透露自己的婚姻已经岌岌可危。

examples.text: Our film industry is on the rocks.
examples.translation: 我们的电影业困难重重。

meanings.meaning: 传奇；浪漫史；风流韵事；冒险故事

examples.text: After a whirlwind romance the couple announced their engagement in July.
examples.translation: 在闪电式的恋爱后，两人在7月宣布订婚。

examples.text: ...a holiday romance.
examples.translation: 假日罗曼史

examples.text: He still finds time for romance by cooking candlelit dinners for his girlfriend...
examples.translation: 他仍然会找时间为女友准备烛光晚餐，制造浪漫。

examples.text: He takes a rather sceptical view of love and romance.
examples.translation: 他对爱情和浪漫持非常怀疑的态度。

examples.text: We want to recreate the romance and excitement that used to be part of rail journeys.
examples.translation: 我们想再度营造以前坐火车旅行的浪漫和兴奋。

examples.text: Her taste in fiction was for chunky historical romances.
examples.translation: 她所喜欢的小说是大部头的历史爱情小说。

examples.text: Since taking up writing romance in 1967 she has brought out over fifty books.
examples.translation: 自1967年开始写爱情小说起，她已经出了50多本书了。

examples.text: ...Arthurian Romances.
examples.translation: 亚瑟王的传奇故事

examples.text: He has romanced some of the world's most eligible women.
examples.translation: 他已经和一些非常适合结婚的女人谈过恋爱了。

examples.text: When we're together, all he talks about is business. I wish he were more romantic...
examples.translation: 我们在一起的时候，他总是谈论生意。我希望他能更浪漫一点。

examples.text: They enjoyed a romantic dinner for two at one of their favourite restaurants.
examples.translation: 他俩在他们最喜欢的一家餐馆里吃了一顿浪漫的二人晚餐。

examples.text: He lived with his pretty wife Helga — his barge was romantically called after her.
examples.translation: 他和漂亮的妻子海尔格一起生活——他的驳船也是以妻子的名字命名的，非常浪漫。

examples.text: ...his early romantic experiences...
examples.translation: 他早期的性爱经历

examples.text: He was not interested in a romantic relationship with Ingrid.
examples.translation: 他并没有兴趣和英格丽德发生性关系。

examples.text: We are not romantically involved.
examples.translation: 我们并不是男女朋友关系。

examples.text: It is a lovely romantic comedy, well worth seeing.
examples.translation: 这是一部温馨的爱情喜剧，非常值得一看。

examples.text: ...romantic novels.
examples.translation: 爱情小说

examples.text: He has a romantic view of rural society...
examples.translation: 他对农村的看法不切实际。

examples.text: I don't have any romantic notions about having a baby. It's a really tough job.
examples.translation: 我对生孩子并没有抱任何幻想。这的确是件很不容易的事情。

examples.text: You're a hopeless romantic.
examples.translation: 你是一个无可救药的浪漫主义者。

examples.text: They suffered from tuberculosis, then still romantically called consumption.
examples.translation: 他们得的是肺结核，但那时仍然满怀乐观地称之为痨病。

examples.text: Seacliff House is one of the most romantic ruins in Scotland.
examples.translation: 海崖城堡是苏格兰最富有浪漫色彩的遗迹之一。

examples.text: ...romantic images from travel brochures.
examples.translation: 旅行手册上充满浪漫色彩的图片

examples.text: ...the romantically named, but very muddy, Cave of the Wild Horses.
examples.translation: 一个有着动听名字但泥泞不堪的地方——野马洞

examples.text: ...the poems and prose of the English romantic poets.
examples.translation: 英国浪漫主义诗人的诗歌和散文

meanings.meaning: 屋顶；最高处，顶部；最高限度

examples.text: ...a small stone cottage with a red slate roof...
examples.translation: 有着红色石板房顶的小石屋

examples.text: A pail stood in one corner of the room to catch the drips where the roof leaked.
examples.translation: 房间的一角放着一个提桶，以接住从屋顶漏下来的水滴。

examples.text: The car rolled onto its roof, trapping him.
examples.translation: 车翻了，把他困在了里面。

examples.text: She clicked her tongue against the roof of her mouth.
examples.translation: 她用舌头顶着上腭发出啧啧声。

examples.text: The cave roof collapsed.
examples.translation: 洞顶坍塌了。

examples.text: Prices for Korean art have gone through the roof.
examples.translation: 韩国艺术品的价格飞涨。

examples.text: Sergeant Long will hit the roof when I tell him you've gone off.
examples.translation: 如果我告诉朗中士你已经走了，他会大发雷霆的。

examples.text: I am just thankful that we have a roof over our heads.
examples.translation: 我们有地方住我就很感激了。

examples.text: He raised the roof at the conference when he sang his own version of the socialist anthem, The Red Flag.
examples.translation: 他演唱自己改编的社会主义赞歌《红旗颂》时，声音穿透了会场的屋顶。

examples.text: The firms intend to open either together under one roof or alongside each other in shopping malls...
examples.translation: 这些公司想一起开在同一栋大楼里，或者彼此紧挨着开在大型购物中心里。

examples.text: While his relations with his mother were reasonably satisfactory, having her living under the same roof was a totally different matter!
examples.translation: 虽然他和母亲的关系还算不错，但和她住在一起就完全是另外一回事了。

examples.text: Lionel has forbidden her ever to mention that name again under his roof.
examples.translation: 莱昂内尔已经禁止她在他家里再提到这个名字。

meanings.meaning: 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人
为…提供住处；租房，合住；投宿，住宿；留…住宿

examples.text: A minute later he excused himself and left the room...
examples.translation: 一分钟之后，他说了声抱歉就离开了房间。

examples.text: Downstairs are two small rooms: a kitchen and a sitting room...
examples.translation: 楼下是两个小房间：一个厨房和一个起居室。

examples.text: The largest conference room could seat 5,000 people...
examples.translation: 最大的会议室可以容纳5,000人。

examples.text: The whole room roared with laughter.
examples.translation: 整个房间的人都大笑起来。

examples.text: If you're running upstairs, go to my room and bring down my sweater, please.
examples.translation: 如果你上楼，麻烦到我的房间把我的毛衣拿下来。

examples.text: Toni booked a room in an hotel not far from Arzfeld.
examples.translation: 托妮在离阿茨费尔德不远的一家宾馆订了一个房间。

examples.text: I had roomed with him in New Haven when we were both at Yale Law School.
examples.translation: 我和他都在耶鲁法学院读书的时候，在纽黑文合租了一个房间。

examples.text: There is usually room to accommodate up to 80 visitors...
examples.translation: 那里通常可以住得下80位来客。

examples.text: There wasn't enough room in the baggage compartment for all the gear...
examples.translation: 行李舱没有足够的空间放下所有的工具。

examples.text: The old artist's studio is a brilliant place for a party with a high ceiling and plenty of room.
examples.translation: 在这位老艺术家的工作室开派对是再好不过了，那里的屋顶很高，空间也很大。

examples.text: The intensity of the work left little room for personal grief or anxiety...
examples.translation: 高强度的工作使人几乎没空去悲伤或者忧虑。

examples.text: Once the plaster was dry there was no room for correction...
examples.translation: 一旦灰泥一干，就没有机会修改了。

examples.text: There's lots of room to express yourself creatively.
examples.translation: 有很多让你展现创意的机会。

examples.text: With an election looming, he has little room for manoeuvre.
examples.translation: 随着大选临近，他几乎没有什么回旋的余地了。

meanings.meaning: (Roll)人名；(英、法、德、俄、罗、葡、捷、挪、西、瑞典)罗尔

examples.text: The ball rolled into the net...
examples.translation: 球滚进了网中。

examples.text: Their car went off the road and rolled over...
examples.translation: 他们的车冲出公路，翻倒在一旁。

examples.text: I rolled a ball across the carpet...
examples.translation: 我把球滚过地毯。

examples.text: Roll the meat in coarsely ground black pepper to season it.
examples.translation: 将肉在粗研的黑胡椒粉里滚一下以调味。

examples.text: When I was a little kid I rolled down a hill and broke my leg...
examples.translation: 我小时候从一座山坡上滚了下来，把腿摔断了。

examples.text: They just rolled about on the floor punching each other like schoolboys...
examples.translation: 他们像小学生一样，在地板上滚来滚去，互相挥着拳头揍对方。

examples.text: She rolled over and propped herself up on her elbows.
examples.translation: 她打了个滚，然后用胳膊肘把自己撑了起来。

examples.text: The lorry quietly rolled forward.
examples.translation: 卡车静静地缓慢前行。

examples.text: He slipped and fell on an airplane gangway as the cameras rolled...
examples.translation: 在摄像时他不慎滑倒在飞机座位间的通道上。

examples.text: The newspaper presses are rolling in Pittsburgh again today.
examples.translation: 今天，匹兹堡的报纸又开始印刷了。

examples.text: She looked at Ginny and tears rolled down her cheeks.
examples.translation: 她看着金尼，泪水滑落脸庞。

examples.text: He took off his sweater, rolled it into a pillow and lay down on the grass...
examples.translation: 他脱下毛衣，将它卷成一个枕头，然后在草地上躺了下来。

examples.text: He rolled and lit another cigarette.
examples.translation: 他又卷了一支烟并点着了。

examples.text: Stein rolled up the paper bag with the money inside.
examples.translation: 斯坦把装了钱的纸袋卷了起来。

examples.text: The photographers had already shot a dozen rolls of film.
examples.translation: 摄影师们已经照了一打胶卷了。

examples.text: ...a roll of blue insulated wire.
examples.translation: 一卷蓝色的绝缘电线

examples.text: In mid-afternoon, shopkeepers began to roll down their shutters...
examples.translation: 下午三时左右，店主们开始放下百叶窗。

examples.text: She rolled up the window and drove on...
examples.translation: 她把车窗摇上来，继续开车。

examples.text: He rolled his window down and gave the man the money.
examples.translation: 他把窗户摇下来，把钱递给这个男人。

examples.text: People may roll their eyes and talk about overprotective, interfering grandmothers...
examples.translation: 人们可能会翻着白眼谈论那些溺爱儿孙、样样都要插手的祖母。

examples.text: His eyes rolled and he sobbed.
examples.translation: 他转了转眼睛，呜咽起来。

examples.text: He spread butter on a roll.
examples.translation: 他把黄油抹在小圆面包上。

examples.text: As the town clock struck two, they heard the roll of drums.
examples.translation: 当小镇的时钟敲响两点钟时，他们听到了隆隆的鼓声。

examples.text: ...the electoral roll.
examples.translation: 选民名单

examples.text: I made a name for myself and I was on a roll, I couldn't see anything going wrong.
examples.translation: 我靠自己的能力成名了，接二连三地获得成功，我觉得一切似乎一帆风顺。

examples.text: Roll on the day someone develops an effective vaccine against malaria.
examples.translation: 盼望有一天有人会研制出一种能有效预防疟疾的疫苗。

examples.text: Experts claimed that teachers had to be Einstein, Marie Curie and Linford Christie rolled into one to help children grasp the new national curriculum...
examples.translation: 专家们称老师必须集爱因斯坦、居里夫人和林弗德·克里斯蒂的本领于一身，才能帮助孩子们掌握新的国家课程大纲。

examples.text: This is our kitchen, sitting and dining room all rolled into one.
examples.translation: 这既是我们的厨房，又是客厅和餐厅。

examples.text: He tied the rope around his waist.
examples.translation: 他把绳索系在自己的腰上。

examples.text: ...a climbing rope.
examples.translation: 一根登山绳

examples.text: ...a piece of rope.
examples.translation: 一根绳子

examples.text: I roped myself to the chimney.
examples.translation: 我用绳子把自己系在烟囱上。

examples.text: He was knocked through the ropes by Tafer.
examples.translation: 他被塔费尔一拳打得从围绳间摔出了场外。

examples.text: The King has merely given the politicians enough rope to hang themselves...
examples.translation: 国王只不过是给了这些政客自缚的绳子。

examples.text: If we give her enough rope, she will hang herself.
examples.translation: 如果我们让她为所欲为，她一定会栽大跟头的。

examples.text: The moment she got to know the ropes, there was no stopping her.
examples.translation: 一旦她懂行了，就什么也难不住她了。

examples.text: The army claims the rebels are on the ropes.
examples.translation: 军队声称叛军支撑不了多久了。

examples.text: ...the twisted roots of an apple tree.
examples.translation: 苹果树盘绕的根

examples.text: Most plants will root in about six to eight weeks...
examples.translation: 大多数植物都会在6到8周内生根。

examples.text: Root the cuttings in a heated propagator.
examples.translation: 把插条放在加热的培育箱里生根。

examples.text: ...root crops such as carrots and potatoes.
examples.translation: 诸如胡萝卜和马铃薯之类的块根作物

examples.text: ...decay around the roots of teeth.
examples.translation: 牙根周围的腐蚀

examples.text: ...wax strips which remove hairs cleanly from the root.
examples.translation: 能彻底将毛发连根清除的脱毛蜡

examples.text: I am proud of my Brazilian roots...
examples.translation: 我为我的巴西血统感到自豪。

examples.text: It's 21 years since she first moved to Britain from the Lebanon, but she hasn't forgotten her roots.
examples.translation: 她从黎巴嫩搬到英国已经有21年了，但她从未忘记自己的根。

examples.text: ...superb roots reggae by the likes of Little Roy and Wailing Souls.
examples.translation: 像小罗伊、“哭泣灵魂”等这一类音乐人表演的极棒的老根雷盖乐

examples.text: We got to the root of the problem...
examples.translation: 我们找到了问题的根源。

examples.text: This lack of recognition was at the root of the dispute...
examples.translation: 这种不被承认就是这次纷争的根源。

examples.text: His sense of guilt had its roots in his childhood loss of his younger sister...
examples.translation: 他的负疚感源于他在童年失去了妹妹。

examples.text: They were treating symptoms and not the root cause.
examples.translation: 他们是治标不治本。

examples.text: The word 'secretary' comes from the same Latin root as the word 'secret'.
examples.translation: 单词secretary和secret有同样的拉丁词根。

examples.text: She rooted through the bag, found what she wanted, and headed toward the door...
examples.translation: 她在包里翻了一阵，找到了想要的东西，然后朝门口走去。

examples.text: Dogs root in the debris at the roadside.
examples.translation: 狗在路边的垃圾里觅食。

examples.text: The forces of National Socialism were transforming Germany root and branch...
examples.translation: 纳粹主义势力当时正在彻底改变德国。

examples.text: Some prison practices are in need of root and branch reform.
examples.translation: 有些监狱的做法需要彻底改革。

examples.text: When they got to Montana, they put down roots and built a life.
examples.translation: 到了蒙大拿后，他们便在那里扎根并过上了新生活。

examples.text: Time would be needed for democracy to take root...
examples.translation: 民主观念要深入人心需要时间。

examples.text: Without a sensible sex education all kinds of strange and fantastic ideas will take root.
examples.translation: 没有合理的性教育，各种各样奇怪荒诞的说法都会有人相信。

meanings.meaning: （表示厌恶、蔑视、烦恼等）胡说；糟了

examples.text: If we don't unload it soon, the grain will start rotting in the silos...
examples.translation: 如果我们不立刻把粮食卸下来，它们就会在筒仓里开始腐烂。

examples.text: Sugary canned drinks rot your teeth.
examples.translation: 罐装的甜饮料会腐蚀牙齿。

examples.text: ...the smell of rotting fish.
examples.translation: 鱼变质的气味

examples.text: Investigations had revealed extensive rot in the beams under the ground floor...
examples.translation: 调查发现一层地下的横梁大面积腐烂。

examples.text: Neither the timber frame nor metal chassis were protected against rot.
examples.translation: 木构架和金属底盘都没有采取防腐措施。

examples.text: In many schools, the rot is beginning to set in. Standards are falling all the time...
examples.translation: 很多学校的情况正开始变得越来越糟，教学水平一路下滑。

examples.text: The country's leaders are unwilling to take unpopular measures to stop the rot.
examples.translation: 该国领导人不愿采取不受欢迎的措施来阻止形势恶化。

examples.text: Most governments simply leave the long-term jobless to rot on the dole.
examples.translation: 大多数政府就让那些长期失业的人领着救济金颓废度日。

examples.text: What a load of pompous, pseudo-intellectual rot...
examples.translation: 真是自命不凡的伪知识分子的一派胡言！

examples.text: You do talk rot!
examples.translation: 你胡扯！

meanings.meaning: 旋转式机器；[动力] 转缸式发动机

examples.text: ...turning linear into rotary motion.
examples.translation: 把直线运动改成旋转运动

examples.text: ...heavy-duty rotary blades.
examples.translation: 重型旋转桨叶

examples.text: ...a rotary engine.
examples.translation: 转缸式发动机

examples.text: The Earth rotates round the sun...
examples.translation: 地球围绕太阳转。

examples.text: Take each foot in both your hands and rotate it to loosen and relax the ankle.
examples.translation: 双手抓住自己的双脚，转动一下，以放松脚踝。

examples.text: The members of the club can rotate and one person can do all the preparation for the evening...
examples.translation: 俱乐部的成员可以轮流工作，而且一个人就能做好晚上的所有准备工作。

examples.text: They will swap posts in a year's time, according to new party rules which rotate the leadership.
examples.translation: 根据轮流担任领导的新政党章程，他们在一年后会轮换职位。

examples.text: The European Union's rotating presidency passed from Sweden to Belgium.
examples.translation: 欧盟轮值主席国由瑞典换成了比利时。

meanings.meaning: 腐烂的；堕落的；恶臭的；虚弱的；极坏的

examples.text: The smell outside this building is overwhelming — like rotten eggs...
examples.translation: 这栋大楼外面的气味让人无法忍受——就像臭鸡蛋的味道。

examples.text: The front bay window is rotten.
examples.translation: 前面的凸窗腐朽了。

examples.text: I personally think it's a rotten idea...
examples.translation: 我个人觉得这个主意非常糟糕。

examples.text: I had a pretty rotten day yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天我过得很糟糕。

examples.text: What rotten luck!
examples.translation: 真是倒霉透顶！

examples.text: You rotten swine! How dare you?...
examples.translation: 你这个讨厌鬼！你竟敢这样？

examples.text: That's a rotten thing to say!
examples.translation: 说这样的话真是太刻薄了！

examples.text: I had glandular fever and spent that year feeling rotten...
examples.translation: 我得了腺热，那一整年都不舒服。

examples.text: Suddenly, Sarah felt rotten about the whole thing.
examples.translation: 突然，萨拉对整件事情感到内疚。

examples.text: She was a rotten coward...
examples.translation: 她是一个讨厌的胆小鬼。

examples.text: Keep your rotten mouth shut.
examples.translation: 闭上你的臭嘴！

meanings.meaning: 玫瑰；粉红色；蔷薇（花）；粉红色的葡萄酒
玫瑰花的；玫瑰色的；粉红色的；带有玫瑰香味的
使成玫瑰色，使（面颊）发红；使有玫瑰香味
起义( rise的过去式)；升起；（数量）增加；休会

examples.text: She bent to pick a red rose.
examples.translation: 她弯腰去摘一朵红玫瑰。

examples.text: ...a bunch of yellow roses.
examples.translation: 一束黄玫瑰

examples.text: Prune rambling roses when the flowers have faded.
examples.translation: 花朵凋谢后要剪除杂生的玫瑰枝。

examples.text: ...fragrant rose bushes.
examples.translation: 芳香的玫瑰丛

examples.text: ...the rose and violet hues of a twilight sky.
examples.translation: 黄昏时天空中玫瑰色和紫罗兰色的云霞

examples.text: We all knew that life was unlikely to be a bed of roses back in England.
examples.translation: 我们都知道回到英格兰以后的生活不太可能幸福完美。

examples.text: Earlier this year, everything was coming up roses for them. Their 'Going Blank Again' album was selling well, and their British tour was a virtual sell-out.
examples.translation: 今年年初，他们一切都很顺利。专辑《再次一片空白》十分畅销，英国巡演的票也几乎销售一空。

meanings.meaning: 迂回的，绕道的；圆滚滚的
迂回路线；环状交叉路口

examples.text: He left today on a roundabout route for Jordan and is also due soon in Egypt.
examples.translation: 他今天启程绕道去约旦，用不了多久还会去埃及。

examples.text: We made a bit of a fuss in a roundabout way.
examples.translation: 我们拐弯抹角地发了点牢骚。

examples.text: ...using indirect or roundabout language in place of a precise noun.
examples.translation: 使用间接的、旁敲侧击的语言，而不是准确的名词

examples.text: Hilton roused him at eight-thirty by rapping on the door...
examples.translation: 希尔顿8点半敲门把他叫醒了。

examples.text: When I put my hand on his, he stirs but doesn't quite rouse.
examples.translation: 当我把手放到他手上时，他动了动，但并没有完全醒来。

examples.text: She seemed to be unable to rouse herself to do anything...
examples.translation: 她似乎打不起精神去做任何事情。

examples.text: He roused himself from his lazy contemplation of the scene beneath him...
examples.translation: 他不再懒洋洋地注视着下面的景色。

examples.text: He did more to rouse the crowd there than anybody else...
examples.translation: 他比其他任何人都更积极地鼓动那里的群众。

examples.text: Ben says his father was good-natured, a man not quickly roused to anger or harsh opinions.
examples.translation: 本说他父亲的脾气温和，不轻易发火或是发表尖锐的意见。

examples.text: ...a rousing speech to the convention in support of the president.
examples.translation: 在大会上作的支持总统的煽动性演说

examples.text: It roused a feeling of rebellion in him...
examples.translation: 这激起了他的叛逆感。

examples.text: This roused my interest in politics and I went to work for the Democrats.
examples.translation: 这激发了我对政治的兴趣，于是我开始效力于民主党。

meanings.meaning: 粗糙的；粗略的；粗野的；艰苦的；未经加工的
艰苦；高低不平的地面；未经加工的材料；粗糙的部分

examples.text: His hands were rough and calloused, from years of karate practice...
examples.translation: 由于多年练习空手道，他的双手粗糙不平，布满老茧。

examples.text: Grace made her way slowly across the rough ground.
examples.translation: 格雷斯缓慢地走过高低不平的地面。

examples.text: She rested her cheek against the roughness of his jacket.
examples.translation: 她把脸颊靠在他粗糙的夹克上。

examples.text: Rugby's a rough game at the best of times...
examples.translation: 即使是在比赛最不激烈的时候，橄榄球也是一种粗野的运动。

examples.text: They have complained of discrimination and occasional rough treatment.
examples.translation: 他们抗议遭受歧视，而且偶尔还会遭到粗暴的对待。

examples.text: A hand roughly pushed him aside.
examples.translation: 一只手粗鲁地把他推到了一边。

examples.text: He regretted his roughness.
examples.translation: 他对自己的粗鲁感到后悔。

examples.text: It was quite a rough part of our town.
examples.translation: 这是我们城里犯罪率很高的地区。

examples.text: All women have a rough time in our society...
examples.translation: 在我们的社会中，所有女性的日子都不好过。

examples.text: Tomorrow, he knew, would be a rough day.
examples.translation: 他知道明天将会是艰难的一天。

examples.text: The virus won't go away and the lad is still feeling a bit rough.
examples.translation: 病毒无法清除，这个小伙子仍然觉得有点不舒服。

examples.text: We were only able to make a rough estimate of how much fuel would be required...
examples.translation: 我们只能对所需燃料作一个粗略的估计。

examples.text: As a rough guide, a horse needs 2.5 per cent of his body weight in food every day.
examples.translation: 作为一个大致的参照，一匹马每天需要吃相当于其体重2.5％的食物。

examples.text: Gambling and tourism pay roughly half the entire state budget...
examples.translation: 博彩业和旅游业支撑着整个国家约一半的财政预算。

examples.text: The Ukraine is roughly equal to France in size and population.
examples.translation: 乌克兰的面积和人口与法国大致相当。

examples.text: ...a period of very roughly 30 million years.
examples.translation: 非常粗略地算作3,000万年的一段时间

examples.text: I've got a rough idea of what he looks like...
examples.translation: 我已经大致知道他长什么样子了。

examples.text: It often helps to make a rough sketch showing where the vehicles were.
examples.translation: 画一个简略的草图标示车辆当时所在的位置往往很有用。

examples.text: He knew roughly what was about to be said...
examples.translation: 他大概知道要说些什么。

examples.text: Roughly speaking, a scientific humanist is somebody who believes in science and in humanity but not in God.
examples.translation: 简单来讲，科学人道主义者是相信科学和人道主义而不相信上帝的人。

examples.text: ...a rough wooden table.
examples.translation: 做工粗糙的木桌子

examples.text: ...chairs set in a rough circle in the middle of the room.
examples.translation: 房间中央大致围成一圈的椅子

examples.text: Roughly chop the tomatoes and add them to the casserole.
examples.translation: 把西红柿大致切一切，然后放到炖锅里。

examples.text: ...houses, roughly painted white or blue.
examples.translation: 简单刷成白色或蓝色的房子

examples.text: A fishing vessel and a cargo ship collided in rough seas.
examples.translation: 一艘捕鱼船和一艘货船在波涛汹涌的海上相撞了。

examples.text: It makes me so sad when I see young people begging or sleeping rough on the streets.
examples.translation: 我看到年轻人沿街乞讨、露宿街头，心里会非常难过。

examples.text: You won't be roughing it; each room comes equipped with a telephone and a 3-channel radio.
examples.translation: 你不会过得太艰苦;每个房间都配备了一部电话和一台可以接收3个频道的收音机。

meanings.meaning: [计] 程序；日常工作；例行公事

examples.text: The players had to change their daily routine and lifestyle...
examples.translation: 这些运动员不得不改变他们的日常生活习惯和方式。

examples.text: They include the floor exercises as a regular part of their fitness routine...
examples.translation: 他们把自由体操做为日常健身运动的固定环节。

examples.text: He checked up on you as a matter of routine.
examples.translation: 他给你做例行检查。

examples.text: ...a series of routine medical tests...
examples.translation: 一系列常规的医疗检查

examples.text: The operator has to be able to carry out routine maintenance of the machine.
examples.translation: 操作员必须能对机器进行日常维护。

examples.text: So many days are routine and uninteresting, especially in winter.
examples.translation: 许多日子都过得平淡乏味，尤其是在冬天。

examples.text: ...this routine thriller about a CIA man and a KGB operative.
examples.translation: 这部关于一个中情局特工和一个克格勃特务的平淡无奇的惊悚片

examples.text: ...the mundane routine of her life...
examples.translation: 她平淡乏味的生活

examples.text: Family holidays are meant to be a break from routine.
examples.translation: 家庭假日就是从平淡的日常生活中解脱一下。

examples.text: ... an installation routine.
examples.translation: 一个安装程序

examples.text: ... like a Marx Brothers routine.
examples.translation: 像马克思兄弟风格的搞笑套路

examples.text: ...an athletic dance routine.
examples.translation: 一套体育舞蹈动作

examples.text: ...the most direct route to the town centre...
examples.translation: 到市中心最直接的路线

examples.text: All escape routes were blocked by armed police...
examples.translation: 所有逃跑的路都被武警封锁了。

examples.text: Tens of thousands lined the route from Dublin airport.
examples.translation: 从都柏林机场出来的道路两边站着数万人。

examples.text: ...the main shipping routes to Japan.
examples.translation: 去往日本的主要航运线路

examples.text: ...the Broadway-Webster exit on Route 580.
examples.translation: 580号公路的百老汇－韦伯斯特出口

examples.text: He began cracking open big blue tins of butter cookies and feeding the dogs on his route...
examples.translation: 他打开装黄油饼干的蓝色大罐子，开始沿路给狗喂食。

examples.text: They would go out on his route and check him.
examples.translation: 他们会到他那里走访一下，看看他的情况。

examples.text: Researchers are trying to get at the same information through an indirect route...
examples.translation: 研究人员正试图通过间接的途径获得相同的信息。

examples.text: Buying the best is as sure a route to success in investment as in any other field.
examples.translation: 和其他领域一样，投资领域获得成功的途径也是买进最佳商品。

examples.text: Double-stack trains are taking a lot of freight that used to be routed via trucks...
examples.translation: 以往由卡车运送的很多货物现在都改用双层列车运送了。

examples.text: Approaching cars will be routed into two lanes.
examples.translation: 驶来的车辆会分流到两条车道。

examples.text: ...plans to route every emergency call in Britain through just three telephone exchanges.
examples.translation: 只通过3次电话转接来传送英国境内所有紧急呼叫的计划

examples.text: They have arrived in London en route to the United States...
examples.translation: 他们已经到达伦敦，正在前往美国的途中。

examples.text: One of the bags was lost en route.
examples.translation: 其中一个包在途中丢失了。

examples.text: The German set three tournament records and equalled two others en route to grabbing golf's richest prize.
examples.translation: 那个德国人在获得高尔夫球赛最高奖金的同时刷新了3项锦标赛纪录，平了其他两项纪录。

examples.text: They have gone the route, in many cases, of just big — big bowls, big statues, big masks, big everything.
examples.translation: 在很多情况下，他们从头到尾都只做大的东西——大碗，大雕像，大面具，所有东西都是大的。

meanings.meaning: 圆的；完全的；大概的；肥胖的
在周围；迂回地；朝反方向；挨个

examples.text: They were sitting round the kitchen table...
examples.translation: 他们正围坐在餐桌旁。

examples.text: The nightdress has handmade lace round the armholes and neckline...
examples.translation: 这件女式睡衣的袖孔和领口都镶着一圈手织花边。

examples.text: All round us was desert...
examples.translation: 我们周围全是沙漠。

examples.text: I shivered and pulled my scarf more tightly round my neck...
examples.translation: 我打了个寒战，用围巾把脖子围得更紧了。

examples.text: He tramped hurriedly round the lake towards the garden.
examples.translation: 他匆匆地迈着沉重的步伐绕过湖边向花园走去。

examples.text: ...cycling round and round the park.
examples.translation: 骑自行车围着公园转了一圈又一圈

examples.text: Visibility was good all round...
examples.translation: 四周的视野都很好。

examples.text: The goldfish swam round and round in their tiny bowls.
examples.translation: 金鱼在小小的鱼缸里一圈圈地游来游去。

examples.text: Suddenly a car came round a corner on the opposite side...
examples.translation: 突然，对面的街角处拐过一辆汽车。

examples.text: Stay on the left-hand pavement to follow a road downhill round a curve...
examples.translation: 继续顺着左边的人行道拐一个弯，然后沿路下山。

examples.text: One of his men tapped and looked round the door.
examples.translation: 他的一个部下轻轻地敲了下门，然后往门里看了一眼。

examples.text: He happens to own half the land round here...
examples.translation: 他恰好拥有这里一半的土地。

examples.text: I think he has earned the respect of leaders all round the world...
examples.translation: 我想他已经赢得了世界各国领导人的尊重。

examples.text: She's been on at me for weeks to show her round the stables...
examples.translation: 她已经跟我唠叨了好几个星期，让我带她到马厩转转。

examples.text: They need some way of getting round the country.
examples.translation: 他们需要一种交通工具来周游全国。

examples.text: Shirley found someone to show them round...
examples.translation: 雪莉找人带他们到处看了看。

examples.text: So you're going to have a look round?
examples.translation: 那么你打算到处看看？

examples.text: Holes can be worn remarkably quickly by a wheel going round at 60mph...
examples.translation: 以每小时60英里的速度前进的车轮很快就会磨出洞来。

examples.text: Stars appeared everywhere, spinning round and round, faster and faster.
examples.translation: 满眼金星乱转，而且越转越快。

examples.text: She paused, but did not turn round...
examples.translation: 她停了一下，但是并没有转身。

examples.text: The end result was that the ship had to turn round, and go back to Djibouti...
examples.translation: 最后的结果是这艘船不得不掉转方向，驶回吉布提。

examples.text: The wind veered round to the east...
examples.translation: 风转向东边刮去。

examples.text: Tricia looked round in surprise.
examples.translation: 翠西卡惊讶地回头看了看。

examples.text: He will be glad to refurnish where possible, change things round and redecorate...
examples.translation: 他会很乐意尽可能添置些家具，把东西挪一挪，然后重新装饰。

examples.text: I've already moved things round a bit to make it easier for him.
examples.translation: 我已经把东西挪了挪，好让他更方便。

examples.text: John handed round the plate of sandwiches.
examples.translation: 约翰把那盘三明治传给大家。

examples.text: ...as the whiskey bottle is passed round.
examples.translation: 当大家传递威士忌酒瓶的时候

examples.text: They started handing the microphone out round the girls at the front...
examples.translation: 他们开始把麦克风传给前面的女孩们。

examples.text: The word is passed round the industry if you think there's a troublesome driver.
examples.translation: 如果你认为某个司机总是惹麻烦，这种话会传遍全行业。

examples.text: I think we should go round and tell Kevin to turn his music down...
examples.translation: 我觉得我们应该去凯文家让他把音乐的声音调小一些。

examples.text: He came round with a bottle of champagne.
examples.translation: 他带着一瓶香槟过来了。

examples.text: I went round my wife's house.
examples.translation: 我去了我妻子家里。

examples.text: As we sat round chatting, I began to think I'd made a mistake...
examples.translation: 当我们坐在那里聊天时，我开始认为自己犯了一个错误。

examples.text: I was running round all hyped up.
examples.translation: 我兴奋地跑来跑去。

examples.text: She would spend the day hanging round street corners...
examples.translation: 她会在街角游荡，无所事事地度过这一天。

examples.text: Leonard pottered round the greenhouse, tying up canes for the tomatoes.
examples.translation: 伦纳德在温室里悠然自得地给西红柿绑上撑杆。

examples.text: That was for a design built round an existing American engine...
examples.translation: 那是用在以现有的一种美国发动机为基础的设计之上的。

examples.text: The core of the Festival's programme centres round performances of new and 20th century work.
examples.translation: 这个音乐节最重要的节目以演奏20世纪的作品和新作为主。

examples.text: Don't just immediately give up but think about ways round a problem...
examples.translation: 不要马上放弃，应该想想解决问题的办法。

examples.text: There are ways of getting round most things!
examples.translation: 有几种可以解决大多数问题的方法。

examples.text: He did his best to talk me round, but I wouldn't speak to him...
examples.translation: 他竭力想要说服我改变主意，但是我不愿意跟他讲话。

examples.text: The Chandler twins were coming round to the same opinion.
examples.translation: 钱德勒家的这对双胞胎也最终统一了意见。

examples.text: In the past, the elections have been marked by hundreds of murders, but this time round the violence has been much more limited...
examples.translation: 在过去，这些选举中总是会发生数百起谋杀案，但这一次暴力事件已经非常少了。

examples.text: Of course, it isn't the same first time round...
examples.translation: 当然，这不同于第一次了。

examples.text: We were very keen when the 1954 Rally came round.
examples.translation: 1954年的集会开始时，我们都非常热切。

examples.text: I'm about two inches larger round the waist.
examples.translation: 我的腰围大概粗了两英寸。

examples.text: ...forty-eight inches round the hips.
examples.translation: 臀围48英寸

examples.text: It's six feet high and five feet round.
examples.translation: 它高6英尺，周长5英尺。

examples.text: I go to bed round 11:00 at night.
examples.translation: 我大约晚上11点上床睡觉。

examples.text: Round about one and a half million people died.
examples.translation: 大概有150万人死亡。

examples.text: ...a system that was abolished round about 1902.
examples.translation: 大约在1902年被废除的制度

examples.text: It ought to make life much easier all round...
examples.translation: 它应该会让生活的方方面面都变得更加方便。

examples.text: Nerves are frayed all round.
examples.translation: 每一根神经都绷紧了。

examples.text: It all keeps going round and round in my head till I don't know where I am.
examples.translation: 这一直在我脑海里萦绕，直到我不知身在何处。

examples.text: Many of these plants are evergreen, so you can enjoy them all year round...
examples.translation: 这些植物中有很多都是四季常青的，所以一年到头都可以观赏。

examples.text: It's a treat to be enjoyed all the year round.
examples.translation: 这是全年都能享受到的款待。

examples.text: It was agreed that another round of preliminary talks would be held in Peking...
examples.translation: 经协商，新一轮的预备会谈将在北京举行。

examples.text: This is the latest round of job cuts aimed at making the company more competitive...
examples.translation: 这是旨在增强公司竞争力的新一轮裁员。

examples.text: There will be more frequent rounds of inspection by our security personnel.
examples.translation: 我们的安全人员会进行几轮更加频繁的检查。

examples.text: ...in the third round of the Pilkington Cup...
examples.translation: 在皮尔金顿杯的第3轮比赛中

examples.text: After round three, two Americans share the lead.
examples.translation: 第3轮比赛结束后，两名美国选手领先。

examples.text: He was declared the victor in the 11th round...
examples.translation: 在第11回合中，他被宣布获胜。

examples.text: Gibson's left eye is completely closed before the end of round one.
examples.translation: 在第一回合结束前，吉布森的左眼完全闭上了。

examples.text: ...two rounds of golf...
examples.translation: 两场高尔夫球赛

examples.text: Ronan Rafferty shot six birdies in a round of 67.
examples.translation: 罗南·拉弗蒂在成绩为67杆的一场比赛中打出了6次小鸟球。

examples.text: ...small fresh rounds of goats' cheese...
examples.translation: 新鲜的小块圆形山羊奶酪

examples.text: A cucumber was sliced into rounds.
examples.translation: 黄瓜被切成了圆片。

examples.text: ...four rounds of toast.
examples.translation: 4片吐司

examples.text: The consultants still did their morning rounds...
examples.translation: 这些顾问们上午仍然四处走访。

examples.text: He got out of the car, and carried on with his paper round.
examples.translation: 他下了汽车，继续带着文件四处拜访。

examples.text: They sat on the clubhouse terrace, downing a round of drinks...
examples.translation: 他们坐在俱乐部会所的露台上，大口喝着别人请的饮料。

examples.text: I think it's my round.
examples.translation: 我想这轮该我请了。

examples.text: ...firing 1650 rounds of ammunition during a period of ten minutes.
examples.translation: 在10分钟之内打出了1,650发子弹

examples.text: ...the use of live rounds of ammunition.
examples.translation: 使用未引爆的弹药

examples.text: Sue got a sympathetic round of applause.
examples.translation: 休得到了一片赞成的掌声。

examples.text: This story was going the rounds 20 years ago.
examples.translation: 20年前，这个故事广为流传。

examples.text: After school, I had picked up Nick and Ted and made the rounds of the dry cleaner and the grocery store...
examples.translation: 放学以后，我接了尼克和特德，然后又去了干洗店和杂货店。

examples.text: We could do the rounds of the galleries.
examples.translation: 我们可以逐一参观各个画廊。

examples.text: She had small feet and hands and a flat, round face.
examples.translation: 她的手脚都很小，脸又扁又圆。

examples.text: ...the round church known as The New Temple.
examples.translation: 被称为“新教堂”的球形教堂

examples.text: ...large round loaves dusted with flour.
examples.translation: 撒着面粉的巨大圆面包

examples.text: The boy sucked his thumb and stared at Hebburn with huge, round eyes.
examples.translation: 男孩吮吸着拇指，瞪圆了大眼睛盯着赫本。

examples.text: A million pounds seemed a suitably round number.
examples.translation: 100万英镑看起来是一个比较合适的整数。

examples.text: The money goes into the team pool, which this summer, in round figures, has now reached £18,000.
examples.translation: 钱都存入小组的集体基金，到今年夏天基金的整数已经达到了18,000英镑。

examples.text: The house disappeared from sight as we rounded a corner...
examples.translation: 我们绕过街角就看不到那座房子了。

examples.text: After rounding Cape Finisterre the boats ride the north-easterly trades.
examples.translation: 绕过菲尼斯特雷角之后，这些船开始在东北信风的吹送下破浪前行。

examples.text: We needed to do decimals to round up and round down numbers...
examples.translation: 我们得把小数四舍五入成整数。

examples.text: The fraction was then multiplied by 100 and rounded to the nearest half or whole number...
examples.translation: 然后，分数被乘以100，取整为最接近的半数或整数。

examples.text: I'll round it off to about £30.
examples.translation: 我将它取整，大约是30英镑。

meanings.meaning: 皇家的；盛大的；女王的；高贵的；第一流的

examples.text: ...an invitation to a royal garden party.
examples.translation: 参加皇家游园会的邀请

examples.text: ...the Japanese royal couple, Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko.
examples.translation: 明仁天皇和美智子皇后这对日本皇室夫妇

examples.text: ...the Royal Academy of Music.
examples.translation: 皇家音乐学院

examples.text: ...several pilots of the Royal Navy's 846 Squadron.
examples.translation: 皇家海军846中队的几个领航员

examples.text: The royals have always been patrons of charities pulling in large donations.
examples.translation: 王室成员一向热心慈善事业，捐资数目巨大。

examples.text: Royalty and government leaders from all around the world are gathering in Japan.
examples.translation: 世界各国的王室成员和政府首脑齐聚日本。

examples.text: ...a ceremony attended by royalty.
examples.translation: 王室成员参加的一个庆典

examples.text: I lived on about £3,000 a year from the royalties on my book.
examples.translation: 我靠着写书得来的每年约3,000英镑的版税生活。

examples.text: The royalties enabled the inventor to re-establish himself in business.
examples.translation: 专利使用费让这位发明家得以再次立足于商界。

examples.text: ...a row of pretty little cottages...
examples.translation: 一排漂亮的小村舍

examples.text: Several men are pushing school desks and chairs into neat rows.
examples.translation: 几个人正挪动学校的桌椅，将它们排整齐。

examples.text: She was sitting in the front row.
examples.translation: 她坐在前排。

examples.text: ...the house at 236 Larch Row.
examples.translation: 拉奇街236号的房子

examples.text: They have won five championships in a row...
examples.translation: 他们已经5次蝉联冠军。

examples.text: If I'm inside for three days in a row, I go crazy...
examples.translation: 如果连续3天不出来，我会发疯的。

examples.text: It is the sixth month in a row in which imports have fallen.
examples.translation: 这是进口量持续下降的第6个月了。

examples.text: He rowed as quickly as he could to the shore...
examples.translation: 他尽快地把船划到岸边。

examples.text: We could all row a boat and swim almost before we could walk...
examples.translation: 我们所有人几乎在还不会走之前就已经会划船和游泳了。

examples.text: The boatman refused to row him back.
examples.translation: 船夫拒绝划船把他送回去。

examples.text: I took Daniel for a row.
examples.translation: 我带着丹尼尔去划船了。

examples.text: This is likely to provoke a further row about the bank's role in the affair...
examples.translation: 这有可能会加深关于银行在此事中的作用的分歧。

examples.text: The ministers must have realized that they risked what could be a major diplomatic row with France.
examples.translation: 部长们应该已经认识到了他们这样做可能会与法国产生严重的外交纠纷。

examples.text: We never seem to stay together for very long before we have a dreadful row...
examples.translation: 我们总是在一起呆不了多久就会大吵一架。

examples.text: A man had been stabbed to death in a family row.
examples.translation: 一位男子在一场家庭纠纷中被刺死。

examples.text: They rowed all the time...
examples.translation: 他们总是争吵不休。

examples.text: He had earlier rowed with his girlfriend.
examples.translation: 他早先和女友吵过架。

examples.text: 'Whatever is that row?' she demanded. 'Pop festival,' he answered.
examples.translation: “那闹哄哄的究竟是在做什么？”她问道。“是流行音乐节，”他回答说。

examples.text: He rubbed his arms and stiff legs...
examples.translation: 他按摩着自己的胳膊和僵硬的双腿。

examples.text: 'I fell in a ditch', he said, rubbing at a scrape on his hand.
examples.translation: “我掉进沟里了”，他一边说着，一边揉着手上的擦伤。

examples.text: A cat was rubbing against my leg...
examples.translation: 一只猫在我腿上蹭来蹭去。

examples.text: He kept rubbing his leg against mine.
examples.translation: 他不停地用腿蹭我的腿。

examples.text: She took off her glasses and rubbed them hard...
examples.translation: 她摘下眼镜使劲擦着。

examples.text: He rubbed and rubbed but couldn't seem to get clean.
examples.translation: 他擦了又擦，可就是擦不干净。

examples.text: He rubbed oil into my back...
examples.translation: 他往我的背上抹油

examples.text: I pretended to rub a fleck of grit from one eye.
examples.translation: 我假装拭去一只眼睛里的沙粒。

examples.text: He rubbed his hands together a few times.
examples.translation: 他搓了几下手。

examples.text: ...the 650-mile rift that separates the Pacific and North American geological plates as they rub together.
examples.translation: 太平洋和北美洲地质板块相互摩擦时产生的一条长达650英里的裂缝

examples.text: Smear cream on to your baby's skin at the edges of the plaster to prevent it from rubbing.
examples.translation: 在宝宝贴膏药的皮肤边缘涂上护肤霜，以防止膏药擦伤皮肤。

examples.text: 'What do you want to write about?'. And there was the rub, because I didn't yet know.
examples.translation: “你想写什么？”难就难在这儿，因为我还不知道写什么。

examples.text: She sometimes asks if I want a back rub.
examples.translation: 她有时会问我想不想做个背部按摩。

examples.text: ...a fresh cucumber rub for your whole face.
examples.translation: 用新鲜黄瓜给整张脸做的面膜

examples.text: He regularly rubbed shoulders with the likes of Elizabeth Taylor and Kylie Minogue.
examples.translation: 他经常与伊丽莎白·泰勒和凯莉·米洛这样的人接触。

examples.text: What are you going to get out of him if you rub him up the wrong way?
examples.translation: 你要是不小心把他惹毛了，你有什么好处？

examples.text: ...unwanted household rubbish...
examples.translation: 无用的家庭垃圾

examples.text: They had piled most of their rubbish into yellow skips.
examples.translation: 他们把大多数的垃圾堆到了黄色的废料桶里。

examples.text: He described her book as absolute rubbish.
examples.translation: 他说她的书一文不值。

examples.text: He's talking rubbish...
examples.translation: 他胡说八道。

examples.text: These reports are total and utter rubbish.
examples.translation: 这些报告废话连篇。

examples.text: He was rubbish at his job...
examples.translation: 他的工作做得差劲极了。

examples.text: I tried playing golf, but I was rubbish.
examples.translation: 我试过打高尔夫球，但是我的球技太烂了。

examples.text: Five whole pages of script were devoted to rubbishing her political opponents...
examples.translation: 整整5页讲稿都是对她的政敌的诋毁。

examples.text: Officials have simply rubbished all positive ideas.
examples.translation: 官员们对所有的正面意见一律否决。

meanings.meaning: 橡胶；橡皮；合成橡胶；按摩师
扭转脖子看；好奇地引颈而望

examples.text: ...the smell of burning rubber.
examples.translation: 橡胶燃烧的气味

examples.text: ...rubber gloves.
examples.translation: 橡胶手套

examples.text: ...a rubber ball.
examples.translation: 橡胶球

examples.text: Let's have a few rubbers of bridge.
examples.translation: 我们玩几局桥牌吧。

meanings.meaning: (Ruby)人名；(法)吕比；(英、西、德、匈、瑞典)鲁比

examples.text: ...a ruby and diamond ring.
examples.translation: 红宝石钻戒

examples.text: ...a glass of ruby-red Cabernet Sauvignon.
examples.translation: 一杯深红色的赤霞珠红葡萄酒

meanings.meaning: 粗鲁的；无礼的；狂暴的；未开化的

examples.text: He's rude to her friends and obsessively jealous...
examples.translation: 他对她的朋友很无礼而且嫉妒心重。

examples.text: People were quite often rude about him, often the people he had helped...
examples.translation: 人们经常对他很无礼，其中有很多还曾得到过他的帮助。

examples.text: Unfair bosses and rude customers make us unhappy on the job.
examples.translation: 不公正的老板和粗鲁的顾客让我们工作起来很不愉快。

examples.text: I could not understand why she felt compelled to behave so rudely to a friend.
examples.translation: 我不明白为什么她非要如此粗鲁地对待一位朋友。

examples.text: She was angry at Steve's rudeness, but I could forgive it.
examples.translation: 她对史蒂夫的无礼非常生气，但是我可以原谅这一点。

examples.text: Fred keeps cracking rude jokes with the guests...
examples.translation: 弗雷德不停地和客人们开着粗俗的玩笑。

examples.text: Luke made a rude gesture with his finger.
examples.translation: 卢克用手指做了个下流的手势。

examples.text: It will come as a rude shock when their salary or income-tax refund cannot be cashed.
examples.translation: 如果他们的工资或所得税返还不能兑现，这对他们来说将是晴天霹雳。

examples.text: People were awakened rudely by a siren just outside their window.
examples.translation: 人们被窗外传来的汽笛声猛然惊醒了。

examples.text: Roden had already constructed a rude cabin for himself and his family in case of necessity.
examples.translation: 罗登已为自己和家人搭好了一个简陋的小木屋，以备不时之需。

examples.text: He is in rude health and can cycle 40 or 50 miles non-stop.
examples.translation: 他体格强壮，能连续骑车四五十英里。

meanings.meaning: 小地毯；毛皮地毯；男子假发

examples.text: A Persian rug covered the hardwood floors.
examples.translation: 硬木地板上铺着一张波斯地毯。

examples.text: The old lady was seated in her chair at the window, a rug over her knees.
examples.translation: 老太太坐在窗边的椅子上，膝盖上盖着一条小毯子。

examples.text: ...a travel rug.
examples.translation: 旅行毛毯

examples.text: If the banks opt to pull the rug from under the ill-fated project, it will go into liquidation.
examples.translation: 如果这些银行不再对这个倒霉的项目提供支持，它也就破产了。

examples.text: My wife was ruining her health through worry...
examples.translation: 忧虑严重损害了我妻子的健康。

examples.text: Entire villages have been washed away. Roads and bridges have been destroyed and crops ruined.
examples.translation: 这些村庄全部都被冲走了。道路和桥梁都被破坏了，农作物也全毁了。

examples.text: She accused him of ruining her financially with his taste for the high life.
examples.translation: 她指责他为了追求奢华的生活致使她倾家荡产。

examples.text: The farmers say recent inflation has driven them to the brink of ruin.
examples.translation: 农民们说最近的通货膨胀使他们濒临破产。

examples.text: The vineyards were falling into ruin...
examples.translation: 这些葡萄园日渐没落。

examples.text: She wasn't going to let her plans go to ruin.
examples.translation: 她不会让她的计划破产的。

examples.text: The new Turkish republic he helped to build emerged from the ruins of a great empire...
examples.translation: 他帮助建立起的新土耳其共和国是从一个伟大帝国的废墟上发展起来的。

examples.text: He stood very still, staring in at the ruins of his work.
examples.translation: 他站在那里一动也不动，呆呆地看着他残余的作品。

examples.text: One dead child was found in the ruins almost two hours after the explosion...
examples.translation: 爆炸发生将近两个小时以后，在废墟中发现了一个已经死亡的小孩。

examples.text: There's only the mountain in this direction, and higher up an old ruin, an abandoned castle.
examples.translation: 从这个方向望去只看得到这座山，以及更高处的一处废墟，一座废弃的城堡。

examples.text: Its heavily-subsidized economy is in ruins...
examples.translation: 其靠资助维持的经济已经完全崩溃了。

examples.text: This country was once proud of its education system. Now it seems to be in ruins.
examples.translation: 这个国家曾一度为其教育体系感到自豪。但现在它似乎已经千疮百孔了。

examples.text: The abbey was in ruins...
examples.translation: 这个修道院已经成了一片废墟。

examples.text: Within Germany, the city of Berlin lay in ruins.
examples.translation: 在德国，柏林市已经满目疮痍。

meanings.meaning: 尺；统治者；[测] 划线板，划线的人

examples.text: ...the former military ruler of Lesotho...
examples.translation: 莱索托的前军事统治者

examples.text: He was a weak-willed and indecisive ruler.
examples.translation: 他是一位意志薄弱、优柔寡断的统治者。

examples.text: The service has not just been a rumor, but an actual product since 2007.

meanings.meaning: 农村的，乡下的；田园的，有乡村风味的

examples.text: These plants have a tendency to grow in the more rural areas.
examples.translation: 这些植物大多生长在偏远的乡村。

examples.text: ...the closure of rural schools.
examples.translation: 农村学校的关闭

examples.text: ...the old rural way of life...
examples.translation: 昔日的田园生活

examples.text: He spoke with a heavy rural accent.
examples.translation: 他说话带着浓重的农村口音。

meanings.meaning: 统治；规定；管理；裁决；支配

examples.text: ...a thirty-two-page pamphlet explaining the rules of basketball...
examples.translation: 说明篮球规则的32页的小册子

examples.text: Sikhs were expected to adhere strictly to the religious rules concerning appearance...
examples.translation: 锡克教徒应当严格遵守该教对外表的规定。

examples.text: Strictly speaking, this was against the rules.
examples.translation: 严格地说，这是违规的。

examples.text: ...the amendment to Rule 22.
examples.translation: 对第22条章程的修订

examples.text: An important rule is to drink plenty of water during any flight...
examples.translation: 一条重要的原则就是每次坐飞机都要多喝水。

examples.text: By and large, the rules for healthy eating are the same during pregnancy as at any other time.
examples.translation: 总的来说，怀孕期间健康饮食的原则和其他时期是一致的。

examples.text: It is a rule of English that adjectives generally precede the noun they modify.
examples.translation: 形容词一般放在所修饰名词的前面是英语中的一条规律。

examples.text: ...according to the rules of quantum theory.
examples.translation: 根据量子论的原理

examples.text: However, for many Americans today, weekend work has unfortunately become the rule rather than the exception.
examples.translation: 然而，现在对于很多美国人来说，周末工作不幸已经成为了一种普遍情况，而非例外。

examples.text: For four centuries, he says, foreigners have ruled Angola...
examples.translation: 他说，外来者统治安哥拉的时间已长达4个世纪。

examples.text: He ruled for eight months.
examples.translation: 他统治了8个月的时间。

examples.text: ...the long line of feudal lords who had ruled over this land.
examples.translation: 曾经统治这片土地的历代封建领主

examples.text: ...demands for an end to one-party rule.
examples.translation: 结束一党专政的要求

examples.text: Scientists have always been aware of how fear can rule our lives and make us ill.
examples.translation: 科学家一直都很清楚恐惧会影响我们的生活，引起我们身体的不适。

examples.text: The court ruled that laws passed by the assembly remained valid...
examples.translation: 法院裁定议会通过的法律仍然有效。

examples.text: The Israeli court has not yet ruled on the case...
examples.translation: 以色列法院尚未对此案作出裁决。

examples.text: A provincial magistrates' court last week ruled it unconstitutional...
examples.translation: 一家省级地方法院上周裁定其违宪。

examples.text: The committee ruled against all-night opening mainly on safety grounds.
examples.translation: 委员会反对通宵营业主要是出于安全方面的考虑。

examples.text: ...a ruled grid of horizontal and vertical lines.
examples.translation: 由水平线和垂直线画成的格子

examples.text: As a rule, however, such attacks have been aimed at causing damage rather than taking life.
examples.translation: 然而，通常此类袭击只是为了造成破坏，并非要人性命。

examples.text: As a general rule, burglars are wary about gaining entry from the front or side of a building.
examples.translation: 通常来说，窃贼对从房屋的正面或侧面潜入会比较谨慎。

examples.text: There is a particular urgency in this case, and it would help if you could bend the rules.
examples.translation: 这次碰巧有紧急情况，如果您能通融一下就好了。

examples.text: A good rule of thumb is that a broker must generate sales of ten times his salary if his employer is to make a profit...
examples.translation: 根据经验来看，如果雇主要获得利润，那么其代理商必须卖出相当于其工资10倍的销售额。

examples.text: As a rule of thumb, a cup of filter coffee contains about 80mg of caffeine.
examples.translation: 凭经验估计，一杯过滤咖啡约含80毫克咖啡因。

examples.text: Nurses are continuing to work to rule.
examples.translation: 护士们还在消极怠工。

meanings.meaning: (Rust)人名；(英)拉斯特；(德、捷、瑞典)鲁斯特；(法)吕斯特

examples.text: ...a decaying tractor, red with rust...
examples.translation: 锈迹斑斑的破拖拉机

examples.text: Manufacturers are looking into building cars out of plastic to avoid the problem of rust.
examples.translation: 制造商们正研究如何用塑料制造车辆，以避免生锈。

examples.text: Copper nails are better than iron nails because the iron rusts...
examples.translation: 铜钉比铁钉好，因为铁会生锈。

examples.text: There was an old rusting bolt on the door.
examples.translation: 门上有一个生锈的旧门闩。

examples.text: ...turquoise woodwork with accent colours of rust and ochre.
examples.translation: 主色调为深褐色和赭色的青绿色木制品

examples.text: ...a rust-coloured blouse.
examples.translation: 深褐色的上衣

examples.text: The President was ruthless in dealing with any hint of internal political dissent.
examples.translation: 在处理任何内部政治分歧的苗头时，总统都毫不留情。

examples.text: ...an invasion by a ruthless totalitarian power...
examples.translation: 残忍的极权主义国家的侵略

examples.text: The late newspaper tycoon is condemned for his ruthless treatment of employees.
examples.translation: 已故的报业大亨因为残忍地对待员工而遭到谴责。

examples.text: The Party has ruthlessly crushed any sign of organised opposition.
examples.translation: 该党派无情地粉碎了任何有组织的反抗的苗头。

examples.text: ...a powerful political figure with a reputation for ruthlessness.
examples.translation: 以冷酷出名的强权政治人物

examples.text: Her lawyers have been ruthless in thrashing out a divorce settlement...
examples.translation: 她的律师在讨论离婚协议的过程中表现得非常坚决。

examples.text: Successfully merging two banks requires a fast and ruthless attack on costs.
examples.translation: 成功合并两家银行需要坚决快速地着手解决费用问题。

examples.text: ...a ruthlessly efficient woman.
examples.translation: 雷厉风行的女人

examples.text: ...a woman with a brain and business acumen and a certain healthy ruthlessness.
examples.translation: 有智慧和商业才干、而且非常果断的女人

meanings.meaning: 使冲；突袭；匆忙地做；飞跃

examples.text: A schoolgirl rushed into a burning flat to save a man's life...
examples.translation: 一位女学生冲进起火的公寓里去救一名男子。

examples.text: Someone inside the building rushed out...
examples.translation: 大楼里有个人冲了出来。

examples.text: I've got to rush. Got a meeting in a few minutes...
examples.translation: 我得赶紧走了。几分钟后要开个会。

examples.text: Shop staff rushed to get help.
examples.translation: 商店的员工冲出去求助。

examples.text: Russian banks rushed to buy as many dollars as they could...
examples.translation: 俄罗斯各家银行争相抢购美元。

examples.text: Before you rush to book a table, bear in mind that lunch for two would cost £150.
examples.translation: 在你抢着订桌之前，记住两个人在那里吃一顿午饭得花150英镑。

examples.text: The men left in a rush...
examples.translation: 男人们匆匆离开了。

examples.text: It was all rather a rush...
examples.translation: 这太仓促了。

examples.text: Then there was the mad rush not to be late for school.
examples.translation: 然后就是匆忙往学校赶，以免迟到。

examples.text: Record stores are expecting a huge rush for the single.
examples.translation: 唱片店正期待着人们会争相抢购这张单曲唱片。

examples.text: ...the rush for contracts.
examples.translation: 争先恐后签约

examples.text: The shop's opening coincided with the Christmas rush...
examples.translation: 这家商店的开张正好赶上了圣诞的抢购热潮。

examples.text: Apply before the rush starts.
examples.translation: 赶在高峰期开始前申请。

examples.text: ...the annual rush to the beaches.
examples.translation: 每年去海边度假的热潮

examples.text: You can't rush a search...
examples.translation: 搜寻时不能仓促行事。

examples.text: Chew your food well and do not rush meals...
examples.translation: 充分咀嚼食物，吃饭不要太快。

examples.text: Instead of rushing at life, I wanted something more meaningful.
examples.translation: 我不想混日子，我想做点更有意义的事情。

examples.text: The report had all the hallmarks of a rushed job.
examples.translation: 这篇报告到处都是仓促了事的痕迹。

examples.text: We got an ambulance and rushed her to hospital...
examples.translation: 我们叫了一辆救护车，赶紧把她送到了医院。

examples.text: Federal agents rushed him into a car...
examples.translation: 联邦探员赶紧把他送进了一辆车里。

examples.text: We'll rush it round today if possible.
examples.translation: 如果可能的话，我们今天会赶紧把它送过去。

examples.text: He will not rush into any decisions...
examples.translation: 他不会草率作出任何决定的。

examples.text: They had rushed in without adequate appreciation of the task...
examples.translation: 他们还没有充分了解这项任务就仓促行动了。

examples.text: Ministers won't be rushed into a response...
examples.translation: 部长们不会急于回应的。

examples.text: Don't rush him or he'll become confused.
examples.translation: 不要催他，不然他会犯糊涂的。

examples.text: At no time did I feel rushed or under pressure.
examples.translation: 我任何时候都不会觉得仓促或者有压力。

examples.text: They rushed the entrance and forced their way in...
examples.translation: 他们猛冲到入口，强行闯入。

examples.text: Tom came rushing at him from another direction.
examples.translation: 汤姆从另一个方向突袭了他。

examples.text: Water rushes out of huge tunnels...
examples.translation: 水从巨大的隧道中奔涌而出。

examples.text: The air was rushing past us all the time.
examples.translation: 气流一直从我们身边呼啸而过。

examples.text: ...the sound of rushing water.
examples.translation: 水流湍急的声音

examples.text: A rush of air on my face woke me.
examples.translation: 脸上吹过的气流惊醒了我。

examples.text: ...the perpetual rush of the mill stream.
examples.translation: 水车水流永不停歇的奔涌

examples.text: A rush of pure affection swept over him...
examples.translation: 一阵强烈而纯洁的爱意涌遍他全身。

examples.text: He felt a sudden rush of panic at the thought.
examples.translation: 想到这点，他突然感到一阵强烈的恐慌。

examples.text: We used to be rushed off our feet at lunchtimes.
examples.translation: 以前我们在午饭时间会忙得不可开交。

meanings.meaning: (Sack)人名；(英、法、葡、瑞典)萨克；(德)扎克

examples.text: ...a sack of potatoes.
examples.translation: 一袋土豆

examples.text: Earlier today the Prime Minister sacked 18 government officials for corruption...
examples.translation: 今天早些时候，首相解除了 18 名涉嫌贪污腐败的政府官员的职务。

examples.text: Science teacher James Wood was sacked for slapping a schoolboy.
examples.translation: 理科教师詹姆斯·伍德因为掌掴一名男生而被开除。

examples.text: People who make mistakes can be given the sack the same day.
examples.translation: 一犯错误可能当天就会被开除。

examples.text: In 1527 Imperial troops sacked the French ambassador's residence in Rome.
examples.translation: 1527年，帝国军队洗劫了位于罗马的法国大使官邸。

examples.text: The Odyssey tells what happened to the Greek heroes after the sack of Troy.
examples.translation: 《奥德赛》讲述的是在特洛伊被洗劫一空之后发生在希腊英雄们身上的故事。

meanings.meaning: 神的；神圣的；宗教的；庄严的

examples.text: The owl is sacred for many Californian Indian people.
examples.translation: 对于很多加利福尼亚的印第安人而言，猫头鹰是圣物。

examples.text: ...shrines and sacred places.
examples.translation: 神龛和圣地

examples.text: ...the sacredness of the site.
examples.translation: 该地的神圣性

examples.text: ...sacred art.
examples.translation: 宗教艺术

examples.text: ...sacred songs or music.
examples.translation: 宗教歌曲或音乐

examples.text: My memories are sacred...
examples.translation: 我的记忆不容亵渎。

examples.text: He said the unity of the country was sacred.
examples.translation: 他说国家的统一神圣不可侵犯。

examples.text: ...the sacredness of his given word.
examples.translation: 他的郑重承诺

examples.text: She sacrificed family life to her career...
examples.translation: 她为事业舍弃了家庭。

examples.text: Her husband's pride was a small thing to sacrifice for their children's security...
examples.translation: 为了孩子们的安全，舍弃她丈夫的尊严不算什么。

examples.text: Kitty Aldridge has sacrificed all for her first film...
examples.translation: 姬蒂·奥尔德里奇为自己的首部影片牺牲了一切。

examples.text: He sacrificed himself and so saved his country.
examples.translation: 他牺牲自己，以此拯救了他的祖国。

examples.text: She made many sacrifices to get Anita a good education...
examples.translation: 为了让安妮塔接受良好的教育，她作出了很多牺牲。

examples.text: He was willing to make any sacrifice for peace.
examples.translation: 他愿意为和平作出任何牺牲。

examples.text: The priest sacrificed a chicken...
examples.translation: 祭司用一只鸡作祭品。

examples.text: Two white bulls were sacrificed and a feast was held.
examples.translation: 献祭了两头白牛，并举行了盛宴。

examples.text: ...animal sacrifices to the gods.
examples.translation: 祭神的牺牲

meanings.meaning: 难过的；悲哀的，令人悲痛的；凄惨的，阴郁的（形容颜色）

examples.text: It's a sad occasion but it's a great tribute to him and his family, said Larsson.
Why don't we saddle a couple of horses and go for a ride?
examples.translation: 我们何不找几匹马套上马鞍出去遛遛？

examples.text: I want to be gone from here as soon as we can saddle up...
examples.translation: 我想我们一上好马鞍就离开这里。

examples.text: She saddled up a horse.
examples.translation: 她给一匹马套上了马鞍。

examples.text: The war devastated the economy and saddled the country with a huge foreign debt.
examples.translation: 战争拖垮了经济，使该国欠下了巨额外债。

examples.text: When I watch horse racing on television, I wish I was back in the saddle.
examples.translation: 看到电视上的赛马节目时，我真希望自己能再度跨马奔驰。

examples.text: The armed forces and the hardliners are now going to be in the saddle.
examples.translation: 武装部队和奉行强硬路线的人即将掌权。

meanings.meaning: [安全] 保护；保卫；保护措施

examples.text: They will press for international action to safeguard the ozone layer...
examples.translation: 他们将督促国际社会采取行动保护臭氧层。

examples.text: The interests of minorities will have to be safeguarded under a new constitution...
examples.translation: 新宪法必须能保护少数群体的利益。

examples.text: They are taking precautionary measures to safeguard their forces from the effects of chemical weapons.
examples.translation: 他们正采取预防措施保护其军队免受化学武器的伤害。

examples.text: Many people took second jobs as a safeguard against unemployment...
examples.translation: 许多人为防失业都干两份工作。

examples.text: A system like ours lacks adequate safeguards for civil liberties.
examples.translation: 我们这样的制度缺乏有效保护公民自由的条款。

meanings.meaning: 安全；保险；安全设备；保险装置；安打

examples.text: The report goes on to make a number of recommendations to improve safety on aircraft.
examples.translation: 该报告接着给出了一系列改善飞机安全性能的建议。

examples.text: He stumbled through smoke and fumes given off from her burning sofa to pull her to safety...
examples.translation: 她的沙发着火了，他冒着浓烟跌跌撞撞地把她拉到安全的地方。

examples.text: Guests ran for safety as the device went off in a ground-floor men's toilet...
examples.translation: 一层男厕所里的炸弹爆炸后，客人们纷纷逃命而去。

examples.text: The refugees were groping their way through the dark, trying to reach safety.
examples.translation: 难民摸黑前进，试图转移到安全的地方。

examples.text: ...the safety of one's own home.
examples.translation: 自己安全的家中

examples.text: ...consumers are showing growing concern about the safety of the food they buy...
examples.translation: 消费者越来越关注所购食品的安全性。

examples.text: The safety of tacrine has not yet been proven, and there is concern that it causes damage to the liver.
examples.translation: 他克林的安全性尚未得到证实，有人担心它会对肝脏造成损害。

examples.text: There is grave concern for the safety of witnesses...
examples.translation: 人们非常担心证人的安全。

examples.text: The two youths today declined to testify because they said they feared for their safety.
examples.translation: 这两个年轻人今天拒绝作证，称他们是出于对自身安全的担心。

examples.text: The built-in safety device compensates for a fall in water pressure.
examples.translation: 该内置式安全装置在水压下降时能提供保护。

examples.text: ...safety glasses.
examples.translation: 护目镜

examples.text: Many people still feel there is safety in numbers when belonging to a union.
examples.translation: 许多人仍然感到加入工会后会有强大的后盾。

meanings.meaning: 奔跑；赛跑；趋向；奔跑的路程

examples.text: I excused myself and ran back to the telephone...
examples.translation: 我说了声抱歉，跑回到电话机旁。

examples.text: Police believe the gunmen ran off into the woods...
examples.translation: 警方认为持枪的歹徒逃到树林里去了。

examples.text: Neighbouring shopkeepers ran after the man and caught him...
examples.translation: 附近的店主在那个男人后面追赶并把他抓住了。

examples.text: He ran the last block to the White House with two cases of gear...
examples.translation: 他带着两箱工具跑过最后一个街区到达白宫。

examples.text: Antonia ran to meet them.
examples.translation: 安东尼娅跑去迎接他们。

examples.text: After a six-mile run, Jackie returns home for a substantial breakfast.
examples.translation: 跑了6英里之后，杰姬回家吃了一顿丰盛的早餐。

examples.text: ...when I was running in the New York Marathon...
examples.translation: 当我参加纽约的马拉松比赛时

examples.text: Phyllis Smith ran a controlled race to qualify in 51.32 sec.
examples.translation: 菲莉丝·史密斯控制好速度，用51.32秒跑完了比赛，获得了参赛资格。

examples.text: The owner insisted on Cool Ground running in the Gold Cup...
examples.translation: 主人坚持要让“酷地”参加金杯赛马会。

examples.text: If we have a wet spell, Cecil could also run Armiger in the Derby.
examples.translation: 如果我们遇上持续下雨，塞西尔也能让“扈从”参加德比马赛。

examples.text: ...the sun-dappled trail which ran through the beech woods.
examples.translation: 穿过山毛榉林的阳光斑驳的小路

examples.text: ...a gas-filled glass tube with a thin wire running down the centre...
examples.translation: 中部有一根延展的细金属丝的充满气体的玻璃管

examples.text: The hallway ran the length of the villa.
examples.translation: 走廊贯穿了整个别墅。

examples.text: Our host ran a long extension cord out from the house and set up a screen and a projector.
examples.translation: 我们的主人从房里牵出一根延长电线，架起屏幕和投影仪。

examples.text: He laughed and ran his fingers through his hair...
examples.translation: 他笑了，用手指拢了拢他的头发。

examples.text: I ran the brush through my hair and dashed out...
examples.translation: 我用刷子刷了一下头发，冲了出去。

examples.text: Fumbling, he ran her card through the machine.
examples.translation: 他笨手笨脚地用她的卡在机器上刷了一下。

examples.text: It hurt to breathe, and he winced as he ran his hand over his ribs...
examples.translation: 他呼吸起来都很痛苦，当他的手摸过肋骨时痛得抽搐了一下。

examples.text: They have gathered the best statistics they can find and run them through their own computers.
examples.translation: 他们已经尽力搜集了数据，并将它们输入了自己的计算机。

examples.text: It was only last February that he announced he would run for president...
examples.translation: 去年2月，他才宣布自己将参加总统竞选。

examples.text: It is no easy job to run against John Glenn, Ohio's Democratic senator...
examples.translation: 和俄亥俄州的民主党参议员约翰·格伦竞选绝非易事。

examples.text: Women are running in nearly all the contested seats in Los Angeles.
examples.translation: 在洛杉矶，女性参选了几乎所有的竞争席位。

examples.text: He was already preparing his run for the presidency.
examples.translation: 他已经开始为参选总统做准备了。

examples.text: His stepfather ran a prosperous paint business...
examples.translation: 他的继父经营着一家生意红火的涂料公司。

examples.text: Is this any way to run a country?...
examples.translation: 这是治国之道吗？

examples.text: Each teacher will run a different workshop that covers a specific area of the language.
examples.translation: 每位老师都会单独主持一个研讨会，讨论语言的一个特定领域。

examples.text: ...a well-run, profitable organisation.
examples.translation: 管理有方、利润可观的组织

examples.text: Officials in charge of the camps say the system is now running extremely smoothly.
examples.translation: 负责这些营地的官员们说现在这一体系运转得非常顺利。

examples.text: ...the staff who have kept the bank running.
examples.translation: 保证银行正常运营的员工

examples.text: He ran a lot of tests and it turned out I had an infection called mycoplasma...
examples.translation: 他进行了多项检查，最后证明我感染了支原体。

examples.text: You can check your program one command at a time while it's running.
examples.translation: 你可以在程序运行期间，逐条输入命令以对程序进行检查。

examples.text: He pushed the play button again and ran the tape...
examples.translation: 他又按下了播放键播放磁带。

examples.text: The tape had run to the end but recorded nothing.
examples.translation: 磁带已经转到头了，但是什么也没录上。

examples.text: He had failed to realise that the tape recorder was still running...
examples.translation: 他没有意识到录音机还在录。

examples.text: We told him to wait out front with the engine running.
examples.translation: 我们告诉他在外边等着，不要熄火。

examples.text: ...with everybody running their appliances all at the same time.
examples.translation: 所有的人都在同一时间使用电器

examples.text: Black cabs run on diesel...
examples.translation: 黑色的出租车使用柴油。

examples.text: Rows of stalls are given over to restaurants running off gas cylinders.
examples.translation: 数排摊位都让位给了使用煤气罐的饭店。

examples.text: I ran a 1960 Rover 100 from 1977 until 1983.
examples.translation: 我从1977年到1983年一直开着一辆1960年产的罗孚100。

examples.text: A shuttle bus runs frequently between the Inn and the Country Club.
examples.translation: 一辆区间公交车频繁地往返于这家旅馆和那个乡村俱乐部。

examples.text: ...a government which can't make the trains run on time.
examples.translation: 不能让火车准点运行的政府

examples.text: Could you run me up to Baltimore?
examples.translation: 你能开车送我到巴尔的摩吗？

examples.text: I'll run over to Short Mountain and check on Mrs Adams.
examples.translation: 我会开车去肖特山看看亚当斯夫人。

examples.text: A run to Southampton showed the car was capable of a reasonable journey.
examples.translation: 南安普敦之行表明这辆车还是挺能跑的。

examples.text: ...doing the morning school run.
examples.translation: 早上去学校

examples.text: ...after their bombing runs against ground troops.
examples.translation: 在他们针对地面部队一番轰炸之后

examples.text: Tears were running down her cheeks...
examples.translation: 泪水滑过她的脸庞。

examples.text: There were cisterns to catch rainwater as it ran off the castle walls...
examples.translation: 雨水顺着城堡的墙壁流下时会流入蓄水池。

examples.text: Wash the rice in cold water until the water runs clear.
examples.translation: 用凉水冲洗大米，直到水变清为止。

examples.text: She went to the sink and ran water into her empty glass...
examples.translation: 她走到水槽边，把空玻璃杯灌上水。

examples.text: They heard him running the kitchen tap...
examples.translation: 他们听见他打开了厨房里的水龙头。

examples.text: I threw off my clothing quickly and ran a warm bath.
examples.translation: 我很快脱了衣服，放上洗澡的热水。

examples.text: You must have left a tap running in the bathroom...
examples.translation: 你肯定忘了关浴室的龙头了。

examples.text: He came fully awake to hear the bath running.
examples.translation: 他完全清醒了，听见浴缸里的水在流。

examples.text: Timothy was crying, mostly from exhaustion, and his nose was running.
examples.translation: 蒂莫西正在哭泣，主要是因为太累了，而且他还流着鼻涕。

examples.text: After an hour he realised he was completely running with sweat...
examples.translation: 一个小时后，他发现自己已经大汗淋漓了。

examples.text: The window panes were running with condensation.
examples.translation: 凝结的水珠在窗玻璃上流动。

examples.text: The ink had run on the wet paper.
examples.translation: 墨迹在湿纸上浸开了。

examples.text: She felt a surge of excitement run through her...
examples.translation: 她突然觉得浑身激动。

examples.text: All sorts of thoughts were running through my head.
examples.translation: 各种各样的想法在我的脑海里闪过。

examples.text: A buzz of excitement ran through the crowd.
examples.translation: 一时间群情激昂。

examples.text: Another thread running through this series is the role of doctors in the treatment of the mentally ill...
examples.translation: 另一条贯穿这部连续剧的主线是医生在治疗精神病患者中起到的作用。

examples.text: ...the theme running through the book...
examples.translation: 贯穿全书始终的主题

examples.text: There was something of this mood running throughout the Congress's deliberations.
examples.translation: 国会的商讨过程中一直透露出几分这样的情绪。

examples.text: The newspaper ran a series of four editorials entitled 'The Choice of Our Lives.'
examples.translation: 这份报纸刊登了4篇社论连载，题为《我们生活的选择》。

examples.text: ...an editorial that ran this weekend entitled 'Mr. Cuomo Backs Out.'
examples.translation: 本周末刊登的题为《科莫先生退出了》的社论

examples.text: 'Whoa, I'm goin' to Barbay-dos!' ran the jaunty lyrics of a 1970s hit song.
examples.translation: “喔，我要去巴巴多斯!”一首20世纪70年代流行歌曲这样欢快地唱道。

examples.text: Today's RPI figure shows inflation running at 10.9 per cent...
examples.translation: 今天的零售物价指数显示通货膨胀率为10.9％。

examples.text: The deficit is now running at about 300 million dollars a year.
examples.translation: 现在，每年的赤字约达3亿美元。

examples.text: It pleased critics but ran for only three years in the West End...
examples.translation: 它得到了评论家们的好评，但只在伦敦西区上映了3年的时间。

examples.text: The contract was to run from 1992 to 2020...
examples.translation: 这份合同在1992年至2020年间有效。

examples.text: I predict it will run and run.
examples.translation: 我估计这会一直延续下去。

examples.text: Tell her I'll call her back later, I'm running late again...
examples.translation: 告诉她我过会儿会给她回电话，我又要晚了。

examples.text: The steward will be able to tell you whether the event is running to time or is ahead of schedule.
examples.translation: 组织者会告诉你活动是如期举行还是会提前。

examples.text: The little girl is running a fever and she needs help.
examples.translation: 这个小女孩发烧了，需要帮助。

examples.text: The show will transfer to the West End on October 9, after a month's run in Birmingham...
examples.translation: 演出在伯明翰上映一个月后，将于10月9日转到伦敦西区。

examples.text: Meanwhile, Dusty Springfield's new TV series began a run on BBC 1.
examples.translation: 同时，达斯蒂·斯普林菲尔德的电视剧新作开始在BBC1台播放。

examples.text: The England skipper is haunted by a run of low scores...
examples.translation: 英格兰队的队长得了一连串的低分。

examples.text: The Scottish Tories' run of luck is holding.
examples.translation: 苏格兰保守党人一直好运连连。

examples.text: Wayne plans to increase the print run to 1,000...
examples.translation: 韦恩打算将印量增加到1,000册。

examples.text: Their defense markets are too small to sustain economically viable production runs.
examples.translation: 他们的国防市场太小，就经济可行性而言不足以维持生产。

examples.text: At 20 he became the youngest player to score 2,000 runs in a season.
examples.translation: 他20岁时就成为了在一个赛季中获得2,000分的最年轻的选手。

examples.text: He had the run of the house and the pool.
examples.translation: 他可以随意使用这座房子和游泳池。

examples.text: ...a man who was outside the common run of professional athletes at the time.
examples.translation: 当时非同寻常的专业运动员

examples.text: ...trying to accomplish the usual run of maintenance jobs and write a column too.
examples.translation: 努力做好维修工的同时还写一个专栏

examples.text: A run on sterling has killed off hopes of a rate cut...
examples.translation: 对英镑的抢购已经完全扼杀了降低汇率的希望。

examples.text: Loss of confidence could trigger a run on Citibank that would threaten the entire financial system.
examples.translation: 民众信心的丧失可能导致花旗银行出现挤兑，从而威胁到整个金融体系。

examples.text: The decisive goal arrived against the run of play...
examples.translation: 这个决定性的得分逆转了场上的局势。

examples.text: Against the run of the polls, the Socialist Workers' Party won Sunday's general election by an unexpectedly large margin.
examples.translation: 工人社会党逆转乾坤，出乎意料地以较大优势获得了星期天大选的胜利。

examples.text: The Under-21 team has defeated Wales and Scotland this season, and ran England very close...
examples.translation: 在这个赛季中，21岁以下代表队已经打败了威尔士队和苏格兰队，和英格兰队的比分也非常接近。

examples.text: The party won at least one county, and ran a close second in several others.
examples.translation: 该党派至少在一个郡获胜，而在其他几个郡也和第一名相距甚微。

examples.text: Streams had run dry for the first time in memory.
examples.translation: 记忆中，小溪第一次干涸了。

examples.text: Three days into production, the kitty had run dry.
examples.translation: 才投产3天凑集的钱就用光了。

examples.text: The insanity which ran in his family haunted him.
examples.translation: 家族遗传的精神错乱困扰着他。

examples.text: So he traded his sailor's cap for an office job and a steady salary.
Officials arrived to assess whether it is safe to bring emergency food supplies into the city...
examples.translation: 官员们赶来评估向该市调拨紧急救援食品是否安全。

examples.text: Most foods that we eat are safe for birds.
