examples.translation: 我们食用的大多数食物对鸟类都无害。

examples.text: ...a safe and reliable birth control option.
examples.translation: 安全可靠的节育方法

examples.text: ...a programme to make Russian nuclear reactors safer.
examples.translation: 提高俄罗斯核反应堆安全性的方案

examples.text: In the future people can go to a football match knowing that they are safe from hooliganism...
examples.translation: 今后人们去看足球比赛时可以不必担心会受到足球流氓的骚扰。

examples.text: On beaches, keep your camera safe from sand by enveloping it inside a plastic bag...
examples.translation: 在沙滩上时，将相机用塑料袋包裹起来以防止进沙子。

examples.text: Crime Prevention Officers can visit your home and suggest ways to make it safer.
examples.translation: 预防犯罪的官员可以登门拜访并就如何使居所更安全向你提出建议。

examples.text: Where is Sophy? Is she safe?...
examples.translation: 索菲在哪里？她没有受伤吧？

examples.text: A baby boy is safe after rescue workers pulled him from a 12-foot-deep construction hole...
examples.translation: 营救人员将一名男婴从 12 英尺深的建筑工地的深坑里拉出来时，他安然无恙。

examples.text: He kissed me twice and I realized suddenly that I felt warm and safe.
examples.translation: 他吻了我两次，我突然意识到自己觉得很温暖、很安全。

examples.text: All 140 guests were brought out of the building safely by firemen.
examples.translation: 消防队员把 140 名客人全部从大楼里安全营救出来。

examples.text: Many refugees have fled to safer areas...
examples.translation: 许多难民已经逃往了更安全的地方。

examples.text: The elimination of all nuclear weapons would make the world a safer place...
examples.translation: 销毁所有的核武器将会使世界变得更安全。

examples.text: We shall take the treasure away to a safe place.
examples.translation: 我们应该把这些宝物带到一个安全的地方。

examples.text: The banker keeps the money tucked safely under his bed.
examples.translation: 这位银行家为保险起见将钱塞在床下。

examples.text: 'I'm heading back to Ireland again for another weekend.' — 'Have a safe journey.'
examples.translation: “我要再回爱尔兰过一个周末。”——“一路平安。”

examples.text: ...the UN plan to deploy 500 troops to ensure the safe delivery of food and other supplies.
examples.translation: 联合国部署一支 500 人的军队以确保食物和其他补给物资安全运送的计划

examples.text: The space shuttle returned safely today from a 10-day mission...
examples.translation: 航天飞机完成 10 天的飞行任务后于今日安全返回。

examples.text: Once Mrs Armsby was safely home, she called the police again.
examples.translation: 阿姆斯比太太一安全到家便再次给警方打了电话。

examples.text: I shall conceal myself at a safe distance from the battlefield...
examples.translation: 我会躲在一个远离战场的安全地带。

examples.text: He thinks he can find a way to vaccinate the elephants from a safe distance.
examples.translation: 他认为自己能找到一种从安全距离给大象接种疫苗的方法。

examples.text: We as consumers need to feel confident that our jobs are safe before we will spend spare cash...
examples.translation: 我们作为消费者在把闲钱花掉之前，需要确信自己不会失业。

examples.text: Is the National Health Service safe with the Conservative party?...
examples.translation: 保守党能否继续实行国民医疗保健制度？

examples.text: Rovers made the game safe with a spectacular second goal in the 84th minute.
examples.translation: 流浪者队凭借第 84 分钟精彩的第二粒进球锁定了胜局。

examples.text: Electricity shares are still a safe investment...
examples.translation: 电力股仍然是低风险投资。

examples.text: It might not be safe politically for the President to leave the country.
examples.translation: 总统离开国家可能会有政治上的危险。

examples.text: We reveal only as much information as we can safely risk at a given time.
examples.translation: 我们仅能透露在某一时刻被认为是没有风险的信息量。

examples.text: ...frustrated artists who became lawyers at an early age because it seemed a safe option...
examples.translation: 趁年轻改行从事律师这一看似稳定的职业的失意落泊的艺术家们

examples.text: Rock'n'roll has become so commercialised and safe since punk.
examples.translation: 摇滚乐自从朋克乐以后就已经过于商业化而缺乏新意了。

examples.text: I think it is safe to say that very few students expend the effort to do quality work in school...
examples.translation: 我认为可以肯定地说学校里很少有学生肯为学好功课下功夫。

examples.text: The only safe assumption is that the world's financial markets will have to find solutions themselves.
examples.translation: 唯一可以断定的是世界金融市场将不得不自己寻找出路。

examples.text: If I go to a grocer I know and trust, I can safely assume the eggs will be fresh...
examples.translation: 如果去的是一家我了解并信赖的杂货店，我便能确信鸡蛋是新鲜的。

examples.text: I think you can safely say she will not be appearing in another of my films.
examples.translation: 我认为你可以打包票说在我今后的电影里不会再有她出现了。

examples.text: Don't worry, Mr Palin, your secret is safe with me.
examples.translation: 别担心，佩林先生，我会保守你的秘密。

examples.text: The files are now in a safe to which only he has the key.
examples.translation: 文件目前放在一个只有他才能打开的保险柜里。

examples.text: I had a huge responsibility to ensure these packets remained in safe hands...
examples.translation: 我负有确保这些包裹得到妥善保管的重大责任。

examples.text: Don't worry, Uncle Tim, your future is safe in our hands.
examples.translation: 别担心，蒂姆大叔，你将来由我们照顾。

examples.text: The Government insisted that Britain's nuclear power stations are as safe as houses.
examples.translation: 英国政府坚称英国的核电站非常安全。

examples.text: Why did these men fight and die? Supposedly it was to make the world safe for democracy.
examples.translation: 为什么这些人战死了呢？据说，是为了在全世界实现民主。

examples.text: If you want to play safe, cut down on the amount of salt you eat...
examples.translation: 如果想要谨慎点的话，就减少盐的摄入量。

examples.text: The pilot decided that Christchurch was too far away, and played it safe and landed at Wellington.
examples.translation: 飞行员认为克赖斯特彻奇距离太远，为求稳妥，就降落在了惠灵顿。

examples.text: You might still want to go for an X-ray, however, just to be on the safe side.
examples.translation: 不过，为稳妥起见，你可能还想要照一个 X 光。

examples.text: Don't be afraid to have this checked by a doctor — better safe than sorry!
examples.translation: 不要害怕找医生检查一下——宁求稳妥以免后悔！

examples.text: All I'm hoping for is that wherever Trevor is he will come home safe and sound.
examples.translation: 我只希望不管特雷弗在哪里，他都能平平安安回家。

examples.text: The white sails billow with the breezes they catch.
examples.translation: 一张张白帆随着微风舞动。

examples.text: The trawler had sailed from the port of Zeebrugge...
examples.translation: 拖网渔船已经驶离了泽布吕赫港。

examples.text: The Kruzenshtern is expected to sail for Boston this week.
examples.translation: “克鲁森施滕”号预计将于本星期启航前往波士顿。

examples.text: I shall get myself a little boat and sail her around the world...
examples.translation: 我要给自己买一条小船，驾着它环游世界。

examples.text: For nearly two hundred miles she sailed on, her sails hard with ice...
examples.translation: 它在船帆硬邦邦地结满了冰的情况下连续航行了将近 200 英里。

examples.text: She sails beautifully in winds over 60 knots.
examples.translation: 它扬着帆以超过 60 节的船速乘风破浪。

examples.text: ...a windmill, its sails turning in the breeze.
examples.translation: 翼板在微风中转动的风车

examples.text: We got into the lift and sailed to the top floor...
examples.translation: 我们进了电梯，很快到了顶层。

examples.text: The cabs sailed past.
examples.translation: 出租车疾驰而过。

examples.text: He loaded his vessel with another cargo and set sail...
examples.translation: 他给自己的船装上另一批货后便启航了。

examples.text: Christopher Columbus set sail for the New World in the Santa Maria.
examples.translation: 克里斯托弗·哥伦布从圣玛丽亚启航前往新大陆。

examples.text: ...the challenge and fun of going to sea under sail.
examples.translation: 扬帆出海的挑战和乐趣

examples.text: ...a big ship under sail.
examples.translation: 扬帆航行的大船

examples.text: ...a salad of tomato, onion and cucumber.
examples.translation: 西红柿、洋葱和黄瓜拌成的色拉

examples.text: ...potato salad.
examples.translation: 土豆色拉

examples.text: The Grand Hotel did not seem to have changed since her salad days.
examples.translation: 从她年少时候到现在，格兰德酒店似乎一直就没有变过。

meanings.meaning: 目的；利益；理由；日本米酒

examples.text: Let's assume for the sake of argument that we manage to build a satisfactory database...
examples.translation: 为了便于讨论，不妨假定我们成功地建立了一个令人满意的数据库。

examples.text: For the sake of historical accuracy, please permit us to state the true facts...
examples.translation: 为忠于历史，请允许我们阐述真正的事实。

examples.text: For safety's sake, never stand directly behind a horse.
examples.translation: 为安全起见，千万别站在马的正后方。

examples.text: Economic change for its own sake did not appeal to him...
examples.translation: 经济变化本身对他并没有吸引力。

examples.text: I just like car trips for their own sake.
examples.translation: 我只是单纯地喜欢驾车旅行。

examples.text: ...a love of truth and learning for its own sake.
examples.translation: 对真理和学问的纯粹的热爱

examples.text: I trust you to do a good job for Stan's sake...
examples.translation: 我拜托你看在斯坦的份上好好干。

examples.text: Linda knew that for both their sakes she must take drastic action.
examples.translation: 琳达知道，为了他俩，她必须断然行事。

examples.text: For goodness sake, why didn't you ring me?...
examples.translation: 天哪，为什么你不给我打电话？

examples.text: You've got a computer system, for heaven's sake.
examples.translation: 天啊，你已经装了计算机系统。

meanings.meaning: 圣人；圣徒；道德崇高的人

examples.text: Every parish was named after a saint.
examples.translation: 每个教区都以某位圣徒的名字命名。

examples.text: ...Saint John.
examples.translation: 圣约翰

examples.text: My girlfriend is a saint to put up with me.
examples.translation: 能够忍受我，我的女朋友真的很有耐心。

examples.text: ...an insurance salesman.
examples.translation: 保险推销员

examples.text: ...the lawyer was paid a huge salary...
examples.translation: 那个律师薪水很高。

examples.text: The government has decided to increase salaries for all civil servants.
examples.translation: 政府已决定给所有公务员加薪。

meanings.meaning: 销售；出售；拍卖；销售额；廉价出售
(Sale)人名；(意、塞、瑞典)萨莱；(英、萨摩)塞尔；(法)萨尔

examples.text: Efforts were made to limit the sale of alcohol.
examples.translation: 过去曾采取措施限制酒的销售。

examples.text: ...a proposed arms sale to Saudi Arabia...
examples.translation: 拟议对沙特阿拉伯出售武器

examples.text: He had never intended living there after his wife's death and immediately set about trying to make a sale.
examples.translation: 妻子去世后他就不打算住在那里了，因此马上着手要将其卖掉。

examples.text: The newspaper has sales of 1.72 million.
examples.translation: 该报纸有 172 万份的销量。

examples.text: ...the huge Christmas sales of computer games.
examples.translation: 电脑游戏在圣诞期间的巨额销量

examples.text: ...retail sales figures.
examples.translation: 零售额

examples.text: Until 1983 he worked in sales and marketing...
examples.translation: 1983 年之前，他一直在市场营销部工作。

examples.text: She was their Dusseldorf sales manager.
examples.translation: 她是他们驻杜塞尔多夫的销售部经理。

examples.text: ...a pair of jeans bought half-price in a sale...
examples.translation: 打折时半价买的一条牛仔裤

examples.text: Many stores have started their January sales a month early.
examples.translation: 许多商店提前一个月就开始了一月份的特价促销活动。

examples.text: The painting was bought by dealers at the Christie's sale.
examples.translation: 这幅油画在佳士得的拍卖会上被交易商拍走。

examples.text: His former home is for sale at £495,000...
examples.translation: 他的旧居要以 49.5 万英镑的价格出售。

examples.text: There was a Leica camera for sale in the window...
examples.translation: 橱窗里有架莱卡相机待售。

examples.text: The company is not for sale.
examples.translation: 该公司不准备出售。

examples.text: English textbooks and dictionaries are on sale everywhere...
examples.translation: 英语教材和词典到处都有卖的。

examples.text: All tickets go on sale this Friday.
examples.translation: 所有票在本星期五开始销售。

examples.text: He bought a sports jacket on sale at Gowings Men's Store.
examples.translation: 他在高英斯男装店买了一件打折的运动上衣。

examples.text: The castle has been put up for sale.
examples.translation: 该城堡已经对外出售。

meanings.meaning: 咸水的；含盐的，咸味的；盐腌的；猥亵的
用盐腌；给…加盐；将盐撒在道路上使冰或雪融化

examples.text: Season lightly with salt and pepper.
examples.translation: 略微加点盐和胡椒调味。

examples.text: ...a pinch of salt.
examples.translation: 一撮盐

examples.text: Salt the stock to your taste and leave it simmering very gently.
examples.translation: 根据自己的口味给原汤加点盐，然后用文火慢炖。

examples.text: Put a pan of salted water on to boil.
examples.translation: 将一锅盐水放上去煮。

examples.text: ...lightly salted butter.
examples.translation: 加了少许盐的黄油

examples.text: The rock is rich in mineral salts.
examples.translation: 该岩石中富含矿盐。

examples.text: Most of the people there are salt-of-the-earth, good, working-class people.
examples.translation: 那里的大多数人都是吃苦耐劳、心地善良的工人阶级。

examples.text: The more miraculous parts of this account should be taken with a pinch of salt.
examples.translation: 对这篇记述中那些颇具神奇色彩的部分也不应全信。

examples.text: Any coach worth his salt would do exactly as I did.
examples.translation: 任何称职的教练都会采取和我一模一样的行动。

examples.text: I had no intention of rubbing salt into a friend's wounds, so all I said was that I did not give interviews.
examples.translation: 我不想往朋友的伤口上撒盐，所以我只说我没有进行面试。

examples.text: One of the company stepped out and saluted the General...
examples.translation: 人群中走出一人向将军敬礼。

examples.text: I stood to attention and saluted.
examples.translation: 我立正敬礼。

examples.text: The soldier gave the clenched-fist salute...
examples.translation: 士兵行握拳礼。

examples.text: He raised his hand in salute.
examples.translation: 他举手致意。

examples.text: I salute him for the leadership role that he is taking...
examples.translation: 我对他发挥的领导作用表示赞扬。

examples.text: The statement salutes the changes of the past year.
examples.translation: 这一表态称赞了过去一年的变革。

examples.text: ...a special salute to Anne Scargill for her plucky underground protest.
examples.translation: 对安妮·斯卡吉尔勇敢开展地下抗议活动致以特别的敬意

examples.text: The church's message of salvation has changed the lives of many.
examples.translation: 基督教中耶稣拯救灵魂的教义改变了很多人的生活。

examples.text: ...a poor, lost, lonely woman clinging for salvation to a son whom she knew was as lost as she was.
examples.translation: 一个孤独可怜、茫然若失的妇人紧紧抓着她的一个儿子寻求解脱，而她知道儿子也同她一样迷惘

examples.text: ...those whose marriages are beyond salvation.
examples.translation: 婚姻已无法挽救的那些人

examples.text: The country's salvation lies in forcing through democratic reforms...
examples.translation: 拯救国家的希望在于强制推行民主改革。

examples.text: I consider books my salvation.
examples.translation: 我视书本为救星。

meanings.meaning: 相同的；同一的；上述的（通常与the连用）；无变化的
同样的事物或人（通常与the连用）

examples.text: The houses were all the same — square, close to the street, needing paint...
examples.translation: 房子都一模一样——方方正正、临近街道、需要粉刷。

examples.text: In essence, all computers are the same...
examples.translation: 所有的电脑其实都一样。

examples.text: People with the same experience in the job should be paid the same...
examples.translation: 工作经历相同的人应拿同样的工资。

examples.text: Driving a boat is not the same as driving a car...
examples.translation: 驾船和开车不是一回事。

examples.text: I want my son to wear the same clothes as everyone else at the school...
examples.translation: 我想让儿子和学校里其他人穿得一样。

examples.text: Bihar had a population roughly the same as that of England.
examples.translation: 比哈尔邦的人口几乎和英国的一样。

examples.text: I mean, it's a relationship, the same as a marriage is a relationship...
examples.translation: 我的意思是它是一种人际关系，就如同婚姻也是一种人际关系一样。

examples.text: I want to go home having won a game of football the same as you leave the ground and you want to go away with your team having won...
examples.translation: 你希望离开赛场的时候自己的球队取得了胜利，同样我也想赢了一场球赛再回家。

examples.text: He just wanted the war to end, the same as Wally did.
examples.translation: 他只不过希望战争结束，和沃利想的一样。

examples.text: Bernard works at the same institution as Arlette...
examples.translation: 伯纳德和阿莱特在同一家机构工作。

examples.text: It's impossible to get everybody together at the same time...
examples.translation: 让所有人同时聚在一起是不可能的。

examples.text: Members of his staff learn to work the same 13-hour days that he imposes on himself...
examples.translation: 他的员工学着和他一样每天强迫自己工作 13 个钟头。

examples.text: John just told me that your birthday is on the same day as mine.
examples.translation: 约翰刚告诉我你和我的生日是同一天。

examples.text: ...business people who spoke the same language as himself...
examples.translation: 和他操同一种语言的生意人

examples.text: Gary plays football with the other children of the same age.
examples.translation: 加里和其他同龄的孩子们一起踢足球。

examples.text: Taking ingredients from the same source means the beers stay the same...
examples.translation: 取材自同一原材料意味着啤酒的口味始终如一。

examples.text: Only 17% said the economy would improve, but 25% believed it would stay the same.
examples.translation: 仅 17% 的人说经济状况会改善，却有25% 的人认为经济会维持老样子。

examples.text: We made the decision which was right for us. Other parents must do the same...
examples.translation: 我们作出了对于我们而言正确的决定。其他父母也必须这么做。

examples.text: In the United States small specialised bookshops survive quite well. The same applies to small publishers...
examples.translation: 美国的小型专业书店经营状况不错。小型出版社也是如此。

examples.text: We like him very much and he says the same about us.
examples.translation: 我们很喜欢他，他也说很喜欢我们。

examples.text: Dwight Eisenhower possessed much the same ability to appear likeable.
examples.translation: 德怀特·艾森豪威尔也具备上述做出讨人喜欢的样子的能力。

examples.text: Wrist watches: £100. Inscription of same: £15.
examples.translation: 腕表: 100英镑。在其上刻字: 15英镑。

examples.text: 'Nice to meet you,' said Michael. 'Same here,' said Mary Ann...
examples.translation: “很高兴见到你，”迈克尔说。“我也是，”玛丽·安说。

examples.text: 'I hate going into stores.' — 'Same here,' said William.
examples.translation: “我讨厌进商店。”——“我也一样，”威廉说。

examples.text: 'Have a nice Easter.' — 'And the same to you Bridie.'
examples.translation: “复活节快乐。”——“你也一样，布赖迪。”

examples.text: 'Goodbye, then, and thanks. Good luck.' — 'The same to you.'
examples.translation: “那么，再见，谢谢。祝你好运。”——“也祝你好运。”

examples.text: Give Roger another pint, Imogen, and I'll have the same again.
examples.translation: 再给罗杰来一杯，伊莫金，我也再来一份同样的。

examples.text: I arranged to pay him the dollars when he got there, a purely private arrangement. All the same, it was illegal...
examples.translation: 我准备等他到那儿时付给他美元，纯属私人安排。不过同样也是非法的。

examples.text: He was unable to pay attention to the papers on his desk. Just the same, he pulled over the stack of papers and started to examine them...
examples.translation: 他的心不在桌子上的那一摞试卷上，尽管如此，他还是拽过来开始评阅。

examples.text: Matt is weak and dependent, but you love him all the same.
examples.translation: 马特软弱无能且依赖性强，但我们照样爱他。

examples.text: ...jokes that she did not understand but laughed at just the same.
examples.translation: 她虽不明白但照笑不误的笑话

examples.text: Whether I've got a moustache or not it's all the same to me...
examples.translation: 我留不留胡子都无所谓。

examples.text: What's the difference between a white lie and a lie? I mean, it's all the same to me.
examples.translation: 善意的谎言和谎言之间有什么不同？我是说，对于我而言二者完全一样。

examples.text: Luckily, Nancy's father and her attorney were one and the same person...
examples.translation: 幸运的是，南希的父亲就是她的律师。

examples.text: I'm willing to work for the party because its interests and my interests are one and the same.
examples.translation: 我愿意为该党效力，因为它的利益和我的利益完全一致。

examples.text: 'This Sawtry guy, he is John Sawtry?' — 'Yes, sir. The very same.'
examples.translation: “这个叫索特里的小伙子，他是约翰·索特里吗？”——“是的，先生。正是他。”

meanings.meaning: 试样的，样品的；作为例子的

examples.text: You'll receive samples of paint, curtains and upholstery...
examples.translation: 你将收到涂料、窗帘、家具垫衬套的样品。

examples.text: We're giving away 2000 free samples...
examples.translation: 我们正免费发放 2,000 份样品。

examples.text: They asked me to do some sample drawings.
examples.translation: 他们请我画些样品图。

examples.text: They took samples of my blood.
examples.translation: 他们取了我的血样。

examples.text: ...urine samples.
examples.translation: 尿样

examples.text: We based our analysis on a random sample of more than 200 males.
examples.translation: 我们随机抽查了 200 多名男性，并在此基础上进行分析。

examples.text: We sampled a selection of different bottled waters.
examples.translation: 我们品尝了一系列不同品牌的瓶装水。

examples.text: ...the chance to sample a different way of life.
examples.translation: 体验不同生活方式的机会

examples.text: I don't actually mind being sampled as long as people give credit where it's due.
examples.translation: 只要人们在适当处标明出处，我其实并不在乎自己的音乐被人节录。

examples.text: He may now be ready to sanction the use of force...
examples.translation: 他现在可能打算批准使用武力。

examples.text: He seemed to be preparing to sanction an increase in public borrowing.
examples.translation: 他似乎正准备批准增加公共贷款。

examples.text: The king could not enact laws without the sanction of Parliament.
examples.translation: 未经议会批准，国王不能制定法律。

examples.text: In 1935 the League of Nations imposed sanctions against Italy following its invasion of Ethiopia.
examples.translation: 1935 年国际联盟在意大利入侵埃塞俄比亚之后对其实施了制裁。

examples.text: He expressed his opposition to the lifting of sanctions.
examples.translation: 他对解除制裁表示反对。

examples.text: As an ultimate sanction, they can sell their shares.
examples.translation: 作为最高的处罚，他们可以出售他们的股份。

examples.text: ...their failure to sanction Japan for butchering whales in violation of international conservation treaties.
examples.translation: 对日本违反国际保护条约残杀鲸鱼的行为他们未能进行制裁

meanings.meaning: 撒沙于；以沙掩盖；用砂纸等擦平或磨光某物；使撒沙似地布满；给…掺沙子
(Sand)人名；(英、德、意、芬、罗、捷、挪)桑德；(瑞典)桑德；(法)桑

examples.text: They all walked barefoot across the damp sand to the water's edge.
examples.translation: 他们全都光着脚走过潮湿的沙地来到水边。

examples.text: ...grains of sand.
examples.translation: 沙粒

examples.text: ...miles of golden sands.
examples.translation: 绵延数英里的金色沙滩

examples.text: Sand the surface softly and carefully.
examples.translation: 用砂纸仔细而轻柔地打磨表面。

examples.text: I was going to sand down the chairs and repaint them...
examples.translation: 我打算用砂纸把椅子打磨光洁后重新上漆。

examples.text: Simply sand them down with a fine grade of sandpaper.
examples.translation: 只要用细砂纸把它们打磨一下即可。

examples.text: He had been a rock in the shifting sands of her existence.
examples.translation: 他一直是她曲折坎坷的生活中的主心骨。

examples.text: ...his shrewd tactical skills in the shifting sands of Arab politics.
examples.translation: 他在阿拉伯风云变幻的政局中的高明谋略

meanings.meaning: 夹入；挤进；把...做成三明治

examples.text: ...a ham sandwich.
examples.translation: 火腿三明治

examples.text: Sandwich the two halves of the sponge together with cream...
examples.translation: 在两半儿海绵蛋糕中间夹入奶油。

examples.text: When you write, avoid sandwiching the bad news between an irrelevant, indirect, or overly cushioned beginning and end.
examples.translation: 在写文章时，不要把坏消息夹在毫不相关、拐弯抹角或过度铺垫的开头和结尾中间。

meanings.meaning: 健全的；理智的；[临床] 神志正常的
(Sane)人名；(日)实(姓)；(日)实(名)；(芬、塞、冈、几比、塞内)萨内

examples.text: He seemed perfectly sane...
examples.translation: 他似乎神志完全正常。

examples.text: It wasn't the act of a sane person.
examples.translation: 心智健全的人做不出这种事来。

examples.text: No sane person wishes to see conflict or casualties.
examples.translation: 理智的人都不愿意看到冲突或伤亡。

examples.text: ...a sane and safe energy policy.
examples.translation: 安全合理的能源政策

examples.text: She poked fun at people's shortcomings with sarcastic remarks.
examples.translation: 她冷嘲热讽地拿别人的缺点开玩笑。

examples.text: 'What a surprise!' Caroline murmured sarcastically.
examples.translation: “太神奇了!”卡罗琳轻声挖苦道。

meanings.meaning: 卫星；人造卫星；随从；卫星国家

examples.text: The rocket launched two communications satellites...
examples.translation: 火箭发射了两颗通信卫星。

examples.text: The signals are sent by satellite link...
examples.translation: 信号通过人造卫星链路发出。

examples.text: Worldwide coverage beamed by satellite generates huge audiences accompanied by global advertising revenues.
examples.translation: 通过卫星发射的信号覆盖全世界，从而产生了大量的观众并在全球范围内赚取不菲的广告费。

examples.text: They have four satellite channels.
examples.translation: 他们有 4 个卫星频道。

examples.text: ...the satellites of Jupiter.
examples.translation: 木星的卫星

examples.text: Italy became a satellite state of Germany by the end of the 1930s.
examples.translation: 意大利在 20 世纪 30 年代末成了德国的附庸。

examples.text: ...Russia and its former satellites.
examples.translation: 俄国及其曾经的卫星国

meanings.meaning: 讽刺；讽刺文学，讽刺作品

examples.text: The commercial side of the Christmas season is an easy target for satire.
examples.translation: 圣诞季商业化的一面很容易招来讥讽。

examples.text: ...a sharp satire on the American political process.
examples.translation: 一部尖刻讽刺美国政治进程的作品

meanings.meaning: 满意，满足；赔偿；乐事；赎罪

examples.text: She felt a small glow of satisfaction...
examples.translation: 她有了一丝满足感。

examples.text: Both sides expressed satisfaction with the progress so far...
examples.translation: 双方对目前的进展都表示满意。

examples.text: I doubt I'll ever get rich, but I get job satisfaction.
examples.translation: 我觉得我不大可能会腰缠万贯，但我得到了工作上的满足。

examples.text: If you can't get any satisfaction, complain to the park owner.
examples.translation: 如果你得不到任何赔偿，向园区所有者投诉。

examples.text: She never could seem to do anything right or to his satisfaction...
examples.translation: 她似乎从没能做过一件正确或令他满意的事。

examples.text: It is hard to see how the issue can be resolved to everyone's satisfaction.
examples.translation: 很难想象这个问题如何解决才能让每个人都满意。

meanings.meaning: 满意的；符合要求的；赎罪的

examples.text: I never got a satisfactory answer...
examples.translation: 我从未得到令我满意的答复。

examples.text: It seemed a very satisfactory arrangement...
examples.translation: 这似乎是个非常令人满意的安排。

examples.text: Neither solution seemed satisfactory.
examples.translation: 两个解决方案似乎都不合适。

examples.text: Their motives have never been satisfactorily explained.
examples.translation: 他们的动机一直未得到令人满意的解释。

meanings.meaning: 满足；说服，使相信；使满意，使高兴

examples.text: The pace of change has not been quick enough to satisfy everyone...
examples.translation: 变化的速度还不够快，不能让所有人都满意。

examples.text: We just can't find enough good second-hand cars to satisfy demand...
examples.translation: 我们实在找不到足够多的性能良好的二手车，满足不了需求。

examples.text: The scandal stories satisfy people's curiosity for a few hours.
examples.translation: 有关丑闻的报道使人们的好奇心在几个小时内得到满足。

examples.text: He has to satisfy the environmental lobby that real progress will be made to cut emissions...
examples.translation: 他必须令环境游说团体相信在减排方面将取得实质性进展。

examples.text: He wanted to satisfy himself that he had given his best performance.
examples.translation: 他想说服自己他已经发挥到极致了。

examples.text: The procedures should satisfy certain basic requirements.
examples.translation: 这些程序应该符合某些基本要求。

meanings.meaning: 浸透，使湿透；使饱和，使充满
浸透的，饱和的；深颜色的

examples.text: In the last days before the vote, both sides are saturating the airwaves...
examples.translation: 选举前最后几天，竞选双方占用了所有的广播电台和电视台。

examples.text: As the market was saturated with goods and the economy became more balanced, inflation went down.
examples.translation: 随着市场上商品饱和，经济趋于平衡，通货膨胀就减弱了。

examples.text: As the domestic market becomes saturated, firms begin to export the product.
examples.translation: 由于国内市场饱和，各公司开始外销。

examples.text: If the filter has been saturated with motor oil, it should be discarded and replaced.
examples.translation: 过滤器如果已被机油浸透，则应丢弃并换上新的。

examples.text: His work clothes, having become saturated with oil, had to be cleaned.
examples.translation: 他的工作服已经被油浸透，该洗洗了。

examples.text: She had a call from him on Saturday morning at the studio...
examples.translation: 星期六早上她在录音室接到他打来的电话。

examples.text: Every Saturday dad made a beautiful pea and ham soup...
examples.translation: 每个星期六爸爸都做美味的豌豆火腿汤。

examples.text: The overnight train runs every night of the week except Saturdays.
examples.translation: 这趟夜班火车除了周六外每个晚上都运行。

examples.text: ...pasta cooked in a sauce of garlic, tomatoes, and cheese.
examples.translation: 用蒜、西红柿和奶酪作酱汁做成的意大利面

examples.text: ...vanilla ice cream with chocolate sauce.
examples.translation: 浇巧克力汁的香草冰激凌

meanings.meaning: 茶托，浅碟；浅碟形物；眼睛

examples.text: I'm sure if we'd needed a flying saucer someone in Llandwrog would have one, he added.

meanings.meaning: 香肠；腊肠；装香肠的碎肉

examples.text: ...sausages and chips.
examples.translation: 香肠和薯条

meanings.meaning: 野蛮的；残酷的；狂怒的；荒凉的
未开化的；粗鲁的人；残暴成性的人

examples.text: This was a savage attack on a defenceless young girl.
examples.translation: 这是对一个毫无自卫能力的年轻女孩的野蛮袭击。

examples.text: ...the savage wave of violence that swept the country in November 1987.
examples.translation: 1987 年 11 月横扫全国的暴力狂潮

examples.text: ...a savage dog lunging at the end of a chain.
examples.translation: 扯着链子不断猛扑的一只恶狗

examples.text: He was savagely beaten.
examples.translation: 他遭到了一顿毒打。

examples.text: ...their conviction that the area was a frozen desert peopled with uncouth savages.
examples.translation: 他们深信该地区曾是严寒的沙漠并居住着未开化的野人

examples.text: The animal then turned on him and he was savaged to death.
examples.translation: 接着野兽突然袭击了他，最后把他咬死了。

examples.text: The show had already been savaged by critics...
examples.translation: 这场演出已受到评论家们的激烈抨击。

examples.text: Speakers called for clearer direction and savaged the Chancellor.
examples.translation: 发言人纷纷要求进一步明确方向并强烈地抨击了该财政大臣。

meanings.meaning: (Save)人名；(法)萨夫；(意、保、西、罗、塞、瑞典)萨薇 (女名)，萨韦

examples.text: ...a final attempt to save 40,000 jobs in Britain's troubled aero industry...
examples.translation: 为保住陷入困境中的英国航空业的 4 万份工作所作的最后一次努力

examples.text: One man was still missing last night after the Belgian trawler Lucky capsized off the Dutch coast. Three other men were saved...
examples.translation: 昨晚比利时拖网渔船“幸运号”在荷兰海岸附近沉没后，仍有1人失踪，其余 3 人被救起。

examples.text: A new machine no bigger than a 10p piece could help save babies from cot death...
examples.translation: 一种体积不超过 10 便士硬币大小的新机器能防止婴儿猝死。

examples.text: The national health system saved him from becoming a cripple.
examples.translation: 在国民医疗保健系统的救助下，他免于致残。

examples.text: His boxing career was ended after two sight-saving operations.
examples.translation: 他的拳击生涯在两次视力救治手术之后终止了。

examples.text: The majority of people intend to save, but find that by the end of the month there is nothing left...
examples.translation: 大多数人都打算存钱，但月末时就会发现已一文不剩。

examples.text: Tim and Barbara are now saving for a house in the suburbs...
examples.translation: 蒂姆和芭芭拉正在攒钱，准备在郊区买一栋房子。

examples.text: They could not find any way to save money.
examples.translation: 他们没办法存下钱。

examples.text: Julie wanted to put some of her money aside for holidays or save up for something special...
examples.translation: 朱莉打算把她的钱拿出一部分用于度假或者存起来作特殊用途。

examples.text: People often put money aside in order to save up enough to make one major expenditure.
examples.translation: 人们常常为了一笔大的开销而存钱。

examples.text: It saves time in the kitchen to have things you use a lot within reach...
examples.translation: 把厨房里常用的东西放在触手可及的地方能节省做饭时间。

examples.text: More cash will be saved by shutting studios and selling outside-broadcast vehicles...
examples.translation: 通过关闭演播室和出售实况转播车将节省更多资金。

examples.text: I'll try to save him the expense of a flight from Perth...
examples.translation: 我会设法替他省下要从珀斯飞来的机票费用。

examples.text: I got the fishmonger to skin the fish which helped save on the preparation time.
examples.translation: 我让鱼贩把鱼鳞刮了，这样准备烹制时能省点儿事。

examples.text: ...labor-saving devices.
examples.translation: 节省劳力的设备

examples.text: Drain the beans thoroughly and save the stock for soup...
examples.translation: 将豆角彻底控干，并把滤出的豆汁留下做汤。

examples.text: Scraps of material were saved, cut up and pieced together for quilts.
examples.translation: 边角碎料都保留下来，剪好后拼在一起做成被子。

examples.text: The scanner will save risk and pain for patients...
examples.translation: 扫描仪将使病人免遭风险和痛苦。

examples.text: She was hoping that something might save her from having to make a decision...
examples.translation: 她希望有什么能使自己不必作决定。

examples.text: He arranges to collect the payment from the customer, thus saving the client the paperwork.
examples.translation: 他安排直接向顾客收取费用，免去了顾客填写各种文件的麻烦。

examples.text: Try to get into the habit of saving your work regularly...
examples.translation: 要努力养成经常将工作内容存盘的习惯。

examples.text: Import your scanned images from the scanner and save as a JPG file.
examples.translation: 从扫描仪导入扫描后的图像，并保存为 JPG 文件。

examples.text: He saved one shot when the ball hit him on the head.
examples.translation: 球砸中他的脑袋，从而让他化解了一次射门。

examples.text: Spurs could have had several goals but for some brilliant saves from John Hallworth.
examples.translation: 要不是约翰·霍尔沃思几次精彩的扑救，热刺队原本可以射进好几个球。

examples.text: There is almost no water at all in Mochudi save that brought up from bore holes.
examples.translation: 除了从钻孔中抽上来的水外，莫丘迪几乎滴水无存。

examples.text: The parking lot was virtually empty save for a few cars clustered to one side.
examples.translation: 除了集中停在一边的少数几辆车之外，停车场几乎是空无一物。

meanings.meaning: 节约的；挽救的；补偿的；保留的

examples.text: Fill in the form below and you will be making a saving of £6.60 on a one-year subscription.
examples.translation: 填写以下表格，全年订阅即可为您节省 6.60英镑。

examples.text: ...a program of household savings on energy use.
examples.translation: 家庭节能计划

examples.text: Her savings were in the Post Office Savings Bank.
examples.translation: 她的钱存在邮政储蓄银行里。

examples.text: ...a savings account.
examples.translation: 储蓄账户

meanings.meaning: 看见；明白，了解；锯；锯成；锯开
锯；用锯；将某物锯成小块

examples.text: He escaped by sawing through the bars of his cell...
examples.translation: 他锯断牢房的窗栅栏逃走了。

examples.text: Your father is sawing wood.
examples.translation: 你的父亲正在锯木头。

meanings.meaning: 讲；说明；例如；声称；假设；指明
(Say)人名；(土)萨伊；(法、老、柬)赛；(英)塞伊；(匈、罗)绍伊

examples.text: 'I'm sorry,' he said...
examples.translation: “对不起，”他说。

examples.text: She said they were very impressed...
examples.translation: 她说他们被深深打动了。

examples.text: Forty-one people are said to have been seriously hurt...
examples.translation: 据说 41 人身负重伤。

examples.text: I packed and said goodbye to Charlie...
examples.translation: 我收拾好行李然后和查利道别。

examples.text: I hope you didn't say anything about Gretchen...
examples.translation: 我希望你对格蕾琴的事只字未提。

examples.text: You didn't say much when you telephoned...
examples.translation: 你打电话时没说太多。

examples.text: Did he say where he was going?...
examples.translation: 他说了要去哪里吗？

examples.text: It doesn't sound exactly orthodox, if I may say so.
examples.translation: 恕我直言，那听起来不太符合常规。

examples.text: I would just like to say that this is the most hypocritical thing I have ever heard in my life...
examples.translation: 我只想说这是我这辈子听说过的最虚伪的事情。

examples.text: I have to say I didn't even know Fox Lane Police Station existed till about four or five years ago...
examples.translation: 我必须承认直到四五年前我才知道有福克斯巷警察局 。

examples.text: I must say that rather shocked me, too...
examples.translation: 我得说那也让我相当震惊。

examples.text: Dead? Well, I can't say I'm sorry.
examples.translation: 死了？嗯，我不觉得难过。

examples.text: The report says there is widespread and routine torture of political prisoners in the country...
examples.translation: 这份报告称该国一直普遍存在折磨政治犯的现象。

examples.text: Auntie Winnie wrote back saying Mam wasn't well enough to write...
examples.translation: 温妮姨妈回信说妈妈身体尚未康复，无法写信。

examples.text: You can't have one without the other, as the song says...
examples.translation: 就像歌里唱的那样，两者密不可分，不能只取其一。

examples.text: 'Highly inflammable,' it says on the spare canister...
examples.translation: 备用罐上写着“高度易燃”。

examples.text: Jung believed that God speaks to us in dreams. The Bible says so too.
examples.translation: 荣格认为上帝在梦中和我们交谈。圣经上也如是说。

examples.text: Perhaps I'm still dreaming, I said to myself...
examples.translation: 也许我还在做梦，我心里想。

examples.text: 'Keep your temper,' he said to himself.
examples.translation: “别生气，”他暗暗告诉自己。

examples.text: You can get married at sixteen, and yet you haven't got a say in the running of the country...
examples.translation: 你 16 岁时可以结婚，但还无权参与国家政事。

examples.text: The students wanted more say in the government of the university.
examples.translation: 学生们想更多地参与大学的管理。

examples.text: The clock said four minutes past eleven...
examples.translation: 钟显示时间是 11 点 4 分。

examples.text: The map says there's six of them.
examples.translation: 地图上显示共有六处。

examples.text: I think that says a lot about how well Seles is playing...
examples.translation: 我认为那很能说明塞勒斯表现得有多出色。

examples.text: The appearance of the place and the building says something about the importance of the project.
examples.translation: 从周边环境和这幢大楼的外观可以看出这个项目的举足轻重。

examples.text: It says a lot for him that he has raised his game to the level required...
examples.translation: 他将比赛技能提至所要求的水平，这说明他颇有能耐。

examples.text: It says much for Brookner's skill that the book is sad, but never depressing.
examples.translation: 这本书笔调忧伤，却并不令人沮丧，这很能说明布鲁克纳超群的写作技巧。

examples.text: He's usually smartly-dressed, I'll say that for him...
examples.translation: 我能说的是，至少他通常穿着入时。

examples.text: At the very least, he is devastatingly sure of himself, you can say that.
examples.translation: 至少还可以说，他对自己是深信不疑的。

examples.text: Say you could change anything about the world we live in, what would it be?
examples.translation: 假定你能对我们所生活的这个世界作出任意改变，你会改变什么呢？

examples.text: To see the problem here more clearly, let's look at a different biological system, say, an acorn...
examples.translation: 为更清晰地理解此处的问题，我们来看一种不同的生物系统，比如说，橡子。

examples.text: Someone with, say, between 300 and 500 acres could be losing thousands of pounds a year.
examples.translation: 比方说，拥有 300 到 500 英亩地的人，可能每年会损失几千英镑。

examples.text: Say, Leo, how would you like to have dinner one night, just you and me?
examples.translation: 哎，利奥，找个晚上一起吃顿饭如何，就你和我？

examples.text: This is my third visit in a week, which says it all.
examples.translation: 这是我一周内第3次拜访，这说明了一切。

examples.text: 'I'm a writer.' — 'You don't say. What kind of book are you writing?'
examples.translation: “我是作家。”——“不会吧。你写哪方面的书？”

examples.text: There's a lot to be said for being based in the country.
examples.translation: 把总部设在该国有很多优势。

examples.text: He's never got much to say for himself.
examples.translation: 他向来寡言少语。

examples.text: 'Well,' she said eventually, 'what have you to say for yourself?'
examples.translation: “那么”，她最后说，“你有什么好说的？”

examples.text: It goes without saying that if someone has lung problems they should not smoke.
examples.translation: 不用说，有肺病的人不应吸烟。

examples.text: The Football Association have had their say.
examples.translation: 足协已经发表了意见。

examples.text: Say what you like about them, but they did love their Mum.
examples.translation: 随你怎么说，但他们确实爱自己的妈妈。

examples.text: I wouldn't say no to a drink.
examples.translation: 我倒想喝一杯。

examples.text: To those who've never received million dollar royalty cheques, this sounded a little odd, not to say offensive.
examples.translation: 对于那些从没有收到过上百万美元版权费的人来说，这听起来就算不令人反感，至少也让人觉得有点儿怪。

examples.text: Unemployment leads to a sense of uselessness, to say nothing of financial problems.
examples.translation: 失业会让人觉得自己一无是处，更何况还会带来经济问题。

examples.text: ...whereas when you get older you're rather set in your ways, shall I say...
examples.translation: 然而随着年纪渐长，可以说，你的大局已定了。

examples.text: My involvement has not been altogether, shall we say, ethical.
examples.translation: 可以说，我的参与还不是完全合乎道德。

examples.text: ...territories that were occupied in 1967, that is to say, in the West Bank and Gaza.
examples.translation: 1967年被占的领土，也就是约旦河西岸和加沙地带的被占领土

examples.text: 'Must have been a fiddly job.' — 'You can say that again.'
examples.translation: “那一定是件精细活。”——“说得太对了。”

meanings.meaning: 丑闻；流言蜚语；诽谤；公愤

examples.text: ...a financial scandal.
examples.translation: 金融丑闻

examples.text: He loved gossip and scandal...
examples.translation: 他喜欢说三道四，散布谣言。

examples.text: These mothers often abandoned their children because of fear of scandal.
examples.translation: 这些母亲经常会因为害怕流言蜚语而抛弃自己的孩子。

examples.text: It is a scandal that a person can be stopped for no reason by the police.
examples.translation: 警察能无缘无故拦人，这真是令人愤慨的行径。

meanings.meaning: 扫描；浏览；细看；详细调查；标出格律

examples.text: She scanned the advertisement pages of the newspapers...
examples.translation: 她浏览了一下报纸的广告页。

examples.text: I haven't read much into it as yet. I've only just scanned through it.
examples.translation: 我还没有细细研读，只是粗略地翻看了一下。

examples.text: I just had a quick scan through your book again.
examples.translation: 我只是又快速浏览了一遍你的书。

examples.text: The officer scanned the room...
examples.translation: 那名警官仔细检查了房间。

examples.text: She was nervous and kept scanning the crowd for Paul...
examples.translation: 她很紧张，眼睛不停地在人群中搜寻保罗。

examples.text: He raised the binoculars to his eye again, scanning across the scene.
examples.translation: 他再一次把双筒望远镜举到眼前，仔细观察整个现场。

examples.text: Their approach is to scan every checked-in bag with a bomb detector.
examples.translation: 他们的方法是用炸弹探测器对每一个办理了登机手续的箱包进行扫描。

examples.text: ...routine scanning of luggage.
examples.translation: 常规行李扫描

examples.text: The disk has no viruses — I've scanned it already.
examples.translation: 这个盘没有感染病毒——我已经扫描过了。

examples.text: The entire paper contents of all libraries will eventually be scanned into computers...
examples.translation: 所有图书馆的全部纸质内容最终都会被扫描进电脑。

examples.text: Designs can also be scanned in from paper.
examples.translation: 设计图也可以从纸上扫描进电脑。

examples.text: The ship's radar scanned the sea ahead.
examples.translation: 船上的雷达扫描了前方的海域。

examples.text: He was rushed to hospital for a brain scan.
examples.translation: 他被火速送往医院做脑部扫描。

examples.text: ...a breast scan to check for cancer.
examples.translation: 为诊察癌症所做的乳腺扫描检查

examples.text: He had written a few poems. Sid told him they didn't scan.
examples.translation: 他写了几首诗。锡德告诉他那几首诗都不押韵。

examples.text: He had a scar on his forehead.
examples.translation: 他的前额有一道疤。

examples.text: ...facial injuries which have left permanent scars.
examples.translation: 留下了永久性疤痕的面部创伤

examples.text: He was scarred for life during a pub fight...
examples.translation: 在一次酒吧斗殴中，他留下了永久性的伤疤。

examples.text: His scarred face crumpled with pleasure.
examples.translation: 他那张疤脸高兴得皱了起来。

examples.text: The arena was scarred by deep muddy ruts.
examples.translation: 赛场上留下了深深的车辙泥痕。

examples.text: ...scarred wooden table tops.
examples.translation: 有划痕的木桌面

examples.text: The early years of fear and the hostility left a deep scar on the young boy.
examples.translation: 早年的恐惧不安和别人的敌意给这个小男孩留下了深深的创伤。

examples.text: ...emotional scars that come from having been abused.
examples.translation: 因受虐待而造成的精神创伤

examples.text: This is something that's going to scar him forever.
examples.translation: 这将成为他一生的创伤。

examples.text: Food was scarce and expensive...
examples.translation: 食物供不应求，而且价格昂贵。

examples.text: Jobs are becoming increasingly scarce.
examples.translation: 工作机会越来越少。

examples.text: ...the allocation of scarce resources.
examples.translation: 对稀缺资源的分配

examples.text: It probably would be a good idea if you made yourself scarce.
examples.translation: 你最好回避一下。

meanings.meaning: 几乎不，简直不；简直没有

examples.text: He could scarcely breathe...
examples.translation: 他几乎喘不过气来。

examples.text: I scarcely knew him...
examples.translation: 我几乎不认识他。

examples.text: She seemed scarcely aware of him...
examples.translation: 她看上去几乎没有注意到他。

examples.text: He was scarcely more than a boy...
examples.translation: 他简直就是个孩子。

examples.text: Scarcely a week goes by without the news providing fresh examples of police racism...
examples.translation: 几乎每周都有关于警方种族歧视事件的新闻报道。

examples.text: She was scarcely 18 when she made her debut.
examples.translation: 首次出镜时，她刚满 18 岁。

examples.text: It can scarcely be coincidence...
examples.translation: 它不太可能是巧合。

examples.text: Yesterday, however, his views seemed scarcely relevant...
examples.translation: 然而，昨天他的观点似乎毫无关联。

examples.text: It was scarcely in their interest to let too many people know.
examples.translation: 他们并不希望太多人知晓此事。

examples.text: Scarcely had they left before soldiers arrived armed with rifles...
examples.translation: 他们刚离开，扛着步枪的士兵们就到了。

examples.text: Bruce had scarcely shaken our hands when the phone rang.
examples.translation: 布鲁斯刚和我们握了握手，电话就响了。

meanings.meaning: 规模；比例；鳞；刻度；天平；数值范围
测量；攀登；刮鳞；依比例决定

examples.text: However, he underestimates the scale of the problem...
examples.translation: 然而，他低估了问题的严重性。

examples.text: You may feel dwarfed by the sheer scale of the place...
examples.translation: 看到此处气势如此恢宏，你可能会觉得自己很渺小。

examples.text: The breakdown of law and order could result in killing on a massive scale...
examples.translation: 法治一旦崩溃可能导致大肆杀戮。

examples.text: The British aid programme is small in scale.
examples.translation: 英国的援助项目规模不大。

examples.text: ...an earthquake measuring five-point-five on the Richter scale...
examples.translation: 里氏 5.5 级地震

examples.text: The patient rates the therapies on a scale of zero to ten...
examples.translation: 患者按十分制给这些治疗方法打分。

examples.text: The higher up the social scale they are, the more the men have to lose.
examples.translation: 社会地位越高，失去的东西就越多。

examples.text: ...those on the high end of the pay scale...
examples.translation: 工资级别最高的人

examples.text: A Registered Osteopath will be pleased to tell you his scale of fees before you decide on a consultation.
examples.translation: 在病人决定是否就诊之前，注册整骨医师会很乐意告知其收费标准。

examples.text: The map, on a scale of 1:10,000, shows over 5,000 individual paths.
examples.translation: 该地图以 1:10,000 的比例尺显示了 5,000 多条不同道路。

examples.text: Franklin made his mother an intricately detailed scale model of the house.
examples.translation: 富兰克林为他的母亲制作了一个复杂精细的房屋模型。

examples.text: ...the scale of C major.
examples.translation: C 大调音阶

examples.text: ...a pair of kitchen scales.
examples.translation: 一台厨房秤

examples.text: ...bathroom scales...
examples.translation: 浴室体重秤

examples.text: I step on the scales practically every morning.
examples.translation: 我几乎每天早上都称一下体重。

examples.text: In 1981, five members of a climbing party died while scaling Mount Hood.
examples.translation: 1981 年，一支登山队的5名队员在攀登胡德峰时遇难。

examples.text: The men scaled a wall and climbed down scaffolding on the other side.
examples.translation: 那些男人攀上一堵墙然后顺着另一侧的脚手架爬了下去。

examples.text: The tower was surmounted by an enormous statue, utterly out of scale with the building.
examples.translation: 那座塔的顶部矗立着一尊巨型雕像，与整个建筑完全不成比例。

examples.text: ...a miniature garden, with little pagodas and bridges all to scale.
examples.translation: 内有全部按比例建造的小塔和小桥的微缩花园

meanings.meaning: 围巾；嵌接，嵌接处；头巾领巾

examples.text: He reached up to loosen the scarf around his neck.
examples.translation: 他伸手松了松脖子上的围巾。

examples.text: You're scaring me...
examples.translation: 你吓着我了。

examples.text: What scares me most is that I'm going to end up not being married...
examples.translation: 最让我担心的是我会一辈子嫁不出去。

examples.text: The prospect of failure scares me rigid...
examples.translation: 一想到失败我就吓得身体发僵。

examples.text: It scared him to realise how close he had come to losing everything.
examples.translation: 一想到他差点儿就失去了一切，他心里直打哆嗦。

examples.text: Don't you realize what a scare you've given us all?...
examples.translation: 你难道不知道你把我们大家都吓得不轻吗？

examples.text: We got a bit of a scare.
examples.translation: 我们受了点惊吓。

examples.text: ...the doctor at the centre of an Aids scare...
examples.translation: 身处艾滋病恐慌中心的医生

examples.text: Despite the scare there are no plans to withdraw the drug.
examples.translation: 尽管大家忧心忡忡，可是并无撤回药物的计划。

examples.text: Despite many recent bomb scares, no one has yet been hurt.
examples.translation: 尽管最近发生多起炸弹恐慌，目前还没有人员受伤。

examples.text: ...a security scare over a suspect package.
examples.translation: 可疑包裹引起的安全恐慌

meanings.meaning: 使散射；使散开，使分散；使散播，使撒播

examples.text: She tore the rose apart and scattered the petals over the grave...
examples.translation: 她掰开玫瑰花，将花瓣撒在坟墓上。

examples.text: They've been scattering toys everywhere...
examples.translation: 他们总是把玩具扔得到处都是。

examples.text: He began by scattering seed and putting in plants.
examples.translation: 他从播种和栽苗开始。

examples.text: After dinner, everyone scattered...
examples.translation: 用餐后，大家各奔东西。

examples.text: The cavalry scattered them and chased them off the field.
examples.translation: 骑兵驱散了他们并把他们逐出了战场。

examples.text: On the table was a pile of books and a scatter of papers.
examples.translation: 桌子上放着一摞书和零落的几份报纸。

examples.text: ...the island's spectacular scenery...
examples.translation: 岛上壮丽的风景

examples.text: Sometimes they just drive slowly down the lane enjoying the scenery.
examples.translation: 有时他们只是沿着小路慢慢地开车，欣赏两旁的风景。

examples.text: A change of scenery might do you the power of good.
examples.translation: 换个地方或许对你大有裨益。

examples.text: I found the scene in which Percy proposed to Olive tremendously poignant.
examples.translation: 我觉得珀西向奥利芙求婚的一幕太让人心酸了。

examples.text: ...the opening scene of 'A Christmas Carol'.
examples.translation: 《圣诞颂歌》的开篇场景

examples.text: ...love scenes.
examples.translation: 情爱场面

examples.text: ...Act I, scene 1.
examples.translation: 第一幕第一场

examples.text: It's a scene of complete devastation...
examples.translation: 那是一副满目疮痍的景象。

examples.text: Thick black smoke billowed over the scene...
examples.translation: 在这一场景中浓浓的黑烟滚滚升起。

examples.text: You can just picture the scene, can't you?
examples.translation: 你完全能想象出那个画面，对吗？

examples.text: There were emotional scenes as the refugees enjoyed their first breath of freedom...
examples.translation: 当难民们呼吸到第一口自由的空气时，有许多感人至深的场面。

examples.text: Television broadcasters were warned to exercise caution over depicting scenes of violence...
examples.translation: 电视台受到警告，要求对暴力场面的描绘采取谨慎态度。

examples.text: It was a bizarre scene.
examples.translation: 那是怪诞的一幕。

examples.text: The area has been the scene of fierce fighting for three months...
examples.translation: 这一地区 3 个月以来不断发生激战。

examples.text: ...traces left at the scene of a crime...
examples.translation: 犯罪现场留下的痕迹

examples.text: Fire and police crews rushed to the scene, but the couple were already dead...
examples.translation: 消防队员和警察匆匆赶往现场，但这对夫妻已经丧命。

examples.text: Riot vans were on the scene in minutes.
examples.translation: 防暴车几分钟就赶到了现场。

examples.text: Sandman is a cult figure on the local music scene.
examples.translation: 桑德曼是当地音乐界的偶像人物。

examples.text: ...when he first burst onto the national political scene at age 28.
examples.translation: 当他在 28 岁刚刚闯入国家政坛时

examples.text: ...a youth guide to London's club scene.
examples.translation: 针对年轻人的伦敦夜店指南

examples.text: ...James Lynch's country scenes.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯·林奇的乡村风景画

examples.text: I'm sorry I made such a scene.
examples.translation: 对不起，我失态了。

examples.text: But behind the scenes Mr Cain will be working quietly to try to get a deal done.
examples.translation: 但是，凯恩先生将背地里偷偷行动以争取达成交易。

examples.text: ...behind-the-scenes discussions.
examples.translation: 秘密讨论

examples.text: It's an exciting opportunity to learn what goes on behind the scenes.
examples.translation: 可以有机会了解幕后的工作，令人非常兴奋。

examples.text: What you need is a change of scene. Why not go on a cruise?
examples.translation: 你需要换换环境。为什么不乘船去旅行呢？

examples.text: But first to set the scene: I was having a drink with my ex-boyfriend.
examples.translation: 不过首先介绍一下背景：我当时正在和前男友喝饮料。

examples.text: Gillespie's goal set the scene for an exciting second half.
examples.translation: 吉莱斯皮的进球为下半场的精彩比赛铺平了道路。

examples.text: He could react rather jealously when and if another child comes on the scene...
examples.translation: 如果别的孩子也加入其中，他可能会表现得相当嫉妒。

examples.text: Harris disappeared from the scene as suddenly as he had appeared.
examples.translation: 哈里斯突然出现，又突然消失了。

examples.text: Lying on the beach all week isn't my scene.
examples.translation: 我不喜欢整个星期都躺在沙滩上。

meanings.meaning: 气味；嗅觉；痕迹；察觉能力
闻到；发觉；使充满…的气味；循着遗臭追踪
发出…的气味；有…的迹象；嗅着气味追赶

examples.text: Flowers are chosen for their scent as well as their look.
examples.translation: 选花不仅要观其形还要闻其香。

examples.text: Jasmine flowers scent the air...
examples.translation: 空气中弥漫着茉莉花香。

examples.text: Scent your drawers and wardrobe with your favourite aromas.
examples.translation: 用你最喜欢的香味熏香你的抽屉和衣柜。

examples.text: She dabbed herself with scent.
examples.translation: 她在身上擦了一点香水。

examples.text: A police dog picked up the murderer's scent...
examples.translation: 一只警犬嗅出了凶手的气味。

examples.text: Many kinds of insect find their mates by scent.
examples.translation: 许多昆虫通过气味找到交配对象。

examples.text: ...dogs which scent the hidden birds.
examples.translation: 嗅出隐藏鸟群的狗

examples.text: Republicans from Pennsylvania and New York are scenting victory.
examples.translation: 来自宾夕法尼亚州和纽约州的共和党人预感到胜利在望。

meanings.meaning: 安排，计划；编制目录；将……列入计划表

examples.text: He has been forced to adjust his schedule...
examples.translation: 他被迫调整了自己的日程安排。

examples.text: We both have such hectic schedules.
examples.translation: 我们俩日程安排得都很紧。

examples.text: The jet arrived in Johannesburg two minutes ahead of schedule...
examples.translation: 喷气式飞机提前两分钟到达了约翰内斯堡。

examples.text: Everything went according to schedule...
examples.translation: 一切都按计划进行。

examples.text: It will be completed several weeks behind schedule.
examples.translation: 这将比原计划晚几个星期完成。

examples.text: The space shuttle had been scheduled to blast off at 04:38...
examples.translation: 航天飞机已经预定于凌晨 4 点 38 分发射升空。

examples.text: A presidential election was scheduled for last December...
examples.translation: 总统选举原计划在去年 12 月举行。

examples.text: No new talks are scheduled.
examples.translation: 没有安排新的会谈。

examples.text: ...a bus schedule.
examples.translation: 公共汽车时刻表

examples.text: The library attracts thousands of scholars and researchers.
examples.translation: 那个图书馆吸引了成千上万的学者和研究人员。

examples.text: ...an influential Islamic scholar.
examples.translation: 一位有影响力的伊斯兰学者

examples.text: She could be a good scholar if she didn't let her mind wander so much.
examples.translation: 如果她没有如此心不在焉，可能会成为一名好学生。

examples.text: He came to Oxford as a Rhodes scholar and studied law.
examples.translation: 他作为罗兹奖学金的获得者来到牛津学习法律。

examples.text: ...schemes to help combat unemployment.
examples.translation: 有助于减少失业的方案

examples.text: ...a private pension scheme...
examples.translation: 私人养老金计划

examples.text: The company was pouring around $30 million into the scheme.
examples.translation: 该公司要向该计划注资约 3,000 万美元。

examples.text: ...a quick money-making scheme to get us through the summer...
examples.translation: 能够让我们撑过这夏天的快速赚钱之道

examples.text: They would first have to work out some scheme for getting the treasure out...
examples.translation: 他们首先得想个法子把财宝取出来。

examples.text: Tourists can be vulnerable to scams and con schemes of all kinds.
examples.translation: 游客们会很容易陷入各种形形色色的骗局。

examples.text: Everyone's always scheming and plotting...
examples.translation: 人人时刻都在谋划着。

examples.text: The bride's family were scheming to prevent a wedding...
examples.translation: 新娘家人正密谋阻止婚礼。

examples.text: They claimed that their opponents were scheming against them...
examples.translation: 他们声称对手正在算计他们。

examples.text: You're a scheming little devil, aren't you?
examples.translation: 你是个耍阴谋诡计的小魔鬼，对不对？

examples.text: ...their favourite pastimes of scheming and gossiping.
examples.translation: 她们最喜欢在一起交头接耳、说长道短来消磨时光

examples.text: He did not quite know how to place women in his scheme of things.
examples.translation: 他不太清楚在自己的人生安排中应把女人摆在什么位置。

examples.text: We realize that we are infinitely small within the scheme of things.
examples.translation: 我们认识到在大千世界中我们极其渺小。

examples.text: The best discoveries in science are very simple.
examples.translation: 最伟大的科学发现都非常简单。

examples.text: ...science and technology.
examples.translation: 科学技术

examples.text: Physics is the best example of a science which has developed strong, abstract theories.
examples.translation: 物理学是自然科学中发展出了强有力的抽象理论的最好例子。

examples.text: ...the science of microbiology.
examples.translation: 微生物学

examples.text: ...the modern science of psychology.
examples.translation: 现代心理学

examples.text: Scientists have collected more data than expected.
examples.translation: 科学家们已经收集到了比预期更多的数据。

examples.text: Scientific research is widely claimed to be the source of the high standard of living in the US.
examples.translation: 科学研究被普遍认为是美国高生活水准的源泉。

examples.text: ...the use of animals in scientific experiments.
examples.translation: 将动物用于科学实验

examples.text: ...scientific instruments.
examples.translation: 科学仪器

examples.text: ...scientifically advanced countries.
examples.translation: 科学发达的国家

examples.text: It's not a scientific way to test their opinions.
examples.translation: 用这个方法来测试他们的意见不科学。

examples.text: ...the scientific study of capitalist development.
examples.translation: 对资本主义发展细致严谨的研究

examples.text: Efforts are being made to research it scientifically.
examples.translation: 正在努力对其进行科学研究。

examples.text: ...a boy who was in my class at school...
examples.translation: 上学时和我一个班的男孩

examples.text: Even the good students say homework is what they most dislike about school...
examples.translation: 就连好学生都说上学最讨厌的就是要写家庭作业。

examples.text: I took the kids for a picnic in the park after school.
examples.translation: 放学后我带孩子们去公园野餐。

examples.text: ...a school built in the Sixties...
examples.translation: 一所建于 60 年代的学校

examples.text: He favors extending the school day and school year.
examples.translation: 他赞成增加每天的课时并延长学年。

examples.text: ...two boys wearing school uniform.
examples.translation: 两名穿校服的男孩

examples.text: Deirdre, the whole school's going to hate you.
examples.translation: 戴尔德丽，学校里所有人都会恨你的。

examples.text: ...a children's writing competition open to schools or individuals.
examples.translation: 可以以学校或个人名义参加的儿童写作比赛

examples.text: ...a riding school and equestrian centre near Chepstow.
examples.translation: 在切普斯托附近的一所骑术学校兼马术中心

examples.text: ...the Kingsley School of English.
examples.translation: 金斯利英语学校

examples.text: ...a lecturer in the school of veterinary medicine at the University of Pennsylvania...
examples.translation: 宾夕法尼亚大学兽医学系的一名讲师

examples.text: Stella, 21, is at art school training to be a fashion designer.
examples.translation: 斯特拉，21 岁，就读于艺术系，正接受时装设计师的培训。

examples.text: Moving rapidly through school, he graduated Phi Beta Kappa from the University of Kentucky at age 18.
examples.translation: 他连续跳级, 18 岁时就以全美优等生联谊会成员的身份从肯塔基大学毕业。

examples.text: ...the Chicago school of economists...
examples.translation: 芝加哥经济学派

examples.text: O'Keeffe was influenced by various painters and photographers, but she was never a member of any school.
examples.translation: 欧姬芙受多位画家和摄影家的影响，但她从未加入过任何学派。

examples.text: Many mothers schooled their daughters in the myth of female inferiority...
examples.translation: 许多母亲把男尊女卑的错误观念传给了她们的女儿。

examples.text: He is schooled to spot trouble.
examples.translation: 他受过训练，能够迅速发现问题。

examples.text: She's been schooling her kids herself.
examples.translation: 她一直在自己教育孩子。

examples.text: ...a cross-cultural study with Indian children, both schooled and unschooled, and American children.
examples.translation: 对受过教育和未受过教育的印度儿童以及美国儿童的跨文化研究

examples.text: She bought him as a £1,000 colt of six months and schooled him.
examples.translation: 在它还是 6 个月的小马驹时，她用 1,000 英镑将它买下，并训练它。

examples.text: He is one of the old school who still believes in honour in public life.
examples.translation: 他思想传统，在别人面前仍然讲究体面。

examples.text: ...an elderly gentleman of the old school.
examples.translation: 年长的老派绅士

meanings.meaning: 剪开；删除（scissor的第三人称单数）

examples.text: He told me to get some scissors...
examples.translation: 他让我去拿把剪刀。

examples.text: She picked up a pair of scissors from the windowsill.
examples.translation: 她从窗台上拿起一把剪刀。

examples.text: If he finds out, he'll scold me...
examples.translation: 如果他知道了，肯定会责骂我的。

examples.text: Later she scolded her daughter for having talked to her father like that...
examples.translation: 后来她训斥女儿不应该那样对父亲说话。

examples.text: 'You should be at school,' he scolded.
examples.translation: “你不是应该在学校吗，”他责骂道。

meanings.meaning: 范围；余地；视野；眼界；导弹射程

examples.text: He believed in giving his staff scope for initiative...
examples.translation: 他认为应给员工提供发挥主动性的机会。

examples.text: Banks had increased scope to develop new financial products.
examples.translation: 银行已为开发新的金融产品留出了更大余地。

examples.text: Mr Dobson promised to widen the organisation's scope of activity.
examples.translation: 多布森先生许诺拓宽该组织的活动范围。

examples.text: ...the scope of a novel.
examples.translation: 小说所涉及的范围

meanings.meaning: 获得；评价；划线，刻划；把…记下

examples.text: Against which country did Ian Wright score his first international goal?...
examples.translation: 在与哪个国家的比赛中伊恩·赖特打进了他在国际比赛中的首粒进球？

examples.text: England scored 282 in their first innings...
examples.translation: 英格兰队第一局就获得了 282 分。

examples.text: Gascoigne almost scored in the opening minute.
examples.translation: 加斯科因在开场第一分钟就差点儿进球得分。

examples.text: Kelly had scored an average of 147 on three separate IQ tests...
examples.translation: 凯利在 3 项不同的智商测试中平均得分 147。

examples.text: Congress as an institution scores low in public opinion polls.
examples.translation: 作为一个公共机构，国会在公众民意调查中得分很低。

examples.text: The U.S. Open golf tournament was won by Ben Hogan, with a score of 287...
examples.translation: 本·霍根以 287 杆的成绩赢得了美国高尔夫公开赛。

examples.text: Robin Smith made 167, the highest score by an England batsman in this form of cricket...
examples.translation: 罗宾·史密斯得到 167 分，创下了英格兰击球手在这类板球比赛中的最高得分纪录。

examples.text: There was also a strong link between children's low maths scores and parents' numeracy problems.
examples.translation: 孩子数学成绩差也与父母算术不好密切相关。

examples.text: 4-1 was the final score...
examples.translation: 最终比分是 4 比 1。

examples.text: They beat the Giants by a score of 7 to 3...
examples.translation: 他们以 7 比 3 的比分击败了巨人队。

examples.text: Even in Zurich he kept up with the County cricket scores.
examples.translation: 即使身在苏黎世，他也一直关注着郡际板球赛的比分。

examples.text: His abiding passion was ocean racing, at which he scored many successes...
examples.translation: 他一直酷爱海上赛艇，并多次在比赛中获胜。

examples.text: In recent months, the rebels have scored some significant victories...
examples.translation: 最近几个月里，叛乱分子已经取得了一些不小的胜利。

examples.text: Soldiers using a multiple rocket launcher scored a direct hit on the steeple of a church.
examples.translation: 士兵们使用多管火箭筒直接击中一所教堂的尖塔。

examples.text: The dance is accompanied by an original score by Henry Torgue.
examples.translation: 这支舞蹈的配乐是由亨利·托尔格所作的一首原创曲目。

examples.text: ...the composer of classic film scores such as West Side Story.
examples.translation: 为《西区故事》等经典影片配乐的作曲者

examples.text: He recognizes enough notation to be able to follow a score.
examples.translation: 他认得足够多的乐符，看懂乐谱不成问题。

examples.text: Strauss spent much of 1941 scoring his last opera, Capriccio...
examples.translation: 施特劳斯用了 1941 年的大部分时间为自己的最后一部歌剧《随想曲》编写总谱。

examples.text: He has mastered enough of the complexities of arrangement to write and score a piece for a chamber music ensemble.
examples.translation: 他对改编的复杂之处已有了足够的掌握，能够谱写一部室内合奏曲了。

examples.text: Campaigners lit scores of bonfires in ceremonies to mark the anniversary.
examples.translation: 参加运动的人们在各种仪式上点起一垛垛篝火以纪念周年庆典。

examples.text: Two people were killed and scores were injured.
examples.translation: 两人死亡，多人受伤。

examples.text: A score of countries may be producing or planning to obtain chemical weapons...
examples.translation: 大概有20个国家可能正在制造或计划获取化学武器。

examples.text: The company already has around four score titles commissioned and planned for publication...
examples.translation: 那家公司已有约80本书委托好了作者并计划出版。

examples.text: The Bible states that the life of man is three score and ten.
examples.translation: 《圣经》中说人的寿命是70年。

examples.text: Lightly score the surface of the steaks with a knife.
examples.translation: 在牛排表面轻轻打花刀。

examples.text: Me and my mate went to score a kilo of amphetamine down in London.
examples.translation: 我和爱人去伦敦市区搞到了一公斤苯丙胺。

examples.text: The companies brought out new products by the score.
examples.translation: 那些公司生产了大量的新产品。

examples.text: You can keep score of your baby's movements before birth by recording them on a kick chart.
examples.translation: 你可以通过胎动图表记录分娩前胎儿的活动情况。

examples.text: I don't feel sorry for Carl. He knew the score, he knew what he had to do and couldn't do it.
examples.translation: 我不为卡尔感到难过。他了解情况。他知道自己必须做什么但却没能做成。

examples.text: I became pregnant easily. At least I've had no problems on that score...
examples.translation: 我很容易就怀上了孩子。至少在那方面我没有问题。

examples.text: If someone you know has cancer, don't let worry on this score stop you from visiting them.
examples.translation: 如果你认识的人得了癌症，不要因为这方面的担忧就不去探望他们。

examples.text: The Prime Minister was trying to score a political point over his rivals...
examples.translation: 首相正设法在政治上将对手一一驳倒。

examples.text: The politicians might be forced to touch on the real issues rather than scoring points off each other.
examples.translation: 政客们可能会被迫讨论真正的问题而不只是互相抬杠。

examples.text: The groups had historic scores to settle with each other.
examples.translation: 这两个集团之间有几笔旧账要了结。

examples.text: Researchers greeted the proposal with scorn...
examples.translation: 研究员们对这个建议嗤之以鼻。

examples.text: Franklin shared the family's scorn for his wife's new friends...
examples.translation: 富兰克林和家里人一样，也对他夫人的新朋友们不屑一顾。

examples.text: He became the object of ridicule and scorn.
examples.translation: 他成了嘲弄和鄙视的对象。

examples.text: Several leading officers have quite openly scorned the peace talks...
examples.translation: 几位高官相当公开地对和平谈判表示出不屑。

examples.text: People scorn me as a single parent.
examples.translation: 人们因为我一个人带着孩子就看不起我。

examples.text: ...people who scorned traditional methods.
examples.translation: 摈弃传统做法的人

examples.text: It is fashionable these days to pour scorn on those in public life...
examples.translation: 如今人们都看不起那些从事公务工作的人。

examples.text: He used to heap scorn on Dr Vazquez's socialist ideas.
examples.translation: 他以前总是嘲笑巴斯克斯博士的社会主义观点。

meanings.meaning: 搜索，侦察；侦察员；侦察机

examples.text: In 1917, William Frederick Cody, army scout and Indian fighter known as Buffalo Bill, died.

meanings.meaning: 攀登；使混杂，仓促凑成；扰乱
抢夺，争夺；混乱，混乱的一团；爬行，攀登
爬行，攀登；不规则地生长；仓促行动

examples.text: Tourists were scrambling over the rocks looking for the perfect camera angle...
examples.translation: 游客们在正爬上岩石寻找最佳的拍摄角度。

examples.text: He scrambled up a steep bank.
examples.translation: 他攀上了一个陡峭的河堤。

examples.text: Ann threw back the covers and scrambled out of bed...
examples.translation: 安掀开被子，急忙下了床。

examples.text: He scrambled to his feet.
examples.translation: 他赶忙站起身来。

examples.text: More than three million fans are expected to scramble for tickets...
examples.translation: 预计会有超过 300 万的球迷抢购门票。

examples.text: Business is booming and foreigners are scrambling to invest.
examples.translation: 商业繁荣，外国人争相投资。

examples.text: ...the scramble for jobs.
examples.translation: 对工作机会的争夺

examples.text: ...a scramble to get a seat on the early morning flight.
examples.translation: 争订凌晨班机的座位

examples.text: Make the toast and scramble the eggs.
examples.translation: 把面包烤一下并炒些鸡蛋。

examples.text: ...scrambled eggs and bacon.
examples.translation: 炒蛋和熏肉

examples.text: The latest machines scramble the messages so that the conversation cannot easily be intercepted.
examples.translation: 最新的机器对信号作扰频处理，通话就不易被侦听了。

examples.text: A crumpled scrap of paper was found in her handbag...
examples.translation: 在她的手提包里发现了一张皱巴巴的小纸片。

examples.text: ...a fire fueled by scraps of wood...
examples.translation: 用木屑燃起的火

examples.text: They need every scrap of information they can get.
examples.translation: 任何能够得到的信息他们都需要。

examples.text: ...the scraps from the Sunday dinner table.
examples.translation: 星期天晚餐的残羹剩饭

examples.text: President Hussein called on all countries in the Middle East to scrap nuclear or chemical weapons...
examples.translation: 侯赛因总统号召中东所有国家放弃核武器和化学武器。

examples.text: It had been thought that passport controls would be scrapped.
examples.translation: 人们曾认为会放开护照管制。

examples.text: There's always tons of scrap paper in Dad's office.
examples.translation: 爸爸的办公室里总有大量的废纸。

examples.text: Thousands of tanks, artillery pieces and armored vehicles will be cut up for scrap.
examples.translation: 成千上万的坦克、大炮和装甲车将被切割成废金属。

examples.text: Billy Bonds has never been one to avoid a scrap.
examples.translation: 比利·邦兹经常与球员发生拳脚冲突。

examples.text: She went round the car scraping the frost off the windows...
examples.translation: 她把结霜的车窗挨个儿擦干净。

examples.text: Young children were trying to scrape up some of the rice that spilled from the sacks.
examples.translation: 小孩子们正试图铲起从麻袋中散落的米粒儿。

examples.text: The only sound is that of knives and forks scraping against china...
examples.translation: 只听见刀叉摩擦瓷器的刺耳声。

examples.text: The cab driver struggled with her luggage, scraping a bag against the door as they came in...
examples.translation: 出租车司机费力地拿着她的行李，进门时把一个包剐破了。

examples.text: The car hurtled past us, scraping the wall and screeching to a halt...
examples.translation: 汽车从我们身边疾驰而过，蹭到墙壁上然后戛然刹住。

examples.text: There was a scraping sound as she dragged the heels of her shoes along the pavement.
examples.translation: 她拖着脚走，鞋跟蹭着人行道嚓嚓作响。

examples.text: From the other side of the door came the scrape of a guard's boot.
examples.translation: 从门的另一侧传来了保安嚓嚓的马靴声。

examples.text: The house was silent but for the scraping of a branch on the slates.
examples.translation: 这所房子寂静无声，只听见树枝刮擦着石板瓦吱吱作响。

examples.text: She stumbled and fell, scraping her palms and knees.
examples.translation: 她绊了一下摔倒了，手掌和膝盖都蹭破了。

examples.text: We got into terrible scrapes.
examples.translation: 我们走投无路。

examples.text: He got a scholarship to the Pratt Institute of Art.
examples.translation: 他获得了普拉特艺术学院的奖学金。

examples.text: ...scholarships for women over 30.
examples.translation: 为 30 岁以上女性设立的奖学金

examples.text: I want to take advantage of your lifetime of scholarship.
examples.translation: 我希望能够用到您一生的学识。

meanings.meaning: 尖叫；呼啸；发出尖锐刺耳的声音；令人触目惊心
尖声喊叫；大叫大嚷着要求
尖叫声；尖锐刺耳的声音；极其滑稽可笑的人

examples.text: Women were screaming; some of the houses nearest the bridge were on fire...
examples.translation: 女人们在尖叫;离桥最近的几所房屋起火了。

examples.text: If I hear one more joke about my hair, I shall scream...
examples.translation: 如果我再听到有人拿我的头发开玩笑，我就会尖叫。

examples.text: He staggered around the playground, screaming in agony...
examples.translation: 他绕着运动场跌跌撞撞地走着，并且痛苦地大叫。

examples.text: To play in front of 40,000 screaming fans was a great experience.
examples.translation: 在4万名尖叫的球迷面前打比赛是一次非常棒的经历。

examples.text: Hilda let out a scream.
examples.translation: 希尔达发出一声尖叫。

examples.text: ...screams of terror.
examples.translation: 恐惧的尖叫

examples.text: 'Brigid!' she screamed. 'Get up!'...
examples.translation: “布里吉德！”她尖叫道，“起来！”

examples.text: I was screaming at them to get out of my house...
examples.translation: 我尖叫着让他们离开我的家。

examples.text: They started screaming abuse at us.
examples.translation: 他们开始对我们破口大骂。

examples.text: She slammed the car into gear, the tyres screaming as her foot jammed against the accelerator...
examples.translation: 她用力关上车门发动汽车，脚猛踩油门时轮胎发出刺耳的声音。

examples.text: As he talked, an airforce jet screamed over the town.
examples.translation: 他谈话时，一架军用喷气式飞机在镇子上空呼啸而过。

examples.text: There was a scream of brakes from the carriageway outside.
examples.translation: 外面车行道上传来刺耳的刹车声。

meanings.meaning: 打草稿用的；凑合的；碰巧的
抓；搔；发刮擦声；勉强糊口；退出比赛

examples.text: He scratched himself under his arm...
examples.translation: 他在胳膊下面挠了挠。

examples.text: The old man lifted his cardigan to scratch his side...
examples.translation: 老人撩起开襟毛衣挠了挠身体的一侧。

examples.text: I had to wear long sleeves to stop myself scratching.
examples.translation: 我只好穿上长袖衣服以免自己挠痒。

examples.text: The branches tore at my jacket and scratched my hands and face...
examples.translation: 树枝刮破了我的夹克，划伤了我的手和脸。

examples.text: Knives will scratch the worktop.
examples.translation: 小刀会在工作台上留下划痕。

examples.text: The seven-year-old was found crying with scratches on his face and neck...
examples.translation: 那名 7 岁男孩被发现时正在哭泣，脸部和颈部都有划伤。

examples.text: I pointed to a number of scratches in the tile floor.
examples.translation: 我指向地板砖上的一道道划痕。

examples.text: Building a home from scratch can be both exciting and challenging...
examples.translation: 建立一个全新的家庭既让人兴奋又富于挑战。

examples.text: Hong Kong's manufacturing industry did not start from scratch in the post-war period.
examples.translation: 战后，香港制造业的兴起并非从零开始。

examples.text: The Institute spends a lot of time scratching its head about how to boost American productivity.
examples.translation: 该协会花费大量时间苦苦思索如何提高美国的生产力。

examples.text: Officials say they've only scratched the surface of the drug problem...
examples.translation: 官员们说他们只是触及了毒品问题的表面。

examples.text: We had only two weeks to tour Malaysia, which was hardly enough time to scratch the surface.
examples.translation: 我们只有两周的时间游览马来西亚，连走马观花都来不及。

examples.text: My mother always made me feel I wasn't coming up to scratch.
examples.translation: 母亲总是使我觉得自己不够优秀。

meanings.meaning: 脚本；手迹；书写用的字母

examples.text: Jenny's writing a film script.
examples.translation: 珍妮在写一个电影剧本。

examples.text: ...James Cameron, who scripted and directed both films.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯·卡梅伦，这两部电影的编剧兼导演

examples.text: ...a text in the Malay language but written in Arabic script.
examples.translation: 一篇使用阿拉伯字母书写的马来语演讲稿

examples.text: Losing was not in the script...
examples.translation: 没想到会输掉比赛。

examples.text: The game plan was right. We just didn't follow the script.
examples.translation: 比赛战术是正确的。只是我们没有照部署去打。

meanings.meaning: 详细审查；监视；细看；选票复查

examples.text: His private life came under media scrutiny...
examples.translation: 他的私生活受到媒体的密切关注。

examples.text: The President promised a government open to public scrutiny.
examples.translation: 总统承诺政府将接受公众监督。

examples.text: Each bracket is fixed to the wall with just three screws.
examples.translation: 每个托架只用了 3 颗螺钉固定在墙上。

examples.text: I had screwed the shelf on the wall myself...
examples.translation: 我自己用螺钉把架子固定在墙上。

examples.text: Screw down any loose floorboards...
examples.translation: 用螺钉固定住所有松动的地板。

examples.text: I particularly like the type of shelving that screws to the wall.
examples.translation: 我尤其喜欢那种用螺钉固定在墙上的搁板。

examples.text: ...an ordinary jam jar with a screw lid.
examples.translation: 带螺旋盖的普通果酱罐

examples.text: Kelly screwed the silencer onto the pistol...
examples.translation: 凯利把消音器拧到手枪上。

examples.text: Screw down the lid fairly tightly...
examples.translation: 把盖子拧紧。

examples.text: This device screws into the shutter release button.
examples.translation: 这个装置能旋进快门释放按钮。

examples.text: ...several aluminium poles that screw together to give a maximum length of 10 yards.
examples.translation: 几根旋接在一起、最长为 10 码的铝杆

examples.text: He screwed the paper into a ball and tossed it into the fire.
examples.translation: 他把纸揉成一团抛进火里。

examples.text: He screwed his face into an expression of mock pain.
examples.translation: 他面部扭曲，假装疼痛。

examples.text: They haven't given us accurate information. We've been screwed...
examples.translation: 他们没有提供准确的消息。我们被骗了。

examples.text: The consumer is getting screwed by cover charges as well.
examples.translation: 这名消费者也被诈取了服务费。

examples.text: For decades rich nations have been screwing money out of poor nations.
examples.translation: 富国压榨穷国长达数十载。

examples.text: Parisian taxi drivers are threatening to mount a blockade to turn the screw on the government.
examples.translation: 巴黎出租车司机们正威胁阻塞交通以对政府进一步施压。

examples.text: Every rebel raid is another turn of the screw, increasing the pressure on the President.
examples.translation: 每次叛乱分子发动袭击就是又往前逼进了一步，使得总统的压力越来越大。

examples.text: Many viewers have strong opinions about violence on the screen...
examples.translation: 许多观众对银幕暴力心存反感。

examples.text: She was the ideal American teenager, both on and off screen.
examples.translation: 无论是在荧幕上还是在生活中，她都是人们心目中完美的美国青少年。

examples.text: The series is likely to be screened in January...
examples.translation: 这个系列剧可能在 1 月份播放。

examples.text: TV firms were later banned from screening any pictures of the demo.
examples.translation: 后来各电视台被禁止播放任何有关这次游行的画面。

examples.text: The film-makers will be present at the screenings to introduce their works.
examples.translation: 制作人将出席电影放映礼介绍他们的作品。

examples.text: They put a screen in front of me so I couldn't see what was going on.
examples.translation: 他们在我面前竖了一面屏风，所以我看不到发生了什么事情。

examples.text: Most of the road behind the hotel was screened by a block of flats.
examples.translation: 宾馆后面的那条路大部分被一片公寓楼遮住了。

examples.text: ...a quick saliva test that would screen for people at risk of tooth decay.
examples.translation: 能快速核查是否长蛀牙的唾液检验

examples.text: Britain has an enviable record on breast screening for cancer.
examples.translation: 英国妇女的乳腺癌患病率很低，着实令人羡慕。

examples.text: They will screen all their candidates.
examples.translation: 他们会对所有求职者进行筛选。

examples.text: ...screening procedures for the regiment.
examples.translation: 参军的筛选程序

examples.text: The airline had been screening baggage on X-ray machines.
examples.translation: 该航空公司已采用X光机对行李进行安全检查。

examples.text: I employ a secretary to screen my calls.
examples.translation: 我雇用了一名秘书转接打给我的电话。

examples.text: ...stone sculptures of figures and animals.
examples.translation: 人像和动物的石雕

examples.text: ...a collection of 20th-century art and sculpture.
examples.translation: 一批 20 世纪的艺术品与雕塑品

examples.text: Both studied sculpture.
examples.translation: 两人都学习雕刻。

examples.text: Most of the kids have never seen the sea...
examples.translation: 多数孩子从未见过海。

examples.text: All transport operations, whether by sea, rail or road, are closely monitored at all times.
examples.translation: 所有的交通活动，无论是通过海路、铁路还是公路，都时刻受到密切监视。

examples.text: He drowned after 30 minutes in the rough seas...
examples.translation: 他在汹涌的海浪中挣扎了 30 分钟后淹死了。

examples.text: The seas are warm further south.
examples.translation: 海水的温度越往南越高。

examples.text: ...the North Sea.
examples.translation: 北海

examples.text: ...the huge inland sea of Turkana.
examples.translation: 图尔卡纳浩瀚的内陆海

examples.text: Down below them was the sea of upturned faces...
examples.translation: 他们下面是无数张仰望的脸。

examples.text: His eyes ran over the sea of bottles and glasses on the table.
examples.translation: 他扫了一眼满桌的瓶子和玻璃杯。

examples.text: If you had never seen a telly ad, you would be all at sea with popular culture.
examples.translation: 如果你从没看过电视广告，你就搞不懂什么是大众文化。

examples.text: The boats remain at sea for an average of ten days at a time...
examples.translation: 这些船只每次在海上平均航行 10 天。

examples.text: His body was found at sea in waters off the Canary Islands.
examples.translation: 他的尸体在离加那利群岛不远的海上被发现。

examples.text: ...fishermen who go to sea for two weeks at a time...
examples.translation: 每次出海两周的渔夫们

examples.text: He pointed out to sea.
examples.translation: 他指向大海。

examples.text: The average UK coal seam is one metre thick.
examples.translation: 英国煤层的平均厚度为 1 米。

examples.text: Britain's university system is in danger of falling apart at the seams.
examples.translation: 英国的大学体系面临分崩离析的危险。

examples.text: The hotels of Warsaw, Prague and Budapest were bursting at the seams.
examples.translation: 华沙、布拉格和布达佩斯的旅馆均是人满为患。

examples.text: I went to spend a few days at the seaside...
examples.translation: 我去海滨玩了几天。

examples.text: The town was Redcar, a seaside resort on the Cleveland coast.
examples.translation: 那个城镇叫雷德卡，是克利夫兰海岸上的一个海滨胜地。

meanings.meaning: 密封；印章；海豹；封条；标志

examples.text: He sealed the envelope and put on a stamp...
examples.translation: 他封住信封并贴上一张邮票。

examples.text: Write your letter and seal it in a blank envelope...
examples.translation: 信写好后把它装进空白信封里封好。

examples.text: A courier was despatched with two sealed envelopes.
examples.translation: 信使受命递送两封封讫的信。

examples.text: She merely filled the containers, sealed them with a cork, and pasted on labels...
examples.translation: 她只是装满容器，用软木塞封住，然后贴上标签。

examples.text: A woman picks them up and seals them in plastic bags.
examples.translation: 一个女人把它们捡起来放入几只密封的塑料袋中。

examples.text: ...a lid to seal in heat and keep food moist.
examples.translation: 用于保温并防止食物风干的盖子

examples.text: ...a hermetically sealed, leak-proof packet.
examples.translation: 密封防漏的包装

examples.text: When assembling the pie, wet the edges where the two crusts join, to form a seal.
examples.translation: 在包馅饼时，先把两片馅饼皮边沿接头部分弄湿，再将其捏合。

examples.text: Check seals on fridges and freezers regularly.
examples.translation: 定期检查冰箱和冷冻柜的密封装置。

examples.text: The seal on the box broke when it fell from its hiding-place...
examples.translation: 盒子从隐藏处掉落时，封口裂开了。

examples.text: Protestors banged on the sides of the lorry and broke customs seals on the doors.
examples.translation: 抗议者们猛砸卡车的侧面，并且撕掉了车门上的海关封条。

examples.text: ...a supply of note paper bearing the Presidential seal...
examples.translation: 一批盖有总统印章的便条纸

examples.text: The best wines are entitled to a numbered seal of quality.
examples.translation: 上等葡萄酒可以盖上带编号的优质产品印章。

examples.text: The soldiers were deployed to help paramilitary police seal the border...
examples.translation: 部署士兵协助准军事警察封锁边境。

examples.text: A wide area round the two-storey building is sealed to all traffic except the emergency services.
examples.translation: 那个两层建筑周围的大片区域被封锁，只有提供应急服务的车辆可以通行。

examples.text: Police and troops sealed off the area after the attack...
examples.translation: 袭击发生后警察和士兵将该区域封锁。

examples.text: Soldiers there are going to seal the airport off.
examples.translation: 那里的士兵将封锁机场。

examples.text: McLaren are close to sealing a deal with Renault...
examples.translation: 麦克拉伦即将与雷诺达成一笔交易。

examples.text: A General Election will be held which will seal his destiny one way or the other...
examples.translation: 一场决定他命运的大选即将举行。

examples.text: His artistic character was sealed by his experiences of the First World War.
examples.translation: 他在第一次世界大战中的经历奠定了他的艺术风格。

examples.text: Such a visit may set the seal on a new relationship between the two governments...
examples.translation: 这样的一次访问可能会使两国政府间确立新关系。
