examples.translation: 男孩张大了嘴巴。

examples.text: The workload can be evened out, instead of the shop having busy times and slack periods.
examples.translation: 商其工作量可以平均开来，不像商店那样有时很忙，有时很闲。

examples.text: Many publishers have simply become far too slack.
examples.translation: 许多出版商就是变得过于懈怠了。

examples.text: He accused the government of slackness and complacency.
examples.translation: 他谴责政府的懈怠和自满。

examples.text: He had never let a foreman see him slacking.
examples.translation: 他从未在哪个工头面前表现出丝毫懈怠。

examples.text: If someone slacks off, Bill comes down hard.
examples.translation: 如果有人怠工，比尔就会严厉地加以斥责。

examples.text: As major airlines give up less-traveled routes, smaller planes are picking up the slack.
examples.translation: 由于大型航空公司放弃了乘客较少的路线，一些较小的飞机正在加紧补位。

meanings.meaning: 拍击；侮辱；掌击；掴…的耳光

examples.text: He would push or slap her once in a while...
examples.translation: 他偶尔会推搡她或是打她的耳光。

examples.text: I slapped him hard across the face...
examples.translation: 我重重地掴了他一记耳光。

examples.text: He was slapping a woman around and I objected.
examples.translation: 他正在掌掴一个女人，我上前制止。

examples.text: He reached forward and gave her a slap.
examples.translation: 他上前打了她一个耳光。

examples.text: A large middle-aged lady slapped me on the back and said 'Nice to see you again.'
examples.translation: 一位身材高大的中年女士拍了拍我的后背说：“很高兴再次见到你。”

examples.text: The barman slapped the cup on to the waiting saucer.
examples.translation: 酒吧服务生麻利地把茶杯放在了茶碟上。

examples.text: The government slapped a ban on the export of unprocessed logs...
examples.translation: 政府贸然禁止出口未加工过的原木。

examples.text: Thankfully the Government still hasn't discovered a way of slapping a tax on love, sunshine or air.
examples.translation: 谢天谢地，政府还没有找到对爱情、阳光和空气课税的方法。

examples.text: 'The Sun' calls it a massive slap in the face for the United States government...
examples.translation: 《太阳报》称之为打在美国政府脸上的一记重重的耳光。

examples.text: Britons persist in treating any pay rise of less than 5% as a slap in the face.
examples.translation: 英国人坚持认为加薪不到 5%不啻于一种羞辱。

examples.text: The fine they gave her is just more or less a slap on the wrist.
examples.translation: 他们对她开出的罚金不过是一个轻微的警告而已。

examples.text: Thirty four people were slaughtered while queuing up to cast their votes...
examples.translation: 有 34 人在排队投票时遭到残杀。

examples.text: Whales and dolphins are still being slaughtered for commercial gain.
examples.translation: 仍然有人为了商业利益大肆捕杀鲸鱼和海豚。

examples.text: ...a war where the slaughter of civilians was commonplace...
examples.translation: 在战争中杀戮平民的事情再平常不过

examples.text: The annual slaughter of wildlife in Italy is horrific.
examples.translation: 在意大利，每年大量捕杀野生动物的现象令人震惊。

examples.text: Lack of chicken feed means that chicken farms are having to slaughter their stock.
examples.translation: 鸡饲料的缺乏意味着养鸡场将不得不杀掉饲养的鸡。

examples.text: More than 491,000 sheep were exported to the Continent for slaughter last year.
examples.translation: 去年有 491,000 多只羊被出口到欧洲大陆供宰杀。

meanings.meaning: (Slam)人名；(阿拉伯)萨拉姆；(罗)斯拉姆

examples.text: She slammed the door and locked it behind her...
examples.translation: 她砰的一下关上门，随手锁上了。

examples.text: I was relieved to hear the front door slam...
examples.translation: 听见前门砰的一声关上了，我松了一口气。

examples.text: He slammed the gate shut behind him.
examples.translation: 他顺手把身后的门猛地关上了。

examples.text: She listened in a mixture of shock and anger before slamming the phone down.
examples.translation: 她又惊又气地听着电话，然后啪地挂断了。

examples.text: The famed film-maker slammed the claims as 'an outrageous lie'...
examples.translation: 这位大名鼎鼎的电影制片人声色俱厉地抨击了这些说法，称之为“无耻的谎言”。

examples.text: Britain has been slammed by the United Nations for having one of the worst race relations records in the world.
examples.translation: 由于在处理种族关系方面的表现位列全世界最糟糕的国家之一，英国遭到了联合国的严厉批评。

examples.text: The plane slammed into the building after losing an engine shortly after take-off...
examples.translation: 飞机起飞之后不久，就有一个引擎出现故障，随即便一头撞上了大楼。

examples.text: He slammed me against the ground.
examples.translation: 他把我狠狠地摔在了地上。

examples.text: The state of Liberia was formed a century and a half ago by freed slaves from the United States.
examples.translation: 150年前，从美国获得了自由归来的奴隶建立了利比里亚。

examples.text: Movie stars used to be slaves to the studio system.
examples.translation: 电影明星过去完全受制于大制片厂制度。

examples.text: When you're busy all day the last thing you want to do is spend hours slaving over a hot stove.
examples.translation: 辛苦了一整天之后，最不愿意做的事情就是在热烘烘的炉子前再忙活上好几个钟头。

examples.text: He stares at the hundreds of workers slaving away in the intense sun.
examples.translation: 他凝视着在炎炎烈日下辛苦劳作的几百名工人。

meanings.meaning: [机] 套筒，[机] 套管；袖子，[服装] 袖套

examples.text: His sleeves were rolled up to his elbows...
examples.translation: 他的袖子卷到了肘部。

examples.text: He wore a black band on the left sleeve of his jacket.
examples.translation: 他在夹克衫的左袖上戴了一条黑箍儿。

examples.text: There are to be no pictures of him on the sleeve of the new record.
examples.translation: 新唱片的封套上不会出现他的照片。

examples.text: ...an album sleeve.
examples.translation: 唱片套

examples.text: He wondered what Shearson had up his sleeve...
examples.translation: 他暗自猜度希尔森究竟有什么高招。

examples.text: I'd been doing some quiet investigating in the meantime and had an ace up my sleeve.
examples.translation: 与此同时，我不动声色地展开了调查，掌握了一张王牌。

examples.text: They were exhausted from lack of sleep...
examples.translation: 由于缺乏睡眠，他们非常疲惫。

examples.text: Try and get some sleep...
examples.translation: 试着睡一会儿。

examples.text: Be quiet and go to sleep...
examples.translation: 别出声，睡觉吧。

examples.text: Often he would have bad dreams and cry out in his sleep.
examples.translation: 他常常做噩梦，并且在梦里喊出声来。

examples.text: During the car journey, the baby slept...
examples.translation: 坐车来的路上，宝宝睡着了。

examples.text: I've not been able to sleep for the last few nights.
examples.translation: 前几个晚上，我一直都无法入睡。

examples.text: ...a pool surrounded by sleeping sunbathers.
examples.translation: 四周躺着边睡觉边晒日光浴的人们的游泳池

examples.text: I think he may be ready for a sleep soon.
examples.translation: 我想他也许很快就要睡一觉了。

examples.text: The villa sleeps 10 and costs £530 per person for two weeks.
examples.translation: 这座别墅可以住下 10 人，每人两周的费用是 530 英镑。

examples.text: I can't get to sleep with all that singing.
examples.translation: 那些歌声搅得我无法入睡。

examples.text: I didn't lose too much sleep over that investigation.
examples.translation: 我并不太担心那个调查。

examples.text: I'm going take the dog down to the vet's and have her put to sleep.
examples.translation: 我要把小狗带到兽医那里，让她安乐死。

examples.text: She was slender, with delicate wrists and ankles.
examples.translation: 她身量苗条，手腕和脚踝曲线玲珑。

examples.text: ...a tall, slender figure in a straw hat...
examples.translation: 头顶草帽、高挑苗条的人影

examples.text: He gazed at her slender neck.
examples.translation: 他凝视着她优美的颈部。

examples.text: The United States held a slender lead...
examples.translation: 美国以微弱优势领先。

examples.text: He has won a vote of confidence but only by a slender majority.
examples.translation: 他以微弱多数赢得了信任票。

examples.text: ...the first slender hope of peace.
examples.translation: 初现的一线和平希望

meanings.meaning: 切下；把…分成部分；将…切成薄片

examples.text: Try to eat at least four slices of bread a day.
examples.translation: 每天尽量至少吃 4 片面包。

examples.text: ...water flavored with a slice of lemon.
examples.translation: 加了一片柠檬调味的水

examples.text: Helen sliced the cake...
examples.translation: 海伦把蛋糕切成片。

examples.text: Slice the steak into long thin slices.
examples.translation: 将牛排切成长长的薄片。

examples.text: I sliced up an onion...
examples.translation: 我把一个洋葱切了片。

examples.text: He began slicing the pie up.
examples.translation: 他开始把馅饼切片。

examples.text: Fiction takes up a large slice of the publishing market.
examples.translation: 小说在出版市场上占了很大的份额。

examples.text: ...a car that represents a slice of motoring history.
examples.translation: 一辆代表了一段汽车发展史的轿车

examples.text: The captain swung his left foot, but sliced the ball wide.
examples.translation: 队长飞起左脚一踢，球却侧着旋出去老远。

examples.text: ...a ball that would reduce hooks and slices.
examples.translation: 一只能够减少左曲球和侧旋球的球

examples.text: The ship sliced through the water.
examples.translation: 轮船在水中破浪前行。

meanings.meaning: 轻微的，少量的；脆弱的；细长的；不重要的

examples.text: Doctors say he has made a slight improvement...
examples.translation: 医生说他的病情稍有好转。

examples.text: We have a slight problem...
examples.translation: 我们有一个小小的问题。

examples.text: A slight smile flickered over his face...
examples.translation: 他的脸上闪过一丝微笑。

examples.text: He's not the slightest bit worried.
examples.translation: 他一点儿也不担心。

examples.text: She is smaller and slighter than Christie.
examples.translation: 她比克里斯蒂瘦小。

examples.text: ...a slight, bespectacled figure.
examples.translation: 身材瘦小、戴着眼镜的人

examples.text: ...a slightly built man.
examples.translation: 身材瘦小的男子

examples.text: They felt slighted by not being adequately consulted.
examples.translation: 没有充分征求他们的意见，这让他们感到被冷落了。

examples.text: It isn't a slight on my husband that I enjoy my evening class.
examples.translation: 我喜欢上夜课并非是对丈夫的冷落。

examples.text: ...slighting references to her age.
examples.translation: 谈到她的年纪时的轻蔑语气

examples.text: That doesn't interest me in the slightest...
examples.translation: 那一点也不能引起我的兴趣。

examples.text: 'Do you worry about ageing?' — 'Not in the slightest.'
examples.translation: “你担心变老吗？”——“一点也不。”

meanings.meaning: 苗条的；修长的；微小的；差的
(Slim)人名；(阿拉伯)萨利姆；(英、西)斯利姆

examples.text: The young woman was tall and slim...
examples.translation: 那个年轻的女子身材苗条修长。

examples.text: Jean is pretty, of slim build, with blue eyes.
examples.translation: 珍妮非常漂亮，身材苗条，有一双蓝色的眼睛。

examples.text: Some people will gain weight, no matter how hard they try to slim...
examples.translation: 有些人无论多么努力地减肥，都会长肉。

examples.text: It makes sense to eat a reasonably balanced diet when slimming.
examples.translation: 在减肥过程中保持饮食的营养相对均衡是明智的。

examples.text: Doctors have told Benny to slim down.
examples.translation: 医生告诉本尼要减肥。

examples.text: ...salon treatments that claim to slim down thighs.
examples.translation: 据称可以瘦大腿的美容疗法

examples.text: ...meals for slimmers.
examples.translation: 减肥餐

examples.text: We live in a society which is obsessed with slimming.
examples.translation: 我们生活在一个热衷于减肥的社会。

examples.text: The slim booklets describe a range of services and facilities...
examples.translation: 这些薄薄的小册子介绍了一系列服务和设施。

examples.text: He published only three slim volumes of verse in his short life.
examples.translation: 在他短暂的一生里，他只出版过 3 卷薄薄的诗集。

examples.text: There's still a slim chance that he may become Prime Minister.
examples.translation: 他仍然有一丝希望当上首相。

examples.text: The company recently slimmed its product line.
examples.translation: 公司最近压缩了产品线。

meanings.meaning: 滑动；滑落；不知不觉陷入
滑动；使滑动；悄悄地迅速放置

examples.text: She slid the door open...
examples.translation: 她滑开了门。

examples.text: I slid the wallet into his pocket...
examples.translation: 我把钱包麻利地塞进了他的口袋。

examples.text: Tears were sliding down his cheeks.
examples.translation: 眼泪顺着他的脸颊往下淌。

examples.text: He slid into the driver's seat...
examples.translation: 他麻利地坐进驾驶员的座位。

examples.text: 'Nice meeting you, Zoe,' I said and slid off.
examples.translation: “很高兴见到你，佐薇，”说完我便溜走了。

examples.text: She had slid into a depression...
examples.translation: 她不觉沮丧起来。

examples.text: He needs them to stop the country sliding into chaos.
examples.translation: 他需要他们来防止这个国家陷入混乱。

examples.text: The US dollar continued to slide...
examples.translation: 美元继续贬值。

examples.text: The upset sent share prices sliding to their lowest level for almost 18 months...
examples.translation: 这种不安情绪使股票价格跌落到几乎 18 个月以来的最低水平。

examples.text: Shares slid 11p to 293p after brokers downgraded their profit estimates...
examples.translation: 股票经纪人降低了他们的利润预期之后，股价下跌了 11 便士至 293 便士。

examples.text: Its share slid from 24.24 per cent to 22.17 per cent.
...the dangerous slide in oil prices.
examples.translation: 石油价格的危险下跌

examples.text: ...a slide show.
examples.translation: 幻灯片放映

examples.text: The company had let environmental standards slide.
examples.translation: 这家公司听凭环境标准的不断下降。

examples.text: Slade hit boys with a slipper, a table tennis bat and his hand, jurors heard.

meanings.meaning: 滑动；滑倒；犯错；失足；减退
使滑动；滑过；摆脱；塞入；闪开
滑，滑倒；片，纸片；错误；下跌；事故
滑动的；有活结的；活络的
串行线路接口协议，是旧式的协议（Serial Line Interface Protocol）

examples.text: He had slipped on an icy pavement...
examples.translation: 他在一条结了冰的人行道上滑了一跤。

examples.text: Be careful not to slip.
examples.translation: 小心，别滑倒了。

examples.text: His glasses had slipped...
examples.translation: 他的眼镜滑掉了。

examples.text: The hammer slipped out of her grasp.
examples.translation: 锤子从她的手中滑落。

examples.text: Amy slipped downstairs and out of the house...
examples.translation: 埃米偷偷下楼溜出了房子。

examples.text: She slipped into the driving seat and closed the door.
examples.translation: 她溜进了驾驶座，关上了门。

examples.text: I slipped a note under Louise's door...
examples.translation: 我偷偷在路易斯的房门下面塞了一张便条。

examples.text: He found a coin in his pocket and slipped it into her collecting tin...
examples.translation: 他摸到口袋里有一枚硬币，便匆匆丢进她的讨钱罐。

examples.text: Just slip in a piece of paper.
examples.translation: 只要塞进一张纸就行。

examples.text: Robert had slipped her a note in school...
examples.translation: 罗伯特在学校里偷偷地塞给她一张纸条。

examples.text: She looked round before pulling out a package and slipping it to the man.
examples.translation: 她四下里看了看，然后拿出一个包裹，偷偷地塞给了这个男人。

examples.text: It amazed him how easily one could slip into a routine...
examples.translation: 他惊异地发现人很容易在不知不觉中因循守旧起来。

examples.text: There was a 50-50 chance that the economy could slip back into recession.
examples.translation: 经济再次陷入衰退的可能性是 50%。

examples.text: Shares slipped to 117p...
examples.translation: 股价跌至 117 便士。

examples.text: The club had slipped to the bottom of Division Four...
examples.translation: 该俱乐部已经跌为丁级组的最后一名。

examples.text: In June, producer prices slipped 0.1% from May...
examples.translation: 6 月的生产价格比 5 月下降了 0.1%。

examples.text: Overall business activity is slipping.
examples.translation: 商业活动整体趋于萧条。

examples.text: ...a slip in consumer confidence.
examples.translation: 消费者信心的下降

examples.text: She slipped out of the jacket and tossed it on the couch...
examples.translation: 她麻利地脱下夹克，扔在了沙发上。

examples.text: I slipped off my woollen gloves.
examples.translation: 我迅速地脱下了毛绒手套。

examples.text: We must be well prepared, there must be no slips.
examples.translation: 我们必须好好准备，不能出任何差错。

examples.text: ...little slips of paper he had torn from a notebook...
examples.translation: 他从笔记本上撕下来的一张张小纸片

examples.text: I put her name on the slip.
examples.translation: 我在纸条上记下了她的名字。

examples.text: ...credit card slips.
examples.translation: 信用卡刷卡单

examples.text: He's a mere slip of a lad compared to his brother...
examples.translation: 跟他哥哥一比，他不过是个小毛孩。

examples.text: She was just a slip of a thing.
examples.translation: 她才是个小丫头。

examples.text: He gave reporters the slip by leaving at midnight.
examples.translation: 他在午夜时分离开，避开了记者的追踪。

examples.text: I bet he let slip that I'd gone to America.
examples.translation: 我可以打赌，是他走漏了我去了美国的消息。

examples.text: The reason for my visit had obviously slipped his mind.
examples.translation: 他显然已经忘掉了我的来意。

examples.text: The tiled floor was wet and slippery...
examples.translation: 瓷砖地面又湿又滑。

examples.text: Motorists were warned to beware of slippery conditions.
examples.translation: 提醒驾车人要当心路滑。

examples.text: He is a slippery customer, and should be carefully watched.
examples.translation: 他是一个狡猾的顾客，要小心提防。

examples.text: The company started down the slippery slope of believing that they knew better than the customer.
examples.translation: 该公司认为他们比顾客更了解情况，而有这种想法注定是要失败的。

examples.text: They say somebody slit her throat...
examples.translation: 他们说有人割断了她的喉咙。

examples.text: He began to slit open each envelope...
examples.translation: 他开始裁开每个信封。

examples.text: She was wearing a white dress slit to the thigh.
examples.translation: 她身穿一条开叉开到了大腿的白色连衣裙。

examples.text: Make a slit in the stem about half an inch long.
examples.translation: 在树干上切一道大约半英寸长的口子。

examples.text: She watched them through a slit in the curtains.
examples.translation: 她透过窗帘上的一道窄缝注视着他们。

examples.text: They could campaign on the slogan 'We'll take less of your money'.
examples.translation: 他们可能打出这样的竞选口号：“我们会让您少出钱”。

examples.text: ...a group of angry demonstrators shouting slogans.
examples.translation: 一群高呼口号的愤怒的示威者

meanings.meaning: 斜坡；倾斜；斜率；扛枪姿势

examples.text: Saint-Christo is perched on a mountain slope.
examples.translation: 圣克里斯托教堂坐落在一个山坡上。

examples.text: ...the lower slopes of the Himalayas.
examples.translation: 喜马拉雅山脉较低处的山坡

examples.text: The street must have been on a slope.
examples.translation: 这条街一定是建在一个斜坡上。

examples.text: The bank sloped down sharply to the river...
examples.translation: 河岸到河面的斜坡非常陡。

examples.text: The garden sloped quite steeply.
examples.translation: 花园的斜坡颇为陡峭。

examples.text: ...a brick building, with a sloping roof.
examples.translation: 有着斜屋顶的砖房

examples.text: ...the gently sloping beach.
examples.translation: 坡度很缓的海滩

examples.text: The writing sloped backwards...
examples.translation: 笔迹朝右倾斜。

examples.text: He wonders why the digits on his calculator slope to the right.
examples.translation: 他不明白为什么他的计算器上面的数字向右倾斜。

examples.text: The slope increases as you go up the curve.
examples.translation: 上了弯道以后，路越来越陡。

examples.text: ...a slope of ten degrees.
examples.translation: 一段坡度为 10° 的斜坡

examples.text: She sloped off quietly on Saturday afternoon...
examples.translation: 星期六下午，她脚底抹油，溜之大吉。

examples.text: They sloped into their hotel at 6am.
examples.translation: 凌晨 6 点，他们悄悄地潜入他们下榻的饭店。

meanings.meaning: 位置；狭槽；水沟；硬币投币口

examples.text: He dropped a coin into the slot and dialed.
examples.translation: 他往投币孔里投了一枚硬币，然后拨了电话。

examples.text: He was slotting a CD into a CD player...
examples.translation: 他正把一张 CD 放入 CD 机中。

examples.text: The car seat belt slotted into place easily...
examples.translation: 汽车坐椅安全带很容易扣上。

examples.text: She slotted in a fresh filter.
examples.translation: 她放进了一张新的滤纸。

examples.text: Visitors can book a time slot a week or more in advance...
examples.translation: 来访者可以提前一周或更早预约一个时间。

examples.text: The first episode occupies a peak evening viewing slot.
examples.translation: 第一集占据了傍晚的一个黄金收视时段。

examples.text: The traffic is heavy and slow...
examples.translation: 交通拥挤，车流缓慢。

examples.text: Electric whisks should be used on a slow speed.
examples.translation: 使用自动搅拌器时应该选用慢挡。

examples.text: ...slow, regular breathing.
examples.translation: 缓慢而均匀的呼吸

examples.text: He spoke slowly and deliberately...
examples.translation: 他说得缓慢而谨慎。

examples.text: Christian backed slowly away.
examples.translation: 克里斯琴慢慢地往后退。

examples.text: She lowered the glass with calculated slowness.
examples.translation: 她有意慢慢地放低了玻璃杯。

examples.text: I began to walk slower and slower...
examples.translation: 我走得越来越慢。

examples.text: We got there by driving slow all the way.
examples.translation: 我们开着车去了那里，一路上开得很慢。

examples.text: The distribution of passports has been a slow process.
examples.translation: 颁发护照的过程非常缓慢。

examples.text: My resentment of her slowly began to fade.
examples.translation: 我对她的怨恨开始渐渐消退了。

examples.text: ...the slowness of political and economic progress.
examples.translation: 政治和经济发展缓慢

examples.text: The world community has been slow to respond to the crisis...
examples.translation: 国际社会对这次危机反应迟缓。

examples.text: I've been a bit slow in making up my mind.
examples.translation: 我下决心有些慢。

examples.text: The rate of bombing has slowed considerably...
examples.translation: 轰炸的速度明显慢了下来。

examples.text: She slowed the car and began driving up a narrow road...
examples.translation: 她放慢车速，开始驶上一条狭窄的道路。

examples.text: Reactions were slowed by fatigue.
examples.translation: 疲劳使反应变得迟缓。

examples.text: He got hit on the head and he's been a bit slow since.
examples.translation: 他的脑袋受过撞击，从那以后，他的反应变得有些迟钝。

examples.text: Don't be faint-hearted when things seem a bit slow or boring...
examples.translation: 事情变得有点沉闷无聊的时候，不要胆怯。

examples.text: The island is too slow for her liking.
examples.translation: 这个岛太沉闷了，不合她的胃口。

meanings.meaning: 贫民窟；陋巷；脏乱的地方

examples.text: ...a slum area of St Louis.
examples.translation: 圣路易斯的贫民区

examples.text: ...inner-city slums in the old cities of the north and east.
examples.translation: 北部和东部老城市里的市中心贫民区

examples.text: ...rich kids slumming it.
examples.translation: 体验下层社会生活的有钱人的孩子

examples.text: ...aristocratic types who enjoyed slumming around in musty old Scottish castles.
examples.translation: 喜欢在发霉的苏格兰古堡里体验苦日子的贵族阶层

examples.text: His lips were spread in a sly smile...
examples.translation: 他心照不宣地咧嘴一笑。

examples.text: He gave me a sly, meaningful look.
examples.translation: 他心照不宣地看了我一眼，意味深长。

examples.text: Anna grinned slyly.
examples.translation: 安娜会意地咧嘴笑了。

examples.text: She is devious and sly and manipulative...
examples.translation: 她阴险狡诈，会玩人。

examples.text: He's a sly old beggar if ever there was one.
examples.translation: 他确确实实是个老奸巨猾的家伙。

examples.text: Was she meeting some guy on the sly?
examples.translation: 她是不是偷偷地在见什么人？

meanings.meaning: 少的，小的；微弱的；几乎没有的；不重要的；幼小的

examples.text: She is small for her age...
examples.translation: 她看上去比同龄人个头小。

examples.text: The window was far too small for him to get through...
examples.translation: 窗户对他来说实在太小，他钻不过去。

examples.text: Next door to the garage is a small orchard area...
examples.translation: 紧挨着车库是一座小果园。

examples.text: Stick them on using a small amount of glue.
examples.translation: 用少许胶水把它们贴上。

examples.text: Amy had not mentioned the smallness and bareness of Luis's home.
examples.translation: 埃米没有提及路易斯家里多么小多么空。

examples.text: A small group of students meets regularly to learn Japanese...
examples.translation: 一小组学生定期聚在一起学习日语。

examples.text: Guns continued to be produced in small numbers.
examples.translation: 枪支继续被小批量地制造出来。

examples.text: I have a wife and two small children...
examples.translation: 我有一个妻子和两个年幼的孩子。

examples.text: What were you like when you were small?
examples.translation: 你小的时候是什么样子？

examples.text: It's quite easy to make quite small changes to the way that you work...
examples.translation: 对工作方式作一些小的改变会比较容易。

examples.text: No detail was too small to escape her attention...
examples.translation: 再小的细节都逃不过她的眼睛。

examples.text: He believes this to be a relatively small problem.
examples.translation: 他认为这相对而言是一个小问题。

examples.text: ...shops, restaurants and other small businesses...
examples.translation: 商店、饭馆以及其他小企业

examples.text: Tool companies here are generally small.
examples.translation: 这里制造工具的公司普遍规模不大。

examples.text: 'I'm scared,' she said in a very small voice.
examples.translation: 她非常小声地说：“我很害怕。”

examples.text: This may just be another of her schemes to make me look small...
examples.translation: 这也许是她处心积虑要让我自惭形秽的另一步棋。

examples.text: When your children misbehave tell them without making them feel small.
examples.translation: 孩子表现不佳时要让他们知道，但不能让他们自惭形秽。

examples.text: Place your hands on the small of your back and breathe in.
examples.translation: 双手置于腰部，吸气。

meanings.meaning: 了不起的；非常轰动的；出色的

examples.text: Someone smashed a bottle...
examples.translation: 有人摔碎了一个瓶子。

examples.text: A crowd of youths started smashing windows...
examples.translation: 一群年轻人开始砸玻璃。

examples.text: Two or three glasses fell off and smashed into pieces.
examples.translation: 两三只杯子掉了下来，摔得粉碎。

examples.text: The demonstrators used trucks to smash through embassy gates...
examples.translation: 示威者用卡车撞开了使馆大门。

examples.text: Soldiers smashed their way into his office.
examples.translation: 士兵冲进了他的办公室。

examples.text: The bottle smashed against a wall...
examples.translation: 瓶子撞到了墙上。

examples.text: He smashed his fist into Anthony's face.
examples.translation: 他一拳打在了安东尼脸上。

examples.text: Their attempts to clean up politics and smash the power of party machines failed.
examples.translation: 他们力图重整政坛、摧毁现有的政党机器，却以失败收场。

examples.text: It is the public who decide if a film is a smash or a flop.
examples.translation: 影片成败与否取决于公众。

examples.text: He was near to death after a car smash.
examples.translation: 他差点在一场撞车事故中丧命。

meanings.meaning: 嗅，闻；察觉到；发出…的气味

examples.text: ...the smell of freshly baked bread.
examples.translation: 新鲜出炉的面包的香味

examples.text: ...horrible smells...
examples.translation: 难闻的气味

examples.text: What is your favourite smell?
examples.translation: 你喜欢哪种气味呢？

examples.text: ...people who lose their sense of smell.
examples.translation: 丧失了嗅觉的人

examples.text: The room smelled of lemons...
examples.translation: 房间里有股柠檬的味道。

examples.text: It smells delicious.
examples.translation: 闻起来很香。

examples.text: ...a crumbly black substance that smells like fresh soil.
examples.translation: 散发着新鲜泥土气息的黑色易碎物质

examples.text: Ma threw that out. She said it smelled...
examples.translation: 妈把那玩意扔出去了，她说它有股怪味。

examples.text: Do my feet smell?
examples.translation: 我的脚臭吗？

examples.text: As soon as we opened the front door we could smell the gas.
examples.translation: 我们一打开前门，就闻到了煤气的味道。

examples.text: I took a fresh rose out of the vase on our table, and smelled it.
examples.translation: 我从饭桌上的花瓶里抽了一只新鲜的玫瑰，闻了闻。

examples.text: He knew virtually nothing about music but he could smell a hit.
examples.translation: 他对音乐几乎一窍不通，却预感到它将会大受欢迎。

examples.text: When he saw me, he smiled and waved...
examples.translation: 他看见我的时候，微笑着朝我挥挥手。

examples.text: He rubbed the back of his neck and smiled ruefully at me...
examples.translation: 他挠了挠脖梗儿，对我苦笑了一下。

examples.text: His smiling face appears on T-shirts, billboards, and posters.
examples.translation: 他的笑脸出现在T恤衫、公告牌和海报上面。

examples.text: She gave a wry smile...
examples.translation: 她苦笑了一下。

examples.text: 'There are some sandwiches if you're hungry,' she said with a smile...
examples.translation: 她笑道：“你要是饿的话，这有一些三明治。”

examples.text: She had a big smile on her face.
examples.translation: 她笑容满面。

examples.text: 'Aren't we daft?' she smiled...
examples.translation: 她微笑着问：“我们不是很傻吗?”

examples.text: She smiled her thanks and arranged the guitar under her arm.
examples.translation: 她微笑着致了谢，把胳膊下面的吉他调整了一下。

examples.text: When fortune smiled on him, he made the most of it...
examples.translation: 当好运来临时，他充分把握住了。

examples.text: God is not smiling on our cause.
examples.translation: 我们的事业没有得到上帝的垂怜。

examples.text: Cars cause pollution, both smog and acid rain.
examples.translation: 汽车造成的污染既有烟雾也有酸雨。

examples.text: A cloud of black smoke blew over the city...
examples.translation: 一团黑烟吹过城市的上空。

examples.text: The air was thick with cigarette smoke.
examples.translation: 空气里充斥着浓浓的烟味。

examples.text: The chimney was smoking fiercely.
examples.translation: 烟囱里浓烟滚滚。

examples.text: ...a pile of smoking rubble.
examples.translation: 一堆冒着烟的瓦砾

examples.text: He was sitting alone, smoking a big cigar...
examples.translation: 他独自坐在那儿，抽着一只大雪茄。

examples.text: It's not easy to quit smoking cigarettes...
examples.translation: 戒烟并非易事。

examples.text: Do you smoke?
examples.translation: 您抽烟吗？

examples.text: Someone came out for a smoke.
examples.translation: 有人出来抽烟。

examples.text: He was not a heavy smoker.
examples.translation: 他烟瘾不大。

examples.text: ...the grid where the fish were being smoked.
examples.translation: 熏鱼用的格栅

examples.text: ...smoked bacon.
examples.translation: 熏咸肉

examples.text: More than 900 years of British history went up in smoke in the Great Fire of Windsor.
examples.translation: 900 多年的英国历史在温莎城堡的一场大火中灰飞烟灭。

examples.text: Their dreams went up in smoke after the collapse of their travel agency.
examples.translation: 他们的旅行社倒闭之后，他们的梦想也随之破灭了。

meanings.meaning: 使光滑；消除（障碍等）；使优雅；缓和

examples.text: ...a rich cream that keeps skin soft and smooth.
examples.translation: 能让皮肤永葆柔嫩光滑的营养霜

examples.text: ...a smooth surface such as glass...
examples.translation: 如玻璃般光滑的表面

examples.text: The flagstones beneath their feet were worn smooth by centuries of use.
examples.translation: 他们脚下的石板路经过数百年的踩踏，磨得光溜溜的。

examples.text: ...the smoothness of her skin.
examples.translation: 她光滑的皮肤

examples.text: Continue whisking until the mixture looks smooth and creamy...
examples.translation: 一直搅拌，直至混合物变得均匀细腻。

examples.text: Blend the cornflour to a smooth paste with a little cold water.
examples.translation: 加入少量的凉水，将玉米粉搅拌成均匀的糊状。

examples.text: This makes the whiskeys much smoother.
examples.translation: 这样一来，威士忌就醇和多了。

examples.text: This exercise is done in one smooth motion.
examples.translation: 这个练习一气呵成。

examples.text: ...the smooth curve of the trunk.
examples.translation: 树干流畅的曲线

examples.text: Make sure that you execute all movements smoothly and without jerking...
examples.translation: 一定要保证所有动作自然流畅，不要一顿一顿的。

examples.text: 'I've no idea,' he said smoothly.
examples.translation: 他平静地说：“我不知道。”

examples.text: Sayer was delighted with the smoothness of the engine.
examples.translation: 塞耶对发动机平稳流畅的运转很是满意。

examples.text: The active suspension system gives the car a very smooth ride.
examples.translation: 这个主动悬架系统使汽车行驶起来非常平稳。

examples.text: The smoothness of the flight was memorable.
examples.translation: 这次平稳顺利的飞行令人难忘。

examples.text: Political hopes for a swift and smooth transition to democracy have been dashed...
examples.translation: 迅速而顺利地过渡到民主体制的政治希望破灭了。

examples.text: A number of problems marred the smooth running of this event.
examples.translation: 一些问题搅乱了这一事件的顺利进展。

examples.text: So far, talks at GM have gone smoothly...
examples.translation: 迄今为止，在通用汽车公司进行的会谈进展顺利。

examples.text: The operation was moving along smoothly.
examples.translation: 手术进展顺利。

examples.text: ...airlines believed regulations requiring identification of all unaccompanied hold baggage would damage the smoothness of their operations.
examples.translation: 航空公司认为，要求确认所有非随行行李的规定会阻碍公司营运的顺利进行。

examples.text: Twelve extremely good-looking, smooth young men have been picked as finalists...
examples.translation: 12 名特别漂亮精明的青年男子被选为参加决赛的选手。

examples.text: He was the smoothest and probably the most powerful chief of staff in political memory.
examples.translation: 在人们关于政治人物的记忆里，他是最精明、可能也是最有权势的参谋长。

examples.text: She stood up and smoothed down her frock...
examples.translation: 她站起身，抹平了裙子。

examples.text: Bardo smoothed his moustache.
examples.translation: 巴多抚了抚胡子。

examples.text: She smoothed the lotion across his shoulder blades...
examples.translation: 她在他的肩胛骨上抹了乳液。

examples.text: His fingers smoothed the hair back from her face.
examples.translation: 他用手把她脸上的头发捋到脑后。

examples.text: Their talks were aimed at smoothing the path towards a treaty to limit long-range weapons.
examples.translation: 他们的会谈旨在为缔结限制远程武器条约铺平道路。

examples.text: My message is 'If you try to smuggle drugs you are stupid'...
examples.translation: 我的意思是“你要是企图走私毒品，你就是一个笨蛋”。

examples.text: Police have foiled an attempt to smuggle a bomb into Belfast airport...
examples.translation: 警方挫败了一场企图将炸弹偷偷带入贝尔法斯特机场的阴谋。

examples.text: Had it really been impossible to find someone who could smuggle out a letter?...
examples.translation: 真的找不到一个能把信偷偷地带出去的人吗？

examples.text: Everything along the border has its price: drugs, teak, smuggled goods.
examples.translation: 边境上所有的东西都有定价，毒品、柚木和走私品无一例外。

examples.text: An air hostess was arrested and charged with drug smuggling.
examples.translation: 一名空姐被捕，并被控以走私毒品的罪名。

examples.text: ...the smuggling of arms.
examples.translation: 军火走私

examples.text: Lunch was a snack in the fields.
examples.translation: 午饭是在野外吃的便餐。

examples.text: Do you eat sweets, cakes or sugary snacks?
examples.translation: 你吃糖果、蛋糕或甜点吗？

examples.text: Instead of snacking on crisps and chocolate, nibble on celery or carrot...
examples.translation: 不要把薯片和巧克力当零食来吃，要吃些芹菜和胡萝卜。

examples.text: She would improve her diet if she ate less fried food and snacked less.
examples.translation: 如果她少吃油炸食品和零食的话，她的饮食结构就会有所改观。

examples.text: The road snaked through forested mountains...
examples.translation: 道路在林间蜿蜒延伸。

examples.text: The three-mile procession snaked its way through the richest streets of the capital.
examples.translation: 3 英里长的游行队伍弯弯曲曲地穿过了首都最繁华的街道。

meanings.meaning: 突然折断，拉断；猛咬；啪地关上
咬；厉声说；咯嗒一声关上

examples.text: He shifted his weight and a twig snapped...
examples.translation: 他挪了一下身体的重心，一根树枝咔嚓一声断了。

examples.text: The brake pedal had just snapped off...
examples.translation: 刹车踏板刚刚啪的一声绷断了。

examples.text: She gripped the pipe with both hands, trying to snap it in half.
examples.translation: 她双手紧握烟斗，想要把它掰成两半。

examples.text: Every minute or so I could hear a snap, a crack and a crash as another tree went down.
examples.translation: 每隔大约一分钟，我就会听见又一棵树咔嚓一声折断、哗啦一下倒地的声音。

examples.text: He snapped the notebook shut...
examples.translation: 他啪的一声合上了笔记本。

examples.text: He snapped the cap on his ballpoint...
examples.translation: 他吧嗒一声把笔帽扣在了圆珠笔上。

examples.text: The bag snapped open.
examples.translation: 包吧嗒一声打开了。

examples.text: He shut the book with a snap and stood up.
examples.translation: 他啪的一声合上书，站起身来。

examples.text: She had millions of listeners snapping their fingers to her first single...
examples.translation: 百万听众和着她第一首歌的节拍打着响指。

examples.text: He snapped his fingers, and Wilson produced a sheet of paper...
examples.translation: 他打了个响指，威尔逊便递过一张纸来。

examples.text: She snapped her fingers at a passing waiter.
examples.translation: 她向经过身边的一个服务生打了个响指。

examples.text: I could obtain with the snap of my fingers anything I chose.
examples.translation: 我不费吹灰之力就可以得到我看中的任何东西。

examples.text: 'Of course I don't know her,' Roger snapped...
examples.translation: 罗杰恶声恶气地说：“我当然不认识她。”

examples.text: I'm sorry, Casey, I didn't mean to snap at you like that.
examples.translation: 对不起，凯西，我不是有意要跟你凶的。

examples.text: He finally snapped when she prevented their children from visiting him one weekend...
examples.translation: 当她不准孩子们在某个周末去看他的时候，他终于控制不住自己了。

examples.text: For the first and only time Grant's self-control snapped...
examples.translation: 生平第一次也是唯一的一次，格兰特失控了。

examples.text: Then something seemed to snap in me. I couldn't endure any more.
examples.translation: 这时候，我的心里像有个东西突然绷断了——我再也忍受不了啦。

examples.text: His teeth clicked as he snapped at my ankle...
examples.translation: 它猛地朝我的脚脖子咬下去，牙齿还咔咔直响。

examples.text: The poodle yapped and snapped.
examples.translation: 卷毛狗又吠又咬。

examples.text: I think this is too important for a snap decision...
examples.translation: 我认为，这件事非常重要，不能仓促作决定。

examples.text: It's important not to make snap judgments...
examples.translation: 不要急于作出判断——这一点很重要。

examples.text: The opposition is worried that a snap election will be held before they can get organised.
examples.translation: 反对党担心的是，选举会在他们组织妥当之前仓促举行。

examples.text: ...a snap my mother took last year.
examples.translation: 我母亲去年拍的照片

examples.text: He was the first ever non-British photographer to be invited to snap a royal.
examples.translation: 他是有史以来第一个应邀为王室成员拍照的非英籍摄影师。

examples.text: Mick snatched the cards from Archie's hand...
examples.translation: 米克一把夺过阿奇手里的牌。

examples.text: He snatched up the telephone...
examples.translation: 他迅速地抓起了话筒。

examples.text: The thin wind snatched at her skirt.
examples.translation: 一阵小风呼地吹起了她的裙子。

examples.text: If your bag is snatched, let it go...
examples.translation: 要是有人抢你的包，就让他拿去。

examples.text: Mr Hillman was snatched by kidnappers last Thursday.
examples.translation: 上周四希尔曼先生被绑匪劫走了。

examples.text: Wealthy tourists are tempting targets for bag snatchers.
examples.translation: 富有的游客很容易成为抢包贼的目标。

examples.text: I snatched a glance at the mirror...
examples.translation: 我乘机瞥了一眼镜子。

examples.text: You can even snatch a few hours off...
examples.translation: 你甚至可以抓紧时间休息几个小时。

examples.text: He was going out for a run, then snatching a piece of toast and a cup of coffee.
examples.translation: 他准备出去跑步，然后抽空吃上一片面包，喝上一杯咖啡。

examples.text: The American came from behind to snatch victory by a mere eight seconds...
examples.translation: 美国人后来居上，仅以 8 秒钟的优势赢得了胜利。

examples.text: Chesterfield snatched a third goal.
examples.translation: 切斯特菲尔德攻入第三粒进球。

examples.text: I heard snatches of the conversation.
examples.translation: 我听见了一点谈话内容。

meanings.meaning: 溜；鬼鬼祟祟做事；向老师打小报告
鬼鬼祟祟的人；偷偷摸摸的行为；告密者

examples.text: Sometimes he would sneak out of his house late at night to be with me...
examples.translation: 有时候，他会在深夜里偷偷溜出家与我相会。

examples.text: Don't sneak away and hide.
examples.translation: 别溜走藏起来。

examples.text: He smuggled papers out each day, photocopied them, and snuck them back...
examples.translation: 他每天都把文件偷偷地带出去复印，然后再偷偷地拿回来。

examples.text: You even snuck me a cigarette.
examples.translation: 你居然偷偷塞给我一支烟。

examples.text: You sneak a look at your watch to see how long you've got to wait.
examples.translation: 你偷偷地望一眼手表，看看要等多长时间。

examples.text: What exactly happens when we sneeze?...
examples.translation: 我们打喷嚏究竟是怎么回事？

examples.text: See your doctor now to beat summer sneezing.
examples.translation: 马上去看病，把花粉过敏引起的打喷嚏治好。

examples.text: Coughs and sneezes spread infections.
examples.translation: 咳嗽和打喷嚏会传播传染病。

examples.text: The money's not to be sneezed at.
examples.translation: 别把这笔钱不当回事。

meanings.meaning: 吸，闻；嗤之以鼻；气味；以鼻吸气；吸气声

examples.text: She wiped her face and sniffed loudly...
examples.translation: 她抹了一把脸，很响地抽着鼻子。

examples.text: Moira looked around and sniffed. 'This place badly needs a decorator.'...
examples.translation: 莫伊拉环顾四周，抽了抽鼻子。“这个地方太需要有人来装修一下了。”

examples.text: Then he sniffed. There was a smell of burning...
examples.translation: 然后他抽了抽鼻子，发觉有一股烧焦的味道。

examples.text: He sniffed back the tears.
examples.translation: 他抽着鼻子，把眼泪忍了下去。

examples.text: At last the sobs ceased, to be replaced by sniffs.
examples.translation: 最后，啜泣终于止住了，只剩下抽鼻子的声音。

examples.text: Suddenly, he stopped and sniffed the air...
examples.translation: 他突然停下来，闻了闻空气里的味道。

examples.text: She sniffed at it suspiciously.
examples.translation: 她怀疑地闻了闻。

examples.text: 'Tourists!' she sniffed.
examples.translation: 她轻蔑地说道：“游客!”

examples.text: The salary was not to be sniffed at either...
examples.translation: 这份工资也不容小觑。

examples.text: Foreign Office sources sniffed at reports that British troops might be sent.
examples.translation: 外交部消息人士对有可能派出英国军队的报道不屑一顾。

examples.text: He felt light-headed, as if he'd sniffed glue.
examples.translation: 他觉得晕乎乎的，好像吸了胶毒一样。

examples.text: ...teenage glue sniffers.
examples.translation: 吸胶毒的青少年

examples.text: You know what they'll be like if they get a sniff of a murder investigation...
examples.translation: 你知道如果他们嗅到马上会进行谋杀调查会怎么样。

examples.text: Have the Press got a sniff yet?...
examples.translation: 新闻界嗅到了一点消息没有？

examples.text: Then, at the first sniff of danger, he was back at his post.
examples.translation: 然后，他一嗅到危险的气息，便马上回到自己的岗位。

examples.text: Winterton has never had a sniff of a government job in his entire twenty-one years in parliament.
examples.translation: 在国会的整整21年里，温特顿没有得到过任何在政府里工作的机会。

examples.text: In 2003, we had a massive 37-inch snowstorm over two days in Fort Collins.
In Mid-Wales six inches of snow blocked roads...
examples.translation: 在威尔士的中部地区，6英寸厚的大雪阻塞了道路。

examples.text: They tramped through the falling snow.
examples.translation: 他们在纷飞的大雪里艰难前行。

examples.text: ...the first snows of winter...
examples.translation: 冬天里的第一场雪

examples.text: As the snows melt, the flood waters rise.
examples.translation: 雪融化的时候，洪水会上涨。

examples.text: It had been snowing all night.
examples.translation: 整晚都在下雪。

examples.text: I'd been a fool letting him snow me with his big ideas.
examples.translation: 我真蠢，居然被他的胡乱吹嘘给蒙蔽了。

examples.text: 'Do you think that made much of a difference to the family?' — 'I think so.'...
examples.translation: “你认为那会给这个家庭带来很大的变化吗?”——“我认为是这样的。”

examples.text: If you can't play straight, then say so...
examples.translation: 要是你无法做到诚实坦率，就直说吧。

examples.text: 'Is he the kind of man who can be as flexible as he needs to be?' — ' Well, I hope so.'...
examples.translation: “他是那种能够灵活变通的人吗?”“嗯，希望如此。”

examples.text: Almost all young women who turn to prostitution do so as a means of survival.
examples.translation: 几乎所有从事卖淫的年轻女孩走这条路都是为了生存。

examples.text: I enjoy Ann's company and so does Martin...
examples.translation: 我喜欢和安在一起，马丁也一样。

examples.text: They had a wonderful time and so did I...
examples.translation: 他们玩得很开心，我也一样。

examples.text: The police arrived, and so did reporters and a photographer from the 'Journal'.
examples.translation: 警察赶到了那里，《日报》的记者和摄影师也到了。

examples.text: As computer systems become even more sophisticated, so too do the methods of those who exploit the technology...
examples.translation: 正如计算机系统变得越来越先进，开发计算机技术的人所用的方法也日益先进了。

examples.text: Just as John has changed, so has his wife...
examples.translation: 约翰变了，他的妻子也变了。

examples.text: Just as the teacher plays the role of leader in the classroom, so does the headteacher play a leadership role in the school.
examples.translation: 在课堂上老师扮演着领导者的角色，同样，在学校里校长也充当着领导者的角色。

examples.text: Gold has been a poor investment over the past 20 years, and will continue to be so...
examples.translation: 最近 20 年来投资黄金的收益很差，今后仍会如此。

examples.text: In those days English dances as well as songs were taught at school, but that seems no longer to be so...
examples.translation: 那时学校里教授英国舞蹈和英语歌曲，可是现在的情形似乎不再是这样了。

examples.text: It is strange to think that he held strong views on many things, but it must have been so.
examples.translation: 现在想来，当时他在许多事情上的观点都非常强硬，真是不可思议——可情况确实如此。

examples.text: Clasp the chain like so.
examples.translation: 像这样扣上链子。

examples.text: ...holding the champagne glass with long red nails positioned just so.
examples.translation: 手指指甲又长又红，就这样握着香槟酒杯

examples.text: I am not an emotional type and so cannot bring myself to tell him I love him...
examples.translation: 我不是一个感情外露的人，因此不会主动告诉他我爱他。

examples.text: People are living longer than ever before, so even people who are 65 or 70 have a surprising amount of time left...
examples.translation: 人们的寿命比以前任何时候都长了，所以即便到了 65 岁或 70 岁，余下的光阴也还很长。

examples.text: I was an only child, and so had no experience of large families...
examples.translation: 我是独生子，因此没有在大家庭里生活的经历。

examples.text: There was snow everywhere, so that the shape of things was difficult to identify.
examples.translation: 到处是雪，所以万物的形状都难以辨认。

examples.text: Come to my suite so I can tell you all about this wonderful play I saw in Boston...
examples.translation: 到我的套房来吧，这样我就可以跟你好好讲讲我在波士顿看的这部非常棒的戏了。

examples.text: He took her arm and hurried her upstairs so that they wouldn't be overheard...
examples.translation: 他挽起她的手臂，带她匆匆上了楼，这样别人就听不见他们说的话了。

examples.text: I was beginning to feel alarm, but kept it to myself so as not to worry our two friends.
examples.translation: 我开始有点慌了，但仍旧不动声色，免得我们的两个朋友担心。

examples.text: The woman asked if he could perhaps mend her fences, and so he stayed...
examples.translation: 女人问他能否给她修一修篱笆，于是他留了下来。

examples.text: She was free for five whole days, from Christmas Eve. And so she would be going to Charles, to join her family...
examples.translation: 她从圣诞夜开始有整整 5 天的自由时间，于是她准备去查尔斯跟家人呆在一起。

examples.text: I thought, 'Here's someone who'll understand me.' So I wrote to her...
examples.translation: 我想：“这个人会理解我的。”于是开始给她写信。

examples.text: He said he'd like to meet Sharon. So I said all right...
examples.translation: 他说想见见莎伦，我便说可以。

examples.text: And so Christmas passed.
examples.translation: 圣诞节就这么过去了。

examples.text: So how was your day?...
examples.translation: 那么，你今天过得怎么样？

examples.text: So you're a runner, huh?...
examples.translation: 这么说，你是个跑步爱好者喽？

examples.text: So as for your question, Miles, the answer still has to be no...
examples.translation: 至于你的问题，迈尔斯，答案仍旧是否定的。

examples.text: So, as I said to you, natural medicine is also known as holistic medicine...
examples.translation: 那么，正如我对你说过的那样，自然医学也被称为整体医学。

examples.text: And so, to answer your question, that's why your mother is disappointed...
examples.translation: 现在可以回答你的问题了，你母亲失望的原因就在这里。

examples.text: 'I didn't find him funny at all.' — 'So you won't watch the show again then?'...
examples.translation: “我一点也不觉得他有趣。”——“那么你不会再看那个节目了?”

examples.text: 'They're slow, heavy and cost a fortune.' — 'So how have these motorbikes become a fashion statement?'
examples.translation: “它们又慢又重，还贵得很。”——“那么这些摩托车是怎样变成时尚标签的呢？”

examples.text: 'It makes me feel, well, important.' — 'And so you are.'...
examples.translation: “这使我觉得自己，嗯，很重要。”——“的确如此。”

examples.text: 'You can't possibly use this word.' — 'So I won't.'...
examples.translation: “你绝不会使用这样的字眼。”——“我的确不会。”

examples.text: 'You know who Diana was, Grandfather.' — 'So I do!'...
examples.translation: “爷爷，您知道戴安娜是谁吧？”——“我当然知道！”

examples.text: 'Why, this is nothing but common vegetable soup!' — 'So it is, madam.'...
examples.translation: “怎么回事，这只是普普通通的蔬菜汤!”——“夫人，确实如此。”

examples.text: 'The car, Annie,' said Max rather grimly. — 'So okay, the car. What about it?'
examples.translation: “安妮，那辆车，”马克斯颇为严厉地说。——“那么好吧，就说说那辆车。它是怎么回事？”

examples.text: 'My name's Bruno.' — 'So?'...
examples.translation: “我是布鲁诺。”——“那又怎样?”

examples.text: 'You take a chance on the weather if you holiday in the UK.' — 'So what?'...
examples.translation: “如果到英国度假，天气好不好得要碰运气。”——“那又如何？”

examples.text: I enjoy someone telling me I'm wonderful, but part of me thinks, 'So what? You won't say that tomorrow.'
examples.translation: 我喜欢听人家夸我很棒，但我转而又会想，“那又怎么样？明天你就不会这么说了。”

examples.text: 'I am so afraid,' Francis thought...
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯心想：“我害怕极了。”

examples.text: He was surprised they had married — they had seemed so different...
examples.translation: 他俩居然结婚了——这让他非常惊讶，因为他们实在是太不一样了。

examples.text: What is so compromising about being an employee of the state?
examples.translation: 当公务员有什么地方让人这么丢脸？

examples.text: The tears were streaming so fast she could not see...
examples.translation: 眼泪哗哗地流下来，她的视线一下子就模糊了。

examples.text: The deal seems so attractive it would be ridiculous to say no...
examples.translation: 这笔交易看上去太诱人了，要是拒绝它简直是笑话。

examples.text: Frescoes are so familiar a feature of Italian churches that it is easy to take them for granted...
examples.translation: 壁画在意大利教堂里是司空见惯的，以至于人们往往会视而不见。

examples.text: He's not so daft as to listen to rumours.
examples.translation: 他没那么蠢，不会听信谣言的。

examples.text: ...the Government's policies on such important issues as health, education, tax and so on...
examples.translation: 政府在卫生、教育、税收等等重大问题上的政策

examples.text: The patient can have apples, apple juice, apple sauce, and so forth.
examples.translation: 病人可以食用苹果、苹果汁、苹果酱等。

examples.text: There is only so much time in the day for answering letters...
examples.translation: 白天回复信件的时间只有这么多。

examples.text: There is only so much fuel in the tank and if you burn it up too quickly you are in trouble...
examples.translation: 油箱里面的油只有这么多了，你要是太快把油耗光可就麻烦了。

examples.text: Even the greatest city can support only so many lawyers.
examples.translation: 即使最大的城市能养活的律师也只有这么多。

examples.text: I did not really object to Will's behaviour so much as his personality...
examples.translation: 我与其说是反感威尔的行为，不如说是讨厌他的为人。

examples.text: A good birth depends not so much on who you are but where you are and how much you know.
examples.translation: 好的出身与其说是取决于你的身份，还不如说是取决于你的生活环境和知识水平。

examples.text: Though rates are heading down, they still offer real returns of 8% or so...
examples.translation: 尽管利率在下降，它们仍然能提供 8%左右的实际收益率。

examples.text: Matt got me a room there for a week or so when I first came here...
examples.translation: 我初次来到这里的时候，马特找了个房间让我住了大约一个星期。

examples.text: The driver usually spends four hours or so helping to load and prepare his lorry.
examples.translation: 司机通常花 4 小时左右的时间帮忙装货和打理货车。

meanings.meaning: 聪明的；巧妙的；敏捷的；厉害的；潇洒的；剧烈的；时髦的

examples.text: He was smart and well groomed but not good looking...
examples.translation: 他仪容整洁，穿戴漂亮，就是人长得不好看。

examples.text: I was dressed in a smart navy blue suit.
examples.translation: 我身穿一套帅气的藏青色西服。

examples.text: ...smart new offices.
examples.translation: 整洁的新办公室

examples.text: He dressed very smartly which was important in those days.
examples.translation: 他衣冠楚楚——这一点在那个时候很重要。

examples.text: ...a smartly-painted door.
examples.translation: 漆刷一新的门

examples.text: The jumper strikes the perfect balance between comfort and smartness.
examples.translation: 这件套头毛衣又舒服又漂亮。

examples.text: He thinks he's smarter than Sarah is...
examples.translation: 他认为自己比萨拉聪明。

examples.text: Buying expensive furniture is not necessarily the smartest move to make.
examples.translation: 购买昂贵的家具不见得就是最明智之举。

examples.text: ...smart London dinner parties.
examples.translation: 气派不凡的伦敦晚宴

examples.text: ...a smart residential district.
examples.translation: 豪华的住宅区

examples.text: My eyes smarted from the smoke.
examples.translation: 我的眼睛被烟薰得很疼。

examples.text: The Americans were still smarting from their defeat in the Vietnam War...
examples.translation: 美国人仍然对越南战争的失败耿耿于怀。

examples.text: He is still smarting over criticism of his victorious but clumsy performance.
examples.translation: 他还在为别人批评他尽管最终胜出但表现笨拙感到闷闷不乐。

examples.text: ...Spago, favourite eating place of the Los Angeles smart set.
examples.translation: 思派古——洛杉矶的时尚富人最喜欢光顾的用餐之地

meanings.meaning: 吸收，吸入；沉浸在（工作或学习中）；使……上下湿透

examples.text: Soak the beans for 2 hours...
examples.translation: 将豆子浸泡 2 小时。

examples.text: He turned off the water and left the dishes to soak.
examples.translation: 他关上水龙头，让盘子浸泡在水中。

examples.text: The water had soaked his jacket and shirt...
examples.translation: 水浸湿了他的夹克和衬衫。

examples.text: Soak the soil around each bush with at least 4 gallons of water.
examples.translation: 用至少 4 加仑的水浸湿每株灌木周围的土。

examples.text: There was so much blood it had soaked through my boxer shorts...
examples.translation: 血流得太多，渗透了我的平脚短裤。

examples.text: Rain had soaked into the sand.
examples.translation: 雨水渗入了沙地。

examples.text: What I need is to soak in a hot tub.
examples.translation: 我需要在热腾腾的澡盆里好好地泡一泡。

examples.text: I was having a long soak in the bath.
examples.translation: 我在浴缸里泡了很长时间。

meanings.meaning: 将肥皂涂在……上；对……拍马屁（俚语）

examples.text: ...a bar of lavender soap.
examples.translation: 一块薰衣草香皂

examples.text: ...a large packet of soap powder.
examples.translation: 一大盒肥皂粉

examples.text: ...a soap bubble.
examples.translation: 肥皂泡

examples.text: She soaped herself all over.
examples.translation: 她把全身涂满肥皂。

examples.text: Insurance claims are expected to soar...
examples.translation: 预计保险索赔数量会急剧增加。

examples.text: Shares soared on the stock exchange...
examples.translation: 股市的股票价格暴涨。

examples.text: ...figures showed customer complaints had soared to record levels and profits were falling.
examples.translation: 有数字表明，顾客投诉已经达到历史最高水平，利润正在下降。

examples.text: The temperature in the south will soar into the hundreds.
examples.translation: 南方的温度会上升到一百多度。

examples.text: ...soaring unemployment.
examples.translation: 急剧上升的失业率

examples.text: If you're lucky, a splendid golden eagle may soar into view...
examples.translation: 幸运的话，会有一只光彩夺目的金雕飞入你的视野。

examples.text: Buzzards soar overhead at a great height...
examples.translation: 秃鹰在高空翱翔。

examples.text: The two sheets of flame clashed, soaring hundreds of feet high.
examples.translation: 两片火焰化作一处，腾起了几百英尺高的烈焰。

examples.text: The steeple soars skyward.
examples.translation: 尖顶高高耸立。

examples.text: ...the soaring spires of churches like St Peter's.
examples.translation: 如圣彼得教堂一样高耸入云的尖塔

examples.text: The music soared to the rafters, carrying its listeners' hearts...
examples.translation: 音乐响彻屋宇，震撼人心。

examples.text: His soaring voice cuts straight to the heart.
examples.translation: 他那高昂的声音洞彻心扉。

examples.text: For the first time in months, my spirits soared.
examples.translation: 几个月来，我的情绪第一次高涨起来。

meanings.meaning: 啜泣，呜咽；（风等）发出呜咽声

examples.text: She began to sob again, burying her face in the pillow...
examples.translation: 她把脸埋在枕头里，又开始抽噎起来。

examples.text: Her sister broke down, sobbing into her handkerchief.
examples.translation: 她姐姐再也控制不住自己的情绪，捂着手绢呜咽起来。

examples.text: The room was silent except for her sobbing.
examples.translation: 房间里静悄悄的，只有她的啜泣声。

examples.text: 'Everything's my fault,' she sobbed.
examples.translation: 她呜咽着说：“一切都是我的错。”

examples.text: When Dad was sober he was a good father.
examples.translation: 不喝醉的时候，爸爸是一个好父亲。

examples.text: We are now far more sober and realistic...
examples.translation: 我们现在清醒、现实多了。

examples.text: It was a room filled with sad, sober faces...
examples.translation: 房间里坐满了人，大家都一脸的忧伤和严肃。

examples.text: The euphoria is giving way to a more sober assessment of the situation.
examples.translation: 兴高采烈的情绪不见了，取而代之的是对局面更为清醒的认识。

examples.text: 'There's a new development,' he said soberly.
examples.translation: 他表情严肃地说：“又有了新情况。”

examples.text: He dresses in sober grey suits.
examples.translation: 他总是穿素净的灰西服。

examples.text: ...sober-suited middle-aged men.
examples.translation: 衣着素淡的中年男子

examples.text: She saw Ellis, soberly dressed in a well-cut dark suit.
examples.translation: 她看见了埃利斯，他穿着一身裁剪合体的素净的黑西装。

examples.text: These are the facts that explode their so-called economic miracle...
examples.translation: 这些就是用来粉碎他们所谓的经济奇迹的事实。

examples.text: More and more companies have gone 'green' and started producing so-called environmentally-friendly products.
examples.translation: 越来越多的公司变得“环保”起来，开始生产所谓的环境友好型产品。

examples.text: ...a summit of the world's seven leading market economies, the so-called G-7...
examples.translation: 世界七大市场经济国家，即所谓的“七国集团”召开的一次峰会

examples.text: She was one of the so-called Gang of Four.
examples.translation: 她是所谓的“四人帮”之一。

examples.text: And when the clock ran out, the Rapids were the best team in American soccer.

meanings.meaning: 社交的；好交际的；友善的

examples.text: She was, and remained, extremely sociable, enjoying dancing, golf, tennis, skating and bicycling...
examples.translation: 她从过去到现在一直非常热衷于交际，喜欢跳舞、打高尔夫球、打网球、溜冰、骑自行车。

examples.text: Some children have more sociable personalities than others.
examples.translation: 有些孩子比其他孩子更善于交际。

examples.text: Some of us are sensitive to smells, others find colours easier to remember.
examples.translation: 我们当中的一些人对气味很敏感，而其他一些人则更容易记住颜色。

examples.text: Shivering tourists had congregated in the only open bar in town. Some, desperate for the sun, headed down to Lisbon, while the rest of us decided to sample the sea air of Biarritz...
examples.translation: 瑟瑟发抖的游客们聚集在城里唯一一家还在营业的酒吧里。有些想晒太阳的，便动身去了里斯本，而我们其余的人决定去体验一下比亚里茨的海风。

examples.text: When the chicken is cooked I'll freeze some.
examples.translation: 鸡肉做好以后，我会把一部分冷冻起来。

examples.text: If you are worried about some aspect of your child's health, call us...
examples.translation: 如果你担心孩子某方面的健康问题，请给我们打电话。

examples.text: Jim Partridge chucked himself off some bridge or other...
examples.translation: 吉姆·帕特里奇从某座桥上跳了下去。

examples.text: She always thinks some guy is going to come along and fix her life.
examples.translation: 她总是认为，会有某个男人来到她的身边，把她的生活安排得井井有条。

examples.text: I have kept birds for some 30 years...
examples.translation: 我养鸟大约有 30 年了。

examples.text: He waited some 80 to 100 yards from the big pink villa...
examples.translation: 他在距离那座粉红色的大别墅约 80 到 100 码的地方等候着。

examples.text: The headquarters is some 30 miles due west.
examples.translation: 总部位于正西大约 30 英里处。

examples.text: If Susanne is off somewhere, I'll kill time by looking around some...
examples.translation: 如果苏珊不在，我就随便看看打发时间好了。

examples.text: 'I party some,' said Jed...
examples.translation: 杰德说：“我有时会去参加聚会。”

examples.text: He decided we should spend Christmas in Acapulco. There we could ski some and relax.
examples.translation: 他作出了决定：我们会到阿卡普尔科过圣诞节。在那里我们可以滑滑雪，休息休息。

examples.text: She lived to be ninety-nine years old and only weighed eighty pounds but she'd raised eight kids. That was some tough woman!...
examples.translation: 她活到了 99 岁的高龄，体重虽然只有 80 磅，却养了 8 个孩子。真是个了不得的女人！

examples.text: 'Some party!'—'Yep. One hell of a party.'
examples.translation: “这算是哪门子的聚会！”——“就是，简直是一塌糊涂。”

examples.text: Is he somebody the government could think about doing business with in the future?

meanings.meaning: 以某种方法；莫名其妙地

examples.text: We'll manage somehow, you and me. I know we will...
examples.translation: 我和你，我们总能应付过去的。我知道我们会的。

examples.text: Channel 4 arrived and somehow created a different role for television...
examples.translation: 第四频道开播了，它在某种程度上为电视创造了一个不同的角色。

examples.text: Somehow Karin managed to cope with the demands of her career...
examples.translation: 卡琳设法达到了其职业的要求。

examples.text: Somehow I knew he would tell me the truth...
examples.translation: 不知何故，我总觉得他会把真相告诉我的。

examples.text: He's been very quiet and withdrawn, sort of different, somehow...
examples.translation: 不知什么缘故，他最近十分沉默，有点异样。

examples.text: This city is somehow different.
examples.translation: 这座城市好像有些不一样了。

examples.text: Her father was shot by someone trying to rob his small retail store...
examples.translation: 她的父亲被企图抢劫他那间小零售店的人开枪打死了。

examples.text: I need someone to help me...
examples.translation: 我需要有人帮忙。

examples.text: She fell in love with someone and ran off with him...
examples.translation: 她爱上了一个人，和那人私奔了。

examples.text: If somebody asks me how my diet is going, I say, 'Fine'...
examples.translation: 要是有人问我节食进行得如何，我就说：“蛮好的”。

examples.text: He noticed a huge crowd gathered outside—someone really famous must be staying there...
examples.translation: 他注意到外面聚集了乌压压一大群人——一定是有某位大名人在那里。

examples.text: She was tired of him and wanted to leave him, perhaps to marry somebody else.
examples.translation: 她已经厌倦了他，打算离开他，也许嫁给别的什么人。

examples.text: He was somebody in the law division...
examples.translation: 他在法律部门是个人物。

examples.text: 'Before she came around,' she says, 'I was somebody in this town'.
examples.translation: “她来之前，”她说道，“我在这个镇上也算得上个人物了。”

meanings.meaning: 重要的人；值得重视的事

examples.text: He realized right away that there was something wrong...
examples.translation: 他马上意识到什么地方出了问题。

examples.text: There was something vaguely familiar about him...
examples.translation: 他身上有着某种似曾相识的东西。

examples.text: The garden was something special...
examples.translation: 这个花园很特别。

examples.text: 'You said there was something you wanted to ask me,' he said politely...
examples.translation: “您说过有事要问我，”他彬彬有礼地说。

examples.text: There was something in her attitude that bothered him...
examples.translation: 她的态度里有某种东西让他感到不安。

examples.text: People are always out in their cars, watching television or busy doing something else.
examples.translation: 人们总是驾车外出，或者看电视，再不就是忙点其他什么事情。

examples.text: He described the smell as something between a circus and a seaport...
examples.translation: 他形容那种气味介于马戏团和海港的味道之间。

examples.text: Clive made a noise, something like a grunt...
examples.translation: 克莱夫发出一种声响，像是咕哝了一句。

examples.text: There was something around a thousand dollars in the office strong box...
examples.translation: 办公室的保险柜里大约有 1,000 美元。

examples.text: Their membership seems to have risen to something over 10,000.
examples.translation: 他们的会员似乎已经增加到约 1 万名以上。

examples.text: You're really something...
examples.translation: 你真了不起。

examples.text: The doors here are really something, all made of good wood like mahogany...
examples.translation: 这些门真是极品，全部由红木一类的优质木材加工而成。

examples.text: This is really something. Someone actually thinks my records are all right!
examples.translation: 太棒了，有人真的认为我的唱片不错呢!

examples.text: Well, at least he was in town. That was something...
examples.translation: 好啦，至少他在城里，还算幸运。

examples.text: Well, you're staying. That's something I suppose.
examples.translation: 啊，你准备留下来了。我想这算是能够聊以自慰吧。

examples.text: The city proved to be something of a disappointment...
examples.translation: 结果这座城市有点儿令人失望。

examples.text: She received something of a surprise when Robert said that he was coming to New York...
examples.translation: 当罗伯特说他就要来纽约的时候，她有点吃惊。

examples.text: He is something of a fighter, and will certainly want to win.
examples.translation: 他可谓是一个斗士，当然想赢。

examples.text: Christianity has stood the test of time, so there must be something in it...
examples.translation: 基督教经受住了时间的考验，因此其中一定是有些道理的。

examples.text: There had been something in Des's first statement...
examples.translation: 德斯最初的陈述有些道理。

examples.text: Could there be something in what he said?
examples.translation: 他的话会不会有些道理呢？

examples.text: This guy, his name was Briarly or Beardly or something...
examples.translation: 这个家伙叫布赖厄利、比尔德利或什么类似的名字。

examples.text: The air fare was about a hundred and ninety-nine pounds or something like that.
examples.translation: 机票 199 英镑左右，大概是这个价钱。

examples.text: The sales figures won't be released until sometime next month...
examples.translation: 下个月的某个时间才会公布销售数据。

examples.text: Why don't you come and see me sometime?...
examples.translation: 为什么不找个时间来看看我？

examples.text: I'm aiming to get to work by nine sometime...
examples.translation: 我准备 9 点左右开始工作。

examples.text: I really want to go to Spain sometime.
examples.translation: 我真的很想找个时间去趟西班牙。

examples.text: Cecile was in her early thirties, a sometime actress, dancer and singer.
examples.translation: 塞茜尔三十出头，曾经做过演员、舞蹈演员和歌手。

examples.text: During the summer, my skin sometimes gets greasy...
examples.translation: 夏天我的皮肤有时候会出油。

examples.text: Sometimes I think he dislikes me...
examples.translation: 有时候，我觉得他不喜欢我。

examples.text: You must have noticed how tired he sometimes looks...
examples.translation: 你一定注意到他有时候显得特别疲惫。

examples.text: Other people's jobs were exactly the same—sometimes good, sometimes bad.
examples.translation: 其他人的工作也一样——时好时坏。

examples.text: He concluded that Oswald was somewhat abnormal...
examples.translation: 他断定奥斯瓦尔德有点不正常。

examples.text: He explained somewhat unconvincingly that the company was paying for everything...
examples.translation: 他解释说公司会支付一切费用，这个说法有点令人不能信服。

examples.text: Although his relationship with his mother had improved somewhat, he was still depressed...
examples.translation: 尽管和母亲的关系有所改观，他仍然十分消沉。

examples.text: 'I believe you know him'—'Somewhat.'
examples.translation: “我相信你认识他。”——“算是吧。”

examples.text: I've got a feeling I've seen him before somewhere...
examples.translation: 我有种感觉——我以前曾在哪里见过他。

examples.text: I'm not going home yet. I have to go somewhere else first...
examples.translation: 我还不准备回家，我要先去别的地方。

examples.text: 'Perhaps we can talk somewhere privately,' said Kesler...
examples.translation: “也许我们可以找个地方私下谈谈，”凯斯勒说道。

examples.text: Somewhere in Ian's room were some of the letters that she had sent him...
examples.translation: 在伊恩房间里的某个地方，有她写给他的一部分信件。

examples.text: Don't I know you from somewhere?...
examples.translation: 我不是在什么地方跟你打过照面吧？

examples.text: I needed somewhere to live in London.
examples.translation: 我需要在伦敦有个住的地方。

examples.text: The Queen is believed to earn somewhere between seven million and one hundred million pounds...
examples.translation: 据说女王的收入大约在 700 万至 1 亿英镑之间。

examples.text: Caray is somewhere between 73 and 80 years of age...
examples.translation: 卡瑞的年纪在 73 到 80 岁之间。

examples.text: The W.H.O. safety standard for ozone levels is somewhere about a hundred...
examples.translation: 世界卫生组织关于臭氧层的安全标准约为 100。

examples.text: He's American-bred, with a sort of Irish background somewhere along the line.
examples.translation: 他出生在美国，家族的血统里有一部分爱尔兰血统。

examples.text: At last they were agreeing, at last they were getting somewhere...
examples.translation: 他们最终逐渐达成共识，终于取得了一些进展。

examples.text: This time it looks as if we're really going to get somewhere.
examples.translation: 这一次，我们似乎真的要取得进展了。

meanings.meaning: 儿子；孩子（对年轻人的称呼）；男性后裔
(Son)人名；(土、老、柬)松；(法、罗)索恩；(日)存(名)；(日)孙(姓)；(越)山

examples.text: He shared a pizza with his son Laurence...
examples.translation: 他和儿子劳伦斯分吃了一张比萨饼。

examples.text: Sam is the seven-year-old son of Eric Davies...
examples.translation: 萨姆是埃里克·戴维斯 7 岁的儿子。

examples.text: They have a son.
examples.translation: 他们有一个儿子。

examples.text: ...New Orleans's most famous son, Louis Armstrong.
examples.translation: 新奥尔良最著名的人物——路易斯·阿姆斯特朗

examples.text: ...sons of Africa.
examples.translation: 非洲之子

examples.text: Don't be frightened by failure, son.
examples.translation: 孩子，不要害怕失败。

meanings.meaning: (Song)人名；(泰)颂；(柬)松；(英)桑；(老)宋；(越)双；(东南亚国家华语)松

examples.text: ...a voice singing a Spanish song.
examples.translation: 正在演唱一首西班牙歌曲的声音

examples.text: ...a love song.
examples.translation: 情歌

examples.text: ...dance, music, mime and song.
examples.translation: 舞蹈、音乐、哑剧以及歌唱

examples.text: ...the history of American popular song.
examples.translation: 美国流行音乐史

examples.text: It's been a long time since I heard a blackbird's song in the evening.
examples.translation: 我很久没有听见乌鸫的夜鸣了。

examples.text: I feel as if I should break into song.
examples.translation: 我觉得自己应该放声歌唱。

examples.text: We found two second-hand chairs that were going for a song.
examples.translation: 我们发现了两把准备低价出售的二手椅子。

examples.text: Ward is not the most consistent of players, but when he is on song he looks a world-beater.
examples.translation: 沃德并不是发挥最稳定的球员，可是一旦进入状态，他似乎就是天下无敌的王者。

meanings.meaning: 快；不久，一会儿；立刻；宁愿

examples.text: You'll be hearing from us very soon...
examples.translation: 你很快就会收到我们的来信。

examples.text: This chance has come sooner than I expected...
examples.translation: 这个机会来得比我预想的要快。

examples.text: You'll find out soon enough...
examples.translation: 你很快就会搞清楚的。

examples.text: The plane was returning to the airport soon after takeoff when it burst into flames...
examples.translation: 飞机起飞之后不久便起火，于是掉头返回机场。

examples.text: Soon afterwards he separated from his wife.
examples.translation: 不久以后，他和妻子分居了。

examples.text: As soon as relations improve they will be allowed to go...
examples.translation: 一旦关系有所改善，他们就可以获准离开。

examples.text: You'll never guess what happened as soon as I left my room.
examples.translation: 你怎么也猜不出我一离开房间就发生了什么事。

examples.text: These people could afford to retire to Florida but they'd just as soon stay put...
examples.translation: 这些人有足够的钱可以去佛罗里达安度退休生活，可是他们却宁愿留在原来的地方。

examples.text: I'd just as soon not have to make this public...
examples.translation: 我宁愿不必将此事公之于众。

examples.text: I'd just as soon you put that thing away...
examples.translation: 我宁可你把那玩意收起来。

examples.text: She'd just as soon throw your plate in your face as serve you.
examples.translation: 她宁可把盘子砸到你脸上也不愿伺候你。

meanings.meaning: 复杂的；精致的；久经世故的；富有经验的
使变得世故；使迷惑；篡改（sophisticate的过去分词形式）

examples.text: Honeybees use one of the most sophisticated communication systems of any insect.
examples.translation: 蜜蜂之间所用的交流方式是昆虫中最为复杂的方式之一。

examples.text: ...a large and sophisticated new British telescope.
examples.translation: 一架崭新的大型英式精密望远镜

examples.text: Claude was a charming, sophisticated companion...
examples.translation: 克劳德是一个很有魅力、见多识广的伙伴。

examples.text: Recently her tastes have become more sophisticated.
examples.translation: 最近她的品位越发优雅时髦起来。

examples.text: These people are very sophisticated observers of the foreign policy scene.
examples.translation: 这些人是观察外交政策领域动向的行家里手。

meanings.meaning: 大学二年级生；（美）有二年经验的人
二年级的；二年级学生的

examples.text: The multi-awarded performer has resumed studies as a sophomore at Fordham, New York's Jesuit university.

meanings.meaning: 疼痛的，痛心的；剧烈的，极度的；恼火的，发怒的；厉害的，迫切的

examples.text: It's years since I've had a sore throat like I did last night...
examples.translation: 我的喉咙已经好几年没有像昨晚那样疼了。

examples.text: My chest is still sore from the surgery.
examples.translation: 手术过后我的胸口还在作痛。

examples.text: The soreness lasted for about six weeks.
examples.translation: 这种疼痛持续了大约 6 周时间。

examples.text: The result is that they are now all feeling very sore at you...
examples.translation: 结果就是，现在他们都对你感到十分恼火。

examples.text: They are sore about losing to England in the quarter-finals.
examples.translation: 他们对在四分之一决赛里输给英格兰队这件事感到非常懊恼。

examples.text: The continuing presence of American troops on Korean soil remains a very sore point with these students.
examples.translation: 美国军队继续驻扎在韩国领土上这一事实仍然让这些学生深感气愤。

examples.text: It was a time of great sorrow...
examples.translation: 这是一个非常悲伤的时刻。

examples.text: Words cannot express my sorrow.
examples.translation: 言语无法表达我的哀伤。

meanings.meaning: 遗憾的；对不起的，抱歉的
对不起，抱歉（表示委婉的拒绝等）

examples.text: 'We're all talking at the same time.' — 'Yeah. Sorry.'...
examples.translation: “我们俩在同时讲话。”——“噢，抱歉。”

examples.text: Sorry I took so long...
examples.translation: 我耽误了这么长时间，真是对不起。

examples.text: Sorry for barging in like this...
examples.translation: 这么冒失地闯了进来，真是抱歉。

examples.text: I'm really sorry if I said anything wrong...
examples.translation: 如果我说错了什么，那真的十分抱歉。

examples.text: I'm sorry to call so late, but I need a favour...
examples.translation: 这么晚打电话真是抱歉，可是我需要帮个忙。

examples.text: The next morning she came into my room and said she was sorry.
examples.translation: 第二天早晨，她来我的房间向我道了歉。

examples.text: She was very sorry about all the trouble she'd caused...
examples.translation: 她为自己引起了那么多麻烦而感到非常抱歉。

examples.text: I'm sorry about what's happened...
examples.translation: 我为所发生的事情感到遗憾。

examples.text: I'm sorry he's gone...
examples.translation: 我为他的离去感到惋惜。

examples.text: He was sorry to see them go.
examples.translation: 看到他们离去，他十分难过。

examples.text: No, I'm sorry, I can't agree with you...
examples.translation: 不，很抱歉，我不同意你的看法。

examples.text: 'I'm sorry,' he told the real estate agent, 'but we really must go now.'...
examples.translation: “对不起，”他对房地产代理人说，“但现在我们真的必须走了。”

examples.text: I'm sorry, but Miss Lee is resting and can't be disturbed...
examples.translation: 抱歉，李小姐正在休息，不能打扰。

examples.text: Sorry — no baths after ten o'clock...
examples.translation: 抱歉，10 点以后没有洗澡水。

examples.text: I'm sorry to have to tell you that Janet West is dead.
examples.translation: 很遗憾，我不得不告诉您，珍妮特·韦斯特已经不在人世。

examples.text: I'll tell Daddy, and then you'll be sorry because he'll give you another black eye...
examples.translation: 我会告诉爸爸，到时候有你好受的，因为爸爸会再揍你一顿。

examples.text: Get back in there, or you'll be sorry.
examples.translation: 滚回那边去，否则你会后悔的。

examples.text: I've only done half of it, I'm sorry to say...
examples.translation: 很遗憾，我只完成了一半。

examples.text: This, I am sorry to say, is almost entirely wishful thinking.
examples.translation: 我很遗憾，这几乎完全是一厢情愿的想法。

examples.text: I've heard about Mollie — I'm so sorry...
examples.translation: 我已经听说了莫莉的事情——我很难过。

examples.text: 'I'm afraid he's ill.' — 'I'm sorry to hear that.'
examples.translation: “恐怕他生病了。”——“真是遗憾。”

examples.text: I felt sorry for him and his colleagues — it must have been so frustrating for them...
examples.translation: 我为他和他的同事们感到难过——这件事一定让他们感到非常沮丧。

examples.text: I am very sorry for the family.
examples.translation: 我十分同情这家人。

examples.text: What he must not do is to sit around at home feeling sorry for himself.
examples.translation: 他万万不可宅在家里自艾自怜。

examples.text: Barcelona will be hoping to bring the trophy back to Spain — sorry, Catalonia — for the first time.
examples.translation: 巴塞罗那将有望首次把奖杯捧回西班牙——抱歉，是捧回加泰罗尼亚。

examples.text: ...refugees (sorry, economic migrants) who refuse to return to Vietnam.
examples.translation: 拒绝回到越南的难民(抱歉，应该说是经济移民)

examples.text: The fire left Kuwait's oil industry in a sorry state...
examples.translation: 这场大火使科威特的石油产业陷入悲惨的境地。

examples.text: She is a sorry sight...
examples.translation: 她的样子看上去糟透了。

examples.text: They were a sorry lot.
examples.translation: 他们是一群可怜的家伙。

examples.text: ...home-made chicken soup.
examples.translation: 家常的鸡汤

examples.text: She has a knack of landing herself right in the soup.
examples.translation: 她老是让自己的处境很尴尬。

examples.text: ...a souped-up Peugeot 205.
examples.translation: 改装过的标致 205 型汽车

examples.text: ...a souped-up version of the theme from 'The Generation Game'.
examples.translation: 主题取自《世代游戏》的加强版本

examples.text: She went to pray for the soul of her late husband...
examples.translation: 她去为亡夫的灵魂祈祷。

examples.text: 'I will put my heart and soul into the job,' he promises.
examples.translation: “我会全身心投入到工作中去，”他保证说。

examples.text: ...a struggle for the soul of the Republican Party.
examples.translation: 为实现共和党的基本宗旨而进行的奋斗

examples.text: He's a jolly soul...
examples.translation: 他是个乐天派。

examples.text: Her mother, poor soul, came to an even worse end.
examples.translation: 她的母亲，那个可怜的人，结局更糟糕。

examples.text: I've never harmed a soul in my life...
examples.translation: 我这一生从未伤害过任何人。

examples.text: There was not a soul there.
examples.translation: 那里一个人也没有。

examples.text: ...American soul singer Anita Baker.
examples.translation: 美国灵乐歌手安妮塔·贝克

examples.text: ...a tiny village of only 100 souls.
examples.translation: 一个只有 100 位居民的小村庄

examples.text: ...politicians who would sell their soul for the sake of office.
examples.translation: 为了谋求官位而不择手段的政客

meanings.meaning: 听（诊）；测量，测…深；使发声；试探；宣告
声音，语音；噪音；海峡；吵闹；听力范围；[医] 探条
健全的，健康的；合理的；可靠的；有效彻底的
听起来；发出声音；回响；测深

examples.text: Peter heard the sound of gunfire...
examples.translation: 彼德听见了枪炮声。

examples.text: Liza was so frightened she couldn't make a sound...
examples.translation: 莉莎实在吓坏了，不敢弄出一点声音来。

examples.text: There was a splintering sound as the railing gave way.
examples.translation: 围栏倒下时发出了断裂的声音。

examples.text: ...the sounds of children playing.
examples.translation: 孩子们的嬉闹声

examples.text: The aeroplane will travel at twice the speed of sound.
examples.translation: 这架飞机的速度将是音速的两倍。

examples.text: She went and turned the sound down...
examples.translation: 她去把音量关小了。

examples.text: Compact discs have brought about a vast improvement in recorded sound quality.
examples.translation: 激光唱片极大地提高了录音的音质。

examples.text: They have started showing a strong soul element in their sound...
examples.translation: 他们的音乐风格开始表现出一种强烈的灵乐特色。

examples.text: He's got a unique sound and a unique style.
examples.translation: 他的音乐风格独具特色。

examples.text: The buzzer sounded in Daniel's office...
examples.translation: 丹尼尔办公室里的蜂音器响了。

examples.text: A young man sounds the bell to start the Sunday service.
examples.translation: 一个年轻人鸣钟宣布周日的礼拜开始了。

examples.text: The Archbishop of Canterbury has sounded a warning to Europe's leaders on third world debt...
examples.translation: 坎特伯雷大主教就第三世界的债务问题向欧洲的领导人发出了警告。

examples.text: Others consider the move premature and have sounded a note of caution...
examples.translation: 其他人认为采取这个行动为时尚早，对此提出了警告。

examples.text: Sir Patrick attempted to sound a positive note, describing the meeting as serving a useful purpose.
examples.translation: 帕特里克爵士极力释放出一种积极的论调，称此次会议是很有用的。

examples.text: They heard what sounded like a huge explosion...
examples.translation: 他们听见一声爆炸般的巨响。

examples.text: The creaking of the hinges sounded very loud in that silence...
examples.translation: 在那片寂静之中，铰链吱吱嘎嘎的声音听起来很响。

examples.text: It sounded as if he were trying to say something.
examples.translation: 听上去他好像试图要说些什么。

examples.text: She sounded a bit worried...
examples.translation: 她的语气里有一点担心。

examples.text: Murphy sounds like a child...
examples.translation: 墨菲的口气像个孩子。

examples.text: She sounded as if she really cared...
examples.translation: 听起来她似乎真的很在乎。

examples.text: I thought she sounded a genuinely caring and helpful person.
examples.translation: 我觉得她听起来像是一个真心真意地关爱和帮助别人的人。

examples.text: It sounds like a wonderful idea to me, does it really work?...
examples.translation: 听起来这个主意很不错，真的能行吗？

examples.text: It sounds as if they might have made a dreadful mistake...
examples.translation: 听起来他们似乎犯下了一个可怕的错误。

examples.text: She decided that her doctor's advice sounded pretty good...
examples.translation: 她认为医生的建议似乎很不错。

examples.text: The book is not as morbid as it sounds...
examples.translation: 这本书并不像听起来那么可怕。

examples.text: I know this sounds a crazy thing for me to ask you.
examples.translation: 我知道我向你提出这个问题似乎很不可理喻。

examples.text: Here's a new idea we liked the sound of...
examples.translation: 这是个新想法，我们一听就喜欢。

examples.text: I don't like the sound of Toby Osborne...
examples.translation: 我不喜欢托比·奥斯伯恩的那一套。

examples.text: From the sound of things, he might well be the same man...
examples.translation: 听起来，他似乎还是原来的那个他。

examples.text: He was being paid danger money from the sound of it.
examples.translation: 印象中他得到了危险工作津贴。

examples.text: When we bought the house, it was structurally sound...
examples.translation: 我们买下这栋房子的时候，它的结构还非常坚固。

examples.text: Although the car is basically sound, I was worried about certain areas...
examples.translation: 尽管这辆汽车基本状况良好，我还是担心一些地方不够安全。

examples.text: His body was still sound.
examples.translation: 他的身体仍然硬朗。

examples.text: We had taken great pains to check the structural soundness of the coachwork.
examples.translation: 我们下了很大的工夫检查汽车车身的结构是否安全。

examples.text: They are trained nutritionists who can give sound advice on diets...
examples.translation: 他们都是受过训练的营养学家，能够在饮食方面提出合理的建议。

examples.text: Buy a policy only from an insurance company that is financially sound...
examples.translation: 一定要从财务状况良好的保险公司购买保险。

examples.text: His reasoning is perfectly sound, but he misses the point...
examples.translation: 他的推理完全正确，但是未切中肯綮。

examples.text: There is sound scientific evidence of what certain gases do to the atmosphere.
examples.translation: 有可靠的科学依据可以证明某些气体对大气的影响。

examples.text: I can appreciate his humanitarian zeal; it is the soundness of his thought that I question...
examples.translation: 我能够理解他的人道主义热忱，我质疑的是他的观点是否正确。

examples.text: They have a strong record of financial soundness.
examples.translation: 他们有着极佳的财务记录，可以证明他们的财务状况良好。

examples.text: I am not sure that this is sound democratic practice...
examples.translation: 我不能肯定这是正确的民主行为。

examples.text: I think the idea of secularism is a very sound one...
examples.translation: 我认为现世主义的观点非常正确。

examples.text: Can anyone suggest a method of deterring spiders which is ecologically sound?
examples.translation: 有人能想出一种不会破坏生态环境而又能够赶跑蜘蛛的办法吗？

examples.text: She had woken me out of a sound sleep.
examples.translation: 她把我从酣睡中叫醒。

examples.text: He was lying in bed, sound asleep.
examples.translation: 他躺在床上，睡得正香。

meanings.meaning: 将…分类；将…排序；挑选出某物

examples.text: What sort of school did you go to?...
examples.translation: 你上的是哪类学校？

examples.text: There are so many different sorts of mushrooms available these days...
examples.translation: 现在可以买到许许多多不同种类的蘑菇。

examples.text: A dozen trees of various sorts were planted...
examples.translation: 一共种了12 棵不同种类的树。

examples.text: He had a nice, serious sort of smile...
examples.translation: 他的笑容亲切而严肃。

examples.text: That's just the sort of abuse that he will be investigating...
examples.translation: 他要调查的正是这一类虐待行为。

examples.text: Eddie was playing a game of some sort...
examples.translation: 埃迪正在玩一种游戏。

examples.text: It is the last time I will take on this sort of work...
examples.translation: 这将是我最后一次干这种工作了。

examples.text: Let's have some more articles of this sort.
examples.translation: 我们多收集一些这类的文章吧。

examples.text: He seemed to be just the right sort for the job...
examples.translation: 他似乎正是干这个工作的合适人选。

examples.text: She was a very vigorous sort of person...
examples.translation: 她是那种精力非常充沛的人。

examples.text: What sort of men were they?
examples.translation: 他们是什么样的人？

examples.text: He sorted the materials into their folders...
examples.translation: 他把材料分门别类放进了文件夹。

examples.text: The students are sorted into three ability groups...
examples.translation: 学生们被按照各自的能力分成了 3 个组。

examples.text: He unlatched the box and sorted through the papers...
examples.translation: 他打开盒子，把文件整理好。

examples.text: I sorted the laundry.
examples.translation: 我把要洗的衣服分了类。

examples.text: I'm trying to get my script sorted...
examples.translation: 我正努力把手稿的内容理顺。

examples.text: These problems have now been sorted.
examples.translation: 这些问题现在已经解决了。

examples.text: There are all sorts of animals, including bears, pigs, kangaroos, and penguins...
examples.translation: 有各种各样的动物，包括熊、猪、袋鼠和企鹅。

examples.text: It was used by all sorts of people...
examples.translation: 各种各样的人都使用它。

examples.text: Self-help groups of all sorts have been running for more than 20 years.
examples.translation: 各类自助团体已经创办 20 多年了。

examples.text: He made a living of sorts selling pancakes from a van...
examples.translation: 他靠用货车卖薄饼勉强度日。

examples.text: She even managed a grimacing smile of sorts...
examples.translation: 她甚至做了个怪笑。

examples.text: They have had an education of a sort.
examples.translation: 他们勉强算是读过一点儿书。

examples.text: You could even order windows from a catalogue — a sort of mail order stained glass service...
examples.translation: 你甚至可以根据目录订购窗户——可以说是一种邮购彩色玻璃的业务。

examples.text: In the end, she sort of pushed it...
examples.translation: 最后，她几乎是用了推的。

examples.text: I sort of made my own happiness.
examples.translation: 可以这么说，是我自己创造了自己的幸福。

meanings.meaning: 酸的；发酵的；刺耳的；酸臭的；讨厌的

examples.text: The stewed apple was sour even with honey.
examples.translation: 炖煮的苹果即便加了蜂蜜还是很酸。

examples.text: She made a sour face in his direction...
