examples.translation: 她冲他阴沉着脸。

examples.text: Police, weary and increasingly sour in mood, wonder aloud why the situation has been allowed to deteriorate.
examples.translation: 警察们疲惫不堪，心情也越来越糟糕，他们不禁满腹狐疑地问：为什么听凭情况不断地恶化下去？

examples.text: 'Leave my mother out of it,' he said sourly.
examples.translation: “不要把我母亲搅进去，”他没好气地说。

examples.text: Everything turned sour for me there...
examples.translation: 在那里，对我来说一切变得很不顺利。

examples.text: Even the European dream is beginning to turn sour...
examples.translation: 甚至连欧洲之梦都开始破灭了。

examples.text: Their songs are filled with tales of love gone sour.
examples.translation: 他们的歌里充斥着变了味的爱情故事。

examples.text: If anything sours the relationship, it is likely to be real differences in their world-views...
examples.translation: 如果有什么东西能够破坏这种关系的话，那可能就是他们世界观方面存在的实质性差异。

examples.text: Her mood soured a little.
examples.translation: 她的心情有点差。

examples.text: Page's response to the suggestion that this might be sour grapes because his company lost the bid is: 'Life's too short for that.'
examples.translation: 有人认为这是佩奇的酸葡萄心理在作怪，因为他的公司未能中标，佩奇对此的回应是：“人生苦短，谁有闲工夫去耿耿于怀呢？”

examples.text: The band hits cities throughout the South and Midwest on the long drive home to Seattle.
China also has commitments to rival free trade blocs in East and Southeast Asia.
The Everglades National Park stretches across the southern tip of Florida.
examples.translation: 大沼泽地国家公园位于佛罗里达州的最南端。

examples.text: ...a place where you can sample southern cuisine.
examples.translation: 可以品尝到南方美食的地方

examples.text: There also were extensive airstrikes southwest of Kandahar and near the Afghanistan-Pakistan border Thursday.
...over 40 per cent of British adults use television as their major source of information about the arts...
examples.translation: 40 %以上的英国成年人把电视当作获取艺术文化信息的主要途径。

examples.text: Renewable sources of energy must be used where practical...
examples.translation: 必须在可行的地方使用可再生能源。

examples.text: Tourism, which is a major source of income for the city, may be seriously affected.
examples.translation: 作为该市主要收入来源的旅游业可能会受到严重影响。

examples.text: Together they travel the world, sourcing clothes for the small, privately owned company...
examples.translation: 他们一道走遍世界各地，为那家私营小公司寻觅服装货源。

examples.text: About 60 per cent of an average car is sourced from outside of the manufacturer.
examples.translation: 一辆普通汽车上大约有60%的部件是由制造商以外的其他供应商提供的。

examples.text: ...furniture sourced from all over the world.
examples.translation: 来自世界各地的家具

examples.text: The union is particularly concerned at the sourcing of products abroad.
examples.translation: 该联盟尤其关注海外的产品货源。

examples.text: Military sources say the boat was heading south at high speed...
examples.translation: 军方称这艘船当时正高速向南行进。

examples.text: She quotes secondary and primary sources without distinction.
examples.translation: 她对二手资料和一手资料的引用毫无区别。

examples.text: This gave me a clue as to the source of the problem.
examples.translation: 这件事给我提供了找出问题根源的线索。

examples.text: ...the source of the Tiber.
examples.translation: 台伯河的源头

meanings.meaning: 至高无上的；有主权的；拥有最高统治权的；不折不扣的；极好的
君主；独立国；最高统治者

examples.text: Lithuania and Armenia signed a treaty in Vilnius recognising each other as independent sovereign states...
examples.translation: 立陶宛和亚美尼亚在维尔纽斯签订条约，承认彼此为独立主权国家。

examples.text: The Russian Federation declared itself to be a sovereign republic.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯联邦宣布自己为主权独立的共和国。

examples.text: Sovereign power will continue to lie with the Supreme People's Assembly.
examples.translation: 最高统治权仍然掌握在最高人民会议手中。

examples.text: In March 1889, she became the first British sovereign to set foot on Spanish soil.
examples.translation: 1889 年 3 月，她成为第一位踏上西班牙领土的英国君主。

meanings.meaning: (Sow)人名；(几、马里、乍、毛里塔、塞内)索乌

examples.text: Sow the seed in a warm place in February/March...
examples.translation: 2 月或 3 月里把种子播种在温暖的地方。

examples.text: Yesterday the field opposite was sown with maize.
examples.translation: 昨天对面的田里播种了玉米。

examples.text: He cleverly sowed doubts into the minds of his rivals...
examples.translation: 他巧妙地令对手心生疑窦。

examples.text: Instead, the session has sowed confusion.
examples.translation: 相反，这次会议却引发了混乱。

examples.text: Rich industrialised countries have sown the seeds of global warming.
examples.translation: 富庶的工业国家播下了全球变暖的种子。

examples.text: It beat out its predecessor, the ATV-1 spacecraft, by about a ton, ESA officials said.
The eponymous capsules look like the sleeping berths on a particularly traditional Japanese spaceship.
Under the plan, bits of open space — fields, golf-course borders and small parks — will be preserved.
examples.translation: 在这份规划里，一些开放空间——运动场、高尔夫球场边缘以及小公园——将得以保留。

examples.text: ...cutting down yet more trees to make space for houses...
examples.translation: 砍掉更多的树，腾出空间来盖房子

examples.text: I had plenty of space to write and sew...
examples.translation: 我有足够的空间进行写作和缝纫。

examples.text: The space underneath could be used as a storage area...
examples.translation: 底下的空间可用作储藏区。

examples.text: He looked cautiously through a half-inch space between the curtains and saw an empty bedroom...
examples.translation: 他小心翼翼地透过窗帘上的一条半英寸的缝隙望去，看见了一个空荡荡的卧室。

examples.text: The bird was enclosed in such a small space that it could not turn without bending its tail...
examples.translation: 小鸟被关在这么狭小的空间里，不弯一下尾巴的话，都转不过身来。

examples.text: List in the spaces below the specific changes you have made.
examples.translation: 在下面空白处列出你所作的具体改动。

examples.text: ...the high cost of office space...
examples.translation: 办公场所的高额成本

examples.text: You don't want your living space to look like a bedroom...
examples.translation: 你可不希望自己居住的地方看上去像个卧室。

examples.text: Finding a parking space in the summer months is still a virtual impossibility...
examples.translation: 在夏季，几乎还是不可能找到一个停车位。

examples.text: The Women's Gym is a women-only space dedicated to women of all ages, shapes and sizes.
examples.translation: 女子健身馆对各种年龄层次、体型和个头的女性开放。

examples.text: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms...
examples.translation: 大型油画可以增加小房间的宽敞感。

examples.text: The sense of space and emptiness is overwhelming.
examples.translation: 巨大的空虚感汹涌袭来。

examples.text: You need space to think everything over...
examples.translation: 你需要时间把一切好好地考虑清楚。

examples.text: We will give each other space to develop.
examples.translation: 我们会给彼此留出发展的空间。

examples.text: We can't promise to publish a reply as space is limited.
examples.translation: 由于版面有限，我们不能保证把回复登载出来。

examples.text: ...some work which we couldn't include because of lack of space in this issue.
examples.translation: 由于这期篇幅有限，我们无法收纳进来的一些文章

examples.text: They've come a long way in a short space of time...
examples.translation: 他们在很短的时间之内就大老远地赶了过来。

examples.text: I have known dramatic changes occur in the space of a few minutes with this method.
examples.translation: 我知道用这种方法短短几分钟之内就能够产生急剧的变化。

examples.text: The six astronauts on board will spend ten days in space.
examples.translation: 飞船上的6名宇航员将在太空度过 10 天。

examples.text: ...launching satellites into space.
examples.translation: 发射人造卫星进入外层空间

examples.text: ...developments in space technology.
examples.translation: 太空技术的发展

examples.text: ...outer space.
examples.translation: 外层空间

examples.text: She felt herself transcending time and space...
examples.translation: 她感到自己正在穿越时空。

examples.text: The physical universe is finite in space and time.
examples.translation: 物质世界在时间和空间上是有限的。

examples.text: Women once again are having fewer children and spacing them further apart...
examples.translation: 女人再次减少了生孩子的数量，而且生育之间相隔的时间也更长了。

examples.text: His voice was angry and he spaced the words for emphasis.
examples.translation: 他的声音里透着愤怒，为了强调，他一字一顿。

examples.text: He talks quite slowly and spaces his words out...
examples.translation: 他说得很慢，每个词之间都有停顿。

examples.text: I was spacing out the seedlings into divided trays...
examples.translation: 我正在把那些小嫩苗分装进有分格的盘子里。

examples.text: They will have time to draw breath between matches, with their last four fixtures spaced out over three weeks.
examples.translation: 由于最后的 4 场比赛间隔分布在 3 个星期里，因此他们有时间在比赛的间隙稍作休息。

examples.text: Its houses are large, well-spaced and surrounded by gardens...
examples.translation: 其房子很大、间距适当，周围全是花园。

examples.text: The RAC is calling for rest areas spaced at regular intervals on major roads.
examples.translation: 皇家汽车俱乐部呼吁：交通主干道上的休息区应均匀分布。

examples.text: Generous spacing gives healthier trees and better crops.
examples.translation: 足够大的间距能使树木和庄稼长得更茁壮。

examples.text: He just sat in the dressing-room staring into space...
examples.translation: 他直愣愣地坐在化妆间里。

examples.text: Molly turned away and gazed off into space, a faraway look in her eyes.
examples.translation: 莫莉转过脸去茫然瞪视，眼神似已飘到了远方。

examples.text: Even Sarah treated him as if he were a waste of space...
examples.translation: 连萨拉对他都像是在对待一个废物。

examples.text: Are we expected to believe those scribblings are art? This piece of trash was a waste of space.
examples.translation: 我们难道真要把那些乱涂乱画当作艺术吗？这种垃圾留着都占地方。

examples.text: Watch this space for details of our next event.
examples.translation: 请继续关注我们对下一事件的详细报道。

meanings.meaning: 宽敞的，广阔的；无边无际的

examples.text: The house has a spacious kitchen and dining area.
examples.translation: 这座房子有一个宽敞的厨房和用餐区。

examples.text: A high ceiling creates a feeling of spaciousness.
examples.translation: 高高的天花板会给人一种宽敞的感觉。

examples.text: ... a garden spade...
examples.translation: 园艺铲

examples.text: The girls happily played in the sand with buckets and spades.
examples.translation: 女孩子们拿着桶和铲子在沙滩上快活地玩耍。

examples.text: ...the ace of spades.
examples.translation: 黑桃 A

examples.text: I'm not at all secretive, and I'm pretty good at calling a spade a spade.
examples.translation: 我不会遮遮掩掩，我喜欢直言不讳。

examples.text: The batteries had a life span of six hours...
examples.translation: 这些电池的寿命为 6 小时。

examples.text: Gradually the time span between sessions will increase.
examples.translation: 会议之间的间隔将逐渐延长。

examples.text: His ability to absorb information was astonishing, but his concentration span was short...
examples.translation: 他吸收信息的能力令人吃惊，但是他的注意力持续时间很短。

examples.text: Young children have a limited attention span and can't concentrate on one activity for very long.
examples.translation: 小孩子的注意力持续时间十分有限，不能长时间地专注于一个活动。

examples.text: His professional career spanned 16 years...
examples.translation: 他的职业生涯持续了 16 年。

examples.text: The film, spanning almost a quarter-century, tells the story of Henry Hill...
examples.translation: 这部时间跨度将近四分之一世纪的影片讲述的是亨利·希尔的故事。

examples.text: Lining a corridor is a wall of photographs spanning his rugby days.
examples.translation: 走廊的一面墙上贴满了他橄榄球生涯里各个时期的照片。

examples.text: Bernstein's compositions spanned all aspects of music, from symphonies to musicals.
examples.translation: 伯恩斯坦创作的乐曲涉及了从交响乐到音乐剧等音乐的各个方面。

examples.text: ...a remarkable man whose interests spanned almost every aspect of nature.
examples.translation: 一个兴趣广泛、几乎涉猎了自然学科所有领域的杰出男性

examples.text: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span...
examples.translation: 这是一只非常美丽的蝴蝶，翼展 2 英寸。

examples.text: It may be that you are unaware of where your hip joint is; it is not at the waist but a good hand span below it.
examples.translation: 这也许是因为你并不晓得髋关节的位置，它不在腰部，而是位于腰部以下一手拃宽处。

examples.text: Travellers get from one side to the other by walking across a footbridge that spans a little stream.
examples.translation: 游客通过一座横跨小溪的步行桥从一边来到另一边。

examples.text: ...the humped iron bridge spanning the railway...
examples.translation: 横越铁路的铁拱桥

examples.text: Architects tell their clients that floors can span 100 metres without any visible means of support.
examples.translation: 建筑师告诉他们的客户，在没有任何有形支撑物的情况下，楼板可以延伸 100 米。

meanings.meaning: 节约，吝惜；饶恕；分出，分让

examples.text: If possible keep a spare pair of glasses accessible in case your main pair is broken or lost...
examples.translation: 如果有可能的话，最好准备一副备用眼镜，以防常用的那副眼镜打碎或者丢失。

examples.text: Don't forget to take a few spare batteries...
examples.translation: 别忘了带上几节备用电池。

examples.text: He could have taken a spare key...
examples.translation: 他本该带上一把备用钥匙的。

examples.text: The wagons carried spare ammunition.
examples.translation: 大货车载着备用的弹药。

examples.text: Give me the trunk key and I'll get the spare.
examples.translation: 把行李箱的钥匙给我，我去拿一下备胎。

examples.text: They don't have a lot of spare cash...
examples.translation: 他们没有多少闲钱。

examples.text: The spare bedroom is on the second floor...
examples.translation: 闲置的卧室在三楼。

examples.text: There was hardly a spare inch of space to be found.
examples.translation: 几乎找不到一丁点空余的地方。

examples.text: You got here with ninety seconds to spare...
examples.translation: 你到这里的时候还剩 90 秒钟时间。

examples.text: It's not as if he has money to spare...
examples.translation: 他又不是有什么余钱。

examples.text: The car suddenly darted ahead, squeezing past him with only inches to spare...
examples.translation: 那辆车突然向前疾驶而去，从他身边擦身而过。

examples.text: Miranda has drive and energy to spare and has now taken on an even bigger challenge.
examples.translation: 米兰达有使不完的干劲和精力，现在已经接受了一个更大的挑战。

examples.text: She said that she could only spare 35 minutes for our meeting...
examples.translation: 她说她只能抽出 35 分钟时间参加我们的会议。

examples.text: He's a very busy man, and it's good of him to spare the time to visit...
examples.translation: 他是个大忙人，能抽出时间到访真是太好了。

examples.text: He suggested that his country could not spare the troops for such an operation.
examples.translation: 他暗示说他的国家无法抽调军队参与这样的行动。

examples.text: We have lost everything, but thank God, our lives have been spared...
examples.translation: 我们已经失去了一切，不过谢天谢地，总算是保住了性命。

examples.text: Not a man was spared...
examples.translation: 无人得以幸免。

examples.text: Northern Somalia was largely spared from the famine.
examples.translation: 索马里北部的大部分地区逃过了这场饥荒。

examples.text: I wanted to spare Frances the embarrassment of discussing this subject...
examples.translation: 讨论这个话题太尴尬，我不想让弗朗西斯难堪。

examples.text: Prisoners are spared the indignity of wearing uniforms...
examples.translation: 囚犯们不必忍受身穿囚服的侮辱。

examples.text: Spare me the gory details...
examples.translation: 别给我讲那些骇人听闻的细节了。

examples.text: She's just trying to spare Shawna's feelings...
examples.translation: 她只是想尽量不让肖娜难过。

examples.text: The policy has not spared the farming community from severe financial pressure.
examples.translation: 这项政策并没有使农村社会逃脱沉重的经济压力。

examples.text: She was thin and spare, with a sharply intelligent face.
examples.translation: 她又高又瘦，一副精明过人的模样。

examples.text: Inside, the two small rooms were spare and neat, stripped bare of ornaments.
examples.translation: 进去以后是两个简单而整洁的小房间，朴实无华，没有什么装饰。

examples.text: The government is determined to spare no effort in investigating this case thoroughly...
examples.translation: 政府决定不遗余力地彻底调查这个案子。

examples.text: Officials say they'll spare no expense to prevent another riot.
examples.translation: 官员说他们会不惜一切地阻止再次发生暴乱。

examples.text: Spare a thought for the nation's shopkeepers — consumer sales slid again in May...
examples.translation: 可怜一下这个国家的店老板吧—— 5 月份消费品的销售量又下滑了。

examples.text: I do not think any of us spared a thought for the ordeal of her crew.
examples.translation: 我不认为我们中间有任何一个人同情过这艘船的船员所遭受的磨难。

examples.text: The fire gradually got bigger and bigger. Sparks flew off in all directions.
examples.translation: 火越燃越烈，火星四溅。

examples.text: He passed an electric spark through a mixture of gases.
examples.translation: 他让一束电火花穿过了一团混合气体。

examples.text: The wires were sparking above me...
examples.translation: 电线在我头顶上方冒着火花。

examples.text: I stared into the flames of the fire as it sparked to life.
examples.translation: 火光在闪烁，我注视着熊熊燃烧的烈焰。

examples.text: A dropped cigarette may have sparked the fire.
examples.translation: 可能是丢弃的烟头导致了这场大火。

examples.text: His music lacked that vital spark of imagination...
examples.translation: 他的音乐缺少非常关键的那一点灵感。

examples.text: Even Oliver felt a tiny spark of excitement.
examples.translation: 连奥利弗都感到一丝兴奋。

examples.text: What was it that sparked your interest in motoring?
examples.translation: 是什么让你对开车产生了兴趣？

examples.text: The proposals are expected to spark heated debate.
examples.translation: 这些提议估计会引起激烈的争论。

examples.text: ...a row sparked by a comment about his sister.
examples.translation: 由对他姐姐的一句评价引发的争吵

examples.text: That incident sparked it off...
examples.translation: 那次事件引发了这件事。

examples.text: His book, Animal Liberation, sparked off a revolution in the way we think about animals.
examples.translation: 他的著作《动物解放》引发了一场关于我们该如何看待动物的思想革命。

examples.text: ...a political crisis sparked off by religious violence.
examples.translation: 宗教暴力触发的政治危机

examples.text: They are not afraid to tackle the issues or let the sparks fly when necessary.
examples.translation: 他们不怕应对这些问题，也不怕必要时来一番激烈的争论。

examples.text: The jewels on her fingers sparkled...
examples.translation: 她手指上戴的首饰闪闪发光。

examples.text: His bright eyes sparkled.
examples.translation: 他一双明眸炯炯发光。

examples.text: ...the sparkling blue waters of the ocean.
examples.translation: 波光粼粼的蓝色海洋

examples.text: ...the sparkle of coloured glass.
examples.translation: 有色玻璃的闪光

examples.text: ...sparkles of light...
examples.translation: 光亮点

examples.text: There was a sparkle in her eye that could not be hidden.
examples.translation: 她眼中闪烁着一丝无法掩藏的亮光。

examples.text: She sparkles, and has as much zest as a person half her age...
examples.translation: 她才华横溢，而且像只有她一半岁数的年轻人一样充满热情。

examples.text: They'd been a dejected lot when he'd arrived at the shipyard, but now they sparkled with enthusiasm.
examples.translation: 他刚到船厂时，他们曾是一群垂头丧气的人，现在的他们却热情洋溢。

examples.text: There was little sparkle in their performance.
examples.translation: 他们的表演缺乏亮点。

examples.text: He is sparkling and versatile in front of the camera.
examples.translation: 镜头前的他光彩照人，多才多艺。

examples.text: He tried to speak, but for once, his voice had left him...
examples.translation: 他想说话，却一时语塞。

examples.text: He speaks with a lisp...
examples.translation: 他说话口齿不清。

examples.text: I rang the hotel and spoke to Louie...
examples.translation: 我打电话到酒店，跟路易通了话。

examples.text: She says she must speak with you at once...
examples.translation: 她说她必须立刻跟你谈谈。

examples.text: She cried when she spoke of Oliver.
examples.translation: 她提起奥利弗的时候哭了。

examples.text: ...as I spoke these idiotic words.
examples.translation: 当我说这些傻话的时候

examples.text: ...a marked decline in the standards of written and spoken English in Britain.
examples.translation: 英国英语写作和口语水平的明显下降

examples.text: When speaking to the seminar Mr Franklin spoke of his experience, gained on a recent visit to Trinidad...
examples.translation: 在研讨会上发言的时候，富兰克林先生谈到了他最近游览特立尼达的经历。

examples.text: He's determined to speak at the Democratic Convention...
examples.translation: 他决定在民主党全国代表大会上发言。

examples.text: The President spoke of the need for territorial compromise.
examples.translation: 总统谈到了在领土问题上达成和解的必要性。

examples.text: He said it was the job of the Church to speak for the underprivileged...
examples.translation: 他说，为贫困群体说话是教会的义务。

examples.text: I speak for all 7,000 members of our organization...
examples.translation: 我代表本组织的 7,000 名成员发言。

examples.text: Obviously I can't speak for other people, but certainly no one I know would entertain the idea.
examples.translation: 我显然不能代表其他人的意见，可是我认识的人当中肯定没有人会有这样的想法。

examples.text: He doesn't speak English...
examples.translation: 他不会讲英语。

examples.text: Many of them can speak two or three or more languages.
examples.translation: 他们当中许多人都会说两三门语言，有的人甚至更多。

examples.text: In the book she speaks of his “social ineptitude” and says he verbally abused her...
examples.translation: 她在书中提到他“缺乏社交技能”，并且说他曾经对她出言不逊。

examples.text: St Paul speaks of the body as the 'temple of the Holy Spirit'.
examples.translation: 圣保罗把身体描述为“圣神的宫殿”。

examples.text: He is not speaking to his mother because of her friendship with his ex-wife...
examples.translation: 因为母亲和前妻仍旧保持着友好的关系，他便不再和母亲说话。

examples.text: The co-stars are still not speaking.
examples.translation: 两位联袂主演的明星仍然互不理睬。

examples.text: His behaviour spoke of an early maturity...
examples.translation: 他的举止流露出早熟的痕迹。

examples.text: The length of the car and the high polish of its fittings both spoke of money...
examples.translation: 长车身和高档配置无不象征着财富。

examples.text: Their music speaks to us with an innate grandeur we can all understand.
examples.translation: 他们的音乐里流露出一种我们都能体会到的天生的高贵。

examples.text: ...the figures speak for themselves — low order books, bleak prospects at home and a worsening outlook for exports...
examples.translation: 这些数字本身就说明了问题——订单订购量低，国内销售前景惨淡，出口形势日趋恶化。

examples.text: The results speak for themselves.
examples.translation: 结局不言自明。

examples.text: 'We're not blaming you,' Kate said. 'Speak for yourself,' Boris muttered.
examples.translation: “我们没有怪你，”凯特说。“也就是你这么想，”鲍里斯嘟囔道。

examples.text: She'd probably drop some comment about her 'fiancé' into the conversation so that he'd think she was already spoken for...
examples.translation: 她可能会在谈话的时候不着痕迹地对她的“未婚夫”作些评论，这样他便会认为她已经名花有主了。

examples.text: By December last year most of the resources had been spoken for.
examples.translation: 去年 12 月之前，绝大多数的资源就被预订了。

examples.text: They have no weaponry to speak of...
examples.translation: 他们没有什么武器值得炫耀。

examples.text: 'Any fresh developments?' — 'Nothing to speak of.'
examples.translation: “有什么新进展了吗？”——“谈不上什么新进展。”

examples.text: This move caused consternation among universities and the government, not to speak of the students affected.
examples.translation: 这个举措在大学和政府里造成了恐慌，更不用说受到影响的学生们了。

examples.text: Both spoke highly of the Russian president...
examples.translation: 双方均盛赞俄罗斯总统。

examples.text: It seemed she found it difficult to speak ill of anyone.
examples.translation: 她似乎觉得说别人的坏话很难。

examples.text: I ought not to tell you but I will, since you're in the family, so to speak...
examples.translation: 我本来不该告诉你的，但我还是要这么做，因为好歹你是家里的一员。

examples.text: The five countries have now all passed, so to speak, their entry test.
examples.translation: 可以说，这5个国家现在都已经通过了入门考试。

examples.text: For a long time her mother and her grandmother had hardly been on speaking terms.
examples.translation: 很久以来，她的母亲和外婆两人之间几乎不怎么说话。

meanings.meaning: 演讲者；扬声器；说话者；说某种语言的人

examples.text: Among the speakers at the gathering was Treasury Secretary Nicholas Brady...
examples.translation: 与会的发言人中有财政部长尼古拉斯·布莱迪。

examples.text: Bruce Wyatt will be the guest speaker at next month's meeting...
examples.translation: 布鲁斯·怀亚特将成为下月会议的特邀发言人。

examples.text: He was not a good speaker.
examples.translation: 他不擅长演讲。

examples.text: ...in the Ukraine, where a fifth of the population are Russian speakers...
examples.translation: 在乌克兰，有五分之一人口说俄语

examples.text: The Department has a growing section which teaches English to speakers of other languages.
examples.translation: 这个系有一个日益壮大的教研组负责向操其他语言的人教授英语。

examples.text: For twenty minutes, the Speaker tried to keep order.
examples.translation: 20 分钟的时间里，议长一直在竭力维持秩序。

examples.text: ...the Speaker of the Polish Parliament...
examples.translation: 波兰议会的议长

examples.text: Mr. Speaker, our message to the president is simple.
examples.translation: 议长先生，我们向总统表达的意思非常简单。

examples.text: From a simple gesture or the speaker's tone of voice, the Japanese listener gleans the whole meaning.
examples.translation: 仅从一个简单的手势或者说话人的语气里，日本人就能够领悟到所有的意思。

examples.text: For a good stereo effect, the speakers should not be too wide apart.
examples.translation: 为了达到理想的立体声效果，扬声器之间的距离不能太远。

examples.text: Spear a piece of fish with a carving fork and dip it in the batter...
examples.translation: 用切肉叉叉一片鱼肉，在面糊里蘸一下。

examples.text: A police officer was speared to death.
examples.translation: 一名警官被刺死了。

meanings.meaning: 特使，特派人员；特刊；特色菜；专车；特价商品

examples.text: You're very special to me, darling...
examples.translation: 亲爱的，你对我来说很重要。

examples.text: There are strong arguments for holidays at Easter and Christmas because these are special occasions...
examples.translation: 支持复活节和圣诞节放假是有充分论据的，因为这些节日都是特殊的时刻。

examples.text: Just to see him was something special...
examples.translation: 见他一面都很难。

examples.text: My special guest will be comedian Ben Elton.
examples.translation: 我的特邀嘉宾将是喜剧演员本·艾尔顿。

examples.text: In special cases, a husband can deduct the travel expenses of his wife who accompanies him on a business trip...
examples.translation: 在特殊情况下，丈夫可以扣除陪同出差的妻子的旅费。

examples.text: So you didn't notice anything special about him?...
examples.translation: 这么说你并没有发现他有什么异常之处了？

examples.text: There is nothing worse than trying to relax and eat a special meal only to find clouds of cigarette smoke drifting over you.
examples.translation: 本打算轻松一下，吃上一顿特别的饭菜，结果却发现周围烟雾缭绕——没有什么比这更糟糕了。

examples.text: ...'Little Scarlet' strawberry jam, made from a special variety of strawberry.
examples.translation: 用特殊品种草莓制成的“小斯卡利特”牌草莓酱

examples.text: Due to his wife's illness, he returned to the State Department as special adviser to the President...
examples.translation: 由于妻子生病，他回到了国务院，出任总统的特别顾问。

examples.text: Frank Deford is a special correspondent for Newsweek magazine.
examples.translation: 弗兰克·德福特是《新闻周刊》杂志的特派记者。

examples.text: Police are still searching for a convicted rapist, who escaped from Broadmoor special hospital yesterday.
examples.translation: 警方仍然在搜寻昨天从布罗德莫尔专科医院逃跑的一名强奸犯。

examples.text: Every anxious person will have his or her own special problems or fears.
examples.translation: 每一个焦虑的人都会有自己的问题或者担心。

examples.text: ...it requires a very special brand of courage to fight dictators.
examples.translation: 与独裁者作斗争需要非同寻常的勇气。

examples.text: ...complaints about the BBC's Hallowe'en special, 'Ghostwatch'...
examples.translation: 对英国广播公司的万圣节特别节目《幽灵观察》的投诉

examples.text: Grocery stores have to offer enough specials to bring people into the store.
examples.translation: 杂货店为了招揽顾客不得不推出多种特色产品。

examples.text: ...talk shows and news specials.
examples.translation: 脱口秀与新闻专题节目

examples.text: If you are housebound, you can arrange for a home visit from a specialist adviser...
examples.translation: 如果你出不了门，可以预约专家顾问上门就诊。

examples.text: Peckham, himself a cancer specialist, is well aware of the wide variations in medical practice.
examples.translation: 佩卡姆本人是一名癌症专家，他非常了解不同治疗方法之间的巨大差异。

examples.text: ...a specialist in diseases of the nervous system.
examples.translation: 研究神经系统疾病的专家

examples.text: My father was a historian of repute. His speciality was the history of Germany...
examples.translation: 我的父亲是一名颇有名气的历史学家，他专门研究德国历史。

examples.text: Handpainted tiled murals for kitchens and bathrooms are Julie Eurich's speciality.
examples.translation: 制作厨房和浴室用的手工绘制花砖是朱莉·尤里克的专长。

examples.text: Rhineland dishes are a speciality of the restaurant...
examples.translation: 莱茵兰菜是这家饭店的特色菜。

examples.text: I started with the Viennese speciality frittatensuppe, or pancake soup.
examples.translation: 我吃的第一道菜是维也纳特色菜鸡蛋饼汤，也叫炒饼汤。

meanings.meaning: 专门从事；详细说明；特化
使专门化；使适应特殊情况；详细说明

examples.text: ...a University professor who specializes in the history of the Russian empire.
examples.translation: 专门研究俄罗斯帝国历史的大学教授

examples.text: ...a Portuguese restaurant which specializes in seafood.
examples.translation: 主打海味的葡萄牙餐馆

examples.text: This degree offers a major specialisation in Social Policy alongside a course in Sociology.
examples.translation: 该学位主修社会政策，同时也包括一门社会学课程。

examples.text: ...an economist who has avoided narrow specialization.
examples.translation: 避免了专业范围过窄的经济学家

examples.text: Pandas are an endangered species...
examples.translation: 熊猫是濒危物种。

examples.text: There are several thousand species of trees here.
examples.translation: 这里有几千种树。

meanings.meaning: 特殊的，特定的；明确的；详细的；[药] 具有特效的

examples.text: Massage may help to increase blood flow to specific areas of the body...
examples.translation: 按摩有助于增加身体特定部位的血液流量。

examples.text: There are several specific problems to be dealt with...
examples.translation: 有几个特定问题需要解决。

examples.text: Specific groups may be formed to address specific issues.
examples.translation: 可能会组成特别小组去解决特定问题。

examples.text: ...the specific needs of the individual.
examples.translation: 个人的特别需求

examples.text: I asked him to be more specific...
examples.translation: 我要求他说得更具体些。

examples.text: These nerve centres generate rhythmic movements; or to be more specific, rhythmic stomach movements...
examples.translation: 这些神经中心产生有节奏的运动，或者更确切地说，是有节奏的肠胃蠕动。

examples.text: This report offered the most specific and accurate description of the problems.
examples.translation: 该报告对问题进行了最具体、最准确的描述。

examples.text: ...the kind of extreme specificity normally associated only with computer programmes.
examples.translation: 通常只有计算机程序才会具备的那种极端明晰性

examples.text: Send your resume with a cover letter that is specific to that particular job.
examples.translation: 寄出你的简历并附上一份针对那个特定工作岗位的附函。

examples.text: Most studies of trade have been country-specific.
examples.translation: 有关贸易的多数研究都是针对某个具体国家的。

examples.text: ...a job-specific course.
examples.translation: 岗位课程

examples.text: Troll's exclusive, personalized luggage is made to our own exacting specifications in heavy-duty PVC/nylon...
examples.translation: 特罗尔专用的、个性化的行李箱是按照我们自己严格的规格要求用耐用聚氯乙烯/尼龙材料定制的。

examples.text: Legislation will require UK petrol companies to meet an EU specification for petrol.
examples.translation: 法规将要求英国的汽油公司必须达到欧盟对汽油的规格要求。

examples.text: ...officials constrained by rigid job specifications.
examples.translation: 受到严格的岗位要求限制的官员们

meanings.meaning: 指定；详细说明；列举；把…列入说明书

examples.text: They specified a spacious entrance hall...
examples.translation: 他们专门指定要一个宽敞的大门厅。

examples.text: He has not specified what action he would like them to take.
examples.translation: 他尚未明确说明自己希望他们采取什么样的行动。

examples.text: Each recipe specifies the size of egg to be used...
examples.translation: 每种菜谱都具体规定了所用鸡蛋的大小。

examples.text: One rule specifies that learner drivers must be supervised by adults...
examples.translation: 一条规则明确规定，见习驾驶员必须有成人的监督。

examples.text: Patients eat together at a specified time.
examples.translation: 病人在规定的时间集体就餐。

examples.text: 200,000 specimens of fungus are kept at the Komarov Botanical Institute.
examples.translation: 有 20 万份菌类标本被保存在科马罗夫植物研究所。

examples.text: ...North American fossil specimens...
examples.translation: 北美化石标本

examples.text: Collectors will pay $50,000 to $1 million for a rare specimen.
examples.translation: 收藏家们会花 5 万到 100 万美元去购入一份稀有标本。

examples.text: Job applicants have to submit a specimen of handwriting.
examples.translation: 求职者必须要提交一份笔迹样本。

examples.text: ...a specimen bank note.
examples.translation: 样钞

examples.text: He refused to provide a specimen...
examples.translation: 他拒绝提供血样。

examples.text: If your urine specimen shows the presence of bacteria, you'll be prescribed antibiotics.
examples.translation: 如果你的尿样显示有细菌存在，医生会给你开抗生素。

examples.text: What a poor specimen that child is!...
examples.translation: 那孩子真不幸！

examples.text: He is a fine specimen of his class.
examples.translation: 他是他那类人的典型代表。

meanings.meaning: 景象；场面；奇观；壮观；公开展示；表相，假相

examples.text: He looked at me over the tops of his spectacles.
examples.translation: 他从眼镜框的上方看了看我。

examples.text: ...thick spectacle frames.
examples.translation: 厚厚的眼镜框

examples.text: It was a spectacle not to be missed.
examples.translation: 这是个不容错过的奇观。

examples.text: 94,000 people turned up for the spectacle.
examples.translation: 94,000 人参加了这一盛大活动。

examples.text: ...a director passionate about music and spectacle.
examples.translation: 对音乐和盛大演出充满激情的指挥

meanings.meaning: 壮观的，惊人的；公开展示的

examples.text: ...spectacular views of the Sugar Loaf Mountain...
examples.translation: 甜面包山的壮观景色

examples.text: They have revamped the business with spectacular success...
examples.translation: 他们成功地调整了业务，成绩斐然。

examples.text: The results have been spectacular.
examples.translation: 结果令人惊叹。

examples.text: My turnover increased spectacularly...
examples.translation: 我的营业额大幅上升。

examples.text: Many of her movies had been spectacularly successful.
examples.translation: 她的很多电影都获得了巨大的成功。

examples.text: ...a television spectacular.
examples.translation: 一场电视盛宴

examples.text: ...one of the world's great sporting spectaculars.
examples.translation: 世界上最壮观的体育盛事之一

examples.text: Thirty thousand spectators watched the final game.
examples.translation: 3 万名观众观看了决赛。

examples.text: She'd seen his moods range across the emotional spectrum...
examples.translation: 她见识过他的情绪波动会有多大。

examples.text: Politicians across the political spectrum have denounced the act...
examples.translation: 各党派的政客们都对该行为表示谴责。

examples.text: The term 'special needs' covers a wide spectrum of problems.
examples.translation: “特殊需求”一词包含的问题范围很广。

examples.text: Vast amounts of energy, from X-rays right through the spectrum down to radio waves, are escaping into space...
examples.translation: 大量的能量，从 X 光直到无线电电波，都正被泄露到太空中去。

examples.text: The individual colours within the light spectrum are believed to have an effect on health.
examples.translation: 光谱中不同的颜色被认为对健康有不同的影响。

examples.text: ...the ultraviolet spectra of hot stars.
examples.translation: 热星的紫外光谱

examples.text: Critics of the project speculate about how many hospitals could be built instead...
examples.translation: 对该项目持批评态度的人在推测如果改作他用不知可以建多少所医院。

examples.text: It would be unfair to Debby's family to speculate on the reasons for her suicide...
examples.translation: 猜测黛比自杀的原因对她的家人来说是不公平的。

examples.text: The doctors speculate that he died of a cerebral haemorrhage caused by a blow on the head...
examples.translation: 医生推测他死于头部受击引起的脑溢血。

examples.text: The reader can speculate what will happen next.
examples.translation: 读者可以推测下一步会发生什么事。

examples.text: The President has gone out of his way to dismiss speculation over the future of the economy minister...
examples.translation: 总统已竭力否认了对经济部长前途的猜测。

examples.text: I had published my speculations about the future of the universe in the Review of Modern Physics.
examples.translation: 我已经在《现代物理评论》上发表了自己对宇宙未来的猜测。

examples.text: Big farmers are moving in, not in order to farm, but in order to speculate with rising land prices...
examples.translation: 大农场主正在不断涌进来，不是为了耕作，而是要利用不断上涨的地价进行投机。

examples.text: The banks made too many risky loans which now can't be repaid, and they speculated in property whose value has now dropped.
examples.translation: 各银行贷出去太多高风险贷款，目前无法收回，他们还进行地产投机，而地产的价值目前已经下跌了。

meanings.meaning: 演讲；讲话；[语] 语音；演说

examples.text: ...the development of speech in children...
examples.translation: 儿童言语能力的发展

examples.text: Intoxication interferes with speech and coordination.
examples.translation: 醉酒会影响言语能力和协调性。

examples.text: ...a speech therapist specialising in stammering.
examples.translation: 专治口吃的言语矫治师

examples.text: His speech became increasingly thick and nasal...
examples.translation: 他说话的声音变得越来越粗，鼻音越来越重。

examples.text: I'd make fun of her dress and imitate her speech.
examples.translation: 我会拿她的衣着开玩笑，并模仿她说话。

examples.text: He could imitate in speech or writing most of those he admired.
examples.translation: 他能模仿大多数自己崇拜的偶像的讲话和写作风格。

examples.text: ...the way common letter clusters are usually pronounced in speech.
examples.translation: 普通字母组合在口语中的常见读法

examples.text: She is due to make a speech on the economy next week...
examples.translation: 她将在下周作一个关于经济的演讲。

examples.text: He delivered his speech in French.
examples.translation: 他用法语发表演说。

examples.text: ...a dramatic resignation speech.
examples.translation: 一场情绪激昂的辞职演说

examples.text: ...the hilarious speech from Alan Bennett's 'Forty Years On'.
examples.translation: 艾伦·贝内特的《弹指四十年》中的一段非常有趣的台词

meanings.meaning: 超速，加速；加速，迅速前行；兴隆
速度，速率；迅速，快速；昌盛，繁荣
加快…的速度；使成功，使繁荣

examples.text: He drove off at high speed...
examples.translation: 他驱车飞驰而去。

examples.text: With this type of camera, the shutter speed is fixed...
examples.translation: 对这类相机而言，快门的速度是固定的。

examples.text: An electrical pulse in a wire travels close to the speed of light...
examples.translation: 电线里的电脉冲以接近光速的速度传输。

examples.text: Wind speeds reached force five.
examples.translation: 风速达到 5 级。

examples.text: In the late 1850s the speed of technological change quickened...
examples.translation: 19 世纪 50 年代末期，技术变革的速度加快了。

examples.text: Each learner can proceed at his own speed.
examples.translation: 每一位学习者都可以按自己的进度学习。

examples.text: Speed is the essential ingredient of all athletics...
examples.translation: 速度是所有田径运动项目的关键要素。

examples.text: He put on a burst of speed...
examples.translation: 他突然加速了。

examples.text: The car is quite noisy at speed.
examples.translation: 这辆车高速行驶时噪音很大。

examples.text: I was amazed at his speed of working.
examples.translation: 他办事之麻利让我深感叹服。

examples.text: ...the sheer speed of the unification process.
examples.translation: 统一进程速度惊人

examples.text: Trains will speed through the Channel Tunnel at 186mph...
examples.translation: 火车将以每小时 186 英里的速度快速穿过海峡隧道。

examples.text: The engine noise rises only slightly as I speed along.
examples.translation: 我一路高速行驶时，发动机的噪音只提高了一点点。

examples.text: This man was not qualified to drive and was speeding.
examples.translation: 这名男子没有驾驶资格，并且违章超速行驶。

examples.text: He was fined for speeding last year.
examples.translation: 他去年因超速行驶被罚了款。

examples.text: A day has been set aside to bring all councillors up to speed on the proposal...
examples.translation: 已经确定了一个日子，届时将向所有的市政委员汇报有关该建议的最新进展情况。

examples.text: Those in charge deluded themselves they were up to speed.
examples.translation: 那些负责人自以为掌握了最新情况。

meanings.meaning: 拼，拼写；意味着；招致；拼成；迷住；轮值

examples.text: He gave his name and then helpfully spelt it...
examples.translation: 他说出自己的名字，然后又热心地将它拼了出来。

examples.text: How do you spell 'potato'?...
examples.translation: potato 这个词怎么拼写？

examples.text: 'Tang' is 'Gnat' spelt backwards.
examples.translation: Gnat倒着写出来就是Tang。

examples.text: If I don't know a word, I ask them to spell it out for me...
examples.translation: 如果我不会写某个字，就让他们替我拼出来。

examples.text: I never have to spell out my first name.
examples.translation: 我从不需要将我的名拼读出来。

examples.text: It's shocking how students can't spell these days...
examples.translation: 当今的学生们拼写上差得令人吃惊。

examples.text: You accused me of inaccuracy yet you can't spell 'Middlesex'.
examples.translation: 你说我不够准确，但你自己却不会拼写Middlesex。

examples.text: If the irrigation plan goes ahead, it could spell disaster for the birds...
examples.translation: 如果灌溉计划开始实施，它可能会给鸟类带来灾难。

examples.text: A report has just arrived on government desks which spells more trouble.
examples.translation: 刚刚有一份报告被送到政府手中，这意味着将要出现更多的麻烦。

examples.text: There has been a long spell of dry weather...
examples.translation: 很长一段时间里天气一直很干燥。

examples.text: You join a barrister for two six-month spells of practical experience.
examples.translation: 你跟着一位出庭律师进行两期为时 6 个月的实习工作。

examples.text: ...sunny spells.
examples.translation: 阳光灿烂的日子

examples.text: They say she died after a witch cast a spell on her.
examples.translation: 他们说她是被一个女巫施了魔法后死的。

examples.text: ...the kiss that will break the spell.
examples.translation: 能破除魔法的吻

examples.text: For many years sundials have cast their spell over scientists and mathematicians...
examples.translation: 多年来，日晷一直吸引着科学家和数学家们。

examples.text: People said he was able to cast a spell on the public.
examples.translation: 人们说他能吸引公众。

examples.text: Even sensible Frank had fallen under her spell.
examples.translation: 甚至连一向理智的弗兰克都被她迷住了。

meanings.meaning: 拼写；意味着（spell的ing形式）；迷住

examples.text: In most languages adjectives have slightly different spellings for masculine and feminine...
examples.translation: 在多数语言中，形容词的阳性和阴性的拼法略为不同。

examples.text: If we got a spelling wrong we were forced to get a dictionary out.
examples.translation: 如果我们拼错了一个字，就会被要求去查字典。

examples.text: His spelling is very bad...
examples.translation: 他的拼写能力很差。

examples.text: ...basic skills in reading, writing, grammar and spelling...
examples.translation: 阅读、写作、语法和拼写等基本技能

examples.text: Spelling mistakes are often just the result of haste.
examples.translation: 拼写错误经常是由于匆忙而造成的。

meanings.meaning: 度过，消磨（时光）；花费；浪费；用尽

examples.text: By the end of the holiday I had spent all my money...
examples.translation: 到假期结束时，我已经花光了自己所有的钱。

examples.text: Businessmen spend enormous amounts advertising their products...
examples.translation: 商人们花费巨额资金为自己的商品做广告。

examples.text: Juventus have spent £23m on new players...
examples.translation: 尤文图斯队已经在新球员身上花了 2,300 万英镑。

examples.text: The survey may cost at least £100 but is money well spent.
examples.translation: 该调查可能要花费至少 100 英镑，但这钱花得值。

examples.text: Has your spending on food increased?...
examples.translation: 你在食品上的开支增加了吗？

examples.text: Government spending is expected to fall.
examples.translation: 政府开支预计要下降。

examples.text: Engineers spend much time and energy developing brilliant solutions...
examples.translation: 工程师们花费很多时间和精力来开发完美的解决方案。

examples.text: This energy could be much better spent taking some positive action.
examples.translation: 这些精力若用于采取某些积极行动的话，可能会更值得。

examples.text: We spent the night in a hotel.
examples.translation: 我们在一家旅馆过夜。

examples.text: ...the marketing and advertising spend.
examples.translation: 营销和广告开支

meanings.meaning: 包围；放入球内；使…成球形

examples.text: ...the sphere of international politics.
examples.translation: 国际政治领域

examples.text: ...nurses, working in all spheres of the health service.
examples.translation: 在公共医疗保健服务业的各领域工作的护士们

examples.text: ...the realities of life outside the government and academic spheres of society.
examples.translation: 政府和学术界以外社会阶层的生活现状

examples.text: They see the region as their natural sphere of influence due to their historical links and a shared language.
examples.translation: 基于历史上的联系和共同的语言，他们把该地区看成是自己天然的势力范围。

examples.text: ...countries traditionally within the British or American spheres of influence.
examples.translation: 传统上处于英国或美国势力范围内的国家

meanings.meaning: 辛辣的；香的，多香料的；下流的

examples.text: Thai food is hot and spicy.
examples.translation: 泰国菜味道辛辣浓烈。

examples.text: ...a spicy tomato and coriander sauce.
examples.translation: 番茄芫荽香辣酱

examples.text: What would your most precious find be', and I said 'A spider's web would be fantastic'.

meanings.meaning: 溢出，溅出；溢出量；摔下；小塞子

examples.text: 70,000 tonnes of oil spilled from the tanker...
examples.translation: 7 万吨油从油轮中溢了出来。

examples.text: ...water behind a dam, getting ready to spill over...
examples.translation: 大坝里的水随时都会溢出来

examples.text: He always spilled the drinks...
examples.translation: 他总是将饮料洒出来。

examples.text: Don't spill water on your suit.
examples.translation: 不要把水洒到你的衣服上。

examples.text: She wiped a spill of milkshake off the counter...
examples.translation: 她把洒出来的奶昔从柜台上擦掉。

examples.text: An oil spill could be devastating for wildlife.
examples.translation: 溢出的油对野生动物来说可能是毁灭性的。

examples.text: A number of bags had split and were spilling their contents...
examples.translation: 有几只袋子裂开了，里面的东西撒了出来。

examples.text: He carefully balanced the satchel so that its contents would not spill out onto the floor.
examples.translation: 他仔细地把小背包放好，不让里面的东西掉到地板上。

examples.text: Tears began to spill out of the boy's eyes...
examples.translation: 男孩的眼泪开始夺眶而出。

examples.text: When the bell rings, more than 1,000 children spill from classrooms.
examples.translation: 当铃声响起时，1,000 多名孩子从教室里涌了出来。

examples.text: She noticed the light spilling under Brian's door...
examples.translation: 她注意到布莱恩门底下透出的光。

examples.text: The door swung open again, spilling light into the cell.
examples.translation: 门再次打开了，光照亮了小屋。

examples.text: He is prepared to spill the blood of a million people...
examples.translation: 他准备杀掉100万人。

examples.text: If blood is spilled the countries will be at war.
examples.translation: 如果出现伤亡，这些国家就会进入交战状态。

examples.text: The latest discs, used for small portable computers, spin 3600 times a minute...
examples.translation: 用在小型便携式计算机上的最新光盘转速为每分钟 3,600 转。

examples.text: The Earth spins on its own axis...
examples.translation: 地球绕着地轴自转。

examples.text: He spun the wheel sharply and made a U turn in the middle of the road...
examples.translation: 他猛打方向盘，在路中间掉头。

examples.text: He spun his car round and went after them.
examples.translation: 他掉转车头，去追他们。

examples.text: This driving mode allows you to move off in third gear to reduce wheel-spin in icy conditions.
examples.translation: 在这个驾驶模式下你可以挂 3 挡起步，以减少轮子在结冰路面上打滑的现象。

examples.text: Just spin the washing and it's nearly dry.
examples.translation: 只需要将洗好的衣物脱水，它就差不多干了。

examples.text: Set on a cool wash and finish with a short spin.
examples.translation: 设定用凉水洗衣，最后短时脱水。

examples.text: My head was spinning from the wine...
examples.translation: 我喝了葡萄酒后晕乎乎的。

examples.text: All those figures make my poor head spin.
examples.translation: 那么多数字把我搞得头昏脑胀。

examples.text: He interpreted the vote as support for the constitution and that is the spin his supporters are putting on the results today.
examples.translation: 他把这次投票解释为对宪法的支持，这也是他的支持者对今天的投票结果所作的解释。

examples.text: ...the wholly improper political spin given to the report, particularly by The New York Times.
examples.translation: 报道中带有的根本不恰当的政治倾向，特别是《纽约时报》的报道

examples.text: The public is sick of spin and tired of promises. It's time for politicians to act.
examples.translation: 公众厌烦了那些有倾向性的报道和种种许诺。该是用政绩说话的时候了。

examples.text: He was surprised, and annoyed that she had spun a story which was too good to be condemned as a simple lie.
examples.translation: 他很惊讶，也很生气，因为她编的故事太真实了，甚至不能被斥为一个简单的谎言。

examples.text: Michelle will also spin a customer's wool fleece to specification at a cost of $2.25 an ounce.
examples.translation: 米歇尔也会按顾客的要求为其纺羊毛呢，每盎司收费 2.25 美元。

examples.text: They do their own cooking, spinning, and woodworking.
examples.translation: 他们自己做饭，纺线，做木工活。

examples.text: Poor Jane was in rather a spin about the party.
examples.translation: 可怜的简对这次聚会真有些不知所措。

examples.text: His club said an operation to remove pressure on his spine had gone well.

meanings.meaning: 使成螺旋形；使作螺旋形上升
盘旋；成螺旋形；螺旋形上升（过去式spiraled/spiralled，过去分词spiraled/spiralled，现在分词spiraling/spiralling，第三人称单数spirals，副词spirally）

examples.text: ...a spiral staircase.
examples.translation: 螺旋形楼梯

examples.text: Vines spiraled upward toward the roof...
examples.translation: 藤蔓盘旋着朝屋顶方向生长。

examples.text: ...a bullet spiralling out of a gun barrel...
examples.translation: 从枪管里飞旋而出的子弹

examples.text: A joss stick spiralled smoke.
examples.translation: 一柱线香青烟袅袅。

examples.text: Larks were rising in spirals from the ridge.
examples.translation: 云雀从山脊上盘旋着飞起。

examples.text: Production costs began to spiral.
examples.translation: 生产成本开始急遽上升。

examples.text: ...a spiralling trend of violence...
examples.translation: 暴力急遽上升的态势

examples.text: The divorce rate is spiralling upwards.
examples.translation: 离婚率正急遽上升。

examples.text: ...an inflationary spiral.
examples.translation: 急遽加快的通货膨胀

examples.text: ...a spiral of debt.
examples.translation: 债务激增

examples.text: House prices will continue to spiral downwards.
examples.translation: 房价将继续暴跌。

meanings.meaning: 圣歌（尤指美国南部黑人的）

examples.text: She lived entirely by spiritual values, in a world of poetry and imagination.
examples.translation: 她追求精神上的满足，完全生活在一个诗歌和想象的世界里。

examples.text: Our whole programme is spiritually oriented but not religious.
examples.translation: 我们的整个节目都是关注心灵的，但却不是宗教性的。

examples.text: ...the peaceful spirituality of Japanese culture.
examples.translation: 日本文化的和平精神

examples.text: The spiritual leader of Ireland's 3.7 million Catholics...
examples.translation: 爱尔兰 370 万天主教徒的宗教领袖

examples.text: A man in priestly clothes offered spiritual guidance.
examples.translation: 一位身着牧师袍服的男子进行了宗教布道。

meanings.meaning: 吐痰；吐口水；发出劈啪声

examples.text: The gang thought of hitting him too, but decided just to spit...
examples.translation: 那伙人也想过要揍他，但最后只是啐了他一口。

examples.text: They spat at me and taunted me...
examples.translation: 他们朝我吐唾沫，还嘲笑我。

examples.text: She spit into the little tray of mascara and brushed it on her lashes.
examples.translation: 她朝一小盒睫毛膏里吐了点唾沫，然后蘸了一点刷到自己的睫毛上。

examples.text: Spit out that gum and pay attention...
examples.translation: 把那块口香糖吐出来，注意听。

examples.text: He felt as if a serpent had spat venom into his eyes...
examples.translation: 他感觉就像有一条蛇朝自己的双眼里喷射了毒液。

examples.text: I started spitting blood and my mother panicked.
examples.translation: 我开始吐血，我母亲吓坏了。

examples.text: The engine spat and banged.
examples.translation: 发动机发出劈啪声，接着是砰的一声响。

examples.text: ...the fire where pork chops were sizzling and spitting.
examples.translation: 把猪排烤得嗞嗞啦啦响的炉火

examples.text: 'Wait a damn minute,' Mindy spat. 'Nobody said anything about staying overnight.'...
examples.translation: “该死的，等一下”，明迪愤愤地说道，“谁也没说过要过夜。”

examples.text: Cramer spat an obscenity.
examples.translation: 克拉默愤愤地骂了一句脏话。

examples.text: He spat out 'I don't like the way he looks at me.'...
examples.translation: 他愤愤地说：“我讨厌他那样看着我。”

examples.text: She spat the name out like an insult...
examples.translation: 她像骂人似的说出了那个名字。

examples.text: He appeared to be angry, spitting out disconnected words.
examples.translation: 他看起来很生气，嘴里愤愤地说着一些毫无条理的话。

examples.text: It will stop in a minute — it's only spitting.
examples.translation: 雨很快就会停的——这只不过是毛毛雨。

examples.text: She roasted the meat on a spit.
examples.translation: 她用烤肉叉子烤肉。

examples.text: ...a restaurant within spitting distance of the Tower of London.
examples.translation: 离伦敦塔非常近的一个餐馆

examples.text: Nina looks the spitting image of Sissy Spacek.
examples.translation: 尼娜看起来像极了茜茜·斯帕赛克。

examples.text: Josef Krips at the State Opera hired her in spite of the fact that she had never sung on stage...
examples.translation: 尽管她从未在舞台上演唱过，国家歌剧院的约瑟夫·克里普斯还是聘用了她。

examples.text: Their love of life comes in spite of, almost in defiance of, considerable hardship.
examples.translation: 尽管面临众多的艰难困苦，他们还是几乎义无反顾地表现出了对生活的热爱。

examples.text: The blunt comment made Richard laugh in spite of himself...
examples.translation: 这番率直的话让理查德不由自主地大笑起来。

examples.text: She was deeply moved and in spite of herself could not help showing it.
examples.translation: 她被深深地打动了，禁不住为之动容。

examples.text: I refused her a divorce, out of spite I suppose...
examples.translation: 我拒绝和她离婚，就是为了出口恶气。

examples.text: Never had she met such spite and pettiness.
examples.translation: 她从未见过这样的怨恨和偏狭。

examples.text: Pantelaras was giving his art collection away for nothing, to spite Marie and her husband.
examples.translation: 潘特拉拉斯将自己的艺术藏品全都无偿捐了出去，存心要激怒玛丽和她的丈夫。

examples.text: A lot of people were in the water, swimming or simply splashing about...
examples.translation: 水里有很多人在游泳或只是在戏水玩耍。

examples.text: She could hear the voices of her friends as they splashed in a nearby rock pool...
examples.translation: 她能听见自己的朋友们在附近的小石潭中嬉水的声音。

examples.text: The gliders and their pilots splashed into the lake and had to be fished out.
examples.translation: 滑翔机连同驾驶员都扑通一声栽进了湖里，只能被捞出来。

examples.text: He closed his eyes tight, and splashed the water on his face...
examples.translation: 他紧闭双眼，将水泼在自己脸上。

examples.text: A little wave, the first of many, splashed in my face...
examples.translation: 一朵小小的浪花飞溅在我的脸上，紧接着更多的浪涌过来。

examples.text: Beer splashed the carpet...
examples.translation: 啤酒洒到了地毯上。

examples.text: Lorries rumbled past them, splashing them with filthy water from the potholes in the road...
examples.translation: 大卡车从他们身旁轰隆隆开过，把路上坑凹里的脏水溅到了他们身上。

examples.text: He heard the sounds of splashing water and glanced at the door to the bathroom.
examples.translation: 他听到水泼溅的声音，就看了一眼浴室的门。

examples.text: There was a splash and something fell clumsily into the water.
examples.translation: 扑通一声，有东西重重地掉进了水里。

examples.text: Wallcoverings and floors should be able to withstand steam and splashes...
examples.translation: 墙面材料和地板都应该能耐热汽且防水。

examples.text: Add a splash of lemon juice to flavor the butter.
examples.translation: 加上一点柠檬汁给黄油调味。

examples.text: Anne has left the walls white, but added splashes of colour with the tablecloth and the paintings.
examples.translation: 安妮让墙壁维持白色，但用桌布及油画进行了色彩点缀。

examples.text: The newspapers splashed the story all over their front pages...
examples.translation: 各家报纸都以整个头版醒目地刊登了这一报道。

examples.text: A picture of his girlfriend Sheryl had been splashed in the previous weekend's tabloids.
examples.translation: 他的女友谢里尔的一张照片被刊登在前一周末各家通俗小报的显眼位置上。

examples.text: Now she's made a splash in the American television show 'Civil Wars'.
examples.translation: 现在她已经凭借美国电视剧《内战》而一炮走红。

meanings.meaning: 辉煌的；灿烂的；极好的；杰出的

examples.text: The book includes a wealth of splendid photographs...
examples.translation: 该书中有大量精彩的照片。

examples.text: Our house has got a splendid view across to the Cotswolds...
examples.translation: 从我们的房子里向外望去，景色宜人，一直能看到科茨沃尔德丘陵。

examples.text: I found him to be splendid company during the hour of our acquaintance.
examples.translation: 在我们相处的那段时间里我发现他是个很好的同伴。

examples.text: I have heard him tell people that we get along splendidly.
examples.translation: 我听到他跟别人说我们相处得很好。

examples.text: ...a splendid Victorian mansion.
examples.translation: 华丽的维多利亚式宅第

examples.text: The young women are splendidly dressed, some in floor-length ball gowns...
examples.translation: 年轻女子们都穿得非常漂亮，有些还穿着拖地的舞裙。

examples.text: Its historic buildings are being slowly and splendidly renovated.
examples.translation: 此处的历史建筑正被缓慢且精心地修复着。

examples.text: ...this splendidly readable and robust autobiography.
examples.translation: 这部可读性很强的、引人入胜的自传

examples.text: 'I was thinking I might do a lemon cream sauce and baked potatoes.' 'Splendid!' Midge applauded.
examples.translation: “我在考虑做一道浇柠檬奶油汁的烤马铃薯。”“好极了！”米基表示赞同。

meanings.meaning: 精神；心灵；情绪；志气；烈酒

examples.text: The human spirit is virtually indestructible...
examples.translation: 人的精神实际上是不可摧毁的。

examples.text: Marian retains a restless, youthful spirit, in search of new horizons.
examples.translation: 玛丽安怀着一颗年轻、不断进取的心去寻求新的天地。

examples.text: His spirit has left him and all that remains is the shell of his body.
examples.translation: 他已灵魂出窍，剩下的只是他的躯壳。

examples.text: ...protection against evil spirits.
examples.translation: 避邪

examples.text: She was a very brave girl and everyone who knew her admired her spirit.
examples.translation: 她是个非常勇敢的女孩，认识她的人都敬佩她的勇气。

examples.text: They played with spirit.
examples.translation: 他们打得生龙活虎。

examples.text: Their problem can only be solved in a spirit of compromise...
examples.translation: 他们的问题只能通过妥协来解决。

examples.text: They approached the talks in a conciliatory spirit.
examples.translation: 他们抱一种和解的态度去参加谈判。

examples.text: There is a great sense of team spirit among the British Olympic squad...
examples.translation: 在英国的奥运代表团中有一种强烈的团队精神。

examples.text: The president has appealed to the Brazilian people for patriotism and community spirit.
examples.translation: 总统已经呼吁巴西人民要有爱国情怀和集体主义精神。

examples.text: ...the real spirit of the Labour movement.
examples.translation: 劳工运动的精髓

examples.text: The requirement for work permits violates the spirit of the 1950 treaty.
examples.translation: 对工作许可证的要求违反了 1950 年条约的精神。

examples.text: I like to think of myself as a free spirit...
examples.translation: 我愿意把自己看成是个无拘无束的人。

examples.text: He was the founder and guiding spirit of New York's Shakespeare Festival.
examples.translation: 他是纽约莎士比亚戏剧节的创始人及领导者。

examples.text: At supper, everyone was in high spirits...
examples.translation: 晚餐时，每个人都兴致勃勃。

examples.text: A bit of exercise will help lift his spirits.
examples.translation: 进行一点儿体育锻炼能帮助他改善情绪。

examples.text: He was spirited away and probably murdered...
examples.translation: 他被秘密带走，可能被杀害了。

examples.text: His parents had spirited him away to the country...
examples.translation: 他的父母偷偷地将他带到了该国。

examples.text: It is possible that he has been spirited out of the country.
examples.translation: 可能他已经被偷偷带出了国。

examples.text: In spirit I was with you here.
examples.translation: 我在精神上支持你。

examples.text: They seemed close in spirit to those first independent-minded Turkish women who took professions...
examples.translation: 她们在本质上似乎和那些最早出去工作的具有独立思想的土耳其女性很相似。

examples.text: It is independent in spirit.
examples.translation: 它本质上是独立的。

meanings.meaning: 分离；使分离；劈开；离开；分解

examples.text: In a severe gale the ship split in two...
examples.translation: 在一次大风中，船断成了两截。

examples.text: If the chicken is fairly small, you may simply split it in half...
examples.translation: 如果鸡比较小，你把它切成两半就行了。

examples.text: We split the boards down the middle to use them for the back of the shelves.
examples.translation: 我们把木板从中间锯开，用作架子的背板。

examples.text: ...uniting families split by the war.
examples.translation: 使因战争分离的家庭重新团圆

examples.text: Yet it is feared the Republican leadership could split over the agreement...
examples.translation: 但有人担心，共和党的领导层可能会在该协议上出现意见分歧。

examples.text: Women priests are accused of splitting the church.
examples.translation: 女牧师被指责分裂教会。

examples.text: ...these organizations all have similar aims and programs and are really split by personal rivalries as much as by politics.
examples.translation: 这些组织都有类似的目标和规划，之所以出现分歧实际上是源于个人之间的对立和政治斗争。

examples.text: The Kremlin is deeply split in its approach to foreign policy.
examples.translation: 克里姆林宫的领导层在外交政策上存在很深的分歧。

examples.text: They accused both radicals and conservatives of trying to provoke a split in the party.
examples.translation: 他们指责激进派和保守派都在试图挑起党内分歧。

examples.text: ...a split between what is thought and what is felt.
examples.translation: 所想到的和感受到的之间的不同

examples.text: The seat of his short grey trousers split...
examples.translation: 他的灰色短裤的臀部开裂了。

examples.text: Twist the mixture into individual sausages without splitting the skins...
examples.translation: 将混合物拧成一段段的香肠，不要把皮弄破。

examples.text: He had a split lip and an eye that wouldn't open properly.
examples.translation: 他长着兔唇，一只眼睛无法正常睁开。

examples.text: The plastic-covered seat has a few small splits around the corners.
examples.translation: 塑料面椅子的四角上有几道小裂缝。

examples.text: I would rather pay for a meal than watch nine friends pick over and split a bill...
examples.translation: 我宁可掏钱请客，也不愿看到9位朋友算来算去分摊账单。

examples.text: Split the wages between you...
examples.translation: 工钱由你们两人平分。

examples.text: All exhibits are for sale, the proceeds being split between Oxfam and the artist.
examples.translation: 所有展品都将出售，收入由乐施会和艺术家平分。

examples.text: It's important not to let mistakes spoil your life...
examples.translation: 重要的是不要让错误毁了你的生活。

examples.text: Peaceful summer evenings can be spoilt by mosquitoes.
examples.translation: 宁静的夏夜可能会被蚊子破坏掉。

examples.text: Grandparents are often tempted to spoil their grandchildren whenever they come to visit.
examples.translation: 祖父母每次来访都往往禁不住要娇惯孙辈。

examples.text: A spoilt child is rarely popular with other children...
examples.translation: 被宠坏的孩子很难得到其他孩子的喜爱。

examples.text: Oh, that child. He's so spoiled.
examples.translation: 哦，那个孩子。他被宠坏了。

examples.text: Spoil yourself with a new perfume this summer...
examples.translation: 今年夏天买瓶新香水慰劳一下自己吧。

examples.text: Perhaps I could employ someone to iron his shirts, but I wanted to spoil him. He was my man.
examples.translation: 也许我可以雇别人来熨他的衬衫，但我想好好宠他。他是我爱的男人。

examples.text: We all know that fats spoil by becoming rancid...
examples.translation: 我们都知道油脂变质后会发臭。

examples.text: Some organisms are responsible for spoiling food and cause food poisoning...
examples.translation: 有些生物会导致食物变质并引起食物中毒。

examples.text: Some of my apples were spoilt last year by grubs inside the fruit.
examples.translation: 去年我的一些苹果被果内的虫子给蛀坏了。

examples.text: ...the potential health problems from spoiled food.
examples.translation: 变质食物可能引起的健康问题

examples.text: They had broadcast calls for voters to spoil their ballot papers...
examples.translation: 他们通过广播呼吁选民们投无效选票。

examples.text: The results showed that 7.2% of the voters cast blank or spoiled ballots.
examples.translation: 结果显示，7.2 %的选民投了空白或无效票。

examples.text: True to military tradition, the victors are now treating themselves to the spoils of war...
examples.translation: 按照军事惯例，胜者正在分享战利品。

examples.text: Competing warlords and foreign powers scrambled for political spoils.
examples.translation: 相互争斗的军阀及外国列强们正在争夺政治上的收益。

examples.text: At lunchtime, MPs are spoilt for choice in 26 restaurants and bars.
examples.translation: 到了午餐时间，议员们有 26 家之多的餐厅和酒吧可供选择。

examples.text: A UN spokesman said that the mission will carry 20 tons of relief supplies.
examples.translation: 联合国的一名男发言人说，该代表团将携带 20 吨救济物资。

meanings.meaning: 采集海绵；过寄生生活；海绵般地吸收

examples.text: ...a sponge mattress.
examples.translation: 海绵床垫

examples.text: He wiped off the table with a sponge.
examples.translation: 他用一块海绵擦桌子。

examples.text: Fill a bowl with water and gently sponge your face and body.
examples.translation: 在一只盆里放上水，轻轻地用蘸湿的海绵擦拭你的面部及身体。

examples.text: If your child's temperature rises, sponge her down gently with tepid water.
examples.translation: 如果你孩子的体温上升，就用海绵蘸上温水轻轻地擦拭她的身体。

examples.text: It makes a superb filling for cakes and sponges.
examples.translation: 它非常适合做蛋糕和软布丁的馅儿。

examples.text: He should just get an honest job and stop sponging off the rest of us!...
examples.translation: 他应该找一份正当的工作，不要再揩我们这些人的油了！

examples.text: He spent his life grumbling about missed opportunities and sponging on his father for money.
examples.translation: 他一辈子都在抱怨失去的机会，并一直伸手向自己的父亲要钱。

examples.text: Mercury, in association with The Independent, is sponsoring Britain's first major Pop Art exhibition for over 20 years...
examples.translation: 《信使报》正携手《独立报》一起为 20 多年来英国举办的首届大型通俗艺术展览提供赞助。

examples.text: The competition was sponsored by Ruinart Champagne...
examples.translation: 比赛是由慧纳酒庄赞助的。

examples.text: Most DES students are sponsored by the National Department of Education.
examples.translation: 多数环境科学系的学生是由国家教育部资助的。

examples.text: Please could you sponsor me for my school's campaign for Help the Aged?
examples.translation: 我在参加我们学校举办的“助老”募捐活动，您能赞助我吗？

examples.text: Eight senators sponsored legislation to stop the military funding.
examples.translation: 8 位参议员支持立法停止军事拨款。

examples.text: Given the strength of pressure on both sides, the superpowers may well have difficulties sponsoring negotiations...
examples.translation: 迫于来自对方的强大压力，两个超级大国想要组织谈判肯定会有困难。

examples.text: The protest comes on the eve of two days of talks in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, sponsored by the United Nations.
examples.translation: 抗议活动发生在联合国组织的于埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴进行的为期两天的会谈即将开始前。

examples.text: We have to make the states that sponsor terrorism pay a price.
examples.translation: 我们必须让那些支持恐怖主义的国家付出代价。

examples.text: Companies will now be able to sponsor programmes on ITV and Channel 4.
examples.translation: 现在公司可以在独立电视台和第 4 频道上出资做节目广告了。

examples.text: I understand Coca-Cola are to be named as the new sponsors of the League Cup later this week...
examples.translation: 我知道可口可乐公司将在本周晚些时候被指定为联赛杯的新赞助商。

examples.text: The chief sponsor of the New York law, state Senator Emanuel Gold, says he's not giving up.
examples.translation: 纽约州立法的主要倡议人州参议员伊曼纽尔·戈尔德说，他不会放弃。

meanings.meaning: 自发的；自然的；无意识的

examples.text: Diana's house was crowded with happy people whose spontaneous outbursts of song were accompanied by lively music...
examples.translation: 戴安娜的家里挤满了兴奋的人们，他们伴着欢快的音乐不由自主地引吭高歌。

examples.text: I joined in the spontaneous applause.
examples.translation: 我跟着也自然而然地鼓起掌来。

examples.text: As soon as the tremor passed, many people spontaneously arose and cheered...
examples.translation: 震感刚一过去，很多人就自发地站起来欢呼。

examples.text: He was never spontaneously warm or friendly towards us.
examples.translation: 他从未自然而然地对我们表示过热情或友好。

examples.text: I had another spontaneous miscarriage at around the 16th to 18th week.
examples.translation: 我在大约第 16 至 18 孕周时又经历了一次自然流产。

examples.text: ...a spontaneous explosion.
examples.translation: 自爆

examples.text: Usually a woman's breasts produce milk spontaneously after the birth...
examples.translation: 女性的乳房通常在产后会自然泌乳。

examples.text: These images surface spontaneously in dreams.
examples.translation: 这些影像在梦中自然地浮现出来。

examples.text: He stirred his coffee with a spoon.
examples.translation: 他用一把小勺搅着自己的咖啡。

examples.text: ...tea with two spoons of sugar.
examples.translation: 放了两匙糖的茶

examples.text: He spooned instant coffee into two of the mugs...
examples.translation: 他舀了几勺速溶咖啡放进两个杯子中。

examples.text: Spoon the sauce over the meat.
examples.translation: 用调羹将调味汁浇在肉上。

examples.text: She was born with a silver spoon in her mouth and everything has been done for her.
examples.translation: 她出生于富贵人家，什么事都已为她安排得好好的。

meanings.meaning: 运动；游戏；娱乐；运动会；玩笑
游戏；参加体育运动；夸耀

examples.text: I'd say football is my favourite sport...
examples.translation: 我最喜欢的运动要数足球了。

examples.text: She excels at sport...
examples.translation: 她在体育方面很优秀。

examples.text: Mark was mainly interested in sport at school, playing rugby as well as soccer...
examples.translation: 在学校，马克主要对体育运动很感兴趣，他打橄榄球，也踢足球。

examples.text: Billy turned on a radio to get the sports news.
examples.translation: 比利打开收音机听体育新闻。

examples.text: He was accused of having no sense of humor, of not being a good sport.
examples.translation: 他被指责缺乏幽默感，不够大度。

examples.text: He sported a collarless jacket with pleated black panels...
examples.translation: 他穿着一件带有黑色褶子饰条的无领上衣。

examples.text: He was heavily-built and sported a red moustache...
examples.translation: 他身材魁梧，留着红色的八字胡。

examples.text: People sported swastikas and walls were covered with inflammatory slogans.
examples.translation: 人们佩戴着纳粹党的曲十字标志，墙上写满了煽动性口号。

examples.text: This is not the first time a sportsman has clashed with a pitch invader.
Such taxes can apply when the first spouse dies and again when the second spouse dies.
The moon was casting a rainbow through the spray from the waterfall...
examples.translation: 月亮在瀑布溅起的水雾上照出了一道彩虹。

examples.text: The rope whipped clear of the water, throwing up a spray of droplets.
examples.translation: 绳子猛地甩过水面，带起一片水珠。

examples.text: ...hair spray.
examples.translation: 喷发胶

examples.text: ...a can of insect spray.
examples.translation: 一罐喷雾杀虫剂

examples.text: A sprayer hooked to a tractor can spray five gallons onto ten acres...
examples.translation: 用拖拉机牵引的喷雾器可以将 5 加仑药水喷洒在 10 英亩田地上。

examples.text: Two inmates hurled slates at prison officers spraying them with a hose...
examples.translation: 两名囚犯朝着用水管向他们喷水的狱警们扔石板瓦。

examples.text: Drops of blood sprayed across the room.
examples.translation: 滴滴鲜血溅洒在房间各处。

examples.text: A shower of mustard seeds sprayed into the air and fell into the grass...
examples.translation: 许多芥子撒向空中，然后落进了草丛里。

examples.text: The intensity of the blaze shattered windows, spraying glass on the streets below...
examples.translation: 熊熊烈火灼裂了玻璃窗，碎玻璃飞溅到了下面的街道上。

examples.text: The bullet slammed into the ceiling, spraying them with bits of plaster.
examples.translation: 子弹砰地射进了天花板，掉落的石膏碎片落了他们一身。

examples.text: He ran to the top of the building spraying bullets into shoppers below...
examples.translation: 他跑到楼顶上，向下面的购物人群开枪扫射。

examples.text: The army lorries were sprayed with machine gun fire from guerrillas in the woods.
examples.translation: 部队的运货卡车遭到了树林中游击队机关枪的扫射。

examples.text: The bare metal was sprayed with several coats of primer.
examples.translation: 裸露的金属上被喷上了几层底漆。

examples.text: He doesn't spray against pests or diseases...
examples.translation: 他并不喷药防虫祛病。

examples.text: Confine the use of insecticides to the evening and do not spray plants that are in flower...
examples.translation: 只在晚间使用杀虫剂，而且不要对正在开花的植物喷药。

examples.text: Because of the immunity of the immature insects, it's important to spray regularly.
examples.translation: 由于幼虫对药物有免疫力，因此必须经常喷药。

examples.text: ...a small spray of freesias.
examples.translation: 一小簇小苍兰

meanings.meaning: 传播，散布；展开；伸展；铺开

examples.text: She spread a towel on the sand and lay on it...
examples.translation: 她在沙滩上铺了一条毛巾，躺在上面。

examples.text: His coat was spread over the bed.
examples.translation: 他的外套摊在床上。

examples.text: He extracted several glossy prints and spread them out on a low coffee table...
examples.translation: 他掏出几张光面照片，将它们摆在一张矮茶几上。

examples.text: In his room, Tom was spreading out a map of Scandinavia on the bed.
examples.translation: 房间里，汤姆正将一张斯堪的纳维亚地图在床上铺开。

examples.text: Sitting on the floor, spread your legs as far as they will go without overstretching...
examples.translation: 坐在地板上，在不要拉伤的前提下将双腿尽量分开。

examples.text: He stepped back and spread his hands wide. 'You are most welcome to our home.'
examples.translation: 他往后退了一步，伸开双手。“非常欢迎你到我们家来。”

examples.text: David made a gesture, spreading out his hands as if he were showing that he had no explanation to make...
examples.translation: 戴维做了个手势，摊开双手，好像在说他没有什么可解释的。

examples.text: You need a bed that's large enough to let you spread yourself out.
examples.translation: 你需要一张能让自己舒展四肢躺着的大床。

examples.text: Spread the mixture in the cake tin and bake for 30 minutes...
examples.translation: 将混合物抹在蛋糕烤盘里，烘烤 30 分钟。

examples.text: A thick layer of wax was spread over the surface...
examples.translation: 表面涂上了厚厚的一层蜡。

examples.text: Spread the bread with the cheese.
examples.translation: 在面包上抹奶酪。

examples.text: ...a wholemeal salad roll with low fat spread.
examples.translation: 涂有低脂酱的全麦色拉面包卷

examples.text: The industrial revolution which started a couple of hundred years ago in Europe is now spreading across the world.
examples.translation: 两百多年前始于欧洲的工业革命目前正在向全世界传播。

examples.text: ...the sense of fear spreading in residential neighborhoods...
examples.translation: 在住宅小区中蔓延的恐惧感

examples.text: He was fed-up with the lies being spread about him.
examples.translation: 关于自己的流言蜚语满天乱飞，他实在受够了。

examples.text: The greatest hope for reform is the gradual spread of information...
examples.translation: 对改革的最大希望是信息能得以逐渐传播。

examples.text: Thanks to the spread of modern technology, trained workers are now more vital than ever.
examples.translation: 由于现代技术的普及，现在受过培训的工人的作用比以往任何时候都更为重要。

examples.text: Fire spread rapidly after a chemical truck exploded...
examples.translation: 一辆装有化学品的卡车爆炸后，火势迅速蔓延。

examples.text: A dark red stain was spreading across his shirt...
examples.translation: 一块深红色的污渍正在他的衬衫上渗开。

examples.text: In Northern California, a wildfire has spread a haze of smoke over 200 miles.
examples.translation: 在加利福尼亚州北部，一场野火产生的烟雾已扩散了 200 多英里。

examples.text: The situation was complicated by the spread of a serious forest fire.
examples.translation: 一场严重的森林大火的蔓延使得形势更加复杂。

examples.text: There seems to be little difference whether you eat all your calorie allowance in one go, or spread it over the day...
examples.translation: 不管你是一次性摄入全天的卡路里限量，还是在一天内分次摄入，结果好像没有多大差别。

examples.text: The course is spread over a five week period.
examples.translation: 这门课将持续 5 周时间。

examples.text: ...policies that spread the state's wealth more evenly...
examples.translation: 更加平均地分配国家财富的政策

examples.text: The loss of jobs has been far more evenly spread across the regions than it was during the early 1980s.
examples.translation: 失业数字在各地区之间的分布要比 20 世纪 80 年代初均衡多了。

examples.text: There are easier ways to encourage the even spread of wealth.
examples.translation: 有一些更简单的方法可以促进财富的平均分配。

examples.text: A topic-based approach can be hard to assess in primary schools with a typical spread of ability...
examples.translation: 因为学生的能力通常差异很大，基于话题的教学方法在小学里评估起来可能很难。

examples.text: We have an enormous spread of industries, mainly in the Home Counties and East Anglia.
examples.translation: 我们拥有种类繁多的工业，主要位于伦敦周围各郡和东英吉利地区。

examples.text: There was a double-page spread of a dinner for 46 people.
examples.translation: 有一张横贯两版的、由 46 人参加的宴席的照片。

examples.text: Market makers earn their livings from the spread between buying and selling prices.
examples.translation: 做市商靠赚取买卖价差生存。

examples.text: Sprinkle the meat with salt and place in the pan...
examples.translation: 在肉上撒上盐，然后放进平底锅。

examples.text: At the festival, candles are blessed and sprinkled with holy water...
examples.translation: 在节日里，要对蜡烛祝圣，并洒以圣水。

examples.text: Cheese can be sprinkled on egg or vegetable dishes.
examples.translation: 奶酪可以撒在鸡蛋或蔬菜做的菜肴上。

examples.text: Unfortunately, the text is sprinkled with errors...
examples.translation: 遗憾的是，文本中零星地有一些错误。

examples.text: Men in green army uniforms are sprinkled throughout the huge auditorium.
examples.translation: 穿着绿色军服的人星星点点地分布在整个大礼堂中。

examples.text: It only takes a few days for beans to sprout.
examples.translation: 豆子只要几天就能发芽。

examples.text: Leaf-shoots were beginning to sprout on the hawthorn...
examples.translation: 山楂树上开始长出叶芽。

examples.text: Birch trees sprouted from the rubble and grew into a dense young wood.
examples.translation: 桦树从瓦砾中长出来，形成了一片茂密的新林。

examples.text: ...the garden, which had had time to sprout a shocking collection of weeds.
examples.translation: 久而久之便野草丛生的花园

examples.text: When you sprout seeds their nutritional content increases...
examples.translation: 让种子发芽后，其营养含量会提高。

examples.text: Sprouted beans only need to be cooked for 1-2 minutes.
examples.translation: 豆芽只需烹炒一到两分钟。

examples.text: She is very old now, with little, round, wire-rimmed glasses and whiskers sprouting from her chin...
examples.translation: 她现在很老了，戴着圆圆的金属架小眼镜，下巴上还长出了胡须。

examples.text: As well as sprouting a few grey hairs, Kevin seems to be suffering the occasional memory loss.
examples.translation: 除长出了些许白发外，凯文似乎还患上了间歇性失忆。

examples.text: More than a million satellite dishes have sprouted on homes across the country...
examples.translation: 100 多万个卫星接收器迅速出现在了全国各地的家庭用户中。

examples.text: Since its first shop was opened in 1976, it has sprouted outlets in 39 countries.
examples.translation: 自从 1976 年开设第一家店以来，它已经在 39 个国家里开设了大量分店。

examples.text: After eleven days of growth the number of sprouts was counted.
examples.translation: 经过11天的生长后，对新芽的数量进行了计数。

meanings.meaning: 春天；弹簧；泉水；活力；跳跃
使跳起；使爆炸；突然提出；使弹开
(Spring)人名；(德)施普林；(英、芬、瑞典)斯普林

examples.text: Last spring was marked by regular reports of explosions, leaks and other problems at the plant.
The leaves have yellow areas on the top and underneath are powdery orange spots...
examples.translation: 叶子的表面有黄色斑块，背面则有桔色粉状圆点。

examples.text: The swimsuit comes in navy with white spots or blue with green spots.
examples.translation: 这款泳衣有藏青色带白色圆点的，也有蓝色带绿色圆点的。

examples.text: Never squeeze blackheads, spots or pimples.
examples.translation: 千万不要挤黑头、小肿块或粉刺。

examples.text: Spots of rain had begun to fall...
examples.translation: 雨点开始落下来了。

examples.text: Secure with a few spots of glue.
examples.translation: 用几滴胶水粘住。

examples.text: Mr Brooke is undoubtedly in a spot of bother...
examples.translation: 布鲁克先生肯定遇到了点小麻烦。

examples.text: A year or two ago I found myself indulging in a spot of yachting in Finnish waters...
examples.translation: 一两年前，我有一阵子曾迷上了在芬兰海域中进行帆船运动。

examples.text: We've given all the club members tea, coffee and a spot of lunch.
examples.translation: 我们为所有俱乐部成员都提供了茶、咖啡和简单的午餐。

examples.text: They stayed at several of the island's top tourist spots...
examples.translation: 他们在岛上最著名的几处旅游景点作了停留。

examples.text: They all stood there staring, as if frozen to the spot.
examples.translation: 他们都站在那儿发愣，就像被冻在那里似的。

examples.text: Unsuccessful at screen writing, he got a spot on a CNN film show.
examples.translation: 写电影剧本未获成功后，他在美国有线新闻网的一档电影节目中争取到了一个固定时段。

examples.text: Vicenzo failed to spot the error...
examples.translation: 维森佐未能发现该错误。

examples.text: He left the party seconds before smoke was spotted coming up the stairs.
examples.translation: 就在他离开聚会几秒钟后有人发现烟雾顺着楼梯冒上来了。

examples.text: ...areas where troops are on the spot and protecting civilians...
examples.translation: 有部队在现场保护平民的地区

examples.text: Mr Connolly is their 'man on the spot' and the person you can call if you have a complaint.
examples.translation: 康诺利先生是他们的“现场代表”，要投诉可以和他联系。

examples.text: James was called to see the producer and got the job on the spot...
examples.translation: 詹姆斯被叫去见制片人，当场就得到了那份工作。

examples.text: The surveyor will use a laptop computer to give on the spot advice.
examples.translation: 检测员会用一台手提电脑当场给出意见。

examples.text: He put me on the spot a bit because he invited me right in front of his mum and I didn't particularly want to go...
examples.translation: 他让我有点难堪，因为他当着他母亲的面邀请我，而我又不太想去。

examples.text: Even clever people are not terribly clever when put on the spot.
examples.translation: 即便是聪明人在面对难题时也未必就能表现得特别聪明。

examples.text: In a tight spot there is no one I would sooner see than Frank.
examples.translation: 有麻烦时，我会首先去找弗兰克。

examples.text: It's the money that spurs these fishermen to risk a long ocean journey in their flimsy boats...
examples.translation: 是金钱驱使这些渔民驾着破旧小船冒险出海远航。

examples.text: His friend's plight had spurred him into taking part.
examples.translation: 朋友的困境促使他投身参与。

examples.text: Their attitude, rather than reining him back, only seemed to spur Philip on...
examples.translation: 他们的态度非但没有令菲利普回头，反倒促使他继续向前。

examples.text: Criticism can be of great use; we may not like it at the time, but it can spur us on to greater things.
examples.translation: 批评可能会很有用;我们当时可能不喜欢它，但它能激励我们获取更大成功。

examples.text: The administration may put more emphasis on spurring economic growth...
examples.translation: 政府可能会更加重视推动经济增长。

examples.text: The trade pacts will spur an exodus of US businesses to Mexico.
examples.translation: 这些贸易协定将会促使大批美国企业涌向墨西哥。

examples.text: ...a belief in competition as a spur to efficiency...
examples.translation: 认为竞争会促进效率的信念

examples.text: Redundancy is the spur for many to embark on new careers.
examples.translation: 裁员促使很多人开始从事新事业。

examples.text: They admitted they had taken a vehicle on the spur of the moment...
examples.translation: 他们承认是一时冲动偷走了一辆车。

examples.text: It wasn't a spur-of-the-moment decision. We discussed it in detail beforehand.
examples.translation: 这可不是头脑一热作出的决定。我们事先仔细地讨论过。

examples.text: Young conductors earn their spurs in a small orchestra or opera house.
examples.translation: 年轻的指挥家们在小乐队或小歌剧院里崭露头角。

examples.text: He was jailed for five years as an alleged British spy...
examples.translation: 他被指控为英国间谍，入狱关押了 5 年。

examples.text: The spy ring passed secrets to the enemy.
examples.translation: 该间谍团伙向敌方传送秘密情报。

examples.text: The agent spied for East Germany for more than twenty years...
examples.translation: 该特工人员为东德做了 20 多年的间谍。

examples.text: East and West are still spying on one another...
examples.translation: 东西方仍在互相进行间谍活动。

examples.text: I never agreed to spy against the United States.
examples.translation: 我从来没有答应去当间谍刺探美国的情报。

examples.text: ...a ten-year sentence for spying.
examples.translation: 因间谍罪判处的 10 年监禁

examples.text: That day he spied on her while pretending to work on the shrubs...
examples.translation: 那天，他假装在修剪灌木，秘密对她进行监视。

examples.text: He had his wife spied on for evidence in a divorce case.
examples.translation: 他请人秘密监视自己的妻子，为离婚案搜集证据。

examples.text: He was walking down the street when he spied an old friend.
examples.translation: 他正沿街走着，突然看见了一位老朋友。

examples.text: But it would be a great loss if digital became the grey squirrel of the arts.

meanings.meaning: 平方的；正方形的；直角的；正直的

examples.text: Serve the cake warm or at room temperature, cut in squares...
examples.translation: 等蛋糕温热或凉至室温时切成四方块端上桌。

examples.text: There was a calendar on the wall, with large squares around the dates...
examples.translation: 墙上有一幅日历，每个日期都用大方框框着。

examples.text: Most of the rugs are simple cotton squares.
examples.translation: 多数小地毯是简单的棉质方块垫。

examples.text: The house is located in one of Pimlico's prettiest garden squares...
examples.translation: 房子位于皮姆利科最美丽的一个花园广场上。

examples.text: The town centre is thick with churches and cafe-lined squares.
examples.translation: 市中心随处都是教堂和被咖啡店包围的广场。

examples.text: ...St Mark's Square.
examples.translation: 圣马克广场

examples.text: Round tables seat more people in the same space as a square table...
examples.translation: 在相同的空间里，圆桌比起方桌可以坐下更多的人。

examples.text: His finger nails were square and cut neatly across.
examples.translation: 他的手指甲是方形的，修剪得很齐。

examples.text: Canary Wharf was set to provide 10 million square feet of office space...
examples.translation: 金丝雀码头计划要提供 1,000 万平方英尺的办公面积。

examples.text: The Philippines has just 6,000 square kilometres of forest left.
examples.translation: 菲律宾只剩下 6,000 平方公里的森林了。

examples.text: ...a linen cushion cover, 45 cm square.
examples.translation: 一个亚麻靠垫套，长宽为 45 厘米

examples.text: ...two pieces of wood 4 inches square.
examples.translation: 两块长宽均为 4 英寸的木片

examples.text: Take the time in seconds, square it, and multiply by 5.12...
examples.translation: 记下用了多少秒时间，将其平方，再乘以5.12。

examples.text: A squared plus B squared equals C squared.
examples.translation: A 的平方加上 B 的平方等于 C 的平方。

examples.text: ...the square of the speed of light, an exceedingly large number.
examples.translation: 光速的平方，一个天文数字

examples.text: That explanation squares with the facts, doesn't it...
