examples.text: O'Brien sat on a bar stool and leaned his elbows on the counter.
examples.translation: 奥布赖恩坐在一张吧凳上，胳膊肘靠在吧台上。

meanings.meaning: 股份，股票；库存；血统；树干
(Stock)人名；(德、匈、捷)施托克；(英、法、葡、瑞典)斯托克

examples.text: ...the buying and selling of stocks and shares...
examples.translation: 证券和股票买卖

examples.text: As stock prices have dropped, so too has bank capital.
examples.translation: 随着股价下跌，银行资本也减少了。

examples.text: Two years later, when Compaq went public, their stock was valued at $38 million...
examples.translation: 康柏公司两年后上市时，他们的股本为 3,800 万美元。

examples.text: The Fisher family holds 40% of the stock.
examples.translation: 费希尔家族持有 40%的股份。

examples.text: The shop stocks everything from cigarettes to recycled loo paper.
examples.translation: 商店货品齐全，从香烟到再生厕纸应有尽有。

examples.text: We took the decision to withdraw a quantity of stock from sale.
examples.translation: 我们决定将一批存货下架。

examples.text: I worked stocking shelves in a grocery store...
examples.translation: 我在一家杂货店工作，负责为货架上货。

examples.text: Some families stocked their cellars with food and water...
examples.translation: 有些家庭在地窖里储备了食品和水。

examples.text: The kitchen cupboard was stocked with tins of soup.
examples.translation: 厨房的橱柜里堆满了罐装汤。

examples.text: I had to stock the boat up with food...
examples.translation: 我得在船上备足干粮。

examples.text: Customers travel from hundreds of miles away to stock up their deep freezes...
examples.translation: 为了在冷冻箱中储备食品，顾客们从几百英里以外的地方赶来购物。

examples.text: Start planning for Christmas now by stocking up the freezer with some festive dishes.
examples.translation: 现在就开始为圣诞节做准备吧，首先在冰箱里备足过节的菜肴。

examples.text: I keep a stock of cassette tapes describing various relaxation techniques...
examples.translation: 我收集了一些介绍各种放松技巧的卡带。

examples.text: Stocks of ammunition were running low.
examples.translation: 弹药的库存正在减少。

examples.text: ...the stock of accommodation available to be rented.
examples.translation: 可供租赁的住房储备量

examples.text: We are both from working class stock.
examples.translation: 我们俩都出身于工人家庭。

examples.text: ...blacks, Asians and people of Mediterranean stock.
examples.translation: 黑人、亚洲人和地中海沿岸高加索人的后裔

examples.text: I am carefully selecting the breeding stock...
examples.translation: 我正在精心挑选种畜。

examples.text: His herd of 170 dairy cattle and 200 young stock are kept on the land.
examples.translation: 他那170头奶牛和200头乳牛都在那块地上圈养。

examples.text: My boss had a stock response — 'If it ain't broke, don't fix it!'...
examples.translation: 我上司总是这一句——“别没事找事！”

examples.text: National security is the stock excuse for keeping things confidential.
examples.translation: 国家安全常被用作对一些事情保密的挡箭牌。

examples.text: Check that your size is in stock...
examples.translation: 查查你的尺码是否有货。

examples.text: Lemon and lime juice were both temporarily out of stock.
examples.translation: 柠檬汁和酸橙汁暂时都缺货。

examples.text: It was time to take stock of the situation...
examples.translation: 是时候统观一下形势了。

examples.text: I was forty, the age when people take stock and change their lives.
examples.translation: 我已年届不惑，到了该全面审视自己并改变生活的年龄了。

examples.text: She was taller than he was and stooped slightly.
examples.translation: 她比他高，而且略微有些驼背。

examples.text: He was a tall, thin fellow with a slight stoop.
examples.translation: 他是个瘦高个儿，有点驼背。

examples.text: ...a slender slightly stooping American.
examples.translation: 略有驼背的苗条美国人

examples.text: He stooped to pick up the carrier bag of groceries...
examples.translation: 他俯下身去提装着食品杂货的购物袋。

examples.text: Two men in shirt sleeves stooped over the car...
examples.translation: 两名穿衬衣的男子趴在那辆汽车上。

examples.text: Stooping down, he picked up a big stone and hurled it.
examples.translation: 他俯身捡起一块大石头扔了出去。

examples.text: He had not, until recently, stooped to personal abuse...
examples.translation: 他以前从未像最近这样卑鄙到进行人身攻击。

examples.text: They've stooped to using any and every weapon at their disposal...
examples.translation: 他们已经无耻到把能用的武器都用上了。

examples.text: How could anyone stoop so low?
examples.translation: 怎么会有人堕落到这种地步？

examples.text: They stood together on the stoop and rang the bell.
examples.translation: 他们一起站在门廊上按响了门铃。

meanings.meaning: (Stone)人名；(捷)斯托内；(瑞典)斯托内；(英)斯通

examples.text: He could not tell whether the floor was wood or stone...
examples.translation: 他无法确定地板是木头的还是石头的。

examples.text: People often don't appreciate that marble is a natural stone.
examples.translation: 人们经常不了解大理石是一种天然石料。

examples.text: ...stone walls.
examples.translation: 石墙

examples.text: He removed a stone from his shoe...
examples.translation: 他从鞋子里倒出一块石子。

examples.text: The crowd began throwing stones.
examples.translation: 人群开始扔石块。

examples.text: The monument consists of a circle of gigantic stones.
examples.translation: 该遗址由一圈巨大的石碑组成。

examples.text: He is merely throwing the idea forward for discussion, it is not cast in stone...
examples.translation: 他只是提出这个观点供讨论，它还没板上钉钉。

examples.text: Scientific opinions are not carved on tablets of stone; they change over the years.
examples.translation: 科学观点并非一成不变;它们随着时间而改变。

examples.text: ...a diamond ring with three stones.
examples.translation: 镶有 3 颗钻石的戒指

examples.text: He had kidney stones.
examples.translation: 他有肾结石。

examples.text: Then stone the fruit and process the plums to a puree.
examples.translation: 然后去核再将李子加工成糊状。

examples.text: Youths burned cars and stoned police...
examples.translation: 年轻人烧汽车，并向警察扔石头。

examples.text: A post office was set on fire and vehicles were stoned by looters.
examples.translation: 抢劫犯放火烧了一家邮局，并用石头砸车。

examples.text: I weighed around 16 stone.
examples.translation: 我体重约为16英石。

examples.text: ...a two-bedroom apartment just a stone's throw from the beach...
examples.translation: 离海滩只有几步之遥的一套两居室公寓

examples.text: Just a stone's throw away is the City Art Gallery.
examples.translation: 不远处就是市美术馆。

examples.text: He said he would leave no stone unturned in the search for peace.
examples.translation: 他说他会尽一切努力去寻求和平。

meanings.meaning: (Storey)人名；(西、瑞典)斯托雷；(英)斯托里

examples.text: Houses must not be more than two storeys high.
examples.translation: 房子的高度不得超过两层。

examples.text: ...the upper storeys of the Empire State Building.
examples.translation: 帝国大厦的最上面几层

examples.text: ...the storage of toxic waste...
examples.translation: 有毒废弃物的存放

examples.text: Some of the space will at first be used for storage...
examples.translation: 一部分空间将首先用于贮藏。

examples.text: The collection has been in storage for decades.
examples.translation: 这些收藏品已保管了几十年。

examples.text: His task is to ensure the fair use and storage of personal information held on computer.
examples.translation: 他的任务是确保计算机里的个人信息得到合理利用和妥善存储。

examples.text: ...data-storage devices.
examples.translation: 数据存储装置

examples.text: She put the kettle on the gas stove.
examples.translation: 她将水壶放在煤气炉上。

meanings.meaning: 起风暴；横冲直撞；狂怒咆哮
(Storm)人名；(瑞典)斯托姆；(德)施托姆；(英、西、芬)斯托姆

examples.text: ...the violent storms which whipped America's East Coast.
examples.translation: 席卷美国东海岸的猛烈暴风雨

examples.text: The photos caused a storm when they were first published...
examples.translation: 照片最初刊登出来时曾引起了一片公愤。

examples.text: The announcement provoked an immediate storm of protest.
examples.translation: 公告一发布就引发了一场强烈的抗议。

examples.text: ...the storm of publicity that Richard's book had generated.
examples.translation: 理查德的书所引起的媒体的极大关注

examples.text: His speech was greeted with a storm of applause...
examples.translation: 人们对他的演讲报以雷鸣般的掌声。

examples.text: Not since the 1968 Olympic Games has a medals ceremony caused such a storm of booing.
examples.translation: 自1968 年奥运会以来，没有哪次颁奖仪式引起过如此哗然的一片嘘声。

examples.text: After a bit of an argument, he stormed out...
examples.translation: 争吵了几句后，他气冲冲地走了出去。

examples.text: He stormed into an office, demanding to know where the head of department was.
examples.translation: 他气冲冲地闯进一间办公室，质问部门经理在哪里。

examples.text: 'It's a fiasco,' he stormed.
examples.translation: “这是场彻底的失败，”他怒吼道。

examples.text: Government buildings have been stormed and looted...
examples.translation: 政府大楼遭到了攻击和抢劫。

examples.text: The refugees decided to storm the embassy.
examples.translation: 难民们决定冲进大使馆。

examples.text: ...the storming of the Bastille.
examples.translation: 巴士底狱的攻陷

examples.text: Kenya's long distance runners have taken the athletics world by storm.
examples.translation: 肯尼亚的长跑运动员在田径界获得了巨大成功。

examples.text: He insists he will not resign and will weather the storm.
examples.translation: 他坚称自己不会辞职，一定渡过难关。

examples.text: Stop throwing those stones!...
examples.translation: 不要再扔那些石头了！

examples.text: He can't stop thinking about it...
examples.translation: 他没办法不再想这件事。

examples.text: I've been told to lose weight and stop smoking...
examples.translation: 我被告知要减肥并戒烟。

examples.text: I stopped working last year to have a baby...
examples.translation: 我去年因生小孩辞去了工作。

examples.text: Does either of the parties want to stop the fighting?...
examples.translation: 双方中没有一方想停止战斗吗？

examples.text: She stopped in mid-sentence.
examples.translation: 话说了半句她就停下不说了。

examples.text: He proposed a new diplomatic initiative to try to stop the war...
examples.translation: 他提出了一项新的外交计划以尽力阻止这场战争。

examples.text: If the fire isn't stopped, it could spread to 25,000 acres...
examples.translation: 如果大火不被扑灭，它可能会蔓延 2.5 万英亩。

examples.text: I think she really would have liked to stop us seeing each other...
examples.translation: 我认为她本来真的可能不想让我们俩继续交往下去。

examples.text: He put the radio on loud to stop himself thinking about it...
examples.translation: 他把收音机的音量开得很大，好让自己不再想这件事。

examples.text: Motherhood won't stop me from pursuing my acting career...
examples.translation: 做了母亲并不会阻止我继续追求我的演艺事业。

examples.text: There's nothing to stop you from doing a bit of exploring further afield.
examples.translation: 没有什么会阻止你到更远一些的地方探险。

examples.text: The rain had stopped and a star or two was visible over the mountains...
examples.translation: 雨停了，山顶上有一两颗星星在闪烁。

examples.text: The system overheated and filming had to stop...
examples.translation: 系统过热，拍摄工作只好停了下来。

examples.text: The music stopped and the lights were turned up...
examples.translation: 音乐停止，灯光亮起。

examples.text: They're treating it like a game, a novelty. That's got to stop.
examples.translation: 他们把这件事当成了一个游戏，觉得很新鲜。不能再那样下去了。

examples.text: The clock had stopped at 2.12 a.m...
examples.translation: 钟在凌晨 2 点 12 分时停了。

examples.text: His heart stopped three times...
examples.translation: 他的心脏曾 3 次停止跳动。

examples.text: Arnold stopped the engine and got out of the car...
examples.translation: 阿诺德关掉发动机，下了车。

examples.text: He stopped the machine and replayed the message.
examples.translation: 他关掉机子，重新放了一遍留言。

examples.text: The car failed to stop at an army checkpoint...
examples.translation: 那辆车没有在军方检查站停车。

examples.text: He stopped and let her catch up with him...
examples.translation: 他停下来，好让她追上自己。

examples.text: The event literally stopped the traffic...
examples.translation: 这一事件几乎让交通陷于停顿。

examples.text: The van was stopped at customs in Harwich.
examples.translation: 小货车在哈里奇海关被拦下了。

examples.text: People often wrongly open doors before the train has come to a stop...
examples.translation: 人们经常在火车还尚未完全停好时就违规打开车门。

examples.text: He slowed the car almost to a stop.
examples.translation: 他放慢车速，车几乎停住了。

examples.text: She doesn't stop to think about what she's saying...
examples.translation: 她都没有停下来想一想自己在说些什么。

examples.text: There is something rather strange about all this if one stops to consider it...
examples.translation: 如果停下来好好想想的话，就会发觉整件事情相当蹊跷。

examples.text: People who lead busy lives have no time to stop and reflect.
examples.translation: 忙忙碌碌的人们无暇停下来反思。

examples.text: The cafe owner has put up the required 'no smoking' signs, but thinks his responsibility stops there...
examples.translation: 咖啡馆老板已经按规定贴上了“禁止吸烟”的标志，但是他认为自己的责任就止于此。

examples.text: The good news did not stop there...
examples.translation: 好消息还不止这些。

examples.text: Once you cross over the thin line to acts of lawlessness, who knows where it stops?
examples.translation: 一旦你越过雷池开始干违法的事，谁知道哪里是个头呢？

examples.text: There was an Underground map above one of the windows and I counted the stops to West Hampstead...
examples.translation: 其中一扇窗户上方有一张地铁线路图，我数了数到西汉普斯特德站共有几站。

examples.text: They waited at a bus stop.
examples.translation: 他们在一个公共汽车站等车。

examples.text: He insisted we stop at a small restaurant just outside of Atlanta...
examples.translation: 他坚持让我们在亚特兰大市外不远的一家小餐馆歇歇脚。

examples.text: It would be a crime to travel all the way to Australia and not stop in Sydney.
examples.translation: 如果不远万里去了澳大利亚，却没在悉尼稍作停留，那真是一种罪过。

examples.text: The last stop in Mr Cook's lengthy tour was Paris...
examples.translation: 库克先生漫长旅程中的最后一站是巴黎。

examples.text: Mack was driving down from Vermont, with a stop in Boston to pick Sarah up.
examples.translation: 麦克正开车从佛蒙特向南行驶，中途经停波士顿接上萨拉。

examples.text: Their motive is money, and they will stop at nothing to get it.
examples.translation: 他们的动机是钱，为了钱他们会不择手段。

examples.text: New Zealand police vowed yesterday to pull out all the stops to find the killer.
examples.translation: 新西兰警方昨天发誓要竭尽全力抓到杀人凶手。

examples.text: His daughter should have stood up and put a stop to all these rumours.
examples.translation: 他的女儿早该站出来平息所有这些谣言。

examples.text: Like many politicians before him, Mr Bentley did not know when to stop...
examples.translation: 和过去的很多政客一样，本特利先生做事也没分寸。

examples.text: You should know when to stop asking questions.
examples.translation: 你应该知道什么事不该问。

meanings.meaning: 故事；小说；新闻报道；来历；假话

examples.text: The second story in the book is titled 'The Scholar'...
examples.translation: 书中的第二个故事题为《学者》。

examples.text: I shall tell you a story about four little rabbits.
examples.translation: 我要给你讲一个 4 只小兔子的故事。

examples.text: ...a popular love story with a happy ending.
examples.translation: 广受欢迎、结局圆满的爱情故事

examples.text: The parents all shared interesting stories about their children...
examples.translation: 父母之间都会分享自己孩子的一些趣事。

examples.text: Isak's story is typical of a child who has a specific learning disability.
examples.translation: 伊萨克的故事就是一个具有某种学习障碍的孩子的典型故事。

examples.text: ...the story of the women's movement in Ireland.
examples.translation: 爱尔兰妇女运动的记载

examples.text: He invented some story about a cousin.
examples.translation: 他骗别人说自己有位堂兄。

examples.text: Those are some of the top stories in the news...
examples.translation: 那些是报纸上的头条新闻。

examples.text: They'll do anything for a story.
examples.translation: 他们为抢到新闻会不择手段。

examples.text: ...front-page news stories.
examples.translation: 头版新闻报道

examples.text: I'd met him at a dance I'd gone to on my own. But that's another story.
examples.translation: 我有一次独自去参加舞会时遇上了他。但那是题外话了。

examples.text: To cut a long story short, I ended up as managing director.
examples.translation: 长话短说，我最终当上了总经理。

examples.text: Where Marcella lives, the rents are fairly cheap, but a little further north it's a different story.
examples.translation: 玛塞拉居住的地方，租金比较便宜，但稍稍再往北一点情况就不同了。

examples.text: It's the same old story. They want one person to do three people's jobs.
examples.translation: 又是老一套。他们想让 1 个人做 3 个人的工作。

examples.text: This may be true but it is only part of the story...
examples.translation: 这可能是真的，但它并不是事情的全部。

examples.text: Jane goes to great lengths to explain that this is not the whole story.
examples.translation: 简竭力地解释说那不是事情的全貌。

examples.text: He had already made up his mind before even hearing her side of the story.
examples.translation: 他没等听到她的解释就已经作出了决定。

examples.text: Bombs were planted in stores in Manchester and Blackpool.
examples.translation: 炸弹被安放在曼彻斯特和布莱克浦的几家商店里。

examples.text: ...grocery stores.
examples.translation: 杂货店

examples.text: ...a record store.
examples.translation: 唱片店

examples.text: Store the cookies in an airtight tin...
examples.translation: 把饼干贮存在一个密封罐里。

examples.text: Some types of garden furniture must be stored inside in the winter.
examples.translation: 有几类花园家具冬季必须存放在室内。

examples.text: He simply stored the tapes away...
examples.translation: 他只是将磁带存放起来。

examples.text: He's stored away nearly one ton of potatoes.
examples.translation: 他已经储备了近 1 吨马铃薯。

examples.text: Where in the brain do we store information about colours?
examples.translation: 我们在大脑的哪个部位储存有关颜色的信息？

examples.text: ...chips for storing data in electronic equipment.
examples.translation: 用于在电子仪器中储存数据的芯片

examples.text: I handed over my secret store of chocolate biscuits...
examples.translation: 我交出了自己偷偷藏起来的巧克力饼干。

examples.text: Dolly's store of drinking glasses had run out.
examples.translation: 多利存放的酒杯已经用完了。

examples.text: ...a decision taken in 1982 to build a store for spent fuel from submarines.
examples.translation: 1982 年作出的为潜艇废燃料建立一个储存库的决定

examples.text: ...a grain store.
examples.translation: 粮仓

examples.text: He possessed a vast store of knowledge...
examples.translation: 他知识渊博。

examples.text: Jessica dipped into her store of theatrical anecdotes.
examples.translation: 杰西卡翻阅了自己收集的大量演艺界的趣闻轶事资料。

examples.text: There were also surprises in store for me...
examples.translation: 也有一些令人吃惊的事在等着我。

examples.text: Who knows what lies in store for the President?
examples.translation: 谁知道总统将要面临什么？

examples.text: ...a retail group which sets great store by traditional values.
examples.translation: 重视传统价值观念的零售团体

meanings.meaning: 简单的；坦率的；明确的；径直的

examples.text: Disposable nappies are fairly straightforward to put on...
examples.translation: 一次性尿布很容易穿上。

examples.text: The question seemed straightforward enough.
examples.translation: 这个问题看起来够简单的。

examples.text: ...simple straightforward language.
examples.translation: 简单易懂的语言

examples.text: Acid rain is not straightforwardly attributable to the burning of coal...
examples.translation: 酸雨并非简单地由烧煤造成。

examples.text: Nor does scientific knowledge derive straightforwardly from experiments and observations.
examples.translation: 科学知识也并非简单地从试验和观察中得来。

examples.text: She is very blunt, very straightforward and very honest...
examples.translation: 她非常直率，很坦诚，也非常诚实。

examples.text: I was impressed by his straightforward intelligent manner.
examples.translation: 我很欣赏他的坦率和睿智。

examples.text: His daughter says straightforwardly that he was not good enough.
examples.translation: 他的女儿直言他不够好。

meanings.meaning: (Strange)人名；(英)斯特兰奇；(瑞典、塞)斯特朗格

examples.text: Then a strange thing happened...
examples.translation: 然后一件奇怪的事发生了。

examples.text: There was something strange about the flickering blue light...
examples.translation: 闪烁的蓝光有点怪异。

examples.text: It was so strange to see a policeman lying down, without his helmet...
examples.translation: 看到一位警察没戴头盔躺着很奇怪。

examples.text: It's strange how things turn out.
examples.translation: 事情的结局出乎意料。

examples.text: She noticed he was acting strangely...
examples.translation: 她注意到他举止怪异。

examples.text: America has no shortage of strangely named clubs...
examples.translation: 美国有不少名字稀奇古怪的俱乐部。

examples.text: The hut suddenly seemed strangely silent.
examples.translation: 小屋突然似乎安静得出奇。

examples.text: ...the breathy strangeness of the music.
examples.translation: 音乐里怪异的喘息声

examples.text: I ended up alone in a strange city...
examples.translation: 结果，我独自一人来到了一个陌生的城市。

examples.text: She was faced with a new job, in unfamiliar surroundings with strange people.
examples.translation: 她面对着一份全新工作，周围是陌生的环境和陌生的人。

examples.text: I felt all dizzy and strange.
examples.translation: 我感到非常头晕、不舒服。

meanings.meaning: (Stranger)人名；(瑞典)斯特朗格；(英)斯特兰杰

examples.text: Telling a complete stranger about your life is difficult...
examples.translation: 要对一个素昧平生的人谈自己的生活经历是比较困难。

examples.text: Sometimes I feel like I'm living with a stranger.
examples.translation: 有时我觉得自己和一个陌生人生活在一起。

examples.text: The women knew nothing of the dead girl. They were strangers.
examples.translation: 女人们都对死去的女孩一无所知。她们互不相识。

examples.text: 'You don't know much about our town, do you?'—'No, I'm a stranger here.'
examples.translation: “你不太了解我们这个镇，是吗？”——“是的，我是外地人。”

examples.text: He is no stranger to controversy...
examples.translation: 他是个颇具争议的人物。

examples.text: We were both strangers to diplomatic life.
examples.translation: 我们俩在外交方面都是生手。

meanings.meaning: 用带捆绑；用皮条抽打；约束
精力旺盛地工作；受束缚

examples.text: Nancy gripped the strap of her beach bag...
examples.translation: 南希抓住了自己沙滩包的带子。

examples.text: Brian pulled the straps through the buckles of his suitcase...
examples.translation: 布赖恩将带子穿过自己手提箱的带扣。

examples.text: She pulled the strap of her nightgown onto her shoulder...
examples.translation: 她将自己睡袍的吊带拉到肩膀上。

examples.text: I undid my watch strap.
examples.translation: 我解开了表带。

examples.text: Strapping the skis on the roof, we boarded the hovercraft in Dover...
examples.translation: 用带子把滑水板绑在船顶后，我们就在多佛登上了气垫船。

examples.text: She strapped the gun belt around her middle...
examples.translation: 她将枪带系在腰上。

examples.text: Through the basement window I saw him strap on his pink cycling helmet...
examples.translation: 透过地下室的窗户，我看到他正在把他那粉色的自行车头盔系在头上。

examples.text: The carer will have to do all the work: placing the patient on the seat, strapping him in, taking him off again at the top.
examples.translation: 护工将要全程照顾：将病人抱到座位上，替他系好安全带，到顶层后再将他抱下来。

meanings.meaning: 张力；拉紧；负担；扭伤；血缘

examples.text: The prison service is already under considerable strain...
examples.translation: 监狱系统已经承受了巨大的压力。

examples.text: The vast expansion in secondary education is putting an enormous strain on the system.
examples.translation: 中等教育的大幅扩张正对该系统造成巨大压力。

examples.text: ...the credit crunch caused by strains on the banking system.
examples.translation: 银行系统在多重压力之下紧缩信贷

examples.text: The volume of scheduled flights is straining the air traffic control system...
examples.translation: 定期航班的数量正让空中交通指挥系统不堪重负。

examples.text: Resources will be further strained by new demands for housing.
examples.translation: 资源将因新的住房需求而变得更紧张。

examples.text: She was tired and under great strain.
examples.translation: 她身心疲惫，压力很大。

examples.text: ...the stresses and strains of a busy and demanding career.
examples.translation: 忙碌而辛苦的工作带来的巨大压力

examples.text: I sometimes find it a strain to be responsible for the mortgage.
examples.translation: 我有时觉得背负这笔抵押贷款很有压力。

examples.text: Place your hands under your buttocks to take some of the strain off your back...
examples.translation: 将手放在臀部下面，减轻背部的一些压力。

examples.text: A build-up of strain on a section of the San Andreas Fault has been detected.
examples.translation: 已经勘测到圣安德烈亚斯断层的其中一处所承受的拉力在增强。

examples.text: Avoid muscle strain by warming up with slow jogging.
examples.translation: 先慢跑热热身，免得拉伤肌肉。

examples.text: ...a groin strain.
examples.translation: 腹股沟拉伤

examples.text: He strained his back during a practice session.
examples.translation: 他在一次锻炼中扭伤了背部。

examples.text: I had to strain to hear...
examples.translation: 我不得不使劲去听。

examples.text: Several thousand supporters strained to catch a glimpse of the new president...
examples.translation: 几千名支持者翘首企盼能一睹新总统的风采。

examples.text: They strained their eyes, but saw nothing.
examples.translation: 他们瞪大了双眼，但什么也没看到。

examples.text: Strain the stock and put it back into the pan.
examples.translation: 滤出原汁，将它放回到平底锅中。

examples.text: There was a strain of bitterness in his voice.
examples.translation: 他的声音听起来有些愤愤不平。

examples.text: ...this cynical strain in the book.
examples.translation: 该书中这种愤世嫉俗的意味

examples.text: Every year new strains of influenza develop.
examples.translation: 每年都有新的流感病毒出现。

examples.text: ...a particularly beautiful strain of Swiss pansies.
examples.translation: 一种格外美丽的瑞士三色堇

examples.text: She could hear the tinny strains of a chamber orchestra.
examples.translation: 她能听见室内管弦乐队尖细的旋律。

examples.text: Next week, health ministers gather in Amsterdam to agree a strategy for controlling malaria...
examples.translation: 下周，卫生部长们将在阿姆斯特丹聚首共商防治疟疾的策略。

examples.text: What should our marketing strategy have achieved?...
examples.translation: 我们的销售策略应该取得了哪些成果呢？

examples.text: Community involvement is now integral to company strategy.
examples.translation: 参与社会活动如今已是公司战略中必不可少的内容。

examples.text: I've just been explaining the basic principles of strategy to my generals.
examples.translation: 我刚刚一直在向各位将军解释战略学的基本原理。

examples.text: ...strawberries and cream.
examples.translation: 奶油草莓

examples.text: ...homemade strawberry jam.
examples.translation: 自制草莓酱

meanings.meaning: 稻草；吸管；一文不值的东西

examples.text: The barn was full of bales of straw...
examples.translation: 谷仓里堆满了成捆的稻草。

examples.text: I stumbled through mud to a yard strewn with straw.
examples.translation: 我跌跌撞撞地趟过泥地来到一个堆满麦秆的场院。

examples.text: ...a wide-brimmed straw hat.
examples.translation: 宽沿草帽

examples.text: ...a bottle of lemonade with a straw in it.
examples.translation: 一瓶插着吸管的柠檬水

examples.text: ...a badly thought-out scheme from a Government clutching at straws.
examples.translation: 政府情急之下采取的考虑欠周的计划

examples.text: For him the Church's decision to allow the ordination of women had been the last straw...
examples.translation: 教会同意授给女性神职的决定使他终于忍无可忍。

examples.text: Then came the recession. Revenues dropped, but the straw to break the camel's back was the war.
examples.translation: 之后出现了经济衰退，财政收入下降，但致命的打击还是那场战争。

examples.text: ...if a few of your guests have drawn the short straw and agreed to drive others home after your summer barbecue.
examples.translation: 如果你的一些客人不幸被抓了壮丁，同意在夏日烧烤野餐结束后开车把其他人送回家

examples.text: The latest straw in the wind is a pick-up in sales among the nation's retail giants.
examples.translation: 最新的迹象是该国几家零售巨头的销售额有所上升。

meanings.meaning: 直的；连续的；笔直的；正直的；整齐的
直接地；不断地；立即；坦率地

examples.text: Keep the boat in a straight line...
examples.translation: 让船保持直线航行。

examples.text: Using the straight edge as a guide, trim the cloth to size...
examples.translation: 用直尺比照着，将布料裁剪成合适的尺寸。

examples.text: His teeth were perfectly straight...
examples.translation: 他的牙齿非常整齐。

examples.text: There wasn't a single straight wall in the building.
examples.translation: 这幢楼里连一面平直的墙都没有。

examples.text: Stand straight and stretch the left hand to the right foot...
examples.translation: 站直身体，伸左手够右脚。

examples.text: Turn right and just basically walk straight, right over the river.
examples.translation: 向右转，然后大致直着往前走，越过小河。

examples.text: Grace had long straight dark hair which she wore in a bun.
examples.translation: 格雷斯把一头长长的黑色直发盘成发髻。

examples.text: The ball fell straight to the feet of Klinsmann...
examples.translation: 球直接落到了克林斯曼的脚上。

examples.text: He finished his conversation and stood up, looking straight at me...
examples.translation: 他说完话站起来，直视着我。

examples.text: Straight ahead were the low cabins of the motel.
examples.translation: 正前方就是汽车旅馆的低矮小木屋。

examples.text: As always, we went straight to the experts for advice...
examples.translation: 像往常一样，我们马上去找专家咨询。

examples.text: We'll go to a meeting in Birmingham and come straight back.
examples.translation: 我们将去伯明翰参加会议，然后马上回来。

examples.text: What a shifty arguer he is, refusing ever to give a straight answer.
examples.translation: 他真是个狡诈的辩论家，总是拒绝给出直截了当的回答。

examples.text: I lost my temper and told him straight that I hadn't been looking for any job.
examples.translation: 我生气了，直截了当地告诉他我压根儿就没在找工作。

examples.text: They'd won 12 straight games before they lost.
examples.translation: 他们在输掉比赛之前已连续赢了12场。

examples.text: He called from Weddington, having been there for 31 hours straight.
examples.translation: 他从韦丁顿打电话过来时已在那儿呆了整整 31 个小时了。

examples.text: It's a straight choice between low-paid jobs and no jobs...
examples.translation: 只有两个选择：要么是报酬很低的工作，要么就是失业。

examples.text: Each has several times beaten the other in a straight fight.
examples.translation: 双方都曾在单打比赛中击败过对方几次。

examples.text: Dorothy was described as a very straight woman, a very strict Christian who was married to her job.
examples.translation: 多萝西被形容成一个非常正统的女人，一个尽职尽责、非常虔诚的基督徒。

examples.text: His sexual orientation was a lot more gay than straight...
examples.translation: 从他的性取向来看，他不像异性恋，更像个同性恋。

examples.text: Marty of New York describes herself as a straight female.
examples.translation: 纽约的马蒂称自己不是女同性恋者。

examples.text: ...a standard of sexual conduct that applies equally to gays and straights.
examples.translation: 同时适用于同性恋者和异性恋者的性行为准则

examples.text: ...a large straight whiskey without ice...
examples.translation: 不加冰的大杯纯威士忌

examples.text: Children should not drink fruit juices straight.
examples.translation: 儿童不应该喝纯果汁。

examples.text: Our cars were clearly too slow along the straights...
examples.translation: 我们的赛车在直道上跑得显然太慢了。

examples.text: I went to overtake him on the back straight on the last lap.
examples.translation: 最后一圈时我在非终点直道上超过了他。

examples.text: You need to get your facts straight...
examples.translation: 你需要讲清楚你的情况。

examples.text: Let's get things straight. I didn't lunch with her.
examples.translation: 咱们把事情说清楚。我没有和她一起吃午饭。

examples.text: All her efforts to keep him on the straight and narrow have been rewarded.
examples.translation: 她为了让他走正道所作出的一切努力都得到了回报。

meanings.meaning: 把…做成流线型；使现代化；组织；使合理化；使简单化

examples.text: They're making efforts to streamline their normally cumbersome bureaucracy...
examples.translation: 他们正努力精简本来繁冗复杂的官僚体制。

examples.text: They say things should be better now that they have streamlined application procedures.
examples.translation: 他们称鉴于他们已经简化了申请手续，情况应该会有所好转。

examples.text: ...streamlined companies using cheap freelance staff.
examples.translation: 雇用廉价自由职业者的精简高效的公司

examples.text: There was a small stream at the end of the garden.
examples.translation: 花园的尽头有一条小河。

examples.text: ...a mountain stream.
examples.translation: 山涧

examples.text: He breathed out a stream of cigarette smoke...
examples.translation: 他吐出一缕烟。

examples.text: Add the oil in a slow, steady stream.
examples.translation: 缓慢、平稳地加油。

examples.text: There was a stream of traffic behind him.
examples.translation: 在他身后是长长的车流。

examples.text: The discovery triggered a stream of readers' letters.
examples.translation: 该发现引来了读者接二连三的来信。

examples.text: ...a never-ending stream of jokes...
examples.translation: 一个接一个的笑话

examples.text: We had a constant stream of visitors.
examples.translation: 我们这里的游客络绎不绝。

examples.text: Tears streamed down their faces...
examples.translation: 泪水顺着他们的脸颊流下。

examples.text: She came in, rain streaming from her clothes and hair.
examples.translation: 她进来时，雨水顺着她的衣服和头发往下流。

examples.text: Her eyes were streaming now from the wind...
examples.translation: 她的眼睛被风吹得直流泪。

examples.text: A cold usually starts with a streaming nose and dry throat.
examples.translation: 感冒开始时通常会流鼻涕、嗓子发干。

examples.text: Refugees have been streaming into Travnik for months...
examples.translation: 几个月来不断有难民涌入特拉夫尼克。

examples.text: The traffic streamed past him...
examples.translation: 车一辆一辆地从他身边疾驶而过。

examples.text: The clock in the church struck twelve, and soon after people began to stream out.
examples.translation: 教堂的钟敲响了十二点，不久人们便开始鱼贯而出。

examples.text: Sunlight was streaming into the courtyard.
examples.translation: 阳光照到院子里。

examples.text: She was wearing a flimsy pink dress that streamed out behind her...
examples.translation: 她穿的那件轻薄的粉红色连衣裙在身后飘舞。

examples.text: He had been greeted by the sight of his mother, her red hair wildly streaming.
examples.translation: 他最先看见了他母亲，她红色的头发在风中狂舞。

examples.text: Examinations may be used to choose which pupils are to move into the top streams.
examples.translation: 可以采取考试的方式来决定让哪些学生进入高阶班。

examples.text: He advocates streaming children, and educating them according to their needs.
examples.translation: 他提倡把学生按能力分班，因需施教。

examples.text: There's no streaming at St Benedict's school.
examples.translation: 圣贝尼迪克特学校不分高低班。

examples.text: As new mines come on stream, Chile's share of world copper output will increase sharply...
examples.translation: 新矿投产后，智利在世界铜产量中所占的份额将大幅增加。

examples.text: This spring RF will also bring on stream the Hotel de Russie in Rome and the Savoy in Florence. RF
examples.translation: 旗下的罗马露兹大酒店和佛罗伦萨萨伏伊酒店也将在今年春季开始营业。

meanings.meaning: 紧张的；费力的；奋发的；艰苦的；热烈的

examples.text: Avoid strenuous exercise in the evening...
examples.translation: 晚上不要做剧烈运动。

examples.text: These trips were strenuous, and the couple did not enjoy them...
examples.translation: 一路舟车劳顿，这对夫妇玩得并不开心。

examples.text: Strenuous efforts had been made to improve conditions in the jail...
examples.translation: 已经做了大量的努力来改善监狱的条件。

examples.text: Despite strenuous objections by the right wing, the grant was agreed.
examples.translation: 尽管右翼分子极力反对，拨款还是通过了。

examples.text: Exercising too much or too strenuously is just as bad as not doing it at all...
examples.translation: 运动过量或过度和不运动一样有害身体健康。

examples.text: The company concerned has strenuously denied the accusations.
examples.translation: 有关公司极力否认这些指控。

meanings.meaning: (Street)人名；(英、葡)斯特里特；(德)施特雷特

examples.text: He lived at 66 Bingfield Street...
examples.translation: 他住在宾菲尔德大街 66 号。

examples.text: Boppard is a small, quaint town with narrow streets.
examples.translation: 博帕德是一个有着许多深巷窄道、古香古色的小镇。

examples.text: Changing money on the street is illegal — always use a bank...
examples.translation: 在街头兑换货币是违法的——无论何时都应该去银行。

examples.text: Their aim is to raise a million pounds to get the homeless off the streets.
examples.translation: 他们的目标是筹集 100 万英镑，使那些无家可归者不再流浪街头。

examples.text: ...a New York street gang.
examples.translation: 纽约街头帮派

examples.text: He was streets ahead of the other contestants.
examples.translation: 他比其他参赛选手水平高出一大截。

examples.text: The average man or woman in the street doesn't know very much about immune disorders.
examples.translation: 普通人一般不是很了解何谓免疫机能紊乱。

examples.text: She loved it, this was just up her street.
examples.translation: 她喜欢这个，这正中她的意。

examples.text: ...the new constitution, which strengthens the government and enables it to balance and check the powers of parliament and president...
examples.translation: 巩固了政府的地位并使其能够制衡国会和总统权力的新宪法

examples.text: To strengthen his position in Parliament, he held talks with leaders of the Peasant Party...
examples.translation: 为巩固其在国会中的地位，他曾与农民党的领导人进行多次会谈。

examples.text: He hoped to strengthen the position of the sciences in the leading universities.
examples.translation: 他希望强化自然科学在一流大学里的地位。

examples.text: He does not seem to be familiar with research which might have strengthened his own arguments.
examples.translation: 他对那些本可以为他的观点提供佐证的研究似乎并不熟悉。

examples.text: The dollar strengthened against most other currencies...
examples.translation: 美元相对大多数其他货币都升值了。

examples.text: If the Government wants to save the Pound it should start by strengthening the British economy.
examples.translation: 如果政府想让英镑保值，那么首先就应该加强英国的经济。

examples.text: I am also looking urgently at how we can strengthen the law...
examples.translation: 我也在急切地关注我们该如何加强法制。

examples.text: Community leaders want to strengthen controls at external frontiers...
examples.translation: 社区领导想要加强对小区外围的管理。

examples.text: Because of the war, security procedures have strengthened.
examples.translation: 由于战争，安保程序变得更加严格。

examples.text: Any experience can teach and strengthen you, but particularly the more difficult ones...
examples.translation: 任何经历都能使你从中受益并让你变得坚强，而那些比较艰难的经历尤其如此。

examples.text: This merely strengthens our resolve to win the league...
examples.translation: 这只会更加坚定我们赢得联赛的决心。

examples.text: She began to believe that Nick would survive, and every day that came and went strengthened her conviction.
examples.translation: 她开始相信尼克会活下来，而且这种信念与日俱增。

examples.text: It will draw you closer together, and it will strengthen the bond of your relationship...
examples.translation: 这将使你们走得更近，并将增进你们之间的关系。

examples.text: His visit is intended to strengthen ties between the two countries...
examples.translation: 他此次访问旨在增进两国间的关系。

examples.text: In a strange way, his affair caused our relationship to strengthen.
examples.translation: 奇怪的是，他的婚外恋倒使我们之间的关系更加紧密了。

examples.text: His speech strengthens the impression he is the main power in the organization...
examples.translation: 他的演讲让人更加确信他才是该组织的主心骨。

examples.text: Every day of sunshine strengthens the feelings of optimism...
examples.translation: 每天晒太阳让人心情更加开朗。

examples.text: Amy's own Republican sympathies strengthened as the days passed.
examples.translation: 埃米个人对共和党的支持与日俱增。

examples.text: Cycling is good exercise. It strengthens all the muscles of the body...
examples.translation: 骑自行车是一项不错的锻炼方式。它能使身体各部分的肌肉更强健。

examples.text: Yoga can be used to strengthen the immune system.
examples.translation: 瑜伽能增强人体免疫系统。

examples.text: The builders will have to strengthen the existing joists with additional timber.
examples.translation: 施工人员将不得不另外用木料加固现有的托梁。

examples.text: As it strengthened the wind was veering southerly...
examples.translation: 风越刮越大，逐渐转为南风。

examples.text: There was a short sharp shower followed by a strengthening breeze.
examples.translation: 一场短时强阵雨后风势渐长。

examples.text: She has always been encouraged to swim to build up the strength of her muscles...
examples.translation: 一直有人鼓励她去游泳以强健体魄。

examples.text: He threw it forward with all his strength...
examples.translation: 他使尽全力把它扔向前方。

examples.text: You don't need strength to take part in this sport...
examples.translation: 参加这项运动不需要太多体力。

examples.text: He leant against the wall, fighting for strength to continue.
examples.translation: 他靠在墙上，努力想鼓起劲继续下去。

examples.text: Something gave me the strength to overcome the difficulty...
examples.translation: 有些事给了我克服困难的勇气。

examples.text: His strength is an inspiration to me in my life...
examples.translation: 他的自信是对我人生的一种鼓舞。

examples.text: I think she showed great strength of character in turning down what must have been a very lucrative offer...
examples.translation: 她拒绝了那个绝对诱人的提议，我认为这显示出了她性格中非凡的意志力。

examples.text: You need strength of mind to stand up for yourself.
examples.translation: 你需要用精神力量来支持自己。

examples.text: He checked the strength of the cables.
examples.translation: 他检查了一下钢索的强度。

examples.text: ...the properties of a material, such as strength or electrical conductivity.
examples.translation: 一种材料的特性，比如强度或导电性

examples.text: America values its economic leadership, and the political and military strength that goes with it...
examples.translation: 美国重视其经济领导地位以及随之产生的政治和军事实力。

examples.text: The Alliance in its first show of strength drew a hundred thousand-strong crowd to a rally...
examples.translation: 该联盟的第一次实力展示便吸引了 10 万余众参加集会。

examples.text: They have their own independence movement which is gathering strength.
examples.translation: 他们自己发起了独立运动，其力量正逐渐壮大。

examples.text: He was surprised at the strength of his own feeling...
examples.translation: 他感情之强烈令他自己都很吃惊。

examples.text: ...the Civil War and the strength of feeling it had engendered among the Spanish people...
examples.translation: 内战以及其在西班牙民众中所激发的强烈情感

examples.text: What makes a mayor successful in Los Angeles is the strength of his public support.
examples.translation: 要想在洛杉矶当好市长，公众的大力支持是关键。

examples.text: Take into account your own strengths and weaknesses...
examples.translation: 考虑一下你自己的优缺点。

examples.text: Vision and ambition are his great strengths...
examples.translation: 目光远大、雄心勃勃是他的两大优点。

examples.text: Tact was never Mr Moore's strength...
examples.translation: 摩尔先生处事不够圆通。

examples.text: Organisation is the strength of any good army...
examples.translation: 任何优良部队都是很有组织纪律性的。

examples.text: The book's strength lay in its depiction of present-day Tokyo.
examples.translation: 该书的精彩之处在于其对现今东京的描写。

examples.text: ...the long-term competitive strength of the American economy...
examples.translation: 美国经济的长期竞争力

examples.text: The drop was caused partly by the pound's strength against the dollar.
examples.translation: 下降的部分原因在于英镑对美元的升值。

examples.text: ...elite forces, comprising about one-tenth of the strength of the army.
examples.translation: 约占军队总人数1/10的精锐部队

examples.text: Its oscillation depends on the strength of the gravitational field...
examples.translation: 它的振动幅度取决于引力场的强度。

examples.text: A tropical storm is gaining strength in the eastern Atlantic.
examples.translation: 在大西洋东部，一场热带风暴的风力正逐渐增强。

examples.text: It is very alcoholic, sometimes near the strength of port...
examples.translation: 它的酒精浓度很高，有时接近波尔图葡萄酒的浓度。

examples.text: Each capsule contains between 30 and 100 pellets of morphine sulphate according to the strength of dose required...
examples.translation: 根据所需剂量的浓度不同，每颗胶囊里含有 30 至 100 个吗啡硫酸盐颗粒。

examples.text: What's the scale that's used to compare the strength of acids and alkalis?
examples.translation: 用何种标准来比较酸碱度？

examples.text: The wine has lots of strength of flavour.
examples.translation: 该酒口味醇厚。

examples.text: Since her heart and lung transplant operation she has gone from strength to strength...
examples.translation: 做过心肺移植手术后，她的身体不断好转。

examples.text: A decade later, the company has gone from strength to strength.
examples.translation: 十年后，该公司已经逐渐壮大。

examples.text: He needed more time to bring US forces there up to full strength.
examples.translation: 他需要更多时间来增派兵力，以确保驻扎在那里的美国军队兵力充足。

examples.text: ...a full-strength team.
examples.translation: 阵容齐整的队伍

examples.text: Mr Gore called on voters and party workers to turn out in strength...
examples.translation: 戈尔先生号召选民和政党工作人员积极前来投票。

examples.text: Security forces have been out in strength.
examples.translation: 已经出动了大批安全部队。

examples.text: He was elected to power on the strength of his charisma...
examples.translation: 他凭借其个人魅力而当选掌权。

examples.text: On the strength of those grades, he won a scholarship to Syracuse University.
examples.translation: 凭借那些成绩，他赢得了锡拉丘兹大学的奖学金。

examples.text: His regiments were considerably under strength...
examples.translation: 他的几个团兵力严重不足。

examples.text: They had been beaten by a below-strength side.
examples.translation: 他们被一支阵容不齐的队伍打败了。

meanings.meaning: 严格的；绝对的；精确的；详细的

examples.text: The officials had issued strict instructions that we were not to get out of the jeep...
examples.translation: 有关官员严令禁止我们下吉普车。

examples.text: French privacy laws are very strict...
examples.translation: 法国的隐私法非常严苛。

examples.text: All your replies will be treated in the strictest confidence...
examples.translation: 你的所有答复都将绝对保密。

examples.text: Even if you are on a fairly strict diet you can still go out for a good meal.
examples.translation: 即使是在严格地节食，也可以出去吃顿好的。

examples.text: The acceptance of new members is strictly controlled.
examples.translation: 新成员的吸纳受到严格的限制。

examples.text: My parents were very strict.
examples.translation: 父母对我要求非常严格。

examples.text: ...a few schools selected for their high standards and their strict discipline.
examples.translation: 因教学水平高、纪律严而入选的几所学校

examples.text: My own mother was brought up very strictly and correctly.
examples.translation: 我母亲从小接受严格而规范的教育。

examples.text: The girl lied because she resented her parents' strictness.
examples.translation: 由于不满父母的严厉态度，这个女孩撒了谎。

examples.text: It's not quite peace in the strictest sense of the word, rather the absence of war.
examples.translation: 严格说来，这并不是真正的和平，只是没有战争罢了。

examples.text: Actually, that is not strictly true...
examples.translation: 事实上，严格说来那不是真的。

examples.text: Strictly speaking, it is not one house at all, but three houses joined together.
examples.translation: 严格来说，这根本不是一间房子，而是三间房子连在一起。

examples.text: Four million Britons are now strict vegetarians...
examples.translation: 目前有400万英国人是严格的素食者。

examples.text: He was a strict, old-school Freudian.
examples.translation: 他是个不折不扣、传统守旧的弗洛伊德学说信奉者。

meanings.meaning: 压力；强调；紧张；重要性；重读
强调；使紧张；加压力于；用重音读

examples.text: The spokesman stressed that the measures did not amount to an overall ban...
examples.translation: 该发言人强调这些措施并不等同于全面禁止。

examples.text: They also stress the need for improved employment opportunities, better transport and health care...
examples.translation: 他们同时也强调需要增加就业机会，改善交通和医疗保健服务。

examples.text: 'We're not saying we're outside and above all this,' he stresses.
examples.translation: “我们并不是说我们对此不闻不问，”他强调道。

examples.text: Japanese car makers are laying ever more stress on European sales.
examples.translation: 日本汽车制造商比以往任何时候都更加重视欧洲市场的销售情况。

examples.text: Katy could think clearly when not under stress...
examples.translation: 在没有精神压力的情况下凯蒂思路清晰。

examples.text: Of course, the British will suffer such daily stresses patiently.
examples.translation: 当然，英国人将会耐心地承受这些日常压力。

examples.text: ...a wide range of stress-related problems.
examples.translation: 与精神压力有关的一系列问题

examples.text: Earthquakes happen when stresses in rock are suddenly released as the rocks fracture.
examples.translation: 当岩石碎裂时其承受的压力突然释放出来，地震就发生了。

examples.text: 'Sit down,' she replied, stressing each word.
examples.translation: “坐下，”她一字一顿地说道。

examples.text: ...the misplaced stress on the first syllable of this last word.
examples.translation: 最后这一个单词第一个音节不应重读

meanings.meaning: 跨过；大踏步走过；跨坐在…

examples.text: They were joined by a newcomer who came striding across a field...
examples.translation: 一个新来的人大步穿过一片田地，加入到他们的行列。

examples.text: He turned abruptly and strode off down the corridor.
examples.translation: 他突然转身，沿走廊大步流星地走了。

examples.text: With every stride, runners hit the ground with up to five times their body-weight...
examples.translation: 赛跑者每一步落地时对地面的压力最大能达到其体重的 5 倍。

examples.text: He walked with long strides.
examples.translation: 他阔步走着。

examples.text: He lengthened his stride to keep up with her.
examples.translation: 他迈大步追上她。

examples.text: The country has made enormous strides politically but not economically.
examples.translation: 该国在政治上取得了巨大的发展，但经济却跟不上去。

examples.text: The campaign is just getting into its stride...
examples.translation: 运动刚开始有点起色。

examples.text: He's still learning and when he hits his stride, he'll be unstoppable.
examples.translation: 他仍旧处在学习阶段，一旦驾轻就熟后将势不可挡。

examples.text: Beth was struck by how Naomi took the mistake in her stride.
examples.translation: 娜奥米在失误面前表现得处乱不惊，给贝丝留下了深刻印象。

examples.text: Money is a major cause of strife in many marriages...
examples.translation: 金钱是造成很多婚姻不和的一个主要原因。

examples.text: The boardroom strife at the company is far from over...
examples.translation: 公司董事会的明争暗斗还远没有结束。

examples.text: It remains a highly unstable and strife-torn country.
examples.translation: 这仍是一个动荡不安、冲突不断的国家。

examples.text: The procession stretched for several miles...
examples.translation: 游行队伍长达数英里。

examples.text: He had burns that stretched from his neck to his hips.
examples.translation: 他从脖子到臀部均被烧伤。

examples.text: ...an artificial reef stretching the length of the coast.
examples.translation: 沿着海岸延伸的人造暗礁

examples.text: It's a very dangerous stretch of road...
examples.translation: 这是一段非常危险的路。

examples.text: This stretch of Lost River was broader and deeper.
examples.translation: 洛斯特里弗的这片水域又宽又深。

examples.text: ...a long stretch of beach with fine white sand.
examples.translation: 沙粒又细又白的一大片海滩

examples.text: He yawned and stretched...
examples.translation: 他打了个呵欠，伸了伸懒腰。

examples.text: Try stretching your legs and pulling your toes upwards...
examples.translation: 试着双腿伸直并且向上拉伸脚趾。

examples.text: She arched her back and stretched herself.
examples.translation: 她弓起背，舒展身体。

examples.text: At the end of a workout spend time cooling down with some slow stretches.
examples.translation: 训练结束后花时间做些缓慢的伸展运动来降降温。

examples.text: Make sure no awkward stretching is required.
examples.translation: 确定不用做太难的伸展动作。

examples.text: He was fluent in French, having spent stretches of time in Southern France.
examples.translation: 他曾在法国南部呆过一段时间，法语流利。

examples.text: ...after an 18-month stretch in the army...
examples.translation: 在部队生活了 18 个月后

examples.text: He would study for eight to ten hours at a stretch.
examples.translation: 他会一口气学习 8 到 10 个小时。

examples.text: ...as anti-abortion protests stretched into their second week...
examples.translation: 随着反堕胎抗议进入第二周

examples.text: The talks could be stretched into the summer of 1993.
examples.translation: 该谈判可能会延续至 1993 年夏天。

examples.text: ...a working day that stretches from seven in the morning to eight at night.
examples.translation: 从早上 7 点持续到晚上 8 点的工作日

examples.text: ...a trading empire, with interests that stretched from chemicals to sugar.
examples.translation: 从化学制品到食糖均有涉足的贸易帝国

examples.text: The cables are designed not to stretch...
examples.translation: 该电缆不能拉伸。

examples.text: Ease the pastry into the corners of the tin, making sure you don't stretch it.
examples.translation: 将油酥面团小心地移至烤盘的各角，注意不要把它拉长。

examples.text: ...stretch fabrics such as Lycra.
examples.translation: 莱卡等有弹性的织物

examples.text: ...stretch cotton swimsuits.
examples.translation: 弹力棉制泳衣

examples.text: They're used to stretching their budgets...
examples.translation: 他们习惯于精打细算。

examples.text: During his senior year his earnings stretched far enough to buy an old car.
examples.translation: 他上年纪时省下的收入足够买一辆旧车了。

examples.text: She suggested to me that I might like to start regular savings and I said Well, I don't know whether I can stretch to that.
examples.translation: 她建议我可以开始定期存钱，我说我还不知道钱是不是够花呢。

examples.text: The drought there is stretching American resources...
examples.translation: 那里的旱灾正在耗尽美国的财力物力。

examples.text: Public expenditure was being stretched to the limit by having to support 3 million unemployed people.
examples.translation: 因为要救济 300 万失业人口，公共支出即将被耗尽。

examples.text: The deal will also help the company's stretched finances.
examples.translation: 这笔生意也将有助于缓解公司的资金紧张状况。

examples.text: I'm trying to move on and stretch myself with something different...
examples.translation: 我正想换工作，想尝试点不一样的事情来挑战一下自己。

examples.text: They criticised the quality of teaching, claiming pupils were not stretched enough.
examples.translation: 他们批评教学质量太差，声称没有使学生们发挥出潜质。

examples.text: He offered his lighter at full stretch.
examples.translation: 他伸长胳膊把打火机递了过去。

examples.text: Everyone would be working at full stretch.
examples.translation: 每个人都将全力以赴。

examples.text: Her husband was not a womaniser by any stretch of the imagination...
examples.translation: 她老公绝对不是个拈花惹草的人。

examples.text: By no stretch of the imagination could his speech be described as impersonal.
examples.translation: 他的演讲再怎么说也不缺乏人情味。

examples.text: I stopped at the square and got out to stretch my legs.
examples.translation: 我在广场处停下来，下车活动活动腿脚。

examples.text: It is stretching a point to call this censorship.
examples.translation: 把这称为审查有点儿牵强。

meanings.meaning: 扎，缚；使排成一列，串起；伸展，拉直

examples.text: He held out a small bag tied with string.
examples.translation: 他拿出一个系着细绳的小袋子。

examples.text: ...a shiny metallic coin on a string.
examples.translation: 拴在绳子上的闪闪发亮的金属硬币

examples.text: She wore a string of pearls around her neck.
examples.translation: 她脖子上戴着一串珍珠。

examples.text: ...a string of fairy lights.
examples.translation: 一串圣诞树小彩灯

examples.text: The landscape is broken only by a string of villages...
examples.translation: 这片风景中只有一排村庄。

examples.text: A string of five rowing boats set out from the opposite bank.
examples.translation: 5 只划艇排成一行从对岸出发了。

examples.text: The incident was the latest in a string of attacks...
examples.translation: 这是一连串袭击事件中最近的一起。

examples.text: Between 1940 and 1943 he had a string of 62 consecutive victories.
examples.translation: 他在 1940 年至 1943 年间连续 62 次获胜。

examples.text: He went off to change a guitar string.
examples.translation: 他出去换一根吉他弦。

examples.text: ...a twenty-one-string harp.
examples.translation: 21 弦的竖琴

examples.text: The strings provided a melodic background to the passages played by the soloist...
examples.translation: 弦乐组为独奏乐章配上了动听的背景乐。

examples.text: There was a 20-member string section.
examples.translation: 有一个 20 人组成的弦乐器组。

examples.text: He had strung a banner across the wall.
examples.translation: 他在墙上挂了条横幅。

examples.text: People were stringing up decorations on the fronts of their homes.
examples.translation: 人们正在各家门口挂起装饰物。

examples.text: I'm never out of work because I have so many strings to my bow.
examples.translation: 我会很多手艺，永远都不会没饭吃。

examples.text: Aid should be given to developing countries with no strings attached.
examples.translation: 应该不带任何附加条件地向发展中国家提供援助。

examples.text: ...no-strings grants that last for five years.
examples.translation: 为期5 年的无附加条件的援助赠款

examples.text: Tony is sure he can pull a few strings and get you in.
examples.translation: 托尼有把握可以托关系让你进去。

examples.text: She wore a bright green jogging suit with a white stripe down the sides...
examples.translation: 她身穿一套裤腿两边有白色条纹的亮绿色慢跑服。

examples.text: The walls in the front bedroom are painted with broad, pale blue and white stripes.
examples.translation: 前卧室的墙壁被漆成淡蓝色和白色相间的宽条纹。

examples.text: ...a soldier with a corporal's stripes on his arms...
examples.translation: 胳膊上别着下士臂章的士兵

examples.text: He'd lost his stripes for slovenliness and cheek.
examples.translation: 他因散漫、无礼而丢了军职。

meanings.meaning: 显著的，突出的，惊人的；打击的；罢工的

examples.text: The most striking feature of those statistics is the high proportion of suicides...
examples.translation: 那些统计数据最引人注目之处是其极高的自杀率。

examples.text: He bears a striking resemblance to Lenin.
examples.translation: 他酷似列宁。

examples.text: ...her striking good looks.
examples.translation: 她那惊人的美貌

examples.text: In one respect, however, the men really were strikingly similar.
examples.translation: 然而，一方面，那些男人真的非常相似。

examples.text: ...a strikingly handsome man...
examples.translation: 绝色美男

examples.text: Most strikingly, the amount consumers spent in the shops grew much more quickly than anyone expected.
examples.translation: 最惊人的是，消费者的购物支出的增长速度远远超过了任何人的预期。

examples.text: She was a striking woman with long blonde hair.
examples.translation: 她是个留着金色长发的俏女郎。

examples.text: He strives hard to keep himself very fit...
examples.translation: 他努力地保持身体健康。

examples.text: She strove to read the name on the stone pillar...
examples.translation: 她费劲地读着石柱上的名字。

examples.text: Mr Annan said the region must now strive for economic development as well as peace.
examples.translation: 安南先生说该地区现在必须为经济发展与和平而奋斗。

examples.text: ...a politician consumed by his own passionate striving for leadership.
examples.translation: 一心为当权而拼命往上爬的政客

examples.text: ...a new kind of manufactured wood made by pressing strips of wood together and baking them...
examples.translation: 一种用木条压紧并烘烤而制成的新型人造木材

examples.text: The simplest rag-rugs are made with strips of fabric plaited together...
examples.translation: 最简单的碎布地毯是由碎布条编在一起制成的。

examples.text: Serve dish with strips of fresh raw vegetables.
examples.translation: 用新鲜的生蔬菜条作配菜。

examples.text: The coastal cities of Liguria sit on narrow strips of land lying under steep mountains.
examples.translation: 利古里亚的沿海城市坐落在陡峭山脉下的狭长地带上。

examples.text: ...a short boat ride across a narrow strip of water.
examples.translation: 乘船渡过一小段狭窄的带状水域。

examples.text: ...Goff's Charcoal Hamburgers on Lover's Lane, a busy commercial strip in North Dallas.
examples.translation: 位于北达拉斯的一条名为“情人巷”的繁华商业街上的戈夫炭烤汉堡店

examples.text: They stripped completely, and lay in the damp grass...
examples.translation: 他们脱光衣服，躺在潮湿的草地上。

examples.text: Women residents stripped naked in protest.
examples.translation: 女性居民裸体以示抗议。

examples.text: The children were brazenly stripping off and leaping into the sea.
examples.translation: 孩子们正无所顾忌地脱光衣服跳进海里。

examples.text: One prisoner claimed he'd been dragged to a cell, stripped and beaten.
examples.translation: 一名犯人声称他曾被拖进一间牢房，全身被脱光并遭到毒打。

examples.text: After Mike left for work I stripped the beds and vacuumed the carpets...
examples.translation: 迈克去上班后，我扯下了床罩并用吸尘器清扫地毯。

examples.text: The floorboards in both this room and the dining room have been stripped, sanded and sealed.
examples.translation: 这个房间和餐厅的木地板都已经被刮除涂层并进行了打磨上蜡。

examples.text: Volvo's three-man team stripped the car and restored it.
examples.translation: 沃尔沃公司的 3 人小组将车拆开进行了维修。

examples.text: In five years I had to strip the water pump down four times...
examples.translation: 5 年来我不得不将水泵拆开了 4 次。

examples.text: I stripped down the two SU carburettors, cleaned and polished the pieces and rebuilt the units.
examples.translation: 我将这两个SU汽化器拆卸开，把各个零件清洗擦亮后重新组装起来。

examples.text: The soldiers have stripped the civilians of their passports, and every other type of document...
examples.translation: 士兵们已经夺走了平民的护照以及所有其他类型的证件。

examples.text: A senior official was stripped of all his privileges for publicly criticising his employer.
examples.translation: 一名高管由于公然批评其老板而被剥夺了所有特权。

examples.text: ...the Doonesbury strip.
examples.translation: 杜尼斯伯理政治漫画

examples.text: He heard Nora tearing a strip off an orderly for not returning the food bins to the kitchen soon enough...
examples.translation: 他听到诺拉正在破口大骂一名勤务兵没有将食品箱及时送回厨房。

examples.text: When the police arrived to tear him off a strip he apologised for all the trouble he'd caused them.
examples.translation: 当警察赶到把他狠狠地教训了一番后，他为自己给他们带来的所有麻烦表示道歉。

examples.text: He collected some orange juice from the refrigerator and, glass in hand, strolled to the kitchen window...
examples.translation: 他从冰箱里拿了点橘子汁，然后手拿杯子溜达到厨房的窗口。

examples.text: Afterwards, we strolled back, put the kettle on and settled down with the newspapers.
examples.translation: 然后，我们溜达回来，烧上水，又坐下看报纸。

examples.text: After dinner, I took a stroll round the city.
examples.translation: 吃过饭，我绕着城散步。

examples.text: The foggy streets were virtually empty, except for the occasional evening stroller.
examples.translation: 除了偶尔一两个傍晚出来散步的人，雾蒙蒙的街上空荡荡的。

meanings.meaning: 打，打击；罢工；敲，敲击；抓；打动；穿透
打，击；罢工；撞击，冲击；侵袭；打动；到达

examples.text: French air traffic controllers have begun a three-day strike in a dispute over pay...
examples.translation: 法国空中交通管制员因为薪资纠纷已开始了为期 3 天的罢工。

examples.text: Staff at the hospital went on strike in protest at the incidents.
examples.translation: 医院员工举行罢工，抗议这几起事件。

examples.text: ...a call for strike action.
examples.translation: 号召进行罢工

examples.text: ...their recognition of the workers' right to strike...
examples.translation: 他们对工人罢工权的认同

examples.text: They shouldn't be striking for more money...
examples.translation: 他们不该为了得到更多的钱而罢工。

examples.text: The government agreed not to sack any of the striking workers.
examples.translation: 政府同意不解雇任何罢工工人。

examples.text: The strikers want higher wages, which state governments say they can't afford.
examples.translation: 罢工者希望得到更高的工资，而州政府称其无力支付。

examples.text: She took two quick steps forward and struck him across the mouth...
examples.translation: 她向前紧走两步，上去扇了他一嘴巴。

examples.text: He struck the ball straight into the hospitality tents...
examples.translation: 他将球直接打进迎宾帐篷里。

examples.text: I struck it away and got a bite on my forearm...
examples.translation: 我把它打跑了，但小臂被咬了一口。

examples.text: It is impossible to say who struck the fatal blow.
examples.translation: 很难判断是谁给了致命的一击。

examples.text: His head struck the bottom when he dived into the 6ft end of the pool...
examples.translation: 他一头扎进 6 英尺深的游泳池时头撞到池底了。

examples.text: One 16-inch shell struck the control tower...
examples.translation: 一枚 16 英寸的炮弹击中了指挥塔台。

examples.text: He was killed when he was struck by a car as he walked to his hotel.
examples.translation: 他步行去旅馆的路上被一辆车撞死了。

examples.text: ...the fire which began when the installation was struck by lightning.
examples.translation: 该装置被闪电击中而引起的大火

examples.text: Wilde fell and struck his head on the stone floor...
examples.translation: 怀尔德摔倒了，头撞在石头地上。

examples.text: My right toe struck against a submerged rock.
examples.translation: 我的右脚趾踢到水下的一块石头上了。

examples.text: Bank of England officials continued to insist that the pound would soon return to stability but disaster struck...
examples.translation: 英格兰银行官员仍然坚持说英镑不久就会恢复稳定，但结果灾难爆发了。

examples.text: Both of them were afflicted with a rare genetic disease, which struck in their thirties...
examples.translation: 他们两个都得了一种罕见的遗传病，这种病在他们30 多岁时发作。

examples.text: A powerful earthquake struck the Italian island of Sicily early this morning...
examples.translation: 今日凌晨意大利西西里岛发生强地震。

examples.text: He was suddenly struck with such a sense of grief, of loss, that his eyes filled with tears.
examples.translation: 一种悲伤、失落感突然袭来，他不由得眼泪汪汪。

examples.text: ...a young woman who had been stricken with polio.
examples.translation: 曾患脊髓灰质炎的年轻女子

examples.text: The attacker struck as she was walking near a housing estate at Monacurra...
examples.translation: 她行走到莫纳卡拉的一个居民区附近时遭人攻击。

examples.text: The killer says he will strike again...
examples.translation: 凶手称他还会再次下手。

examples.text: Then the scorpion struck.
examples.translation: 然后蝎子突然蜇了一下。

examples.text: ...a punitive air strike.
examples.translation: 惩罚性空袭

examples.text: ...a nuclear strike.
examples.translation: 核武器攻击

examples.text: ...strategic strikes against Italian air bases.
examples.translation: 对意大利空军基地的战略性攻击

examples.text: ...a rejection of her core beliefs and values, which strikes at the very heart of her being...
examples.translation: 对她的核心信念和价值观的否定，也就否定了她存在的根本

examples.text: The issue strikes at the very foundation of our community.
examples.translation: 该问题直指我们社会的根基。

examples.text: A thought struck her. Was she jealous of her mother, then?...
examples.translation: 她猛地冒出一个念头：那么难道她在嫉妒母亲吗？

examples.text: At this point, it suddenly struck me that I was wasting my time.
examples.translation: 在这一刻，我突然意识到自己是在浪费时间。

examples.text: He struck me as a very serious but friendly person...
examples.translation: 他让我感觉他是一个十分严肃但友好的人。

examples.text: What struck me as interesting is how much we judge other people by the clothes they wear...
examples.translation: 让我觉得很有意思的是我们经常以衣取人。

examples.text: You've always struck me as being an angry man.
examples.translation: 我感觉你好像总是一副气冲冲的样子。

examples.text: She was struck by his simple, spellbinding eloquence...
examples.translation: 她被他那率直、富有鼓动性的口才迷住了。

examples.text: Theresa was struck by her own lack of forethought...
examples.translation: 特蕾莎强烈意识到自己事先太欠考虑了。

examples.text: What struck me about the firm is how genuinely friendly and informal it is.
examples.translation: 该公司的真诚、友好和不拘小节深深打动了我。

examples.text: They struck a deal with their paper supplier, getting two years of newsprint on credit...
examples.translation: 他们同纸张供应商达成协议，可赊购两年的新闻用纸。

examples.text: The two struck a deal in which Rendell took half of what a manager would...
examples.translation: 两个人达成协议，伦德尔获得相当于经理所得的一半。

examples.text: He insists he has struck no bargains for their release.
examples.translation: 他坚称他没有就他们的获释达成过任何交易。

examples.text: At times like that you have to strike a balance between sleep and homework.
examples.translation: 在这种情形下你得在休息和做作业之间找到一种平衡。

examples.text: She struck a pose, one hand on her hip and the other waving an imaginary cigarette.
examples.translation: 她摆了个姿势，一只手叉腰，另一只手夹着一支假想的香烟。

examples.text: If there is a single subject guaranteed to strike fear in the hearts of parents, it is drugs.
examples.translation: 如果只有一样东西定能让父母感到恐惧，那就是毒品。

examples.text: I was struck dumb by this and had to think it over for a moment...
examples.translation: 这让我吃惊得说不出话来，我不得不仔细考虑一会儿。

examples.text: For this revelation he was struck blind by the goddess Hera.
examples.translation: 由于揭露此事，他被女神赫拉弄瞎了眼。

examples.text: The clock struck nine...
examples.translation: 钟敲了 9 下。

examples.text: Finally, the clock strikes.
examples.translation: 最后，钟敲响了。

examples.text: Strike that from the minutes...
examples.translation: 从备忘录中将之删去。

examples.text: Her achievements were struck from the record book.
examples.translation: 她所取得的成就被从档案中删去了。

examples.text: The censor struck out the next two lines.
examples.translation: 审查员划掉了下面两行。

examples.text: Robina struck a match and held it to the crumpled newspaper in the grate.
examples.translation: 罗比娜划着一根火柴去点壁炉里揉皱的报纸。

examples.text: Hamilton Oil announced that it had struck oil in the Liverpool Bay area of the Irish Sea.
examples.translation: 汉密尔顿石油公司宣布其已在爱尔兰海域的利物浦海湾地区开采出石油。

examples.text: Another medal was specially struck for him.
examples.translation: 专门为他铸造了另一枚奖章。

examples.text: The Hotel has two strikes against it. One, it's an immense ugly concrete building. Second, it lies in a rather awkward position...
examples.translation: 该旅馆有两个缺点。其一，它是个非常难看的大型混凝土建筑。其二，它位于一个相当偏僻的地段。

examples.text: When I got out I couldn't find any work, and for being an ex-con, that was a strike against me.
examples.translation: 我出狱后找不到任何工作，曾经服过刑的身份对我很不利。

examples.text: I believe we are within striking distance of an agreement...
examples.translation: 我相信我们即将达成协议。

examples.text: The airport was within striking distance: no more than sixty miles to the west.
examples.translation: 机场近在咫尺，西行不到 60 英里即到。

examples.text: The company has struck gold with its new holiday development, Center Parcs.
examples.translation: 该公司凭借其新开发的“中央公园”度假村而赚了个盆满钵满。

examples.text: He hoped to strike it rich by investing in ginseng.
examples.translation: 他希望通过投资人参发大财。

meanings.meaning: （游泳或划船的）划；中风；（打、击等的）一下；冲程；（成功的）举动；尝试；轻抚
（用笔等）画；轻抚；轻挪；敲击；划尾桨；划掉；（打字时）击打键盘
击球；作尾桨手，指挥划桨；（打字时）击打键盘

examples.text: Carla, curled up on the sofa, was smoking a cigarette and stroking her cat...
examples.translation: 卡拉正蜷缩在沙发上，一边吸着烟，一边轻抚着她的猫咪。

examples.text: She walked forward and embraced him and stroked his tousled white hair.
examples.translation: 她走上前拥抱他并轻抚他凌乱的白发。

examples.text: He had a minor stroke in 1987, which left him partly paralysed.
examples.translation: 他 1987 年曾患轻度中风，之后就半身不遂了。

examples.text: Fill in gaps by using short, upward strokes of the pencil.
examples.translation: 用铅笔向上短短地勾画几道来填充空白。

examples.text: I turned and swam a few strokes further out to sea...
examples.translation: 我转身向海里又游了几下。

examples.text: The boatmen accompany the stroke of their oars with the sound of their voices.
examples.translation: 船夫们一边划桨一边喊号子。

examples.text: She spent hours practising the breast stroke.
examples.translation: 她花了数小时练习蛙泳。

examples.text: On the stroke of 12, fireworks suddenly exploded into the night.
examples.translation: 12 点的钟声刚敲响，焰火便在夜空中绽放。

examples.text: Compton was sending the ball here, there, and everywhere with each stroke.
examples.translation: 康普顿一会将球打到这里，一会打到那里，每一拍的落点都不同。

examples.text: It didn't rain, which turned out to be a stroke of luck.
examples.translation: 天没下雨，结果成了件幸事。

examples.text: At the time, his appointment seemed a stroke of genius.
examples.translation: 当时，对他的任命犹如神来之笔。

examples.text: The disease wiped out 40 million rabbits at a stroke...
examples.translation: 该疾病一下子就使 4,000 万只兔子丧命。

examples.text: How can Britain reduce its prison population in one stroke?
examples.translation: 英国如何能一下子减少其监狱服刑人数?

examples.text: I never did a stroke of work at college.
examples.translation: 我在上大学时懒得要命。

examples.text: The typical family structure of Freud's patients involved two parents and two children...
examples.translation: 弗洛伊德的病人的典型家庭结构是父母二人和两个孩子。

examples.text: The chemical structure of this particular molecule is very unusual.
examples.translation: 这个特殊分子的化学结构很不寻常。

examples.text: The feet are highly specialised structures made up of 26 small delicate bones.
examples.translation: 脚的结构非常特殊，由 26 块细小的骨头组成。

examples.text: About half of those funds has gone to repair public roads, structures and bridges...
examples.translation: 那些基金中大约有一半已被用来维修公路、公共建筑物和桥梁。

examples.text: The house was a handsome four-story brick structure.
examples.translation: 这所房子是一幢造型美观的四层砖砌建筑物。

examples.text: By structuring the course this way, we're forced to produce something the companies think is valuable.
examples.translation: 这样制定发展规划后，我们不得不生产各公司认为有价值的东西。

examples.text: We have introduced a more structured training programme.
examples.translation: 我们已经推出了一门更系统的培训课程。

meanings.meaning: 顽固的；顽强的；难处理的

examples.text: He is a stubborn character used to getting his own way...
examples.translation: 他性格固执，惯于一意孤行。

examples.text: His face was set in an expression of stubborn determination.
examples.translation: 他脸上流露出固执坚定的表情。

examples.text: He stubbornly refused to tell her how he had come to be in such a state.
examples.translation: 他固执地拒绝告诉她自己是如何沦落到这种地步的。

examples.text: I couldn't tell if his refusal to talk was simple stubbornness.
examples.translation: 我不清楚他拒绝说话是否只是因为他的顽固不化。

examples.text: This treatment removes the most stubborn stains...
examples.translation: 这个方法能清除大多数顽固污渍。

examples.text: The first and most stubborn problem was that of reductions in the number of aircraft.
examples.translation: 最首要也是最棘手的问题是飞机数量的减少。

examples.text: Some interest rates have remained stubbornly high.
examples.translation: 部分利率一直居高不下。

examples.text: They had to struggle against all kinds of adversity...
examples.translation: 他们不得不同一切困境做斗争。

examples.text: Those who have lost their jobs struggle to pay their supermarket bills.
examples.translation: 那些失业的人们想方设法以支付超市的账单。

examples.text: Life became a struggle for survival.
examples.translation: 生活成了一场奋力求生的斗争。

examples.text: ...a young lad's struggle to support his poverty-stricken family...
examples.translation: 年轻的小伙子为了支撑他贫困的家庭所作的努力

examples.text: He is currently locked in a power struggle with his Prime Minister.
examples.translation: 他目前陷入了一场同总理的权力之争当中。

examples.text: I struggled, but he was a tall man, well-built.
examples.translation: 我使劲挣扎，但他又高又壮。

examples.text: She screamed at him to 'stop it' as they struggled on the ground...
examples.translation: 他们在地上扭打成一团，她向他尖叫着“别打了”。

examples.text: We were struggling for the gun when it went off!...
examples.translation: 我们正在争夺那把枪，这时它突然走火了！

examples.text: There were signs that she struggled with her attacker.
examples.translation: 现场有她和攻击者扭打过的痕迹。

examples.text: He died in a struggle with prison officers less than two months after coming to Britain.
examples.translation: 来英国不到两个月，他就在一次与狱警的打斗中丧命了。

examples.text: I could see the young boy struggling to free himself...
examples.translation: 我看到小男孩正在奋力挣脱。

examples.text: I struggled with my bags, desperately looking for a porter.
examples.translation: 我提着行李艰难地走着，迫切地寻找着搬运工。

examples.text: The pilot struggled out of the wreck almost uninjured...
examples.translation: 飞行员艰难地从失事的飞机中爬出来，几乎没有受伤。

examples.text: Catherine struggled to her feet...
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳艰难地站起来。

examples.text: I struggled into a bathrobe and staggered down the stairs.
examples.translation: 我挣扎着穿上浴衣，踉跄地下了楼。

examples.text: The company is struggling to find buyers for its new product...
examples.translation: 该公司正竭力为其新产品寻找买主。

examples.text: One in five young adults was struggling with everyday mathematics... 1/5
examples.translation: 的年轻人做日常的数学计算都费劲。

examples.text: By the 1960s, many shipyards were struggling.
examples.translation: 到 20 世纪 60 年代，许多造船厂都在勉强支撑。

examples.text: Losing weight was a terrible struggle.
examples.translation: 减肥是一件非常艰难的事。

examples.text: Warren's eldest son is an art student, at St Martin's.
examples.translation: 沃伦的大儿子是圣马丁学院艺术系的学生。

examples.text: ...a 23-year-old medical student.
examples.translation: 23 岁的医科大学生

examples.text: ...a passionate student of nineteenth century history.
examples.translation: 热衷于 19 世纪历史的研究者

meanings.meaning: 坚强的；强壮的；牢固的；擅长的

examples.text: I'm not strong enough to carry him...
examples.translation: 我力气不够大，抱不动他。

examples.text: I feared I wouldn't be able to control such a strong horse.
examples.translation: 我怕我驾驭不了这么强壮的马。

examples.text: He is sharp and manipulative with a strong personality...
examples.translation: 他个性很强，为人精明且爱指使人。

examples.text: It's up to managers to be strong and do what they believe is right...
examples.translation: 经理人应坚定立场，认准的事情就应该勇敢去做。

examples.text: Eventually I felt strong enough to look at him.
examples.translation: 最后我才鼓起勇气向他看去。

examples.text: The vacuum flask has a strong casing, which won't crack or chip...
examples.translation: 这种热水瓶瓶身坚固，不易断裂破碎。

examples.text: Glue the mirror in with a strong adhesive...
examples.translation: 用强力胶把镜子牢牢地粘上。

examples.text: The fabric is strong enough to withstand harsh processing.
examples.translation: 这种织物非常结实，能经受粗加工。

examples.text: The fence was very strongly built, with very large posts.
examples.translation: 围栏用粗大的木桩建成，非常坚固。

examples.text: Strong winds and torrential rain combined to make conditions terrible for golfers in the Scottish Open...
examples.translation: 狂风暴雨一齐袭来，致使苏格兰高尔夫球公开赛的比赛条件变得异常糟糕。

examples.text: A fairly strong current seemed to be moving the whole boat...
examples.translation: 一股湍急的水流好像要冲走整条船。

examples.text: A neutron star has a gravitational field strong enough to generate X-rays.
examples.translation: 中子星上存在强大的重力场，足以产生X射线。

examples.text: The metal is strongly attracted to the surface.
examples.translation: 金属紧紧地吸附在表面上。

examples.text: We're glad if our music makes a strong impression, even if it's a negative one...
examples.translation: 如果我们的音乐能给人留下深刻的印象，哪怕是负面的印象，我们都会很高兴。

examples.text: There will be a strong incentive to enter into a process of negotiation...
examples.translation: 将会出现迫切地想要进入谈判阶段的强烈动机。

examples.text: Teenage idols have a strong influence on our children...
examples.translation: 青少年偶像对孩子们的影响非常深。

examples.text: We had strong family traditions; we couldn't escape them.
examples.translation: 我们有浓厚的家族传统，我们无法逃避。

examples.text: He is strongly influenced by Spanish painters such as Goya and El Greco...
examples.translation: 他深受戈雅、埃尔·格列柯等西班牙画家的影响。

examples.text: They were so determined to learn and they were so strongly motivated.
examples.translation: 他们深受激励，决心好好学习。

examples.text: She is known to hold strong views on Cuba...
examples.translation: 她在古巴问题上的鲜明观点人人皆知。

examples.text: There has been strong criticism of the military regime...
examples.translation: 该军事政权一直受到人们的强烈抨击。

examples.text: I am a strong supporter of the NHS...
examples.translation: 我是国民医疗保健制度的坚定支持者。

examples.text: It condemned in extremely strong language what it called Britain's iniquitous campaign...
examples.translation: 它言辞激烈地谴责了这场它所谓的英国极不公正的竞选活动。

examples.text: It's bad judgment, but it's not treason. I think treason is too strong a word.
examples.translation: 这是一次判断失误，但不是叛国。我认为说叛国太过了。

examples.text: Obviously you feel very strongly about this...
examples.translation: 显然你对这件事的看法很坚定。

examples.text: We are strongly opposed to the presence of America in this region...
examples.translation: 我们强烈反对美国势力介入这一区域。

examples.text: The police have strongly criticised England's football authorities...
examples.translation: 警方强烈谴责了英格兰足球管理机构。

examples.text: The presidents issued a strongly-worded statement in support of the government.
examples.translation: 诸位总统联合发表了一份措辞鲜明的声明来支持该政府。

examples.text: The government has said it will take strong action against any further strikes...
examples.translation: 政府声称要采取严厉行动制止罢工进一步发展。

examples.text: He has also said he will have to become a strong President to put things right.
examples.translation: 他还说为力挽狂澜他将不得不做一个强权总统。

examples.text: The testimony presented offered a strong case for acquitting her on grounds of self-defense...
examples.translation: 当庭的证词为裁定她是正当防卫而无罪提供了强有力的证据。

examples.text: The evidence that such investment promotes growth is strong...
examples.translation: 有充分的证据表明这种投资能够促进增长。

examples.text: A strong link was found between parental mental illness and disturbance in their children.
examples.translation: 业已发现父母的精神病史和子女的精神障碍之间有密切的关系。

examples.text: He argues strongly for retention of NATO as a guarantee of peace...
examples.translation: 他强烈要求保留北大西洋公约组织以维护和平。

examples.text: These are conditions said by doctors to be strongly indicative of heart failure.
examples.translation: 这些症状都是医生们说的心力衰竭的明显前兆。

examples.text: There is a strong possibility that the cat contracted the condition by eating contaminated pet food.
examples.translation: 猫很有可能是吃了受污染的宠物食品而染上这种疾病的。

examples.text: Discretion is not Jeremy's strong point...
examples.translation: 小心谨慎不是杰里米的强项。

examples.text: Exports may be the only strong point in the economy over the next six to 12 months...
examples.translation: 在接下来的 6 到 12 个月中，出口也许是经济中的唯一亮点。

examples.text: Even in the area of foreign policy, his strong suit, he failed to deliver a major foreign policy address...
examples.translation: 即使在他擅长的外交政策领域里，他也没能发表过一个重要的外交政策演讲。

examples.text: Cynics argue that the EU is stronger on rhetoric than on concrete action.
examples.translation: 怀疑者认为，相比具体行动，欧盟更擅长夸夸而谈。

examples.text: She was a strong contender for Britain's Olympic team...
examples.translation: 她是有望入选英国奥运代表团的有力竞争者。

examples.text: Some countries where English is becoming a strong competitor to French, such as Algeria and Senegal, may see an immediate halt to the council's work...
examples.translation: 在一些国家里，比如阿尔及利亚和塞内加尔，英语正在成为法语强有力的竞争者，委员会在这些地方的工作可能会很快陷入停滞状态。

examples.text: They've got a strong squad and some great players...
examples.translation: 他们有一支实力雄厚的队伍和一些出色的选手。

examples.text: This show has several strengths — notably a strong cast.
examples.translation: 这个表演有一些亮点——尤其是演员阵容特别强大。

examples.text: He felt he had a relationship strong enough to talk frankly to Sarah...
examples.translation: 他认为和萨拉的关系很紧密，足以推心置腹。

examples.text: This has tested our marriage, and we have come through it stronger than ever...
examples.translation: 这是对我们婚姻的考验，我们经受住了考验而且关系比以往任何时候都更稳固了。

examples.text: Delhi first began to develop strong ties with Moscow in the 1950s.
examples.translation: 德里在 20 世纪 50 年代开始和莫斯科建立起稳固的关系。

examples.text: The US dollar continued its strong performance in Tokyo today...
examples.translation: 美元今天在东京继续保持强劲的走势。

examples.text: The local economy is strong and the population is growing...
examples.translation: 当地经济蓬勃发展，人口也在增长。

examples.text: The company was not financially strong enough to be floated on the Stock Exchange.
examples.translation: 该公司资金不够雄厚，无法上市。

examples.text: We are especially encouraged by the strong representation, this year, of women in information technology disciplines...
examples.translation: 今年，女性在信息技术领域的突出表现尤其让我们备受鼓舞。

examples.text: There is a strong element of truth to each of these explanations.
examples.translation: 这些解释每一个都很有道理。

examples.text: Ukraine indicated that it would establish its own army, 400,000 strong.
examples.translation: 乌克兰表示将自己建立一支40 多万人的军队。

examples.text: ...a 1,000-strong crowd.
examples.translation: 有 1,000 多人的人群

examples.text: Strong coffee or tea late at night may cause sleeplessness...
examples.translation: 深夜喝浓咖啡或浓茶可能会导致失眠。

examples.text: In strong concentrations it can cause nausea and vomiting.
examples.translation: 浓度过高会导致恶心呕吐。

examples.text: As she went past there was a gust of strong perfume...
examples.translation: 她走过时有一股浓烈的香水味。

examples.text: Strong colours would flatter her pale skin and dark hair...
examples.translation: 亮颜色更能衬托她的白皮肤和黑头发。

examples.text: The wine goes with strong and mild cheese alike.
examples.translation: 喝这酒的时候可以搭配浓乳酪或淡乳酪。

examples.text: He leaned over her, smelling strongly of sweat...
examples.translation: 他向她俯过身来，身上散发着浓浓的汗味。

examples.text: The effect only works well with strongly coloured subjects.
examples.translation: 色彩鲜明的主题才会产生这种效果。

examples.text: 'Good, Mr Ryle,' he said in English with a strong French accent.
examples.translation: “好的，赖尔先生，”他用带有浓重法国口音的英语说。

examples.text: He had a strong Greek nose and olive-black eyes.
examples.translation: 他有一个高挺的希腊式鼻子和一双墨橄榄绿色的眼睛。

examples.text: 'I come on strong sometimes. Don't know why.' She was beginning to feel like a bully.
examples.translation: “我有时言行很过分，不知道为什么。”她开始感觉自己像个恶霸。

examples.text: The old machinery was still going strong.
examples.translation: 这台旧机器依然运转良好。

meanings.meaning: 工作室；[广播][电视] 演播室；画室；电影制片厂

examples.text: She was in her studio again, painting onto a large canvas.
examples.translation: 她又回到了画室，在一张大帆布上作画。

examples.text: She's much happier performing live than in a recording studio.
examples.translation: 与在录音棚里录音相比，她更喜欢现场表演。

examples.text: She wrote to Paramount Studios and asked if they would audition her.
examples.translation: 她写信给派拉蒙电影公司，询问他们是否同意让她去试镜。

examples.text: I live on my own in a studio flat.
examples.translation: 我自己住在一个单间公寓里。

examples.text: He stumbled and almost fell...
examples.translation: 他差点被绊倒。

examples.text: I stumbled into the telephone box and dialed 999.
examples.translation: 我跌跌撞撞地进了电话亭拨了 999。

examples.text: I make it into the darkness with only one stumble.
examples.translation: 我只是绊了一下，周围就变成了一片黑暗。

examples.text: ...his voice wavered and he stumbled over the words at one point.
examples.translation: 他声音颤抖，一度说话磕磕巴巴的

meanings.meaning: 使震惊；打昏；给以深刻的印象
昏迷；打昏；惊倒；令人惊叹的事物

examples.text: Many cinema-goers were stunned by the film's violent and tragic end.
examples.translation: 许多来看电影的人都被这部影片暴力而悲惨的结局所震惊。

examples.text: When they told me she had gone missing I was totally stunned...
examples.translation: 他们告诉我她不见了时，我当时完全惊呆了。

examples.text: His announcement did not produce any immediate cheers, only a stunned silence while the words sank in.
examples.translation: 他的声明并没有当即引起什么欢呼，人们在领会了他的话后，只有一片令人意想不到的沉默。
