examples.text: Sam stood his ground and got a blow that stunned him.
examples.translation: 萨姆站在原地，被一下打昏了。

examples.text: I'll never do anything so stupid again...
examples.translation: 我再也不会做这种傻事了。

examples.text: I made a stupid mistake...
examples.translation: 我犯了个愚蠢的错误。

examples.text: Your father wouldn't have asked such a stupid question...
examples.translation: 你父亲不会问这么愚蠢的问题。

examples.text: If you give him half a chance he can make you look stupid.
examples.translation: 如果你给他半点机会，他就会极力愚弄你，让你出丑。

examples.text: We had stupidly been looking at the wrong column of figures...
examples.translation: 我们一直在看的数据栏却是错的，真是愚蠢。

examples.text: He got rather drunk and behaved stupidly.
examples.translation: 他喝得烂醉，失态出丑了。

examples.text: I stared at him, astonished by his stupidity.
examples.translation: 我盯着他，对他的愚蠢无知倍感惊讶。

examples.text: I wouldn't call it art. It's just stupid and tasteless...
examples.translation: 我不认为这是艺术。它简直无聊透顶，毫无品位。

examples.text: Friendship is much more important to me than a stupid old ring!
examples.translation: 友谊对我来说可比一个破戒指重要得多！

meanings.meaning: 东西；材料；填充物；素材资料

examples.text: I'd like some coffee, and I don't object to the powdered stuff if it's all you've got...
examples.translation: 我想来点咖啡，如果你只有速溶的那种也可以。

examples.text: I don't know anything about this antique stuff...
examples.translation: 我对于这种古玩物件一无所知。

examples.text: 'What do you want to know?'—'About life and stuff.'...
examples.translation: “你想知道些什么？”——“关于生命之类的东西。”

examples.text: Don't tell me you still believe in all that stuff?...
examples.translation: 别告诉我你仍旧相信那些东西。

examples.text: He pointed to a duffle bag.'That's my stuff.'
examples.translation: 他指着一个旅行袋说：“那是我的东西。”

examples.text: I stuffed my hands in my pockets...
examples.translation: 我把手插进口袋里。

examples.text: He stuffed the newspapers into a litter bin and headed down the street...
examples.translation: 他把报纸塞进了垃圾箱，然后沿街往前走了。

examples.text: His pants were stuffed inside the tops of his boots.
examples.translation: 他的裤腿儿塞在靴子里。

examples.text: He grabbed my purse, opened it and stuffed it full, then gave it back to me...
examples.translation: 他抢过我的钱包，打开并塞满钱，然后还给了我。

examples.text: He still stood behind his cash register stuffing his mouth with popcorn.
examples.translation: 他仍站在收银机后，嘴里塞满了爆米花。

examples.text: ...wallets stuffed with dollars.
examples.translation: 装满美元的钱包

examples.text: I could stuff myself with ten chocolate bars and half an hour later eat a big meal.
examples.translation: 我可以一口气吃10块巧克力，半小时后再吃一顿大餐。

examples.text: But you're just so stuffed you won't be able to drink anything.
examples.translation: 但你已经撑得什么也喝不下了。

examples.text: Will you stuff the turkey and shove it in the oven for me?
examples.translation: 你能帮我给火鸡填上料然后放进烤箱里吗？

examples.text: ...stuffed tomatoes.
examples.translation: 酿西红柿

examples.text: A pike weighing 29 lb 8 oz taken in 1878 was stuffed and is on display at the estate office...
examples.translation: 一条 1878 年捕获的重 29 磅 8 盎司的梭子鱼被制成标本陈列在庄园管理处。

examples.text: He didn't much care for the stuffed animal heads that hung on the walls.
examples.translation: 他不是很喜欢墙上挂的那些动物头颅标本。

examples.text: The idea that we can be whatever we want has become the stuff of television commercials.
examples.translation: 每个人皆无所不能，这一理念已经成为电视广告的精髓。

examples.text: Ultimately my attitude was: stuff them...
examples.translation: 我最终的态度是：去他们的。

examples.text: Stuff your money. We don't want a handout.
examples.translation: 收起你的钱，我们不需要施舍。

examples.text: Once I get on the pitch I know I can do my stuff...
examples.translation: 我一上场就知道是我大显身手的时候了。

examples.text: All that was left was to plant the roses and wait for nature to do her stuff.
examples.translation: 剩下的就只是栽上玫瑰，然后等大自然施展她的神奇魔力。

examples.text: These chaps know their stuff after seven years of war.
examples.translation: 7年的战争过后，这些家伙都成了作战行家。

meanings.meaning: 学习，研究；课题；书房；学问

examples.text: ...a relaxed and happy atmosphere that will allow you to study to your full potential...
examples.translation: 能让人充分发挥学习潜质的轻松愉快的环境

examples.text: He went to Hull University, where he studied History and Economics...
examples.translation: 他去了赫尔大学学习历史和经济学。

examples.text: The rehearsals make it difficult for her to study for law school exams.
examples.translation: 排练使她难以专心准备法学院的考试。

examples.text: ...the use of maps and visual evidence in the study of local history...
examples.translation: 利用地图和图像资料研究当地历史

examples.text: She gave up her studies to have Alexander.
examples.translation: 为了生亚历山大，她放弃了学业。

examples.text: Recent studies suggest that as many as 5 in 1000 new mothers are likely to have this problem.
examples.translation: 最近的研究成果表明在 1000 个刚生产完的妈妈中，有 5 个可能存在这样的问题。

examples.text: ...the first study of English children's attitudes.
examples.translation: 首个关于英国儿童观念的研究

examples.text: ...a new centre for Islamic studies...
examples.translation: 新的伊斯兰教研究中心

examples.text: She is currently doing a business studies course at Leeds.
examples.translation: 她目前在利兹大学修读一门商科课程。

examples.text: Debbie studied her friend's face for a moment.
examples.translation: 黛比仔细端详了一会她朋友的脸。

examples.text: I know that you've been studying chimpanzees for thirty years now...
examples.translation: 我知道你研究黑猩猩至今已有30年了。

examples.text: I invite every citizen to carefully study the document.
examples.translation: 我请每位市民都仔细研读该文件。

examples.text: She was a short, sturdy woman in her early sixties...
examples.translation: 她是个 60 岁出头、身材矮小结实的女人。

examples.text: The camera was mounted on a sturdy tripod.
examples.translation: 相机固定在一个坚固的三脚架上。

examples.text: It was a good table too, sturdily constructed of elm.
examples.translation: 这也是张很不错的桌子，榆木的，很结实。

examples.text: We know that taste in art is a subjective matter...
examples.translation: 我们知道艺术品位因人而异。

examples.text: The way they interpreted their past was highly subjective.
examples.translation: 他们解释其过去的方式太主观。

examples.text: Our preliminary results suggest that people do subjectively find the speech clearer.
examples.translation: 我们的初步结果显示，人们的确在主观上感觉演讲表达得更清晰明了了。

examples.text: They accused her of flippancy and subjectivity in her reporting of events in their country.
examples.translation: 他们指责她在报道他们国家的事件时轻率而主观。

meanings.meaning: 设计式样；用刻刀作装饰画

examples.text: Our children's different needs and learning styles created many problems...
examples.translation: 孩子们不同的需求和学习方式给我们带来了许多问题。

examples.text: Belmont Park is a broad sweeping track which will suit the European style of running...
examples.translation: 贝尔蒙特跑马场有宽阔的弧形跑道，很适合举行欧式赛马。

examples.text: Sam celebrated in fine style.
examples.translation: 萨姆精心庆祝了一番。

examples.text: Bournemouth, you have to admit, has style...
examples.translation: 你不得不承认伯恩茅斯是个很有格调的地方。

examples.text: Both love doing things in style...
examples.translation: 两人行事都讲究风度。

examples.text: She had not lost her grace and style.
examples.translation: 她依然仪态优雅，不失风度。

examples.text: His 50 years of experience have given him strong convictions about style...
examples.translation: 50 年的经验使得他在款式上有自己的独到见解。

examples.text: Several styles of hat were available.
examples.translation: 帽子有几种款式。

examples.text: ...six scenes in the style of a classical Greek tragedy.
examples.translation: 6 个古典希腊悲剧式的场景

examples.text: ...a mixture of musical styles.
examples.translation: 音乐风格的混搭

examples.text: ...the revival of the gothic style.
examples.translation: 哥特式风格的复兴

examples.text: His thick blond hair had just been styled before his trip.
examples.translation: 他在旅行前刚把浓密的金发修剪了一番。

examples.text: ...classically styled clothes.
examples.translation: 式样传统的衣服

examples.text: Mr Blair was not off guard. That is not his style...
examples.translation: 布莱尔先生没有放松警惕，这不是他的风格。

examples.text: To be honest, the house is not quite our style.
examples.translation: 说实话，这房子我们不是非常喜欢。

examples.text: ...a nuclear submarine.
examples.translation: 核潜艇

examples.text: ...submarine caves.
examples.translation: 海底洞穴

examples.text: ...submarine plants.
examples.translation: 海底植物

examples.text: Hippos are unable to submerge in the few remaining water holes...
examples.translation: 在仅剩的几个水坑里，河马根本无法没入水中。

examples.text: The river burst its banks, submerging an entire village.
examples.translation: 河水决堤，淹没了整个村庄。

examples.text: He submerges himself in the world of his imagination.
examples.translation: 他沉浸在自己想象的世界中。

meanings.meaning: 主题；科目；[语] 主语；国民
服从的；易患…的；受制于…的

examples.text: It was I who first raised the subject of plastic surgery.
examples.translation: 是我第一个提到整形手术这个话题的。

examples.text: ...the president's own views on the subject.
examples.translation: 总统在此问题上的个人观点

examples.text: ...steering the conversation round to his favourite subject.
examples.translation: 把谈话引到他最感兴趣的话题上

examples.text: Over the past few years, some of the positions Mr. Meredith has adopted have made him the subject of criticism...
examples.translation: 在过去的几年里，梅雷迪思先生所采取的某些立场使他成为了批评的对象。

examples.text: He's now the subject of an official inquiry.
examples.translation: 他现在是官方调查的对象。

examples.text: Surprisingly, mathematics was voted their favourite subject.
examples.translation: 令人惊讶的是，数学课被选为他们最喜欢的科目。

examples.text: ...a tutor in maths and science subjects.
examples.translation: 辅导数学和理科课程的家教

examples.text: 'White noise' was played into the subject's ears through headphones...
examples.translation: 让受试者通过耳机听“白噪声”。

examples.text: Subjects in the study were asked to follow a modified diet.
examples.translation: 要求研究对象按改进的食谱进食。

examples.text: Her favourite subjects are shells spotted on beach walks.
examples.translation: 她最喜爱的题材是那些在海边散步时发现的贝壳。

examples.text: Prices may be subject to alteration...
examples.translation: 价格可能会有所变动。

examples.text: In addition, interest on Treasury issues isn't subject to state and local income taxes.
examples.translation: 另外，国债利息不需缴纳政府和地方所得税。

examples.text: ...a disorder in which the person's mood is subject to wild swings from mania to depression.
examples.translation: 患者情绪在狂热和抑郁之间疯狂起伏的紊乱状态

examples.text: The tribunal is unique because Mr Jones is not subject to the normal police discipline code.
examples.translation: 因为琼斯先生不受一般的治安条例法规约束，所以专门设立了特别法庭。

examples.text: ...arguing that as a sovereign state it could not be subject to another country's laws.
examples.translation: 争论说作为一个主权国家其不受其他国家法律的约束

examples.text: ...the man who had subjected her to four years of beatings and abuse...
examples.translation: 使她遭受了 4 年毒打和辱骂的男人

examples.text: Innocent civilians are being arrested and subjected to inhumane treatment.
examples.translation: 无辜的平民正被逮捕并遭受非人的虐待。

examples.text: ...his subjects regarded him as a great and wise monarch...
examples.translation: 他的臣民把他视为伟大而英明的君主

examples.text: Roughly half of them are British subjects.
examples.translation: 他们中大约有一半是英国国民。

examples.text: The subject peoples of her empire were anxious for their own independence.
examples.translation: 她的帝国中被迫向她臣服的民族迫切渴望自身的独立。

examples.text: ...colonies and other subject territories.
examples.translation: 殖民地和其他臣服的属地

examples.text: He tried to change the subject, but she wasn't to be put off.
examples.translation: 他努力想换个话题，但她却兴趣正浓。

examples.text: They denied a report that Egypt had agreed to a summit, subject to certain conditions.
examples.translation: 他们否认了宣称埃及已同意在特定条件下参加峰会的报道。

examples.text: In desperation, Mrs. Jones submitted to an operation on her right knee to relieve the pain...
examples.translation: 绝望之际，琼斯夫人只好同意在其右膝上做手术以减轻疼痛。

examples.text: If I submitted to their demands, they would not press the allegations.
examples.translation: 如果那时我答应他们的要求，他们就不会坚持那些指控了。

examples.text: They submitted their reports to the Chancellor yesterday...
examples.translation: 他们昨天向财政大臣递交了报告。

examples.text: Head teachers yesterday submitted a claim for a 9 per cent pay rise.
examples.translation: 校长们昨天提交了一份要求加薪 9%的声明。

examples.text: Haig tended not to seek guidance from subordinates...
examples.translation: 黑格不愿向下属请教。

examples.text: Nearly all her subordinates adored her.
examples.translation: 几乎所有的下属都崇拜她。

examples.text: Sixty of his subordinate officers followed his example...
examples.translation: 他的60个下级官员都以他为榜样。

examples.text: Women were regarded as subordinate to free men.
examples.translation: 过去女人被认为是从属于自由民的。

examples.text: It was an art in which words were subordinate to images.
examples.translation: 这是一种形象胜于语言的艺术。

examples.text: He was both willing and able to subordinate all else to this aim.
examples.translation: 为了这个目标他愿意并能够把其他一切都放在次要的位置。

examples.text: ...the social subordination of women.
examples.translation: 女性的社会从属地位

examples.text: ...economic subordination to Europe.
examples.translation: 经济上从属于欧洲

meanings.meaning: 订阅；捐款；认购；赞成；签署

examples.text: I've personally never subscribed to the view that either sex is superior to the other.
examples.translation: 我个人从来都不同意性别有优劣之分的观点。

examples.text: My main reason for subscribing to New Scientist is to keep abreast of advances in science.
examples.translation: 我订阅《新科学家》主要是为了了解科学的最新进展。

examples.text: Usenet is a collection of discussion groups, known as newsgroups, to which anybody can subscribe.
examples.translation: 全球新闻网络是由多个被称为新闻组的讨论组组成，任何人都可以注册加入。

examples.text: I subscribe to a few favourite charities.
examples.translation: 我定期向几个中意的慈善机构捐款。

examples.text: Employees subscribed for far more shares than were available.
examples.translation: 员工申请认购的股份远远超出实际可认购的额度。

examples.text: ...the increase of population in subsequent years...
examples.translation: 随后几年人口的增长

examples.text: Those concerns were overshadowed by subsequent events.
examples.translation: 随后发生的事使之前所关注的那些问题显得无足轻重。

examples.text: She subsequently became the Faculty's President...
examples.translation: 她随后成了系主任。

examples.text: Subsequently the arrangement was terminated.
examples.translation: 后来这个计划被终止了。

examples.text: They won only one more game subsequent to their Cup semi-final win last year.
examples.translation: 继去年在杯赛半决赛中获胜后，他们仅又赢过一场比赛。

examples.text: European farmers are planning a massive demonstration against farm subsidy cuts...
examples.translation: 欧洲农场主正策划一场抗议削减农场补贴的大规模示威游行。

examples.text: They've also slashed state subsidies to utilities and transportation.
examples.translation: 他们还大幅削减了对公共事业和交通运输的政府补贴。

examples.text: There's absolutely no regulation of cigarettes to make sure that they don't include poisonous substances...
examples.translation: 根本没有法规来确保香烟不含有毒物质。

examples.text: The substance that's causing the problem comes from the barley.
examples.translation: 引起该问题的物质来自大麦。

examples.text: It's questionable whether anything of substance has been achieved...
examples.translation: 是否已经取得了任何实质性进展还是个问题。

examples.text: Syria will attend only if the negotiations deal with issues of substance.
examples.translation: 只有在谈判涉及重大问题时叙利亚才会参加。

examples.text: The substance of his discussions doesn't really matter.
examples.translation: 他讨论的要点实际上根本不重要。

examples.text: There is no substance in any of these allegations.
examples.translation: 这些指控都毫无根据。

examples.text: ...mature men of substance.
examples.translation: 有钱有势的成熟男人

meanings.meaning: 大量的；实质的；内容充实的

examples.text: The party has just lost office and with it a substantial number of seats...
examples.translation: 该党刚刚竞选失利，同时还失去了许多席位。

examples.text: That is a very substantial improvement in the present situation.
examples.translation: 在当前形势下这是一个非常巨大的进步。

examples.text: ...those fortunate enough to have a fairly substantial property to sell.
examples.translation: 那些有相当多的固定资产可出售的幸运儿

meanings.meaning: 微妙的；精细的；敏感的；狡猾的；稀薄的

examples.text: ...the slow and subtle changes that take place in all living things...
examples.translation: 发生在所有生物身上的缓慢而细微的变化

examples.text: Intolerance can take subtler forms too.
examples.translation: 过敏反应也可能会表现得很不明显。

examples.text: The truth is subtly different...
examples.translation: 事实略有不同。

examples.text: We change subtly all the time.
examples.translation: 我们每时每刻都在发生细微的变化。

examples.text: I even began to exploit him in subtle ways...
examples.translation: 我甚至开始巧妙地利用他。

examples.text: He is a subtle character, you know.
examples.translation: 你知道他为人狡猾。

examples.text: What I've tried very subtly to do is to reclaim language.
examples.translation: 我费尽心机在做的就是改造、拯救语言。

examples.text: ...subtle shades of brown.
examples.translation: 淡棕色

examples.text: ...delightfully subtle scents.
examples.translation: 怡人的淡淡香气

examples.text: ...whole aubergines in a very subtle sauce.
examples.translation: 清淡的调味汁里整只的茄子

examples.text: ...a white sofa teamed with subtly coloured rugs.
examples.translation: 白沙发搭配以色彩柔和的地垫

examples.text: They were substituting violence for dialogue...
examples.translation: 他们在用暴力取代对话。

examples.text: You could always substitute a low-fat soft cheese...
examples.translation: 你总是可以代之以低脂肪的软奶酪。

examples.text: Would phone conversations substitute for cosy chats over lunch or in the pub after work?...
examples.translation: 打电话能代替午餐时或下班后在酒吧里的惬意闲谈吗？

examples.text: He was substituting for the injured William Wales.
examples.translation: 他替下了受伤的威廉·威尔士。

examples.text: In my experience a straight substitution of carob for chocolate doesn't work...
examples.translation: 根据我的经验，用角豆制品直接代替巧克力行不通。

examples.text: Both Scotland and Northern Ireland had made last-minute substitutions.
examples.translation: 苏格兰队和北爱尔兰队都在最后时刻做了换人调整。

examples.text: She is seeking a substitute for the very man whose departure made her cry.
examples.translation: 那个男人的离去令她伤心痛哭，她正想找一个人填补内心的空缺。

examples.text: ...tests on humans to find a blood substitute made from animal blood.
examples.translation: 为从动物血液中提取人血的替代品而在人体上进行的试验

examples.text: The printed word is no substitute for personal discussion with a great thinker...
examples.translation: 阅读印在纸上的内容远不如与伟大的思想家面对面探讨那般受益。

examples.text: There is no substitute for practical experience.
examples.translation: 实践经验是无法替代的。

examples.text: Coming on as a substitute, he scored four crucial goals for Cameroon.
examples.translation: 作为替补队员上场的他为喀麦隆队打入了四粒关键进球。

examples.text: Mandy subtracted the date of birth from the date of death...
examples.translation: 曼迪用去世的日期减去出生的日期。

examples.text: We have subtracted $25 per adult to arrive at a basic room rate.
examples.translation: 我们已给每位成人房客减去了 25 美元，这就是基本的房费价格了。

examples.text: She's ready to learn simple addition and subtraction...
examples.translation: 她已经可以开始学习简单的加减法。

examples.text: I looked at what he'd given me and did a quick subtraction.
examples.translation: 我看着他给我的东西，快速做了个减法。

examples.text: Anna was born in 1923 in Ardwick, a suburb of Manchester.
examples.translation: 安娜于1923年出生在曼彻斯特的郊区阿德维克。

examples.text: ...the north London suburbs of Harrow, Barnet and Enfield.
examples.translation: 伦敦北部郊区哈罗区、巴尼特区和恩菲尔德区。

examples.text: His family lived in the suburbs.
examples.translation: 他家住在城郊。

examples.text: ...Bombay's suburbs.
examples.translation: 孟买城郊住宅区

examples.text: ...the Bay Area Rapid Transit subway system...
examples.translation: 旧金山海湾地区地铁捷运系统

examples.text: I don't ride the subway late at night.
examples.translation: 我深夜不坐地铁。

examples.text: The majority of us feel worried if we walk through a subway.
examples.translation: 大多数人在走地下通道时都感到害怕。

meanings.meaning: 成功，成就；胜利；大获成功的人或事物

examples.text: It's important for the long-term success of any diet that you vary your meals.
examples.translation: 如果想要成功做到长期节食，很重要的一点是要膳食多样化。

examples.text: ...the success of European business in building a stronger partnership between management and workers.
examples.translation: 欧洲企业在劳资双方之间建立更牢固的伙伴关系上所取得的成功

examples.text: Nearly all of the young people interviewed believed that work was the key to success.
examples.translation: 几乎所有被采访的年轻人都认为工作是成功的关键。

examples.text: Most of the cast was amazed by the play's success...
examples.translation: 大多数演员都为该剧大获成功而感到惊奇。

examples.text: Enthused by the success of the first exhibition, its organisers are hoping to repeat the experience.
examples.translation: 由于首展告捷，组织者大受鼓舞，希望能再创佳绩。

examples.text: The jewellery was a great success...
examples.translation: 这些珠宝大获赞誉。

examples.text: We hope it will be a commercial success.
examples.translation: 我们希望它能取得商业上的成功。

examples.text: How successful will this new treatment be?...
examples.translation: 这一新的疗法会有多大成效？

examples.text: I am looking forward to a long and successful partnership with him...
examples.translation: 我期盼着能与他建立长期而有成效的合作关系。

examples.text: She has been comparatively successful in maintaining her privacy.
examples.translation: 在保护自己的隐私方面她一直都做得比较成功。

examples.text: The doctors have successfully concluded preliminary tests.
examples.translation: 医生们已经成功地完成了初步的检查。

examples.text: ...the hugely successful movie that brought Robert Redford an Oscar for his directing...
examples.translation: 让罗伯特·雷德福拿到了奥斯卡最佳导演奖的大受欢迎的影片

examples.text: One of the keys to successful business is careful planning.
examples.translation: 打造成功企业的关键之一就是要精心策划。

examples.text: Women do not necessarily have to imitate men to be successful in business...
examples.translation: 女性不见得非要模仿男性才能在商界叱咤风云。

examples.text: She is a successful lawyer.
examples.translation: 她是个成功的律师。

examples.text: We have already succeeded in working out ground rules with the Department of Defense...
examples.translation: 我们已经成功地与国防部敲定了基本原则。

examples.text: Some people will succeed in their efforts to stop smoking...
examples.translation: 一些人经过努力可以成功戒烟。

examples.text: If they can succeed in America and Europe, then they can succeed here too.
examples.translation: 如果他们在美国和欧洲都能取得成功的话，那么在这儿也不例外。

examples.text: If marriage is to succeed in the 1990's, then people have to recognise the new pressures it is facing.
examples.translation: 在 20 世纪 90 年代人们要想婚姻美满，那就不得不认识到它所面临的新压力。

examples.text: ...a move which would make any future talks even more unlikely to succeed.
examples.translation: 可能使今后的所有对话都更加难以取得什么成果的举动

examples.text: ...the skills and qualities needed to succeed in small and medium-sized businesses.
examples.translation: 经营好中小企业所需的技能和素质

examples.text: David Rowland is almost certain to succeed him as chairman on January 1...
examples.translation: 戴维·罗兰将在 1 月 1 日接替他任主席几乎已成定局。

examples.text: The present ruler, Prince Rainier III, succeeded to the throne on 9 May 1949.
examples.translation: 现任元首，兰尼埃三世亲王于 1949 年 5 月 9 日继位。

examples.text: A quick divorce can be succeeded by a much longer — and more agonising — period of haggling over the fate of the family.
examples.translation: 闪电式离婚后可能紧接着就是一段在家庭命运上互相纠结的更加漫长、更加痛苦的时期。

meanings.meaning: 连续的；继承的；依次的；接替的

examples.text: Jackson was the winner for a second successive year...
examples.translation: 杰克逊已经是连续第二年获胜了。

examples.text: Britain was suffering from the failure of successive governments to co-ordinate a national transport policy.
examples.translation: 接连几届政府都没能协调出一个全国性的交通运输政策，英国因此而深受其苦。

examples.text: He successively won the British, European and World championships.
examples.translation: 他一口气拿下了英国、欧洲和世界冠军。

examples.text: ...the successively higher levels of unemployment we have endured during the past three recessions.
examples.translation: 在过去三次大萧条中我们所经历的持续上涨的失业率

meanings.meaning: 连续；继位；继承权；[生态] 演替

examples.text: Adams took a succession of jobs which have stood him in good stead...
examples.translation: 亚当斯连着做过几份让他颇为受益的工作。

examples.text: Scoring three goals in quick succession, he made it 10-8...
examples.translation: 在短短的时间内他连进三球，最终以 10 比 8 取胜。

examples.text: Fraser Clyne has won the Scottish Road Running Championship for the third year in succession.
examples.translation: 弗雷泽·克莱因已经连续第三年获得苏格兰公路赛跑比赛冠军了。

examples.text: She is now seventh in line of succession to the throne.
examples.translation: 她目前是王位的第七顺位继承人。

examples.text: He set out several principles that he hopes will guide his successors...
examples.translation: 他制订了几条原则，希望可以引导继任者。

examples.text: ...several critics hailed him then as the greatest living Scottish poet, the natural successor to his old friend Hugh MacDiarmid.
examples.translation: 紧接着，一些评论家称赞他为当今苏格兰最伟大的诗人，是他的老朋友休·麦克迪尔米德理所当然的接班人。

examples.text: There have been previous attempts at coups. We regard such methods as entirely unacceptable...
examples.translation: 以前也有人试图发动政变。我们绝对不能接受这种做法。

examples.text: You say you feel that you're being made to choose, and so you are. Such choices as this are a by-product of freedom...
examples.translation: 你说自己感觉是在被迫作选择，确实如此，而这样的选择是自由的附带品。

examples.text: There'd be no telling how John would react to such news as this.
examples.translation: 还不知道约翰听到这样的消息会作何反应。

examples.text: If your request is for information about a child, please contact the Registrar to find out how to make such a request...
examples.translation: 如果你想了解某个孩子的信息，请联系户籍管理员以了解如何提出此类申请。

examples.text: She has told us that when she goes back to stay with her family, they make her pay rent. We could not believe such a thing...
examples.translation: 她曾经跟我们说过，如果她回去和家人一起住，他们就要求她付房租。我们简直不相信竟然有这种事情。

examples.text: How can we make sense of such a story as this?
examples.translation: 我们如何能理解这样的事？

examples.text: We are scared because we are being watched — such is the atmosphere in Pristina and other cities in Kosovo.
examples.translation: 我们很害怕，因为我们受到了监视——普里什蒂纳和科索沃的其他城市就是笼罩在这种氛围下。

examples.text: There should be a law ensuring products tested on animals have to be labelled as such.
examples.translation: 应该制定一项法律，要求在动物身上进行过试验的产品必须就此贴上明确的标识。

examples.text: Issues such as these were not really his concern...
examples.translation: 他其实并不关心诸如此类的问题。

examples.text: I wouldn't see another chance such as this in my lifetime.
examples.translation: 我一生都不会再有这样的机会了。

examples.text: Each member of the alliance agrees to take such action as it deems necessary, including the use of armed force...
examples.translation: 该联盟的每一位成员国都同意采取其认为必要的行动，包括动用武力。

examples.text: Britain is not enjoying such prosperity as it was in the mid-1980s.
examples.translation: 英国现在已经不像 20 世纪 80 年代中期那么繁荣昌盛。

examples.text: Children do not use inflections such as are used in mature adult speech...
examples.translation: 孩子们说话时的语调不像成年人那样抑扬顿挫。

examples.text: His confessions to the two killings did reveal special knowledge such as could only have been known by the killer.
examples.translation: 他在两宗谋杀案的供状中的确透露出一些只有杀手本人才知道的特殊细节。

examples.text: He was said to have written such books as The Day of Locusts and Miss Lonely Hearts.
examples.translation: 据说他曾经写过《蝗虫之日》和《寂寞芳心小姐》之类的小说。

examples.text: ...such careers as teaching, nursing, hairdressing and catering.
examples.translation: 教书、护理、美发和餐饮之类的工作

examples.text: ...delays caused by such things as bad weather or industrial disputes.
examples.translation: 由恶劣天气或劳资纷争之类的事件导致的延机

examples.text: ...serious offences, such as assault on a police officer...
examples.translation: 袭警等重罪

examples.text: He definitely wants to perform further tests, such as a biopsy and some x-rays...
examples.translation: 他肯定很想做进一步的检查，如活组织检查和 X 光片等。

examples.text: When I get tired, such as when I'm working on my computer, I turn to biscuits.
examples.translation: 我累了的时候，譬如说在电脑前工作累了，就会吃饼干。

examples.text: I think most of us don't want to read what's in the newspaper anyway in such detail...
examples.translation: 我想我们大多数人无论如何都不想如此仔细地去读报纸。

examples.text: One will never be able to understand why these political issues can acquire such force...
examples.translation: 人们永远也不会明白为什么这些政治问题会有如此大的影响力。

examples.text: The economy was not in such bad shape, he says.
examples.translation: 他说经济状况并不是特别糟糕。

examples.text: You know the health service is in such a state and it's getting desperate now...
examples.translation: 你知道，医疗卫生服务本来就够差的了，现在更是变本加厉了。

examples.text: He had such a way with the ladies...
examples.translation: 他非常善于和女士打交道。

examples.text: It was such a pleasant surprise...
examples.translation: 那真是个大大的惊喜。

examples.text: He's such a sweet boy, isn't he.
examples.translation: 他是一个非常可爱的男孩，不是吗？

examples.text: The weather has brought such a demand for beer that one brewery will operate over the weekend...
examples.translation: 天气状况使得对啤酒的需求大增，一家啤酒厂周末要加班了。

examples.text: This is something where you can earn such a lot of money that there is not any risk that you will lose it...
examples.translation: 这可以让你挣一大笔钱，而且没有任何赔钱的风险。

examples.text: He was in such a hurry that he almost pushed me over on the stairs.
examples.translation: 他这么急匆匆的，差点把我推下楼梯。

examples.text: She looked at him in such distress that he had to look away.
examples.translation: 她如此痛苦地看着他，他不得不把目光转向别处。

examples.text: Though Vivaldi had earned a great deal in his lifetime, his extravagance was such that he died in poverty...
examples.translation: 虽然维瓦尔第一生赚钱无数，但是他挥霍无度，死的时候一贫如洗。

examples.text: He kept thinking the pain was such that he would faint.
examples.translation: 他不停地想太疼了，他会疼昏过去了。

examples.text: The operation has uncovered such backstreet dealing in stolen property that police might now press for changes in the law.
examples.translation: 这次行动破获了这样的地下销赃活动，现在警方可能会因此敦促修改法律。

examples.text: He could put an idea in such a way that Alan would believe it was his own.
examples.translation: 他能把观点表达得让艾伦认为那是他自己的主意。

examples.text: OFSTED's brief is such that it can conduct any inquiry or provide any advice which the Secretary of State requires.
examples.translation: 英格兰教育标准办公室的主要职责使其可以根据国务大臣的要求进行任何调查或提供任何建议。

examples.text: I said, 'Well what time'll I get to Leeds?' and he said such and such a time but I missed my connection...
examples.translation: 我说：“那么我什么时候才能到利兹?”他说了一个时间，但是我没赶上联运车。

examples.text: They're informed that we've got this money to spend and we will do such and such with it.
examples.translation: 他们被告知我们已经拿到了这笔钱并将用它来做什么。

examples.text: Well my toilet's all blocked up and I've got it all coming into my flat and it'll ruin my home, such as it is...
examples.translation: 我的马桶堵死了，脏水全都涌到屋子里，家里脏得一塌糊涂，情况就是这样。

examples.text: The British Women's Movement, such as it is these days, came up with a programme of speeches at the House of Commons.
examples.translation: 如今波澜不惊的英国妇女运动提出要在下议院发表演讲的计划。

examples.text: I am not a learner as such —I used to ride a bike years ago...
examples.translation: 严格说来，我并不完全是一个初学者——几年前我经常骑自行车。

examples.text: Mark joined as an office boy at the age of fourteen with no academic qualifications as such at all...
examples.translation: 马克在14岁的时候以勤杂员的身份进入公司，他当时根本就没有任何学历。

examples.text: There is no rudder as such, so the craft can be steered only when under power.
examples.translation: 没有真正的方向舵，所以只有在动力驱动的情况下才能操控船只。

examples.text: House prices are easily upset by factors which have nothing to do with property as such. The fall in prices in the South-East results largely from the high rate of interest on mortgages...
examples.translation: 房价很容易受与地产本身无关的因素所影响。东南部房价的下跌很大程度上是由于抵押贷款利率的上涨所引起的。

examples.text: Mr Simon said he was not against taxes as such, 'but I do object when taxation is justified on spurious or dishonest grounds,' he says.
examples.translation: 西蒙先生说他对税收本身并不反对，“但是我反对以虚假不实的理由巧立明目收税，”他说。

examples.text: He had been deeply affected by the sudden death of his father-in-law...
examples.translation: 岳父的猝死使他十分伤心。

examples.text: 'I hope,' the stranger said, 'that the sudden change of venue did not inconvenience you.'...
examples.translation: 那位陌生人说：“我希望突然改变地点不会给您带来不便。”

examples.text: She started to thank him, but a sudden movement behind him caught her attention...
examples.translation: 她正要谢他时，他身后有什么东西突然动了一下吸引了她的注意力。

examples.text: It was all very sudden.
examples.translation: 这一切都太突然了。

examples.text: The enemy seemed stunned by the suddenness of the attack.
examples.translation: 进攻之出其不意似乎让敌人大吃一惊。

examples.text: All of a sudden she didn't look sleepy any more.
examples.translation: 她突然看起来一点都不困了。

examples.text: They waited in silence and sucked their sweets...
examples.translation: 他们安静地等着，嘴里咂着糖果。

examples.text: He sucked on his cigarette...
examples.translation: 他抽了一口烟。

examples.text: Doran was clutching the bottle with both hands and sucking intently.
examples.translation: 多兰双手紧紧抓着瓶子尽情地喝着。

examples.text: The pollution-control team is at the scene and is due to start sucking up oil any time now...
examples.translation: 污染控制小组就在现场，现在随时准备开始吸油。

examples.text: The air is sucked out by a high-powered fan...
examples.translation: 由强力风机把空气吸出去。

examples.text: They sucked in deep lungfuls of air.
examples.translation: 他们深吸了几口气。

examples.text: ...the airline pilot who was almost sucked from the cockpit of his plane when a window shattered.
examples.translation: 飞机的一处窗户破碎时差点被从驾驶舱里吸出去的飞行员

examples.text: He warned that if the President tried to enforce control, the country would be sucked into a power vacuum.
examples.translation: 他警告说，如果总统想要实施强权统治的话，那么这个国家将陷入权力真空状态。

examples.text: ...the extent to which they have been sucked into the cycle of violence.
examples.translation: 他们卷入暴力恶性循环的程度

examples.text: The system sucks.
examples.translation: 这个系统太差劲了。

meanings.meaning: (Sue)人名；(日)末(名)；(法)休；(英)休(女子教名Susan、Susanna的昵称)

examples.text: Mr Warren sued him for libel over the remarks...
examples.translation: 沃伦先生控告他散布诽谤性言论。

examples.text: The company could be sued for damages...
examples.translation: 该公司可能会被起诉，要求其赔偿损失。

examples.text: One former patient has already indicated his intention to sue.
examples.translation: 一位以前的病人已经表示要提起诉讼。

meanings.meaning: 遭受，忍受；受痛苦；经验；受损害

examples.text: Within a few days she had become seriously ill, suffering great pain and discomfort...
examples.translation: 几天的时间，她就病得很严重了，疼痛难忍，周身不舒服。

examples.text: Can you assure me that my father is not suffering?
examples.translation: 你能保证我父亲不会受罪吗？

examples.text: He was eventually diagnosed as suffering from terminal cancer...
examples.translation: 他最终被诊断出患了晚期癌症。

examples.text: I realized he was suffering from shock.
examples.translation: 我意识到他休克了。

examples.text: The peace process has suffered a serious blow now...
examples.translation: 现在和平进程遭到重创。

examples.text: Romania suffered another setback in its efforts to obtain financial support for its reforms.
examples.translation: 罗马尼亚在为其改革努力寻求经济援助时再次受挫。

examples.text: There are few who have not suffered...
examples.translation: 谁都会经受挫折。

examples.text: It is obvious that Syria will suffer most from this change of heart.
examples.translation: 很明显，这一态度的转变对叙利亚的影响最大。

examples.text: I'm not surprised that your studies are suffering...
examples.translation: 你的功课变得越来越差，我并不感到奇怪。

examples.text: Without a major boost in tourism, the economy will suffer even further.
examples.translation: 旅游业如果没有大的起色，经济状况会每况愈下。

examples.text: She doesn't suffer fools gladly and, in her view, most people are fools.
examples.translation: 她不愿与笨人为伍，而在她看来，大多数人都是笨人。

examples.text: A cover letter should never exceed one page; often a far shorter letter will suffice.
examples.translation: 附信不应超过一页，通常来说，一封相对非常简短的信就足够了。

examples.text: Suffice it to say that afterwards we never met again...
examples.translation: 简单地说，此后我们再也没有见过面。

examples.text: Suffice to say, it was more than a couple of years ago!
examples.translation: 我只想说，那是几年前的事了！

examples.text: One metre of fabric is sufficient to cover the exterior of an 18-in-diameter hatbox...
examples.translation: 一米布足以包裹住直径为 18 英寸的帽盒。

examples.text: Lighting levels should be sufficient for photography without flash...
examples.translation: 光照亮度应达到不开闪光灯便可以清楚拍照的程度。

examples.text: There was not sufficient evidence to secure a conviction.
examples.translation: 没有足够的证据来定罪。

examples.text: She recovered sufficiently to accompany Chou on his tour of Africa in 1964...
examples.translation: 她恢复得不错，并得以在 1964 年陪同周访问非洲。

examples.text: The holes were sufficiently large to serve as nests.
examples.translation: 这些洞作鸟巢足够大。

examples.text: Discipline is a necessary, but certainly not a sufficient condition for learning to take place.
examples.translation: 纪律是有必要的，但绝对不是保证学习成效的充分条件。

examples.text: ...bags of sugar...
examples.translation: 几袋食糖

examples.text: Ice cream is high in fat and sugar.
examples.translation: 冰激凌富含脂肪和糖。

examples.text: How many sugars do you take?
examples.translation: 你加几勺糖？

examples.text: ...a mug of tea with two sugars.
examples.translation: 一杯加了两块方糖的茶

examples.text: He sat down and sugared and stirred his coffee.
examples.translation: 他坐下来，在咖啡中加糖并搅拌。

examples.text: Plants produce sugars and starch to provide themselves with energy.
examples.translation: 植物产生糖和淀粉来为自身提供能量。

examples.text: ...the natural sugars found in grape juice.
examples.translation: 葡萄汁中所含的天然糖分

examples.text: I know how to make you feel better, sugar. I'll tell you a story.
examples.translation: 宝贝，我知道怎么能让你感觉好些，我给你讲个故事。

meanings.meaning: 提议，建议；启发；使人想起；显示；暗示

examples.text: He suggested a link between class size and test results of seven-year-olds...
examples.translation: 他认为 7 岁大的学生的测试分数和班级的规模有关系。

examples.text: I suggest you ask him some specific questions about his past...
examples.translation: 我建议你问他一些有关他的过去的具体问题。

examples.text: I suggested to Mike that we go out for a meal with his colleagues...
examples.translation: 我向迈克提议，我们和他的同事们一起出去吃饭。

examples.text: No one has suggested how this might occur...
examples.translation: 没人说得清这事是怎么发生的。

examples.text: 'Could he be suffering from amnesia?' I suggested...
examples.translation: “他是不是患了健忘症?”我试探着问道。

examples.text: So instead I suggested taking her out to dinner for a change.
examples.translation: 于是我又提议，带她出去吃饭换换口味。

examples.text: Could you suggest someone to advise me how to do this?...
examples.translation: 这该怎么办？你能不能推荐一个人帮我出个主意？

examples.text: They can suggest where to buy one.
examples.translation: 他们可以推荐去哪里购买。

examples.text: I'm not suggesting that is what is happening...
examples.translation: 我没有说那就是事实。

examples.text: It is wrong to suggest that there are easy alternatives...
examples.translation: 如果认为有更容易的选择，那就错了。

examples.text: Their success is conditional, I suggest, on this restriction.
examples.translation: 我认为他们能否成功取决于这一限制因素。

examples.text: Earlier reports suggested that a meeting would take place on Sunday...
examples.translation: 早先的报道暗示周日可能会召开会议。

examples.text: Its hairy body suggests a mammal.
examples.translation: 它毛茸茸的身体表明它是哺乳动物。

examples.text: This onomatopoeic word suggests to me the sound a mousetrap makes when it snaps shut.
examples.translation: 这个拟声词让我想起捕鼠夹子突然合上时的声音。

meanings.meaning: 建议；示意；微量，细微的迹象

examples.text: The dietitian was helpful, making suggestions as to how I could improve my diet...
examples.translation: 这位营养学家就如何改善饮食给我提出了些建议，对我很有帮助。

examples.text: Perhaps he'd followed her suggestion of a stroll to the river...
examples.translation: 也许他已经听从了她的建议去河边散步了。

examples.text: I have lots of suggestions for the park's future.
examples.translation: 对于公园未来的规划我有很多提议。

examples.text: We reject any suggestion that the law needs amending...
examples.translation: 对于任何暗示该法律需要修改的观点我们都拒绝接受。

examples.text: There are suggestions that he might be supported by the Socialists.
examples.translation: 有人认为他可能会受到社会党的支持。

examples.text: There is no suggestion whatsoever that the two sides are any closer to agreeing...
examples.translation: 没有任何迹象表明双方将会达成一致。

examples.text: There is absolutely no suggestion of any mainstream political party involvement.
examples.translation: 没有任何依据表明有任何主要政党参与其中。

examples.text: ...that fashionably faint suggestion of a tan.
examples.translation: 略带一点流行的古铜色

examples.text: ...a firm, well-sprung mattress with not one suggestion of a sag.
examples.translation: 结实、没有一点凹陷的高弹力床垫

examples.text: The power of suggestion is very strong.
examples.translation: 暗示的力量是无比强大的。

examples.text: She tried to commit suicide on several occasions.
examples.translation: 她自杀过好几次。

examples.text: ...a case of attempted suicide.
examples.translation: 自杀未遂事件

examples.text: ...a growing number of suicides in the community.
examples.translation: 社会上越来越多的自杀事件

examples.text: Quite a few have committed social suicide by writing their boring memoirs...
examples.translation: 有一些人因为写那些枯燥无味的回忆录而毁了自己的社会形象。

examples.text: They say it would be political suicide for the party to abstain.
examples.translation: 他们说这个政党弃权无异于自毁政治前程。

examples.text: According to the army, the teenager said he was on a 'suicide mission' for the movement.
examples.translation: 军方消息称，这个少年说他正在为这次运动执行“自杀性任务”。

examples.text: ...a suicide bomber.
examples.translation: 自杀性炸弹袭击者

examples.text: ...a dark pinstriped business suit.
examples.translation: 黑色的细条纹正装

examples.text: ...a smart suit and tie.
examples.translation: 帅气的西装和领带

examples.text: I was wearing my tweed suit.
examples.translation: 我穿着我的花呢套装。

examples.text: ...a completely revolutionary atmospheric diving suit.
examples.translation: 令人耳目一新的大气压潜水服

examples.text: They will only release information if it suits them...
examples.translation: 他们只会发布对他们有利的信息。

examples.text: They should be able to find you the best package to suit your needs.
examples.translation: 他们应该能提供满足你需要的最佳套餐。

examples.text: I don't think a sedentary life would altogether suit me.
examples.translation: 我认为长期伏案的生活一点也不适合我。

examples.text: Green suits you.
examples.translation: 绿色很配你。

examples.text: These large institutions make — and change—the rules to suit themselves...
examples.translation: 这些大机构总是随意制定规定，而且说变就变。

examples.text: He made a dismissive gesture. 'Suit yourself.'
examples.translation: 他做了一个很不屑的手势。“随你便。”

examples.text: Up to 2,000 former employees have filed personal injury suits against the company...
examples.translation: 多达 2,000 名旧职员以个人伤害为由向该公司提起诉讼。

examples.text: The judge dismissed the suit.
examples.translation: 法官驳回了诉讼。

examples.text: One insurance company has already filed suit against the city of Chicago.
examples.translation: 一家保险公司已经对芝加哥市提起诉讼。

examples.text: Efforts to persuade the remainder to follow suit have continued.
examples.translation: 说服其余人跟着效仿的努力仍在继续。

examples.text: Their London house suits them down to the ground.
examples.translation: 他们在伦敦的房子很合他们心意。

examples.text: Employers usually decide within five minutes whether someone is suitable for the job...
examples.translation: 雇主通常在 5 分钟内就能决定一个人是否适合这份工作。

examples.text: She had no other dress suitable for the occasion...
examples.translation: 她没有其他适合这种场合穿的套裙。

examples.text: The authority must make suitable accommodation available to the family.
examples.translation: 当局必须给这个家庭提供适当的食宿条件。

examples.text: ...information on the suitability of a product for use in the home.
examples.translation: 有关家用产品适用性的信息

meanings.meaning: （一套）家具；套房；组曲；（一批）随员，随从

examples.text: They had a fabulous time during their week in a suite at the Paris Hilton.
examples.translation: 他们在巴黎希尔顿酒店的套房里度过了非常愉快的一周。

examples.text: ...a new suite of offices.
examples.translation: 新的办公套间

examples.text: ...a three-piece suite.
examples.translation: 三件套家具

examples.text: Better filters are needed since fuel in Afghanistan is usually high in sulfur content.

meanings.meaning: (Sum)人名；(英)萨姆；(柬)孙；(俄、德、捷)苏姆；(越)森

examples.text: Large sums of money were lost...
examples.translation: 损失了大笔钱财。

examples.text: Even the relatively modest sum of £50,000 now seems beyond his reach.
examples.translation: 现在即使是相对来说并不算多的 5 万英镑对他来说也是遥不可及的。

examples.text: I can't do my sums.
examples.translation: 我算不出来。

examples.text: The sum of all the angles of a triangle is 180 degrees.
examples.translation: 三角形内角总和为 180 度。

examples.text: 'Public opinion' is only the sum of the views of thousands of people like yourself...
examples.translation: “舆论”只是所有像你一样的成千上万人的意见的总和。

examples.text: The sum of evidence points to the crime resting on them...
examples.translation: 所有证据都表明该犯罪乃他们所为。

examples.text: Has it, in its 30 years, added much to the sum of human happiness?
examples.translation: 30 年来，它为人类带来了更多幸福吗？

examples.text: In sum, the two countries are now true economic partners...
examples.translation: 总而言之，两国目前是真正的经济合作伙伴。

examples.text: It is a situation, in sum, devoid of logic.
examples.translation: 总之，该情况毫无逻辑。

examples.text: As individual members' solo careers have proved, each band was greater than the sum of its parts.
examples.translation: 成员单飞后的发展证明，每个乐队的成员只有组合在一起才能创造出更大的成功。

examples.text: Table 3.1 summarizes the information given above...
examples.translation: 表格 3.1 是对以上信息的总结。

examples.text: Basically, the article can be summarized in three sentences...
examples.translation: 这篇文章基本上可以概述为 3 句话。

examples.text: To summarise, this is a clever approach to a common problem.
examples.translation: 总而言之，这是一个解决常见问题的巧妙方法。

examples.text: What follows is a brief summary of the process...
examples.translation: 接下来是对此流程的一个简短概括。

examples.text: Here's a summary of the day's news...
examples.translation: 下面是今日新闻简报。

examples.text: Milligan gives a fair summary of his subject within a relatively short space.
examples.translation: 米利根用比较小的篇幅对他的课题作了一个清晰简要的概述。

examples.text: In summary, it is my opinion that this complete treatment process was very successful.
examples.translation: 总的来说，我认为整个治疗过程非常成功。

examples.text: It says torture and summary execution are common...
examples.translation: 那上面称酷刑和草草处决很常见。

examples.text: There is no doubt that some considered that a beating was no more than summary justice...
examples.translation: 毫无疑问，有人认为拷打比草菅人命好不到哪去。

examples.text: The four men were killed after a summary trial.
examples.translation: 草草审讯后这四个人即被处死。

examples.text: Several detainees had been summarily executed.
examples.translation: 几个在押犯被草草处决。

examples.text: I escaped the heatwave in London earlier this summer and flew to Cork...
examples.translation: 今年初夏我逃离了伦敦的炎热，飞往科克去避暑。

examples.text: It was a perfect summer's day.
examples.translation: 那是一个美好的夏日。

examples.text: ...in the summer of 1987.
examples.translation: 在 1987 年的夏天

examples.text: ...the summer holidays...
examples.translation: 暑假

examples.text: He used to spend childhood summers with his grandparents.
examples.translation: 他小时候夏天都是和爷爷奶奶一起度过的。

meanings.meaning: 顶点；最高级会议；最高阶层

examples.text: ...next week's Washington summit.
examples.translation: 下周的华盛顿峰会

examples.text: ...the NATO summit meeting in Rome.
examples.translation: 在罗马举行的北约峰会

examples.text: Snow gleamed on the summit of Mount Simon.
examples.translation: 西蒙山山顶白雪皑皑。

examples.text: Howe summoned a doctor and hurried over...
examples.translation: 豪叫了医生，然后匆忙赶了过来。

examples.text: Suddenly we were summoned to the interview room...
examples.translation: 突然我们被叫进了面试的房间。

examples.text: He has been summoned to appear in court on charges of incitement to law-breaking.
examples.translation: 因被控教唆犯罪，他已经被传唤出庭。

examples.text: It took her a full month to summon the courage to tell her mother.
examples.translation: 她用了整整一个月才鼓足勇气告诉了妈妈。

examples.text: Painfully shy, he finally summoned up courage to ask her to a game...
examples.translation: 他太过腼腆，不过最后终于鼓起勇气邀请她一起去看比赛。

examples.text: We couldn't even summon up the energy to open the envelope.
examples.translation: 我们甚至连打开信封的力气都没有了。

meanings.meaning: (Sun)人名；(中)孙(普通话·威妥玛)；(柬)孙；(缅)素；(土)松

examples.text: The sun was now high in the southern sky...
examples.translation: 太阳正高挂在南边的天空上。

examples.text: The sun came out, briefly.
examples.translation: 太阳短暂地露了露脸。

examples.text: ...the sun's rays...
examples.translation: 太阳的光线

examples.text: The sun was shining.
examples.translation: 阳光照耀。

examples.text: Dena took them into the courtyard to sit in the sun...
examples.translation: 德娜带他们到院子里晒太阳。

examples.text: They were trying to soak up some sun.
examples.translation: 他们想晒晒太阳。

examples.text: She was last seen sunning herself in a riverside park.
examples.translation: 最后一次有人看见她时，她正在河边公园晒太阳。

examples.text: We sat there for hours talking about everything under the sun...
examples.translation: 我们在那儿坐了几个小时，谈天说地。

examples.text: The fashion-conscious will go for anything under the sun!
examples.translation: 流行意识将无所不在。

examples.text: I thought we might go for a drive on Sunday...
examples.translation: 我想星期天我们可以开车去兜兜风。

examples.text: Naomi used to go to church in Granville every Sunday.
examples.translation: 娜奥米以前每个星期天都去格兰维尔的教堂做礼拜。

examples.text: The rain began before sunrise.
examples.translation: 日出前下起了雨。

examples.text: There was a spectacular sunrise yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天的朝霞很绚烂。

examples.text: The dance ends at sunset.
examples.translation: 舞会在日落时分结束。

examples.text: There was a red sunset over Paris.
examples.translation: 巴黎的天空映着红色的晚霞。

examples.text: In the marina yachts sparkle in the sunshine...
examples.translation: 码头上游艇在阳光下闪闪发光。

examples.text: She was sitting outside a cafe in bright sunshine...
examples.translation: 她坐在咖啡馆外阳光明媚的地方。

examples.text: I awoke next morning to brilliant sunshine streaming into my room.
examples.translation: 第二天早晨我醒来时房间里洒满了灿烂的阳光。

meanings.meaning: 特级品，特大号；临时雇员

examples.text: We had a super time...
examples.translation: 我们玩得很痛快。

examples.text: That's a super idea...
examples.translation: 那真是个绝妙的主意。

examples.text: 'I think I could find you something.'—'That would be super.'
examples.translation: “我想我可以给你找到点儿什么东西。”——“那太棒了。”

examples.text: I'm going to Greece in the summer so I've got to be super slim.
examples.translation: 夏天我要去希腊，因此我要变得格外苗条才好。

examples.text: ...squads of super-fit athletes.
examples.translation: 身体超棒的一组组运动员

examples.text: ...the development of superfast computers.
examples.translation: 超高速计算机的研发

examples.text: ...building Russia into a super state.
examples.translation: 把俄罗斯建成一个超级大国

examples.text: ...a chance to test-drive a stunning Lotus super-car.
examples.translation: 试驾车速惊人的莲花牌超级汽车的机会

examples.text: ...planning and refining the next generation of superweapons.
examples.translation: 设计和改进下一代超级武器

examples.text: There is a superb 18-hole golf course 6 miles away...
examples.translation: 6 英里外有一个一流的 18 洞高尔夫球场。

examples.text: The waters are crystal clear and offer a superb opportunity for swimming.
examples.translation: 这片水域水质清澈，是游泳的绝佳场所。

examples.text: The orchestra played superbly.
examples.translation: 这支管弦乐队演奏得棒极了。

examples.text: With superb skill he managed to make a perfect landing.
examples.translation: 他凭借超凡的技术实现了完美着陆。

examples.text: ...his superbly disciplined opponent...
examples.translation: 他那训练有素的对手

examples.text: The sports complex is huge and superbly well-equipped.
examples.translation: 这个综合体育馆规模巨大，设备一流。

meanings.meaning: 表面的；肤浅的 ；表面文章的；外表的；（人）浅薄的

examples.text: This guy is a superficial yuppie with no intellect whatsoever...
examples.translation: 这个家伙是个肤浅的雅皮士，没有什么头脑。

examples.text: The tone of his book is consistently negative, occasionally arrogant, and often superficial.
examples.translation: 他的书基调一贯是负面消极的，有时还有点儿傲慢自大，且常常流于肤浅。

examples.text: He hated the superficiality, the neon glamour and the cheap prettiness of life in L.A.
examples.translation: 他痛恨洛杉矶浮华浅薄、灯红酒绿、纸醉金迷的生活。

examples.text: Hill cannot write badly or superficially; his characters and plotting are, as usual, admirable.
examples.translation: 希尔不可能写得太差，也不会缺乏深度;他刻画的人物和情节和以前一样精彩。

examples.text: Their arguments do not withstand the most superficial scrutiny...
examples.translation: 他们的论据经不起一点推敲。

examples.text: His roommate had been pleasant on a superficial level...
examples.translation: 他的舍友只是表面上装和气。

examples.text: Father had no more than a superficial knowledge of music.
examples.translation: 父亲对音乐只懂一点皮毛。

examples.text: His assessment only serves to demonstrate the superficiality of the judgements we make when we first meet people.
examples.translation: 他的评价只能证明我们对人的第一印象是肤浅的。

examples.text: The film touches on these difficult questions, but only superficially.
examples.translation: 这部电影触及了这些难题，但只是蜻蜓点水式的。

examples.text: Despite these superficial resemblances, this is a darker work than her earlier novels...
examples.translation: 尽管表面上有一些相似之处，但这本著作实际要比她以前的小说悲观。

examples.text: Spain may well look different but the changes are superficial.
examples.translation: 西班牙可能看起来与以前有很大不同，但这些变化都是表面上的。

examples.text: Many of these killers are frequently glib and superficially charming...
examples.translation: 这些杀手中，多数都是能说会道、外表迷人。

examples.text: Superficially there have been many changes in Britain in recent years.
examples.translation: 近几年来英国的面貌发生了很多变化。

examples.text: The 69-year-old clergyman escaped with superficial wounds...
examples.translation: 69 岁的牧师幸免于难，只受了点皮肉伤。

examples.text: The explosion caused superficial damage to the fortified house.
examples.translation: 这次爆炸只对这所加固过的房屋造成了轻微破坏。

examples.text: ...superficial blood vessels in the forearm.
examples.translation: 前臂的表层血管

meanings.meaning: 多余的；不必要的；奢侈的

examples.text: My presence at the afternoon's proceedings was superfluous...
examples.translation: 我去参加下午的活动是多此一举。

examples.text: I rid myself of many superfluous belongings and habits that bothered me.
examples.translation: 我把很多无用的物品都丢掉了，并且改掉了一些让我烦心的习惯。

meanings.meaning: 上级的；优秀的，出众的；高傲的
上级，长官；优胜者，高手；长者

examples.text: We have a relationship infinitely superior to those of many of our friends...
examples.translation: 我们的关系要比我们其他许多朋友的关系好得多。

examples.text: ...a woman greatly superior to her husband in education and sensitivity...
examples.translation: 学历和悟性都比她丈夫高出许多的女人

examples.text: Long-term stock market investments have produced superior returns compared with cash deposits.
examples.translation: 股票市场长期投资的收益比现金存款要高。

examples.text: The technical superiority of laser discs over tape is well established.
examples.translation: 激光影碟相对于磁带的技术优势早已牢牢确立。

examples.text: A few years ago it was virtually impossible to find superior quality coffee in local shops...
examples.translation: 几年前在当地商店里几乎买不到优质咖啡。

examples.text: Lulu was said to be of very superior intelligence.
examples.translation: 大家都说露露智力出众。

examples.text: ...negotiations between the mutineers and their superior officers...
examples.translation: 哗变士兵和他们的上司长官间的谈判

examples.text: Locally passed laws are of superior authority to those laws passed in Moscow.
examples.translation: 当地法律高于莫斯科颁布的全国法律。

examples.text: Other army units are completely surrounded and cut-off from communication with their superiors...
examples.translation: 其他陆军部队被重重包围，和上级的联系也被切断了。

examples.text: The company president, and my immediate superior, was the dynamic Harry Stokes.
examples.translation: 公司的董事长，也就是我的直接上司，是精力充沛的哈里·斯托克斯。

examples.text: Finch gave a superior smile...
examples.translation: 芬奇高傲地笑了笑。

examples.text: You can stand there and feel superior as you point and laugh at them.
examples.translation: 你站在那儿指指点点、嘲笑他们时，会觉得自己高人一等。

examples.text: ...a false sense of his superiority over mere journalists.
examples.translation: 他在微不足道的记者面前所表现出的一种虚妄的优越感

examples.text: The demonstrators fled when they saw the authorities' superior numbers...
examples.translation: 看到当局派出人员人数占优，示威者就四散逃跑了。

examples.text: His men were far superior numerically.
examples.translation: 他手下的士兵在人数上占了绝对优势。

examples.text: Anthony sometimes felt that his mistress was his superior in willpower...
examples.translation: 有时安东尼感觉他的情妇比他更有意志力。

examples.text: Among his immediate rivals was Arnold Matters, probably his superior in comic roles.
examples.translation: 在他的直接竞争者中，阿诺德·马特斯也许在喜剧表演上比他更胜一筹。

examples.text: The US will need a three-to-one superiority in forces to be sure of a successful attack...
examples.translation: 美国需要在军力上具有3比1的优势才能确保进攻胜利。

examples.text: We have air superiority.
examples.translation: 我们有空中优势。

meanings.meaning: 超级市场；自助售货商店

examples.text: Most of us do our food shopping in the supermarket...
examples.translation: 我们大多数人去超市购买食品。

examples.text: How do those prawns find their way from Norway to the supermarket shelf?
examples.translation: 这些对虾是如何从挪威跑到超市货架上来的呢？

examples.text: There was a huge bang; it sounded like a supersonic jet.
examples.translation: 传来一声巨响，听起来像是超音速喷气式飞机的声音。

examples.text: Fortune-telling is a very much debased art surrounded by superstition...
examples.translation: 算命是一种非常低级的把戏，充满了迷信色彩。

examples.text: The phantom of the merry-go-round is just a local superstition.
examples.translation: 旋转木马的幽灵只不过是当地的迷信说法。

examples.text: University teachers have refused to supervise students' examinations...
examples.translation: 大学教师拒绝监考。

examples.text: He supervised and trained more than 400 volunteers.
examples.translation: 他指导和培训了 400 多名志愿者。

examples.text: He makes the wines and supervises the vineyards...
examples.translation: 他酿酒并管理葡萄园。

examples.text: One of his jobs was supervising the dining room.
examples.translation: 他的工作之一是管理餐厅。

examples.text: Some guests like to dress for supper.
examples.translation: 一些客人喜欢穿礼服去赴晚宴。Y See Usage Note at meal. 见 meal 的用法说明

examples.text: She gives the children their supper, then puts them to bed.
examples.translation: 她让孩子们吃了点夜宵，然后让他们上床睡觉。

examples.text: They would have to 'sing for their supper' during the exhausting official round of duties.
examples.translation: 他们不得不在那些耗人精力的官方手续的办理过程中进行疏通。

meanings.meaning: 增补，补充；补充物；增刊，副刊

examples.text: ...people doing extra jobs outside their regular jobs to supplement their incomes...
examples.translation: 除了正常的工作外还要额外兼职以贴补收入的人

examples.text: I suggest supplementing your diet with vitamins E and A.
examples.translation: 我建议你在日常饮食中补充些维生素 E 和维生素 A。

examples.text: Business sponsorship must be a supplement to, not a substitute for, public funding.
examples.translation: 商业赞助必须是公共基金的一种补充，而不能取而代之。

examples.text: ...a multiple vitamin and mineral supplement...
examples.translation: 含复合维生素和矿物质的营养剂

examples.text: I took regular supplements and exercised every day.
examples.translation: 我每天都按时吃营养片并坚持锻炼。

examples.text: ...a special supplement to a monthly financial magazine.
examples.translation: 一本金融杂志月刊的特别增刊

examples.text: ...the supplement to the Encyclopedia Britannica.
examples.translation: 《不列颠百科全书》附录

examples.text: If you are travelling alone, the single room supplement is £11 a night.
examples.translation: 如果是一个人旅行，住单间每晚要多交 11 英镑。

examples.text: Some people may be entitled to a housing benefit supplement.
examples.translation: 有些人可能有资格拿到住房补贴。

examples.text: ...people who need a supplement to their basic pension.
examples.translation: 除了基本养老金外还需要额外补贴的人

examples.text: ...an agreement not to produce or supply chemical weapons.
examples.translation: 不生产或供应化学武器的协议

examples.text: ...a pipeline which will supply the major Greek cities with Russian natural gas.
examples.translation: 从俄罗斯向希腊主要城市输送天然气的管道

examples.text: ...the blood vessels supplying oxygen to the brain.
examples.translation: 向脑部供氧的血管

examples.text: What happens when food and gasoline supplies run low?...
examples.translation: 如果食物和汽油供应减少，会出现什么情况呢？

examples.text: The country's only supplies are those it can import by lorry from Vietnam.
examples.translation: 这个国家仅有的补给品是用卡车从越南进口来的。

examples.text: The brain requires a constant supply of oxygen...
examples.translation: 大脑需要持续供氧。

examples.text: Most urban water supplies in the United States now contain fluoride in varying amounts.
examples.translation: 现在美国大部分城市供水中都存在含量不一的氟化物。

examples.text: Prices change according to supply and demand.
examples.translation: 价格受供求关系的影响。

examples.text: Supply the missing word(s) and you could win a T-shirt.
examples.translation: 填出所缺少的单词，你就会赢得一件T恤。

examples.text: Food is in short supply all over the country...
examples.translation: 全国普遍食品供应不足。

examples.text: Nowadays that sort of innocence is in short supply.
examples.translation: 现在那种天真烂漫很少见。

meanings.meaning: 支持，支撑，支援；扶持，帮助；赡养，供养
支持，维持；支援，供养；支持者，支撑物

examples.text: The vice president insisted that he supported the hard-working people of New York...
examples.translation: 副总统坚称他支持辛勤工作的纽约人。

examples.text: The National Union of Mineworkers pressed the party to support a total ban on imported coal.
examples.translation: 全国矿工工会向该政党施压，要求其同意全面禁止煤炭进口。

examples.text: The prime minister gave his full support to the government's reforms...
examples.translation: 首相对政府改革予以全力支持。

examples.text: They are prepared to resort to violence in support of their beliefs.
examples.translation: 他们准备诉诸暴力来捍卫自己的信仰。

examples.text: It was hard to come to terms with her death after all the support she gave to me and the family...
examples.translation: 她曾经给予我和家人莫大的帮助，她的死讯令人难以接受。

examples.text: We hope to continue to have her close support and friendship.
examples.translation: 我们希望她能继续大力支持，并能与她维持亲密友谊。

examples.text: ...the government's proposal to cut agricultural support by only about 15%.
examples.translation: 仅削减约 15%的农业拨款的政府提案

examples.text: I have children to support, money to be earned, and a home to be maintained...
examples.translation: 我要抚养孩子，挣钱养家。

examples.text: She sold everything she'd ever bought in order to support herself through art school.
examples.translation: 为了供自己读完艺术学校，她把过去购置的所有东西都卖掉了。

examples.text: The Freudian theory about daughters falling in love with their father has little evidence to support it.
examples.translation: 弗洛伊德关于女儿恋父的理论缺乏依据。

examples.text: The two largest powers in any system must always be major rivals. History offers some support for this view.
examples.translation: 任何制度里两个最大的权力组织必定总是主要对手，这一点历史可以提供佐证。

examples.text: ...the thick wooden posts that supported the ceiling...
examples.translation: 支撑天花板的粗木柱子

examples.text: Let your baby sit on the floor propped up with plenty of cushions to support him.
examples.translation: 让宝宝坐在地板上，多放几个垫子让他倚靠。

examples.text: He supported himself by means of a nearby post.
examples.translation: 他靠在旁边的柱子上。

examples.text: Alice, very pale, was leaning against him as if for support.
examples.translation: 脸色苍白的艾丽斯靠在他身上，像在寻求支撑。

examples.text: Tim, 17, supports Manchester United.
examples.translation: 17 岁的蒂姆支持曼联队。

meanings.meaning: 假设；认为；让（虚拟语气）；推想

examples.text: Suppose someone gave you an egg and asked you to describe exactly what was inside...
examples.translation: 假设有人给了你一枚鸡蛋并要你准确描述鸡蛋里面有什么。

examples.text: Supposing he's right and I do die tomorrow? Maybe I should take out an extra insurance policy.
examples.translation: 假设他是对的，我确实明天就会死，那该怎么办？也许我应该再买一份保险。

examples.text: The policy is perfectly clear and I see no reason to suppose that it isn't working...
examples.translation: 这项政策非常清楚明了，我没有理由认为它不会奏效。

examples.text: I knew very well that the problem was more complex than he supposed...
examples.translation: 我很清楚那个问题比他料想的要更复杂。

examples.text: It had been supposed that by then Peter would be married.
examples.translation: 人们一直认为到那时彼得应该结婚了。

examples.text: I get a bit uptight these days. Hormones, I suppose...
examples.translation: 这些天我有点焦躁。我看是荷尔蒙在作怪。

examples.text: I suppose I'd better do some homework...
examples.translation: 我看我最好做做功课。

examples.text: Is that the right way up? — Yeah. I suppose so...
examples.translation: 这是上去的路吗？——是的，我想是。

examples.text: There's nothing to keep us here, is there? — I suppose not.
examples.translation: 这里没有什么让我们留恋的，对吧？——我想没有。

examples.text: I suppose you think you're funny...
examples.translation: 我想你认为自己很好笑。

examples.text: I don't suppose it occurred to you to notify the police.
examples.translation: 我看你没想过要去通知警察。

examples.text: I don't suppose you could tell me where James Street is could you?
examples.translation: 你能否告诉我詹姆斯街在哪儿？

examples.text: Do you suppose he was telling the truth?...
examples.translation: 你认为他说的是实话吗？

examples.text: What do you suppose they want with her?...
examples.translation: 你认为他们想从她那里得到什么？

examples.text: You don't suppose they'd start the trip without us, do you?
examples.translation: 你认为他们是不会抛下我们就上路的，对吧？

examples.text: Do you suppose we could get together for a little chat sometime soon?
examples.translation: 我们最近能抽空聚在一起聊上几句吗？

meanings.meaning: 最高的；至高的；最重要的

examples.text: MacArthur was Supreme Commander for the allied powers in the Pacific.
examples.translation: 麦克阿瑟将军曾是太平洋战区盟军的最高统帅。

examples.text: ...the Supreme Court.
examples.translation: 最高法院

examples.text: ...the Supreme Being.
examples.translation: 上帝

examples.text: Her approval was of supreme importance...
examples.translation: 她的认可是至关重要的。

examples.text: The lady conspired to seize supreme power.
examples.translation: 该女士图谋攫取最高权力。

examples.text: We are supremely confident because we have the right mixture of skill and experience...
examples.translation: 我们有必备的技巧和经验，因此自信满满。

examples.text: She gets on with her job and does it supremely well.
examples.translation: 她继续她的工作,并且做得非常出色。

examples.text: ...drug traffickers, who continue to flourish despite international attempts to suppress them...
examples.translation: 在国际社会强力打击下活动依然猖獗的贩毒分子

examples.text: ...nationwide demonstrations for democracy, suppressed after 7 weeks by the army.
examples.translation: 在进行7周后遭到军队镇压的全国性民主示威活动

examples.text: ...people who were imprisoned after the violent suppression of the pro-democracy movement protests.
examples.translation: 在拥护民主的抗议活动遭到暴力镇压后被投入监狱的人们

examples.text: The reproduction and growth of the cancerous cells can be suppressed by bombarding them with radiation.
examples.translation: 可以通过放疗杀死癌细胞来抑制其再生和扩散。

examples.text: ...the strongest evidence so far that ultraviolet light can suppress human immune responses.
examples.translation: 迄今为止可证明紫外线能抑制人体免疫反应的最有力证据

examples.text: Eye problems can indicate an unhealthy lifestyle with subsequent suppression of the immune system.
examples.translation: 患眼疾可能表明生活方式不健康，而且免疫系统同时受到抑制。

examples.text: Liz thought of Barry and suppressed a smile...
examples.translation: 莉兹想起了巴里，忍住没笑。

examples.text: The Professor said that deep sleep allowed suppressed anxieties to surface.
examples.translation: 教授说深度睡眠可以使压抑的焦虑情绪得以释放。

examples.text: A mother's suppression of her own feelings can cause problems.
examples.translation: 母亲压抑自己的情感会产生问题。

examples.text: At no time did they try to persuade me to suppress the information...
examples.translation: 他们从没有试图劝我隐瞒这个消息。

examples.text: The wrong criminal is in the dock either because a genuine mistake has been made or because evidence has been suppressed.
examples.translation: 冤案错案的出现，要么是因为确实弄错了，要么是因为证据被隐瞒。

examples.text: The inspectors found no evidence which supported any allegation of suppression of official documents.
examples.translation: 检察官没有找到任何证据来证实有关官方文件被封锁的说法。

examples.text: 'The Government is suppressing inflation by devastating the economy,' he said...
examples.translation: 他说，“政府正在通过破坏经济来抑制通货膨胀。”

examples.text: Lawyers said today's ruling would lead to higher prices and would suppress innovation of new products.
examples.translation: 律师们称今天的裁决将会抬升价格，并抑制新产品的创新。

examples.text: Ozone forms a protective layer between 12 and 30 miles above the Earth's surface.
examples.translation: 臭氧在地球表面上方 12 到 30 英里处形成一个保护层。

examples.text: ...tiny little waves on the surface of the water...
examples.translation: 水面的涟漪

examples.text: The road surface has started breaking up...
examples.translation: 路面已开始开裂。

examples.text: Its total surface area was seven thousand square feet.
examples.translation: 它的总表面积为 7,000 平方英尺。

examples.text: It can simply be left on the work surface...
examples.translation: 把它放在操作台上就行了。

examples.text: Place the fish on a flat surface and sprinkle the flesh with lemon juice and pepper.
examples.translation: 将鱼放在案面上并在鱼肉上撒柠檬汁和胡椒粉。

examples.text: Back in Britain, things appear, on the surface, simpler...
examples.translation: 而在英国国内，事情表面上看来要简单一些。

examples.text: Social unrest, never far below the surface in Brazil, has erupted over the last few days...
examples.translation: 巴西一直以来一触即发的社会不安定因素在过去的几天里爆发了。

examples.text: It's brought to the surface a much wider controversy.
examples.translation: 这使得更广泛的争论浮现了出来。

examples.text: In contrast with its surface fleet, Britain's submarine force was relatively small.
examples.translation: 同其水面舰队相比，英国的潜艇部队规模相对较小。

examples.text: ...Nato surface forces.
examples.translation: 北约地面部队

examples.text: He surfaced, gasping for air.
examples.translation: 他浮出水面，大口吸气。

examples.text: The paper says the evidence, when it surfaces, is certain to cause uproar...
examples.translation: 该报称该证据一经披露，一定会引起骚动。

examples.text: The emotions will surface at some point in life...
examples.translation: 各种情绪都会在生活中的某个时刻流露出来。

examples.text: The same old problems would surface again.
examples.translation: 同样的老问题会再次暴露出来。

examples.text: There's no chance that he'll surface because he's bound to have heard by now...
examples.translation: 他不会再出现了，因为他现在肯定听说了。

examples.text: What time do you surface?
examples.translation: 你几点钟会醒？

meanings.meaning: 汹涌；大浪，波涛；汹涌澎湃；巨涌

examples.text: Specialists see various reasons for the recent surge in inflation...
examples.translation: 专家们认为目前通货膨胀加剧有多种原因。

examples.text: The anniversary is bound to bring a new surge of interest in Dylan's work.
examples.translation: 该周年纪念肯定会再一次激发人们对迪伦作品的浓厚兴趣。

examples.text: The Freedom Party's electoral support surged from just under 10 per cent to nearly 17 per cent...
examples.translation: 自由党的选举支持率从区区不到 10%骤升至近 17%。

examples.text: Surging imports will add to the demand for hard currency.
examples.translation: 进口激增将增加对硬通货的需求。

examples.text: The photographers and cameramen surged forward.
examples.translation: 摄影师和摄像师们蜂拥上前。

examples.text: ...the crowd surging out from the church.
examples.translation: 从教堂里涌出的人群

examples.text: The whole car shuddered with an almost frightening surge of power...
examples.translation: 油门猛然加大到几乎让人恐惧的程度，整个汽车剧烈震颤着。

examples.text: In the year 1091, London Bridge was destroyed by a tidal surge during a storm.
examples.translation: 伦敦大桥曾于 1091 年在一次暴风雨中被汹涌的潮水冲毁。

examples.text: Thousands of volts surged through his car after he careered into a lamp post, ripping out live wires...
examples.translation: 他的车猛地撞到灯柱上，扯断了带电的电线，数千伏高压电流骤然通过车身。

examples.text: Fish and seaweed rose, caught motionless in the surging water.
examples.translation: 鱼和海藻浮起来，在汹涌的水流中动弹不得。

examples.text: 'It must be very difficult,' said Hunter, feeling a surge of embarrassment for Diane's predicament...
examples.translation: “那肯定不好过，”亨特说，突然为黛安娜的困境感到很为难。

examples.text: He was overcome by a sudden surge of jealousy.
examples.translation: 他突然妒火中烧。

examples.text: Nausea surged in him and he retched violently...
examples.translation: 他突然觉得恶心，猛烈地干呕起来。

examples.text: Panic surged through her.
examples.translation: 她顿时惊慌失措。

examples.text: A slow hatred for Hilton began to surge up in him...
examples.translation: 他心里开始对希尔顿渐生恨意。

examples.text: Memories surged up in Don's mind.
examples.translation: 一幕幕回忆在唐脑海里涌现。

examples.text: ...a heart surgeon.
examples.translation: 心脏外科医师

meanings.meaning: 外科；外科手术；手术室；诊疗室

examples.text: His father has just recovered from heart surgery...
examples.translation: 他父亲刚刚从心脏外科手术中康复过来。

examples.text: Mr Clark underwent five hours of emergency surgery.
examples.translation: 克拉克先生经受了 5 个小时的外科急救手术。

examples.text: Bill was in the doctor's surgery demanding to know what was wrong with him.
examples.translation: 比尔在医生的诊疗室里想要知道自己到底得了什么病。

examples.text: His surgery always ends at eleven.
examples.translation: 他的出诊时间总是到11点结束。

examples.text: She'd never known his surname...
examples.translation: 她一直不知道他姓什么。

examples.text: The majority of British women adopt their husband's surname when they marry.
examples.translation: 大多数英国女性结婚后随夫姓。

examples.text: He'd never been in a class before and he was not even sure that he should have been teaching...
examples.translation: 他以前从未教过课，甚至不确定自己该不该教课。

examples.text: The president has never been sure which direction he wanted to go in on this issue...
examples.translation: 总统一直都不确定自己想从哪个方面来着手处理该问题。

examples.text: She was no longer sure how she felt about him...
examples.translation: 她不再确定自己对他的感觉。

examples.text: It is impossible to be sure about the value of land.
examples.translation: 土地的价值是无法确定的。

examples.text: A lot of people think that it's better to pay for their education so that they can be sure of getting quality...
examples.translation: 许多人认为最好是接受付费教育，这样能确保教学质量。

examples.text: It is the self-assurance of the new generation which makes them sure of their success.
examples.translation: 年轻一代的自信让他们对成功志在必得。

examples.text: With over 80 beaches to choose from, you are sure to find a place to lay your towel...
examples.translation: 有 80 多个海滩可供选择，你一定能找到一处满意的。

examples.text: Anyone who goes food shopping without a list is sure to forget the things they really need.
examples.translation: 任何人如果采购食物时没列清单的话，肯定会忘了真正需要的东西。

examples.text: Sharpe's leg and shoulder began to ache, a sure sign of rain...
examples.translation: 夏普的腿和肩膀开始疼痛，这预示着肯定要下雨了。

examples.text: She has a sure grasp of social issues such as literacy, poverty and child care.
examples.translation: 她对扫盲、贫穷和儿童保育等社会问题都有深切的认识。

examples.text: New to the job, he was keen to demonstrate his sureness of mind.
examples.translation: 刚接触这份工作，他急于展示自己的聪明才智。

examples.text: Be sure to read about how mozzarella is made, on page 65...
examples.translation: 务必看看莫泽雷勒干酪是怎么制成的，在第 65 页。

examples.text: Be sure you get your daily quota of calcium.
examples.translation: 要确保每天的钙摄入量。

examples.text: 'He rang you?' — 'Sure. Last night.'...
examples.translation: “他给你打电话了？”——“没错。昨天晚上打的。”

examples.text: 'I'd like to be alone, O.K?' — 'Sure. O.K.'...
examples.translation: “我想一个人呆会儿，好吗？”——“好的，没问题。”

examples.text: 'We'll phone and you can make an appointment.' —'Sure. What time do you want to go?'
examples.translation: “我们会再打电话，你可以安排约见。”——“没问题。你们想什么时间去？”

examples.text: 'Has the whole world just gone crazy?' — 'Sure looks that way, doesn't it.'
examples.translation: “整个世界难道都疯了吗？”——“看上去的确如此，不是吗。”

examples.text: It sure is hot, he thought.
examples.translation: 天的确太热了，他想。

examples.text: We found the English treacle pudding too good to resist. Sure enough, it was delicious...
examples.translation: 我们觉得英国糖蜜布丁太好吃了，令人无法抗拒。的确非常美味。

examples.text: I was in a shop when I saw a lady looking carefully at me. She'd recognised me, and sure enough, she came across.
examples.translation: 我正在逛商店，突然看到一位女士在仔细地打量我。她认出了我，果不其然，她走了过来。

examples.text: One thing's for sure, Astbury's vocal style hasn't changed much over the years...
examples.translation: 有一点可以肯定，阿斯特伯里的演唱风格多年来没怎么改变。

examples.text: Even to this day we don't know what happened for sure.
examples.translation: 即使到现在我们也不确定究竟发生了什么。

examples.text: Make sure that you follow the instructions carefully...
examples.translation: 一定要认真按照操作指南来做。

examples.text: He wants to make sure that schools are committed to providing alternative education.
examples.translation: 他想确保学校尽力提供新型教育。

examples.text: He looked in the bathroom to make sure that he was alone...
examples.translation: 他往浴室里看了看，确定就他一个人。

examples.text: Before you cut the cloth, make sure that the pattern matches up on both edges.
examples.translation: 在裁剪布料前要确保两个边缘的图案对称。

examples.text: This proposal is by no means a sure thing.
examples.translation: 这个提议绝不会理所当然地获得通过。

examples.text: 'Be careful!' — 'Sure thing, Dad. So long.'
examples.translation: “要多加小心!”——“一定会的，爸爸。再见。”

examples.text: Parents make the rules. To be sure, many of the rules are no longer appropriate today.
examples.translation: 规矩由父母立下。诚然，其中有许多放在今天已不再合适了。

examples.text: I'd never seen him like this, so sure of himself, so in command.
examples.translation: 我从来没见他如此自信满满、指挥自若。

meanings.meaning: 超越；胜过，优于；非…所能办到或理解

examples.text: He was determined to surpass the achievements of his older brothers...
examples.translation: 他决心超越几个哥哥的成就。

examples.text: Warwick Arts Centre is the second largest Arts Centre in Britain, surpassed in size only by London's Barbican.
examples.translation: 沃里克艺术中心是英国第二大艺术中心，规模仅次于伦敦的巴比肯。

examples.text: Conrad Black gave an excellent party that surpassed expectations.
examples.translation: 康拉德·布莱克举办了一次远超人们预期的精彩聚会。

examples.text: ...a clever and spectacularly successful system, the detailed complexity of which surpasses our full understanding.
examples.translation: 一个设计巧妙且极其成功的系统，其复杂的细节非我辈所能完全理解

meanings.meaning: 剩余；[贸易] 顺差；盈余；过剩

examples.text: Germany suffers from a surplus of teachers.
examples.translation: 德国遭遇了教师过剩的问题。

examples.text: Few people have large sums of surplus cash...
examples.translation: 几乎没人手头很富裕。

examples.text: I sell my surplus birds to a local pet shop...
examples.translation: 我把多余的鸟卖给当地的宠物商店。

examples.text: The houses are being sold because they are surplus to requirements.
examples.translation: 这些因超出需求而闲置着的房子正在出售。

examples.text: Japan's annual trade surplus is in the region of 100 billion dollars.
examples.translation: 日本每年的贸易顺差额在 1,000 亿美元左右。

examples.text: Norway's budget surplus has fallen from 5.9% in 1986 to an expected 0.1% this year.
examples.translation: 挪威的预算盈余已经从 1986 年的 5.9%降至今年预计的 0.1%。

examples.text: General Martin Bonnet called on the rebels to surrender...
examples.translation: 马丁·邦尼特将军呼吁反叛者投降。

examples.text: She surrendered to the police in London last December.
examples.translation: 她去年 12 月在伦敦向警方自首。

examples.text: ...the government's apparent surrender to demands made by the religious militants.
examples.translation: 政府对宗教激进分子所提要求的明显妥协

examples.text: Nadja had to fill out forms surrendering all rights to her property...
examples.translation: 纳佳不得不填表放弃其全部财产所有权。

examples.text: Gen. Morgan's troops yesterday surrendered their heavy weapons to Belgian and US troops.
examples.translation: 昨天，摩根将军的部队被迫向比利时和美国军队交出了他们的重型武器。

examples.text: ...the sixteen-day deadline for the surrender of weapons and ammunition.
examples.translation: 上缴武器和弹药的16天期限

examples.text: They have been ordered to surrender their passports.
examples.translation: 他们被要求出示护照。

examples.text: ...the need for total personal surrender to and dependence on Jesus...
examples.translation: 需要完全顺从并依靠耶稣

examples.text: Depression is a partial surrender to death...
examples.translation: 沮丧是对死亡的一定妥协。

examples.text: A look of disbelief came into his eyes, but was quickly replaced by one of dismal surrender.
examples.translation: 他眼里闪现出一丝怀疑，但又马上代之以可怜无助的依从。

examples.text: The small churchyard was surrounded by a rusted wrought-iron fence...
examples.translation: 不大的教堂墓地周边围着一圈生锈的熟铁栅栏。

examples.text: The shell surrounding the egg has many important functions.
examples.translation: 蛋壳有许多重要的功能。

examples.text: ...the snipers and artillerymen in the surrounding hills.
examples.translation: 周围山里的狙击手和炮手

examples.text: When the car stopped in the town square it was surrounded by soldiers and militiamen...
examples.translation: 当汽车停在城镇广场时立刻被士兵和民兵包围了。

examples.text: He tried to run away but gave up when he found himself surrounded...
examples.translation: 他试图逃跑，但发现已被包围时只好放弃了这个念头。

examples.text: Shooting broke out after the guards surrounded a villa in the city.
examples.translation: 卫兵包围了该市的一所别墅后便发生了枪战。

examples.text: The decision had been agreed in principle before today's meeting, but some controversy surrounded it...
examples.translation: 该决定在今天的会议之前就已达成原则上的共识，但围绕这一决定还存在一些争议。

examples.text: Once the euphoria surrounding this victory subsides, reality must return.
examples.translation: 这场胜利的喜悦退去后，人们将不得不回归现实。

examples.text: He had made it his business to surround himself with a hand-picked group of bright young officers...
examples.translation: 他总会亲手挑选一批聪明而年轻的军官常伴他左右。

examples.text: They love being surrounded by familiar possessions.
examples.translation: 他们喜欢身边都是自己熟悉的物品。

examples.text: ...a small fireplace with a cast-iron surround.
examples.translation: 有铸铁边饰的小壁炉

examples.text: The entire team enjoyed hot showers in the spacious surrounds of a new, modern village hall.
examples.translation: 全队都在新建的现代化村会所的宽敞洗浴间享受了热水淋浴。

examples.text: Schumacher adapted effortlessly to his new surroundings.
examples.translation: 舒马赫非常轻松地适应了新环境。

examples.text: ...a peaceful holiday home in beautiful surroundings.
examples.translation: 环境优美宁静的度假屋

examples.text: The council conducted a survey of the uses to which farm buildings are put...
examples.translation: 市政会就农场建筑的使用情况进行了调查。

examples.text: According to the survey, overall world trade has also slackened.
examples.translation: 根据这项调查，世界贸易整体上也有所放慢。

examples.text: Business Development Advisers surveyed 211 companies for the report...
examples.translation: 企业发展顾问公司为此报告调查了 211 家公司。

examples.text: Only 18 percent of those surveyed opposed the idea.
examples.translation: 被调查者中只有 18%的人反对该主张。

examples.text: He pushed himself to his feet and surveyed the room...
examples.translation: 他站起来仔细打量整间屋子。

examples.text: He surveys American politics with a conservative world view.
examples.translation: 他用一种保守的世界观审视美国政治。

examples.text: ...a brief survey of some important books on astrology...
examples.translation: 有关占星术的几本重要著作的简要概述

examples.text: He sniffed the perfume she wore, then gave her a quick survey.
examples.translation: 他闻了闻她身上的香水味，然后又飞快地打量了她一眼。

examples.text: ...the organizer of the geological survey of India...
examples.translation: 印度地质勘察活动的组织者

examples.text: The scientists conducted two aerial surveys followed by two ground surveys.
examples.translation: 科学家们在两次地面勘测后又进行了两次空中勘测。

examples.text: Scarborough Council commissioned geological experts earlier this year to survey the cliffs.
