examples.translation: 斯卡伯勒市政会在今年早些时候委托地质专家对这些悬崖进行勘测。

examples.text: ...data relating to astronomy, astrology, surveying and navigation.
examples.translation: 有关天文学、占星术、测量学和航海术的资料信息

examples.text: ...surveying equipment.
examples.translation: 勘测设备

examples.text: ...a structural survey undertaken by a qualified surveyor.
examples.translation: 由一位有资质的房屋鉴定员所作的结构评估

examples.text: ...the people who surveyed the house for the mortgage.
examples.translation: 抵押贷款房屋的评估人员

examples.text: In more than 30 years of surveying he has never yet known a building to collapse because of subsidence.
examples.translation: 他做房屋评估工作都30多年了，还从未听说过哪一座房子由于地基下陷而倒塌的。

meanings.meaning: 幸存，残存；幸存者，残存物

examples.text: ...companies which have been struggling for survival in the advancing recession...
examples.translation: 在日益萧条的经济环境中挣扎求生的各个公司

examples.text: Ask for the free booklet 'Debt: a Survival Guide'.
examples.translation: 可以索要免费小册子《债务：生存指南》。

examples.text: If cancers are spotted early there's a high chance of survival...
examples.translation: 如果癌症在早期发现的话，存活的几率会很高。

examples.text: An animal's sense of smell is still crucial to its survival.
examples.translation: 动物的嗅觉对其生存仍然至关重要。

examples.text: I have a surprise for you: We are moving to Switzerland!...
examples.translation: 我有一个惊喜的消息要告诉你：我们要搬去瑞士了！

examples.text: It may come as a surprise to some that a normal, healthy child is born with many skills...
examples.translation: 一个身体健康正常的小孩天生就会许多技能，这或许会令有些人感到惊奇。

examples.text: It is perhaps no surprise to see another 60s singing star attempting a comeback.
examples.translation: 看到又一个20世纪60年代的歌星试图重返歌坛大概并不会觉得意外。

examples.text: Baxter arrived here this afternoon, on a surprise visit...
examples.translation: 巴克瑟特今天下午突然来此拜访。

examples.text: German intelligence expected Japan to launch a surprise attack on the US, and Pearl Harbor was the likely target.
examples.translation: 德国情报机构预计日本会对美国发动突袭，袭击目标可能是珍珠港。

examples.text: The Foreign Office in London has expressed surprise at these allegations...
examples.translation: 位于伦敦的英国外交部对这些说法表示惊讶。

examples.text: 'You mean he's going to vote against her?' Scobie asked in surprise...
examples.translation: 斯科比惊讶地问道：“你是说他会投她的反对票吗？”

examples.text: I started working hard for the first time in my life. To my surprise, I found I liked it.
examples.translation: 我生平第一次开始努力工作。令我惊讶的是，我发现我竟然很开心。

examples.text: We'll solve the case ourselves and surprise everyone...
examples.translation: 我们要自己解决这件事，然后让所有人感到吃惊。

examples.text: It surprised me that a driver of Alain's experience should make those mistakes...
examples.translation: 令我惊讶的是像阿兰这样经验丰富的司机竟然会犯那样的错误。

examples.text: It wouldn't surprise me if there was such chaos after this election that another had to be held...
examples.translation: 如果你告诉我这次大选后局面会出现混乱，以致不得不重新举行选举，我一点也不会惊讶。

examples.text: They were served lamb and rosemary and she surprised herself by eating greedily.
examples.translation: 给他们上的是迷迭香焖羊肉，令她惊讶的是，自己竟然吃得那么起劲儿。

examples.text: Surprise a new neighbour with one of your favourite home-made dishes.
examples.translation: 做一道拿手的家常小菜，给你的新邻居一个惊喜。

examples.text: ...Senga MacFie, one of the surprises of the World Championships three months ago...
examples.translation: 森加·麦克菲，三个月前世界锦标赛上的一匹黑马

examples.text: My father decided to slip a little extra spending money into my purse as a surprise.
examples.translation: 为了给我一个惊喜，父亲决定往我的钱包里多塞一些零花钱。

examples.text: Marlborough led his armies across the Rhine and surprised the French and Bavarian armies near the village of Blenheim.
examples.translation: 马尔伯勒带领他的部队穿过莱茵河，在离布莱尼姆村不远的地方向法国和巴伐利亚联军发动了突袭。

examples.text: There is a shortage of carrots. So everybody starts growing carrots. Next season, surprise, surprise, there is a glut of carrots.
examples.translation: 胡萝卜紧缺，于是大家都去种胡萝卜。等到来年这个时候，可想而知，胡萝卜就会过剩。

examples.text: He came back in as I was heading up to the shower. 'Surprise, surprise,' he said.
examples.translation: 我正要去淋浴时他回来了。“想不到吧，”他说。

examples.text: His question took his two companions by surprise...
examples.translation: 他提的问题让他的两个伙伴都愣住了。

examples.text: Whenever it snows in Britain we are taken by surprise.
examples.translation: 每次英国下雪，我们都会感到惊讶。

meanings.meaning: 幸存；生还；幸免于；比...活得长

examples.text: ...the sequence of events that left the eight pupils battling to survive in icy seas for over four hours...
examples.translation: 致使这 8 个小学生在冰冷的海水里挣扎求生四个多小时的一连串事件

examples.text: Those organisms that are most suited to the environment will be those that will survive...
examples.translation: 最适宜该环境的微生物将会存活下来。

examples.text: Drugs that dissolve blood clots can help people survive heart attacks.
examples.translation: 能溶解血栓的药物会有助于治疗心脏病。

examples.text: On my first day here I thought, 'Ooh, how will I survive?'
examples.translation: 我第一天到这儿时就想，“天哪，我怎么能挺过去呢?”

examples.text: ...people who are struggling to survive without jobs...
examples.translation: 艰难度日的失业者

examples.text: Where once she had been totally self-sufficient, she now had to survive on income support.
examples.translation: 她曾经完全能自给自足，而现在却不得不靠收入补助金维持生计。

examples.text: ...a man who had survived his share of boardroom coups.
examples.translation: 董事会改组后仍然持有股份的人

examples.text: When the market economy is introduced, many factories will not survive...
examples.translation: 引入市场经济后，许多工厂将面临倒闭。

examples.text: The chances of a planet surviving a supernova always looked terribly slim.
examples.translation: 行星躲过超新星爆发的几率总是十分渺茫。

examples.text: ...surviving examples of 19th-century architecture in the MidWest.
examples.translation: 美国中西部几处仍留存至今的19世纪建筑

examples.text: Most women will survive their spouses...
examples.translation: 大多数女性都比配偶长寿。

examples.text: She is survived by two daughters from her first marriage.
examples.translation: 她身后留下了头婚时生的两个女儿。

examples.text: ...William Shakespeare's last surviving descendant.
examples.translation: 威廉·莎士比亚最后一个健在的子孙

meanings.meaning: 易受影响的；易感动的；容许…的

examples.text: Young people are the most susceptible to advertisements...
examples.translation: 年轻人最容易受广告的影响。

examples.text: James was extremely susceptible to flattery...
examples.translation: 詹姆斯听几句奉承话就忘乎所以。

examples.text: He was, she believes, unusually susceptible to women.
examples.translation: 她认为他对女人毫无招架之力。

examples.text: Walking with weights makes the shoulders very susceptible to injury...
examples.translation: 负重行走时肩膀很容易受伤。

examples.text: Diesel exhaust is particularly aggravating to many susceptible individuals.
examples.translation: 许多体质敏感的人尤其反感柴油废气。

examples.text: Hers was a susceptible nature.
examples.translation: 她很情绪化。

examples.text: I suspect they were right...
examples.translation: 我感觉他们是对的。

examples.text: The above complaints are, I suspect, just the tip of the iceberg...
examples.translation: 我想，以上的抱怨只是冰山一角。

examples.text: Do women really share such stupid jokes? We suspect not.
examples.translation: 女人们真的会觉得如此愚蠢的笑话好笑吗？我们想不会。

examples.text: He suspected that the woman staying in the flat above was using heroin...
examples.translation: 他怀疑楼上公寓里的那个女人正在吸食海洛因。

examples.text: Police said they suspected that Sobhraj had accomplices who are drug smugglers...
examples.translation: 警方说他们怀疑索布拉还有一些走私毒品的同伙。

examples.text: It was perfectly all right, he said, because the police had not suspected him of anything...
examples.translation: 他说，什么事都没有，因为警察一点也没有怀疑到他。

examples.text: You don't really think Webb suspects you?...
examples.translation: 你不是真的认为韦布怀疑你吧？

examples.text: Frears was rushed to hospital with a suspected heart attack.
examples.translation: 弗里尔斯疑似心脏病发作，被紧急送往医院。

examples.text: Police have arrested a suspect in a series of killings and sexual assaults in the city.
examples.translation: 警察已经逮捕了一名涉嫌在该市犯下一系列杀人及强奸案的嫌疑犯。

examples.text: Delegates evacuated the building when a suspect package was found...
examples.translation: 发现可疑包裹后，代表们撤离了这座楼。

examples.text: The firm has taken out adverts in national newspapers to urge customers to return suspect products...
examples.translation: 该公司在全国性的报纸上登出广告，催促顾客退回疑似假冒产品。

examples.text: The whole affair has been highly suspect.
examples.translation: 整件事情一直都非常可疑。

examples.text: There was a suspicion that this runner attempted to avoid the procedures for dope testing...
examples.translation: 这名赛跑选手涉嫌有意逃避兴奋剂检验。

examples.text: The police said their suspicions were aroused because Mr Owens had other marks on his body...
examples.translation: 警方说欧文斯先生尸体上的其他伤痕引起了他们的怀疑。

examples.text: Scotland Yard had assured him he was not under suspicion...
examples.translation: 伦敦警察厅已经向他保证，他没有被视为可疑分子。

examples.text: ... police arrested nineteen people on suspicion of drugs offences and burglary.
examples.translation: 警方逮捕了 19 名涉嫌毒品犯罪和入室盗窃的嫌疑犯

examples.text: ...the traditional British suspicion of psychotherapy...
examples.translation: 英国人传统上对心理疗法的猜忌

examples.text: He may have had some suspicions of Michael Foster, the editor of the journal...
examples.translation: 他可能对杂志主编迈克尔·福斯特有些怀疑。

examples.text: I was always regarded in the Army with a certain amount of suspicion because of my left-wing tendencies.
examples.translation: 由于我的左翼倾向，在军队中我总是受到一些猜疑。

examples.text: I have a sneaking suspicion that they are going to succeed...
examples.translation: 我隐约觉得他们将要成功了。

examples.text: Astronomers will have to collect more spectra from these stars to confirm their suspicions.
examples.translation: 天文学家们必须要从这些恒星上采集更多的光谱来证实他们的推想。

examples.text: ...large blooms of white with a suspicion of pale pink.
examples.translation: 一朵朵略带淡粉色的大白花

examples.text: He was rightly suspicious of meeting me until I reassured him I was not writing about him...
examples.translation: 当然他很不放心见我，直到我再一次向他保证我不是在写他。

examples.text: He has his father's suspicious nature.
examples.translation: 他像他父亲一样生性多疑。

examples.text: 'What is it you want me to do?' Adams asked suspiciously.
examples.translation: 亚当斯满腹狐疑地问道：“你到底要我做什么？”

examples.text: Two officers on patrol became suspicious of two men in a car...
examples.translation: 两名巡警开始对一辆车里的两个人起了疑心。

examples.text: A woman kept prisoner in a basement was rescued after suspicious neighbours tipped off police.
examples.translation: 觉得情况可疑的邻居们报警后，被囚禁在地下室里的一名女子获了救。

examples.text: He reported that two suspicious-looking characters had approached Callendar...
examples.translation: 他报告说两个形迹可疑的人曾跟卡伦德接触过。

examples.text: Nottingham police last night found what they described as a suspicious package.
examples.translation: 诺丁汉警方昨晚找到了他们声称的可疑包裹。

examples.text: They'll question them as to whether anyone was seen acting suspiciously in the area over the last few days...
examples.translation: 他们将询问这些人最近几天在这一带有没有看到形迹可疑的人。

examples.text: Police were told to arrest voters found with suspiciously large sums of money in their pockets.
examples.translation: 警方接到命令，对口袋里装有大量可疑现金的投票者要予以逮捕。

meanings.meaning: 维持；支撑，承担；忍受；供养；证实

examples.text: But he has sustained his fierce social conscience from young adulthood through old age...
examples.translation: 而他从青年时期一直到老年都始终保持着强烈的社会良知。

examples.text: The parameters within which life can be sustained on Earth are extraordinarily narrow.
examples.translation: 地球上生命可以存活下来的地域范围是非常狭小的。

examples.text: ...a period of sustained economic growth throughout 1995.
examples.translation: 1995 年全年经济持续增长时期

examples.text: Every aircraft in there has sustained some damage...
examples.translation: 那里的每架飞机都受到了一些损坏。

examples.text: A seventeen-year-old tourist died late last night of injuries sustained in yesterday's bomb blast.
examples.translation: 一位 17 岁的游客在昨天的炸弹爆炸中受伤并于当天深夜身亡。

examples.text: The cash dividends they get from the cash crop would sustain them during the lean season...
examples.translation: 从经济作物中获得的收益能帮助他们度过不景气的时期。

examples.text: I am sustained by letters of support and what people say to me in ordinary daily life...
examples.translation: 这些支持的信件和人们每天对我的鼓励一直支撑着我。

examples.text: Sustained by this wonderful breakfast, it was with restored morale that we re-boarded our plane.
examples.translation: 这顿丰盛的早餐补充了我们的体力，我们又精神焕发地登上了飞机。

meanings.meaning: 延缓，推迟；使暂停；使悬浮

examples.text: The union suspended strike action this week...
examples.translation: 这周工会暂停了罢工。

examples.text: A UN official said aid programs will be suspended until there's adequate protection for relief convoys.
examples.translation: 一名联合国官员说将会暂停援助项目，直到援助车队能够得到充分的保护为止。

examples.text: Julie was suspended from her job shortly after the incident...
examples.translation: 出事后不久，朱莉就被停职了。

examples.text: Buchanan was suspended for a year from Georgetown University after brawling with police...
examples.translation: 布坎南因与警察发生肢体冲突而被乔治敦大学停学一年。

examples.text: The Lawn Tennis Association suspended Mr Castle from the British team.
examples.translation: 草地网球协会暂停了卡斯尔先生在英国队的职务。

examples.text: ...a mobile of birds or nursery rhyme characters which could be suspended over the cot.
examples.translation: 能悬挂在摇篮上方、由小鸟或童谣故事人物组成的风动玩具

examples.text: ...chandeliers suspended on heavy chains from the ceiling.
examples.translation: 悬挂在天花板上、由粗重吊链吊着的枝形吊灯

examples.text: You are asked to swallow a capsule containing vitamin B...
examples.translation: 你要服一粒维生素 B 胶囊。

examples.text: Polly took a bite of the apple, chewed and swallowed.
examples.translation: 波利咬了一口苹果，嚼了嚼咽了下去。

examples.text: Jan lifted her glass and took a quick swallow.
examples.translation: 简拿起玻璃杯猛地喝了一口。

examples.text: Nancy swallowed hard and shook her head.
examples.translation: 南希用力咽了口口水，摇了摇头。

examples.text: It was vital that he swallowed the story about Juanita being in that motel room that night.
examples.translation: 关键是他对朱厄妮塔那晚住在那个汽车旅馆房间里一事毫不怀疑。

examples.text: I too found this story a little hard to swallow.
examples.translation: 我也觉得这件事有点难以置信。

examples.text: Gordon has swallowed the anger he felt...
examples.translation: 戈登忍住了内心的愤怒。

examples.text: He flashed me a quick grin but rapidly swallowed it when he saw my expression.
examples.translation: 他先是冲我咧嘴一笑，不过看到我的表情后又赶紧收起笑脸。

meanings.meaning: 使陷于沼泽；使沉没；使陷入困境
下沉；陷入沼泽；陷入困境；不知所措（过去式swamped，过去分词swamped，现在分词swamping，第三人称单数swamps，名词swampiness，形容词swampy）

examples.text: A rogue wave swamped the boat...
examples.translation: 凶猛的海浪淹没了船只。

examples.text: The Ventura river burst its banks, swamping a mobile home park.
examples.translation: 本图拉河的河水冲破堤岸，淹没了活动房区。

examples.text: He is swamped with work...
examples.translation: 他工作忙得不可开交。

examples.text: The railway station was swamped with thousands of families trying to flee the city.
examples.translation: 火车站挤满了成千上万想要逃离这座城市的家庭。

examples.text: She spends her time swanning around the world...
examples.translation: 她一个人自由自在地环游世界。

examples.text: The mother was widowed and had swanned off.
examples.translation: 这位母亲成了寡妇，已经悠然闲逛去了。

examples.text: A dark cloud of bees comes swarming out of the hive.
examples.translation: 黑压压的一大群蜜蜂从蜂巢中飞出来。

examples.text: People swarmed to the shops, buying up everything in sight.
examples.translation: 人们成群地涌向商店，见什么买什么。

examples.text: A swarm of people encircled the hotel...
examples.translation: 一大群人围住了这个酒店。

examples.text: Today at the crossing there were swarms of tourists taking photographs.
examples.translation: 今天在十字路口有大群的游客在拍照。

examples.text: Within minutes the area was swarming with officers who began searching a nearby wood.
examples.translation: 几分钟内很多警察就来到了这一地区，开始搜查附近的树林。

examples.text: The people swayed back and forth with arms linked...
examples.translation: 人们手挽手，前后摇晃着。

examples.text: The whole boat swayed and tipped.
examples.translation: 整条船摇晃后翻倒了。

examples.text: ...a coastal highway lined with tall, swaying palm trees.
examples.translation: 两旁有摇曳的高大棕榈树的沿海公路

examples.text: Don't ever be swayed by fashion.
examples.translation: 永远不要受潮流的影响。

examples.text: ...last minute efforts by the main political parties to sway the voters in tomorrow's local elections.
examples.translation: 主要政党为说服选民在明天的地方选举中投自己一票而作出的最后努力

examples.text: South of the Usk, a completely different approach seems to hold sway...
examples.translation: 阿斯克以南盛行的似乎是一种完全不同的方式。

examples.text: The 'families' are the basic units, each holding sway over a recognised territory.
examples.translation: “家庭”是基本单位，每一个家庭都控制着自己受人认可的领地。

examples.text: How mothers keep daughters under their sway is the subject of the next five sections.
examples.translation: 在接下来的 5 节将探讨母亲怎样管教女儿。

examples.text: It's wrong to swear and shout...
examples.translation: 破口大骂是不对的。

examples.text: They swore at them and ran off.
examples.translation: 他们骂了他们后就跑掉了。

examples.text: Alan swore that he would do everything in his power to help us...
examples.translation: 艾伦许诺要尽其所能帮助我们。

examples.text: We have sworn to fight cruelty wherever we find it...
examples.translation: 我们发誓要见恶除恶。

examples.text: The police are the only civil servants who have to swear allegiance to the Crown...
examples.translation: 警察是唯一要宣誓效忠君主的公务员。

examples.text: I have sworn an oath to defend her.
examples.translation: 我发誓要保护她。

examples.text: I swear I've told you all I know...
examples.translation: 我发誓我已经把我所知道的全都告诉你了。

examples.text: I swear on all I hold dear that I had nothing to do with this...
examples.translation: 我以身家性命担保，我和这件事无关。

examples.text: Behind them was a confusion of noise, perhaps even a shot, but he couldn't swear to it.
examples.translation: 他们身后响起一片嘈杂声，也许还有枪击声，但他不能确定。

examples.text: She was bursting to announce the news but was sworn to secrecy.
examples.translation: 她急不可待想宣布这个消息，但却发过誓要守口如瓶。

meanings.meaning: 使出汗；流出；使干苦活；剥削；藉出汗减轻；焦急地期待
出汗；辛苦工作；懊恼；结水珠

examples.text: Both horse and rider were dripping with sweat within five minutes...
examples.translation: 没过五分钟，马和骑手都大汗淋漓。

examples.text: He wiped the sweat off his face and looked around...
examples.translation: 他擦了擦脸上的汗水并四处张望。

examples.text: Her sweat-stained clothing clung to her body.
examples.translation: 她那被汗水浸透的衣服黏在身上。

examples.text: Already they were sweating as the sun beat down upon them.
examples.translation: 在阳光的强烈照射下他们已经汗流浃背。

examples.text: ...symptoms such as sweating, irritability, anxiety and depression.
examples.translation: 发汗、烦躁、焦虑和抑郁等症状

examples.text: Every morning I would break out in a sweat...
examples.translation: 每天早上我都会出一身汗。

examples.text: Cool down very gradually after working up a sweat...
examples.translation: 大量出汗后要慢慢降温。

examples.text: I really don't feel a bit sick, no night sweats, no fevers.
examples.translation: 我真的感觉一点毛病也没有，没盗汗也不发热。

examples.text: The very thought brought me out in a cold sweat.
examples.translation: 一想到这我就一身冷汗。

examples.text: The islanders can do little but sweat it out, wondering whether they will be forced to go and seek a new life elsewhere.
examples.translation: 岛民不知道自己是否要被迫去往他处另谋生路，但却无能为力，只好干等。

examples.text: 'Many thanks.' — 'No sweat. Anything else?'...
examples.translation: “非常感谢。”——“没什么，还需要别的吗？”

examples.text: No-one minds that she's a woman, that's no sweat at all.
examples.translation: 没有人在意她是个女人，这完全没有关系。

meanings.meaning: 毛线衣，运动衫；大量出汗的人，发汗剂

examples.text: She threw him a white sweater against the chill of a fall night in Chicago.
The owner of the store was sweeping his floor when I walked in...
examples.translation: 当我走进商店的时候，店主正在扫地。

examples.text: She was in the kitchen sweeping crumbs into a dust pan...
examples.translation: 她正在厨房把面包屑扫入簸箕里。

examples.text: Norma picked up the broom and began sweeping.
examples.translation: 诺尔玛拿起扫帚开始扫了起来。

examples.text: I swept rainwater off the flat top of a gravestone...
examples.translation: 我拂去了墓碑顶上的雨水。

examples.text: With a gesture of frustration, she swept the cards from the table...
examples.translation: 她懊恼地把桌子上的牌都拂到了地上。

examples.text: 'Thanks friend,' he said, while sweeping the money into his pocket.
examples.translation: “谢了，朋友，”他说着就把钱划拉进了口袋。

examples.text: ...stylish ways of sweeping your hair off your face...
examples.translation: 露出脸形的时髦发式

examples.text: Her long, fine hair was swept back in a ponytail.
examples.translation: 她长长的秀发在脑后梳成一个马尾。

examples.text: His arm swept around the room...
examples.translation: 他伸出手臂绕着房间挥了一圈。

examples.text: Daniels swept his arm over his friend's shoulder.
examples.translation: 丹尼尔斯把胳膊搭在了他朋友的肩上。

examples.text: ...the long sweeping arm movements of a violinist.
examples.translation: 小提琴演奏者的大幅度挥臂动作

examples.text: With one sweep of her hand she threw back the sheets.
examples.translation: 她手一挥掀开了床单。

examples.text: ...landslides that buried homes and swept cars into the sea...
examples.translation: 埋没家园并把汽车卷入大海的山体滑坡

examples.text: Suddenly, she was swept along by the crowd.
examples.translation: 一时间，她被人群推搡着向前走。

examples.text: The visitors were swept past various monuments...
examples.translation: 游客们被带着走马观花地参观了各种纪念碑。

examples.text: A limousine swept her along the busy freeway to the airport.
examples.translation: 一辆豪华轿车载着她沿着拥挤的高速公路飞速驶向机场。

examples.text: An icy wind swept through the streets...
examples.translation: 一阵寒风扫过街道。

examples.text: The car swept past the gate house.
examples.translation: 汽车飞速穿过门楼。

examples.text: A flu epidemic is sweeping through Moscow.
examples.translation: 流感正在莫斯科迅速蔓延。

examples.text: ...the wave of patriotism sweeping the country.
examples.translation: 席卷全国的爱国主义热潮

examples.text: She swept into the conference room...
examples.translation: 她大模大样地走入会议室。

examples.text: Scarlet with rage, she swept past her employer and stormed up the stairs...
examples.translation: 她气得涨红了脸，大摇大摆地经过她的上司，冲上了楼。

examples.text: The Chief turned and swept out.
examples.translation: 机长转过身，气呼呼地夺门而去。

examples.text: The commission's conclusions sweep away a decade of denials and cover-ups...
examples.translation: 委员会的结论将十年来的否认和掩饰无情地揭开。

examples.text: In times of war, governments often sweep human rights aside...
examples.translation: 战争时期，政府经常对人权置之不顾。

examples.text: He swept the names from his mind.
examples.translation: 他把这些名字抛诸脑后。

examples.text: Helicopters with searchlights swept the park which was sealed off...
examples.translation: 直升飞机的探照灯来回扫射这个被封锁的公园。

examples.text: Her gaze sweeps rapidly around the room.
examples.translation: 她快速地扫视了一下这个房间。

examples.text: The land sweeps away from long areas of greenery.
examples.translation: 这块地从草木茂盛的狭长地带一直伸展开来。

examples.text: ...the arc of countries that sweeps down from South Korea to Indonesia.
examples.translation: 从韩国到印度尼西亚呈弧形伸展开来的几个国家

examples.text: The ground fell away in a broad sweep down to the river.
examples.translation: 转过一处大弯后，地面消失在与河水相接处。

examples.text: ...the great sweep of the bay.
examples.translation: 一大片海湾

examples.text: ...a man who's promised to make radical changes to benefit the poor has swept the election...
examples.translation: 承诺彻底改善贫困人口状况的候选人轻松赢得了选举。

examples.text: In both republics, centre-right parties swept to power.
examples.translation: 两个共和国的中右派政党都轻而易举地夺取了政权。

examples.text: ...voters nostalgic for the free-spending policies of the 1980s swept his Socialists back to power.
examples.translation: 选民们很怀念 20 世纪 80 年代的自由支出政策，这使得社会党人轻松重夺政权。

examples.text: ...a sweeping victory.
examples.translation: 一场大胜

examples.text: Two of the soldiers swiftly began making a sweep of the premises...
examples.translation: 两名士兵立即开始搜索该建筑物。

examples.text: There may be periodic police 'sweeps' of crime in the area.
examples.translation: 警方可能对该地区的犯罪活动进行定时的“扫荡”。

examples.text: ...the whole sweep of German social and political history.
examples.translation: 德国社会政治的完整历史

examples.text: For a long time this problem has been swept under the carpet.
examples.translation: 这一问题被掩盖了很长一段时间。

examples.text: ...the first club to make a clean sweep of all three trophies.
examples.translation: 第一个将3项杯赛奖杯悉数收入囊中的俱乐部。

examples.text: I was swept off my feet. I had always dreamed of being an officer's wife.
examples.translation: 我被迷得神魂颠倒，一直梦想着成为官太太。

meanings.meaning: 甜的；悦耳的；芳香的；亲切的
糖果；乐趣；芳香；宝贝 （俚）酷毙了

examples.text: ...a mug of sweet tea...
examples.translation: 一大杯甜茶

examples.text: If the sauce seems too sweet, add a dash of red wine vinegar.
examples.translation: 如果酱汁太甜的话，可以加少许红酒醋。

examples.text: ...the sweet taste of wild strawberries.
examples.translation: 野草莓的甘甜

examples.text: Florida oranges have a natural sweetness.
examples.translation: 佛罗里达柑橘带有一种天然的甘甜。

examples.text: The sweet was a mousse flavoured with whisky.
examples.translation: 甜点是威士忌口味的慕斯。

examples.text: ...the sweet smell of her shampoo...
examples.translation: 她的洗发水的芳香

examples.text: She'd baked some bread which made the air smell sweet.
examples.translation: 她刚烤制了一些面包，空气里都弥漫着一股香味。

examples.text: I gulped a breath of sweet air.
examples.translation: 我吸了一大口清新的空气。

examples.text: ...a stream of sweet water.
examples.translation: 一股纯净的水

examples.text: Her voice was as soft and sweet as a young girl's.
examples.translation: 她的声音如少女般柔美悦耳。

examples.text: ...the sweet sounds of Mozart.
examples.translation: 莫扎特音乐优美的旋律

examples.text: He sang much more sweetly than he has before.
examples.translation: 他的演唱比以前要动听许多。

examples.text: There are few things quite as sweet as revenge.
examples.translation: 几乎没有比复仇更爽的事情了。

examples.text: ...the sweet taste of illicit love...
examples.translation: 婚外情带来的快感

examples.text: His success was all the sweeter for being at the expense of Europe's most admired team.
examples.translation: 他击败的是欧洲最受人崇拜的球队，这让他更有成就感。

examples.text: He was a sweet man but when he drank he tended to quarrel...
examples.translation: 他平时是一个温和的人，但喝了酒后往往就会又吵又闹。

examples.text: How sweet of you to think of me!
examples.translation: 你能想着我真是太好了！

examples.text: I just smiled sweetly and said no.
examples.translation: 我只是甜笑着婉拒了。

examples.text: ...a sweet little baby girl...
examples.translation: 漂亮的小女孩

examples.text: The house was really sweet.
examples.translation: 这房子太漂亮了。

examples.text: I am so proud of you, my sweet!
examples.translation: 我真为你骄傲，亲爱的！

examples.text: Where's the money to keep us sweet?
examples.translation: 用来讨好我们的钱在哪呢？

examples.text: The human population swelled, at least temporarily, as migrants moved south...
examples.translation: 随着移居者南移,人口出现膨胀，至少是暂时性膨胀。

examples.text: By the end of this month the size of the mission is expected to swell to 280 people...
examples.translation: 到这个月底，参加该任务的人员规模将有望增至 280 人。

examples.text: His bank balance has swelled by £222,000 in the last three weeks...
examples.translation: 在过去的 3 周里，他银行的存款多了 222,000 英镑。

examples.text: Offers from other countries should swell the force to 35,000.
examples.translation: 其他国家的支援将可使兵力增至 35,000 人。

examples.text: ...the ever-swelling numbers of the homeless...
examples.translation: 无家可归者人数的持续增长

examples.text: Its population is swollen by 360,000 refugees.
examples.translation: 360,000 名难民使该国人口大增。

examples.text: Do your ankles swell at night?...
examples.translation: 你夜里脚踝肿吗？

examples.text: The limbs swell to an enormous size.
examples.translation: 四肢肿得不得了。

examples.text: When you develop a throat infection or catch a cold the glands in the neck swell up.
examples.translation: 当咽喉感染或感冒时，扁桃腺就会肿胀。

examples.text: She could see her two sons swell with pride.
examples.translation: 她能看出她的两个儿子充满了骄傲。

examples.text: Heavenly music swelled from nowhere.
examples.translation: 不知从何处响起天籁般的音乐。

examples.text: We bobbed gently up and down on the swell of the incoming tide.
examples.translation: 我们随着涨潮的浪涌轻轻地起伏。

examples.text: I've had a swell time.
examples.translation: 我过得极为开心。

meanings.meaning: 快的；迅速的；敏捷的；立刻的

examples.text: Our task is to challenge the UN to make a swift decision...
examples.translation: 我们的任务是敦促联合国快速做出决策。

examples.text: The police were swift to act.
examples.translation: 警方行动迅速。

examples.text: The French have acted swiftly and decisively to protect their industries.
examples.translation: 法国人采取了迅速而果断的行动来保护他们的产业。

examples.text: The secrecy and swiftness of the invasion shocked and amazed army officers.
examples.translation: 这次入侵的隐秘和迅速令陆军军官们大为震惊。

examples.text: With a swift movement, Matthew Jerrold sat upright.
examples.translation: 马修· 杰罗尔德迅速坐直了。

examples.text: Lenny moved swiftly and silently across the front lawn.
examples.translation: 伦尼悄无声息地快速穿过房前的草坪。

examples.text: ...a swiftly flowing stream.
examples.translation: 湍急的小溪

examples.text: With incredible swiftness she ran down the passage.
examples.translation: 她沿通道飞奔而去。

examples.text: She learned to swim when she was really tiny...
examples.translation: 她很小的时候就学会了游泳。

examples.text: I went round to Jonathan's to see if he wanted to go swimming...
examples.translation: 我去乔纳森那里看看他是否想去游泳。

examples.text: He was rescued only when an exhausted friend swam ashore...
examples.translation: 当一个精疲力尽的友人游上岸后他才获救。

examples.text: I swim a mile a day.
examples.translation: 我每天游一英里。

examples.text: When can we go for a swim, Mam?
examples.translation: 妈妈，我们什么时候能去游泳啊？

examples.text: She swam the 400 metres medley ten seconds slower than she did in 1980.
examples.translation: 她 400 米混合泳的成绩比其 1980 年慢了 10 秒。

examples.text: In 1875, Captain Matthew Webb became the first man to swim the English Channel.
examples.translation: 1875年，马修·韦布船长成为横渡英吉利海峡的第一人。

examples.text: The barriers are lethal to fish trying to swim upstream.
examples.translation: 这些障碍物对于想要往上游游动的鱼儿来说是致命的。

examples.text: Alexis suddenly could take no more: he felt too hot, he couldn't breathe, the room swam.
examples.translation: 亚历克西斯突然觉得受不了了，他感到闷热，喘不上气，仿佛整间屋子在旋转。

examples.text: The musty aroma of incense made her head swim.
examples.translation: 熏香发霉的气味令她感到头晕。

examples.text: He polished off a large steak, salad, broccoli swimming in thick sauce, and half a litre of wine.
examples.translation: 他狼吞虎咽地吃下了一大块牛排、很多色拉和浸着浓稠酱汁的花耶菜，还喝了半升红酒。

meanings.meaning: 摇摆；摆动；秋千；音律；涨落
摇摆；转向；悬挂；大摇大摆地行走
旋转的；悬挂的；强节奏爵士音乐的

examples.text: The sail of the little boat swung crazily from one side to the other...
examples.translation: 小船的帆猛烈地左右摇摆着。

examples.text: She was swinging a bottle of wine by its neck...
examples.translation: 她正握着瓶颈摇晃一瓶葡萄酒。

examples.text: Ian lit a cigarette and sat on the end of the table, one leg swinging.
examples.translation: 伊恩点燃了一支烟，坐在桌子的一端，一条腿晃来晃去。

examples.text: ...a woman in a tight red dress, walking with a slight swing to her hips.
examples.translation: 身着红色紧身连衣裙、走路时臀部来回轻微扭动的女人

examples.text: The torchlight swung across the little beach and out over the water, searching...
examples.translation: 手电筒的光在小海滩上扫过，而后照向水面搜索着。

examples.text: The canoe found the current and swung around...
examples.translation: 独木舟遇上急流后直打转。

examples.text: Roy swung his legs carefully off the couch and sat up.
examples.translation: 罗伊小心地把腿挪下沙发，坐了起来。

examples.text: When he's not on the tennis court, you'll find him practising his golf swing.
examples.translation: 他不打网球时就练习高尔夫挥杆。

examples.text: Joanna swung back on to the main approach and headed for the airport...
examples.translation: 乔安娜猛地调转车头回到主路上，朝机场开去。

examples.text: The tyres dug into the grit as he swung the car off the road.
examples.translation: 当他一个急转弯把车驶离马路时，轮胎陷进了沙子里。

examples.text: She swung around to him, spilling her tea without noticing it.
examples.translation: 她一下子转身面向他，茶水溅了出来都没注意到。

examples.text: Blanche swung at her but she moved her head back and Blanche missed...
examples.translation: 布兰奇挥手朝她打去，但她头向后一闪，布兰奇没有打到。

examples.text: I picked up his baseball bat and swung at the man's head.
examples.translation: 我捡起他的棒球棒朝那个人的头打去。

examples.text: I often want to take a swing at someone to relieve my feelings.
examples.translation: 我常想打谁一顿来发泄情感。

examples.text: There was a massive twenty per cent swing away from the Conservatives to the Liberal Democrats...
examples.translation: 出现了一个巨大转变:多达20％的人由支持保守党转而支持自由民主党。

examples.text: Educational practice is liable to sudden swings and changes...
examples.translation: 教学实践中经常会出现突然的变化与改革。

examples.text: Dieters suffer from violent mood swings.
examples.translation: 节食者会有激烈的情绪波动。

examples.text: In two years' time there is a presidential election, and the voters could swing again...
examples.translation: 总统选举在两年后举行，届时选民们可能会再次倒向另一方。

examples.text: The mood amongst Tory MPs seems to be swinging away from their leader.
examples.translation: 保守党议员似乎正在疏远他们的领袖。

examples.text: ...a campaign swing through South Dakota and Texas.
examples.translation: 在南达科他州和得克萨斯州的巡回竞选活动

examples.text: When we returned, the party was in full swing and the dance floor was crowded...
examples.translation: 我们回来时，聚会已进入高潮，舞池里挤满了人。

examples.text: The international rugby season is in full swing.
examples.translation: 国际橄榄球赛季正如火如荼地进行着。

examples.text: Everyone understood how hard it was to get back into the swing of things after such a long absence.
examples.translation: 每个人都知道这么长时间不在，再重新完全融入进来有多难。

examples.text: Sara Lewis' impressive recipes are guaranteed to make the party go with a swing.
examples.translation: 萨拉·刘易斯令人赞不绝口的食谱一定能使聚会的气氛热烈非凡。

examples.text: Leona put some detergent into the dishwasher, shut the door and pressed the switch.
examples.translation: 利昂娜将一些清洁剂放入洗碗机，关上门后按了开始键。

examples.text: ...a light switch.
examples.translation: 电灯开关

examples.text: Estonia is switching to a market economy...
examples.translation: 爱沙尼亚正在向市场经济转轨。

examples.text: The law would encourage companies to switch from coal to cleaner fuels...
examples.translation: 该法律将鼓励企业转而使用比煤更加清洁的能源。

examples.text: The encouragement of a friend spurred Chris into switching jobs.
examples.translation: 在一位朋友的鼓励下，克理斯换了工作。

examples.text: New technology made a switch to oil possible...
examples.translation: 新技术使得转而使用石油成为可能。

examples.text: The spokesman implicitly condemned the United States policy switch.
examples.translation: 发言人含蓄地谴责了美国政策上的转变。

examples.text: ...a professional man who started out in law but switched over to medicine.
examples.translation: 开始学法律后转而从医的专业人士

examples.text: My mother's interest had switched to my health...
examples.translation: 母亲转而关注起我的健康来。

examples.text: As the era wore on, she switched her attention to films.
examples.translation: 随着这个时代慢慢过去，她把目光投向了电影业。

examples.text: In half an hour, they'd switched the tags on every cable...
examples.translation: 半个小时内，他们就给每根电缆都换了标签。

examples.text: The ballot boxes have been switched.
examples.translation: 投票箱被人调换了。

examples.text: ...a candidate who's crossed swords with Labor by supporting the free-trade pact...
examples.translation: 因为支持自由贸易协定而与工党交锋的候选人

examples.text: The fiercest of rivals, the last time they crossed swords was during the 1980s.
examples.translation: 这对争得你死我活的竞争对手的最后一次交锋是在 20 世纪 80 年代。

examples.text: To them, the monarchy is the special symbol of nationhood...
examples.translation: 对他们来说，君主政体是国家地位的特殊象征。

examples.text: She was put under house arrest two years ago but remained a powerful symbol in last year's election.
examples.translation: 虽然两年前就已遭软禁，她在去年的选举中仍然是势力强大的代表人物。

examples.text: Later in this same passage Yeats resumes his argument for the Rose as an Irish symbol...
examples.translation: 随后在同一篇诗歌里，叶芝再次将玫瑰作为爱尔兰的标志。

examples.text: I frequently use sunflowers as symbols of strength.
examples.translation: 我经常用向日葵来作为力量的象征。

examples.text: What's the chemical symbol for mercury?
examples.translation: 汞的化学元素符号是什么？

examples.text: ...the incredible beauty and symmetry of a snowflake...
examples.translation: 雪花难以置信的美丽和对称

examples.text: I loved the house because it had perfect symmetry...
examples.translation: 我喜欢这所房子，因为它非常对称。

examples.text: Their own lives already seemed to possess the symmetries of narrative art.
examples.translation: 他们自己的生活似乎已经拥有叙事艺术的对称性。

examples.text: The superpowers pledged to maintain symmetry in their arms shipments.
examples.translation: 超级大国承诺在武器运输方面要保持数量均衡。

examples.text: He said that Britain would not rejoin the ERM 'until there is much greater symmetry between our economy and other European economies.'
examples.translation: 他说在英国经济与其他欧洲国家的经济实现更大的趋同性之前，英国不会重新加入欧洲汇率机制。

meanings.meaning: 同情的；交感神经的；共鸣的；赞同的；和谐的；合意的
交感神经；容易感受的人

examples.text: She was very sympathetic to the problems of adult students...
examples.translation: 她对成年学生的问题深表同情。

examples.text: It may be that he sees you only as a sympathetic friend.
examples.translation: 也许他只是把你当作一个可以倾诉的朋友。

examples.text: She nodded sympathetically.
examples.translation: 她同情地点了点头。

examples.text: She met people in London who were sympathetic to the Indian freedom struggle...
examples.translation: 她在伦敦结识了一些支持印度独立运动的人。

examples.text: His speeches against corruption may find a sympathetic hearing among some Trinidadians.
examples.translation: 他关于反腐反贪的讲话可能会赢得一些特立尼达岛居民的支持。

examples.text: After a year we will sympathetically consider an application for reinstatement.
examples.translation: 一年后我们会对复职申请予以考虑和批准。

examples.text: She sounds a most sympathetic character.
examples.translation: 她听起来是个很招人喜欢的人物。

examples.text: I must tell you how much I sympathize with you for your loss, Professor...
examples.translation: 教授，我对您遭受的损失深表同情。

examples.text: He would sympathize but he wouldn't understand.
examples.translation: 他可能会表示同情，但不会理解。

examples.text: Some Europeans sympathize with the Americans over the issue...
examples.translation: 一些欧洲人在该问题上对美国人表示理解。

examples.text: He liked Max, and sympathized with his ambitions.
examples.translation: 他喜欢马克思，而且认同他的志向。

examples.text: Most of the people living there sympathized with the guerrillas.
examples.translation: 住在那里的大多数人支持游击队。

examples.text: We expressed our sympathy for her loss...
examples.translation: 我们对她的损失表示同情。

examples.text: I have had very little help from doctors and no sympathy whatsoever...
examples.translation: 我从医生那里没有得到什么帮助，也未获得丝毫同情。

examples.text: I wanted to express my sympathies on your resignation.
examples.translation: 对你的辞职我表示同情。

examples.text: I have some sympathy with this point of view...
examples.translation: 我比较同意这个观点。

examples.text: Lithuania still commands considerable international sympathy for its cause...
examples.translation: 立陶宛的事业仍然拥有相当的国际支持。

examples.text: She has frequently expressed Republican sympathies.
examples.translation: 她多次表达对共和党的支持态度。

examples.text: Several hundred workers struck in sympathy with their colleagues...
examples.translation: 几百名工人罢工以声援他们的同事。

examples.text: Milne resigned in sympathy because of the way Donald had been treated.
examples.translation: 米尔恩以辞职来抗议唐纳德所遭受的不公待遇。

examples.text: ...calls for sympathy strikes.
examples.translation: 号召举行声援罢工

examples.text: The laughter bounces against the walls and mixes into a cheery symphony of children's' sounds.

meanings.meaning: 讨论会，座谈会；专题论文集；酒宴，宴会

examples.text: He had been taking part in an international symposium on population.
examples.translation: 他那时正参加一个有关人口问题的国际研讨会。

examples.text: One of the most common symptoms of schizophrenia is hearing imaginary voices.
examples.translation: 精神分裂症的最常见的一个症状就是幻听。

examples.text: ...patients with flu symptoms...
examples.translation: 有流感症状的病人

examples.text: If the symptoms persist, it is important to go to your doctor.
examples.translation: 如果这些症状持续存在，一定要去看医生。

examples.text: Your problem with keeping boyfriends is just a symptom of a larger problem: making and keeping friends...
examples.translation: 你在维系同男友的关系时遭遇的困难暴露了一个更大的问题：如何结交朋友和维持友谊。

examples.text: The contradictory statements are symptoms of disarray in the administration.
examples.translation: 这些互相矛盾的说法反映了管理的混乱。

meanings.meaning: [临床] 综合征；综合症状；并发症状；校验子；并发位

examples.text: Irritable bowel syndrome seems to affect more women than men...
examples.translation: 女性比男性更易患肠易激综合征。

examples.text: The syndrome is more likely to strike those whose immune systems are already below par.
examples.translation: 这种综合征更容易对那些免疫系统已经低于正常水平的人构成威胁。

examples.text: It's a bit like the exam syndrome where you write down everything you know regardless of what has been asked...
examples.translation: 不论问题是什么就把所知道的统统写上，这有些像典型的考试心理。

examples.text: Scientists call this the 'it won't affect me' syndrome.
examples.translation: 科学家把这种现象称为“我无所谓”的典型表现。

meanings.meaning: 综合，[化学] 合成；综合体

examples.text: His novels are a rich synthesis of Balkan history and mythology...
examples.translation: 他的小说融合了大量巴尔干半岛的历史和神话故事。

examples.text: Her synthesis of feminism and socialism ran counter to all other historical currents.
examples.translation: 她将女权主义和社会主义的结合与所有其他的历史潮流背道而驰。

examples.text: ...the genes that regulate the synthesis of these compounds...
examples.translation: 控制这些化合物合成的基因

examples.text: This kind of lighting encourages vitamin D synthesis in the skin.
examples.translation: 这种光照会促进皮肤中维生素 D 的合成。

examples.text: Boots made from synthetic materials can usually be washed in a machine.
examples.translation: 合成材料制成的靴子通常可以机洗。

examples.text: ...synthetic rubber.
examples.translation: 合成橡胶

examples.text: ...the therapeutic use of natural and synthetically produced hormones.
examples.translation: 天然荷尔蒙和人工合成荷尔蒙在治疗上的使用

examples.text: The present system of funding for higher education is unsatisfactory.
examples.translation: 目前高等教育的经费体制并不令人满意。

examples.text: ...a flexible and relatively efficient filing system.
examples.translation: 灵活而相对高效的存档系统

examples.text: ...a multi-party system of government...
examples.translation: 多党执政体制

examples.text: The Court of Appeal has a pivotal role in the English legal system.
examples.translation: 在英国的法律体系中，上诉法院起着关键性的作用。

examples.text: Viruses tend to be good at surviving when a computer system crashes.
examples.translation: 计算机病毒在系统崩溃后往往依然存在。

examples.text: ...a central heating system.
examples.translation: 中央供暖系统

examples.text: ...Australia's road and rail system.
examples.translation: 澳大利亚的公路网和铁路网

examples.text: ...a news channel on a local cable system.
examples.translation: 地方有线电视网的新闻频道

examples.text: He had slept for over fourteen hours, and his system seemed to have recuperated admirably...
examples.translation: 他已睡了超过 14 个小时了，他的身体恢复得很不错。

examples.text: These gases would seriously damage the patient's respiratory system.
examples.translation: 这些毒气会严重损害患者的呼吸系统。

examples.text: ...the reproductive system.
examples.translation: 生殖系统

examples.text: ...the decimal system of metric weights and measures.
examples.translation: 公制度量衡的十进制

examples.text: ...Trachtenberg's system of simplified mathematics.
examples.translation: 特拉赫滕贝格简化的数学体系

examples.text: These feelings are likely to make people attempt to overthrow the system...
examples.translation: 这些情绪有可能促使人们想要推翻现行的体制。

examples.text: He wants to be the tough rebel who bucks the system.
examples.translation: 他想成为现行体制的坚决反抗者。

examples.text: I want to get boxing out of my system and settle down to enjoy family life.
examples.translation: 我想结束拳击生涯，安定下来享受家庭生活。

meanings.meaning: 系统的；体系的；有系统的；[图情] 分类的；一贯的，惯常的

examples.text: They went about their business in a systematic way...
examples.translation: 他们按部就班地做生意。

examples.text: They had not found any evidence of a systematic attempt to rig the ballot.
examples.translation: 他们没有发现任何证据证明有人企图全面操纵投票。

examples.text: The army has systematically violated human rights...
examples.translation: 该部队蓄意侵犯人权。

examples.text: She began applying systematically to colleges.
examples.translation: 她开始有计划地向各个大学提出入学申请。

examples.text: She was sitting at the kitchen table eating a currant bun...
examples.translation: 她正坐在餐桌旁，吃着葡萄干圆面包。

examples.text: I placed his drink on the small table at his elbow.
examples.translation: 我把他的饮料放在他肘边的小桌子上。

examples.text: I'd like a table for two at about 8:30, please...
examples.translation: 我想订一张 8:30 左右的双人桌。

examples.text: I booked a table at the Savoy Grill...
examples.translation: 我在萨沃伊烧烤店订了张桌子。

examples.text: You will join us at our table, won't you?
examples.translation: 你会过来和我们一起吃，对吗？

examples.text: They've tabled a motion criticising the Government for doing nothing about the problem.
examples.translation: 他们提交了一项动议，批评政府在该问题上无所作为。

examples.text: We will table that for later.
examples.translation: 那个问题我们留到以后再讨论吧。

examples.text: Consult the table on page 104...
examples.translation: 参阅 104 页的表格。

examples.text: Other research supports the figures in Table 3.3.
examples.translation: 其他研究也可证实表 3.3 中的数据。

examples.text: He didn't know his eleven-times table...
examples.translation: 他不知道11的乘法口诀。

examples.text: I attempted to learn my tables.
examples.translation: 我努力背诵乘法表。

examples.text: This is one of the best packages we've put on the table in years...
examples.translation: 这是我们几年来提交的最好的几套方案之一。

examples.text: It means that all the options are at least on the table.
examples.translation: 这就意味着，至少所有的选择都已经摆到了桌面上。

examples.text: The only question is whether the President can use his extraordinary political skills to turn the tables on his opponents.
examples.translation: 唯一的问题是，总统能否运用他杰出的政治手腕化被动为主动，击败对手。

examples.text: It's time for your tablets, dear...
examples.translation: 该吃药了，亲爱的。

examples.text: It is never a good idea to take sleeping tablets regularly.
examples.translation: 频繁服用安眠药绝对不是好办法。

examples.text: He also studied the ancient stone tablets from around the pyramids.
examples.translation: 他还研究了在金字塔周围发现的古代石匾。

examples.text: The first reason to tackle these problems is to save children's lives...
examples.translation: 果断处理这些问题的首要原因是为了挽救孩子们的生命。

examples.text: Firemen later tackled the blaze.
examples.translation: 消防队员们后来扑灭了这场大火。

examples.text: Foley tackled the quarterback.
examples.translation: 福利成功拦截了四分卫。

examples.text: ...a tackle by full-back Brian Burrows.
examples.translation: 后卫布赖恩·伯罗斯的拦截

examples.text: I tackled him about how anyone could live amidst so much poverty.
examples.translation: 我坦率地问他，人在如此贫穷的环境中如何还能生存。

examples.text: He claims Pasolini overtook and tackled him, pushing him into the dirt.
examples.translation: 他声称帕索利尼追上去打他，把他推倒在烂泥里。

examples.text: ...fishing tackle.
examples.translation: 渔具

examples.text: I finally hoisted him up with a block and tackle.
examples.translation: 我最终用滑轮组把他拉了上去。

examples.text: What sort of tactics will the President use to rally the people behind him?
examples.translation: 总统会用什么样的策略把人们号召起来支持他呢？

examples.text: He pressed on in the hope that a few others would join him. The tactic paid off.
examples.translation: 他硬着头皮干下去，希望能有几个人加入进来。这一招奏效了。

examples.text: We can tailor the program to the patient's needs.
examples.translation: 我们可以根据病人的需要调整治疗方案。

examples.text: ...how the local forces were trying to tailor their policing style to increase public confidence.
examples.translation: 地方部队如何努力调整治安维护方式以增强公众信心

examples.text: ...scripts tailored to American comedy audiences.
examples.translation: 为美国喜剧片观众量身定做的剧本

meanings.meaning: 标签；名称；结束语；附属物
尾随，紧随；连接；起浑名；添饰

examples.text: Staff wore name tags.
examples.translation: 工作人员都佩戴姓名牌。

examples.text: ...baggage tags.
examples.translation: 行李标签

examples.text: A hospital is to fit newborn babies with electronic tags to foil kidnappers...
examples.translation: 一家医院计划在新生儿身上安置电子追踪器，防止婴儿被拐卖。

examples.text: Sometimes, they've snapped off the security tag and just taken the one shoe.
examples.translation: 有时候，他们把防盗标签扯掉，顺走那一只鞋。

examples.text: Professor Orr has developed interesting ways of tagging chemical molecules using existing laboratory lasers...
examples.translation: 奥尔教授发明了用现有实验室激光设备给化学分子做记号的种种有趣的办法。

examples.text: The most important trees were tagged to protect them from being damaged by construction machinery.
examples.translation: 最珍贵的树木都被贴上了标签，以防被建筑机械毁坏。

examples.text: In Britain, jazz is losing its elitist tag and gaining a much broader audience.
examples.translation: 在英国，爵士乐不再是精英人物的专利，它正吸引着越来越多的听众。

examples.text: ...the pundits were still tagging him with that age-old label, 'best of a bad bunch'...
examples.translation: 专家们仍用多年前的称呼“最好的坏人”来称呼他。

examples.text: She has always lived in John's house and is still tagged 'Dad's girlfriend' by his children.
examples.translation: 她一直住在约翰家里，依然被他的孩子们称作“爸爸的女友”。

meanings.meaning: 故事；传说；叙述；流言蜚语

examples.text: ...a collection of stories, poems and folk tales...
examples.translation: 由短篇故事、诗歌和传说汇成的作品集

examples.text: Episodes 1 and 2 of Tales of the City will be shown together on Tuesday.
examples.translation: 《城市故事》的第一、二集将于星期二两集连播。

examples.text: The media have been filled with tales of horror and loss resulting from Monday's earthquake.
examples.translation: 媒体上尽是星期一发生的地震所带来的恐惧和损失的报道。

examples.text: ...a property analyst, full of cheery tales about soaring share prices and new capital pouring into property companies.
examples.translation: 总是兴高采烈地描述着股票价格飙升和新资本源源不断注入房地产公司的房地产分析师

examples.text: You lived to tell the tale this time but who knows how far you can push your luck.
examples.translation: 你这次算是逃过了一劫，不过谁知道你的运气还会持续多久呢？

examples.text: I hesitated, not wanting to tell tales about my colleague.
examples.translation: 我犹豫了，不想说同事的坏话。

examples.text: The cattle were swinging their tails to disperse the flies.
examples.translation: 那些牛甩动着尾巴驱赶苍蝇。

examples.text: ...a black dog with a long tail.
examples.translation: 长尾黑狗

examples.text: ...white-tailed deer.
examples.translation: 白尾鹿

examples.text: ...the horizontal stabilizer bar on the plane's tail...
examples.translation: 飞机尾部的水平尾翼

examples.text: Elsie tugged her husband's coat tail.
examples.translation: 埃尔西用力拉了拉她丈夫外套的后摆。

examples.text: ...a comet tail.
examples.translation: 彗尾

examples.text: Officers had tailed the gang from London during a major undercover inquiry...
examples.translation: 在一次重大的秘密调查行动中，警察从伦敦就盯上了那帮匪徒。

examples.text: He trusted her so little that he had her tailed.
examples.translation: 他十分不信任她，所以派人跟踪她。

examples.text: He checked behind. No tail.
examples.translation: 他看看身后——没有人跟着。

examples.text: Past TV deals have seen the tail wagging the dog. Now football clubs feel they are equal partners with TV.
examples.translation: 以往和电视台的交易中，足球俱乐部就已经有过喧宾夺主的记录。现在，他们更是觉得可以和电视台平起平坐了。

examples.text: His team retreated last night with tails tucked firmly between their legs.
examples.translation: 昨晚，他的队伍灰溜溜地退场了。

examples.text: I turned tail and fled in the direction of the main house.
examples.translation: 我掉头就跑，朝主屋方向逃去。

examples.text: She is proud that both her children have a talent for music...
examples.translation: 她为自己的两个孩子都有音乐天赋而自豪。

examples.text: The player was given hardly any opportunities to show off his talents...
examples.translation: 那位选手几乎没有得到什么机会展示自己的天赋。

examples.text: He's got lots of talent.
examples.translation: 他天赋很高。

meanings.meaning: 高的；长的；过分的；夸大的
(Tall)人名；(马里、阿拉伯)塔勒；(芬、罗、瑞典)塔尔；(英)托尔；(土)塔勒

examples.text: Being tall can make you feel incredibly self-confident...
examples.translation: 个子高会使你感觉极其自信。

examples.text: She was a young woman, fairly tall and fairly slim...
examples.translation: 她是个身材修长的年轻女子。

examples.text: The windows overlooked a lawn of tall waving grass.
examples.translation: 窗户外边是一块草地，高高的草随风摇摆。

examples.text: How tall are you?...
examples.translation: 你多高？

examples.text: I'm only 5ft tall, and I look younger than my age...
examples.translation: 我才 5 英尺高，显得比实际年龄小。

examples.text: I am already as tall as she is...
examples.translation: 我已经和她一样高了。

examples.text: Tony, my oldest, is already taller than me, and he's only eleven.
examples.translation: 我家老大托尼今年才 11 岁，就已经比我高了。

examples.text: Financing your studies may seem like a tall order, but there is plenty of help available.
examples.translation: 学费的筹措可能看似一个大难题，好在你可以获得许多帮助。

meanings.meaning: 驯服的；平淡的；乏味的；顺从的

examples.text: The deer never became tame; they would run away if you approached them.
examples.translation: 那些鹿一直没有被驯服：你一靠近，它们就跑开。

examples.text: Some of today's political demonstrations look rather tame...
examples.translation: 如今有些政治游行显得毫无激情。

examples.text: The report was pretty tame stuff.
examples.translation: 这份报告平淡无奇。

examples.text: There was no excuse though when Thomas shot tamely wide from eight yards.
examples.translation: 托马斯在 8 码外一脚软弱无力的射门将球打飞，这回的确是没什么借口可言。

examples.text: The Amazons were believed to have been the first to tame horses.
examples.translation: 据说亚马孙人最先驯化了马。

examples.text: Two regiments of cavalry were called out to tame the crowds.
examples.translation: 调集了两个装甲兵团去威慑、控制人群。

examples.text: He was too distressed to talk...
examples.translation: 他伤心得讲不出话来。

examples.text: A teacher reprimanded a girl for talking in class...
examples.translation: 老师斥责了一个在课堂上说话的女生。

examples.text: The boys all began to talk at once...
examples.translation: 所有的男孩子们立即说起话来。

examples.text: Though she can't talk yet, she understands what is going on.
examples.translation: 虽然她还不会说话，可发生的这一切她都懂。

examples.text: That's not the kind of talk one usually hears from accountants.
examples.translation: 会计们通常不会说那样的话。

examples.text: We talked and laughed a great deal...
examples.translation: 我们说笑了很久。

examples.text: I talked to him yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天我和他谈过了。

examples.text: A neighbour saw her talking with Craven...
examples.translation: 一个邻居看见她在和克雷文交谈。

examples.text: When she came back, they were talking about American food...
examples.translation: 她回来时，他们在谈论美国食品。

examples.text: Can't you see I'm talking? Don't interrupt.
examples.translation: 没看见我在说话吗？别插嘴。

examples.text: We had a long talk about her father, Tony, who was a friend of mine.
examples.translation: 她爸爸托尼是我的朋友，我们一起谈论了他很久。

examples.text: Your first step should be to talk to a teacher or school counselor...
examples.translation: 你第一步应该是去找老师或学校辅导员谈谈。

examples.text: There's no one she can talk to, and she's on the verge of collapse...
examples.translation: 她找不到一个可以倾诉的对象，快要崩溃了。

examples.text: We need to talk alone...
examples.translation: 我们得单独谈谈。

examples.text: Do ring if you want to talk about it...
examples.translation: 你要是想谈谈，一定给我打电话。

examples.text: I have to sort some things out. We really needed to talk.
examples.translation: 我必须把一些事情搞清楚。我们真的需要谈一谈。

examples.text: I think it's time we had a talk.
examples.translation: 我感觉我们是该谈谈了。

examples.text: She will talk on the issues she cares passionately about including education and nursery care...
examples.translation: 她将会谈一些自己十分感兴趣的话题，包括教育和幼儿护理。

examples.text: He intends to talk to young people about the dangers of AIDS.
examples.translation: 他打算和青年人谈谈艾滋病的危害。

examples.text: A guide gives a brief talk on the history of the site...
examples.translation: 导游简要地介绍了那个遗址的历史。

examples.text: He then set about campaigning, giving talks and fund-raising.
examples.translation: 然后他就着手进行竞选，发表讲话，筹集资金。

examples.text: ...the next round of Middle East peace talks...
examples.translation: 下一轮中东和平谈判

examples.text: Talks between striking railway workers and the Polish government have broken down...
examples.translation: 罢工的铁路工人和波兰政府间举行的谈判已经破裂了。

examples.text: They are holding hostages to try to force the authorities into talks on possible amnesties for drugs offences.
examples.translation: 他们扣押了若干人质以胁迫当局就赦免毒品犯罪与他们谈判。

examples.text: We're talking to some people about opening an office in London...
examples.translation: 我们在和一些人讨论在伦敦设立办事处的事儿。

examples.text: The company talked with many potential investors...
examples.translation: 公司和许多潜在的投资人举行了磋商。

examples.text: It triggered broad speculation that GM and Jaguar might be talking.
examples.translation: 这引发了人们对通用公司和捷豹公司可能在进行磋商的大量猜测。

examples.text: The Foreign Minister said he was ready to talk to any country that had no hostile intentions...
examples.translation: 外交部长说他愿意和任何不怀敌意的国家举行会谈。

examples.text: They are collecting information in preparation for the day when the two sides sit down and talk...
examples.translation: 他们正在收集情报，为双方坐下来谈判的那一天做准备。

examples.text: John Reid has to find a way to make both sides talk to each other...
examples.translation: 约翰·里德得想办法让双方对话。

examples.text: The speed with which the two sides came to the negotiating table shows that they are ready to talk.
examples.translation: 双方那么快就来到谈判桌旁，这说明他们愿意谈判。

examples.text: Everyone is talking about him...
examples.translation: 人人都在议论他。

examples.text: People will talk, but you have to get on with your life.
examples.translation: 人们会有议论，但日子还得过下去。

examples.text: There has been a lot of talk about me getting married...
examples.translation: 有很多传言说我要结婚了。

examples.text: There was even talk that charges of fraud would be brought.
examples.translation: 甚至有传闻说会以诈骗罪起诉。

examples.text: They'll talk, they'll implicate me.
examples.translation: 他们会招供的，他们会把我牵连进去的。

examples.text: You don't sound like a foreigner talking English...
examples.translation: 听你讲英语，不像是外国人。

examples.text: They were amazed that I was talking in an Irish accent.
examples.translation: 我说话带爱尔兰口音让他们感到很惊奇。

examples.text: The guests were mostly middle-aged men talking business.
examples.translation: 顾客多数是些谈正事的中年男子。

examples.text: You must admit George, you're talking absolute rubbish.
examples.translation: 乔治，你得承认你说的全都是废话。

examples.text: We're not talking a murder here; we're talking poker machines or gambling — things that are misdemeanors in most states...
examples.translation: 我们现在讨论的不是谋杀，而是扑克机或赌博——这些在多数州只能算轻罪了。

examples.text: We're talking megabucks this time.
examples.translation: 我们这次谈的可是上百万的买卖。

examples.text: Has much of this actually been tried here? Or is it just talk?...
examples.translation: 这个多半已经真正尝试过了吗？还是仅仅说说而已？

examples.text: Conditions should be laid down. Otherwise it's all talk.
examples.translation: 应该先定下条件，否则全是空谈。

examples.text: Took us quite a while to get here, didn't it? Talk about Fate moving in a mysterious way!...
examples.translation: 我们用了很长时间才走到今天这步，是吧？这就叫命运难测啊！

examples.text: She threw the cake I'd made on the floor and stood on it. Talk about being humiliated!
examples.translation: 她把我做的蛋糕扔到地上，然后踩在了上面。真是欺人太甚！

examples.text: Belvoir Farms produce a delicious elderflower tea. Talking of elderflower, you might wish to try Elderflower Champagne.
examples.translation: 贝尔沃农场生产一种非常好喝的接骨木花茶。说到接骨木花，你兴许想尝尝接骨木花香槟酒。

examples.text: As it says in the Bible, my cup is running over. Talking of which, I must get you a cup of tea.
examples.translation: 正如《圣经》所说，给我恩赐太多了，我的杯子已经满满当当了。说到杯子，我得去给你倒杯茶来。

examples.text: A tangle of wires is all that remains of the computer and phone systems...
examples.translation: 原来的计算机和电话系统如今只剩下乱糟糟的一团电线。

examples.text: There he stood: hair in wild tangles, dark stubble shadowing his chin.
examples.translation: 他站在那儿，头发乱成一团，下巴上一片黑胡茬。

examples.text: Animals get tangled in fishing nets and drown...
examples.translation: 动物被缠进渔网里淹死了。

examples.text: She tried to kick the pajamas loose, but they were tangled in the satin sheet...
examples.translation: 她想把睡衣踢脱，可是它却和缎子床单绞到了一块。

examples.text: Lee and I fell in a tangled heap...
examples.translation: 李和我扭作一团，摔倒在地。

examples.text: Her hair tends to tangle...
examples.translation: 她的头发容易打结。

examples.text: He suggested that tangling fishing gear should be made a criminal offence.
examples.translation: 他提议，缠绕捕鱼器材应该算刑事犯罪。

examples.text: I was thinking what a tangle we had got ourselves into.
examples.translation: 我在想，我们卷入了怎样的纷争之中。

examples.text: ...the tangle of domestic politics.
examples.translation: 国内政局的错综复杂

examples.text: The themes get tangled in Mr. Mahfouz's epic storytelling...
examples.translation: 马赫福兹先生讲述的故事过于宏大，主题有些混乱了。

examples.text: You are currently in a muddle where financial and emotional concerns are tangled together.
examples.translation: 你眼下头脑不清了，对于金钱和感情的忧虑交织在了一起。

examples.text: His personal life has become more tangled than ever.
examples.translation: 他的个人生活比以前更混乱了。

examples.text: For many days now Buddy and Joe had appeared to be more and more tangled up in secrets.
examples.translation: 这些天巴迪和乔好像变得越来越神神秘秘。

examples.text: ...an empty fuel tank...
examples.translation: 空空的油箱

examples.text: Two water tanks provide a total capacity of 400 litres.
examples.translation: 两个水缸的总容量为 400 升。

examples.text: ...a tank full of goldfish.
examples.translation: 满是金鱼的鱼缸

examples.text: A lorry can drive up to 600 miles on a single tank of fuel.
examples.translation: 大卡车只用一箱油就能行驶 600 英里。

meanings.meaning: 拿，取；采取；接受（礼物等）；耗费（时间等）
捕获量；看法；利益，盈益；（入场券的）售得金额

examples.text: She was too tired to take a shower...
examples.translation: 她累得连澡都懒得冲。

examples.text: Betty took a photograph of us...
examples.translation: 贝蒂给我们照了张相。

examples.text: I've never taken a holiday since starting this job...
examples.translation: 自从做这份工作起，我就没有休过假。

examples.text: There's not enough people willing to take the risk...
examples.translation: 没有足够的人愿意冒这个险。

examples.text: Walk around the property and take a good look at it from the outside...
examples.translation: 围着房子走一圈，从外边好好看一看。

examples.text: We took a long walk through the pines.
examples.translation: 我们在松树林中穿行了很久。

examples.text: The Patriotic Front took power after a three-month civil war...
examples.translation: 经过 3 个月内战，爱国阵线夺取了政权。

examples.text: I felt it was important for women to join and take a leading role...
examples.translation: 我觉得让女性参与其中，并担当领导角色对于女性而言意义重大。

examples.text: The constitution requires members of parliament to take an oath of allegiance...
examples.translation: 宪法规定，议员必须宣誓效忠。

examples.text: In Asia the crisis took a different form.
examples.translation: 在亚洲，危机的表现形式有所不同。

examples.text: Here, let me take your coat...
examples.translation: 来，我帮你拿大衣。

examples.text: Colette took her by the shoulders and shook her...
examples.translation: 科利特抓住她的双肩，摇晃着她。

examples.text: She took her in her arms and tried to comfort her.
examples.translation: 她把她揽进怀里，尽力安慰她。

examples.text: Mark often took his books to Bess's house to study...
examples.translation: 马克常常带着书本去贝丝家学习。

examples.text: I'll take these papers home and read them...
examples.translation: 我会把这些文件带回家阅读。

examples.text: You should take your passport with you when changing money...
examples.translation: 兑汇时要带上本人护照。

examples.text: Don't forget to take your camera.
examples.translation: 别忘了带上相机。

examples.text: She took me to a Mexican restaurant...
examples.translation: 她带我去了一家墨西哥餐厅。

examples.text: The school bus takes them to school and brings them back...
examples.translation: 校车接送他们上下学。

examples.text: She was taken to hospital.
examples.translation: 她被送进医院。

examples.text: He was a poor student from Madras whose genius took him to Cambridge...
examples.translation: 他是个来自马德拉斯的穷学生，凭自身的才华上了剑桥。

examples.text: My work takes me abroad a lot.
examples.translation: 由于工作原因，我经常出国。

examples.text: You need to take your problems to a trained counsellor...
examples.translation: 你需要去找训练有素的咨询顾问请教这些问题。

examples.text: In a true market, the customer can take business elsewhere.
examples.translation: 在真正的市场中，顾客可以去别处洽谈业务。

examples.text: A combination of talent, hard work and good looks have taken her to the top...
examples.translation: 兼具天赋、勤奋和美貌使她得以出人头地。

examples.text: The managing director had given himself a pay rise of 20%, taking his salary to £20,000...
examples.translation: 经理给自己加了 20%的薪，使他的薪水达到了 2 万英镑。

examples.text: Her latest research takes her point further.
examples.translation: 她的最新研究进一步深化了她的观点。

examples.text: He took a handkerchief from his pocket and lightly wiped his mouth...
examples.translation: 他从口袋里掏出手帕，轻轻擦了擦嘴。

examples.text: Opening a drawer, she took out a letter.
examples.translation: 她打开抽屉，取出一封信。

examples.text: He has taken my money, and I have no chance of getting it back...
examples.translation: 他偷了我的钱，我再也要不回来了。

examples.text: The burglars took just about anything they could carry.
examples.translation: 窃贼们盗走了所有拿得动的东西。

examples.text: A Serb army unit took the town...
examples.translation: 一支塞尔维亚部队攻占了那个镇。

examples.text: Marines went in, taking 15 prisoners...
examples.translation: 海军陆战队士兵攻了进去，俘获 15 人。

examples.text: Labour took Edgbaston from the Conservatives.
examples.translation: 工党从保守党手中把埃奇巴斯顿赢了过来。

examples.text: Take off the price of the house, that's another hundred thousand.
examples.translation: 减去房价，又是 10 万。

examples.text: Don't ever ask me to look after those kids again. I just can't take it!...
examples.translation: 以后别再叫我去照看那些孩子了，我简直无法忍受！

examples.text: Harry's rudeness to everyone was becoming hard to take.
examples.translation: 哈里对谁都粗暴无礼，这渐渐叫人无法忍受。

examples.text: They have taken heavy casualties.
examples.translation: 他们遭受重大伤亡。

examples.text: Since the roads are very bad, the journey took us a long time...
examples.translation: 由于路况很糟糕，我们路上花了很长时间。

examples.text: I had heard an appeal could take years...
examples.translation: 我听说上诉要花好几年时间。

examples.text: The sauce takes 25 minutes to prepare and cook...
examples.translation: 这个调味料从准备到做好要 25 分钟。

examples.text: The game took her less than an hour to finish...
examples.translation: 她没用一个小时就拿下了这场比赛。

examples.text: You must beware of those traps — you could take all day getting out of them...
examples.translation: 你必须当心那些陷阱——陷进去的话，要一整天才能脱身。

examples.text: It takes 15 minutes to convert the plane into a car by removing the wings and the tail...
examples.translation: 拆除机翼和机尾，将飞机改装成汽车，前后要花 15 分钟。

examples.text: It had taken Masters about twenty hours to reach the house...
examples.translation: 马斯特斯用了约 20 个钟头才到达那所房子。

examples.text: It took thirty-five seconds for the hour to strike.
examples.translation: 报时用了 35 秒钟。

examples.text: At one time, walking across the room took all her strength...
examples.translation: 曾经有段时间她得费尽全力才能从房间一头走到另一头。

examples.text: We want to get married and start a family and all. But that takes money...
examples.translation: 我们想结婚，生孩子等，可是那得花钱。

examples.text: It takes courage to say what you think...
examples.translation: 说出真实想法是需要勇气的。

examples.text: It takes the bark of three whole trees to make enough of the drug to treat a single patient...
examples.translation: 单是治疗一个病人，就需要三棵树的全部树皮来制取这种药。

examples.text: It takes a pretty bad level of performance before the teachers will criticize the students.
examples.translation: 学生只有表现极差时，老师才会批评他们。

examples.text: When I took the job I thought I could change the system, but it's hard...
examples.translation: 我接受那份工作时，以为我能改变那种体制，可实际上很难。

examples.text: His sons took his advice.
examples.translation: 他的儿子们采纳了他的建议。

examples.text: They take great pride in their heritage...
examples.translation: 他们为自己的历史传统深感自豪。

examples.text: The government will take comfort from the latest opinion poll.
examples.translation: 政府会从最新的民意调查中得到安慰。

examples.text: The firm took £100,000 in bookings.
examples.translation: 这家公司在票务预订方面的收入达到 10 万英镑。

examples.text: It added another $11.8 million to the take, for a grand total of $43 million.
examples.translation: 这就又增加了1,180万美元的收入，总计为 4,300 万美元。

examples.text: 'Poison' took first prize at the 1991 Sundance Film Festival...
examples.translation: 《毒药》在 1991 年的圣丹斯电影节上获得一等奖。

examples.text: Christie took the gold medal in the 100 metres.
examples.translation: 克里斯蒂在 100 米赛中夺得金牌。

examples.text: His brother Raoul did it, but Leonel took the blame and kept his mouth shut...
examples.translation: 事情是莱昂内尔的弟弟拉乌尔干的，可是莱昂内尔却代他受过，并且对此绝口不提。

examples.text: She's reluctant to take all the credit.
examples.translation: 她不愿接受所有荣誉。

examples.text: Some universities would be forced to take more students than they wanted...
examples.translation: 有些大学将被迫超计划招生。

examples.text: They were told that Dr Albright wasn't taking any new patients.
examples.translation: 他们被告知，奥尔布赖特医生不再接收新病人了。

examples.text: Douglas telephoned Catherine at her office. She refused to take his calls.
examples.translation: 道格拉斯把电话打进凯瑟琳的办公室，可是她不接。

examples.text: Unfortunately, no one took my messages seriously...
examples.translation: 遗憾的是，没人把我提供的信息当回事。

examples.text: Her husband had taken the news badly...
examples.translation: 她丈夫听到那个消息后伤心透了。

examples.text: I was determined to take the news in a calm and dignified manner.
examples.translation: 我决定要沉着冷静地面对这一消息。

examples.text: There's confusion and resentment, and it's almost never expressed out in the open. Take this office, for example...
examples.translation: 有人迷惘，有人憎恨，可是几乎谁也没有公开表达过。就拿这个办公室的人来说吧。

examples.text: You can attack this problem from many angles, but let's take one thing at a time...
examples.translation: 这个问题可以从多个角度解决，不过，还是让我们逐个分析吧。

examples.text: Taken in isolation these statements can be dangerous fallacies.
examples.translation: 孤立地看，这些说法可能是危险的谬论。

examples.text: They've turned sensible, if you take my meaning...
examples.translation: 他们变得通情达理了，如果你明白我的意思的话。

examples.text: 'I'm not saying it's right, I'm just saying that's what happens.' — 'I take your point.'
examples.translation: “我没说这样就对，我只是说实际情况如此。”——“你的意思我懂。”

examples.text: She had taken him for a journalist...
examples.translation: 她把他错当成记者了。

examples.text: Do you take me for an idiot?...
examples.translation: 你以为我是白痴吗？

examples.text: I naturally took him to be the owner of the estate.
examples.translation: 我自然而然地把他当成了庄园的主人。

examples.text: 'I'll take the grilled tuna,' Mary Ann told the waiter.
examples.translation: “给我来份烤金枪鱼吧，”玛丽·安告诉侍者。

examples.text: From Wrexham centre take the Chester Road to the outskirts of town...
examples.translation: 从雷克瑟姆市中心出发，沿着切斯特路到达市郊。

examples.text: He had to take a different route home...
examples.translation: 他只好从别的路回家。

examples.text: The road forked in two directions. He had obviously taken the wrong fork.
examples.translation: 道路分岔为两个方向，他显然是走错岔道了。

examples.text: My wife and I have taken the cottage for a month.
examples.translation: 我和妻子租下这套乡间小屋已经一个月了。

examples.text: Before the Chronicle I used to take the Guardian.
examples.translation: 在订阅《纪事报》以前，我看的是《卫报》。

examples.text: It's the other end of the High Street. We'll take the car, shall we?...
examples.translation: 它在大街的那头，我们乘车去，好吗？

examples.text: She took the train to New York every weekend...
examples.translation: 她每个周末乘火车去纽约。

examples.text: We'll take a taxi home.
examples.translation: 我们打的回家。

examples.text: Students are allowed to take European history and American history.
examples.translation: 学生可以选修欧洲史和美国史。

examples.text: She took her driving test in Greenford...
examples.translation: 她在格林福特参加了驾照考试。

examples.text: She travelled to India after taking her A levels.
examples.translation: 她参加完高等程度考试后去印度旅行了。

examples.text: The teacher who took us for economics was Miss Humphrey.
examples.translation: 教我们经济学的是汉弗莱小姐。

examples.text: She's been taking sleeping pills...
examples.translation: 她一直在服用安眠药。

examples.text: I have never taken illegal drugs.
examples.translation: 我从未使用过违禁药品。

examples.text: She made a habit of coming in to take tea with Nanny Crabtree...
examples.translation: 她养成了进来和克拉布特里奶奶一起喝茶的习惯。

examples.text: If you don't take milk, cheese or yoghurt, other sources of calcium are important.
examples.translation: 你要是不喝鲜奶和酸奶，也不吃乳酪，那么其他的补钙来源就很重要了。

examples.text: She sat expressionless, carefully taking notes...
examples.translation: 她坐在那儿面无表情，认真记着笔记。

examples.text: Take a letter, Miss Singleton.
examples.translation: 帮我写封信，辛格尔顿小姐。

examples.text: By drilling, geologists can take measurements at various depths...
examples.translation: 通过钻探，地质学家可以在不同深度测量。

examples.text: If he feels hotter than normal, take his temperature.
examples.translation: 如果他感觉比平时热，量量他的体温。

examples.text: The place could just about take 2,000 people.
examples.translation: 那地方只能容纳大约 2,000 人。

examples.text: 47 per cent of women in the UK take a size 16 or above.
examples.translation: 英国47%的女性穿16码或更大号的。

examples.text: If the cortisone doesn't take, I may have to have surgery.
examples.translation: 如果可的松无效，我恐怕只能动手术了。

examples.text: She couldn't get it right — she never knew the lines and we had to do several takes.
examples.translation: 她就是拍不好——她总记不住台词，我们只好拍了好几遍。

meanings.meaning: 油轮；运油飞机；油槽车；坦克手

examples.text: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
examples.translation: 一艘希腊油轮搁浅了。

examples.text: ...an accident involving a petrol tanker on the M27, east of Southampton.
examples.translation: 在南安普敦以东的 27 号高速公路上发生的一起车祸，其中有一辆油罐车

meanings.meaning: （日晒后皮肤的）黝黑色；棕褐色；鞣料；马戏团
(Tan)人名；(俄、土、土库、吉尔)塔恩；(英)坦；(柬、老)丹

examples.text: She is tall and blonde, with a permanent tan.
examples.translation: 她高个儿，一头金发，皮肤黝黑。

examples.text: I have very pale skin that never tans...
examples.translation: 我皮肤很白，怎么也晒不黑。

examples.text: I don't tan...
examples.translation: 我不愿晒黑。

examples.text: Leigh rolled over on her stomach to tan her back.
examples.translation: 莉翻了个身趴下，开始晒后背。

examples.text: Their skin was tanned and glowing from their weeks at the sea.
examples.translation: 他们在海边呆了几个星期，皮肤晒得黝黑发亮。

examples.text: ...a tan leather jacket.
examples.translation: 棕黄色皮夹克

examples.text: ...the process of tanning animal hides.
examples.translation: 鞣革的过程

meanings.meaning: 录音；用带子捆扎；用胶布把…封住

examples.text: Tape is expensive and loses sound quality every time it is copied...
examples.translation: 磁带成本高，而且每录制一次音质就会变差一些。

examples.text: Many students declined to be interviewed on tape.
examples.translation: 许多学生谢绝录音采访。

examples.text: ...a new cassette tape...
examples.translation: 一盒新带子

examples.text: She still listens to the tapes I made her.
examples.translation: 她还在听我为她录制的带子。

examples.text: She has just taped an interview...
examples.translation: 她刚录制完一次采访。

examples.text: He shouldn't be taping without the singer's permission.
examples.translation: 他不该在没有征得演唱者同意的情况下录音。

examples.text: ...taped evidence from prisoners.
examples.translation: 犯人的证词录音

examples.text: ...an unauthorized taping.
examples.translation: 未经授权的录音

examples.text: The books were all tied up with tape.
examples.translation: 所有书籍都用布条捆扎了起来。

examples.text: ...the finishing tape.
examples.translation: 终点线

examples.text: ...strong adhesive tape.
examples.translation: 强力胶带

examples.text: I taped the base of the feather onto the velvet...
examples.translation: 我用胶带把羽毛的根部粘在了天鹅绒上。

examples.text: There are notes from years ago taped to the walls...
examples.translation: 墙上有多年前用胶带粘上去的字条。

examples.text: The envelope has been tampered with and then taped shut again.
examples.translation: 信封被人动过手脚，然后又用胶带封上了。

meanings.meaning: (Tar)人名；(东南亚国家华语)大；(罗、塞、匈、阿拉伯)塔尔

examples.text: The oil has hardened to tar...
examples.translation: 油已经硬化成柏油了。

examples.text: They drove across the river to New Hampshire on a hot tar road.
examples.translation: 他们沿着一条滚烫的柏油路开过了河，来到新罕布什尔州。

examples.text: I am a football supporter and I have to often explain that I'm not one of the hooligan sort because we'll all get tarred with the same brush when there's trouble.
examples.translation: 我是足球迷，经常要解释我不是那种足球流氓，因为一旦出事，我们就会被当成是一路货色。

examples.text: She turned on the taps.
examples.translation: 她打开了那些龙头。

examples.text: ...a cold-water tap...
examples.translation: 冷水阀

examples.text: The honey runs out of a tap at the bottom of the drum.
examples.translation: 蜂蜜从鼓形圆桶底部的一个旋塞流出来。

examples.text: He tapped the table to still the shouts of protest...
examples.translation: 他敲了敲桌子，以平息抗议的喧闹声。

examples.text: Tap the eggs gently with a teaspoon to crack the shells...
examples.translation: 用茶匙轻敲鸡蛋，让蛋壳开裂。

examples.text: Grace tapped on the bedroom door and went in...
examples.translation: 格雷丝轻轻敲了敲卧室的门，走了进去。

examples.text: There was a comfortable-looking clerk on duty, tapping away on a manual typewriter...
examples.translation: 有个神态安适的办事员在当班，在手动打字机上啪嗒啪嗒地打着字。

examples.text: To hold the carpet in place, it's a good idea to tap in a few nails temporarily.
examples.translation: 要想固定住地毯，临时钉些钉子是个好办法。

examples.text: A tap on the door interrupted him and Sally Pierce came in.
examples.translation: 敲门声打断了他，萨莉·皮尔斯走了进来。

examples.text: The song's so catchy it makes you bounce round the living room or tap your feet.
examples.translation: 这首歌很动听，听着它你就会不由自主地在客厅里舞动，或是用脚打拍子。

examples.text: He owes his election to having tapped deep public disillusion with professional politicians...
examples.translation: 他将自己的当选归因于充分利用了公众对于职业政治家们不再抱希望的心情。

examples.text: The company is tapping shareholders for £15.8 million...
examples.translation: 公司要向股东募集 1, 580 万英镑。

examples.text: The Campbell Soup Company says it will try to tap into Japan's rice market.
examples.translation: 坎贝尔羹汤公司表示，它将努力开发日本的大米市场。

examples.text: The government passed laws allowing the police to tap telephones...
examples.translation: 政府通过了允许警方监听电话的法令。

examples.text: We suspected the telephone line was tapped.
examples.translation: 我们怀疑电话遭人窃听了。

examples.text: He assured MPs that ministers and MPs were not subjected to phone taps.
examples.translation: 他向议员们保证，部长和议员的电话不会遭到窃听。

examples.text: Filtered water is always on tap, making it very convenient to use.
examples.translation: 随时打开龙头都有过滤水，用起来很方便。

examples.text: The advantage of group holidays is company on tap but time alone if you want it.
examples.translation: 团体度假的好处在于，要找人陪伴非常容易，想要独处也行。

examples.text: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
examples.translation: 美国打算取消电子产品等的关税。

examples.text: The daily tariff includes accommodation and unlimited use of the pool and gymnasium.
examples.translation: 日常费用包括住宿以及游泳池和健身房的不限时使用。

examples.text: ...electricity tariffs and telephone charges.
examples.translation: 电费和电话费

meanings.meaning: 把……作为目标；规定……的指标；瞄准某物

examples.text: The village lies beside a main road, making it an easy target for bandits...
examples.translation: 村子坐落在大路边上，很容易成为土匪袭击的对象。

examples.text: The missiles missed their target...
examples.translation: 导弹没有击中目标。

examples.text: He missed the target only once yesterday...
examples.translation: 昨天他只有一次脱靶。

examples.text: We threw knives at targets.
examples.translation: 我们往靶子上掷飞刀。

examples.text: He's won back his place too late to achieve his target of 20 goals this season.
examples.translation: 他赢回自己的位置时为时已晚，无法实现本赛季进 20 粒球的目标。

examples.text: ...school leavers who failed to reach their target grades.
examples.translation: 未能达到规定分数的肄业生

examples.text: Republicans targeted Unsoeld as vulnerable in her bid for reelection this year...
examples.translation: 共和党人将安索尔德定为攻击目标，认为她在争取今年连任的竞选中不堪一击。

examples.text: He targets the economy as the root cause of the deteriorating law and order situation.
examples.translation: 他抨击经济是治安状况不断恶化的根源。

examples.text: In the past they have been the target of racist abuse...
examples.translation: 过去，他们一直是种族虐待的对象。

examples.text: The professor has been a frequent target for animal rights extremists.
examples.translation: 那位教授屡屡受到极端动物保护主义者的抨击。

examples.text: The campaign will target American insurance companies...
examples.translation: 这场活动将以美国各保险公司为目标。

examples.text: The company has targeted adults as its primary customers.
examples.translation: 这家公司将成年人作为其主要顾客。

examples.text: Yuppies are a prime target group for marketing strategies.
examples.translation: 雅皮士是市场营销策略面向的主要目标群体。

examples.text: We were still right on target for our deadline.
examples.translation: 我们仍然有可能赶在最后期限前达成目标。

examples.text: Walker had the unenviable task of breaking the bad news to Hill...
examples.translation: 沃克不得不把这个坏消息告诉希尔。

examples.text: She used the day to catch up with administrative tasks.
examples.translation: 她白天忙着处理行政工作。

examples.text: The minister was tasked with checking that British aid money was being spent wisely.
examples.translation: 部长被指派去督查英国的援助资金是否已用到实处。

examples.text: The country's intellectuals are also being taken to task for their failure to speak out against the regime.
examples.translation: 该国知识分子也因未能公开反对该政权受到了指责。

examples.text: No-one enjoys paying tax...
examples.translation: 没人喜欢纳税。

examples.text: They are calling for large spending cuts and tax increases.
examples.translation: 他们呼吁大幅度削减开支并提高税收。

examples.text: ...a cut in tax on new cars.
examples.translation: 降低新车所缴纳的税款

examples.text: ...a pledge not to raise taxes on people below a certain income...
examples.translation: 对收入低于一定水平的人不提高税收的承诺

examples.text: His decision to return to a form of property tax is the right one.
examples.translation: 他决定恢复征收财产税是正确的。

examples.text: Husband and wife are now taxed separately on their incomes...
examples.translation: 现在夫妻双方分别按各自的收入纳税。

examples.text: ...the government's commitment to simplifying the way companies are taxed...
examples.translation: 政府简化公司纳税手续的承诺

examples.text: The Bonn government taxes profits of corporations at a rate that is among the highest in Europe.
examples.translation: 波恩政府对公司所得税的征收税率之高在欧洲处于前列。

examples.text: Overcrowding has taxed the city's ability to deal with waste...
examples.translation: 人口过多使得城市的垃圾处理能力达到了极限。

examples.text: These dilemmas would tax the best of statesmen.
examples.translation: 这些进退两难的局面对一流的政治家也是个考验。

examples.text: The taxi drew up in front of the Riviera Club...
examples.translation: 出租车在里维埃拉俱乐部门口停了下来。

examples.text: He set off by taxi.
examples.translation: 他打的走了。

examples.text: She gave permission to the plane to taxi into position and hold for takeoff...
examples.translation: 她发出指令，允许飞机滑行入位，准备起飞。

examples.text: The pilot taxied the plane to the end of the runway.
examples.translation: 飞行员将飞机滑行到了跑道尽头。

examples.text: ...a keen sense of taste.
examples.translation: 灵敏的味觉

examples.text: I like the taste of wine and enjoy trying different kinds...
examples.translation: 我喜欢葡萄酒的味道，喜欢品尝不同的口味。

examples.text: The taste of blood in her throat made her want to vomit...
examples.translation: 她嗓子里的血腥味让她直恶心。
