examples.text: Nettles are surprisingly good — much like spinach but with a sweetish taste.
examples.translation: 没想到荨麻这么好吃——很像菠菜，但带了点甜味。

examples.text: We have a taste of the white wine he's brought.
examples.translation: 我们尝了尝他带来的白葡萄酒。

examples.text: I drank a cup of tea that tasted of diesel...
examples.translation: 我喝了杯有股柴油味的茶。

examples.text: It tastes like chocolate...
examples.translation: 它吃起来像巧克力。

examples.text: The pizza tastes delicious without any cheese at all.
examples.translation: 不加奶酪的比萨饼很好吃。

examples.text: He finished his aperitif and tasted the wine the waiter had produced...
examples.translation: 他喝完开胃酒，又尝了点侍者端来的葡萄酒。

examples.text: Before proceeding any further, cut off a small bit of the meat and taste it.
examples.translation: 在进行下一步之前，先切一小块肉尝尝。

examples.text: You can taste the chilli in the dish but it is a little sweet.
examples.translation: 你可以尝出菜里面有辣椒，不过味道有点甜。

examples.text: But having had a taste of the big time, he won't want to go back to playing in the reserves...
examples.translation: 但是，有过一举成名的经历以后，他就不会再想回去当替补了。

examples.text: This voyage was his first taste of freedom.
examples.translation: 这次航行使他初次体验到了自由的滋味。

examples.text: Anyone who has tasted this life wants it to carry on for as long as possible.
examples.translation: 任何过过这种日子的人都希望它持续得越久越好。

examples.text: She developed a taste for journeys to isolated hazardous regions in North America...
examples.translation: 她喜欢上了到北美那些险象环生的偏远地区旅行。

examples.text: That gave me a taste for reading.
examples.translation: 那使我喜欢上了读书。

examples.text: His taste in clothes is extremely good...
examples.translation: 他在穿衣方面很有品味。

examples.text: Oxford's social circle was far too liberal for her taste.
examples.translation: 牛津的社交圈过于开放，不合她的胃口。

examples.text: ...a large family with different tastes and preferences...
examples.translation: 兴趣爱好各不相同的大家庭

examples.text: How could so many people have such bad taste in music?
examples.translation: 音乐鉴赏力差的人怎么会有那么多？

examples.text: He rejects the idea that his film is in bad taste...
examples.translation: 他不接受那种认为他的电影格调不高的观点。

examples.text: I do not feel your actions were either appropriate or done in good taste.
examples.translation: 我认为你的行为既不妥当又不合时宜。

examples.text: Add tomato paste, salt and pepper to taste.
examples.translation: 酌量添加番茄酱、盐和胡椒粉。

examples.text: ...a cup of tea...
examples.translation: 一杯茶

examples.text: Would you like some tea?...
examples.translation: 要喝茶吗？

examples.text: Four or five men were drinking tea from flasks.
examples.translation: 四五个男人在喝保温瓶里的茶水。

examples.text: Would anybody like a tea or coffee?
examples.translation: 有没有人要来杯茶或者咖啡？

examples.text: ...a packet of tea...
examples.translation: 一包茶叶

examples.text: America imports about 190 million pounds of tea a year...
examples.translation: 美国每年进口大约 1.9 亿磅茶叶。

examples.text: Earl Grey, Darjeeling and Jasmine are best-selling traditional teas.
examples.translation: 伯爵茶、大吉岭茶和茉莉花茶是最畅销的几种传统茶叶。

examples.text: I'm doing the sandwiches for tea...
examples.translation: 我在做下午茶吃的三明治。

examples.text: I took her to tea at the Ritz.
examples.translation: 我带她去里茨饭店吃下午茶了。

examples.text: At five o'clock he comes back for his tea.
examples.translation: 他 5 点钟回来吃晚餐。

examples.text: Politics was not his cup of tea...
examples.translation: 他对政治不感兴趣。

examples.text: I know I'm not everyone's cup of tea.
examples.translation: 我知道自己不是人见人爱。

examples.text: I'm a teacher with 21 years' experience.
examples.translation: 我是个有 21 年教龄的教师。

examples.text: ...her chemistry teacher.
examples.translation: 她的化学老师

examples.text: The trainers have a programme to teach them vocational skills...
examples.translation: 培训师计划教他们一些职业技能。

examples.text: George had taught him how to ride a horse...
examples.translation: 乔治已经教会了他骑马。

examples.text: She taught Julie to read...
examples.translation: 她教朱莉识字。

examples.text: The computer has simplified the difficult task of teaching reading to the deaf.
examples.translation: 电脑简化了教聋人阅读这一艰巨的工作。

examples.text: Their daughter's death had taught him humility...
examples.translation: 他们女儿的死使他学会了谦逊。

examples.text: He taught his followers that they could all be members of the kingdom of God...
examples.translation: 他教导信徒们说，他们都可以升入天国。

examples.text: Teach them to voice their feelings.
examples.translation: 训练他们敢于表达自己的感受。

examples.text: Ingrid is currently teaching Mathematics at Shimla Public School...
examples.translation: 英格丽德目前在希姆拉公立学校教数学。

examples.text: The topic is not taught in degree courses...
examples.translation: 学位课程不讲授这个课题。

examples.text: She taught English to Japanese business people...
examples.translation: 她教日本商人学英语。

examples.text: She has taught for 34 years...
examples.translation: 她已从教 34 年。

examples.text: She taught children French.
examples.translation: 她教孩子们学法语。

examples.text: ...this twelve month taught course.
examples.translation: 这门为期 12 个月的课程

examples.text: The team failed to qualify for the African Nations Cup finals...
examples.translation: 该队未能闯入非洲国家杯决赛。

examples.text: He had lost his place in the England team.
examples.translation: 他失去了在英格兰队的位置。

examples.text: Each specialist consultant has a team of doctors under him...
examples.translation: 每位会诊专家手下都有一组医生。

examples.text: The governors were joined by Mr Hunter and his management team.
examples.translation: 亨特先生及他率领的管理小组加入了州长们的队伍。

meanings.meaning: 眼泪, （撕破的）洞或裂缝, 撕扯
撕掉, 扯下, 扰乱

examples.text: Her eyes filled with tears...
examples.translation: 她双眼噙满泪水。

examples.text: I just broke down and wept with tears of joy...
examples.translation: 我一下子禁不住喜极而泣。

examples.text: I didn't shed a single tear.
examples.translation: 我一滴眼泪也没掉。

examples.text: He was in floods of tears on the phone...
examples.translation: 他在电话里失声痛哭。

examples.text: She burst into tears and ran from the kitchen...
examples.translation: 她突然哭了，跑出了厨房。

examples.text: She was conscious of being very near to tears.
examples.translation: 她意识到自己快哭出来了。

examples.text: She very nearly tore my overcoat...
examples.translation: 她差点把我的大衣扯破了。

examples.text: Mary Ann tore the edge off her napkin...
examples.translation: 玛丽·安撕掉了餐巾的边儿。

examples.text: He took a small notebook from his jacket pocket and tore out a page...
examples.translation: 他从上衣口袋里掏出小笔记本，撕下来一页。

examples.text: Too fine a material may tear...
examples.translation: 料子太薄容易撕破。

examples.text: Nancy quickly tore open the envelope...
examples.translation: 南希飞快撕开信封。

examples.text: He noticed that fabric was tearing away from the plane's wing...
examples.translation: 他注意到机翼在一块一块地断裂。

examples.text: He went ashore leaving me to start repairing the torn sail.
examples.translation: 他上岸去了，留下我修理被撕破的船帆。

examples.text: She tore the letter up...
examples.translation: 她撕开信。

examples.text: Don't you dare tear up her ticket.
examples.translation: 谅你也不敢撕她的票。

examples.text: ...a torn up photograph.
examples.translation: 撕碎的照片

examples.text: I peered through a tear in the van's curtains.
examples.translation: 我通过篷车帘子的破洞窥视。

examples.text: Canine teeth are for piercing and killing prey, and tearing flesh...
examples.translation: 犬齿用来咬穿、咬死猎物，还可以撕肉。

examples.text: He had stumbled down and torn the skin from his knees.
examples.translation: 他绊倒在地，膝盖上蹭破了皮。

examples.text: He tore a muscle in his right thigh...
examples.translation: 他右大腿的一块肌肉拉伤了。

examples.text: If the muscle is stretched again it could even tear.
examples.translation: 这块肌肉要是再拉伸的话，甚至可能会撕裂。

examples.text: ...torn ligaments.
examples.translation: 拉伤的韧带

examples.text: She tore the windscreen wipers from his car...
examples.translation: 她猛地扯掉他车上的雨刷。

examples.text: He tore down the girl's photograph, and crumpled it into a ball.
examples.translation: 他一把扯下那女孩的照片，将它揉成一团。

examples.text: Female fans fought their way past bodyguards and tore at his clothes.
examples.translation: 女粉丝冲破保安的阻拦，撕扯他的衣裳。

examples.text: The door flew open and Miranda tore into the room...
examples.translation: 门猛地开了，米兰达闯进房间。

examples.text: Without looking to left or to right, he tore off down the road.
examples.translation: 他也不朝两边看，就在路上开始狂奔。

examples.text: ...a country that has been torn by civil war and foreign invasion since its independence.
examples.translation: 自独立以来就饱受内战和外敌入侵之苦的国家

examples.text: ...the riot-torn areas of Los Angeles.
examples.translation: 洛杉矶骚乱频发的地区

meanings.meaning: 取笑；戏弄；梳理；欺负；强求；使起毛
戏弄；爱纠缠的小孩；挑逗者；卖弄风骚的女孩

examples.text: He told her how the boys in East Poldown had set on him, teasing him...
examples.translation: 他告诉她东波尔顿的男孩们是如何攻击他、嘲笑他的。

examples.text: He teased me mercilessly about going Hollywood...
examples.translation: 他毫不留情地嘲笑我想去好莱坞。

examples.text: 'You must be expecting a young man,' she teased.
examples.translation: “你一定是在等哪位小伙子吧，”她揶揄道。

examples.text: Calling her by her real name had always been one of his teases.
examples.translation: 他一直把称呼她的真名当作一种取乐。

examples.text: She tolerated the teasing, until the fourth grade.
examples.translation: 她忍受着别人的嘲笑，一直忍到四年级。

examples.text: My brother's such a tease...
examples.translation: 我弟弟太喜欢戏弄人了。

examples.text: The best way to deal with a tease is to ignore him.
examples.translation: 对付爱捉弄人的人的最佳方法就是不搭理他。

examples.text: I thought she was teasing, playing the innocent, but looking back, I'm not so sure...
examples.translation: 我当时以为她是在勾引我，装纯情，不过现在回想起来，我又说不准了。

examples.text: When did you last flirt with him or tease him?
examples.translation: 你上次和他调情或挑逗他是什么时候？

examples.text: Later she heard he had told one of her friends she was a tease.
examples.translation: 后来，她听说他告诉她的一个朋友，说她是狐狸精。

meanings.meaning: 工艺的，科技的；技术上的；专门的

examples.text: In order to reach this limit a number of technical problems will have to be solved.
examples.translation: 要达到这个限度，还有很多技术问题必须解决。

examples.text: ...jobs that require technical knowledge...
examples.translation: 要求具备技术知识的工作岗位

examples.text: Many technical experts at the time had doubts about the technology.
examples.translation: 当时，许多技术专家对那种工艺抱有疑问。

examples.text: ...the largest and most technically advanced furnace company in the world.
examples.translation: 世界上规模最大、技术最先进的锅炉公司

examples.text: Their technical ability is exceptional...
examples.translation: 他们技艺超群。

examples.text: In the realm of sculpture too, the technical skill of foreign artists was long recognised.
examples.translation: 在雕塑领域，外国艺术家的技艺也早已得到认可。

examples.text: While Sade's voice isn't technically brilliant it has a quality which is unmistakable.
examples.translation: 虽然萨德的歌声从技巧方面说谈不上多出色，但很独特。

examples.text: The technical term for sunburn is erythema...
examples.translation: 晒斑的专业术语叫红斑。

examples.text: He's just written a book: large format, nicely illustrated and not too technical.
examples.translation: 他刚出了本书：大开本，插图精美，专业性也不太强。

meanings.meaning: 技师，技术员；技巧纯熟的人

examples.text: ...a laboratory technician.
examples.translation: 实验室技术员

examples.text: ...a versatile, veteran player, a superb technician.
examples.translation: 技术全面、经验丰富、技巧娴熟的运动能手

examples.text: ...tests performed using a new technique.
examples.translation: 用新技术进行的试验

examples.text: He went off to the Amsterdam Academy to improve his technique.
examples.translation: 他动身前往阿姆斯特丹学院去进修技艺。

examples.text: Technology is changing fast...
examples.translation: 科技日新月异。

examples.text: They should be allowed to wait for cheaper technologies to be developed.
examples.translation: 应该允许他们等到更廉价的技术被开发出来。

examples.text: ...nuclear weapons technology.
examples.translation: 核武器技术

examples.text: ...the scientists and technologists that we will need for the future.
examples.translation: 我们将来需要的科学家和技术专家

examples.text: Such lists are long and tedious to read.
examples.translation: 这种表单读起来冗长乏味。

examples.text: ...the tedious business of line-by-line programming.
examples.translation: 枯燥乏味的逐行编程工作

examples.text: ...the most tediously boring aspects of international relations.
examples.translation: 国际关系中最枯燥乏味的方面

meanings.meaning: 十几岁的青少年；十三岁到十九岁的少年

examples.text: As a teenager he attended Tulse Hill Senior High School.
examples.translation: 十几岁时，他上了塔尔斯山高中。

examples.text: Scores of congratulatory telegrams and letters greeted Franklin on his return...
examples.translation: 富兰克林一回来，就收到了好几十封贺电和贺信。

examples.text: The President received a briefing by telegram.
examples.translation: 总统收到用电报发来的一份简报。

examples.text: Churchill telegraphed an urgent message to Wavell...
examples.translation: 丘吉尔给韦维尔发了封紧急电报。

examples.text: 'Please,' he telegraphed, 'just leave it alone.'...
examples.translation: “拜托，”他在电报中说，“别管它了。”

examples.text: He telegraphed to me asking me to do something.
examples.translation: 他给我发来电报，叫我做点什么。

examples.text: The commission telegraphed its decision earlier this month by telling an official to prepare the order.
examples.translation: 本月早些时候，委员会命令一位官员准备起草指令，透露了其决定。

examples.text: They usually exchanged messages by telephone...
examples.translation: 他们一般通过电话互通消息。

examples.text: I dread to think what our telephone bill is going to be...
examples.translation: 我不敢想象我们的电话费会有多少。

examples.text: She was wanted on the telephone.
examples.translation: 有人打电话找她。

examples.text: He got up and answered the telephone...
examples.translation: 他起身去接了电话。

examples.text: The telephone in Rizzoli's room rang.
examples.translation: 里佐利房间的电话响了。

examples.text: I felt so badly I had to telephone Owen to say I was sorry...
examples.translation: 我心里实在难受，觉得必须给欧文打电话道个歉。

examples.text: They usually telephone first to see if she is at home.
examples.translation: 他们通常先打个电话，看看她在不在家。

examples.text: Linda remained on the telephone to the police for three hours...
examples.translation: 琳达在电话里和警察谈了 3 个小时。

examples.text: We talked on the telephone for quite a while.
examples.translation: 我们在电话里谈了好一阵子。

examples.text: She wasn't on the telephone...
examples.translation: 她没装电话。

examples.text: Are you on the telephone at home?
examples.translation: 你家有没有电话？

examples.text: It's hoped that the telescope will enable scientists to see deeper into the universe than ever before.
examples.translation: 人们希望望远镜能使科学家看到比以往更遥远的宇宙深处。

meanings.meaning: (Tell)人名；(英、德、瑞典)特尔；(罗、意)泰尔；(阿拉伯)塔勒

examples.text: In the evening I returned to tell Phyllis our relationship was over...
examples.translation: 晚上我回来告诉菲莉丝我们之间完了。

examples.text: I called Andie to tell her how spectacular the stuff looked...
examples.translation: 我打电话告诉安迪，那东西看上去太棒了。

examples.text: Claire had made me promise to tell her the truth...
examples.translation: 克莱尔要我保证把真相告诉她。

examples.text: I only told the truth to the press when the single was released as it seemed the perfect time to do it...
examples.translation: 等到单曲唱片开始发行时，我才把真相透露给媒体，因为那似乎是最佳时机。

examples.text: Tell us about your moment on the summit...
examples.translation: 说说你登上顶峰的那一刻，心里是怎么想的。

examples.text: Her voice breaking with emotion, she told him: 'It doesn't seem fair'.
examples.translation: 她激动得声音颤抖，对他说：“这好像不公平吧。”

examples.text: His friends say he was always quick to tell a joke...
examples.translation: 他的朋友们说，以前他讲笑话总是张嘴就来。

examples.text: He told his story to The Sunday Times and produced photographs...
examples.translation: 他把自己的经历讲述给了《星期日泰晤士报》的记者，还提供了照片。

examples.text: Will you tell me a story?
examples.translation: 能讲个故事给我听吗？

examples.text: A passer-by told the driver to move his car so that it was not causing an obstruction...
examples.translation: 一个过路人叫那个司机把他的车挪一挪，免得挡道。

examples.text: She told me on the telephone to come help clean the house.
examples.translation: 她在电话里叫我过去帮忙打扫屋子。

examples.text: 'Come on', she told herself...
examples.translation: “加油！”她在心里暗暗打气。

examples.text: I told myself I would be satisfied with whatever I could get.
examples.translation: 我告诉自己，不管得到什么我都会心满意足的。

examples.text: It was already impossible to tell where the bullet had entered...
examples.translation: 已经无法判断子弹是从哪里打进来的。

examples.text: I couldn't tell if he had been in a fight or had just fallen down...
examples.translation: 我不知道他是和人家打架了，还是仅仅摔了一跤。

examples.text: You can tell he's joking.
examples.translation: 你能看出来他是在开玩笑。

examples.text: I can't really tell the difference between their policies and ours...
examples.translation: 我真的看不出他们的政策和我们的有什么不同。

examples.text: How do you tell one from another?...
examples.translation: 你怎么把他们区分开来？

examples.text: I had to look twice to tell which was Martinez; they all looked alike.
examples.translation: 我得仔细看一下才能认出哪个是马丁内斯，他们长得实在太像了。

examples.text: Many of the children know who they are but are not telling.
examples.translation: 许多孩子知道他们是谁，可就是不说。

examples.text: The facts tell us that this is not true...
examples.translation: 事实告诉我们，这不是真的。

examples.text: I don't think the unemployment rate ever tells us much about the future...
examples.translation: 我认为，从失业率上永远看不出未来的情况究竟如何。

examples.text: The evidence of our eyes tells us a different story...
examples.translation: 我们亲眼所见的可不是那么一回事。

examples.text: While most of us feel fairly complacent about the nutrients we're getting from our diets, the facts tell a very different story.
examples.translation: 虽然我们大多数人对于从饮食中获取的营养成分感到相当满足，实际情况却不是这样。

examples.text: The pressure began to tell as rain closed in after 20 laps...
examples.translation: 跑完 20 圈以后，眼看就要下雨了，大家开始紧张起来。

examples.text: The strains of office are beginning to tell on the prime minister.
examples.translation: 首相开始感到公务繁忙的压力了。

examples.text: As far as I can tell, Jason is basically a nice guy...
examples.translation: 据我所知，贾森算得上是个好人。

examples.text: So far as anyone can tell, there's evidence that there was a Robin Hood...
examples.translation: 众所周知，有证据表明确实有罗宾汉这么个人。

examples.text: As far as I could tell, neither of us was under observation.
examples.translation: 据我所知，我们俩都没有受到监视。

examples.text: I tell you this, I will not rest until that day has come...
examples.translation: 我可以肯定地说，不到那天我不会休息。

examples.text: This little letter gave us a few chuckles, I can tell you...
examples.translation: 说真的，我们看了这封短信都笑了。

examples.text: I can't tell you how glad I was to leave that place.
examples.translation: 我无法形容自己离开那个地方心里有多高兴。

examples.text: You never can tell what life is going to bring you.
examples.translation: 你永远不知道人生会给你带来些什么。

examples.text: Her parents did not approve of her decision and, if she failed, her mother would say, 'I told you so.'
examples.translation: 她父母不赞同她的决定，要是她失败了，她妈妈就会说：“怎么样，我说对了吧？”

examples.text: I tell you what, I'll bring the water in a separate glass.
examples.translation: 要不这样吧，我用另一个玻璃杯把水端过来。

meanings.meaning: 脾气；（钢等）回火；性情；倾向
使回火；锻炼；调和；使缓和

examples.text: He had a temper and could be nasty...
examples.translation: 他脾气不大好，有时凶得很。

examples.text: His short temper had become notorious...
examples.translation: 他的臭脾气是出了名的。

examples.text: I hope he can control his temper.
examples.translation: 我希望他能克制住自己的脾气。

examples.text: I was in a bad temper last night...
examples.translation: 昨晚我心情不好。

examples.text: He was in a very good temper...
examples.translation: 他当时心情非常好。

examples.text: In a fit of bad temper, Dougie threw the deep fat fryer overboard.
examples.translation: 一气之下，道吉把那个又深又大的油炸锅扔了。

examples.text: For others, especially the young and foolish, the state will temper justice with mercy...
examples.translation: 对待其他人时，尤其是年轻人和愚蠢的人，国家会刚柔并济。

examples.text: He had to learn to temper his enthusiasm.
examples.translation: 他得学着给自己的热情降温。

examples.text: She was still in a temper when Colin arrived...
examples.translation: 科林到的时候，她气还没有消。

examples.text: When I try to explain how I feel he just flies into a temper.
examples.translation: 我刚要解释我心里是怎么想的，他就勃然大怒。

examples.text: I've never seen him get cross or lose his temper...
examples.translation: 我从未见过他生气或者发火。

examples.text: I lost my temper and banged my book down on the desk.
examples.translation: 我大发雷霆，把书砰地往课桌上一摔。

examples.text: His impulsive temperament regularly got him into difficulties...
examples.translation: 他容易冲动，经常因此惹麻烦。

examples.text: She was furtive and vicious by temperament.
examples.translation: 她本来做事就偷偷摸摸，心肠狠毒。

examples.text: Mark does have a habit of allowing his temperament to get the better of him...
examples.translation: 马克的确经常由着自己的性子来。

examples.text: Some of the models were given to fits of temperament.
examples.translation: 有些模情喜怒无常。

meanings.meaning: 温度 量某人的体温 发烧 氛围 体温

examples.text: The temperature soared to above 100 degrees in the shade...
examples.translation: 阴凉处的温度骤升至100 多度。

examples.text: The temperature of the water was about 40 degrees...
examples.translation: 水温大约 40 度。

examples.text: Coping with severe drops in temperature can be very difficult.
examples.translation: 温度大幅下降可能会很难应付。

examples.text: His temperature continued to rise alarmingly.
examples.translation: 他的体温还在上升，令人担忧。

examples.text: There's also been a noticeable rise in the political temperature.
examples.translation: 政治气氛也明显升温了。

examples.text: Stir the parsley into the potatoes and serve at room temperature.
examples.translation: 把欧芹拌入土豆里，放至常温后再端上桌。

examples.text: He began to run an extremely high temperature...
examples.translation: 他开始发高烧。

examples.text: Little Constance had a temperature that day.
examples.translation: 小康斯坦丝那天发烧了。

examples.text: He will probably take your child's temperature too.
examples.translation: 他很可能也会量量你家孩子的体温。

examples.text: ...a small Hindu temple.
examples.translation: 一座小的印度教庙宇

examples.text: ...the Temple of Diana at Ephesus.
examples.translation: 以弗所的狄安娜神庙

examples.text: Threads of silver ran through his beard and the hair at his temples.
examples.translation: 他的胡须和鬓发里夹杂着缕缕银丝。

examples.text: ...owing to the slow tempo of change in an overwhelmingly rural country...
examples.translation: 由于以农业占绝对主导地位的国家变革速度缓慢

examples.text: Both teams played with a lot of quality, pace and tempo.
examples.translation: 两支球队的水平都很高，节奏和速度都很快。

examples.text: In a new recording, the Boston Philharmonic tried the original tempo...
examples.translation: 在新唱片中，波士顿爱乐乐团尝试了全新的节奏。

examples.text: Elgar supplied his works with precise indications of tempo.
examples.translation: 埃尔加给自己的作品标上了精确的节奏标记。

examples.text: His job here is only temporary...
examples.translation: 他在这儿的工作只是临时的。

examples.text: Most adolescent problems are temporary.
examples.translation: 多数青少年问题是暂时性的。

examples.text: ...a temporary loss of memory.
examples.translation: 暂时失记

examples.text: The peace agreement has at least temporarily halted the civil war...
examples.translation: 该和平协定至少暂时停止了内战。

examples.text: Checkpoints between the two zones were temporarily closed.
examples.translation: 那两个地区之间的检查站被临时关闭。

meanings.meaning: 诱惑；引起；冒…的风险；使感兴趣

examples.text: Reducing the income will further impoverish these families and could tempt an offender into further crime...
examples.translation: 降低收入只会使这些家庭更加贫穷，而且可能诱使不法分子进一步犯罪。

examples.text: It is the fresh fruit that tempts me at this time of year...
examples.translation: 一年当中这个时节，新鲜水果最能吸引我了。

examples.text: Can I tempt you with a little puff pastry?...
examples.translation: 我能给你尝点泡芙点心吗？

examples.text: The fact that she had become wealthy did not tempt her to alter her frugal way of life.
examples.translation: 她有钱了，可这丝毫没能让她改变节俭的生活习惯。

examples.text: ...a million dollar marketing campaign to tempt American tourists back to Britain...
examples.translation: 耗资百万美元试图把美国游客重新吸引到英国来的营销活动

examples.text: Having spent so long at a great club like Rangers, no other Scottish team could tempt him away...
examples.translation: 在流浪者队这样优秀的俱乐部呆了这么久之后，其他苏格兰球队都吸引不了他了。

examples.text: Don't let credit tempt you to buy something you can't afford...
examples.translation: 不要因为可以赊购，就买超过自己支付能力的东西。

examples.text: She will be offering a package worth about 40 million dollars, to tempt the rebels into agreeing to disarm.
examples.translation: 她将提出价值 4, 000 万美元的一揽子条件，以诱使反叛分子答应解除武装。

examples.text: As soon as you start to talk about never having played on a losing side, it is tempting fate.
examples.translation: 你刚说从来没输过，晦气就来了。

examples.text: Will they be able to resist the temptation to buy?
examples.translation: 他们能忍住诱惑不买吗？

examples.text: ...the many temptations to which you will be exposed.
examples.translation: 你将面临的许多诱惑

examples.text: Over the past ten years things have changed.
examples.translation: 过去 10 年间，情况已发生了变化。

meanings.meaning: 承租人；房客；佃户；居住者

examples.text: Regulations placed clear obligations on the landlord for the benefit of the tenant...
examples.translation: 为维护房客的利益，条例明确规定了房东负有的各项义务。

examples.text: Landowners frequently left the management of their estates to tenant farmers.
examples.translation: 地主们经常将土地的管理交给佃农。

examples.text: A problem for manufacturers is that lighter cars tend to be noisy...
examples.translation: 制造商们遇到的一个问题是，重量较轻的汽车往往噪音大。

examples.text: In older age groups women predominate because men tend to die younger...
examples.translation: 在老年群体里女性占大多数，因为男性通常不易高寿。

examples.text: They tend to buy cheap processed foods like canned chicken and macaroni.
examples.translation: 他们往往会买便宜的加工食品，像鸡肉罐头和通心粉之类的。

examples.text: Artistic and intellectual people tend towards left-wing views.
examples.translation: 搞艺术的人和知识分子容易持“左倾”观点。

examples.text: I tend to think that members of parliament by and large do a good job.
examples.translation: 我个人觉得，议会议员总体上工作还是不错的。

examples.text: For years he tended her in her painful illness...
examples.translation: 多年来她一直受到病痛的折磨，都是他在照料。

examples.text: He tends the flower beds and evergreens that he has planted in the driveway.
examples.translation: 他打理着他栽在车道两旁的花坛和常青树。

examples.text: In our culture, girls are brought up to tend to the needs of others...
examples.translation: 在我们的文化里，女孩从小就学着照料别人。

examples.text: She hurried away to pour more coffee and tend to the grill.
examples.translation: 她匆忙走开，去添加咖啡和照看烤架。

examples.text: The army has become increasingly restless over the mounting separatist tendencies of the northern republics.
examples.translation: 军方对于北方几个共和国不断加剧的分裂倾向感到越来越不安。

examples.text: ...the government's tendency towards secrecy in recent years.
examples.translation: 近年来政府的保密倾向

examples.text: He is spoiled, arrogant and has a tendency towards snobbery...
examples.translation: 他被宠坏了，傲慢无礼，而且经常自命不凡。

examples.text: Helen had been struggling against suicidal tendencies.
examples.translation: 海伦一直在压制心里的自杀念头。

meanings.meaning: 温柔的；柔软的；脆弱的；幼稚的；难对付的
提供，偿还；使…变嫩；使…变柔软

examples.text: Her voice was tender, full of pity...
examples.translation: 她的声音很温柔，充满了怜爱。

examples.text: Patients may not receive the tender, loving care once associated with a hospital stay.
examples.translation: 病人们可能享受不到以前住院时那种悉心体贴的照顾。

examples.text: Mr. White tenderly embraced his wife.
examples.translation: 怀特先生温柔地拥抱了妻子。

examples.text: She smiled, politely rather than with tenderness or gratitude.
examples.translation: 她只是出于礼貌地笑了笑，而非出于关心或感激。

examples.text: He had become attracted to the game at the tender age of seven.
examples.translation: 他在7岁的小小年纪就喜欢上了这项运动。

examples.text: ...the loss of her father at such a tender age.
examples.translation: 如此幼小的年纪就失去了父亲

examples.text: Cook for a minimum of 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
examples.translation: 至少煮两个小时，或一直煮到肉变烂为止。

examples.text: ...tender young dwarf beans.
examples.translation: 幼嫩的四季豆

examples.text: My tummy felt very tender...
examples.translation: 我的肚子一碰就很疼。

examples.text: Treat any tender points by massaging.
examples.translation: 用按摩法治疗疼痛部位。

examples.text: There is still some tenderness in her tummy.
examples.translation: 她的肚子还有点疼。

examples.text: Builders will then be sent the specifications and asked to submit a tender for the work...
examples.translation: 建筑商们将会收到说明书，并被邀请参与该项目投标。

examples.text: Some services are now compulsorily put out to tender.
examples.translation: 现在，有些服务项目必须进行招标。

examples.text: ...the consortium that has won the tender to build the second Severn Bridge.
examples.translation: 中标得以建造第二座塞文桥的财团

examples.text: The staff are forbidden to tender for private-sector work...
examples.translation: 工作人员不得投标承接私营部门的工作。

examples.text: He tendered for and was awarded the contract.
examples.translation: 他参与竞标，并赢得了合同。

examples.text: ...compulsory competitive tendering for council leisure and recreation services.
examples.translation: 对市政会休闲娱乐服务项目的强制性竞标

examples.text: She quickly tendered her resignation...
examples.translation: 她很快递交了辞呈。

examples.text: He took his wallet from his inside coat pocket and tendered the permit.
examples.translation: 他从外套内兜里掏出钱包，出示了许可证。

examples.text: The table-tennis gang sits to the right, flicking shrimp shells at one another with quicksilver speed.
This gesture of goodwill did little to improve the tense atmosphere at the talks...
examples.translation: 这一友好姿态基本上没有改善会谈的紧张气氛。

examples.text: After three very tense weeks he phoned again...
examples.translation: 过了紧张不安的 3 个星期，他又一次打来电话。

examples.text: There was a tense silence.
examples.translation: 有一阵令人局促不安的沉默。

examples.text: Dart, who had at first been very tense, at last relaxed.
examples.translation: 起初，达特非常紧张，最后终于放松了下来。

examples.text: She waited tensely for the next bulletin...
examples.translation: 她焦虑地等候着下一期公告。

examples.text: 'Tony, I can explain everything,' she said tensely.
examples.translation: “托尼，这一切我都可以解释，”她紧张地说。

examples.text: McKay walked slowly toward this screen, feeling a growing tenseness.
examples.translation: 麦凯缓缓地朝这个屏幕走来，每走一步心情都更加紧张。

examples.text: She lay, eyes shut, body tense...
examples.translation: 她躺着，双目紧闭，全身绷直。

examples.text: A bath can relax tense muscles.
examples.translation: 洗个澡可以放松紧张的肌肉。

examples.text: If you feel a tenseness around the eyes, relax your muscles.
examples.translation: 你要是觉得两眼周围紧绷，就放松一下肌肉。

examples.text: Newman's stomach muscles tensed...
examples.translation: 纽曼的腹肌绷紧了。

examples.text: He tensed as the big West Indian gripped his shoulder...
examples.translation: 那个大块头西印度群岛土著人抓住他的肩膀时，他浑身紧张起来。

examples.text: Jane tensed her muscles to stop them from shaking.
examples.translation: 简把肌肉绷紧，不让它们颤抖。

examples.text: When we are under stress our bodies tend to tense up...
examples.translation: 人一紧张，身体就会变僵硬。

examples.text: I tried not to tense up, or become obviously wary...
examples.translation: 我尽量不让自己紧张，或者表现得非常警觉。

examples.text: Tense up the muscles in both of your legs.
examples.translation: 把两腿的肌肉绷紧。

examples.text: It was as though Corinne was already dead: they were speaking of her in the past tense.
examples.translation: 科琳娜好像已经去世了：他们谈论她时用的是过去时。

meanings.meaning: 张力，拉力；紧张，不安；电压

examples.text: The tension between the two countries is likely to remain...
examples.translation: 那两个国家间的紧张局面可能会持续下去。

examples.text: ...continued tension over the killing of demonstrators...
examples.translation: 示威者遇害后的持续紧张局势

examples.text: The years of his government are remembered for political tension and conflict.
examples.translation: 他执政的那些年留给人们的记忆是政治局势紧张、冲突不断。

examples.text: She has done her best to keep calm but finds herself trembling with tension and indecision...
examples.translation: 她尽力保持镇定，可还是由于紧张、犹豫不决而抖个不停。

examples.text: Smiling and laughing has actually been shown to relieve tension and stress.
examples.translation: 事实证明，微笑和大笑能够缓解焦虑和压力。

examples.text: The film explored the tension between public duty and personal affections.
examples.translation: 这部电影探讨了公共义务和个人情感之间的冲突。

meanings.meaning: 用帐篷遮盖；使在帐篷里住宿

examples.text: To minimize discomfort, each tent is equipped with air conditioning and a private bathroom.

meanings.meaning: 试验性的，暂定的；踌躇的

examples.text: Political leaders have reached a tentative agreement to hold a preparatory conference next month...
examples.translation: 政治领导人已就下个月举行预备会议达成初步协定。

examples.text: Such theories are still very tentative.
examples.translation: 这种理论仍然是探索性的。

examples.text: The next round of talks is tentatively scheduled to begin October 21st in Washington.
examples.translation: 下一轮会谈暂定于10月21日在华盛顿开始。

examples.text: My first attempts at complaining were rather tentative...
examples.translation: 我刚开始投诉时很犹豫不决。

examples.text: She did not return his tentative smile.
examples.translation: 她并没有对他怯生生的微笑作出回应。

examples.text: Perhaps, he suggested tentatively, they should send for Dr Band.
examples.translation: 他小心地建议道，也许他们应该让人去请班德大夫。

examples.text: Our goods compete in terms of product quality, reliability and above all variety...
examples.translation: 我们的产品在质量、可靠性，尤其是品种方面颇具竞争力。

examples.text: Paris has played a dominant role in France, not just in political terms but also in economic power.
examples.translation: 不仅仅在政治方面，而且在经济实力上巴黎在法国也都一直处于支配地位。

examples.text: The video explains in simple terms how the new tax works...
examples.translation: 录像用简单易懂的语言解释了新税法。

examples.text: The document is expressed in terms that are readily understood and agreed.
examples.translation: 文件用语浅显易懂，让人易于接受。

examples.text: Myocardial infarction is the medical term for a heart attack.
examples.translation: 心肌梗死是心脏病的医学用语。

examples.text: He had been termed a temporary employee...
examples.translation: 他被称作临时雇员。

examples.text: He termed the war a humanitarian nightmare.
examples.translation: 他称这场战争是一场人道主义噩梦。

examples.text: ...the summer term.
examples.translation: 夏季学期

examples.text: ...the last day of term.
examples.translation: 学期最后一天

examples.text: Felipe Gonzalez won a fourth term of office in Spain's election.
examples.translation: 费利佩·冈萨雷斯在西班牙选举中获得第 4 次连任。

examples.text: ...a 12 month term of service...
examples.translation: 为期 12 个月的任职期

examples.text: Offenders will be liable to a seven-year prison term.
examples.translation: 违犯者可判处 7 年监禁。

examples.text: Premiums are guaranteed throughout the term of the policy.
examples.translation: 在保单有效期内，所缴纳的保险费是有保障的。

examples.text: That makes her the first TV presenter to work the full term of her pregnancy...
examples.translation: 那样，她就成了首个怀孕期间一直上班的电视节目主持人。

examples.text: Women over 40 seem to be just as capable of carrying a baby to term as younger women.
examples.translation: 年过 40 的女性好像和年轻女性一样能够怀孕到足月。

examples.text: ...the terms of the Helsinki agreement...
examples.translation: 《赫尔辛基协议》的条款

examples.text: Mayor Rendell imposed the new contract terms.
examples.translation: 伦德尔市长强加了新的合同条款。

examples.text: She had come to terms with the fact that her husband would always be crippled.
examples.translation: 她只好接受了丈夫将终生残疾这个现实。

examples.text: I had at last found a sport where I could compete on equal terms with able-bodied people...
examples.translation: 我终于发现了一个可以和体格健全的人平等竞争的体育项目。

examples.text: The focus was on women gaining access to work on the same terms as men.
examples.translation: 核心问题在于女性应与男性享有平等的就业机会。

examples.text: Madeleine is on good terms with Sarah...
examples.translation: 马德琳和萨拉相处很好。

examples.text: We shook hands and parted on good terms.
examples.translation: 我们握了握手，友好地告别。

examples.text: The agreement should have very positive results in the long term...
examples.translation: 从长远来看，这个协议将会产生非常积极的影响。

examples.text: In the short term, chemical sprays are clearly an effective way to control pests...
examples.translation: 从短期来看，喷洒化学药品显然能有效控制虫害。

examples.text: In the medium term the UK car industry has a brighter outlook.
examples.translation: 从中期来看，英国汽车行业前景将会更好。

examples.text: They will sign the union treaty only on their terms.
examples.translation: 只有同意他们的条件，他们才会在联盟条约上签字。

examples.text: United should be thinking in terms of winning the European Cup...
examples.translation: 联队应该在考虑要赢得欧洲杯。

examples.text: She was thinking in terms of a career.
examples.translation: 她在考虑干一番事业。

examples.text: ...terminal cancer.
examples.translation: 晚期癌症

examples.text: ...his illness was terminal.
examples.translation: 他的病没治了。

examples.text: The patient is terminally ill.
examples.translation: 那个病人患了不治之症。

examples.text: They have started a hospice for terminal patients.
examples.translation: 他们为身患绝症的病人开办了一个安养所。

examples.text: Plans are underway for a fifth terminal at Heathrow airport.
examples.translation: 正在制定在希思罗机场修建第 5 航站楼的计划。

examples.text: Carl sits at a computer terminal 40 hours a week.
examples.translation: 卡尔每周在电脑终端前坐 40 个小时。

examples.text: ...the positive terminal of the battery.
examples.translation: 电池的阳极

examples.text: Her next remark abruptly terminated the conversation...
examples.translation: 她接下来说的话使谈话戛然而止。

examples.text: His contract terminates at the end of the season.
examples.translation: 他的合同在本赛季末终止。

examples.text: ...a dispute which led to the abrupt termination of trade.
examples.translation: 导致贸易突然终止的一场争端

examples.text: After a lot of agonizing she decided to terminate the pregnancy...
examples.translation: 经历一番痛苦挣扎后，她决定终止妊娠。

examples.text: In the world as a whole, about ten per cent of all pregnancies are terminated.
examples.translation: 从全世界看来，所有怀孕的人中约 10% 的妊娠被终止了。

examples.text: You should also have a medical check-up after the termination of a pregnancy.
examples.translation: 终止妊娠后还应该体检一次。

examples.text: This train will terminate at Taunton.
examples.translation: 这列火车的终点站是汤顿。

meanings.meaning: 可怕的；很糟的；令人讨厌的

examples.text: Tens of thousands more suffered terrible injuries in the world's worst industrial disaster...
examples.translation: 还有成千上万的人在那场全世界最严重的工业灾难中受了重伤。

examples.text: I often have the most terrible nightmares...
examples.translation: 我常做很吓人的噩梦。

examples.text: Prison life, he told me, was terrible.
examples.translation: 他告诉我，监狱生活很可怕。

examples.text: My son has suffered terribly. He has lost his best friend.
examples.translation: 我儿子遭受了巨大痛苦，他失去了最要好的朋友。

examples.text: He did feel terrible at the time but seems to be fine now...
examples.translation: 他当时确实很难受，但现在似乎好了。

examples.text: Are you all right? You look terrible. Are you sick?
examples.translation: 你没事儿吧？你的脸色很难看，生病了吗？

examples.text: She admits her French is terrible.
examples.translation: 她承认自己的法语很蹩脚。

examples.text: I was a terrible fool, you know. I remember that now...
examples.translation: 你知道，我那时愚蠢至极。我至今还记得。

examples.text: Her death is a terrible waste.
examples.translation: 她死得太不值了。

examples.text: I'm terribly sorry to bother you at this hour...
examples.translation: 这个时候打搅您，我万分抱歉。

examples.text: I suffered terribly when she died.
examples.translation: 她死的时候，我伤心透了。

meanings.meaning: 极好的；极其的，非常的；可怕的

examples.text: What a terrific idea!...
examples.translation: 多么好的主意！

examples.text: Everybody there was having a terrific time...
examples.translation: 在场的每个人都玩得开心极了。

examples.text: You look terrific, Ann. You really do.
examples.translation: 安，你看起来太迷人了。真的。

examples.text: He did a terrific amount of fundraising...
examples.translation: 他做了大量的筹款工作。

examples.text: All of a sudden there was a terrific bang and a flash of smoke.
examples.translation: 突然传来惊天动地一声响，还冒出一股烟。

examples.text: She really is terrifically pretty.
examples.translation: 她真的漂亮极了。

examples.text: ...the only child of terrifically repressed parents.
examples.translation: 极度压抑的父母的独生子

examples.text: Flying terrifies him...
examples.translation: 坐飞机让他害怕得要命。

examples.text: The thought of dying slowly and painfully terrified me.
examples.translation: 缓慢而痛苦地死去的想法使我恐惧不已。

examples.text: He was terrified of heights...
examples.translation: 他恐高。

examples.text: She was terrified that Ronnie would kidnap Sam...
examples.translation: 她吓坏了，生怕龙尼会绑架萨姆。

examples.text: I'm terrified to think about the fact that my mother will die someday.
examples.translation: 一想到母亲有一天会去世，我就非常恐惧。

meanings.meaning: 领土，领域；范围；地域；版图

examples.text: The government denies that any of its territory is under rebel control.
examples.translation: 政府否认有领土被反叛分子所控制。

examples.text: ...Russian territory.
examples.translation: 俄罗斯领土

examples.text: They just want to return to their families in the occupied territories...
examples.translation: 他们只是想回到在占领区的家人身边。

examples.text: He toured some of the disputed territories now under UN control.
examples.translation: 他去一些目前由联合国接管的争议地区巡视了一番。

examples.text: Following the futuristic The Handmaid's Tale, Margaret Atwood's seventh novel, Cat's Eye, returns to more familiar territory...
examples.translation: 写完了具有未来色彩的《女仆的故事》之后，玛格丽特·阿特伍德的第七部小说《猫眼》回归到了人们较熟悉的题材上。

examples.text: Reading from a tedious technical brief for hours on end, he would stray into difficult territory.
examples.translation: 连续看上几个小时枯燥的技术简报后，他会不自觉地钻起牛角尖来。

examples.text: The territory of a cat only remains fixed for as long as the cat dominates the area.
examples.translation: 猫的地盘只在它占据那个地方的时候是固定不变的。

examples.text: ...mountainous territory.
examples.translation: 多山地带

examples.text: ...a vast and uninhabited territory.
examples.translation: 广阔的无人居住区

examples.text: Doing human rights work is risky business. That comes with the territory...
examples.translation: 做人权工作是要冒风险的。这是难免的。

examples.text: You can't expect not to have a debate; that's what comes with the territory in a democracy.
examples.translation: 不要指望不会发生辩论，那在民主社会已成为必然。

meanings.meaning: 恐怖；恐怖行动；恐怖时期；可怕的人

examples.text: I shook with terror whenever I was about to fly in an aeroplane...
examples.translation: 每次坐飞机前，我都吓得直发抖。

examples.text: The day of terror ended after police used teargas and stormed the house.
examples.translation: 警察使用了催泪瓦斯攻入屋子以后，恐惧的一天结束了。

examples.text: The bomb attack on the capital could signal the start of a pre-election terror campaign.
examples.translation: 对首都的炸弹袭击可能标志着选举前的恐怖活动开始了。

examples.text: As a boy, he had a real terror of facing people.
examples.translation: 小时候，他特别害怕见人。

examples.text: ...the terrors of violence.
examples.translation: 恐怖的暴力行为

examples.text: He was a terror. He had been a difficult child for as long as his parents could remember.
examples.translation: 他是个淘气鬼，从小就不老实。

examples.text: Childbirth now held fewer terrors for her than it once had.
examples.translation: 她现在不像原来那样害怕分娩了。

examples.text: Either measure the temperature with a bath thermometer or test the water with your wrist...
examples.translation: 要么用浴用温度计测量水温，要么用手腕试一下。

examples.text: Here the army has its ranges where Rapier missiles and other weaponry are tested...
examples.translation: 军方在这儿有发射场，“长剑”导弹等武器都在这里进行试验。

examples.text: The drug must first be tested in clinical trials to see if it works on other cancers.
examples.translation: 这种药物必须首先经过临床测试，看它是否适用于其他癌症。

examples.text: ...the banning of nuclear tests.
examples.translation: 禁止核试验

examples.text: There was a time when each teacher spent an hour, one day a week, testing pupils in every subject...
examples.translation: 曾经，每个老师每周都有一天花上一小时对学生的每门功课进行测试。

examples.text: She decided to test herself with a training run in London.
examples.translation: 她决定在伦敦对自己进行跑步训练的测试。

examples.text: Out of a total of 2,602 pupils only 922 passed the test...
examples.translation: 所有 2,602 名学生中，只有 922 名通过了测试。

examples.text: She had sold her bike, taken a driving test and bought a car.
examples.translation: 她卖了自行车，考了驾照，并买了辆汽车。

examples.text: She may be testing her mother to see how much she can take before she throws her out.
examples.translation: 她可能在试探她妈妈，看她能忍耐到什么程度才会把她撵出家门。

examples.text: It is a commonplace fact that holidays are a major test of any relationship...
examples.translation: 度假对任何恋爱关系都是重大考验，这是常识。

examples.text: The test of any civilised society is how it treats its minorities.
examples.translation: 检验一个社会是否文明的办法就是看它怎样对待其少数群体。

examples.text: My doctor wants me to be tested for diabetes...
examples.translation: 我的医生要我去做个检查，看是否患有糖尿病。

examples.text: Girls in an affected family can also be tested to see if they carry the defective gene.
examples.translation: 染病家庭的女孩们也可以检查一下，看看是否携带这种缺陷基因。

examples.text: If necessary X-rays and blood tests will also be used to aid diagnosis...
examples.translation: 如有必要，还要进行 X 光检查和验血以帮助诊断。

examples.text: The family doctor ordered numerous, expensive medical tests, which revealed no physical problem.
examples.translation: 家庭医生安排了名目繁多、收费昂贵的检查，结果没有查出任何健康问题。

examples.text: The Liverpool team are now putting their theory to the test...
examples.translation: 利物浦队此时正在验证他们的理论。

examples.text: Arriving at the railway station, I put local knowledge to the test and ask a taxi driver.
examples.translation: 到了火车站，为了检验自己对当地的了解程度，我请教了一个出租车司机。

examples.text: Sooner or later, life will put the relationship to the test.
examples.translation: 总有一天，生活会考验这种关系是否牢固。

examples.text: It says a lot for her culinary skills that so many of her recipes have stood the test of time.
examples.translation: 她的许多食谱经受住了时间的考验，这充分证明了她的厨艺。

examples.text: Several eyewitnesses testified that they saw the officers hit Miller in the face...
examples.translation: 几位目击证人证明他们看见那几个警官打了米勒的脸。

examples.text: Eva testified to having seen Herndon with his gun on the stairs...
examples.translation: 伊娃作证称看见过赫恩登持枪站在楼梯上。

examples.text: He hopes to have his 12-year prison term reduced by testifying against his former colleagues.
examples.translation: 他希望通过出庭检举从前的同事缩短自己 12 年的刑期。

examples.text: Recent excavations testify to the presence of cultivated inhabitants on the hill during the Arthurian period.
examples.translation: 最近几次发掘证实了亚瑟王时期这座山上有农耕人口居住过。

examples.text: His testimony was an important element of the Prosecution case...
examples.translation: 他的证词是这宗公诉案件中的一个重要因素。

examples.text: Prosecutors may try to determine if Robb gave false testimony when he appeared before the grand jury.
examples.translation: 检方可能要努力查证罗布在大陪审团面前是否作了伪证。

examples.text: This book is testimony to a very individual kind of courage.
examples.translation: 这本书显示了个人非凡的勇气。

examples.text: Her living room is also her office, filled with desks, books, papers, a testimony to her dedication to her work.
examples.translation: 她的客厅也是她的办公室，里面摆满了书桌、书籍和文件，充分证明了她的敬业精神。

examples.text: The text is precise and informative.
examples.translation: 正文内容准确，信息量大。

examples.text: The machine can recognise handwritten characters and turn them into printed text...
examples.translation: 这种机器能够识别手写字体，并将其转化为打印文本。

examples.text: A CD-ROM can store more than 250,000 pages of typed text.
examples.translation: 一张只读光盘能存储25万多页键入的文本。

examples.text: A spokesman said a text of Dr Runcie's speech had been circulated to all of the bishops.
examples.translation: 一位发言人说，朗西博士的演讲稿已经分发给所有主教了。

examples.text: Her text is believed to be the oldest surviving manuscript by a female physician.
examples.translation: 她的文献据信是现存最古老的、由女性内科医生留下的手稿。

examples.text: I'll read the text aloud first...
examples.translation: 我先朗读一下课文。

examples.text: His early plays are set texts in universities.
examples.translation: 他早期的戏剧作品现在是大学指定课文。

examples.text: I borrowed my wife's mobile phone last week and a text arrived from another man.
examples.translation: 我上周借我老婆的手机用，收到一个男人发来的短信。

examples.text: Mary texted me when she got home.
examples.translation: 玛丽到家后给我发了条短信。

examples.text: She wrote a textbook on international law.
examples.translation: 她写了本国际法教材。

examples.text: ...a chemistry textbook.
examples.translation: 化学课本

examples.text: The house is a textbook example of medieval domestic architecture...
examples.translation: 这所房子是典型的中世纪民居。

examples.text: France Telecom is a textbook model of what can be achieved by a state-owned company.
examples.translation: 法国电信是国有公司成功的典范。

examples.text: ...decorative textiles for the home.
examples.translation: 家用装饰织品

examples.text: ...the Scottish textile industry.
examples.translation: 苏格兰纺织业

examples.text: Another 75,000 jobs will be lost in textiles and clothing.
examples.translation: 纺织和服装业又要减少 75,000 个工作岗位。

meanings.meaning: 比（用于形容词、副词的比较级之后）；除…外（用于other等之后）；与其…（用于 rather等之后）；一…就（用于 no sooner等之后）

examples.text: The radio only weighs a few ounces and is smaller than a cigarette packet...
examples.translation: 这台收音机重量仅为几盎司，比香烟盒还小。

examples.text: Indian skins age far more slowly than American or Italian ones.
examples.translation: 印度人的皮肤比美国人或意大利人的皮肤衰老得慢得多。

examples.text: He wished he could have helped her more than he did...
examples.translation: 他真希望当初能给予她更多的帮助。

examples.text: Sometimes patients are more depressed six months later than when they first hear the bad news.
examples.translation: 有时，病人 6 个月后比最初听到坏消息时情绪更低落。

examples.text: They talked on the phone for more than an hour.
examples.translation: 他们在电话里谈了一个多小时。

examples.text: ...the three-match Test series in England, starting in less than two months time...
examples.translation: 再过不到两个月就要在英格兰开始的三场制国际板球对抗赛

examples.text: Head teachers yesterday demanded a nine per cent rise, more than twice the rate of inflation.
examples.translation: 校长们昨天要求增加 9% 的工资，这个比例是通货膨胀率的两倍多。

examples.text: The arrangement was more a formality than a genuine partnership of two nations...
examples.translation: 这一协定与其说体现了两个国家之间真正的伙伴关系，还不如说是一种形式。

examples.text: I would rather stare at a clear, star-filled sky than a TV set...
examples.translation: 我宁可凝视繁星满天的晴朗夜空也不愿盯着电视机。

examples.text: I would sooner give up sleep than miss my evening class.
examples.translation: 我宁肯不睡觉也不愿错过夜校的课。

meanings.meaning: 质地；纹理；结构；本质，实质

examples.text: Aloe Vera is used in moisturisers to give them a wonderfully silky texture...
examples.translation: 芦荟用于润肤霜中，使之具有美妙的丝般润滑感。

examples.text: Her skin is pale, the texture of fine wax.
examples.translation: 她肤色苍白，肤质细腻如蜡。

examples.text: This cheese has an open, crumbly texture with a strong flavour...
examples.translation: 这种奶酪多孔松脆，风味浓郁。

examples.text: Earthworms consume large amounts of soil, and produce a rich humus, perfect in texture.
examples.translation: 蚯蚓吃下大量土壤，排出肥力丰富、物理结构理想的腐殖质。

examples.text: The very texture of his prose bears the influence of his familiarity with drugs.
examples.translation: 他独特的散文风韵显示出他常常在毒品的影响下进行创作的痕迹。

examples.text: No matter where his business took him, he always managed to be home for Thanksgiving...
examples.translation: 不管因生意关系去了什么地方，他总要赶回家过感恩节。

examples.text: It's going to be the most magnificent Thanksgiving dinner we ever had.
examples.translation: 这将是我们参加过的最盛大的感恩节晚餐。

examples.text: Thank you very much for your call...
examples.translation: 非常感谢您的来电。

examples.text: Thanks for the information...
examples.translation: 谢谢提供这个信息。

examples.text: Oh thank you so much! They're so pretty!...
examples.translation: 哦，太感谢你了！它们真漂亮！

examples.text: Thanks a lot, Suzie. You've been great.
examples.translation: 多谢了，苏兹。你太好了。

examples.text: 'You'd like a cup as well, would you, Mr Secombe?' — 'Thank you, Jane, I'd love one.'...
examples.translation: “塞科姆先生，你也想来一杯吧？”——“谢谢，简，我确实想来一杯。”

examples.text: 'Would you like a cigarette?' — 'No thank you.'...
examples.translation: “要来支烟吗？”——“不了，谢谢。”

examples.text: 'A whisky?' — 'I'd better not, thanks.'
examples.translation: “来杯威士忌？”——“还是不要了，谢谢。”

examples.text: The policeman smiled at her. 'Pretty dog.' — 'Oh well, thank you.'...
examples.translation: 警察冲她笑了笑，“这狗真漂亮。”——“哦，谢谢。”

examples.text: 'His eyes were glassy?' — 'And dilated. They were watery.' — 'Thank you.'...
examples.translation: “他的眼神呆滞？”——“还双眼圆睁，泪汪汪的。”——“谢谢！”

examples.text: 'It's great to see you.' — 'Thanks. Same to you.'
examples.translation: “看见你很高兴。”——“谢谢，我也是。”

examples.text: I can stir my own tea, thank you...
examples.translation: 我的茶我自己会搅，谢谢。

examples.text: We know where we can get it, thank you very much.
examples.translation: 我们知道在哪儿能买到，谢谢。

examples.text: I thanked them for their long and loyal service...
examples.translation: 我感谢他们长期以来忠诚的效力。

examples.text: When the decision was read out Mrs Gardner thanked the judges.
examples.translation: 判决书宣读完，加德纳夫人向法官们表示感谢。

examples.text: They accepted their certificates with words of thanks.
examples.translation: 他们一边道谢，一边接过证书。

examples.text: We give thanks for this food.
examples.translation: 感谢上帝赐给我们食物。

examples.text: I was wrong, thank God...
examples.translation: 原来我错了，感谢上帝。

examples.text: Thank heavens we have you here.
examples.translation: 谢天谢地，我们可等到你了。

examples.text: I have her to thank for my life...
examples.translation: 我这条命多亏了她。

examples.text: For all this I have only you to thank.
examples.translation: 这一切我都得感谢你才是。

examples.text: It is thanks to this committee that many new sponsors have come forward...
examples.translation: 又有许多赞助商找上门来，这要归功于这个委员会。

examples.text: Thanks to recent research, effective treatments are available.
examples.translation: 多亏近来的研究才有了有效的疗法。

examples.text: It is no thanks to the Government that net assets did rise.
examples.translation: 净资产的确增长了，但这与政府无关。

examples.text: They said you particularly wanted to talk to me. Why was that?...
examples.translation: 他们说你特别想和我谈谈。为什么？

examples.text: 'Hey, is there anything the matter with my sisters?' — 'Is that why you're phoning?'...
examples.translation: “喂，我的姐妹们没事儿吧？”——“你打电话就为这个？”

examples.text: Some members feared Germany might raise its interest rates on Thursday. That could have set the scene for a confrontation with the US.
examples.translation: 一些成员国担心德国可能于星期四提高利率，那有可能导致其与美国发生冲突。

examples.text: The most important purpose of our Health Care is to support you when making a claim for medical treatment. For that reason the claims procedure is as simple and helpful as possible.
examples.translation: 我们的医疗保健服务最重要的目的是在您申请医疗服务时提供帮助。正因为如此，申请程序会尽可能地简单有效。

examples.text: The Commissioners get between £50,000 and 60,000 a year in various allowances. But that amount can soar to 90,000 a year...
examples.translation: 委员们每年领取的各种津贴在 5 万到 6 万英镑之间，但最高可达 9 万英镑。

examples.text: The biggest increase was on the cheapest model, the CRX-HF. That car had a 1990 base price of $9,145.
examples.translation: 涨价最快的是最便宜的车型 CRX-HF，那款车 1990 年的基价是 9,145 美元。

examples.text: The story was published in a Sunday newspaper later that week...
examples.translation: 这篇报道于那周晚些时候刊登在一份周日报纸上。

examples.text: That morning I had put on a pair of black slacks and a long-sleeved black blouse.
examples.translation: 那天早上，我穿了一条宽松的黑裤子和一件长袖黑衬衫。

examples.text: A recession like that of 1973–1974 could put one in ten American companies into bankruptcy...
examples.translation: 像 1973–1974 年间那样的经济衰退能让 1/10 的美国公司破产。

examples.text: Indoor pollution falls into two categories, that which we can see or smell, and pollution which is invisible and produces no odour.
examples.translation: 室内污染分为两种：一种是我们能看得见或闻得着的，另一种是无色无味的。

examples.text: 'She said she'd met you in England.' — 'That's true.'...
examples.translation: “她说她在英格兰见过你。”——“是的。”

examples.text: 'I've never been to Paris.' — 'That's a pity. You should go one day.'
examples.translation: “我从没去过巴黎。”——“可惜了，你什么时候应该去一次。”

examples.text: In my case I chose that course which I considered right...
examples.translation: 至于我呢，就选择了我认为正确的那条路线。

examples.text: That person who violates the law and discriminates should suffer in his career.
examples.translation: 非法歧视他人的人在事业上应该受到惩戒。

examples.text: Too much time is spent worrying over that which one can't change.

examples.translation: 小说的主题是男人和女人之间永无休止的冲突。

examples.text: This painting points to another recurring theme in Munch's work.
examples.translation: 这幅画体现了蒙克作品中另一个常见的主题。

examples.text: ...variations on themes from Mozart's The Magic Flute.
examples.translation: 莫扎特的《魔笛》中主旋律的变奏曲

examples.text: ...the theme from Dr Zhivago...
examples.translation: 电影《日瓦戈医生》的主题曲

examples.text: The BBC used Vangelis's Chariots of Fire as its Olympic theme tune in 1984.
examples.translation: BBC 选用了范吉利斯的《火战车》作为其 1984 年奥运节目的主题音乐。

meanings.meaning: 理论的；理论上的；假设的；推理的

examples.text: ...theoretical physics.
examples.translation: 理论物理学

examples.text: This is certainly a theoretical risk but in practice there is seldom a problem...
examples.translation: 从理论上讲，这肯定是有风险的，可是实际上很少出问题。

examples.text: These fears are purely theoretical.
examples.translation: 这些担忧纯粹是臆测出来的。

examples.text: Marx produced a new theory about historical change based upon conflict between competing groups...
examples.translation: 马克思创立了一种新理论，认为历史的演变是基于对立集团之间的冲突之上的。

examples.text: Einstein formulated the Theory of Relativity in 1905.
examples.translation: 爱因斯坦于 1905 年创立了相对论。

examples.text: There was a theory that he wanted to marry her...
examples.translation: 有人认为他想娶她。

examples.text: My theory about divorce is that it's not the split-up that damages children, it's how it is handled.
examples.translation: 我对离婚的看法是，伤害孩子的不是婚姻的破裂，而是处理离婚的方式。

examples.text: He taught us music theory.
examples.translation: 他教我们乐理。

examples.text: ...graduates who are well-trained in both the theory and practice of statistics.
examples.translation: 在统计学理论和实践两方面都训练有素的毕业生

examples.text: A school dental service exists in theory, but in practice, there are few dentists to work in them.
examples.translation: 照理说，学校也有牙医诊所，可实际上，里面的牙医寥寥无几。

examples.text: In therapy, she began to let go of her obsession with Mike...
examples.translation: 在接受治疗的过程中，她开始逐渐从对迈克的迷恋中解脱出来。

examples.text: He is having therapy to conquer his phobia.
examples.translation: 他在接受治疗以克服自己的恐惧症。

examples.text: ...hormonal therapies.
examples.translation: 激素疗法

examples.text: ...conventional drug therapy.
examples.translation: 常规药物疗法

meanings.meaning: 在那里；在那边；在那点上

examples.text: There are roadworks between Camblesforth and Carlton...
examples.translation: 坎布斯福斯和卡尔顿之间的道路在施工。

examples.text: Are there some countries that have been able to tackle these problems successfully?...
examples.translation: 有没有哪些国家已经能成功解决这些问题了？

examples.text: There were differences of opinion, he added, on very basic issues...
examples.translation: 他补充说，在一些非常基本的问题上存在意见分歧。

examples.text: There's nothing in this room; there's not a single chair, there's no bed, and not a single shelf...
examples.translation: 这个房间空无一物，没有椅子，没有床，连个架子都没有。

examples.text: There's no way we can afford to buy a house at the moment...
examples.translation: 眼下我们无论如何也买不起房子。

examples.text: There's no question she is the best comedienne in this country.
examples.translation: 她无疑是该国最优秀的女喜剧演员。

examples.text: There remains considerable doubt over when the intended high-speed rail link will be complete...
examples.translation: 人们对于拟建的高速铁路何时能竣工仍存有很大疑问。

examples.text: There appeared no imminent danger...
examples.translation: 看不出有什么迫在眉睫的危险。

examples.text: There rose before us the great pyramid of Gaza...
examples.translation: 雄伟的加沙金字塔矗立在我们面前。

examples.text: There developed a practice that came to a tragic and terrible end.
examples.translation: 逐渐形成了一种做法，其结局却很悲惨。

examples.text: 'Hello there,' said the woman, smiling at them. — 'Hi!' they chorused...
examples.translation: “嘿，你们好！”那个女人笑着对他们说。——“你好！”他们齐声说。

examples.text: Oh, hi there. You must be Sidney.
examples.translation: 喂，你好。你一定是西德尼吧。

examples.text: The group of old buildings on the corner by the main road is still there today...
examples.translation: 大路拐角处的古老建筑群如今还在。

examples.text: The book is there for people to read and make up their own mind...
examples.translation: 书摆在那儿，供人们阅读后再作决定。

examples.text: Nothing will be spent until he has made sure the money is there to pay for it.
examples.translation: 他在确保有钱付账之前不会花一分钱。

examples.text: The next day we drove the 33 miles to Siena (the Villa Arceno is a great place to stay while you are there) for the Palio...
examples.translation: 第二天，我们驱车 33 英里来到锡耶纳参加赛马节(此地的阿尔希诺山庄是个好地方，值得一去)。

examples.text: 'Come on over, if you want.' — 'How do I get there?'...
examples.translation: “你要想来的话，就过来吧。”——“我怎么去那里？”

examples.text: It's one hell of a train trip, about five days there and back...
examples.translation: 这趟旅行来回坐了大约 5 天火车，受的那个罪就别提了。

examples.text: What if Spain reacts to the similar economic pressures which are appearing over there?
examples.translation: 西班牙要是对类似于那里正在出现的经济压力做出反应该怎么办？

examples.text: There it is, on the corner over there...
examples.translation: 在那儿呢，在那边那个角上。

examples.text: There she is on the left up there...
examples.translation: 她在那边，左边那儿。

examples.text: The toilets are over there, dear...
examples.translation: 亲爱的，厕所在那边。

examples.text: You'll find the details there.
examples.translation: 你会在那里找到详细的信息。

examples.text: So there we were with Amy and she was driving us crazy...
examples.translation: 就这样，我们和埃米到了一起，而她快把我们逼疯了。

examples.text: I looked, and there he was, riding a horse, with a double barreled shotgun on his shoulder.
examples.translation: 我看了看，发现他在那儿，骑着马，肩上扛着一把双筒猎枪。

examples.text: Hello, is Gordon there please?
examples.translation: 喂，请问戈登在吗？

examples.text: Death is terrible. I agree with you there...
examples.translation: 死亡很可怕。这点我同意你的观点。

examples.text: I think you're right there John...
examples.translation: 约翰，我觉得你这点说对了。

examples.text: Can I just stop you there sir?...
examples.translation: 老师，我能不能在这里打断您一下？

examples.text: If you'll excuse me, ladies and gentlemen, we'd better leave it there.
examples.translation: 对不起，女士们，先生们，我们还是不要再讨论这个了。

examples.text: We are making further investigations and will take the matter from there...
examples.translation: 我们正在进一步调查，将从那儿入手。

examples.text: And there we end this edition of Science in Action...
examples.translation: 本期《科学在行动》到这里就结束了。

examples.text: And there we have a question that most women would find uncomfortable to answer. Do we really want the men to be at home?
examples.translation: 这里有个多数女性不愿回答的问题：你们真的希望男性待在家吗？

examples.text: We had hoped to fill the back page with extra news; we're not quite there yet...
examples.translation: 我们本来希望补充一些新闻把最后一版填满，可是现在差得还很远。

examples.text: Life has not yet returned to normal but we are getting there.
examples.translation: 生活还没有恢复正常，不过就快了。

examples.text: I'm the oldest and, according to all the books, should be the achiever, but there you go...
examples.translation: 我岁数最大，无论怎么说，都应该有所成就了，可是你看看我这个样子。

examples.text: It's the wages that count. Not over-generous, but there you are...
examples.translation: 重要的是工钱，不要过于慷慨，但也没办法。

examples.text: 'They didn't seem to know anything about it.' — 'Oh well there we are.'
examples.translation: “他们好像对此一无所知。”——“嗯，有什么办法呢。”

examples.text: You see? There you go. That's why I didn't mention it earlier. I knew you'd take it the wrong way...
examples.translation: 你看，我说的没错吧？这就是为什么我早没提。我就知道你会误解。

examples.text: 'There you are, you see!' she exclaimed. 'I knew you'd say that!'...
examples.translation: “你看看，我说对了吧！”她叫道，“我就知道你要那么说。”

examples.text: Victoria Street, that's the name of the street. There we are, look.
examples.translation: 维多利亚大街，那条街就叫这个名字。看，我说的没错吧！

examples.text: At 18 stone, I can't run around the way I used to. There again, some people say I never did...
examples.translation: 我现在体重18英石，不能像从前那样跑来跑去了;不过有人说我以前就跑不动。

examples.text: I mean small cars are the answer surely. Or there again a good system of public transport might do the same thing.
examples.translation: 我是说小汽车肯定是解决之道，不过良好的公交系统或许也能解决问题。

examples.text: 'There you go again, upsetting the child!' said Shirley...
examples.translation: “瞧，又来了不是？又惹孩子伤心！”雪莉说。

examples.text: 'There you go again, Dad, with your silly words.' — 'Sorry, son.'...
examples.translation: “爸爸，又来了吧，又说傻话了。”——“对不起，儿子。”

examples.text: Careful, there I go again, getting sentimental.
examples.translation: 看看，我又来了，又开始多愁善感了。

examples.text: 'Take That' are the best group in the whole world. So there...
examples.translation: “接招”乐队是世界上最好的组合，就是这样的。

examples.text: I think that's sweet, so there.
examples.translation: 我看那样很好，就这么定了。

examples.text: Many felt that he should have resigned there and then...
examples.translation: 许多人觉得他应该当场辞职。

examples.text: There and then he made his decision...
examples.translation: 他当时就做出了决定。

examples.text: A friend of Pip's invited them then and there to his college ball that night.
examples.translation: 皮普的一个朋友当时就邀请他们参加他当晚的大学舞会。

examples.text: 'There, there,' said Mum. 'You've been having a really bad dream.'
examples.translation: “好了，好了，”妈妈说，“你只是做了一个很可怕的噩梦。”

examples.text: Nora picked up the boy, and gave him a biscuit. 'There you are, Lennie, you take the nice biscuit.'
examples.translation: 诺拉抱起那个男孩，给他一块饼干，说：“伦尼，给，拿着这块好吃的饼干。”

examples.text: Despite what happened in the past I want her to know I am there for her.
examples.translation: 无论过去发生过什么，我希望她知道，我是支持她的。

examples.text: Inflation will fall and thereafter so will interest rates...
examples.translation: 通货膨胀率将下跌，随后利率也将下降。

examples.text: It was the only time she had ever discouraged him from dangerous activities and she regretted it thereafter.
examples.translation: 那是她唯一一次劝他不要参加危险活动，说完以后她就后悔了。

meanings.meaning: 从而，因此；在那附近；在那方面

examples.text: Our bodies can sweat, thereby losing heat by evaporation...
examples.translation: 我们的身体能出汗，由此可以蒸发散热。

examples.text: A firm might sometimes sell at a loss to drive a competitor out of business, and thereby increase its market power.
examples.translation: 公司有时会通过亏本出售来将对手挤垮，从而提高其市场地位。

examples.text: Muscle cells need lots of fuel and therefore burn lots of calories...
examples.translation: 肌肉细胞需要很多能量，所以会燃烧大量卡路里。

examples.text: Nothing was to prevent him now from becoming the richest, and therefore the happiest, man in the world.
examples.translation: 现在什么也阻挡不了他成为世上最富有因而也是最幸福的人。

examples.text: ...thermal power stations.
examples.translation: 热电厂

examples.text: ...financial assistance with repair, thermal insulation and improvements to homes through Government grants.
examples.translation: 政府拨款供修缮、隔热和房屋改造之用的经济援助

examples.text: Volcanic activity has created thermal springs and boiling mud pools.
examples.translation: 火山活动产生了温泉和沸腾的泥浆池。

examples.text: My feet were like blocks of ice despite the thermal socks...
examples.translation: 虽然穿了保暖袜子，我的双脚还是像冰块一样。

examples.text: I put on my thermal leggings, long socks and the rest of my clothes.
examples.translation: 我穿上保暖紧身裤、长袜和其他衣服。

examples.text: Have you got your thermals on?
examples.translation: 你穿保暖衣了吗？

examples.text: Birds use thermals to lift them through the air.
examples.translation: 鸟类利用上升热气流升入空中。

examples.text: Recently, the thermometer had topped out at a hundred and nine in the valley.
Switch to an interest-paying current account and stay in credit. Most banks and larger building societies now offer these accounts...
examples.translation: 转成付息的活期存款账户，并保持账上有余额。多数银行和较大的购房互助会现在都能开立这种账户。

examples.text: A steering committee has been formed. These people can make decisions in ten minutes which would usually take us months.
examples.translation: 已经成立了一个指导委员会。我们通常要几个月才能决定的事，这些人在 10 分钟内就能作出决定。

examples.text: AIDS kills mostly the young population of a nation. These are the people who contribute most to a country's economic development.
examples.translation: 死于艾滋病的主要是一个国家的年轻人，而正是这些人对国家经济发展贡献最大。

examples.text: Your camcorder should have these basic features: autofocus, playback facility, zoom lens...
examples.translation: 你的便携式摄像机应该具备以下基本功能：自动聚焦、回放功能、变焦镜头。

examples.text: If you're converting your loft, these addresses will be useful.
examples.translation: 你要是打算改造阁楼，这些地址会派上用场。

examples.text: Look after yourself properly while you are pregnant. These are some of the things you can do for yourself.
examples.translation: 怀孕期间要小心照顾自己的身体，以下这些事情是你自己能做的。

examples.text: I was on my own and these fellows came along towards me...
examples.translation: 我正一个人走着，一些家伙朝我走过来。

examples.text: She used to make all these chocolate puddle puddings, you know, with the sauce underneath and all this sort of thing.
examples.translation: 她过去喜欢做巧克力夹心布丁，你知道吧，就是里面有巧克力酱之类的东西的。

examples.text: These are my children.
examples.translation: 这些都是我的孩子。

examples.text: What I try to do in putting these pictures up here is to show how varied children are in solving the problem...
examples.translation: 我把这些图片挂在这儿的目的是想展示一下孩子们解决这个问题的方法是多么千差万别。

examples.text: These scissors are awfully heavy.
examples.translation: 这把剪刀重得要命。

examples.text: These are the people who are doing our loft conversion for us...
examples.translation: 就是这些人在为我们改造阁楼。

examples.text: These are my favourite biscuits.
examples.translation: 这些是我最喜欢吃的饼干。

examples.text: You know these last few months when we've been expecting it to warm up a little bit?...
examples.translation: 你知道最近这几个月我们一直盼望着天能暖和一点吧？

examples.text: You know these funny cigarettes I smoke?
examples.translation: 你了解我抽的这些味道怪异的香烟吧？

examples.text: Living in Bootham these days can be depressing...
examples.translation: 如今住在布萨姆会让人心情抑郁。

examples.text: Trying to make it as a single parent raising your children would be the main concern to me these days.
examples.translation: 我现在最关心的事情就是作为一个单亲家长，努力把自己的孩子抚养长大。

examples.text: This thesis does not stand up to close inspection.
examples.translation: 这个命题经不起仔细推敲。

examples.text: ...proponents of the thesis that computers can be programmed to do anything which a human mind does.
examples.translation: 对电脑经过程序设计可完成人脑一切活动这一观点表示支持的人

examples.text: He was awarded his PhD for a thesis on industrial robots.
examples.translation: 他凭一篇研究工业机器人的论文获得博士学位。

examples.text: The two men were far more alike than they would ever admit...
examples.translation: 那两个人也许不承认，可他们非常相像。

examples.text: People matter because of what they are, not what they have...
examples.translation: 人之所以重要，不在于他们拥有什么，而在于他们是什么样的人。

examples.text: The young horses broke in a pack, and over the first furlong, they remained in a pack.
examples.translation: 几匹小马一起冲出，跑完头一弗隆后还没拉开距离。

examples.text: The teacher is not responsible for the student's success or failure. They are only there to help the student learn...
examples.translation: 教师对学生的成败并不负有责任，其职责只是帮助学生学习。

examples.text: I never saw anyone go in to buy. Whether they ever did I don't know.
examples.translation: 我从未见过有人进去买东西。到底有没有人进去过，我不知道。

examples.text: They say there's plenty of opportunities out there, you just have to look carefully and you'll find them...
examples.translation: 他们说，那里机会多的是，你只要仔细找就能发现。

examples.text: In Australia I believe that they call it animal magnetism.
examples.translation: 我相信，在澳大利亚，他们称之为动物磁性。

meanings.meaning: 最拥挤部分；活动最多部分；事物的粗大浓密部分

examples.text: For breakfast I had a thick slice of bread and syrup...
examples.translation: 早餐我吃了一片厚厚的涂了糖浆的面包。

examples.text: He wore glasses with thick rims...
examples.translation: 他戴了一副厚框眼镜。

examples.text: This material is very thick and this needle is not strong enough to go through it.
examples.translation: 这种料子很厚，这根针都扎不透。

examples.text: An old man sat in a great carved armchair of black wood, thickly padded with soft cushions...
examples.translation: 一个老人坐在一把精雕的黑檀木扶手椅上，椅子上铺了厚厚的软垫。

examples.text: Slice the meat thickly.
examples.translation: 把肉切成厚片。

examples.text: The folder was two inches thick...
examples.translation: 那个文件夹有两英寸厚。

examples.text: How thick are these walls?
examples.translation: 这些墙有多厚？

examples.text: ...a finger as thick as a sausage.
examples.translation: 和香肠一样粗的手指

examples.text: His life was saved by a quarter-inch-thick bullet-proof steel screen.
examples.translation: 多亏一块 1/4 英寸厚的防弹钢板，他才捡了条命。

examples.text: The size of the fish will determine the thickness of the steaks...
examples.translation: 鱼的大小决定鱼排的厚度。

examples.text: The egg had a shell thickness of 0.14mm and the newly-hatched chick weighed nine grams.
examples.translation: 那只蛋的壳厚 0.14 毫米，新孵出的雏鸟重 9 克。

examples.text: ...a layer of gases about 200 miles in thickness.
examples.translation: 厚约 200 英里的大气层

examples.text: She inherited our father's thick, wavy hair...
examples.translation: 她继承了我们父亲那头浓密的卷发。

examples.text: They walked through thick forest.
examples.translation: 他们徒步穿越了茂密的森林。

examples.text: I rounded a bend where the trees and brush grew thickly...
examples.translation: 我绕过一个林木茂盛的弯。

examples.text: The interior flatlands and valleys are thickly planted with coconuts.
examples.translation: 内陆的平地和山谷中种着茂密的椰子树。

examples.text: The air is thick with acrid smoke from the fires...
examples.translation: 空气中弥漫着火灾产生的刺鼻浓烟。

examples.text: She ate scones thick with butter.
examples.translation: 她吃了一些涂满了黄油的烤饼。

examples.text: In the winter she wears thick socks, Wellington boots and gloves...
examples.translation: 冬天，她穿着厚袜子和橡胶雨靴，戴着手套。

examples.text: She wore a thick tartan skirt and a red cashmere sweater.
examples.translation: 她穿了一条厚厚的格子呢裙和一件红色羊绒衫。

examples.text: The smoke was bluish-black and thick...
examples.translation: 那烟黑中带蓝，而且很浓。

examples.text: It wasn't very thick fog.
examples.translation: 雾不算很浓。

examples.text: They had to battle through thick mud to reach construction workers...
examples.translation: 他们只好挣扎着穿过厚厚的泥巴去找建筑工人。

examples.text: The sauce is thick and rich so don't bother trying to diet.
examples.translation: 这个酱汁又浓又香，别费劲节食了。

examples.text: When he spoke his voice was thick with bitterness.
examples.translation: 他说话时，声音低沉，充满痛苦。

examples.text: 'It's all my fault,' he mumbled thickly.
examples.translation: “全都怪我，”他咕哝道。

examples.text: He answered our questions in English but with a thick accent...
examples.translation: 他用英语回答了我们的问题，不过口音很重。

examples.text: 'What do you want?' a teenage girl demanded in a thick German accent.
examples.translation: “你想要什么？”一个十几岁少女操着一口浓重的德国口音问道。

examples.text: How could she have been so thick?
examples.translation: 她怎么能蠢到那个地步？

examples.text: The rumours have been coming thick and fast...
examples.translation: 谣言接二连三地传来。

examples.text: Distress calls were pouring in thick and fast from all over the area.
examples.translation: 求救电话从该地区各地蜂拥而至。

examples.text: I enjoy being in the thick of things...
examples.translation: 我喜欢全身心投入到事情当中。

examples.text: Peterson suddenly found himself in the thick of desperate fighting.
examples.translation: 彼得森突然发现自己身陷一场殊死搏斗中。

examples.text: She'd stuck by Bob through thick and thin...
examples.translation: 她对鲍勃不离不弃，甘苦与共。

examples.text: I will go on loving James through thick and thin no matter what happens.
examples.translation: 不管发生什么，不管经历多少艰辛，我都会一直爱着詹姆斯。

examples.text: The thieves snatched the camera.
examples.translation: 窃贼偷走了相机。

examples.text: ...car thieves.
examples.translation: 偷车贼

examples.text: Finkelstein was wounded in right thigh and shin and is listed in good condition.

meanings.meaning: 薄的；瘦的；稀薄的；微弱的

examples.text: A thin cable carries the signal to a computer...
examples.translation: 一根细电缆将信号传送给一台计算机。

examples.text: James's face was thin, finely boned, and sensitive.
examples.translation: 詹姆斯面部瘦削，轮廓分明，容易过敏。

examples.text: He was a tall, thin man with grey hair...
examples.translation: 他是个瘦高个，头发灰白。

examples.text: He is small and very thin and has pale-white skin.
examples.translation: 他个头瘦小，肤色苍白。

examples.text: There was something familiar about him, his fawn raincoat, his thinness, the way he moved.
examples.translation: 他有点眼熟——浅黄褐色雨衣，瘦削的身影，走路的姿态。

examples.text: ...a small, blue-bound book printed in fine type on thin paper...
examples.translation: 一本用纸轻薄、字体精细的蓝皮小书

examples.text: A thin layer of topsoil was swept away.
examples.translation: 薄薄的一层表土被冲走了。

examples.text: Peel and thinly slice the onion...
examples.translation: 剥掉洋葱皮，然后切成薄片。

examples.text: Roll the pasta out as thinly as possible.
examples.translation: 把面团擀开，擀得越薄越好。

examples.text: The soup was thin and clear, yet mysteriously rich...
examples.translation: 汤又稀又清，味道却出奇地浓。

examples.text: They are stirring huge pots of rice and thin vegetable soup over a fire made of charcoal.
examples.translation: 他们搅动着架在木炭火堆上的大罐米饭和蔬菜清汤。

examples.text: The crowd, which had been thin for the first half of the race, had now grown considerably.
examples.translation: 比赛前半段观众还稀稀拉拉的，这时明显增多了。

examples.text: The island is thinly populated.
examples.translation: 这个岛上人烟稀少。

examples.text: ...thinly attended meetings.
examples.translation: 与会者寥寥无几的会议

examples.text: All she could manage was a thin, wan smile.
examples.translation: 她极力挤出了一丝勉强的苦笑。

examples.text: Wilson smiled thinly. 'We have decided to name the new Home after Councillor Minford.'
examples.translation: 威尔逊淡淡一笑，“我们已经决定以市政议员明福德的名字给这个新疗养院命名。”

examples.text: Her gown was thin, and she shivered, partly from cold.
examples.translation: 她的礼服很薄，浑身在发抖，一半是冻的。

examples.text: Mrs Brown wrapped the thinly clad man in her fur coat.
examples.translation: 布朗夫人用自己的皮大衣把那个衣衫单薄的男子裹住。

examples.text: However, the evidence is thin and, to some extent, ambiguous...
examples.translation: 然而，这个证据难以令人信服，而且有点模棱两可。

examples.text: Even if the optimists' theory is true, it still seems a thin argument against reform.
examples.translation: 就算乐观主义者的理论是对的，还是不足以阻止改革的进行。

examples.text: Much of the speech was a thinly disguised attack on the management of the company.
examples.translation: 讲话内容大多是对公司管理层几乎不加掩饰的抨击。

examples.text: ...a series of what correspondents describe as thinly veiled threats to use force.
examples.translation: 一系列被记者们描述为几乎公开表明要诉诸武力的威胁

examples.text: Her thin voice rose high in complaint.
examples.translation: 她抱怨时抬高了尖细的嗓音。

examples.text: She had pale thin yellow hair she pulled back into a bun.
examples.translation: 她把一头稀疏的浅黄色头发向后梳，挽成了个圆髻。

examples.text: It would have been better to have thinned the trees over several winters rather than all at one time...
examples.translation: 当初要是分几个冬天疏剪树木，会比一下子疏剪完效果好。

examples.text: By midnight the crowd had thinned.
examples.translation: 半夜时分，人群渐渐散去了。

examples.text: NATO will continue to thin out its forces...
examples.translation: 北约将继续缩减兵力。

examples.text: When the crowd began to thin out, I realized that most of the food was still there...
examples.translation: 人群渐渐散去的时候，我意识到大多数食物基本没人动过。

examples.text: Further up the river, the vineyards start to thin out and the orange groves and almond trees take over.
examples.translation: 继续溯流而上，葡萄园开始淡去，柑橘园和杏树多了起来。

examples.text: It may be necessary to thin the sauce slightly...
examples.translation: 可能有必要将酱汁稍稍稀释一下。

examples.text: Aspirin thins the blood, letting it flow more easily through narrowed blood vessels.
examples.translation: 阿司匹林可以稀释血液，使其在变窄的血管里更顺畅地流动。

examples.text: Thin down your mayonnaise with soured cream or natural yoghurt.
examples.translation: 用酸奶油或原味酸奶稀释蛋黄酱。

examples.text: ...an oil-based paint that was thinned down with white spirit.
examples.translation: 用石油溶剂油稀释了的油性油漆

examples.text: His hair is thinning and his skin has lost all hint of youth.
examples.translation: 他的头发开始脱落，皮肤也老化了。

examples.text: Parliament has not yet begun to combat the deepening economic crisis, and public patience is wearing thin.
examples.translation: 议会还没有着手应对日益严重的经济危机，公众日渐失去了耐心。

examples.text: 'What's that thing in the middle of the fountain?' — 'Some kind of statue, I guess.'...
examples.translation: “喷泉中间的那个是什么东西？”——“估计是塑像什么的吧。”

examples.text: She was in the middle of clearing the breakfast things...
examples.translation: 她正在忙着收拾早饭后的那一摊子。

examples.text: If you could change one thing about yourself, what would it be?...
examples.translation: 如果你能够改变自己的某个方面，那会是哪个方面呢？

examples.text: A strange thing happened...
examples.translation: 发生了一件怪事儿。

examples.text: We get blamed for all kinds of things.
examples.translation: 什么事儿都怪在我们头上。

examples.text: These are genetic disorders that only affect males normally. They are things like muscular dystrophy and haemophilia...
examples.translation: 这些遗传病通常只发生在男性身上，如肌肉萎缩、血友病等。

examples.text: The Earth is made mainly of iron and silicon and things like that...
examples.translation: 地球主要由铁、硅等物质构成。

examples.text: Big things, such as hospitals and social security, are paid for by the Government...
examples.translation: 医疗和社会保障之类的大型项目是由政府支付。

examples.text: You can spot them fairly easily because of their short haircuts and things.
examples.translation: 你可以根据他们的短发之类的特征轻易找出他们。

examples.text: Of course, literacy isn't the same thing as intelligence...
examples.translation: 当然，识字和智力是两码事。

examples.text: To be a parent is a terribly difficult thing...
examples.translation: 为人父母真难啊。

examples.text: Perhaps it's a good thing that Dizzy retired.
examples.translation: 迪齐退休或许是件好事。

examples.text: It isn't going to solve a single thing...
examples.translation: 这什么问题也解决不了。

examples.text: Don't you worry about a thing...
examples.translation: 你什么也不必担心。

examples.text: 'It's all here,' she said. 'Every damn thing.'
examples.translation: “都在这儿了，”她说，“所有的破玩意儿。”

examples.text: I don't believe he would tell Leo such a thing...
examples.translation: 我不信他会告诉利奥这种事。

examples.text: 'Are you accusing me of being a thief?' — 'I have done no such thing, Tony.'...
examples.translation: “你在指责我是小偷吗？”——“我没有做过这种事，托尼。”

examples.text: How do you actually go about discovering a thing like that?...
examples.translation: 你到底是怎么发现这种东西的？

examples.text: I'm trying to cope. These things happen. You have to cope.
examples.translation: 我在想法处理。这种事难免发生，只能想办法处理。

examples.text: I'm a bit unsettled tonight. This war thing's upsetting me...
examples.translation: 我今晚有点心神不定，这场争斗让我不安。

examples.text: These folks clearly take this ballroom thing very seriously.
examples.translation: 这些家伙显然很拿舞厅这事当回事。

examples.text: ...the man who had spoken dismissively of the 'vision thing' when running for the presidency in 1988.
examples.translation: 1988 年竞选总统时不以为然地谈到“那种虚幻的东西”的那个人

examples.text: She'd actually taken it home and she put it in this jar thing...
examples.translation: 她确实把它拿回了家，放在了一个罐子模样的东西里。

examples.text: The captain of the submarine has got this periscope thing.
