examples.translation: 那个潜艇艇长有个类似于潜望镜之类的东西。

examples.text: One thing I am sure of was that she was scared...
examples.translation: 有一点我能肯定，那就是她当时被吓到了。

examples.text: The first thing parents want to know is: will the baby survive?...
examples.translation: 父母亲最想知道的是：孩子能活下来吗？

examples.text: The funny thing is that the rest of us have known that for years...
examples.translation: 滑稽的是，那个情况我们其余的人很多年以前就知道了。

examples.text: The most important thing to remember about fish is to buy it really fresh.
examples.translation: 买鱼最要紧的是要买活蹦乱跳的。

examples.text: Getting drunk is a thing all young men do...
examples.translation: 喝醉酒这种情况小伙子都会有。

examples.text: I never wanted to be normal. It was not a thing I ever thought desirable...
examples.translation: 我从来也没有想要正常过。那不是我想做的事。

examples.text: The Captain stretched his left leg on one of the empty chairs. He knew it was not a polite thing to do.
examples.translation: 上尉把左腿架在了一把空椅子上。他知道这样做并不礼貌。

examples.text: It's not a thing, Beauchamp. It's a human being!
examples.translation: 比彻姆，那不是一件东西，是一个人！

examples.text: This thing's virtually useless...
examples.translation: 这玩意儿简直一点用也没有。

examples.text: They're armed with sub-machine-guns or machine-pistols or whatever you call those things...
examples.translation: 他们持有轻机枪或者冲锋枪，还是什么玩意儿的。

examples.text: Turn that thing off!
examples.translation: 把那东西关掉！

examples.text: You really are quite a clever little thing...
examples.translation: 你真是个聪明的小家伙。

examples.text: Oh you lucky thing!
examples.translation: 你这个走运的家伙！

examples.text: Sara told him to take all his things and not to return...
examples.translation: 萨拉叫他带着他的全部家当离开，再也别回来。

examples.text: Is there anything you'd like to borrow, before your own things are unpacked?
examples.translation: 你在打开行李之前还要借什么东西吗？

examples.text: Everyone agrees things are getting better...
examples.translation: 大家都认为，情况正在好转。

examples.text: A change of ownership might improve things...
examples.translation: 改变所有权也许能使情况改善。

examples.text: How are things going?
examples.translation: 日子过得怎么样？

examples.text: ...a movement away from the things of this world to the things of the spirit...
examples.translation: 出世超凡

examples.text: I think I'm more aware now of some spiritual things and I do believe in good and evil.
examples.translation: 我觉得我现在更加注重精神生活，而且我真的相信善恶报应。

examples.text: ...John W. Campbell, author of 'The Thing From Another World.'
examples.translation: 约翰·W.坎贝尔，《外星来客》的作者

examples.text: I feel under pressure to go out and get drunk because it's the thing to do...
examples.translation: 我感觉不得不出去喝他个一醉方休，因为流行这样。

examples.text: They were obviously of the opinion that his taste was not quite the thing.
examples.translation: 他们显然认为他的品味已不太流行。

examples.text: Sara wished Franklin to follow family tradition, in this as in all things.
examples.translation: 萨拉希望富兰克林在这件事上和所有其他事情一样，能遵循家庭传统。

examples.text: ...the old rule of health, which prescribes moderation in all things.
examples.translation: 提倡凡事适可而止的传统养生之道

examples.text: I realised I had a big problem. I wanted to be all things to all people...
examples.translation: 我意识到我有个大毛病，我总想不得罪任何人。

examples.text: The film tries to be all things to all men — comedy, romance, fantasy, and satire.
examples.translation: 这部电影试图面面俱到——既是喜剧、爱情剧、梦幻剧，还想是讽刺剧。

examples.text: People want to do the right thing and buy 'green'...
examples.translation: 人们想要做正确的事，于是购买“绿色”产品。

examples.text: Carrington did the honourable thing and resigned...
examples.translation: 卡林顿作出了令人敬佩的举动，辞了职。

examples.text: I think I did the wrong thing.
examples.translation: 我想我做错了。

examples.text: It was not the done thing. In those days the man was supposed to be the provider.
examples.translation: 那不符合社会习俗。在那个年代，养家的应该是男人。

examples.text: I'll go see her, first thing...
examples.translation: 我一早就去看她。

examples.text: Take the money to your office without fail, first thing in the morning...
examples.translation: 早上第一件事是一定要把钱拿到办公室去。

examples.text: I always do it last thing on a Saturday...
examples.translation: 这件事我总是放在星期六晚上睡觉前做。

examples.text: Last thing at night, he thought of her.
examples.translation: 晚上临睡前，他想起了她。

examples.text: I had always had a thing about red hair...
examples.translation: 我一直很讨厌红头发。

examples.text: He's got this thing about ties.
examples.translation: 他对领带很在意。

examples.text: Can you tell me whether it is a good thing to prune an apple tree?...
examples.translation: 你能否告诉我该不该修剪苹果树？

examples.text: In a new democracy, it is no bad thing to master the art of compromise...
examples.translation: 在新的民主国家，掌握妥协这门艺术不是件坏事。

examples.text: It is a terrible thing to doubt someone you have trusted all your life.
examples.translation: 怀疑你信任了一辈子的人是很叫人痛心的事。

examples.text: Gossips made a big thing about him going on shopping trips with her...
examples.translation: 风言风语把他和她出去购物这件事闹得沸沸扬扬。

examples.text: I took his hand to make a big thing of introducing him to my mother...
examples.translation: 我拉着他的手，郑重其事地把他介绍给了我母亲。

examples.text: I didn't have time to tell you, and anyway, I didn't want to make a big thing out of it.
examples.translation: 我当时没有时间对你讲，再说了，我也不想把这事闹大。

examples.text: It was one thing to talk about leaving; it was another to physically walk out the door...
examples.translation: 说走容易，真要抬腿跨出门可就难了。

examples.text: Borrowing $100,000 is one thing. Owing $425,000 is another!
examples.translation: 借 10 万美元事儿小，欠 42.5 万美元这事可就大了。

examples.text: She was a monster. For one thing, she really enjoyed cruelty...
examples.translation: 她是个恶魔。一方面，她确实以残忍为乐。

examples.text: She was unable to sell it, because for one thing its size was awkward...
examples.translation: 她卖不掉它，一来是由于尺寸用起来不方便。

examples.text: 'How have the sanctions affected your life in Belgrade?' — 'Well, for one thing, we already have shortages.'
examples.translation: “制裁措施对于你在贝尔格莱德的生活有多大影响？”——“嗯，首先，我们已经缺乏物资。”

examples.text: What with one thing and another, it was fairly late in the day when we returned to Shrewsbury...
examples.translation: 忙完这个又忙那个，等到我们回到什鲁斯伯里的时候，天色已经很晚了。

examples.text: Everybody came in with their Christmas order for beer and spirits and port and one thing and another.
examples.translation: 每位来客都要为圣诞节订购啤酒、烈酒、波尔图葡萄酒等这样那样的酒。

examples.text: 'I wonder why.' Mr. Dambar shrugged. 'It must be just one of those things, I guess.'
examples.translation: “我也不知道为啥，”丹巴先生耸了耸肩，“我想可能是赶巧了吧。”

examples.text: It was simply one of those things, pure coincidence.
examples.translation: 这是没办法的事，纯属巧合。

examples.text: He came by on Saturday to see if she was lonely. One thing led to another and he stayed the night.
examples.translation: 他星期六过来看看她是不是感到孤独。自然而然地，他就留下来过夜了。

examples.text: We accept the right of all men and women to do their own thing, however bizarre...
examples.translation: 我们承认所有人——无论男女——都有权以自己的方式去生活，不管其方式有多么怪异离奇。

examples.text: She was allowed to do her own thing as long as she kept in touch by phone.
examples.translation: 只要她保持电话联系，她就可以随心所欲地生活。

examples.text: Painful typhoid injections are a thing of the past, thanks to the introduction of an oral vaccine...
examples.translation: 自从发明了口服疫苗后，令人痛苦的伤寒疫苗注射就成为了过去。

examples.text: Cheap computers, faxes and phone calls will make commuting to work a thing of the past.
examples.translation: 廉价的电脑、传真和电话通信将使每天坐车上下班成为历史。

examples.text: Dr Payne led Lana back into the examination room and told her she was seeing things...
examples.translation: 佩恩大夫把拉娜领回检查室，告诉她她有幻视。

examples.text: I thought I was hearing things yesterday. I thought I heard a cuckoo.
examples.translation: 我想昨天我出现幻听了。我以为听到了布谷鸟叫。

examples.text: There really is no such thing as a totally risk-free industry...
examples.translation: 完全没有风险的行业是不存在的。

examples.text: 'I found a mermaid.' — 'Don't be daft. There's no such thing.'
examples.translation: “我发现了一条美人鱼。”——“别说傻话了。哪有那种东西。”

examples.text: 'What does your market research consist of?' — 'Well, the thing is, it depends on our target age group.'...
examples.translation: “你的市场调查有哪些内容？”“嗯，这个嘛，要视我们的目标年龄群体而定。”

examples.text: I'm getting a grant for a speech therapy course. But the thing is, I don't know whether I want to do it any more.
examples.translation: 我要弄到开设言语治疗课程的经费了。但问题是，我不知道自己是否还想做下去。

examples.text: Kiwi fruit are just the thing for a healthy snack...
examples.translation: 猕猴桃正是健康的小点心。

examples.text: I know the very thing to cheer you up.
examples.translation: 我知道什么能让你提起精神。

examples.text: Patricia Hewitt knows a thing or two about how to be well-organised...
examples.translation: 帕特里夏·休伊特很了解如何做到有条不紊。

examples.text: They do agree Africa could teach America a thing or two about family values...
examples.translation: 他们一致认为，在家庭价值方面，非洲可以教给美洲很多。

examples.text: The peace movement has learnt a thing or two from Vietnam.
examples.translation: 和平运动从越南学到了不少东西。

examples.text: I certainly think there should be a ban on tobacco advertising...
examples.translation: 我确实认为应该禁止香烟广告。

examples.text: Do you think I ought to seal the boxes up?...
examples.translation: 你认为我应该把这些盒子封起来吗？

examples.text: A generation ago, it was thought that babies born this small could not survive...
examples.translation: 20多年前，人们认为这么大点儿的新生儿是活不下来的。

examples.text: Tell me, what do you think of my theory?...
examples.translation: 你说说，我的理论怎么样？

examples.text: Peter is useless, far worse than I thought...
examples.translation: 彼得真没用，比我想象的还要差。

examples.text: He manages a good deal better than I thought possible...
examples.translation: 他处理得比我预想的要好多了。

examples.text: 'It ought to be stopped.' — 'Yes, I think so.'
examples.translation: “这件事应该到此为止。”——“对，我也这么想。”

examples.text: Nora thought he was seventeen years old...
examples.translation: 诺拉觉得他有 17 岁。

examples.text: Do you think she was embarrassed about it?...
examples.translation: 你觉得她曾为此而难为情吗？

examples.text: She's in Napa, I think...
examples.translation: 我觉得她现在在纳帕。

examples.text: The storm is thought to be responsible for as many as four deaths...
examples.translation: 据认为，暴风雨造成 4 人死亡。

examples.text: 'Did Mr Stevens ever mention her to you?' — 'No, I don't think so.'
examples.translation: “史蒂文斯先生有对你提起过她吗？”——“没，我想没有。”

examples.text: You were probably brought up to think like that...
examples.translation: 你可能从小就被教育那样考虑问题。

examples.text: He can keep matters under control by silencing the demonstrators and others who think like them...
examples.translation: 他可以通过压制示威者和与他们观点相同的人来控制住事态。

examples.text: If you think as I do, vote as I do...
examples.translation: 你要是和我想法一样，那就和我投一样的票吧。

examples.text: I don't blame you for thinking that way.
examples.translation: 你那样想，我不怪你。

examples.text: She closed her eyes for a moment, trying to think...
examples.translation: 她闭了一会儿眼睛，努力思考着。

examples.text: I have often thought about this problem...
examples.translation: 我常考虑这个问题。

examples.text: Next time you have a problem, think about how you can improve the situation instead of dwelling on all the negative aspects...
examples.translation: 下次再碰到问题，想想怎样改善局势，而不是一味考虑那些消极的方面。

examples.text: Let's think what we can do...
examples.translation: 我们想想看能做些什么。

examples.text: We had to think what to do next.
examples.translation: 我们必须考虑下一步该怎么办。

examples.text: I'll have a think about that.
examples.translation: 我会考虑那件事的。

examples.text: To make the computer work at full capacity, the programmer has to think like the machine...
examples.translation: 为了让计算机充分发挥作用，程序员就得像计算机一样思考。

examples.text: I meet many businessmen, and I see they think in terms of the overall picture...
examples.translation: 我认识许多商人，我发觉他们考虑问题都是从全局出发的。

examples.text: The referee has to think the way the players do.
examples.translation: 裁判必须从运动员的角度考虑问题。

examples.text: Nobody could think of anything to say...
examples.translation: 谁也想不出什么话说。

examples.text: I can't think of any reason why he should do that...
examples.translation: 我想不出来他为什么非要那样做。

examples.text: I just can't think of his name...
examples.translation: 我就是想不起来他叫什么了。

examples.text: I was trying to think what else we had to do.
examples.translation: 我在努力想我们还得做些什么。

examples.text: He thought of another way of getting out of the marriage...
examples.translation: 他又想到一个摆脱那桩婚姻的点子。

examples.text: I don't know why I never thought of that.
examples.translation: 我怎么就从未想到过那一点。

examples.text: She must be ill, Tatiana thought...
examples.translation: 她一定是病了，塔蒂亚娜心想。

examples.text: I remember thinking how lovely he looked...
examples.translation: 我记得曾经在心里暗想他的样子多么可爱。

examples.text: I'm trying to think positive thoughts.
examples.translation: 我尽力往积极的方面想。

examples.text: We all thought of him as a father...
examples.translation: 我们都视他为父亲。

examples.text: He thinks of it as his home...
examples.translation: 他将那儿当作自己的家。

examples.text: In China bats are thought of as being very lucky...
examples.translation: 在中国，蝙蝠被视为吉祥物。

examples.text: Nobody had thought him capable of that kind of thing.
examples.translation: 谁都没想到他能干出那种事情来。

examples.text: To tell the truth, I don't think much of psychiatrists...
examples.translation: 说实话，我不太喜欢精神科医生。

examples.text: The Director thought a good deal of him...
examples.translation: 主任对他评价很高。

examples.text: People at the club think very highly of him...
examples.translation: 俱乐部的人很佩服他。

examples.text: He seemed to be a good man, well thought of by all.
examples.translation: 大家都对他评价不错，他似乎是个好人。

examples.text: I'm only thinking of you...
examples.translation: 我一心只为你着想。

examples.text: You never think of anyone but yourself...
examples.translation: 你从来不考虑别人，就只顾你自己。

examples.text: We have the interest of 500,000 customers to think of...
examples.translation: 我们得为 50 万名顾客的利益着想。

examples.text: You don't have to think about me and Hugh.
examples.translation: 你不必挂念我和休。

examples.text: Martin was thinking of taking legal action against Zuckerman...
examples.translation: 马丁在考虑对朱克曼提起诉讼。

examples.text: Have you ever thought of marrying?...
examples.translation: 你有没有想过结婚？

examples.text: It would be unwise for the government to think of privatisation as a means of saving money.
examples.translation: 政府要是把私有化当作省钱之道就不明智了。

examples.text: I'm primarily thinking of the first year...
examples.translation: 我考虑的主要是第一年。

examples.text: There is a theme of tragedy that runs through it: I'm thinking in particular of the story of Tom Howard.
examples.translation: 贯穿始终的是一个悲剧主题，特别是汤姆·霍华德的故事。

examples.text: Who does she think she is? Trying to make a fool of me like that...
examples.translation: 她以为她是谁啊？竟敢那样取笑我。

examples.text: You can't do this! What do you think you're doing?...
examples.translation: 你不能这样做！你以为自己在干些什么？

examples.text: What were you thinking of? You shouldn't steal.
examples.translation: 你当时是怎么想的？你不该偷东西。

examples.text: To think I left you alone in a place with a madman at large!...
examples.translation: 想想看，我竟然把你一个人抛在那儿，让你和一个无人看管的疯子呆在一起！

examples.text: When I think of how you've behaved and the trouble you've got into!
examples.translation: 现在想想看，你都做了些什么，闯了多少祸！

examples.text: You'd think you'd remember to wash your ears...
examples.translation: 还以为你能记得洗耳朵呢。

examples.text: We would have thought he would have a more responsible attitude...
examples.translation: 我们本以为他会采取更负责的态度。

examples.text: 'Surely to God she should have been given some proper help.' — 'Well I would have thought so.'
examples.translation: “她真应该得到适当的帮助。”——“嗯，我也这么想的。”

examples.text: Anyone would think you were in love with the girl...
examples.translation: 谁都会以为你和那个姑娘恋爱了。

examples.text: You'd think you had never seen a door before!
examples.translation: 就好像你以前连门都见过一样！

examples.text: He was her distant relative, as was everyone else on the island, come to think of it...
examples.translation: 想起来了，他和岛上的其他人一样，都是她的远亲。

examples.text: When you think about it, he's probably right.
examples.translation: 现在想想看，他很可能是对的。

examples.text: I think I'll go home and have a shower...
examples.translation: 我觉得我得回家冲个澡。

examples.text: We need a job, and I thought we could go around and ask if people need odd jobs done...
examples.translation: 我们需要工作，我看我们可以四处打听打听，看有没有零活可做。

examples.text: Time for a pint of beer, I think...
examples.translation: 我觉得该来一品脱啤酒了。

examples.text: 'Would you like to do that another time.' — 'Yes I think so.'
examples.translation: “你愿意再找时间做那件事吗？”——“我觉得可以。”

examples.text: I think he means 'at' rather than 'to'...
examples.translation: 我想，他是想说at，而不是to。

examples.text: Thanks, but I think I can handle it...
examples.translation: 谢谢，不过我想我自己能应付。

examples.text: This is, I think, much, much more important...
examples.translation: 我认为这个要重要得多得多。

examples.text: 'You've got it wrong.' — 'I think not.'
examples.translation: “你搞错了。”——“我看没搞错。”

examples.text: Just think; tomorrow we shall walk out of this place and leave it all behind us forever...
examples.translation: 你想想看，明天我们就要走出这个地方，再也不回来了。

examples.text: Just think how snug and cosy we could be.
examples.translation: 想象一下，我们可以多么温暖舒适呀。

examples.text: It has forced politicians to think again about the wisdom of trying to evacuate refugees...
examples.translation: 这迫使政治家们重新考虑疏散难民是否明智。

examples.text: He intends to ask the court to think again.
examples.translation: 他打算请求法庭再重新审度。

examples.text: I thought nothing of betting £1,000 on a horse.
examples.translation: 我认为把 1,000 英镑押在一匹马身上没什么了不起。

examples.text: When she went off to see her parents for the weekend I thought nothing of it...
examples.translation: 她周末去看她的父母，我当时没觉得有什么特别的。

examples.text: One of Tony's friends, David, kept coming to my house but I didn't think anything of it.
examples.translation: 托尼的朋友戴维经常来我家，不过我当时并没多想。

meanings.meaning: 口渴的，口干的；渴望的，热望的

examples.text: If a baby is thirsty, it feeds more often...
examples.translation: 婴儿要是渴了，就会吃得更频繁。

examples.text: Drink whenever you feel thirsty during exercise.
examples.translation: 运动过程中渴了就喝点水。

examples.text: The child nodded, drinking her milk thirstily.
examples.translation: 那个孩子边大口地喝着牛奶边点了点头。

examples.text: People should understand how thirsty for revenge they are.
examples.translation: 人们应该理解他们复仇的愿望是多么强烈。

examples.text: Coca is well-known for reducing hunger, thirst and fatigue...
examples.translation: 人们都知道可乐能消饿、止渴和解乏。

examples.text: Instead of tea or coffee, drink water to quench your thirst...
examples.translation: 渴了喝水，别喝茶或咖啡。

examples.text: I had such a thirst.
examples.translation: 我渴得难受。

examples.text: They died of thirst on the voyage.
examples.translation: 他们在航行途中因缺水而死亡。

examples.text: Children show a real thirst for learning.
examples.translation: 孩子们对于学习表现出真诚的渴望。

examples.text: ...their ever-growing thirst for cash.
examples.translation: 他们对于金钱越来越强烈的渴求

examples.text: We all thirst for the same things.
examples.translation: 我们都渴望得到同样的东西。

examples.text: He was gigantic, maybe thirteen feet high, and seemed built entirely of muscle and stone.
Mozart clearly enjoyed good health throughout his twenties and early thirties.
examples.translation: 显然，莫扎特在二十几岁到三十刚出头时，身体非常好。

examples.text: She became quite a notable director in the thirties and forties.
examples.translation: 她在三四十年代成了一位名导演。

examples.text: When food comes out of any oven, it should stand a while. During this delay the centre carries on cooking...
examples.translation: 食物出炉后都应该静置一会。在此期间，中心部分还在继续加热。

examples.text: On 1 October the US suspended a proposed $574 million aid package for 1991. Of this amount, $250 million is for military purchases.
examples.translation: 10 月 1 号，美国暂停了拟议中的一项 1991 年度总计 5.74 亿美元的一揽子援助方案，这其中有 2.5 亿美元是用于军事采购的。

examples.text: I don't know how bad the injury is, because I have never had one like this before.
examples.translation: 我不知道伤得有多重，因为以前从没受过这样的伤。

examples.text: This is what I will do. I will telephone Anna and explain.
examples.translation: 下面是我要做的：我要给安娜打电话解释清楚。

examples.text: This report is from David Cook of our Science Unit: 'Why did the dinosaurs become extinct?'
examples.translation: 以下是来自我们科学部的戴维·库克的报道：“为什么恐龙灭绝了？”

examples.text: You feel that it's uneconomic to insist that people work together in groups. Why is this?...
examples.translation: 你觉得要求大家分组工作不划算，这是为什么呢？

examples.text: A job is pretty much nine-to-five. Is this what you feel would make you happy?
examples.translation: 工作时间多数是朝九晚五，你觉得这样会让你感觉愉快吗？

examples.text: There have been continual demands for action by the political authorities to put an end to this situation.
examples.translation: 各方不断要求政府当局采取行动来结束这种局面。

examples.text: I came here by chance and was just watching what was going on, when this girl attacked me...
examples.translation: 我碰巧来到这儿，正看着热闹，突然一个女孩袭击了我。

examples.text: So I just walked up the steps into this big, beautiful church.
examples.translation: 于是我就拾级而上，走进了这座漂亮的大教堂。

examples.text: 'If you'd prefer something else I'll gladly have it changed for you.' — 'No, this is great.'...
examples.translation: “您要是喜欢别的，我很乐意帮您调换一下。”——“不用了，这个挺好。”

examples.text: 'Is this what you were looking for?' Bradley produced the handkerchief...
examples.translation: “你刚才找的是不是这个？”布拉德利掏出那块手绢。

examples.text: This is my colleague, Mr Arnold Landon.
examples.translation: 这位是我的同事，阿诺德·兰登先生。

examples.text: This church was built in the eleventh century.
examples.translation: 这座教堂修建于 11 世纪。

examples.text: I thought, this is why I've travelled thousands of miles...
examples.translation: 我想，这就是我为何不远千里赶来的原因。

examples.text: Tim, this is awful. I know what you must think, but it's not so...
examples.translation: 蒂姆，这可糟了。我知道你心里在想什么，但实际情况不是这样的。

examples.text: Is this what you want to do with the rest of your life?
examples.translation: 这就是你后半辈子想要做的事情吗？

examples.text: We've stopped transporting weapons to this country by train...
examples.translation: 我们已停止用火车向该国运送武器。

examples.text: This place is run like a hotel ought to be run...
examples.translation: 这个地方的经营方式就是旅馆应该有的样子。

examples.text: I think coffee is probably the best thing at this point...
examples.translation: 我认为此时喝杯咖啡是最赞的了。

examples.text: Nothing seems certain in this crucial period in Pakistan's political life.
examples.translation: 在巴基斯坦政治历史上的这个紧要关头，一切皆非定数。

examples.text: This is the worst place I've come across...
examples.translation: 这是我见过的最差的地方。

examples.text: This could have been one of the coldest golf tournaments on record.
examples.translation: 这很可能是高尔夫锦标赛比赛史上天气最为寒冷的一次。

examples.text: ...this Sunday's 7.45 performance...
examples.translation: 本周日 7 点 45 分的表演

examples.text: We're getting married this June...
examples.translation: 我们准备今年 6 月结婚。

examples.text: Jordan's own-label collection of sweatshirts, T-shirts and caps will be available this Christmas.
examples.translation: 乔丹自有品牌的运动衫、T恤衫和帽子系列将于今年圣诞节上市。

examples.text: They'd said the wound was only about this big you see and he showed me with his fingers.
examples.translation: 他们说伤口只有这么一点大，他还用手指比划给我看。

examples.text: I am not going to reveal what my seven-year plan is, but I will tell you this much, if it works out, the next seven years will be very interesting.
examples.translation: 我不想透露我的七年计划的具体内容，不过有一点可以告诉你，如果顺利实施，今后的七年将非常有意义。

examples.text: 'You know, people conveniently forget the things they say.' — 'Well this is it.'
examples.translation: “你知道，人们会选择性地忘记自己说过的话。”——“嗯，是这样。”

examples.text: Hello, this is John Thompson...
examples.translation: 喂，我是约翰·汤普森。

examples.text: 'Hello, is this Raymond Brown?' — 'Yeah, who's this?'...
examples.translation: “喂，是雷蒙德·布朗吗？”——“对，您是哪位？”

examples.text: This is NPR, National Public Radio.
examples.translation: 这里是NPR，国家公共电台。

examples.text: What I'm going to do in this lecture is focus on something very specific...
examples.translation: 我在今天的讲座中将主要探讨一些非常具体的问题。

examples.text: What a book can do, and what this one will try to accomplish, is to present examples of how life can be made more enjoyable...
examples.translation: 一本书能做到的，也是本书努力实现的，就是列举一些例子说明如何让生活变得更加愉快。

examples.text: Later in this chapter, I recommend several specific steps we need to take.
examples.translation: 在本章后面部分，我将提出几个我们需要采取的具体步骤。

examples.text: 'And what are you doing now?' — 'Oh this and that.'
examples.translation: “那你现在在做什么呢？”——“哦，瞎忙。”

examples.text: I want to make a point about all these charges going up, water rates and all this that and the other.
examples.translation: 我想就水费及其他各种各样费用的上涨谈谈看法。

meanings.meaning: (Thorn)人名；(柬)通；(英)索恩；(法、德、丹、瑞典)托恩

examples.text: Roses will always have thorns but with care they can be avoided.
examples.translation: 玫瑰花上都有刺，不过只要小心就碰不到。

examples.text: ...the shade of a thorn bush.
examples.translation: 一丛荆棘下的阴凉

examples.text: ...the thorn and bramble thickets.
examples.translation: 荆棘密布的灌木丛

examples.text: She's a real thorn in his side...
examples.translation: 她真叫他头疼。

examples.text: The Party was a thorn in the flesh of his coalition.
examples.translation: 该党是他所在联盟的眼中钉、肉中刺。

examples.text: We are making a thorough investigation...
examples.translation: 我们正在进行彻底调查。

examples.text: This very thorough survey goes back to 1784...
examples.translation: 这个非常全面的调查可追溯到 1784 年。

examples.text: How thorough is the assessment?
examples.translation: 这个评估详细到什么程度？

examples.text: Food that is being offered hot must be reheated thoroughly.
examples.translation: 买来的热熟食必须重新热透。

examples.text: ...a thoroughly researched and illuminating biography.
examples.translation: 一本资料翔实、极富启发性的传记

examples.text: The thoroughness of the evaluation process we went through was impressive.
examples.translation: 我们亲历的评估过程面面俱到，给人留下了深刻印象。

examples.text: Martin would be a good judge, I thought. He was calm and thorough...
examples.translation: 我想，马丁将会是个优秀的法官，他做事沉稳，头脑严谨。

examples.text: The men were expert, thorough and careful.
examples.translation: 那些人业务精通，作风严谨，态度认真。

examples.text: His thoroughness and attention to detail is legendary.
examples.translation: 他的严谨和对细节的关注是出了名的。

examples.text: I was a thorough little academic snob...
examples.translation: 我那时是个目空一切、自以为是的小学术愤青。

examples.text: We regard the band as a thorough shambles.
examples.translation: 我们认为那个乐队一塌糊涂。

examples.text: I thoroughly enjoy your programme...
examples.translation: 我非常喜欢你们的节目。

examples.text: We returned home thoroughly contented.
examples.translation: 我们心满意足地回家了。

examples.text: Theoretically he had control over more than $400 million in US accounts. But, in fact, it was the US Treasury and State Department who controlled those accounts...
examples.translation: 从理论上说，他掌管着美国账户里的 4 亿美元。然而，事实上，是美国财政部和国务院在掌控那些账户。

examples.text: They have the aircraft capable of doing significant damage, because most of those aircraft are capable of launching anti-ship missiles.
examples.translation: 他们拥有具有强大杀伤力的飞机，因为那些飞机多数都能发射反舰导弹。

examples.text: I understand that there are a number of projects going on. Could you tell us a little bit about those?...
examples.translation: 我知道目前正在进行许多项目。能否请您简单谈一谈那些项目？

examples.text: Waterfalls never fail to attract and those at the Falls of Clyde are no exception.
examples.translation: 瀑布向来都不乏吸引力，克莱德瀑布群也不例外。

examples.text: What are those buildings?...
examples.translation: 那些是什么建筑？

examples.text: Oh, those books! I meant to put them away before this afternoon.
examples.translation: 哦，那些书！我本来要在下午之前收起来的。

examples.text: Those are nice shoes. Where'd you get them?...
examples.translation: 你那双鞋子不错，在哪儿买的？

examples.text: Excuse me. What are those for?...
examples.translation: 对不起，那些是做什么用的？

examples.text: I think those are my earrings.
examples.translation: 我想那是我的耳环。

examples.text: Those people who took up weapons to defend themselves are political prisoners...
examples.translation: 那些拿起武器自卫的人是些政治犯。

examples.text: The point of home bread-making is to avoid those additives used in much commercial baking.
examples.translation: 自制面包就是为了避免吃到许多面包店使用的添加剂。

examples.text: The interests he is most likely to enjoy will be those which enable him to show off himself or his talents...
examples.translation: 他最有可能感兴趣的就是那些能让他表现自己或炫耀才华的事情。

examples.text: The cells of the body, especially those of the brain, can live only minutes without circulating blood.
examples.translation: 如果血液不循环，肌体细胞，尤其是脑细胞，只能存活几分钟。

examples.text: A little selfish behaviour is unlikely to cause real damage to those around us...
examples.translation: 稍许自私的行为不会对我们身边的人造成实质性伤害。

examples.text: A number of leading opposition figures were said to be among those arrested.
examples.translation: 据说，许多反对派的重要人物也在被捕者之列。

examples.text: He did buy me those daffodils a week or so ago...
examples.translation: 他确实在大约一个星期前给我买了那些水仙花。

examples.text: I have been putting pressure onto the Cleansing Services to replace those dustbin lids...
examples.translation: 我一直在给保洁部门施加压力，要求他们更换那些垃圾箱的盖子。

examples.text: I believe they've doubled their turnover since those advertisements appeared in the press.
examples.translation: 我相信，那些广告在报上刊登出来后，他们的营业额已经翻番。

examples.text: ...those embarrassing moments we all have.
examples.translation: 我们都经历过的那些尴尬时刻

examples.text: Gaelic has been a dying language for many years, though children are nowadays taught it in school...
examples.translation: 盖尔语多年来一直濒于消亡，尽管如今孩子们还在学校学习这门语言。

examples.text: After news of this new court case Ford broke down again, though he blamed the breakdown on his work...
examples.translation: 福特听到这一场新官司的消息后再次精神崩溃，尽管他说自己是因为工作才这样的。

examples.text: He's very attractive, though certainly not a ladykiller...
examples.translation: 他很有魅力，虽然还不至于使女人一见倾心。

examples.text: Cleveland has always had a reputation for being a dirty, ugly, boring city, though now they say it is much better.
examples.translation: 克利夫兰一直因其环境脏乱、市容丑陋、沉闷无趣而恶名在外，尽管据说现在好多了。

examples.text: I look back on it as the bloodiest (though not literally) winter of the war...
examples.translation: 我现在回想起来，觉得那是战时最血腥的(但并非字面意义上的)一个冬天。

examples.text: The problem was finally, though not conclusively, identified as a severely pinched nerve...
examples.translation: 问题终于被认定为是神经受到严重挤压，尽管这还不是最终结论。

examples.text: His achievements, though hardly exciting, were widely admired.
examples.translation: 尽管他的成就不怎么激动人心，可依然备受赞赏。

examples.text: I like him. Though he makes me angry sometimes...
examples.translation: 我喜欢他，不过他有时惹我生气。

examples.text: I want to try my hand at politics, or go back to the law. I don't want to go to school for it, though...
examples.translation: 我想进入政坛，或者重操律师旧业。不过我不想进学校去专门学习。

examples.text: It might be worth your while to go to court. This is tricky, though, and you'll need expert advice.
examples.translation: 对你来说这官司或许值得一打，不过这件事有点棘手，你需要专家的建议。

examples.text: I'm a good cook, though I say it myself...
examples.translation: 我并非自夸，我的厨艺的确高超。

examples.text: Even though I do say it myself we've probably got the best little restaurant in town.
examples.translation: 不是我吹牛，我们的小饭店可能是全城最好的。

examples.text: Nancy, who had been thoughtful for some time, suddenly spoke...
examples.translation: 南希沉思了一会儿，突然开口说话了。

examples.text: He was looking very thoughtful...
examples.translation: 他似乎在静静思考着什么。

examples.text: She had a thoughtful expression on her face.
examples.translation: 她一脸若有所思的表情。

examples.text: Daniel nodded thoughtfully.
examples.translation: 丹尼尔若有所思地点了点头。

examples.text: ...a thoughtful and caring man...
examples.translation: 体贴入微、关心他人的男人

examples.text: Thank you. That's very thoughtful of you...
examples.translation: 谢谢你，你想的真周到。

examples.text: It was a very kind and thoughtful gesture.
examples.translation: 这真是十分友好体贴的举动。

examples.text: ...the bottle of wine he had thoughtfully purchased for the celebrations.
examples.translation: 他特地为庆祝活动买的那瓶葡萄酒

examples.text: I can't tell you how much I appreciate your thoughtfulness.
examples.translation: 非常感谢您的体贴入微，我真的无以言表。

examples.text: ...a thoughtful and scholarly book.
examples.translation: 一本兼具思想性和学术性的书

examples.text: ...these thoughtfully designed machines.
examples.translation: 这些精心设计的机器

meanings.meaning: 想，思考；认为（think的过去式和过去分词）

examples.text: The thought of Nick made her throat tighten...
examples.translation: 一想到尼克，她的喉咙就发紧。

examples.text: I tormented myself with the thought that life was just too comfortable...
examples.translation: 一想到生活太过舒适了，我内心就很痛苦。

examples.text: He pushed the thought from his mind...
examples.translation: 他抛开心头这个想法。

examples.text: I've just had a thought.
examples.translation: 我刚刚有了个主意。

examples.text: I jumped to my feet so my thoughts wouldn't start to wander...
examples.translation: 我跳起来，免得走神。

examples.text: Usually at this time our thoughts are on Christmas...
examples.translation: 通常在这种时候，我们的心思全放在了圣诞节上。

examples.text: If he wasn't there physically, he was always in her thoughts.
examples.translation: 就算他人不在那儿，他也总在她的心里。

examples.text: Many of you have written to us to express your thoughts on the conflict...
examples.translation: 你们中有许多人给我们来信，表达对冲突的看法。

examples.text: Mr Goodman, do you have any thoughts on that?
examples.translation: 古德曼先生，那个问题你怎么看？

examples.text: Alice had been so deep in thought that she had walked past her car without even seeing it...
examples.translation: 艾丽斯考虑问题入了神，连走过自己的车都没看见。

examples.text: He had given some thought to what she had told him...
examples.translation: 他认真考虑了她对他说过的话。

examples.text: After much thought I decided to end my marriage.
examples.translation: 经过慎重考虑，我决定结束我的婚姻。

examples.text: ...the differences between his thought processes and ours.
examples.translation: 他的思维过程和我们的思维过程之间的区别

examples.text: Sarah's first thought was to run back and get Max...
examples.translation: 萨拉首先想到的就是跑回去把马克斯叫来。

examples.text: They had no thought of surrender...
examples.translation: 他们没有想过要投降。

examples.text: Morris has now banished all thoughts of retirement.
examples.translation: 莫里斯现在已经打消了退休的所有念头。

examples.text: 'Would you like to move into the ward?' — 'A kind thought, but no, thank you.'
examples.translation: “你想不想挪到病房里来？”——“哦，您太好心了，不用了，谢谢。”

examples.text: 'She has given them this seven hundred pounds.' — 'What a lovely thought.'
examples.translation: “她给了他们这 700 英镑。”——“太慷慨了。”

examples.text: Aristotle's scientific theories dominated Western thought for fifteen hundred years...
examples.translation: 亚里士多德的科学理论统治了西方思想达 1,500 年。

examples.text: This school of thought argues that depression is best treated by drugs.
examples.translation: 这一学派主张抑郁症最好用药物治疗。

examples.text: ...five thousand acres...
Visitors can expect to pay about a thousand pounds a day.
examples.translation: 游客每天大概要支付 1,000 英镑。

examples.text: Thousands of refugees are packed into overcrowded towns and villages...
examples.translation: 成千上万的难民涌入拥挤不堪的城镇和村庄。

examples.text: I must have driven past that place thousands of times.
examples.translation: 我得有上千次开车经过那里。

examples.text: Hundreds have been killed in the fighting and thousands made homeless.
examples.translation: 数百人在战斗中丧生，数千人无家可归。

examples.text: Some couples see single women as a threat to their relationships...
examples.translation: 有些夫妇把单身女人看成是对他们婚姻的威胁。

examples.text: The Hurricane Center warns people not to take the threat of tropical storms lightly...
examples.translation: 飓风中心警告人们，不要对热带风暴的危险掉以轻心。

examples.text: All countries in the region had the right to protect themselves against external threat.
examples.translation: 该地区的所有国家都有权保护本国免受外来威胁。

examples.text: He may be forced to carry out his threat to resign...
examples.translation: 他也许会被迫把自己的辞职威胁付诸行动。

examples.text: The priest remains in hiding after threats by former officials of the ousted dictatorship...
examples.translation: 受到被驱逐下台的独裁政府官员的威胁后，那个牧师一直藏匿不出。

examples.text: The last journalist to interview him received a death threat...
examples.translation: 上次去采访他的记者受到了死亡恐吓。

examples.text: His position as leader will be under threat at a party congress due next month...
examples.translation: 在定于下月举行的党代表大会上，他的领导地位将受到威胁。

examples.text: She lives daily under threat of violence...
examples.translation: 她每天都生活在暴力威胁之下。

examples.text: Even the most security-conscious computer user is under constant threat from computer viruses.
examples.translation: 即使是有强烈安全意识的计算机用户也时刻处于计算机病毒入侵的威胁下。

examples.text: Britain's rarest breeding birds are under threat from fanatical and selfish egg collectors.
examples.translation: 英国最珍贵的种鸟正因为那些狂热而自私的鸟蛋收集者而面临着威胁。

meanings.meaning: 线；螺纹；思路；衣服；线状物；玻璃纤维；路线

examples.text: This time I'll do it properly with a needle and thread.
examples.translation: 这次，我要用针线将它缝好。

examples.text: ...a tiny Nepalese hat embroidered with golden threads.
examples.translation: 带有金丝线刺绣的尼泊尔小帽

examples.text: The thread running through many of these proposals was the theme of individual power and opportunity...
examples.translation: 贯穿这许多提案的主线是个人权力和机遇这一主题。

examples.text: All religions are united by the common threads of fighting evil and helping others...
examples.translation: 所有宗教都因为惩恶助人这一共同主题而联合起来。

examples.text: The possible consequences so filled his mind that he lost the thread of Wan Da's narrative.
examples.translation: 他脑子里充满了各种可能的结局，结果跟不上万达的叙述。

examples.text: A thin, glistening thread of moisture ran along the rough concrete sill.
examples.translation: 在粗糙不平的水泥窗台上有一条细细的发光水印。

examples.text: ...Venetian glass decorated with embedded threads of white.
examples.translation: 镶嵌有白色线条的彩色装饰玻璃

examples.text: ...a corpulent man with threads of black hair plastered across his brow.
examples.translation: 几缕黑发紧贴额头的肥胖男子

examples.text: ...a cheap place to pick up natty threads.
examples.translation: 能买到既整洁时髦而又便宜的衣服的去处

examples.text: The screw threads will be able to get a good grip.
examples.translation: 螺纹能牢牢地咬合卡紧。

examples.text: Slowly she threaded her way back through the moving mass of bodies...
examples.translation: 她从人流中慢慢地挤了回来。

examples.text: ...threading our way past little boats...
examples.translation: 我们在小船中间蜿蜒穿行

examples.text: We threaded through a network of back streets.
examples.translation: 我们在蜘蛛网似的偏僻街道中七拐八拐地穿行。

examples.text: ...threading the laces through the eyelets of his shoes...
examples.translation: 把鞋带穿进他的鞋眼

examples.text: Air ducts and electrical cables were threaded through the complex structure...
examples.translation: 通风管和电缆在这幢结构复杂的建筑物中穿过。

examples.text: Instruments developed at the hospital allow doctors to thread microscopic telescopes into the digestive tract.
examples.translation: 医院开发研制的仪器使医生们得以将显微内镜伸入消化道。

examples.text: Wipe the mushrooms clean and thread them on a string.
examples.translation: 把这些蘑菇擦干净，然后用线穿起来。

examples.text: I sit down, thread a needle, snip off an old button.
examples.translation: 我坐下来，穿好针，剪下一枚旧纽扣。

examples.text: The fragile peace was hanging by a thread as thousands of hardliners took to the streets.
examples.translation: 成千上万的强硬派分子走上街头示威，脆弱的和平局势危在旦夕。

examples.text: Many women have been able to pick up the threads of their former career.
examples.translation: 许多女性得以重操旧业。

examples.text: He said army officers had threatened to destroy the town...
examples.translation: 他说陆军军官们曾威胁要摧毁那座小镇。

examples.text: He tied her up and threatened her with a six-inch knife...
examples.translation: 他把她捆起来，拿着一把 6 英寸长的刀子威胁她。

examples.text: If you threaten me or use any force, I shall inform the police.
examples.translation: 你要是威胁我或是动武，我就报警。

examples.text: The newcomers directly threaten the livelihood of the established workers...
examples.translation: 新来的工人直接威胁到老工人的饭碗。

examples.text: The unity of our society is threatened by troublesome and restless minorities...
examples.translation: 我们社会的团结遭到了一小撮滋扰生事、不安分守己的群体的威胁。

examples.text: 30 percent of reptiles, birds, and fish are currently threatened with extinction.
examples.translation: 目前，30% 的爬行动物、鸟类和鱼类面临灭绝的危险。

examples.text: The fighting is threatening to turn into full-scale war...
examples.translation: 这场战斗有可能会演变为全面的战争。

examples.text: Plants must be covered with a leaf-mould or similarly protected if frost threatens.
examples.translation: 如果霜冻来临，植物必须盖上腐叶土或用类似方法加以保护。

examples.text: We waited three months before going back to see the specialist.
examples.translation: 我们等了 3 个月才回去见那位专家。

meanings.meaning: 入口；门槛；开始；极限；临界值

examples.text: He stopped at the threshold of the bedroom...
examples.translation: 他在卧室门口停住了。

examples.text: The bride was carried over the threshold.
examples.translation: 新娘被抱进了家门。

examples.text: She has a low threshold of boredom and needs the constant stimulation of physical activity...
examples.translation: 她容易厌倦，需要时常进行活动来刺激一下。

examples.text: The consensus has clearly shifted in favour of raising the nuclear threshold...
examples.translation: 显然大家已普遍开始转向支持提高核武器使用的门槛了。

examples.text: Fewer than forty per cent voted — the threshold for results to be valid.
examples.translation: 投票的人不到 40%——投票结果无效。

examples.text: We are on the threshold of a new era in astronomy.
examples.translation: 我们很快就将迎来天文学的新纪元。

examples.text: ...a lovely girl on the threshold of growing up.
examples.translation: 眼看就要长大成人的可爱女孩

meanings.meaning: 节俭；节约；[植] 海石竹

examples.text: They were rightly praised for their thrift and enterprise.
examples.translation: 他们勤俭节约，积极进取，得到了当之无愧的赞扬。

examples.text: I sleep on the third floor...
examples.translation: 我睡在三楼。

examples.text: It was the third time one of his cars had gone up in flames...
examples.translation: 这是他的车第三次起火。

examples.text: He came third in the poll with 149 votes...
examples.translation: 他在选举中获得 149 票，名列第三。

examples.text: The attack was the third so far this year.
examples.translation: 这是今年迄今为止的第三次袭击。

examples.text: A third of the cost went into technology and services...
examples.translation: 有三分之一的支出投入了技术和服务。

examples.text: Only one third get financial help from their fathers...
examples.translation: 只有三分之一的人得到父亲的经济援助。

examples.text: He divided their kingdom into thirds.
examples.translation: 他把他们的王国分成了三个部分。

examples.text: First, interest rates may take longer to fall than is hoped. Second, in real terms, lending may fall. Third, bad loans could wipe out much of any improvement.
examples.translation: 首先，利率的下降可能没有希望的那样快;第二，实际贷款额可能会减少;第三，坏账很可能抵消大部分增长。

meanings.meaning: 使…颤动；使…紧张；使…感到兴奋或激动
颤抖；感到兴奋；感到紧张

examples.text: I can remember the thrill of not knowing what I would get on Christmas morning...
examples.translation: 我还记得自己不知道圣诞节早晨会得到什么礼物时内心有多么激动。

examples.text: It's a great thrill for a cricket-lover like me to play at the home of cricket.
examples.translation: 对我这样的板球爱好者来说，能够在板球的故乡比赛是一件令人无比兴奋的事。

examples.text: ...the realization that new adventures, new thrills, and new worlds lie ahead.
examples.translation: 认识到前面有新的冒险，新的惊喜和新的世界

examples.text: The electric atmosphere both terrified and thrilled him...
examples.translation: 极度紧张的气氛让他既害怕又兴奋。

examples.text: The children will thrill at all their favourite characters.
examples.translation: 孩子们看到所有那些他们最喜爱的人物形象会兴奋不已。

examples.text: Its prime audience lies in the 17 to 24 age group, and they want instant thrills and spills.
examples.translation: 它的主要观众的年龄集中在 17 岁到 24 岁之间，而这些人喜欢极速的惊险刺激。

examples.text: Today his company continues to thrive...
examples.translation: 今天，他的公司继续蓬勃发展。

examples.text: Lavender thrives in poor soil.
examples.translation: 薰衣草在贫瘠的土壤中茁壮生长。

examples.text: ...the river's thriving population of kingfishers.
examples.translation: 那条河上不断繁衍的翠鸟群

examples.text: Many people thrive on a stressful lifestyle...
examples.translation: 有许多人喜欢充满压力的生活方式。

examples.text: Creative people are usually very determined and thrive on overcoming obstacles.
examples.translation: 富有创造力的人一般都意志非常坚定，能不断克服困难，事业蒸蒸日上。

examples.text: She had a sore throat...
examples.translation: 她嗓子疼。

examples.text: As she stared at him she felt her throat go dry.
examples.translation: 她盯着他看的时候，感觉自己的喉咙发干。

examples.text: His striped tie was loosened at his throat.
examples.translation: 他的条纹领带松松地挂在脖子上。

examples.text: Cross cleared his throat and spoke in low, polite tones.
examples.translation: 克罗斯清了清嗓子，开始有礼貌地低声说话。

examples.text: I've always been close to my dad but he's never rammed his career down my throat...
examples.translation: 我一直和爸爸很亲近，不过他从不强迫我继承他的事业。

examples.text: I can't understand why we're trying to ram Shakespeare down their throats.
examples.translation: 我搞不懂我们为什么硬要他们学习莎士比亚的作品。

examples.text: The idea that Billy and I are at each other's throats couldn't be further from the truth.
examples.translation: 认为我和比利斗得你死我活的想法真是大错特错。

examples.text: What sticks in my throat is that I wasn't able to win the trophy...
examples.translation: 令我耿耿于怀的是自己没能获奖。

examples.text: She wanted to ask if he had news of Keith, but the words stuck in her throat.
examples.translation: 她想问他有没有基思的消息，可是难以启齿。

examples.text: ...the Queen's 50th anniversary on the throne.
examples.translation: 女王登基 50 周年纪念日

examples.text: ...the heir to the throne.
examples.translation: 王位继承人

examples.text: The national tragedy of rival groups killing each other continued throughout 1990...
examples.translation: 敌对派别相互残杀的国家悲剧 1990 年全年都在上演。

examples.text: Movie music can be made memorable because its themes are repeated throughout the film.
examples.translation: 电影音乐要想让人记住不难，因为它的主旋律贯穿影片始终。

examples.text: ...a single-minded devotion to racing which Gaye has shown throughout her career.
examples.translation: 盖伊在她的职业生涯中对赛跑自始至终的全身心投入

examples.text: The first song, 'Blue Moon', didn't go too badly except that everyone talked throughout.
examples.translation: 第一首歌《蓝色的月亮》唱得并不太差，只是所有人从头到尾都在讲话。

examples.text: 'Sight Savers', founded in 1950, now runs projects throughout Africa, the Caribbean and South East Asia...
examples.translation: 创始于 1950 年的国际防盲及救盲组织如今在非洲、加勒比海地区和东南亚各地都开展项目。

examples.text: As we have tried to show throughout this book, companies that provide outstanding service don't do it by luck.
examples.translation: 正如我们一直想在本书中努力表明的那样，提供优质服务的公司靠的不是运气。

examples.text: The route is well signposted throughout...
examples.translation: 这条路线全段都清楚地设有路标。

examples.text: Throughout, the walls are white.
examples.translation: 那些墙壁通体上下都是白的。

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, through is used in phrasal verbs such as ‘see through’, ‘think through’, and ‘win through’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，through 还可用于 see through，think through，win through 等动词短语中。

examples.text: Go straight through that door under the EXIT sign...
examples.translation: 从“安全出口”标志下的那道门直穿过去。

examples.text: Visitors enter through a side entrance...
examples.translation: 游客从侧门进入。

examples.text: The main path continues through a tunnel of trees.
examples.translation: 主路继续延伸，穿过了树枝遮顶的林阴道。

examples.text: He went straight through to the kitchen and took a can of beer from the fridge...
examples.translation: 他径直来到厨房，从冰箱里取出一罐啤酒。

examples.text: She opened the door and stood back to allow the man to pass through.
examples.translation: 她打开门，退后一步让那名男子进去。

examples.text: Use a proper fish knife and fork if possible as they are designed to cut through the flesh but not the bones...
examples.translation: 如果可能的话，选用正规的吃鱼刀叉，因为它们是专门设计来切开鱼肉而又不会切断鱼骨的。

examples.text: Rabbits still manage to find a way in. I am sure that some have even taken to gnawing through the metal.
examples.translation: 兔子还是找到办法进去了。我敢断定，有些兔子甚至已经用上了咬断金属的办法。

examples.text: Score lightly at first and then repeat, scoring deeper each time until the board is cut through.
examples.translation: 先轻轻地划一道痕，然后再反复划，每次划得深一点，直到木板被割断。

examples.text: Go up to Ramsgate, cross into France, go through Andorra and into Spain.
examples.translation: 北行至拉姆斯盖特，然后横跨法国，穿过安多拉，进入西班牙。

examples.text: ...travelling through pathless woods...
examples.translation: 在人迹罕至的树林中穿行

examples.text: The couple set off in August from Morocco, drove through the Sahara, visited Nigeria and were heading for Zimbabwe.
examples.translation: 那对夫妇 8 月从摩洛哥出发，驱车穿过撒哈拉大沙漠，游览了尼日利亚，正向津巴布韦进发。

examples.text: ...and Sue Cook takes her family on a motoring trip through Cornwall.
examples.translation: 而且休·库克开车带着家人在康沃尔兜了一圈

examples.text: Few know that the tribe was just passing through.
examples.translation: 很少有人知道那个部族只是路过。

examples.text: We made our way through the crowd to the river...
examples.translation: 我们挤过人群，来到河边。

examples.text: Sybil's fingers ran through the water...
examples.translation: 西比尔的手指在水中划来划去。

examples.text: Nancy kept running, plunging through the sand...
examples.translation: 南希一直跑啊跑，穿过沙地。

examples.text: He hurried through the rain, to the patrol car.
examples.translation: 他冒着雨急匆匆地跑到巡逻车前。

examples.text: He pushed his way through to the edge of the crowd where he waited.
examples.translation: 他一直挤到人群的边缘，然后就在那儿等着。

examples.text: Allow twenty-five minutes to get through Passport Control and Customs...
examples.translation: 留出 25 分钟过护照检查处和海关。

examples.text: He was one of the last of the crowd to pass through the barrier...
examples.translation: 他是那群人里最后一批跨越障碍的。

examples.text: Traders generally travel safely through the border.
examples.translation: 商人通常可以安全通过边界。

examples.text: ...a maze of concrete and steel barriers, designed to prevent vehicles driving straight through.
examples.translation: 专为防止车辆直行通过而设计的迷宫似的钢筋混凝土障碍物

examples.text: He was killed at a road junction by a van driver who went through a red light...
examples.translation: 他在交叉路口被一辆闯红灯的小货车撞死了。

examples.text: We drove through red traffic lights, the horn blaring.
examples.translation: 我们鸣着喇叭，闯过红灯。

examples.text: The ends of the net pass through a wooden bar at each end...
examples.translation: 网的两端各穿过一根木棒。

examples.text: Zita was herself unconventional, keeping a safety-pin stuck through her ear lobe.
examples.translation: 齐塔自己就不守传统，在一只耳垂上穿了一根别针。

examples.text: I bored a hole so that the fixing bolt would pass through.
examples.translation: 我钻了个孔，好让固定插销穿过去。

examples.text: ...electric currents travelling through copper wires...
examples.translation: 通过铜导线的电流

examples.text: What a lot of cards you've got through the post!
examples.translation: 你们收到了多少寄来的贺卡啊！

examples.text: ...a child's successful passage through the education system.
examples.translation: 孩子顺利完成学业

examples.text: It is also expected to consider a resolution which would allow food to go through immediately with fewer restrictions.
examples.translation: 预计还将考虑通过一项决议，将减少限制使食品迅速通过。

examples.text: Alice gazed pensively through the wet glass...
examples.translation: 艾丽斯透过湿漉漉的玻璃神情忧郁地凝视着窗外。

examples.text: They could hear music pulsing through the walls of the house...
examples.translation: 透过墙壁，他们能听到有节奏的音乐声。

examples.text: I am sure I can feel a vibration through the soles of my feet.
examples.translation: 我敢肯定我能感到脚底下有震动。

examples.text: An atmosphere of anticipation vibrated through the crowd...
examples.translation: 期待的心情在人群中弥漫开来。

examples.text: The melody that ran through his brain was composed of bad notes...
examples.translation: 回荡在他脑海里的旋律都走调了。

examples.text: What was going through his mind when he spoke those amazing words?...
examples.translation: 他说出那些令人诧异的话时，心里都在想些什么？

examples.text: A mood of optimism swept through the company and its customers.
examples.translation: 公司上下及其顾客都洋溢着一股乐观情绪。

examples.text: We're playing in New Zealand, Australia and Japan through November...
examples.translation: 整个 11 月，我们都在新西兰、澳大利亚和日本巡回演出。

examples.text: Saga features trips for older people at home and abroad all through the year...
examples.translation: “传奇”旅行社为老年人提供全年的国内外旅游服务。

examples.text: She kept quiet all through breakfast.
examples.translation: 早饭时，她从头到尾一声不吭的。

examples.text: We've got a tough programme, hard work right through to the summer...
examples.translation: 我们有一个难啃的项目，需要一直奋战到夏天。

examples.text: He worked right through.
examples.translation: 他参与了整个过程。

examples.text: ...open Monday through Sunday from 7:00 am to 10:00 pm...
examples.translation: 开放时间：周一到周日，每天早晨 7: 00 到晚上 10: 00

examples.text: During her busy season (March through June), she often completes as many as fifty paintings a week.
examples.translation: 她忙的时候(从 3 月一直到 6 月)，常常一个星期完成多达 50 幅画作。

examples.text: Men go through a change of life emotionally just like women.
examples.translation: 男人和女人一样，也要在情绪上经历更年期。

examples.text: ...a humorous woman who had lived through two world wars in Paris...
examples.translation: 在巴黎经历过两次世界大战的幽默女人

examples.text: Why was I putting myself through all this misery?...
examples.translation: 我为什么要如此自找苦吃啊？

examples.text: Through it all, Mark was outwardly calm.
examples.translation: 自始至终，马克表面上都显得很镇定。

examples.text: I'm through with the explaining...
examples.translation: 我不想再解释了。

examples.text: Training as a marriage counsellor would guarantee her some employment once her schooling was through...
examples.translation: 她接受的婚姻指导师培训能保证她学业一结束就找到工作。

examples.text: They were through. They wanted out. Forever...
examples.translation: 他们受够了，他们想要解脱，永远的解脱。

examples.text: I'm through with women.
examples.translation: 我这辈子都不会再和女人交往了。

examples.text: A thirty-nine-year-old competitor collapsed half-way through the marathon and died shortly afterwards.
examples.translation: 一名 39 岁的马拉松参赛者跑到一半时瘫倒在地，没过多久就死了。

examples.text: Stir the pork about until it turns white all the way through.
examples.translation: 不停搅动猪肉，直到它全部变白为止。

examples.text: They are understood to have retired through age or ill health...
examples.translation: 据知他们是因年龄或健康问题而退休。

examples.text: The thought of someone suffering through a mistake of mine makes me shiver.
examples.translation: 想到有人因为我犯的错误而吃苦头，我就不寒而栗。

examples.text: Those who seek to grab power through violence deserve punishment...
examples.translation: 企图通过暴力夺权的人理应受到惩罚。

examples.text: You simply can't get a ticket through official channels.
examples.translation: 通过官方渠道是压根儿搞不到票的。

examples.text: Do I need to go through my doctor or can I make an appointment direct?...
examples.translation: 我必须经过我的医生呢，还是可以直接预约？

examples.text: Speaking through an interpreter, he called for some new thinking from the West.
examples.translation: 他通过译员发出呼吁，希望西方能采取一些新的思维。

examples.text: It is possible that the present Governor General will be made interim President, if the proposals go through...
examples.translation: 如果提案获得通过，现任总督可能被任命为临时总统。

examples.text: The secretary of state during the Nixon-Ford transition did not wish to push the proposals through.
examples.translation: 尼克松-福特过渡时期的国务卿不希望推动那些提案得到通过。

examples.text: They want to get the plan through Congress as quickly as possible.
examples.translation: 他们想让该计划尽快获得国会的批准。

examples.text: She was bright, learned languages quickly, and sailed through her exams...
examples.translation: 她头脑聪明，学语言学得快，各门考试都顺利地通过。

examples.text: All the seeded players got through the first round.
examples.translation: 所有种子选手都闯过了第一轮比赛。

examples.text: Nigeria also go through from that group.
examples.translation: 尼日利亚队也在那个小组中胜出。

examples.text: He may find the line cut on the telephone so that he can't get through...
examples.translation: 他可能会发现电话线被切断了，所以打不通。

examples.text: Smith tried to get through to Frank at Warm Springs the next morning.
examples.translation: 第二天早上，史密斯试图打电话给在沃姆斯普林斯的弗兰克。

examples.text: Let's go through the numbers together and see if a workable deal is possible...
examples.translation: 我们一起把这些数目过一遍，看能不能找出个可行方案。

examples.text: When you have finished your list of personal preferences, go through it again...
examples.translation: 等你列出个人喜好的单子后，从头到尾再看一遍。

examples.text: David ran through the agreement with Guy, point by point...
examples.translation: 戴维和盖伊一起把协议逐条看了一遍。

examples.text: He, too, had a lot of paperwork to get through.
examples.translation: 他也有很多文书工作要处理。

examples.text: She read through pages and pages of the music I had brought her...
examples.translation: 她一页一页地翻看我带给她的乐谱。

examples.text: I only had time to skim through the script before I flew over here.
examples.translation: 我在乘飞机来这儿之前，只来得及把稿子浏览了一遍。

examples.text: He read the article straight through, looking for any scrap of information that might have passed him by.
examples.translation: 他将那篇文章从头读到尾，寻找先前可能漏看的任何一点零星信息。

examples.text: ...Britain's longest through train journey, 685 miles.
examples.translation: 英国行程最远的直达列车路线——685 英里

examples.text: I returned to the inn cold and wet, soaked through by the drizzling rain...
examples.translation: 我回到小旅馆时身上被毛毛雨淋透了，感觉又冷又湿。

examples.text: She went on crying, and cried and cried until the pillow was wet through.
examples.translation: 她还是哭，哭呀哭，一直哭到枕头都湿透了。

examples.text: I've gotten my feet thoroughly soaked and feel frozen through and through...
examples.translation: 我双脚湿透，感觉都冻到骨头里了。

examples.text: People assume they know me through and through the moment we meet.
examples.translation: 人们一见到我，就自以为对我了如指掌了。

examples.text: He spent hours throwing a tennis ball against a wall...
examples.translation: 他好几个小时都对着一堵墙掷网球。

examples.text: On one occasion, his father threw a radio at his mother...
examples.translation: 他父亲曾有一次拎起收音机砸向他的母亲。

examples.text: The crowd began throwing stones...
examples.translation: 人群开始投掷石块。

examples.text: Sophia jumps up and throws down her knitting...
examples.translation: 索菲娅跳起身来，扔下正在织的毛衣。

examples.text: He threw Brian a rope.
examples.translation: 他扔给布赖恩一根绳子。

examples.text: One of the judges thought it was a foul throw...
examples.translation: 有个裁判认为投球犯规。

examples.text: A throw of the dice allows a player to move himself forward.
examples.translation: 掷一次骰子，玩家可相应向前移动。

examples.text: He didn't really know very much about javelin throwing.
examples.translation: 他其实并不太懂掷标枪。

examples.text: She threw her arms around his shoulders...
examples.translation: 她一把搂住他的肩膀。

examples.text: She threatened to throw herself in front of a train...
examples.translation: 她威胁要卧轨。

examples.text: He set his skinny legs apart and threw back his shoulders.
examples.translation: 他叉开两条细腿，猛地挺起胸膛。

examples.text: He struggled out of his bulky jacket and threw it on to the back seat...
examples.translation: 他费劲脱下他那件笨重的夹克，随手把它扔在后座上。

examples.text: Why not throw it all in the pot and see what happens?
examples.translation: 为什么不把它全扔进罐子，看看会发生什么变化？

examples.text: He threw me to the ground and started to kick...
examples.translation: 他把我摔倒在地，开始用脚踢。

examples.text: The device exploded, throwing Mr Taylor from his car.
examples.translation: 那个装置爆炸了，把泰勒先生从车里抛了出去。

examples.text: Those two should have been thrown in jail...
examples.translation: 那两个人早就应该抓去坐牢。

examples.text: Police should have the power to fine people who hamper rescue efforts. In fact I'd throw them into prison for a night.
examples.translation: 警察应该有权对妨碍救援的人处以罚款。其实要是换了我，非关他们一宿不可。

examples.text: The horse reared, throwing its rider and knocking down a youth standing beside it.
examples.translation: 那匹马尥了个蹶子，把骑手掀下马，还撞倒了旁边站着的一个小伙子。

examples.text: Abidjan was thrown into turmoil because of a protest by taxi drivers...
examples.translation: 出租车司机的抗议使得阿比让陷入了混乱。

examples.text: Economic recession had thrown millions out of work...
examples.translation: 经济衰退导致数百万人失业。

examples.text: The border dispute has threatened to throw next week's OPEC meeting in Geneva into confusion.
examples.translation: 边境纠纷很可能会使下周将在日内瓦举行的石油输出国组织会议陷入混乱。

examples.text: The sunlight is white and blinding, throwing hard-edged shadows on the ground.
examples.translation: 阳光明亮刺眼，在地上投下轮廓分明的影子。

examples.text: This new information does throw doubt on their choice...
examples.translation: 这个新信息确实使人们对他们的选择产生了怀疑。

examples.text: She did not attempt to throw any suspicion upon you.
examples.translation: 她无意让大家怀疑你。

examples.text: Emily turned and threw her a suggestive grin.
examples.translation: 埃米莉转过头，冲她意味深长地一笑。

examples.text: She threw herself into a modelling career...
examples.translation: 她投身于模特事业。

examples.text: They threw all their military resources into the battle.
examples.translation: 他们将全部军事资源都投入了那场战斗。

examples.text: I used to get very upset and scream and swear, throwing tantrums all over the place.
examples.translation: 以前，我动不动就发脾气，大喊大叫，还骂人。

examples.text: The professor rather threw me by asking if I went in for martial arts...
examples.translation: 教授问我是否爱好武术，这个问题让我吃了一惊。

examples.text: Obviously the puncture threw me a little, but I'm reasonably happy.
examples.translation: 显然，轮胎扎破让我感到有些意外，不过我还是挺开心的。

examples.text: I lost my first serve in the first set, it threw me off a bit.
examples.translation: 我在第一局的第一个发球失误，使我有点乱了方寸。

examples.text: Everything was fine until someone threw a punch.
examples.translation: 开头还好好的，后来不知是谁动了拳头。

examples.text: Why not throw a party for your friends?
examples.translation: 干吗不在家里为你的朋友们搞个聚会？

examples.text: Prince Edward threw the switch to light the illuminations.
examples.translation: 爱德华王子按动开关亮起彩灯。

examples.text: ...offering him a bribe to throw the game.
examples.translation: 向他行贿，叫他故意输掉比赛

examples.text: Most applications software for personal computers cost over $500 a throw.
examples.translation: 个人电脑使用的多数应用软件的单价为 500 多美元。

examples.text: I'll say you started it, that you threw yourself at me.
examples.translation: 我觉得是你主动向我投怀送抱。

meanings.meaning: 插入；用向某人刺去；猛然或用力推

examples.text: They thrust him into the back of a jeep...
examples.translation: 他们把他硬塞进吉普车后座。

examples.text: She grabs a stack of baby photos and thrusts them into my hands.
examples.translation: 她抓起一沓婴儿照片塞到我手里。

examples.text: Two of the knife thrusts were fatal.
examples.translation: 有两处刀伤是致命的。

examples.text: She thrust her way into the crowd...
examples.translation: 她一头扎进人群。

examples.text: He reached the garden gate and thrust his way through it.
examples.translation: 他来到花园门口，挤了进去。

examples.text: An aerial thrust up from the grass verge...
examples.translation: 一根天线在草地边上竖立着。

examples.text: A ray of sunlight thrust out through the clouds.
examples.translation: 一缕阳光透过云层照射下来。

examples.text: It provides the thrust that makes the craft move forward.
examples.translation: 它提供了飞机前进所需的推力。

examples.text: The real thrust of the film is its examination of New York's Hasidic community...
examples.translation: 这部电影的真正要旨是它审视了纽约的哈西德教徒。

examples.text: The main thrust of the research will be the study of the early Universe and galaxy formation...
examples.translation: 此项研究的核心是早期宇宙和银河系的形成。

examples.text: The conductor brought home the full thrust of the work's emotional resolution.
examples.translation: 指挥将该作品情感上的毅然决然这一主旨充分表现了出来。

meanings.meaning: 翻阅；以拇指拨弄；作搭车手势；笨拙地摆弄
用拇指翻书页；竖起拇指要求搭车

examples.text: She bit the tip of her left thumb, not looking at me.
examples.translation: 她咬着左手的拇指尖，眼睛也不看我。

examples.text: It may interest you to know that a boy answering Rory's description thumbed a ride to Howth...
examples.translation: 你或许会对这个消息感兴趣，有个和罗里描述的一模一样的小男孩搭便车到了霍斯。

examples.text: Thumbing a lift had once a carefree, easy-going image.
examples.translation: 伸手搭便车曾经给人以轻松随意的形象。

examples.text: Does the new housing stick out like a sore thumb or blend into its surroundings?...
examples.translation: 这个新住宅区是显得有点扎眼，还是和环境融为一体？

examples.text: In Japan a European stands out like a sore thumb.
examples.translation: 欧洲人到了日本会极为惹眼。

examples.text: The prospect of waiting around just twiddling his thumbs was appalling...
examples.translation: 想到将要无所事事，他就非常害怕。

examples.text: The Government cannot expect graduates to twiddle their thumbs on the dole.
examples.translation: 政府不愿意看到毕业生领着救济金却什么也不干。

examples.text: I cannot tell you what pain I feel when I see how much my mother is under my father's thumb...
examples.translation: 看见我母亲完完全全受我父亲的控制，我心里别提有多难受。

examples.text: She has Rachel firmly under her thumb.
examples.translation: 她把雷切尔牢牢地抓在手心里。

examples.text: There was frequent thunder and lightning, and torrential rain.
examples.translation: 雷电交加，大雨倾盆。

examples.text: ...a distant clap of thunder.
examples.translation: 远处一声炸雷

examples.text: The day was heavy and still. It would probably thunder later.
examples.translation: 天色阴沉，一丝风也没有。或许马上就要打雷。

examples.text: The thunder of the sea on the rocks seemed to blank out other thoughts...
examples.translation: 海水拍打礁石的咆哮声似乎要淹没一切思绪。

examples.text: Khalil heard the thunder of an avalanche.
examples.translation: 哈利勒听到了雪崩传来的轰隆声。

examples.text: The horses thundered across the valley floor...
examples.translation: 马群轰隆隆地从谷底奔跑而过。

examples.text: Niccolini was thundering up the stairs, taking them two at a time...
examples.translation: 尼科利尼一步两个台阶地噔噔跑上楼。

examples.text: A lorry thundered by.
examples.translation: 一辆货车轰隆隆地驶过。

examples.text: She heard the sound of the guns thundering in the fog.
examples.translation: 她听到雾中传来隆隆的枪炮声。

examples.text: ...thundering applause.
examples.translation: 雷鸣般的掌声

examples.text: 'It's your money. Ask for it!' she thundered...
examples.translation: “那是你的钱。快去要！”她生气地大喊。

examples.text: The Prosecutor looked toward Napoleon, waiting for him to thunder an objection.
examples.translation: 检察官朝拿破仑望去，等他大声抗议。

examples.text: He had no intention of letting the Foreign Secretary steal any of his thunder.
examples.translation: 他无意让外交大臣抢他的风头。

examples.text: On Thursday Barrett invited me for a drink...
examples.translation: 星期四，巴雷特约我去喝两杯。

examples.text: We go and do the weekly shopping every Thursday morning...
examples.translation: 每周四上午，我们会去采购一周的日用品。

examples.text: I'm always terribly busy on Thursdays.
examples.translation: 一到星期四我就忙得不可开交。

examples.text: Neither of them thought of turning on the lunch-time news. Thus Caroline didn't hear of John's death until Peter telephoned...
examples.translation: 两个人谁也没有想到打开电视看午间新闻，所以直到彼得打来电话，卡罗琳才得知约翰的死讯。

examples.text: Even in a highly skilled workforce some people will be more capable and thus better paid than others.
examples.translation: 就算是在技术高度熟练的劳动者中，也会有人能力更强，因此，薪水也就更高。

examples.text: ...women's access to the basic means of production and thus to political power.
examples.translation: 女性获得基本的生产资料，从而获得政治权力

examples.text: Joanna was pouring the drink. While she was thus engaged, Charles sat on one of the bar-stools...
examples.translation: 乔安娜正在倒酒。就在她正忙的当儿，查尔斯坐在了一张酒吧凳子上。

examples.text: Martin helped his father dig the water gardens out by hand. Thus he discovered his interest in gardening.
examples.translation: 马丁亲手帮他父亲修建起了水景园，就这样对园艺产生了兴趣。

examples.text: His exercise books were full of well deserved red ticks...
examples.translation: 他的练习本上尽是些红钩钩，都是他应得的。

examples.text: Place a tick in the appropriate box.
examples.translation: 在相应的方框里打钩。

examples.text: Please tick this box if you do not wish to receive such mailings...
examples.translation: 如果你不想收到此类邮件，请在这个方框里打钩。

examples.text: As each boy said yes, he ticked their name.
examples.translation: 随着男孩们依次答到，他在他们的名字旁打了钩。

examples.text: A wind-up clock ticked busily from the kitchen counter.
examples.translation: 一只上了弦的钟在厨房的案子上嘀嗒响个不停。

examples.text: A grandfather clock ticked away in a corner.
examples.translation: 一只落地式大摆钟在墙角嘀嗒作响。

examples.text: ...the endless ticking of clocks.
examples.translation: 时钟永无休止的嘀嗒声

examples.text: He sat listening to the tick of the grandfather clock.
examples.translation: 他坐在那儿，听着落地式大摆钟嘀嗒作响。

examples.text: Just hang on a tick, we may be able to help...
examples.translation: 稍等一会儿，我们或许能帮上忙。

examples.text: I'll be back in a tick...
examples.translation: 我马上就回来。

examples.text: I shall be with you in two ticks.
examples.translation: 我过会儿就到。

examples.text: He wanted to find out what made them tick...
examples.translation: 他想搞清楚他们为什么会那样。

examples.text: I'm interested in how people tick.
examples.translation: 我对人们的所思所想很感兴趣。

examples.text: ...chemicals that destroy ticks and mites...
examples.translation: 杀灭蜱和螨虫的化学品

examples.text: Tick bites can cause Lyme disease.
examples.translation: 被蜱叮咬会引发莱姆病。

meanings.meaning: 票；入场券，标签；（美）候选人名单；证明书；交通罚款单
加标签于；指派；对…开出交通违规罚单

examples.text: I queued for two hours to get a ticket to see the football game...
examples.translation: 我排了两个小时的队，就是为了买张足球赛的票。

examples.text: I love opera and last year I got tickets for Covent Garden...
examples.translation: 我喜爱歌剧，去年我搞到几张科芬园皇家歌剧院的票。

examples.text: Entrance is free, but by ticket only...
examples.translation: 免费入场，但是要凭票进去。

examples.text: He became a ticket collector at Waterloo Station.
examples.translation: 他在滑铁卢车站当上了一名检票员。

examples.text: I want to know at what point I break the speed limit and get a ticket.
examples.translation: 我想知道我是在什么地方超速而受到处罚的。

examples.text: She bought a lottery ticket and won more than $33 million.
examples.translation: 她买了张彩票，中了3,300多万美元。

examples.text: He first ran for president on a far-left ticket...
examples.translation: 他第一次代表极左政党参加总统竞选。

examples.text: She would want to fight the election on a ticket of parliamentary democracy...
examples.translation: 她想以实施议会民主制为纲领去参加竞选。

examples.text: It's a ticket that was designed to appeal to suburban and small town voters.
examples.translation: 这一竞选政策意在吸引郊区和小城镇选民。

examples.text: He plans to remain on the Republican ticket for the November election.
examples.translation: 他计划继续代表共和党参加 11 月份的选举。

examples.text: Young kids need all the energy and protein they can get and whole milk is just the ticket.
examples.translation: 儿童需要摄入足量能量和蛋白质，而全脂牛奶正好能满足这一需求。

examples.text: The tide was at its highest...
examples.translation: 潮水正处于最高位。

examples.text: The tide was going out, and the sand was smooth and glittering...
examples.translation: 正在退潮，沙滩平坦，闪着微光。

examples.text: State police say that high tides and severe flooding have damaged beaches.
examples.translation: 州警方称，高潮位和严重的水灾冲坏了海滩。

examples.text: Roman vessels used to sail with the tide from Boulogne to Richborough.
examples.translation: 罗马的船只过去经常乘着潮汐从布洛涅航行到里奇伯勒。

examples.text: The tide of opinion seems overwhelmingly in his favour.
examples.translation: 绝大多数人的观点看来是一边倒地支持他的。

examples.text: They talked of reversing the tide of history...
examples.translation: 他们谈到扭转历史潮流。

examples.text: The tide of war swept back across their country.
examples.translation: 战争的浪潮回过头来席卷了全国。

examples.text: ...an ever increasing tide of crime...
examples.translation: 不断高涨的犯罪浪潮

examples.text: The tide of nationalism is still running high in a number of republics.
examples.translation: 民族主义浪潮在许多共和国势头正盛。

examples.text: Having a tidy desk can seem impossible if you have a busy, demanding job...
examples.translation: 如果工作忙、难度大，要想保持桌面整洁似乎不太可能。

examples.text: I'll do your garden, I'll keep that tidy for you.
examples.translation: 我会帮你弄弄花园，帮你保持它的整洁。

examples.text: ...books and magazines stacked tidily on shelves.
examples.translation: 整整齐齐地摞在架子上的书和杂志

examples.text: ...some tidily arranged papers.
examples.translation: 一些排列整齐的文件

examples.text: Employees are expected to maintain a high standard of tidiness in their dress and appearance.
examples.translation: 员工们要保持着装和仪表高度整洁。

examples.text: She's obsessively tidy, always hoovering and polishing.
examples.translation: 她有洁癖，整天不是用吸尘器吸尘，就是擦来擦去。

examples.text: I'm very impressed by your tidiness and order.
examples.translation: 你的整洁、有条理给我留下了很深的印象。

examples.text: She made her bed, and tidied her room.
examples.translation: 她整理了床铺，收拾了自己的房间。

examples.text: The opportunities are there to make a tidy profit.
examples.translation: 赚大钱的机会就在那儿摆着。

examples.translation: 他把狗拴在了沟旁的一棵树上。

examples.translation: 他把她的双手绑在背后。

examples.text: She tied her scarf over her head...
examples.translation: 她把头巾围在头上。

examples.text: Roll the meat and tie it with string...
examples.translation: 把肉卷起来，用线捆扎牢。

examples.text: Dad handed me a big box wrapped in gold foil and tied with a red ribbon.
examples.translation: 爸爸递给我一个用金箔包装、外面扎了根红丝带的大盒子。

examples.text: He took a short length of rope and swiftly tied a slip knot...
examples.translation: 他拿起一小截绳子，飞快地打了个活结。

examples.text: She tied a knot in her scarf...
examples.translation: 她把围巾打了个结。

examples.text: She grabbed her hair in both hands and swept it back, tying it in a loose knot...
examples.translation: 她用双手揽起头发，拢到脑后，挽成一个松松的结。

examples.text: She wore a checked shirt tied in a knot above the navel.
examples.translation: 她身穿一件格子衬衫，衣角在肚脐上方打了个结。

examples.text: He pulled on his heavy suede shoes and tied the laces.
examples.translation: 他穿上厚厚的软皮鞋，系上鞋带。

examples.text: ...a long white thing around his neck that tied in front in a floppy bow.
examples.translation: 他的脖子上围着个长长的白色的东西，在前面松松地打了个蝴蝶结

examples.text: Jason had taken off his jacket and loosened his tie.
examples.translation: 贾森已经脱下夹克，松开了领带。

examples.text: Their cancers are not so clearly tied to radiation exposure...
examples.translation: 他们的癌症是否和接触放射线有关还不太清楚。

examples.text: My social life and business life are closely tied.
examples.translation: 我的社交生活和工作联系紧密。

examples.text: They had children and were consequently tied to the school holidays...
examples.translation: 他们有孩子，当然就受学校假期的束缚。

examples.text: I wouldn't like to be tied to catching the last train home.
examples.translation: 我不想非得赶最后一趟列车回家。

examples.text: Quebec has always had particularly close ties to France...
examples.translation: 魁北克和法国一向关系特别紧密。

examples.text: I can't find any tie between her and the town...
examples.translation: 我一点也看不出她和那个小镇有什么联系。

examples.text: Louise herself had family ties in Nimes.
examples.translation: 路易丝本人在尼姆有亲戚。

examples.text: Both teams had tied on points and goal difference...
examples.translation: 两支队伍得分和净胜球都相当。

examples.text: Ronan Rafferty had tied with Frank Nobilo.
examples.translation: 罗南·拉弗蒂和弗兰克·诺比洛打成了平局。

examples.text: The first game ended in a tie.
examples.translation: 第一局比赛双方战平。

examples.text: They'll meet the winners of the first round tie.
examples.translation: 他们将迎战第一轮淘汰赛中的胜者。

meanings.meaning: 紧的；密封的；绷紧的；麻烦的；严厉的；没空的；吝啬的

examples.text: She walked off the plane in a miniskirt and tight top...
examples.translation: 她身穿迷你裙和紧身上衣走下了飞机。

examples.text: His jeans were too tight.
examples.translation: 他的牛仔裤太紧了。

examples.text: He buttoned his collar tightly round his thick neck.
examples.translation: 他把衣领的扣子扣上，紧紧地裹住了他的粗脖子。

examples.text: She just fell into my arms, clutching me tight for a moment...
examples.translation: 她正好跌进我的怀里，一时间紧紧地抓着我。

examples.text: Just hold tight to my hand and follow along...
examples.translation: 抓紧我的手，跟着我。

examples.text: Hold on tight!
examples.translation: 抓紧了！

examples.text: As he and Henrietta passed through the gate he kept a tight hold of her arm.
examples.translation: 他和亨丽埃塔通过大门时，他紧紧抓住她的胳膊。

examples.text: She climbed back into bed and wrapped her arms tightly round her body.
examples.translation: 她爬回床上去，双臂紧紧抱住身体。

examples.text: The measures include tight control of media coverage...
examples.translation: 那些措施包括对媒体报道的严格管制。

examples.text: The Government were prepared to keep a tight hold on public sector pay rises...
examples.translation: 政府准备严格控制公共部门的工资增长。

examples.text: Security is tight this week at the polling sites.
examples.translation: 这个星期，各投票点的安全工作抓得很严。

examples.text: The internal media was tightly controlled by the government during the war.
examples.translation: 战争期间，国内媒体被政府牢牢控制着。

examples.text: The baby lay on his back with his eyes closed tight...
examples.translation: 那个婴儿仰面躺着，两眼紧闭。

examples.text: I keep the flour and sugar in individual jars, sealed tight with their glass lids...
examples.translation: 我把面粉和食糖分别放在罐子里，并将玻璃盖子紧紧地盖上。

examples.text: Within minutes she was outside, closing her bedroom door tight behind her...
examples.translation: 不出几分钟，她就出去了，并把卧室的门紧紧带上了。

examples.text: She kept her eyes tight closed.
examples.translation: 她紧闭双目。

examples.text: Pemberton frowned and closed his eyes tightly...
examples.translation: 彭伯顿皱了皱眉，然后把眼睛紧紧闭上。

examples.text: Despite the heat its windows remained tightly closed with wooden shutters.
examples.translation: 虽然天热，窗户却紧闭着，木制百叶窗也放了下来。

examples.text: My skin feels tight and lacking in moisture...
examples.translation: 我的皮肤感觉紧巴巴的，缺少水分。

examples.text: Pull the elastic tight and knot the ends.
examples.translation: 把橡皮筋拽紧，两头打上结。

examples.text: Her sallow skin was drawn tightly across the bones of her face.
examples.translation: 她那蜡黄的皮肤紧紧地包着脸上的骨头。

examples.text: She curled up in a tight ball, with her knees tucked up at her chin...
examples.translation: 她蜷缩成一团，膝盖抵着下巴。

examples.text: The men came in a tight group.
examples.translation: 那些男人密密匝匝地来了。

examples.text: The people sleep on sun loungers packed tight, end to end.
examples.translation: 人们躺在首尾相连、密密排在一起的日光浴床上。

examples.text: Many animals travel in tightly packed lorries and are deprived of food, water and rest.
examples.translation: 许多动物被装上货车运输，车上拥挤不堪，没吃没喝，也得不到休息。

examples.text: It is better to stretch the tight muscles first...
examples.translation: 最好先伸展一下僵硬的肌肉。

examples.text: Sarah came forward with a tight and angry face...
examples.translation: 萨拉走上前来，紧绷着脸，怒气冲冲。

examples.text: 'There were no survivors, of course,' said Fred, his throat tight.
examples.translation: “当然，一个幸存的也没有，”弗雷德说，喉咙发紧。

examples.text: Heart disease often shows itself first as pain or tightness in the chest.
examples.translation: 心脏病的前兆常常是胸口疼痛或憋闷。

examples.text: We're a tight group, so we do keep in touch.
examples.translation: 我们关系很铁，所以的确保持着联系。

examples.text: They collided on a tight bend and both cars were extensively damaged.
examples.translation: 他们在一个急转弯处相撞，两辆车均严重受损。

examples.text: It's difficult to cram everything into a tight schedule...
examples.translation: 日程紧，很难把所有事情都安排进去。

examples.text: Emma is on a tight budget for clothes...
examples.translation: 埃玛预算很紧，没有多少钱买衣裳。

examples.text: Financially things are a bit tight.
examples.translation: 经济上有点吃紧。

examples.text: It was a very tight match...
examples.translation: 参赛双方不分伯仲。

examples.text: The most recent polls predict a tight three-way race.
examples.translation: 最近的调查显示，这将是一场三方激烈角逐的比赛。

examples.text: What about getting new ones — Are you so tight you won't even spend three roubles?
examples.translation: 买些新的怎样——你就小气到连3个卢布也不肯掏吗？

examples.text: That puts the president in a tight spot if the vote is not a resounding 'yes'...
examples.translation: 如果投票结果不是一个响亮的“是”，总统的处境就不妙了。

examples.text: They teach you to use your head to get out of a tight corner.
examples.translation: 他们教你开动脑筋，摆脱困境。

examples.text: Good night, Davey. Sleep tight.
examples.translation: 晚安，戴维。睡个好觉。

examples.text: Amy's shoes squeaked on the tiles as she walked down the corridor...
examples.translation: 埃米走过走廊时，鞋子踩在地砖上嘎吱作响。

examples.text: The cabins had linoleum tile floors.
examples.translation: 船舱地上铺着油毡。

examples.text: ...a broken piece of tile.
examples.translation: 瓷砖碎片

examples.text: ...a fine building, with a neat little porch and ornamental tiles on the roof.
examples.translation: 一幢精致的建筑，有齐整的小巧柱廊，屋顶上覆着装饰瓦

examples.text: He wants to tile the bathroom...
examples.translation: 他想在浴室里铺瓷砖。

examples.text: The terracotta tiled floor gives the place a wonderfully homely character.
examples.translation: 陶瓦地板使这个地方给人一种非常舒适温馨的感觉。

examples.text: ...a slate-tiled floor.
examples.translation: 石铺地板

examples.text: ...a narrow white-tiled room.
examples.translation: 贴有白色瓷砖的窄小房间

examples.text: Charlotte was dressed for a night on the tiles...
examples.translation: 夏洛特为彻夜狂欢精心打扮了一番。

examples.text: I used to be out on the tiles every night.
examples.translation: 我曾每晚都在外面花天酒地。
