examples.text: They had to wait till Monday to ring the bank manager...
examples.translation: 他们必须等到周一才能给银行经理打电话。

examples.text: I've survived till now, and will go on doing so without help from you.
examples.translation: 我一直努力活到了现在，而且没有你的帮助也能继续活下去。

examples.text: I hadn't left home till I was nineteen...
examples.translation: 直到 19 岁我才离开家。

examples.text: They slept till the alarm bleeper woke them at four.
examples.translation: 他们一直睡到4点钟被寻呼机闹钟叫醒。

examples.text: ...long queues at tills that make customers angry.
examples.translation: 收银台前令顾客恼火的长队

examples.text: He checked the register. There was money in the till.
examples.translation: 他查看了一下收银机的抽屉，里面有钱。

examples.text: Workers were singing as they tilled the rice paddy fields.
examples.translation: 劳动者们一边耕犁稻田一边唱歌。

examples.text: ...freshly tilled fields.
examples.translation: 刚犁过的田地

meanings.meaning: 倾斜；翘起；以言词或文字抨击

examples.text: She tilted the mirror and began to comb her hair...
examples.translation: 她斜过镜子开始梳理头发。

examples.text: Leonard tilted his chair back on two legs and stretched his long body...
examples.translation: 伦纳德把椅子向后倾斜，仅以两条腿作支撑，然后舒展开他长长的身躯。

examples.text: The boat instantly tilted, filled and sank.
examples.translation: 船立即倾斜，进了水，然后沉没了。

examples.text: Mari tilted her head back so that she could look at him...
examples.translation: 玛丽把头向后仰，以便能看到他。

examples.text: His wife tilted his head to the side and inspected the wound...
examples.translation: 妻子把他的头侧过去检查他的伤口。

examples.text: She tilted her face to kiss me quickly on the chin.
examples.translation: 她侧过脸飞快地在我下巴上亲了一下。

examples.text: He opened the rear door for me with an apologetic tilt of his head.
examples.translation: 他抱歉地歪着头为我打开后车门。

examples.text: ...calculations based on our understanding of the tilt of the earth's axis...
examples.translation: 基于我们对地轴倾斜度的了解的计算

examples.text: ...the abrupt tilt of the hill...
examples.translation: 山势的陡峭

examples.text: The 3-metre-square slabs are on a tilt.
examples.translation: 3 平方米的厚板倾斜放置着。

examples.text: When the political climate tilted towards fundamentalism he was threatened...
examples.translation: 当政治气候倾向于原教旨主义时，他受到了威胁。

examples.text: He continued to urge the Conservative Party to tilt rightwards...
examples.translation: 他继续敦促保守党奉行右倾路线。

examples.text: The paper has done much to tilt American public opinion in favour of intervention.
examples.translation: 该报做了大量工作，使得美国舆论倾向于支持干涉。

examples.translation: 主席也批评该计划倾向于主张高税收而不是低消费。

examples.text: His first tilt at Parliament came in the same year but he failed to win the seat...
examples.translation: 同年，他首次尝试进入国会，但没有赢得席位。

examples.text: He was determined to use his remaining year with Manchester United for one last tilt at the League title.
examples.translation: 他决心利用他效力曼彻斯特联队的剩余一年时间最后一次冲击联赛冠军。

examples.text: As John approached at full tilt he saw a queue of traffic blocking the road...
examples.translation: 约翰全速接近的时候，看到一大串车辆挡住了道路。

examples.text: Larry Layton's trial is going full tilt right now.
examples.translation: 拉里·莱顿一案的审判工作即将全面展开。

examples.text: These Severn Valley woods have been exploited for timber since Saxon times.
examples.translation: 从撒克逊时代起就开始采伐塞文山谷的这些树林获取木料。

examples.text: ...a single-story timber building.
examples.translation: 木质平房

examples.text: ...a bird nestling in the timbers of the roof.
examples.translation: 栖息于屋顶横梁上的鸟

examples.text: The recent outbreaks of cholera are a timely reminder that this disease is still a serious health hazard...
examples.translation: 最近霍乱的爆发及时提醒了人们该疾病仍然会严重危害健康。

examples.text: The exhibition is timely, since 'self-taught' art is catching on in a big way.
examples.translation: 展会召开得非常及时，因为“自修”艺术正在广泛流行。

examples.text: A timid child, Isabella had learned obedience at an early age.
examples.translation: 伊莎贝拉是一个羞怯的孩子，很小就学会了顺从。

examples.text: She doesn't ridicule my timidity.
examples.translation: 她没有奚落我的羞怯。

examples.text: The little boy stepped forward timidly and shook Leo's hand.
examples.translation: 小男孩羞怯地走上前去握了握利奥的手。

examples.text: The President's critics say he has been too timid in responding to changing international developments...
examples.translation: 批评总统的人认为他在应对风云变幻的国际局势时过于瞻前顾后。

examples.text: The newspaper called the plan timid and unimaginative.
examples.translation: 该报称这一计划谨小慎微，毫无想象力。

examples.text: He was soon disillusioned by the government's timidity on social reform.
examples.translation: 他不久就因政府在进行社会改革时缩手缩脚而不抱幻想了。

examples.text: A number of these states are moving timidly towards multi-party democracy.
examples.translation: 这些国家中有很多正小心翼翼地向多党民主制发展。

examples.translation: 他伸手去够身后架子上的一罐烟叶。

examples.translation: 他们倒出油漆罐里剩下的所有油漆，把它涂在货车的内壁。

examples.text: Pour the mixture into the cake tin and bake for 45 minutes.
examples.translation: 把混合物倒进烤模烤制 45 分钟。

examples.translation: 起居室非常小。

examples.text: Though she was tiny, she had a very loud voice...
examples.translation: 她虽然个头小，嗓音却非常洪亮。

examples.text: The crop represents a tiny fraction of U.S. production.
examples.translation: 农作物仅占美国出产物极小的一部分。

examples.text: The sleeves covered his hands to the tips of his fingers...
examples.translation: 袖子遮住了他的手，一直盖到指尖。

examples.text: This may encourage gold traders to dip their toes back into the markets...
examples.translation: 这可能会促使黄金交易商谨慎地尝试重返市场。

examples.text: Universities are dipping their toes in the waters of management education.
examples.translation: 各大学正开始尝试进入管理教育领域。

examples.text: His fiery campaign rhetoric has kept opposition parties on their toes for months.
examples.translation: 他激烈的竞选言辞使反对党派一连几个月都保持警觉。

examples.text: ...attempts to persuade the rebel members to toe the line...
examples.translation: 说服叛乱分子顺从政府的努力

examples.text: He's one of the politicians that wouldn't toe the party line.
examples.translation: 他是不肯服从政党路线的几个政客之一。

examples.text: I must be careful not to tread on their toes. My job is to challenge, but not threaten them.
examples.translation: 我必须小心谨慎，不能得罪他们。我的工作是挑战他们，而不是威胁他们。

meanings.meaning: 一起；同时；相互；连续地；总共
新潮的；情绪稳定的，做事有效率的

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, together is used in phrasal verbs such as ‘piece together’, ‘pull together’, and ‘sleep together’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，together 还可用于piece together, pull together 和 sleep together 等短语动词中。

examples.text: He and I worked together on a book…
examples.translation: 我和他合写了一本书。

examples.text: They all live together in a three-bedroom house...
examples.translation: 他们全都一块儿住在一幢三居室的房子里。

examples.text: Together they swam to the ship.
examples.translation: 他们一起游向那艘船。

examples.text: Mix the ingredients together thoroughly...
examples.translation: 把配料充分混合。

examples.text: She clasped her hands together on her lap...
examples.translation: 她十指紧扣，放在膝上。

examples.text: If a window is broken, you can't stick it back together again.
examples.translation: 如果窗户碎了，就无法再把它粘回到一起了。

examples.text: The trees grew close together...
examples.translation: 树木密密地长在一起。

examples.text: Ginette and I gathered our things together...
examples.translation: 我和吉内特把东西收拢好。

examples.text: People stood packed together tightly.
examples.translation: 人们拥挤地站在一起。

examples.text: He has done enough to pull the party together...
examples.translation: 他为使政党内部团结一致已经做得够多了。

examples.text: I want us all to be a happy family together…
examples.translation: 我希望我们大家都能在一起，成为一个幸福的家庭。

examples.text: His tough brand of social democracy was largely successful in holding the country together.
examples.translation: 他别具一格的强硬的社会民主主义在很大程度上成功地使该国团结在一起。

examples.text: We are together in the way we're looking at this situation.
examples.translation: 我们对这一形势的看法是一致的。

examples.text: We were together for five years...
examples.translation: 我们共同生活了 5 年。

examples.text: Towards the end of our time together he was impossible…
examples.translation: 到我们在一起的最后那段时间，他简直令人难以忍受。

examples.text: Passion kept us together.
examples.translation: 激情使我们在一起。

examples.text: Three horses crossed the finish line together...
examples.translation: 3 匹马同时越过终点线。

examples.text: 'Yes,' they said together.
examples.translation: “是的，”他们齐声说。

examples.text: The two main right-wing opposition parties together won 29.8 per cent…
examples.translation: 两大右翼反对党合计赢得 29.8% 的选票。

examples.text: The companies have together spent £300 million…
examples.translation: 这些公司总计支出 3 亿英镑。

examples.text: Together they account for less than five per cent of the population...
examples.translation: 他们总共占不到总人口的 5%。

examples.text: The two together are particularly deadly.
examples.translation: 二者相加尤为致命。

examples.text: I can see that some colours go together and some don't...
examples.translation: 我看得出有些颜色很相配，有些就不行。

examples.text: Winckelmann declared that art and freedom went together…
examples.translation: 温克尔曼宣称艺术与自由不可分割。

examples.text: Poverty and illiteracy go together with high birth rates.
examples.translation: 贫困、文盲与高出生率密切相关。

examples.text: She was very headstrong, and very together...
examples.translation: 她非常倔强，又非常精干。

examples.text: I know on the surface I appear to be quite a together person…
examples.translation: 我知道表面上我似乎自信能干。

examples.text: I had to take a break for a cup of tea before I could really get myself together.
examples.translation: 在我能振作精神之前，必须先休息一下喝杯茶。

examples.text: Every month we'll deliver the very best articles, together with the latest fashion and beauty news...
examples.translation: 每个月我们都登载最好的文章，还有最新的时尚美容资讯。

examples.text: A famine started which, together with the war, carried away millions of lives…
examples.translation: 一场饥荒开始了，再加上战争，夺走了几百万条生命。

examples.text: Together with his wife, he helped to draft the ANC's 1955 'Freedom Charter'.
examples.translation: 他和妻子一起协助起草了非洲人国民大会 1955 年《自由宪章》。

meanings.meaning: 时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数
计时；测定…的时间；安排…的速度

examples.text: ...a two-week period of time...
examples.translation: 两周的时间

examples.text: Time passed, and still Ma did not appear...
examples.translation: 时间一点点过去，马先生仍然没有出现。

examples.text: As time went on the visits got more and more regular...
examples.translation: 随着时间的流逝，探访变得越来越频繁。

examples.text: The social significance of religion has changed over time.
examples.translation: 宗教的社会意义随着时间的变迁已经发生了变化。

examples.text: 'What time is it?' — 'Eight o'clock.'...
examples.translation: “几点钟了？”——“8点钟。”

examples.text: He asked me the time...
examples.translation: 他问我几点了。

examples.text: What time did he leave?...
examples.translation: 他什么时候离开的？

examples.text: I phoned my mother to ask what time she was coming home...
examples.translation: 我打电话给母亲问她几点回家。

examples.text: The time is now 19 minutes past the hour.
examples.translation: 现在的时间是整点过19分。

examples.text: Departure times are 08:15 from St Quay, and 18:15 from St Helier.
examples.translation: 从圣奎伊的出发时间是 8 点 15 分，从圣赫利尔的出发时间是 18 点 15 分。

examples.text: The tidal predictions are expressed in Greenwich Mean Time. Add one hour for British Summer Time...
examples.translation: 潮汐预报用的是格林尼治标准时间。英国夏令时要在标准时基础上加一小时。

examples.text: The incident happened just after ten o'clock local time.
examples.translation: 事件发生在当地时间 10 点刚过。

examples.text: Adam spent a lot of time in his grandfather's office...
examples.translation: 亚当经常呆在他祖父的办公室里。

examples.text: He wouldn't have the time or money to take care of me...
examples.translation: 他既不会有时间也不会有钱来照顾我。

examples.text: Listen to me, I haven't got much time...
examples.translation: 听着，我没多少时间。

examples.text: It's obvious that you need more time to think...
examples.translation: 显然你需要更多时间来思考。

examples.text: The route was blocked for some time...
examples.translation: 道路被堵了一段时间。

examples.text: For a long time I didn't tell anyone...
examples.translation: 很久我都没有告诉任何人。

examples.text: A short time later they sat down to eat...
examples.translation: 过了一小会儿，他们坐下来吃东西。

examples.text: Thank you very much for your time.
examples.translation: 非常感谢你抽出了宝贵时间。

examples.text: He was also for a time the art critic of 'The Scotsman'...
examples.translation: 有相当长的一段时间他为《苏格兰人》报撰写艺术评论。

examples.text: He stayed for quite a time...
examples.translation: 他呆了相当长的一段时间。

examples.text: After a time they came to a pond.
examples.translation: 过了好久，他们来到一个池塘。

examples.text: We were in the same college, which was male-only at that time...
examples.translation: 我们那时在同一所学院，当时只招男生。

examples.text: By this time he was thirty...
examples.translation: 到那时他 30 岁了。

examples.text: During the time I was married I tried to be the perfect wife...
examples.translation: 在那段婚姻生活中，我努力要做个完美的妻子。

examples.text: It was a time of terrible uncertainty...
examples.translation: 那是一切都很不确定的一段时间。

examples.text: Homes are more affordable than at any time in the past five years...
examples.translation: 现在住宅比过去5年里的任何时候都要便宜。

examples.text: It seemed like a good time to tell her...
examples.translation: 那似乎是告诉她的好时机。

examples.text: There were times when he would ring his bell at all hours of the day or night.
examples.translation: 有段时间，他白天或晚上随时都可能摁铃。

examples.text: They were hard times and his parents had been struggling to raise their family...
examples.translation: 那是段艰苦时期，他父母一直艰辛地养家糊口。

examples.text: We'll be alone together, quite like old times...
examples.translation: 我们会单独在一起，就像过去那样。

examples.text: We are in one of the most severe recessions in modern times...
examples.translation: 我们正在经历现代最严重的一段经济衰退。

examples.text: A 'Felucca' is the traditional Nile sailboat, unchanged since the time of the pharaohs.
examples.translation: Felucca 是尼罗河地区的传统帆船，自法老时代起就没有变过。

examples.text: He is unafraid to move with the times...
examples.translation: 他敢于与时俱进。

examples.text: This approach is now seriously out of step with the times...
examples.translation: 这种方法如今与时代潮流严重脱节。

examples.text: Johnny has changed his image to fit the times.
examples.translation: 约翰尼已经改变了他的形象以迎合时代潮流。

examples.text: Sarah and I had a great time while the kids were away...
examples.translation: 孩子们不在的时候，我和萨拉度过了一段美好时光。

examples.text: She's had a really tough time the last year and a half...
examples.translation: 这一年半以来，她度过了一段非常艰难的时期。

examples.text: You had an easy time of it at home...
examples.translation: 你在家度过了一段轻松时光。

examples.text: I try to remember all the good times I've had here.
examples.translation: 我试着回忆在这里度过的所有美好时光。

examples.text: Now Martin has begun to suffer the effects of AIDS, and he says his time is running out...
examples.translation: 现在马丁开始遭受艾滋病的折磨，他说他的生命就要走到尽头。

examples.text: Every administration has its time. And when your time is over, you leave...
examples.translation: 每届政府都有其执政期限，任期届满时就得下台。

examples.text: I doubt I would change anything if I had my time again.
examples.translation: 如果能重新活过，我不确定自己是否愿意做出任何改变。

examples.text: Opinion polls indicated a feeling among the public that it was time for a change...
examples.translation: 民意测验表明，公众认为到了改革的时候了。

examples.text: It was time for him to go to work...
examples.translation: 他该去上班了。

examples.text: This was no time to make a speech...
examples.translation: 这不是长篇大论的时候。

examples.text: The time has come to put an end to the conflict...
examples.translation: 结束冲突的时候到了。

examples.text: It's time you went to school.
examples.translation: 你该去上学了。

examples.text: Every time she travels on the bus it's delayed by at least three hours...
examples.translation: 每次她乘公车出行都至少耽搁3个小时。

examples.text: The last time I saw her was about sixteen years ago...
examples.translation: 我上次见她大约是 16 年前了。

examples.text: House prices are rising for the first time since November...
examples.translation: 房价自 11 月以来首次上涨。

examples.text: Next time you go shopping, throw in a few extra fruit and vegetables...
examples.translation: 下次你去买东西，多买点水果蔬菜。

examples.text: Remember that time she picked up my daughter when I was ill?
examples.translation: 还记得那次我生病，她替我接女儿吗？

examples.text: It was her job to make tea three times a day...
examples.translation: 她的差事就是每天沏3次茶。

examples.text: How many times has your mother told you never to talk to strangers?...
examples.translation: 你母亲告诉你多少次了，绝不能和陌生人谈话？

examples.text: The Masters golf tournament was won a second time by the American Ben Hogan.
examples.translation: 美国的本·霍根再次夺得高尔夫大师锦标赛冠军。

examples.text: Its profits are rising four times faster than the average company...
examples.translation: 它的利润增长速度比一般公司快4倍。

examples.text: Young people were several times more likely to be out of work than older members of the workforce...
examples.translation: 劳动人口中，年轻人失业的可能性是年长者的好几倍。

examples.text: He polled four times as many votes as his rival.
examples.translation: 他得到的选票数量是竞选对手的4倍。

examples.text: ...an area five times the size of Britain.
examples.translation: 面积为英国领土5倍大的区域

examples.text: Four times six is 24.
examples.translation: 4 乘以 6 等于 24。

examples.text: He was over a second faster than his previous best time...
examples.translation: 他比自己以前的最好成绩快了 1 秒多。

examples.text: She recorded a time of two minutes 8.74 seconds.
examples.translation: 她以两分 8 秒 74 的成绩创了纪录。

examples.text: A reel is in four-four time, and a jig is in six-eight time.
examples.translation: 里尔舞曲是四四拍，吉格舞曲是六八拍。

examples.text: He timed the election to coincide with new measures to boost the economy...
examples.translation: 他把选举安排在振兴经济的新政策出台时。

examples.text: We had timed our visit for March 7...
examples.translation: 我们把访问时间确定在3月7日。

examples.text: He had timed his intervention well...
examples.translation: 他选择介入的时机恰到好处。

examples.text: Operation Amazon is timed to coincide with the start of the dry season.
examples.translation: 拯救亚马孙河的行动安排在了旱季来临之际。

examples.text: He timed each performance with a stop-watch.
examples.translation: 他用秒表测定每组动作所花的时间。

examples.text: It's about time a few movie makers with original ideas were given a chance...
examples.translation: 该给为数不多的几个有创见的电影制作者一个机会了。

examples.text: 'Here she is.' — 'About time too.'
examples.translation: “她来了。”——“也早该来了。”

examples.text: Find out ahead of time what regulations apply to your situation.
examples.translation: 提前搞清楚什么规章适用于你的情况。

examples.text: My mother was ahead of her time. She surrounded me with culture and art.
examples.translation: 我母亲思想前卫，给予了我文化和艺术的熏陶。

examples.text: His only fundamental mistake, he insists, is that he was 20 years before his time.
examples.translation: 他坚持认为，他仅有的根本性错误是他比时代超前了20年。

examples.text: We can't be together all the time...
examples.translation: 我们不能始终在一起。

examples.text: I get the two of them mixed up all the time, they're so similar.
examples.translation: 我一直把他们俩弄混，他俩太像了。

examples.text: Beat in the eggs, one at a time...
examples.translation: 打入鸡蛋，一次一个。

examples.text: She ran for the staircase and down the steps, taking them two at a time...
examples.translation: 她跑向楼梯，一步两级地奔下台阶。

examples.text: Do you sometimes find that you are doing very little physical exercise for several weeks at a time?
examples.translation: 你有时会不会发现自己一连几个星期都没怎么锻炼过？

examples.text: Conditions are still very tense and the fighting could escalate at any time.
examples.translation: 局势仍然非常紧张，战斗随时可能升级。

examples.text: A trade war would be bad at the best of times, but in the current economic climate, it would be a disaster.
examples.translation: 即使在情况最好的时候贸易战都是有害无利的，而在当前这种经济形势下只会是一场灾难。

examples.text: At one time 400 men, women and children lived in the village.
examples.translation: 曾经有 400 个男人、女人和孩子居住在村子里。

examples.text: ...enormous glaciers, which at one time covered vast areas of the northern hemisphere.
examples.translation: 一度覆盖了北半球辽阔区域的巨大冰川

examples.text: I was afraid of her, but at the same time I really liked her...
examples.translation: 我害怕她，但同时也确实喜欢她。

examples.text: She was somehow able to look sad and cheerful at the same time.
examples.translation: 她能够做出又悲又喜的神情。

examples.text: I don't think I set out to come up with a different sound for each album. At the same time, I do have a sense of what is right for the moment.
examples.translation: 我不觉得我一开始就特意为每张专辑设定了不同的曲风。然而，我确实知道当时想要的是什么感觉。

examples.text: The debate was highly emotional at times...
examples.translation: 辩论有时变得异常情绪化。

examples.text: At times she had an overwhelming desire to see him...
examples.translation: 她有时会特别想见他。

examples.text: He went on listening to her, at times impatient and at times fascinated.
examples.translation: 他继续听她讲，有时很不耐烦，有时深受吸引。

examples.text: 'You've never seen the Marilyn Monroe film?' — 'No, I think it was a bit before my time.'
examples.translation: “你从来没看过玛丽莲·梦露演的电影？”——“是的，她拍电影时我还不记事呢。”

examples.text: The small print has forced me, years before my time, to buy spectacles...
examples.translation: 印刷文字过小迫使我早早就要买眼镜戴。

examples.text: There is nothing like a college town to make you feel old before your time.
examples.translation: 没有哪个地方能像大学城那样让你感到未老先衰。

examples.text: The virus is getting more and more attention, and not before time...
examples.translation: 这种病毒正受到越来越多的关注，其实早该如此。

examples.text: Not before time, that is about to change.
examples.translation: 那一切总算要变了。

examples.text: Scott Hastings has called time on his international career by cutting short his contract.
examples.translation: 斯科特·黑斯廷斯中止合同，结束了他的国际比赛生涯。

examples.text: He is serving 11 years for robbery, and did time for a similar offence before that.
examples.translation: 他因犯抢劫罪正在服11年的刑期，此前他也曾因类似罪行蹲过监狱。

examples.text: The desperate condition of the world is that madness has always been here, and that it will remain so for all time.
examples.translation: 这个世界令人绝望的是，疯狂之事一直存在，而且将永远存在下去。

examples.text: For the time being, however, immunotherapy is still in its experimental stages...
examples.translation: 但免疫疗法目前仍处于实验阶段。

examples.text: The situation is calm for the time being.
examples.translation: 局势暂时稳定。

examples.text: Her daughters visited him from time to time when he was ill.
examples.translation: 他生病的时候她的女儿们时常去探望他。

examples.text: Half the time, I don't have the slightest idea what he's talking about.
examples.translation: 我经常一点儿都听不懂他在说什么。

examples.text: When I think of what he's done to my mother and me, I've just got no time for him...
examples.translation: 想到他对母亲和我所做的一切，我就很讨厌他。

examples.text: I have got a lot of time for people who are prepared to put the welfare of their party above their own vanity.
examples.translation: 我很钦佩那些不计个人名利，以政党的利益为重的人。

meanings.meaning: 象征的；表意的；作为对某事的保证的

examples.text: The announcement was welcomed as a step in the right direction, but was widely seen as a token gesture...
examples.translation: 该公告被认为是向正确方向迈进的一步，因而受到欢迎，但也被普遍看作是一种象征性的姿态。

examples.text: Miners have staged a two-hour token stoppage to demand better pay and conditions…
examples.translation: 矿工们举行了两小时的象征性停工，以要求提高工资和改善工作条件。

examples.text: You described her as the token woman on the shortlist.
examples.translation: 你把她形容为入围名单上象征性的女性人选。

examples.text: …£10 book tokens…
examples.translation: 价值 10 英镑的购书券

examples.text: Here is the fifth token towards our offer. You need six of these tokens.
examples.translation: 这是第 5 张礼券，你需要 6 张才能享受我们的特价。

examples.text: Some of the older telephones still only accept tokens.
examples.translation: 一些较老式的电话机仍然只收代币。

examples.text: He kept sending gifts and assured her that they were merely small tokens of his appreciation…
examples.translation: 他不断送她礼物，并向她保证说这些只是为了略表谢意。

examples.text: As a token of goodwill, I'm going to write another letter.
examples.translation: 为了证明我的善意，我打算再写一封信。

examples.text: …the custom of exchanging love tokens to celebrate February 14.
examples.translation: 互换爱情信物以庆祝 2 月 14 号情人节的风俗

examples.text: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
examples.translation: 停止锻炼会使肌肉萎缩、脂肪增加。同样，如果花更多的精力锻炼，就会减掉脂肪。

examples.text: ...his tolerance and understanding of diverse human nature.
examples.translation: 他对人性多面性的宽容与理解

examples.text: …the acceptance and tolerance of other ways.
examples.translation: 对其他方法的接受与宽容

examples.text: There is lowered pain tolerance, lowered resistance to infection.
examples.translation: 对疼痛的忍耐力降低了，对感染的抵抗力也减弱了。

examples.text: ...a low tolerance of errors.
examples.translation: 对错误的低容忍度

examples.text: As with any drug taken in excess, your body can build up a tolerance to it.
examples.translation: 和过量服用任何其他药物一样，身体会对它产生耐药性。

meanings.meaning: 宽容的；容忍的；有耐药力的

examples.text: They need to be tolerant of different points of view...
examples.translation: 他们需要容忍不同的观点。

examples.text: Other changes include more tolerant attitudes to unmarried couples having children.
examples.translation: 其他变化包括对非婚夫妇生育更为宽容的态度。

examples.text: She had listened tolerantly to his jumbled account.
examples.translation: 她一直包容地听着他语无伦次的描述。

examples.text: ...plants which are more tolerant of dry conditions...
examples.translation: 更耐旱的植物

examples.text: Today's floppy disc drives are tolerant of poor quality discs.
examples.translation: 现在的软驱对质量低劣的软盘也能读取。

examples.text: She made Tina flush the pills down the toilet.
examples.translation: 她让蒂娜把药丸扔进马桶里冲走。

examples.text: Annette ran and locked herself in the toilet...
examples.translation: 安妮特跑向洗手间，把自己锁在里面。

examples.text: Fred never uses public toilets.
examples.translation: 弗雷德从不使用公共厕所。

examples.text: She can no longer tolerate the position that she's in...
examples.translation: 她再也受不了自己的处境了。

examples.text: The cousins tolerated each other, but did not really get on well together.
examples.translation: 这对表亲互相容忍，但是相处得并不真正融洽。

examples.text: …his views on religious toleration, education, and politics.
examples.translation: 他对宗教宽容、教育和政治的看法

examples.text: The ability to tolerate pain varies from person to person.
examples.translation: 对疼痛的忍受力因人而异。

meanings.meaning: 通行费；代价；钟声；伤亡人数

examples.text: Church bells tolled and black flags fluttered...
examples.translation: 教堂丧钟敲响，黑色的旗帜飘动。

examples.text: The pilgrims tolled the bell.
examples.translation: 朝圣者缓缓敲响了钟。

examples.text: There are fears that the casualty toll may be higher.
examples.translation: 有人担心伤亡总数可能会更高。

examples.text: …the second highest annual murder toll in that city's history.
examples.translation: 年谋杀案件总数处于该市历史上的第二高位

examples.text: Winter takes its toll on your health...
examples.translation: 冬天对健康不利。

examples.text: Higher fuel prices took their toll.
examples.translation: 燃料提价产生了恶果。

examples.text: …a high exchange rate took a heavy toll on industry.
examples.translation: 高汇率使工业蒙受了严重损失。

examples.text: Mr. Mackinnon-Patterson calls for adding tomato juice to the risotto once it is almost cooked through.
The first Tomb Raider, which sold more than 2.5 million copies, launched Croft to star status.
Bye, see you tomorrow...
examples.translation: 再见，明天见。

examples.text: The first official results will be announced tomorrow.
examples.translation: 第一批官方结果将于明天宣布。

examples.text: What's on your agenda for tomorrow?…
examples.translation: 你明天的日程是怎么安排的？

examples.text: Davies plays for the Barbarians in tomorrow's match against England...
examples.translation: 戴维斯将在明天对阵英格兰队的比赛中为野人队效力。

examples.text: Tomorrow is Christmas Day.
examples.translation: 明天是圣诞节。

examples.text: What is education going to look like tomorrow?
examples.translation: 未来的教育会是什么样子？

examples.text: ...tomorrow's computer industry...
examples.translation: 未来的计算机产业

examples.text: Experiences in the past become a part of us, affecting our tomorrows.
examples.translation: 过去的经历成为我们的一部分，影响我们的未来。

meanings.meaning: (Ton)人名；(西、俄、捷、荷)托恩；(柬)敦；(东南亚国家华语)通；(朝)敦

examples.text: Hundreds of tons of oil spilled into the sea...
examples.translation: 数百吨石油溢出流入大海。

examples.text: Getting rid of rubbish can cost $100 a ton.
examples.translation: 清除垃圾每吨要花费 100 美元。

examples.text: If you do something awful they all come down on you like a ton of bricks.
examples.translation: 如果你做了错事，他们全都会对你大发雷霆。

meanings.meaning: 颜色调和；呈现悦目色调

examples.text: Cross could hear him speaking in low tones to Sarah.
examples.translation: 克罗斯听得到他对萨拉低声说话。

examples.text: ...the clear tone of the bell.
examples.translation: 清亮的铃音

examples.text: I still didn't like his tone of voice...
examples.translation: 我还是不喜欢他说话的语气。

examples.text: Suddenly he laughed again, this time with a cold, sharp tone…
examples.translation: 突然他又笑了，这次笑得冷漠、刺耳。

examples.text: Her tone implied that her patience was limited.
examples.translation: 她的口气暗示她的耐心是有限的。

examples.text: The spokesman said the tone of the letter was very friendly...
examples.translation: 发言人说信函的语气非常友好。

examples.text: His comments to reporters were conciliatory in tone...
examples.translation: 他对记者们的讲话带着安抚的口吻。

examples.text: The whole tone of President Suharto's speech was one of continuity and stability.
examples.translation: 苏哈托总统演讲的整个基调是强调连续性与稳定性。

examples.text: The high tone of the occasion was assured by the presence of a dozen wealthy patrons…
examples.translation: 十几位富有资助人的出席确保了仪式的高格调。

examples.text: The service desk at the entrance, with its friendly, helpful and efficient staff, sets the tone for the rest of the store.
examples.translation: 入口处设有服务台，加之友好、热心与高效的服务人员，营造了这家商店的整体氛围。

examples.text: ...stretch exercises that aim to improve muscle tone...
examples.translation: 旨在提高肌肉结实度的伸展锻炼

examples.text: Keeping your muscles strong and in tone helps you to avoid back problems.
examples.translation: 保持肌肉强健有力有助于避免背部疾病。

examples.text: This movement lengthens your spine and tones the spinal nerves...
examples.translation: 这一动作舒展脊椎，使脊神经更加强健。

examples.text: Try these toning exercises before you start the day.
examples.translation: 在开始一天的活动之前，试着做做这些强身健体的体操。

examples.text: ...finely toned muscular bodies.
examples.translation: 健美强壮的身体

examples.text: Exercise tones up your body...
examples.translation: 锻炼使身体结实强健。

examples.text: Although it's not strenuous exercise, you feel toned-up, supple and relaxed.
examples.translation: 虽然这不是剧烈运动，但会让人感到强健、柔韧与放松。

examples.text: Each brick also varies slightly in tone, texture and size...
examples.translation: 每块砖在色调、质地与大小上也都略有不同。

examples.text: I'm a cheery sort of person, so I like cheerful tones.
examples.translation: 我是个活泼类型的人，因此喜欢明亮的色调。

examples.text: …two-tone, striped wallpaper.
examples.translation: 两种色调、带条纹的墙纸

examples.text: Princess Margaret toned with her in a turquoise print dress.
examples.translation: 玛格丽特公主那条青绿色的印花裙子与她很相配。

examples.text: The bowls tone in cleverly with the mugs.
examples.translation: 那些碗与杯子巧妙相配。

examples.text: Councillors say plastic-framed windows lower the tone of the neighbourhood.
examples.translation: 市政会委员说塑料框架的窗户让这个社区掉份儿了。

examples.text: When Ken Hom wrote his first book for the BBC he was asked to tone down the spices and garlic in his recipes.
examples.translation: 当肯·霍姆为英国广播公司写第一本书的时候，他被要求在菜谱里少用些香料和大蒜。

examples.text: I walked over to the mirror and stuck my tongue out...
examples.translation: 我走到镜子前面伸出舌头。

examples.text: She ran her tongue around her lips.
examples.translation: 她用舌头舔了舔嘴唇。

examples.text: …her sharp wit and quick tongue…
examples.translation: 她敏捷的才思和伶俐的口齿

examples.text: She had a nasty tongue, but I liked her.
examples.translation: 她言辞尖刻，但我喜欢她。

examples.text: The French feel passionately about their native tongue.
examples.translation: 法国人对他们的母语非常热爱。

examples.text: A yellow tongue of flame shot upwards.
examples.translation: 一条黄色的火舌直冲上天。

examples.text: …a silver, frozen tongue of water.
examples.translation: 一条冻结了的银色水舌

examples.text: ...a lighthearted, tongue-in-cheek approach...
examples.translation: 漫不经心、虚情假意的态度

examples.text: This is all slightly tongue-in-cheek, I'd like to make that clear…
examples.translation: 这一切都有些缺少诚意，我想清楚地指出这点。

examples.text: Were they written tongue-in-cheek, or with an underlying conviction?
examples.translation: 它们只是随便写出来的呢，还是有什么深层的信念？

examples.text: Douglas held his tongue, preferring not to speak out on a politically sensitive issue.
examples.translation: 道格拉斯沉默不语，不愿谈论政治敏感问题。

examples.text: At one stage he referred to Anna as John's fiancée, but later said that was a slip of the tongue.
examples.translation: 曾有那么一段时间他把安娜称作约翰的未婚妻，但后来又说那是口误。

examples.text: I'm at home tonight...
examples.translation: 我今晚在家。

examples.text: Tonight, I think he proved to everybody what a great player he was...
examples.translation: 我认为今晚他向所有人证明了他是个多么出色的选手。

examples.text: There they will stay until 11 o'clock tonight.
examples.translation: 他们今晚将一直在那里呆到 11 点钟。

examples.text: Tonight is the opening night of the opera.
examples.translation: 今晚是这部歌剧的首演之夜。

examples.text: ...tonight's flight to London.
examples.translation: 今晚去伦敦的航班

examples.text: 'Nice to talk to you.' — 'Nice to talk to you too.'...
examples.translation: “和你谈话很高兴。”——“我也一样。”

examples.text: 'I've got a great feeling about it.' — 'Me too.'...
examples.translation: “我感觉这次一定没问题。”——“我也是。”

examples.text: Depression may be expressed physically too…
examples.translation: 抑郁症也会表现在身体状况上。

examples.text: He doesn't want to meet me. I, too, have been afraid to talk to him...
examples.translation: 他不想见我。我也害怕和他谈话。

examples.text: We talked to her agent. He's your agent, too, right?
examples.translation: 我们和她的经纪人谈过了。他也是你的经纪人，对吧？

examples.text: We did learn to read, and quickly too...
examples.translation: 我们确实学会了阅读，而且学得很快。

examples.text: People usually think of it as a 'boys' book', which of course it is, and a very good one too.
examples.translation: 人们通常把它看作“男孩读物”，它当然是，而且还是本很不错的男孩读物。

examples.text: 'That money's mine.' — 'Of course it is, and quite right too.'...
examples.translation: “那笔钱是我的。”——“当然是你的，而且也理应如此。”

examples.text: 'Oh excuse me.' — 'I should think so too.'...
examples.translation: “哦，请原谅。”——“你确实应该感到抱歉。”

examples.text: The banks are being told to think about small businesses a little more. And about time too.
examples.translation: 银行被告知要更多地为小企业考虑一下。的确是时候该这样做了。

examples.text: 'I'm getting a bike for my birthday.' — 'You are not.' – 'I am too.'
examples.translation: “我过生日想要一辆自行车。”——“不行。”——“我就要。”

examples.text: Leather jeans that are too big will make you look larger...
examples.translation: 过于肥大的皮裤会让你看起来块头更大。

examples.text: Eggs shouldn't be kept in the fridge, it's too cold...
examples.translation: 鸡蛋不应保存在冰箱里，温度太低了。

examples.text: The shaking inside may be due to low blood sugar, too much caffeine or too many cigarettes…
examples.translation: 心悸可能是由于低血糖、咖啡因过量或抽烟过多。

examples.text: She was drinking too much, eating too much, having too many late nights...
examples.translation: 她饮酒过度，吃得过多，熬夜过于频繁。

examples.text: 'I've come to see Miss Ridley.' — 'Then I'm afraid you're too late, sir. She's gone.'
examples.translation: “我来见里德利小姐。”——“那您恐怕来得太晚了，先生。她已经走了。”

examples.text: …I know you need your freedom too much to stay with me.
examples.translation: 我知道你太需要自由了，无法和我在一起。

examples.text: Americans are never too keen to leave their beloved country…
examples.translation: 美国人从不急于离开他们热爱的国家。

examples.text: I wasn't too happy with what I'd written so far...
examples.translation: 我对于目前已写完的这些并不太满意。

examples.text: He won't be too pleased to see you.
examples.translation: 他见到你不会很高兴的。

examples.text: 'I'll try and get you a cake.' — 'Oh Ann you're too kind.'
examples.translation: “我会设法为你弄来一个蛋糕。”——“噢，安，你真是太好了。”

examples.text: She remembered it all too well...
examples.translation: 她记得太清楚了。

examples.text: She is all too aware that we should be grateful for good health…
examples.translation: 我们应对健康的身体心存感恩，这一点她太清楚了。

examples.text: The letter spoke only too clearly of his anxiety for her.
examples.translation: 那封信再明白不过地倾诉了他对她的渴望。

examples.text: They think this is too little too late…
examples.translation: 他们认为这已经为时已晚了。

examples.text: The government is now bringing in laws to reduce air pollution. But, is it a case of too little, too late?
examples.translation: 政府如今正引入法律以减少空气污染。但这是否为时已晚了呢？

使用工具；用机床装备工厂

examples.text: I find the best tool for the purpose is a pair of shears.
examples.translation: 我发现做这件事最得力的工具是一把大剪刀。

examples.text: Writing is a good tool for discharging overwhelming feelings…
examples.translation: 写作是宣泄强烈感情的好方法。

examples.text: The video has become an invaluable teaching tool...
examples.translation: 录像已经成为非常有用的教学手段。

examples.text: The threat of bankruptcy is a legitimate tool to extract money from them.
examples.translation: 破产威胁是从他们那里索得钱款的合法手段。

examples.text: He became the tool of the security services.
examples.translation: 他成了安全部门的工具。

examples.text: They're here to learn the tools of their trade from their American colleagues...
examples.translation: 他们来这里向美国同事学习行业技术和技能。

examples.text: Black-leather jackets and tattoos are the standard tools of the trade for heavy-metal musicians.
examples.translation: 黑皮夹克与纹身是重金属乐手的标准行头。

examples.text: She had very pretty straight teeth...
examples.translation: 她有一口漂亮整齐的牙齿。

examples.text: If a tooth feels very loose, your dentist may recommend that it's taken out.
examples.translation: 如果某颗牙松动得很厉害，牙医会建议把它拔掉。

examples.text: The front cog has 44 teeth.
examples.translation: 前齿轮有 44 个齿。

examples.text: The opposition argues that the new council will be unconstitutional and without teeth...
examples.translation: 反对派争辩说新委员会不但违反宪法，而且没有效力。

examples.text: The law must have teeth, and it must be enforced.
examples.translation: 法律必须拥有效力，而且必须强制实施。

examples.text: Both sides were armed to the teeth.
examples.translation: 双方都全副武装。

examples.text: ...director John Glen, who cut his teeth on Bond movies...
examples.translation: 从邦德电影开始初试牛刀的导演约翰·格伦

examples.text: He cut his teeth in the sixties as director of Edinburgh's Traverse Theatre.
examples.translation: 他 60 年代刚出道时在爱丁堡特拉弗斯剧院担任导演。

examples.text: Their voices set your teeth on edge.
examples.translation: 他们的声音让你浑身不舒服。

examples.text: He fought tooth and nail to keep his job...
examples.translation: 他竭尽全力保住自己的工作。

examples.text: Unions pledged to fight any compulsory redundancies 'tooth and nail'.
examples.translation: 工会许诺会“竭尽所能地”阻止任何强制裁员。

examples.text: This role gave her something to get her teeth into...
examples.translation: 这一角色让她全情投入其中。

examples.text: They have to get involved and get their teeth into some police work.
examples.translation: 他们必须参与进来，全力投入到一些警务工作中。

examples.text: I was battling my way along the promenade in the teeth of a force ten gale...
examples.translation: 我不顾十级大风沿着步行街挣扎前行。

examples.text: In the teeth of the longest recession since the 1930s, the company continues to perform well.
examples.translation: 尽管面对 20 世纪 30 年代以来持续时间最长的经济衰退，这家公司却一直经营良好。

examples.text: Aren't I a bit long in the tooth to start being an undergraduate?
examples.translation: 我现在才去读大学本科不是有点太老了吗？

examples.text: Add more honey if you have a sweet tooth.
examples.translation: 如果你喜欢吃甜的就多加点蜂蜜。

meanings.meaning: 主题（等于theme）；题目；一般规则；总论

examples.text: The weather is a constant topic of conversation in Britain…
examples.translation: 在英国，天气是交谈中永恒的话题。

examples.text: The main topic for discussion is political union...
examples.translation: 讨论的主题是政治联合。

examples.text: They offer tips on topics such as home safety.
examples.translation: 他们就家居安全等问题提供建议。

meanings.meaning: 火把，火炬；手电筒；启发之物

examples.text: They lit a torch and set fire to the chapel's thatch.
examples.translation: 他们点着一支火把，放火烧了小教堂的茅草屋顶。

examples.text: …a torch-lit march for peace.
examples.translation: 要求和平的火炬示威游行

examples.text: The gang worked for up to ten hours with acetylene torches to open the vault.
examples.translation: 那伙匪徒为打开金库用氧乙炔炬干了长达10个小时。

examples.text: The rioters torched the local library...
examples.translation: 暴乱者放火烧了当地的图书馆。

examples.text: Cars and trucks have been torched, bottles and bricks thrown.
examples.translation: 轿车、卡车被放火焚烧，瓶子与砖块乱砸乱飞。

examples.text: He has always carried a torch for Barbara.
examples.translation: 他一直单恋芭芭拉。

examples.text: This group aims to carry the torch for the millions who demonstrated and the thousands who died...
examples.translation: 这个团体旨在将游行示威的数百万人与死去的数千人的信念传承下去。

examples.text: Since his death in 1985 his widow has carried the torch of his Stalinist legacy.
examples.translation: 自从他 1985 年去世以来，他的遗孀一直致力于保存和发扬他的斯大林主义遗产。

examples.text: The torment of having her baby kidnapped is written all over her face.
examples.translation: 因孩子被绑架所受的万分折磨全写在她脸上。

examples.text: He spent days in torment while the police searched for his stolen car.
examples.translation: 在警方搜寻他遭窃汽车的同时，他在极度苦恼中过了好些天。

examples.text: Sooner or later most writers end up making books about the torments of being a writer...
examples.translation: 或早或晚，大多数作家最终都会著书讲述身为作家的苦恼。

examples.text: Outdoors, mosquitoes and midges were a perpetual torment.
examples.translation: 在户外，蚊子和蠓虫永远让人不得安生。

examples.text: At times the memories returned to torment her...
examples.translation: 有时，她再度想起往事，又会痛苦万分。

examples.text: He had lain awake all night, tormented by jealousy.
examples.translation: 他彻夜未眠，深受嫉妒的折磨。

examples.text: My older brother and sister used to torment me by singing it to me.
examples.translation: 哥哥姐姐以前常唱那首歌来戏弄我。

超越，超过；给…加盖；达到…的顶端

examples.text: I waited at the top of the stairs.
examples.translation: 我在楼梯顶端等着。

examples.text: ...the picture at the top of the page...
examples.translation: 书页天头的图片

examples.translation: 把饼干烤 20 到 25 分钟，直到表面略呈棕色。
