examples.translation: 子弹已经进入了大脑顶部。

examples.text: ...the top corner of his newspaper.
examples.translation: 他报纸顶端的一角

examples.text: I can't reach the top shelf...
examples.translation: 我够不着最上面的架子。

examples.text: Our new flat was on the top floor...
examples.translation: 我们的新公寓在顶层。

examples.text: A plastic surgeon can remove the top layer of skin.
examples.translation: 整形外科医生可以除去最表层的皮肤。

examples.text: ...the plastic tops from aerosol containers.
examples.translation: 喷雾剂容器的塑料盖子

examples.text: ...a bottle top.
examples.translation: 瓶塞

examples.text: ...a little shop at the top of the street...
examples.translation: 在街道那头的小店

examples.text: He moved to the empty chair at the top of the table.
examples.translation: 他挪到桌子另一端的空椅子上坐下。

examples.text: ...the hill near the top end of the garden.
examples.translation: 靠近花园那头的小山

examples.text: ...the top corridor of the main building.
examples.translation: 主楼另一端的走廊

examples.text: Look at my new top.
examples.translation: 看看我的新上衣。

examples.text: The vehicles have a top speed of 80 kilometres per hour.
examples.translation: 这些车辆最高时速为 80 公里。

examples.text: ...a top-ranking Saudi officer.
examples.translation: 最高级别的沙特阿拉伯军官

examples.text: For $50, the guests got three courses of top nosh, fizz, wine, and beer.
examples.translation: 花 50 美元，客人们就尝到了三道美味菜肴，还有汽水、葡萄酒和啤酒。

examples.text: We started from the bottom and we had to work our way up to the top.
examples.translation: 我们从最底层开始，是一步一步奋斗到最高层的。

examples.text: ...his dramatic rise to the top of the military hierarchy.
examples.translation: 他戏剧性地晋升至最高军阶

examples.text: …the man at the top.
examples.translation: 地位最高的人

examples.text: I need to have the top people in this company pull together.
examples.translation: 我需要将公司的最高层团结起来。

examples.text: So you want to be a top model…
examples.translation: 这么说，你想成为超级名模喽。

examples.text: The President met this afternoon with his top military advisers...
examples.translation: 总统今天下午会见了他最得力的军事顾问。

examples.text: Those are some of the top stories in the news.
examples.translation: 以上是一些要闻。

examples.text: The United States will be at the top of the medal table...
examples.translation: 美国将在奖牌榜上位列第一。

examples.text: Labour was top of the poll with forty-six percent.
examples.translation: 工党以 46% 的得票数高居首位。

examples.text: He was the top student in physics…
examples.translation: 他是物理尖子。

examples.text: I usually came top in English.
examples.translation: 我英语常得第一。

examples.text: Cleaning up the water supply is their top priority...
examples.translation: 清洁供水系统是他们的当务之急。

examples.text: On arrival, a six-course meal was top of the agenda.
examples.translation: 他们到达之后要做的第一件事是吃一顿六道菜的大餐。

examples.text: He was Italy's top scorer during the World Cup matches...
examples.translation: 他是世界杯比赛期间意大利队进球最多的球员。

examples.text: Management consultancy was the top choice of career among 11,500 students in a survey this year…
examples.translation: 在今年一项对 11,500 名学生进行的调查中，管理顾问是首选职业。

examples.text: It was the first time a Japanese manufacturer had topped the list for imported vehicles...
examples.translation: 这是日本制造商初次占据进口车排行的首位。

examples.text: So what happens if the Socialists top the poll but fall short of an absolute majority?
examples.translation: 那么如果社会党人得票居首却达不到绝对多数会怎么样？

examples.text: Imports topped £10 billion last month...
examples.translation: 上个月进口总额超过了 100 亿英镑。

examples.text: These five schools are in the state's top 5% in achievement scores, one school topping the score for the whole state.
examples.translation: 这 5 所学校的成绩在该州居前 5%，其中一所的成绩高于全州所有其他学校。

examples.text: The holiest of their chapels are topped with gilded roofs...
examples.translation: 他们最神圣的教堂屋顶镀了金。

examples.text: To serve, top the fish with the cooked leeks.
examples.translation: 上菜时，把炒好的韭葱覆在鱼上。

examples.text: ...the glass-topped table.
examples.translation: 玻璃面餐桌

examples.text: How are you going to top that?
examples.translation: 你怎样超过那个？

examples.text: The publisher expected the book to sell 1,500 copies, tops...
examples.translation: 出版商预计该书至多能卖出 1,500 本。

examples.text: Be here in half an hour, tops.
examples.translation: 最晚半个小时以后到这里。

examples.text: He reckons a hundred is tops.
examples.translation: 他认为 100 是上限了。

examples.text: Majorca and Ibiza are tops for holiday bargain-hunters in June…
examples.translation: 对于实惠型度假者来说，马略卡岛与伊维萨岛是 6 月份的绝好选择。

examples.text: The United States was tops in finance and services…
examples.translation: 美国在金融业与服务业方面无可匹敌。

examples.text: I thought it was the tops so I bought it.
examples.translation: 我认为再找不到比它更好的，所以就买下了。

examples.text: He blew his top after airport officials refused to let him on a plane.
examples.translation: 机场工作人员拒绝让他登机之后，他勃然大怒。

examples.text: The only way to come out on top is to adopt a different approach.
examples.translation: 脱颖而出的唯一途径就是采用一种不同的方法。

examples.text: People will always pay top dollar for something exclusive.
examples.translation: 人们总是会为绝无仅有的东西付出高价。

examples.text: …a club frequented by top-dollar models and their movie star companions.
examples.translation: 身价最高的模特与她们的影星同伴经常光顾的俱乐部

examples.text: She would clean the house from top to bottom.
examples.translation: 她会把房子彻底打扫一下。

examples.text: They were sensibly dressed from top to toe in rain gear.
examples.translation: 他们从头到脚都用雨具捂得严严实实，非常明智。

examples.text: Things have been getting on top of me lately.
examples.translation: 最近事情太多，压得我透不过气来。

examples.text: It was the best I could think of off the top of my head.
examples.translation: 这是我一时所能想到的最好的办法。

examples.text: ...the vacuum flask that was resting on top of the stove.
examples.translation: 放在炉子上的保温瓶

examples.text: …the fairy on top of the Christmas tree…
examples.translation: 圣诞树顶上的仙子

examples.text: Place the sliced pork fillet on top and pour a little sauce over it.
examples.translation: 把切成片的猪肉里脊放在上面，再往上浇点调味汁。

examples.text: A stepfamily faces all the problems that a normal family has, with a set of additional problems on top…
examples.translation: 再婚家庭会面临正常家庭的所有问题，外加一堆额外难题。

examples.text: An extra 700 jobs are being cut on top of the 2,000 that were lost last year.
examples.translation: 除了去年被裁掉的 2,000 个职位，还有700个岗位在裁撤中。

examples.text: How does he stay on top, 17 years after becoming foreign minister?
examples.translation: 他是怎样在成为外交大臣以后的17年间保住最高职位的？

examples.text: ...the government's inability to get on top of the situation.
examples.translation: 政府无力掌控局势

examples.text: Two months before she gave birth to Jason she left work feeling on top of the world.
examples.translation: 生贾森前的两个月，她辞工回家，感觉无比幸福。

examples.text: I have overcome this problem by placing a sheet of polythene over the top of the container...
examples.translation: 我在容器上盖了一片聚乙烯塑料薄膜，解决了这个问题。

examples.text: Stir the sauce and pour it over the top.
examples.translation: 搅拌调味汁，把它浇在上面。

examples.text: The special effects are a bit over the top but I enjoyed it.
examples.translation: 特效有点夸张，但是我喜欢。

examples.text: He sees himself going right to the top of the tree.
examples.translation: 他预见自己在同行中将无人可及。

examples.text: 'Stephen!' shouted Marcia at the top of her voice.
examples.translation: “斯蒂芬！”马西娅放声大喊。

meanings.meaning: 奔流；倾注；迸发；连续不断

examples.text: Torrents of water gushed into the reservoir...
examples.translation: 急流涌入了水库。

examples.text: The rain came down in torrents, and we could see nothing…
examples.translation: 大雨倾盆而下，我们看不见任何东西。

examples.text: The trip involved crossing a raging torrent.
examples.translation: 旅途中要穿过一条水势凶猛的急流。

examples.text: He turned round and directed a torrent of abuse at me.
examples.translation: 他转过身来冲我劈头盖脸地骂了一通。

examples.text: …a £45,000 offer which prompted a torrent of criticism in the media.
examples.translation: 激起媒体一片指责的 4.5 万英镑的出价

examples.text: French police are convinced that she was tortured and killed...
examples.translation: 法国警方确信她是被拷打致死。

examples.text: Three members of the group had been tortured to death…
examples.translation: 该团体中有三个人被拷打致死。

examples.text: They never again tortured a prisoner in his presence.
examples.translation: 他们再也没有当他的面严刑拷打过囚犯。

examples.text: ...alleged cases of torture and murder by the security forces...
examples.translation: 指控安全部队严刑拷问和谋杀的案例

examples.text: Many died under torture, others committed suicide…
examples.translation: 很多人被酷刑折磨致死，另一些人则选择了自杀。

examples.text: I had thought this was a medieval torture that had mercifully disappeared.
examples.translation: 我还以为这是中世纪的酷刑，早已令人庆幸地不复存在了。

examples.text: He would not torture her further by trying to argue with her...
examples.translation: 他不愿与她争辩，让她更痛苦。

examples.text: She tortured herself with fantasies of Bob and his new girlfriend.
examples.translation: 她想象着鲍勃和他的新女友在一起的情形，心里备受煎熬。

examples.text: Waiting for the result was torture...
examples.translation: 等待结果的过程是一种折磨。

examples.text: The friction of the sheets against his skin was torture…
examples.translation: 被单摩擦着他的皮肤，简直像是酷刑。

examples.text: Learning — something she had always loved — became a torture.
examples.translation: 学习——她一直喜欢的事情——变成了一种痛苦。

meanings.meaning: 投掷；摇荡；投掷的距离；掷币赌胜负
投掷；使…不安；突然抬起；使…上下摇动；与…掷币打赌
辗转；被乱扔；颠簸；掷钱币决定某事

examples.text: He screwed the paper into a ball and tossed it into the fire...
examples.translation: 他把纸揉成一团扔进火里。

examples.text: He tossed his blanket aside and got up…
examples.translation: 他把毯子掀到一边起了身。

examples.text: He tossed Malone a can of beer, and took one himself.
examples.translation: 他扔给马隆一罐啤酒，自己也拿了一罐。

examples.text: 'I'm sure I don't know.' Cook tossed her head...
examples.translation: “我确信我不知道。”库克一甩头说。

examples.text: Gasping, she tossed her hair out of her face.
examples.translation: 她气喘吁吁地把头发从脸上甩开。

examples.text: With a toss of his head and a few hard gulps, Bob finished the last of his beer.
examples.translation: 鲍勃猛一仰脖，咕嘟咕嘟几大口喝完了杯中剩下的啤酒。

examples.text: We tossed a coin to decide who would go out and buy the buns.
examples.translation: 我们掷硬币决定谁出去买小圆面包。

examples.text: It would be better to decide it on the toss of a coin.
examples.translation: 还不如用抛硬币的方法来决定。

examples.text: Bangladesh won the toss and decided to bat first.
examples.translation: 孟加拉国队掷硬币赢了，决定先击球。

examples.text: The seas grew turbulent, tossing the small boat like a cork...
examples.translation: 海浪变得汹涌澎湃，把小船像漂浮的软木塞一样抛来甩去。

examples.text: As the plane was tossed up and down, the pilot tried to stabilise it.
examples.translation: 飞机上下颠簸，飞行员试图将其稳住。

examples.text: Do not toss the salad until you're ready to serve...
examples.translation: 到快上菜时再轻轻搅拌色拉。

examples.text: Add the grated orange rind and toss the apple slices in the mixture...
examples.translation: 加入磨碎的橙皮，再将苹果片在其中轻拌。

examples.text: Serve straight from the dish with a tossed green salad.
examples.translation: 配上拌过了的田园色拉直接上桌。

examples.text: They were still arguing the toss about the first goal...
examples.translation: 他们仍在为第一个进球争论不休。

examples.text: They spend so much time arguing the toss over inconsequential matters.
examples.translation: 他们花了这么多时间为无关紧要的事争个没完。

examples.text: Well, who gives a toss about sophistication anyway?...
examples.translation: 嗯，不管怎样，谁会在意高雅时髦呢？

examples.text: I don't give a toss what people think…
examples.translation: 我才不在乎人们怎么想呢。

examples.text: The rest of us really couldn't give a toss; money's what we want.
examples.translation: 我们其余这些人根本不在乎：我们想要的就是钱。

examples.text: You feel as if you've been tossing and turning all night, and wake up feeling worn out.
examples.translation: 感觉就像整夜翻来覆去睡不着、醒来时浑身疲惫一样。

examples.text: The companies have a total of 1,776 employees.
examples.translation: 这些公司总计有 1,776 名员工。

examples.text: They said that the total number of cows dying from BSE would be twenty thousand…
examples.translation: 他们说患疯牛病死亡的牛的总数将达 2 万头。

examples.text: The total cost of the project would be more than $240 million.
examples.translation: 该项目的总成本会超过 2.4 亿美元。

examples.text: I was with my husband for eight years in total...
examples.translation: 我和丈夫在一起的时间总共有 8 年。

examples.text: In total, 45 per cent of adults in Britain are exposed to tobacco smoke at home.
examples.translation: 英国总计有 45% 的成人在家里遭受到烟草烟雾的侵害。

examples.text: The unit's exports will total $85 million this year...
examples.translation: 该部门今年的出口总额将达 8,500 万美元。

examples.text: They will compete for prizes totalling nearly £3,000.
examples.translation: 他们将为总额近 3,000 英镑的奖金展开争夺。

examples.text: They haven't totalled the exact figures.
examples.translation: 他们还没有对确切数据进行总计。

examples.text: You were a total failure if you hadn't married by the time you were about twenty-three…
examples.translation: 如果到了 23 岁左右还没结婚，你就是个彻底的失败者。

examples.text: There was an almost total lack of management control…
examples.translation: 管理控制几乎是完全缺失的。

examples.text: Why should we trust a total stranger?...
examples.translation: 我们为什么要信任一个素昧平生的人呢？

examples.text: I have total confidence that things will change.
examples.translation: 事情会有所改变的，我对此信心十足。

examples.text: Young people want something totally different from the old ways...
examples.translation: 年轻人想要与以往截然不同的东西。

examples.text: The fire totally destroyed the top floor.
examples.translation: 大火彻底烧毁了顶层。

meanings.meaning: 艰苦的，困难的；坚强的，不屈不挠的；坚韧的，牢固的；强壮的，结实的

examples.text: He built up a reputation as a tough businessman...
examples.translation: 他树立了铁面生意人的名声。

examples.text: She is tough and ambitious.
examples.translation: 她坚韧顽强，满怀抱负。

examples.text: Mrs Potter has won a reputation for toughness and determination on her way to the top.
examples.translation: 波特夫人在奋斗到上层的过程中赢得了坚韧和果敢的声誉。

examples.text: He had shot three people dead earning himself a reputation as a tough guy.
examples.translation: 他因枪杀三人得到了暴徒的恶名。

examples.text: Three burly toughs elbowed their way to the front.
examples.translation: 三个膀粗腰圆的恶汉挤到了前面。

examples.text: She doesn't seem cut out for this tough neighbourhood...
examples.translation: 她似乎不适合在这个治安恶劣的社区生活。

examples.text: Arthur grew up in a tough city.
examples.translation: 阿瑟在一个到处是暴力与犯罪的城市长大。

examples.text: She had a pretty tough childhood…
examples.translation: 她的童年非常不幸。

examples.text: It's been a tough day…
examples.translation: 这是难熬的一天。

examples.text: He was having a really tough time at work.
examples.translation: 他当时工作上困难重重。

examples.text: It was a very tough decision but we feel we made the right one...
examples.translation: 这是个困难的决定，但是我们认为我们做出了正确的选择。

examples.text: Whoever wins the election is going to have a tough job getting the economy back on its feet…
examples.translation: 不管是谁赢得选举都将面对复苏经济的棘手任务。

examples.text: It may be tough to raise cash…
examples.translation: 筹措现金可能不好办。

examples.text: Change is often tough to deal with.
examples.translation: 变化总是很难应对。

examples.text: He is known for taking a tough line on security...
examples.translation: 他因在安全问题上采取强硬路线而闻名。

examples.text: He announced tough measures to limit the money supply.
examples.translation: 他公布了限制货币供应的严厉措施。

examples.text: In industry, diamond can form a tough, non-corrosive coating for tools.
examples.translation: 在工业上，金刚石可以用作工具表面坚固、耐腐蚀的覆盖层。

examples.text: …dark brown beans with a rather tough outer skin.
examples.translation: 有着相当坚韧外壳的深棕色豆类

examples.text: The steak was tough and the peas were like bullets.
examples.translation: 牛排老得嚼不动，豌豆像子弹一样硬。

examples.text: The White House is hanging tough for a good agreement to be reached.
examples.translation: 白宫为达成一项有利协议寸步不让。

examples.text: Her tiny hands gently touched my face...
examples.translation: 她的小手轻轻触摸我的脸庞。

examples.text: Don't touch that dial…
examples.translation: 不要碰那个刻度盘。

examples.text: She reached down, touching her toes with opposite hands…
examples.translation: 她弯腰向下，左右手交叉触及脚趾。

examples.text: The virus is not passed on through touching or shaking hands.
examples.translation: 那种病毒不会通过接触或握手传染。

examples.text: Sometimes even a light touch on the face is enough to trigger off this pain.
examples.translation: 有时即便轻轻一碰脸部都足以引起这种疼痛。

examples.text: Their knees were touching ...
examples.translation: 他们的膝盖挨着。

examples.text: A cyclist crashed when he touched wheels with another rider...
examples.translation: 一个骑车人与另一辆自行车车轮相碰后摔倒在地。

examples.text: If my arm touches the wall, it has to be washed again...
examples.translation: 如果我的胳膊碰到了墙，就得再洗一次。

examples.text: In some countries people stand close enough to touch elbows...
examples.translation: 在某些国家人们站得很近,足以挨到臂肘。

examples.text: He touched the cow's side with his stick.
examples.translation: 他用棍子碰了碰牛的肋部。

examples.text: The evidence suggests that our sense of touch is programmed to diminish with age.
examples.translation: 有证据表明，我们的触觉会随着年龄的增长而减损。

examples.text: …boys and girls who are blind and who want to be able to read and write by touch.
examples.translation: 想通过触觉读写的失明的男孩和女孩

examples.text: He scored the first time he touched the ball…
examples.translation: 他第一次触球就得分了。

examples.text: As the aeroplane went down the runway the wing touched a pile of rubble.
examples.translation: 飞机降落沿跑道滑行的时候机翼擦到了一堆碎石。

examples.text: When John began to restore the house in the 1960s, nothing had been touched for 40 years.
examples.translation: 约翰 20 世纪 60 年代开始整修那幢房子时，它已有 40 年都无人照管了。

examples.text: Pearce remained adamant, saying 'I didn't touch him'...
examples.translation: 皮尔斯仍旧坚定不移地说：“我没有碰过他。”

examples.text: I was in the garden. I never touched the sandwiches.
examples.translation: 我那时在花园里。我根本没动三明治。

examples.text: He doesn't drink much and doesn't touch drugs...
examples.translation: 他喝酒不多，也不沾毒品。

examples.text: His diet is vegetarian, and he hasn't touched meat for six years…
examples.translation: 他吃素，已经 6 年不知肉味了。

examples.text: Jones hasn't touched a trumpet in 10 years.
examples.translation: 琼斯有 10 年没吹小号了。

examples.text: The film touches on these issues, but only superficially...
examples.translation: 这部电影涉及了这些问题，但却流于表面。

examples.text: She writes about women's idealisation of men, touching briefly on the topic of women's fantasy life.
examples.translation: 她写女人心目中理想化的男人，其中简单涉及了女人所幻想的生活的话题。

examples.text: ...a guilt that in some sense touches everyone...
examples.translation: 在某种意义上影响到每个人的负罪感

examples.text: Nor had the benefits of the war years touched all sectors of the population.
examples.translation: 战争年代的救济金也没有惠及所有的人。

examples.text: It has touched me deeply to see how these people live...
examples.translation: 看到这些人的生活境况，我深受触动。

examples.text: Her enthusiasm touched me.
examples.translation: 她的热情打动了我。

examples.text: I was touched to find that he regards me as engaging...
examples.translation: 他认为我很迷人，这真令我感动。

examples.text: He was touched that we came.
examples.translation: 我们能来让他很感动。

examples.text: His crinkly hair was touched with grey...
examples.translation: 他卷曲的头发有些花白。

examples.text: The boy was touched with genius.
examples.translation: 那个男孩透着点天分。

examples.text: No one can touch these girls for professionalism.
examples.translation: 就职业素养来说，没人能比得上这些姑娘。

examples.text: By the third lap Kinkead had touched 289 m.p.h.
examples.translation: 到第三圈时，金基德的车速达到了每小时 289 英里。

examples.text: The winds had touched storm-force the day before.
examples.translation: 风力前一天就已达到了狂风级。

examples.text: Now is the time to touch him for a loan.
examples.translation: 现在是向他借笔钱的时候了。

examples.text: They called the event 'a tribute to heroes', which was a nice touch...
examples.translation: 他们把这一活动称为“向英雄致敬”，这可是加分之举。

examples.text: Small touches to a room such as flowers can be what gives a house its vitality.
examples.translation: 房间里放些诸如鲜花之类的小点缀可以给家里带来生气。

examples.text: The dishes he produces all have a personal touch...
examples.translation: 他做的菜全都带有其个人风格。

examples.text: The striker was unable to find his scoring touch.
examples.translation: 那个前锋找不到进球的感觉。

examples.text: She thought she just had a touch of flu...
examples.translation: 她认为自己仅仅有点感冒。

examples.text: At university he wrote a bit, did a touch of acting, and indulged in internal college politics.
examples.translation: 在大学期间他写过一点东西，小试过表演，并迷恋于校内政治活动。

examples.text: We were all a touch uneasy, I think...
examples.translation: 我想我们都稍有点不自在。

examples.text: I found it a touch distasteful.
examples.translation: 我觉得这略有点让人反感。

examples.text: Staff will be able to trace calls at the touch of a button.
examples.translation: 工作人员一摁按钮便可以追踪电话。

examples.text: …seats that flip out at the touch of a lever.
examples.translation: 一按控制杆就会翻开的座位

examples.text: Unlike many senior judges, he has consistently shown that he has the common touch.
examples.translation: 与很多高级法官不同，他一贯表现得平易近人。

examples.text: I will get in touch with solicitors about this…
examples.translation: 我会就此事与律师联系。

examples.text: The organisation would be in touch with him tomorrow...
examples.translation: 该组织明天就会和他联络。

examples.text: My parents were constantly in touch.
examples.translation: 我的父母一直都保持着联系。

examples.text: You'll also be kept in touch with local Oxfam events.
examples.translation: 您还将随时获得乐施会在当地的最新活动信息。

examples.text: ...keeping the unemployed in touch with the labour market...
examples.translation: 使失业者即时了解劳动力市场的最新动态

examples.text: Mr Cavazos' problem was that he was out of touch.
examples.translation: 卡瓦佐斯先生的问题是他不了解最新形势。

examples.text: In my job one tends to lose touch with friends...
examples.translation: 干我这行，往往会与朋友失去联系。

examples.text: We lost touch after that.
examples.translation: 我们自那以后就失去了联络。

examples.text: Their leaders have lost touch with what is happening in the country.
examples.translation: 他们的领导人不再了解该国正发生的一切。

examples.text: It was touch and go whether we'd go bankrupt.
examples.translation: 我们是否会破产还很难说。

examples.text: Mr Wilson is no soft touch…
examples.translation: 威尔逊先生绝不会轻易借钱给别人。

examples.text: Pamela was an easy touch when she needed some cash.
examples.translation: 她缺钱花的时候，帕梅拉总是有求必应。

examples.text: ...foreign tourists...
examples.translation: 外国游客

examples.text: Blackpool is the top tourist attraction in England.
examples.translation: 布莱克浦是英国的顶级旅游胜地。

examples.text: …the tourist season.
examples.translation: 观光季节

meanings.meaning: 旅行，在……旅游；在……作巡回演出

examples.text: The band are currently on a two-month tour of Europe...
examples.translation: 乐队目前正在欧洲进行为期两个月的巡回演出。

examples.text: It will be the first official cricket tour of South Africa for 22 years.
examples.translation: 这将是 22 年来南非首次正式的板球巡回赛。

examples.text: ...a presidential campaign tour in Illinois.
examples.translation: 在伊利诺伊州的总统竞选巡回活动

examples.text: The band will be going on tour...
examples.translation: 乐队将进行巡回演出。

examples.text: The Royal Opera is on tour…
examples.translation: 皇家歌剧团正在巡回演出。

examples.text: There were mixed fortunes for French rugby teams on tour.
examples.translation: 参加巡回比赛的法国橄榄球队成绩有喜有悲。

examples.text: A few years ago they toured the country in a roadshow...
examples.translation: 几年前他们在全国作了巡回演出。

examples.text: He toured for nearly two years and played 500 sell-out shows...
examples.translation: 他巡回演出了近两年，500场演出场场爆满。

examples.text: Dean Jones is with the Australian touring team in Sri Lanka.
examples.translation: 迪安·琼斯正随澳大利亚巡回赛队在斯里兰卡。

examples.text: It was week five of my tour of the major cities of Europe.
examples.translation: 那是我在欧洲主要城市游历的第 5 周。

examples.text: ...a guided tour of a ruined Scottish castle.
examples.translation: 由导游带领游览苏格兰荒废城堡

examples.text: You can also tour the site on modern coaches equipped with videos...
examples.translation: 您也可以乘坐配有视频设备的现代化长途汽车游览那处遗址。

examples.text: We toured the streets of Milan.
examples.translation: 我们游览了米兰的街道。

examples.text: Kimball said his review of those responses found no "undue amount of animus" toward Mitchell.

meanings.meaning: 拖；麻的粗纤维；拖曳所用之绳

examples.text: He had been using the vehicle to tow his work trailer...
examples.translation: 他一直用这辆车牵引他的活动工作室。

examples.text: They threatened to tow away my car...
examples.translation: 他们威胁要拖走我的车。

examples.text: The British navy boarded the vessel and towed it to New York.
examples.translation: 英国海军登上船，把它拖到纽约。

examples.text: I can give you a tow if you want.
examples.translation: 如果你愿意，我可以拖带你的车。

examples.text: There she was on my doorstep with child in tow...
examples.translation: 她站在我门口，身后跟着一个孩子。

examples.text: She had a reporter and a photographer in tow.
examples.translation: 她有一个记者和一名摄影师追随着。

examples.text: ...a bath towel.
examples.translation: 浴巾

examples.text: James came out of his bedroom, toweling his wet hair...
examples.translation: 詹姆斯从卧室出来，用毛巾擦着他湿漉漉的头发。

examples.text: I towelled myself dry...
examples.translation: 我用毛巾把身体擦干。

examples.text: He stepped out of the shower and began towelling himself down.
examples.translation: 他走出淋浴间，开始用毛巾把身子擦干。

examples.text: It seemed as if the police had thrown in the towel and were abandoning the investigation.
examples.translation: 警方似乎已经认输，打算放弃调查。

examples.text: ...an eleventh century castle with 120-foot high towers.
examples.translation: 带有 120 英尺高塔的 11 世纪城堡

examples.text: ...the Leaning Tower of Pisa.
examples.translation: 比萨斜塔

examples.text: He stood up and towered over her...
examples.translation: 他站起身来，比她高出许多。

examples.text: At school, a girl may tower over most boys her age…
examples.translation: 在学校，一个女孩可能比她同龄的大多数男孩子都要高出许多。

examples.text: The icebergs towered above them.
examples.translation: 冰山高耸于他们上方。

examples.text: Troops are still in control of the television and radio tower.
examples.translation: 军队仍然控制着电视和广播发射塔。

examples.text: ...his design for a new office tower in Frankfurt.
examples.translation: 他为法兰克福一栋新写字楼所作的设计

examples.text: Pat was a tower of strength to our whole family.
examples.translation: 帕特是我们全家人的主心骨。

examples.text: ...Saturday night in the small town of Braintree, Essex...
examples.translation: 埃塞克斯郡布伦特里小镇的周六之夜

examples.text: Parking can be tricky in the town centre.
examples.translation: 在市镇中心停车可能会挺费事。

examples.text: The town takes immense pride in recent achievements.
examples.translation: 全镇人对近来取得的成就都感到非常自豪。

examples.text: He admits he doesn't even know when his brother is in town...
examples.translation: 他承认自己甚至不知道弟弟什么时候来了本市。

examples.text: She left town.
examples.translation: 她离开了自己生活的城镇。

examples.text: …attractive and fun loving Americans, new to town.
examples.translation: 刚来镇上的富有魅力、寻求乐趣的美国人

examples.text: I walked around town...
examples.translation: 我在市中心逛了逛。

examples.text: I caught a bus into town.
examples.translation: 我赶上辆公交车去了市中心。

examples.text: More people are going to want to escape from the town into the country…
examples.translation: 更多的人将会想要逃离城市到乡村去。

examples.text: It had the advantages of town and country combined.
examples.translation: 它兼具都市与乡村的优势。

examples.text: We really went to town on it, turning it into a full, three-day show...
examples.translation: 我们下了真功夫，把它办成了一场内容丰富、为时三天的展览。

examples.text: The papers got hold of it and went to town on it…
examples.translation: 报纸抓住这件事大做文章。

examples.text: With £800 spending money for each couple, you can really go to town!
examples.translation: 每对人有 800 英镑的零花钱，你们真正可以大把花钱了！

examples.text: He was known as a tall, handsome man about town…
examples.translation: 他以高大英俊的花花公子形象为人所知。

examples.text: He is an old flame of Sarah's, from her days as a single girl about town.
examples.translation: 他是萨拉的旧情人，是她作为单身时髦女郎时的旧爱。

examples.text: My idea of luxury used to be going out on the town and coming back in the early hours of the morning...
examples.translation: 我过去对奢侈的概念是夜晚在闹市通宵玩乐到清晨才回来。

examples.text: Last Saturday, I was out on the town with my mate…
examples.translation: 上个星期六我和老友晚上去闹市玩乐了。

examples.text: Tim was just arriving home from a long night on the town.
examples.translation: 蒂姆在外面玩了一宿，刚刚到家。

examples.text: ...the cost of cleaning up toxic waste...
examples.translation: 清除有毒废弃物的成本

examples.text: These products are not toxic to humans.
examples.translation: 这些产品对人类没有毒性。

examples.text: ...data on the toxicity of chemicals.
examples.translation: 有关化学品毒性的数据

meanings.meaning: 玩具；小装饰品；不值钱的东西
玩弄；调情；随随便便地对待

examples.text: He was really too old for children's toys.
examples.translation: 他已经长大了，实在不再适合玩儿童玩具了。

examples.text: ...a toy telephone.
examples.translation: 玩具电话

examples.text: Computers have become household toys.
examples.translation: 计算机已成了家庭的消遣玩意儿。

meanings.meaning: 痕迹，踪迹；微量；[仪] 迹线；缰绳

examples.text: The exhibition traces the history of graphic design in America from the 19th century to the present...
examples.translation: 展览追溯了美国从19世纪至今的平面设计历史。

examples.text: I first went there to trace my roots, visiting my mum's home island of Jamaica…
examples.translation: 我最初到那里是为了寻根，探访我妈妈的故乡牙买加岛。

examples.text: The psychiatrist successfully traced some of her problems to severe childhood traumas.
examples.translation: 这位精神病学家将她的一些问题成功地追溯到她童年时代遭受的严重创伤。

examples.text: Britain's Parliament can trace its history back to the English Parliament of the 13th century...
examples.translation: 英国议会的历史可以追溯到 13 世纪的英格兰议会。

examples.text: She has never traced back her lineage, but believes her grandparents were from Aberdeenshire.
examples.translation: 她从没有查考过自己的家系，不过她认为她祖父母来自阿伯丁郡。

examples.text: Police are anxious to trace two men seen leaving the house just before 8am...
examples.translation: 早上将近8点时有人看到两名男子离开那所房子，警方急于找到他们。

examples.text: We are currently trying to trace the whereabouts of certain sums of money…
examples.translation: 我们目前正试图找到某些钱款的下落。

examples.text: They traced the van to a New Jersey car rental agency.
examples.translation: 他们查出面包车属于新泽西州的一家租车行。

examples.text: I traced the course of the river on the map.
examples.translation: 我在地图上勾勒出这条河的流向。

examples.text: She learned to draw by tracing pictures out of old storybooks.
examples.translation: 她通过描摹旧故事书上的图画学会了画画。

examples.text: Wash them in cold water to remove all traces of sand...
examples.translation: 用冷水冲洗它们以清除所有的沙子。

examples.text: He took great pains to write on his subject without a trace of sensationalism.
examples.translation: 他尽力不带一丝哗众取宠的色彩来写作他的题材。

examples.text: The local church has traces of fifteenth-century frescoes…
examples.translation: 当地教堂仍留有 15 世纪壁画的遗迹。

examples.text: There's been no trace of my aunt and uncle...
examples.translation: 没有我姑姑、姑夫的踪迹。

examples.text: Finally, and mysteriously, Hoffa disappeared without trace.
examples.translation: 最后，霍法毫无踪迹地神秘消失了。

examples.text: The Social Democratic Party has sunk without trace at these elections...
examples.translation: 社会民主党在这些选举中已销声匿迹。

examples.text: Pop groups are like Olympic swimmers — they hit gold once, then they sink without trace.
examples.translation: 流行乐队就像奥林匹克游泳选手——拿到一次金牌后就无声无息了。

examples.text: But the SLCS team eventually pulled her out too, using a tractor and rope.

meanings.meaning: 追踪；通过；循路而行；用纤拉

examples.text: We set off once more, over a rough mountain track.
examples.translation: 我们沿着一条崎岖的山间小路再度出发。

examples.text: The two men turned to watch the horses going round the track.
examples.translation: 那两个男人转身观看赛马沿赛道而行。

examples.text: ...the athletics track.
examples.translation: 田径跑道

examples.text: A woman fell on to the tracks.
examples.translation: 一名女子摔倒在铁轨上。

examples.text: Graeme Naysmith has produced two of the ten tracks on this album.
examples.translation: 格雷姆·内史密斯创作了这张专辑十首歌中的两首。

examples.text: The only evidence of pandas was their tracks in the snow...
examples.translation: 熊猫活动的唯一迹象是它们留在雪地上的足迹。

examples.text: McKee suddenly noticed tire tracks on the bank ahead.
examples.translation: 麦基突然注意到前方岸边的轮胎痕迹。

examples.text: He thought he had better track this wolf and kill it...
examples.translation: 他认为最好跟踪这只狼，杀了它。

examples.text: I followed him, tracking him in the snow until finally he got tired.
examples.translation: 我跟着他，在雪地里追踪他，直到他最终体力不支。

examples.text: Our radar began tracking the jets...
examples.translation: 我们的雷达开始追踪喷气式飞机的动向。

examples.text: Forecasters are also tracking hurricane Josephine.
examples.translation: 气象预报员也在追踪飓风“约瑟芬”的动向。

examples.text: If it's possible, track the rumour back to its origin...
examples.translation: 如果可能，应追查谣言的源头。

examples.text: The player is being tracked by Juventus.
examples.translation: 该选手正为尤文图斯队所追踪关注。

examples.text: Students are already being tracked.
examples.translation: 学生已经按能力分班了。

examples.text: Tracking assigns some students to college prep and others to vocational programs.
examples.translation: 按照能力，一些学生被分到大学预科班，另一些则被分到职业培训班。

examples.text: He covered his tracks, burnt letters and diaries...
examples.translation: 他掩盖形迹，烧毁了信件与日记。

examples.text: The killer may have returned to the scene of the crime to cover his tracks.
examples.translation: 凶手可能曾回到犯罪现场掩盖自己的罪行。

examples.text: Denver has the inside track among 10 sites being considered...
examples.translation: 丹佛在 10 个被考虑的地点之中具有优势。

examples.text: As an agent, you may have an inside track when good deals become available.
examples.translation: 作为代理人，一旦有划算的买卖你恐怕能近水楼台先得月。

examples.text: With eleven thousand employees, it's very difficult to keep track of them all...
examples.translation: 对于一支 1.1 万人的员工队伍，很难及时了解到所有有人的动态。

examples.text: It's hard to keep track of time in here.
examples.translation: 在这里很容易忘了时间。

examples.text: You become so deeply absorbed in an activity that you lose track of time...
examples.translation: 你会因过于专注某项活动而失去时间概念。

examples.text: It's so easy to lose track of who's playing who and when.
examples.translation: 很容易就忘记谁要和谁比赛，什么时候比。

examples.text: We'd better make tracks soon, hadn't we?
examples.translation: 我们最好马上就走，不是吗？

examples.text: It may take some time to get the British economy back on track...
examples.translation: 要使英国经济重新回到正轨可能需要一段时间。

examples.text: David put me back on track…
examples.translation: 戴维让我重新回到了正轨。

examples.text: He believes the talks are still on track.
examples.translation: 他相信会谈仍在朝正确的方向发展。

examples.text: He was on the track of an escaped criminal...
examples.translation: 他正在追踪一名逃犯。

examples.text: The research institute is on the track of what causes the artery damage.
examples.translation: 研究所正在探究动脉损伤的诱因。

examples.text: Guests are returning in increasing numbers — a sure sign that we are on the right track...
examples.translation: 回头客越来越多了——这显然表明我们的路走对了。

examples.text: We need a convincing win to put us back on the right track…
examples.translation: 我们需要一场令人信服的大胜，以重回正轨。

examples.text: We thought we were on the wrong track when we heard their description of you…
examples.translation: 听到他们对你的描述，我们以为自己走错了道。

examples.text: The country was headed on the wrong track, economically.
examples.translation: 该国在经济上走错了路线。

examples.text: This magnificent church cannot fail to stop you in your tracks…
examples.translation: 这座宏伟的教堂一定会让你止步赞叹。

examples.text: They stopped in their tracks and stared at him in amazement…
examples.translation: 他们突然停下，惊讶地盯着他。

examples.text: The thought almost stopped me dead in my tracks.
examples.translation: 这个想法几乎让我一下子停步。

examples.text: Francis felt he would like to stop this conversation in its tracks…
examples.translation: 弗朗西斯觉得他应该立即打断这一谈话。

examples.text: U.S. manufacturers may find the export boom stopping dead in its tracks.
examples.translation: 美国制造商将会发现出口热戛然而止。

examples.text: The ministry had direct control over every aspect of foreign trade.
examples.translation: 该政府部门直接掌控着外贸的各个方面。

examples.text: ...negotiations on a new international trade agreement...
examples.translation: 有关新国际贸易协定的谈判

examples.text: Texas has a long history of trade with Mexico.
examples.translation: 得克萨斯州与墨西哥的贸易往来历史悠久。

examples.text: They may refuse to trade, even when offered attractive prices...
examples.translation: 即便对方的报价很有吸引力,他们也有可能拒绝进行交易。

examples.text: They had years of experience of trading with the West...
examples.translation: 他们有多年与西方贸易往来的经验。

examples.text: He has been trading in antique furniture for 25 years.
examples.translation: 他从事古董家具买卖已有 25 年。

examples.text: Trading on the stock exchange may be suspended...
examples.translation: 证券交易可能被暂停。

examples.text: Sunday trading laws will be reformed.
examples.translation: 星期日交易法将进行改革。

examples.text: They've completely ruined the tourist trade for the next few years.
examples.translation: 他们把今后几年的旅游业完全给毁了。

examples.text: ...the arms trade.
examples.translation: 军火贸易

examples.text: He learnt his trade as a diver in the North Sea...
examples.translation: 他在北海学会了潜水员这一行的本事。

examples.text: Allyn was a jeweller by trade...
examples.translation: 阿林是珠宝匠。

examples.text: She is a patron of small businesses and trades.
examples.translation: 她是几个小企业和小手工艺者的资助人。

examples.text: They traded land for goods and money...
examples.translation: 他们用土地换取了货物与金钱。

examples.text: He still claims the arms weren't traded for hostages…
examples.translation: 他仍然声称军火没有被用来交换人质。

examples.text: Kids used to trade baseball cards...
examples.translation: 以前孩子们常常互相交换棒球卡片。

examples.text: They suspected that Neville had traded secret information with Mr Foster.
examples.translation: 他们怀疑内维尔和福斯特先生交换了秘密情报。

examples.text: I am willing to make a trade with you...
examples.translation: 我愿和你做个交易。

examples.text: It wouldn't exactly have been a fair trade.
examples.translation: 那就不会是完全公平的交换了。

examples.text: Mike asked George to trade places with him so he could ride with Tod...
examples.translation: 迈克要求乔治和他交换位置，让他和托德同坐一辆车。

examples.text: Kennedy mischievously suggested that professors ought to trade jobs for a time with janitors…
examples.translation: 肯尼迪调皮地建议教授和看门人互换一段时间工作。

examples.text: The receiver and the quarterback are going to trade positions.
examples.translation: 接球手与四分卫将会对换位置。

examples.text: He was traded from the Giants to the Yankees...
examples.translation: 他从巨人队转会到扬基队。

examples.text: The A's have not won a game since they traded him.
examples.translation: 奥克兰运动家队自从他转会后还没有赢过一场比赛。

examples.text: Children would settle disputes by trading punches or insults in the schoolyard...
examples.translation: 儿童会通过在操场上对打或互骂的方式解决争端。

examples.text: They traded artillery fire with government forces inside the city.
examples.translation: 他们与城内的政府军互相开炮。

examples.text: ...the spiky punk hairdo that became his trademark.
examples.translation: 成为他标志的朋克刺猬头

examples.text: …the designer bars which have become the new trademark of the city.
examples.translation: 已成为这个城市新标志的时尚酒吧

examples.text: ...the rich traditions of Afro-Cuban music, and dance...
examples.translation: 非裔古巴人丰富的音乐、舞蹈传统

examples.text: Mary has carried on the family tradition of giving away plants...
examples.translation: 玛丽承袭了向别人赠送植物的家族传统。

examples.text: The story of King Arthur became part of oral tradition.
examples.translation: 亚瑟王的故事成为口头传说的一部分。

examples.text: They're marvellous pictures in the tradition of Gainsborough.
examples.translation: 这些是具有庚斯博罗风格的绝妙画作。

examples.text: …a Catholic novelist in the tradition of Graham Greene.
examples.translation: 与格雷厄姆·格林一脉相承的天主教小说家

meanings.meaning: 交通；运输；贸易；[通信] 通信量

examples.text: There was heavy traffic on the roads...
examples.translation: 道路上车流拥挤。

examples.text: Traffic was unusually light for that time of day.
examples.translation: 对于一天中的那个时间段而言，来往车辆少得有些不寻常。

examples.text: ...the problems of city life, such as traffic congestion.
examples.translation: 交通拥堵等城市生活问题

examples.text: Air traffic had returned to normal...
examples.translation: 空中交通已恢复正常。

examples.text: The railways will carry a far higher proportion of freight traffic...
examples.translation: 铁路将承担比例高得多的货运量。

examples.text: The ferries can cope with the traffic of both goods and passengers.
examples.translation: 货运与客运渡船都可应付。

examples.text: Traffic in illicit drugs was now worth some 500 thousand million dollars a year.
examples.translation: 如今每年非法毒品的交易值约在 5,000 亿美元。

examples.text: The president said illegal drugs are hurting the entire world and anyone who traffics in them should be brought to justice.
examples.translation: 总统称毒品正在危害整个世界，任何非法贩卖毒品的人都应依法受到惩处。

examples.text: He was sentenced to ten years in prison on charges of drug trafficking.
examples.translation: 他因贩毒被判刑 10 年。

examples.text: …the trafficking of illegal weapons.
examples.translation: 非法武器交易

examples.text: They have suffered an enormous personal tragedy...
examples.translation: 他们遭逢了巨大的个人不幸。

examples.text: Maskell's life had not been without tragedy.
examples.translation: 马斯克尔的生活亦有过变故。

examples.text: The story has elements of tragedy and farce.
examples.translation: 这个故事兼有悲剧与闹剧的元素。

examples.text: …a classic Greek tragedy.
examples.translation: 古典希腊悲剧

examples.text: It was just a tragic accident...
examples.translation: 它只是场不幸的事故。

examples.text: …the tragic loss of so many lives…
examples.translation: 这么多人的不幸丧生

examples.text: The circumstances are tragic but we have to act within the law.
examples.translation: 事情令人痛心，但我们必须在法律范畴内行事。

examples.text: Tragically, she never saw the completed building because she died before it was finished...
examples.translation: 可叹的是，她在大楼竣工前就去世了，无缘见到它的落成。

examples.text: My father died very suddenly and very tragically.
examples.translation: 我父亲的死非常突然，非常不幸。

examples.text: ...Michael Henchard, the tragic hero of 'The Mayor of Casterbridge'.
examples.translation: 迈克尔·亨察德，《卡斯特桥市长》的悲剧主人公

examples.text: He was following a broad trail through the trees.
examples.translation: 他沿着林间的一条阔路行进。

examples.text: ...a large area of woodland with hiking and walking trails.
examples.translation: 间有远足与散步路线的一大片林地

examples.text: Everywhere in the house was a sticky trail of orange juice...
examples.translation: 家里到处是泼洒的橙汁留下的黏糊糊的痕迹。

examples.text: He left a trail of clues at the scenes of his crimes…
examples.translation: 他在犯罪现场留下了一些蛛丝马迹。

examples.text: The typhoon has left a trail of death and destruction across much of central Japan.
examples.translation: 台风横扫日本中部大部分地区，留下死亡的足迹和满目疮痍。

examples.text: Two detectives were trailing him...
examples.translation: 两个侦探正在追踪他。

examples.text: I trailed her to a shop in Kensington.
examples.translation: 我跟踪她来到肯辛顿的一家商店。

examples.text: During a recent speech on the campaign trail, he was interrupted by hecklers.
examples.translation: 在最近的一次竞选巡游演讲中，他被起哄者中途打断。

examples.text: …at the end of a hard day on the election trail.
examples.translation: 选举巡游途中难熬的一天结束之时

examples.text: She came down the stairs slowly, trailing the coat behind her...
examples.translation: 她慢慢走下楼梯，大衣在身后拖曳着。

examples.text: He let his fingers trail in the water.
examples.translation: 他把手伸进水里，任水流滑过指间。

examples.text: He trailed through the wet Manhattan streets...
examples.translation: 他没精打采地走过曼哈顿湿漉漉的街道。

examples.text: I spent a long afternoon trailing behind him.
examples.translation: 整个下午我都拖着步子跟在他身后。

examples.text: He scored again, leaving Dartford trailing 3-0 at the break...
examples.translation: 他又进球了，使得中场休息时达特福德队以 3: 0 落后。

examples.text: The polls showed the Tories trailing behind the Government by 17 per cent.
examples.translation: 民调显示，保守党落后于政府 17 个百分点。

examples.text: The police were hot on his trail...
examples.translation: 警方正全力追捕他。

examples.text: There was a newspaper on the trail of the story.
examples.translation: 有一家报纸在追踪报道此事。

meanings.meaning: (Train)人名；(英)特雷恩；(法)特兰；(意)特拉因

examples.text: The train pulled into a station...
examples.translation: 列车驶入了一个车站。

examples.text: We can catch the early morning train...
examples.translation: 我们能赶上凌晨的火车。

examples.text: He arrived in Shenyang by train yesterday.
examples.translation: 他昨天乘火车到达沈阳。

examples.text: In the old days this used to be done with a baggage train of camels.
examples.translation: 在过去，这往往由一队驮载行李的骆驼完成。

examples.text: ...a long train of oil tankers.
examples.translation: 一长队油轮

examples.text: He lost his train of thought for a moment, then recovered it...
examples.translation: 他一时思维短路，然后又重新想了起来。

examples.text: Giles set in motion a train of events which would culminate in tragedy.
examples.translation: 贾尔斯触发了随后的一系列事件，这些事件最终将以悲剧收场。

examples.text: In a moment the ceremony was in train…
examples.translation: 仪式马上就要开始了。

examples.text: He praised the economic reforms set in train by the government.
examples.translation: 他称赞政府启动的经济改革。

examples.text: The cars have brought in their train a host of other problems.
examples.translation: 汽车随之带来其他一大堆问题。

examples.text: The US was ready to train its troops to participate...
examples.translation: 美国准备训练军队参加。

examples.text: Stavros was training to be a priest...
examples.translation: 斯塔夫罗斯正受训成为一名牧师。

examples.text: Psychiatrists initially train as doctors...
examples.translation: 精神病医生首先是作为医生接受培训的。

examples.text: We don't train them only in bricklaying, but also in other building techniques...
examples.translation: 我们不仅仅训练他们砌砖，而且教给他们其他建造技术。

examples.text: Companies tend to favour the lawyer who has trained with a good quality City firm...
examples.translation: 各公司往往偏爱那些在伦敦金融城的大律师事务所受过培训的律师。

examples.text: I'm a trained nurse...
examples.translation: 我是一名受过专业训练的护士。

examples.text: Our workforce is highly trained and competitive.
examples.translation: 我们的员工队伍训练有素，竞争意识强。

examples.text: Mr. Koutab is an American-trained lawyer.
examples.translation: 库塔布先生是在美国受过专业培训的律师。

examples.text: …French-trained Indian troops.
examples.translation: 法国人训练的印度军队

examples.text: ...a book for both teachers and teacher trainers.
examples.translation: 一本同时面向教师及教师培训者的书

examples.text: I see my degree as something which will train my mind and improve my chances of getting a job...
examples.translation: 我把学位视为可以锻炼心智、增加就业机会的东西。

examples.text: Some children come to school with more finely trained perceptual skills than others.
examples.translation: 一些孩子在入学时比其他孩子受过更好的感知技能培养。

examples.text: Strachan is training for the new season...
examples.translation: 斯特罗恩正为新的赛季进行训练。

examples.text: He has spent a year training crews for next month's round the world race.
examples.translation: 他已花了一年时间为下个月的环球比赛训练队伍。

examples.text: She went to the gym with her trainer.
examples.translation: 她和她的教练一起去了健身房。

examples.text: Sniffer dogs could be trained to track them down.
examples.translation: 可以训练嗅探犬追捕他们。

examples.text: ...a man who trained hundreds of dogs...
examples.translation: 训练过数百只狗的人

examples.text: She had brought her trained sheepdog to help in the rescue.
examples.translation: 她带来了经过训练的牧羊犬帮助营救。

examples.text: The horse made a winning start for his new trainer.
examples.translation: 这匹马为它的新驯马师开了个好头。

examples.text: She trained her binoculars on the horizon...
examples.translation: 她将双筒望远镜对准地平线。

examples.text: Police cameras had been specifically trained on that area.
examples.translation: 警方摄像头已特别对准那一区域。

examples.text: Instead of training the shoots up the fence, lay them flat in both directions alongside it...
examples.translation: 不要让嫩枝爬上篱笆，要令其沿着篱笆伏地向两边长。

examples.text: You could even put a trellis on your walls and train plants to grow up it.
examples.translation: 你甚至可以在墙上搭置棚架，让植物攀缘其上。

examples.text: He called for much higher spending on education and training...
examples.translation: 他呼吁在教育和培训方面加大投入。

examples.text: Kennedy had no formal training as a decorator.
examples.translation: 肯尼迪没有接受过做油漆匠的正规培训。

examples.text: ...a one-day training course.
examples.translation: 为时一天的培训课程

examples.text: The emphasis is on developing fitness through exercises and training.
examples.translation: 重点在于通过锻炼促进健康。

examples.text: ...her busy training schedule.
examples.translation: 她繁忙的训练日程

examples.text: He will soon be back in training for next year's National...
examples.translation: 他将很快回来为明年的全国联赛进行特训。

examples.text: Redman broke a toe in training.
examples.translation: 雷德曼在训练中折断了一根脚趾。

examples.text: The study found that some alcoholics had clear personality traits showing up early in childhood...
examples.translation: 研究发现一些酗酒者在童年早期就显现出鲜明的人格特征。

examples.text: Creativity is a human trait.
examples.translation: 创造力是人类的一种特性。

meanings.meaning: 叛徒；卖国贼；背信弃义的人

examples.text: Some say he's a traitor to the working class.
examples.translation: 一些人说他是工人阶级的叛徒。

examples.text: ...rumours that there were traitors among us who were sending messages to the enemy.
examples.translation: 关于我们中间有叛徒向敌人通风报信的传言

examples.text: You can get to the beach easily from the centre of town by tram.
examples.translation: 你从市中心乘有轨电车到海滩会很方便。

meanings.meaning: 流浪；践踏，踩；脚步沉重地行走
流浪者；沉重的脚步声；徒步旅行

examples.text: They put on their coats and tramped through the falling snow...
examples.translation: 他们穿上外套，拖着沉重的步子行走在飞雪中。

examples.text: She spent all day yesterday tramping the streets, gathering evidence.
examples.translation: 她昨天一整天都在街上四处奔走，搜集证据。

examples.text: He heard the slow, heavy tramp of feet on the stairs.
examples.translation: 他听到楼梯上传来缓慢沉重的脚步声。

examples.text: …the tramp of heavy boots.
examples.translation: 厚靴发出的重重的脚步声

meanings.meaning: 交易；事务；办理；会报，学报

examples.text: The twentieth century triumphed over the nineteenth, and Brandon understandably makes much of the final transaction.
...issues like European union that transcend party loyalty.
examples.translation: 诸如欧洲结盟这样超越党派忠诚的议题

examples.text: Remove the wafers with a spoon and transfer them to a plate...
examples.translation: 用勺子抄起薄饼，把它们转盛到盘子里。

examples.text: He was transferred from Weston Hospital to Frenchay…
examples.translation: 他从韦斯顿医院转院到了法兰查。

examples.text: He wants to transfer some money to the account of his daughter…
examples.translation: 他想把一些钱转到女儿的账户上。

examples.text: The person can transfer from wheelchair to seat with relative ease.
examples.translation: 那个人可以比较轻松地从轮椅上移到座位上。

examples.text: Arrange for the transfer of medical records to your new doctor...
examples.translation: 安排一下把病历转给你的新医生的事宜。

examples.text: The bank reserves the right to reverse any transfers or payments.
examples.translation: 银行保留撤销任何转账或支付操作的权利。

examples.text: I realized she'd transferred all her love from me to you...
examples.translation: 我意识到她已把所有的爱从我身上转移到了你身上。

examples.text: The chances of the disease being transferred to humans is extremely remote…
examples.translation: 该疾病传播到人类身上的几率微乎其微。

examples.text: On 1 December the presidency of the Security Council automatically transfers from the US to Yemen.
examples.translation: 12 月 1 日，联合国安全理事会的轮值主席国职位自动地由美国移交给也门。

examples.text: ...the transfer of power from the old to the new regimes.
examples.translation: 新旧政权的权力移交

examples.text: The Philippines needs capital and technology transfer...
examples.translation: 菲律宾需要资本与技术转让。

examples.text: There will be a transfer of technology from this country to Mongolia.
examples.translation: 这个国家将会向蒙古国进行技术转让。

examples.text: ...Nick Barmby who transferred from Spurs to Middlesbrough...
examples.translation: 从热刺队转会到米德尔斯伯勒队的尼克·巴尔姆比

examples.text: He was transferred from Crystal Palace to Arsenal for £2.5 million.
examples.translation: 他以 250 万英镑的身价从水晶宫队转入阿森纳队。

examples.text: ...Gascoigne's transfer to the Italian club, Lazio.
examples.translation: 加斯科因转会到意大利俱乐部拉齐奥

examples.text: I was transferred to the book department...
examples.translation: 我被调到图书部。

examples.text: I suspect that she is going to be transferred...
examples.translation: 我猜想她要被调走了。

examples.text: Anton was able to transfer from Lavine's to an American company.
examples.translation: 安东成功地从拉文调到了一家美国公司。

examples.text: They will be offered transfers to other locations.
examples.translation: 他们将会被安排调任到其他地方。

examples.text: Such information is easily transferred onto microfilm.
examples.translation: 这种信息很容易转存到缩微胶卷上。

examples.text: ...systems to create film-quality computer effects and then transfer them to film.
examples.translation: 创造胶片级电脑画质并将之转录到胶片的系统

examples.text: It can be connected to a PC for the transfer of information.
examples.translation: 它可以与个人电脑连接进行信息转存。

examples.text: ...data transfer.
examples.translation: 数据转存

examples.text: He has already transferred ownership of most of the works to a British foundation...
examples.translation: 他已把大部分作品的所有权转让给一家英国基金会。

examples.text: Certain kinds of property are transferred automatically at death.
examples.translation: 死亡时某些财产会自动转让。

examples.text: ...an outright transfer of property.
examples.translation: 财产的全部让与

examples.text: He likes to transfer from the bus to the Blue Line at 103rd Street in Watts...
examples.translation: 他喜欢在华兹区第 103 大街下公交车转乘地铁蓝线。

examples.text: 1,654 passengers were transferred at sea to a Norwegian cruise ship.
examples.translation: 1,654 名乘客在海上转搭了一艘挪威游轮。

examples.text: ...gold letter transfers.
examples.translation: 金字转印纸

examples.text: Your metabolic rate is the speed at which your body transforms food into energy...
examples.translation: 新陈代谢率是身体把食物转换为能量的速度。

examples.text: Delegates also discussed transforming them from a guerrilla force into a regular army.
examples.translation: 代表们还讨论了把他们从游击队武装改造为正规军的问题。

examples.text: Norah made plans for the transformation of an attic room into a study...
examples.translation: 诺拉计划把一个阁楼间改建成书房。

examples.text: Chemical transformations occur.
examples.translation: 发生了化学转换。

examples.text: The Minister said the Urban Development Corporation was now transforming the area...
examples.translation: 部长声称城市开发公司如今正使该地区改头换面。

examples.text: A cheap table can be transformed by an interesting cover…
examples.translation: 一块趣味盎然的桌布就能使一张廉价桌子面目一新。

examples.text: He said she had transformed him from a hard-drinking womaniser into a devoted husband and father.
examples.translation: 他说她已经把他由一个酗酒玩女人的浪荡子彻底改造成了一位忠诚的丈夫、一位慈爱的父亲。

examples.text: In the last five years he's undergone a personal transformation.
examples.translation: 过去 5 年里他整个人发生了全新的转变。

examples.text: …one of the most astonishing economic transformations seen since the second world war.
examples.translation: 二战以来最惊人的经济改革之一

meanings.meaning: 瞬变现象；过往旅客；候鸟

examples.text: ...the transient nature of high fashion...
examples.translation: 顶级时装的瞬息万变性

examples.text: In most cases, pain is transient.
examples.translation: 大多数情况下，疼痛是短暂的。

examples.text: …a hotel for transients.
examples.translation: 为过路客人开设的旅馆

examples.text: On chips where components are 22 nanometres in size, transistor gates are about 42 atoms across.

meanings.meaning: 过渡；转变；[分子生物] 转换；变调

examples.text: The transition to a multi-party democracy is proving to be difficult.
examples.translation: 事实证明，向多党民主制的转型非常艰难。

examples.text: ...a period of transition.
examples.translation: 过渡时期

examples.text: Most of the discussion was on what needed to be done now as we transitioned from the security issues to the challenging economic issues...
examples.translation: 随着我们由安全议题转向具有挑战性的经济议题，讨论最多的就是目前需要做些什么。

examples.text: There was a significant decline in the size of the business as the company transitioned to an intellectual property company.
examples.translation: 随着公司向知识产权公司转型，其业务规模显著下降。

meanings.meaning: 翻译；转化；解释；转变为；调动

examples.text: Only a small number of Kadare's books have been translated into English...
examples.translation: 卡达雷的书仅有一小部分译成了英文。

examples.text: Martin Luther translated the Bible into German...
examples.translation: 马丁·路德把《圣经》译成了德语。

examples.text: The Celtic word 'geis' is usually translated as 'taboo'...
examples.translation: 凯尔特语中的geis一词通常被译作taboo(禁忌)。

examples.text: The girls waited for Mr Esch to translate.
examples.translation: 女孩们等待埃施先生作翻译。

examples.text: ...Mr Mani by Yehoshua, translated from Hebrew by Hillel Halkin.
examples.translation: 耶霍舒亚所著《马尼先生》，由希勒尔·霍尔金译自希伯来语

examples.text: The papers have been sent to Saudi Arabia for translation.
examples.translation: 文件被送到沙特阿拉伯进行翻译。

examples.text: His family's Cantonese nickname for him translates as Never Sits Still.
examples.translation: 家人为他起的广东话绰号意思是Never Sits Still(从来坐不住)。

examples.text: Reforming Warsaw's stagnant economy requires harsh measures that would translate into job losses...
examples.translation: 重整华沙停滞的经济需要强硬措施，这会造成工作岗位的裁减。

examples.text: Your decision must be translated into specific, concrete actions.
examples.translation: 你的决定必须转化为具体明确的行动。

examples.text: 'I love him' often translates as 'He's better than nothing'...
examples.translation: “我爱他”经常解释为“有他总比没有强”。

examples.text: I translated this as a mad desire to lock up every single person with HIV.
examples.translation: 我把这点理解为想把每个艾滋病病毒携带者都关起来的疯狂欲望。

examples.text: ...MacNiece's excellent English translation of 'Faust'...
examples.translation: 麦克尼斯精彩的《浮士德》英文译本

examples.text: I've only read Solzhenitsyn in translation.
examples.translation: 索尔仁尼琴的作品我只读过译本。

examples.text: Much of the wit is lost in translation…
examples.translation: 很多诙谐的成分都在翻译中丢失了。

examples.text: French filmmakers say American remakes are losing something in the translation.
examples.translation: 法国电影人说美国翻拍的版本丧失了原作的部分精髓。

examples.text: Heterosexual contact is responsible for the bulk of HIV transmission.
examples.translation: 艾滋病病毒大半是经异性性接触传播的。

examples.translation: 传真机及其他形式的电子数据传输

examples.text: ...the transmission of knowledge and skills.
examples.translation: 知识与技能的传播

examples.translation: 这辆车装配了自动变速器。

examples.text: ...a four-speed manual transmission.
examples.translation: 四挡手动变速器

examples.text: The game was transmitted live in Spain and Italy...
examples.translation: 这场比赛在西班牙和意大利进行了现场直播。

examples.text: The information is electronically transmitted to schools and colleges…
examples.translation: 信息通过电子方式传送到各所学校和学院。

examples.text: This is currently the most efficient way to transmit certain types of data like electronic mail...
examples.translation: 这是目前传送电子邮件等某些类型的数据的最高效方式。

examples.text: The device is not designed to transmit to satellites.
examples.translation: 该设备不是为向卫星发送信号而设计的。

examples.translation: 传染疾病给人类的蚊子

examples.text: There was no danger of transmitting the infection through operations.
examples.translation: 不存在通过手术传播这种传染病的风险。

examples.text: …the spread of sexually transmitted diseases.
examples.translation: 性传播疾病的蔓延

examples.text: The message they are transmitting to their daughters is very different from that of previous generations…
examples.translation: 他们向女儿传输的信息与上几代人截然不同。

examples.text: He transmitted his keen enjoyment of singing to the audience.
examples.translation: 他把自己对演唱的激情投入传递给了观众。

examples.text: These thin crystals transmit much of the power...
examples.translation: 这些薄薄的晶体传导了大部分的动力。

examples.text: There was no vibration transmitted to the handles and the machine wasn't noisy either.
examples.translation: 没有任何振动传导到手柄，机器也没有任何噪音。

meanings.meaning: 透明的；显然的；坦率的；易懂的

examples.text: ...a sheet of transparent coloured plastic...
examples.translation: 透明有色塑料板

examples.text: I looked at his thin face with its almost transparent skin.
examples.translation: 我看着他清瘦的脸，脸上肌肤几近透明。

examples.text: We are now striving hard to establish a transparent parliamentary democracy…
examples.translation: 我们现在正努力建立明晰的议会民主制。

examples.text: The company has to make its accounts and operations as transparent as possible.
examples.translation: 公司必须使其账目与运作尽可能地清晰透明。

examples.text: The system was clearly not functioning smoothly or transparently...
examples.translation: 该系统显然运行并不顺畅，也不明晰。

examples.text: The book is remarkably accurate and transparently fair-minded.
examples.translation: 这本书记述确凿，言辞明晰，见解公正。

examples.text: …a transparent effort by officials to blame foreigners…
examples.translation: 官员指摘外国人的明显企图

examples.text: He thought he could fool people with transparent deceptions.
examples.translation: 他以为他能用那些可以一眼看穿的鬼把戏愚弄人。

examples.text: To force this agreement on the nation is transparently wrong...
examples.translation: 把这一协定强加于全体国民显然是错误的。

examples.text: Her answers were transparently untruthful.
examples.translation: 她的答语显然不实。

meanings.meaning: 移植；移植器官；被移植物；移居者

examples.text: He was recovering from a heart transplant operation.
examples.translation: 他做了心脏移植手术，正在康复。

examples.text: ...the controversy over the sale of human organs for transplant.
examples.translation: 出售移植用人体器官引起的争议

examples.text: The operation to transplant a kidney is now fairly routine.
examples.translation: 肾脏移植手术如今已相当常见。

examples.text: ...transplanted organs such as hearts and kidneys.
examples.translation: 类似心脏、肾脏这样的移植器官

examples.text: ...a shortage of kidneys for transplantation...
examples.translation: 移植用肾脏的短缺

examples.text: Bone marrow transplantation began 20 years ago.
examples.translation: 骨髓移植开始于 20 年前。

examples.text: Marriage had transplanted Rebecca from London to Manchester...
examples.translation: 因为结婚，丽贝卡从伦敦移居到了曼彻斯特。

examples.text: In the 19th century, the Santa Claus tradition seems to have been transplanted back to Europe…
examples.translation: 19 世纪，圣诞老人的习俗似乎又传回了欧洲。

examples.text: Farmers will be able to seed it directly, rather than having to transplant seedlings.
examples.translation: 农民将能够直接播种，而不用移种秧苗。

meanings.meaning: 运输；运输机；狂喜；流放犯

examples.text: Have you got your own transport?...
examples.translation: 你有自己的交通工具吗？

examples.text: Which type of transport do you prefer?
examples.translation: 你更喜欢哪种类型的代步工具？

examples.text: The extra money could be spent on improving public transport...
examples.translation: 多余的资金可以用于改善公共交通系统。

examples.text: The sudden onset of winter caused havoc with rail and air transport…
examples.translation: 冬天的突然降临让铁路和航空运输系统陷入混乱。

examples.text: An efficient transport system is critical to the long-term future of London.
examples.translation: 高效的公共交通系统对伦敦长远的未来至关重要。

examples.text: Local production virtually eliminates transport costs.
examples.translation: 本地生产实际上消除了运输成本。

examples.text: There's no petrol, so it's very difficult to transport goods...
examples.translation: 没有汽油，因此很难运输货物。

examples.text: They use tankers to transport the oil to Los Angeles...
examples.translation: 他们用油轮把石油输送到洛杉矶。

examples.text: The troops were transported to Moscow.
examples.translation: 部队被运往莫斯科。

examples.text: Dr Drummond felt that he had been transported into a world that rivalled the Arabian Nights...
examples.translation: 德拉蒙德博士觉得自己仿佛被带入了一个可与《天方夜谭》相媲美的世界。

examples.text: In a dream you can be transported back in time…
examples.translation: 在梦里你可以回到过去。

examples.text: This delightful musical comedy transports the audience to the innocent days of 1950s America.
examples.translation: 这部令人开怀的音乐喜剧把观众带到了 20 世纪 50 年代美国的纯真时期。

meanings.meaning: 诱捕；使…受限制；使…陷入困境
陷阱；圈套；[建] 存水弯

examples.text: The locals were encouraged to trap and kill the birds.
examples.translation: 当地居民过去被鼓励设捕捉器捕杀这种鸟。

examples.text: He failed to keep a rendezvous after sensing a police trap…
examples.translation: 他察觉到警方设了圈套以后就没有如约会面。

examples.text: He was trying to decide whether the question was some sort of a trap.
examples.translation: 他试图判断那个问题是不是个套。

examples.text: Were you just trying to trap her into making some admission?...
examples.translation: 你刚才是想诱使她供认吗？

examples.text: She had trapped him so neatly that he wanted to slap her.
examples.translation: 她骗他骗得如此干净利落，他恨不得给她一记耳光。

examples.text: The police knew that to trap the killer they had to play him at his own game...
examples.translation: 警方知道要捉到凶手必须将计就计。

examples.text: The couple set up a 24-hour security camera to trap the vandal scratching their car.
examples.translation: 夫妇俩装了个 24 小时监控摄像头，想要抓住故意划坏他们车子的家伙。

examples.text: The Government has found it's caught in a trap of its own making.
examples.translation: 政府发现自己作茧自缚。

examples.text: The train was trapped underground by a fire...
examples.translation: 列车被大火困在地下。

examples.text: The light aircraft then cartwheeled, trapping both men...
examples.translation: 这架轻型飞机接着一个侧翻，把两个人都困住了。

examples.text: Until he saw the trapped wagons and animals, he did not realize the full extent of the catastrophe.
examples.translation: 直到他看见受困的马车和动物，才意识到灾难的严重性。

examples.text: Wool traps your body heat, keeping the chill at bay...
examples.translation: 毛织品能够保暖御寒。

examples.text: The volume of gas trapped on these surfaces can be considerable.
examples.translation: 存留在这些表面的气体体积可能相当大。

examples.text: Many people fall into the trap of believing that home decorating must always be done on a large scale...
examples.translation: 很多人错误地认为家居装修总是要大动一番干戈。

examples.text: It's a trap too many people fall into.
examples.translation: 太多人都掉进了这个陷阱中。

examples.text: You had better travel to Helsinki tomorrow...
examples.translation: 你最好明天赶赴赫尔辛基。

examples.text: Granny travelled down by train…
examples.translation: 奶奶是乘火车过来的。

examples.text: I've been traveling all day...
examples.translation: 我整整一天都在赶路。

examples.text: Students often travel hundreds of miles to get here...
examples.translation: 学生常常赶数百英里的路来到这里。

examples.text: I had been travelling at 150 kilometres an hour...
examples.translation: 我一直以每小时 150 公里的速度行进。

examples.text: He was a charming travelling companion.
examples.translation: 他是个讨人喜欢的旅伴。

examples.text: I love travelling...
examples.translation: 我热爱旅行。

examples.text: Getting to and from school involves two hours' travelling a day.
examples.translation: 往返学校每天要两个小时的行程。

examples.text: Information on travel in New Zealand is available at the hotel…
examples.translation: 新西兰的旅行信息可以在宾馆获取。

examples.text: He detested air travel.
examples.translation: 他厌恶乘飞机旅行。

examples.text: ...a writer of travel books.
examples.translation: 旅游类书籍作家

examples.text: Dr Ryan travelled the world gathering material for his book...
examples.translation: 瑞安博士周游世界为他的书搜集资料。

examples.text: He has had to travel the country in search of work.
examples.translation: 他不得不走遍全国寻找工作。

examples.text: When sound travels through water, strange things can happen...
examples.translation: 当声音在水中传播时，可能会发生奇怪的现象。

examples.text: Light travels at around 300,000,000 metres per second.
examples.translation: 光以每秒约 30 万公里的速度传播。

examples.text: News of his work traveled all the way to Asia...
examples.translation: 有关他研究成果的消息一路传到了亚洲。

examples.text: Seems like news travels pretty fast around here.
examples.translation: 这里似乎消息传播得很快。

examples.text: He also collects things for the house on his travels abroad.
examples.translation: 他在国外旅游时也为家宅搜集物品作为摆设。

examples.text: Ripe fruit does not travel well, but unripe fruit can be transported worldwide.
examples.translation: 熟透的水果不宜长途运输，但未成熟的水果却可以运往全世界。

examples.text: That brand of humour generally travels well.
examples.translation: 那种风格的幽默通常在各地都喜闻乐见。

meanings.meaning: 托盘；文件盒；隔底匣；（无线电的）发射箱

examples.text: With a slotted spatula, remove and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
The yards are overgrown and cluttered with trash…
examples.translation: 院子里杂草丛生，垃圾成堆。

examples.text: Mowing lawns and taking out the trash are jobs for the tenant.
examples.translation: 刈剪草坪、倒掉垃圾是房客该做的事。

examples.text: Pop music doesn't have to be trash, it can be art...
examples.translation: 流行音乐不必非得是垃圾，也可以是艺术。

examples.text: Don't read that awful trash.
examples.translation: 不要读那本拙劣的垃圾之作。

examples.text: Would they trash the place when the party was over?...
examples.translation: 聚会结束时他们会把这地方搞得一团糟吗？

examples.text: The building had been trashed and its electricity supply cut.
examples.translation: 那栋楼遭到打砸，电被切断。

examples.text: People asked why the candidates spent so much time trashing each other.
examples.translation: 人们问为什么候选人花这么多时间互相贬损。

examples.text: But government officials said that criticizing the country on Indian soil amounted to treason.
It was here, the buried treasure, she knew it was.
examples.translation: 就在这里，那些埋藏在地下的财宝，她知道就在这里。

examples.text: The house was large and full of art treasures.
examples.translation: 房子很大，里面摆满了艺术珍品。

examples.text: She treasures her memories of those joyous days.
examples.translation: 她珍视那段快乐时光的记忆。

examples.text: His greatest treasure is his collection of rock records.
examples.translation: 他最珍爱的宝贝是他收藏的摇滚唱片。

examples.text: These books are still among my most treasured possessions.
examples.translation: 这些书仍然是我最珍爱的宝贝之一。

examples.text: Charlie? Oh, he's a treasure, loves children.
examples.translation: 查理？噢，他是个不可多得的好帮手，非常喜欢孩子。

examples.text: Artie treated most women with indifference...
examples.translation: 阿蒂对大多数女人都漠不关心。

examples.text: Police say they're treating it as a case of attempted murder...
examples.translation: 警方称他们正把它当作一起谋杀未遂案件来处理。

examples.text: She adored Paddy but he didn't treat her well...
examples.translation: 她深爱帕迪，但他对她却并不好。

examples.text: The issues should be treated separately.
examples.translation: 这些问题应该分别对待。

examples.text: Doctors treated her with aspirin...
examples.translation: 医生用阿司匹林为她治疗。

examples.text: The boy was treated for a minor head wound...
examples.translation: 那个男孩因头部轻伤接受了治疗。

examples.text: An experienced nurse treats all minor injuries.
examples.translation: 一位有经验的护士处理所有的轻伤。

examples.text: About 70% of the cocoa acreage is treated with insecticide...
examples.translation: 大约 70% 的可可树林地喷过杀虫剂。

examples.text: It was many years before the city began to treat its sewage.
examples.translation: 很多年以后这个城市才开始处理污水。

examples.text: She was always treating him to ice cream...
examples.translation: 她总是请他吃冰激凌。

examples.text: Tomorrow I'll treat myself to a day's gardening...
examples.translation: 明天我将犒劳一下自己——享受一天的园艺乐趣。

examples.text: If you want to treat yourself, the Malta Hilton offers high international standards.
examples.translation: 如果您想犒劳一下自己，马耳他希尔顿酒店将为您提供高水准的国际化服务。

examples.text: Lettie had never yet failed to return from town without some special treat for him.
examples.translation: 莱蒂每次从城里回来都必定会给他带点特别的礼物。

examples.text: The first part of the plan works a treat...
examples.translation: 计划的第一部分天衣无缝。

examples.text: The apricots would go down a treat.
examples.translation: 杏会非常好吃。

examples.text: …the Treaty of Rome, which established the European Community.
examples.translation: 建立了欧洲共同体的《罗马条约》

examples.text: ...negotiations over a 1992 treaty on global warming.
examples.translation: 围绕 1992 年制定的遏制全球变暖问题的公约而进行的谈判

examples.text: I planted those apple trees.
examples.translation: 我栽了那些苹果树。

examples.text: ...a variety of shrubs and trees.
examples.translation: 各种灌木和乔木

examples.text: Scientists in Switzerland realised that most other researchers had been barking up the wrong tree.
examples.translation: 瑞士科学家意识到其他研究者大多研究方向不对头。

examples.text: I felt a tremendous pressure on my chest...
examples.translation: 我感到胸口堵得难受。

examples.text: There's tremendous tension between the local population and the refugees…
examples.translation: 当地居民与难民之间关系非常紧张。

examples.text: That's a tremendous amount of information.
examples.translation: 那是海量的信息。

examples.text: The business is tremendously profitable...
examples.translation: 这笔生意利润巨大。

examples.text: I enjoyed the show tremendously.
examples.translation: 我非常喜欢那场演出。

examples.text: He was a tremendous person…
examples.translation: 他是个非常了不起的人。

examples.text: I thought it was absolutely tremendous.
examples.translation: 我认为它精彩极了。

examples.text: I thought they played tremendously well, didn't you?...
examples.translation: 我认为他们踢得非常棒，你不觉得吗？

meanings.meaning: 使挥动；用颤抖的声音说出

examples.text: His mouth became dry, his eyes widened, and he began to tremble all over...
examples.translation: 他嘴唇发干，眼睛圆睁，全身开始颤抖起来。

examples.text: Gil was white and trembling with anger...
examples.translation: 吉尔脸色发白，气得直发抖。

examples.text: With trembling fingers, he removed the camera from his pocket.
examples.translation: 他手指哆嗦着从口袋里取出相机。

examples.text: I will never forget the look on the patient's face, the tremble in his hand.
examples.translation: 我永远都不会忘记那个病人脸上的表情，还有他颤抖的手。

examples.text: He felt the earth tremble under him...
examples.translation: 他感到大地在脚下颤动。

examples.text: The leaves trembled in the trees.
examples.translation: 树上的叶子瑟瑟抖动。

examples.text: His voice trembled, on the verge of tears.
examples.translation: 他声音颤抖，泪水在眼眶里打转。

examples.text: 'Please understand this,' she began, a tremble in her voice.
examples.translation: “请理解这一点，”她开始说道，声音有些发颤。

examples.text: We fought with them in the trenches.
examples.translation: 我们曾在一战西线战场上与他们并肩作战。

examples.text: ...trench warfare.
examples.translation: 堑壕战

examples.text: This is a growing trend.
examples.translation: 这是日益显著的趋势。

examples.text: ...a trend towards part-time employment.
examples.translation: 倾向于兼职就业的趋势

examples.text: …the downward trend in gasoline prices.
examples.translation: 汽油价格下滑的趋势

examples.text: The record has already proved a success and may well start a trend.
examples.translation: 该唱片已证明大获成功，并且很可能会引导潮流。

examples.text: New evidence showed the police lied at the trial...
examples.translation: 新的证据表明警方在审讯时撒了谎。

examples.text: He's awaiting trial in a military court on charges of plotting against the state...
examples.translation: 他因被控密谋颠覆国家正等待军事法庭的审判。

examples.text: They believed that his case would never come to trial.
examples.translation: 他们认为他的讼案根本不会开庭审理。

examples.text: They have been treated with this drug in clinical trials...
examples.translation: 他们已在临床试验中接受过这种药物的治疗。

examples.text: I took the car out for a trial on the roads…
examples.translation: 我开车上路试驾了一下。

examples.text: The robots have been on trial for the past year...
examples.translation: 这些机器人过去一年都在试用当中。

examples.text: We plan to release a prototype this autumn for trial in hospitals.
examples.translation: 我们计划今年秋天在各医院推出一个模型进行试验。

examples.text: He had just given a trial to a young woman who said she had previous experience...
examples.translation: 他刚给了一位声称自己有从业经验的年轻女子一次试用机会。

examples.text: The 26-year old fullback has been on trial at the club for ten days.
examples.translation: 那位 26 岁的后卫已经在该俱乐部试用 10 天了。

examples.text: ...the trials of adolescence.
examples.translation: 青春期的苦恼

examples.text: He has been riding in horse trials for less than a year.
examples.translation: 他参加赛马选拔赛还不到一年。

examples.text: ...Dovedale Sheepdog Trials.
examples.translation: 达夫谷牧羊犬测试赛

examples.text: Many drugs were found by trial and error...
examples.translation: 很多药物都是通过反复试验才发现的。

examples.text: She feels that raising her children has been a matter of trial and error.
examples.translation: 她感到抚养孩子就像是摸着石头过河。

examples.text: He is currently on trial accused of serious drugs charges...
examples.translation: 他目前正因严重的毒品控罪而受审。

examples.text: He will go on trial later this month charged with murder…
examples.translation: 他将因谋杀罪名在本月晚些时候出庭受审。

examples.text: Two skinheads were put on trial for those murders last week.
examples.translation: 上周两个光头党成员因为那几宗谋杀案而被带上法庭受审。

examples.text: The President will be drawn into a damaging battle in which his credentials will be on trial.
examples.translation: 总统将被卷入一场造成负面影响的争斗中，他的资格会因此受到考验。

examples.text: He was found to be mentally unfit to stand trial…
examples.translation: 他被判定精神状况不宜接受审判。

examples.text: Five people are to stand trial for murder.
examples.translation: 将有 5 个人因涉嫌谋杀受到审判。

meanings.meaning: 三角（形）；三角关系；三角形之物；三人一组

examples.text: This design is in pastel colours with three rectangles and three triangles…
examples.translation: 这一设计由淡色的 3 个长方形和 3 个三角形构成。

examples.text: Its outline roughly forms an equilateral triangle.
examples.translation: 它的轮廓大致形成一个等边三角形。

examples.text: ...triangles of fried bread.
examples.translation: 三角油炸面包

examples.text: …the great triangle of the Lancashire textile towns, stretching from Manchester up as far as Burnley and across to Accrington.
examples.translation: 兰开夏郡的纺织城镇形成的大三角地带，从曼彻斯特向北至伯恩利，再从伯恩利西至阿克灵顿

examples.text: She plays a French woman in a love triangle with Jonathan Pryce and Christopher Walken.
examples.translation: 她扮演一位与乔纳森·普赖斯和克里斯托弗·沃肯有三角恋关系的法国女子。

examples.text: …the classic triangle of husband, wife and mistress.
examples.translation: 丈夫、妻子与情妇的典型三角关系

examples.text: ...three-hundred members of the Xhosa tribe.
examples.translation: 300 名科萨族人

examples.text: …a map of Maryland marked with the names of Indian tribes.
examples.translation: 标有印第安部落名称的马里兰州地图

examples.text: ...tribes of talented young people.
examples.translation: 一群群才华出众的年轻人

examples.text: …the particularly unpleasant tribe who argue over the splitting of restaurant and bar bills.
examples.translation: 那帮为分摊吃喝账单而争吵的令人非常讨厌的家伙

meanings.meaning: 诡计；恶作剧；窍门；花招；骗局；欺诈
特技的；欺诈的；有决窍的

examples.text: We are playing a trick on a man who keeps bothering me.
examples.translation: 我们正在戏弄那个一直烦我的家伙。

examples.text: Stephen is going to be pretty upset when he finds out how you tricked him...
examples.translation: 如果斯蒂芬发现你怎样欺骗了他，他会非常气愤。

examples.text: His family tricked him into going to Pakistan, and once he was there, they took away his passport...
examples.translation: 家人骗他去了巴基斯坦，等到他一到那里，他们就拿走了他的护照。

examples.text: His real purpose is to trick his way into your home to see what he can steal.
examples.translation: 他的真实目的就是设局欺骗你以进入你的家里，看看他可以偷走什么。

examples.text: He shows me card tricks.
examples.translation: 他表演纸牌戏法给我看。

examples.text: Tiffany revamped her sitting room with simple decorative tricks.
examples.translation: 蒂法尼采用简单的装饰技巧将起居室翻新。

examples.text: It is not just a little trick you can pick up in half an hour.
examples.translation: 这不是你半个小时就能学会的小窍门。

examples.text: Sometimes a few choice words will do the trick.
examples.translation: 有时说几句尖酸刻薄的话就有人听了。

examples.text: Companies are using every trick in the book to stay one step in front of their competitors.
examples.translation: 各公司想方设法地保持比竞争者领先一步的优势。

examples.text: Her head appears to be on fire but that is only a trick of the light.
examples.translation: 她的头部看上去像是着火了，但那只是灯光造成的幻觉。

examples.text: When it comes to integrating their transport systems, the French don't miss a trick.
examples.translation: 法国人从不放过任何整合其交通系统的机会。

examples.text: To get you started, we have asked five successful writers to reveal some of the tricks of the trade.
examples.translation: 为了让你开始写作，我们邀请了 5 位成功作家向你透露一些写作秘诀。

examples.text: I have no respect for my father who, having remarried, is still up to his old tricks.
examples.translation: 我对父亲没任何敬意，他已经再婚，却依然喜欢耍老把戏。

examples.text: As a photographer, he'd found both locations just a trifle disappointing...
examples.translation: 作为摄影师，他感到两处景点都有点儿不尽如人意。

examples.text: 'There we go,' said Diane, a trifle too cheerily…
examples.translation: “这就对了，”黛安娜说道，语气有点儿过于兴高采烈。

examples.text: His uniform made him look a trifle out of place.
examples.translation: 他的制服让他看起来有些格格不入。

examples.text: He had no money to spare on trifles...
examples.translation: 他没有闲钱买些小玩意儿。

examples.text: Believe me, it's the least I can do, a mere trifle.
examples.translation: 相信我，这是我最起码能做的了，只是小事一桩。

meanings.meaning: 礼物；[税收] 贡物；颂词；（尤指对死者的）致敬，悼念，吊唁礼物

examples.text: The song is a tribute to Roy Orbison...
examples.translation: 那首歌是对罗伊·奥比森的致敬。

examples.text: He paid tribute to the organising committee...
examples.translation: 他赞扬了组委会。

examples.text: Over nine-thousand ex-servicemen and women marched past in tribute to their fallen comrades.
examples.translation: 9,000多名退伍的男女战士列队行进而过，以悼念他们倒下的同志。

examples.text: His success has been a tribute to hard work, to professionalism...
examples.translation: 他的成功充分体现了他的勤劳苦干和敬业精神。

examples.text: It is a tribute to Mr Chandler's skill that he has fashioned a fascinating book out of such unpromising material.
examples.translation: 钱德勒先生竟然以如此不被看好的素材写出了一本引人入胜的书，这充分证明了他的写作技巧。

meanings.meaning: 扳机；[电子] 触发器；制滑机

examples.text: A man pointed a gun at them and pulled the trigger.
examples.translation: 一名男子拿枪指着他们，接着扣动了扳机。

examples.text: ...trigger devices for nuclear weapons.
examples.translation: 核武器的引爆器

examples.text: The thieves must have deliberately triggered the alarm and hidden inside the house...
examples.translation: 盗贼肯定是故意触发了报警器，然后躲在房子里。

examples.text: The one thousand pound bomb was triggered by a wire.
examples.translation: 那颗重达 1,000 磅的炸弹是由一根导线引爆的。

examples.text: …nuclear triggering devices.
examples.translation: 核引爆装置

examples.text: ...the incident which triggered the outbreak of the First World War...
examples.translation: 导致第一次世界大战爆发的事件

examples.text: The current recession was triggered by a slump in consumer spending…
examples.translation: 目前的经济衰退是由消费支出骤跌引起的。

examples.text: Even a problem as simple as a bad back often has an underlying triggering factor.
examples.translation: 甚至像背疼这样的小问题都常常有潜在的诱发因素。

examples.text: It is still not clear what events triggered off the demonstrations.
examples.translation: 现在仍然不清楚是什么事件引发了示威活动。

examples.text: Stress may act as a trigger for these illnesses.
examples.translation: 压力可能会成为引发这些疾病的原因。

examples.text: The neighbours' gardens were trim and neat.
examples.translation: 邻居们的花园整洁美观。

examples.text: …the trim houses.
examples.translation: 整齐的房舍

examples.text: The driver was a trim young woman of perhaps thirty.
examples.translation: 司机是个大约 30 岁的身材苗条的年轻女子。

examples.text: My friend trims my hair every eight weeks...
examples.translation: 我朋友每 8 个星期为我修剪一次头发。

examples.text: Grass shears are specially made to trim grass growing in awkward places.
examples.translation: 除草剪刀专门用于修剪缝隙角落里的青草。

examples.text: His hair needed a trim.
examples.translation: 他该理发了。

examples.text: American companies looked at ways they could trim these costs...
examples.translation: 美国公司研究了能够削减这些成本的方法。

examples.text: We trimmed the marketing department.
examples.translation: 我们缩小了市场营销部的规模。

examples.text: ...jackets, which are then trimmed with crocheted flowers...
examples.translation: 另外以钩花镶边的夹克
