examples.text: I am wearing a plaid nightgown trimmed with white lace.
examples.translation: 我穿着一件带有白色蕾丝花边的格子呢睡衣。

examples.text: He wears a fur-trimmed coat.
examples.translation: 他身穿一件镶毛边的外套。

examples.text: …gold-trimmed fitted furniture.
examples.translation: 镶金边的定制家具

examples.text: ...a white satin scarf with black trim...
examples.translation: 黑边白缎围巾

examples.text: The saddles feature a reflective trim for night time visibility.
examples.translation: 这些车座的特点是带有在夜间可视的反光镶边。

examples.text: He is already getting in trim for the big day...
examples.translation: 他已经在为那个重要的日子调整状态了。

examples.text: It is an excellent way of keeping my voice in trim.
examples.translation: 那是保持我声线处于良好状态的极好办法。

meanings.meaning: 绊倒；远足；犯错误；轻快地走

examples.text: On the Thursday we went out on a day trip...
examples.translation: 星期四我们出去玩了一天。

examples.text: Mark was sent to the Far East on a business trip.
examples.translation: 马克被派往远东出差。

examples.text: She tripped and fell last night and broke her hip...
examples.translation: 她昨晚绊倒了，摔坏了髋骨。

examples.text: He tried to follow Jack's footsteps in the snow and tripped on a rock...
examples.translation: 他想要跟着杰克在雪中留下的脚印走，却让一块石头绊倒了。

examples.text: The cables are all bright yellow to prevent you tripping over them.
examples.translation: 电缆都是亮黄色，以防绊倒人。

examples.text: I tripped up and hurt my foot...
examples.translation: 我绊了一下，伤到了脚。

examples.text: Make sure trailing flexes are kept out of the way so you don't trip up over them.
examples.translation: 别让拖地的皮线挡了道，这样你就不会被绊倒。

examples.text: One guy stuck his foot out and tried to trip me.
examples.translation: 一个家伙把脚伸出来想要绊倒我。

examples.text: He made a sudden dive for Uncle Jim's legs to try to trip him up...
examples.translation: 他突然扑向吉姆叔叔的双腿，想要把他绊倒。

examples.text: He was tripped up by a passer-by.
examples.translation: 他被一个路人绊倒了。

examples.text: There's such pressure to be happy in Hawaii, if you're unhappy you're on a guilt trip...
examples.translation: 就好像去夏威夷就一定要开心似的，如果你不开心，你会一个劲儿地感到愧疚。

examples.text: The biggest star perk, and the biggest power trip, must be the private plane.
examples.translation: 顶级的明星待遇和无上的权力体验肯定要数私人飞机了。

examples.text: An anxious or depressed person can experience a really bad trip.
examples.translation: 焦虑或抑郁的人吸毒后可能会有非常糟糕的幻觉。

examples.text: One night I was tripping on acid.
examples.translation: 有一天晚上我服用了迷幻药后正在幻游。

examples.text: A girl in a red smock tripped down the hill...
examples.translation: 一个身穿红色罩衫的女孩迈着轻快的步子下山。

examples.text: They tripped along with scarcely a care in the world.
examples.translation: 他们轻快地走着，几乎没有世间的烦恼。

examples.text: ...a triple somersault...
examples.translation: 空翻三周

examples.text: In 1882 Germany, Austria, and Italy formed the Triple Alliance.
examples.translation: 1882 年，德国、奥地利和意大利结成了三国同盟。

examples.text: I got a fantastic new job and my salary tripled...
examples.translation: 我得到了一份非常好的新工作，薪水涨到了原来的 3 倍。

examples.text: The Exhibition has tripled in size from last year...
examples.translation: 展览会规模自去年已经扩至3倍。

examples.text: The merger puts the firm in a position to triple its earnings.
examples.translation: 合并可使公司利润增长两倍。

examples.text: The mine reportedly had an accident rate triple the national average...
examples.translation: 据报道,该矿事故发生率是全国平均水平的 3 倍。

examples.text: The kitchen is triple the size it once was.
examples.translation: 厨房面积扩为原先的 3 倍。

examples.text: The championships proved to be a personal triumph for the coach, Dave Donovan...
examples.translation: 事实证明，在这次锦标赛中教练戴夫·多诺万取得了非凡的个人成就。

examples.text: Cataract operations are a triumph of modern surgery, with a success rate of more than 90 percent...
examples.translation: 成功率达到 90% 以上的白内障手术是现代外科学的杰出成果。

examples.text: In the moment of triumph I felt uneasy.
examples.translation: 在成功的那一刻我反而感到了不安。

examples.text: Her sense of triumph was short-lived...
examples.translation: 她只感受了片刻成功的喜悦。

examples.text: He was laughing with triumph.
examples.translation: 他发出胜利的大笑。

examples.text: All her life, Kelly had stuck with difficult tasks and challenges, and triumphed...
examples.translation: 凯莉一生经历了各种艰巨的任务与挑战，她都一一成功应对了。

examples.text: The whole world looked to her as a symbol of good triumphing over evil.
examples.translation: 全世界都把她视为正义战胜邪恶的象征。

meanings.meaning: 不重要的，琐碎的；琐细的

examples.text: The director tried to wave aside these issues as trivial details that could be settled later...
examples.translation: 主管试图对这些问题置之不理，认为都是些细枝末节的小事，可以稍后解决。

examples.text: I don't like to visit the doctor just for something trivial.
examples.translation: 我不喜欢为一点小毛病就去看医生。

examples.text: The next phase of the operation will involve the deployment of more than 35,000 troops from a dozen countries...
examples.translation: 下一阶段的军事行动将要对来自 12 个国家的 35,000多名士兵进行部署。

examples.text: There were reports of troop movements.
examples.translation: 有报道称将要调动军队。

examples.text: ...a troop of enemy cavalry trotting towards the Dutch right flank.
examples.translation: 敌方一支骑兵队正冲向荷兰军右翼

examples.text: …a Scout troop.
examples.translation: 一队童子军

examples.text: Amy was aware of the little troop of travellers watching the two of them...
examples.translation: 埃米知道那一小队旅行者正在看着她们俩。

examples.text: Out of beams and cracks came troops of beetles, ants and spiders.
examples.translation: 从横梁上和裂缝里爬出来了一群群甲虫、蚂蚁和蜘蛛。

examples.text: They all trooped back to the house for a rest...
examples.translation: 他们都成群结队地回到房子里休息。

examples.text: The men trooped into work with resignation.
examples.translation: 男人们被迫只好一伙伙地开始工作。

meanings.meaning: 手推车；（美）有轨电车（等于trolley car）；（英）无轨电车（等于trolleybus）；空中吊运车

examples.text: A porter relieved her of the three large cases she had been pushing on a trolley.
examples.translation: 搬运工帮她卸下了她一直用手推车推着的3个大箱子。

examples.text: ...supermarket trolleys.
examples.translation: 超市手推车

examples.text: The waiter had brought the sweet trolley.
examples.translation: 侍者已经推来了甜食推车。

examples.text: She was left on a hospital trolley for 14 hours without even a glass of water.
examples.translation: 她被放在一辆担架车上14个小时，连一杯水都没有喝。

examples.text: He took a northbound trolley on State Street.
examples.translation: 他在州街登上了一辆北行的有轨电车。

examples.text: Is she off her trolley or what?
examples.translation: 她是疯了还是怎么了？

examples.text: It was the most painful experience of my entire journey around the Tropic of Cancer.
...tropical diseases.
examples.translation: 热带疾病

examples.text: ...a plan to preserve the world's tropical forests.
examples.translation: 保护世界热带雨林的计划

meanings.meaning: 麻烦的；讨厌的；使人苦恼的

examples.text: He needed surgery to cure a troublesome back injury...
examples.translation: 他需要做手术来治好烦人的背伤。

examples.text: Parents may find that a troublesome teenager becomes unmanageable.
examples.translation: 父母会发现令人头疼的青少年变得难以管教。

examples.text: The economy has become a troublesome issue for the Conservative Party.
examples.translation: 经济状况已成为保守党的一大难题。

examples.text: I had trouble parking...
examples.translation: 我停车有困难。

examples.text: You've caused us a lot of trouble...
examples.translation: 你给我们造成了很多麻烦。

examples.text: The plane developed engine trouble soon after taking off...
examples.translation: 飞机在起飞后不久发动机就出了问题。

examples.text: The crew are in serious trouble in 50-knot winds and huge seas...
examples.translation: 船员们在 50 节的大风与滔天巨浪中深陷困境。

examples.text: The Sullivans continued to have financial troubles.
examples.translation: 沙利文一家依然手头拮据。

examples.text: The trouble is that these restrictions have remained while other things have changed...
examples.translation: 问题是其他事情都变了，而这些条条框框还在。

examples.text: Your trouble is that you can't take rejection.
examples.translation: 你的问题是不能接受拒绝。

examples.text: She tells me her troubles. I tell her mine…
examples.translation: 我和她互相倾诉烦恼。

examples.text: She kept her troubles to herself.
examples.translation: 她把烦心事都放在心里。

examples.text: An unsuitable bed is the most likely cause of back trouble…
examples.translation: 不合适的床最有可能引起背部疼痛。

examples.text: Her husband had never before had any heart trouble...
examples.translation: 她丈夫以前从来没得过任何心脏疾病。

examples.text: He began to have trouble with his right knee.
examples.translation: 他的右膝盖开始出现不适。

examples.text: Riot police are being deployed throughout the city to prevent any trouble...
examples.translation: 正在全城部署防暴警察以防止发生骚乱。

examples.text: Fans who make trouble during the World Cup will be severely dealt with.
examples.translation: 在世界杯期间闹事的球迷将受到严惩。

examples.text: ...the first victim of the troubles in Northern Ireland.
examples.translation: 北爱尔兰动乱的第一个遇难者

examples.text: It's no trouble at all; on the contrary, it will be a great pleasure to help you...
examples.translation: 根本不费事，恰恰相反，非常荣幸能帮到你。

examples.text: Will it be any trouble to get over here that quickly?
examples.translation: 那么快来这里会不会有什么不便？

examples.text: My little grandson is no trouble at all, but his 6-year-old elder sister is rude and selfish.
examples.translation: 我的小孙子一点都不让人操心，但是他6岁大的姐姐却野蛮而又自私。

examples.text: Is anything troubling you?...
examples.translation: 有什么事情让你烦恼吗？

examples.text: He was troubled by the lifestyle of his son.
examples.translation: 他对儿子的生活方式感到很担心。

examples.text: But most troubling of all was the simple fact that nobody knew what was going on.
examples.translation: 但最令人头疼的是根本没人知道正在发生什么事。

examples.text: The ulcer had been troubling her for several years.
examples.translation: 溃疡已经折磨她好几年了。

examples.text: He yawns, not troubling to cover his mouth...
examples.translation: 他打了个哈欠，都懒得抬抬手遮一下嘴巴。

examples.text: He hadn't troubled himself to check his mirrors...
examples.translation: 他都没想要看看后视镜。

examples.text: He seemed to be a naturally solitary person, troubling himself about only a few friends.
examples.translation: 他似乎天生就是独行侠，不愿费神多交几个朋友。

examples.text: I'm sorry to trouble you, but I wondered if by any chance you know where he is...
examples.translation: 对不起打扰了，但我想打听一下您是否知道他在哪里。

examples.text: I hate to trouble you, but Aunt Lina's birthday is coming up and I would like to buy something nice for her.
examples.translation: 我真不愿打扰您，但莉娜阿姨的生日就要到了，我想给她买点好东西。

examples.text: He was in trouble with his teachers...
examples.translation: 老师们都想好好教训他。

examples.text: The person who loaned them to me got into terrible trouble for it.
examples.translation: 把那笔钱借给我的那个人因此倒霉了。

examples.text: …a charity that helps women in trouble with the law.
examples.translation: 帮助违法犯罪的妇女的慈善团体

examples.text: It is worth taking the trouble to sieve the fruit by hand…
examples.translation: 值得费点劲用手挑挑果子。

examples.text: He did not take the trouble to see the film before he attacked it.
examples.translation: 他在批评那部电影之前都懒得费神欣赏。

examples.text: Some grumbled that Johnson was more trouble than he was worth...
examples.translation: 有人抱怨说根本不值得为约翰逊浪费精力。

examples.text: Learning more about it always seemed more trouble than it was worth.
examples.translation: 似乎总是觉得没必要为进一步了解它而大费工夫。

examples.text: He was smartly dressed in a shirt, dark trousers and boots...
examples.translation: 他穿着衬衫和黑裤子，脚蹬皮靴，看上去很帅气。

examples.text: Alexander rolled up his trouser legs.
examples.translation: 亚历山大把裤腿卷起来。

examples.text: I smoothed his khaki-trousered leg.
examples.translation: 我把他那条卡其布裤子的裤腿弄平展。

examples.text: Now and then they heard the roar of a heavy truck.
examples.translation: 他们不时地听到大卡车的轰鸣声。

examples.text: They were loaded on the railway trucks to go to Liverpool.
examples.translation: 它们被装上开往利物浦的货运火车。

examples.text: The liquor was sold legally and trucked out of the state.
examples.translation: 该酒合法出售，用卡车运出了该州。

examples.text: He would have no truck with deceit...
examples.translation: 他不愿去骗人。

examples.text: As an American, she had no truck with the painful formality of English life.
examples.translation: 作为一名美国人，她不愿拘泥于英国人生活中令人非常不舒服的繁文缛节。

examples.text: He gave a cry of arrival and display, and the boys hooted with true astonishment.

meanings.meaning: 吹喇叭；发出喇叭般的声音

examples.text: The government has been trumpeting tourism as a growth industry...
examples.translation: 政府一直积极宣扬旅游业是快速发展型产业。

examples.text: …Mark Morris, who is trumpeted as the dance talent of his generation…
examples.translation: 马克·莫里斯，被吹捧为他那一代的舞蹈奇才

examples.text: Nobody should be trumpeting about chemical weapons...
examples.translation: 任何人都不应大肆鼓吹化学武器。

examples.text: It was trumpeted that the nation's health was improving.
examples.translation: 人们大力宣传该国的健康状况正在改善。

examples.text: …the much trumpeted 'tax cuts' in the 1980s.
examples.translation: 20 世纪 80 年代被大肆宣扬的“减税”

examples.text: The elephants trumpeted and stamped their feet at their approach.
examples.translation: 当他们靠近时，大象又吼又跺脚。

meanings.meaning: 树干；躯干；象鼻；汽车车尾的行李箱

examples.text: ...the gnarled trunk of a birch tree.
examples.translation: 白桦树粗糙多瘤的树干

examples.text: …toadstools growing on fallen tree trunks.
examples.translation: 在倒下的树干上长出的伞菌

examples.text: I wear these trunks because they have a streamline effect in the water.
examples.translation: 我穿这条游泳裤因为它在水中有流线效果。

examples.text: 'I trust you completely,' he said...
examples.translation: “我完全信任你，”他说。

examples.text: He did argue in a general way that the president can't be trusted.
examples.translation: 他确实泛泛提过总统不可信赖。

examples.text: After speaking to a group of her most trusted advisers, she turned her anger into action.
examples.translation: 在与最亲信的顾问团谈过以后，她将愤怒付诸行动。

examples.text: He destroyed me and my trust in men...
examples.translation: 他毁了我，也摧毁了我对男人的信任。

examples.text: You've betrayed their trust...
examples.translation: 你已经背叛了他们的信任。

examples.text: There's a feeling of warmth and trust here.
examples.translation: 这里有一种温暖和信任的感觉。

examples.text: That's why I must trust you to keep this secret...
examples.translation: 那就是为什么我必须得相信你会保守这个秘密的原因。

examples.text: They argued that the ruling party could not be trusted to oversee its own removal from power.
examples.translation: 他们争辩说不能相信执政党会监督解除自身的权力。

examples.text: This could make your superiors hesitate to trust you with major responsibilities...
examples.translation: 这样会使上级不敢对你委以重任。

examples.text: I'd trust him with my life.
examples.translation: 我愿把终身托付给他。

examples.text: She was organizing and running a large household, a position of trust which was generously paid...
examples.translation: 她正操持管理着一个大家庭，这是一个需要充分信任的高薪职位。

examples.text: Although I didn't betray a trust, I feel I behaved shabbily.
examples.translation: 尽管我没有辜负别人的托付，却感到自己行为龌龊。

examples.text: She nodded, not trusting her own voice...
examples.translation: 她只点点头，没有说话。

examples.text: For one thing, he didn't trust his legs to hold him up...
examples.translation: 首先，他不相信自己能站起来。

examples.text: I still can't trust myself to remain composed in their presence.
examples.translation: 我仍然不放心自己能否在他们面前保持镇静。

examples.text: Jake has raised two smashing kids and I trust his judgement…
examples.translation: 杰克养大了两个了不起的孩子，我相信他的判断。

examples.text: I blame myself and will never be able to trust my instinct again.
examples.translation: 我自责，而且今后再也不能相信自己的直觉了。

examples.text: I trust you will take the earliest opportunity to make a full apology...
examples.translation: 我想你会一抓住机会就诚恳道歉的。

examples.text: We trust that he and his department are considering our suggestion.
examples.translation: 我们估计他和他的部门正在考虑我们的建议。

examples.text: He was a pastor who trusted in the Lord who lived to preach.
examples.translation: 作为一名牧师，他相信上帝是用一生去传教的。

examples.text: Don't blindly trust in the good faith of any government official.
examples.translation: 不要盲目信任任何政府官员的诚意。

examples.text: You could also set up a trust so the children can't spend any inheritance until they are a certain age…
examples.translation: 你也可以设立财产信托，这样孩子们只有达到一定年龄才能动用遗产。

examples.text: The money will be put in trust until she is 18.
examples.translation: 钱会交付他人托管，直到她年满 18 岁。

examples.text: He had set up two charitable trusts...
examples.translation: 他已设立了两个慈善信托机构。

examples.text: The National Childbirth Trust has recently conducted a survey of 1,271 new mothers.
examples.translation: 国家生育信托基金会最近对 1,271 位新妈妈做了一个调查。

examples.text: St Mary's Hospital in Paddington became a self-governing trust this week.
examples.translation: 帕丁顿的圣玛丽医院这周成为政府资助的独立经营医院。

examples.text: The British Library holds its collection in trust for the nation...
examples.translation: 大不列颠图书馆为国家保存被托管藏书。

examples.text: Works of art are in trust to us during our lifetime.
examples.translation: 艺术品交由我们托管一生。

examples.text: He was adamant that the allegations were untrue, so I took him on trust.
examples.translation: 他坚持认为那些指控不属实，因此我也完全相信他。

examples.text: Is it possible to separate truth from fiction?…
examples.translation: 有可能把事实与虚构分开吗？

examples.text: I must tell you the truth about this business...
examples.translation: 我必须告诉你这件事的真相。

examples.text: The truth of the matter is that we had no other choice...
examples.translation: 实情就是我们别无选择。

examples.text: In the town very few know the whole truth.
examples.translation: 镇子里只有很少人知道全部实情。

examples.text: …judgements of truth or falsity.
examples.translation: 对虚与实的判断

examples.text: There is no truth in this story...
examples.translation: 这个故事纯属虚构。

examples.text: Is there any truth to the rumors?...
examples.translation: 那些谣言有什么事实依据吗？

examples.text: The criticisms have at least an element of truth and validity.
examples.translation: 那些批评至少有一丝真实性和合理性。

examples.text: It is an almost universal truth that the more we are promoted in a job, the less we actually exercise the skills we initially used to perform it.
examples.translation: 这几乎是一条普遍的真理：我们在某一工作中越往上晋升，实际运用那些当初在工作中经常实践的技能的机会就越少。

examples.text: In truth, we were both unhappy.
examples.translation: 事实上，我们俩都不快乐。

examples.text: To tell you the truth, I was afraid to see him...
examples.translation: 坦白说，我害怕见他。

examples.text: Truth to tell, John did not want Veronica at his wedding.
examples.translation: 说实在的，约翰不想韦罗妮卡参加他的婚礼。

meanings.meaning: 洗盆浴；（衣服等）被放在桶里洗

examples.text: He peeled the paper top off a little white tub and poured the cream into his coffee...
examples.translation: 他把小白盒上的纸盖撕去，然后把奶油倒进他的咖啡里。

examples.text: Shrubs can be grown in tubs or large containers.
examples.translation: 灌木可以种植在盆里或大型容器中。

examples.text: She would eat four tubs of ice cream in one sitting.
examples.translation: 她以前常常一次就吃4桶冰激凌。

examples.text: She lay back in the tub.
examples.translation: 她向后靠着躺在浴缸里。

meanings.meaning: 使成管状；把…装管；用管输送

examples.text: He is fed by a tube that enters his nose.
examples.translation: 他靠鼻饲管进食。

examples.text: ...a cardboard tube.
examples.translation: 纸卷芯

examples.text: ...a tube of toothpaste.
examples.translation: 一管牙膏

examples.text: ...a small tube of moisturizer.
examples.translation: 一小管保湿液

examples.text: The lungs are in fact constructed of thousands of tiny tubes.
examples.translation: 肺实际上由上千条细微的气管构成。

examples.text: I took the tube then the train and came straight here...
examples.translation: 我先乘地铁，然后坐火车直奔这里。

examples.text: He travelled by tube.
examples.translation: 他乘地铁旅行。

examples.text: The only baseball he saw was on the tube.
examples.translation: 他看过的唯一一场棒球赛是在电视上看的。

examples.text: The country was going down the tubes economically...
examples.translation: 该国经济正在彻底崩溃。

examples.text: When I was dieting, that was when my social life started going down the tube.
examples.translation: 我节食的时候，也就切断了一切社交生活。

meanings.meaning: 卷起；挤进；用某物舒适地裹住；使有褶裥；收拢；大口吃；使隐藏
食物；船尾突出部；缝摺；抱膝式跳水；活力；鼓声
缝褶裥；缩拢；舒服地裹在里面；大口吃
(Tuck)人名；(东南亚国家华语)德；(英)塔克

examples.text: He tried to tuck his flapping shirt inside his trousers...
examples.translation: 他设法把飘起的衬衫塞到裤子里。

examples.text: She found a rose tucked under the windscreen wiper of her car one morning.
examples.translation: 一天清晨，她发现自己汽车的挡风玻璃雨刷下插着一支玫瑰。

examples.text: He stole a Mars bar from the school tuck shop.
examples.translation: 他从学校小吃店偷了一条玛氏巧克力棒。

examples.text: She'd undergone 13 operations, including a tummy tuck.
examples.translation: 她已经做了 13 次手术，包括一次腹部瘦身整形手术。

examples.text: He phoned on Tuesday, just before you came...
examples.translation: 他星期二来电话了，就在你来之前。

examples.text: Talks are likely to start next Tuesday…
examples.translation: 会谈有可能下周二开始。

examples.text: On Tuesdays and Saturdays the market comes to town.
examples.translation: 每逢周二与周六，镇上就会有集市。

meanings.meaning: 试图，努力；试验；审判；考验

examples.text: He secretly tried to block her advancement in the Party...
examples.translation: 他暗地里设法阻挠她在党内的晋升。

examples.text: Try to make the effort to work your way through all of your tasks one at a time…
examples.translation: 争取努力把你所有的任务一次完成一项。

examples.text: Does it annoy you if others do things less well than you would, or don't seem to try hard enough?...
examples.translation: 如果别人不如你能干，或者似乎不够努力，你会很生气吗？

examples.text: I tried calling him when I got here but he wasn't at home...
examples.translation: 我到这里时试着给他打电话，但他不在家。

examples.text: No matter how bad you feel, keep trying.
examples.translation: 不管你感觉多么糟糕，继续努力。

examples.text: It wasn't that she'd really expected to get any money out of him; it had just seemed worth a try...
examples.translation: 她并不是真指望能从他那里得到钱，只是觉得值得一试。

examples.text: After a few tries Patrick had given up any attempt to reform his brother.
examples.translation: 几次尝试之后，帕特里克放弃了改造弟弟的任何努力。

examples.text: He has started a privatisation programme to try and win support from the business community…
examples.translation: 他启动了一套私有化方案，以设法赢得商界的支持。

examples.text: I must try and see him.
examples.translation: 我必须设法见到他。

examples.text: My partner and I have been trying for a baby for two years...
examples.translation: 我和爱人两年来一直想要个孩子。

examples.text: He said he was going to try for first place next year.
examples.translation: 他说他明年会争取夺得第一名。

examples.text: It's best not to try a new recipe for the first time on such an important occasion...
examples.translation: 在这么重要的场合最好不要尝试以前从未做过的新菜谱。

examples.text: I've tried everything from herbal cigarettes to chewing gum…
examples.translation: 中草药香烟、口香糖之类的我统统都试过了。

examples.text: I have tried painting the young shoots with weed poisoner, but this does not kill them off.
examples.translation: 我试过在小嫩芽上涂除草剂，但这并没有将它们除净。

examples.text: If you're still sceptical about exercising, we can only ask you to trust us and give it a try.
examples.translation: 如果你对锻炼还有疑虑，我们只能要求你相信我们，亲自试一试。

examples.text: Have you tried the local music shops?
examples.translation: 你到当地的音像店找过了吗？

examples.text: Bob tried the door. To his surprise it opened.
examples.translation: 鲍勃试着推了推门。令他吃惊的是，门竟然开了。

examples.text: He suggested that those responsible should be tried for crimes against humanity...
examples.translation: 他建议那些责任人应该以反人类罪受到审判。

examples.text: Whether he is innocent or guilty is a decision that will be made when the case is tried in court...
examples.translation: 他有罪与否，等案件在法庭受审后就会作出判决。

examples.text: The military court which tried him excluded two of his lawyers...
examples.translation: 审判他的军事法庭拒绝让他的两位律师出庭辩护。

examples.text: Why does it take 253 days to try a case of fraud?
examples.translation: 为什么审讯一宗欺诈案要花 253 天时间？

examples.text: The French, who led 21-3 at half time, scored eight tries.
examples.translation: 上半场以 21:3 领先的法国队有 8 个达阵得分。

examples.text: Not all is perfect, but it isn't for want of trying.
examples.translation: 一切并非无可挑剔，但已经竭尽全力了。

examples.text: A little boy came running up and tugged at his sleeve excitedly...
examples.translation: 一个小男孩跑上来，非常激动地拽着他的袖子。

examples.text: She kicked him, tugging his thick hair.
examples.translation: 她一边踢他，一边扯着他那浓密的头发。

examples.text: Bobby gave her hair a tug…
examples.translation: 博比使劲拽了她头发一下。

examples.text: I felt a tug at my sleeve.
examples.translation: 我感到袖子被拽了一下。

examples.text: The courses will give the beginner personal tuition in all types of outdoor photography.
examples.translation: 该课程将为初学者一对一地讲授各种户外摄影技巧。

examples.text: Angela's $7,000 tuition at University this year will be paid for with scholarships.
examples.translation: 安杰拉将用奖学金支付今年 7,000 美元的大学学费。

meanings.meaning: 摔倒；倒塌；滚动；打滚；仓惶地行动
跌倒；翻筋斗；跌跤 [ 过去式tumbled 过去分词tumbled 现在分词tumbling ]

examples.text: A small boy tumbled off a third floor fire escape...
examples.translation: 一个小男孩从3楼防火梯上摔了下来。

examples.text: The dog had tumbled down the cliff…
examples.translation: 那只狗已摔下了悬崖。

examples.text: He fell to the ground, and the gun tumbled out of his hand.
examples.translation: 他跌到地上，枪从手里摔了出去。

examples.text: He injured his ribs in a tumble from his horse.
examples.translation: 他从马背上摔下来时伤到了肋骨。

examples.text: House prices have tumbled by almost 30 per cent in real terms since mid-1989...
examples.translation: 房价自 1989 年中期以来实际上暴跌了近 30%。

examples.text: Share prices continued to tumble today on the Tokyo stock market.
examples.translation: 东京股市的股价今天继续暴跌。

examples.text: ...tumbling inflation.
examples.translation: 急剧下降的通货膨胀率

examples.text: Oil prices took a tumble yesterday.
examples.translation: 昨天油价暴跌。

examples.text: Waterfalls crash and tumble over rocks.
examples.translation: 瀑布飞流直溅，冲刷着岩石。

examples.text: ...the aromatic pines and tumbling streams of the Zonba Plateau.
examples.translation: 松巴高原芬芳的松树与湍急的河流

examples.text: Many mothers and children tumble into poverty after divorce...
examples.translation: 很多母亲和孩子在离婚后陷入贫困。

examples.text: There's no thought more pleasing than the prospect of tumbling into my apartment and slamming the door.
examples.translation: 没有比一头冲进自己的公寓摔上房门更让我开心的事了。

examples.text: Last week he revealed he had also had surgery to remove a cancerous tumour.
She was humming a merry little tune.
examples.translation: 她正哼着一支欢快的小调。

examples.text: She'll also be playing your favourite pop tunes.
examples.translation: 她还将演奏你最喜欢的流行乐曲。

examples.text: 'We do tune our guitars before we go on,' he insisted.
examples.translation: “我们在演奏以前确实会为吉他调音，”他坚持说道。

examples.text: Others were quietly tuning up their instruments.
examples.translation: 其他人正静静地为他们的乐器调音。

examples.text: Drivers are urged to make sure that car engines are properly tuned.
examples.translation: 司机们被敦促要确保汽车发动机调试妥当。

examples.text: The shop charges up to $500 to tune up a Porsche.
examples.translation: 那家店调试一辆保时捷收费高达 500 美元。

examples.text: A small colour television was tuned to an afternoon soap opera.
examples.translation: 一台小彩色电视机频道调在了一出下午的肥皂剧上。

examples.text: Who would then be calling the tune in Parliament?
examples.translation: 那在国会谁说了算？

examples.text: You've changed your tune since this morning, haven't you?...
examples.translation: 你从今天早上就变卦了，是不是？

examples.text: Yesterday he changed his tune, saying the fare increase was experimental.
examples.translation: 昨天他变卦了，说提价只是试行。

examples.text: The danger of commercialism is that the churches end up dancing to the tune of their big business sponsors.
examples.translation: 商业主义的危险就是教会最终可能会被大赞助商牵着鼻子走。

examples.text: It was just an ordinary voice, but he sang in tune...
examples.translation: 他声音很一般，但唱得都在调子上。

examples.text: Many of the notes are out of tune...
examples.translation: 很多音都走调了。

examples.text: It's no wonder the piano kept going out of tune.
examples.translation: 难怪钢琴一直不在调上。

examples.text: Today, his change of direction seems more in tune with the times...
examples.translation: 今天，他方向的改变似乎更与时代合拍。

examples.text: The peace campaigners were probably out of tune with most Britons.
examples.translation: 和平倡导者可能不被大部分英国人认同。

examples.text: They've been sponsoring the World Cup to the tune of a million and a half pounds.
examples.translation: 他们已经对世界杯提供了高达 150 万英镑的赞助费。

meanings.meaning: 挖；在…打开通道；在…挖掘隧道

examples.text: ...two new railway tunnels through the Alps.
examples.translation: 穿过阿尔卑斯山的两条新的铁路隧道

examples.text: …the motorway tunnels under the Hudson river.
examples.translation: 哈得孙河下的高速公路隧道

examples.text: The rebels tunnelled out of a maximum security jail...
examples.translation: 叛乱者挖地道逃离了戒备最为森严的监狱。

examples.text: The caterpillars tunnel into the fruit to grow and mature.
examples.translation: 毛虫钻入果实，并在其中生长为成虫。

meanings.meaning: [动力] 涡轮；[动力] 涡轮机

examples.text: Suarez says renewable energy could be generated by a turbine powered from collected groundwater.

meanings.meaning: 骚乱的，混乱的；狂暴的；吵闹的；激流的，湍流的

examples.text: They had been together for five or six turbulent years of rows and reconciliations...
examples.translation: 他们在一起生活了五六年，一直吵吵闹闹，分分合合，没有片刻安宁。

examples.text: The turbulent world of Middle Eastern politics defies prediction.
examples.translation: 中东动荡不安的政治局势让人难以预测。

examples.text: I had to have a boat that could handle turbulent seas.
examples.translation: 我必须有一艘能经得起狂风骇浪的船。

examples.text: It's a proper Christmas dinner, with turkey and bread sauce.
examples.translation: 这是顿像样的圣诞大餐，有火鸡和牛奶沙司。

meanings.meaning: 翻覆；[贸易] 营业额；流通量；半圆卷饼；失误

examples.text: Her annual turnover is around £45,000…
examples.translation: 她的年营业额大约是 4.5 万英镑。

examples.text: The company had a turnover of £3.8 million.
examples.translation: 那家公司营业额为 380 万英镑。

examples.text: Short-term contracts increase staff turnover...
examples.translation: 短期合同使得员工流动率增高。

examples.text: The industry has a high turnover of young people.
examples.translation: 该行业的年轻从业者流动率较高。

meanings.meaning: 当家庭教师；（美）在家庭教师指导下学习

examples.text: He is course tutor in archaeology at the University of Southampton...
examples.translation: 他是南安普敦大学考古学课程导师。

examples.text: Liam surprised his tutors by twice failing a second year exam.
examples.translation: 利亚姆两次都没能通过大二的一门考试，这让他的导师们很吃惊。

examples.text: The old man was tutoring her in the stringed instruments.
examples.translation: 那个老人在教她弹弦乐器。

examples.text: ...at the college where I tutored a two-day Introduction to Chairmaking course...
examples.translation: 在我曾教过为期两天的椅子制作入门课的那个学院

examples.text: I tutored in economics.
examples.translation: 我教经济学。

examples.text: He made his living by a mixture of tutoring and journalism.
examples.translation: 他靠教书与从事新闻工作谋生。

examples.text: The TV was on...
examples.translation: 电视开着。

examples.text: I prefer going to the cinema to watching TV.
examples.translation: 我更喜欢看电影而不是看电视。

examples.text: ...a TV commercial.
examples.translation: 电视广告

examples.text: Twelve suspected LRA rebels have been arrested by the Congolese army and peacekeepers since 23rd December.
They're both in their twenties and both married with children of their own.
examples.translation: 他们俩都二十几岁，都已经结婚生子了。

examples.text: It was written in the Twenties, but it still really stands out.
examples.translation: 它写于20世纪20年代，但直到今天仍然备受瞩目。

examples.text: He visited me twice that fall and called me on the telephone often...
examples.translation: 那年秋天他来看过我两次，而且经常给我打电话。

examples.text: The government has twice declined to back the scheme…
examples.translation: 政府已两次拒绝支持该方案。

examples.text: Thoroughly brush teeth and gums twice daily...
examples.translation: 每天两次彻底刷净牙齿和牙龈。

examples.text: Twice before he had been in New York with Gladys on summer vacations.
examples.translation: 他之前已经和格拉迪丝两次来到纽约度暑假。

examples.text: …Foster, who is twice the world champion.
examples.translation: 两次获世界冠军的福斯特

examples.text: I phoned twice a day, leaving messages with his wife...
examples.translation: 我每天打两次电话，托他妻子捎口信。

examples.text: This famous horse race has taken place here twice a year since 1310.
examples.translation: 这一著名的赛马比赛自 1310 年以来每年在这里举行两次。

examples.text: The figure of seventy-million pounds was twice as big as expected.
examples.translation: 7,000 万英镑的金额是预期的两倍。

examples.text: …a report claiming that teachers could be twice as effective if they returned to traditional classroom methods.
examples.translation: 声称教师若重新采用传统课堂讲授方法，授课效果会事半功倍的报告

examples.text: Unemployment in Northern Ireland is twice the national average...
examples.translation: 北爱尔兰的失业率是全国平均水平的两倍。

examples.text: Double cream contains approximately twice the quantity of fat-soluble vitamins as single cream.
examples.translation: 高脂厚奶油中脂溶性维生素的含量大约是稀奶油的两倍。

examples.text: She'd better shut her mouth and from now on think twice before saying stupid things.
examples.translation: 她最好闭上嘴巴，而且今后在说出蠢话之前先过过脑子。

meanings.meaning: 转动，使旋转；转弯；翻过来；兑换

examples.text: Turn is used in a large number of other expressions which are explained under other words in the dictionary. For example, the expression ‘turn over a new leaf’ is explained at leaf.
examples.translation: turn 还有许多其他用法，在本词典其他词条下作了解释。例如，turn over a new leaf 这一表达在 leaf 词条下作了解释。

examples.text: He turned to his publicist and jokingly asked, 'What's next?'…
examples.translation: 他转向他的宣传员开玩笑地问道：“下一个是什么？”

examples.text: He sighed, turning away and surveying the sea...
examples.translation: 他叹口气，转身远眺大海。

examples.text: He turned his head left and right...
examples.translation: 他左右转动脑袋。

examples.text: He waited for the woman to turn her face back to the road.
examples.translation: 他等待那个女人把脸转回路这边。

examples.text: I felt a tapping on my shoulder and I turned around...
examples.translation: 我感到有人拍了一下我的肩膀，于是转过身去。

examples.text: Turn your upper body round so that your shoulders are facing to the side.
examples.translation: 转动上身，让双肩朝向一侧。

examples.text: They turned their telescopes towards other nearby galaxies...
examples.translation: 他们把望远镜转向附近其他星系。

examples.text: Turn the cake the right way up on to a wire rack…
examples.translation: 把蛋糕翻到合适的方向对准金属丝架上。

examples.text: I turned my jacket inside out…
examples.translation: 我把夹克衫翻了个面。

examples.text: She had turned the bedside chair to face the door...
examples.translation: 她把床头椅转向正对门的方向。

examples.text: The lid, turned upside down, served as a coffee table.
examples.translation: 那个盖子被翻过来当作咖啡桌。

examples.text: As the wheel turned, the potter shaped the clay...
examples.translation: 轮子一边转动，制陶工人一边拉坯。

examples.text: The engine turned a propeller.
examples.translation: 发动机使螺旋桨旋转起来。

examples.text: Turn a special key, press the brake pedal, and your car's brakes lock...
examples.translation: 转动一把特制的钥匙，踩下刹车踏板，这样你的汽车刹车就锁住了。

examples.text: Turn the heat to very low and cook for 20 minutes...
examples.translation: 把温度调到很低，煮 20 分钟。

examples.text: I tried the doorknob and it turned.
examples.translation: 我试了试门把手，结果它转动了。

examples.text: He turned into the narrow terraced street where he lived…
examples.translation: 他转向自己居住的那条夹在排房间的狭窄街道。

examples.text: Now turn right to follow West Ferry Road...
examples.translation: 现在向右拐沿西渡路往前走。

examples.text: The man with the umbrella turned the corner again.
examples.translation: 拿伞的人又拐进了拐角处。

examples.text: You can't do a right-hand turn here.
examples.translation: 此处禁止右拐。

examples.text: ...the corner where Tenterfield Road turned into the main road.
examples.translation: 滕特菲尔德路拐向主道的岔路口

examples.text: ...a sharp turn in the road.
examples.translation: 路上的急转弯

examples.text: There was not much time before the tide turned.
examples.translation: 不久就要涨潮了。

examples.text: They were still doing wild acrobatics in the yard, turning somersaults and cartwheels.
examples.translation: 他们还在院子里一通杂耍，翻着跟头，玩着侧手翻。

examples.text: He turned the pages of a file in front of him.
examples.translation: 他翻阅面前的文件。

examples.text: He tried to turn the gun on me...
examples.translation: 他企图把枪对准我。

examples.text: The crowd then turned their anger on Prime Minister James Mitchell.
examples.translation: 然后人群把怒火都撒向詹姆斯·米切尔总理。

examples.text: To order, turn to page 236.
examples.translation: 如需订购，参见 236 页。

examples.text: We turned our attention to the practical matters relating to forming a company...
examples.translation: 我们开始考虑有关成立公司的具体事宜。

examples.text: We turn now to the British news.
examples.translation: 我们现在来关注英国新闻。

examples.text: For assistance, they turned to one of the city's most innovative museums...
examples.translation: 他们求助于该市最具创新风格的一家博物馆。

examples.text: There was no one to turn to, no one to tell.
examples.translation: 没人可以求助，没人可以诉说。

examples.text: These communities are now turning to recycling in large numbers...
examples.translation: 这些团体现在正转而致力于大规模的回收利用工作。

examples.text: The Superpowers turned to the harder task of cutting their nuclear arsenals…
examples.translation: 超级大国开始着手削减核武器库这项更为艰难的工作。

examples.text: Universities are turning from academic to commercial sponsorship.
examples.translation: 各大学正从学术赞助转而寻求商业赞助。

examples.text: A prince turns into a frog in this cartoon fairytale...
examples.translation: 在这个卡通童话里王子变成了一只青蛙。

examples.text: Their grief turned to hysteria when the funeral procession arrived at the cemetery…
examples.translation: 当送葬队走到墓地时，他们更加悲恸欲绝。

examples.text: The hated dictator had turned his country into one of the poorest police states in Europe...
examples.translation: 这个为人深恶痛绝的独裁者把他的国家变成了欧洲最贫穷的极权国家之一。

examples.text: He soon turned his dreams to reality.
examples.translation: 他不久便梦想成真了。

examples.text: …an MP turned diplomat.
examples.translation: 成为外交官的下院议员

examples.text: If the bailiff thinks that things could turn nasty he will enlist the help of the police...
examples.translation: 如果法警认为事情变得不可收拾，他就会寻求警方的帮助。

examples.text: She announced that she was going to turn professional.
examples.translation: 她宣布自己即将成为职业选手。

examples.text: The sea would turn pale pink and the sky blood red...
examples.translation: 大海会变成浅粉色，天空则变成血红色。

examples.text: Her contact lenses turned her eyes green.
examples.translation: 隐形眼镜把她的眼睛变成了绿色。

examples.text: If it turns cold, cover plants...
examples.translation: 如果天气变冷，就把植物盖起来。

examples.text: The weather had turned warm and thundery overnight.
examples.translation: 天气一夜之间就转暖，而且雷声阵阵。

examples.text: The scandal took a new turn over the weekend.
examples.translation: 周末时丑闻有了新的发展。

examples.text: …the latest turn in the fighting…
examples.translation: 战斗的最新进展

examples.text: Retailers have given up waiting for a turn in the housing market.
examples.translation: 零售商们已放弃等待房产市场上的转机。

examples.text: The game turned in the 56th minute.
examples.translation: 比赛在第 56 分钟时发生了扭转。

examples.text: …the Gareth Edwards try which turned the game between France and Wales in Paris in 1971.
examples.translation: 加雷思·爱德华兹于 1971 年法国队与威尔士队在巴黎的比赛中贡献的一记扭转赛事的触地得分

examples.text: The firm will be able to service debt and still turn a modest profit...
examples.translation: 那家公司将有能力支付债务，而且还会赚得一笔可观的利润。

examples.text: He says the fares are just too low to turn profits.
examples.translation: 他说票价太低，根本无利可图。

examples.text: It was his ambition to accumulate a million dollars before he turned thirty...
examples.translation: 他立志要在而立之年以前攒够 100 万美元。

examples.text: It had just turned twelve o'clock.
examples.translation: 刚过 12 点。

examples.text: They fled to South America around the turn of the century.
examples.translation: 他们在世纪之交逃到了南美洲。

examples.text: ...the joys of making a living from turning wood.
examples.translation: 靠车削木材谋生的乐趣

examples.text: …finely-turned metal.
examples.translation: 精心车削的金属

examples.text: Tonight it's my turn to cook...
examples.translation: 今晚该我做饭了。

examples.text: Let each child have a turn at fishing...
examples.translation: 让每个孩子轮流钓鱼。

examples.text: Students are expected to take their turn leading the study group.
examples.translation: 学生们要依次轮流当学习小组的组长。

examples.text: He is having one of his turns…
examples.translation: 他又犯病了。

examples.text: He gets funny turns, you know. It's his age.
examples.translation: 他总是感觉不舒服。也是，他都这个岁数了。

examples.text: His tone was by turns angry and aggrieved.
examples.translation: 他的语气时而透着愤怒，时而流露出哀怨。

examples.text: They were horrified at this unexpected turn of events.
examples.translation: 这种出乎意料的形势变化让他们无比震惊。

examples.text: Its operations were hampered at every turn by inadequate numbers of trained staff...
examples.translation: 因为缺乏训练有素的员工，其生产经营总是遇到各种障碍。

examples.text: At every turn smoke and flame stopped efforts to get into the living quarters.
examples.translation: 到处是烟雾和火焰，根本无法进入住处。

examples.text: He did you a good turn by resigning...
examples.translation: 他辞职对你有利。

examples.text: One good turn deserves another.
examples.translation: 善有善报。

examples.text: They hadn't found a scrap of evidence though they had turned his flat inside out.
examples.translation: 他们虽然把他的公寓翻了个底朝天，却没有找到一丝证据。

examples.text: He felt too shocked to move. His world had been turned upside down.
examples.translation: 他惊呆了。他的世界已经完全被打乱了。

examples.text: One of the members of the surgical team leaked the story to a fellow physician who, in turn, confided in a reporter.
examples.translation: 手术小组的一名成员把这个消息泄露给了在一起工作的一个内科医生，后者又透露给了一位记者。

examples.text: There were cheers for each of the women as they spoke in turn.
examples.translation: 当这些女人们逐一发言时，她们每个人都赢得了喝彩声。

examples.text: She was of a rational turn of mind.
examples.translation: 她是个理性的人。

examples.text: I hope I haven't spoken out of turn.
examples.translation: 希望我没有多嘴。

examples.text: We took turns to drive the car...
examples.translation: 我们轮流开车。

examples.text: Ted and I took it in turns to go into hospital and sit with Emma.
examples.translation: 我和特德轮流去医院陪护埃玛。

examples.text: Her condition took a sharp turn for the worse.
examples.translation: 她的病情突然急剧恶化。

examples.text: Sarah was looking after the twins...
examples.translation: 萨拉当时正在照管那对双胞胎。

examples.text: I think there are many positive aspects to being a twin…
examples.translation: 我认为身为双胞胎中的一个有很多积极方面。

examples.text: She had a twin brother and a younger brother.
examples.translation: 她有一个双胞胎哥哥和一个弟弟。

examples.text: ...the twin spires of the cathedral.
examples.translation: 大教堂的那对尖塔

examples.text: ...the world's largest twin-engined aircraft.
examples.translation: 世界上最大的双引擎飞机

examples.text: ...the twin concepts of liberty and equality...
examples.translation: 自由与平等这两个密切相关的概念

examples.text: Nothing was done to save these women from the twin evils of begging or the workhouse.
examples.translation: 没有采取任何措施把这些妇女从乞讨或济贫院这两大相似的灾难中拯救出来。

examples.text: Five Polish banks are to be twinned with counterparts in Western Europe...
examples.translation: 5 家波兰银行将和 5 家西欧银行结为姐妹银行。

examples.text: The borough is twinned with Kasel in Germany.
examples.translation: 该自治市与德国的卡瑟尔市结成了友好城市。

examples.text: The twinning of Leeds and St Mary was formalised at a function held last week.
examples.translation: 在上周举行的典礼上，利兹市与圣玛丽市正式缔结为姐妹城市。

examples.text: This led Zagreb's twin town, Mainz, to donate £70,000-worth of high-quality equipment.
examples.translation: 这使得萨格勒布的友好城市美因茨捐赠了价值 7 万英镑的高品质装备。

examples.text: At night, lights twinkle in distant villages across the valleys.
examples.translation: 夜间，山谷那头的遥远村落里灯光闪闪。

examples.text: ...a band of twinkling diamonds.
examples.translation: 一串闪闪发光的钻石

examples.text: We always decorated a grand 6m pine tree on our front lawn with soft, twinkly blue lights.
examples.translation: 我们总是给屋前草坪上一棵 6 米高的大松树挂上柔和闪烁的蓝灯。

examples.text: She saw her mother's eyes twinkle with amusement.
examples.translation: 她看到母亲眼中闪烁着喜悦的光芒。

examples.text: A kindly twinkle came into her eyes.
examples.translation: 她的目光变得友善起来。

examples.text: She describes him as kind, warm, compassionate, with the most naughty twinkly blue eyes.
examples.translation: 她形容他善良、热情、富有同情心，还有一双最为顽皮的闪闪发亮的蓝眼睛。

examples.text: Her hands began to twist the handles of the bag she carried...
examples.translation: 她双手开始捻弄手提包的拎带。

examples.text: Twist the string carefully around the second stem with the other hand...
examples.translation: 用另外一只手小心地把细绳缠绕到第二根茎上。

examples.text: She twisted her hair into a bun and pinned it at the back of her head.
examples.translation: 她把头发盘成一个髻，用发夹别在脑后。

examples.text: He twisted her arms behind her back and clipped a pair of handcuffs on her wrists...
examples.translation: 他把她的胳膊扭到背后，在她手腕上拷上一副手铐。

examples.text: Sophia's face twisted in pain...
examples.translation: 索菲娅疼得脸都扭曲了。

examples.text: Her hands twisted in her lap…
examples.translation: 她的手在膝头扭绞着。

examples.text: The body was twisted, its legs at an awkward angle...
examples.translation: 尸体扭曲变形，双腿弯成别扭的角度。

examples.text: The car was left a mess of twisted metal.
examples.translation: 车子成了一堆扭曲的金属。

examples.text: She twisted her head sideways and looked towards the door...
examples.translation: 她侧头朝门看去。

examples.text: Susan twisted round in her seat until she could see Graham and Sabrina behind her...
examples.translation: 苏珊在座位上扭来扭去，直到她看见身后的格雷厄姆和萨布丽娜。

examples.text: Holding your arms straight out in front of you, twist to the right and left.
examples.translation: 双臂向前平伸，接着转向身体左右两侧。

examples.text: He fell and twisted his ankle...
examples.translation: 他摔倒了，扭伤了脚踝。

examples.text: Rupert Moon is out of today's session with a twisted knee.
examples.translation: 鲁珀特·穆恩扭伤了膝盖，无法参加今天的训练。

examples.text: She was staring down at her hands, twisting the ring on her finger...
examples.translation: 她低头盯着双手，转动手指上的戒指。

examples.text: She twisted the handle and opened the door…
examples.translation: 她转动门把手打开了门。

examples.text: Reaching up to a cupboard he takes out a jar and twists the lid off.
examples.translation: 他伸手够到上面的碗橱，拿出一个罐子并把盖子旋开。

examples.text: The bag is resealed with a simple twist of the valve.
examples.translation: 只需拧一下阀门，气囊就能重新密封。

examples.text: The roads twist round hairpin bends...
examples.translation: 道路呈U字形蜿蜒曲折。

examples.text: The lane twists and turns between pleasant but unspectacular cottages.
examples.translation: 小径在令人惬意而又毫不起眼的村舍间迂回曲折。

examples.text: It allows the train to maintain a constant speed through the twists and turns of existing track.
examples.translation: 它使火车在通过现有轨道的弯曲处时得以保持恒定的车速。

examples.text: It's a shame the way that the media can twist your words and misrepresent you...
examples.translation: 媒体歪曲他人言论、曲解他人意图的做法真是可耻。

examples.text: Even remarks that were quite innocent could be twisted to produce an unintended effect.
examples.translation: 即便完全没有恶意的话都会被歪曲，以达到并非说话人本意的效果。

examples.text: …the twists and turns of economic policy…
examples.translation: 经济政策的一波三折

examples.text: The battle of the sexes also took a new twist...
examples.translation: 两性之争也出现了新的变数。

examples.text: Roger Hardy of the BBC looks at this latest twist in the political crisis in Algeria…
examples.translation: 英国广播公司的罗杰·哈迪就阿尔及利亚政治危机的这一最新转机作出解析。

examples.text: As so often happens, this little story has a twist in the tail.
examples.translation: 正如经常发生的那样，这个小故事在结尾处出现了转折。

examples.text: ...bunches of violets in twists of paper...
examples.translation: 纸卷包裹的一束束紫罗兰

examples.text: A thin twist of smoke curled from the cottage's single chimney.
examples.translation: 一缕盘旋的轻烟从农舍唯一的烟囱里缭绕升起。

examples.text: By a curious twist of fate, cricket was also my favourite sport...
examples.translation: 让人感到惊奇的是，板球碰巧也是我最喜欢的运动。

examples.text: In a cruel twist of fate, Ann's husband Bill is also suffering from the disease.
examples.translation: 造物弄人，安的丈夫比尔也患上了那种病。

examples.text: Divorce is never the fault of one partner; it takes two...
examples.translation: 离婚从来都不是一方的错误：双方都有责任。

examples.text: It takes two to tango and so far our relationship has been one-sided.
examples.translation: 双方都应该努力，可迄今为止我们的关系只是一厢情愿。

examples.text: Putting two and two together, I assume that this was the car he used.
examples.translation: 根据我的了解，我猜想这是他曾开过的车子。

examples.text: …several types of lettuce…
examples.translation: 几个不同品种的莴苣

examples.text: There are various types of the disease...
examples.translation: 该疾病有各种类型。

examples.text: In 1990, 25% of households were of this type.
examples.translation: 1990年，25%的家庭属于这种类型。

examples.text: Have you done this type of work before?...
examples.translation: 你以前做过这种活儿吗？

examples.text: Rates of interest for this type of borrowing can be high...
examples.translation: 这种类型的借款利率可能会很高。

examples.text: I am a very determined type of person.
examples.translation: 我是那种非常坚决的人。

examples.text: It's the first time I, a fair-skinned, freckly type, have sailed in the sun without burning...
examples.translation: 身为那种皮肤白皙而又长雀斑的人，这是我第一次在阳光下航行而没有被晒伤。

examples.text: I was rather an outdoor type…
examples.translation: 我是那种特别喜欢户外运动的人。

examples.text: She was certainly not the type to murder her husband.
examples.translation: 她绝不是那种会谋杀亲夫的人。

examples.text: At first I thought he was rather ordinary looking, a little chubby, not my type...
examples.translation: 刚开始我认为他相貌很普通，有点胖乎乎的，并非我喜欢的类型。

examples.text: I'm not his type. I am probably too strong a character.
examples.translation: 我不是他喜欢的类型。大概我性格太要强了。

examples.text: I can type your essays for you...
examples.translation: 我可以帮你把文章打出来。

examples.text: I had never really learnt to type properly...
examples.translation: 我从来没真正学会怎样正确打字。

examples.text: The letter consists of six closely typed pages.
examples.translation: 那封信有密密麻麻打印出来的 6 页。

examples.text: The correction had already been set in type.
examples.translation: 那处修正已经出现在铅字纸上。

examples.text: Mr. DOC SEARLS (Blogger): Text(ph) as if he had a typewriter and that's what he used.
At 0800 GMT, the typhoon was centered about 430 kilometers southwest of Hong Kong.

meanings.meaning: 典型的；特有的；象征性的

examples.text: Cheney is everyone's image of a typical cop: a big white guy, six foot, 220 pounds...
examples.translation: 切尼是每个人心目中典型的警察形象：大块头白人，6 英尺高，220磅重。

examples.text: Carole goes in for such typical schoolgirl pastimes as horse-riding and watching old films…
examples.translation: 卡萝尔喜欢一些女生常玩的娱乐活动，例如骑马、看老电影等。

examples.text: Horrigan was typical of the new-generation executive Sticht had brought into the company.
examples.translation: 霍里根是施蒂希特引入公司的新一代主管的典型代表。

examples.text: This reluctance to move towards a democratic state is typical of totalitarian regimes...
examples.translation: 不愿朝民主制国家迈进是极权主义政权的特性。

examples.text: This is not typical of Chinese, but is a feature of the Thai language…
examples.translation: 这不是汉语所特有的，而是泰语的一个特征。

examples.text: With typical energy he found new journalistic outlets.
examples.translation: 他凭着自己特有的干劲找到了新的新闻渠道。

examples.text: She threw her hands into the air. 'That is just typical of you, isn't it?'
examples.translation: 她挥舞着双手说，“只有你才干得出来，不是吗？”

examples.text: 'Typical!' Hattie slammed down the receiver. 'Absolutely typical!'
examples.translation: “果不其然！”哈蒂重重摔下听筒。“真是果不其然啊！”

examples.text: David Siegrist joined the CNN.com chat room by telephone and CNN provided a typist.

meanings.meaning: 丑陋的；邪恶的；令人厌恶的

examples.text: ...an ugly little hat...
examples.translation: 难看的小帽子

examples.text: She makes me feel dowdy and ugly.
examples.translation: 她让我自惭形秽。

examples.text: ...the raw ugliness of his native city.
examples.translation: 他老家城市的极度丑陋

examples.text: There have been some ugly scenes...
examples.translation: 出现了一些恶性事件。

examples.text: The confrontation turned ugly.
examples.translation: 对抗局面进一步激化。

examples.text: ...an ugly publicity stunt.
examples.translation: 恶俗的宣传噱头

examples.text: ...the subtlety and ugliness of sexual harassment.
examples.translation: 性骚扰的隐蔽与龌龊

examples.text: He said it is still not possible to predict the ultimate outcome...
examples.translation: 他说现在还无法预料最终的结局。

examples.text: The ultimate aim is to expand the network further.
examples.translation: 最终目的是为了进一步拓展该网络。

examples.text: Plants are the ultimate source of all foodstuffs...
examples.translation: 植物是所有食物的最根本来源。

examples.text: The ultimate cause of what's happened seems to have been the advertising campaign.
examples.translation: 出事的最根本原因似乎在于那场广告宣传活动。

examples.text: ...the ultimate power of the central government...
examples.translation: 中央政府的至高权力

examples.text: Of course, the ultimate authority remained the presidency...
examples.translation: 当然，拥有最高权力者依然是总统。

examples.text: My experience as player, coach and manager has prepared me for this ultimate challenge.
examples.translation: 当球员、教练和主教练的经历锻炼了我，使我能够应对这一终极挑战。

examples.text: Being removed from his post during operations is the ultimate humiliation for a ship's captain.
examples.translation: 在执行任务的过程中被免职，这对一位船长来说是莫大的耻辱。

examples.text: Treachery was the ultimate sin...
examples.translation: 背叛是最不可饶恕的罪孽。

examples.text: Coleman lives in fear of the ultimate disgrace.
examples.translation: 科尔曼整天担心会颜面尽失。

examples.text: He is the ultimate English gentleman...
examples.translation: 他是最最典型的英国绅士。

examples.text: Caviar and oysters on ice are generally considered the ultimate luxury foods.
examples.translation: 一般认为，鱼子酱和冰镇牡蛎是顶级美味。

examples.text: Ballet is the ultimate in human movement...
examples.translation: 芭蕾舞在人类的动作中可谓优雅至极。

examples.text: This hotel is the ultimate in luxury...
examples.translation: 该酒店极尽奢华。

examples.text: Working from home offers the ultimate in flexible life styles.
examples.translation: 在家办公为人们提供了极其灵活的生活方式。

examples.text: The sun's ultraviolet rays are responsible for both tanning and burning.
examples.translation: 阳光中的紫外线是皮肤晒黑和灼伤的根源。

meanings.meaning: 雨伞；保护伞；庇护；伞形结构

examples.text: Harry held an umbrella over Dawn.
examples.translation: 哈里为唐打着伞。

examples.text: Does coincidence come under the umbrella of the paranormal?...
examples.translation: 巧合属于超自然现象吗？

examples.text: Within the umbrella term 'dementia' there are many different kinds of disease.
examples.translation: “痴呆”这一统称里包括多种不同的疾病。

examples.text: ...Socialist International, an umbrella group comprising almost a hundred Social Democrat parties...
examples.translation: 社会党国际，一个包括近百个社会民主党的综合团体

examples.text: The major powers have chosen to act under the moral umbrella of the United Nations...
examples.translation: 世界主要大国都选择在联合国的道义框架下行事。

examples.text: Britain cannot avoid being under the US nuclear umbrella, whether it wants to or not.
examples.translation: 不管愿不愿意，英国都免不了要处于美国的核保护伞之下。

meanings.meaning: 全体一致的；意见一致的；无异议的

examples.text: Editors were unanimous in their condemnation of the proposals...
examples.translation: 编辑人员一致谴责这些提议。

examples.text: They were unanimous that Chortlesby Manor must be preserved.
examples.translation: 他们一致认为必须对乔特勒斯比庄园加以保护。

examples.text: Today its executive committee voted unanimously to reject the proposals...
examples.translation: 今天执行委员会投票一致否决了这些提案。

examples.text: The board of ministers unanimously approved the project last week.
examples.translation: 上周长执会一致批准了这个项目。

examples.text: ...the unanimous vote for Hungarian membership...
examples.translation: 投票一致同意匈牙利成为会员国

examples.text: Their decision was unanimous.
examples.translation: 他们的决定是全体一致通过的。

meanings.meaning: 叔叔；伯父；伯伯；舅父；姨丈；姑父

examples.text: My uncle was the mayor of Memphis...
examples.translation: 我伯父是孟菲斯市市长。

examples.text: A telegram from Uncle Fred arrived...
examples.translation: 弗雷德舅舅发的一封电报来了。

examples.text: Uncle, pa wants to see you.
examples.translation: 舅舅，我爸爸想见你。

examples.text: Auditors said they had uncovered evidence of fraud...
examples.translation: 审计人员说他们已经发现了欺诈的证据。

examples.text: A specific plot to kill him was uncovered in the past couple of weeks.
examples.translation: 一个针对他的暗杀阴谋在过去几周里被揭露了出来。

examples.text: Archaeologists have uncovered an 11,700-year-old hunting camp in Alaska.
examples.translation: 考古学家在阿拉斯加发现了一个距今11,700年的狩猎营地。

examples.text: When the seedlings sprout, uncover the tray.
examples.translation: 秧苗发芽后，就把盘子上的盖子拿掉。

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, under is also used in phrasal verbs such as ‘go under’ and ‘knuckle under’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，under还可用于go under，knuckle under等短语动词中。

examples.text: ...swimming in the pool or lying under an umbrella...
examples.translation: 在泳池里游泳或躺在阳伞底下

examples.text: Under a wide shelf that holds coffee jars stands a pile of magazines...
examples.translation: 放咖啡罐的一个宽架子下方有一摞杂志。

examples.text: She buried her head under the covers, pretending to be asleep...
examples.translation: 她把头埋到被子底下，假装睡着了。

examples.text: A path runs under the trees.
examples.translation: 树下有一条小径。

examples.text: They said he'd been held under the water and drowned...
examples.translation: 他们说他被按到水里淹死了。

examples.text: Goldfish were swimming lazily in a group just under the surface.
examples.translation: 金鱼聚在一起贴着水面懒洋洋地游着。

examples.text: When the water was up to his neck, a hand came from behind and pushed his head under.
examples.translation: 水没到他的脖子时，从后面伸过来一只手把他的头按到了水里。

examples.text: He went under a brick arch...
examples.translation: 他穿过一个砖砌的拱门。

examples.text: A river boat passed under the bridge.
examples.translation: 一条内河船从桥下经过。

examples.text: I was wearing two sweaters under the green army jacket...
examples.translation: 我在绿军装里套了两件毛线衫。

examples.text: He had no shirt on under his thin jumper...
examples.translation: 他在薄套头衫里面没有穿衬衣。

examples.text: It was hard to see the colours under the layer of dust.
examples.translation: 蒙了一层灰尘后颜色就很难看清了。

examples.text: ...fishermen whose livelihoods are under threat...
examples.translation: 生计受到威胁的渔夫

examples.text: I'm rarely under pressure and my co-workers are always nice to me...
examples.translation: 我很少感受到压力，同事们一直对我很好。

examples.text: Firemen said they had the blaze under control...
examples.translation: 消防队员说他们已经控制住了火势。

examples.text: The cause of the crash was under investigation...
examples.translation: 事故原因正在调查中。

examples.text: He was rushed to court yesterday under armed guard.
examples.translation: 昨天他被急匆匆地武装押解到了法庭。

examples.text: His best friend was killed by police under extremely questionable circumstances...
examples.translation: 他最好的朋友在极其可疑的情况下被警察打死了。

examples.text: Under normal conditions, only about 20 to 40 per cent of vitamin E is absorbed...
examples.translation: 正常情况下，仅有20%到40%的维生素E会被吸收。

examples.text: Most doctors and nurses live under stressful conditions.
examples.translation: 大多数医生和护士都承受着很大的压力。

examples.text: Under law, your employer has the right to hire a temporary worker to replace you...
examples.translation: 根据法律规定，你的雇主有权雇用一名临时工来代替你。

examples.text: We believe an offence was committed under EU regulations...
examples.translation: 我们认为根据欧盟有关规定已经构成了犯罪。

examples.text: Under the Constitution, you cannot be tried twice for the same crime.
examples.translation: 依据《宪法》规定，不能一罪两判。

examples.text: There would be no new taxes under his leadership.
examples.translation: 在他主政期间不会增加新税种。

examples.text: ...the realities of life under a brutal dictatorship...
examples.translation: 残暴的独裁统治下的生活现实

examples.text: The North has been under Communist rule since 1954.
examples.translation: 北方自1954年起就一直处于共产党的统治之下。

examples.text: Kiefer was just one of the artists who had studied under Beuys in the early Sixties...
examples.translation: 基弗只是60年代早期师从博伊斯的艺术家之一。

examples.text: General Lewis Hyde had served under General 'Billy' Mitchell...
examples.translation: 刘易斯·海德将军曾是“比利”·米切尔将军的部下。

examples.text: I am the new manager and you will be working under me.
examples.translation: 我是新任的经理，你们将在我手下工作。

examples.text: Were any of your books published under the name Amanda Fairchild?...
examples.translation: 你们所出版的书里有署名为阿曼达·费尔柴尔德的吗？

examples.text: The patient was registered under a false name.
examples.translation: 那位患者挂号时用了假名。

examples.text: This study is described under 'General Diseases of the Eye'...
examples.translation: “普通眼科疾病”这一部分里对该项研究作了描述。

examples.text: ...a parental rights order under section 4 of the Family Law Reform Act...
examples.translation: 《家庭法改革法案》第4款中有关父母权利的规定

examples.text: Where would it be?' — 'Filed under C, second drawer down.'
examples.translation: “它会在哪儿？”——“归放在C字母下，往下数第二个抽屉。”

examples.text: ...jobs for those under 65...
examples.translation: 适合65岁以下人群从事的工作

examples.text: Nearly half of mothers with children under five have a job...
examples.translation: 孩子不满5岁的妈妈中近一半有工作。

examples.text: Expenditure this year should be just under 15 billion pounds.
examples.translation: 今年的支出应正好低于150亿英镑。

examples.text: ...free childminding service for 5's and under.
examples.translation: 免费照看5岁及5岁以下儿童的服务 under canvas

examples.text: None of us should ever underestimate the degree of difficulty women face in career advancement...
examples.translation: 我们谁都不应该低估女性在事业发展过程中所面临的困难程度。

examples.text: Never underestimate what you can learn from a group of like-minded people.
examples.translation: 千万不要低估你从一群志趣相投的人那里所能学到的东西。

examples.text: ...a serious underestimation of harm to the environment.
examples.translation: 对危害环境程度的严重低估

examples.text: I think a lot of people still underestimate him...
examples.translation: 我觉得很多人仍然低估了他。

examples.text: The first lesson I learnt as a soldier was never to underestimate the enemy.
examples.translation: 作为一名士兵，我学到的第一课就是决不要低估敌人。

examples.text: New recruits have been undergoing training in recent weeks...
examples.translation: 最近几周，新兵正在接受训练。

examples.text: He underwent an agonising 48-hour wait for the results of tests.
examples.translation: 他苦苦等待了48个小时，化验结果才出来。

examples.text: Economics undergraduates are probably the brightest in the university.
examples.translation: 经济学专业的本科生可能是大学里最聪明的学生。

examples.text: ...undergraduate degree programmes.
examples.translation: 大学本科课程

meanings.meaning: 地下的；秘密的；先锋派的
地下；地铁；地道；地下组织；秘密活动；先锋派团体

examples.text: Solid low-level waste will be disposed of deep underground...
examples.translation: 放射性水平低的固体废料将做地下深埋处理。

examples.text: The plane hit so hard that one engine was buried 16 feet underground.
examples.translation: 飞机猛烈撞击地面，致使一个引擎陷到了地下16英尺处。

examples.text: ...a run-down shopping area with an underground car park.
examples.translation: 带有地下停车场的破败的购物区

examples.text: ...underground water pipes.
examples.translation: 地下水管

examples.text: ...a woman alone in the underground waiting for a train...
examples.translation: 独自在地铁里等车的女子

examples.text: He crossed London by underground...
examples.translation: 他乘地铁穿过伦敦。

examples.text: The underground is ideal for getting to work in Milan.
examples.translation: 在米兰，乘地铁去上班非常便捷。

examples.text: These US dollars were smuggled into the country during the war, to aid the underground.
examples.translation: 战争期间，这些美元被偷运到该国，用以资助那里的地下组织。

examples.text: ...the underground Kashmir Liberation Front...
examples.translation: 秘密的克什米尔解放阵线

examples.text: They are accused of organising and financing an underground youth movement.
examples.translation: 他们被指控组织并资助地下青年运动。

examples.text: After the violent clashes of 1981 they either went underground or left the country.
examples.translation: 经历了1981年的激烈冲突之后，他们或转入地下，或离开了该国。

examples.text: ...opposition leaders, who are working underground because of the threat of arrest.
examples.translation: 面临被捕危险不得不秘密开展工作的反对派领导人

examples.text: Try to figure out what feeling underlies your anger.
examples.translation: 努力找出你的愤怒之下潜藏的情感。

examples.text: ...the energy which seems to underlie all human success.
examples.translation: 人类一切成功背后似乎都不可缺少的干劲

examples.text: The report underlined his concern that standards were at risk...
examples.translation: 报告强调了他对道德水准可能会受影响所表示的关注。

examples.text: The decision to keep him in hospital for a second night underlines the seriousness of his injury...
examples.translation: 让他在医院再住一晚的决定表明了其伤势的严重性。

examples.text: But the incident underlines how easily things can go wrong.
examples.translation: 但这一事件也突出表明出差错是多么容易。

examples.text: Underline the following that apply to you...
examples.translation: 在符合自身情况的项下画线。

examples.text: Take two coloured pens and underline the positive and negative words.
examples.translation: 用两支彩笔分别在表示肯定和否定意义的词下面画线。

meanings.meaning: 潜在的；根本的；在下面的；优先的
放在…的下面；为…的基础；优先于（underlie的ing形式）

examples.text: To stop a problem you have to understand its underlying causes...
examples.translation: 要想杜绝问题的发生，必须弄清它的深层原因。

examples.text: I think that the underlying problem is education, unemployment and bad housing.
examples.translation: 我认为深层的问题在于教育、失业和糟糕的住房条件。

examples.text: ...hills with the hard underlying rock poking through the turf...
examples.translation: 坚硬的下层岩石穿过草皮凸出来的山丘

examples.text: Cars were covered with clear-coat finish at the factory to protect the underlying paint from fading.
examples.translation: 工厂给汽车上了透明罩漆，以防底漆褪色。

meanings.meaning: 破坏，渐渐破坏；挖掘地基

examples.text: Offering advice on each and every problem will undermine her feeling of being adult...
examples.translation: 对每个问题都给出建议会令她觉得自己不像个成年人。

examples.text: Western intelligence agencies are accused of trying to undermine the government.
examples.translation: 西方情报机构被指责企图动摇该政府的统治。

examples.text: She undermined him and destroyed his confidence in his own talent...
examples.translation: 她暗中打击他，让他对自己的才华信心全无。

examples.text: The conversations were designed to undermine her authority so she felt that she could no longer work for the company.
examples.translation: 这些谈话有意削弱她的威信，这样她会觉得自己在公司干不下去。

examples.text: The continued fighting threatens to undermine efforts to negotiate an agreement...
examples.translation: 持续的战斗会破坏希望通过谈判来达成协议的努力。

examples.text: I don't want to do something that would undermine the chances of success.
examples.translation: 我不想做会影响成功机会的事情。

meanings.meaning: 在…的下面；在…的形式下；在…的支配下

examples.text: The device exploded underneath a van.
examples.translation: 该装置在一辆货车底下发生了爆炸。

examples.text: ...using dogs to locate people trapped underneath collapsed buildings.
examples.translation: 利用狗来寻找被困在倒塌的楼房下面的人

examples.text: ...a table for two underneath the olive trees...
examples.translation: 橄榄树下的一张两人桌

examples.text: Her apartment was underneath a bar, called 'The Lift'.
examples.translation: 她的公寓在一个叫“醒神”的酒吧下面。

examples.text: He has on a denim shirt with a T-shirt underneath.
examples.translation: 他穿了一件牛仔衬衫，里面套了件T恤。

examples.text: ...if we could maybe pull back a bit of this carpet to see what's underneath...
examples.translation: 我们能否把这块地毯往后拉一拉，看底下是什么东西

examples.text: The shooting-range is lit from underneath by rows of ruby-red light fittings.
examples.translation: 射击场被一排排深红色的灯光设备从下面照亮了。

examples.text: Check the actual construction of the chair by looking underneath...
examples.translation: 看看椅子的下面，检查一下它的实际构造。

examples.text: The sand martin is a brown bird with white underneath...
examples.translation: 崖沙燕是一种褐羽白腹的鸟。

examples.text: His bare feet were smooth on top and rough-skinned underneath.
examples.translation: 他赤裸的双脚脚面很光滑，脚底却很粗糙。

examples.text: Some objects had got entangled with the underneath mechanism of the engine.
examples.translation: 一些东西缠在了发动机下面的机件上。

examples.text: Now I know what the underneath of a car looks like.
examples.translation: 现在我知道汽车的底部是什么样子了。

examples.text: He was as violent as Nick underneath...
examples.translation: 在内心深处，他和尼克一样暴躁不安。

examples.text: Underneath, Sofia was deeply committed to her husband.
examples.translation: 索菲娅从内心里对丈夫忠贞不贰。

examples.text: Underneath his outgoing behaviour Luke was shy.
examples.translation: 在外向活泼的外表下，卢克其实很害羞。

meanings.meaning: 了解的；聪明的；有理解力的

examples.text: They have to have a basic understanding of computers in order to use the advanced technology.
examples.translation: 要想利用先进技术，他们必须先对计算机有个基本的了解。

examples.text: Her boss, who was very understanding, gave her time off...
examples.translation: 她的老板很通情达理，准了她的假。

examples.text: Fortunately for John, he had an understanding wife.
examples.translation: 幸运的是，约翰有一个通情达理的妻子。

examples.text: We would like to thank them for their patience and understanding.
examples.translation: 我们要感谢他们的耐心和理解。

examples.text: There was complete understanding between Wilson and myself.
examples.translation: 我和威尔逊之间完全能够彼此理解，相互信任。

examples.text: We had not set a date for marriage but there was an understanding between us.
examples.translation: 我们还没有确定结婚的日子，不过我们对此有一致的想法。

examples.text: It is my understanding that this torture has been going on for many years...
examples.translation: 据我了解，这种折磨已经持续很多年了。

examples.text: Our understanding is that they wanted to be in Washington.
examples.translation: 我们的理解是，他们想呆在华盛顿。

examples.text: Kevin had treatment on the understanding that he would attempt to overcome his drinking problem.
examples.translation: 凯文接受了治疗，但条件是他要努力克服自身的酗酒问题。

meanings.meaning: 承担，保证；从事；同意；试图

examples.text: She undertook the arduous task of monitoring the elections.
examples.translation: 她承担了监督选举的艰巨任务。

examples.text: He undertook to edit the text himself.
examples.translation: 他答应亲自编辑正文的内容。

examples.text: I managed secretly to undo a corner of the parcel...
examples.translation: 我悄悄地设法解开了包裹的一角。

examples.text: I undid the bottom two buttons of my yellow and grey shirt...
examples.translation: 我解开了自己黄灰相间的衬衫上最下面的两个纽扣。

examples.text: Some clamps that had held the device together came undone.
examples.translation: 用来将装置夹在一起的一些夹子松开了。

examples.text: A heavy-handed approach from the police could undo that good impression...
examples.translation: 警方采取高压手段可能会毁掉之前留下的好印象。

examples.text: She knew it would be difficult to undo the damage that had been done...
examples.translation: 她知道想要消除已经造成的损害是很难的。

examples.text: If Michael won, he would undo everything I have fought for.
examples.translation: 如果迈克尔赢了，那我一直以来努力争取的一切都将白费。

examples.text: They were undone by a goal from John Barnes...
examples.translation: 约翰·巴恩斯的一粒进球使他们落败。

examples.text: Macbeth is the story of a Scottish soldier who becomes king but is undone by his own ambition.
examples.translation: 《麦克白》讲述的是一个苏格兰士兵当上了国王，却毁于自己的野心。

examples.text: I think you heard and also understand me...
examples.translation: 我想你听到了我的话，也明白我的意思。

examples.text: Rusty nodded as though she understood the old woman...
examples.translation: 拉斯蒂点点头，好像听懂了那位老妇人的话似的。

examples.text: I don't understand what you are talking about...
examples.translation: 我不明白你在说什么。

examples.text: He was speaking poor English, trying to make himself understood.
examples.translation: 他的英语说得很差，努力想让别人明白他的意思。

examples.text: I couldn't read or understand a word of Yiddish, so I asked him to translate.
examples.translation: 我根本不懂意第绪语，所以请他来翻译。

examples.text: It would be nice to have someone who really understood me, a friend...
examples.translation: 要是有个真正理解我的人、有个朋友就好了。

examples.text: Trish had not exactly understood his feelings...
examples.translation: 特里希并没有完全理解他的感受。

examples.text: She understands why I get tired and grumpy.
examples.translation: 她理解我为什么累、为什么爱发火。

examples.text: They are too young to understand what is going on...
examples.translation: 他们还太小，不明白发生了什么事。

examples.text: She didn't understand why the TV was kept out of reach of the patients...
examples.translation: 她不明白为什么病人不能看电视。

examples.text: In the effort to understand AIDS, attention is moving from the virus to the immune system.
examples.translation: 为了解艾滋病，人们的注意力从艾滋病病毒转向了免疫系统。

examples.text: We understand that she's in the studio recording her second album...
examples.translation: 我们听说她正在录音棚录制她的第二张专辑。

examples.text: I understand you've heard about David...
examples.translation: 我知道你们已经听说了戴维的事了。

examples.text: As I understand it, you came round the corner by the cricket field and there was the man in the road...
examples.translation: 据我了解，你沿板球场边来到拐角处，那个男的挡住了你的去路。

examples.text: The management is understood to be very unwilling to agree to this request...
examples.translation: 据了解，管理层很不乐意答应这项要求。

examples.text: It is understood that the veteran reporter had a heart attack.
examples.translation: 据悉，那位资深记者心脏病发作。

examples.text: I am given to understand that he was swearing throughout the game at our fans.
examples.translation: 我得知整场比赛中他一直冲着我方球迷骂个不停。

examples.text: You do not hit my grandchildren, do you understand?...
examples.translation: 你不准打我的孙子孙女，明白吗？

examples.text: I don't need it, understand?...
examples.translation: 我不需要，懂吗？

examples.text: I don't want to hear another word about it. Is that understood, Emma?
examples.translation: 关于此事我不想再听到一个字，明白吗，埃玛？

examples.text: Such changes would undoubtedly result in even larger effects for our nation's most needy children.

meanings.meaning: 不舒服的；心神不安的；不稳定的

examples.text: He said nothing but gave me a sly grin that made me feel terribly uneasy...
examples.translation: 他什么也没说，只是朝我狡黠地笑了笑，这让我感到极其不安。

examples.text: He looked uneasy and refused to answer questions...
examples.translation: 他看上去焦虑不安，拒绝回答问题。

examples.text: I had an uneasy feeling that he was going to spoil it.
examples.translation: 我有种不安的感觉，觉得他会把事情搞糟。

examples.text: Meg shifted uneasily on her chair...
examples.translation: 梅格坐在椅子上焦躁不安地动来动去。

examples.text: He laughed uneasily...
examples.translation: 他局促不安地笑了。

examples.text: 'Well,' she said a little uneasily, 'what is it?'...
examples.translation: “噢，”她有些不自在地说道，“是什么？”

examples.text: He was uneasily aware of another watcher in the bushes.
examples.translation: 他不安地感到还有一个人在灌木丛里盯着他。

examples.text: With a small degree of uneasiness, he pushed it open and stuck his head inside.
examples.translation: 他略带不安地将它推开，把头探了进去。

examples.text: Richard was uneasy about how best to approach his elderly mother...
examples.translation: 最好如何去跟年迈的母亲谈，理查德心里没有数。

examples.text: Scientists feel uneasy about giving a positive answer.
examples.translation: 科学家们觉得很难给出一个明确的答案。

examples.text: I felt a great uneasiness about meeting her again.
examples.translation: 想到要再次见到她，我感到极不自在。

examples.text: An uneasy calm has settled over Los Angeles...
examples.translation: 洛杉矶归于一种不稳定的平静之中。

examples.text: The uneasy alliance between these two men offered a glimmer of hope...
examples.translation: 两人之间不够稳固的联合给了人们一线希望。

examples.text: There is an uneasy relationship between us and the politicians.
examples.translation: 我们和那些政治家之间的关系很不稳固。

examples.text: Democracy and entrepreneurial flair often sit uneasily together...
examples.translation: 民主与创业才干常常不能融洽地并存。

examples.text: The people have always coexisted uneasily since their country came into being.
examples.translation: 自从建国以来，人们一直都相处得不很融洽。

examples.text: ...a country whose component parts fit uneasily together.
examples.translation: 由各组成部分勉强拼凑在一起的国家

examples.text: 'Rid Of Me' is harrowing, uneasy listening...
examples.translation: 《弃我而去》这首歌非常伤感，听起来很晦涩。

examples.text: This is an uneasy travel book.
examples.translation: 这本旅游手册不是很好懂。

examples.text: ...an uneasy mix of thudding bass, drums and screaming guitar.
examples.translation: 沉闷的贝司声、鼓声和尖利的吉他声胡乱混杂在一起

examples.text: ...an area that had the highest unemployment rate in western Europe...
examples.translation: 西欧失业率最高的地区

examples.text: Unemployment is so damaging both to individuals and to communities.
examples.translation: 失业对个人和社会都有极大的负面影响。

examples.text: His death was totally unexpected...
examples.translation: 他的死亡完全出乎意料。

examples.text: He made a brief, unexpected appearance at the office...
examples.translation: 他出乎意料地在办公室露了一下脸。

examples.text: Help may also come from some unexpected places...
examples.translation: 帮助也可能来自某些意想不到的地方。

examples.text: 'Hello,' he said. 'This is an unexpected pleasure.'
examples.translation: “嗨，”他说。“这真是个意外之喜。”

examples.text: Moss had clamped an unexpectedly strong grip on his arm...
examples.translation: 莫斯突然紧紧抓住他的手臂。

examples.text: The Indians came out unexpectedly, catching the soldiers off-guard.
examples.translation: 印第安人突如其来地出现，令士兵们猝不及防。

examples.text: Unfortunately, my time is limited...
examples.translation: 可惜的是，我的时间有限。

examples.text: Unfortunately for the Prince, his title brought obligations as well as privileges...
examples.translation: 可惜对于王子来说，封号赋予他特权的同时也给他带来了义务。

examples.text: The enclosed photograph is unfortunately not good enough to reproduce.
examples.translation: 遗憾的是，附寄的照片不够清晰，无法复制。

examples.text: The outcome depends on conditions as well as how events unfold...
examples.translation: 结果取决于条件，还取决于事件的进展。

examples.text: The facts started to unfold before them.
examples.translation: 真相开始在他们面前显露出来。

examples.text: Don's story unfolded as the cruise got under way...
examples.translation: 随着航行的开始，唐的故事也随之展开。

examples.text: Mr Wills unfolds his story with evident enjoyment.
examples.translation: 威尔斯先生喜形于色地讲述自己的经历。

examples.text: He quickly unfolded the blankets and spread them on the mattress...
examples.translation: 他迅速展开毯子，铺在床垫上。

examples.text: When the bird lifts off into flight, its wings unfold to an impressive six-foot span.
examples.translation: 这种鸟起飞时，翼展可达6英尺，很惊人。

meanings.meaning: 统一的；一致的；相同的；均衡的；始终如一的

examples.text: The town police wear dark blue uniforms and flat caps...
examples.translation: 镇上的警察穿着深蓝色制服，戴着鸭舌帽。

examples.text: Philippe was in uniform, wearing a pistol holster on his belt...
examples.translation: 菲利普身着制服，腰带上别着手枪皮套。

examples.text: She will probably take great pride in wearing school uniform.
examples.translation: 她大概会为穿上校服而感到非常得意。

examples.text: Mark's is the uniform of the young male traveller — green Army trousers, T-shirt and shirt.
examples.translation: 马克一身年轻男性旅行者的典型行头——绿军裤、T恤外加衬衫。

examples.text: Chips should be cut into uniform size and thickness...
examples.translation: 土豆条要切得大小厚薄均匀。

examples.text: All flowing water, though it appears to be uniform, is actually divided into extensive inner surfaces, or layers, moving against one another...
examples.translation: 所有流动的水看似一成不变，但实际上内部分成许多广延的面，或者说层，彼此逆向移动。

examples.text: The price rises will not be uniform across the country.
examples.translation: 全国各地的价格涨幅将不会划一。

examples.text: ...the caramel that was used to maintain uniformity of color in the brandy.
examples.translation: 用来使白兰地色泽保持均匀的焦糖

examples.text: Beyond the windows, a November midday was uniformly grey...
examples.translation: 往窗外望去，11月的中午始终都是灰蒙蒙的。

examples.text: Microwaves heat water uniformly.
examples.translation: 微波炉能把水均匀加热。

examples.text: Along each wall stretched uniform green metal filing cabinets...
examples.translation: 每面墙边都一溜摆着相同的绿色金属档案柜。

examples.text: Shrimp are raised in long uniform ponds, frozen in the nearby packing plant and shipped north.
examples.translation: 虾放养在清一色的长池子里，再送到附近的包装车间冷冻，最后用船运往北方。

examples.text: ...the dull uniformity of the houses.
examples.translation: 房子样式的千篇一律

examples.text: They are all about twenty years old, serious, smart, a bit conventional perhaps, but uniformly pleasant...
examples.translation: 他们全部20岁左右，严肃、聪明，也许还有点传统，但是都很讨人喜欢。

examples.text: The natives uniformly agreed on this important point.
examples.translation: 当地人在这一要点上达成了共识。

examples.text: A flexible retirement age is being considered by Ministers to unify men's and women's pension rights...
examples.translation: 大臣们正在考虑一个灵活的退休年龄机制，这样可以把男性和女性的养老金权益统一起来。

examples.text: He said he would seek to unify the Conservative Party and win the next general election...
examples.translation: 他说他将寻求团结保守党，赢得下届大选。

examples.text: The plan has been for the rival armies to demobilise, to unify, and then to hold elections to decide who rules...
examples.translation: 这个计划是要让各派敌对武装遣散军队、联合起来，然后通过选举决定谁来统治。

examples.text: Both sides say they want to re-unify their country, which has been divided since the end of the Second World War.
examples.translation: 双方都表示想重新统一自第二次世界大战结束以来分裂的国家。

examples.text: ...the benefits of unifying with the West.
examples.translation: 联合西方的好处

examples.text: ...a unified German state.
examples.translation: 统一的德国

examples.text: ...a unified system of taxation.
examples.translation: 划一的税收体系

examples.text: I feel that women in all types of employment can benefit from joining a union.
examples.translation: 我认为女性无论从事什么工作，加入工会都是有好处的。

examples.text: ...union officials.
examples.translation: 工会官员

examples.text: In 1918 the Romanian majority in this former tsarist province voted for union with Romania.
examples.translation: 1918年，这个前沙皇统治的省份中占了多数的罗马尼亚人投票赞成与罗马尼亚合并。

examples.text: Tanzania is a union of the states of Tanganyika and Zanzibar.
examples.translation: 坦桑尼亚是坦噶尼喀和桑给巴尔两个政体组成的联合国家。

examples.text: ...the question of which countries should join the currency union.
examples.translation: 关于哪些国家应该加入货币联盟的问题

examples.text: Even Louis began to think their union was not blessed in the eyes of God.
examples.translation: 就连路易斯都开始认为他们的婚姻并没有受到上帝的祝福。

examples.text: The naming of stars is at the discretion of the International Astronomical Union.
examples.translation: 给星体命名是由国际天文学联合会决定的。

examples.text: ...the Mothers' Union.
examples.translation: 母亲联合会

meanings.meaning: 独特的，稀罕的；[数] 唯一的，独一无二的

examples.text: Each person's signature is unique...
examples.translation: 每个人的签名都是独一无二的。

examples.text: The area has its own unique language, Catalan.
examples.translation: 这个地区有自己单独的语言，加泰罗尼亚语。

examples.text: Because of the extreme cold, the Antarctic is a uniquely fragile environment...
examples.translation: 极度严寒造成了南极地区绝无仅有的脆弱环境。

examples.text: Uniquely among the great world religions, Buddhism is rooted only in the universal experience of suffering known to all human beings.
examples.translation: 与世界其他主要宗教不同的是，佛教是唯一基于全人类所共知的苦难而产生发展起来的。

examples.text: Each time I returned I was struck by the uniqueness of Australia and its people.
examples.translation: 每次返回，我都会惊讶于澳大利亚及其国民的与众不同。

examples.text: Brett's vocals are just unique...
examples.translation: 布雷特的歌声无与伦比。

examples.text: Kauffman was a woman of unique talent and determination.
examples.translation: 考夫曼是一个有着超群才智和决断力的女子。

examples.text: ...people who consider themselves uniquely qualified to be president of the United States.
examples.translation: 认为自己最能胜任美国总统一职的人

examples.text: ...a festival ambience that is uniquely conducive to the absorption of serious music.
examples.translation: 特别适合欣赏严肃音乐的节日氛围
