examples.text: No one knows for sure why adolescence is unique to humans...
examples.translation: 没有人确切地知道为什么只有人类才会经历青春期。

examples.text: This interesting and charming creature is unique to Borneo.
examples.translation: 这种有趣迷人的动物是婆罗洲独有的。

examples.text: The problem isn't uniquely American.
examples.translation: 这个问题不是美国所独有的。

meanings.meaning: 单位，单元；装置；[军] 部队；部件

examples.text: Agriculture was based in the past on the family as a unit.
examples.translation: 过去的农业是以家庭为单位的。

examples.text: ...the health services research unit...
examples.translation: 医疗卫生服务研究部门

examples.text: The results from this unit are staggering.
examples.translation: 这个团队得出的结果令人吃惊。

examples.text: One secret military unit tried to contaminate the drinking water of the refugees...
examples.translation: 一个秘密军事分队企图污染难民的饮用水。

examples.text: Two small Marine units have been trapped inside the city for the last 36 hours.
examples.translation: 两支海军小分队在过去的36个小时被困在城内。

examples.text: The unit plugs into any TV set.
examples.translation: 这个部件能插进任何电视机。

examples.text: Senior politicians met today to discuss the future of European economic unity.
examples.translation: 高级政要今天会晤，探讨欧洲经济一体化的未来。

examples.text: ...German unity.
examples.translation: 德国的统一

examples.text: ...a renewed unity of purpose...
examples.translation: 目标的重新确认一致

examples.text: Speakers at the rally mouthed sentiments of unity...
examples.translation: 集会上的发言人空泛地呼吁大家要团结一致。

examples.text: The choice was meant to create an impression of party unity.
examples.translation: 这个选择意在给人一种党内团结的印象。

examples.text: The two parties have been trying to unite since the New Year...
examples.translation: 这两个党从新年开始就试图联合。

examples.text: The vast majority of nations have agreed to unite their efforts to bring peace.
examples.translation: 绝大多数国家都同意团结起来为实现和平而努力。

meanings.meaning: 普遍的；通用的；宇宙的；全世界的；全体的

examples.text: The insurance industry has produced its own proposals for universal health care...
examples.translation: 保险业提出了自己的全民医疗保健方案。

examples.text: The desire to look attractive is universal.
examples.translation: 爱美之心，人皆有之。

examples.text: I have been amazed at the universality of all of our experiences, whatever our origins, sex or age.
examples.translation: 尽管我们的身世、性别和年龄各不相同，但令我惊讶的是我们都有着共同的经历。

examples.text: ...universal diseases.
examples.translation: 全球性的疾病

examples.text: There are no economic universals.
examples.translation: 没有普遍适用的经济学原理。

examples.text: Einstein's equations showed the Universe to be expanding...
examples.translation: 爱因斯坦的方程式表明宇宙正在膨胀。

examples.text: Early astronomers thought that our planet was the centre of the universe.
examples.translation: 早期的天文学家认为我们的星球是宇宙的中心。

examples.text: Good writers suck in what they see of the world, recreating their own universe on the page...
examples.translation: 优秀的作家从他们眼中的世界汲取体验，然后在纸上重塑自己的天地。

examples.text: They marked out the boundaries of our visual universe...
examples.translation: 他们标出了我们视觉经验领域的界限。

examples.text: Behind his eyes was a whole universe of pain.
examples.translation: 他眼神中隐藏着无尽的痛楚。

examples.text: According to my friends I am the coolest, thinnest, cleverest, funniest journalist in the universe.
examples.translation: 我的朋友说我是全天下最酷、最瘦、最聪明、最幽默的记者。

meanings.meaning: 大学；综合性大学；大学校舍

examples.text: Patrick is now at London University...
examples.translation: 帕特里克现在就读于伦敦大学。

examples.text: They want their daughter to go to university, but they are also keen that she get a summer job...
examples.translation: 他们想要女儿上大学，但也希望她能打一份暑期工。

examples.text: The university refused to let Dick Gregory speak on campus.
examples.translation: 这所大学不让迪克·格雷戈里在校园里发表演说。

examples.text: Unless you are trying to lose weight to please yourself, it's going to be tough to keep your motivation level high...
examples.translation: 除非减肥是为了悦已，否则很难保持积极性。

examples.text: We cannot understand disease unless we understand the person who has the disease...
examples.translation: 若不了解患者我们就不能了解疾病。

examples.text: I'm not happy unless I ride or drive every day.
examples.translation: 只有每天骑车或开车我才会开心。

examples.text: This was a foreign country, so unlike San Jose...
examples.translation: 这是外国，与圣何塞很不一样。

examples.text: She was unlike him in every way except for her coal black eyes.
examples.translation: 她除了那双乌黑的眼睛外，跟他没有一点儿相像。

examples.text: Unlike aerobics, walking entails no expensive fees for classes or clubs.
examples.translation: 散步不像有氧健身操那样需要交纳昂贵的费用来参加健身班或俱乐部。

examples.text: It was so unlike him to say something like that, with such intensity, that I was astonished...
examples.translation: 他一反常态用如此强烈的语气说出那番话，着实让我吃惊。

examples.text: 'We'll all be arrested!' Thomas yelled, which was most unlike him.
examples.translation: “我们都会被抓的！” 托马斯大声嚷道，跟平时的他判若两人。

examples.text: A military coup seems unlikely...
examples.translation: 看起来不太可能会发生军事政变。

examples.text: As with many technological revolutions, you are unlikely to be aware of it...
examples.translation: 就像诸多的技术革命一样，你可能不太会注意到它。

examples.text: It's now unlikely that future parliaments will bring back the death penalty...
examples.translation: 现在看来，将来议会不太可能恢复死刑。

examples.text: In the unlikely event of anybody phoning, could you just scribble a message down?
examples.translation: 虽然可能性极小，但如果有人打来电话，你能不能随手把留言记下来？

examples.text: Unload everything from the boat and clean it thoroughly...
examples.translation: 把所有东西从船上卸下来，然后把船彻底清理一下。

examples.text: They were reported to be unloading trucks filled with looted furniture.
examples.translation: 有人举报说他们正在从满满当当的卡车上卸洗劫来的家具。

examples.text: Since March, he has unloaded 1.3 million shares.
examples.translation: 从3月至今，他已经卖出130万股了。

examples.text: Until 1982 he was senior lecturer in botany at Durham University.
examples.translation: 1982年以前他一直是达勒姆大学生物系的高级讲师。

examples.text: ...consumers who have waited until after the Christmas holiday to do that holiday shopping.
examples.translation: 等到过完圣诞节才进行节日采购的顾客

examples.text: I waited until it got dark...
examples.translation: 我一直等到天黑。

examples.text: Stir with a metal spoon until the sugar has dissolved.
examples.translation: 用金属调羹搅拌至糖融化。

examples.text: The traffic laws don't take effect until the end of the year...
examples.translation: 交通法要到年底才生效。

examples.text: It was not until 1911 that the first of the vitamins was identified.
examples.translation: 直到1911年才发现了第一种维生素。

examples.text: The EU will not lift its sanctions until that country makes political changes.
examples.translation: 除非该国实施政治改革，否则欧盟将不会解除制裁。

meanings.meaning: 不寻常的；与众不同的；不平常的

examples.text: They have replanted many areas with rare and unusual plants...
examples.translation: 他们在许多地方重新种上了珍稀植物。

examples.text: To be appreciated as a parent is quite unusual.
examples.translation: 可怜天下父母心。

examples.text: He was an unusual man with great business talents.
examples.translation: 此人不同凡响，具有异常敏锐的商业头脑。

meanings.meaning: 更新；校正，修正；使现代化

examples.text: He was back in the office, updating the work schedule on the computer...
examples.translation: 他已回到办公室，正在电脑上更新工作日程。

examples.text: Airlines would prefer to update rather than retrain crews.
examples.translation: 航空公司更愿意换新员工而不是对旧员工重新进行培训。

examples.text: ...an updated edition of the book.
examples.translation: 该书的新版

examples.text: She had heard the news-flash on a TV channel's news update.
examples.translation: 她在一家电视台的新闻快讯中听到了这则简明新闻。

examples.text: ...a weather update.
examples.translation: 最新天气报告

examples.text: ...football results update.
examples.translation: 最新足球战况

examples.text: We'll update you on the day's top news stories...
examples.translation: 我们将为您提供当天的重要新闻。

examples.text: I would just update them on any news we might have.
examples.translation: 我们一有新消息我就会告诉他们。

examples.text: Helicopters have been upgraded and modernized...
examples.translation: 直升机已经更新换代，装配了现代化设备。

examples.text: Medical facilities are being reorganized and upgraded.
examples.translation: 正在对医疗设施进行重组和升级。

examples.text: ...upgraded catering facilities.
examples.translation: 更新换代的餐饮设施

examples.text: ...equipment which needs expensive upgrades.
examples.translation: 更新费用高昂的设备

examples.text: ...upgrades in the level of security.
examples.translation: 安全级别的升级

examples.text: He was upgraded to security guard.
examples.translation: 他被擢升为保安。

examples.text: You can upgrade from self-catering accommodation to a hotel.
examples.translation: 您可以将自理膳食旅店升级为酒店。

examples.text: They were climbing up a narrow mountain road...
examples.translation: 他们正沿一条狭窄的山路向上爬。

examples.text: I ran up the stairs and saw Alison lying at the top...
examples.translation: 我跑上楼梯，见艾莉森躺在那里。

examples.text: The heat disappears straight up the chimney.
examples.translation: 热气从烟囱冒出后马上就消散掉了

examples.text: Finally, after an hour, I went up to Jeremy's room...

examples.translation: 并不是他们把全球的资源耗费殆尽的。

examples.text: We were breathing really fast, and using the air up quickly.
examples.translation: 当时我们呼吸非常急促，很快就要把空气用完了。

examples.text: He denied he had used drugs...
examples.translation: 他否认自己吸过毒。

examples.text: You'll find that most people that don't use heroin don't like people that do.
examples.translation: 你会发现绝大多数不吸海洛因的人都不喜欢吸食者。

examples.text: Wash your hands after using the toilet...
examples.translation: 便后要洗手。

examples.text: He asked whether he could use my bathroom.
examples.translation: 他问是否可以用我的卫生间。

examples.text: The judge liked using the word 'wicked' of people he had sent to jail...
examples.translation: 这个法官喜欢使用“邪恶”一词来形容被他判罪入狱的人。

examples.text: When Johnson talks about cuts, he uses words like 'target price' and 'efficiency payments'.
examples.translation: 约翰逊谈起降价时，会使用“目标价位”和“效率支付”之类的字眼。

examples.text: Now I use a false name if I'm meeting people for the first time...
examples.translation: 现在和初次见面的人交往时我会用假名。

examples.text: I didn't want to use my married name because we've split.
examples.translation: 我不想用我的夫姓，因为我们已经离婚了。

examples.text: Be careful she's not just using you...
examples.translation: 当心她不只是在利用你。

examples.text: Why do I have the feeling I'm being used again?
examples.translation: 为什么我感觉又被利用了？

examples.text: The treatment does not involve the use of any artificial drugs.
examples.translation: 这种治疗不会使用任何人工合成药物。

examples.text: ...research related to microcomputers and their use in classrooms...
examples.translation: 关于微型电脑及其课堂使用的研究

examples.text: We are denied use of the land by the ruling classes...
examples.translation: 统治阶层剥夺了我们使用土地的权利。

examples.text: He would support a use of force if the UN deemed it necessary.
examples.translation: 如果联合国认为有必要使用武力的话，他会支持的。

examples.text: You will no longer have a use for the magazines...
examples.translation: 你再也用不着这些杂志了。

examples.text: They both loved the fabric, but couldn't find a use for it.
examples.translation: 他们都很喜爱这块布，可是不知道拿来做什么好。

examples.text: Infrared detectors have many uses...
examples.translation: 红外探测器有多种用途。

examples.text: It's an interesting scientific phenomenon, but of no practical use whatever...
examples.translation: 这是一种有趣的科学现象，但没什么实用价值。

examples.text: French furniture was designed for every use...
examples.translation: 法式家具的用途极其广泛。

examples.text: The report outlined possible uses for the new weapon.
examples.translation: 该报告概述了这种新式武器的可能用途。

examples.text: ...Elderflower Water for use as an eye and skin lotion...
examples.translation: 可用于眼霜及润肤乳中的接骨木花水

examples.text: We need to recognize that certain uses of the land upon which we live are simply wrong.
examples.translation: 我们需要认识到，我们对自己生活的这片土地的某些使用方式是完全错误的。

examples.text: She will have the use of the car one night a week.
examples.translation: 她每周有一个晚上会用车。

examples.text: ...young people who at some point in the past have lost the use of their limbs...
examples.translation: 曾经一度手脚失去功能的年轻人

examples.text: You will have full use of all the new leisure club facilities.
examples.translation: 你可以充分享受俱乐部的所有新增休闲设施。

examples.text: There are new uses of words coming in and old uses dying out.
examples.translation: 单词总有新用法出现，也有旧用法慢慢被淘汰。

examples.text: Police have been hampered by Mr Urquhart's use of bogus names.
examples.translation: 厄克特先生使用了假名，警方的调查因此受阻。

examples.text: The leisure facilities are there for the use of guests...
examples.translation: 这些休闲设施是供客人使用的。

examples.text: He raises crops mainly for the use of his family.
examples.translation: 他种农作物主要是为了家庭自用。

examples.text: Being a hospital Sister had its uses.
examples.translation: 在医院当护士有它的好处。

examples.text: ...the methods of making Champagne which are still in use today...
examples.translation: 至今仍在用的香槟酿制法

examples.text: The site has been out of use for many years.
examples.translation: 这个地方已经闲置多年。

examples.text: Not all nursery schools make use of the opportunities open to them.
examples.translation: 并不是所有的托儿所都能抓住他们面临的机会。

examples.text: ...making use of the same bottle time after time.
examples.translation: 多次重复使用同一个瓶子

examples.text: It's no use arguing with a drunk...
examples.translation: 跟一个醉汉争论是没有用处的。

examples.text: There's no use you asking me any more questions...
examples.translation: 你问我再多的问题也没有用。

examples.text: What's the use of complaining?
examples.translation: 抱怨有什么用呢？

examples.text: It's no use. Let's hang up and try for a better line.
examples.translation: 打不通。挂掉吧，找一条更好的线打吧。

examples.text: The contents of this booklet should be of use to all students...
examples.translation: 这本小册子的内容应该会对所有的学生都有用处。

examples.text: I'm sorry, I've been no use to you.
examples.translation: 对不起，我一点儿忙也没帮上。

meanings.meaning: 习惯的；二手的，使用过的

examples.text: People used to come and visit him every day...
examples.translation: 人们过去每天都来拜访他。

examples.text: He used to be one of the professors at the School of Education...
examples.translation: 他曾是教育学院的一名教授。

examples.text: I feel more compassion and less anger than I used to.
examples.translation: 我觉得自己比过去多了些同情，少了些怒气。

examples.text: Borrowing used not to be recommended...
examples.translation: 过去是不建议借贷的。

examples.text: At some point kids start doing things they didn't use to do. They get more independent...
examples.translation: 从某个时候起，孩子们开始做以前不曾做的事情。他们变得更加独立。

examples.text: He didn't used to like anyone walking on the lawns in the back garden.
examples.translation: 他以前不愿意任何人在后花园的草地上走。

examples.text: I'm used to having my sleep interrupted...
examples.translation: 我习惯了睡觉时被吵醒。

examples.text: It doesn't frighten them. They're used to it.
examples.translation: 这可吓不倒他们。他们已经习惯了。

examples.text: This is how we do things here. You'll soon get used to it...
examples.translation: 我们这里就是这么做事的。你很快就会习惯的。

examples.text: He took some getting used to...
examples.translation: 他过了一段时间才慢慢适应。

examples.text: You quickly get used to using the brakes.
examples.translation: 你很快就会习惯使用刹车的。

examples.text: ...a used cotton ball stained with makeup...
examples.translation: 沾满化妆品的脏棉球

examples.text: He took a used envelope bearing an Irish postmark.
examples.translation: 他拿了一个盖着爱尔兰邮戳的旧信封。

examples.text: Would you buy a used car from this man?...
examples.translation: 你会从这个人手里买一辆旧车吗？

examples.text: His only big purchase has been a used Ford.
examples.translation: 他买的唯一一个大件就是一辆二手福特。

meanings.meaning: 有用的，有益的；有帮助的

examples.text: The slow cooker is very useful for people who go out all day...
examples.translation: 慢炖锅对于整天都不在家的人来说很有用。

examples.text: Hypnotherapy can be useful in helping you give up smoking...
examples.translation: 催眠疗法可能有助于你戒烟。

examples.text: The police gained a great deal of useful information about the organization.
examples.translation: 警方收集到了大量关于该组织的有用信息。

examples.text: ...the problems to which computers could be usefully applied...
examples.translation: 可以利用计算机解决的问题

examples.text: We need to find ways of dealing creatively and usefully with our feelings.
examples.translation: 我们需要找到一些既有创意又实用的方法来调整我们的情绪。

examples.text: His interest lay in the usefulness of his work, rather than in any personal credit.
examples.translation: 他的兴趣在于所从事的工作是有用的，而不在于什么个人荣誉。

examples.text: The accommodation is some distance from the clubhouse, so a hire car comes in useful.
examples.translation: 住处离会所有一段距离，所以租一辆车会很有用。

examples.text: It is a neighborhood beset by all the usual inner-city problems...
examples.translation: 这是个为各种内城常见问题所困扰的社区。

examples.text: She's smiling her usual friendly smile...
examples.translation: 她脸上挂着她一贯的微笑。

examples.text: After lunch there was a little more clearing up to do than usual...
examples.translation: 午餐之后要做的清扫工作比平时略多。

examples.text: We've had more press coverage in the last three weeks than in the usual three years...
examples.translation: 过去的三个星期里，媒体对我们的报道比往常的三年还多。

examples.text: It is usual to tip waiters, porters, guides and drivers.
examples.translation: 给服务员、行李搬运工、导游和司机小费是惯例。

examples.text: The stout barman in a bow tie presented himself to take their order. 'Good morning, sir. The usual?'
examples.translation: 那名打着领结的矮胖酒吧招待走上前来请他们点餐。“早上好，先生们。还是平常那些吗？”

examples.text: As usual there will be the local and regional elections on June the twelfth...
examples.translation: 照例，6月12日将会进行地方及区域选举。

examples.text: The front pages are, as usual, a mixture of domestic and foreign news.
examples.translation: 像平常一样，头版上刊登着国内外新闻。

examples.text: When somebody died everything went on as usual, as if it had never happened...
examples.translation: 就算有人死了一切也都照常进行，好像什么事都没发生过。

examples.text: With medication, life at home goes on as usual.
examples.translation: 接受药物治疗后，家里的生活还能一切如常。

examples.text: The best information about hotels usually comes from friends and acquaintances who have been there...
examples.translation: 关于酒店的最可靠信息通常来自曾经去过那里的朋友和熟人。

examples.text: They ate, as they usually did, in the kitchen...
examples.translation: 像平常一样，他们是在厨房吃的饭。

examples.text: Usually, the work is boring...
examples.translation: 这项工作通常枯燥乏味。

examples.text: Offering only one loan, usually an installment loan, is part of the plan.
examples.translation: 计划的一部分是只提供一笔贷款，通常是分期付款贷款。

examples.text: She felt more than usually hungry after her excursion...
examples.translation: 远足后，她比平时感觉更饿。

examples.text: He was more than usually depressed by problems at work.
examples.translation: 工作上的问题使他异常沮丧。

examples.text: Sound engineers utilize a range of techniques to enhance the quality of the recordings...
examples.translation: 音响师运用一系列技术来提高录音质量。

examples.text: Minerals can be absorbed and utilized by the body in a variety of different forms.
examples.translation: 人体可通过很多不同形式吸收和利用矿物质。

examples.text: ...the utilisation of human resources.
examples.translation: 人力资源的利用

examples.text: ...land utilization on large farms.
examples.translation: 大型农场的土地使用

examples.text: It is a matter of the utmost urgency to find out what has happened to these people...
examples.translation: 当务之急是要弄清楚这些人出了什么事。

examples.text: Security matters are treated with the utmost seriousness...
examples.translation: 安全问题的处理极其严肃。

examples.text: You should proceed with the utmost caution...
examples.translation: 你应该小心行事。

examples.text: Utmost care must be taken not to spill any of the contents.
examples.translation: 千万注意里面的东西一点都不能洒出来。

examples.text: He would have done his utmost to help her, of that she was certain...
examples.translation: 他肯定会尽最大努力帮她，这一点她非常肯定。

examples.text: He will try his utmost to help them by means of his conventional medical knowledge.
examples.translation: 他将会用自己的传统医学知识尽全力帮助他们。

examples.text: My limited diplomatic skills were tested to the utmost...
examples.translation: 我有限的外交手腕儿受到了极其严峻的考验。

examples.text: The best plan is to continue to attack him to the utmost of our power.
examples.translation: 最佳方案就是继续不遗余力地攻击他。

meanings.meaning: 完全的；彻底的；无条件的

examples.text: He uttered a snorting laugh...
examples.translation: 他嗤笑了一声。

examples.text: They departed without uttering a word.
examples.translation: 他们一言不发地离开了。

examples.text: This, of course, is utter nonsense.
examples.translation: 这当然是一派胡言。

examples.text: ...this utter lack of responsibility...
examples.translation: 这种完全没有责任感的表现

examples.text: A look of utter confusion swept across his handsome face.
examples.translation: 他英俊的脸上掠过一丝大惑不解的神情。

meanings.meaning: 空虚的；空的；空缺的；空闲的；茫然的

examples.text: Half way down the coach was a vacant seat...
examples.translation: 车厢中部有一个空座。

examples.text: In every major city there are more vacant buildings than there are homeless people.
examples.translation: 各大城市里空置的楼房都比无家可归的人多。

examples.text: A number of senior people were regarded as likely to occupy the now vacant post...
examples.translation: 几位资深人士被认为有望填补现在空缺的职位。

examples.text: The post of chairman has been vacant for some time.
examples.translation: 主席之位已经空缺一段时间了。

examples.text: She had a kind of vacant look on her face.
examples.translation: 她脸上有种茫然的神情。

examples.text: He looked vacantly out of the window.
examples.translation: 他失神地望着窗外。

examples.text: ...African children, vacantly staring into a bleak world.
examples.translation: 神情茫然地凝望着这个凄凉世界的非洲儿童

examples.text: During his summer vacation he visited Russia...
examples.translation: 暑假期间他去俄罗斯了。

examples.text: Did you have a lot of reading during the vacation?
examples.translation: 放假期间你读了很多书吗？

examples.text: They planned a late summer vacation in Europe...
examples.translation: 他们打算夏末去欧洲度假。

examples.text: We went on vacation to Puerto Rico.
examples.translation: 我们去了波多黎各度假。

examples.text: The French get five to six weeks' vacation a year.
examples.translation: 法国人每年有5到6周的假期。

examples.text: Myles vacationed in Jamaica...
examples.translation: 迈尔斯去了牙买加度假。

examples.text: He was vacationing and couldn't be reached for comment.
examples.translation: 他当时正在度假，无法联系到他征求意见。

meanings.meaning: 真空的；利用真空的；产生真空的

examples.text: The collapse of the army left a vacuum in the area...
examples.translation: 这支军队的溃败使这个地区出现了军事真空。

examples.text: His presence should fill the power vacuum which has been developing over the past few days.
examples.translation: 他的出现将填补过去这几天形成的权力真空。

examples.text: Moral values cannot be taught in a vacuum...
examples.translation: 道德价值观的教育不能脱离实际。

examples.text: We lived in a vacuum — no life, no news, no books.
examples.translation: 我们生活在与世隔绝的环境里——没有其他生物，收不到外界消息，也没有书看。

examples.text: I vacuumed the carpets today...
examples.translation: 今天我用吸尘器清洁了地毯。

examples.text: It's important to vacuum regularly.
examples.translation: 定期用吸尘器吸尘很重要。

examples.text: Wind is a current of air caused by a vacuum caused by hot air rising...
examples.translation: 风是由于热空气上升产生真空导致的一种气流运动。

examples.text: The spinning turbine creates a vacuum.
examples.translation: 旋转的涡轮形成了一块真空区域。

meanings.meaning: 模糊的；含糊的；不明确的；暧昧的

examples.text: A lot of the talk was apparently vague and general...
examples.translation: 很多话明显是些含糊的泛泛之论。

examples.text: The description was pretty vague.
examples.translation: 描述相当模糊。

examples.text: ...vague information.
examples.translation: 不明确的信息

examples.text: 'I'm not sure,' Liz said vaguely...
examples.translation: “我不确定，”利兹含糊其词地说。

examples.text: They issued a vaguely worded statement.
examples.translation: 他们发表了一份措辞含混不清的声明。

examples.text: ...the vagueness of the language in the text.
examples.translation: 文章语言隐晦

examples.text: They have only a vague idea of the amount of water available...
examples.translation: 他们只是大概知道可用水的总量。

examples.text: Waite's memory of that first meeting was vague.
examples.translation: 韦特对第一次见面的记忆很模糊。

examples.text: Judith could vaguely remember her mother lying on the sofa.
examples.translation: 朱迪丝隐约记得她母亲躺在沙发上的情景。

examples.text: He was vague, however, about just what U.S. forces might actually do...
examples.translation: 然而，他对美军实际可能采取的行动却闪烁其词。

examples.text: Democratic leaders under election pressure tend to respond with vague promises of action...
examples.translation: 民主党领导人在选举压力下往往用一些含糊其词的行动承诺来予以回应。

examples.text: Christopher's answer was deliberately vague.
examples.translation: 克里斯托弗的回答故意模棱两可。

examples.text: She had married a charming but rather vague Englishman...
examples.translation: 她嫁给了一个外表迷人实际却很迷糊的英国人。

examples.text: His eyes were always so vague when he looked at her.
examples.translation: 他看她的眼神总是那么暧昧。

examples.text: He looked vaguely around the room as he spoke, his mind elsewhere.
examples.translation: 他边说话边茫然地打量着房间，心不在焉的样子。

examples.text: ...a girl wandering in the blissful vagueness of someone in love.
examples.translation: 被幸福冲昏了头脑的热恋中的女孩

examples.text: He was conscious of that vague feeling of irritation again...
examples.translation: 他再次感到有点儿恼火。

examples.text: He had a vague impression of rain pounding on the packed earth.
examples.translation: 他隐约记得雨点打在坚实地面上的情景。

examples.text: He looked at her vague shape through the frosted glass...
examples.translation: 他透过雾蒙蒙的眼镜注视着她模糊的身形。

examples.text: The bus was a vague shape in the distance.
examples.translation: 远处的公交车只是一个模糊的轮廓。

meanings.meaning: 徒劳的；自负的；无结果的；无用的

examples.text: The drafting committee worked through the night in a vain attempt to finish on schedule...
examples.translation: 起草委员会为按计划完成草案已通宵加班，但结果仍是徒劳。

examples.text: I was singing in a vain effort to cheer him up.
examples.translation: 我唱歌试图让他高兴起来，结果是白费力气。

examples.text: He hunted vainly through his pockets for a piece of paper.
examples.translation: 他翻遍口袋想找一张纸，结果没找到。

examples.text: He married his fourth wife, Susan, in the vain hope that she would improve his health.
examples.translation: 他娶了第四个老婆苏珊，徒然希望她能使他健康状况好转。

examples.text: He then set out for Virginia for what he vainly hoped would be a peaceful retirement.
examples.translation: 于是他动身前往弗吉尼亚，幻想能够平静引退。

examples.text: I think he is shallow, vain and untrustworthy.
examples.translation: 我认为他浅薄虚荣，不可信任。

examples.text: He stopped at the door, waiting in vain for her to acknowledge his presence...
examples.translation: 他在门口停住，徒然地等待她和自己打招呼。

examples.text: It became obvious that all her complaints were in vain.
examples.translation: 很明显她所有的抱怨都是白费口舌。

examples.text: He wants the world to know his son did not die in vain.
examples.translation: 他想让全世界都知道，他的儿子不是白白死去的。

meanings.meaning: 有效的；有根据的；合法的；正当的

examples.text: They put forward many valid reasons for not exporting...
examples.translation: 他们提出了很多不出口的正当理由。

examples.text: It is valid to consider memory the oldest mental skill, from which all others derive...
examples.translation: 我们有理由认为记忆是最原始的心智技能，所有其他技能都在此基础上衍生出来。

examples.text: He recognized the valid points that both sides were making.
examples.translation: 他认可双方观点中的合理之处。

examples.text: The editorial in the Financial Times says this argument has lost much of its validity.
examples.translation: 《金融时报》的社论认为这个观点已不太令人信服。

examples.text: Most designers share the unspoken belief that fashion is a valid form of visual art.
examples.translation: 大多数设计者都认同这样一种不言而明的理念，即时尚是视觉艺术的一种重要形式。

examples.text: ...the validity of making children wear cycle helmets.
examples.translation: 让孩子在骑车时戴头盔的重要性

examples.text: For foreign holidays you will need a valid passport...
examples.translation: 出国度假需持有效护照。

examples.text: All tickets are valid for two months.
examples.translation: 所有的票在两个月内有效。

examples.text: ...a wooded valley set against the backdrop of Monte Rosa.
examples.translation: 罗莎峰背后树木繁茂的山谷

examples.text: ...the Loire valley.
examples.translation: 卢瓦尔山谷

meanings.meaning: 有价值的；贵重的；可估价的

examples.text: Many of our teachers also have valuable academic links with Heidelberg University...
examples.translation: 我们的很多老师也和海德堡大学保持着有益的学术联系。

examples.text: If you decide to do you own make-up, here are a few valuable tips that will help you look your best...
examples.translation: 如果你决定自己化妆，这里有一些有用的小窍门，可以帮助你呈现最美的一面。

examples.text: The experience was very valuable.
examples.translation: 这一经验很宝贵。

examples.text: Just because a camera is old does not mean it is valuable.
examples.translation: 古旧的相机不一定就值钱。

examples.text: ...valuable books.
examples.translation: 贵重书籍

meanings.meaning: 值；价值；价格；重要性；确切涵义

examples.text: The value of this work experience should not be underestimated...
examples.translation: 这种工作经验的重要性不应该被低估。

examples.text: Further studies will be needed to see if these therapies have any value...
examples.translation: 这些治疗是否有效需要进行进一步的研究。

examples.text: Ronnie put a high value on his appearance.
examples.translation: 龙尼非常注重自己的外表。

examples.text: This weekend course will be of value to everyone interested in the Pilgrim Route...
examples.translation: 这一周末课程对每一个对朝圣路线感兴趣的人来说都会很有用。

examples.text: Current sales figures tell us something of value about what is really going on.
examples.translation: 最近的销售数据能够告诉我们一些有关真实行情的重要信息。

examples.text: I've done business with Mr Weston before. I value the work he gives me...
examples.translation: 我以前和韦斯顿先生有过业务往来，我很重视他给我的业务。

examples.text: If you value your health then you'll start being a little kinder to yourself.
examples.translation: 如果你重视自己的健康，你就要开始对自己好一点。

examples.text: As you are a valued customer, I am writing to you to explain the situation...
examples.translation: 您是一位我们很重视的客户，所以我写信向您解释一下情况。

examples.text: Why were spices so highly valued in late 15th-century Europe?
examples.translation: 为什么香料在15世纪末期的欧洲如此贵重？

examples.text: The value of his investment has risen by more than $50,000...
examples.translation: 他投入的资本已经增值了5万多美元。

examples.text: The company's market value rose to $5.5 billion...
examples.translation: 该公司的市值涨到了55亿美元。

examples.text: The country's currency went down in value by 3.5 per cent...
examples.translation: 这个国家的货币贬值了3.5%。

examples.text: That cup is priceless. You can't put a value on it.
examples.translation: 那个杯子价值连城，无法定价。

examples.text: ...a brooch which is really of no value...
examples.translation: 一枚根本不值钱的胸针

examples.text: It might contain something of value.
examples.translation: 它里面也许还有什么值钱的东西。

examples.text: Your lender will then send their own surveyor to value the property...
examples.translation: 然后贷款方会派他们自己的评估员来对房产进行估价。

examples.text: I asked him if he would have my jewellery valued for insurance purposes...
examples.translation: 我问他能否给我的珠宝进行保险估价。

examples.text: Spanish police have seized cocaine valued at around $53 million.
examples.translation: 西班牙警方查获了一批价值约5,300万美元的可卡因。

examples.text: The restaurant is informal, stylish and extremely good value...
examples.translation: 这家餐厅氛围轻松，装修雅致，而且价格非常公道。

examples.text: Both offer excellent value at around £90 for a double room...
examples.translation: 两家的双人客房都报出了大约90英镑的超值价格。

examples.text: This wine highlights the quality and value for money of South African wines.
examples.translation: 这种酒突出显示了南非产葡萄酒优异的性价比。

examples.text: The countries of South Asia also share many common values...
examples.translation: 南亚各国也有许多相同的价值观。

examples.text: The Health Secretary called for a return to traditional family values.
examples.translation: 卫生部部长呼吁传统家庭价值观的回归。

examples.text: ...young Muslims who feel little sympathy for the values of their adopted country.
examples.translation: 与所移居国家的价值观格格不入的年轻穆斯林们

examples.text: The script has lost all of its shock value over the intervening 24 years...
examples.translation: 时隔24年后，这个剧本已经完全失去了震撼力。

examples.text: Having a mid-morning party certainly adds novelty value.
examples.translation: 在上午10点左右开派对一定会增加新鲜感。

meanings.meaning: 阀；[解剖] 瓣膜；真空管；活门

examples.text: He also has problems with a heart valve.
examples.translation: 他的一个心瓣也有毛病。

examples.text: In the guard's van lay my tin trunk.
examples.translation: 我的铁皮箱放在了卫兵的行李车厢中。

examples.text: He just vanished and was never seen again...
examples.translation: 他就这么消失了，再也没人见到过他。

examples.text: The aircraft vanished without trace...
examples.translation: 飞机消失得无影无踪。

examples.text: Anne vanished from outside her home last Wednesday...
examples.translation: 安妮上周三突然在家门外失踪了。

examples.text: The gunmen paused only to cut the wires to the house, then vanished into the countryside.
examples.translation: 那些持枪歹徒停下来只是切断了连接到房子里的电线，然后消失在乡间。

examples.text: Near the end of Devonian times, thirty percent of all animal life vanished...
examples.translation: 在泥盆纪末期，30％的动物物种都灭绝了。

examples.text: ...all the species of birds that had vanished from Iowa.
examples.translation: 艾奥瓦州所有消失了的鸟类物种

meanings.meaning: 虚荣心；空虚；浮华；无价值的东西

examples.text: Men who use steroids are motivated by sheer vanity...
examples.translation: 使用类固醇的男人纯粹是受虚荣心的驱使。

examples.text: With my usual vanity, I thought he might be falling in love with me.
examples.translation: 由于我一贯的虚荣心作祟，我以为他可能爱上了我。

examples.text: ...water vapour.
examples.translation: 水蒸气

meanings.meaning: 变量的；可变的；易变的，多变的；变异的，[生物] 畸变的
[数] 变量；可变物，可变因素

examples.text: The potassium content of foodstuffs is very variable...
examples.translation: 食物中钾的含量差别很大。

examples.text: There was a bit of a wind and it was blowing onshore, variable, but quite strong.
examples.translation: 有一阵风朝岸上吹来，风向变化不定，但风力很强。

examples.text: ...a variable rate of interest.
examples.translation: 时高时低的利率

examples.text: There's a great deal of variability between individuals.
examples.translation: 人和人之间有很大的不同。

examples.text: ...the variability in the climate.
examples.translation: 气候的变化无常

examples.text: Decisions could be made on the basis of price, delivery dates, after-sales service or any other variable...
examples.translation: 购买决定可能会基于价格、送货日期、售后服务以及其他可变因素。

examples.text: Other variables in making forecasts for the industry include the weather and the general economic climate.
examples.translation: 对该产业进行预测时还要考虑天气和宏观经济环境等其他不确定因素。

examples.text: It is conventional to place the independent variable on the right-hand side of an equation.
examples.translation: 普遍做法是把自变量放在等式的右边。

meanings.meaning: 变化；[生物] 变异，变种

examples.text: This delicious variation on an omelette is quick and easy to prepare...
examples.translation: 这种稍加变化的可口煎蛋卷做起来又快又容易。

examples.text: Many theories on punishment exist, all of which are variations on a theme.
examples.translation: 关于惩罚的理论有很多，虽形式略有不同，但其主旨都是一样的。

examples.text: The survey found a wide variation in the prices charged for canteen food...
examples.translation: 调查发现食堂饭菜的价格相差很大。

examples.text: Every day without variation my grandfather ate a plate of cold ham.
examples.translation: 我的祖父每天都会吃一盘冷火腿，雷打不动。

meanings.meaning: 多样；种类；杂耍；变化，多样化

examples.text: Susan's idea of freedom was to have variety in her life style...
examples.translation: 苏珊心目中的自由就是拥有丰富多彩的生活。

examples.text: I know no store anywhere in the world that has such variety and display...
examples.translation: 我不知道世界上还有哪个商店的经营品种如此繁多，陈列如此美观。

examples.text: The music itself has so much variety.
examples.translation: 音乐本身就种类繁多。

examples.text: West Hampstead has a variety of good shops and supermarkets...
examples.translation: 西汉普斯特德有各种各样不错的店铺和超级市场。

examples.text: The island offers such a wide variety of scenery and wildlife...
examples.translation: 这个岛屿拥有丰富多样的景致及种类繁多的野生动植物。

examples.text: People change their mind for a variety of reasons.
examples.translation: 人们会由于种种原因改变主意。

examples.text: I'm always pleased to try out a new variety...
examples.translation: 我一直乐于尝试新产品。

examples.text: She has 12 varieties of old-fashioned roses.
examples.translation: 她有12种双花玫瑰。

examples.text: ...a variety show of music, comedy, and magic.
examples.translation: 汇集了音乐、喜剧及魔术表演的一档综艺节目

examples.text: His plan is to spread the capital between various building society accounts...
examples.translation: 他打算把资金分散存到不同的购房互助会的账户上。

examples.text: The school has received various grants from the education department.
examples.translation: 学校得到了教育部门的多项资助。

examples.text: The methods are many and various.
examples.translation: 方法很多且各不相同。

examples.text: ...the country's rich and various heritage.
examples.translation: 该国丰富多样的传统

examples.text: As they're handmade, each one varies slightly...
examples.translation: 由于它们是手工制作的，彼此都会有些微小的差异。

examples.text: The text varies from the earlier versions...
examples.translation: 这一文本与较早的版本有些不同。

examples.text: Different writers will prepare to varying degrees.
examples.translation: 不同作者的准备程度也会各不相同。

examples.text: The cost of the alcohol duty varies according to the amount of wine in the bottle...
examples.translation: 酒税税额随酒瓶容量的大小而有所不同。

examples.text: You are welcome to vary the diet.
examples.translation: 我们鼓励不时变换饮食。

meanings.meaning: 广阔的；巨大的；大量的；巨额的

examples.text: ...Afrikaner farmers who own vast stretches of land...
examples.translation: 拥有广袤土地的南非白人农场主

examples.text: The vast majority of the eggs would be cracked.
examples.translation: 绝大部分鸡蛋都会被打碎。

examples.text: ...the vastness of the desert.
examples.translation: 沙漠的浩瀚无边

examples.text: ...a vase of red roses.
examples.translation: 一花瓶的红玫瑰

examples.text: ...lead crystal vases.
examples.translation: 铅晶质玻璃花瓶

examples.text: A good general diet should include plenty of fresh vegetables.
examples.translation: 良好的日常饮食应该包含大量的新鲜蔬菜。

examples.text: ...traditional Caribbean fruit and vegetables.
examples.translation: 加勒比地区传统的水果和蔬菜

examples.text: ...vegetable soup.
examples.translation: 蔬菜汤

examples.text: ...compounds, of animal, vegetable or mineral origin.
examples.translation: 动物源性、植物源性或矿物源性的化合物

examples.text: ...decayed vegetable matter.
examples.translation: 腐烂的植物质

examples.text: Yasmin sticks to a strict vegetarian diet...
examples.translation: 亚斯明坚持不沾一点儿荤腥。

examples.text: Over 1.5 million people in Britain are vegetarian.
examples.translation: 在英国，1,500多万人都是素食主义者。

examples.text: ...a special menu for vegetarians.
examples.translation: 一份专为素食者准备的特殊菜单

examples.text: ...vegetarian lasagnes.
examples.translation: 素卤汁宽面

meanings.meaning: 植被；植物，草木；呆板单调的生活

examples.text: The inn has a garden of semi-tropical vegetation.
examples.translation: 这家小旅馆里有一个亚热带植物园。

examples.text: ...a smell of gently-rotting vegetation.
examples.translation: 一股植物轻微腐烂的味道

meanings.meaning: [车辆] 车辆；工具；交通工具；运载工具；传播媒介；媒介物

examples.text: The vehicle would not have the capacity to make the journey on one tank of fuel.
examples.translation: 这辆车单靠一箱燃料无法跑完整趟旅程。

examples.text: ...a vehicle which was somewhere between a tractor and a truck.
examples.translation: 一种介于拖拉机和卡车之间的机动车

examples.text: Her art became a vehicle for her political beliefs...
examples.translation: 艺术成了她表达政治信仰的工具。

examples.text: The vehicle that permitted both communication and acceptability was social revolution.
examples.translation: 既能实现交流又能被广为接受的手段就是社会革命。

meanings.meaning: 遮蔽；掩饰；以面纱遮掩；用帷幕分隔
蒙上面纱；出现轻度灰雾

examples.text: She's got long fair hair but she's got a veil over it...
examples.translation: 她有一头金色的长发，但她用头巾包住了。

examples.text: She swathes her face in a veil of decorative muslin.
examples.translation: 她用装饰性的薄纱遮住了脸。

examples.text: The country is ridding itself of its disgraced prime minister in a veil of secrecy...
examples.translation: 这个国家暗地里正试图把失势的首相赶下台。

examples.text: The chilling facts behind this veil of silence were slow to emerge.
examples.translation: 沉默背后的骇人真相慢慢显露出来。

examples.text: The eruption has left a thin veil of dust in the upper atmosphere...
examples.translation: 火山爆发在高层大气中留下了一层薄薄的尘土。

examples.text: He recognized the coast of England through a veil of mist...
examples.translation: 透过薄雾他认出了那是英格兰的海岸线。

examples.text: He retreated behind a veil of cigarette smoke.
examples.translation: 他隐藏在一层香烟烟雾之后。

examples.text: The clamour to draw a veil over the minister's extra-marital activities reeks of hypocrisy.
examples.translation: 想要掩饰部长婚外情的喧嚣叫嚷之声让人倍感虚伪。

meanings.meaning: 血管；叶脉；[地质] 岩脉；纹理；翅脉；性情
使成脉络；象脉络般分布于

examples.text: Many veins are found just under the skin.
examples.translation: 许多静脉血管就在皮肤下面。

examples.text: It is one of his finest works in a lighter vein...
examples.translation: 这是他行文风格轻松活泼的作品中最出色的作品之一。

examples.text: The girl now replies in similar vein.
examples.translation: 这个女孩现在以相似的口吻回答。

examples.text: The striker's rich vein of form this season has seen him net 32 goals...
examples.translation: 这位前锋本赛季状态奇佳，进球已达到32个。

examples.text: This Spanish drama has a vein of black humour running through it.
examples.translation: 这出西班牙戏剧自始至终都带有几分黑色幽默。

examples.text: ...a vein of copper.
examples.translation: 铜矿层

examples.text: ...a rich and deep vein of limestone.
examples.translation: 储量丰富的深层石灰石矿脉

examples.text: ...the serrated edges and veins of the feathery leaves.
examples.translation: 羽状叶子的锯齿边沿和纹理

meanings.meaning: 速率，速度；周转率；迅速；高速，快速

examples.text: ...the velocity of light.
examples.translation: 光速

examples.text: ...the velocities at which the stars orbit.
examples.translation: 恒星沿轨道运行的速度

examples.text: ...high velocity rifles.
examples.translation: 高速步枪

meanings.meaning: 天鹅绒，丝绒；天鹅绒似的东西

examples.text: ...a charcoal-gray overcoat with a velvet collar...
examples.translation: 带天鹅绒领子的炭灰色外套

examples.text: She looked pretty and rather fragile, dressed in black velvet.
examples.translation: 她穿着黑色的天鹅绒礼服，看上去娇小美丽。

meanings.meaning: 使通风；给…装通风设备；宣布

examples.text: Ventilate the room properly when paint stripping...
examples.translation: 当油漆开始剥落时，要给房间适当通风。

examples.text: The pit is ventilated by a steel fan.
examples.translation: 矿井中用钢制通风机来保持空气流通。

examples.text: ...badly ventilated rooms.
examples.translation: 通风条件很差的房间

examples.text: The only ventilation comes from tiny sliding windows.
examples.translation: 只能通过小推拉窗来通风。

examples.text: He did not think it the job of officials to ventilate their doubts or daydreams.
examples.translation: 他认为公开提出自己的疑问或不切实际的想法并非官员们的分内之事。

examples.text: ...his latest writing venture.
examples.translation: 他最新的写作尝试

examples.text: ...a Russian-American joint venture.
examples.translation: 一家俄美合资企业

examples.text: People are afraid to venture out for fear of sniper attacks...
examples.translation: 由于害怕狙击手，人们不敢冒险外出。

examples.text: Few Europeans who had ventured beyond the Himalayas had returned to tell the tale.
examples.translation: 少数几个冒险翻越了喜马拉雅山的欧洲人回来后讲述了这个故事。

examples.text: 'So you're Leo's girlfriend?' he ventured...
examples.translation: “那么你就是列奥的女朋友了？”他大胆问道。

examples.text: He ventured that plants draw part of their nourishment from the air...
examples.translation: 他大胆提出植物从空气中吸收部分养分的观点。

examples.text: Stephen ventured a few more sentences in halting Welsh.
examples.translation: 在阻止韦尔什时，斯蒂芬壮着胆子多说了几句。

examples.text: 'Don't ask,' he said, whenever Ginny ventured to raise the subject.
examples.translation: 每当金尼鼓起勇气提起这个话题时，他就说“不要问”。

examples.text: He enjoyed little success when he ventured into business.
examples.translation: 他冒险涉足商界后几乎没有取得什么成功。

meanings.meaning: 动词；动词词性；动词性短语或从句
动词的；有动词性质的；起动词作用的

examples.text: Once you graduate from this adventure, escape is sure to be your new favourite verb.

meanings.meaning: 口头的；言语的；动词的；照字面的

examples.text: They were jostled and subjected to a torrent of verbal abuse...
examples.translation: 他们被推来搡去，受到大肆的谩骂攻击。

examples.text: We have a verbal agreement with her...
examples.translation: 我们和她有个口头约定。

examples.text: The West must back up its verbal support with substantial economic aid.
examples.translation: 西方国家必须以切实的经济援助来兑现他们的口头支持。

examples.text: Teachers were threatened with kitchen knives, physically assaulted and verbally abused...
examples.translation: 老师们被人用菜刀威胁，遭受人身侵犯和言语辱骂。

examples.text: Twins often have difficulty expressing themselves verbally.
examples.translation: 双胞胎往往有言语表达方面的困难。

examples.text: The test has scores for verbal skills, mathematical skills, and abstract reasoning skills...
examples.translation: 测试包含对语言能力、数学能力和抽象推理能力的考查。

examples.text: Wayne has great verbal dexterity.
examples.translation: 韦恩的语言表达能力很强。

examples.text: ...a verbal noun.
examples.translation: 动名词

examples.text: The jury returned a unanimous guilty verdict...
examples.translation: 陪审团一致作出了有罪裁决。

examples.text: Three judges will deliver their verdict in October.
examples.translation: 3名法官将在10月份作出裁决。

examples.text: The doctor's verdict was that he was entirely healthy...
examples.translation: 医生的结论是他完全健康。

examples.text: The critics were too quick to give their verdict on us.
examples.translation: 评论家们给我们下定论未免太操之过急了。

examples.text: The country was on the verge of becoming prosperous and successful...
examples.translation: 这个国家即将走向繁荣富强。

examples.text: Carole was on the verge of tears.
examples.translation: 卡萝尔差点就要哭了。

examples.text: I verified the source from which I had that information...
examples.translation: 我核实了我所获消息的来源。

examples.text: A clerk simply verifies that the payment and invoice amount match.
examples.translation: 职员只是核实付款和发票上的数额是否一致。

examples.text: All charges against her are dropped pending the verification of her story.
examples.translation: 在她的事情核实之前，所有针对她的指控都已撤回。

examples.text: ...the agency's verification procedures.
examples.translation: 该机构的核查程序

examples.text: The government has not verified any of those reports...
examples.translation: 政府还没有证实那些报告中的任何一个。

examples.text: I can verify that it takes about thirty seconds.
examples.translation: 我能证明，这大约要用30秒的时间。

meanings.meaning: 多才多艺的；通用的，万能的；多面手的

examples.text: He had been one of the game's most versatile athletes.
examples.translation: 他是这项运动中技术最全面的运动员之一。

examples.text: Aileen stands out for her incredible versatility as an actress.
examples.translation: 艾琳多才多艺，是一位出类拔萃的女演员。

examples.text: Never before has computing been so versatile.
examples.translation: 计算机的用途从没像现在这么广泛过。

examples.text: ...a versatile blue chambray skirt.
examples.translation: 多用途的蓝条纹裙子

examples.text: Velvet is not known for its versatility.
examples.translation: 天鹅绒的用途并不是非常广泛。

examples.text: ...a slim volume of verse...
examples.translation: 一本薄薄的诗集

examples.text: I have been moved to write a few lines of verse.
examples.translation: 我因感动而写下了几句诗。

examples.text: This verse describes three signs of spring...
examples.translation: 这节诗描绘了春天来临的三个征兆。

examples.text: The choir has sung only two verses of the last hymn.
examples.translation: 合唱团只唱了最后一首赞美诗的两个段落。

examples.text: ...an updated version of his book...
examples.translation: 他的书的最新版本

examples.text: Ludo is a version of an ancient Indian racing game...
examples.translation: 鲁多是由一种古印度竞赛游戏演变而来。

examples.text: The second-hand version is a poor copy of the original.
examples.translation: 盗版版本是对原版的低劣复制。

examples.text: Yesterday afternoon the White House put out a new version of events...
examples.translation: 昨天下午，白宫对事件给出了另一种说法。

examples.text: She and her friends wanted to go public with their version of the incident...
examples.translation: 她和朋友们想把他们看到的事情经过公之于众。

examples.translation: 非洲舞蹈强劲奔放，但又处处透着细腻。

examples.translation: 法官对此并不赞成，我因此蹲了6年的监狱。

examples.translation: 依我看，事情不会改变。

examples.text: He has called a meeting of all parties tomorrow, with a view to forming a national reconciliation government.

examples.translation: 她语气之强烈令阿利斯泰尔深感震惊。

examples.translation: 剧烈的爆炸好像要把整个地面都掀起来。

examples.translation: 附近的一座火山猛烈爆发了，喷出大量熔岩和滚烫的泥流。

examples.translation: 对该计划的强烈反对之声仍不绝于耳。

examples.translation: 强烈感情的爆发

examples.translation: 拉里开始出现严重的头痛和剧烈的情绪波动。

examples.text: It was the most violent film that I have ever seen.
examples.translation: 这是我看过的最暴力的一部电影。

examples.translation: 一场猛烈的暴风雨席卷了该地区。

meanings.meaning: (Violet)人名；(西)比奥莱特；(法)维奥莱；(印、匈、英)维奥莱特

examples.text: The light was beginning to drain from a violet sky.
examples.translation: 光线开始从紫罗兰色的天空渐渐消退。

examples.text: When it comes to expressing himself he is no shrinking violet...
examples.translation: 他在表达自己的想法时毫不羞怯。

examples.text: None of the women he paints, however, could be described as shrinking violets.
examples.translation: 然而，他画过的所有女人中没有一个是羞涩腼腆的。

examples.text: Lizzie used to play the violin.
examples.translation: 莉齐曾经拉过小提琴。

examples.text: ...the Brahms violin concerto in D.
examples.translation: 勃拉姆斯D调小提琴协奏曲

meanings.meaning: 处女的；纯洁的；未经利用的，处于原始状态的

examples.text: I was a virgin until I was thirty years old...
examples.translation: 我30岁前一直是个处女。

examples.text: They were both virgins when they met and married.
examples.translation: 他们从相识到结婚前都未曾经历男女之事。

examples.text: Within 40 years there will be no virgin forest left.
examples.translation: 过不了40年，就将不会再有未开发的森林了。

examples.text: ...a sloping field of virgin snow.
examples.translation: 覆着皑皑白雪的坡地

examples.text: Until he appeared in 'In the Line of Fire' Malkovich had been an action-movie virgin...
examples.translation: 出演《火线狙击》以前，马尔科维奇从未演过动作片。

examples.text: He was a political virgin when Mrs Thatcher picked him as Lord Advocate.
examples.translation: 当撒切尔夫人任命他为苏格兰检察总长时，他是个完全没有从政经验的新人。

meanings.meaning: [计] 虚拟的；实质上的，事实上的（但未在名义上或正式获承认）

examples.text: Argentina came to a virtual standstill while the game was being played...
examples.translation: 在比赛进行的时候，阿根廷全国几乎陷入了停顿状态。

examples.text: He claimed to be a virtual prisoner in his own home.
examples.translation: 他说自己在家里简直就像是个囚犯。

examples.text: ...conditions of virtual slavery.
examples.translation: 实质上等同于奴隶制的状况

examples.text: Up to four players can compete in a virtual world of role playing...
examples.translation: 最多可以有4个玩家在一个虚拟世界中扮演角色互相拼杀。

examples.text: This is a virtual shopping centre offering visitors entry to a clutch of well-known etailers without going to their different websites.
examples.translation: 这是一个虚拟的购物中心，访问者在此就可以浏览很多著名的网上零售店铺，而无需分别访问它们各自的网站。

examples.text: People speculate about virtuality systems, but we're already working on it.
examples.translation: 人们才开始构思虚拟系统的时候，我们已经进行开发了。

examples.text: Virtue is not confined to the Christian world...
examples.translation: 善行并不是仅限于基督教世界。

examples.text: She could have established her own innocence and virtue easily enough.
examples.translation: 她本可以轻易地证实自己纯真善良的品性。

examples.text: His virtue is patience...
examples.translation: 耐心是他的美德。

examples.text: Her flaws were as large as her virtues...
examples.translation: 她的缺点和优点一样多。

examples.text: Humility is considered a virtue.
examples.translation: 谦虚被认为是一种美德。

examples.text: There was no virtue in returning to Calvi the way I had come...
examples.translation: 沿着我来的路线返回卡尔维并不可取。

examples.text: Its other great virtue, of course, is its hard-wearing quality.
examples.translation: 它的另一个突出优点当然就是经久耐用。

examples.text: The article stuck in my mind by virtue of one detail...
examples.translation: 由于一个细节，这篇文章在我脑海里印象深刻。

examples.text: Mr Olaechea has British residency by virtue of his marriage.
examples.translation: 奥拉伊奇先生通过结婚而取得在英国的永久居留权。

examples.text: The movie makes a virtue out of its economy.
examples.translation: 这部电影充分利用了其有限的成本。

examples.text: There are many different strains of flu virus.
examples.translation: 流感病毒有很多不同类型。

examples.text: ...HIV, the virus believed to cause AIDS. HIV
examples.translation: ，一种据信会引发艾滋病的病毒

examples.text: Hackers are said to have started a computer virus.
examples.translation: 据说黑客们已经开始传播一种新的电脑病毒。

examples.text: His visitor's visa expired.
examples.translation: 他的访问签证过期了。

examples.text: ...an exit visa.
examples.translation: 出境签证

examples.text: ...a tightening of U.S. visa requirements.
examples.translation: 对赴美签证要求的提高

meanings.meaning: 明显的；看得见的；现有的；可得到的
可见物；进出口贸易中的有形项目

examples.text: The warning lights were clearly visible...
examples.translation: 警示信号灯清晰可见。

examples.text: They found a bacterium visible to the human eye...
examples.translation: 他们发现了一种肉眼可见的细菌。

examples.text: The meadows are hardly visible from the house.
examples.translation: 从房子里几乎看不见草地。

examples.text: The most visible sign of the intensity of the crisis is unemployment...
examples.translation: 预示危机严重程度的一个最显著的迹象就是失业情况。

examples.text: He was making a visible effort to control himself...
examples.translation: 他明显是在努力控制自己的情绪。

examples.text: Miss Amiel has become a highly visible columnist and was voted the 1989 Woman of Distinction.
examples.translation: 埃米尔小姐已成为一个备受关注的专栏作家，并当选为1989年度最杰出女性。

examples.text: The Russians were visibly wavering...
examples.translation: 那些俄国人明显在犹豫。

examples.text: They emerged visibly distressed and weeping.
examples.translation: 他们显然很沮丧，一副哭哭啼啼的样子。

examples.text: In the UK visible imports have traditionally been greater than visible exports.
examples.translation: 在英国，传统上有形产品的进口一直大于出口。

meanings.meaning: 视力；美景；眼力；幻象；想象力

examples.text: I have a vision of a society that is free of exploitation and injustice...
examples.translation: 我希望建立一个没有剥削和不公的社会。

examples.text: That's my vision of how the world could be...
examples.translation: 那是我对未来世界的想象。

examples.text: Turning that vision into a practical reality is not easy.
examples.translation: 把那种设想转化为实实在在的现实并非易事。

examples.text: He had a vision of Cheryl, slumped on a plastic chair in the waiting-room...
examples.translation: 他想象谢里尔瘫坐在候诊室的一把塑料椅子上。

examples.text: Maybe you had visions of being surrounded by happy, smiling children.
examples.translation: 也许你曾幻想过被快乐嬉笑的孩子所包围的情景。

examples.text: It was on 24th June 1981 that young villagers first reported seeing the Virgin Mary in a vision.
examples.translation: 1981年6月24日那天，年轻的村民们首次报告说看到了圣母马利亚的幻象。

examples.text: It causes blindness or serious loss of vision...
examples.translation: 这能导致失明或视力严重受损。

examples.text: In spite of his otherwise excellent vision, he found he was colour-blind.
examples.translation: 尽管他视力很好，他却发现自己是个色盲。

examples.text: Jane blocked Cross's vision and he could see nothing...
examples.translation: 简挡住了克罗斯的视线，他什么也看不见。

examples.text: I saw other indistinct shapes that stayed out of vision.
examples.translation: 我看见另有一些模糊的影子晃了一下就不见了。

examples.text: He wanted to visit his brother in Worcester...
examples.translation: 他想去看望住在伍斯特的哥哥。

examples.text: He was visited by an old friend from Iraq...
examples.translation: 一位来自伊拉克的老朋友来看望他。

examples.text: Bill would visit on weekends.
examples.translation: 周末比尔会来。

examples.text: Helen had recently paid him a visit.
examples.translation: 海伦最近去探望了他。

examples.text: He'll be visiting four cities including Cagliari in Sardinia...
examples.translation: 他将要访问4个城市，包括萨迪尼亚的卡利亚里。

examples.text: Caroline visited all the big stores.
examples.translation: 卡罗琳光顾了所有的大型商店。

examples.text: ...a visiting truck driver.
examples.translation: 一位路过的卡车司机

examples.text: ...the Pope's visit to Canada...
examples.translation: 教皇对加拿大的访问

examples.text: I paid a visit to my local print shop.
examples.translation: 我去了我们当地的照片冲洗店。

examples.text: For details visit our website at www.cobuild.collins.co.uk.
examples.translation: 欲知详情，请访问我们的网站www.cobuild.collins.co.uk。

examples.text: If necessary the patient can then visit his doctor for further advice...
examples.translation: 如有必要，病人可以上门咨询自己的医生以得到更多的建议。

examples.text: A doctor will visit you in your apartment.
examples.translation: 会有医生到您的住所出诊。

examples.text: You may have regular home visits from a neonatal nurse.
examples.translation: 可以雇请育婴护士定期到家里提供服务。

examples.text: Violence is visited upon us every day...
examples.translation: 暴力事件每天都会降临在我们身上。

examples.text: Death and suffering had been visited on thousands of innocents.
examples.translation: 死亡和苦难降临在了数千名无辜的人身上。

meanings.meaning: 视觉的，视力的；栩栩如生的

examples.text: ...the graphic visual depiction of violence.
examples.translation: 对暴力赤裸裸的影像描绘

examples.text: ...music, film, dance, and the visual arts.
examples.translation: 音乐、电影、舞蹈和视觉艺术

examples.text: ...visual jokes.
examples.translation: 视觉笑话

examples.text: ...visually handicapped boys and girls.
examples.translation: 视力有缺陷的男孩和女孩

examples.text: Remember you want your visuals to reinforce your message, not detract from what you are saying.
examples.translation: 要记住，使用视觉材料是为了使表达的意思更加清楚明白，而不能分散对所讲内容的注意力。

meanings.meaning: 至关重要的；生死攸关的；有活力的
(Vital)人名；(法、德、意、俄、葡)维塔尔；(西)比塔尔

examples.text: The port is vital to supply relief to millions of drought victims...
examples.translation: 这个港口对向数百万旱灾灾民提供救援物资是至关重要的。

examples.text: Nick Wileman is a school caretaker so it is vital that he gets on well with young people...
examples.translation: 尼克·威尔曼是学校的管理员，因此与年轻人搞好关系很重要。

examples.text: After her release she was able to give vital information about her kidnapper.
examples.translation: 获释之后，她提供了一些有关绑架她的人的关键信息。

examples.text: Lesley's career in the church is vitally important to her.
examples.translation: 莱斯莉在教堂的工作经历对她来说至关重要。

examples.text: They are both very vital people and a good match...
examples.translation: 他俩都很有活力，十分般配。

examples.text: They have something important to say and vital and radical ways of saying it.
examples.translation: 他们有些重要的事情要说，言辞会比较激烈。

meanings.meaning: 访问者，参观者；视察者；候鸟

examples.text: The other day we had some visitors from Switzerland...
examples.translation: 前几天我们接待了几位来自瑞士的参观者。

examples.text: As a student I lived in Oxford but was a frequent visitor to Belfast.
examples.translation: 求学时我住在牛津，但常常去贝尔法斯特。

meanings.meaning: [生化] 维生素；[生化] 维他命

examples.text: Butter, margarine, and oily fish are all good sources of vitamin D.
examples.translation: 黄油、人造黄油和多脂鱼都含有丰富的维生素D。

examples.text: Healthy people do not need vitamin supplements.
examples.translation: 健康的人不需要额外补充维生素。

examples.text: People of my generation who lived through World War II have vivid memories of confusion and incompetence...
examples.translation: 我们这一代经历过二战的人都真切地记得当时的迷惘和无助。

examples.text: On Wednesday night I had a very vivid dream which really upset me.
examples.translation: 周三晚上，我做了个十分逼真的梦，让我很不安。

examples.text: I can vividly remember the feeling of panic.
examples.translation: 我能清楚地记起那种恐慌感。

examples.text: The vividness of the characterisation came as a complete surprise.
examples.translation: 人物刻画的生动程度完全出乎意料。

examples.text: ...a vivid blue sky.
examples.translation: 蔚蓝的天空

examples.text: ...vividly coloured birds.
examples.translation: 羽毛色泽艳丽的鸟儿

examples.text: He has been very vocal in his displeasure over the results...
examples.translation: 他直言不讳地表达了他对结果的不满。

examples.text: A public inquiry earlier this year produced vocal opposition from residents.
examples.translation: 今年早些时候进行的一次公众调查显示居民对此强烈抗议。

examples.text: Both these proposals were resisted by the developed countries, most vocally by the United States.
examples.translation: 这两项提议都遭到了发达国家的抵制，其中美国的意见最为强烈。

examples.text: ...a wider range of vocal styles.
examples.translation: 更多样的歌唱风格

examples.text: ...vocal training.
examples.translation: 发声训练

examples.text: Vocally, it is often a very accomplished performance...
examples.translation: 就演唱而言，表演常常称得上达到了很高的水准。

examples.text: I then begin to improvise melodies vocally.
examples.translation: 接着我开始哼起即兴创作的旋律。

examples.text: His speech is immature, his vocabulary limited...
examples.translation: 他说话很幼稚，使用的词汇有限。

examples.text: We read to improve our vocabularies.
examples.translation: 我们阅读以便扩大词汇量。

examples.text: ...a new word in the German vocabulary.
examples.translation: 德语词汇中的一个新词

examples.text: ...the vocabulary of natural science.
examples.translation: 自然科学词汇

examples.text: It could well be that he has a real vocation...
examples.translation: 很可能他是找到了自己真正的使命。

examples.text: Diana was a young mission school teacher convinced of her vocation to provide support for her schoolgirl pupils.
examples.translation: 黛安娜是教会学校的一名年轻老师，她深信帮助学校的女学生是其天职。

examples.text: Her vocation is her work as an actress...
examples.translation: 她的职业就是当演员。

examples.text: She has no vocation for teaching.
examples.translation: 她不是当老师的料。

examples.text: Miriam's voice was strangely calm...
examples.translation: 米里亚姆的声音异乎寻常地平静。

examples.text: 'The police are here,' she said in a low voice...
examples.translation: “警察在这里，”她低声说。

examples.text: There was a sound of loud voices from the kitchen...
examples.translation: 厨房传来一阵喧闹声。

examples.text: I ended up with bronchitis and no voice.
examples.translation: 结果我得了支气管炎，不能说话了。

examples.text: What does one do when a government simply refuses to listen to the voice of the opposition?...
examples.translation: 当政府就是不肯听取反对意见时，你该怎么做呢？

examples.text: There was no disagreement, there were no dissenting voices.
examples.translation: 既没有争执，也没有异议。

examples.text: Egypt is once again accepted as an important voice in Arab politics...
examples.translation: 埃及再一次被认为是阿拉伯政治中的一个重要声音。

examples.text: But your partners will have no voice in how you operate your company.
examples.translation: 但是你的合伙人对你如何经营公司不会有发言权。

examples.text: Some scientists have voiced concern that the disease could be passed on to humans...
examples.translation: 有些科学家表示了担忧，认为这种病可能传染给人类。

examples.text: The predominant opinion voiced by Detroit's Arab population seems to be one of frustration.
examples.translation: 底特律的阿拉伯人所表达的似乎主要是一种挫折感。

examples.text: 'Kurt Kohn was my paternal grandfather's name,' Laura said when she found her voice.
examples.translation: “库尔特·科恩是我祖父的名字，”克服了恐惧的劳拉开口说道。

examples.text: The poems which he wrote in the trenches are generally agreed to be those in which he found his true voice.
examples.translation: 他在战壕里创作的那些诗歌被公认为是他找到了自己声音的作品。

examples.translation: 一家由天主教教会开办的、贫民区居民可以在其节目中表达抗议的社区电台

examples.text: Keep your voice down, for goodness sake.
examples.translation: 看在上天的份儿上，小点儿声。

examples.text: I had to be careful not to get a sore throat and lose my voice.
examples.translation: 我必须得小心，免得嗓子痛，话都说不出来。

examples.text: He raised his voice for the benefit of the other two women...
examples.translation: 为了让其他两个女人听清，他提高了嗓门。

examples.text: She'd lowered her voice until it was barely audible.
examples.translation: 她把嗓音压低到几乎听不见。

examples.text: 'Damn!' he yelled at the top of his voice.
examples.translation: “该死！”他声嘶力竭地喊道。

examples.text: This would enable the community to speak with one voice in world affairs.
examples.translation: 这将使该共同体在国际事务上能以一个声音讲话。

examples.text: His death has left a void in the cricketing world which can never be filled.
examples.translation: 他的死给板球界留下一个永远无法填补的空白。

examples.text: ...an aching void of loneliness.
examples.translation: 痛苦的孤寂感

examples.text: He stared into the dark void where the battle had been fought...
examples.translation: 他凝望着那片漆黑的空旷之地，那次战役就是在这里进行的。

examples.text: The ship moved silently through the black void...
examples.translation: 船静悄悄地划过漆黑的夜。

examples.text: Observers have recently found in the Universe giant voids about 500,000,000 light-years across.
examples.translation: 观察员最近在宇宙中发现了直径约5亿光年的巨型空洞。

examples.text: The original elections were declared void by the former military ruler...
examples.translation: 前军事领导人宣布最初的选举无效。

examples.text: The agreement will be considered null and void.
examples.translation: 该协议将被视作无效。

examples.text: He rose, his face void of emotion as he walked towards the door...
examples.translation: 他站起来，面无表情地朝门口走去。

examples.text: The treaty is now void of absolute commitments.
examples.translation: 条约现在失去了绝对的约束力。

examples.text: The Supreme Court threw out the confession and voided his conviction for murder.
examples.translation: 最高法院驳回了供词，宣布他谋杀罪名不成立。

examples.text: The volcano erupted last year killing about 600 people...
examples.translation: 去年那座火山喷发致使约600人遇难。

examples.text: Etna is Europe's most active volcano.
examples.translation: 埃特纳山是欧洲最活跃的火山。

examples.text: Four ticketed events have taken place this year: Mountain bike, beach volleyball, basketball and BMX.

meanings.meaning: 伏特（电压单位）；环骑；闪避

examples.text: The Volt kind of accomplishes even more than the Smart could do, Synder says.
The systems are getting smaller and using lower voltages.
examples.translation: 这些系统变得更小，使用的电压也更低。

examples.text: ...high-voltage power lines.
examples.translation: 高压电线

examples.text: Senior officials will be discussing how the volume of sales might be reduced.
examples.translation: 高层领导将要讨论销售量如何削减。

examples.text: ...the sheer volume of traffic and accidents.
examples.translation: 交通流量之大、事故之多

examples.text: It is 2,300 metres above sea level, so a given volume of air contains only about one-third as much oxygen as it would at sea level...
examples.translation: 这是在海拔2,300米的高空，因此一定体积空气的含氧量只有海平面处的约1/3。

examples.text: When egg whites are beaten they can rise to seven or eight times their original volume.
examples.translation: 蛋清打散后，体积可增至原来的七八倍。

examples.text: ...a 125-page volume.
examples.translation: 一本125页的书

examples.text: ...the first volume of his autobiography.
examples.translation: 他自传的第一卷

examples.text: ...bound volumes of the magazine.
examples.translation: 杂志的合订本

examples.text: He turned down the volume...
examples.translation: 他调低了音量。

examples.text: He came to complain about the volume of the music.
examples.translation: 他过来抱怨音乐的音量太高了。

examples.text: What you wear speaks volumes about you...
examples.translation: 你的衣着能传递很多关于你的信息。

examples.text: Their absence spoke volumes.
examples.translation: 他们的缺席已经充分说明了问题。

meanings.meaning: 自愿的；志愿的；自发的；故意的

examples.text: Attention is drawn to a special voluntary course in Commercial French...
examples.translation: 一门特别的商务法语选修课引起了大家的关注。

examples.text: The scheme, due to begin next month, will be voluntary.
examples.translation: 定于下个月开始实施的方案是自愿性质的。

examples.text: I would only leave here voluntarily if there was a big chance to work abroad.
examples.translation: 只有当国外有非常好的工作机会时，我才会主动离开这里。

examples.text: In her spare time she does voluntary work...
examples.translation: 她在业余时间做义工。

examples.text: He'd been working at the local hostel for the handicapped on a voluntary basis.
examples.translation: 他曾在当地的残疾人救助站当过义工。

examples.text: Apna Arts has achieved more with voluntary workers in three years than most organisations with paid workers have achieved in ten...
examples.translation: “我们”艺术中心依靠志愿者在3年内取得的成就超过了大多数雇用受薪员工的机构10年中取得的成绩。

examples.text: We depend solely upon our voluntary helpers.
examples.translation: 我们完全依靠我们的志愿者。

examples.text: Some local authorities and voluntary organizations also run workshops for disabled people...
examples.translation: 一些当地机构和志愿组织也为残疾人开设了一些工场。

examples.text: It has been largely through the voluntary sector that the needs of victims have been met.
examples.translation: 受害者的需要主要是通过志愿组织予以满足的。

examples.text: ...a voluntary hostel for ex-offenders.
examples.translation: 为出狱囚犯义务提供的宿舍

examples.text: She now helps in a local school as a volunteer three days a week...
examples.translation: 目前她在当地的一家学校做志愿工作，一周去3天。

examples.text: Mike was a member of the local volunteer fire brigade.
examples.translation: 迈克是当地消防队的一名志愿消防员。

examples.text: Right. What I want now is two volunteers to come down to the front...
examples.translation: 好了，现在我需要两个自告奋勇的人到前面来。

examples.text: Any volunteers?
examples.translation: 有没有人自告奋勇？

examples.text: Aunt Mary volunteered to clean up the kitchen...
examples.translation: 玛丽阿姨主动要求清扫厨房。

examples.text: He volunteered for the army in 1939...
examples.translation: 1939年他志愿参军。

examples.text: She volunteered as a nurse in a soldiers' rest-home...
examples.translation: 她自告奋勇到士兵疗养院当护士。

examples.text: He's volunteered his services as a chauffeur.
examples.translation: 他主动提出当司机。

examples.text: The room was quiet; no one volunteered any further information...
examples.translation: 房间很安静，无人主动提供更多的信息。

examples.text: 'They were both great supporters of Franco,' Ryle volunteered...
examples.translation: “他们都是佛朗哥的忠实支持者，”赖尔主动说道。

examples.text: The next week, Phillida volunteered that they were getting on better.
examples.translation: 第二周，菲莉达主动说他们相处得好些了。

examples.text: They fought as volunteers with the Afghan guerrillas...
examples.translation: 他们作为志愿军和阿富汗的游击队员并肩作战。

examples.text: Victory in the civil war had been achieved by a mainly volunteer army.
examples.translation: 一支主要由志愿军组成的队伍取得了内战的胜利。

meanings.meaning: 提议，使投票；投票决定；公认

examples.text: He walked to the local polling centre to cast his vote...
examples.translation: 他走到当地的投票中心投了票。

examples.text: The government got a massive majority — well over 400 votes...
examples.translation: 政府获得了远远超过400票赞成的绝大多数票。

examples.text: Mr Reynolds was re-elected by 102 votes to 60.
examples.translation: 雷诺兹先生以102票对60票再次当选。

examples.text: Why do you think we should have a vote on that?...
examples.translation: 为什么你认为我们应该对那件事进行表决？

examples.text: They took a vote and decided not to do it.
examples.translation: 他们进行了表决，决定放弃。

examples.text: Opposition parties won about fifty-five per cent of the vote...
examples.translation: 反对党大约赢得了55％的选票。

examples.text: The vote was overwhelmingly in favour of the Democratic Party.
examples.translation: 压倒多数的选票投给了民主党。

examples.text: ...a huge majority of the white male vote.
examples.translation: 绝大多数的白人男性的选票

examples.text: And of course we didn't even have the vote, did we?...
examples.translation: 当然了，我们连投票权都没有，不是吗？

examples.text: Before that, women did not have a vote at all...
examples.translation: 在那之前，妇女连选举权都没有。

examples.text: People with disabilities have got a vote as well, you know.
examples.translation: 你知道，残疾人士也拥有投票权。

examples.text: Two-thirds of the national electorate had the chance to vote in these elections...
examples.translation: 全国选民的2/3有机会在这些选举中投票。

examples.text: It seems many people would vote for the government, at a general election, if there was a new leader...
examples.translation: 如果有一个新领导人的话，大选时似乎许多人都会投票支持政府。

examples.text: Both chambers plan to vote on that policy before January 15th...
examples.translation: 两院都打算在1月15日前对那一政策进行投票表决。

examples.text: The residents of Leningrad voted to restore the city's original name of St Petersburg...
examples.translation: 列宁格勒市的居民投票决定恢复该市原来的名字——圣彼得堡。

examples.text: The parliament has voted by an overwhelming majority to suspend its declaration of independence...
examples.translation: 议会以压倒性的多数票决定推迟宣布独立。

examples.text: The Bridgeport Common Council voted 9:8 for a five percent tax increase.
examples.translation: 布里奇波特市议会以9比8的投票结果通过了将税率提高5％的决定。

examples.text: Voting began about two hours ago.
examples.translation: 投票大约两个小时前就开始了。

examples.text: 52.5% of those questioned said they'd vote Labour...
examples.translation: 52.5％的受访者表示他们会投工党的票。

examples.text: I probably would have voted that way anyway...
examples.translation: 无论如何我可能都会那样投票。

examples.text: A single candidate is put forward and the people vote yes or no.
examples.translation: 先推出一个候选人，由人们投票表示赞成或反对。

examples.text: The General Court had voted $2,500 for a monument to be erected to his memory...
examples.translation: 州议会投票决定拨款2,500美元为他建一座纪念碑。

examples.text: The Parliament voted more funds to help maintain American forces.
examples.translation: 国会投票同意拨出更多资金来维持美国军队的开支。

examples.text: His class voted him the man 'who had done the most for Yale.'...
examples.translation: 他被班里评选为“为耶鲁作出最大贡献”的人。

examples.text: Michael has been voted Player of the Year.
examples.translation: 迈克尔被评为“年度最佳球员”。

examples.text: Thousands of citizens are already voting with their feet, and leaving the country...
examples.translation: 成千上万的公民正准备离开这个国家，以这一举动表示反对。

examples.text: Authors still have power to vote with their feet by leaving to join smaller companies.
examples.translation: 作者依然可以通过退出并加盟规模小些的公司来表明他们的反对立场。

examples.text: I vote that we all go to Holland immediately...
examples.translation: 我建议我们全都立刻前往荷兰。

examples.text: I vote that you try to pick out the trail for us.
examples.translation: 我提议由你来选我们该走哪条小路。

examples.text: Mr Gould called for a move towards 'one man one vote'...
examples.translation: 古尔德先生号召采取“一人一票制”。

examples.text: The African National Congress insists on a one-man, one-vote system.
examples.translation: 非洲国民大会坚持实行一人一票的制度。

examples.text: The vowel in words like 'my' and 'thigh' is not very difficult.
examples.translation: 单词my和thigh中的元音并不难发。

examples.text: ...English vowel sounds.
examples.translation: 英语中的元音

examples.text: He aims to follow Columbus's voyage to the West Indies.
examples.translation: 他打算重走哥伦布到达西印度群岛的航行路线。

examples.text: ...the first space shuttle voyage to be devoted entirely to astronomy.
examples.translation: 首次完全以天文研究为目的的航天飞行

examples.text: The Greenpeace flagship is voyaging through the Arctic cold of the Barents Sea.
examples.translation: 绿色和平组织的旗舰正在穿越巴伦支海的北极寒冷地带。

examples.text: ...fifteenth-century voyagers to the lands now called America and the Caribbean.
examples.translation: 在15世纪到达今天被称为美洲和加勒比地区的航海家们

examples.text: Our boat would not have been appropriate for ocean voyaging.
examples.translation: 我们的船只本不适合海上航行。

examples.text: I think it's a very vulgar house...
examples.translation: 我觉得这所房子很俗气。

examples.text: The film is tasteless, vulgar and even badly shot.
examples.translation: 这部电影毫无品位、庸俗不堪，甚至可以说拍得很烂。

examples.text: I hate the vulgarity of this room.
examples.translation: 我讨厌这个房间的庸俗劲儿。

examples.text: The women laughed coarsely at some vulgar jokes...
examples.translation: 那些女人听了一些下流的笑话后粗俗地大笑。

examples.text: The lyrics were vulgar.
examples.translation: 歌词粗俗下流。

examples.text: There's a good deal of vulgarity.
examples.translation: 真是俗不可耐。

examples.text: He was a vulgar old man, but he never swore in front of a woman...
examples.translation: 他是个粗鲁的老头，但他从来不在女人面前说脏话。

examples.text: 'Don't be vulgar,' she reprimanded.
examples.translation: “不要无礼，”她斥责道。

examples.text: It's his vulgarity that I can't take.
examples.translation: 我不能容忍的是他的粗鄙。

meanings.meaning: 易受攻击的，易受…的攻击；易受伤害的；有弱点的

examples.text: Old people are particularly vulnerable members of our society.
examples.translation: 老年人是社会中尤为明显的弱势群体。

examples.text: David accepts his own vulnerability.
examples.translation: 戴维承认了自己的脆弱。

examples.text: People with high blood pressure are especially vulnerable to diabetes...
examples.translation: 有高血压的人尤其易患糖尿病。

examples.text: Plants that are growing vigorously are less likely to be vulnerable to disease.
examples.translation: 生命力强的植物不容易得病。

examples.text: Taking long-term courses of certain medicines may increase vulnerability to infection.
examples.translation: 长期服用某类药品可能会增加感染的可能性。

examples.text: Their tanks would be vulnerable to attack from the air...
examples.translation: 他们的坦克易受到空袭。

examples.text: ...a table showing which cars are most vulnerable to theft...
examples.translation: 易被盗车辆一览表

examples.text: Goodyear could be vulnerable in a prolonged economic slump.
examples.translation: 经济长期疲软可能会对固特异公司造成影响。

examples.text: ...anxieties about the country's vulnerability to invasion.
examples.translation: 对于国家易受侵犯的焦虑

examples.text: I'm on the wagon for a while. Cleaning out my system.
examples.translation: 我这段时间正在戒酒，对体内进行大扫除。

examples.text: Ricky kept his arm round her waist...
examples.translation: 里基一直揽着她的腰。

examples.text: He was stripped to the waist.
examples.translation: 他上身赤裸。

examples.text: Sarah looked slender-waisted, fragile and very beautiful.
examples.translation: 萨拉纤纤细腰，弱不禁风，楚楚动人。

examples.text: ...high-waisted dresses.
examples.translation: 高腰裙

examples.text: His wages have gone up...
examples.translation: 他涨工资了。

examples.text: This may end efforts to set a minimum wage well above the poverty line.
examples.translation: 这可能会使将最低工资定得远高于贫困线的努力告吹。

examples.text: ...the three factions that had been waging a civil war...
examples.translation: 发动内战的三个派别

examples.text: They waged a price war.
examples.translation: 他们打起了价格战。

examples.text: I walk to a street corner and wait for the school bus...
examples.translation: 我走到街角等校车。

examples.text: Stop waiting for things to happen. Make them happen...
examples.translation: 不要坐等事情发生。要创造条件让它们发生。

examples.text: I waited to see how she responded...
examples.translation: 我等着看她如何回应。

examples.text: Angus got out of the car to wait...
examples.translation: 安格斯从汽车里出来等着。

examples.text: We will have to wait a week or so before we know whether the operation is a success...
examples.translation: 我们还得等一周左右才能知道手术是否成功。

examples.text: He told waiting journalists that he did not expect a referendum to be held for several months.
examples.translation: 他告诉守候着的记者，他认为几个月内不会举行全民公决。

examples.text: The waiting became almost unbearable.
examples.translation: 等待变得让人几乎无法忍受。

examples.text: ...the four-hour wait for the organizers to declare the result.
examples.translation: 组织者宣布结果之前长达4小时的等待

examples.text: There'll be a car waiting for you...
examples.translation: 会有辆汽车等你。

examples.text: When we came home we had a meal waiting for us...
examples.translation: 我们到家时，有一顿美餐正等着我们享用。

examples.text: Ships with unfurled sails wait to take them aboard...
examples.translation: 船只扬起风帆，等待他们上船。

examples.text: Three-hundred railway wagons were waiting to be unloaded...
examples.translation: 有300个铁路货车车厢等着卸货。

examples.text: He had a taxi waiting to take him to the train...
examples.translation: 他让一辆出租车等着带他到火车站去。

examples.text: The President had his plane waiting, 20 minutes' drive away.
examples.translation: 总统让飞机在20分钟车程的地方等着。

examples.text: I want to talk to you, but it can wait...
examples.translation: 我想和你谈谈，但可以晚点再说。

examples.text: Any changes will have to wait until sponsors can be found.
examples.translation: 任何改变都要等找到赞助商之后再作决定。

examples.text: If you think this all sounds very exciting, just wait until you read the book...
examples.translation: 如果你觉得所有这些听起来令人兴奋，那就等着去读这本书吧。

examples.text: As soon as you get some food inside you, you'll feel more cheerful. Just you wait.
examples.translation: 吃点儿东西你就会打起精神的。等着瞧吧。

examples.text: 'Wait a minute!' he broke in. 'This is not giving her a fair hearing!'
examples.translation: “等一下，”他插嘴说，“这没有给她一个公平的解释机会！”

examples.text: There were plenty of servants to wait on her...
examples.translation: 有很多仆人服侍她。

examples.text: Each student is expected to wait at table for one week each semester.
examples.translation: 每学期每个学生都要在餐厅服务一周。

examples.text: We can't wait to get started...
examples.translation: 我们迫不及待地想开始。

examples.text: It's gonna be great. I can hardly wait...
examples.translation: 那一定很棒。我都等不及了。

examples.text: I could hardly wait to get out of there.
examples.translation: 我迫不及待地要离开那里。

examples.text: Arms bend. Arms upward. Wait for it. Stretch.
examples.translation: 手臂弯曲。手臂上举。保持一下。伸展。

examples.text: A cool $500,000 is to be spent on obtaining genuine 17th-century air from the inside of, wait for it, an occupied lead coffin.
examples.translation: 将花费整整50万美元获取货真价实的17世纪的空气，注意了，是从一个内有尸体的铅制棺材里获得。

examples.text: We'll have to wait and see what happens.
examples.translation: 我们只好等等看将会发生什么。

examples.text: ...a wait-and-see attitude.
examples.translation: 观望态度

examples.text: Well, what are you waiting for? Do I have to ask you for a kiss?
examples.translation: 那你还等什么呢？难道要我求你吻我吗？

examples.text: He's a waiter at Shakey's or some shit, and now he's gotta deal with this.
She had been working in a pub, cooking and waitressing.
examples.translation: 她之前在酒吧工作，负责烹饪和招待。

examples.text: She does a bit of waitressing as a part-time job.
examples.translation: 她有时兼职做一下服务员。

examples.text: It was cold and dark when I woke at 6.30...
examples.translation: 我6点半醒来时，天又冷又黑。

examples.text: Bob woke slowly to sunshine pouring in his window...
examples.translation: 直到阳光从窗外泻入，鲍勃才慢慢醒来。

examples.text: She woke to find her dark room lit by flashing lights...
examples.translation: 她醒来时发现黑暗的屋子被闪烁的灯光照亮。

examples.text: She went upstairs to wake Milton.
examples.translation: 她上楼去叫醒米尔顿。

examples.text: One morning I woke up and felt something was wrong...
examples.translation: 一天早上我醒过来后感觉有些不对劲。

examples.text: At dawn I woke him up and said we were leaving.
examples.translation: 黎明时分，我把他叫醒，告诉他我们要走了。

examples.text: The ride was smooth until they got into the merchant ship's wake...
examples.translation: 航行一直很顺利，直到他们碰上了商船的尾流。

examples.text: Dolphins sometimes play in the wake of the boats.
examples.translation: 有时海豚在船的尾流中嬉戏。

examples.text: A funeral wake was in progress.
examples.translation: 正在进行葬礼守灵。

examples.text: The governor has enjoyed a huge surge in the polls in the wake of last week's convention...
examples.translation: 上周的大会过后，民意调查显示州长支持率大幅上升。

examples.text: The company is in bankruptcy proceedings in the wake of a strike that began last spring.
examples.translation: 去年春天开始的罢工一结束，这家公司就进入了破产程序。

examples.text: It was work which consumed most of his waking hours...
examples.translation: 他醒着的时候大部分时间都在工作。

examples.text: Most of their waking hours are spent eating.
examples.translation: 他们醒着时大部分时间都在吃东西。

examples.text: Adam stumbles on, leaving a trail of devastation in his wake...
examples.translation: 亚当蹒跚而行，沿路留下毁坏的痕迹。

examples.text: The tanks left burning vehicles in their wake as they ploughed through makeshift barricades.
examples.translation: 坦克冲过临时搭建的路障，所过之处留下了燃烧的车辆。

examples.text: In his wake came a waiter wheeling a trolley.
examples.translation: 一位推着手推车的侍者紧随着他过来。

examples.text: ...the endless stream of female artists who released albums in her wake.
examples.translation: 无数效仿她发行专辑的女艺术家

examples.text: Rosanna and Forbes walked in silence for some while...
examples.translation: 罗莎娜和福布斯默不作声地走了一会儿。

examples.text: We walked into the foyer...
examples.translation: 我们走进门厅。

examples.text: She turned and walked away...
examples.translation: 她转身走开了。

examples.text: They would stop the car and walk a few steps...
examples.translation: 他们会停下车走上几步。

examples.text: When I was your age I walked five miles to school.
examples.translation: 我像你这么大时，要步行5英里去上学。

examples.text: I went for a walk...
examples.translation: 我去散步了。

examples.text: He often took long walks in the hills.
examples.translation: 他经常在山中久久漫步。
