examples.text: It was only a three-mile walk to Kabul from there...
examples.translation: 从那里到喀布尔只需走上3英里。

examples.text: The church is a short walk from Piazza Dante.
examples.translation: 教堂离但丁广场只有几步之遥。

examples.text: There is a 2 mile coastal walk from Craster to Newton.
examples.translation: 从克拉斯特到牛顿有一条两英里的海滨小径。

examples.text: She slowed to a steady walk.
examples.translation: 她放慢脚步，徐徐而行。

examples.text: George, despite his great height and gangling walk, was a keen dancer.
examples.translation: 乔治尽管长得过高，走路姿势难看，但却热衷于跳舞。

examples.text: She walked me to my car...
examples.translation: 她陪我走到我的车旁。

examples.text: 'What a nice gentleman you are, to walk Hilary home,' her mother said.
examples.translation: “您能送希拉里走回家，真是一位绅士，”她的母亲说道。

examples.text: I walk my dog each evening around my local streets.
examples.translation: 我每晚在家附近的街道上遛狗。

meanings.meaning: (Wall)人名；(英)沃尔；(德、芬、捷、瑞典)瓦尔

examples.text: Kathryn leaned against the wall of the church...
examples.translation: 凯瑟琳倚靠在教堂的墙上。

examples.text: The bedroom walls would be painted light blue...
examples.translation: 卧室的墙壁会被漆成浅蓝色。

examples.text: She checked the wall clock.
examples.translation: 她对了对墙上的钟。

examples.text: ...a glass-walled elevator...
examples.translation: 玻璃壁电梯

examples.text: Our bedroom was white-walled with yellow silk curtains.
examples.translation: 我们的卧室墙壁是白色，挂着黄色的丝绸窗帘。

examples.text: He sat on the wall in the sun...
examples.translation: 他坐在墙上晒太阳。

examples.text: The well is surrounded by a wall only 12 inches high.
examples.translation: 井台只有12英寸高。

examples.text: He ran his fingers along the inside walls of the box.
examples.translation: 他用手指摸了摸盒子的内壁。

examples.text: She gazed at the wall of books...
examples.translation: 她目不转睛地盯着书墙。

examples.text: I was just hit by a wall of water.
examples.translation: 我刚撞上了一堵水墙。

examples.text: The police say they met the usual wall of silence...
examples.translation: 警方称他们像往常一样碰了壁，没人吭气。

examples.text: Despite its prevalence, schizophrenia has existed behind a wall of secrecy for years.
examples.translation: 尽管精神分裂症患者为数众多，但多年来这种病一直被捂着掩着。

examples.text: I appealed for help but felt I was always banging my head against a wall...
examples.translation: 我寻求帮助，却发现自己处处碰壁。

examples.text: I wondered if I was banging my head against a brick wall.
examples.translation: 我怀疑自己是不是在把鸡蛋往石头上碰，徒劳无益。

examples.text: Their threat to hire replacement workers has the union with its back to the wall.
examples.translation: 他们威胁说要雇用替工，这使工会陷入了困境。

examples.text: Sitting at home would only have had him climbing the walls with frustration.
examples.translation: 呆在家里只会让他沮丧得抓狂。

examples.text: The heat is driving me up the wall...
examples.translation: 炎热快把我逼疯了。

examples.text: I sang in the bath and drove my parents up the wall.
examples.translation: 我在浴室里唱歌，我父母快受不了了。

examples.text: Even quite big companies are going to the wall these days.
examples.translation: 现如今甚至有些大公司也濒临破产。

examples.text: Camping is easy on the wallet and also opens a whole new world for parents.
The noise of a door slamming wakened her...
examples.translation: 砰的摔门声把她吵醒了。

examples.text: Women are much more likely than men to waken because of noise.
examples.translation: 女性通常比男性更易被噪音吵醒。

examples.text: 'Drink this coffee — it will waken you up.'...
examples.translation: “把这杯咖啡喝了——它会让你清醒过来。”

examples.text: If you do waken up during the night, start the exercises again.
examples.translation: 如果你夜里真的醒了，就再从头开始做这套动作。

examples.text: When he got bored he wandered around the fair...
examples.translation: 他烦了就去集市上逛逛。

examples.text: They wandered off in the direction of the nearest store...
examples.translation: 他们信步朝最近的商店走去。

examples.text: Those who do not have relatives to return to are left to wander the streets and sleep rough.
examples.translation: 举目无亲的人只好四处游荡，露宿街头。

examples.text: A wander around any market will reveal stalls piled high with vegetables.
examples.translation: 随便到哪个市场逛逛，都能看见蔬菜堆得老高的菜摊。

examples.text: Because Mother is afraid we'll get lost, we aren't allowed to wander far...
examples.translation: 妈妈生怕我们迷路，不准我们走远。

examples.text: To keep their bees from wandering, beekeepers feed them sugar solutions.
examples.translation: 为了防止蜜蜂迷路 ，养蜂人给它们喝糖水。

examples.text: His mind would wander, and he would lose track of what he was doing...
examples.translation: 他会走神，忘了自己正在干什么。

examples.text: Jarvis found his attention wandering...
examples.translation: 贾维斯发现自己走神了。

examples.text: Grace allowed her mind to wander to other things.
examples.translation: 格雷丝任由自己的思绪游走。

examples.text: His eyes wandered restlessly around the room...
examples.translation: 他的眼睛不安地转来转去，打量着房间。

examples.text: His eyes kept wandering to the picture...
examples.translation: 他的眼神不停地瞄到这幅画上。

examples.text: Read their body language. Are their eyes wandering or are they drumming the desk with their fingers?
examples.translation: 解读他们的肢体语言。他们的眼睛游离不定吗，抑或他们在用手指不停地敲打桌子？

examples.text: I want a drink...
examples.translation: 我想喝点什么。

examples.text: Ian knows exactly what he wants in life...
examples.translation: 伊恩很清楚他需要什么样的生活。

examples.text: People wanted to know who this talented designer was...
examples.translation: 人们想知道这位天才设计师是谁。

examples.text: They began to want their father to be the same as other daddies...
examples.translation: 他们开始希望他们的父亲能和别人的老爸一样。

examples.text: They didn't want people staring at them as they sat on the lawn, so they put up high walls...
examples.translation: 他们不希望坐在草坪上时被别人盯着看，于是便筑起了高墙。

examples.text: He wanted his power recognised...
examples.translation: 他希望他的权力得到认可。

examples.text: I want my car this colour...
examples.translation: 我希望我的小汽车是这种颜色的。

examples.text: And remember, we want him alive.
examples.translation: 记住，我们要他活着。

examples.text: I want to say how really delighted I am that you're having a baby...
examples.translation: 我想说你怀孕了我有多高兴。

examples.text: Look, I wanted to apologize for today. I think I was a little hard on you.
examples.translation: 听我说，我想就今天的事向你道歉。我觉得我对你有点过于苛刻了。

examples.text: Do you want another cup of coffee?...
examples.translation: 你想再来一杯咖啡吗？

examples.text: Do you want to leave your bike here?
examples.translation: 你想把自行车停在这里吗？

examples.text: I want an explanation from you, Jeremy...
examples.translation: 杰里米，我需要你解释一下。

examples.text: If you have a problem with that, I want you to tell me right now...
examples.translation: 如果你有异议，我要你马上告诉我。

examples.text: Do you want to tell me what all this is about?...
examples.translation: 你不打算告诉我这一切都是怎么回事吗？

examples.text: I want my money back!
examples.translation: 我要讨回我的钱！

examples.text: The windows wanted cleaning...
examples.translation: 窗户该擦了。

examples.text: Her hair wants cutting.
examples.translation: 她该剪头发了。

examples.text: You want to be very careful not to have a man like Crevecoeur for an enemy...
examples.translation: 你应当格外小心，别与克雷弗克这样的人为敌。

examples.text: You want to look where you're going, mate.
examples.translation: 伙计，你应当看看你要去哪里。

examples.text: They were wanted by the police...
examples.translation: 他们被警方通缉。

examples.text: He has killed many in his time, and is wanted in at least three countries...
examples.translation: 他那个时候杀了很多人，现在至少有3个国家在通缉他。

examples.text: He was wanted for the murder of a magistrate.
examples.translation: 他因谋杀一名地方法官而被通缉。

examples.text: He is one of the most wanted criminals in Europe.
examples.translation: 他是欧洲最重要的通缉犯之一。

examples.text: Come on, darling. I want you.
examples.translation: 亲爱的，过来。我想要你。

examples.text: Children should be wanted and planned...
examples.translation: 应当好好照看孩子，并为他们规划一生。

examples.text: I want this baby very much, because it certainly will be the last.
examples.translation: 我很爱这个小宝贝，因为它肯定是我最后一个孩子了。

examples.text: Albie wants you in his office...
examples.translation: 阿尔比要你去他办公室。

examples.text: They didn't want her as attorney general...
examples.translation: 他们不想要她做司法部长。

examples.text: This is my territory. I want you out of here.
examples.translation: 这是我的地盘。我要你离开。

examples.text: ...a want of manners and charm...
examples.translation: 缺乏风度和魅力

examples.text: The men were daily becoming weaker from want of rest.
examples.translation: 由于缺乏休息，这些男人日渐虚弱。

examples.text: He said they were fighting for freedom of speech, freedom of worship, and freedom from want.
examples.translation: 他说他们在为言论自由而战，为信仰自由而战，为远离贫困而战。

examples.text: She couldn't lift a spoon without a servant anticipating her wants and getting it for her...
examples.translation: 要是没有仆人事先想她所想并为她准备妥当，她连汤匙也举不起来。

examples.text: Supermarkets often claim that they are responding to the wants of consumers by providing packaged foods.
examples.translation: 超市经常声称他们根据消费者的需要提供包装食品。

examples.text: Many of them had gone into teaching for want of anything better to do...
examples.translation: 因为没有更好的工作，他们当中很多人做了教师。

examples.text: There was another emotion, and for want of a better word he called it grief.
examples.translation: 还有一种情感，由于找不到更好的字眼来描绘，他称它为悲痛。

examples.text: Mary says you're welcome to stay the night if you want...
examples.translation: 玛丽说如果你愿意，可以在这儿呆一宿。

examples.text: 'Do you want to go through it all?' — 'Yeah, if you want.'
examples.translation: “你想把它都看完吗？”——“是的，如果你愿意的话。”

examples.text: 'I don't want to appear big-headed,' explains Loubet, 'but I would say there is a 95% chance of success.'...
examples.translation: “我并不想显得自大，”劳伯特解释说，“但我有95%的成功把握。”

examples.text: Without wanting to sound mean about it, these things all have to come from a budget.
examples.translation: 我并不想显得小气，但所有这些东西都必须从预算中开支。

examples.text: 'What do you want!' she whispered savagely. 'Get out.'...
examples.translation: “你想干什么！”她粗野地低语道，“滚开。”

examples.text: 'Bernie's been on the phone.' — 'What does he want?'
examples.translation: “伯尼来过电话。”——“他想干什么？”

meanings.meaning: 战争，斗争；军事，战术；冲突，对抗，竞争

examples.text: He spent part of the war in the National Guard...
examples.translation: 战争期间，他在国民警卫队呆过一段时间。

examples.text: ...matters of war and peace...
examples.translation: 战争与和平的问题

examples.text: They've been at war for the last fifteen years.
examples.translation: 最近15年来他们一直在打仗。

examples.text: The most important thing is to reach an agreement and to avoid a trade war.
examples.translation: 最重要的是达成协议，避免贸易战。

examples.text: She has been involved in the war against organised crime.
examples.translation: 她参与了打击有组织犯罪的斗争。

examples.text: ...if the United States is to be successful in its war on drugs.
examples.translation: 如果美国想在反毒斗争中获得胜利…

examples.text: Ben has also been in the wars. He is still in plaster after breaking a leg.
examples.translation: 本也受了伤。他摔断了一条腿，现在还打着石膏。

examples.text: Do you think this crisis can be settled without going to war?
examples.translation: 你认为这场危机能和平解决吗？

examples.text: Animal rights activists have been engaged in an increasingly bitter war of words with many of the nation's zoos.
examples.translation: 动物权利保护者和该国多家动物园展开了越来越激烈的论战。

meanings.meaning: (Ward)人名；(英)沃德；(德、芬、瑞典、葡)瓦尔德

examples.text: A toddler was admitted to the emergency ward with a wound in his chest.
examples.translation: 一个蹒跚学步的小孩因胸部受伤被送进急救室。

examples.text: ...the marginal wards of Reading Kentwood and Tilehurst West.
examples.translation: 边缘选区雷丁肯特伍德和西泰尔赫斯特

examples.text: Alex was made a ward of court.
examples.translation: 亚历克斯由法院监护。

meanings.meaning: 储入仓库；以他人名义购进（股票）

examples.text: It uses the warehouse to demonstrate to distributors how effectively those previews turn into ticket sales.
Her wardrobe consists primarily of huge cashmere sweaters and tiny Italian sandals.
examples.translation: 她的衣物主要是宽大的开司米毛衣和小巧的意大利凉鞋。

examples.text: In the wardrobe department were rows of costumes.
examples.translation: 戏装部有一排排的戏装。

examples.text: ...the threat of chemical warfare.
examples.translation: 化学战的威胁

examples.text: Much of the violence is related to drugs and gang warfare...
examples.translation: 大多数暴力事件都与吸毒和群殴有关。

examples.text: At times party rivalries have broken out into open warfare.
examples.translation: 政党间的矛盾有时爆发为公开的冲突。

meanings.meaning: 使…兴奋；使…温暖；使…感兴趣

examples.text: Wheat is grown in places which have cold winters and warm, dry summers...
examples.translation: 小麦适宜在冬季寒冷而夏季温暖干燥的地方生长。

examples.text: Because it was warm, David wore only a white cotton shirt...
examples.translation: 因为天气暖和，戴维只穿了一件白色的棉衬衣。

examples.text: Dissolve the salt in the warm water.
examples.translation: 把盐放在温水里溶解。

examples.text: They have been forced to sleep in the open without food or warm clothing...
examples.translation: 他们被迫风餐露宿，吃不饱也穿不暖。

examples.text: The bed had clean sheets and warm blankets.
examples.translation: 床上是干净的被单和暖和的毯子。

examples.text: Remember to wrap up warmly on cold days.
examples.translation: 记得天冷时穿暖和些。

examples.text: ...warmly dressed.
examples.translation: 穿得暖和

examples.text: We hope the colour gives the house a warm and inviting feel...
examples.translation: 我们希望这种颜色能让房子给人一种暖意融融、宾至如归的感觉。

examples.text: The basement hallway is painted a warm yellow.
examples.translation: 地下室的走廊漆成了暖黄色。

examples.text: She was a warm and loving mother...
examples.translation: 她是一位热情慈爱的母亲。

examples.text: 'Wonderful!' he exclaimed, in the familiar warm voice that made everybody who knew him feel welcome...
examples.translation: “太棒了！”他欢呼道，他熟悉而热情的声音让所有认识他的人都感到如沐春风。

examples.text: I would like to express my warmest thanks to the doctors.
examples.translation: 我想向医生们表达我最由衷的感谢。

examples.text: New members are warmly welcomed...
examples.translation: 新成员受到了热烈的欢迎。

examples.text: He greeted me warmly.
examples.translation: 他热情地向我打招呼。

examples.text: The sun had come out to warm his back...
examples.translation: 太阳出来了，把他后背晒得暖洋洋的。

examples.text: She went to warm her hands by the log fire.
examples.translation: 她把手伸向木火堆取暖。

examples.text: Those who got to know him better warmed to his openness and honesty...
examples.translation: 那些对他日渐了解的人被他的坦率和真诚所打动。

examples.text: Elizabeth warmed to her theme as the letter continued with her favourite lament.
examples.translation: 随着这封信接下来进入到伊丽莎白最喜欢抱怨的内容，她开始奔向主题。

examples.text: She went further into the room, drawn by the warmth of the fire...
examples.translation: 暖暖的炉火吸引着她继续向前走进那间屋子。

examples.text: June had brought with it the first of the summer warmth.
examples.translation: 六月带来了夏日的第一缕热气。

examples.text: The blanket will provide additional warmth and comfort in bed.
examples.translation: 毛毯能让你睡得更温暖、更舒适。

examples.text: He greeted us both with warmth and affection.
examples.translation: 他热情且友好地迎接了我们俩。

examples.text: When I had my first baby friends warned me that children were expensive...
examples.translation: 当我有了第一个孩子时，朋友们提醒我说养孩子是很花钱的。

examples.text: They warned him of the dangers of sailing alone...
examples.translation: 他们警告他说独自航行危险重重。

examples.text: Analysts warned that Europe's most powerful economy may be facing trouble...
examples.translation: 分析家警告说，欧洲最强大的经济体可能将面临困境。

examples.text: He also warned of a possible anti-Western backlash.
examples.translation: 他还警告有可能会出现对西方的强烈抵制。

examples.text: Mrs. Blount warned me not to interfere...
examples.translation: 布朗特夫人警告我不要插手。

examples.text: Children must be warned to stay away from main roads...
examples.translation: 必须警告孩子们远离交通要道。

examples.text: 'Don't do anything yet,' he warned. 'Too risky.'...
examples.translation: “暂时不要采取行动，”他警告说，“太危险。”

examples.text: 'Keep quiet, or they'll all come out,' they warned him...
examples.translation: “别作声，否则他们全都出来了，”他们警告他。

examples.text: I wish I'd listened to the people who warned me against having the operation...
examples.translation: 我真希望自己当时听从了别人的劝告，没去做手术。

examples.text: Mr Lowe warned against complacency.
examples.translation: 洛先生告诫说不能自满。

examples.text: But be warned: this is not a cheap option.
examples.translation: 但要慎重：这个选择代价不菲。

meanings.meaning: 根据；证明；正当理由；委任状

examples.text: The allegations are serious enough to warrant an investigation...
examples.translation: 这些指控很严重，有必要进行一番调查。

examples.text: No matter was too small to warrant his attention.
examples.translation: 再小的事也会引起他的注意。

examples.text: Do you think this fear is warranted?
examples.translation: 你认为有必要这样害怕吗？

examples.text: Police confirmed that they had issued a warrant for his arrest.
examples.translation: 警方证实他们已经签发了对他的拘捕令。

examples.text: ...a search warrant...
examples.translation: 搜查令

examples.text: Equipment is allocated by warrant.
examples.translation: 设备已经按照令状分配好了。

examples.text: There is some warrant for holding back on full-scale aid.
examples.translation: 有理由不进行全面援助。

examples.text: All entrants must warrant that their entry is entirely their own work...
examples.translation: 所有参赛者必须保证其参赛作品完全是自己创作的。

examples.text: The contract warrants that an experienced person is on board all the time.
examples.translation: 合同确保一位富有经验的人会一直呆在船上。

meanings.meaning: 洗涤；洗的衣服；化妆水；冲积物

examples.text: He got a job washing dishes in a pizza parlour...
examples.translation: 他在比萨店里找到一份洗盘子的工作。

examples.text: The colours gently fade each time you wash the shirt...
examples.translation: 衬衣每洗一次都会褪点色。

examples.text: It took a long time to wash the mud out of his hair...
examples.translation: 花了很长时间才把他头发上的污泥洗干净。

examples.text: Rub down the door and wash off the dust before applying the varnish.
examples.translation: 在上清漆前，要彻底打磨这扇门并把尘土清洗掉。

examples.text: That coat could do with a wash...
examples.translation: 那件外套要洗一下了。

examples.text: The treatment leaves hair glossy and lasts 10 to 16 washes.
examples.translation: 这种护理方法能使头发富有光泽，清洗10到16次都还可以保持效果。

examples.text: They looked as if they hadn't washed in days...
examples.translation: 他们看起来好像已经有好些天没洗澡了。

examples.text: She washed her face with cold water...
examples.translation: 她用凉水洗了把脸。

examples.text: You are going to have your dinner, get washed, and go to bed.
examples.translation: 你先吃晚饭，然后洗漱睡觉。

examples.text: She had a wash and changed her clothes.
examples.translation: 她洗澡后换了身衣服。

examples.text: The sea washed against the shore...
examples.translation: 海水冲刷着海岸。

examples.text: The oil washed ashore on roughly 1,000 miles of coastline...
examples.translation: 石油沿着海岸线扩散到了大约1,000英里范围的沿岸海域。

examples.text: The force of the water washed him back into the cave.
examples.translation: 大水把他冲回到洞里。

examples.text: ...the wash from large ships.
examples.translation: 大船激起的浪花

examples.text: A wave of self-consciousness can wash over her when someone new enters the room...
examples.translation: 一有陌生人进房间，她就感到极不自在。

examples.text: The overpowering despair that he'd fought so hard to keep at bay washed through the boy.
examples.translation: 一直极力压制的绝望情绪终于将男孩击垮了。

examples.text: The lights from the truck sent a wash of pale light over the snow.
examples.translation: 卡车的车灯在雪地上洒下一层淡淡的光。

examples.text: He said her policies didn't work and the excuses didn't wash...
examples.translation: 他认为她的政策没有起到效果，而且理由也不能令人信服。

examples.text: If they believe that solution would wash with the Haitian people, they are making a dramatic error.
examples.translation: 如果他们认为海地人会接受那个解决方案，那他们就大错特错了。

examples.text: This will all come out in the wash—I promise you.
examples.translation: 一切终会真相大白的——我向你保证。

examples.text: Your jeans are in the wash.
examples.translation: 你的牛仔裤还在洗着呢。

meanings.meaning: 浪费；废物；荒地；损耗；地面风化物

examples.text: There could be many reasons and he was not going to waste time speculating on them...
examples.translation: 原因可能有很多，他不打算浪费时间对此妄加猜测。

examples.text: I resolved not to waste money on a hotel...
examples.translation: 我决心不住酒店，以免浪费钱。

examples.text: The system wastes a large amount of water.
examples.translation: 这套系统浪费了大量的水。

examples.text: It is a waste of time going to the doctor with most mild complaints...
examples.translation: 一点小毛病就去看医生是浪费时间。

examples.text: I think that is a total waste of money.
examples.translation: 我认为那完全是浪费金钱。

examples.text: The packets are measured to reduce waste...
examples.translation: 包裹的大小经过测量以减少浪费。

examples.text: I hate waste.
examples.translation: 我讨厌浪费。

examples.text: Congress passed a law that regulates the disposal of waste...
examples.translation: 国会通过了一项规范废弃物处理的法律。

examples.text: Up to 10 million tonnes of toxic wastes are produced every year in the UK.
examples.translation: 英国每年会产生多达1,000万吨的有毒废弃物。

examples.text: ...the process of eliminating body waste.
examples.translation: 身体排泄物的排出过程

examples.text: Let's not waste an opportunity to see the children...
examples.translation: 咱们别错过了看孩子们的机会。

examples.text: It was a wasted opportunity.
examples.translation: 这是一个错失了的良机。

examples.text: All the well-meant, sincere advice is largely wasted on him.
examples.translation: 他对所有善意、真挚的建议基本都无动于衷。

examples.text: There was a patch of waste land behind the church...
examples.translation: 教堂的后面有一块荒地。

examples.text: Yarrow can be found growing wild in fields and on waste ground.
examples.translation: 田野里和荒地上会疯长蓍草。

examples.text: ...the barren wastes of the Sahara.
examples.translation: 贫瘠的撒哈拉沙漠

examples.text: So much of his enormous effort and talent will go to waste if we are forced to drop one hour of the film...
examples.translation: 如果我们被迫把电影缩短1小时，那么他付出的许多努力就会白费，他的才华也将大半被淹没。

examples.text: Mexican cookery is economical, she says. Nothing goes to waste.
examples.translation: “墨西哥的烹调注重俭省，”她说，“任何东西都不会浪费。”

examples.text: The war has laid waste large regions of the countryside.
examples.translation: 这场战争摧毁了大片村庄。

examples.text: ...cities laid waste by the decline of traditional industries...
examples.translation: 因传统工业衰落而没落的城市

examples.text: The aphid is now laying waste to the wheat and barley fields.
examples.translation: 蚜虫正在毁掉一片片的小麦和大麦田地。

examples.text: ...a nation that prides itself on its 'waste not, want not' thrift and its environmental conscience.
examples.translation: 为其“俭以防匮”的节俭作风和环保意识而自豪的国家

examples.text: The man was standing in his doorway watching him...
examples.translation: 那个男人站在门口盯着他看。

examples.text: He watched the barman prepare the beer he had ordered...
examples.translation: 他看着酒吧招待员备好他点的啤酒。

examples.text: Chris watched him sipping his brandy...
examples.translation: 克里斯注视着他品尝白兰地。

examples.text: I watched as Amy ate a few nuts.
examples.translation: 我看着埃米吃了几粒坚果。

examples.text: I'd stayed up late to watch the film...
examples.translation: 我熬夜看了那场电影。

examples.text: They spent a great deal of time watching television.
examples.translation: 他们很多时间都看电视了。

examples.text: Human rights groups have been closely watching the case...
examples.translation: 人权组织一直在密切关注此案。

examples.text: Annoyed commuters could only watch as the departure time ticked by.
examples.translation: 随着发车时间一点点过去，恼怒的上班族只能干瞪眼。

examples.text: Parents can't be expected to watch their children 24 hours a day.
examples.translation: 父母不可能每天24小时照看孩子。

examples.text: Ella was scared that someone was watching her...
examples.translation: 有个人一直在监视埃拉，这让她很害怕。

examples.text: I always had the feeling we were being watched.
examples.translation: 我总感觉我们被监视了。

examples.text: You really ought to watch these quiet types...
examples.translation: 你真的应该留神这些寡言少语的人。

examples.text: If you're watching the calories, don't have mayonnaise.
examples.translation: 如果你在意卡路里的摄入量，就不要吃蛋黄酱。

examples.text: I had the first watch that May evening.
examples.translation: 我第一次执行警戒任务是在那个五月的晚上。

examples.text: Jose, as usual, had climbed a tree to keep watch.
examples.translation: 乔斯像往常一样爬到树上放哨。

examples.text: US officials have been keeping close watch on the situation.
examples.translation: 美国官员一直密切注意着事态的发展。

examples.text: 'Now watch it, Patsy,' the Sergeant told her.
examples.translation: “留点神，帕齐。”中士提醒她。

examples.text: Apart from two men on watch in the engine-room, everyone was asleep.
examples.translation: 除了两个人在机房值班外，其他人都在睡觉。

examples.text: Environmentalists will be on the watch for damage to wildlife.
examples.translation: 环境保护主义者将会密切关注对野生动物造成的伤害。

examples.text: You watch. Things will get worse before they get better.
examples.translation: 看着吧，事情在好转之前会先恶化。

examples.text: ...Angel Falls, the world's highest waterfall.
examples.translation: 安赫尔瀑布，世界上最高的瀑布

meanings.meaning: 水；海水；雨水；海域，大片的水

examples.text: Get me a glass of water.
examples.translation: 给我杯水。

examples.text: ...the sound of water hammering on the metal roof.
examples.translation: 雨水敲打金属屋顶发出的声响

examples.text: ...a trio of children playing along the water's edge.
examples.translation: 3个在水边玩耍的孩子

examples.text: The ship will remain outside Chinese territorial waters.
examples.translation: 这艘船将继续呆在中国领海之外。

examples.text: ...the open waters of the Arctic Ocean.
examples.translation: 北冰洋的公共海域

examples.text: ...the man brought in to guide him through troubled waters...
examples.translation: 被请来帮助他渡过难关的人

examples.text: The British Government may be in stormy economic waters.
examples.translation: 英国政府可能陷入了动荡的经济困境中。

examples.text: He went out to water the plants.
examples.translation: 他出去给植物浇水。

examples.text: His eyes watered from cigarette smoke.
examples.translation: 他的眼睛被香烟熏得直流泪。

examples.text: ...cookies to make your mouth water.
examples.translation: 令人垂涎的饼干

examples.text: My waters broke at six in the morning and within four hours Jamie was born.
examples.translation: 我是凌晨6点破水的，不到4个小时杰米就出生了。

examples.text: He was relieved his time in jail was over and regarded it as water under the bridge.
examples.translation: 他为服刑期满而感到如释重负，而且觉得既已无可更改，过去的就让它过去吧。

examples.text: You certainly seem to be in deep water...
examples.translation: 你看起来无疑是陷入了困境。

examples.text: I could tell that we were getting off the subject and into deep water.
examples.translation: 我觉得我们在跑题并已陷入尴尬境地。

examples.text: This argument simply cannot hold water in Europe.
examples.translation: 这个论点在欧洲根本就站不住脚。

examples.text: The company has already been in hot water over high prices this year.
examples.translation: 这家公司今年由于价格过高已经陷入困境。

examples.text: City economists pour cold water on the idea that the economic recovery has begun.
examples.translation: 伦敦金融城的经济学家给经济开始复苏的说法泼了冷水。

examples.text: You should be cautious when getting involved and test the water before committing yourself.
examples.translation: 参与其中时一定要小心谨慎，表态之前最好试探一下。

examples.text: Take waterproof clothing — Orkney weather is unpredictable...
examples.translation: 带上防水的衣服吧——奥克尼的天气可是变幻莫测的。

examples.text: Designed to be completely waterproof, the lights are manufactured from heavy duty plastic.
examples.translation: 为了彻底防水，这些灯具均采用重型塑料制成。

examples.text: For staying dry you'll want nice lightweight waterproofs to wear over your leathers.
examples.translation: 为了不被淋湿，你需要在皮衣的外面套上一件轻便的防水服。

examples.text: The whole boat has been totally waterproofed...
examples.translation: 整条船全部经过防水处理。

examples.text: Waterproofed fabric pants are more expensive than plastic pants.
examples.translation: 防水纤维短裤比塑料短裤贵多了。

examples.text: Use a 3 amp fuse for equipment up to 720 watts.
examples.translation: 720 瓦以下的设备使用3安培的保险丝。

examples.text: ...a 100-watt lightbulb.
examples.translation: 100 瓦的灯泡

meanings.meaning: 波动；起伏；挥手示意；摇动；呈波形
卷（烫）发；向…挥手示意；使成波浪形
波动；波浪；高潮；挥手示意；卷曲

examples.text: Jessica caught sight of Lois and waved to her...
examples.translation: 杰茜卡看到了洛伊丝，就冲她挥手致意。

examples.text: He waved at the waiter, who rushed to the table...
examples.translation: 他冲服务员招了招手，服务员就急忙跑到桌边。

examples.text: He grinned, waved, and said, 'Hi!'...
examples.translation: 他咧嘴笑了笑，挥挥手说：“嗨！”

examples.text: Elaine turned and waved her hand lazily and left.
examples.translation: 伊莱恩转过身，懒懒地挥了一下手就走了。

examples.text: Steve stopped him with a wave of the hand...
examples.translation: 史蒂夫摆摆手让他停下来了。

examples.text: Paddy spotted Mary Ann and gave her a cheery wave.
examples.translation: 帕迪看到玛丽·安后高兴地冲她挥挥手。

examples.text: Leshka waved him away with a show of irritation...
examples.translation: 廖什克恼火地挥手让他离开。

examples.text: He waited for a policeman to stop the traffic and wave the people on...
examples.translation: 他等着警察来让车辆停下，指挥人们前行。

examples.text: He waved the servants out of the tent.
examples.translation: 他挥手让仆人们退到帐篷外。

examples.text: Hospital staff were outside to welcome him, waving flags and applauding...
examples.translation: 医院的工作人员都在外面一边挥动旗子一边鼓掌欢迎他。

examples.text: She was apt to raise her voice and wave her hands about.
examples.translation: 她经常会提高嗓门，双手胡乱挥舞。

examples.text: Hundreds of banner-waving demonstrators took to the streets.
examples.translation: 几百名挥舞着标语的游行者涌上街头。

examples.text: ...a flag-waving crowd.
examples.translation: 挥舞着旗帜的人群

examples.text: There will be marching bands and plenty of flag-waving.
examples.translation: 届时将会彩旗飘扬并伴有军乐游行。

examples.text: ...grass and flowers waving in the wind.
examples.translation: 随风摇曳的花草

examples.text: ...the sound of the waves breaking on the shore.
examples.translation: 海浪拍岸的声音

examples.text: The shock waves of the earthquake were felt in Teheran...
examples.translation: 地震带来的冲击波在德黑兰也能感觉到。

examples.text: The blast wave crushed the breath from Neil, but he survived.
examples.translation: 爆炸冲击波震得尼尔喘不过气来，不过他还是得以幸存。

examples.text: Sound waves, light waves, and radio waves have a certain frequency, or number of waves per second.
examples.translation: 声波、光波或无线电波等都有特定的频率，或者说是每秒的波数。

examples.text: She felt a wave of panic, but forced herself to leave the room calmly...
examples.translation: 她感到一阵恐慌，但还是强作镇定地离开了房间。

examples.text: A wave of sympathy for her swept Ireland...
examples.translation: 爱尔兰举国上下都同情她。

examples.text: The loneliness and grief comes in waves.
examples.translation: 孤独和悲伤不断涌上心头。

examples.text: ...the current wave of violence.
examples.translation: 目前的暴力浪潮

examples.text: ...an even newer crime wave.
examples.translation: 更新一波的犯罪风潮

examples.text: ...the shortages of bread, meat and gasoline that have hit Moscow in waves over the summer.
examples.translation: 这个夏天里莫斯科接连遭受了缺粮、少肉和汽油短缺的打击

examples.text: A wave of immigrants is washing over Western Europe.
examples.translation: 移民潮正席卷西欧。

examples.text: There were coloured candles which had spread pools of wax on the furniture...
examples.translation: 彩色蜡烛在家具上留下一摊摊蜡油。

examples.text: She loved the scent in the house of wax polish.
examples.translation: 她喜欢房子里打过蜡的味道。

examples.text: We'd have long talks while she helped me wax the floor.
examples.translation: 她帮我给地板打蜡时我们谈了很久。

examples.text: ...all those Sundays spent washing and waxing the car.
examples.translation: 那些用来洗车和给车上蜡的星期天

examples.text: She has just had her legs waxed at the local beauty parlour...
examples.translation: 她刚在当地一家美容院除了腿毛。

examples.text: She could go shopping, and wax her legs.
examples.translation: 她可以去逛商店，顺便除一下腿毛。

examples.text: He waxed lyrical about the skills and commitment of his employees...
examples.translation: 他津津乐道于员工的技能和敬业精神。

examples.text: My mother waxed eloquent on the theme of wifely duty.
examples.translation: 我母亲大谈为妻之道。

examples.text: Portugal and Spain had possessed vast empires that waxed and waned.
examples.translation: 葡萄牙和西班牙都曾是经历了兴衰的大帝国。

meanings.meaning: 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人

examples.text: We both swore we'd be friends ever after...
examples.translation: 我俩都发誓从此以后永远是朋友。

examples.text: We ordered another bottle of champagne...
examples.translation: 我们又点了一瓶香槟。

examples.text: Don't you think we should ask this young man some technical questions?...
examples.translation: 你不觉得我们应该向这位年轻人请教几个技术问题吗？

examples.text: We students outnumbered our teachers.
examples.translation: 我们学生的人数比老师多。

examples.text: We need to take care of our bodies.
examples.translation: 我们需要注意身体。

examples.text: ...the withdrawal symptoms that we all experience at the end of a long, close relationship.
examples.translation: 在一段长期的亲密感情结束时大家都会体会到的难以割舍的痛苦

examples.text: We will now consider the raw materials from which the body derives energy.
examples.translation: 现在我们来细想一下为身体提供能量的原料。

examples.text: Economic reform has brought relative wealth to peasant farmers...
examples.translation: 经济改革给农民带来了相对的财富。

examples.text: His own wealth grew.
examples.translation: 他的个人财富在增长。

examples.text: ...such a wealth of creative expertise...
examples.translation: 如此丰富的创造性专门技能

examples.text: The city boasts a wealth of beautiful churches.
examples.translation: 这座城市拥有众多美丽的教堂。

examples.text: ...a wealthy international businessman.
examples.translation: 富有的国际大亨

examples.text: ...a measure to raise income taxes on the wealthy.
examples.translation: 提高富有阶层所得税的措施

meanings.meaning: [经] 疲软的；虚弱的；无力的；不牢固的

examples.text: I was too weak to move or think or speak...
examples.translation: 我太虚弱了，无法动弹，无法思考，也无法说话。

examples.text: His arms and legs were weak.
examples.translation: 他的四肢虚弱无力。

examples.text: 'I'm all right,' Max said weakly, but his breathing came in jagged gasps...
examples.translation: “我没事，”马克斯软弱无力地说，但他的呼吸却上气不接下气。

examples.text: He weakly pressed his arms against her sides.
examples.translation: 他无力地搂着她的腰。

examples.text: Symptoms of anaemia include weakness, fatigue and iron deficiency.
examples.translation: 贫血的症状包括虚弱、疲劳和缺铁。

examples.text: Until the beating, Cantanco's eyesight had been weak, but adequate...
examples.translation: 挨打前坎坦科的视力就一直很弱，不过也还勉强看得见。

examples.text: She tired easily and had a weak heart.
examples.translation: 她很容易疲劳，心脏也不好。

examples.text: He was a nice doctor, but a weak man who wasn't going to stick his neck out...
examples.translation: 他是位为人和蔼的医生，但胆小怕事，不敢冒什么风险。

examples.text: You have been conditioned to believe that it is weak to be scared.
examples.translation: 你已经习惯性地认为害怕就是软弱。

examples.text: Many people felt that admitting to stress was a sign of weakness.
examples.translation: 许多人认为承认有压力是意志薄弱的表现。

examples.text: His weak voice was almost inaudible...
examples.translation: 他的声音微弱，几乎听不见。

examples.text: He managed a weak smile.
examples.translation: 他勉强挤出一丝笑容。

examples.text: He smiled weakly at reporters.
examples.translation: 他对着记者们勉强笑了笑。

examples.text: The owner said the bird may have escaped through a weak spot in the aviary...
examples.translation: 鸟的主人说这只鸟可能是从鸟舍一处不结实的地方逃走的。

examples.text: Swimming is helpful for bones that are porous and weak.
examples.translation: 游泳有助于改善骨质疏松和骨骼脆弱。

examples.text: The molecules in regular liquids are held together by relatively weak bonds...
examples.translation: 常规液体里分子之间的键合力相对较弱。

examples.text: Strong winds can turn boats when the tide is weak.
examples.translation: 潮水小的时候强风可以让船只改变航向。

examples.text: ...the weak winter sun.
examples.translation: 冬日清冷的太阳

examples.text: The mineral is weakly magnetic...
examples.translation: 这种矿物带有轻微的磁性。

examples.text: Down through the trees the wind whooshed weakly, like a sick child.
examples.translation: 风慵懒地吹过树木，像个病殃殃的孩子。

examples.text: The council was too weak to do anything about it.
examples.translation: 市政会手中无权，对此无能为力。

examples.text: He voiced his solidarity with the weak and defenceless.
examples.translation: 他表示自己同弱势和无助群体站在一起。

examples.text: It made me feel patronised, in a position of weakness.
examples.translation: 这让我觉得自己软弱无能，蒙人恩惠。

examples.text: The changes come after mounting criticism that the government is weak and indecisive...
examples.translation: 随着对政府软弱和优柔寡断的批评愈演愈烈，情况终于有了变化。

examples.text: The chief editorial writer also blames weak leadership for the current crisis.
examples.translation: 首席社论员也把当前的危机归咎于领导层软弱无力。

examples.text: ...the weakly-led movement for reform.
examples.translation: 领导不力的改革运动

examples.text: Officials fear that he might interpret the emphasis on diplomacy as a sign of weakness.
examples.translation: 官员们担心他会把对外交的重视理解为软弱的表现。

examples.text: The weak dollar means American goods are relative bargains for foreigners...
examples.translation: 美元疲软意味着美国的产品对外国人来说相对便宜。

examples.text: When the economy is weak, it's very hard for suppliers to raise their prices.
examples.translation: 经济疲软时供货商很难提价。

examples.text: The weakness of his regime is showing more and more...
examples.translation: 其政权不稳逐渐显现出来。

examples.text: The pound's weakness compounded the widespread gloom in the City.
examples.translation: 英镑的疲软加重了笼罩在伦敦金融区上空的惨淡愁云。

examples.text: Do you think the prosecution made any particular errors, or did they just have a weak case?...
examples.translation: 你认为公诉人犯了什么错误呢，还是根本就是证据不足？

examples.text: The claim exposed a weak point in the structure of facts upon which his argument rested...
examples.translation: 这一主张暴露了支撑他论点的论据结构的一个弱点。

examples.text: The evidence against him was weak and insufficient.
examples.translation: 指控他的证据不足且无说服力。

examples.text: The doctor weakly puts the case that the mother-to-be has many relatives, so needs less support from the hospital.
examples.translation: 那个大夫还草率认为这位准妈妈有不少亲戚，因此不需要医院过多的帮助。

examples.text: ...the strengths and weaknesses of the government's case...
examples.translation: 政府一方的优势和弱点

examples.text: The Law recognises the weakness of claims based on retrospective knowledge.
examples.translation: 法律基于追溯效力的相关规定认定索赔证据不足。

examples.text: ...a cup of weak tea...
examples.translation: 一杯淡茶

examples.text: ...a very weak bleach solution.
examples.translation: 高度稀释的漂白剂

examples.text: You may very well be asked what your weak points are. Don't try to claim you don't have any...
examples.translation: 你很可能会被问到有什么缺点。不要试图声称自己没有任何缺点。

examples.text: Geography was my weak subject...
examples.translation: 地理是我的弱项。

examples.text: His short stories tend to be weak on plot.
examples.translation: 他的短篇小说往往情节牵强。

examples.text: His only weakness is his temperament...
examples.translation: 他唯一的缺点就是他那脾气。

examples.text: There's some weakness in their teaching ability.
examples.translation: 他们的授课能力有些欠缺。

examples.text: She was a plain-looking woman with a weak chin.
examples.translation: 她相貌平平，性格懦弱。

examples.text: ...nuclear weapons.
examples.translation: 核武器

examples.text: I attack politicians with the one weapon they don't have, a sense of humor.
examples.translation: 我运用一种政客不具备的武器攻击他们，那就是幽默感。

meanings.meaning: 方法；道路；方向；行业；习惯

examples.text: Freezing isn't a bad way of preserving food...
examples.translation: 冷冻不失为一种保存食物的好方法。

examples.text: Another way of making new friends is to go to an evening class...
examples.translation: 另一种交友的办法就是去上夜校。

examples.text: I worked myself into frenzy plotting ways to make him jealous...
examples.translation: 我绞尽脑汁，处心积虑，就是为了让他嫉妒。

examples.text: I can't think of a worse way to spend my time...
examples.translation: 我想不出更糟的消磨时间的办法。

examples.text: There just might be a way...
examples.translation: 或许会有个什么办法。

examples.text: 'All right, Mrs Bates,' she said. 'We'll do it your way.'
examples.translation: “好吧，贝茨夫人，”她说，“我们就按你说的办。”

examples.text: She smiled in a friendly way...
examples.translation: 她友好地笑了笑。

examples.text: He had a strange way of talking...
examples.translation: 他说话的方式怪怪的。

examples.text: I also used to love the smooth way in which the foreigner operated.
examples.translation: 我也曾经喜欢那个老外平稳流畅的操作方式。

examples.text: Computerized reservation systems help airline profits in several ways...
examples.translation: 电子订票系统通过多种方式帮助航空公司获利。

examples.text: She was afraid in a way that was quite new to her...
examples.translation: 她感到从未有过的害怕。

examples.text: To be female is not a disability; it is just a particular way of being human.
examples.translation: 身为女性并不意味着不便;这只是人类一种特定的存在形式。

examples.text: In some ways, the official opening is a formality...
examples.translation: 从某些方面来说，正式的开幕仪式只不过是走个形式。

examples.text: She described her lover as 'perfect in every way'.
examples.translation: 她形容她的爱人“各方面完美至极”。

examples.text: He denounces people who urge him to alter his ways...
examples.translation: 他指责那些督促他改变习惯的人。

examples.text: I think you've been too long in Cornwall. You've forgotten the ways of the city...
examples.translation: 我认为你们在康沃尔呆的太久了，已经忘记了城市的生活方式。

examples.text: He said he was against returning to old authoritarian ways.
examples.translation: 他说他反对回到过去的独裁做法。

examples.text: She is now divorced and, in her usual resourceful way, has started her own business...
examples.translation: 如今她离了婚。一贯足智多谋的她已开始自己创业。

examples.text: Direct confrontation was not his way.
examples.translation: 正面冲突不是他的风格。

examples.text: I suppose that's one way of looking at it...
examples.translation: 我想那是其中的一种看法。

examples.text: With most of Dylan's lyrics, however, there are other ways of interpreting the words...
examples.translation: 但是，迪伦的大多数歌词都有其他的解读方式。

examples.text: Sometimes, the bank manager just doesn't see it your way.
examples.translation: 有时银行经理和你看问题的角度就是不一样。

examples.text: There is no indication which way the vote could go...
examples.translation: 没有迹象表明投票结果会怎样。

examples.text: The judge could have decided either way.
examples.translation: 两种结果法官怎样判都有可能。

examples.text: I'm terribly sorry — I had no idea you felt that way.
examples.translation: 我非常抱歉——没有想到你是那样想的。

examples.text: I hate the way he manipulates people...
examples.translation: 我讨厌他摆布别人。

examples.text: You may remember the way each scene ended with someone looking pensive or significant.
examples.translation: 你或许还记得，每一场的结尾要么是某人作沉思状，要么是某人故作深沉。

examples.text: She thrust her way into the crowd...
examples.translation: 她挤进了人群。

examples.text: He thought we were trying to buy our way into his company...
examples.translation: 他以为我们是想通过贿赂进入他的公司。

examples.text: Start at the bottom and try to work your way up.
examples.translation: 从底层干起，然后努力一步步升上去。

examples.text: Does anybody know the way to the bathroom?...
examples.translation: 有谁知道洗手间在哪里吗？

examples.text: I'm afraid I can't remember the way...
examples.translation: 我恐怕不记得路了。

examples.text: We're not even a third of the way there...
examples.translation: 我们才走了不到三分之一的路。

examples.text: We'll go out the back way.
examples.translation: 我们从后门出去。

examples.text: As he strode into the kitchen, he passed Pop coming the other way...
examples.translation: 他大步走进厨房，与迎面而来的爸爸擦身而过。

examples.text: They paused at the top of the stairs, doubtful as to which way to go next...
examples.translation: 他们在楼梯顶部停住了，不知道接下来该往哪边走。

examples.text: Could you look this way?
examples.translation: 请往这边看好吗？

examples.text: It's not very far out of his way...
examples.translation: 就在他走的路上不远处。

examples.text: She would say she was going my way and offer me a lift.
examples.translation: 她会说和我同路，可以载我一程。

examples.text: The men lost their way in a sandstorm and crossed the border by mistake...
examples.translation: 那些人在沙尘暴中迷了路，不小心穿越了边境。

examples.text: They've changed a lot of the old street names, and people can't find their way anymore.
examples.translation: 许多老的街道名都被改了，人们再也找不到原来的路了。

examples.text: It wasn't until we each went our separate ways that I began to learn how to do things for myself...
examples.translation: 直到大家各奔东西，我才开始学着自力更生。

examples.text: You go your way and I'll go mine.
examples.translation: 你走你的阳关道，我过我的独木桥。

examples.text: Take advantage of the opportunities coming your way in a couple of months...
examples.translation: 把握住这几个月之内你可能获得的机会。

examples.text: If I run into anything that might interest you, I'll send it your way.
examples.translation: 如果我碰上你可能感兴趣的东西，我就给你寄过去。

examples.text: 'You're standing in the way,' she said. 'Would you mind moving aside'...
examples.translation: “你挡着道了，”她说，“麻烦你让一下。”

examples.text: Get out of my way!
examples.translation: 滚开！

examples.text: Silvertown Way, was that the road?
examples.translation: 锡尔弗敦路，是这条路么？

examples.text: ...the well-trodden 250-mile Pennine Way.
examples.translation: 长250英里、人来人往的奔宁路

examples.text: If you speak standard English anywhere round our way, people tend to view you with suspicion.
examples.translation: 如果你在我们这里说标准英语，大家就会对你产生怀疑。

examples.text: ...somebody from Newcastle way.
examples.translation: 从纽卡斯尔那边来的人

examples.text: The flag was held the wrong way up by some spectators...
examples.translation: 一些观众把旗子拿倒了。

examples.text: It's important to fit it the right way round.
examples.translation: 将它安到正确位置上很重要。

examples.text: Way down in the valley to the west is the town of Freiburg...
examples.translation: 从这里往西远远的山谷中是弗赖堡镇。

examples.text: These exam results are way above average...
examples.translation: 这些考试成绩远高于平均水平。

examples.text: I have to decide my plan way in advance.
examples.translation: 我得趁早制订计划。

examples.text: The region was split three ways, between Greece, Serbia and Bulgaria...
examples.translation: 这一地区被希腊、塞尔维亚和保加利亚分成了3部分。

examples.text: Splitting the price six ways had still cost them each a bundle.
examples.translation: 即使把价钱平摊成6份，每人也还是要花一大笔钱。

examples.text: ...a simple three-way division.
examples.translation: 简单的三分法

examples.text: Some of them live in places quite a long way from here...
examples.translation: 他们中有些人住的地方离这里很远。

examples.text: A little way further down the lane we passed the driveway to a house...
examples.translation: 顺着巷子再走过去一点，我们经过车道来到一幢房子前。

examples.text: We've a fair way to go yet.
examples.translation: 我们还有一大段路要走。

examples.text: Success is still a long way off...
examples.translation: 离成功还远着呢。

examples.text: August is still an awfully long way away.
examples.translation: 离8月还早着呢。

examples.text: He had unscrewed the caps most of the way...
examples.translation: 他已经快把螺丝帽拧下来了。

examples.text: When was the last time you listened to an album all the way through?
examples.translation: 你上一次完整地听完一张专辑是什么时候？

examples.text: ...the big gabled house across the way.
examples.translation: 街对面那座带三角屋顶的大房子

examples.text: He had to walk all the way home...
examples.translation: 他不得不一路步行回家。

examples.text: That dress came all the way from New York.
examples.translation: 那条裙子是大老远从纽约送来的。

examples.text: Having started a revolution we must go all the way...
examples.translation: 既然已经发动了革命，我们就一定要进行到底。

examples.text: I'll support him all the way.
examples.translation: 我自始至终都会支持他。

examples.text: As is the way with these gatherings, the declarations were largely drafted before the delegations arrived.
examples.translation: 就像通常的这种集会一样，宣言内容在代表团到达之前就差不多拟好了。

examples.text: He's in a bad way, but able to talk.
examples.translation: 他病得很重，但还能说话。

examples.text: The man who took over a few weeks later has also helped further her career in a big way...
examples.translation: 几周后上台的那个人也帮助她把事业推进了一大步。

examples.text: Soccer in the States has never taken off in a big way.
examples.translation: 足球在美国从来就没获得过大发展。

examples.text: Countries cannot have it both ways: the cost of a cleaner environment may sometimes be fewer jobs in dirty industries...
examples.translation: 各国不可能两全其美：环境更清洁的代价有时可能就是污染企业就业岗位的减少。

examples.text: Make up your mind, you can't have it both ways.
examples.translation: 你决定吧，反正鱼与熊掌不可兼得。

examples.text: The name Latifah, by the way, means 'delicate'...
examples.translation: 顺便说一句，Latifah 这个名字意思是“娇嫩”。

examples.text: By the way, how did your seminar go?
examples.translation: 对了，你的研讨会进行得怎样？

examples.text: By way of contrast, Manchester United will travel slightly more than 1,200 miles...
examples.translation: 相比而言，曼联队的行程将略多于1,200英里。

examples.text: 'I get very superstitious about things like that,' she said by way of explanation.
examples.translation: “在那种事儿上我会很迷信，”她解释道。

examples.text: I teach psychology by way of a range of traditional lectures, practicals and tutorials.
examples.translation: 我采用传统授课与实践和指导相结合的方式教授心理学。

examples.text: The path goes under the river by way of the tunnel.
examples.translation: 这条通道经隧道从河下经过。

examples.text: What can be done to encourage convicted offenders to change their ways?
examples.translation: 怎样才能激励这些罪犯洗心革面呢？

examples.text: The talks are meant to clear the way for formal negotiations on a new constitution...
examples.translation: 会谈旨在为新宪法的正式商讨扫清道路。

examples.text: The decision could open the way for other children to sue their parents.
examples.translation: 这项判决可能会为其他孩子起诉他们的父母开辟一条通道。

examples.text: As soon as things got difficult he took the easy way out...
examples.translation: 事情刚变得有点棘手他就急忙脱身。

examples.text: It is the easy way out to blame others for our failure.
examples.translation: 把我们的失败归罪到别人头上倒是省事。

examples.text: The sea may rise or the land may fall; either way the sand dunes will be gone in a short time.
examples.translation: 可能会出现海平面上升或陆地下沉:不论发生哪种情况，沙丘都会在短时间内消失。

examples.text: ...people who genuinely believe that anarchy is the way forward...
examples.translation: 真的相信无政府主义才是未来出路的人

examples.text: Young players have got to be the way forward for every club.
examples.translation: 培养年轻球员应该是所有俱乐部谋求发展之道。

examples.text: She is very good at using her charm to get her way.
examples.translation: 她非常善于利用自己的魅力随心所欲。

examples.text: First he had been numb. Then the numbness gave way to anger...
examples.translation: 起初他只是麻木，接着转为了愤怒。

examples.text: The last houses give way to soybean fields.
examples.translation: 最后一批房子也被拆掉用作了大豆地。

meanings.meaning: 疲倦的；厌烦的；令人厌烦的

examples.text: Rachel looked pale and weary.
examples.translation: 雷切尔看起来脸色苍白，疲惫不堪。

examples.text: ...a weary traveller...
examples.translation: 疲惫不堪的旅行者

examples.text: He managed a weary smile.
examples.translation: 他勉强挤出了一丝疲倦的笑容。

examples.text: I sighed wearily...
examples.translation: 我疲倦地叹了口气。

examples.text: He trudged wearily down Arthur Street.
examples.translation: 他沿着亚瑟大街精疲力竭地跋涉。

examples.text: Despite his weariness, Brand mustered a wan smile...
examples.translation: 虽然精疲力竭，布兰德还是无力地笑了笑。

examples.text: He showed absolutely no signs of weariness.
examples.translation: 他毫无倦意。

examples.text: They're getting awfully weary of this silly war...
examples.translation: 他们越来越厌烦这场无聊的战争。

examples.text: She was weary of being alone.
examples.translation: 她厌倦了独处。

examples.text: 'I'm not Mrs Reynolds,' she said wearily...
examples.translation: “我不是雷诺兹夫人，”她不耐烦地说道。

examples.text: Measures like these sound wearily familiar.
examples.translation: 这些措施听得都让人耳朵生茧了。

examples.text: The public had wearied of his repeated warnings of a revolution that never seemed to start...
examples.translation: 他一再预警的革命迟迟没有开始，公众已对此感到厌倦。

examples.text: He had wearied of teaching in state universities...
examples.translation: 他已经厌烦了在州立大学教书。

examples.text: The political hysteria soon wearied him and he dropped the newspaper to the floor.
examples.translation: 政界的歇斯底里让他厌烦，他把报纸扔到了地板上。

examples.text: He was wearing a brown uniform...
examples.translation: 他当时穿着褐色的制服。

examples.text: I sometimes wear contact lenses...
examples.translation: 我有时戴隐形眼镜。

examples.text: She can't make her mind up what to wear.
examples.translation: 她拿不定主意穿什么。

examples.text: She wore her hair in a long braid...
examples.translation: 她梳着一根长辫子。

examples.text: He wore a full moustache.
examples.translation: 他留着浓密的八字须。

examples.text: When we drove through the gates, she wore a look of amazement...
examples.translation: 我们驶过大门时，她流露出惊讶的神情。

examples.text: Millson's face wore a satisfied expression.
examples.translation: 米尔森一脸的心满意足。

examples.text: The shop stocks an extensive range of beach wear...
examples.translation: 这家商店备有各式各样的沙滩服装。

examples.text: Bring informal casual wear.
examples.translation: 带上休闲的衣服。

examples.text: You'll get more wear out of a hat if you choose one in a neutral colour...
examples.translation: 如果你选个中性颜色的帽子，戴的时间会更多一些。

examples.text: Rugs in the bedrooms got much less wear.
examples.translation: 卧室里的小毯子用得少多了。

examples.text: ...a large, well-upholstered armchair which showed signs of wear.
examples.translation: 有磨损痕迹、配垫考究的大扶手椅

examples.text: The stone steps, dating back to 1855, are beginning to wear...
examples.translation: 那些可以追溯到1855年的石阶开始出现磨损。

examples.text: Your horse needs new shoes if the shoe has worn thin or smooth.
examples.translation: 如果马掌磨薄或磨平，就需要换新马掌了。

examples.text: Casual shoes need to wear well...
examples.translation: 休闲鞋得耐穿。

examples.text: Ten years on, the original concept was wearing well.
examples.translation: 10年过去了，原先的概念仍不过时。

examples.text: She may give the impression that she wears the trousers but it's Tim who makes the final decisions.
examples.translation: 她让人觉得是她当家，但实际上是蒂姆说了算。

examples.text: Her husband was sympathetic at first but his patience soon wore thin.
examples.translation: 一开始她丈夫还抱以同情，可不久就失去耐心了。

examples.text: Some of Wilson's eccentricities are beginning to wear thin.
examples.translation: 人们逐渐对威尔逊的古怪行为失去了兴趣。

examples.text: He arrived on January 9, disheveled and much the worse for wear.
examples.translation: 他是1月9号到的，蓬头垢面，疲惫不堪。

meanings.meaning: 经受住；使风化；侵蚀；使受风吹雨打

examples.text: The weather was bad...
examples.translation: 天气很糟。

examples.text: I like cold weather...
examples.translation: 我喜欢冷天。

examples.text: Fishing is possible in virtually any weather.
examples.translation: 几乎任何天气里都可以钓鱼。

examples.text: ...the weather conditions.
examples.translation: 天气情况

examples.text: They go out in all weathers.
examples.translation: 无论天气好坏他们都会外出。

examples.text: Unpainted wooden furniture weathers to a grey colour...
examples.translation: 没有上漆的木制家具会褪成灰色。

examples.text: This rock has been weathered and eroded.
examples.translation: 这块岩石经风吹日晒已被侵蚀。

examples.text: The facade of the building was a little weathered...
examples.translation: 楼正面有点儿斑驳。

examples.text: The man had a worn, weathered face.
examples.translation: 这个男人有张饱经沧桑的脸。

examples.text: The company has weathered the recession...
examples.translation: 这家公司从经济萧条中挺了过来。

examples.text: The government has weathered its worst political crisis.
examples.translation: 政府平安度过了其最严重的政治危机。

examples.text: Street committees keep a weather eye on the families in their district.
examples.translation: 街道委员会留意所辖区域内的家家户户。

examples.text: Some of the riders in this section made heavy weather of the cross-country race.
examples.translation: 这个环节的部分骑手夸大了这场越野比赛的困难。

examples.text: I was still feeling a bit under the weather.
examples.translation: 我仍觉得身体有些不舒服。

examples.text: They would spin and weave cloth, cook and attend to the domestic side of life...
examples.translation: 她们纺纱、织布、煮饭以及料理家务。

examples.text: In one room, young mothers weave while babies doze in their laps.
examples.translation: 在一间屋子里，年轻的母亲们在织布，而她们的孩子就在她们膝上打盹。

examples.text: ...woven cotton fabrics.
examples.translation: 棉织物

examples.text: When I studied weaving, I became intrigued with natural dyes.
examples.translation: 学习纺织激起了我对天然染料的兴趣。

examples.text: Fabrics with a close weave are ideal for painting.
examples.translation: 编织紧密的布最适合作画。

examples.text: Jenny weaves baskets from willow she grows herself.
examples.translation: 珍妮用她自己种的柳树的枝条编篮子。

examples.text: The floors are covered with woven straw mats.
examples.translation: 地板上铺着编织的草垫。

examples.text: The cars then weaved in and out of traffic at top speed...
examples.translation: 这些轿车就在车流中全速穿行。

examples.text: He weaved around the tables to where she sat with Bob...
examples.translation: 他绕过一张张桌子，走到她和鲍勃坐着的地方。

examples.text: He weaves his way through a crowd.
examples.translation: 他在人群中迂回前行。

examples.text: Jan Roberts weaves a compelling tale which traps a young woman in a world run by the Mafia.
examples.translation: 简·罗伯茨编了一个引人入胜的故事，诱骗一位年轻女性进入了黑手党的地盘。

examples.text: She weaves imaginative elements into her poems...
examples.translation: 她在诗中编织着奇思妙想。

examples.text: Bragg weaves together the histories of his main characters.
examples.translation: 布拉格把他主要人物的身世都串在一起。

examples.text: ...the spider's web in the window.
examples.translation: 窗户上的蜘蛛网

examples.text: He's forced to untangle a complex web of financial dealings...
examples.translation: 他被迫去理清一堆错综复杂的金融交易。

examples.text: They accused him of weaving a web of lies and deceit.
examples.translation: 他们指控他编织了一个满是谎言和欺诈的骗局。

examples.text: ...the complex web of life on this planet.
examples.translation: 这颗星球上复杂的生命网

examples.text: Relationships are often a tangled web at the best of times.
examples.translation: 即使在最好的情况下，关系也是错综复杂的。

examples.text: Most Britons want a traditional wedding.
examples.translation: 大多数英国人都想要传统的婚礼。

examples.text: ...a wedding present.
examples.translation: 喜礼

examples.text: ...the couple's 22nd wedding anniversary.
examples.translation: 这对夫妇的第22个结婚纪念日

meanings.meaning: 楔子；楔形物；导致分裂的东西

examples.text: I shut the shed door and wedged it with a log of wood...
examples.translation: 我关上小屋的门，并用一根木棍将门楔住。

examples.text: We slammed the gate after them, wedging it shut with planks.
examples.translation: 他们出去后，我们在后面砰地把大门关上，并用板条抵死。

examples.text: Wedge the plug into the hole...
examples.translation: 将塞子塞进洞口。

examples.text: The hotel's wedged right between the two airports.
examples.translation: 那家宾馆正好处于两个机场中间。

examples.text: I started to feel Toby was driving a wedge between us.
examples.translation: 我开始觉得托比在挑拨我们之间的关系。

examples.text: I think it's the thin end of the wedge when you have armed police permanently on patrol round a city.
examples.translation: 我觉得让武装警察永久性地在城市里巡逻是老鼠拉木锨，大头在后边。

examples.text: Come and have supper with us on Wednesday, if you're free...
examples.translation: 如果你有空的话，周三晚上来和我们一起吃晚饭吧。

examples.text: Did you happen to see her leave last Wednesday?...
examples.translation: 上周三你有没有碰巧看见她离开？

examples.text: David always collects Alistair from school on Wednesdays.
examples.translation: 戴维总是在星期三接阿利斯泰尔放学。

examples.text: ...a garden overgrown with weeds.
examples.translation: 长满杂草的园子

examples.text: Large, clogging banks of weed are the only problem.
examples.translation: 唯一的问题就是大量水草阻塞了水道。

examples.text: Caspar was weeding the garden...
examples.translation: 卡斯珀正在给花园除杂草。

examples.text: Try not to walk on the flower beds when weeding or hoeing.
examples.translation: 拔草和锄地时尽量不要踩到花坛。

examples.text: She taught me to do the weeding.
examples.translation: 她教我除草。

examples.text: Two and a half years ago I gave up the evil weed.
examples.translation: 两年半以前我改邪归正，不抽大麻了。

examples.text: I had a letter from my mother last week...
examples.translation: 上周我收到了母亲的一封信。

examples.text: This has been on my mind all week...
examples.translation: 我整个星期都在想这件事。

examples.text: I know a wonderful restaurant where we can have lunch next week.
examples.translation: 我知道一家很不错的餐厅，下周我们可以去那里吃午饭。

examples.text: Her mother stayed for another two weeks...
examples.translation: 她母亲又呆了两个星期。

examples.text: Only 12 weeks ago he underwent major heart transplant surgery...
examples.translation: 12个星期前他才刚刚接受了风险很高的心脏移植手术。

examples.text: Three million people will visit theatres in the annual six-week season.
examples.translation: 在每年为期6周的戏剧季里，会有300万人去看戏。

examples.text: It is not unusual for women to work a 40-hour week.
examples.translation: 女性一周工作40小时并不少见。

examples.text: ...workers on a three-day week.
examples.translation: 一周只工作3天的工人

examples.text: ...the hard work of looking after the children during the week...
examples.translation: 除周末外每天都要照看孩子的辛苦

examples.text: They arrived at the weekend and gave three concerts in the week.
examples.translation: 他们周末抵达，从周一到周五举办了3场音乐会。

examples.text: The deadline to publish the document is a week tomorrow...
examples.translation: 一周后的明天是公布这份文件的最后期限。

examples.text: The 800 metre final is on Monday week.
examples.translation: 800米决赛在下周一进行。

examples.text: 'That's the time you weren't well, wasn't it?' — 'Yes, that's right, that was a week ago yesterday.'
examples.translation: “就是那个时候你不舒服，没错吧？”——“是的，没错，就是一周前的昨天。”

examples.text: ...stars who appear on television week in week out.
examples.translation: 接连好几个星期都在电视上露脸的明星。

examples.text: If you want to avoid the crowds, it's best to come on a weekday...
examples.translation: 如果想避免人多，最好在周一到周五来。

examples.text: Visitor Centre and shop open 9 a.m.—5 p.m. weekdays; 10 a.m.—5 p.m. weekends.
examples.translation: 访客中心和商店的营业时间：周一至周五上午9点至下午5点，周末上午10点至下午5点。

meanings.meaning: 周末，周末休假；周末聚会

examples.text: She had agreed to have dinner with him in town the following weekend...
examples.translation: 她答应下一个周末和他在城里共进晚餐。

examples.text: He told me to give you a call over the weekend.
examples.translation: 他让我周末给你打个电话。

meanings.meaning: 每周的；周刊的；一周一次的

examples.text: Each course comprises 10-12 informal weekly meetings...
examples.translation: 每门课程都包括10至12次每周一次的非正式讨论会。

examples.text: We go and do the weekly shopping every Thursday.
examples.translation: 我们每周四去采购一次。

examples.text: ...a weekly newspaper.
examples.translation: 一份周报

examples.text: The group meets weekly.
examples.translation: 这个小组每周见一次面。

examples.text: ...a magazine published weekly since 2 January 1909.
examples.translation: 从1909年1月2日起每周发行的杂志

examples.text: In addition to my weekly wage, I got a lot of tips.
examples.translation: 除了每周的薪水外，我还能得到不少小费。

examples.text: Two of the four national daily papers are to become weeklies.
examples.translation: 4份全国性日报中有两份将改为周报。

meanings.meaning: 哭泣；流泪；哀悼；滴落；渗出液体
哭泣；流泪；悲叹；流出或渗出液体

examples.text: She wanted to laugh and weep all at once...
examples.translation: 她哭笑不得。

examples.text: The weeping family hugged and comforted each other...
examples.translation: 哭泣着的一家人相互拥抱并彼此安慰。

examples.text: She wept tears of joy.
examples.translation: 她喜极而泣.

examples.text: There are times when I sit down and have a good weep.
examples.translation: 有时候我会坐下来痛痛快快地哭一场。

examples.text: In severe cases, the skin can crack and weep.
examples.translation: 在恶劣的条件下，皮肤可能会开裂并流脓。

examples.text: ...little blisters which develop into weeping sores.
examples.translation: 会成为脓疮的小水泡

meanings.meaning: 重量为…；具有重要性；成为…的重荷；起锚

examples.text: It weighs nearly 27 kilos (about 65 pounds)...
examples.translation: 它重近27千克(约65磅)。

examples.text: This little ball of gold weighs a quarter of an ounce...
examples.translation: 这个小金球重0.25盎司。

examples.text: You always weigh less in the morning.
examples.translation: 早晨体重总是会轻一些。

examples.text: The scales can be used to weigh other items such as parcels.
examples.translation: 这台秤可以用来称包裹等其他物品。

examples.text: She weighed her options...
examples.translation: 她在各种选择间权衡斟酌。

examples.text: He is weighing the possibility of filing criminal charges against the doctor...
examples.translation: 他正在仔细考虑对那个医生提起刑事诉讼的可能性。

examples.text: She spoke very slowly, weighing what she would say.
examples.translation: 她讲话时斟酌再三，说得非常慢。

examples.text: The company will be able to weigh up the environmental pros and cons of each site...
examples.translation: 这家公司将可以权衡每处选址在环境方面的利与弊。

examples.text: You have to weigh up whether a human life is more important than an animal's life.
examples.translation: 你必须权衡人的生命是否比动物的生命更重要。

examples.text: He said the words very slowly, as if weighing each one of them.
examples.translation: 他说话非常慢，好像每个字都要仔细斟酌。

examples.text: The separation weighed on both of them...
examples.translation: 分离使他们两人都十分苦恼。

examples.text: She knows how your brother's disappearance weighs upon you.
examples.translation: 她知道你哥哥的失踪让你有多忧虑。

examples.text: Current economic hardships weigh heavily in young women's decisions to find salaried work...
examples.translation: 目前的经济困难大大影响着年轻妇女在寻找有薪水的工作时的决定。

examples.text: Human life weighed more with him than purity of policy...
examples.translation: 人类生命对他而言比政策的纯洁性更重要。

examples.text: There are many factors weighing against the meeting happening.
examples.translation: 有好多因素影响了会议的召开。

examples.text: I was too weighed down by guilt to eat the sweet.
examples.translation: 我满怀内疚，吃不下甜食。

meanings.meaning: 怪异的；不可思议的；超自然的

examples.text: That first day was weird...
examples.translation: 第一天有些怪异。

examples.text: He's different. He's weird...
examples.translation: 他与众不同，有点怪。

examples.text: Drugs can make you do all kinds of weird things...
examples.translation: 毒品可以让你做出各种各样奇怪的事情。

examples.text: It must be really weird to be rich...
examples.translation: 成为有钱人感觉一定不同寻常。

examples.text: It felt weird going back to Liverpool.
examples.translation: 回到利物浦后，感觉很奇怪。

examples.text: ...weirdly wonderful sculptures.
examples.translation: 奇妙的雕刻品

examples.text: ...difficult men who dressed weirdly.
examples.translation: 穿着怪异、难以相处的男人

examples.text: The weirdness of Hollywood suits him well.
examples.translation: 好莱坞的光怪陆离非常适合他。

meanings.meaning: 重量，重力；负担；砝码；重要性

examples.text: What is your height and weight?...
examples.translation: 你的身高和体重是多少？

examples.text: This reduced the weight of the load...
examples.translation: 这减轻了负荷的重量。

examples.text: Turkeys can reach enormous weights of up to 50 pounds.
examples.translation: 火鸡能重达50磅。

examples.text: I'm lucky really as I never put on weight...
examples.translation: 我很幸运，因为我的体重从来没有增加过。

examples.text: He lost two stone in weight during his time there.
examples.translation: 他在那儿的时候体重下降了2英石。

examples.text: His weight was harming his health...
examples.translation: 他体重过重，这有损他的健康。

examples.text: Despite the vehicle's size and weight it is not difficult to drive.
examples.translation: 尽管车子很大很重，但它一点都不难开。

examples.text: He shifted his weight from one foot to the other...
examples.translation: 他把重心从一只脚转到另一只脚上。

examples.text: He kept the weight from his left leg.
examples.translation: 他一直不让左腿受力。

examples.text: I was in the gym lifting weights.
examples.translation: 我在健身房举哑铃。

examples.text: Straining to lift heavy weights can lead to a rise in blood pressure.
examples.translation: 用力提重物会导致血压升高。

examples.text: It can be sewn into curtain hems to weight the curtain and so allow it to hang better.
examples.translation: 可以把它缝到窗帘的褶边里增加重量，使窗帘更有垂感。

examples.text: ...a computer program which weights the different transitions according to their likelihood...
examples.translation: 根据可能性的大小对不同转换进行加权处理的电脑程序

examples.text: This takes account of the number of countries in which a company wins approval for a new drug, weighted by the size of each country's market.
examples.translation: 这考虑到了允许一家公司的新药在本国上市的国家的数量，并依照每个国家的市场规模权衡其重要性。

examples.text: The scientists involved put different weight on the conclusions of different models...
examples.translation: 相关科学家对不同模型的结论给予不同的权重。

examples.text: We had this understanding that courses were roughly the same weight.
examples.translation: 我们已经了解到各门功课差不多一样重要。

examples.text: The weight of expectation was getting to them...
examples.translation: 他们逐渐感觉到了期望带来的压力。

examples.text: Companies found themselves collapsing under the weight of debts.
examples.translation: 许多公司发现自己因债台高筑而濒临倒闭。

examples.text: The fact that he is gone has given more weight to fears that he may try to launch a civil war...
examples.translation: 他已经离开这一事实让人更担心他会发动一场内战。

examples.text: Do you think, perhaps, that what happened today might lend weight to that criticism?
examples.translation: 你觉得今天发生的事情可能会使那种批评加剧吗？

examples.text: Consumers generally place more weight on negative information than on the positive when deciding what to buy.
examples.translation: 消费者在决定要买什么东西的时候往往更重视负面消息，而不是正面消息。

examples.text: ...the overwhelming weight Freud assigned parents in our development.
examples.translation: 弗洛伊德认为父母在我们的成长过程中所起到的举足轻重的作用

examples.text: The relief was indescribable. It was freedom after years of slavery. A great weight lifted from me.
examples.translation: 如释重负的感觉是难以言喻的。这是受多年奴役之后的自由。我卸下了一个重担。

examples.text: That argument no longer carries as much weight...
examples.translation: 那个论点不再具有那么大的影响力了。

examples.text: Senator Kerry carries considerable weight in Washington.
examples.translation: 参议员克里在华盛顿举足轻重。

examples.text: Any successful manager is worth his weight in gold.
examples.translation: 任何一个成功的管理者都是千金难求的。

examples.text: He accused the team of not pulling their weight.
examples.translation: 他指责这个团队没有尽到本分。

examples.text: The administration is throwing its full weight behind the UN plan.
examples.translation: 该政府正鼎力支持这项联合国计划。

examples.text: Several people came by to welcome me...
examples.translation: 有几个人过来迎接我。

examples.text: She was there to welcome him home from war...
examples.translation: 她在那儿迎接他从战场归来。

examples.text: The delegates received a welcoming speech by the President.
examples.translation: 总统致词欢迎代表们。

examples.text: There would be a fantastic welcome awaiting him back here.
examples.translation: 为了迎接他回来，这里将举行一个热烈的欢迎仪式。

examples.text: Welcome to Washington...
examples.translation: 欢迎来到华盛顿。

examples.text: Welcome back, Deborah—It's good to have you here.
examples.translation: 欢迎回来，德博拉，有你在这儿真好。

examples.text: She welcomed this move but said that overall the changes didn't go far enough...
examples.translation: 她欣然接受了这一举措，但是说总体上改变还不彻底。

examples.text: In Germany, the move was welcomed by the Bundesbank president.
examples.translation: 在德国，联邦银行行长欣然接受了这项措施。

examples.text: Environmental groups have given a guarded welcome to the Prime Minister's proposal.
examples.translation: 环保组织对首相的提议表示谨慎的欢迎。

examples.text: This was certainly a welcome change of fortune...
examples.translation: 这确实是命运中一个令人欣喜的转变。

examples.text: The new 25 metre pool for more serious swimmers is a welcome addition...
examples.translation: 为更高水平的游泳爱好者新建的25米长的游泳池受到了大家的欢迎。

examples.text: Any progress in reducing chemical weapons is welcome.
examples.translation: 削减化学武器的任何进展都是受人欢迎的。

examples.text: We welcome you to join us on a special tour which explores this unique Australian attraction...
examples.translation: 我们欢迎你加入探索这处独特的澳大利亚景观的特别之旅。

examples.text: We would welcome your views about the survey.
examples.translation: 我们欢迎你就这项调查发表意见。

examples.text: New members are always welcome...
examples.translation: 随时欢迎新成员加入。

examples.text: I told him he wasn't welcome in my home.
examples.translation: 我告诉他我家不欢迎他。

examples.text: You are welcome to visit the hospital at any time.
examples.translation: 你可以随时来医院。

examples.text: ...a conservatory which guests are welcome to use.
examples.translation: 客人们可随意使用的温室

examples.text: If women want to take on the business world they are welcome to it as far as I'm concerned.
examples.translation: 就我而言，如果女人们想进军商界的话，就让她们去好了。

examples.text: After the kindness that had been shown to him, he didn't want to outstay his welcome.
examples.translation: 在受到热情款待后，他决定离开以免过多打搅主人。

examples.text: 'Thank you for the information.' — 'You're welcome.'
examples.translation: “谢谢你提供的信息。”——“ 不客气。”

examples.text: It's possible to weld stainless steel to ordinary steel...
examples.translation: 不锈钢是有可能和普通钢焊接在一起的。

examples.text: They will also be used on factory floors to weld things together...
examples.translation: 它们也可用于工厂车间，用来焊接物体。

examples.text: Where did you learn to weld?
examples.translation: 你在哪儿学会的焊接技术？

examples.text: All the welding had been done from inside the car...
examples.translation: 所有的焊接都在车内完成。

examples.text: ...welding equipment.
examples.translation: 焊接设备

examples.text: She has both the authority and the personality to weld the party together...
examples.translation: 团结全党所需的权威和个人魅力她两者兼具。

examples.text: The miracle was that Rose had welded them into a team.
examples.translation: 令人称叹的是罗斯把他们打造成了一个团队。

meanings.meaning: 福利；幸福；福利事业；安宁
福利的；接受社会救济的

examples.text: I do not think he is considering Emma's welfare...
examples.translation: 我认为他没有考虑到埃玛的幸福。

examples.text: He was the head of a charity for the welfare of children.
examples.translation: 他是一个儿童福利慈善机构的负责人。

examples.text: Child welfare services are well established and comprehensive...
examples.translation: 儿童福利机构发展成熟，体系完善。

examples.text: He has urged complete reform of the welfare system.
examples.translation: 他极力主张对福利制度进行彻底改革。

examples.text: States such as Michigan and Massachusetts are making deep cuts in welfare...
examples.translation: 诸如密歇根和马萨诸塞等州正在大幅削减社会保障金。

examples.text: If she does find a job through the training program she may have less money than now when she's on welfare.
examples.translation: 如果她在培训后真的找到份工作，那她的收入可能还不如她现在领的社会保障金多。

meanings.meaning: 著名的；众所周知的；清楚明白的

examples.text: He surrounds himself with attractive, intelligent, or well-known people...
examples.translation: 他混迹于有魅力、有学问或有名气的人当中。

examples.text: He is well-known to the local police...
examples.translation: 当地警察都知道他。

examples.text: Hubbard was well known for his work in the field of drug rehabilitation.
examples.translation: 哈伯德因在戒毒康复领域所做的工作而为人所熟知。

examples.text: It may be a well-known fact, but I didn't know it...
examples.translation: 这可能是人所共知的事实，但我却不知道。

examples.text: It is well known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
examples.translation: 竹笋是熊猫的主要食物，这是人所共知的。

meanings.meaning: 很好地；充分地；满意地；适当地

examples.text: Sylvia shook hands. 'Well, you go get yourselves some breakfast.'...
examples.translation: 西尔维娅摆了摆手说：“嗯，你们自己去吃些早餐吧。”

examples.text: Well, I don't like the look of that.
examples.translation: 唔，我不喜欢事情看起来的样子。

examples.text: You can lose your perspective. You know, get paranoid? Well, that's something I really try and avoid...
examples.translation: 你会失去自己的判断力。知道吗，就是变得疑神疑鬼？这正是我努力想避免的。

examples.text: The trouble with City is that they do not have enough quality players. Well, that can easily be rectified.
examples.translation: 曼城队的难题在于他们缺乏优秀球员。不过，这种情况很容易改变。

examples.text: Thank you Lionel, for singing that for us. Well, we'd better tell you what's on the show between nine and midnight...
examples.translation: 谢谢你的歌声，莱昂内尔。好了，我们来看看从9点到午夜都播出什么节目。

examples.text: Well, let's press on.
examples.translation: 好了，让我们继续努力。

examples.text: 'I'm sure you will be an asset,' she finally added. 'Well, I see it's just about time for lunch.'...
examples.translation: “我相信你会是一个有用的人才，”她最后加上一句，“好了，我看该吃午饭了。”

examples.text: Well, thank you for speaking with us.
examples.translation: 好吧，谢谢你和我们谈话。

examples.text: Well, maybe it would be easier to start with a smaller problem...
examples.translation: 那么，也许从小问题入手会更容易些。

examples.text: Well, let's wait and see...
examples.translation: 那么，让我们等着看吧。

examples.text: Well, I thought she was a bit unfair about me.
examples.translation: 嗯，我觉得她对我有点不公平。

examples.text: Look, I'm really sorry I woke you, and, well, I just wanted to tell you I was all right.
examples.translation: 听我说，我真抱歉吵醒你，嗯，我只是想告诉你我一切都好。

examples.text: The comet is going to come back in 2061 and we are all going to be able to see it. Well, our offspring are, anyway...
examples.translation: 彗星将在2061年返回，到时我们都看得到。噢，反正我们的子孙看得到。

examples.text: There was a note. Well, not really a note.
examples.translation: 那儿有张便条，噢，其实不算是便条。

examples.text: 'But finance is far more serious.' — 'Well I don't know really.'
examples.translation: “但是财政更加困难了。”——“是吗，我真不知道。”

examples.text: 'Go on, Dennis.' — 'Well, if you're sure.'
examples.translation: “继续啊，丹尼斯。”——“哦，如果你确定的话。”

examples.text: 'Imelda,' said Mrs Kennerly. 'That's my name, Tom.' — 'Well,' said Tom. 'Imelda. I never knew.'...
examples.translation: “伊梅尔达，”肯纳利夫人说道，“这是我的名字，汤姆。”——“哦，”汤姆说道，“伊梅尔达，我以前从来不知道。”

examples.text: Well, honestly! They're like an old married couple at times.
examples.translation: 哦，天哪！他们有时看起来真像一对老夫老妻。

examples.text: 'Well?' asked Barry, 'what does it tell us?'...
examples.translation: “嗯？”巴里问道，“它到底告诉我们什么？”

examples.text: 'Well, why don't you ask me?' he said finally.
examples.translation: “嗯，那你为什么不问我呢？”他最后问道。

examples.text: Well, well, well, look at you. Ethel, look at this little fat girl...
examples.translation: 哟，哟，看看你啊，埃塞尔，看看这个小胖姑娘啊。

examples.text: Bob peered at it. 'Well, well!' he said, 'I haven't seen Spam since the war!' and laughed.
examples.translation: 鲍勃仔细瞧了一眼，说道：“哇，哇！自从战后我就再也没见过午餐肉了！”然后笑了起来。

examples.text: Oh well, it could be worse...
examples.translation: 哎，算了，可能会更糟糕的。

examples.text: 'I called her and she said no.' — 'Oh well.'
examples.translation: “我打电话给她了，但她拒绝了。”——“唉，那就这样吧。”

examples.text: All the Indian batsmen played well...
examples.translation: 所有印度击球手都打得不错。

examples.text: He speaks English better than I do...
examples.translation: 他的英语说得比我好。

examples.text: It is a formula that worked very well indeed...
examples.translation: 这的确是一套很管用的方案。

examples.text: I don't really know her very well.
examples.translation: 我其实不太了解她。

examples.text: Mix all the ingredients well...
examples.translation: 把所有原料搅拌均匀。

examples.text: Wash your hands well with soap.
examples.translation: 用肥皂把手好好洗洗。

examples.text: 'He speaks well of you.' — 'I'm glad to hear that.'...
examples.translation: “他对你评价很高。”——“真高兴听到这个。”

examples.text: It might help people think better of him.
examples.translation: 这可能会让人们对他的印象好点。

examples.text: Helen is a very well-known novelist in Australia...
examples.translation: 海伦是澳大利亚非常著名的小说家。

examples.text: People live longer nowadays, and they are better educated...
examples.translation: 当今，人们越来越长寿，受教育程度也提高了。

examples.text: British nurses were among the best trained in Europe.
examples.translation: 英国护士位居欧洲最训练有素的护士之列。

examples.text: How well do you remember your mother, Franzi?...
examples.translation: 关于你妈妈你还记得多少，弗兰齐？

examples.text: This new career doesn't pay nearly as well as the old one...
examples.translation: 这份新工作的薪水还不如原来那份多。

examples.text: Their captain said his team had played as well as it possibly could...
examples.translation: 队长说他们队发挥出了最佳水平。

examples.text: He wasn't dressed any better than me.
examples.translation: 他穿得也比我好不了哪去。

examples.text: Franklin did not turn up until well after midnight...
examples.translation: 富兰克林直到午夜过后很久才出现。

examples.text: We often plan our meals well in advance...
examples.translation: 我们经常很早就计划好要吃什么。

examples.text: They had remained silent until they were well away from the house...
examples.translation: 他们直到离那所房子很远后才开口说话。

examples.text: There are well over a million Muslims in Britain.
examples.translation: 英国的穆斯林远远超过了一百万。

examples.text: She has a close group of friends who are very well aware of what she has suffered...
examples.translation: 她有一群十分了解其遭遇的密友。

examples.text: Men are generally better able to express anger...
examples.translation: 男人通常能更好地表达愤怒。

examples.text: The show is well worth a visit.
examples.translation: 这个展览很值得一看。

examples.text: It was about the only time I got up the field in the whole game so I was well happy with my goal...
examples.translation: 这是我在整场比赛中唯一一次上场，所以我对自己的进球非常开心。

examples.text: I was well pissed off about it at the time.
examples.translation: 当时我对这件事特别生气。

examples.text: You know perfectly well I can't be blamed for the failure of that mission...
examples.translation: 你很清楚那次任务的失败不该怪我。

examples.text: I'd got myself into this marriage and I jolly well had to get myself out of it.
examples.translation: 是我让自己陷入到这场婚姻中，我也一定要让自己从其中脱身。

examples.text: The murderer may well come from the estate...
examples.translation: 凶手很可能来自那个庄园。

examples.text: Ours could well be the last generation for which moviegoing has a sense of magic.
examples.translation: 我们这一代很可能是认为到电影院观影具有一种魔力的最后一代人了。

examples.text: It is most often diagnosed in women in their thirties and forties, although I've seen it in many younger women, as well...
examples.translation: 这种病一般多发于三四十岁的女性，但我也见过许多更年轻的女性患这种病。

examples.text: 'What do you like about it then?' — 'Erm, the history, the shops—people are quite friendly as well.'
examples.translation: “那么你喜欢这儿的什么？”——“嗯，它的历史啦，商店啦，还有这儿的人也都很友好。”

examples.text: Andy's face paled with disappointment; perhaps with anger as well.
examples.translation: 安迪的脸色由于失望而变得苍白，也许还掺杂着气愤。

examples.text: She published historical novels, as well as a non-fiction study of women in the British Empire...
examples.translation: 她出版了许多历史小说和一部有关英帝国女性的纪实性研究著作。

examples.text: It is in his best interests as well as yours...
examples.translation: 这符合他的最大利益，同时也符合你的利益。

examples.text: Wearing the right shoes and clothes as well as being fit can make all the difference...
examples.translation: 穿着合适的鞋子和衣服，再加上健康的体魄，情况会大不相同。

examples.text: As well as a good academic record I look for people who've climbed mountains or been captain of a team.
examples.translation: 除了优秀的学业成绩之外，我要找的人还需要有登山经验或担任过球队队长。

examples.text: This caused a few gasps, as well it might...
examples.translation: 这毫不奇怪地引得一些人倒吸凉气。

examples.text: You can see he's terrified, as well he might be after what we've been through.
examples.translation: 你能看出他被吓着了，考虑到我们经历过的事情，这种反应很正常。

examples.text: Blue asbestos is far less common in buildings, which is just as well because it's more dangerous than white asbestos...
examples.translation: 蓝石棉在建筑中很不常见，这倒是一件幸事，因为它比白石棉危险得多。

examples.text: Judging from everything you've said, it was just as well she wasn't there.
examples.translation: 从你所说的这一切来看，幸好她不在那儿。

examples.text: It is as well to bear in mind that laughter is a great releaser of tension.
examples.translation: 你最好记住大笑是消除紧张情绪的良方。

examples.text: He would do well to remember that, sooner or later, everyone's luck runs out...
examples.translation: 他可别忘了任何人的运气早晚都会用完的。

examples.text: Investors would do well to take a look at the Swiss economy.
examples.translation: 投资者应该关注一下瑞士的经济。

examples.text: The couple might as well have been strangers...
examples.translation: 这对夫妇形同陌路。

examples.text: We might just as well be in prison for all the quality our lives have at present.
examples.translation: 我们现在的生活状况跟蹲监狱差不了多少。

examples.text: If I've got to go somewhere I may as well go to Birmingham...
examples.translation: 如果要去什么地方，那就去伯明翰吧。

examples.text: Anyway, you're here; you might as well stay...
examples.translation: 反正你已经在这儿了，那就留下来吧。

examples.text: I'll come with you if you like. I might as well.
examples.translation: 如果你想的话，我会和你在一起来。我无所谓。
