examples.text: She was sincere and genuine in her wish to make amends for the past...
examples.translation: 她真诚地希望弥补从前的过失。

examples.text: Clearly she had no wish for conversation...
examples.translation: 她显然无意谈话。

examples.text: She wanted to go everywhere in the world. She soon got her wish...
examples.translation: 她想走遍世界，很快便如愿以偿。

examples.text: The decision was made against the wishes of the party leader.
examples.translation: 这个决定违背了该党领导人的意愿。

examples.text: If you wish to go away for the weekend, our office will be delighted to make hotel reservations...
examples.translation: 如果您想外出度周末，我们办事处将很乐意为您预订旅馆。

examples.text: We can dress as we wish now...
examples.translation: 我们现在着装可以随心所欲。

examples.text: There were the collaborators, who wished for a German victory.
examples.translation: 有通敌者希望德国获胜。

examples.text: I don't wish to sound callous, but I am glad I wasn't here...
examples.translation: 我不想让自己的话听上去麻木不仁，但我真的很庆幸我当时没在这儿。

examples.text: Without wishing to be unkind, she's not the most interesting company.
examples.translation: 我不想那么刻薄，不过她并不是非常有情趣的伴侣。

examples.text: I wish I could do that...
examples.translation: 我希望我能做那件事。

examples.text: I wish it weren't true...
examples.translation: 但愿这不是真的。

examples.text: Pa, I wish you wouldn't shout...
examples.translation: 爸，我希望你不要嚷嚷了。

examples.text: The world is not always what we wish it to be.
examples.translation: 世界并不总是如我们所愿。

examples.text: We have all wished for men who are more considerate...
examples.translation: 我们都曾祈求能找到更加体贴的男人。

examples.text: A philosopher once said, 'Be careful what you wish for; you might get it.'
examples.translation: 一位哲学家曾说过：“别轻易许愿——你可能会如愿以偿。”

examples.text: Blow out the candles and make a wish.
examples.translation: 吹蜡烛许愿吧。

examples.text: I really could not have wished for a better teacher...
examples.translation: 这个老师对我来说是再好不过的了。

examples.text: Who could wish for a better opportunity?
examples.translation: 谁还会企求能得到比这更好的机会呢？

examples.text: It's a horrid experience and I wouldn't wish it on my worst enemy.
examples.translation: 这种经历太痛苦了，我甚至都不希望它发生在死对头身上。

examples.text: I wish you both a very good journey...
examples.translation: 我祝愿你们两人旅途愉快。

examples.text: Goodbye, Hanu. I wish you well.
examples.translation: 再见，哈努，祝你顺心如意。

examples.text: I found George's story very sad. Please give him my best wishes...
examples.translation: 我觉得乔治的经历很悲惨，请向他转达我最诚挚的祝福。

examples.text: Western leaders sent good wishes to the new American president.
examples.translation: 西方领导人向新任美国总统致以良好的祝愿。

examples.text: Cain is now in full damage control mode and calling this a witch hunt.

In addition to the uses shown below, with is used after some verbs, nouns and adjectives in order to introduce extra information. With is also used in most reciprocal verbs, such as 'agree' or 'fight', and in some phrasal verbs, such as 'deal with' and 'dispense with'.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，with 还用于一些动词、名词和形容词后引出附加信息，也用于 agree, fight 之类的相互动词后，及 deal with, dispense with 等短语动词中。

examples.text: She is currently staying with her father at his home.
examples.translation: 她现在陪父亲呆在家里。

examples.text: Serve hot, with pasta or rice and French beans...
examples.translation: 趁热和意大利面或米饭以及四季豆一起端上桌。

examples.text: Cookies are just the thing to serve with tall glasses of real lemonade.
examples.translation: 曲奇就应该搭配高脚杯的天然柠檬汁一起享用。

examples.text: Parents will be able to discuss their child's progress with their teacher...
examples.translation: 家长将可以和老师交流谈论子女的进步情况。

examples.text: He walked with her to the front door.
examples.translation: 他陪她走到前门。

examples.text: About a thousand students fought with riot police in the capital...
examples.translation: 大约1,000名学生在首都与防暴警察发生了冲突。

examples.text: He was in an argument with his landlord downstairs.
examples.translation: 他与楼下的房东发生了争执。

examples.text: Remove the meat with a fork and divide it among four plates...
examples.translation: 用餐叉把肉叉走，分到4个盘里。

examples.text: Pack the fruits and nuts into the jars and cover with brandy...
examples.translation: 把水果和坚果放进罐子里，用白兰地酒浸泡。

examples.text: Doctors are treating him with the drug AZT.
examples.translation: 医生在用齐多夫定药物对他进行治疗。

examples.text: A man came round with a tray of chocolates...
examples.translation: 一名男子端着一托盘巧克力走过来。

examples.text: A young woman came in with a cup of coffee.
examples.translation: 一名年轻女子端着一杯咖啡走进来。

examples.text: He was in his early forties, tall and blond with bright blue eyes...
examples.translation: 他40出头儿，高高的个子，金黄头发，一双天蓝色眼睛。

examples.text: Someone with an income of $34,895 can afford this loan.
examples.translation: 一个收入为34,895美元的人能负担得起这笔贷款。

examples.text: I spent a week in bed with flu.
examples.translation: 我得了流感，一星期都卧病在床。

examples.text: His legs were caked with dried mud...
examples.translation: 他腿上结着干泥巴。

examples.text: They sat at a Formica table cluttered with dirty tea cups.
examples.translation: 他们坐在铺有福米加塑料贴面的餐桌前，桌上凌乱地堆着用过的茶杯。

examples.text: ...rivers teeming with salmon and trout.
examples.translation: 盛产鲑鱼和鳟鱼的河流

examples.text: He was still a little angry with her...
examples.translation: 他还有点儿生她的气。

examples.text: After sixteen years of marriage they have grown bored with each other...
examples.translation: 结婚16年后，他们已经渐渐彼此厌倦了。

examples.text: I am happy with that decision.
examples.translation: 我对那个决定很满意。

examples.text: Our aim is to allow student teachers to become familiar with the classroom...
examples.translation: 我们的目标就是让实习教师熟悉课堂。

examples.text: He still has a serious problem with money...
examples.translation: 他手头儿还是很紧。

examples.text: Depression lowers the human ability to cope with disease.
examples.translation: 抑郁症会降低人体对疾病的抵抗力。

examples.text: ...teaching her to read music with skill and sensitivity...
examples.translation: 教她熟练而敏锐地识乐谱

examples.text: He agreed, but with reluctance.
examples.translation: 他同意了，但很勉强。

examples.text: With a sigh, she leant back and closed her eyes...
examples.translation: 她叹了口气，身体向后倚靠，闭上了眼睛。

examples.text: The front door closed with a crash behind him...
examples.translation: 前门在他身后砰的一声关上了。

examples.text: Her eyes stared into his with an expression of absolute honesty.
examples.translation: 她凝视着他的眼睛，一脸诚恳。

examples.text: Gil was white and trembling with anger...
examples.translation: 吉尔气得脸色煞白，浑身发抖。

examples.text: I felt sick to my stomach with sadness for them...
examples.translation: 我为他们感到十分痛心。

examples.text: His father's body was hot with fever.
examples.translation: 他父亲烧得浑身发烫。

examples.text: Joanne stood with her hands on the sink, staring out the window...
examples.translation: 乔安妮站着，两手放在水槽上，眼睛定定地望着窗外。

examples.text: Michelle had fallen asleep with her head against his shoulder...
examples.translation: 米歇尔睡着了，头靠在他的肩上。

examples.text: She walked back to the bus stop, with him following her.
examples.translation: 她走回公交车站，他跟在她身后。

examples.text: With all the night school courses available, there is no excuse for not getting some sort of training...
examples.translation: 夜校课程一应俱全，没理由不去接受一些培训。

examples.text: With the win, the US reclaimed the cup for the first time since 1985.
examples.translation: 这次胜利使美国队自1985年后第一次重获此杯。

examples.text: We're not like them. It's different with us...
examples.translation: 我们和他们不一样,我们不那么做。

examples.text: Sometimes I'm busy and sometimes I'm not. It's the same with most jobs.
examples.translation: 我时忙时闲，大多数工作都是如此。

examples.text: The risk of developing heart disease increases with the number of cigarettes smoked...
examples.translation: 吸食香烟的数量越多，患心脏病的风险就越大。

examples.text: Blood pressure decreases with exercise.
examples.translation: 血压随着锻炼而降低。

examples.text: ...a piece of driftwood carried down with the current...
examples.translation: 顺流而下的一块浮木

examples.text: We left him there to float off with the tide, and told him to follow the coast.
examples.translation: 我们把他放在那里，让他随波漂流，并且告诉他要沿着海岸线走。

examples.text: Yes, I know who you mean. Yes, now I'm with you...
examples.translation: 是的，我知道你说的是谁。是的，我现在明白你的意思了。

examples.text: I'm not with you. Tell me what you mean.
examples.translation: 我不明白你说的话，告诉我你是什么意思。

examples.text: 'I'm with you all the way.' — 'Thank you.'
examples.translation: “我会一直支持你。”——“谢谢！”

examples.text: He reached into his pocket and withdrew a sheet of notepaper...
examples.translation: 他把手伸进口袋，掏出一张便签。

examples.text: Cassandra withdrew her hand from Roger's.
examples.translation: 卡桑德拉将手从罗杰手里抽了回来。

examples.text: He stated that all foreign forces would withdraw as soon as the crisis ended...
examples.translation: 他声明危机一结束，所有外国军队都将撤离。

examples.text: Unless Hitler withdrew his troops from Poland by 11 o'clock that morning, a state of war would exist between Great Britain and Germany...
examples.translation: 如果希特勒那天上午11点前不从波兰撤兵，英德两国便将处于战争状态。

examples.text: Troops withdrew from the north east of the country last March.
examples.translation: 军队去年3月从该国东北部撤出。

examples.text: Open a savings account that does not charge ridiculous fees to withdraw money...
examples.translation: 开一个取款时不会乱收费的储蓄账户。

examples.text: They withdrew 100 dollars from a bank account after checking out of their hotel.
examples.translation: 他们在旅馆结账后，从银行账户中取了100美元。

examples.text: He and the others withdrew to their rented rooms...
examples.translation: 他和其他人回到了他们租住的房间。

examples.text: He poured the wine and then withdrew again...
examples.translation: 他斟完酒，然后就又退下了。

examples.text: Kenworthy withdrew into his bedroom, washed and shaved.
examples.translation: 肯沃西回到自己卧室，洗脸，刮胡子。

examples.text: The African National Congress threatened to withdraw from the talks.
examples.translation: 非洲国民大会威胁要退出会谈。

examples.text: He withdrew his remarks and explained what he had meant to say.
examples.translation: 他收回所说的话，然后又解释他本来想说什么。

examples.text: Boulding was known for his biting wit...
examples.translation: 博尔丁爱说尖酸的俏皮话是出了名的。

examples.text: They love her practical attitude to life, her zest and wit.
examples.translation: 他们喜欢她务实的人生态度、她的热情和幽默。

examples.text: Holmes was gregarious, a great wit, a man of wide interests.
examples.translation: 福尔摩斯爱交际,非常风趣，兴趣广泛。

examples.text: The information is there and waiting to be accessed by anyone with the wit to use it.
examples.translation: 资料就摆在那儿，等着有头脑的人去利用。

examples.text: She has used her wits to progress to the position she holds today.
examples.translation: 她凭借个人才智升到了今天的职位。

examples.text: You scared us out of our wits. We heard you had an accident.
examples.translation: 你把我们吓坏了，我们听说你出事了。

examples.text: ...a huge bass drum which frightened the wits out of the organist each time it was banged.
examples.translation: 每次敲起来都让风琴师惊慌失措的巨型低音鼓

examples.text: Travellers need to keep their wits about them.
examples.translation: 旅行者需要随机应变。

examples.text: We row a lot and we never have time on our own. I'm at my wit's end.
examples.translation: 我们经常争吵，从无在一起的时间，我真是没有办法了。

examples.text: He has to pit his wits against an adversary who is cool, clever and cunning.
examples.translation: 他不得不与一个冷静、聪明而又狡猾的对手斗智。

examples.text: He'd like 'happiness' to be given a new and more scientifically descriptive label, to wit 'Major affective disorder, pleasant type'.
examples.translation: 他想给“幸福”一个更为科学的新称谓，准确地说即“愉悦型重度情感障碍”。

examples.text: Police withheld the dead boy's name yesterday until relatives could be told...
examples.translation: 警方昨天拒绝在通知亲属前透露死亡男孩的姓名。

examples.text: Financial aid for Britain has been withheld...
examples.translation: 向英国提供的经济援助已经被扣。

examples.text: The captain decided to withhold the terrible news even from his officers.
examples.translation: 船长决定哪怕是对高级船员也要封锁这个可怕的消息。

examples.text: The withholding of property from the market may cause prices to be higher than normal.
examples.translation: 捂盘可能导致房价过高。

examples.text: Serotonin syndrome often resolves within 24 hours of stopping any medication that increases serotonin.

meanings.meaning: 户外；在外面；没有或不显示某事物

examples.text: In addition to the uses shown below, without is used in the phrasal verbs ‘do without’, ‘go without’, and ‘reckon without’.
examples.translation: 除下列用法外，without 还可用于 do without, go without 和 reckon without 等短语动词中。

examples.text: She wore a brown shirt pressed without a wrinkle.
examples.translation: 她穿着一件熨烫得没有一点儿褶儿的棕色衬衫。

examples.text: ...a meal without barbecue sauce.
examples.translation: 没有烧烤酱的一顿饭

examples.text: He was offered a generous pension provided he left without a fuss...
examples.translation: 他如果一声不吭地离开，就会获得一笔丰厚的养老金。

examples.text: They worked without a break until about eight in the evening...
examples.translation: 他们一刻不停地干到晚上8点钟左右。

examples.text: Alex had done this without consulting her.
examples.translation: 亚历克斯这么做事先并没有跟她商量。

examples.text: Janet Magnusson watched his approach without enthusiasm...
examples.translation: 珍妮特·马格努森冷冷地看着他走过来。

examples.text: 'Hello, Swanson,' he said without surprise.
examples.translation: “你好，斯旺森。”他说话的时候并未显得惊讶。

examples.text: I told Franklin he would have to start dinner without me...
examples.translation: 我告诉富兰克林吃晚饭不必等我。

examples.text: How can I rebuild my life without my husband?...
examples.translation: 失去丈夫后我怎么才能重新开始生活？

examples.text: We would never go anywhere without you.
examples.translation: 没有你我们会一事无成。

examples.text: Witnesses to the crash say they saw an explosion just before the disaster...
examples.translation: 空难目击者称，就在灾难发生之前他们看见飞机发生了爆炸。

examples.text: No witnesses have come forward.
examples.translation: 没有目击证人站出来。

examples.text: Anyone who witnessed the attack should call the police...
examples.translation: 目睹这次袭击的人都应向警方报告。

examples.text: It was the quickest swimming lesson I'd ever witnessed.
examples.translation: 这是我所见过的最速成的游泳课。

examples.text: In the next three or four days, eleven witnesses will be called to testify.
examples.translation: 接下来的三四天里，将传唤11名证人出庭作证。

examples.text: Ask a friend to witness your signature.
examples.translation: 请一位朋友给你的签名作证。

examples.text: India has witnessed many political changes in recent years...
examples.translation: 印度近年来经历了很多政治变动。

examples.text: The year 1886 witnessed the first extended translation into English of the writings of Eliphas Levi...
examples.translation: 1886年，埃利法斯·莱维的作品第一次有了长篇英译本。

examples.text: At present, we are witnessing another building boom.
examples.translation: 当前，我们又一次处于建筑繁荣期。

examples.text: Americans are a generous people: witness the increase in charitable giving, even during the recession.
examples.translation: 美国人是个慷慨的民族：即使是在经济萧条时期，慈善捐赠也在不断增加，这便是明证。

examples.text: Too often children are witness to a disturbing amount of violence.
examples.translation: 孩子们经常会目睹暴力事件,其数量之多令人不安。

examples.text: Many of these poems bear witness to his years spent in India and China...
examples.translation: 这些诗中有很多见证了他在印度和中国度过的岁月。

examples.text: Many veterans believe it is their job to bear witness to the horrors of war that they personally experienced.
examples.translation: 很多老兵认为他们有职责为他们亲身经历的战争的恐怖作证。

examples.text: ...armoured vehicles designed to withstand chemical attack...
examples.translation: 具有抵御化学武器袭击的设计功能的装甲车

examples.text: Exercise really can help you withstand stresses and strains more easily.
examples.translation: 锻炼真的能帮助你更轻松地应对压力和紧张情绪。

meanings.meaning: (Wolf)人名；(以、捷、芬、瑞典、德、匈、法、罗、荷、英)沃尔夫

examples.text: I was back in the changing room wolfing tea and sandwiches.
examples.translation: 我回到更衣室，狼吞虎咽地喝茶、吃三明治。

examples.text: He wolfed down the rest of the biscuit and cheese...
examples.translation: 他把剩下的饼干和奶酪一扫而光。

examples.text: She bought a hot dog from a stand on a street corner and wolfed it down.
examples.translation: 他从街角小摊上买了一个热狗，大口地吃了下去。

examples.text: A lot of the lads took small jobs to help keep the wolf from the door.
examples.translation: 很多少年打零工帮补家里维持生计。

examples.text: I wondered what that noise was...
examples.translation: 我纳闷儿那是什么声音。

examples.text: 'He claims to be her father,' said Max. 'We've been wondering about him.'...
examples.translation: “他自称是她父亲，”马克斯说，“我们一直都在怀疑他。”

examples.text: It makes you wonder about the effect on men's behaviour...
examples.translation: 这让人怀疑其对男性行为的影响。

examples.text: 'Why does she want to get in there?' Pete wondered...
examples.translation: “她为什么想进那里面？”皮特心想。

examples.text: But there was something else, too. Not hard evidence, but it made me wonder.
examples.translation: 但还有些别的东西，虽没有确凿的证据，却让我心生疑惑。

examples.text: He liked to sit and wonder at all that had happened...
examples.translation: 他喜欢坐着对发生的一切惊叹不已。

examples.text: Walk down Castle Street, admire our little jewel of a cathedral, then wonder at the castle...
examples.translation: 沿着城堡街走下去，欣赏我们视若珍宝的教堂，继而叹服于城堡的壮观。

examples.text: We all wonder you're still alive.
examples.translation: 我们都很惊讶你居然还活着。

examples.text: It's a wonder that it took almost ten years...
examples.translation: 这差不多用了10年的时间，真是桩奇事。

examples.text: The wonder is that Olivier was not seriously hurt.
examples.translation: 奥利维尔伤得不重，真是奇迹。

examples.text: 'That's right!' Bobby exclaimed in wonder. 'How did you remember that?'...
examples.translation: “对呀！”博比惊奇地叫道。“你是怎么想起那件事的？”

examples.text: I was expressing some amazement and wonder at her good fortune...
examples.translation: 我对她的好运既惊奇又感叹。

examples.text: Cross shook his head in wonder.
examples.translation: 克罗斯惊奇地摇摇头。

examples.text: ...a lecture on the wonders of space and space exploration.
examples.translation: 关于宇宙奇观和太空探险的讲座

examples.text: ...the wonder of seeing his name in print...
examples.translation: 看见他的名字出现在出版物上的诧异

examples.text: The East Window is a wonder of medieval glazing.
examples.translation: 东窗是中世纪玻璃安装工艺的奇迹。

examples.text: Mickelson was hailed as the wonder boy of American golf...
examples.translation: 米克尔森被誉为美国高尔夫球界的神奇小子。

examples.text: Dr Williams describes it as a potential wonder drug.
examples.translation: 威廉斯医生称其可能会成为特效药。

examples.text: Harry dismissed his old friend's speech as 'a nine-day wonder'...
examples.translation: 哈里对老朋友的讲话不屑一顾，称之“火不了多久”。

examples.text: Some supernova researchers wondered if it might be just a nine-day wonder.
examples.translation: 有些超新星研究者怀疑，这可能只是昙花一现。

examples.text: I was just wondering if you could help me...
examples.translation: 不知您是否能帮我个忙。

examples.text: I just wonder what you make of all that...
examples.translation: 我只是纳闷儿你是怎么看待这一切的。

examples.text: I'm wondering if that was the spirit in the courtroom, too.
examples.translation: 不知这是否也是法庭的精神。

examples.text: No wonder my brother wasn't feeling well...
examples.translation: 难怪我兄弟感觉不舒服了。

examples.text: Under such circumstances, it is little wonder that they experience difficulties...
examples.translation: 在这种情形下，他们遇到困难就不足为怪了。

examples.text: Small wonder that he decided to take no part in the debate.
examples.translation: 难怪他决定不参加辩论呢。

examples.text: Brad was Jane's brother! No wonder he reminded me so much of her!
examples.translation: 布拉德是简的兄弟！怪不得他老是让我想起她呢！

examples.text: A few moments of relaxation can work wonders...
examples.translation: 放松一会儿就可以收到奇效。

examples.text: Rushton has done wonders for the industry.
examples.translation: 拉什顿创造了行业奇迹。

examples.text: ...a young Lithuanian woman named Dayva.
examples.translation: 名叫戴娃的立陶宛年轻女子

examples.text: ...men and women over 75 years old.
examples.translation: 75岁以上的男女

examples.text: ...a woman doctor.
examples.translation: 女医生

examples.text: ...the oppression of woman.
examples.translation: 对妇女的压迫

examples.text: She is an avid outdoors woman...
examples.translation: 她酷爱户外运动。

examples.text: I'm too old to have a dog now. I'm a cat woman.
examples.translation: 我太老了，养不了狗。我喜欢养猫。

examples.text: ...a 38-year-old London woman...
examples.translation: 38岁的伦敦女子

examples.text: The headmistress was an Oxford woman.
examples.translation: 女校长毕业于牛津大学。

examples.text: I know my woman will never leave me.
examples.translation: 我知道我的女人永远不会离开我。

examples.text: Yet another successful Labour woman took her seat...
examples.translation: 又有一位成功的工党女代表就任议员。

examples.text: That's Judith Croft, the CND woman.
examples.translation: 那个就是朱迪丝·克罗夫特, 核裁军运动女代表。

examples.text: Do you realize, woman, the scandal and publicity that will be involved?
examples.translation: 臭婆娘，你知不知道这会恶名远扬？

examples.text: She knew she had made the right decision. She was her own woman again.
examples.translation: 她知道她作了一个正确的决定。她又独立自主了。

meanings.meaning: 极好的，精彩的，绝妙的；奇妙的；美妙；胜；神妙

examples.text: The cold, misty air felt wonderful on his face...
examples.translation: 雾蒙蒙的寒冷空气使他脸上感觉很舒爽。

examples.text: It's wonderful to see you...
examples.translation: 见到你真好。

examples.text: I've always thought he was a wonderful actor.
examples.translation: 我一直认为他是个出色的演员。

examples.text: It's a system that works wonderfully well...
examples.translation: 该系统运转得十分顺畅。

examples.text: The weather was wonderfully warm.
examples.translation: 天气暖洋洋的。

examples.text: Their dishes were made of wood...
examples.translation: 他们的盘子是木制的。

examples.text: There was a smell of damp wood and machine oil.
examples.translation: 有潮湿的木料和机油的气味。

examples.text: ...a short piece of wood.
examples.translation: 一块短木料

examples.text: After dinner Alice slipped away for a walk in the woods with Artie...
examples.translation: 晚餐后艾利斯溜出去跟阿蒂到林子里散步。

examples.text: About a mile to the west of town he came upon a large wood.
examples.translation: 他在镇子以西约一英里处偶遇一大片林地。

examples.text: The nation's economy is not out of the woods yet.
examples.translation: 该国经济尚未摆脱困境。

examples.text: She's never even been to the doctor's, touch wood...
examples.translation: 她从未看过病，希望她一直好运。

examples.text: Touch wood, I've been lucky enough to avoid any other serious injuries.
examples.translation: 老天保佑，我一直很幸运，别的重伤都躲过了。

examples.text: ...the shop's bare brick walls and faded wooden floorboards.
examples.translation: 商店裸露的砖墙和褪色的木地板

meanings.meaning: 羊毛；毛线；绒线；毛织品；毛料衣物

examples.text: ...a wool overcoat...
examples.translation: 羊毛大衣

examples.text: The carpets are made in wool and nylon.
examples.translation: 这些地毯是用毛料和尼龙制成的。

examples.text: Stop trying to pull the wool over my eyes! What were you two fighting about just now?
examples.translation: 休想蒙我！你们俩刚才在争执什么呢？

meanings.meaning: [语] 单词；话语；消息；诺言；命令

examples.text: The words stood out clearly on the page...
examples.translation: 那些字赫然写在纸上。

examples.text: The word 'ginseng' comes from the Chinese word 'ren-shen'.
examples.translation: ginseng 这个词来自汉语的“人参”。

examples.text: ...swear words...
examples.translation: 脏话

examples.text: Do you enjoy word puzzles?
examples.translation: 你喜欢字谜游戏吗？

examples.text: I was devastated when her words came true...
examples.translation: 她的话应验了，我伤心欲绝。

examples.text: The words of the young woman doctor echoed in his ears...
examples.translation: 那位年轻女医生的话在他耳畔回响。

examples.text: Allied military leaders have said they want actions, not words.
examples.translation: 盟军领导人说他们要的是行动，不是空话。

examples.text: Can you hear the words on the album?
examples.translation: 你听得清这张专辑中的歌词吗？

examples.text: I think it's time you had a word with him...
examples.translation: 我觉得你该跟他谈谈了。

examples.text: James, could I have a quiet word?...
examples.translation: 詹姆斯，我能和你私下说几句吗？

examples.text: It's the detective-sergeant. He wants a word.
examples.translation: 这位是探长，他想找你聊两句。

examples.text: A word of warning. Don't stick too precisely to what it says in the book...
examples.translation: 提醒一句：不要过于迷信书上的话。

examples.text: May I also say a word of thanks to all the people who sent letters.
examples.translation: 请允许我也向所有来信的人表示感谢。

examples.text: I can't understand a word she says...
examples.translation: 她说的我一点儿也不懂。

examples.text: I bet he doesn't remember a single word...
examples.translation: 我敢说他一个字都不记得。

examples.text: Not a word was spoken.
examples.translation: 一言未发。

examples.text: There is no word from the authorities on the reported attack...
examples.translation: 所报道的袭击事件没有得到当局的证实。

examples.text: Word has been spreading fast of the incidents on the streets...
examples.translation: 有关街头骚乱的消息迅速传播开来。

examples.text: Both men sent word that they had retired for the evening.
examples.translation: 两个男人都传话说他们已经就寝了。

examples.text: ...an adult who gave his word the boy would be supervised...
examples.translation: 一位承诺监护这个男孩的成年男子

examples.text: He simply cannot be trusted to keep his word.
examples.translation: 根本不能相信他会信守诺言。

examples.text: I want nothing said about this until I give the word.
examples.translation: 没有我的命令，不准议论这件事。

examples.text: If I had written the letter, I might have worded it differently.
examples.translation: 如果换作我写这封信，我或许会用不同的措辞。

examples.text: ...a strongly-worded statement.
examples.translation: 措辞强硬的声明

examples.text: ...a carefully-worded speech.
examples.translation: 措辞谨慎的讲话

examples.text: So many people think feminism is a dirty word.
examples.translation: 这么多人都认为女权主义是个龌龊的字眼。

examples.text: He has had to eat his words about the company being recession-proof.
examples.translation: 他不得不收回他说过的公司能免受经济衰退影响的话。

examples.text: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
examples.translation: 他是个沉默寡言的人，彬彬有礼，待人谦和。

examples.text: It's essential you make the right decisions from the word go.
examples.translation: 关键是从一开始就作出正确的决定。

examples.text: Melina was hanging on his every word, fascinated.
examples.translation: 梅利娜凝神细听着他的每句话，被深深吸引住了。

examples.text: The press never has a good word to say about them...
examples.translation: 新闻界从来没说过他们的好话。

examples.text: She doesn't have a kind word for anyone.
examples.translation: 她对谁都是冷言冷语。

examples.text: We had words and she stormed out...
examples.translation: 我们争执了起来，她夺门而出。

examples.text: I shall have words with these stupid friends of mine!
examples.translation: 我真应该跟我这些愚蠢的朋友理论理论！

examples.text: Even the Assistant Secretary of State had to admit that previous policy did not, in his words, produce results.
examples.translation: 就连助理国务卿也不得不承认之前的政策并没有，用他的话说，收到成效。

examples.text: Victor, in a word, got increasingly fed up...
examples.translation: 总而言之，维克多越来越厌倦了。

examples.text: 'Shouldn't he be given the leading role?' — 'In a word — No.'
examples.translation: “难道不该让他当主角吗？”——“一句话——不行。”

examples.text: She does like to have the last word in any discussion...
examples.translation: 她确实喜欢商量什么事都最终自己说了算。

examples.text: The final word will still come from the Secretary of State.
examples.translation: 最后仍然要由国务卿来定夺。

examples.text: The spa is the last word in luxury and efficiency.
examples.translation: 这家矿泉疗养浴场极尽奢华，功效极高。

examples.text: I'm lost for words — it's fantastic...
examples.translation: 我无以言表——太精彩了。

examples.text: She was gaping at it, lost for words.
examples.translation: 她目瞪口呆地看着这场面，一时语塞。

examples.text: 'And has she agreed to go with you?' — 'Not in so many words. But I read her thoughts'.
examples.translation: “她同意跟你一起去了吗？”——“没有直接说，但我知道她是怎么想的。”

examples.text: That's what you'll end up with, you mark my words.
examples.translation: 那就是将来你的下场，记住我的话。

examples.text: The story has been passed down by word of mouth.
examples.translation: 这个故事是口头流传下来的。

examples.text: The mobile library services have been reorganised — in other words, they visit fewer places.
examples.translation: 流动图书馆服务重新作了安排——换句话说，他们去的地方减少了。

examples.text: Now tell us in your own words about the events of Saturday.
examples.translation: 现在你来给我们讲讲星期六的活动吧。

examples.text: Friends passed the word that the miners wanted to see him.
examples.translation: 朋友们传话说矿工们想见他。

examples.text: When I say the word, follow me down.
examples.translation: 我一发话，就跟着我下来。

examples.text: The community reacted quickly and spread the word about safe sex.
examples.translation: 社区迅速作出反应，宣传安全性行为。

examples.text: They're willing to take him at his word when he says, 'Oh, I made mistakes and now I'll change.'
examples.translation: 只要他说“哦，我错了，现在我要改过自新”，他们就愿意当真。

examples.text: You'll buy nothing but trouble if you buy that house, take my word for it.
examples.translation: 你要是买那栋房子只会买来麻烦，我说的都是真的。

examples.text: It's too stupid for words not having the machines switched on when they're most needed...
examples.translation: 最需要这些机器时却不打开，真是愚蠢至极。

examples.text: I feel simply too devastated for words.
examples.translation: 我惊愕万分，不知说什么好。

examples.text: How do I know that he will be true to his word?...
examples.translation: 我怎么知道他会信守诺言呢？

examples.text: They were as good as their word and stayed away.
examples.translation: 他们信守诺言，离得远远的。

examples.text: I don't try to memorize speeches word for word.
examples.translation: 我不会试图一字不落地记住讲话要说的内容。

examples.text: ...office workers...
examples.translation: 办公室职员

examples.text: The society was looking for a capable research worker.
examples.translation: 该协会在物色一位有能力的研究人员。

examples.text: ...aid workers in Somalia.
examples.translation: 索马里的救援人员

examples.text: Wages have been frozen and workers laid off.
examples.translation: 工资被冻结，工人下岗。

examples.text: ...a call for the workers of the world to unite...
examples.translation: 呼吁全世界工人团结起来的号召

examples.text: The agreement encourages worker participation in management decisions.
examples.translation: 该协议鼓励工人参与管理层的决策。

examples.text: He is a hard worker and a skilled gardener...
examples.translation: 他工作很努力，对园艺很在行。

examples.text: A first-class worker, she operated the difficult Jacquard looms.
examples.translation: 她技艺高超，操作着复杂的提花织布机。

meanings.meaning: 车间；研讨会；工场；讲习班

examples.text: Trumpeter Marcus Belgrave ran a jazz workshop for young artists...
examples.translation: 小号手马库斯·贝尔格雷夫为年轻艺术家办了一个爵士乐研习班。

examples.text: The Jamaica Festival is planning a series of workshops and business seminars.
examples.translation: 牙买加节正在筹划一系列研习班和商务研讨会。

examples.text: ...a modestly equipped workshop.
examples.translation: 设备简陋的车间

examples.text: ...the railway workshops.
examples.translation: 铁路机车修理厂

examples.text: His books have sold more than 20 million copies worldwide...
examples.translation: 他的书在全世界已经售出两千多万本。

examples.text: Every day the newspapers tell stories of children worldwide who are abused...
examples.translation: 每天报纸都在讲述世界各地受虐儿童的故事。

examples.text: Worldwide, an enormous amount of research effort goes into military technology.
examples.translation: 在世界范围内，大量的研究精力都投入到军事技术上。

examples.text: Today, doctors are fearing a worldwide epidemic.
examples.translation: 现今，医生们担心会爆发世界性的流行病。

meanings.meaning: 工作；[物] 功；产品；操作；职业；行为；事业；工厂；著作；文学、音乐或艺术作品
使工作；操作；经营；使缓慢前进

examples.text: Weiner works for the US Department of Transport...
examples.translation: 韦纳就职于美国交通部。

examples.text: I started working in a recording studio...
examples.translation: 我开始在一个录音棚工作。

examples.text: Where do you work?...
examples.translation: 你在哪儿工作？

examples.text: He worked as a bricklayer's mate...
examples.translation: 他给瓦工打下手。

examples.text: I want to work, I don't want to be on welfare.
examples.translation: 我想去工作，不想吃救济。

examples.text: Fewer and fewer people are in work...
examples.translation: 就业人数越来越少。

examples.text: I was out of work at the time...
examples.translation: 那时我失业了。

examples.text: She'd have enough money to provide for her children until she could find work...
examples.translation: 她在找到工作前应该有足够的钱供养孩子。

examples.text: What kind of work do you do?
examples.translation: 你是做什么工作的？

examples.text: I can't talk to you right now—I'm working...
examples.translation: 这会儿我不能跟你说话——我在干活儿。

examples.text: He was working at his desk...
examples.translation: 他正在桌前用功。

examples.text: Some firms expect the guards to work twelve hours a day.
examples.translation: 有些公司要求保安每天工作12小时。

examples.text: We're supposed to be running a business here. I've got work to do...
examples.translation: 我们在这里应该是要经营公司。我有一堆的事情要做。

examples.text: I used to take work home, but I don't do it any more...
examples.translation: 我过去常把活儿带回家干，不过我如今再也不这么做了。

examples.text: There have been days when I have finished work at 2pm.
examples.translation: 有一段时间我凌晨两点才干完活儿。

examples.text: ...an image of teaching which highlighted the stressful and difficult aspects of the teacher's work.
examples.translation: 突出显示了教师工作的压力和困难的教学场景

examples.text: Linda spends all her time working on the garden...
examples.translation: 琳达把所有时间都花在打理花园上。

examples.text: While I was working on my letter the telephone rang...
examples.translation: 我正在写信，电话铃响了。

examples.text: Leonard was working at his German. His mistakes made her laugh...
examples.translation: 伦纳德正在学习德语，他出的洋相让她哈哈大笑。

examples.text: The most important reason for coming to university is to work for a degree...
examples.translation: 上大学最重要的原因就是要拿个学位。

examples.text: The government expressed hope that all the sides will work towards a political solution.
examples.translation: 政府表示希望各方共同努力，制订出政治解决方案。

examples.text: There was a lot of work to do on their house...
examples.translation: 他们的房子有很多地方需要收拾。

examples.text: We hadn't appreciated how much work was involved in organizing a wedding...
examples.translation: 我们没有意识到筹备婚礼有多少事情要做。

examples.text: He said that the peace plan would be rejected because it needed more work.
examples.translation: 他说和平计划会被否决，因为还需要进一步修改。

examples.text: Many people travel to work by car...
examples.translation: 很多人开车去上班。

examples.text: She told her friends at work that she was trying to lose weight.
examples.translation: 她跟单位的朋友说她在努力减肥。

examples.text: It can help to have an impartial third party look over your work...
examples.translation: 让客观公正的第三方看一下你的成果会有助益。

examples.text: Tidiness in the workshop is really essential for producing good work...
examples.translation: 工作间干净整洁对于生产出好的产品非常重要。

examples.text: That's a beautiful piece of work. You should be proud of it.
examples.translation: 那件作品非常漂亮，你应当为之自豪。

examples.text: In my opinion, this is Rembrandt's greatest work...
examples.translation: 我认为这是伦勃朗最伟大的作品。

examples.text: Under his arm, there was a book which looked like the complete works of Shakespeare...
examples.translation: 他胳膊底下夹着一本书，看上去就像是夹了《莎士比亚全集》。

examples.text: The church has several valuable works of art.
examples.translation: 教堂有几件珍贵的艺术品。

examples.text: Professor Bonnet has been working for many years on molecules of this type.
examples.translation: 邦尼特教授多年来一直在从事这种分子的研究工作。

examples.text: Their work shows that one-year-olds are much more likely to have allergies if either parent smokes.
examples.translation: 他们的研究表明，如果父母中有一人吸烟，一岁婴儿患过敏的可能性就会大大增加。

examples.text: She spent a period of time working with people dying of cancer...
examples.translation: 她有一段时间曾帮助垂危的癌症患者。

examples.text: He knew then that he wanted to work among the poor.
examples.translation: 他那时明白了自己想帮助穷人。

examples.text: ...a highly respected priest who is noted for his work with the poor...
examples.translation: 以救助穷人闻名的备受尊敬的教士

examples.text: She became involved in social and relief work among the refugees.
examples.translation: 她参加了帮助难民的社会救济工作。

examples.text: The pump doesn't work and we have no running water...
examples.translation: 水泵坏了，我们没有自来水了。

examples.text: Is the telephone working today?...
examples.translation: 电话今天能用吗？

examples.text: Ned turned on the lanterns, which worked with batteries...
examples.translation: 内德打开开关亮起了装电池的灯笼。

examples.text: How does the gun work?
examples.translation: 这枪怎么用?

examples.text: 95 per cent of these diets do not work...
examples.translation: 这些节食方法95%都不起作用。

examples.text: If lust is all there is to hold you together, the relationship will never work...
examples.translation: 如果肉欲是你们在一起的唯一理由，这种关系是不会持久的。

examples.text: I shouldn't have come, I knew it wouldn't work...
examples.translation: 我不应该来，我知道这起不了什么作用。

examples.text: A methodical approach works best.
examples.translation: 有条不紊的方法效果最佳。

examples.text: I wake at 6 am as the sleeping pill doesn't work for more than nine hours...
examples.translation: 安眠药的药效不会超过9个小时，所以我清晨6点就醒了。

examples.text: The drug works by increasing levels of serotonin in the brain.
examples.translation: 这种药物通过提高大脑中血清素的含量来产生疗效。

examples.text: One factor thought to have worked in his favour is his working class image...
examples.translation: 据认为，一个帮上了他的因素就是他的工人阶级形象。

examples.text: This obviously works against the interests of the child.
examples.translation: 这显然会对孩子不利。

examples.text: Nevertheless, she is always optimistic about the possibilities and can work her charm on the disenchanted...
examples.translation: 虽然如此，她总是乐观地抱持希望，并能深深地感染那些心灰意冷的人。

examples.text: Our spirits rallied as the bitter-sweet alcohol worked its magic.
examples.translation: 苦中带甜的酒发挥了奇效，我们的精神随之振奋起来。

examples.text: My mind was working frantically, running over the events of the evening.
examples.translation: 我的大脑疯狂地运转，把那晚发生的事情飞快地一幕幕重演。

examples.text: We are working on the assumption that it was a gas explosion.
examples.translation: 我们假设这是一场燃气爆炸事故。

examples.text: Brand has been working the clubs and the pubs since 1986, developing her comedy act...
examples.translation: 布兰德自1986年以来一直在俱乐部和酒吧表演，提高她的喜剧演技。

examples.text: This is the seventh year that he has worked the streets of Manhattan.
examples.translation: 这是他在曼哈顿街头献艺的第7个年头。

examples.text: They're working me too hard. I'm too old for this...
examples.translation: 他们把我用得太狠了，我老了，干不了这种活儿啦。

examples.text: They didn't take my father away, but kept him in the village and worked him to death.
examples.translation: 他们没有把我爸爸带走，而是一直让他在村里干活，把他活活累死了。

examples.text: The Prime Minister has an ability to work a crowd — some might even suggest it is a kind of charm...
examples.translation: 首相有种感召人群的本事——有些人甚至认为这是一种魅力。

examples.text: He worked the room like a politician, gripping hands, and slapping backs.
examples.translation: 他又是握手，又是拍背，像个政客一样把一屋子的人都笼络了一番。

examples.text: Farmers worked the fertile valleys.
examples.translation: 农民们在肥沃的山谷里耕种。

examples.text: The mines had first been worked in 1849, when gold was discovered in California...
examples.translation: 1849年加利福尼亚发现金矿时，这些矿第一次被开采。

examples.text: Only an agreed number of men was allowed to work any given seam at any given time.
examples.translation: 只有少数得到批准的人可以在特定时间开采特定的矿层。

examples.text: Many adults still depend on their children to work the video.
examples.translation: 很多成年人仍然要靠孩子来操作录像机。

examples.text: A screw had worked loose from my glasses.
examples.translation: 我眼镜上有一个螺丝松了。

examples.text: Work the dough with the palm of your hand until it is very smooth...
examples.translation: 用手掌将面团揉至光滑为止。

examples.text: Remove rind from the cheese and work it to a firm paste, with a fork.
examples.translation: 将奶酪的外皮去掉，用叉子将其压成硬硬的膏状。

examples.text: ...the machines needed to extract and work the raw stone.
examples.translation: 开采加工原石的机器

examples.text: ...a long, cool tunnel of worked stone.
examples.translation: 一条跨度长且阴凉的石凿隧道

examples.text: He studied sculpture because he enjoyed working with clay.
examples.translation: 他学习雕塑是因为他喜欢玩黏土。

examples.text: Each position will work the muscles in a different way...
examples.translation: 每种姿势都会以不同方式活动肌肉。

examples.text: Her mouth was working in her sleep.
examples.translation: 她睡着的时候嘴巴还在动。

examples.text: The steel works could be seen for miles.
examples.translation: 这个钢厂几英里外都能看见。

examples.text: ...a recycling works.
examples.translation: 回收工厂

examples.text: ...the works canteen.
examples.translation: 工厂餐厅

examples.text: ...six years of disruptive building works, road construction and urban development.
examples.translation: 6年间进行的破坏性的建筑工程、道路修筑和城市扩建

examples.text: Amazing place he's got there—squash courts, swimming pool, jacuzzi, the works.
examples.translation: 他的那个地方真是太棒了——壁球场、游泳池、按摩浴池，一应俱全。

examples.text: The salvage teams are already hard at work trying to deal with the spilled oil...
examples.translation: 救援队已经在紧张地设法处理溢出的石油。

examples.text: He is currently at work on a novel...
examples.translation: 他这会儿正忙着写一篇小说。

examples.text: Television cameras were invited in to film him at work.
examples.translation: 电视台摄像师被请进来拍摄他工作的镜头。

examples.text: The report suggested that the same trend was at work in politics...
examples.translation: 这份报告表明，同一趋势也在影响着政治。

examples.text: It is important to understand the powerful economic and social forces at work behind our own actions.
examples.translation: 重要的是，要理解在我们自身行动背后起作用的强大的经济和社会力量。

examples.text: The new administration has its work cut out for it. Creating jobs in this kind of environment is not going to be easy...
examples.translation: 新一届政府面临重重困难。在这种环境下创造就业机会绝非易事。

examples.text: He will have his work cut out to get into the team.
examples.translation: 他要进入该队困难重重。

examples.text: He said there were dozens of economic plans in the works...
examples.translation: 他说有几十项经济计划已经开始实施。

examples.text: Nobody should be surprised by this. It's been in the works for some time.
examples.translation: 不应该有人对此感到惊奇，这事已经张罗了有一阵子了。

examples.text: An aerosol spray will make short work of painting awkward objects...
examples.translation: 用喷罐来喷涂，不好对付的物品也能轻松搞定。

examples.text: This horse made light work of the cross-country course...
examples.translation: 这匹马轻松地跑完了越野赛程。

examples.text: Australia made hard work of beating them.
examples.translation: 澳大利亚队非常艰难地击败了他们。

examples.text: Underneath I think he's actually a rather nasty piece of work.
examples.translation: 内心里我觉得他是个非常讨厌的家伙。

examples.text: By stimulating the economy, we're going to put people to work...
examples.translation: 我们将通过刺激经济让人们实现就业。

examples.text: Instead of sending them to prison, we have set them to work helping the lemon growers.
examples.translation: 我们没有把他们送进监狱，而是让他们帮种柠檬的果农干活儿。

examples.text: He promised to get to work on the state's massive deficit...
examples.translation: 他承诺着手解决国家庞大的财政赤字问题。

examples.text: He returned to America where he set to work on a new novel.
examples.translation: 他返回美国，开始写一部新小说。

examples.text: Rescuers were still working their way towards the trapped men...
examples.translation: 营救人员仍在艰难地向被困者靠拢。

examples.text: Many personnel managers started as secretaries or personnel assistants and worked their way up.
examples.translation: 很多人事经理最初是从秘书或人事助理做起，然后慢慢升上去的。

examples.text: Nice work, Matthew. I knew you could do it.
examples.translation: 干得好，马修。我知道你能行。

meanings.meaning: 世界；领域；宇宙；世俗；全人类；物质生活

examples.text: It's a beautiful part of the world...
examples.translation: 这是世界上很美的一个地区。

examples.text: More than anything, I'd like to drive around the world...
examples.translation: 我最想做的事是开车周游世界。

examples.text: The satellite enables us to calculate their precise location anywhere in the world.
examples.translation: 卫星使我们能够计算出他们在世界上任何地方的精确位置。

examples.text: The world was, and remains, shocked...
examples.translation: 世人当时感到震惊，现在仍然如此。

examples.text: He wants to show the world that anyone can learn to be an ambassador.
examples.translation: 他想向世人表明任何人都能通过学习而成为一名大使。

examples.text: ...his personal contribution to world history.
examples.translation: 他个人对世界历史的贡献

examples.text: ...inflationary pressures in the world economy.
examples.translation: 世界经济的通货膨胀压力

examples.text: Abroad, Mr Bush was seen as a world statesman...
examples.translation: 在国外，布什先生被看作一位国际上举足轻重的政治家。

examples.text: China has once again emerged as a world power...
examples.translation: 中国又一次以世界强国的姿态崛起。

examples.text: He was one of Newcastle's most distinguished medical men, a world authority on heart-diseases.
examples.translation: 他是纽卡斯尔最优秀的医生之一，也是世界心脏病方面的权威。

examples.text: Athens had strong ties to the Arab world.
examples.translation: 雅典与阿拉伯世界关系密切。

examples.text: ...the developing world...
examples.translation: 发展中国家

examples.text: Dogs were also associated with healing in the ancient world.
examples.translation: 在古代，狗也与治病有关。

examples.text: His world seemed so different from mine...
examples.translation: 他的生活圈子和我的似乎有天壤之别。

examples.text: I lost my job and it was like my world collapsed...
examples.translation: 我丢了工作，我的世界好像都垮掉了。

examples.text: I tried to understand the adult world and could not.
examples.translation: 我试着去了解成人世界，却无法猜透。

examples.text: The publishing world had certainly never seen an event quite like this.
examples.translation: 出版界以前确实没有遇见过类似这样的事。

examples.text: ...the latest news from the world of finance.
examples.translation: 来自金融界的最新消息

examples.text: ...a golf course set in a hidden world of parkland, forest and lakes...
examples.translation: 位于一处有公共绿地、森林和湖泊的隐秘之地的高尔夫球场

examples.text: The patient must re-enter a world full of problems and stresses.
examples.translation: 患者必须再次进入充满问题和压力的世界。

examples.text: Good fortune will follow you, both in this world and the next.
examples.translation: 无论今世还是来生，好运都会伴随你。

examples.text: He looked like something from another world...
examples.translation: 他看上去像是从另一个星球来的。

examples.text: Man was drawing closer to the stars, opening new worlds.
examples.translation: 人类在接近各个星球，探索新的天体。

examples.text: Intellectually, this man and I are worlds apart...
examples.translation: 在智力上，我和这个男子有天壤之别。

examples.text: The novel is worlds apart from his academic writings.
examples.translation: 这本小说和他的学术著作截然不同。

examples.text: Her living room provides the best of both worlds, with an office at one end and comfortable sofas at the other.
examples.translation: 她家客厅一头是办公处，一头是舒适的沙发，真是两全其美。

examples.text: I never felt I achieved a great deal in my life, apart from bringing my children into the world.
examples.translation: 除了生了几个孩子，我从未觉得自己这辈子取得了很大成就。

examples.text: There's a world of difference between an amateur video and a slick Hollywood production.
examples.translation: 业余制作的录像短片与好莱坞制作精湛的电影作品有天壤之别。

examples.text: I wouldn't have missed this for the world.
examples.translation: 我决不会错过这个。

examples.text: A sleep will do you the world of good.
examples.translation: 睡一觉你就会感觉舒服多了。

examples.text: ...a mature performance which must have done his career prospects a world of good.
examples.translation: 肯定为他的事业打开了一片坦途的成熟表演

examples.text: The saddest thing in the world is a little baby nobody wants...
examples.translation: 世上最让人难受的莫过于小婴儿遭到遗弃。

examples.text: He had no one in the world but her.
examples.translation: 除了她，他再也没有任何亲人。

examples.text: What in the world is he doing?...
examples.translation: 他究竟在干什么？

examples.text: Where in the world were you when I was struggling for my life?
examples.translation: 我挣扎求生的时候，你究竟在哪儿？

examples.text: In an ideal world Karen Stevens says she would love to stay at home with her two-and-half-year old son...
examples.translation: 卡伦·史蒂文斯说在理想的生活中，她非常愿意呆在家里照料两岁半的儿子。

examples.text: In a perfect world, there would be the facilities and money to treat every sick person.
examples.translation: 理想的状况是有足够的设备和财力治疗每一位病人。

examples.text: All young people must face up to reality and not kid themselves that the world owes them a living.
examples.translation: 所有的年轻人都必须接受现实，不要自欺欺人，觉得生来就该享清福。

examples.text: Look, we are both men of the world, would anyone really mind?
examples.translation: 听着，我们都是见过世面的人，真有人会介意吗？

examples.text: ...an elegant, clever and tough woman of the world.
examples.translation: 优雅、聪明、顽强并且阅历丰富的女人

examples.text: These new trains are out of this world.
examples.translation: 这些新火车太棒了。

examples.text: For many, the post office is the only link with the outside world...
examples.translation: 对很多人来说，这个邮局是与外界联系的唯一纽带。

examples.text: This, at least, was the situation as it appeared to the outside world.
examples.translation: 至少在外界看来情况是这样的。

examples.text: Some problems are the same the world over...
examples.translation: 有些问题在全世界都一样。

examples.text: Governments the world over should do something about it.
examples.translation: 世界各国政府应该对此采取行动。

examples.text: When I'm swimming I'm in a world of my own...
examples.translation: 游泳的时候，我沉浸在自己的世界里。

examples.text: Sarah was nine years old and until that moment she had been locked in a world of her own.
examples.translation: 萨拉当时9岁，之前她一直封闭在自己的世界里。

examples.text: I think the world of him, but something tells me it's not love...
examples.translation: 我很在乎他，但是某种感觉告诉我这不是爱。

examples.text: We were really close. We thought the world of each other.
examples.translation: 我们的确很亲近，非常在乎对方。

examples.text: When they started to go up in the world, they moved to a flat in London.
examples.translation: 他们开始发家的时候，搬进了伦敦的一所公寓。

examples.text: ...young women of middle class families which had come down in the world.
examples.translation: 出身于落魄的中产阶级家庭的年轻女子

meanings.meaning: 虫，蠕虫；蜗杆；螺纹；小人物
使蠕动；给除虫；使缓慢前进

examples.text: I worm all my birds in early spring...
examples.translation: 早春的时候我给我所有的鸟打虫。

examples.text: All adult dogs are routinely wormed at least every six months.
examples.translation: 所有的成年狗至少每半年要例行打一次虫。

examples.text: I had to worm my way out sideways from the bench in a ridiculous, undignified fashion...
examples.translation: 我侧着身子艰难地从长凳上移开，那个样子很可笑，很不雅观。

examples.text: The kitten wormed its way through the just-open door.
examples.translation: 小猫缩着身子从刚开了一点儿的门中挤过来。

examples.text: She never misses a chance to worm her way into the public's hearts...
examples.translation: 她从不放过任何博取公众欢心的机会。

examples.text: Everyone knows people who have wormed their way up on old school connections.
examples.translation: 每个人都认识一些利用老同学关系向上爬的人。

examples.text: You've opened up a whole new can of worms here I think. We could have a whole debate on student loans and grants...
examples.translation: 我认为你在此引发了一个极为棘手的全新问题，我们可能会就学生贷款和助学金展开一次大辩论。

examples.text: Drug abuse is a can of worms nobody wants to open at sporting events.
examples.translation: 滥用药物是体育赛事中无人想要触及的棘手问题。

examples.text: Now the worm turns, and his wife Elizabeth chucks him out and takes a lover herself.
examples.translation: 现在他妻子伊丽莎白被逼急了，把他撵了出去，自己找了个情人。

examples.text: Don't worry, your luggage will come on afterwards by taxi...
examples.translation: 别担心，你的行李随后会由出租车送过来。

examples.text: I worry about her constantly...
examples.translation: 我无时无刻不为她担心。

examples.text: I work in a school so I don't have to worry about finding someone to look after my little boy...
examples.translation: 我在学校工作，所以不用为找人照顾我年幼的儿子而操心。

examples.text: They worry that extremists might gain control.
examples.translation: 他们担心极端分子可能会取得控制权。

examples.text: I'm still in the early days of my recovery and that worries me...
examples.translation: 我还处于恢复的早期阶段，这让我很担心。

examples.text: 'Why didn't you tell us?' — 'I didn't want to worry you.'...
examples.translation: “你为什么不告诉我们？”“我不想让你们担心。”

examples.text: The English, worried by the growing power of Prince Henry, sent a raiding party to Scotland to kill him...
examples.translation: 英格兰人对亨利亲王权势日增感到不安，便派突袭队到苏格兰除掉他。

examples.text: Does it worry you that the Americans are discussing this?
examples.translation: 美国人在讨论这事，你不担心吗？

examples.text: The cold doesn't worry me...
examples.translation: 冷我不怕。

examples.text: It wouldn't worry me if he came to my house, but I don't know if I would go out of my way to ask him.
examples.translation: 我倒不介意他来我家，但我不知道自己是否会特意邀请他。

examples.text: The admission shows the depth of worry among the Tories over the state of the economy...
examples.translation: 这一认可表明了保守党党内对经济状况的忧虑之深。

examples.text: His last years were overshadowed by financial worry.
examples.translation: 他生命的最后几年穷困潦倒，十分惨淡。

examples.text: My main worry was that Madeleine Johnson would still be there...
examples.translation: 我最担心的是马德琳·约翰逊仍会在那儿。

examples.text: The worry is that the use of force could make life impossible for the UN peacekeepers...
examples.translation: 让人担心的是，使用武力可能会使联合国维和人员性命难保。

examples.text: His wife Cheryl said she had no worries about his health.
examples.translation: 他的妻子谢里尔说她并不担心他的健康。

examples.text: 'Not to worry, Baby,' he said, and kissed her tenderly.
examples.translation: “没关系，宝贝儿。”他说道，然后温柔地吻了她一下。

meanings.meaning: 更坏的；更差的；更恶劣的（bad的比较级）；（病情）更重的（ill的比较级）
更糟；更坏；更恶劣地；更坏地

examples.text: For the past couple of years my life has gone from bad to worse.
examples.translation: 过去几年来，我的生活每况愈下。

examples.text: Scientists in search of a challenging career could do worse than consider forensic science.
examples.translation: 寻求富有挑战性的事业的科学家不妨考虑一下法医学。

examples.text: The grandparents sigh and say how things have changed for the worse.
examples.translation: 爷爷奶奶叹着气说情况变得如何如何糟糕。

examples.text: Father came home from the pub very much the worse for drink...
examples.translation: 父亲从酒吧回到家里，乱撒酒疯。

examples.text: They are all apparently fit and well and none the worse for the fifteen hour journey.
examples.translation: 他们的身体状况显然都很好，15个小时的行程没有给他们带来不适。

examples.text: I enjoy going to church and worshipping God.
examples.translation: 我喜欢去教堂做礼拜。

examples.text: ...Jews worshipping at the Wailing Wall.
examples.translation: 在哭墙前敬拜的犹太人

examples.text: ...the worship of the ancient Roman gods...
examples.translation: 对古罗马诸神的敬奉

examples.text: St Jude's church is a public place of worship.
examples.translation: 圣犹大教堂是做礼拜的公共场所。

examples.text: At the end of the service, scores of worshippers streamed down to the altar.
examples.translation: 礼拜结束时，许多敬拜者涌向圣坛。

examples.text: She had worshipped him for years...
examples.translation: 她仰慕他已有多年。

examples.text: They worship James Brown, Bob Marley and Jimi Hendrix.
examples.translation: 他们崇拜詹姆斯·布朗、鲍勃·马利和吉米·亨德里克斯。

meanings.meaning: 最差的，最坏的；最不利的；效能最低的

examples.text: Though mine safety has much improved, miners' families still fear the worst...
examples.translation: 尽管矿井的安全状况有了很大改善，矿工的家属仍然害怕最糟的情况会发生。

examples.text: The country had come through the worst of the recession.
examples.translation: 该国已经度过了经济衰退最糟糕的时期。

examples.text: The people most closely affected are the passengers who were injured and, worst of all, those who lost relatives.
examples.translation: 受影响最大的是受伤的乘客，那些失去亲人的乘客尤为甚。

examples.text: At best Nella would be an invalid; at worst she would die...
examples.translation: 内拉往好里说会落下残疾，往坏处说可能会生命不保。

examples.text: At the worst he would be there by the following night.
examples.translation: 最不济他会在第二天晚上之前到那儿。

examples.text: This was their mother at her worst. Her voice was strident, she was ready to be angry at anyone.
examples.translation: 这是他们的母亲情绪最坏之时，她说话咄咄逼人，随时会对任何人发火。

examples.text: If the worst comes to the worst I guess I can always ring Jean...
examples.translation: 到了一筹莫展的时候，我想我总还是能给琼打电话。

examples.text: He was asked whether he would walk out if the worst came to the worst.
examples.translation: 他被问到如果发生最坏的情况他是否会退席。

examples.text: I think it was dangerous to say: look, we've got an army now — do your worst.
examples.translation: 我觉得要是说“瞧，我们现在有一大群人——你有什么手段尽管使出来吧”，可能会引起麻烦。

examples.text: These books might be worth £80 or £
examples.translation: 90 or more to a collector... 这些书对收藏家而言可能值八九十英镑或更多。

examples.text: His mother inherited a farm worth 15,000 dollars a year...
examples.translation: 他母亲继承了一处年产值为1.5万美元的农场。

examples.text: The contract was worth £25 million a year.
examples.translation: 这份合同一年价值2,500万英镑。

examples.text: I went and bought about six dollars' worth of potato chips...
examples.translation: 我去买了大约6美元的薯条。

examples.text: Large numbers of deer now roam the forests and are causing thousands of millions of roubles-worth of damage.
examples.translation: 现在大批鹿群在森林里游荡，造成价值几十亿卢布的损失。

examples.text: 'How many do you want?' — 'I'll have a pound's worth.'
examples.translation: “你要多少？”“我要1英镑的。”

examples.text: You've got three years' worth of research money to do what you want with...
examples.translation: 你有可维持3年的研究经费去做自己想做的事。

examples.text: After an hour and a quarter's-worth of cleansing, toning and pampering, the difference to the way my skin felt was remarkable.
examples.translation: 经过1小时15分钟的清洁、柔肤和精心护理后，我的皮肤摸上去感觉大不一样。

examples.text: There's really not very much food down there. About two weeks' worth.
examples.translation: 那儿真的没多少吃的了，大概能维持两个星期。

examples.text: He's decided to get a look at the house and see if it might be worth buying...
examples.translation: 他决定去瞧瞧那座房子，看是否值得买下。

examples.text: If this was what his job required, then the job wasn't really worth having...
examples.translation: 如果这是他的工作所需，那么这份工作真的不值得去做。

examples.text: Most things worth having never come easy.
examples.translation: 大部分值得拥有的东西都来之不易。

examples.text: No one is worth a great deal of sacrifice...
examples.translation: 没有谁值得付出重大的牺牲。

examples.text: I am spending a lot of money and time on this boat, but it is worth it...
examples.translation: 我在这艘船上花了很多金钱和时间，但都很值得。

examples.text: This restaurant is well worth a visit...
examples.translation: 这家饭店非常值得光顾一番。

examples.text: It is worth pausing to consider these statements from Mr Davies.
examples.translation: 戴维斯先生的这番话值得大家停下来思考一下。

examples.text: He had never had a woman of her worth as a friend...
examples.translation: 他从来没有过像她这样值得交往的女性朋友。

examples.text: The team would have need of a driver of his worth.
examples.translation: 这支队伍需要一位他这样技术水平的司机。

examples.text: We both began waving to the crowd for all we were worth...
examples.translation: 我们俩开始使劲地朝人群挥手。

examples.text: Push for all you're worth!
examples.translation: 使足劲推！

examples.text: You get anywhere with legal aid only by playing the system for all it is worth.
examples.translation: 你若想让法律援助多少发挥点作用，只有充分利用这一制度。

examples.text: ...taking an idea and exploiting it for all it's worth.
examples.translation: 选取一种观点并对其充分加以挖掘

examples.text: For what it's worth, my feeling is that ice in whisky is fine...
examples.translation: 不管怎么样，我觉得威士忌放冰很好。

examples.text: I've brought my notes, for what it's worth.
examples.translation: 不管有没有用，我反正把我的笔记带来了。

examples.text: It might be worth your while to go to court and ask for the agreement to be changed...
examples.translation: 上法庭要求对协议进行改动也许对你有益。

examples.text: You'll find it well worth your while to learn something of each island's special features before visiting them.
examples.translation: 你会发现游览之前先了解一下各岛的特色非常有帮助。

meanings.meaning: 值得做的，值得花时间的

examples.text: The President's trip to Washington this week seems to have been worthwhile...
examples.translation: 总统本周的华盛顿之行看来是有价值的。

examples.text: ...a worthwhile movie that was compelling enough to watch again...
examples.translation: 非常吸引人、值得再看一遍的精彩影片

examples.text: It might be worthwhile to consider your attitude to an insurance policy.
examples.translation: 考虑一下你对投保的看法也许有所助益。

meanings.meaning: 值得的；有价值的；配得上的，相称的；可尊敬的；应…的

examples.text: The bank might think you're worthy of a loan...
examples.translation: 银行也许会认为你具备贷款的条件。

examples.text: The Minister says the idea is worthy of consideration...
examples.translation: 部长说这个想法值得考虑。

examples.text: I hope he was worthy of her.
examples.translation: 我希望他配得上她。

examples.text: I have not achieved my goal in becoming chief constable, a rank I know I could have worthily held.
examples.translation: 我没有实现当警察局局长的目标，但我知道自己已经能够胜任这个职位。

examples.text: Some people are afraid to take risks because their belief in their own worthiness is so low.
examples.translation: 有些人害怕冒险, 因为他们妄自菲薄。

examples.text: ...worthy members of the community...
examples.translation: 团体中德高望重者

examples.text: They thought the feminist label was too worthy.
examples.translation: 他们觉得女权主义者这个称谓太抬举她们了。

examples.text: ...the commission, which brought together worthies from big corporations, universities and state governments.
examples.translation: 汇聚了大公司、大学和州政府中贤达人士的委员会

examples.text: Would is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. In spoken English, would is often abbreviated to 'd.
examples.translation: would是情态动词，后接动词原形，口语中常略作 ’d。

examples.text: Would he always be like this?…
examples.translation: 他会一直是这个样子吗？

examples.text: Once inside, I found that the flat would be perfect for my life in Paris...
examples.translation: 一到里面，我就发现这套公寓对我在巴黎生活再适合不过了。

examples.text: He expressed the hope that on Monday elementary schools would be reopened...
examples.translation: 他表示希望各小学星期一能复课。

examples.text: A report yesterday that said British unemployment would continue to rise...
examples.translation: 昨天一篇称英国失业率将继续上升的报道

examples.text: I don't think that he would take such a decision.
examples.translation: 我认为他不会作出这样的决定。

examples.text: The statement added that although there were a number of differing views, these would be discussed by both sides...
examples.translation: 这项声明还称，虽然双方观点存在若干分歧，但将就这些分歧展开讨论。

examples.text: George decided it was such a rare car that he would only use it for a few shows...
examples.translation: 乔治认为这辆车非常稀罕，所以他只会拿它展示很少的几次。

examples.text: He did not think he would marry Beth.
examples.translation: 他觉得他是不会和贝丝结婚的。

examples.text: Ordinarily it would be fun to be taken to fabulous restaurants...
examples.translation: 一般来说，跟别人去豪华餐馆吃饭会是件乐事。

examples.text: It would be wrong to suggest that police officers were not annoyed by acts of indecency...
examples.translation: 要是认为警官对粗鄙行为不气不恼，那可就错了。

examples.text: It would cost very much more for the four of us to go from Italy.
examples.translation: 从意大利走，我们4人花的钱会多得多。

examples.text: ...identity cards without which fans would not be able to get into stadiums.
examples.translation: 球迷不随身携带就不能进入体育场的身份证

examples.text: You wouldn't know him...
examples.translation: 你肯定不认识他。

examples.text: His fans would already be familiar with Caroline...
examples.translation: 他的崇拜者们肯定已经很熟悉卡罗琳了。

examples.text: That would have been Della's car...
examples.translation: 那应该是德拉的车。

examples.text: He made a promise to his great-grandfather? That would have been a long time ago...
examples.translation: 他曾向他的曾祖父许下承诺？那准是很久以前的事情了。

examples.text: It was half seven; her mother would be annoyed because he was so late.
examples.translation: 7点半了，他到得这么晚，她母亲一定会生气的。

examples.text: If only I could get some sleep, I would be able to cope...
examples.translation: 要是我能睡会儿，我就能够应付。

examples.text: I think if I went to look at more gardens, I would be better on planning and designing them...
examples.translation: 我觉得如果我更多地去看一些花园,就有可能更好地规划和设计它们。

examples.text: A policeman would not live one year if he obeyed these regulations...
examples.translation: 警察如果遵守这些规定的话，一年都活不了。

examples.text: The targets would not be achieved unless other departments showed equal commitment.
examples.translation: 除非其他部门同样努力，否则这些目标无法达成。

examples.text: They said they would give the police their full cooperation...
examples.translation: 他们说他们愿意与警方通力合作。

examples.text: She indicated that she would help her husband...
examples.translation: 她表示愿意帮助她丈夫。

examples.text: David would not accept this...
examples.translation: 戴维不愿接受这个东西。

examples.text: He wouldn't say where he had picked up the information.
examples.translation: 他不肯说是从哪儿得到这个消息的。

examples.text: He kicked, pushed, and hurled his shoulder at the door. It wouldn't open...
examples.translation: 他冲着门又踢又推，还用肩膀撞，但门就是打不开。

examples.text: He kept trying to start the car and the battery got flatter and flatter, until it wouldn't turn the engine at all...
examples.translation: 他反复试着发动车子，但电池的电越来越少，最后根本就打不着火了。

examples.text: The paint wouldn't stick to the wallpaper.
examples.translation: 这种漆不会粘在墙纸上。

examples.text: She asked me what I would like to do and mentioned a particular job...
examples.translation: 她问我想干什么，然后提到了一份工作。

examples.text: Right now, your mom would like a cup of coffee...
examples.translation: 你妈妈现在想喝一杯咖啡。

examples.text: Ideally, she would love to become pregnant again...
examples.translation: 按理想状况来说，她希望再怀上孩子。

examples.text: He wished it would end...
examples.translation: 他希望这会终结。

examples.text: Anne wouldn't mind going to Italy or France to live.
examples.translation: 安妮不会介意去意大利或法国生活。

examples.text: Do you think it would be all right if I smoked?...
examples.translation: 我可以抽烟吗？

examples.text: Mr. Cutler, would you mind if I asked a question?
examples.translation: 卡特勒先生，我可以问您个问题吗？

examples.text: Would you like a drink?...
examples.translation: 想喝一杯吗?

examples.text: Would you like to stay?...
examples.translation: 您愿意留下来吗?

examples.text: Perhaps you would like to pay a visit to London.
examples.translation: 也许,您乐意去游览一下伦敦。

examples.text: Would you do me a favour and get rid of this letter I've just received?...
examples.translation: 请帮个忙把我刚刚收到的这封信处理掉行吗?

examples.text: Would you come in here a moment, please?...
examples.translation: 请进来一下好吗?

examples.text: Would you excuse us for a minute, Cassandra?...
examples.translation: 卡桑德拉，我们出去一会儿你不介意吧?

examples.text: Oh dear, there's the doorbell. See who it is, would you, darling.
examples.translation: 哦,天哪，门铃响了。看看是谁好吗，亲爱的。

examples.text: Well, you would say that: you're a man...
examples.translation: 呵，你当然会这样说的，因为你是个男的。

examples.text: 'Well, then Francesca turned round and said, That's a stupid question.' — 'She would, wouldn't she.'
examples.translation: “嗯，接着弗朗西丝卡转过身说，这个问题问得真蠢。”——“她肯定会这么说，不是吗？”

examples.text: I think you'd agree he's a very respected columnist...
examples.translation: 我想你得承认他是个备受尊敬的专栏作家。

examples.text: I would have thought it a proper job for the Army to fight rebellion...
examples.translation: 我会认为派军队去平叛是恰当之举。

examples.text: 'Was it much different for you when you started at the Foreign Office?' — 'Worse, I'd expect.'...
examples.translation: “你开始在外交部干的时候感觉很不一样吗？”——“我想是更糟一些。”

examples.text: I would imagine she's quite lonely living on her own.
examples.translation: 我猜想她一个人过肯定很孤独。

examples.text: If I were you I would simply ring your friend's bell and ask for your bike back...
examples.translation: 如果我是你,我就会直接去按你朋友的门铃, 把自行车要回来。

examples.text: I would not, if I were you, be inclined to discuss private business with the landlady...
examples.translation: 我要是你，就不会跟房东太太谈私事。

examples.text: There could be more unrest, but I wouldn't exaggerate the problems.
examples.translation: 可能会有更大的动荡，不过我想也不必夸大问题。

examples.text: Chris is so full of artistic temperament you'd never think she was the daughter of a banker...
examples.translation: 克丽丝极富艺术气质，你根本想不到她是银行家的女儿。

examples.text: Inside, he admits, his emotions may be churning, but you would never guess it.
examples.translation: 他承认，内心里他可能心潮起伏，但你根本不会猜到。

examples.text: Sunday mornings my mother would bake. I'd stand by the fridge and help...
examples.translation: 星期天早晨，妈妈会烤面包，我就站在冰箱旁帮忙。

examples.text: 'Beauty is only skin deep,' my mother would say.
examples.translation: “美是肤浅的。”妈妈会说。

examples.text: Within ten weeks of the introduction, 34 million people would have been reached by our television commercials.
examples.translation: 在推出10周之内，可能会有3,400万人看到我们的电视广告。

examples.text: My daughter would have been 17 this week if she had lived...
examples.translation: 我女儿要是还活着的话，这周就17岁了。

examples.text: If I had known how he felt, I would never have let him adopt those children...
examples.translation: 我要是知道他的想法，我是决不会让他领养那些孩子的。

examples.text: If I had not been enjoying the work, I would not have done so much of it.
examples.translation: 如果我不喜欢这份工作的话，就不会这么卖命干了。

examples.text: I would have liked a life in politics...
examples.translation: 我本想从政的。

examples.text: She would have liked to ask questions, but he had moved on to another topic...
examples.translation: 她本想问问题，但他又继续谈另一个话题去了。

examples.text: He also had made it a practice to dine there regularly, though he would have preferred being at home.
examples.translation: 他也习惯了经常在那里就餐，虽然他原本更喜欢在家吃的。

examples.text: I would never have done what they did.
examples.translation: 他们做的事情我是决不会做的。

examples.text: Would that he could have listened to his father.
examples.translation: 他要是听了他父亲的话就好了。

examples.text: The wound is healing nicely...
examples.translation: 伤口愈合得很好。

examples.text: Six soldiers are reported to have died from their wounds.
examples.translation: 据报道，有6名士兵因伤而亡。

examples.text: A bomb exploded in a hotel, killing six people and wounding another five...
examples.translation: 一枚炸弹在一家旅馆爆炸，造成6人死亡，5人受伤。

examples.text: The driver of an evacuation bus was wounded by shrapnel...
examples.translation: 一辆疏散大巴的司机被弹片炸伤。

examples.text: The two wounded men were taken to a nearby hospital.
examples.translation: 两名受伤男子被送到附近医院。

examples.text: Hospitals said they could not cope with the wounded...
examples.translation: 医院表示无力收治这么多伤者。

examples.text: They were told to carry their wounded and leave their dead.
examples.translation: 他们被命令抬走伤员，丢下死者。

examples.text: She has been so deeply hurt it may take forever for the wounds to heal.
examples.translation: 她内心受伤太深，也许再也无法愈合。

examples.text: He was deeply wounded by the treachery of close aides...
examples.translation: 他被亲密助手的背叛深深地伤害了。

examples.text: My children have wounded me in the past.
examples.translation: 我的孩子们过去曾伤害过我。

examples.text: I think she feels desperately wounded and unloved.
examples.translation: 我想她觉得受到了莫大的伤害，无人爱她。

examples.text: The British team was returning home yesterday to lick its wounds after defeat by India.
examples.translation: 英国队负于印度队后，昨日回国休整。

examples.text: Courts have been reluctant to reopen old wounds by trying crimes that are decades old.
examples.translation: 法院不愿重揭旧伤疤，去审理几十年前的罪案。

examples.text: Harry had carefully bought and wrapped presents for Mark to give them...
examples.translation: 哈里精心购置了礼物又仔细包好，让马克交给他们。

examples.text: Mexican Indians used to wrap tough meat in leaves from the papaya tree.
examples.translation: 墨西哥印第安人过去常用番木瓜树叶把难嚼的肉包起来。

examples.text: Diana is taking the opportunity to wrap up the family presents.
examples.translation: 黛安娜利用这个机会将家人的礼物包起来。

examples.text: I tucked some plastic wrap around the sandwiches to keep them from getting stale.
examples.translation: 我用塑料包装纸把三明治裹起来，防止变质。

examples.text: ...gift wrap.
examples.translation: 礼品包装纸

examples.text: She wrapped a handkerchief around her bleeding palm...
examples.translation: 她用手绢将流血的手掌包扎起来。

examples.text: Then she stood up, wrapping her coat around her angrily...
examples.translation: 然后她站了起来，怒气冲冲地穿上大衣。

examples.text: Wrap the foil over the fish.
examples.translation: 用箔纸把鱼包起来。

examples.text: He wrapped his arms around her.
examples.translation: 他紧紧搂住她。

examples.text: The bids were submitted in May and were meant to have been kept under wraps until October...
examples.translation: 标书5月份递交，本欲10月份才予以公布。

examples.text: The date and venue of the game must remain under wraps...
examples.translation: 比赛的时间和地点必须保密。

examples.text: You can never keep a launch as big as ours completely under wraps.
examples.translation: 像我们这么大规模的新品发布，要绝对保密是不可能的。

examples.text: The coffin lying before the altar was bare, except for a single wreath of white roses...
examples.translation: 祭台前的棺木上除了仅有的一个白玫瑰花圈外，没有其他任何装饰。

examples.text: The British, Australian and Turkish Prime Ministers laid wreaths at the war memorial.
examples.translation: 英国首相、澳大利亚总理和土耳其总理向战争纪念碑敬献了花圈。

meanings.meaning: 破坏；失事；残骸；失去健康的人

examples.text: He wrecked the garden...
examples.translation: 他毁掉了花园。

examples.text: A coalition could have defeated the government and wrecked the treaty...
examples.translation: 联盟本来可以击败政府并毁掉该条约的。

examples.text: His life has been wrecked by the tragedy.
examples.translation: 他的生活被这场灾难毁掉了。

examples.text: ...missed promotions, lost jobs, wrecked marriages.
examples.translation: 错过的提升机会，失去的工作，破裂的婚姻

examples.text: They may be remembered as the wreckers of a fine company.
examples.translation: 他们也许会因为搞垮一家好公司而留下恶名。

examples.text: The ship was wrecked by an explosion.
examples.translation: 这艘船被炸毁了。

examples.text: ...a wrecked cargo ship.
examples.translation: 失事的货船

examples.text: ...the wreck of a sailing ship...
examples.translation: 帆船的残骸

examples.text: The car was a total wreck...
examples.translation: 这辆车完全报废了。

examples.text: We thought of buying the house as a wreck, doing it up, then selling it.
examples.translation: 我们想过把这栋房子当作废弃建筑买下来，修缮一下，然后再卖掉。

examples.text: He was killed in a car wreck.
examples.translation: 他在一场车祸中丧生。

examples.text: ...the little girl that survived that plane wreck...
examples.translation: 在空难中幸存的小女孩

examples.text: What would he tell his parents if he had a wreck?
examples.translation: 如果他出了事故，他怎么向他的父母交代？

examples.text: You look a wreck...
examples.translation: 你看起来身体很糟糕。

examples.text: It was embarrassing and sad to see this man reduced to a mumbling wreck.
examples.translation: 看见这个人变得口齿不清、弱不禁风，真是让人既难堪又悲哀。

meanings.meaning: 扳手，扳钳；扭伤；痛苦；歪曲；猛扭

examples.text: He felt two men wrench the suitcase from his hand...
examples.translation: 他感觉有两个人在使劲拽他手里的手提箱。

examples.text: He wrenched off his sneakers...
examples.translation: 他使劲儿脱下运动鞋。

examples.text: They wrenched open the passenger doors and jumped into her car.
examples.translation: 他们使劲拽开后座车门，跳进了她的车子。

examples.text: She wrenched herself from his grasp...
examples.translation: 她从他手里挣脱开来。

examples.text: He wrenched his arm free...
examples.translation: 他把手臂挣脱开来。

examples.text: She tore at one man's face as she tried to wrench free...
examples.translation: 她试图挣脱时朝一个男子的脸上抓去。

examples.text: I wrenched my hand away from my attacker.
examples.translation: 我用力把手从袭击者手里挣脱出来。

examples.text: He had wrenched his ankle badly from the force of the fall.
examples.translation: 他因摔倒而严重扭伤了脚踝。

examples.text: I always knew it would be a wrench to leave Essex after all these years...
examples.translation: 我一直心里清楚过了这么多年后离开埃塞克斯会非常痛苦。

examples.text: Many of the things are of great sentimental value and it is going to be a wrench parting with them...
examples.translation: 其中很多东西都具有重要的情感价值，令人难以割舍。

examples.text: Although it would be a wrench, we would all accept the challenge of moving abroad.
examples.translation: 虽然移居海外会很痛苦，但我们都愿意接受这个挑战。

examples.text: Their delegation threw a giant monkey wrench into the process this week by raising all sorts of petty objections.
examples.translation: 他们的代表团本周提出了各种细枝末节的反对意见，极在地阻挠了进程。

meanings.meaning: 可怜的；卑鄙的；令人苦恼或难受的

examples.text: You have built up a huge property empire by buying from wretched people who had to sell or starve.
examples.translation: 你靠从那些不卖房就得挨饿的可怜人手里买下房子后建立起了庞大的房产帝国。

examples.text: The country's 37 million people are wretchedly poor.
examples.translation: 该国3,700万人一贫如洗。

examples.text: ...prisoners living in wretchedly overcrowded conditions.
examples.translation: 生活在拥挤不堪的环境中的囚徒

examples.text: He does deserve some good luck after so much wretchedness.
examples.translation: 经过这么多苦难之后，他应该行点好运了。

examples.text: Wretched woman, he thought, why the hell can't she wait?...
examples.translation: 他想，可恶的女人，她怎么就不能等一等呢？

examples.text: Theft is something that really disgusts me. It makes me feel hateful towards this whole wretched island.
examples.translation: 偷窃是让我深恶痛绝的事情，它让我对这整个该死的岛都充满仇视。

examples.text: I feel really confused and wretched...
examples.translation: 我觉得十分迷惘，难过极了。

examples.text: The wretched look on the little girl's face made him sorry.
examples.translation: 小女孩脸上痛苦的表情让他很难受。

examples.text: His marriage was wretchedly unhappy...
examples.translation: 他的婚姻很不幸福。

examples.text: 'I made it all up,' she said wretchedly.
examples.translation: “这都是我编出来的。”她难过地说。

examples.text: ...their shared wretchedness at Werner's death.
examples.translation: 他们对沃纳之死共同的哀伤

examples.text: What a wretched excuse...
examples.translation: 多么拙劣的借口！

examples.text: The pay has always been wretched.
examples.translation: 薪水总是少得可怜。

examples.text: His face was covered with wrinkles...
examples.translation: 他的脸上布满了皱纹。

examples.text: Some deep wrinkles furrow his lower forehead.
examples.translation: 他额头下方出现了几道深深的皱纹。

examples.text: The skin on her cheeks and around her eyes was beginning to wrinkle.
examples.translation: 她两颊和双眼周围开始起了皱纹。

examples.text: ...protection against the sun's rays that age and wrinkle the skin.
examples.translation: 防晒以免皮肤老化起皱

examples.text: I did indeed look older and more wrinkled than ever.
examples.translation: 我的确比从前显老, 皱纹也多了。

examples.text: He noticed a wrinkle in her stocking.
examples.translation: 他注意到她长筒袜上有一道褶儿。

examples.text: Her stockings wrinkled at the ankles...
examples.translation: 她的长筒袜在脚踝处起了褶儿。

examples.text: I wrinkled the velvet.
examples.translation: 我把天鹅绒布弄皱了。

examples.text: His suit was wrinkled and he looked very tired.
examples.translation: 他的西服皱巴巴的，整个人显得非常疲惫。

examples.text: Frannie wrinkled her nose at her daughter...
examples.translation: 弗兰妮朝她女儿皱了皱鼻子。

examples.text: Ellen's face wrinkles as if she is about to sneeze.
examples.translation: 艾伦的脸皱了起来，好像要打喷嚏。

examples.text: Carpal tunnel syndrome is a painful condition caused by a pinched nerve in the wrist.
If you'd like one, simply write your name and address on a postcard and send it to us...
examples.translation: 如果你想要一个的话，只要把姓名、住址写在一张明信片上寄给我们就行。

examples.text: They were still trying to teach her to read and write...
examples.translation: 他们还在试图教她读书写字。

examples.text: He wrote the word 'pride' in huge letters on the blackboard.
examples.translation: 他在黑板上写了一个大大的单词pride。

examples.text: I had written quite a lot of orchestral music in my student days...
examples.translation: 我在学生时代创作过很多管弦乐作品。

examples.text: Finding a volunteer to write the computer program isn't a problem...
examples.translation: 找个志愿者编这个计算机程序不成问题。

examples.text: Thereafter she wrote articles for papers and magazines in Paris...
examples.translation: 此后她给巴黎的报纸和杂志撰稿。

examples.text: Jung Lu wrote me a poem once.
examples.translation: 荣路有一次给我写了一首诗。

examples.text: Jay wanted to write...
examples.translation: 杰伊想要写作。

examples.text: She writes for many papers, including the Sunday Times...
examples.translation: 她给包括《星期日泰晤士报》在内的很多报纸撰稿。

examples.text: He now works in industry and writes on science in his spare time.
examples.translation: 他现在在企业工作，业余时间写点科学文章。

examples.text: Many people have written to me on this subject...
examples.translation: 很多人给我写信探讨这个问题。

examples.text: She had written him a note a couple of weeks earlier...
examples.translation: 她几周前给他写过一个便条。

examples.text: I wrote a letter to the car rental agency, explaining what had happened...
examples.translation: 我给租车行写了一封信说明发生的情况。

examples.text: Why didn't you write, call, anything?...
examples.translation: 你为什么不写信，不打电话，什么也不做？

examples.text: He had written her in Italy but received no reply.
examples.translation: 他在意大利给她写过信，但没有收到回音。

examples.text: 'Some six months later,' Freud writes, 'Hans had got over his jealousy.'...
examples.translation: “大约6个月后，”弗洛伊德写道，“汉斯克服了他的嫉妒心理。”

examples.text: A few days later he wrote that he had hopes of a staff job.
examples.translation: 几天后，他写信说他有望得到一份行政工作。

examples.text: Snape wrote a receipt with a gold fountain pen...
examples.translation: 斯内普用金笔开了一张收据。

examples.text: I'll write you a cheque in a moment.
examples.translation: 我过会儿给你开张支票。

examples.text: We went straight to the estate agent and wrote out a cheque...
examples.translation: 我们径直到房地产经纪人那里开了一张支票。

examples.text: Get my wife to write you out a receipt before you leave.
examples.translation: 你走之前让我太太给你开个收据。

examples.text: You should write-protect all disks that you do not usually need to write to.
examples.translation: 你应该对你通常不需要写入内容的磁盘进行写保护。

examples.text: Turner is a writer and critic.
examples.translation: 特纳是作家兼批评家。

examples.text: ...detective stories by American writers.
examples.translation: 美国作家创作的侦探小说

examples.text: ...novelist and travel writer Paul Theroux.
examples.translation: 小说家兼游记作家保罗·泰鲁

examples.text: ...Frank Keating, this paper's respected sports writer.
examples.translation: 弗兰克·基廷——本报备受尊敬的体育专栏作家

examples.text: No-one is to see the document without the permission of the writer of the report...
examples.translation: 此报告未经作者允许，任何人不得翻阅。

examples.text: I can't agree with the letter writer who claims bringing back the death penalty would be an abuse of human rights.
examples.translation: 我不能赞同写信人所称恢复死刑就是侵犯人权的说法。

meanings.meaning: 书写；作品；著作；[法] 笔迹

examples.text: 'It's from a notebook,' the sheriff said, 'And there's writing on it.'...
examples.translation: “这是在一个笔记本里找到的，”法官道，“上面还有文字。”

examples.text: If you have a complaint about your holiday, please inform us in writing.
examples.translation: 如果您对您的假日有什么意见，请书面告知我们。

examples.text: The writing is brutally tough and savagely humorous...
examples.translation: 该作品带有残酷的强悍和野性的幽默感。

examples.text: It was such a brilliant piece of writing.
examples.translation: 这真是一篇才华横溢的文章。

examples.text: She had begun to be a little bored with novel writing.
examples.translation: 她开始对写小说有些厌倦了。

examples.text: ...activities to help prepare children for writing.
examples.translation: 帮助孩子准备写作的活动

examples.text: It was a little difficult to read your writing...
examples.translation: 你写的字有点不好认。

examples.text: I think it's due to being left handed that he's got terrible writing.
examples.translation: 我想他的书写这么糟糕是因为他是左撇子。

examples.text: Althusser's writings are focused mainly on France...
examples.translation: 阿尔都塞的著作主要是论述法国的。

examples.text: The pieces he is reading are adapted from the writings of Michael Frayn.
examples.translation: 他目前阅读的作品改编自迈克尔·弗雷恩的著作。

examples.text: The writing is clearly on the wall. If we do nothing about it, we shall only have ourselves to blame.
examples.translation: 凶兆显而易见。如果我们对此毫无行动，就只能怨自己了。

meanings.meaning: 错误地；邪恶的，不正当地
错误的；失常的；不适当的

examples.text: Pain is the body's way of telling us that something is wrong...
examples.translation: 疼痛是身体在告诉我们有地方出问题了。

examples.text: Nobody seemed to notice anything wrong...
examples.translation: 似乎没有人注意到出了问题。
