examples.text: ...a relationship that felt wrong from the start...
examples.translation: 一开始就觉得不对头的关系

examples.text: He sensed that something was very wrong...
examples.translation: 他感觉到有些地方很不对劲。

examples.text: What's wrong with him?
examples.translation: 他怎么了？

examples.text: He went to the wrong house...
examples.translation: 他去错了房子。

examples.text: The wrong man had been punished...
examples.translation: 罚错了人。

examples.text: Could you have given them the wrong drug by mistake?...
examples.translation: 你有没有可能一时疏忽给错他们药了呢？

examples.text: There is no right or wrong way to do these exercises.
examples.translation: 做这些练习的方法无所谓对错。

examples.text: You've done it wrong...
examples.translation: 你做错了。

examples.text: I must have dialed wrong.
examples.translation: 我一定是拨错号了。

examples.text: I really made the wrong decision there...
examples.translation: 在那点上我的决定确实错了。

examples.text: The wrong choice of club might limit your chances of success...
examples.translation: 选错俱乐部也许会限制你成功的机会。

examples.text: We got married when I was 30 for all the wrong reasons.
examples.translation: 由于种种阴差阳错，我30岁时我们结了婚。

examples.text: How do you know that this explanation is wrong?...
examples.translation: 你怎么知道这个解释是错误的呢？

examples.text: 20 per cent of the calculations are wrong.
examples.translation: 这些计算有20%是错误的。

examples.text: ...a clock which showed the wrong time...
examples.translation: 显示的时间有误的钟

examples.text: Lots of people got the questions wrong.
examples.translation: 很多人把问题理解错了。

examples.text: I must have added it up wrong, then...
examples.translation: 那我一定是加错了。

examples.text: It looks like it's spelled wrong...
examples.translation: 看起来像是拼错了。

examples.text: I can see exactly where he went wrong.
examples.translation: 我知道他究竟错在哪儿了。

examples.text: A child was wrongly diagnosed as having a bone tumour...
examples.translation: 一个孩子被误诊为患了骨瘤。

examples.text: Civilians assume, wrongly, that everything in the military runs smoothly.
examples.translation: 老百姓以为军队中一切都运转正常，其实不然。

examples.text: We think there's something wrong with the computer...
examples.translation: 我们认为计算机出了故障。

examples.text: Something must have gone wrong with the satellite link.
examples.translation: 卫星连接一定出了毛病。

examples.text: I was wrong about it being a casual meeting...
examples.translation: 我误以为这是个非正式会议。

examples.text: Am I wrong in thinking that?...
examples.translation: 我这么想错了吗？

examples.text: It would be wrong to assume that rich countries will always be able to insulate themselves with drugs against the ravages of new diseases...
examples.translation: 要是以为富国总能为自己备好药物以抵御新发疾病的侵害，那就错了。

examples.text: He was wrong to call it science...
examples.translation: 他将此称之为科学是错误的。

examples.text: I'm sure you've got it wrong. Kate isn't like that...
examples.translation: 我敢保证你弄错了，凯特不是那个样子的。

examples.text: It's been very nice to prove them wrong.
examples.translation: 非常高兴能证明他们错了。

examples.text: 'I thought you and I were going to spend the night together,' he whispered. 'You thought wrong,' Nancy whispered back.
examples.translation: “我以为我和你要一起过夜呢。”他小声说。“你想错了。”南茜小声回应道。

examples.text: She was wrong to leave her child alone...
examples.translation: 她不该把孩子单独留在那儿。

examples.text: We don't consider we did anything wrong.
examples.translation: 我们认为我们没有做错什么。

examples.text: ...a man who believes that he has done no wrong.
examples.translation: 认为自己毫无过失的男子

examples.text: Is it wrong to try to save the life of someone you love?...
examples.translation: 尽力挽救所爱之人的生命难道错了吗？

examples.text: It is wrong that we have to tell ill people to go somewhere else to look for treatment...
examples.translation: 我们不得不让病人到别处求医的做法是不可取的。

examples.text: They thought slavery was morally wrong...
examples.translation: 他们认为奴隶制在道义上是错误的。

examples.text: You mustn't do that. It's wrong...
examples.translation: 你不能这么做。这是不对的。

examples.text: The only thing I consider wrong is when you hurt someone...
examples.translation: 我认为唯一的过错就是伤害别人。

examples.text: There is nothing wrong with journalists commenting on the attractiveness of artists.
examples.translation: 记者评论艺术家的个人魅力无可厚非。

examples.text: Johnson didn't seem to be able to tell the difference between right and wrong.
examples.translation: 约翰逊似乎不能分辨是非曲直。

examples.text: I intend to right that wrong...
examples.translation: 我打算纠正那个错误。

examples.text: The insurance company should not be held liable for the wrongs of one of its agents.
examples.translation: 保险公司不应该为其中一名保险代理所犯的错误负责。

examples.text: You have wronged my mother...
examples.translation: 你冤枉了我妈妈。

examples.text: She felt she'd been wronged...
examples.translation: 她觉得受委屈了。

examples.text: Those who have wronged must be ready to say: 'We have hurt you by this injustice.'
examples.translation: 冤枉了别人的人一定要勇于说：“我们待你不公，伤害了你。”

examples.text: If you went to the wrong school, you won't get the job...
examples.translation: 如果你进错了学校，就得不到这份工作。

examples.text: The prospect of easy profits has attracted the wrong kind of businessman.
examples.translation: 轻松捞取利润的可能性吸引了一拨不良商人。

examples.text: Don't get me wrong, it's interesting work. But it's not permanent...
examples.translation: 别误会我的意思，这个工作很有意思，可惜不是长期性的。

examples.text: I mean, don't get me wrong. Joanie's my best friend, but she can be kind of a pain sometimes.
examples.translation: 别误会，我的意思是乔安妮是我最好的朋友，但她有时候可能有点儿招人烦。

examples.text: It all went horribly wrong...
examples.translation: 情况完全变得一团糟。

examples.text: Nearly everything that could go wrong has gone wrong.
examples.translation: 差不多可能出乱子的地方都出了乱子。

examples.text: He didn't press charges because he was in the wrong...
examples.translation: 他没有起诉，因为过错在他。

examples.text: She was the one in the wrong.
examples.translation: 她是有过错的一方。

examples.text: She was advised to have an abdominal X-ray.
examples.translation: 她被建议拍一张腹部的X光片。

examples.text: All hand baggage would be x-rayed...
examples.translation: 所有的手提行李都要接受X光检查。

examples.text: They took my pulse, took my blood pressure, and X-rayed my jaw.
examples.translation: 他们给我量了脉搏、血压，还给我的下颌拍了X光片。

meanings.meaning: 院子；码（英制中丈量长度单位，1码=3英尺）；庭院；帆桁

examples.text: The incident took place about 500 yards from where he was standing...
examples.translation: 事件发生在距他所站位置大约500码远的地方。

examples.text: A few yards away, Jos Vargas stands beside his small home.
examples.translation: 几码之外，乔斯·瓦尔加斯站在他的小房子旁边。

examples.text: ...a long narrow strip of linen two or three yards long.
examples.translation: 两三码长的细长亚麻布条

examples.text: ...a yard of silk.
examples.translation: 一码丝绸

examples.text: I saw him standing in the yard.
examples.translation: 我看到他站在院子里。

examples.text: ...a railway yard.
examples.translation: 铁路调车场

examples.text: ...a ship repair yard.
examples.translation: 船舶修理场

examples.text: He dug a hole in our yard on Edgerton Avenue to plant a maple tree when I was born.
examples.translation: 我出生的时候，他在埃杰顿大街我们家的园圃里挖了个坑，种了棵枫树。

examples.text: She yawned, and stretched lazily...
examples.translation: 她打了个哈欠，伸了个懒腰。

examples.text: They looked bored and yawned at the speeches.
examples.translation: 他们看起来已经厌倦了这些演讲，直打哈欠。

examples.text: Rosanna stifled a huge yawn.
examples.translation: 罗莎娜想打个大哈欠，但强忍住了。

examples.text: The debate was a mockery. A big yawn...
examples.translation: 这场辩论实在可笑。简直是无聊透顶。

examples.text: The concert was a predictable yawn.
examples.translation: 果不其然，那场音乐会很乏味。

examples.text: The gulf between them yawned wider than ever...
examples.translation: 他们之间的隔阂比以往任何时候都要深。

examples.text: Liddie's doorway yawned blackly open at the end of the hall.
examples.translation: 走廊尽头利迪的门黑洞洞地敞开着。

meanings.meaning: 年；年度；历年；年纪；一年的期间；某年级的学生

examples.text: The year was 1840...
We had an election last year.
examples.translation: 去年我们进行了一次选举。

examples.text: ...the number of people on the planet by the year 2050.
examples.translation: 到2050年这个星球上的人口数量

examples.text: The museums attract more than two and a half million visitors a year...
examples.translation: 这些博物馆一年能吸引逾250万名参观者。

examples.text: She's done quite a bit of work this past year...
examples.translation: 过去的一年里她做了不少工作。

examples.text: The school has been empty for ten years.
examples.translation: 学校已经空置10年了。

examples.text: He's 58 years old...
examples.translation: 他58岁。

examples.text: I've been in trouble since I was eleven years of age...
examples.translation: 我从11岁起就麻烦不断。

examples.text: This column is ten years old today.
examples.translation: 这个专栏到今天已经开办10年了。

examples.text: ...the 1990/91 academic year...
The twins didn't have to repeat their second year at school.
examples.translation: 这对双胞胎不需要重读二年级。

examples.text: The first years and second years got a choice of French, German and Spanish.
examples.translation: 一年级和二年级学生可以在法语、德语和西班牙语中选一门。

examples.text: He announced big tax increases for the next two financial years...
examples.translation: 他宣布在接下来的两个财年里将大幅提高税收。

examples.text: The company admits it will make a loss for the year ending September.
examples.translation: 公司承认到9月本财年结束时将会出现亏损。

examples.text: I haven' laughed so much in years...
examples.translation: 我很久没这么畅快地笑过了。

examples.text: It took me years to fully recover...
examples.translation: 我过了很久才完全康复。

examples.text: People hold onto letters for years and years.
examples.translation: 人们经年累月地保存着信件。

examples.text: The joy turned to tragedy during his years in Cyprus.
examples.translation: 他在塞浦路斯的那段日子里，生活由喜转悲。

examples.text: ...his years as Director of the Manchester City Art Gallery.
examples.translation: 他担任曼彻斯特城市艺术馆馆长的那些年

examples.text: Regulars return year after year...
examples.translation: 老主顾每年都会再来。

examples.text: You keep on amazing me, year after year, the same old ways.
examples.translation: 你不断地给我同样的惊喜，年年如此。

examples.text: This problem has increased year by year...
examples.translation: 这个问题一年比一年严重。

examples.text: The department has been shrinking year by year because of budget cuts.
examples.translation: 这个部门因为预算削减而逐年萎缩。

examples.text: Year in, year out, nothing changes...
examples.translation: 年复一年，一切照旧。

examples.text: With stockbroking it was the same thing, year in year out.
examples.translation: 证券经纪工作每年都重复着一成不变的内容。

examples.text: He was moving with surprising speed for a man of his years...
examples.translation: 他的行动速度对于他那个年纪的人来说很是惊人。

examples.text: A young man of his years needed to have a separate room.
examples.translation: 他那个年纪的年轻人需要有个单独的房间。

examples.text: I always turn adversity and defeat into victories, but it's probably put ten years on me.
examples.translation: 我总是能够扭转逆境，反败为胜，但这可能让我显得老成了10岁。

examples.text: Town gardens are ideal because they produce flowers nearly all year round...
examples.translation: 城市公园是理想去处，那里几乎一年四季鲜花盛开。

examples.text: Drinking and driving is a problem all the year round.
examples.translation: 酒后驾车是个常年存在的问题。

examples.text: Changing your hairstyle can take ten years off you.
examples.translation: 换换发型能让你年轻10岁。

examples.text: The seven major industrial countries will have their yearly meeting in London.
examples.translation: 7个主要工业国家将在伦敦举行一年一度的会议。

examples.text: Clients normally pay fees in advance, monthly, quarterly, or yearly.
examples.translation: 客户通常按月、季度或年度预付费用。

examples.text: In Holland, the government sets a yearly budget for health care.
examples.translation: 在荷兰，政府会制定医疗保健部门的年度预算。

examples.text: Novello says college students will spend $4.2 billion yearly on alcoholic beverages.
examples.translation: 诺韦洛说大学生每年在酒精饮品上会消费掉42亿美元。

examples.text: 'Eva!' he yelled...
examples.translation: “伊娃！”他大喊道。

examples.text: I'm sorry I yelled at you last night...
examples.translation: 很抱歉昨天晚上我冲着你大吼大叫的。

examples.text: Christian pushed him away, yelling abuse...
examples.translation: 克里斯蒂安一边把他推开，一边高声谩骂着。

examples.text: He was out there shouting and yelling.
examples.translation: 他在外面，又嚷又叫的。

examples.text: 'Are you coming or not?' they yelled out after him.
examples.translation: “你来不来？”他们在他后面大声喊道。

examples.text: Something brushed past Bob's face and he let out a yell.
examples.translation: 有什么东西从鲍勃的脸上扫过，他大叫了一声。

examples.text: The walls have been painted bright yellow...
examples.translation: 墙壁漆成了亮黄色。

examples.text: Kim opted for cooler blues and yellows in the master bedroom.
examples.translation: 金为主卧室挑选了偏冷色调的蓝色和黄色。

examples.text: The flesh of his cheeks seemed to have yellowed...
examples.translation: 他似乎有些面色发黄。

examples.text: She sat scanning the yellowing pages.
examples.translation: 她坐着浏览发黄的书页。

examples.text: In informal English, yes is often pronounced in a casual way that is usually written as yeah.
examples.translation: 在非正式英语中，yes的发音常较为随意，通常写作yeah。

examples.text: 'You actually wrote it down, didn't you?' — 'Yes.'...
examples.translation: “你的确把它写下来了，对吗？”——“是的。”

examples.text: Will she say yes when I ask her out?
examples.translation: 我约她出去，她会答应吗？

examples.text: 'More wine?' — 'Yes please.'...
examples.translation: “再来点酒？”——“好的。”

examples.text: 'Will you take me there?' — 'Yes, I will.'...
examples.translation: “你可以带我去那儿吗？”——“可以。”

examples.text: 'Can I ask you something?' — 'Yes, of course.'
examples.translation: “我能问你点儿事情吗？”——“当然可以。”

examples.text: 'Well I suppose it is based on the old lunar months isn't it.' — 'Yes that's right.'...
examples.translation: “噢，我想这是按照旧制阴历来算的，是吧？”——“对，是的。”

examples.text: 'That's a type of whitefly, is it?' — 'Yes, it is a whitefly.'
examples.translation: “那是一种粉虱，对吗？”——“是的，是粉虱。”

examples.text: He pushed a button on the intercom. 'Yes?' came a voice...
examples.translation: 他按了内部对讲机上的一个按钮。“有什么事吗？”一个声音问道。

examples.text: Yes, can I help you?
examples.translation: 您好，我能为您效劳吗？

examples.text: 'A lot of people find it very difficult indeed to give up smoking.' —'Oh yes. I used to smoke nearly sixty a day.'...
examples.translation: “很多人觉得戒烟真的非常困难。”——“确实如此，我以前每天抽将近60根香烟。”

examples.text: 'It's a fabulous opportunity.' — 'Yeah. I know.'
examples.translation: “这是一次非常棒的机会。”——“是，我知道。”

examples.text: 'I remembered something funny today.' — 'Yeah?'
examples.translation: “我记得今天有件特别有趣的事。”——“什么事？”

examples.text: 'She is entitled to her personal allowance which is three thousand pounds of income.' — 'Yes, but she doesn't earn any money.'...
examples.translation: “她享有的个人所得免税额是3,000英镑。”——“是的，但是她一分钱都不挣。”

examples.text: Ah yes, but think of all the family life they're missing.
examples.translation: 是这样，不过别忘了他们错过了多少天伦之乐。

examples.text: 'That is not possible,' she said. 'Oh, yes, it is!' Mrs Gruen insisted...
examples.translation: “那不可能，”她说。“不，有可能！”格伦太太坚持道。

examples.text: 'I don't know what you're talking about.' — 'Yes, you do.'
examples.translation: “我不知道你在说什么。”——“不，你知道。”

examples.text: 'There was no way to stop it.' — 'Oh yes? Well, here's something else you won't be able to stop.'
examples.translation: “没法阻止它。”——“是吗？哼，那这还有些别的事也是你没法阻止的。”

examples.text: What was I going to say. Oh yeah, we've finally got our second computer.
examples.translation: 我刚想说什么来着。噢，对了，我们终于有了第二台电脑。

examples.text: He collected the £10,000 first prize. Yes, £10,000.
examples.translation: 他领取了1万英镑的头奖。对，是1万英镑。

examples.text: 'Was it strange for you, going back after such a long absence?' — 'Yes and no.'
examples.translation: “那么长时间不在，然后又回来，你会觉得陌生吗？”——“既陌生又不陌生。”

examples.text: The no-votes are leading the yeses...
examples.translation: 反对票领先于赞成票。

examples.text: The noes have 50 percent, the yeses 35 percent and the rest are undecided.
examples.translation: 反对者占50%，赞成者占35%，其余人尚未决定。

examples.text: She left yesterday...
examples.translation: 她昨天走了。

examples.text: Yesterday she announced that she is quitting her job.
examples.translation: 昨天她宣布打算辞职。

examples.text: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two-one.
examples.translation: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士队以2比1战胜了美国队。

examples.text: The worker of today is different from the worker of yesterday.
examples.translation: 如今的工人和以往的不同了。

examples.text: ...a world without yesterdays or tomorrows.
examples.translation: 没有过去和未来的世界

examples.text: Will she yield to growing pressure for her to retire?...
examples.translation: 面对要求其隐退的压力越来越大，她会屈服吗？

examples.text: I yielded to an impulse...
examples.translation: 我没有忍住冲动。

examples.text: If the government does not yield, it should face sufficient military force to ensure its certain and swift defeat.
examples.translation: 如果政府不让步，它就会面临重兵围困，必将迅速落败。

examples.text: He may yield control...
examples.translation: 他可能会放弃控制权。

examples.text: The President is now under pressure to yield power to the republics.
examples.translation: 总统现在面临着让权给共和党人的压力。

examples.text: Giulio Andreotti yielded up the prime ministership last summer.
examples.translation: 朱利奥·安德烈奥蒂去年夏天辞去了总理之职。

examples.text: Boston's traditional drab brick was slow to yield to the modern glass palaces of so many American urban areas.
examples.translation: 波士顿传统而单调的砖石建筑并没有迅速被许多美国城市地区流行的现代玻璃大厦所取代。

examples.text: When entering a trail or starting a descent, yield to other skiers.
examples.translation: 进入滑雪道或开始下滑时，要给其他滑雪者让路。

examples.text: ...examples of common signs like No Smoking or Yield.
examples.translation: “请勿吸烟”或“让行”之类的常见标志的例子

examples.text: The door yielded easily when he pushed it.
examples.translation: 他一推，门就开了。

examples.text: Last year 400,000 acres of land yielded a crop worth $1.75 billion.
examples.translation: 去年40万英亩的土地产值达17.5亿美元。

examples.text: The shallow sea bed yields up an abundance of food.
examples.translation: 浅海床提供了丰富的食物。

examples.text: ...improving the yield of the crop...
examples.translation: 提高农作物产量

examples.text: Polluted water lessens crop yields.
examples.translation: 受污染的水源会降低农作物产量。

examples.text: It yielded a profit of at least $36 million.
examples.translation: 它带来了至少3,600万美元的收益。

examples.text: ...a yield of 4%...
examples.translation: 4%的收益

examples.text: The high yields available on the dividend shares made them attractive to private investors.
examples.translation: 红利股票的高收益率对私人投资者极具吸引力。

examples.text: ...the yield on a bank's investments.
examples.translation: 一家银行投资带来的收益

examples.text: This research has been in progress since 1961 and has yielded a great number of positive results...
examples.translation: 这项研究自1961年起一直在开展，已取得了不少积极成果。

examples.text: His trip to Melbourne had yielded a lot of information.
examples.translation: 他的墨尔本之行让他大开眼界。

meanings.meaning: (You)人名；(柬)尤；(东南亚国家华语)猷

examples.text: When I saw you across the room I knew I'd met you before...
examples.translation: 看到你穿过房间时，我就知道我以前曾经见过你。

examples.text: You two seem very different to me...
examples.translation: 你们两个似乎与我大不一样。

examples.text: I could always talk to you about anything in the world...
examples.translation: 我总是可以和你谈论世界上的任何事情。

examples.text: What is alternative health care? What can it do for you?...
examples.translation: 什么是另类医疗？它能为你做些什么?

examples.text: What you kids need is more exercise.
examples.translation: 你们这些孩子需要的是多做运动。

examples.text: Getting good results gives you confidence...
examples.translation: 取得好的结果会给人以信心。

examples.text: In those days you did what you were told.
examples.translation: 那时候，你只能听命于人。

examples.text: 'Yous two are no 'gettin' paid,' he said. 'Ye're too lazy!'
examples.translation: “你们两个别指望拿到工钱，”他说。“你们太懒了！”

examples.text: They haven't finished yet...
examples.translation: 他们还没有完成。

examples.text: No decision has yet been made...
examples.translation: 尚未作出决定。

examples.text: She hasn't yet set a date for her marriage...
examples.translation: 她还没选定结婚的日子。

examples.text: 'Has the murderer been caught?' — 'Not yet.'...
examples.translation: “抓住凶手了吗？”——“还没有。”

examples.text: Have you met my husband yet?...
examples.translation: “你见过我丈夫了吗？”

examples.text: Hammer-throwing for women is not yet a major event.
examples.translation: 女子链球运动还不是主要的赛事。

examples.text: There was so much that Sam didn't know yet...
examples.translation: 还有很多是萨姆当时不知道的。

examples.text: He had asked around and learned that Billy was not yet here.
examples.translation: 他四处询问，得知比利还没到这儿。

examples.text: Don't get up yet...
examples.translation: 先不要起床。

examples.text: The hostages cannot go home just yet...
examples.translation: 人质目前还不能回家。

examples.text: We should not yet abandon this option for the disposal of highly radioactive waste.
examples.translation: 我们还不能放弃选择这种方式来处理高辐射废料。

examples.text: This is the BBC's worst idea yet...
examples.translation: 这是到目前为止英国广播公司的最糟糕的点子。

examples.text: Her latest novel is her best yet.
examples.translation: 她的最新小说是她迄今为止最好的一部。

examples.text: ...one of the toughest warnings yet delivered.
examples.translation: 到目前为止发出的最严厉的警告之一

examples.text: Like the best stories, this one may yet have a happy end...
examples.translation: 就像最精彩的故事那样，这个故事也许仍会有个美好的结局。

examples.text: A negotiated settlement might yet be possible.
examples.translation: 也许仍有可能通过磋商达成协议。

examples.text: Unemployment will go on rising for some time yet...
examples.translation: 失业人数在一段时间内还将上升。

examples.text: Nothing will happen for a few years yet...
examples.translation: 几年内还不会有什么事发生。

examples.text: They'll be ages yet.
examples.translation: 他们还得好长时间呢。

examples.text: She has yet to spend a Christmas with her husband...
examples.translation: 她还从没和她的丈夫一起过过圣诞节。

examples.text: He has been nominated three times for the Oscar but has yet to win.
examples.translation: 他已经3次获奥斯卡提名，但从未获奖。

examples.text: I don't eat much, yet I am a size 16...
examples.translation: 我吃得并不多，但是却穿16码的衣服。

examples.text: They were terrified James would die — yet there were moments when they almost wished he would...
examples.translation: 他们很害怕詹姆斯会死——然而，有那么几个瞬间，他们几乎是希望他会死。

examples.text: It is completely waterproof, yet light and comfortable.
examples.translation: 它防水性能非常好，但却轻巧舒适。

examples.text: Yet bigger satellites will be sent up into orbit...
examples.translation: 更为大型的卫星将被送入轨道。

examples.text: I saw yet another doctor...
examples.translation: 我又看了一个医生。

examples.text: They would criticize me, or worse yet, pay me no attention...
examples.translation: 他们会指责我，或者更糟糕的是，干脆对我毫不理睬。

examples.text: By then governments may have woken up to a yet more radical option...
examples.translation: 到那时政府可能已经意识到该采取更为激进的手段。

examples.text: It is plain to see we will not have anything to eat yet again.
examples.translation: 很明显我们又将没有任何东西可吃了。

examples.text: As yet it is not known whether the crash was the result of an accident...
examples.translation: 目前尚不清楚撞车是否是由事故引起的。

examples.text: We have not as yet received a response.
examples.translation: 我们还未收到回复。

meanings.meaning: 年轻的；初期的；没有经验的

examples.text: In Scotland, young people can marry at 16...
examples.translation: 在苏格兰，年轻人16岁就可以结婚。

examples.text: You weren't so very young when she died; you were old enough to remember.
examples.translation: 她去世的时候你不算太年幼，已经能记事了。

examples.text: ...a field of young barley...
examples.translation: 长满青青大麦苗的田地

examples.text: He played with his younger brother.
examples.translation: 他和弟弟一起玩。

examples.translation: 协会建议孕妇、儿童和老年人不要食用此类食物。

examples.translation: 我妈妈年轻时曾经是个成功的时装销售员。

examples.text: I was twenty-three, I suppose, and young for my age...
examples.translation: 我当时23岁，我想，看上去比实际年龄小。

examples.translation: 我觉得他似乎非常年轻，非常孤独。

examples.translation: 雌鸟可能无法给幼鸟喂食。

examples.translation: 其他的孩子则没有这么幸运。

examples.text: I was only a youngster in 1935.
examples.translation: 1935年时我还只是个孩子。

examples.text: Emma, I trust your opinion a great deal...
examples.translation: 埃玛，我非常相信你的看法。

examples.text: I left all of your messages on your desk...
examples.translation: 我把所有给你的便条都放在你书桌上了。

examples.translation: 如果你无法获得所需信息，请查询电话号码簿。

examples.text: Painkillers are very useful in small amounts to bring your temperature down...
examples.translation: 小剂量的止痛药对于降低体温非常有用。

examples.text: I then realized how possible it was to overcome your limitations.
examples.translation: 那时我才意识到，人克服自身局限的可能性到底有多大。

examples.translation: 斯坦·赖利其实并不是那种典型的布赖顿男孩。

examples.text: It's just your average wooden door.
examples.translation: 它就是那种平常的木门。

meanings.meaning: 你（们）的东西；你的责任[义务]；你的家属；来信，尊函
你（们）的（东西）；信末署名前用语

examples.text: I'll take my coat upstairs. Shall I take yours, Roberta?...
examples.translation: 我要把我的外套拿到楼上去。罗伯塔，要我把你的也拿上去吗？

examples.text: I believe Paul was a friend of yours...
examples.translation: 我想保罗曾是你的朋友。

examples.text: If yours is a high-stress job, it is important that you learn how to cope.
examples.translation: 如果你从事一份高压工作，一定要学会如何应对。

examples.text: With best regards, Yours, George...
examples.translation: 致以最诚挚的祝愿，您真挚的，乔治

examples.text: Yours faithfully, Michael Moore, London Business School...
examples.translation: 您忠实的，迈克尔·穆尔，伦敦商学院

examples.text: Waiting to hear from you, Yours sincerely, William Faulkner.
examples.translation: 盼复，您的诚挚的，威廉·福克纳

examples.text: Have the courage to be honest with yourself and about yourself...
examples.translation: 要有勇气对自己坦诚，同时对别人也要开诚布公。

examples.text: Your baby depends on you to look after yourself properly while you are pregnant...
examples.translation: 你怀孕的时候，你的孩子指望着你好好照顾自己。

examples.text: Treat yourselves to a glass of wine to help you relax at the end of the day.
examples.translation: 一天下来，喝上杯葡萄酒，有助于放松自己。

examples.text: They mean to share the business between them, after you yourself are gone, Sir...
examples.translation: 先生，他们两个打算等您本人离开后瓜分这个企业。

examples.text: I've been wondering if you yourselves have any idea why she came.
examples.translation: 我一直在想，你们自己是否知道她为什么来。

examples.text: A wealthy man like yourself is bound to make an enemy or two along the way...
examples.translation: 像你这样的有钱人，一路走来注定会结下一两个仇人的。

examples.text: I wouldn't want to cause such important people as yourselves any bother.
examples.translation: 我不想给你们这样的大人物添任何麻烦。

meanings.meaning: 青年；青春；年轻；青少年时期

examples.text: In my youth my ambition had been to be an inventor.
examples.translation: 我年轻时的抱负是成为一个发明家。

examples.translation: 我少年时代看的漫画书

examples.text: Gregory was still enchanted with Shannon's youth and joy and beauty...
examples.translation: 格雷戈里仍为香农的朝气、快乐和美丽着迷。

examples.text: The team is now a good mixture of experience and youth.
examples.translation: 这个队如今既经验丰富又充满朝气。

examples.text: ...gangs of youths who broke windows and looted shops...
examples.translation: 打碎玻璃橱窗抢劫商店的成群的年轻人

examples.text: A 17-year-old youth was remanded in custody yesterday.
examples.translation: 一名17岁的年轻人昨天被还押候审。

examples.text: He represents the opinions of the youth of today...
examples.translation: 他代表着当今年轻人的看法。

examples.text: She's not a very good influence on the youth of this country.
examples.translation: 她对这个国家的青年一代没什么好影响。

examples.text: ...his zeal for teaching...
examples.translation: 他对教学工作的热情

examples.text: Mr Lopez approached his task with a religious zeal.
examples.translation: 洛佩斯先生以宗教般的热诚对待工作。

examples.text: Auto Zebra in Tokyo's western suburbs sells cars from the early 1960s through the 1970s.
Visibility at the city's airport came down to zero, bringing air traffic to a standstill.
examples.translation: 该市机场的能见度降为零，空中交通陷入了停顿。

examples.text: ...a scale ranging from zero to seven.
examples.translation: 从0到7的范围

examples.text: It's a sunny late winter day, just a few degrees above zero...
examples.translation: 那是晚冬阳光明媚的一天，温度只有零上几度。

examples.text: That night the mercury fell to thirty degrees below zero.
examples.translation: 那天晚上温度计显示气温降到了零下30度。

examples.text: This new ministry was being created with zero assets and zero liabilities.
examples.translation: 这个新部委正在筹建，既无资产也无负债。

examples.text: ...zero inflation...
examples.translation: 零通货膨胀率

examples.text: His chances are zero.
examples.translation: 他毫无机会。

meanings.meaning: 曲折的；锯齿形的；之字形的
使成之字形；使曲折行进
曲折行进；作之字形行进
曲折地；之字形地；Z字形地

examples.text: They staggered in a zigzag across the tarmac.
examples.translation: 他们深一脚浅一脚，跌跌撞撞地穿过停机坪。

examples.text: ...a zigzag pattern.
examples.translation: 锯齿形状

examples.text: I zigzagged down a labyrinth of alleys...
examples.translation: 我在迷宫般的小巷中穿行。

examples.text: Expertly he zigzagged his way across the field, avoiding the deeper gullies.
examples.translation: 他熟练地左一拐右一拐地绕过深沟，穿过了原野。

meanings.meaning: 镀锌于…；涂锌于…；用锌处理

examples.text: In the novel, David Zinc, a young but burned-out attorney, is having a really bad day.

meanings.meaning: 拉链；活力，精力；尖啸声，撕裂声；一种程序压缩的档案文件格式
拉开或拉上；以尖啸声行进
给...以速度；拉上或拉开拉链

examples.text: He pulled the zip of his leather jacket down slightly.
examples.translation: 他稍稍往下拉了拉皮夹克的拉链。

examples.text: She zipped her jeans...
examples.translation: 她拉上了牛仔裤的拉链。

examples.translation: 我慢慢地把那些沉重的黑色尼龙袋的拉链拉上并锁好。

examples.text: These files have been zipped up to take up less disk space.
examples.translation: 这些文档已经进行了压缩，以节省磁盘空间。

examples.text: My craft zipped across the bay...
examples.translation: 我的小艇飞速驶过海湾。

examples.text: Max zips back and forth across the living room.
examples.translation: 马克斯在客厅里快速地来回走动。

examples.text: Share options will play a bigger role in future, putting zip into the performance of middle managers...
examples.translation: 认股权在未来会发挥更大的作用，将激发中层管理者的工作热情，使其有更出色的表现。

examples.text: Tommy Tune gives the choreography his usual class and zip.
examples.translation: 汤米·图恩在编排的舞蹈中注入其一贯的优雅和活力。

examples.text: Many people have stayed behind in the potential war zone...
examples.translation: 许多人留在了可能会沦为交战区的地方。

examples.text: The area has been declared a disaster zone.
examples.translation: 这个地区已经被宣布为灾难地带。

examples.text: ...time zones.
examples.translation: 时区

examples.translation: 这块地未划作商业用地。

examples.translation: 公园中的大多数私人土地并未进行任何专门规划或保护。

examples.text: ...the use of zoning to preserve agricultural land...
examples.translation: 通过土地规划以保护农业用地

examples.text: Local zoning laws prohibit building near property lines.
examples.translation: 本地的规划法禁止在地产边界附近进行建筑施工。

examples.text: He took his son Christopher to the zoo.
examples.translation: 他带着儿子克里斯托弗去了动物园。

examples.text: ...the penguin pool at London Zoo.
examples.translation: 伦敦动物园的企鹅馆

examples.text: We zoomed through the gallery...
examples.translation: 我们飞快地穿过画廊。

examples.text: A police car zoomed by very close to them.
examples.translation: 一辆警车从他们身边擦身疾驰而过。

examples.text: The economy shrank and inflation zoomed...
examples.translation: 经济萎缩，通货膨胀加剧。

examples.text: Profits zoomed from nil in 1981 to about 16 million last year.
examples.translation: 利润从1981年的零收益飙升至去年的 1,600万。
